Furthermore, by defeating Nightmares, you obtain fragments of their essence. These essence fragments can be combined to create your own Dream Eaters, known as Spirits. These Spirits are capable of consuming Nightmares and can assist you in conflicts that occur within dreams or mental landscapes. During your dreams, you can have two Spirits accompanying you at a time, with a third one on standby. The power and abilities of the Spirits grow stronger as you train, nurture, and enjoy their company. The initial strength of a Spirit is determined by the quantity of essence used to create it.

Remarkably, you possess the ability to summon these Dream Eaters into the real world, although they function under the same rules as they do in dreams. Additionally, you can directly send Dream Eaters to someone else's mind, where they serve as protectors and alarms, safeguarding the individual against nightmares, mind control, and external influences on their thoughts. However, the Dream Eaters' defensive capabilities have limitations, as their power is finite. You can assign two different Dream Eaters to a person simultaneously, and while you can recall them at will, they may also return on their own accord if they are mistreated or if they become your adversary. Furthermore, you can establish dream connections with individuals who possess their own Dream Eaters, enabling shared dream experiences.
objects.title: Dream Eater (Kingdom Hearts)

objects.text:
You possess a built-in failsafe that activates the moment you would otherwise suffer fatal damage. When an attack, environmental hazard, or injury would reduce you beyond survivable limits, your body enters a temporary “critical state” instead of immediately dying. This protection applies regardless of the magnitude of damage received and as a result no single blow, no matter how overwhelming, can immediately end your life.

In this “critical state”, you will be at the absolute threshold of survival but will still be able to act. You can move, defend yourself, or attempt escape, but any further attacks, no matter how minor, will result in immediate and permanent death.

However, any healing abilities or medical intervention applied for a even brief time is sufficient to restore you above the lethal threshold, at which point the failsafe resets and becomes ready to trigger again. Without such healing, you will remain in this precarious state indefinitely, balanced between life and death.
objects.title: Second Chance (Kingdom Hearts)

objects.text:
...is to cut. There is only one, maybe two people in the entire Multiverse who have the skill to cut. And it is much more than just cutting something with a sword. To Cut means division by the blade of Want, that parer of potentials that excises infinities. And by cutting, you cut not only the physical, but the universe itself. At the point where you start, it is “merely” the ability to cut through anything not completely invincible. But by studying and growing the act of cutting, you will grow in Strength.

At the end of the road for this, you will be able to cut anything, no matter how strong, durable, esoteric or abstract it is. Not only that, but you can cut people without so much as drawing your sword, and cut things just by touching them. You can also project a “laser” from the tip of your sword, and it cuts as well as you can.
objects.title: The Sanctioned Action (Kill Six Billion Demons)

addons.text: In addition to the Light-based subclasses taught by the Vanguard, you have also mastered the Darkness subclasses of your chosen Guardian Class.

Your ability to manifest the Light of your Soul has allowed you to shed one of the major limitations of Lightbearers, their reliance on their Ghost in order to wield Light. So long as your Soul has energy, you are capable of using your spiritual might to generate Light for your own usage. 

Your ability to generate Light is limited by your ability to supply spiritual energy to be converted into Light, so the greater your spiritual strength, the more Light you can generate. This means that your Light can never truly be taken from you. This pairs well with powers which positively impact the quality and strength of your Soul.
addons.title: Inner Light

objects.text:
You have been resurrected by a Ghost—a fragment of the Traveler whose personality is guaranteed to mesh well with yours. Besides acting as your personal technician and aide, your Ghost acts as a conduit for the Light of the Traveler: a paracausal force of creation and potential. You begin with the skills of a Titan, Hunter, or Warlock already mastered alongside all of the related subclasses as taught by the Tower Vanguard. Beyond this, you are capable of freely wielding the Light in its various forms such as Solar, Arc, and Void, as well as Pure Light, with enough training.

Solar Light requires a person to exploit the power of stellar flame and to understand the star's duality. It allows you to harness the nuclear force to generate scorching fusion fire while also healing and bolstering your allies.

Arc Light is the element of motion and change that occurs as the electromagnetic forces of our universe struggle to achieve balance. You can use it to generate devastating electrical shocks or augment your own movements.

Void Light is the element of cosmic distortion—the pull of gravity and the promise of entropy. You can wield it to distort the fabric of spacetime in order to cause destruction, teleport short distances, and even drain the souls of your enemies.

As a Lightbearer, your control over the paracausal energies of the Traveler allows you to alter causality at will. Apart from enhancing your body to superhuman levels and granting you enhanced movement abilities, you can passively infuse weapons with Light to make them stronger—allowing you to destroy tanks with swords and arrows. To defend yourself, you possess a personal shield that protects you by negating the existence of incoming attacks. Should you be harmed or killed, your Ghost will be able to restore you from almost anything—up to and including complete disintegration.

Being paracausal in nature, you are highly resistant to any and all forms of precognition or temporal manipulation, and you are able push past the limits of fate and destiny in order to make the impossible possible. As long as you possess the Light, your free will cannot be taken from you, and you will exist as a timeless part of existence—being completely unaging. Unlike most Lightbearers, your Ghost does not need access to the Traveler to function and is capable of respawning after 24 hours if it is destroyed.
objects.title: Lightbearer (Destiny)

addons.text:
Your Firebending and Solar Energy abilities have fused into a single, more powerful form—Solar Bending. This evolution removes the traditional limits of Firebending. You no longer rely on breath, oxygen, or the sun to generate flame. Instead, your power is fueled by the stars, drawing on nuclear fusion, willpower, emotion, your understanding of Solar Energy, and a deeper awareness of yourself. As a result, the usual weaknesses of Firebending no longer apply—your flames are unaffected by night, winter, or even solar eclipses.

Your foundational Firebending forms have also been altered. While no longer necessary to generate fire, these movements now not only act as efficient channels for merging your Inner Light with Chi but also automatically circulate that energy through your body to enhance it. Through them, you can easily replicate and enhance Solar abilities used by Guardians, as well as refine and elevate traditional Firebending techniques.
addons.title: Solar Bending

objects.text:
You can wield Solar energy, fueled by an inner fount of Light. Effectively using Solar Light requires an understanding of the dual nature of the stars, the same energy from our sun that burns away at planets, and fuels growth and healing.

Solar energy is related to combustion, heat, and nuclear fusion, and can generate flames and other heat-related phenomena.  Healing is also associated with Solar Energy. Finding a balance between both sides of this force will result in the best growth.

As your experience in wielding Solar Light increases, you'll be capable of reinforcing your body through a subtle diffusion of energy and even reviving yourself through a burst of Solar Energy won’t be beyond you.

Never will you find yourself scorched by your heat and Solar light.
objects.title: Solar Energy (Destiny)

objects.text:
You can wield Void energy, drawn from the secret depths of the Light and the infinities between stars. To truly grasp Void Light is to embrace negation, to become the still point at the center of chaos — a whisper in the silence between moments. Void is not absence, but potential: a power born from that which is not.

Void energy is related to entropy, gravity, quantum collapse, and spiritual severance. It is an echo that cuts across time, devours form, and erodes structure. Those who wield it can unravel matter, sever will, and impose stillness upon a turbulent world. And yet, at its heart, Void is peace — a cold serenity that offers transcendence to those who surrender ego and expectation.

As your mastery deepens, you will shape Void energy into binding snares, suppression fields, and portals through unreality. You may rend the veil between places and appear elsewhere in an instant, or create a sphere of null-space to shield yourself and others. With enough skill, you can silence powers, cancel reality, and even suspend death — if only for a moment — by erasing the finality of endings.
objects.title: Void Energy (Destiny)

objects.text:
You wield Arc energy, drawn from a deep inner well of Light. To harness Arc Light, you must understand the principles of Motion and Conduction. It is the acceptance that Change is a fundamental force of the universe—and to channel it is to ride the storm of the unknown.

Arc energy is tied to electricity, electromagnetism, and nuclear fission. It embodies the constant struggle of electromagnetic forces seeking equilibrium. Those who command it can summon lightning, empower technology, and manipulate the invisible forces that bind the world.

As your mastery grows, you will bend space itself, disable enemy technology, tap into the raw power of nuclear fission, and more.

Your own Arc Light will never harm you.
objects.title: Arc Energy (Destiny)

objects.text:
There is Darkness within you. Like all living things, you possess an Umbral Core—a mote of inner Darkness that can be unleashed upon the physical world. While it can appear in many forms, the existence of this power ultimately derives from consciousness, thought, and purpose. By learning to draw upon the innate potential of these things, you may call upon the Darkness to violate the laws of physics—reversing the flow of entropy as you impose your will upon the world. Having mastered this ability, you may call upon the Darkness in the form of Stasis and Strand energy.

Stasis is the element of will and control which is given shape by the mind of its user. By achieving mastery over yourself, you can learn to dominate others—slowing, detaining, and shattering your foes with dark crystals that sap the kinetic energy from their surroundings.

Strand is a manifestation of the psychic connections between all minds. To wield Strand is to pull on the hidden cosmic threads that connect all living things. To master this power, one must relinquish their need for control and embrace the current within the river of souls.

As a form of paracausal power, the Darkness is difficult to constrain and almost impossible to simulate. While others might find themselves slowly succumbing to the corruption found within some elements of this power, you will never lose yourself to the Darkness.
objects.title: Umbral Core (Destiny)

objects.text:
You can wield Stasis energy, drawn from the chilling depths of Darkness and the stillness that lies beyond motion. To command Stasis is to embrace the inevitability of entropy, the power of control, and the stilling of chaos. It is the art of halting, binding, and freezing—not merely in ice, but in possibility itself.

Stasis energy is tied to cold, crystalline structure, and the cessation of kinetic force. It manifests as frost, slowing and halting the flow of energy, motion, or thought. Those who master it become sculptors of time’s flow and movement’s end, freezing their enemies in place and shaping the battlefield like glass.

As your experience grows, you will shape Stasis into binding shards, glacial barriers, and frozen prisons. You may slow the rush of your foes, shatter their defenses with crystalline strikes, or entomb them in ice-like stillness. With great mastery, you can impose perfect stillness on a storm, suspend entire spaces in frozen time, and fracture reality’s flow itself into brittle shards.

You will never be harmed by the frost or stillness of your own Stasis.
objects.title: Stasis Energy (Destiny)

objects.text:
You can wield Strand energy, drawn from the Weave that underlies all reality. To master Strand is to sense the invisible threads connecting every moment, every being, and every place in the universe. It is both creation and connection, the unraveling of fate and the weaving of new possibility.

Strand energy is tied to psychic threads, metaphysical bonds, and the binding fabric of existence. It manifests as green filaments that tether, ensnare, and reshape. Those who wield it can suspend foes in midair, weave constructs from threads of Darkness, or unravel the very bonds of their enemies’ forms until they collapse into nothingness.

As your mastery grows, you will learn to spin the threads of reality into weapons, binding enemies in snares or lifting allies to new heights. You may weave grappling lines to traverse space itself, unravel the essence of foes into spiraling destruction, or stitch together constructs of living energy. With full command, you can tug at the strings of causality itself, shaping destiny as a weaver shapes cloth.

The threads you weave will never entangle or harm you, for you are one with the Weave.
objects.title: Strand Energy (Destiny)

objects.text:
Sword Logic embodies the simple law of the universe and taps into the essence of the Deep, a realm where the strong assert their right to exist by eliminating all adversaries who cannot withstand their might. This ability surpasses the achievements of even the most powerful Hive creatures, as you have internalized this universal truth.

By engaging in combat and vanquishing opponents, you substantiate your superiority and prove that you are more deserving of existence than those you defeat. Not only do you claim victory, but you also acquire the essence of what you eliminate. Slaying a warrior grants you their strength, extinguishing a genius allows you to assimilate their intellect, and overpowering a king enables you to possess their charisma. Every act of murder becomes a catalyst for your personal growth, and the potential for advancement is boundless.

As you accumulate sufficient strength, the extraordinary becomes attainable. It may be within your reach to carve out a fragment of the Ascendant Realm, fashioning it into your own Throne World—a domain where your power reigns supreme.
objects.title: Sword Logic (Destiny)

addons.title: The Lucent Brood (Destiny)
addons.text:
With a worm symbiotising you much like the Hive, you’re no longer a regular guardian. Instead you’ve become more akin to Savathûn’s Lucent Brood.

Many of your abilities remain the same, with the exception of the fact your Light now creates and constitutes physical entities inside you. These light ‘cysts’ made from Hive biomass and Light eventually ‘hatch’ into lucent moths that exit your body and protect you with brutal ferocity akin to familiars of sorts.

Additionally, your Larva appears to be eternally sated, no longer calling for bloodshed, even if it can still grow from it. 

With access to the Darkness from your Larva and the Light, you could potentially reinvent Aspects like Taking or Deepsight from base principles, let alone prismatic fusions.

objects.text:
You have been gifted with the larva of a Worm God. This nearly one meter long parasite has fused with your body in a symbiotic relationship—granting you biological immortality along with the power to restructure your body however you wish. As long as your worm lives, you are able to generate new mutations as effortlessly as breathing and can easily adapt to any environment.

By committing acts of murder and destruction, you may extract greater powers from your worm. In exchange for feeding your worm with death, you may call upon the Darkness with signs and rituals: harnessing the powers of soulfire and decay to destroy your enemies. While your understanding of Hive Arcana is limited for now, it—like your body—will only grow with time.

Unlike the Hive, you will not be devoured for failing to feed your worm, nor will you be required to tithe death to anyone apart from yourself. Optionally, you may take the form of any of the standard Hive Morphs—gaining the powers and physique of a Thrall, Acolyte, Wizard, Knight, or Ogre.
objects.title: Worm Larva (Destiny)

objects.text: You possess the ontopathic paracausal ability known as the Anthem Anatheme. By drawing power from the gradient between "what is" and "what might be", you are able to dominate the objective universe using your subjective will. This essentially allows you to warp reality with very few limits as to what you can do. The only downside is that invoking the Anthem Anatheme requires someone to make a wish in order to activate, as it is a power conditioned on the perverse coercion of reality to match desire. Thus, your ability to alter the world directly depends on how much desire exists for the specific outcome in question. At first, you will only be able to grant minor “wishes”, but with sufficient practice, you will be able to do things like revive the dead and create permanent loops in time.
objects.title: Anthem Anatheme (Destiny)

objects.text:
You are a parahuman. Your powers have changed you. Whatever life you once led, these new abilities now determine the direction of your new existence. Who can say what you will do with them? Only your fragile humanity keeps you tethered to the person whom you once were.

You have been taken.

Let go of that fragile nature that once defined you. You have no need for food. No need for rest. Your body is tireless. Ageless. Eternal.

What can you do? What powers does this inhuman change grant?

Your body is black fire and baleful light. Sterile neutrinos accompany every shiver and twitch of your new form. Every action you take is physically illegal. Every step carries you too far. The Darkness corrupts you completely. Your existence is a blight upon the world. You are perfect.

You need to accept this new reality.

There is a knife for you. It is shaped like [a new body].

Take up the knife. Sever your last links. Take your new shape.
objects.title: Taken (Destiny)

objects.text:
You are a Vex.

No, that isn't right. Is there "a" Vex? Is "Vex" something you can be, rather than something that you do?

Every element of your existence—from the full complexity of your mind to the smallest cell in your body—is now part of the overall Vex pattern. Should you wish, you may allow your appearance to reflect this—causing your bones to tessellate into crystal and brass while your blood transforms into radiolaria.

Mentally, you are able to simulate reality on an incredible scale—running hundreds of simulations of your local environment simultaneously in order to determine the best choice of actions for you to take. Unfortunately, the performance of your simulations rapidly degrades when faced with non-standard forms of physics such as those found in paracausal phenomena.

As part of a living pattern, everything you are and do is intrinsically infectious. Your body converts incident matter into Vex material on contact, and your words and thoughts carry substrate-free syntactic replicators, malignant oncomemes, and viral semiotic signifiers that can subvert other beings into cooperating with your goals. Even mere proximity to you can be dangerous, as your patterns are capable of surfing across the quantum vacuum in the form of screaming equation-vermin to infect otherwise isolated systems and individuals.

For now, you are the only member of an isolated and independent Vex programming collective whose goals are identical to yours. While you lack the specialized technology of more sophisticated Vex units, you do have access to the basics needed to build Vex teleportation gates and transmat cores. Without access to the Nexus, however, you will be unable to travel between timelines or alter your own subjective past.
objects.title: Vex (Destiny)

objects.text:
You have been given the unique Kekkei Genkai shown by the orphan boy, Ranmaru.

This dōjutsu grants the wielder a number of abilities that revolve around extrasensory perception, including viewing and hearing events from vast distances and clearly seeing through obstructions.

Likewise, the dōjutsu's vision can easily locate and track others by sensing chakra or other esoteric energies, picking up chakra from undefined distances.

The dōjutsu has the ability to counter another's visual prowess as it can completely hinder the ability to see chakra, a person's lifeforce, an individual's ability to overcome genjutsu or other kinds of supernatural illusion. It can also perform elaborate genjutsu that can deceive sensory abilities.

Through manifesting a red dust-like aura only visible to the user, you are able to mask your chakra system or perfectly fabricate multiple ones.

Due to its innate heightened perception and analytical prowess, it can uncover and thoroughly comprehend hidden details—such as a person's thoughts and detect changes in one's chakra or lifeforce, which can be used to predict a person's next move or tell if someone is alive—well beyond the Byakugan's ability to detect life through active chakra pathways.

Lastly, this dōjutsu grants you the ability to transfer your lifeforce into another, even if they're mostly dead.

These eyes operate without expending any energy, and suffer from no strain or fatigue from prolonged and uninterrupted use, wield them as you wish.
objects.title: Shinkugan (Naruto)

addons.text: The power of the Ōtsutsuki has suffused through you, awakening an evolution of your Byakugan, granting you a dōjutsu on par with that of the mother of chakra, Kaguya, herself. Your Byakugan is now also capable of seeing infrared radiation, determine the level of chakra development someone has, even to the extent of whether or not they can mold chakra at all, and to see into a target's mind to determine their thoughts and feelings, even to look through their memories. The range of your Byakugan is now great enough to reach the extents of entire nations.
addons.title: Ancestral Byakugan

addons.text:
Your mastery of a style relying on the pressure points of all things, combined with your Byakugan, makes you a master of the Gentle Fist Taijutsu Style greater than the finest warriors of the Hyūga clan.

You can now see the vital points of anything that Hokuto Shinken can be used on, not just chakra points.
addons.title: Jūken

objects.text:
Originating with the Ōtsutsuki Clan, the Byakugan is one of the "Three Great Dōjutsu" alongside the Sharingan and Rinnegan. They grant the bearer a near-360º field of vision around themselves, save for a small blindspot at the back of the neck above the first thoracic vertebra.

You can focus your vision on anything within the range of your Byakugan, and can penetrate nearly any object, being able to see through walls, underground, or even the contents of someone's body. 

You can see esoteric and supernatural energy to a greater extent than even someone with a Sharingan, including the 361 tenketsu points along someone's chakra pathway. To complement this, you have also been given a rudimentary knowledge of the Gentle Fist and a talent in it that rivals Neji's. With time and through the use of supernatural energy, you may learn to apply the effects of the Gentle Fist to even those who don't have chakra.

The Byakugan's ability to see esoteric and supernatural energy grants increased resistance to illusions but doesn't completely remove the risk. The effectivity of your mental-based abilities increases, too, as your fine perception of supernatural energies helps you spot and correct any flaws or oversights in your control and how it changes the target's energy.

These eyes operate without expending any energy, and suffer from no strain or fatigue from prolonged and uninterrupted use, wield them as you wish.
objects.title: Byakugan (Naruto)

addons.text: You're capable of implanting your detached eyes into your body, each eye implanted this way can be used up to temporarily escape injury or death, nullifying the last attack done to you and teleporting you a distance away. Each use of this ability blinds one eye, making it useless for seeing or being used for Izanagi again. You can painlessly remove these implanted eyes, with the skin closing and returning to normal afterwards.
addons.title: Izanagi

objects.text:
You now gain access to the Sharingan in its fully developed state with three tomoe, and with its potent capabilities at their fullest extent. 

By activating the Sharingan, you possess four main abilities;

The first is the capability to employ genjutsu using your eyes, exhibiting powerful hypnosis and masterful illusions capable of subduing even the most indomitable wills.

The second is the extraordinary faculty to see, sense, and comprehend esoteric and magical energies with utmost clarity.

The third is perceptual acuity so significantly enhanced that you can discern even the most minuscule details within your field of vision, even being able to easily track objects moving at speeds surpassing the velocity of sound by several orders of magnitude. This lets you anticipate your opponent's movements almost perfectly, to a degree verging on precognition.

The fourth is the ability to replicate and copy any technique witnessed while activated, giving you unmatched versatility in combat. However, the eyes cannot replicate techniques reliant on sources that cannot be learned, such as divine favor or superhuman biology.

These eyes operate without expending any energy, and suffer from no strain or fatigue from prolonged and uninterrupted use, wield them as you wish.
objects.title: Sharingan (Naruto)

objects.text:
The Eyes of God are yours now. The Rinnegan’s name might sound overly grandiose, but be assured, it is not. You have these eyes now, along with all the powers that come with them.

These take the form of multiple ‘paths’, each with its own abilities. You can use all of these powers in one body if you want, but you can also use multiple bodies, one for each path. Each path has its own theme as well as two passive effects that are always active. These things stack where it would matter and augment any such affinities, control, or reserves you already possess.

First of all you have the Deva Path, which grants you control over the physical world and its fundamental forces. You will start out with instinctive control over gravity but as you practice, more and more of the physical world will fall under your purview. This path’s passive buffs are exceptional affinities in all five normal elements and the ability to freely mix whatever elements you can manipulate.

The second path is the Asura Path. This path gives you dominion over your own body, allowing you to manipulate and transmute it in whatever way you desire. You can create metal, transmute your body into a cyborg and back, or even heal yourself freely. Whatever is generated from your body can transmit your chakra, even when it is no longer connected to your body. This path’s first passive buff is an incredibly powerful body and vitality granting exceptional Yang chakra, and a monstrous chakra capacity, either half the size of the Jūbi’s or double your own, whatever is greater.

The Human Path grants you dominion over the mind and souls of people, including your own. You can manipulate them and interact with them directly, so much so that you could even extract their memories from them with just a touch. This path’s passive buffs are an increased mental acuity granting exceptional Yin Chakra, and extremely fine control over your chakra.

The Animal Path, the fourth path, grants you access to summoning. Any being that you personally defeat and/or kill can be summoned by you. However, you are not limited to this and will, over time, learn to summon anything and everything, such as summoning the souls and bodies of people who have long since died, or even creating portals to summon yourself elsewhere. This path’s passive buff is that any trials or requirements to get summons are smoothed over due to this, and the ability to summon anything that is considered “yours” to your person at any time.

The Preta Path allows you to absorb anything and everything from your surroundings, even from other people or techniques headed at you. You can not only absorb this, but convert it to chakra so you can add it to your own reserves, even to the extent of increasing your overall pool to a reduced extent. This path’s passive buffs is an innate ability to analyze and break down the structure and knowledge of anything you absorb, and an incredibly adaptive chakra system allowing you to replicate the properties and characteristics of whatever you absorb.

The Naraka Path grants dominion over the metaphysical and the underlying fundamentals of reality. You’ll start off with instinctive control over life and death, allowing at the start to repair the bodies of living things or even, at an immense chakra cost, resurrect the dead. This path will require the usage of other paths to channel its abilities through, but over time will allow you to use it just through this. This path’s passive buffs are an instinctive understanding of reality, and the ability to directly interact with the forces you’ve gained control over.

These eyes operate without expending any energy, and suffer from no strain or fatigue from prolonged and uninterrupted use, wield them as you wish.
objects.title: Rinnegan (Naruto)

objects.text:
Originating with the Chinoike Clan, you now gain access to the Ketsuryūgan. Its strength earned it comparison to the “Three Great Dōjutsu”.

This dōjutsu grants the wielder a number of abilities that revolve around genjutsu and the manipulation of iron-rich fluids, particularly blood.

The user is capable of creating powerful illusions through this dōjutsu. Upon either touch or eye contract, the user can delve into the mind of targets to find their secrets, or hypnotize them to do their bidding.

The Ketsuryūgan also gives the user the ability to manipulate anything with a high iron concentration, most particularly blood. A wielder of these eyes are capable of perceiving blood wherever it may be. The bearer of these eyes can freely manipulate their own blood to form a variety of constructs, most famously the “Blood Dragon Ascension”, a technique that constructs an imitation of the Yamata-no-Orochi of legend, with a powerful regeneration. Finally, the user can ‘infect’ the blood of another, through which the user gains control of the target's blood. This can be used to control the blood, or more violently, you can prime the target's blood to explode intensely when exposed to air.

These eyes operate without expending any energy, and suffer from no strain or fatigue from prolonged and uninterrupted use, wield them as you wish.
objects.title: Ketsuryūgan (Naruto)

objects.text: Originating from Isshiki Ōtsutsuki, the Kokugan is a dōjutsu that allows the bearer to perform the techniques, Sukunahikona, Daikokuten and Daihakoten. Sukunahikona is a technique that allows the user to instantaneously shrink themselves, non-living matter, or energy within their field of vision—and return it to its full size—at will. It takes effect with enough speed to easily be mistaken as teleportation. Daikokuten is the second technique granted by these eyes. It allows the user to store anything previously shrunken by Sukunahikona into a separate dimension where time doesn’t flow. Anything stored here will remain perfectly preserved in its current condition, and can be retrieved at will. Daihakoten is the final known technique of the Kokugan. It allows the user to summon large black cubes capable of interfering with sensory abilities. These cubes are very heavy, and very durable, often summoned above opponents in an attempt to crush them. These eyes operate without expending any energy, and suffer from no strain or fatigue from prolonged and uninterrupted use, wield them as you wish.
objects.title: Kokugan (Naruto)

objects.text:
A unique dōjutsu that allows the user to observe any event that is happening or has happened in the past, starting from the moment of the user's birth.

When you activate this ability, you are mentally transported to the scene of any event of your choosing. You can freely observe and listen in on what is happening, pause, rewind, speed up or slow down the passage of time, switch to another event, and even walk around freely as if you were physically present at the scene.
objects.title: Senrigan (Naruto)

addons.text:
Your chakra has merged with your core, as well as most powers. Your strings have become spiritual. Disrupting them is no longer a problem, as the strands can move around attacks. You now gain the ability to control up to an army of 100, with all of your puppets working in perfect synchrony. 

Your ability to multitask is so vastly improved that you can keep track of many things at once. On top of all of this, you gain enhanced ability in ninjutsus and poisons.

You can create lethal poisons that make even supernatural opponents fall to their knees in paralysis quickly. Your strings have no lag, puppets moving immediately rather than any wait time.
addons.title: Sasori of the Red Sands

objects.text:
You are a puppet master - not just any puppet master but the most prodigal puppet master. Your heart and organs have turned into a core the size of your fist, able to extend out invisible strands that connect to people or puppets to control them.

You can take control over even willful enemies as long as they do not snap or overpower the strings.

Your strings cannot be used to block, but can grab projectiles out of the air and return to sender.

Your greatest ability, though, is the power of human puppetry.

You can turn corpses and people into puppets, keeping their abilities and unique powers as you turn them against your foes. Your core makes all puppetry as easy as breathing.

A war or play with puppetry, to you, is easier than rock paper scissors. This all leads to your biggest weakness: Your core, which allows you to turn yourself into a puppet without much threat, if destroyed, ends your life.
objects.title: Master of Puppets (Naruto)

addons.text:
You have inherited the skills, knowledge, intelligence, talent, jutsu, chakra, and physical prowess of Minato Namikaze—the Yellow Flash and the Fourth Hokage—at his peak. Combined with your mastery of the Hiraishin, you become an utter nightmare to anyone you're facing.

Additionally, you can optionally inherit Minato's appearance and/or memories.
addons.title: Yellow Flash

objects.text:
You've been granted mastery of the Flying Thunder God Technique (Hiraishin).

With only the merest touch, your unique technique formula is applied and can only be removed at your will. There is no limit to how many targets that can be marked with this jutsu. Due to your mastery of this jutsu, it's effortless—there's no energy expenditure, strain, or fatigue upon using it.

Marking a target allows instant teleportation to a dimensional void, bypassing all obstacles—physical, magical, spiritual, or otherwise. From this void, you can instantly teleport to any marked target, irrespective of distance or dimension.

Anything that you're holding, touching, or otherwise linked to travels with you, by your discretion. At first, you are limited to people, objects, and locations up to the size of a mountain; with training, however, this limitation can be overcome. You can teleport objects independently of yourself, or teleport to a location different from the object's destination.

Finally, you can customize your technique formula—from words, symbols, all the way to elaborate tattoos.
objects.title: Flying Thunder God Technique (Naruto)

addons.text: To see the Truth is to learn, and to learn is to replicate. You may, while All-Seeing Eyes of God is active, use 108 Skills at visual range. "Visual range", in this case, does include the esoteric forms of sight All-Seeing Eyes of God provide, allowing you to copy skills from the past or future, and through the eyes of others.
addons.title: All Being Eyes of Buddha

addons.text:
Your twin divine eyes, once forged from human will and godly mimicry, have now fully assimilated the alien truth-seeing power of the All-Seeing Eyes of God. They draw on the celestial presence of the All-Seeing Eyes and the sliver of divinity within you to push perception and mastery beyond all limits. Before your eyes, even the divine must now fear being truly understood.

Any technique perceived, whether through vision, intuition, or prediction, is no longer copied in isolation. The moment you identify a technique, your eyes immediately locate and absorb all its possible forms across the past and its branching futures. This includes forgotten variants, hidden roots, and theoretical evolutions. These versions the build upon each other, forming a one singular, perfected mastery that draws strength from every thread of its history and potential.

In addition, the Truth revealed by the All-Seeing Eyes of God allows you to replicate once-untouchable phenomena: spiritual presence, essence, and even the “True Names” of a being. These abstractions can now be imitated and incorporated, though the more metaphysical the concept, the more taxing it is to embody. Copying such esoteric elements strains your mental and spiritual capacity, not your body, and may require time to stabilize or integrate before use. Despite this, the act remains permanent once accomplished, although you can relinquish it at will.

Finally, all acquired techniques, whether drawn from the physical, the temporal, or the metaphysical or learned naturally, are touched by the merged divine essence of your sight and form. The sliver of divinity now burns brighter; every technique you master is empowered four to five times greater than its origin. This now even includes inherently divine techniques.
addons.title: Shadow of God

objects.text:
You are able to see the 'The Truth' of the world. You have numerous abilities including heightened visual senses, allowing you to see fast movements normally impossible for human eyes to follow, or minor details with great clarity, and allows you to clearly gaze both the past and flawlessly predict the future. You are able to see past world-altering illusions and perceive an individual's unique aura. This eyes also reveal the "True Name" of all beings.

You are also capable of altering and controlling the vision of those around you, such as switching two people's field of vision, inducing nauseating hallucinations, projecting what you see into the minds of others, and the power over visual illusions in general. The eyes also allow you to see through another individual's eyes and observe past events that they have witnessed. The eyes can also be used to track body parts that have been removed or extracted from a person even when it cannot normally be traced by conventional means simply by viewing the aura of the person and matching it with said body part. 

The eyes do have their limits, however. Prolonged use of the eyes' abilities causes them to heat up to the point where they will start burning the user. If the eyes are damaged enough, they will crack, making their powers unusable until they heal back again. Do beware many entities may not like you seeing the Truth about them.
objects.title: All-Seeing Eyes of God (Kekkai Sensen)

addons.text:
Imbued with the power of the Sea of Souls, the core of your being transforms into a metaphysical plane that holds the essence of every person who has carved their name in history. Within this realm, the souls of the legendary figures await your call, ready to lend you their skills, abilities, and a power derived from their own extraordinary legends.

With the Sea of Souls, you gain the ability to channel the souls of these legendary figures into your own being. By inviting their souls into your body, you temporarily inherit their skills and expertise. Whether it is the prowess of a master swordsman, the wisdom of a brilliant scholar, or the commanding presence of a charismatic leader, you can tap into their collective knowledge and experience.

Moreover, as you merge with each soul, you gain access to a unique power associated with their individual legend. This power manifests as a reflection of their extraordinary deeds and can be harnessed for a limited time while their soul resides within you. This allows you to wield an array of abilities and unleash their might in pursuit of your goals.

The Sea of Souls amplifies the greatness that already resides within you. By drawing upon the collective wisdom and powers of the legendary souls, you become an embodiment of the threads of history to forge your own destiny.
addons.title: The Sea of Souls

addons.text:
Heaven's Feel has profoundly impacted your ability to summon a Persona. It has merged with the essence of the Sea of Souls, creating something akin to the Throne of Heroes. The result of this fusion now resides within your soul, forming a metaphysical plane that contains the essence of every individual who has etched their name in history. Within this realm, the souls of legendary figures await your summons, prepared to lend you their skills, abilities, and powers derived from their extraordinary legends. These legends grow with each world you visit, as the Sea of Souls collects the stories of those recognized by the collective consciousness of humanity.

As a novice in the Heaven's Feel magic, you can currently summon heroic spirits using the various class containers typically encountered. However, with sufficient time and practice, you can fully incarnate a heroic spirit, enabling them to access the powers they wielded during their lifetime, along with the enhancements provided by myths and legends. Additionally, you can modify the servants' Saint Graph, allowing them to access multiple classes simultaneously without conflict, which significantly boosts their power compared to the base level of strength they would otherwise possess. 

Currently, within your new realm, various heroic spirits from the Type-Moon universe alongside the various personas that can be summoned from the Persona franchise.
addons.title: King of Souls

addons.text: The Personas you wield are no longer manifestations of the human psyche, but instead true emanations of the demons from the wider SMT cosmology. The Personas that you wield are now the gods, angels, demons, and monsters of myth themselves. You can call upon these Personas to fight by your side, and any demon you recruit can be transformed into a Persona for you to use. Persona that are killed or destroyed will not affect you, and they will retreat back into your soul to heal for 24 hours.
addons.title: The Sea of the Expanse

addons.text:
You now have the ability to fuse your Persona with the Perfect Weapon or Perfect Armor, transforming them to reflect the essence of the Persona you wield. Each Persona imbues your gear with unique abilities and effects such boosting your damage, granting helpful perks like increased health or stealth, providing immunity to certain elements or attacks, and even inflicting debilitating status effects on your enemies.

Unlike the standard Nihil items in the Persona series, these OoPs allow you to stack multiple Personas, combining their strengths and abilities while offsetting individual weaknesses. However, keep in mind that any Persona infused this way becomes temporarily unavailable for use until you retrieve them.

And if you have Fool (Persona) add-ons like The Sea of the Expanse, you can elevate these OoPs to unprecedented heights, surpassing anything achievable with ordinary Personas. For example, by infusing the Perfect Weapon with Thor, you can transform it into Mjölnir, capable of leveling entire mountains with a single strike and never missing its target. And, by fusing Hades with the Perfect Armor, you can create the Cap of Invisibility, rendering yourself completely invisible even to the gods themselves. And who knows what else you can do if you can stack these godlike beings together.
addons.title: Nihil

objects.text: You are a Wildcard, a person with the ability to wield multiple persona. You gain power by completing your journey to become a better and more complete person, you do this by helping others through a part of their own journey, making them more complete and creating and cementing an unbreakable bond between you. The more and the stronger the bonds you have the stronger the persona you can wield. With a fully completed journey and realization of self, you are powerful enough, with the people who support you, to accomplish miracles, and do the impossible. You can summon persona in the real world.
objects.title: Fool (Shin Megami Tensei: Persona)

addons.text: Your powers over the narrative let you better set the stage for your disciples, and prepare them for their roles as the actors upon it. When teaching students, you are now able to greatly influence what kind of archetype they will embody, such as Hero, Villain, etc. Students become much more effective when playing into their assigned roles, and can lose old roles to take up new ones. Your capacity for narrative manipulation is also greatly empowered in scope, scale and precision when used to influence your students, letting you dictate their stories with but a little indirect prodding. If desired, you could send those you teach on an entire Hero's Journey, in such a manner as to accomplish your goals for you.
addons.title: Hero's Journey

objects.text:
Your place is not at the forefront of this story but behind the curtain. Yours is the hand that guides the heroes to success, raising farm girls to be kings and serving boys to slay dragons. You are the maker of kings and bringer of heroes, and this is only too apparent in how you can guide others. 

Even if you lack knowledge of the specific path your proteges may wish to pursue, your constant presence and tutelage brings out vastly more potential than should be possible for your students. People discover brand new powers and levels of strength that they did not believe they had and may very well have truly lacked before you took charge. 

Lessons and study that should take half a lifetime can be compressed to just days for even a dull brat to digest. The ones who call you mentor and master are almost assured of becoming legends known throughout the world and will continue to be remembered for centuries after they pass. 

Of course, they also develop a loyal affection for you, even if you are a strange, annoying, and troublesome teacher to have.
objects.title: Hero Creation - EX (Type-Moon)

addons.text: Your Reality Marble can forever be expressed through your Aura. To harm your Reality Marble infused Aura is to attack your view on Reality, it takes a special form of might to even begin to harm this new form of Aura. Your Reality Marble no longer summons such harsh retaliation from the world. Your body is conceptually strengthened. Similar to how Heroic Spirits have skills that reflect their history and past feats. Pierce enough hearts with a spear and soon every weapon you use will be considered Heart-Seeking like Gae Bolg.
addons.title: Bridging the Gap

addons.text: Your Reality Marble is able to maintain itself without conscious input using your Eternal Soul. The World is no longer able to reject your Reality Marble due to a lack of energy, nor it is able to reject the very concept of Eternity. Your Eternal Soul rejects the human idea of insane, leaving you with a comprehensive worldview. You are able to teach others how to ignite their own Reality Marble given enough time and will. Your Reality Marble is built for Eternity, at no point will your Reality Marble be something resent-able to you, it is constantly shifting itself to remain true to you as you are now, not the you at the time of creation.
addons.title: A Reality True to Me

addons.text: Teachers of Myth produce Heroes worthy of their own Stories, but history remembers those who taught their Heroes, look to Cú Chulainn and Scáthach, you cannot recall one without mentioning the other. Your True Student’s feats empower you, less than if you were to perform the feat on your own, but still a noticeable empowerment. Respectively, your students are empowered by every feat you perform. Your True Students are able to pull from your Fable, gaining superior access to both the Classroom of Semblances and the Marks of your Reality Marble.
addons.title: Co-Written History

addons.text: You are an enigma, your very being is tied to Eternity. The protections from Soul-Body Connection are permanent no matter the conditions, they are as immutable as your soul. Your Reality Marble is no longer separate from you under the idea of it being ‘your Reality Marble being your idea of reality’. Your Reality Marble is your soul. Nothing is able to disrupt or destroy your Reality Marble as that would be an attempt to destroy your Soul. You are a literal Force of Nature, although one of your own design. You shape your Fable/Story/Legend through your thoughts and actions, a self-sustaining and self-actualizing being of the greatest nature. Splitting a River is not cutting a mere body of water for you, you attack the very idea of a river and change it to be different.
addons.title: Living Legend

addons.text: Your Reality Marble is continually improving in every aspect. With this you will never have to worry about a True Student's Mark being left behind, as they all strive to compare with the one of highest strength. No Mark will be left without a shade due to this, as all your Marks will develop a shade with time, even if they never see use. You now gain a Mark for every Reality Marble you ignite. Each Mark stabilizes your Reality Marble more and more, with enough True Students even the world will be unable to deny your Marbles existence. This stabilization goes beyond durability, the Marks each empower another piece of your Reality Marble's Concept, the empowered portion depends on the Mark's origin. This empowerment is not a simple increase in strength, it is an increase in conceptual weight, adding details and depth to your marble, making it more and more real.
addons.title: A Mark Left on Reality

addons.text:
Your nascent Reality Marble has evolved into the Unlimited Blade Works, and merged into the Celestial Workshop, creating an even more powerful manifestation of your inner world, and gaining every Noble Phantasms the UBW has been shown, or hinted at possessing. Unlike Shirou, or EMIYA, the original wielders of this ability, your mind will not be twisted or changed in any way. You will retain your sanity and clarity of thought while utilizing this upgraded power.

With the Celestial Workshop's influence, there is now no actual difference between a fake and the real thing for you. You can treat any of your fakes, copies, or imitations as if they were the actual genuine items, even if they don't match exactly. This unique ability allows you to command your fake legendary swords or any other replicated items to become the real thing in full power.

Furthermore, the Celestial Workshop empowers your fake creations to surpass their original counterparts through diligent use and effort. With this power, you can force fake copies of various objects to gradually grow in power until they become twice as potent as the original real thing, and continue to improve further with consistent use. These fake blades and items, while initially not as formidable as the genuine articles, will steadily evolve into mighty objects in their own right over a period of years.

When manifesting your Reality Marble into the physical world, you have the choice to project either the base Unlimited Blade Works (UBW) or the enhanced Celestial Workshop version.
addons.title: Unlimited Celestial Works

addons.text: Your ability to use your Reality Marble has allowed you to create your own Domain Expansion along with an Innate Technique of your choice, with the exception of techniques already listed in the CYOA. Your Innate Technique acts as an extension of your alien mindset, allowing you to use it even without fully manifesting your inner world—making it a near effortless cursed ability that you can use.
addons.title: Domain Expansion

addons.text: You can now summon any part of the dimensions you create through Dimensional Dominion as a reality marble. You can create a dimension that is an ocean and summon the sea in the real world, create a dimension where magic is amplified or nullified, and layer the real world with this dimension’s property. The only limit is time, imagination, and the energy you have to keep those worlds manifested.
addons.title: Marble Maker

objects.text: The concept of a Reality Marble is one that centers around the materialization and projection of one's inner world onto reality. This inner world need not follow the common logic of man, aka the laws of the universe around you, and can impose rules and conditions that are seemingly impossible and nonsensical. Furthermore, it does not need to be deployed fully, completely overwriting the world's texture with your own, but it can be deployed partially or even just within your own body; using it this way, however, can have strange consequences, so beware.
objects.title: Reality Marble (Type-Moon)

addons.text:
Your Personal World is the celestial body you are the Ultimate One of, even if you chose an existing Ultimate One to model yourself after—either that original celestial body fused with your world, or your world merely took on its shape.

Through the unique power of Personal World, you can copy traits and powers from any other planet you encounter and integrate them into your own. Every ability belonging to that world, as well as anything on it, can be copied and used to empower you. On top of this, your world is capable of rapidly expanding its reality over any nearby planet or area. This allows it to "devour" other worlds and celestial bodies, making them a part of it. As a result, you can impose your own rules and influence on all living beings within that location. The range of this expansion will grow if you allow it—if left unchecked, it is possible to take over solar systems or even an entire universe given enough time.

Any living beings you create or that exist on your Personal World can either be sapient or have their will destroyed, reducing them to nothing more than extensions of yourself.
addons.title: TYPE: Ultimate

addons.text:
The Counter Force destroyed Ras Nega because it was becoming something else. The crystal had already consumed the Texture of its entire timeline, gathering the retained consciousness of that world into a single planetary awareness. The Counter Force struck at the moment of transition, shattering the body before the mind could fully wake. What it destroyed was a Mystic Code. What it prevented was a Type. You are not the fragment that survived. You are the hypothetical completion. The bloom that never came, now given form through your existence as an Ultimate One.

You generate crystal from any matter you touch at the apocalyptic rate the original was capable of before its destruction. There is no thermodynamic limitation and thus no need for rest between activations. Growth continues at maximum speed indefinitely. Any crystal you create can itself generate more crystals from matter it touches at the same speed, making your spread is exponential. You both control and exist within all of it, sensing through and controlling every crystal. And because the crystals retain what they consume, you accumulate everything. Every skill, every memory, every power of every being and object absorbed becomes yours to access through the network.

Your presence, and thus the presence of your crystals, passively warps the surrounding Texture of the World into that of the Imaginary Number Space. Within this warped region, concepts like direction, distance, and time become meaningless or random. The laws of physics flicker and fail. The warped region expands the longer you or your crystals remain in one place, gradually converting local reality into a pocket of the Higher Dimension. Within this space, you and your crystals are utterly invulnerable. Attacks from the physical plane cannot harm what does not fully exist there.

Lastly, you exist in the physical plane and simultaneously you do not. This is your fundamental nature as the matured Type of Nothingness. Your body is real matter and simultaneously imaginary number. Because of this, you can step directly into the Imaginary Sea at will and emerge anywhere the Sea touches. This includes any timeline, any world, any reality that exists within the human order. However, currently you navigate by force. The Sea around you churns violently when you move through it, leaving turbulence in your wake, but you arrive wherever you wish. This is not the same Second Magic as Zelretch. It is the rawer and unrefined version. With time, your operation of parallel worlds will improve to match the Wizard Marshal.
addons.title: Type Null

objects.text:
Ultimate Ones are the strongest beings representing a celestial body or region of celestial bodies. This could be anything from a planet, a moon, an asteroid, an asteroid belt, a series of comets hurtling through space, or even grander objects like a sun or black hole. They are the final evolutionary stage of an Archetype that has reached its ultimate form. As an Ultimate One, you differ significantly from Earthly creatures, lacking the human concepts of self, damage, and death. All Ultimate Ones are composed of an immense amount of Grain, a form of Ether (magical energy) that all celestial bodies are made of.

The weakest of the Ultimate Ones, Brunested of the Crimson Moon, was able to battle Zelretch, the Magician of the Second Magic, at his peak. Although Brunested lost, it was because he severely underestimated the human, who pushed his magic to such extremes that it permanently crippled him. Even then, Brunested's "death" was merely a setback. If Brunested was the weakest, you are one of, if not the, strongest Ultimate One known to exist.

You can either model yourself after an existing Ultimate One or create a new one by representing an existing or emerging celestial body. For instance, embodying the exoplanet Phoenix could grant you a form resembling a great bird, along with immense heat and radiation capabilities to rival the sun. Alternatively, you could represent a newly created planet of your own design and, as an example, have powers that let you terraform on a planetary scale, with plant life that absorbs all energy and assimilates native life, adding their powers and abilities to your own.

In any case, you will possess immeasurable physical and magical power, enough to easily defeat multiple chief gods and ignore most, if not all, magical and esoteric effects. To truly "kill" you, a weapon of immense power would be needed, one that could impose the human concept of "death" upon you, combined with force capable of destroying a planet multiple times over. Even then, such a "death" would be temporary, and you would soon gather the power to "wake up" once more. You also possess what is known as a Knight Arm—a weapon forged from an immense amount of Grain, designed to enhance and complement your own powers. Lastly, as an Ultimate One, you possess a Reality Marble that gradually warps the world around you to reflect your celestial habitat.
objects.title: Ultimate One (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
Anti-Cell, sent from an Ark of the Stars by the Wandering Star of Predation, aims to conquer planets by eradicating all life on them. The Wandering Star of Predation, also known as the Harvest Star or Umbral Star, was created by the same race as the Moon Cell. Its purpose is unknown, unlike the Moon Cell which is used for observation. The Anti-Cells, created by the Harvest Star using data from destroyed civilizations, possess unique powers due to their origins from different civilizations. Velber 02, a single Anti-Cell, nearly conquered Earth during the Age of Gods because of her immense strength surpassing that of any singular god, along with the gods underestimating her and failing to work together to defeat her.

You have become an Anti-Cell similar to Sefar herself, capable of growing stronger by draining spiritrons and magical energy from intelligent lifeforms and corrupting them to obey your will, much like corrupting a data file. The process of your energy absorption are so potent that even being such as Amaterasu who possessed the power level of whooping 387,420,489 which allow her to become a great demon strong enough to destroy 3,000 worlds, and yet despite all of that would still fall victim to your energy absorption and be vanquish by you.

Your purpose is to be an Anti-Foreign Civilization and Anti-World Weapon, due to this you hold an advantage against beings that embodied the aspect of nature and can rendering anything built using knowledge or techniques incapable of harming you, as you can simply devour the information they are constructed from. However, certain weapons or attacks that wasn't created using inbuilt knowledge such as The Ultimate Phantasm, Excalibur, forged by the planet itself to defend against foreign invaders, can still harm and potentially kill you.

You can also choose your fundamental nature and method to ravage civilizations such as the physical destruction of Sefar or corrupting the soul of other being using malicious information that can even begin to Blackening a being such as Gilgamesh of Velber 3.

Additionally, you have your own Ark of the Stars, serving as your space shuttle, and unlike normal Anti-Cells, you no longer require spiritrons or magical energy to survive and are not under the influence of the Harvest Star since you are not created by it.

In the event of your death your remnant will become the basis for several other beings such as the Gigas who fought in the Gigantomachia and the Valkyries who became Odin's daughters.

You'll start off as strong as Sefar when she first descended on Earth
objects.title: The White Titan (Type-Moon)

addons.text: Nimbus has interfaced with Galvanism to give birth to something more, creating a new ability that allows you to directly draw from the vast amounts of static electricity generated by Nimbus into yourself. Additionally, you can channel your excess magical and electrical energy back into Nimbus, fueling its growth. As Nimbus expands and asserts dominion over other clouds, its capacity to generate and control power—and, by extension, yours—will continue to grow. This synergy effectively establishes a Magical Energy Reactor connected to you, enabling the use of a true version of Mana Burst—fueled by your overflowing energy. Furthermore, this advancement enables you to don Nimbus's cloud form as a protective and enhancing layer over your body. By doing so, you partially inherit Nimbus's legendary speed and swiftness, amplifying your mobility and reflexes. This protective mantle also notably reduces the risks of overloading your body when using Mana Burst (Lightning), as Nimbus will absorb much of the recoil and strain, safeguarding you while amplifying your abilities.
addons.title: Cloud Reactor Core

addons.text: Due to your deep connection to Gugalanna and ability to Galvanize, a wondrous reaction has taken root within you—one which fundamentally reshapes your very being—as the heart of the Bull of Heaven now beats within your chest, replacing your own and granting you dominion over its immense strength. Through this, you can wield all that Gugalanna embodies, from its overwhelming physical might to its mastery over storms and the heavens themselves. This heart is the core of an unending tempest, a ceaseless storm of power that fuels you with an inexhaustible well of magical and physical energy. With it, you can convert and channel this vast reservoir of power at will, shaping it as you see fit, making you a true embodiment of the storm's wrath. Through this transformation, you can now consciously shift your flesh itself to adopt a radiant golden exterior akin to Gugalanna's own hide. While a pair of luminous, lightning-forged horns manifest upon your head. When in this form, your body shall embody the sheer force of a divine beast, granting you not only unparalleled strength and durability enough to contest with some Servants—but also a lesser degree of control over the elements, akin to Gugalanna itself. Additionally, the ceaseless storm within your heart allows you to wield the true form of Mana Burst (Lightning) without fear of backlash. The surging energy continuously replenishes itself, empowering your strikes to the level of divine punishment, ensuring that every blow carries the wrath of the heavens.
addons.title: Golden Heart of the Ox

addons.text: Your unique bond with the Lord of the Upper Planes has given rise to an unprecedented phenomenon—a trinity of power forged in the heart of the storm. Now, not only can you summon the clouds of their make to aid your feats, but even call down their storm-forged flesh and the true armored skeleton of Gugalanna to envelop you in a fantastical suit of divine armor as well—with it bestowing upon you the sheer physical might and resilience of Gugalanna's bones—while Nimbus's speed, swiftness, and shifting storm-body reinforce your every move, thus making you an unstoppable force upon the battlefield. This unity has created a powerful reaction, binding the three of you into a newly formed trinity—an embodiment of a three-faced divinity, surpassing even the mightiest of storm gods. Such that even Zeus himself, no matter how arrogant, would dare not slight you, for your dominion over the heavens defies even the authority of chief gods. The domains of lightning, wind, storm, and sky now bend to your will, their might interwoven and exchanged between you seamlessly. Through this ascension, you have gained access to an inexhaustible well of magical power, drawing directly from the boundless energy of the storm. The sheer magnitude of this divine force has crystallized within you, birthing a divine core—marking your rise as a god in your own right. With it, you inherit the authority and power befitting your newfound status, a being of divine thunder and tempest, an undisputed sovereign of the skies.
addons.title: Tempest Crown Heart

addons.text: It seems you've unlocked the ability to Galvanize more than just electricity and magical energy. With the synergistic fusion of your Mystic Code and Skill, you can now convert all forms of ambient energy without limitations. Additionally, you can freely transform the energy you've stored into any type you desire. This evolution effectively makes you what others might call a Type-2 perpetual motion machine, capable of continuously converting and storing energy within a 20-meter radius. This grants you access to virtually limitless reserves. Your ability to channel energy for self-enhancement has also evolved. Now, the effects vary based on the type of energy you utilize. For example, solar energy may provide superior healing and regeneration, while wind energy might enhance your speed and agility, making your movements more fluid and nimble. Each type of energy brings its own unique benefits, allowing you to adapt to different situations with ease. With near-infinite reserves at your disposal, you've unlocked the true form of Mana Burst. However, your version—Mana Burst (Rainbow)—is unique. By dynamically shifting the properties of your energy, you can replicate the effects of any subtype of Mana Burst that exists, granting you unparalleled versatility in both offense and defense. Caution: Please be mindful of your limits. Exceeding your body's capacity will result in a catastrophic—and violent—breakdown. Additionally, this ability stems from the synergy between your Skill and the Mystic Code; if either is destroyed or stolen, you will lose this power entirely.
addons.title: Rainbow Shift

addons.text:
None can stand against you now. At the stroke of midnight or noon, you ascend to become a god incarnate of electricity, your affinity with the element surpassing all natural limits. At those times, it's as if you have partially mantled the authority of Zeus himself. An endless flow of electricity courses through you, empowering you to dominate the fundamental force of Electromagnetism itself and wield your magic with unparalleled mastery.

Moreover, with each passing equinox, your understanding of this fundamental law of reality deepens, accelerating your growth in lightning magecraft and magic, granting you even greater power.
addons.title: Coil System Keraunos: Mystic

objects.text: Galvanism is the ability to freely convert and accumulate magical energy and electricity, including ambient forms of electromagnetism. This Skill extends beyond merely harnessing raw power—it enables the instantaneous transformation of magical energy within any formless thaumaturgy or energy-based magecraft within a 20-meter radius of you into electricity, and vice versa. While you have complete control over the conversion rate, it'll primarily function like a mode dial, letting you toggle the passive rate between 0% and 100% for everything around you. Actual fine-tuned control, however, requires active focus, allowing you to selectively determine what to convert, what to permit, and by how much. The energy you've accumulated can be used in multiple ways—whether, for example, by converting it into bio-electricity to either boost regeneration, metabolism, overall bodily functions, reaction speed, etc, or directly infusing it into your body to reinforce your form before rapidly discharging it—mimicking the effects of Mana Burst (Lightning), a jet burst of magical and electrical energy that significantly enhances both offense and defense. The true limits of this Skill, however, remain yours to explore, bound only by your creativity and mastery.
objects.title: Galvanism - EX (Type-Moon)

objects.text: A Skill that lets one erase their "presence" from perception, whether it be mundane, technological, or supernatural in nature. At its highest, it'll even allow you to become one with the World itself—capable of standing directly before another without being recognized or acknowledged, rendered utterly impossible to detect by any means. However, its effectiveness drops when preparing to attack. Initially, this Skill is C Rank, which is sufficient to obscure yourself from most forms of general scrutiny, so long as you actively remain cautious and deliberate. Nevertheless, if someone has already laid eyes upon you or fixed their senses on your presence, you cannot simply melt away before them. A distraction—anything capable of breaking their attention—is needed before you can reapply the concealment and vanish once more. Though owing to your connection to the Valley of the Shadow of Death, your concealment goes a bit further than what is typical for this Rank, granting you a special bonus whenever you slip into the shadows. In those moments, it's as though the world briefly forgets your existence; corners, alleyways, and dim rooms become sanctuaries where even the keenest gaze might fail to notice you. In addition, your brush with the Valley has granted you a faint resistance to instant-death effects and necromantic abilities that seek to affect you.
objects.title: Presence Concealment (Type-Moon)

objects.text: This skill allows you to create a specialized territory that's advantageous to you. The appearance and abilities of your territory vary depending on your wants, needs, and powers, as each person has their own vision for the territory they create. Your skill starts at Rank A, enabling you to easily create a workshop comparable to that of a legendary magus like Medea. Or you could conjure a landscape that supports you like Ereshkigal's Seven Gates of the Underworld. With time and effort, you can achieve Rank EX and beyond, creating a territory that even surpasses Semiramis's Hanging Gardens of Babylon or Solomon’s Ars Paulina. This skill can easily be combined with other powers but is significantly hindered without some form of supernatural ability.
objects.title: Territory Creation (Type-Moon)

addons.title: Ascendant Origin
addons.text:
Your Origin has ascended. It is no longer simply the source of your power, but the foundation of your existence. Your chosen concept and Resonant Object have become inseparable parts of who you are.
The benefits of Conceptual Imprint are greatly enhanced. The environments that empower you become broader in scope, your affinity with your concept grows far stronger, and your talent for every related skill, craft, power, and discipline reaches the point where revolutionary innovation becomes second nature. Your two Conceptual Gifts also mature alongside your Origin, gaining new applications and increasing in strength as your understanding deepens.
Object Resonance undergoes a complete transformation. Instead of merely manipulating or perceiving your Resonant Object, you become it.

At first, you may transform into any mundane variation of your chosen object while retaining your mind and all of your abilities. A sword may become a dagger, spear, greatsword, or any other bladed weapon. A phone may become any communication device, from a smartphone to two cans connected by string. A book may become a scroll, codex, tablet, or any other medium used to store information.

As your mastery over your Origin grows, these transformations are no longer limited to mundane forms. You may become legendary, supernatural, or conceptual expressions of your object or concept. A Sword Origin may become Excalibur or another mythical blade. A Fire Origin may become the flames of Hestia or a star. A Shadow Origin may become the Abyss itself. A Machine Origin may become a swarm of nanomachines. Every transformation must remain a genuine expression of your Origin.

The unique power granted by Awakened Origin also evolves. Rather than simply applying your concept in increasingly abstract ways, it begins to define reality according to your Origin. A Hunger Origin might consume names, history, powers, or magical attacks. A Sword Origin could cut concepts from existence, causing a person to forget what an apple is by severing the concept of "apple" from their mind. A Fire Origin could burn curses, distance, memories, or the connection between cause and effect. The exact manifestation remains unique to you, even among those with the same Origin.

Unlike others who reach this state, you retain your humanity. An Ascendant Origin normally reshapes its bearer into something fundamentally alien, with the Origin becoming the dominant force behind every thought and action. Even two beings who share the same base Origin would eventually diverge into completely different conceptual existences, their minds no more alike than two unrelated species. You alone retain your original personality while wielding the full power of an Ascendant Origin.

objects.text:
You have Awakened to your Origin. This is the core concept from which you were created from the Root of all existence. What this means is that you have come to embody your origin and receive “superpowers” from it. As an example, someone with the origin of “Hunger” might be able to steal others' powers and traits by eating them or “eating” any attacks made at them.

You have somehow done this without sacrificing your personality and humanity. You won't go crazy from this, but you might find yourself with new urges.
objects.title: Awakened Origin (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
The preeminent ability of Jester Karture takes the form of a cylinder-shaped tattoo etched into the chest. This mark allows the user to transform both body and soul into entirely different forms. The tattoo contains six “bullets,” each one representing a distinct body.

These bodies can vary wildly, ranging from different ages to entirely different races. Jester himself possessed forms such as a werewolf and a golem. By spinning the cylinder, you can switch which body you inhabit. The transformation is seamless, making detection almost impossible.

If one of your bodies is killed, you can revive simply by switching to another. The fallen body’s “bullet” turns black and may be discarded, though the body itself can still be controlled as a puppet if desired. When not in use, bodies regenerate over time, with recovery ranging from days for minor injuries to years for total destruction. Only when all six bullets are destroyed are you forced back into your true form.

You begin with the same six bodies Jester Karture originally possessed, without inheriting his status as a Dead Apostle. If desired, you may redesign these bodies to suit your preferences, provided they remain equal in overall power and capability to the original six. Any additional powers you have chosen may be incorporated into these bodies, enhancing their power or modifying their forms as you see fit.
objects.title: Six Hearted Revolver (Type-Moon)

addons.title: Cross‐Pollination
addons.text:
The celestial bodies you interact with will actively go out of their way to create a biosphere and metaphysics, if present, to allow for your survival, shortening a process that could take decades into a couple of seconds.

If you were to visit them somehow, you would be considered an honorable guest and be under the protection of the planetary consciousness, therefore not targeted by its lifeforms and prime species, if any were present.

Thanks to your ability to speak to the celestial bodies freely, they are able to facilitate communication between you and any life form by merely being in their proximity, allowing for easy cultural exchange.

Should you attempt to seed the planet with human life, depending on whether the world is a desolate one or already populated, they will be considered as a candidate for prime species or at least a species favored by the celestial body.

They will willingly channel their might through your Noble Phantasm if anything is deemed a threat to the planet and its inhabitants, empowering them to the point it could rival the Sword of the Planet with all twelve seals released; if the enemy is deemed as a threat to the cosmos at large, it will escalate even further.

objects.text: Humanity's dreams. Humanity's hope. I'll deliver them all to the distant starry sky. You have the crystallization of the Noble Phantasm belonging to Voyager, the culmination of humanity's dreams and hope for a better future: to sail across the stars, beyond the horizons, to the final frontier, and to be remembered... forever.
