While it is still undeveloped due to its infancy, it can be manifested in a variety of different ways. It is capable of facilitating human colonization on foreign planets—even those that do not possess conditions that permit human life—by directly changing the planet. It alters the environment while imposing the metaphysical rules and consensus reality accepted by humans onto the alien world. You are capable of using it offensively, whether by firing concentrated energy beams or turning yourself into a flying high-speed battering ram. Since it possesses properties similar to those of the sacred lance, Rhongomyniad, it acts as a massive damage multiplier against those with divine or foreign attributes not aligned with the Human Order, actively destabilizing their abilities in the process. As a final function should humanity perish, you can use this power to seed a barren world with life. This nascent life is metaphysically destined to follow the exact evolutionary processes that lead to humanity, eventually developing civilizations that naturally align with the social values and historical standards preserved within the Golden Record. You gain the equivalent of Voyager’s Golden Record, containing all knowledge regarding humankind and Earth, such as music, culture, sounds of nature, images, and academic information, which you can play like an audiobook for others to hear if you wish. As a bonus, you always know exactly where Earth is relative to you, just in case you go on a billion-year voyage.
objects.title: Pale Blue Dot, O' Distant Blue Star (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
You become the vessel of the Shadow Monarch. 

As the Monarch of Shadows, Ruler of the Dead you are capable of extracting the Shadows of the dead, though there’s a chance of failure if the being is significantly stronger than you or had been dead for a long time. Three attempts may be made on the same being before you can no longer attempt to extract their Shadow.  

While Shadows start slightly weaker than when they were alive, they gradually get stronger the more they kill and can eventually evolve into greater beings. You can only hold onto so many Shadows at a time; however, as you grow more experienced in wielding this power, this limit increases. Stored Shadows are kept inside your own shadow. Additionally, you can use your shadow to store items.

You can use shadows as portals to travel vast distances in an instant, create shadow constructs, telekinetically move objects through your authority as a ruler. You can create a domain by projecting your own shadow, which further amplifies your powers and strengthens any Shadows within by 50%. Finally, you can form armor from shadows that greatly increases all your powers and abilities by concentrating a large amount of power around yourself.
objects.title: Shadow Monarch (Solo Leveling)

addons.title: Entwined
addons.text:
Your connection to the Void allows you to use it as a ‘central core’ of sorts to warp your connection to the Light or Darkness. 

For instance, you could use your connection to the Void to alter the properties of Strand, spreading chained tethers for miles across massive amounts of targets, or use the Void’s ability to warp gravity to enhance the Void Light to a borderline ludicrous degree.

addons.title: Rap Tap Tap
addons.text:
Your weight in the Fourth World, now tethered to the Void has given you a fastly deeper well to draw on, becoming more akin to an angel of the void that’s somehow retained its sense of self. This means that your reservoir of Void energy never truly runs dry, giving you far greater control. With little effort you could transmit a ship like the Zariman 10-0 without accident or willingly create a hundred like it.

Additionally, as the Void reflects and distorts anything that it sees or that sees it, you can do the same in the Fourth World. This essentially allows you to amass and convert things to their platonic ideal, giving them more metaphysical weight through their connection to you. 

For instance, you could reflect a ‘strong man’ and course the void through them making them ‘Strong’ on levels deeper than physicality, or turning a chair into the ideal of a chair that perfectly performs its function. This extends so far that if you were to find the embodiment of something in the fourth world, with some effort you could even infect it with the Void, making yourself a part of all of its expressions going forwards, though they would likely violently attempt to prevent this.

objects.text: You've gained a connection to the Void unmarred by any being other than yourself. You are an immortal weapon of war capable of fighting off entire armies on your own, able to infiltrate and sabotage with unparalleled skill. To find a weapon you are not proficient in would be to find a weapon that doesn't exist. You have completed the War Within, making yourself capable of launching beams of Void, displacing yourself to avoid detection, and shifting yourself throughout space. As a master of all 5 focus schools you are capable of making force fields, healing yourself and others, bolstering your physical capabilities, and manipulating Time, Gravity, Electricity, and any other elements you can think of. The only thing restricting your growth is time, eventually you will have absolute control over your Void. You are unique in that you do not need a Warframe to gain access to their abilities, having a much stronger connection to the Void than most Tenno.
objects.title: Tenno (Warframe)

addons.text: As a True Dragon, your existence is unique, even when compared to other True Dragons. As the pinnacle of all bask in the light of creation, your individuality and self-idealized form makes your particularly attuned to the Voice of the World. You will find that the World acknowledges your prowess and abilities more often, making the aquisition of skills an easier and intuitive process for you. Others who find themselves in your presence often enough, even outside the Cardinal World, will eventually become attuned to the Voice of the World, themselves, allowing them to develop skills and possibly eventually even attain higher states of evolution.
addons.title: Intuitive Existence

addons.text:
The sliver of divinity that is the Falna, accurately judges and records the fruits of one's actions and rewards them accordingly. This usually takes the form of Excelia which fills and pushes the limits of their soul causing them to grow stronger. Now the Falna provides an equal measure of magicules dedicated to strengthening skills and abilities awarded by the Voice of the World. It is only a matter of time before any skills evolve into more powerful forms, without specific dedication to that evolution. If there are no eligible skills for evolution, then the gifted magicules will instead double the effect of the Excelia gained normally.

If you were a full blooded god though, you would gain the power to let the Voice of the World interact with your Famila through you. Allowing them to gain magicules in equal measure to their acquirement of Excelia that will enhance their skills and abilities. This does not stop your own benefit of such a thing if you have a Falna.
addons.title: Unique Skill: Divine Record

addons.text:
You have heard the Voice, and taken a piece of it into yourself. This piece, now burned into your essence, does not take up a slot. As a result, the Voice identifies you as "aligned" to it, and as such demonstrates a subtle bias towards you in all things. Skills are gained slightly quicker, chance-based effects resolve a bit more often in your favor, and information it provides you is a little more complete. This bias is subtle, but all-encompassing and constant.

Additionally, your 108 Skills, the source of this alignment, gains greater bias still. You may upgrade any of your 108 through the Voice, increasing its power like any normal skill could be. Upon completing a significant achievement with a slotted skill, such as defeating a stronger enemy while chiefly using it, or crafting a great work with it as the centerpoint, it becomes an Intrinsic Skill, linked to you and no longer taking up a slot.
addons.title: World Soul

addons.text:
Evolutions happen due to the user's body not being able to hold the power accumulated within them, and therefore their bodies change to adapt to the new power. 

As you evolve, you will slowly become a Spiritual existence and your body will start to change to more align with your desires. Spiritual existences are beings who have transcended their body and have become beings made of pure energy and willpower alone, with their soul acting as their mind. Becoming a full spiritual being is very rare and very difficult, with it only being truly possible when certain conditions are met.

After you acquire a substantial amount of Magicules and Skills, you achieve a 'Demon Lord Seed', which is the qualification for becoming a True Demon Lord. It requires more than 10,000 souls to awaken as a True Demon Lord. 

Becoming a Demon Lord will evolve at least one of your skills into an Ultimate Skill and empower all who have a soul connection to the wielder.
addons.title: Evolution

addons.text:
The Voice of the World has noticed the malleability of your soul; most individuals who the Voice of the World has blessed can only acquire so many Skills before the strain starts to damage their soul, thanks to the unusual nature of your soul, you no longer possess this issue, being able to store any amount of Skills within your soul without feeling any of the strain usually encountered by keeping a vast array of Skills. The only equal you would have in terms of soul quality would be Rimuru himself. 

The removal of the number of Skills that your soul can possess is not the only notable change; as you seem to acquire Skills at an unnatural rate, almost as if the Voice of the World favored you more than any other individual responding to your desires similar in nature to how otherworlders first gain Skills when crossing into the Cardinal World, so too shall you find the Voice of the World responding to your desires to evolve and gain further Skills; however, its initially limited to only acquiring new Unique Skills until your Skills have developed further, acquiring an Ultimate Skill for your own. 

Your blessed nature is also evident in the ease with which you evolve your existing Skills, taking both less energy and effort to advance preexisting skills to higher levels, making the process faster. The less power a Skill initially starts with, the quicker it grows. Intrinsic and Common skills take days to evolve into Extra Skills; Extra Skills take months to develop into Unique Skills.
addons.title: Favored Soul

addons.text:
Due to the fusion of your soul and mind, thanks to Soulmind, along with the malleability of your soul, you have undergone a unique evolution regarding the Skills that you acquire. As your Skills evolve and you undergo evolutions, you will eventually find that any Skills that you acquire now have the potential to gain an Ego and Personality, becoming the ultimate heretical evolution beyond the intended direction Veldenava had for Skills becoming a Manas. 

While your Skills have yet to reach this state of becoming a Manas, they will possess more intelligence than a normal Skill, gaining the ability to act and grow in ways that benefit you. As a Manas, they will become something wholly unique to your person, even beyond an Ultimate Skill, a personality befitting your own and absolutely loyal to you. Any skill that eventually evolves into becoming a Manas will supercharge any existing skill to which it is attached. As an example, when Raphael became Ciel, the thought acceleration that Raphael had that boosted Rimuru's processing speed by 1 million times was upgraded to 1 billion times the processing speed.

Should your skill evolve into a Manas, it will be ingrained so deeply into your soul that it cannot be stolen from you, separated or destroyed, existing both alongside your soul and separately. Should your physical or spiritual body perish, it will still exist as information and attempt to find a way to resurrect you.
addons.title: Seed of Sapience: Manas

addons.text:
Beyond your soul merely being favoured by the voice of the world, it seems that due to the unique, anomalous quality of your soul, you have acquired the same skill as Yuuki. This skill will allow you to manipulate the energy of your soul, changing its form into different skills depending on the user's situation and the amount of desire that they have. Using this power, the user can create just about any skill you have in mind, although you are currently limited to Unique Skills.

You are not limited to creating Skills based on existing skills; however, they will be easier to create with the Voice of the World retaining information on canonical skills. Although with enough imagination and creativity, you could create custom skills based on your current desires, new skills will take more time than existing skills. Similar to Yuuki, when coming into contact with someone who possesses skills, detect and analyse their skills, including unique skills, and use information gathered to create new skills.

Creator does have one weakness in that Yuuki's use of this skill was limited by his own shortcomings in his soul, not being strong enough to hold that many skills without straining from possessing multiple unique skills, which is why he used Creator to evolve into a Saint. As your soul is anomalous, you will eventually not possess the same problem as Yuuki.
addons.title: Unique Skill: Creator

objects.text:
The Voice of the World is a phenomenon present in all places. It serves to announce important events such as the acquisition of skills, racial evolution, obtaining a demon seed or hero's egg, and the activation of some skills. When active, it will echo within the mind of all parties relevant to the event in question. Skills may make use of the Voice of the World to communicate prompts for activation to their users.

You now have the ability to hear the Voice of the World, which grants you the capacity to develop new skills and abilities based on your personal growth. 

Your skills will be inscribed onto your soul or material body. Each skill will take an amount of metaphysical “space” within your body or soul based on the type, meaning you can only hold so many skills at a time without improving the strength of your body or soul. 

Once you obtain a skill, it may be used instinctively without practice; however, practice and experience can improve the efficiency and effectiveness of your skills. 

The Voice of the World will allow you to convert all of your existing powers gained at character creation into skills without taking any space within your body and soul. You will also not have to worry about magicule poisoning in case you are a nonmagical species such as unmodified nonmagical humans.

Intrinsic skills encompass skills and abilities that are common to members of the user's species.

Common skills are relatively low powered and not unexpected to be encountered, such as telepathy or self-regeneration.

Extra skills stand at several magnitudes higher in terms of power and efficiency than common skills. They might exist as intrinsic skills for particularly powerful species or as sub-skills for unique and ultimate skills.

Unique skills stand at the next evolutionary stage after extra skills, and are unique to their user. They are frequently made of a collection of subskills of common or extra rank, or might have a subskill unique to that skill. They are described as the "shape of the mind" and thus require their user to have strong desires to acquire them. Some unique skills may possess potency to rival ultimate skills, the next stage of evolution.

Ultimate skills are the final stage of evolution for skills, in general. They grant their user's ultimate power to control the laws of nature within the confines of the skill. Ultimate skills can be achieved by bringing one's unique skills beyond their limit. Only an ultimate skill can counter specific effects of another ultimate skill.

Resistance skills can be intrinsic skills or acquired through long term exposure to attacks of that type, such as resistance to elemental magic or temperature fluctuations.

World System Skills are skills that allow the user to create a unique world and are exclusively found as subskills of ultimate skills.
objects.title: Voice of the World (Tensura)

objects.text: You are able to split apart and combine your powers with ease, allowing for much greater flexibility through splitting your abilities apart to use their component abilities and potency through combining multiple abilities that can do much the same thing together. In addition, this allows you to train individual components of your powers through splitting them apart, or your collective powers through combining them together.
objects.title: Degenerate (Tensura)

addons.text:
Alibi Block is only one of a great many skills the enigmatic Anshin'in has, but it serves as a piece of her essence you've since integrated into yourself, not requiring a slot to hold onto. Some day the heights of her power could be within your grasp. You gain 10 powers every day, each slotted into your 108 wherever there's free space.

Most of these powers are weak and situational, already accounting for the division of effectiveness and manifesting based on your immediate desires. Effects like removing facial hair with a thought or ruining the back wheel of cars you can see are common, with more broadly useful powers rarely appearing in desperate situations.

This is more likely if the power suits your personality, such as pyromania increasing the chance of fire-aligned powers. Over colossal stretches of time, the overall quality of powers you gain daily will slowly grow.
addons.title: Not Equal

objects.text: This is the ability that allows Najimi Ajimu to instantaneously appear wherever and whenever she wants, including physical locations such as: in a locked room, in space, in heaven, or in hell, as well as metaphysical places such as: inside a dream, inside a heart, or even inside people. There is no place in all of reality that is beyond your grasp.
objects.title: Alibi Block (Medaka Box)

addons.text: This prison? To hold me? Thanks to your flesh prison’s nature, you can delay the returners clock to activate either another 24 hours past it’s death or when your Prime Soul finally dies instead, taking you 24 hours before your body’s death. Additionally, I Want To Be Like You activates upon both deaths independently, both that of your flesh prison and your Prime Soul.
addons.title: It’s Not Self Harm If You Get a Power Up.
Minor Arm
addons.text:
When you’re killed, you can choose whether to return with the skill of your killer, or a ‘minor’ arm. 

‘Minor’ Arms are not full Devil Arms. Though still carrying characteristics from the being that created them, their effects are incredibly minor, such as a sword that draws other blades to it lightly to make parrying slightly easier. 

However, these Minor Arms are not limited to the same limit as your Skill Copying, and are independent from it. This means that if you were to die to the same enemy three times, the first you may copy their skill, the second you could create a minor arm based from them, and the third you could improve that arm, with it growing more powerful each time they kill you

Should you manage to subjugate or befriend them, you can combine them with this ‘Minor’ arm to increase the base power of the arm created from them.

objects.text:
You possess the following two skills : 

I Want to Become Just Like You : Activates automatically upon death. After being killed by an enemy, copy one of their skills and make it your own. Skills cannot be copied from targets who have killed you before. The copied skill is randomly selected. Copying stronger skills will make you go through the traumatic memories of your killer. The stronger the skills, the deeper the immersion, which may lead to you loosing your identity without sufficient willpower. 

Returner’s Clockwork Watch : Activates automatically upon death. Return 24 hours prior to death. Memories and abilities are preserved even after returning.
(*If you are a drop-in you cannot go beyond the time you have been inserted)
objects.title: Just Like You! (SSS Class Suicide Hunter)

objects.text:
You can summon anyone you have killed as undead monsters. The dead cannot use their abilities from when they were living. But if you want, the dead will be able to keep their memories and their looks from when they were alive. If you don’t want to, they’ll just be summoned as monsters. 

You can only summon them once a week, but they can remain summoned indefinitely. If you summon someone who was already summoned, they will simply appear near you, regardless of where they were earlier.
objects.title: Hundred Ghosts Reincarnation (SSS Class Suicide Hunter)

objects.text:
The Black Swan is a curse created by the legendary Saberhagen, and it has been cursing generations of humans all for the sake of killing the vampire king. You receive a copy of this curse, although it is slightly altered from the original, as it offers only benefits and removes any of the drawbacks. Some of the most notable changes you receive are a significant boost to your physical capabilities, along with the ability to fly. While you might not yet have the strength to match a vampire blow for blow, you effortlessly surpass the Vampire Queen and King in speed.

Keep in mind that when those two go all out, they can easily move at significant relativistic speeds, so this boost isn't meant to be taken lightly. The greatest ability of the Black Swan is its power to nullify any magic it comes in contact with. Any magic that comes within an inch of any part of your body will be nullified, unlike the original, which only affected the arms. You’re able to form a solid anti-magic barrier around yourself and others in case you need to protect people from magic spammers. This nullification is selective, so any magic you want to be affected by will work along with your own.

The final ability of the Black Swan is its power to grow stronger with every generation. With each passing year, you become more powerful, surpassing the past version of yourself as any limits you have are broken. Given enough time, all of your abilities, powers, and everything else about you will be enhanced in strength the longer you exist. Even when doing absolutely nothing, you’ll find that you surpass the previous year’s version of yourself by a significant margin.

If you were to train any of your skills, they would gain an astronomical boost, as any progress will be heavily accelerated due to your time limiter being removed. There is no limit to this either, so whether you wait a year or engage in a short workout, you’ll surpass the Vampire King in strength and go even further beyond. While you may not be unstoppable now, time is all you need before you surpass everyone.
objects.title: The Black Swan (The Record Of A Fallen Vampire)

objects.text:
You possess the extraordinary ability to harness the conceptual power of 'Law'. This power grants you the activation of a unique vision that enables you to see and identify those who have violated laws within the past 72 hours. Using this ability, you can visually mark the transgressors for all to see. The nature of the mark is entirely under your control; it could be a hovering red X above their head, a temporary stamp on their forehead, or even an ethereal scroll displaying a list of their committed crimes.

This mark imposes a temporary debuff on the individuals, the severity of which escalates based on the gravity of their offenses. The debuff weakens their capabilities, making them more vulnerable and hindered in their actions.

Additionally, as long as your actions align with the law, you possess the power to summon restrictive equipment infused with the essence of Law. This equipment, such as cuffs or chains, materializes around your targets, restraining them and becoming increasingly resistant to their attempts to break free. It should be noted that innocent civilians who have not broken any laws recently are immune to the effects of this equipment.

With dedicated training and thorough research, you can uncover new applications for the conceptual power of Law. For instance, you may discover the ability to enforce Karmic retribution upon individuals with negative Karma, subjecting them to equal amounts of misfortune proportional to their misdeeds. However, it is important to remember that the essence of Law exists to uphold order and safeguard the well-being of society. Any attempts to pervert the law for personal gain or unjust purposes will result in the failure of this power.
objects.title: Incantation of Law (The Experimental Log of the Crazy Lich)

addons.text: Your Esper super gene has devoured your quirk to fuel your life hierarchy ascension. This causes your Esper ability to develop emitter, transformation, and heteromorphic aspects, making it much broader and more well-rounded overall. Your Esper ability will have some form of emission and transformation. With [Dawn of Life] or [Power Of Death], you could develop the ability to transform into an underworld spirit and fire lasers of highly concentrated lifeforce or death energy that gives people super cancer. The heteromorphic aspect manifests mostly in the way of influencing the life hierarchy ascension. By using the energy your cells produce as a means of super accelerating and supercharging the evolution of your genetics, you can gradually evolve into an ideal vessel for your chosen Esper ability, so with [Blood Control], you might evolve into a member of the Blood (Vampire) race, etc. Nevertheless, your progress in the Esper class goes much more smoothly than before. You can develop new techniques for your Esper ability and grow in energy rank almost three times as fast as an ordinary Esper. It's as if you were born for this. If you get Double Quirk (My Hero Academia), you get another Esper ability of similar well-roundedness. These Esper abilities share growth as they draw upon the same super gene.
addons.title: Golden Genetic Lottery Ticket

addons.text:
You have the same Esper ability as EsGod and Evans, the Esper ability of [Replicate]. This ability allows you to absorb the Esper abilities of other Espers through touch. You may still give Esper abilities to others through touch as well.

As an F-grade Esper, you can store around a hundred esper powers and use 15 of those at once. Going beyond this risks destabilizing your genes. 
Increasing in grade increases your storage capacity by 50% and allows you to use five more powers simultaneously.

Unlike All for One, you do not steal the raw power behind the esper ability, only the ability itself. In exchange, you apply your own esper development and raw power to your stolen esper powers, boosting them up to your level, though powers stolen from a stronger foe will weaken until you reach their original holder's level.

Your ten starter quirks are instead esper abilities already stored within your gene chain, though super high-risk esper abilities are worth more, with [Energy Control], [Particle Control], and [Force Control] being worth five, [Dawn of Life], [Power of Death], and [Shadow Control] being worth three, [Dark Energy and Dark Matter Control] and [Spacetime Freeze] being worth two.

This also allows you to turn any other power you have into an Esper ability in your storage.

If you have Symbol of Evil (My Hero Academia), you also obtain all the Esper Abilities EsGod has stolen over his life, along with his Beyond A Grade power. These Esper abilities carry no genetic load but otherwise remain as if you replicated them normally.
addons.title: EsGod, The God of Espers

objects.text: You are one of the lucky ones, an Esper. Your strength comes from your DNA. The abilities of Espers are varied and unique, and two Espers with the same ability might not necessarily use them in the same ways. Through leveling up their talents, your control over your powers would increase power, speed, control, etc. With sufficient time, an Esper’s potential could be said to be unlimited. You are guaranteed to have a strong Esper ability if you choose. You start as an F grade Esper, with grade F energy reserves. You have the potential for reaching X grade without the beyonders' vestige and needing members of all 5 main classes to help you.
objects.title: Super System: Esper (Legendary Mechanic)

addons.text:
You are not just a Pugilist; no, you are the embodiment of the path itself. You possess one of the most refined pugilist combat talents in the universe, that being [Perfect Pugilist Sense]. This massively amplifies your potential within the Pugilist class.

A coefficient of 1.4x amplifies your pugilist class affinity, as this enhancement takes effect last from any of your bonuses, even temporary boosts are fully included.

When enhancing your body, your strikes and physical performance are elevated far beyond normal limits, granting your body and attacks +100% to +200% their usual effectiveness.

Last but not least, the levels of all your Pugilist class active abilities are increased by 4. This allows you to even enhance their levels beyond the ordinary level cap. 

To your senses, your body is no longer just flesh, but a perfectly tuned instrument of combat and martial arts, where every movement and strike flows with flawless precision and deadly force.
addons.title: [Perfect Pugilist Sense]

addons.text: Your Touki is subsumed and integrated into your Qi, turning into a set of powerful talents. [Vital Flames] Your pugilist flames deal an additional 25% True Damage, whenever your pugilist flames injure others, you regenerate 12.5% of the damage dealt, this is capped at regenerating 50% of your health per second. [Sheer Force of Vitality] The sheer force of your vitality enhances your pugilist flames; your damage is multiplied by 1.55, and you gain +2 to all pugilist skills. [Lifeforce Bolster] Your lifeforce is vigorous and extremely tenacious. You gain extra Endurance to HP at a conversion rate of 1:45, +15% to all resistance, and a passive 5% HP regeneration per second.
addons.title: Vital Pugilist Flames

objects.text: Your strength lies in your inner strength, your ability to use Qi. Although Pugilists across the universe practiced and employed different kinds of teachings and techniques, all of them were centered around the use of qi. You start as an F grade Pugilist, with grade F energy reserves. You have the potential for reaching X grade without the beyonders' vestige and needing members of all 5 main classes to help you.
objects.title: Super System: Pugilist (Legendary Mechanic)

objects.text: You focus on mind over matter, you are a Psychic. Psychics primarily focus on ranged mental attacks and grow more powerful at higher levels. Psychics eventually are able to control their physical environments. You start as an F grade psychic, with grade F energy reserves. You have the potential for reaching X grade without the beyonders' vestige and needing members of all 5 main classes to help you.
objects.title: Super System: Psychic (Legendary Mechanic)

addons.text:
You are not some mechanic; no, you are THE mechanic. You possess one of the most potent mechanical molding talents in the universe, that being [Perfect Mechanical Sense]. This massively amplifies your potential within the mechanic class. 

A coefficient of 1.4x amplifies your machinery affinity, as this enhancement takes effect last, even temporary machinery affinity boosts are taken into account. 

All mechanical equipment that receives your mechanical force bonuses is temporarily raised one to two grades; this can, at most, raise the grade to pink.

Last but not least, the levels of all your mechanic skills are raised by 4. This allows you to enhance their levels beyond the ordinary level cap. This also boosts blueprints, as they are considered skills as far as the mechanic class is concerned. 

To your senses, every machine is a world of ecological balance.
addons.title: [Perfect Mechanical Sense]

addons.text:
You have obtained yet another molding talent at the pinnacle of the mechanic class. With the molding talent [Blueprinter], you instantaneously learn the blueprints of any machinery you lay your eyes on. You are still required to fulfill the requirements to build said blueprint; however, you can always create weaker prototypes from a greater blueprint.

Furthermore, you have the ability to derive the mechanic knowledge used in the blueprint with a fixed one in a hundred chance to receive a knowledge fragment. You need six fragments of basic knowledge to derive basic knowledge, 12 for advanced knowledge, 18 for high-end knowledge, 24 for cutting-edge knowledge, and 48 for ultimate knowledge.
addons.title: [Blueprinter]

addons.text:
You have obtained an Exclusive talent, functioning as a powerful upgrade to the [Perfect Mechanical Sense].

Your Mechanical Force has the "Sparky" attribute, making it inherently high-energy (your machinery affinity coefficient is raised to a base of 1.5x), but slightly unruly and volatile, making precise control more difficult when you are lucid.

Furthermore, both your machinery affinity and mechanical energy regeneration scales with how deep you are in the Madness Place, raising to 2x affinity coefficient and 5x mechanical energy regeneration when you are deep in the Phase 3 of the Madness Place.

Most notably, however, your Spark defies conventional progression. You can reliably invent, operate and build based on principles one full knowledge tier above your formal understanding: with only Basic Knowledge, you can try to bring Advanced blueprints to life; with Advanced, you can attempt to realize High-End designs. This is further enhanced when you are deep in the Phase 3 of the Madness Place, allowing you to skip an entire tier of knowledge and build things 2 tiers above what you were taught to.

Whenever you successfully design a new blueprint that is beyond your current knowledge, it triggers the [Blueprinter] derivation ability, providing a flat 1% chance to immediately gain a fragment of that higher knowledge.
addons.title: [Perfect Spark Sense · Heterodyne]

addons.text: You were born with an innate understanding of all 60 mechanic class advancement knowledge at complete mastery, from the basic knowledge that is only a little ahead of current modern science to the ultimate knowledge that allows for true mechanical life creation. You also gain a +1.25 Total Machinery Affinity bonus multiplier, +3 levels to all mechanic class-related abilities, + 40% production, enhancement, and repairing ability, +15% Machinery basic attributes, +120 machinery production speed. A +60% bonus to your second specialization when you get it, so if you become a Virtual Mechanic, you will gain a 60% bonus to all virtual technology. Along with a massive intelligence attribute bonus equivalent to what Han Xiao’s interface would numerically register as a +3000 bonus. This gives you comparable intelligence to that of an average mid- to high-A+ grade mechanic. In the machinery territory, you're an all-knowing sage.
addons.title: [Great Machinery Sage]

addons.text: You have received the max level mechanic subclass [Fourth Machine Lord]. Giving you several skills and a large amount of attribute points. At lv.10, you gain a total of +30 Endurance, +60 Intelligence, +90% machinery affinity, +160 free attribute points, and +120 potential points. [Sacrifice Equip] You can sacrifice one or more pieces of equipment to turn them into a [Deploy Armament] subskill. You can also sacrifice equipment to raise the level of these subskills, which increases the attributes, abilities, and grade of the deployed armament (up to Gold). [Deploy Armament] By expending energy, you can manifest armaments from your selection of [Deploy Armament] subskills created from your sacrificed equipment. This skill has a variable energy cost equal to the armament's power level. Additionally, the deployed armaments are temporary; after combat ends or after 3 hours, they will dissolve back into energy. [Break Core] You can cause the core of any piece of equipment to detonate, creating a powerful explosion that deals 10x the equipment's energy level. Base energy cost: 1000. You can also overcharge your energy into a piece of equipment to temporarily increase the energy rank at a 1:1 ratio, allowing you to supercharge this explosion. You are not immune to the damage of this explosion.
addons.title: [Fourth Machine Lord]

objects.text: You are an inventor, someone who builds their way to victory. The mechanic is extremely weak in its early period but can become one of the strongest professions in their later period. It is the only professionals who are polyvalent, it can be a long-range damage dealer, a close-combat damage dealer, a support, a tank, or an army commander; following your machinery or equipment you can take different positions to take part in a fight. Being a mechanic is expensive, however, due to the materials needed and their costly nature. You start as an F grade mechanic, with grade F energy reserves. You have the potential for reaching X grade without the beyonders' vestige and needing members of all 5 main classes to help you.
objects.title: Super System: Mechanic (Legendary Mechanic)

objects.text: You are one of the lucky ones, a natural mage, being born with magical power or being able to awaken it. These mages can learn magic from any branch. One way to learn new spells, for you, is to burn energy, in place of experience. Each spell is split into stages, and you need to learn all of the stages to learn the spell. Your success rate for learning a stage is dependent on your intelligence and mysticism. You start as an F grade mage, with grade F energy reserves. You have the potential for reaching X grade without the beyonders' vestige and needing members of all 5 main classes to help you.
objects.title: Super System: Mage (Legendary Mechanic)

objects.text:
You now possess the ability to skillfully manifest nigh flawless illusions. Your mastery over the faculties that shape one's perception of reality is unparalleled, enabling you to induce a state of near complete hypnosis in anyone subject to your manipulation. You can project diverse shapes and forms, manipulate the perception of time in those within your vicinity, or envelop them in profound darkness by impeding their senses. With sufficient expertise, you can even construct an entire lifetime for them within a matter of seconds. The potential applications of these powers are limited only by the boundaries of your imagination.

While the illusions you create wield significant potency, individuals of considerable power and proficiency themselves may discern subtle disparities between the illusions and reality, although they may struggle to pinpoint the exact nature of these discrepancies. The definitive means to wholly dispel these illusions is either through physical contact with you by those ensnared within them, or through your death.
objects.title: Dolos (Bleach)

addons.text: Your Divine Patron has gained Authority over the entity Od Laguna (The World) and now has the power to bestow Divine protections onto you and others who follow its religion. Unlike with Od Laguna there is no miscommunication between you and your patron, making it so you will always have whatever Divine Protection you and your God/Goddess believe are needed in whatever situation you are going through.
addons.title: Guardian of the Faithful

addons.text:
Your connection to the divine has deepened beyond simple blessings. Each Divine Protection you acquire is now a fragment of a god’s essence, infused with their legend, authority, and power. Rather than merely granting you a single ability, these Divine Protections now carry the presence of the deity who bestowed them, their will echoing through you in a way far beyond what a normal blessing could provide.

With each Divine Protection, you gain a deeper connection to the god who granted it. Their instincts, wisdom, and mythos subtly guide your actions, allowing you to channel their divine expertise. A Divine Protection of War might not just enhance your combat prowess—it could grant you the battle-honed instincts of a war god, letting you perceive and react as they would. A Divine Protection of storms could imbue you with the presence of a storm deity, making your movements as unstoppable as a hurricane.

Over time, these Divine Protections may evolve, reflecting the growth of your relationship with the gods. If your bond with a particular deity strengthens, their blessing may expand beyond its original limits, granting powers that mirror their greatest feats and legends.
addons.title: Divine Protection of the Gods

objects.text:
The possessor of this extraordinary ability has the power to acquire any Divine Protection they desire in specific situations and retain them permanently. These Divine Protections are granted by an entity known as Od Laguna (The World), which can even create new Divine Protections that have never existed before. However, there is a chance of miscommunication, leading to the recipient not receiving the intended Divine Protection accurately. This ability is independent of any other inherent powers and allows the user to erase Divine Protections if desired.

Divine Protections are unique blessings bestowed upon individuals at birth by the world, though most people lack them. Certain races possess inherent Divine Protections, granting special abilities. The ratio of holders varies. These blessings encompass a wide range of effects, like reading the wind or emotions, enhancing physical abilities, or providing elemental protection and much more. They can evolve and differ slightly among users with the same Protection. Certain magical methods can temporarily remove them.  If two Protections clash, they nullify each other.
objects.title: Divine Protection (Re:Zero)

addons.text: When you have a dilemma in mind you are able to peer through time, revealing the future outcomes of two mutually exclusive choices you can make. These two outcomes are a string of events that will occur as a result of making that decision. You will then have to decide between these two outcomes before the moment will end, thus guaranteeing that outcome to happen. The events between your choice and the outcome are not detailed, but the outcome is guaranteed to happen. Though it may be possible for others to work around your junction depending on the nature of your universe.
addons.title: Junction Impact

objects.text:
You become a Chronon Active Lifeform. You seemingly generate infinite amounts of Chronon Particles, allowing you to power your time-related abilities without requiring external sources of power. Your mastery over your time-related powers grows when exposed to external sources of time-related energy. Whether they be Temporal anomalies, time related magic, ect. Some abilities you get as a Chronon Active Lifeform are...
Chronon Locked: It is much harder from unwanted external interference to affect your current timeline, and impossible to harm the current you by affecting your past.

You also gain the ability to manipulate time. Allowing you to act unfazed in the face of temporal anomalies, and even extending this protection to other people and objects through touch. You also gain a certain sight that allows you to see glimpses of past and future events around a given location. Although it starts out not too strong. These glimpses will only present relevant information, and you can even see them when time has stopped. 
You also gain the power to temporarily stop time in a bubble, only requiring line of sight. You can learn to eventually create a shield of distorted time around yourself, making all attacks directed at you distort around you and miss. Or affecting your own time to rewind injuries, accelerate yourself to move extremely quickly to others point of view, or affect the time of other targets. Rewinding broken objects, or fast forwarding an apple to make it quickly rot.

Your powers are also no longer constrained by time. Meaning that temporal limits and restraints, such as cooldowns, delayed activations, limited durations, or limited uses over a period of time can be ignored. (Does not include Foundation, Keystone, or Paragon Powers.) This does not remove the need of energy for said powers, nor any other resources that may be required.
objects.title: Chronon Active Lifeform (Quantum Break)

objects.text:
The inherited power of Sight bestowed upon its wielder the ability to perceive hidden and lost things. With a mere activation, the individual gains unparalleled vision, capable of seeing even the most elusive and reluctant entities. This power extends beyond the boundaries of the Nightside, reaching into the outer world, and remains impervious to most attempts to shield against it. 

The wielder possesses a form of telekinesis, allowing them to subtly influence physical objects and manipulate intangible energies. The true potential of this gift is said to be far greater than anticipated, hinting at the ability to shape reality itself when the inner eye is fully awakened. However, the power exacts a toll on the user, causing physical and spiritual strain with excessive or intense usage, often accompanied by nosebleeds, headaches, and pain. 

Furthermore, activating the power can draw unwanted attention, acting as a beacon across Time and Space. 

Beyond its ability to locate and perceive, this power grants insights into the weaknesses, fears, hopes, and even the eventual demise of adversaries, as well as the capacity to unravel magical spells and bindings. Firearms are rendered unnecessary in the presence of this formidable gift.
objects.title: John Bloody Taylor (Nightside)

objects.text:
You have become an embodiment of the ancient and enigmatic Root species.

At the start, your transformation into the Root is nascent, granting you limited control and abilities. As you claim territories and infuse your essence into the land, you will rapidly grow in strength, evolving into a formidable entity. 

In your Root form, you are imbued with superhuman strength, speed, and durability. Your body possesses a potent regenerative capacity, enabling you to heal swiftly from any non-fatal wounds, rejuvenating your being with the lifeforce of the land.

Even when not in your Root form, you command dominion over all life surrounding you. With a mere thought, you can manipulate and shape them to your will. By imbuing your essence into a living creature, you can induce supernatural mutations, transforming both the living organisms and the very landscape according to your desires.

As you amass sufficient essence and establish a sanctum, the true extent of your power is unveiled. Within the sanctum, you gain the ability to create Root structures, create creatures of the Root, and forge anomalous objects infused with supernatural properties. You hold the limited ability to warp reality, harnessing the essence of the land to bend and mold it to your whims.

Furthermore, your connection to the Root grants you the gift of shaping life into weaponry. With a mere thought, you can manifest any weapon you desire, forged from the very essence of the Root itself. 

Within your sanctum, you have the ability to create a core, a vital source of your essence. As long as one core remains intact, you attain immortality, even if your mortal form falls outside the sanctum's protection. The core acts as a beacon, allowing you to teleport to and through it, even other realms are not beyond your reach, ensuring your resilience and continued existence in the face of adversity.
objects.title: The Undying Root (R:FTA)

objects.text:
You are a Herrscher, a being that carries a shadow of Finality, an authority over a concept. You have a core with limitless amounts of Honkai, though you cannot use all of that energy. Being limited to only enough to burn down Australia in a week if your authority was say, Flames. 

The Honkai is an energy, those without a resistance to it experience effects of rapid decay and become Zombies, and there are also Honkai Beasts, which are generally immune to small arms. Honkai as an energy is fundamentally omni-applicable because of its imaginary nature.

A few other examples of authorities include the Herrscher of Reason, which could create any technology civilization believed possible, this includes things like teleporting to the moon, a mecha, and summoning dozens of lasers, Ice, who could freeze and entire city in a layer of ice in mere hours, and Void, who could create portals, pocket dimensions and projectiles that pierced through defenses. You also have perfect control over the Honkai you emit so you won’t cause a zombie apocalypse wherever you go.
objects.title: Herrscher (Honkai Impact 3rd)
Wishpower (Honkai: Star Rail)
objects.text:
You wield Wishpower, energy produced by wishes, belief, imagination, and attention. Hope, prayer, dreams, fear, admiration, hatred, disbelief, and believed stories can empower you when directed toward you, your creations, or an idea you represent. Gathering this energy does not weaken its source, and your own wishes ensure you are never completely powerless.

You sense wishes as impressions, learning what is desired and how strongly it is felt without reading private thoughts or memories. Wishpower can be stored within meaningful art, masks, books, symbols, monuments, and performances. It does not decay while that meaning remains, and destroying a vessel releases its stored power rather than erasing it.

You use imagenesis to transform imagination into reality. You initially manifest simple objects, food, tools, minor creatures, and sensory environments. Creations follow their concepts, allowing imagined wings to fly, legendary weapons to affect supernatural targets, or mascots to protect those whose hopes inspired them.

The required Wishpower increases with a creation’s size, complexity, duration, and abilities. You must understand its concept well enough to produce a coherent result. Attention can reinforce it, while contradictory beliefs create instability until you choose which interpretation takes priority. Creations may be dismissed, repaired, or made permanent through continued investment. Permanent creations remain real without further belief, although powerful abilities may still consume energy.

You may create independent imaginary beings called imagenae from characters, symbols, species, guardians, monsters, or collective dreams. Their bodies and natural abilities reflect their concepts and the power invested in them. Imagenae possess emotions, free will, and the ability to grow beyond their intended roles. They are not puppets or copied souls. They cannot perform imagenesis unless they independently obtain Wishpower, though they may use their own abilities and reproduce normally when appropriate.

You may also manifest locations and scenarios, turning a room into a forest, expanding a stage into a city, or generating terrain and challenges based on a story or game. Those inside retain free will and can resist the scenario or escape its boundaries.

Wishpower can produce miracles. Minor wishes may locate keepsakes, repair objects, arrange coincidences, or create opportunities. Greater wishes require proportionately greater energy, belief, preparation, symbolic acts, and a possible route to the intended result. You understand a wish’s honest intent and need not twist its wording. You may refuse it, fulfill only part, or explain what is required. No wish can command you or claim ownership of your power.

Public perception may temporarily strengthen qualities associated with you, such as protection, artistry, or leadership. You decide which expectations affect you; reputation cannot overwrite your identity, values, appearance, history, or loyalties.

Initially, your effects are local and complex creations rapidly drain your reserves. Practice improves scale, efficiency, permanence, and the wishes you can fulfill. You may eventually create communities, species, and pocket environments, but cannot provide unlimited wishes, perfectly duplicate unique beings, or manufacture omnipotence through belief.

Legend speaks of the coming of great heroes. As the darkness gathers and the forces of the underworld rise to swallow the land of the living, a few brave souls will hear the call to greatness. Their deeds will become the stories of our time, and their victories will be celebrated for centuries to come. Even now, they walk among us— unaware of the destiny that awaits them. The moment is almost here. Their hour is at hand.

You are one of those heroes.
You start out on the first tier of a mythic path of your choice and gain all of its benefits. Through overcoming adversity or accomplishing great deeds you will be able to gain further tiers and their benefits.
objects.title: Mythic (Pathfinder)

objects.text:
Embrace the dark allure of the Dread Gods with this formidable power. As an Avatar of Fear, you gain the ability to channel the essence and embodiment of a chosen aspect of fear. This grants you immense power and influence, as you become a vessel for the chosen god's fearsome presence.

Upon invoking your authority, your form willingly morphs into a terrifying metamorphosis, assuming traits associated with the chosen deity, while also passively generating an aura linked to your dread god. Whether it is the maddening visage and contorted presence of The Spiral, the all-seeing and paranoia-inducing gaze of The Eye, or the encroaching tendrils and rot of The Corruption, your presence becomes a chilling reflection of the dread god's domain.

As an Avatar, you gain access to a range of abilities aligned with the chosen Dread God's aspect of fear. These may include the ability to induce disorientation and confusion, manipulate perceptions and illusions, instill intense paranoia and surveillance, spread decay and corruption, or relentlessly hunt down your targets. The potency of these abilities increases as your connection to the dread god deepens and your understanding of their domain grows.

However, beware the consequences of wielding such forbidden power. The dread gods are ancient and unfathomable, their motives inscrutable and often beyond mortal comprehension. As an Avatar, you risk losing yourself to the insidious influence of the dread deity, slowly succumbing to madness and becoming an agent of chaos and terror. The boundaries between your humanity and the entity you embody blur, and the line between foe and ally becomes increasingly indistinguishable.

Choose your dread god wisely, for each one carries its own unique challenges and rewards. Will you embrace the seductive whispers of The Web, the suffocating loneliness of The Lonely, or the relentless pursuit of The Hunt?
objects.title: Avatar of Fear (The Magnus Archive)

objects.text:
The power of the Tyrant King of Returners bestows upon you a formidable set of abilities derived from the Sinner-type talent of Xiang Yu, the Tyrant King of Ancient China. With this power, you've transform into a Perfect Returner, and allowing you to wield absolute control over creation, bending it to your will through your battle aura.

Your aura manifests as a menacing black energy, extending from your being and granting you mastery over the surrounding environment. Effortlessly, you can lift and propel objects, transforming them into lethal projectiles. By manipulating the fabric of space and time, you can teleport across vast distances, swiftly traversing the battlefield along with your followers.

Imbuing yourself with your aura, you become intangible, impervious to harm as attacks pass harmlessly through you. By extending your aura into others, you seize control of their bodies and delve into their minds, delving into their thoughts and memories. Reinforcing objects with your aura enhances their strength and durability, elevating them into formidable weapons.

Harnessing the raw power of your aura, you command the very earth itself. Infusing the ground with your energy, you summon towering golems to aid you in battle, as well as allowing you to reshape the battlefield to your liking.

At the pinnacle of your abilities lies the Black Death Harmony technique. After a brief meditation, you erect a black spherical barrier that ensnares your foes. Within this enclosed space, you become an untouchable deity, exerting complete control over all matter on a molecular level. Through manipulation of intense magnetic and gravitational forces, you dismantle, compress, and reshape matter, generating an awe-inspiring energy akin to a miniature Big Bang.
objects.title: The Tyrant King of Returners (Petals of Reincarnation)

objects.text:
You are the scourge, the creeping darkness, the source of corruption which seeps into the world, warping and twisting everything it touches. With your newfound power, you can emit an invisible and ever-present madness that infects the very fabric of reality. If you remain in a place long enough, your corruption takes root, warping creatures, mutating flora, and driving sentient beings to depravity.

The extent of your corruption depends on your unique abilities, desires, and emotions. Those with a deep affection for insects may witness people and beast sprouting delicate wings, and antennas. Meanwhile, those connected to the ocean, with a command over its depths, may witness the ground transforming into swirling currents and trees taking the form of elegant coral structures. As time passes, your corrupting influence becomes even more strange, molding the world according to your desires.

As your domain expands, you gain a sense of connection, feeling the streets and stairs as if they were extensions of your own being. Once the location is completely saturated, you achieve immortality, able to resurrect endlessly within your corrupted realm.

You hold the power to control this corruption, switching it on and off at will or limiting its progression. But beware, leaving your domain weakens the effect, and it takes twice as long as it was applied to fully dissipate. Although creatures and structures transformed within your domain won't revert, they crumble to dust as reality reclaims its hold.
objects.title: The Creeping Darkness (Fear & Hunger)

objects.text:
Your body has received the an injection of three different nanomachines, each of these nanites are able to harness perpetual energy through three distinct functions. Dispersed throughout your being, these nanites enable you to manipulate energy and overcome physical limitations.

First, you possess the ability to generate boundless energy from nothingness. Comparable to the output of a nuclear power plant, you effortlessly produce vast amounts of energy without external sources or fuel. This limitless reserve grants you unmatched physical attributes and near-inexhaustible vitality.

The second facet of your power revolves around thermal energy mastery. As heat enters your body, the nanites convert it into usable energy with utmost efficiency and zero loss. Your capability to convert heat on a grand scale rivals volcanic eruptions, granting you the ability to harness and utilize immense thermal power.

The third aspect manifests as a localized field of friction manipulation. Within a 20-meter radius, you can reduce friction to absolute zero. This ability nullifies resistance for objects within the field, allowing effortless movement. Additionally, you can selectively apply this frictionless state to a chosen object for up to 2 minutes. This manipulation empowers you to navigate challenging environments with ease and create temporary frictionless surfaces.

Harnessing the potential of these nanites, you possess extraordinary mastery over all types of energy, defying the laws of physics and surpassing conventional limitations.
objects.title: Code Unknowns (Mondaiji)

objects.text:
Avesta grants you three extraordinary abilities centered around the concept of duality.

Firstly, Avesta allows you to temporarily copy the powers of those near you or directly facing you for up to 24 hours. By tapping into their essence, you replicate their abilities, effectively adapting to various opponents and harnessing their strengths as your own.

Secondly, Avesta grants you a counterpower specifically designed to neutralize the abilities you have copied. This ensures that you possess the means to overcome any threat posed by your adversaries, and nullifies any advantage your adversaries power have over you.

Additionally, when you copy someone's powers, you gain 50% of their attributes. This augmentation significantly boosts your own capabilities, enhancing strength, speed, agility, intelligence, and more. With this shared synergy, you wield formidable prowess, rivalling even the most powerful adversaries.

As long as Avesta is active, your chance of victory will never fall below 50%, regardless of the situation or number of enemies you face. In fact, the more opponents you confront, the stronger you become. This power creates an insurmountable challenge for your adversaries, as their collective might only fuels your unstoppable rise.
objects.title: Avesta: The Duality of Good & Evil (Mondaiji)

addons.text:
The Mark of a King and Warrior’s Bond has fused into an unparalleled force, transcending its origins to offer extraordinary capabilities. Your powers has evolved, allowing you to create intelligent, living weapons crafted from the deepest desires and aspirations of individuals. These sentient beings possess formidable combat prowess and unique abilities tailored to their original hosts. These living weapons retain memories of their past lives, and if created unwillingly, they can exhibit rebellious behavior until their will is broken. Despite their rebellion, they remain inherently loyal to you.

Additionally, you can now mass-produce these Weapons and Voids through the cultivation of Void Crystals. By embedding specific Voids into these crystals, you can generate multiple clones of a particular weapon or being, each maintaining the core attributes and abilities of the original. It is possible for deviancy to occur, creating mutations where new abilites are gained or lost. These clones share a single hive mind, allowing for seamless coordination and strategic advantage in combat. This capability enables you to form entire armies of specialized living weapons.

Another enhancement is the ability to bestow marks upon others, granting them a lesser version of your fused power. These marks enable recipients to wield and create living weapons or tools imbued with symbolic resonance, though to a lesser extent. This distributed power allows for a network of allies, each capable of harnessing the collective strength of the fused abilities, thus amplifying your influence and reach.

All the minds of both the weapons and the marked individuals are interconnected through a network, allowing for communication and the sharing and storing of information. This network enhances coordination and ensures that all members of your force are constantly informed and synchronized, further solidifying your position of power.
addons.title: Warrior King

objects.text:
You have been marked by the enigmatic power known as "The Mark of a King." This unique ability grants you control over the ominous Apocalypse Virus, allowing you to harness its destructive potential. Unlike others infected by the virus, you are immune to its maddening influence, and instead have become its ruler.

The Apocalypse Virus, a mysterious entity of unknown origins, infects individuals and binds them to a collective hivemind. Those affected slowly succumb to its influence, their bodies transforming into exotic Void Crystals. However, as the King of the Virus, you are untouched by its corruptive sway.

With the power of the Void at your command, you possess the ability to extract and manipulate the "Voids" of individuals. By delving into their deepest desires and aspirations, you can manifest their true selves in tangible forms. These Voids take on various shapes, representing the innermost wishes and unique abilities of each individual.

Once in possession of a Void, you wield complete control over it. Mastering its supernatural potential, you can wield it as a formidable weapon, unleashing devastating attacks and gaining unparalleled advantages in combat. The Voids are imbued with abilities and properties that align with the desires and dreams of their original owners, making them potent tools in your arsenal.

Beyond combat, your proficiency in Void Manipulation allows you to tap into the vast potential of the Apocalypse Virus. You can manipulate the Void Genome to strengthen your own body, mending wounds with its regenerative properties. Furthermore, you are able to harness the Virus to generate Void Crystals, shape constructs, brainwash the mind of those infected, and various other feats as the Apocalypse Virus continues to evolve and adapt to best suit you.
objects.title: The Mark Of A King (Guilty Crown)

objects.text:
Congratulations! You have become the chosen host of an ancient and formidable primordial entity known as The Darkness. As the wielder of The Darkness, you gain mastery over the very essence of darkness, shadow, and evil in existence, enabling you to manipulate and even shape reality through it. 

With this, you possess the ability to manifest anything you can imagine. Creation comes effortlessly to you, allowing you to craft objects, armors, and even living beings with ease. The Darklings, loyal minions spawned from the depths of The Darkness, serve as your personal companions and possess formidable strength and shapeshifting capabilities.

The armor bestowed upon you by The Eternal Darkness is forged from necroplasm, a powerful material infused with dark energy. This armor adapts to your desires, enabling you to summon various weapons and appendages, granting you enhanced strength, durability, and speed. It becomes a symbol of your power, empowering you to overcome any challenges that come your way.

Another aspect of The Darkness is its ability to enhance existing objects. By channeling its energy, you can imbue any item, such as a car, with limitless fuel and repairs, reinforcing its durability and even adding defensive armor. This versatility allows you to adapt and thrive in any situation.

Unlike its former state, The Eternal Darkness is no longer weakened by light. You can wield its power without fear of cancellation or destruction. You are a force to be reckoned with, even in the brightest of days, making even the most formidable adversaries wary of crossing your path.

You control over The Darkness is absolute, using it as a tool rather than succumbing to its addictive influence. Allowing you to wield it it's power and maintain your moral compass. Additionally, this immunity to corruption extends beyond The Eternal Darkness, safeguarding you from other sources of malevolent influence.
objects.title: The Eternal Darkness (The Darkness)

objects.text:
Congratulations! You have become the chosen host of an ancient and powerful primordial entity known as The Angelus or The Light. As the wielder of The Angelus, you gain mastery over the very essence of Holy Light, Fire, Good, and Order in existence, enabling you to manipulate and even shape reality through it. You are also given all the memories of all previous Angelus Hosts before you.

With this, you possess the ability to manifest anything you can imagine. Creation comes effortlessly to you, allowing you to craft objects, armor, and even living beings with ease through The Holy Light & Fire of the Angelus. The Angels, loyal minions spawned from the Heights of The Light, serve as your personal companions and possess formidable strength and combat capabilities. You also have a Psychic Link with your creations.

You can create and breathe fire or manipulate fire and light to form solid physical objects such as swords, shields, and razor-sharp bladed spears. You can also turn these weapons back into light and/or fire anytime you wish.

The armor bestowed upon you by The Angelus is forged from Holy Light & Fire and is a match for the Necroplasm of the Darkness. This armor adapts to your desires, and you can also create and infuse weapons with the Light and Fire of the Angelus, granting you enhanced strength, durability, and speed above all but the hosts of The Darkness and Witchblade who are your equals, empowering you to overcome any challenges that come your way.

Another aspect of The Angelus is its ability to enhance existing objects. By channeling its energy, you can imbue any item with your holy light & fire, such as Guns, with limitless ammunition and reinforce its durability while increasing its Penetrative power. This versatility allows you to adapt and thrive in any situation. This also allows The Angelus to heal her hosts of any physical wounds, even fatal ones such as torso impalement. This rejuvenating effect also heals psychological trauma endured by the host and gives them fortitude in battle.

The Angelus allows you to teleport both yourself and other beings to any location, either one that you choose or any random location. You can also open portals to ethereal/metaphysical planes (if they exist in your setting). You can also use your tactile-teleportation abilities to summon powerful light to overpower and banish your foes. And you can fly at superhuman speeds as the Angelus.

Unlike its former state, The Angelus is no longer weakened by Darkness. You can wield its power without fear of cancellation or destruction. You are a force to be reckoned with, even in the darkest of nights, making even the most formidable adversaries wary of crossing your path.
Your control over The Angelus is absolute, using it as a tool rather than succumbing to its absolute control of its Hosts. Allowing you to wield its power and maintain your moral compass. Additionally, this immunity to corruption extends beyond The Angelus, safeguarding you from other sources of malevolent influence.
objects.title: The First Light (The Darkness)

addons.text:
While you cannot create or convert any of your created money into CC (as the people behind Celestial Market have countermeasures to prevent this exact scenario), you'll get 1000 CC per day for the rest of your life as a consolation prize.

You may still sell gold and gemstones of your creation, although the overabundance of such materials lead to them having rock bottom prices.
addons.title: Passive Income

objects.text:
Congratulations! You have received a VIP Account to access the Celestial Market! As a first-time customer, allow me to explain how it works. By holding your hand in a praying gesture, you can conjure a panel with access to the market in front of you, and freely explore its offerings without any fees. With the Celestial Market, you can purchase a wide variety of items, as long as you can afford the price. Additionally, the market accepts any currency you possess, and convert them in Celestial Coins (CC). However, be aware that the prices are slightly inflated. For example, a lesser bag of holding, which would typically cost 5 CC's, now goes for 50 CC's. 

Extraordinarily rare and powerful items like the Longinus Sacred Gear can easily cost half a million CC's. Incredibly potent items crafted by the Gods, typically obtainable only by completing quests, may be priced in the tens of millions of CC's. Despite the elevated costs, the market truly offers anything you can imagine: items, hints to enhance your abilities, complete skills and abilities, non-player characters (NPCs) of any level available for lease or outright purchase, information, animals, and monsters. 

You can even find items of questionable usefulness, such as the brawling tapes of the Gods ("Goddess of Love VS. Goddess of Beauty, Beach Edition, Interactive"). Furthermore, if you possessed a billion CC's and were willing to sacrifice the population of a planet, you could even buy your way into capital G godhood. The Celestial Market offers products from countless worlds, including some you may not be familiar with, ensuring that its promise of providing truly anything remains valid. 

However, keep in mind that the price markup applies regardless. As a VIP customer, you also have the privilege of selling items to the market, though you will only receive their normal prices rather than the inflated ones.
objects.title: The Celestial Market (World Seed Jump)

addons.text: The House of Horror has become an integral part of your being, its macabre essence intertwining with your own. With this it becomes an extension of your will, fully integrated into your personal domain. As you harness and manipulate despair, the inhabitants of the haunted theme park grow stronger, feeding on the fear of the guests. Their evolution into formidable beings like Demons and Red Spectres accelerates, solidifying your dominion over this eerie landscape. Within the theme park, you are the master of fear and horror, a true architect of malevolence.
addons.title: Theme Park of Dreads & Grudges
Nightmare Missions (My House of Horror)
addons.text:
Now, another type of quest begins to appear on your board: Nightmare Missions. Nightmare Missions are extremely dangerous daily tasks issued by the Quest Board. Most Nightmare Missions involve supernatural phenomena or are related to something frightening in some way.

If you choose to accept a Nightmare Mission and successfully complete it, you will be rewarded with rare items, Ghosts, new scenarios to expand your haunted house, special ghostly powers, and other items or powers related to supernatural. The more difficult the mission you undertake, the greater the rewards will be.

Even if your world is completely mundane and contains nothing supernatural, the moment you accept a Nightmare Mission, the Quest Board will create the necessary beings, scenarions, phenomena, and rewards for you to encounter and obtain as part of these missions.

objects.text:
You've become the holder of a unique origin, this grants you the ability to harness and manipulate despair to your advantage. You can tap into the depths of negative emotions, channeling them to amplify your own strength, endurance, and resilience. Embracing the essence of despair, you gain an uncanny ability to perceive the hidden fears and vulnerabilities of others, enabling you to exploit their weaknesses and manipulate their emotions. You possess an aura of desolation that instills unease and dread in those around you.

Furthermore, you have an innate affinity for the black fog and the red city, the spiritual worlds located in a person psyche. You can navigate these realms with ease, utilizing their dark energies to traverse dimensions and access forbidden knowledge. The black fog becomes an extension of your will, allowing you to summon its tendrils and envelop your enemies, suffocating them in a miasma of despair and hopelessness. Within the red city, you wield dominion over the twisted architecture and nightmarish inhabitants, bending them to your command.

An intriguing aspect of your power is your ability to materialize spirits from these realms into the real world. Utilizing the black fog, you can bring forth spectral entities, granting them corporeal forms to roam the mortal plane. But the true mastery of this art lies in your ability to cultivate spirits bound to you. By feeding them fear, you empower these spirits over time, enabling even mundane ghosts to evolve into formidable beings such as Demons or Red Spectres.

Your consciousness remains indomitable, impervious to fragmentation or destruction. Even in the face of death within the Black Fog or the Red City, you always return to your body at dawn, reinvigorated and ready to continue your relentless pursuit. With each resurrection, your connection to despair strengthens, further empowering you.
objects.title: Kind, Yet Evil (My House of Horror)

objects.text:
You've gain the hereditary power of Code: Emperor. This power allows you to utilize any of seven demonic flames, representing the seven deadly sins. Each flame possesses unique properties, they are all spiritual in nature, allowing you to manipulate souls and hellfire in countless ways.

- Satan’s Blaze: A blue flame fueled by the spirits of sinners. It cannot be extinguished and burns hot enough to destroy gene fragments and melt steel. This wrathful flame can engulf someone, burning them down to their very soul.

- Belphegor, the "Blaze of Limbo": A pitch-black flame that nullifies supernatural powers and their effects. However, it cannot damage physical abilities.

- Mammon, the "Dichromatic Twin Flame of the Netherworld": Two flames in one—a blazing hot blue flame and a freezing cold yellow flame. Together, they create devastating winds and explosions capable of destroying half a building in an instant.

- Beelzebub, the "Achromatic Catharsis Flame of Purgatory": A completely invisible flame that cloaks its user. It can be launched into the air, transforming into a downpour of invisible 1500-degree flames from above.

- Leviathan, the "Argenteous Phantom Flame of Hades": A silver flame that severs all matter, behaving like a sword rather than burning. It steals heat from targets, freezing them solid.

- Asmodeus, the "Iridescent Explosive Flame of Hell": Flames that burn in various colors, trapping targets in illusions of their desires. It can ignite surrounding minerals, triggering devastating explosions.

- Lucifer: The final flame, available only after mastering all six other flames. It takes the form of an upgraded Satan's Blaze. With Lucifer, you can use all the flames together without conflict. You can even merge all seven flames to produce a powerful flame capable of burning the impossible, even "nothingness."
objects.title: Flames of Purgatory (Code: Breaker)

objects.text:
You have some serious power over the flow of time. Through manipulating time, you can speed yourself up relative to everything else, enabling you to act far, far faster than any human could react, or turn it towards mundane uses such as aging a planted seed to see it rapidly mature into a tree, quickly aging fine wines, or freezing a volley of bullets in midair in order to evade it. From halting time completely to reversing its course, you are a master of time. Finally, since time is intertwined with space, after significant progression of your powers, you may find yourself being able to alter space itself by manipulating time in certain ways. 

Your command and mastery over time and consequently space can be considered absolute. The only limit being reversing time which depends upon the laws of physics governing the specific universe in which you operate. Otherwise there is virtually no limits to your power.
objects.title: Lunar Dial (Touhou Project)

addons.text: As a Magician all but destined to become a Yōkai, you stand to inherit far more than Yukari's famed power to bend boundaries. Her entire treasury of arcane lore—Onmyōdō arrays, the crafting of shikigami, the delicate art of opening Gaps—settles into your mind at once, giving you a head start even if you cannot yet match her more exotic feats. Most important, however, is the way your future transformation has changed.
