You no longer need to hunt for some ritual or catalyst to become a Magician-Yōkai; the very act of wielding your power alters you. Each spell, each Gap you weave and open, steadily nudges your essence toward a "species" previously exclusive to Yukari: the Gap Yōkai. As the metamorphosis unfolds, Yōkai traits start to seep in, allowing for a sharper affinity for magic, diminished bodily needs, and heightened physical prowess—until, at its crescendo, you stand as a fully fledged Yōukai rivaling Yukari herself. In that state, fear, and belief become subtle delicacies. Like any Yōkai, you can draw strength from them, yet your lingering human core frees you from relying on that nourishment to survive. Even so, their tang—the crackle of terror, the hum of reverence—remains undeniably appealing. One gift you share only with Yukari proves the most unsettling of all: your "body" is merely a façade. A Gap Yōkai is the living seam between what is and what is not, and your true form is a vaguely human-shaped wound in reality, a rift stitching existence to non-existence. Wounds that carry no profound "meaning" or "intent" glance off you and those that do land can be erased with a thought. Your appearance of humanity is a convenient masquerade—and nothing more. Should you also possess the Creature of Fear Addon, then you skip the transformation process entirely and automatically become a Gap Yōkai.
addons.title: Border of Phantasm

objects.text:
You can create, shape, perceive, and manipulate boundaries—whether physical, metaphysical, or conceptual. These include divides such as distance, day and night, life and death, and even those of more abstract constructs.

By altering the boundary between night and day, you could plunge the world into eternal darkness. Shift the divide between dimensions, and you can travel freely between worlds. Blur the line between life and death, and you might achieve immortality—or even bring others back from beyond the grave. And because you can perceive these hidden lines, both seen and unseen, you're able to glimpse into every dimension simultaneously without being overwhelmed.

Since boundaries can existentially and conceptually define everything, the possibilities offered by your power are nigh-limitless, with the only constraint being your imagination.

You can also open eerie, ominous-looking "gaps" lined with countless unblinking eyes. That serves as both windows and doorways, allowing you to observe or pass through anywhere your power can reach.

For now, your abilities are still developing. Thus making the act of manipulating conceptual boundaries taxing to perform in quick succession. But with time and practice, you will one day surpass Yukari Yakumo herself.
objects.title: Boundary Manipulation (Touhou Project)

addons.text:
As a Magician who weaves the Tapestry of Fate and is all but destined to become a Youkai, you inherit the powers and knowledge of one Remilia Scarlet, the Vampiric Scarlet Devil.

Through gaining Remilia’s knowledge of her own Fate Manipulation, you gain a sizable boost towards your initial control, giving you more freedom from the get go. Remilia’s knowledge also includes spearmanship and hemomancy, especially how to create blood magic constructs such as bullets, needles, chains, knives, spears, and animated bats. 

Most impressive however is the physiology you inherit, that of a Vampire. Your speed and strength rival those of Youkai specialized in those traits, being faster than the eye can follow and strong enough to crush boulders, in addition to your immense magical prowess and standard Youkai attributes like lessened physical needs. 

You also possess typical Vampire powers such as regeneration, haemokinesis, and the ability to turn into mist or a swarm of bats. Your regeneration is strong enough to render you biologically immortal and completely recover your entire body in a single night so long as your head remains. 

However, that same physiology grants you a few weaknesses. Silver harms you, as does sunlight - although like Remilia you have declared that you “are not fated to die to sunlight,” meaning it merely burns and weakens you instead of outright killing you. Your last weakness is roasted soybeans oddly enough. Due to having been syncretized with Oni by human belief, you have inherited their weakness to roasted soybeans, being burnt by contact with them.
addons.title: Scarlet Devil

addons.text:
Your mere existence distorts probability to assure your success, the nature of your power directing the hand of fate to swing in your favor.

Probability twists and warps to accommodate you, causing events to happen in favor of your goals and desires. So long as there is a non-zero chance of an event happening, then it can happen if it would advance your goals and desires.

Of course, this power isn’t capable of manifesting outright impossible events such as an immortal suddenly dropping dead or you spontaneously manifesting invincibility. Furthermore, this power follows the path of least resistance to accomplish things, defaulting to the most probable series of events which would still lead to an outcome which would qualify as a “success” for you. 

You are a living promise of victory.
addons.title: Promised Victory

addons.text: You are an anomaly, simultaneously part of Fate and yet outside of it as well, the Weaver who resides beyond the Veil. Your awareness of Fate and the Future expands, less sight and more an omnipresent understanding, requiring no effort or thought to know and comprehend the Fate of anything and everything, from a simple rock all the way to entire universes. Your control is similarly expanded, becoming so perfect that it could be said that you are Fate, that your will and the will of Fate are one and the same. Such is your dominance that you need not pay regard to logic, reason, causality, paradoxes, or probability, if you will it then so it shall be, the universe itself bending to suit your desires. Perhaps you dictate that your attack is destined to land, warping reality to suit this outcome, or maybe you declare that you are fated not to die, rendering yourself unkillable. Whatever your choices may be, know now that your word is has become the absolute law of the world.
addons.title: The Weaver Beyond

objects.text: You have gained the powerful and somewhat abstract ability to manipulate fate. At first, your control is mostly subconscious; you merely experience extremely good luck while your enemies experience extremely bad luck. However, with time, you can learn to actively reach out and change the strings of fate, blessing an endeavor with good fortune, cursing your enemies with misfortune, or even writing out custom fates for people to guide their lives in a specific direction. You can also use this to prevent specific fates, causing some interesting effects as reality accommodates the changes in possibility, such as severely weakening a vampire’s vulnerability to the sun by making it so they “are not fated to die to the sun.” The only real limitation is that you cannot make the statistically impossible happen, although things that are merely incredibly unlikely are still fair game, although the more unlikely an outcome is, the more energy needed to guarantee it. This works best on creatures weaker than you, with diminishing returns against creatures equal or greater than yourself, so don’t think this makes you invincible. This power also provides you with a passive awareness of fate, allowing you to sense when interesting or important things are happening or about to happen, as well as sensing whether someone has an important fate ahead of them. If trained further, this awareness can allow you to actively see the string of fate, making alterations much easier. This power is finicky to use, with conscious manipulations being tiring, although this does not stop it from being incredibly powerful.
objects.title: Fate Manipulation (Touhou Project)

objects.text:
You have gained the powerful but nebulous ability to sense and manipulate “waves” of all kinds, from light and sound waves to brain waves. 

By manipulating light, you could turn things invisible or create illusions such as after-images or seemingly endless mazes. By manipulating sound, you could make someone hear anything or nothing. And by manipulating brain waves, you could induce madness, hallucinations or just hypnotize someone. 

If it can be construed as a “wave” in some way then you can exert at least some level of control over it, although more powerful and conceptual “waves” are out of your reach for now, requiring more practice and power to be properly utilized.

The source of this power localizes to your eyes or the closest equivalent, causing usage of this power to have the odd side effect of making your eyes glow.
objects.title: Lunatic Eyes (Touhou Project)

addons.text:
You were unbothered by eldritch horrors, cruel truths, madness and insanity; now, truly, nothing bothers you.

Your lack of comprehension of the errors in reality only further reinforces your frivolity and cheerfulness, significantly distancing yourself from reality, allowing you to live your life free from true hardship. You will be able to 'float' through life, bringing about a future where you will never have to fight impossibly strong beings, not with anything at stake at least. You will live in your ideal world, being able to resolve everything with a happy ending.
addons.title: Fantasy Heaven

addons.text:
You now possess the abilities of the Hakurei Shrine Maiden. You can create ofuda, sacred paper charms, which can be thrown to attack enemies, imbued with homing properties to track your targets. These ofuda can also be used to create barriers or even copies of yourself. Your barriers are highly versatile, capable of blocking spiritual, physical, or magical attacks. Additionally, they can be made with a variety of effects, such as exploding on contact, pushing you or enemies with concussive force, and even letting you teleport. You are an expert in barriers of all kinds and can dismantle them with ease, no matter their origin or complexity.

You can also summon Yin-Yang orbs, crafted from a wondrous type of crystal and brimming with immense spiritual energy, to the point where they seem alive. These orbs possess purifying properties, potent enough such that it is dangerous for spirits and devilish powers to make contact. They can be used as projectiles with homing abilities, their flight path adjustable at will. The orbs can also absorb energy, good and evil—and channel it for attacks or other purposes. Additionally, the orbs can be used as a proxy, allowing you to treat them as the point of origin for any of your attacks. You can control what sizes you summon them in, and they can also be used as communication devices.

Beyond these techniques, you possess the ability to manipulate temperament, the natural spirits within living things. You also possess the ability to summon divine spirits, also known as gods, into your body to borrow their powers: such as summoning lightning through Honoikazuchi, dematerializing and rematerializing matter through Kanayama-hiko no Mikoto, or using the Yata Mirror through Ishikori-dome no Mikoto. You can even call upon the powers of Amaterasu Oomikami herself. You have complete control over how much power you draw from these gods, whether using fragments or their full divine strength, you can also channel the abilities of multiple gods simultaneously. Furthermore, you can access the collective might of all the eight million gods of the Yaoyorozu no Kami.
addons.title: Hakurei Shrine Maiden

addons.text:
Your nature makes ascending deeper into the dreamlands innate, causing you to adopt the qualities of abstraction itself. Your existence becomes increasingly unbound—fluid, indeterminate, and untouched by the rigid mechanics of causality. Thought and self begin to blur, and you naturally begin to "float" within both the dreamland and the waking world, no longer requiring meditation or ease of mind. 

This also dissolves the boundary between the dreamland in your mind and the world outside. External forces struggle to anchor you—you’re perceived as present, but not reachable, as though reality fails to fully register your form. This state of being is not one of control, but of alignment. You do not force direction; instead, meaning arises from the act of drifting. Certainty, identity, and linearity lose priority, and in their place emerges a quiet, intuitive precision—one that operates without effort, as if guided by a principle outside of reason. Your movements carry the precision of thought and the unpredictability of air. The world flows around you, your presence like vapor—visible, yet ungraspable. You exist in suspension, both here and elsewhere, grounded not by definition, but by the ephemeral rhythm of thought itself. You drift through layered realities without anchoring, untethered by clarity, yet not lost—only apart. Essentially developing and expanding your ability to "float".
addons.title: Innate Dream

objects.text:
You possess the innate ability to "float"; that can be alternatively translated as possessing the innate ability "to be cheerful", "to be frivolous", "to be undefined or uncertain", "to be isolated from others", or "to have no basis." 

This ability allows you to thrive by going with the flow; the less seriously you take a situation, the more effortlessly the outcome shifts in your favor, you shine best when relaxed and unbothered. Subsequently, when you aren't simply going with the flow, you actually perform worse, your ability to "float" ceases to function.

You can "float" away from troubles, complications, and challenges—even those you are unaware of. In its more overt manifestations, this ability renders you invincible and untouchable. Your attacks fly guided in impossible directions, homing in on your opponent, while for your opponent it's as if there's an unbridgeable distance between you and them, as if you exist in an entirely different world, their attacks veer away, as if though you’re made of air, like your opponent is trying to pound a nail into dust. Ironically, illusions bolster your strength, as uncertain and surreal situations make you completely unaware of reality, allowing you to perform better. Additionally, you can defy gravity, soaring through the sky with nothing able to hold you down.
objects.title: Fantasy Nature (Touhou Project)

objects.text:
Did that spell just hit your head? No worries, it actually missed you! Within the center of your body, just around your heart, resides a fist-sized round hitbox. As long as it isn’t struck, you’re safe. However, a direct hit to your hitbox counts as a critical strike, dealing around 25% increased damage.

Things start getting fun when a strike comes almost too close, barely grazing your hitbox. In such cases, you earn 1 graze point, and you can accumulate up to 100 such points. Each graze point increases your speed-related stats (speed, agility, dexterity, reflexes and so on) by 1%. The more points you gather, the faster and better you become. However, a single hit to your hitbox will erase all your hard-earned points, so be careful.

Your hitbox will start as big as a clenched fist. But with years of training you can shrink your hitbox to the size of a small coin. Such a small hitbox’s benefits are apparent, but as it gets smaller, it also becomes more fragile. At coin size, you will receive 100% increased damage from direct hits. At this point the benefits of your graze points will also increase, going from 1% to as high as 10%.

Powers that grant defense, resistance or so on will instead affect the hitbox, but at a reduced rate.

Now go out there, dance and flirt with danger, reap all the rewards, but be careful to not get hit!
objects.title: Hitbox (Touhou Project)

objects.text:
Gems are such precious things, aren't they? They have luster, shine, and the most important thing of all, beautiful. Gems are simply just so precious, aren’t they? With their luster and shine, they hold an undeniable beauty. Yet, beyond that beauty, each gem possesses unique qualities. Qualities that only you can harness.

When you hold a gem on your person, you can become more powerful, depending on the gem. The higher the gem's quality, the more potent its effects. A raw gem may offer negligible benefits, while a finely cut diamond could grant a 5% boost.

All currently known effects of gems are: Amathyst, Aquamarine, Topaz, Ruby, Sapphire, Emerald, and Diamond. Presuming normal quality, the effects of each gem is as follows:

• Amethyst: 2% more potent grazing. To clarify what grazing is, it's to be being almost hit by something, but never actually getting hit. Utilizing this will store up time energy, which can be used to slow down time to a crawl for 0.25 seconds with just a single graze, presuming you have no gems. Your eyes will also turn red in this state. Time energy must be stored within a vessel that represents time, like watches, or clocks.

• Aquamarine: 2% faster resource regeneration. Resources would be referring to stamina, magic power, or any supernatural  energy.

• Topaz: 2% faster cooldown rate. This means that anything that has a cooldown will be available by 2% faster. For the mundane, it would mean decreasing the time for certain actions, like reloading a gun, or fueling a car.

• Emerald: 3% increase to your regeneration. Sufficient amount of emeralds might even restore lost limbs.

• Ruby: 1% increase to your vitality. This would mean you become tougher for the mundane.

• Sapphire: 1% increase in attack potency. You aren't stronger, your attacks are just seemingly more effective.

• Diamond: 0.2% increase to vitality and attack potency.

You also gain a hammer space exclusively to house your gems, allowing you to hoard gems without having to worry about where to put them, while reaping all the benefits.
objects.title: Gem Empowerment (Touhou Project: Luna Nights)

addons.text:
You bear the most curious combination of the legacy of two different versions of Caine, that of being his Childe Vampires and being a student of his with The Hercules Method. This combination has vastly increased your vampiric Discipline powers that focus on increasing your physical, mental, sensory, and biological-based abilities. You are also able to learn and advance such Disciplines much faster than normal and possibly even create new ones with great effort. 

The Amount of Vitae you can hold is increased greatly. With it being doubled at what it would normally be and able to increase even further based on your mastery of The Method and your Vampiric Generation, with lower generation granting more per normal. 

Through The Hercules Method, you are now able to regenerate a small amount of Vitae with great focus and cost of stamina. This free Vitae is enough that you will rarely be in danger of starving unless you overuse your Vampiric Discipline Powers. Your weakness for the sun can also be blunted through the usage of The Hercules Method for a time and with your freely gained Vitae, such that spending a short amount of time in direct sunlight will only weaken you and pose no danger unless you push yourself or spend too long in direct sunlight.

However, the greatest boon this combination grants is the ability to slowly distill your Vampiric Essence such that, with unimaginable effort and skill with The Hercules Method, you can slowly decrease your Vampiric Generation. This allows you to grow vastly more powerful, but will take vastly longer amounts of time per generation you lower yourself. With centuries and even millennia of work and extreme effort, you may one day rise to same level of power as that of a second generation, and perhaps with eons of effort, you may one day become a second Dark Father alike to Caine himself, and become a being truly between life and death with no Vampiric Weaknesses.
addons.title: Childe and Student of Caine

addons.text: There is one mercy the Archangel Gabriel offered to Caine, and to all Kindred, said to have been first achieved by Saulot. Now you too have successfully passed through your suspire and joined the illustrious ranks of those who achieved Golconda. In doing so, you gain a number of benefits. First, you no longer suffer from frenzy, be it from fury, hunger, or Rötschreck. You are also freed from your Clan Weakness, as well as being able to advance your Disciplines beyond your generational limits with sustained effort. Next, your need for blood has been drastically reduced, with what once sustained you for a night now lasting a week, assuming you don't burn additional blood-points in, for example, combat. Finally, a kindred having achieved Golconda can walk beneath the glare of the sun unharmed, though if they do they will find their blood-reserves severely depleted the following night. Growing a third eye is optional unless you're a Salubri. However, Golconda is not a gift, but seeking and being granted a form of redemption. As such, a kindred who loses their humanity, becoming too callous or cruel, will fall out of Golconda, losing all its benefits. If you have the Perk Humanity, you cannot fall out of Golconda.
addons.title: Golconda (World of Darkness - Vampire: The Masquerade)

addons.text:
You do not bear the limitations of the Get of Caine, for you are of different origin; you were cursed by the August Personage Of Jade for your deeds in a past life.

You may now choose to be a Kuei-jin, a being who bears a resemblance to their Western counterparts but are truly and fully different beings. You have an internal reserve of chi, rather than blood, and therefore it is this you need to absorb from others. Your techniques are different than Cainite Disciplines, having originated from a separate curse, one directed at the ten-thousand heroes of Creation (Which sounds kind of familiar, doesn't it?).

The chi you absorb can either be Yin or Yang aspected, with Yin energy making you seem more "undead" and Yang energy making you seem more "alive". You advance in power by following a Dharma, a philosophy of life on your way to redemption, with your spiritual development being comparable to a Cainite's Generation. You start as a Jina if you don't purchase any upgrades, as an Ancestor if you otherwise would have been a Methuselah, as a Bodhisattva if you would have been an Antediluvian, & an Arhat if you would have been alike to Caine.

Of course, why give up the legacy of Caine at all? Saulot learned a great deal from the Wan Kuei on his path to Golconda, so you can also mix and match features between Cathayans and Cainites if you wish.
addons.title: Kindred Of The East

addons.text:
You have taken the curses leveled upon Caine by God and made it into your own, achieving a state not unlike the fabled Golconda.

Your Inner Beast and the Beast given to you by the curse of Caine are now the same entity, allowing you to not only communicate with your Beast, but also reason with it. You will no longer be compelled to devour and despoil, as your beast no longer needs to resort to such methods to make its will known. While it is still a creature of hunger and wrath, it is one that you get along with quite well.

Due to the fact that your Beast is the living embodiment of your curse, it is able to shape and alter itself, removing or even inverting your weaknesses. Not only would you be immune to the effects of fire and the sun, but even clan banes would be inverted, with a Nosferatu becoming unearthly beautiful, or a Lasombra gaining a thorough awareness of themselves.

You can choose for anyone you embrace to share any of these benefits, though how they get along with their beast is up to them.
addons.title: Blessing of Caine

objects.text:
You have been embraced as an eighth-generation vampire, a supernatural being of immense strength, speed, and abilities. Standing low on the totem pole of supernatural beings, only a neonate compared to an older vampire of a higher generation. Depending on your clan, you gain three disciplines that can be used through the expenditure of Vitae that can be gained from sucking the life out of humans, with a maximum of 15 Vitae available at any given time.

You have enough strength to throw a car around, enough speed to outpace a car, and enough durability to take a shotgun blast to the chest and survive. Regardless of which clan you choose, gaining the disciplines of the clan, all clans have access to Blood Buff, a skill that allows Kindred to Buff all physical abilities and doubles them for as long as you have enough Vitae. You may also embrace others into becoming vampires, although they will always be weaker than you as they are now a Ninth-Generation vampire. Vampires are also able to turn humans into ghouls by feeding them blood; they turn into loyal enhanced humans who have all of the strength without any of the weaknesses; however, they have a limited amount of vampire blood that they can use to access disciplines.

Depending on the vampire clan that you choose to be a part of, you can gain different weaknesses; however, this is not the only curse you must bear; you have also been cursed to no longer walk under the sun, feel the red fear at the sight of fire, the so-called Rötschreck, feel the pain of no longer being able to eat normal food and being forced to consume blood, and contend with the beast, an animalistic side to your vampiric curse.
objects.title: Kindred (World of Darkness - Vampire: The Masquerade)

objects.text:
You are an Unchained. You are a powerful and ageless esoteric program with an eidetic memory, capable of altering reality in limited ways and using quantum mechanics. You were once an angel of the God-Machine who was cut off due to becoming too human and thus became a demon. You start with a Primum of 1 and an Incarnation of your choice. As your Primum gets higher over time, your power increases, your reserve of Aether becomes greater and your demonic form gets more abilities. You can choose an Agenda, but in a world without other Unchained or the God-Machine it won't serve much purpose.

Your mortal identity is a Cover, existing in quantum superposition with your true demonic form and any other Cover you might have - while one is observable, the others aren't. Due to that, you have complete control on anything it does, from expressions not reflecting your emotions down to even the Cover and your real self having different thoughts. This prevents most type of precognition from working well on you, especially if using multiple Covers regularly.

Your initial Cover will never degrade, and you will never experience glitches as other demons would. However, other Covers will slowly degrade if you act in a way in which the "character" it embodies wouldn't, reality fraying around its edges and small things starting to not make sense, such the Cover living in the basement of a building that shouldn’t have one. 

Other Covers can be obtained and repaired through making pacts with mortals to exchange parts of their lives for various benefits, be they material or more esoteric; however, a pact cannot give powers to the either party. If you can convince someone to trade their souls, you can fully erase them from reality as you assume their identity. These pacts must be written pacts and signed by both of the parties, neither of which must be mind-controlled, though coercion is alright. If destroyed, both parties immediately lose all benefits of the pact.

Your demonic form can look like pretty much anything; humanoid, animalistic, classic angel/demon or mechanical are all possible. It also possesses a handful of various abilities, different for each Unchained, which should be enough on their own to fight a mid-tier parahuman; however, it won't have access to the defense against precognition your Covers enjoy. You can also partially assume your demonic form, gaining access to only some of its abilities but maintaining the protection of your Cover, but this wears out Covers other than your original.

You also have access to Embeds, abilities which manipulate causality and reality in subtle ways, and exploits, which are similar but a lot more flashy. For example, a lot of them can bring tropes to reality, various others alter the physical properties of matter and energy, and one changes the meaning of the words said by another without changing the words themselves.

Embeds and Exploits use Aether, which is a byproduct of manipulation of causality or quantum physics, reality alterations or interactions between parallel universes if those are done by non-Unchained, as well as produced by you shifting to your demonic form. A minor expenditure of Aether allows you to detect any source of it nearby for an hour. While normally demons get Aether from interactions with angels and infrastructure of the God-Machine, on Earth Bet, the connection between shards and parahumans should provide you with a steady stream.

Finally, you can Go Loud, burning a Cover entirely. If you do so, you immediately assume your full demonic form and for one hour, you jump to Primum 10 (or perhaps even higher if you find a way to bypass your limits), fully recharge your Aether, gain access to all Embeds relating to your Incarnation and all Exploits and supercharge all your other powers. However, doing so makes you extremely noticeable to precognition for that hour.
objects.title: Unchained (Chronicles of Darkness - Demon: the Descent)

objects.text:
You have become a Handler of an Asura Machina, forming an inseparable bond with a powerful, over 15-foot-tall, adaptive mecha, that was originally created as a drone to traverse through dimensions inhospitable for humans. Unlike traditional handlers who require a human sacrifice known as a burial doll, you possess a rare ability - you can fuel your Asura Machina with your own soul and channel your memories or emotions to further boost it's power. Your close connection with the Machina is unbreakable, allowing it to materialize from your shadow at will.

Initially, your Asura Machina manifests dominion over one element, such as fire, water, metal, air, shadow, light, or others. Additionally, you also gain a single ability to control an aspect of space-time, such as creating and manipulating gravity wells, cutting through space to teleport, or slowing down time in the Machina's vicinity. As you progress and train, you can use the Machina's space-time ability to eventually travel to parallel dimensions.

Overtime, your Asura Machina will evolve and grows stronger, especially during battles, it rapidly adapts and evolve to overcome new challenges. With enough experience and dedication, it will morph into stronger and stronger form, acquiring mastery over additional elements and gaining more space-time abilities, expanding its already formidable arsenal.

In its pinnacle form, your Asura Machina will reach such tremendous might that it can shed its armor, which functioned as its limiter, to transcend into a pseudo higher-dimensional Daemon. This greatly boosts all its power to the point where its mere existence alone can destabilize entire dimensions.
objects.title: The Shadows Cast By The Sins of Science! (Asura' Cryin)

objects.text:
You have truly bonded with any one dragon found in the barbaric archipelago, although the specifics change form species to species they are generally resistant to impacts and fire, can fly, swim somewhat well enough and have an elemental-breath shot.

Your bond is strong enough to have them be resistant to the mental effects of an alpha and other types of mental control, in turn it's possible for them to become an alpha dragon which makes them able to control and order similar creatures.

In addition to this, you get highly skilled in mechanical crafting and designs as well as an impressive boost to your sight and aiming.
objects.title: Dragon Friend (How To Train Your Dragon)

objects.text:
Similar to Dirk Gently and Bart Curlish, you have become an anomalous entity, described as a causality psychic. A being that exists in and interacts with the universe and the fabric of reality in anomalous ways, seemingly bending the laws of reality and probability.

The world now operates for you based on the interconnectedness of all things. So long as you don't remain stagnant, any action you take, no matter how ridiculous it may be, will ultimately be a step toward the solution to one of the problems you are currently facing. This power will lead you toward an answer and a solution, but you must still recognize and implement the solution on your own. Follow a car at random when you're lost; it may not lead you to where you were trying to go, but it will lead you to where you need to be.
objects.title: Holistic Deduction (Dirk Gently)

objects.text:
You are able to summon a shadow-like, omnivorous beast that acts as an extension of your will. This entity, seemingly composed of dark matter drawn from interdimensional or unknown origins, can fluidly shift between offense and defense to suit your needs. It manifests as a black, formless creature with a monstrous presence, capable of tearing through anything in its path.

In combat, this beast can extend and reshape itself into razor-sharp claws, tendrils, or blades, allowing for devastating long-range and close-quarters attacks. It is capable of slicing through solid steel, flesh, and even energy-based constructs with ease. Its form can adapt instantly, striking multiple opponents at once or coiling around enemies to crush and eviscerate them.

Defensively, it can envelop you in a protective shroud, forming an impenetrable shield that deflects incoming attacks or even swallows them whole. This allows you to nullify certain threats by consuming objects, energy, and even space itself, erasing them from existence.

This shadow-born entity does not merely serve as a weapon—it is an extension of your own presence, moving with your intent and reacting as fast as you do.
objects.title: Rashōmon (Bungo Stray Dogs)

addons.text: With the ability to immerse yourself into a character, you gain access to a level of understanding and empathy that no other can match. You can now recreate the gear of a character, but it is a taxing act that requires concentration, willpower, and significant energy. If you are not careful, this process can drain your strength, leaving you vulnerable and disoriented. But if you can successfully re-create the gear of a character, the benefits are worth the toll. You will gain a deeper understanding of their abilities, strengths, and weaknesses, which can aid you in navigating difficult situations and overcoming challenges with relative ease.
addons.title: Immersive Gear

objects.text: You are able to bring objects to life simply by writing them in a notebook, tearing out the page, and willing them into reality. However, the objects cannot be larger than the page itself, and their creation depends entirely on your understanding. This ability works best when replicating existing items, as you can study their structure and function to recreate them more accurately. While you can create original objects from imagination, they may not always function as intended unless you fully understand how they work. The more knowledge you have about an item, the more precise and reliable your creation will be.
objects.title: The Matchless Poet (Bungo Stray Dogs)

objects.text: You are able to heal all types of external physical injuries for both yourself and others, but only under one strict condition—the target must be on the verge of death. This means minor wounds or moderate injuries cannot be treated; the person must be gravely injured, hovering between life and death, for your ability to take effect. However, if someone is not injured enough for your power to work, you are able to inflict further harm until they reach the necessary threshold, allowing your healing to take hold.
objects.title: Thou Shalt Not Die (Bungo Stray Dogs)

objects.text:
You are able to significantly enhance and amplify the functionality of anything you hold by a factor of a hundred. This applies to any material within your grasp, whether it be a Hunting Dogs katana, a ship’s handlebar, someone’s fist, or even a simple stone.

For example, when wielding a sword, you can strike with twice the force while experiencing no additional weight, making your swings feel as effortless as moving air. The cutting power of your blade rivals that of a concentrated heat beam, allowing you to slice through even reinforced materials with ease. Your attacks become so refined and swift that even those with heightened sensory perception struggle to react in time.

This enhancement isn’t limited to weapons—any object you hold can be optimized to its peak potential. A shield becomes nearly impenetrable, a gun fires with pinpoint accuracy and improved velocity, and even a mundane tool like a wrench can function with unparalleled efficiency. Anything in your hands transforms into an instrument of absolute mastery, making you an unpredictable and formidable force in battle.
objects.title: Mirror Lion (Bungo Stray Dogs)

addons.text: Whenever you use your ability to transport someone into your stories, you have the option of either having them simply drop in as themselves or to awaken in the form of a specific character within the story. This applies to you as well. You can choose the form you assume when entering your stories, whether it's as yourself or as a designated character within the narrative. Both you and those who incarnate into characters will gain the characters memories, these memories will be lost once you leave.
addons.title: Isekai

objects.text: You are able to transport yourself and others into the world of any novel, but only while actively reading it. This works with physical books, digital copies, and even audiobooks. Once inside, those transported must either see the story through to a satisfying conclusion or rely on you to bring them back to reality. Time flows differently within the novel’s world—what feels like an entire day inside passes in just a minute in the real world.
objects.title: Black Cat in the Rue Morgue (Bungo Stray Dogs)

addons.text: While you cannot use money gained from Golden One, in return the boost to power is increased and permanent
addons.title: Pay To Win
Money Talks
addons.text:
Any money or wealth spent, including wealth created by Golden One and Black Card, can now provide a permanent increase to the abilities it enhances rather than merely a temporary boost.

You decide how much of any expenditure actually contributes to the enhancement and whether the resulting increase is permanent or temporary, allowing you to spend freely without empowering yourself when you do not want to.

This allows you to limit what an expenditure can increase your power by. Not enhance it further. 

There is no inherent limit to how far these permanent enhancements can accumulate beyond how much value you can spend.

objects.text:
You are able to temporarily enhance your physical abilities, including strength, speed, durability, and endurance, by spending money. This does not have to be literal cash—anything that holds value, such as jewelry, checks, or other expensive items, can be used to fuel your power, proportional to how much they cost. In addition to increasing your physical capabilities, you are also able to amplify other abilities you have, be it magic or any other form of power. 

When activated, glowing green markings appear across your skin and clothing, serving as a visible sign that your power is in effect. The more you spend, the greater the boost.
objects.title: The Great Fitzgerald (Bungo Stray Dogs)

objects.text:
The Heavenly Flames are unique flames originating from the Dou Qi continent, born from the ignited essence of heaven and earth.

Twenty-three Heavenly Flames are known to exist, each possessing distinct properties, ranging from tremendous destructive power to beneficial effects far surpassing those that cultivators can create.

Examples include the Bone-Chilling Flame, which burns with extreme cold instead of hot; the Fallen Heart Flame, which passively increases the purity and potency of one's Ki while also being capable of burning the soul of your enemy; and the Life Spirit Flame, which possesses the power of life, granting longevity and accelerating the growth of magical herbs,...etc.

These properties make them highly coveted by cultivators, especially alchemists seeking to enhance their skills.

The Emperor Flame is the strongest of the 23, formed by combining the other 22, thereby encompassing all their special properties.

You have now absorbed and refined the Emperor Flame, hosting it within your body. Although the flame you possess is merely a faint ember, it retains all its special properties, allowing you to manipulate it effortlessly as an extension of yourself.

By infusing the flame with supernatural energy or allowing it to burn and consume, you can nurture it back to its original, world-incinerating glory and beyond.
objects.title: The Emperor Flames (Battle Through The Heavens)

objects.text:
A long time ago, before the land had been irreversibly damaged, there was a great catastrophe that occurred called the Mushroom War. The war resulted in the near annihilation of the entire human species and irreversibly changed the world into the land of Ooo once the final weapon of the war, the mushroom bomb, was detonated. In the presence of the radiation, a great evil emerged. He was referred to as the Lich King. Something similar has happened to you, perhaps from exposure to the radiation of the mushroom bomb or some other method, you have become an existence similar to that of the Lich. A herald of death, destruction, and the end of all, an undying physical manifestation of decay.

Your body has changed into that of decay and death, giving you access to strength beyond that of a mortal. As you have just started your adventure into being undead, you are only capable of destroying islands with your physical might. However, through time and growing your necrotic energy, you can do so much more than break islands. You have enough speed that you could easily move at speeds that others with enhanced senses beyond those of humans would only be able to assume you teleported. Your durability is also nothing to sneeze at, as you can take hits that would break continents with just a scratch and regenerate in seconds. Like all undead, you possess unlimited stamina and have no need to breathe, eat, or drink to survive.

Through your necrotic energy, you possess a variety of abilities, such as being able to manipulate fire, radiation, the minds of others, necromancy, induce paralysis in others, nullify the powers of others, create illusions, stop and manipulate time and darkness, manipulate objects with your mind, and so much more. As you grow more experienced in necrotic energy, you can do practically anything that the lich is seen doing or even do things he hasn't seen by exploring the magic that you now possess.
objects.title: The Lich (Adventure Time)

objects.text: “Long ago in a distant land, I, Aku, the shapeshifting master of darkness, unleashed an unspeakable evil. But a foolish samurai warrior wielding a magic sword stepped forth to oppose me. Before the final blow was struck, I tore open a portal in time and flung him into the future, where my evil is law. Now the fool seeks to return to the past and undo the future that is Aku." - Aku Like Aku, you have become the embodiment of the very essence of evil. You have grown immeasurable darkness within yourself that is beyond what normal mortals could ever hope to withstand. Like Aku, you are the evil of the universe personified. However, unlike Aku, you are only just starting to become the embodiment of evil, and it will take a while for you to grow into your full might as evil personified. To start with, you gain invulnerability, which makes you nigh invincible to all mortal attacks; however, like Aku, you are weak to those of pure heart and divine weapons; in order to truly harm you, someone would require both. You have the ability to transform into any form that you desire, from the smallest insect to the mightiest of dragons. Your form is malleable and able to turn into a liquid, stretch, or expand at your command. You can alter your physical capability using evil and magic, manifesting strength beyond that of a human. You are able to smash islands apart effortlessly. Similar in nature to aku, you have regeneration that allows you to regenerate to such a degree that if even a small part of you survives, you will be able to reconstitute yourself in seconds. As your evil might grows, the abilities you possess will match those of Aku; however, as of right now, you possess only a fraction of what Aku is capable of. After sufficient evil energy has been amassed, you can use abilities such as, but not limited to, shooting beams from your eyes. View locations from far away, teleportation, control the elements, telekinesis, necromancy, precognition, possessing others or infecting them with the evil of the universe, turning them into loyal servants, Manipulating time, manifesting objects out of the evil energy you possess, corrupting others, and having magical might that far surpasses others.
objects.title: Aku (Samurai Jack)

objects.text:
You have transformed into an interdimensional demon, and while your power is at its strongest within the dreams of others, you can still wield a fraction of your might on the material plane. Dream demons originate from the second dimension. As a being from the second dimension, you are a higher-dimensional being than most people on the traditional plane, and you require a host to physically interact with the material plane.

As a being of dreams, you are at the height of your power, while inside others dreams, it is unmatched. Being able to warp the entire fabric of reality while in others dreams. You are able to foresee things that have happened in the past and future, using it to your advantage when taunting others or getting them to make deals with you. peer into alternate realities, viewing the multiverse from the position of someone from a higher dimension. manipulate and create illusions to confuse others and trick them into deals that they normally wouldn't have agreed to.

The abilities you have access to also include becoming intangible to dodge incoming attacks. Fly at the same speed that you can normally walk without exhausting your stamina. induce nightmares in those you are near. possess others and gain access to the material plane. control fire and manipulate it as a method of attack. Regenerate from almost any attack. shapeshifting. Move things around with your mind, read others minds, and possess the power of immortality. You also possess the ability to make deals with others, granting their wishes in return for power or other things that they are willing to offer you in exchange for their wishes being granted. You can trick others into deals, but they can also trick you, and you are unable to force someone into a deal.

Outside the dreams of others, your powers are weakened, but this can be nullified by making deals and growing in power as you explore your demonic powers.
objects.title: Dream Demon (Gravity Falls)

objects.text:
You have the power to turn any cats you touch into one of the many types of monster cats from the mobile game Battle Cats. Whether you want a cute and cuddly cat, a fierce and ferocious cat, or a weird and wacky cat, or even the great Ȇ̴̡l̸̛̪d̸̎̈́r̷͈̔ì̵͙t̷̅̑c̶̿̏h̶͛ cat, you can choose from hundreds of options. These cats can also switch between different forms of the same battle cat types, such as their normal, evolved, or true forms, and even combine 2 cat types to create a whole new battle cat. 

All the cats you transform will be loyal to you, and will follow your commands in battle or in everyday life. However, they will also retain some of their catlike traits and attitude, such as being playful, curious, lazy, or independent. You can communicate with them telepathically, and share their knowledge. 

You are the ultimate cat lover and leader.
objects.title: Cathulhu (Battle Cats)

objects.text:
Your perspective on reality has been forever changed, perhaps due to crossing the boundaries between dimensions. Now you perceive the very strings that make up the fabric of reality. Inperceivable to all but yourself, upon pulling or thinking about pulling said strings, you may transform reality around you; however, you need to find the right strings to pull to get the correct effect that you wish.

Pulling upon a string connected to another human, you can alter them slowly, increasing the power that they can use, granting them powers for a short time, taking away their powers, granting them immunity to psychic attacks, or altering the age of the one whose string you have pulled. You could also use this power to heal people or even raise the dead, so long as they have recently departed.

Using this power, you could also change objects, creating new life out of existing matter, or create viewing portals that would allow you to see into alternate realities or different dimensions, or even traverse the multiverse. Transmuting matter from one state to another or even creating exact duplicates of objects or people.

The longer you use this power, the more uses you can find by pulling the right strings, gaining more control over pulling the right strings, and affecting things that are farther away from you, eventually growing into your full potential, creating pocket dimensions, and so much more.
objects.title: Quantum Strings (Marvel)

objects.text:
You have become the latest person to host the powerful system known as the Star Brand. The Star Brand is a powerful glyph created by the Builders as a planetary defense system. Bestowed during a rare cosmic event known as a White Event, the Star Brand grants its bearer god-like powers and manifests as a smooth, warm, black mark somewhere on the body. 

Each Star Brand functions as a sentient system, replacing older defense mechanisms developed by the Builders. Those who carry it—referred to as Starbrands—are charged with the immense responsibility of protecting worlds, and, when necessary, destroying them.

The bearer gains extraordinary abilities, including flight, superhuman strength, invulnerability, energy projection, and the capacity for space travel. The Star Brand also enhances the user’s perception, allowing them to detect nearby life forms and analyze threats. Along with these powers come immortality, resistance to aging, and minor mutagenic effects. With enough control and experience, a Starbrand can unlock even more incredible abilities, such as creating objects out of nothing, altering living beings, neutralizing nuclear weapons, and even traveling through time. You have complete control over all powers provided by the Star Brand.

The glyph itself can shift to different parts of the body and, when transferred, leaves the former bearer with about ten percent of its power—energy that slowly regenerates over time. However, the Star Brand must always be carried by a sentient being. If abandoned or misused, its unchecked power can result in catastrophic consequences, triggering volatile energy surges that pose a threat to anything nearby.
objects.title: Starbrand (Marvel)

objects.text:
You are the latest to inherit the Old Power — an artificial counterpart to the Power Cosmic, engineered by the mysterious Shadow People, becoming what Sakaar knows as an Oldstrong. This ancient force greatly enhances your physical abilities, enabling you to perform superhuman feats such as lifting over 100 tons, enduring strikes from beings as powerful as the Hulk, and sustaining peak exertion for hours before fatigue sets in.

Beyond raw strength, the Old Power grants flight, energy projection, and — most notably — terrakinesis. This unique connection to the Earth allows you to manipulate stone and lava, reshape terrain, and communicate across vast distances by using the planet itself as a conduit. You can even transform your body into living stone or access a form of retrocognition, reading the echoes of past events embedded in the Earth.

Wielders of the Old Power possess astonishing precision — enough to locate an individual anywhere on the globe and kill them without ever being near. And should your body be destroyed, the Old Power enables your resurrection by reforming your physical form from the surrounding earth.
objects.title: Oldstrong (Marvel)

addons.text: Like Stephen, you have gained an understanding of the Axiom, giving you the ability to manipulate & understand natural and supernatural phenomena just as Stephen himself does. This glimpse into the workings of the universe also effectively gives you a Shin Megami Tensei based Tinker power, allowing for the use of technology from that universe, such as Terminals, COMPs, and the Demon Summoning Program. You also gain Stephen's intellect, knowledge, and foresight, which were enough to outwit YHVH & determine a way for humanity to surpass the Axiom.
addons.title: Singularity Wave

objects.text:
Through the benevolence of Galactus, you have been granted the extraordinary transformation bestowed upon his Heralds, along with unrestricted access to the awe-inspiring Power Cosmic. This transformative process empowers you with strength and durability comparable to the an enraged Hulk, incredible speed and flight capable of traversing the vast expanse of the universe in mere moments, supreme agility almost capable of seizing a fully empowered Infinity Gauntlet from the clutches of Thanos himself, and heightened senses allowing you to perceive and interact with aspects of reality beyond the comprehension of mortal beings.

Moreover, this process elevates your Mind and Soul, enabling you to engage with and communicate with the most potent cosmic forces without succumbing to their overwhelming influence.

The greatest gift of this transformation is the infusion of the Power Cosmic into the very essence of your being. This enhancement fortifies every aspect of yourself, including your physical, mental, and spiritual attributes, while also amplifying your existing abilities with the boundless energy of the universe.

Access to the Power Cosmic bestows upon you remarkable abilities, including Cosmic energy manipulation and projection, giving you mastery over the cosmic energies and fundamental forces of the universe, and enabling you to wield them for offensive, defensive, and utilitarian purposes, Cosmic awareness, which expands your consciousness to encompass the vastness of the universe, allowing you to comprehend and perceive its intricacies on both a universal and multiversal scale, virtual immortality and invulnerability to all but the most formidable cosmic effects, molecular manipulation, resurrection, telepathy, telekinesis, lifeforce manipulation, dimensional travel, time travel, and a myriad of other powers waiting to be discovered through your exploration and mastery.

Lastly, as a symbol of your position as a Herald, you will be bestowed with a unique Item/Vehicle/Weapon. This artifact can be customized to align with your personal preference, much like the Surfer's iconic Board, Frank's trusted Bike, or the wielders of the Axe.

Note: The limitations of the Power Cosmic are solely determined by the extent of your imagination and your willingness to explore and harness it's limitless potential.
objects.title: Champion of the World Eater (Marvel)

objects.text:
You gain access to a piece of Hawkeye's supposedly "peak human" skill, as depicted in Marvel Rivals.

When focusing, you gain the ability to see spectral afterimages of your enemies, revealing where they were moments ago. These afterimages remain visible for a short time, even if the target moves behind cover or out of sight. More importantly, the afterimages are sympathetically linked to the people who left them. Hitting, shooting, or otherwise damaging an afterimage will also damage the real target, regardless of their current position.

At first, the afterimages will be choppy, like frames of a film played too far apart, offering only fleeting glimpses of your target’s movements. With continued use, however, they become more numerous and appear closer together, gradually creating a smoother trail of their movements. Training can also increase how long the afterimages remain visible.

Because this ability affects everyone within your line of sight, it is particularly effective against far away and fast-moving targets. A blur of motion becomes a trail you can follow, allowing you to strike where your enemy was and still hit where they are.

Do note that Hunter’s Sight does not bypass a target’s durability or other defensive powers. If they are intangible, invincible, or otherwise protected when you strike their afterimage, they will not take damage.

Now, exactly how Hawkeye manages to do all of this without having any superpowers is anyone's guess.
objects.title: Hunter's Sight (Marvel)

objects.text:
You've gained the incredible gift to create inky black portals that serve as gateways to anywhere your mind can visualize. The very fabric of space and time bends to your will as you manipulate these interdimensional openings. 

Picture it—a gesture of your hand, a thought in your mind, and a portal materializes before your eyes, swirling with chaotic energy. Step through and find yourself transported to distant lands, alternate dimensions, and even parallel universes. The possibilities are nearly boundless as you navigate through the vast tapestry of existence, discovering new worlds and encountering extraordinary beings.

However, traversing these gateways does initially pose a challenge, as the multidimensional terrain can be treacherous and disorienting. But fear not, for with time and experience, your mastery over this power will grow, allowing you to navigate the cosmic labyrinth with increasing finesse. One day, the entirety of the multiverse will become your playground, a vast expanse of wonder and adventure at your fingertips.

But that's not all. When pushed to the brink of life or death, or when faced with immense stress, you temporarily transcend your mortal form, becoming a being crafted from swirling, inky black portals. Space-Time warps around you, fractal patterns dancing in your wake as you gain absolute control over temporal and spatial dimensions near you. In this state, the rules of the universe are merely guidelines you can easily break. 

Through dedicated training and honing your abilities, accessing this form will become second nature to you, as the boundaries of what is possible shatters.
objects.title: I Mark The Spot! (Marvel: Spiderverse)

addons.text:
Your Minecraft power now extends to the mod known as Mystical Agriculture. This gives you all the knowledge and recipes available in the mod and its addons, as well as providing new materials and passive abilities to make said recipes possible. Some examples of what the mod can do are as follows.

You can now earn inferium essence and prosperity shards randomly from ‘mining’ ores or defeating enemies in combat. This essence is used as the basis for creating almost everything in this mod, which is mostly centered around the creation and production of ‘material’ seeds from their base material (which allow you to farm normally non-sowable materials, like wood, coal, or diamond), higher level essences, and eventually meta-alloys using said higher level essences.
addons.title: Mystical Agriculture

addons.text: “If the crown fits, wear it.” You have become the successor of the Blood God. No, not that one! Technoblade, you’re the successor of Technoblade. As his successor you inherit his martial prowess, unnatural capacity to inflict fear, and skill at… farming potatoes? You also gain an uncanny affinity for Withers, making them not target you and even obey rudimentary orders, although this affinity won’t save you if you aggravate them enough. Go forth and spread the Legacy of your predecessor, the Blade.
addons.title: The Blood Prince

addons.text:
Your Minecraft abilities now allow you to install various tech mods and their addons, such as, Create, Ender IO, Tinkers' Construct, and  Refined Storage. Whenever you install a mod it comes preinstalled with all of its addons and supplements. You start out with 3 mod slots and with time and the creation of special upgrade modules you can unlock more of said slots. You possess all of the necessary knowledge, recipes, and training needed to fully utilize these mods and their addons. Some of these mods will require unique materials that cannot be found naturally, which may impede your progress. Fortunately, you can create these materials by finding a substitute and converting them into the required material at a 1:1 ratio.

With mods like Refined Storage, you can store items and liquids in hard drives, only requiring expansion to increase their capacity. With enough of these upgraded drives, you could potentially hold the equivalent of entire planets within a single server. Similarly, mods such as Create and Ender IO provide an easy way to generate and transport energy. This lets you power entire structures and stations with a small, reliable setup that never stops or breaks. Mods like Tinker's Construct enable you to craft items using materials typically considered impossible, such as slime or paper, with each material granting unique properties. 

With the right mods, you can design an entire spaceship that doesn’t need to stop for fuel or resources, as everything you might need can be created onboard, with farms held within pocket dimensions, a cargo bay that only requires a few cubic meters of space to hold entire planets' worth of materials, weapons that produce their ammunition as it is required. You can create unique “farms” that automate the crafting and production of items. It is possible to set up infinite sources of materials and produce unlimited quantities of any item you need. 

This will enhance any of your Tech powers, allowing you to acquire essential materials much more efficiently while easily automating their production. With the right combination of mods, there is nothing you cannot accomplish.
addons.title: Tech Mods

objects.text:
With this power you've become a Minecraft character - with all the physics it entails but none of the downsides of looking like you crawled out of Minecraft.

You can punch trees into blocks while the entire tree floats in the air. You can break veins of ore with a pickaxe and get a 1 cubic meter block of that material no matter what. You can even shove 1728 cubic meters of diamond into a cubed storage chest!

You also have a limited inventory space consisting of 4 armor slots, 9 hotbar slots for quickly swapping items, and 27 storage slots. Each hotbar and storage slot can hold 64 of the same items in a stack. All items inside the inventory are weightless as well, we can't have you carrying 22 billion pounds of gold after all!

Besides an inventory, you also have a crafting menu. Besides knowing normal recipes found in the base game you are also capable of creating both a Nether and End Portal out of suitable substituted materials.

In addition, you gain the ability to enchant items with an Enchantment Table by using ‘Experience’, which you gain from defeating enemies and crafting items as the fuel, and Lapis Lazuli (or a suitable substitute) as the binding agent for the enchantment.

You have 10 ‘hearts’ that depict your current health and status, and you acquire more with any extra brute powers you may possess. You do not get the ability to respawn unless you have a power allowing it, but if you do, you will respawn back in your bed after dying. 

In combat, you deal slight knockback damage when hitting an enemy. You gain invincibility frames for a short duration upon being hit, and can critically strike an enemy, dealing additional damage, every so often.

You can selectively toggle which parts of this power are in effect at any given time, meaning you aren’t stuck to only crafting cubed objects permanently, nor do all of your creations have to defy gravity.
objects.title: Most Known Game (Minecraft)

addons.text:
Now, instead of being left behind when you die, any objects you had on you will instead be stored inside your Inventory.

You can optionally choose for certain objects to get left behind. This applies to both those that were on your person or in your Inventory.
addons.title: Keep Inventory

objects.text:
"You died!"

But fortunately, death is not the end for you. You have inherited the ability to "Respawn", just like the player characters in Minecraft.

When you die, your body will dissolve into smoke, and your consciousness will be sent to the space between life and death—a place resembling a game over screen. Here, you will see two buttons. The "Quit" button allows you to die permanently, sending your soul to its destined resting place. In contrast, the "Respawn" button lets you revive at your last spawn point. Additionally, there will be a "was killed by X" style text board message relating to how you died.

Your spawn point will be set at the last bed you slept in. If that bed is destroyed, you will respawn at the location where you first entered your world. You can change your world spawn point, but every time you do so, you will have to wait for one year before you can do so again.

Be wary of letting others discover your spawn point—lest you become trapped in a death cycle by those clever enough to exploit it.

Also, do note that any objects you had on you at the time of your death, except your clothes, will get left behind at the location where you died.
objects.title: Respawn (Minecraft)

addons.text: Powers you create come equipped with fully-fledged Magical Girl equipment and gain the benefit of the Magical Girl perk. While it can vary in appearance, there will usually be indicators that they share design-wise with you. You can vaguely sense the condition of power users at any given point in time.
addons.title: One Team, One Dream

addons.text: The bond you share with your allies makes you recover faster. The more they wish to see you, the faster you revive. The more they trust you, the quicker you return to peak conditions. But the bond they have with you isn’t one way. It can also go the other way. Your allies can recover, albeit slower compared to you, from anything as if they also have Eternal Flame.
addons.title: The Bonds of Trust

addons.text: The more people pin their hopes on you, the stronger you become. As you stand as a figure people respect, fear, or otherwise rely on, you grow stronger to match their expectations or surpass them.
addons.title: The Rejection of Friendship

addons.text: When one of your allies improves, you improve an equal amount as them. Honing skills, powers, and strength guarantees that you will grow just as much as they do. If you’re fighting alongside a person in real combat, you will grow many times more than they do.
addons.title: The Power of Friendship

addons.text: You can give your people weaker copies of your powers they grow stronger and more flexible as they use it. The powers you give them cannot be used to harm you or your allies unless you wish it to and you can take your copies back anytime you wish. When you take back power, any growth that power had is added to your original power.
addons.title: The Art of Giving

objects.text:
You gain the power of the Light Side, taking in your allies’ bonds and turning them into power. Memories you have and the friendships you share are directly turned into sources of power that you can use to gain replications of their abilities. By working together, both of you will grow stronger. However, while you can create these powers, they do not reach the full strength of the original unless you spend a significant amount of time and have a strong bond with each other. You can create powers of your own abilities or of powers you currently possess to give to other people, but their strength is directly related to your bond with them or their bond with the original power owner.

Should the original wielder of the power die or their relationship with you sour, your power can no longer grow even if it has not reached the full strength of the original. But as long as you have positive memories of the original wielder, you can still use that power. You cannot create powers from negative relationships you have with people, and it must be a two-way friendship. If you think about them, you will be able to feel the location of other power users you’ve given abilities.
objects.title: Light Side (Magical Girl ☆Sym-tan☆)

addons.text: Using powers together makes them stronger, improving the synergistic effects they have as well as making new synergies with other powers. Your powers now blend together, gaining the traits of each other and are stronger than the sum of their parts.
addons.title: One Plus One Equals Four

addons.text: Anyone whose opinion of you that is less than neutral in your paradise suffers not just weakening, but they also make you stronger. The more hostile they are to you, the stronger you get. The stronger the person is, the faster you get stronger as well.
addons.title: This Isn’t What You Wished For

addons.text: The location from which you obtain Vestiges can impact their nature. A warzone, for example, can give a Vestige an alternate, more combat-focused mode. Additionally, how the original is remembered can create alternate forms that strengthen the Vestiges in specific ways.
addons.title: History’s Monster

objects.text: You gain the power of the Dark Side, breaking down your opponents’ abilities and turning them into your own. You can imbue your attacks with the ability to damage the powers of hurt enemies and extract fragments of their abilities. Successful extraction of fragments can be used to create versions for your own use. These powers are inherently weaker than the original unless you kill the owner of the original or constantly harm the opponent over a long enough time, as power damage from the Dark Side can eventually recover. The more you weaken your enemies, the stronger your powers become.
objects.title: Dark Side (Magical Girl ☆Sym-tan☆)

addons.text: Your copies have a transformation that allows them to transform into a kind of style. This can be a uniform of your choosing, an outfit they designed, or even clothing that looks fancy on them. The outfit itself doesn't impact the copy's combat prowess no matter how fancy it is and can alter their equipment's look to match or be altered to match their equipment's look.
addons.title: Magical Girl Brigade

addons.text: Your inviolable soul protects your paradise from any kind of harm. Even if your soul is completely erased or you experience true death, your paradise wouldn't be impacted. The protection even extends to the inhabitants and copies of your paradise, allowing them to recover from anything should they ever get harmed.
addons.title: Eternal Paradise

addons.text: You can sacrifice people or copies to enhance the powers of your other allies or yourself. This can give the powers, skills, abilities, and so on to the chosen target. This can also improve the talent and growth potential of the chosen target based on the sacrificed person’s potential. You can also choose not to apply Symbol Brigade’s growth or weakening onto certain people to instead increase the growth or weakening of someone else.
addons.title: The Price of Peace

addons.text: You can summon an unlimited number of copies of the people in your Paradise, and if you or they choose, it can be connected to them, allowing them to operate in multiple locations at once. The fewer friends you have, the stronger the few friends become. If you only have one meaningful relationship inside your Paradise, they grow 150x faster. If you have 2, it’s 75x faster for both of them. The minimum limit of this is 2x.
addons.title: Ode to Friendships

addons.text: You can force others to be added to your Paradise even if they don’t want to, dragging others into it as long as you have something that belongs to them. But even if you don’t, you can use your attacks to forcibly turn them into a copy of you. The stronger their wills, the harder this is, but upon successful conversion, that strong willpower will grant you and your copies a trait based on the host’s powers or personality. These traits can be used to enhance all of your powers in one way or another.
addons.title: The Mirror’s Reflection

addons.text: Anything within your personal paradise can grow stronger, the more emotional value people place into an object or pet the faster it will get stronger it is with it also gaining unique abilities and functions.
addons.title: Echos of You

addons.text:
You can choose to invade the universe you are currently in. The invasion process is incredibly slow, and its influence will start out small. Initially, you may be able to get a general feel for the location of certain things or knowledge of events happening at the moment. The greater influence you have, the stronger you and your allies become. As time passes, you slowly become able to exert your rules over the places you control, from complete alteration of the area to the removal of gravity. Alternatively, you can simply rule the universe to kill everyone inside, but something like that will take a long time.

While most people will not be able to feel the invasion, reality benders can both feel and slow down this process. Traveling outside of the universe you are in the process of invading will pause the invasion. Reality benders will be able to capitalize on this and reverse the process. This power considers alternate timelines and separated dimensions as separate universes. Dimensions that are created, reliant on, or connected to the invaded universe are not considered separate dimensions. This includes small pocket dimensions.
addons.title: Brigade Invasion Order

objects.text:
You have a personal paradise inside of your soul, one of infinite size and shape. You can alter its appearance however you like and it is filled with an abundance of infinite, yet mundane, resources. You can create portals, even permanent ones, to enter and exit your paradise or connect it to the outside world. You can also invite others to live there, inside they will experience healing and relaxation of the body, mind, and soul. Capable of extending their lifespan however long they wish and living far longer than they were capable of. The longer they stay inside, the stronger they will grow. The bonds they have with you and the happiness they create will further hasten this growth. On the other hand, if they are hostile and untrusting they will experience little to no growth. And if they plan on betraying you, they will even be weakened.

You can also summon a copy that symbolizes a person within your paradise with all the abilities, equipment, and skills they have, you can even choose to synchronize the copy with the real one allowing the person to explore and traverse the real world without leaving the safety of your paradise. But even if they left your paradise for one reason or another, you can still summon a copy of them with all their personality, memories, and so on with more degree of flexibility like changing the copy of them to be from a certain point of time. If the person comes back radically changed, you'll be able to use both copies at the same time. But the older copy can't synchronize with the real person anymore. Those with your permission are also capable of creating portals to paradise.

You are also supernaturally good at understanding and empathizing with all kinds of beings. You can understand and possibly befriend those you want to befriend. You can turn foes into friends, and teach monsters without empathy love. The bonds you create with those close to you can last as long as you continue to befriend them. You are both the ruler of paradise but also their friend, you can inspire hope and courage in your allies no matter how dark it gets.

And even if you are not in your paradise, you can create and set laws inside that are automatically enforced on anyone or thing that enters. By your order, nothing can happen unless you allow it. This allows you to create a safe environment for all who want to live here without causing chaos. By your order, you can make violence forbidden and those who violate it can suffer punishment of your choosing. Be it being banned from your paradise forever to being weakened and restrained. But for those who follow your rules, this land is a perfect haven full of all kinds of resources.
objects.title: The Symbol Brigade (Magical Girl ☆Sym-tan☆)

addons.text: Your Negative Emotion Drive can siphon your alternate dimension’s vast reserves of negative emotional energy, fueling your powers without the need to experience negative emotions yourself. This creates a self-reinforcing loop: as you draw energy from your alternate dimension, Negative Emotion Drive uses this energy to strengthen you, and byproduct your dimension, increasing the amount of energy it produces, which then further strengthens Negative Emotion Drive.
addons.title: Negativity Nexus

objects.text:
Your being has been infused with an infinitesimal speck of power from the Fifth Timeline, home to a primordial embodiment of eldritch evil hellbent on subjugating all which exists to its malevolent whims. Normally, this would deprive you of agency and transform you into one of its servants, but you have achieved the impossible and retained both your mental faculties and broken free of its control. 

Your very existence down to your soul has been drenched in the deepest dark, and you have come out fundamentally changed. Your body is no longer biological in nature, instead a mass of sapient shadow. Physical blows are useless against you, with only magic or other spiritual means of attack capable of hurting you. 

Furthermore, you no longer require sustenance of any kind, you are biologically immortal, and your sense of empathy and love for others has been washed out. It is still possible to care about someone else, but that affection will most likely be twisted from the perspective of a normal person. 

These alterations do not come without benefit, however, as you gain unparalleled mastery over darkness. Your Umbrakinesis allows you to generate and control darkness to do your bidding, using tendrils of shadow to strike at foes or using it to teleport all come naturally to you. Your control over shadow extends to the darkness which comprises your body as well, allowing you to shapeshift. Your mental capacity is increased to be able to manipulate darkness with pinprick precision across your entire range, which covers an area the size of a country.

Reality itself bends in your presence, granting you a limited form of omnikinesis which grows weaker the further you try to extend your power, fully petering out at around 500 meters from you. At your weakest, you can transmute small bits of matter into different forms and manifest small light shows. At your strongest, you gain limited control over local spacetime.

You have become a self-perpetuating memetic infohazard with the ability to assimilate anyone who even thinks about you. When someone thinks of you, you gain a continual awareness of who they are, where they are, and a scan of their thoughts and memories.
