You will then passively drain the victim of their sanity and willpower until they are utterly devoted to you. Supernaturally shielded or alien minds will be more difficult to corrupt, but in such cases, you may simply kill them instead, as you may also assimilate a corpse. 

Once a person is assimilated, they become linked to you on every level. They become part of a hivemind with you as its sovereign. Their mind, body, and soul become part of you, granting you their memories, skills, and powers. You may choose to grant your servants a degree of autonomy and independent thought, but they will ultimately remain subservient to you. If any of them are killed, they will slowly reform over a period of 24 hours. As your power grows, this period of time will shorten.

Finally, you have acquired a small piece of the Fifth Timeline for yourself, a domain of dread filled with evils and negative emotion. While inside this pocket dimension, all your powers are amplified in strength by several magnitudes, and you can reshape its appearance to your liking. You can enter your pocket dimension by creating portals via your umbrakinesis, which can also be used to drag other things into the realm. Other creatures within the realm cannot escape. Any dimension-hopping abilities they have will fail to work.

You and your realm are intrinsically linked, so long as your pocket dimension exists, you will be unable to die, reforming at most an hour after your death within it. The same is true in reverse, so long as you live, you can slowly recreate your pocket dimension over the course of a year. Even if both you and your realm are destroyed, so long as a single one of your minions exists, your existence will simply be transferred into one of your choosing, making you a difficult one to truly stamp out indeed. 

If you so wish, you may “invade” a world by having the evils within your pocket dimension spew out from a portal and into the space around it, effectively corrupting reality itself to become more akin to your own realm of darkness, strengthening you in return. This process is slow, however, and can be counteracted by other reality warpers if you don't stop them.

Perhaps one day, you will be able to grow into this speck of power you have obtained into something which matches the original, but if that day comes at all, it shall be aeons from now.
objects.title: Shadows of The Fifth Timeline (Magical Girl ☆Sym-tan☆)

objects.text:
An eldritch power, whispered into being not by the Goddess who rules the realms, but by the Witch of all Fae—an entity so ancient and unbound that even the Goddess dares not covet her station. This is not a divine gift, but a burden veiled in majesty. It is a power the Goddess could wield, but does not, for it requires a responsibility so absolute it borders on sacrilege. The Witch, however, has no such reservations. And so, she grants it to you.

This power, known as Mod Status, bestows three distinct abilities upon its bearer—tools of governance, exile, and silence.

The first is Role Request. With but a thought, you may assign roles to others—ephemeral titles that confer tangible skill and instinct. To be given a role is to become it. A person branded “War Criminal” finds themselves gifted with uncanny instinct for combat—reaction times sharpen, pain tolerance increases, and their capacity for ruthlessness is instinctual rather than taught. In contrast, one assigned the ignoble title of “Yellow-Bellied Wimp” is granted an acute, almost preternatural Danger Sense. Anyone who lays eyes on a person will instantly know what roles they carry, like a name-tag carved into reality itself. Each role can grant no more than 5 SP worth of power or utility. There is no upper limit to how many roles a person may hold, but the act of assigning one is not without toll. For a normal human, role granting is so draining that it can only be safely performed once per week. This fatigue can be lessened through the creation of a special role—Veteran—who are capable of carrying the burden whenever you grant a role. You can also grant yourself roles. 

The second ability is Timeout. You can force a target into a state of total isolation from the world. They become intangible and insubstantial—phantoms that cannot act, speak, or be touched. They cannot be heard or seen by most, nor can they affect the world in even the smallest way. The longer the timeout, the greater the cost—but once exiled, they remain so until the set period ends or you release them. A minute might leave you breathless; a day could feel like an hour long exercise session; and casting a weeklong timeout on someone, if you were no more than a regular human, would feel like having sprinted an entire marathon. 

And finally, there is Ban. Ban allows you to forcibly exclude a target from a location—not merely barring their entrance, but rewriting the fabric of space to reject their very presence. The scale of the area affects the cost: a room may be manageable; a city block causes immense strain. But more than area, it is the rebound—the force with which the world repels the banned—that defines the true danger of this power. A minor rebound can teleport them back the moment they cross a threshold. But at full strength, the very boundary of the Ban acts like a slingshot—hurling the violator across planes, even into a wholly different dimension. This barrier is permanent until you will it undone, and its strength can be layered, reinforced, or modified over time. Yet make no mistake: even a relatively modest Ban—excluding a single person from a small home, with a rebound strong enough to eject them from the surrounding neighborhood—would drain as much from you as Timeouting them for a full week.
objects.title: Mod Status (Magical Girl ☆Sym-tan☆)

objects.text: The end times have come. The cycle must take its course. Hear the Goddess’s decree. “Go touch grass and write stories.” As commanded by the Goddess, the time of creation and transformation must have its end. Many of the Goddesses' subjects weep in sadness at their inability to add to the gloriousness of her creation, but there is a time when the fields must lie fallow and allow grass to take root. Known as the End of the Cycle, Grass Week is the death of time throughout the realms. Nothing is created nor destroyed. Nothing moves nor stops. Chemical reactions are halted and bullets hang in the air. Everything is frozen like a picture. Even people are no exception to this rule. After a week, the goddess resets the universe and causes a new cycle to start. Many worshippers wonder why the goddess goes through with this ritual. Hypotheses range from staving off a primordial foe or wanting the ascension of mankind. Or maybe even goddesses need a break sometimes. You may emulate a very small sliver of the Goddess’s divine power, being able to project Grass Week as a kind of layer over reality. This starts as a bubble no bigger than a small room, but with time and training, it may span creation itself, even if it may only last a week in duration. With immense strain on yourself, you may ignore the restrictions of Grass Week, allowing you to affect the world around you. You won't be able to dance around your opponents whilst juggling fifty weapons without blood leaking from your nose or muscles rupturing, but a few short bursts of movement are feasible. This layer of reality causes the entire landscape to change in appearance to an endless field of grass that stretches beyond the horizon with an eternal blue sky and fluffy white clouds.
objects.title: Grass Week (Magical Girl ☆Sym-tan☆)

objects.text:
There was once a creature, a being born chaos and destruction. It stalked through the lands of the Goddess, its presence heralded by silence and ruin. Forests withered in its wake, mountains trembled at its steps, and even the most sacred shrines crumbled beneath the weight of its fury. Many feared its power, having suffered its wrath and been Gungniered. Yet there were those who worshiped it, yearning for the raw, unbridled power that flowed through its being. When the creature finally fell, its essence shattered into countless fragments. From those fragments, you have inherited a sliver of its might: the power of Gungnier.

Gungnier grants its wielder a form of metaphysical perception: the ability to see the “structure” of powers, abilities, and energy systems. Every power functions on a set of underlying principles, like a formula or mechanism. Gungnier allows you to perceive and understand those principles directly, as though analyzing the code behind reality. This understanding is the first step to deconstruction.

To use Gungnier, the wielder must first analyze the target’s power. This requires direct observation or exposure, be it witnessing the ability being used, feeling its energy, or coming into physical or spiritual contact with it. The duration of analysis depends on the complexity of the power and the wielder’s proficiency with Gungnier. A simple elemental spell could be understood in moments; a divine or multi-layered ability may take hours, days, or even repeated encounters. Once comprehension reaches a certain threshold, the wielder can identify the power’s core flaw, the point of instability or contradiction that sustains it.

When that flaw is targeted, you can begin a gradual process, starting with altering the way a power functions permanently. The wielder might impose limits, distort rules, or rewrite small parameters within the target’s ability. A fire mage’s flames may weaken or not be able to burn without a catalyst; a healer’s regeneration might slow or cost the target’s nutrients. These early stages act as testing grounds, small recalibrations that reveal how the power’s framework reacts to manipulation.

Only when the wielder achieves complete understanding, with every mechanism, flow, and underlying principle of a power revealed after prodding does Gungnier reach its true potential: deconstruction. This process forcibly destabilizes the target power’s internal logic, unraveling it from the inside. Like before, the effect is permanent. The target loses the ability completely, whether it is a magical gift, divine blessing, or innate racial trait. The power doesn’t return over time and cannot be restored through normal means, resurrection, or re-teaching, because it is conceptually erased from the target’s essence. The victim remains intact physically but becomes incapable of ever wielding that specific power again. When a person’s power is destroyed, it affects only them. Other practitioners, creatures, or systems using similar abilities are untouched. 

However, deconstruction comes with strict limitations and risks. The wielder must fully understand the target power’s structure; guessing or partial understanding will cause feedback, damaging the wielder’s own abilities. Additionally, Gungnier cannot deconstruct things it cannot understand, such as powers based on concepts beyond mortal comprehension, divine will, or pure chaos resist analysis. Likewise, Gungnier cannot erase physical matter or life directly; it targets powers, not bodies. This can be circumvented if the matter or life was created through the use of a power rather than naturally occurring.
objects.title: Gungnier, the Spear of Destruction (Magical Girl ☆Sym-tan☆)

objects.text:
A variant of Anaqi, in an attempt to create a weapon to destroy his enemies, captured and weaponised a wild entity called Anarchy. Anarchy was once a raw, mindless beast of destruction, but under Anaqi’s command, it was refined into a fundamental law of reality: a static, perfect paradox that defines itself solely through negation.

You command a reserve of Imaginary Energy, a paradoxical substance that both exists and does not, possessing no inherent properties of its own. The total amount of this energy is finite and scales directly with your own physical and mental fortitude, increasing through dedicated practice and personal growth over time. It serves as the raw fuel for all aspects of your Anarchy power.

Your primary function is the Anarchic Field, a passive and absolute shield that surrounds you. The Field operates on a single, immutable principle: it is the perfect, static negation of any and all "defined existence" that interacts with it. Any force, substance, or concept, be it a physical strike, a psychic assault, or a divine curse, is met with an equal and opposite negation, causing the two to annihilate each other upon contact. This defense is total and instantaneous from the first moment of contact.

However, this perfection comes at a cost. Maintaining the Field against any interaction consumes Imaginary Energy proportional to the force being negated. A gentle breeze costs a pittance; a blow that could shatter a mountain demands a king's ransom. The Field makes you nigh-invulnerable, but each attack whittles away at your finite resources. It can defend against any number of simultaneous attacks, but the energy cost is cumulative, rapidly draining your reserves under a coordinated assault.

You can offensively manifest the Imaginary Energy as a Spear of Annihilation. Once a target is within your perception or you are aware of their exact position, you can target them, focusing a massive portion of your Imaginary Energy into a single point, making an instantaneous creation of the target's "anti-existence", a perfect conceptual opposite, like antimatter to matter. Nature itself abhors this perfect vacuum of being, and the universe instantly reconciles the paradox by annihilating the target with their anti-existence to fill the void. This makes the attack a guaranteed hit that cannot be dodged or intercepted, as it is the cosmos itself that executes the erasure. The energy cost scales dynamically to the target's "existential mass," meaning weaker foes require minimal energy while stronger ones may only be partially erased if your reserve is insufficient for complete annihilation. Manifesting it consumes a vast amount of energy in an instant, potentially depleting your defenses and leaving you exposed.
objects.title: Shield and Spear of Anarchy (Magical Girl ☆Sym-tan☆)

objects.text:
Stories have power, but most lack the ability to tap into it. Now, you too can grant others access to those stories' power by granting them a title based on their personality as you perceive it, with that title granting associated abilities that grow as the title's bearer acts in ways befitting of it. As an example, a woman granted the title of Artemis, Goddess of the Hunt, might gain the ability to conjure a bow and arrows, become supernaturally good at tracking, and an affinity to moon-based magics, all of which would increase in power by things like hunting animals or protecting girls and women. After a title is granted, the power of that story can only be revoked if someone changes such that the granted title no longer fits them.

As for the abilities a title grants and their initial power, they range from 10-20 SP worth, depending on your interpretation and emotional connection to the story the title represents. When granting a title, you will intuitively understand all abilities it comes with and how powerful they are. While you cannot give multiple of the same title, you can give multiple people titles relating to the same story and give one person multiple titles, as long as those titles do not have a conflict in how they'd grow.

As for your abilities, those come from the titles you innately possess. The first of those titles is Title-Granter, letting you both understand and give others access to a title and the associated story's power. The second is Title-Bearer, letting you use any one title nobody else currently has, with its growth being kept even when not in use. As with other titles, these can grow, allowing you to potentially do things like control the initial power of a granted title and access multiple titles at once.
objects.title: Vel, the Appointer (Magical Girl ☆Sym-tan☆)

addons.text: Reality echoes with your every breath. Expanding and contracting with motions of your lungs. Vibrating with every step and every shift of your flesh. Resonating with every intent. Your powers feed into each other in an exponential self-reinforcing loop. Your influence over reality grows further and deeper with every breath. Your capabilities expand. Soon, your very thoughts and whims will be enough to alter reality around yourself. The mere thought of striking someone enough for them to be struck. The idea of something existing enough for it to manifest. Your actual actions become nigh-unstoppable. Overwhelming. Practically laws of reality unto themselves. The only thing holding you back is your self control.
addons.title: Completion

objects.text: "Hey! If you haven't designed a power that can one-shot Worm, are you even trying?" – Nanotrix Insecure but determined after only having 'weak' powers to show to the chat at a gathering, the Pale-Feathered Serpent decided to weave a new power, one to be the biggest and greatest ever! Unfortunately, they weren't used to making large powers. With this ability, every action one takes is imbued with the concepts of Amplification and Cascade. As an otherwise normal human, one would be able to break buildings with a step, pulp normies with a slap, and crudely carve their name in walls with a single hard poke. All energy and force affected by this ability is controllable dependent on one's will and intent, with mentally flexible, strong-minded individuals being able to control this ability precisely enough to carve intricate statues out of marble with a single tap. But this ability's influence is not limited to the base material plane. One can, with sufficient practice and grasp—or with a sufficient seed action—alter the Amplification and Cascade onto and through concepts. Such as striking not only a target, but those connected to the one they are striking; such as the Shard behind a parahuman's ability, followed by all the shards related to it, then the Entity, etc. Or shift the cascade to affect things connected to their initial action, such as staggering a parahuman's ability itself with a throat punch. Further, one could do such things as Amplifying concepts while forging or creating something, Cascading the results through and deep into their workpiece. Or Amplifying and Cascading their own training through themselves, or even into others around them. With sufficient practice, experience, control, and will—and a strong enough power level and intent to go with it—one can use this ability to even shift the foundations of the reality they are within; changing the laws of an entire universe with their punches, if they are so inclined. But the Pale-Feathered Serpent forgot to take into account one's foundation due to being a dragon, and did not include reinforcement. Thus, this power does not enhance one's base power—spiritual, magical, physical, or otherwise—on its own. If you're a squishy base-line normie, you'll have to work up to such towering capabilities the hard way.
objects.title: Half a One Shot (Magical Girl ☆Sym-tan☆)

objects.text:
This is a power bestowed upon your soul by the Goddess Lt. It grants you the ability to draft Designs for powers, items, or skills. Upon your mental command, you can formalize a concept into a Design dossier and submit it.

Once submitted, a Vote commences. For the next 24 hours, your Design is reviewed by an invisible committee of hundreds of entities scattered across the multiverse, each with their own perspectives, ethics, and senses of humor. They cast a simple vote: "Yes" to actualize it for you, or "No" to deny it. The threshold for failure is razor-thin. If more than five voters dissent with a "No," the Design is instantly denied. Each "No" vote is not just a rejection; it comes with a Feedback, a burst of intuitive understanding revealing the voter's core objection, allowing you to refine your proposal. You are granted one chance to revise and re-submit a denied Design. If it fails a second time, that entire concept of the Design is locked and cannot be attempted again for three months. Any Designs that are worth more than 25 SP are more than likely to be denied for being too strong. You also cannot have more than one Design submitted at a time.

This power operates on a strict monthly cycle. It functions at full capacity for two consecutive weeks. During the third week, it enters a limited state: you cannot create new Designs, only alter existing ones, which still needs to be voted on. In the fourth week, the power fully deactivates to recharge, resetting at the week's end and preparing for a new cycle.

At the conclusion of each recharge week, there is a small chance for a new Rule to be generated. These Rules can be temporary boons or permanent fixtures, and they dynamically alter the power's framework. They might expand or restrict the types of allowed Designs, or temporarily modify the Voting mechanics. Most permanent Rules are restrictive.
objects.title: Design Submissions (Magical Girl ☆Sym-tan☆)

objects.text:
“Isn’t that name too narcissistic?”
“Eh, if it walks like a duck and quacks like a duck, it's a duck.”
- A Conversation between Anaqi and his Assistant.

You gain the power of the Nameless Assistant, Avatar of Anaqi, his Herald and Voice. 

You are able to receive revelations in the form of spoken words. This manifests as an involuntary trait: you now mutter unintentionally whenever you are in deep thought or focused on solving a problem. Each time you speak under these conditions, there is a one-in-five chance your sentence is hijacked. What emerges from your mouth is not your intended thought, but a piece of information pulled directly from the Root of the World, the Akashic Records. This information is something you have no possible way of knowing, yet it is always precisely what you need to overcome your current obstacle.

However, this revelation is easily missed. The information is delivered in your own voice, nestled within your habitual muttering. Unless you or someone else is consciously paying close attention to the specific words you say, there is a nearly ninety percent chance you will not notice the revelation occurred. If you miss it, then you will have lost the information. Additionally, you cannot ask specific questions. The revelation is tied to your focus, not your intent. You might be pondering a moral dilemma and receive the chemical formula for a nerve agent because, subconsciously, you saw it as a "solution" to a threat.
objects.title: Voice of God (Magical Girl ☆Sym-tan☆)

addons.text: ‘A Dog-like creature leaping through the air, cloaked in many strange objects’ Your bond, thankfully, has adapted to your items. You can now have your items represented on your body in inscription form, rather than constantly wearing miscellaneous items on your person to gain their benefits.
addons.title: Condensation

objects.text:
You can use the items from the series called Risk of  Rain. Too bad you don't have any of them, but don't worry, defeating enemies gives a certain chance to drop an item. For comparison, an ordinary person has a 5% chance of dropping an item, while a low-to-mid tier cape will have a 20% chance. High tier capes have a 50% to drop an item. Any item from the Risk of Rain series can be dropped, including, but not limited to: Teddy bears that can completely negate an attack; glasses that give you a chance to double damage; A chronobauble that slows an enemy by 60% for 2 seconds; Armor Plates that reduces incoming damage; A 57 leaf clover that rerolls failed chances.

You will notice some items will have a chance to activate, like the ukelele which, 25% of the time upon attacking will fire chain lighting dealing 80% of the damage of the original attack. Having multiple items with a chance to activate allows for the potential of a proc chain. A proc chain is when you an item is activated, and it hits it's enemy, which will result in another item activating. There is no attack that can't proc.

If a duplicate item appears that you already have, you can merge them for a 2-in-1 deal. You can also undo the process and give the item to someone else to use if you desire. The item needs to be on your person to work, but the items have an unnatural ability to seemingly always stick.

With enough items, you might be able to shred an endbringer in a few seconds.
objects.title: Petrichor V Survivor (Risk of Rain)

addons.text: Your Origin is inscribed on your soul, this grants you a second Epithet that matches your Origin.
addons.title: Inscribed Origin

objects.text:
You are an "Inscribed," a person with a word attached to your soul called an "Epithet." This allows you to develop various powers and abilities based on your Epithet.

Exactly what powers and abilities an Inscribed can potentially develop depends on two factors: the creativity of the Inscribed and the Epithet itself. Additionally, Epithets are somewhat unique, meaning that no two individuals will have exactly the same Epithet.

Someone with an Epithet of "Barrier" could potentially create/control barriers and block memories, while someone with an Epithet of "Dumb" could potentially reduce a person's intelligence, suppress sound, and weaken attacks, and someone with an Epithet of "Sundial" could potentially turn things forwards or backwards along any process, such as gravity, inertia, the cycle of the sun, and even a person's lifespan.

Epithets are powered by your stamina, so overuse of an Epithet can be exhausting.

(While Epithets are typically random, you get to choose yours.)
objects.title: Epithet (Epithet Erased)

objects.text:
You possess the power of Assertion, an extraordinary ability that allows you to impose an aspect of yourself onto the fabric of reality so perfectly that it bends to your will. This power enables you to selectively ignore a single law of reality at a time.

Assertion can take many forms, ranging from erasing your presence from the world to slicing a block of steel with a mere branch, or traversing miles in a single step. Effortlessly defying the world's laws becomes second nature, as you can seamlessly switch between different assertions.

Initially, you are limited to ignoring one reality law at a time. However, with time and dedication, you can expand the scope and breadth of your assertions. True masters of this power are capable of distorting causality, tearing through the unreal with their bare hands, or even glimpsing into the threads of fate.
objects.title: Assertion (A Practical Guide to Evil)

objects.text:
You are a Hero! One of the few who have accomplished the legendary feat of defeating a Demon Lord and saving the world. With this, you gain the skills and equipment worthy of a Hero! Each Hero possesses unique powers, skills, and items—whether it be Sword, Spear, Magic, or Return, you may choose any Hero from the series and inherit their abilities.

But why stop at just one? Now, you can challenge other worlds and become their Hero as well! Enter a simulated world based on any Hero from the series and go on a quest to defeat that world’s Demon Lord. Since these are simulations, death is impossible, and you have some control over the world itself. While you cannot lower the difficulty, you can increase it for greater rewards or slightly modify the world itself.

Defeating a Demon Lord grants you a basic Hero template. However the greater the challenge, the greater the rewards. Slay a Demon Lord twice as strong as you, and you may earn stronger abilities, powerful items, or companions who can leave with you. If you achieve the impossible—defeating a Demon Lord ten times stronger than you—you will gain a copy of that world as your own personal pocket dimension. 

Time in these worlds runs 1.5x faster than reality, and you can exit and return at any time, like pausing a game. However, you can only challenge one world at a time. Starting a new world means forfeiting the old one.

Your Heroic powers aren’t limited to their world, allowing you to continue growing them as you wish. Also, the Hero of Return’s time loop no longer has its cursed drawback or multiversal range.
objects.title: A Brave Man is back (Hero Has Returned)

addons.text: A Treachery is an anomaly in the laws of physics, created by a obscurant that prevents the laws of the Judgements from applying within a certain area. The Red Science is also capable of enforcing Treacheries through its mysterious practices and devices. It is on these treacheries that the Neath is guarded, effects writ large through vast quantities of the Neathbow, particularly Irrigo to hide the Neath from the sight of the Judgements. The Treachery of Maps can make locations shift and writhe when you aren't looking, allowing seemingly immobile areas, such as ports or islands, to drift location. The Treachery of Clocks can case strange behavior in time and causality writ large, allowing history and memory to be far more mutable than they ought to be, or allowing the same task to render different results; Potentially, one can sit down, take tea with someone, briefly leave to wage a war or two over the course of months or years, then return mid-coversation as though nothing ever happened, their cup still warm. The Treachery of Breath can render death far less permanent, the Treachery of Glass can render dream worlds bleeding into the real, and there are countless others you can discover through your own works.
addons.title: Neathy Treacheries

objects.text:
The Neathbow is an important subject of study, if you wish to learn of the underpinnings of reality, seven colors that dissipate the moment they interact with natural light. These colors can cause a great deal of mental alteration, even to those mighty Judgements in the sky, with sufficient amounts - and much like them, can affect reality with sufficient quantities, causing space and time to break down. Seven different hues exist, each possessing their own effect on the mind. They are as follows.

Irrigo, which robs those exposed of memory, a color of known forgetfulness.
Violant, a color of necessary if unwanted connections and unbidden lingering memories.
Cosmogone, the hue of remembered suns and nostalgia, encouraging growth of flora and fungi alike.
Peligin, the color of the deepest Zee, of mystery, danger, and fear.
Apocyan, the shade of coral, memory of a time beyond, calling the envisioned future to the now in snapshots and visions.
Viric, a hue of the unknown known, the perceived disregarded, and pleasant inattentiveness.
Gant, the color left when all else is eaten, the hue of the End, a hue of existential dread, leaving behind naught but bones. 

Studies in this field are lighter on the ground, as these colors can have a wide, wide range of effects depending on what you're doing with them, though proper application can rewrite a person, and sufficient quantity can warp even the minds of eldritch gods. As an expert with their use, you'll find yourself able to create and utilize large amounts of this color in the form of dyes, paints, inks, even lights. Safe utilization may be a slightly taller ask, given the nature of the Neathbow, but the results speak for themselves, really.
objects.title: The Neathbow (Fallen London)

objects.text: ‘Hey, looks like you’ve died! Fortunately for you, somebody gave you a second chance in the form of becoming a Player in the Reaper’s Game. Actually wait… the Composer just sent word that you’re not to take part in the game, they mentioned something about a CYOA?’ Having died and become a Player, minus the system, you’ve gained Neku Sakuraba’s ability to use various pins found in your world as mediums for reality warping abilities. Viable pins all have a singular ability that are determined by its brand, fashion statement, popularity, and overall build quality. Their potency is also determined the same way, meaning that a homemade pin of Zeus’ thunderbolt that looks like crap might have you be able to give someone a nasty static shock, while the same pin worn on a famous model’s jacket during a runway show would be able to hurl lightning bolts with relative ease. Regardless of how strong a pin is initially, with frequent usage you can level up pins, increasing their singular effect, and decreasing the amount of mental stamina used to active them. Finally once you hit the peak level of a pin, you have the option to evolve it. Evolving a pin can grant a multitude of effects, ranging from a massive increase in potency, to completely changing the original effect of the pin. Upon evolution of a pin, it can be leveled up again, but once it peaks it can no longer be evolved again.
objects.title: Psych Pins (The World Ends With You)

objects.text: "Ink Death is silent, heaven and earth sing his intent." You gain a small portion of the power of Ink Death, the Heavenly Spirit sent to exterminate all life in the Cong Yun Sea. You are capable of sensing, creating, and controlling a pitch black inky substance. This substance contains the property of "total obliteration" as it deletes any matter it touches. You can also expend any supernatural energy you possess to generate and control more of this substance around you. In the beginning, you will only be able to form a couple fish tanks worth of pitch black ink, but this will eventually increase to the level of forming curtains, and waves of ink in a few months of diligent training. After several decades, you will be able to create trillions of specks of ink and wipe entire continents off the map with contemptuous ease. You have total control of any ink you generate regardless of distance. Manually controlling the ink greatly increases the speed it travels, so a multitasking power is recommended. Often, the "total obliteration" offered by the ink is overkill and extremely energy intensive, especially because unlike Ink Death, you do not have the Heavenly Dao providing nigh-infinite energy. Thus, you can dilute your ink in order to create a less absolute but still powerful version. This diluted ink is passively infused into any weapons you use, spells you cast, and powers you manifest. This allows for all of your abilities to have immensely boosted offensive abilities, capable of tearing through substances like endbringer layers like a knife through butter. This infusion does not require any energy. You can also expend energy to infuse your abilities and weapons with non-diluted ink, regaining the total obliteration properties. Individuals who are hit by your ink do not feel any pain, and may not even notice that parts of their body are suddenly missing from coming into contact with your ink. The substance also affects the soul of anything it touches. Whenever you kill an enemy or destroy an object with your ink, their wounds, body, and form dissolve into more of the inky substance, which you can utilize to create an exponentially growing tide of death. By default, your ink takes the form of tiny black particles, falling from the sky like snow or rain. However, this is extremely mutable and you can shift the baseline state to anything you desire. You can (optionally) change the color of the ink from black to something else, but this is only available when purchasing the power unless you have the thematic perk.
objects.title: Executioner of Heaven (My Longevity Simulation)

addons.text: The eyes you possess have combined into a unique existence ordained by the heavens. The purifying power you possess has gained even more perception, allowing you to strike at the deepest depths of unholy creatures, and even if it can’t erase them, it will weaken them considerably. Your ability to manipulate energy has also undergone a profound change: you now have the ability to add a positive element to all energies you possess, granting them increased power against creatures of negative energies. You’ve become a beacon of death to darkness, able to see their weaknesses and gaining awareness of all in your range.
addons.title: Shining Throughout

objects.text:
You possess a bloodline known as The Silver Eyes, originating from another world. The version you possess has mutated from its original form. The Original Silver Eye Bloodline typically only affected creatures of Grimm. The Mutated Form of the Silver Eyes now affects any creature or being that opposes the cycle of life or whatever lifeform you are protecting.

The list of beings affected by the Mutated Silver Eyes is extensive and includes creatures of negative influence, eldritch entities, and supernatural beings similar to Slender Man. The Silver Eyes adapt to whatever threat you face, using Light, Holy, Divine, or Pure Positive Energy to disintegrate weaker creatures or lock stronger ones into a state of absolute stasis.

The stronger a being is, the less effective the Silver Eyes are against them; however, they will still experience considerable pain. The effect of The Silver Eyes can be strengthened through use. The Silver Eyes will be passed down through your family as a hereditary bloodline.

You must think of life and everything you wish to protect to use The Silver Eyes.
objects.title: Silver Eyes (RWBY)

addons.text: Skill Lender is incorporated into your system as a core function, allowing it to manage your skills and powers and also expanding your options during the Seizing Process, which now allows you to drain the experience in place of skill points until your target falls back to level 1, which is the minimum basic state for their age and race. Draining their level will also convert everything it represents into experience points, including things like stats, traits, titles, and similar parameters depending on your system.
addons.title: Level Drain

addons.text: Thanks to the Skill Tree System, your efficiency during the Repayment Process and Seizing Process increased, as any duplicate knowledge and mastery you obtain is converted to research points usable within the system. This also allows you to enable Refinancing during the Seizing Process, which will convert any skill points they obtain into your research points directly, making the target incapable of advancing in any skill until their debt is paid off.
addons.title: Point Conversion

addons.text:
Now traits are treated as a special class of skills which have a static skill point value and both positive and neutral traits are allowed to be used for the contracting process, as traits can’t be learned or trained in normal circumstances they always have to be covered by other skills in the contract for the Repayment Process. Now during the Seizing Process, you will also get the Character Menu of your target allowing you to claim positive and/or neutral traits or even off load your own negative traits to offset the debt.

You are restricted to a single character during the entire process in both loaning and repayment so this can’t be used to move traits between your characters. Albeit you can make separate contracts with the same person using different characters with all contracts processed in chronological order.
addons.title: Trait Acquisition

objects.text:
You gain the ability to lend out your mundane and/or supernatural skills and powers to others via a contract. This includes the secondary power to visualise a mental screen that quantifies all of your skills by skill points, which represents your knowledge and mastery within the skill. The power has three fundamental parts, with each having its own rules:

The Loan Process, where you must establish a verbal and/or written contract with your target, which must include the selected skill(s) to be loaned, the duration, which must be a minimum of 10 days, the rate, which is calculated as compound interest every 10 days, and any optional conditions for the repayment process. The contract will only become active if your target both understands and accepts its conditions.

The Repayment Process, which can be initiated based on the conditions set in the contract, will automatically reclaim the loaned skill(s) and/or power(s), including the interest acquired on the loaned skill. So, for example, a cooking skill with 600 skill points loaned with a 10% interest rate will return a cooking skill with 660 skill points after 10 days. If the target didn’t obtain enough skill points in the loaned skill by training or using it, then the user can engage in the Seizing Process.

The Seizing Process, is the final stage of the contract, which allows the user to bring up a mental screen with the target’s list of skills and powers and their calculated skill point values to select and seize them until the debt of the target is fully paid. This screen will be available as long as there is an existing debt, so even if the target goes “bankrupt” with all of their skills and powers gone, you will be able to seize the skills they learn in the future until the full debt is paid off.

As skill points represent knowledge and mastery, obtaining duplicate skills will have a heavy diminishing return as you are not getting new knowledge besides solidifying your foundation. Lending out skills without the target having the appropriate requirements for their usage can end up with them being incapable of using them. The lending process can also be used as a training tool, as the target will retain memories of using the skill, and any excess skill points they retain will be kept by them, which in some cases even allows others to obtain skills that would be impossible via mundane learning and training.
Finally, in the event of the death of one of your active contracted targets, you will reclaim any skill(s) you invested in their original state without interest.
objects.title: Skill Lender (Gikou Taichi no Torikaeshi ~ Toichi tte Saisho ni itta yo na ~)

addons.text: Perfection is a subjective concept, with each individual holding a unique vision of what it means to be perfect. Yet, for you, achieving a state of ever-evolving perfection is now your destined right. Your vessel exists in a continuous state of flow. You can transform and adapt your form based on anything you've devoured. Instead of laboriously refining a single form to reach transcendence, you can now effortlessly manifest multiple forms, each representing the pinnacle of perfection from your assimilations. Whether you desire the form of a Saiyan composed of Mithril, a Dragon crafted from Demon flesh, or a God Machine woven from Shards, your vessel is perpetually perfect, embodying the zenith of what you have consumed. No matter what you devour your vessel can never be overwhelmed.
addons.title: Perfection is in the Eye of the Beholder

addons.text: Your ability to fuse anything you devour has reached a new level. Previously, assimilating and fusing esoteric elements like SCPs, Psychics, or Magics was challenging, but not anymore. Now, you can effortlessly combine anything you've consumed and utilize it through your vessel. Whether it's fusing materials like Vibranium and Orichalcum, or merging powers such as Quirks and X-genes, your assimilation will know no limit. Even psychic techniques and magical abilities can be seamlessly integrated, making you a master of fusion.
addons.title: Adept Devourer

addons.text: You no longer merely wield the power of a dimensional devourer; you now embody the very concept of Devour, born from the insatiable desires of a million worlds. As a Living Concept of Devour, you exist beyond your physical vessel. Even if your body and soul are destroyed, your metaphysical existence ensures your return. As long as there is a dimension or reality where the concept of Devour exists, you have a chance to be revived. This resurrection could take days, centuries, or even millennia, depending on the manner of your death but you will always claw your way back. Only those with the power to affect the multiverse or the ancient beings beyond reality can truly lay you low.
addons.title: Living Concept

addons.text: You are the predator of gods, able to devour divine powers with extraordinary ease. Divine spells merely feed you, empowering you as you consume them. Godly powers become your sustenance, further enhancing your strength. By completely devouring gods, you can absorb their divinity and domains, making their powers your own.
addons.title: Devour the Divine

objects.text: Embrace the essence of Zakranaid, a unique entity born to consume every dimension in its quest for transcendence. As a Dimensional Devourer, you can absorb and integrate matter, energy, and organic life. Everything you consume is analyzed and merged into your own being. However, mindless devouring and assimilation of matter, energy, or life forms can overwhelm or even shatter your vessel. Thoughtful integration is essential. By skillfully layering matter, energy, and organisms, you can forge the ultimate vessel capable of true transcendence. Consuming the same objects repeatedly will inevitably lead to diminishing returns. But over time, your capabilities may even extend to devouring metaphysical or conceptual entities. With time and effort you can achieve anything with this power. Set forth and consume the very stars!
objects.title: Dimensional Devourer (I Am The Sorcerer King)

objects.text:
Like Kamen Rider Decade, you can create Aurora Curtains—ripples that connect two points in space and time.

With this power, you can open portals, allowing yourself and others to travel instantly between locations without range limitations. These portals can even facilitate travel to different universes, parallel worlds, or through time.

The Aurora Curtains also protect from temporal alterations, enabling users to act as "time capsules" within the multiverse, safeguarding them from changes in the timeline.

However, be careful. Overuse of this power can lead to mental instability, such as amnesia, or, worse, trigger a convergence of worlds, where multiple realities are forcefully fused, causing unintended disasters.

These risks can be mitigated or even entirely avoided with proper training and mastery.
objects.title: Aurora Curtain (Kamen Rider)

objects.text:
In the hand of your choosing now resides a mysterious power called Imagine Breaker.

While it has no effect on your own abilities, when your chosen hand, and Imagine Breaker within it, comes into contact with any supernatural phenomenon, no matter its origin, it will completely nullify it. In truth, this is not so much a nullification, but instead returning the portion of the world, affected by the supernatural phenomenon, to its natural state.

This power has a few limitations. First, sufficiently powerful or sustained attacks may be too much for Imagine Breaker to erase all at once, so be careful when trying to nullify enemy spells. And second, while some phenomena may seem supernatural, they may very well be an organic part of the world, as such, Imagine Breaker would have no effect on them. For example, souls will not be destroyed by the contact with Imagine Breaker, as they are a natural part of the world, even while appearing to be supernatural in origin.
objects.title: Imagine Breaker (Raildex)

addons.text:
World Rejecter has merged with the Holy Right. When Holy Right is active, it can exile anything and anyone to the New World, without any conditions or range limitation.

The New World itself is now under your complete control. You can reshape it however you desire, segregate the space within to keep the exiles separate, adjust the passage of time and refresh rate, travel to and from it freely, even bring others with you, and much more.
addons.title: God's Garbage Bin

objects.text: Inside your right hand now lies a mysterious power, born from the crystallisation of the hopes and dreams of all magicians to leave the current world behind and escape to the new one, known as the World Rejecter. To activate it, the following two conditions must be fulfilled. First condition: the target must itself possess or be created by someone with conflicting desires in their heart. Second condition: any part of the target must be within the range determined by the length of the World Rejecter user's right hand's shadow. Upon activation, the target can be sent to the New World, a spare region of the universe's timeline which reflects the current state of the world—with the exception of any living beings—and updates once every 24 hours. Nothing exiled to the New World, no matter how powerful, can ever escape back into or affect the real world. Due to the nature of this power, godlike beings who possess in their hearts desires for a new world will be greatly tempted to let themselves be banished if they see the World Rejecter in action and know of its power, being drawn to it like moths to a flame.
objects.title: World Rejecter (Raildex)

addons.text:
Your mastery over Smart Atoms has dramatically expanded your Sub-Atomic Manipulation. By combining direct matter manipulation with programmable Smart Atom systems, you can now create self-sustaining constructs, living technologies, adaptive materials, and automated reality-altering effects that continue functioning without your constant focus.

You may permanently encode transformations, commands, and behaviors into matter itself, allowing your creations to evolve, self-repair, react to stimuli, and replicate complex powers or phenomena automatically. This grants far finer control over your abilities, massively reducing the mental strain and precision normally required for large-scale transmutation.

Your understanding of Smart Atoms also greatly accelerates the growth of your powers, helping you bypass many of the limitations Atom Eve originally faced. Organic manipulation becomes vastly easier to understand and safely perform, while your energy constructs, self-modifications, and matter creation become more stable, versatile, and efficient.

At higher levels, the fusion of these powers allows you to create technology and phenomena virtually indistinguishable from magic, including dimensional constructs, artificial superpowers, autonomous living creations, and programmable laws of physics.
addons.title: The Smartest Atom

objects.text:
You have gained the same modifications that granted Atom Eve her powers. Through this power, you are granted complete mastery over matter at the subatomic level and your mind becomes hyper-optimized to best use this power. This means you can modify existing matter to whatever you can imagine and even convert the very air around you acting as a form of pseudo-reality warping. Your body will subconsciously optimize itself and you can heal yourself at command or even subconsciously should you be about to die of injury or age. In addition, you wield the extraordinary power to mould pure energy into tangible constructs of solid light, limited only by the bounds of your imagination. Your powers at the start will be limited in the range and size you may affect but may grow without limits with use and practice.

However, like Atom Eve your powers are at first limited to non-organic matter, being unable to affect living beings such as animals or people. Should you be pushed to your limit and about to die, this limit will break, removing your previous limits on organic matter.
objects.title: Subatokinesis (Invincible)

addons.text:
Your Personal World has fused with your Starborn physiology's need to gather the Artifacts to grow in power, now generating it’s own Artifacts. Allowing you to only need to explore your Personal World to gather them and using the Armillary in your Personal World won’t change your universe but will instead also power up your Personal World on top of yourself.

The change might be subtle or large depending on what you need, but just going through the Unity once will double the speed of helpful modifications your Personal World makes for you. With every other run gaining diminishing return, it might also start making new planets for you to explore.
addons.title: Explore the Universe? That is for fools.

objects.text: You have started your journey to become a Starborn, someone who explores the universe in search of the Artifacts in exchange for powers linked to the stars. You start as a maxed Starborn with abilities such as Solar Flare, Anti-Gravity Field, or even the ability to see the future by looking into alternate universes. However, you can still become stronger as a Starborn but is no easy task, requiring you to find at least 24 Artifacts that will be scattered throughout the universe of the world you go to, as well as find temples linking to these artifacts to boost your powers. (Note, depending on the universe you go to, the Artifacts might only be on a single world; it is up to you to decide.) You also get the bonus of a Tier 10 Starborn Suit and Starborn Ship called the Star Guardian, with the ability to go even further beyond by going through the Unity. The Ship and Suits are affected by OoP Upgrades. Gathering those artifacts requires skills and know-how, which you now have in the form of a maxed-out Starfield Character, even including Starborn powers. (You also get a watch that lets you look at your vitals, stats, map, and everything in between.) While you can get endlessly stronger by gathering the artifacts, each time they are gathered you need to use either your ship or a high-tech table that you have the blueprint for and put the gathered artifacts, called the Armillary once assembled, and then use your ship's FTL drive, called the Grav Drive, to go to the next alternate world by passing through the Unity, where you can repeat what you have already done but everything will be slightly off. Maybe Ruby from Team RWBY is now the main villain of the world, maybe Salem is now a good guy, or maybe the cities are slightly shifted to the left; there is no way to tell until you explore. If you have a power that lets you visit another world or the Homecoming Perk, passing through the Unity can result in sending you to a different world that has been fiction for you. The ship now comes with a small slot where the physical medium of those media can be inserted to go there once you finish a journey. Note. To get higher-tier Suit and Ship, you need to pass through the Unity multiple times; each time those objects get stronger. (Unity is what is called using the Armillary to go to an alternate world.)
objects.title: Starborn (Starfield)

addons.text: You can gather energy from the negative emotions other people have towards you and use them to enhance any powers you possess. The collected energy will crossover to the past even if you were unknowingly in a time loop or reset to a past version of yourself.
addons.title: Gatherer of Hate

addons.text: Instead of gaining energy from only negative emotions towards you, you can also gather energy from any kind of emotion aimed at you. From love to hate, fear to revere, or even guilt to glee. So long as the person has some kind of emotion towards an identity you possess you will obtain energy from them. This functions anywhere, even in alternate universes.
addons.title: Hope Orb

objects.text: The more hated and cursed you are, the healthier and longer you will live. You are also capable of giving longevity and healing to others. This effect applies even if people do not know your true identity, for example through a social media account. If you possess any medical or healing abilities, they will be enhanced. Grudge Orb can turn subpar healing and strengthen it to cure all kinds of diseases and wounds from minor illnesses to even serious cancers.
objects.title: Grudge Orb (Infinite Regressor)

addons.text:
Through the power of Master of Words, you have the option to manifest the content of words through spoken manifestations as a source of invocation without needing to carry a book or the medium they originate from. Meanwhile, Unified Language ensures that anything you invoke is bound to your soul and completely loyal; you may revoke this domination at will, and if it ever becomes dangerous or turns against you, it will automatically submit to you.

Additionally, thanks to the effects of Master of Words, new categories have opened for Silvertongue to operate in:

Place: Able to manifest the building or environment described in the story and adapt it into reality as if it had always existed. From a simple wooden house from a children’s tale to possibly the mysterious fog from a horror story.

Phenomenon: Able to summon all anomalies produced by the environment or reality itself. From a tsunami taken from a natural disaster movie to the anomalous behavior of human society sourced from a horror film.

Trait: Able to extract and bestow upon yourself or others the inherent qualities of a particular story along with its rules and limitations. For example, bringing in the characteristic magic of Harry Potter, obtaining the powers of a particular anime or video game, and other such things. This does not grant knowledge or experience to master the trait you manifest; at best you will be a novice with a decent level of control.

All new categories depend directly on your proficiency as a Master of Words in terms of efficiency, range, and potency.
addons.title: Author’s Authority

objects.text:
You’ve possess the incredible power to make words come to life. 

You’ve gained the ability to read things into reality by reading out loud. This can range from inanimate objects to characters, even fictional ones.

You’ve also gained the ability to throw things into stories, you merely need to touch the thing in question in order to do this, or you can read aloud a written passage where the person enters the story. Character’s significantly more powerful than you can resist being thrown into stories if they don’t wish to go. Anything tone banished into a story can be taken out without needing the story or reading, only needing intention.  

When things are summoned into the real world, they are summoned in one of four ways, which method you may toggle at will. 

The first is they are summoned as the author imagined, regardless of any other possible interpretation others may have had.

The second is how you imagine them regardless of other interpretations or even the author’s, the third is the general consensus of how an audience imagines them, and the final is how the world at large perceive them as.

The stories do not need to be famous stories, nor even complete ones. They can be derived from nothing more than children’s short scribble, notes on the edges of a novel, a few sentence on a napkin, and more.

Moreover, you can make edits to the story by writing out your own sections and/or replacing pages, allowing you to alter what you draw out.

You can enter stories at will, when doing so the world outside seeming to stop until you come back unless you’d wish otherwise. This allows you to potentially spend years inside a story. 

Destroying the source of where items or characters were taken out of does not hurt or destroy the derived summons. Altering the sources or pages does not alter something if it has already been summoned.

You can summon multiple instances of you wish. When/if you send them back you can choose to send them back to the very moment they were taken from, and revert them to the state they were in before their summoning, memories and all. 

This power comes with a mental on/off switch, moreover you’ll never summon or banish something you didn’t intend to.

Overtime you’ll need to read out loud less and less to have the power work properly, eventually becoming capable of just reading it in your mind or remembering it, and in time not even needing that. 

This power will naturally extend to other forms of media such as movies and even oral stories over time, eventually no longer needing even media at all, capable of drawing it directly from imagination. 

Your power is limited solely to the summoning/banishment, you have no control or innate protection over them after their arrival, so be wary of potentially summoning something hazardous to your health.
objects.title: Silvertongue (Inkheart)

objects.text:
Your soul has fundamentally changed and is now rooted in quantum mechanics, specifically the Schrödinger's Cat thought experiment.

Because of this transformation, you can exist in multiple states at once, being everywhere and nowhere until observed. This allows you to be anywhere unobserved and only appear at a specific point when someone observes you. This includes observing yourself. In practice, you can instantly teleport between unobserved locations and disappear when not seen. You can even appear in dreams and people's mindscapes. Since your existence is tied to your self-awareness, as long as you believe you are somewhere, you will be there. If you believe you are alive and uninjured, you will remain so regardless of any physical harm.

Your entire being hinges on the idea of "I think, therefore I am," making your presence both absolute and non-existent, determined solely by your consciousness. This grants you a form of pseudo-immortality and prevents you from being conventionally killed, but you can still be permanently killed if someone attacks your soul, consciousness, or mind, so be careful.

You have direct control over your beliefs regarding yourself, capable of shifting it on a moments notice to directly control your power.

Even if your physical body is destroyed, you can manifest elsewhere without issue due to your soul's changed nature. Despite being able to appear in different places, there is only one of you; you cannot split into multiple selves or create duplicates.
objects.title: Everywhere and Nowhere (Hellsing)

addons.text:
You’ve got your work cut out for you, eh? 

With your ring aligned to the white light of life, as you master the emotional spectrum, you’ll also need to master the usage of their host. For instance, while mastering the Orange light of Avarice, you’d need to also wrangle an understanding and utilisation of the Ophidian. 

This will put exceptional strain on your body and mind as you learn, but at the end of it, you’ll be the Quintessential, The Avatar of the Entity, embodiment of the White Light of Creation.
addons.title: Entity Mastery

objects.text:
The Emotional Entities are the sentient embodiments of emotions within the Emotional Electromagnetic Spectrum, one of the seven fundamental forces of the universe. Each entity is tied to a specific emotion and linked to its respective Lantern Corps, which channels the power of these emotions. The entities include The Butcher (anger), Ophidian (greed), Parallax (fear), Ion (will), Adara (hope), Proselyte (compassion), and the Predator (love). These beings draw upon the emotional energy of all sentient life in the universe, granting them vast, nearly limitless power.

As a host for one of these Emotional Entities, you become an immortal being, unaffected by the passage of time and permanently connected to your corresponding emotion. While your bond doesn't overwhelm you with the entity's emotion, you are still inclined to it, such as feeling angrier as a host for the Butcher or more compassionate as a host for Proselyte, but to a manageable degree.

This bond grants you infinite access to that emotional power, such as infinite willpower as a host for Ion, allowing you to wield abilities on a scale far beyond those of the Lanterns and their rings. You can generate and manipulate emotional energy without limits, performing feats like reigniting dead stars back into blue stars as a host for Adara or even altering reality itself, depending on the nature of your emotional entity.
objects.title: Emotional Avatar (DC Comics)

addons.text:
Your portals aren’t just linked to space and dimensions anymore. Rather, by mixing with the X-Gene, you have the power of Reggie Macnair, portals that are completely temporally independent. 

As well as their regular abilities, your portals can let you move across time with incredible ease, easily dropping decades into the past or as fine as a few minutes. During the Age of Revelation, RIft used this power to infinitely repeat a single mission to get a perfect result.

Additionally, your portals aren’t limited to your fingertips, being able to create multiple hundreds of meters away large enough to move a fleet from river to river across the continental United States.
addons.title: Rift (Marvel: X-Men)

objects.text:
Much like Derek James, you can create dimensional rifts in space-time from your fingertips. These rifts let you connect any two locations you’ve seen (though they can be used blind at great risk), even across universes, and move through them at will. Additionally, these rifts can either be transparent or opaque, letting you look through them like windows.

Unlike the centre, the edges of your rifts are indestructible, capable of being used as both barriers and active weapons, able to cut through solid material. Additionally, causing two portals to overlap results in a microscopic black hole, which will usually immediately collapse and, in turn, cause a massive and unstable explosion.
objects.title: Sideways (DC Comics)

addons.text: Your affinity for Negativity and Death has greatly enhanced your ability to wield Stasis. You can create and wield gargantuan quantities of Stasis with no worry for safety, for your connection to Negativity shields from its detrimental effects. Your ability to create and wield Stasis will only grow with time and as you absorb more Negativity, until eventually your strength and skill with Stasis can rival Toross Mordal, the person who scared the Gods so much they abandoned the planet and fled to another world entirely. Possessing Avatar of Negativity causes you to start on Toross’ level and you’ll only grow stronger from there.
addons.title: Essence of Destruction

objects.text:
You’ve formed a connection with the very concept of Negativity. 

You have a strong affinity for magics aligned with Negative attributes such as Darkness, Death, and Evil, and you can imbue your attacks with Negativity for extra umph, especially against Positive aligned beings. The enhancement of your attacks scales with your Negativity. Furthermore, you can conjure a personalized weapon which amplifies powers associated with Negativity and can shift forms to match your needs. 

Your presence passively amplifies Negative emotions and you can choose to actively project Negative emotions onto others, twisting and corrupting their emotions and thought processes. Furthermore, you gain power from the presence of Negativity, which combined with your ability to project Negative emotions can drown an entire world in Negativity if left unchecked, although feats on that level would take time and be very obvious. Lastly, you can project your vision or teleport yourself and others to anywhere within your range which contains Negativity, providing a means of transportation and a way to accurately target a location.

These powers don’t come without a cost, however. Positivity is very bad for you, with the mere presence of Positive emotions being uncomfortable and slowly leeching your strength. Substances and attacks imbued with Positivity are harmful to you to the point of being caustic. Even feeling Positive emotions is difficult, your mind subconsciously suppressing and avoiding them.
objects.title: Essence of Darkness (Undertale: Dreamtale)

addons.text: Your affinity for Positivity has synergized with and enhanced your ability to wield the Holy Light. Firstly, your Holy Factor is ridiculous in strength, capable of matching and surpassing most Angels, although the truly powerful remain beyond you. Secondly, you can treat Positivity and Holy Light as roughly the same thing, with anything you imbue with Positivity counting as Holy and anything Holy counting as “Positive.” With this, you gain power from the presence of Holy energy and can imbue anything with Holy power, turning any weapon into a lesser Holy Weapon. Lastly, you can use Holy Light to shield yourself from the effects of Negativity, remaining strong and Positive even while surrounded on all sides by Negativity so long as your Light remains strong. Should you possess Avatar of Positivity then the effects of this are magnified even further, with a Holy Factor rivaling the Archangels at the minimum, capable of turning random sticks into Holy Weapons on par with Excalibur and being effectively immune to any and all Negativity so long as your Light remains strong.
addons.title: Light of Positivity

addons.text:
Well, this is odd. Congratulations, you’ve done something thought to be impossible and formed a connection with both Positivity and Negativity. By all means, you should either be in constant pain or a raving lunatic whose mind is torn into pieces, but you’re not. 

You longer have any vulnerability to either Positivity or Negativity; in fact, your affinity for them is even greater than before, even being able to mix them together into a paradoxical energy that is simultaneously both and neither. You have also gained an affinity for all magics related to Balance.
addons.title: Guardian of Balance

addons.text: You have taken in the Father’s Light and made it yours. Firstly, the boost in strength you gain from the presence of Positivity grows by several orders of magnitude to rival the enhancement your Light would give, and it stacks with your Light such that you can double up on boosts and become a veritable juggernaut which outstrips even a manifested Prime Soul. Secondly, your Light and Positivity share traits, such that your Light counts as “Positive” and things imbued with Positivity experience a growth in power a bit less than if it was imbued with your Light, although again it can be stacked with your Light for an even greater boost. Additionally, your Light benefits from the more flexible nature of your Positivity, allowing it to be imbued into objects and even other people to enhance them similar to how you and your abilities can be enhanced. Lastly, you passively produce your own Light, ensuring that you can never run out of it. However, if you recklessly use your Light for literally everything you could still outpace your passive production. Of course, if you were to possess Avatar of Positivity then your production would be so absurd that it would take entire universes worth of Light to even begin to overcome your passive Light production.
addons.title: Your Light

objects.text:
You’ve formed a connection with the very concept of Positivity. 

You have a strong affinity for magics aligned with Positive attributes such as Light, Life, and Good, and you can imbue your attacks with Positivity for extra umph, especially against Negative aligned beings. The enhancement of your attacks scales with your Positivity. Furthermore, you can conjure a personalized weapon which amplifies powers associated with Positivity and can shift forms to match your needs.

Your presence passively amplifies Positive emotions and you can choose to actively project Positive emotions onto others, lifting their spirits and soothing their emotions and thought processes. Furthermore, you gain power from the presence of Positivity, so combined with your ability to project Positive emotions, you can spread Positivity to an entire world if left unchecked, although feats on that level would take time and be very obvious. Lastly, you can project your vision or teleport yourself and others to anywhere within your range which contains Positivity, providing a means of transportation and a way to accurately target a location.

These powers don’t come without a cost, however. Negativity is very bad for you, with the mere presence of Negative emotions being uncomfortable and slowly leeching your strength. Substances and attacks imbued with Negativity are harmful to you to the point of being caustic. Even feeling Negative emotions is difficult, your mind subconsciously suppressing and avoiding them.
objects.title: Essence of Light (Undertale: Dreamtale)

addons.text: You now possess the knowledge needed to create any of the technology shown or even hinted at in Murder Drones, with the sole exception of the Absolute Solver itself. From overpowered railguns to even making Drones of your own, everything seen in the show can be made. To reiterate, you cannot use this to create the Absolute Solver, nor should you even attempt to.
addons.title: JCJenson (IN SPAAAAACEE!!!!)

objects.text: You are now a Worker Drone, an autonomous robot that exhibits human-like qualities, such as feeling and expressing emotions, speech, etc.. You are superior to the average human physically, but not by a large margin. Fortunately (or unfortunately), you have mutated and created a connection to an eldritch vampire-esque program known as the “Solver of the Absolute Fabric”, the Absolute Solver, or simply Solver for short. Being its host, this not only makes you more techno-organic than simply mechanical, but gives you a ‘core’ inside of your chest, able to move, speak and use the powers given by the Absolute Solver should your body be destroyed or be separated from you. Your body has the hardware necessary to use the powers given by the Solver. Along with this, you receive a pocket dimension you can use to store biomass and materials for your powers to use. To start off, you gain the capability to utilize a few powers using the Solver, such as telekinesis, short-range teleportation, moderate regeneration (able to repair your body of major wounds such as missing limbs, open chest cavities, and shattered visors, given a minute or so), and using what’s stored in your pocket dimension, you can grow body parts such as tentacles, wings, or tails. Your most powerful ability of them all, but also the most expensive, is [NULL], the power to create a small black hole capable of expanding and stretching to annihilate any matter it touches. You start off at a level of proficiency similar to Uzi Doorman when she began to come into her Solver abilities. You can become better at this, but overusing your new powers or overexerting yourself may lead to overheating. Furthermore, the Absolute Solver program still remains inside of you, and will attempt to slowly take over your body should you continue to show weakness to it. Finally, to go along with your vampiric theming, you bear a moderate weakness to heat and light. Exposure to sunlight on a casual level will make the exposed parts sizzle up enough to be uncomfortable, and heat roughly equal to atmospheric reentry can melt your core in seconds if you don’t have something to protect it. You can survive in an Earth-like climate, but colder climates will serve you better. Consuming liquids such as blood or oil will also help in cooling you off. Additionally, you require your hands in order to make use of most of the powers given by the Solver, so losing them will render you effectively powerless until you regenerate them. While you can run the Solver with your current body’s hardware, you will be unable to perform any form of ability or feat at a continent or planet-busting level. Not without gazing into the digital abyss and surrendering to the Solver program, that is.
objects.title: Solver Drone (Murder Drones)

objects.text: Perhaps you have heard urban legends about a slender man? Well, now you know more about him than anyone else. You have combined several common versions of Slender Man without their shortcomings. Now, you have become a disturbance upon the fabric of reality. You can change your form on a large scale, from a faceless alien predator to a multidimensional being and a memetic virus. You are a manifestation beyond comprehension, existing in realms untouched by the laws of nature. While you dwell outside the confines of ordinary reality, you are resistant to the typical assaults of humanity, such that only esoteric or conceptual weapons and effects may harm or affect you. You possess the ability to teleport at will, either vanishing in a haze of static that overwhelms all senses or instantly teleporting with no warning, traversing time and space to any location that you have marked, in your line of sight, or have personally been through. You can weave your influence through emotions with a mere thought, or reshape identities at your whim, bending the will of those you encounter until they become mere extensions of yourself, and more. Either a proxy for yours to play with or something more sinister. You can even enter dreams and sculpt them as you would a mind in the waking world. Reality itself distorts in your presence, violently unmaking and scarring the landscape around you. You have no control over this ability at first, but time and effort can grant you mastery over it and allow you to disable it if you desire. Achieving mastery over your distortions lets you do a myriad of effects, from an overwhelming sense of dread and a static haze upon all senses; resurrecting the dead, to outright tearing an entire planet apart. This is very difficult to resist, as you are not just warping reality, but completely and utterly violating it on a conceptual level. Finally, you are aware of all beings who have knowledge of you, regardless of how little it may be or if it is merely in their subconscious. You know where they currently are at all times and their surrounding location, and can choose to teleport within a 50-meter radius relative to the being you're attempting to teleport to. You will not be affected by information overload, no matter what, as a testament to your nature as a hole in reality. You've essentially become the embodiment of the Slenderman concept. You have the abilities of all relatively well-known versions of Slenderman in your original world, including famous fanfiction, in your arsenal. Be the Administrator who controls the plot of the world, walk around as an Operator from Marble Hornets, take the form of the embodiment of fear of obscurity from Fear Mythos, and much more. If there is any existing Slenderman or Slenderman-like figure in your chosen Earth, you can choose to replace them, retroactively or otherwise; turn them into an extension of yourself; erase them at the time of your insertion; or just leave them be. If any were to be created after your insertion, then they'll merely become extensions of yourself.
objects.title: Der Ritter (Creepypasta Mythos)

objects.text:
You have become an Ender, someone who possesses a fragment of the Origin Essence of Miracle, one of the three absolute laws of Mount Sumeru.

Hosting this fragment grants you a powerful Authority uniquely suited to you and your journey. No one else could wield this Authority better than you.

In its early stages, an Authority may manifest as tremendous talent in a particular field, such as martial arts, a powerful bloodline, or a physique suited to a specific style of cultivation. However, the true scope and scale of your Authority is not limited to something so simple.

Some known Authorities include Truth Attainment, which allows one to accelerate toward a chosen goal more quickly the more distant and impossible that goal is, bending reality to force that goal to come to pass; Causality Induction, which imposes one’s desired cause and effect upon a target; Truth Manipulation, which turns lies into truth; Paradise Guide, which leads others toward the realization of their ideals; and Bridle Creation, which creates and manipulates laws.

You may either create a custom Authority and its related talent, or select one of the canon Authorities and adapt its related talent as your own.

Because you are not going to Mount Sumeru, you are not bound by an immutable fate, nor do you need to worry about the Future King. You may freely tell others about your abilities.
