objects.title: Ender (A Regressor's Tale of Cultivation)

objects.text:
Binding Vows are powerful contracts that grant benefits in exchange for following specific rules or restrictions, either self-imposed or agreed upon with others.

A self-imposed vow allows a person to place limitations on their self, in exchange for stronger power or relaxed restrictions in return. By limiting how, when, or even if certain powers can be used, they receive a benefit—yet, true to the principle of equivalent exchange, the vow must be fair or even unfavorable to the one who makes it. You can’t just restrict your right hand and expect to gain the power to punch the sun. 

For example, a person can reveal how their powers work to an opponent in exchange for increasing that power’s strength. There’s no limit to how much one can gain from these vows—creative and imaginative vows can grant extraordinary power, as long as you're willing to accept the right limitations. However, breaking a self-imposed vow results in the loss of any advantage gained through the contract.

Binding Vows can also be made with others, either as part of a trade or to ensure both parties uphold an agreement. These vows bind both individuals and can only be created or dissolved by mutual agreement. Breaking a Binding Vow with another person will cause severe repercussions for the oath-breaker. Although the terms of the contract must be honored, it is possible to trick them; for example, you could promise to kill someone, but you can immediately revive them after without breaking the terms.

Binding Vows remain in effect indefinitely unless they are broken or include a clause that ends them.
objects.title: Binding Vow (Jujutsu Kaisen)

addons.text:
Upon activating Boogie Woogie, you gain a mental image of every possible target you can switch with. This is represented as soundwaves that travel throughout the area, highlighting potential targets with a glowing orb. 

As a bonus, you can take all the time you need to decide your switch target. This process always happens within a fraction of a second in real time.
addons.title: Resonance

objects.text:
You have the ability to switch the position of two people by clapping. The range on this ability is dependent on how loud your claps are. If someone can hear it, then they are applicable to teleported. Don't worry about deaf people, they will still count as in range if they could hear it as if they weren't deaf. This works on anything with energy, like lifeforce, magic, or anything else.

 If you want to jump someone, this power is the tool for the job.
objects.title: Boogie Woogie (Jujutsu Kaisen)

addons.text:
You and your stick figures have been bestowed a mighty gift from Alan Becker himself; The Minecraft Game Icon. To prevent disasters to your living space and/or computer, it has been significantly nerfed but can still reach the capabilities once showcased by its wielders.

Anyone with your expressed permission can gain the abilities of a Minecraft character by touching the block. Whether that is permanent, temporary, conditional, or otherwise is your choice.

If you have Creative Mode or other additions, then the Icon scales to allow others that power as well. As the Admin, you can summon and dismiss the Icon from an exclusive pocket space, are fully aware of everyone with access to this power, and may toggle their capabilities at will.

You also gain King Orange's staff to properly wield the block and know how to forge perfect replicas of it.
addons.title: Animation vs Minecraft

addons.text: Another of Alan's gifts have been given to you, this time as a boost that gives you an immense growth rate in studying Educational Laws and Concepts. From anything related to Math, Science, Geography, English, Coding, etc. You will rapidly gain professor level knowledge and understanding about your chosen subject until you've completely mastered it, with perfect memory, skill, and intuition to apply it. The one caveat is that you must be specific about your subject. Instead of simply "Science", you must study one of its fields like Chemistry or Biology. Broader ones like "Math" you can study all the topics for, but you'll need "Physics" to grasp ones like Thermodynamics, Optics, Relativity, etc. You can freely bestow and take away powers gained from these concepts through your stick figures, or others.
addons.title: Animation vs Education

addons.text:
Who said you could only create sentient stick figures? You're a master-class artist who can make your creations come to life! Use it to your heart's content!! Draw that character, fantasy creature, legendary artifact, or whatever else you've always wanted and bask in their glory!!!

This extends beyond just aesthetic changes to your little friends, as many quality of life changes such as speech also follow suit. Your once stick figures can now be fully realized/stylized humans, creatures, or objects and shapeshift into any of these forms at will or for your preference. 

They will also gain lesser powers and characteristics based on their current form, with some bonus ones if it just so happens to align with their "Name".
addons.title: Brushogun

addons.text: Another blessing from Alan Becker falls onto your lap, granting your stick figures the ability to travel to and from the Outernet. A plane that exists parallel to The Internet, where other stick figures and other creations from websites like Newgrounds, YouTube, Twitter, Twitch, Reddit, etc. live and thrive within multiple civilizations. From entire cities of futuristic marvels, rural villages, warp spaces that connect to other computers and devices across the internet, and more. Like your creations, the inhabitants of these websites have their own individualism and character. From a guy making a living selling corn dogs to the YouTube website having sentience, the various icons of social media sites coming to life and being interactable, etc. This effect is now present within your computer or equivalent devices connected to the Datumplane, allowing your stick figures and you — via your mouse and keyboard — to interact with your digital space in a whole new light. Playing a game like Pokemon, League of Legends, or Minecraft can result in the beings from them gaining the same level of sentience as your stick figures, make the items from their respective sources real, create or discover the worlds they live in, and change how you interact with your mundane activities. Such as your stick figures assisting you in writing a document or spreadsheet by physically interacting with the program in nuanced ways that create amazing results in less time than normal, to using the applications on your device as Objects of Power. The possibilities are truly endless.
addons.title: The Outernet

addons.text:
It seems that your ability to create Stickmen — combined with your own Stickman-like traits — has resulted in an unexpected synergy. It grants you a unique ability: you can transform into any Stickman you’ve either created or physically touched (assuming, of course, you manage to find one not made by you).

By default, you have three slots where you can store Stickman templates for future transformation. You can switch forms at will by selecting one of the saved templates, though switching between slots takes one full minute during which you must avoid sudden movements. With time, training, and practice, you can reduce this transformation delay and even unlock additional slots.

When transformed into a Stickman, you fully inherit their powers, combat skills, knowledge, and intuitive understanding. If the Stickman were your own creation, you’d gain full access to everything they knew and could do. For Stickmen made by others, some knowledge may be locked or incomplete.

When you return to your original form, you lose all powers, skills, and knowledge acquired through the transformation. However, with consistent effort and experience, you may gradually retain parts of their skills and understanding. Unfortunately, their powers cannot be carried over in any form.
addons.title: Now I’m a Creation That I Create

objects.text: With access to any writing tool and paper, or even a computer, you can draw and create sentient stick figures. To start, you must first draw them using your medium of preference; secondly, you must declare a "Name" for them. Once declared, your creation will magically come to life. Appearing within the confines of the medium it was created in or somewhere within your vicinity. They are about the size of a mouse at default, but you may adjust their size to no larger than an average human and shrink them back down at any time. They can freely "jump" into and out of paper, computers, and the real world with ease at your discretion. Your creations are fully developed individuals in their own right, complete with their own personalities, quirks, interests, and such. You may have control over their individualism or let them develop on their own; either way, their loyalty to you is absolute as their creator. They will by default possess the full package of superhuman characteristics across the board, enough to surpass the average athlete. You can communicate seamlessly with them and they with each other through telepathy. The "Names" of your stick figures must be no longer than 3 words at most--and cannot be changed afterwards. These names bestow them with additional characteristics and powers to match, alongside any complementary, secondary, tertiary, and other ones that logically fit. You may skew these to fit your vision in anyway you wish. For example, naming a stick figure "Red" can potentially result in one of many archetypes; a hot-headed brawler, a pyrokinetic, or a blood-bender. While a more specific name such as "The Dark Lord" will imbue them with the potential to become a "Formidable Warlock", "Ruler of the Underworld", "King of Evil" and all that such a title can entail. But starting at the most basic level.
objects.title: The Animator (Animator vs Animation)

objects.text:
You get access to the Toolbar, a meta-conceptual interface that brings together a variety of unique tools designed to solve a variety of problems. Each tool has a unique design and functionality, reminiscent of professional tools used in graphic editors like Photoshop or other specialized apps. The effects of each tool are absolute, constant and predictable.

The bar is visualized on your left wrist as a compact interface that allows you to instantly switch between tools. At any given time, it can contain up to six active tools that you can use immediately. Initially, you get six basic tools: Selection, Moving, Lasso, Brush, Healing and Pause. These tools cover a wide range of basic tasks.

The Toolbar supports customization to your individual needs. You can add, replace or delete tools, tools for your needs. Over time and depending on your needs, the bar will expand, providing access to new tools designed to solve more complex problems. This ability to grow and be flexible makes Toolbar a versatile tool for any task.
objects.title: Toolbar (Animator vs Animation)

objects.text:
You have gained great insight into a phenomenon called the Observer Effect, which is a phenomenon exclusive to humanity that allows humans to influence and reshape reality based on their cognition.

You have become a superhuman expert in storytelling, psychology, sociology, social media, and memetic propagation. This expertise enables you to actively and effectively harness the Observer Effect as a powerful tool.

You instinctively know what to say and do to sway public opinion and trigger the Observer Effect to achieve your desired outcomes. Additionally, you possess a sixth sense that allows you to predict the consequences of spreading certain ideas, helping you avoid unfavorable results.

The scale of change you can enact depends on how many people believe—or at least acknowledge—the change you are attempting to make. For example, trying to introduce magic into a magicless world would fail initially, as most people would find such a concept too unbelievable. Without collective acknowledgment, the Observer Effect cannot take hold.

Although the Observer Effect typically cannot influence other humans directly, your exceptional insight allows you to bypass this limitation, making both yourself and others susceptible to its influence.
objects.title: The Observer Effect (Hololive)

objects.text:
You gain access to Jobs, which are pretty much Classes and Professions, but instead of only giving access to combat- or work-specific roles, these can be pretty much anything. Examples include Corpse Hauler, Dark Poet, Slime Wrangler, Adventurer, Clumsy Servant, Thief, Petty Chief, Hero, and King, though they’d have to exist in the setting and you’d need to be declared as such. You can choose which Job you have, though only those you’ve met the prerequisites for are available, if you for example didn’t have any magic or know anything about machines, then you wouldn’t be able to become a Mage or a Mechanic. Though you can take your time choosing one if you’d rather try your hand at meeting prerequisites for your desired Job, you can see which Jobs are available to you. Should you be unsatisfied with your current one, you can also change your Job, though that will reset your Level with all relevant Parameters and Skills being lost, with no way to get back the XP and Levels you earned for it.

Levels are how you progress with your Job. By doing Job-related tasks, like delivering mail as a Courier, or cooking as a Cook, you slowly but surely gain eXPerience, the more difficult and unfamiliar the task is, the more XP it gives. Simply going through a normal workday of your Job would give you XP as well, though only doing that would lead to slower leveling than by challenging yourself. You can also gain XP by killing monsters, though for non-combat Jobs it will at most be a replacement for normal work, unless it’s a very high-level monster or a large number of them. Once you’ve accumulated enough XP you level up, increasing Job-relevant Parameters and granting you a new Skill or upgrading an existing one.

Parameters, also known as Stats, are: Health, Attack, Magic, Technology, Swiftness, Intelligence, Education, Social and Charm. Increased Parameters give a boost on top of the ones you naturally possess.

Skills are abilities that assist you in your Job, a Guard might have Skills like Arresting I or Battlestaff I, which help with taking down criminals and give increased competence with the Battlestaff, a Knight would have Swordsman I and a Warrior Sword/Shield II for combat, while a Landlord might have Soilwork or Seeding Crops if they reside over farms, assisting them in planting and caring for crops, with Negotiations to get good deals for their harvests.

While this power does give you a small amount of Magic, it won’t be enough to gain any Magic-related Jobs unless you have other sources for it or do much with it. There will be the odd Skill that doesn’t necessarily fit your Job depending on what else you do, you could gain the Capillamancy Skill for example(A body-enhancement technique that allows hardening your hair and rapidly changing your hairstyle), if you trained it a lot, or Skills and Magic Skills that are at most convenient or Job relevant. Like getting a weapon enhancing skill, a Jumping Skill for someone who is obsessed with jumping or Cleaning Magic for a Janitor. Though you’d still only get those Skills after leveling up and having trained in that direction for quite a while.

You only start with one Job, but you can take on an additional one every 15 levels, though reaching that level would take time, likely a few years. If you split up your Jobs, focusing on two, you’re liable to reach about Lv 30-35 in one and 25-30 in the other at age 50, while focusing on only one would leave you at around Lv 40-50, assuming constant employment with the odd challenges and accomplishments, having more than two jobs is liable to slow down your leveling speed unless you can compensate somehow. While this is the typical amount of time necessary, being reckless, overly talented or competent would accelerate this pace. Lv 25 in a combat-oriented Job would make you about Street-Level, capable of dealing with normal criminals and the odd super-powered one. Other non-combat Jobs at Lv 25 also grant about Street-Level Parameters, though only in Job-relevant Stats. A Courtier would be a low-level Speedster for example, able to run fast and for hours on end. An Accountant meanwhile would be a quick Thinker able to deal with piles of Paperwork in minutes and calculate math in seconds, though they wouldn’t be of much use in combat due to their lack of Stats in that area.

Your Jobs can also change, if you act a certain way, then your Jobs could gain an Adjective in front of them, these will subtly alter the Skills you gain towards that Adjective. A Petty Chief who oversalts their soup might gain a Skill to oversalt it just enough that their customers become annoyed, but not annoyed enough that they’d complain, someone Quick would get Skills to be faster, while an Anti-Human would get Skills specifically designed to combat humans. Promotions or Major Feats can also alter the Job, like an Apprentice Smith becoming a Journeyman, or a Journeyman becoming a Master Smith after managing to complete a very difficult commission, a Guard becoming Head Guard and a Bandit a Bandit Squad Leader. Both Adjectives and Promotions alter Parameters, the former changing where they’re spread, like a Quick one getting more Swiftness, but less Health, while the latter raises them slightly across the board, the increase higher in Job-relevant Parameters.

Finally there’s Titles, Achievements, Attributes and your own Status. You can mentally review your Level, Skills, Parameters, Achievements and Attributes, which are tendencies you have, like Good-Natured, Dull, Poor Talker or Studious. Achievements are accomplishments or reflections of your nature which earn you a Moniker that you can attach to your Title with a ‘the’, though it is a lot easier to earn negative achievements, (like Coward, Liar, Clumsy One) than positive ones. If you’ve got a short temper and earned it as an Achievement, then you could call yourself ‘Name’ the Short-Tempered, and anyone you’re unfamiliar with would use that as your Title, should you ever change it, which you can do at the nearest government office or equivalent, then everyone would change how they addressed you as well. If you have a secret identity, then the Title can be exclusive to that identity.
objects.title: Job (The Dragon, The Hero and The Courier)

addons.text:
You have gained an alternative way to obtain Time. Instead of waiting for people to voluntarily give you Time, you can usurp it by taking another's life.

The amount of Time you gain is equal to the remaining lifespan of the person you kill. Each usurpation grants you a massive amount of Time, and the total Time taken from a hundred people would be enough to give you the power to effortlessly destroy cities. Actively using this Time of hundred people would allow you to perform what ordinary people would consider wonders.

However, there are restrictions. The victim must refuse their Time, otherwise the usurpation is impossible. You could seek out those already on the edge of despair or push them toward it yourself.

Additionally, usurped Time cannot be freely used immediately after acquisition. It requires assimilation, which usually happens passively over the time of a month. However, you can significantly accelerate this process by learning about the history, thoughts, and personality of the person whose Time you have taken.
addons.title: Time Usurpation

addons.text:
Now, you have a Counter in your mind that increases every time you gain a new subscriber. For someone to be considered your subscriber, they must gift approximately one year of Time to you.

Each time the Counter reaches a significant milestone, you receive a Helper—a special servant created to assist in your growth. They can inspire you, provide moral support, and serve you in various ways. Their strength is directly based on the total amount of Time donated to you at the moment the milestone is reached.

Helpers usually take on a humanoid form, but once summoned, their appearance cannot be changed. However, you can choose the form of the next Helper in advance: they could be a weapon, armor, mech, building, or something else.

Each Helper has one primary function (such as a butler, bodyguard, or chef) and two secondary functions that complement their main role. If a Helper is summoned from a world with unique traits, they may gain an extra ability related to that world.

The standard milestones are 100 thousand, 1 million, 10 million, 100 million, and so on. However, you can summon Helpers before reaching these milestones, but they will be exponentially weaker than if summoned at the intended time.

Helpers are fully loyal to you and cannot be turned against you in any way. If a Helper dies, you can resummon them after one day.

Every time you enter a new world, a new Counter is created, allowing you to gain new Helpers unique to that world.
addons.title: Milestone Helpers

objects.text:
You possess the ability to alter reality, but the price is Time—not yours, but that of others.

Anyone who looks at you directly metaphysically "donates" a portion of their Time to you. This does not shorten their lifespan but instead converts Time into a resource you can accumulate and use.

The stronger the observer's emotions, the more Time you receive. A neutral gaze grants a standard amount, but if someone feels genuine admiration or deep hatred for you, the flow of Time increases significantly. This effect extends beyond direct observation—it also works through images, videos, and even thoughts. However, fleeting thoughts about you provide only a negligible amount, whereas deep contemplation grants Time as if the person were watching you directly.

You can use Time in two ways: Actively by altering reality around you. The greater and more complex the change, the more Time is required. The laws of nature are merely a matter of your stored reserves and Passively by gradually enhancing yourself. Your body, mind, abilities, and even your very essence grow stronger simply because others continue to watch and think about you.

Even with a steady influx of Time, your potential is limited by how much you have stored. You must always decide when and how to use it.

In a world where attention is the most valuable currency, this power makes you a being that thrives on fame. An idol, a streamer, a cult figure, or the hated enemy of millions— the more people watch you, love you, or hate you, the stronger you become.
objects.title: Chronophage (SomacGuffin)

objects.text: Your existence has been rewritten to become a living threat to Cyberspace. Now, you are the Virus. Your new state grants you numerous advantages: superhuman strength, speed, durability, and pseudo-immortality, allowing you to resurrect after death given enough time. The only way to truly destroy you is to erase all traces of your data from cyberspace beyond recovery. However, your greatest power lies in your unique abilities, embodying the most infamous and questionable digital patterns found in the depths of the Deep Web. You manifest the traits of shady programs, ranging from piracy and "horny" websites to full-blown malware. For instance, a DDoS attack script could grant you the form of a humanoid war machine, armed with an overwhelming arsenal. A "horny site" template might allow you to duplicate yourself every time you are cut into pieces. Your new state has also bestowed upon you a name that thematically represents your abilities. You can create lesser viral entities from your own blood, though they lack intelligence and behave more like mindless predators. Unlike Algorithm, your powers are not absolute—though they come close. Instead, they grow stronger as you engage in actions that align with your nature. You are the digital world chaos, an unstoppable force that will not rest until everything is colored blue
objects.title: Virus (SomacGuffin)

addons.text:
You are no longer just Algorithm or Virus—you are their coalescence, the perfected union of two opposites made whole. Your origin, your human essence, has been merged with these digital forces, granting you not only absolute conceptual power but also the potential for infinite growth. You are no longer merely a tool of the digital world—you are its rewritten code, the one who changes the rules of the game.

As Algorithm, you possess structure, a defined Category, but now that Category is no longer a limitation—it evolves, absorbing related concepts and expanding beyond its original design. As Virus, you embody chaos and destruction, but no longer in its raw form—now your chaos is controlled, turning weakness into strategy.
Your influence on reality begins subtly. You don’t break systems by force—you embed yourself within them, becoming an integral part of their function. The deeper you infiltrate, the stronger your control grows. Algorithms begin to serve you, viruses become your agents, and the very concepts of the world turn into your tools.

But then comes the rewrite. When your presence reaches its peak, you begin to alter the system from within, reshaping it into something entirely new. You can take a category related to games and force reality to behave like a video game. You can take viral chaos and turn it into a controlled weapon. You do not merely exist in the digital space—you dictate its very form.

You are no longer bound by mere existence. Your body is a shell, housing boundless adaptability. Your form shifts and evolves, reflecting your influence. At your strongest, you may become something even other digital entities fear to comprehend.

You are not just immortal—you are indestructible. Even if erased, you remain within the system, hidden in its code, its whispers, its concepts. Even if the world forgets you, your echo lingers, ensuring that one day, you will return.
addons.title: Trojan

objects.text:
You have received a particle of the power of one of the Servants created by the Cyberspace Creator, and have received a power that reflects a certain category or algorithm of a specific Program. This could be a YouTube algorithm related to the topic of video games, tourism, movies, etc., or a Google Store category: action, business, RPG, etc. Your power is unique: it does not grow over time, but gives access to semi-absolute or conceptual power depending on the prevalence of your concept in the digital space or any of its analogues in your world. 

For example, if you represent the Video Game algorithm, you get the ability to use everything related to this concept: summon characters and weapons from video games, turn into game heroes and use their abilities. Your power is directly linked to the digital network or its analogue in the world of your stay, and its strength fluctuates depending on the popularity of your category. Even in a world without a global Internet, you will connect to the generally accepted understanding of your concept. 

You are immortal, which makes you invulnerable: even if you are killed, you will be reborn after a certain time. However, you can be destroyed forever if the concept you represent is completely eradicated from human consciousness. You are not just a being, but an embodiment of an algorithm or category, which is part of a larger entity, the existence of which depends on its significance and prevalence in the consciousness of people and on the world wide web.
objects.title: Algorithm (SomacGuffin)

objects.text:
You are not what the world assumes you to be. You are an anomaly, a castaway from the intricate design of a larger system. Your “identity” and “existence” resembles that of an NPC but you are an incomplete version. You are a “Rejected Model,” a prototype left unfinished, deemed unfit to fulfill your intended purpose. This isn’t due to any inherent weakness, but rather because you were abandoned before reaching a state of completion. However, what may appear as a limitation is, in truth, a source of extraordinary potential.

Unlike those bound by the rigid framework of the system, you are free. The constraints of “fate” and “preordained roles” do not apply to you. This liberation allows you to bend the rules of reality. You excel at discovering and exploiting “glitches” and “bugs” in the fabric of existence. Reality is a game, and you are a bug capable of taking advantage of its script. Furthermore, abilities that attempt to target or identify you fail because you are not truly “you”—you are a rejected and unofficial version, unrecognized and outside the system’s design.

Your most dangerous ability lies in your connection to alternate versions of yourself. Across the multiverse, there exist completed iterations of you, each one fully formed and embodying the traits you lack. Through your uncanny link to these other “yous,” you can locate them in their respective worlds. Once found, you possess the ability to confront and overpower them. Your incomplete nature gives you an inherent advantage when faced against them; you are unbound and not limited by the same internal rules they follow. 

When you defeat an alternate version of yourself, you can “cannibalize” them, absorbing their unique abilities, traits, or knowledge. For example, one version of you might possess incredible strength, another unparalleled intelligence, and another the power to manipulate fire. By assimilating these traits, you become stronger, more versatile, and closer to perfection, though the process is inherently destructive and unsettling. Your potential is limitless because it is not bound by the same rules that limit everyone else.

While your existence began as a failure, it has become a path to unparalleled freedom and power. You are not what you seem, but that is precisely why you are extraordinary.
objects.title: Rejected Model (MiSide)

objects.text:
"Tear Reality" grants you the extraordinary ability to open rifts in the fabric of existence, creating portals to other places, times, and even alternate universes. Initially, you can access locations within a few miles, allowing for quick movement and tactical advantages. As you hone your skill, your range increases to anywhere on Earth.

With greater mastery, you can travel to alternate timelines where history unfolded differently or the laws of physics have changed. Eventually, you can explore the vast multiverse, experiencing wonders and horrors beyond imagination.

This power also lets you bring elements from these alternate realities into your own. You can summon objects like weapons, tools, or environmental features to aid you. For example, you might bring a weapon from another reality or summon cover during combat.

You can interact with the environment profoundly—unlocking doors, repairing structures, or accessing otherwise unreachable areas by replacing damaged elements with intact versions from other worlds. This facilitates exploration and progression, allowing you to reshape your surroundings.

Your connection to multiple realities grants you heightened temporal awareness. You can perceive events across different timelines, foreseeing potential outcomes and making informed decisions.

Mastering "Tear Reality" requires dedication, as each stage becomes more challenging. Through perseverance, you navigate multiple realities, utilizing the multiverse to your advantage and gaining profound insights into existence.
objects.title: Tear Reality (BioShock Infinite)

addons.text: A subsection of the Celestial Market has opened to you. Within this multidimensional shop, you can purchase items to modify and enhance the P.O.S. system. These include, but are not limited to, additional slots for your traits, games, and save slots, natural and normal traits, as well as XP boosters to help you level up.
addons.title: Abyssal Auction

objects.text:
Congratulations, you are now a Gaming Console Human. You can now become and gain the powers of your favorite gaming characters.

You can transform into these game characters by inserting the cartridges or CDs of your games into a slot in your stomach. These games can range from RPGs and hack-and-slash titles to simulators and puzzle games, as long as they have a single-player campaign. MMOs are not compatible. The slot will always shape itself to match the cartridge or CD that you are inserting. You can hold up to 3 games at any time. If you have any games slotted in, you can interface with any electronic device with a screen through an HDMI cord coming from your skin to play those games. It could be a TV, phone, laptop, or even a calculator. You will always be able to play these games on any device regardless of what they are.

This power will be managed and guided by a system designed to provide vague and minimal assistance. This system will be referred to as the "Power Operating System" or the POS. The POS will offer general, often unhelpful tips and only restate basic, well-known facts about the power’s capabilities. While it won’t cause you harm, it will not actively assist you. It will be up to you to discover the full extent of your power on your own.

You will start as level 1 and can get EXP through life experience, battle, and playing games. The longer and harder a battle or game is, the more EXP you will receive. At the start, you will only be able to gain the power, stats, and abilities of your gaming character.

Leveling up grants you the chance to buy and upgrade traits that will help you. Traits are powers that will enhance your abilities, such as a trait that allows you to summon your gaming character’s equipment or a trait that makes all attacks non-lethal. You can also get traits by completing and 100%ing games. You can only have up to 3 traits active at any given time.

The powers and abilities available to you will depend on two main factors. The first factor is your progression in the respective games. For example, if you choose Fallout 3, your character will start with the level, stats, and perks they have in your current save file from that game. The second is your console level. The more powerful a gaming character is, the higher your console level must be. For example, to access Asura’s Wrath or God of War 3, you must be level 99.

Be warned that connecting certain games may introduce new metaphysical elements that will affect you, which could have both positive and negative consequences for you. For instance, connecting to Spider-Man might grant you the Spider Totem, or linking to Dishonored could give you the power of The Outsider. These natural traits will grant you unique abilities that persist even when you switch games or turn off the system. These traits won’t take up a slot in your Trait list, but they are permanent and cannot be removed, meaning they will permanently affect you in both beneficial and potentially harmful ways.

You will have access to a save and load feature, but with a limitation: you have only one save slot. To create a new save, you must overwrite the existing one. Be aware that powers which manipulate timelines can interfere with this ability, causing harm to you, though they won't completely negate it. If you are nearby in major events that occurs outside of your control such as a triggering event, this can delete your save file, forcing the system to auto-save after the event clears. Loading a save must be done consciously, and when you do, anyone nearby with the ability to see into the future will experience a headache, the source of which they won't be able to identify.
objects.title: Console (Console)

objects.text:
You've been gifted with the extraordinary ability of psychic absorption, the same abilty that allowed Rou to become the world's greatest evil, while starting as a goblin. This power allows you to absorb the traits, powers, and skills of anything you consume. Devour a dragon, and you might find yourself breathing fire. Eat a cheetah, and you could be sprinting at incredible speeds. The possibilities are endless, limited only by what you dare to ingest.

To top it off, you've also been blessed with enhanced jaws and teeth, capable of chewing through  even steel effortlessly. And don't worry about safety – anything consumed is completely harmless. In fact, everything you eat tastes amazing, even if it's a little... unique.
objects.title: Absorption (RE:Monster)

objects.text:
Commandments are both a source of immense power and a binding pact with the cosmos, embodying a user’s will and their willingness to abide by absolute laws. They grant unique and unparalleled abilities that allow their bearers to transcend natural limits, but they do so at the cost of imposing strict conditions that shape the user's existence. For example, Magsarion's Commandment of "No Blood Wasted" ensures that every drop of blood he spills enhances his strength and power. This grants him monstrous resilience and the ability to turn injuries into a source of overwhelming advantage. However, it forces him to continuously endure the agony of battle without reprieve, as the Commandment's nature thrives on constant conflict and bloodshed​.

The advantages of Commandments lie in their transformative potential, turning the wielder into a living embodiment of their ideals, making them capable of reshaping reality itself. For example, Varhran's Commandment of Absolute Victory allows him to rewrite the rules of engagement, guaranteeing triumph no matter the odds. Similarly, Montserrat's foresight Commandment provides an unmatched tactical edge, allowing him to anticipate and counter almost any action. Spenta-Mainyu’s Commandment elevates him to the level of a living neutron star, enabling him to obliterate foes with galactic-scale power​.

Yet, Commandments are not without their dangers and costs. The unyielding nature of a Commandment means failure to adhere to its terms results in catastrophic consequences, often as severe as instant death, ensuring that wielding a Commandment is as much a test of character as it is a source of power. For example, Magsarion’s reliance on enduring bloodshed leaves him perpetually teetering on the edge of destruction, his survival a testament to his sheer willpower and combat mastery. Montserrat’s foresight comes at the cost of his memory and senses, while Spenta-Mainyu’s self-imposed isolation strips him of emotional connections, leaving him as an unapproachable force​.

Commandments demand not just mastery of their abilities but also a profound understanding of their limitations and consequences. As a user, you are not merely bound by your Commandment; you are defined by it. The power it grants is only as effective as your ability to uphold its terms and wield it with precision. Failure is not an option, and success often comes at a steep personal cost. This balance between empowerment and sacrifice is what makes Commandments the ultimate test of strength, resolve, and identity in the eternal struggle between good and evil.
objects.title: Commandments (Shinza Bansho)

objects.text:
A small shard of the God of Darkness, Methuselah, has been embedded deep within your soul. And now, it awakens, granting you the same powers he once wielded, albeit diminished in strength for now—a flaw you will be able to remedy as your power will continue to grow the longer you exist, your entire being compounding on the very history of the universe. Each passing night you live through adds to your history, increasing your strength. Moreover, if some notable events that reverberate through history take place at night, they may be etched into your being as well, granting you small thematic abilities, which will also in turn grow stronger over time. In turn, beings whose history is shallow will find it harder and harder to actually find any way to harm you.

As void is associated with darkness, your presence is now a perfect spiritual, physical, and mental nothingness. You may assume any corporeal form you wish, but even if someone destroys it, you can just reform it instantly. If you do not wish so, you cannot be interacted with by any means, physical, spiritual, magical, etc., and every attack aimed at you will be reflected back at the attacker or consumed entirely, adding the strength of attack to your own. Moreover, as the fear of darkness is rooted deep inside each and every living being, a mere glimpse of your presence, if you so desire, will drive those who lay their eyes upon you completely and irreversibly mad, with those possessed of weak will dying on the spot from horror.

Your control over darkness is absolute. You can shape it in any physical form you desire, appear out of any shadow, fly while in your physical form by supporting it with giant invisible pillars of darkness and much more. And, just as darkness is ever-present, your attacks also bypass any defences, natural or supernatural.

This control also extends to more esoteric concepts associated with darkness, like the night itself. As each night and day equally share the world equally between them—each night is half as durable as strong as the entire world. You can take all the nights you have experienced, and shape them into any form you desire, creating minions, weapons, spikes, out of it. The more nights you infuse into them, the stronger they become.

Do be careful, however, as carelessly utilising your gifts may cause a yin-yang collapse. When darkness retreats from the space that light is too slow to fill, the result is a paradoxical existence, a collapse of logic and causality, destroying everything and everyone it touches, with you as the sole exception.

One of the most terrifying abilities you possess is control over the physical and spiritual entropy. At will, you can speed up the passage of time in a localised area to such a degree that trillions of trillions of years will pass in an instant, with even the souls and bodies of immortal beings grinding to dust instantly. Alternatively, you can halt someone's entropy, turning them immortal and ageless, or even reverse it.

Lastly, as the God of darkness, you can control any creature strongly associated with it, such as vampires, as well as create your own. By letting someone drink your blood, or what passes for it, you can start the process of turning them into the servants of darkness. They will become creatures of the night, a mystery in their own right, immortal and growing stronger for each passing night, yet irreversibly loyal to you.
objects.title: King of Darkness (Shinza Bansho)

objects.text: You can claim those you have a strong personal connection to, like friends, loved ones, family, or those who are loyal to you and acknowledge you as their superior, as a part of your Legion. Once someone becomes a legionnaire, they are inseparably bound to you on a level deeper than even the soul and are immortal and unageing for as long as you live. You can summon them to your side, rewind their age to restore their youth, and—should they perish—resurrect them no matter in what manner they die, even if they were erased from existence entirely. Members of your legion are perpetually self-sustaining, even if previously they needed some outside source of power to exist or utilise their abilities. You can empower your legionnaires, raising them up to the level of power equal to yours. This improves every aspect of their being: powers and abilities grow both in potency and scope until they equal yours in magnitude, and even legionnaires' very metaphysical presence grows to match your own. As the strength of legionnaires is ultimately sourced from you, these new and enhanced abilities can never be used to harm you. Lastly, should you wish to, you can share any of your self-targeting perks with the members of your Legion.
objects.title: Legion (Shinza Bansho)

addons.text:
The conditions for forced cooperation have been expanded. Now, whenever someone manages to kill you, all opponents that contributed to your demise automatically trigger forced cooperation.

Additionally, whenever you steal anything from a target, you can automatically apply any effect of one of your stolen powers to this target as a sort of 'payment' for acquired abilities, with the effect being enhanced to the same level as Yomotsugaeri's retribution.
addons.title: Curse of Retribution

objects.text: You have acquired Habaki Sakagame's unique distortion, born from the dual desires I don't want to die and I want to live. Whenever you are killed, you may take the attack or an attribute of your opponent to resurrect yourself with. When you take an attack, it is amplified 1500000 times over and can be redirected at any target of your choice, being inescapable and undodgeable, serving as a sort of 'karmic retribution' for your demise. This can even be done with several attacks at once, resulting in vengeance of a terrifying scale. Alternatively, you can take any attribute of your opponent or opponents and apply it to yourself with the same multiplier. For example, you can take the 'speed', 'strength', 'durability', 'magical power' or anything else, albeit such boosts are not permanent and will expire when the conflict reaches its resolution. When you die, you remain in a 'paused' state, allowing you to select a target and recuperate from the trauma of death, and then you are instantly restored to perfect health when the power is utilised. As this power does not come from Edo's pollution but rather from a higher, transcendental source, it cannot be affected by other abilities or resisted and will restore you no matter how gruesome the death was, even from complete existential annihilation.
objects.title: Misogiharae — Yomotsugaeri (Shinza Bansho)

addons.text:
You can create Aeons of anyone you have met or conjured in the Dreamlands. Those that you Aeonise that way, while in between summons, will reside within the Dreamlands and now have their minds protected from your alterations the same as a regular visitor would due to having been made 'real' by the Aeonisation.

Additionally, any other Aeon you summon can, with your permission, enter the Dreamlands upon being dismissed, residing there until you call upon them again.
addons.title: Aeon Imaginary

objects.text:
You possess the ability to create Aeons—recreations of living beings that you witnessed, either in person, via any power of yours, or even if someone shared the memories of the relevant person with you.

These recreations do not have any hard limit on their power, but to summon Aeons at their full power, you must have a thorough understanding of them, which may be hard with abilities that surpass human comprehension. Should your understanding of some aspects be lacking or non-existent, this will result in the power of Aeon weakening, or even them losing some abilities altogether. Lacking knowledge of their mentality and personality will result in Aeons being wildly different from the original, twisted by your impression.

This also works in reverse. If you suspect the ability is much more powerful than it actually is, it can drastically increase the power of Aeon compared to the original.

Aeons come with all the knowledge and equipment they possessed when you witnessed them and can be further refined with time, should your understanding of the originals deepen. Once summoned, you can dismiss any Aeon at will or resummon them again with no effort, with Aeons keeping their memories between summons.

Do note that while naturally inclined to respect you, Aeons possess free will and are not bound to follow your orders and may even betray you. The closer Aeons are to their original mentality and personality, the stronger their will and sense of self.
objects.title: Aeon (Shinza Bansho)

objects.text:
You have transcended the boundaries of magic and science, attaining an Aspect—a transcendent Title and Purpose that grants you supreme power. Each Aspect is entirely unique, and no two beings can possess the same one.

As a bearer of an Aspect, you gain several universal abilities shared by all Aspects. You can fly at immense speeds in any direction, speak and understand all languages—written, spoken, or otherwise—and possess perfect memory, retaining every detail with flawless accuracy. You are also endowed with near-perfect immortality. Your body becomes exponentially durable, with internal resilience so great that only immense cosmic forces can cause significant harm.

At the heart of your being lies an Indestructible Core, the source of your immortality. Around this core, your physical body reforms and regenerates. Superficial wounds heal almost instantly, while deeper injuries take more time. If your entire body is destroyed, leaving only the core intact, you will enter a death-like slumber, unconscious until your form fully regenerates.

Each Aspect bestows a unique purpose and power, reflecting its Title. For example, the Logos holds within them the library of all things, encompassing written and spoken words, unspoken thoughts, and even hidden truths, The Elysium can see the future, shaping and guiding the cosmos to fulfill its destined path, The Epitaph takes death and destruction into themselves, preventing harm to others, only to release it upon their chosen target with devastating force.

These are merely a few examples of the Aspects that exist. You may choose another from the CYOA or create your own, so long as it matches the power and scope of those already defined. The possibilities are as vast as the cosmos itself.
objects.title: Aspect Attainment (Ouroboros CYOA)

addons.text: Your reality-bending abilities have harmonized with your mind's eye, enhancing your perception of reality. With this heightened awareness, you could sense spatial distortions, detect nearby magic, or intuitively measure Hume levels in an area. It also grants you the instinct to recognize large-scale reality shifts, such as timeline changes, fate manipulation, or universal collapse.
addons.title: Pierce The Veil

addons.text:
Your mastery of magic and reality-bending has evolved, allowing you to create Kinetoglyphs—anomalous effects triggered by specific gestures and motions. Unlike traditional magic or reality-bending, Kinetoglyphs require no resources, magical energy, or interaction with Hume. They rely solely on performing precise movements to activate the effect.

For instance, SCP-3688 is a Kinetoglyph requiring an extremely complex dance that grants invincibility as long as it continues. The time and effort required to craft one depends on the desired effect, while the complexity of the gestures also scales with its power—a small gust of wind might require tapping to a beat, whereas teleportation could require an intricate, hour-long combination of hand movements.

While you cannot create Kinetoglyphs beyond your abilities, their unique nature makes them invaluable. Operating independently of Hume levels or magic, they function more like command prompts to reality and are nearly impossible to nullify. Kinetoglyphs can be shared, but they only work if you personally teach someone; knowing the gestures alone is not enough.
addons.title: Kinetoglyphs

addons.text: You have the ability to absorb the anomalous energy generated when you create anomalous phenomena through Paranomalous. This prevents any uncontrollable anomalous events from occurring beyond your control and simultaneously increases your Hume level.
addons.title: Hume Sink

objects.text:
You are a Type Green, or reality bender, capable of reshaping reality through sheer will. This power stems from being inherently "more real" than the world around you, a concept measured in Humes—the scientific unit for reality's substance and stability. Higher Hume levels signify greater solidity and resistance to change, while lower levels represent a more fluid, malleable reality.

Imagine reality as a thin layer of sand covering the universe. Removing sand makes reality less stable, while adding sand increases its solidity. Your elevated Hume level is like having far more sand than the baseline, granting you "weight" to reshape the world around you.

Earth's baseline Hume level is 50 Hm, representing a stable, normal reality. In contrast, your starting level is 100 Hm. At this ratio, your abilities allow for minor manipulations, such as changing an object’s color, twisting metal into a rose, or summoning small items. While you can affect nearly anything, your power's range and scale are weak, and altering yourself will always be a magnitude harder than altering external reality.

Different environments, phenomena, and universes can have varying Hume levels. Low-Hume areas amplify your abilities by loosening the fabric of reality, while high-Hume areas suppress them by making reality more rigid. For instance, phenomena like magic may register as low-Hume in some cases, making them easier to bend, or as high-Hume, rendering them immutable as natural law. 

Your Hume level will naturally rise with practice, though growth slows as your power increases. You can overcome this by deepening your understanding of reality: experimenting with natural laws, encountering supernatural phenomena, or traveling to new dimensions. To grasp the heights of power you can attain, consider SCP-343, a reality bender with a Hume level of 860, who confidently refers to himself as God.
objects.title: Type Green (SCP Foundation)

addons.title: Technopathogen
addons.text:
Your cyborg body opens new pathways for your viral nature to evolve and grow, your cybernetics are now just as infectious as every organic part of you.

At first, this simply means that your disease becomes cybernetically enhanced, gaining resistance to things that would normally destroy it through it's partially inorganic nature. In time, you could learn to change your virus into true nano virus, tiny machines impervious to mundane immune systems and antibiotics alike, yet still able to replicate by infecting organic beings.

Though there is no reason to limit yourself to infecting biological lifeforms, your disease has the potential to cross transmit to machines. Eventually, your technopathy can even allow for your disease to become a computer virus, spreading through a digital vector instead of a biological or mechanical one.

objects.text:
You are a Type Silver—an infectious hazard. A living host of disease, your body carries a unique plague that is an extension of you. You are the vector, the source, and the controller. Every part of you—skin, breath, blood—can carry and transmit your infection.

You have full control over your disease. You can transform it into common illnesses like the flu, pneumonia, or strep throat. Alternatively, you can render it dormant, allowing it to spread silently without symptoms. With effort, your pathogen can even be beneficial—boosting immune systems or devouring harmful infections.

Your current range of influence is limited to line of sight. You can still affect existing strains outside this range, but your control becomes vague and weak. The farther the infection, the weaker your connection becomes. Currently, you can infect a few thousand people. Beyond that, the strain begins to dilute, losing connection to you and becoming a mundane disease. With time, you can expand both your range and the scale.

Your strain can evolve. With experience, you may enhance its lethality or complexity—developing degenerative effects like cancer or neurodegenerative conditions like Alzheimer’s. You can also absorb and assimilate other diseases, merging them into your personal strain and increasing its potency. The more unique or powerful the infection, the more your own grows.

While your body is highly resistant to disease and illness, absorbing too many infections too quickly can overwhelm you, leading to severe damage.

With enough time and mastery, your disease could unleash devastating effects—flesh-liquefying toxins, mind-controlling strains, or engineered super-plagues capable of infecting the entire planet.
objects.title: Type Silver (SCP Foundation)

objects.text:
You are a Type Beige—a dismembered body part. Your existence is bound not to a full body, but to a single preserved piece: your reliquary. Whether it’s a hand, eye, heart, or skull, this part contains your soul, mind, and essence. As long as it exists, you are not truly dead.

Your reliquary is incredibly durable. Even as a baseline human, it can survive missile-level impacts and resist metaphysical effects. As you grow in power, its durability and resistances will grow.

Though dismembered, you are not without agency. You can assign an epithet to your reliquary—such as Hand of the Dead—granting you a minor affinity and a basic movement ability tied to the name. For example, Sky Skull might allow flight, while Heart of the Sea could let you flow through water. Your movement begins at normal human speed and can improve over time.

You are also capable of possessing individuals who come into contact with—or remain near—your reliquary for extended periods. Whether possession succeeds depends on your strength and willpower versus theirs. Upon success, the individual becomes your new body, with the reliquary integrating into their body. The host will slowly adapt to reflect your preferences, though only within the limits of their existing physiology—you cannot, for instance, turn a human into a dragon.

You may choose to leave the host’s soul intact, forming a symbiotic relationship instead of possession. At any time, you may also choose to detach from the body, returning to your dismembered state.
objects.title: Type Beige (SCP Foundation)

addons.text: Your awareness of the Complex grows to conscious control over the Backrooms’ limited area, and your charges, in turn, increasing the range and depth of control over a specified area, grasping furthermore to the Complex’s physical properties, gravitational center, and passage of time being a few of the elements you can control.
addons.title: Beyond the Spurned Threshold

objects.text: "I had a home once… A manor... Overlooking the sea... Upon the world, this was a vestige… Calling forward onto strangled ears… But when the skies turned dark… The house was taken by the sea… A pillar truncated… Cast down to the seabed with all the other forgotten things… But I remember. Fleeting shells sinking ever slowly... Folding downwards, into themselves. Forever tearing along the seams of the sky... Until nothing remains except the eternal ghost... And you ask yourself... Could there ever be anything greater than this?" “It was always been here.” —Anonymous 1989. An earthquake occurred around the states ranging from California to San Francisco which caused untold devastation; $6 billion in damages, 63 deaths, and nearly 3,600 injuries caused by a slip along the San Andreas Fault with a 6.9 magnitude in the Richter scale. October 17, 1989. Meanwhile, the ASYNC Foundation tested for the 6th time their Low-Proximity Magnetic Distortion System in regards to the KV31 Project, efforts in creating unlimited storage and housing, using the LPMDS which uses magnetic waves inflicting holes in reality called Thresholds by ASYNC scientists. Project KV31 planned to make a stable portal to this, so far, unseen dimension allowing for rapid travel, storage, and residential and industrial facilities. They, surprisingly, succeed. The records of an unknown (and [REDACTED]) item enabling this leap in scientific wonder are present but need to be more conclusive. All it needed was the earthquake’s for the right circumstances. You know this; you were close by, after all. The energies and almost-deadly proximity on an inopportune moment in the test caused you to become a Threshold yourself. Instead of simply being allowed access to the Backrooms as a personal dimension, you act as a custodian of the Complex. Either as a “door” or fault in physical reality, you can “open” and “close” entries for anyone close enough to your vicinity and sense which Backrooms “location” intersects with the area. Yet… you know the Complex better than any scientist or theorist realize: It is a Sea. A Plane. All that is forgotten, all this is left listless, any place or object you didn’t give much thought to, only recalling you’ve seen or taken place while drawing a blank on itself then put into form in the Complex. It remembers what has been consigned to oblivion, molding and twisting these memories all the more tearing itself and reality apart resulting in what is it to this day: a warped reflection of memories left behind. This understanding can grow into bringing forth any place or object from The Complex into physical reality, layering a part of it with all that entails. Let’s hope the others don’t find themselves encountering anything dangerous.
objects.title: The Complex (Kane Pixels’ The Backrooms)

objects.text: Formerly a hivemind in the video game industry in its golden age only known as ‘M’, he was trapped inside one of the many cartridges he created in collaboration with his associate-turned-enemy. Now he extends an ‘invitation’ to you, not to join him, but to become like him. By accepting this invitation, you have been transformed into a being similar to the demon known as M, also known as Horror Mario. You are sealed away in a game cartridge, containing your own personal dimension. Slumbering within its code, it manifests as worlds based upon a series of games tailor-made to fit you, with you as its protagonist. Optionally, you may change this to be a game series of your choosing instead. You are able to move your cartridge without being in the real world, able to manipulate the minds of those in physical contact with the game to do your bidding. Upon entering visual contact with your cartridge, the game subtly entices and tempts people into playing it, upon which you can reach into the real world and bring them into your domain. There, you are the highest authority and the de-facto God of all within it. While the cartridge is impossibly more durable than a mundane one, being able to shrug off blows that would otherwise shatter it, if the cartridge is ever destroyed, you and everything inside your world will die. You can create new versions of your game’s world and the characters inside it based upon the base template of your game, taking upon a new narrative unique compared to its peers. However, it is almost guaranteed to take some form of event or twist at some point in its timeline, forever altering its course. This could be anything, from having a character be possessed by the God of the local forest, an infection spreading throughout the land and mutating those caught by it, the heroes losing and the consequences of such a loss, or simply a psychotic break that caused a character to become murderous. All of these characters are sentient and have feelings, but while you may interact and even befriend them, they’re all puppets under your control at the end of the day. As a sort of trump card, you may add them to your hivemind with you at its center, adding their power to your own. With enough additions to this hivemind, you will be able to transform into more powerful forms that will enhance your power and abilities even further. As your influence grows, the area around your cartridge will progressively change itself to follow the rules of your game as you see fit; Extra Lives, Game Overs, and everything else that your rules entail. Eventually, you will be able to manifest outside of the cartridge, albeit in a comparatively weakened state. At this point, you would still be more than enough to handle the average person or a small group of people, but anything more than that would require more power to be gained. With time, you’ll be able to bring out your creations as well. Any instance of murder or other such forms of life-taking your creations commit will add to your power as well as their own. As your power grows, so too does the area around your cartridge grow. When thousands of souls are claimed in your name and some time to fester and grow like a tumor upon the world, you will be able to absorb the cartridge without any consequence to you and yours. Your physical form will become the new phylactery for you and your subjects, and more importantly, you will be free from your prison. What will happen then, I wonder? With tens of thousands of souls in your toybox. Hundreds of thousands? Millions? Billions? Regardless, I will watch your growth with great interest. … ...and with flickering hope.
objects.title: It's-A-Me, Mario... Almost! (Friday Night Funkin': Mario's Madness)

addons.text:
Your "stomach" now gains a secondary function, the ability to store your copy abilities. Once you’ve sucked up an enemy, you may choose to "store" the ability instead of gaining the power provided. This also applies to Starspit and other objects you wish to carry and/or "spit out".

You may only store a total of 5 objects at a time, and are mentally aware of all objects present within. You can also project this information as a holographic interface that resembles a Nintendo DS, with full functionality. Aesthetics can be altered to your tastes.

Now the fun part. Sure you could just tap the ability you want and gain it no problem, but wanna know what happens when you drag two of them together? They combine, or give you a brand new ability. Results may vary from Spark + Cutter = Lightsaber, Sword + Ice = Ice Sword, Plasma + Bomb = Thunderbomb, etc.
addons.title: Copy Palette

addons.text:
Every copy ability you've ever obtained becomes recorded into an exclusive room within your Archive called the “Ability Room”. An infinitely expanding museum that displays all of your acquired abilities as stars of various colors encased within floating domes, with symbols to easily represent what they grant.

By simply touching one of them, you automatically gain its associated copy ability. Touching it while you already have one will either do nothing or switch to the ability in question, your choice. Alternatively, you may access this library with just a thought to gain, switch, or place into your Copy Palette, any abilities listed. 

There's also a “Training Room” to practice and test the limits of your abilities to your heart's content, with no issues. You may also design other rooms for your own purposes, such as an art room to practice with your “Artist” ability, a race track for “Wheel”, an arena for “Sword”, etc.
addons.title: Copy Codex

addons.text:
You gain your very own Warp Star, or a vehicle from the Kirby Air Ride Series. It can be summoned and dismissed at will from a pocket space, or can return to your exact location at hyper sonic speeds regardless of where you "parked" it with a simple thought, or an external method. 

You and those you can grant permission to can control the vehicle with ease, and stick to it like concrete regardless of speed and physics. It can also expand and change its shape to allow more drivers and passengers.
addons.title: Air Rider

objects.text: 🎵"How can I help you, King Dedede? I need a monster to clobber that there Kirby! That's what we do best at N.M.E.! You'd better get it with a money-back guarantee!"🎵 You've gained the power of maximum pink my friend, allowing you to suck up anything with the force of a super vacuum cleaner, and gain a power if said thing passes certain criteria. What? You don't like the idea of sucking stuff up? Fine, you can make it so you absorb them through your hand or something. Why do people keep calling that weird? Once an object is successfully inhaled, you gain one of the many copy abilities within the entire Kirby franchise. How you get basic ones like Fire, Water, Plasma, Cutter and Yoyo should be obvious. But how do you get stuff like UFO, Cupid, Suplex, Hi-Jump, or the Smash Bros one? Simple, you can substitute the "enemies" you need to inhale to gain access to them. You'll instantly know which ones on sight. Only one ability can be used at a time, unless you either spit them out or take a big hit. You've still got a window of opportunity to gain it back by inhaling the star that bounces about. Objects that don't grant abilities can be stored into your blackhole of a stomach to make Starspit. Which you can fire as a small to gigantic star out of your "mouth", with destructive potential to bring down concrete to iron walls. Wait, I almost forgot the main selling point. The aesthetics you take based on your copy abilities are automatically tailored to you. And can change on the fly.
objects.title: Inhale (Kirby)

objects.text: Team Go is a group of five siblings, that received their powers in the aftermath of a rainbow-coloured meteor crashing into their treehouse, in the aftermath each gained a “Glow” from the meteor, granting them a superpower. Perhaps you took the place of one of these siblings, gaining their Glow? Perhaps you are simply an unknown member of the family gaining one of the glows that didn’t get ‘handed’ out? Whatever you decide, along with your Glow’s unique ability, it also grants you a level of enhanced durability suitable for surviving a life of a Superhero (or Supervillain). The Red Glow was gained by the Wego twins, gifting them the power of self-duplication, and allowing them to overwhelm their foes with sheer numbers. The Green Glow was gained by Shego allowing her to surround her hands with high temperature green plasma without harm, and to hurl blasts of said plasma at her targets. The Blue Glow gave Hego super-strength, able to leap tall buildings in a single bound, to lift and throw heavy objects well beyond a normal human, and to destroy most targets he hit. The Violet Glow was used by Mego to alter his size, both increasing and decreasing at will. The Orange Glow is the ‘first’ of the unknown Glow’s granting the user the ability to move objects via an orange telekinetic glow. The Yellow Glow is the ‘next’ of the unknown Glow’s, a user of this is capable of shaping the Glow into various constructs such as shields or swords. These constructs can be given out at will, but will degrade over time lasting only about an hour in ideal conditions. The Indigo Glow is the ‘last’ of the unknown Glow’s, it’s user is capable of opening portals, capable of opening and closing them fast enough to be viable in combat, while being powerful enough to cross the planet with a single portal. Purchasing all seven Glow’s here will grant you the Glow Meteor itself, anyone who touches it will gain a Glow from the Meteor, and whatever power that Glow grants. As one who has all seven Glow’s you possess the power to ‘select’ which Glow they might get, otherwise it will remain random. Note: Possessing a Glow typically changes the users Eye, Skin, and Hair Colour to a shade of the Glow’s colour. You can decide if you have this change or not, toggling it at will. Note: If you choose multiple Glow’s you can decide which Glow is to be the ‘visible’ one for the colour of your eyes, skin and hair.
objects.title: Go Glow (Kim Possible)

objects.text: You are now Poseidon, one of the three ancient "weapons" from the Void Century—an entity with the overwhelming power to bring the entire world to ruin. Your ability, Poseidon, grants you the power to communicate with and command every Sea King in existence—colossal sea creatures capable of unfathomable destruction. No being, mortal or divine, holds sway over them except for you. To the Sea Kings, you are not just a ruler but an unquestioned sovereign, revered with absolute loyalty. These beasts can grow to impossible sizes, some rivaling entire islands. Their territorial and aggressive nature makes them a force feared by even the bravest of warriors. When united, their combined strength is enough to drag entire continental landmasses beneath the sea, reshaping the world itself. No matter the universe you inhabit, your power will affect every Sea King within it. And should a world lack these primordial leviathans, your very presence will ensure their emergence—rising naturally from the depths, as if the ocean itself bends to your will. You also possess the ability to transform into an exquisitely beautiful mer-person whenever you are in the sea—assuming your true form as the one and only Poseidon. In this form, you become one of the fastest beings beneath the waves, you are also perfectly adapted to the sea, allowing you to breathe underwater and navigate its currents with unmatched grace.
objects.title: Poseidon (One Piece)

addons.text: Due to becoming an established Path Practitioner you can use Paths much more easily and intuitively. This grounds the presence of Path Others allowing you to bring them with you when you leave their Path as long as you’ve made deals with them. This also gives an overall boost to your boons and Path Practices.
addons.title: Path Practitioner

addons.text:
In addition to whatever specialty you chose, your family now also specializes in Paths, meaning they have Path Practices like ones for Scriveners, Losers and Path Finders. You also gain access to dozens of well-researched Paths with various secrets unveiled allowing you to gain more rewards, from better items, improved boons, to gaining the favor of Others. 

As you come from a known Practitioner family some Others in the Paths will already be aware of you, knowing your family name and what it stands for. This grants you some connections and benefits as being already known will make deals smoother, grant you more access and make most of them more welcoming.

Should the first specialty you’ve chosen also be Paths, then you’ll have just as much potential as Hazel did, someone that ran Paths for a full century and who was closest to solving them in their entirety.
addons.title: Path Family

addons.text:
Your natural affinity with movement and parkour, has resonated with the Zoomtown Path, granting you its boon, thus allowing you to race through incoming traffic, for a liberal definition of that word as it could be used to weave through gunfire as long as it isn’t too clustered to no longer qualify as ‘traffic’ and similar combat or movement situations. 

It also improves your instincts in all matters pertaining to Paths, just like it has become second-nature for you to parkour, you can now naturally intuit the pathways you have to follow, including important people, locations and items. Like a speedrunner who had time to prepare, you can now run through Paths as if they were just another rooftop.
addons.title: Zoomtown

addons.text:
You’re no typical Pathfinder, instead you’re something a bit more focused, you’re a Receiver, instead of entering random Paths and running them aimlessly your destinations will be a tad more curated.

You’ll first run a very personal Path, which once completed will leave you in a central area where you can explore either 7 or 12 different Paths, with success in one area providing an opening to another. These Paths can cover major dilemmas and aspects of your character. Other Paths are still accessible through different means, oftentimes items found on the Paths, but they give lesser rewards and a share of that power is diverted to draw in tools that help with one or more of your twelve ‘personal’ Paths. Expect recurring characters and some bleed-over to real Life.

While this slightly reduces the high-end variance of powers offered, they’re much more curated, being stuff you’d favor, like and would have typically chosen if offered. Failure tends to send you out of the Path without harming you, instead of some of the less than stellar fates that would normally apply, though that doesn’t rule out trauma or Pathstuff coming back with you.

As you proceed down these personal Paths you’ll have to face some hard truths and resolve personal problems to proceed. As you increase your repertoire with path rewards, they tend to synergize and strengthen each other where gaining one reward can strengthen another, like one Path reward giving two boons since you've completed the Path next to it, instead of gaining the somewhat random boons typical Paths would offer.
addons.title: Receiver

objects.text:
You can sense how to enter "Paths". Each path is an extradimensional area featuring a sequential series of events, phenomena, creatures, and objects forming a sort of mini-quest or narrative. Imagine a linear platforming video game, mixed with something from Alice and Wonderland, and running on dream logic. You have just enough instinct to avoid dying trivially, but otherwise, you will need to figure out the paths, like figuring out an optimized speedrun at a videogame level irl. 

Paths can be used as shortcuts to travel in the real world. Most paths have minor boons or items associated with completing them (examples: the ability to see through smoke, an envelope that fills with a few loose dollars each week, skill at dodging through traffic), more dangerous paths occasionally have stronger boons (examples: immunity to fall damage, a short-range teleportation jump rope, polyglot ability).
objects.title: Path Runner (Worm Meme Powers Cyoa)

addons.text: Your self-censoring nature leaves no subject for the horror you inflict, transforming part of the essence of that fear. Your presence no longer needs recognition to instill dread—even in complete forgetfulness, that fear remains. The fear becomes ambient, diffused through space, perception, and subconscious association. Even when unperceived or erased from memory, its influence lingers and grows. Afflicted people might feel watched in locked rooms, hear footsteps in silent hallways, find movement in the corner of their vision, or feel discrepancies in the reflections of mirrors. They become terrorized by the feeling of anticipation, the anticipation of a threat, or some source for this terror where there is none, ultimately degrading their spirit, will and intelligence. Things you censor can now also afflict this terror to a similar effect, causing people inexplicable anxiety, insomnia and psychological strain from things they've forgotten.
addons.title: Peaceful Mode

addons.text:
The gift fate gives you has been slightly altered, and the star you were born under shines a cold, ominous light, inflicting terror into the hearts of those who observe it. Other than your talent for murder and destruction, you are also innately gifted in ways to maximise the fear you inflict.

Your terror can now also be inflicted into inanimate objects. Unmanned missiles change their trajectories from their fear of you, buildings crumble, collapsing into themselves to escape your presence. Not only this, but you can now control elements inflicted with your terror, similarly to your control over malevolent energies and chaotic forces. Also, you can alternatively fuel the unending hunger of your gift by inflicting fear.
addons.title: The Foreboding Star That Shrouds the Heavens

objects.text:
Your presence instills terror into any entity with sentience, regardless of race, affecting the heart and soul directly. This irrational fear is not a perceivable ability or technique of yours, but a natural reaction to your very existence. Every passing moment of your existence blankets the world in terror and fear, leading to strife, conflict and despair. The terror you inflict does not require your physical presence, glancing thoughts about you are enough to drive people mad with fear. Even after your disappearance, the places you've and the legends made about you continue to instill deep and irrational fear.
