Your fear also instills itself into the subconsciousness, and also fuels previous fears and traumas, resurfacing and reinforcing them. The effects of your presence grows stronger with proximity, direct touch with your body, even body parts detached from you, such as blood, or hair, is enough to cause instant death. The trauma inflicted by your terror can reflect physically, causing the body to tear and damage itself, abilities possessed by others can uncontrollably activate, and work against themselves.

You are able to hold back the terror you inflict.
objects.title: The Enemy of All (Ishura)

objects.text:
You are now a cat. Thankfully, you are not a normal cat; not only you can turn into a human form at will—and even become anything between both—, you also have access to an abnormal gift: the capacity to kill things by drawing their shape. 

Every living being contains shapes that only you can see, and by drawing those shapes while they are within 10 meters of you they will die; not by suddenly turning into a corpse, but by their body, mind and soul being completely erased—certain things like clones would still persist and so you would need to kill them too. 

Shapes vary in complexity and quantity depending on the strength of your opponents—sometimes a shape may need to be draw multiple times before its gone—, but regardless of complexity they can all be draw continuously—because stopping a line counts as it being complete and since it wouldn't match the shape it would not work—and can be draw within a short time-frame. Your drawing needs not to be perfect, as long as its similar enough it will work just fine. While you can hit multiple of the same shapes simultaneously, you are limited to just three at a time.

Some opponents are special and may manifest their shapes in different forms. For example, those with enhanced durability will have their shapes briefly hide—and the higher the durability the lower the window of opportunity—, while those with shapeshifting will have a different shape everytime they change.

What you use to draw is a white energy, in cat form you just manifest it somewhere around you and then drag it around in order to replicate a shape. In human form it manifests in the tip of one of your fingers and you need to move it to draw.
objects.title: Shapes of Life (Divineko)

objects.text:
The Patapons have searched for centuries for the rebirth of their gods following their sacrifice at Earthend, and they have found you. You might not be the Almighty Patapon that they are used to, but you are close enough not to matter. 

What this power gives you is the means to control an army of Patapons through music from four Drums gifted to you; Pata, Pon, Don, and Chaka. Patapons are weak individually apart from some rare exceptions but more than make up for it with their coordination and versatility.

You gain Mater, The Tree of Life. It is from this tree you can plant and replant anywhere that you will gather your army of Patapon, each Patapon made requires materials gifted to the tree as fertilizer which will allow you to spawn new Patapon depending on the materials offered. Be aware that Animal or Monster Parts/Materials will be more effective at making new Patapon.

You can also make “Rarepons” which are Patapons that resemble animals, each having strength and weakness but are normally better than normal Patapons.

By doing music with your drum in a perfect beat with the Rythm of the Earth, you can enter “Fever Mode” which makes your Patapon all thrice as strong and durable as long as you stay on a perfect timing beat. You start with all songs from the series like: Pata Pata Pata Pon, The March Song, Pon Pon Pata Pon, The Attack Song, Chaka Chaka Pata Pon, The Defense Song, Pon Pata Pon Pata, the Retreat Song, Pon Pon Chaka Chaka, the Charge Song, Don Don Chaka Chaka, the Jump Song and more.

There are multiple different “Class” of Patapons, each having its strengths and weaknesses such as the Toripons, a Cavalry that rides flying birds, are very mobile and hard to reach but vulnerable to things such as fire or paralysis as it makes them fall from the skies. Or the Dekapon, Giant Patapons that are more durable than any of the rest and can stun enemies after doing a charge and then attack song but are slow. There are also more basic classes like Yumipon which are bow users or the Yaripon or Tatepon, Spear Thrower, and Shield and Sword classes respectively.

But more important of all, is the Hero Class. Only one Patapon can be a Hero Class but they can also be any other class on top, their strength is massive due to their Hero Mode, which happens when doing a corresponding beat in perfect timing in Fever Mode corresponding to their secondary class; a Tatepon Hero will activate their Hero Mode when doing the Defense Song which will negate any damage your army receive as long as their Hero Mode last, a Yaripon will launch their Spear in an Attack Song and the spear will explode on contact, etc.

The primary way to strengthen your Patapon is through battle with your army, every victory will give you equipment in a pocket space to equip your Patapon with, often coming with enchantments like fire or lightning. You will also gain materials from battle to make more Patapon but Hunting Battle will give more high-quality material and less equipment while normal battles are the inverse.

While the Patapons normally resemble black eyeballs with legs, you can choose their appearance even to the point of appearing as human due to their 2-dimensional nature being brought to 3 dimensions.
objects.title: The Almighty Patapon (Patapon)

objects.text:
You gain the power to listen to the Heart Songs of others; those with major problems in their lives will seemingly start to burst out in song and dance at random, expressing their problems through the songs they sing, even if they’d be physically incapable of it. While you’re listening to these Heart Songs, you can freely move around unimpeded as long as you stay close enough to listen. Should this be in public, people will dance as if they were a flash mob. Once the Heart Song ends, you’ll return to the place you first started hearing it, and despite the song taking minutes, on the outside, you’ll have only zoned out for a few seconds with none of it happening in the real world. Through this part of your power, you can realize the problems people close to you deal with. Should they know about your power, and should you allow it, they can physically sing out their Heart Song.

The second part of your power is the power to express your own Heart Song, while listening to others is an internal process, you’ll be singing and dancing in the real world when expressing your own. While doing so people won’t attack or interrupt you (though neither can you) and instead will be assisting your performance, at the start this might at most be rhythmic walking or clapping as a crowd goes by, thus creating the melody to your song, or willing friends acting as background dancers, but with practice you’ll become capable of growing the scope of your performances.

While others can’t interfere directly, it’s still possible for them to intervene by countering with their own Heart Song, this song battle will be in a battle of the bands style, while this is a non-physical confrontation, it will have a mental impact on the losers equivalent to the impact your performances made on them or yourself if you lost. If you won the song battle and the argument, they’d be beaten mentally, feeling as if they lost completely, an unrepentant villain indifferent to your song in the meanwhile would simply see it as you prolonging the inevitable.

This doesn’t mean that you can stall anyone; those stronger than you will have appropriately more presence and influence, experienced foes could reposition their forces to an advantageous position, summon minions or otherwise prepare the battlefield. They could even counter your arguments or performance, while those that completely overpower you could attack your allies, or cut your Heart Song short by destroying the atmosphere you’re going for (a hopeful song would be difficult to perform while limbs are flying around, for example). Should you be unsuccessful or have a Heart Song end in a draw where neither side gives in, then your power will go on a cooldown equal to the intensity of your loss.
objects.title: Heart Songs (Zoeys Extraordinary Playlist)

objects.text: You now possess the secret of the Improbable Stair, a phenomenon that exists everywhere and everywhen, winding throughout all of time and space. Normally, it can only be accessed by an extremely powerful artifact, such as one of the Keys to the Kingdom; however, you are simply able to access it in your own right. To access the Stair, you need only imagine that there is a stair—having a stair-like image to focus on helps, even if it’s a painting or a series of boxes—and take the first step onto it. Once upon the Stair, the traveler needs to focus on their destination, both in space and in time. But the user should beware: the Stair has many ‘landings,’ and if one does not find the Stair again, it is possible to become stranded where it leaves you. When you become stranded by the Stair, it will always be in a place you could survive, but not necessarily in a place you will survive. The Stair will also refuse to allow you to use it for a time—around 24 hours—if you fail to reach your original destination.
objects.title: The Improbable Stair (The Keys to the Kingdom)

objects.text:
Tune on in. You are now attuned to the Transmission, a nightmarish eldritch force that infects anything with a screen.

You start as the equal of Mono, capable of teleporting between nearby TVs (or similar devices) as long as you can fit your body through the screen and manipulating technology through touch, though this control is limited to what an experienced user with no backdoor access could do. The Transmission also allows you to distort space within your immediate vicinity to move things closer or further from you. Lastly, you gain the Transmission-powered scream of the Viewers, which disintegrates matter through sustained exposure.

This power comes at a cost, however; the Transmission is both intelligent and actively malevolent, and by using its power you spread its influence over others and yourself. Watch your screen time.
objects.title: Transmission (Little Nightmares)

addons.text:
Your Synch Power merges with the Action Command to create the Bros Moves and Bros Attack blocks, allowing you and your partner to perform special attacks at the pinnacle of teamwork, trust, and good ol’ wacky toon force. These can cost BP, FP, SP, etc, which you and your partner have a starting amount of 20 to 25 each. 

The cost and power of a Bros Attack depends on your overall relationship, compatibility, and creativity. You start with two Bros Attacks each, with more possible as you deepen your Synch. When performing them, both of you must work together to pass the QTE with your respective buttons for maximum payoff. 

The inflicted damage of a Bros Attack scales with its overall power, spectacle of performance, and how much you push the bar on toon force. Kicking a shell like a pinball before smashing it into your foe is cool, and it’ll do good damage, but pales in comparison to doing the same thing with a soccer ball charged with the energy of a supernova. Now that is cool!

Outside of battle, you and your partner can perform Bros Moves, wacky little maneuvers that are carried by toon force. From spinning in a ladder formation to hover across gaps, mimic a spring jump, smashing one of your heads for shrinkage, a ball formation to roll through pipes, etc.

But wait, this power isn’t limited to just two partners. You can have a party of four, and swap one out for another. As your Synch and overall bonds flourish, your Bros Moves and Attacks become more complex, wacky, impossibly effective, and absolutely devastating. Also, your cap in SP/ BP/FP increases to accommodate this.
addons.title: Bros Moves

addons.text:
If you squint slightly, you’ll see an audience watching your battles. If you perform something cool during these bouts, they’ll cheer and reward you for a good show. The first method to perform a stunt in the middle or end of your attacks, called a Stylish Move. 

Performing attacks of grandeur, like  Bros Attacks, also fuel their excitement. The last method is to “Appeal” to them, whether through posing, catchphrases, stunts, etc. This is wasting a turn, but the easiest method.

The cheers of the audience fuels you with a proportional increase in your stats. Your HP and BP/FP/SP can be refreshed in small doses, but this is random. Any gauges like Star Power, or Badges are consistently and largely refueled. Other rewards of being Stylish involve the audience throwing items to you, extra damage and defense, and learning variations of attacks you can “save” as an additional combat option.
addons.title: Stylish

addons.text:
Your technological expertise unlocks the Gear block, allowing you to view a treasure chest of Badges, Battle Plugs, Battle Cards, Clothing, Shoes, Hammers, Gloves, and other attachments that aid you in battle via status effects, buffs, debuffs, failsafes, and more. You can access this in and out of battle to customize to your heart’s content, but counts as wasting a turn in battle.

You start with one “field” of Gear like the above mentioned and can learn the other fields overtime, even combine them. All Gear works exactly how it did in their respective games, with some overlap possible. 

If you took Magitech, you start with some basic Gear you’ll find at the beginning or quarter point of a Mario RPG, which can improve with your tinkering in time. Taking Across the Rainbow Road rewards you with more variety to choose from, and an additional field of Gear, with the kind you’d obtain at the halfway point or slightly later in a Mario RPG.

Taking both improves the gear to be the kind found at the 75% mark, where the final boss is hinted or schemes are in motion, but suspense is still in the air for the player and the heroes.
addons.title: Gear

addons.text:
Just like how Mario and Luigi are the ultimate sibling duo, so are you and your Perfect Companion. The bond you share is absolutely perfect and unbreakable, you both seamlessly flow from one action to the next, your ideas become aligned with the path to victory, and watching yourselves in action is a spectacle even gods will be honored to witness firsthand. 

All actions performed alongside your Perfect Companion are effortless, no matter how much the QTE sequences try to throw you off. If you have the Bros Moves addon, your Synch Power is always at 100%, because you're just that good. The same doesn't apply to other companions, but bonding and growing their Synch cap is much easier.

This boost applies to other addons and upgrades related to the Action Command, that involve teamwork. Also, just because you're already the Perfect Team, doesn't stop you from further improvement.
addons.title: Brothership

addons.text:
You can use the powers offered by the Star Spirits and/or Crystal Stars at full potential and beyond, using QTE sequences to amplify their already potent powers. Also, you gain the Star Power Gauge to use their abilities as many times as you please, as long as you can pay their equivalent cost in Star Power.

You generate Star Power passively or through successful Action Commands that fill the gauge in proportion to your performance, and can spend it to perform the Special Move you wish. These abilities possess the potential to go beyond their simple purposes in the Paper Mario Games, such as developing new abilities or upgrading old ones. All abilities available are listed in a new block that depicts them.

Finally, you learn the Focus ability to charge one bar of Star Power in exchange for a turn.
addons.title: Star Child

addons.text:
Just like how Paper Mario attracts many colorful companions that aid him throughout his journey, so you do. Furthermore, they become instantly proficient with the Action Command to some degree, with some starting abilities based on their background, character, or path in training, and a few unique ones exclusive to them. New ones tailored to them, that also synergize with your team can be developed overtime.

Additionally, you gain an awareness of where to find such companions. Subtly nudging you in the right direction to their exact location, even conspiring events that allow you meet them on friendly terms, or at the right time.
addons.title: Partners

objects.text: You gain the foundational ability of the Mario RPG games, encompassing the titles of Super Mario RPG, the Mario & Luigi series, and Paper Mario series. You have 4 blocks laying dormant above your head, or in your mind. By “selecting” one and then an option available, you automatically perform it on autopilot, regardless of your actual condition. With the twist of timing your actions with a QTE of the A, B, X, or Y buttons. A successful QTE yields greater results such as higher damage, reinforced defense, counters, and dodging. This scales with a series of onomatopoeia in the order of weakest to strongest: OK, GOOD, GREAT! and EXCELLENT!! Failure halts the process, and you will suffer some form of backlash, like tripping, getting dizzy, or your enemy damaging you. Speaking of enemies, this power activates when engaged in combat, giving options for attacks and maneuvers you can perform, with a slowed perception that gives you more than enough time to make a decision, regardless of current situation. You start with the following blocks: “Attack” — A basic attack that hits your targeted enemy up to twice. Like a punch, jump, kick, etc. “Weapon” — A single attack that involves some form of weapon. Like a hammer, sword, gun, bow, etc. ”Item” — Instantly consumes, or uses any item in an infinite, pocket dimension inventory. Like drinking potions, throwing bombs, or eating food. ”Flee” — Acts on the most optimal route of escape available. If you fail the button press for this, you will lose a small portion of your currency, or other resources. After performing your action, you must wait a cooldown of 5 to 10 seconds to do another. This is typically spent defending against your enemies. You can share this power with a second person.
objects.title: Action Command (Super Mario)

addons.text:
Your Fear Value is off the charts! People trust in your fear—and fear how they trust you—creating an endless feedback loop.

Your fans’ Fear and Trust are each equal to that of a hundred normal people. That’s not even counting the rare few zealot fans—a single zealot fan is worth a thousand ordinary followers!

With this, you gain the power of a god unbound. Theoretically, your only limit is what people believe you are capable of.

At the starting level, however, you gain all the powers of Zero, the first Hero—and Villain—of the To Be Hero X universe.
addons.title: Zero

objects.text:
You have been granted a modified version of the legendary Trust System — the same metaphysical force that powers the mightiest heroes of another world. Unlike the original, which is volatile and fully dependent on perception, this version has been stabilized to grant lasting strength without compromising your identity.

This power allows you to draw strength not from bloodlines, training, gods, or technology — but from belief. Through Trust, your abilities are shaped, enhanced, and even created by the confidence, admiration, and expectations others place in you. Your legend becomes a source of power; your reputation, a weapon.

So long as others believe you can do something, you can. If they believe you can walk through storms, survive the vacuum of space, or cut through fate itself — you will. The greater the faith in you, the stronger your reality-warping potential.

Each legendary act, rumor, or tale surrounding you feeds this power. With time, new abilities may emerge — some spontaneously, based on what the world imagines you can do. Even falsehoods, if sincerely believed, can become truth through you.

You also gain a supernatural awareness of how others perceive you, and can actively draw upon positive emotions — trust, awe, admiration — to bolster your strength in real time. In the presence of those who believe in you deeply, your powers may temporarily surge to overwhelming levels.

However, if you fail, betray expectations, or are defamed, the flow of belief weakens. You will lose the ability to gain new powers through Trust until that belief is restored. But unlike the original system, all powers you’ve already manifested remain permanently. Once belief has made them real, they are carved into your essence.

Additionally, your personality remains fully intact. The trust others place in you will never distort your thoughts, identity, or will. You are the wielder of Trust — not its prisoner.

They believe in you. And so, impossibility believes in you, too.
objects.title: Trust (To Be Hero X)

objects.text: You have a less useful, less powerful version of Eidolon’s power. You can manifest two powers at once, but they typically default to overpowered, crude blaster attacks such as inaccurate giant lasers, irregularly sized massive fireballs, uncontrollable lightning, and others in that vein. If you focus (and mentally whine at your power) enough you can sometimes get other powers like flight, brute ratings, or complimentary powers (like pyrokinesis to direct fires started by your fireballs, for example).
objects.title: Useless Eidolon (Worm Meme Powers CYOA)

addons.text:
Your Quirk and Sigil have triggered an extraordinary mutation. Where before you were limited to a single expression of power based on category, you can now express multiple abilities through a single Sigil.

This transforms the new expressions of power into subcategories, granting new directions for what you’re capable of doing or simply granting new powers instead of altering or evolving your base ability. In exchange for this mutation in the form of a blessing, these new expressions will be significantly weaker than your base power in terms of versatility, range, efficiency, and potency.

Nevertheless, they retain the same potential for evolution, and may eventually equal or even surpass your original power. Additionally, your physical, mental, and spiritual condition scales alongside your Sigil. Finally, the power, efficiency, range, and versatility of your base ability are tripled compared to its original version. The effects of your Quirk receive the same enhancements and changes.
addons.title: Mixed Sigil

objects.text:
You have inherited the power that Darwin Game grants to the players who participate, whether voluntarily or not. Just like Shidou Izaya, you received a single Sigil directly from the World Tree, which is the source of your power, and it is now fully yours embedded into your very essence without being a player or a guardian. It can be presented in 5 distinct categories.

Telekinetic: These are the ones that grant the user the power to manipulate materials, specific objects, or some element of nature like space, water, and others. An example would be being limited to controlling “Chains,” and given the expression of your power, you can manipulate anything that fits your concept. It can only manipulate preexisting things and has an effective range of only 5 meters omnidirectionally.

Metamorphic: They can totally or partially transform the user's body, giving it a quality or shape entirely different from its original form. This can take on characteristics of a normal or mystical creature, even becoming an elemental being, and possibly autobiokinesis.

Mental Control: Grants powers that can directly influence the mind of a specific target and then impose a particular mental condition for a limited duration. This category does not truly grant full mind control unless explicitly stated. The more notable the limitation, the longer-lasting and stronger the mental influence will be.

Scientific Engineering: Allows the user to create any substance. These creations can be made from nothing in exchange for consuming your mental or physical stamina. Another way to create substances is to make them according to the fundamentals of chemistry. For example, creating water from hydrogen and oxygen or directly producing the same substance. The energy cost to create something is proportional to the quantity you produce.

Sensory Expansion: These are powers that affect the user’s mind and perception. This might give you a mental ability to distinguish truth from lies or simply allow you to interact with ghosts.

Regardless of your power’s category, all consume either your mental stamina or physical stamina, and in some cases, they have a time limit for how long they can remain active, a cooldown period, or even a daily usage limit. Sometimes, there may be a mix of all of these.

Your Sigil does not grant any changes to your body, mind, or soul unless explicitly stated. Every time you activate your powers, glowing blue veins will appear across your body or the area where your power is focused. Only you and other Sigil users can see this; optionally, you can make it fully visible and choose to turn it on or off at will.

Keep in mind that depending on the expression and category of the Sigil you possess, it may initially be weak or strong. But all of them share the same opportunity the ability to evolve through training, creativity, and the strength required to overcome your own limits. For example, a simple power that can only spin pencils with no offensive capability can potentially, in the future, mimic the gravitational force of an entire galaxy.

You inherit any Sigil that has been shown or implied in the anime, manga, or novel of the series. Alternatively, you may create your own Sigil. The Sigil grants you the understanding and experience necessary to control your powers, but it is basic and vague.
objects.title: Sigil (Darwin Game)

objects.text:
You’re a Champion, a force of good in the world, who will fight to keep it safe. While this grants you an overall boost, pushing your physical stats into superhuman territory with a single standout feature, like being bullet proof, having super hearing or being strong enough to lift a car. 
The more relevant portion is that you’re a Chosen One. 

If there’s prophecies out there, you’ll be a part of them. If the world’s in need of saving then you’re the one they’ll call, if there’s plot-relevant characters in need of rescuing, then you’ll be within hearing distance when they call for help and The Powers That Be, will frequently call on you for assistance, pushing you into the direction of emerging and present threats. 

This makes sure that as long as you survive and keep fighting you’ll stay relevant in the fight and as such plot-relevant. As you'll become a stalwart protector against evil, that also means that you'll gain the resources necessary to remain in the fight, this can range from gaining allies, power-ups or blessings from The Powers That Be, to gaining magical artifacts and weapons to combat the threats ahead.
objects.title: Champion (Buffyverse)

objects.text:
You’re a Knight, what kind is up to you, as long as it can be described with a single word, though once you’ve chosen a name you can’t change it.

As a Knight you gain your own armor and weapon which will both fit you perfectly and repair itself if damaged. Will have enhanced durability and some way to increase your mobility, like wallrunning or double-jumping. You also gain special moves you can use, like a charged strike  that deals double damage, with practice you can increase your repertoire of such moves. 

Examples include: Shovel Knight, Plague Knight, King Knight and Specter Knight. 
You’ll gain sufficient talent to be worthy of your name and have some kind of special characteristic because of it, a Shovel Knight would be an incredible digger, a Plague Knight capable of concocting all kinds of plagues, a King Knight very charismatic and a Specter Knight stealthy. There are of course plenty of other options limited only by your imagination, such as Propeller Knight who can fly or Tinker Knight who can tinker up all kinds of creations.
objects.title: Knight (Shovel Knight)

objects.text:
You are now a Primal Beast, or simply a Primal—a myth, belief, idea, or concept made real. You can come from existing myths, beliefs that live only in the mind, or ideas that shape how people live in the world. As a creation of the Astals, you don’t understand death, and you can’t die. But if the myth, belief, or idea that you represent is destroyed or taken over by another, you could still be destroyed.

Primals are powerful enough to destroy entire islands.
They can’t be affected by powers that change history or reality because they exist on a different level of existence. Your powers come from the concept you represent. But you can only use one of the six elements: Fire, Water, Earth, Wind, Light, or Dark. The exception to this is the Supreme Primarch who can use all six elements at the same time.

Primals are unchangeable, unless an Astral changes them.
A Primal Beast has two parts: a core and an Astral’s power. By changing the core, an Astral can change how the Primal looks and how strong they are. But you don’t need an Astral to change yourself. You can change your appearance by interacting with your core, adding or removing things like ears, tails, horns, or other features such as  size and height as you like. You can also shift your attributes, making one stronger and another weaker as needed.

Like other primals, you can bless a place with helpful effects. However, unlike other primals, you don’t need to connect with the place to do this. You can pick the type of blessing based on your own powers: Such as, if you have wind powers, you can bring calm winds. If you have water powers, you can create gentle waves. If you have earth powers, you can help plants grow faster and stronger, etc.

Primals can create weapons that have powers linked to their abilities.
You can make weapons that represent one or all of your powers, and these weapons will never be stronger than you. But they will still be very powerful. Since these weapons are made from your own power, they can’t hurt you. You can choose the type of weapon and how it looks.
objects.title: Primal Beast (Granblue Fantasy)

objects.text:
You possess the power to transform corpses into monstrous, bio-engineered entities known as Nomus. 

These creations are vastly enhanced versions of their former selves, capable of wielding multiple Quirks. However, this transformation damages their higher brain functions, leaving them as mindless husks that can only act under the explicit commands of a superior.

The Quirks bestowed upon a Nomu are randomized but will always be usefully aligned with the intended purpose of the creature. For instance, a combat-focused Nomu will manifest abilities tailored for battle. This customization ensures that each Nomu is uniquely suited to its designated role.

Nomus are classified into distinct grades based on their physical augmentations and the number of Quirks they possess: Lower-Tier, Middle-Tier, Upper-Tier, Near High-End, and High-End. Lower-tier Nomus can hold up to three Quirks, while High-End Nomus boast at least ten. Crafting a Nomu varies in complexity; lower-tier Nomus can be created from average human corpses in a matter of hours. However, ascending to higher tiers demands more time, superior-quality corpses, and meticulous preparation—though you possess an intrinsic understanding of the precise requirements for each grade. 

The mental faculties of the nomus as well as the potential for further growth, will show significant improvement the higher the ladder you go, to the point where high end Nomus are considered geniuses, able to figure out all their target weaknesses on the spot.

These bio-engineered abominations are devastatingly powerful. An Upper-Tier Nomu was once capable of challenging and nearly defeating All Might himself. Meanwhile, even four severely weakened High-End Nomus required the combined might of dozens of top professional heroes just to keep them in check. 

Every nomu you create is perfectly loyal only to you, serving you with absolute obedience and relentless dedication.
objects.title: Nomus (My Hero Academia)

objects.text:
You can impose your will upon reality, creating absolute commands upon what you can touch.

You can impose up to two rules either upon anything or anyone you touch, or upon yourself. These rules allow you to manipulate and bestow new properties upon those you affect. This can be simple rules to more complex and conditional ones.

For your power to work, your understanding of what your affecting sense of identity must align with your own. You do not need to verbalize either the name or the rules. You also have a subconscious awareness of the rules you have in place at all times.

This makes it easy for you to manipulate things without a sense of self, such as inanimate objects, as just your own one-sided understanding of it is enough to enforce the rules.

In addition to physical entities such as people, New Order can be used to affect incorporeal things such as the air, laser beams, and even the powers of others, provided you can touch the one you're affecting.

For those with a sense of self, your rules cannot be enforced unless you know of an identity that aligns with the one you’re affecting. This could be their name, or even some kind of vigilant persona they may have taken on that they identify with.

However, if your understanding doesn’t align with theirs, your rule cannot be enforced. This could be a result of you not having the correct name, the one you’re affecting not having an identity that they properly connect with (such as having an identity crisis), or some other reason. This also means that if their sense of identity changes even after you’ve placed a rule on them, the rule can no longer be enforced. Furthermore, your rules cannot be arbitrarily twisted to affect those that you did not also touch.

The rules of New Order are not omnipotent; there are limits to what you can impose and apply, but the limits of what you can do can be waned away with training and effort.

To start with, you’ll be able to do things such as causing the air to disappear 100 meters in front of you, shaping the air into a giant version of yourself that will mimic your movements, catch and manipulate lasers as a corporeal entity, stop someone’s heart, and even enhance yourself to superhuman levels.

You can optionally choose whether this power is a Quirk or from something else.
objects.title: New Order (My Hero Academia)

objects.text: You've awakened your Ability. In UnOrdinary, almost everyone is born with a supernatural ability, which ranges from destructive lasers and energy grenades to invisibility and mind reading. Someone who doesn't have an ability is called a cripple. All abilities require a conscious decision to be activated; however, abilities can be activated on reflex in times of need, such as when you need to defend yourself or dodge an attack. Whenever an ability is used, it usually gives off an aura in the person's hair or eye color—you're free to choose whether to use your hair color, eye color or any color that you feel would suit you. A person's aura flows through Aura Channels which regulates the flow of aura throughout the body. The stronger the flow of aura is, the stronger the ability being used will be. Normally, the aura flow through these channels are self-regulated and cannot be altered, but there are abilities that allow the user to naturally alter their aura flow. Abilities also do not seem to damage the user if used on themselves. For example, users of Explosion aren't hurt by their blast, users of Heat Palm can touch themselves without getting burned, and users of Lightning can coat their body with electricity without getting shocked. You can choose any ability that's shown, referenced, or hinted at in the entirety of UnOrdinary, or it can be an ability that's unique to you. Regardless of the ability chosen, you start at the level of a low-tier along as well as the aura supply to match, but with the potential to go above level 10.0, the highest level in UnOrdinary. With time, training, combat and mastery, you can climb up the levels to the peak of elite-tiers. You need to put in the effort to get stronger and master your ability's every aspect, but rest assured—with enough grit, you can ascend to the top.
objects.title: Ability (UnOrdinary)

objects.text:
You gain control over a metaphysical force similar to the one that fuels Silent Hill—the power to manifest the subconscious. When invoked, the world around you twists into the Fog World or the Otherworld.

Within a radius of several kilometers, you can summon an unnatural fog that muffles sound, distorts vision, and warps space. Those inside may lose their way even on familiar streets. Ambient whispers, phantom footsteps, and distant sirens haunt the air, keeping all who wander trapped in a state of unrelenting paranoia.

At will, you may force the environment to peel away into the Otherworld where you can compel individuals to undergo a trial of their sins. This is no illusion the environment itself reflects the deepest fears, sins, and traumas of those caught within your influence Each victim is confronted with surroundings tailored to their psyche, littered with symbols from their past.

The Otherworld spawns creatures born of subconscious fears, desires, and guilt. They cannot exist outside your domain and are sustained only by the psyche that birthed them. These beings ignore you unless you command otherwise.

Survival these trial bring catharsis and freedom, but failure leads either to mental collapse or eternal entrapment within their own nightmare. Once the trials start you can`t interface in it too much.

As your psychic power grows, so does the reach of this domain. Your domain can also take permanent root in a location. Over time, such places become psychic sinkholes, drawing in wanderers who carry unresolved trauma.

But there are some limitations, the Otherworld cannot manifest without the presence of unresolved guilt or trauma, for it feeds on human darkness. Beyond the bounds of your domain, all manifestations vanish and the world returns to normal—though survivors are left scarred forever.

Once trapped inside only being stronger then you are able to escape without your permission.
objects.title: Silent Hill's Call (Silent Hill)

objects.text:
You have been blessed by a divine intervention. You have been gifted the power of the Infinite Gacha.

It is an object in the shape of a cross where each side is a golden rhombus that keeps afloat a purple sphere located at the center of the structure. The entire figure has no physical structure holding its shape, as if gravity itself were being maintained. A metaphysical manifestation projected from the depths of your being.

By infusing your will into the gacha to manifest something, it will summon a card that contains a brief or detailed description and an image of the element it contains. By breaking the card, it will manifest in reality. This is not a simple temporary manifestation or illusion; on the contrary, it is a real and irreversible materialization.

It can be any type of element from a simple bottle of water to a divine manifestation that acts according to your own will. It can even summon entities of all kinds of origins that will be willing to follow your orders. However, the entities will have their own will, personality, and moralities.

The quantity and quality of the element that is manifested depends on the gacha’s consumption of energy present in the environment or from your own reserves of any type of supernatural energy. The generation of gacha cards is practically random, so you will have to use your ingenuity to decide which ones to take advantage of at the right moment and which ones to waste without any concern.

The relationship between the quantity and quality of the cards and the energy consumption is directly proportional.
objects.title: Infinite Gacha (Mugen Gacha Level 9999)

addons.text:
Your reality warping powers have been escalated, no longer just a descendant but a mighty Terminae, almost completely unrivaled among reality warpers. You possess well above multiversal scale reality warping of utmost power and sub-quantum precision, making you functionally impossible for any mundane threat to oppose.

Furthermore, your physical form embeds and enmeshes itself in the fabric of reality, making you immune to any attacks that do not sunder existence itself by making you a living wrinkle in existence-and where you physically manifest your avatars does not have to be anywhere near the wrinkle that makes up your true core.

Your one potential weakness is that anything with sovereign power over the base substrate of reality can directly interfere with your powers and even suppress your sustaining wrinkle. Think things on the level of the Lovecraftian Outer Gods Azathoth or Yog Sothoth in terms of what might do this. Of course, if there's nothing like that around, you might as well be God now, wouldn't you?
addons.title: Terminae

addons.text:
You have become like unto the Void's plot forces themselves, the Narrative and (pre-shattering) Conflict. More alike to a living physical law of reality itself than anything more mundane. While your scope is relatively limited for now, over time, your reach will worm its way through all corners of existence where you are not contested by similar beings. Wherever your power reaches, your very outlook and desires shall influence the structure of existence just by your mere presence.

Unlike the original plot forces though, you are conscious and able to direct that power with intent. Once you have grown into your full might across countless eons, you will have the capacity to manipulate everything within your domain with minute precision. Fighting you will be little more than fighting existence itself, unto the End Of Man and back.
addons.title: Living Plot Force

objects.text:
You can manifest your imagination into reality, applying just about anything you can think of to the world, whether that be turning a chunk of the battlefield into abstract art, summoning Mechagodzilla, or calling down storms of meteors shaped like rubber ducks to annihilate your enemies. Not only that, it works perfectly intuitively, so changes you make will work exactly like you expect, and you won’t have to worry about accidentally changing something you shouldn’t. It wouldn’t be much of an exaggeration to say that you are wielding limitless power.

That said, this power DOES have a pair of notable downsides to it. First, it is rather ephemeral. While it can be used to immense effect, the immediate applications of Descendancy don’t tend to affect much outside of the immediate time and place of their use, at least without a dedicated and substantial effort from you. You could slam a planet onto another planet, but if you aren’t focusing on affecting the entire planet you’re on, it will somehow only damage things at the point of contact, and the knock-on effects to the environment you’d expect from two planetary masses colliding probably won’t even happen. And, even if you do destroy the planet, it’s even odds it’ll be back together later. Similarly, you can give yourself power-ups and self-upgrades, but unless you put extra work and creativity into making them last, they’ll vanish before long. Secondly, Descendancy tends not to synergize with other powers. It is not boosted by things like amplifiers, power multipliers, focal implements, or even straight-up using other powers to strengthen the Descendancy itself.

For now your abilities are still developing, making it taxing on your body and mind to use Descendancy for prolonged periods, but with time and practice you can reach the point where you’re casually conquering universes with an army of sentient cakes, calling down primordial powers in storms that make galaxies look minute, and finding or inventing layer after layer of new immortalities and godhoods to place upon yourself.
objects.title: Descendancy (Destroy The Godmodder)

objects.text: This ability allows you to repeat recent occurrences to nearby foes that have happened in the last 10 seconds for 50% of the effect or damage, so long as it is negative. To trigger the ability, you must click a stopwatch. Any stopwatch can do, so long as it can be clicked. Events that have already been repeated, or repeating events, can't be repeated.
objects.title: Restage (Elden Ring: Nightreign)

objects.text:
At any point - most critically in moments of conflict or danger - you can mentally activate "Frame-By-Frame" Mode. Time instantly grinds to a complete halt from your personal perspective. You are not moving faster; the flow of time itself is paused solely for your deliberation.

While time is stopped, you gain the ability to run mental simulations. You can select any "move" you can perform (a punch, a dodge, a spell, activating another power, etc.) and mentally project the ghostly, full-motion trajectory of that action. You can then select a hypothetical move from your opponent (based on their current stance, momentum, and known capabilities) and see a simulated "clash" play out.

This simulation visually shows the trajectories, positions, and physical outcomes for both of you - who connects, who dodges, where you both end up, and the resulting forces (knockback, stun, etc.). The simulation offers a perfect physics-based prediction of the outcome, provided you correctly anticipate your opponent's action.

You may spend as long as you need to test different combinations of your moves against their possible moves. Once you have found a sequence you are satisfied with, you "lock in" your decision. Time resumes instantly. Your body then executes the chosen move with flawless, mechanically perfect timing and technique.

You cannot reactivate this power until you have finished your move and have the opportunity to make the next one. You can, however, reactivate Frame Perfect at the precise instant you regain control (e.g., after the follow-through of a punch, just as your foot lands from a dash, or after a spell leaves your hand).

If you can make several moves at once, you take another turn each time you get the opportunity to make a move, even if you're already in the middle of another move.

Note that once you've locked in a move, you cannot interrupt it (though the enemy can).

Your tactical prowess fuels a tangible internal resource known as the Level Meter. This gauge of raw combat momentum builds with every success: landing blows, narrowly evading attacks, and outmaneuvering your foe.

Expending a Level allows you to perform a Super Action that bends conventional limits: an undodgeable attack, an instantaneous invocation of a complex spell, or a perfect counter that defies the normal order of action and reaction.

You can, of course, simulate these rule-breaking maneuvers before you commit, ensuring your Level is always spent for maximum impact.

You also gain the ability to mildly influence the direction you're knocked in, allowing you to fine-tune your trajectory or landing point even mid-air.

Be sure to set up a camera. The real-time replays are incredible.
objects.title: Frame Perfect (Your Only Move Is HUSTLE)

addons.text:
3 minutes isn't a lot of time to get somewhere, but now with your magic map, you can go anywhere you're aware of, or that your powers and items would let you become aware of, and Dash will draw you a fast-as-possible route right in that direction. And instead of making you do it as one big level, it'll put together a cluster of multiple 60 to 90 second levels, the end of each of which will act as a checkpoint so that each leg of your journey can be retried separately as you go instead of having to start from the beginning each time you fail. 

This has a couple of extra effects too: First, Dash gains greater travel efficiency the longer your journey is, taking advantage of existing transportation methods or cutting across large swaths of empty space in high speed 'transitions'. A harder place to reach will still take longer, but your overall speed will increase as the length of the journey does, making long enough trips go orders of magnitude faster while Dashing than you could go under your other powers. 

And secondly, every time you successfully complete an entire series of levels in an extended trip with Dash, you'll receive a payout consisting of cash, a cosmetic option or two for your Dash forms, and a few 'shards of power' which are crystals of elementally charged energy that can be used in tandem with things you've purchased in this CYOA to temporarily boost their abilities in relation to the expended shards' element or to temporarily reflavor it to operate more in line with the element while the boost lasts. 'Gauntlet rewards' increase in quantity for longer and more difficult journeys.
addons.title: Worm Gauntlet

addons.text: Well you already have the ability to loop time... The retry cooldown has now been removed, and, when you retry a level that Dash has generated, time will automatically rewind back to the start (as if using the Time-Loop power) and ensuring minimal changes to the level, ensuring that, as in the game that inspired this power, you are able to try over and over again as many times as you want in order to memorize and master your route. This effect does not move your Time-Loop anchor forward on use.
addons.title: Geometry Crash

objects.text:
Pick a destination you are aware of that could be reached if you traveled in a straight line at a reasonably fast pace (for you) for three minutes or less. You will transform into a roughly human sized decorated cube, and launch towards your destination with musical accompaniment, with a variety of form changing portals and momentum altering interaction dots appearing along the way to ensure that you can get to your target-essentially turning your brief journey into a fully synced and fleshed out Geometry Dash level in the real world.

A few notes on how this works. First, you are as fragile as normal for a geometry dash level-if you hit an obstacle your form will shatter and you will reappear at your starting point then need to wait 3 seconds before trying again. Finishing a 'level' applies no such limits, allowing you to chain destinations if the place you want to go is more than 3 minutes away by geometry dash.

Second, levels take place in the actual distance you are trying to cover and moreso will be predictively assembled to scale its difficulty to the difficulty of traveling that distance in one piece normally. Trying to get down an ordinary street in a hurry will probably be trivial, trying to get past a violently enraged Scion might give you a level that's only beatable in theory. 

Third and finally, changes in the environment will result in changes in the level you're attempting-if there's anything sentient or notably reactive like a security system in the path to your destination expect the level layout to change at least a little every time you try it! Sometimes it might be better to just fight your way through, even if that's slower and risks actual injury.
objects.title: Dash (Geometry Dash)

objects.text:
You possess the physiology of a Plant—an artificially engineered immortal lifeform capable of manipulating and dismantling Planck lengths to create and command both matter and energy. Though still a juvenile and far from the full potential of your kind, your abilities are already formidable. You can wield powerful dynakinesis, manipulate gravity, and even generate micro black holes through the use of negative energy. You can teleport across vast distances, and reshape your own biology to regenerate, shapeshift, or absorb other entities. Additionally, you can infuse your energy into objects, much like Vash’s Black Hole Bullets.

These abilities culminate in the manifestation of your Angel Arm—a biological weapon of staggering power. The Angel Arm can transform between a massive cannon that fires devastating energy blasts and a razor-thin blade capable of slicing through dimensions. It can also manifest Angel Wings, tendril-like extensions that act as autonomous offense and defense systems, functioning even when you are unconscious. For additional protection, you can generate forcefields strong enough to repel attacks from other Angel Arms.

The Angel Arm’s power extends beyond the physical: it can read minds, manipulate memories, control actions, and even obliterate consciousness itself. Combined, these abilities allow you to annihilate opponents on both a physical and mental level.

However, your powers come with a critical weakness—limited energy reserves. The immense power required to wield your Angel Arm drains your life force, and overexertion can leave you completely depleted—or even prove fatal.
objects.title: Juvenile Plant (Trigun)

addons.text: You begin your journey already at the level of a Sequence Four Beyonder within the Pathway of your choosing. Upon choosing your Pathway, you immediately gain the corresponding characteristics and abilities, along with mastery over their use. You can choose for your Mythical Creature Form to follow the natural design of your Pathway or alter it into a unique form of your own creation, allowing full freedom in how your essence manifests. The loss of control and strain once tied to your Mythical Creature Form are now greatly reduced, and you will now always be able to recover from any potentially harmful effects. Your grasp of mystical principles equals that of high-sequence Beyonders, granting you the capability to perform advanced rituals, create mystical items such as charms, and possess advanced spiritual perception that allows you to perceive the world directly through your soul, bypassing the physical world to gain deeper and more detailed information. You possess exceptional affinity and talent within your Pathway, enabling you to reach Sequence Zero within only a few years of focused advancement. If you possess the True Mythical Creature upgrade, you begin at Sequence Two of your chosen Pathway instead, with all corresponding traits, powers, and the capabilities inherent to a complete Mythical Creature.
addons.title: Sequence Four Initiate

addons.text: Having crossed the Abyss and grasped higher knowledge of the universe’s underlying principles, your Mythical Creature Form is no longer incomplete or unstable at the beginning. Instead, you begin at the equivalent of Sequence Two, corresponding to that of an Angel, where you have fully achieved your Mythical Creature Form becoming your true form. All corresponding traits, powers, and capabilities are elevated to match this level with all the inherent drawbacks removed. As a result of crossing the Abyss and your true self elevating to a higher level, your consciousness now exists as a unified whole, indivisible even within a consciousness space or under similar circumstances. Your higher knowledge grants you full understanding and mastery of the powers, symbolism, and structure of your own Mythical Creature Form. Through this, you can now freely shape its structure, traits, and expression, altering it into any form you desire. If you possess the True Mythical Creature upgrade, you instead begin at Sequence One, existing as one on the level of a King of Angels, though without a Uniqueness. If you possess a Uniqueness, you may choose to immediately ascend further, becoming Sequence Zero, a true god, with all traits, powers, and capabilities elevated accordingly. Finally, if you possess Sequence Four Initiate, the Pathway chosen, can be elevated to match your current Sequence in full.
addons.title: Da’at Ascendant

addons.text:
The spirit of the Oldest One elevates your Mythical Creature Form to an entirely different level. You can manifest it freely and maintain it for any duration without strain, exhaustion, or the need for recovery. Its use does not damage your mind or spirit, and you do not lose control while it is active. You possess a unified consciousness, indivisible even within a consciousness space or similar circumstances. Destruction of your physical vessel does not harm your Mythical Creature Form, and so long as even the faintest remnant of your will or spirit remains, you will reform.

You possess clear awareness of the structure, symbols, and concepts that compose your form and can modify them at will. Its traits, abilities, and expressions follow your intent, allowing you to change its design, adjust its properties, and determine what effects it releases into the surroundings. The spiritual pressure and knowledge it emits can be regulated, suppressed, or focused only on chosen targets, and you now gain control and influence over the information of yourself and how it is reflected across planes such as the Spirit World. Your form also inherits the presence and traits of the Original Creator, and its spirituality and knowledge when perceived, can cause corruption of body and mind of beings at the level of gods and is even capable of affecting Great Old Ones.

Your starting Sequence does not change, but the limits on its growth are removed. It will continue developing beyond the level of an Angel toward the standard of a Pillar and potentially approach the level of the Original Creator. As you advance, its authority and complexity deepen accordingly, as your existence becomes closer to the primordial source.
addons.title: Incarnation of the Primordial Creator

objects.text:
You possess the power to manifest your Mythical Creature Form, an elevated and symbolic embodiment of your true self that merges your essence and powers. This form is the reflection of your inner nature and authority, the living manifestation of who you are.

When invoked, your existence transcends its human limits, reshaping into a mythical entity born from your powers and essence. Its form differs for every individual, defined by your nature and the concepts that compose you. One might appear as a being of blinding flame and sacred light, another as an immense shadow that silences all sound, or as an existence so alien and ineffable that perception itself bends in its presence. Whatever the form, it is a direct expression of who you are.

The very existence of a Mythical Creature Form is a potential catastrophe. Its manifestation floods the surroundings with overwhelming spirituality and incomprehensible knowledge, forcing complex truths directly into the minds and souls of all who perceive it. This influx of information bypasses perception entirely, inflicting damage according to the target’s mental and spiritual strength. Even a brief glance can tear the minds of ordinary beings apart, their souls unable to withstand the sudden influx of corruptive higher knowledge forced into them, often causing physical mutation as their forms distort under the strain. Only those who have sufficiently high mental or spiritual strength to withstand the flood of knowledge and symbols, and the physical resistance and durability to endure the resulting mutations, will be capable of resisting its effects. Those that survive may retain fragments of what they glimpsed, gaining partial understanding or distorted insight into higher truths. However, such knowledge often forms a spiritual link between them and your existence, making them vulnerable to corruption or influence. The nature of these effects often mirrors the essence of your form, such as the mutations in those who witness it reflecting its nature.

A Mythical Creature Form is not something that can be described superficially or within the confines of three-dimensional understanding. Apart from quantitative terms such as length, width, and height, it is a convergence of complex knowledge, godhood characteristics, and secret symbols. In form, where a dragon’s scales would be grey-white, a Mythical Creature Form’s scales are symbols that represent grey-white; where flesh would be solid, patterns and meanings interlock. As you grow in strength, these characteristics, symbols, and concepts become more intricate and complex, making their effects grow far more potent and irresistible. Minds without sufficient strength cannot properly comprehend these layers, and the strain could very likely cause the threat of collapse.

You begin with only an incomplete Mythical Creature Form, able to temporarily assume it for a few seconds at most. Sustaining it for extended periods is excruciating, as the weight of its power quickly overwhelms you, threatening to erode your reason and turn you into a monster in truth. Overuse can cause severe damage to your spirit if you do not allow yourself to recover. Even so, its use grants tremendous strength, elevating your physique and recoverability, spiritual capacity, and resistance to both physical and supernatural forces, while drastically amplifying the strength and effects of all your powers and abilities. Despite this overwhelming power, there remains a very real risk of losing control over yourself and your abilities if you overextend your limits without rest.

You may also partially manifest your Mythical Creature Form, transforming only specific parts of your body, such as your arms, eyes, or head, for less strain. Even these minor manifestations carry a trace of the form’s true nature, releasing waves of spirituality and concepts potent enough to cause fatal harm to the minds of those who look upon them.

As your power deepens, your Mythical Creature Form evolves alongside you toward completion, becoming more stable and natural. Eventually, you may attain that completion and become a true Mythical Creature, corresponding to Sequence 2, often referred to as an Angel, where your Mythical Creature Form is no longer a transformation but your true self.
objects.title: Mythical Creature Form (Lord of the Mysteries)

addons.text: "In the beginning there was darkness. Until someone set themselves aflame. Only then did the universe know light." You bear the Ancient Name Tumaini, meaning "Hope." Your presence alone inspires courage and resilience in your allies, while instilling dread and fear in your enemies. Wherever you go, you are welcomed—even in worlds where the residents or gods might resist your arrival. You thrive in dire situations, especially where hope or salvation seems absent, often succeeding against overwhelming odds. You can also be resurrected through your ancient name by any member of your race or someone using the sacred flame. As the Bearer of the Ancient Name Tumaini, you share this title with Aether and Lumine if they are your Siblings. This bond grants you access to their knowledge and powers, including any new abilities they acquire—primarily elemental ones—after inheriting the name. You gain mastery over the pyro energy and Night Soul powers of Natlan, even if you have not yet visited that world. Furthermore, you inherit the powers, memories, and knowledge of any future bearer of the Ancient Name Tumaini. Your mere presence strengthens your allies in battle, enhancing their abilities and providing a passive area-of-effect (AOE) healing aura when needed. Your own powers are significantly amplified, with fire-based attacks and abilities boosted by 50–75% in power, output, and strength. As a living embodiment of hope and salvation, you are often able to turn the tide in battles, quests, or moments of great need—though even you may face challenges beyond your strength. Your deeds earn you renown in the worlds and nations you save. In Natlan, you are recognized immediately upon your arrival, and your reputation precedes you, ensuring respect and acknowledgment wherever your journey takes you.
addons.title: Tumaini

addons.text:
Your Sweet Home has evolved due to your status as a member of the same race as Aether and Lumine. Previously, you could naturally create a sanctuary similar to an Adeptus Teapot, which acted as both a refuge and a traveling home. While functional, it was far from ideal. Now, your Sweet Home and previous sanctuary have fused and been replaced with the Traveling Home, a vastly improved version. It retains all the benefits of the Adeptus Teapot and The Sweet Home but introduces new features, such as the ability to adapt its surroundings to match any world you’ve previously visited, along with many other unknown features.

The Traveling Home allows you to create keys for guests, enabling them to visit you from any universe. However, these keys only grant access to your Traveling Home; guests cannot use it to travel between worlds. If someone wishes to travel across worlds, they must become a True Guest, which bestows upon them the same protections you enjoy, including an increased lifespan, it wont fully match yours, but they will live longer.

As its owner, you no longer need a key to enter your Traveling Home. You can simply will yourself inside, where you’ll arrive on a serene starter island surrounded by a beautiful sea. From this point, you can create new islands, expand existing ones, alter the surroundings, or even redesign the house itself. You are free to come and go as you please, and no one can detect or enter the Traveling Home without your explicit permission.

For ease of travel, you can create beacons or waypoints, similar to those in Teyvat, and place them in worlds you’ve visited. These allow you to instantly travel between your home, other beacons, and your current location, eliminating the need for lengthy journeys back to previous worlds. Expanding your home—whether by adding new rooms, furniture, or other features—requires energy and, for more luxurious additions, specific materials. You can also modify the rules governing your Traveling Home to suit your needs.  Waypoints will require a tremendous amount of energy to create, and they must be placed in the worlds you wish to place them in, also just like your Traveling Home, they cannot be seen or detected. 

When traveling between worlds, you can retreat into your Traveling Home and rest while in transit. During this time, an outer shell will envelop your home, resembling a shooting star or any form of your choosing. Regardless of its size, the shell will fit your entire Traveling Home. While inside, you can view your surroundings in full 360 degrees, sense external conditions, and even take control of the shell’s movements, granting you unparalleled control over your journey.

You can also create entry points for vehicles, allowing visitors to arrive with your permission. As the Third Traveler , you have the option to grant any member of your race an all-access key, giving them full rights to your Traveling Home. Alternatively, you may choose to create separate Traveling Homes for them in the future.
addons.title: A Traveler's Home

addons.text:
You have gained your very own Paimon, just like The Traveler in Teyvat. However, this version of Paimon is unique, with the ability to change form and appearance as part of the Perfect Companion trait. You may choose to keep the name Paimon or give your companion a new name to suit your preference. Equipped with an omniversal library containing knowledge from every world in existence, your Paimon is the ultimate guide for navigating your journey across worlds.

In addition to being your guide, Paimon is a valuable resource for understanding and utilizing your powers. No matter the abilities you possess—whether innate or acquired through addons—Paimon will have the knowledge to assist. If you're a blacksmith, Paimon can provide details on materials and methods for crafting specific objects of power. If you wish to create entirely new abilities for others, Paimon can guide you through the process. From materials and energy to tips and techniques, Paimon is your go-to companion for all power-related information.  

Loyalty is at the core of Paimon’s nature, she will always come to your aid in times of need. If ever destroyed, Paimon will reform, returning in peak condition and ready to continue the journey with you.

Paimon is more than a guide—she is your ally, your partner, and your friend. Treat her well, for as The Traveler, it is only fitting that you have your very own Paimon by your side.
addons.title: Your Very Own Paimon

addons.text:
As The Traveler, you naturally possessed an inventory space. While it was functional, it was limited to holding a modest amount of armor, weapons, supplies, food, water, and currency. However, with the merging of your natural inventory and the enhanced Inventory system, it has transformed into a boundless subspace. This Inventory now provides infinite slots, capable of storing endless quantities of anything you desire—armor, weapons, food, water, currency, or everyday essentials.

Each slot in the Inventory is dedicated to a specific item. For example, placing steak in one slot allows it to hold an unlimited amount of steak, but nothing else. Similarly, a slot for water will only hold water. Individual armor pieces and weapons occupy their own slots, with duplicates or identical items stacking seamlessly within the same space.

Your Inventory interface appears mentally, organized into tabs and pages. For instance, the first page may list food slots, while the second organizes armor. You can also physically enter the Inventory Subspace at will, provided you are not in battle. This subspace manifests as a corridor of rooms, each representing a page of slots. One room might house crates of food, while another displays endless racks of armor or weapons. Currency could fill a vault-like chamber. Notably, you can enter this space even when being pursued, using it as a safe haven where no one can follow. Outside the subspace, the Inventory can be controlled entirely through your thoughts via the interface.

As a Classic adventurer, your interface also includes equipment slots corresponding to your body: head, chest, arms, legs, feet, hands, and accessory slots. Switching gear is effortless—equip armor or weapons instantly with a thought or by navigating the interface. You can create and modify presets for quick changes, with separate tabs for everyday clothing and combat gear. Each slot accommodates items with unique effects or no effects at all, depending on your needs.

Thanks to Transmogrification, you can customize the appearance of your gear. Favorite outfits can be worn indefinitely while maintaining the effects of your equipped armor. You can even activate both clothing and armor tabs simultaneously, allowing armor effects to apply invisibly beneath your casual attire. For added convenience, an inventory bar provides quick access to weapons and tools, enabling seamless switching between items.

This is the quintessential adventurer’s interface, and it may hold hidden features yet to be discovered. Good luck, Traveler.
addons.title: Travelers Interface

addons.text:
You are no longer merely an Emanator of Akivili. With Akivili’s disappearance, the role of the Trailblaze Aeon is now vacant—and as Akivili’s sole Emanator, you have ascended to take that place. You are now a full Aeon, though vastly different from most others. While Aeons are typically universal concepts given form, your nature as a Traveler extends beyond the limits of a single universe. You are the omniversal embodiment of Trailblazing, Traveling, Traversal, and all related concepts. Your gaze stretches across countless worlds and layers of the omniverse, and those deemed worthy may walk the path of the Nameless under your guidance. All who have ever walked this path—before, during, and after Akivili’s disappearance—are now your Nameless.

Unlike most Aeons, you and Akivili share a rare trait: the desire to walk among your followers. You are not a distant, untouchable entity but a mentor, a guide, a parent, a friend—someone who travels alongside the Nameless. No matter where you go in the omniverse, they can always follow.

As the new Trailblaze Aeon, you inherit Akivili’s memories and knowledge while retaining your own sense of self. You may use their name as an Aeon while keeping your human name when adopting a mortal form. Unlike most Aeons, you are not bound to a singular identity and can define your own gender—or choose to have none at all. As the creator of the Astral Express, you hold the power to forge entire fleets, sending them out into the omniverse to connect distant worlds through the Star Rails. You can travel freely between every Astral Express, ensuring that you remain among the Nameless. Additionally, all abilities you possessed as an Emanator remain intact, now amplified by your ascension. If you bore an Ancient Name that aligned with your role, its power is also retained and enhanced.

Now that you embody Trailblazing itself, you are unkillable so long as the concepts of Travel, Trailblazing, and Traversal exist—and as long as your followers walk the path, you remain an absolute, unwavering presence. Your power allows you to absorb and integrate new concepts, evolving into a multi-concept Aeon, though such growth is a near-impossible feat requiring endless time. You can also create lesser avatars—Emanators or Pathstriders—to act on your behalf as needed.

As the Trailblaze Aeon, you alone define the characteristics, ideals, and requirements for one to become Nameless. You also hold the authority to strip your favor from any follower, returning them to their human state. Any changes regarding your concept are yours to command. However, be mindful of one consequence: everywhere you travel, Star Rails will form, linking worlds, dimensions, layers, and subspaces throughout the omniverse. This may inadvertently allow other Aeons, or even new concepts, to rise—potentially creating Aeons as vast in reach as yourself.  Wherever you go Imaginary energy shall follow giving rise to countless new paths.  

Take heed the only beings that would be able to harm you or do anything to you are those who are also the embodiment of a concept like great red, ophis, and other aeons, gods and similar beings will find themselves struggling against you.

Rejoice for a New Era approaches, you alone can travel anywhere and everywhere, connecting all worlds to one another, Let your ascension announce the start of a New Era of Prosperity.
addons.title: Trailblazer Ascension

addons.text:
You are an existence that defies reason—one that should not exist. Your origins remain shrouded in mystery, with no known parentage, yet you have somehow inherited Ichor, the divine blood. Beyond that, as an Omniversal Traveler, you are a Demigod intrinsically connected to the very will of the Omniverse. This grants you limitless potential, setting you on a path to surpass all gods and beings over time.

All constraints have been shattered. There are no limits to hold you back, no shackles to restrain your growth. However, true divinity is not simply given—it must be earned. To reach godhood, you must train, fight, and continuously push yourself beyond your current strength. Battles, sparring, and relentless perseverance will fuel your ascent. Worship and faith will serve as the catalyst for your rise, but for your legend to take root, your name must spread across countless worlds. As a result of your unique existence, all previous enhancements from your divine blood and demigod status are doubled, with each milestone in strength further amplifying them.

Because of the impossibility of your existence, no realm is beyond your reach. You can travel anywhere safely—through realities, layers, subspaces, and even the divine realms of the afterlife. No force can seal you, and in most situations where death seems inevitable, the will of the Omniverse itself will intervene in your favor. Your skills, abilities, and weapons have been strengthened beyond their previous limits, allowing your arsenal to deal immense damage to even the most powerful beings.

Upon your evolution into a True God, every feat, deed, and legend associated with you will be woven into your divine essence, shaping the domains you will embody. You will stand as an omniversal force, akin to the Aeons and the very aspects of reality itself. Your worshippers will become devoted followers—priests, saints, and believers—spreading your influence across the vast Omniverse. Your primary domain will be Traveling, Traversal, and Trailblazing, much like an Aeon. You will have the power to bestow blessings upon others through your Gaze, granting them a fraction of your might. However, with divinity comes restriction. Your full power can only be wielded when truly necessary, forcing you to act through avatars and followers.

Upon ascension, you will gain a divine sanctuary—a personal realm that will expand with worship, faith, and the passage of time. This domain will serve as your refuge and stronghold within the Omniverse. Once you attain godhood, you will also have the ability to share your divine blood, creating beings akin to demigods with the potential to ascend themselves, thus forming the foundation of your own pantheon.

If you are an Emanator, your divine Ichor will seamlessly merge with your nature, accelerating your path to ascension as a being that embodies both God and Aeon. However, your existence is an anomaly, and gods or similar entities will recognize this the moment they encounter you. Many will either see you as a threat or an ally, hostility will be inevitable when meeting arrogant beings. You must be prepared to face powerful enemies and endure until the moment of your destined ascension.
addons.title: The Traveler's Divinity

addons.text:
You, who have traversed the stars and walked countless worlds, witnessing the rise and fall of civilizations, have accomplished something beyond what was foretold. Interloper, you have reached the Cocoon of Finality before any other and embraced its power, transforming into something far greater than what you once were—a force of destruction, yet also a force of balance. You now stand beyond both the Original Cocoon and Kiana in power.

With this transformation, you have come to understand that all things must come to an end. You have embraced Finality itself, yet you have only just emerged from the cocoon, and your journey has only just begun.  

As the Desender of Finality, you can freely use the full scope of authority you obtained by merging with the cocoon of Finality. However, while you begin with planetary output in time and effort, you can increase this far beyond the cocoon of Finality.

As all things must come to an end, you gain the ability to create new authorities suitable for bringing an end to any enemy or opponent. This, however, is time-consuming, and while you can force this process through raw power, it will leave you fully drained of energy. These new authorities must be connected to Finality in one way or another, be it the end of reason to incite madness or the end of ignorance to bestow knowledge.

As a traveler, a being known as a Descender, you are an entity foreign to all worlds—akin to an Outer God, yet never entirely at the level of one. Your very existence and the natural Honkai energy within you are disruptive to civilization, but you can also be a force of peace and good due to your control over Reason and Truth. Tread carefully, for your presence alone can alter the course of worlds. However, if you so choose, you may grant resistance or even immunity to the Honkai to those you deem worthy.
