You embody the essence of Honkai, for you are the inevitable collapse of all things. Once bound to planetary limits, you now stand unshackled, with infinite potential for growth through training and the acquisition of new cores.

You are Finality, not someone who merely wields the powers of Finality; you are the concept, the idea of Finality, Akin to The Endless and Other Omniversal Beings. As a newborn abstract existence, you can reach levels of power where you might as well be omnipotent to lesser lifeforms.

Know this—your potential extends beyond even this path.
addons.title: Descender of Finality

addons.text:
You are the embodiment of the first Light that ever existed, the primal force that sparked creation itself. As the source of all light, your essence transcends the omniverse. You begin as a demigod, but your potential is limitless, growing as you develop. Over time, your Light expands to touch every realm, dimension, and reality, rejecting darkness and bringing peace and hope to all it touches.  

You are no longer the wielder of a mere fragment or shard of the First Light, you have become the Very embodiment of The First Light, at first your powers are limited, allowing for the usage of whatever colors you could use before, but now with access to more variants of light. Due to being the embodiment of the First Light you will eventually be able to use any light based powers from other worlds, like the Traveler's Light, the Light of YHWH, or other light based, or creation based beings.  Even Different concepts can be combined to affect reality, on a much larger scale then before this is due to essentially being the very embodiment of The First Light, that very Spark of Creation that brought forth everything, you are Creation and Destruction. You are The Light.

Your Light adapts, harmonizing with cosmic forces like Honkai and others, evolving as you do. Even if you transform into an eldritch being or an Outer God, your Light remains an integral part of you, guiding your path.

You are the source of all [LIGHT], boundless and beyond the confines of any single reality. You stand as the natural counterpart to Death, embodying Life itself, existing in balance with the end of all things.

In time, you will reach the level of beings like YHWH, The Presence, The One Above All, The Traveler, Michael, and Lucifer. Your journey will be long, requiring growth and evolution, but the first Light is destined to ascend to these heights.
addons.title: Let There Be Light

objects.text:
You are part of a mysterious race so enigmatic that almost nothing is known. Until now, only two members of this race have been known to exist: the Traveler siblings, Aether and Lumine. But now, a third traveler has emerged—you. You can choose to either become the sibling of Aether and Lumine, choose to be the child of one of them, or be unrelated to them but still come from the same race. Like Aether and Lumine, you possess the same golden wings and extraordinary powers, including the innate ability to traverse worlds and an inventory space. This natural Omniversal Travel Power allows you to journey across any distance or dimension. While this ability can be temporarily sealed, it can never be permanently taken from you, and your powers will always return. Furthermore, you are immune to aging and sickness, though you can still die in battle or through assassination. However, your enhanced regeneration makes it incredibly difficult to kill you. As a Side note, you also have your own outfit that is very similar to Aether and Lumine.

You are highly resistant to corruption in all forms—whether physical, spiritual, emotional, mental, or tied to your powers. Unlike others, you suffer no adverse effects from abilities or energies acquired during your travels. Upon entering a new world with a unique power system or energy source, you naturally adapt and gain access to it, much like how Aether and Lumine learned to wield different elements without a vision. Your very purpose aligns with the essence of travel, akin to the Aeon of Trailblaze, Akivili. You can choose to remain in a world for as long as you wish and leave whenever the call of adventure beckons.

As an outsider, you are unaffected by Fate and Destiny. Yet, your nature as a traveler makes you a welcomed presence in most worlds, except in cases where a powerful deity opposes your arrival or departure. You are inherently skilled in using your powers and proficient with a wide array of weapons, making you a formidable presence wherever you go.

As a fellow traveler, you also have the option to create a Traveling Home—a portable sanctuary reminiscent of the Adeptus Teapot from Liyue. This home serves as a protective shell for long-distance travel and can connect seamlessly to a personal world, acting as both an entry point and an observation hub during your journey. It is highly versatile, capable of taking any form you desire, and remains stored within your soul when not in use. When activated, your Traveling Home becomes indestructible, and no one can enter its space without your explicit permission. You can even invite guests to reside within it, extending your travel protections and benefits to them.

Your nature ensures that you grow stronger with time, shaped by the vast experiences and knowledge gained on your endless journey. As a traveler, you are both an outsider and an integral part of every world you visit. Your path is yours to decide—no being or force can control your destiny, trap you indefinitely, or bind you to a predetermined script. You are The Traveler, a being whose journey will never truly end.
objects.title: The Traveler (Genshin Impact)

addons.text:
Rather than selecting a single classpect, when you bestow a Classpect on someone they will have the best fit assigned to them in order to fulfil their narrative role. 

Similarly, you can dispense multiple classpects with great ease, facilitating this narrative convenience.
addons.title: ALREADY HERE

objects.text:
You are an actor fulfilling a role in the cosmic story, which has been known to provide some benefit. Aspects are the basic building blocks that make up everything within Paradox Space, of which everything can be broken down to. A Class meanwhile is the intended role a player occupies and the way the aspect is expressed through them. These combinations result in various abilities through the specific way Classes and Aspects interface with each other and the world around them. These can manifest in many ways but almost counterintuitively diametrically opposed Classpects can have similar powers through different methods. Aspects are a group of twelve and determine the primary ‘domain’ which is filtered through the class. Each Aspect has three fundamental parts; Its nature, its antithesis, and the narrative function it plays. Space is one of the two foundational aspects, governing the big picture and position of things. It’s strongly correlated with creation and restorative beginnings as much as the physical positions and velocity of objects. Time is the second foundational aspect, governing not only literal time but exploits and death and its inevitability. Like its counterpart, it’s occupied with the big picture but strongly correlated with destruction and the goal of the project rather than the project itself. Heart is the aspect of the soul, the essence of being, impulses, and emotions. Usually Heart focuses on the self primarily, with a tendency to splinter either themselves,or others in order to serve their needs. Mind is the antithesis of Heart, and the aspect of order, planning, paths and karma. Intimately connected to the perception of the world and the other players' place within it. Light represents knowledge, fortune, and light itself. Often giving way from curiosity to a dogged determination drawn from ‘certainty’. Void, the antithesis of light is the utter nothingness. It is a lack of things, both in a physical sense and in the way of knowledge or secrets, both of which being linked to its antithesis. While it’s main purposes are obscuring and consumption, it can also be a creative force to produce, quite literally, ex nihilo. Life players are known to be stupidly resilient, with much emphasis on healing, lifespan, and life force in general. Life is keyed to adaptation and regeneration, but also evolution and the change through life’s persistence. Doom meanwhile is representative of fate. It’s linked to Judgement, bad endings, and misfortune as much as prophecy (often unheeded). Breath represents freedom in its basest form. It’s self-expression and motivation, often represented by ‘The Breeze’ as a force of encouragement. However, it’s also linked to progression and a fondness and ability to navigate progressive systems. Blood as its corollary is representative of bonds and unity. Blood players are usually dedicated leaders or unifiers for this reason and it’s associated with both these and a quite literal invulnerability. Hope is the aspect of belief, both in others and oneself. Hope players tend get more powerful the more they believe in something, but ultimately taking the form of self-centredness. It’s linked to Faith and Morale, but also a more explicit warping of reality to fit these beliefs. Rage as its opposite is concerned with a brute and material force. Being aligned with emotion and raw power, it’s often also associated with both ‘Madness’, or rather the loss of sanity, and Narrative contrivance itself, taking the form of a necessary and singular path for its players as opposed to other aspects which tend to enforce multiple.
Classes meanwhile are largely split into two groups of seven, ‘Active’ (+) Classes that act on or employ their aspect, and ‘Passive’ (-) Classes that act through or are affected by their aspect. They’re intimately connected to the role a player has in their story and the narrative purpose they serve. The Witch (+) is a class of change, taking control of their aspect and controlling it with mastery. This control is to such an extent Witches tend to break their Aspect’s own rules to an extent, and cause change in their larger narrative. The Heir(-), also a class of change, are ‘Provided with their aspect’ or ‘provide their aspect’. The aspect overtly protects them and will often provide what they require to progress. The Knight (+) is a class of exploits. They ‘protect their aspect’ or ‘protect with their aspect’, often taking central roles in their groups for just this reason. They tend to be more overtly skilled in the use of their aspect despite (or rather due to) their increased responsibility over it. The Page(-) is the corollary passive class, ‘providing their aspects to those who need it’. A progressively growing class, they often begin lacking in their aspect before steadily growing in proficiency and strength until the end of their narrative. The Mage (+) is the active knowledge class, ‘aware of their aspect and its influences’. While other players may use their aspect, mages understand it to its fullest and can manipulate its reach almost freely. However, Mages are almost universally negatively impacted by their aspect as both a consequence and a price of this power. The Seer (-) is another class of knowledge. They ‘know, see, or understand their aspect’. While lacking true control, they are almost always aware through their aspect of circumstances and act best as constantly well informed advisories. The Maid (+) is the first creation class, they ‘prepare others through their aspect’ or ‘serve their aspect’. The Maid’s duty is to prepare people of note for what lies ahead, and to maintain their aspect to ensure it does not unbalance the narrative it exists within. The Sylph(-), its corollary ‘heal their aspect’ or ‘heal through their aspect’. They are dedicated to the healing and maintenance of the group through the aspect to their core. The Prince(+) is a class of destruction. They ‘destroy their aspect’ or ‘destroy using their aspect’. Most often the most dangerous player in a narrative, their main job is to attempt to rule through their aspect or dethrone it. The Bard (-) is an outwardly similar destruction class, but inevitably mess everything up. They ‘invite destruction through their aspect’ or they ‘invite the destruction of their aspect’. Consummate fools, a Bard is the only class that can cause utter mayhem by simply doing nothing. The Thief (+) is, obviously, the active stealing class. They ‘steal their aspect from others’ or ‘use it for their own benefit’. They often feel the need to be the centre of all attention and are usually arrogant, selfish, and impulsive people often operating with little self control. The Rogue (-) meanwhile is the passive stealing class, who ‘steal their aspect for others’. Fundamentally the Rogue collects their aspect to redistribute it to their team or tot he enemy. Ultimately, a Classpect’s alignment is a form of expression, both of your internal character and the methodology you’d tend to take.
objects.title: Classpect (Homestuck)

addons.text:
You are an existence that is simultaneously outside existence and fundamental to it. One aspect places you beyond systems, causality, and narrative closure; the other anchors you as a necessary constant whose absence reality cannot accommodate. Both conditions apply at once, without hierarchy or resolution.

Your being is self-justifying and self-authorizing. No law, observer, framework, or cosmology is required to validate you. Reality does not determine whether you exist; it is forced to account for the fact that you do. Attempts to deny, erase, overwrite, or negate you fail not through resistance, but because there is no coherent state—inside or outside existence—in which your absence can be maintained.

“I am me. My existence simply is. I am the beginning and the end. No further evidence is required to prove my existence. I give myself permission to exist. I am both Mystic and Terror - logos and pathos. Myself is proof of such.”
addons.title: Decagrammaton

addons.text:
The Boon restructures your relationship with nothingness. You are no longer required to enter a state of nullity to benefit from Nihili. Your body, mind, and soul are permanently relegated to the status of projections—functional interfaces rather than your true self.

Your true existence is now identical to the nothingness defined by Nihili. Harm, destruction, alteration, or erasure applied to your physical form, mind, or soul no longer meaningfully affects you, regardless of whether you are manifest, tangible, or interacting with reality. These layers may be destroyed, disrupted, or overwritten freely without consequence, as they are no longer where “you” reside.

You do not become vulnerable by choosing to exist. Manifestation is no longer a risk state, and intangibility is no longer required for safety. Even total annihilation of body, soul, and mind merely results in continued function or effortless re-manifestation, as nothing has been done to the underlying nothingness that constitutes you.

In effect, Nihili is no longer a mode you enter, but a permanent truth. The Boon ensures continuity, stability, and agency, while Nihili ensures that there is nothing beneath those layers that can ever be meaningfully harmed.
addons.title: Nihili Suprema

objects.text:
The Plane, raises us UP from LOWER to HIGHER
The Torque, twist the REVOLUTIONARY into the STRAIGHT-AND-NARROW
The Wedge, splits the twain APART...or holds them TOGETHER
The Sphere, spinning with the TRANSFERENCE of POWER
The Fulcrum, empowers the WEAK to become MIGHTY
The Axle, bears any BURDEN...moves any MOUNTAIN

You are bound to The Boon. This bond rewrites your existence at a fundamental level—mind, body, soul, and the continuity that defines you are permanently altered. The change is absolute and cannot be copied, suppressed, disrupted, or undone. You are no longer governed by the normal rules of life, death, decay, or restoration. The Boon is final.

Your body is restored to its ideal state and locked there permanently. Aging, illness, degeneration, and physiological failure are impossible. Injury resolves automatically: minor damage fades instantly, severe trauma repairs over time, and total physical destruction merely triggers reconstruction. Death does not apply. There is no terminal state.

This immortality is not regeneration alone. Your soul is removed entirely from the cycle of life and death and rendered inviolable. The physical body is a replaceable vessel, recreated as needed to house an unbroken consciousness. Memory, identity, and continuity persist flawlessly across all restorations, regardless of the extent of destruction.

Vitality is inexhaustible. Strength, stamina, resilience, and endurance renew continuously, allowing peak performance under any condition and in any environment without fatigue or decline. Physical capability is decisively superhuman, capable of withstanding extreme forces and exerting power far beyond human limits, indefinitely.

The mind is stabilized and perfected. Memory capacity is unlimited, recall is absolute, and cognition remains ordered and intact regardless of physical damage. Emotions exist but never overwhelm or impair judgment. Madness, despair, psychological collapse, and mental degradation are impossible. Thought remains calm, coherent, and enduring.

The soul cannot be harmed, altered, stolen, erased, or negated. Your existence cannot be ended—only delayed. You are restored endlessly to your perfected state and compelled to continue existing without end.

The Boon does not release its bearer. Once bound, it cannot be escaped.
objects.title: The Boon-Bound (Valiant)

objects.text:
With just a touch and small expenditure of energy—energy that naturally regenerates over course of a 24 hours—you gain the ability to grant the Mark of Ophis to yourself or anyone else. When activated, this mark provides not only a massive boost in power ranging from ten to one hundred times, depending on the potential of the marked individual but also draws out the full potential of their abilities, and any item in their possession capable of enhancement like Zanpakuto or Sacred Gear. Once the mark is deactivated, target's abilities return to normal. As long as you have sufficient energy to mark someone, you may mark as many beings as you wish.

Using this power puts strain on the body. Although it would take prolonged use to cause severe damage—your mark being far more forgiving than the lesser versions others possess—you will still find yourself exhausted after anything beyond light or occasional use of the mark.

You can easily remove these marks without any side effects, or you can trigger any and all marks to self-destruct—a process that is almost always fatal, as the user’s own power tears through their body, overwhelming all but the most resilient.
objects.title: Mark of Ophis (High School DxD)

objects.text:
The Identity System utilizes Mirror World Technology in order to overlay a version of yourself from a parallel universe onto your own body and consciousness, thereby gaining their skills and abilities. 

To obtain an Identity, you must reach into a mirror or any reflective surface, upon which you will be able to peer into the various mirror worlds from the perspective of your alternate selves. Once you find an acceptable Identity, you must pull out of the mirror with all your might. This process will net you an Identity card, allowing you to switch to that Identity whenever you please as long as the card is in your possession. 

Extraction can reach across time as well, though it is typically limited to a range of 3 years into past or future. There exists and exception, as every 3 months, an event known as Walpurgisnacht will occur, causing the range of extraction to extend up to 10 years. Extraction cannot be done infinitely, as it causes mental strain for every Identity extracted. 

However, this power comes with some risks. When you equip an Identity, everything about the Identity is reflected unto you, including appearance, memories, and personality. This will not completely override your free will, but it will naturally cause bleed over of the Identity's wishes into your own personality, this gets worse the longer which an Identity is equipped, so it is best to not overdo it.
objects.title: The Identity System (Project Moon)

objects.text: You possess a terrifying ability to take away anything you desire from your target. For it to activate, two conditions must be met: you must envy the target, and the target must have negative feelings toward you. Anything you consider a negative emotion would count, no matter how small or insignificant, or how well-concealed: a subconscious flash of irritation or even a misplaced bout of compassion. Once those conditions are satisfied, what is known as forced cooperation takes place. From this moment forward, the target counts as having agreed to fall under the effect of Harirankyu, and it can be activated any number of times regardless of the distance or time passed. No matter what the target does, or how it tries to evade, defend, or circumvent this ability, you can take anything from it for yourself: powers, skills, memories, soul, body, possessions, even abstract things like concepts, qualities, or fate—anything you can think of. Missing information will be replaced with a white noise and cannot be restored even if the target tries to relearn what has been taken from it. Anything you steal can be activated/deactivated or summoned/desummoned at will. Copied abilities will function even if they required an external source before, and similar abilities will compound on each other for a much greater effect. Stolen skills and knowledge will perfectly integrate with your own, as if you personally spent time learning and mastering them. Once you have completely absorbed the target, taking its body, soul, abilities, its very existence, it appears as a mummified corpse nailed to an upside-down cross—which you can summon or dispel at will—behind your back and can be summoned as an absolutely loyal, perfect replica. These copies are completely immortal unless you permit them to die, and you can restore any damage done to them instantly. Lastly, Harirankyu protects you from having any of your abilities stolen; anyone trying to do so will find itself immediately targeted and fully absorbed. Similarly, Harirankyu itself can never be stolen, copied, destroyed or otherwise taken from you, as it is an integral part of your being.
objects.title: Harirankyu (Soushuu Senshinkan Gakuen Hachimyoujin)

objects.text: You have gained access to the metaphysical plane called Dreamworld. Inside it, you gain access to Kantan, the power to control dreams. Dreams are divided into five types: Power Type, which enhances your attack and speed; Defence Type, which enhances your durability and regeneration; Magic Type, which grants long-range and area-of-effect abilities; Cancel Type, which specialises in destruction and supernatural perception; and lastly, Creation Type, which grants you the ability to create anything and control the world around you. You start with the ability to use one type at a time, capable of projecting barriers, flying, healing light wounds, shattering concrete with your punches, creating basic objects, etc. With practice, your abilities will grow, eventually allowing you to use any number of types simultaneously and combine them to achieve almost any effect, from total existential erasure of targets and regeneration from being erased yourself to creating entire pocket universes with their own metaphysical structures. Dreamworld itself consists of eight layers. The first through third layers are where normal, lucid, and shared dreams are experienced. Levels four through eight, however, are new worlds entirely, with their own inhabitants and laws of reality, and these layers are where you can experience the power of Kantan. Each layer starting from the fourth has something called a Breach Point that allows you to progress to the next level. Usually it is required to defeat the ruler of the layer, but sometimes conditions might be far more convoluted and not readily apparent. Progressing to the next level of the Dreamworld boosts your abilities in Kantan exponentially, and reaching the final eighth layer will yield the greatest reward of all, allowing you to take your dreams, your powers of Kantan, into reality. You can fall asleep at will and appear on any of the levels one through four or any other conquered layer. Whenever you die in the Dreamworld, you wake up back in the real one. However, the next time you enter the Dreamworld after your death, you will return to the fourth layer and have to start your journey over again. Each new layer gets exponentially harder to conquer, requiring you to spend time and effort in mastering your Kantan, as you cannot bring any powers aside from your mind, will, and perks to this world.
objects.title: Kantan (Soushuu Senshinkan Gakuen Hachimyoujin)

objects.text:
From an Earth Bet different from the norm, you have been granted a Truth, something akin to a Shard Power, reflecting your lowest point. In function, this begins at the strength of a 10 SP power, but its growth and virulence are far beyond the norm. With each battle, you prove yourself and your way as superior to those of your challengers, and progress towards a breakthrough. The benefits of such breakthroughs are threefold for you, allowing the development of a secondary Truth to complement the original, helping ease troublesome limits of the original Truth, and creating a bud to be delivered by the tides of destiny to someone favorable to you. Each of these may be put off, to avoid dispersing Truth when wishing to avoid complications, or simply avoiding the alteration of your abilities at an inconvenient time.

Do note that the Dao sees foes as just as valuable if not moreso than friends, so someone favorable could mean they shall become a valued teammate, but they could just as readily be a bitter rival who will push you towards your limits. It is difficult but not impossible for those granted truths this way to surpass their destined roles, and those that the Dao raises as obstacles in your path are marked as your inferior, helping to refine you while being destined to fail at the most critical moment.

While much like shard powers, the powers of the Dao are tireless, and slightly less flexible without breakthroughs in exchange for their greater capacity to grow and change. Truths will happily alter themselves to intertwine with other powers, and as one grows stronger in the ways of Conflict, their flesh will slowly be refined towards a jade like substance, with organs associated with powers being the first to change, as the fallibility and lesser nature of flesh gives way to raw truth.

Other Seekers of Truth shall have to choose at each threshold which of the three paths they wish to take with their breakthroughs. As a final boon, with a touch, you may attract the attention of the Conflicted Dao upon a person, granting them a Truth reflecting their own lowest point, though with no subordination like you would gain with your buds.

Secondary Truths usually start significantly lower than the initial one gained, but grow with time.
objects.title: Conflicted Dao Universal Access Power "Agreement" (Ruins of Isekai cyoa)

objects.text: They’re like bards, if everyone was fucking petrified of bards. A Dictator’s greatest gift is The Voice and the Performance, allowing you to issue command with magical force. Emotions are tweaked, even to supernatural extremes. The Voice can easily make people cry with joy. It can make people cry so hard their face slowly melts away in ecstasy. When you speak your commands aloud however, something always gives away the use of your gift; demonic vocals, suddenly appearing facial scars, strange smells coming from your mouth or stranger besides. Dictators all have a favoured ‘theme’, an emotional palate made of one of eight emotions and all its derivatives; Rage, Vigilance, Ecstasy, Admiration, Terror, Amazement, Grief, and Loathing. The one you select is your favourite to manipulate, using it and all its shades, joy in ecstasy, love in acceptance etc. Initially, The Voice is only able to be used on a single person at a time, and will release them when used again. As you develop the power of your Voice and Performance you’ll be able to use it on entire crowds like a one person choir, learning signature pieces like rote performances, making your changes permanent and irreversible, gaining agents and webs of allies, emotional capital and influence as the power behind thrones. However there is another way, a left-handed path. A Portrait of the Artist as a Monster. It’s an expression of all the worst parts of you, a personal werewolf, a woman on fire. Defined by your fears and wants. It’s an adaptive monster, changing as your own vision of yourself changes. Claws giving way to wings, disguise giving way to might. They already think you are a monster, grow your fangs and prove them right. The pinnacle of a Dictator is naturally, to become The Great Dictator. Your gift growing to spread and influence crowds, cities, nations. Hail to the King.
objects.title: Dictator (DIE)

objects.text: Fools rush in... and their friends have to deal with the consequences. Fools are lucky. They bound in without a care knowing their luck holds true. They smile through every tragedy and scrape through by the skin of their teeth each time they almost doom everyone for a quick thrill. Fools are prone to flukes of luck, even when they really shouldn't be. They're con-artists, hustlers, Robin Hoods, and Rogues. Lucky morons. Whenever one does anything particularly foolish or entertaining, their luck temporarily rises to match. A fool's advancement is just that, foolish. It's leveraging luck, figuring out how they can make an absolute arse of themselves effectively and entertainingly to maximise their fortune, acquiring tricks and schemes, knacks and minor spells to help you on your way. When all else fails, a Fool can make a somewhat heroic sacrifice. In a truly dire situation, a Fool can give up all of their temporary luck to just get themselves or their allies out of a situation alive, knowing that sooner or later they'll have to balance the scales. A Fool’s 'pinnacle' is split in two places. They can become true Robin Hoods, gaining their temporary luck whenever they act with kindness and altruism, or completely give in to their persona, utterly avoiding all consequence and fobbing it off on everyone around them, making everyone else pick up every sling and arrow. You'll never end up falling in the heap of dung/deathtrap/maw of a dragon. Only your friends. Never you.
objects.title: Fool (DIE)

addons.text: Your limitless will and ability couple around your sacred emotion, allowing you to remain coherent and lucid as it surges within you and around you. You still need to grow your abilities and learn to cope, but no matter how overwhelming it is you are always able to catch yourself at the brink and surge forwards.
addons.title: Knight Typhoon

objects.text: They can defeat anything. Except the passion which drives them. Across DIE, there are orders of great knights, the world's greatest warriors, each devoted to one of the eight sacred emotions, using them to fuel the power of their sentient arcane weapons. When consumed by their sacred sensation, they are incomparable warriors, capable of miraculous feats. Nothing can stand against their blades, not armies, mountains, or even ideas. As an Emotion Knight, you draw power from one of eight central emotions: Rage, Vigilance, Ecstasy, Admiration, Terror, Amazement, Grief, and Loathing. Depending on the intensity you're feeling, your sacred emotion the scale of your might grows. When strongly engaged with your emotion, you would be stronger and more skilled than most; when overwhelmed by it, you could cleave armies and rend towns to ash beneath you. There are tales of Emotion Knights so consumed that entire countries have been ground beneath them. Your arcane weapon, a sapient companion, channels your abilities. While they have a single form, chosen when first joining the order, they can communicate with their owner (both audibly and with short-range telepathy) and share a bond with their owner. Additionally, they can sense strong sources of their owner's sacred emotion in their vicinity. All of this is to facilitate one aim. The weapon is at most an ally; its only drive is to push you towards your sacred emotion, whether it would be best for you or not. Growing in your abilities as an Emotion Knight is largely devoted to learning new techniques and stances, ways to apply your power both physically and socially to progress both your understanding of your sacred emotion and the depth of it. The Pinnacle of the Emotion Knight is selecting a different arcane weapon. This 'Dual Wielding' allows you to utilise a second sacred emotion as much as your first, feeding off each other and into each other in equal measure.
objects.title: Emotion Knight (DIE)

addons.text: The amount of Fairgold you automatically receive per day has been increased. Now you can safely activate each gift you gain to its minimum level each day, with the shipment growing to compensate for any more gifts you gain.
addons.title: Supply and Demand

addons.text:
By integrating your gifts as spiritual technology, you’re able to overclock them with impunity. Usually, where you would have a 50% chance of paying a price for your overclocking, now you can feed energy directly into the gifts to mitigate this chance. 

While you still need Fair gold to initially activate them, this overclock would bring them to massively increased functionality, activating more and more of their various ‘Upgrades’ as energy is fed into them. 

This naturally turns you into an absolute dervish as Reflex Boosters accelerate multiple times over making you near-impossible to hit, your ‘Sick-Ass Ride’ becomes impossibly fast and silent, and Reactors spin to functionality filling all of your integrated technology with charge.
addons.title: Overclock

objects.text: Adventurers all want gold, but no-one needs it like a Neo. Anyone who's ever met one knows why people are suspicious about Neo. There's a special kind of gold, and a Neo's magical technology needs to be activated by it every day. If they can't find enough, then their gifts mean nothing. They can’t skip between shadows, dance through the sky, or punch a hole through a head from a mile away. Gifted by the Fair, a kind of quantum elves, you always have an AI system and basic ability to access the Fair Field, an invisible data network fuelled by technology sufficiently advanced enough to pass as magic. This AI system is capable of talking with you and performing basic tasks relating to all of your gifts and abilities. Accessing the Fair Field allows you to hack anything technological, or build on a technological base, subverting them to your control or shutting them down. As a Neo, you also gain otherworldly gifts from the Fair: guns with multiple eccentric modes, energy weapons, light field projectors rendering you invisible, blink teleporters, familiars, forcefields, cybernetic enhancements, and more. The more you grow and the more Fair Gold you collect, the more gifts the Fair bestows on you such as otherworldly vehicles, extradimensional fences, etc. At the pinnacle, you can even gain a special relationship with the Fair, making requests and deals. The Fair are capable of miraculous feats, but never without cost and consequence. However, all of your gifts come at a price: Fair Gold, a techno-magical fuel that takes the form of small coins which you will find yourself drawn to with a frightening intensity. There are many sources and cashes of Fair Gold around, not to mention the small amounts to be found in the corpses of magical beings; your AI will be able to tell you if there is any in the vicinity and guide you to it. A single piece of Fair Gold is required to activate one of your gifts until the following dawn, with all Neo having a slot on their body to insert the coin (usually behind the neck). Additional pieces of Fair Gold can be used to either activate another gift or overcharge an already activated gift, increasing its functionality greatly. Unfortunately, Fair Gold is ephemeral and always disappears at the next dawn, though you're always given a single coin at the start of each day.
objects.title: Neo (DIE)

addons.text: The good disposition most Gods have towards you has allowed your ability to wheel and deal with the best divinities to flourish. They’ll be more willing to weigh deals in your favour, be more receptive to your appeals and less likely to take offense.
addons.title: High Tolerance

objects.text: Because if you think about it, the difference between "cleric" and "demonologist" is the same as the one between "freedom fighter" and "terrorist." As a Godbinder, you make contracts with gods, trade favours, make relationships, and break them. While all Godbinders begin with a small relationship to a god and have an associated ability to cast minor magical effects in their domains, their real strength comes in Debt and Miracles. You can call gods —gods of light, death, eldritch and unknowable or personal and understanding. At any time, you can speak to them and request their action, Miracles. While these Miracles can be theoretically anything within their domain, they are not without cost. This usually takes the form of taking on a debt to them, performing a specific task for them immediately, making a specific promise you will fulfil in the future, or most dangerously, owing them an open-ended favour. In the same way, acting in accordance with a god's desires or asks will let you accrue 'Credit', which you can then use as leverage for Miracles later, exchanging it for magics and blessings. It is worth noting that breaking a deal with a god is rarely very intelligent, and often spells doom of at least some variety, or a forfeit of some kind to 'make even' the debt. The ultimate expression of a Godbinder’s skill is the creation of a new covenant. Most could never reach the construction of a new god, but the greatest of Godbinders have made their own bespoke gods beneficial to their own ends.
objects.title: Godbinder (DIE)

objects.text: We can be honest. You cheat all the time. The Master has a kind of control over reality. Masters can perform any spell reasonable and likely, based upon their character and personality. They can fly, throw fireballs, turn invisible, heal people, create incredible firework displays and generally be a reality warper masquerading as a wizard. Beyond that, as the arbiter of DIE, the Master can explicitly cheat. This lets them create miraculous events like teleporting to escape, summoning hugely powerful monsters, and creating a fortress from nowhere. Additionally, they can cheat to undo the effects of something that’s happened, like regenerating from harm or instantly reviving someone. Unfortunately, you can only cheat so much. Doing so too often can lead to The Powers That Be noticing your interference. Though these Powers That Be may differ depending on the setting, you will likely not survive their attention. Additionally, unlike the other Paragons of DIE, there's no way to grow as a Master.
objects.title: Master (DIE)

objects.text:
You have come into possession of a great ability known as the Wings of the Light Hawk, known as the life force of the gods; the Wings of the Light Hawk are divine higher-dimensional energy that takes the form of a shield that can block any attack, with the only way to bypass it being through repeated rapid-fire attacks.

While primarily a shield able to effortlessly shrug off planet-destroying attacks at a baseline, the Wings of the Light Hawk are capable of so much more; becoming a weapon capable of planetary destruction is simple enough, as is converting matter and energy into one another or into different forms.

To wield the Light Hawk Wings is to wield divine power on a cosmic scale, as there is effectively no limit to what can be done with them: ignoring the laws of the universe, transmutation, space-time manipulation, travelling to other timelines and universes, and even achieving multiversal feats such as forcing timelines and universes to collide into one another to either be merged or destroyed. You are able to channel this power through items and vehicles to increase their capabilities exponentially per wing.

The only real soft limit to the Wings of the Light Hawk is yourself; while being stronger in body, mind, and spirit would help you will the effects you want, a more efficient method would be to have a greater understanding of the universe and what you want to achieve as the end results, and increasing the number of wings you can manifest at once, with the only hard limit being the dimension you find yourself in, as any more than 10 Light Hawk Wings at once can destroy three-dimensional reality.

You begin being able to manifest a single Light Hawk Wing, but can learn to generate more in time; however, this is no small feat, as the energy required to manifest a single wing doubles for each additional wing after the first. In other words, to manifest three Light Hawk Wings it would need seven times the energy for one (1 + 2 + 4 = 7), but this increase in cost is evidence of the increase of power your Light Hawk Wings gain.

Side Note: Light Hawk Wings can possess different shapes and colours depending on the user; this is more for appearance and does not affect the ability.
objects.title: Light Hawk Wings (Tenchi Muyo!)

objects.text: This Reality (that is to say, everything that exists) is one of Rules, and everyone in it is a being of the Rules. You have broken a Rule. There is no reason this has happened. You are not particularly special, you took no particular steps to become a rulebreaker, you are not located in a particularly special area of reality. Still, you are a rulebreaker now, one of six types. The Aeonophore exists orthogonally to time, and can alter its movements and flow as far as reality will allow– perhaps even further. At the neophyte level you can slow the flow of time to 1/100th of its speed indefinitely without affecting your mind, effectively quickening your thoughts. With a bit more effort you are capable of more visible manipulations like slowing time for everything but your body or controlling the flow of time forwards and backwards over small areas, enough to age a car into dust or revert an enemy into a zygote. With practice you will learn to adapt to your position outside time; attacking areas where an enemy was at one point to harm them in the present or surviving being reduced to ash by a nuclear bomb by retroactively having secretly left the planet and faked your continued presence with a remote-controlled clone, for example. With mastery and creativity you can become powerful beyond imagining, just so long as you can keep the convolutions you inflict upon time organized. A Red Queen is biologically perfect, the theoretical best possible organism and then some. Every cell in your body is as efficient as physically possible, dispersing heat, metabolising energy, and exerting force to the maximum amount allowed by the Rules, as well as responding to your will to shapeshift in moments. With some concentration you can go beyond, growing cells in your body that incrementally become more capable of arbitrary feats of strength, speed, survival, and more. Your mind is split evenly among every cell in the universe descended from yours, allowing you to split into a hivemind and grow in cognitive ability the more brain matter you have. It is a trivial challenge for you to release spores and viruses which travel and infect other organisms to turn them into more of your cells without necessarily causing a noticeable change. You can create brains which function autonomously without your oversight while allowing you to assume direct control at will. At high levels of skill you will be able to form cells capable of obviously supernatural feats, so long as you have enough energy available. You can leave your cells on “autopilot” and have them keep doing what they’re doing without your input; taking too much of yourself off of autopilot can be an overwhelming experience and could cause sensory overload if you aren’t used to it. As a Noogenic Psychotic your consciousness is no longer bound to any specific thing, letting you float bodiless in the void. You are practically impossible to destroy, but struggle to perceive or interact with the world without a body. You can inhabit any cognitive matter with the computational capacity of at least a calculator, from human to a fox to a spaceship. You possess intuitive control over all information in your vicinity allowing you to instantly create perfectly-coded computer programs and interfere with the perception and memories of living things easily, as well as endless processing power allowing you to take in and process arbitrarily high amounts of complex information instantly. You can embed an inactive copy of your mind into anything that can store 100 bytes of information, including written symbols. Copying that data, whether in writing, through a picture, or within a memory, creates a duplicate within the new record. You can instantly take control of anything with an inactive copy of your mind and give directives on a grand scale to anything capable of processing information with some effort. With deep contemplation you may even encode bits of information into reality itself, imbuing a space, object, or individual with minor rulebreaking properties. A Hyperreality Geyser is a white hole shaped like a mortal. At will you can project energy, matter, space, and even time, in any manner you choose. If thrown into the vacuum of space you could create a small, hollow, habitable planetoid. You can become effectively utterly invincible by activating your event horizon, which nothing that follows the Rules can cross. Your creations can be imbued with consciousness to make them act autonomously. Whatever you create comes out exactly how you imagine them, but you must understand what you are making; if you make a smartphone without knowing how its innards look it’ll just be a plastic brick. You are capable of creating supernatural things, but it’s exhausting for you. As you master this power with training and study you will be able to create arbitrarily high amounts of energy, firing plasma beams that can bisect a planet and forming kugelblitz black holes directly inside your enemies’ skulls or weaving entire planets with vast and complex ecosystems from nothing in an instant. This power only gives you the power to create, not to control, so once you’ve set a creations properties the only way to change them outside what they’re already designed to do is to create more. Using Self-Directed Monopotence gives you absolute, inviolable control over your own body. Nothing can hurt you or bind you unless you will it, you can enact arbitrarily high amounts of force, move at faster-than-light speeds, teleport, increase your temperature of that of a star’s core, or completely abandon your biology to become a robot or living hologram. You can boost your own intelligence but it will be more like having a supercomputer strapped onto your brain than being smart on your own. Your control stops right at the outer end of your skin (or whatever surface your body has), and your body parts must be connected to one another at all times. You have no control over anything outside you, but unspeakable supernatural control of anything within. With time you may learn more esoteric methods of using your power, such as willing your arm to point at the nearest object of interest or your mouth to speak the most convincing possible argument, or transforming into a form so supernaturally beautiful it drives romantic types to tears on sight. This will never allow you to use your powers on outside objects, but it will provide alternatives that help you get around that block. The rarest type, the Positive-Sum Anchor, is capable of making Rules. You can generate Anchors, objects of immense complexity and power which can enforce Rules in a set radius around them. The process of manifesting an Anchor is long, intensive, and intellectually exhausting, but the results infinitely scale in ways no other Rulebreaker could hope to achieve. With millennia of work you could even create your own Realities. The one major limit on what Rules you can make, more than time, effort, or knowledge, is that you must fully commit to the Rules you make and never doubt that they are as natural and necessary as any other law of reality. You must internalize them as being as inevitable as an object falling when it is dropped or the sun rising in the morning. Any lingering doubt when making new Rules will ruin the process. As long as you maintain the correct state of mind you can create things far beyond your power. You may choose which kind of rulebreaker you are or design a new Rule in line with the others in terms of power and versatility. Rulebreakers, by their nature, unravel the fundamental factors that define everything. Use of rulebreaking powers slowly compromises reality, and past a far-off yet achievable critical point reality may collapse entirely, returning everything to a primordial state where there are no rules, borders, or protections. Depending on the setting there may or may not be beings capable of repairing the damage you deal. If there are, they probably won’t like you. Any beings dedicated to preserving reality inherently recognize that you are a disruption to the natural order.
objects.title: Broken Rule (RULEBREAKERS, a Reasonable CYOA)

addons.text:
Your incredible sorcery genius somehow translates over to your hobby of slandering people, and through your grasp of the Reverse Cursed Technique you have figured out how to reverse Reverse Slander Technique into Reverse Reverse Slander Technique which allows the user to give a target feats rather than take them away.

By creating a fake record of yourself or someone else performing a feat, placing your watermark on it, and then carefully channeling reversed cursed energy into it, you can turn it into a real and valid feat for the one depicted, boosting their power to be capable of what they were shown doing and even unlocking new abilities they were depicted as having. The greater the boost being given the more energy is required, but there isn’t really anything stopping you from repeatedly Reverse Reverse Slandering your own power level to grow exponentially as a cheap (but effective) method of “training.”
addons.title: Reverse Reverse Slander Technique

objects.text:
Created in an effort to further slander Potential Man, the Reverse Slander Technique is the single most infamous and devious method of slander conceived by the sinister minds of Jujutsufolk. It's principle is thus; any feat generated by AI is slop, and therefore invalid. Ergo, placing an AI watermark onto a feat will turn it into slop, negating it entirely. 

By interacting with a recording of an impressive feat, you can place a supernatural Sora watermark into the video, completely negating whatever powers were shown off in the video. For example, invalidating someone's best feat of strength will make them unable to push themselves to their prior limits, no matter how hard they try.

However, the Reverse Slander Technique comes at a price. Literally. You will need Tokens to apply the watermark to videos. Each Token is only able to negate about 10 seconds of footage, and you will gain a stackable 10 Tokens per day to start.

The negation applies to all abilities shown off in the recording, but should a target have other proven instances of showing off a power, then you must apply the Reverse Slander Technique to those as well to truly strip them of the ability. Of course, you cannot negate a feat which has not been shown, so any hidden tricks up the sleeve of an opponent cannot be destroyed.

Furthermore, should a target be stronger in reality than the feat negated, then the the target will only be weakened in proportion to the feat, subtracting the power shown from their overall true power. 

For now, you are limited to just recordings, but with time and practice, you will be able to interact with any medium which could be conceivably AI generated and place the telltale signs of AI within it. A photograph would gain weird fingers or fuzz, a piece of text would gain the prompt used to generate it, seemingly 'forgotten' to be deleted by the promoter, and so on. Naturally, images and text will require fewer Tokens than video. A single Token can affect about 10 images or 2000 words of text. 

The apex of the Reverse Slander Technique is to apply it to a livestream, immediately nullfying an ability the instant after it is used. Though such a technique will constantly drain your Tokens.
objects.title: Reverse Slander Technique (r/Jujutsufolk)

objects.text:
At certain landmarks in your world, there is a clown only you can see named Bob. Based on how many things you've done in the worlds you've been to, he gives you Completion Points that can be spent on useful items or changes to the world, though rarely anything extreme. Some examples include:

-Nouveau Riche Influx: Aggressive gold suited men randomly appear in every major population center. They'll attack you on sight, but they're not any stronger than an average weak thug, and they're always solo. The beneficial part is that when beaten, they drop either large sums of money, or valuable (but non-unique) items. There are no legal, moral, or social consequences to beating them up, and hunting them can be a great way to make money if you're short on cash.

-Key Keeper: A device that beeps when you get close to any item that you might want to collect. It also causes the items in question to glow, though only you can see it.

-Trouble Finder: A device that tells you where a "Sidestory" might be happening, an interesting sidequest that will give you a reward, a personal connection with someone who could be relevant later, or simply something that progresses you closer to your goals in a roundabout way.

-Beads Of Good Fortune: Prevents any combat not directly related to your life's "main plot" or "Sidestories" from occuring.

-Charismatic Photo: The opposite of the Beads Of Good Fortune, you will have constant random battles as long as you equip this.

-Purgatory: An underground wonderland hidden within the main city you reside in, where gambling, fighting, and, uh, other things, take place. The arena is open to all, and the strongest fighters in your world will often appear there, even if it logically seems like they shouldn't or wouldn't. The arena has different "leagues", so that you (or others) can choose to fight weak or strong opponents, with or without weapons, or in an arena with environmental hazards like an electrified cage or a floor that shoots fire.

These are just examples, much more is available if you have the Completion Points for it.
objects.title: Bob Utsunomiya (Yakuza: Like A Dragon)

objects.text:
A skill that allows its user to dismantle a killed creature on every level — physical, magical, and spiritual. After an creature is killed by the user, this ability activates automatically and starts dismantling the dead monster so the user receives the most high quality drops from the monster that the user would deems necessary(I.e: bones, skin etc.)

Through this process, the user also receives various other drops: materials, attribute points, and even the magical skills or abilities the killed creature possessed before dying. The target’s knowledge is analyzed and converted into readable format (I.e: books) so the user can learn it later on.
objects.title: Complete Dismantle (Shinka No Mi)

objects.text:
A Milieu is a metaphysical embodiment of the Wielder’s background and personality. They are created from the random accumulation of scraps of broken stories held in the back of the Library, containing all the knowledge there is, an endless number of books each of which is a universe of their own.

Milieus are often both bizarre and powerful, typically manifesting in the form of a conjured object or animal which produces esoteric effects, like a bunch of floating eyes allowing the Wielder to use a map to create reality-warping public signage, or transforming into particles of gravel so small they have no mass allowing them to travel at light speed and phase through matter and which also secrete asbestos and cause severe allergic reactions, or making it so by opening their armpits the Wielder can summon a drawer that spawns a deodorant that produces towels that creates pancakes that secretes cream that creates iron bouncing swords that manipulate vibrations and cause rumblings which can achieve perpetual motion and create infinite energy, with an unrelated secondary use that conjures a leather armchair which gives the Wielder different buffs depending on what smoothie flavor they drink while sitting on it.

The awakening of a Milieu is a near-zero probability event, and wielders of a Milieu will often find luck has a much greater influence on their lives; in the sense that the improbable happens to them often, for better and for worse. Wielders also constantly grow in power over time, even if they do nothing, although training will make the growth faster. Possessing a Milieu also makes the Wielder intangible and invulnerable to harm from anyone who doesn’t also have powers, as well as completely immune to the effect of their own Milieu. The Milieu itself also inherently possesses protections against any sort of outside interference, negating both direct and indirect means of altering or removing the ability.

Milieus are by default of the Physically Bounded type, which means they manifest in the form of a solid object. Despite the other protections a Milieu has Physically Bounded Milieus can be broken by force, and this will erase the ability from the user. However, if the Wielder is to awaken their Milieu for a second time after having their original one broken, they will gain a far more powerful version which no longer requires a physical form, only creating one as a visual indicator of its use. The other major “weakness” of Milieus is that, while not universally, they commonly possess situational quirks or intricate rules that can make using them complicated.

To start with you may choose any canon non-evolved Milieu, design one yourself, or leave it up to random chance.
objects.title: Milieu (C∅ntext)

objects.text: Primordial Energies are not magic. They are fundamental forces that predate The System itself. They cannot normally be dispelled, typically requiring exceptional magical mastery or Primordial Void to counter. Control is instinctive, but misuse is lethal. There are Five Standard Energies: Kinetic, Thermal, Lightning, Gravity, and Void. Rarer Primordial Energies beyond the Standard Five also exist, such as Blood, Binding, and Stellar Winds but they are far less understood and little is know about them. You gain control over one Primordial Energy per purchase. Examples of what the Standard Five Primordial Energies can do the following: Kinetic Control motion and force directly. Launch yourself, halt attacks, redirect impacts, or strike targets with sudden bursts of momentum. Precision increases lethality. Thermal Typically manifests as pyromancy. Manipulate heat and cold directly. Superheat areas, melt materials, flash-ignite air, or drain heat to freeze and shatter. Spread is difficult to contain. Lightning Command electrical discharge and electromagnetic force. Paralyze targets, accelerate your body, arc through defenses, and fire improvised railgun-like attacks. Gravity Increase, reduce, or redirect gravitational pull. Crush enemies, pin targets, distort movement, or maneuver through altered gravity fields. Void Dissipate energy, mana, and Primordial Energies. Create zones where power weakens, collapses, or fails entirely. Particularly effective against supernatural effects.
objects.title: Primordial Energy (Hell Tutorial Difficulty)

objects.text:
You have gained a special pool of energy which you can use to create things from nothing, you are able to create anything you want with this pool of energy; superpowers, eldritch horrors, fruit, fire, as long as you can think of it you can make it. The more complicated / powerful the thing you want to create is the more difficult it will be for you and the more energy it will cost.

This pool of energy can also be used to change things that already exist, which is a very handy way to create something that would usually be beyond you, just slowly add to it over time.

This energy pool starts big enough to let you create something like a lesser spirit or a minor T1 superpower, with a fast enough recovery to refill completely in 24 hours.This energy pool will grow slowly through use.

As a creator you have gained a truly supernatural talent at all forms of creation; building, painting, programming, singing, etc… as long as it can be counted even slightly as a from of creation you will be supernaturally talented in it. This will not give you any amount of skill or knowledge to start with, but it will take a very short amount of time for you to get supernaturally skilled at it.

You are supernaturally good at figuring out and understanding any form of creation you encounter.

This connection will slowly improve itself endlessly over time, but it will improve much faster through actually creating things, how it improves depends on the person, but there is no limit to the heights it can reach.
objects.title: Creator (Essence Meta CYOA)

objects.text:
You have gained a special pool of energy which you can use to erase things from existence, you are able to erase/destroy anything you want with this pool of energy; superpowers, eldritch horrors, regardless of what it is you can unmake it. The difficulties lies in control, as the energy is both destructive and volatile. Naturally you are resistant if not outright immune to your own destructive energy, and with descent control you can manipulate and shape the energy in anyway you see fit.

If you possess enough control and restraint to only reduce that which you destroy down to it’s most basic foundation rather than completely erasing it, then you can recycle and repurpose it for your own use in anyway you see fit, or restore it as part of a process of renewal.You begin with the energy pool being large enough to destroy an entire continent and will only continue to grow over time.

Your control, which grows with more uses, will only be good enough to safely use a small portion at the start.

As a destroyer you have gained a truly supernatural talent at all forms of destruction; martial arts, combat spells, art of war, assassination, etc… as long as it can be counted even slightly as a from of destruction you will be supernaturally talented in it. This will not give you any amount of skill or knowledge to start with, but it will take a very short amount of time for you to get supernaturally skilled at it.

You are supernaturally good at discerning and understanding the flaws or weaknesses of anything you encounter.

As a destroyer your combat talents has now been boosted far beyond superhuman levels and over time, it will only grow even further and beyond.

This connection will slowly improve itself endlessly over time, but it will improve much faster through actually destroying things, how it improves depends on the person, but there is no limit to the heights it can reach.
objects.title: Destroyer (Essence Meta CYOA)

objects.text:
You awaken as an S Rank Calamity, a being which embodies a specific concept. For example, an S Rank Firearms Calamity will have the abilities of all Firearms, and its powers scales directly with the strength of said firearms. A calamity’s strength is based on both the fear humanity holds on it and its strength. A Nuclear Bomb Calamity can raze the entire planet’s surface, wiping out 90% of all human life on the planet and forcing them to live underground.

Your power is expressed through a Domain, inducing rules which apply various effects on your local area. You’ll have control over the contents of this domain, but an example of this is creating an mirage where a sunken ship is travelling the surface and anyone who stays for longer than 12 hours will evaporate. Although for some domains, it could simply be blowing up the entire planet’s surface. But even outside of a Domain, you still possess your power and it is just the full expression of it cannot be released. You can think of a Domain as an instantly deployable area where you can maximize your powers, so long as you’re within it, you get the benefits even if your powers travel outside of it.
You can consume the concepts of others, gaining their concepts as well. So long as the thing holds a concept of something, you will be able to additionally become a Calamity of that thing and gain powers based on it. This means anything which that concept covers will also be a part of your power. However, as you embody the concept of something, if you die then the thing you replaced will cease to exist with no memory of it at all.

Upon your awakening, all similar supernatural or normal objects or entities will cease to exist. An S Rank Firearms Calamity will replace anything before it, be it machine guns, pistols, fully automatic, and anything that could be considered a firearm. A Nuclear Calamity includes any kind of radioactive material like Uranium and Plutonium as well as any kind of nuclear bomb. A Human Calamity will make all humans cease to exist, leaving just you. You can select what you are a Calamity of.
objects.title: S Rank Calamity (Step Aside, I’m The One Becoming a Magical Girl)

objects.text:
You gain the power to control one person, by designating them, they will no longer be able to control their body unless you give back control. How you control them is up to you, it can be via a game controller, a keyboard and mouse, a virtual reality device, or you possess them. If the person dies, you can revive them at the cost of 2% of their max sanity. Upon 0%, they will die for good and you can switch. Moments outside of your control that are extremely special to the person, such as visiting the sick in a hospital. These will be as if you are stuck in a cutscene. You will also lose control if the person controlled is at moments of intense despair.

When you are not controlling, you get a short summarized version of the events the person does. Including what they did, what they ate, activities they have done. These activities can increase the stats of the person or improve their proficiency with a power increasing its effect.

While in control, the person being controlled gained traits akin to a souls-game. While their stats is based on their physical body, they gain the invincibility frames for 0.3 seconds while dodging and no matter how close they are to death they will be able to move. A tactical dodge that ignores even direct hits ignoring all things within that 0.3 second timeframe. Similar to souls games, once the person’s stamina bar is empty they enter a staggered state but it recovers quickly. 

If the foe you’re fighting is powerful or a boss, there are moments where the person you control can pull impossible feats surpassing their current stats akin to a cutscene for massive damage. Even against foes whose defense far surpasses your attack, you can find critical weak points in them for big riposte damage. You can glitch your way through walls, but the person you control will feel the experience of being shoved through an impossible wall, melting and fusing together then coming out of the other side.
The person you are controlling does not possess weapon limits. Even if they physically cannot swing a lamp post, under your control they will be able to. So long as they hold it, they can use it. But the person in control will feel the pain of trying to and successfully holding something they can’t normally.

Outside of combat, for puzzles, exams, or anything that requires intelligence, you can play QTE mini games to forcefully shove information into the person you control to solve it. This doesn’t require you to know what the topic is.

The person being controlled is still fully conscious of everything that is happening and will feel pain when hurt. While moving, the person in control will feel all the costs of your control. If they are tired, it feels like their lungs will give out. But they will still move according to you until their stamina bar is completely emptied. Any mental costs are also incurred on the person you are controlling.

Defeating enemies through the person you control gives you items, experience, and currency (gold) based on what it is and difficulty. This allows you to purchase or craft consumable items like health potions and equipment for your person you control. With this you will be able to upgrade the person you control. Note that currency obtained does not work in the real world and can only be used to purchase items from this power. Equipment equipped cannot be taken off, cat ears are bonded to the head and so on, but you have different loadouts to quickly change akin to a Magical Girl transformation. 

When leveling up, you can add stats to their basic attributes and three special ones. Erosion, which represents resistance to corruption or sanity loss. Spirit Vision, which represents the ability to see the truth of the world. And Unspeakable Charm, which improves your charisma and makes people more likely to worship the person you control. 

Upgrading equipment imbues enchantments onto it, a magical girl wand which can only glow can gain the effect of increased weight and gravity, attacks with it can induce stun. Randomly around the area are interactable objects that will become weapons, such as a fire hydrant becoming a high pressure water cutter.
objects.title: Code Zero (Battle, Activation, Magical Girl)

objects.text:
The sky will show the past and future similar to a television show, complete with an Opening and an Ending. The show it will display will depend on the world you are in, but it follows the main protagonists. If events already happened before this appears, it will show the past events. If nothing happened before, it will instead show the present for Season 1. 

Once it gets to Season 2, it will instead show the future if the Special Screen doesn’t exist. This future revealed will still operate as a television show, oftentimes revealing hidden dangers and foreshadows way ahead of time. In many cases, it simply reveals hidden plots happening months before it even happens. Anyone can watch this, both good and bad. It will show one episode per day, but depending on the actions in response it will quicken its pace to show even 3 episodes per day.

The television show is mostly impartial and will display what works best for a television show, mostly revealing the important bits of a character's personal lives and actions. However for you it is different, and if you have an identity you don’t want to reveal it will coincidentally cut you out of the show. 

Through editing, it only shows what you want to display. So if you act as a Magical Girl, it only shows you while transformed and not your base version. Depending on your actions in your base form, it may show what you do in it, but it will use editing trickery to conceal the fact you are the same person.
objects.title: Heavenly Screen (Magical Girl Has Been Exposed)

objects.text:
You can summon and command eighty massive stone monoliths, each roughly thirteen feet tall and seven feet wide. Every monolith possesses its own soul, allowing it to act independently. Individually or in concert, they can serve as shields, weapons, platforms, or even sensory extensions of your awareness. At any moment, you can swap places with a monolith—or even a fragment of one—making your positioning highly unpredictable.

Your power also lets you organize the monoliths into three distinct formations. The first, Vlad Pile, reshapes them into sharpened stone stakes and launches them in a devastating aerial barrage. The second, Phantom Stones, arranges the monoliths into a circular formation that disorients anything within it through overwhelming noise and sensory interference; this effect can also be inverted into a powerful, omnidirectional sonic shockwave. The final formation, Cradle Tower, draws the monoliths together into a towering structure that restores you and your allies while also producing seven stone guardians, each equipped with unique weapons for both offense and defense.

Despite its versatility, this ability has a critical limitation: its effectiveness depends on solid ground. Combat in midair or over water significantly reduces the monoliths’ strength and durability. Formations also require a sufficient number of intact monoliths; attempting to create one without enough can cause physical backlash. While individual monoliths can regenerate, sustained damage—or attacks targeting their souls—can destroy them. If a monolith is lost entirely, you can only restore it by creating a new soul, a process that takes a full month.
objects.title: Stonehenge (Superhuman Era)

addons.text:
Your Resonance Ability evolves into a modified version of Galbrena's Forte, Frequency Consumption. Retaining the capabilities and growth potential of the original, it is stabilized, free from corruption, Dark Tide dependence, and its former flaws. This Forte functions in any setting and may interact with any form of existence, energy, power system, or metaphysical structure.

Your original Resonance Ability is not lost. Instead, it becomes a white-gold flame at the core of your Resonance. It preserves your identity, stabilizes your existence, and anchors Frequency Consumption. This core continuously filters all absorbed structures, removing instability, corruption, incompatibilities, and harmful effects while ensuring that everything you acquire remains under your control. It also serves as the final authority over what you consume, allowing you to fully end targets that rely upon regeneration, resurrection, reincarnation, or similar forms of return.

Your Forte becomes Frequency Consumption. You do not simply destroy enemies. You break down and devour the structure that defines them, absorbing their traits, abilities, properties, energies, and functions into yourself. Devoured targets are preserved as stable internal constructs that may be accessed and expressed at will. Abilities may be used individually or combined without loss of function.

D.A.G. is altered to support this system. Devour becomes full assimilation, granting permanent access to what is taken. Assimilate becomes controlled extraction, allowing selective acquisition of specific traits or abilities without full consumption. Gift remains unchanged. The wolf is replaced by Chimera, which serves as the processing core. Chimera digests, filters, and stabilizes acquired structures, converting incompatible forms into usable ones. It may act independently in combat while continuously supporting your internal systems.

You begin with all frequencies, traits and abilities already possessed by Galbrena. This includes the complete devoured pattern of the Flame Demon Galbrena, granting the ability to permanently erase entities that would otherwise regenerate or return. You possess enhanced regeneration, allowing rapid recovery from otherwise fatal damage. You have access to spatial manipulation derived from devoured entities, including feather-like constructs that act as anchors for instantaneous repositioning and teleport-like movement, portal creation, and traversal across layered or adjacent spaces.

You possess advanced sensory perception adapted from devoured sources, allowing you to perceive structural weaknesses, hidden systems, energy flows, and disguised or intangible phenomena. You may manifest traits taken from consumed entities, including natural weapons, movement adaptations, defensive properties, and specialized functions, and combine multiple traits simultaneously for adaptive combat.

You inherit her combat style and equipment, including her dual pistols formed from integrated frequency constructs, capable of channeling your power through high-speed precision combat. You may also project energy directly without reliance on physical weapons.

This power has no upper limit. Any entity you can successfully devour or extract from becomes a permanent addition to your capabilities, allowing continuous growth across any environment or system.

Despite its stability, this state retains internal pressure. All consumed structures remain active within you, increasing complexity as your arsenal grows. Chimera continuously processes this load, but greater accumulation increases strain and demands stronger control. Improper integration or excessive intake may slow processing, reduce efficiency, or create internal resistance that must be overcome through willpower and mastery.
addons.title: Frequency Consumption

objects.text:
You are a Resonator, a being who experienced their Awakening, resonating with the frequencies of something in the world and gained a Resonance Ability, also called a Forte. When this happened, a symbol known as a Tacet Mark appeared somewhere on your body, giving you the ability to store and use Resonance Energy.

You can create your own Forte and how it expresses itself. It can be an element, specific object, or conceptual archetype, as long as it is not of a broad category. For example, you cannot resonate with war, as it is a broad concept, but you can resonate with mist, with your Forte being the manipulation and/or creation of mist.

A Resonator's power is not a static quantity but exists as invisible Wavebands that constitute the totality of their Forte. Through the collection and completion of Remnant Wavebands-often acquired through repeated exposure to similar frequency sources—a resonator can undergo a process of internal refinement known as a Resonance Chain. This chain acts as a progression track, enhancing a Resonator through a series of six 'Sequence Nodes', with each completed node increasing the power of a Resonator's Forte. 

But be careful, as exerting one's mental capacity, an exhausted emotional state, as well as other circumstances, can lead you to Overclock; losing control of your Forte and endangering yourself and others. The exact triggers and effects of Overclocking are unique to each Resonator.
objects.title: Resonator (Wuthering Waves)

objects.text:
Everything in this world is decided by simple games. People's lives... and even national borders!

Tet, the One True God

You have the power to invoke the covenant laid down by Tet, the God of Play, and force all conflict within an area the size of a small city to be resolved through a game. This prevents any and all forms of harm from being targeted at another sentient being within this power’s range, unless a Game is being played. Any and all types of games may be played—ranging from well-known classics like Chess to modern inventions like Video Games, or even a game made up on the spot. While the games do not need to be particularly “fair,” all sides involved should have, in theory, the ability to win. Being caught cheating in a game results in an immediate loss.
