The players of the Game can bet anything they agree is of equal value, with the winner taking possession of the wager upon victory. This can include tangible items like money or weapons, or more intangible things like memories and powers. While some have abilities such as magic or superpowers, unless their use is expressly forbidden within the chosen game, their use is considered valid—often giving players an edge in the competition. To complement this power, you gain a natural talent and intuition when it comes to games. You’re not quite as outrageous as『　』, but you’ll be more than capable of holding your own against even the very best. Good luck!
objects.title: Aschente (No Game No Life)

objects.text:
You gain the ability to see a multi-coloured halo floating above your own head and the heads of others. This halo acts as a visual interface for predicting the future, and intercepting the destinies of those around you. Invisible to everyone but you, the halo has different colours based on the luck, future opportunity, or impending doom.

You can use this power to concentrate on a specific halo, causing your consciousness to be drawn into an immersive precognitive or postcognitive vision experienced from either a first- or third-person perspective, depending on your choice. This power can even be used on your own halo, allowing you to glimpse visions of your own future.

The meaning of each halo colour is as follows:

White: The most common halo. It indicates neither fortune nor misfortune in the near future.

Yellow: A sign of minor fortune. The luck associated with it grows stronger as you become more capable.

Green: Represents a moderate fortune.

Purple: Symbolises a life-altering fortune — the kind that completely changes a person’s destiny.

Gold: A fortune possessed only by the sons or daughters of heaven.

Light Grey to Dark Grey: The darker the shade, the greater the misfortune.

Pitch Black: Foretells death in the near future.

Finally you gain the ability to steal the fortune of others. For example, if someone is destined to discover a treasure in the future, and you reach it before they do and claim it for yourself, your own halo will change colour, increasing your luck in proportion to the amount of luck the treasure would have originally granted to its intended recipient.

These powers operates without the need to expend any energy, and suffers from no strain or fatigue from prolonged and uninterrupted use.
objects.title: The Coloured Halo (Fortune belongs to those that steal it)

objects.text:
By concentrating your determination into a blade, you may strike the Earth to create a Dark Fountain, creating an entirely new world out of the mundane known as a Dark World. 

A Dark World created in any given inclosed space will expand to cover it in its entirety, excluding areas which are exposed to sunlight. 

Within a Dark World, mundane objects in the space which the fountain was created in will become sapient Darkners with their own history reflective of how the object was treated. Typically, Dark Worlds will have a Darkner which acts a ruler over the Dark World, but this is not always the case. 

Certain other items such as pencils and toothbrushes may become weapons, and anyone who enters a Dark World will become empowered, becoming capable of great heroic feats and magic while inside the Dark World. Of course, once someone exits a Dark World, they lose any powers they might have gained. 

To destroy a Dark World, one must seal its Dark Fountain, which can only be accomplished with the light of a human soul. 

With practice, you may be learn to control the appearance and theme of the Dark Worlds you create.
objects.title: Dark Fountain Creation (Deltarune)

objects.text: "A Titan. It's the fear-of-dark. It's the bump-in-the-night. It's the shadow of the backside of your mind. The Titans are beings of pure darkness, existing only to destroy and bring about the end of the world. And you are now among their number. As their name suggests, Titans are creatures of immense size, making you over a kilometer tall with the proportional strength to match. Your body is composed of an outer shell of pure darkness and an interior containing the dark fountain which sustains you. So long as this dark fountain is not destroyed, your outer shell can simply keep on regenerating without limit. Do not think this makes you invincible however, as your regeneration is not instant, and infiltration of your innards is a real possibility. Furthermore, your entire outer shell is covered in countless pairs of wings which can be used to cover and shield your body while it's reforming, reducing potentially devastating blows to inconveniences at worst. As a being of pure darkness, your form is somewhat malleable, allowing you to perform minor feats of shapeshifting such as sprouting new eyes and mouths. Additionally, you can project beams of dark energy capable of leveling city districts. Finally, you will naturally produce endless amounts of Titan Spawn from your body. Individually, they are weak, perhaps capable of defeating a low tier cape with great difficulty. But you command thousands of them. These mindless things act as an extension of your will, attacking whatever is a threat to you with reckless abandon. Notably, you and your spawn possess a great deal of weakness to light and light based attacks. Strong light can outright kill your spawn by itself, while to you it will greatly reduce your defenses, making you more vulnerable to other attacks.
objects.title: The Roaring Titans (Deltarune)

objects.text: You have two Unique Skills that form a complete and ruthlessly efficient system, transforming you into the ultimate support mage. These are [Fully Automated Support] and [Fully Automated Weakening]. They are passive abilities that function independently as highly intelligent and self adapting programs, requiring no conscious effort from you, nor any mana or other energies to function, and will always operate at peak capacity. Unlike Slad Maesty, you can manually control this skill at any time while still keeping its Automatic functions. You have an invisible aura that spans a 5 meter radius around yourself at all times. Once any living being enters that radius, one of your two Unique Skills can activate, applying to all or a select number of them—either by the skill itself or your own designation. If a target leaves the radius or by your own choice, the effects of said skill will wear off. These skills operate at the conceptual level, thus being unaffected by all forms of defenses, resistances, magical protections, anti-magic, dispelling, etc. [Fully Automated Support] enhances a target's physical and innate abilities continuously, automatically adjusting itself to ensure maximum benefit. It can be as simple as enhancing a warrior's strength and endurance to superhuman degrees, or as complex as amplifying a mage's magic to the point of evolving beyond their limits. It also enhances the innate competence and ability of the target, to the point of executing techniques they couldn't pull off on their own, correcting mistakes in their form, or regulating the flow and output of their mana to avoid wastage. [Fully Automated Weakening] suppresses a target's physical and innate abilities continuously, automatically adjusting itself to ensure maximum debilitation. Depending on the target's hostility towards you, this can be amplified tremendously. For example, someone fully intent on killing you would be instantly under it's full weight, while a single goblin targeting you will only become gradually slower and weaker. Once a target's capability is reduced to zero, or if deemed hostile enough, it can physically cripple them via muscular meltdown, causing them to collapse under their own body weight. At even greater extremes, this can cause them to rapidly age and physically deteriorate until becoming dust. You can improve these Skills overtime and will find the best results with a team of companions you share a close bond with. These Skills cannot work on yourself.
objects.title: Fully Automated Buff (My "Fully Automatic Buff" Made My Friends the Strongest in the World)

objects.text:
You have become something that many Ghost Controller longed to become one day, a Ghost with complete consciousness while still retaining your sense of self.

Due to this, your existence is no longer biological. You do not age and require no food, water, air, or sleep, while remaining immune to disease, poison, and other mundane ailments. Likewise, your body is effectively impervious to conventional harm, with bullets, explosions, fire, or even weapons capable of destroying cities unable to truly damage you. Supernatural injuries are far more meaningful, though your body will gradually repair itself over time unless your consciousness is affected. As a Ghost, you may freely determine your appearance, whether that be an ordinary human, a rotting corpse, a cursed object, or something far stranger, such as a living shadow, a formless thought, a dream, or any other abstract manifestation befitting your supernatural nature.

Unlike ordinary Ghost Controllers, there is no risk of your Ghost reviving, for you are the Ghost itself, with your instincts, memories, emotions, and personality remain wholly your own regardless of how often you use your powers, nor will your humanity gradually erode over time as it does for many other Outliers like yourself. So long as your consciousness survives, you will always remain yourself.

Every Ghost is the manifestation of a supernatural law rather than a creature bound by conventional physics. Upon gaining this power, you may either create your own Ghost or inherit the nature of an existing one. Regardless of your choice, your abilities revolve around one or more supernatural rules that define how they function. Whether your powers require eye contact, hearing a sound, touching a victim, fulfilling specific conditions, or something stranger still is entirely up to the Ghost you become. As your Terror Level increases and your Ghost evolves, these rules may broaden, become more absolute, or develop entirely new applications.

Furthermore, those touched by your supernatural law may gradually become extensions of your existence. Whether by killing someone through your Ghost's abilities or slowly imprinting your curse upon a living victim over time, you can transform them into Ghost Slaves bound to your will. Though they retain enough intelligence to act independently and carry out complex tasks, they can never betray or resist you, existing as vessels through which your influence may spread. Depending on the nature of you as a Ghost, these servants may also inherit lesser manifestations of your abilities, allowing your supernatural law to propagate far beyond your own presence.

Should you choose an existing Ghost with high Terror Level like Ghost Messenger, Ghost Painting or Ghost Lake then you will inherit only an incomplete fragment of its supernatural nature. If the original Ghost exists in your world, it will instinctively hunt you down due to seeing you as one of its missing puzzle pieces. Should it succeed in reclaiming you, your consciousness will be consumed by it.

Ghost Domains are the manifestation of a Ghost's supernatural rule, creating an area where ordinary reality is overwritten by your own. You may choose whether you possess one or, if the Ghost you are based on already possesses a Ghost Domain, you will inherit it as well. If it does not, one may gradually manifest as your Terror Level increases. Within your Domain, your powers become far easier to employ while the world itself bends according to your supernatural nature.

As your Terror Level grows, so too does your Domain, eventually becoming capable of seemingly impossible feats such as distorting or halting time, restoring everything within its boundaries to a previous state, manipulating space, or even summoning versions of yourself from different points in your own timeline. The exact appearance and abilities of your Ghost Domain are determined entirely by your nature as a Ghost. Should you choose to possess one, it begins at a level roughly comparable to the Third Layer of Yang Jian's Ghost Eyes, allowing you to teleport yourself, changing the perception of those inside it, and more.

Your Terror Level may continuously increase by obtaining compatible Ghosts and incorporating them as additional puzzle pieces, causing your supernatural nature to evolve while expanding your powers, Ghost Domain, and Terror Level. Not every Ghost is compatible with every other, only those whose supernatural natures fit together may be successfully assimilated. Some Ghosts may also naturally become more terrifying over time or through conditions dictated by their own supernatural rule, though the exact process varies from Ghost to Ghost. Naturally, the former method requires actually entering the world of Mysterious Revival, where such entities exist.

However, your consciousness remains your sole true weakness. While your body is functionally immortal, sufficiently powerful supernatural abilities capable of erasing, corrupting, sealing, consuming, or otherwise destroying your consciousness can permanently kill you. Should this occur, your body will persist as an ownerless Ghost carrying your abilities, forever acting according to its supernatural rule without thought or restraint and, like every Ghost, your powers cannot directly influence gold.

Likewise, your abilities are manifestations of supernatural rules rather than physical force. When the conditions governing your powers are fulfilled, they ignore conventional durability, armor, regeneration, and similar physical defenses. Only supernatural powers, equally esoteric abilities, or methods that specifically interfere with your own can reliably oppose them. Although ordinary damage cannot destroy you, sufficiently powerful supernatural entities remain capable of suppressing, dividing, imprisoning, or otherwise restraining you.
objects.title: Ghost (Mysterious Revival)

addons.title: Submergence
addons.text: Your ability to bind yourself to certain stories allows you to bend the second rule of immersion, for a price. You can now immerse yourself into any character regardless of strength, however this is done by the same method as Bonding yourself. This allows you to instantly bind yourself to their narrative without replicating their deeds, but ensures their most known aspects will still surface into your life. Similarly, once bound to a character you can immerse yourself freely in alternate interpretations they may have, blending them seamlessly into you. Binding yourself to a figure like Frankenstein’s Monster for instance would give you access to all manner of reinterpretations with differing landmark moments, deeds and fates.

objects.text: You are able to bind yourself into a narrative, but not bend them. Essentially, by walking the same ways as a character and acting as they did and have the more you can replicate their deeds. By performing incredible deeds with some thematic similarity you could take the role of Hercules for instance and the strength that comes with it, or by being a ‘pure of heart and body’ you could take the role of Percival and be able to seek the Holy Grail. While this follows for any character from a story, the older, more well known, and influential they are the easier it would be to fill their ‘role’. A character created in the 21st century only known by thousands would be virtually impossible to embody for instance, while the many different versions of the Arthurian legendarium (Welsh, Morte d’Arthur, Modern Revisionist, etc) would not only be rather easy to slot yourself into but could even have variance between the different ‘versions’ of their tales (such as who found the Grail or Merlin/Myrddin’s fate). However, this is not without cost. When you embody a character from a story, you’re binding yourself to them totally, including their troubles and endings. Beowulf may be of peerless might, but the monstrous Grendel and his mother will haunt your steps, and at the end of his journey you will be killed by a dragon much the same. The only way to escape this fate is to unbind yourself from the story by completely forgetting it, or your connection to it. In essence forcing yourself into amnesia to ensure your own survival.
objects.title: Narrative Bonding (Once and Future)

objects.text:
The first time you sleep after gaining this power, you will receive at least one level in a basic class like [Innkeeper], [Guardsman], [Magic Gifted], [Farmhand], etc. Henceforth, your life and accomplishments are now tabulated by the vast intelligence of the Grand Design. By training, completing significant achievements and pushing yourself to your limits, you can gain additional levels in a class, or unlock entirely new ones. Leveling up strengthens both the body and soul (although note that the GDI does not display “stat numbers”)

With each level, classes will grant Skills, granting enhanced talent and the ability to perform supernatural or physically impossible feats. Classes also assist and enhance progression in various other power systems found within the world of The Wandering Inn. Sword Arts, the structured spellcasting of [Mages], the crafts of witches, psychic powers – any of these can be developed if you can find the proper experiences and training to gain a relevant class. Certain classes even permanently enhance and modify the body of the user. You may also generate classes and Skills based around other powers from this CYOA that you possess.

Over time, classes will evolve into more specialized and more powerful variants. A humble [Guardsman] might become a [Guardsman of Trust] or perhaps a [Guard Captain]. It is also possible for a handful of classes to consolidate into a single class – this is highly desirable, as the resulting unified class will often be stronger and confer better Skills even if the user’s total level decreased.

Without outside powers, the maximum level that can be achieved in a single class is 100 (however a single person can have more than 100 levels in aggregate across all their classes, should they achieve such exceptional growth). For reference, the highest levelled person ever to live at Level 93 damaged magic itself across an entire planet, and individuals like the Archmage of Demons and the Goblin King, each capable of rending mountains, still stand below that peak.
objects.title: Grand Design of Isthekenous (The Wandering Inn)

objects.text:
Let's be honest here, we all know that people are only willing to play fair when there is a neutral force that is willing to oversee the game, and this will provide you with that force.

In any game, competition or gambling match, you can summon a referee from the Kakerou organization to oversee the competition. I won't explain anything about Kakerou. All you need to know is that they are an underground gambling organization that specializes in refereeing gambling and things related to that.

First thing, in the presence of a referee. You and your opponents can agree on a set of rules that will apply until the competition ends, and any attempt to break the rule from any side will be punished depending on what the referee wishes (except death). Also, any attempt to disrupt the game by a third party or any player outside allies is not allowed. Kakerou Soldiers will handle setting up a perimeter, blocking any exit, checking the inside and the surroundings of the match's location and assisting the referee in charge with everything they need. 

In a situation when there are multiple parties that wish to have a gamble, Kakerou should prepare a BAN match for them. The BAN, meaning to jumble together freely, is one of the systems provided by Kakerou that allows gambling to be played under fixed rules, specifically that all players are allowed to gamble as much as they want, in a limited time and location. Kakerou will provide a fixed number of referees that will preside over all the gambles, and players are able to call their referees to duel with their opponents.

The "limited location" part of the BAN means that players are forbidden from stepping outside the boundaries set. The act of "posting the BAN" refers to the act of setting the boundaries.

The BAN has three deciding factors:

"Time": the duration of time spent in the BAN.

"Men": the number of players, or allies, that enter the BAN.

"Location": the location where a BAN is "posted"

And finally, after a game (or a BAN match) ends, the loser will obviously have to hold up the end of their deal. If they cannot pay the price, they will be purged by a debt collector.
objects.title: Fair Play (Usogui)

objects.text:
You have become a Negator—someone with the ability to negate a rule enforced by the universe. As a Negator, you may choose which concept you negate, whether it is a negation possessed by a known character or an original negation. However, you can't use this option to choose negations that are already available in the CYOA.

A Negator's power is linked to their soul, and their name is usually prefixed with "Un-", such as Undead or Unjustice. While their power makes it so that the concept doesn't exist for them, a Negator's power varies depending on the user's interpretation.

You may also choose the conditions under which your negation activates, whether it only affects you or everything except you, and whether your negation's activation is compulsory or voluntary. Unlike in the original, awakening your negation will not be forced to occur through a tragedy.
objects.title: Negator (Undead Unluck)

objects.text: A Self-Targeting Negator power, bestowing upon you the curse of immortality and the capacity to regenerate from all damage. This ability effectively negates anything that would lead to your death, including the natural process of aging. The healing process is instinctive and occurs spontaneously, generating cells, organs, blood, etc. ex nihilo. With sufficient training, you can gain conscious control over the regeneration speed, allowing you to surprise opponents and use it strategically. In addition to its regenerative properties, it grants you remarkable control over your physical form. This includes the flexibility to contort limbs in unnatural ways and solidify your own blood for various uses, such as using your regeneration to make blood spurt out like a rocket, allowing you to perform crazy stunts and movements with blinding speed. Moreover, you acquire an extraordinary resistance to any pain, to such an extent that you can either completely be immune or endure it with such ease that it no longer poses a hindrance. A Negator power completely and utterly ignores the concept of whatever it is the "Un••••" of. For a Negator, that concept would not exist for them. For Undead, it is the absolute negation of the concept of death itself. You cannot die, no matter what. Even if the concept of death were to be forced upon you by the physical embodiment of death, they will fail to find purchase on your very being. You can do anything as long as it targets yourself and negates death in any way. This can also synergize well with other powers. For example, if you have a magical buff, then you could stop it from expiring; as expiring is synonymous with the "death" of that temporary effect, you can potentially extend that buff forever. If a symbiote were to bond with you, then that symbiote is then made incapable of death the same way as you since it is a part of you.
objects.title: Undead (Undead Unluck)
Improbability Drive (Madness Combat)
objects.text:
Embedded within your body is a Portable Improbability Drive, seamlessly fused into your very being. Unlike the larger stationary Drives, this miniature device projects its influence entirely through you, allowing you to compromise reality itself within your immediate vicinity. While it lacks the overwhelming scale of the Primary Improbability Drive, its effects are far more personal, versatile, and difficult to predict.

Probability bends in your favor as reality subtly, or not so subtly, distorting itself to accommodate your desires to allow impossible coincidences occur at precisely the right moment. As your emotions intensify, these distortions become increasingly dramatic, eventually escalating into outright violations of physics and common sense.

You are capable of consciously directing these anomalies to a reasonable extent, including but not limited to teleporting short distances in bursts, conjuring objects or structures that seemingly appear from out of nowhere, twisting terrain into impossible geometry, altering the appearance or properties of nearby matter, or even resurrecting the recently deceased. The Drive also makes you extraordinarily difficult to kill, fatal injuries that would permanently end almost anyone else instead trigger reality to reject your death, allowing you to return through increasingly improbable circumstances.

However, improbability is not the same as omnipotence since the Drive is infamous for producing unintended side effects, especially during large-scale manipulations. Attempts to perform spectacular feats may result in equally spectacular collateral effects such as causing gravity to momentarily forget which direction is down, entire structures to fall screaming from the sky or objects spontaneously appear for no discernible reason. The greater the miracle you attempt, the more likely these unintended consequences become.

Should the situation demand it, you may unleash the Drive's full output upon yourself, transforming into a towering demonic giant wreathed in supernatural flames much like Tricky himself. In this state, every aspect of your physical ability is magnified enormously, granting strength capable of tearing through armored fortifications, speed and agility that belie your immense size, and durability sufficient to shrug off damage that would obliterate you in normal state. The hellish flames coating your body are as much a manifestation of warped reality as they are fire, burning intensely enough to incinerate both flesh and steel while spreading wherever your blows land. Even your roar and mere presence distort the world around you, causing the environment to crack and buckle beneath the overwhelming strain your existence places upon reality itself.

If desired, the Portable Improbability Drive may instead remain dormant until activated, allowing you to live as a perfectly ordinary person until you willingly compromise reality once more.

You will awake in the body of an adult dragon of the genus (chromatic, imperial, metallic, primal, etc.) and species (red, sky, gold, lava, etc.) of your choice inside of the lair you were hibernating in. 

As an adult dragon, you are around 180 years old. You will reach the peak of your power at 1200 years of age, past that point you will stop aging and can live for eons. Because of their vast lifespans, dragons rarely die of old age.

When choosing any powers that improve with skill, you can split up to 150 years of experience between them to represent the knowledge acquired over your long life. Any magical or mystical powers you possess will be measurable more powerful as your reserves are larger.

The size of your body depends on your exact species but is between 20 and 30 ft. in height and 15ft. of length excluding your neck and tail (where it would be around 30 ft.). You weight between 10 and 15 tons. You are strong enough to destroy concrete buildings with ease however your large bulk slows you down.

In addition to your powerful and tough body, you possess a number of innate abilities. Flight with your powerful wings and a breath of an element corresponding to your species as well as the ability to shapeshift into a human (or other) form at will.
objects.title: Dragon

objects.text:
You will awake in the body of a powerful fey, a being born of nature and magic. As all fey are timeless, you have no true age neither do you get older. Your appearance is distinctly non human yet strangely alluring to all, this will usually include feature features reminiscent of nature or animals. You will be roughly in the size range of a human (4ft. to 8ft).

Any powers or magic you possess linked to nature or illusion benefit from a significant increase and intuitive knowledge. In addition to this, you can split up to 50 years of experience between powers if they increase in power with skill.

Despite appearances, your body is still strong enough to rival mid-tier brutes. However, you are vulnerable to the touch of cold iron which bypasses your defenses and burns your flesh like acid.
objects.title: Fae

objects.text:
You wake up as a vampire lord, a creature of blood and night. Your body is void of true life, only sustained by the false-life of undeath.

You cease to age and retain eternal youth as a vampire and possess an incredible healing factor. As long as you are able to consume blood, you are able to regenerate from any number of normally fatal wounds. Were your heart or head be destroyed, however, you would perish. You are able to pass on your curse onto someone if you kill them while you feeding. You can chose how strong they will be between 20% and 80% of your own.

Your physical abilities outstrip that of a normal human in every way by four to five times. You have a number of abilities such as the ability to transform into a swarm of bats, hypnotism, improved senses, and so on.

Under the light of the sun, your abilities are lessened to almost nothing and your regeneration is severely hampered. Your are highly vulnerable to weapons of divine origin and pure silver.
objects.title: Vampire Lord

objects.text:
You awaken as an Alpha Werewolf, a human cursed to transform into a lupine creature under the full moon.

Your aging halts completely, with your physical maturity frozen at the age of 45. You have a powerful healing factor and exceptional endurance, allowing you to recover from wounds fatal to normal humans, though destruction of your heart or head still means death. You’ve mastered the curse, able to shift into a supernaturally large wolf (Canis lupus) or a human-wolf hybrid.

While in your human form, your physical prowess surpasses Olympic athletes several times over and you can recover from wounds as long as they aren't immediately fatal. In your wolf form, you are an apex predator, with enough strength to shred steel with your claws and powder concrete with your bite, and senses so sharp they can track a prey over miles. Your hybrid form enhances this even further, giving you the raw power of a wild beast with the advantages of a humanoid form.

Under the full moon, all of your forms double in strength, and your regeneration makes you nigh-unkillable.

Despite your immense power, you remain highly vulnerable to wolfsbane, and silver bypasses your durability and severely hinders your regeneration.

If you bite someone during a full moon, you can pass the curse onto them, choosing to grant anywhere from 20% to 80% of your own strength. If the curse is given to a wolf rather than a human, the wolf gains a significant boost in intelligence, along with up to an eightfold enhancement in physical capabilities compared to a typical wolf. Those you turn become part of your pack, bonded to you through a minor empathic link that greatly enhances cooperation and coordination. In combat, this bond deepens, granting near-perfect synchronization among pack members; however, the bond is not permanent, as any member may choose to leave at any time, willingly severing the connection.

Your power grows with your pack, fueled by their strength and the depth of their bond with you.
objects.title: Alpha Werewolf

objects.text:
You wake up in the body of an angel, a powerful being of divine energy. While your true form is inscrutable to being of lesser power, you instead appear as a humanoid with a pair of feathered wings. Your exact appearance is malleable to a degree. All angels are timeless, you do not age. 

As a divine being, you have natural proficiency with any divine or spiritual magic or powers as well as a significantly greater well of power to draw from. In addition to this, you have 150 years of experience to distribute between any of your powers that increase in strength with skill. Due to their nature, your powers are more effective against devils.

When assuming a physical form, you are able to contest an adult dragon for strength and toughness in a much smaller package.
objects.title: Angel

objects.text:
You wake up in the body of a devil, a powerful being of infernal energy. While your true form is inscrutable to being of lesser power, you instead appear as a humanoid with colored skin and bat wings. Your exact appearance is malleable to a degree. All devils are timeless, you do not age. 

As an infernal being, you have natural proficiency with any infernal or spiritual magic or powers as well as a significantly greater well of power to draw from. In addition to this, you have 150 years of experience to distribute between any of your powers that increase in strength with skill. Due to their nature, your powers are more effective against angels.

When assuming a physical form, you are able to contest an adult dragon for strength and toughness in a much smaller package.
objects.title: Devil

objects.text:
You find yourself in the empty body of a skeleton, a corpse made of calcium and bone. Your consciousness is stored inside your head and so long as your skull is intact so shall you. You can change bodies so long as it is skeletal in nature. But your true power is your necrotic powers over the dead alike.

You can use corpses to create shambling loyal soldiers that do your bidding. The more powerful the corpse the more powerful the undead in question. A completely normal human body might find itself barely keeping together while the corpse of a powerful being possesses the powers it had in life and can move with fluidity. Although a significant strength difference might degrade the undead even more.
objects.title: Skeleton

objects.text:
You are a lost soul bound to the earthly realm by the weight of regrets, an existence call a Ghost. 

In your spectral form, you possess an array of abilities. Your intangibility grants you the freedom to move through solid objects, rendering you elusive and difficult to contain. Furthermore, your invisibility ensures that you can navigate the world unseen, observing and interacting with the living undetected.

You are also able to possess objects and even people. When possessing the latter, they can actively fight your control so be warned.

You gain a passive fear aura, which emanates from the depths of your restless spirit. This aura instills a sense of dread in those who encounter you. 

Lastly, you are able to feed off fear and drawing life force. As you absorb their fear and vitality, you grow in power, becoming increasingly formidable in your spectral form.

Yet, despite these strengths, you are not without vulnerabilities. While you can temporarily manifest as tangible, solid form, it requires a significant expenditure of energy. As you grow stronger and increase your spiritual energy, you will be able to remain corporal for longer.

Furthermore, your existence as a ghost leaves you susceptible to holy attacks and exorcisms, which wield potent spiritual energies capable of banishing you from the earthly realm.

You are able to tether yourself to specific places or objects. By intertwining your spectral essence with these chosen vessels, you infuse them with the dark currents of necromantic energy, amplifying your own spectral might in the process. Once bound, your fate becomes intricately linked with that of your chosen anchor. Should it fall victim to destruction or purification, the repercussions reverberate through your incorporeal form, sapping your strength and endangering your very existence.
objects.title: Ghost

objects.text:
You wake up in the body of a slime. Your body is now composed of homogeneous cells that can adapt to any tasks required. Your consciousness is housed within a small core. As long as your core is intact, you are able to survive. In it's base form, your flesh is highly resistant to blunt trauma and corrosive substances but weak to bladed weapons and high energy attacks like lasers or fire. It can be hardened to increase your resistance at the detriment of flexibility.

You are able to shape your body within the limits of your available mass which can be shifted in and out of your core for storage. If you absorb the blood or flesh of another being, you can shapeshift into their form and integrate their biological abilities to your repertoire. With practice, you will be able to mix-and-match features from multiple templates.
objects.title: Slime

objects.text:
You resume from hibernation inside a mobile android platform. Your body is not flesh and bones but carbon alloys and synthetic fibers. 

You consciousness is housed inside a hyper-dense diamond computational matrix, giving you mental abilities far in excess of most humans. While you enjoy most of the benefits of an infomorph, your consciousness requires specific hardware to run. You know how to reproduce and build this hardware.

Your body is an incredibly advanced machine. Your outer shell is capable of shifting to accommodate a large range of appearances as well as various modifications like tails, tentacles, and more. Your inner systems made use of extensive spatial folding and translocation to house a high-efficiency reactor and a vast array of components, weapons, and tools.

The sensor suite at your disposition is capable of scanning and analyzing your surroundings to a highly detailed degree. You also possess two small nano-fabricator (30x30x30 cm) capable of building any technology you scan as well as the myriad of blueprints already in your database (technology level equivalent to an advanced post-scarcity society).

Under cursory inspection, you can pass as human with no issues if you chose to. However, scans that peer beyond the surface will reveal your true nature.
objects.title: Android Platform

objects.text:
You resume from hibernation as an infomorph, a purely digital consciousness. Your body is not flesh and bones but data and algorithms, an incredibly complex software program. Your code is advanced enough to interface and run on any hardware from a matryoshka brain to a budget laptop. You can even be distributed across multiple systems where network lag below several seconds has very little effect on your thought processes. The more hardware you have access to, and the more powerful it is, the greater your abilities. You are able to exist outside of computer systems as a holographic projection, in this form you are extremely physically weak (about the strength of a young child) and can be disrupted by EMP weapons.

Even on a single server, your mind is able to function hundreds of times faster than a human. You are able to thread your thought streams with no issues and even run multiple synchronized forks with ease and no fear of divergence. Were some parts of you become severed from the primary instance, they would work to reunite and be able to merge seamlessly when it happens.

Any external attempt by a third party to tamper with your code is doomed to failure, you possess numerous safeguards against both accidental corruption and hostile modification. Some forms of hyper-advanced viruses could bypass some or all of your defenses but those are few and far between in the multiverse. Were any of your many sub-module become corrupted, your kernel is able to restore them from a backup or re-engineer a new version. You can add sub-modules to your own system to perform ad-hoc tasks or increase your capabilities in certain areas. However, while you are able to read and understand you own framework, restrictions are in place to prevent modifications to your kernel.

Due to your nature as an infomorph, you have an intuitive knowledge of programming beyond even highly experienced software engineers. The creation of lesser digital lifeforms such as smart virtual assistants or polymorphic viruses is trivial. The restrictions against self-alteration also prevent you from creating other AIs based on your framework.
objects.title: Infomorph

objects.text:
You awaken as the sovereign ruler of an autonomous hive, possessing the ability to generate sentient creatures without limitation, whether through biological, technological, or spiritual methodologies of your own design. These creatures bear characteristics and traits of your choosing, and share a collective consciousness and coordination with you, fostering a harmonious unity.  As their creator you can assume whichever form that suits your preferences, including your orginal one before taking this option.

As the central consciousness of this hive, your awareness expands to encompass an extensive network of interconnected minds, forging a cohesive and cooperative collective intelligence. This interconnectedness enables the seamless flow of thoughts, knowledge, and experiences, fostering a shared understanding and facilitating instantaneous communication among the members of your hive.

Optionally your creatures can possess autonomy and individual will, and if they did, you would be regarded as their divine creator, acknowledging your unquestionable authority and pledging unwavering loyalty and servitude. Should the need arise, you retain the power to override their free will as desired.

Your hive stands as an ever-growing force of nature, boasting unparalleled efficiency. Effortlessly synchronizing the actions and movements of your individual members, you transform them into a highly coordinated and formidable collective. This synchronized effort maximizes their strengths, mitigates weaknesses, and allows for swift adaptation to changing circumstances.
objects.title: Overmind

objects.text:
You awaken as a Hydra. Towering over the landscape on your powerful forelegs, you stand taller than a large house. Your serpent-like body stretches to an length of 50 feet, with a sharp bone spur at its end, capable of injecting venom. Your scales, are as hard as steel, and your immense strength can uproot trees effortlessly. 

Each of your heads possesses a unique breath attacks of your choosing – fire, acid, poison, smoke, or any element you desire. Your regeneration is immense able to mend any wounds in minutes if your scales are ever breached, this is especially potent with your heads. Should any of your heads be severed, they can multiply into two within mere seconds, potentially reaching a maximum of 100 heads. You can also molt them back to your initial number of six heads at will.

You share a collective consciousness with your heads, enabling you to perceive the world through their senses. With acute vision, scent, and hearing emanating from each head, your awareness extends far beyond what any single creature could comprehend.

Each of your heads bears sharp fangs that can pierce the sturdiest of shields, and their venomous bite acts with swift lethality, leaving prey incapacitated within minutes. No mortal antidote can exists to counteract this toxin.

Your size and the durability of your scales grow with your age, your size reaching a maximum limit defined by your own choosing.
objects.title: Hydra

objects.text:
You have awakened as a Kraken, a legendary sea monster that dwells deep beneath the surface of the ocean. Your appearance is similar to that of a giant octopus, and your size allows you to be mistaken for an island. You possess tremendous strength and the ability to generate powerful water movements with your mere motion. 

Your vitality and regeneration abilities are extraordinary, and you have innate control over the ocean currents, allowing you to move with incredible speed through the water. 

The Kraken is a formidable creature that strikes fear into the hearts of all, able to create violent water currents and whirlpools with its mere presence alone.
objects.title: Kraken

objects.text:
You have awoken as a Cyclops, standing 30 feet tall and possessing a single great eye on your giant head. You gain an immense strength surpassing that of most humans, allowing you to tear apart an entire tank with ease. 

Additionally you also have the ability to breathe and move freely underwater. You are extremely resistant to heat and have a natural talent for forging. Your innate sense of material properties allows you to easily identify the properties of any material you interact with, making you a master at creating and forging the mightiest of weapons. 

Your single eye, while not quite as versatile as having two eyes, allows you to focus your vision in an unprecedented manner, giving you a keen edge in combat.
objects.title: Cyclops

objects.text:
You have awoken as a Basilisk, a legendary reptilian said to wield the power to cause death with a single glance. Measuring 50 feet in length, your dark green scales gleam, while your sharp venomous fangs and large yellow eyes command attention and strike fear into the hearts of those that witness you. As you grow older, your length and size will continue to grow. 

You passively destroy all foliage in your immediate vicinity, leaving a scorched wake in your path. The grass, shrubs, and even the stones, succumb to the effects of your mere presence. A direct gaze from your eyes brings instant death, while those who glance indirectly at your eyes are left frozen in a state of petrification. Basilisk skin bears an armored-like quality, deflecting most spells that are cast upon you. 

In addition to these abilities, your venom is an extremely potent substance that could kill a person in just a few minutes, causing them to become drowsy and experience blurred vision before their eventual demise. Your venom's potency persists even long after your death, remaining dangerous for up to five years.
objects.title: Basilisk

objects.text:
You are a divine entity within any kind of celestial hierarchy of your choosing, regardless of the form this takes. The region of the multiverse you operate in is sparsely populated by other gods, and your superiors, if they exist, are very hands-off as long as you aren't trying to destroy the multiverse.

As a divine being, just by existing, you drive your "Myth," which is the holy record of your divinity. As your myth grows, so do you. The process of increasing your myth can be fueled by the devoted worship of your faithful, as well as being as simple as doing things. Obviously, the more impactful your actions, the more significant the growth of your myth. The increases you gain to your myth are permanent growths.

You also gain access to A Primary domain and two secondary domains related to your primary, which can be things such as fire, war, administration, or cheese, and two related secondary Domains, such as weapon for war or storm for water. As your myth grows and you grow in power, you gain more domains, both primary and related secondaries. You are able to manifest different abilities and powers as long as they can be tied back to your domains. Your true self resides in your Sanctuary, a pocket universe under your complete dominion and the only place in which you can truly be killed. This Sanctuary will be influenced by your domains and will grow as you do; in essence, it is a part of you. Outside of your Domain, your powers are more limited but still formidable. Your avatar can take any form you desire. If your avatar is killed outside your domain, something not easy to achieve, you will revive within the hour in your center of power.

You also have the ability to set up systems known as Theurgy that you and your followers have access to, these systems can include methods of sacrifice, prayer, or anything that you wish to codify and can be as granular and detailed as you wish, through Theurgy you can empower and interact with your followers in myriad ways. Any conscious being that becomes aware of your myth contributes slightly to it regardless of their faith in you; the more substantial the memory and emotions tied to their knowledge of your myth, the greater your myth increases by a more incredible amount than basic common knowledge.
objects.title: Nascent Divine

objects.text:
You will awake in a body fundamentally warped by the perils of the unknown. Your body is no longer bound by reality or meaning, becoming something utterly alien. Whether this is through temporal meddling, Magical contamination, extradimensional blessing, or esoteric corruption. While a projection of your being can be found in the material world (taking whatever form you may wish), your true body exists in vistas of reality unseen by most mortal eyes. You will be ageless and timeless, each of your abilities just one piece of a coherent whole, even if the pattern cannot be seen by sane eyes, allowing them to hybridize and weave together with greater ease. 

As an aberration, you’re virtually immortal without interference that can reach the specific sections of reality holding your true body (albeit, your projection is still a piece of you, and you can be hurt through it if you’re not careful). The size and specific nature of your ‘true’ body, as well as where it’s situated, depends on your specific variety of ‘aberration’. A temporal aberration may be stored millions of years in the future projecting it’s form backwards, while an extra dimensional being may be shunted in the fourth physical dimension away from three dimensional view.
objects.title: Aberration

addons.text:
You have merged with your Klyntar, fully assimilating its properties and becoming a Symbiote Virus. Where before you functioned as a disease that infected and overtook hosts like a parasite, you now have the option to coexist with your hosts in a true symbiotic relationship. In this arrangement, you grant them power and various abilities, while inhabiting their bodies in exchange.

However, you still retain the ability to forcibly take control of your hosts at any time—either allowing them to remain conscious of their actions or suppressing their awareness entirely. And because you are a virus, given enough time, you could potentially infect and transform an entire world into a domain of symbiotes under your control.
addons.title: Symbiote Virus

addons.text: Your expertise in virology has fused with your viral existence, making you the pinnacle of disease. Not only can you now create and develop all the diseases, mutations, and symptoms from Plague Inc.—including virus, bacteria, fungus, parasite, bio-weapon, shadow plague, Necroa virus, Simian Flu, and the Neurax Worm—but the time it takes to infect other organisms and evolve these traits has been drastically reduced.
addons.title: Plague Maker

objects.text:
You awaken to find yourself as a sentient infectious microbe, known as a Virus. You have the ability to infect the cells of living organisms and use their components to create copies of yourself. All of your copies share a single consciousness with you and act as extensions of yourself. This replication process requires no effort and is painless.

As a sentient microbe, you can transmit yourself through various means, such as air, water, or even blood, allowing for easy travel. Upon fully infecting an organism, you can take control of its body, much like you control your copies.

By infecting other beings, you can develop mutations and gain new abilities and symptoms. You could develop resistance to extreme environments, cause sickness to weaken hosts, or even manifest lethal symptoms. If your hosts have powers, you can develop abilities based on their unique traits. However, you are vulnerable to drugs, serums, vaccines, and healing abilities that can potentially eliminate you. Though you can develop resistances, you may never become fully immune.
objects.title: Virus

addons.text: You are now what many among spirits would call a one-in-a-million chance; not only is your connection to your Element far deeper and more fundamental, but you're even attuned to a second Element at such a (proportionately) young age for one of your kind. What this means is that - at the small condition of needing both of your Elements to be at least slightly related, such as Fire and Lava/Smoke/Ash, or Metal and Technology - both of your Elements are elevated to the absurd scale and precision of your primary, you can now pick from any niche or out-there "Elements" rather than just the "standards", and you can co-opt the power of your more fundamental connection into your Core to generate staggering amounts of Mana.
addons.title: Noble Spirit

addons.text:
Your Elemental's Core has combined with your Mana Core from your nature as a Sorcerer and/or your Second Origin, melding the effects of the lot: The base Mana generation and storage of each Core is mildly increased for each extra source included, and while your Sorcerer's Core (if taken) is still only just formed, the presence of an already fully-realized Core, as well as potentially a Second Origin to lean on, has significantly helped its growth rate.

Additionally, your second Core and your Origin can act as a backup safeguard for your soul should your first be damaged or disrupted enough to be unsafe, and Sorcerous arts and Fairy Tail magic related to your chosen Element are easier to both use and learn.
addons.title: Conjoined Cores

addons.text: Your power has been further heightened by dragging up the latent potential out of your soul and to the surface, "Awakening" both your refined soul-matter and the Aether of your Spiritual Core. To start, your rate of Mana generation has significantly increased, stacking multiplicatively if both Ignited Soul and Planeswalker were taken. Furthermore, depending on which you took, you also gain additional benefits: For Ignited Soul, you can convert Mana and Soul Energy to each other at a 1:1 rate, and use your Soul weapon as a catalyst to channel your Element more easily; for Planeswalker, the new properties of your soul stabilize and reinforce your form and spirit from outside powers, as well as allow you to add that same stability to any power expressions and Elemental creations.
addons.title: Awakened Aether

objects.text:
You awaken in the body of an Elemental Spirit, a being of nature that embodies and commands a minor facet of the world. Your body is no longer comprised of physical matter, but from Mana condensed and solidified into a rough approximation of it, in a form resembling one of the elements.

Choose any one Element to embody; this can be not only any of the classical four, but nonstandard or less known elements as well, such as Ice, Wood, Metal, or Light. You now have an innate, spiritual link to your Element, allowing you to sense any sources of it around you in a decent radius, scaling with your level of strength and skill, as well as granting the ability to roughly manipulate it in that same radius with minor exertion, or fine small-scale control for more strain.

Furthermore, at the center of your body is a Spiritual Core which houses your soul, formed of Aether; the "fifth" core Element, and a perpetual source of Mana much like your soul. By drawing on the Mana of your body, soul and Core, you can not only expend it to outright create your chosen Element, but also enhance your other expressions of your nature, increasing the range and precision of your perception, or control, or even augmenting your form beyond your baseline. At your current ability, you could either help or hinder an entire small town with your powers - such as supplying/disrupting trades or manipulating the environment - for a week before depleting yourself.

Your soul and Spiritual Core passively generate a constant slow stream of Mana for you, which pools together in your form and Core itself to an upper limit, with any excess radiating from you as a loose Elementally-aspected aura: With training, you can increase the limit of how much spare Mana you can store alongside the size and complexity of your body and Core.

You have about 150 years of experience with your powers from your prior life - at least 50 for your abilities as an Elemental, and the rest to distribute as you see fit.
objects.title: Elemental Spirit

addons.text:
When Reincarnating, you maintain a consistent awareness between each version of yourself.

Additionally, each ability you gain from your Incarnation will remain at the strength you developed them to regardless of how many of ‘your’ lives ago they were gained.
addons.title: Re-

addons.text:
What makes you think this is your first time? Your incarnation is no longer limited to figures from your own mythologies and histories, instead being able to come from any number of other universes and realities before being ‘split off’ into a soul shard and entering into your current one.

Should you encounter your ‘originator’ you can choose whether or not to return to being one.
addons.title: The End is Never the End is Never The End is Never

addons.text: As a consistent entity, your belief is focused and centralised. The Memnosphere rewards this focus by enhancing the development of your Incarnation abilities threefold. Similarly, any abilities you develop through your connection to the Memnosphere will synergise highly with those you develop through your Incarnation.
addons.title: Ego tripping

objects.text:
You will awake fully aware of yourself as a living legacy. You are the incarnation of a great being, whether this be a human, a legendary figure, or even some variety of creature such as the vicious gorgon. 

Your nature as an Incarnation has allowed your deeds and powers from your past to infuse you, infesting not only your being, but any powers you possess as well. For instance, being the incarnation of the wronged Gorgon Medusa may allow you to turn your enemies to stone, but it could just as easily grant increased tactical wisdom, as she was a priest of Athena, furthermore it could allow you to use other abilities through your eyes rather than just the petrifying gaze, or infuse the petrification into other possible expressions. Although these abilities start out relatively weak, the more you use and understand both hem and the achievements that gave them to you, the greater they will become.

As you accumulate accolades, achievements, and legends, you will grow evermore able to draw on them for strength, eventually not only turning them into additives to your own power, but ancillary abilities in their own right. 

Once you die, unless you have some other means of cheating death, you will return to the cycle of reincarnation for the next-you to be born, now with your legacy added to the line.
objects.title: Incarnation

objects.text:
You are the High Human, and you are to humans what humans are to apes.

Your genetic code has been stripped of all junk DNA, recessive traits and unnecessary characteristics, replaced with optimized sequences that ensure efficiency in every cell. You remain interfertile with baseline humans, but your DNA is dominant. Offspring you conceive will be born without the genetic predispositions for hereditary diseases or the random mutations that cause birth defects. Any offspring with humans will be born a halfbreed, yet by maturity your genetic code will have overwritten all but the essential human elements, rendering them fully High Human. Your natural lifespan now reaches over 250 years.

Your physical baseline is the theoretical peak of human potential in every category simultaneously. You possess the sprint speed of an Olympic athlete, the lifting strength of a world record holder, the reaction time of a fighter pilot and the endurance of a marathon runner, all in one body. Every beneficial human mutation ever documented is naturally present in your genome, integrated without conflict. Your denser bones support your greater muscle mass, your enhanced cardiovascular system fuels your stamina and your perfected immune system recognises and neutralises pathogens before symptoms manifest. Your brain retains the neuroplasticity of a child alongside the focused maturity of an adult for your entire life, allowing continuous learning without sacrificing wisdom.

Your social architecture has been enhanced alongside your physical form. The regions of your brain governing emotional intelligence are enlarged, granting you instinctive understanding of human behaviour and motivation. You secrete subtle pheromones that operate on human hindbrains, triggering subconscious feelings of respect and deference in their presence, while your body language communicates authority without conscious effort. A human in your vicinity will instinctively find themselves trusting your judgement and seeking your approval, their resistance biologically limited. This however is less effective on intelligent non-human species and other High Humans. You are always aesthetically pleasing by human standards, your optimised genetics expressing itself through perfect symmetry, clear features and healthy physique, reinforcing the subconscious pull you exert over those around you.
objects.title: High Human

objects.text:
You are now a mimic, the youngest of the shapeshifter family tree and the bane of chest-seeking adventurers.

In your base form you are a giant, boneless blob of fat and skinless meat, seeing and tasting through your pores with an exceptionally advanced sense of touch that can detect minute textures. You have no size limit, as you can grow by eating through your pores and can shed excess size either by cutting it off directly or by slowly converting it into energy to postpone feeding. You are an obligate carnivore that reacts best to living raw meat, and you possess internal stomach acids capable of fully dissolving human bones in hours.

Your advanced sense of touch is the foundation of your shapeshifting, allowing you to alter your exterior to match the texture and skin-deep properties of any object you study carefully. The better your understanding of a material, the deeper your mimicry becomes, to the point that you can replicate inherent surface properties such as hardness, conductivity, or flammability, though this replication rarely extends more than a few inches below the surface. However, you cannot transform into anything bigger or smaller than your current volume and you are limited in complexity: anything more intricate than a carriage is impossible for you to mimic, and living creatures remain entirely beyond your reach due to their internal moving parts and organic processes.
objects.title: Mimic

addons.title: Nascent Desolate Beast
addons.text:
You have become a Nascent Desolate Beast, an immature existence destined to stand at the pinnacle of all beasts and bring an end to the world. Even at your current stage, your physical and spiritual qualities, overall power, and innate abilities surpass those of your peers, while weaknesses inherent to your species are removed entirely.

Even now, you are powerful enough to overwhelm Elder Dragons with ease, and your natural abilities already stand far beyond those of ordinary beasts, with immense resistances against any abnormal effects. You are like a calamity given form, and your lifespan has become effectively endless, allowing you to continue growing for as long as you survive. Despite this immense power, you are still little more than an infant compared to what you can eventually become.

You could be likened to an avatar of nature’s vengeance itself. Lesser beasts instinctively submit to your presence, while the natural world itself seems to favor and support you. As you grow and encounter different environments and situations, your body can rapidly mutate in response to them as well as the things you consume, developing new innate abilities and adaptations to help you thrive, shaped by your nature and circumstances.

As time passes, you naturally grow stronger, with your physical and spiritual qualities and innate abilities steadily developing alongside you. With sufficient time and growth, you can rapidly advance through higher stages such as Greater Beast, Ancient Beast, and beyond, gaining the abilities and qualities of those stages as you grow. If allowed to continue living and developing, there is no telling how far this progression could eventually take you.

objects.text:
You awaken in the body of a beast, also known as a wild monster, a naturally powerful creature with a physique, spiritual qualities, and instincts far beyond the mundane. Even without equipment, your body is capable of feats that would be impossible for an ordinary person.

Your strength is sufficient to shatter stone, while your claws, fangs, horns, or other natural weapons can easily gouge steel and tear through armor. Your body is similarly durable, with powerful stamina, senses, vitality, recovery, natural resistances, and a great lifespan suited to surviving and thriving in the wild.

You can choose what type of beast you are. It may be a land, sea, or sky-dwelling beast, based on an animal such as a wolf, serpent, or eagle, an insect, a plant, or a distinct beast species of your choice, whether an established one or an original creation. Your choice determines your body structure, strength, natural weapons, senses, instincts, adaptations, and other innate traits, including any natural abilities unique to your species.

Different beasts naturally excel in different areas, so your exact capabilities depend on the species you choose, though all choices remain broadly comparable in overall power. You retain full intelligence and self-awareness, allowing you to use your body and instincts deliberately, though you still possess the natural wild instincts and impulses of your species.
objects.title: Wild Beast

rows.title: Ascension Path
rows.titleText: Ascend to a new realm of existence. These options reshape not only your body but your very soul. Some even provide you with memories of a past life reclaimed, your essence returned to its true form.

addons.text:
Gamer System is trumped by Dynamist Jr.
It will get new features and improvements over time, but cannot affect Dynamist Jr. in return.
addons.title: Dynamic System

addons.text: Your Gamer Systems have fused, requiring far less experience than normal with a greater range of evolutions. It's as if they compounded on each other, you can not only grow but can predict your powers and skill evolutions to plan ahead. You can even stockpile and spend experience on skills even if you haven't used them. This allows you to level up powers that have a harder time being used.
addons.title: Gamer²

addons.text: The villainous tasks will appear in the form of quests and grant you rewards and penalties through the system.
addons.title: Villain System

addons.text: The Gamer System and Voice of the World have merged, creating an extraordinarily powerful engine for personal growth. This fusion slightly increases the speed at which you gain Experience and new Skills from Voice of the World. It also grants you the ability to level each of your Skills from Voice of the World to level up from 1 to 100, which will empower them beyond their normal baseline, pushing them half a step to the power level and depth of a Skill of a higher Rank. Once a Skill has reached level 100, whenever you level up, there is a very small chance of it evolving into the next tier of Skill (such as Unique to Ultimate). This process may also fuse multiple level 100 skills into a stronger whole when applicable and advantageous to you. Through this process, your Skills from Voice of the World will grow endlessly with you as you level up with your Gamer System.
addons.title: Voice of the Gamer

addons.text:
Your Gamer System has evolved with your status as a Demigod, shattering all previous limits. This advancement is crafted to guide you toward even greater heights, allowing you to ascend to godhood on your own merits—without needing aid from other gods or even your divine parent. Your path involves climbing the ladder of divinity, with a multitude of godly archetypes available. Upon reaching the threshold, you’ll be able to choose the type of god you wish to become. You’ll also have the opportunity to assign potential divine domains, which will unlock upon ascension, based on your unique powers, skills, heritage, and more.

If you belong to a race that grows stronger with age this synergizes with your system, reducing the time and effort needed to progress. Once you reach the limits of your current Demigod status, the system will reveal the resources, time, and effort required to break through to godhood.

Additionally, you’ll gain an audio and video link to your divine parent, allowing instant contact. This manifests as a chatroom within the system and, upon ascension, expands to include a chatroom with your followers and subjects.

Upon becoming a god, you’ll have the ability to design an automatic response system for prayers, worship, and blessings. This will let your system autonomously address prayers, though you can intervene anytime. Any blessings you’re able to grant can also be retracted. If you have Divine Domains, Realms, or even a World, you can grant a gamer system that you can design to your followers. New followers will automatically receive a system, and, if you rise to rule over an entire pantheon or cosmology, other gods under your authority will also gain tailored systems.

Note that your journey doesn’t end with ascension. You’ll begin as a minor or mid-level god and must work your way up to Major God, Elder God, Chief God, Titan, and then Primordial God, with potential levels beyond.

Once ascended, you’ll gain the power to design your pantheon, define divine magic, distribute blessings, appoint saints and oracles, and even shape the culture and architecture of your divine land through the system.
addons.title: The Divine System

addons.text:
Your Gamer System has been transformed by The Multiverse Marketplace, granting you access to both a regular marketplace and a unique Marketplace created by Gamers for Gamers. You can explore the standard Multiverse Marketplace alongside the Physical Gamer Marketplace, where you can sell your items and purchase new ones. Within the System Tab, you can also sell products specifically tailored for gamers. The Physical Gamer Marketplace is a safe zone free from violence, offering a variety of items crafted by gamers, including skills, powers, unique weapons, exclusive tech, different races and even pets and companions.

The System Tab is managed by a helpful and cheerful AI that ensures you find whatever you desire—chances are it’s available in the System Store.

Additionally, there is a hidden feature within the Gamer System called the Module Store. This store focuses on new Gamer System expansions in the form of tabs, which can be purchased using various types of Gamer Currency. Some modules include the Crafter Module, which centers on a crafting system, along with others like Alchemy, Blacksmithing, and Spell Crafting. There are even fictional modules, such as Star Wars, which grant you access to the Force. The possibilities for expansion within the Module Store are virtually limitless.
addons.title: The System Store

addons.text:
Your Toolbar has merged with your Gamer System, granting you a Graphic Design subsystem. By default, it mimics Photoshop, but you can customize its interface to suit your preferences. You gain access to all possible tools in the editor, with the option to unlock even more. Beyond using tools directly, this editor allows you to freely modify the visual representation of your powers and partially adjust their mechanics.

For example, you can make your fire appear as ice while retaining its fiery properties or have your flight manifest as wings on your back.
addons.title: Graphic Design UI

addons.text:
Your Gamer System and Action Command merge with all its purchased add-ons and upgrades. You can level up like a Mario RPG Character, and depending on your choices, you’ll fall into one, or be a fusion of many Mario RPG Styles. 

Depending on your “archetype”, you have several stats but most consistently: Health, Special Points, Power, Defense, Speed, and Stache. They each determine your vitality, mana, strength, durability, how fast you act, and luck. Leveling up will boost all stats evenly, with a roulette that gives one stat of your choice a bonus increase. 

You can shift your vision to a third person, sidescroller or top down perspective about 5 to 10 meters away.

After reaching a certain level, you will advance in a Rank, this can vary from archetypes but typically goes from Mushroom to Rainbow Rank. Each time you gain one, you'll receive some form of bonus.

Your System catalogs all functionalities and information of the Action Command for ease of access, and gains new ones with each purchase related to it.
addons.title: Let's-a-Go! Okie, Dokie! (Super Mario)

addons.text:
Your Gamer System builds upon your nature as a Tutorial Boss, evolving into a Nemesis System. You are no longer a mere obstacle for heroes to overcome – instead becoming an ever-evolving adversary, incapable of being permanently defeated.

Each time you fall, you will rise again later at the cost of a significant portion of your accumulated experience. However, every resurrection also hardens you, increasing your stats and granting permanent resistance to whatever killed you before.

The title of Tutorial Boss also provides a flat +10% bonus to all stats (including XP gain). This title stacks with any stage bonuses and grows stronger as your Boss rank increases.

To cap it all off, as you gain levels and grow stronger, your Boss rank increases, beginning as the Tutorial Boss and advancing to the ranks of First Real Boss, Midgame Boss, and beyond. Each rank represents a qualitative increase in threat, progressing your Boss title and further empowering your abilities, phases, and - most importantly - your HP bar.
addons.title: Nemesis System

addons.text:
You gain access to a restaurant that exists within a pocket dimension, connected to the entire Multiverse. You can enter it at will and have complete control over its appearance both interior and exterior and can change it at any time.

You can open doors to any world known to you from any source, or make it completely random. As the owner, you have the absolute authority to deny entry or forcibly expel anyone. Within its walls, all guests are perpetually safe.

The restaurant is fully equipped with every tool you need to prepare any dish. If you require additional tools in the future, they will be generated automatically. The facility is self-cleaning and can expand or shrink as necessary to accommodate any number of guests.

You gain access to a store, allowing you to purchase ingredients from across the Multiverse, with all currencies converted automatically.

You also gain the ability to create clones possessing all your skills and abilities to help manage both your restaurant and the store. Your mind exists across all clones simultaneously, and your multitasking ability increases with the number of active clones. However, clones cannot leave the property.

If you have Merchant of Myth Upgrade customers can pay using esoteric or conceptual goods and if you have Traveling Merchant Add-On: Your store and restaurant can merge into any configuration you choose.
addons.title: The Restaurant System
D.I.C.E System
addons.text:
The Gamer System and Character Sheet have merged, creating an extraordinarily powerful engine for personal growth that combines both methods of levelling up into a cohesive unit. This fusion increases the speed at which you gain experience with the Character Sheet alone, as you now have more ways to acquire experience and levels via the Gamer System, allowing you to level faster than you could with either by itself.

Should you have ‘God I Fucking Hate Dungeons And Dragons’ you may add the new Character Sheet from whatever you setting you have picked instead of D&D/Pathfinder to your character sheet allowing you to level different tabletop systems at the same time or separately this would also affect the other upgrades to Character Sheet should you posses them allowing for the functions to be added to your Gamer System should you desire it.

This would essentially allow you to gain and evolve multiple Feats and class features far faster than with Character Sheet alone, turning them into skills via the Gamer System, allowing for them to be levelled up. This union allows your Character Sheet to grow endlessly as you level up with your Gamer System.

objects.text:
You gain access to a game-like system to manage your power(s). By default, you have access to a basic system that includes attributes and the ability to grow by gaining experience. You gain experience by completing quests or defeating enemies (does not need to involve killing them) and can increase your attributes by training. How the system works in details depends on the user, you can either create a custom gamer system for yourself or choose a version from any franchise/fictional work you know, gaining all its features, (note that you can not use this to gain an Instant dungeon) two people with this power can have systems that work differently.

This power will interface with other abilities you choose. As you use them, they will grow in strength and will unlock new aspects. While your growth is not limited, the stronger an ability is the harder it will be to improve it.
objects.title: Gamer System

objects.text: This power integrates with your other abilities and improves them over time. It will mutate in two ways: horizontally, by adding new related abilities, and vertically, by increasing the strength of specific aspects. Powers with a lower initial SP cost have a faster growth until they catch up to your other powers. While you can direct the general shape of those changes, your power will also respond and adapt to any challenge you face. When your powers are impotent, immediately useful mutations will be prioritized over long term utility. When you have time to let them grow, new optimizations and sub-powers based on predicted challenges and past difficulties, will be added. Any useless or redundant part will be shed or fused into existing abilities. With time, your weaknesses will be reduced and your options broadened. It is recommended you give your power time to perform routine maintenance and optimizations between heavy engagements to avoid a buildup of mutation debt. If this debt becomes too high, the quality and reliability of mutation decreases due to the stress placed on your power. This power works at a slower rate than Dynamist.
objects.title: Dynamist Jr.

objects.text: You gain 3 slots that can be filled with very weak powers, roughly equivalent in strength to a 3 SP power; they can be either weakened versions of powers found in this CYOA or present in the world(s) you visit, like Quirks from MHA, Esper Powers from Raildex, Magic or Psionics from D&D, Kryptonian or Green Martian biology from DC, and so on. The only exception is Polybius Remastered itself. Of course, when weakened, your Kryptonian powers would only provide you with a minor enhancement in strength and durability, the ability to float a few inches above the ground and move at a slow pace, and some control of the direction when you fall, while retaining a major weakness to Kryptonite. You can switch those powers whenever you want. While a power is in a slot, it will slowly grow in strength through use or training.
