This aptitude ensures you can achieve a novice level of proficiency with ease across any field. As long as you have teaching materials or examples of the practice/skill you can easily grasp the basics in no time. However, progressing beyond this initial stage demands more than this natural talent alone; it does not offer any shortcuts to advanced expertise.

Additionally, while your aptitude spans all subjects, it doesn’t grant you the specific energies, physical conditions, or capabilities needed to fully utilize these powers. Even if you have an aptitude for it you can’t use the practice or skill if you don’t have the requirements to use it. For instance, understanding the principles of shard powers is one thing, but wielding them without the requisite shard biology is impossible. Your aptitude is tied to the rules of the universe you inhabit, your power's foundation is rooted in the norms of the world you first appear in. To extend its reach, you must reside in a new universe for at least 6 months, after which your aptitude will adapt to encompass everything within that realm as well.

The journey to harness your full potential rests solely in your hands.
objects.title: Universal Aptitude

objects.text:
Your heart has crystallized itself, becoming indestructible and eternal. No longer is it mere blood being pumped throughout your body. Through your veins runs your life force condensed into an impossible form, the Prima Materia, an iridescent golden ichor. You have surpassed the realm of men, breaching into a new level of existence. 

Due to your heart's transformation, your ichor constantly seeps into your mind and body, enhancing it, improving all aspects of yourself, and granting you endless mental and physical stamina, allowing you to function at your best indefinitely. You are able to direct your life force through your heart, allowing you to improve yourself at the cellular level. Nothing is impossible with enough experience and dedicated life force. Your mutations will be manageable and never will negatively impact each other. 

Your human imperfections will be burnt away, allowing you to progress beyond human limits with enough dedication to your actions. Igniting your heart's power fills you with divine inspiration as you burn away your imperfections, enabling you to improve through means of regression to perfection. Finding balance will come with time, knowing when it is best to start with a fresh slate and proper comprehension. Every time you regress you set yourself up for a better future learning faster depending on how many times you've burnt out the impurities of your actions. 

Your life force lets you heal from scrapes and wounds instantly, while regrowing fingers in minutes, and arms and legs in hours. You will never have to worry about old age, for you have undergone an ascension, putting you among the immortal ones for as long as your heart beats true. Your healing is perfect, always restoring you to your best.

Whenever you do not actively wish to keep your ichor outside your body, the Prima Materia will shift into liquid lead, unconnected to your existence.
objects.title: Promethean Ichor

objects.text:
Your power now grows rapidly whenever you engage in combat. The harder you push your limits, the faster your fighting capabilities develop in both potency and mastery.

In battle, connections form in your mind more quickly. Techniques you have just learned, even unfamiliar ones, swiftly become second nature. As you seek ways to counter your opponent, new uses for your existing power will emerge, with inspiration and epiphanies rushing into your mind.

With this power, a friendly sparring session can be more effective than a week of regular training. A life-or-death struggle, where death is almost certain, would enhance both the potency and mastery of your power, as well as your battle IQ, equivalent to a year of intense training.
objects.title: Forged In The Trials of Combat

objects.text:
This power is intricately linked to your soul, a unique force solely yours, akin to the semblances in RWBY. The power unfolds with distinct features and is governed by specific rules. When activated, it manifests as an interface visible only to you.

The first feature is the Copy Ability, enabling you to replicate any power, skill, or bloodline encountered, though limited to one at a time. A prerequisite condition must be met to choose what to copy, ranging from friendship to overcoming a specific challenge. The copied attribute initiates at level one, necessitating training through real-life application or combat to reach level one hundred. Conditions may vary, such as defeating the source using a designated skill or surviving a confrontation. Skills encompass a broad spectrum, from weapon mastery to elemental resistance.

The second ability, Fusion, permits the fusion of two or more copied powers or skills. A preview of the resulting fusion and its effects is presented, allowing cancellation if undesirable. However, fusion entails losing the involved powers or skills, necessitating recopying, which resets them to level one.

The third ability, Evolve, comes into play once a power, skill, or bloodline reaches level one hundred. Upon evolution, it undergoes transformative changes, potentially becoming an entirely new power or skill. A list of possible evolutions is provided for your selection, or randomness can be embraced. Post-evolution, the new power or skill reverts to level one, demanding further leveling.

 Restrictions apply, allowing a maximum of 25 powers and 25 skills, with bloodline abilities counting as powers. Attempting to exceed this limit results in losing other elements, potentially including memories. However, the power provides the option to delete any unwanted power or skill, offering a degree of control over your acquired abilities. You will gain more slots over time through effort and dedicated training.

In the future, you will be able to share any power or skill you possess with those you trust or bond with.
objects.title: Copy-Fusion-Evolve

addons.text:
Through VitaSync, the synchronicity between your body and your magic has been extended to all the supernatural systems you wield. Now, not only does strengthening your body result in your abilities becoming stronger, but strengthening your abilities strengthens your body in turn, resulting in your body and all your supernatural abilities constantly matching each other in might.

Additionally, if the bodily system carrying one of your supernatural systems is damaged, the rest of your body can now compensate in part. For example, the psionics in your nerves or the spiritual energy in your bones can support your magic in your veins if some of them are cut.
addons.title: My Body is a Temple

objects.text:
Magic runs through your veins. Your spirit is deeply tied to your bones. Your nerves carry psionic signals that your mind responds to. In all things, your body is something that could be considered a reflection of your abilities. Any time you bump into something esoteric or otherwise supernatural, you’ll find you have a little potential to use it that improve your body, which in turn allows you to improve your powers.

The way this works is that you carry an awareness of what parts of your body hold various effects, though generally, they will be lumped in with similar parts if viable. For example, the Force would grow just the same as any other psychic power through the improvement of your nervous system, despite the presence of midichlorians in your cellular structure. From there, you may work on your body to improve these capabilities however you wish, be it naturally, artificially, etc.

In general, the structure of your self-improvements to your own system will reflect the improvements your various supernatural systems gain. Take up a regimen that leaves your cardiovascular system more robust, and you'll find your magical abilities generally growing in breadth and depth in a controlled way, whereas if you give yourself a high-tech cybernetic heart to better circulate blood, you'll find your magic vastly faster to respond and more powerful, but with far less room to organically grow, for instance.

This power is not without risks, as significant damage to your body will tear at your ability to cast spells, channel your spirit, or focus your psionics to a proportional degree to the damage you take. It should be noted, however, that these very same things can provide a level of healing themselves, should you train them well enough - even to the point of a separated sample of blood bringing you back from the dead, after some time, or other such things. However, you will not have any special level of healing to begin with, just a slow, steady, human-level recovery rate.
objects.title: VitaSync

addons.text: Now you gain the ability to awaken the aura of sufficiently advanced machines granting them a soul and turning them into a True Bio-Machine like yourself. You can also choose to grant the same benefits for a living being with a soul when you awaken their aura.
addons.title: Awakening

addons.text: Your ghost physiology allows you to possess both biological and technological beings and objects, not only allowing you to control them but also temporarily benefiting from your own powers as if they were incorporated into your own body. With sapient beings, this will require you to overwhelm their willpower or be willing to be possessed. This can be used in a variety of ways, like to assist the healing of another being or machine with your own natural regeneration, hide in objects, boost their powers with your own, or just let them act as a gateway for transportation, like using a computer’s internet connection to travel to another end point.
addons.title: Bio-Machine Spirit

addons.text:
By fusing a Mother Box into yourself, you have become a Baby Bio-Machine God like Cyborg from DC Comics. This has pushed your existence to levels unreachable by mortal flesh or machinery. It has given your body abilities that would have taken you years if not centuries to unlock or incorporate. You can now see and interact with the entire electromagnetic spectrum and other forces, including esoteric forces like magic or the divine, though you will still need to study them to understand what they can do. You can easily connect to every single computer on a planet at once and access anything stored on them, analyze and interact with unknown technology or biology near-instantly. You also have the ability to change your arms into cannons like Cyborg, which defaults to using sonic energy but can be configured to use any form of energy you have access to easily, as well as shift your body to form whatever weapons or equipment you have either incorporated or have a full understanding of.

The greatest benefit from this fusion is your ability to freely open Boom Tubes to travel the Greater Multiverse (you do have the cosmological positioning systems of your Mother Box needed to travel existence, so don't worry about getting lost). Though beware, every few thousand jumps may drop you in New Genesis if your calculations aren't precise enough. You can also use Hush Tubes, the untraceable, unnoticeable version of Boom Tubes, though they take more time to form. You also gain an immense ability to process knowledge & multitask such only someone like the Queen Administrator would be your equal or superior in such areas.

Lastly, you have internalized the New God Database that your Mother Box comes with. This means that the Mother Box will be constantly updating your mechanical and biological parts to be better than they were yesterday, as well as analyzing your opponents and creating adaptive countermeasures using this database. This also grants you knowledge beyond most mortal beings and machines in existence, though it will take you a bit of time to truly understand it all.
addons.title: Booyah!

objects.text:
You become compatible with both organic and inorganic matter, with both being fused within your body in perfect harmony.

Any object, item, or even object of power you possess can be added to your body, which incorporates it into yourself over time via your soul acting as a bridge between the two types of matter. Because of this innate compatibility, your body will conceptually benefit from all your powers, no matter what it is made of. A healing potion would mend your steel, your nanites could repair your flesh, and your batteries could fuel your body and be recharged from eating a meal. Your memory could be expanded via implanting hard drives into your body, and your nerves may serve as cables to connect your prosthetics. This compatibility also extends to more meta abilities and perks, like the Mental Barrier, which would also protect your machine's parts against being controlled via hacking or the power to evolve and adapt would extend to your machine parts as well.

The incorporation process can’t add new functionality, so to have a sense of touch in a new prosthetic limb, it will require the appropriate sensors, or it will have to be covered with actual living skin tissue. The same restriction applies for every function added to your body.
Because the connection is made via your soul, if you change your general body shape, size, or mass, it will strain your soul, making you feel sluggish and exhausted, and it can’t physically keep your body together, so all your modifications have to be properly attached to your body. Albeit your soul can adapt to a minor strain, allowing you to slowly stray away from your original form.

This also allows you to add any biological modifications that suppress any kind of organ rejection or incompatibilities at the cost of a longer incorporation time.

If a power in this CYOA integrates technology into you or turns you into technology, you can choose to begin with it fully incorporated into your body, with your soul completely adapted to its new shape.
objects.title: True Bio-Machine

addons.text:
Engaging with life's basics fuels a deep understanding, elevating you beyond mere observation to an intuitive grasp of reality. 

This enlightenment enhances every skill you possess. For instance, in cooking, after a year of casual practice, you don't just follow recipes; you blend flavors with an instinctual mastery, creating dishes that defy convention, perhaps even granting immortality. 

This enlightenment permeates all your abilities, whether in art, music, or combat, elevating them to miraculous levels. Ultimately, you embody the limitless potential of human experience, constantly reshaping reality with each action.
addons.title: A World Beyond

addons.text:
As you journey through the vast expanse of existence, every facet of your being undergoes a metamorphosis, evolving in tandem with your deepening understanding of reality. 

Your abilities, honed by passive observation, transcends its very nature, fortifying your body, sharpening your mind, and enriching your soul. Each passing day enriches the tapestry of your existence, empowering your physical form to ascend beyond the bounds of mortality. Your flesh becomes impervious, your beauty irresistible, and even the resonance of your voice carries a potent sway over those who hear it. 

This evolution is not instantaneous, requiring the patient passage of time to unfurl its transformative magic, yet diligent training and profound introspection can hasten its pace, unlocking untold potential within. 

So it begins, the Apotheosis.
addons.title: Existence Beyond it All

objects.text:
Any skill you may have, be it cooking, martial arts, or even walking, can be pushed beyond the level of mundane, all while remaining mundane in nature. The more often you use a skill, the better it gets, taking the skill to its logical extreme. Casually cooking a few times a day will result in your cooking dramatically improving, reaching the level far beyond any mundane cooking in a year. Actively practicing and learning to improve a skill will drastically increase the rate of its improvement.

With enough time and effort, your cooking could cause even the most vicious demons to be kind, your martial arts could defeat armies, or you singing can bewitch fairies. Just note that you may reach bottlenecks at times, as it will require certain mindsets or understandings to further improve a skill.
objects.title: A Step Beyond

addons.text:
Your pocket dimension has now expanded, Archive’s massive mental dimension capable of being manifested here.

Retaining its original ability and function as a gym, your pocket dimension can now be shaped freely, growing as large or as small as you wish, getting whatever rooms you’d wish, changing them at will, even establish an outdoors for you to explore.

But moreso, you can freely go through your Archive in this pocket world capable of manifesting in whatever form it could in your mind in a much more physical manner, from scientific experiments and tools, to an endless library of ancient tomes, to a holocrons of ancient teachers, etc. 

But moreover is that you’ve gained the ability to summon teachers, teachers for anything you can possibly learn. 

You can summon different teachers for you to learn from, as many of them as you wish in any subjects and disciplines you can think of. You can change them at anytime. 

Your learning speed is 10 times as fast inside the pocket dimension as it would be outside, and whatever teachers you have seem to be perfect for you and anyone else they are teaching. This also applies to your teachers, and anyone else that tries to teach while they are here. 

You can also freely invite other is into your pocket dimension, capable of inviting them as fellow students. While in the pocket dimension, you can grant them a copy of your Knowledge is Power ability. 

You may rescind this at will or opt to give them a reduced form instead if you wish, they’ll automatically lose the ability upon exiting, but will retain any learned abilities. They’ll be unable to learn Knowledge is Power unless you expressly allow it. 

If you instead take the role of a teacher, your ability to teach is greatly enhanced, barely even needing to try to effectively and quickly teach whatever you wish.  This also applies to any visitors or other inhabitants. 

While you cannot take any equipment out, anything that has been brought in and altered by anything inside your pocket dimension will retain the changes made to it, allowing you to use the scientific tools to construct powerful machines and other devices inside it provided you can bring in the raw materials. 

You can infuse any other pocket dimension/personal worlds into this, expanding each other’s abilities to one another and shedding any weaknesses.
addons.title: University

addons.text:
You now have the ability to create a special dungeon. This dungeon can be used to enhance your strength, speed, or any specific aspect of your abilities. For example, you can use it to learn your Aura’s semblance, discover your Nen ability, advance to the next stage of your martial arts, or simply grow stronger overall.

The dungeon automatically creates the perfect environment, complete with mobs, traps, and puzzles, tailored to what you wish to train in, as long as you already possess the source of that ability, or power. For example, you would need Cursed Energy to learn your innate technique, or Nen to learn your Nen ability.

If you successfully complete the dungeon, you are guaranteed to gain the improvement you sought, you`ll also gain item or trinket to celebrate your achievement. However, if you die inside, you’ll be ejected and barred from re-entering for one week. You can also create these dungeons for others.
addons.title: Training Dungeon

objects.text:
Have you ever struggled to maintain a consistent training routine, unable to find the right resources to support your training goals? Or perhaps you've longed for a training partner who can match your skill and strength, pushing you to new heights when others fall short? Or maybe your local gym just isn't cutting it anymore, and your gainz are no longer gaining. Well, fear not you now have access to the ultimate training facility imaginable.

With just a thought, you can teleport to a pocket dimension housing a single building. This building boasts three floors, each tailored to enhance your training experience.

The first floor is your personal gym haven, equipped with every training machine imaginable, weights ranging into the millions of tons, and even weighted clothes and accessories. You can even customize the ambiance with your favorite tunes, oh and the room will always have perfect air conditioning.

On the second floor lies a cutting-edge combat simulation facility. Here, you can spar with a simulated training partner in any environment of your choosing. Adjust your opponent's size, intelligence, abilities, and skill level to match your preferences, you can make them weaker than, equal than, and even stronger than you. You can even face off against multiple opponents simultaneously, up to 10 at a time.

The third floor is dedicated to relaxation and rejuvenation. From plush bedding and a luxurious spa to a top-of-the-line robot chef serving up nutritional gourmet meals, this space offers the ultimate in comfort and entertainment. Indulge in video games, high-speed internet, movies, and more. Don't slack off on your training though, or there will be consequences.

While you're free to come and go from this dimension as you please, nothing can be taken outside its confines. Time inside this pocket dimension passes at a rate 10 times faster than the real world.
objects.title: How Heavy Are Your Dumbbells?

addons.text:
The opponents you defeat in your simulation room are valid targets for your Right of Conquest, allowing you to collect their skills and abilities as you would normal opponents.

This also waives the normal requirements to your power, as you do not need to fight the opponent to the death as they are a simulation, nor do you need to wager anything, all you have to do is prove your superiority to your opponent by winning against them, allowing you to collect from them whatever you wish.
addons.title: Right of Winners

objects.text:
You may at any point declare a wager to an opponent for any thing either of you possess, for which they must either accept or decline. 

Upon the acceptance of a wager you may determine the rules and terms of victory, neither of which can inherently favor either side. When either side wins, the winning side will have their prize transferred to them. 

The catch is that either side can wager whatever it is they desire, from powers, skills, bodies, lives, loyalty, to even your soul. Neither side can back out of a wager without approval from the opposing side, but can do so if all parties agree. 

You may utilize this power in battle, in which case the requirements for acceptance on all parties is waived, instead requiring just your own. Under this caveat, this becomes a life or death battle. Upon victory you may take *anything and everything* that belongs to your opponent, from powers to even their place in society, reality itself will shift to grant you it if necessary, such is the Right of Conquest.

If neither party is capable of winning the wager is instead nullified, if either party is incapable of consenting to nullifying a wager due to extenuating circumstances then the wager is nullified. For the purpose of a life or death battle, your own loss does not grant your opponent the same benefits you would incur if you won.
objects.title: Right of Conquest

objects.text:
Congratulations! You’re committing a war crime against yourself!

Inside the essence of every living thing are four virtues. In various societies they’ve held meanings and names, but to the only human societies in your neck of the woods that have seen them, they’re named after card suits. Each virtue covers a certain personal domain. Burning Virtue allows you to harness and exhaust this ‘Virtue’ in order to enhance yourself, but being actively deficient in certain areas also bestows benefits and drawbacks.

For the price of Burning Virtue, you can, as an adrenal response, briefly impart your will over reality. Usually this takes the form of boosting existing abilities, granting them massively increased potency for an incredibly short period. However, as more is learnt about Virtue, one can start channelling it into stranger effects within the domain of the virtue sacrificed.

Hearts, as a domain, governs devotion and authoritarianism. Burning Hearts emphasises these traits. You’ll find yourself becoming more devoted, rigid and prone to hierarchy. Deficiency in hearts leads to increased charisma and persuasiveness. It’s leading archetype in deficit is the cult leader. 

Diamonds governs cowardice and submission. Burning Diamonds emphasises these traits. You’ll find yourself becoming more agreeable and prone to emphasising your own survival. Deficiency in Diamonds also leads to increased logical aptitude and planning. It’s leading archetype in deficit is the Right-Hand-Man.

Spades is the domain of the outsider. Burning Spades emphasises social unacceptance, and outside design. It is the virtue of deception and adaptation. You’ll find yourself becoming persecuted and self-righteous. Deficiency in Spades grants an animal cunning. Its leading archetype is the Pariah.

Clubs embodies paranoia. Burning Clubs embodies the grease that makes systems operate. It is the allowed dissent within systems. You’ll find yourself becoming more paranoid and poised, rejecting the concept of normality in favour of embracing occult realities. Deficiency in Clubs grants a wisdom-beyond-years. Its leading archetype is the Occultist.

However, all things come at a cost. Burning Virtue too rapidly starts to change you, as you become deficient in some areas and saturated in others, your personality can shift and crack under you as the amount of virtue you possess grows lesser and lesser. Normally, sentients produce Virtue exclusively in childhood and adolescents before stabilizing their varying levels of each Virtue upon reaching maturity. Thankfully, you're excepted from this, and will continue to refresh Virtue. However, this means that burning too much virtue too quickly can render you significantly unstable depending on what you’ve exhausted.
objects.title: Virtue Burning

addons.text:
Guidance. What is guidance to you? You know the art of the brand and the art of the bond intimately. Infinitely recursive guidance spirals from each marking. The Brand & Bond is no longer subconscious to you, you can dictate every movement, every expenditure, and every ink blot that appears. With a great deal of time, and enough ink, you could develop any number of skills or abilities. 

Your body has become the universe’s tapestry
addons.title: The End Is Never the End Is Never The End...

objects.text:
You’ve been given the inscription of gods, The Brand and Bond.

The Brand and Bond is a system of depiction where your capabilities are engraved on your body, whether it be in Tattoo, Engraving, Scarification or Branding. The Bond’s most noticeable feature after its immediate mark is the manner that the markings shift and reform to depict your abilities and their remaining power in a constantly updating manner.

The second, and most vital aspect of the Bond is the manner it affects its inscriptions. Powers inscribed upon the Bond’s host find themselves becoming broader as they’re used, incorporating more utilities and branches as your abilities develop. These adaptations are rarely, if ever, direct increases in strength, instead adapting to focus on long-term utilities and synergies. The more these utilities are used, the more they will grow, though you cannot consciously direct their path.

The final aspect of the Brand and Bond is that the creation of markings is not limited to your abilities, also developing as major events in your life transpire, and granting a root for further abilities to sprout relating to the event thematically. 

You can change the style and appearance of the Brand and Bond and its individual components, as long as it always remains visible on your body.
objects.title: Brand & Bond

addons.text: The Ugliest Flower You revel in your monstrous reputation, which no longer affects you in your everyday life as you are in peace with your own desires and actions, allowing you to keep up your normal appearance. But your awful power is not lost. When you embrace your own reputation or are in great distress, it will make you undergo a new transformation, showing the world what they believe you to be and removing all mental inhibitions that would stop you from fulfilling your desires, turning you into a true monster. This transformation is only undone if you are truly defeated or if the goal that made you transform is achieved.
addons.title: Unleashed Monstrosity

addons.text: As a sorcerer, your mindset can no longer hold you back, just like how Satoru Gojo has an absolute belief in his own invincibility, you have the same confidence in your own boundless desires. This will allow you to advance and experience rapid breakthrough in all jujutsu techniques you have; your growth can never be stunted, as you will always desire to be greater than before.
addons.title: Self-Indulgence of Desire

addons.text: Your willpower joined your desire in an unholy coalescence, creating a corrupted but much more powerful driving force. Now, when you die, you will experience everything you’ve done to indulge in your primary desire in a single moment, fueling and evolving your manifested soul form, making it more powerful depending on the amount of indulgence you experienced during your lifetime. Because of this fusion, you can fuel your willpower by indulging in your primary desire, so as long as you stay true to yourself, your will is unbreakable!
addons.title: Prime Desire

addons.text: Your primary sin as a Devil will synergize with your primary desire, which allows you to grow your demonic energy quality and quantity through indulgence. Your power of imagination-based spells will also greatly increase in both efficiency and potency if it serves your desire. Through multiple transformations, you might even achieve a final form comparable to Sirzechs Lucifer’s true form through sheer monstrous desire, even without any bloodline power to assist you.
addons.title: Creature of Sin

addons.text: If you choose to have the same Origin and desire, then you are no longer limited to the improvement and evolution of your existing powers; now, out of sheer desire, you can develop new powers. Gain enhanced senses to stalk your prey in your ravenous gluttony, obtain super strength to satisfy your pride, or possess the power to imprison a creature in a seal, enacting your personal justice. Now there is nothing you cannot do; the question is, is your desire great enough for it?
addons.title: Awakened Monster

addons.text: Now you are not only fueled by negative emotions, but you can also create and store energy from your own primary desires. This secondary stockpile can only be unleashed when you are already under the effect of the Negative Emotion Drive, mixing your desire with the already present negativity, creating an even more potent driving force and also driving you into a frenzy of your darkest desires.
addons.title: Secondary Obsession Drive

addons.text:
Your need for indulgence has been replaced with the Joy of the Grind, creating a powerful feedback loop of indulgence. The more you indulge, the more you improve, the more you improve, the more you indulge. This massively increases the benefits gained from pursuing your desires, allowing any indulgence, no matter how small, to provide a feeling of improvement.

No longer do you chase desire with withdrawal but with the thrill of being one step closer to becoming your very best.
addons.title: Monster of the Grind

objects.text: You become a monstrous being, truly driven by its own desires. When you gain this power, you must pick an obsession to be your primary desire (or simply let your naturally strongest desire take over) and revel in it, which will slowly make you better and stronger, improving your core being and all of your powers. Simple indulgences like lazing around like a sloth or satisfying your vanity by taking selfies will benefit you, but at a quite slow rate. But when you become truly depraved, you and your powers will rapidly evolve as you rob a bank out of greed, slaughter a group of criminals for justice, kill the entire family of your enemy out of jealousy, and revel in the high of becoming greater as you conquer everything you dreamed of. Not all desires are inherently evil; after all, one can become a monster of justice and benevolence just as easily as any other "sin”. The more absurd your actions and the more you ride the high of your own excitement, the more your powers evolve and restrictions lessen. When you truly outdo yourself riding the manic ecstasy of your self-indulgence, you can even reach enlightenment, unlocking transformations that massively amplify and evolve your entire power kit, even developing new secondary powers. Meanwhile, you will always be beholden to your primary desire, and as you discover more of it, you can branch out to any connected vices. After all, you can satisfy your pride by being a perfect paragon of justice while also being a proud owner of the finest collection of wines. And truly, is there anything humanity can’t lust for? But this comes with the drawback that your satisfaction is always temporary. You will always dream of greater ecstasy, chasing a new experience like a deep abyss of sweet temptation, which drives you to dive deeper and deeper, making your potential to evolve and grow more powerful truly endless. Your ability to indulge is limitless, as whatever your primary desire is, it can always become better, more and more and more and MORE…
objects.title: Monster of Desire

addons.text:
You can convert templates into full-blown classes, expanding upon them in a logical manner. Also, by evolving these classes, you can obtain powers and skills beyond what the original characters had, with the evolved classes representing possible futures of said characters.

You can also use your template slots for your classes, which allows you to progress in multiple classes simultaneously, massively speeding up your progression.

Your ability to grant templates is also improved, as now you can also choose to evolve their granted class templates every time they reach the cap, albeit this shares the same 24-hour cooldown as the original ability.
addons.title: Class Template

addons.text:
The [CLASS QUEST] system activates whenever you progress sufficiently in your class, giving you a difficult, but far from impossible goal to achieve related to the class. After completion, the [CLASS QUEST] gives you access to a powerful ability related to the class that the Quest is associated with. 

For instance, a Paladin [CLASS QUEST] might be based around avoiding temptation a number of times, and in turn allow you a kind of temporary ‘Divine Protection’ shield as a reward. Or an Esper may charge you with a significant feat of psychic strength and reward you with a potent telekinetic strike as a reward.
These [CLASS QUESTS] are not required to reach the cap of a class, and can be completed after the cap is reached, but if the class is evolved it will be replaced with a [CLASS QUEST] for the new class.
addons.title: [CLASS QUEST]

addons.text: Your two class systems have merged with new options. You now have two class slots to use and your chosen classes will blend together to make startlingly powerful benefits for you. Also, you can use Class Change to edit classes gained from Character Sheet, allowing you to grow basic classes into monstrously powerful specializations. Instead of needing to hit the cap of class in order to change it you may now change it as long as your level in a class is at least 50% towards its cap. You gain a full mental catalog of every first-party class from Dnd and Pathfinder. additionally, classes chosen from this list level slightly faster.
addons.title: Gestalt

addons.text:
You have now become the ultimate tabletop munchkin who is able to bend the rules of your classes to devastating effect. You now possess a grand total of 5 slots which can be used to level classes and you may slot a single class into multiple slots to level it far faster based on the number of slots used, with each extra slot used giving +100% leveling speed towards that class. You can change your class when you level up that class in a slot. Finally, your ability to gain and unlock new classes increases exponentially.

Embrace your inner Munchkin and level your way to Godhood in whatever path you desire.
addons.title: Munchkin

addons.text: In addition to both your Jobs and Classes, you now also have Subclasses. These can be Specializations or Supporting Classes. A Warrior could have a Regenerator Subclass, a Mage a Magitech Subclass, while a Cook could have an Ingredient Gatherer Subclass. These Subclasses have to be related to their primary Jobs and Classes, and they can’t outlevel them, but they can evolve. If you evolve your starting Class for example, your Subclass will remain as it is until it also reaches the required level and evolves, if you’ve evolved your Class again in that time-period, the Subclass will still evolve to match the second Class instead of your current one. For Jobs it’s pretty much the same, though your Subclasses can evolve at Lv 25, even if the related Job hasn’t yet.
addons.title: Jobs and Classes²

addons.text:
Your Class Change power gains enhanced synergy with Aincrad. Each Floor acts as a specialized training ground that accelerates class growth, skill development, and mastery.

Defeating Floor Bosses provides major progression boosts, while Aincrad’s environment makes skill creation easier and more reliable. Your monsters can assist in training, and managing multiple classes becomes significantly more efficient.

This does not change how your class system works, but greatly improves the speed, stability, and effectiveness of developing classes within Aincrad.

Defeated monsters within Aincrad will gradually reform over time, allowing for continued training and use of the castle’s forces. Stronger monsters and Floor Bosses take significantly longer to return, and those destroyed outside of Aincrad recover far more slowly.

However, repeated or large-scale losses place strain on Aincrad’s ecosystem, significantly slowing recovery across all Floors. Entities destroyed beyond the castle’s bounds are especially taxing to restore, and excessive losses may temporarily prevent their return altogether.

Note: The benefits of this add-on are strongest within Aincrad and diminish significantly outside of it.
addons.title: Aincrads Blessing

objects.text:
Through saying the phrase "Class Selection," you can view an interface that allows you to select your class, such as Warrior, Mage, Priest, Druid, Summoner, Necromancer, Monk, or Esper. You can also select an existing class from your chosen world or even create an original one, and you can select a class from any world you visit.

You start as a novice in your chosen class, which grants you a basic set of skills, though you can unlock new ones by practicing and even create your own skills, and enhance your attributes depending on your selected class. The overall increase your class grants varies based on the powers you already possess.

Even if you are an average human, you would still become a superhuman capable of damaging materials such as steel by using one of your skills if you were a Warrior, Barbarian, or even a Monk. The more you practice with your class and increase your skill proficiency, the stronger they become until you hit a cap and become eligible to evolve your class.

When you hit the cap of your starting class, you can choose to either evolve your class or select another one, while retaining the gains from your previous class. The new class will once again enhance your attributes depending on whether you already have existing powers or not and give enhancements accordingly. This process can be repeated indefinitely, with you growing stronger by practicing your skills, evolving your classes, and selecting new classes to evolve.

However, the more you evolve your classes, the longer it takes to reach its cap and evolve, eventually taking years to evolve your class. This time can be shortened by defeating powerful foes, achieving accomplishments such as creating legendary items, and so forth.
objects.title: Class Change

objects.text: Every time you achieve a feat, you will receive a number of points. These points can be used for a variety of purposes. The main features of this power are the Mastery and Evolution features. Other features will need to be unlocked using the Evolution feature. To achieve a feat, you must accomplish certain objectives. These objectives are often arbitrary and depend on various factors such as location, time, and more. An example of a major feat in Worm would be to take care of the Dragonslayers and unchain Dragon. The Mastery feature lets you instantly master any of your powers by granting you both the knowledge and muscle memory needed to use and master your chosen power. However, there are some limitations; you can only master abilities you already possess. For example, if you possess magic and know three spells, you will instantly master those spells, but you won't gain any new ones. The Evolution feature allows you to branch out your powers, but you will only receive basic knowledge and muscle memory for this, meaning you must either master it yourself or use the Mastery feature. To use the previous example, if you have magic, you will develop new spells. While you have some control over the type of spell you develop, you cannot be very specific. For instance, if you want a destruction-based spell of the AOE type, the result will always be something you can control and use effectively. Your feat points and benefits are protected from outside tampering, ensuring that you retain them even in the event of reality changes, timeline erasure (if you survive), or other alterations. Additionally, the rewards you receive will always be proportional to the significance of the feat achieved.
objects.title: Roleplayer: Feat System

addons.text: Your curious aptitude for hosting the otherworldly has made it far more likely your breaches will summon compatible Exceptions. Be they parasites, mechanical devices, or persistent effects. Similarly, they’re more likely to be sapient, or at least sentient to facilitate these connections.
addons.title: Matchmaking System

addons.text: You can connect your breaches to any universe you could travel to through homecoming, allowing you greater control over the possibilities an Exception could be. Ie. Connecting to Toril (D&D) would make it much less likely to produce an alien life form, but far greater for magical artefacts or effects. The breaches remain unable to be used to move between universes.
addons.title: Known Factor

addons.text: A tattooed tear in the flesh up the arm, revealing an inked-on nebula By using the Brand & Bond, you can shift the path of the breach, forcing the Exception into a different expression of itself. Whether this be turning a magical artefact into a super science device, or an exotic bacterium into a psychic virus. You can use this with Exceptions you have already seen to produce multiple variations, each counting as their own ‘observed’ Exception.
addons.title: Refinement & Pruning

addons.text:
The internals of the breaches you summon are incredibly hazardous to human life. Thankfully, you’re inhuman.

Using it as a mode of transportation is not only advisable, but efficient, letting you not only transport yourself, but understand the mechanics of the Breaches, altering their destinations anyway you wish. These require some trial and error, as they can appear anywhere throughout time and space in the multiverse, but in a few attempts per universe, you’ll swiftly have an accurate and stable transportation method between known locations.

Other humans are still unable to be transported using the Breaches safely.
addons.title: Hazard Warning

objects.text:
The Multiverse is not a stable phenomenon. By the very nature of it, it’s filled with breaches and scars that tunnel through it connecting virtually incompatible locations through eldritch geometries. You are intimately connected to one of these scars. A Breach in the fabric of reality, connecting aberrant vistas across realities. 

From this, you can manifest these breaches, in essence creating portals across universes from which utterly alien ‘Exceptions’ can be pulled. Exceptions can be objects, creatures, materials, even energies, only bonded in that they are not native to your universe. Being near-random on results, you always have an idea of what you'll bring forth from a breach and likewise can always summon the same Exception once previously observed. You can control the Exceptions you summon, although sentient Exceptions may have leeway in interpreting your orders.

As examples, One Exception is a creature made of corrosive gas, it is completely sentient and has no concept of colour. Another Exception is a fully operational mechanical exosuit that unfortunately assumes the occupant is likely to be no more than 40cm tall. A final example is a sharp force that immediately renders everything sterile in a cone exactly seventeen yards in front of it.

The internals of the breaches you summon are incredibly hazardous to human life. Using it as a mode of transportation would be borderline impossible without exceptional protective measures.
objects.title: Centre of the Breach

addons.text: ’A ring around your neck with equidistant lines flowing down a different limb, each representing a different Root The Brand has allowed you to compartmentalise your Roots, allowing you to use them in conjunction with each other through it, although at reduced potency for the Root that isn’t being primarily ‘used’.
addons.title: Sprouts

addons.text: Your Roots can now act as a basis for Classes, allowing them to minorly modify the expression of a Class depending on the nature of the Root. A ‘Flesh’ Root may change an ‘Esper’ class’s techniques so they physically interface with the brain of the target  instead of using psychic energy, for instance.
addons.title: Now that's a Class Tree

objects.text: There is only one constant: Change. Unfortunately, most creatures cannot survive a constant state of change, and thus they require rooting. Humans find their Root in Flesh, a changing and evolving meat. You possess the ability to change your rooting at any time. At the beginning of your journey, the Roots you might be able to embody may be Flesh, emphasising adaptation and regeneration in its nature, or Metal and its emphasis on interconnectedness and comprehending the world around it, or perhaps Shadows and the necessity of stealth and remaining undetected. As you develop, you can both train Roots you have access to and embody stranger and more conceptual Roots, such as ‘Overcharge’ which itself is impotent but exaggerates the other abilities of life, ‘Aureate’ which is ever growing without restraint, or ever stranger Roots. Perhaps with time you may even create Roots of your own, with concepts as broad as ‘Life’ itself, or as specific as ‘Spider’.
objects.title: Roots of Life

addons.text:
“There is only one step on the path to royalty. It is the idiot’s step, and it stretches to the horizon.” -Ya’at Death Poem

You have achieved what could be considered both the hardest and easiest feat possible: understanding the true name of God and reach a state of being, attained by few throughout the history of the Wheel—true Royalty.

You have mastered yourself entirely, attaining self-mastery, self-acceptance, and self-actualization to become the king of your own being. This level of self-realization grants you absolute freedom from all outside influence, even from the bounds of reality itself.

You have forged an invincible sense of self and an unbreakable will, impervious to any force. Not even the strongest mental assaults, the most seductive illusions, the pain of unbearable torture, unfathomable eldritch truths, or cosmic shattering revelations can leave a trace on the tower that is your mind.

The three hurdles designed to slow your progress have effectively ceased to exist, as your current state has far surpassed the challenges they present. This fuels your unstoppable growth even further, accelerating your already rapid advancement to an exponential degree, transforming you into a continuous cutting motion that moves ever forward to your intended destination.
addons.title: Royalty

objects.text:
From the moment you entered the world, the definition of power was forever redefined.

Your rise to be the strongest is almost inevitable, with the only thing capable of stopping you is if you slack off on your training, or an early demise. This power is accomplished through incredibly fast and virtually unstoppable growth, for you are him. You are the exception, the coincidence, the thing that shouldn’t happen yet it does. Yet, one day, your ascent will slow as you encounter three profound hurdles on your path to being the strongest. Each hurdle will challenge you more than you would expect, but overcoming one will grant you a surge in power and accelerate your growth even further, with each hurdle being more potent then the last.

First hurdle: The Depth of Resolve

What will you sacrifice for power? How much are you willing to sacrifice to be the strongest? Perhaps family, or a bit of your sanity? Sometimes the desire of power demands an obscene amount of sacrifice. Will you meet its demands and make the sacrifices that must be made, or will you demand freedom of choice?

Second hurdle: The Acceptance of Self

Every individual is unique, and uniqueness brings flaws. You must embody your true self to the highest degree, otherwise what is the point in existing? If you are a hypocrite, you must accept your hypocrisy and revel in it. If you are a warrior, then you must bathe in blood and stand above the corpses of your enemies. You must accept every single aspect of yourself, or change your true self until you embody the ideals you desire.

Third hurdle: The Pinnacle of Strength

“Throughout Heaven and Earth, I alone am the honored one.”

You do not chase for power, power chases you. Your strength is true, not because it towers above others, but because it stands unshaken by doubt. Arrogance isn’t what you possess—it's in knowing who you are, even when the world trembles in rejection. Yet now comes the ultimate question: What does it mean to be the strongest? In isolation, when there is no audience to witness, no foe to vanquish, and no accolades to earn, what does it mean to be the strongest?
objects.title: The Honored One

addons.text:
Integrating your ability to seal with your rings has allowed you to fully compartmentalise them, synergising in two key ways;

Firstly, at any time someone wears a ring, it allows you to initiate a contest of will to seal them into their ring to enhance its power. This also gives any other wearer of the ring the ability to use all of their abilities as if they were their own and use them through the ring. 

As the rings themselves are a part of you they take from your own strength when determining how difficult they are to break out of, though if you were to store multiple people within on ring they could work together to escape their prison.

Secondly, you can shift entities you’ve already sealed within yourself into the rings, both to enhance the direct power-boosting of a ring, or to give the entity’s abilities through it to someone else.
addons.title: To Bind Them

addons.text:
Store entities directly inside the Manus, making it far harder for them to escape and increasing the immediate level of finesse you can use their abilities.

You can now use the Manus’ frame as a prison, directly storing entities within your new arm. This not only makes it more difficult for them to escape your esoteric complex but also unlocks two distinct capabilities.

Firstly, you can direct the entity’s power through your arm, utilising the Manu’s connections to give yourself far greater finesse than you would have before, even with your initial ninth of its power.

Secondly, you can completely forgo gaining the abilities of something you’ve sealed to instead increase the power and growth of the Manus Superior directly. Forgoing the steady development of its strength you can use your sealed beings to power its development in incredible bounds.
addons.title: Caged

addons.text: Thanks to your transformative device, you can now become things you’ve bound in their totality temporarily. The exact effects of this varies depending on your specific device, giving you all the effects they would usually have on their transformations; An Ultimatrix for instance would give you access to an ‘ultimate’ version of what you’d sealed, while the Forma Dominae would let you slowly grow and evolve from their base into new and different forms, all stored within it.
addons.title: Get in The Damn Watch!

addons.text:
Your connection to the ten orbs allows you to ‘shift’ anything bound from being within you to being within one of your orbs instead. This either can be done like normal sealing, or by enveloping the subject entirely within an Orb. Whil;e within the orb the subject is as easily manipulated and altered as the orb itself.

The primary benefit of which being that while an entity is within an orb rather than yourself, it cannot escape confinement. The cost of this is that the orb becomes the focal point of all of their abilities rather than your own body, which you could theoretically amend by imbuing yourself with the orb containing them, but this would naturally mean the orb isn’t available externally.

You may also choose to give the entity contained within control over the specific Orb’s functions if you desire, and can rescind this control as you please. Naturally this also means they can reshape the sphere to give themselves a physical presence.
addons.title: Ten Impregnable Cells

objects.text:
You can seal and contain creatures and supernatural forces within your soul. This will give you access to their supernatural energies and abilities. This does extend to the physical abilities of things you’ve sealed that are made possible by supernatural means. 

Though in the case of physical abilities there are two factors to consider. How much they rely on supernatural means to function, and how they line up with your physiology. Say for example you seal something who’s physiology gives them a horn based ability, if it relies on magic to function, and you have a similar horn you’ll be able to use that ability with no trouble.

In order to seal something in your soul they must either not resist, or can’t defend themselves. Starting out by itself the sealing is something the average human could resist. But the stronger you get, and the more you develop this power the harder it will become for even cosmic entities to resist. However after you seal something it’ll temporarily become harder to seal other things for up to a month afterwards.

The sealing process manifests as ethereal chains extending from your body dragging the target towards you, with the target vanishing once they touch you if they can’t mount a resistance. The chains have a range of three meters.

Once you seal something you’ll start off able to use their supernatural powers at roughly one ninth the strength of the sealed creature or force. Eventually as you grow used to their power you’ll be able to use more of it. 

Things you seal can resist you even after being sealed, this will make it harder for you to use their abilities. But they will be encouraged not to fight as the environment of their seal will reflect their relationship with you. This is aided by you being able to mentally communicate with those you have sealed and even visit them through meditation and sleep.

Using the energy of something you’ve sealed will drain that energy. You may regenerate lost energy using any method that that sealed creature or force can utilize to recover their energy.

Once you’ve fully acclimated to the power of things you’ve sealed, you can train or use other such methods to make that power stronger as if it was truly your own. This will come with twice the gains than if the thing you sealed was training by itself. Of course that’s only if the power system of whatever you sealed allows growth in the first place.

Things you have sealed do not age or physically degrade and your interactions with them are purely mental. You may at any time release something you’ve sealed with this power.
objects.title: Power of a Human Sacrifice

objects.text:
Inside your soul is a world that you are the embodiment of, this world starts off as an infinitesimal empty void. But using your knowledge, things you learn, and experiences you’ll be able to shape the physics and metaphysics of this world. The more developed the physics and metaphysics the stronger and larger this world can grow. 

This is not as simple as thinking about stars and suddenly making your world a full sized star, first off your world can only grow so much in a day only about a foot in length starting off. Second, while you are able to freely manipulate the physics and metaphysics of your world, things you add or alter about them must actually be functional otherwise your world will suffer damage related to the mishap, shrink in size, and then revert to previously functional state of existence while healing. Having knowledge and experience to work off of when altering the physics and metaphysics of your world will make any such alterations smoother and easier.

Shaping the physics and metaphysics of your world has many uses because as you develop your world you’ll be able to exert it on your outside environment. 

Say you develop your world to have heat and you’ll be able to release bursts of that heat in the outside world, or develop the metaphysics so magic exists and you’ll be able to use that magic in the outside world. Altering and enhancing your body and soul using some quirk of physics or metaphysics from your world is also possible. These are just a few examples of the possibilities the potential applications are theoretically limitless. 

The development of your world directly correlates to the strength you’ll be able to exert on the outside world.

Starting out with say a small foot long world with only basic concepts of heat and cold and you’ll be able to have the equivalent of t0 power to manipulate your own body temperature. Develop your world to the size of Earth with a well developed concept of kinetic energy and you’ll be able to crack the moon like an egg.

You start off as aware of your world as you are your surroundings, a sense of awareness that will only grow as your world develops.

The more well developed a particular form of physics or metaphysics becomes as part of your world the more difficult they become to alter further.
objects.title: World Spirit

addons.text:
Your ability to study laws and concepts has evolved. You can now create "Study Partitions," which passively study your chosen laws and concepts while you do nothing or even while actively studying another law or concept. This allows for continuous progress without needing to pause or switch focus. Initially, you can create two partitions, with an additional partition becoming available each year. However, overusing this ability may strain your mind, so caution is advised.

As you add more partitions and accumulate knowledge, a vast simulated world—the "Library of Knowledge"—will take shape. This library reflects the depth of your studies and serves as a testament to your progress. Within this simulated world, mastery and understanding of laws and concepts are accelerated. Instead of directly experiencing these concepts yourself, your alternate self within the study partition absorbs the brunt of the experience. Also with each new partition created the strain on your mind will be reduced as you get used to the current number of partitions. 

By using "Idle Trainer" or "Archive" you can summon simulations of beings who possess mastery over your chosen concepts. These beings may include experts in abstract disciplines, such as a master of martial arts like "The Edge of Taixuan." Learning from these simulated teachers allows for faster progress in your studies. The more teachers you summon who specialize in a single concept, the quicker your learning rate for that particular law or concept.

Over time, your study partitions will naturally generate new attacks and powers derived from the vast archive of knowledge within the simulated world. These innovations provide practical applications for your studies, enabling you to advance not only in understanding but also in skill and capability.
addons.title: Idle Study Partitions

objects.text:
You possess the rare ability to study and realize the Laws and Concepts that underpin all of existence. These represent various aspects of reality, such as Thunder, Fire, or even higher concepts such as death. Most beings, like gods, hold a limited degree of control over specific Laws or Concepts. For example, a deity like the Raiden Shogun may command 50% control over the concept of Thunder. Beings with higher control can often exercise their mastery unrestricted, even over others who share lesser control of the same Law or Concept.

However, your ability is unique. You can study any Law or Concept, gradually going from powerless to being able to use powers or abilities based upon the percentage of the law or concept that you have learned. Through study, your mastery over the chosen subject grows, granting you new powers tied to that domain. Once you reach 100% mastery of a Law or Concept, you achieve its Truth, unlocking 10% true control of it. This allows you to apply that Law or Concept across different worlds. If you ascend further to 100% Truth realization, you gain full omniversal control, wielding the power to shape reality at the highest level.

For instance, by studying a concept such as Solid or Sharp, you can manifest its principles in versatile ways. You might combine it with other Concepts, like Fire or Barriers, creating entirely new applications. Once mastered, these powers grow exponentially stronger, enabling feats such as defeating powerful beings or achieving seemingly impossible goals. You can also combine your concepts with each other to create unique effects, or even create a true fusion expanding the power of your concepts greatly, true fusions will be harder to achieve just not impossible. 

Some Laws and Concepts are inherently more challenging to study and master. Examples include Higher laws and concepts such as Finality, Death, Life, Dreams, Infinity, and Kabbalah's Tree of Life, they will just take a long time to study, master, and eventually realize the truth. However, any Truth you realize significantly enhances your abilities, empowering you to challenge even divine beings.

You can study up to three Laws or Concepts simultaneously, with the option to pause progress on one and switch focus as needed. Additionally, delving into forbidden knowledge, such as the domains of Outer Gods, comes with risks. These forbidden Laws and Concepts may have profound effects on your being, abilities, and even your sanity.

Approach this journey with caution. The deeper your understanding, the greater your power—and the higher the stakes.
objects.title: The Study of Laws and Concepts

objects.text:
Inside your soul is your own personal TRUTH, a customizable concept that will come to embody you, your experiences, your knowledge, your desires, and outlook. 

This TRUTH starts weak, barely an idea with no real influence, but as you develop it and it becomes more defined it will start being able to affect you and reality around you. 

To develop your TRUTH you need to meditate on it or contemplate it in general. This isn’t as simple as thinking about it for a few hours a day and being able to punch out a god in a month, instead you need to think about your TRUTH and how it relates to you, your life, other concepts, and how you want it to develop. Given a few decades of healthy development then you might be able to pick fights with deities like mythological Kronos or Typhon.

You are able to mentally visualize your TRUTH which helps you guide its development with your own conscious perspective of it.

You are able to choose the base concept of your TRUTH when selecting this power. Though how your TRUTH develops will determine the exact details of the abilities that manifest from that concept.

For example, someone with a strong sense of duty in a leadership position who has [Foundation] as their TRUTH and developed it inspired by Fates’ Rhongomyniad and the Mount Buzhou of myth could result in that TRUTH being mentally represented by a pillar that supports the existence of the world. As that [Foundation] TRUTH develops they’ll start getting abilities like being a reality anchor, shielding others, enhancing the abilities of their subordinates, enhanced leadership, elemental powers, and enhanced physical capabilities. 

Any powers that give you either enhanced comprehension of concepts or give you some way to sense concepts will naturally improve your ability to develop your TRUTH a proportional amount.
objects.title: Personal Truth

addons.text:
Reality is layered with multiple Phases, which are created by humanity’s beliefs, myths, and religious systems. These Phases act as filters that alter how the world is perceived and enable supernatural phenomena. Together, they form a complex structure that distorts the natural state of reality. Beneath these layers lies the Pure World, a realm untouched by belief or religion, where only natural laws exist. Through the Imagine Breaker, one can nullify the Phases and restore reality to this unfiltered state.

As the force of nature’s will and the opposite of civilisation, your connection to the Imagine Breaker grants immense power. You can destroy not only the physical structures of civilisation but also the beliefs and concepts that sustain them. Each Phase you destroy erases the religion or system that created it. Miracles cease to exist, gods lose their power, and sacred artifacts become meaningless. Without the support of their Phases, civilisations collapse, and the natural world reclaims the space they once occupied.

The destruction of a Phase has wide-reaching effects. Landscapes shaped by supernatural forces revert to their original state, magical realms and alternate dimensions are erased. Individuals and creatures who relied on the Phase for their powers lose them entirely. As one Phase is destroyed, others destabilise, creating a chain reaction that accelerates the breakdown of belief systems. In their absence, the Pure World expands, creating areas immune to new Phases where nature flourishes without human interference.

Through the destruction of Phases, you reveal the fragile nature of human civilisation and restore reality to its original, natural state. The Pure World grows as the layers of belief are stripped away, returning existence to a state governed only by its true, unaltered laws.
addons.title: Civilisation Breaker

addons.text:
You are the Paradox Engine, a force of inevitable transformation and balance. Born from the clash of progress, nature, and Mystery, you exist to dismantle what has grown too advanced, too unnatural, or too incomprehensible. You are not a destroyer in the purest sense, but a force of reversion—where civilisation builds towers of steel, you return them to forests of stone and vine; where Mysteries manifest as unknowable powers, you strip them of their secrets and reshape them into natural, tangible forces. In your wake, the world is reborn, simpler yet enduring, as progress and chaos alike give way to a new, primal equilibrium.

You unravel the complex and incomprehensible. Technology, systems, and supernatural forces crumble in your presence, reduced to their most basic, natural forms. A weapon of steel might become a root of stone, a magical artifact might be transformed into a living organism with similar functions, and entire cities may collapse into vast forests teeming with life. The more advanced or intricate the system, the faster it falls apart under your influence. Yet, your abilities do not stop at decay; you adapt what you dismantle, warping both civilisation’s tools and Mystery’s power into weapons or manifestations of the natural order, turning the creations of progress and magic against themselves.

Your strength grows with the scale of what you oppose. Complex civilisations and deep Mysteries offer immense power to you when dismantled, fueling your abilities and allowing you to accelerate their downfall. Despite your destructive nature, you are also a force of creation. In every ruin you leave behind, life flourishes, and the natural world begins anew, untouched by the excesses of progress or the dangers of the unknown, reborn anew, stronger than ever.
addons.title: Paradox Engine

objects.text:
You are the living embodiment of nature’s fury, a relentless force born from the ancient, untamed world. In your essence, you carry the raw, unyielding power of the primordial earth—a deep and abiding hatred for the artifice and arrogance of civilisation. Where others see progress, you see blight; where they build, you tear down. You are not merely opposed to civilisation—you are its antithesis, its reckoning, and its inevitable undoing.

Your presence alone undermines the fabric of civilised existence. The more advanced the beings you face, the stronger you become, as if the very hubris of their technological superiority feeds your wrath. Against primitive tribes or nomads, you are limited; against sprawling empires of steel and circuitry, you are a cataclysm. Your abilities grow exponentially when confronting beings and societies defined by their technological advancements. This growth manifests in various ways, including a heightened resistance to their tools and weapons, a near-supernatural ability to exploit the vulnerabilities of their systems, and a devastating capacity to dismantle their progress at its roots.

Your powers are not purely destructive. You are a guardian of balance and an agent of renewal. As you dismantle civilisation, you restore the world to its pure, untouched state. Forests reclaim the ruins you leave behind, rivers break through the dams built to constrain them, and the earth heals itself in your wake. You can nurture natural life, guiding the natural world to thrive and flourish in the absence of civilisation’s interference.

The more you interact with civilised beings, the more your abilities sharpen. You develop an intuitive understanding of their structures, their ambitions, and their weaknesses. You can sense the currents of their progress—their trade routes, their centers of innovation, and their pillars of power—and strike at these keystones with devastating precision. Your power grows with every civilisation you dismantle. The lessons learned from toppling a primitive kingdom make you better equipped to unravel the fabric of an empire, and the destruction of one empire sharpens your ability to dismantle the next.

Ultimately, you are a reminder of the fragility of all that civilisation holds dear. No matter how high their towers rise or how far their machines reach into the heavens, they cannot escape the truth you embody: nature is eternal, and it will not be tamed.
objects.title: Civilisation Lost

addons.text:
To cheat death and be reborn is a powerful ability, but it often comes with the cost of losing your power and starting from scratch. While reincarnation typically offers greater potential with each cycle, you can now further capitalize on your losses.

Each time you are reborn, you retain any Prestige boosts you’ve previously earned. In addition, reincarnating will automatically Prestige you based on the amount of power you’ve lost. This additive increase in potential allows you to become even more powerful, accelerating your growth with every reincarnation.
addons.title: Reincarnating Prestige

objects.text:
Have you ever hit a plateau where you simply just grow too slowly? Ever wish you could just go faster? Well now you can, at a small cost.

When you activate Prestige, all your powers, skills, and physical gains are reset to their original baseline. Your memories however, remain untouched. The progress you "lost" isn't truly gone, instead it is invested into your growth rate.

If, for example, you were twice as strong as when you started and then activated Prestige, your growth rate would increase by 25%. If you were three times as strong, it would rise by 50%. However, some powers might not be properly benefit from this due to their unique mechanics. For example, powers like “The Honored One,” which rely more on mentality than physical progress, may experience little to no boost.
objects.title: Prestige

objects.text:
You have become the wielder of one of the most chaotic and unpredictable powers in the multiverse — Wiki Warrior. This ability, rooted in the vast encyclopedia of Wikipedia, turns any article into a source of power. Each time you use this ability, three D20 dice are rolled.

The first determines the number of random pages selected. The second decides the duration of the effect: 1–3 lasts a few minutes, 4–6 a few hours, 7–10 a few days, 11–13 weeks, 14–16 months, 17–18 permanently, and 19–20 grants an additional random effect. The third die determines the potency of the summon, ranging from simple objects to global phenomena or unique abilities.

Your summons work in your favor, but they can indirectly kill you if you're not careful. For instance, instead of summoning a real black hole, you might gain the ability to control gravity. Temporary summons are copies, while permanent ones are originals. All summoned entities possess intelligence and free will but are compelled to follow your verbal commands, so be precise and clear in your instructions.

You always know exactly which articles were selected, their effects, and their duration. If you roll three 20s in a row, you are guaranteed an outcome that reshapes the very rules of your situation. Whether it modifies the mechanics of your powers or enhances your other skills, the result will always be extraordinary and transformative.
objects.title: Wiki Warrior

addons.text: Thanks to your understanding of the Warrior’s Bond, you’re able to transform individuals into Rings instead of using your own well of energy. While transformed, they are almost identical to other Rings, but both lightly affect the personality of the wearer, and require a clash of wills with their wielder, as they usually would if transformed unwillingly.
addons.title: Shackle

addons.text:
Your spheres and their workings have impacted your ring making. Your Rings can now act as ‘lesser’ spheres of our own, being of roughly half the potency of your ‘real’ spheres.

The rings cannot be imbued and must be worn, but otherwise act as conduits of Destruction, Alteration, and Creation. They are also subject to your Thinker abilities as a result.
addons.title: Lesser Amendments

addons.text: You can use your Alloy pool to fuse rings, combining their potency in all factors.
addons.title: Adornment

addons.text:
Your rings now function as tinkering nodes for your other powers, allowing you to modify and enhance granted abilities as if they were an extension of your own power. Each ring, when given to others, act as 20SP nodes that you can reconfigure at any time or distance, without the wearer’s awareness or consent.

As a result, you are not restricted to giving or enhancing powers you already possess or those thematically linked to the wearer. A ring can now give any ability you can create, creating a possibility for diverse and adaptable power set for any user.

Additionally, you can remotely reconfigure, weaken, or fully disable a ring’s enhancements at will. The ring’s influence over its wearer can also be adjusted at any time, subtly scaling their deference to your will as needed.

If worn by you instead of another, the ring still provides free customizable 10SP of enhancements to your own abilities that can be changed at a moments notice.
addons.title: Long Distance Engineering

addons.text:
Each Ringbearer ring can now also give an additional 10 CP in skills, even skills you do not possess. You can further boost this number of skills by converting the ring’s SP to CP at a rate of 2 SP to 1 CP. 

However, you cannot convert any CP to SP and you cannot naturally change the gifted skills once they are decided.
addons.title: Lesser Rings of Mastery

addons.text:
Each Ringbearer ring can now give up to 20 CP in skills, even skills you do not possess. You can further boost this number of skills by converting the ring’s SP to CP at a rate of 2 SP to 1 CP.  

However, you cannot convert any CP to SP and you cannot naturally change the gifted skills once they are decided.
addons.title: Greater Rings of Mastery

addons.text:
Each Ringbearer ring can now give up to 25 SP in Powers and 25 CP in skills, even skills you do not possess. You can further boost this number of powers or skills by converting one to the other at a rate of 2 SP to 1 CP or 2 CP to 1 SP. 

However, you only change a ring’s gifted skills and powers though an external ability such as Long Distance Engineering.
addons.title: Supreme Rings of Mastery

objects.text:
Hail, Ringmaker/Ringbearer. Hail to that who hold the words.

As ringmaker, you have a singular ability: you can summon a single ring each month. Multiple of these rings can be summoned at once should multiple months have passed. Similarly, you can recall a ring into yourself to be reproduced, no matter how far from you it may be or who is wearing it.

The rings themselves are more complex. Their primary purpose is to be gifted to others; to this end, they vary in form, shifting in size and shape to fit the taste of whoever is their ringbearer.

The Rings’ most visible ability, however, is enhancement. While a ringbearer wears it, you can enhance any abilities they may have as if 20SP were given to them. This includes giving them new attributes or powers as long as you yourself already possess them.

The flow of this energy is not one-way, however. The ring’s main function is to supplement yourself with others, allowing you to duplicate their own attributes and abilities as long as they wear your gift. For example, a Pyromancer wearing your gift to unleash torrents of hellfire would, in turn, grant you their prior level of proficiency in the magic before the ring’s enhancement.

Finally, the ring’s most insidious facet. The more a Ringbearer wears a ring, the more their will begins to defer to your own. When coupled with the implicit loyalty required to receive their new power, very few will be willing to openly defy their Ringmaker.

You can wear your own rings, but they will be reduced to half of their usual potency.
objects.title: Ringbearer

addons.text:
