Your body has the terrifying ability to absorb those that are in physical contact with you in order to grow stronger. Further, this manifests through merging with the target you have absorbed.

Merging has the absorbed target becoming permanently fused with you, in which you gain their skills, memories, strength, and power systems added on top of your own. Notably, a quirk of this process is that you will gain some of the physical and mental characteristics of the absorbed. For example, absorbing an Uzumaki from Naruto would result in you having the combined life-force and chakra of both of you, possessing all of their sealing knowledge, your appearance changing to have some of their physical traits like red hair, and gaining their verbal tic if they had one. 

Finally, it should be noted that the process isn’t instant, with the strength difference changing whether it takes a few moments, a few minutes, or even a few hours.
objects.title: Absorb to Grow

objects.text:
Every 24 hours, you receive one charge which can be spent to permanently improve another power you have by 1% of its base in a single attribute. The improvement can randomly target any measurable aspect of the ability, including (but not limited to): raw output, effective range/area, duration, cooldown, frequency, and efficiency. Additionally, any charge has a 10% chance to double the effectiveness of the increase. 

Should you achieve the furthest possible increase in a given stat, the charge will automatically reroll. The stats with maximums are efficiency and cooldown, which cap at 50% improvement
objects.title: Let’s Go Gambling

objects.text:
Within your existence lies a truly unique ability—the power to bridge desire and realization. Your cravings, when sustained and genuine, begin to manifest as tangible change, transforming both yourself and the world to fulfill them. This manifestation scales with the strength and depth of your craving. While you cannot fully control how your desires manifest at first, particularly in broad or undefined cravings, this control can itself be developed.

At the lowest levels, this effect is subtle: a desire for strength may slightly accelerate muscle development or push your body to adapt more efficiently during training. Wanting to learn a skill may improve your memory, attention, and coordination toward that purpose. Desiring to survive may heighten your reflexes or resistance at critical moments, granting weak regenerative ability that slowly heals small cuts and bruises. Craving to enhance your existing powers can gradually refine their efficiency, raise their upper limits, or unlock new applications of those abilities.

The stronger and more absolute your craving becomes, the greater the effects it produces. A sustained craving for strength could eventually reshape your physiology beyond normal limits, granting supernatural durability and might. A desire to master a skill could lead to instinctive understanding and talent beyond genius. Craving survival and growth could induce continuous forced evolution, allowing adaptation to nearly any environment or circumstance, or granting powerful regeneration capable of restoring deep wounds or even lost limbs. At higher levels, this ability can even act upon itself.

Manifested effects tied directly to active cravings will weaken as the desire that sustains them fades. Once a craving loses its strength, abilities born purely from that yearning will diminish or vanish entirely. However, changes that have already become part of your being remain; only the ongoing growth or active manifestation tied to the craving ceases. For example, losing the desire for strength halts accelerated improvement but does not strip away the strength already attained. Likewise, refinements of self gained through desire persist as part of your nature, such as a talent or understanding developed through sustained yearning. With time and sufficient depth in a desire, its manifested effects can become imprinted, remaining even after the desire itself has faded.

The power’s potential is limited by how deeply you are capable of craving. Ordinary human desire cannot reach far beyond the mundane. To manifest effects that alter reality itself requires an intensity of yearning that borders on inhuman—cravings so absolute that they define your being. But for you, there exists a unique ability, an innate faculty that allows the strength of your soul or the weight of your existence to directly determine how deeply you are capable of craving, actively deepening your capacity for desire as they grow, enabling you to reach and bear levels of craving that normal beings could never withstand without losing yourself to it.

At the highest levels, the act of wanting itself becomes Law—a force encompassing all of existence, capable of warping probability, rewriting reality, and bending the world to fulfill your will, where all its manifested effects attain permanence, for the potential of this power is limitless.
objects.title: Desire Manifestation

addons.text: When applying a charge to a power gained from your creations, it gains an additional boost for each copy of it you've received.
addons.title: Additive Increases

addons.text: When giving the Maiden one of your creations as an offering, if nobody has used it for long enough to gain the power inside, you will get the power(s) within it at half strength. As for the other half, the Maiden herself will get them, allowing for her to not just be a partner and patron, but a companion who can fight alongside you, should you give her the chance.
addons.title: Love Language

addons.text: You can now make lesser arrows based on the stand arrow you possess. These lesser arrows can grant stands with a guaranteed theme, such as making arrows that give stands with powers relating to fire, thread, or something more nebulous, like art. While your created arrows are guaranteed to give someone a stand, the stands themselves are on the weaker end, being roughly 5-10  SP in power.
addons.title: Variant Arrows

objects.text:
You can imbue objects you create with a power that is roughly 1 SP in terms of strength that follow a chosen theme, although the power itself is random. This requires personally creating the object, although tool use in creation is allowed. The powers themselves can be something that works through the object or enhances the user in some way (your choice). Eventually, you'll be able to figure out how to give more powers and more precisely choose which ones you imbue, though multiple identical powers cannot be on the same piece of equipment.

After being created, your creations' powers will slowly become more powerful, reaching the level of 5 SP powers within a month and starting to slow down, as the growth is logarithmic. Over time, a single user of your creations, yourself included, can permanently gain the 1 SP version of the power imbued into it, although this will, at the fastest, happen within roughly a month. Identical powers obtained this way will combine, adding together their cumulative power.
objects.title: Objects of Low Power

addons.text:
Your ability to integrate technology has allowed the Manus Superior to begin infusing your body, slowly weaving it’s way into the rest of your nervous system, then your muscles, then your bones until the entirety of your body is as a giant Manus, an improved reactor will make it’s home in your chest and supply all your needs, and your body will be it’s focus.

Additionally, this allows any OoPs you may possess to interface with the Manus with far greater ease and rapidly decrease development and adaptation times. 

Just give it time to actually develop, won't you?
addons.title: Manus Interior

addons.text:
The Manus has established a connection to the Breach. Whenever you use the Breach to summon an Exception, the Manus keeps a note of its existence, nature and relative coordinates in order to synthesise more effects more efficiently within it. 

Depending on the Exceptions you end up getting, this can be a great boon, but is ultimately to the whims of the Breach.
addons.title: Manus Exterior

addons.text:
The Manus Superior has adapted to your other arm’s… guest. Power from the Manus Superior can be channeled into your prison to help bind your Fae in desperate circumstances, weakening it’s ability to send agents for your demise.

In addition, over time the Manus will begin to utilise the… Unique, construction of the fae as a new power source, raising the amount of power it has at its disposal.
addons.title: Manus Ulterior

addons.text:
The Manus has connected with each of your rings. On one level, this allows you to treat the Manus as a ring, inheriting the usual benefits from it being attached to your body as if you were wearing one.

On the other hand, it allows you to use the Manus Superior through any other rings you possess, regardless of whether they are being worn by others. Depending on how the Manus develops this can let you spy, fake omnipresence, supply more power to individual rings, or fake certain rings being more powerful by simply exerting abilities of your Manus through them.
addons.title: Manus Supreme

addons.text:
Thanks to the Manus’ anchoring to your soul, you can choose for each of your minions to possess a manus of their own (whatever they may be).

While at first the advantage is obvious, dramatically increasing each of thor utility, these Manus can be used in conjunction at your direction, adding their strengths together to create larger effects that would be impossible for a single manus alone.
addons.title: Plurimus Superior

addons.text:
As an artificial being, the Manus has infused each part of you, dramatically increasing the energy at its disposal. Additionally, you can now force the Manus into two modes, ‘Development’ and ‘Application’.

Development mode focuses all of the Manus’s energy into advancing it’s own capabilities/ It’s range, strength, and the permanence of its effects among other things. While in Development mode this growth will be three times faster than without. 

Application mode meanwhile forces all of the Manus’s energy into its immediate effect, amplifying the power it can bring to bear at the expense of using more energy that will eventually begin drawing from your own battery, and completely nullifying any growth it could be making during that time. 

The Development and Application modes are more akin to a spectrum than a binary switch allowing you to customise the Manus’ output between them, though it will take ten seconds for any changes made to come into effect.
addons.title: Corpus Superior

addons.text: As the Manus is attached to your soul, it has become fully digitised like yourself. This allows you to use the Manus through any server or node you’re attached to as if it were your body.
addons.title: Animus Superior

addons.text:
The Manus is a shard of you, aberrant yet not. The hybridisation of your abilities allows you to press more into the world through the manus. To this end, its raw potency has been increased five times over in all areas

Additionally, the effects of the Manus are always permanent, no longer slowly coming undone without energy pumped into them.
addons.title: MANUS ETURNUM

addons.text:
The Manus Superior, already growing with your strength, has been enhanced. Not only is it easier than ever to shape the manus to your desires, you can manufacture objects out of the manus with even greater finesse and speed. 

These objects still need to be connected to the Manus to remain stable, disappearing shortly after removed from its range, but this does almost guarantee you’ll always have whatever tool, weapon or miscellaneous object you need at a moment’s notice through your arm.

Naturally, these objects benefit from Growth Tool.
addons.title: Convenience Superior

addons.text: Your transformative device has been integrated into the Manus Superior. Allowing it to warp and alter it’s precise effects, at a price. The device will continue to act normally if unedited, but under the Manus’ direction, it allows you to essential ‘Jailbreak’ it to access deeper commands and make radical edits. For instance, the manus could ‘Jailbreak’ the H-Dial into acting akin to another of its ilk, like the S-dial, specifically creating Sidekicks, or G-dial, specifically creating super-tools to be used, and more bespoke things besides. Or the Omnitrix could fully develop an ‘Ultimate’ function with enough time, or impart only partial transformations, or create mutations in the species samples. However, this does not come without a price, as until you ‘work out the kinks’ so to speak these altered functions will be prone to errors, some inconvenient, others catastrophic, with the more severe the malfunction the closer fixing it will bring you to rendering the new function ‘safe’ and permanent. You can return your device to its default state at any point, with the manus keeping a spiritual ‘schematic’ to any functions you’ve developed prior. Should you have multiple devices that fit this description, it will apply to each.
addons.title: Commutatio Superior

addons.text: ’Circuits draw from the arm, covering the body as they lace out, each pulsing gently with cyan motes’ The Brand and Bond has begun branching through the Manus, altering it in subtle ways. While the Manus will grow as usual, you will find it gaining more and more bespoke abilities that would usually fall outside of it. Medical use, repairing machines, even temporary empowerment, with each of these abilities having a feed, allowing you to distribute as much energy as you would like to any and all of them form the Manus’ main supply.
addons.title: Compunctum notis Thraeciis

addons.text:
Each of your Yous have a Manus of their own rather than being divided across them or held entirely in one. 

Each of these manus may develop in their own ways, but when your parts come together, they are all combined additively with each other.
addons.title: Greater as One

addons.text:
Your connection with the multiverse, and your ability to exchange pieces with your variant selves can now be applied to the Manus Superior as well. 

Naturally, this means you can exchange the Manus, a more general tool,with a version of it that is more specialised in certain directions, or even overwhelming in a single one, borrowing form all its potential versions. The potential applications of these Manus are as varied as your alternates themselves, with different capabilities, variations and adaptations.

Your Manus can also now utilise information gained from these alternate forms to inform its own development, collecting and storing data from their own home universes, acting as a repository for you to peruse. 

Additionally, by using this data, your Manus could ‘learn’ how to improve itself even without developing in those specific ways. For instance, a Manus specially designed to create knock-on effects through minor changes may allow yours to improve its own finesse and focus in its activities.
addons.title: Prototyping

addons.text:
The Manus’ roots into your soul, and its unusual resilience, has now allowed you to utilise it on your soul itself. The consequences of this would usually be immense, but thanks to your unusual soul, any damage is easily undone. 

This allows you to purposely misshape your soul, moulding it in order to open and enhance avenues of spiritual power that were previously closed. Greater magical strength, physical changes, bespoke abilities, all possible with fine enough tuning.

With enough practice, you could even learn do the same to others, though they would likely suffer dramatically worse effects on account of lacking your soul’s unusual properties.
addons.title: Manus Animus

addons.text:
Your Perfect Omnitool has fused with the Manus, forming into a kind of cognizant intelligence. 

The Omnitool’s new status allows it to iterate and develop the Manus further, growing at greater speeds than ever before. Additionally, your Omnitool will begin adapting processes and functions for issues it predicts the Manus will face. 

Additionally, the Omnitool’s access to data networks and its large-scale scanning allows the Manus to be used at a far greater range than before. While this can be used to produce the Manus’ usual effects it can also produce widespread illusions by manipulating the light in those areas, and with some energy form the Manus, can make these projections ‘hard’ and tactile.

Finally, the Omnitool’s old housing can be used as a ‘relay’ for all of the Manus’ capabilities, and they can be used through it much like how the Omnitool can be used through your arm.
addons.title: Blue Brain

objects.text: You’ve lost an arm, sorry about that. You have been given an adaptive prosthetic arm called the Manus Superior. The Manus Superior’s main role was to be a kind of prototype local reality manipulator. Unfortunately, as a result of its creators' untimely erasure from existence, it’s both relatively weak and unstable. The Manus can make relatively minor changes anywhere within an inch of it. This ranges from sudden bursts of energy to material transmutation, but these effects rapidly deteriorate the further they get from the arm. For instance, you could create steel from air, but within the minute it would be reduced back to oxygen. While this may seem less than useful, with creative application you can create any number of eclectic effects. Sudden superheated air enhanced by the sudden appearance of a vector shooting it forwards to create a fireball, for instance. After a few upgrades, forcefields and energy constructs may be possible. The second, and more outwardly notable aspect of the Manus Superior is its nature as an Adaptive prosthetic. The more technologies, magics, and esoteric energies and artifacts it encounters, the more it shifts and changes to grow itself and its capabilities. It essentially acts as a self-repairing focus and integration platform for these elements. Naturally, it can also change its appearance in order to accommodate these, and also to suit the taste of the wielder. The Manus Superior needs downtime to make repairs, adapt, and recharge its internal battery, which usually can sustain intensive use for about two hours, and is self-sustaining at minimum power.
objects.title: Manus Superior

objects.text: You possess a rather interesting power: the power of friendship. Literally. By forming positive emotional bonds with others, you slowly begin to link with them on a spiritual level. As this bond (called SL) increases in level, you slowly begin to grow stronger physically and spiritually, and when working together your bond further strengthens both of you and your teamwork, such that together you are stronger than either of you alone. However, this growth is very slow, such that it'd take at least ten fully leveled up SL just to double your strength, with each further doubling requiring ten times the number of links (100 for 4x, 1000 for 8x, etc.). The real growth comes from SL Traits. Each unique SL has 10 levels, with SL 1 being equivalent to a random acquaintance and SL 10 being as close as a best friend or close family. Every other SL (2, 4, 6, 8, 10) comes with some kind of Trait that gets progressively better the higher the level. These Trait can manifest as practically anything, from a minor boost to your math abilities, to a bonus to luck in combat, to a slight affinity for a given element, an increase in growth through training, or even a multiplier to SL growth with specific groups, with similar or overlapping Traits stacking endlessly. Generally, the more powerful or connected to the world itself the person is, and the higher the level the SL is, the better the Trait. Upon reaching SL 10, you gain a minor Power or Item representing the bond. For example, in DxD reaching SL 10 with Aika would give you the ability to measure a person's dimensions at a glance, while Issei could end up giving you a copy of Twice Critical, and Ophis would grant you a stabilized version of her Mark. All of these Powers and Items can be improved either by training or by synergizing with other SL Traits that resonate with them, such as random teleportation power and a power that lets you always knowing where you are on a map combining to allow you to set a destination to teleport into the general area of. These Links are based on the soul, allowing you and the person you have SL with to subconsciously empathize with each other, making communication easier and allowing one another to gain a better understanding, slowly working to help the other develop as a person. These bonds are strengthened by active attempts to befriend one another, mutual communication, hanging out, playing games together, battling side by side, and other such bonding activities. The exact nature of a specific SL’s relationship with you, whether friends, family, rivals, lovers, frenemies, or something else is up to how you choose to develop it. However, they must be genuine, using mindcontrol or emotional manipulation powers to make someone see you as a friend will not build SL. Because of the feedback loop of higher SL making it easier to befriend someone making it easier to reach higher SL with them, this power makes forming strong relationships vastly easier and faster, with dedicated, focused effort taking you from SL 1 to SL 10 with a specific person within a month if there are no other modifiers to SL growth. However, this goes both ways, with you being just as willing to die for an SL 10 as they are for you, so be careful who you decide to befriend less they change you more than you change them, especially as the SL does not fray over time, being just as strong after a decade apart as it was the day you left. Theoretically, this power allows for unlimited growth, although that growth is relatively slow without other powers to build off of or accelerate it. With this power alone, you could eventually grow powerful enough to go from a mundane human to someone who could slay or become a god, but it would take decades minimum.
objects.title: Social Links

objects.text:
Upon selecting this power, you choose a single Essence that you can sense, draw in, and consume. An Essence can be anything, from blood or energy to more unconventional or conceptual targets such as emotions, heat, or even the color red. The more specific and narrowly defined your chosen Essence is, the more effective this power becomes. 

You primarily draw Essence from other things through physical contact, manifesting as wisps or flows appropriate to the chosen Essence. If physical contact is impractical, alternative but equivalent means will manifest. Essence that is willingly or actively directed toward you is consumed faster and with greater potency. Excessive feeding from sentient beings can leave them weakened, dazed, numb, or otherwise impaired, with symptoms reflecting the nature of the Essence consumed.

Consumed Essence permanently enhances you, strengthening your body and improving all of your powers. The magnitude of this enhancement depends on the quantity, quality, intensity, and source of the Essence consumed. Essence drawn from more powerful beings, objects, or phenomena yields proportionally greater benefits. Common or diluted Essence grants small increases, while rare, concentrated, or extreme manifestations provide significant gains. These improvements are multiplicative, and narrower and more unusual Essences scale more efficiently.

This power carries inherent risk. Excessive or uncontrolled daily consumption pushes you into a state of Chaos. While its effects vary by Essence, Chaos universally causes the traits of the consumed Essence to bleed into your behavior, body, or mind. Feeding on emotions may destabilize your psyche, while feeding on blood may intensify predatory instincts. Highly abstract Essences produce more unpredictable distortions and failure to manage Chaos can result in lasting or permanent alterations.

Sustained overconsumption gradually alters your instincts. You develop a growing preference for your chosen Essence, finding it increasingly satisfying and desirable, while ordinary sustenance becomes less fulfilling by comparison.
objects.title: Essence Vampire

objects.text: "And thus, I become god." – some stupid hiki-neet, probably. Congratulations! You now have the innate ability to improve yourself via your tremendous amount of personal insecurities. Never in a way that directly improves what you are actually insecure about, but an improvement nonetheless. Insecure about your looks? Your general health will improve. Insecure about how much hair you have? Your skin will grow more resistant to puncture and wounding. These improvements are small, but permanent, and stack. The more toll the mental insecurity takes upon you, the quicker your compensations take root. Anxiety and panic attacks will have your compensations spike in response. The more general the insecurity, the more general but slower the compensation you gain from them.
objects.title: Compensation

objects.text:
You have gained the power to become an existence that opposes all that you slay, and your power is as simple as it is horrifying. The more you slay of a specific type of being, the more your existence becomes the slayer of it.

Initially, killing one or two would have you instinctively finding their weak points, but with each additional member of said type slain, your opposing nature would grow to a greater extent.

Such examples being, your attacks that would normally cause mere scratches instead of creating great gashes, your mere presence inspiring an instinctive dread, armored beings finding their defenses effortlessly shattering before you, and even reaching the point where your mere existence would be akin to a poison for them slaying them without having to lift a finger.

As a final note, should an individual you slay be far stronger than the norm for its type, then it would count akin to having slain several of that type, depending on how great a difference.
objects.title: The Slayer's Path

objects.text:
You are a knock-off version of the legendary Tinker 12 Inventor. While you fall short of their inspired brilliance, a spark of the same genius still burns within you.

Every 6 days, you gain 1 Charge which can be spent to make you a Tinker within a particular specialization, theme or focus. You may invest multiple Charges into the same specialty to deepen your proficiency and expand your capabilities or, alternatively, split them apart between different particular areas of expertise.

You begin with a starting bonus of 3 Charges to use. At the outset, a single Charge is equal to 1 SP. If your chosen focus is moderately broad or useful, one Charge places you at the bare minimum of what would pass as a Tinker. Comparably, if the specialization is very weak or narrow in scope, you might rival a novice second-rate Tinker in understanding... but only just.

This power scales with continued investment; after every 6 SP, the number of Charges needed to upgrade a specialization doubles. So beyond 6 SP each additional SP takes two Charges, past 12 SP it needs four, after 18 SP it needs eight and so on. For example, investing six Charges into Chemistry would raise it to 6 SP but to boost further up to 7 SP would require two Charges.

This scaling continues up to the max possible of 60 SP for a single specialization. If multiple areas overlap in some manner, they will synergise flawlessly and expand off of each other. All conceivable fields of technological knowledge are viable for this power, whether robotics, miniaturization, nuclear physics, medicine or otherwise.
objects.title: Inferior Inventor

addons.text:
After completing certain achievements, you may now be rewarded with an epithet or title directly tied to that accomplishment. For example, defeating ten opponents using boxing techniques may grant you the epithet “Novice Boxer.”

In addition, every title or epithet you possess - including those gained through Epithet Collector - now gains its own personal achievement line. Completing achievements tied to a specific title strengthens it over time and may cause it to evolve into a higher form. A title such as “Novice Boxer” can eventually grow into “Master of Boxing” significantly enhancing its associated effects.
addons.title: Achieved Title

addons.text:
The presence of Epithet Collector and the integration of the more advanced Roleplayer: Feat System into the sub-mechanics of Feats allow your Achievement System to unlock a new, higher form of development - Paths.

A Path represents a finite, legendary series of achievements. Completing a Path grants you a unique Legendary Title and a full set of powers associated with that Title. Each Path is based on a specific legend, archetype, or myth. For example, the Path of the Monkey King consists of achievement chains that replicate the key stages of his legend - from his first feats to the divine challenge to the heavens.

Completing each chain grants a fragment of his power, gradually bringing you closer to the full embodiment of the Title.

The achievement chains of a Path are extremely challenging and cannot be completed randomly or formally. Unlike regular achievements or Feats, a Path cannot be created or requested directly from the System. For a Path to become available, you must meet its requirements possessing certain powers, skills, personal qualities, mindset, or modes of action that reflect the essence of the legend.

In rare cases, access to a Path may be granted in another way: if the original bearer of the Title or an entity associated with it recognizes you as worthy, accepts you as an heir, or voluntarily transfers to you the right to follow their Path.
addons.title: Path

objects.text:
You gain access to a System with a constantly expanding list of achievements that can be completed in exchange for rewards. The difficulty of an achievement directly determines the scale of the reward. Simple goals grant small but practical enhancements - for example, completing “Run 100 meters in 10 seconds” may increase your running speed, reinforce your legs, and protect your ligaments from strain. At the other extreme, extraordinary feats such as “Slay a dragon as an ordinary human” can grant really high power.

Most achievements exist as sequential chains. Each achievement can theoretically continue indefinitely, with requirements gradually increasing over time. For example, after “Walk 100 meters”, the next stage becomes “Walk 1 kilometer”, then 10 kilometers, and so on - each new stage increases the conditions by a factor of 10, with rewards scaling accordingly. Depending on how an achievement is completed or what abilities you possess, these chains may branch into alternative paths, such as “Fly 1 kilometer” or “Teleport 10 kilometers forward”.

Any achievement chain can be permanently ended by choosing a Final Achievement. Its conditions far exceed those of the previous stage, ranging from 1,000× to 10,000× the last requirement. In exchange, you receive a reward worthy of such Feat.

The System is not static. It dynamically adapts based on your actions, worldview, thoughts, goals, and the powers or skills you possess. All achievements are divided into two types: Sequential and Feats.

Sequential achievements are the previously mentioned chains with numerical and progressively increasing conditions, focused on gradual growth and accumulation of power.

Feats, on the other hand, represent rare and significant accomplishments capable of heavily influencing the world. Their conditions may be concrete - such as “Defeat the Monkey King” or “Destroy an entire Pantheon of Gods” - or abstract, like “Cure the ‘Disease of the Mind’ afflicting the people of The City”. Some Feats are literature in nature, such as “Travel Around the World in 80 Days” or “Become The Honoured One”. Their difficulty is extreme, but the rewards are equally immense.

You may also initiate achievements yourself by proposing specific conditions and rewards. For example: “If 10 people highly rate my cooking, I gain the ability to sharpen knives.” The System evaluates the request and may accept it, reject it, or adjust its conditions or reward for balance. Additionally, if you accomplish something truly significant that does not fall under any existing achievement or Feat, the System will still register your action and grant a reward based on its impact.
objects.title: Achievement System

objects.text: Upon taking this power, choose a Set. These Sets can be any group with clear bounds, such as the major arcana, the four cardinal directions, the seven catholic sins, or even something like the alphabet. Even things such as the characters making up an acronym can be a Set. The larger the Set, the weaker the effects of this power will be. You can assign any available powers, techniques, or spells to a slot of this Set, and it will be both strengthened and altered to more thematically match the slot of the Set to which it is assigned. Fire magic placed under the sin of pride might become difficult to put out, or a luck ability assigned to the direction of south may become better at bringing misfortune. Once an ability is bound to a Set, it cannot be unbound, and will continue to grow in strength and versatility to match. Powers placed with a set slot they already are aligned with will recieve the boost to a greater degree, such as assigning fire magic to the sun arcana. This powers true strength lies in completing your Set. Upon filling all slots of your Set, all powers will be boosted, and they will begin to evolve in ways to complement the Set they are a part of. Your north and east ability would work better when used together, or your winter ability would work better when used directly after fall. You can only create one Set. Choose wisely.
objects.title: Set Collector

objects.text:
You gain the ability to manipulate the “attributes” that constitute your being, both physical and metaphysical. This power operates on a principle of Equivalent Exchange: to enhance one attribute, you must diminish another, with the magnitude of the enhancement directly proportional to the magnitude of the sacrifice. 

You can freely and near-instantly shift points between your core physical attributes, draining raw physical Strength to gain immense Speed and Agility, or sacrificing speed to gain overwhelming Durability and Strength, seamlessly reshaping yourself to fit the demands of the moment.

The scope of what constitutes an “attribute” is limited only by your understanding and imagination, extending far beyond simple physical statistics. You may temporarily sacrifice your Sense of Sight to gain vastly enhanced hearing or a supernatural danger sense, dampen your Emotional Responses to achieve cold clarity and tactical brilliance, drain Stamina or Endurance for a massive but brief surge of magical or psionic power, or exchange your Capacity for Long-Term Memory for a short-lived yet flawless eidetic recall. These exchanges can be highly specific and nuanced, allowing you to trade the strength of a single limb to empower another, or sacrifice linear movement speed to drastically heighten reaction time and reflexes.

The process of manipulation is fluid and adaptive. You can make these changes on the fly, transitioning instantly between different configurations to meet immediate challenges, shifting from a resilient frontline juggernaut to an evasive, precise combatant in the midst of battle. The effects may be temporary or semi-permanent: you can perform quick, momentary shifts and return to your baseline, or establish a carefully balanced “default” state that persists until you choose to alter it again.
objects.title: Attribute Manipulation

objects.text:
Your labour yields returns, and the harder the labour, the riper the fruit. When you take risks, endure hardships, and venture into the unknown, your actions reliably create or reveal pathways to reward proportionate to your effort. These rewards can be tangible—like resources, equipment, or treasure—and or intangible, such as crucial knowledge, a vital alliance, or earned reputation.

A minor challenge might yield useful supplies or a friendly contact. Surviving a true ordeal could reveal a hidden trove or grant you the trust of a powerful faction. Because you ventured into the deep ruins, you are the one who finds the architect's secret cache or deciphers its historical truth. By enduring the lethal wilds, you cross paths with the sole hermit who holds the knowledge you need. The reward, in whatever form, is a direct, plausible consequence of your effort and presence. You develop a reliable instinct for where to look and when to act, ensuring your sweat and risk are commensurately rewarded.
objects.title: Fruits of Labour

objects.text:
You no longer experience diminishing returns. 

Any form of growth—skills, powers, attributes, learning, training, adaptation, progression, or anything else—advances as easily at later stages as it did at the beginning.

Each improvement takes the same relative effort as the first step ever did. The same actions net the same scaled benefit, no matter what scale you grow to. This includes surpassing inherent ceilings as a result of this. 

Once gained, progress never fades, decays, or regresses unless you explicitly choose otherwise. Skills do not rust. Powers do not weaken. Conditioning does not slip. Knowledge does not atrophy. 

Likewise, if any step beyond the first would be easier, faster, or give more progress than the first step, then your new speed of progression will align with the best of each property when reached. 

This does remove soft and hard caps on usage of powers, for example enchantment caps or how many charges may be used on a power, but does not remove any inherent limitations, such as a fire power turning into a water power.
objects.title: As Easy As The First Step

objects.text:
Every week, your power assigns you quests designed to bring about the betterment of the world. Completing these quests rewards you with additional resources for your power, such as extra charges. However, you won’t receive explicit instructions—only a subtle sensation guiding you toward what needs to be done. If someone’s life is in danger, for instance, you will sense their distress but won’t immediately know the cause, the timing, or the full circumstances.

Each quest consists of three tiers, with increasingly greater rewards for each level of completion. Finishing the first step grants a full day’s worth of charges. Completing two steps increases the reward to three days’ worth of charges. Completing all three steps earns you a full week’s worth of charges.

For example, if your power guides you toward saving a young girl, rescuing her from immediate danger would complete the first step and grant the initial reward. If her babysitter is also in peril, ensuring their safety would fulfill the second step and increase your reward. Finally, bringing the girl’s kidnapper to justice would complete the quest entirely, securing the highest reward.

Your power does not dictate how you accomplish these tasks—or even if you choose to attempt them. It simply offers you the opportunity to act, rewarding your efforts accordingly.
objects.title: Karmic Quests

addons.text:
Anything gained through roulette is now a valid target for your Copy ability, allowing you to ‘save’ aspects of a build to it as you would any other copy. 

Should the base ability be removed from Roulette, the copy will still remain, and you can do this for any number of abilities inside Roulette.
addons.title: Rent-A-Power

objects.text:
You have a torrent of energy inside of you that you can allow to define itself into a random structure. Once it’s found this structure, you gain a random assortment of abilities totalling 1.5x the sp you put into this power at its conception. 

For instance, by putting 10sp into Roulette would mean you gain 15sp of powers, though these can be divided up randomly, such as one 5sp power. Three 1sp powers, and a 7sp power. You do not have control of the powers that are drawn, being utterly random. 

Additionally, a month after defining it, the energy can collapse into its undefined state again, allowing you to either retain what you have or lose the powers within Roulette in order to gain a new random set with the same SP total.

As this power develops the time between re-rolls can become shorter, and the total power of the builds can grow, but this is a rather slow process initially.
objects.title: Roulette

objects.text:
By cutting out a region of space-time around yourself with a spherical barrier, you can manifest a Domain—a dimension where every supernatural ability, regardless of the source, stops working. You can imbue one of your supernatural powers into the domain, transforming this cut-out region into a metaphysical realm representative of the imbued power and also granting the domain a sure-hit effect, which automatically and instantly attacks any and all targets within the domain via embedded power, regardless of any previous limitations of the ability or the target's attempts at defence or evasion.

At first, you can only manifest a domain with one embedded power and will need some downtime between activations, as rapid and repeated use puts a strain on your mind and body. But with practice, there are almost no limits to what you will be able to do: from imbuing multiple powers to manifesting multiple domains simultaneously, creating domains without a barrier that seamlessly overlays the real world, compressing and firing domains like power-negating bullets, or anything else you can imagine.
objects.title: Domain Expansion

objects.text:
The worse your mental state, the greater your talent in all things. This allows you to rapidly learn, improve, and master any skill or ability, with your talent scaling in direct proportion to your mental decline. Even a state as common as mental exhaustion can elevate your capabilities to genius-level, allowing you to innovate and create within any field with the same prowess as historical figures like Einstein. However, unlike such figures who were limited to a specific discipline, your enhanced talent is universally applicable, unrestricted by domain or specialty. 

Any ability, effect, or circumstance that temporarily relieves, seals away, or suppresses your negative emotions or mental suffering will be ignored by this power. These will not cause the boost to diminish, it only fails to activate if your overall mental state is genuinely and sustainably improved.

This only augments your talent, it does not grant you access to hidden knowledge or information. The raw material for innovation must still come from your own experience and study; the power lies in how you process and build upon it. 

A side effect of this dynamic is a psychological pull toward worsening your own mental health. As your mind equates instability with peak performance, you may find yourself unconsciously, or even deliberately, gravitating toward thoughts and behaviors that deteriorate your well-being, simply to maintain or amplify your newfound genius.
objects.title: I Smile As I Crush My Own Heart

objects.text:
Growth comes from action. Every challenge you face and overcome feeds an internal wellspring of potential. This is Essence Experience, the tangible measure of your development.

Experience flows from many sources. Surviving dangers you faced and lived through teaches you, with greater risks granting more. Defeating foes who opposed you, the difficulty of the victory adding to what you gain. Completing goals you set for yourself, achievements both large and small. Moments of insight where you understood something new about yourself or the world. Character growth as you change, evolve, and become more. Discovery when you find something hidden, a place, a truth, a power. The more dangerous, difficult, or meaningful the experience, the more experience it yields.

You spend this accumulated experience to acquire or develop Charms. Charms are supernatural expressions of your inner nature, discrete abilities that expand what you are capable of. The more powerful or versatile a Charm, the more experience it requires.

A simple charm, like shifting into a bear for a short time, requires a moderate investment of experience. A more significant charm, such as calling down lightning to strike where you will, demands substantially more. A charm of world-altering scale, like summoning a supernova, would require an immense, long-term accumulation of experience, the kind of goal you build toward over an entire journey rather than a quick purchase.

Charms generally fall into three categories. Enhancements make you better at what you already do: strike harder, move faster, see clearer, endure more. New capabilities let you do what you couldn't before: fly, breathe underwater, walk through fire. Defiant effects push against normal limits: ignore a fatal wound, shake off a curse, act for a moment beyond exhaustion.

Charms can be active or passive. Active Charms require conscious use and draw on your Essence, the internal reservoir of energy that powers your supernatural expressions. A charm might have a set cost to activate. A charm that lets you strike three times at once might cost a fixed amount each time you use it. A shapeshifting charm might require an upfront cost to assume the form and then consume a small amount of Essence each minute you maintain it. A leap across a canyon. A surge of healing that regrows a lost arm in moments. A charm that calls a spirit to fight alongside you for a time. A marksman might develop an active charm that lets them shoot the wings off a fly from thirty paces. Another might reveal the weakest points on a foe's body for a few heartbeats.

Passive Charms are always with you. They require no activation and no ongoing Essence cost. Keener senses that function constantly. The ability to understand and speak with animals as naturally as you would another person. Immunity to poisons, your body simply rejecting anything harmful. Natural regeneration that slowly mends wounds over time. Flight that is as effortless as walking. Because they function without effort, a passive version of a charm typically costs more experience than its active, temporary counterpart.

You recover Essence through rest and meditation. A full night's sleep restores your pool completely. Meditating restores Essence as well, though more slowly than true rest. If your Essence runs dry, you can push further by drawing on your health or stamina instead, powering charms through sheer physical cost until you can recover.

Your existing charms shape what comes next. Developing a charm aligned with abilities you already possess costs less experience than one from an unfamiliar domain. A shapeshifter who speaks with animals and moves through forests unseen will find nature-aligned charms easier to develop. A sorcerer who has honed their control will find charms that refine mana efficiency or shaping more accessible. A warrior with multiple enhancement charms will find new physical improvements come more naturally. Your path has momentum, and your investments compound.

You are not limited to a preset list. Charms emerge from your experiences, needs, and creative vision. They can be combined, layered, and developed further. As you grow, you can refine existing Charms into more powerful versions or discover entirely new expressions of your nature. Act, grow, and spend. What you create is up to you.
objects.title: Charms

objects.text:
When you work together with others toward a shared goal, you rapidly adapt to their styles, rhythms, and capabilities. Within hours of collaborating with someone, you instinctively know how to complement their strengths, cover their weaknesses, and anticipate their needs before they express them. This mutual understanding deepens the more you work together, creating a synergy that makes your combined efforts smoother and more effective than any individual contribution could be. The effect is mutual; your partners find themselves understanding you just as well in return, creating a feedback loop of growing cooperation.

Your abilities and those of your collaborators actively grow through this synergy. Every successful joint effort strengthens not just your coordination but the underlying capabilities each of you brings to the table. A fighter and a mage working together will find their combat instincts and spellcasting becoming sharper, more intuitive, and more responsive to combination tactics. An engineer and a diplomat solving problems as a pair will develop faster technical insight and keener social perception respectively. The growth is organic and tailored to how you work together, reinforcing the skills you actually use in collaboration. The more people you work with simultaneously, and the longer you work with them, the faster every member of the group improves. These gains persist even when you are apart, as if the synergy you built together permanently strengthened the foundations of your abilities. Groups you have collaborated with extensively find that they continue to develop faster even in separate endeavors, carrying forward the growth sparked by your presence.
objects.title: Aquarius, Friends We Made Along The Way

objects.text:
Whenever you sleep, you dream of yourself as you could be. These are not fantasies of power or glory but practical dreams in which you practice skills, refine techniques, and explore the deeper logic of your abilities. A musician dreams of playing impossible pieces until their fingers move without thought. A fighter dreams of dueling opponents who exploit every weakness until those weaknesses close. A mage dreams of casting spells in dreams where magic obeys different rules, forcing creative adaptation that reveals hidden dimensions of their art. These dreams feel like hours or days of practice compressed into a single night's rest.

You retain every insight from these dreams subconsciously, waking with your abilities subtly improved. A skill you struggled with yesterday flows more easily today. A problem that seemed unsolvable now has an answer waiting at the edge of your thoughts. A technique you could never quite master feels more natural, as if your body and mind integrated the lesson while you slept. The dreams always show you a path forward, never perfection itself, revealing the next step in your growth rather than the final destination. Over time, consistent dreaming accumulates into genuine mastery, with each night's sleep adding a layer of refinement that feels effortless but proves undeniable when you test yourself upon waking. You cannot control what you dream about, but your subconscious always knows what you most need to improve and shows you exactly that.
objects.title: Pisces, the Dream of Perfection

objects.text:
You may now declare any area as your Home. Your Home will encompass 50 square meters of any space. As long as you remain in your Home, all your abilities will grow stronger. This growth rate starts small, with you simply learning or developing your abilities slightly faster while in your Home.

But the longer you choose to remain in your Home, the faster this rate will grow. Over time, Hermit’s Home will also expand in size. Leaving Hermit’s Home will decay its boost and size depending on how far you go and how long you are away. Stepping a few steps outside for a minute would have virtually no effect. But leaving for a few days on a trip could undo months of progress.

You can interact with the outside world while inside your Home, but the more you interact, the more your Home's growth rate will slow, depending on the method. If you are merely chatting with someone in the outside world on the phone, the stall in growth rate will be minor. But if you are piloting a perfect clone in the outside world, expect the growth rate to be abysmal even if you remain inside the Home. Hermit’s Home grows faster the more you live as a recluse, with its effects compounding the longer you remain that way.

Hermit’s Home can be moved anytime you wish. But moving it will cost you growth rate and size, depending on the severity of the move. Moving a few blocks might undo a couple of weeks of progress. But moving to a different planet could reset years. Hermit’s Home can never go below 50 square meters, and its base growth rate, though.
objects.title: Hermit’s Home

objects.text:
By permanently crippling or killing someone you gain a reserve of energy equivalent to potential change on the world they could have enacted across the rest of their lifespan if you hadn’t done so. You can spend this energy to instantly achieve a change on the world equal to the amount of energy spent. For example, if you killed several thousand able-bodied individuals you could spend a significant portion of that energy and instantly build a city with all infrastructure in place, and you wouldn’t even need to know how to do it yourself.

The measurement used here refers solely to what they could have done personally, rather than the butterfly effect they would have had. Killing the inventor of the steam engine won’t give you the power of the entire Industrial Revolution.
objects.title: Potential Energy

objects.text: Every time you lose something you get an improved version of that thing in return. If you have a power stolen from you then you’ll manifest a stronger, more versatile version of that power good enough to crush the power thief with your old power with ease. Lose an arm and you’ll grow a superior arm that comes with special abilities like built-in weapons and changing shape. If you lose your job you’ll immediately get hired to a better-paying, easier position at a more important company. You have to actually lose something for this to take effect, so intentionally setting it aside with full control won’t do anything, although putting yourself in a situation that causes you to get something taken from you or allowing another to take it is fair game. The effects of this power extend to itself if you lose it.
objects.title: Spend [X] To Make [X]

objects.text:
This power ensures that the user is always improving.

Every action the user performs will be better than their previous attempt. This applies universally to all aspects of the user’s existence, including physical ability, mental capacity, learned skills, supernatural techniques, and methods of thought.

Whenever the user attempts something, whether lifting a weight, solving a problem, refining a skill, or developing a new technique, the result will always be an improvement over their previous effort.

This improvement has no upper limit.

Natural ceilings such as biological constraints, intellectual limits, or theoretical skill caps cannot halt progress. When such limits are reached, further attempts will surpass them, allowing the user to continue improving beyond what would normally be possible.

Over time this enables the development of abilities far beyond conventional boundaries. A swordsman who continuously improves their ability to cut may eventually slice through steel, energy, space, or even abstract phenomena as their technique evolves.

This power guarantees perpetual growth and prevents stagnation. Progress may vary in magnitude, but it will always move forward.

The only requirement is that the user must actively attempt to improve. Improvements occurs through action, practice, and repeated effort.
objects.title: Askesis

objects.text: You now have what appears at face value to be one of the weakest powers in existence, while ultimately having the promise of being one of the strongest. The ability... to be average. You have the ability to select any measurable metric of ability, and make yourself Average at it, such as strength, speed, elemental affinity, and so much more. You can only hold around a dozen metric’s as Average to begin with, gaining the ability to hold an additional one roughly every month. There are three main forms of average you can draw from, the Mean, the Median, and the Mode. To be the Mean Average, is the average achieved by summing up the entire range, and dividing that total by the number of the range. For example: 2, 3, 3, 5, 7, 10, the Mean Average would be (2+3+3+5+7+10)/6 = 5. To be the Median Average, is to arrange the entire range in numerical order, and take the number that is in the middle of the range. For example: 2, 3, 3, 5, 7, 10, the two middle numbers are 3 and 5. The b>Median Average would be (3+5)/2 = 4. To be the Mode Average, is to select the number that occurs most frequently in the range. For example: 2, 3, 3, 5, 7, 10, the Mode Average would be 3. By default, this power will target all sentients within the world you currently exist. Changing worlds/dimensions/realms will change the range that your power is drawing upon, though it will never drop you below the capabilities you would have had without this power. With time and practice, you will find yourself able to exclude categories of beings from the Range your power targets, eventually even to the extent of making something like the Mean Average only include the strongest and weakest in its range. Half the capability of the “best” at something isn’t so bad now... is it?
objects.title: Average One

objects.text:
Most people are born uneven. One gift stands above the rest while everything else lags behind, forcing them into narrow paths where excelling in one thing comes at the cost of everything else. That imbalance no longer applies to you. Your talent, aptitude, and potential do not remain confined to a single domain; they spread, pulling the rest of your abilities upward so that nothing is left behind. This applies not only to your natural traits, but also to any effects or abilities that enhance your talent.

Whenever you possess exceptional talent, aptitude, or potential in any field, that level does not remain isolated. Instead, it establishes a shared baseline across all your current and future abilities. At minimum, in any and all skills, you will have half the talent, aptitude, and potential of your highest. Your capabilities rebalance themselves, taking an average between your strongest and weakest areas in terms of talent, aptitude, and potential, ensuring that no aspect of you falls too far behind while your strengths propagate across the rest of your skillset.

This means that if you possess a heaven-defying level of talent in one field, even areas where you would normally have little to no talent will be raised through this averaging effect to at least half of that level. If another field already has some talent, the difference between them is reduced instead, with the lower being pulled upward to close the gap by half. For example, if your swordsmanship reaches a transcendent level while your aptitude for something like magic or music would otherwise be nonexistent, it will be raised to around half of that level, and if another talent is already high, it will instead be drawn closer by narrowing the gap.
objects.title: Half-Ascended Talent

objects.text:
The age-old question of hard work versus talent has finally found its answer in you. From now on, effort can substitute for talent in anything you pursue, allowing you to compensate for any lack of natural aptitude through sheer hard work. The harder you push yourself and the closer you operate to your limits, the faster you grow. With enough effort, you can rival or surpass even the most talented individuals in any field, regardless of what form that talent would normally take.

Even minimal effort produces extraordinary results. Simply cruising along could take you from an ordinary mage to an archmage capable of leveling mountains or cities within two to three years, while moderate hard work could turn an ordinary scientist into someone capable of developing planet-destroying superweapons or grand unified theories within the same period. Pushing yourself as hard as humanly possible accelerates your growth proportionally, potentially allowing you to become a solar-system-spanning entity capable of extinguishing life on a similar scale within the same time frame.

With sufficient willpower and discipline, you can push beyond your normal limits and enter a flow zone where your growth has no ceiling. In this state, no barrier can permanently halt your progress, and you can even bypass unique prerequisites such as bloodlines or other exotic requirements through effort alone.

Your growth reaches its absolute peak at the edge of insanity, when you work until your body and mind begin to shatter and only sheer spirit keeps you moving. Under these extreme circumstances, your growth becomes truly limitless. You can break through any ceiling or limitation and continue growing as powerful or capable as you desire, though reaching this state is almost impossible and requires a truly exceptional mindset.
objects.title: Hard Work Pays Off

objects.text: A seed of potential is embedded into the core of your soul. This seed can only be awakened by facing a Wall, an existential crisis that pushes you to your absolute limit and threatens to consume you entirely. A situation where all your current capabilities prove insufficient, every avenue of escape is sealed, and the result of failure is the complete breaking of your mind, spirit, or identity rather than simple physical defeat. Most will never encounter a Wall in their lifetime, and of the few who do, most will break before it. To bloom the Seed, you must face a Wall with the Will to Continue. Only by looking at the inevitable, into the infinite abyss, and with nothing but Will alone, refuse it, can the seed bloom and you temporarily awaken your full potential. In this state you become the idealised version of your current self, operating at a level of skill, cognition, and presence that represents the theoretical peak of everything you could possibly be in that moment. This burst of enlightenment fades as the Wall is surmounted. The form your idealised self takes is not fixed but instead emerges from how you respond to the Wall in the instant of blooming, shaped entirely by the nature of the will you exercised to continue. If your will was spiteful and animalistic, your ideal form may manifest as a mad berserker whereas if your will was protective, your ideal may manifest as a guardian, with any skills and abilities you have following suit. The only absolute requirement is that you refused to stop. Your ideal self essentially embodies who you truly are in extremis, and forces you to both accept it and continue with this knowledge. After the bloom fades, a small portion of that potential remains integrated into your being. Your baseline restructures itself and your total potential expanded exponentially beyond what it once was. While you still are far below the idealised self you saw, you are incomparable to what you once were. In many ways you cease to be human, your very humanity warped by the encounter. As the saying goes, “ignorance is bliss” and you have tasted a truth about yourself that can never be forgotten, your very mind rebuilt to forcibly accept your enlightenment. Your natural talent and your rate of learning will surge in directions that align with the path your ideal self revealed, effectively making you a superhuman genius in fields related to your transformation, akin to those giants who form the foundation of humanity itself. In other words, you become a “Genius” who cannot be understood by man, nor understand the struggles of man. This cycle can be triggered as many times as you are able to find Walls, with each successive activation building upon the last, your total potential increasing exponentially with every Wall surpassed, and each new Wall growing proportionally higher as your own capabilities escalate. Fate will conspire to guarantee that, when you are ready, you will face a Wall, with all the challenges that entails. This will only occur once, any Wall you face afterwards will be naturally occurring rather than a guarantee.
objects.title: Blooming Genius

addons.text:
You have come to realize your 7 Chakras are the spiritual version of your 8 Chakra Gates, allowing you to refine your Chakra through them for a startling increase in chakra potency and control. As you slowly open each of your 7 Chakras and refine your Chakra through them, which will drastically increase your Chakra Density while also increasing your Chakra Control to Ōtsutsuki levels.

After refining one Chakra, your Chakra Density and Control can match a Chunin. Refining three Chakras would allow you to match a Jonin, six would let you match a Kage, and finally 7 would push your Chakra Density and Chakra Control to equal an Ōtsutsuki. Note that this does nothing for your total Chakra Pools size. However, as your Chakra Pool increases, these benefits will exponentially multiply to unimaginable levels.

Lastly, for each of the 7 Chakras you refine, you will also discover it to be far easier to open each of the 8 Gates, and the strain they place on you will drastically decrease. With each additional 7 Chakras you refine, the strain of using lower-number Chakra Gates will further decrease. Once you have refined all 7 Chakras, you will gain the ability to open the 8th Gate safely for up to 5 minutes; however, afterwards, you will experience extreme backlash similar to the 7 Gates' normal aftermath. As such, using the 8th Gate now becomes a last-resort trump card instead of sacrificing your life. Should you possess any powers that further strengthen your body or grant extreme levels of regeneration, you may become able to use the 8 Gates, including the Gate of Death, without limits.
addons.title: Seven Channels
Inner Tree of Heaven and Earth
addons.text:
Just as a tree is nourished by the Earth and the Heavens, so too have the Sutras, Three Splendours, and Five Energies nourished the core of your being as they and your Chakras undergo a profound metamorphosis.

All your Chakras have opened, with your Crown Chakra shining as your enlightened being becomes more apparent to all, the spiritual energies that flow through your Chakras have grown in all aspects countless times over, to many, you would seem to be one who has delayed their own liberation to aid those in achieving theirs.

Though not without reason, as your Tranquillity not only soothes nerves but nudges others to continue their spiritual journeys and the awakening of their Chakras, becoming a teacher to others in achieving their own liberation or a turning point for them. Just as it heals the people, it heals the world too as your mere presence wards away all that is malevolent, with even a ruler of Demons wary of merely approaching you.

Your Body Rebirth has achieved new heights, as the various energies of your being allow you to no longer decay or wither, should you leave your physical body behind, it shall remain in pristine condition, and these energies allow you to go without food, water, and sleep.

As your Chakras attain complete Openness, you will be able to manifest items from them, treasures of unequaled value representing the Chakra they emerged from. There is no hard limit on what these treasures can be, with the size of them determining how long they take to manifest, a cooking pot, armour, food, or drink from the Root Chakra can manifest nearly instantly whereas a home could take several minutes depending on the size. Should you gift these treasures, they can help guide others in opening the related Chakra to complete Openness.

objects.text: You have started opening your Chakras, the seven centers of energy within your body. This is a gradual and challenging journey requiring emotional balance for each Chakra. You can move closer to the mental state needed to open each Chakra, but you cannot unlock one further than the one below and preceding it. ​ Independently, your Chakras produce and circulate a basic, faint spiritual energy. Your initial openness puts you just above peak human capacity physically, mentally, and spiritually, while complete openness elevates you to parahuman levels. Each Chakra also grants distinct abilities beyond basic enhancement. ​ However, this ability shines when you have access to some other energy system. You can channel other spiritual energies through your Chakras, refining them to increase their potency, as well as improving techniques within the system that might be connected with a given Chakra. Root Chakra- Located at the tailbone, this Chakra is the foundation of your energies, and therefore is opened by strengthening what could be considered the foundations of your life. Things like your sense of family, community, and home. Opening this Chakra enhances your self-knowledge and improves your resistance to outside forces. ​ Sacral Chakra- Found below the navel, this Chakra is opened by your enthusiasm and enjoyment of all that life has to offer. In opening, you will recover much faster, especially regarding mental traumas and spiritual pains. ​ Solar Plexus Chakra- Situated in the stomach, this Chakra is opened through self-expression and empowerment. It increases and enhances any traits and abilities that are specific to you. The more unique, the more effective the boost would be. Heart Chakra- Despite its name, this Chakra isn’t found directly in the heart; it is instead found in the center of the chest. The heart Chakra is opened by connecting and bonding with people on a direct, personal level. As this Chakra opens, you can begin to both give and take energy from those you are emotionally close to. ​ Throat Chakra- Positioned in the vocal cords. The throat Chakra is opened through creative acts, especially in the form of art. The so-called “quality” of the art is not as important; what does matter is the creative drive behind it. You will find that as you open this Chakra, anything you play a part in creating will be granted an infusion of your Chakra energy, improving its functionality. ​ Third Eye Chakra- Set between the brows, the third eye is opened through the acceptance and embracing of the new, whether that be new circumstances, ideas, or people. As this Chakra opens, your senses expand and improve, now functioning on the mental and spiritual levels. ​ Crown Chakra— Placed at the top of the head, this Chakra stands out from the others. The lower six are at least partially physical, while the Crown Chakra exists purely spiritually. To open it, all previous Chakras must be opened first, and even then, opening the Crown Chakra requires true acceptance of oneself, the universe, and one’s place in it. The rewards are well worth the effort: once fully opened, it greatly amplifies all lower Chakras and enables full release of Chakra energy into the world, granting abilities such as psychokinesis and low-level reality warping.
objects.title: Chakra Opening

addons.text: Your baseline now includes the acquisition of new powers. The amount of time it takes to train in order to retain temporary powers has been cut to one third. Tier 1 Shard powers only need to be acquired to receive a permanent copy. Tier 2 would only need a few weeks, and Tier 3, or any stronger Shardless powers, would only require a few months at most.
addons.title: Quick Study

objects.text:
You are at your lowest, weakest point...and that's a good thing.

As you are now, you will find that your current state is the absolute baseline you can go. Your fitness, strength, overall health and of course powers cannot decline any further, no matter how much time passes, only improving. In fact, any improvements that you make will raise this baseline, making you incapable of becoming any worse than your new normal.

Temporary buffs will now last five times longer, leaving a lingering ability to train yourself up to the level of that buff permanently. The ease of this training scales with how many times you have applied that buff, as well as reducing the duration of negative side effects by a factor of 5, at least. Lose any limbs? Well, that would result in a decrease in functionality, so no you don't! Optionally, you may choose to make it so that any prosthetics you gain are as good as your original limbs. If the prosthetics are better, your other limbs will grow in capability to compensate.

For better or worse, there's nothing to keep you down!
objects.title: Rock Bottom

addons.text:
Instead of personally going back to the beginning, you can now instantly create a sensory that would take your place in the beginning of your history as long as you are restarting your life in some universe you are not currently inhabiting.

Additionally, you can now freely reverse, pause, or speed up the passage of time for any of your sensories.

At any point you can freely transfer yourself into a sensory created through New Game+, with your previous body becoming an awakened sensory.
addons.title: Proxy Life

objects.text:
At will, you can completely restart your life, with your mind and soul returning to the moment of your birth or, if you came to existence in some other way, to the moment of your first appearance in the universe. You maintain all your perks, powers, memories, and skills. Upon returning you can redesign your physical body, changing your sex and appearance if you wish.

However, everything you have achieved in your life before the restart is not meaningless, as fate and circumstances will—should you wish so—align in such a way that in your new life, everything you have achieved, be it financial success, friendships, or anything else, will come to you again with barely any effort on your part. Previous friendships will form anew, and the opportunities to regain your wealth will drop into your lap.

This power functions separately for every universe you have ever visited, including your original one, with restarting life in one universe not affecting any others. This completely separates your personal timeline from the rest of existence, ensuring that not even atemporal beings or gods that command the flow of time itself will notice anything happening nor will be able to prevent it.
objects.title: New Game+

objects.text: You are now a nascent Anathema, a being who is the living embodiment of the rejection of a particular facet of existence itself. Anathema reject their facet so hard they essentially become that thing's antithesis, a being whose mere presence weakens it like kryptonite and who exists solely to slay it. Think a dragon vs a dragon slayer or a parahuman vs an all-or-nothing Null Trump. However, you are special: you have the potential to one day reject not just a facet of existence, but all of existence and even non-existence. By familiarizing yourself with a targeted concept, such as parahumans, dragons, gods, eldritch horrors, or even planets, you begin to slowly resonate with all that hates and rejects that concept. Everything ever harmed by it, everything killed by it, everything that ever cursed its mere existence, whether they were a person wronged by it, a thing crushed by it, a place abandoned by it, something supplanted by it, all that and more. Eventually this resonance hits a peak and suddenly, you are its Anathema. Being the Anathema of something allows you to manifest a number of effects. The first is the ability to sense the presence of that which you are the antithesis of from a distance. You always know when you are looking at your antithesis, and which it is if you have multiple, such as knowing you are looking at a human and a mage but not a dragon or a fae, and can sense the rough distance and direction of any within a hundred meters of you to start. The second is the ability to weaken your antithesis in a number of ways. Just by being near it, you fill it with a sense of fear, as if an apex predator were standing over it, and it begins to weaken on a conceptual level. Enough time in your presence could reduce even a god to the level of a scared and defenseless toddler. This effect is amplified and accelerated by any and every attack that hits it; every punch, spell, verbal assault, and more tearing your target down faster and more brutally. The third effect is the most potent of them all, the complete rejection of their existence on a fundamental level. As you attack them, not only are they weakened, but they are also rejected bit by bit. Their spells are torn apart and nullified, their connections to any domains begin to decay, their very presence in the world is slowly chipped away, even their very soul begins to buckle and fade. Eventually, nothing is left but a corpse no one can quite remember the name of, and if you have powers which allow you to target beings on a spiritual or other esoteric levels, you can continue your assault until not even that remains, just a person or other being shaped hole in peoples memories. These effects are proportional to how familiar you are to your antithesis, with no real upper limit to how powerful they may become, potentially developing even more specialized and unique applications of your Anathema nature to counter them, such as firing off waves of anti-magic to shatter a mage's spells from a distance. Ways to familiarize yourself with a target include but are not limited to; studying known information about it, observing its behavior or nature in person, combatting it in some form such as by hunting a dragon or those who wield powers within its domain, finding your own personal reasons to hate it, and even more methods still unnamed. You can fully control your Anathema nature, such that you could be at the point where even dragon gods are permanently crippled just by your mere passing and yet your Dragon Friend is left completely unharmed. This also means you can become Anathema to concepts that would normally be a really bad idea to be the antithesis of, such as humans or beings born of the earth, without putting yourself at risk of spontaneous soul death or something. You start out being the Anathema of one thing, with a baseline familiarity such that you could slay a peer opponent embodying that concept in less than thirty seconds without being scratched, and could slay one which is an order of magnitude stronger than you with some effort. Eventually however, you will get to the point of being a true Anathema of All, a being who can destroy worlds and universes just by standing within them, but that is a journey that will take many centuries to reach the conclusion of.
objects.title: Anathema: That Which Rejects All

objects.text:
You’re only as good as your word, quite literally. 

At any time you can compile a short ritual to focus yourself onto a set of rules, or perhaps a code of conduct. Having and keeping to this code will serve to enhance yourself, making you stronger, faster, more perceptive and enhancing any extranormal abilities you possess. 

However, this enhancement scales in strength to how restrictive and active it is. A restrictive code while Hunting would give major benefits during the activity, while a less restrictive code that is constantly active (such as a no-kill rule) would give minor benefits constantly. An incredibly restrictive code that always must be adhered to would give major benefits likewise.

Should you break this code however, you would need to either construct a new one that is meaningfully different from it, or undergo a major trial in order to become ‘worthy’ of it again. Similarly you can only have one ‘code’ at a time, though performing a ritual to change your code of conduct does not count as ‘breaking’ it.
objects.title: Keeping the Code
