objects.text: “The meaning of life is that it stops.” They may rail against it, powerful mutations, demonic contracts, incomprehensible magics, whatever tricks they try to prolong it, whatever lies they tell to themselves and others, you are inevitable. You are relentless, unassailable, unpredictable, unavoidable, you are The Snail. As the bane of immortals everywhere, you’ve gained a host of abilities that grow exponentially more powerful the more resistant your target is to death, nonetheless even without targets, your abilities are formidable. Your first ability is Sense. What this power does is it allows you to mentally assign a target or particular characteristics, such as an individual or a particular category, such as immortals. This will immediately make you subconsciously aware of where your target is and their distance to you. The longer you are tracking someone, the more and more info your subconscious will provide you about your target, at first it won’t be more than their location, but given a few hours, your mind will start to fill in their current actions, given a few days and you’ll get a deeper sense of their emotions and start to get a glimpse into their past and their motivations, a week, and even their thoughts will become clear to you, and in a month, their deepest thoughts and fears, their abilities, their strengths and weaknesses, their innermost and subconscious faculties, all of it will be laid bare to you. You’ll subconsciously understand them on a level greater than they know themselves, greater than you know yourself, able to inuit their actions and before they can even think about making them. The greater the amount of interactions you have with them, the faster this power progresses. The above examples are for individuals, when spread out to a larger group the ability is spread out, but it is more concentrated on those you’ve had greater interaction with. You may only have one target active at a time, but can change at any time, and your progress for the Sense is retained and will pick up where you left off when reassigning the same target. The second ability is Entanglement. This ensures that you will inevitably run into your target. This can be done passively, making no attempt at finding your target will inevitably find you running into them within a year through more mundane means, actively seeking them out will ensure that timeline cuts down to a week. Moreover, the longer you have them as your target, the faster, and more esoteric your means of encountering them get. An active search for your target can have you encountering entirely randomly occurring spacetime crinkles that result in portals that will take you directly towards your target within a month, a few months of this and you’ll be able to ensure that you can and will encounter them within moments of when you seek them out. Whether it needs to force fate, casualty, space-time, or pure sheer luck to bend over backwards so far that it breaks to ensure it, it’ll happen. You can turn this off or dial it down, but your progress will be retained so you can take a break and then pick up the hunt again at the same point you left it at. This also applies for when you swap between targets. The third ability is Permanence. This allows you to enforce a form permanence on anything you do or effect. This means that injuries you impart on others cannot heal, activate someone’s paranoia and they’ll remain in a state of perpetual state of heightened paranoia, kill someone who could normally resurrect and they’ll remain dead forever, etc. The fourth ability is Bypass. This will allow you to slowly bypass protections, securities, and other forms of defenses a target has the longer you’re hunting them. If a target has an ability that turns them intangible for example, you’d be able to grasp them as if they were as solid as anyone else. The time this ability takes to take root is dependent on how powerful and esoteric their defenses are as well as how long you’ve been hunting them, but regardless of defenses within a month of actively hunting your target you’ll be able to bypass any and all defenses a target may have in place. The fifth ability is Antithesis. What this ability does is it slowly creates and grows abilities that are aligned opposite to your enemies, or otherwise specialized to allow you to hunt them, based on a targeted metric that you can determine when selecting your target. This will also mutate abilities that you already possess to be more effective against your targets. The closer and more absolute your target is to your targeted metric, the faster and more absolute your abilities will grow. Moreover, the more absolute your target is to the targeted metric, the closer you yourself can replicate. Using the above example, as long as your target is immortal, you will be as immortal. These abilities disappear as soon as you swap targets, but progress is retained for when you target them again. The sixth ability is Bane. What this ability does is that it will slowly grow your own ability the more aligned your target is with your targeted metric. The more powerful and advanced their ability is, the more powerful your enhancement is, the faster your other abilities take hold, the faster you adapt to them. For example, by targeting immortals, a low level regenerator may result in a small boost, an absolute immortal that recovers from anything would see your power skyrocket into the stratosphere. This boost goes away as soon as you swap targets, progress is retained when you target them again. This particular ability works concurrently with Antithesis to make you your target's worst enemy. The final ability is Victor’s Reward. By killing your target, the benefits of Antithesis and Bane become permanent, allowing you to develop a litany of abilities and powers over time.
objects.title: The Snail

addons.title: Ingrained Effects
addons.text:
Now, on top of training any temporary or summoned powers up into being permanent additions, you can now incorporate the full breadth of temporary effects using this power: Training retained boosts held in your reserve slowly decreases the amount of capacity they take, with slight diminishing returns but still capable of reaching 0% in a reasonable timeframe.

Once a boost reaches a negligible fraction such as 5-10% of its original capacity, it also stops taking up a dedicated slot, allowing you to fill the empty space all over again.

addons.title: Permanency³
addons.text: ...Okay, NOW this is absolutely unfair. Thanks to this synergy, your sheer capacity to Lock effects is tripled in all areas - from five to fifteen individual effects, triple the maximum total power, and three times your rate of growth in the former two. If you possess both Permanent Effect and Infinity, then this boost is stacked multiplicatively to nine times total.

addons.title: Consume-mate Boost
addons.text: Now, anything that comes from "consumable" outside sources - alchemical and magical potions, Tinkertech and super-science drugs, and so on - puts far less strain on your power than usual: Despite being enhanced by S.E.D., they only take up the "normal" amount of capacity they would before the multiplier is applied.

objects.text: You now have the ability to take any temporary enhancements placed on you and "Lock" them in, making them permanent until you let them go, and removing their energy or material requirements. This can run the whole range of definitions for "temporary" - from needing a resource such as mana, stamina or some kind of external substance to keep active, having a strict time limit, or just needing particular conditions to activate. The power does not differentiate between buffs you place upon yourself and ones granted from outside sources: Brief blessing from a Patron and empowerment Trump effects from Parahumans qualify just as well as magic spells or spiritual techniques you place on yourself. It can even include more mundane enhancements as well, such as modern or near-future medicines and performance enhancers. Any flaws or downsides to the enhancements that aren't tied to their temporary are also retained, however, and any enhancements you can freely toggle on or off such as many Breaker states naturally can't be Locked. You have an approximate limit of five 'individual' effects, and five times the strength of your own strongest boost; for example, an enhancement spell that uses your entire reserve in one go for a brief surge, or a super-form that drains your vitality within minutes. Attempting to grab an enhancement larger than you can handle would see the whole of your free capacity filling up with as much of the power-up it could grab, possibly up to your full limit if you were willing to discard other boosts. You can train up the number of effects you can Lock by actively using them in various situations, starting at months to develop a new slot and gradually scaling up; your limit on raw strength of buffs scales with your other powers. If you somehow lack any powers other than this, than your starting power cap is equivalent to this power's cost, and increasing said cap is also converted to just active use and training.
objects.title: Boost-Lock

objects.text:
You have the ability to change part of the consequences of your past decisions. This applies to any skill or ability that can be developed and to any other powers that offer different development paths, such as "Twin Hands of Power" or "Character Sheet (D&D/Pathfinder)" - for example, changing a D&D class, or after choosing waterbending and training it in a combat style, changing it so that it's as if all that time was spent on healing instead.

To activate it, you enter a meditation that lasts for a specific duration: one hour for the first year of that power's development, another hour for two years, another for four, and so on (exponential doubling). In case of premature exit from the ritual, no effect occurs - you simply return to your original state.  

There is also a second, more dangerous method, which reduces the waiting time from an hour to a minute. However, it is far less forgiving of interruption: if the ritual is interrupted, your power will become stuck at a level corresponding to the time elapsed, recovering to maximum at a rate of one week per each missed minute.  

Upon successful completion of the ritual, you permanently receive a new choice, on which the same amount of time and resources have been spent as on the previous one - as if you had always developed along this new path.

This ability can be used not just on CYOA-granted powers, but also on other learned techniques or abilities - only within the limits you could have influenced.
objects.title: Re-Build

objects.text:
Your love of card games has elevated you beyond a regular card game enjoyer; you are something far more than that. Now, in your mind, you can pick a single card game as your initial focus to gain cards and build a [Deck] of around [30] cards; however, that is only the minimum for a complete deck; a deck can hold more cards.

You can open [Booster Packs] once a day, each containing around [14] cards. However, you can gain more Booster Packs, such as by doing something of renown and being rewarded with additional packs depending on the deed.

Once you have acquired enough cards to complete a deck, such as the 30-card minimum, you can either switch to a new card game or continue getting additional cards from your initial choice.

Depending on what card game you pick, various cards can be granted; they will all follow typical styles, such as giving monster or creature cards, spells, traps, legendary creatures, artefacts, locations, and many others; that is not to say that that is all that can be gained, as cards may vary depending on the game chosen initially.

Cards will also have additional powers; for example, beyond being summoned and allowing you to have, for example, a high-level wizard, cards will typically have some effect when summoned or when something triggers the card effects, such as letting you draw more cards of a certain type or destroying one of your enemies.

You can pick a wide selection of card games; although some may start stronger, they will require more difficult tasks to acquire additional booster packs beyond the daily booster pack.
objects.title: Card Game Player

objects.text:
All your abilities increase over time, but with diminishing speed - in the first second, the increase is 100%, and each next identical increase requires one second more. A x2 multiplier takes 2 seconds to reach x3, and x3 takes 3 seconds to reach x4, and so on.

However, growth only occurs while you move below a certain threshold: a twofold increase requires movement at half your speed limit, a threefold increase - at a third, and so on. If this condition is violated, the enhancement instantly resets to a state that allows this. So, even if you've reached a x3 multiplier, moving faster than a third of your maximum possible speed will instantly drop you back to x2 - and you'll lose the enhancement entirely if you move faster than half of the maximum.

This power comes with capacity to disable involuntary movements and to move no faster than the necessary threshold.
objects.title: Rooting In

objects.text:
The range of all your abilities increases over time, but the rate is not constant. In the first second, the increase to x2 multiplier, growth from an x2 to x3 takes two seconds, from x3 to x4 — three seconds, and so on.

However, growth only occurs while you move below a certain threshold: an x2 increase requires movement at half your maximum speed, x3 at a third, and so on. If this condition is violated, the enhancement instantly resets to a state that allows this. That is, even if you have reached an x3 multiplier, but you move faster than a third of your possible maximum, you instantly return to an x2 multiplier - and if you move faster than half of the possible maximum, you lose the enhancement entirely.

If an ability's base range is under 10 meters, it becomes 10 meters while enhanced. For example, if there is telekinesis with a range of 11 meters and pyrokinesis with a range of 5, then at an x5 multiplier the range of telekinesis becomes 55 meters, and that of pyrokinesis becomes 50, since its base range becomes 10, after which it is multiplied.

Abilities like sight, hearing, and other senses, plus moving objects by hand, count as touch-range abilities, which allows you to project your senses and effects to a distance depending on your current enhancement. Also this power comes with the skill to disable involuntary movements and the ability to move no faster than the required threshold.
objects.title: Spreading Out

addons.title: And this is to go even further beyond!
addons.text: When unlocking a new form through This isn't even my final form, rather than making you generally more powerful than usual, you can instead declare a central power to focus it around. You can have as many of these ‘specific’ forms as you can conceptualise from the powers you have access to, though they do not scale as linearly powerful as your central ‘general’ line, making your transformations more like a tree than a linear progression. This means if you could develop ‘specific’ forms off of other forms to hone in or narrower and narrower aspects. For instance, if you had access to a precognitive power, you could make that a ‘branch’ form that only improves that power massively but leaves your other abilities and attributes as they were, letting you innately dodge and predict movements before even the opponent had thought of them.

objects.text:
You gain the ability to use a series of immensely powerful transformed states of your own design, which greatly increase your power, with the first one giving a 2x boost to all your powers and physical stats, and the others after that offering a 2x boost to the previous form, offering an exponential increase to your power with drawbacks. These transformations could take a myriad of themes and appearances; maybe you want to look more animalistic or more regal, have a more monstrous theme, etc. You can choose and design each form, as long as it follows your transformation's theme.

Note that each form drains your supernatural energy reserves (if applicable) and stamina, and each additional transformation further increases the drains exponentially. Should you not be careful, this drain can do anything from temporarily weaken you, injure you, or possibly even kill you if pushed recklessly past safe limits. You can rectify such limitations and dangers through training, possibly even making it so that a transformation consumes effectively zero supernatural energy and stamina, though this will take great effort and time, with the amount increasing for each level of transformation. In addition, you can increase the multiplier for each of your transformations with training and use along with strong emotions, though with semi-diminishing returns without extreme effort.

You start with your first form and can unlock more in the future through training or a sudden boost of extreme emotion such as rage.
objects.title: This Isn't Even My Final Form?
Debuff Stacking
objects.text:
You can convert abnormal status effects and self-inflicted suffering into combat power. Poison, burns, curses, hallucinations, and other debuffs increase your attack power, physical attributes, magical potency, and ability to survive otherwise fatal attacks, including those resulting from your own actions.

The greater the afflictions the greater the bonuses. These effects also stack, provided they are distinct. Poisoning yourself twice, for example, won't grant additional benefits unless the poisons are notably different, such as a neurotoxin and an anticoagulant.

You must acquire the means to inflict these conditions yourself. This power does not grant you any power or magic that will automatically poison, burn, or curse you, nor does it inherently protect you from their effects.

This power is nearly suicidal for anyone without some form of regeneration, healing, or resistance. Furthermore, possessing an immunity to a particular affliction, such as poison, will greatly weaken the benefits you can derive from it.

This is the ultimate high-risk, high-reward build, turning debilitating debuffs into peerless buffs.

addons.title: Wizard Level 1
addons.text:
You will essentially start as a level one Wizard, boosting the rate at which you can learn new spells with Arcane Magic (D&D/Pathfinder) as you further level yourself with Character Sheet, which is much easier now that you possess magic.

This also gives you a boost in unlocking class features, as you can now gain them from levelling up. However, you still have access to the ability to learn them naturally. Character Sheet (D&D/Pathfinder) makes it go faster. You aren't locked into just getting the class features of your archetype due to Arcane Magic (D&D/Pathfinder) letting you take features that aren't from your specific Arcane Tradition. Still, you will gain a massive discount on any features in your Arcane Traditions.

addons.title: Bard Level 1
addons.text:
You will essentially start as a level one Bard, boosting the rate at which you can learn new spells with Bardic Magic (D&D/Pathfinder) as you further level yourself with Character Sheet, which is much easier now that you possess magic.

This also gives you a boost in unlocking class features, as you can now gain them from levelling up. However, you still have access to the ability to learn them naturally. Character Sheet (D&D/Pathfinder) makes it go faster. You aren't locked into just getting the class features of your archetype; Bardic Magic (D&D/Pathfinder) lets you take features that are not from your specific archetype. Still, you will gain a massive discount on any features in your archetype.

objects.text: You now have a Character Sheet from any version of Dungeons and Dragons or Pathfinder. This character sheet allows you to level up through both XP and Milestones. You start off without access to any classes, in order to unlock classes you will need to either put enough XP into the class or achieve a feat worthy enough to unlock the class best fit. Feats can both be earned naturally and selected upon levels up like normal. Your initial stat array will be representative of who you are.
objects.title: Character Sheet (D&D/Pathfinder)

objects.text:
You are the bearer of the 666 Evil Eyes, granting supernatural abilities to one of your eyes. The default eye, known as The Blankest Eye of The Great King of Normalcy, allows you to see all things supernatural, pierce illusions, and see through obstacles. Each of the 666 Evil Eyes has a unique name, changing the appearance of your eyes and providing specific powers related to its name.

Using an Evil Eye other than the default requires effort and cannot be maintained constantly. With practice, you can extend its usage, but you need to return to the default form to rest your eye. These abilities are not fixed; they can grow and change with training and effort, becoming more potent and versatile without limits. Even new Evil Eyes not among the 666 can appear over time.

To use a specific Evil Eye, you must first attune to it by using it. The more you use it, the stronger the connection becomes, increasing its chances of appearing again during selection until you can use it at will. You also start fully attuned to two randomly selected additional Evil Eyes.

Among the 666 Evil Eyes, 99 are classified as Supreme Evil Eyes, appearing during extreme emotional stress or near-death experiences. These Eyes are incredibly powerful and can cause world-altering events when unleashed. Using them initially enters you into an unconscious berserker state, and their powers become unpredictable. Learning to control a Supreme Evil Eye's abilities is challenging but possible with great mental discipline and training.

The power of the Evil Eyes is not tied to the physical form of your eye. If lost, the power transfers to your remaining eye or another body part until the lost eyes are replaced. You can grant copies of fully attuned Evil Eyes to others, instilling loyalty and providing them with similar, albeit weaker, powers initially. You can remove copies of Evil Eyes you've granted at any time.
objects.title: 666 Evil Eyes (Essence Meta)

addons.text: The primal Tatau has merged with your Brand and Bond, enhancing it on a conceptual basis. Now, as your tatau becomes more intricate to enhance itself, you can have the Bond do the same, allowing you to guide the paths that its branches of power take, actively pressing them to your desired paths.
addons.title: Trimming Branches

objects.text:
Inscribed into your very flesh is the wondrous Primal Tatau, a tattoo of ancient origin that evolves and flourishes with the passage of time. Each symbol and mark etched upon your skin serves as a conduit, enhancing your physical and mental prowess. As the Tatau grows more intricate, so too do your abilities, reaching heights previously unattainable.

The Primal Tatau not only grants you increased strength, speed, and perception, but also bestows upon you a unique skill rooted in the primal aspects of nature. These skills could be gaining the instinctual knowledge of the landscape, the ability to commune with animals, or even entering into a trance where time seems to slow down and you instantly knows the weakness of the enemy you face.
objects.title: Primal Tattoo (Far Cry 3)

addons.text:
You have taken the power of the Mark into yourself, shedding mortality to become a being of the Void, kin to the Outsider. Your powers are not drawn from the Outsider but from your own connection to the void, bestowing greater power, versatility, and freedom of use, no longer restricted to the structured confines of specific abilities and free to shape the power of the Void as you wish.

However, you are not yet on par with the Outsider, God of the Void that he is. However, through the passage of time or the absorption of souls you can climb your way to become his equal. Alternatively, should you find a Void without a God you can assume that role, at the cost of becoming the Lynchpin of said Void, unable to leave it.

Lastly, like the Outsider you can Mark others, branding your name in an ancient tongue onto a part of their body to bestow a connection to the Void upon them.
addons.title: Child of the Void

objects.text:
You have been chosen by the mysterious entity known as the Outsider, who has granted you a tattoo on one of your hands. This mark is a conduit for the power of the Void, a dark and chaotic dimension that lies beyond reality. Through the mark, you can enhance your physiology, improve your powers, and manifest specific abilities that defy the laws of nature. 

At the start, you will have three random weak abilities that you can use by spending mana, a limited resource that regenerates slowly over time. These abilities may include:

Blink: A short-range teleportation that allows you to move instantly from one point to another.
Dark Vision: A night vision that enhances your perception in low-light conditions and reveals living beings through walls.
Devouring Swarm: A summoning ability that calls forth a swarm of rats that will attack your enemies and devour their corpses.

Over time, or through absorbing the souls of the living and feeding them to your mark, you will become much stronger, gaining more mana and unlocking new abilities or upgrading existing ones. Some of the more advanced abilities are:

Bend Time: A temporal manipulation ability that allows you to slow down or stop time for everyone except yourself. 
Possession: A mind control ability that allows you to take over the body of an animal or a human for a limited duration, using their senses and abilities as your own.
Shadow Kill: An ability that causes your enemies to turn into ash when they die, leaving no trace of their existence.
In addition to these supernatural powers, you also have an incredible innate talent for fighting, sneaking, and assassination. You can wield various weapons and gadgets with ease, such as swords, crossbows, pistols, grenades, mines, etc. You can also use the environment to your advantage, such as hiding in shadows, climbing on rooftops, or using traps and distractions. You are a master of stealth and combat, capable of taking down your targets with lethal or non-lethal methods.
objects.title: Mark of The Outsider (Dishonored)

addons.text:
By choosing Shadow Slave as your setting, you won't be granted shortcuts like being able to challenge the Second Nightmare at your leisure or immediately skipping to Awakened rank as soon as you conquer the First Nightmare. No, you will be progressing like everyone else in Shadow Slave. Once the First Nightmare is conquered, you will become a Sleeper, with everything mentioned unlocked. However, when the winter solstice arrives, you will be transported to the dream realm where you must fight to return to the real world and become an Awakened.

You will travel to the Forgotten Shore if you are transported to the dream realm at the same time as Sunny. Once awakened, you will need to find the nightmare seeds yourself to ascend further. Failure in conquering the Nightmares will result in death.
addons.title: Playing fair like the rest of us

addons.text: Now, instead of the Worst Day Ever drawback triggering on the first day, it will trigger on your Nightmare instead. If combined with Playing fair like the rest of us, you'll be placed in a historical situation where you'll inevitably encounter them. Be careful when choosing, as with Worthy Opponent, Nightmare Spell can send you into the War of Fate.
addons.title: The Midnight Hour

addons.text:
Normally, to gain powers you would need to undergo a traumatic event if your power source is a Shard, or experience a moment of great need similar to an origin story if you chose Shardless.

Regardless of your choice, if you still have not gained your powers, the Nightmare Spell will call to you on the next Winter Solstice. You will become fatigued and increasingly drowsy as it compels you to close your eyes and succumb to the Trial.

Within the Trial, you will encounter scenarios, environments, and challenges connected to the abilities you have chosen. If your powers share a theme, the Trial will incorporate and reflect that theme in its design. Tech-focused builds will encounter more technological elements, Thinker or mental builds will face more complex and frequent puzzles, and so on. Potential enemies and obstacles will also be influenced by the nature of your selected powers.

The Nightmare itself has evolved. While the first Nightmare remains unique to you, its difficulty now scales with your total SP as well as the powers you have acquired. For every 25 SP beyond the initial 10 SP required to purchase the Nightmare Spell, the overall difficulty of the Trial doubles.

However, there is still a reward for enduring the ordeal. During the Trial, you will have opportunities to obtain Memories and Echoes that synergize strongly with the abilities granted by the Spell and your other powers. Upon completion, you are guaranteed to receive at least one Memory that pairs well with your strongest power, and its Rank will match the Rank you achieve at the end of the Trial.

Do not beg for mercy. The Nightmare Spell has none to give.
addons.title: The Nightmare Calls

objects.text: Upon selecting this path, you will be granted the opportunity to transcend human limits and ascend toward greater heights through the trials of the Spell. With this choice comes infection. The Spell will take root in you, and before long, you will be drawn into an irresistible slumber. Within that sleep, you will face your first Nightmare: a trial crafted uniquely for you. Your task will be to overcome it. Should you succeed, the Spell will evaluate your performance and assign a score based on how well you overcame the challenge. This score determines the Rank of your Aspect and the quality of the gifts you receive. With this, you will awaken your soul sea, form a soul core, claim your Aspect, and unlock the Spell's powers: Echoes and Memories. Failure is not the end—you may attempt the trial again, but each retry will lower your final evaluation. After completing the trial, you will gain the freedom to choose your Aspect, Aspect Ability, Innate Ability, Aspect Legacy, and Flaw. The potency of these choices will scale directly with your score. However, power never comes free: the stronger your chosen abilities, the harsher the Flaw you must bear in return. A True Name will also be bestowed upon you, one woven from the threads of your character, origin, and destiny. Alternatively, you may choose your Flaw yourself from the available drawbacks—but by doing so, it will become one of your defining traits, deepening its impact upon you and making it permanent. With each Nightmare conquered, your strength will grow. New potential will awaken. Yet your trials will not grow easier. Each challenge ahead will scale in kind, evolving to match your newfound might. Victory will never come without struggle. Aspect: A fusion of your affinities and specialization. For example, if your specialization is combat and your affinity is shadows, your Aspect would reflect a combination of the two, manifesting, perhaps, as an Assassin-type of Aspect, etc. The resulting Aspect is always unique, shaped by the synergy between your essence and your chosen path. Memories: These are items intrinsically tied to your soul, capable of being manifested or dismissed at will. They may be created or granted through the act of slaying opponents and take many forms—clothing, weapons, armor, charms, and more. Each Memory is more than just a tool; it carries traces of what you've defeated, often bearing abilities or traits linked to the fallen. Echoes: Though rare, Echoes may also be claimed by slaying worthy foes, whether monster or man. Unlike Memories, they are not items but beings—replicas of what you've killed, shaped in the image they held before death. Echoes have no soul, yet they may exhibit limited autonomy. Like Memories, they can be summoned and dismissed at will.
objects.title: The Nightmare Spell (Shadow Slave)

objects.text: A unique Skill granted to those who served as turning points in humanity's history. It bestows the ability to transform what's deemed "impossible" into a possibility—"events that can be realized." Strictly speaking, this power does not directly produce results on its own. But rather, lets you break through the perceived limits of whatever you set your focus on, enabling you to glimpse a future where the impossible becomes attainable. Even conceptual impossibility isn't exempt; as the Skill opens a path for you to escape inevitability itself, creating a chance—however slim—for success in any endeavor, so long as you have the will and put in the effort to pursue it. With enough dedication, this Skill allows for feats such as attaining immense magical prowess despite having access to limited magical energy, or bringing knowledge that should lie far outside the reaches of humanity down to a level anyone can understand, etc.
objects.title: Pioneer of the Stars (Type-Moon)

addons.text:
You are now more than just a slayer of Mysteries—you have become a guiding light of innovation, discovery, exploration, and progress. With the acquisition of the Star attribute, all facets of your power have been enhanced, transforming you into a "North Star" for others to look up to, drawing inspiration, motivation, and insight from your presence.

As the embodiment of excellence, those who strive to follow in your footsteps and emulate you as their idol will find themselves unusually inspired. They'll absorb information more quickly, think more abstractly, and gain clarity in their actions as if your very existence accelerates their intellectual and personal growth.

Not only does your presence reinforce the Human Order, but it also helps others to digest and assimilate once-incomprehensible Mysteries, expanding humanity's understanding of the unknown. You now serve as both protector and beacon, guiding others to grasp what was once beyond reach.
addons.title: Eternal Light of Civilization

addons.text: You are no longer a mere slayer but have ascended into something far grander—a brilliant thinker of great rapport and a refined gentleman of many talents. With each Mystery you defeat, you gain the unique ability to appropriate some of their strengths, learning to harness their abilities for your own purposes. Over time, as you defeat multiple Mysteries of the same type, your understanding of them shall deepen, enabling you to unlock peerless insights into their nature. Eventually, you may even bring down Mysteries once associated with the gods and entities of the same realm or nature to humanity's level, demystifying them and revealing their inner workings. In doing so, you will not only expand your achievements but also grant humanity unparalleled knowledge of the cosmos and heavens, transforming the unknown into accessible knowledge. Moreover, this new aspect will mitigate the risk of stagnation inherent in your ability, effectively allowing you to curate what grand wisdom humanity may attain. As a consequence of this new acquisition, you will also find yourself acting much more gentlemanly in everything you do, with such supreme grace and elegance as to mesmerize all who witness you.
addons.title: The Extraordinary Gentleman

objects.text: Yours is the power to cancel or destroy any manifestation of Mystery, erasing its supernatural expression, allowing you to counter and confront the metaphysical in whatever form it may appear; for this reason, you are a slayer of myths, an ender of fantasy, a killer of phantasms, and a revealer of mysteries. Though others throughout history have wielded similar abilities, none have your potential. You are not merely another hunter of mysteries but destined to become The Slayer of Mystery—once you have amassed enough power. The essence of your power lies in its ability to kill or eliminate Mysteries—entities or phenomena that transcend current human understanding. This grants you the unique capacity to "slay" Mysteries of any kind, whether they stem from alien science, supernatural magic, or any force beyond the established scope of the Human Order. As long as it exists outside the bounds of human comprehension, it can be neutralized by your power. At first, your strength is humble, barely registering as E-rank by most standards, granting only a minor conceptual edge in combating Mystery, subtly enhancing everything you do, whether offensive or defensive. Yet, even this minuscule amount of power allows an ordinary human to contend against the supernatural forces of the moonlit world, secret societies, and magical realms—provided they are well-prepared and use their abilities strategically. Additionally, this power synergizes seamlessly with abilities that drive innovation and expand humanity's collective knowledge. As the mysteries of the supernatural are unraveled and cataloged, your strength will naturally grow, feeding off humanity's increasing understanding and advancement. The more you unveil, the stronger you become—dismantling and countering the very essence of Mystery itself. For what better weapon is there against the darkness of Mystery than the light of discovery and understanding? Gradually, as you test your mettle against the supernatural, through whatever form it may take, growing stronger with each small victory. Eventually, you'll outgrow the scale altogether, being able to solidify the Human Order in an area with your mere presence at EX-Rank. This power, by its very nature, can lead to stagnation, as you may inadvertently destroy Mysteries faster than they can be assimilated and understood by the Human Order. In doing so, you disrupt the natural evolution of discovery and growth, risking humanity's progress and limiting its potential to explore and comprehend the unknown.
objects.title: Mystery Slayer (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
Imperial Privilege, also known as Emperor’s Prerogative, is an ability that allows the user to manifest and temporarily possess abilities, skills, or powers they would not normally have through sheer belief, will, and insistence. You begin with a C Rank in this skill, meaning you can manifest only one ability at a time. Innate or biological abilities are restricted in lower ranks until EX Rank, and the potency of abilities or skills is determined by the Rank of this skill.

At C Rank, you may manifest practical abilities such as Swordsmanship, the Arts, Charisma, and similar abilities. These abilities must be concrete and non-abstract, and they cannot be supernatural in nature.

At A Rank, your abilities reach supernatural levels, you can manifest almost any ability, and you can also manifest a handful of them at the same time. If you manifest Swordsmanship, for instance, you surpass the level of an expert or master, entering realms beyond normal human capability. At this level, it is also possible to manifest and use various magic at an expert level.

It is only at EX Rank that the skill reaches its full potential. At this level, abilities you manifest the most may become permanent with repeated use. You can still manifest only a handful at the same time. You may now also manifest abstract or conceptual abilities. It is possible to manifest a Divine Body, granting you demi-god like strength, enough to destroy cities with ease or withstand the impact of large-scale explosions. Or, you could manifest Sagacious Wisdom, endowing you with piercing intellect and insight that surpasses even the most brilliant human minds. 

Of course, leveling up Imperial Privilege is difficult, reaching EX Rank even more so. It requires time, experience, and the right mindset. Without the proper bearing befitting the ideal Emperor you envision, progress will be slow. But if you do embody such qualities, then reaching EX Rank within a few years is not out of reach.

Finally, remember that this skill is fueled by willpower, belief, and insistence. The stronger your conviction, the more powerful the abilities you can manifest, even those that exceed your current Rank. Even at EX Rank.
objects.title: Imperial Privilege (Type-Moon)

addons.title: A Fool’s Smile in the Jaws of Death
addons.text:
Your decline and impending death are no longer separate. Each now amplifies the other.

This Skill is the superior evolution of Epiphany in the Jaws of Death, greatly enhancing every aspect of the original. As before, the more hopeless your situation becomes and the closer you are to certain death, the stronger its effects become. The difference is that this ability has now reached the realm of an EX-Rank Skill.

The conditions of I Smile As I Crush My Own Heart also expand beyond mental deterioration. Any form of decline, whether physical, spiritual, magical, or otherwise, strengthens this Skill. The more extreme and broken your overall condition becomes, the greater your talent, adaptability, instincts, and capacity for growth become.

As your decline and desperation reach their extremes, they continuously compound, allowing you to achieve supernatural feats of intellect and body. You may devise seemingly impossible solutions, such as effectively being in two places at once through on-the-fly planning, or in your final moments, setting events into motion that only bear fruit decades after your death.

Because of this, you become naturally talented at Xanatos Gambits, particularly the Speed Chess variety, capable of constructing intricate plans in an instant and adapting them just as quickly as circumstances change. Like before, this does not guarantee victory; it merely makes it more likely.

At EX Rank, this Skill represents the ultimate contradiction: a fool who smiles not because they cannot comprehend death, but because they have already found a path beyond it.

objects.text:
There is no one more dangerous than someone with nowhere left to run.
The worse your situation becomes, the stronger this ability grows. When exhausted, wounded, and out of options, you are at your most dangerous.

Your Skill is currently at C Rank. Through repeated survival against certain death, you can develop the skill further, eventually surpassing Jason and his A Rank version of the skill.

If you manage to get the Skill to EX rank, it might as well be considered something equal to a form of Precognition or Probability Manipulation. Despite how others might see you, it is neither, let alone their equals, at its current Rank.

This skill makes it so when you're faced with genuine, unavoidable mortal danger, your mind and body enter a state of extreme clarity. Your ability to analyze, improvise, and formulate strategies sharply increases, while you instinctively draw out your body's full potential.

A killing blow becomes one you roll with at the last instant, landing on the softest patch of grass. A fatal stab becomes a survivable wound because your leg refused to move at the last second. Instinctively, your body makes the best possible use of itself, your surroundings, and any opportunity.

The closer you are to certain death, the stronger this Skill's effects become. It is at its strongest when defeat appears inevitable, allowing you to identify opportunities, resources, and desperate gambits others would never notice.

Every realization is based solely on information you possess or could reasonably infer, consciously or unconsciously, throughout your entire life to the events leading up to your current situation. Every action remains within your physical capabilities, though pushing yourself to those limits or performing the optimal action may further worsen your condition.

It does not guarantee survival. Your plans can still fail, your injuries remain, and your enemies are free to continue attacking. This ability simply allows you to perform at your absolute peak and beyond when death is certain.
objects.title: Epiphany in the Jaws of Death (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
You possess a voice within your mind called Interface, which can respond to you and act as your Guide. It can receive and relay prayers, provide guidance for occult rituals, and serve as a God for spells. Interface can extract resources from Spirituality, which exists in everything. The more mystic or forbidden something is, the more Spirituality you can extract. By sharing knowledge with Interface, you can share it for knowledge of equivalent value, such as exchanging 3,000 words of a mundane language for three characters of Dragon Shout Fus Ro Dah. However, there is a maximum capacity of knowledge you can obtain and the amount of Spirituality you can hold, based on your soul. Because Spirituality exists within all things, you can merge supernatural systems and create something new, such as combining a prayer based on Harpies with the Skyrim Dragon God of Time Akatosh to delve into Dreams.

Additionally, you know the process of becoming a Beyonder, an occult mysticism that grants greater power, longevity, and transcendence. Each step you take greatly improves you based on your selected path, which is initially aligned with the six attributes of spirituality. Unlike others, you are immune to the Poison of Knowledge, which causes madness and can lead to irreparable death. As a result, any kind of Forbidden Knowledge, Eldritch Truth, or similar effects cannot influence you to the point where you can't even feel their effects.

Lamp symbolizes positivity and order. Shadow represents negativity. Stone represents inanimate matter. Chalice represents the vitality of life, Silence represents death, and Revelation represents knowledge. Each path is flexible and not fixed to a single idea. For example, Stone can be found in minerals and human bones with the latter having more Spirituality compared to normal rocks. And even without Interface, Spirituality can be extracted by doing acts related to each Path. As you continue becoming a Beyonder, you may discover even more Paths.
objects.title: Interface (Dorothy’s Forbidden Grimoire)

addons.text:
Your power has merged seamlessly with your Divine Innocence and Purity, creating a unique, transcendent state. You are now the Sacred Girl of Innocence, an embodiment of unblemished holiness, standing apart from all others. 

This transformation has given birth to a Sacred Essence, a divine energy that flows within you, serving as the new foundation for all of your powers. Your Sacred Essence is a wellspring of power that grows stronger as you do, its purity amplifying your abilities beyond the ordinary.

With your newfound state, you are capable of feats that transcend the laws of nature. Your Sacred Essence allows you to perform miracles, such as healing wounds, manipulating the elements, or even bending time to your will. You can alter the very fabric of reality, turning the impossible into the possible. 

The pureness of your being makes you immune to corruption or harm, as any malevolent influence or energy is simply repelled by your divine innocence. 

Whether you’re facing a curse, a mind-bending supernatural force, or an attack from a corrupted being, your purity shields you and turns these forces to your advantage.

Your Sacred Essence also grants you the ability to defy the limits of ordinary existence. The more you use your divine energy, the more it grows, constantly replenishing itself as a reflection of your own inner purity. 

No matter the challenge or darkness you face, your divine light will never falter, and your journey toward divinity continues unimpeded.
addons.title: Sacred Girl of Innocence

addons.text: Instead of using your stamina to fuel your powers, you can instead choose to use your Soul Gem as a source of power, massively boosting the strength of any power you fuel it with an equally proportionate loss of control over that power. This does not affect the strength nor control of your Wish Magic.
addons.title: My Heart and Soul

addons.text: Your Obsession has become your Truth, the Prime Mover of your existence, and with that comes a change to your power as a Magical Girl, with it too drawing power and meaning from your emergent Truth. You now find that all your powers and techniques just simply work better the more you act in accordance with your Truth, even more so if said power or techniques falls within the scope of your Truth. Such is the potential extent of this that by fulling indulging and following your Truth to its pinnacle you can amplify your power by several orders of magnitude, albeit at the cost of being essentially high on your Obsession as it is highly unlikely to be able to achieve this level of devotion to your Truth in a stable state of mind. Another important aspect is just how intuitive it is to do things that align with your Truth. Powers and techniques that fall within the scope of your Truth are ridiculously easy to learn and use, in fact they’re so intuitive that you can manifest entirely new abilities and techniques from scratch based purely on your desires within the moment. A Magical Girl whose Truth is Justice would be able to successfully create and use a technique that determines innocence even without any training simply because they feel that wrongful punishment of the innocent would be unjust. With Obsessive Desire this is taken to the utmost extremes, where following your Truth can grant levels of power beyond comprehension and achieve feats which defy the rules of reality. For when it comes to your Truth, your power is in some ways akin to Divine Authority, caring for naught but your Truth, and much like the Divine your Truth cares not for the Laws of the World. Cleave fate with a Sword, banish death with Hope, or shatter unbreakable bonds in the name of Freedom.
addons.title: La Verità

objects.text:
You are a Magical Girl, though unlike others, you are always in a state of transformation. This grants you shifting hair colors and a magical outfit that can manifest at will. More than that, you possess the power to defy logic itself. While you begin with only peak human abilities and flight equal to twice your running speed, you can grow stronger by learning miracles that transcend reason and natural laws, allowing you to replicate supernatural phenomena without difficulty.

As you encounter the supernatural, you instinctively begin to understand its workings like magic, psychic abilities, reality bending, or even the unique powers of other Magical Girls. While you can learn these through self-study or observation, learning directly from a mentor or an ability user greatly accelerates the process. No power is beyond your reach, no matter how unique or esoteric. Even traits as simple as heightened intelligence can be acquired through dedication. And yet, no power you seek to learn can harm you in the process. Gazing upon Eldritch Truths or reading from a corrupting grimoire does not twist your mind or soul. Instead, such forbidden knowledge becomes a tool in your hands, something you can weaponize and turn against others.

Should you receive powers through a contract or divine blessing, they do not truly grant you abilities. Instead, they serve as training wheels for your own development. Your powers remain fully under your control, and even if the connection to the original source is severed, you retain everything you have gained.

If a power you seek to learn requires a supernatural energy source you do not possess, you can directly convert your stamina into that energy instead. However, this does not alter the speed at which you master new abilities, as your progress still depends on effort, comprehension, and practice.
objects.title: Girl of Magic (Magical Girl ☆Sym-tan☆)

addons.text:
Your potential with Phase Force is an anomaly on par with Ji-soo Seo.

Whatever your Phase Force expression is, it will be powerful enough to challenge a Great King in single combat/a battle of wills and bring things to a stalemate, or win if you are in the ‘Phase Awakening’ state.
addons.title: Alpha Queen

objects.text:
You have awakened your Phase Force, a spiritual energy that once existed in only Dimensional Monsters, a type of being created by The Nameless Will to destroy humanity.

A key facet of Phase Force is how it can be expressed. Some examples are Mind Control, Physical Enhancement, Clairvoyance, Matter Creation (Weapons), and Electrokinesis + Gravity Control.

Your Phase Force’s expression will be determined by multiple factors in order of importance: Personality, Other Powers, and Environment.

Unlocking your Phase Force has enhanced your abilities across the board, making you a shining example of humanities potential. And in combat you will slowly build up power until you can perform a ‘Phase Awakening’ enhancing your abilities even further for a limited time.

You will start out at Novice Agent/Hireling Rank strength but can grow to the Special Agent/Black Hands Rank with training.

A Novice Agent/Hireling can fight off Dimensional Monsters that are a threat to a city in large numbers, but would struggle against anything stronger, meanwhile a normal Special Agent/Black Hands would be able to put up a fight against a Dimensional Monster capable of threatening an area the size of Europe.

In addition you have gained a fully developed set of PNA(Phase Nucleic Acid), and a tool to tweak its configuration to one of three types: Power - Increasing your overall combat strength, Defense - Increasing your overall durability and ability to survive, Utility - Increasing the overall versatility of your Phase Force Abilities
objects.title: Phase Awakened (Closers)

objects.text:
In its essence, D.A.G. consists of three fundamental abilities that allow you to interact with the very essence of your enemies: Devour, Assimilate, and Gift.  

Devour is the deadliest facet, capable of consuming almost anything: from humans and monsters to angels, demons, and spiritual entities. At its core, Devour directly attacks the soul, but its reach is broader, able to consume energy, attacks, or even fragments of space. When using this ability, you absorb the complete or partial soul of the target, gaining a permanent 15% of their energy reserves, as well as fragments of their knowledge, skills, memories, and emotions. Through this ability, you not only acquire what the target has left behind but can also evolve the devoured skill or power, strengthening your abilities over time.  

However, this ability is not infallible. It will not work against divine beings or those significantly stronger than you unless your power increases. Additionally, when you only consume a fraction of the soul, what you gain is proportionally reduced. Devour also has a mental cost, as consuming too many souls too quickly can overwhelm your mind with the emotions and memories of the devoured. Fortunately, by spacing out its use, you can mitigate this effect and even retain the souls to gain multiple lives, should you wish.  

The physical manifestation of Devour is Amarok, a giant wolf bound to you. Amarok can teleport to defend you and tirelessly hunt its prey, dividing into a pack of smaller wolves if necessary. If Amarok is destroyed, it will simply reform when called.  Note You can share Amarok's senses, and speak through it as well, Amarok also has the ability to shrink or grow depending on its needs, its most powerful ability is its power to adapt to any situation.  Amarok is extremely durable and its strength is enough to toss around heavy duty vehicles. 

Assimilate, on the other hand, is the non-lethal version of your power. It allows you to defeat an opponent and steal what defines them, without the need to destroy their soul. When activating this ability, you will have 10 minutes to absorb what the opponent offers, but it will take 30 minutes to recharge it. The benefits you gain from using Assimilate include a permanent 5% increase in your energy reserves, a random trait (such as maximum health, ambidexterity, or innate talent), and, depending on the enemy, new knowledge, techniques, and skills. Unlike Devour, what you absorb is less invasive but equally powerful, allowing you to gain strength without the more destructive consequences of consuming a soul.  

Each skill you assimilate starts in its most basic form and will require training to fully develop. Additionally, any negative effects related to the assimilated skill are automatically removed, ensuring you only retain the useful parts. You cannot assimilate the same target more than once, and the results are always unpredictable.  

Lastly, Gift allows you to share what you have acquired with an ally. Whether it is a power, skill, or technique obtained through Devour, Assimilate, or natural development, you can permanently transfer it to another. However, this act has a price: the power you gift is lost to you forever.
objects.title: D.A.G. (Devour, Assimilate, Gift)

addons.text:
It looks like you're not just a master of skill but also of crafting. Whenever you want to create something, all you have to do is envision the finished product, its abilities, design, and effects, and your power will take care of the rest. This will provide you with a clear, step-by-step guide on how to craft the desired item.

Of course, you're still limited by factors such as available materials, resources, tools, and your personal crafting skills. But beyond those constraints, there is virtually nothing you cannot create with this power.
addons.title: Down to The Last Minute Detail

addons.text:
Your abilities as a Skill Master grant you the unprecedented ability to figure out how to forcibly unlock an infinite number of Skills from the world of Tensura. This includes every rarity of skills from Common Skills to the terrifying power of reality warping Ultimate Skills. This is not just limited to canon Skills, but with some creativity and effort, you can create entirely new custom Skills.

However, you are still limited by your number of Magicules in that unlocking skills will require you to still meet the minimum threshold needed to unlock a Skill based on its power and tier, with Ultimate Skills requiring a vast amount of Magicules to unlock. Also, you can only hold so many Skills based on the power of your body, mind, and soul.

Through this combination, as long as you continue to gain more Magicules, you will be able to climb your way, reaching the same level of power as a God, and possibly even beyond with powers that enhance your body, mind, soul, and magical energy.
addons.title: Voice of the Master

objects.text:
In most worlds that operate on RPG logic, a person’s various skills and their level of mastery play a major role in overall combat ability, sometimes even more so than level or stats. Having the right skill can mean the difference between life and death in battle.

Some skills are relatively easy to acquire. For example, basic weapon skills can often be unlocked simply by practicing with the corresponding weapon. Similarly, resistance skills can be gained by repeatedly exposing yourself to hazardous conditions.

However, other skills are much harder to obtain, with vague unlock conditions or not immediately obvious. For instance, imagine you want a skill that allows you to nullify fatal damage once and then become immune to all damage for a short period afterward. Where would you even start to earn such a skill?

That’s where this power comes in. With it, you can think of any skill, regardless of how overpowered or obscure, and this ability will reveal the exact requirements needed to unlock it. Not only that, but it also guides you intuitively on how to achieve it using the resources available to you.

Take the skill mentioned earlier: if you wanted to nullify fatal damage and become briefly invincible, you would know that the requirement involves perfectly blocking multiple attacks while your health is critically low. Want a skill that bypasses an enemy’s special defense mechanics? Then perform 100 consecutive attacks dealing consistent damage, with a deviation of no more than 5% on a resisting opponent, and so on.

The more powerful the skill you wish to obtain, the more demanding and absurd the requirements will become. Some may even require unlocking multiple prerequisite skills first. But if you have the determination and the capability to meet those conditions, then there is no skill beyond your reach.

You are also given a basic RPG system to help facilitate skill acquisition. Through this system, you can earn EXP to level up and train to increase your stats. However, it is significantly weaker than the typical gamer system, and you will need much more effort to reach a similar level of strength. If you possess the full Gamer System ability or any similar RPG-based power, such as Falna, you have the choice to merge them with this one to have an overall stronger system.
objects.title: Skill Master (Ascension Through Skill)

objects.text:
You have the power to summon the chibi idols of Hololive to do your bidding. You start out with one of your choice. This idol begins only as physically powerful as a peak human and has basic access to her powers. When she or you defeats an enemy, they will drop either EXP or HoloCoins. Stronger enemies will either drop more EXP or higher quality EXP. As she runs near EXP, she will slowly "level up," gaining access to stat boosters, buffs to her existing powers, or even entirely new abilities. There is no level cap, but the higher she goes, the more EXP she will need to continue leveling up. These powers include powerful healing abilities, temporary invincibility, time-stopping, flame breath, bombs, guns, and more.

If she dies or you decide to unsummon her, she will lose all her levels and powers when resummoned. This is where your HoloCoins come in. With a thought, you can teleport to and visit a specific dimension called The Shop, run by A-Chan. Here, you can buy permanent boosts and upgrades for all your idols, including ones that increase EXP and HoloCoin drop rates. You can also purchase new idols and even duplicates of existing ones through the Character Gacha. Duplicates will increase an idol’s base stats.

There is no limit to how many idols you can have out at once. There is no range on the distance they can be and take orders from you either, if you wish you could even directly control one from the shop while they're in the real world.
objects.title: Choose Your Idol (Holocure: Save the Fans!)

objects.text:
The Seven Stars is a unique trait that represents the manifestation of a transcendent star, essentially, the innate right and potential of a being to break through the limits of their world and continue growing stronger.

The power of this trait is simple yet immensely potent. In exchange for being limited to only seven empowered skills at a time, it grants those skills a tremendous boost in growth rate.

Additionally, it allows the user to inherit the intentions, experiences, and knowledge of each skill’s original creator, as well as from other masters of the skill, assimilating their wisdom as their own. Skills and abilities influenced by this trait can surpass their natural limitations and even mitigate or completely eliminate their inherent weaknesses.

If the chosen skill is an innate trait or ability rather than a learned technique, no external knowledge is granted. However, the growth rate of that trait is still significantly enhanced.

For example, if you applied Seven Stars to Kaio-Ken, you would gain the knowledge and experience of both King Kai and Goku regarding the technique, allowing you to master it rapidly. Furthermore, you could refine and evolve the ability, unlocking higher multipliers with reduced strain on your body and Ki.

Or, if you assigned a slot to God Hand, the Noble Phantasm of Heracles, you would gain increased resistance with each recovery from damage. Over time, this could result in losing no more than one life per death, or even gaining immunity to vulnerabilities such as poison or venom.

Unlike the original version of this trait, you are not limited to possessing only seven skills or powers. You may acquire as many as you like; however, only seven can be empowered by Seven Stars at any given time. You are free to switch which skills are empowered whenever you choose.
objects.title: Seven Stars (Reincarnator)

addons.text: It would seem as though you have found a special glitch that allows you to stay hidden from any higher powers just up until you become strong enough to threaten them. This means you can freely gain power without any need to fear drawing unwanted attention.
addons.title: Ghost in the code

addons.text: You have a NEED a need for speed, that is. Your obsession is focused on increasing your speed and control over reality above everything else. This desire will help and fuel your growth to levels unimaginable to such a degree that becoming a speedrunning god becomes an inevitable question of when, not if.
addons.title: A NEED FOR SPEED

addons.text: You have done it, you have attained the holy grail of Speedrunners, that is to say: INFINITE SPEED. You no longer have any need to leap across timelines to gather speed, as you now have it in infinite amounts by default, thanks to the Speed Force. Your ability to use the Speed Force is also massively increased to such a degree that you become freely able to time-travel freely with no fear of causing any kind of time paradoxes. The mental enhancements from the Speed Force allow you to more quickly and easily grasp the source code of reality. Even the trickiest and esoteric of realities become an open book to your enhanced mind. Dialing your abilities to the reality you reside in becomes nearly effortless, with you able to calibrate mundane realities near instantly and more complicated ones in weeks at most. With this combination of powers, you become a virtual god of speed, able to almost effortlessly manipulate reality.
addons.title: INFINITE SPEED

objects.text:
You gain the ability to see the source code of reality and manipulate it directly through seemingly nonsensical actions and movements, which may defy physics as you perform them. This power is limited by your understanding of the source code of the reality you reside in, along with your speed; with more speed, making it far easier to bend and even break reality. 

However, some realities which hold more esoteric and complicated metaphysics or realms with higher powers. Being in such realities will make it harder for you to learn and manipulate reality, such as Marvel Comics and DC Comics, which are massively multidimensional realities and have various local gods that will not be happy with your meddling.

To grow stronger, you must overcome challenges and fights before leaping to another timeline to repeat this action endlessly. You can set a single special marker in space-time to create a starting line for your speedruns, which you can repeat as many times as you want. The faster you complete this process and the more you do it, the faster you will become until you eventually gain immeasurable speed. Once you reach this level, reality itself becomes your plaything, with you able to do anything. With enough speed, you can exist in multiple timelines at once, acting as a powerful form of immortality and granting you the ability to create time clones.

Starting off, you will have enough understanding of the source code where you reside and speed to move at sub-light speed, and treat the environment as a bounce house, and manipulate reality in small ways. You gain the knowledge of how to perform the terrifying backwards long jump, which allows you to treat nearly any surface as a launch pad, allowing you to increase your speed exponentially, and is your main means to jump to different timelines.

Now go forth and speedrun your way to glitch godhood.
objects.title: SPEEDRUNNER (Terminal Montage Mario)

addons.text:
You have refined and utilized the Rank Six Second Aperture Gu immortal Gu, gaining a second aperture with a talent equivalent to your original aperture, which provides an additional 99% primeval essence, for a total of 198% primeval essence.

This allows you to refine a second Vital Gu.

Like your original aperture, this Second Aperture also has the potential to cultivate to the immortal stage.
addons.title: Second Aperture Gu

addons.text:
Your nature as the lord of alchemy has resonated with the refinement path, pushing your attainment of the refinement path straight into the realms of Supreme Grandmaster, as alchemy, as a concept, does not exist in the world in the form you can use.

This also advances your human path, pill path, and transformation path to Grandmaster, as all those paths are related to alchemy in some way, such as the creation of human vessels through homunculi, creation of healing pills as magical agents, or combining different species and entities into a chimera.

With this, your ability to refine gu, something vital to the Gu World, becomes second nature, allowing you to refine gu beyond the limits of your cultivation. You can also modify the gu recipes to remove the fixed failure chance, though this always comes with increased resource cost.

Even with your incredibly limited cultivation, you can refine a gu two to three ranks above your current cultivation level. However, before becoming a gu immortal, refining a rank six gu is the limit.

You obtain an encyclopedic knowledge and a deep understanding of gu, gu refinement materials, and gu refinement techniques, enabling you to invent or reverse-engineer different gu recipes with little difficulty. This also boosts your ability to create killer moves, as you have a deep understanding of how different gu can come together to achieve the intended effect.

Having attainment in other paths makes it easier to invent gu recipes and refine gu of the corresponding path. The greater the attainment, the greater the ease you can invent and refine the gu of the path.

As long as your cultivation reaches rank four to five, even an immortal gu can be refined, though depending on how difficult the immortal gu is to refine, it can strain or even damage your soul.

Even if your refinement fails, you will never lose more than 75% of the resources used during the refinement.
addons.title: Refinement Path

addons.text: You have attained Great Grandmaster Attainment in the Wisdom Path, which emphasizes control and research upon certainty. The Wisdom Path has three main components: Thoughts, Wills, and Emotions. Thoughts are ever-changing, while wills are intense, and emotions interrupt. Wisdom Path cultivation means having control over these three aspects. This allows them to be calm and collected, as they know how to handle their state of mind. Your mind has a remarkable capacity for information storage and processing, enabling you to comprehend the information you obtain with greater ease. You can use this information to make deductions and predictions of various kinds, whether it is predicting the future, events in the past, people's motives, unraveling schemes, or even things like Gu recipes. Even without using wisdom path gu or killer moves, your predictions are very accurate, though with wisdom path gu or killer moves to support your deductions, you can reach the point of seeming omniscient to others. If you have Laplace Determinism (Darwin's Game), Sherlock Scan, or The Hand Behind The Curtain, your attainment is raised to the very peak of Quasi-Supreme Grandmaster, to the point you only need to innovate applications and methods beyond the limits of the world and obtain secrets of the wisdom path that did not exist previously in the world to reach Supreme Grandmaster. Doing this would put your wisdom on a level beyond heaven and earth.
addons.title: Wisdom Path

addons.text: Your inherent ability to steal anything has harmonized with the Theft Path, propelling your attainment into the realms of Quasi-Supreme Grandmaster. As the method used for this inherently surpassed the limits of the world, your attainment broke straight into Supreme Grandmaster. From this, you have created the killer move Killer Move Steal Achievement, which allows you to steal the attainments of others to elevate your own. Furthermore, creating killer moves to steal other things, such as gu, dao marks, or even the apertures of others, comes easily. You develop an instinct for recognizing valuable things, enabling you to avoid missing opportunities to steal the valuables of others. As the Theft Path could be said to imitate Heaven and Earth, as well as being in line with the way of humans, you gain Grandmaster attainment in both the Heaven Path and the Human Path. If you have Refinement Path, your Human Path attainment is raised to Great Grandmaster.
addons.title: Theft Path

addons.text:
You have inherited the Killer Moves, Ghostly Concealment, and Divine Concealment from the Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable. These killer moves are artificial Secluded Domains, and take the form of Theft Path Dao Marks surrounding your soul. These are permanently active and do not expend any primeval or immortal essence.

Ghostly Concealment prevents souls from noticing you or any anomaly surrounding your soul. This is powerful enough to even prevent Spectral Soul Demon Venerable from noticing you soul swapping within his direct proximity. This also applies to soul beasts.

Divine Concealment protects you from the deduction of any thought, will, or emotion, preventing them from deducing your state or origins, granting you immunity to the deductions of most wisdom path immortals. With this, only a rank nine wisdom path gu immortal have a chance of making deductions about you. 

As Heaven's Will is a type of will, it too is unable to deduce you, which protects you from calamities and tribulations, at the expense of not gaining the Dao marks they carry, and preventing your cultivation from advancing the typical way along the immortal stage.
addons.title: Thieving Heaven Concealment Inheritance

addons.text:
Typically, only five in a million would be able to reach the attainment realm of Master in a single path, though among immortals, nearly every single one would have master attainment in their primary path. You, on the other hand, have an inborn attainment of Master in every single path.

This provides you with a comprehensive understanding of the world and its functions. Even if this understanding is not very deep, it does provide a solid foundation for your cultivation and pushes your usage of gu to the point where it is akin to art.

As having master attainment in a path generates an intuition regarding matters related to that path, having master level attainment in all paths naturally provides an incredibly potent intuition, as all the different intuitions are merged into a collective whole, as each of your path attainments build upon each other, your effective attainment reaches something like a generic ‘’quasi-grandmaster’’ allowing you to push the limits of your attainment of a path by leaning on your other paths attainment.
addons.title: Master of Many Paths

addons.text: You who have inherited the Original One’s knowledge and more importantly Understanding or as it is known within the world of Reverend Insanity Attainment of the world and everything within it. By using your own inborn master attainment in all paths as a scaffolding to account for the differences between worlds, and the deep understanding of all things you have inherited, your attainment in all paths has elevated to the limits of the world, pushing all of them to Quasi-Supreme Grandmaster. You can control the Dao Marks found in nature, much like how a Dao Lord would, however, you have not refined these Dao Marks, and a Dao Lord would supersede your control. As your control over these Dao Marks is inferior to that of a Dao Lord’s, you can only control those within close proximity, and you cannot form Battlefield Killer Moves, you can only use them to form Formations and ordinary Immortal Killer Moves. Controlling Dao Marks requires no immortal essence, only some of your mental strength to set up natural formations or control killer moves. This gives you a combative strength on par with stronger Rank Seven Gu Immortals or the weaker end of Rank Eights. As your Dao Attainment reaches the limits of heaven and earth, your attainment forms a prescient sixth sense, which begins to give you premonitions about matters around you, allowing you to avoid danger and reap benefits you otherwise would miss. Furthermore, as you have not refined these Dao Marks, they remain natural Dao Marks, which allows you to use them directly as raw immortal material to refine gu with, while mortal Gu can be refined without issues. Refining Immortal Gu would trigger calamities and tribulations corresponding to its rank, as the method used is very similar to the Hairymen Heaven and Earth refinement style. Moreover founding new paths that align with the symbols or authorities you once held as the Oldest One, such as a Bizarreness Path, Error Path, Twilight Path, Tyrant Path, or Paragon Path comes with ease, as you have already the corresponding Attainment that would be needed. You can create Extreme Physiques for these paths using your Dao Mark Control directly, but creating supreme physiques on par with the Sovereign Immortal Body and Aperture would require you to refine fetus immortal gu. You begin with the foundation of six different variations of such supreme physique Gu, such as Chaos Sea Fetus Gu, Eternal Darkness Fetus Gu, Demon of Knowledge Fetus Gu, etc.
addons.title: Origin Dao Lord

addons.text: You have attained Great Grandmaster attainment in the Soul Path, a path founded by Spectral Soul Demon Venerable that revolves around three aspects: strengthening the soul, refining the soul, and pacifying the soul. Gu Masters of this path elevate their own soul foundation, damage the souls of others, and use their or other's soul to achieve different feats. With this attainment, you possess a profound and instinctual understanding of the methods and ways of Soul Path and its workings. This allows you to easily design soul path killer moves, refine soul path Gu, and modify existing soul path methods with little difficulty. You are deeply familiar with techniques related to soul nourishment, soul searching, and soul-based combat methods, as well as the materials, environments, and resources commonly used in soul cultivation. Your knowledge of soul cultivation is very close to completion in the knowledge and understanding of the profundities of the Soul Path. Your Great Grandmaster attainment allows you to imitate and make use of the specialty traits and advantages of other paths through Soul Path methods, and also allows the use of natural Soul Path Dao Marks. If you possess both Soul Weaver and Hundred Million Man Soul (Reverend Insanity), your attainment rises to the very peak of Quasi-Supreme Grandmaster in the Soul Path. At this level, you only need to develop new methods or uncover previously unknown profundities of the soul to step into the realm of Supreme Grandmaster. As a bonus if you also possess both powers, you may choose to possess a special Soul Path physique only inferior to the Ten Extreme Physiques, but without any of their inherent flaws or limitations. This physique naturally amplifies all Soul Path methods and greatly increases cultivation speed and Human Qi, similar to the Ten Extreme Physiques.
