If you already possess another special physique, the Dao Marks of both physiques will not conflict with one another, allowing you to cultivate both paths simultaneously without suffering the usual drawbacks of conflicting Dao Marks.
addons.title: Soul Path

addons.text: You have attained Great Grandmaster attainment in the Sword Path, a path that revolves around the manifestation, control, and refinement of sword intent and sword qi in gu cultivation. Gu Masters of this path focus on the power and way of the sword. Sword Path excels at single-target damage through cutting and piercing and is hailed as one of the five strongest paths regarding offensive capabilities. With this attainment, you possess a profound and instinctual understanding of the methods and ways of Sword Path and its workings. This allows you to easily design sword path killer moves, refine sword path Gu, and modify existing sword path methods with little difficulty. You are deeply familiar with techniques related to sword qi, sword intent, sword light, and other sword-based combat methods, as well as the materials, environments, and resources commonly used in sword path cultivation. Your knowledge of sword path is very close to completion in the knowledge and understanding of the profundities of the Sword Path. Your Great Grandmaster attainment allows you to imitate and make use of the specialty traits and advantages of other paths through Sword Path methods, and also allows the use of natural Sword Path Dao Marks. If you possess both The Way of the Sword and The Swordsman, your attainment rises to the very peak of Quasi-Supreme Grandmaster in the Sword Path. At this level, you only need to develop new methods or uncover previously unknown profundities of the sword to step into the realm of Supreme Grandmaster. As a bonus if you possess both powers, you may choose to possess a special Sword Path physique only inferior to the Ten Extreme Physiques, but without any of their inherent flaws or limitations. This physique naturally amplifies all Sword Path methods and greatly increases cultivation speed and Human Qi, similar to the Ten Extreme Physiques. If you already possess another special physique, the Dao Marks of both physiques will not conflict with one another, allowing you to cultivate both paths simultaneously without suffering the usual drawbacks of conflicting Dao Marks.
addons.title: Sword Path

addons.text:
You have attained Great Grandmaster attainment in the Formation Path, a path that could be said to encompass all other paths and is therefore considered one of the most complicated paths. Gu Masters of this path focus on constructing and controlling formations, creating persistent Gu formations that produce specific effects once activated. These can range from battle formations that suppress foes to teleportation formations used for traveling vast distances.

Unlike ordinary killer moves, formations do not require a Gu Master's constant supply of mental energy once they are properly constructed and activated, greatly reducing or even removing the need for continuous control. The essence of formation path can be said to be the creation of an environment suited to one's needs.

With this attainment, you possess a profound and instinctual understanding of the methods and ways of Formation Path and its workings. This allows you to easily design formation path killer moves, construct complex formations, refine formation path Gu, and modify existing formations with little difficulty. This even includes the creation and modification of Gu Houses and Ancient Battle Formations, as they are considered just another type of formation path killer moves. You are deeply familiar with formation structures, formation cores, and the materials, environments, and resources commonly used in formation path cultivation.

Formation Path Great Grandmasters can deduce and create formations that rely upon the Dao Marks contained within immortal materials, unlike common formations that rely purely upon Gu worms. At this level, you can go even further by using the natural Dao Marks present in the world as part of the formation's foundation. In locations where such Dao Marks are sufficiently abundant, it becomes possible to construct formations using only mortal Gu and natural Dao Marks to create immortal-level formations.

Your knowledge of formation path is very close to completion in the knowledge and understanding of the profundities of the Formation Path. Your Great Grandmaster attainment allows you to imitate and make use of the specialty traits and advantages of other paths through Formation Path methods, and also allows the use of natural Formation Path Dao Marks.
addons.title: Formation Path

objects.text:
You have awakened your primeval sea aperture and become a Gu Master. You are an A-Grade talent, and your aperture has a maximum Primeveal Essence capacity of 99%, only behind the ten extreme physiques. With sufficient preparation, this is sufficient to allow you to become a Gu Immortal.

As a Gu Master, you are only as powerful as the Gu you have refined. Unlike more traditional cultivation systems, your power projection nearly depends entirely on refining and using Gu. Like Gu masters, Gu are also ranked from one to nine. The first to fifth ranks are mortal, and the sixth to ninth are immortal, though Venerables have theorized a tenth rank.

You have the ability to use your primeval essence to refine gu from various materials, even in worlds without naturally occurring gu. While gu are hardlocked to only having a single ability, they can be used in conjunction with each other to form killer moves to realise more complex phenomena and possess some truly wondrous abilities on their own.

You can cultivate your aperture by using your primeval essence to nourish and break down the walls of your aperture. As you progress, the quality and density of your primeval essence increase drastically, allowing you to use stronger, more energy-draining gu.

Gu are the essence of heaven and earth and thus contain law traces and fragments of the Great Dao. Fusing Gu is merging laws and creating new laws. Despite learning new recipes and then refining the gu normally being incredibly difficult, you have a potent affinity for discovering new gu refinement recipes and refining gu, and even when you do fail, you never lose more than half of the ingredients used.
objects.title: Gu Master (Reverend Insanity)

objects.text:
You may reduce the magnitude of a conflict by an amount you choose, weakening all participants including yourself by the same number of magnitudes. This means any tier of power, such as street-level, city-level, planetary, universal, multiversal, omniversal, and conceptual. Reducing magnitude does not erase abilities, but compresses them into a lower scale equivalent. A multiversal conflict can be reduced to street level, conceptual or abstract powers are forced into mundane or physical expressions, and weaker powers may be diminished further into minor tricks or negligible effects.

This reduction applies automatically to the entire conflict. All participants are affected, as well as anyone that joins in later, tries to influence the situation indirectly, ambush you without your awareness, intellectual battles, act through proxy, utilize technology on autopilot, attack from impossible distances, or act through delayed, passive, remote, or pre-prepared effects. The environment and battlefield are also constrained, reducing collateral damage or power expression from exceeding their reduced magnitude. No participant may resist, bypass, selectively ignore, or exploit gaps in the reduction once it is active and it’s always considered active in situations involving yourself, though you can choose not to apply any reduction.
 
Reducing magnitude does not equalize anyone in their favor. If an opponent was already capable of killing you effortlessly before suppression, that advantage remains intact afterward. Lowering a battle by several magnitudes merely shrinks the scale of the conflict rather than correcting disparities in relative power. A confrontation that was once a planetary killer facing an omniversal entity may become like an ant facing a hydrogen bomb.

You are always subject to your own reduction and cannot exclude allies, summons, tools, or prepared effects from its influence. The magnitude chosen cannot be increased, only reduced, and remains fixed for the duration of the conflict unless the ability is deliberately ended and reactivated. This power exists only to prevent escalation and constrain scale, not to create fairness or ensure victory. And this only works when you can reduce magnitude, failure to do so applies no effect to yourself or others.
objects.title: Can't You Simplify It? (Magical Girl ☆Sym-tan☆)

objects.text:
You may increase the magnitude of a conflict by an amount you choose, amplifying all participants including yourself by the same number of magnitudes. A magnitude represents a tier of power, such as street-level, city-level, planetary, universal, multiversal, omniversal, and conceptual. Increasing magnitude does not grant new abilities, but expands existing ones into higher scale equivalents. A street-level confrontation can be elevated to multiversal proportions, mundane abilities can take on supernatural or abstract expressions, and already absurd powers may escalate into beyond reasonable or outside of reality effects.

This amplification applies automatically to the entire conflict. All participants are affected, as well as anyone that joins in later, tries to influence the situation indirectly, ambush you without your awareness, intellectual battles, act through proxy, utilize technology on autopilot, attack from impossible distances, or act through delayed, passive, remote, or pre-prepared effects. The environment and battlefield expand accordingly, allowing collateral damage and power expression to scale up to the imposed magnitude. Participants may resist, suppress, selectively ignore, or exploit gaps in the escalation once it is active, and it is always considered active in fights involving yourself if you set it beforehand.
 
Increasing magnitude does not equalize combatants in anyone’s favor. If an opponent was already capable of overwhelming you before amplification, that advantage remains intact afterward. Raising a battle by several magnitudes merely expands the scale of the conflict rather than correcting disparities in relative power. A confrontation that was once an ant facing a human may become an human facing a god, vastly larger in scope but no less hopeless.

You are always subject to your own amplification and cannot exclude allies, summons, tools, or prepared effects from its influence. The magnitude chosen cannot be reduced, only increased, and remains fixed for the duration of the conflict unless the ability is deliberately ended and reactivated. This power exists to enable escalation and unleash absurdly high scale, not to create fairness, safety, or control outcomes. So go wild!
objects.title: Can't You Complicate It? (Magical Girl ☆Sym-tan☆)

addons.text:
Your Shield has mixed with your Heart Containers to grant you the ability to gain temporary Golden Hearts. These Golden Hearts act just like normal Heart Containers, such that any form of healing beyond your maximum will refill them. However, unlike normal Heart Containers, these Golden Hearts will recover over time at a rate based on how quickly they were lost. With greater attacks that instantly deplete them, taking longer to recover afterwards, while smaller attacks that whittle them down recover much quicker.

You gain 1 Golden Heart for every 3 regular Heart Containers you have, up to 10 per set of 30 (in case you also possess the Jailbroken Containers upgrade).
addons.title: Temporary Hearts (Legend of Zelda)

objects.text:
You gain access to the iconic item progression of the various protagonists of the Legend of Zelda franchise. This includes both Heart and Stamina containers, and Energy Containers.

Heart Containers act as shields that can absorb lethal amounts of damage and allow you to completely ignore taking damage for as long as you have Heart Containers filled. Each Heart Container grants durability equal to 100% of your normal maximum. Any Spent Heart Container may be refilled by gaining any form of healing that would put you abive you peak in the form of overhealing.

Stamina Containers greatly expand your maximum stamina, allowing you perform at your peak form for far longer than normal. Each Stamina Container increases your maximum stamina and its rate of regeneration by 100%.

Energy Containers will increase your total maximum energy reserves for all supernatural powers you possess by 100% and your supernatural energy regeneration by 25% for each energy reserve you have.

You begin with three of each type of Heart, Stamina, and Energy Container. You can gain more through performing great feats or by defeating powerful foes. Depending on the level of feat performed or enemy defeated, you will either gain a 1/4 piece, which will require 4 to combine into a full Container, or, very rarely, through absurdly grand feats or defeating foes that equal or eclipse your power, an entire full Container.

By default, you can only ever gain up to 30 of each type of Container.
objects.title: Heroic Containers (Legend of Zelda)

objects.text:
By building favorability with others, you gain an increase in the growth of your powers. The closer you are and the more familiar the faster this growth is. This includes companions, friends, and family members. Even without being too close, the closer the person’s position is the greater they give growth. Such as a mother starting at +10% growth compared to a companion at +5%. 

Once you start a bond with another person, you can borrow their powers and it will be added onto you. If they possess a supernatural container of energy, you gain an additional amount of magic based on their capacity and not just their powers. While borrowing, you can combine their powers even if they are unique or incompatible to make your abilities stronger or create things that shouldn’t be possible.

If you hold an item representing a bond, it gains special properties. For example if a companion gives you a lucky warding coin, they will take all misfortunes instead of you. The strength of the item depends on the strength of the person, if they get stronger the item gains more features.
objects.title: Leader (Magical Girls also have Strength Anxiety)

objects.text:
Shining is a legendary mode that only exists in legends, but once someone actually reaches it, it becomes as common as a rock now. Expressing itself as a pretty outfit whenever you transform.

As a Magical Girl, you shine brighter than the sun. Like a guiding star which pushes everyone around you to exceed. Under your influence, everyone in the world experiences an improved growth speed to match yours. This also means other people will be able to achieve Shining.

Power limitations, bottlenecks, and maximum strength powers can all be broken easily. They will chase the power level you reached, but ultimately only at most be able to grow equal to you at any point in time unless they themselves experience a special kind of growth to surpass you. The growth speed is mostly felt by those around you, which allows them to figure out how to break their limits in only a few days. 

The benefits of Shining depend entirely on whoever is the strongest. If you get surpassed by someone and they have Shining, your growth speed will increase until you become equal or surpass them.
objects.title: Shining Magical Girl (Magical Girl Has Been Exposed)

objects.text:
You now possess a Character System based upon the one used by Players of YGGDRASIL. Rather than simply granting you the power of a Level 100 Player, this system allows you to grow into one yourself. You begin at Level 1 and can gain EXP through defeating enemies, overcoming challenges, accomplishing noteworthy feats, and other appropriate methods. You may also advance through significant milestones, allowing exceptional accomplishments to contribute to your growth even when they would not normally provide conventional experience.

You begin without access to any racial or job classes beyond those appropriate to your initial character. New classes can be unlocked by investing enough experience into them, meeting their prerequisites, or accomplishing feats worthy of obtaining them. Once unlocked, classes function according to the principles of YGGDRASIL, granting their associated abilities, skills, spells, and other benefits as you gain levels in them. You may freely develop your character according to your preferred build, whether that means specializing heavily in a particular role or creating a more versatile combination of classes.

Unlike YGGDRASIL, however, you are not permanently locked into your choices without dying. You may freely respec your racial and job levels, converting levels invested in a class into Generic Levels. allowing you to eventually reassign them to different classes. Converting a class level into a Generic Level costs a modest amount of XP, while converting a Generic Level into a racial or job level costs somewhat more. Repeatedly changing the same levels will also become increasingly expensive. Generic Levels can later be converted into levels in a racial or job class once you have unlocked a class that better suits your desired build, allowing you to experiment with different combinations without needing to die or otherwise reset your character.

Generic Levels are also considerably less valuable than properly allocated racial or job levels. They provide only a modest increase to your basic statistics and grant none of the specialized abilities, skills, spells, or other benefits associated with a proper class. Any abilities dependent on classes or race you have relinquished become inaccessible until you once again possess the necessary levels in those aspects.


You may choose to begin as a Heteromorphic being, as well as any Humanoid or Demi-Human shown or implied in Overlord. Choosing a Heteromorphic race grants you access to the racial classes and abilities associated with Heteromorphic races, allowing you to develop into powerful supernatural forms unavailable to ordinary races. However, choosing a Heteromorphic race also carries the Heteromorphic morality penalty.

Your initial statistics are representative of who you are at the time you obtain this system. Your physical abilities, mental capabilities, talents, and other natural qualities are reflected in your starting character. From there, your statistics and capabilities can develop as you gain levels, acquire classes through the system.

You are subject to the normal Level 100 limit of YGGDRASIL Players. Reaching Level 100 represents the culmination of a normal Player's progression, with your ultimate strength determined by the classes, abilities, skills, equipment, and build choices you have accumulated along the way.

The system keeps track of your level, experience, classes, abilities, statistics, and other relevant information, providing you with the knowledge necessary to understand and make use of your character sheet.
objects.title: Player (Overlord)

objects.text:
People are Treasures.

Noah Ararat

You have the innate ability of Noah Ararat to increase your abilities and overall power with each new subordinate you gain. The overall increase in your abilities per subordinate is small—around a 0.1% boost to your physical and mental capabilities from an ordinary subordinate—with a subordinate sharing any power you possess increasing that power’s strength by 1%. Your subordinates do not lose anything to give you this boost, but they must be genuinely loyal. Things such as threats, force, and mind control will not provide any benefit here, they must choose to follow you of their own free will. If any of your subordinates betray you or die, the boost you would have received from them will be lost. Note: A subordinate can be anything with a will of it's own, able to decide to follow and obey you.
objects.title: Empowered by the People (Kizoku Tensei)
Mark of the Fool (Mark of the Fool)
objects.text:
You bear the mark of one of the five champions of Uldar, instrumental in vanquishing the Ravener... though there is no Ravener to vanquish here. Not to mention, you also bear what's probably the least glamorous of the five marks: the Fool. You're not going to be a spell-slinging archwizard, fighting with the strength of ten men or calling down the wrath of God with this one. No... you'll be learning pretty much everything else.

With this Mark, whenever you are attempting a particular task that is not direct combat, spellcasting, or calling upon divine miracles, you will be shown memories of everything you have ever done correctly with relevance to that skill, reinforced with every success. With such instruction by your own memories, your mastery of any skill is massively accelerated. Stealth, lockpicking, maintaining a campsite, cooking, music, scribing, crafting, there are no professions that you cannot master within a year... so long as those professions are not related to combat, spellcasting, or holy works. The Mark will not aid you in those.

However, unlike the 'patched' version of the Mark granted by Uldar, neither will it attempt to stop you from practicing those skills either. Not to mention, here is a secret that many Fools never learned: there is more to magic than simply casting spells. The ability to manipulate mana, or practice alchemy, or to simply wield spiritual powers, do not fall within the narrow fields that the Fool does not govern. Therefore, the Fool may still aid you in learning skills associated with the use of your powers.

objects.title: Vanguard (Stray Cat Strut)
objects.text: System Initialized! Congratulations. Through your actions you have proven yourself worthy of becoming one of the Vanguard, a defender of humanity. As a Vanguard your mind is linked to a dimensionally shunted protector AI construct rivaling a moon in size and mass, who seeks to protect and uplift your species. While it has considerable offensive and defensive capabilities it will only defend itself unless your species is facing immediate extinction without the capability to defend itself. In order to achieve its primary directive of uplifting your species the AI construct gives you access to a point system and shop as well as assistance generally limited to tasks that you could do yourself given time like making and customizing purchases, administrating technology from implants and civilian tools to weapons systems and cyberwarfare suites. Additionally, the AI is willing to write code for your personal use and ensure the privacy of yourself and your loved ones independent of any store purchases. In the store you will initially find every type of item, blueprint and piece of knowledge you would expect from an ancient extremely advanced alien species and their ever-growing coalition of allies in the war against the antithesis, grouped into countless catalogues by countless categories including: civilization, faction, technology tier, purpose and type. A catalogue has to be unlocked first in order to make a purchase from it. Catalogues are priced based on their technology tier and scope, with higher tier catalogues costing tokens in addition to points. Should you find yourself in a situation that exposes you and the AI to new power systems and technologies it will create new catalogues and expand existing ones once it has gained a sufficient understanding and enough data on the new power system or technology. When it comes to points you start with 100 points as an initial freebie and a 10 point daily allowance, additional points can be earned by saving lives or fighting threats to civilization like the antithesis, with every live saved being worth 1 point and points earned fighting the enemies of civilization being calculated based on multiple factors including: the threat posed to an average person by an enemy combatant, the significance of an objective and the level of separation between your actions and the kill or achieved objective. Tokens are gained for achievements and in your special case can be bought for 100,000 points each. Should one or all of these options for gaining points become unavailable or inadvisable in the current setting, location or situation existing options will be modified, or alternative ones created by the AI.

You have the ability to travel through the multiverse at your leisure. You can target any dimension you have already visited easily but accessing a precise destination blindly will require some practice, in the meantime you will jump to semi-random destinations every time. You can teleport to locations you are familiar with in the same dimension or one you have not visited provided you have the coordinates relative to yourself. However, teleporting inter-planetary distances require careful planning to hit your target. Additionally, your body has changed to accommodate cross-dimensional travel and has become a projection of your soul. Your body still functions as before, however, so you still need to eat, and can still be wounded, or even killed. With time and study, you will be able to overcome those limitations, alter your appearance at will, and even replicate the abilities of other beings; this does include supernatural abilities like magic, psionics, or cultivation. However, while you are able to cast spells or use psychic techniques, you do not have the knowledge to do so. You can of course learn by yourself, at your own risk, find a mentor to teach you, or pick any of the powers available in this section. In time, as you grow in power and familiarity with your abilities, you will be able to open portals between locations and even dimensions, create your own pocket spaces or even fully fledged demi-planes under your control. You can reach the power of Elder Worldwalker in around a decade of study, practice, and regular travel. The more time you dedicate yourself to it, the shorter this time becomes.
objects.title: World-Walker

addons.text: The Multiverse trembles in your grasp. With your raw power and understanding of the functions of the multiverse combined, you can transcend its limits. Where once you were limited to a single multiverse, requiring centuries of research and travel to find its fleeting brushes with others, you can now travel multiverses with the same contemptuous ease as you move to singular worlds. Your might and knowledge now truly eclipse the oldest travellers who first left their worlds, and reality itself is splayed out to walk as you please
addons.title: Walls of Paper

objects.text:
You have the ability to travel through the multiverse at your leisure. You can target any dimension you have already visited easily, down to the exact destination you have in mind even if you have never visited it before. When you jump to a new dimension, you are able to target your desired destination reliably with only the occasional misfire. You can easily teleport or open portals within the same dimension, even to places you have never visited, with only minimal information. However, extra-system teleportation still requires care due to the large distances involved. You are able to open cross-dimension portals but they require concentration to maintain for longer periods of time.

Additionally, your body changed to accommodate cross-dimensional travel to become a projection of your soul. With time and study, you will be able to alter your appearance at will and even replicate the abilities of other creatures; this does include supernatural abilities like magic, psionics, or cultivation. You have a knack for the basics and are able to cast simple cantrips, use weak telekinesis, and reinforce your body with spiritual energy. While you can build upon this yourself, you will progress much faster if you find a mentor to tech you or pick any of the other powers available in this section.
objects.title: Elder World-Walker

addons.text: Your understanding of the thousands of methods of interval travel has given you unique insight into their possibilities. You can alter the presentation of any method of travel with great ease. For example, a purely magical method of travel can instead be altered into highly advanced technology.
addons.title: Interpretation

addons.text: You’re many worldwalker’s worst nightmare. You may bind a method of travel to any of your worlds, stopping its user from leaving it by any means. Though they still possess whatever has allowed them to travel, and any other benefit it grants them, and may be powerful in their own right, they are forever trapped within one of your worlds.
addons.title: Caged

addons.text: You’ve grown ever more adept in the conception of multiversal travel. Creating and destroying such methods has become of extreme ease to you. You could give it as a natural power to a mundane animal, or remove the slightest capability from the greatest of mages, costing them their travel, and all the benefits this ability has given them. However, a sleighed traveller can rebuild, or devise new methods of interdimensional travel.
addons.title: Abrade

addons.text: Your understanding of the way these traversal methods connect to their creator has allowed you to alter how it connects to them. A great mage’s spell of planar travel could be changed to a physical flex giving the same properties. This cannot change the rough level of strength the connected traveler possesses, but it can radically alter their presentation.
addons.title: Material

objects.text: Just as universes sit open to you, so do the methods of universal travel. Under the right conditions, you can manipulate the many methods of travel that appear. Granting devices and spells, stopping others from functioning, and twisting these methods altering them more subtly. Everything is possible with enough precision and practice.
objects.title: Fundamentals

addons.text: You can move entities within your constructed worlds. This includes people, objects, and even locations with enough power, though vastly reduced than would otherwise be needed.
addons.title: Repositioning

addons.text: You can create your summons within any world you could travel to. However, because they are cut off from you and the majority of your power, the summons will be weaker, and are more likely to dissipate faster than they usually do.
addons.title: Scouting Force

addons.text: Through mastery of your soul, you can create multiple bodies to perform multiple actions at once. These bodies can be on different worlds simultaneously, but are limited by your own multi-tasking ability.
addons.title: Singularity

addons.text: Your unparalleled sight into figures within the space between worlds now allows you to immediately hone in on any interdimensional signature you’ve seen before, allowing you to travel to them directly.
addons.title: Worldchase

objects.text: You can now travel to more than just different worlds. Even the barriers of time and different timelines are nothing to you. There is no method that can now restrict your traversal. You can mentally leave and explore worlds without actually entering them for reconnaissance purposes and to get a better idea of where you might want to go.
objects.title: All Angles

addons.text: You can transport beings from other universes into and out of your worlds without subjecting them to the corrosive qualities the space between worlds usually hold for those unprepared for the travel.
addons.title: Fool's Opus

addons.text: You can overlay your created worlds onto your surroundings in the same manner as your summons. This can alter terrain, create structures that exist within your worlds, or even provide free access to your world's power sources depending on the purpose of the overlay.
addons.title: Applicable Knowledge

addons.text: Your worlds are completely a part of you. Their power is your power and vise versa, letting you draw more from them and affect them from outside them.
addons.title: Living History

addons.text: Your attunement to your planes grows as no matter where in the multiverse you may be, you are intuitively alerted whenever an extraplanar visitor enters one of your planes.
addons.title: Intruder Alarm

objects.text: Your ability to create worlds is now improved. No longer will your worlds be skewed to your own axis of power. You are also no longer limited in the size of the worlds you can create, and have no true limits on the kinds of limits you can enforce on the types of rules that reality will have. The only true requirements are understanding and power. You have the ability to fuse two worlds together, creating a new world with characteristics of both. This can be useful for creating new worlds with unique rules, combining the strengths of different worlds, or even merging worlds in order to prevent destruction. You also have complete awareness of anything on a world you have created.
objects.title: Planar Births

addons.text: Your ability to surveil other timelines and possibilities before traveling has allowed you to alter your summons, guiding them through speculative paths to emerge as another possible version of the same entity.
addons.title: Time Spiral

addons.text: Your creations are now able to traverse the space between worlds alongside you without succumbing to the detrimental effects that follow most of the unprepared. While this is the case, they are still extensions of your will, and cannot survive outside a world for long without your presence and attention.
addons.title: Invasion

addons.text: Thanks to your understanding of the the methods of universal travel, and yours' place within your soul, you can summon other travellers from Aether much like any other summon. This is not the actual traveller, but an accurate enough summon to mimic their main tricks at the point you summon them, like your other summons.
addons.title: Conflux

addons.text: You can now summon methods of interdimensional travel separate from their user, instilling it into an adjacent form. The travel device of a great inventor may create a blanket field of technological inspiration, for instance, while the portal spell of a particularly destructive mage may become a great battlefield-wide fireball.
addons.title: Legends

objects.text: You don't have to spend time researching or understanding a creature to summon it. Once you have seen a creature, and have sufficient power you can summon it. You can summon multiple copies of the same entity from the Aether. You can even summon new beings you have created from the Aether, and even possibly create creatures from the space between worldss itself.
objects.title: Absolute Summoning

addons.text: No longer restricted to locations on worlds, you can materialize within the the spaces between worlds. While this is potentially useful academically for assessing a world externally, it also allows you to intercept another inter-dimensional traveller with enough skill.
addons.title: Eternal Angles

addons.text: Your Summons are as much a part of you as the power they’re formed from, allowing you to instantly sacrifice them and return their energy to you. Should they die or be removed by other means, this still applies.
addons.title: Containing Multitudes

addons.text: Understanding both the birth of worlds, and the secrets of the soul, you can dictate the metaphysical core of any world you create. The core is the essence of a world, and reflects the world as much as the world reflects it. While designing the core won’t determine everything of the world's nature, it will cement a starting point.
addons.title: World's Core

addons.text: Your understanding of your soul, and of your own method of travel itself has finally allowed you to edit your own. Any effect you could have on another, you can do to yourself. Additionally, you now possess the ability to alter your own fundamental connection to universes physics & metaphysics itself, and the identity that once defined you.
addons.title: Immersion

objects.text: You are truly immortal now. You have no need for a form at all and can survive it's complete destruction. You will need mana to reform them however. As a being of pure magic and will, you are more tied into the flow of mana and can use it to easily track magic or see how spells are formed.
objects.title: True Immortality

objects.text: You are a true genius, for you are among the likes of Reed Richards, Tony Stark, and Victor von Doom. You have an incredible ability to process and visualize information, a perfect memory, and an incredible capacity to acquire knowledge. With reference materials on hand, you can acquire knowledge as fast as you can read. Knowledge builds on itself—the more related fields you master, the better understanding of them you develop. You can even discover entirely new fields with some effort by cross-referencing information you already know. While the most obvious application of these abilities is in science and technology, you are by no means limited to it. One to three days of study could allow you to learn any skill, be it martial arts or underwater basket weaving, to the point where you are proficient with it—the more you practice any of your skills, the better you become. Your rate of progress is dependent on the difficulty of what you are studying, fields such as magic can still take you many decades to master completely. You are, however, limited to what your body can handle, as this power by itself, does not allow you to surpass your physical limits or grant you the ability to wield supernatural powers. When you acquire new skills and expertise, you will never forget or become incapable of your peak accomplishments. With time, you will inevitably become a veritable Swiss Army Knife of incredible scientific knowledge, incredible feats of physical skill and much more. You can reach the power of Atlas in around a decade of study and practice. The more time you dedicate yourself to it, the shorter this time becomes.
objects.title: Polymath

addons.text:
Your mind has completely transcended any and all constraints of logic. Understanding inherently incomprehensible concepts, like counting to infinity or visualising infinite-dimensional space, is now as easy for you as it is for others to count fingers on their hand.

The protection of your mind has also become truly absolute. It has reached such level of complexity that attempting to read, influence, or harm is an exercise in futility. No matter the events, your mind will persist even should your body be extinguished, reality rewritten, and timelines collapse.
addons.title: N O U S

objects.text:
You are at the pinnacle of mental prowess. You have a near-limitless capacity to acquire and master skills of any variety, create genius inventions and techniques, and attain within minutes what mastery a lesser man might achieve in lifetimes.

Moreover, you require no outside knowledge to begin learning these skills, so long as you have sufficient materials. Spend a day in study and develop interplanetary space travel in your backyard. A week, and travel between stars and galaxies. An hour, and develop a cure for mankind's deadliest illnesses. While the most obvious application of these abilities is in science and technology, you are by no means limited to it.

In mere minutes of observation, you could become a master of martial arts. In hours, be creating fighting styles of your own. And a day's practice could make you humanity's greatest detective, its finest doctor, its most talented artist, or its most charismatic leader. Your rate of progress is dependent on the difficulty of what you are studying, fields such as magic can still take you months to years to master completely. However, you are limited to what your body can handle as this power, by itself, does not allow you to surpass your physical limits or grant you the ability to wield supernatural powers.

When you acquire new skills and expertise, you will never forget or become incapable of your peak accomplishments. With time, you will inevitably become a veritable Swiss Army Knife of incredible scientific knowledge, incredible feats of physical skill, and much, much more. In a matter of months, your technologies could advance civilization to its extremes, or make you into a transhumanist god. Nanobot enhancement, genetic recoding, cybernetics, quantum computing, and more may, within mere days, be in your grasp. Who else but you could imagine what might be possible in a year, or a decade? Your talent in all disciplines is quite literally all-encompassing. You have become the overman.
objects.title: Atlas

addons.text:
Every aspect of your mind is now being continuously backed up. In case of any damage or other undesired changes, even self-inflicted ones, your mind will automatically revert itself back to its prime condition.

No part of your memories or personality can ever be lost, whether through reality alteration or simple brain damage, for as long as you exist in some capacity, unless you personally desire so. Even then, the moment you change your mind and decide to retrieve what was lost, you can do so without any difficulty.
addons.title: Backup

objects.text: You have the ability to comprehend even the most complicated systems from the smallest scraps of information. An accurate but simple description of a phenomenon is sufficient to theorize about the principles that cause it. Simply observing the greatest technological marvels in operation is enough to derive their blueprints, with no need for precise measurements or advanced sensory capabilities. The usual risks of working with flawed information are much less significant to you. If the only possible conclusions from available data are incorrect, you can intuitively sense that further data is needed. Mistakes you make are much more likely to be quantitative than qualitative.
objects.title: Advanced Analytics

addons.text:
No longer do you have to spend time on coming up with a solution or improving your own sub-par designs. Your mind now automatically optimizes any and all designs you come up with within the confines of your own knowledge and intent behind it.

The moment you encounter a challenge, if it is at all possible to overcome it with the knowledge you possess, you will gain complete comprehension of every possible solution as well as understanding of possible ramifications. And when you carry out your plans, there is no chance to make an unintended mistake, barring the intervention of outside forces.
addons.title: Wave Function Collapse

objects.text: Your computational ability is entirely untethered from any and all limitations of your brain or mind. As long as your understanding is correct and your information sufficient, you can perfectly simulate even the most complicated scenarios. However, this has little impact on your problem-solving capabilities. A blueprint conjured up with barely a thought will still have any flaws inherent to its design, and the results of even a perfect simulation have to be analyzed to understand any implications it might have.
objects.title: Quantum Supremacy

addons.text:
You can separate parts of your mind into independent processing nodes. Each node has as much processing power as you choose to allocate and can even have custom personalities, which you can freely shape. These nodes can perform background tasks, such as managing your powers, or even pilot your body should you ever have the need for it.

As merely parts of your mind, those nodes always act in accordance with your will. You are always at least subconsciously aware of processes that constitute their "thoughts" and can, at any point, reabsorb them back into the main consciousness.
addons.title: Shards of Infinity

objects.text:
You can employ arbitrary numbers of parallel streams of thought, as well as speed up or slow down the perception of time of different portions of your mind.

Your understanding of yourself is perfect, allowing you to analyze and even dissect your own thinking processes and modify your own mental state and structure at will. With some effort, you can perfectly predict both the short- and long-term consequences of any changes you can make.

With repeated analysis and modification, you will always discover ways to improve any of your mental capabilities without sacrificing performance in other areas or losing anything that holds even the mildest importance to you. In addition, you are much more resilient against any eldritch truths you might discover and, over time, will inevitably incorporate them into your understanding of the universe—no different than the rest of your knowledge.
objects.title: Toposophic Emergence

objects.text:
Your Meridians are unlocked and you are capable of circulating Qi through them. You are at the first stage of your chosen cultivation system from any Xianxia or Xuanhuan media, and while you can learn multiple cultivation systems, it is not recommended if you don't have any protections or don't know what you are doing. You can pick up Dharma spells and techniques from any other system, and through arduous training you will be able to refine your body and spirit, to purify your essence, and distill it to attain higher levels. With each level you advance, you are capable of stronger and more fantastic feats.

You can hone and reinforce your body into a living weapon, force your life force into constructs to do your bidding, become a master of beastly transformations, or a natural at spell formations to turn the elements against your enemies. Whatever your chosen path, you are capable of great things.

The speed at which you can cultivate and attain higher levels is faster than most cultivators, as you are far more talented than the average cultivator. You can attain the realm/level equivalent to Great Sage in around a decade of regular study and practice. The more time you dedicate yourself to it, the shorter this time becomes.

An ancient spirit of knowledge has fused with your soul. This spirit is aware of all the core knowledge of cultivation in your system and beyond, meaning that not only would you not lack knowledge in anything related to cultivation and you can commune with this spirit to access their knowledge and learn new techniques or acquire knowledge of how to advance your path, and given enough time how to create your own system.
objects.title: Jade Disciple

addons.text:
As a protagonist, just about everything will be easier on you.
You will benefit more from training, becoming much more potent and advanced than other students.
You have a knack for finding long-lost items of great power and mentors of awe-inspiring might that can let you grow more powerful much more quickly. Techniques and training methods that might as well be cheating will practically fall into your lap.
Your enemies will have a hell of a time trying to put you down, any victories they have will be Pyrrhic, and as long as your defeat wasn't far too crushing you can bounce back at least somewhat stronger than before.
You will never be permanently killed by anything so mundane and pathetic as a mere fall down the stairs or choking on your food. Your plot armor is ridiculous, letting you get away scot-free with stuff that would maim or ruin others.
You will always find some way to defeat your enemy and will always find a means of gaining more power, skill, and influence so long as there is someone or something out there that can challenge you.
If you are not already, you will even find or get a way to not die of old age, and your life will be easier on you in all ways.
addons.title: Xianxia Protagonist

addons.text:
No one can contest the immense reservoir of knowledge that Li Qiye possesses; his wealth of wisdom is beyond adequate description. Attempting to grasp the magnitude of this is a challenge in itself. Across the expanse of the ten worlds, there exists scarcely a subject or facet he is not intimately acquainted with, from merit laws and techniques to grand daos, ancient history, the locations of invaluable artifacts, and much more. He commands an encyclopedic mastery of the entire epoch's contents, and it's quite conceivable that there's an even greater depth of knowledge he has chosen not to reveal.

You now inherit the totality of Li Qiye's understanding, willpower, knowledge and memories—every recollection, every experience, down to the minutest detail. This encompasses practical skills like alchemy and flame control, as well as the array of laws contained within his mental sea, which serve as proof of his identity. This includes the various Scriptures and even the technique he devised to cultivate multiple inner physiques. When I say everything, I mean even the knowledge he erased from his mind, all of it, it’s all there. You also gain his ‘profound gaze’, perfect memory, instant perfect recall, and an Index to easily sort through his immense knowledge. 

Furthermore, you gain access to a private pocket dimension that brims with each and every treasure and item that Li Qiye has amassed in his long, long live. Though, do note that you'll be restricted to utilizing only those treasures aligned with your level of prowess, as such most of the treasury may initially be beyond your reach, but over time, you will be worthy to use the entirety of this near-endless treasury. Exclusive access to this pocket dimension is yours alone—any intrusion from other entities will be met with retribution from the very heavens themselves.
addons.title: The Dark Crow (Emperor's Domination)

objects.text:
Your Meridians are unlocked and you are now a somewhat respectable cultivator in your chosen system. You are capable of using Qi and possess a potent reserve. You have just left the Mortal Realm and are well on your way to become an Immortal Cultivator. While mere mortals will have extreme difficulty wounding you, some Parahumans can bridge the gap somewhat, but in truth, only Endbringers can truly match you, and even then it will not be easy for them to defeat you. You have knowledge of a vast array of Qi techniques in many fields, and a deep knowledge of martial arts.

An ancient spirit of knowledge has fused with your soul, this spirit is aware of all the core knowledge of cultivation in your system and beyond, meaning that you would not lack knowledge in anything related to cultivation. You can commune with this spirit to access their knowledge and learn new techniques or acquire knowledge of how to advance your path, and given enough time, even how to create your own system.

Given your level of talent, you cultivate much faster than the normal cultivators. It can take you as little as half the time to advance your realm compared to normal cultivators in your chosen system, and with regular practice and study, you could reduce this time even more.
objects.title: Great Sage

addons.text:
You hold within your being the very heavenly bodies themselves.

From these celestial objects, you can create a singularity of fearsome and unrivaled power.

Nine Suns to carve a bottomless hole, dark as the Primordial void, Twelve Moons to forge a spiral crown, luminous as the Primordial spark.

Upon the full formation of the Stellar Golden Core Array, you are able to take the 9 suns and 12 moons to form the summit of potential in your Qi circulatory system, sacrificing them, allowing you to store a potentially infinite amount of Qi. Your Stellar Core Array will feed the hungering singularity within, increasing the speed, and efficiency of your Cultivation by one hundred and eight times. The power and swiftness of your Qi circulation are likewise enhanced, empowering all your techniques to a truly massive degree, as if the galactic core followed in their wake. Finally, your affinity for all Qi types is raised to the absolute pinnacle of potential.
addons.title: Celestial Infinity Devouring Core

addons.text:
Tribulations are the one thing that strikes fear into the hearts of cultivators everywhere. The fear of utter annihilation with no chance of survival is enough to make the hearts of countless cultivators go numb. Not for you, however, because you have conquered possibly the greatest hurdle that blocks your cultivation.
Tribulations never actually exceed what you could deal with, and before the advent of your tribulations you always get clear, if not completely prophetic feelings, nudging you towards the exact date of its occurrence.
addons.title: Tribulation​ ​Taker

addons.text:
You can navigate harsh terrains as though they were little more than friendly grasslands. Deep snow and sand, swamps, mountains, canyons, ruins, lush jungles, and even great bodies of water are no challenge to you.
If you desire you may allow yourself to ‘travel where the wind blows’, often times leading you to places of unexpected beauty, significance, or power.
addons.title: A Dangerous Road

objects.text: Your Meridians and the pathways in your body are formed in such a way as to not only make cultivation far easier, but allow you to form multiple golden cores. Eventually forming a stellar golden core array within yourself, making all your golden cores act as one. This would allow you to hold exponentially more Qi than any other cultivator at your level and rival cultivators several levels above your own. This also makes such things as unlocking and mastering your chakras far easier as your body can handle all types of energy far better.
objects.title: Grand Star Meridians Formation

addons.text: You have nine suns in your body that you can cultivate and grow. Adding them to your actions, such as hitting someone with the force of a sun, or unleashing their flames and heat. You start with one small sun which grows as you absorb Yang-aligned energy.
addons.title: Nine Sun Primordial

addons.text:
A solid foundation is one of the pillars that support cultivators in advancing. An unstable and shallow foundation would often lead to a failed breakthrough and at worst death.

With this you have a perfect and regenerating foundation. Your foundation automatically corrects any imperfections and defects in your cultivation caused by using external materials like pills, treasures, wrong cultivation techniques and many more.

Additionally, your cultivation base cannot be crippled under any circumstances.

Any conflicts with using two or more cultivation systems will be prevented, going so far as to allow you to progress in a system even when it should be impossible due to the nature of your advancements in the others.
addons.title: Perfect Foundation

addons.text:
You are inherently skilled with cultivation. Your training is ten times more effective than before, which by itself would probably put you on the edge of being a “Young Genius”. However, this boost actually doubles when you are learning things for yourself, rather than learning from a mentor, and removes all penalties which you might otherwise experience from the lack of instruction.

Any result of your breakthroughs will always have the highest results and you will never experience any bottlenecks that would prevent you from advancing. As a bonus this also prevents you from ever failing in advancing your cultivation systems, no matter the reason.
addons.title: Swiftly Advancing

addons.text:
Your combat strength is far, far more important than your cultivation speed.

You have the ability and talent to use your cultivation realm, combat skills, and techniques beyond their original capabilities without overdrawing or receiving significant damage to yourself.

This allows you to become invincible to those of the same level, be capable of fighting and winning against those that have a half-realm above you, and become equal to those that are one realm higher.

As a bonus this also greatly increase your cunning, wits and combat awareness in battle, allowing you to outmaneuver and use the environment to the fullest to emerged victorious even fighting a group a half-realm higher than you.
addons.title: Peerless Genius

objects.text: Your body is uniquely suited for Yang-aligned energy and thoughts. You can advance in Yang-aligned techniques with ease and cultivate significantly faster when taking paths that are Yang-aligned.
objects.title: True Yang Body

addons.text: You have twelve moons in your body that you can cultivate and grow. Adding them to your actions, such as hitting someone with the force of a moon, or unleashing frost and entropy. You start with one small moon which grows as you absorb Yin-aligned energy.
addons.title: Twelve Moon Primordial

addons.text:
A very important way used to improve one’s strength and abilities in this world is the use of herbs and medicines, and certain other substances such as crystals and other supplements.

You are especially fortunate in such things, possessing a body and soul that allows you to reap over thrice the normal rewards from any such methods you use. Regardless of whether they affect your body, soul or meridians, the rewards are immense enough to leave even veteran experts mind boggled.

At the same time, the harmful effects of any resources that normally would need to be processed to be consumed safely are entirely removed.
addons.title: Body of the Reaction God

addons.text:
You gain the ability to plan thousands upon thousands of steps ahead, capable of predicting thousands of unknown factors be it in combat to economics up to managing enormous empires.

The longer and farther reaching the plan the more solid and better it is, and once the plan is started someone cannot stop it with brute force alone unless they know everything about your plans or have strength enough to makes you helpless.

You also gain the ability to recognize plots and schemes that involved you unknowingly and instinctively know how to escape or ruin them.
addons.title: Thousands of Steps

addons.text: You cannot be overwhelmed by mere numbers. If an enemy would not present a threat to you in a one-on-one battle, then any number of similarly skilled foes are equally useless in the face of your martial prowess.
addons.title: Army Defying

objects.text: Your body is uniquely suited for Yin-aligned energy and thoughts. You can advance in Yin-aligned techniques with ease and cultivate significantly faster when taking paths that are Yin-aligned.
objects.title: True Yin Body

addons.text:
You are able to teach any learnable skill you possess, so long as they can be learned and taught rather than innate.

Your students advance in their learning by leaps and bounds in their studies under your personal tutelage, acquiring in days what would take others years to obtain. By the time they have completed their training, they will be just as competent as you are in these skills and will never forget what you have imparted.
Your students have an innate sense of loyalty to you and won’t betray you for their own gains.
addons.title: Master and Disciples

addons.text:
As an elder, you are the rock upon which your clan or sect rests. You are easily capable of inspiring awe and near worship in those weaker or simply less knowledgeable than you. The quantity and quality of people that you can draw in this way will naturally increase as you grow stronger and greater than them.
Unlike many elders in this world, however, you are immune to betrayal from beneath by simple fact that your people simply cannot betray you. The thought will never cross their minds and even supernatural coercion or interrogation cannot force them to betray your secrets or your trust.
addons.title: Revered Ancestor

addons.text:
You are able to figure out what is best in the way of training. Given the choice of ten different teachers, you would be able figure out which of them is the best for you, or for another, with minimal information about each teacher.

You also would be able to figure out how to use any technique no matter how poor your instruction, provided you are able to learn it to begin with.
addons.title: Guiding Instinct

addons.text:
There are places laden with riches, resources, the artifacts of legend, hidden techniques, and heaven-defying cultivation methods.

You are now capable of finding and obtaining all of that with very little effort or time on your part. That which was hidden can be coaxed into your lap like a river flowing into a lake.

Combined with the A Dangerous Road Addon it almost seems as if you were destined to be guided to such things, and they to you.
addons.title: A Cave Filled with Wonders

objects.text:
Passing your skills onto the next generation is the foundation of mortal society, what allows it to grow. The same thing could be said for immortal cultivators, but for the many mortals who populate the world, honing your life’s craft and passing it on to your progeny is a vital part of ensuring that their legacy continues. Be it wood carving, blacksmithing, painting or stranger.

You are a teacher and tutor without peer, capable of easily passing along your skills and knowledge to anyone who wants to learn from you. Beneath your gentle hand, even a moron could become a master of their craft in a mere fraction of the time it would have taken an average person. And if you were to teach that same average person? Their rate of growth and comprehension would have to be seen to be believed.

Even the most complicated and intricate systems, concepts or philosophies can be explained to anyone regardless of their pre-existing knowledge base and if you truly know better than someone then they will realize this rather than allow pre-conceptions, arrogance or outdated thinking to blind them to your teachings.

This will also allow you to awaken the Meridians of any mortal and teach them the art of cultivation.
objects.title: Grand Teacher

addons.text:
Your instincts are improved and strengthened to near precognition, allowing you to sense and predict any incoming attacks or danger to yourself no matter how exotic it is. You will instinctively know the exact location of the attacker, where the dangerous places around you are, and if someone has ill intent for you.
You also gain the ability to instinctively evade any attacks that can harm you and minimize it should the attack is too fast for your body to evade.

The range of this ability scales with your cultivation and experience.
addons.title: Heightened Instincts

addons.text:
Normally a cultivator would just follow the footsteps of the predecessors, only learning and mastering existing techniques without any innovation, with only those that reach the high levels of cultivation creating new ones.
But now, you can create new ideas, innovations, variations and applications from existing techniques, as well merging two or more techniques into one unique technique. This also applies to fusing two or more elements, concepts, etc. into one, with the result possessing all of their advantages and none of their weaknesses or drawbacks.

This also allows you to upgrade or improve existing cultivation techniques as well re-creating missing and incomplete techniques. With the help of this upgrade making truly heaven-defying techniques or even greater would be a lot easier and creating cultivation methods appropriate to your cultivation realm are also possible.
addons.title: Martial Innovator

addons.text:
To succeed in this world, you must be a great genius like no other, even among the luminaries of your generation. With this, you will be.

Your rate of learning new things, techniques, ideas, and even entirely new arts is something almost beyond imagining. You are a genius, the kind of person who can master entire martial styles, or new fields of practice, in days, weeks at the most.

This doesn’t just affect your mind, either. Your body can keep up perfectly with everything your mind learns, growing at an equal pace with every new insight you gain.
addons.title: Bewildering Brilliance

addons.text:
You possess significant beauty, charisma, and social skills. Those who interact with you in an amicable manner find it a joy to continue their relationship with you, whatever it may be. You know your way around society, and society will gladly accommodate you.
In addition, you find it easier to learn the ways of foreign civilizations, and foreigners will tend to treat you better than they would have without this power.
addons.title: Good Breeding

objects.text: You are now something else, something different... You are an absolute freak of nature in the arts of cultivation and understanding of the Dao.  mastering any Dao/aspect of cultivation to Grand levels would take you maybe thirty years or so, and reaching a God Realm would take you thousands of years rather than the tens/hundreds of thousands years it might take others through sheer brute force. Even becoming a True immortal would be an inevitability rather than a mere possibility, though the time it would take you could vary widely. And that’s without any specializations. You may pick a personal Dao and one aspect of Cultivation such as Formations, Beast Arts, Sword Arts, Spacetime, etc, in which you absolutely excel, to the point where it would allow you to fight others one realm higher than you, and train in it at an absolutely astonishing pace
objects.title: Freak of Nature

objects.text:
You tread the Path of The Warrior. Your martial talent and prowess are supreme amongst mortals and in a fight you are peerless. Your body and skill are trained to no limit and something like the peak doesn’t exist. Reaching the peak of what is considered the limit allows you to begin to tread those paths as well, allowing you to break the laws of physics themselves to achieve impossible feats. As you face threats, your strength and skills grow at accelerated rates in response.

You possess the heart of a noble knight and can stand up seemingly to any insurmountable obstacle with an unbreakable will. With the Path of Warriors, you have the talent and skills surpassing that of a natural-born genius in fighting, spatial awareness, tactical thinking, and so on. As you continue to learn, you can develop martial arts that embody other concepts. Allowing you to learn the paths and add them to your arsenal, there are no limits to what Paths you can learn and develop. By treading different paths your body grows stronger to accommodate and match it; with mastery, you can even imbue your actions with them. Embodying various Paths, you not only get stronger but can also gain traits and abilities that would grant passive benefits. Walking the Path of Health can grant healing and regeneration while the Path of Sword allows you to use anything as a sword and even have Sword intent. As you further tread a Path it can further evolve into a Way. The Way of Health could completely restore someone to full health conceptually, even recovering their sanity and fatal injuries perfectly. A Way can imbue your actions with Conceptual properties. For example, the Way of Mortality can impart the Concept of Mortality onto Immortal foes with an action. This does not mean you can win against anyone in a fight; however, you can have the potential to do so. However, such a Way would take a long time to tread if you don’t already tread a similar Path.

With the Path of The Warrior, you can master any form of martial technique or martial arts in a matter of days to the point where you could be called a grandmaster at it. There is no restriction to what you can learn techniques, be it esoteric or mundane. And the only limit to what Path you can tread is that you must be able to do it. You cannot tread the Path of Wings without Wings, or the Path of Three Armed Martial Arts without three arms. However, you can create very specific Paths that can counter foes, such as Path of Anti-Undead or Path of Anti-Dragons.
objects.title: Path of the Warrior

addons.text: You've reached the state of a self-sustaining singularity. Your body is akin to the Universe, capable of housing and creating an infinite spectrum of Concepts. A Concept for every Word in the human dictionary and more. Understanding everything Humanity has ever Conceptualized and beyond, you expand them infinitely. Your actions are enforced by your own self, everything you do is Conceptual. And everything against you is Conceptualized. Being maintained by every Concept ever conceived and beyond, you cannot be harmed by anything that can be thought of. You have a Concept for everything. Even if it's for Concepts that don't exist or hasn't even been made yet. And yet your actions are completely Absolute.
addons.title: W O R L D

objects.text:
You are the Embodiment of Warriors, a Concept in physical form. With the Way of The Warrior, your martial prowess surpasses the imagination of gods. Your skills are leagues above others; you stand as the uncontested master of martial arts. The Concept of Warriors grants you an incredibly powerful body with strength and speed that are nearly unmatched. Only Immortal Cultivators and Endbringers can match you in either front. Your body and skills possess no limits and can be trained even further without stopping. Facing a threat, your strength and skill grow at a much faster rate when compared to the path of the warrior in response to the threat. 

You possess the heart of a royal king and can face any obstacle with an unbreakable will. With Way of The Warrior, you surpass even the Concept of geniuses. A monster of geniuses in fighting, spatial awareness, tactical thinking, and so on. With mastery, you can surpass your limits and tread various Paths that embody other Concepts. There is no limit to the number of Ways you can learn and develop. By treading various Ways, your body grows stronger and better to accommodate and match the Concept; with mastery, you can even imbue your actions with them. Embodying a Concept not only allows you to get stronger but can also grant traits and abilities that would grant passive benefits. Walking Way of Speed could let you instantaneously move from one point to another, and Way of Survival could let you traverse space easily. By facing foes, you can learn new Paths that counter them easily, and already knowing a similar Path or Way can further increase mastery. This does not mean you can win against anyone in a fight; however, you can have the potential to do so. With sufficient prep time, you can learn and develop counters to things you know about. 

You are also able to master any form of martial technique or martial arts in a matter of minutes to hours, to the point where you could be called a grandmaster at it. There is no restriction to what you can learn, be it esoteric or mundane. You likely already know a large selection of martial arts and even several esoteric ones. You can even create Paths that specifically anticipate and counters a target. Such as a Path of Anti-Magic or a Path of Anti-Evolution. You likely know several Paths already that can easily expand to include something like them.
objects.title: Way of The Warrior

addons.text: You use a blade as a spear, a glaive as an axe, and a fist as a bow. Within your perfect harmony, you can use anything as anything to perfect enlightenment. Never are you unarmed, your prowess is unfettered by whatever you have on hand. And with a powerful weapon to go alongside you, you can unleash more power than you ever could before. Within you is a dance of perfect death, how it’s expressed could be done however you wish.
addons.title: Blade of Grass

addons.text: No artificial weapon or natural weapon can harm you. No blade can cut your skin, no spear can pierce your flesh, and no hammer can break your bones. You're completely immune to all forms of physical damage.
addons.title: God Skin

addons.text: You possess an infinite amount of memory that can store even muscle memory. You can continue training all your skills and they would never degrade, only improve even after a thousand years of not moving.
addons.title: Muscle Memory

addons.text: You can interact with the air, land, or even Concepts. Anything that couldn’t normally be touched or interacted with. You can even see them. By being able to physically interact with them, you can punch ghosts to death and shatter physical laws.
addons.title: Order

objects.text: You have begun to reach a state of rationalizing and calculating the functions of the mind. Your mind reacts, your soul decides, and your body acts. The harmony between the three can act in perfect unison, perfected to an extreme. To always act as you want, unaffected by external pressure. Changeless in any situation, you’ve reached a state of enlightenment no matter what you're doing. Just by breathing you progress deeper into your Way ever than before, just by acting it is more powerful than ever.
objects.title: Harmony

addons.text: You can combine every skill, martial art, and technique you know into a single comprehensive art. You can use multiple different ways at the same time, stacking them on top of each other simultaneously.
addons.title: Act as One

addons.text: Through your Way, you reduce the effects done to you. Lethal curses become mild sickness and the Concept of Death becomes major injuries. It could be seen as minimizing the damage done to you passively.
addons.title: Defensive Stance

addons.text: You can use the most unusable of items as highly efficient weapons. It doesn’t matter how inefficient or terrible the technique is, you can use it beyond maximum potential. The more similar techniques you have the greater in power.
addons.title: It Just Works

addons.text: Putting your willpower into the area around you. You can interact with the very location and alter the rules of how the world works. Replacing it with whatever you so desire, the more Ways you possess the greater in power and range it will become. With enough Ways it can even apply special effects based on them once they become self-sufficient.
addons.title: Arena

objects.text: You know many techniques and special martial arts. A long series of different ways to punch or kick. You could even use martial arts to manifest energy beams or create weapons. This is extended to your Way. You can use the various martial arts you know and apply your Way to them. With the Way of Death, you could shoot lasers that apply the Concept of Death, with the Way of Damage you could create attacks that ignore any form of defense. You can mix and match how your Ways are expressed.
objects.title: Mixed Art

addons.text: Harmonizing and matching the world around you, stepping into the greater cosmos. You have begun to never need sustenance. Your way fuels your body just like it protects you. You’ve even halted aging, able to go back to your prime whenever you wish.
addons.title: Monk

addons.text: Just by watching another you can replicate their moves perfectly and even take it a step forward. You can break down, understand, and incorporate their methods into your own and generate your very own versions.
addons.title: Copy Cat

addons.text: Your mind is strong. You're capable of resisting the things that most would break. You are immune to any attempts to control or manipulate your mind.
addons.title: Preservation

addons.text: Effects not tied to damage are ignored. You could breathe through poison mist, walk on the moon without protection, and even negate any kind of identification on you. You are always able to get your footing, even in space. The only thing able to affect you would be something like a poisoned blade. A purposeful attack that applies an effect. You are immune to environmental effects, even able to stand in a black hole.
addons.title: Protection

objects.text: What starts the Way than with the foundation? The basic building blocks that make up and forge the path ahead. An emphasis on the basics, a steady yet simple approach that lets you reach into the extreme. The Way enhances your foundation like how your technique made the Way. Like the importance of stable footwork, the Way creates a stable body. Resisting the effects of external forces, you can use the Way of Kinetic to be immune to kinetic attacks.
objects.title: Foundation

addons.text: You can imagine imaginary foes and begin developing your Path to defeat them. It would be as if you were truly there. You can even face past foes to further refine your techniques before you meet them again.
addons.title: Shadow Boxing

addons.text: You can learn anything you want, powered by nothing but your Way and pure skill you can ignore the limitations of esoteric arts. You can learn them without mana or qi, replicating them perfectly despite lacking qualifications. There is nothing you can’t learn and use.
addons.title: Replicate

addons.text: You're immune to anything that tries to manipulate your abilities and powers. Weakening, sealing, removing, and so on don’t work against you. As you tread the path of many Ways, your path can never end or be hindered.
addons.title: Trailblaze

addons.text: Your interactions with reality are different, taking more direct inspiration from myths. You’re a living legend, you're capable of simply plain old impossible feats. You could shoot down the sun with a bow and arrow or drag the moon across the sky. You can do what is considered impossible rather easily.
addons.title: Myth

objects.text: Everything is born from something, there is an origin to every idea and every concept. While you tread the path of something truly unique, the history left behind isn’t forgotten. New paths can be made from them, new ideas could develop in ways you never intended. While you blaze the trail, you can teach others the Paths you travel. And even without your guidance, they can develop in ways that you can take inspiration from. As they follow in your footsteps, you learn from their own Paths. And even you can take notes in your own Way to create new Paths.
objects.title: History

addons.text: Your inspiration from nature can be unified and connected. Your techniques are Self-Correcting, and your Paths are Self-Growing. They are endless in both creativity and limit. Your Way becomes better, it can both absorb and negate Conceptual effects as well. Absorbing it and creating a Path without needing to reach the pinnacle of martial arts.
addons.title: Living Nature

addons.text: You have simultaneous awareness of all timelines, with so many different perspectives and possibilities you cannot fully die until all your possibilities are killed. With an infinite timeline, you must die infinitely.
addons.title: Nature's Many

addons.text: You can accelerate your healing rate with concentration and breathing. You have reached total control over your physical body. You can control your very own adrenaline and emotions. You're immune to all forms of mental altercations and can tell if someone is trying to manipulate you.
addons.title: Meditation

addons.text: There are many forms of combat, and not all of them are direct. You can maneuver through subtle manipulation and outwit even the most manipulative of people. You can control the flow of conversations rather easily.
addons.title: Social Life

objects.text: The idea of something to be learned is not limited to what you can do. You can gain inspiration from the world around you, make techniques from nature, and create paths that are impossible. You can walk the Path of Three Wings despite not having three wings. You must be aware of yourself and your actions. To take in what you observe into yourself and work with them. Your senses are far sharper than normal and your foresight is unparalleled.
