You are like a grand sage of wisdom, your mental fortitude and patience are infinite.
objects.title: Nature

objects.text: "You have potential, my apprentice, but it remains to see if you can live up to my high expectations." Your ability to manipulate mana, one of the fundamental energies of the multiverse, is unlocked. Your mana core has just ignited and has an above average capacity and regeneration rate, enough to cast around 20 novice or 5 adept spells before you need to rest for an hour, and it can also be improved and refined with various spells and rituals. You have an innate knowledge of the three fundamental branches of magic and an above average talent. Conjuration, the shaping of mana into constructs that produce specific effects, more commonly known as spells. You start with a wide selection of cantrips and novice spells at your disposal that range from elemental missiles and barriers to scrying spells and dark curses. Enchantment, the creation of objects powered by mana, capable of producing the same effects as conjuration, but anchored to objects. You know an array of novice ritual circles that allow you to implant artificial mana cores and create things like foci, accessories, crystals, and other basic enchanted items. And Alchemy, the creation and transmutation of matter using mana, from potions that produce effects when ingested or thrown to esoteric metals and gems to use in enchantments, the creation of devices, or armor. You know an array of novice alchemy circles to create basic reagents and potions, and how to build the necessary equipment to practice your craft. A vast library of grimoires about the three branches of mana manipulation has been implanted into your soul—you can read them in your mind or materialize the tomes if you prefer the feel of paper. (note: the tomes are mana constructs, not real books, and you can dismiss them at your leisure, even if they are not in your possession.) With this power, you can reproduce any magic system from first principles and even create your own. The library contains several broad magic systems to get you started and new sections will become available as you grow. If you have other magic systems, you can integrate them into Sorcerer Apprentice, this will expand your library to include the theories and spells from those systems up to the highest level of mastery, and also allows you to fuel all spells using your mana core, even if the original tradition relies on other methods. While this ability has no theoretical upper limit, the more complex and powerful conjurations will test your knowledge. Over time, as your understanding of magic expands, you can discover new branches of magic beyond the primary three. With enough time, you will be able to reach heights only the gods can dream of but be careful not to break reality or destroy your soul on your journey there. You can reach the power of Sorcerer Supreme in around a decade of study and practice. The more time you dedicate yourself to it, the shorter this time becomes.
objects.title: Sorcerer Apprentice

addons.text:
Inscribed upon your very soul is the Sigil of the Archmage—the magnum opus of sorcery—written in the primordial runes that underpin the very foundation of the multiverse, and proof that you have reached the pinnacle of sorcery. This mark can manifest on your body as an intricate tattoo if you wish it, as proof of your achievement for all to see.

Not only have you mastered the three fundamental branches of sorcery, you expanded upon them and unlocked the secrets of true magic, known only to a select few. As an experienced archmage, you know dozens of magical traditions and can easily engineer more should you wish to. You possess several dozen fully-developed magic cores with a wide array of specializations. 

The breadth and depth of your mental library matches that of your skill as an archmage—grimoires on sorceries thought lost to time, manuscripts on primordial runes written on pages of pure space, tomes of alchemy on the transmutation of substances only theorized about, and many other obscure and esoteric subjects.

While this sigil is active, you fear not the ravages of time nor disease, for you are beyond them. Your body will forever maintain optimal condition, no matter what age or form you choose to appear as. Wounds inflicted upon your body, mind, or soul that are not fatal will heal and leave no scars. Using the sigil, you can sense all supernatural effects in a sphere around you, be they psychic, spiritual, or exotic in origin, and can analyze or disrupt their framework. The further the effects are, the weaker your influence over them becomes, slipping beyond your grasp after 500 meters and awareness after 5000 meters.

The sigil allows you to tap into an inexhaustible well of mana to replenish your reserves or empower your workings. However, while the well is infinite, the capacity of your soul to channel that energy is not. Many foolish archmages have met their untimely demise while attempting to reach for more than what they could handle, their soul burned to nothingness by the resulting manablaze.

Another function of the sigil is to host your Sanctum Sanctorum, a minor plane which hosts your personal workshop, mental library, and other amenities. You are able to open portals to the Sanctum from the outside and return from where you came easily, but can only open gates to destinations you are already familiar with from within.
addons.title: Height of Occultism

objects.text: "At last, the student has surpassed the master." This title proves that you stand far above the rest and have your place among the greatest sorcerers. Your mana core has been upgraded countless times and has an incredible capacity to generate, store, and transfer mana, enough to cast and maintain dozens of master spells at once with no perceivable strain, as only highly complex or incredibly powerful spells will significantly drain your reserves. If you were to empty your core completely, it would take around six hours to completely refill. Your mastery of magic covers not only the three fundamental branches of magic, where you have developed many sub-fields and specializations, but also a dozen complex magic systems. Not only do you know thousands of spells and are able to use complex meta-magic to alter their functions, but your skill is such that you are also able to create more on the fly when the need occurs, even during stressful situations like combat. While your magical creations are not quite on par with those of legends, most will not be able to tell the difference. Your skill at alchemy allows you to create potions of incredible power and transmute almost any material—both mundane and magical—and also conjure them from pure ether when necessary. Somehow, you have still not managed to exhaust the contents of the library, always finding new tomes with obscure magical knowledge and spells. Somewhere in there is the key to reach even greater heights and discover forms of magics that most can only dream of and it's only a matter of time until you find them. If you have other magic systems, you can integrate them into Sorcerer Supreme, which will expand your library to include the theories and spells from those systems up to the highest level of mastery, allow you to fuel all spells using your mana core, and also increase the level at which you start to that of an experienced mage. With dedicated practice, you can double your power every decade. However, keep in mind that great power comes with great dangers, so be careful where you venture, Sorcerer, for there is always a bigger fish.
objects.title: Sorcerer Supreme

addons.text: Your spells and mana remain under your control, unable to be influenced by outside sources. This results in your spells becoming eternal, unaffected by the passage of time. You have the ability to convert one form of magical energy into another with perfect efficiency as they all pale in comparison to pure mana. There are many ways to use Magic, and for you, insofar as casting methods are concerned, there are no hard limits. Your entire body is your greatest magical focus, allowing you to cast spells in ways their magic systems might not normally allow. Some examples are silent casting verbal magic and wandless casting wand magic.
addons.title: Paradise

addons.text: You are able to ignite a mana seed in an individual, allowing them to eventually grow into a sorcerer of the same type as you. People you awaken can gain a spirit version of you, whether they receive this spirit version of you is dependent on your will. This spirit will simply be another portion of your mind that you are able to access at any time. You will receive a copy of every single spell your students use and create. You are able to give a student direction and experience in using a spell you wish to teach.
addons.title: Ignition

addons.text: You have removed all inefficiencies and waste from your magic as well as improved their stability. Such is your mastery of magic that spells you cast no longer interfere with each other unless that is your intention. Casting a fireball that is covered by ice can be done with ease, unleashing the fire inside upon impact. You may make dastardly creations like Frostfire or Fiendfyre with ease. When you speak, magic listens—even without the direct intent of casting magic, you will find that, on occasion, an opponent's spell will misfire or be slightly off-course when they had you dead to rights. Or Maybe your healer's spell is much more effective than it should have been when they went to heal you.
addons.title: Stable Care

addons.text: You create spells with ease as if there was never any concern for failure. The more you use a spell, the stronger it gets—this is because your spells accrue damage multipliers for enemies defeated or an increase in efficiency for an incredible feat. Killing a dragon with a basic magic missile could have your magic missiles become increasingly effective against all further dragons you face off against. Defending a city with a barrier spell will have your barriers begin to protect your charges against more than physical or magical damage, possibly protecting them from things like heartbreak. These extra modifiers are entirely optional and only apply when you wish them to.
addons.title: Meta-Magic

objects.text: There are dozens of ways this is described throughout different magical cultures but they all boil down to the same thing—being loved by magic itself. You have instinctual and perfect control over all your magic, requiring barely a flicker of thought to gather your mana. Spells you cast have no charge-up time and come into effect nearly instantaneously. This has also allowed you to remove all impurities from your mana, causing magical creatures and sensitive mages to adore your presence and grow stronger from it, as it shows them what it means to be loved by Magic itself.
objects.title: Beloved by Magic

addons.text: Mana is a fundamental energy of the universe and when in your hands, it can't be suppressed or snuffed off, your magical effects can now ignore any innate magical resistances or protections. Your internally cast spells will begin to increase in power at no cost or thought the longer they are stored. Your body is constantly shifting to be in peak condition, and your innate magic resistance is in line with those of the strongest dragons. Even when you die, you can enter a temporary form of undeath that will last until you are able to resurrect yourself.
addons.title: Absolute Magic

addons.text: Each specialized Core gives you an innate resistance to that type of magic—the more specific the specialization, the better the resistance. Spells you store in your body can be unleashed at once without regard for your normal multi-casting limit. You are able to cast grand rituals requiring dozens of participants using your entire body as an instrument of magic.
addons.title: Growing Resistance

addons.text: You are magic in motion, constantly refining yourself with every action. Walking enough could have each and every step take you farther than you could possibly stride, eventually moving miles with each step without any thought required. Wanting to hide could allow you to shrink yourself or possibly jump into a shadow to avoid detection. Casting the same spell over and over again could see the mana required dip to almost nothing. When you attempt to improve these things, they will increase in bounds greater than they would passively.
addons.title: Perpetual Refinement

addons.text: You are able to turn your stored spells into Legacy spells, reducing the amount of mana required to cast them. Legacy spells gain more power the more you use them and are able to be passed down to your children through your genetics. You are able to cast an intricate ritual to adopt someone into your Legacy. As the founder of these Legacy spells, you gain more power as more individuals gain access to, and use your Legacy spells.
addons.title: Legacy

objects.text: Every cell in your body is saturated with the fundamental force that is mana. Due to this, when wielded by you, magic can't be suppressed or snuffled, and all attempts to block it will fail. Your spells grow more potent and any consequences from dangerous magic or misspells are greatly mitigated. You are also particularly skilled at preparing contingent spells, allowing them to be cast whenever some pre-chosen conditions are fulfilled, such spells can activate even if you are asleep, incapacitated, or even dead.
objects.title: Infused with Mana

addons.text: The unique abilities given to your specialized cores are even stronger. Cores no longer receive a weaker boost for broader specializations. You may strengthen the Core-granted abilities, and with enough time and effort, they can reach Isekai Cheat Skill levels of power. You are now able to give each Core two specializations—they can be the same or different, and the ability to reflect this combination.
addons.title: Specialist

addons.text: Your mana-infused body allows for incredible passive growth for all your seeds and Cores, which begin to constantly take mana from your cells at no cost to you. This passive growth receives the same multiplier that the effects of practice and rituals have—a multiplier based on your total number of cores. Eventually, you will be able to plant multiple magic seeds at the same time, with no reduction in growth speed.
addons.title: Superior Soil

addons.text: You are able to cast spells with ambient magic. These spells cast will be weaker than if you were to cast with your own mana, but they will still be affected by your Core-granted abilities and have no magical cost on your end. Specialized Cores occasionally give you a high-level insight into whatever the target specialization is. These insights will qualitatively affect all spells of the specialization’s magic.
addons.title: Shortcut

addons.text: You are able to link a Core to an artifact, binding it to yourself until you unlink it. The linked artifact will receive the linked growth of your cores with the same multiplier. These artifacts can be utterly destroyed and will be reformed inside of your Core in due time. These artifacts will receive increased benefits depending on what the linked Core’s specialization is.
addons.title: Connect Cores

objects.text:
You are able to form a magic seed that will grow into a Nascent Mana Core, the additional core then will grow at an increased rate until it catches up to your main core. In addition to this increased rate of passive growth, the effects of practice and rituals are multiplied by your total number of cores. Once your new core has caught up to your main core, you may link your cores together, allowing all linked cores to share the same amount of growth across one another.

Each additional core allows you another 'instance' of casting, multiplicatively increasing the number of spells you can cast simultaneously. You can cast spells and do rituals that require multiple people on your own by using linked cores as a fill-in for another person.

Once you have linked the newest core, you may begin to form another seed. Each additional core linked increases your Mana Concentration, allowing you to get more magic out of a smaller quantity of mana. Linked cores also increase your total mana throughput, allowing you to cast both higher quality and quantity of spells at once. You may repeat this process infinitely as there is no limit to the number of cores you can have.

Once you have linked your third core, you may begin to permanently designate cores as specialized, allowing them to perform a specific branch of magic at a much higher level than a regular core. The specialization can be something as broad as Conjuration, or something as niche as Repair of Small Objects, though the broader it is, the lesser the boost it provides. Each specialized core forms a unique ability fit for whichever has been selected. It's up to you to form your own path beyond this step. Nothing is off-limits for you in regards to magic, only time will be able to stop you, and not for much longer.
objects.title: Core Matrix

addons.text: You are able to identify spells by feeling alone, allowing you to sense an opponent's spell before it has even been cast and form a counter-spell with enough practice. Flashes of insight can occur with a much higher frequency, and always in a subject you would appreciate. With enough practice, you could even break down a spell before it has been fully formed.
addons.title: Return to Sender

addons.text: You can gain a mental image of an object you lay hands on down to the molecular level. You replicate anything you scan with ease, no matter how magically complicated it is. Your contingency spells are able to gain a slice of your mind no matter the conditions, allowing you to no longer have to worry about limited activating conditions. Your entire body acts as a magnifier for your mana sense, increasing your detection radius by a magnitude.
addons.title: Analysis

addons.text: Your Cores will constantly grant low levels of insight without conscious thought or direction, this insight is always in an area of magic you would appreciate. Each specialized Core grants you an incredible affinity to whatever magic is chosen—a Core specialized in Spatial Magic could have you developing a fine level of spatial awareness, and a Core specialized in Book Magic could have you develop an intuition toward sources of important arcane knowledge. These affinities are not static things, growing as you use and experience more.
addons.title: Whisper

addons.text: You are able to identify all sorts of magical materials through feel alone, be they metals, plants, or mixtures. With enough practice, you could even replace materials with your own mana in their place. Making a sword with no forge, replacing a rare ingredient with your own magic to form a potion—the possibilities are endless. Your magic will remember all of the forms it has taken, only having to achieve a form once for you to replicate it again with ease, no matter the initial challenge.
addons.title: Substitute

objects.text: You are attuned to magical forces to a high extent. You can intuitively feel the flows and nature of magic, and you can sometimes have flashes of inspiration that let you figure things out or invent a new spell. Eventually, you will be able to copy any spell you see and send it back to the caster improved. When working with magic, you will find that everything just comes easier to you, to the point that you are able to just will your magic together in hopes of a certain effect and have it succeed. Your spells will passively refine themselves to be more in line with what you want. The limitations of magic break down in front of your very eyes when researching for long enough.
objects.title: Attunement

addons.text: Your enchantments are always better than you plan for, as magic itself will ensure you always receive its aid. This could be something as simple as shoring up the weaknesses in your enchantment, or something as major as cementing an item's legacy, allowing it to be soul-bound to a lineage it was designed for. Your artifacts will even be able to grow a limited form of awareness due if you so wish.
addons.title: Spiritual

addons.text: You are able to retract enchantments from your magical artifacts, storing them inside your body, allowing you to apply them to another item at any time. These stored enchantments will gain more and more power the longer they are stored. With enough practice, you will be able to gift these enchantments to other people through some marking, be it a tattoo, crest, or what have you.
addons.title: Retract

addons.text: You may go beyond the creation of simple golems, shaping magic into people underneath your hands. You may plant a magic seed inside of an artifact that will grow into an ego—when applied correctly, you are able to give life to a new person with enough time and care. You may use a magic seed to make a Magical Focus the world has never seen before, the magic seed can instead bind to the next person that picks up the artifact, or be a person of your choice.
addons.title: Gardener

addons.text: You are able to meditate on an enchantment you wish to design and will find some form of insight if you ponder it long enough. Artifacts created by you can eventually begin to grow to best fit their wielder, and these growths will become the new baseline when an artifact is passed onto its next wielder. You can replicate artifacts on sight with enough practice.
addons.title: Enlightenment

objects.text: You are able to craft magical items akin to Excalibur and Avalon. Every material you use for Enchantment and Alchemy can be enhanced to its best natural quality—rusty scraps turn to fresh, perfectly forged metals, and burnt-out unhealthy plants shift into well-cared-for alchemic ingredients through the infusion of mana. You are able to create items that will grow as they are used, armor that becomes more resistant as it withstands more. Magical Foci are perfectly fit for their wielder and can be made with ease.
objects.title: Artifact Extraordinaire

objects.text: Your psionic potential has been unlocked. You start out with low-level psionic power and an intuitive knowledge of basic techniques (telekinesis, telepathy, barriers, etc.). You are able to train yourself to become more powerful. You have an uncanny intuition for developing new techniques and refining existing ones. A library of memories about psionic techniques has been implanted into your mind. You will need to meditate and experience the memories and understand them but all the knowledge you need is at your fingertips. With enough time, you will be able to develop into a psychic god capable of rewriting reality on a whim, but the road there will be long and arduous—be careful not to lobotomize yourself on your journey. You can reach the power of Almighty Mind in around a decade of study and practice. The more time you dedicate yourself to it, the shorter this time becomes.
objects.title: Nascent Mind

addons.text: The endless potential of the mind is at your beckoned call. It's said that a description of everything around you is perceived by your senses and built within your mind. You can change your perception, and thus, the world itself. Altering its very fundamentals is like child's play to you. You can control even the uncertain unobserved and manipulate it to change the very fabric of reality. What you don’t know becomes something that assists you. You can do whatever you want to do if you close your eyes and wish anything can come true. Whatever you desire and whatever you want or need is yours to possess with a simple flicker of thought.
addons.title: M A X

objects.text:
Your psionic potential has been unlocked. You start out with high-level psionic power and an intuitive knowledge of a vast array of techniques (telekinesis, telepathy, barriers, etc.). You are able to train yourself to become even more powerful. You have an uncanny intuition for developing new techniques and refining existing ones.

A library of memories about psionic techniques has been implanted into your mind. You will need to meditate and experience the memories and understand them but all the knowledge you need is at your fingertips.

With enough time, you will be able to develop into a psychic god capable of rewriting reality on a whim, but the road there will be long and arduous—be careful not to lobotomize yourself on your journey. At this level of power, it takes you around a decade to double your power.
objects.title: Almighty Mind

addons.text: You can follow the future more accurately than before. Your precognitions are not only more accurate but can be used at any distance. You could even predict those hidden beyond the material world.
addons.title: Trace Route

addons.text: If you can recall them, you can track them based on the information you know about them. The more information, the more accurate it is and it works better if you have an object they used. But once you have tracked them once, you can always come back to them.
addons.title: Favorite

addons.text: You could view your future self and assist yourself—or is it calling your past selves to assist you now? Regardless, you can call forth and connect to alternate versions of yourself from various points in time to multiply your power. Due to your atemporal nature, you could even ignore the chains of fate. Whatever future that may be in store for you are yours to decide and no other.
addons.title: Backseat Gaming

addons.text: By watching the effects of others, you can reproduce them. You can also create your very own spin-off based on it and improve it just like any other normal psychic power.
addons.title: Virtual Box

objects.text: You can see the uncertain future, the underlying mechanics that guide what is to be. You're able to use your psychic powers to gain information that you couldn’t possibly know, predicting the outcomes of events before they even happen. While there are many ways of doing so, you can pick your flavors. While not limited to, you're capable of all the various forms of precognition, ranging from vague prophecies to palm reading. Not only are they accurate on their own, but the vaguer it is, the more accurate. You can even read those that would be blind spots to your vision, albeit extremely vaguely.
objects.title: Precognition

addons.text: Your power can interact with the many worlds and universes that make up the greater whole of the multiverse. You can view alternate dimensions and universes, and even exert your powers from a different universe altogether.
addons.title: Parallel Worlds

addons.text: You can mentally recreate the past so accurately that you could simulate entire universes. This not only allows you to recreate events, but if you practiced Telepathy, you could even read their minds.
addons.title: The Past Worlds

addons.text: Those who think about you, even vaguely, lights up in your metaphysical psychic senses like fireflies. You’ll be able to sense the conversation or their thoughts, their opinions, and their minds—you could even influence their thoughts from wherever they are. You can choose to ignore them as well and log them in your infinite memory to recall later should you desire. You can’t be distracted from these things.
addons.title: Nameless One

addons.text: You can astrally project an image of yourself anywhere that can interact with the real world. You're no longer limited to your mortal body and can survive without a physical vessel. Your existence lives wherever you wish. You are truly omnipresent within your infinite range. There are no differences between your real body and an Astral Projection, but no matter how many bodies you have, they are all controlled by one mind. You're immune to even the complete erasure of your being.
addons.title: Astral Projection

objects.text: Your psychic powers are no longer limited to your general surroundings, as you can extend them further than before. From where you are to the edge of the universe, there are no limits to how far your psychic powers can perceive. What you can see is what you can affect, and there is effectively no limit to how far you can see. The only thing you will not be able to see is the multiverse and beyond. You possess infinite multitasking that could easily handle the tracking of trillions of different people.
objects.title: Clairvoyance

addons.text: You can intuitively understand skills, machines, knowledge, and even your own psychic powers. With slight foresight, you are capable of self-correcting your abilities which grants you the capacity to always improve. The better and more esoteric it is, the longer it may take, but you will always find a path. You're capable of not just finding improvements but removing weaknesses and improving strengths.
addons.title: Feel it Out!

addons.text: With a thought, you can ping a target you desire. It could be an object, location, or a person. It could even be a specific phenomenon or current event.
addons.title: Ping

addons.text: Your sense of self is fully protected and backed up. You can’t accidentally damage yourself with your psychic powers, and even if you were to somehow injure your soul, it restores itself through the backup. Upon full erasure of self, you can restore yourself based on a previous version, ensuring continuity and memories seamlessly.
addons.title: Backup

addons.text: You can read even the esoteric nature of the unknown—bringing them back to an origin and cross-referencing with psychic powers, your emulations of various powers and effects are now real. They aren’t imitations, they are the real genuine thing. Because of this, you can even control magic just like any other form of energy at your disposal.
addons.title: Original

objects.text: With just a touch, you can scry historical moments and memories concerning beings, objects, and locations. You possess the power to understand, break down, and even learn the past. By working backwards, you could learn to create machines as precisely as it is, you could copy the skills of others and use them as your own, and you could even learn the tips and tricks of previous owners to use an object as well as all of them combined.
objects.title: Psychometry

addons.text: With a slight flicker of senses, a bit of precognition, and a dash of mind control, you are capable of manipulating people to later help you. Be it consciously or not, you can create malware within people that doesn’t activate unless needed.
addons.title: Bird Bomb

addons.text: Should you desire, you can gather data on everyone in your range and file it within your mind. It can automatically filter anything harmful or useless to you. So long as one person knows, you know too; the more people who know, the stronger you can use it.
addons.title: Aggregate

addons.text: You can communicate in any form of language, even mechanical ones like code. You can read, influence, and control machines, bugs, animals, and even things without minds. There is nothing you cannot interact with and interface with.
addons.title: Communion

addons.text: You're capable of making and creating miniature emulators that can perfectly mimic the thoughts, emotions, values, memories, and anything else of anyone you have accessed. You are capable of storing these emulations in directories that can be accessed and turned off at any time. By perfectly emulating them, you can even use recreations of their powers, including those that require a certain personality or mental state. You can modify these emulations to have the same goals as you and even put them on a timer.
addons.title: Mkdir

objects.text: No thought shall remain a secret before you, as every mind is like an open book ready to be read at any moment. You could reach out and alter the minds of anyone. With just a thought, you control the hearts, minds, dreams, and aspirations of anyone. Billions of minds are laid out before you, waiting to kneel before you with just a single thought. Your mind can harness and use an infinite capacity of minds. There are no limits to how much information you can have and recall instantly.
objects.title: Telepathy

addons.text: Your psychic powers automatically react to your desires in response to things. It could lash out in your sleep or even if you are caught off guard. It automatically analyzes threats in the future and can even counter them by the time it happens. An automatic passive defense that protects you.
addons.title: Automatic

addons.text: You can mentally select entire sections and move them. Even if you were halfway across the universe, you could move galaxies so finely the inhabitants wouldn’t be able to tell. You could even see atoms of objects rip them apart before you.
addons.title: Section Selector

addons.text: If you know something or someone, you can perfectly recreate that something or someone down to the very second. Even if it's black-boxed with unknown esoteric effects, you can guesstimate and recreate them.
addons.title: Creation

addons.text: Your ability to control minds is absurd. You're capable of completely overhauling the brain so thoroughly that even if they found recordings of their past self, they would think those are fake and the current them is real. You can make someone perceive kindness as a sin and murder as a virtue all with a mere thought. You can compress telepathy into a single package and send it out, spreading it to everyone in contact with them to the point it could very well be a mental pandemic.
addons.title: Information Hazard

objects.text: You are capable of recreating the fundamental forces—with just your mind, you can reproduce any effect. You could even take inspiration from things that you can’t do. With a mere thought, you could change the very land itself; with a flick of your wrist, the very skies can turn into a raging storm. With your mind, you could move the very moon and stars. Alone, you are a force of nature—if you want something controlled, you can move it as you wish. You possess a mind capable of accelerated thinking and reflexes, as you can even monologue entire stories within your mind while watching a bullet fly towards you. Your ability to calculate and process information is absurd.
objects.title: Psychokinesis

objects.text:
You possess self-biokinetic adaptable cells capable of accelerated evolution. Your rapidly mutating somatic cells grant you peak physical and mental capabilities, with mutative regeneration capable of restoring limbs in hours.

Your cells improve with time and use, granting ever-improving physical strength, durability, speed, reaction time, motor skills, coordination, thought speed, and senses. You could even develop entirely new senses with an expanded awareness of things normal humans can’t even imagine.

Your mutative regeneration restores wounds and adapts to what causes them while gaining new features, growths, and capabilities to match any situation regardless of the source. These rapid mutations guarantee immunity to attacks in 8-10 hits, adaption to hostile environments in minutes, and can even trump alterations to you and your mind. Being pushed too far without time to rest can cause your body to adapt out of control much faster than usual, negatively impacting and hindering your movements and actions.

This can be prevented through time or stored biomass, as your body naturally refines mutations to become more streamlined and efficient, which allows you to return to a normal human form while maintaining all the adaptive weapons, defenses, and redundancies you have developed. Your cells can never have any demerits that will get in the way of each other. Negative mutations, subversion, unfixable changes, or unwanted assimilation are impossible to maintain in the long run.

When forcefully separated from your main body, your cells decay into simple proteins that prevent anyone from properly analyzing them and can easily be reabsorbed to aid your regeneration, similar to stored biomass. Consuming biomass allows you to store or gain traits to improve or add adaptations without being exposed to danger or killed. You can also use the stored biomass to rapidly alter your physical form.

Your understanding and analysis of powers through your senses are accelerated as you can quickly break down and guide adaptations to counter them. This allows further streamlined adaptations based on experiences, battles, and information. An example is gaining immunity to flamethrowers, which can escalate to gaining immunity to plasma.

You can even develop entirely new adaptations based on observed technological or organic abilities, replicating them inside your body. In time, you can grow immunity to poisons, sickness, Trumps, Masters, Strangers, reality rewriters, precogs, and many more. With a long and arduous journey, you can eventually shrug off the scariest beings imaginable.
objects.title: Heraclitus

addons.text: The Goal of All Life is to Evolve. Your existence evolved to be beyond comprehension. Things only work on you because you allow them to. People cannot properly interact with you unless you purposely lower yourself into their perspective. It would be impossible for someone to act against you because you are so undefinable that their acts couldn't be registered against you. There is no limit to what you cannot grow to counter or what idea, concept, or even beyond conceptual challenge you can't surpass. You can confidently survive the scary things out in the great unknown. Even if something exists from beyond everything, including human comprehension. No matter what, you'll be able to survive these challenges and overcome them.
addons.title: E V O L U T I O N

objects.text:
You are the pinnacle of biological perfection; your cells are in a state of superposition, allowing them to be anything and everything simultaneously. All the adaptions you've gained could be used at once, meaning a single cell could simultaneously operate as your brain, organ, sensory node, or whatever else you require.

Your cells have already removed the need for breathing, eating, sleeping, and even aging as you are completely self-sufficient. Because of this, you possess physical strength that not many parahumans can match, skyrocketing mental capabilities that can even understand eldritch horrors, a wide array of nigh-impossible senses, and an instantaneous form of healing that makes total destruction appear as if you were not hit in the first place.

Your highly adaptable cells can grant immunity to any attack in 2-3 hits, adapt to hostile environments in seconds, and even ignore attempts to alter your mind or body. While you have a better-evolved form of healing, you can still gain mutations and adaptions. Due to this, esoteric or rare forms of offense with sufficient variety can cause your body to rapidly adapt to the point of negatively impacting your movements and actions. However, this doesn't last long due to your body's natural refinement of mutations that allow you to return to a normal human form with the additions of your new adaptions.

Thanks to this refinement, your cells can never have any permanent demerits that will get in the way of each other, such as negative mutations, subversion, unfixable changes, or unwanted assimilation. Anything that could negatively affect you will be adapted to. Your cells are also information black holes that make no sense to anyone but you and actively ignore forms of analysis; they could even self-destruct and vanish for this purpose. Consuming biomass allows you to store or gain traits to improve or add adaptations without being exposed to danger or killed. You can also use the stored biomass to rapidly alter your physical form. 

Your understanding and analysis of powers from your senses lets you break down and grow immune to even conceptual dangers. This allows further enhancement of adaptions based on experiences, battles, and information. An example of this is gaining immunity to hammers, which can escalate to being immune to blunt force. You can even develop entirely new adaptions based on observed technological and organic abilities, replicating them perfectly within you. In time, you can grow immune to everything ever imagined and shrug off things that make even the fabric of reality pale.
objects.title: The One Who Crawls

addons.text: Your body can grow more than immune; it can fuel itself with the myriad wonders of reality. You can use anything you're immune to as a fuel source to evolve. Instead of being hurt, you are empowered by what once harmed you. Allowing you to evolve faster and stronger by absorbing whatever you are immune to.
addons.title: The Art of Excess

addons.text: Information about yourself is impossible. Your evolution of the soul protects it from any form of power, sight, interaction, theft, replication, or soul reading. Anything that tries to properly gauge you in any way will at the least be hindered from working properly against you. Meaning even judgment of things like sins doesn't work on you. No matter what, your powers cannot be drained, suppressed, weakened, stolen, copied, altered, controlled, reproduced, or otherwise influenced by anything aside from yourself.
addons.title: Cognito Hazard

addons.text: There are no limits to your understanding of the material world. Your perfect understanding of all kinds of matter allows you to break down and predict any kind of technology to incorporate it into yourself without limits. It doesn't matter what it is. You can utilize your perfect understanding and Biokinesis to incorporate it into your own body. Stealing any advancements for your own use.
addons.title: Civilization

addons.text: Your evolution is completely independent of yourself and only you. There are no others, not in the past or the future. There is simply only you in the present, your evolution pushing you ever forward, evolving to where nothing can be known, nothing is fixed, and everything is on you. As you are completely unique and separate from everything, you cannot step back. Your evolutions will always go forward, and nothing can try to freeze or regress you. You can walk through chaotic temporal distortions and come out completely fine and on time. As your past only exists in the now, you cannot be removed from existence because your past self was killed.
addons.title: Unique

addons.text: The redundancies you developed from evolving can wildly evolve in separate directions. With infinite fuel, you can evolve not only your main line of defenses but hundreds of backups as well. With endless backups and redundancies, you'll have an evolution ready whenever you encounter something new.
addons.title: Waste Not

objects.text:
Your power is capable of plotting and creating evolution on a grander scale. Not only do you adapt to attacks in just one hit, but there’s no limit to how far or wide your evolution can get. Nothing is impossible for you to evolve towards, as life finds a way.

When it comes down to evolving and overcoming stagnation, you are able to create the perfect evolutions to suit any challenge you come across. Your mind can come up with ideas that can suit any challenge you think of. Your body is a blank canvas waiting for you to be filled, and improvements are always there, waiting to be made.
objects.title: Darwinism

addons.text: Your existence rejects all limits. Even if your body is destroyed, your soul unraveled, and your concept erased from every layer of reality, you continue. Time cannot age you. Death cannot claim you. Oblivion cannot erase you. You recover from anything, no matter how impossible, always returning in perfect form. Your body, mind, and soul remain at their absolute peak, untouched by decay or distortion. You cannot be permanently harmed, erased, or forgotten. Even if all memory of you is lost and every timeline is rewritten, you return. You do not simply live. You survive.
addons.title: The Image of An Angel

addons.text: Biomass is a common term, but its meaning may differ across universes. The flesh of a unicorn, a psychic’s brain, and a Phoenix’s blood are all biomass yet different. The special Esoteric Mysteries of the Universe reveal themselves to you, and you can replicate the properties of such beings. This is an excellent way to gain various powers or create catalysts for certain situations.
addons.title: Esoteric Mysteries

addons.text: Your power can generate any material you want. It could be any form of metal, wood, gas, or plasma. If you understand it, you can make it with just a blink of an eye. There is nothing your power can’t form.
addons.title: Maker

addons.text: You can combine your adaptations, powers, and equipment inside you to gain all their benefits and remove their downsides. Your weapons, defenses, and creations can be combined to be much stronger than if they were separate, becoming more potent and versatile.
addons.title: Combination

addons.text: The matter that makes up your body can also evolve. You can improve the very foundation of yourself to create matter that doesn’t conform to any known sciences or laws. Each piece that makes you up can have varying properties and attributes that allow you to gain various special properties or even ignore the basic fundamentals of reality. Because of this, nothing of you could be understood even under direct analysis unless you let it be understood.
addons.title: Non-Euclidean

objects.text:
You possess the power to generate and manipulate biomass, the organic matter that makes up living organisms. With this, you are not constrained by the existing materials around you, as you can produce biomass from your body or absorb it from other sources. You can easily transform biomass into whatever you need or want, both in appearance and function. You can become any shape or form you desire in moments, changing your form to fit the situation.

You can also affect biomass separated from you, using biokinesis to alter it as quickly as your own body. You can divide yourself into multiple parts and control them as one. This allows you to have multiple bodies at your disposal, all connected to you.
objects.title: Brethren Moon

addons.text: With just a touch, you can claim it. Anything unprotected, whether physical or abstract, becomes part of you without anyone noticing. You can reshape it, alter it, and bend it to your will as if you had consumed it. Machines, people, objects, ideas, Concepts, emotions, and even intangible forces can become extensions of yourself, fully integrated without the need for consumption or awareness.
addons.title: Secrets of Encroaching Influence

addons.text: You can consume machines just like you can consume organic beings. Letting you absorb them within yourself and harvest data, information, programs, and whatever you can use for yourself. This grants you a greater understanding of software, programs, and coding while making you immune to any virus or malware from pilfering data and programs.
addons.title: Machine

addons.text: You can hyperventilate yourself to rapidly increase your power. In exchange for temporarily losing control of your body and letting it expand wildly, your mutation rate accelerates immensely. You can evolve immunities before they are needed, allowing you to overcome attacks the first time you encounter them. The more information you have, the easier and less taxing this is on your body. The more effort needed, the more inhuman you become before your evolutions allow you to overcome the perceived or theoretical threat.
addons.title: Hyperventilate

addons.text: There is nothing you cannot consume, making you a marvel of voracious destruction. You can evolve to destroy or consume anything from energy like electricity, heat, light, or more esoteric things like the fabric of space-time itself. You can also derive weapons from phenomena you observe. Using your immunities as a basis to create powerful counteractions to phenomena. You can evolve the antithesis of everything, turning your versatile defenses into a myriad of equally versatile offenses.
addons.title: Snicker-Snack

addons.text: Whenever you inflict harm on someone, you can siphon off a part of their essence and gain access to part of their knowledge, skills, and powers. The more you hurt them, the more you learn from them. If you kill them, you can devour their entire soul and assimilate their full powers and personality.
addons.title: Voracious

objects.text: You can absorb others, dead or alive. As you consume someone, your understanding of them grows. The way they speak, how they look, their actions, and even their emotions. Harvesting their knowledge, skills, and even physical capabilities (like genetics, powers, and mutations) to use as your own.
objects.title: When Evolution Breaks

addons.text: Because your body, mind, and soul are fully unified under your complete control, all abilities that rely on them are enhanced. You hold absolute authority over every part of yourself, where every thought, movement, and being follows your will. When you consume someone, you can choose to preserve their soul and consciousness, storing them in a mental world as part of you. You may allow the beings in this world to act through a separate portion of yourself, a body shaped entirely by your design and empowered with as many or as few of your abilities as you choose.
addons.title: Make Us Whole

addons.text: Your knowledge of life, matter, souls, and all sorts of amazing and strange phenomena is flawless and allows seamless usage of anything you may come across. You can replicate the parts that make something unique within yourself with just a glance. Taking things people can do and granting you the power to do it, too. You have no limits. You can replicate anything.
addons.title: Copy

addons.text: With your body, mind, and Soul merged and the reach of your power unlimited, you have touched upon the notion that you could be far more than you appear. Given time and understanding, you can expand the notion of "yourself" and thus the reach of your adaptations. Due to the nature of this undertaking, it is much easier to extend yourself over things that are already conceptually close to you. Pulling "Information" into yourself might allow you to change knowledge about yourself, whether written down or memorized. Pulling "Past" could allow you to act in the past as it becomes necessary retroactively. Repeated expansions towards the same concept loosen your limitations on them until it is completely under your control.
addons.title: Linked

addons.text: You survive, no matter what form you take. If your body is lost, you continue as a thought, a memory, a piece of media, or a whisper in the dark. So long as something or someone remembers, knows, or carries a trace of you, you persist. Even if your existence is erased, its remnants echo in minds, in stories, in data. Oblivion cannot claim you as long as even the idea of you remains. Each piece of you, regardless of medium, can be controlled and influenced by whatever you are inside of. You can even come out of it, acting as spawn points.
addons.title: Anathema

addons.text: Your Soul can evolve just like your body, and because of this, your Powers evolve, too. They grow more versatile, robust, and adapted to foes at hand. Conflict creates the path for your growth, creating evolutions based on past and current foes to make future ones easier to defeat.
addons.title: Fires of Conflict

objects.text:
Your body is not merely a vessel for your Soul. It is an integral part of your being. Your Soul can evolve with your body, granting it the same level of defense as your physical body. Your mind, body, and Soul are one.

Your evolutions can adapt and learn from strange and esoteric forces and use them to your advantage. In time, you can even use and evolve far beyond the original holders of your copied powers and the you of the past.
objects.title: Soul Container

addons.text: Each adaptation you have competes with the others, testing its strength, purpose, and potential. When one surpasses the rest, it does not replace them. Instead, it sets a new standard. The others adapt, pushing themselves to match or overcome the latest breakthrough. This constant struggle drives all your evolutions to improve, learning from each other and striving toward something greater. New evolutions emerge, shaped by the strengths and failures of the old, while the existing ones refuse to be left behind.
addons.title: Cog in The Machine

addons.text: Your senses are far stronger than normal. Not only are they better capable, but they can also see anything. Souls, mana, psychic wavelengths, and so on. Normal things that can’t be seen or interacted with normally can be observed and matched.
addons.title: The Eye

addons.text: Any object, item, or even Object of Power you possess can be added to yourself without problems. Incorporating it into yourself means it can evolve to the same strength and immunities you have. Allowing these items to gain the same benefits as your physical body and constantly evolve and improve to counter enemies or remain useful.
addons.title: Incorporate

addons.text: You can convert one form of matter to another without losing anything. Being fully machine, fully organic, or both simultaneously. Shifting flesh into metal and metal to flesh, they are exactly the same to you. This conversion lets you keep the advantages of being fully machine or living while removing the downsides of both.
addons.title: Conversion

addons.text: Your power can invent the wheel and deduce evolutions from nowhere to gain immunity to things you haven’t even thought of yet. Despite having no data or prior information, you can evolve with features to suit the current situation.
addons.title: The Wheel

objects.text: For you, there is no distinction between organic and inorganic augmentation. You can consume any material as if it were flesh and bones, and anything consumed can be converted to your own biomass. As far as you are concerned, flesh and metal are just two sides of the same coin.
objects.title: Inorganics

objects.text:
Your soul has awakened to its true potential, granting you the ability to manipulate spiritual energy and perceive the hidden world beyond the veil with your clear-sighted eyes. Ghosts, spirits, angels, demons, yōkai, fairies, and countless other beings can no longer conceal themselves from you. However, when you stare into the abyss, the abyss stares back. Your awakened soul acts as a beacon, drawing supernatural entities toward you and leaving you vulnerable to their influence—whether through haunting, curses, or possession.

That said, you are not defenseless. You can channel spiritual energy to ward off, exorcise, and even banish such entities. This power grants you many abilities, including communicating with spiritual beings, sensing nearby supernatural activity, projecting your astral form, and traversing the spiritual plane. You can also perceive the souls of people and objects, discerning their state—including whether an item carries supernatural influence such as a curse or blessing.

You can wield spiritual energy to unleash blasts that harm both the physical and spiritual realms, create barriers to shield against either, heal yourself and others, bestow blessings, and dispel curses. You may also tap into spiritual leylines—sacred conduits linking directly to the spiritual plane. These provide immense power but are exhausting to maintain and fade once you disconnect.

All of your abilities require discipline and meditation. The deeper your attunement to the spiritual plane, the stronger your spirit becomes. Imprinted within your soul is a vast library of scrolls and scriptures on spiritual techniques. You can study them within your mind or manifest them at will. This library contains numerous systems—from Buddhist scriptures to the crafting of Onmyōdō talismans—and will expand as your soul grows, offering knowledge up to the highest levels of mastery. You also possess an unparalleled intuition for developing new techniques and refining existing ones.

Yet power comes with risk. The more complex and powerful the technique, the greater the strain on your soul. With dedication, you may cultivate your spirit into a divine entity capable of standing alongside the mightiest gods and spirits. The path is long and perilous—be careful to not corrupt or even destroy your soul on your journey. But with perseverance, you could achieve Apotheosis in as little as a decade of study and practice—perhaps sooner, depending on how fully you devote yourself.
objects.title: Nascent Soul

addons.text: ”Throughout heaven and earth, I alone am the honored one" - Buddha Your spiritual awareness has enlightened you to the true nature of all things—both the physical and spiritual planes, and realms beyond. You possess complete knowledge of yourself, your purpose, and the workings of the universe. Nothing is hidden from your perception; every event, intention, and mystery is laid bare before you. Through your unity with the spiritual plane, you access its endless reservoir of knowledge at all times, granting you a form of omniscience and an unshakable understanding of every situation. This oneness with the spiritual plane also bestows upon you infinite spiritual energy and boundless power, as you draw directly from its limitless essence. All souls and spiritual beings, whether within or outside the spiritual plane, now fall under your absolute authority. With a mere thought, you can elevate mortals to the rank of gods, reshape destinies, or command the forces of life and death. Your influence is no longer confined to the immaterial—your will extends into the physical world itself, allowing you to mold reality as effortlessly as clay, existing everywhere at once, and even erasing or recreating reality at will. Through your enlightenment, you have ascended into a state of being that transcends not only the universe but all of existence itself. No being within creation can harm you, and even those beyond it can, at best, stand as your equal—none may truly end you. You are eternal, untouchable, and absolute, a living embodiment of boundless power and infinite knowledge, existing as the pinnacle of spiritual perfection.
addons.title: N I R V A N A

objects.text:
You stand at the pinnacle of spiritual power and attunement with the world’s natural forces. Not only have you learned to perceive the true nature of the soul—its origin and the essence of any person, object, or spiritual creature—but you can also conceal your presence from all supernatural beings. Conversely, you can amplify it, shining as bright as the sun and drawing the attention of every entity across the physical and spiritual planes. Your soul has grown so strong that no supernatural influence can touch you—not even the will of gods.

Your spiritual energy is powerful enough to repel the mightiest creatures, and your mere presence drives away those weaker than you while warning stronger beings not to trifle with you. You can now channel spiritual energy to bring back long-dead souls from the depths of the spiritual plane, and your astral form has ascended to the level of a divine spirit. In the spiritual plane, only a handful of entities can still threaten you—there is always a bigger fish, but never many. Your energy has become vast and overwhelming, and your mastery of it would leave even the greatest spiritual practitioners, such as Abe no Seimei, dumbstruck.

Your energy blasts can now shake or annihilate entire regions of both the physical and spiritual planes. You can erect barriers strong enough to shield worlds and bar the passage of the greatest beings, heal any wound, bestow blessings of immense fortune, and dispel even the strongest curses. You can also tap into and channel spiritual leylines far longer than before, recovering quickly and rendering yourself nearly invincible so long as you remain near one—though excessive exposure still risks exhaustion or even death.

You live in constant harmony with the spiritual plane, allowing you to grow steadily stronger and receive guidance in moments of need or breakthrough. Having mastered countless spiritual systems and thousands of techniques, you can even create new ones instantly. Your inner library has become infinite, endlessly expanding with new scrolls and scriptures born from its vast knowledge. With dedication, you can double your strength with each passing decade.
objects.title: Apotheosis

addons.text: You have gained the ability to channel your contracted spirits through your spiritual body, allowing you to manifest their symbols of power—such as a tengu’s weapon and armor, a grim reaper’s scythe, an angel’s holy sword, and more. This manifestation lasts only as long as you have the spiritual energy to sustain it, and the more powerful the item, the faster your energy is depleted.
addons.title: Legion's Incarnation

addons.text: Previously, you could only access your territory by entering the spiritual plane. Now, your spiritual body has become an extension of your domain, granting you constant awareness of everything that occurs within it and the ability to influence it from the physical world. This does not allow you to manifest your territory in the physical plane but provides far easier and more direct access.
addons.title: Inner Realm

addons.text: Even great spiritual power is meaningless without a proper focus. You have now gained the ability to forge a weapon directly from your own soul. This weapon naturally assumes the form most suited to you, grows alongside you, enhances your control over your spiritual powers, and may even develop unique abilities of its own. Optionally, it may be sentient, semi-sentient, or entirely inert, depending on your will.
addons.title: Soul Weapon

addons.text: While your soul may be immune to destruction from decay or indirect means, this does not make you unextinguishable. However, you have now developed an uncanny ability to endlessly reincarnate regardless of how many times you are destroyed. Upon true death, you will be reborn in a new life, regaining memories of your past lives sometime after reincarnation. The interval between lives is unpredictable—sometimes as little as a year, other times decades, centuries, or even millennia.
addons.title: Samsara

objects.text:
You have broken free from the shackles of mortality. Where once your soul alone was immortal while your flesh would eventually perish, leaving you to exist solely as a spiritual being, you now possess the ability to transform your physical body into a spiritual body and back at will. Even when in your physical form, it retains your soul’s immortality.

As a Spiritual Body, you gain not only the abilities of a ghost but also the power to shape your appearance with spiritual energy, even manifesting specific attire such as a shinigami’s kimono. Unlike astral projection, where your body is left behind, you can directly enter the spiritual plane with your own body. Your powers are also at their peak in this form, allowing you to channel spiritual energy with far greater efficiency and potency.

Your spiritual body is more akin to that of a yōkai than a mere projection, granting you dominion—or authority—over an aspect of the world. This domain can range from elemental forces like fire, water, or earth, to more esoteric concepts such as life and death, time, love, or even music. The stronger the domain, the greater the conditions required to wield it. However, as your soul grows in strength, these restraints diminish, granting you an increasingly vast command over your chosen domain.
objects.title: Spiritual Body

addons.text: You can now channel your contracted spirits through your spiritual body to wield their authority directly—such as a vengeful ghost’s strength, an elemental spirit’s command over its element, an afterlife agent’s dominion over souls like the Black and White Impermanence, an angel’s holy power, or a demon’s unholy might. The more potent the authority, the faster your spiritual energy is consumed.
addons.title: Spirit Authority

addons.text: If you have ever dreamed of being the head of a great clan, that dream can now become reality. You may allow your contracted spirits to reside within your territory in the spiritual plane, granting them a delegated authority to manage, enforce, and even create new rules within the boundaries of your will. They may dwell there indefinitely until summoned to your side, though some may prefer to remain by you rather than in your domain.
addons.title: Legion's Dominion

addons.text: You have gained the ability to temporarily merge with your contracted spirits, fusing your powers into exponentially stronger forms. You may merge with as many spirits as you can sustain with spiritual energy, but the cost scales dramatically with both the number and power of the spirits you combine with.
addons.title: Soul Resonance

addons.text: The contracts you form with supernatural beings have transcended all external constraints. No force, no matter how powerful, can break them. They cannot be dissolved by anyone but you and remain intact even through death—if you or your contracted spirits are revived, the contracts remain fully valid.
addons.title: Eternal Contracts

objects.text:
There are many kinds of creatures hidden from the eyes of the wider world, both benevolent and malevolent, and you possess the ability to bring them under your command. You can form contracts with supernatural beings, compelling them to do your bidding and follow you wherever you go. While these contracts must provide some form of benefit to both parties, the requirement is minimal—anything that satisfies either side is sufficient. Even something as simple as a being wishing to make a contract with you for the sake of it fulfills the condition. The contracts cannot be exploited by either party and may only be dissolved if both sides agree or if one of the two perishes. Furthermore, neither party may scheme to bring about the other’s end, whether directly or indirectly.

Your aura, which naturally draws supernatural beings toward you, also influences them in subtle yet powerful ways. Even creatures that would normally refuse a contract find themselves more inclined to accept one. Those who do form contracts with you feel this influence even more strongly, gradually becoming friendlier and, over time, developing deeper bonds—true friendship, sibling-like closeness, parental affection, or even romantic love. There is no limit to the number of beings you can bind by contract, allowing you to gather so many that you could form an entire clan with yourself as the head of the family.
objects.title: One Hundred Demons

addons.text: You have become more attuned to your territory, and your connection now mirrors the state of your soul. As your emotions shift, so too does your domain’s environment: happiness causes the creatures and nature within to flourish in a cascade of fortunate events, anger strengthens your defenses against lawbreakers and invaders, love fosters empathy among inhabitants, and sadness compels them to reflect on their life choices in a positive way.
addons.title: Living Bastion

addons.text: While your contracted spirits were already formidable, once they enter your territory the land itself empowers them to extraordinary levels. By default, their strength doubles—if not triples—but when the domain is threatened, their true might is revealed as they can become up to ten times stronger than before.
addons.title: Spirit Court

addons.text: The spiritual plane may be a realm for spiritual beings, but it is not itself an afterlife—merely a passage to countless others. Now, your territory can serve as a true afterlife for departed souls. You may shape how this realm functions and set the requirements for entry, such as creating a paradise where the righteous may rest or a hell where the sinful are punished. Regardless of its form, the more souls you shelter within your domain, the stronger both your soul and your territory become.
addons.title: Personal Paradise

addons.text: Where once your soul was merely unbound from worldly forces, now it stands utterly beyond them. As long as you remain within your spiritual territory, no amount of damage can extinguish you, and your regeneration becomes immense—healing nearly any wound in an instant. However, once you leave your domain, you are once again vulnerable to true death.
addons.title: Absolute Immortality

objects.text:
The spiritual plane is an endless realm filled with countless wonders—from the souls of the deceased on their way to the afterlife, to beings such as yōkai and gods. Its appearance varies depending on the world you enter, but regardless of which world you choose, you will always retain access to the spiritual plane, even without taking this option. By default, the plane is a lawless domain where the strong prey upon the weak, and the only safe havens are those ruled by powerful beings or gods who impose some measure of order. The souls of the deceased that are not lost are typically guided to their final destination by agents of the afterlife.

Previously, you could access the spiritual plane using spiritual energy, but now you can establish a territory within it where you reign as the absolute ruler. Within this territory, you may set the laws that govern it—laws which the land itself enforces, punishing or even expelling those who defy them. You can also reshape and manipulate reality within your domain, much like one can alter a dream while lucid.

In theory, your word is absolute within your territory; however, beings far stronger than you may still invade by breaching its protective barrier. Should they manage to extinguish you or force you to surrender control, they could seize your territory—though even they would be weakened by the immense effort required to break through. Over time, as your soul grows stronger, so too will your domain.
objects.title: Spiritual Plane's Lordship

addons.text: You have acquired the ability to awaken the spiritual energy within other living beings. Those you awaken gain the same basic abilities as you, such as perceiving the hidden world beyond the veil, communicating and interacting with supernatural beings, projecting their astral form, and traversing the spiritual plane. However, they also become beacons that attract nearby supernatural entities, leaving them vulnerable to their influence. Beyond manipulating spiritual energy for a variety of effects, the awakened also gain the ability to transform into their spiritual bodies at will and even develop authorities of their own.
addons.title: Soul Awakening

addons.text: Your contracts are no longer limited to spiritual beings—you can now bind living beings and even objects. Those you contract with transform into supernatural creatures, such as yōkai, depending on their personality and the lives they led. Objects bound by contract awaken into sentient spiritual beings, their nature shaped by their past: a cherished tool may become a benevolent guardian, while a neglected or abandoned one may turn into a cursed spirit.
addons.title: Soul Pact

addons.text: Where once you could only exercise your sovereign abilities within your territory, you can now temporarily extend your domain into the physical world, radiating outward up to a hundred meters. Within this area, you may apply the laws of your territory and alter reality as if shaping a lucid dream. A protective barrier also manifests, preventing unauthorized entry unless the intruder possesses power greater than your own. This expansion, however, consumes spiritual energy at a rapid pace and lasts only as long as you can sustain it.
addons.title: Spirit World Projection

addons.text: While your transcendent soul could previously fragment and safely reintegrate, you can now share fragments of your soul with other living or spiritual beings, granting them access to portions of your power. The true strength of this ability lies when you draw those fragments back—the growth they accumulate within others is transferred to you, and their effects are doubled upon reintegration.
addons.title: Soul Shards

objects.text:
The soul, also known as essence or anima, is the core of a being’s existence, and nearly all creatures, living or dead, possess one. Previously, you could only manipulate the spiritual energy generated by your own soul for a variety of effects, but you can now directly influence the souls of others through spiritual energy. This grants you many abilities, such as controlling another being’s actions by manipulating their soul, destroying souls outright, or even creating entirely new ones.

You can also resurrect the dead by returning their soul to their body (though without healing, the result may resemble a form of undead), eject souls from their vessels with a mere gesture, and forge soul links between yourself and other beings or objects. Beyond manipulation, you may also absorb the souls of others, greatly amplifying the power of your own—though not from souls you create, as they are born of your own energy. While this act has no strict limit, each soul carries its consciousness, memories, and personality. The more you absorb, the greater the risk of being overwhelmed—until their voices drown out your own, erasing your sense of self.
objects.title: Anima Manipulation

addons.text: Your transcendent soul has gained the ability to spread fragments of itself, forming new spiritual bodies that can act independently or under your direct control. These bodies can channel all of your powers and exist in a hive-mind-like state, sharing your consciousness while still maintaining autonomy. They cannot be severed from your soul, and you may recall the fragments at will.
addons.title: Echoes of the Soul

addons.text: Previously, while you could contract countless spirits to serve you, they could still be extinguished. Now, whenever one of your contracted spirits perishes, it will eventually regenerate and resurrect from within your soul through the link of your contracts. The time required depends on the spirit’s strength—ranging from hours or days to weeks, years, or longer. However, the stronger you are in comparison to the spirit, the shorter the process becomes.
addons.title: Immortal Legion

addons.text: Your transcendent soul has developed a unique attunement to your territory, granting you the ability to establish sanctuaries in the physical world—lesser reflections of your true domain in the spiritual plane, though with diminished strength and authority. Within these sanctuaries, you can manipulate reality to a limited degree; your laws are still enforced, and weaker spirits cannot enter without permission. However, clever or comparably powerful beings may breach your sanctuary with effort. You can also teleport freely between sanctuaries, granting you instantaneous travel.
addons.title: Sacred Grounds

addons.text: Where once you risked losing yourself to the wills and memories of the souls you absorbed, now your transcendent soul allows you to assimilate them without danger. Their consciousness and will are stripped away, reduced to harmless essence, while their memories and knowledge merge seamlessly with your own. Even so, consuming too many souls at once may still overwhelm you in a form of spiritual intoxication.
addons.title: Perfect Assimilation

objects.text:
Even among the endless ocean of the spiritual plane, where countless unique and strange beings exist, you remain one of a kind. Your soul cannot be altered by any outside force—whether through soul manipulation, space or time alteration, reality-warping, fate, erasure, or any other means. Even in physical death, no agent of the afterlife, such as a grim reaper, can force you into realms like heaven, limbo, hell, valhalla, or the underworld. Your soul also cannot be sealed or imprisoned against your will.

You can even defy the laws of territories within the spiritual plane, suffering no direct punishment, and effortlessly breach their protective barriers, which normally repel uninvited guests. Your soul naturally recovers from any direct damage and rapidly restores spent spiritual energy. However, while this grants you immense freedom, it does not make you unbreakable or truly immortal. Your soul can still be extinguished by direct means, and a being vastly stronger than you could end your existence with little effort.
objects.title: Transcendent Soul

objects.text:
You have the potential to create anything you can imagine.
Your skills at crafting with your hands have no limit and you can defy reason and rationality to create stunning works of art the likes of which have never been seen before. 

Your skill at blacksmithing and other such arts of creation is at the peak of mortal skill and you have no limit on how high it can go in the future. You gain skill within these fields at a tremendous rate; with each work you create, you seemingly grow to be able to surpass your previous work, fixing any flaws or adding new perfections. This power allows you to imbue any concepts, ideas, ideals, energies, and material properties into your creations, limited only by your understanding, skill, and time.

A blacksmith must have their workshop and a craftsman their tools to work. Luckily, you have both at hand at all times, as your workshop metaphysically travels with you wherever you go. What this means is that wherever you may find yourself, as long as you wish it, the tools you need seem to just appear or perhaps change the environment in such a way as to function as well as your proper tools if you wish, such as using a river to quench a blade you are working on, and using a stone nearby as an anvil. These tools grow with you, and can withstand anything you may inflict on them to create your works.
objects.title: Blacksmith of Potential

objects.text:
You have the potential to create anything you can imagine.
You can craft objects with such splendor and beauty as to leave gods stunned, fashion weapons to sunder armies with a single swing and more. Your level of skill with all types of craftsmanship leaves you rival only to gods and greater powers with such domains—this includes more esoteric forms of craftsmanship such as music, drawing, and painting. You can work with any type of energy concept or idea you want, such as weaving a dress made of the night sky, or forging a blade made from the prayers of all dead warriors.

Your skills at crafting with your hands have no limit and you can defy reason and rationality to create stunning works of art the likes of which have never before been seen. Your skill at blacksmithing and other such arts of creation is at levels unimaginable to mortals and most gods alike, and you have no limit on how high it can go in the future.

You gain skill within these fields at a tremendous rate; with each work you create, you seemingly grow to be able to surpass your previous work, fixing any flaws or adding new perfections. This power allows you to imbue any concepts, ideas, ideals, energies, and material properties into your creations, limited only by your understanding, skill, and time.

A blacksmith must have their workshop and a craftsman their tools to work. Luckily, you have both at hand at all times, as your workshop metaphysically travels with you wherever you go.
