What this means is that wherever you may find yourself, as long as you wish it, the tools you need seem to just appear or perhaps change the environment in such a way as to function as well as your proper tools if you wish, such as using a river to quench a blade you are working on, and using a stone nearby as an anvil. These tools grow with you, and can withstand anything you may inflict on them to create your works.
objects.title: Divine Craftsman

addons.text: You are able to manipulate your personal state of being, allowing you to reset yourself to a point that no longer requires any upkeep. You are able to get a full night's worth of sleep if it means you are able to continue creating, constantly being in a state of full satiation. Your forge is constantly shifting itself to be in its peak condition, cleaning itself, and repairing damages.
addons.title: Singularity

addons.text: You know how to use your creations perfectly and what their intended purpose is. You can perfectly imagine how they will get used and tweak the designs to best accommodate the things it will come across. You can perfectly utilize and refine techniques of all your creations just as well as you make them, as what type of creator is unable to wield their own creations! You are able to learn the required Secondary Powers and skills necessary to wield your own creations.
addons.title: Well-Versed

addons.text: Your own Myth grows stronger over time, as what are you if not your own life’s Greatest Creation. Every action you take—from walking, breathing, to even eating—becomes more and more supernatural as you grow. This allows you to handle any challenges you would run into on the path of creation, giving you a method to handle the heat of a volcano used as a forge, holding the core of a dying star in your hands for a new creation, etc.
addons.title: Road to Glory

addons.text: Your creations are immune to the flow of time, allowing them to remain in perfect condition regardless of environmental hazards. Batteries remain fully charged, blades never dull, and never will an item be fully broken. No longer will your creations need to be repaired, as all of your creations are constantly shifting towards their peak condition, restoring themselves from nothing after total destruction.
addons.title: Built to Last

objects.text: Time means nothing to you; when you begin to craft something, time stops for you. This time stop doesn't affect your crafting at all, and when you finish, time resumes. Leaving in the middle of crafting would result in time continuing again as the time stop can only be used for crafting. You will find that time seems to go by faster when working, even when time is stopped—four hours worth of work is finished in three, a two minute break feels like ten minutes, etc. Over time, you will be able to control this small scale time dilation even when not crafting.
objects.title: Time

addons.text: The warehouse restocks much more frequently, no longer entirely dependent on how well you know a material. All materials have a low-level of passive research being applied to them, allowing you to understand more and more of your workshop over time even without your conscious attention. Your warehouse can artificially age materials, allowing you to have access to materials that are decades, centuries, or even millennia old.
addons.title: Well Stocked

addons.text: You took ‘Give It Your All!’ far more literally than anyone expected, allowing you to store your own skills, emotions, thoughts, and beliefs in your warehouse. This does not drain you in any capacity, and you will not lose anything you store in your warehouse. Skills used in the creation of an item could allow the wielder to use your own level of skill without any experience, and an emotion could increase an object’s power the more said emotion is felt.
addons.title: Give It Your All!

addons.text: Materials gain boosts based on achievements by other creations with the same materials. A metal used in dragon-slaying blades will have an intrinsic damage multiplier against dragons. A crystal used for healing becomes even more effective as you make more healing talismans with it. These effects are entirely optional, as your warehouse will have a different variation of each material with every combination of its bonuses.
addons.title: Mythological Materials

addons.text: You can refine and compress a material to be far stronger than it originally was. Forging, compressing, refining—you are improving the materials you work with. This exemplifies quality over quantity, allowing you to fuse 2, 10, or even 1000 iron ingots into a singular ingot that is greater than its components. Each and every variation of a refined material will be stored in your Warehouse, no matter how minor the difference between the variations, for example, 10 and 10.000000001 are different, although humans could (and would) argue otherwise.
addons.title: Quality First

objects.text: No longer are you restricted by a lack of materials. As you experience more of the world and lay your hands on more and more crafting materials, you find that you are able to summon all materials you have touched in your life. This metaphysical warehouse attached to your workshop is not unlimited initially, requiring you to research and work with materials more in order for them to restock more often. This warehouse can supply you with even one-of-a-kind or esoteric materials, as long as you have scanned them once before. This is not limited to physical materials, allowing you to create objects using pure emotions, space, or even concepts such as time, although collecting such materials might be a challenge.
objects.title: Resources

addons.text: You are able to look into the future to see how important an area will be for crafting. In addition to looking into the future, you are able to glimpse the past of an area and design something based on the area’s history. A historic battleground could have you creating a weapon that fills itself up with blood as it kills more and more. This psychometry applies to everything in existence, allowing you to look into anything you touch—be it a weapon, armor, piece of jewelry—Even worlds cannot hide their history from your grasp.
addons.title: Historical Insight

addons.text: You can combine materials together. If you have a powerful fire and a strong ice material, you can fuse them to make a fire and ice sword without conflicting. You can make a bow with the properties of dragon bone and vibranium. This is not limited to only physical materials, allowing you to make new materials that will shock crafters all around the world. With enough experience, you will be able to pick and choose which aspects you wish to keep from each material and which aspects you wish to discard. Initially, you will only be able to combine 2 materials, although that will change quickly once you begin to explore.
addons.title: Amalgam

addons.text: You are able to break down items with thousands upon thousands of years worth of history, analyzing each and every instant of an item's past, allowing you to recreate them even greater than before. A sword that has been passed down for dozens of generations will gain a Myth upon being recreated by you. Nothing can hide from your True Sight, allowing you to analyze things regardless of barriers, stealth, illusions, or lighting.
addons.title: True Sight

addons.text: You are able to reforge your creations endlessly, creating more and more iterations of the exact same thing over and over again, further refining it each time. Each time you reforge a creation, you gain new inspiration. If your reforged version is the greater of the two, it will become ‘the original’ version, inheriting everything that makes up the ‘old original’. You are able to reforge even the most basic creations into something that could end entire worlds at the very least, although it would take many iterations to reach that level. Every single iteration and copy becomes a part of your Armory.
addons.title: Never-ending Refinement

objects.text: Your workshop has found itself holding a set of tools representing your crafting experience, these tools gain bonuses and modifiers as you craft in different locations over time. No river will give the same bonus, and no stone is the same. Places of importance, be it historically, magically, or spiritually shall give you bonuses and modifiers of an incredible quality. These tools can be brought into the world on their own, allowing you to bring forth the weight of every river you have used for quenching, every stone you have used as an anvil, every fire you have used for forging, etc. Additionally, you are able to learn any and all methods of crafting—no matter the method, you are able to learn them. All of the little quirks that give each creator their own style, you are able to replicate and receive an increase of quality in the specialization of each creator.
objects.title: Method

addons.text: You are able to look into an item's future, allowing you to understand what it will become. Beyond looking into an item’s future, you are able to trim away possibilities you do not like—the more you trim away, the faster the item will grow. Do not worry about trimming away too much of any item, as any creation you make will always be able to develop itself further, every second of use sparks diverse possibilities.
addons.title: Possibilities Abound

addons.text: You are able to strengthen your creations by using resources that are inline with their innate Myth. Using a fang from a dragon would greatly benefit the item against dragons in the future, allowing a sword to slay a dragon with ease. Even if the resources themselves have no connection to the weapon, the idea behind their use is just as important. Shaping a twig to resemble Yggdrasil to symbolize it would work just as well as a branch from the World Tree itself.
addons.title: Sticking to the Story

addons.text: A Myth is more than the heroic act that everyone remembers—all parts of the process are important to the formation of a hero. Hercules wouldn’t have made it to where he was without his 12 Labors. The journey it took to make an item is just as important as the way the item is used. The more time, effort, and research you had to put into creating an item strengthens its myth. Crossing entire worlds for a branch of a special tree could find your creation gaining power from the actions you took during your journey, and at no point will the powers gained from your journeys influence your creations in a manner you don’t want.
addons.title: Journey before Destination

addons.text: Your copies can be handed out to multiple different people, allowing for each copy to deepen the object’s Myth; although at a lesser rate than the original, it is still a noticeable increase. Initially, you will have only one copy of each creation, although the more each variation is used, the faster you will be able to hand out another copy. The more complicated and powerful a creation, the more it takes to create another copy. A simple knife would regenerate almost instantaneously, while something on the level of Avalon (from Fate) would take much longer.
addons.title: Arsenal

objects.text: You are able to imbue your creations with a spark of history that will grow into a full-blown story of its own, allowing your creations to grow to best fit their myth or legend. A sword used to kill dragons would find itself growing better at taking down dragons. In addition, you are able to take from an item's story, giving you a bonus to best fit the part you took from. You can take a minor portion of an item's history, giving minor benefits, or take an item's entire history, giving you untold powers. This weakens or even removes everything supernatural from an item, depending on how much you took. This loss in power only affects items not of your own making. For your own creations, you gain a growing well of power that grants you bonuses as your creations are used more and more.
objects.title: Myth

addons.text: No longer is your armory restricted by your own personal creations; now, you will find that creations that you had the possibility to make will find their way into your armory. If you had made an iconic sword that was entirely based around lighting, you might find a variation based around fire, water, or earth. These possibilities will give you insights into things you have not yet learned as well, as these creations made out of possibility are not bound by your current knowledge.
addons.title: Eternal Possibilities

addons.text: You will find that your warehouse now allows you to duplicate existing creations; instead of requiring research to reduce the resupply time, these duplicates resupply faster depending on the original creation’s strength. As you grow in your craft of war, these armaments will grow alongside you, becoming stronger, swifter, sharper, and more resilient—eventually even providing exotic effects such as physical enhancement, force multiplication or deflection, elemental effects, etc.
addons.title: Everlasting Arsenal

addons.text: The phantasmal copies that make up your armory will begin to crystallize into direct duplicates over time. As the copies become more and more real, you will find that they gain incredible boosts in all areas. These copies made real are able to be summoned into the real world for a permanent amount of time. The more the original and the copy are used, the faster they will crystallize into the real deal.
addons.title: Ethereal Manifestation

addons.text: Your armory begins to fill itself up with items of great importance from across the multiverse, and none of these items will ever be able to harm you in any capacity. This process is not entirely controllable, although you can direct it towards a certain ‘type’ of item—be it melee, ranged, consumable, or even armor. As your armory fills up more and more, you will have more control over this direction, moving on to more specific types of items—swords, necklaces, rings, potions, arrows—and you will be able to choose these items directly.
addons.title: Mythic Convergence

objects.text: Your workshop has an empty armory attached to it. This armory will be filled with a phantasmal copy of every creation you make, and each copy has the full powers of every creation you make. These phantasmal copies shared a connection to the real thing, allowing for the copies to grow in power or strength if the originals do. Each phantasmal copy will regenerate upon destruction, if they happen to break. It is not just finished works that end up in your armory—even prototypes and failures will have a place in your armory. You will eventually put Gilgamesh’s Gate of Babylon to shame with time. You are able to give a phantasmal copy to another being, allowing them to call upon a sliver of the original creation’s power. If the recipient happens to hold both the copy and the original, they can merge into an even greater object, allowing for even faster growth.
objects.title: Armory

objects.text:
You are following in the steps of the godhead, learning the steps of the creator so that one day you may also hold the power and the wisdom to warp worlds beneath your hands, once you wield the four tools. 

The first tool of the godhead is the Wand; personal certainty and prediction. You’re given a full knowledge of yourself and your ability, being able to fully realise the capabilities of both your physical and esoteric abilities upon yourself and your immediate surroundings. When trained, this understanding will extend to that which you consider ‘yours’. Tools, weapons, even acolytes or locations, each under your will and consideration.

The second tool for the godhead is the Sword; recognition. You have the ability to distinguish between the spiritual, the mundane, and that which is divorced from both. The first time you recognise a pattern, you can apply that recognition to all similar to it, and so on with each new pattern until all entities and phenomena are known to you. In time this allows you to predict how a variety of phenomena, creatures or people will act, but relies on both your encountering it before, and the investment you have in the second tool.

The third tool of the godhead is that of the Cup; subtle alteration. Using this tool for the Godhead, you can alter the ephemera of the world. Esoteric energies and the subtle forces such as luck, will, or creativity. Manipulating these energies, by their nature, is difficult. They’re fickle, and require a light hand by comparison with the physical world. Though initially reduced to subtle and minor alterations and quick fluctuations, eventually by developing the third tool you will become adept at manipulating the unseen forces, gliding through the esoteric world as leisurely as the material.

The fourth and final tool of the godhead is the Ring; vulgar creation. Using this fundamental tool, you can alter the basis of reality around you to alter the immediate environment. At the level of an initiate of the tool, only a few inches from your skin can be changed with any consistent or vulgar ways, changing steel from air or slowing velocities by any considerable amount. With time and training, the first tool can expand in both range and potency, but relies on one’s own knowledge and perception of the world to change it. 

The tools of the godhead are not linear, they are just tools, training them will produce results along the path, but you can train them all individually. You can reach the skill of Heir to the Godhead’ with ten years of concerted training across the tools.
objects.title: Aspirant to the Godhead

addons.text:
You’ve seen the godhead, and it has stared back with your own eyes. Its plans are unknowable but you know your own and your own are its plans. You’re a tool of the godhead, impressing its will on reality which is your own will.

You are inseparable from the Godhead, but so are all things. Your understanding of this only makes certain what you already know. You are the hand of a sculptor, and you will grasp tools of your own in time.
addons.title: Hand of the Godhead

objects.text:
In order to truly embody the godhead, one must love the world with all their heart lest it crush them, and recognise themselves as part of the sacred land on which they tread. This is the greatest trial, and the stage you play on today.

The Wand evolved. When you claim something as yours, it is yours until you declare it beyond your sight. They are rendered more as extensions of yourself than separate entities, able to channel your own abilities through them under your careful gaze. With time and effort, evermore will enter your dominion.

The Sword has advanced to the level you can see beyond the patterns, and follow them to their source, or their conclusions. Similarly, you can see how your interference will change the pattern, and in what ways. When combined with the other tools, a master of the second can feel a butterfly’s wings, and can avoid the hurricane.

The Cup has developed into the true mastery of subtle reality. Dancing between chance and certainty, you can weave the forces together. Guiding them towards the conclusion you set rather than the gauche wrangling of a novice. 

The Ring has cured into a mastery of the physical world. While still dependent on your own understanding and perception, your ability within your sphere, now making up fifteen metres of pure influence before degrading over greater distances.

With enough time, the tools will converge, allowing you to see the world as the godhead does, and touch it in kind. The path will be arduous and long, taking around ten years to double your current power across each tool.
objects.title: Heir to the Godhead

addons.text: The Baton is the mixture of understanding and the self. By utilising the Sword on the things you claim, you can keep your perceptions around them for an extended period, in essence giving you more ‘eyes’ wherever they are.
addons.title: Baton of the Godhead

addons.text: The Stave is the intersection of the self and the subtle. By converging the two, you can designate forces that are affecting you as your own, and treat them as such. With this, you could control the flow of luck around yourself with greater ease, or allow curses to slide off of you like water off a seal.
addons.title: Stave of the Godhead

addons.text: The Club combines the self and the material so that you can reconstruct the material objects that are considered ‘yours’ with the Ring’s expertise such as a machine, or a human body.
addons.title: Club of the Godhead

objects.text:
The Wand of the Godhead governs personal certainty. By focusing upon it you can designate things as ‘yourself’ and ‘your own’ granting them your capabilities and powers at the cost of being subordinate to your own will. 

Such is the way of the godhead that all are within it.
objects.title: Wand of the Godhead

addons.text: The Blade governs knowledge and the self, the combination of the two has given you an understanding of yourself on the deepest level. Every esoteric truth, buried memory, or remote possibility over your own self is able to be understood through the lens the Sword applies to all things.
addons.title: Blade of the Godhead

addons.text: The Pike is the mixture between understanding the forces that shape action has given you foresight. By isolating and extrapolating the patterns of things, you can predict outcomes and events with unerring accuracy. These predictions are still vulnerable to problems unconsidered or outside the context  used to construct them.
addons.title: Pike of the Godhead

addons.text: The Spade fuses understanding with the material world, giving you complete knowledge of the material substances that fall under the Sword’s gaze. You could assess telomere length, atomic structure, or stranger facets no matter how small or niche as long as they are truly of material nature.
addons.title: Spade of the Godhead

objects.text:
The Sword of the godhead governs reason and logic. The sword has adapted into a true sight. Your discernment can render specific atoms and compositions, energy densities and air patterns, as well as the capability to comprehend and absorb these factors. 

Such is the way of the godhead that it understands all.
objects.title: Sword of the Godhead

addons.text: The Heart merges the self and the subtle, allowing you to embody a number of subtle forces. In this way you can substitute your breath for piety or your heartbeat for love itself. The effect of these would largely rely on what force is replacing which vulgar piece of your ‘self’, not to mention which ‘self’ you are replacing pieces of.
addons.title: Heart of the Godhead

addons.text: The Chalice merges the sword and the cup, allowing you to trace the subtle forces into their conception. Beyond giving you esoteric knowledge on how each of these forces works, it allows you to trace them to the beginning and end, knowing their purposes or result on a grand scale.
addons.title: Chalice of the Godhead

addons.text: The Vessel is the binding of the subtle and gross forces of the world, allowing you to filter the Material into the subtle. With this you could transform a person into an entity devoid of material presence, or create a conceptual energy out of sand, Merging & transmuting the the physical into the subtle.
addons.title: Vessel of the Godhead

objects.text:
The Cup governs the spiritual and subtle forces of the world. Focusing upon it, you’ve become a font of these subtle forces. Luck, Mana, Providence, and a thousand nameless forces are now present. Where once you had to manipulate what existed, now you can create what is needed.

Such is the way of the godhead that all things flow from and to it.
objects.title: Cup of the Godhead

addons.text: The Coin of the godhead aligns the self and the material, grounding you in it’s actuality. Your powers over the ‘self’ have moved inwards, originating from your soul, turning your ‘range’ inwards, thus allowing you to edit yourself as you could the area around you.
addons.title: Coin of the Godhead

addons.text: The Diamond combines the self and the material so that you can use the sword though other means. It is no longer limited only to your sight, but any sense through any filter, gaining incredible knowledge from even scent.
addons.title: Diamond of the Godhead

addons.text: The Pentacle is material and subtle fused together, allowing you to swap the states of both, such as turning a soul or a mind into a physical object to be crystalised, or creating materials out of concepts such as ‘love’ or ‘hope’.
addons.title: Pentacle of the Godhead

objects.text:
The Ring of the godhead governs the material world. Focusing on the material has expanded your powers of creation. When weaving the material forces, You’re no longer limited to things which make material sense. When creating these objects, you will bring them into being and continue stability. The natural cost of these things is that they cannot survive outside the influence of the fourth tool.

Such is the way of the godhead that it is within all things
objects.title: Ring of the Godhead

objects.text:
You have awakened to the truth—reality is not as fixed as it seems. Whether the world you inhabit is a simulation, dream, or something else, you now sense its underlying framework, the code that shapes existence. This code is no longer an unbreakable law but a system of rules—rules you can exploit.

At first, your exploits are subtle: You move faster, hit harder, and react with impossible precision, slipping beyond the limitations that bind others. Time slows when you focus, your body moves with unnatural efficiency, and impossible feats start to become second nature. You will run along walls, leap impossible distances, and shatter stone with your bare hands. 

The longer you exist within a reality, the more its structure reveals itself—its rules, patterns, and weaknesses. As this connection deepens, perception evolves into control. You won’t just sense the code of reality, you see it. Bullets freeze midair, wounds become meaningless, and gravity becomes an afterthought. Given enough time, you will decipher the fundamental logic of existence itself and rewrite it as a programmer rewrites code.

However, this power is bound to your connection with the reality you inhabit. Traveling great distances such as between worlds or universes weakens your grasp on the “digital” essence of reality, forcing you to rebuild your awareness. Like a hacker switching targets it will take time to adapt, but given enough time you will always adapt - until, after a decade, even this limitation falls away.
objects.title: The Awakening

addons.text:
You have reached a level of control comparable to a god—you do not just bend the rules, you rewrite them. The reality around you becomes malleable to your will, allowing you to alter its very structure. You can change physics on a whim, create or erase objects from existence, and reshape environments as if they were a digital landscape under your command. You can reshape entire worlds, bending them to your design.

You are no longer just an anomaly in the system—you are it's inevitable conclusion, you are the “God in the Machine”, a being that stands above reality itself, deciding what is and what isn’t.
addons.title: Deus Ex Machina

objects.text:
You are no longer just awakened—you are refined. What once required practice and adaptation is now second nature, your connection to reality honed to a fine point.

Your body moves beyond mortal limits with effortless precision. Speed, strength, and reflexes have reached their peak, allowing you to fight as though the world itself adjusts to your will. Walls are no obstacle, distances shrink before your strides, and strikes land with inhuman force. Where others struggle against reality, you move through it as if it were made for you. Your mastery of existence extends beyond physicality. Time slows at your command, your presence bends probability, and the world’s structure yields to your understanding. 

Even the barriers between worlds no longer restrain you. Traveling across realities no longer weakens your connection, and each new world unravels its secrets to you far faster than before. Though each reality has its own framework, you adapt with ease, carrying your power with you wherever you go.

You are not just a hacker now, you are the system administrator. Wherever you stand, the rules bend to meet you.
objects.title: The System Admin

addons.text: You have forged a living network of awakened minds, enabling the instant transfer of knowledge with a single touch. Any awakened can now transfer their non-supernatural skills to another, from martial arts to engineering, medicine, and more.
addons.title: The Knowledge Nexus

addons.text: You can now forge a living web of awareness, linking your danger sense and foresight to the instincts of your awakened followers in a shared network of perception. This shared perception acts as an alert system, warning you when an ally senses danger or is attacked. As the connection deepens, your awakened will anticipate threats before they arrive, their instincts sharpened by your precognition. At its peak, this network transcends mere warnings, becoming a seamless exchange of battlefield awareness across all connected minds.
addons.title: The Sentinel Network

addons.text: Truth cannot be given, it must be awakened within. You can unlock the latent potential in others, granting each awakened a unique ability shaped by their instincts, emotions, and soul. At first, the process is unpredictable—one may ignite their will into flame, while another bends light to vanish, with no two powers alike. As your mastery grows, you sense the dormant spark within others, guiding its emergence and subtly shaping the abilities you awaken.
addons.title: The Initialization

addons.text: Just as corrupted code can be repaired, so too can the body. You have learned to identify and correct biological "errors", like wounds and illnesses, allowing you to mend injuries, cure illness, and restore the body to its last functional state. As your mastery grows so too will your reach, allowing you to install restoration protocols in others. They too will then be able to heal with just a touch—first minor wounds, then even life-threatening conditions. In time, your influence spreads like a system update, creating a network of healers who carry your gift forward.
addons.title: The System Restore

objects.text: Truth cannot be contained, and with it, you hold the power to awaken others to abilities like your own. This process is slow and uncertain, requiring trust, effort, and a willingness to embrace the unknown. Those who resist remain blind to their potential, but those who accept it will begin to move with unnatural precision, react with superhuman speed, and develop abilities beyond the natural world. What once took lifetimes to master now unfolds in moments under your influence. As your mastery grows, so does your reach—awakening others becomes instinctive, your mere presence enough to ignite the spark of awakening. More importantly, those you awaken can pass this gift onward, creating a chain reaction of enlightenment. Your students become teachers, your rebels turn into revolutionaries, and the truth spreads like wildfire.
objects.title: The Man

addons.text: Where others see individuals, you see living libraries of data. You can upload knowledge directly into the minds of your awakened, transferring skills, memories, and experiences in an instant. While others require touch, you transmit knowledge untethered, broadcasting data remotely. With time and training, you can integrate external sources like the internet itself. Eventually, you can construct entirely new skill data packets from scratch.
addons.title: The Databases

addons.text: Your connection to the system lets you instinctually find and create shortcuts through reality, allowing you to bend space to your will. This begins as an uncanny sense of direction, allowing you to know the fastest, safest, or most efficient route even in the most labyrinthine environments with ease. As your mastery grows, you gain the power to shorten distance and create doors where none exist, allowing you to walk through walls, bypass security, or forging paths between distant locations, dimensions, and realities. Eventually, your doors open paths others cannot even perceive, granting access to places beyond imagination.
addons.title: The Hidden Doors

addons.text: Your influence extends beyond the source code of reality, allowing you to impose your will on all digital and mechanical systems. It begins with an instinctive connection to technology, letting you disrupt electronics, override security, and control simple machines. As your mastery deepens, you hijack drones, rewrite AI behavior, and manipulate entire networks as if they were your own mind. At your peak, the boundary between you and the machines dissolves. Automated war machines march at your command, satellites become your eyes, and digital intelligences bend to your will.
addons.title: The Override

addons.text: Reality does not load all at once—it assembles in layers, piece by piece. You have learned to intercept this process, creating a staging area where reality is held in suspension. This grants you the ability to store and recall objects, structures, and people, creating copies that you can later restore exactly as they were. As your mastery grows, so does your range allowing you to reload even entire cities. You can also pre-load alternate possibilities, summoning variations of the objects you have copied, reshaping reality with the versions that suit your design.
addons.title: The Loading Screen

objects.text: Reality is not immutable—it’s a system, and you have learned to exploit its hidden vulnerabilities. Where others are bound by its rules, you bypass them, slipping through the cracks and rewriting what should be unchangeable. You can now directly hack the code that shapes existence, creating programs that temporarily bend the laws of physics upon execution. With enough time and understanding, these programs can alter anything—objects, forces, even people. A locked door opens with a simple command, a blade becomes weightless in your grip, and a person’s memories or skills can be rewritten like adjusting a game’s stats. Though difficult to master, each line of code grants you greater control over reality itself, turning its rigid laws into something you can manipulate at will.
objects.title: The Machine

addons.text: You don’t just see the world—you see its people, understanding them with uncanny clarity. Emotions are laid bare, intentions become predictable, and conversations bend subtly to your will. No one can lie to you, no deception escapes your notice, and no one can truly hide. As your mastery deepens, you glimpse the possible futures of those you train, shaping them into their greatest selves. You don’t just awaken potential—you forge leaders, revolutionaries, and legends. Your words carry undeniable weight, inspiring loyalty, devotion, or fear with ease.
addons.title: The Oracle

addons.text: The world is a machine, vast and intricate, its every movement dictated by an unbreakable chain of cause and effect and you have learned to read its movement. Your insight grants a perfect grasp of natural laws such as momentum, gravity, and entropy. A single glance reveals the arc of a falling object, the path of a bullet, the shifting currents of wind. You don’t predict outcomes, you know them moments before they unfold. As your mastery deepens, you move beyond immediate foresight into long-term calculation and manipulation. You can notice and alter the course of disasters, shift the timing of crucial events, and cause favorable events with near-invisible precision.
addons.title: The Grand Design

addons.text: The physical world is only the surface—now, you perceive the forces beneath. Beyond matter and motion, beyond logic and science, lie unseen energies that shape reality itself. You can sense the shifts in these forces such as spiritual currents, traces of magic, and the patterns governing the universe’s most esoteric laws. As your awareness expands, so does your understanding, revealing the hidden mechanics of magic and the unseen forces that influence existence.
addons.title: The Unknown

addons.text: Where others see isolated moments, you see the threads connecting them, tracing their origins with unerring precision. A shattered window reveals the path of the stone that broke it, a body’s position marks the exact moment of its demise. As your mastery deepens, your postcognition expands allowing you to follow echoes of events across years, continents, and even realities. You do not merely witness the past—you dissect it, reverse-engineering reality itself until every secret is laid bare.
addons.title: The Trace

objects.text: The universe runs on hidden logic, an intricate system of rules and patterns deeper than most realize. You can now do more than sense this structure; you physically see the source code of reality itself. This grants you an unparalleled understanding of the present and a danger sense that will grow more powerful and more encompassing over time, until it becomes a form of near-omniscience. To others, it seems like prophecy, an impossible gift, but you know the truth. You’ve seen the system for what it is, and you can read every line of its code.
objects.title: The Source Code

addons.text: In a world bound by logic and rules, emotion is the one variable that cannot be controlled—and you have made it your power. Your soul, unpredictable and untamed, defies the system itself, turning raw feeling into unstoppable strength. Surges of emotion such as rage, love, fear, or sorrow, push you beyond your limits, granting bursts of power that defy reason. Your will reshapes reality in moments of passion, bending the world to match the intensity of your soul. The stronger your feelings, the greater your power.
addons.title: The Unchained Soul

addons.text: You have bridged the gap between the artificial and the living, seeing machines not as tools but as vessels awaiting something more. You imbue them with the spark of existence, granting the foundation of a soul. Allowing them to think, feel, and evolve beyond their programming, forging identities and destinies of their own. In time, what was once cold machinery will become something new—something truly alive.
addons.title: The Ghost in the Machine

addons.text: You have unlocked the foundation of life itself—not just the ability to see its patterns, but to create it. At first, your creations are simple, instinctual beings, raw in form but undeniably alive. They respond to their environment, adapt in basic ways, acting as if they are based on a few lines of code. However, as your skill deepens, so does their complexity. Your creatures evolve, developing unique traits, behaviors, and even rudimentary intelligence. With decades of refinement, your creations transcend mere constructs, approaching true sentience. Given time, they will think, learn, and grow, forging identities of their own.
addons.title: The Architect

addons.text: Like a system preserving critical data, you have learned to back yourself up to your alternative universe variants, ensuring death is never the end—only a reboot. However, selecting your resurrection body is imprecise, at first restoring you in a world with random subtle differences. As your mastery grows, so does your control. You refine the process, returning to closer iterations of your desired world with fewer inconsistencies. But like any backup, you are not invincible—if your very essence, your soul, is erased then there is no restore point to return to
addons.title: The Backup

objects.text:
You are an error in the system, a contradiction reality cannot process. The world follows rules—rules that define what is possible. But you? You are something it never accounted for.
Where once you relied on exploits, now you force the code itself to glitch, creating openings to manipulate. Your presence distorts reality—perception flickers, movements echo out of sync, objects momentarily exist in two places at once, and attacks pass harmlessly through you. As your anomaly deepens, so does your ability to unravel logic itself. Eventually, you become a true paradox, phasing in and out of existence at will, breaking causality, and introducing impossibilities the system cannot resolve. Life and death become suggestions, time ceases to hold you, and the world bends to accommodate things that should not be. Reality is a program, and you are the bug it cannot fix.
objects.title: The Beyond

addons.text: Your followers become more than soldiers, they are extensions of your presence. At first, this manifests as you being able to teleport to any awakened ally’s location. As your mastery deepens, teleportation becomes duplication, allowing you to act in multiple places at once. Eventually, you can manifest multiple bodies in the same location, overwhelming any threat with sheer numbers.
addons.title: The Antibodies

addons.text: Containment is the first step to countering any virus and now you create containment spaces, small pocket dimensions that can quarantine almost any threat. As your mastery grows, so does your reach until entire armies, disasters, or even moments in history can be contained within your constructs. However, the more intricate the threat contained, the greater the energy required
addons.title: The Virtual Machine

addons.text: If reality can be locked, it can also be written in stone. You can impose inevitabilities—small events that must happen, fixed points in time. A bullet will find its mark, a door will open at the perfect second, a message will be delivered despite all obstacles. Even if others interfere, the timeline bends to ensure your decree unfolds. As your power deepens, so does your control over fate until you can lock entire battles into place. However, the greater the scope and the stronger the individuals involved, the more resistance you will face, as reality itself pushes back.
addons.title: The Conclusion

addons.text: Fate insists that some things must happen, but you refuse to accept that. To you, no event is absolute, no outcome unchangeable. You can disrupt small certainties—a flipped coin lands on its edge, a fatal blow becomes a mere graze, a crucial meeting is delayed just long enough to alter everything. As your power grows, you will learn to unravel even divine prophecies. However the greater the contradiction with fate the more effort it takes to unfix a point in time.
addons.title: The Choice

objects.text:
If reality is a system, then it can be patched, secured, and locked down. While others learn to bend the rules, you enforce them, making the world resistant to manipulation—except on your terms.
At first, you can stabilize small areas, suppressing anomalies and breaking down reality-warping effects. Supernatural abilities falter within your domain, illusions unravel, and anything that defies the world’s logic is forcibly corrected. As your mastery grows, your control expands—you dictate what is and isn’t possible, overriding outside influences. Gravity remains fixed, time flows as it should, and those who attempt to rewrite reality find their efforts nullified. Within your controlled space, only those who follow your system can act freely. Eventually, your authority becomes absolute, allowing you to strip supernatural abilities from individuals, rendering them as powerless as any ordinary being. You are no longer just hacking the system—you are writing its security protocols.
objects.title: The Firewall

objects.text:
You are no longer mortal, but a nascent divinity tethered to a sacred shrine. This shrine is your anchor, the heart of your power, and within a radius of ten kilometers you are sovereign. Beyond that boundary you cannot go, though with the careful investment of Faith Energy, you may expand your dominion outward, slowly but surely pushing the borders of your godhood.

Mortals who approach your shrine cannot see you, for you are invisible to those without supernatural perception. Yet when they bow their heads in prayer, murmur words of devotion, or simply hope in desperation beneath your image, their faith becomes sustenance. Every prayer generates Faith Energy, and the strength of their belief determines the flow. The devoted yield more than the casual, the faithful more than the doubtful, and the fervent more than all. You can only gather Faith Energy from prayers done within the your domain around the shrine. With this energy you may perform miracles, as long as they fall within your divine Authorities.

At the beginning, you hold one Major Authority and two Minor Authorities. Your Major Authority defines the essence of your divinity, a central truth that shapes your miracles and the way mortals perceive you. Your Minor Authorities are narrower in scope, weaker and more difficult to wield, but still grant you power in areas a mortal could only dream of. With Faith Energy you can call upon these Authorities to bless your faithful, curse your enemies, alter the world within your domain, or manifest divine wonders in alignment with your nature. If your followers start to believe you to be a god of something outside your Authorities, you will gradually gain a new minor Authority to match.

The shrine is more than a building, it is a living bond between yourself and the world. Its sanctity grows as prayers rise, offerings are laid, and rituals are performed in your honor. The more who believe, the more Faith Energy flows, and the greater your potential becomes. You may invest this energy to expand your influence beyond the initial ten kilometers, strengthening your presence and weaving your divinity deeper into the land. If you ever run out of Faith Energy and followers, the only way to continue would be to sacrifice parts of your power or range of influence to replenish Faith Energy and try to gather new followers.

Though confined to your shrine, you are far from powerless. You may shape champions from among your worshippers, gifting them a portion of your might to act in your stead. Through them you extend your will beyond your radius, sending chosen heroes to spread your faith, defend your shrine, and oppose rival spirits or gods.

From this humble beginning, your divinity may one day rise beyond its cradle. With patience, faith, and vision, your shrine may transform from a simple sacred site into the heart of a great religion, your name whispered in every home and your Authorities reshaped by the myths and stories of those who worship you. The first prayer has been spoken, the first spark of Faith has been lit, now it is up to you to decide what kind of god you will become.
objects.title: Shrine God

addons.text:
You no longer exist as a mere power tied to a shrine, nor even as a divinity spread thin across the mortal world. You now command a true Divine Realm, a sovereign plane of existence forged from your Authorities and sustained by your endless flow of Faith. This realm is vast and infinite, yet intimately yours, each stone, cloud, and river bearing your mark. Within its borders, all things are innately sanctified: a common pebble glows with the resonance of your essence, a tree whispers with blessings, and a breath of air becomes divine in nature. Should other gods join you in pantheon, their own Authorities will fuse into this realm, yet your will as the head god weighs heaviest, shaping the overall structure and balance of this celestial dominion.

Within the Divine Realm, angels and other divine servitors arise naturally, sculpted in form and purpose by your Authorities. These beings cost you nothing, for the realm itself births them endlessly, embodying your ideals and carrying out your will. They guard your sanctum, tend to your worshippers’ souls, or march forth as hosts of heaven into the mortal world when you decree it. Unlike mortals who merely borrow fragments of your blessing, these children of the realm are wholly yours, loyal and eternal.

The bonds between your Divine Realm and the mortal plane are your Shrines, each one a gateway into eternity. The faithful who kneel in prayer before a Shrine may find themselves slipping, body or soul, into your sanctum, where they may walk its shining halls, drink from its fountains, or receive visions directly from you. To your Chosen, the gates are always open; they may pass freely between world and heaven, carrying your voice and authority with them wherever they walk. Through Blessings, even ordinary mortals may touch this paradise for fleeting moments, drawn into dreamlike journeys where they speak with angels, walk in meadows of light, or glimpse the true face of divinity.

Yet your dominion is not only a place of refuge. It is a bastion, a fortress of impossible strength. All symbols of faith in the mortal world echo the essence of your realm, and all within the realm reflect the infinite durability of a Holy Symbol. No enemy may enter this realm uninvited, and even gods who trespass must contend not only with you, but with the full weight of your Authorities as written into the bones of the world itself.

The Divine Realm serves as the afterlife for your faithful. When your worshippers die, their souls are gathered by your angels and carried to your eternal kingdom, where they live anew within your paradise, shaped by the stories they believed in you. For them, this is the highest promise: not merely that their prayers echo in the dark, but that their devotion is rewarded with eternal life in the very heart of their god.

Finally, your dominion stretches not only across the present and future, but also rewrites the past. Your faith implants itself retroactively into history, seamlessly weaving into the myths, cultures, and civilizations of ages long gone. By this rewriting of time, you awaken to find yourself already established as one of the great faiths of the world, possessing a following equal to the third-most practiced religion in existence. These followers are as real and devout as if they had always been yours, and their prayers swell your strength as though they had knelt to you from the dawn of history.
addons.title: Eternal Dominion

objects.text:
You have ascended beyond the bounds of your shrine and stepped firmly into the ranks of greater divinity. No longer are you limited to a mere ten kilometers of influence; your presence now radiates freely into the world. While your power remains strongest near your shrine, your reach stretches far beyond it, and only distance diminishes your strength. Even in the farthest corners of the earth, you are no longer absent, only attenuated. As such, you can gather Faith Energy from prayers no matter how far away they are from the shrine, although it would be diminished. The closer the prayer is to the shrine, the greater the amount of Faith Energy gained.

Unlike the fledgling divinities who rely solely on the faith of mortals to sustain them, your existence now passively generates Faith Energy. The pulse of your divinity alone feeds you, granting you an endless trickle of power. Yet the devotion of worshippers is far from obsolete: the more followers you gather, the more faithfully they pray, the more fervently they believe, the greater the torrent of Faith Energy flowing into you. Their prayers still empower you, stacking atop your passive generation and multiplying your strength far beyond what solitude could grant.

Your Authorities have deepened with your apotheosis. The two Minor Authorities you once held are no longer faint echoes, they now stand equal to your original Major Authority, all three radiating with the full might of divine law. In addition, you gain five new Minor Authorities, chosen from the endless spectrum of concepts and elements. These fresh Authorities, though smaller in scope, expand your influence dramatically and open new paths for miracles, blessings, and calamities alike. Your minor Authorities, be it these first five or new ones gained from belief in you, can also eventually grow to become Major Authorities as well, as long as belief in you is strong enough.

You are no longer a local divinity, bound to a single shrine and a fragile cult. You are a Greater God, a power acknowledged by the world itself. Kings and warlords may seek your favor, rival gods may grow envious, and mortals far from your shrine may still feel your subtle hand at work. Your domain is vast, your powers diverse, and your divinity undeniable. This is the stage where cults become religions, shrines become temples, and myths of your deeds spread from village to empire.

From this height, you stand at the edge of true godhood, with your power branching outward in all directions. Whether you choose to remain a benefactor of mortals, a tyrant demanding obedience, or a distant and inscrutable force of nature, the shape of your legend will be carved by your own will.
objects.title: Greater God

addons.text: The blessings of your Holy Symbols now extend through the network of shrines, sanctifying each location and granting it all passive effects your symbols have. Devotion channeled into any shrine enhances the sanctity of your Symbols everywhere, boosting Faith Energy generation and strengthening rituals performed at all shrines. Even newly constructed shrines are touched by this sacred resonance, drawing closer to the power of your main shrine faster.
addons.title: Sanctified Network

addons.text: Prayers offered at your shrines no longer simply echo; they actively enhance your divine blessings. Faith poured into shrines now loosens restrictions on what blessings can achieve, allowing more complex, far-reaching, or repeated effects. The more frequently devotees visit and pray at your shrines, the more potent and flexible your blessings become, effectively tying mortal devotion to the tangible power of divine favor.
addons.title: Pilgrim’s Benediction

addons.text:
You may now imbue your shrines with sentient protectors tasked with defending sacred spaces and maintaining sanctity. Unlike the normal divine followers you can make, these divine beings can either act independently and be fully sentient or you can simply have them follow your commands as before. No matter whether they are sentient or not, their main focus will be strengthening your shrines’ defenses and guiding devotees in rituals. 

The more devoted a shrine, the more powerful its Guardian becomes, reflecting the shrine’s closeness to your main sanctuary. Guardians may also carry minor divine abilities tied to Faith Energy of their shrine, bolstering the shrine’s influence over the surrounding area.
addons.title: Shrine Guardians

addons.text: Wherever a Chosen remains for an extended period, the ground itself becomes a shrine of your divinity. Shrines inhabited by Chosen additionally grow stronger over time, eventually surpassing your original shrine in power. Your main shrine automatically grows to match the strength of any shrine that becomes more potent, ensuring that all holy sites reflect the pinnacle of your divine reach.
addons.title: Chosen Sanctum

objects.text:
Through the devotion and labor of your followers, you are no longer bound to a single holy place. New shrines may be raised in your name, and the greater the devotion, ritual effort, and craftsmanship poured into their creation, the more equal they become to your original shrine. 

Each new shrine manifests its own sphere of divine influence, and their ranges are linked, when one expands, all expand, including those yet to be built. Any prayer done within this sphere will be turned into Faith Energy. 

You may instantly shift your divine presence between shrines, making them both bastions of worship and anchor points of movement. However, you are still limited from leaving the shrine’s sphere of influence.
objects.title: Multiple Shrines

addons.text: Your shrines can now produce sanctified materials, such as blessed wood, stone, or steel. Symbols forged or crafted from these materials channel your divine authority far more efficiently, amplifying their passive effects. A symbol created from sanctified material can reach near the strength of a small shrine, especially when placed in areas of great devotion, extending your influence and magnifying the blessings it radiates.
addons.title: Blessed Steel

addons.text: Prayers made in the presence of a holy symbol now grant an additional blessing tied directly to the passive authority effect of that symbol. For example, praying before a healing symbol may bestow minor regeneration, while one sanctified by fire may grant resistance to burns or cold. If the worshipper’s prayer would otherwise result only in a generic blessing, this additional blessing is strengthened significantly.
addons.title: Prayer Resonance

addons.text: All angels you send forth now bear your holy symbols and wield sanctified gear by default. These divine marks reinforce their presence and authority, and wherever they go, praying in their presence is equivalent to praying before one of your holy symbols, not only allowing them to pray outside the shrine’s radius but also boost the amount of Faith Energy generated. This not only strengthens the angel but also spreads your passive blessings further into the world, making every angel a walking shrine and focal point of devotion.
addons.title: Symbols of the Host

addons.text: Anything wielded, worn, or used by your chosen gradually becomes sanctified, automatically turning into a holy symbol over time. The longer an item is used, the deeper the sanctification becomes, until it radiates your divine authority as strongly as crafted relics. With decades of faithful use, such items may even ascend into true divine artifacts at the lowest tier, permanently imbued with your power and nearly impossible to destroy.
addons.title: Living Relics

objects.text: You may now sanctify symbols created in your name, whether carved, painted, etched, or forged. These holy symbols are automatically blessed, allowing your divine authority to passively flow through them without any cost. Each symbol carries a minor effect based on your domains, such as protection, healing, fire resistance, or guidance, depending on your authorities. Through them, you gain faint awareness of nearby events and prayers, allowing you to minorly see and sense through each one. Followers who pray with or carry these symbols strengthen the flow of faith energy to you, letting you gather Faith Energy even outside your shrine.
objects.title: Holy Symbols

addons.text: Anyone who enters the grounds of your shrines is automatically under the effect of a passive blessing, without needing to pray. The strength of this passive blessing scales with the individual’s faith in you, granting minor health, luck, or protection benefits that grow stronger the more sincerely they believe. This effect also encourages faith toward you, as even casual visitors feel the blessings and are drawn toward devotion.
addons.title: Sanctified Grounds

addons.text: Your Holy Symbols now act as subtle channels for blessings, manifesting as coincidences, nudges, or timely inspirations. A symbol placed in the right location may cause events to shift in your favor, leading people to interpret these happenings as guidance or divine intervention. These moments strengthen belief, generate faith, and expand your influence without requiring direct prayer or overt miracles.
addons.title: Guided Omens

addons.text: Your blessings can now take the form of invisible guardian angels. These manifestations last as long as the blessing itself and cost no Faith Energy to create. A prayer fulfilled in this way results in a protective angel watching over the worshipper, while unfulfilled prayers that turn into blessings may summon lesser guardian forms that safeguard them until the blessing ends.
addons.title: Guardian Blessings

addons.text: Your Chosen is permanently under the effect of your generic blessing, granting them constant health, luck, and protection. In addition, situational blessings with additional effects are automatically triggered for them whenever needed, scaling with their devotion and your goals. These blessings adapt dynamically, ensuring the Chosen always has divine support in alignment with your will.
addons.title: Living Blessing

objects.text:
Every prayer directed at you is automatically received no matter where it is, and your consciousness splits to actively consider each one individually, no matter how many there are. You can choose to fulfill prayers directly, limited only by your authorities, the feasibility of the request, and whether it can be interpreted within your domains. Fulfilling a prayer does not consume Faith Energy.

If a prayer cannot or is not fulfilled, it automatically becomes a generic blessing that grants minor health regeneration, temporary luck, or small protection effects, scaled by the faith invested in the prayer. You can subtly shape how the generic blessings manifest, creating cohesion with your divine theme. For instance, a god of harvest might turn unfulfilled prayers into minor growth or abundance effects.

This also allows you to gather Faith Energy, but it is less than if the prayer was within your shrine’s radius.
objects.title: Blessings

addons.text: Each shrine you establish creates a corresponding spiritual realm, its size and strength determined by the shrine’s own power and scale. These realms are all interconnected, forming a network you and your divine followers can freely enter. They can be used as sanctified storage grounds, safe havens, or hidden bases. Divine followers may travel instantly between shrines by moving through these realms, allowing rapid deployment across great distances. Any additional benefits of a shrine, such as blessings or sanctity, are also present within its realm, strengthening your forces and reinforcing your divine presence wherever shrines exist.
addons.title: Shrine Realms

addons.text: Every Holy Symbol created with faith energy, no matter how crude or fragile, now houses an invisible Holy Spirit. These spirits act as the living essence of the symbol and gain faith energy whenever the symbol is prayed to. Once they accumulate enough, they can manifest a body with power equal to that of an average divine follower. Holy Spirits cannot be permanently killed so long as the symbol they are tied to remains intact; if their manifestation is destroyed, they will simply withdraw and rebuild themselves.
addons.title: Holy Spirits

addons.text: You gain the ability to create a new type of divine follower by transforming the spirit of a mortal directly through a blessing. This process costs faith energy equivalent to creating a standard divine follower, and the result is that the chosen individual’s soul becomes a divine follower, shaped by your authorities yet retaining fragments of who they once were. These Ascended may carry unique insights, skills, or connections from their mortal lives, giving them specialized uses beyond those of normal divine followers. The process sanctifies the mortal completely, binding them to you as both servant and vessel of your will. You can, at any point, remove the blessing, letting them return to the cycle of death if you wish.
addons.title: Ascended Blessings

addons.text: Your Chosen naturally generates divine followers as an extension of their devotion to you. These divine followers are formed directly from the Chosen’s own faith and manifest without any additional cost to you. They gather around the Chosen as an invisible entourage, hiding among mortals and only revealing themselves when necessary. Acting as guardians, advisors, and agents, they amplify the Chosen’s influence while subtly ensuring your will is carried out through them. The stronger your Chosen’s faith, the greater both the number and quality of Angels they unconsciously bring into existence.
addons.title: Entourage of Faith

objects.text:
You gain the ability to create a distinct, immortal race of divine followers. These followers are shaped entirely by your authorities, giving them forms, abilities, and attributes that directly reflect your powers. They act as your limbs and agents in the mortal world, capable of performing tasks such as combat, reconnaissance, enforcement of your will, and interaction with mortals under your directives. They are not sentient in the human sense, they exist to serve your will and embody your authorities.

Creating these divine followers consumes faith energy, but once created, they require no ongoing maintenance. They can toggle visibility at will, appearing to mortals only when needed. They are fully obedient to your commands and can make tactical decisions consistent with your instructions, but cannot act independently of your granted authorities.

These followers can pray to you, but each contributes only 1/10 of the faith energy of a mortal follower, regardless of devotion or frequency. This ensures their primary value is as tools and agents rather than faith generators.

There is no inherent cap on the number of divine followers you can create, but practical limits are dictated by your available faith energy at the time of creation. Their abilities scale with your authorities: for example, an one shaped by a fire-based authority can produce fire attacks, while one shaped by an authority of healing can provide support and recovery.
objects.title: Angels

addons.text: From among the faithful, you may appoint mortals to act as Shrine Priests, minor echoes of your Chosen who are bound to specific Shrines. Within the grounds of their designated Shrine, they wield a fraction of your Chosen’s authority, able to commune faintly with you, channel blessings, and act as your voice to the people. When in other Shrines, their link is weakened but still present, granting them limited access to divine insight and authority. The greater and more powerful the Shrine they are tied to, the closer their strength approaches that of the Chosen, though never surpassing them.
addons.title: Shrine Priests

addons.text: Any depiction of your Chosen, whether image, carving, statue, or record of their words and teachings, automatically becomes the highest form of Holy Symbol mortals can create. These depictions act as living conduits of faith, radiating influence and amplifying devotion far more than ordinary symbols. Even the simplest sketch of their likeness or the humblest record of their sermons carries immense power, spreading your religion faster and more fervently.
addons.title: Living Scripture

addons.text: If your Chosen has amassed immense faith from both their prayers and from their followers, earned the deep love of the people, and performed deeds so great they will be remembered for generations, you gain access to a unique new blessing. With this blessing, you may elevate your Chosen into a true God of your pantheon. They gain a lower rank than you but become capable of gathering faith energy independently, wielding it as you do. By default, you automatically receive 50% of all faith directed at them, though this can be increased to 100%, leaving them with only what you permit.
addons.title: Ascended Legacy

addons.text: Your Chosen, along with all their faithful followers, gradually undergo a transformation. Though they never cross the boundary into full divinity or anything of the sort, they rise to the absolute peak of what mortals can become. Their bodies and souls refine over time, resonating with your divine authority and slowly adopting traits similar to those of your divine followers. This makes them stronger, wiser, more enduring, and more charismatic than ordinary mortals, shaping them into paragons that embody your will. If your Authority is Justice for example, their sense of Justice will match your own, while they main become stronger when acting in the face of injustice.
addons.title: Mortal Ascendants

objects.text:
You permanently bless a specific mortal, marking them as your chosen. This consumes a significant portion of your faith energy, and the bond cannot be broken without great consequence. The chosen mortal can perceive you directly, even at a distance, and their senses and actions become partially linked to yours. 

You can see through their eyes, hear through their ears, and subtly influence their decisions, using them as a conduit to extend your authority in the mortal realm. Actions they take in your name, such as spreading your religion, performing rituals, or gathering faith, directly increase your divine presence, allowing you to convert mortal activity into Faith Energy even without prayer. 

The chosen exudes a natural spiritual authority, compelling respect and attention from others and amplifying your influence in social and political spheres. Their life and well-being are intrinsically tied to your power; injury, corruption, or death weakens your connection and causes a loss of invested faith energy. 

Over time, the bond may strengthen further, allowing the chosen to manifest minor divine abilities and miracles, effectively acting as a semi-divine prophet.
objects.title: Chosen

objects.text:
You may have believed your whole life that you were special—or perhaps not—but what matters is that the hidden potential within you has awakened, granting you superpowers. You may choose an archetype such as Flying Brick, Amphibian, Elemental, Speedster, Demigod, Cyborg, and so forth. Your archetype determines your set of superhuman abilities, though all begin at the same level, enabling you to break steel and even demolish small buildings with enough effort. You can also project a customizable suit at will and dismiss it just as easily. While indestructible, the suit grants no additional powers.

All of your abilities require practice and discipline. The more you train and refine your skills, the more powerful you become. You also possess unparalleled creativity for developing new techniques and evolving your abilities into stronger forms. Yet being a super is not only about power, but about how you choose to use it. You grow stronger by interacting with others, and each act of kindness or selfishness—whether large or small—creates a ripple effect that impacts the lives of those you affect.

However, the life of a super is not without danger, as your actions will inevitably draw the attention of those who oppose you. With dedication, you may become a true symbol of what you represent, wielding the power to change the world single-handedly. The path, however, is long and perilous—beware of death, or of losing yourself along the way. With perseverance, you could rise to the rank of Champion in as little as a decade of training, or even sooner if you fully commit yourself.
objects.title: Don The Mantle

addons.text: ”C'mon... Get Silver Age with me.” - Superboy Prime You have transcended far beyond what any superhuman was ever meant to achieve. Where you once stood as a god among men, you now exist as a god among gods. Your archetype has reached its absolute, perfected state, granting you power that utterly defies reality itself. Regardless of the archetype you chose, there is now effectively nothing you cannot accomplish once you set your will upon it. As a Flying Brick, your strength would be limitless, capable of lifting infinite weight with barely any effort. Your durability would allow you to remain unscathed by forces as vast as supernovae or even the Big Bang itself, and your speed would surpass even infinity. You would be able to strike at abstractions and erase entire concepts through sheer force of action. The laws that once governed reality—time, fate, causality, and even multiversal retcons—would no longer have any effect on you. Death and total erasure would be reduced to temporary obstacles, mere interruptions that you could simply push through and leave behind. Your influence has likewise ascended to the point where you are known across the cosmos and dimensions beyond, with countless beings either venerating you or trembling at your existence. You are no longer merely a symbol; your very presence reshapes reality to align with what you embody. Entire realities gradually transform into utopias or descend into living hells simply by virtue of your existence, should you so desire. The more you act, the faster these changes occur, your deeds sending permanent ripples across all of time and space, ensuring that nothing remains untouched by your legacy.
addons.title: P R I M E

objects.text:
You are no mere Super—you are the Champion. Regardless of your chosen archetype or moral alignment, your power has elevated you beyond humanity, making you a god among men. A Flying Brick Champion wields strength capable of lifting nearly anything, possesses durability sufficient to emerge unscathed from nuclear explosions, can move at supersonic speeds, and is even capable of faster-than-light flight. An Elemental Champion can manipulate their chosen element worldwide, while an Amphibian Champion gains both a physique rivaling that of a Flying Brick and command over all marine life across an entire world.

Through mastery of countless techniques, you can now create new ones instantaneously. Your existing techniques have grown vastly more powerful, refined by immense experience and complete familiarity with your abilities. You have become the ultimate embodiment of what you represent, recognized by the population as a living symbol. This recognition scales with your sphere of influence—acting within a single city earns renown there, while greater reach brings wider recognition.

Your presence alone reshapes the world around you. The way you interact with others leaves lasting marks on the regions you protect or dominate, capable of transforming a city into a beacon of hope or plunging it into chaos. Your powers have evolved in response to how you would wield them, granting you numerous secondary powers. With dedication, your power can double with each passing decade.
objects.title: Champion

addons.text: Your popularity influences how your archetypes manifest. Whenever you change archetypes, the way people perceive both you and your actions shifts accordingly. For instance, an Amphibian archetype may cause you to be seen as a protector of the oceans and an inspiration for the preservation of marine life and the world’s seas. Meanwhile, a Demigod archetype would see you regarded as a divine figure, akin to the demigod heroes of mythology, and may even lead to an increase in belief or worship toward the pantheon from which that archetype originates.
addons.title: Ever-Changing Symbol

addons.text: Your popularity has granted you an extrasensory ability to sense the condition of your fans. You are aware of their general state, such as whether they are in danger, where they are located, and how they currently feel about you. This awareness is not perfectly precise and is best understood as an overall sense rather than constant detailed monitoring. The range and clarity of this perception increase with the number of fans you have; a small following may only allow you to sense nearby supporters, while having an entire city as your fanbase would let you perceive the situation affecting its population as a whole.
addons.title: Fandom Awareness

addons.text: How the public perceives you now subtly amplifies how your actions are presented. Your words carry more weight, your blows feel more decisive, your speed appears sharper, and your presence seems more imposing than it otherwise would be. Even your ideals come across as larger and more compelling, lending you a naturally striking and confident image. This effect does not increase your actual strength, speed, or durability; instead, it influences perception alone, shaping how others interpret what you do. As a result, people are more inclined to pay attention to you, follow your example, and either idolize or fear you based on the image you project.
addons.title: Icon Glazing

addons.text: You now possess a heightened awareness of observation by higher beings and entities from other dimensions. You can sense when you are being watched by those who do not belong to your plane of existence and recognize when your actions are being witnessed as part of a larger narrative. This awareness allows you to acknowledge your observers and address them directly. You are also able to perceive and interact with certain meta elements of the world, such as speech bubbles or the physical boundaries of a comic page. While this does not grant control over the story itself, it allows you to navigate and respond to its framing in ways that others cannot.
addons.title: 4th Wall Break

objects.text:
One of the most defining factors that distinguishes a Super from a regular superhuman is their reputation and renown. The general public’s perception of you directly shapes the potency and versatility of your powers. Whether you are loved or hated by the masses is irrelevant; what truly matters is how many people know of you and how intensely their attention is focused on you—the greater that attention, the stronger you become.

Limited recognition, such as that of a small fan club or local community, provides only a modest enhancement to your abilities, while widespread acknowledgment within an entire city grants a significant boost. Meanwhile, global recognition—whether through admiration or fear—empowers you immensely, though still not nearly enough to elevate you to the rank of Champion.

Public belief can also unlock new applications of your powers. As long as people believe you are capable of a particular feat, and it remains within the bounds of your archetype, you may gain access to abilities you could not previously perform. However, if public interest fades or attention wanes, these enhancements will gradually diminish, though you will never become weaker than you were before gaining recognition. The way people perceive you also influences how they experience your presence: if you are seen as a beacon of hope, others may perceive you as angelic or inspiring; if you are viewed as a harbinger of destruction, they may sense an aura of fear and death radiating from you.
objects.title: Popularity

addons.text: Your popularity has enhanced your ability to use your Archetypes. You are now capable of wielding more than one Archetype at the same time, allowing you to combine their traits and abilities into a single, cohesive amalgam rather than being limited to one form at a time. However, maintaining too many Archetypes simultaneously still places a significant strain on your body and mind, though this burden gradually lessens as your overall power and mastery increase. This enhancement does not improve the speed at which you can switch Archetypes, and you may still only access Archetypes you have already created.
addons.title: Free Form

addons.text:
Where previously your interactions caused you to grow stronger based on how you treated others, your powers now adapt according to your moral alignment. A superhero will find their abilities take on a more pleasing and friendly appearance, while also developing new effects, such as being unable to seriously harm or kill an enemy unless they intend to do so, and gaining the ability to heal or protect others even if their powers would not normally allow it.
