A villain, by contrast, will find their powers become more intimidating and frightening in appearance, while also growing more lethal and agonizing for enemies so long as they possess the intent to cause harm, and developing the ability to siphon life force from their targets to heal or empower themselves.
addons.title: Alignment Shift

addons.text: While you may choose any archetype, not every idea naturally qualifies as one, as some concepts are too abstract to be considered an archetype. However, with this option, you may turn any idea into an archetype so long as it falls within your power level. For example, you could create a Household Appliance archetype that transforms you into a sentient washing machine with abilities such as generating extremely durable bubbles and “washing” your enemies, or a Super Baby archetype that literally turns you into a baby with superpowers, and so on.
addons.title: Abstract Concept

addons.text: Where once you would have had to spend several minutes changing from one archetype to another, you may now switch archetypes instantaneously, so long as the change is thematically appropriate. For example, if you find yourself in a dire situation that can only be resolved with a specific archetype, you will be able to shift to that archetype immediately. This ability also shortens the time required for non-instant switches, such as reducing five minutes down to two and a half minutes.
addons.title: Instant Swap

objects.text:
Your archetype is an essential part of what defines who you are as a Super, determining both your powers and how you operate in the world. A Nocturne Stalker archetype would naturally lead you to act primarily, if not exclusively, at night, while a Space Explorer archetype would focus on exploring the cosmos. However, you now possess the ability to switch between archetypes, meaning you are no longer permanently bound to the original archetype you chose—though this freedom comes with several conditions.

First, you cannot have more than one archetype at a time; you must switch archetypes before gaining access to another archetype’s powerset. Second, changing archetypes is not instantaneous—you must spend several minutes undergoing the change, and if the process is interrupted, you will have to start over from the beginning.

Finally, you cannot freely switch to any archetype at will; you must first imagine and create an archetype before you can assume it. Archetypes are created by envisioning what you want them to be, but this process requires effort and can be exhausting if done repeatedly without rest, meaning you cannot create an unlimited number of archetypes in rapid succession.
objects.title: Archetypes

addons.text:
Your popularity now gives rise to new allies, as those who feel a connection to your ideals or way of thinking are likely to develop powers of their own, should you desire it. These awakenings may occur in many ways—through accidents that unexpectedly grant superpowers, by simply waking up one day to discover they possess abilities, or through other circumstances. Regardless of the cause, these individuals will choose to follow your example, rising as new symbols of hope, despair, or something else, depending on your alignment.

This effect also applies to those with whom you share a close relationship, such as friends, family, or even a romantic partner. While this does not necessarily mean they will grow as strong as you or reach the same heights, their abilities will still be significant enough to make a real difference in the world.
addons.title: Super Mania

addons.text: Regardless of the path you choose, it does not mean you can flawlessly fulfill that role. However, as long as it is something you desire, you may make yourself accurately embody a specific role, whether morally good or bad—for example, an edgy Nightstalker archetype behaving in line with what one would expect from that role. This influence only extends as far as you wish, and you retain the ability to “switch off” this role-playing at any time.
addons.title: Roleplay Mode

addons.text:
The path you choose now influences probability, making outcomes more likely to go your way. The more consistently you act in accordance with your chosen role, the more “momentum” you build, causing events to favor results that reinforce that role.

For example, if you are a hero faced with a dire situation where the odds of saving someone are slim, your chances of success will increase in proportion to how strongly you embody your role. With sufficient momentum, those odds can even reach 100%. However, this momentum will gradually fade if you begin acting contrary to your role. That said, momentum can be built in a new direction if you genuinely choose to change the role you embody.
addons.title: Moral Inertia

addons.text:
The world of supers is one of endless possibilities, where literally anything can happen. People are inherently flawed; even paragons of justice make mistakes, and even the worst criminals may do something good once in a lifetime. You now possess the ability to take advantage of this reality.

As a hero, your words carry greater weight with your enemies, and your actions leave an even deeper impact, causing opponents to view you more favorably even when they would otherwise hate you. With enough effort and genuine intent, you could even persuade them to seek redemption and truly change for the better. Likewise, as a villain, even heroes may come to view you with a degree of favor so long as you do not go too far in your actions, and with sufficient effort you could even convince them to abandon their ideals and join your side.
addons.title: Redemption & Corruption

objects.text:
You now possess the special ability to intuitively recognize the most effective course of action to achieve your goals. A hero gains a keen sense of how to most positively influence the situations around them, such as choosing the best way to interact with others, resolve conflicts, or improve existing structures—whether physical, social, or otherwise. Likewise, a villain—or a more egocentric individual—perceives the actions that would most benefit themselves and can identify opportunities within their surroundings that can be exploited for personal gain.

In addition, this sense heightens your awareness of the people and events around you. You can discern the intentions and inner nature of those you interact with, recognizing whether someone is benevolent or malicious, whether they harbor harmful intent toward you or those you care about, and whether their ideals align with your own or make them suitable to join your cause.

It also allows you to sense when people in the area are in immediate danger—if you are a hero—or only those you care about, if you are selfish, as well as when a plot is underway that could negatively affect or harm you or others. However, this ability does not allow you to read thoughts or emotions beyond intent, nor does it grant the ability to predict danger in advance unless it falls within these specific conditions.
objects.title: Good & Evil

addons.text: Previously, you already grew stronger from people paying attention to you, but now this effect increases based on how much attention you receive at once. For instance, if you were fighting an opponent and everyone present was focused on you and cheering you on, you would find yourself becoming even stronger for the duration of the battle. This boost also scales with the stakes involved; in a situation where the lives of everyone present depend on you to save them, you would become significantly stronger. However, all of these boosts are temporary and fade once the situation calms down and the spotlight is no longer on you.
addons.title: Spotlight Effect

addons.text: Previously, you were already able to bend logic to suit your actions, but now your ability to create Archetypes also allows you to change the genre of a situation to better match your current Archetype. For example, if you are using a comedy-based archetype, situations may twist to fit the comedic genre, with enemies behaving more goofily or making foolish mistakes. Conversely, if you adopt a horror-based archetype, situations may shift toward a horror theme, with enemies becoming more easily frightened or making poor decisions—such as splitting up, despite that almost always ending badly in horror stories.
addons.title: Genre Shift

addons.text: One of the most problematic aspects of being a super is collateral damage—though this is only a concern for those who actually care about it. This will no longer be a problem for you. Whenever you use your powers and end up damaging your surroundings, you will never be held accountable for the destruction you cause. In fact, this ability goes even further, automatically undoing any environmental damage resulting from you or your battles. However, this effect does not extend to lives lost; it applies only to the surrounding environment.
addons.title: Consequence Free

addons.text: Previously, events were already far more likely to go your way, but this effect has now been enhanced even further. Whenever you find yourself in a critical situation—such as facing imminent death at an enemy’s hands or an impending crisis that could determine whether everyone lives or dies—events conveniently unfold at the exact moment you need them most. Whether it’s an enemy stopping to monologue or reinforcements arriving in the nick of time, it has become far less likely for you to die or suffer a decisive loss.
addons.title: Last-Second Turn

objects.text:
You now possess the ability to make logic bend to accommodate your actions. Beyond the basics—such as grabbing someone at supersonic speeds without turning them into paste—actions that would normally be impossible, whether due to physical laws or metaphysical constraints, become fully achievable the moment you attempt them. This includes affecting entities that should otherwise be untouchable, such as ghosts or invulnerable beings whose true forms exist on a “higher plane of existence,” as well as performing blatantly illogical feats, including influencing fundamental concepts like space and time.

This power also retroactively supplies the “convenient” explanations necessary to prevent worlds from destabilizing or becoming hostile due to your disregard for physics. Events will align in a way that renders your actions internally consistent within the setting, even if such consistency would normally be impossible. However, this ability is strictly reactive, not passive. Logic follows what you do, not what you wish would happen. You must act first—effort, intent, and execution are required. Expecting reality to conveniently arrange itself in your favor without intervention will yield nothing.
objects.title: Comic Logic

addons.text: For some reason, comic book characters often possess the strange ability to return from death even when survival should be impossible, and this same phenomenon now applies to you. Whenever you die—regardless of the cause, severity, or circumstances—you will return to life fully healed and restored to peak condition. If your body is completely destroyed, you will instead reappear in a safe location, unharmed and whole. However, this ability allows resurrection only once per year; should you die a second time before that year has passed, you will not be brought back.
addons.title: Back From The Dead

addons.text:
Your Plot Armor has been further enhanced by the power of your Archetypes. This means you are effectively incapable of being defeated by anything that directly contradicts the internal logic or theme of your currently active archetype. Threats that would normally be dangerous simply fail to function if they are “too ridiculous” for your role.

For example, a Speedster archetype cannot die from colliding with objects or even extremely durable opponents, a Flying Brick would not perish from having their cape caught in an airplane engine, an Amphibian cannot be killed by mundane aquatic creatures, and a Cyborg cannot be brought down by a simple computer virus. In short, anything that would be considered an absurd or anticlimactic end for your archetype is no longer a valid way to take you out.
addons.title: Archetypal Immunity

addons.text: Some supers are never able to arrive when they are needed most, often showing up too late to their job or losing people they care about as a result. This, however, does not apply to you. No matter the circumstances, you are always capable of appearing exactly when you are needed most. Whether you happened to wake up earlier that day, were already nearby, took a different route, or simply found yourself in the right place at the right time, events always seem to align in your favor. You arrive when it counts, ensuring you are never too late to make a difference.
addons.title: Never Too Late

addons.text: In the world of superhero comics, a recurring and pervasive aspect is the presence of reality warpers, timeline alterations, time paradoxes, and even multiversal rewrites. These phenomena are a constant problem for nearly everyone—heroes, villains, and civilians alike—and almost always have a profound impact on their lives. You, however, are not like the rest. Your Plot Armor has been enhanced to grant you a powerful resistance to these effects, giving you a significant advantage over those who lack such protection. It is far more difficult for these phenomena to affect you at all, and you can even outright shrug off alterations that fall below your power level.
addons.title: Anti-Retcon

objects.text:
Have you ever wondered how some characters manage to survive situations they should not be able to endure, or perform feats that should otherwise be impossible—such as pulling items from their pockets despite logically never having had the time to obtain them? You now possess that same ability, commonly known as “Plot Armor” or “Writer’s Convenience.” This power functions passively, manifesting as a subtle “aura” that causes reality itself to conveniently align in your favor.

To begin with, this ability allows you to survive nearly any conflict, even when your archetype would not normally permit it. For example, you might withstand gunfire simply because you are a Super, despite lacking inherent superhuman durability. It also enables you to successfully carry out plans and actions that would otherwise be impossible, such as recalling a technique you had conveniently forgotten or producing an item that happens to be the perfect solution to your current predicament.

Additionally, this power allows your abilities to function in ways that defy logic. A character with regeneration, for instance, may recover even after being reduced to a skeleton, despite such an outcome normally resulting in death. However, your plot armor is not absolute. The higher the threat you face the less likely you are to survive, and any feats you perform must remain thematically appropriate to the situation at hand.
objects.title: Plot Armor

objects.text: Most people see in three dimensions, great walls erected in their consciousness. You can see past the fourth. You know the words on the page, the marginalia between the panels, the text boxes and scene transitions. You can feel them as they exist and move with them as they do. Your connection to the [Outside] of your [Medium] allows you to sense how it shifts focus and flow, as well as sheltering you from Retcons Atemporal dangers. Furthermore, your abilities always take the form of your [Narrative]'s necessities. Living narrative convenience/contrivance. Unfortunately, as an agent of your [Narrative], you’re dependent on your narrative and medium. Knowing that there are beings beyond you stamping you onto the page does not inspire confidence when in constant danger of cancellation, lack of renewal, or simply author disinterest.
objects.title: Pool

addons.text:
In full ascendance, you’ve reached the pinnacle of power over your medium, becoming the final arbiter of your work as much as a character.

Your interpretation of your medium is the only one that holds weight, the true and final conception of it, with you capable of warping it to fit your will. The Author Is Dead, Long Live The Author.
addons.title: [M E T A]

objects.text:
Your transcension beyond the narrative has allowed you to see it all clearly. Beyond the fourth wall you can see your entire medium and the overarching ‘soft’ rules it operates by. You can take these rules and warp them, altering the [Genre] and [Tone] of your world by pulling on its threads, angling the direction these things pass. 

Furthermore, by taking a stronger hand in your medium, you can alter the finer aspects, changing the [Narrative] direction like a producer mandating changes. Taking a finer view of things you become akin to a co-author or an influence on the path things take at the consequence of your finer arena.

Finally, as a true [INCITING INCIDENT] you can pull others into your orbit, starting another narrative as soon as one ends in one great unbroken [serialised] journey. You control your progression and your path, and the fleeting disinterest of a greater god will not deter you.
objects.title: Prime

addons.text:
Your understanding of the vulgar and subtle aspects of your medium has allowed you to shape it with far greater ease. 

More genre savvy than ever, you have an awareness for the author’s intent and an understanding of your medium’s specific tropes and themes, giving you foresight into the shape of things as they turn out.
addons.title: Trope Talks

addons.text: Using the vulgar aspects of your medium, you can replicate the aspects of others instead to replicate the effect. For instance, you could cut film strips in a comic to ‘erase’ sections of time, or use the marginalia of comic panels in a literature book to teleport.
addons.title: Not How That Works

objects.text:
Your understanding of your medium has broadened into actually affecting its rules.

What this exactly means is dependent on your medium itself. A comic may have its panels warped, you could rearrange or steal words in literature, changing the backing track or making scene cuts in a cinematic medium and the like.

As you grow more adept at manipulating your medium, you’ll be able to affect it in more and more dramatic ways, morphing and breaking its rules with impunity.
objects.title: Duck Amuk

addons.text:
Access to both the front and backend of production has allowed you to alter the world by speech alone. 

Like any good narrator, reality follows your command with the only notable restrictions being those of your own mind and explanation. With greater changes comes greater reasoning needed, blending your understanding and control over your medium in order to make your audits as you see fit, as narration that doesn’t fit the established narrative is ultimately meaningless.
addons.title: Stations of Canon

addons.text:
Able to pull things from outside your medium into it, your understanding of it’s fundamentals lets you drag more abstract sections in as well, pulling tropes and themes from other works and mediums into your own like they were objects and characters.

Notably, this is easier than drawing physical characters in, but becomes more difficult the more dissonant the tone and trope is with your accepted medium, it being very difficult to bring a comedic trope into a tragedy.
addons.title: Wait, I’ve Seen This One! (Attribution Tag)

objects.text:
Your understanding of your medium has specialised into affecting the ‘back end’ of this medium.

You can make secondary edits depending on this ‘back end’. In a film you might be able to edit the script in particular, while in a serial you could develop new or adjusted abilities as if the author ‘forgot’ how they originally worked, or changed focus as if a new writer with new priorities took over your medium.
objects.title: Coyote Gospel

addons.text:
Beyond dragging things from outside your medium, you can drag people and things from [your world] into your medium. Like everyone else they're bound by the rules and tone of your medium but isn’t it nice to have company?

Additionally, things you pull in have a far easier time remaining in your medium, though it still takes the same amount of effort to actually pull in.
addons.title: Isekai

addons.text: Knowing the shape of things, it’s far easier to pull things into your medium when you can justify their appearance. Rogue teleporters, author’s pets, in-character fandom and more. As long as it’s able to be justified, the strain on you to pull it into play is lessened greatly.
addons.title: Contrivance and Convenience

objects.text:
Beyond breaking the rules of your medium, you can shatter them, pulling things from beyond it inwards. 

While initially these take the form of summoning objects that could feasibly exist in your work, it steadily grows into pulling variant characters from your medium. For instance, in a comic you could pull any number of niche Cover Art Variants of people around you into your vicinity, while in a film you could pull in something from its remake or source material. 

As you grow this extends even to pulling other characters and items from unrelated places and even other mediums into your work.

Naturally, the more powerful something you try to pull in is the more effort and buildup it will take to pull them in and keep them around before they exit and return.
objects.title: Help! I'm Stuck Inside a CYOA!

objects.text:
You have access to the Celestial Forge.

You start out with 5 random free perks and one random 200 points perk.

Every day, you gain 50 points which can be spent to purchase perks. You can spend points to gain a random perk or purchase a specific perk for twice it's listed price.You can only gain one free perk per day for free, subsequent purchases cost 25 points.

 (Note: In the context of this power, points represents the Jumpchain 'Choice Points'. Points generated by any of the Celestial powers you've purchased are shared between each, and can be used in any of them interchangeably)
objects.title: Celestial Forge

objects.text:
You have access to the Celestial Grimoire.

You start out with 5 random free perks and one random 200 points perk.

Every day, you gain 50 points which can be spent to purchase perks. You can spend points to gain a random perk or purchase a specific perk for twice it's listed price.You can only gain one free perk per day for free, subsequent purchases cost 25 points.

 (Note: In the context of this power, points represents the Jumpchain 'Choice Points'. Points generated by any of the Celestial powers you've purchased are shared between each, and can be used in any of them interchangeably)
objects.title: Celestial Grimoire

objects.text:
You have access to the Celestial Menagerie.

You start out with 5 random free perks and one random 200 points perk.

Every day, you gain 50 points which can be spent to purchase perks. You can spend points to gain a random perk or purchase a specific perk for twice it's listed price.You can only gain one free perk per day for free, subsequent purchases cost 25 points.

 (Note: In the context of this power, points represents the Jumpchain 'Choice Points'. Points generated by any of the Celestial powers you've purchased are shared between each, and can be used in any of them interchangeably)
objects.title: Celestial Menagerie

objects.text:
You have access to the Celestial Dojo which allows you to gain knowledge and training from any setting and its characters. Over time this power will drift towards constellations which function as focus groups based on a single setting. When you pick a power you will be sent to a simulation where characters from that setting will teach you based on the perk and its cost. While in this simulation time is frozen and a single training session can last upwards of a decade based on the complexity of the perk chosen. You will be able to learn to use any power system with this power based on perks gained.

You start out with 5 random free perks and one random 200 points perk.

Every day, you gain 50 points which can be spent to purchase perks. You can spend points to gain a random perk or purchase a specific perk for twice its listed price.You can only gain one free perk per day for free, subsequent purchases cost 25 points.

(Note: In the context of this power, points represents the Jumpchain 'Choice Points'. Points generated by any of the Celestial powers you've purchased are shared between each, and can be used in any of them interchangeably)
objects.title: Celestial Dojo

addons.text:
The changes brought on by the atavistic reversion of your Path of the Celestial have spread deeper, doubling the amount of Celestial Points generated by this upgrade.
you now generate an additional 100 CP every cycle for each time you have picked this upgrade, instead of the previous 50.
addons.title: Celestial Chaos Points

objects.text: You generate 50 additional CP per 24h.
objects.title: Increased CP (Celestial Collections)

objects.text: Increases the frequency of charges. Each purchase halves the time between charges generated (every 12h, 6h, 3h).
objects.title: Increased Frequency (Celestial Collections)

objects.text:
You can mark one perk at a time, and by seriously training in a related topic, you can get a discount of up to 90% on it.
Keep in mind, the amount of effort required grows exponentially to the power of the perk. And some things are too esoteric to be trained.
objects.title: Blood and Sweat

objects.text:
You may designate up to eight individuals of your choice as Companions, granting 3 random 0-CP perks, a random 100-CP perk, and 60% of your total CP to spend as they see fit. They may choose to either draw from the same crafting-related perks and items that you do, or specialize into a different category, such as combat perks, magic perks, and so on.

"Property"-type items, such as buildings, landmasses and the Personal Reality, are shared by everyone, meaning that only one person in the Forge has to purchase them for everybody to benefit. If you have also purchased Blood and Sweat or Increased CP/Frequency, they will also benefit from those as well.
objects.title: Companionship

objects.text: Your Companions now benefit from the full strength of the Path of the Celestial you have chosen. This Grants them the full compliment of starting freebies, and increases their total CP and CP gain to match. In addition, this also grants them a form of resurrective immortality, allowing you to revive them after one year, provided you aren't dead as well.
objects.title: True Companions

objects.text:
You have reached beyond the fixed constellations of your original Celestial path and touched the origin point of all things: the primordial Chaos that birthed creation itself.

You may now freely choose whether to spend your points within your original Celestial path or spend your points on a random Celestial path. However, this random Celestial path changes every week and may define itself through any possible categorization.

Through this ever-shifting wheel, you may now access any roster that exists, could exist, or ever might exist — companions and allies, beasts both mundane and divine, magic and supernatural gifts, technology and artifacts, estates and domains, and even more conceptual rosters such as philosophies, destinies, or other metaphysical constants.

In addition, you also gain another initial 5 random perks and one random 200-point perk drawn from anywhere in this infinite well. Otherwise, the rate of point acquisition and relative worth of your points remain unchanged.

Furthermore, if you pull from a Celestial path that has special mechanics (such as the Dojo’s frozen-time training or the Menagerie’s pocket zoo for living beings), those functions remain, but are now widened by Chaos, such as the Dojo now being able to simulate anyone or anything as a teacher, or the Menagerie now being able spawn a comfortable living environment for any conceivable life-form, sapient or otherwise.
objects.title: Celestial Chaos

objects.text:
Your Celestial Path hasn't just touched Primordial Chaos, but eagerly embraced it.
This has resulted in an atavistic reversion to the Original Celestial Path, the Primordial Chaos Gacha.

The Primordial Chaos Gachas connection to the Origin of Creation doubles your Celestial Point Gain per cycle, increasing it from 200 to 400.

But this doesn't come for free, the very same connection to Primordial Chaos disables your ability to browse the Powers made available by your Paths of the Celestial.
You can no longer choose between buying random Power or buying a specific Power for twice the price.
The Primordial Chaos Gacha will instead, at the start of each cycle, roll five (5) random Powers to be available for this cycle, becoming unavailable at the start of the next cycle.
These Powers can come from any Roster described in "Celestial Chaos".

If a Power has requirements, and you have enough Celestial Points to buy that power AND all missing mandatory requirements then you may do so. 
This bulk-purchase may additionally also include any optional requirements for any addons on the rolled Power made available by the Primordial Chaos Gacha, but not optional requirements for any of the other powers you are buying in this bulk-purchase.
objects.title: Primordial Chaos Gacha

addons.text:
Your cores now attach to the grid and are able to interface with specialized modules. Emulation cores use 7 nodes in a circular formation, other cores use 3 nodes in a triangular formation).

Your grid starts with 271 nodes.
addons.title: Embedded Engineer

objects.text:
You have access to a hexagonal grid of empty 127 nodes. These nodes can be filled with specialized modules which can be connected together to form a power, each module provides one component of the power. The strength of a power is determined by its highest level module and incurs a penalty of 1/10th of a level for every module 3 or more levels below the maximum. 

The powers you create cannot create knowledge out of nowhere, any Thinker or Tinker power starts with an empty database unless you fill it with data you already have.

Every day, you generate 10 base level modules. Those modules can be specialized to be used in powers and there are hundreds of possible module specializations, some only available for higher level modules. Modules can be specialized to handle logic or data processing, however you will need to combine multiple of them to handle complex tasks. (Picking Electronics Engineering related Skills or Tinker powers makes you proficient with the language.)

You can upgrade a module by fusing it with one or more other modules. Level 2 needs 3 total levels, level 3 needs 6 total levels, level 4 needs 10, etc. (Costs up to level 9: 1, 3, 6, 10, 15, 21, 28, 36, 45). Each level is approximately 'worth' 3 SP - a power built out of level 4 modules will thus be equivalent to one valued at 12 SP in this document. Once fused they cannot be split and will only retain a single specialization of your choice. A module always uses one slot regardless of its level. You can store up to 200 spare modules of any level.

Over time, the number of nodes, the number and level of generated modules, and other aspects of your power will grow.
objects.title: Builder

objects.text:
You have access to 5 emulation cores, which can be programmed to emulate powers, one computational core, which can be used to run background tasks, one data core, which can be used to store data permanently, and one router core which allows cores to communicate.

The emulation cores you start with can support powers up to roughly 20 SP in strength. The computational core is capable of fast parallel computation on par with a supercomputer. While emulation cores can perform the same tasks as a computational core, at the same cost they are 20% less powerful than a computational core due to the dedicated power hardware. Data cores can store one exabyte of data and provide a build-in filesystem. The router core can handle up to 9 connections.

These emulation and computational can be programmed using a low level assembly language (machine code). Emulation cores have special hardware that allows them to manifest powers through special instructions.

You have access to a complete reference manual for this language. Each instruction has simple usage examples and the manual contains several complete example of basic powers to get you started. (Picking Software Engineering related Skills or Tinker powers makes you proficient with the language.)

Every day, you generate one core which can be used to improve your existing ones or add more. Once a core is improved or specialized, it cannot be turned back. Computational, data, and router cores each cost 5 cores to create. An emulator core costs 1 core at first level and needs 2 cores to upgrade it to level 2, and 3 cores for level 3, etc. Each level is approximately 'worth' 3 SP - a power emulated on a Level 4 core will thus be equivalent to one valued at 12 SP in this document.

You can specialize emulator cores to make them more able to support specific types of powers at the expense of making other types less powerful (+2 to chosen type, -3 to all others) for the cost of the current level.
objects.title: Engineer

objects.text:
Your Builder and Engineer powers become part of a greater whole. The amount of cores you produce every 24 hours is doubled and your storage capacity is no longer limited.

You gain the ability to create Clusters and start with three. Each Cluster possesses its own grid of 127 nodes that behave like Embedded Engineer. You gain a new type of Core, the Interchange, which allows nodes to communicate between Clusters, as well as a new type of Module, the Interface, which allows a Cluster to connect to someone else and grants them the ability to use its powers, you have a fine degree of control over the permission of each Interface. Every 120 hours (5 days) you can chose to generate a new Cluster, increase the number of nodes in an existing Cluster to the next central hexagonal number (169, 217, 271, 331, 397, ...), improve a Cluster to make all Modules and Cores within 10% more powerful (multiplicative), or improve your Modules and Core generation by 20% (additive). 

The power also provides you with an embedded VI assistant to which various tasks can be delegated. Network maintenance or reorganization, programming of cores, debugging assistance, etc. The VI has a personality of your choice but it is not truly sapient. This assistant can be provided with computational cores to increase its capabilities though it is not capable of evolving into an AGI unless you create that capability yourself.

As the Clusters are bound to your soul, it is possible for you to dedicate a Cluster to host your consciousness. The ability to project a body is optional but highly recommended as your clusters exist outside of reality and, without an anchor or navigation system, you will find it hard to make your way back to the proper place.
objects.title: Principal Engineer

objects.text: Increases the frequency of charges. Each purchase halves the time between charges generated (every 12h, 6h, 3h).
objects.title: Increased Frequency (Builder)

objects.text: You generate 5 additional charges per 24h.
objects.title: Increased Charges (Builder)

objects.text: Increases the frequency of charges. Each purchase halves the time between charges generated (every 12h, 6h, 3h).
objects.title: Increased Frequency (Engineer)

objects.text: You generate an additional charge per 24h.
objects.title: Increased Charges (Engineer)

objects.text: You can create Emission Modules/Cores that can grant Receivers (through various methods such as an artificial Corona Pollentia to bio authentication). These emission modules/Cores can store Virtual versions of modules you currently have and grant them to others. As you upgrade and improve your emitters they would show greater range, capabilities, and potential. You can design feedback from the virtual machines to gain user data.
objects.title: Virtual Machine

objects.text:
You can copy the powers of any person or entity you encounter. You can use as many powers you want at the same time as long as they don't conflict. You can toggle powers at will, any copied power is disabled by default. Similar powers can be merged together (and separated again) to work as a single entity. Copied powers grow and adapt with continued use.

For parahumans, you get a full copy of their power. For Endbringers, you gain a full copy of their power by touching their core, and a weakened copy equivalent in strength to a Parahuman by seeing them. For Entities, you gain a full copy of all the Entity's powers if you defeat it, by touching their corpse you gain weakened copies of its powers equivalent in strength to a Parahuman, you can gain a weakened copy of any ability it uses by seeing it in action. If your target has Trumped the Trump, you will need to beat your target in a fight to copy their power. A friendly spar or chess game counts for the purposes of this power.

You have a secondary power that allows you to sort through your collection of powers efficiently.
objects.title: Unlimited Ability Works

objects.text:
You can copy the appearance, powers, skills, memory, and personal equipment (any equipment they had on their person when you saw them) of any person you see (for a very broad definition of person). The target must be in your field of vision long enough for you to see them and you need to concentrate on copying them.

You can have an unlimited number of templates stored but can only use one at a time. While taking on a form, you remain yourself and are not mentally influenced by the transformation unless you allow it.

You can copy the powers of a target with Trumped the Trump in all cases.
objects.title: Shifter

objects.text: Some of the rarest and most valued Parahumans are those who can affect the powers of others. People who nullify powers and allow enemy Parahumans to be subdued as easily as an unpowered human being, those who boost other's powers give their allies a much needed edge over the opposition. Some even have the ability to copy or steal powers temporarily. You can do all this and more, and only your personal desires can stop such effects from being permanent. You can sense, nullify, enhance, modify, copy, and even steal the powers of others in your range (25km wide sphere). You can freely change a Shard power into a Shardless power but not the reverse (unless you have powers that allow you to create Shards). Transferring powers from one person to another is trivial, as is stacking multiple onto a single target. You can sense, remotely modify, and even take back all of the powers you have given regardless of the location. You gain 5 charges every day which let you create Shardless powers likes yours, whose nature are fully under your control. One charge can create a power worth 4 SP, but spending more charges increases its power, versatility, pushes or removes limits, and adds more functions. Charges can also be spent to boost any of your powers, including those bought here, and even modify Architect itself. You can split any power into its base components and revert any changes made at no cost but you do not recover any charges when doing so. You can permanently destroy a power to recover the charges put into its creation. While you can copy an unlimited number of powers, the strongest you can copy for free is the equivalent of 10 charges (40 SP); above that, you can either expend charges to copy the complete version of the power or copy a weakened version and the complete blueprint. The same applies to other actions like stealing or modification. (This mostly applies to Endbringers, Entities, and other powerful beings like them.) If your target has Trumped the Trump you need to expend a charge to copy the blueprint of their power at range, physical contact to copy the power itself, and the perk blocks all other functions unless consent is given.
objects.title: Architect

objects.text:
You have up to five of any powers you desire at any given time. You have a vast number of powers from which you may select and this roster will improve with time with new powers eventually forming in this set to suit your needs if one does not already exist.

You can shift between powers instantly and at will. If you cannot think of a power to achieve a goal, your powers will automatically offer you the best solution available, most if not all of which are absurdly powerful in their own right.

Powers granted by this ability may include equivalent to 60 SP powers or weaker depending on what is required for your purposes. Powers you use will improve, increasing the relative capability of powers you use frequently and more steadily increasing those you've used even once. The number of powers you may access at a time will also slowly increment. albeit at a sluggish pace comparatively. With extreme training, you may attain Paragon powers through this ability and grow existing ones into Paragon powers. However, the pool of Paragon powers accessible through this power is much more limited than your usual abilities.

This power comes with a significant cognitive enhancement which allows these powers to operate at their absolute maximum potential, as well as discern your intent before you could actually think of it. What this means is that, if you do not consciously direct them, your powers will find and switch to an optimal set of abilities often choosing powers optimal for your current situation or any future one you could encounter. Whenever you switch to a new power, you are given a perfect understanding of its limits, capabilities, applications in near-infinite scenarios, and combination potential with other powers among vast number within your reach.
objects.title: Polybius

objects.text:
You possess complete dynakinetic control over matter and energy alike, allowing you to manipulate all forms of energy and matter, be they kinetic, atomic, electromagnetic, nuclear, gravitational, chemical, or otherwise. There is no distinction between matter and energy in your control; both are equally subject to your authority and may be created, altered, converted, or erased at will.

You can create immense, mind-boggling telekinetic forces and exert those same forces as a form of super-strength, or endure them by dampening or redistributing them. You may cancel anomalous effects, including matter or energy created by other superpowers. You can feel the vibration and structure of everything around you, even across dimensional barriers, and tune your control accordingly.

You can generate mass, alter the chemical and physical properties of existing matter, restructure it at the atomic or subatomic level, or wipe it from existence entirely. Likewise, you may produce or extinguish any form of energy, from thermal output and radiation to the forces released in stellar collapse or the epicenter of black holes. Matter and energy may be freely converted between one another under your control.

As both matter and energy are beneath you, your consciousness is not dependent upon any specific physical form. Destruction of your body is a minor inconvenience; you may manifest a new vessel from matter and energy at will.

The scale and variety of feats possible with this power are immense. You may terraform worlds, power entire planets subconsciously, collapse stars, travel at superluminal speeds, ignite stellar reactions, generate gamma ray bursts, manipulate gravitational and nuclear forces, create life itself, create continents or palaces, fabricate exotic matter such as neutron star material, dark matter, strange matter, or other anomalous substances, and provide effectively endless resources if you so choose.

You possess inhuman knowledge of matter, energy, their properties, interactions, and transformations, allowing you to operate with full precision rather than approximation. The only limitation is the rate at which you create, destroy, or alter matter and energy at any given moment, though there is virtually no upper scalar limit to how much you may manipulate at once, and this rate improves with time.

With a thought, you may construct entire worlds from the quark upward, prune and reshape celestial structures, or erase them just as easily. Nothing composed of matter or energy is beyond your reach.
objects.title: Amun

objects.text:
You are a high-level spacetime and dimension manipulator. To you, the past is clay to be molded and shaped, and the future is no more able to resist your will; you are able to enter all possible pasts and futures.

With this power, you can warp spacetime in order to traverse to any location in an instant or alter your progression through time. You can affect not only yourself but objects and living organisms as well by changing their spatio-temporal properties, sending them careening into the future or past, or compressing them down to the volume of a penny. You can decrease or increase the distance between any two points without moving them, create fields in which time moves thousands of times slower or faster, and whisk objects between dimensions as you please.

You may, potentially, cut holes in dimensions so vast as to warp the laws of one in accordance with the other, or create your own empty pocket-dimensions for yourself, which you may occupy with objects you take from local realities and other futures. You can even interlink dimensions via your own dimensions to create a nexus of possible futures and faraway spaces if you are so inclined. Nearly any manipulation of space and time on a finite scale is within your grasp, and the maximum finite scale with which you may operate will increase as your powers develop.
objects.title: Mobius

objects.text:
This power emphasizes mutability over versatility. When you acquire this power, you can choose three Major Powers which cost up to 60 SP, excluding Paragon and Ascensions, and five Minor Powers which cost up to 30SP. You can choose powers from the Shard list only if you have Essence of Shard. Your power will integrate your chosen abilities and behave as if you had them. It will mutate them over time, both horizontally by adding new related abilities and vertically by increasing the strength of certain aspects. Powers with a lower initial SP cost have a faster growth until they catch up to your other powers.

While you can direct the general shape of those changes, your power will also respond and adapt to any challenge you face. When your powers are impotent, immediately useful mutations will be prioritized over long term utility. When you have time to let them grow, new optimizations and sub-powers based on where they detect challenges to be most likely, or which have stumped you before, will be added. Any useless or redundant part will be shed or fused into existing abilities. With time, your weaknesses will be reduced and your options broadened.

It is recommended you give your power time to perform routine maintenance and optimizations between heavy engagements to avoid a buildup of mutation debt. If this debt becomes too high, the quality and reliability of mutation decreases due to the stress placed on your power.
objects.title: Dynamist

objects.text:
Without any need for reason or justification, you will find that there is no one in this world or any other that you cannot overcome, for your raw ability scales seamlessly to match and then just barely overcome any opposition you face in all your endeavors. If you would kill a man where he stood, your strength and cunning would best him. If all humanity were to turn against you and deny you your right to do as you please, you could dance between the rain of all their weapons and prove your supremacy by force. If dragons would keep you from the treasures you seek, you could rip them from their hoards and cleave their skulls in twain, and if the very gods themselves would name you as their enemy, you could hurl them screaming from their thrones and force them into submission.
  
  Though naturally limitless in every respect that matters, your puissance is best expressed through paths of least resistance: you'll find that those capabilities you already possess are always infinitely quicker to expand in scope, scale, and potency than any entirely new abilities are to appear at hand. Likewise, you'll far more readily find raw ability and talent within yourself than you'll find cultivated skill. If you were to challenge a king of games to a game of chess for his throne, you would sooner find the sheer genius you needed to outwit him than discover the specialized professional understanding of a chess grandmaster, let alone the blessings of a god of the chessboard.
  
  As this ability gives you exactly what you need and no more at every turn, you will never lack for a challenge by this power alone: the limitless power you find within you when you exceed your grasp and your limits are tested will never sully or obsolete the simple pleasures of overcoming the mundane, and you will never be bored by the battles you might face. Similarly, though you may find the strength within you to wrest stars in twain, it is only an extension of your own will to power, and thus will never overflow beyond your ability to control; you will never face a "world of cardboard' except insofar as you actually want to rip it all to shreds in your hands. And on the flip side, you can also never be surprised (and thus overwhelmed) by any factors you would choose to struggle against if you knew of them, for your will cannot be so easily overcome. If unseen enemies were to conspire to assassinate you, you would find it in yourself to dodge the killing bullet or purge the lethal dose from your flesh.
  
  Finally, whatever form of pleasure, satisfaction, and happiness you take in your victories, you may freely share at your discretion with those you have overcome. Whether this is merely another form of violence you're capable of inflicting upon others, a guilty pleasure you needn't deny your unwilling subjects the opportunity to experience, or a final self-demonstrating proof of the ecstatic rightness of your rule, is up to you.
objects.title: Conquest

objects.text:
You gain access The Celestial Inventory. This power allows you to summon from your own Gate of Babylon analogue and wield with absolute mastery of ANY Item. Be it mundane, supernatural to the Metaphysical, you can summon any item in the known Omni verse.

You have a mental search bar that can be used to help locate a certain type of items from catalog. When looking at an item in your inventory or out in the real world, you will get a description of what it is, what it can do, how powerful it is, and what restrictions it has as well as side-effects. To summon a Item, you must know what the item's name is, so you can summon it out of the Inventory. Your Inventory will also "Refill" up a item, if you lose it. So do be careful you don't leave a Reality Gauntlet lying around. You can also place certain items as favorites to always be remembered. Please do note you can only have 5 Favorites at a time. Also some Items should not be used without great caution, respect and wariness as some may cause the Apocalypse, cause universal destruction or summon a Eldritch God like Cthulhu. Please wield responsibly.
objects.title: Celestial Inventory

objects.text: You gain access to the Summoner's Sanctuary, a power that allows you to summon anyone from any timeline or dimension. You have a mental search bar that can help you locate a specific individual from your catalog. When summoning someone, you will receive their complete profile, including their strengths, weaknesses, and abilities. You can summon people with specific skills and knowledge to help you, whether it is for combat or for obtaining information. All you summon will be loyal to you unless you specifically choose a disloyal one. Once you summon someone, they will remain until you dismiss them.
objects.title: Summoner's Sanctuary

rows.title: Weapon Objects of Power
rows.titleText: Note: All non-consumable Objects of Powers can be transferred to another person. When this happens, you do not lose any abilities the object unlocked or awakened (physical alterations, magic independent of the object, etc.) but any soul bonds transferred to the new owner.

objects.text:
You have been granted the bow once wielded by a Counter Guardian who sought to become a hero of peace. Born from modern science and reinforced through Magecraft, it was raised to the status of a Noble Phantasm through its constant and infamous use throughout history.

This bow is exceptionally durable, capable of firing Broken Phantasms with enough force to destroy buildings without suffering damage. In addition, it is highly receptive to Enhancement Magecraft and grants the wielder the equivalent of F Rank Clairvoyance.

After becoming a Noble Phantasm in its own right, the bow inherited traits of its owner’s greatest feat of magecraft, their Reality Marble. Any arrow fired through it is recorded within the weapon, allowing the wielder to Trace those arrows through drawing back its string and expending magical energy. However, as it is only a replica of that Reality Marble, it can only project arrows with a strength equal to or below a C rank Noble Phantasm, and currently only has basic mundane arrows recorded.
objects.title: A Counter Guardian's Bow

objects.text: I am the Bone of my Sword A grotesque imitation of a greatsword, though its appearance denies the term. A mystic code that is near the level of a crystallized legend, but missing an identity and myth to anchor it. At its core lies a pale, marrow-white bone serving as both the handle and spine of the weapon, around which are dozens of blades welded to it. These blades vary in size and shape, ranging from shattered daggers to ruined greatswords, all jutting in roughly the same direction to form an uneven, club-like mass of steel. The “bone” of the weapon contains a dimensional pocket. Within this internal world, one can find a barren mound composed entirely of rusted, broken swords. Each weapon embedded in the hill is an echo of a blade that once existed elsewhere, however having forgotten its identity. The Nameless Faker’s Blade draws upon this inner world as its resource, replenishing itself by manifesting fragments from the hill into the material plane. The hill itself is effectively infinite, but stagnant; it neither grows nor decays, existing only as a repository of forgotten arms. Whenever a portion of the blade’s structure is damaged or destroyed, replacement blades emerge from the bone almost instantly. The process follows a proportional pattern: minor chips are replaced by knife-sized growths, missing edges are filled in by small blades that overlap like scales, and total blade loss results in clusters of new weapons blooming outward in tangled growth. This regenerative effects ensure that the weapon cannot remain broken for more than a moment, rendering it nearly impossible to permanently destroy by physical means. When swung, the wielder can release the outer blades as high-velocity projectiles. These blades launch at speeds comparable to a modern sniper round. The act of launching does not diminish the weapon’s mass, as new fragments are drawn from the internal hill to replace the lost ones immediately after ejection. Each launched fragment retains a condensed core of magical energy. As long as it maintains supersonic speed, the energy remains stable. Upon deceleration below a critical threshold, the internal charge destabilizes and detonates. These detonations are proportional to the blade’s size: small shards produce controlled concussive bursts, while larger fragments can cause localized explosions capable of pulverizing stone or armor. If the wielder wishes, the protruding blades can retract or sink back toward the core, allowing the weapon to assume a more streamlined or compact form. However, this function has a strict limitation: the bone of the blade must remain completely covered by metal at all times. The weapon’s structure rejects exposure of the bone, and any attempt to retract the blades below that threshold results in immediate regrowth to seal the surface.
objects.title: A Nameless Faker’s Blade

objects.text:
You receive a World War I rifle, a unique piece crafted from wood and adorned with an intricate, hand-painted peacock feather pattern. Alongside it is a pouch of similar design, containing an unlimited supply of ammunition. The rifle is capable of firing up to 13 shots before requiring a reload.

This rifle has two unique abilities that make it truly lethal. The first, "Be Calm", activates when the target enters the rifle's scope and remains within it; they lose the ability to perceive any surrounding threats. While they can still feel pain, they remain completely calm, showing no reaction whatsoever.

The second ability, "Not as Sad", grants the user the power to teleport instantly to the location where the bullet strikes, as long as it hits a solid object or a person. For example, if the bullet hits a wall 100 meters away, the user will instantly teleport to that spot. The bullet's trajectory leaves behind a colorful smoke trail, shifting through shades of light blue, green, purple, and yellow, creating a visually striking mark.

However, this last ability is not without its risks. If the user faces a particularly fast or perceptive opponent, the smoke trail could give away their next move, offering the enemy a strategic advantage.

Note: Optionally, you can customize both the decoration and style of the rifle, as well as the colors of the smoke trail, however you like. Whether you prefer a simple, classic rifle or one with a more unique theme—such as a magical girl style—you’ll have the freedom to make it your own.
objects.title: Aim & Ignite

objects.text:
This anchor was once a common ship's anchor, but after the breach that claimed the pirate crew and their vessel, it became host to an eldritch law. Translucent ghost tentacles now wrap around its barnacle-encrusted form, glowing faintly even in darkness. The barnacles never die, clicking softly whether wet or dry.

When you grip the anchor with bare skin, the ghostly tentacles wrap around your hand and forearm, seeping into your flesh. Your skin pales and becomes slick, your fingers merging and reforming into muscular tentacles lined with suckers. You feel a slow, drowning sensation, but no pain. While transformed, you can lift the anchor as if it weighed nothing, though anyone else finds it immovable. You can swing the anchor as a weapon, extend your tentacle-arm up to fifteen feet to strike at range, or hook the anchor around obstacles. Dropping the anchor or setting it down deliberately causes the tentacles to recede from your flesh, returning your arm to normal.

When you swing the anchor as a weapon, it strikes with force equal to the highest deep-sea pressure. This means even a graze can collapses armor, shatters bone, and implodes wooden hulls as if they had sunken into the deepest trenches in the sea.
objects.title: Anchor of the Lost Seas

objects.text:
A natural enemy of all things draconic and serpentine.

While an ordinary spear by any other metric—with the exception of being extremely durable—its true power awakens when it is used for its one true purpose: killing dragons. Against those beasts, Ascalon slices through their scales or any defensive abilities they may possess easier than a knife goes through butter. When it strikes, it leaves incurable wounds, festering with rot and decay, slowly spreading across their whole body until the beast is dead. And if a dragon is impaled through the heart, its death is instant and inescapable, with no way to heal or resurrect a fallen creature.

Ascalon itself abhors dragons and dragonkin. If you are engaged in a battle with one, it will steer your hand to always strike true; even should your mind and senses be clouded by illusions, the tip of the spear will always point to a dragon's heart.

While Ascalon's primary targets are true dragons, anyone and anything related to them, like serpents, half-dragons, or even those simply revered as dragons in human flesh, are affected as well, albeit the less the more distant they are from true dragons.
objects.title: Ascalon

objects.text:
An ethereal-looking dagger commissioned by the renowned assassin that sought a painless method of killing. It is unnaturally sharp and durable, but its main attribute is that it inflicts absolutely no pain. When someone is injured by this weapon, they feel nothing, not even a shiver of discomfort. The only indication that something has happened is the sensation of liquid flowing over their skin - their own blood.

This blade can be used not only for assassinations, but also in combat if you are skilled enough. Attacking someone with it can cause them to miss an injury completely until their body betrays them at the most crucial moment. Cut ligaments, pierced arteries, or lacerated muscles can go unnoticed until it's too late.
objects.title: Assassin's Mercy

objects.text: It lives still, though torn apart. A five-foot fang, pearly white, torn from the jaw of a great beast that left only plague in its wake. Curved like a saber, thick as a thigh at the base and tapering to a wicked point. Its handle is the ever-rotting, malodorous gum tissue that once attached it to a ravenous canine, still twitching and pulsing. The surface smells equally as wrong, covered in hairline fractures that rinse tears of yellowish venom down its ivory length. Its outer layers are brittle enamel designed to break inside flesh, while the core beneath is solidified nervous tissue compressed into steel-hard channels that host the glands that secrete the toxin, running three-fourths of the length of the tooth. Fragments of enamel burrow inwards on impact, the venom that coats them serving to transfer a chemical through the blood which, when given time, begins to liquefy bone. This occurs instantly when the venom directly touches bone. All orifices leaking osseous tissue - the victim’s gums laid bare of teeth, their head softly caving in, leaving nothing but a pile of body. The fang can drink of this liquified substance, seeping it through its cracks to add the bone directly to its form and feeding itself. As it imbibes, the wielder can mentally reshape its mass, like clay under thought. Extending reach, adding serrated edges, forming hooks and barbs. Feed it enough and it shall grow to ten feet or more. Starve it and the blade shall shrink until only its core remains, though it always remembers its form when it is fed enough. Each wound the fang inflicts automatically enhances the wielder’s capabilities and grants further hunting instinct, but dulls their rationality. Rabid strength, wild movements, and increases in physical size and temperature are notable symptoms. By the tenth strike the wielder drops to all fours between strikes without thinking, moving faster than if they were sprinting on both feet, seven feet tall hunched over. Absorbed bone accelerates the wielder's own healing during this feral state. Fractures knit in seconds using stolen calcium. Torn muscle reweaves using absorbed marrow. The danger in wielding it lies in its corruption. The further you give yourself to bloodlust and the hunt, the more the gum tissue dissolves your skin, beginning to fuse with your hand. At any point before its complete fusion, you may still pull yourself back from the brink, but as its pulse grows stronger - as it begins to synchronize with yours - it becomes more and more difficult. At full skeletal integration, when it has replaced your hand fully, there is no more coming back.
objects.title: Black Dog

objects.text:
Forged for close-quarters clearance and point-blank saturation, the Hellstorm is a magnetically-accelerated, dual-barrel shotgun designed for overwhelming short-range firepower. Issued to boarding teams, urban assault specialists, and heavy infantry for structural breach and confined space engagements, it is engineered to neutralize multiple targets and degrade fortified positions with a single trigger pull.

The Hellstorm employs a side-by-side dual barrel configuration, each lined with a compact magnetic acceleration coil. The barrels are thick-walled and shrouded in a unified heat sink, bored with a progressive choke that tightens the projectile spread over distance. A synchronized firing mechanism allows for sequential or simultaneous discharge, governed by a robust magnetic regulator.

Firing modes are selectable between standard semi-automatic, which uses alternating barrels, and a dedicated "Volley" function. Volley mode fires both barrels in a staggered sequence, 0.04 seconds apart, to deliver a concentrated storm of projectiles while maintaining controllability. The weapon’s housing is fully sealed, with a corrosion-resistant finish and thermal shielding around the muzzle to protect the user from the intense discharge flash and heat bloom.

Capable of firing specialized Scatter-Cells, the Hellstorm launches a dense cloud of 24 tungsten flechettes per barrel, each projectile core-packed with a micro-thermite charge suspended in a viscous incendiary gel. Upon impact, the flechettes pierce light armor and the gel splatters and adheres tenaciously to surfaces. The thermite then ignites this gel, resulting in simultaneous penetration and persistent, adhesive combustion that is difficult to extinguish and burns with intense, prolonged heat. The combined effect shreds soft targets, cooks off ammunition, and turns light cover into a sustained burning hazard. 

You are issued 8 cylindrical ammunition canisters, each containing 10 Scatter-Cells. Canisters are heavy-duty, rotary-feed units that load horizontally into the receiver beneath the action. They are designed for rapid replacement; a spent canister is ejected via a lever-release, and a fresh one is locked in place, a process achievable in under three seconds with training. Canisters are environmentally sealed and reusable.

Alongside the weapon, you receive a portable ammunition storage box — a medium-yield field fabricator that recycles spent canisters and manufactures new Scatter-Cells from raw material. The unit accepts empty canisters and common feedstock such as scrap metal, conductive polymers, and oxidizer compounds. It deconstructs, purifies, and re-forges the components into new flechettes, synthesizes the incendiary gel, and assembles them into a fresh canister. Given sufficient feedstock, the box can fabricate one full 10-cell canister in approximately 22 minutes under stable planetary conditions.

The Hellstorm system weighs 11 kilograms when loaded with one canister. It is a physically demanding weapon, intended for users with skeletal reinforcement or light exo-frame assistance. The semi-automatic mode allows for sustained room-clearing, but the Volley function is a resource-intensive emergency tool. The dual magnetic coils generate intense thermal load; after 12 consecutive semi-automatic shots or any use of the Volley function, the weapon enforces an 8-second mandatory cooldown cycle, during which the coils power down and the heat sinks actively vent. Ignoring this cycle risks permanent deformation of the barrel chokes and a severe degradation of shot grouping.
objects.title: Breach Weapon System 08 “Hellstorm”

addons.title: Physics Breaks Down
addons.text:
While you’re able to draw an arrow from the centre of a black hole, the actual physics that apply to it are suggestions at best.

By using Trick Ammo with the bow, you can apply its various effects with the same intensity. While this results in dramatically more powerful effects than the pouch would usually supply, it’s most devastating when used while Sagittarius is shining.

If used when Sagittarius is in the sky it’s capable of using these effects to alter the outcome of the shot perfectly. If the aim was to guarantee a kill it would perform as usual, if the aim was to destroy a crowd then an explosive arrow would guarantee it likewise, or the destruction of a shuttle with an EMP arrow.

objects.text: As the new wielder of the Bow of Sagittarius, you never fail to hit your mark, as the bow grants you the ability to see the future of your targets' movements, predicting them without fail. The Arrows of Sagittarius’s bow are formed directly on the bow from mass drawn from the heart of the supermassive black hole Sagittarius A* that lies at the center of the galaxy. Each Arrow can be scaled in mass from almost nothing to the mass of entire stars, though the Bow will only allow you to “load” an Arrow with a mass—and weight—that you can actually draw. The mass at the center of a black hole is where all known understanding of physics begins to break down, and the arrows of Sagittarius’s Bow are no exception. The arrows are not affected by things such as gravity, friction, or drag and will “punch” through most things in an all-or-nothing effect. The greatest power of the Bow is its link to the constellation Sagittarius. While it typically only appears in the night skies of Earth for a portion of the year, with the Bow in your possession you can cause the constellation to shine in the sky throughout the year, in any world, dimension or realm. With Sagittarius shining overhead, you can cause the constellation itself to fire its Bow at a designated target. It will hit the target with absolute precision—and no collateral damage—using just enough of the mass from Sagittarius A* to guarantee a kill, at the cost of exhausting the Constellation for a full month. Finally, while the default form of the Bow is that of a golden Grecian bow, it can take the form of any bow and be turned into a small pin of Sagittarius for easy storage.
objects.title: Bow of Sagittarius

objects.text:
This cannon was once a standard naval gun, but after the breach from beyond reality, it became host to an eldritch law. It has no carriage or stand, only four leather straps bolted to its sides for carrying. The iron is pitted and crusted with salt, and the cannon constantly smells of the sea, while the air around it tastes of blood.

The cannon has the mass and density of a normal cannon, but it feels weightless when you carry it via the straps. To anyone else, it remains impossibly heavy. The cannon requires no gunpowder or loading. It speaks to your mind, telling you when it is ready to fire and how long until the next shot. You fire it by mental intent alone. It fires roughly once every ten seconds, and each shot uses extremely high pressure bursts of seawater to fire its shot, which results in it leaking seawater and mist from the muzzle.

When the cannon fires, it releases a cannonball octopus. This octopus is roughly fist-sized, spherical, and covered in a steel-hard exoskeleton. Upon impact, the exoskeleton cracks and the octopus latches onto the nearest creature you do not consider an ally. It grips with its tentacles, tears with its beak, and rips with raw tentacle strength. The octopus lives for at most one hour, acting on pure instinct to grab and destroy anything not allied to you. After death or one hour, it dissolves into coarse salt.
objects.title: Cannon of Baleful Waves

objects.text:
This is an improvised divine weapon tied to the battle of Lehi recorded in the Book of Judges, where Samson used the jawbone of a donkey to defeat a thousand Philistines. 

In its dormant state, it appears as an ancient, dry jawbone with no special strength beyond that of an ordinary blunt object. However, when the wielder is surrounded or outmatched, the jawbone awakens and shifts the balance of conflict in a very specific way. 

The greater the disadvantage, especially when that disadvantage is numerical, the faster the user’s strength, speed, and durability surge in response, as the weapon draws upon remnants of the strength of it’s former wielder.

When fully active, each swing carries the weight of every previous strike. It also disrupts groups of enemies, as every hit simultaneously affects the physical world and the concept of coordination itself, causing enemy formations to break apart or individuals to lose bodily control as coordinated cannot be maintained under its influence.

The longer the fighting continues, the more durable the jawbone becomes. If combat is sustained for an entire day and night, it reaches a state of absolute indestructibility against all forms of damage. 

However, this state is not permanent and cannot be maintained outside of battle. Once combat ends, the enhancement collapses, and the jawbone gradually loses its reinforced durability until it returns to its original fragile state.

If the jawbone is forced into this peak condition repeatedly without sufficient time for the effect to fully settle, its status as an improvised divine relic begins to show as it destabilizes. Small fractures of inconsistent power appear within it, and its enhancement becomes unreliable, potentially leading to permanent damage over time.
objects.title: Donkey’s Jawbone

addons.text:
When a Veltrass-MKIV bonds with a Drexil-AXVII, their neural matrices connect and activates PRXII. A system that most soldiers of the Xeno Alliance, properly known as the Federation of Worlds. A symbiosis of armour and weapon.

The most immediate change is in power supply. With PRXII active, the reservoirs of both systems merge into a single shared cycle. The Drexil draws directly from the Veltrass’s Deuteric Singularity Drive, allowing the cannon to sustain its 1 MJ heavy fire mode indefinitely so long as water is available to the armor. In parallel, the gravitic systems of both platforms merge into a single field-control matrix. The Drexil’s emitter stabilizers synchronize with the Veltrass’s anchoring nodes, creating a closed inertial loop between armor and weapon. The consequence is twofold: heavy overdrive discharges can be fired without subjecting the user to destabilizing recoil, and the same recoil impulses can be redirected into controlled bursts of momentum.

The Drexil’s basic non-invasive intent-trigger is subsumed into the armor’s hybrid interface and Virtual Intelligence. The armor’s VI grants the weapon a degree of auto-correction mid-discharge, allowing gravitic pulses to arc and bend slightly to track mobile or evasive targets. In critical states, the VI can assume partial control, firing the Drexil reflexively when the wearer is stunned, unconscious, or otherwise incapacitated.

Finally, PRXII unlocks a continuous beam firing mode unavailable to either system independently. The Drexil can channel reactor-fed energy through its emitter array in a stabilized lance configuration. This beam can shear through armored bulkheads, bore into vehicle hulls, or act as sustained suppressive fire against shielded positions. While technically sustainable, the lance drains hydration reserves at a far higher rate than pulsed fire.
addons.title: PRXII

objects.text:
The Drexil-AXVII was the standard-issue arm cannon of the Xeno Alliance infantry during the Outer Planetary Conflict, mass-produced for versatility in vacuum, atmosphere, and high-gravity environments. Its gravitic pulse emitter was designed as a direct counter to the Coalition’s shielded gunships and orbital drop troopers, giving front-line infantry the ability to cripple vehicles, breach fortifications, and neutralize armored exosuits with a single integrated weapon system.

The Drexil-AXVII is an arm-mounted system bonded directly to the forearm. Upon initial integration, it performs a biostructural scan and reshapes its internal matrix to match the user’s limb geometry. This allows the cannon to interface seamlessly with different physiologies: the brace reshapes to lock around bones, tendons, or equivalent structural tissue, and the surface plates expand or contract to align with musculature and armor. For a human, the system typically wraps from elbow to wrist, encasing the forearm in a 0.35 m, 12 kg housing in rifle mode. The neural link ties into local nerve clusters through non-invasive field coupling, meaning the user fires simply by intent rather than by trigger pull.

The external form is composed of an adaptive nano-ceramic exoskeleton with internal actuator veins. In rifle configuration, the barrel is a short gravitic emitter cylinder that extends 30 cm beyond the wrist, with retractable heat vent fins along the lateral edges. In heavy cannon configuration, the emitter unfolds a series of ferro-ceramic lens petals that extend forward into a 1.4 m long assembly, bracing against the upper arm and shoulder through morphing support struts. When not in use, the entire system contracts tightly around the forearm.

Operation is simple: the user points their arm at the target, and the cannon aligns its emitter automatically using integrated gyros and the neural interface. In rifle mode, each shot releases a 100–200 kJ gravitic pulse, strong enough to throw a 100 kg target 20–30 meters. In heavy mode, the extended barrel focuses pulses to 1 MJ per shot, imparting enough acceleration to shove a 1,000 kg vehicle at ~10 m/s, knocking it 50–60 meters off course depending on terrain. Overdrive allows a 5 MJ burst, which can impart ~20 m/s to a 5-ton object, enough to hurl it more than 100 meters. Transformation between modes takes 1.2 seconds. Recoil is minimal via inertial dampeners, allowing majority of the impulse to be directed outward with little reaction force on the user.

Heat management is the primary limiter. Each 1 MJ shot produces ~500 kJ of waste heat. Radiators extend automatically from the cannon’s flanks, with 0.8 m² surface area capable of rejecting up to 100 kW at 1,000 K. In rifle mode, this allows 10–20 rounds per minute for extended engagements without buildup. In heavy cannon mode, the system can manage short bursts of 1 MJ shots at up to 12 per minute, but progressive firing at that rate will cause overheating within a few minutes, forcing cooldown pauses. Overdrive bursts of 5 MJ generate ~2.5 MJ of waste heat, requiring about 25–30 seconds to fully dissipate before the cannon can safely fire again.

Water consumption is minimal during sustained use. A 1 MJ shot consumes ~0.05 g of deuterium, requiring the processing of ~3 g of water, given natural abundance. Thus, with a 1-liter onboard water reservoir, the Drexil-AXVII can sustain ~330 full-power 1 MJ shots or thousands of rifle-mode shots before requiring resupply. In survival conditions, it can draw ~30 mL/hour from the operator to sustain 100 kW continuous combat output, with hydration loss comparable to sweating in high heat but without long-term harm.
objects.title: Drexil-AXVII

objects.text:
Durandal is not a sword of finesse or dexterity. It is built to overpower an opponent through pure physical force alone, staggering the opponent through repeated earth-shattering strikes. 

Reflecting this, Durandal is indestructible, and wielding it will grant you the strength of your opponent tenfold, allowing you to overwhelm with sheer power. This only affects one opponent of your choosing at a time, and the boost to strength is lost once the chosen opponent is defeated. 

The boost only effects pure physical might, and does not make you superior to your opponent in any other way, and there is a real possibility that if you attempt to confront an opponent which significantly outclasses you, your arms will be obliterated from the sheer force of your own swings.
