objects.title: Durandal

objects.text: In your possession is an enchanted sword, with undecipherable writing along the blade. The blade is enchanted to never dull or rust and possesses a sharpness great enough to cut in half a man in full plate armor with only moderate difficulty. It is also extremely durable and resistant to snapping and other forms of damage, such as nicks and scratches. Despite the name, this can be any form of bladed weaponry such as polearms, but is by default a European longsword.
objects.title: Enchanted Sword

objects.text: In your possession is an enchanted warhammer, with undecipherable writing along the shaft and head. It is enchanted to cause intense shockwaves upon impact, allowing the hammer to bypass armor entirely. It is also extremely durable and resistant to snapping and other forms of damage, such as nicks and scratches. Despite the name, this can be any form of blunt weaponry, such as a mace or staff, but is by default a european warhammer.
objects.title: Enchanted Warhammer

objects.text: "Light is not a gift from a distant throne. It is the ember nursed in a calloused hand. It is the prayer whispered with a broken voice. It is the leg that stands when the body demands rest. I am the voice of the voiceless. Be cut down by this sword that refuses to yield. Shine, ⌜Excalibur Replica⌟!" This is a Mystic Code that blurs the line between a constructed magical tool and a genuine Noble Phantasm, taking the form of a simple European longsword with lion motifs, a blade made by no one special and with no significant history. It taps into the myth of King Arthur by appropriating the conceptual identity of Excalibur, but where the Last Phantasm is the crystallisation of humanity's collective hopes for a promised victory, this blade draws from the spirit of the invisible and faceless common people who believed in that legend to endure their own suffering. It exists more as a fictional ideal made real by collective belief than as a genuine relic of the Arthurian age. The blade forges a direct circuit between your willpower and your physical capability, allowing you to convert sheer determination into supernatural strength, allowing you to strike with far greater power and even ignore certain defences. So long as your spirit refuses to break, you can fight past wounds and exhaustion, moving what physically shouldn’t be able to move with strength you shouldn’t have. Any energy you have will surge and replenish just enough energy for one more push beyond your limits, again and again, one surge after the other, without end. In addition to that, the sword's faint radiance acts as a beacon that subtly pulls at the threads of fate, causing kindred spirits fighting their own desperate battles to cross paths with you at critical moments. The blade's effects scale inversely with your odds of victory, growing stronger the more certain your failure becomes. When you stand against overwhelming power with no reasonable hope of triumph, the invisible glow of the sword brightens perceptibly and draws attention from allies and enemies alike, marking you as a rallying point of defiance. This is not a power that guarantees victory but one that makes you profoundly difficult to defeat, transforming you into the lightning rod and standard-bearer of a doomed charge that might just change the course of something larger than yourself.
objects.title: Excalibur Replica: The Fantasy Sword of Human Spirit

objects.text:
The Fangtian Huaji was the personal weapon of Lu Bu during his final stand at Xiapi. In a moment of defiance against fate itself, Lu Bu unleashed a strike that tore open the storm-choked heavens, revealing a clear sky. In that instant the weapon tasted the primordial essence of the sky. Much like the Holy Lance that gained divinity through contact with the divine, Fangtian Huaji was forever changed by this baptism, ascending to wield a fragment of authority over the sky. You now carry this legendary spear, and the sky itself acknowledges your claim.

The halberd is perpetually surrounded by a gentle breeze. This wind both cools you and deflects incoming projectiles. Arrows, throwing knives, small stones, and similarly weighted objects are curved away, as if caught in an invisible current. Heavier projectiles however remain effective.

Whenever you commit to any attack, whether a slash, thrust, sweep, or chop, the authority of the sky manifests in three simultaneous expressions of power. First, a blade of hypercompressed air launches from the weapon along the exact path of your attack, extending its reach and allowing you to strike targets at mid-range with the same force as a melee blow. Second, the winds coalesce into four phantom replicas of the spearhead that flash into existence around the point of impact, attacking your target from four different angles simultaneously to create wounds that are nearly impossible to block cleanly. Third, the winds themselves carry the halberd forward into each successive movement, building momentum with every consecutive strike you deliver without a break exceeding five seconds. This accelerating cadence makes each subsequent attack faster than the last, so long as the break between each attack is less than five seconds.
objects.title: Fangtian Huaji: Piercer of the Heavens

objects.text:
A high-tech, but low-maintenance, response to trench warfare. The Field Operations Spade 03 “Breaker” is a next-generation entrenching tool that merges battlefield utility with tactical lethality in a compact, rugged form. At first glance, it resembles a standard combat shovel—but beneath its simple exterior lies a suite of advanced features designed for multi-role functionality in the harshest conditions.

Forged from a self-sharpening alloy of shape memory materials and nano-ceramics, the blade stays sharp through continuous use. Integrated into the edge is a vibrational system that emits low-frequency pulses, allowing the Breaker to cut through compacted soil, frozen ground, or tangled roots with ease. In melee, the vibrating edge destabilizes enemies or disrupts armor on impact—powered by kinetic energy harvested during use.

The shovel’s modular head pivots between three configurations: a broad spade for trenching, a sharpened hoe for shaping terrain, and a spear-like form for close-quarters combat. A magnetically-assisted locking mechanism allows smooth, glove-friendly transitions between modes, even in mud or cold. Built-in motion sensors enable passive perimeter defense—when planted, the Breaker enters a silent alert mode, detecting nearby movement and pinging a wristband or HUD via low-frequency haptics.

Its signature feature is the gravity-inertia plate embedded in the shovel’s flat. This experimental field allows real-time control over the tool’s effective mass. With a dial at the grip’s base, the Breaker can shift from nearly weightless for rapid digging to extremely heavy for compacting slams or high-impact strikes. The transition is instant, powered by a closed-loop, EMP-resistant system that operates with no external power source.
objects.title: Field Operations Spade 03 “Breaker”

objects.text:
This humble fishing rod once belonged to the Fisher King, who in his long years of wounded vigil sat by the waters of his castle and cast his line into the depths. Though the rod itself was crafted with no enchantment, it drank deeply of its master’s strange condition. From the perpetual outpouring of his wound the rod absorbed a fragment of the Fisher King’s inheritance.

The rod’s line is unbreakable, woven of a substance that seems to be both thread and light, thin enough to vanish from sight yet strong enough to bind giants or drag creatures from the deepest waters. It’s infinite in length, although one rarely has the strength needed to cast it far enough for this to be apparent. Its hook is invisible as well, a phantom lure that needs no bait; prey are drawn to it, ensnared before they realize they have been caught. The rod itself is unusually resilient, supple and elastic, bending without snapping, and its balance feels attuned to the hand that wields it.

In fishing, the rod is peerless. You will find yourself with mastery in fishing techniques, including casting the line. Anything caught upon its unseen hook can be reeled in, no matter its size or strength, for the rod grant its wielder the strength needed to drag it in. Fish, or even giant beasts, are drawn inexorably toward the hand that holds it.

If you wish, you can use it in battle. By doing so you will find your instincts sharpened, guided by the echo of the Fisher King’s own weary cunning. The line can be cast to entangle limbs, to coil around or rip a throat. It could also be used to snare the legs of an enemy and bring them crashing down. The invisible hook might catch on armor, clothing, or gear, tugging and pulling to unbalance, distract, or wound. Weapons can be wrenched from an opponent’s grasp, or momentum broken with a sudden pull of the unseen tether.
objects.title: Fisher King’s Fishing Rod

objects.text:
Forged in the years of the Heian Era, Harvest Season is a Kusarigama that was once wielded by a reclusive Onmyōji. This sacred tool was designed specifically for exorcism and spiritual warfare.

The sickle’s blade is curved in the classic style, yet its edge can never be dulled, chipped, or rusted. Laced along its inner edge are dozens of microscopic spiritual barbs, invisible to the human eye, yet excruciating to any spiritual being that comes into contact with them. These hooks will not cut any physical foe, only spiritual ones. To a mortal, the weapon is merely cold metal. To a spirit, it is agony.

The chain that connects the sickle to its iron counterweight is equally unorthodox. Forged with a blend of sacred metals and ritually blessed under the five elemental seals, the chain repels spiritual presence. Both the dead and the living who carry strong spiritual resonance cannot remain untouched. When wrapped around a living target, the blessed chain severs the connection between body and soul, not permanently, but violently enough to cast the victim into a temporary state of spiritual dislocation. The soul is ejected just slightly, enough to daze, disarm, or even trap.

For spirits, when ensnared, they are pulled taut, as though being stretched. The physical chain keeps them from escaping but simultaneously expels them. If they are weak enough this can tear them apart.
objects.title: Harvest Season

objects.text:
Forged for frontline suppression and perimeter denial, the Goliath is a fully independent, hip-mounted rotary weapon system developed for heavy infantry and mechanized support units. Issued to cybernetically reinforced soldiers and exo-frame operators, it is designed to dominate wide-area engagements through volume, pressure, and explosive saturation.

Goliath features a six-barrel, magnetically accelerated rotary cannon. Each barrel is precision-forged and encased in a vibration-dampening shroud, rotating on a stabilized axis with a synced internal gyro. The weapon is fired exclusively from the hip using a braced rig and reinforced harness, with the core power and feed units mounted along the back and waist.

Capable of reaching 3,600 rounds per minute, the Goliath fires heavy caseless slugs embedded with incendiary and micro-explosive payloads. On impact, each round delivers a focused detonation capable of penetrating light armor, igniting cover, or dispersing lethal shrapnel within enclosed spaces. Kinetic trauma alone can disable unarmored targets, while the added thermal and explosive effects increase lethality in all conditions. A built-in magnetic shunt system disperses excess heat and stabilizes the feed coils during prolonged fire. 

You are issued 10 reinforced ammunition bricks, each containing 500 explosive incendiary slugs. Bricks are designed for seamless integration into a rotating feed drum and can be swapped in under two seconds by trained users. Alongside the weapon, you also receive a portable ammunition storage box — a compact field fabricator that recycles spent bricks and constructs new ones from raw material. Given enough feedstock (scrap metal, refined powder, polymers), the box can fabricate a fresh brick in approximately 90 minutes under stable environmental conditions.

The Goliath system — including its barrels, feed mechanism, and stabilization rig — weighs approximately 42 kilograms when loaded, not including spare ammo. It is designed to be wielded only by physically enhanced users or those in powered exosuits. Each ammo brick lasts just over 8 seconds at full spin, and after 60 continuous seconds of fire, the weapon automatically triggers a 5-second cooldown to vent heat and protect the coil housings.
objects.title: Heavy Weapon System 04 “Goliath”

objects.text:
You receive a cursed blade, taking the form of a standard kitchen knife. This knife is imbued with the power to turn its wielder into a “Hero” as the local world defines it. 

To trigger this hero creation effect, you must complete the difficult task of killing one million sentient living beings. This does not need to be done with the knife; only that you, the wielder of the cursed artifact, are the one ultimately responsible for their deaths.

In a world like Worm, the effect of this blade would manifest as a large-scale master effect, influencing the beliefs of others into thinking of you as a popular and well-beloved hero. Whereas in a world like Tensura, it would awaken you as a Chosen Hero, even if you lack a Hero’s Egg, the Blessing of the Fairy Queen, or even the qualifications to receive either.

You must repeat this process if you want to become a hero in multiple worlds.

Regardless, all you need to do is kill a few people. That's a small price to pay to become a hero, no?.
objects.title: Hero Creation Kit

objects.text: Have a dirty kitchen? Need an easier way? Well say goodbye to daily stains and dirty surfaces with your new Kitchen Gun™! Why waste hours scrubbing when you can let high-velocity cleaning technology do the work for you? Simply point, fire, and watch years of dirt, grime, rust, stains, mold, corrosion, graffiti, and other unwanted contaminants disappear instantly! Kitchen Gun™ comes standard in the form of a Beretta M9, but with our patented Adaptive Ergonomic Profile™, it can permanently assume the shape of any compatible firearm. Simply leave the two alone together for several minutes up to an hour. During this process, please avoid looking directly at Kitchen Gun™ and refrain from entering it's direct line of sight under any circumstances. regardless of any unfamiliar sounds, screams, cries for help or additional gunshots you may hear. You will instinctively know when the process is complete, and the Kitchen Gun™ will have adopted its new appearance. Kitchen Gun™ will appear by itself. Kitchen Gun™ assumes no liability for madness, cognitive instability, persistent auditory or visual phenomena, or other adverse effects resulting from observation of the patented Adaptive Ergonomic Profile™ process. Customers who directly or indirectly witness the procedure are advised to immediately repeat the approved reassurance phrase, "It was just a gun," until instructed to discontinue by an authorized representative. Failure to comply may void all warranties and negatively impact your eligibility for future Kitchen Gun™ products.
objects.title: Kitchen Gun™

objects.text:
This blade was wielded by the Sword Demon during the war against the Magic King. He eventually killed the Magic King with it at cost of his own life, all to get revenge for his younger sister’s murder. The sword itself was one of their nine treasures of the Demonic Sect.

Inside the blade's steel, an angel is bound and crucified in eternal agony, its divine blood dripping without end through every fiber of the weapon, and this ceaseless martyrdom is what powers the sword's gifts. When you grip the hilt, that corrupted blessing floods your body with a torrent of stolen life, knitting your wounds shut at a speed that makes a mockery of death and burning away any poison or illness that dares intrude upon what the tortured angel's grace has claimed as sacred. The same holy origin grants the blade its defining defiance: it cuts magic and nullifies spells on contact because the angel's very nature rejects all miracles that do not flow from its own absent god. 

The greater your sword skills, the greater the sword, its edge sharpening and its balance perfecting itself to reflect your mastery, though even in the hands of a novice it will never be less than a masterwork blade any smith would weep to behold. Every technique you use through this sword is elevated by the angel's divine comprehension of form and motion, becoming closer to its perfected “idealised” form. 

Yet the angel's most profound gift is its ability to create true miracles. At will, you can invoke a miracle and turn the impossible into an absolute certainty, but each invocation permanently harms the crucified being within. Using the third miracle will result in the angel's mind shattering, removing your ability to perform miracles while leaving the sword's other powers intact.
objects.title: Ichorus

addons.text:
Your ability to reach beyond space and time, combined with your power of excellence as a Solar Exalted, has imbued the arrow of Sunfeller with the ability to unfailingly hit its target. Regardless of the target's location or the protection it may have, your arrow will absolutely find its mark.

Whether your opponent attempts to hide in another dimension, travel through time, seal themselves in an indestructible room, or employ an Exalted charm for perfect defense, etc., the arrow will unerringly hit its mark under any circumstance.

As long as you can perceive your opponent and release the arrow, there is no escape or defense against its impact.
addons.title: The Perfect Shot

addons.text:
The various solar-related powers that you wield have supercharged the power of the bow, not only granting you access to its full potential from the outset but also exponentially boosting its power.

This mastery also enables you to manipulate how the bow utilizes solar energy, granting you the ability to combine multiple firing modes into one or even create an entirely new mode.

The might of its arrow can now incinerate its target on an abstract and conceptual level, essentially burning your target from existence upon impact.
addons.title: Overwhelming Firepower

addons.text:
Your might as a celestial Incarna of the sun has resonated with the god bow, transforming it into one of your divine symbols, thus making it a weapon on par with the god spear of all searing noon.

The bow now deals infinite damage to all targets it hits, annihilating even the most indestructible of foes with absolute ease. Resisting or being immune to light, heat, fire, and the like would do nothing before the boundless might of your bow.
addons.title: Wrath Of The Most High

objects.text:
The Legendary Bow of the Immortal Hou Yi, renowned for its role in downing nine golden sun crows from the sky, leaving one to illuminate the heavens and earth, stands as a godly weapon capable of slaying immortals and gods alike.

Following this remarkable feat, the bow underwent further enhancement through the power of the nine fallen golden sun crows. Each crow infused it with the power of a mystical sun. When drawn, the bow requires no physical arrows; instead, it conjures an arrow of Sunfire. Moreover, the bow offers several firing modes for the wielder:

Multi-shot: Upon drawing, multiple arrows resembling flaming feathers materialize around the user, allowing them to rain down hundreds, if not thousands, of arrows simultaneously, dealing fiery destruction to adversaries.

Tracking shot: The arrow takes on the form of a three-legged golden sun crow mid-flight, relentlessly pursuing its target to ensure a precise strike.

Charge shot: The arrow's power intensifies as the bow is drawn and held. Upon release, its force can penetrate any defense, cleanly piercing the target or causing a devastating explosion that turns surrounding matter into molten slag.

As an immortal weapon, those lacking divine strength will struggle to unleash its full potential. A novice wielder might only manage to unleash enough power to demolish a city block with a single shot. However, with practice, one can unlock more of its true capabilities.

Individuals possessing powers related to the sun or solar energy will find it easier to harness the bow's full potential. Even after unlocking its full power, the bow remains an extraordinary conduit for channeling solar abilities, akin to Mjolnir's relationship with Thor.
objects.title: Immortal Slaying Godbow Sun Feller

objects.text:
One of the four legendary swords of ancient myth, the Juexian Jian was forged by the Heavens as the ultimate check against those who would transcend their ordained limits. Juexian Jian presides over absence, holding the power to render power itself unto nothing.

When you wield the Juexian Jian, you carry an aura of nullification that radiates from the blade in all directions. Any being near you will find their supernatural abilities suppressed, with you alone remain untouched by this effect. The strength of this suppression depends entirely on how powerful your foe is compared to you. Against those weaker than yourself, their powers are simply gone, as if they never had them at all. Against those somewhat stronger, perhaps up to twice your own measure, they will feel their abilities dampened significantly, only regaining at best 30-40% of their power. Should you face a being of truly immense power, one more than twice your strength, they will at best suffer a minimum ten percent suppression of their capabilities, as Juexian Jian respects no being so much that it grants them immunity except its wielder. Beyond this passive field, you may actively use the blade to cut through expressions of power themselves, from slicing a fireball in half to disperse it instantly, severing a magical enchantment from its victim to render it null, or cutting a beam of pure energy so that it splits harmlessly around you. The sword does nothing to ordinary humans or beings no stronger than mortal men.
objects.title: Juexian Jian: The Power-Severing Sword

objects.text:
One of the four legendary swords of ancient myth, the Juxian Jian was forged not to kill, but to imprison. This sword was crafted by the first jailers of the celestial realm to contain what could not be destroyed. Entire gods had once been sealed within this blade, where they drift still in endless sensory deprivation, their divine screams echoing in a void that has no ears to hear them. While empty now, you can fill it with ease.

When you cut a being no stronger than an average man with the Juxian Jian, even a scratch smaller than a paper cut, they are pulled into the blade itself. This visually manifests much like spaghettification of a Black Hole. Stronger beings can resist, needing deeper cuts. You cannot seal anyone more than one magnitude of power above your own unless you land a killing blow first, meaning you must defeat them through skill before the sword can do its work. Once sealed, they exist in perfect isolation: no sight, no sound, no touch, no passage of time, only the awareness of their own being suspended in a space that is both infinite and infinitesimal. You may unseal them at any time, releasing them back into the world, though those who return are never quite right, their minds having brushed against infinity and found it hollow.
objects.title: Juxian Jian: The Divinity-Trapping Sword

objects.text:
A cursed weapon passed through the hands of countless killers, most famously tied to the Victorian murderer known as Jack the Ripper. Its origins are far older, possibly ancient, with rumors claiming it was once held by Cain himself. The knife takes on the appearance of whatever a “knife” is considered in the current era or cultural context, whether a crude obsidian shard, a ritual dagger, or a Victorian-era scalpel.

The knife is not sharp in the traditional sense. Its edge is physically blunt, but the accumulated malice of its countless victims has become so concentrated and inhuman that it has manifested as a demonic aura, forming an infernal cutting force. This allows the weapon to slice through human tissue and bone effortlessly. It can also bypass physical immunity, dealing minor wounds to entities normally unaffected by conventional attacks, as the damage comes from metaphysical hatred rather than material sharpness.

Anyone holding the knife gains immediate access to the precision and reflexes of all its previous wielders. This grants unnatural control over hand movement, enabling instinctive targeting of anatomical weak points and execution of complex cutting techniques. The effect is exclusive to the knife and ends once released, but prolonged use can leave lasting muscle memory, effectively teaching the wielder how to handle blades with expert skill.

When the knife is aimed at any target, it triggers an overwhelming sense of existential fear. This reaction bypasses emotional immunity and affects even beings without standard emotional or mental faculties. Fear, in this context, is not psychological but a raw, primal awareness, the knowledge that existence is finite. That they currently exist, and will one day cease to exist. The knife forces this recognition to the surface, making even the unfeeling remember they can end.
objects.title: Knife of Jack the Ripper

objects.text: Also known as the Ame-no-Murakumo-no-Tsurugi, this sword was pulled from the corpse of the dreaded Yamata-no-Orochi by Susanoo-no-mikoto, before eventually being gifted to Amaterasu-Ōmikami, who in turn bestowed it upon her grandson, Ninigi-no-mikoto. As a sword of such providence, the Kusanagi has developed many powers from those who have owned it. From its mythic origin in the Yamata-no-Orochi’s tail, the Kusanagi can split its blade into eight metallic heads that imitate the serpent’s own. Each head can be independently controlled by the wielder, who gains enough multi-tasking ability to manage them without issue. The Kusanagi can also coat its blade with what was ultimately the serpent’s downfall—a potent sake that can induce anyone affected by it into a drunken stupor. The sword can also learn to replicate other substances, such as poison, through contact. Next, as a gift from the god of storms, to the goddess of the sun the blade has the ability to call upon their domains of wind and flame. The sword can call forth the wind as cutting blades, or powerful blades, while also surrounding itself in solar flames—that do no harm to the sword itself or its wielder. If this sword were to be wielded by a god of the sun or storm—or their descendant—the wielder would find themselves able to manipulate the weather to create storms, or disperse them. As a Sacred Treasure of Japan, the Kusanagi-no-Tsurugi embodies the virtue of Valor. Those bearing the sword will find themselves empowered with great courage, bravery, and strength of mind to face any adversity. With this the sword also grants immunity against the powers and tricks of Yōkai.
objects.title: Kusanagi no Tsurugi

addons.text:
Using Spear as a focus, you have developed a unique two-stage spell, invoking the punishment of Longinus by God.

The first stage allows you to summon spectral lions composed of Telesma, all under your control and as strong and durable as the spear itself.

The second is a constantly active protection, keeping you immortal and immune to illnesses or ravages of time, as well as allowing you to—once per day, at dawn—heal from any and all injuries you may have sustained, even resurrecting should you perish.

Lastly, the lance also becomes your true spiritual item. Bonded to your very soul, it will strive to protect you even on its own, adjusting the rank of incoming attacks, returning to your hand when needed, and even attacking those who may try to wield it without permission.
addons.title: Pilate Cycle

addons.text: It goes Me, then Dirt, then You. You are no longer limited to rewriting the relative hierarchy of two targets at a time. While you can pick as many targets at once as you wish, they must form a fully ordered set, meaning that between each possible pair, there should be a clear higher- and lower-ranked one.
addons.title: Pecking Order

objects.text:
The spear that pierced the side of Jesus as he hung on the cross and the most potent holy relic is now in your possession.

That humans would be able to harm the Son of God is an utterly impossible idea, and thus, for it to be accomplished, the "order of precedence" must have been changed. The spear is the crystallisation of this idea, being able to change the relative hierarchy of any two targets, be those individual people, armies, gods or concepts.

The target with a lower order of precedence will find itself entirely incapable of opposing the higher-ranked one. Whatever powers, abilities, equipment, plans, and strategies it may bring to the table will all be useless.

In turn, the target with a higher order of precedence will find its every attack striking true, without regard for any barriers or attempts at evasion, and only its own intent may stop those strikes from being fatal, as well as any action taken against the lower-ranked one will be devastatingly effective. For example, an army with a higher rank is guaranteed victory in battle against its lower-ranked opponent.

The spear itself constantly maintains its own order of precedence higher than any other existence, being completely indestructible and—when it is used as a weapon—entirely impossible to defend against.

The only limitation is that the hierarchy may be changed only between one pair of targets at a time, although you can switch the targets at will.
objects.title: Lance of Longinus

objects.text:
One of the four legendary swords of ancient myth, the Luxian Jian was forged in the dying thoughts of a primordial sage and quenched in the tears of a weeping cosmos. It is said this blade does not cut flesh alone, but severs the very fabric of reason from a soul, allowing madness to flood in where wisdom once dwelt. Even the most enlightened masters who have achieved perfect clarity of mind find their thoughts corrupted by its touch, their centuries of meditation undone in a single moment of violence.

When you cut a foe with the Luxian Jian, you do more than wound their body. The blade's curse flows into them like poison into a well, its intensity matching the severity of the harm you inflict. A shallow cut across the arm might bring weeks of troubled sleep, vivid nightmares that blur into waking life, a creeping paranoia that makes a man question his oldest friends. Run them through the gut, and they will begin to see things that are not there, hear whispers from empty rooms, forget the faces of their own children. But should you take their head from their shoulders, should you land a blow that would kill any mortal thing, the madness does not simply end with their last breath. Their soul itself becomes infected, and when they are reborn into their next life, the scars remain. They may be born with an inexplicable terror of the dark, or hear voices no one else can hear, or suffer rages that reduce them to something less than human. Time can soften these marks across countless reincarnations, but they never fully vanish, a permanent stain upon the spirit that bears witness to the blade that once cut them down.
objects.title: Luxian Jian: The Sage-Slaying Sword

objects.text:
The Midas Dusters are stunning pieces of pure gold, shaped into simple, elegant knuckle guards that look more like expensive, high-fashion jewelry than a fighting tool. They are detailed with subtle patterns, but their key feature is a strange magic that makes them forgettable. When not being used, eyes tend to slip right over the weapon, making the Midas easy to hide and ignore, even when worn openly.

The Midas greatly boosts the power of any blow while acting as a shock absorber. A quick, light jab thrown by the wearer strikes with the heavy, punishing force of a fully committed haymaker from a strong fighter. A punch that is already thrown with great effort and speed becomes even stronger. Additionally, the Midas also completely stops the painful kickback and jarring shock, allowing the wearer to punch with maximum power over and over without any fear of self-injury.

The moment the wearer prepares to strike, the gold lights up with an unnaturally brilliant, hypnotic shimmer. This sudden, fierce glow instantly pulls the eyes of anyone looking at it, causing them to fall victim to a sudden, intense tunnel vision. The opponent can only fixate on the incoming golden fist, making them forget to look at the wearer’s whole body; they stop tracking feints, footwork, or where the next hit might come from.
objects.title: Midas Dusters

objects.text:
The Modular Baton System 07 “BLACKOUT” was developed by the Coalition of Mankind as a standard-issue tool for police forces across the Core Worlds. The BLACKOUT replaced older impact-only batons with a compact, scalable system capable of delivering non-lethal force to both organic and electronic targets.

The BLACKOUT consists of a single baton in tonfa configuration, 36 inches long in its combined form. It can split at the midpoint into two independent 18-inch short tonfas. Each half retains its own perpendicular handle and is fully functional when separated. The locking joint uses an internal spring-loaded steel pin and magnetic stabilizers. The weapon’s exterior is composed of 6061-T6 aluminum coated with a non-conductive polymer-ceramic composite. The grip areas are wrapped in thermoplastic rubber with internal insulation to protect the user during electrical discharge.

Both halves are equipped with built-in tasers and EMP emitters. These systems activate automatically upon a successful physical strike against a target. A combined sensor package detects impact pressure exceeding 40 newtons and triggers the dual discharge systems. The taser outputs approximately 50,000 volts at low amperage, sufficient to incapacitate an unarmored or lightly armored biological target weighing up to 250 kilograms. The BLACKOUT requires no conscious input once in hand as striking an enemy immediately delivers the electrical payload through the contact points at the baton’s tip and side guard. 

The EMP component activates in tandem with the taser if it detects electronics on contact. Its effective range is limited to direct touch, with a 0.3-meter spread zone to ensure disruption of electronics without affecting nearby allies or equipment. A successful strike against low-shielded electronics, such as cybernetic limbs, drones, or standard exosuits, results in temporary disruption lasting between 2 and 5 seconds. The EMP and taser systems can be disabled via a switch to prevent accidental activation during storage or transport. 

The BLACKOUT features a passive energy recovery system. Both batons are equipped with ambient induction panels built into their frames, allowing them to slowly recharge using background electromagnetic radiation, thermal gradients, or kinetic energy from movement. Under normal urban conditions, such as operating near power grids, transport networks, or dense civilian electronics, the BLACKOUT regains approximately 10–15% total battery capacity per hour.
objects.title: Modular Baton System 07 “BLACKOUT”

objects.text: The Ruyi Jingu Bang is no mere weapon—it is a relic of divine providence, a pillar of the world once held within the treasury of Ao Guang, the Dragon King of the East Sea. During times immemorial, it was wielded by Yu the Great, used to measure the ocean's depths and stabilize the turbulent seas, a celestial instrument that helped to uphold the harmony between Heaven and Earth. Yet for all its divine origin, it remained dormant and unmoving, left to languish and be forgotten in the Dragon King's hoard—until the day it was claimed by Sun Wukong, the Great Sage Equal to Heaven. In his hands, it became something greater—no longer was it a passive artifact but a force of defiance and destruction. It was the cudgel used to shatter armies, defy the will of Heaven, and carve an immortal legend across the cosmos. To all others, its crushing weight and suffocating presence rendered it immovable, an untouchable monolith beyond mortal reach. But now, it has chosen you. It has deemed you worthy, binding its fate to yours—entrusting you with the legacy of its first bearer. Far more than a mere weapon, the Ruyi Jingu Bang is a tool of limitless versatility—answering to your will with absolute obedience. With but a thought, it may swell into a mountain-crushing colossus or shrink into an innocuous needle, as it once did when Sun Wukong stored it behind his ear. A simple staff one moment, a celestial pillar the next, it may stretch beyond the heavens, lancing through the stars, or collapse into the palm of your hand, barely more than a sliver of iron. It may become a bridge between realms, a spear to skewer the sky, or a tempest of iron descending upon your foes. It heeds no limits but those of your own resolve, growing stronger as your will deepens. And should you desire, it may birth countless replicas of itself—echoes of the original, each wielding but a fraction of its unparalleled might and durability. Yet even these diminished forms can withstand blows that would shatter mountains and carve gorges with a single lazy swipe, if only once. In sheer numbers, their presence alone is overwhelming—you may summon them in such vast quantities that the sky itself darkens, forming an iron forest capable of turning entire mountain ranges into pincushions or reducing them to dust should their size permit. Each copy moves at your command as effortlessly as the original, a legion of divine cudgels, all answering to your will. Forged from the immutable black iron of Heaven's own forges, tempered by divine hands, the staff is an indestructible titan—impervious to all forces of ruin. It is a paradox of power—an object of unfathomable weight, 80,000,000 tons in slumber, yet light as air in your grasp, shifting and warping to match your needs, an extension of your very being. It is more than a mere artifact—it is a sentinel, a companion bound to your own fate. No matter the distance, it will answer your summons, returning to your hand as though it had never left. Not even death can sever its devotion—for through cycles of life and rebirth, across the sands of time, the Ruyi Jingu Bang will find you, for you are its master, now and forevermore.
objects.title: Monkey Staff

objects.text: They say that its tassel was forged from the First Flame. They say that its blade was forged from the First Light. A two-handed blade with metal that gleams as if freshly pulled from the forge, warm to the touch, radiating a constant gentle heat, and emanating the sound of the crackling of flame. At the butt of its hilt lies a tassel, condensed fire given semi-solid form, a pulse running through its length as if it lived and breathed. Perhaps it does. At rest it wraps itself around the blade as its sheath, muffling its crackling to barely audible embers. The weapon feels lighter than it should be due to its constant heat creating lift in its wielder’s grasp. With a single parry or by its wielder merely running their fingers across its sheathed form, the tassel unravels from the blade and flows as if carried by gentle wind, but in such a way that it does not obstruct its wielder’s path. The blade cuts through temperature differences as much as its own sharpness, its edge parting matter while the flats of the blade superheat whatever it passes through. Glancing strikes embrittle steels and ceramics. Strike something solid and it will roar with the sound of sudden combustion. The tassel moves autonomously when its user is injured, seeking out their injuries without prompting, wrapping around damaged tissue and igniting. The cauterization is immediate and total, and extremely painful. After it has fully burnt wounds shut, it retreats as if ashamed. The burns it leaves behind throb from the heat, but beneath charred flesh the wielder’s bones shall knit five times faster, infections are washed away, muscle regenerates overnight, and swelling reduces in hours. Even limbs once severed and lost will regenerate, if the user were able to stomach the pain of burning the stumps. At will, the tassel can be released from its condensed form, turning it into an inferno. Flames that were once orange now burn white, spreading with frightening intelligence to the point where minutes of burning turn to seconds of cremation. The wielder may concentrate and direct these flames themselves as well, turning them into focused streams or sending flames across entire formations. A single sweep could reduce a village to ashes. During this state, the blade’s light intensifies dramatically, banishing shadows entirely and turning dusk to dawn across hundreds of feet. However, the wielder will find themselves bathed in its flame for the entirety of its duration - and unfortunately, for all the healing miracles of the tassel’s flame for its wielder, it will do little for suffocation as the flame devours any oxygen it may come to reach, including that within the wielder’s lungs.
objects.title: Morning White

objects.text: An exquisite nodachi forged by the legendary blacksmith Sengo Muramasa. Along its gleaming length are inscribed the kanji: "Split the sky, separate the mountains, cleave the ocean." Commissioned by a minor lord who sought a sword that could slice through armor, horse, and man as if it were passing through air, it stands among Muramasa's finest works. Though forged from ordinary steel and iron, the blade is nearly unbreakable and retains an impossibly sharp edge, able to cleave stone and metal like mud. Only divine weapons can hope to damage it. Its unmatched quality stems from naught else, but Muramasa's obsessive craftsmanship—one so consuming it birthed a will within the blade. From that madness, a spirit or yōkai was born. Not conjured by ritual or sorceries but by Muramasa's blood and relentless will. Though not demonic in origin, its unrelenting bloodlust and singular drive to kill renders this distinction meaningless. Whether demon or not, it is violent, insistent, and all too eager to taste blood. The blade carries all the hallmarks of a cursed weapon. Wounds inflicted by it heal slowly and wrongly—flesh twisting and mending awry, leaving behind a deep, enduring pain that'll never cease. A constant cruel reminder of the sword's malice and hatred for those it failed to end. Even while sheathed, it exerts influence. Merely holding it stirs aggression, making even the disciplined irritable and short-tempered. Stronger wills may resist this. However, those of weaker will find their mental defenses stripped away by whispers and hallucinations, slowly reduced to vessels of violence driven by a hunger that isn't theirs. Bystanders are not immune as many who draw near find themselves inexplicably drawn to the sword, bewitched, gripped by a greed they don't understand, as if the blade were a treasure meant only for them. Once drawn, its malevolence becomes suffocating. The spirit's voice grows louder, whispering in serpentine tones—seductive, cruel, and relentless—beseeching bloodshed. The longer it remains unsheathed, the more its aura unravels minds, stoking tempers and driving all nearby toward madness, frenzy, and violence. Yet, it is not without its twisted blessings. Once fed blood, even an untrained hand finds their instincts sharpened, their strikes refined into deadly precision, if only for a moment, becoming a master swordsman. For seasoned warriors, the sword's influence is subtle, merely quietly corrects—adjusting stances, easing tension, trimming away waste—making their style colder, crueler, and terrifyingly efficient. But the blade does not rest easily. Once awakened, it must taste blood before being laid to sleep. A drop, a wound—it matters not from whom. Without it, the sword refuses to be sheathed.
objects.title: Muramasa no Kyōen

objects.text:
A dark wooden lacquered box, marked with the emblem of a snake entwined with a centipede; inside of which is a set of one hundred golden acupuncture needles. Though these are no ordinary instruments of medicine, for they possess the special ability to replicate any poison they've touched.

Once even a single needle comes into contact with a toxin, you may choose to have the entire set adopt that same poison. The effect isn't a simple coating of the substance mentioned; as the needles will emit a permanent poison energy mimicking it, almost like it were woven into their very metal. Any poison or venom can be copied, and should the needles acquire multiple toxins over time, you may freely switch between them or assign specific kinds to specific needles at will.

Right out of the box, the set carries only a mild paralytic and numbing agent—weak, but sufficient enough to dull sensation in a localized area of an ordinary person with a single one. However, the lethality of any copied poison intensifies dramatically when administered in an acupuncture point, vein, or vital point, allowing even the subtlest of toxins to achieve a profound effect.
objects.title: Mysterious Roaming Physician's Acupuncture Kit

objects.text:
This is the guitar of Neon, the Guitarist and Lead Singer of the band Mondays. It was made to Neon's specifications through the use of magical technology to better use his powers.

This guitar has the special power to both amplify and allow one to use their powers through the way of strumming the strings and singing. If you had magic to shoot fire, then playing different beats and or singing songs that resonate with passion or fire would allow you to shoot blasts of fire at greater strength than you would without this guitar. Having a healing power that would only heal one person at a time through touch, will instead heal anyone who can hear your guitar and voice, you could even choose who it will heal.

The boost in strength to your powers will depend on your own skill at playing the guitar, your singing skills, and what kind of song you play. If you're a poor guitarist or vocalist, it would at most make things 10% stronger, while a rockstar could double the strength of their powers. This also removes the need for things like hand signs or chants for specific spells, but you will instead need to play the rough equivalent of how long it would take you to cast the jutsu or spell in terms of length to a song.

It has a built-in speaker and mic to allow your voice and music to reach long distances. It can even mimic other instruments to play as backup to your voice and guitar. This guitar is indestructible, and its appearance can change to any kind of design—even an acoustic guitar.
objects.title: Neon's Guitar

addons.text: The weapon you have is not something that was merely given to you or found, it was something forged in the very pit of your soul by your Inner Beast to enhance your already formidable powers. Any powers you channel through this weapon will find itself greatly amplified. A strike capable of splitting a house will now cleave a fortress. You lose no control over your powers due to the increase in potency. Alongside this, regardless of whatever form your item takes you are granted perfect and instinctive knowledge on how to wield your weapon.
addons.title: Inner Weapon

addons.text: You know now how to forge such weapons with all it’s benefits for either yourself or others.
addons.title: Weapons Maker

objects.text: When you awaken, you’ll find something incredible by your side. What you have been given here is something that makes any warrior gleam in jealousy, any weapons maker gawk in awe and beg you to study it. You have been given a Perfect Weapon, this is not some mere, albeit well crafted, weapon. Perfectly suited for you, this weapon can take whatever form you desire, capable of easily switching within a moment's notice, even in the middle of combat. This can switch forms into any weapon that could conceivably be wielded and or constructed by you, this includes anything from incredibly sharp nanothorn blades, to magitech guns that shoot fireball spells. Alongside the many forms this can take, the weapon will automatically default to the best weapon for you however you can also manually choose its form. Because of it’s incredible connection to you it seems the weapon will grow alongside you, allowing you to channel your abilities through it, and it will grow to match your abilities over time ensuring that it will always be an incredible tool for you wherever your journey takes you. This weapon can be summoned to your side at any time regardless of distance, and can be stored in your soul if you wish. If it is ever destroyed you’d simply need to summon it to you and it will reappear repaired. You may optionally combine any other weapons to add their properties to the weapon.
objects.title: Perfect Weapon

objects.text:
Prototype Weapon System 01 “Helios” was humanity’s first successful attempt at reverse-engineering the plasma-rail hybrid weaponry of the Xeno Alliance. Developed in the early years of the Outer Planetary Conflict, it served as both proof of concept and a brutal field prototype. Though crude by modern standards, it became infamous for its unmatched destructive power and the heat shimmer that followed every shot.

It is a rugged, heavy infantry weapon that combines electromagnetic rail systems with a stabilized plasma delivery mechanism. It features two distinct firing modes: one for high-powered long-range precision, and another for rapid, suppressive combat. In its long-range configuration, the weapon extends its barrel and charges a ferrous slug wrapped in a plasma envelope. The shot is slow to prepare but devastating on impact, easily capable of melting through bunker walls or enemy armor. Each of these sniper-mode discharges generates a tremendous amount of heat, which must be vented before the weapon can fire again. A built-in failsafe prevents firing during this cooldown phase, which typically lasts between one to two seconds depending on the environment.

Switching to rapid fire mode compresses the barrel and reconfigures internal plasma regulators for quick cycling. The weapon becomes more compact, losing some of its range and punch, but gaining speed and adaptability. Each shot is still plasma-enhanced, though less intense than in sniper mode. Roughly every dozen shots generate enough heat to trigger the weapon’s brief automatic lock, forcing a short delay as the internal cooling system vents pressure and rebalances the coils.

Mounted beneath the barrel is a fixed bayonet, forged from smart alloys and connected directly to the weapon’s heat transfer matrix. Excess thermal energy is redirected into the blade during high-use situations, causing it to superheat along its edge. At full charge, it glows with residual plasma and can cut through armor plating or sear flesh with a single strike. A secondary capacitive system allows the blade to deliver short, high-voltage pulses on impact, acting similar to a taser. It serves as both a heat sink and a brutal last-resort weapon when the main system is cooling down or out of ammunition.

The weapon is powered by modular energy cells — commonly referred to as magazines, though they function more like rechargeable batteries. Each cell holds enough energy to fire one hundred shots in rapid mode or ten in long-range mode. When depleted, the cells can be swapped in seconds, allowing sustained combat operations with minimal downtime. Once ejected, a spent cell can continue to recharge independently by absorbing ambient energy sources — solar, thermal, or otherwise. On a standard Earth-like world, a full recharge takes about four hours of direct sunlight.

It weighs over twenty kilograms fully loaded. Its immense power comes with serious recoil, particularly when firing in its long-range configuration — the magnetic and plasma forces combined produce a vicious kick that can stagger even trained users if unbraced. It is loud, unmissable, and completely unsuited for stealth operations. Every shot detonates from the barrel in a thunderous eruption of plasma and electromagnetic discharge, lighting the air and leaving behind the metallic scent of ionized dust.
objects.title: Prototype Weapon System 01 “Helios”

objects.text: They say that whatever goes on the Internet can last forever. That machines will outlast man due to their superior bodies and minds. Well... with this gun, you can call that fact a lie now. Developed by a Spanish cybernetics organisation for their guards, the Segadora Mecánica (or, Machine Reaper) is a rather unique gun. It can be used for a regular firefight, yes, with its 2300° Fahrenheit bullets piercing right through human flesh when fired, but that is not its intended purpose. For when put against machines is when it truly thrives. If you were to shoot a surface-to-air missile system, the system would start wiping itself and wouldn't have the chance to fire even on accident. Shoot a tank even in the treads, and all of its systems, from the firing mechanism to the sensors, everything, would shut down. Any technology you fire at will "die", or at least die in the way technology can. This is due to a nearly unexplainable EMP variation in the bullets primed when the firing pin hits the primer of the bullets. Oddly, as some have observed, the gun seems to preserve the tech's hardware, as even if it pierces a mundane phone, it only hits the absolute bare minimum needed to do its job. The ammo for this gun is easy to replicate for you in terms of the actual process, although you would need a hint of infrastructure to get many more bullets than about 6 per week.
objects.title: Segadora Mecánica

objects.text:
A lacquered sheath and an intricately designed folding fan, mostly matte black with pink accents. The sheath appears empty at all times, sized for a blade that does not exist. The fan fits perfectly into its mouth when closed, its tip locking in place with a satisfying click as though completing a puzzle. With a small exertion of the user’s will, drawing the fan from the sheath produces a transformation. The fan becomes a hilt, and extending from it where an empty space is supposed to be is a fractured, light pink blade. Fine cracks run across its entire length, giving it the appearance of something delicate, though it holds firm under stress and cuts cleanly through most materials the user can bring it against.

The weapon truly reveals itself when the fan is opened while the blade remains formed. The sword fractures along its existing cracks, breaking apart into a thousand rigid shards. In the same motion, those shards soften and bloom into cherry blossom petals, pale pink and weightless, spreading outward into a drifting cloud. Each one responds to the user as an extension of their intent, albeit needing to be guided by gestures of the fan.

Sweeping the open fan directs the cloud, guiding its flow, shaping its speed, and defining its area of effect. The blossoms move like a current of wind, able to surround, pursue, or encircle targets, with its speed capable of allowing the user to cleave through a steel wall in seconds, turning the blossoms into a hurricane of sharp blades around themselves. At any moment, the user may harden individual petals or entire swathes of the cloud, turning them back into razor edged fragments that slice through whatever they pass. The transition between soft petal and cutting edge happens instantly, allowing precise control over what is affected and what remains untouched. The range of the cloud extends several dozen meters from the user, with finer control maintained the closer to the fan the blossoms are. Beyond that distance, the blossoms begin to lose cohesion and begin to aimlessly drift until recalled.

A sweeping motion inward draws the petals back towards their wielder. As they return, they settle along the tip of the fan, reforming the blade as the fan closes. The weapon may then be returned to the sheath, with the fan parting from it without its blade just as easily as the user had made it whole.
objects.title: Senbonzakura

objects.text:
In a horrible apocalypse inhabited by both zombies and raiders, someone created a conceptually simple weapon—one that some thought impossible: the Shotgun Axe.

This shotgun axe operates using an ignition system fitted behind the axe blade, with a storage compartment for shotgun shells located behind that. The shells are designed to go off as soon as the gases ignite. This gives the axe far more cutting power with less physical strength required, thanks to the lack of recoil. A steel door in your way? Two or three shells, and you're in. A zombie's skull is particularly hard? One swing, and that zombie’s new nickname is Two-Face.

Another quality of life benefit it has is thanks to its blade, cuts are very clean depending on the angle the slice is at, preventing stuff like zombie guts from coming on you to infect you. Otherwise, the wood and the blade are very durable among their mundane brethren.
objects.title: Shotgun Axe

objects.text:
You are now in possession of a knife that can instantly kill any target it cuts provided that all conditions are met.

One, the target can not be overwhelmingly more powerful overall compared to yourself (100x or more). Two, the target must be a humanoid. Three, the attack must be a successful sneak attack.

Even if the conditions are not met, the knife is capable of cutting through all mundane materials and can only be harmed by esoteric materials.
objects.title: Silent Gasp

objects.text:
This is the very slingshot used by David to strike down Goliath. Simple, worn, and unadorned, it looks like any shepherd’s tool — a long strip of worn leather, split into two cords with a central cradle for holding stones, it looks like nothing more than a tool for driving off wolves or guarding sheep — but carries the undeniable weight of history and divine intervention.

When wielded, the Slingshot of David grants its user near-absolute accuracy. Every shot is subtly corrected mid-flight by an unseen force. It negates the effects of wind, distance, shaky hands, and even partial cover, provided the target is visible. This effect does not guarantee a critical hit or strike a vital area — just that it will hit. 

The power of the slingshot increases based on the physical size of the enemy. The larger the target, the more force the shot carries. A giant, a dragon, a behemoth — they get struck with raw, crushing impact. The damage scales linearly with size. A pebble that would bruise a soldier might stagger a troll, punch through a cyclops’s armor, or crack the skull of a titan.

Lastly, every stone or projectile launched from the slingshot is automatically sanctified the moment it is fired. This allows it to bypass resistances and immunities tied to mundane weapons. It can strike incorporeal creatures, such as ghosts or spirits, and can damage cursed or demonic entities that would normally shrug off physical attacks. The sanctification is temporary — the projectile only carries this property until impact — but it makes each shot effective in both the physical and spiritual realms.
objects.title: Sling of David

addons.text: You now stand as a newly acknowledged child of the god Lugh Lámfada, along with all that this brings. Lugh is known for his many varied skills, and now so shall you. A Wright, a Smith, a Champion, a Swordsman, a Thrower, a Harpist, a Sailor, a Hero, a Poet, a Teacher, a Historian, a Sorcerer, and a Craftsman—these are the skills for which Lugh was known, granting him the name Samildánach, meaning “equally skilled in all the arts.” And now you share these skills, each pushed beyond the limits of an average human's abilities. Lugh was also known for teaching, and now you can do so as well. For each hour of your tutoring, your student gains the equivalent of 24 hours of training from the next best instructor. This cannot push someone beyond their own physical or mental limits, but it can elevate them to the absolute peak of their potential. Lastly, your divine heritage unlocks the final name of the Spear of Gorias: Brionac. The spear can take the form of a bolt of lightning, which can be thrown to strike your foes. However, this ability can only be used once before needing to be recharged from a natural lightning storm.
addons.title: Child of Lugh

objects.text: This legendary spear is known by many names, most famously as “The Spear of Lugh.” It is the treasured artifact known as the “Spear of the City of Gorias.” Brought to the Emerald Isle by the Tuatha Dé Danann eons ago, it is one of the legendary Four Treasures of Ireland. Formed from the wood of the strongest yew tree, this spear is all but unbreakable. It excels on the offensive, particularly when thrown. When thrown, it flies with unerring accuracy to always hit the target. Bypassing all armor and all defenses, this is an unblockable and undodgeable attack designed to inflict cursed wounds that cannot heal. The spear is also capable of fighting on its own, using the skills of those who have ever wielded it in battle. It will fight anyone and anything on the battlefield that catches its attention. Next, should you manage to gain the support of others, you now have the right to lay claim to the Throne as King of the Tuatha Dé Danann, once held by your divine father. The spear will return to you, its wielder, with just a word. What word, though? Whichever word you choose, the spear will always know which one and react accordingly.
objects.title: Spear of Gorias

objects.text:
A colossal war spear once wielded by the Trojan prince Hector, a weapon of unmatched size and weight, stretching eleven cubits in length, or roughly 5 meters. It is a weapon far beyond the strength of ordinary humans, its sheer mass demanding the might of those who defy mortal limits. Yet despite its overwhelming size, the spear is perfectly balanced, a weapon capable of piercing the strongest armor, sundering shields, and striking down monsters and men alike with the crushing power of a siege weapon. It is not merely a tool of battle—it is a challenge to the very concept of human limitation.

The spear carries with it the echo of Hector’s final moments, his death forever marked by Athena’s trickery and abandonment. Imprinted within the spear is this lingering memory, manifesting as a second form—a javelin. The transformation reshapes the spear, but it does not lessen its weight. If anything, the javelin form is heavier, dense beyond logic, yet so precisely balanced that it can be thrown by those capable of wielding it. This form is the triumph of human effort, the stubborn rebellion of courage in the face of the impossible.

When thrown, the javelin defies its own mass, soaring as if it were weightless, flying with increasing speed and force the longer it remains in the air. It does not lose momentum, and it does not slow. The farther it travels, the more devastating its impact becomes. When it strikes, the force gathered during its flight is unleashed in a violent kinetic explosion, capable of obliterating walls, shattering formations, and leaving behind ruin. The spear itself is untouched by its own explosion, ready to be wielded again.
objects.title: Spear of Hector

objects.text: As the new owner of the Spear of Scorpio, you have the ability to command and control its various abilities. The Spear is capable of retracting its shaft—becoming a dagger—and extending it again. Its blade is soaked with the scorpion’s venom, causing agonizing pain and inflammation with every scratch. This venom is incurable—so long as you wish it to be—and will naturally incorporate the effects and lethality of any poison or toxin you expose it to. The greatest power of the Spear lies in its connection to the Constellation of Scorpio. While this constellation typically appears in the night skies of Earth for a portion of the year, with the Spear in your hand, you can cause the constellation to shine in the sky throughout the year—on any world, in any dimension, realm, or location. The Scorpion has historically been a gatekeeper to the Underworld, with creatures wielding a burning sting that controlled who could enter and exit the realm of the dead. With the Scorpion standing watch in the heavens overhead, you can freely call forth the souls of the departed to serve you. This effect can only be invoked once every 12 days. Finally, while the default form of the Spear is that of a Grecian spear, it can take the shape of any spear—or spear-like—weapon, and can be turned into a small pin of Scorpio for easy transport and storage.
objects.title: Spear of Scorpio

objects.text:
An old greatsword, so old in fact that had it possessed memory, the memory of its origin would have long since crumbled to dust. Only fragments remain, a single impression preserved in the blade: the sensation of being swung daily, and the feeling of its thirst being sated by the one who first wielded it. That owner's name, face, and fate are lost forever, leaving only the thirst that has never left since.

The blade is massive, a slab of steel that would demand exceptional strength merely to lift from the ground, yet its construction defies its appearance. Perfect balance has been achieved in its forging, such that once you possess the strength to hold it properly, the weapon moves as though it weighs nothing at all. Skilled techniques that require precision and control become possible with this sword despite its intimidating size, with its weight becoming irrelevant so long as you can lift it.

Its true nature reveals itself in the strange porosity of its metal, a construction unlike any other steel. Liquids drawn into contact with the blade vanish into its surface, absorbed into the sword. Mundane water means nothing to it, but magical potions or chemicals, when poured upon the steel, grants the sword their properties temporarily, the effects lasting for one minute per pint consumed. The stronger the liquid consumed, the greater the effect. Blood of magical creatures affects it similarly, the blood granting the monster’s abilities to the sword. This constant thirst manifests in every deep wound you inflict, leaving them weakened by anemia or dehydration.
objects.title: Spongia

objects.text:
Originally designed for wide-scale deployment in off-world military zones, the Vindicator is a dependable, magnetically-assisted machine gun built for rough conditions and long engagements. Its streamlined construction and self-correcting internals make it ideal for both trained soldiers and civilian militias. Though not elegant, it is brutally effective in its simplicity and staying power.

The Vindicator uses an electromagnetic acceleration system to fire dense, caseless slugs at high velocity. It operates without chemical propellant, relying instead on a network of magnetic coils along the barrel to launch each round with precision and force. This system drastically reduces internal wear and lowers the chance of mechanical failure, even during extended use in high-stress environments.

Firing modes include full-auto for suppression, burst for controlled engagements, and semi-automatic for precision fire. Integrated recoil compensation software adjusts the firing rhythm dynamically based on user stability and posture, allowing smoother sustained fire. The construction is sealed, resistant to dust, heat, vacuum exposure, and most corrosive agents. 

You are issued 10 ammunition bricks — modular cartridges containing 200 smart-slugs apiece. These bricks are designed for rapid replacement and can be swapped in under two seconds with minimal training. Bricks are self-cooling, weatherproof, and disposable. To ensure logistical sustainability in the field, each weapon includes a portable storage box — a low-output fabrication unit that accepts empty bricks and raw materials such as scrap metal, polymers, or alloy powder. Given sufficient resources, the box can rebuild one ammunition brick every 45 minutes under normal planetary conditions.

The Vindicator is a heavy-duty firearm, weighing just under 14 kilograms when fully loaded. While manageable by most trained users, prolonged use without physical enhancement or mechanical support leads to fatigue. Sustained fire can lead to heat buildup, and while venting is automatic, barrel degradation is possible under extreme use without proper maintenance.
objects.title: Standard Infantry Weapon 03 “Vindicator”

objects.text:
Designed as a rugged, high-impact sidearm for frontline personnel and auxiliary forces, the Evoker is a magnetically-accelerated handgun built to deliver punishing firepower in a compact, durable frame. While not necessarily a commonly used gun within the Coalition of Mankind, most elites have one as an easy to carry breaching weapon.

The Evoker fires oversized, caseless smart-slugs using a compact electromagnetic acceleration system embedded along its reinforced barrel. A set of short-length magnetic coils engage in rapid succession, propelling each round at high velocity with minimal mechanical strain. The system is optimized for reliability over finesse, sacrificing sustained rate of fire for consistency and terminal performance.

Firing modes are limited to semi-automatic for deliberate, high-impact shots. A secondary “double-tap” function, activated through trigger pressure modulation, allows for a near-instantaneous two-round burst designed to overwhelm personal shielding or armor. Recoil is substantial but manageable, assisted by a microcontroller that modulates coil timing based on hand stability and user feedback.

The weapon’s internals are fully sealed, with no exposed ejection ports or gas vents, making it resistant to particulate contamination, electromagnetic interference, vacuum exposure, and most atmospheric hazards. The Evoker is designed to be field-serviced without tools, and can continue operating with moderate coil misalignment or barrel fouling without catastrophic failure.

The Evoker uses disposable magnetic-feed magazines, each holding six heavy smart-slugs. Slugs are denser and broader than standard infantry rounds, and are optimized for impact over volume. Reloading is simple and fast, taking under two seconds with minimal training. Magazines are weather-sealed and can be stored long-term without degradation.

You are issued 8 magazines per unit, totaling 48 rounds. To ensure logistical sustainability in the field, it comes with a portable storage box, a low-output fabrication unit that accepts empty magazines and raw materials such as scrap metal, polymers, or alloy powder. Given sufficient resources, the box can produce one magazine every 4 minutes under normal planetary conditions, with a full reload cycle of 8 magazines completed in approximately 35 minutes.

Weighing just under 4 kilograms when loaded, the Evoker is a heavy sidearm by most standards, and prolonged use without stabilization or assistance will result in user fatigue. Its compact magnetic system generates heat more rapidly than full-length rifles, and although passive venting mitigates short-term buildup, overuse without cooldown can degrade coil efficiency or shorten barrel lifespan.
objects.title: Standard Sidearm 07 “Evoker”

addons.text:
You stand now as a newly acknowledged child of the god Nuada Airgetlám, along with all that this brings. Nuada is known across the Celtic world by many other names, primarily those associated with water. Thus, water is your inheritance, granting you the ability to command it in all forms. Nuada is also famous for his Silver Arm; should you or one of your companions lose a body part, you will have the ability to replace it with liquid silver. Lastly, should you manage to gain the support of others, you now have the right to lay claim to the Throne as King of the Tuatha Dé Danann, once held by your divine father.

Your divine heritage also unlocks the final name of the Sword of Findias: Fragarach—the Answerer. When this sword is placed against an enemy's throat, it will rob them of all their strength and compel them to reveal what they believe to be the truth in response to any questions you might ask.
addons.title: Child of Nuada

objects.text:
A legendary Celtic sword, known by many names and said to have served many kings, this is the Sword of the City of Findias. It was brought to Ireland by Nuada Airgetlám during the migration of the Tuatha Dé Danann, and is legendary as one of the Four Treasures of Ireland.

The Sword of Findias grants the user command over the wind, allowing it to cut through any mortal shield or wall with ease and inflict wounds from which no mere man may recover.

Known also as Claiomh Solais—or the Sword of Light—this blade is regarded as the sword of heroes and champions. It is strong enough to withstand divine onslaughts, and its edge can rend divine flesh effortlessly. Unfortunately, the sword is prohibited from killing until certain conditions are met.

This is a sword that works with fate to fulfill the needs of a hero's journey. To wield the sword and right the villain’s wrongs, nearly always involving the saving of a damsel—or dude—in distress, and have them somehow reveal the villain’s weakness. Only then can the power of the sword be unleashed to deal enhanced damage to their vulnerability and defeat the villain. While after the Hero's Reward awaits.
objects.title: Sword of Findias

objects.text: The Sword of Virgo now in your hands was once wielded by the Goddess of Justice, Astraea, before she returned to the Heavens. With the sword, as long as the wielder believes their actions to be just, the blade will allow nothing to contaminate or mar it—its blade rejecting even the touch of light itself. This causes the blade to take on a mirror-like appearance that reflects all light absolutely and to leach heat from all things struck by it. The sword holds a supernatural sharpness due to this effect, allowing it to cleave through flesh, stone, and metal with ease. The sword’s ties to the constellation of Virgo, however, grant it its greatest strength: the ability to impart finality into a strike. Anyone slain under this effect cannot be revived by any method without the wielder’s permission. This effect can only be activated once every 12 days. While Virgo only appears for part of the year—and only on Earth—you can cause the star sign to appear in the sky throughout the year, regardless of the world, dimension, realm, or location. Finally, while the default form of the Sword of Virgo is that of a Greek xiphos with a mirror-like blade, the sword is capable of taking the form of any other sword and transforming itself into a small pin of Virgo for easy transport and storage.
objects.title: Sword of Virgo

objects.text:
This jet-black rapier was developed as a failsafe for summoning rituals and as a way to deal with various beings foreign to the world.

While perfectly capable of acting as a regular weapon—being near-indestructible and razor-sharp—its true purpose reveals itself when it engages with any entity not native to the world you find yourself in, be they a summoned familiar or someone who found a way into your corner of reality on their own. For such entities, it will not only ignore any and all defences—whether it is physical armour, magical barriers, or anything else—but a mere graze is enough to send this entity back to its home dimension, and fully piercing it will completely prevent any further attempt to re-enter the world.
objects.title: The Blade of Banishment
The Black Thorn
objects.text: Pure black in appearance, the Black Thorn is a small shapeshifting weapon, about the size of a dagger, made of pure Ichor. Wounds caused by it will quickly necrotize, as the Ichor infects them seeking to consume your foes. If it should reach their heart or core, it will proceed to convert them into Ichor which it will absorb to grow stronger, allowing it to turn into bigger things, or even divide itself to create another Black Thorn once it possesses sufficient Ichor. But care must be taken when wielding this weapon, because it possesses a will of its own, and won’t allow someone it sees as weak to wield it. If you ever waver in your convictions while wielding a Thorn, it will turn on you, quickly devouring you and leaving behind a small puddle of Ichor, as it awaits someone worthy of wielding it once more. Come back to me, back to your home… Come back to the Mountain.

addons.title: Blood of Thorns
addons.text:
You answered the call and found a mountain that doesn’t exist. One that devours men, as a dying god slumbers and heals. And you conquered it, slaying every monster, madman, and cultist that sought to feed you to the mountain.

The entire time the thorn was unusually silent, simply watching you. Even when you stumbled from your wounds, or your conviction wavered for a moment, the thorn did not act upon your weakness.

Eventually though, you reached a cave, and deep within it, you could feel was the source of the call, but blocking the way was one final monster, more terrible than any you faced before, and you fell short.

And as you laid there dying, the thorn made it’s judgment. It dissolved and began flowing into your wounds, infusing you with a burst of strength and vitality, enough to kill the monster, and devour the heart of the mountain.

Now your heart beats black, producing Ichor and allowing you to wield it like an extension of yourself. The Black Thorn’s properties are now a part of you, and every day you produce enough Ichor to make a dagger from your blood.

Additionally, the Ichor will slowly enhance your body and soul, making them stronger and more resilient, and gaining new properties and abilities with time as you become something more.

You are the child of a god of the Hunt—perhaps the Greek goddess Artemis, the Celtic god Cernunnos, the Allfather Odin, or a forgotten deity of the Sumerian, Aztec, or Mayan pantheons. Your divine blood grants you access to a vast array of weapons, powers, skills, and animal companions tied to your parent’s sacred domains.

Your arrows are crafted for one purpose: the hunt. Monsters, abominations, eldritch horrors, and unnatural creatures all become prey beneath your gaze. Even an Endbringer or an Entity cannot hide from your Sight, your arrows will strike down all. Your very essence is compelled to seek out and slay those who defy nature or threaten humanity—they are marked, and you are the reckoning.

Obstacles no longer hinder your aim. With ease, you strike down targets through terrain, barriers, or illusions. Your hunting daggers now resonate with your divine heritage, channeling your parent’s domains through their steel—be it moonlight, wild fury, silence, or storm.

You can craft any type of special arrow, each tailored with unique effects—poisoned, explosive, spectral, or divine. Those you kill may yield new abilities, arrows, or enhancements to fuel your future hunts. Alternatively, you may infuse your parent’s divinity into a single arrow, the effects shaped by their domains and symbols. A war-aspected god may create arrows that demoralize enemies or inspire allies within a blast radius.
