All abilities tied to your divine lineage are passively empowered. As a Child of the Hunt, you possess instinctive knowledge of survival, tracking, and nature itself. With time, your understanding deepens, unlocking new techniques and insights drawn from your godly parent. You have access to a vast Library of knowledge about traps, skills, techniques, and even spells that all have to do with Hunting, Surviving, and Tracking, all of these are yours to Learn. 

You are the Hunter’s Heir. Nature embraces you. You are the Survivor, the Apex Predator—an unstoppable force beneath the wild sky.
addons.title: Child of The Hunt

objects.text:
The Cosmic Bow is a legendary artifact of cosmic and divine origin, renowned for its versatility and the wide array of mystical arrows it can summon. It is not a mere bow; it is a relic capable of slaying gods and supernatural beings alike. Its cosmic essence allows it to pierce the stars, shatter worlds, rain down meteoric devastation, and strike targets even across dimensions.

Forged with powerful enchantments, the bow is indestructible and soul-bound to its wielder. It requires no quiver, as the arrows are conjured directly from the power itself when the string is drawn, allowing the bow to generate arrows instantly with each use. The wielder can channel elemental, arcane, or divine affinities into the bow, imbuing each shot with unique effects based on their intent.

Common arrow types include Spatial Arrows, Power-Infused Arrows, Magical Arrows, Dimensional Arrows, and Divine Arrows. These can be used individually or combined to create hybrid effects. For example, a Power-Dimensional Arrow can pierce through planes of existence while channeling a devastating force. Additionally, there are simpler but powerful arrows, suitable for less demanding situations.

In its default state, known as General Use, the bow maintains a compact form suitable for everyday wielding. This mode allows access to weaker arrow types and simplified versions of the additional features. However, activating Core Form allows the bow to integrate additional enchantments or tap into stronger power sources, enhancing its destructive capabilities. Once activated, the bow can return to General Use to lock in these changes and adjust its power accordingly.

Multi-Shot Mode allows the wielder to release volleys of arrows, either of the same type or mixed, unleashing a wave of destruction. These arrows rain down on enemies, overwhelming them with simultaneous magical effects. This mode is ideal for quickly overwhelming large groups with diverse attacks.

In Tracking Shot Mode, each arrow becomes sentient, taking the form of a beast tied to its elemental or magical type. This beast relentlessly hunts its target, ensuring a lethal strike. If multiple arrow types are combined or divine energy is channeled, the beast transforms, greatly increasing its power and symbolic significance.

Charge Shot Mode allows energy to build as the bowstring is drawn. Once released, the arrow explodes with enough force to destroy matter, pierce through barriers, or completely obliterate the target. At full charge, even the strongest defenses may be shattered.

In Combat Mode, the bow transforms into a pair of deadly daggers, which can be upgraded into short swords or other melee forms. While losing its ranged capability, these daggers inherit the properties of the arrows, enabling the wielder to unlock unique melee-based techniques and abilities rooted in the bow's nature.

As an immortal artifact, the Cosmic Bow resists full mastery by those lacking divine strength. In inexperienced hands, a single shot might level a city block—an impressive feat, but only a fraction of its true potential. With experience and understanding, the full extent of its power is revealed.

Those attuned to cosmic forces or with a natural gift for archery will find the bow’s power more accessible. Even at its peak, it remains a supreme conduit for the wielder’s abilities, much like Mjolnir to Thor—an extension of their will, strength, and legend.

It’s important to note that some of the bow’s modes may unlock special types of arrows that are exclusive to those modes, enriching the wielder’s arsenal and expanding the strategic possibilities in combat.
objects.title: The Cosmic Bow

objects.text: What you now hold is Mistilteinn, the legendary arrow that felled the invincible Baldur. Fashioned from a small, unassuming, and oh-so-overlooked humble sprig of mistletoe, once deemed too weak to pose a threat. It was transformed by its act of deicide and the weight of myth into a weapon that defies the natural order of things, capable of becoming the exception to any single rule. Mistilteinn can bypass any one chosen law or principle at a time, no matter how immutable or absolute it may be. It can ignore invulnerability, pierce immortality, or transcend concepts like distance or speed, etc. And despite its modest size, being no larger than a crossbow bolt, Mistilteinn requires no bow to fire. Simply think it, and the arrow will launch itself toward your intended target. You may also direct it mid-flight with thought alone, altering its path or turning it upon multiple foes in quick succession. It moves with such swiftness that even sound struggles to keep pace, yet it shall remain utterly silent in flight, leaving no trace and disturbing nothing in its path, quiet and forgotten as it is. Additionally, due to having tasted the blood of a god, it is especially effective against beings of divine nature, while also rendering it nearly indestructible—only divine weapons on the level of Wotan's Gungnir are capable of breaking it.
objects.title: The Little Arrow that Felled a God

objects.text:
The Oracle Multitool takes the form of a small gold cylinder around the side of one's hand. Within it swirls a black, mercury-like liquid with magical properties.

In combat, the liquid responds to the will of the user, automatically shapeshifting into a melee weapon most suited for the situation, ensuring the user will always have an advantage over any opponent. Though if you wish, you may consciously choose a weapon for it to become. It has applications outside of combat as well, as it can transform into various mundane tools like a screwdriver or a lockpick. 

Whatever weapon the Multitool transforms into will be supernaturally effective. Blades and spikes tear through steel like wet tissue paper, and blunt weapons strike with the force of cannonballs. Moreover, the weapons will be able to withstand several tons of force before breaking and necessitating that it be reformed. The cylinder itself is similarly durable.
objects.title: The Oracle Multitool

objects.text: A plain looking Katana stained black in a white sheath, it seems to possess a remarkable ability as it is able to cut through anything except its own sheath. But its ability comes at a cost, every time it cuts, it also cuts a memory from the user, equal to what it destroyed. Cutting through something trivial would cost an insignificant memory- like waiting in the doctors office for an hour during a regular check up, while cutting through something like an Endbringer would cost you significant memories core to your personality. Thankfully there is one mercy… the sheath is able to be imbued with 3 memories, granting them the same protection from being cut as the sheath.
objects.title: The Unknown Blade

objects.text:
A rapier gifted to a knight by a princess as a token of her affection and promise to protect and love her forevermore. Through a tragic turn of events, he failed in his duties and took his own life while kneeling over her corpse. The mix of both their lifeblood was absorbed into the blade, causing the rose on its hilt to take on a red pigment and the blade to glow with a blood-red hue.

Through the events that took place with its previous wielder, the rapier has gained several abilities. The first is that it is very durable, well beyond what modern metals could accomplish. The second is that, should the blade be damaged, it can feed upon the blood of either yourself or others to repair itself, even if only a tiny portion remains. The third is an extension of the second: the blade has the ability to absorb the blood of anyone it strikes and either transfer it to you to heal your wounds, or allow you to release bursts of blood aura and a vortex of blood to strike foes. These attacks are strong enough that a thrust releasing this aura could rival the strength of a cannonball, and the vortex surrounding the blade allows for situations where, even if you miss your swing, you could still leave lacerations on a foe that draw even more blood from them.

Thorn is also useful as a type of wand or conduit to cast powers through, should you require it for such a situation.
objects.title: Thorn

addons.text:
There was a time when this weapon was just a tool—simple, sturdy, and overlooked. But through trials, battles, and the weight of your legend, it has become something more: a reflection of your will, purpose, and command. It no longer belongs to the world; it belongs to you—and those you choose to empower.

The weapon’s buffs now only activate when wielded by you, or by someone to whom you’ve personally granted permission. This bond is absolute, and you may revoke permission at will. When another uses the weapon with your blessing, it subtly guides their form—adjusting their stance, instinct, and rhythm to echo your fighting style.

Additionally, any boosts gained from your phase(s) now extend to the weapon as well, empowering it in full alongside your transformation. When your aura flares and your strength surges, so too does the weapon respond, enhancing its damage and effectiveness in perfect sync with your ascension.

Lastly, during your phase(s), the weapon undergoes a purely cosmetic transformation. It may glow with light, leave trails of arcane fire, pulse with energy, or shift in form to match your elevated presence. While it grants no mechanical advantage, it serves as a striking symbol of the power you wield—and the challenge the hero now faces.
addons.title: Signature Weapon

objects.text:
This is the kind of weapon found at the start of every journey—the one a hero pulls from a dusty rack, a forgotten training room, or a battlefield long past. You can choose its form: a sword, a spear, an axe, a bow, a staff, or something else entirely. Regardless of what you pick, it always looks plain—practical, worn, and entirely unremarkable. But when you hold it, it feels balanced in a way that catches you off guard, like it was made to be wielded, not admired.

While wielded, the weapon grants you a 50% increase to a single stat of your choice—Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Intelligence, or another, depending on your system. This choice is made when you first equip the weapon and cannot be changed afterward. Your chosen stat shapes the passive trait in the weapon itself. A Strength-focused weapon might stagger on impact, while a Dexterity-tuned one recovers faster between moves. 

The weapon also has a knack for syncing with the world’s power system, improving your base interaction with magic, ki, aura, or whatever force governs power where you are. You can channel it through your weapon, allowing your strikes or spells to carry more weight. 

This isn’t a legendary relic or mythical blade. It’s better than that—it’s reliable. Its design is forgiving, subtly improving your technique, making it slightly more efficient when used with techniques you favor (e.g., thrusts, parries, combo strikes). Lastly, your attacks with this weapon do 20% more damage to all enemies, and 5% of their total damage bypasses defenses and immunities.
objects.title: Tutorial Weapon

objects.text:
It seems that you have acquired an unnamed magic sword that was rumored to grant its wielder the power to defeat armies single-handedly.

It appears that this rumor was true, as besides being supernaturally sharp and durable, this sword bears simple, yet terrifying enchantment upon it. It multiplies the capabilities of its wielder to legendary levels. 

In the hands of a well-trained yet ordinary man, it would grant strength that makes every strike generate shockwaves capable of blasting apart castle walls, the speed to make ordinary men look as they are simply in slow-motion, senses and reflexes sharp enough to be mistaken for precognition, and the durability to endure the same power it grants.

Who knows what a wielder who already possessed supernatural might would be capable of should they wield this sword.

Note: You may choose which form of sword this will be.
objects.title: Unnamed Sword of Legend

addons.text:
Your skills in improving weapons have granted supernatural, exclusive upgrades for your arsenal, found in the crate.

You now have pistols that can penetrate through five people in a single line, shotguns with twice the physically possible firepower, and Magnums that inflict even greater critical damage when striking enemy weak points.

You also possess two guns with unlimited ammunition: The Chicago Sweeper submachine gun and the Handcannon Magnum.

You are also given four melee weapons: the first three are knives, with the third, called the Primal Knife, being indestructible, and the ones before it having two times the cutting power and attack speed, respectively. The last weapon is the LZ Answerer, which is "definitely not" a dual-bladed lightsaber.

Lastly, you now possess the ability to give supernatural, exclusive upgrades to other weapons as well, such as infinite ammo, but they can only have one upgrade per weapon. This is not limited to just modern weaponry.
addons.title: Now That’s a Weapon!

objects.text:
A seemingly ordinary military crate, rugged and reinforced, this container holds far more than its appearance suggests. Within it lies a comprehensive cache of advanced weaponry—rifles, sidearms, explosives, and specialized gear—each designed with a level of craftsmanship that surpasses anything found in modern arsenals. Though they look and function like contemporary firearms, lacking energy blasts or futuristic designs, their performance is anything but ordinary. These weapons are not only more powerful but operate with an uncanny efficiency: shots carry greater kinetic force, trajectories remain stable over long distances, and recoil is minimal, allowing for exceptional control and precision even under pressure.

In terms of ammunition, the crate offers a vast and varied selection tailored to every combat scenario. Incendiary rounds burst into flames on impact, armour-piercing bullets can punch through reinforced plating, and there are even other munitions with devastating effects. The crate ensures that you’re never without the right tool for the job, regardless of the battlefield conditions.

Beyond its contents, the crate itself serves a vital support role. Built with modular functionality, it doubles as a fully equipped workbench for weapon maintenance and modification. With the appropriate raw materials at your disposal, you can repair damaged gear, craft new ammunition, and even upgrade or customize your arsenal to suit evolving tactical needs.
objects.title: Weapons Crate

objects.text:
Forged in the deepest forges of Hades and wielded by the relentless Furies, the Whip of the Furies is a weapon of unending torment.

Wherever its barbed lashes strike, they ignite hellfire, a spectral flame that latches to the victim’s spirit, causing intense, soul-deep pain. The lash does no physical harm, but each strike magnifies the victim’s sensitivity to pain, stacking with each successive hit until even the faintest touch feels like a searing brand.

The torment lingers well beyond the initial assault. Faint tendrils of hellfire continue to cling to the victim’s soul, kindling persistent phantom pains that flare without warning. These fade given enough time however.

When the whip lashes out at multiple foes, it does more than simply spread pain—it entwines them in a shared suffering. Each victim becomes linked, their agony resonating between them in cruel echoes.

As the pain compounds, should a target endure enough sustained torment, there is a chance they may break, submitting to the wielder’s commands out of raw, primal fear. This chance increases the more they suffered and weaker their will to resist.

However, wielding the Whip of the Furies is not without cost. The whip carries within it the lingering essence of the Furies themselves—ancient, merciless beings whose purpose is endless pursuit and punishment. With every crack of the whip, their influence seeps into the wielder’s mind. 

Over time, this presence grows stronger, wearing down compassion, eroding patience, and replacing it with a cold hunger for control and domination. The wielder may begin to crave the power to inflict pain, to see others squirm under their lash, losing sight of justice and slipping into cruelty for its own sake. 

The whip does not possess the wielder outright, but it stains the soul, polluting thoughts, breeding obsession, and slowly reshaping the wielder in the image of the Furies themselves.
objects.title: Whip of the Furies

objects.text:
One of the four legendary swords of ancient myth, the Zhuxian Jian was forged by the Heavens and imbued with the Dao of Death itself. It is said that this blade does not merely cut flesh, but severs the very thread of existence, adding names to the Book of Life and Death in Diyu that were long ago erased. Even immortals who have removed themselves from the cosmic ledger find their names rewritten upon its pages by this sword, their immortality rendered void.

The Zhuxian Jian is no sharper than any well-made blade, nor does it strike with any greater force. Its power lies entirely in what happens after you land a lethal blow. When you run an immortal through, when you cleave their head from their shoulders, when your strike would kill any mortal thing, the Dao of Death imbued in the blade floods into the wound, negating the target's immortality and rendering them as mortal as any common man. Their name, long since removed from the Book of Life and Death in Diyu, is rewritten by the sword's power, and their death becomes absolute and final. 

No god can resurrect them, no magic can restore them, no cosmic power can return them from the void. Do note that the sword cannot kill abstract concepts or natural laws, for they have no names to write. But if a law takes form, if a god of gravity stands before you with flesh and name, you may slay that being permanently with a lethal strike. The law itself remains, but the entity bearing it is gone forever.
objects.title: Zhuxian Jian: The Immortal-Slaying Sword

addons.text:
It's not Finn, it's you. You are the sword, and not at the same time. Wielding yourself would effectively double your capabilities. You will still have Finn's physical abilities when wielding the sword. Previous limitations of the sword are still in place, meaning you still have to hold it to gain bonuses.

Because you are the sword, you will always know where it is, no matter what.
addons.title: You Sword

objects.text:
This sword is Finn who became a sword. This sword is extremely durable, but it has a weak point, which is the blue sphere at the hilt. When this sword is wielded, the wielder will find they have the physical capabilities of Finn on top of the wielders own.

To put this into perspective, he managed to lift a monster that was more than twice the size of an elephant and take hits from the said monster. While not an easy task, if the blue sphere is destroyed, then you will just have a really durable sword.

You can also communicate with Finn.
objects.title: Finn Sword (Adventure Time)

objects.text:
A beautifully twisted weapon pulled from the depths of a fractured mind. The Vorpal Blade is a compact, ornate kitchen knife with an impossibly keen edge, forged in the heart of Wonderland’s madness. Though small in size, its lethality is absolute. It never dulls, never breaks, and slices through flesh, thought, and dream alike with frightening ease.

In your hand, it becomes more than just a blade—it is an anchor of focus, clarity, and silent rage. With each strike, it cuts deeper than mere skin, disrupting magical constructs, illusions, and psychic barriers. The blade is unnaturally fast, perfectly balanced, and allows for devastatingly precise attacks that ignore most forms of defense.

Enemies struck by the Vorpal Blade suffer lingering trauma—memories stutter, thoughts shatter, and supernatural regeneration falters. In places of dream, chaos, or unreality, the blade becomes stronger, feeding off the instability of the world to deliver sharper, swifter blows.

When held by one with a fractured mind or a deep will to survive, the Vorpal Blade whispers—softly guiding, gently urging forward, always toward the next cut.
objects.title: Vorpal Blade (Alice: Madness Returns)

objects.text:
Ascalon was conceived by Azmuth in his pursuit to harness the fundamental forces of the universe, with the intent to "cleave right through" and reshape reality. The First Thinker succeeded in his ambitions, forging a weapon of immense, incomprehensible power. With each strike, Ascalon rends apart the fabric of space and time, bending the laws of existence to the wielder's desires, reshaping the world as they see fit.

As the chosen wielder of Ascalon, you are bestowed with its phenomenal cosmic power. Acknowledged as its sole master, Ascalon will bar others from wielding it. By invoking its essence, you can channel vast amounts of energy, empowering yourself and even reversing the weathering of age, restoring you to your prime while unlocking its extraordinary capabilities.

You can then, at will, summon an all-encompassing armor of your choosing, unrestricted by the appearance depicted in the series. However, this is purely aesthetic and provides no tangible improvements or drawbacks beyond the inherent properties the armor already provides.

Once summoned, the armor, in whatever form it may take, grants you the power to command and absorb energy, transforming it into a deadly weapon or an unyielding shield, depending on the situation. From your hands, you can unleash radiant waves or searing beams of pure energy, sweeping across the battlefield with devastating results, or conjure immense, shimmering domes to repel even the most brutal onslaughts. This mastery over energy affords you a graceful offense and an impenetrable defense, making you a force few can withstand.

The armor, on its own, provides with you incredible protection from threats, both physical and immaterial, while eliminating the original's susceptibility to electricity—be it from the ferocious onslaught of an Ultimate Vaxasaurian, searing blasts of pure mana, or even the effect of mind control, it stands unmoved. However, do not take this as invincibility—a sufficiently powerful attack may still overwhelm your defenses. Nevertheless, despite its might, the armor ultimately pales in comparison to the unmatched durability and offensive prowess of the blade itself.

Ascalon, the sword itself, holds all the powers and abilities of the armor, only amplified to astonishing levels. Its exceptional durability enables it to endure the cataclysmic destruction of an entire planet while its energy slashes eclipse the blasts unleashed from your armor. Yet, these abilities are merely just the beginning. Ascalon can slice through any material and even the fabric of reality, allowing you to create portals to any destination with a single, deft slash, rewrite, or reverse localized reality. When fully empowered, it can even alter or control fundamental aspects of the universe, including the annihilation of all evil.
objects.title: Ascalon/The Sword of Azmuth (Ben 10)

objects.text:
This is far too big to be called a sword. Massive, thick, heavy, and far too rough, it's more like a heap of raw iron.

You gain the enormous sword of the Black Swordsman, Guts. It is a one-of-a-kind piece that was forged by the blacksmith Godot, intending to create a sword truly strong enough to kill a dragon. What he made was unusable by a human being, or so he thought.

You also gain the strength and skill of the only man to ever successfully wield this blade, Guts. This includes the strength to fight Apostles on equal terms, speed that can't be seen by normal human eyes, and the skill to kill 100 knights in a single night. Part of this comes from the Brand of Sacrifice on Guts' neck, which places him in between this world and the next, allowing for mind to triumph over matter & for Guts to detect supernatural beings and events by feeling their effect on the brand. You gain these abilities without the curses that come along with it.

It is unbreakable and will never lose its edge. Thanks to being bathed in the blood of astral beings over and over again, It is able to harm not only physical beings, but supernatural and metaphysical ones, such as the God Hand.
objects.title: Dragonslayer (Berserk)

objects.text:
The Graviton Beam Emitter (GBE) takes the form of an ordinary handgun, distinguished by a cross-shaped energy indicator at the gun's rear.
 Upon activation, the GBE emits a broad, perfectly cylindrical red beam capable of obliterating almost anything in its trajectory. While it hints at gravity-manipulating technology, the intricacies of its functioning have been lost to time, rendering reverse engineering impossible.
 The GBE fires condensed unknown energy, with the beam emitted literally pushing away the atoms of whatever is in it's path; the pushed atoms crashing back together cause large explosions, creating additional damage than the initial gravity beam.
 It can be discharged in two modes: either by individually pulling the trigger for rapid shots or by holding the trigger longer to generate a charged shot with a larger, extended energy beam.
 - Level 1 requires almost no charge and can be fired rapidly. At this level, the range of the weapon is 70 km.
 - Level 2 requires several seconds of charge and is notably more powerful, creating massive holes in it's target. If you can fire the gun on level 1 with minimum recoil, you are knocked backwards from the force of the kickback.
 - Level 4, the weapon will actually open up. In this state the recoil is so powerful and instantaneous that it will actually tear off the limb holding it.
 Due to its substantial recoil, firing it beyond level 1 is ill-advised for regular humans, with a level 5 strongly discouraged even for an Endbringer.
(Tsutomu Nihei has stated that the effects of the weapon are so powerful that if it were to ever be fired at it's strongest from Earth's surface, it would have devastating effects on the climate and atmosphere of the planet itself.)
objects.title: Graviton Beam Emitter (Blame!)

addons.text:
The Hōgyoku, in its quest to break the boundaries between all things and further evolve you, has decided that you no longer need a Zanpakutō. Specifically, it has determined that you and your Zanpakutō are one and the same. Any spirit or designated being that was originally the core of your Zanpakutō has been fused with you, and any powers they had are now personally yours. Weaknesses or drawbacks they had will eventually fade away as the Hōgyoku continues its quest to bring you closer to becoming the perfect being.

You no longer need to call out Shikai or Bankai; you can simply activate these transformations with a thought.

You no longer need your Zanpakutō but can will it into existence as it is a part of you. Your Bankai, due to your new state of being and the influence of the Hōgyoku, can never be permanently destroyed.
addons.title: Breaking the Boundary

addons.text:
Your Asauchi, after merging with the ever-evolving Perfect Weapon, has gained a second form in addition to its original one—the ultimate Zanpakutō: Enrakyōten.

Similar to the ancestral Zanpakuto of the same name from the Tsunayashiro Clan, your new Zanpakutō possesses a unique Shikai that allows it to mimic the Shikai abilities of any Zanpakutō you have witnessed. However, unlike its namesake, yours, through its growing perfection, automatically knows the abilities of all known Zanpakutō. From the lesser powers of Haineko to the devastating flames of Ryūjin Jakka, every Shinigami’s Shikai can be mimicked. The strength of these abilities, however, depends not on their original wielder but on your own power meaning Ryūjin Jakka, for instance, could range from a mere flamethrower to something far greater than the original all depending on your own power.

Additionally, your Shikai grants the ability to use multiple Zanpakutō abilities simultaneously. Due to the unique nature of the Perfect Weapon, unlike the original, you don’t need to worry about your lifespan constantly reduced with each use.

Over time, Enrakyōten will naturally grow strong enough to unlock a Bankai, which will allow you to use the Bankai of all Zanpakutō you know.
addons.title: Enrakyōten

addons.text:
Your Inner Beast has become your Zanpakutō's spirit. This has granted it the ability to fully manifest whenever it wants, for as long as it wants, while still allowing you to use your Zanpakutō's releases. Because your Inner Beast is your spirit, it also possesses your Zanpakutō, allowing you both to either fight in tandem when it is manifested or to have it double the power or effectiveness of your Shikai or Bankai when within your inner world. This also means you immediately know your Shikai and Bankai.

You no longer need to speak a release command for either Shikai or Bankai and can simply enter each stage with a thought. Your Zanpakutō cannot be permanently destroyed and will rapidly restore itself to perfect condition if damaged in any way.
addons.title: Sword Beast

objects.text:
An Asauchi is a nameless Zanpakutō that initially appears to have no unique qualities beyond being a weapon. However, its true power lies in its ability to change and grow with its wielder. Once purchased, this blade will connect to your soul and begin to alter its shape and appearance to match you. It can transform from a katana to any other weapon or item that best suits you. The Asauchi will adopt aspects of your soul and powers, and it may even manifest a consciousness that either amalgamates your powers or houses a being that was already connected to you.

Alternatively, it might have no will of its own and function solely as a powerful weapon under your control. This transformation process can take anywhere from a week or be instant, depending on whether you have powers and your skill level with them. Unlike normal Asauchi, this modified one does not require Reiatsu to function and can run on any powers and any energy, including stamina.

Once it transforms, it becomes a proper Zanpakutō, connected to your soul and allowing your powers to flow through it. The Zanpakutō gains two additional transformations: Shikai and Bankai. These transformations can further enhance your powers, temporarily remove weaknesses, or add versatility. If your Asauchi is ever destroyed in its base form or Shikai, it can take up to a week to fully reform, although this process can be expedited with stamina or other available energy.

However, if it is destroyed in Bankai, your Bankai will either be lost or permanently damaged. Healing or regeneration powers that affect you, as well as skills in soul or blacksmithing, can potentially restore your Bankai to its former glory.
objects.title: Modified Asauchi (Bleach)

addons.text:
Your armory expands to include every weapon featured in Lies of P and its DLC. Alongside this, your workshop is now equipped with all the necessary tools to maintain, enhance, and modify these weapons to their fullest potential.

Your Manus Superior evolves as well, integrating the properties of all fully-upgraded Legion Arms, enabling you to wield the abilities of multiple arms simultaneously with seamless control. Furthermore, your body gains the ability to generate Ergo, providing a continuous power source to fuel the Fable Arts of your weapons. This self-sustaining Ergo generation also accelerates the growth and potency of the Manus Superior’s reality-altering abilities, pushing the limits of what it can achieve.
addons.title: Armory of P (Lies of P)

objects.text: Left to you by hunters of old, an armory of every trick weapon and Hunters tool, including those taken from enemy and ally factions in history including even legendary weapons like the Holy Moonlight Greatsword, the mighty Burial Blade, and even the swift and elegant Rakuyo. The armory also comes with Hunters Tools like the Old Hunters Bone, Executioner's Blade, Empty Phantasm Shell, A Call Beyond, etc. Finally the Armory comes with its most powerful item sets, a horde of bloodgems and bloodshards of every variety and every known Caryll Rune. To make sure whomever has this armory can make the most use of it, the armory also comes with a portable workshop filled with every tool needed to repair weapons, add bloodgems, give yourself rune enhancements, etc.
objects.title: Trick Armoury (Bloodborne)

objects.text:
Alucard's trusted blade, a magical estoc that served him faithfully throughout his journeys, now rests in your grasp. No mere weapon, it is an extension of your will—bound to you by mind and spirit, answering your thoughts with fluid precision as you control it telekinetically. Like a vigilant sentinel, it hovers at your side, its eerie sentience ever watchful. Capable of acting on its own to defend you—be it by parrying strikes, intercepting attacks, or striking down foes should it sense danger.

Due to being forged through the alchemical marriage of science and sorcery, this blade is as unyielding as it is timeless, nigh-indestructible in its make. Its edge and point remain forever keen, unstained by age or battle, able to pierce the flesh of powerful night creatures and even a weakened Dracula as though they were never there.

Even against the mightiest of foes, the sword endures, as it has withstood the wrath of beings beyond mortal reckoning—Dracula himself among them—and emerged unscathed, as immaculate as the day it was forged.

Beyond steel and sorcery, it is also a conduit for power itself—as supernatural energies of any kind flow through it unimpeded, amplifying both blade and bearer alike.
objects.title: Heirloom Sword Familiar (Castlevania)

objects.text:
The Vampire Killer is a legendary whip passed down through generations of the Belmont clan.

This whip is both a holy and vampiric weapon of the highest caliber, capable of dealing tremendous holy damage to any monster. When the tip of the whip touches a monster, it causes an explosion of holy fire at the point of impact. It can significantly diminish if not outright negate, any monster's ability to resurrect or regenerate. Additionally, it can nullify and reflect magic and projectiles with a mere touch.

However, beware: those not of Belmont blood cannot easily use the weapon, as it will drain the life force of anyone who tries to wield it without being a direct descendant of the Belmont clan.

This obstacle can be overcome by undergoing a trial. Within the whip resides the power of all who have used it before, and by defeating these vestiges of past wielders, one not only unlocks the right to use the whip and its full potential but also gains the collective skill and knowledge of all its past wielders.
objects.title: Vampire Killer (Castlevania)

objects.text:
You have managed to bind the Service Weapon to yourself, regardless of how worthy the Board may consider you to be. This unique weapon is an Object of Power, an item shaped by the collective unconscious to possess paranatural features.

The Service Weapon, in particular, is a shapeshifting tool that can alter into a variety of different forms beyond its standard 'Grip' pistol-like design. These include the shotgun-esque 'Shatter,' the high-fire-rate 'Spin,' the immensely powerful charged single-shot 'Pierce,' capable of tearing through walls to eliminate enemies, the explosive three-shot 'Charge,' and the sticky grenade-launching 'Surge,' among others.

However, its current appearance is heavily influenced by the collective unconscious. In other words, this weapon may even adopt forms distinct from its seemingly iconic pistol-like design. Despite these variations, the Service Weapon will have a commonality of always embodying a suitable personal weapon (or whatever is considered one in that world). For instance, it could take the form of a mighty sword as powerful as the myth of Excalibur, a hammer delivering devastating blows like Mjolnir, or something far stranger.

Additionally, you may choose to bind with the weapon known as the Aberrant, which serves a similar purpose to the Service Weapon, but tends more towards a melee focus. It takes the form of a vibrating, glitching rod, which can split and morph in various ways, pulling additional segments out of nowhere to take on melee-based forms and falling apart when not needed. Forms include Cleave (an axe), Strike (a pair of short swords), Glaive (a long sickle), Crush (a hammer), Pierce (a long drill-spear) and Extend (a long, segmented whip).
objects.title: The Service Weapon (Control)

objects.text: You have a sword known as Nightblood. It comes with an aluminium sheath. Nightblood is imbued with the command of "Destroy Evil", and will take all it can to that effect. Evil people feel a strong desire to wield the sword, at which point they are overtaken by the swords command and go on a killing spree where they kill everything evil in sight and then themselves. Good people will feel an aversion to the sword, but they will not be overtaken if they wield the sword. The sword will consume your lifeforce when picked up, or any magical source if you have any available. Everything the blade touches will turn into a dark inky smoke as it is destroyed. It is powerful enough to kill the Vessel of a Shard of Adonalsium, but it did not destroy the Shard itself.
objects.title: Nightblood (Cosmere)

objects.text:
A single arrowhead, formed of an unidentifiable black substance. It was created by a man many would view as a god of death, an attempt to repent for the guilt he felt at causing so much destruction.

The arrowhead, when held by a sapient creature, can be commanded to kill one being whose name is uttered aloud, with conscious intent for it to be carried out. The arrowhead will then seek out the targeted being, crossing the universe in an instant to reach them, and will bury itself in them. The target's existence will be cleanly, precisely and utterly severed from the Way, the great chain of causality and fate that governs all of reality, causing instant death. This death is inescapable, and not even those who hold immortality are exempt from it, their lives extinguished utterly. Not even gods are exempt from this. Any consequences of their death, such as a curse, or a plague to be unleashed, or a broken seal, will fail to trigger, as their existence is no longer recognized by the universe at large. A god whose existence carries a fundamental part of reality as part of their being will not cause the collapse of reality upon death, their concept continuing to exist without them.

Upon being used, the arrowhead will be expended, only returning after 4 weeks, whereupon you may summon it to you.

Note: A target using Eternal Flame will still be killed, however their power is such that they may return from death eventually. A death inflicted by Penance will take roughly three times as long to recover from as an Eternal Flame user might normally take to come back.
objects.title: Penance (Cradle)

addons.text: By being a child of the moon and a user of the Moonlight Greatsword, the weapon synchronizes with you, thus increasing its efficiency even higher. Not only is it now stronger, but it has also inherited from you the ability to get different powers through the phases of the moon, thus augmenting its repertoire of possible uses. From becoming nearly invisible in a new moon to having it frostbite reach a whole new level in a crescent moon, to creating moonlight that reveals what is hidden in a full moon.
addons.title: Our Guiding Moonlight

objects.text:
You have obtained one of the most recognizable weapons in the Souls franchise. The Moonlight Greatsword. This weapon is of immense quality and can act as a catalyst for most magic, and any magic used with it will have its efficiency augmented. By feeding it mana, or stamina should you have no mana left, you can shoot a beam of magic that can level buildings (provided you supply enough energy). The sword can also inflict frostbite by choice of its user.

(The appearance of Moonlight can be chosen by the user when buying.)
objects.title: Moonlight Greatsword (Dark Souls)

objects.text:
"Chaoseater… the angry blade thirsts for destruction" - The Charred Council
Once the signature weapon of the Horseman of War, now its prodigious weight rests in your hands. Chaoseater is an ornate greatsword of truly massive size, measuring over 8 feet of deadly sharp blade. As the mayhem of battle rises Chaoseater will empower you to greater and greater heights, providing limitless stamina, enhancing your regeneration the more foes you face, and healing you when you inflict wounds on others. However, the defining ability that Chaoseater possesses is its hunger for souls. As you slay powerful enemies Chaoseater will permanently grow, becoming deadlier and gaining new abilities based on what you kill.
objects.title: Chaoseater (Darksiders)

addons.text:
"Make me something pretty and toxic. Like me. How about something with... gold?"

Along with Captain Cold's Cold Gun and Heatwave's Heat Gun, you now have in your hands a weapon that even Snart's sister would kill for.

Introducing the Gold Gun, a technological masterpiece that uses advanced nanotechnology and molecular manipulation to instantly turn any target into solid 24-karat gold.

Unlike other weapons that alter temperature, this gun doesn't mess with heat; instead, it reorganizes the atomic structure of the target (whether it's an inanimate object or a living being), transforming it into a pure gold statue in seconds and permanently halting any biological or mechanical processes.
addons.title: Fire, Ice and... Gold?

objects.text:
"A lot of guys shoot ice, but I don't freeze things. I eliminate movement altogether. I stop atoms cold."

You gain Captain Cold's Cold Gun, a sophisticated cyclotron-based cannon capable of emitting bursts of cold that reach absolute zero (-273.15°C), reducing the atoms of anything it strikes to a state of absolute stillness and bringing the thermal motion of its molecules to a complete halt.

By releasing this extreme cold, the moisture suspended in the air instantly freezes, transforming into ice and frost, allowing you to shape the environment at will: from creating surfaces so slippery that they hinder any movement to causing razor-sharp ice stalagmites to erupt from the ground, and even encasing people in blocks of ice and keeping them in a state of suspended animation.

This version of the Cold Gun incorporates all the improvements and modifications that Captain Cold has developed over the years, including an automatic voice-activation function that fires the freezing ray when the password “Jingle bells, Batman smells” is spoken—which you can change to whatever you prefer—as well as the ability to adjust the weapon to fire a sphere of blue energy that, upon reaching its intended target, detonates and expands into an immense Cold Field.

Within this Cold Field, any person or object experiences a drastic reduction in speed as a result of the weapon's effect on molecular motion, allowing you to bring projectiles such as bullets to a complete stop in midair and even reduce speedsters on the level of the Flash to speeds comparable to those of an ordinary person.

Note: You also receive Captain Cold's Snow Goggles, designed to diminish the blinding flashes of energy produced by the weapon within your field of vision, as well as a coat/parka with advanced thermal insulation, specifically designed to protect you from the extreme temperatures generated by the Cold Gun.
objects.title: Captain Cold's Cold Gun (DC Comics)

objects.text:
"The friction the Flash hits when he's moving twenty times the speed of sound can't even warm up his crimson cowl. But my fire can melt the Flash's boots. You think about that if you still can."

You gain Heatwave's Heat Gun, a high-tech handheld flamethrower capable of generating and firing flames so intense that they reach absolute heat, temperatures so high that there's no way any target (including its atoms) can remain intact.

This gun doesn’t just shoot flames capable of melting metals, destroying structures, or reducing any unfortunate target to ash; it is also capable of dramatically increasing the ambient temperature in its surrounding area, creating an extreme heat wave that can cause severe burns to nearby living beings, even at relatively safe distances.

This version of the Heat Gun includes all the upgrades and modifications Heatwave has implemented over the years, such as a temperature adjustment system that allows you to alternate between small personalized bursts of flame or full-blown firestorms that can incinerate multiple targets at once.

Note: You also receive Heatwave's Fireproof Suit, a high-tech outfit that protects you from the extreme heat generated by the gun, as well as his Infrared Goggles, which can fire infrared lasers capable of producing a heat so intense that even Flash's aura can't protect him.
objects.title: Heatwave's Heat Gun (DC Comics)

objects.text:
The Trident of Poseidon is a powerful magical weapon originally wielded by the sea god Poseidon and later passed down to Aquaman. The trident is nearly unbreakable and grants its wielder control over the ocean, allowing them to manipulate and summon water for various purposes, such as creating water elementals or forming water-based constructs. Additionally, it can manipulate ice and control the weather, enabling the summoning of lightning and the creation of powerful storms, and can even create earthquakes.

The Trident of Poseidon also grants the ability to teleport anywhere with water while underwater and enables the wielder to fly. This trident’s power is also enough to allow you to potentially contest with incredibly powerful beings, having once been used to injure even Rao, the Kryptonian god.
objects.title: Trident of Poseidon (DC Comics)

objects.text:
With this you gain the legendary sword from the bible, the “Flaming Sword” used to guard the Garden of Eden. This powerful divine weapon, forged by God, is considered to be one of the most powerful weapons in creation. Thus God broke it into three pieces to keep it out of Lucifer’s hands – until you reunited the parts. The Blade of Death, The Medallion of Life, & The Key to bind them together.

The Blade of Death, known to be possessed by the Angel Azrael, is the primary component of the Sword. It retains the Flaming Sword’s power of eradication, when used to kill someone, it eradicates their soul from existence. The blade is supernaturally sharp, capable of cutting through metal and stone with ease.

The Medallion of Life serves as the hilt of the Flaming Sword. On it’s own it possesses powerful healing abilities, able to heal all injuries at a touch. It also grants immunity to all diseases, toxins and poisons. Last is the ability to call upon the Knowledge and Memories of God, at the time of this artifact’s creation. 

Lastly is The Key, serving as the lynchpin to bind the other pieces together. As it is the strength that binds the Flaming Sword together, it lends it’s user Supernatural strength and endurance.

United they form the Flaming Sword, while keeping all of the original abilities, it gains new one’s. Least of which is the ability to reshape it’s form to one that suits the users needs. A user wielding it can find the blade extending in Celestial Fire, and it’s most powerful ability is gained, the power of absolute sharpness, capable of slicing through all things, even opening gateways between dimensions.

You are able to unite and separate the three relics here at will, and suffer no ill effects from utilizing them.
objects.title: The Flaming Sword (DC Comics: Lucifer)

objects.text:
Devil Arms are demonic, sometimes sentient weapons that are commonly the manifestation of a defeated Demon's soul or power.

You get to choose any devil arm that appeared in the game series except for Yamato, Rebellion and Devilsword Dante.
objects.title: Devil Arm (Devil May Cry)

objects.text:
Ebony & Ivory are heavily modified M1911-style handguns, originally crafted by Nell Goldstein and famously wielded by Dante. Now, these legendary firearms are in your hands.

The left-handed gun, Ebony, is designed for long-distance targeting, while still offering excellent stability and comfort. Meanwhile, the right-handed gun, Ivory, is optimized for rapid fire and quick draw, making it perfect for high-speed combat scenarios.

Thanks to their unique construction and prolonged exposure to demonic energy, Ebony & Ivory require no ammunition. They can fire endlessly, their bullets imbued with residual demonic power from Dante. This energy allows the guns to unleash a barrage of fire akin to a machine gun, penetrate metal with ease, and even propel you into the air by firing downward.

If you possess your own supernatural energy, you can channel it into these weapons, transforming and amplifying both their performance and the nature of their ammunition to align with your power.

Additionally, should you undergo a transformation or some other temporary increase in power, Ebony & Ivory will transform alongside you. Their power will scale with your own for as long as it lasts.

You have to option to change the engraving on the guns from Tony Redgrave to either your name or whatever you want.
objects.title: Ebony & Ivory (Devil May Cry)

objects.text:
The Rebellion came into existence alongside the legendary Sparda and Yamato when Sparda, in a moment of great power, divided himself into three parts. This extraordinary sword embodies the essence of "retaliation" and holds within it a fraction of Sparda's immense power, waiting for you to unleash its potential. 

But the Rebellion is more than just a weapon of vengeance. It possesses a unique ability to unite, and merge anything, such as uniting a persons mortal and demonic side, combining opposing forces with perfect harmony.

In your hands, this power is under your complete control. You possess the rare gift to unite and merge without sacrificing the sword or resorting to impaling others. And what sets your Rebellion apart from its predecessor is its indomitable nature—it is impervious to destruction, an eternal symbol of strength and defiance.
objects.title: Rebellion (Devil May Cry)

objects.text:
Yamato, the sword of separation, wielded by the Legendary Dark Knight Sparda and his son Vergil. It is able to cut through anything, even concepts.

Sparda used it to separate the human and demon realm, and his son Vergil used it to separate his fears and his human half from himself, manifesting as their own beings, his human half V, his demon half Urizen and his fears as Nightmares.

Also, Yamato is often used to cut through space, creating portals to another place or even realm.
objects.title: Yamato (Devil May Cry)

objects.text:
You have acquired the arsenal of the Dante of an alternate timeline, including his version of Rebellion. While a potent weapon on its own, its true power comes from its ability to shapeshift into angelic and demonic weapon forms. 

These forms include a scythe called Osiris, a set of chakrams called Aquila, a slow but powerful axe called Arbiter, a pair of gauntlets called Eryx, and a grappling hook called Ophion. Shifting weapon forms is seamless, allowing you to easily put together stylish combos. 

As a bonus, you also gain access to the guns present in the DMC reboot at their maximum power. You know how to use all of these weapons to the best of their capabilities, but you will need physicality akin to a son of Sparda to fully put this knowledge into action.
objects.title: Nephilim’s Arsenal (Devil May Cry)

objects.text:
With a whistle on the wind you find yourself with a pair of sickles, at first glance they seem quite normal with a few features such as extending shafts that combine together and blades able to lock into place at different angles allowing you to use them like sickles, blade knuckles and double headed scythes.

However; there is a power within. A sense of finality. For these are Death's Tool. Not metaphorically, or poetically, or some fancy title or name given by a couple of no names and those forgotten in a few generations. These tools belong to Death.

As such these sickles possess a power that makes quite formidable, able to bypass exoteric protections such as fate that would prevent these blades from claiming their prey, multiple forms of immortality and even able to neutralize special forms of healing such as magic leaving a target with only normal healing to work with. Not even hiding will do them any good as these tools can track targets but only one at a time. On the bright side for them these wounds will not be infected as the lingering powers of death leaves the wounds clean of plague and pests.

However; there is another more frightful power to these tools. The closer a target has been to death and how assured in their own invincibility the more powerful these tools and you become. With sickle in hand you can make even the mightiest of heroes turn tail and run, almost as if Death itself was hunting them.

While the boost is centred around how close the target has been to death it does gain minor boosts based on the target, how confident in their own invincibility, their fear for their mortality and how their being and actions pervert the natural course of things.

In the garden of life you are the gardener, ready to prune the trees and cut the excess to ensure a healthy garden. Although there is another in the garden who tends to whistle, nothing to worry about as it's merely an old friend.​
objects.title: Death's Sickles (Dreamworks)

objects.text:
This weapon, known as the BFG9000 to many and the Big Fucking Gun to others, is one of the most powerful man-made weapons in existence, and can atomize just about anything in its path. Using a unique ammo known as Argent Energy that will thankfully refill itself once a week (60 Units per week in an unsuspecting crate). 

In fact, you can even charge it up at the cost of using up the 2 shots to make sure even less can survive it, but at the risk of heavily damaging or killing yourself. The weapon itself also weighs a decent amount, requiring good upper-body strength to use.

Its power is so great that it can heavily damage a being that could destroy the world on its own power.
objects.title: BFG9000 (DOOM)

objects.text: In the face of insurmountable demonic forces, there exists a weapon that transcends the boundaries of power. Its very presence strikes fear into the hearts of demons, as even the mighty Titans crumble before its unstoppable might. Behold the Crucible, a weapon of unparalleled potency. With its razor-sharp edge, it effortlessly cleaves through the flesh of Barons of Hell and other formidable adversaries, defying all resistance. A mighty conduit which draws upon the unholy energies of Hell itself. It becomes an eternal instrument of destruction. As the chosen wielder, you may imbue your other weapon with the essence of the Crucible, allowing all your weapons to relentlessly devastate the legions of Hell!
objects.title: The Crucible (DOOM)

addons.text:
Fidget's projectiles become enhanced in combination with the Dust Storm, to the point of scorching, electrocuting and/or blinding an entire room of enemies on top of you reducing them to less than mincemeat within seconds. 

You're not limited to simply spamming the Dust Storm to cause this effect--which you can do indefinitely now--as you will naturally develop combos and other techniques unique to you. Fidget can also grow stronger through various means other than simple projectiles. 

Ahrah by extension, will also assist you in reaching your full potential with all the grace of a great old sage. Making the three of you an immaculate trio.
addons.title: Dust to Dust

objects.text: "Justice must be tempered with mercy. Otherwise, it's nothing more than revenge." A voice beckons you this ancient blade, claiming you as it's fated sword-bearer. It takes the persona of a sage that guides you to whatever purpose to wish to fulfill. Although, he seems to know more than he lets on. The moment you touch this blade, you're imbued with all of the skills and expertise to wield it at full power. Immediately matching the capabilites showcased by Dust himself throughout his adventure. From the Parry to stun enemies, all the way to the various combos that let you hack n slash them with ease. Finally, you gain it's signature technique; The Dust Storm. Where you either spin the blade at immense speeds within your hand to create a mini-whirlwind that pulls or scatters enemies and other objects within, or makes you spiral through the air like a vortex of death. Maintaining them for too long can backfire on you.
objects.title: Blade of Ahrah (Dust: An Elysian Tail)

objects.text: The Black Blade is the Rune of Death, also known as Destined Death, turned into the form of a blade. It is the concept of Death in physical form. It holds powerful death magic, and can be used to kill things that normally cannot die, such as gods.
objects.title: The Black Blade (Elden Ring)

objects.text: Described as a 'sword wrought from the remains of a god who should have lived a life eternal', tis the weapon used by the mighty Elden Beast, brought into the Tarnished's hands as they repair the Elden Ring. And now, it is yours to wield. Brought to its fullest potential from when the Tarnished faced off against their final obstacle, the sword can coat itself in a glowing holy aura to be used to fell the foul undead and foolish warriors that stand in its way. However, its true strength in its Waves of Gold, a wide range arc of golden light that reach far and wide, annihilating the hordes of enemies that dare to stand in your path, especially undying creatures as the power of the Greater Will descends upon them. You have the culmination of the struggle and work of Tarnished everywhere. Go forth, and prove their work was not in vain!
objects.title: Sacred Relic Sword  (Elden Ring)

objects.text:
The Sword of Aeons and Tears of Avo are virtually identical weapons, with the only real difference being appearance. You can choose which weapon you want.

With this sword in hand, you are capable of reshaping the world with ease, attempting to do so with focus and precision though, is tiring, and gruesome work. If you just focus it on an area of a small nation, then you can virtually change it to anything possible. Create mountains of gold, destroy a valley, or raise statues in your image. 

The weapons are unnaturally sharp, will never dull, make you much more hardy, recover from wounds that would kill an ordinary man, regenerate your mana(if you have any) much faster, and offer you bits of wisdom that come from William's life for as long as you possess the sword. Even if you don't have any mana, the sword of Aeons will simply use William's mana as an alternative to achieve your desires, and for Tear's of Avo, the usage of multiple heroes is the equivalent to William.

You can also sell your soul to either weapon, becoming able to change the world to your liking. Of course, it does come with the obvious drawback of not owning your soul anymore. If this happens, they make sure you don't lose the weapon, as you will slowly appear to look like a corpse (And actually become one) until you retrieve your weapon.
objects.title: Sword of Aeons / Tears of Avo (Fable - The Lost Chapters)

objects.text:
The wasteland of Fallout holds many great weapons, from the relatively mundane and realistic to the absolutely insane, with various futuristic weapons and others influenced by the general insanity of the wasteland's craziest and/or brightest minds. Such weapons include various forms of melee weaponry, which include general military weapons, ones based on various futuristic technology, and ones made from the remains of the wastelands' strongest creatures. Countless ranged weapons, which include ballistic weapons, energy weapons based on firing highly powerful lasers or superheated plasma energy, to heavy weapons able to wreak havoc on anything you aim at using a hailstorm of bullets, lasers, plasma, or straight-up miniature nuclear missiles.

Each time you purchase this, you may select a more powerful weapon from the described examples as follows:

First purchase will allow you to select any non-heavy unnamed/generic non-legendary normal weapon from any Fallout game.

Second purchase allows you to instead select a single, uniquely named, or nonstandard weapon, or ones that require quests or unlocking from any Fallout Game. These weapons serve as a stronger variation of general items, featuring enhanced attributes and possibly unique, non-standard abilities, as well as distinctive designs that set them apart as something exceptional.

Third purchase allows you to add Legendary Attributes to your weapon from Fallout 4 or Fallout 76. You may select any not three, but FIVE lines of appropriate effects to add onto your weapon.

You will also gain a single copy of any additional weapon attachments and modifications to be swapped between with some small work. Also, any weapon you purchase will come with a large amount of ammo for it and the equipment to craft more, as well as any equipment needed to care for and repair the weapon with effort.
objects.title: Wasteland Arms (Fallout)

objects.text:
Derflinger is an ancient sentient spirit sword who was created over 6000 years ago. In his current form he is an exceptionally powerful magic sword per his worlds standards. Derflinger also acts as an insanely knowledgable mentor in martial arts and magical knowledge. 

He has the ability to nullify and absorb hostile spells aimed at his wielder but poses difficulty versus overwhelmingly powerful spells, still being able to blunt them to an extent.
Through this ability and his own nature he can store a massive amount of mana which can be utilized in different ways. Derflinger can use this mana pool to empower his welders physical ability and control them should they go unconscious, or use it as a teaching aid. Additionally Derflinger can fire concentrated blasts of mana using this pool. Be warned using these ability at full power will quickly drain the stored mana.
Lastly this mana pool can be used by his wielder to cast spells. 

Derflinger can move himself into other swords should his vessel be broken or he finds a better sword to inhabit. This can massively improve the sword and Derflinger himself based on the quality and power of the sword he inhabits. He can possess objects other than swords in a pinch.
objects.title: Derflinger (Familiar of Zero)

addons.text: You now know how to create materia, crystalline orbs that can benefit you in a plethora of ways, to enhance your attributes, allowing you to cast spells, and even summoning gods. The sword itself only come with two slots, but you know how to create slots in other objects to fit any materia.
addons.title: Materia

objects.text: As big as a person, the Buster Sword is a powerful blade. Fitting for a 1st Class Soldier, it is perfectly balanced, can cut through monsters with ease, and never lose its edge. The sword is also a powerful magic channeler, allowing you to input magic through it to either enhance your blows or to extend your attacks. That said, it weighs close to a hundred pounds, and it doesn't grant you any magical potential or the strength to wield it.
objects.title: Buster Sword (Final Fantasy)

objects.text:
The Divine Blade Falchion, also known as the Blade of Light, is a divine weapon forged by the Divine Dragon, Naga, for mankind's protection against rogue dragons. As it was forged from one of her very own fangs, only those with her blood are able to wield it properly; those without her blessings will find it no more effective than a pretty paperweight.

The divinity coursing through the blade will see it maintain its edge for thousands of years before its blessing even need to be considered for renewal. Keeping the blade on your person fills you with the power to slay dragons: damage you inflict on dragons is tripled. Focusing your might into a powerful attack will see you always being capable of fully slaying a dragon, no matter how powerful they once were.

During combat, you may call upon the blessings of the blade to recover from non-grievious wounds. Outside of combat and with a degree of focus, calling upon Naga's blessings can grant you a full recovery from anything short of death itself.

If you were a Divine Dragon yourself, Falchion would instead be made from your own fang and you can choose how it looks. Its blessings would come from you, meaning anyone who has your blood would be able to wield it and use it at full power, and you would be able to renew the blessings yourself should they ever begin to falter.
objects.title: Falchion (Fire Emblem)

objects.text:
You've gained access to either a set of canonical Heroes' Relics or Sacred Weapons connected to a specific Crest. Heroes' Relics are made from the bodies of slaughtered Nabateans and are indestructible while possessing great magical powers, such as releasing blasts of lightning, passively reducing damage taken, or dealing increased damage against monsters or flying enemies. However, anyone who attempts to use one without the proper Crest will never be able to wield it at full power and will eventually transform into a Demonic Beast.

Sacred Weapons were created by two of the Four Saints, Macuil and Indech. These are similar to Heroes' Relics but can safely be used by anyone. However, they will only reveal their full power to someone with the right Crest. All Sacred Weapons heal their wielder over time, with the amount varying depending on whether the wielder possesses the correct Crest and whether it is a major or minor one.

To complement this, you will gain the appropriate Major Crest of any set of weapons you choose and the physiology and potential of someone from Fodlan. Crests, in turn, grant abilities such as longevity, increased strength, enhanced magical skill, or even healing a small amount of health every time you deal damage. Some Crests, like the Crest of the Beast, can be considered a curse, drastically overusing this Crest and it's relic Blutgang while indulging too much in your bloodlust can potentially turn you into a Demon Beast.

You will receive all the associated weapons for whatever Crest you have. For example, the Crest of Seiros will grant you the Sword and Shield of Seiros, Aymr, and Labraunda. You cannot choose the Crest of Flames. Crests are hereditary.
objects.title: Heroes' Relics/Sacred Weapons (Fire Emblem)

addons.text:
With the Crest Stone of Flames, the Crest of Flames, and the Sword of the Creator reunited, the sword’s full power has been brought out as the Sublime Creator Sword. With a proficient wielder, this sword is single-handedly capable of razing entire armies, destroying mountains, and defeating even the strongest of foes in its time. You have truly become the equal to both Byleth Eisner, the Ashen Demon, and the Bandit King Nemesis, the King of Liberation.

Furthermore, due to being in close proximity to other parts of herself, Sothis’ progression in her rise back to full divinity has been expedited. Now she is able to use all of her power, but it will tire her out for a bit, and even you to an extent. As a small bonus, in exchange for losing access to the Sublime Creator Sword for an indefinite amount of time, you may give Sothis a physical body to interact in the physical world. You will still be able to communicate with each other telepathically, but she will not be in the mental realm. If you chose to not have Sothis, this just means that you do not have to wait 2 years to have Sothis’ full power at your disposal.

Optionally, you may also receive the Dark Creator Sword. Black in color, it is a replica of the Sword of the Creator made by the masterminds behind the Nabatean Genocide, using the Timotheos and Noa Crest Stones for power. Because the Crest of Flames is the Crest of the Progenitor Goddess, you will be able to wield the Dark Creator Sword at its full power, which is slightly below that of the Sublime Creator Sword.
addons.title: God Shattering Star

objects.text: You have come into possession of the Sword of the Creator, the most sacred of all the Heroes Relics in Fódlan’s history. While many do not know the origins of the Relics, they are assumed to be artifacts handed down by the Progenitor Goddess Sothis unto humanity. In reality, the Relics were powerful weapons crafted from the bones of the Nabateans, Sothis’ children. In the case of the Sword of the Creator, it was made using the bones of Sothis herself, and thus is the most powerful of them all. Each Relic is powered by a Crest Stone, an orb made of a Nabatean’s heart, that empowers the Relic immensely. Each Relic is attuned to a certain Crest Stone, but The Sword of the Creator is special, in the sense that it does not come with the Crest Stone implanted inside it, like other Relics do. To complement your possession of the Sword, you have been given the proficiency to wield the Sword effectively, as well as an overall enhancement to your abilities to match peak human standards. This means that while you are able to wield the Sword of the Creator, you do not have the Crest Stone, and as such you will not be able to wield it at its full power. Additionally, by focusing your energy into the Sword of the Creator, you may use it to create a small 10-foot-tall portal to a location you have previously visited within a month’s worth of time. You can only have 1 portal open at a time, requiring you to close the first before a second portal can be made. To clarify, the Sword of the Creator is a whip-sword, meaning that not only can it function as a normal sword, but it can also extend itself into a whip-like mode, where segments of the blade separate and extend to a maximum reach of around 4-5 meters.
objects.title: Sword of the Creator (Fire Emblem)

objects.text: A faceless messenger with a large box approaches you. Reaching into the box, they pull out a sword. It's very rusty, the words 'Leather Shield’ hastily engraved into the base of the blade. You can distinctly see parts of it aggressively flickering in and out of existence, yet somehow keeping itself together. You get the distinct feeling that this thing is not meant to exist. After placing it into your hands, the messenger walks away without a word and vanishes from your sight. You have been gifted an impossibility. The power of an Agarthan Viskam, contained in the form of a sword. While it can be used as a regular blade (and is exceptionally durable despite its appearance, nigh-unbreakable in fact), it is in reality a long-range magical ballista in the guise of a sword. Using this, you can wreak havoc on enemies up to 90 meters away from you. By investing some of your magical energy into the 'sword’ and pointing it upwards, you can unleash a blast of blue lightning that homes in on your intended target. This blade deals more damage based on your overall magical strength, with higher magical strength equating to more damage, and having little to none equating to dealing as much damage as a rusted sword possibly could. As this weapon's damage is purely magical in nature, defenses meant for physical damage, such as shields and other mundane protections, are often ignored by the Viskam's attacks. If you do not have magical energy, this is just a rusty sword. An exceptionally durable one, but a rusty sword nonetheless.
objects.title: Viskam...? (Fire Emblem)

objects.text:
Musou Isshin, a legendary sword created by the divine power of Raiden Makoto, the original Electro Archon Inazuma, and later wielded by the subsequent Electro Archon Raiden Ei, Makoto's sister. This allows the sword to bear the imprint of their will, passing on part of it to the current owner.

The sword is connected to the Plane of Euthymia, which reflects the owner's mind and inner world. At the owner can enter this plane, summon someone else, or forbid someone from being there. But in addition to this, the owner of the sword can discard the physical form and hide their spirit in this plane, retaining the ability to observe external reality through the sword, while avoiding the harmful influence on their spirit.

The sword is stored inside the heart and is capable of summoning when needed, being removed from the middle of the chest.

The sword allows the wielder to perform an extremely powerful legendary sword technique - Musou no Hitotachi, which was wielded by Raiden Ei and the Shogun. The technique allows one to teleport, briefly stop time and mark a target, which will be surrounded by lightning and when the flow of time begins, they will strike the target with a beam of lightning, completely destroying it. This technique is strong enough to cut through mountains and islands, as well as kill gods and similar creatures. This attack is quite difficult to block.
objects.title: Musou Isshin (Genshin Impact)

objects.text: The Blades of Chaos were forged at the darkest depths of the Underworld by Ares himself. They were imbued with primordial fire, which allowed them to ignite with every attack that the user performed. The Blades' chains would stretch out for a set distance with each attack, allowing for fluid movement no matter who wielded them. The chains of the blades were permanently seared onto the forearms of the wielder, which served as a reminder of their oath to the God of War, and could only be removed either by the God of War himself or when the wielder's time of servitude ended.
objects.title: Blades of Chaos (God of War)

addons.text:
Opposites Combined into nine spears, Draupnir is the antithesis to Odin's spear, Gungnir, Draupnir heavily relies on the conventional physical implementation of a spear as a physical weapon while Gungnir focuses on the utilization of magic. With Rhongomyniad allowing them to combine into a weapon of nearly limitless potential.

Now Floating above you lay nine spears, One for each realm with traits that apply to them, each capable of being thrown, striking the opponent's heart, detonating with immense force, and then instantaneously returning to you with but a thought, causing untold devastation upon your foes.

Calling Out its true name, Spears of Heavens Ends, Causes all nine spears to obliterate a single target, This EX rated Noble Phantasm Cannot be avoided, blocked, or otherwise stopped from reaching its target. But will disable the spears for a time after usage.

"May it be wielded with wisdom."
addons.title: Spears of Heavens Ends

addons.text:
"Zeus! Your son has returned. I bring the destruction of Olympus"
Two Pantheons Have been broken, and Gods, Titans, Monsters, and Beasts, All lay in ruin before you, The Primordial Flame combines with the echoing screams of frost trolls and The sound of the wind itself, Creating a weapon of utter ruination, capable of bending the elements of the world into a devastating attack, or perhaps it would have, but the truth of this weapon is its nature, not its form.

Instead, the fusion has created the perfect defensive ability, Ragnarøkkr, A shield that alters cause and effect to protect whatever the user loves, Blessing them with invulnerability to all threats, physical or magical, Physical or magical. A representation of the trials and tribulations its first user went through.

"May it be put down when its job is done." - Brok Of The Huldra Brothers, Blessing Draupnir
addons.title: Ragnarøkkr Come.

objects.text:
A spear forged from Draupnir, a ring that originally had the power to multiply itself every ninth night. But it was later reforged by the Lady of the Forge using it, the blood of the God of War Kratos, and the sound of wind and blessed by the dwarf Brokk, to the form it has now.

It still appears as a ring, but it has new abilities. Through Draupnir's original ability, you can continuously summon more spears with a thought, allowing you to either throw them at targets without losing your weapon or to throw one spear in the air and cause multiple to come down with it. Because of its attunement to wind, it has the ability to summon gusts of wind with swings, create miniature tornadoes to throw enemies around, suck targets toward you, and even pull in nearby elemental energies to temporarily imbue your spear with that element.

The final ability of your spear is that by slamming the butt of one spear into the ground, you can cause all its duplicates to explode, dealing damage to anyone currently impaled by one.
objects.title: Draupnir Spear (God Of War)

objects.text:
The Spear of Heaven, the mighty weapon <s>and walking stick</s> used by the leader of the Norse Gods and King of Asgard, Odin. Utilized both as a wand and as a spear, this artifact has been by Odin’s side, bound to his very soul, for as long as any mortal can remember. Because of this, some of the Allfather’s divinity has rubbed off on the staff and now that the man himself is dead, Gungnir has some neat tricks to show whosoever it deems worthy. The who in this situation, of course, is you. Extremely durable, and sharp enough to kill a God, this is certainly one of the most potent relics of the Norse Pantheon.

Being bound to the God of Knowledge, Wisdom, and Magic for so long, these domains have infused Gungnir with their power. Among these effects is that any who wield Gungnir will learn magic far faster than they usually should, finding it much easier to create new spells and magical techniques along the path to mastery. When in the pursuit of knowledge with Gungnir in hand, the wand will sense your hunger for answers, and enhance your creativity and cunning by a noticeable margin. 

Finally, after being infused with the same noose the Allfather used to hang himself upon the branches of the World Tree, Gungnir is now able to extend itself a few meters away from the wielder similar to a whip-sword. Gungnir may hold more mysteries and secrets, learned or inherited from its time with The Hooded One, but it will be up to you to uncover them.

With the Spear of Heaven in hand, make the first step in your journey to learn all of the secrets in the world.
objects.title: Gungnir (God of War)

addons.text: The Leviathan Axe and Jarnbjorn—forged in realms apart yet born of the same anguish—have now been combined into one mythic weapon. Both axes are steeped in the pain of gods who lost their way. Jarnbjorn, stained by Thor’s earliest battles and his failure to grasp the true weight of godhood. Leviathan, crafted in guilt—not as a weapon of glory, but one of responsibility. United, they embody a truth few gods dare to face: that power does not equal righteousness. This fusion channels both the physical and magical might of the originals—Jarnbjorn’s peerless sharpness and indestructible defense, alongside Leviathan’s cryogenic force, drawn from the echoing screams of frost trolls.
