But more than their abilities, it is their legacy that defines them: one was wielded by a god unworthy of his station, the other forged as an act of repentance. Combined, they become a weapon not of divinity, but against it—capable of cleaving through godly protections, cutting away divine essence itself, and erasing a god's very nature. Even the Oversoul, that last refuge of immortality, is not beyond its reach. No god can escape judgment—for not even their Oversouls are safe from the God Butcher.
addons.title: Gor Was Right

objects.text:
The Leviathan Axe was made by the Dwarven brothers Brok and Sindri, specifically forged to fight off the power of Mjolnir after feeling responsible for the destruction caused by Thor.

It was infused with the echoing screams of twenty frost trolls (give or take), and has several runes inscribed on the blade that grants different powers.

Among it's powers, the Axe has ice magic, capable of creating and shooting ice, freeze almost anything, bring ice storms and more related abilities. It is bonded to you and can be called back to your hand via mental command from any distance, even through dimensions and universes.

The Axe is strong enough to fight Mjolnir, being it's equal match in power.
objects.title: Leviathan Axe (God of War)

objects.text:
The legendary hammer, Mjölnir, was forged by the dwarven Huldra brothers, Brok and Sindri, and wielded by the Aesir God of Thunder and Strength, Thor. This hammer was used by its wielder to slay countless giants, monsters, and other supernatural beings. One of Mjölnir’s defining features is its ability to return to its wielder at a thought, regardless of distance, so long as it isn’t trapped in another dimension or magically restrained. It is indestructible and so heavy that no one short of a god could hope to lift it, let alone wield it in battle. However, you are among the few who can, and even more, you are considered its true wielder. Within Mjölnir resides a portion of Thor’s own divinity and powers.

At the beginning, Mjölnir grants you the ability to release blasts of electricity powerful enough to level buildings, move at speeds faster than the human eye can track, and wield strength capable of demolishing large houses with a single blow. Your durability also allows you to endure such force as though it were no more than an ineffective punch. Over time, more of Thor’s divinity will pass to you, gradually increasing your power until you can summon and control storms large enough to cover a city and shatter a mountainside with a single swing of your hammer.

Eventually, you will inherit Thor’s domains and gain mastery over all the unique applications of his thunder and electricity, as well as his combat skills. In the end, you will have fully succeeded Thor, with the power to lift mountains, dodge lightning, move at supersonic speeds, and withstand blows capable of destroying cities.
objects.title: Mjölnir (God of War)

objects.text:
The Revenant Weapons are the most powerful weapons ever created by the Skydwellers to fight against the Astrals during a major war. These weapons have incredible power and can defeat anything, even things that don’t die or come back to life. Each weapon strengthens the person who uses it and helps them use their powers better. Each purchase of this grants you one of the weapons of your choice:

One-Rift Spear: This golden spear with a large gem on the tip, allows you to summon many spearheads to throw at enemies ,and shoot a strong laser from the tip. It also increases the user's wisdom and insight.

Two-Crown Bow: This golden bow has two gems. It shoots magical arrows that can pass through space and time, avoiding any enemy defenses. You can summon many arrows around you or shoot a stream of arrows from the bow.

Three-Tiger Axe: This golden axe has three gems. It can float in the air, and greatly increase the user's physical strength.

Four-Sky Blade: This golden dagger has four gems in the handle. It boosts the user's speed so much that they appear to be teleporting, and every hit from this dagger lands twice on the enemy.

Five-Soul Staff: This golden staff has five gems. It increases the user's magical skills and greatly improves their ability to see things clearly.

Six-Ruin Fist: These golden gloves have six gems. They create copies of the user's movements and attacks that follow them around.

Seven-Star Sword: This golden greatsword has seven gems. It lets you summon copies of any swords you've seen before. Each copy has the same power as the real one and can be shot at enemies. It can also summon seven strong, powerful warriors to fight with you.

Eight-Life Katana: This golden sword has eight gems. It can attack ghosts, spirits, and other supernatural beings. It can also cut a person's soul from their body and control or create dreams.

Nine-Realm Harp: This golden harp has nine gems. It can change how someone feels, making them experience emotions they’ve never felt before. The music can be heard even by beings that can't hear. Playing this harp also strengthens musical abilities.

Ten-Wolf Gun: This golden revolver has ten gems in the barrel. It fires magic bullets that never run out. It can create portals that send a stream of guided magic bullets at enemies. It can also cause hallucinations in the target.

The Revenant Weapons you buy here don’t have their own thoughts, or you can choose for them to have loyal spirits. They don’t need any care or repairs and cannot be broken.
objects.title: Revenant Weapons (Granblue Fantasy)

addons.text:
You now own Pyet-A; Wielded in Seal Weapon form as the sword Prototype, Pyet-A is the First of the Automagods, and the prototype design that subsequent Automagods were iterated off of. Although surpassed in might by Automagod Diaspora, its combat capabilities exceed those of the other 11 Automagods, which had their specifications pared down for the sake of practicality and efficiency. 

Since this is the prototype in which Arianensa and Grynoth came from, it has far superior armor, frame and capacity making it far superior than both but not practical to mass produce. It possesses the function of both Automagods and far superior power allowing it to resist even the Nullification and sealing capabilities of Nybeth only slowing down its abilities such as regeneration. Pyet-A has multiple Source Core but one only needs one to be able to control and activate its Automagod form.

The powers it has is the use of Pyrotech capable of using purple flame, its machine cells can also take the form of a liquid and flow in your veins giving you strength and resistance of the Automagod even without wielding the Sealed Weapon. Also can form
Whips and thin wires with laser and plasma properties allow it to cut through almost anything, although Automagod Armors can resist it, prolonged exposure or contact will allow it to slowly slice through even that Armor.
addons.title: Pyet-A (Granblue Fantasy)

addons.text:
You now own the Automagod that merged with the first generation moon dweller who went back to Sky-realm to study Sky-dwellers, and Primal Beasts, and establish The Society to help with her goal. Due to the engineer nearing the end of her lifespan before she could return to the moon for life extension procedure, she tampered and merged her being and existence with Yatima becoming one with it.

 Yatima is a massive Automagod with a highly condensed Machine cell that is equivalent to the size of a regular floating island in Sky-realm but her main body/source is the size of a young girl with dark red hair. Yatima's abilities are close to replication and duplication capable of copying primal beast shape and power by simply analyzing them, capable of copying even Proto-Bahamut and his abilities. How she is able to completely copy a primal beast abilities is unknown but she employs the use of Automagods abilities to completely absorb a primal beast and machine cell to completely copy and replicate the shape and abilities of a primal beast allowing her to use their abilities by simply witnessing them or analyzing an entity and their capabilities.

 Although she is capable of copying primal beast abilities she has never shown to copy other Automagod abilities, she is also capable of making Composite forms of primal beast merging primal beast abilities into one and having their body function separately from her but still as part of her.

You can choose to merge with her like your other seal weapons, or still allow her to have her own form , but with you also having shared machine cells.
addons.title: Yatima (Granblue Fantasy)

addons.text:
You now own The 13th, last, and final Automagod created by the Moon. It is the culmination of the Moon’s technological development, and like all Automagods Diaspora was composed of Machine Cells, but the Machine Cells used in its construction were more advanced models capable of greater autonomy. This allowed it to effortlessly reconfigure into different forms, as well as separate into any number of fully functional independent entities.

 Diaspora used these Machine Cells in order to break materials down into their basic molecular components, and as such was used by Central Axis in order to recycle waste into usable resources. The development of Automagod Diaspora caused further construction of Automagods to cease, as they were deemed unnecessary and outdated- instead Diaspora was continuously upgraded and improved.

 It consists of Machine cells roughly 15%-20% of the moon's mass capable of reducing all existence in Sky-realm to machine cells and absorbing them into its being. Diaspora is built with a Superior self-learning AI allowing it to adapt and evolve accordingly to whatever situation it faces, it also employs all the abilities of previous Automagods.

 Due to its superior control to Machine cells it can individually control each who are roughly the size of a molecule and atom allowing it to use them as vapor and liquid capable of completely controlling the bodies of anyone who have inhaled/within/exposed to it and its machine cells passively deconstruct entities and absorb energy or powers that isn't normally tangible. It is also immune and resistant to all special interference from moon dweller technology and will only stop once it has accomplished its goal to completely eradicate all life and existence in Sky-realm.
addons.title: Diaspora (Granblue Fantasy)

objects.text:
The Cores of dormant Automagods, are highly advanced weapons designed to combat Primal Beasts, and can absorb and harness power from them. Modifications made by Moon Dwellers who desired to aid Sky Dwellers,these weapons have since taken on unique development paths as they have altered themselves to suit the various wielders they have had over the centuries.Each purchase of this grants you one of the weapons of your choice:

Arianensa a monofilament wire that possessed the ability to slice through most materials at incredible speed.

Grynoth is a large scythe that possesses the ability to extend tendrils of Machine Cells into its wielder in order to grant them increased strength and durability, at the cost of sending them into bouts of mindless rage.

Flamek is a firearm that possesses the ability to fire unyielding torrents of electricity, which can affect large spaces and massed quantities of targets.

Nybeth is a pair of firearms that possesses the ability to restrict the powers of other entities, both magical and technological. Although this renders it less capable in direct combat relative to other Seal Weapons, its potent ability is nonetheless invaluable in crippling opponents.

Arvess is a spear that possesses the ability to generate flames of incredible heat and augment its wielder’s speed, and responds to its wielder’s emotional conviction.

Embrasque is a sword that possesses the ability to increase its offensive power relative to the state of its wielder. The more its wielder is injured or otherwise pushed to the edge, the greater its power becomes.

Merlenaut is a free floating spread of machine cells that possesses the ability to change into a poison that can debilitate virtually any target. Its efficacy is nearly absolute, and it is capable of overcoming any amount of physical or magical resistance in theory-even that of a God. It can only be used against a 
target once.
objects.title: Seal Weapon(s) (Granblue Fantasy)

addons.text:
As you uncover your long-hidden heritage as a direct descendant of the legendary Hogwarts Founder, Godric Gryffindor, you are catapulted into a world of wonder and possibility. With no known heirs before you, you pass the Founder’s test and claim your rightful inheritance within the castle's walls.

As you step into your new role, you discover that Godric's life of adventure has left behind a treasure trove of weapons, treasures, and secrets. The vaults, once sealed to outsiders, now lie open before you, revealing the spoils of his storied past. You also claim a luxurious custom suite of rooms within the castle, a testament to your new status as a member of the Gryffindor legacy.

As you explore your newfound identity, you find that you have developed a natural talent for dueling and battle magic, as well as exceptional skill with a sword. Furthermore, you discover a strong affinity for the element of fire, which seems to fuelled by your magical abilities.

With this new heritage comes the discovery of the Sword of Gryffindor's hidden abilities. You learn that it can absorb other weapons and foci, integrating their combined powers into its own. You can separate these absorbed items at will, allowing you to wield their abilities independently.

Additionally, you gain insight into how to disable or remove enhancements from the Sword at will. This newfound knowledge opens up new possibilities for strategy and combat, as you learn to harness the full potential of your inherited legacy.
addons.title: True Heir of Gryffindor

objects.text:
A goblin-crafted magical sword, once owned by the legendary Hogwarts Founder, Godric Gryffindor, possesses extraordinary properties. This enchanted blade can be used as a wand, and its silver composition, forged from the finest goblin craftsmanship, imbues it with a unique ability. It can strengthens itself with substances it touches, and needs no cleaning or maintenance.

Moreover, the sword is infused with Basilisk venom, rendering it an instrument of formidable might. When wielded by an individual with a fire affinity, the blade can ignite with scorching magical flames, posing a perilous threat only to those deemed enemies of its user.

Furthermore, this sword has a profound impact on its wielder's character. It enhances their courage and resolve, granting them resilience against fear and mind-affecting abilities. Those who hold this sword close will find their confidence and determination bolstered, making them more formidable in battle and more steadfast in the face of adversity.
objects.title: Sword of Godric Gryffindor (Harry Potter)

objects.text:
"By the power/For the honor of Grayskull, I have the power!"

With a chant of these magic words and your sword of choice held aloft, fabulous secret powers are revealed to you in a crackle of lightning, an explosion of fire, and a swirl of magic. You become the chosen defender of the Secrets of Castle Grayskull and all its boundless energies, transforming into the most powerful (wo)man in the universe.

Your physical attributes are elevated to extraordinary heights, enabling you to perform truly physics-defying feats. Move a moon the size of Earth's in and out of orbit with a bit of elbow grease? Check. Take a beating from Superman and keep going? Absolutely. Run faster than the speed of light while dodging laser beams? You bet. Oh, and let’s not forget the snazzy new kung-fu action, complete with acrobatic flips—free of charge. Somersaulting over hapless enemies has never been deadlier!

But that’s just the beginning. The true limitless power of Grayskull lies in its ability to grant an adaptive power level proportional to the threat you’re facing. The stronger your opponent, the stronger you become. Want to unravel a tornado with your sword? Done. Plug a canyon by pulling tectonic plates with your bare hands? Piece of cake! Toss Castle Grayskull itself through alternate dimensions? You’ve got it. With the power of Grayskull, nothing is impossible.

As if that weren’t enough, your sword can reflect any and all energy attacks. And if you happen to wield the Sword of Protection specifically, you’ll even gain the ability to communicate with animals as a bonus! Just, uh... watch out for ponies; they love the taste of your dress. Heck, we at Castle Grayskull love animals so much that we’ll let you empower your pets too. Just zap 'em and see what happens.

With Castle Grayskull and its mystical energy source safely locked away in a dimension accessible only to you, there’s no need to worry about anyone raiding your gothic bachelor pad and stealing your power. The sword(s) will always be keyed to your existential fingerprint, so no one—not even an evil alternate version of you—can claim your power by stealing your steel. And if you drop, lose, or forget your sword, don’t worry—it’ll magically pop back into your hands. Giving it away or abandoning it is as simple as wishing it so of your own free will. You cannot be forced to part with it against your will, no matter the means.

To sweeten the deal, no one will ever be able to connect your regular identity with your superpowered self, no matter how obvious it seems. And, yes, we’ll even throw in a free alter-ego appearance and body design of your choice, complete with an airbrushed finish. So, don’t wait—claim your sword now!

P.S. The untransformation phrase is: "Let the power return!"
objects.title: Sword of Power/Protection (He-Man and the MotU)

objects.text:
The signature weapon of Jintae Yang, also known as the Blade of Glass, is a translucent blade powerful enough to make any swordsman covet it. Its most treasured feature is the ability to adapt the shape and design of the blade to the wielder's desires, significantly enhancing its reach and destructive capabilities. Although it can take any shape, it must first be unsheathed out of its scabbard per change, requiring the wielder to practice unsheathing it quickly and effectively. 

A true master of the One Hundred-Sided Blade can slice through an entire city block, cleave someone in half from a hundred meters away, weave a rope of sword light to bind enemies, or unleash a wave of slashes to butcher their opponent. But the blade’s potency is ultimately limited to your own skill and imagination.

Augmented by Jintae Yang’s Gift, the blade’s sheathe also grants access to minor self-regeneration as long as one has it. You won’t be able to regenerate limbs but injuries that would’ve taken weeks to heal can be shortened to mere days.
objects.title: One Hundred-Sided Blade (Hero Killer)

addons.text:
You do not have just Caliburn—you're Arthur Pendragon, descendant of King Arthur. Or rather, at the very least, you have his abilities and memories, and the option to have his appearance, memories, etc. With this, you are granted immense physical capabilities, enough for you to keep up with and fight beings capable of destroying cities in a short amount of time. Your talent at using Caliburn means your blasts of Caliburn's released aura are powerful enough to destroy a large portion of a city or most of a mountain in one attack.

You also naturally know quite a bit of magic— not enough to be considered a real magician, but things like throwing some fireballs, spot healing, creating magical circles, and even enhancing yourself further with magic are all things you could do.
addons.title: Arthur Pendragon

objects.text:
The Strongest Holy Sword. It passively releases an immense Holy Aura that dwarfs the original complete Excalibur and Durandal. This blade can, even in the hands of a novice, release waves of such powerful aura that it's capable of toppling city blocks. However, it's not just its holiness that makes this the most powerful sword, but its power of dimensions.

It's capable of tearing space with its slashes and opening portals, allowing its wielder to teleport wherever they wish. It can also create barriers around the user and their allies so that they are both protected from attacks and allowed to travel between dimensions and worlds without being negatively affected by the environment.
objects.title: Caliburn (High School DxD)

addons.text: The Golden Sword of the Victorious The Excalibur fragments resonate with the presence of the Sword of Promised Victory, taking on the form and abilities of the Noble Phantasm Caliburn, also known as the Sword in the Stone, while retaining all of their original powers. The sword grants its user eternal youth and can become utterly immovable at the wielder's command. The blade can also transform the wielder’s energies into heat and light to attack the user's target. Upon the hilt of this Sword of Selection is an inscription: “Whosoever pulleth out this sword of this stone is rightwise king of all England.” With this, the sword re-enacts its most famous legend, empowering the wielder with the right to assume the role and title of King of England—or whatever local equivalent exists. This role can be that of an Absolute Monarch ruling over your new subjects or a Constitutional Head of State, with a loyal, capable government handling the governance of your people. Either way, you will enjoy the power and privileges of your new position. Taking on the title of King—or Queen—is entirely optional. Should you choose not to hold this position, you may freely decline or abdicate at will. The Sword of Selection will retain the ability to grant you this title whenever you wish.
addons.title: Caliburn

addons.text:
Now alongside the Excalibur swords, you obtain the long lost scabbard of the legendary sword. This is a divine relic that grants its bearer strong protection against harm, even able to mitigate specific vulnerabilities—such as a Vampire’s weakness to sunlight . It also provides potent healing abilities, healing the user from nearly any wound, almost faster than the wound is made.

The Scabbard reflects the powers of the sword it’s made for in a diminished capacity. It can change it’s own shape, turn invisible, and generate illusions around itself. It slightly boosts the wielder's speed, enhances holy powers, and can produce small blasts of destruction. Finally it can control a non-sentient object upon contact.
addons.title: The Scabbard

objects.text: These seven swords are derived from the shattered remnants of King Arthur's famous Excalibur. Each, in its own right, wields the power to incinerate an ordinary devil while possessing its own unique power. Each can be wielded alone, or they can be combined or separated as needed. Excalibur Mimic: The Holy Sword of Mimicry allows the user to transform the size, form, and material of the sword into anything desired. From weapons to armor, even a piece of string, this Excalibur fragment is prized for its adaptability. Excalibur Transparency: The Holy Sword of Transparency is the blade of the stealthy, capable of turning itself and its wielder invisible to strike unseen. Excalibur Rapidly: The Holy Sword of the Heavenly Flash is the sword of the speedy; it provides the user with superhuman speed, enhancing mobility and the wielder’s ability to strike swiftly. Excalibur Blessing: The Holy Sword of Blessing holds truest to its name; it grants all of the wielder’s attacks the holy element and boosts the user's holy powers, magnifying their effects. Excalibur Destruction: The Holy Sword of Destruction unleashes potent blasts of destruction and strengthens the force of attacks to easily shatter all that it impacts. Excalibur Nightmare: The Holy Sword of Dreams induces fear and illusions, manipulating an opponent's mind for the psychological advantage. Excalibur Ruler: The Holy Sword of Control enables the wielder to control anything or anyone it cuts. However, the effectiveness varies with the target’s willpower, allowing the wielder to wreak havoc on the battlefield by turning friend into foe. Together, these swords represent a versatile arsenal, each fragment with its unique strengths to aid the wielder in battle. While the glory of the original unbroken Excalibur is no more, these fragments are still among the strongest holy swords around.
objects.title: Excalibur Swords (High School DxD)

objects.text:
The Ending Requiem Spear was created by the Mechanical Girls for the purpose of killing a world’s consciousness. It is a weapon designed to slay the very being responsible for the creation of its wielder. The spear itself was forged using a world’s consciousness as material. It possesses two defining traits. The first is the ability to directly attack a world’s consciousness, and the second is the ability to track and automatically home in on such entities when thrown. While it can target and destroy any form of consciousness, it is most effective against a world’s consciousness. The spear is simply very fast, tracks the target, and goes straight through anything to hit.

With this spear you can kill the world’s consciousness, who possesses complete and total authority over what they create and know what their creations would do. With just a thought they can create life, with another they can destroy it. Their very presence suppresses life forms they create more than something like killing intent, bloodline suppression, or Conqueror's Haki. Normal attacks against a world’s consciousness are normally suppressed and grow stronger the more rebellious its creations are. It’s with this authority a world’s consciousness is capable of twisting the most willful person’s ideals into that of a cowards or alter the personality of anyone however they please. A world’s consciousness is often described as having nigh Omnipotence and Omniscience under the purview of what they create. This includes the stars, the sun, the planet, and the universe. And they can grow by consuming other universes or realms such as Heaven. The Ending Requiem Spear is made to kill beings like these.
 
If you possess means of a mental attack, such as voice of consciousness, psychic powers, soul based attacks, or similar means you can use this as a springboard to directly invade the souls of the target. It directly ignores the vitality and defenses of the target going straight for their consciousness and it ignores the kinds of suppression found when a lower tier being attempts to face a higher tier being. Or in this case, when a creation attempts to face off against its creator. This spear makes no attempts in protecting its user, it merely tracks the target and kills their consciousness.
objects.title: Ending Requiem Spear (Homebody Witch)

objects.text:
The greatest treasure passed down through the royal family of the Kingdom of Altar and the strongest sword in the world of Infinite Dendrogram, surpassing even Superior Arms. Altar appears as a decorated blue crystal sword with beauty beyond human knowledge. Its true form is that of an elemental created by the Smith, one of the previous administrators of the world. You were born qualified to use this sword even if you do not have the Superior Job [Sacred Princess] or [Sacred King].

Altar possesses the ability of Absolute Severance, to cut absolutely everything, from physical objects to energy and even concepts. Individuals cut by this sword cannot heal ever again. In the case of certain immortals, they can only heal by dying and returning. The blade is normally bound by three seals, reducing it to the level of a normal sword in the hands of all except its true wielder.

Lifting the first seal will regain Altar's sharpness to cut through everything in the physical realm. Releasing the second seal allows you to cut spiritual bodies, dealing damage to the soul, and strip away magic and energy. The third seal locks away the sword's greatest ability, cutting concepts and esoteric properties.
objects.title: The Primeval Sword, Altar (Infinite Dendrogram)

objects.text:
Tenseiga is a slender katana wrought from the fang of a mighty demon lord and twin to Sō’unga and Tessaiga. However, unlike its sibling blades, it cannot shed blood or strike down the living. No matter how fierce the swing or skilled the swordsman, its edge will always pass harmlessly through flesh and armor. To the unknowing, it might seem a useless relic—but to those who understand its true purpose, Tenseiga is among the rarest and most powerful treasures in existence.

When drawn over the fallen, the sword reveals the normally invisible specters of the underworld who seek to drag a departed soul into the afterlife. With a single slash, Tenseiga severs their grasp, pulling the soul back into its body and healing the mortal wounds that resulted in its death. Such resurrections are instantaneous, though not without limit: the body must be largely intact, and the spirit must choose willingly to return.

Yet this is Tenseiga at its weakest. As its wielder grows in kindness and wisdom, the sword’s power deepens, granting the ability to banish malevolent spirits, purify corruption, and even part the veil between worlds to open passages into realms of the dead. Though incapable of physically harming an enemy, Tenseiga can destroy curses, sunder bindings, or sever the spiritual cords that tether one being to another. In moments of mortal peril, the blade may even create a shield for its bearer, placing itself between them and death’s hand.

Tenseiga is not a weapon for warriors or tyrants, nor for those who seek glory in slaughter. It is a sword of mercy and compassion—one that, at the height of its strength, can resurrect a hundred souls with a single swing.
objects.title: Tenseiga (Inuyasha)

objects.text: Tessaiga is a legendary sword forged from the fang of the Inu no Taisho, said to “kill a hundred demons in a single stroke”. The Tessaiga has the ability to strike Wind Scars, releasing an energy wave strong enough to kill 100 Yokai in a single swing or destroy a mountain. It can also produce barriers to protect you and can absorb the primary abilities/attacks of those destroyed by its blade and assimilate it. It possesses a mind of its own and will sometimes guide you through wanting to be drawn and giving advice in certain situations. In its regular form, it looks like a regular, if battered, katana, but when wielded properly transforms into a giant sword somewhat resembling a falchion.
objects.title: Tessaiga (Inuyasha)

objects.text:
The Infinity Ray is a near-mythical laser pistol with an unusually long barrel that holds unimaginable power. When the Infinity Ray is fired, it releases a wave of absolute destruction that can destroy nearly anything in its path, whether they be entire planets or even stars. Its beam will continue for upwards of an entire galaxy in distance or until it hits a great enough target, one that is either very large, such as a planet, or something that is exceptionally durable. Typically, either a planet or a star which will instantly go supernova.
 
The Infinity Ray possesses a strange ability to bond with its owner psionically, such that only its true owner can use it. As such, only you will be able to use its vast power.

Users of the Infinity Ray must exercise a steady hand and restraint in its use, as firing this weapon is not something to be done lightly, with the wake of destruction it leaves in its path.
objects.title: The Infinity Ray (Invincible)
Dragon Taming Mace (Judge Dee)
objects.text: By most standards, this weapon resembles more of a heavy, square baton with a segmented shaft. The Dragon Taming Mace may be wielded like a sword, but deals powerful blunt strikes. It also possesses a spinning mechanism near the handle that when spun, causes the metal of the Mace to resonate powerfully. This allows the wielder to expose flaws in whatever they strike, and shatter both objects and any mundane weaponry. Its efficacy against supernatural weaponry is uncertain. It also doubles as a symbol of authority as a judge within the Chinese Imperial court.

You have been granted ownership of a blade forged from Datenseki by Rokuhira Kunishige. Datenseki is a material that allows one to channel their Spiritual Energy (or life force) through it, massively amplified to the point where it manifests in a physical form outside the body. More importantly, the swords are constructed in such a way that this process is stable and does not harm the user, excepting cases where one overextends themselves. Normally, taking up an Enchanted Blade will cause your other sorcery or other powers to become sealed. These ones, however, will only cause that temporarily, and only as long as you are actively using a sword's power. Each Enchanted Blade will become bound to you, making you the only one who can use its power, known as an Eternal Contract. If you die, the Contract is nullified and someone else can form a new one with the sword. Each Enchanted Blade possesses at least three abilities, based around a particular theme. Said abilities tend to be simple, but strong. In addition, as you grow more accustomed to using the sword and you come to understand its power more, its powers and abilities will grow to suit your needs. Each ability will become more flexible, forming new variations. In extreme cases, the sword may even manifest a new ability altogether. With each purchase, you may gain one of the Enchanted Blades shown in canon, with the exception of Magatsumi the Shinuchi, or even an Enchanted Blade of your own creation. In the latter case, you may determine the core 'purpose' behind the sword's creation. The three abilities it develops after that will be based around that and tailored specifically to you, and will be the same no matter who else uses it.
objects.title: Enchanted Blade (Kagurabachi)

addons.text: Your Patron and divine weapon resonate with each other, creating a profound transformation for the both of you. Firstly, instead of a deity on the rise, your Patron becomes one equal to Palutena in terms of influence and power, becoming recognized as a figure worthy of reverence and protector of humanity by the masses. This massive influx of worship allows them to manifest a physical body to act in the mortal world, though you will still play your role as their champion. Their realm is no longer a space you visit in dreams, but a real and physical domain on par with Sky World under their authority, which you can teleport, or be summoned to and from easily. Within this realm, you can have various facilities like a training grounds, armory, living quarters, entertainment, kitchen, etc. With servants to tend and maintain them. This domain is not fixed and can easily change to accommodate either of your needs. Secondly, you've gained the ability to transform into an angel equal to Pit. In this form, you become a truly worthy champion for your deity. A one man army with mastery over all divine weapons, inspire their followers into symphonies of cheers, and return from the depths of the Underworld victorious. Unlike Pit, you can fly on your own indefinitely with no drawbacks. You still retain these benefits in your mortal form, though your full power can only be accessed as an angel. Note: If you have the Pantheon’s Chosen Envoy Addon, you can have all the gods from Kid Icarus Uprising as that Pantheon.
addons.title: Servant of the Gods
Palutena Bow
addons.text: As a weapon created by the Goddess of Light, your bow becomes a perfect conduit for Holy Light, transforming into Pit's signature weapon—The Palutena Bow. In this state, it's even more effective against agents of darkness, to the point that even Hades might break character just by gazing at its brilliance. It's natural homing, rapid fire, and charge shots are elevated to the point of sniping from thousands of miles away, finding targets to smite even if you were to shoot blind, and critically injure beings as strong as Super Devils. Holy Light can easily augment the bow in various ways, like firing arrows of Holy Fire, Lightning, nullifying enemy attacks, and exploding on contact. As well as upgrade it, transmute it into other kinds of weapons from Kid Icarus Uprising, DxD, and even your own creations. Note: Should you possess the Light Weaponry Addon, your expertise elevates to creating weapons on par with the Palutena Bow, and with enough mastery, to the point of rivalling the Three Sacred Treasures.

objects.text: "I am Pit, servant of the Goddess of Light! And you. Are. History!" You receive a divine weapon crafted by the Goddess of Light, Palutena. This bow can generate arrows of light by pulling its strings and lock onto targets after firing them, becoming stronger and faster the farther they travel. They can also be charged to make them bigger upon release, which will also increase their strength and speed proportionally to how long they've been charged. You can choose to apply or disable the lock on feature, or change the trajectory of the arrows. You can fire the arrows continuously with no limit, to the point of releasing multiple at the same time or with the rapid fire of a machine gun. A fully charged arrow has the potential to pierce through steel, send a target flying with explosive force upon impact, and move at speeds faster than a bullet, to lightspeed, or even faster as it goes further. They also double as two shortswords for close range combat and can easily switch between both forms. As a divine weapon, it's supernaturally effective against all manner of malevolent, demonic, or other unholy creatures regardless of their form. If you possess supernatural, or better yet, any form of light or holy powers, the weapon can be further augmented and amplified.
objects.title: Silver Bow (Kid Icarus Uprising)

addons.title: Keyblade Transformations
addons.text:
Your Keyblade(s) gain a modified enhanced version of the Weapon Transformation ability from Kingdom Hearts 3 through being combined with the Modified Asauchi.

This fusion grants your Keyblade the ability to transform into unusual forms with modified combat styles, with various boons and buffs, which is treated as a Shikai Release that also increases your power while in use. However, unlike the original version of the Keyblade Transformation mechanic, you can transform your Keyblade a second time as a form of Bankai. This second transformation will take the effects of the previous transformation and massively empower them while also broadening their abilities and effects.

Your Keyblade may now also assume the form of a unique katana which bears subtle hints at its true nature while it is in its default base form.

Additionally, you may decide to optionally choose to grant your empowered Keyblade a Spirit which will reside within your Inner World slash “Heart”, which will act as a wise mentor figure who will help you grow both in strength and character to become the best version of yourself.

Lastly, the typical potential weakness of your weapon being destroyed is rendered almost entirely null thanks to the absurd durability inherent in all Keyblades, and should it somehow be destroyed, it will retreat into yourself to repair over time, which can be expedited by spending through regeneration powers or smithing as normal.

objects.text: You have found and formed a bond with a Keyblade, a weapon and tool of nigh unimaginable power that grants its bonded wielder near unlimited growth potential in physical and magical power, but also can open and close nearly anything. Things it can unlock include locked items, magical seals, the barriers and gates between worlds, a person's “Heart”, and unlock a near bottomless well of potential power within its bonded wielder. As a person bonded to a Keyblade, it grants you the ability to use magic (if you could not already) and enhances your physical attributes to superhuman levels. This unlocking of your potential grants you the ability to grow stronger almost endlessly. Your growth is only limited by the strength of your “Heart” and inner conviction alongside combat experience and training. This bond you share with your keyblade allows you to summon it back to your hand at will or dismiss it back into your “Heart”. Also, this bond cannot be easily broken unless your “Heart” is weakened and powerful esoteric methods are used. Even if you somehow lose your Keyblade, you can regain it by recovering your resolve and conviction, which will strengthen your “Heart” to where your Keyblade can recognize you again and rebond with you. Though it may appear as a very impractical weapon, the immense magic within allows it to function effectively despite how unwieldy it looks, as well as allowing it to teleport back to your hand at will. A Keyblades magical properties allow it be used as a blade or blunt weapon despite it appearance. Also, the damage it deals can be done on a metaphysical level, which makes defending against it tricky and allows you to selectively cause damage that does not appear as physical wounds on a target. You start with a custom Keychain, which will create a Keyblade that will deeply reflect you at a personal level and will be influenced by your preferred fighting style. Alternatively, you may instead start with the Keychain for the classic Kingdom Key Keyblade that Sora uses. In addition, you are given a handful of basic starting spells, such as Fire, Blizzard, Thunder, Cure, or Reflect, along with physical and magical power roughly equal to Sora at the start of his journey. Over time, you will gain additional Keychains after undergoing significant events, forming strong bonds with others, or through Synthesis and crafting them.
objects.title: Keyblade (Kingdom Hearts)

addons.text:
You have merged with the fragment within the scythe and become like Shiraori, the White Weaver herself. You inherit all her powers and abilities, including her talents, physiology, knowledge, skills, and more—all at her peak in godhood from the light novel series. This grants you all her Conjuring, including her spatial manipulation, her Evil Eyes, her clone creation, and much more. You also have the option to inherit her memories, with their manifestation and effects being entirely up to you.

Your scythe has fully transformed, becoming an extension of your very being. It now houses a fragment of your soul, forming an unbreakable soulbond that allows it to grow alongside you and ensures that it can never be taken from you.

Finally, your soul has absorbed a small fragment of D’s soul, granting you a glimpse into a power beyond—and the potential to one day reach it.
addons.title: White Weaver

addons.text: Through your Unique Skill: Lord of Names, you have managed to name the soul that is still within the Scythe, giving a body to the soul inside. As with all individuals named through the Unique Skill: Lord of Names, the monster will evolve, granting it a higher evolution than the Lesser Taratect it would have been should you have found another way of giving the soul a body instead, the Lesser Taratect will start at around the level the original body would be when it was a Zoa Ele. Being both part of you and named by you Unique Skill: Lord of Names will not only grant the soul an initial starting bonus but connect it to your version of the Voice of the World transferring the abilities it already would have into Skills granted through the Voice of the World giving it the push it need to regain the strength of the original body through evolving with the Voice of the World. The soul already starts with the beginnings of a Demon Lord Seed, and should the soul evolve far enough, it could become a Demon Lord through the manner seen in the world of Tensura, without the limitations of the title that would normally be associated with taking the title in her original world.
addons.title: So I’ve Been Named, so What?

objects.text:
"Nai Wa~~"

Congratulations, you have found White's Scythe!... or rather, it has found you.

This scythe is a weapon forged from one of the front limbs, shaped like a scythe, of a certain Arachne. It has been modified by ██████ █████, known as D, incorporating properties of automatic growth, making it virtually indestructible. It can cleave through anti-magic constructs and possesses two attributes: the [Rot Attribute], which governs death and, when invoked, disintegrates everything that lacks proper resistance to it; and the [Dark Attribute], which cancels out Light Magic upon contact. Additionally, the scythe itself emits an eerie aura of darkness.

A fragment of its former wielder’s soul resides within it, granting it a will of its own. This fragment has taken a liking to you and will come to your aid in times of great need, offering encouragement—though more as a general feeling (imagine a spider with pom-poms doing a little dance to cheer you on). If stolen, it will actively sabotage your enemies before returning to you. Additionally, the scythe will autonomously manifest in moments of danger, granting its wielder a tremendous boost in strength.

A small but important note: If you were to give the Soul Fragment its own body, it would take the form of a Small Lesser Taratect (a white spider the size of a dog), which corresponds to the initial species of the former wielder. Retaining its growth properties, it would be able to evolve in the same way its original wielder did, gaining access to Dark Magic (magic that manipulates shadows) and Heretic Magic (magic that attacks the soul directly). However, on its own, it is unlikely to reach the power of the soul from which it originally came.
objects.title: White's Scythe (Kumo desu ga, Nani ka?)

objects.text:
The Blade of the Ruined King, originally known as Sanctity, a royal heirloom passed down among the kings of Camavor that absorbed a fragment of each new king's soul upon coronation to enable automatic revival from fatal battlefield injuries. You step into this legacy as the new Ruined King after Viego, wielding the same sword that Viego once used, the same one that has imprisoned his soul within the now-corrupted weapon until you claimed its power.

You can use the soul absorption and revival capabilities of the sword through wielding it, as the blade stores a fragment of your soul to trigger instant resurrection if you suffer a fatal wound, pulling your essence back from death even in the midst of overwhelming enemy forces. For example, if an assassin delivers a killing strike during a duel, the embedded soul fragment activates the revival process without any external input from you, restoring your body and consciousness while the Black Mist surges to weaken nearby foes through parasitic draining. It also lets you channel soul-binding effects on a broader scale, such as ripping life force from living targets to sustain yourself mid-battle or trapping defeated enemies' souls within the Mist for later torment.

Via wielding the blade you gain secondary abilities including spectral manifestation that lets you summon the ghostly Zweihänder at will even when separated from your physical form, along with the capacity to spread controlled bursts of Black Mist that corrupt the land and bind souls into an undead state as extensions of your will. 

Lastly, you stand in Viego's place with part of your soul permanently embedded in the blade, fully embodying the Ruined King as its current master.
objects.title: Blade of the Ruined King (League of Legends)

objects.text:
You have come into possession of a pair of magitech gauntlets, oversized on the outside and reaching up to your mid forearm. Skipping over all the technical details, the Hextech that these gauntlets are made from give you a surprising amount of control over the weight and acceleration of them, as well as passively boosting your strength and dexterity. You will find it rather intuitive to speed up your punches while lessening weight until the last second, or slowing down their movements so as to absorb blows more solidly.

The rest of your body will be strengthened to best take advantage of the raw power of the gauntlets; despite them only covering part of your arms, you will be able to lift and throw various heavy objects with ease, not to mention accuracy thanks to enhancing your dexterity.

Optionally, you may receive a pair of boots instead, if you wish for a more speed- or kicking-based fighting style.
objects.title: Hextech Gauntlets (League of Legends)

objects.text:
The Master Sword, also known as the Blade of Evil's Bane, is a legendary blade dating back to ancient times. Originally the Goddess Sword, it was crafted by the goddess Hylia, tempered with the Sacred Flames of the three Golden Goddesses, then blessed with Hylia's own power, granting it the power to repel and vanquish evil, destroy magical barriers, and break curses involving dark magic. It is also an exceptionally good blade in addition to these qualities, being far sharper and lighter than any non-Tinkertech sword, as well as nearly unbreakable.

Normally, this sacred blade could only be wielded by those who were pure of heart and strong of body, repelling those of an evil nature and potentially killing those too weak to draw it - however, your version of the sword lacks either issue, allowing you to wield it with impunity regardless of strength or moral character. Additionally, the Master Sword can, in some cases, be enhanced even further beyond its baseline, such as being further tempered by an expert blacksmith, or through being infused with an outside source of power, for example.
objects.title: Master Sword (Legend of Zelda)

objects.text:
This magic set of swords are fabled in their power, a single one being able to turn the tides in a battle. This however isnt a single sword, but the whole set in one. You can change the current sword with a thougth. Be aware, the sword effects only last while they are in their active form.

Sword of Truth and Justice: So long you feel that your cause is just, you gradually keep gaining strength while in combat.

Sword of Once and Future: You can see the moves your opponent will use, and your reaction time increases.

Sword of Sinew and Steel: Hits caused by the sword will turn the target brittle, stacking to the point that a gust will break them. This damage is hard to recover.

Sword of Forge and Frontier: Each hit that lands on the enemy increases in force on the next hit. It is cumulative, not multiplicative.

Sword of Hearth and Home: Your allies gain strength and vitality while around you, their resolve to fight will grow,slowly healing their wounds.

Sword of Light and Shadow: When causing damage to an enemy, you drain them of their vitality. You can use this energy to heal yourself or an ally.

Sword of Feast and Famine: The longer you fight an enemy, the faster they will tire, the more their wounds will bleed and fester, slowly draining than of their force.

Sword of Body and Mind: Each time you attack, you create an echo that has the same powers as you. That echo lasts for 15 seconds, and coordinates telepathically with you.

Sword of Fire and Ice: The sword is covered by a cold-fire that spreads on your enemies and can't be extinguished. You can select what it will hurt and won't.

Sword of War and Peace: While this sword is active, you get stronger the more allies you have, and your enemies slowly lose the will to fight.
objects.title: Mirran Sword Set (Magic: The Gathering)

addons.text:
You can detach the Harpoon and place it in a designated location, alternatively, you can launch the Astral Harpoon anywhere you have in mind including alternate dimensions or across time. Additionally, the Astral Harpoon can summon itself to you at a moment's notice. Any situation the Astral Harpoon or Astral Spoon finds itself in counts towards the Astral Spoon’s Spooneth infusion towards you. If the harpoon is orbiting the sun, then you can develop Magical Girl Kryptonian powers despite not even being in the sun. Unlike the Astral Spoon, the Astral Harpoon does not develop strange quirks like something as ridiculous as Kamen Rider Kryptonian if it is too far away from you.

The Astral Harpoon gains the features of the Astral Spoon, granting it all the same durability and negation that the Astral Spoon possesses.
addons.title: Anchor Being

objects.text:
You own the Astral Harpoon, a heavy arm-mounted harpoon designed for difficult and dangerous situations. Weighing approximately 120 lbs, the harpoon is constructed from tungsten carbide, a composite material known for its hardness and wear resistance. This ensures it can withstand the rigors of use while remaining reliable in various conditions. Compared to other harpoons, the Astral Harpoon's substantial weight enhances its power, delivering decent impact. Its striking copper sheen not only provides a unique aesthetic in the dark underwater depths but also offers corrosion resistance and antibacterial properties, thanks to specialized nickel and chrome plating. This finish adds an extra layer of protection against environmental elements, ensuring durability, while the flat surface texture allows users to customize their harpoons with symbols and designs, making it a unique tool you can show off to your friends.

The launcher mechanism relies on a traditional mechanical spring system. A powerful high-carbon steel coil spring, heat-treated for elasticity and strength, provides the necessary force to propel the harpoon’s projectile over 300 meters away. The design includes a simple trigger mechanism, allowing for easy operation with a quick pull, making it intuitive even under pressure.

The harpoon and launcher’s design incorporates adjustable components that enhance portability and usability. The launcher features a collapsible frame made from aircraft-grade aluminum and carbon fiber, allowing it to be compacted for easier transport and storage. This adjustability means that the Astral Harpoon can be easily stowed in a vehicle or carried on a long trek, making it an ideal companion for adventurers who need both performance and convenience. It’s uncertain why an arm-mounted cannon needs to be shrunk further, but the designers insisted this was necessary.

The harpoon's projectile is designed with a streamlined shape to enhance aerodynamics, ensuring stable flight. The pointed tip, crafted from tungsten carbide for maximum penetration, is complemented by a shaft featuring strategically placed fins for improved stability and accuracy during flight. Notably, while the harpoon is attached to the launcher, it can rotate rapidly, functioning similarly to a high-speed drill, making it effective for both piercing and anchoring tasks. Constructed from high-quality tungsten carbide, the Astral Harpoon boasts enhanced durability through corrosion-resistant coatings, which help prevent rust and degradation. This protective layer ensures that the harpoon remains functional even when exposed to harsh conditions, such as salt water. Additionally, the tungsten carbide undergoes heat treatment, providing extra strength and resilience, crucial for withstanding the stresses of various challenging tasks.

Incorporating unique features, the Astral Harpoon houses a compact diesel engine within its frame, designed for efficiency, allowing it to operate in remote locations without relying on external power sources. Complementing this is an integrated lemonade maker, which enables users to create lemonade on the go and doubles as a backup fuel source for the harpoon’s engine. The combination of diesel and lemonade creates a hybrid fuel system, making it useful in case you do not have diesel on hand.
 
Connecting the harpoon to the launcher is a heavy-duty, reinforced rope constructed from high-tensile synthetic fibers like Dyneema and Kevlar, designed to withstand significant stress and tension during use. This rope serves multiple purposes: it ensures that the harpoon remains tethered to the launcher after firing, allowing for quick retrieval, and it provides additional stability during operation. The rope is coiled neatly around a spool integrated into the launcher, enabling rapid deployment and retraction as needed.

The Astral Harpoon features a quick-release mechanism designed for emergency situations. This user-friendly system allows the harpoon to be detached from the launcher with a simple press of a button, enabling immediate disengagement. The mechanism is engineered for reliability, ensuring that the harpoon remains securely attached during normal use but can be swiftly released without compromising safety.

Mounting the harpoon on your arm allows for ease of use while simultaneously freeing both hands. The design prioritizes a comfortable grip, enabling you to aim and fire without straining your arm despite its weight. Durable straps secure the harpoon in place, ensuring it stays firmly attached even during vigorous movement, while padded sections minimize discomfort. These straps are easy to replace in case they suffer wear and tear.

The Astral Harpoon is a reliable, no-frills tool designed for those who need a dependable harpoon for various tasks, whether for fishing, hunting, or securing lines in challenging environments. Its copper sheen gives it an eye-catching aesthetic, while its straightforward construction, impressive weight, and innovative features make it easy to maintain and operate. It can pierce through flesh as easily as it can pierce through rocks.

The versatility of the Astral Harpoon makes it suitable for a wide range of usage scenarios. It excels in deep-sea fishing, where its unique design and long-range capabilities allow for the precision targeting of various maritime animals. In rescue operations, the harpoon can be used to secure lines and pull individuals to safety. Additionally, its high-speed drilling capability is invaluable for climbing challenges, allowing climbers to anchor securely and navigate difficult terrains.

To ensure the longevity and optimal performance of the Astral Harpoon, regular maintenance is essential. Users should clean the harpoon after each use, particularly if it has been exposed to saltwater or debris. A gentle wash with fresh water followed by thorough drying will help prevent corrosion. It’s also recommended to inspect the spring mechanism and trigger lock periodically for any signs of wear or damage, ensuring that all components are functioning smoothly and safely.

One of the most interesting aspects of the Astral Harpoon is its modular design, which allows for various additional features to be attached as needed. Users can equip the harpoon with a variety of accessories, such as a built-in knife for quick cuts, netting attachments for trapping fish, or a storage compartment for extra harpoons (not that you have any). This modularity enhances the harpoon's functionality, allowing it to adapt to different tasks and environments, making it an invaluable tool for any adventurer or professional user. Each of these features is noted to cost as much as buying a whole new Astral Harpoon, emphasizing the investment in this versatile tool.
It’s said the Astral Harpoon was used in a battle against ancient underwater gods underneath the ocean. Eldritch beings against comprehension, the Astral Harpoon is a reliable tool that Magical Girls of old would use in the face of danger. It’s unknown if its inability to be controlled through powers is part of lacking any form of device in it to be controlled or that there’s genuinely something supernatural about it. But those with supernatural powers find it difficult to directly manipulate it. It’s said maritime sailors praise the Astral Harpoon and use replicas of it as both fishing tools and as a tool of faith against the depths.

(Note: You only have one harpoon. It comes with a free ‘#1 Magical Girl’ baseball cap, it is a simple cotton blend hat.)
objects.title: Astral Harpoon (Magical Girl ☆Sym-tan☆)

objects.text:
Epoch is a sheathed sword created from the remnants of a temporal explosion aimed to destroy every other timeline except the current one. Forged into the shape of a blade, it carries a similar but weaker effect than its original form. While sheathed, it gathers temporal energy created from the passing of time and expends it when unsheathed.

For the duration of the time it is unsheathed the user's actions will be a fixture in time itself, locked to always happen even in events trying to retcon it. The timeline would not split regardless of the choices made. It strangely has the ability to not exist at any point except for the user's present. Even alternate timelines or future selves would not possess this blade.
objects.title: Epoch (Magical Girl ☆Sym-tan☆)

addons.text:
Your nature as a heroic spirit has allowed for the shield's immense metaphysical weight to enhance it transforming it into a true noble phantasm, based on the concepts of freedom and indestructibility.

The shield is now indestructible in every sense, capable of withstanding direct blows from beings such as an Odin Force-empowered Thor without sustaining so much as a scratch. The concept of freedom applies to the shield itself, making most attempts to manipulate it against the wielder’s will futile. 

It cannot be controlled by magnetic forces, weakened by matter manipulation, and can not be affected, disenchanted, or cursed by magic. Additionally, it grants protection against effects that would deprive its wielder and their allies of freedom, such as sealing or mind control.

When activated as a Noble Phantasm, the shield can completely block and negate a single attack, regardless of its potency or scale.

Should you also have the super soldier serum you could become a Demi-Servant of the Shielder class carrying the hypothetical Saint Graph of Captain America if he had become a heroic spirit how the exact detail of the Saint graph and its ability is up for you to decide as long as it is reasonable.
addons.title: Conviction of A True Patriot (EX-Rank)

objects.text:
The legendary shield of Captain America is a disc-shaped weapon forged from proto-adamantium, making it nearly indestructible. It can absorb immense amounts of kinetic energy, allowing it to withstand the full force of incredibly powerful beings such as the Hulk, Thor, and the Silver Surfer without causing Captain America to be thrown back by the impact.

Thanks to its Vibranium component and aerodynamic design, the shield experiences minimal loss of momentum when thrown. It can rebound multiple times at full force before slowing down, and its sharp edge makes it an exceptionally effective projectile weapon—provided the wielder possesses the strength and skill to predict its trajectory accurately.

Beyond its physical capabilities, the shield symbolizes the core ideals upon which America is built and what all true patriots should strive for: truth, justice, freedom, and equality for all. 

Its rich history and profound symbolism imbue it with significant metaphysical weight, despite being entirely non-magical in nature. This unique characteristic could be exploited with the right power to great effect.
objects.title: Captain America Shield (Marvel)

objects.text: You are now the wielder of Gungnir, the "Spear of Heaven". An ancient weapon of vast power, in the form of a three pronged Uru spear. Once wielded by Odin Borson, it's various powers are now yours to command. Gungnir is capable of returning to your hands after being thrown, enhancing the power of your strikes, piercing through all but the toughest defenses, firing energy beams of considerable power, channeling and enhancing magical energies, and using the Bifrost for point to point teleportation at intergalactic ranges.
objects.title: Gungnir (Marvel)

objects.text:
Jarnbjorn was the Dwarven-forged battle axe composed of Asgardian Steel and created for one of the original members of the Valkyrior. After her disappearance it was stored in Asgard's armory and eventually taken up by Thor long before he obtained Mjolnir.

Forged by Dwarves, Jarnbjorn was naturally sharper than almost any Earthly weapon, and could cut virtually anything. In addition, Jarnbjorn had a charm placed on it that made it indestructible, it can be used to defend against any attack, even bursts of energy like Apocalypse's optic beam. 

During his time as the Axe's wielder, Thor placed an Enchantment on the blade that further increased its cutting capability, now capable of piercing a Celestial's armor.
objects.title: Jarnbjorn (Marvel)

objects.text:
Mjolnir is the enchanted hammer wielded by Marvel Thor.

The Uru hammer, which grants you many of his powers and abilities, forged by Eitri and the Dwarves of Nidavellir in the heart of a dying star, is enchanted, so it can only be wielded by those who are deemed "worthy" (if purchased, only you will be able to choose who can wield it).

Mjolnir is virtually indestructible. And would repair itself if destroyed or damaged, and it will always return to your hand no matter the distance through space and time.

The God Tempest's contained inside gives it unparalleled weather manipulation, flight, energy projection sensing, absorption and redirection, dimensional travel, and it also works as an unparalleled focus for your own power, with many more abilities.
objects.title: Mjolnir (Marvel)

addons.text:
Your ability to deny and lockdown psychic forces has meshed with your ability to cut through magical connections, allowing you to strip wards from a building and slice through spells denying their activation. 

With dedicated intent, you may reverse the Soulsword’s ability to channel magic and instead amplify your magically disruptive presence, crippling those reliant on ambient mana. Once your amplified aura is cast, nearly all magics, passive and active, cease to function near you.

Your magical talent has blossomed due to your awakened soul. You may feed portions of your aura into your spell work to reinforce it, making each spell more convincing to reality. 

Every spell and piece of magical knowledge you possess improves and soaks into your Soulsword, refining every individual spell to better fit your needs over time. 

Your ability to create new spells, safely at that, is astounding. Disastrous mistakes in magic can be avoided due to your new, deeper, awareness of your magic.

Through a masterful fusion, you have blended your Shehai and Soulsword. Swordsmanship is a part of your soul, granting you a peerless talent for the art. 

No longer are you restricted to affecting only supernatural entities with your blade. All techniques innate to the Shehai will be learned far faster, and the results will shine brighter than others. 

Divide the indivisible, force reality to buckle through sheer will and a determined cut of the sword, and become greater.

The Library of Heaven's Path has created a new partition inside of itself, one entirely dedicated to the discovery and progression of magic. Beyond destroying magical bonds and connections, the Soulsword will record every spell and magic you shatter, storing them inside your soul to be learned at a later date. 

Breaking down a spell lets you gain far more insight into the creation of a spell than if you were to learn on your own. You’ll find notes and past experiences of the spell to analyze on your own inside the Library of Heaven’s Path. 

By meditating on any spell you know, you may dive into its history, figuring out obscure uses and tricks created by other magic users.

objects.text:
A fragment of your soul has been shaped into a weapon that you can summon from your soul and recall at will, the Soulsword. 

Contrary to the name this weapon can take any form, as it represents your soul. As you change and grow as a person, you might find its form-changing, with critical events having the chance to result in far more drastic differences.

The Soulsword is entirely designed around harming the magical and supernatural, with it being of little use against mundane entities. Where you could slice through a dragon’s scales like warm butter, cutting a wood log would require a herculean effort for the same results. This specialization applies to even the ethereal and intangible, allowing you to strike spirits without physical form with no extra effort. 

Additionally, the Soulsword can counter and break spells, and potentially shatter any other supernatural means of control, transformation, and possession. With a dedicated cut, you could remove a distant psychic’s remote control over a present entity.

The final boon afforded to the wielder of the Soulsword is your soul’s awakening to its innate magical potential. While this doesn’t grant any magical knowledge, you’ll still be able to develop your own style of magic through devoted time and effort. 

Channeling your magic through the Soulsword will allow it to act as a conduit, enhancing and amplifying the strength of anything cast through it. This boost scales off the strength of your soul and magics known.
objects.title: Soulsword (Marvel)

addons.text:
The HF Muramasa, being the pinnacle example of pre-Dark Age of Technology weapon smithing, has been further upgraded with the best technology the Priests of Mars in the 40th millennium can muster.

This enhancement includes a further strengthening of the blade using a Ceramite coating and honing the edge to atomic precision akin to obsidian. The sword's High Frequency technology has been combined with a Power Sword Matter Disruption Field, which pushes the sword's lethality to nonsensical levels. This combination allows the sword to cut through just about anything like butter, and should it, by some stroke of Chaos, meet a material it cannot immediately cut, it is only a matter of time before it hits the target before its durability is reduced to nothing.

Should you also possess the <u>STC (Warhammer: 40k)</u> upgrade, the Muramasa will be even further improved with a material coating using the strongest meta materials possible from the Dark Age of Technology. Its Matter Disruption Field will also be even further empowered using Archeotech designs, turning it into an artifact of unprecedented power and value. Such a weapon would almost certainly see the entity of the Imperium of Mankind and the Mechanicus declare a Holy Crusade to claim it.
addons.title: Archeotech Muramasa

objects.text:
The HF (High Frequency) Muramasa is an ancient 16th-century master-craft Japanese katana reforged and upgraded with futuristic crafting techniques and High Frequency technology, transforming it into a one-of-a-kind weapon that mixes the best of ancient and futuristic techniques and technology.

This sword, on its own, is an extreme example of Japanese forging crafted by the legendary sword-smith Muramasa, which is leagues better than nearly any other sword from its time and even today with modern and advanced crafting techniques and materials. A certain mercenary further upgraded this weapon with futuristic crafting modifications, further improving its durability and cutting edge in addition to adding High Frequency technology, granting it the ability to resonate at extremely high vibration frequencies, allowing it to cut through all but the toughest meta materials with ease. 

Even if the sword should meet a material it cannot instantly cut through, it has the ability to weaken the atomic structure of whatever it hits, softening it until it too is easily able to be cut.

The Sword also comes with a customized sheath that can use high-caliber explosive blanks for unimaginably fast quick draws, further increasing its already ridiculous lethality.

While this sword is an exquisite example of mixing ancient and futuristic craftsmanship, it still possesses a few glaring limitations.

Unless the user possesses some form of physical enhancement, they will be unable to bring out the sword's full potential or be able to use the sheath's quick draw ability safely. Also, the sword requires energy to use its High Frequency ability, and the sheath requires specialized ammunition to be used. Thankfully, the sword comes with equipment that allows you to recharge it and craft more of its special ammunition, provided you gather the materials to use it.
objects.title: HF Muramasa (Metal Gear)

objects.text:
The Paralyzer is a compact, sleek energy sidearm carried by Samus Aran during missions where her Power Suit is unavailable. Originally developed as an emergency backup weapon, this auto-charging pistol fires condensed energy blasts designed to incapacitate rather than kill. Though non-lethal, it is far from useless—especially in the hands of someone with agility, precision, and timing.

By default, the Paralyzer fires weak energy bolts that are harmless to most enemies. However, when left to charge for two seconds, it unleashes a paralyzing shot capable of stunning even resilient foes for several seconds, leaving them open for escape or follow-up attacks. This function makes the Paralyzer invaluable for stealth, crowd control, or disabling high-speed or dangerous targets without permanent harm.

Its most notable ability, introduced in later refinements, is its modular transformation into a Plasma Whip, allowing for mid-range sweeping strikes, grappling, and acrobatic maneuverability. In combat, this whip can act as a crowd-control tool or even as a makeshift melee weapon in close quarters. The Paralyzer can also tether onto surfaces or ledges, functioning similarly to a grappling hook.

Although it lacks the overwhelming firepower of most legendary weapons, its utility, adaptability, and energy efficiency make it a reliable tool for infiltration, mobility, and tactical engagements.
objects.title: Paralyzer (Metroid)

objects.text: "I feel like I'm gonna break this damn thing" These were the words of a man who knew not of the power of this small gun. Provided by the Men in Black, this pistol is deceptively powerful, firing a sphere of energy that can penetrate a truck, concrete, and other similar materials. Unfortunately, the recoil and noise of the gun is quite immense, knocking an athletically fit man quite a few feet back and sounding like a magnified cricket noise respectively. Thankfully, your Noisy Cricket comes with an attachable "silencer," negating the kickback and noise.
objects.title: Noisy Cricket (Men In Black)

objects.text:
You have acquired dual chained swords with a bifurcated double-blade design, each blade measuring 60cm in length and ending in a pointed tip. Their aesthetic features a black and white yin-yang design. These are Mythological-class swords which, in their original universe, were classified as artifacts that are one step away from being truly divine objects or simply as semi-divine artifacts.

Their first function is the ability to control any type of elemental spirit regardless of the concept it embodies or its origins. There is no limit to the number of spirits you can command; however, it does not necessarily grant any form of multitasking ability. The wielder is not able to control spirits beyond their own power. Once controlled, the spirits become loyal to the wielder without altering their essence as individuals.

Their second function is the ability to create elemental spirits from any concept you can imagine. From a simple fire elemental to elemental beings that could embody time, immortality, or abstract concepts such as love, peace, and other denominations. The scope of creation is free, though it requires a certain amount of energy of any kind in proportion to what was imagined.

They are completely autonomous with their own appearance, personality, will, morality, and soul or alternatively, you can customize them. The level of intellect and knowledge of the elemental spirit reflects that of its creator. If the first function is used on your creations, they retain a certain level of autonomy and individuality but will be eternally loyal to you.

Their third function grants the benefit of receiving a single passive or active effect reflected in the concept it embodies for each spirit under your domain. For example, a fire elemental can grant you heat resistance as a passive effect or direct control of fire as an active one. However, the quality and expression of the benefit are directly proportional to the level of power of the wielder at the time the elemental spirit was created or a preexisting one was dominated.

Their fourth function is a passive effect that boosts the evolution and perfection of the base characteristics of the elemental spirits under your domain and of the third function. Thus improving their efficiency, power, range, and versatility.

Beyond its four functions, the Elemental Sword is not much different from a high-quality steel sword. However, it can also utilize the benefits of the third function at the cost that the wielder cannot access the specific benefit that was implemented. This is not permanent and can be modified.
objects.title: Elemental Swords (Mugen Gacha Level 9999)

objects.text:
The Dragon Blade is a formidable weapon, roughly the length of a man's arm and loosely shaped like a kunai. It is fiercely loyal to its wielder, always returning to their hand when called, and similar to the legendary sword Samehada, the Dragon Blade possesses the ability to cut and absorb chakra, and replenish its users reserves.

Accompanying the blade are five fist-sized elemental orbs, each representing one of the five primary elements: red for fire, blue for water, green for wind, yellow for lightning, and orange for earth. These orbs allow use of the swords most powerful feature, by swapping the orb seated in the blade's guard, the wielder can utilize any elemental technique they know of for the appropriate orb, regardless of their training or natural affinity.

Typically, wielding this weapon requires a high level of chakra. However, by purchasing the Dragon Blade here, this requirement is waived.

<small>Note: While this weapon is originally designed to work with chakra, in worlds with other supernatural energies you will find it just as capable with those.</small>
objects.title: Dragon Blade (Naruto)

objects.text:
This is the mystical sword utilized by the Seven Ninja Swordsmen of the Mist, regarded as the most terrifying out of all their blades. Samehada is unique for being a sentient weapon that gains nourishment from the Physical & Spiritual energy of others and shares a symbiotic relationship with its wielder. Samehada usually chooses its own user, but this has been changed such that Samehada views you as its one and only wielder. If someone else attempts to wield it without your permission, spikes will protrude from the handle to force them to release their grasp. If that's not enough, it will start draining them of their Physical & Spiritual energy at an increasing rate until they either let go or die, at which point Samehada will return to you.

Because of this bond, Samehada will constantly consume your Physical & Spiritual energy (though never enough to majorly hinder you). Its largest meals come from fights, where it absorbs the Physical & Spiritual energy of the opponent by slicing through them, stopping them from performing techniques that require such energies. It can also slice through techniques made of such energies and consume them. Due to its voracious appetite, Samehada is able to sense such energies and communicate when it senses them to you. It can also produce a mist veil through your blood. This enables it to absorb the chakra of anyone nearby through their open wounds.
