While the ability to absorb chakra is useful in defeating opponents, it is even more beneficial to you because of your bond with Samehada. Any energies it absorbs can be transferred to you, revitalizing your Physical & Spiritual energies, stamina, or even instantly healing fatal injuries.

Samehada's construction is atypical in that its actual blade is comprised of a series of downward-facing scales running along the entirety of its length until its hilt. As such, it inflicts injuries through shredding or shaving what it comes into contact with, rather than just cutting the object in question. Ordinarily, Samehada remains rigid, appearing as a large Greatsword covered in scales. Its hilt is able to stretch and bend to a great extent, allowing the weapon to be used like a flail. To supplement the blade's offensive capabilities, it is able to extend its scales to spikes. Samehada can also be used in conjunction with your physical and spiritual energy, leading to the sword glowing with energy and enhancing its various abilities. Samehada will grow larger in proportion to the amount of energy it absorbs, causing its scales to become so long that they ultimately resemble shark fins and its mouth, located at the tip of the blade, to become even more pronounced with visible teeth. Usually, its bandages help to inhibit this growth, but you will actually have full control of this transformation, able to choose its state as long as the proper energy is given for the larger forms.

Your bond with Samehada can be taken one step further by temporarily merging with it. You can receive some of Samehada's abilities, such as being able to extend spikes from your body and absorbing the physical & spiritual energies when others come into direct contact with you, as well as the ability to track such energies and avoid the senses of others.
objects.title: Samehada (Naruto)

addons.text:
Before you stands the Spear of Lucretius, a symbol of philosophy, crafted from roughly 0.39 seconds' worth of energy at the peak of an Impact, it rejects myth to uncover reality.

Inspired by a Roman philosopher's quest to test human observation, the Spear of Lucretius shares the Spear of Longinus' ability to easily pierce AT Fields, and similar esoteric defenses. This spear, like the Lance of Longinus, can shapeshift, regenerate, and easily achieve  FTL speeds when thrown for interstellar travel. But it also possesses its own set of distinctive traits.

While lacking a mind, the Spear of Lucretius can partially function autonomously, adapting and instantly shapeshifting against certain barriers. It might even defend its user automatically at times or abstain from attacking its master, if wielded by anyone else.

Despite its lack of sentience, the spear boasts an outstanding targeting system. It effortlessly predicts obstacles' movements, adjusting its trajectory as needed. This precision allows it to accurately strike a target, even if that target resides on the other side of the galaxy, a feat that other spears would struggle to achieve without precise calculations.

Representing philosophy rather than myth, the spear wields a unique effect on extradimensional and/or metaphysical entities and structures that diverge from the universe's "conventional" physics. This ability compels such entities to assume a physical, three-dimensional form that can be affected by more conventional means.

For instance, entities like Angel Leliel—described as a baffling entity existing in a pocket dimension defined solely by higher-order physics theories—could be forced into a physical, monstrous form made of shadow-like substance, enabling direct attacks.

Additionally, the spear can render invisible beings visible and intangible entities tangible again. Initially designed for use by an Evangelion, the spear can be persuaded to shapeshift into a smaller form for personal use.

Lastly, the Spear of Lucretius recognizes you as its master and can be summoned back to you at will. Should it be lost or destroyed, a new one will appear immediately.
addons.title: Spear of Lucretius

objects.text:
Seele created nine artificial replications of the original Lance of Longinus, known as Copy-Lances or Replica Spears. Interestingly, there was an additional one designed as a backup plan, which you managed to acquire. This Copy-Lance possesses the unique ability to shapeshift, transforming into a handheld tower shield, a highly destructive close combat weapon, or even just a bracelet you can wear in your civilian life. Unlike typical melee weapons used by Evangelions, it boasts far greater destructive potential. The weapon can alternate between its default spear form, a double-blade configuration, and other forms that may develop to suit different combat scenarios.

Retaining some of the metaphysical properties of the original spear, the Copy-Lance can regenerate from damage over time. It holds a special advantage against AT fields and similar soul-based barriers, rendering them vulnerable to its attacks. Notably, the weapon can also function partially autonomously, adapting instantaneously against certain barriers and occasionally defending its user on its own. It even possesses the ability to recognize and refrain from attacking its master (you), rejecting use by anyone else.

Importantly, this weapon carries a fragment of the original's power, but accessing it requires the wielder to be in a life-or-death situation.
objects.title: Discount Longinus (Neon Genesis Evangelion: Anima Jump)

objects.text:
You wield Curoch "The Sword of Power" and Iures "The Staff of Law", you now stand above the greatest mages to ever live, if you can survive the effort of using them. These twin artifacts were created by Jorsin Alkestes and Ezra the day before Jorsin's demise. Curoch, also called Sunderer, is said to give its wielder access to limitless power, but only the strongest mages can channel it without immediately perishing in a magical conflagration. Curoch can shift its form at will, from any weapon you can conceive into even armor pieces. Capable of cutting instantly through nearly anything, Curoch can deliver true death to even Immortal beings. The immense power of Curoch serves to amplify magic. Any magic channeled with this artifact will be multiplied 100 times over.
Iures, hidden as the blade Retribution for nearly a millennia by the Immortal Acaelus Thorne. The Staff of Law is capable of shifting its form at will. And serves as a peerless aid in the weaving of magic. It perfectly records any magic it encounters, and when channeling it allows the wielder to perform works of magic orders of magnitude more complex, at a fraction of the effort.
objects.title: Curoch and Iures (Night Angel)

objects.text:
You now possess one or multiple (up to a maximum of 3) Meito otherwise known as prize blades, They are weapons that are renowned for their quality and prestige, possessing incredible durability, sharpness, and for some even special powers or curses. 

The Meito could be in the form of whichever weapon you like and their quality would be equal to the 12 supreme grade blade like Mihawk Yoru or Whitebeard Murakumogiri. They could also possess abilities similar to Enma ability to draw out haki or be cursed like the Sandai Kitetsu. You could also choose for your blade to be a black blade or not.
objects.title: Meito (One Piece)

addons.text:
Your odd mix of bone steel and Stygian iron has had a synergistic effect. Your stygian iron has granted your bone steel the ability to have multiple attunements if you meet one simple requirement, if your blade holds that type of creature's essence. Alongside this, your blade still retains its ability to be attuned to a creature through their blood, possibly even tripling your damage.

Note: This effect does not stack based on the amount of essence your sword holds of that particular creature.
addons.title: Stygian Steel

addons.text: Your equipment made out of a divine metal was granted to you by your divine parent. Due to this being a gift, when using them, you have a closer connection to your parentage, with all your demi-god abilities being enhanced. Alongside this enhancement, you also gain a natural talent for using the equipment. Lastly, your weapon now gains the ability to return to you, akin to Riptide for Percy. If you are a demi-god with an underworld deity, then this equipment is automatically upgraded to Stygian Iron.
addons.title: Divine Gift

addons.text:
Instead of receiving a standard enchanted Celestial Bronze weapon, your strengthened bond with your divine parent can alternatively grant you a weakened replica of a divine artifact associated with them. While this replica lacks the full power of the original, it retains weakened versions of its abilities and grows stronger alongside your heritage and connection to your parent—though it can never match the original's true power. Each time you purchase Celestial Bronze, you may choose to receive an additional divine replica instead.

Note: This replica retains all features and upgrades of the original Celestial Bronze weapon in addition to its new abilities.
addons.title: Divine Replica

objects.text:
You have been given a weapon made out of celestial bronze that has the basic property of being nigh-indestructible, supernaturally sharp, harming only supernaturals, and being naturally invisible for normal people. Another feature this weapon specifically has is the ability to channel and slightly enhance any divine power channeled through the blade. Lastly, your weapon has been enchanted to have a more mobile and compact form, with some examples being a hairclip, a pen, or a golden coin.

If you choose a bow, you will receive a quiver full of arrows that will automatically return and repair any fired arrows after the battle is over. Your quiver automatically holds and contains 24 celestial bronze arrows and is enchanted to both have more space and to have a more compact form. If you buy this multiple times then your weapons can either be enchanted to one compact form, akin to Jason's Coin, or you can have multiple.

Alternatively, you can have it made out of Imperial Gold, which has the same properties.
objects.title: Celestial Bronze Weapon (Percy Jackson)

objects.text:
Now you possess Poseidon’s Trident, the legendary symbol of his power and authority as the god of the oceans. This three-pronged spear of celestial bronze was forged for the god by the Elder Cyclops during the rebellion against the Titans millennia ago.

The Trident allows its wielder to create and control water on a macroscopic scale, capable of generating entire bodies of water and bending them to their will in countless ways. It can be used to manipulate the weather, generate storms, hurricanes, and floods with little effort. It also enables the user to transform anything they can overpower into an object related to the sea or into a docile sea creature.

Every impact by the Trident’s tips delivers devastating shockwaves capable of destroying most objects and causing earthquakes. The wielder can channel their own energies through the spear, causing it to emit blasts of raw power.

Finally, the Trident is capable of changing its form to suit the wielder’s needs and shrouding itself in the Mist to disguise its form entirely when discretion is required.
objects.title: Poseidon's Trident (Percy Jackson)

objects.text:
The Master Bolt, which packs enough power to make mortal hydrogen bombs look like firecrackers.

Chiron

In your hands now lies the Master Bolt, the symbol of Zeus’s authority and power, from which all other lightning bolts are patterned. It is the first and most powerful weapon forged by the Elder Cyclopes for the Olympians during the first Titanomachy. The Master Bolt is a two-foot-long cylinder of Celestial Bronze, capped on both ends with divine electrical explosives. Its power is said to “make hydrogen bombs look like firecrackers.” When activated, the ends generate crystallized electrical bolts, making it resemble a classical lightning bolt. The weapon allows the user to generate—and control—a nearly infinite amount of lightning, even while held in the user’s hand. When thrown, its blasts “light up the world,” with the impact being felt many miles away. Once the Master Bolt hits its target, it is capable of returning to the user’s hand with only a thought.
objects.title: The Master Bolt (Percy Jackson)

objects.text:
Forged in legend and whispered to have originated in the lost city of Atlantis, the Sword of Triton is a weapon of unmatched nautical might. Its power flows from the sapphire set into its hilt, granting its wielder unparalleled dominion over the sea and its vessels.

With but a thought, the wielder can command any ship within sight—turning its sails, steering its rudder, firing its cannons, and even summoning favorable winds to carry it forth. On the open seas, this blade makes its bearer nearly unstoppable.

Beyond mastery of ships, the sword carries another arcane gift: the ability to shrink captured vessels into glass bottles. These bottled ships may be kept as trophies or unleashed later as part of the wielder’s fleet.

However, its power is not without limits. The wielder must maintain direct line of sight to control a ship, and the sword’s influence temporarily weakens the longer it remains away from the presence of ships.
objects.title: Sword of Triton (Pirates of the Caribbean)

objects.text:
An Odachi of impeccable quality, Arayashiki is a relic blade which forever severs all it comes into contact with. Any wounds inflicted by this blade will reopen in its presence. Scars will bleed anew, prosthetics will shatter, and wounds will forever burn with an implacable fire.

However, this power comes at a cost. For every swing of its pristine blade, parts of the user's own memories will be severed as well, starting with ones the wielder cherishes most. The user's mind will be cut so cleanly that it's impossible to tell what memories were erased. It is not impossible to regain memories torn by Arayashiki, but it is exceedingly difficult to do so and a hopeless endeavor without external help or magic.

But should a wielder abandon their self, and walk the path of Ashura, then they shall gain incredible power. By cleaving away all which matters to them, the user will attain a state of non-self, a hollow thing whose only purpose is to cut. It is within this state of complete emptiness in which the true power of Arayashiki is laid bare, the power to destroy concepts. With each slash of the blade, Arayashiki will begin to erase the target from existence. Everything which makes up a person will be carved out, starting with skills and memories, then eventually culminating in the complete and total removal of the target from reality, even annihilating the memory of them. 

Arayashiki is in essence, a Concept Incinerator shaped into the form of a blade.
objects.title: Tiansha Star's Blade - Arayashiki (Project Moon)

addons.text: Endless has spawned a suitable weapon for its master, improving upon every aspect of its predecessor. Neo Decalogue retains Decalogue's ten forms, however the power of each form is magnified by a factor of ten, allowing Dark Explosion to destroy a fortified tower with a single swing, Dark Mel Force to blow away a tornado with a single blast of air, and letting Dark Emilia's aura of darkness expand to an area large enough to cover a city.
addons.title: Neo Decalogue

objects.text:
You wield the Dark Bring Sword Decalogue, a sword that you will instinctively wield with masterful skill even if you've never held a weapon before. Additionally Decalogue has a total of ten forms you can wield, with training even using the abilities of multiple forms simultaneously to unleash combination attacks.

1. Eisenmeteor, Decalogue's default form. An extremely wide blade that, other than the typical durability shared by all Dark Brings, has no special abilities.

2 Explosion. A blunt longsword that creates explosions on impact.

3. Silfarion. A rectangular blade that makes you lighter, allowing you to move and attack at an extreme speed. Though due to the lightening of your body the power of each individual attack actually decreases.

4. Runesave. A jagged blade that cannot harm physical objects that could be damaged by a conventional blade. In return, it can cut things that cannot normally be affected by a blade, such as water, electricity, or fire. Additionally it can temporary seal abilities of whatever is cut.

5. Blue Crimson. A pair of swords, one generating flames while the other generates ice. They can be used both in melee-combat and at range.

6. Mel Force. An extremely short blade that can manipulate the air, primarily in the form of powerful blasts that send enemies flying.

7. Gravity Core. An extremely broad and heavy blade that can manipulate its own gravity in order to make itself even heavier, able to cleave through almost anything thanks to its immense weight. Though this same weight makes it somewhat cumbersome to wield for more than brief moments.

8. Million Suns. Somewhat misleadingly named, a blade of pure darkness that actively smothers all light in its vicinity, making it particularly effective against light-based powers.

9. Sacrifar. A vaguely scimitar-like blade that suppressed all of its wielder's emotions other than rage while in return granting immense strength and speed. Difficult to control, this blade can with extended use actually physically damage its wielder as the hilt gradually grows and attempts to fuse with and absorb the wielder bit by bit, leaving lingering pain and possibly even crippling injuries if used extensively but not controlled absolutely.

10. Emilia. Final and strongest form of Decalogue, this one actually requires time and familiarity with Decalogue to unlock. Increases the user's physical abilities and reflexes to an even greater extent than Sacrifar, Emilia's greatest ability is the aura of metaphorical darkness it radiates. Unlike Million Suns this is not physical darkness, but instead a field of negative energy that will strengthen any debilitating, crippling or otherwise curse-like effects used around it while reducing the effectiveness of beneficial abilities like healing or strengthening. This darkness also seeps into the minds of those around them, sapping courage and hope while instilling feelings of dread and despair in the enemy.
objects.title: Decalogue (Rave Master)

objects.text:
You wield a heavy, dark gray metallic, black lined aspis shield that initially appears as a solid defensive tool but conceals multiple mechanical functions beneath its surface.

You can extend the shield by a chain to launch it at opponents, and the center portion lifts up to reveal multiple spinning blades that emerge for close-range offense; the two halves around the center can detach into six spider-like legs that reassemble into a large metal ball, which extends a handle to give you a large hammer in one hand while the shrunken shield remains in the other, both connected by the chain.

Once the shield has taken enough damage, its entire metallic covering breaks apart to reveal a standard-looking aspis shield underneath engraved with a lambda, and a dark aura emits from it; when activated, you perform a straightforward charge at your opponent that creates a shockwave, representing the essence of Sparta's Phalanx as an unceasing and unrelenting offensive charge that pierces straight ahead like a spear.

This shield counts as a Völundr, meaning it is magically attuned to you as its wielder, and you may optionally include the Valkyrie Geirölul as a companion or use the shield without her.
objects.title: Aspis Shield - Geirölul (Record of Ragnarok)

objects.text:
In your possession is a case roughly the size of a cigarette pack, containing ten white, infinitely thin two-dimensional sheets in a protective electromagnetic field. Each sheet, known as a dual-vector foil, upon collapse of its protective field, will begin reducing the surrounding three-dimensional space into two dimensions, with the result briefly looking like a flat picture of the area that previously occupied the collapsed space until the residual light scatters. This results in total annihilation of all matter and energy caught in the collapse.

The collapse is accompanied by a spatial distortion and is preceded by a collapse front a few light-years in diameter. It is possible to escape the collapse for objects moving just at or above lightspeed.

By taking one sheet, you can mentally set the destination where it must detonate, at which point it will travel there at the speed of light before beginning the dimensional reduction, which expands almost at lightspeed in all directions. Unlike the original dual-vector foil used by the Abyss-Gazers, you can also set the effective radius of the dimensional reduction, ensuring that using the foil will not, in time, destroy the entire universe.

Do note that you do not possess any inherent immunity to the dimensional reduction.
objects.title: Dual-Vector Foil (Remembrance of Earth's Past)

objects.text:
You gain the nameless sword of the nameless samurai warrior known as Jack. It is a holy katana that was forged by the three gods Odin, Ra, and Rama for the sole purpose of destroying the evil Aku.

It is unbreakable and will never lose its edge, it is extremely adept at destroying evil and will not harm the innocent or pure hearted. 

You are a master of all forms of combat. From swordfighting to archery to staff fighting, horse riding and everything in-between.

You are also now frozen at the age of 25, never able to age past that. (If you are younger you won't be frozen until you reach 25, if you are older you are de aged)
objects.title: Jack's Sword (Samurai Jack)

objects.text:
Forged in an age long forgotten, the Gungnir, the Godless Lance, the Spear of the Non-Believer is a weapon of absolute negation, crafted by the hands of the first man, Adam el Asem, to pierce the divine itself. Said to have been wielded by those who defied gods and rejected the will of higher powers, this spear carries an unfathomable presence—one that denies the very concept of faith and supernatural authority. It is a weapon that does not recognize gods, spirits, or eldritch entities, treating them as nothing more than flesh and bone.

One of the spear’s most terrifying attributes is its ability to bypass all supernatural defenses. No divine protection, mystical barrier, or anomalous regeneration can resist its strike. Miracles unravel, spells collapse, and deific forms shatter beneath its touch. To those who wield divine power, even standing in its presence is agonizing, as it suppresses and nullifies their very essence. Only one with the absolute resolve to defy the divine can truly wield it, and you are among the chosen few.

At the start, the Spear of the Non-Believer grants you the strength to pierce through supernatural creatures with ease, the reflexes to counter divine strikes, and the endurance to withstand attacks meant to obliterate lesser beings. Your willpower is unbreakable, rendering you immune to mind control, fear, and faith-based abilities. Over time, the spear’s influence will deepen, allowing you to sever the connections between deities and their followers, nullify entire pantheons’ powers, and erase the very existence of supernatural phenomena in your vicinity. 

Eventually, you will reach the pinnacle of god-slaying, able to dismantle divine realms, erase noosphere beings from reality, and fight on equal footing with the greatest of eldritch beings. In the end, you will embody the ultimate defiance—a force that gods themselves will fear, for even the divine must bow before a man
objects.title: The Spear of Non-Believer (SCP Foundation)

objects.text:
The Mortal Blade, a relic of unfathomable power, stands as a testament to the convergence of life and death, granting its wielder dominion over both. This extraordinary weapon combines the essence of the Red Mortal Blade, capable of vanquishing the undying, and the Black Mortal Blade, with its ability to open portals to the afterlife and restore individuals in their prime.

As the chosen owner of this mythical blade, you possess unparalleled expertise in wielding it, effortlessly mastering its deadly techniques. The art of Mortal Draw becomes second nature to you, allowing you to draw the blade that cannot be drawn, unleashing devastating waves of destruction upon your foes. With a single swift motion, the blade cleaves through enemies, leaving behind a reddish-black, noxious mist that engulfs the battlefield. This seeping mist extends the range of the Mortal Blade, ensuring that no adversary can escape its reach.

In your hands, the Mortal Blade embodies both the power to sever the lifelines of the undying and the ability to harness the forces of the afterlife. With each swing, you channel the primordial forces of life and death, striking fear into the hearts of even the most formidable opponents. Your command over this extraordinary weapon grants you the capability to pierce through the defenses of the undying, casting them into eternal oblivion.
objects.title: The Mortal Blade (Sekiro)

objects.text:
The Longinus Lance Testament, an enigmatic relic known as the Spear of Destiny, possesses unimaginable power. However, its potency at the beginning is severely weakened, requiring time to reach its full potential, although you will find that taking lives with the Longinus Lance Testament grants it more power. As the chosen bearer you are able to handle this weapon with incredible ease. You will find that you are able to control whether others will barely be able to handle this weapon without being eradicated, or whether they are able to handle it just as well as you.

Initially, you embody a mere shadow of its true power, with limited speed, precision, and force. But as time progresses or through the sacrifice of countless souls, the relic's might grows. Swift as a fleeting shadow, it hones in on its target, always faster and unfaltering. Its all-killing essence eradicates enemies physically, spiritually, and conceptually. Unleashing beams of radiant light, it incinerates all, defying the laws of existence.

Distance holds no dominion over you as the relic pierces through dimensions, rendering even the strongest beings vulnerable. As the bearer, you hold the key to unlock the full potential of the Longinus Lance Testament.
objects.title: Longinus Lance Testament (Shinza Bansho)

addons.text: Using the sheath of another Excalibur as a catalyst, you've managed to bring the Scabbard of Excalibur back into reality. With both scabbards in hand, you have become, unquestionably, an unstoppable force in close-quarters combat. The Scabbard itself offers many benefits similar to Avalon, such as regeneration fast enough to heal wounds mid-combat and boost to your durability that would be often mistaken for near-invulnerability. While not as much as the aforementioned, the Scabbard also enhances your other attributes as well, increasing your strength and speed twofold. All of this would be yours to use as you see fit… if they hadn't fused into something new the moment the Scabbard came into contact with Avalon. A new scabbard for Deathcalibur, Inferno, takes the boons of both and blends them together, making it better than the sum of its parts. The regenerative immortality offered by Avalon further enhances the regeneration from the Scabbard, healing the worst of wounds in mere seconds. In turn, the Scabbard spreads Avalon's protections to mirror its own enhancements, boosting your power, speed, and durability threefold so long as you have Inferno on your person. With a perfect scabbard for this stygian blade, none could stand before you as you claim your birthright. All hail the True King, the Black Knight, Arthur.
addons.title: Inferno, Scabbard of Deathcalibur

objects.text:
You have been chosen to bear the mantle of the false king, the illusion of King Arthur made by the mage Merlina. His personal armory uses you as an anchor to reality, giving them true existence where they once had none. However, the Scabbard of Excalibur remains out of reach, the one true part of the false Arthur becoming immaterial. Deathcalibur has in exchange chosen you as its new wielder. If you do not have the ability to use it properly, you will inherit the strength, experience, and skill of the False King Arthur, the so-called ‘Black Knight’.

Deathcalibur, a large and powerful greatsword that makes all other blades look even smaller in comparison, has a sharp edge infused with dark magics. Besides boasting a nigh-unmatched ability to cut and slice, this allows the wielder to cleave open portals to The Underworld, summoning minions and monsters to do your bidding. It can also be used as a focus to channel and amplify magic, harboring a notable affinity for dark magic.

Along with it came the Black Knight's armor and his infernal steed. The horse of the Black Knight is made entirely of dark magic and is capable of extreme speeds, able to barely keep up with Sonic the Hedgehog. They are also able to fly, giving off the appearance that it's merely galloping in the air. Meanwhile, the Black Knight's armor, made by the best Camelot could offer, could protect him from normally very dangerous attacks, even if the armor was very heavy in exchange. Even swords that rivalled the fame and might of Deathcalibur, such as Caliburn, had difficulty piercing through the armor.

Take these gifts and ride onwards, New King. Go forth and make the realm tremble before your dark powers.
objects.title: Armory of the False King (Sonic the Hedgehog)

addons.text:
Caliburn finally acknowledged your potential after being upgraded alongside the 108 Skills. Gaining every skill, combat style, and title from Sonic and the Black Knight. Well not really, you still need to unlock them first 

You start as a Level 1 - "Knave" and can work your way up to Level 10 - "Knight of the Round Table". As you progress in titles, you'll eventually unlock more skills and the 3 combat styles: Knight Style, Cavalier Style, and Paladin Style. All of which you can blend and switch at anytime, and gain the buffs each skill provides. 

You can develop new skills based on your own powers, what you need, or by copying the ones from those around you.
addons.title: Blacksmith

addons.text:
You can assume the Excalibur Form when absorbing the Chaos Emeralds. It's similar in strength to your Super Form, with some unique abilities. 

You're dawned in brilliant golden armor that will make King Arthur himself blush, and Caliburn transforms into the greatest of the Sacred Swords, Excalibur. Due to gaining the properties of your Super Form, there's nothing Excalibur can't cut through, and your armor is just as impenetrable.

Your arsenal of swordsmanship extends not just to Sonic, but the Knights of the Round Table, able to wield Excalibur in the same way they do their own Sacred Swords, and even become them, down to their variants of the Soul Surge. With Sir Lancelot's having teleportation, Sir Gawain's to throw your sword with nigh-absolute accuracy and return to you, and Sir Percival's flame tornado.
addons.title: Excalibur

addons.text:
You gain access to the Sacred Swords of Sir Gawain, Sir Lancelot, and Sir Percival: Arondight, Galatine, and Laevatein. You can swap between each on the fly, dual wield, and even triple wield them. 

Each sword has their own unique merits, combat styles, and skills to unlock. If you have the Blacksmith addon, you can apply any skills there to them, as if each sword is one of four loadouts. 

Instead of just the sword techniques of each knight, you also gain their powers, such as Lancelot's chaos powers, Percival's pyrokinesis, Gawain's glide, and burrowing underground. (To a lesser version if you don't have Fastest Thing Alive). Finally, by fusing these swords into Caliburn, you can transform him into Excalibur, and gain the armor alongside it.

Excalibur can't use it's full power without the Chaos Emeralds.
addons.title: King Arthur

objects.text:
Ever wanted a talking sword as a companion? Well now you do! After proving your worth by pulling him out of a rock, the first thing he does is call you a Knave. You can wield Caliburn on the same level as a master swordsman. Regardless of whether you're standing still, on the move, performing acrobatics, or simply showing off.

You can also perform all of Sonic's techniques during the events of Black Knight. From simple yet effective swings, air dashes, wall jumping, rail grinding, summoning a shield when guarding, curling into a ball while in the air, and slicing through hoards of enemies in a manner akin to the Homing Attack

Your greatest ability is the Soul Surge. A technique that allows you to slash through endless hoards of enemies or obstacles, parry projectiles or attacks, and rapidly assault a single target. All while moving at speeds comparable to the blue blur himself. But also consumes your stamina, or other energy reserves until you either halt the process or are depleted. (This is omitted if you possess the Soul Gauge Addon under Fastest Thing Alive).

Caliburn can also levitate and keep up with you if you're not wielding him.
objects.title: Caliburn (Sonic the Hedgehog)

objects.text:
Once an ordinary sword made by a nameless blacksmith, it was bathed in hatred, death, and blood. With such acts of evil, a malevolent spirit, Inferno, was created and now resides inside the blade. The Ultimate Sword, Soul Edge, has found its way into your hands.

Soul Edge is capable of increasing your power by leaps and bounds when you hold it, at the cost of draining your lifeforce at an equally alarming pace. Soul Edge can also shapeshift, changing its form to suit their wielder's fighting style. Many who hold it are unable to wield the blade for long, eventually being 'consumed’ by the blade and drained of all their worth. Those who don’t possess extremely strong wills or minds may end up being possessed by the blade, going on killing sprees so that it may devour as many souls as it can to empower itself.

A notable quality of Soul Edge is the nature of its fragments, pieces of the Evil Blade that can be broken off and used by others. If someone finds a fragment, they can become infected by its dark powers and become what is known as a Malfested. These fragments feed off of its host's bloodlust and darkest desires, manipulating their actions to have their wielder take the souls of those they defeat in battle so as to further strengthen themselves.

All of these shards can be fused back into Soul Edge without issue, but they cannot be summoned to you, meaning you must retrieve them yourself. Should you prove yourself against the blade's curse in a test of wills, you can use its full power, and all who bear its shards are subservient to you. However, for every fragment that is created, Soul Edge is rendered 'incomplete’ and is weakened little by little for being such.
objects.title: Soul Edge (Soulcalibur)

addons.text: Instead of the High-Tech weapon favored by the Jedi and Sith, you can choose to accept this, the legendary sword of Tobirama Senju, known as the Raijin no Ken. This sword bears a superficial resemblance to a lightsaber, both in appearance and capability, but its true power lies in its mastery over lightning. The Raijin no Ken generates a blade of lightning to wield against your enemies. The Raijin’s blade has the ability deliver a variety of shocks to whoever or whatever it contacts—from subtle surprises that jolt and disorient, to powerful paralyzing currents that immobilize muscles, all the way to lethal jolts capable of stopping a heart in an instant. The Raijin is also capable of defensive use, able to channel its electricity into the air to block incoming attacks. Note: If you have the Ninja Tools add-on, you will have the ability to recreate this sword, or variants on it as you see fit.
addons.title: Raijin no Ken (Naruto)

addons.text: Instead of an ordinary lightsaber, you can choose any lightsaber variant from the Star Wars universe or create an original version based on the franchise's known designs if you wish.
addons.title: Weapon Of A More Civilized Age
Gimmicks for Days!
addons.text:
By connecting the Trick Ammo pouch to your lightsaber you can morph any number of lightsaber 'gimmicks' through it. From the humble saber-staff, to lightsabers with crossguards and the Inquisitor's blender-sabers, to phase-shift lightsabers, and even stranger options. In order to shift from one to the other you'd need to deactivate your lightsaber first before activating again to modify it.

Additionally, you can shift the colour of your saber as you please, but this is ultimately secondary to your unveiling of some form of Doohickey when the opponent was expecting a normal fight.

objects.text:
The lightsaber was a weapon usually used by the Jedi, Sith, Force-sensitive Mandalorians, and other Force-sensitives. Lightsabers consisted of a plasma blade, powered by a kyber crystal, that was emitted from a usually metal hilt and could be shut off at will. It was a weapon that required skill and training and was greatly enhanced when used in conjunction with the Force. Though also used by the Sith, the lightsaber was synonymous with the Jedi, with some in the galaxy believing only Jedi could use lightsabers.

A lightsaber could cut through virtually anything, from flesh to blast doors. The only way to block the incoming attack of a lightsaber was with a weapon made with material that conducted energy, such as an electrostaff, a Z6 riot control baton, some rare metals like beskar, or another lightsaber.
objects.title: Lightsaber (Star Wars)

objects.text:
You have been given a high carbon stainless steel knife that looks completely ordinary, except for ancient markings carved into the flat of the blade. Enchanted through a long-forgotten ritual, it can permanently destroy demons or related beings by striking them or their host in a vital area. Wounds that don’t kill still heal much more slowly and cause intense pain, often enough to disrupt possession entirely.

In addition, the knife can pierce most demonic defenses and harm entities in their spiritual form. While it is lethal to common demons, it is far less effective against stronger ones, which it can only wound or weaken rather than destroy.

By studying the blade and the magic bound within, you may eventually learn how to create more weapons capable of killing demonic entities.

Note: You may choose the knife’s style or appearance.
objects.title: Demon-Killing Knife (Supernatural)

addons.text:
The Colt has been upgraded into an unimaginably powerful mystic code gaining the abilities of the original Black Barrel of Atlas. It now has the conceptual ability to impose a finite lifespan onto its targets, rendering them mortal. This works by destroying all forms of supernatural energy at a conceptual level.

In any environment rich in supernatural energies The Black Colt will be even further empowered without any danger of overloading. 

While The Colt still needs special ammo to reach its full power it can now 
also fire blasts of magic partially infused with its conceptional powers. While these blasts are much weaker you can freely modify their power based on the amount of magic and energy used.
Lastly, any limits The Colt had on what it could kill are completely and utterly removed. 

Have fun killing the most powerful beings in existence.
addons.title: The Black Colt

objects.text:
The Colt is a mysterious Colt Paterson 1836 modified to fire modern cartridge bullets rather than a percussion cap and ball. It was created by Samuel Colt in 1835 under the light of Hailey's Comet and through other unknown methods. Alongside it, 13 special bullets were created which when fired from the gun kill nearly anything with few exceptions. 

These exceptions include the most powerful and ancient deities and concepts such as Biblical God, The Darkness, Death, and the strongest Archangels and Archdemons. However, those last two can be injured with one bullet and killed if more are used. In more general terms any being which is high multiversal or conceptional in nature cannot be killed by this gun.

You are also given the instructions for creating more bullets. However, the ritual requires “a spark of true divinity” which may prove challenging to acquire without having access from elsewhere in the cyoa.
objects.title: The Colt (Supernatural)

objects.text:
Created by the Seas and wielded by the most noble farran, you hold the fabled weapon last wielded by the Wraith and Wanderer to slay Tor Namun.

This swords most basic ability is to let the wielder surf just above liquid-like matter, and going much faster the more water-like it is. On solid surfaces you may be capable of only going faster than a car, yet on water you would be able to reach speeds surpassing that of a jet. It also allows you to form a trail of water in mid air to fly, though only for a few seconds.

The sword is extremely durable and strong, able to easily shatter large boulders with no loss of momentum and handle anything short of blocking attacks from a god.

It can also restore life to dead oceans, though only in small areas at a time.
objects.title: Sword of the Sea (Sword of the Sea)

objects.text:
The Material Blades are a legendary pair of twin swords, known as the Vorpal Sword and the Flamberge. Each was forged by master craftsmen and infused with ancient elemental magic. While powerful individually, they are meant to be wielded together. In unison, they unleash powerful techniques and spellworks far beyond what either blade could achieve alone.

The Vorpal Sword, with its blade resembling eternally frozen ice, channels potent ice magic to pierce enchanted barriers and magical defenses. The Flamberge, appearing as a sword of perpetual flame, burns with searing fire magic to slice through the strongest of physical armors. Together, they balance one another, capable of slicing through nearly any defense, whether magical or physical.

These swords do not decay. They will never rust, dull, or shatter. Yet their power is only a fragment of something far greater, a vital component in the creation of the The Eternal Sword. However, the Material Blades are not enough to being form to such a cosmic weapon.
objects.title: The Material Blades (Tales of: Symphonia)

addons.text:
The very few limitations on the revolver can now be lifted through modification! Tired of working with only 6 shots? Well now you can mod your gun to be like the Caldwell Chain Pistol from Hunt: Showdown and have 18 shots instead of a measly 6! 

That's not all though as you can now create your own bullets with various effects! Don't like how the shield is domed and prevents things and objects from getting in and out? Well you can change it to be a wall that can prevent things from going in but not out. Or something absurd like a bullet that shoots eagles that attack whatever you were aiming at until it dies or gets destroyed or you call it off to which it disappears. Note that you can only create up to 50 total bullet types including your current ones, you can get rid of other bullets to make room for different ones including your starting ones but can never go over 50 total.

Like what you already have but think you don't need all 38 bullet types? Then sacrifice some to empower others! The effects stack multiplicatively as well and can be undone but losing the boost as well. You cannot add more bullet types if there are sacrificed ones until you undo it and remove it individually.
addons.title: W8RKSH8P

objects.text:
Through some means or another you were granted the EV3ERYTHING REV8LVER!

This revolver as the name entails, shoots just about everything! From your classic bullets of choice in caliber, to a fully automatic minigun that can spray for a full 5 seconds from a single “bullet”. Note anything that shoots for a period of time can be stopped mid way and continued with the remaining time left, so 1 second of shooting and stopping leaves you with 4 seconds left for next time.

You'll gain a hud of the various bullets you can shoot for a total of 38 types but only 6 slots to use. You'll be able to individually select each bullet to load or pick one to load all 6 slots instantly. With this you'll also instinctively know what's loaded and what's currently chambered.

The bullets you can use can range from a simple bullet as expected to spawning random props or items that exist in your current world, railgun shots, a temporary shield, a bounce pad, a mini slow moving controlled blackhole that disappears after 10 seconds, or even a rhythm bullet that plays music once chambered and only shoots if you pull the trigger on a beat. 

As for ammo it's infinite so you'll be able to be able to load your gun as much as you want with different combinations or if your happy with your current set up, twirl it to reload it instantly.

As a bonus it can take the form of any revolver at will but only for looks.
objects.title: EV3RYTHING REV8LVER (Teardown Mod)

objects.text:
A sword designed by Ch'rell, the Utrom Shredder. This blade was crafted from extraterrestrial Utrom metal, forged by the greatest sword smiths of Feudal Japan. Later it was imbued with mystical power, becoming a weapon that was potent mix of science and sorcery.

The entire blade is constantly oscillating, when swung it can unleash sonic waves that have the potential to obliterate anything or anyone in their path. The hilt of the blade acts as the power source for the Utrom metal, it is designed to shock anyone that tries to wield the weapon, you receive special gauntlets to protect your hands from this electricity.

The metal that makes up the blade reacts in the presence of similar substances, allowing its wielder to track down Utrom technology.
objects.title: Sword of Tengu (Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles)

objects.text:
Forged from a shard of eternity itself, the Ark of the Cosmos is a monumental, indestructible scissor-shaped sword, its twin blades seemingly displaying an endless starry expanse within.

The Ark is an autonomous, sentient, floating weapon, rarely needing to be held. Usually hovering next to its bearer, it silently surveys its surroundings, acting as a vigilant sentry and positioning itself instinctively in response to danger.

The Ark exists fractionally out of phase with linear time, granting it the capacity for preemptive action. If an opponent attempts to harm the wielder, the Ark will travel back in time to intercept the strike, temporarily creating multiple instances of itself.

Not limited to time alone, the Ark of the Cosmos can split the fabric of space with precision, opening portals across vast distances, bypassing otherwise impossible barriers, or simply hiding between spaces while not summoned.

As its final and most feared function, the Ark can collapse and cut through dimensions themselves. A single use of its power may fold a three-dimensional existence into a two-dimensional remnant. Subsequent uses will compress that remnant into a zero-dimensional singularity, erasing it entirely in a flash of light reminiscent of a Big Rip, denying its existence and leaving nothing to which it may return.
objects.title: The Ark of The Cosmos (Terraria)

objects.text: The Devil went down to Georgia. He was lookin’ for a soul to steal... It seems you’ve come into possession of the Devil’s Golden Fiddle. Or perhaps more accurately, Johnny’s Golden Fiddle. With this in hand, you become the best there’s ever been. As its new owner, you gain the legendary skill of Johnny, the man who defeated the Devil in three separate fiddle contests. Your skill with the fiddle becomes supernatural. While that’s impressive, the real benefit of this magical golden fiddle is its infernal power. It allows you to summon and control demons to aid in your musical performances, whether as backup musicians, assistants, or supernatural support for your craft. The fiddle also greatly enhances all bardic and musical abilities. At a baseline, any music-based powers, spells, or effects you use are roughly three times as strong while wielding it. With training, preparation, and better coordination with the demons the fiddle can summon, this enhancement can be increased even further. Despite summoning and controlling demons, and despite coming from the Devil himself, the Golden Fiddle is not considered a Cursed or Demonic artifact. It carries no hidden curses, no corruptive influence, and no mental compulsions forcing its owner to use it. If you leave it unattended, the worst thing that will happen is that it’ll need to be tuned.
objects.title: The Golden Fiddle (The Devil Went Down to Georgia)

objects.text:
"Mortals call it Dawnbreaker, for it was forged in a holy light that breaks upon my foes, burning away corruption and false life.”

Dawnbreaker is a Daedric artifact created by the Daedric Prince Meridia. It appears as a longsword with a distinctive light-emitting crystal in its cross-guard, known as the Dawnstar Gem. Crafted to 'burn away corruption and false life,' it is especially effective against Meridia's foes, primarily targeting the undead, but also affecting Daedra and werewolves.

This artifact possesses power far beyond that of mundane weapons due to its Daedric nature, incorporating conceptual and magical elements. The sword inflicts magical and fire damage upon its targets, with additional damage to Meridia's enemies. When an undead creature or any being Meridia categorizes as 'false life' is slain by Dawnbreaker, it may trigger a fiery explosion that incinerates all other similar creatures within its radius. If any such creatures survive the explosion, they will be forced to flee.
objects.title: Dawnbreaker (The Elder Scrolls)

objects.text: The Hammer of Might is a potent force on any battlefield. A massive Ebony hammer, blessed by the Daedra Malacath. It grants its wielder the strength to demolish the walls of enemy keeps with ease, and durability to match. Volendrung is enchanted with the ability to paralyze foes and can be used to bolster the capabilities and resolve of your allies.
objects.title: Volendrung (The Elder Scrolls)

objects.text:
You have gained possession of the exceedingly powerful artifact, The Reaper's Scythe.

The most notable abilities of The Reaper's Scythe are its ability to cut through anything and leave behind permanent wounds. For example, the scythe's blade could cut open tears in the fabric of reality and permanently remove a detachable head. This ability is based on intent, though, as accidental cuts do not exhibit the same properties. 

Another notable ability possessed by the scythe is the ability to create openings to the afterlife, usually for the Reaper to guide the departed there, but it can be used to summon an army of the dead.

Besides its primary capabilities, the scythe has a myriad of additional capabilities, granting it a great deal of versatility. In particular, it has the following abilities: creating Inter-and-extra dimensional rifts in space and time for travel, casting spells, firing energy blasts, deflecting energy blasts, creating protective barriers, and its handle could even be used like a light-saber.

The main caveat to The Reaper's Scythe's great power is the enforcing of promises or oaths you've made with another, such that you may never break them if you wish to wield the scythe's power.
objects.title: The Reaper's Scythe (The Grim Adventures of Billy and Mandy)

objects.text:
These are the signature weapons of Mori Jin also known as Mori Dan/Son Wukong, The Great Sage, Equal to Heaven. These are some of the strongest weapons of the gods, for each one is made from the bones of a Dragon King and then infused with their spirit, making them nigh invulnerable to everything except battles with the most supreme of gods, such as Satan 666 (also known as Lucifer) and the Jade Emperor with his sword that can cut through anything.

The completed Yeoui, made famous as the Ruyi Jingu Bang, is the simplest of the staffs but also the strongest of the Dragon Staffs in pure durability. It is crafted from the bones of Orge, the very first and strongest Dragon King. This staff is so heavy that even the Archangel Uriel, who can casually lift 80,000,000 tons, had her arms torn off when trying to catch it. Though it is able to change its weight at the owner's whim, this also extends to its size, which changes freely. It can grow broader, slimmer, taller, or shorter, and can reach incredible lengths—such as easily reaching the Moon from Earth—or become as small as a pencil. Yeoui can also clone itself, though the clones are much weaker than the original (though they are not to be underestimated, as they can still be used in combat with high-level gods).

While the exact abilities of all the other Yeouiju are unknown, what is known is that they all share the ability to change size (though to a lesser extent than the first), immense durability, and the ability to levitate and be controlled remotely. The last user of the 20 Yeouiju demonstrated that the staff can control lightning, ice, nature, water, flames, and more.

All the staffs can be summoned to their user, no matter the distance, if they are in the same realm, and will break through anything between them and their user in seconds. If you are separated by realms, they can be teleported to their user's hand, so do not worry about being separated from your new best friend.
objects.title: 20 Yeouiju (The God of High School)

objects.text: The sword of the Jade Emperor himself. A simple katana and matching sheath, neither with any embellishments or additions. This mighty blade possesses no innate power, save its limitless cutting edge. A single, lazy slash was able to slice all of South Korea in half and the blade was also able to destroy the cloned Ruyi Jingu Bang. It can summon gigantic waves of incredibly hot flame at the user’s command and even the sheath of the blade is powerful enough to split in half the super massive swords wielded by Nephilim without any action on the user’s behalf. Even if somehow broken, a feat only accomplished once by the Monkey King using over a hundred National Treasures and multiple Charyeok at once, the blade will be replenished to pristine condition within minutes.
objects.title: Blade of Tathagata (The God of High School)

objects.text:
I, Arthur, anointed Heir to the Kingdom, claim this Key and with it the Mastery of the Lower House. I claim it by blood and bone and contest, out of truth, in testament, and against all trouble.

Arthur Penhaligon

 Within your grasp now lie the twin halves of the First Key: two clock-hand-like daggers—the Hour Hand, stronger but slower, and the Minute Hand, faster but weaker—that can be freely fused into a stylized clock-hand sword and split apart as you wish. A Key can lock and unlock, bind, unbind, open, close, animate, petrify, illuminate, darken, translate, befuddle, heal, harm, kill, protect its user from harm, grant them wings and, in general, manipulate the surrounding environment in a variety of ways. Key's can only be freely given, no amount of force can remove it from your possession. Each Key has a "specialization"—an aspect of reality that it alone controls best. The First Key holds absolute command of time, capable of accelerating, slowing, reversing or even stopping it entirely. The bearer of the First Key can travel through time—into the past or possibilities of the future—and is protected from negative consequences resulting from manipulating and changing time. However, a Key is only at full power within its own domain inside the House—for the First Key the Lower House—or during one of the seven days of the week in the Secondary Realms—for the First Key a Monday. Otherwise, it can only perform small workings and is unable to harness its grander, more formidable powers. Should you however possess another Key, it can grant you the ability to use the First Key’s powers within its demesne and day.
objects.title: The First Key (The Keys to the Kingdom)

objects.text:
I, Arthur, anointed Heir to the Kingdom, claim this Key and with it command of the Glorious Army of the Architect, and Mastery of the Great Maze. I claim it by blood and bone and contest, out of truth, in testament, and against all trouble.

Arthur Penhaligon

 Within your hand now is the form of the Fourth Key, taking the shape of a Marshal’s baton. It has the capacity to change its size and shape to into any weapon to suit its wielder’s needs, with a preference for swords. A Key can lock and unlock, bind, unbind, open, close, animate, petrify, illuminate, darken, translate, befuddle, heal, harm, kill, protect its user from harm, grant them wings, and, in general, manipulate the surrounding environment in a variety of ways. Keys can only be freely given; no amount of force can remove them from your possession. Each Key has a “specialization”—an aspect of reality that it controls best. The Fourth Key holds absolute command of Mind, able to enhance, manipulate, control, distort, and bend them in a variety of ways to suit its needs. It allows the Key to force obedience from those exposed to it, changing their memories and allegiances at your will. The Fourth Key empowers its wielder with a superhuman talent for tactics and strategy, and the ability to intuitively predict your opponents next moves bordering on precognition. However, a Key is only at full power within its own domain inside the House—for the Fourth Key, the Great Maze—or during one of the seven days of the week in the Secondary Realms. For the Fourth Key, that day is Thursday. Otherwise, it can only perform minor workings and is unable to harness its grander, more formidable powers. Should you possess another Key, it can grant you the ability to use the Fourth Key’s powers within its demesne and on its day.
objects.title: The Fourth Key (The Keys to the Kingdom)

objects.text:
I, Arthur, anointed Heir to the Kingdom, claim this Key and with it the Mastery of the Border Sea. I claim it by blood and bone and contest, out of truth, in testament, and against all trouble.

Arthur Penhaligon

 Within your hand now is the form of the Third Key, taking the shape of a trident. It has the capacity to change its size and shape to suit its wielder’s needs, though it will always be recognizably a trident. A Key can lock and unlock, bind, unbind, open, close, animate, petrify, illuminate, darken, translate, befuddle, heal, harm, kill, protect its user from harm, grant them wings, and, in general, manipulate the surrounding environment in a variety of ways. Keys can only be freely given; no amount of force can remove them from your possession. Each Key has a “specialization”—an aspect of reality that it controls best. The Third Key holds absolute command of Space, able to manipulate, control, distort, and bend it in a variety of ways to suit its needs. Increase or decrease the height, depth, and width of objects and spaces, teleport by reducing the distance between your location and destination to zero, and much more. The Third Key also has the ability to control water on both microscopic and macroscopic levels. However, a Key is only at full power within its own domain inside the House—for the Third Key, the Border Sea—or during one of the seven days of the week in the Secondary Realms. For the Third Key, that day is Wednesday. Otherwise, it can only perform minor workings and is unable to harness its grander, more formidable powers. Should you possess another Key, it can grant you the ability to use the Third Key’s powers within its demesne and on its day.
objects.title: The Third Key (The Keys to the Kingdom)

addons.text: You are the reincarnation of Anos Voldigoad, the Demon King of Tyranny. With this, you inherit all of his skills, knowledge, magic, Magic Eyes, and power. You can summon Demon Castle Delsgade without any time restrictions, and you have access to the full power of Venuzdona without needing to summon Delsgade. You also gain Team Anos as loyal companions.
addons.title: Demon King of Tyranny

objects.text: You gain the Demon Sword Venuzdona, the primary weapon of the Demon King of Tyranny Anos Voldigoad. This weapon has the power to destroy virtually anything, even reason itself. However, possessing this weapon comes with some caveats. While you are able to use the sword without needing to summon the Demon Castle Delsgade, the sword’s full power is restricted to you. While you can cut through most materials effortlessly, nullify spells, and bypass the immortality of others, performing feats like destroying the order of the world to slice a faraway target are beyond you at the moment. Fortunately, the sword will alter your body as you gain more experience with it to become closer to Anos, allowing you to draw on more of its power over time.
objects.title: Reason Destroying Sword Venuzdona (The Misfit of Demon King Academy)

addons.text:
Your ability to at the very least learn everything, even supposedly contradictory concepts, has resonated with your Legendary Weapon’s potential. 

Now, much like the Legendary Shield’s Sharing Upgrade Method, you can learn the Upgrade Methods of the other Legendary and Vassal Weapons provided you have a basic understanding of how they work, equivalent to having the method described to you by a direct user. 

Furthermore, you also start with the Upgrade Methods of 3 of the canon Legendary Weapons (not including your own which you already possess) and 6 of the canon Vassal Weapons.
addons.title: Upgrade Methods

objects.text:
You can choose one of the Heroes Weapons seen so far or possible to exist. Hero Weapons are ancient spirits who manifest themselves as weapons and forcibly summon suitable users to resist the fusion of worlds. The users who wield these weapons are given the title of Legendary Hero.

The Legendary Weapons are not limited to the Bow, Sword, Shield, and Spear or the list bellow. They encompass a wide array of Hero-class and Vassal-class weapons but looses none of the powers even if in the original world they would:

Hero Weapons: Hunting, Jewel, Blunt Instrument, Ofuda, Armor, Ring, and Brush, Bow, Sword, Shield, and Spear.

Vassal Weapons: Staff, Gauntlet, Projectile, Hammer, Axe, Claw, Whip, Carriage, Fan, Scythe, Book, Katana, Boat, Mirror, Musical Instrument, Harpoon, Sewing Set, and Chain.

All weapons possess a gem that acts as the functional matrix to activate abilities, this gem persists in every weapon form. Possessors of the weapon upgrade it through adventuring within their respective worlds, with each world having different power metrics. Each Legendary Weapon possesses different functions that can be discovered.

There are many ways of enhancing a Legendary Weapon and certain conditions can unlock powerful forms. Legendary Weapons are capable of translating any spoken language and dialect but is unable to do so with written languages.
objects.title: Legendary Weapon (The Rising of The Shield Hero)

objects.text:
The Demon Sword Lostvayne is a Sacred Treasure belonging to the Dragon's Sin of Wrath, Meliodas.

In addition to being a quite sharp shortsword it has a unique ability: Jitsuzo Bunshin.

This ability allows it's wielder to create up to 6 clones of themself, though the clones are combined only half as powerful as the wielder of Lostvayne. Creating a single clone makes it half as powerful, two clones each have a quarter of it's power and creating all 6 makes them only as powerful as a twelfth of the original.
objects.title: Lostvayne (The Seven Deadly Sins)

objects.text:
King’s sacred treasure, the Spirit Spear Chastiefol, is a highly versatile weapon crafted from the Sacred Tree in the Fairy King’s Forest. It possesses the ability to transform into ten distinct forms, each serving unique purposes for offense, defense, or support. However, form nine and ten is unknown.

In its resting state, Chastiefol takes the form of a Pillow, a soft, moss-like object that offers comfort and can act as a shield when needed.

Form One: “Chastiefol” is an enormous spear. When launched, it generates a massive, cross-shaped explosion upon impact, capable of obliterating anything caught in its radius. This form’s sheer size and power make it an overwhelming offensive tool.

Form Two: “Guardian” manifests as a muscular, stuffed bear. Its physical strength and destructive power allows it to overpower even the strongest foes. This form excels in close combat, combining brute force with durability.

Form Three: “Fossilization” transforms the weapon into a twin-headed spear with claw-like spearheads. This form has the ability to petrify those it pierces, turning them into living statues incapable of movement.

Form Four: “Sunflower” takes the form of a towering flower-like structure with spiked teeth surrounding the mouth-like center. Its roots extend to colossal proportions, anchoring it firmly as it charges up to release thousands of destructive projectiles. This form is capable of unleashing widespread devastation across a battlefield.

Form Five: “Increase” multiplies Chastiefol into a swarm of large swords. These projectiles are larger, stronger, and more numerous, allowing for concentrated and overwhelming attacks from multiple angles.

Form Six: “Yggdra Cloth” takes the form of a protective armor, wrapping itself around the wielder. This armor includes large gauntlets equipped with long forearm blades, offering both offense and defense. The Yggdra Cloth enhances physical combat capabilities while providing a sturdy barrier against attacks.

Form Seven: “Luminosity” changes the weapon into a glowing, ringed sphere. Its brightness can illuminate large areas. It serves as a beacon of light, cutting through even the deepest darkness to reveal hidden threats or obstacles.

Form Eight: “Pollen Garden” transforms the weapon into a massive, intricately patterned, egg-shaped barrier. This can enclose and heal multiple individuals, including giants, while withstanding even the most devastating attacks. Its defensive strength is unparalleled, capable of enduring the immense power of Mael, one of the Four Archangels, enhanced by his Commandments.

If you so wish, you can have the appearance of each form shift into its unawakened version. This change doesn’t weaken the power of the spear.
objects.title: True Spirit Spear Chastiefol (The Seven Deadly Sins)

objects.text: “One brick in hand can dominate the entire world!” This unassuming bright red brick is actually a legendary weapon that should not be able to exist! The Nine Five Legendary Brick is absolutely and utterly indestructible, and ignores all forms of defense when attacking; however, it doesn’t posses any properties to increase how much damage it can deal other than that, so you better have a good throwing arm! The Nine Five Legendary Brick’s most wondrous property, however, is the fact that any direct hit on the head (or similar body part) of any being (at minimum) immediately knocks them unconscious for exactly one minute—no matter how hard or how small the hit was or what immunities the target has, they will always be knocked out even if it was only a light graze. Additionally, this property does not have a cool-down and hitting the same being on the head again will refresh the duration of the unconsciousness; although, it will not extend the duration beyond one minute regardless of the number of hits.
objects.title: Nine Five Legendary Brick (The Strongest System)

objects.text: With each purchase here you gain one of the Twelve Swords of Power, each a one-meter long, near indestructible, double-bladed sword with a black hilt, forged by Vulcan from a meteorite. Each sword—other than Soulcutter—is almost indistinguishable from the next, other than a small symbol representing the sword in question, while Soulcutter bears none. Who holds Coinspinner knows good Odds Whichever move he make But the Sword of Chance, to please the Gods, Slips from him like a snake. Coinspinner is the Sword of Chance, granting the wielder immense luck. Even while still within its sheathe, the Sword has the ability to ensure the wielder ends up in an advantageous position. Typically, the Sword would betray the wielder at an inconvenient time, and disappear. However, due to purchasing Coinspinner here, the Sword will be forever loyal. The Sword of Justice balances the pans Of right and wrong, and foul and fair. Eye for an eye, Doomgiver scans The fate of all folk Everywhere. Doomgiver is the Sword of Justice, it has the power to return any "attack" back upon the attacker, regardless of the nature of the "attack", or whether it was overt or stealthy. Dragonslicer, Dragonslicer, how d'you slay? Reaching for the heart behind the scales. Dragonslicer, Dragonslicer, where d'you stay? In the belly of the giant my blade impales. Dragonslicer is the Sword of Heroes, able to cut through the hide and flesh of any dragon. The sword unerringly seeks the heart of any dragon the wielder declares its target, inflicting wounds that do not heal. Farslayer howls across the world For thy heart, for thy heart, who hast wronged me! Vengeance is his who casts the blade Yet he will in the end no triumph see. Farslayer is the Sword of Vengeance, with the ability to seek out and kill anyone regardless of distance, fortifications, or protections. The wielder only needs to think of the one they seek dead, and loose the blade. Normally, Farslayer's weakness is that is stays impaled in the body of your target, however now the Sword will instead fly swiftly back to your hand instead. Whose flesh the Sword of Mercy hurts has drawn no breath; Whose soul it heals has wandered in the night, Has paid the summing of all debts in death Has turned to see returning light. Woundhealer is the Sword of Mercy, able to heal the injuries or ailments of those who have been pierced by the blade without fail. So long as the target is not dead, the Sword can heal it all. Skulltwister spun in the dawn's gray light And men and demons knelt down before. Skulltwister flashed in the midday bright Gods joined the dance, and the march to war. It spun in the twilight dim as well And gods and men marched off to hell. Skulltwister is the Sword of Glory, its wicked power compelling absolute devotion from all those who's eyes see the blade, even gods may fall before its might, while it's cursed edge causes all wounds it inflicts to fester. I shatter Swords and splinter spears; None stands to Shieldbreaker. My point's the fount of orphans' tears My edge the widowmaker. Shieldbreaker is the Sword of Force, providing protection from all enemy attack, melee, ranged, magical or other. Shieldbreaker possesses the arm of its wielder, preventing it from being sheathed until the battle is over. However the Sword will not allow itself to be used against an unarmed opponent. The Sword also provides immunity from the negative effects and consequences of the other Swords. The Sword of Stealth is given to One lonely and despised. Sightblinder's gifts: His eyes are keen His nature is disguised. Sighblinder is the Sword of Stealth, able to cloak its wielder from view. Any who gaze upon its bearer are only capable of seeing either the one they love most of all, or the one they fear most. The Sword also allows its wielder to see the truth in any situation, and preventing its user from being deceived. The Tyrant's Blade no blood hath spilled But doth the spirit carve Soulcutter hath no body killed But many left to starve. Soulcutter is the Sword of Dispair, once drawn from its sheathe all those around the blade begin to be affected by a deep malaise. This effect spreads to around meters in radius, and can cause those affected such melancholy and despair, that they simply sit and wait to die. Normally the user ages rapidly while wielding the Sword, around 5 years a minute, due to your purchase here, this effect will not be present. The Sword of Siege struck a hammer's blow With a crash, and a smash, and a tumbled wall. Stonecutter laid a castle low With a groan, and a roar, and a tower's fall. Stonecutter is the Sword of Siege, its blade cuts through stone and rock as easily as air. Long roads the Sword of Fury makes Hard walls it builds around the soft The fighter who Townsaver takes Can bid farewell to home and croft. Townsaver is the Sword of Fury, able to control the body of its wielder, and grant them superhuman strength and speed. Once the Sword is taken up, it will not allow itself to be put down til all enemies have been beat. Who holds Wayfinder finds good roads Its master's step is brisk. The Sword of Wisdom lightens loads But adds unto their risk. Wayfinder is the Sword of Wisdom, able to lead its wielder to any goal they seek. Be warned however for Wayfinder does not lead you to the safest path. If you should buy all twelve of these Swords, you will find yourself able to merge and separate the Swords at will—as if you had Fusion and Fission—and toggle their effects. But perhaps most useful will be the ability to forge weapons that duplicate their effects.
objects.title: Sword of Power (The Twelve Swords of Power)

objects.text:
The Sword of Omens is an enchanted weapon of immense power, within which resides the Eye of Thundera. The sword is adaptable, changing its length from a dagger to a full-sized blade at the wielder's command, offering flexibility in combat.

Its blade is razor-sharp, indestructible, and never dulls, effortlessly slicing through even the toughest materials, such as solid stone. It can block and refract energy of various forms, making it a formidable weapon in both offense and defense.

The sword channels powerful energy, capable of unleashing blue lightning or energy blasts throughout its blade, while the Eye of Thundera fires a devastating red energy blast that can obliterate enemies in its path.

Through the Eye, the sword grants Sight Beyond Sight, allowing the wielder to see beyond the physical world and gain clairvoyant visions of hidden truths, potential futures, or unseen threats.

Imbued with ancient safeguards, the Sword of Omens cannot be wielded by dark forces. Mystical protections prevent evil beings from seizing control, ensuring that only those with pure intentions can wield its power.

The sword also has the unique ability to sense the goodness in others; it will not allow its bearer to harm those with pure hearts, preventing the wielder from turning it against innocents, no matter the circumstances.
objects.title: Sword of Omens (Thundercats)

objects.text:
This is a perfect copy of Zahard’s Needle when he climbed the Tower as a Regular; its name is Lecalicus, the Needle of War. This is a transforming weapon that has three forms. 

Lecalicus is the first form where it takes the shape of a wide, white blade that extends into a large snake creature that is under your command.

The second form is called Coelacanth, this form condenses into a thinner size and turns red, this form has a much wider attack radius and shoots beams of devastating power.

The most powerful and final form is called Leviathan, it grows thicker and longer and is coated with red electricity. The Needle is tremendously powerful and grows stronger with each transformation.
objects.title: Needle of War (Tower of God)

objects.text:
You are the owner of the Transistor, a large blunt sword also serving as a powerful computer holding a virtual world. Only you can use it unless you give user access to others.

The Transistor is able to use Functions, which projects its digital resources into the outside world to various effect. The base Function of the Transistor is Turn(), allowing the user to pause their perception of time and program a course of action, up to a limit, with more exhausting actions costing more against that limit; once released, they'll execute every action they programmed extremely rapidly over the course of the next second. Afterward, the Transistor will need to recharge for a few seconds before any of its Functions are available.

By touching a living being with it for around ten seconds, their consciousness is copied as a Trace inside of the Transistor's virtual world, and their data is analyzed by it, granting a Function fitting to the being digitized. If they have powers, their Function will usually imitate those powers in some way. You start with one such Function, which corresponds to you.

Unlike Turn(), other Functions will need to be assigned to certain roles; Active, Passive or Upgrade. Active Functions can grant abilities such as dashes or blasts of energy. Upgrade Functions are added to Active ones, altering them in various ways such as reducing their energy cost or making them strike multiple times. Finally, Passive Functions augment you directly, such as by granting you an energy shield or masking you from sight. You may have four Active and four Passive Functions working at once, and each Active Function can have two Upgrades. Changing it around requires a few minutes of messing with the sword's computer. None of these functions can grant you capacities above street-level.

The Transistor can also create the Process, mindless programs projected into the real world. It can theoretically control them, however, without someone with extraordinary knowledge in programming to fine-tune them, they will rampage and digitize things without reason.
objects.title: The Transistor (Transistor)

objects.text:
You gain a greatly modified AGL Arms .45 Long Colt revolver. This double-action revolver fires powerful 45 caliber bullets, has a break-action auto-ejecting barrel that holds up to 6 bullets. The gun also fires from the underside below the cylinder, which greatly increases the gun's stability while firing. It also comes with multiple easy-to-use and refillable speed loaders, allowing its user to reload the gun extremely quickly. The gun also comes with a secondary barrel, cylinder, and firing pin, which can fire 8 .22 caliber bullets.

While at first glance this gun looks like a relatively mundane though heavily modified revolver, it hides a powerful secret in that it hides Plant based technology. This allows the gun to merge with the user's arm in the form of an angel-like growth covered in feathers when fully manifested. This “Angel Arm” is highly malleable in the shapes it can take and can turn into various forms of weapons and be used as a shield that is stronger than any mundane metals. 

Yet its greatest ability is that it can fire blasts of energy comparable to nuclear bombs, capable of leaving massive craters on Earth’s Moon, easily able to be seen without a telescope. You can also set the Angel Arm to automatically defend you from any possible attacks towards you. Lastly, you can fire powerful blasts of energy from the revolver without needing to fully manifest the Angel Arm, with strength upwards to that of a rocket launcher.
objects.title: Modified Love and Peace (TRIGUN)

addons.text: Your Fighting Instinct is sublimated into the blessing already bestowed upon you by the hallowed blade Arondight giving you truly sublime sword skill. You have the instinctual knowledge and ability to fight on par with Lancelot, who in terms of pure skill, was praised as the greatest Swordsman of the Knights of the Round Table. Like him, you can fight even when subjected to mental interference, terrain adjustment, environmental hazards or any other obstruction.
addons.title: Eternal Arms Mastery

objects.text:
