You have come into possession of the Knight of the Lake Lancelot's signature blade. This blade is made in the image of Excalibur and possesses the characteristic of "Indestructability". No matter what damage may befall it, no matter how it may be suppressed, no matter how much energy is channeled into it, the blade will never be harmed or altered. The blade also inherits an Anti-Dragon attribute from Lancelot's legend of Slaying a Dragon, making it cut deeper and cause harsher wounds on those with a Dragon attribute. 

Being a gift from his foster mother, the Great Mother Vivian, the blade carries a blessing and upon drawing the blade, you become twice as strong, fast and durable with your magic being equally amplified. The blade will always be the ideal length for the user and has a light golden image or a darkened purple appearance which reflects the mental alignment of the user. This also makes it so that only you may truly use the blade.

Upon chanting an aria containing the name of the blade and infusing magical energy into it, the energy is amplified and turned into a beautiful light that cuts into anything and can be expelled in a wave blast like Excalibur, or be restrained within the blade, preventing collateral damage and cleaving into a single specific target with the power of the full blast.
objects.title: Arondight: The Unfading Light of the Lake (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
The hallowed scabbard of Excalibur. The embodiment of Utopia. Its connection to the heart of the world, Avalon, grants its wielder regenerative immortality simply by carrying it.

When magical energy is supplied and its true name is called, it becomes the ultimate shield by overwriting the rules of the world around you to temporarily become like the utopia it is connected to. A world where the concept of harm and hurt does not exist.

Thus, it can block even the likes of true magics from harming its wielder.
objects.title: Avalon (Type-Moon)

objects.text: Phantasmal Greatsword – Felling of the Sky Demon This two-handed greatsword was received by Siegfried from the Nibelungs as payment for aiding in fairly and impartially dividing up their treasure. As a Holy sword of the Nibelung’s and a sword ‘descended’ from the demonic sword Gram, it is a cursed holy blade that can switch between attributes as a Holy Sword, and a Demonic Sword depending on the wielder. Having achieved the monumental task of dragon-slaying, those who have draconic traits will find themselves especially vulnerable to the bite of this blade. Upon chanting “—O sword, Let thee be filled”, the blade will glow with orange light as the jewel in its hilt draws magic directly from the Age of Gods, to release it as a surging wave of destruction. Note: You change between the appearance of Balmung wielded by Siegfried and the Balmung wielded by Kriemhild at will. This is only an aesthetic appearance, though.
objects.title: Balmung (Type-Moon)

objects.text: The sword in the stone, the mark of kingship, inscribed with: "Whosoe'er pulleth out this sword of this stone is rightwise king of all England." It is the blade that crowned Arthur King of Albion, now called Britain. Chosen by Caliburn, it has recognized the qualities of a king within your heart. From this moment onward, it shall acknowledge no other master. And in return, you shall forevermore be untouched by time. But with this blessing comes the responsibility to uphold the code of chivalry—or suffer the consequences. As the Sword of Selection and a blade forged for a king, its majesty is undeniable, but because it was made as a symbol of authority rather than as a weapon of war, its combat effectiveness is lowered. Such is the cost of being a dazzling sword that it may never match Excalibur in might. More often than not, being reduced to the role of fancy ornamentation. Still, as a holy sword, Caliburn is no mere ornament. It can convert magical energy into heat, concentrating it into a sharp beam of light fired from the tip of its blade. When its True Name is released, it is possible to display firepower comparable to Excalibur. However, since Caliburn isn't built to withstand the magical energy needed to accomplish such a feat, it may very well shatter if pushed that far. That said, you don't need to overcharge it when invoking its True Name.
objects.title: Caliburn: Golden Sword of the Victorious (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
Behind you acting as a halo, are the great wheels of life and death, shining brightly, turning endlessly.

When deployed, these two chakrams of light, one seven kilometers in diameter and the other seventy kilometers hover in the sky above you. 

The power of the Buddha manifests as a divine artillery platform that launches immensely powerful arrows of light in a rain of fury against any enemy you have. This rain increases as any one battle goes on, the Chakrams becoming more ornate and layered until a maximum of seven rings appear. Little can survive when every individual arrow unleashes enough force to strike down a mountain and hundreds are unleashed each moment. 

You can channel any of your powers as arrows through these rings, thus firing it down as divine punishment upon your foes.

But offense is just one part of this treasure. It grants control over the cycle of life and death to the owner. Short of death, any wound can easily be healed by the wielder when the target is within the radius of the chakrams. 

Those who would be unable to be saved can be prevented from passing on, trapped in a state between death and life where they become vengeful apparitions. The rings could even forcefully control these creatures to an extent.
objects.title: Chakravartin (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
Before the Earth was born, before weapons were conceived by mankind, there was Ea, the Sword of Rupture. It is the oldest and most destructive, existing only to end the world and expose the truth. It does not need an edge to inflict devastating damage. It can obliterate anything it touches, even in the hands of a novice. It can also release a powerful blast of energy that targets only what the wielder wants, multiplying the force of each strike.

But that is not all it can do. When the user channels their energy into the sword, it starts to spin faster and faster, gathering more power. The sword then unleashes an attack that surpasses everything else. It is a recreation of the genesis miracle, a reset of all creation. Its red wind erases everything in its path, leaving only the original reality before it was shaped and then ripping that apart too. Nothing can survive its true power, unless it escapes to a world beyond the sixth dimension. Even a slight use of this power can tear apart time, space, and reality itself. The sword can also destroy smaller worlds, pocket realities, and dimensions, forcing them back to the main reality. And if enough energy is used, there is nothing that Ea cannot destroy
objects.title: Ea (Type-Moon)

objects.text: These are Enkidu, the Chains of Heaven, which bound the Bull of Heaven and are named after the only being Gilgamesh ever truly considered a friend. The Chains can elongate and contract without limit, split their ends into multiple points, and be controlled directly by the user's thoughts and will. As one of the few weapons holding the concept of reigning over the divine, the Chains' most impressive ability is their capacity to suppress and bind those who bear divinity. The strength and durability of the Chains power increases with the level of Divinity your target possesses however, without your target possessing divinity, the Chains are only as strong and durable as a regular chain, though a regular human will have no chance of escaping the grasp of these links.
objects.title: Enkidu (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
The strongest and most majestic holy sword. A weapon crafted in the heart of the world, made entirely out of the prayers, wishes, hopes, and light of humanity, to safeguard humanity and the earth against alien threats. It cannot be called beautiful, for such a word would only dirty it.

It is sacred. Excalibur is a divine construct, the pinnacle of holy swords. Normally, the sword is an energy amplifier, taking energy and expelling many times what it received as a blinding white wave of energy. However, when humanity or the planet is threatened, it becomes a divine construct capable of achieving a miracle to save the world.

It is a crystallization of the concept of glory, the sad, yet noble dreams of all warriors, past, present, and future, who lie dying on the field of battle, clutched to their hearts with their last breath. To be exalted.
objects.title: Excalibur (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
Gáe Bolg, a cursed spear crafted by Scáthach from the remains of the Phantasmal sea monster Curruid's skull. Scáthach made several versions of this spear with the intention of one of her students being able to kill her. The Gáe Bolg is descended from Gungnir, which is Odin's spear in Norse mythology.

The spear has two unique attacks that you can use. The first is Gáe Bolg: Barbed Spear That Pierces With Death. This attack is focused on a single opponent, and it always strikes the opponent's heart, ensuring a fatal blow and spreading tiny thorns within the bodies of those pierced by the spear. Once the name of the spear is called, the spear reverses the causality of nature, ensuring that no matter how much the opponent struggles, the spear is always fated to pierce the heart of the one whom the wielder strikes. In other words, instead of the cause being the lance being thrust, it is replaced by the effect of the lance piercing the heart, even turning at angles that would otherwise be impossible to pierce the heart. There is no hope of evading this attack unless the target has a way of changing their fate themselves.

Wounds that come from the spear cannot be healed unless the effect of healing it is greater than the curse that is on Gáe Bolg, as long as the spear exists.

The second technique is Gáe Bolg: Soaring Spear That Strikes with Death. By tossing the spear and unlocking the true potential of the spear's curse, the wielder produces thousands of barbs that all strike at once, effectively carpet-bombing an area. This attack is more effective against multiple opponents, as it cannot be dodged or blocked under normal circumstances.
objects.title: Gáe Bolg (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
You have come into possession of the Lancer Servant Diarmuid Ua Duibhne's signature spears. 

Gáe Dearg: Crimson Rose of Exorcism is a 2 meter long demonic spear with the ability to disrupt magical energy on contact. It effortlessly penetrates through magical energy and disrupts the connection between magical items and thier users. However it is too weak to nullify a magical barrier or break contracts outright, instead only making a temporary disruption. This once let it slip right past Saber's armor, cleave through a noble phantasm reinforced weapon and sever the link between a Mana Reactor and it's user. 
Unlike Diarmuid, you can control the disruption effect telepathically instead of needing specialized sealing cloth.

Gáe Buidhe: Golden Rose of Mortality is a 1.4 meter long cursed spear with the ability to restrict the vitality of those it cuts. Essentially if you get a cut, you cannot be healed because any healing will treat you as having full health thus causing your wound to bleed continuously turning even a papercut fatal. Unless the victim has immense curse immunity, breaks the spear or uses conceptual healing, the wound will never heal due to the curse being the product of a Nasuverse Fairy King.
Unlike Diarmuid, you can telepathically control the curse, either stopping it from activating or dispelling it.
objects.title: Gáe Dearg and Gáe Buidhe (Type-Moon)

objects.text: Sword of Revolving Glory Galatine, the sister sword to the legendary Excalibur, is a powerful weapon often overshadowed in myth. Originally owned by the Lady of the Lake, Galatine may not be as frequently mentioned in tales, but it possesses a power that rivals that of Excalibur. While Excalibur is known for its ability to gather light from the Earth itself, Galatine harnesses energy directly from the Pseudo-Sun residing within its hilt, and the real celestial object high above. Galatine’s means of destruction differs from that of Excalibur, while the Sword of Promised Victory annihilates targets with—relatively—precise blasts of light, Galatine can cloak itself in Solar flame and unleash waves of searing heat and radiance capable of obliterating entire landscapes. Its devastating reach extends up to approximately thirteen kilometers. As a sword that imitates the essence of the sun, Galatine draws additional strength from its celestial source. The higher the sun ascends in the sky, the greater the sword’s power becomes, allowing its wielder to utilize its powers with greater ease.
objects.title: Galatine (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
Immortal Slaying Scythe

The Divine Sword is a legendary weapon famously wielded by the hero Perseus to vanquish Medusa. Originally belonging to Zeus, he employed it in his struggle against Typhon.

Not just any weapon, this holy sword possesses remarkable qualities; it has the power to slay immortals, inflicting wounds that are impervious to supernatural healing or recovery. Despite these extraordinary capabilities, the sword does not stand out in a conventional sense.

The origins of this legendary sword trace back to the interstellar machine gods, who designed it with a specific purpose in mind: to disrupt atomic bonds at a fundamental level—a symbol of both myth and technology. The Harpe can switch between its many interoperations from its sword form to a scythe.
objects.title: Harpe (Type-Moon)

addons.text:
Fire, as a force of nature, symbolizes a myriad of concepts. It can represent fury and destruction, an uncontrollable power that decimates everything. Yet, fire can also embody hope, for as long as a tiny spark continues to burn, one can find the resolve to persevere. The fire of the sun or a campfire brings warmth and rejuvenation, banishing the darkness of the night.

Laevatein, the Sword of Calamity, symbolizes destruction. Has resonated with and connected to the Sacred Flame, a symbol of rebirth, perseverance, and hope. Drawn together as though two halves of a whole, the Sacred Flame imbues Laevatein with the power of renewal and rebirth equal to its destructive power.

Having merged with the sword of a thousand blazing suns, the flames it unleashes can now discern what to burn and what to preserve. Moreover, these flames possess the extraordinary ability to mend and reforge, restoring things to their rightful state whether they are living beings, objects, or even abstract metaphysical laws of the world. If the sword can destroy something, it can also restore it.

With the aspects of rebirth and creation imbued into Laevatein, you are no longer at risk of being incinerated by its overwhelming power. However, it remains an unwieldy weapon, and its full potential is difficult to master.

If you are an elemental Archon with control over Pyro, or a deity with dominion over fire or the sun, you can activate the Incandescent Ode of Resurrection to temporarily transform yourself into an unkillable fire giant, who might surpass that of Surtur at his peak. In this form, Laevatein’s power becomes so immense that it can even ignite new suns into existence.
addons.title: Flame of Rebirth

objects.text:
A weapon born of ancient flame and divine wrath, Laevatein is the Noble Phantasm of Surtr, forged in the primordial heart of the planet. A synthesis of divine constructs, it embodies the destructive essence of Surtr's flaming blade, Freyr’s solar sword, and Loki's infernal craftsmanship. It is safeguarded by nine seals laid by Sinmara to contain its overwhelming power, each seal a safeguard against calamity. Laevatein is a Divine Construct, an armament made to challenge gods, destroy life, and rip apart the world's ancient structures. Its flames are not mere fire; they are manifestations of authority, concepts forged into physical heat. The sword prioritizes life over anything else, marking living beings as its ultimate prey. Its fiery blade leaves only ashes of those it touches, consuming both the body and soul.

Laevatein’s heat manifests as a living force, searing not only physical objects but concepts and existence itself. Gods, heroes, and divine constructs crumble before its flames, as even divine life-forms are unable to withstand its blaze. By invoking Laevatein’s true name, the wielder can tear apart world textures, unraveling mythological foundations or ages tied to the divine. For example, it can forcibly sever connections between the Age of Gods and the modern world, erasing even the strongest gods’ foothold in reality. Laevatein’s power is locked behind nine seals that must be broken to unleash its full destructive potential. Each seal removed grants additional abilities, such as enhanced destructive range, conceptual obliteration, and increased effectiveness against divine entities. Once all nine seals are broken, the sword becomes an unstoppable force of destruction.

The sword’s flames are akin to the sun itself, generating an overwhelming heat that can melt fortresses, incinerate armies, and even cause localized phenomena resembling solar flares. These flames are self-sustaining and can spread across vast areas, consuming all life within their reach. Against gods, demigods, and mythological creatures, Laevatein delivers unmatched power, burning through their divine essence and annihilating their immortality. Against mortal life, the flames attack the very concept of existence, leaving no trace of the victim behind. To use Laevatein at its full power, the wielder must call its true name, shattering the seals and igniting the calamity. The wielder is warned, however, that unleashing Laevatein risks burning even themselves if unprepared, as the sword’s flames care not for allies or foes.

Laevatein’s power comes at a cost. The wielder must be resilient enough to withstand the immense heat and conceptual backlash of using a weapon designed to unmake creation. Fully breaking the nine seals locks the sword into its destructive state, requiring tremendous magical energy to wield and control. Laevatein stands as a peer to Rhongomyniad and Ea, a weapon of finality meant not to preserve but to destroy. It is the ultimate tool of ending, purging even the divine itself when necessary. Only the strongest of wills and the most unyielding of spirits can hope to master it without being consumed.
objects.title: Laevatein: Calamity of the Sun-Like Sword (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
A sword passed down to Noah by his grandfather, Methuselah, which has been in his family line for generations before that. This “sword” is the embodiment of the word of God. It was used by archangels to guard paradise and the tree of life, and separate Eden from the world at large. It therefore has the same characteristics as the Sword of Rupture, Ea.

It can be used as a traditional sword, but it also has the capabilities to act autonomously, capable of levitating and attacking without having to hold it, slashing, drilling and striking down under its own power.

As the crystallized Word of God, the sword holds immense power over the material, and immaterial, world around it, capable of generating and controlling the elements making up the world around it, from unleashing enormous firestorms to moving mountains, to making the seas rise and smash apart one's foes under its weight, to even unleashing beams of pure ether. However. its greatest power is that it can generate the same power that Ea, the Sword of Rupture, used to separate heaven, the underworld, and earth. The Whirling Flaming Sword used that same power to separate Eden from the world. Whereas Ea generates black winds, however, this sword generates the power in the form of black flames, which seemingly unmakes anything it touches down to its origin. It can likewise be used to separate something from the world at large, should one know how to observe and recognize the textures that make up Gaia. Needless to say, it also holds the qualities of a holy sword and would be extremely dangerous to any demonic, dark, and evil entities.

To properly wield the word of God takes not only a great reserve of magical energy, but also the correct character. As the sword will not listen to anyone it deems irredeemably stained by sins. This is a mercy only granted to those who still have a way back to the light, so to speak. Should anyone truly irredeemable grab a hold of this weapon, they will be instantly consumed and unmade by black flames. The Whirling Flaming Sword will only unleash its full power for those “pure of heart” or “sinless”. Theoretically, it has never been seen to have been used at its maximum potential, as all who have been seen wielding it have been stained by Original Sin. This is likely a good thing, as a mystery as powerful as the word of God himself is likely better left unused by the conflict-prone humanity. For the good of both humanity and the world around it.

The sword finds you worthy enough to wield it, at least some of its power. Depending upon how you decide to live your life, going forward, and how you accrue sins, it may choose to limit the amount of power it will unleash for you, somewhat akin to a sword of selection like Gram or Caliburn, though continuous instead of a one-time ordeal. Should it find you of fitting character going forward, if you live your life with goodness and virtue in your heart and mind, more and more of its immense power will be accessible to you. And should you somehow rid yourself entirely of sin, a feat not actually unattainable if you are a human who lives after the death and sacrifice of Jesus Christ, you can but for a moment, access the entirety of the power of the word of God. This allows you to realize a miracle, any miracle. But be warned, it is not a power to be wielded lightly, for to wield it for longer than a moment would kill even an Archangel, and even the Primordial Man Adam would not be able to do so without perishing.
objects.title: Lahaṭ Haḥereb Hammithappeket - Whirling Flaming Sword (Type-Moon)

addons.text:
Your Mage's Trapping has connected with Lord Camelot. Now, your shield is also receptive to enchantments and can it can also absorb and transfer any form energy into your own reserves on a 1-to-1 basis. If your energy is full, your shield possesses a massive personal pool to store excess energy for later use.

Your Mage's Trappings, even if completely destroyed, can be regenerated, as your shield serves as an anchor for them. The regeneration speed is nearly instantaneous if it utilizes any energy stored within your shield.
addons.title: Proper Knight of the Round

addons.text:
The massive amount of mana you have access to has passively elevated your Succeed Phantasm to the point where it is always active, allowing you to effortlessly shrug off blows that could destroy large houses. You can also flare it enough to purge status ailments like corruption or poison from your body. Your enhanced skill in magic has indirectly granted you access to the traditional Mana Burst, enabling you to move and fight on par with the average Servant.

The real benefit is the acquisition of a skill akin to Numeral of the Saint EX. From noon to 3 PM and midnight to 3 AM, your infinite mana during these hours also grants you effectively infinite defense through your Succeed Phantasm. Outside of truly extraordinary conceptual abilities, you are virtually indestructible during these times, and your Mana Burst elevates your physical prowess to that of a top-tier Servant.
addons.title: Numeral of the Saint EX

addons.text:
As Lord Camelot is made from remnants of the Round Table which was considered "the place where heroes gather" it has allowed you to go past the limit of 1 servant only. You will gain the singular chosen servant, but you now have the capability to summon more servants, you do not get to choose any of these servants and they share the same three command spells as the original servant you summoned.  While you did not gain more command spells, your command spells regenerate completely after 24 hours of using one or more.

Their combat prowess and ability to act depends on your own magical energy to sustain them.
addons.title: Gathering of Heroes

objects.text:
In your possession is the Shield of Mash Kyrielight (and her tagalong, Galahad), an indestructible shield that embodies the Round Table, "where the Knights of the Round Table sat at the center of the Castle of White Walls, Camelot," in the form of a shield. This grants several overall great abilities, focused entirely on being the ultimate shield for yourself and anyone you decide to protect. The shield is connected to you and can be materialized and dematerialized at will.

Just by having this shield, you gain a very high resistance to magic, the ability to adequately ride most mounts—from horses to cars to potentially planes—and an ability called Succeed Phantasm, which, similar to Mana Burst, allows you to expend stamina or any form of energy to translate into defensive power.

Besides these, you have three unique abilities whose cooldowns depend greatly on your own stamina and supernatural energy reserves:

Exalted Impervious Wall of Snowflakes: This temporarily gives you and all nearby allies greatly increased defense, capable of making you impervious to small- and medium-caliber firearm-level force. On top of that, it provides a further 20% reduction to all damage taken.

Obscurant Wall of Chalk: Allows you to apply temporary invincibility to one target for a short amount of time. It does this by temporarily shifting the target out of the axis of time to avoid attacks.

Shield of Rousing Resolution: Forces all nearby enemies to target you for a few minutes and raises your own defense by a large amount during this time.

The final ability of Lord Camelot is its Noble Phantasm, sharing the same name: Lord Camelot - Now, a Fortress of Distant Ideals. By holding the shield in front of you and reciting Lord Camelot, you can raise the very walls of Camelot itself to create a barrier, protecting you and anyone behind you from any attack. The strength of this defense is proportionate to your will; as long as your heart doesn’t break or falter, you can block any attack. You also have the ability to send the force of any attack stopped by your Noble Phantasm back at the sender.

This does not make you invulnerable. For instance, Mash was able to stop an attack that would have penetrated through the planet with a beam the size of North America but was vaporized by the sheer heat.

Such a Noble Phantasm, for a normal human, could only be summoned for a minute straight and has a cooldown of an hour. However, anyone superhuman or with magic or other supernatural energies could summon it for much longer or use it more often.
objects.title: Lord Camelot (Type-Moon)

addons.text:
You have now been proclaimed as a saint. You are so holy that members of your faith would weep in your presence. Luminosite Eternelle has allowed for your garments to be the cloth and armour of Jeanne D’Arc, amplifying their defensive properties. 

Those with demonic or darkness alignment will be unable to even be within your presence unless they wish to be painfully smote by a follower of the Divine.

Your innate magical resistance has skyrocketed to EX rank, meaning all magical attacks targeting you will be diverted away from your body. In addition to this, it may grow past EX rank, allowing for the nullification of magical casting within an area.

Your saint-like nature also allows for the production of Holy Shrouds, a type of mystic code that is formed from the death wrappings of venerated figures.
addons.title: Saint EX

objects.text: "O` Lord, I beg of you... Grant me the strength to protect those precious to me." It is the battle standard of Jeanne d’Arc, which she carried into battle in the 100 years’ War, a crystallisation of her ability to fight at the vanguard and remain unharmed. Not merely a rallying point, this flag has a spear point attached at the end of the shaft, allowing it to be used as an instrument of violence in combat against other Heroic Spirits. Like all Noble Phantasms, Luminosite Eternelle’s true talents are unleashed when calling out its true name. Any innate magical resistance you have is converted into an angel’s blessing, which protects against all spiritual and physical attacks, isolating the bearer from their surroundings. Jeanne, who had EX-rank magical resistance, was able to divert an anti-fortress Noble Phantasm away from her allies. However, too much damage accumulating in a short period of time will cause the standard to rip and tear until it is unusable. By being the owner of this Noble Phantasm, you start with an innate magical resistance ranked at E. The more that you use the flag or the more pious you are, the more steadily this may grow until your magical resistance reaches EX rank.
objects.title: Luminosite Eternelle: God is Here with Me (Type-Moon)

objects.text: Gate Open! This all of my power! From the great Heavens, towards the great earth! The future will take care of itself. Maana is the ship that carries Mesopotamian Gods across the Heavens and is the fastest ship throughout creation, even under Gilgamesh's appraising eyes. The Boat of Heaven does this by creating teleportation gates to the destination of your choice, even if that place requires you to travel interstellar distances. Additionally, Maana can be used as a bow, firing energy beams that can annihilate even the children of Tiamat with just basic attacks. Maana is not a weapon you string and fire physically but by using mental commands, as it is as tall as multiple men put together. Eventually, you will be able to use Ishtar's Noble Phantasm, An Gal Ta Ki Gal Šè, the ability to place "Venus" within Maana's magazine and fire an arrow with the force of a conceptual planet.
objects.title: Maana (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
The sword of "the foundation of the sacred right to select the king," including Gram and Caliburn. It is utilized by The King of Heroes testing if an opponent is worthy of the power of Ea. 

Although it has a different appearance from Caliburn, its "true nature," the "idea of its creation" and its "soul" are nearly identical. Due to being its model, its strength as a Noble Phantasm is incomparable, easily shattering Caliburn without it being able to put up any resistance. 

Though not as powerful as Excalibur, it utilizes the same power as Caliburn, a "light that can burn away everything it touches".
objects.title: Merodach (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
A switchblade once wielded by the titular Tohno Shiki passed down through the Nanaya bloodline. Aside from its age and craftsmanship, the knife was originally nothing more than a finely made, if mundane, masterpiece. However, now that it has found its way into your hands—perhaps guided by fate—it seems to have awakened a few minor abilities.

The blade carries faint imprints of its former wielders—most notably Tohno Shiki, bearer of the Mystic Eyes of Death Perception. These lingering echoes grant the wielder a low, instinctive hum of combat intuition—memories and impressions from generations of seasoned demon hunters. When held, the knife subtly guides your grip and movements, offering a minor yet tangible sense of how to wield it effectively in battle.

In particular, it grants a faint awareness of weak points—not lines or points of death, but natural vulnerabilities: structural flaws, soft targets, or moments of exposed motion, thanks to the knife's connection to its last user. This intuitive "buzz" in the back of your mind grows stronger the closer you are to death or mortal danger, sharpening your ability to exploit these openings.
objects.title: Nanatsu-yoru (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
Rhongomyniad, known as The Lance that Shines to the Ends of the World is a Divine Construct that rivals Excalibur in power. Rhongomyniad is sealed by the Thirteen Restraints of the Round Table. This is the same set of restraints that bind Excalibur. 

The restraints are:
1. The enemy must be more powerful than oneself
2. The battle must be one-on-one
3. The enemy must not be an elemental spirit 
4. The battle must be one against evil
5. The battle must not involve personal gain
6. The battle must not be against Humanity
7. The battle must not be inhumane
8. The battle must be for truth
9. The battle must be to live
10. The battle must be to save the world
11. The battle must be to defend human order
12. The battle must not be against one pure of heart
13. The battle must be an honorable one

After you release a single restraint, it will permanently remain open, allowing you to reach Rhongomyniad's full power after you have unlocked all 13 restraints at least once.

Wielding this weapon will slowly change you into the highest-ranking Divine Spirit, giving you a Magical Energy that surpasses space and time, which will allow you to gain control over the flow of time and eventually, time travel. 

Rhongomyniad has the ability to shape-shift as well. The outer spiral shell of the spear can be shifted into a shining set of armor reminiscent of white bark, this armor can grow branches as an additional form of defense.
objects.title: Rhongomyniad (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
A dagger that is the materialization of the legend of the Witch of Betrayal herself. It is mostly ceremonial, with nonexistent capabilities as a weapon, being thin, blunt, and overall useless. However, while it lacks the capacity to murder, its true purpose lies in the destruction of any magic. 

The dagger is capable of nullifying all magical effects; once it comes into contact with something connected to magic, such as a person affected by magic, magical contracts, curses, or spells, so long as it is rooted in magic or something adjacent to magic (such as cursed energy or chakra), the dagger can break its effects and return the object to its original state.
 
When used on magical contracts, it can rewrite them, such as how the Witch of Betrayal used it to steal Saber. You can also use this to cancel other supernatural effects, such as the connection between a shard and a parahuman.
objects.title: Rule Breaker (Type-Moon)

objects.text: It is a spear of mortality made of lightning that can only strike once. It is a spear made to kill the Divine; as such, it possesses "power proportionate to an A-rank attack," dealing A-rank physical damage, because it has the power to kill gods. Heroic Spirits, Monstrous Beasts, Phantasmal Beasts, Divine Beasts, Shields, Fortresses, Bounded Fields, and every single existence are equally meaningless before its might. Vasavi Shakti's power is enough to destroy a "single" existence completely, which can be as specific as a single target or an entire texture of the world. However, once a target is chosen, it won't affect much else. Releasing Vasavi Shakti's true power will melt everything in the area for miles with its heat and lightning.
objects.title: Vasavi Shakti: O' Sun, Abide to Death (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
In your possession is a prototype repeating gas-powered crossbow straight from the armoury of the Vatican. It is capable of firing at a rate of several bolts per second, all the while retaining power similar to the most powerful heavy-weight crossbows.

It comes with five pre-loaded magazines containing a hundred bolts each, several spare gas canisters, and the tools and instructions on how to refill the canisters and manufacture new bolts.
objects.title: Repeater Crossbow (Van Hellsing)

objects.text:
Frostmourne is the Mournblade of the Lich King—a fearsome, rune-inscribed two-handed longsword. Frostmourne possesses the power to shatter and imprison the souls of those it slays, reanimating the corpses of those that the sword has slain into mindless undead. With each new soul, the sword drains and becomes more powerful. The blade is strong, able to shatter even the strongest weapons with minimal resistance, and despite its weight, it is as light as a feather to those who wield it.

Those who wield the blade also fall under the effects of the blade slowly turning into an undead, corrupting those who would wield it. The blade houses the abilities, memories, and skills of its victims. Within the blade are the various souls it has claimed in its long time in Azeroth, such as its most well-known wielder, Arthas. Those who wield the blade also possess the powers of a death knight. 

Should you claim the blade as your own and overpower the intelligence of the blade, you will gain the power of the blade without succumbing to its corruptive influence, granting you the power of Ner'zhul, the original lich king. But you could learn to use its corruptive influence on others, subverting them into loyal subjects with their minds still intact, excluding your corruptive influence.
objects.title: Frostmourne (Warcraft)

addons.text:
Due to possessing the Noble Phantasm of Nikola Tesla, you can keep the Tesla fully charged as long as you have magical energy with the drain being minimal. As the Tesla is a creation of the inventor himself, you can channel the power of System Keraunos through it. By channeling through the Tesla, you gain greater control of the Noble Phantasm, as the Tesla acts as a focus that helps you master System Keraunos.

But this is not a one-way benefit; the Tesla also grows from the System Keraunos through repeated use, expanding its capabilities more and more as if Nikola himself were continuing to work on it. Its upper limits steadily increase over time, becoming a force to be reckoned with, with the major limit being the supply of power needed for the higher, more powerful levels.
addons.title: Living Tesla Coil

objects.text:
You've found The Tesla, an electric polyphase pistol named after its inventor, Nikola Tesla, who designed this weapon in collaboration with his apprentice at the time, H.G. Wells.

The Tesla, affectionately known as a "polyphase ass-kicker," is an electroshock weapon with 9 power levels, each increasing by 0.5 units, and operates much like a modern taser, emitting a directed electrical charge to incapacitate a target.

In addition to stunning the victim and causing temporary unconsciousness, the electrical discharge also briefly scrambles the brain's synapses, erasing several minutes' worth of short-term memory; these effects occur at a power setting of 2, but higher settings, such as 5, are much more dangerous and are known to reduce people to ash. It’s important to note that, at close range, even the lower settings, such as 1 or 2, can still be lethal.

Teslas can fire several times before running out of charge, depending on the setting; once the power is depleted, they must be returned to their carrying case, where they are plugged in and automatically recharged.

Note: As an alternative to the basic Tesla, you can also choose another Tesla weapon, such as the Tesla Rifle, which works similarly to the Tesla pistol but is primarily designed for long-range blasts.
objects.title: The Tesla (Warehouse 13)

addons.text: Though Cain you might not precisely be. His sins you have, nevertheless, taken upon yourself. As the one responsible for the concept of murder being created Drach’nyen is especially taken with you. You have its complete and total loyalty. And furthermore your mere presence has unlocked it’s latent potential. Drach’nyen in your hands has the ability to deal death to anything as long as a single attack hits. It needs not be a sure hit, even a single nick is enough to kill. The blade merely needs to bite the least bit into something which you want dead, and it will be so. Furthermore the blade enhances your vampiric abilities, drinking blood for you, as every being with vitae you slay will instantly have all its sweet succulent life juices transferred to you upon their demise.
addons.title: The Origin of Murder

addons.text:
From the moment of its birth as the children of man committed the first murder, Drach'nyen has been tied to humanity, its power growing with every murder, every act of hatred they committed. With every bit of power the Echo of the First Murder gained from these acts, it bound itself ever more tightly to the children of man, and through them to you, their primogenitor. It has no power over you, as you predate the original sin and remain untouched by it, yet as a being born and grown exclusively through mankind, Drach'nyen could not avoid taking in the universal love the children of man feel for their father, for it is as intrinsic to them as the hatred that birthed and nourishes the Echo of the First Murder.

And so, even as the seal that bound the End of Empires to a static and mostly immobile form breaks, letting Drach'nyen freely shift its form not just to different weapons, turning from a sword into a mace, a whip, a brass knuckle, or any other object that was ever used to commit an act of murder, but also return to its true form, a black tornado of gnashing teeth and spiked bone-tendrils, Drach'nyen cannot help but treat you as a loyal hound treats its master, following your commands, protecting you, and carrying out your will to the best of its abilities, whether that be as your weapon, your mount, or your warbeast.
addons.title: Unshackled Yet Forever Bound

objects.text:
Drach’nyen is a powerful daemonic warp predator that has been known by many names in the history of humankind, such as The End of Empires and The Echo of the First Murder. This aetheric monster of humanity's sins now takes the form of a massive, two-handed sword, though in truth, it could take the form of any weapon its wielder desires. Born at the moment of the first murder, the first time a human killed another outside of the need to survive.

The name Drach’nyen is an approximation of the scream of the first murderer and that of the brother he murdered. That single act of evil planted a seed in the Immaterium, which would blossom into the daemon Drach’nyen, for every life taken by a human anywhere, every word of hatred spoken into the ears of the dying and dead, every thought of willingly murdering another to further one's own goals, makes this daemonic sword stronger.

Upon its blade can be seen the faces of every murderer humanity has ever produced, bubbling to the surface with a silent scream before disappearing beneath the surface of the blade again. The sword is powerful enough to rend reality apart where it strikes, destroying anything and everything in its path without so much as any resistance.

Drach'nyen also acts as a powerful passive psychic attack upon all one's foes in a large area around the wielder, attacking their minds with psychic torment, images, sounds, smells, pain, fear, and feelings of their own acts of murder, now turned back upon themselves. This has no effect on those who are entirely innocent of the crime of murder. Furthermore, the daemon animating the sword can greatly empower its chosen wielder with unnatural strength and fortitude. Having devoured and gorged itself on the blood of the Emperor of Mankind, its strength is far from finished developing. 

Drach’nyen would normally extract a heavy toll on anyone wielding it, eating away at their sanity and morality; however, you are singularly immune to this; it’s voice has no effect on you outside of what a voice from a daemonic sword could normally convince you to do, hopefully very little, even being able to shut out its voice entirely should you choose so. It cannot communicate with or influence anyone else outside of you. Furthermore, should someone other than you try to use it, they will find the sword will fall through their hand as though it were made of air, though not before rending apart the offending limb with violent warp energy.
objects.title: Drach’nyen: The Echo of the First Murder (Warhammer: 40k)
Empathic Obliterator (Warhammer: 40k)
objects.text:
You are now the proud owner of the empathic obliterator, a spear made from the most high-quality technology the Necron empire could muster.

Not only is the top of the spear a hyperphase blade capable of cutting and piercing through almost any kind of armor or forcefield as if they were butter, but thanks to psychic technology stolen from the long extinct Old Ones, the empathic Obliterator causes any kind of being slain with it to emit a potent psionic wave that will kill anyone around of a similar mind and purpose to that of the deceased being. 

This makes it an ideal weapon to be used against several oponents at once, as it will ensure that only one of them needs to be struck down for the rest to fall like flies. But one must be careful, while it will be highly efficient against indoctrinated armies, cultists, and packs of beasts, a ragtag bunch of adventurers with nothing in common with one another besides their hatred of you would be the worst possible matchup against this weapon.

You should also try to stick to slaying lesser beings. Using the empathic effect against one of your own kind might prove to be a mildly ridiculous way of putting an end to your own life.

objects.title: EtaCarn Plasma Pistol (Warhammer: 40k)
objects.text:
The EtaCarn Plasma Pistol is a compact, slab-sided sidearm issued primarily to Theyns and other junior officers among the Kin. Machined from dense void-forged alloys, it is a weapon built for decisive close-quarters work rather than sustained fire.

Each shot is a tightly contained bolt of superheated plasma that will reliably punch through Space Marine power armor, carapace, and the lighter plates of most xenos or Imperial vehicles. On impact it vaporizes flesh, flash-boils bodily fluids, and leaves clean, cauterized cavities. Against unarmored or lightly armored targets the result is usually catastrophic overkill.

Its compact form necessarily limits both its range and ammunition capacity. It only has approximately 25 meters of effective range (past which the projectile loses coherency and dissipates into a rapidly cooling cloud of ionized gas), and only enough energy and hydrogen gas for five shots before needing to change its hydrogen flask.

In addition to the pistol, you get five spare hydrogen flasks and a briefcase-sized pressurizer that can refill them given a source of hydrogen and some time.

He pulled the trigger. A spray of explosive psychoactive rounds incinerated the tightly packed mortals, body and soul, each individual screaming into a pyre that burned across two realms. Aravain counted twenty-five men armed with stub pistols and wrenches. A second after he had counted them they were gone, every ripple and echo that suggested they had ever existed eradicated, and even Aravain's eidetic recall struggled to conjure any details of their appearance: except that there had been twenty-five, armed with stub pistols and wrenches. An itch walked up his spine, and in spite of his discipline Aravain struggled to suppress a shudder as he lowered the weapon and continued his advance. The retcon gun, or an Ontological weapon. Seemingly similar to “Standard” molecular disruption weapons, this weapon is in fact far more terrifying. When fired at someone this rifle sends out bullets which utterly destroys matter and energy on the atomic level across space and time. Causing any living thing hit by it to be retcon out of reality. Every atom, molecule, or quark which makes up your body, any ectoplasmic piece of your soul, any moment in time in which the matter and energy which constitutes YOU, any memory of you, is now gone. Having never existed in the first place. Having been utterly and thoroughly ripped out of the timeline. As if you were quite literally retconned out of existence. Your rifle comes packaged with a hefty supply of ammunition, and any time you find yourself needing more, you will simply find it, whether that is around you or on you in ammo belts/cases. Be warned, for this weapon is a miracle of the golden age of technology, and nearly impossible to truly and fully maintain, much less study, without significant understanding of human technology during the peak of the federation's time. Without the help of an STC or similar knowledge and intellect even slightly understanding this weapon would be far beyond you.
objects.title: Ontological Rifle (Warhammer: 40k)

addons.text:
You are the Emperor, and you have simply reclaimed what was always yours. You no longer need to wait hundreds of years to achieve elevation; as the Emperor, you can directly absorb the soul fragment that was yours, further increasing your formidable psychic might. You may also choose whether to absorb the memories contained within the soul fragment or take only its power. In addition, you now have complete control over the Sword, no longer needing to fear it overriding your intent.

Furthermore, you gain the final pieces of the Emperor’s Gear:

First, even without the Object of Power: Wargear (Warhammer: 40k), you receive the Emperor’s Armour. This armour is nearly indestructible, easily withstanding bombardment from a Titan’s main gun, and merely looking at it harms demonic and corruptive forces. The armour can grow or shrink according to your preference and can change shape into anything you desire, even ordinary clothing. You can also integrate your shield into the armour, further increasing the defensive capabilities of both.

Second, you gain the Emperor’s Lightning Claw, typically worn on the left hand and featuring three to five razor-sharp blades. The claw shares the same anti-demonic and anti-corruptive properties, and is unmatched in sharpness, even capable of cutting through space itself. Any wounds inflicted by the claw are extremely difficult to heal, with only the most powerful regenerative or healing abilities able to counteract them.

Lastly, you obtain the Emperor’s Bolt Pistol. This weapon never needs to be reloaded, as it has an infinite supply of ammunition and can fire bolt rounds indefinitely. Its rounds possess a fundamental advantage against immaterial, demonic, and similar entities. You can also charge the bullets with your own psychic power, greatly increasing their speed, range, and destructive force—enough to destroy Titans, spacecrafts, or even entire planets, with the only limit being your own psychic might.

These items are bonded to you at the level of the soul and can be summoned or dismissed at will, stored safely within your very soul.
addons.title: The Full Package (Warhammer: 40K)

objects.text:
"Forged in righteous hate. The Galaxy is not right. It needs correction.
<h style="color:Gold;">HUMANITIES DREAM'S WILL NOT DIE</h>
Offering everything to its people and demanding everything in return. Uncompromising compromises.
<h style="color:Gold;">OFFER YOUR HEAD. I HAVE NEED OF IT</h>
An eternity of torment for oneself. An eternity of sacrifice. An eternity of dying, but never death.
<h style="color:Gold;">AN ACCEPTABLE PRICE</h>"

You gain the God-Emperor’s wargear—his Sword, Tarot, and Shield. They are no longer relics, but ascended artifacts shaped by ten thousand years of devotion in the 42nd Millennium. That faith has rendered the Emperor's tools quasi-divine; each item exists as a minor Warp god anchored in reality.

The Sword can be wreathed in anathema Warp-flame that annihilates rather than destroys, and is fundamentally and conceptually oposed to all things Immaterial, unnatural, Daemon based, or Demonic, granting true death to entities that would otherwise persist, or be immune to certain types of damage. These flames purge corruption of all kinds and inspire loyalty, and devotion. The blade is indestructible and effortlessly cut any material. Finally it is capable of unleashing massive storms of the same Warp fire mentioned previously, the storm starts on a level where it is able to bathe a full blown battlefield instantly, the storm of Warp Fire grows with your skill with the blade, with fighting, and your Power.

The Shield, is absolutely indestructible, and merely holding it grants protection to you and all behind you, comparable to possessing the Durability of The Emperor himself wearing his full armor. It nullifies or reflects all energy-based attacks, regardless of origin or scale. Its mere presence exerts overwhelming conceptual pressure on all things Unnatural, immaterial, or Corruptive in nature, enough to destroy even a Greater Daemon Prince's for daring to look at You and your Shield.

The Tarot Cards provide flawless, unbreakable precognition on a galactic scale, that are never wrong, and are capable of breaching all defenses against Divination of any type or strength. Their meanings are delivered with perfect clarity and cannot be altered, obscured, or interpreted by anyone else. And finally they grant you a transcendent Affinity to all things Divination, Fate, or Seer based, just as The Emperors greatest skill and strength lay in his Divination.

The Sword represents the greatest transformation of The God Emperor's Gear. It contains fragments of the Emperor’s soul, granting it full sapience. Its nature mirrors his—deeply hostile to xenos, daemons, and all things of Chaos or of the immaterial—and it acts with fierce, often overzealous judgment.

It is utterly devoted to you, viewing itself as a tool for your will, ambitions, and glory, just as the Emperor vied himself and all of his creations as tools for Humanity. It will go to extreme lengths to serve you so long as no harm comes to you. However, like the Emperor’s own uncompromising, and Tyrannical nature, it may override your intent, or will when it judges a threat to you to be severe enough. It does not act without what it perceives as cause, but its standards are absolute. Even then, its “mercy” more often manifests as overwhelming, soul-altering terror rather than immediate destruction.

The Sword also seeks to elevate you toward the Emperor’s and his creations stature, and even beyond them, in every way, steadily reshaping your entire being through process that intensifies in combat, whcih feels like thing worming their way through your being. It carries with it the Emperor’s knowledge, including much of humanity’s lost Golden Age.

To start with you immediately gain a few alterations. Your soul develops a vent for excess energy, manifesting as a radiant golden aura that allows unrestricted use of your abilities. At rest, this condenses into a spiked halo that projects a forcefield, using excess energies your body or soul produces. Your presence becomes sunlike—radiant, stabilizing, and inspiring to allies. You also become anathema to immaterial and hostile entities: to them, your presence is either agonizing or overwhelmingly sublime, depending on intent. This quality infuses all your abilities, which take on a golden, radiant aspect. You awaken as a Gamma-level psyker with the potential to surpass even the Emperor at his very peak.

Beyond the Basic alterations you start with, the process of your Elevation is a very very long process without excessive combat, taking around 250 years to reach the heights of The Emperor before the Age Of Strife, and around 750 more to reach his heights right before he was entombed on the Golden Throne, though do keep in mind Great amounts of Warfare, and Combat can accelerate this process immensely.

All of these relics are bound to you at the level of the soul, and may Gain the positive or neutral properties of other "Types" of Soul Bond's, such as Memories if you have the power The Nightmare Spell (Shadow Slave) or are in a world with the Nightmare spell. They can alter their size to suit your form, ensuring they remain usable regardless of your shape or scale. They are inherently hostile to any who are not you, especially those who attempt to wield or even touch them without your consent, actively sabotaging such individuals and ultimately seeking to erase their souls for their transgression. Additionally, should you possess the Object of Power: War Gear (Warhammer: 40K), you may manifest the Emperor’s armor as part of this already divine arsenal.
objects.title: The God Emperors Gear of War (Warhammer: 40K)

objects.text:
You have become the latest bearer of the war hammer Ghal Maraz. Created by the Smith God Grungi in the World-That-Was, the weapon was gifted to Sigmar back when he was still mortal, and the weapon ascended to godhood alongside him. Sigmar would eventually bestow this hammer upon the Celestant-Prime, the greatest of his Stormcast Eternals.

This hammer is extremely durable, able to survive the destruction of the World-That-Was without a scratch. It is also an extremely potent holy relic, capable of emitting light that can cause immense harm to both Daemons and the undead as well as negating their immortality. The Celestant-Prime was even able to use this power to destroy corrupted parts of the souls of those in thrall to Chaos, and send whatever good was left for Sigmar to reforge into Stormcast Eternals. These abilities are augmented when Ghal Maraz assumes its divine form of a hammer made of pure golden light, though this transformation is temporary on the mortal plane.

The use of this hammer by both Sigmar and the Celestant-Prime has left this hammer highly saturated in the magic of Azyr. This makes the wielder go through a process similar to the Reforging, granting you the physiology of a Stormcast Eternal and an armor made of Sigmarite. This link to Azyr allows you to wield heavenly magics, with possible applications being celestial blasts, teleportation, and summoning the beasts of the realm of Azyr to your side.

To prevent a repeat of the Battle of Burning Skies, the hammer is enchanted to return to your side even if you throw it across dimensions.
objects.title: Ghal Maraz (Warhammer: Age of Sigmar)

addons.text:
The Sword Of Khaine has changed form from the dripping blood red favored by Khaine, to the striking black with green highlights of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army. You now possess a Cursed Gear!

Khaine's restless spirit has stabilized; now losing your mind without specialized resistances is the outlier rather than the expected outcome, with the demon of the sword being far easier to manage.

It retains its shapeshifting ability, able to transform into any kind of Cursed Gear, with a quality always at least equal to the Black Demon series.
addons.title: Cursed Gear (Seraph of the End)

objects.text:
Forged by the smith god Vaul for Khaine, the Elven lord of murder and violence, the Old World knows of no finer blade.

The user becomes powerful beyond measure, with it's greatest wielder Aenarion once using it to kill four Greater Daemons solo, and many wielders in the Total War: Warhammer timelines have been able to use it to easily slay entire armies on their lonesome.

But there is a price: the more one uses it, the more the blade corrupts the wielder, making them callous, cruel, murderous, and ever more like Khaine himself.

While called a sword, the weapon actually reshapes itself to the form the user most desires at any given time, as it is willing to do anything to tempt an unfortunate soul into wielding it. It always shows a little of its true nature however, as whatever form it takes, it seems to be dripping blood.
objects.title: Sword of Khaine (Warhammer: Fantasy)

objects.text:
You have been issued a monopole rifle, one of the main weapons of the Green Army.

The rifle fires zero-dimensional topological defects, which erase any physical matter on contact, even xeelee construction material, but dissipate quickly when they come into contact with large chunks of dense matter, leaving spherical gouges a few tens of centimeters in diameter.
objects.title: Monopole Rifle (Xeelee Sequence)

rows.title: Wearable Objects of Power
rows.titleText: Note: All non-consumable Objects of Powers can be transferred to another person. When this happens, you do not lose any abilities the object unlocked or awakened (physical alterations, magic independent of the object, etc.) but any soul bonds transferred to the new owner.

addons.text:
Medusa’s eyes are a formidable weapon, capable of petrifying all who meet their gaze. Now, the Aegis has been bestowed with this terrifying power, displaying the visage of Medusa prominently upon its surface. This fearsome image serves to strike terror into the hearts of all who see it.

With but a thought or a mere flex of your will, you can command the Gorgoneion to open its eyes, unleashing the full might of the Mystic Eyes of Petrification. With pinpoint precision, you can turn your foes to stone, rendering them helpless and immobile.

The power of the Gorgoneion can be shared with allies imbued with the Aegis’s strength. However, as the ultimate bearer of this legendary shield, you retain full control over its effects. You can choose who may be affected by its petrifying gaze, and even seal away this power entirely if you wish.
addons.title: Gorgoneion

objects.text:
Now, in mortal hands, lies the greatest defensive armament of the Olympian Gods: the Aegis. Often regarded as a shield, a cloak, or even a suit of armor, this divine protection has been borne by both Zeus and Apollo, but is most closely associated with the Goddess Athena.

The Aegis possesses unparalleled defensive power, capable of absorbing damage and harm that meets it. Most attacks are rendered harmless upon contact, with even Zeus’s lightning bolts unable to breach its protections.

While its default form is that of a bronze-covered Greek shield, the Aegis is a versatile artifact that can be reshaped at will. It can take the form of any shield, cloak, or piece of armor—either alone or as a set—while maintaining its protective properties. It can even be stored as a bracelet or a watch worn upon your arm, though such concealment diminishes its strength.

The Aegis also possesses a final, powerful ability: it can share portions of its defensive capabilities with allies, by imbuing them with a fraction of its defensive might. This imbuement can be directed to empower an existing item in their possession or allow them to generate—and dismiss—a new protective artifact of their own, and can be reclaimed at your will.
objects.title: Aegis

objects.text:
A ring that anchors your existence. It holds three slots, each capable of automatically nullifying a single instance of reality alteration directed at you—whether it’s a timeline shift, a forced transformation, or an attempt to rewrite your fate. When triggered, the ring ensures your safety, shielding you from the effect—whether the change is localized or cosmic in scale.

The ring is attuned to your mind and only triggers in response to changes or effects you would reject. If you willingly accept a change—such as a polymorph from an ally or a timeline revision you consent to—the ring remains inactive. It is metaphysically bound to you, making it immune to theft or destruction, though you may choose to give it away.

Each slot requires one month to recharge after use. While powerful, the ring's protections can be circumvented through repeated changes in quick succession. Once all three slots are exhausted, it offers no further defense until recharged.
objects.title: Anchoring Ring

objects.text:
A pendant crafted from seven feathers taken from an archangel, each preserved beneath a coating of blessed silver.

While worn, the pendant grants its bearer extraordinarily powerful divine protection against harmful supernatural and mundane effects. This protection includes, but is not limited to, physical and magical attacks, poison, disease, petrification, curses, instant-death effects, telepathic intrusion, mind control, madness, spiritual corruption, possession, soul damage, existence erasure, hostile reality alteration, temporal interference, and time-stop abilities.

The pendant does not necessarily render its wearer completely immune to every such effect, especially when confronted by forces of immense power. However, it provides exceptionally strong resistance and may greatly reduce, delay, or entirely negate effects that would otherwise overwhelm the wearer.

Because of its intensely holy nature, the pendant greatly strengthens any divine or holy magic wielded by its bearer. It is especially effective against demonic, infernal, and corruptive forces. All demonic entities within one hundred meters are weakened, with the suppression becoming increasingly severe as they approach the wearer. Demons that come within ten meters risk being immediately banished, although exceptionally powerful entities may resist or delay this effect.

The pendant also grants its wearer a constant regenerative effect. Wounds heal more quickly, physical exhaustion fades sooner, and bodily damage is gradually repaired. Because this healing operates at the cellular and genetic levels, it also slows the aging process and helps prevent the accumulation of age-related damage.

The pendant’s greatest power lies within the seven archangel feathers from which it was created. Whenever the wearer dies from an unnatural cause, one feather is automatically consumed, losing its radiance and protective power. The wearer is then resurrected in perfect physical, mental, and spiritual condition.

This resurrection can restore the wearer from nearly any form of death, including complete bodily destruction, severe mental damage, and injuries to the soul. However, it may fail if the wearer’s entire existence has been completely erased, or if their soul has been permanently destroyed, imprisoned, or otherwise prevented from returning by a sufficiently powerful force.

A consumed feather requires one full week to regain its power. Feathers recharge in the same order in which they were expended, and only one feather can recover at a time. Consequently, if all seven resurrection charges are consumed in rapid succession, the pendant will require seven weeks to return to full strength.

Each depleted feather also reduces the pendant’s other abilities by one-seventh. For example, if three feathers have been consumed, the pendant’s protection, demonic suppression, and regenerative effects are reduced by three-sevenths until those feathers recover.

If all seven feathers are depleted, the wearer temporarily loses the pendant’s divine protection, demonic suppression, regenerative abilities, and resurrection effect until the first feather finishes recharging.
objects.title: Angelic Embrace

objects.text:
The Arcane Hat, a mystical masterpiece crafted for the discerning witch or wizard seeking to enhance their magical prowess. This enchanting headwear not only boosts your innate magical abilities but also serves as a reservoir for your personal mana pool, allowing you to continue to cast magic even when your own mana pool is empty.

But that's not all—the Arcane Hat is a veritable hub of magical innovation. Through its passive research capabilities, it continuously delves into the arcane mysteries, allowing you to create 3 low-tier spell a day. Moreover, it also refines and improve 5 spells simultaneously, increasing its strengths, removing its limits and even giving the spells new capabilities in time.
objects.title: Arcane Hat

objects.text:
The lion constellation Leo was placed long ago into the heavens by Zeus to honor the first labor of Hercules—his slaying of the Nemean Lion. The beast was an embodiment of the scorching heat of summer, a living drought manifest. Its presence sapped the strength of men and caused the bronze weapons and armor of the time to melt.

Yet Hercules slew this monstrosity with his sheer strength, wrestling against the intense heat of the creature before eventually breaking its back. Hercules took the beast's pelt as a trophy, fashioning it into armor that retained the beast's power as a defense.

Now, this armor is in your possession. Its fiery aura melts—and eventually vaporizes—any weapons that come into contact with it. Only weapons on the level of those wielded by the gods can survive contact with this defense. The armor only emits heat outward, a result of the lion’s own natural immunity to its power. As a side effect, this renders the user completely immune to temperature, always remaining comfortable within the armor.

The armor’s connection to the constellation, however, grants it its greatest strength. While the Leo constellation typically only shines for a few months at the height of summer—and only on Earth—while wearing this armor, you can cause the sign to remain in the sky throughout the year, regardless of the world, dimension, realm, or location.

With Leo overhead, you can invoke the full power of the Nemean Lion, bringing forth the scorching heat of the midday sun at the height of summer. Buckling railways, melting roads, wildfires, and mass heatstroke are among the many effects that may occur. Once invoked, this power can rage uncontrolled but will burn out within five hours and exhaust the constellation’s power for 30 days.

Finally, the Armor of Leo can take the form of any other body armor you desire, while still retaining the full protection of the Nemean Lion’s power. You can also transform it into a small Leo pin for ease of transport and storage.
objects.title: Armor of Leo

addons.text:
The Cathedra Protocol is a bridging system that binds Ars Logicae Principialis to the Throne of Lesser YHWH, reconfiguring the ten rings into Sefirah-Keys, distributed authenticator nodes that continuously handshake with the Throne across time and space. When worn together the rings generate a tenfold cryptographic halo, functioning as authenticator keys and secure relays for remote Throne access.

Not only does this allow for remote access to the Throne’s gargantuan computational power, further boosting your efficiency and predictive prowess, but it also allows for the projection of the Throne’s Authority at range, deploying Throne Creation even when not seated on the Throne at the cost of being ranked down and limited to a lesser scale. 

Additionally, due to being connected to a proper Divine Construct, the rings are now capable of reproducing proper True Ether and storing much larger quantities of energy, as well as directly siphoning energy from the Throne.

Of interesting note is the way in which connecting to a Divine Throne has amplified the rings’ connection to the Rings of Solomon. Each ring can issue Throne-backed “Edicts” which can suborn entities weaker than the Throne’s Authority such as familiars, elementals, or even lesser Demons or Angels.

On a slightly more mundane note, as the rings connect to both your mind and the Throne, they can serve as a bridge to allow you to interact with and control the Throne without having to touch it, allowing you to browse or game at the speed of thought.
addons.title: Cathedra Protocol: Sefirot Relay Array

objects.text: A Supreme Mystic Code taking the form of ten rings made from photonic crystals, that's modeled after both the 「Seals of Solomon」 and the「Sword of Paracelsus」, and built upon their Mysteries, principles, and underlying structures. When worn together, the rings interlink with one another and your Magic Circuits, forming a distributed, cloud-like quantum computing network. The rings act as the primary processing nodes, while your brain and circuits serve as the central command unit, all supported by a hyper-advanced operating system. This system interfaces directly with your senses, continuously gathering data to run predictive algorithms. The result is short-term future prediction on the level of a lesser TRI-HERMES, capable of extrapolating events within the next few hours with a 99.9999999% accuracy rate. As with Hohenheim's famed blade, the rings likewise enhance, assist, and amplify Magecraft, even allowing for instant execution of ritual magic without setup. By using the Five Elements as a catalyst, the Mystic Code can simulate True Ether (False), reproducing Age of Gods–era magical energy—albeit to a lesser degree than the specialized artifact it's derived from. In addition, they can store centuries' worth of magical energy for later use. Each ring is further optimized for magical interference and subversion; its immense computing power allows it to analyze spells in real time, perform counter-calculations, generate appropriate formulas, and respond by hijacking, rewriting, or nullifying enemy Magecraft entirely. This marvel of Atlas alchemy also runs almost exclusively on pseudo-spiritrons.
objects.title: Ars Logicae Principialis

objects.text:
This plain silk bag opens to a magically expanded space that is larger than its outer dimensions.

The bag has an internal volume of 750 liters and can store any item as long as they fit through the opening, which can be expanded to a circle 100cm wide.

Magically expanded items (and other spatial distortions) can be safely stored in this bag but their contents cannot be access until they are pulled out.
objects.title: Bag of Holding

objects.text:
This plain silk bag opens to a magically expanded space that is larger than its outer dimensions.

The bag has an internal volume of 7500 liters and can store any item as long as they fit through the opening, which can be expanded to a circle 500cm wide.

Magically expanded items (and other spatial distortions) can be safely stored in this bag but their contents cannot be access until they are pulled out.
objects.title: Bag of Holding (Greater)

objects.text:
This leather belt has several magically expanded pouches. Somehow, it fit more pouches than its size would indicate.

The four largest pouches have a volume of 100 liters and can store any item as long as they fit through the opening, which can be expanded to a circle 75cm wide. The four medium pouches have a volume of 50 liters and their opening can stretch to 20cm. The four smallest pouches have a volume of 25 liters and their opening can stretch to 15cm.

In addition to those, the belt also has a collection of modular utility holders that can fit a variety of things that can like potions, ammunition, gadgets, or small weapons.

Magically expanded items (and other spatial distortions) can be safely stored in this bag but their contents cannot be access until they are pulled out.
objects.title: Belt of Holding

objects.text: Now twined around your waist is the Belt of Pisces, said to be created from the ribbon that bound the gods of love in their flight. The belt allows the wearer to transform their body in an almost unending number of ways, taking the form of beasts from the land, sea, and sky, or changing one’s appearance to that of another. Take heed, though—the Belt’s powers only work while worn, with any changes soon unraveling if it is removed. The belt’s ties to the constellation of Pisces, however, grant its strongest power. While Pisces only appears for part of the year—and only on Earth—you can cause the star sign to appear in the sky, regardless of the world, dimension, realm, or location. With the constellation overhead, you can invoke the star sign’s association with duality, meeting any attack or defense with its equal opposite. This effect can only be invoked once every 12 days. Finally, while the default form of the Belt of Pisces is that of a blue belt shimmering like water itself, the belt is capable of taking the form of any other belt and transforming itself into a small pin of Pisces for easy transport and storage.
objects.title: Belt of Pisces

addons.text: With the treasures of Aries, Leo, and Sagittarius now within your possession, and their constellations shining high in the sky, you have unlocked more of the powers of the relics of the Triune of Fire. The Cloak of Aries allows the user to negate the weight of all they are carrying and heal injuries and illnesses with a touch. The Armor of Leo enables the wearer to extend the burning aura of protection granted by the armor to everything they are wielding, granting those items the power to disintegrate and burn anything the armor itself would have destroyed. The Bow of Sagittarius allows you to predict and exploit the weaknesses of your targets and draw the bow, so long as you can carry the arrow’s weight. Finally, the relics’ strongest powers—linked to their respective signs—can now be used once every 3 days.
addons.title: Triune of Fire

objects.text:
Once sought after by the famous Argonauts, the golden fleece of the ram Chrysomallos is now in your possession, taking the form of a cloak made from the ram's golden wool.

When worn, the cloak adheres to the wearer’s back and grants the ability to fly using the Ram’s wings still attached. The wings allow the user to reach both great heights and great speeds safely—able to extend to the outer edges of the atmosphere and break the sound barrier.

The cloak also grants powerful healing and regeneration to anyone or anything covered by it, replenishing vitality, restoring stamina, and curing all ailments short of death itself.

Its greatest power requires a link to the constellation Aries. The Ram’s power allows the wearer to revive from death fully healed and restored once every 30 days. While the star sign typically shines only for a brief period of the year—and only on Earth—with the cloak upon your back, the constellation can be caused to stay high in the sky throughout the year, regardless of world, dimension, realm, or location.

Finally, the Cloak of Aries can take the form of any other cloak or cape, and can also be transformed into a small Aries pin for easy storage and transportation.
objects.title: Cloak of Aries

objects.text: Originally known as the Cloak of Shimmering Glass, this enchanted mantle was once the prized possession of a renowned grand illusionist—until the Nightwalker stole it and repurposed it for her own exploits. Its legendary status stems from one core principle: the manipulation of light. Foremost, the cloak's weave can absorb and store light, using it to fuel and enhance its other subsequent abilities or even release it all at once in a single, dazzling burst. Although there's no actual capacity limit, it cannot hold the light indefinitely, able at most to store a full day's worth for only a few hours after dusk before the energy begins to fade. It can also refract and bend light to distort the wearer's position, scattering about a dozen mirror-images around themselves. These illusions can mimic and follow simple movements, last indefinitely with sufficient ambient light, and stray up to 25 meters from the wearer before dissipating. In dimly lit environments, their number becomes limited, and in total darkness, they may not form at all—unless sustained briefly by the stored light. Finally, the cloak can shape and solidify light into tangible constructs, breathing temporary life into illusions; however, this will require a source to fuel them. And as a passive effect, any light-based attack striking the fabric is harmlessly deflected or absorbed.
objects.title: Cloak of The Nightwalker

objects.text:
A timeless garment forged from enchanted fabric, the Cloak of the Wayfarer is a traveler's perfect companion. It adjusts itself seamlessly to your body and surroundings, reshaping, resizing, and adapting to provide comfort in any situation. Whether you're walking through frozen tundra, climbing sun-scorched cliffs, or navigating humid jungles, the cloak maintains the ideal temperature and fit, allowing for easy movement and restful wear at all times.

The cloak offers powerful protection. It is incredibly resistant to all forms of harm—blades, bullets, elemental forces, and even magical attacks.
