No force can pierce or pass through it physically; anything that strikes the fabric is met with overwhelming resistance. While not truly invulnerable, it can withstand blows that would shatter armor or incinerate steel, absorbing and dispersing the force to keep the wearer safe. Only the most extreme and focused attacks—those beyond the realm of ordinary danger—can strain or temporarily overwhelm its defense.

When damaged, the cloak slowly regenerates over time, its threads mending on their own. This recovery process is steady but not instant, meaning sustained or repeated damage may leave it weakened for a time.

When the hood is raised, your face becomes impossible to see—shrouded in a soft, unnatural shadow that conceals your features entirely unless you will them to be revealed. Even magical sight or enhanced senses cannot pierce the veil unless you allow it.

Elegant, enduring, and fiercely protective, the Cloak of the Wayfarer is the mark of one who walks through peril unshaken.
objects.title: Cloak of the Wayfarer

addons.title: Schmoovin for a Bruisin!
addons.text:
Attached to your armour, the COWL is the perfect cloak for someone on the move, manipulating itself to never be truly restrictive like other options. 

Beyond this though, by connecting it to your visor, the COWL’s computational abilities can truly be brought to bear, giving you a fully augmented Heads Up Display and analytical suite in addition to its original rudimentary functions.

objects.text:
This cowl/cloak hybrid is made from specialised nanocircuitry, not only allowing it to be controlled as if it were an extension of you, but stretch and expand to follow your commands.

Additionally, due to the circuitry embedded within it, it can act as a moderately powerful and portable computer with only minor modifications.
objects.title: Cognition Operated Wearable Layer [Public Release ver. (Final) (Final Final) (3)]

objects.text:
The Aether is a civilian-grade neural interface developed by Neuropan Systems under license from Coalition Defense Research. While originally derived from military-grade cognitive support prototypes, the Aether was re-engineered for mass civilian use and is now a standard part of life for most citizens of the Coalition of Mankind.

Aether appears as a lightweight, flexible metallic circlet — a closed neural wreath — worn around the crown of the head. Its structure contains adaptive graphene mesh overlaid with nano-haptic nodes, allowing it to make non-invasive contact with cranial neural fields. A single port on the rear accepts Coalition-standard data chips (CDCs), which contain structured learning modules, sensory pattern cues, or procedural skill sets. Once activated, the wreath initiates a controlled sleep cycle using precision-targeted electromagnetic pulses, guiding the user into a compressed deep sleep state lasting approximately 180 minutes.

During this state, the Aether dynamically manages the user’s sleep architecture, alternating between accelerated slow-wave and REM cycles. The system it injects low-level stimulus patterns into specific sensory cortices, such as auditory or visual areas, encoded from the CDC data. The user’s brain then interprets and constructs dream scenarios based off the data, using existing symbolic and emotional frameworks. This preserves memory plasticity and avoids cognitive overload or semantic mismatch. The Aether does not “install” large volumes of knowledge or procedural skillsets instantaneously. Rather, it supports incremental, cumulative learning by optimizing the sleep-based consolidation of information. The effect is comparable to attending structured lessons while asleep, leveraging natural neuroplasticity without bypassing organic cognitive processes.

Simultaneously, the system enhances hippocampal–neocortical communication, increasing the fidelity of memory consolidation. Neural replay during sleep is amplified via hippocampal stimulation, promoting transfer of short-term memories (acquired during wakeful study or daily activity) into long-term storage. The Aether can also prioritize emotionally relevant content or instructionally tagged segments from the CDC, improving retention. This process is managed entirely by the user’s own neural architecture; the system only optimizes the biological conditions.

Users report significantly increased cognitive stamina, improved memory recall, and reduced mental fatigue. In Coalition education metrics, students using Aether consistently outperform non-users by 89% on baseline testing after three cycles. In occupational applications, the device reduces retraining time for technical roles by 68%, and has been credited with extending functional work-life in high-cognition sectors.

Included with the Aether system is a compact chip fabricator unit, issued with each civilian package. The fabricator allows users to create new, blank CDCs using standardized memory substrate materials provided in modular cartridges. The fabricator also features an integrated data port, enabling users to write custom information onto the chips — ranging from academic materials and skill modules to personal recordings or project-specific knowledge libraries.
objects.title: Cognitive Sleep Suite 27 “Aether”

objects.text:
Issued to commissioned leaders across Coalition field armies, the Command Uniform 02 “Eagle” was designed to replace outdated officer fatigues with attire that could survive in the same combat environments as the troops under command. While it lacks the heavy plating or servo support of powered armor, the Eagle provides officers with a refined presence, integrated command systems, and battlefield survivability suitable for both direct engagement and operational leadership.

The Eagle is a sharply cut uniform in dark slate-gray or deep navy, with an iridescent finish that subtly shifts under light. Its structure is tapered through the torso with reinforced shoulders, emphasizing authority without adding bulk. A high collar houses integrated communications hardware, while glowing threadlines at the chest, cuffs, and collar display rank insignia and unit affiliation. These identifiers can brighten for visibility in formation or dim into stealth mode in the field. Its seams lie flush against the body, preventing snagging and ensuring compatibility beneath exosuits when required.

The uniform is constructed from a ballistic nanoweave of carbon-strand and polymer microfibers, dense enough to disperse glancing small-arms fire and shrapnel yet flexible for daily wear. Beneath this outer layer lies a ballistic gel undermesh focused around vital zones, absorbing blunt trauma and fragmentation. The weave is self-healing, able to close small tears automatically, and carries a phase-weave finish tuned to reduce infrared signature and soften the wearer’s visibility to hostile sensors without obscuring them from their own troops.

Integrated microfluidic coolant channels run throughout the Eagle, filled with thermally conductive gel linked to belt-mounted phase-change packs. These systems regulate body temperature under exertion, storing excess heat or venting it in controlled bursts to avoid thermal detection. The fabric is climate-adaptive, adjusting permeability automatically to suit desert, tundra, or toxic environments. Waste-recycling and active moisture-wicking fibers maintain hydration and cleanliness across extended deployments.

Medical and protective features are embedded throughout. Auto-med filaments line the inner layers, capable of delivering coagulants, stimulants, or anti-shock compounds through direct skin contact. Impact-dampening pads at the spine, knees, and elbows reduce fatigue and absorb sudden falls or concussive force. Subdermal sync ports integrated into the fabric allow real-time transmission of officer vitals and cognitive load to squad HUDs and command networks, keeping leadership functional and trackable.

For utility, the Eagle employs smart magnetic-seal pouches along the chest and waist, designed for sidearms, wafers, and tablets rather than heavy ordnance. A command collar node provides secure short-range uplink capability, acting as a local hub for squad and platoon comms. Retinal projectors embedded in the collar allow officers to receive tactical HUD overlays without helmets, enabling visible leadership while maintaining battlefield awareness.

Self-cleaning nanofiber treatments render the surface resistant to dirt, blood, and chemical agents, preserving composure under field conditions. Modular paneling allows damaged sections to be replaced without replacing the full uniform, ensuring consistent command presence even during extended campaigns.
objects.title: Command Uniform 02 “Eagle”

objects.text:
A high-grade Mystic Code developed by a talented modern Magus renowned for gemstone thaumaturgy, this Mystic Code was crafted through research inspired by a Nameless Servant and his absolute mastery of Reinforcement. The armor takes the form as a sleeveless, matte-black compression shirt woven from spiritual carbon-silk and dragon-sinew composite fibers, lined with silver thaumaturgical conduits that trace your musculature and nerve paths. Around the collar lies a crescent-shaped metal plate of moon-silver and orichalcum. When worn, it conforms seamlessly to the body, creating the impression of skin overlaid by liquid steel.

The Counter Guardian’s Armor functions as a continuous Reinforcement field, harmonizing its internal circuits with your own, if you have any. When worn, the armor conducts prana through the silver channels in precise rhythm, reading the biological and thaumaturgical patterns that define your physical structure. It amplifies the output of every movement, maintaining your muscles, reflexes, and sensory acuity at their optimal thresholds. The armor’s field does not alter your nature but instead presses your form toward its theoretical limit: your body becomes an idealized version of itself, refined without distortion. Prana efficiency remains stable as the armor recycles excess output through its conductive weave, preventing overload or cell damage.

The metal collar serves as the interface for Alteration. By channeling a clearly defined concept into the node, you can impose a new structural property onto yourself for a limited duration. The process requires complete cognitive understanding of the target property, partial comprehension results in field instability or rejection. For simple effects, such as hardening your epidermis to the tensile strength of steel, the node’s array recalibrates the reinforcement field’s parameters, rewriting only the outer layer of the body’s thaumaturgical formula. Complex alterations, such as emulating a nonhuman trait or altering your body shape and build requires precise internal mapping; failure to maintain conceptual coherence risks field collapse and backlash. During Alteration, the armor acts as an externalized magic circuit, isolating the rewritten property within a bounded shell around your form to prevent it from spreading into your soul layer.

The armor autonomously generates and maintains its own energy reserves by drawing ambient magical particles and environmental mana from the surrounding area. This collected energy is refined through the armor’s conductive lattice and stored in subdermal prana capacitors within the silver conduits, allowing it to operate independently of your own circuits for extended durations. Under normal conditions, the armor sustains continuous Reinforcement without external input. However, you can manually supply prana to the system through your own circuits or an external source to exceed its inherent energy limitations. Doing so allows temporary overclocking of the Reinforcement field or the execution of high-tier Alterations that would otherwise be unsustainable. A limiter built into the control node prevents runaway prana intake by venting excess energy back into the environment once saturation thresholds are reached.
objects.title: Counter Guardian’s Armor

addons.title: RESET SCAN
addons.text:
Wiring your Doubletime™ Access Bracers into your armour allows them to piggyback off the detection of your vitals. 

At any time you can declare a ‘scan’ and after ten seconds of assessment, the bracers will set it as a ‘reset point’, allowing you to return to that point in time and space with a touch of a button. 

This can also be linked to your armour’s detection of your vitals to instantly send you back when you take a would-be lethal hit. 

Do note going from death to your last reset can be disconcerting, especially if it was taken a while ago.

objects.text: You have been given a set of Doubletime™ Access Bracers (patent pending) designed to slightly disjoint the user from the timestream. By pressing a button on the top of one of the bracers, or linking it to another input system, it drags the user backwards or forwards up to ten seconds in time. The other is solely dedicated to the more complex task of true time travel. The two have been separated for user convenience and safety. When moving backwards, you’ll be in the same place as you are when activating it, leaving two of you there for a short time before their bracer automatically activates to preserve the timeline and send them to become you. Unfortunately the Bracer is designed to avoid chaining backwards slips together for the user’s safety, and will not be able to send you backwards again until the previous you has left. When moving forwards, you instead appear to ‘disappear’ from where you were and reappear there after your preselected time. The other bracer is designed to allow the user to time travel more conventionally, however it requires a far greater amount of energy to perform and more time to calculate your temporal trajectory. As such, it requires a day to charge per month traveled in either direction, though this can be shortened by connecting it to large energy sources. Unlike the other bracers you can input co-ordinates to teleport to upon activation. In order to preserve the integrity of the timeline, unlike the other bracer, this product operates on the ‘Multiverse Theory of Time Travel’. Daeva Inc. apologises for any existential dread caused in the use of this product. Operations Supervisor’s note: Craig, Corporate wants you to find a better name or they’re relocating the office’s sapience budget.
objects.title: Doubletime™ PROTOTYPE (2) (1)

objects.text: In your possession is a full set of armor, capable of protecting your entire body. This is no normal armor however, it is enchanted. First off, there are absolutely no gaps in the armors protection, allowing you to be protected absolutely everywhere. You can see perfectly fine despite not having any eyeholes. Secondly, the armor is enchanted to be much more durable than steel, capable of reliably protecting you from small arms fire, though too much in the same spot will break it. Lastly, it is almost weightless, allowing you to move as if you were wearing nothing at all. The armor can be of any type and design you wish, such as leather armor, but is by default a full set of european plate armor.
objects.title: Enchanted Armor

objects.text: You receive a full wardrobe of enchanted clothing tailored to your preferences. All clothes are enchanted to self repair, clean themselves, and be more resistant to general wear and tear. The self repair happens quickly, restoring fully after a few seconds. The clothes are only resistant to the wear and tear incurred during daily life—they’re not going to protect you from being stabbed, you’ll need actual armor for that.
objects.title: Enchanted Clothing

addons.text:
Developed within a year of the Vindicator and Bigfoot entering service, the Anvil-Link was introduced as an automatic integration protocol activated whenever both systems detect each other. It was designed by the Coalition of Mankind to standardize human-machine interaction and reduce operator burden during prolonged operations, effectively merging the firearm’s control systems with the exosuit’s neural interface.

When active, Anvil-Link fuses the Vindicator’s recoil compensation algorithms with the Bigfoot’s servo-feedback system. This reduces felt recoil by 80%, allowing controlled full-automatic fire while moving. Accuracy loss while firing on the move is halved compared to baseline Bigfoot use. Anchoring servos can hard-lock in place within 0.3 seconds, reducing weapon sway to less than 0.2° over sustained volleys.

The ammunition fabrication box can be attached onto the Bigfoot’s back and linked to the suit’s load-balancing software. Completed bricks are automatically cycled into back-mounted slots. Reloads require only one servo-assisted motion, reducing brick swap time to 0.8 seconds. Ammunition weight is dynamically redistributed across the frame, lowering effective carried weight by 65% and reducing operator fatigue accumulation to negligible levels.

Weapon handling is further adjusted by the Bigfoot’s dynamic stabilization system. The Vindicator’s 14 kg weight is reduced to an effective 5 kg in-hand through servo redistribution. The operator can sprint at up to 35 km/h with the weapon readied and being fired without significant accuracy degradation, compared to 40 km/h baseline unarmed sprint. Sustained fire penalties due to fatigue are eliminated.
addons.title: Integrated Combat Suite 02 “Anvil-Link”

objects.text:
The Bigfoot is the standardized infantry exosuit, a dependable powered frame built to extend the reach and endurance of soldiers across every theater of war. It was among the first exosuits fielded by the Coalition of Mankind.

Power is supplied by a compact fusion micro-core, providing a high-density, continuous energy output for days without external refueling. The suit’s servo-hydraulic muscle-assist framework amplifies strength and stamina while reducing fatigue. A Bigfoot-equipped operator can exert up to 2,500 newtons of grip strength per hand, enough to crush a steel pipe or bend rebar and lift up to 600 kg in controlled loads.

Ceramic-graphene plates shield vital areas from direct fire, capable of withstanding projectiles up to 7.62×51mm NATO rounds at point-blank range, and dispersing impacts up to 30 kJ of kinetic energy before structural compromise. The carbon-fiber weave underlayer protects against fragmentation, blunt trauma, and impacts of up to 2,000 N across distributed surfaces, allowing soldiers to shrug off shrapnel or debris that would incapacitate unarmored troops. The exosuit’s mobility is unhindered by this protection, granting the wearer the ability to consistently jog at 40 km/h, climb vertical obstacles up to 3 meters unaided, and leap gaps of 5 meters with load. 

A survival suite is fully integrated into the Bigfoot’s design. A thermal-regulated undersuit ensures operability in both freezing tundras and desert extremes. A submersible oxygen tank and closed-loop filtration system allow soldiers to operate in smoke, toxic atmospheres, or underwater. The filtration system can extract oxygen dissolved in water, supplementing the onboard tank to extend operational time indefinitely in submerged conditions. Filters automatically scrub 99.9% of airborne or dissolved toxins, particulates, and biological agents, providing reliable respiratory protection for extended engagements.

The helmet incorporates a tactical optics array with 4× optical zoom, infrared overlay, low-light enhancement, and range-finding up to 1.2 km. A neural-response interface links the operator’s movements to the exosuit’s servos in real time, creating seamless, lag-free operation. Integrated load-balancing software actively adjusts power distribution based on motion, weapon handling, and terrain, ensuring efficiency without conscious input.
objects.title: Exosuit System 01 “Bigfoot”

addons.text:
The Aegis-Titan is not a one-off creation. It’s part of a broader line of high-end exosuits developed and manufactured entirely within Sentinel Bastion. Your suit is one of many—equal in capability to several others—but what sets it apart is simple: you’re the one using it. Most of the others are still sealed in maintenance cradles, systems live, weapons calibrated, and power reserves full. They were built, perfected, and prepped for deployment—but never assigned. Without users, they’ve been left to gather dust in vaults and staging bays across the Bastion.

The mass-production line of Aegis-Titan suits focuses on standardized combat efficiency. These are rugged, all-purpose frames designed to function autonomously or under basic human operation. While not lacking in firepower or durability, they’re stripped down for flexibility and reliability—“Jack of all trades” units built to handle a range of situations without excelling in any one. They’re used by drones, AI subroutines, or in rare cases, field personnel with clearance. They get the job done, but they aren’t tuned or specialized. 

Alongside these standard units are the other full-spec variants from the Exosuit System 09 series—each matching the Aegis-Titan in core performance, but built for different roles. The Aegis-Wraith is engineered for infiltration and stealth operations, with active camouflage and silent movement systems. The Aegis-Abyss is a deep-sea combat unit, sealed and pressure-armored for underwater warfare. The Aegis-Phalanx is a siege and breaching platform with reinforced armor and integrated heavy shielding. The Aegis-Zenith is built for aerial deployment, capable of atmospheric re-entry and sustained hover mobility. Finally, the Aegis-Duskfall is a hardened survival suit meant for extreme environments like irradiated zones, arctic tundra, and volcanic terrain. This is not all and even now, more is being made in the R&D Department.
addons.title: Standard Gear

addons.text:
The greatest flaw of the Aegis-Titan was never its hardware, but the fragile human inside. Conventional operators could not withstand the suit’s full reactive power, suffering from neural feedback collapse, crushed tissue, or catastrophic system lag. You are the exception — the Super Soldier for whom the suit was rewritten — not just to match your limits, but to exceed them.

When worn by you, the Aegis-Titan enters its Second Skin configuration — unlocking its unrestricted output protocols. This includes the unshackling of muscle-actuator limiters, tripling baseline strength and acceleration while reinforcing internal inertia compensators to handle the raw force of your movements. The suit’s neural command link fuses directly to your prefrontal cortex relay via reinforced bio-ports, allowing the exosuit to predict your combat decisions microseconds before they occur. With your cybernetic physiology acting as a living regulator, the Aegis-Titan’s internal cold-fusion engine is allowed to run hot — overclocking all core systems in combat. Railgun charge times are halved, missile targeting becomes hyper-reactive, and environmental shielding strengthens dynamically in live fire zones.

You can channel surplus kinetic force into devastating directional bursts — shockwaves on landing, concussive punches, or mid-air thrusts that redirect your trajectory. With the suit’s adaptive terrain locomotion and your internal dampeners, vertical engagement becomes trivial: you can wall-pivot in tight spaces, rebound off armored surfaces, or convert freefall velocity into a weaponized descent. Additionally, minor systems such as microgyro stabilizers in the ankle servos and shoulder brace recoil-dampeners sync to your muscle movements in real-time, minimizing weapon lag and maximizing control.
addons.title: Second Skin

addons.text:
The pairing between Aegis-Titan and Breaker proved unexpectedly effective in long-duration breach-and-hold missions across collapsed megacities and irradiated trench zones. Combat engineers noticed that Titan pilots wielding the Breaker gained a marked edge in survivability, leading to the development of a dedicated sync protocol between the two. The resulting system allowed both tools to operate as a unified combat-engineering platform without interrupting frontline momentum.

The suit now includes a rear hip-mounted magnetic cradle for Breaker storage and neural-link integration that allows the Aegis-Titan to deploy, mode-shift, and strike with the Breaker as if it were a native limb weapon. When synced, the suit dynamically adjusts inertia compensation based on the Breaker’s gravity-inertia plate settings, allowing devastating compacted-earth slams or precision kinetic strikes in melee. Additionally, trenching or excavation actions performed with the Breaker in sync mode provide power back to the suit’s systems via enhanced kinetic energy harvesting, enabling brief boosts to shield recovery or missile pod recharge during prolonged engagements.
addons.title: Loadout

addons.text:
Developed during the classified Polaris Convergence Program, Weapon Platform 57 “Apollo” was created to solve a critical gap in orbital siege operations—fielding a weapon that could deliver Helios levels of devastation without limiting operator mobility or combat flexibility. Only a handful of Aegis-Titan frames were ever equipped with Apollo, and each was said to have reshaped entire conflict zones before vanishing into silence.

Apollo is a modular integration system that enables the Helios to be hard-mounted into the right arm of the Aegis-Titan, replacing the standard railgun in whole or in part. The weapon is housed in a retractable carriage that folds into the forearm chassis, with a reinforced plasma-barrel extension that deploys along the wrist and forearm when engaged. Using a universal hardlink interface, Apollo connects directly into the suit’s internal power conduits, bypassing the external energy cells entirely. The suit’s hybrid cold fusion core becomes the weapon’s primary energy source, enabling sustained fire in both long-range and rapid modes without requiring reloads or battery swaps. When not needed, the Helios module can be manually detached or automatically decoupled, allowing the user to reactivate the original railgun and carry the weapon in handheld form if desired.

Integration dramatically improves performance and safety: the Aegis-Titan’s thermal-regulated mesh and ablative ceramic shell are rerouted through Apollo’s plasma stabilizers, creating a closed-loop heat dissipation network. This allows superheated gases and residual plasma to be absorbed, redirected, or vented with precision across non-critical armor surfaces. The cooling delay and auto-lockout systems of the Helios are rendered obsolete; overheating becomes a non-issue, even under continuous fire.
addons.title: Weapon Platform 57 “Apollo”

addons.text:
“Indra” was developed from reverse-engineered Xeno Alliance drone systems and energy-lattice redirection systems. It was engineered specifically to counter the Alliance’s energy-based weaponry. Given only to elite soldiers, it was one of the most advanced add-ons to the Aegis-Titan. 

The Aegis-Titan’s shoulder missile pod can be replaced with the compact R.C.A.S.D.A.S. core. The exosuit routes hybrid fusion energy directly into the drone network, tripling plasma output, doubling flight time, and reducing inter-shot delay from 6 seconds to 2.2 seconds. The system is fully contained within the armor with no manual deployment is needed.

The R.C.A.S.D.A.S. headset is fused into the Aegis-Titan’s neural link, creating a unified command matrix. This allows real-time concurrent control of both exosuit systems and drone artillery with zero latency. The drone array reacts autonomously to battlefield conditions while remaining override-capable through thought input.

Four upgraded scanners, now CSV (Conductive Scan Vortex) scanner drones form a directional energy grid capable of intercepting and redirecting incoming energy-based attacks. This includes plasma, laser, EMP, and high-temperature beam weapons. The grid generates a flexible energy shield with a 120-degree arc and up to 15 meters in radius. It can sustain up to 15 megajoules per second across all nodes before overload. In addition to absorbing direct attacks, the drones can passively accumulate ambient charge by acting as lightning rods, drawing in atmospheric electrical activity to replenish reserves during storms or energy-rich environments.

Once the energy threshold is exceeded, the shield collapses and begins a reconstitution cycle lasting 6.5 seconds. During active shielding or while storing excess charge, the system allows for two energy redirection pathways: it can discharge stored energy as 600kV electrical bursts at hostile targets within an 8-meter radius (with a 1.2-second pulse interval), or divert the energy internally to fuel overclocking of the Aegis-Titan’s core systems. Overclocking has no artificial cap and dynamically boosts strength, speed, and fire rate in proportion to available energy, limited only by the stored output of the CSV array or auxiliary intake.

Lastly, the R.C.A.S.D.A.S. digestion module functions as an auxiliary energy source. Solid matter fed into the port—organic or inorganic—is converted at 99% efficiency into high-density charge, which can be routed directly to drone systems, reinforce the CSV array, or bulk-feed the overclock channel. This enables emergency recovery or momentary surges far beyond what the hybrid core can sustain alone. Continuous intake cycles allow for sustained operation during extended missions, or deliberate matter-fed overdrive states during critical assaults.
addons.title: Prototype Weapon Platform 14 “Indra”

objects.text:
The Aegis-Titan is an experimental heavy exosuit engineered for front-line shock operations and deep-strike combat in high-risk zones. Towering and formidable, this wearable warframe is powered by a hybrid cold fusion core and built around a reactive muscle fiber system that multiplies your strength and speed far beyond human limits. The Aegis-Titan’s exoshell is constructed from a titanium-boron carbide alloy, designed to shrug off high-caliber kinetic impacts and resist the destructive effects of shaped charges and plasma weaponry. Beneath this hardened shell, a graphene-reinforced carbon weave provides both flexibility and secondary protection, with a ceramic ablative coating layered on top to disperse energy from directed energy weapons. A thermal-regulated mesh interior ensures operational integrity in both arctic and desert extremes.

Armament is fully integrated: a shoulder-mounted smart missile pod locks onto and tracks multiple targets with surgical precision, while the right arm houses a railgun capable of punching through armored bunkers and enemy vehicles alike. The left arm features a multi-tool hardpoint adaptable to your mission needs—whether a breaching blade, demolition hammer, or flamethrower module. Full-spectrum sensors encircle the helmet, including infrared, LIDAR, and low-light optics, with threat-tagging capabilities to provide you complete situational awareness. A neural command link allows the suit to move as an extension of your body, responding in real time to your reflexes and intent. 

The Aegis-Titan employs a silent tactical optimization core. This system monitors your behavior and fine-tunes response times, movement calibration, and support systems over time to maximize combat efficiency. For battlefield awareness and electronic warfare, the suit includes a Signal Recon & Intercept Suite capable of passively monitoring and decoding enemy communications, enabling you to anticipate troop movements or disable coordination among hostile forces. The adaptive terrain locomotion system enables you to scale walls, leap across urban ruins, and move with deceptive agility for a platform of its size. Finally, a self-healing nanomaterial mesh embedded throughout the interior layers allows the suit to gradually seal and repair minor breaches, granting it extended viability in long-term deployments without the need for field maintenance.
objects.title: Exosuit System 09 “Aegis-Titan”

objects.text:
You possess an exquisite set of formal attire—either a sharp tuxedo or an elegant evening gown, tailored perfectly to your personal style and sizes. This ensemble is completed with a tasteful selection of accessories: ties, cufflinks, brooches, gloves, hats, or high heels—each chosen to suit both fashion and function. On the surface, it’s the epitome of refinement, designed for galas, embassy dinners, high-stakes auctions, or intimate meetings in candlelit restaurants. But beneath the polished exterior lies a masterpiece of concealed utility.

This is not mere clothing; it’s advanced gear disguised as couture. The fabric is lined with a flexible, lightweight composite resistant to bullets up to medium-caliber rounds, slashing blades, and even minor explosions. It maintains perfect thermal regulation, keeping you cool under pressure—whether from the desert heat or the ballroom spotlight. It can also do the opposite and keep you warm even in the Arctic. The suit never stains, wrinkles, or tears under normal wear, and its subtle nanoweave adapts to your movement, preserving elegance without sacrificing agility.

The accessories are more than just stylish embellishments. A tie might conceal a garrote wire or stiffen into a temporary splint. Cufflinks double as encrypted data drives or short-range EMP pulses. A high heel can contain a hidden lockpick set or deliver a shock powerful enough to stun an assailant. A pocket square could be a fold-out recon drone no larger than a matchbox. A hat could be used to obscures facial recognition. Even a perfume spritz might act as a mild hallucinogenic or a short-term visual cloaking mist.
objects.title: Fine Dining

addons.text:
Science, Magic, and the space between the two. With these three resonant objects, you can piece them together into a greater form.

With these three transformative objects linked together, you can start manufacturing transformations as you see fit—adjusting and combining them into new multifaceted places.

Furthermore, any additional effects that would have applied to one, can now apply to each of them—be that the enhancement and adaptation of the Dominae, or the intimate metaphysical connection of the H-Dial. This means if you were to use the H-Dial’s ‘We The People Upgrade for instance, it would be able to access any of these three objects at your discretion.
addons.title: Tripartite Reality

addons.text:
The Manus Superior has been fused with the Forma Dominae, allowing you to channel it through your new arm.

While this naturally includes its nature as a magical focus, this also allows you to; access it’s evolutionary abilities, exclusively transform the arm, channel the Dominae’s internal intelligence through it, and more.

The Dominae’s can no longer be lost or removed as it is fused completely with the Manus Superior.
addons.title: Forma Superior

objects.text:
You possess the Forma Dominae, A rune held in a bracer that runs from the back of the hand to the elbow. 

The bracer itself is nigh-indestructible, and can be used as a magical focus due to the Rune’s nature. The Rune however, is where its true power lies. The rune is an adaptive parasitic organism, slowly but surely growing more intelligent and adaptive as it grows. These adaptations usually take the form of alternate ‘modes’ of function varying from improved stability as a focus to additional forms, fusions and stranger things besides. 

The main facet of the bracer is to channel the Forma Dominae into a single main aspect, a limited form of shapeshifting. By making certain motions over the rune it allows the user to change their form into a great number of predetermined bodies. While at first these forms usually begin general (quadrapedal carnivore, bipedal flier etc), the Dominae quickly begins to vary and adapt them into new niches and specialties with powers and abilities to match. Eventually, these forms range from the humanoid to the monstrous to the utterly alien. While the transformations are rendered predictable given the hand symbols you form over it before activation, the sheer number of possible transformations renders it unpredictable if these remain unlearned, or rather extrapolated. Naturally, the Forma Dominae reshapes itself to fit any new form you enter.

As the intelligence of the Dominae grows, it will attempt to aid you, and perhaps converse if it develops that far, but its opinions on how best to allow you to survive may not align with your own. 

As you use and learn the intricacies of the rune you can create, modify, and fuse transformations or even new functions yourself. Additionally, at any point, you can ‘lock’ one of the forms and the Forma Dominae will not make any major edits to it besides refining its efficiency.

 The more exposure to magical phenomena and energies the Forma Dominae receives, the faster and more dramatic it will be able to make these developments, making use of these energies.

As an example, we’ll track a form through a typical user’s development—when beginning with the Forma Dominae, one may construct an ‘armored’ body, capable of protecting the body from blades and bullets; as this develops, these could transfigure into interlocked plates like a pangolin, and further from that, the user may be able to fire them from their back or change their material to crystal or metal to change their properties. Furthermore, by introducing say—a demonic variety of energy or phenomena to the Dominae—the form could gain any number of traits associated with or caused by said energy. All of these stages would then be stored in the Forma Dominae ready to be used, sampled and remixed into more forms and functions.
objects.title: Forma Dominae

objects.text: A pair of gloves once owned by the legendary rogue known as the Nightwalker—a figure spoken of in hushed taverns and whispered myths, a shadow who moved unseen and left no trace. Tales claimed she could lift purses unnoticed, snatch trinkets from across a room, and even steal memories from those unfortunate to cross her path. As it so happens, those stories were true—and these gloves are the very artifacts from which they sprang. The Phantom's Grasp, the right glove, grants you an uncanny power: the ability to summon a spectral hand from any point on your body, an invisible extension of your will. One which can reach up to five meters from where it manifests, moving with the full dexterity of your own hand; capable of grasping, stealing, manipulating objects, even pulling you up ledges. Its strength mirrors your own right arm, and though it never tires, any harm done to it is felt as if it were your actual hand. Should it be destroyed, it'll require a full day's time to reform. The Whispering Touch, the left glove, offers a far subtler and insidious power. It lets you sense the emotions of those nearby: in a crowd, only the strongest feeling rises above the din of collective noise, but alone with someone, every surface emotion is laid bare, pressing gently into your mind as if you were feeling them yourself. Its true potency lies in its touch—a brush of the fingers can steal up to a minute of a person's most recent memories, adjustable to your precise intent.
objects.title: Gloves of The Nightwalker

objects.text:
This leather bag has multiple magically expanded pouches of varying sizes.

The main compartment has a volume of 500 liters and can store any item as long as they fit through the opening, which can be expanded to a circle 75cm wide. The four side pouches, two on each side, have a volume of 100 liters and the opening can stretch to 50cm wide. And the six smaller pouches have a volume of 20 liters and their opening can stretch to 25cm wide.

Magically expanded items (and other spatial distortions) can be safely stored in this bag but their contents cannot be access until they are pulled out.
objects.title: Handy Haversack

objects.text:
This leather bag has multiple magically expanded pouches of varying sizes.

The main compartment has a volume of 5000 liters and can store any item as long as they fit through the opening, which can be expanded to a circle 300cm wide. The four side pouches, two on each side, have a volume of 500 liters and the opening can stretch to 150cm wide. And the six smaller pouches have a volume of 250 liters and their opening can stretch to 100cm wide.

Magically expanded items (and other spatial distortions) can be safely stored in this bag but their contents cannot be access until they are pulled out.
objects.title: Handy Haversack (Greater)

objects.text: High in the sky, the Bull of Heaven stood over the world in ancient times, before being slain by the hero-king Gilgamesh long ago. Fashioned from the beast’s bones and hide, the last physical remnant of the creature now resides within your hands: the Helm of Taurus. The Helm grants the wearer a portion of the Bull’s enormous strength. The user will find themselves able to rend steel, shatter rock with their blows, or lift buses and trains with ease. The greatest power of the Helm relies on its connection to the star sign Taurus, allowing it to call down one of the Taurid meteors to strike a target once every 12 days. While the constellation only shines for a few months of the year—and only on Earth—with the Helm, you can cause the constellation to shine throughout the year, regardless of the world, dimension, realm, or location. Finally, while its default appearance is that of a horned Corinthian helmet, the Helm of Taurus is capable of taking the form of any other helmet or headgear, and can transform itself into a small pin of the constellation of Taurus for easy transport and storage.
objects.title: Helm of Taurus

addons.text:
You can weave the Golden Fleece into the inner lining of the Hide of the Nemean Lion, allowing the Fleece's regenerative power to act directly on the impact trauma that the Hide lets through; this means you no longer need to worry about broken ribs, internal bleeding, or other injuries beneath the layer, as the Fleece heals them while the Hide itself stops the cutting force.

In addition to this, the power of the Golden Fleece's Mist now also extends to the Hide of the Nemean Lion, whether the two artifacts are interwoven or not, allowing you to transform both into modern clothing, such as a leather jacket and a scarf, without losing any of their properties while remaining completely undetectable to both mortal eyes and magical means.

Finally, the set now includes the Claws of the Nemean Lion, the only weapons capable of piercing the lion's own hide, as they can bypass any form of physical or magical armor or protection, and they come in whatever form you prefer, whether a pair of hilted daggers, retractable claw blades, knuckle dusters, or any other design of your choice; it goes without saying that these, like the rest of the set, can be transformed through the Mist.
addons.title: The Mantle of the Golden Lion

objects.text:
You are the new owner of the Hide of the Nemean Lion, the legendary relic taken from the monstrous beast slain by Heracles during his first Labour. The Nemean Lion was a terror of the land, immune to all mortal weapons with a hide so tough that nothing could pierce it. Heracles triumphed not with steel, but with strength, choking the beast to death and skinning it with its own claws. He draped the indestructible pelt over his shoulders like a cloak, the lion’s head resting atop his own—a symbol of victory, divine favor, and the strength to overcome the impossible.

Worn like a great cape, the hide grants you complete protection from any attack that strikes its surface. Blades shatter, arrows deflect, and even enchanted fire or frost leaves no mark. You can stand in the path of onslaughts that would destroy lesser beings, shielded by a relic that once turned aside every blow aimed at its original bearer. As long as the hide covers you, you are a fortress made flesh, wrapped in the primal might of the lion that even the gods feared to face.

But this defense is not without its limits. The hide is invulnerable—you are not. The force of attacks can still throw you, crush you, or batter your body beneath the skin. Attacks that bypass the cloak entirely—aimed at your face, limbs, or from within—can still wound or kill. And just as Heracles overcame the beast by choking it, so too can you be restrained, strangled, or suffocated despite the hide’s protection.
objects.title: Hide of the Nemean Lion

addons.text:
Your Trappings have merged with your Garments to make a set of stylish clothing so powerful, many of the divine will weep, wishing their top servant had clothing so divine. Your ability to absorb energy has made it so that now you can absorb the ambient faith and prayers of others and take either for yourself if you're a god or godlike being, or direct them to your own god if you have one. It does not matter who those people are praying to, as now, as long as they're in your city-sized radius or you're near the person or object they're heading towards, they will become yours to steal.

You also indirectly gain a greater boost in shrugging off debuffs and other corruptions that are inflicted upon you, as your clothes will absorb and convert them into an energy of your choosing at a varied rate depending on their strength. Such energy can even be faith or prayers.
addons.title: Faith Thief

objects.text:
Whether you're an aspiring priest, a nun, a deacon, a random priest or priestess of a fantasy world religion, or even the freaking pope, you will need the proper drip to let everyone know that you're a beacon of purity and goodness in this cold, dark world.

These Holy Garments take the form of your choosing, as long as that design looks like something a member of a holy religion or man of God would wear. It cannot become armor, but it can change into a proper set of garments you would wear under any armor you have, allowing you to benefit from its powers. These powers are a 300% increase in using any holy or divine powers that can be classified as holy or good. It also grants a 100% increase in the benefits from both any buffs and blessings you cast or have cast on you. The Garments also provide a noticeable increase in resistance against corruptive powers and debuffs, as well as making it easier for the wearer to have such things either wear off or be cured using any powers they or another may have.

The Holy Garments can repair over time from being ripped or torn, but not from being completely destroyed.
objects.title: Holy Garments

objects.text:
Once belonging to the greatest hunter of his age, a man limited by the reach of his weapons, the knowledge of his time, and the body he was born with. The Garb is all that remains. The skill remains with it.

The Hunter’s Garb consists of a high-collared leather cuirass with overlapping scale-like segments, reinforced pauldrons, fitted gauntlets, and a long leather duster split for mounted movement. Greaves and sabatons cover the lower legs, and beneath it all are padded breeches and a close-fitting gambeson. The entire set is crafted from hardened, weather-treated leather layered over flexible plating, adorned with subtle gothic accents: thorn-shaped tooling, crow-feather etchings, and burnished seams that catch no light.

Each individual piece activates a portion of the honed predatory skillset encoded into the Garb. Wearing only the gloves will grant perfect scent tracking and grip awareness, while the hat will grant immediate spatial orientation and line-of-sight prediction. These effects are specific to the piece and are not interchangeable. Combinations of pieces increase the depth and range of the instinct. For example, wearing the coat and boots together will grant you the skill for long-distance movement over unstable terrain without noise or misstep.

When the full set is worn, the Garb grants the skills required for survival and predation in any environment where something can be tracked. The skills adjust without error to alien gravity, magical distortion, abstract geometry, or incomprehensible landscapes. Even without conscious understanding, you will execute the correct techniques and tactics, as though you had trained for these conditions your entire life. Your actions reflect the precision of someone who has mastered this terrain and this prey through experience you never lived.

None of these abilities translate into knowledge. You will not be able to explain or recall why you acted in a specific way unless you already possess the understanding independently. Once the Garb is removed, all skills granted is lost immediately.

Wearing the full set also reshapes your body into that of a peak-condition human hunter: strong lungs, stable joints, high endurance, excellent balance, and efficient musculature. This scales the stronger your base form is. Additionally, you will give off an aura, causing a fear response that resembles the reaction of a prey animal when it encounters its predator. The stronger your body, the greater the effect. However, if any single piece is removed, it returns your state to what it was before and remove the aura.
objects.title: Hunter's Garb

objects.text:
Originally assembled from salvaged military wrecks and defunct industrial equipment, the Vulture is a one-of-a-kind powered flight suit used by a crime syndicate leader within the Saturn-Titan Exclusion Zone. Made using Valkyrie ship remains and Bigfoot exosuits, it is perhaps one of the most advanced criminally-made gear.

The wingspan extends to 9.5 meters (4.75 meters per side) and is split into three articulated segments per wing. The middle segment, measuring 2.5 meters, contains a single gyroscopic gravitic burst drive housed in a toroidal frame. These drives generate up to 3.8 kN of upward thrust each when oriented perpendicular to the ground, enough to lift and accelerate the 310 kg total suit mass vertically at 12.2 m/s². The disks tilt dynamically along two axes, granting omnidirectional thrust vectoring and mid-air maneuvering at speeds up to 240 km/h in atmosphere. 

The root segment, measuring at 1.5 meters, connects to the suit’s back via a dual rotary mechanical-magnetic coupling system. Each coupling is isolated from shock via hydraulic dampeners and overbuilt with triple-redundant anchor bolts to handle dynamic torque loads up to 11,000 N·m during microburst maneuvers. The tip segments are used for directional control and include micro-flaps and vectored thruster ports adapted from industrial drone stabilizers. 

Each wing segment is armored with titanium-laced salvage plating capable of withstanding a direct hit from a standard anti-materiel round before structural compromise begins. Heat from sustained burst drive use is vented through salvaged hull fins mounted along the trailing edges of the wings, and thermal overload is mitigated with active cycling every 22 seconds of continuous use. The wings can fold vertically along the back, with the gravitic disks rotating flat into the primary wing structure. When folded the wings can be detached to lower weight.

The suit’s core frame is reinforced with scrap exosuit actuators and shock-dampened servos. The overclocked fusion micro-core offers continuous output for 96 hours of active use and peaks at 1.2 MW during burst flight. The legs are overbuilt to compensate for the wings’ weight, measuring 30% thicker than standard infantry exosuits, with each limb containing triple-hydraulic pistons and retractable stabilizer spikes that deploy in 0.5 seconds. The suit grants a sprint speed of 48 km/h and allows for vertical leaps up to 4.2 meters. Its ceramic-composite torso plating is rated to withstand direct hits from 7.62×51mm NATO rounds and distribute up to 32 kJ of kinetic energy without breaching. Integrated actuators enhance the wearer’s strength to support the full load of the suit and its flight apparatus.

The suit’s helmet is a stylized metal plague mask mixed with a pilot helmet, made of reinforced titanium alloy, its elongated beak-like design serving as a high-efficiency rebreather unit capable of supplying breathable oxygen at high altitudes or in thin atmospheric conditions. Integrated filtration and thermal regulation systems maintain stable internal pressure and temperature, allowing the wearer to operate in low-oxygen environments without compromise. Lastly it has a hybrid neural-link control system that routes suit commands directly through the pilot’s cognitive signals, offering real-time motion mapping, tactile feedback, and autonomous system modulation.
objects.title: Illegally Modified Exosuit “Vulture”

objects.text: The Golden Headband of legend is a radiant band, ranging from golden to white, encircling the wearer's forehead like a crown. Once worn by the Monkey King, Sun Wukong, it was used by Tripitaka to bind and subdue his unruly nature. Yet, its true purpose lies beyond mere control—serving to pacify chaotic, malevolent, and negative energies and traits while fostering one's harmony with nature and aiding its wearer in achieving self-mastery and enlightenment. As its new bearer, the headband grants you greater control over your powers and helps you find your place in the world. Alongside this, it has the unique ability to bind or seal away destructive energies and detrimental abilities, gradually pacifying them until you can wield them with precision. Furthermore, it instills a profound sense of balance, easing mental burdens, sharpening focus, and guiding you toward enlightenment. You won't have to worry about losing this artifact either, as it is bound to you and can even regenerate and repair itself if damaged.
objects.title: Jin Gu Zhou

addons.text:
The cursed oni within the mask, forged from the wrathful essence of a fallen rōnin, has not merely brushed against the yokai bound within the blade—it has consumed it. As the blade’s blood-drunk spirit whispered its violent hunger, the oni, shaped by slaughter and sin, embraced it fully. No longer are these two spirits separate. The hollowed soul of the rōnin, already devoured by rage and rendered monstrous, has now subsumed the blade’s yokai, fusing them into something far more terrible—a Kishin, a war god born of hatred, obsession, and boundless violence.

When both mask and sword are wielded in unison, the rōnin’s spectral legacy coalesces into a ghostly set of samurai armor forged from the lingering spirits of those he slew, and those claimed by the sword. To ordinary eyes, the armor is invisible. Only those able to see sprits can see it. The armour exudes a pressure of bloodlust that can be felt even those unable to see it. The armor’s strength reflects the bond between mask and blade—its potency grows with each act of violence. The more blood drank by the blade, and the deeper the wearer surrenders to the mask’s oni form, the more defined and formidable the armor becomes. In its nascent state, it offers mere protection, dampening blows with ghostly resistance. But as it feeds on blood and rage, the armor evolves and takes on additional abilities such as reflecting damage.

Though powerful, this armor carries the same risk as the artifacts that birthed it. As the armor thickens, so too does the voice of the Kishin. In its whispers is neither the blade nor the oni, but a new being—cruel, commanding, godlike in its wrath. Merely being in the same proximity as the two can cause its words to resound in one’s head. Separating the blade and mask is the only way to weaken the voice back to what it once was, and even then should they be rejoined the Kishin shall awaken once more.
addons.title: Kishin no Yoroi

objects.text:
Forged in blood and bound by onryou, this mask once belonged to a rounin who slew countless without remorse. The hatred of those he slew seeped into the lacquered wood and bone of the mask, staining it with generations of pain and rage. Upon his death, the rounin’s soul was devoured by that fury, and the mask awakened as a tsukumogami—one that now holds the sealed essence of a violent oni born from his monstrous nature.

When worn, Kourounin no Kimen passively enhances the wearer’s physical capabilities—strength, speed, reflexes, and awareness—pushing them to the peak of human potential. These enhancements scale with the wearer’s natural strength and skill; the stronger the foundation, the greater the power.

The wearer may choose to borrow the oni’s power sealed within the tsukumogami. This triggers a transformation: the mask begins to animate subtly, and the wearer’s body shifts—thickened muscle, change in skin colouration, sharpened features, and eventually claws and horns. The mast itself seems to fuse with the wearer’s face, becoming real. This state grants power that exceeds human limits—strength to shatter steel blades, speed to vanish mid-strike, and perception that borders on precognition.

But this power is not free. The deeper the wearer draws, the more their mind unravels—thoughts blur, instincts surge, and violent impulses rise. The oni’s rage leaks through along with the rounin’s own death-dealing madness. At high levels of corruption, the user may lose all control, becoming a vessel for destruction that even allies cannot reason with. 

While the mask is worn, it tempts constantly. Even if the wearer doesn’t tap into the oni’s power, the mask speaks—softly, persistently—offering strength in moments of weakness, fury in times of fear. The longer it remains on your face, the louder and more persuasive the voice becomes.

Note: The mask’s effects only activate when fully worn on the face. Holding it, hanging it from your belt, or placing it to the side provides no benefit and no influence.
objects.title: Kourounin no Kimen

addons.text:
Your trappings resonate with the other tools of a growing mage, placing you on the path to becoming an Archmage. All three of your items can now be enchanted by your Nexus Arcanum, and any enchantment applied to one will affect them all, greatly multiplying the power each individual enchantment would have while simultaneously boosting their abilities.

Your Arcane Hat’s maximum mana pool will always match yours in size, and its interaction with the Akashic Records has doubled the number of low-tier spells you can learn each day, as well as the number of spells it can refine and improve at once. Additionally, the energy absorption capabilities of your clothing can be used to fuel your hat’s reserves.

The Akashic Records spell storage ability has expanded to encompass all your other items. For instance, you could set a barrier within your clothing to activate when attacked, or program your hat to initiate a mind defense and counterattack spell combo if someone attempts to invade your mind.

Your Akashic Records, Mage’s Trappings, and Arcane Hat can recover from any damage, even complete destruction, as they will use the Nexus Arcanum as an anchor to reform.

With this level of power, your path to becoming one of the greatest mages in existence is assured. The only thing that could stand in your way is time.
addons.title: The Archmage

addons.text:
Your Trappings seem to have had some of the enchantments and enhancements from the operational support ring rub off on them. Separate from the enhancements from the ring, your clothing gives you a moderate increase in constitution and a 50% increase in spell power, which, combined with the ring, results in a large increase in constitution and a total 150% increase in spell power.

The real bonus is that, through your clothes' ability to absorb energy, they evolved your ring to not only recover supernatural energy at 600% but also recover mundane energy such as stamina at a 1200% increased recovery rate, for as long as you have both in your possession. The 80% reduction in supernatural energy usage, for as long as you have both, also applies to stamina.
addons.title: Operational Support Clothes

objects.text:
You have acquired a set of clothing ideal for any aspiring wizard or mage. This magical attire is crafted from enchanted fabric and metal, highly receptive to being magically enhanced, and capable of self-repair as long as a single thread remains. The repair time can vary from just a few seconds to a maximum of one hour. Dirt and grime vanish automatically, ensuring you're always spotless and looking your best. The appearance of this outfit set changes with a thought depending on what you want at the time, as what kind of mage would be caught wearing the same thing twice?

The true function of the clothing lies in its ability to absorb all forms of energy and convert it into whatever energy you require to replenish your reserves. This can include simple sources like solar energy, more esoteric forms like magical energy, or even kinetic energy. While the clothing can absorb energy from attacks directed at you, it won't prevent the physical force or damage from affecting you or the attire. The energy conversion rate is 1:1.
objects.title: Mage's Trappings

addons.text:
Nyx is not entirely satisfied with her creation. Therefore, she decided to infuse into the cloak her own fragment of divine essence, assimilating the very essence of the Cloak of the Wayfarer.

If before the cloak was limited to camouflage and performing enchantments like a ghost slipping from the grasp of others, now the cloak is able to protect its wearer when they choose to stand at the front rather than rely solely on cunning tactics.

It not only acquires defensive capabilities but is also able to grow in accordance with the strength of the wearer’s soul. It is no longer limited by a set threshold of damage it can endure and regenerate, granting it the potential to grow and become a divine mantle capable of protecting against all harm. Even so, divine forces or powers of similar level remain a danger capable of piercing its incredible defenses.

With the divine essence of Nyx, the cloak has gained another extraordinary quality: Rebirth of the Night. The ability to induce temporary amnesia in those who fall under your enchantment, using the same mechanism employed by the Veil of Silence.

The effect lasts only 2 hours, and the amnesia can cover anything from brief moments to the last 12 hours of memory, after which the victim returns to normal. However, they will feel that something is wrong with their memory and with the events that transpired beyond their awareness. No one is exempt when affected by such an enchantment not even the gods.

A perfect ability to compensate for any deficiency the cloak may have in its concealment capabilities. Although temporary and reversible, it provides more than enough time to carry out any act and escape unpunished. Only the shadows and the night sky bear witness to what you have done.
addons.title: Nocturnal Mantle

objects.text:
You have acquired a special mantle created by the divine hands of Nyx, the primordial goddess of the night in Greek mythology. It is made from small fragments of the divine essences of her children: Hypnos, Eros, and Oneiroi.

It is a mantle so black and opaque that not even light itself is able to project its presence or cast any shadow. It appears as a simple hooded cloak that completely covers the wearer’s body, and even if the wearer has a form beyond the humanoid, it will adapt to conceal any trace unless the wearer wishes otherwise.

Veil of Silence: With the power of Hypnos, you are capable of inducing eternal sleep in anyone who falls under your enchantment through your gaze or by hearing your words. It only works on targets with an equal or lower soul strength than that of the wearer. Nothing can reverse this enchantment unless the wearer desires it. However, a power equal to or greater than the divine essence of Hypnos can reverse the eternal sleep.

The Shared Heartbeat: With the power of Eros, the wearer can perceive the thoughts, emotions, and dreams of those around them. At a basic level of control, it acts as a passive ability, but without any precision. Over time and with training, it can become as refined as telepathy, empathy, and oneiropathy. Its effectiveness depends on the wearer’s soul strength relative to the target; otherwise, attempting to glimpse the secrets of beings beyond their own power would simply leave them temporarily blind or have no effect at all.

Path of Images: With the power of Oneiroi, the wearer can become an elusive phantom. That is, they can become invisible and hidden not only in the physical world and among the living, but also camouflage themselves within the realm of dreams and the spiritual dimension. Only a sensory perception on the level of a god or similar being can detect their presence.
objects.title: Mantle of the Beloved Shadows

objects.text: This plain black-and-white mask upon your face is the Mask of Gemini said to have been created by the Dioscuri in antiquity. The Mask allows the wearer with a thought, separate themselves into two bodies becoming akin to a pair of twins, one wearing a white mask, and one wearing a black—and rejoin into one being at will. You retain perfect control over each body, and all items, and abilities are shared between your two bodies. The Mask’s ties to the Constellation of Gemini grant its greatest power. While Gemini typically only shows for part of the year—and only on Earth—while wearing this mask, you can cause the constellation to appear in the sky, regardless of the world, dimension, realm, or location. With the star sign overhead, you can generate and control St. Elmo’s fire, and use it to designate targets for lightning strikes. This effect can only be activated once every 12 days. Finally, while the default form of the Mask of Gemini is that of a black-and-white mask, the Mask is capable of taking the form of any other mask, and transforming itself into a small pin of Gemini for easy transport and storage.
objects.title: Mask of Gemini

addons.text:
Your Adventurer's Armor has been integrated into your Mage's Trappings, giving you the best of both worlds. Now your trappings are stronger than any mundane metal by miles while still being able to shapeshift into any clothing set you wish. It could be cloth with no headwear, yet you will still have full protection over your whole body.

Instead of increasing your physical abilities by fifty percent, they have been enhanced by the continuous energy gathering of your trappings to increase your physical abilities by seventy percent while also providing major resistance to magic and other supernatural powers.

When further enhanced with more magic or any powers you possess, this new fusion can reach maximum potential, increasing your physical abilities by fivefold and granting a ninety percent resistance to harmful effects targeting you.
addons.title: JRPG Heroes' Armor

objects.text: You gain a full set of master-crafted magic armor consisting of a long sleeve shirt, pants, and helmet that is made of finely woven Mithral and Adamantine. That without careful inspection will appear as normal clothing and is incredibly comfortable and can be conformably worn under other clothing or armor. Being nearly weightless and able to control your bodies temperature with the cooling properties of Mithral. The armor is stronger than any mundane metal by miles but is not invincible and can be destroyed. This armor is also enchanted to increase your physical abilities by fifty percent and provides minor resistance towards magic and other supernatural powers. You can also empower the armor with magic or whatever powers you have in order to increase the armors durability and enchantments. At full power this suit will increase your physical abilities by three times and grant fifty percent resistance towards harmful effects targeting you.
objects.title: Master-craft Adventurer’s Armor

objects.text:
You have gained the magical belt of Thor, which is enchanted to double the strength and durability of anyone who wears it. Due to its prolonged contact with Thor, the belt also gives the wearer increased resistance and affinity to lightning.

Note: This belt will adjust to be the perfect size and weight for the wearer
objects.title: Megingjörð

objects.text:
This black 3 piece suit has been enchanted so as to provide a field of complete and total invulnerability to anyone who wears it. Anything from extreme temperatures to the full force of a planet shattering punch will be rendered impotent upon contact with its fabric. This protection even extends to areas not covered by the suit, such as the head and hands.

However, much like the hero of myth which this suit is named after, there is a critical flaw; attacks aimed at the soles of the wearer's feet will completely bypass the suit's protection. But who would ever think to attack you there?
objects.title: Orlando Threads

objects.text:
When worn, this large black mask will completely cover the wearer's face and supernaturally obscure the user's identity. Any and all attempts to discern who the user is, even via supernatural means, will invariably fail.

Moreover, the mask will cause the wearer to become an afterthought in the perception of others. They will blend into the background as something utterly mundane and unimportant, unworthy of paying any mind from anyone. This effect will not work in combat. While the user's identity will still be perfectly hidden, opponents can view the user as a threat and act accordingly.
objects.title: Perception Nullifying Mask

addons.text: Your acquisition of this armor was not mere luck but a gift, this armor was forged by the beast inside your soul to amplify you, in all aspects. Your armor now augments everything about you, from your strength and stamina to even your skill. A normal human would now find themselves capable of clashing fists with the likes of Alexandria and capable of out running even Legend, and if you were more than a normal human few parahumans, if any, could match you. Your armor’s durability is the most affected, enhancing the factor that it protects you by 10. Your armor’s life support can now support you forever if need be and your Inner Beast can act as an A.I. equivalent to manage any functions of the suit.
addons.title: Inner Armor

addons.text: You now know how to forge such armors with all its benefits for either yourself or others.
addons.title: Armorer

addons.text:
Your Armor has taken on the characteristics of the Fighting God Armor. 

Whoever wears the Golden Armor will feel neither pain nor fatigue and will have their power increased across the board substantially, such that they can fight higher members of the Seven Great Powers on equal or superior ground and shatter fortresses with physical strength alone. 

Regardless of the wearer's knowledge when it comes to battle, the armor itself is a battle master. It knows how to use, counter and adapt to countless weapons it has trained with and can imitate many martial arts. The armor can analyze the flow of battle and has an existing repertoire of over 1000 secret techniques, which will increase with your own battle experience.

Unlike the traditional Fighting God armor, yours is not powered by your life force, nor does its will attempt to suppress your own and drive you into a battle frenzy.
addons.title: Fighting God Armor

objects.text: It seems a legendary piece of equipment has managed to attach itself to you. Now stored inside your soul, you possess an incredibly powerful armor that you may instantly summon and adorn at will. But this is no mere power armor or even a magical artifact, what you have here is the Perfect Armor, an adaptive set designed specifically for you and your powers. You may freely choose the armor’s appearance, and may alter it any time by simply unsummoning it and resummoning it. This same function can also be used to repair and/or clean the armor in the event it takes any damage. It can look like anything from a full steel regalia to simple normal attire, however it does not limit your movement at all and it’s protection covers your entire body regardless of what is covered. You can choose to summon and unsummon portions of the armor at any time, and as long as at least a portion is summoned its full protection is imparted on to you. Your armor can incorporate any technology or magic it comes into contact with, or that you yourself could conceivably build or wield into it. For tech, magic, or magitech that you know how to build the armor can manifest it on its own, and you can freely channel any of your powers through your armor. Alongside its adaptability, your armor will grow as you do, imparting on you the same factor of protection that a normal human enjoys inside a heavily fortified nuclear bunker. This protection extends beyond just the physical and treats all damage as physical, allowing protection even from things such as mental or magic attacks. Aside from these benefits the armor offers small benefits without the requirement of any additional powers, such as an increase in physical ability to compete with mid-level brutes, flight and levitation, and a life support system designed to withstand the hurdles of most extreme environments such as the void of space or at the deepest point in the sea and keep you alive for a year. You may incorporate any other armors into this to give it their properties as well.
objects.title: Perfect Armor

objects.text:
This set of mundane clothes can morph to fit any occasion, from a pair of comfy pajamas to a tuxedo or evening dress, and everything in-between; and you can also create some accessories, like a purse or jewelry, to complement your outfit. Some parts can be separate from you, so you can remove your shoes when visiting someone, or leave your handbag on a table, but they will degrade if they are further than 100m away from you, and eventually disappear; how long this takes depends on time and distance.

The clothes don't have any special properties by themselves, but they can self-clean on command — it might take some time for harder to remove stains — and will also repair over time, even if completely destroyed.
objects.title: Perfect Wardrobe

objects.text:
This is a complete Victorian ensemble: long coat, waistcoat, gloves, top hat, and a single antique monocle. The set once belonged to the Phantom of Whitechapel, a spectral figure reportedly seen drifting near the scenes of Jack the Ripper’s murders. The suit appears pristine despite its age, though the fabric carries a faint chill and the scent of distant fog.

When worn, the suit summons a fog that clings tightly to the wearer’s form. The mist flows in slow, continuous motion, unaffected by wind or weather. Though the wearer feels no change, the air within the fog is unnaturally cold. Nearby, the temperature drops noticeably. Breath becomes visible, glass may frost over, and exposed skin begins to numb after prolonged exposure. A subtle, unnatural wind stirs within the fog, moving hair, paper, and flame in slow, spiraling patterns that disregard the surrounding environment. While the mist does not fully obscure vision, it blurs outlines and softens movement within 10 meters, making the wearer harder to focus on in dim light. This fog follows the wearer at all times and cannot be dispelled or contained.

Through the monocle, the wearer can see spirits with perfect clarity. Even those that are hidden, phased, or residual appear fully visible. Lesser spirits and passive undead, such as ghosts, shadows, and bound souls without strong attachments, will generally respond positively to the wearer. As long as the wearer is polite, restrained, and avoids issuing harmful or aggressive commands, these entities will typically comply. Spirits may reveal hidden paths, guard locations, deliver messages, or fade away quietly if asked. Hostile spirits or those with unresolved trauma will not obey and may respond negatively if the wearer overreaches.

Anyone who meets the wearer’s gaze beneath the shadow of the top hat experiences a subtle but profound discomfort, often felt as guilt, sorrow, or regret. The wearer’s eyes appear to glow faintly within the gloom. Their voice takes on a somber, layered tone, as if carried by distant overlapping whispers. Each word carries emotional weight, making even simple conversation feel mournful or haunting. These effects are entirely passive and cannot be turned off while the suit is worn.
objects.title: Phantom of Whitechapel

objects.text:
You’ve been gifted a magical potion harness capable of holding up to 16 vials. While stored in the harness, the vials become significantly tougher, are magically attached to the harness, their contents no longer degrade over time, and they are shrunken to a third of their size. 

Not only that, but the harness lets you instantly consume anything within it, set conditions for automatic activation, or teleport a vial directly into your hand with a thought.

As a bonus, the harness comes with 16 empty vials to get you started.

Note: You can choose the design of this harness
objects.title: Potion Harness

objects.text:
A costume set of your choice, recreated exactly as you envision it. You may select any clothing style or outfit design, and it will manifest as a complete, top-quality ensemble.

Crafted from the finest materials, the costume will flawlessly reflect your design. However, it is entirely cosmetic—whether armor, robes, or advanced gear, the design is visual only. Functionally, it offers no more protection than a well-made set of mundane clothes.

The costume comes with a unique benefit: a personal pocket-space. With a single thought, you can summon or dismiss it instantly, skipping the inconvenience of changing clothes. Bound solely to you, it can repair itself from anything while stored and remains impossible to steal, even when worn.

Your outfit will repair itself even if you add new upgrades, such as enchantments or advanced technology. However, the more powerful or complex the repair required, the longer it will take.
objects.title: Premium Costume

addons.text: It seems your gown has been given an upgrade by the future. Now, if you are to make an animal noise of any kind, your body will be encased in an inflatable plush armor resembling the Plush Pals, with the princess outfit fitting still perfectly, though more of an anthropomorphic shape in your instance rather than an upright animal. Another benefit of this is that it gives you access to magic based on the animal. A cat could give you spells that let you see in the dark as perfectly as if it were daylight, "Nine Lives" which is more like 9 perfect healings from near death or immediately upon death, a vastly enhanced sense of smell and hearing, and more. A bird would give you flight, wind magic capable of ripping trees out of the ground by flapping your wings, etc. You are also given the ability, when this form is active, speak to any animal or creature without even the slightest issue. You will also have a natural charisma with them, depending on the form you are in. To deactivate this form, simply clap hard 3 times with a smile. Even if you lack a limb normally, the suit thankfully still has its own limbs that work even without said limb. And if you are an armless creature, simply do the closest equivalent to clapping you can.
addons.title: Magical Girl! Form of Cute!

objects.text: It seems you have been blessed with every little girl's dream, becoming a "Princess" thanks to a special gown, capable of being visually modified. This gown is suspected to be actually part of a rather... horrifying origin, able to chill even the most evil man's bones. But, no one knows the full scope of what it could be.
