Regardless, this dress has quite a few abilities that make it desirable. For one, it shapes itself perfectly to the users body making it so while it's snug, it's never tight. You are also guaranteed to never look silly in it no matter what you look like, even if you were an ogre or a goblin. A more practical benefit is the odd, unexplainable origin of a pocket space in the outfit around your body. In the sleeves and the gown, any object you put towards it will be sucked inside and can be ejected with a thought. It can simply fall out, or be ejected with up to the same amount of force you can throw with. There is a source of Magic attached to this outfit that allows for rather interesting synergy. In worlds with even hinted magical energy, it will absorb the mana while also amplifying what it absorbs three-fold and store it in your body through contact with the dress. On its own, it can do what could be considered "Princess-ly" magic; Pacification of aggressors, nature manipulation, an aura of cleanliness that cleans any and everything around you in a 10 meter radius, and more. All you have to do is figure out the gestures to activate them, where one spell could require a finger snap while another could require a specific pose. You are also able to move in a supernaturally elegant fashion, making your combat for example, smoother than silk in every way, even if logic dictates your legs shouldn't be able to move like they can in the dress. Finally, this outfit is able to compress into a doll-like size and shape and, if placed on any small sentient creature or inanimate object, It will give them all the powers of this outfit as if they were you.
objects.title: Princess Gown

objects.text:
You have been given a helmet containing a network of psychoforms. These psionic ghosts were cloned, indoctrinated and captured into the device, both feeding on them as power source and acting as a nexus for them, letting you siphon from them to replicate their own abilities. 

While wearing the helmet you can communicate with the psychoforms inside. While usually your abilities while wearing the helmet are rather middling and limited to one focus at a time; holding car-sized objects, telepathy the range of a small country, pyrokinesis enough to extinguish a housefire, etc. with their aid these limits can be dramatically increased, although this will require actively dealing with them or cowing them to aid you.

If you are entering a universe with psychics, rather than the default random thoughtforms you may choose for the psychoforms to be copies of the psychics that would be typical in your new universe. For instance, entering Nexus would result in these psychics likely being almost entirely made up of former psychic head slaves while a world like Marvel would result in an improbable number of mutants and a far greater variety.
objects.title: Psychoform Solitude Unit PROTOTYPE [NOT FOR MARKET RELEASE]

objects.text:
This magical necklace, when worn, will slowly cleanse curses, poisons, diseases, corruptive influences, and any other harmful effects or ailments afflicting your person, whether supernatural or mundane.

The cleansing is gradual and continuous, weakening such effects over time rather than dispelling them instantly. Minor effects may fade quickly, while ancient curses, divine punishments, or actively maintained effects may require extensive time to fully remove, or may resist the necklace entirely.

This necklace does not restore physical health or regenerate damaged tissue. For example, it may purge a supernatural plague or deadly poison, but it will not heal damage they had already inflicted.
objects.title: Purification Necklace

objects.text:
The Qi Tian Da Sheng is a two-meter-tall exosuit that powers itself exclusively by draining your naturally expelled waste lifeforce and chi, a passive process that occurs constantly while you wear it. All of the suit's core functions scale directly in proportion to the raw vitality of your body and the volume of chi you can supply; a stronger physical vessel with greater vitality provides the suit with more fuel, which it converts into a more powerful enhancement across every system.

Your strength is amplified to superhuman levels, with the degree of force scaling to your body's vitality. If you possess the baseline vitality of an average human, this grants you enough strength to punch straight through a standard 13-inch brick-and-mortar wall without injury, reducing it to powder and rubble with a single blow.

The suit grants you masterful martial arts skill by interfacing directly with your motor cortex, with the depth and intuition of this skill also scaling to your physical vitality. At the average human level, you gain the seamless, unified skill of a grandmaster who has trained in every known form of hand-to-hand combat for a lifetime, executing strikes, grapples, and counters with unconscious precision.

If you possess any other form of supernatural energy, such as psychic force or spiritual power, the suit acts as an amplifier for that energy, with the amplification factor again scaling to your body's strength. For an average human with a minor psychic ability, this could amplify a weak telekinetic push into a concussive wave of force strong enough to knock over a car. 

The suit is addictive; the euphoria of limitless power cultivates a destructive thirst, compelling you to destroy. Its safeties cap the drain at your waste energy, but you can voluntarily deactivate them, allowing the suit to drain your active lifeforce reserves. This unsafe overcharge exponentially boosts all functions without requiring you to physically strengthen your own body first, but it consumes your vitality faster than your body can regenerate, leading to physical and spiritual desiccation. This addiction can be managed by simply taking off the suit and resting.
objects.title: Qi Tian Da Sheng

objects.text:
An old and unnamed Holy Shroud, dating back several centuries. It was created by a priest in honor of the red-clad archer who eliminated a warlord before they started a war, disappearing after. Like that spirit’s cloak, the shroud is a deep crimson in color. The cloth reshapes itself to suit the wearer’s sense of comfort, taking on the general form and sewing of their preferred outerwear, such as a cloak, coat, or shawl, without altering its texture, weight, or color. The material is thick and coarse to the touch, more akin to tightly woven linen than silk, and carries a faint scent of iron and fire. Despite its age, the fabric shows no signs of deterioration and resists physical tearing or mundane burning.

It functions as a regenerative Mystic Code based on the principle of reconstruction through spiritual imprint. It reads the complete “image” of your body as defined by your Spirit Origin, the metaphysical blueprint of your ideal state, and uses it to restore and maintain your physical form. Through this method, the shroud can generate new biological material to replace what has been lost. Wounds, severed limbs, or destroyed organs are gradually recreated from prana, converted into organic substance through a continuous materialization process. The rate of regeneration scales with the complexity of the damage and the stability of your self-image. The greater the divergence between your current state and your soul’s image, the slower and more demanding the repair. Only deliberate changes by you remain.

Because the shroud relies on the Spirit Origin’s immutable image rather than mental self-perception, it maintains your form at the point of conceptual stability, that is, the physical state your existence recognizes as its baseline. For most, this manifests as their prime physical condition. As a result, aging does not progress while the shroud is worn, since biological decay is incompatible with the Origin’s defined state. The shroud does not reverse time, but it enforces a form of ontological consistency, compelling the body to remain synchronized with its core spiritual pattern. However, alterations to one’s Origin or Soul will directly affect how the shroud “restores” you.

If the shroud determines that an injury or condition will cause your death before full reconstruction can be completed, the shroud instead establishes a state of localized stasis. This halts further degradation, prevents blood loss and infection, and isolates the damaged area from internal or external interference. The effect persists as long as the shroud remains in contact with you, effectively suspending the condition in a neutral, non-progressive state. Healing continues while in stasis, although it would be far slower.

A secondary and unintended function of the shroud is the stabilization of your mental and spiritual condition. Because it must read both the body and the soul to initiate reconstruction, this process harmonizes irregularities within your psyche. The result is a constant state of calm and emotional equilibrium, reducing agitation, fear, and mental interference. This effect is passive and does not provide direct protection against mental attacks, but it lessens their severity by restoring your spirit to its natural baseline. Prolonged use helps maintain composure and clarity under stress or exposure to corruptive influences.
objects.title: Red Holy Shroud

addons.text: A beneficial effect has manifested from having two similar objects—the necklace and the ring. While you have both on your person, you will restore both your physical health and your energy at the same time. The one that is currently more important to your current status (such as being injured but still having a lot of energy) will regenerate at 1% every 5 seconds. The second, less important one will regenerate at 0.5% every 10 seconds. Once the more important one is fully restored, it will boost the regeneration of the second one to 1.5% every 5 seconds.
addons.title: Sunny Regen

objects.text:
This magical necklace, when worn, will regenerate 1% of your physical health every 5 seconds. This assumes 100% represents all limbs and organs intact, as well as smooth, unblemished skin. If you're of full health, it will instead regenerate 1% of your maximum supernatural or mundane energy stores every 5 seconds.

This necklace does not work directly on curses, supernatural poisons, or other magical and supernatural ailments or effects on your person. For example, its healing may help you avoid immediate death from a curse that kills you over time, but it will not directly address or remove the curse itself.
objects.title: Regeneration Necklace

objects.text:
This is the bag of Rendall Othric Balthazar, a legendary alchemist often mistaken for a ROB. Technically, this is one of his countless backups—specifically, his 100,000th backup bag. But consider yourself lucky—despite his eccentricness, Rendall’s alchemical genius nearly rivals that of a true ROB. His endless need for research led him to fill his bags with notes, trinkets, and prototypes—anything that piqued his interest. 

The bag is organized into sections, progressing from simpler items at the top to increasingly powerful ones deeper down. Right at the top, you’ll find a recipe for a universal minor health potion and pouches of stamina herbs that slowly restore energy. But venture deeper, and you’ll find the contents grow increasingly erratic. 

Each level is secured by an encrypted lock, which unlocks as you decipher a recipe or refine an item from that section. The deeper you go, the more unpredictable—and perilous—the items become. Rendall wasn’t exactly diligent with his labeling, so be careful you don’t accidentally consume poison. And good luck making sense of the haphazard notes he scribbled on a whim. On the bright side, nothing in the bag will harm or kill you through mere contact.

Still, the rewards are worth it. Buried within this bag are formulas for immortality, prototype poisons powerful enough to kill dragons, herbs that would stoke even Gods’ greed, and who knows what else. While the bag isn’t truly infinite, you could easily spend decades digging through its depths and barely scratch the surface.
objects.title: Rendall's Bag Of Whimsy

objects.text:
You now own an ornate steel and silver ring once worn by an ancient immortal king, This ring possesses the power to hide you from all who seek to harm the wearer. 

The range and potency of the concealment scales with the range and potency of the wearer, for a normal human it can only hide from the senses on the scale of a normal human, but for a divine being worshiped by a galactic empire it can hide the entire solar system they are in from all magical, technological and other esoteric means of detection.
objects.title: Ring of Concealment

objects.text:
It looks unremarkable at first. An aged bronze band, dull and pitted, with faint etchings worn down by time. But slip it on, and you’ll hear the whisper.

Bound within is a powerful entity. Once a peak cultivator, ancient archmage, primeval dragon, or forgotten god, depending on who you ask. Its true name has long since faded from memory, so now it answers only to the new "Master" of the ring.

The bond is immediate. From the moment you wear the ring, the entity awakens, tethered to your soul. You gain a constant companion. Advisor, trainer, schemer, and occasional problem. How you deal with them is up to you. Some form real partnerships. Others make do with uneasy alliances.

The Master’s knowledge runs deep. Spells, martial techniques, crafting methods, history, lost arts, and more. While they cannot act directly upon the world, they can teach you techniques, help you refine your power, decipher unknown magic, and guide you through spiritual or metaphysical realms where others would be lost.

As the connection strengthens, they may lend you some of their old power when it matters. A sudden technique. A focused insight. A brief projection of their might to push through a fight. But their help has limits. You will need to earn it.

Their voice, personality, and background are yours to shape. Gruff immortal cultivator sealed after a cosmic war. Bored demon-lord turned reluctant teacher. Silent goddess watching through your eyes. They can even be a character from the setting you're walking into or even one from another. Whatever fits the story you choose to tell.

The only certainty is this. With the Ring of the Forgotten Master on your finger, you will not walk alone.
objects.title: Ring of the Forgotten Master

objects.text: Before you lies the fabled ring of the legendary rogue whose name it bears—a relic steeped in whispered tales of daring escapes and vanishing acts, the very artifact that helped her slip through shadows and remain the ever-elusive phantom of storied rumor. The ring carries a passive enchantment that allows the embrace of night and shadow to shroud you from prying eyes, subtly bending perception. It won't render you invisible, but it does make you harder to notice or focus on, whether by mundane senses or magical scrutiny. This effect amplifies with darkness, growing stronger the deeper the umbra. As an added benefit, the ring will also grant you feline-like night vision, letting you see clearly in darkness, complete with the same eerie eye shine of a cat's. However, its true marvel lies in its active ability: Shadow Walk—a shadow-bound teleportation that lets you dissolve into darkness and reappear within any nearby shade you can see. You may use this up to five times per day for swift escape or to tactically reposition; any use beyond that steadily drains your mental stamina and joy, wearing down your resolve—leaving you as cold and detached as the shadows you inhabit. For maximum effect, it is recommended to use Shadow Walk while already shrouded, as this will ensure a smoother and quieter transition, leaving behind little trace of your passage—along with easing the strain on your mind should you press beyond your daily limit.
objects.title: Ring of The Nightwalker

objects.text:
This unassuming rosary, plain to the eye, is anything but ordinary. It is a holy relic Mystic Code of the highest order—an artifact imbued with the partial authority of Christ himself. When worn, it grants its bearer the power to summon an unlimited number of Black Keys in any form or variation—each forged with exceptional spiritual purity. The only limitation is that they can only be summoned if there's space in the user's hands to receive them.

Each Black Key is itself a Sacrament, its blade a physical manifestation of scripture—litanies and Principles of faith given form. They are instruments to enact baptisms through violence, designed to purge evil spirits, wraiths, undead, and other creatures of the night. Even Heroic Spirits and entities with spiritual cores are not exempt from this. What might appear to be a hilt is actually a hardened page of scripture infused with magical energy to serve as the grip. Of the holy armaments, they were one of the earliest and have remained a staple in the arsenal of Church Executors ever since.

Despite their sacred nature, Black Keys are versatile and deceptively simple weapons. They take the shape of long, slender rapiers with short hilts, over a meter in length, weighing about a kilogram. Their balance favors the tip, making them unwieldy for standard melee combat—better suited for precise, practiced throws rather than close-quarter duels.

Through specialized techniques, often enhanced with magical energy, a skilled user can unleash sacramental effects. A thrown Key may ignite its target in holy flame, desiccate the body into a lifeless husk, or summon a cloud of crows to tear the enemy apart, etc. Others can be planted into the ground to erect Holy Barriers, either to shield the faithful or burn and melt the damned. Even without magic, techniques like the Iron Plate Effect can turn a single throw into a force strong enough to shatter concrete or level entire buildings.

Ultimately, the measure of the Black Keys lies not in the weapons themselves but in the hand that wields them. The more refined your skill, the deeper your faith, and the more creative your application, the more devastating they'll become.
objects.title: Rosary of Black Providence

objects.text: This is the ruined armour of a nameless knight of no renown, who served Morgan as their lord long before Arthur was born. After every battle fought in her name, this knight scavenged the bodies of the dead like a vulture, stripping their armour and melting it down to repair their own gear, doing so terribly and unskilfully, never cleansing the steel of ash and blood and other impurities. They died in a ditch, rotting inside this very armour until only duty remained, becoming a curse that turned this armour into what it is now. The armour is extremely heavy, each piece dense with impure steel. The moment you don it, however, that weight vanishes completely, replaced by a surge of raw strength that feels like it belongs to five fully trained men flowing into your limbs. Beyond this physical power, you also gain access to the collective martial skill of countless unrenowned and nameless knights who died on battlefields long before they could become well known, their techniques and instincts now yours to call upon. By concentrating, you can reach into the seams of the armour where bound spirits burn and pull them forth, manifesting them as a burning wraith in knight's gear that follows your mental commands. Each wraith fights with the skill of a trained knight and possesses the strength of a well trained man, but they are mindless things, capable only of understanding simple combat directives like "attack that target" or "guard this area." Each summoning costs a significant portion of your stamina and leaves you with a splitting headache that worsens with each additional wraith you call. Keeping even one manifested requires constant mental effort, building with every additional one summoned, and the moment you relax that focus or exhaust yourself entirely, the wraiths dissolve back into the armour. The strain and cost lessens when in battle. Supernatural energy can be used as a substitute.
objects.title: Ruined Knight

addons.text:
Due to your School Uniform and Trinket's interactions, you gain the ability to create patches representing different tropes and skills you have encountered and studied; these patches can be as broad as to cover a whole topic or archetype, or focused on specific areas for greater specialized boosts. Like an Otaku Patch could give you vague knowledge of recent announcements in entertainment that a lot of people know about, or a Delinquent Patch to boost your intimidation and strength.

You can make up to 3 new patches per day, including duplicates of ones you already have to give out to others, and while they can take any form you wish, they must be an accessory of some kind and do not gain greater or less durability.

Aside from skill and power boosts, these patches have nothing special about them, being as fragile as they should be normally, and while they can still give power after being stained or damaged, once they are destroyed, it will take 24 hours for them to be restored, appearing where the previous one was.
addons.title: Scout Badges

objects.text:
A special school uniform that can change its appearance and size to match any kind of school uniform. This includes accessories that would go with school uniforms, such as scarves, glasses, keychains, school bags, etc.

It has a special effect of buffing or gifting you some powers based on a high school trope you're either representing or currently experiencing. Should you be in a shounen situation while wearing this uniform, you could more easily pick up martial arts techniques or even rudimentary ki/chi usage. Acting like a typical blond-haired delinquent with a sad backstory could see a normal human becoming borderline peak human strong, and maybe even have an unconscious urge to go to a certain place, leading you to find the one girl who had a crush on you. Even acting like a yandere could see you get better at stalking and more knowledgeable in not getting caught when you kill your love rivals.

The boosts and new powers will only last for as long as the trope(s) you're taking part in last, as well as while you're wearing or near your uniform. The boosts will scale with the situation to make sure you have just enough to be relevant to fit the trope. The maximum power increase you can get from just this uniform and nothing else cannot exceed destroying a house. But can be higher if you have any powers or your physical body is already above a mundane human. 

There is also no age limit on triggering the tropes, nor do you actually need to be in school. But you may get strange looks being an adult running around in this.
objects.title: School Uniform

addons.text: With the treasures of Cancer, Scorpio, and Pisces now within your possession, and their constellations shining high in the sky, you have unlocked more of the powers of the relics of the Triune of Water. The Shield of Cancer will reveal the ability to leach and restore the vitality and life force of your surroundings. The Spear of Scorpio will allow you to poison any creature or entity with its venom; even such existences as spirits or gods will suffer under its power. The Belt of Pisces allows the wearer to merge the various forms they take into chimeric creatures, without risk. Finally, the relics’ strongest powers—linked to their respective signs—can now be used once every 3 days.
addons.title: Triune of Water

objects.text:
Cancer is a constellation with relatively few myths. The most well-known is that of the crab Karkinos, which snapped at the heel of Heracles and paid the ultimate price. However, two thousand years ago, the Egyptians revered this constellation as the celestial embodiment of the god Khepri, a deity taking the form of a scarab that caused the sun to rise, life to return, and the days to lengthen once more.

The Shield pours Khepri’s gift of vitality and life into the user, restoring their stamina at a tremendous rate. While bearing this artifact, the user is effectively incapable of running out of stamina, able to go months without exhaustion setting in.

Although the Cancer constellation only shines for a brief few months on Earth, when wielding the Shield, you can cause this sign to remain in the heavens throughout the year—regardless of the world, dimension, realm, or location. Once every 12 days, you can invoke the star sign’s connection to the sun. When this power is active, attacking the Shield of Cancer will require the same force and power as attacking the sun itself.

Finally, the Shield of Cancer can take the form of any shield you desire or be transformed into a small pin of Cancer for easy transport and storage.
objects.title: Shield of Cancer

objects.text:
A traditional black Shinobi garb, finely crafted and layered with subtle enchantments. When worn, the Shozoku erases the common traces one would leave behind. Footprints do not form where you step, no fingerprints are left upon surfaces you touch, and your ordinary movements produce no sound—silent steps, quiet breathing, the brushing of fabric all swallowed into nothing. In darkened areas, your presence seems to dissolve, making it easy to blend into your surroundings.

These effects are not absolute. When you engage in rigorous activity such as sprinting or combat, the Shozoku’s concealment falters, though it still heavily dampens the noise and signs of your movement. Even in the midst of battle, your actions remain harder to track, muffled and obscured in ways that make you elusive and difficult to pin down.

The garb also conceals physical tells. Wounds, exhaustion, and signs of stress are carefully hidden. Blood does not seep through the fabric, sweat is absorbed without trace, and the Shozoku subtly adjusts your posture to mask injury or fatigue. Even when your body is failing, your silhouette remains steady and unreadable. This concealment is not perfect under direct pressure, such as during combat, but you remain far more difficult to read than a normal fighter.

When you cover your face with the mask and hood, your identity becomes almost impossible to discern. Features that could identify you—facial structure, skin tone, the color of your eyes—all vanish beneath layers of shadow. Your voice is altered, subtly warped and scrambled, making it impossible to connect to your unmasked self. Even to those who know you well, recognition becomes a distant challenge, as the Shozoku shrouds every trace of who you are.
objects.title: Shinobi Shozoku

objects.text:
These shoes once belonged to the legendary rogue whose name they bear, steeped in history and myth. It was said that with them, she could move unseen and unheard, her steps as soft as whispers on the wind.

Crafted for those who move unseen, they grant their wearer an uncanny silence as they muffle every footfall, allowing the wearer to glide across any surface without a sound. Creaky floorboards, brittle twigs, even the treacherous pressure plates of hidden traps—none betray your presence. Whether walking or running, each step remains feather-light, leaving no sound, no trace, not even a footprint upon freshly fallen snow.

But their magic extends beyond mere stealth. The shoes also absorb impact, dampening the force of a fall. Drop from the roof of a castle, and you will land with little more than a soft thud—so long as you land on your feet. However, even this enchantment has its limits. A fall beyond fifteen meters will push the shoes past their ability to cushion the descent, and from the heights of a mountain or cliff, not even their magic will save you.
objects.title: Sneakers of The Nightwalker

addons.text:
The 72 demons of the Ars Goetia are more than lone rulers—they are sovereigns of vast armies, each commanding legions of the infernal. Now, those legions are yours to summon and wield.

Where once you called only the demons themselves, now their full hosts rise at your command. Each demon brings forth the legions sworn to them, their numbers ranging from the smallest retinues of 19 to the overwhelming forces of Paimon’s 200. In total, you now command 6,541 legions, each numbering tens of thousands of supernatural warriors—shadows given form, horrors of ancient war, creatures of nightmare and legend.

Bael’s 66 legions vanish into invisibility, striking unseen before melting away. Amon’s 40 legions spread chaos and discord, unraveling battle lines before the fight has begun. Sabnock’s 50 legions erect hellish fortresses in moments, turning any battlefield into an impregnable stronghold. The sky darkens as Vepar’s 29 legions emerge from the depths, flooding the land with supernatural tides. Asmodeus alone commands 72 legions, each filled with monsters strong enough to tear through stone and steel as if they were paper.

From Paimon’s legions of scholars and strategists to Andras’s executioners, from Buer’s healers to Balam’s warlords, every demon’s forces now serve as an extension of your will. With but a word, entire armies march. With but a thought, wars are won.

The world has seen war. Now, it will witness the might of Solomon’s heir.
addons.title: Armies of the 72

addons.text:
The Seal of Solomon once granted dominion over demons, but Lucifer—the First Fallen, the Lightbringer—was never among them. The reason? He was beyond Solomon’s reach. Even the 72 kings, dukes, and marquises of Hell bowed before him, recognizing his supremacy. But now, his essence resides within you. You are no longer merely a Demon Lord—you have ascended to Great Lord Lucifer, taking on his perfection, power, and sovereignty over all infernal beings. 

Your body has transformed into something beyond mortal or demon, taking on his celestial perfection while retaining the raw power of the abyss. Large, angelic wings extend from your back, granting you complete mastery over flight, while your presence alone instills both awe and terror. You radiate an aura of absolute authority, making it nearly impossible for those before you to resist your will. Strength, speed, and resilience far exceed what you once had, marking you as a being that exists beyond the constraints of ordinary existence.

As the Lord of Lies, deception has no power against you. No one, no matter how skilled, can lie in your presence. This extends to your entire domain, ensuring absolute transparency and preventing treachery from ever taking root. Manipulation and betrayal against you become impossible, and all who serve you do so with unwavering, undeniable loyalty.
addons.title: Great Lord Lucifer

addons.text: The Ars Goetia is but one collection of demons among countless others across the world. While the Seal of Solomon grants dominion over 72 infernal nobles from Judeo-Christian tradition, your mastery of demonology reveals a broader truth: demons of equal rank and power exist in every mythology. You do not limit yourself to a single pantheon of infernal beings; instead, your authority extends across cultures, claiming the greatest supernatural warlords, kings, and horrors from myths beyond the Western world. You have gain an entirely new set of 72 demons, separate from both the Ars Goetia and the binding slots granted by Solomon’s Ring. These are the rulers and nightmares of other traditions—legendary spirit kings, ancient warlords, and demonic deities whose names have persisted through the ages. Among them is Nurarihyon, the supreme commander of yokai, who bends the will of spirits and mortals alike. There is Ravana, the ten-headed Rakshasa lord, whose boundless intellect is matched only by his overwhelming strength. Iblis, the defiant djinn, weaves illusions and fire, his cunning matched only by his scorn for lesser minds. Erlik, the dark lord of the Turkic underworld, rules an empire of the dead with iron decree. Camazotz, the Mayan death bat, spreads his wings to usher in night eternal. These beings, like the Ars Goetia, exist to serve you once called forth, though their nature is vastly different. If you have Armies of the 72 then each of these demons will also gain their respective army. If you have Great Lord Lucifer then they will also gain your Mark of Dominion and you will also gain access to their powers.
addons.title: 72 Foreigners of Power

addons.text: The heavens open not by divine invitation, but by your command. You now gain mastery over the Shem HaMephorash—the 72 Names of God—able to summon the angelic counterparts to the demons of the Ars Goetia. Like your demons, these celestial beings do not exist until called forth; they are formed from divine essence shaped by your will, unshackled from any higher throne. Once brought into existence, they are bound completely, their loyalty absolute and unshakable. No creed, pantheon, or sacred law can override your authority. They serve you and only you. These are not the gentle messengers of scripture, but the fierce guardians, the seraphic judges, and the architects of divine will. Each one embodies a unique virtue and power, ranging from the angel of sacred geometry who can reshape reality with divine pattern, to the angel of retribution who rains holy fire upon the corrupt. As with the demons, your command is their reason for being, and their purpose is singular: to carry out your will with heavenly precision. If you possess Armies of the 72, then each angel too commands a legion of their own. These hosts are divine forces of unmatched brilliance and discipline—blades of living light, beasts of glory, constructs of sacred song. They descend as stars falling from the firmament, taking formation in perfect silence, ready to purge unholiness or defend creation. Your dominion is now balanced on both wings of eternity: one infernal, the other celestial. If you possess Great Lord Lucifer, your nature transforms into something unprecedented—a being of both divine and demonic essence. You are no longer defined by darkness or light, but a perfected synthesis of both. Your power becomes dual-natured: wrathful and redemptive, damning and sanctifying. Your presence radiates paradox, terrifying and transcendent, drawing reverence from both angels and demons alike. No force, holy or hellish, may claim superiority over you—you are the final authority of both realms. If you have 72 Foreigners of Power, you unlock yet another set of 72, this time angelic and divine beings drawn from the myths and heavens of the world’s myriad cultures. Celestial warlords and radiant protectors from distant traditions bend the knee: the Tennin of Japanese lore descend like cherry blossom storms; Ašvins, the Vedic twins of light, ride the dawn across the sky; Xangô, orisha of divine judgment, brings thunder that sings with justice; Zarathustrian Yazatas burn with holy fire unquenched by time. These too are yours, not as allies—but as bound emissaries of your divine will.
addons.title: Shem HaMephorash

objects.text:
The ring in your possession is none other than the fabled Seal of Solomon, gifted to the king by God. It is a seamless fusion of truth and legend—merging both the historical artifact and the mythical powers born from Solomon’s legend.

With it comes absolute dominion over 72 demons of the Ars Goetia, the infernal nobles who each wield unique abilities. These demons do not exist until the ring summons them into being, ensuring they have no ties to any preexisting Hell. At the lowest rank, demon knights possess strength great enough to shatter buildings or wield magic that can slaughter dozens. At the highest, demon kings command power vast enough to rival armies. From Asmodeus, whose sheer might can reduce a town to rubble, to Paimon, whose sight unveils the future, every rank—from knight to count, from marquis to duke—exists solely to serve you, their loyalty bound so completely that betrayal is impossible.

But mastery over demons is only the beginning. Born from Solomon’s legend, the ring grants unrivaled authority over bindings. To mirror its dominion over the Goetia, it provides 72 binding slots, allowing you to bind any supernatural being as your own. Ghosts, eldritch entities, psychics, rogue AIs—anything beyond the natural order can be claimed. The binding process depends on your power; beings equal to you are bound instantly, while stronger entities may take months or even years, and anything two magnitudes above you remains beyond reach. Once bound, all prior contracts, oaths, and allegiances are erased, their will shackled as deeply as the 72 demons.

Beyond this, the ring also grants resistance to bindings placed upon you. Demonic pacts, divine decrees, psychic compulsions—any attempt to subjugate you without consent is simply nullified. A demon offering power in exchange for your soul? You take the power and walk away, untouched. If you have an open slot, you may even reverse the contract, binding the entity instead. This immunity holds against all but the most powerful, with paragon-level beings or higher able to override it.
objects.title: Solomon’s Seal Ring

objects.text:
This ring has a very strange property to it — the capacity to store anything the wearer has, without limit or constraint. Whether it’s physical objects like ammunition or a phone, or intangible things like mana, feelings, emotions, memories, or even living organisms, the ring has no issue storing them. Size, type, or nature doesn’t matter; if the wearer possesses it, it can be stored.

Storing something is simple: the wearer merely thinks of what they want to store, and it goes into the ring. Retrieving anything is just as easy — a single focused thought, and the desired item is immediately summoned, no matter how big or varied the contents inside are.

The ring also grants the wearer absolute control over the flow of time within its storage. Food can stay eternally fresh, wine can age in seconds, and fragile materials can be preserved in a perfect state — all according to the user’s preference, with no effect interfering with another. Besides, the ring cannot be stolen, lost, or removed except when you deliberately choose to relinquish it. And you can choose to have all or some of your possessions — whether vehicles, objects of power, and the like- already safely stored inside from the start, ready to be accessed whenever you need.
objects.title: Storage Ring

objects.text:
This enchanted ornate silver ring anchors a phantom space, a pocket dimension adjacent to reality. It grants the wearer awareness of the contents of the phantom space and allows them to store and retrieve physical objects at their convenience.

The pocket dimension has a volume of 2500 liters in the shape of a cube (1.35m on each side). Only items that can fit in this volume can be moved in and out of the phantom space; liquids and gasses need to be stored in containers.
objects.title: Storage Ring (Lesser)

objects.text:
This pair of gloves is enchanted so that when worn, all sounds produced by the wearer are muffled. The wearer will produce no audible noise as a result from their actions. Footsteps, breathing, shouting, none of it will make any noise.

Furthermore, the gloves are connected to an extra dimensional inventory, allowing the wearer to summon and store items instantly. The inventory is theoretically infinite, although no objects larger than 5 cubic meters in volume may be stored.
objects.title: The Black Gloves

objects.text:
You have been gifted the rarest crown in all the Wheel—a mark of True Royalty, so distinct that no one would dare challenge your claim. This crown is etched deep into your essence, forging an eternal connection between your soul and body. As True Royalty, you exist beyond the reach of the infinite multiverse; no forced clones, no temporal variants, nor parallel universe counterparts will ever emerge from you. You are—and always will be—one of a kind, beyond even the Wheel’s boundless power to replicate.

With this crown, your heart is strengthened, and your presence exudes undeniable Royalty. You possess an innate ability to gather the most skilled and loyal followers, and your aura is so immense that even Gods and Demons will be forced to acknowledge your presence. Your unique nature grants you the courage to face the infinite worlds of the Wheel with a smile on your face.

The crown itself can take the form of any headgear you choose, though it remains purely cosmetic, offering no functional protection.
objects.title: The Crown Of One

addons.text:
Wiring the Doubletime bracer into the Host allows you to compress the Host’s local timedilation, giving it more subjective time to make changes and adaptations. 

In essence this vastly increases the speed of its changes and its growth.
addons.title: Compression

addons.text:
Beyond having one sapience in your armour, now the psychoforms that inhabit the Solitude Unit are the sapience of the armour, each able to administrate individual systems making the Host of Problems adapt far faster and in far more ways than it previously did. 

This also gives the different Psychoforms more responsibility and a greater stake in your mutual survival.
addons.title: Ah, The Problems Previously Mentioned

objects.text:
You have been given a suit of living and growing armour. Fortunately it grows and evolves over time with new abilities and capabilities. Unfortunately you do not control the direction of its development, it does. 

The armour, a living organism, feeds both environmentally and from the energy of the wearer, using this energy to make adjustments and improvements to itself. More durable plating, integrated weaponry, psionic comms, and much more being available to it as it grows.

However, you yourself have no control over its direction or priorities. Instead, the sapience within it acts in its own interests first and foremost. Should it develop means to communicate, you could provide input on its choices but not control.

Upon purchase you can decide the aesthetics of the base armour, be it fantastical plate, a skintight bodysuit, or even a kind of scifi power-armour.
objects.title: The Host of Problems™

objects.text:
You now possess the Linen of Unification, the sacred burial shroud woven for the first Pharaoh of Egypt. These twenty meters of bandages feel cool to the touch, and when you will them to move, faint, golden hieroglyphs flare to life within the fabric’s weave. By right of possession, they answer to your command alone.

The linen is an extension of your will, moving with telekinetic force within a thirty-meter radius. This telekinetic control does not grant flight, as it requires leverage against a solid surface or object to generate movement. However, it translates into immense physical power. When anchored to your own body, it acts as telekinetic musculature, amplifying your strength to allow you to lift over fifteen tons, shatter reinforced concrete, and leap gaps of fifty meters. You can also "shoot" the linen out like grasping tendrils to seize objects or opponents from afar, using the anchored cloth to pull them toward you or slam them into surfaces. The material itself, despite its cloth like texture, has the composite durability and ballistic resistance of modern tank armor.

Any living flesh that contacts the linen is instantly mummified and time for that tissue stops completely. Wounds cease to bleed, decay halts, and the flesh takes on the appearance of dried out husk. This makes the flesh completely immutable. This effect is purely physical and reversible; the moment contact is broken, biological processes resume exactly where they left off and the flesh returns to looking like how it originally did. If you choose to fully wrap your head, encasing your brain, this stasis makes it so that your thinking process is no longer reliant on the biological brain. As the brain is frozen, it cannot be chemically altered, damaged, or affected. Your mind is rendered immune to all mental attacks, influences, or conditions that target or require a functioning physical brain. This state ends immediately when the linen is removed from the head, and normal brain function resumes.
objects.title: The Linen of Unification

objects.text: The Queen wished for a battle armor, something to help her fight alongside the soldiers in battle for morale and efficiency, and in a way, to make her son not feel alone. With a decree sent out and a very hefty payday offered, MANY measurements were taken over weeks and weeks, before finally... an Elven blacksmith was able to complete the task, his only request being not the gold, but that it be worn at least once a day. The Queen is a large exosuit of steel, elven glass, and Mithril armor, measuring 6.1 meters in height and weighing approximately 590 kilograms. Heavily layered and fully encased, the armor certainly keeps its wearer safe and snug. The wearer is set into a space right in front of the sphere on the chest, their arms and legs dropped into full arm gloves and full legged boots respectively, with a relatively tight harness that makes them almost resemble a bouncer. Movement is enabled by magical sensors, detecting intent with the arms and legs while the wearer remains completely immobile inside. The 3 dots on the chest are in reality, magical equivalents to cameras, acting as 4 eyes for the wearer inside. The main center acts as a normal pair of eyes, able to see mana in the air and through illusions. The other 2 act as extra eyes that can be activated with a specific set of blinks. These cannot be tricked by illusions and disguises, the only way to take them out being to outright destroy them. The Queen, like the suit of her beloved son, does not come with built-in weapons. But compared to her son, It can generate weapons from mana in the air if sufficient knowledge of the weapon and focus is applied. However, only the suit can wield the weapons, as they disappear once knocked out of their grasp. They can also only be focused if any form of mana exists in the world, even if it is the absolute minimum. Finally, its own physical capabilities is nothing to sneeze at. It is able to smash through Mithril with heavy effort, run at up to 500 mph for up to 2 hours, and withstand attacks from whole armies by itself. However, all this is only able to work at full capability if it is worn at least once a day for even just 1 minute. The more days missed, the less useful it becomes until after 180 days, it becomes a paperweight until used enough to make up for the lack of use. If unused for 3 days, then 30 minutes of total wear time is required to get its full power back. 180 days, however, would require exactly 18 days worth of continuous wearing.
objects.title: The Queen

addons.text:
When The Rook was first forged, it was salvation for a dying boy. But you are no dying boy. The suit has been rebuilt for a knight who needs no crutch. In the hands of a trained warrior, The Rook is no longer a castle for protection. While wearing it, you’ll sacrifice no strength, no speed; your dexterity and flexibility remain razor-sharp, all you’ll find is more force and power.

The suit’s limbs now use dual-cable tension and tuned springs for faster strikes and smoother return. Cam-lever locks in its joints allow for rapid bracing and motion arrest mid-combat. Harness adjustments rebalance the frame for a stronger body, increasing stability in sprints and climbs. Torso plating is reinforced with ribbed steel to absorb and spread blows from polearms or cavalry.

An internal haptic feedback system is added via tactile straps and tensioned bands, installed across the arms, legs, and torso, giving real-time physical feedback as the suit moves. These bands tighten or slacken slightly depending on resistance and limb position, allowing you to feel shifts in motion and load as if the suit were an extension of your own body.

A rear-mounted lead counterweight shifts with movement to keep balance under momentum. A collapsible back spike has also been added, allowing bracing under impact. Over it, a fire-retardant mantle of soaked leather and quilted mail helps absorbs heat, flame, or blast.

Deployable climbing claws have been added in the knees and gauntlets for siege ascent. The visor is now a layered design, improving vision in low, wide, or forward angles. It can be sealed shut when in smoke or volleys.

Cooling is improved with copper heat plates that draw warmth toward rear vents, aided by bellows driven by leg motion. Ankle bellows activate under footwork stress. Wicking inserts made of linen and sheepskin can be re-soaked mid-combat through a refill port beneath the gorget.

Lastly, all but the most critical safety limiters have been removed. The suit no longer shields the wearer from overstrain, meaning the strength behind every movement is enhanced even greater than before, but control now rests entirely with the knight to avoid self-injury.
addons.title: Castling

objects.text:
Commissioned by the King for his youngest and most beloved son, born frail and cursed with a wasting sickness, The Rook was a means for the prince to be made strong through ways other than blood and bone. The royal smiths, engineers, and artificers labored for thirteen years to complete the design: a fully enclosing, mechanically assisted exosuit of armor that would allow the boy to ride to war as a knight in form, if not in flesh.

The Rook is a massive, full-body exosuit of articulated plate armor, measuring 2.3 meters in height and weighing approximately 480 kilograms. Heavily reinforced and fully enclosing, it functions as both protection and a strength-amplifying frame. The wearer is suspended inside in a semi-standing brace posture by an internal harness system designed to distribute load and minimize concussive force. Movement is enabled by a mechanical linkage system: cable and pulley assemblies in the limbs convert the pilot’s motion into amplified suit motion. Pre-tensioned springs at the elbows and knees assist with limb return and reduce fatigue. Each joint includes a mechanical brace-lock system, allowing the wearer to hold weight-bearing poses without muscular effort.

The shoulder and hip joints are built with multi-axis assemblies supported by internal bracing, allowing a greater range of motion than conventional armor. Internal load is transferred through a rigid frame into the pelvic structure, reducing strain on the pilot’s arms and torso.

Ventilation is driven by a hybrid system of passive drafting and mechanical bellows. Vertical flue channels pull cool air in at the waist and vent heat through the backplate, aided by a bellows unit built into the legs that compresses slightly with each step. This ensures consistent airflow even when stationary for short periods. Cooling is handled by evaporative wicking: wool padding at key contact points is soaked before use, reducing internal temperature as air moves through. Inserts are modular and can be replaced or re-soaked between deployments.

The suit includes no integrated weaponry, but it is engineered to wield a massive, double-headed polearm designed exclusively for The Rook. Measuring over two and a half meters in length, the weapon features a reinforced haft with two crescent-shaped axe blades mounted at either end and a fixed thrusting spike at the center. Weighing nearly forty kilograms, it is too heavy and unbalanced to be wielded by any unassisted human. However, when mounted to The Rook’s pulley-amplified gauntlets and bracing system, it can be maneuvered with surprising speed, comparable to a longsword in the hands of an unarmored knight. When not in use, it is stored vertically, blade-up or point-down. 

Included within are parchment instructions detailing proper maintenance, along with all necessary tools and materials. Maintaining the suit requires no more effort than a knight would spend caring for their own armor and arms.
objects.title: The Rook

objects.text: This bathrobe, of a color you can choose, was created by a great wizard who got fed up with short potion use times. The garment when worn and stained with a potion provides the effect of the potion to the wearer, until the stain dries up. While wearing it all your spells aligned with cleaning and potion making are stronger by 50%.
objects.title: The Wizardly Bathrobe

addons.title: Ammo Surge
addons.text:
By wiring the Overclock into your ammo pouch, you can go beyond overclocking individual pieces, but instead using the charge to apply a Trick effect to something that’s not ammunition. 

These effects are temporary as the overcharge and do not exceed 3sp in strength on their own, but causing gauntlets to heal instead of harm or giving a forcefield a ricochet effect is well within your ability.

objects.text:
You have been given a pouch that is able to be clipped onto a belt or sash of some kind. This pouch is not empty however, but rather contains an improbable amount of ‘trick ammunition’ for any weapon you could imagine. 

These trick ammunition include bullets capable of freezing small areas, crossbow bolts that unfold into nets, even the notorious ‘boxing glove arrow’. By reaching into the pouch and pulling you can grab any variant you know exists inside, taking the form of something you could currently use for a weapon you possess. 

While the sheer amount and variety of ammunition it contains is helpful, you do not know what ammunition it contains natively, meaning you need to experiment with the variety it produces in order to know what is at your disposal, after which you can call it to the top of the pouch with a thought when reaching in for new ammunition.
objects.title: Trick Ammo

addons.text:
What once looked like a mess of hand-me-down armor has become something unmistakably yours. Every frayed stitch, every dented plate, every scratch across the leather tells a story of someone who fought, learned, and survived. It is not prized for how it gleams, but for how it endures—and it endures because it remembers you.

The gear’s protective effects now activate only when worn by you, or by someone to whom you’ve given explicit permission. This permission is temporary and entirely under your control, and you may revoke it at any time. While worn by another with your blessing, it still protects, but subtly molds to their form with traces of your movements and battle instincts.

More importantly, the durability of your gear is now treated as an extension of your own health. Your second phase no longer triggers at 40% of your base HP alone, but instead at 40% of your total durability pool—your HP combined with the gear’s current integrity. For example, if you have 100 HP and the gear has 20 durability, your second phase will now activate at 48 HP instead of 40. This means you can enter your second phase earlier in the fight, while still having a larger margin for survival—allowing you to enjoy its full power longer, without dancing on the edge of death.
addons.title: Signature Gear

addons.text: They may not have been crafted as a pair, but time, wear, and purpose have shaped them into something more. Now, when worn together, they speak with the same voice—steel to steel, leather to leather, bearing the same marks of use and intent. Once simple tools, they now are parts of a complete set. When both the Tutorial Weapon and Tutorial Gear are equipped, their effects are enhanced—each gains a 50% boost in effectiveness. The weapon strikes harder and channels more cleanly, while the gear absorbs more damage, lasts longer, and recovers faster. Equipping both also grants a passive ability based on the theme they represent. Heavy plate sets might grant resistance to staggering or knockback, while lighter, agile sets like hunter’s garb could enhance stealth, reaction time, or sensory sharpness. The passive reinforces the combat style the set was made to support—practical, grounded, and dependable. Visually, the weapon and armor now resemble one another in appearance—matching in design, material, and finish. They look unmistakably like parts of the same set, unified not just in purpose, but in form. Lastly, if separated, the weapon and gear can be used to locate one another. They naturally gravitate toward their counterpart, drawn by the quiet pull of being part of a whole.
addons.title: Set Gear

objects.text:
At a glance, your gear looks like something barely held together—simple cloth wrappings under weathered leather pads, or perhaps a loose-fitting tunic with dented iron plates stitched in with crude thread. The boots are scuffed, the gloves fingerless, and the helmet—if there is one—is more a pot with holes than real protection. Whatever its form, it’s unmistakably starter gear: something meant to be replaced, forgotten, and discarded. Despite its humble appearance, its total durability is deceptively solid—roughly equivalent to that of full medieval plate armor, even if it looks like it shouldn’t survive a strong breeze.

While worn, the gear takes every hit in your place. Physical, magical, elemental—it doesn’t matter. As long as it has durability left, you do not take damage. The gear itself absorbs all harm until its endurance hits zero. When that happens, it doesn’t shatter or disappear—it simply stops working. Its form dulls and frays, the seams split, the metal blackens or cracks, and it looks one solid hit away from falling off. However, it can be repaired if provided with basic materials, and if tended during rest, it will gradually mend itself over time.

In addition, the gear carries a latent connection to the world’s power system. If you’re already attuned, it enhances your control and efficiency—making your casting, channeling, or ki usage cleaner and slightly more powerful. If you have no such connection, it grants you the barest functional link: enough to use basic powers or spells in a clumsy, first-time sort of way. It doesn’t teach you mastery, but it ensures you’re not entirely powerless in a world ruled by systems you haven’t yet learned to use.
objects.title: Tutorial Gear

addons.title: Piccolo’s Pupil
addons.text: “Yes, Piccolo, I see the Drip” It would seem as though you have learned the ways of Drip Master Piccolo such that you can use your Weighted Equipment to farm Aura passively with zero effort as long as you keep your Weighted Equipment on. Additionally, for as long as you are wearing your Equipment, it becomes much harder to lose Aura. Whenever you decide to remove your Weighted Equipment in combat, you will gain a large increase to your Aura and power based upon the time you have had your Weighted Equipment on yourself consistently without removing it for more than a day. This increase can at most double your Aura and Power at full strength should you wear it for a month or longer consistently. Lastly, whenever you remove your Weight Clothing in combat and win, you will permanently keep a small amount of Aura which cannot be lost and a minor increase to your overall strength and power.

objects.text:
Perhaps one of the most common tropes in fiction is weighted equipment or trinkets that act as weights used for training. You gain a single set of clothing, equipment, or trinket of your design, which may take the form of any weighted clothing/item from any story or your own design.

When you equip your chosen Weighted Equipment, it will seamlessly adjust its weight evenly around your entire body to a perfect level for you to grow stronger without any risk of injury to yourself. You can also selectively change the amount of weight as you wish, though it is advised to be careful when doing so.

You can either choose to take off the Ultimate Weighted Equipment or turn off its increased weight effect without physically taking it off.
objects.title: Ultimate Weighted Equipment

objects.text:
This set of clothing, from the shoes to the cloak, was the traditional uniform worn by the Royal Knights who swore an oath to protect both the Royal Family and the innocent. What sets it apart from an ordinary set of silk garments is that all Royal Knights were magic users, if not full mages, and therefore each uniform was both magically enchanted and crafted from silk imbued with mana. The entire set possesses various effects that work together to enhance the already formidable physical and magical abilities of the knight wearing them.

The white cape grants a self-cleaning and self-repairing effect for itself and any other nearby parts of the uniform. The long white coat is imbued with an enchantment that regulates the wearer’s temperature, preventing them from sweating in summer or feeling cold in winter—though magical or extreme conditions can bypass this. The black shirt amplifies the wearer’s self-imbuing magics or powers by 100%, including abilities such as reinforcing the body with mana or other supernatural energies. The gloves increase the potency of external spells cast by the wearer by 150%. The pants grant the wearer the ability to move and jump at twice their normal speed and height. Finally, the shoes are enchanted to allow the wearer to walk on water or similar surfaces.

On top of all this, the silk from which the uniform is made has been magically enhanced to be as durable as steel. While typically meant to be used by someone with magic, it can translate well to other kinds of supernatural energies and powers.
objects.title: Uniform of the Royal Knight

objects.text:
A set of power armor once fielded as the standard issue across the front-line ranks of the Xeno Alliance during their devastating war against the Coalition of Mankind.

The suit is completely sealed, capable of full vacuum operation, and features integrated multi-spectrum life support systems. It is also universally adaptable. On initial contact, it will perform a full biostructural scan and then shift to accommodate your biology, restructuring its internal composition as well as shedding or generating structural mass using molecular construction drawn from its H₂O stores. The suit's self-modification capabilities are such that it can even regenerate nano-ceramic matrices that comprise its internal and external components mid-fight, using water as a catalyst for material synthesis.

The suit can operate in high-pressure environments, up to those similar to Jupiter’s upper atmosphere. Although, the more power the suit needs to divert to maintain structural integrity, the less physical boost it can provide. Your total physical capabilities will never be reduced below that of a trained human soldier, but with full power diverted to physical enhancement, you will be capable of feats such as tearing through reinforced hull plating, leaping across orbital structures, or catching and redirecting mass-reactive munitions mid-flight. The suit also includes gravitic anchoring nodes in the palms and soles to scale vertical surfaces or even cling to ceilings.

The suit's sensory and camouflage modules include scanners for nearly all conceivable spectrums, from infrared and ultraviolet to seismic and electromagnetic, as well as limited active adaptive camouflage for the outer shell and passive regulation of the emission of heat and energy signatures.

Encrypted quantum burst channels, tight-beam laser relay, audio broadcast, and a variety of other systems allow for communication at universal distances and include a linguistic processor capable of parsing over twenty thousand spoken languages, complete with tone recognition and non-verbal cue analysis.

Control of the armor is performed via a hybrid interface—a neural link at its core, supported by biometric feedback and kinetic gesture recognition, allowing for the suit to feel like an extension of the wearer's body. All the visual data is overlaid directly through retinal overlays, unaffected by glare, jamming, or optical distortion.

Embedded within the neural interface is a combat-grade Virtual Intelligence, capable of handling threat detection, target prioritization, real-time tactical optimization, communication assistance for translation accuracy, and limited motor assistance during unconsciousness or shock states, using predictive modeling to simulate intended movements and maintain survival reflexes.

The entire system is powered by a Deuteric Singularity Drive, a compact hydrogen-fusion reactor that isolates deuterium from any accessible H₂O and performs micro-scale fusion, which results in a stable and clean energy output for as long as the reactor has access to any H₂O source, whether it is water, ice, mist, or even atmospheric vapor. In desperate circumstances, the suit will draw the minimal required fluid from its wearer, precisely measured so as to avoid permanent harm. At worst, this causes symptoms of dehydration, but it ensures that the armor—and by extension, the soldier—can continue operating.
objects.title: Veltrass-MKIV

addons.text: You have gained the Sword of Valor Kusanagi no Tsurugi, the Jewel of Benevolence Yasakani Magatama and the Mirror of Truth Yata no Kagami, these three legendary relics are known as the Imperial Regalia of Japan, now as their new owner you receive the power’s rights and privileges of being the Emperor of Japan (or it’s analogues) in any world you enter. As the Emperor you can be the absolute ruler of Japan, with a loyal and obedient government to enact your will on an adoring populace, or be instead a figure head with that same government governing your people in any way you desire. At your whim you can change which of these choices, with your subjects happy to comply. While you do have a newfound talent for governing and leadership, you also serve the role of Head of the Shinto faith. Even in worlds where there are no gods, this brings immense levels of loyalty and respect from the faithful, while on worlds where the Shinto Gods exist? You serve as the direct link to the Kami, able to communicate humanities desires and barter for divine favour and intervention.
addons.title: Chrysanthemum Throne

addons.text: While normally a designation more commonly found in the Greco-Roman Pantheon, you now stand as a Legacy of the Shinto Sun Goddess Amaterasu-Ōmikami. While your connection to her is diluted by many generations you are an anomaly that has managed to gain a more powerful connection to her domains of Sun and Light enough to be considered equal to a demigod. From the Domain of the Sun you can generate and control Solar Flames, are empowered while the sun is in the sky, and and have a limited ability to control gravity While the Domain of Light allows you to generate and manipulate light, from simply illuminating a dark space, to illusions of light, and even constructs of hard light, the variety of uses serving you well.
addons.title: Legacy of the Sun

objects.text: The Yata no Kagami is a bronze mirror sacred to the Shinto faith. Forged long ago by the deity Ishikori-dome, the Mirror represents Truth and aided in luring Amaterasu-Ōmikami from the cave Ama-no-Iwayato and restoring the light of the sun to the world once more. The mirror has many abilities, Firstly it has the ability to be worn as a shield, and reflect back all attacks that target it, whether they be magical, physical, or spiritual. Secondly though easiest with mirrors it is capable of displaying the surroundings of any other reflective surface. Through this one may spy or communicate as you see fit. Thirdly the mirror only reflects Truth therefore disguise and deception are rendered impossible to all but the user while one is reflected within it. Fourthly the mirror is capable of manipulating light to create illusions, albeit only visual ones, a clever user can find many uses for this. Fifthly as a relic of the Sun Goddess in the hands of a solar deity or demigod the mirror is capable of shrouding itself in solar flame and temporarily acting as the sun. Lastly the user may change the size and form of the mirror to suit their needs, though the end result will always be reflective like a mirror, and clearly made of bronze.
objects.title: Yata no Kagami

objects.text:
To possess a Regalia is to be acknowledged as a king, but you are no mere king, for you are the Emperor. You have been granted a personal Regalia that embodies the composite essence of all Regalia's. It harnesses the collective abilities of the 28 Regalia's, granting you access to a vast array of powers and techniques from each one, including the revered tricks from the 8 Main Roads. This Regalia stands above all others, seamlessly blending the unmatched potential of the Sky Regalia, the elemental prowess of the Flame, Thunder, Wind, and Fang Regalia, the paralyzing vibrations of the Gem Regalia, and more.

Crafted with unparalleled craftsmanship, The Emperor's Regalia possesses an unbreakable nature. Furthermore, this Regalia operates without the need for any external energy source, defying the limitations of conventional ATs.

Upon wearing The Emperor's Regalia, you are bestowed with supernatural agility and dexterity, your movements becoming a fluid symphony of grace. The Regalia molds into your body as if an extension of your very being. With innate mastery over this divine Regalia, you seamlessly maneuver and ride the Regalia with the prowess of a true king, effortlessly performing any tricks and traversing any terrain or environment.
objects.title: The Emperor's Regalia (Air Gear)

addons.text:
You're now the fully ordained King of the Sarkaz and sovereign ruler of Kazdel, the nation of no borders and Promised Land for all Sarkaz. As their leader, you command a blend of respect, reverence, and fear from your people.

Alongside this, the spirits within the Black Crown have now accepted you as one of their own, for no longer are you an Outblood king, offering greater access to their immense power. However, caution is still necessary, as each spirit harbors their own motives and expectations for you.

With this ascension, all of your racial abilities have been significantly enhanced by the expertise and accumulated experience contained within the Crown. Your mastery over its mental and emotional influence has also deepened, allowing you to exert more sway over others and even more so for your fellow Teekaz. As King, your power and presence resonate throughout Kazdel, shaping its destiny and that of your people.
addons.title: Lord of Fiends

objects.text:
DWDB-221E, more widely known as the Black Crown, is an artifact of the First Civilization—a relic forged to preserve their history and ensure they would never repeat their mistakes. However, held within its boundless depths are not only the record of its creators' past but also of every civilization that has risen and fallen on Terra's soil through the millennia of its existence.

Commanding dominion over the realm of the mind, the Black Crown possesses the power to twist thoughts and reshape consciousness as if it were mere putty, exerting complete control over the emotions and perceptions of those around it. Even the most well-fortified mental defenses, like Patriot's, were still vulnerable to its influence. It can induce illusions so lifelike they're indistinguishable from reality, trap others in unending dreams, or wipe another's memories entirely clean.

However, the crown's most formidable ability lies in its capacity to create a collective consciousness by fusing and altering the wills of all life it encounters.

In the wake of its makers' ruin, the crown found itself in the possession of the Teekaz and, over the centuries, became a conduit of immense influence among the Sarkaz, binding itself to their fate. Now, it endures as the symbol of their ruler—the Lord of Fiends.

And it seems the crown's long shadow has decided to stretch forth and claim you as its new bearer, marking your destiny with the weight of its unbroken legacy and imbuing you with the knowledge and power of countless civilizations. Upon your brow rests more than a mere emblem or tool of manipulation; the Black Crown harbors within its shadowed depths a power vast enough to unmake Terra itself.

This ancient relic transforms its chosen bearer, amplifying all of their current abilities and elevating their mastery of Arts to unimaginable heights. Yet, the crown is far from a silent witness, for within it dwells the minds, memories, and powers of all who wore it—a pantheon of remnant souls, eternally vigilant. Their watchful gaze weighs heavily upon every new successor, judging their worthiness. Whether they'll deem you, an Outblood king, worthy to be amongst their storied ranks—remains to be seen.
objects.title: Civilight Eterna (Arknights)

addons.text:
Your Dragon Amulet has been infused with your draconic abilities and is now your Dragonstone. Just having it in your possession provides a large increase to your strength, physical defense, and magic resistance, along with a moderate increase to your magical abilities, accuracy, and speed. You can choose to have it's appearance change to any of the normal Dragonstone stone appearances and even continuously change it between those appearances.

On top of this, due to the unique abilities of its original form, your Dragonstone allows you to change your species of dragon while out of combat, enabling you to choose the right species for the future fight at hand. You also naturally begin to learn unique dragon skills, such as Dragonskin and Rightful God, and regardless of how often you use your powers, you will not degenerate. Your Dragonstone, like a Dragon Amulet, cannot be broken and is bound specifically to you. Its previous functions will still work as usual for other dragons you wish to change.
addons.title: Dragonstone+

objects.text:
The Dragon Amulet is an indestructible artifact that grants extraordinary power to dragons or dragon-blooded beings, it is bound to you and cannot be lost. Merely possessing it allows you to temporarily empower any dragon of your choice. This includes bringing a baby dragon to its prime for battle, transforming a dragon’s appearance—such as granting ground dragons wings to fly—and altering their magical or elemental attributes, like changing a darkness-aligned dragon into one aligned with holy magic. No limit on how many times you can do this and it can be done even mid-combat.

If you share a connection with a dragon, whether as its rider or through a supernatural bond, the amulet enhances your own abilities. You gain magic and heightened physical capabilities, putting you on the path to become a dragonlord.

The amulet’s effects can potentially work for you too. If you are a dragon yourself or possess dragon blood, you will passively benefit from its power as long as it remains in your possession. It allows you to modify your own abilities in the same way it affects other dragons, and it may even help you suppress or eliminate inherent weaknesses associated with being a dragon.

However, the amulet is nearly useless if you are neither a dragon nor have access to one. In such cases, it can still function as a serviceable magical focus or wand, but its true potential lies in its connection to dragons.
objects.title: Dragon Amulet (Artix Entertainment)

objects.text: You are given access to the bread butter of Fumizuki Academy, their more iconic trait, the summoning system. Through this magical bracelet you can summon beings without the need for an ESB-Field or the permission of a teacher. Unlike the standard rules of summoning, this bracelet bypasses those limitations, granting the ability to summon creatures freely. The summoned beings take the form of small, chibi-like versions of their summoners, adorned in clothes that reflect their personalities, with slight beast-like features. The strength and vitality of the summoned beings are determined by the summoner's willpower, while their agility and accuracy depend on the summoner's concentration and physical endurance.
objects.title: Bracelet of Summoning (Baka & Test)

addons.text:
"Humanity is not the only one to possess magic; there were those who came before, those who will come after, and those who developed differently."

Due to your talent and connection to the Occult, the Keystone of Bezel sought to merge with you and, as a result, fused with the Omnitrix. As a consequence, the powers of the Keystone are now added to the Omnitrix, allowing you to store and summon the Charms of Bezel. These appear along your arm by default, but you can decide where they appear, and if the charms are destroyed they will begin the process of recreation taking about a day to be restored.

With the Keystone of Bezel, your Occult abilities have become significantly stronger. Basic rituals and spells are now easier to cast, with a lower chance of failure. You begin on the same level as Hex, with your magical potential even surpassing that of Bezel, who was regarded as the Father of Magic on Earth. However, the most profound change is that you now gain the knowledge and abilities of the Occult native to each transformation, should they possess any.

Your transformations stabilize these alien magical systems, allowing them to be performed anywhere. These rituals from other worlds can bypass the native magic of a world, as they are an out-of-context element, making them harder to fight against.

However, these alien magic systems are limited to the transformations, so when they end, the magic fades with them. In most cases, it disappears, but some rituals may spiral out of control in the worst cases, causing chaos before burning themselves out. However, with time and research, you may learn ways to bypass this, possibly even recreating the Magic System seen in Ben 10, such as those seen in characters like Gwen and Charmcaster.​
addons.title: E.T. Magic
Training Wheels
addons.text:
To any normal human, the Charms of Bezel are incredible magical relics able to give powers many dream of. To an Anodite, they are more like training wheels.

With access to the charms, you’re able to route your own ‘Spark’ through them, not only improving the potency of the Charms themselves dramatically but giving you a model on which to base your own skill and training. 

By using the Charms to their fullest extent you could theoretically half the time it would take for you to become a fully realized anodite, though the last decade would likely be solely dedicated to letting go of your six mystic crutches.

objects.text:
The Charms of Bezel are six magical talismans created by the Master Magician Bezel, that grant different powers and abilities depending on the charm.

Charm of Luck: Grants supernaturally good luck, causing anything and everything to go your way, but only if it's possible in the first place, the Charm don't make the impossible. Any opponents nearby suffer from increased misfortune.

Charm of Reincarnation: Can return you to life, make you recover from physical wounds, besides making you regain consciousness if you're unconscious (after a short amount of time).

Charm of Fire (Pyrokinesis): Grants you the ability to generate, control, and manipulate fire.

Charm of Telekinesis (Levitation): Allows you to fly at incredible speeds and have telekinetic control over multiple objects or people all at once.

Charm of Electricity: Grants the wielder the ability to create, generate, control, and manipulate all forms of electrical energy.

Keystone of Bezel: The Keystone of Bezel increases all natural powers, abilities, skills of the possessor and the power of the other charms 10 times. It can recreate the other Charms in case they're destroyed.
objects.title: Charms of Bezel (Ben 10)

objects.text:
