Created by Azmuth as a tool for his ultimate creation, the Omnitrix, the Mechamorph Armor is an incredible gadget capable of turning the user into a Galvanic Mechamorph, enabling feats of technology possession and upgradation.

In Retaliator Mode, it is combat-capable, able to fire lasers, missiles, and cryogenic blasts. Additionally, the armor is equipped with booster rockets located in the feet that allow for self-propelled flight, and it possesses galaxy-wide teleportation abilities, enabling the user to teleport throughout the galaxy.

Prolonged use risks mental-state degradation, manifesting as single-minded aggression unless mitigated by specific Perks. Additionally, the armor’s shapeshifting and tech-modification abilities are more limited than those of a true Galvanic Mechamorph, prioritizing combat functionality over full technomorphic versatility.

Note: While not in use, the armor turns into a small cube for easy storage.
objects.title: Mechamorph Armor (Ben 10)

addons.text:
Your symbiote has merged with your Omnitrix, allowing it to access the DNA within the Omnitrix, granting it expanded shapeshifting abilities and enabling it to transform into various aliens and even fuse alien forms. Additionally, it can create weapons based on alien forms, such as a crystal sword from Diamondhead or a megaphone enhanced by Echo Echo—unique combinations tailor-made to provide you with useful abilities in any given situation. However, unlike Skurd, these enhancements are not temporary. Within the Klyntar resides a genetic database that it can use to call upon its abilities at any time.

Even without fusing or creating weapons, the symbiote can enhance the aliens that you have transformed into by amplifying their strength and improving any existing abilities the alien has, such as upgrading Clockwork to fight on par with Maltruant. Once it has absorbed an alien's genes, it can eliminate previous weaknesses, like its weakness to fire by bonding with Heatblast or its weakness to sound waves by bonding with Echo Echo.
addons.title: Skurd+

addons.text:
Possessing both the Omnitrix, a repository of that which exists through purely material evolution. And the Forma Dominae, which creates through complete magic and possibility, allows you to incorporate the two together. 

The practical outcome of this is that your Alien forms can be enhanced with the Dominae’s magic, enhancing them like any of its own forms, treating them as a base to build from. This can result in radically different and enhanced alien forms, over time perhaps becoming analogous to an ‘Ultimate’ or ‘Enhanced’ variation.

Much like other Dominae forms, you can ‘save’, ‘discard’ and switch between these variations.
addons.title: A Two Tailed Coin…

addons.text:
The Omnitrix already transforms you into the apex of the relevant species, but this? This is to surpass that pinnacle.

Not only are racial weaknesses of your transformations greatly mitigated or outright nullified, but the abilities endemic to them are greatly enhanced. These abilities will come to you more naturally than many of the original donors, but also allow you to develop new and associated abilities with a little training and a bit of creativity.
addons.title: To Go Even Further Beyond!

addons.text:
Much like you, your Omnitrix now embodies every conceivable version of itself, granting it a vast range of abilities.

The first of these abilities is the power to modify the Omnitrix at will. You can change its design, appearance, state, and even add new functions. Initially, you can only add one function at a time, such as enabling Ultimate Forms, removing glitches, and so on. However, purchasing Additional Function will increase your ability to add more functions.

The second ability extends to your alien forms. You can alter their abilities, swap out powers, and equip them with new gear. For example, you could enhance a Galvan’s strength to match that of a Kryptonian, grant a Pyronite cryokinesis without making them sick, or bestow an alien with their ultimate form’s abilities. The extent of these changes will depend on both your power and the form in question.

The third ability is the Omnitrix's capacity to download and copy the DNA database from alternate versions of the Omnitrix from other universes. This will allow you to access new and unique forms from other universes. These forms will never pose a threat to you or the Omnitrix, though the power of these forms will depend on your current power, the strength of the aliens within your Omnitrix, and your Omnitrix's capacity to acquire and store these new DNA.
addons.title: Across the Omni-verse!

addons.text:
Easy access to the DNA found within the Omnitrix has allowed you to craft bespoke forms from the samples within.

Using your Osmosian ability to absorb DNA, you can essentially use yourself as a makeshift laboratory, creating fusion and amalgam forms using any previously seen sample from the Omnitrix.

These fusions naturally will have benefits and determinants depending on what’s being fused. Similarly, you can use up to ten samples at a time, but the more samples you fuse, the less stable the transformation will become, potentially rendering you chimeric and subject to a familiar Osmosian ‘overload’. The fewer samples used in a fusion, the easier it is to purge from your system, returning to your base form.
addons.title: Fusion Lab

addons.text:
By combining your alternate forms with the myriad of aliens in the Omnitrix, you can adjust them into more specialized niches. 

For instance, you could change the exact properties of an Arachnachimp’s webs, or you could increase the amount of methane you produce as a Methanosian, vastly increasing your firepower at the cost of regenerating more slowly from harm due to the increased complexity of the secretion glands.

This only grows more potent with access to Ultimate forms, as subjecting an already altered and specialized form to the Ultimatrix process has the potential to take the final transformation into a vastly different direction than its common ‘ancestor’.
addons.title: Divergent Evolution

addons.text:
Upon coming into contact with the Omega-1 Nanites, the Omnitrix absorbed into the Nanites, or perhaps it is the other way around; as a result, your Omega-1 Nanites have gained the powers of the Omnitrix, enhancing the abilities of the already powerful Omnitrix, or the Omnitrix has gained the functionality of the Omega-1 Nanites. 

The Omega-1 Nanites are constantly enhancing the Omnitrix, increasing functionalities and unlocking new features. Perhaps it could create new modes for the Omnitrix, such as a fusion or an ultimate function, if you don't possess those features given enough time. 

Initially, even without upgrading anything within the Omnitrix, all of your aliens now possess the Omega-1 Nanites, upgrading them to be beyond the peak functionality of the species. This is more apparent for species that are mechanical in nature, such as Clockwork, Nanomech, Atomix, Waterhazard, Upgrade and any other mechanical alien. An example of this would be Clockwork being equal in power to the time Ben 10 and Ben 23 fused Clockwork and Upgrade to battle Maltruant. Even non-mechanical aliens receive a similar boost from this fusion.

Using the Omega-1 Nanite and the Omnitrix combined, you could even permanently transform others into aliens from the Omnitrix.
addons.title: Omni-Nanites

addons.text:
Your Omnitrix has assimilated the DNA and genetic material of every sentient lifeform residing in the Mass Effect universe. This includes a diverse array of species, such as the Turians, Asari, Krogan, Salarians, Leviathans, Protheans and every other sentient and sapient lifeforms that the Reapers have culled in every cycle. 

With this vast repository of DNA, you could undo the damage that was done to the galaxy should you ever go back to the Mass Effect universe, fulfilling the true purpose of the Omnitrix as being a veritable Noah's ark of every alien species in case of disastrous world-ending threats to repopulate aliens who have been wiped out.

As with the aliens in the Omnitrix, this comes with the basic feel of how to use the abilities of the various aliens that now reside in the Omnitrix and transforms you into the peak of said species. It also now has the various languages of the Mass Effect universe installed.
addons.title: Catalyst of Change

addons.text:
The Omnitrix has successfully assimilated the DNA and genetic material of every sentient lifeform residing in the vast Star Trek universe. From all quadrants of space, the Alpha quadrant, Beta quadrant, Gamma quadrant, and Delta quadrant. This includes, but is not limited to, species such as the Vulcans, Klingons, Cardassians, Betazoids, Ocampa, and many other species from the Star Trek universe.  

With this vast repository of DNA, you could undo any damage that has been done to the galaxy, repopulating the various species that have been wiped out by the Borg or through other natural means, fulfilling the true purpose of the Omnitrix as being a veritable Noah's ark of every alien species in case of disastrous world-ending threats to repopulate aliens who have been culled.

As with the aliens in the Omnitrix, this comes with the basic feel of how to use the abilities of the various aliens that now reside in the Omnitrix and transforms you into the peak of said species. It also now has the various languages of the Star Trek universe installed.
addons.title: To Boldly Go

addons.text:
The Omnitrix has successfully assimilated the DNA and genetic material of every sentient lifeform residing in the vast Power Rangers multiverse, from the galaxy-defending Eltarians, the humanoid canine Sirians, the highly evolved aquatic Aquitians, the intelligent and gentle Edonities, and many more.

With this vast repository of DNA, you could undo any damage that has been done to the galaxy, repopulating the various species that have been wiped out by the forces of Evil, such as Lord Zed, The Machine Emperor, the Troobian Empire, and the Grand Monarch of Evil Dark Specter, to name a few; or through other natural means, fulfilling the true purpose of the Omnitrix as being a veritable Noah's Ark of every alien species in case of disastrous, world-ending threats to repopulate aliens who have been culled.

As is standard with the Omnitrix, it can transform you into the peak of these species, with a general feel for how to use their abilities right away, but due to a special resonance, a greater change has occurred.

Your Morpher and Omnitrix have melded together due to this resonance, gaining the benefits of both and empowering one another, along with transforming the device to hide it from all forms of detection. When you transform into an alien, they will be pushed beyond their species' peak to their respective superhuman levels, gaining greater power and skill using their abilities. Morphing into a Power Ranger while already an alien will double your power, but it can be tiring the first few times you do it.

Should you transform into your Ranger Form, you can call upon the DNA in the Omnitrix to summon armour based on the aliens to draw upon, allowing you to mix and match their specialized powers without their weaknesses. You can even channel the power of your alien transformations through the Morphin Grid energy to enhance your equipment, such as weapons and Zords, with alien-based upgrades.

Should you have the Omni-Naut, or any other armoured functions, they will be greatly upgraded from before, becoming akin to the Battleizers of Power Rangers at the minimum.
addons.title: Morphin Hero

addons.text:
"Well, this is… different"

Through your nature as an Alicorn, the Omnitrix has successfully assimilated the DNA and genetic material of every sentient lifeform from all media of My Little Pony, regardless of generations, from the Pony Tribes and their branches, such as Batponies and Umbrum, to Changelings, to Dragons, magical Goats, Centaurs, Griffons, Diamond Dogs, and more, including a Draconequus form.

With this, you can undo any damage done to them, repopulating the species or curing them from whatever ill fate has befallen them, whether it be through natural causes or magic, such as curses and sealing magic, fulfilling the true purpose of the Omnitrix as an Ark for countless species.

You can transform into the peak of the respected species and have a basic grasp on how to use their abilities with instinctual knowledge for various spells that can grow with time, research, and use.

Now, though, there is the matter of your Alicorn power and the Omnitrix, with there being one of two options you can take:

1.) You can have your Alicorn form be your default, meaning you're an Alicorn with an Omnitrix, but as a result, you do not gain additional benefits.

2.) You have your Alicorn form as a transformation within the Omnitrix, and it benefits from being the peak of its species with the potential to far surpass any Alicorn seen in the series, regardless of continuity, massively empowering it, with the restriction that you have to transform into it. Though that doesn't mean you completely lose the power in your default form; if you were human, you would be stronger (Earth Pony), more agile (Pegasus), and quicker to learn (Unicorn) than you were before, while remaining around human limits, with your Cutie Mark enhancement remaining, even though it's gone.

Whichever path you choose, you find yourself having an easier time making friends with other species and being more adaptive to their culture and ideals, and they with yours, bridging gaps that would slow down developing friendships.

Finally, you gain a sixth sense for when there's a friendship problem you can help with or when children are in danger. During these incidents, you become stronger, wiser, and more ferocious in resolving matters when the need arises.

Note: For any power interactions, Alicorns, at minimum, can count Earth Ponies, Pegasi, and Unicorns as part of their species, with other Ponies allowed per the writer's wishes.
addons.title: GALACTIC FRIENDSHIP!

addons.text:
The Omnitrix already contained records of normal Human DNA; when it attached to you, it began to study it and reverse engineered the process that led to the evolutionary leap that could be applied to other species to give them their own genetic Uplift.

The Genetic Uplift for your Transformation will enhance the abilities of your aliens and give them new abilities, like a Pyronite (Heatblast) being able to absorb ambient heat to the point of freezing things, or a Galvan (Grey Matter) developing psychic abilities, and giving them access to your Tier 0 powers and any power connected to your original body, with them being treated as addons that can have different synergies depending on the alien and powers.

With this new information, the DNA Repair Function has gained a new feature, allowing it to grant others Type: Humanity and Platinum Genes, either at full strength or through a partial uplift, with this process being applied to all beings scanned by the Omnitrix.
addons.title: Type: Alien Uplift

addons.text:
Thanks to the technology in the Escafl Device, your Omnitrix can now safely transform you into any living creature, regardless of its sapience.

Additionally, your Genetic Database not only contains the genetic information of Earth-based species but also includes biosphere data for the homeworlds of every alien in the original Omnitrix. At first, your access to these transformations will be limited to what could be described as “sub-playlists” for each of your sapient alien transformations that consist of ten organisms from that species biosphere. These will range in usefulness but will always be selected to complement each other and your main playlist. Once you unlock Master Control, you can freely select from the database, though the Omnitrix’s AI will give suggestions to help sort through the nigh-endless array of options.

Finally, your morphing is no longer subject to a 2-hour limit.
addons.title: Omni-Ark
Parasite Civilization
addons.text:
The Parasites have evolved as they are known to do, thanks to the device you wear in the Omnitrix that has been bonded to you on the genetic level. They have advanced way past where they would ordinarily be from a regular Renaissance period, as they have viewed the Omnitrix, and in doing so, it has kicked off a Renaissance to end all Renaissances in their society, with them evolving at a much faster pace to match the level of technology they have viewed in the Omnitrix.

The parasites have also managed to mix themselves with the various genetic samples in the Omnitrix to give themselves powers and further help in enhancing your body, like how some of them will mix themselves with Galvanic genes to make themselves smarter and build better things inside your body and so on, becoming a hyper-advanced civilisation far faster than they ordinarily would have.

Something that would also be affected is that any time you transform via the Omnitrix, the Parasites will adapt to being in your new form, getting bigger or smaller inside your body depending on the form you take. Their society will also transfer into your new alien body, also enhancing it just as they would your regular body. As the Omnitrix already transforms you into the apex of the relevant species, this would let you go even further beyond that and reach pinnacles that surpass the apex of the species.

addons.title: Sparks
addons.text:
As your Anodite heritage, the ‘spark’, is only tangentially related to genetics, it has been inherited by all your forms.

No matter your alien form, you can use magic and access your Anodite form as you please. While this does not confer any immediate new abilities, it does allow you to weave magic effects into any abilities, such as booking the water created by a Bivalvan, or taking advantage of a Galvan’s enhanced intelligence to create masterwork spells.

The only limit to these combinations would be your own creativity and the aliens you have unlocked.

objects.text:
You’ve been given possession of an Omnitrix. The Omnitrix is a device designed to transform the user into various alien forms. These vary in form and adaptation wildly depending on where the species evolved, but all the species inside the Codon Stream from which the Omni-matrix draws its DNA are, at the very least, sentient, even if they can impact the host’s thinking in the moment.

The Omnitrix is fitted with various systems to facilitate these transformations. It’s virtually indestructible except through its own self-destruct, it has a scan function to acquire non-recognised DNA, and can store multiple profiles for subspecies as necessary. The regular Omnitrix contains 1,000,905 ‘genetic samples’ (though the phrase is misleading, as it will accept the closest substitute depending on the species, as many do not have genes), with ample room for more acquired via scan.

Naturally, you’ve also been given an understanding of how to operate the Omnitrix to the fullest extent of its capabilities. Additionally, you may choose to gain any kind of Omnitrix rather than the final version (Ultimatrix, Biomatrix, or even the Nemetrix)

(The Entities and Endbringers lack DNA; the Omnitrix cannot transform you into them.)
objects.title: Omnitrix (Ben 10)

objects.text: You have the Berserker Armor. It grants you highly increased strength at the cost of a berserker rage and the armor damages you the more you use it (as it pushes your body past its physical limits). The armor molds itself to suit you. It had a skull helmet when wielded by Skull Knight, and a wolf helmet when wielded by Guts for example.
objects.title: Berserker Armor (Berserk)

objects.text:
You possess a suit of armor forged from authentic Megastructure-grade material—the same impossible substance that forms the super-dense strata of the City and the Outer Frame. It is not metal, not ceramic, and not nanotech as mortals understand them; its physical properties simply exceed the limits of conventional matter.

The armor is functionally indestructible to any normal force. Anti-stuff firearms, Nukes, plasma, cutting tools, or industrial lasers cannot mar it. Even catastrophic impacts—orbital kinetic strikes, collapsing planetoids, high-yield anti-matter warheads—are absorbed without so much as a scratch. Only Graviton-class weapons (such as the Gravitational Beam Emitter or Graviton Blades) can meaningfully damage it.

Despite its mass and strength, the armor moves as lightly as clothing. It perfectly mirrors your motions, does not limit flexibility, and does not fatigue the wearer. Temperature extremes, radiation, toxins, and corrosives are rendered irrelevant within it.

The suit is seamless and fully sealed, automatically regulating oxygen, pressure, and bodily needs, allowing survival in vacuum, underwater, or harsh planetary environments indefinitely. Its inner layer adapts to your physiology, reshaping itself for comfort and integration.

While it does not grant weapons by default, it can anchor and stabilize extreme firepower, allowing safe use of high-recoil or experimental weaponry. The suit slowly self-repairs any harm inflicted by Graviton attacks, though this may take days or weeks depending on severity.

In appearance, the armor resembles the stark, angular aesthetics of Megastructure constructs—sleek, minimalistic, and unsettlingly alien. It can compress into a compact slab of material when not worn, unfolding around you in seconds when forced against the skin.
objects.title: Mega-Structure Armor (Blame! / Aposimz)

objects.text:
The Planeteer Rings are five magical rings created to safeguard the Earth from all threats, whether they be environmental disasters or those who would exploit the planet for personal gain. Gifted by Gaia to five chosen champions, each ring grants control over an elemental force of nature: Earth, Fire, Wind, Water, and Heart. The rings allow their wearers to manipulate their respective element to a limited degree. The Fire ring can instantly ignite surfaces or project streams of flame like a living flamethrower, while the Wind ring can summon powerful gusts, generate whirlwinds, or even lift the user and others into the air.

When the powers of all five rings are united, they can summon the superhero Captain Planet, a powerful champion of nature. This process requires all five rings to be present and their powers intentionally channeled together. Once Captain Planet is summoned, the rings temporarily lose their abilities, remaining inert until he returns their power and departs. In this form, the collective strength of the rings manifests as a single being whose capabilities far surpass those of any individual Planeteer.

Captain Planet wields the magnified power of all five elements, granting him dominion over earth, fire, wind, water, and heart. He can manipulate these forces freely, transform his body into elemental forms, withstand extreme temperatures, and survive in all natural environments. His superhuman strength allows him to lift virtually any weight, while his durability makes him extremely resistant to both physical and energy-based attacks. He can fly by riding the currents of the wind and does not appear to require food, water, or other basic necessities to survive.

Captain Planet also possesses a wide array of abilities tied to nature and the environment. He can control plant life, influence the weather, and manipulate electricity and electromagnetic forces. He senses ecological imbalances nearby, absorbs solar energy to heal or empower himself, and fires energy blasts from his hands. He can also travel instantly by transforming into light, communicate telepathically across vast distances, and empathize with animals. His deep understanding of ecology allows him to recognize the impact of human actions on the natural world. The emblem on his chest serves as a life meter, shrinking as he sustains damage and restoring as he recovers.

However, both the rings and Captain Planet share a critical weakness. Exposure to heavy pollution or environmental corruption weakens the rings' powers, sometimes to the point of rendering them completely ineffective. Captain Planet’s abilities are affected in the same way, diminishing or vanishing entirely.

By selecting this choice you receive all of the Planeteer Rings. You may choose to wear all of them yourself or grant some of them to others. Unlike the original rings, you will not be prevented from wielding their power due to a polluted mind.
objects.title: Planeteer Rings (Captain Planet and the Planeteers)

objects.text:
The Blue Crown, an artifact of formidable power, bestows upon its wearer divine dominion over pestilence and sickness. It is a symbol of authority over the realm of disease, evoking associations with toxicity and corruption. With its deep blue hue, the crown represents the malevolent effects of pestilence, reflecting the influence of its wearer.

Radiating an aura of ominous energy, the Blue Crown binds to its chosen owner, empowering them with unparalleled control over afflictions and ailments. As the crown adorns their head, it grants them the ability to command and manipulate the forces of sickness. Noxious tendrils of power entwine with their divine dominion, enabling them to unleash devastating plagues and diseases upon their adversaries.

Once the Blue Crown bonds with its wearer, they become the vessel of divine authority. With the crown upon their brow, they gain the ability to manipulate and command the forces of pestilence and sickness. The wearer can invoke plagues, disease, and ailments at their will, spreading them with an almost supernatural precision. The crown heightens their senses, granting an innate understanding of the subtlest nuances of illness, allowing them to detect and identify diseases with ease.

The Blue Crown can manifest a staff, a sword, a dagger, and a globus cruciger, turning the wearer into a formidable force to be reckoned with. Each weapon strike release waves of pestilence and affliction upon those who dare to oppose them.

When harnessed to its full potential, the Blue Crown unleashes the wearer's true Divine form, a writhing mass of tendrils and tentacles that covers the body, granting an otherworldly appearance. Two pairs of arms manifest, each holding a different weapon, symbolizing the dominion over sickness and the ability to wield both destruction and salvation within it's dominion, an Eldritch God that embodies Pestilence and Sickness.
objects.title: The Blue Crown - To Hear No Evil (Cult Of The Lamb)

objects.text:
The Green Crown, a mystical artifact of immense power, embodies the divine dominion over Nature and the essence of Chaos. It is a symbol of authority, granting its wearer unparalleled control and influence over the realm of flora, fauna, and the chaotic unpredictability within nature.

When adorned, the Green Crown establishes a bond with its owner, awakening their inherent connection to the natural world, and granting an innate sixth sense over probability, allowing for prediction of the near future, and mastery over all things related to nature.

Unlike the Red Crowns, the Green Crown can not transform into weapons or tools to aid its wearer. Instead, it bestows an abundance of power, with the Green Crown, one can command the very forces that shape the wilderness and harness the chaotic energies that dwell within Nature.

When harnessed to its full potential, the Green Crown unleashes the wearer's true Divine form, an enormous, tree-like worm, its head adorned with gnarled, thick branches resembling horns. Its massive maw, lined with rows of razor-sharp teeth, exudes a drooling ichor that hints at its otherworldly power. Four bulging black-and-red eyes protrude from the sides, witnessing all that transpires within it's dominion, an Eldritch God that embodies raw Chaos and untamed Nature.
objects.title: The Green Crown - To See No Evil (Cult Of The Lamb)

objects.text:
The Purple Crown, a formidable artifact of divine power, bestows upon its bearer absolute dominion over war and conquest. It embodies authority over the realm of conflict, symbolizing supremacy, strategic wisdom, and the unyielding spirit of battle. With its regal purple hue, the crown exudes an air of mystery and reverence, reflecting the potent influence it grants to its wearer.

As the Purple Crown bonds with its chosen owner, it forges a divine connection, empowering them with unparalleled control over the art of war. Resting upon their brow, the crown enhances their abilities and grants them the strength to command and manipulate the forces of conquest. It merges seamlessly with their being, almost becoming one with their essence.

With the Purple Crown adorning their head, the wearer becomes a vessel of divine authority, exuding an aura of invincibility and strategic brilliance. Their every move is guided by the crown's wisdom, granting them unparalleled tactical insight and an instinctive understanding of warfare. The wearer can rally armies, inspire unwavering loyalty, and shape the course of battles with their mere presence.

Though the Purple Crown does not transform into weapons or tools, its power surges through the bearer's being, infusing them with martial prowess. Their every strike carries the weight of divine dominion, delivering devastating blows and overwhelming their foes with ease. The crown magnifies their presence on the battlefield, imbuing them with an irresistible aura of command.

When fully harnessed, the Purple Crown unveils the wearer's trues divine form—a towering demonic spider with two pairs of cross-like horns protruding from their head. Their body emanates an aura of tyrannical conquest that blends the cruelty of war with elegance and strength, a tyrannical lord over it's dominion, an Eldritch God that embodies War and Conquest.
objects.title: The Purple Crown - To Think No Evil (Cult Of The Lamb)

addons.text:
Having acquired the Green Crown, Yellow Crown, Blue Crown, and Purple Crown, the Red Crown has assimilated the domains and divine authorities of all four crowns. Transforming you into a God King, you now stand at the helm of a new pantheon of deities that will form under your guidance. Through this ascension, you possess the power to bestow fragments of your divine essence upon others, elevating them to become new gods who will forever remain loyal to your cause.

As the God King, your authority reaches unprecedented heights. The Red Crown's abilities have been greatly enhanced, particularly its power to convert faith. Now, the conversion of faith yields not only miracles but Divine Authorities—profound manifestations of divine power that far surpass the previous miracles in magnitude and potency. With each act of faith bestowed upon you, you have the ability to shape reality, influence destiny, and bend the fabric of existence itself.

Furthermore, the previous abilities of the Red Crown have been amplified to new levels of mastery. Your immortality is inviolable, ensuring your resurrection even in the face of the most formidable challenges. The crown's transformative capabilities grant you an arsenal of weapons that can shape-shift into even more devastating forms. The captivating charisma you possess becomes unmatched, compelling even your enemies and adversaries to become followers of your cause and bending dissenters to your will.
addons.title: From The Ruins, A New Heaven Shall Form!

addons.text:
To the worms within you, their entire existence revolves around you and your body, which they live inside of, so it is only natural that they would worship you. The Worm civilization within you now functions as a perfect ever-replenishing cult for you to gain Faith from, allowing you to gain vast amounts of power not only easier than with a normal cult but also constantly.

You gain the ability to speak with the worms within you as their God. Allowing you to manage and coordinate the Worms' efforts and faith in any way you could want or need.

With this combination, you will rise to the same level of power as The One Who Waits and beyond at an extraordinary speed.
addons.title: Cult of the Worm

objects.text:
The Red Crown, a divine artifact of immense power, binds itself to its chosen bearer, bestowing upon them unparalleled dominion over death and the afterlife.

As the Red Crown adorns its wearer, Immortality becomes their gift, ensuring their resurrection if ever faced with demise.

In the hands of its owner, the Red Crown can manifests as a formidable array of weaponry and tools. Transforming into swords, daggers, gauntlets, axes, and hammers, it empowers the wearer with exceptional combat prowess, allowing them to vanquish even the most formidable adversaries.

With the Red Crown's blessings, the wearer gains heightened health and resilience, provided by The One Who Waits. Though not invincible, they possess the unwavering determination to overcome challenges.

While adorned with the Red Crown, the wearer possesses an enigmatic charisma that captivates others, drawing countless followers to their cause. Their persuasive influence allows them to sway hearts and change the minds of dissenters, wielding their divine authority to guide others towards their vision.

In addition, the Red Crown possesses a unique power—the ability to convert the faith of their followers into miracles. Miracles can manifest as profound knowledge of crafting techniques, unveiling the secrets of creating new and wondrous artifacts. It can inspire the revelation of innovative battle tactics and strategies, granting the bearer new powers and techniques to overcome challenges. Miracles may also materialize as the physical manifestation of the bearer's divine mandate, bolstering their abilities and influence. The crown's miracles even extend to the creation of entirely new afterlife realms, shaping the destiny of souls beyond death's embrace. The scope of these miracles knows no bounds, limited only by the strength of the faith gathered.
objects.title: The Red Crown - To Do No Evil (Cult Of The Lamb)

objects.text:
The Yellow Crown, a powerful artifact of divine dominion, binds itself to its owner, granting unparalleled control over famine and the withering of life. Symbolizing the decay and scarcity that befall the land, It represents the influence of famine and scarcity, bringing forth a sense of danger and contamination.

This enigmatic crown possesses an immense wellspring of power, though its sentience remains ambiguous. With the Yellow Crown, the wearer gains the ability to speak all languages, even when afflicted by severe injuries or impediments. It compensates for any physical limitations, enabling eloquence and communication.

The Yellow Crown bestows dominion over the realm of famine and the decay of life. With its divine influence, it wields control over the very essence of scarcity, allowing its wearer to manipulate the ebb and flow of resources, bringing forth famine or prosperity at their command. The Yellow Crown's powers grant the ability to induce withering and decay, both in flora and the vitality of creatures, bringing forth the dire consequences of scarcity. It instills a profound sense of control over life's sustenance and the balance of nature.

When harnessed to its full potential, the Yellow Crown unleashes the wearer's true Divine form, a colossal, demonic frog-like creature, its backed adorned with markings reminiscent of eyes and crosses burst through the skin. Its massive cross-shaped slit mouth, lined with rows of razor-sharp teeth, exudes a drooling ichor that hints at its otherworldly power. Six bulging black-and-red eyes gaze with unwavering clarity, witnessing all that transpires within it's dominion, an Eldritch God that embodies Famine and the withering of life.
objects.title: The Yellow Crown - To Speak No Evil (Cult Of The Lamb)

objects.text: You can pick any equipment from the Dark Souls trilogy. Each chosen item has the capacity for self-repair, while eliminating the need for extensive polishing or meticulous maintenance to sustain the gear's optimal functionality. You can confidently rely on these artifacts to withstand the rigors of battle and remain in peak condition.
objects.title: Fashion Souls (Dark Souls)

objects.text:
A ring made from the orange eye of a calamitous dragon. This ring was once merely a symbol of dragon worship, merely passed down to its mnost fervent adherents, convinced that it is a blessing instead of a curse. Now though, it has been repurposed.

The ring intensifies the damage you receive twice over from every source. Be it from a stab, magic, miracles, your body is simply more vulnerable while this ring is worn.

But by willing the ring to close it's eye, you can reverse the effect so that you only take half the normal damage, and do double damage. This lasts for as long as the eye remained open while the ring was worn. So if you wore it for an hour, you will only benefit from this state for an hour. The duration is completely reset though once the ring is removed.
objects.title: Calamity Ring (Dark Souls III)

objects.text:
Ring associated with Gwynevere, princess of sunlight and eldest daughter of Gwyn, the First Lord.

The ring is vaguely warm, like a beam of sunlight to a needy plant, and gradually restores the wearer's body by 0.1% every 10 seconds.
objects.title: Sun Princess Ring (Dark Souls III)

objects.text:
You now possess the Equipment used by those chosen to be the Wonder Woman of Themyscira.
This gives you;

The Bracelets of Submission- Two magical bracelets made from 8th Metal that can deflect just about anything with only the highest levels of Force able to break them

Wonder Woman's Tiara- a Tiara made of 8th Metal that is sharp enough to cut a Kryptonian easily, and returns to your hand when thrown.

Magical Sword and Shield - A sword forged by Hephaestus, said to be sharp enough to cut the electrons off an atom and a shield made to protect from the greatest attacks.

Lasso of Truth - called the Golden Perfect, and Forged from the Golden Girdle of Gaea, The lasso is completely unbreakable, immutable, and indestructible. It also capable of altering in length, based on the wielder's needs. 

Among its powers are the ability to restore lost memories, cast hypnosis, dispel illusions, and protect those held within its circumference from magical attacks. 

Those who have been altered in a unnatural metaphysical or physical manner are forced to undergo a biophysical reset when ensnared by the lariat, making the enhanced revert back to their base self. 

This can relieve an individual from the effects of toxins or poisons, as well as cease the effects of mind control. Empowered by the Fires of Hestia, the lasso forces anyone held by it to tell and understand the absolute truth. 

(Beware this can be very dangerous, as not everyone is capable of facing the truth of their actions stripped bare of excuses, and this has lead a few individuals to suicide from facing the pure TRUTH of themselves.)
objects.title: Equipment of The Wonder Woman (DC Comics)

addons.title: The Fury of Firestorm (DC Comics)
addons.text:
Rather than a physical object, you now have access to the true Firestorm Matrix, an active force connected to the elemental plane The Shine. While it still must be wielded with another to prevent instability, it’s far more powerful.

The strength and stability of the Matrix as a result have been drastically improved, turning you into a form of ‘Shine Elemental’ letting you wield the Shine with unparalleled ease using the Matrix as a stabilising element.

With this connection you can turn towns to glass and lead and back again, increase the density of a bird until they plummet from the sky like they were made of osmium, to creating exotic materials and energies from thin air. 

You could even condense the raw Shine into physical form, a cocoon of crystal energy to act as a true conduit of its might on par with its avatar, if only for a time.

Be advised that while you might be able to wield the matrix alone for a time, it is a sapient entity in its own right, one that doesn’t understand humanity and comes from a realm of nuclear fire. Be cautious.

addons.title: High Load Compensation
addons.text: Having multiple minds of sorts already, you’ve been inoculated from the strain that comes from utilising the Matrix with a single body. This allows you to maintain the Firestorm form far longer than would otherwise be safe, allowing this connection to bear the strain as another mind would.

objects.text:
The Firestorm Matrix a volatile, quantum-forged artifact that serves as the foundation for one of the most dangerous transformations in the multiverse. When activated, the Matrix merges two individuals into a single nuclear-powered entity: Firestorm. One becomes the physical host, the other a disembodied intellect sharing the mindspace, able to advise, argue, or even guide the fused being’s actions.

While fused, the resulting Firestorm gains vast superhuman strength, durability, flight, energy projection, and—most notably—the ability to transmute matter at the subatomic level. Wood into steel, rubble into oxygen, uranium into smoke—the Matrix obeys imagination, intellect, and will. Scientific understanding enhances precision, but raw instinct can still yield terrifying results.

The fusion is normally stable when two compatible individuals form the bond. However, the Matrix can be used by a single person—forcefully initiating a self-contained fusion. Doing so grants full access to Firestorm’s power, but at a steep cost: immense physical and mental strain. Without a second consciousness to balance the Matrix, prolonged use risks cognitive overload, nuclear feedback, or outright molecular destabilization. Most cannot hold the form for long without consequence.

The Matrix is bound to you now. You choose who joins you. Or you bear the burden alone—and become a walking singularity with a ticking clock in your chest.
objects.title: Firestorm Matrix (DC Comics: CW Flash)

objects.text:
You’ve acquired the Helmet of Fate, A premiere magical repository created by the Lord of Order Nabu to contain his essence, The Amulet of Anubis, and the Cloak of Destiny, which are woven with all sorts of anti-magical protections.

The Helmet itself bestows a number of abilities, acting as a wellspring of intense magical energy, capable of channeling directly from the realm the Lords of Order call home. To this extent, it allows the user to shape and command magical energy in ways that would leave all but the most adept of mortal sorcerers baffled, creating constructs, enchantments and mystical effects beyond the pale of most. Such is its command that it can even weave other esoteric sources of power through it, though this requires skill and focus. Similarly, this Maelstrom of power gives the user resistance from most Magical effects, and outright guards them from probability manipulations and precognitive effects.

It also naturally gives the wearer great magical sight and awareness, allowing them to see all magical effects, sympathetic links, and spiritual movements within the area, and what caused them. 

Finally, the Helmet’s most unique effect is the spirit residing inside it that grants it its connection. Depending on the spirit in question (and their attitudes), this can have differing effects on the Helmet. The most well known, Nabu, heightened it’s imaginative casting, making it far easier to use for the inexperienced but talented and creative who often found themselves his hosts. Whereas Thoth and Hauhet both provided great elementalism and heightened awareness respectively. 

It is worth noting of the Helmet that while its inhabitants will likely be co-operative, they have their own personalities, goals and motives to consider. Nabu specifically has been known to attempt to rend control from his hosts in extreme situations.
objects.title: Helmet of Fate (DC Comics)

objects.text: You have gained a Lantern Ring of your own, this ring acts as a conduit of the Emotional Spectrum. Each color ring draws on a different emotion to power the functions of the ring. Anything can be done with a Lantern Ring so long as the user has enough power and imagination. This ring comes with a Universal Translator that will allow you to communicate with anything you come across and Faster-Than-Light travel that is necessary for ring-bearers that need to cross entire solar systems in a mere moment. You have a Subspace Pocket that will only grow in size as you funnel more power into it, as well as an AI that will assist its bearer. The Lantern Ring is also outfitted with a database that has all the knowledge of Oa that the AI can draw from in order to make informed decisions and help its wielder. The AI starts as clinically inhuman in personality, although the longer you talk to it and the more data it observes, the more human it becomes. The AI can speak to your mind telepathically or verbally. This comes with both the Lantern Ring and an infinite Power Battery. Red, the Emotional Spectrum’s representation of Rage. Upon receiving a Red Lantern Ring, the bearer will have their heart replaced by the very ring they wear. Their blood spoils and the ring expels it from the bearer's mouth in a vomit of violent rage. A Red Lantern's veins stretch as they fill with the liquid fire of the red light. Red Lanterns have the special capacity to vomit a plasma, made of a vicious mixture of napalm and acid. These flames burn away everything, continuing to burn even in space. Orange, the Emotional Spectrum’s representation of Avarice. Orange Lanterns can hold a charge far greater than the normal ‘100%’ with the most achieved by Larfleeze himself being 100,000% percent energy. Orange Lanterns can wield more than one Orange Ring, as they often kill other Orange Lanterns and take their rings. Orange Lantern Rings have the innate capacity to absorb other Rings, shifting them into Orange Rings. Additionally, Orange Ring Bearers are also able to absorb people, turning them into constructs dependent on the bearer’s avarice. Yellow, the Emotional Spectrum’s representation of Fear. Constructs of Yellow Rings gain increased strength by feeding on the fear of their victims. Yellow Rings are capable of charging the powers of a Kryptonian or Daxamite. These Lantern Rings can recharge themselves by feeding off of ambient fear, even without a Yellow Lantern. Green, the Emotional Spectrum’s representation of Will. All constructs created by a Green Lantern can be reinforced to an extraordinary degree. With enough Willpower anything is possible, with Green Lantern Rings free to generate artificial Kryptonite energy to harm Kryptonians. Blue, the Emotional Spectrum’s representation of Hope. Blue Lanterns have healing capabilities beyond all other Lantern Rings. Blue Rings shine when supporting Green Lanterns, as they are able to supercharge Green Lanterns past 100% energy. Blue Rings can be entirely supported by the Hope of nearby entities, allowing for even the reversal of a dying star's age at no energy cost. Indigo, the Emotional Spectrum’s representation of Compassion. Indigo Lantern Staffs are capable of emulating other energies of the Emotional Spectrum when nearby. Indigo Lanterns cannot create constructs using Compassion and instead rely on other rings. Violet, the Emotional Spectrum’s representation of Love. Violet Lantern Rings are able to Crystallize their victims and keep them under a form of suspended animation. Violets can detect when eternal love is put at risk, allowing the Violet Bearers to track the lovers across the universe in order to keep the love alive. Violet Rings are immune to the Orange Light of Avarice. Black, the Emotional Spectrum's representation of Nothingness, a void of emotion and, as a consequence, Death. The bearer is rendered dead in all meaningful ways, with their soul stored within the ring. Black Lanterns can see the primary emotions within an individual, and recharge their rings by prompting them into a high emotional state before eating their heart. As Black Lanterns are deceased, their rings tend to consider returning them to health non-critical. As it is devoid of the Emotional Spectrum, a user must be cold, logical, and unclouded by it to use it at its maximum potential.
objects.title: Lantern Ring (DC Comics)

objects.text:
Composed of Valorum, the Legion Flight Rings acts as both a badge of office for the 31st century organisation the Legion of Superheroes, but also confers a single ability on every Legionnaire, Flight.

The ring’s flight is usually locked just above supersonic in an atmosphere, however when leaving an atmosphere it automatically engages a form of life support, and disengages this lock as soon as it is a safe distance from planetary defences. After this, the ring engages a kind of ‘space flight’ mode, acting as a kind of personal interstellar transportation.
objects.title: Legion Flight Ring (DC Comics)

addons.title: A Cold Shoulder to Lean On
addons.text:
Your cryogenic suit has been upgraded with Cold Gun technology, integrating its principles of extreme thermal manipulation into the suit's cryogenic systems.

Thanks to this improvement, the Freeze Gun and the rest of the suit's cryogenic weaponry are now capable of reaching temperatures close to absolute zero, matching the performance of the technology developed by Leonard Snart, which, in turn, allows the vapors released by the suit's cryo-vapor system to generate a Cold Field around you.

Keep in mind that the presence of this field causes the moisture in the environment to freeze and snow to begin forming around you, meaning you could gradually alter the climate conditions of an area if you maintain this field for an extended period while remaining there, eventually creating snowstorms capable of covering large areas with ice and snow.

Finally, the suit also enhances its cryogenic protection systems, granting you complete immunity to extreme temperatures, freezing, and effects that attempt to halt the molecular movement of your body—including abilities capable of freezing targets at an atomic level or affecting the speed of their particles—as the suit keeps your atoms protected through its advanced thermal regulation systems.

Note: The USB drive now contains, in addition to the blueprints for Mr. Freeze's suit, the designs and technological principles behind the Cold Gun, providing you with the knowledge necessary to maintain, repair, and even develop new improvements for both the Freeze Gun and any part of the cryogenic suit that incorporates this technology.

objects.text:
You receive Mr. Freeze's cryo-suit or, more specifically, an enhanced version of the one designed by Victor Fries.

Built as both a life-support system and a powered armor suit, the suit is heavily armored, resistant to extreme heat, and equipped with thermal detectors, environmental scanners, and a reinforced exoskeleton that approximately triples your base physical strength while worn, while also being a completely self-sufficient system that allows you to operate without difficulty in environments ranging from arctic wastelands to industrial facilities exposed to extreme temperatures.

The suit's cryogenic life-support system temporarily alters your physiology while active, lowering your body temperature to the sub-zero levels required for the system to function. While wearing the suit, you become completely immune to cold and cryogenic hazards; your metabolism slows down drastically, greatly delaying your aging process, while your body develops exceptional resistance against most toxins, bacteria, viruses, and diseases.

These changes depend entirely on the suit's life-support system, meaning that once you remove it, your body temperature will gradually return to normal over the course of approximately one hour, after which your metabolism, aging process, and biological vulnerabilities will return to their usual state without any permanent side effects.

The suit also incorporates a wide arsenal of cryogenic technology developed by Victor Fries, including:

- Freeze Gun: a cryo-cannon capable of projecting powerful streams of cryogenic coolant cold enough to instantly freeze almost any target, create ice barriers and structures, extinguish fires, and immobilize enemies.

- Freeze Blast: high-powered projectiles with sub-zero temperatures that explode on impact, capable of freezing targets or temporarily incapacitating enemies.

- Heat-Seeking Drones: devices capable of detecting heat signatures even through obstacles and providing support through cryogenic projectiles.

Additionally, the suit includes various tools designed to control the environment and turn the battlefield into a tactical advantage, as well as an integrated security override chip that ensures all systems remain locked to unauthorized users, preventing enemies from turning your own equipment against you if they manage to steal it.

Note: Along with the suit, you will receive a USB drive containing Victor Fries' complete research into cryogenics, refrigeration engineering, cryogenic weaponry, environmental cooling systems, and suit maintenance, as well as all technological improvements developed by those who have carried the mantle of Mr./Mrs. Freeze. This will provide you with all the knowledge necessary to maintain, repair, reproduce, and even improve both the suit and its cryogenic equipment.
objects.title: Mr. Freeze's Suit (DC Comics)

addons.text:
The Omega-1 Nanite has combined with the Blue Beetle Scarab, creating a seamless integration between both machines; they have become practically irremovable from you, as each nanite made by the Omega-1 Nanite is now a part of the Scarab this has enhanced the onboard AI to new levels, amplifying its capabilities and doubling the processing power with each nanite that is available, allowing for unprecedented levels of computational power.

This fusion of the Omega-1 Nanite and Scarab has pushed the limits of their respective technologies. The evolutionary functions of both machines have combined, granting the Scarab the enhanced capabilities of both machines granting the Scarab the ability to modify itself as well as the biology of the one it has bonded to; enhancing nearly every aspect of the Scarab, enabling it to adapt and evolve in response to new challenges and environments faster than it could before. The Scarabs' connection to the Bleed has been enhanced through the nanites and can now generate portals similar to Breach, even through time, using tachyons.

The machines produced with the Nanite and Scarab are augmented using both to create more elaborate machines. Through the Omega-1 Nanite, the Scarab has accessed the technological database of the Reach. Additionally, the Scarab has established a limited initial connection to the Dominion Code via the Omega-1 Nanite.

Before fusing with the Omega-1 Nanite, the Scarab was able to match up against the inexperienced members of the Green Lanterns and even Guy Gardner; now the Scarab has gathered enough data to start the process of using the data collected from the Reach on the Lanterns to implement the emotional spectrum technology of Oa into the Scarab with the help of the Omega-1 Nanite.
addons.title: Epsilon Nanites

addons.text:
The Shi’ar and the Reach are both brutal monocultural expansionist empires, where they differ is in their methods of conquest, deniable violence and explicit conquest. The Raptor and the Scarab are the ultimate expressions in their exceptions. 

Allowing the scarab and the Amulet to incorporate each other has allowed them to become a truly planet-conquering weapon. The nanotechnology of the scarab’s adaptation allows the Android to construct its alternate modes on the fly, and adapt in seconds what would have taken weeks to produce fully. Integrating novel and interesting energies and technologies becoming as common and easy as allowing the device to run automatically.

Similarly, the Datasong has fused with the Scarab’s AI, making it vastly more efficient, implicitly understanding what you need and want to construct. Additionally, the Scarab can administrate a quantum state to you in Null-Space, essentially allowing you to exist both outside Null-Space and inside it until needed at the same time, only cementing which as necessary (ie. if attacked ‘you’ would have been in Null-Space and the android outside it).

A single Raptor and a Scarab could match warships. You can match war fleets.
addons.title: Talon of Empires

objects.text:
You have acquired a Scarab of the Reach, an alien empire of insectoid conquerors that wages war through the use of Scarabs—highly advanced techno-organic exoskeletons engineered as living weapons. Designed to bond with hosts, Reach Scarabs function as technological parasites that attach themselves to a host’s spine, typically seeking out weak-willed individuals to ensure full control.

Their sophistication allows a bonded Scarab to contend with members of a Lantern Corps for a time. However, they are not infallible; Scarabs can be tampered with or even removed through magic, and their control can be resisted by hosts possessing sufficient willpower. If someone attempts to forcibly remove a Scarab from a host’s spine, the process will be fatal to the host.

In your case, your Scarab has been altered to be completely loyal to you and lacks any hidden failsafes that would allow the Reach to subvert it. The Scarab also possesses an onboard AI with a personality of your choosing and is capable of developing real-time countermeasures. It is equipped with highly advanced sensors and can hack extremely advanced terrestrial and alien technologies.

Once bonded, the Scarab generates a fully adaptive suit of armor tailored to your body, featuring a color scheme of your choice. This armor grants you superhuman strength, durability, speed, and agility, enabling feats such as catching a truck with a single arm, engaging Kryptonian-level opponents, shrugging off gunfire, and surviving a fall from orbit without damage. In terms of mobility, the Scarab enables flight via generated wings and jet propulsion, allows you to evade lasers with ease, and supports faster-than-light travel in space.

The Scarab’s true specialty lies in its weaponization and adaptability. It can reshape itself to produce an immense array of armaments, including bladed weapons, plasma cannons, cryogenic weaponry, neural scramblers, magnetic field generators, hadron accelerators, electromagnetic- and strong-force-based weapons. Beyond direct combat, the Scarab can deploy drones, translate nearly any language or analyze unfamiliar ones, assume control of your body to protect you from threats if incapacitated, generate clothing, and interact with intangible beings.

Additionally, the Scarab can project energy shields more durable than the armor itself—impervious even to speedsters vibrating through matter—emit powerful energy pulses, and absorb energy without any known upper limit. It possesses resistance to telepathic intrusion and features multiple operational modes, such as configurations optimized for enhanced strength or speed. The Scarab can also produce kryptonite radiation and generate tachyons capable of disrupting time travel.
objects.title: Reach Scarab (DC Comics)

objects.text:
The Silent Armor is a magical alien war-plate forged within the heart of a sun, created for the singular purpose of opposing the demon Trigon. Over the ages, it passed from one bearer to another, each wielding its power in desperate conflicts against overwhelming darkness.

In its dormant state, the armor conceals itself as a pair of unassuming arm bracers, but when summoned, it can fully manifest around its wearer in mere seconds. Once active, it vastly amplifies physical strength, speed, and durability—enough that one of its former users was able to force Trigon himself into retreat. The armor grants the power of flight and manifests a crimson, lariat-shaped tendril that can detach and act independently, draining the life energy of any being it ensnares.

Unlike those who bore the Silent Armor before you, you face no risk of losing control to its influence. The armor no longer demands immense willpower or constant focus to wield, responding fully and obediently to your intent.
objects.title: Silent Armor (DC Comics)

objects.text:
The Suit of Souls is a mystical artifact created during the time of Abraham, originally designed to protect Jewish communities. Its primary ability is the theft of souls, which is activated through physical touch or by extending tendrils to capture souls from a distance. However, it can only steal the souls of the wicked. Unlike the original version, which was powered solely by absorbed souls, this iteration grows stronger as more souls are collected. Redeeming a soul is possible if the soul willingly aids the wearer, though the process can take at least a century.

The Suit grants the wearer superhuman physical attributes, including enhanced strength, durability, speed, coordination, and combat skill. It can withstand gunfire even with a minimal number of souls and enables the wearer to defeat an entire room of armed men without injury. With sufficient power, the wearer can even keep pace with beings as powerful as Blue Devil. The energy of absorbed souls can also be used to generate an intimidating aura capable of causing enemies to hesitate, cease their attacks, or flee in terror.

Additionally, the Suit allows the wearer to access the memories of stolen souls, extracting valuable information. With sufficient practice, this includes utilizing the knowledge of sorcerers to cast spells. The Suit can sense sin but does not compel its wearer to attack sinners. It maintains a telepathic link with its wearer, allowing communication with its consciousness and enabling the wearer to summon it over short distances. The Suit also possesses long-range teleportation capabilities—such as traveling from Gotham to New Orleans—and can employ this ability in close combat to evade attacks.
objects.title: Suit of Souls (DC Comics)

addons.title: The XE Suit
addons.text:
In addition to your usual suit, you will receive the Extreme Environment Batsuit, a suit designed to allow you to operate in extreme environments, particularly those covered in ice, protecting you from intense cold, sub-zero temperatures, and dangerous cryovapors.

This suit not only grants you superhuman strength and durability, but its internal honeycomb structure is also designed to effectively insulate against extreme temperatures without adding additional weight; as such, you can maintain your mobility and speed despite its bulkier appearance, allowing you to move and fight with the same effectiveness as you would in a conventional Batsuit, even under the harshest environmental conditions.

Additionally, the suit comes equipped with a pair of Thermal Gloves, devices capable of generating intense heat powerful enough to melt the ice created by Mr. Freeze's cryogenic technology; as such, they are especially effective against opponents who use cryogenic powers or weaponry, while also allowing you to free people trapped in ice blocks, thermally overload objects, break through ice formations, and even incapacitate enemies through concentrated heat discharges.

Lastly, in addition to their primary function, the Thermal Gloves can also be used to temporarily apply a thermal overload to other objects, such as Batarangs, allowing you to destroy frozen objects from a distance while also expanding your tactical options against cryogenic threats.

addons.title: Classic Utility Belt
addons.text:
The Utility Belt of your Batsuit receives an additional collection of gadgets inspired by the equipment used by Batman during the classic 1960s era, particularly as portrayed by Adam West.

The collection includes everything from tracking devices and miniature listening devices to a forensic kit designed to collect and preserve evidence during an investigation, as well as tools for absurdly specific situations that, no matter how unlikely they may seem, are always worth being prepared for.

After all, you never know when you might need something like Shark Repellent Spray to fend off a shark determined to attack you, or the Bat-Credit Card when an unexpected situation requires you to make a financial transaction.

Although many of these devices have an apparently outdated or extravagant design, they have been rebuilt and upgraded using WayneTech technology, preserving their distinctive functionality while bringing their reliability in line with the rest of your equipment. For example, the Bat-Credit Card has been retrofitted with WayneTech technology, making it impossible to track and allowing it to be used with virtually any payment terminal, even those that normally accept only certain card networks or card types.

Finally, the belt now also features a security system that allows only its user, or anyone they designate, to open its compartments, along with a defensive mechanism that electrocutes anyone attempting to access them without authorization.

objects.text:
You receive the Batsuit from Batman: Arkham Knight, considered the most advanced tactical costume in the entire Batman: Arkham video game series, which comes equipped with all the upgrades for the Batsuit seen in the game.

The suit consists of two parts: a skintight bodysuit made with magneto-rheological (MR) fluid, reinforced with hard points of titanium-coated tri-weave fabric, similar to the material seen in The Dark Knight, which hardens upon impact; and an external armor plating, more akin to that of a Medieval European knight, with an impact dispersion substructure and WayneTech biomechanical support technology, layered with kinetic damping gel.

These armor panels are highly articulated, able to expand or contract according to your movements—the chest armor is motorized and features high-tensile wires, designed to keep the pieces securely in place while allowing you to breathe and move freely—giving the suit a far less bulky appearance than previous versions and allowing it to compress around wounds caused by anything that gets past the armor's defenses.

The suit also integrates military-style pants reinforced with Kevlar plates around the thighs, ensuring additional protection without limiting your mobility; at the same time, the boots are made from a combination of carbon fiber and hardened plastic, equipped with steel tips, ballistic shin guards, and reinforced knee pads.

The gauntlets, on the other hand, in addition to featuring the signature spiked blades that define Batman, also house a mini-computer and a remote control system capable of resisting interference, allowing you to operate your vehicles remotely and securely.

The cowl, for its part, is designed as a reinforced hood with a graphite exterior and Kevlar panels inside, providing resistance against low-caliber gunshots, blunt force trauma, and concussive blows; at the same time, it houses advanced technological systems, including a listening device located in the right ear, which allows you to communicate and intercept distant conversations.

Furthermore, the cowl's visor also features a device developed by WayneTech's Applied Science Division, called Detective Mode; which allows you to analyze crime scenes, see through walls, track enemies, gather data, navigate complex environments, and even locate specific signals.

Lastly, the cape is made of a memory fabric developed by Wayne Enterprises that, although it initially appears to be a lightweight material similar to nylon, is capable of realigning its molecular structure when an electric current is applied; as a result, it becomes rigid, allowing you to glide over long distances. Moreover, the cape is not only waterproof and fireproof, but it also features winged tips that you can use strategically to disorient your enemies during combat.

Note: The Batsuit also includes the iconic Utility Belt, equipped with every gadget, device, and upgrade available in Batman: Arkham Knight. If you have the Batmobile, its Remote Control will also be integrated into the Utility Belt, allowing you to summon the vehicle and remotely control some of its functions.
objects.title: The Batsuit (DC Comics)

objects.text: [The Madness Vest, constructed on meta allows the user to project themselves out of their body and into a shared psychic plane referred to as ‘madness’.] The M-Vest is a wondrous thing. It lets you visualise the impossible, see the unseen and do the undone? Or undo the done? Perhaps. [This form can then move between reality and The Madness as it pleases. The Madness is in essence a force that can be used to alter reality and perceptions to a massive extent, but largely under the influence of metaphor, perspective and emotion. Largely this takes the form of localised and impermanent reality manipulation.] Seeing the madness that lies in the heart of the world, the anger, the joy, you can shape it, unleash it, contain it, display it, consume it, bop it, rock it and one-stop-shop it. An infinite playground to splay yourself upon like a surprisingly salacious rug. Lord of Chaos? Maybe perhaps, perhaps just a poet, or a lovesick girl or a timeless beast. [The user is not immune to the Madness, however, and the Coat will eventually seep into both them and their consciousness, letting them manipulate it without its use, but also giving them no respite from it, in essence developing schizophrenic delusions and hallucinations.] And what a good time can be had when everything’s mad. Be Subtle. [Should the user’s body die when they’re wearing the vest, they’ll be lost in the madness, akin to completely absorbing the Vest’s abilities over time. The vest meanwhile will always retain it’s abilities, no matter how many users it has had] Do note your mad self is not invulnerable, nothing ever is, vulnerable to all your own tricks, the making the binding the breaking the unwinding… well. That’s enough of that, have a good one Shade.
objects.title: The Madness Vest (DC Comics)

objects.text:
You now possess the advanced armor worn by Absolute Superman, originally created by his mother, Lara-El. This suit is a hybrid between an ultra-advanced spacesuit and a fully functional rocketship. It can self-repair, adapt its structure, and reshape itself to meet any need, including entering its specialized battle configuration known as Tornado Mode.

The armor houses an artificial intelligence called Sol, originally created to monitor Superman’s energy levels, process solar radiation, and regulate his powers. Sol now fulfills that same role for you—tracking your physiology, optimizing every ability you possess, and managing all your power sources with perfect precision. If you choose, Sol can also replace the AI of any other OoP you’ve acquired, inheriting all their functions in addition to its own. Above all, Sol is absolutely, unbreakably, and eternally loyal—devoted to your survival, wellbeing, health, care, and continued safety.

The armor continuously absorbs solar radiation and energy, using it to fuel your solar-based powers, sustain itself, and supply any OoP that requires conventional energy input. it also emits an energy field to obscure your features, no matter how advanced the means are.

The armor can deploy and manipulate a cloud of finely-ground Sunstone, which orbits you like wings or a cape. This Sunstone dust—controlled entirely by Sol—can form powerful dust storms, function as a defensive barrier, carry people or objects, heal minor injuries, or even allow you to fly.
Finally, the armor is capable of releasing all stored solar energy in a single, massive burst of explosive force—one that you are shielded from.

Your version of this amour lacks the insignia of house El, and optionally may contain any symbol you choose instead of being left blank, such as the logo of the SCP Foundation, or a Bat.
objects.title: Absolute Armour (DC Comics: Absolute Superman)

objects.text: The Totems of Zambesi are six magical amulets bestowed upon the Zambesi tribes long ago by their gods. Each totem represents a different elemental power and grants its wearer control and mastery over that element. These powers start at around street-level strength and can grow indefinitely through experience and training. Each Totem bearer can communicate with the others via the Totems and can sense when another bearer has died. The Spirit Totem—also known as the Anansi or Tantu Totem allows the user to summon the spirits of various animals and tap into their unique abilities and attributes. With enough practice, the wearer can manifest animal-like constructs made of energy to interact with the physical world. This Totem also grants limited communication with animals, enabling the wearer to convey emotions and basic concepts. The Fire Totem grants the user the power of Pyrokinesis—enabling them to sense, generate, and manipulate heat and fire in various ways. The Air Totem bestows the power of Aerokinesis—allowing the wearer to sense, generate, and manipulate air. With enough training, the user can also achieve flight. The Water Totem enables the wearer to harness Hydrokinesis—allowing them to sense, generate, and manipulate water in numerous ways. With sufficient practice, they can even transform into water itself. The Earth Totem grants the power of Geokinesis—enabling the user to command soil, mud, and rock. It also provides control over plant life and offers limited abilities to resurrect or heal the wearer upon death. The Death Totem allows its wearer to sense, summon, and control the spirits of the dead. It also grants the power of Telekinesis and short-range Teleportation. When the powers of all six Totems are combined and drawn upon simultaneously, they enable the summoning of an Avatar of pure light to vanquish enemies. The Earth Totem supplies its flesh, the Water Totem provides blood, the Air Totem grants breath, the Fire Totem gives life, and the Spirit Totem endows the Avatar with a soul. With these five Totems, the Avatar can imprison any foe. When the Death Totem’s power is added, the Avatar becomes capable of bypassing resistances and immortality to eliminate any target. Finally, although the Totems are typically worn as necklaces or amulets, their physical form is only a vessel for the power they contain. They can change shape and form to suit the bearer’s needs. Each purchase grants you one of these six Totems. While the Totems are primarily designed to be used individually by their respective bearers, they can also be wielded together by a single person if desired. You may choose to keep them as separate items or merge them into a single, unified Totem if desired.
objects.title: Zambesi Totems (DC Comics: Arrowverse)

objects.text:
A futuristic batsuit that Batman had made in the year 2039, after getting older than his pursuit of vigilante justice could handle. This futuristic technology represents the combined advancements of the year 2039 and beyond, surpassing the capabilities of its time of creation. The suit might as well be a walking utility belt with its various functions.

The suit can augment the physical prowess of those who wear it, allowing them to throw around cars, withstand buildings dropping on top of them, and walk away unscathed, or even withstand direct energy fire from weapons. The suit could turn a normal thug into having the power of Batman in his prime. The suit is equipped with additional functions: retractable claws, jet boots, retractable wings, various disposable batarangs, listening devices, a cloaking device, wrist-mounted lasers, a built-in rebreather, grappling Hooks on each hand,  and other devices that Batman would normally have in a utility belt.

The suit also comes built in with a heads-up display and an onboard computer that would make the Batcomputer blush. Of course, it would not be complete without a useful function in the detective mode, allowing the suit to look through walls, highlight useful clues in yellow, and scan rooms for footprints. Housing thermal and night vision, the suit could very well make even a novice become a master detective. The suit also comes with an onboard AI to assist with crime fighting and listening to police radios, and is quite the detective, a useful ally for a fledgling vigilante.
objects.title: Beyond Batsuit (DC Comics: Batman Beyond)

objects.text:
A protective suit of armor, created using the Philosopher's Stone, made of calcified speed force energy. The armor is completely metallic, and covers its occupant from head to toe. The inside of the suit, such as the rib cage area and the eyes, glow a light blue color. The suit bears a downwards-pointing diagonal lightning bolt symbol on the chest. The mouth of the suit can open as if an actual mouth, and there are two retractable blades at the wrists.

The suit acts as a protective armor. Using it, you can run beyond your limit and the suit can protect you from the static build up you create while moving at such speeds. You also are able to enter the speedforce with it, becoming far faster and invisible to non-speedsters.

The suit can also be remotely controlled.
objects.title: Savitar Armor (DC Comics: CW Flash)

objects.text:
An advanced technological suit that’s capable of absorbing energy in all forms. While the suit itself is durable enough to absorb blows from a Kryptonian while still protecting the wielder, it only grows stronger with additional energy. The suit itself can absorb virtually any kind of energy (i.e. Electricity, Chemical, Kinetic) with seemingly little to no upper limit. Any energy source separate from the suit can provide power to it, such as other powers, or electrical lines.

In addition to its energy absorption, at the lowest level the suit comes equipped with claws and a tail for offense and is, to a degree, adaptive. When seeking out energy it can produce sharp tendrils to stab into the ground and draw from the central power grid, for example. These adaptations tend towards energy gathering tools, but these often double as weaponry due to the detrimental effects draining energy can have on an outside entity. The energy absorbed also feeds into the suit, first providing superhuman Speed, Strength, Durability, and limited flight, all of which only grow as the suit continues to absorb energies.

As the suit absorbs energy it’s tendency is to grow, eventually reaching sizes comparable to a kaiju, but requiring evermore energy to maintain this size. Sudden removal of an energy source at this size can cause monumental failures in the suit, reducing it to little more than a giant statue in the worst cases. In addition, should the suit be denied the requisite energy to keep functioning without deactivation, it will begin drawing on the user to stay active, which can have catastrophic effects on their health.
objects.title: Parasite Suit (DC Comics: My Adventures With Superman)

objects.text: Now you have five pairs of bio-clothing from Mars that can be commanded mentally to change color and shape. When put on by a user, it forms a nascent psychic connection that they can utilize to control it. Though it can properly channel all powers and, given enough time, heal itself in the case of harm, this bio-clothing offers no actual defense. This bio-clothing can integrate other pieces of equipment but cannot manipulate or store the equipment in any way.
objects.title: Bio-Suit (DC Comics: Young Justice)

objects.text:
You have managed to acquire an iconic object that once belonged to a certain blue cat robot.
