As its name implies, the 4D pocket acts as a portal that allows the user to access and deposit items in another dimension with little concern for space occupation or mass. It allows the user to retrieve any gadget from inside by simply thinking about it. Additionally, it has the ability to shrink or enlarge objects, making storage more efficient while ensuring that their abilities remain intact; shrunken objects return to their normal size when taken out.

Inside the pocket lies a vast arsenal of 1,293 gadgets, each with extraordinary capabilities. Among them is the Take-copter, a small propeller that, when placed on the head, grants the user the power of flight with precise control and surprising speed, and the Anywhere Door, a simple-looking pink door that opens to any location the user imagines, regardless of distance.

More subtly powerful tools include the Time Cloth, a fabric that can reverse or accelerate the state of objects, restoring broken items or aging them instantly, and the What-If Telephone Booth, which can change the world itself based on hypothetical scenarios spoken into it.

Unlike the original, all gadgets within the pocket, if used up, damaged, or destroyed, will repair or replenish themselves within 24 hours.
objects.title: 4D Pocket (Doraemon)

objects.text:
The Tetrian Occulus, also known as The Evil Third Eye, is an unbelievably powerful magical artifact in the shape of a menacing red eye. By pushing it into someone’s forehead, it will stick and function as a biological third eye with massively empowered magical sight.

The Tetrian Occulus grants its bearer an unbelievable increase to any supernatural energies they possess, such as Ki or Magic. While acting as an extremely powerful focus for powers. Both amplifying one's power and making it much easier to perform feats far beyond what they could do normally. The eye can transmute materials within its gaze and even control or cancel the energy of objects or even people, shutting down their powers, such as transformations.

For as long as the eye is installed, its bearer is effectively immortal. Able to ignore and shrug off fatal injuries and quickly regenerate in a matter of seconds to minutes based on severity. They also gain infinite stamina and nigh-infinite supernatural energy. Lastly, the eye can also increase the user's size up to becoming the size of a skyscraper.

The eye itself has a rudimentary sentience and can partially adapt and empower its bearer even further to a point. Should the bearer be pushed into a corner, it may release an insanely powerful beam of energy to defend its holder.

For all of its power, it has a rather pathetically simple weakness. Should its bearer be hit in the back of the head three times, it will fall out. Also, be warned that the eye can be destroyed while not in someone. But the eye has the remarkable ability to stay clean and immune to outside elements indefinitely.

It is highly recommended to purchase some form of integration so that it cannot be removed.
objects.title: The Tetrian Occulus (Dragon Ball Daima)

objects.text:
You get the earrings worn by Supreme Kais and their apprentices. Despite being worn so casually, they have incredible properties, allowing two individuals to fuse by wearing one Potara each on opposite ears.

The Fusion has the powers and abilities of the two individuals and increases their power tens of times. The increase in power depends on the compatibility of the two individuals and it will last until the Fusion has run out of energy, but at most 1 hour.

Should either of the individuals be a Kai the fusion will be permanent.
objects.title: Potara (Dragon Ball Series)

objects.text:
Congratulations, Time Breaker; somehow, you have obtained one of the most powerful artifacts belonging to the Supreme Kais: the Time Ring. Although it would normally require the wearer to use a Potara earring, this specific ring has been modified so that you, or anyone you give it to, can use it with ease. 

The Time Ring possesses extraordinary abilities related to traveling between timelines, ranging from traveling to the future and moving between timelines to detecting space-time anomalies caused by other time travelers. While you would normally only be able to travel to the future of a timeline adjacent to your local multiverse, you can bypass this limitation by using the anomaly detection feature to travel into the past, following the trail of any time traveler who has gone before you. 

Don't get too excited, though; any change you make in the past will simply create an alternate timeline rather than altering your own. This, in turn, generates an additional green Time Ring that you can use at your own discretion. 

As a final bonus, the ring shields you from any attempt to erase you from the timestream. This protection is so potent that not even beings of the caliber of Gods of Destruction could erase you from existence by targeting your past self or even by destroying or altering the entire timeline from which you originate. 

However, do not let your guard down. This only protects you from attempts to eliminate you by targeting your past self or altering your home timeline, effectively making you a living paradox as long as you wear the ring, but it does not offer total immunity against being erased from existence through other methods.
objects.title: Time Ring (Dragon Ball Series)

objects.text: You get a set of special clothing. The clothing provided is able to take on any desired appearance, as long as it fully covers the user's body. This includes outfits such as a tracksuit and track pants. The special clothing is able to alter the user's physique, transforming them into an average-sized human being. For example, a man who originally stood at 2 meters tall and had a muscular build would be transformed into a 1.6-1.7 meters tall man with a regular build upon wearing the clothing. The user's size does not matter, since the clothing is designed to fit them regardless.
objects.title: The Hidden Build (Dumbbell Nan-Kilo)

addons.text:
Your suit has gone a step beyond. The normal adrenaline spike has been enhanced to a cocktail of exodrugs, letting you slow down your perception of time at will while you fight. This will allow you to become a total dervish on the battlefield, seamlessly weaving between adversaries and eventually, as your combo rises, bullets like they are standing still.

Optionally, you can exchange the suit for a set of extensive cybernetic implants with the same functions.
addons.title: Severed (Severed Steel)

addons.text:
Your superhuman mobility and reflexes has allowed you to utilise your tech to its greatest extent. Switching between grappling modes on the fly, incorporating movement techs, even using recoil to propel you like it’s natural.

This has extended so far that you can switch between the ‘perks’ you have equipped and the contents of your suit’s ‘slots’ with impunity.
addons.title: Sick Flips and Quick Thwips!
Power Surge
addons.text:
With this sheer amount of connected technologies, the Reactor has to work overtime to overclock them all at once. What this means is that while it is possible to overclock everything, more mileage will be gained by focusing on specific pieces.

By focusing the overclock on a specific element, such as your armour itself, you can increase the amount of energy directed towards them, increasing the bonus three times over from a single charge. This would turn your jetpack into a true flightpack or turn one of your minor 5sp powers into a 15sp one temporarily.

addons.title: Party Mode
addons.text:
Wiring your pouch through your perk system not only allows you to change ammo types on the fly, but lets you filter anything connected to the system through it.

Your Hoverboard could be augmented with a freezing effect to leave a trail of ice, or your grappling hook could be augmented to pull things towards you, or become a solid and rigid tripline. 

By weaving these effects together you could become an anomalous whirlwind, completely controlling a battlefield you glide onto with the right choices.

addons.title: Truly Severed (Severed Steel)
addons.text:
You’ve been given access to the specialised implants that Steel possessed, allowing her to go toe to toe with a bevy of EdenSys mercenaries.

Your armour and the equipment gained through ‘Schmoovment Shooter’ (or its addons) has been integrated into your body as a set of cybernetic implants rather than an armour, ensuring it cannot be removed from you. This includes Steel’s specific bevy of exodrugs designed to slow cognition to a crawl, and make the world seem as though it’s running in slow motion at will. These drugs natively regenerate thanks to implanted production glands.

Secondly, you’ve been given the EdenSys Experimental Canon Steel attached to her arm, complete with all its features as seen in the ‘EdenSys Experimental Cannon’ addon.

addons.title: EdenSys Experimental Cannon (Severed Steel)
addons.text:
Much like Steel, your arm has been replaced from the elbow-down with an experimental plasma cannon created by EdenSys BioTech Labs.

The cannon has a few modes it can access, but its most basic shot is a plasma blast capable of vapourising enemies and melting through solid steel walls instantly. However, its lens can also be focused into a laser cutting-implement fine enough to cut bullets in flight, and capable of slicing through far stronger materials than steel. 

However, the most useful mode the canon possesses is its gravity canon, letting you pull items towards you from long distances, manipulate them to such an extent you could operate machinery as if it were a regular hand, or repulse objects with great speed. This can even be weaponised more directly, overcharging the repulsor to create a makeshift impact driver.

Finally, the EdenSys Experimental Canon can be overcharged, expelling a massive and continuous beam of plasma, though this only lasts for a minute at most and leaves the canon inoperable for two hours, needing to recharge.

objects.text:
You’ve gained a set of equipment with all the amenities needed for someone annihilating thousands of mercenaries a day.

Firstly, a set of full covering armour capable of taking twenty artillery shells before losing effectiveness that’s no more bulky than a bulletproof vest though completely airtight and allowing you to breathe and survive in space or the ocean for several hours. Inside the boots are small thrusters allowing you to ‘jump’ in the air, though only once at first (eventually reaching four separate times in mid-air). On the back meanwhile is a self-recharging jetpack, though its power supply is rather limited initially, and useful only for evasion, needing to be upgraded and modified to become a truly powerful piece of your kit. It also has several LED light fixtures to customise your appearance to your preference.

The armour plugs directly into your nervous system when worn, giving you increased reaction speed and multitasking, letting you seamlessly switch between active tasks and elements. It can also induce a manual spike of adrenaline into your system in extremis.

Additionally, the suit has a small pocket dimension capable of storing a wide variety of equipment, though only eight of these slots can be ‘quick equipped’, and switching what’s in those slots to be brought out at will takes a minute. Anything inside the pocket or linked to it features on a HUD displayed inside your helmet.

The gauntlet of the armour also contains an energy based grappling hook, capable of pulling you forwards at great speeds. This grappling hook can be toggled between a ‘pull to’ mode and a ‘swing’ mode allowing you to pull yourself to areas with great finesse.

Secondly, the most important part of your kit, a hoverboard. The board has a dedicated space inside your pocket storage, always able to be brought out at a moment's notice. While it can’t fly in the air unaided, it does provide far greater momentum when going forwards, and can hover over land and sea easily. Much like the armour the board is also equipped with various LEDs to customise it to your tastes.

All of this equipment is able to be modified with various ‘perk’ modules that slowly open up over time, ranging from modifying bullets with explosive capabilities, to making grappling hook fire an EMP, to heightening your reaction speed massively for a few seconds.

Furthermore, beyond perks, when you defeat a particularly imposing or powerful foe, you’ll gain access to a minor (5sp or less) power you can call from the suit, usually along the lines of a utility skill, like the ability to freeze the ground in front of you or plant patches of compacted wind for aiding enemy disruption and your own movement.
objects.title: Schmoovement Shooter (Echo Point Nova)

objects.text: A rather unassuming pair of glasses, it allows you to read up to 120 times your normal reading speed. This works on books, magazines, screens, even computer programs - so long it is text you can use it.
objects.title: Gale-Force Reading Glasses (Fairy Tail)

objects.text:
You now have a suit of West Tek crafted, US Army issued T-60 Power Armor. The best available for the average soldier of the US Military in 2077. The armor very heavily armored, even armor piercing rounds have no effect on it. Alongside the armor you also have: an air filtration system, bullet resistant visor slit, flash light mounted to the helmet, and servos and parts able to take a 50 meter (165 foot) drop without so much as a scratch. While also giving boosted strength, being able to fire a minigun with ease and improving punches to skull-breaking levels of strength.

The Armor's fusion core is brand new, able to function for over 200 years with no issues other than lower energy due to being used for 200 years. This model of T-60 Power Armor has a jetpack useful for small boosts to get to harder to reach places.

You may have whatever paint job you wish. This version has solved the issue with the weld weak point on the chest plate.
objects.title: T-60 Power Armor (Fallout)

objects.text:
You now have the Crown of Karsus, created in his attempt to usurp Mystryl as the new God of Magic. Despite the eventual failure of Karsus, for a brief moment, he achieved his goal of apotheosis. Implanted in this crown is the portion of the weave that Karsus stole.

Just being near the crown boosts those with the gift of magic, towering them in magic power that would put them near the realm of Karsus in the system of magic that they wield. Long-term exposure from wearing the crown would eventually see you gain power similar to the divine wielding of the domain of magic held within the crown unto oneself, becoming natural to the user and slowly allowing the user to evolve and become a true god.

However, upon the crown lie three jewels known as the Netherstones, which, when separated from the crown, allow the wielder total control over the one who wears the crown, similar to how the chosen of the Dead three control the Netherbrain.
objects.title: Crown of Karsus (Forgotten Realms)

addons.text:
Silent Mode now includes invisibility against high-level sensory technology, including extraterrestrial technologies and exotic forms. Considering that it is technology originating from the Martians, it also includes protection against psychic means and similar forms. Its activity duration extends to 2 hours and its cooldown is reduced to 30 minutes. It is still visible to other sensory means of a supernatural nature such as magic and spiritual power.

It acquires a third function under the name Mimetic Mode. This consists of taking advantage of the connection between the suit and the biological body to extend the morphic functions of the Bio-Suit. This becomes true Auto-Biokinesis, but limited to the user’s biomass and the total mass provided by the Hunting Suit and the Bio-Suit. Its active time is the same as Silent Mode.

Additionally, any trace you leave behind no longer falls under the effects of this new mode, such as your blood, for example. On the other hand, the regenerative capabilities of the Bio-Suit are now integrated into your body through the same connection used by Mimetic Mode. The time it takes to regenerate depends on the severity of the damage and the nutrients required or any resources contained within your body. It does not provide regeneration if your brain is completely destroyed.

With the integration of Bio-Suit and Smiling Face, it has acquired a level of digital mastery sufficient to manipulate any technological device that integrates directly into your suit or through physical contact. It still maintains the limitation of being unable to store anything inside your suit, although it can improvise small creations such as a small pouch to store cards or your phone. The largest thing it could create would be an improvised holster to hold a weapon or a moderately large object.
addons.title: Camouflaged Hunter

objects.text:
The material of the suit is constructed from an armored nano-fiber compound which is smooth and warm to the touch. The system’s functions are secured by the circulation of an organic liquid of a bright blue color, with several cells stored in certain parts of the body.

When worn, a connection is created that penetrates the skin and grows into the major arteries and main nerves; in this case, users notice a slight tingling or mild itching sensation. This allows direct interaction with the muscles, nerves, and the vascular system. In addition, it fully adheres to the user’s body, and in case of possessing metamorphic abilities or transformations, the suit gains an automatic adaptation function.

It provides a series of enhancements throughout the entire body. Strength sufficient to lift 15 tons of weight without breaking a sweat. Durability three times greater than your own strength. Your Speed and Endurance are sufficient to maintain a 60 km/h run for 4 consecutive hours. Agility and Reflexes are increased enough to compete with professional gymnasts even if you are overweight or an average person, you quickly become someone very agile, even in parkour activities.

Due to the material of your suit, it provides protection against most mundane damage, both physical and chemical. Nevertheless, certain chemicals and certain levels of military firepower can still harm you. For example, an acid capable of decomposing steel in a matter of seconds, bladed weapons capable of cutting diamonds, laser beams, or a direct shot from a modern tank or warship. Lastly, the suit offers a couple more functions:

Silent Mode: You become invisible to most modern sensors and the perception of different lifeforms. Only advanced technologies or supernatural sensory means can detect you, such as sensing your soul or your presence through the weight of your body. It can be maintained for 1 hour before suffering a 2-hour cooldown.

Active Mode: Quadruples all your physical capabilities for 5 minutes from your enhanced state before suffering a 5-hour cooldown and the temporary loss of the basic enhancement provided by the suit. If you deactivate it before the time limit, you do not suffer any loss aside from the cooldown time.

The suit is tight enough and causes no discomfort, allowing it to be worn beneath any clothing. Even with short or open clothing, the suit automatically turns invisible or adapts to make it appear that your legs and arms are not under any suit, and this small function does not count toward the limits of Silent Mode.
objects.title: Hunting Suit (Gantz)

addons.text:
You have mastered the art of creating Ancient Names, a profound skill that can be shared with others to perpetuate the tradition. Traditionally, a Wayob would bestow Ancient Names upon individuals deemed worthy. However, as you are not a Wayob, you must craft these names yourself for those who have earned them through their deeds.

For someone to be worthy of an Ancient Name, their actions must embody the "spirit" of the name they are to receive. While the recipient may not immediately understand why they were chosen, most will strive to live up to the essence of their name. Ancient Names are generally not restricted to specific groups, families, organizations, or tribes. Exceptions exist for special names, such as those of heroes or names deeply rooted in a group’s culture or traditions. As a Crafter and Engraver of Names, you possess the insight to discern when someone is deserving of an Ancient Name.

The process of forging an Ancient Name is not inherently difficult, but it demands rigorous and meticulous gathering of information about the intended recipient’s life. Any falsehoods embedded in the information engraved into the name can corrupt it, potentially causing cognitive harm to the bearer. Most Ancient Name Engravers sacrifice their lives in the creation of these names. However, in your case, the process will instead drain a significant amount of your energy, leaving you noticeably weakened but alive.

Receiving an Ancient Name is a distinct honor. The deeds performed under the name contribute to its legacy, inspiring future bearers. However, if an Ancient Name is not passed on, it risks being lost, along with the memory of the deeds of its previous bearers. As the Source of Ancient Names, you have the unique ability to retrieve lost names and grant them to new bearers. Despite this, most of the names you create will be soul-bound to their recipients, leaving the responsibility of passing them on to the bearers themselves.

You have inherited the collective experiences and knowledge of every being who has ever created or granted an Ancient Name. This includes individuals like Xilonen, her mentor Tlazolli, and even the Wayobs themselves. This vast reservoir of wisdom ensures your unparalleled mastery of this sacred art.
addons.title: Engraver of Names

addons.text:
You bear the ancient name Msomi, meaning "Scholar." This unique name holds profound significance, affecting only you and no one else. It grants unparalleled mastery over all forms of learning. Your ability to comprehend, study, and master knowledge is vastly enhanced. Concepts and laws you focus on become more powerful in application, and the time and effort required to master them are significantly reduced.

If you possess the ability to create study partitions, their quantity and efficiency will increase over time. With the name Msomi, there is nothing beyond your capacity to learn or understand.

For any field of study, once you acquire the foundational knowledge—whether from a book, a mentor, or another source—it takes only one year to reach an intermediate level and another year to achieve mastery. This includes not just intellectual pursuits but also physical disciplines such as martial arts, weapon mastery, tactics, and strategy.

Furthermore, when adapting to any power system or energy source in the worlds you visit, the time required to gain access and proficiency is drastically reduced. Learning techniques or skills tied to these systems becomes effortless, allowing you to quickly master even the most complex methods.

All the knowledge, skills, techniques, and energy sources you acquire are stored within the archive of the ancient name. Those who inherit the name Msomi may resonate with its stored knowledge, unlocking access to this vast repository. However, mastering the inherited knowledge will still require dedication and time.

If you bear another ancient name, such as Tumaini or any other, they will not clash. Instead, these names will resonate harmoniously, coexisting and complementing one another. This unique ability to bear multiple ancient names is exclusive to you and cannot be passed down to your inheritors.
addons.title: Msomi: Scholar of Infinite Potential

addons.text:
You bear the Ancient Name Msafiri, meaning "Traveler," a title that defines your essence as a wanderer, a trailblazer, and a seeker of paths. This name signifies your unique role in the cosmos, one recognized by Akivili, the Aeon of Trailblaze, who welcomed you among the Nameless. With Akivili’s disappearance, you have risen as the Trailblaze Emanator, destined to succeed them and carry forward their legacy. This role grants you extraordinary powers and privileges, marking you as a pivotal figure in the grand tapestry of existence.

As an Emanator, your natural ability to travel has been greatly enhanced. You can now reach any realm or omniverse, even those considered inaccessible or sealed. This includes self-contained worlds like the Imaginary Tree’s domains, divine realms of other gods, various afterlives, and dimensions that would normally be impervious to entry. No barrier or restriction can prevent your passage. Moreover, your elevated status ensures that no being of equal or lesser strength can impede your journey. Gods and other entities cannot seal, imprison, or hinder you. Only primordial deities, such as the strongest Elder Gods, possess the power to challenge your freedom. Even the Sustainer of Heavenly Principles is incapable of stopping, weakening, or trapping you, granting you unrestricted access to worlds like Teyvat.

Your powers and abilities are significantly amplified, making you a formidable presence. In addition, you inherit the Astral Express and its crew, comprising both past and present Nameless. The Astral Express is more than a vessel; it symbolizes your connection to the Nameless, who draw strength from you and, in turn, empower you. While your natural ability allows you to travel independently, the Astral Express extends the reach of the Star Rails across existence, offering unparalleled opportunities for exploration and discovery.

Your eventual ascension to Aeonhood will further solidify your immortality. As long as the Nameless and the Astral Express endure, your existence is tied to the ideal of traveling. Even in defeat, you will return—either through the power of your ancient name or after an indeterminate period. This ensures that your role as the embodiment of Trailblaze remains eternal.

Although you are stronger than most gods and beings, your current status as an Emanator imposes some limitations. Truly powerful entities, such as the Endless, Odin, Indra, Shiva, and primordial deities, can still harm or affect you. However, your eventual ascension will elevate you to a level where few can rival your strength.

Your journey is one of boundless exploration, resilience, and transformation. As the successor to Akivili, you embody the eternal ideal of Trailblazing, destined to illuminate the cosmos with your endless travels and inspire others to follow the path of discovery. If you bear another ancient name, such as Tumaini or any other, they will not clash. Instead, these names will resonate harmoniously, coexisting and complementing one another. This unique ability to bear multiple ancient names is exclusive to you and cannot be passed down to your inheritors.
addons.title: Msafiri: The Trailblazer

addons.text:
You bear the Ancient Name Uumbaji, meaning "Creation," a title that encompasses all forms of creation. This power extends to diverse disciplines, such as the scroll weaving of the Masters of the Night Wind, the golem crafting of a Magicraft Meister, the forging of noble phantasms and powerful weapons, the development of personal systems for others, and even the creation of powers. Additionally, it includes the invention of various technologies, both ancient and modern. Every form of creation is within your grasp, from sculpting and painting to the crafting of Objects of Power. No creative endeavor is beyond your reach.

While there is nothing you cannot create, the complexity of certain creations may demand significant effort and preparation. For example, forging a dragon-slaying weapon requires you to personally slay a dragon and use its materials in the crafting process. Similarly, creating intricate systems necessitates an understanding of required materials and potential substitutions if specific resources are unavailable. Your innate understanding will guide you through these processes, ensuring you know what is needed and how to adapt.

The creation of dimensions and worlds is also within your capability, but such feats are extraordinarily challenging. Without a power like Dimensional Dominion to assist, the task becomes even more demanding, requiring vast amounts of esoteric materials, energy, and personal power. However, if you possess complementary abilities, the effort required for these monumental creations will be significantly reduced. Even without such powers, your status as the Bearer of the Ancient Name Uumbaji grants you the potential to achieve these feats through persistence and ingenuity.

As the Bearer of Uumbaji, you possess the unique ability to mine or harvest any resource, no matter how rare, impossible, or esoteric. This includes materials that should not naturally exist, such as solidified time, emotions, or thoughts. These resources can be harvested from powers affecting time or other abstract forces. However, harvesting must be approached with care, as you will only acquire small amounts at a time. To aid in this endeavor, you have access to a substantial inventory space where harvested materials can be safely stored. You will also gain access to a small forge dimension, that can be entered at will, this is so you have access to all the materials and resources along with an actual forge or space to create things.

Your ability to forge, craft, and create is boundless, serving both your needs and those of others. However, you must exercise caution in your creations, ensuring they are bestowed only upon the worthy. If your creations fall into the hands of the unworthy or malevolent, they could bring about great destruction. Your responsibility as a creator is as significant as your power.

Your proficiency in all forms of creation begins at a basic level but grows over time through training, practice, and effort. With dedication, you can achieve mastery in every discipline of creation, embodying the essence of the Creator. The knowledge and skills associated with your title are stored within the Archive of the Ancient Name, waiting to be unlocked and mastered by you or those who inherit your legacy.

If you bear another ancient name, such as Tumaini or any other, they will not clash. Instead, these names will resonate harmoniously, coexisting and complementing one another. This unique ability to bear multiple ancient names is exclusive to you and cannot be passed down to your inheritors.
addons.title: Uumbaji: The Creator

addons.text:
You bear the Ancient Name Mtsengisi, meaning "Merchant," a title that embodies the essence of trade and commerce in all its forms. As the bearer of this name, you are granted a unique shop, separate from any personal dwelling, such as a Sweet Home, personal world, or a creation like the Adeptus Teapot. This shop is intrinsically linked to your soul and can be accessed simply by willing yourself there. Similarly, you can leave the shop at will. When absent, you may leave a clone to manage the shop or employ individuals residing in your Teapot or other personal home. If a customer enters while you are away, you will be instantly alerted, enabling you to return to the shop promptly.

Your shop is connected to every world and dimension within the omniverse. Harmful individuals are barred from entry, ensuring the safety of both you and your customers. The shop manifests as a random door within a world, and you cannot access that world until someone discovers and opens the door. You remain unaware of the connection until the door is used. These doors may appear in locations ranging from easily accessible to seemingly impossible. Multiple doors can exist within the same world. The doors and the shop itself are indestructible, and powers or weapons are rendered ineffective inside, guaranteeing a secure environment. Additionally, you may establish a physical shop in the world you are visiting, allowing you to remain there while customers from other worlds can still access your shop. Please note if you have access to the Muliversal Marketplace in some way, you can still setup a door within the marketplace allowing for yourself and customers to buy and sell products.

It is important to note that you cannot use a door to enter a world until you have personally traveled there, even if a customer has already accessed it. This limitation ensures a gradual exploration of connected dimensions.

As the bearer of the Ancient Name Mtsengisi, you possess the ability to make verbal deals and trade for a wide range of items, including objects, powers, systems, bloodlines, memories, and even abstract concepts like time. Esoteric trades, such as firstborn children or other unconventional items, are also within your purview, though your moral compass may guide your decisions regarding such transactions. You instinctively know the value of anything in existence and can identify the most suitable customers for it, provided you have encountered them. Over time, your shop can be expanded to accommodate vast storage capacities.

If you have the ability to create dimensions, these can be utilized for farming, enabling you to sell food, animals, and other resources. However, you remain responsible for stocking your store. Large storage spaces allow for the automation of restocking shelves. Non-unique, non-one-of-a-kind products will be duplicated upon purchase, ensuring an endless supply of basic items. When acquiring or trading items from others for your shop, you are prohibited from influencing their decisions through powers or manipulation, maintaining the integrity of each transaction.

If you bear another ancient name, such as Tumaini or any other, they will not clash. Instead, these names will resonate harmoniously, coexisting and complementing one another. This unique ability to bear multiple ancient names is exclusive to you and cannot be passed down to your inheritors.
addons.title: Mtsengisi: The Merchant

addons.text:
You bear the Ancient Name Shujaa, meaning "Hero," a title embodying the essence of heroism in its purest form. Like Gilgamesh, the King or Queen of Heroes, your deeds stand unmatched, casting a shadow over all who come after you. Whenever a situation calls for a hero, it will inevitably summon you. No matter the odds, any challenge you face will find resolution—be it the fall of an enemy or the defeat of a demon lord—for fate itself has decreed that the hero shall prevail. Yet even fate is not absolute; it can be defied by those strong enough to resist its pull.

Your name and deeds echo across all worlds and civilizations. Wherever there are those in need, you will find them, transcending distance and barriers to reach them in time. Your skills as a hero are unparalleled, honed with extraordinary speed. What takes others years to master, you achieve in months—be it strategy, diplomacy, swordsmanship, or weapon mastery. As the Traveler, you possess a unique ability to adapt to and harness any energy source, eliminating the limitations of traditional heroism. Furthermore, your power to redistribute talents is no longer restricted to a single instance; you can now adjust them repeatedly, though this ability comes with a cooldown.

Your strength grows in proportion to the good you do. Acts of saving, defending, healing, or aiding others amplify your powers. Repeated actions, such as defending others tirelessly, will transform temporary boosts into permanent enhancements. This progression ensures that your commitment to heroism is rewarded with lasting growth.

As a true hero, your resolve is unbreakable, impervious to all but your own surrender to despair. In moments of great need, your resolve ignites, enhancing your existing powers in response to the situation. While this ignition brings immense strength, it does not grant new abilities, and frequent reliance on it comes at great risk—even death.

As the bearer of the Ancient Name Shujaa, you carry a legacy that extends beyond yourself. Worthy heroes who earn this name contribute their memories, skills, and powers to an infinite archive housed within it. This archive is accessible only to heroes, who must still train and strive to master the knowledge they acquire.

If you bear another Ancient Name, such as Tumaini, these titles will not conflict. Instead, they will resonate harmoniously, complementing one another and enhancing your abilities. This unique capacity to bear multiple Ancient Names is exclusive to you and cannot be transferred to your inheritors.

Go forth, hero, and let no force—be it evil or despair—stand in your way. Stand tall, and let your unwavering resolve light the path for others.
addons.title: Shuja: The One True Hero

addons.text:
You bear the Ancient Name Maafa, meaning "Disaster," specifically a Sun-like disaster. This title, coupled with your possession of Laevatein, has transformed you into a living embodiment of the sun. Your blade is no longer just a weapon—it has been enhanced to the point where it can destroy anything in existence. From worlds and stars to the very foundations of entire realms, nothing is safe from the flames of Laevatein. To gods, entities like Trigon, and other cosmic beings, you and your sword represent the ultimate end of creation. Just as creation itself was forged, your flames are capable of unmaking everything in their path. You are the Calamity, destined to bring an end to all things. When it comes to destruction and death, you are unparalleled. Your sword can cut through not only physical forces but also esoteric and abstract ones—time, space, emotions, thoughts, and even metaphysical forces will fall to your flames.

As the bearer of the Ancient Name Maafa, you are immune to the destructive power of your sword and its flames. You can also grant this immunity to others, should you choose. However, controlling the flames is no easy feat, even with your connection to Maafa. The Seals that bind you still remain in place, but they now offer you the ability to scale the destructive power of your sword. If you wish to obliterate an entire multiverse, you may unleash its full potential. But if you seek a more measured destruction, the power can be dialed down to a level capable of destroying only a building. This sword and its flames are not to be wielded recklessly—they are a last resort. Even if you bear other Ancient Names, Laevatein shall remain your One True Weapon, to be used only when all else fails.

Should you possess the Sacred Flame alongside Laevatein, your sword will retain the life-restoring and life-giving powers it once had when fused with the Sacred Flame. However, these abilities will be greatly amplified when combined with Laevatein’s destructive flames.

Those who bear the Ancient Name Maafa after you will contribute their skills, powers, and memories to the Infinite Archive, a repository tied to the Ancient Name. This will grant future bearers access to new powers and abilities, though mastering them will require effort and training.

If you bear another Ancient Name, such as Tumaini, these titles will not conflict. Instead, they will resonate harmoniously, complementing one another and enhancing your abilities. This unique capacity to bear multiple Ancient Names is exclusive to you and cannot be transferred to your inheritors.

Let all tremble in terror, for a being greater than Ragnarok itself has arrived. All shall flee, for your flames unmake everything in their path, and all beings will know that their end has come.
addons.title: Maafa: Sun Like Disaster

addons.text:
You bear the Ancient Name Silaha, meaning "Arms." This Name embodies the essence of all weaponry and armor in existence. As the bearer, you possess the Perfect Arms, granting you the ability to wield any weapon or armor, regardless of its original owner if any, and reshape them at will.

You’ll possess at least basic proficiency with any item, with your skill naturally rapidly advancing to complete mastery.

Items incorporated by your Perfect Arms can have their any of their features and abilities selectively incorporated into any other item you can shift them into, enhancing their effectiveness, as well as simply being able to call upon their power on their own even without directly manifesting their features.

For instance, if you wish to wield a particular lance, you not only gain access to the weapon but also acquire all associated skills and abilities of a lancer. This capability extends to all weapons and armor absorbed, retaining their powers and abilities, even those belonging to legendary or mythical items. There is also a chance to unlock latent or future powers of absorbed items.

As a further benefit to your status, you can also gift others with a variation of your Perfect Arms, that you can recall back at any time.

The Ancient Name Silaha is vast in scope. It connects all who wield weapons or armor and bear related Ancient Names, creating a shared, infinite archive of skills, memories, knowledge, and power. This archive is accessible not only to you but also to others with weapon- or armor-related Ancient Names. However, while new skills and powers can be acquired through this connection, true mastery still requires training and effort.

If you bear another Ancient Name, such as Tumaini, these titles will not conflict. Instead, they will resonate harmoniously, complementing one another and enhancing your abilities.
addons.title: Silaha: The Perfect Armory

addons.text:
You bear the Ancient Name "Joka," meaning Dragon. As the Dragon Archetype, you are the fusion of all dragons across existence. No matter what type of dragon you begin as, you will eventually gain access to the forms, powers, and skills of every dragon — from the Dragons of Arda, Skyrim, Tensura, DxD, and countless other worlds. You embody them all.

You possess three forms: human, partial dragon, and full dragon. Your strength, speed, reflexes, defenses, magic, potential, and growth have no limits. For as long as you live, you will continue to evolve, growing stronger without end. You start as a young dragon and ascend through stages — adult dragon, ancient dragon, dragon king, heavenly dragon — reaching the heights of dragon god and dragon aspect, and possibly even beyond. With each rank achieved, your power multiplies exponentially.

Even as a young dragon, your traits far exceed those of average dragons, particularly in strength, durability, and flight speed. Early on, you may choose a developmental path, much like the dragons of DxD, select a domain or concept like the True Dragons of Tensura or Warcraft, or forge your own unique lineage by combining all some of all of them.  As the Archetype, you are free to choose any dragon form — Eastern, Western, or something yet unknown. 

You can focus on physical strength, magical mastery, dominion over a concept, or any specialized path you wish, you can create a path of your own. Your command over elements, magic and your powers allows you to imbue them into your breath attacks or any part of your body. In time, you will master them all.  You can also cast magic in your dragon form if you desire. 

Upon reaching the Dragon King rank and beyond, you become the undisputed ruler of all dragons. Every dragon, even Dragon Gods and Evil Dragons, will favor and protect you even as a young dragon. Your existence becomes intertwined with that of all dragons — as long as a single dragon lives, your death becomes nearly impossible. This bond is even stronger if you wield powers like the Eternal Flame or a divine domain over dragons. 

You can create new dragons, either by transforming others into dragons of your chosen type or fusing multiple dragon types into new beings. You can birth dragons at will, and they will be fully loyal to you. Dragons under your command inherit a fraction of your abilities, including the limitless potential to grow and evolve.

All dragons, regardless of their Ancient Name, contribute to the Infinite Archive — a living repository tied to your Ancient Name. Each new dragon adds their skills, powers, and memories to this archive, granting future bearers and you access to greater strength. Mastery of these abilities, however, still demands effort and training.

If you bear other Ancient Names, such as Tumaini, they will harmonize with Joka rather than conflict, each enhancing the other. This rare gift — the ability to bear multiple Ancient Names — is unique to you and cannot be passed to your descendants, further affirming your singular role as the Dragon Archetype.

If you are a Divine, Eldritch, or godlike being, your starting powers and rank are automatically elevated, and you will become the God of Dragons. If you belong to another race, your draconic essence will merge and synergize with it, creating a new, fused existence.
addons.title: Joka: The Dragon Archetype

addons.text:
You bear the Ancient Name "Mnyama," which means Monster. As the Monster Archetype, you embody the fusion of all monsters and yokai across existence. Regardless of the monster you start as, over time, you will gain access to the forms, powers, and abilities of every monster—ranging from those in Supernatural to High School DxD, Rosario + Vampire, and beyond. As you evolve, you will unlock new monster races and integrate them into your being, growing into an increasingly complex entity.

You possess three forms—human, partial, and full—that apply to each monster race you unlock. Your strength, speed, reflexes, defense, magic, and growth are limitless. As long as you live, you will continue to evolve, ascending from youth to adulthood, then to elder, ancient, and beyond, eventually achieving powers that may even surpass the Primordial Gods. Every rank you achieve multiplies your power exponentially, and because each monster race has its own ranks, you inherit them all.

Even as a young monster, your traits far surpass the ordinary. Your defenses and attacks—both physical and magical—are vastly enhanced. From the beginning, you can choose to follow a unique developmental path for each race or forge your own lineage, blending traits and powers from different races into something entirely new. As the Archetype, you are free to assume any form—from the common to the supernatural, or even forms yet unknown.

You can focus on brute strength, magical mastery, conceptual dominion, or carve your own specialized path. Your command over elements, magic, and innate powers allows you to weave them into every attack. Over time, you will master them all, and even in your full monster form, you will wield magic with ease.

Upon reaching the Elder rank and beyond, you become the undisputed sovereign of all monsters. No matter your age, greater forces will protect you, and your existence becomes intertwined with all monsters—while even one survives, your death becomes nearly impossible. This bond deepens if you command powers such as the Eternal Flame or possess divine dominion over monsters.

You can create new monsters by transforming others or fusing different types into entirely new beings. You can also birth monsters at will, each one fully loyal to you and inheriting a fraction of your limitless potential.

All monsters connected to an Ancient Name contribute to the Infinite Archive, a living repository tied to your Ancient Name. Every monster adds their memories, skills, and powers to this archive, strengthening both future bearers and yourself. While access to this vast repository is guaranteed, mastering it requires effort and discipline.

If you bear other Ancient Names, such as Tumaini, they will harmonize with Mnyama, amplifying each other rather than conflicting. The rare ability to bear multiple Ancient Names is yours alone and cannot be inherited, affirming your singular role as the Monster Archetype.

If you are already Divine, Eldritch, or godlike, your starting power and rank are heightened accordingly, making you the God of Monsters. If you belong to another race, your monster essence will merge and synergize with it, creating a new, fused existence that is greater than either on its own.
addons.title: Mnyama: The Monster Archetype

addons.text:
You bear the Ancient Name Mwisho, meaning “The End.” This Name embodies the essence of Finality—the last moment, the end state and culmination of existence. While others cling to becoming, you are what is to come, and none can escape it. You do not merely witness conclusions; you define them. You are not bound by fate—you are its terminus. The past bends beneath your presence, and the future finds no ground to stand on before you.

As Mwisho, yours is the Authority of All: time, gravity, flame, void, sentience, even the principles of life and death. All concepts end in you, and in ending them, you gain mastery. While at first you may retain your restriction on planetary range, as you grow stronger and your existence enrichs itself, the metaphysical shadow you cast grows ever greater, spreading your control across entire star systems and even beyond given enough time.

Where others may find the manipulation of their Authorities difficult to achieve—struggling to invoke abstract aspects or merge dissonant Authorities into a greater whole—your nature as the culmination of all things allows you to seamlessly combine them, synthesizing composite Authorities that do not naturally exist, not merely hybridizations but rather evolutions. For example, Flame with Time may yield Accelerated Ash, a temporal combustion that erases events rather than burning matter.

As the living embodiment of Finality, you don’t simply shape events—you anchor them. You may issue and enforce prophecies, your nature as the final state declaring that in the last moment reality will be as you foretold. If you declare that a world shall fall, then probability and causality shall unravel and realign in order to fulfill that declaration.

Additionally, as the End made manifest, you hold the power to seal ends, rendering the conclusion of a thing absolute. A slain enemy cannot be resurrected. A destroyed idea cannot be rekindled. A closed path remains forever closed as you dictate the final shape of reality.

If you bear another ancient name, such as Tumaini or any other, they will not clash. Instead, these names will resonate harmoniously, coexisting and complementing one another. This unique ability to bear multiple ancient names is exclusive to you and cannot be passed down to your inheritors.
addons.title: Mwisho: The Final State

addons.text:
You bear the Ancient Name Mvunaji, meaning “The Reaper.” This Name embodies the essence of Death—not merely an event, but a principle, a force, and a destiny that arrives for all things. You are the hand that closes the final door, the silence after the last breath. Where others end, you begin.

Mvunaji transforms your dominion over death and the afterlife into cosmic absolutes. Your will becomes the frame upon which the concept of death is hung—not just in action, but in definition. Death does not simply happen under your influence—it happens because of it. Any Death related powers or artifacts you may possess are elevated to a similar level, carried with you in your ascent to cosmic supremacy.

As the living embodiment of Death, you cannot die so long as the concept of Death exists, a paradox which renders you immortal as in order for you to be able to die the very concept of dying cannot exist. You can be damaged, but any harm suffered can be undone and nothing may end your existence. Furthermore, nothing may bar your path, no bindings may hold you nor may any barrier stymie your advance, for Death is a guest none can bar.

As Mvunaji, your presence is metaphysically silent and omnipresent. You may go unnoticed by all things—cosmic or mundane—unless you choose to be seen. You may instantaneously appear anywhere in any location or realm you desire with no regard for distance, as Death reaches all places equally. Additionally, as a ferryman of souls you may bring others with you and conceal them as you conceal yourself, allowing you to shepherd the dead wherever they must go without complications.

Lastly, you are more than just an ender of lives, you are the arbiter of conclusions. Your ability to induce death has expanded in a conceptual direction, allowing you to prune all things, severing ideas and concepts from reality. Furthermore, you may seal endings, rendering them permanent and irrecoverable. A slain enemy cannot be resurrected. A destroyed idea cannot be rekindled.

If you bear another ancient name, such as Tumaini or any other, they will not clash. Instead, these names will resonate harmoniously, coexisting and complementing one another. This unique ability to bear multiple ancient names is exclusive to you and cannot be passed down to your inheritors.
addons.title: Mvunaji: The Reaper

addons.text:
You bear the Ancient Name Fikra, meaning “Genius,” an ideal centered on one principle: progress without ceiling. Fikra does not merely preserve legacy. It records breakthroughs—the precise reasoning, method, and insight that turned limits into stepping stones. Every discovery becomes a map for surpassing the next boundary.

Your Natural-Born Genius is elevated into a structural advantage of the mind. Memory is flawless, comprehension immediate, and cross-disciplinary synthesis instinctive. Science, magecraft, alien systems, divine mechanics, and conceptual law all become subjects you can analyze and reorganize. Given reference material, you master theory and practice at extraordinary speed, condensing years of study into weeks. You do not simply learn systems; you refine them.

Pioneer of the Stars is integrated into the Name itself. When you confront something declared impossible, Fikra ensures that a viable path exists. It does not grant success or bypass effort. Instead, it removes absolutes. Closed systems reveal weaknesses. Incompatible forces expose underlying bridges. Sealed fates allow alternate routes. If you are willing to pursue the answer, one can always be found.

The archive of Fikra evolves differently from ordinary Ancient Names. Future bearers contribute not only triumphs but unfinished work, failed attempts, theoretical drafts, and alternative models. Nothing is wasted. Each generation builds upon the last, accelerating collective advancement. Over time, Fikra may expand to encompass multiple intellectual ideals, merging disciplines into a cohesive framework of understanding.

Fikra does not grant omniscience or free victories. Its central power is clarity—the ability to perceive structure within complexity and opportunity within constraint. True stagnation becomes rare, because there is always another angle to approach.

If you bear other Ancient Names, Fikra strengthens them by refining their systems and expanding their applications. This resonance remains exclusive to you and cannot be inherited.

Fikra is not simply intelligence. It is the living principle that limits exist to be surpassed. You are the Universal Genius
addons.title: Fikra: The Universal Genius
Amri: The Living Concept of Command
addons.text:
You bear the Ancient Name Amri, meaning "Command." This Name embodies the ideals of command, leadership, strategy, tactics, logistics, military doctrine, organization, morale, intelligence, campaigns, conquest, and victory through superior planning. Where Vita embodies war itself, Amri embodies the mind that directs it.

As Amri, your perception expands beyond individual battles. You instinctively perceive conflicts as interconnected campaigns, recognizing the countless decisions that determine victory long before swords are drawn. Supply lines, communication, terrain, weather, morale, intelligence, recruitment, diplomacy, engineering, and logistics become as obvious to you as breathing. Every army, organization, fleet, or civilization naturally reveals its strengths, weaknesses, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement.

Your understanding of command continually evolves through experience. Every campaign you oversee, every battle you witness, every victory you achieve, and even every defeat you suffer permanently refines your strategic instincts. Failure is never wasted. Each setback becomes another lesson that strengthens your understanding of warfare, ensuring that the same mistake is rarely made twice.

The Ancient Name Amri possesses an infinite archive unlike any ordinary military record. Every bearer contributes their campaigns, doctrines, formations, logistical innovations, engineering methods, command philosophies, diplomatic solutions, intelligence operations, battlefield reports, military reforms, and hard-earned experience. The successes and failures of countless commanders across generations become part of a living legacy that continually expands as new bearers leave their mark upon history.

You may draw freely upon this archive, learning from the accumulated wisdom of legendary generals, admirals, tacticians, strategists, quartermasters, engineers, intelligence officers, and military reformers. Entire schools of warfare, forgotten doctrines, revolutionary formations, and centuries of battlefield innovation become available to you. Mastery still demands practice, but no lesson preserved within Amri is ever truly lost.

Although Amri first awakens through strategy and command, it naturally expands beyond any single doctrine. As your bond with the Ancient Name deepens, you gradually master every philosophy of warfare preserved within its archive, from ancient shield walls and cavalry charges to modern combined-arms warfare, magical battlefields, interstellar fleet engagements, multidimensional conflicts, and forms of warfare yet to be invented. Every military tradition eventually finds its place within your understanding.

Those who willingly serve beneath your command are subtly elevated by Amri. Discipline strengthens, morale steadies, communication improves, and coordination becomes almost effortless. Veterans under your leadership learn faster, adapt more readily, and preserve their own hard-earned lessons, contributing to the growing legend of your Ancient Name. Armies commanded by you become increasingly efficient with every campaign they survive.

If you bear other Ancient Names, Amri will not conflict with them. Instead, it refines and coordinates them, allowing command to guide war, creation, heroism, scholarship, travel, dragons, monsters, death, and every other ideal you embody into a single harmonious whole. This unique harmony is exclusive to you and cannot be inherited.

Amri is not merely the authority to give orders.

It is the living memory of every commander who has ever led others to victory, and the certainty that no battlefield is won before it is first conquered in the mind.

addons.title: Mtawala: The Living Concept of Sovereignty
addons.text:
You bear the Ancient Name Mtawala, meaning "Ruler." This Name embodies Sovereignty itself—not merely kingship, but the ideals of legitimate rule, authority, civilization, governance, prosperity, justice, order, legacy, and the eternal bond between a sovereign and those who willingly stand beneath their banner. Where Amri embodies Command, Mtawala embodies the civilization that gives them purpose.

As Mtawala, reality itself recognizes your sovereignty. Your authority is no longer dependent upon titles, bloodlines, laws, or recognition from others. It is an intrinsic truth of your existence. Whether you rule a village, an empire, a world, or an entire multiverse, your legitimacy cannot be denied. Others may oppose your rule, but even gods, demons, eldritch beings, and cosmic entities instinctively recognize that they stand before a true Sovereign.

The Ancient Name grants profound understanding of governance, diplomacy, law, economics, statecraft, justice, and administration. Every triumph and failure refines your judgment, ensuring that every challenge overcome becomes another lesson preserved within your Name.

Mtawala possesses an infinite archive unlike any royal library ever assembled. Every bearer contributes their reigns, reforms, laws, philosophies, institutions, diplomacy, engineering, culture, and statecraft. Their civilizations—including the achievements of rulers, generals, judges, scholars, artisans, merchants, engineers, heroes, and citizens—are preserved forever, allowing each generation to build upon the last. The Archive possess everything you and your people have ever done, ever invented, ever concieved, all of your people's skills nad techniques are yours to learn and master.

Anything beneath your legitimate rule gradually flourishes. Prosperity, innovation, culture, education, commerce, infrastructure, and public welfare steadily improve, allowing your realm to naturally enter a Golden Age worthy of its Sovereign. Your people learn faster, cooperate more naturally, and preserve the lessons of previous generations with remarkable efficiency.

Your Sovereignty and your realm become inseparable. As your civilization prospers, so do you. As your own strength grows, your lands, institutions, and people flourish in equal measure, forming an ever-strengthening cycle between ruler and realm.

Mtawala naturally unites diverse peoples without erasing their identities. Different cultures, races, worlds, philosophies, magical traditions, and technologies find common purpose beneath your rule, allowing them to build a civilization greater than any could achieve alone.

By invoking the full Authority of Mtawala, you unite the collective resolve preserved within the Ancient Name. Every ruler, hero, citizen, and civilization remembered within the archive lends its conviction to your will. Whatever weapon you wield becomes the Throne made manifest, unleashing a transcendent strike empowered by the accumulated legacy of civilization itself rather than divine power—the unshakable resolve of countless generations declaring that their future shall endure.

If you bear other Ancient Names, Mtawala will not conflict with them. Instead, it provides the sovereign foundation upon which they flourish, allowing every ideal you embody to find greater purpose, stability, and harmony beneath your rule. This harmony is exclusive to you and cannot be inherited.

Mtawala is not merely the right to rule.

It is the living memory of every civilization that has ever risen, every throne that has ever endured, and the eternal truth that the greatest sovereign is measured not by the power they possess, but by the greatness they inspire in others.

objects.text: Someone had this to say about Ancient Names: "Our forebearers carved 'miracles' into obsidian rock, yet future bearers looked upon them and saw 'strength.'" The miracles of the past become the motivations of the present. The limitations of the past become the breakthroughs of today You are the bearer of an Ancient Name. This name embodies your deeds, accomplishments, knowledge, skills, and powers. All who hear your Ancient Name will recognize you and your legacy. The essence of your name determines the ideals it represents, granting you powers, knowledge, and skills aligned with those ideals. However, the formation of an Ancient Name is a gradual and organic process. It emerges naturally, without any influence from you or others, ensuring its uniqueness compared to the names found in Natlan. Anyone who bears your Ancient Name in the future will contribute their deeds, experiences, knowledge, skills, and powers to an infinite archive stored within the name itself. This shared repository allows both you and future bearers to draw upon its collective wisdom, gaining new abilities and insights. Over time, your Ancient Name may evolve, expanding to include other names or ideals, reflecting the growing legacy stored within its archive. Due to the fact that Ancient Names can evolve, new powers, skills, and abilities can be created from any ideal stored within the evolved Ancient Name. This type of Ancient Name differs significantly from ordinary names. Its unique origin, functionality, and impact on future generations set it apart. Descendants, whether by blood or adoption, can also acquire their own Ancient Names, continuing the legacy and ideals represented by this extraordinary phenomenon.
objects.title: Ancient Name (Genshin Impact)

addons.text:
Thanks to having both a Vision and a Delusion, you gain the ability to combine their power, granting you new techniques and enhanced power. Additionally, should they be of the same element, a resonance effect occurs, causing the power gain to be increased beyond what could possibly be obtained with either alone.

Your abyssal taint also gives you access to a technique resembling the Foul Legacy Transformation. This form transforms you to twice your size and equips you with black armor, highlighted by the color of your Delusion’s element. You gain enhanced speed and strength, levitation, and the power to make your elemental attacks stronger. This form is extremely draining and can have lasting effects on your body. If needed you may instead stay at your original size, lessening the power you gain and decreasing the strain.
addons.title: Foul Legacy Transformation

addons.text: The abyssal nature of your modified Delusion has tainted your Moon Wheel, yet the purity of Kuuvhaki has paradoxically enhanced your power and the power of the Abyss, increasing the potency of your elemental power and the breadth of what you can achieve, even becoming more intuitive to use. The most notable change however is to your Transformation, which has mutated under the influence of Kuuvhaki’s primordial power and become more personalized, more akin to Arlecchino’s Crimson Moon transformation then Childe’s Foul Legacy. The power of your transformation has greatly increased and the physical strain it causes has been greatly alleviated due to your increased compatibility. Additionally, rather than black armor and a simple size increase, the visuals of your transformation become more monstrous as it now matches the Abyssal Creature you have the potential to become. However, these changes aren’t all positive. The same increased compatibility which reduces strain gives rise to a new problem, you’re now too compatible. When you use your transformation your body adapts to and assimilates its power, leaving traces reminiscent of it even once the transformation fades. Little by little, each usage chips away at your humanity until eventually your transformation becomes your default form - enhanced power included - once you become a true Creature of the Abyss. If you bought Creature of the Abyss this drastically increases your power to the level of Arlecchino after she got the Iridescent Moon Marrow, putting you on power the strongest of Gods, although the true primordial powers of the world such as the Shades or Sovereigns are still beyond you, and becoming a Curse God would make you akin to the Crimson Moon itself.
addons.title: Tainted Moon

objects.text:
You have been granted a modified version of a Delusion; a somewhat flawed replacement of a Vision made by the Fatui. This grants you the ability to use and control one of seven elements of your choosing. Despite the similarities, Delusions have two major differences to Visions:

First is that a Delusion is not dependent on your ambition. This means that its power will not be lost should you lose your ambition. It not being tied to a single person’s ambition also means that Delusions can be used by anyone.

Second is that a Delusion will normally require the lifeforce of the user to function. This is thankfully not as painful as you would imagine, with only excessive use bringing debilitating pain.

A Delusion can be used in much the same way a Vision can; possessing the capability to do things like creating barriers, healing wounds, or predicting the future depending on how you apply it. This even includes the benefits it can provide such as resistance to curses, Forbidden Knowledge, even dangerous forms of energy.

As they were made to oppose the Gods, they do not have the potential to ascend you into one. However, yours has been modified with the power of the abyss, meaning that prolonged use will change you into a creature of the abyss. Though this would solve the lifespan problem.
objects.title: Modified Delusion (Genshin Impact)

objects.text:
You have been granted a Vision, an item that allows you to control one of the following elements: Anemo (Wind), Geo (Earth), Electro (Electricity), Dendro (Flora), Hydro (Water), Cryo (Ice), or Pyro (Fire).

A person's Vision represents their ambition. Losing it may lead to the loss of that ambition, though this depends on the nature of the ambition itself. In some cases, individuals may remain unaffected even without their Vision.

The way a Vision is used varies greatly from person to person. With practice and skill, it can be harnessed to create barriers, heal wounds, predict the future, fly, or even summon sentient beings. The versatility of a Vision depends on the wielder’s skill, knowledge, and personal approach to manipulating elemental energy.

Possessing a Vision also grants passive abilities beyond those of ordinary humans. You gain resistance to curses and forbidden knowledge, and even energies harmful to mortals affect you less. Elemental energy, regardless of its type, is a manifestation of the natural order. When concentrated, it can cleanse corruption, dispel unnatural forces such as Abyssal energy, and help restore balance to the world.

It is believed that those who possess a Vision hold the potential to ascend and become a god.
objects.title: Vision (Genshin Impact)

objects.text:
The MJOLNIR[GEN3] Armor is the most advanced Powered Assault Armor the UNSC has at its disposal, designed for Spartan use. Weighing nearly 900 pounds, the armors outer shell is a titanium alloy capable of outright ignoring small arms fire, augmented with a refractive coating capable of dispersing a limited amount of energy weapon strikes, a crystalline computational matrix layer which can house an AI, as well as magnetic weapon holder strips on the legs, waist, and back. 

Below, the Pressure Seal maintains a breathable atmosphere within the armor indefinitely underwater, or for up to 90 minutes in a vacuum while being hardened against radiation, toxins, bacteria, and EMPs. Underneath, the suits gel-filled layer regulates temperature and can reactively change its density and pressurize itself to protect the wearer from high velocity impacts or G forces up to 38g. 

The Inner Skinsuit is made of a moisture-absorbing synthetic material linked to an environmental control computer and an inbuilt neural interface, which will install itself into the user upon the first time donning the suit through a painless surgical procedure.

The MJOLNIR[GEN3] Armor is powered a compact microfusion reactor, the single most essential component of your armor. Typically, it will power the armor for fifteen years of continuous operation with exceptional throughput. Yours, however, has a regenerating fuel supply, so as to never run dry.

The armor is equipped with Energy Shielding, which deflects anything from material projectiles to directed energy streams or plasma weaponry. Your armor's Energy shielding is powerful enough to practically ignore small arms fire, and is capable of withstanding a limited amount of heavy explosives before being drained. It is strong enough to recharge within a handful of seconds of interrupted fire. 

The Force-multiplying circuits enhance the force you exert, to grant increased strength and speed. Baseline individuals gain a force multiplier of five on top of powering the armor to be near weightless, so as to not push those incapable into excessive strain, while superhuman individuals can gain a multiplier up to twenty while acting as a second skin.

The armor is not just a shell, however. Installed is a very powerful BIOS which is capable of handling the suits software functions, and acting as an incredibly powerful portable computer. It is capable of being updated in the field to allow for newer hardware to be supported.

Within the palms of your armor, you have holographic emitters embedded, allowing you to project a holographic display.

Your helmet's HUD is powered by a waterfall VISR. Able to provide real time tactical data, it allows you to link into infrastructure systems at nearly any level. It provides you with navigational data, highlights points of interest, light enhancement, programmable colour coded highlighting of objects, real time adjustable IFF and motion tracking, alongside numerous other features.

Arguably the most powerful component in your arsenal, you come equipped with your own personalized AI. Typically reserved for starships, it is housed on a data crystal chip and slotted into your armor. Their initial personality adapts itself to suit you, and will grow over time. Incredibly powerful, they are designed for software intrusion, hardware hacking, and espionage, but also act as a companion, and are capable of learning and expanding their capabilities. In nearly mythic fashion, yours has passed all three stages of rampancy and passed into the theoretical fourth stage, metastability, where it can be fully considered a "person".

On top of all of these features, your armor can come equipped with any of the following variety of attachments, and you may customize the armor design.

- Temporary Active Camouflage System 
- Grappleshot Tether
- Overshield Enhancement Kit
- Portable Slipspace Translocator
- Anti-Gravity Repulse Generator
- Stealth Shroud Screen Launcher
- Threat Sensor Launcher
- Back-Mounted Jump Thrusters and Maneuver system
- Small Nuclear Fail-safe Detonation system
objects.title: MJOLNIR Powered Assault Armor [GEN3] (Halo)

addons.text:
As you uncover the truth about your family's long-forgotten legacy, you are thrust into a world of wonder and possibility. Your revelation as a direct descendant of Rowena Ravenclaw, one of the Hogwarts Founders, comes with a sense of pride and responsibility. With no known heirs before you, you pass the Founder's test with flying colors, and the castle walls welcome you as the rightful heir to Rowena's inheritance.

Stepping into your new role, you discover that Rowena's life of study and research, has left a wealth of tomes, and treasures to better her heirs. The vaults, once sealed, now lie open before you, revealing the archived knowledge of her past. You also claim a luxurious custom suite of rooms within the castle, a benefit of your new status as Rowena’s Heir.

As you explore your newfound inheritance, you find a natural talent for divination and astronomy, with the natural abilities of a seer, granting visions of the Past, Present, & Future, though still requiring practice to interpret what you see. Furthermore, you discover a strong affinity for the element of Wind, fueled by your magical abilities.

With this new heritage comes the discovery of more of the Diadem of Ravenclaw’s hidden abilities. This artifact, crafted from silver and sapphires, has been passed down through generations of Ravenclaws. You learn how to change its shape and size at will, adapting to suit your needs. Its greatest ability however is its capacity to passively divine knowledge from any subject, drawing upon the collective wisdom of the universe.
addons.title: True Heir of Ravenclaw

objects.text:
This headpiece is often said to enhance the wisdom of its wearer; however, in truth, it does far more than that. When worn, the diadem enhances the wearer's overall intelligence, creativity, wisdom, and problem-solving abilities. It clears the user’s mind of all distractions, allowing for unparalleled clarity of thought. Additionally, it enhances the speed at which the wearer perceives events, giving them more time to think within the same span.

The diadem grants its user a form of photographic memory, enabling them to recall anything they have ever known and perfectly retain any knowledge gained while wearing it, even after it has been removed. This leads to enhanced insight and inspiration, making the user exceptionally inventive.

Moreover, the diadem amplifies the wearer's ability to understand and interpret visions of the past, present, and future. The user can also store their knowledge and memories within the diadem and access those of previous users, including the legendary Rowena Ravenclaw herself. This collective reservoir of wisdom and experience provides the wearer with a profound depth of knowledge and insight, making the diadem a truly extraordinary artifact.
objects.title: Diadem of Rowena Ravenclaw (Harry Potter)

addons.text:
As you explore your heritage as a descendant of Hogwarts' most controversial founder, Salazar Slytherin, you uncover a world filled with mystery and potential. With no challengers to hinder you, you pass the tests left behind by Salazar, claiming your rightful inheritance within the castle’s walls.

As you embrace your new responsibilities, you learn that Salazar’s life of ambition and cunning has bequeathed you a wealth of secrets and treasures. The once-sealed vaults of his riches now open at your approach, revealing the substantial wealth he accumulated. Additionally, you gain access to a luxurious suite of rooms in the castle, tailored to your personal tastes—a privilege that accompanies your new status as heir to Salazar’s legacy.

You discover a natural talent for Transfiguration and the mental arts of Occlumency and Legilimency. Your skills with daggers and poisons also flourish, and you find a powerful affinity for the element of water.

With the revelation of your heritage as Salazar’s heir, you unlock further secrets of his locket. It allows the wearer to cast powerful magical illusions, which the locket will automatically maintain. Furthermore, it grants the user the ability to see through such illusions with minimal effort.

The locket also reveals an expanded magical space within, containing various trinkets and treasures, along with ample room for many more.
addons.title: True Heir of Slytherin

objects.text:
The Locket of Salazar Slytherin is a golden piece adorned with an emerald serpent, cherished as a treasured heirloom by the descendants of the legendary Hogwarts founder, Salazar Slytherin.

Enchanted with a range of abilities, this locket offers its wearer numerous advantages. Some of its features include preventing anyone except the wearer from removing it, shielding the wearer from all forms of tracking—both magical and mundane—and the ability to change its form to suit the wearer’s tastes and needs.

Additionally, the locket grants the wearer knowledge of a ritual that enables someone to gain the magical ability to speak and understand Parseltongue, the language of serpents. This capability allows the speaker not only to command the obedience of ordinary snakes and the respect of more extraordinary species.

Finally, this neckpiece enhances the wearer’s mental magics. It provides protective mental “shields” to safeguard one’s deepest secrets, as well as offensive “swords” for forcefully extracting such secrets from others. Furthermore, it offers supportive abilities such as mental acceleration and partitioning, enhancing the wearer's overall magical prowess.
objects.title: Locket of Salazar Slytherin (Harry Potter)

addons.text:
As the personification of Death itself, the true power of the Resurrection Stone is revealed to you.
