The Stone has merged with your body, suffusing your essence with its power. With a mere thought you can call forth the spirits of the dead, effortlessly manifesting them in the real world. These spirits may be granted semi or even fully corporeal bodies if you so desire, allowing them to more actively carry out your will. Additionally, no force may bar you from calling a spirit and restoring it to life, the Stone serving as a form of absolute Authority.

The Authority of the Stone now extends to all forms of the dead, not just the spirits you conjure yourself. This allows you to issue absolute orders to all forms of the dead, orders which can only be contested by a being of similar status as yourself.
addons.title: Will of Death

objects.text: The Resurrection Stone is one of the three Deathly Hallows, and it is a magical object that can summon the spirits of those who have passed away. You need to hold the stone and turn it three times in your hand to use it. Once you do this, the spirits will appear translucent, and you can communicate with them or give them instructions. However, it's important to remember that those who return to life through the stone do not belong in the world of the living, and it's essential to allow them to return to their resting place.
objects.title: The Resurrection Stone (Harry Potter)

addons.text:
You accepted your mortality. As Master of Death, you understand that Death is part of life, and while it doesnt make you suicidal or reckless in any way, you are in peace with it. 

You become biologically ageless, becoming younger and older at will. You know when death is coming to others, and can offer to let them have a peaceful death, and guide them to their afterlife. You gain a affinity for spells related to life and death, and know when someone cheated death. Whatever you kill, it become impossible to bring back.

The Relics now recognize only you as their master, and will only work for others if you lend or give it to them.
addons.title: Master of Death

addons.text:
As the personification of Death itself, the true power of the Invisibility Cloak is revealed to you. 

The Cloak can take the form of any clothing you desire and is capable of perfectly concealing you from all things, even the dead. The cloak covers more than just visible means of detection, concealing your scent and deafening your movements. It can even shield you from passive magic, allowing you to pass through complex and powerful wards as if they didn’t exist. If you so desire then you can turn off the concealment or even have it only selectively hide you from certain people. 

However, there is an even further level of concealment available to you. When you actively channel magic into the Cloak it goes a step further and conceals you from the universe itself, allowing you to phase through anything, even magic. You are an ethereal, a silent but omnipresent wraith.
addons.title: Shroud of Death

addons.text:
The True Cloak of Invisibility has merged with your essence, becoming an extension of yourself, allowing you to shape it as you wish, as well as apply its effects over large areas, such as cloaking an entire planet from external observation.

You may observe the world as events unfold while selectively interacting with it, remaining unseen, unheard, and unregistered by both mundane and supernatural means by utilizing the concepts of endings and entropy as a medium.

Any hostile act against you will result in the attacker's actions, strength, abilities, and any other attributes they might possess being rendered Null (Ø) by the Shroud, as such endeavors are equivalent to rushing into Oblivion's embrace.

In its default state, it manifests as a white cloak laced with golden trim that is inseparable from your essence. 

Should you have the Counterpart add-on, they will obtain the equivalently powerful Veil of Emergence, which allows one to remain unnoticed as well as emerge anywhere from the spaces between.
addons.title: The Shroud of Null

objects.text: The True cloak of invisibility was once a part of Death's own cloak. With this, so long as you remain covered, you are invisible to all mortals, but still visible to those that have already died. It is virtually indestructible, can shrink or enlarge to cover up to three people, and will never lose its potency. However, it is not infallible. People can still detect you via non-optical means, and while the cloak itself is indestructible, it doesn't offer this boon to you.
objects.title: The True Cloak of Invisibility (Harry Potter)

addons.text: Instead of accelerating an object, when a Temporal Pouch is used on a Time Turner, it allows the Time Turner to travel up to 24 hours into the past, instead of the usual 5. A Temporal Pouch can only be used once at a time on an individual Time Turner.
addons.title: Better Sands of Time

objects.text: You have a time turner, an object that can rewind time for up to five hours and cannot actively change the past without serious consequences. It is mainly used to gain more time on a certain day. Be careful not to create repeating Tuesdays or to erase people from the time stream.
objects.title: Time Turner (Harry Potter)

addons.title: Godsbane-class Battlesuit
addons.text: Instead of a mass-produced armor you receive a 4th-generation Battlesuit, built to allow Valkyries to defeat Herrschers by themselves. While the official description is clearly an exaggeration, the Battlesuit does increase all your capabilities to superhuman levels, and allows you to take a few solid hits from any Herrscher while dishing out similar damage in turn. This alone grants you the power of an S-rank Valkyrie, though you still need training and experience to actually reach their level. Your Battlesuit is automatically integrated into your Perfect Armor. You share a constant mental link with it, improving response time and movement. This also makes the suit impossible to hack as long as this connection persists, and nobody else can wear the armor or use the connected weapons unless you give explicit permission. You are not in risk of contracting Honkai Energy erosion while wearing the Battlesuit, even from its own reactor. Your advanced armor now includes all technologies from the other Battlesuit types that you did not choose, and its capabilities are further enhanced. The pocket dimension is tripled in size and can be controlled through the mental link. The wearer support system can inject you with harmless combat drugs that increase concentration and strengthen natural healing. The environmental defense system protects you from even the most hostile surroundings, such as areas with extreme temperatures, the bottom of the ocean, or the vacuum of space. The thrusters allow stable flight, or burst acceleration up to supersonic speeds. The energy shield is projected just above the skin and clothes of the wearer, enabling its use almost constantly, without any drawbacks, and will have the same defenses as your Perfect Armor. You may also upgrade all weapons gained from Valkyrie Equipment to their 4-star model. If you also have the Armorer addon you gain the knowledge of how to produce all Battlesuits from Honkai Impact 3rd, as well as how to artificially produce any materials they are constructed from.

addons.title: PRI-ARM
addons.text: High-ranking Valkyries are valuable assets. They are given the best accommodation, teams to support them, and of course the best weapons an organization can produce. And you in particular receive all the weapons. Your Perfect Weapon automatically integrates the design of every weapon that you can gain in the Honkai Impact 3rd game, except for the Divine Keys and their alternate forms, even if you normally would not be able to use them at your current level. This allows you to automatically transform your armament into over 300 unique weapons, each of them battle-tested and powerful, besides your weapon's normal arsenal. Though be warned, the more powerful any of these weapons are, the more demanding they are on their wielders, requiring talent and great practice to master even a single one. With just a 3rd-generation Battlesuit and baseline human strength you'll barely be able to unleash a fraction of their power. Meanwhile your Battlesuit is upgraded with a Spacetime Deceleration Engine, capable of bending space to slow down the speed of light, and making it appear as if time itself slowed or stopped. While you have free control over the compression of time, using it without a mental link to your Battlesuit requires precise inputs through your wrist computer. Slowing down the speed of light through this Engine has no adverse effects on you, other living beings, or the underlying physics of the world itself. You can use Spacetime Fracture to achieve 'super-speed' by slowing the world around you, or imprison a target in a bubble of stopped time with Spacetime Lock. With enough practice and fine control you could use this Engine to slow down incoming attacks, make barriers of stopped time that cannot be crossed by contemporary physics, or 'stutter' the space around you to effectively delete all kinetic energy. The Engine has to reset itself after each use. Short bursts of use in a fight will maybe take a few seconds to reset, while long-term activation may require hours of rest time. If you also have the Weapons Maker addon you gain the knowledge of how to produce each of these weapons, as well as how to artificially produce any materials they are constructed from.

addons.title: Ingenious Machine
addons.text: Your Battlesuit is upgraded with technology from Teyvat, including alchemy and machinery from Khaenri'ah that improve the Battlesuit's armor, Arkhe energy technology from Fontaine to increase its power stores, and the Akademiya's artificial god creation that allows the wearer to wield elemental energy without a Vision. The Honkai energy reactor in your armor can freely convert Honkai energy and Elemental energy into each other, allowing you to use elemental abilities and equipment. In addition to the weapons you already received you may choose and gain one weapon of every type introduced in the Genshin Impact game that is 3-star or below. If you have a Godsbane-class Battlesuit it will gain five slots into which you can imbue any applicable items, to add their stats and bonuses on top of your armor, though you can only have one item of any type slotted at once. You receive an archive of all possible Genshin Impact artifacts to insert or switch at any time, allowing you to easily activate set bonuses or change what aspects of your power are increased. If you have a PRI-ARM your weapon will integrate all weapons obtainable in the Genshin Impact game, though it does not include divine armaments like Musou Isshin. This grants your weapon over 250 additional unique forms, each of them with their own abilities and specializations. With your knowledge you can construct any of these artifacts and weapons yourself, though you need to find proper materials, and it will take time and effort to reach their original creators' skill.

addons.title: A Dream Yet to Be Seen
addons.text: Your Battlesuit is further upgraded with some of the best technology throughout the MiHoYo games, including armoring from the Glamoth Iron Cavalry, the Genius Society's various energy and quantum technologies, a Scepter system anchored in a pocket universe, and much more. If you have a Godsbane-class Battlesuit your artifact archive expands to include all possible Honkai: Star Rail relics, and you can set them in their appropriate slots to gain their set bonuses. The Circlet corresponds to the headpiece, the Plume to the hands, the Goblet to the body, the Sands to the footwear, and the Flower to any accessories. The Battlesuit also gains another two slots, consisting of the Planar Sphere and Link Rope that form, and connect to a conceptual world in your soul. The Planar Ornaments will be much stronger than their game counterpart, allowing you to draw power and authority from a variety of real Bubble Worlds in a similar manner to Durandal, granting you a limitless and exponentially expanding growth. If you have a PRI-ARM your weapon will integrate all armaments wielded by playable characters from the MiHoYo games, as well as all otherwise obtainable weapons. Notably your weapon has also integrated previously restricted weapons like the Divine Keys and the Archons' armaments. With your vast knowledge you can construct all these relics, weapons and more. You have a talent for easily finding suitable substitute materials, and it will not take long until you reach, and even surpass their original creators' skill.

objects.text: You receive a 3rd-generation Battlesuit, the standard armor for B-rank Valkyries, and a set of weaponry for their level. To facilitate your rise as a Valkyrie you may choose and receive one weapon of every type introduced in the Honkai Impact 3rd game that is 3-star or below; lower-ranked weapons may also be upgraded to their 3-star model. While your weapons aren't exactly mass-produced trash, they are still far from the best of Honkai-based technology. All weapons and equipment gained through this OoP and its addons are fully leveled and upgraded. Your Battlesuit has an inbuilt Honkai Energy reactor that keeps itself and all your Honkai-powered weapons running indefinitely, allowing you to use them even without a Stigma. While this power source is theoretically endless, it cannot be used to power outside technology, and running it in high-output mode, such as during a fight, will deplete its charge in about an hour. Your weapons only have internal batteries, and without a connection to your Battlesuit or another source of Honkai Energy will only last for a few attacks before losing functionality. Additionally using the Battlesuit in high-power mode for a long time, or fighting with it often after another without taking a proper rest, will slowly infect you with Honkai Energy erosion if you have no Honkai resistance or your physiology isn't up to par. The Battlesuit has a number of inbuilt technologies that increase its wearer's strength, speed and endurance to rival the pinnacle of non-enhanced humans. It also offers a small pocket dimension just large enough to fit your weapons and food for about a week, accessible over a small wrist computer or a row of quick-select buttons. Additionally, depending on its type, it gains a specialized system. You may only choose one of the following: The General Purpose Universal Combat Battlesuit boasts an advanced support system that automatically closes wounds and relieves damaged areas through specific fabric compression. This is linked to a basic environmental protection system that filters out toxins and radiation from the surroundings. The Close Quarter Assault Battlesuit has tiny inbuilt thrusters that allow you to increase your burst speed, the impact power of your fists and melee weapons, and boosts your jumping height. The Ranged Support Specialist Battlesuit features a basic energy shield centered around the wearer that can defend from most solid projectiles and low-power energy weapons, though sustained or high-caliber fire can overpower and temporarily disable it. It cannot selectively choose what it rejects, meaning you have to deactivate it to shoot out, let allies through, or in close spaces.
objects.title: Valkyrie Equipment (Honkai Impact 3rd)

objects.text:
The Tech Jacket is hailed as "the most powerful weapon in the universe". It is a highly advanced alien battle suit created by the Geldarians to compensate for their physical limitations.

Upgraded by the Colossal, it boasts a wide array of abilities, including energy projection, flight, interstellar travel, and invulnerability, and enhances all physical attributes by about 100 times, granting superhuman agility, stamina, reflexes, and speed, making the wearer incredibly fast and strong. 

The suit also offers self-sustenance, metamorphosis for creating weapons and defences, and the generation of protective force fields. Additionally, it provides host maintenance, eliminating the need for bathing and keeping the wearer clean-shaven.
objects.title: Tech Jacket (Invincible)

objects.text:
Fee, Fie, Foe, Fum Ask not whence the thunder comes. Ask not where the herds have gone. Nor why the birds have ceased their song. When coming home, don’t take too long For monsters roam in Albion.

Jack

You now possess the famous crown of King Erik, enabling you to command the obedience of the inhabitants of Gantua—the fierce giants. With this crown upon your brow, the giants will obey your every command without fail. Gantua is only accessible through the use of magic beans, which rapidly grow a beanstalk tall and large enough to pass even the clouds themselves. King Erik’s crown contains half a dozen of these beans in various small, hidden compartments. Each time a beanstalk dies, it will provide you with at least one bean to replace those used. The giants of Gantua are brutish and strong, equipped with crude weapons and armor. Despite how many giants may be called forth by the terrible power of the crown, there will always be more able to be summoned from Gantua.
objects.title: King Erik's Magic Crown (Jack the Giant Slayer)

objects.text:
"Tarakudo's reign came to an end when the spirits of his generals were trapped within masks; nine generals, nine masks."

You have come into possession of an Oni Mask, but not just any Oni Mask; this is the mask in which Tarakudo and his Oni generals were sealed.

When worn, it will meld with your head, partially transforming you into an Oni; in this state, you are able to summon Shadow Spirit Warriors known as Shadowkhan, who will serve you faithfully and without question.

Originally, wearing an Oni Mask would corrupt the wielder and drive them to insanity; however, your mask does not have this drawback and at most makes you sound rude or more likely to do minor bad things, like littering or stealing candy.

Shadowkhan are divided into nine Tribes with different specializations and appearances; but common amongst them is the ability to transform into and move through shadows, as well as phase through matter.

The nine tribes are:

- Ninja Khan: Once serving under the Oni General Rairakku, they are the most versatile of the tribes, having mastered all aspects of Ninjutsu. They wield tools such as ninja stars and swords.

- Razor Khan: Once serving under the Oni General Murasaki, they possess long-bladed fingers on their hands and are considered the fastest land Shadowkhan.

- Bat Khan: Once serving under the Oni General Kiiro, they are the fastest among the tribes and can fire shadowy beams from their hands, which can be used for attacks or binding others.

- Sumo Khan: Once serving under the Oni General Midori, they are among the largest Shadowkhan, possessing incredible strength and durability, making them nearly impervious to normal attacks unless they are superhuman.

- Samurai Khan: Once serving under the Oni General Ikazuki, they are fully armored master swordsmen, each wielding a blade of shadows capable of cutting through anything that lacks protection against dark magic.

- Squid Khan: Once serving under the Oni General Orenji, they are aquatic-like creatures capable of extending their tentacle arms and bodies great distances, along with being highly elastic.

- Crab Khan: Once serving under the Oni General Kuro, they are an attack-focused tribe with impressive height and strength. They have two claw arms — the left with crab-like pincers and the right intended for stabbing.

- Leech Khan: Once serving under the Oni General Mosugurīn, they seem harmless at first but are capable of devouring the shadows of others, robbing them of their life force. They grow in strength based on the size of their victims and the amount of shadow they've consumed.

- Mantis Khan: Once serving under the Oni General Aka, they are essentially giant praying mantises with fast, powerful bladed arms capable of cutting down anything that stands in their way.

While formidable, they are not without weaknesses; since they are not living creatures, they can be easily distracted and tricked, and they cannot speak to one another or to you; however, the latter is mitigated a bit, as you can get a general sense of what they have experienced.

In the beginning, you will be limited to drawing on one Tribe of Shadowkhan at a time; but with time and training, you will be able to summon multiple tribes. Should the day come when you can call upon all nine, you would have a force large enough to coat the world in Shadow and Darkness.

Should you wish it, you can summon up to nine different Oni Masks, each connected to a Shadowkhan Tribe, and give them to others to command the Shadowkhan, with you able to reclaim the gifted masks at any time.

Note: If you wear the mask too frequently, you will develop a natural affinity for Shadow Magic, which on its own will allow you to summon a handful of Shadowkhan even without wearing the mask; and envelop yourself in shadows to grant you the abilities of the Shadowkhan Tribes.
objects.title: Tarakudo's Mask (Jackie Chan Adventures)

addons.text: Your Inner Beast takes on the role and power of your cursed spirit, and is perfectly compatible with you.
addons.title: Perfect Bond

objects.text: "Come Rika. Give me everything." This ring was once used by Yuta Okkotsu to aid in controlling his Cursed Energy and Rika, the Queen of Curses. Now it's passed onto you with all of its benefits. It serves as a great conduit for channelling, controlling, and mastering your own supernatural energies, especially as a beginner, and will continue to do so long past that point. Most importantly, it has a cursed spirit sealed within that is soulbound and loyal to you. This can be any cursed spirit from Jujutsu Kaisen or of your own design. Though in the latter case, it cannot exceed Rika. The cursed spirit can be used as an additional reservoir of supernatural energy on par with Rika, grant access to its abilities through the ring, be summoned to fight alongside you, and be used as a pocket dimension of unlimited storage—which will keep all contents within at optimal condition. It can also operate autonomously without needing your command, as if anticipating your needs in the heat of the moment and providing assistance accordingly. From partially manifesting an arm to catch something you accidentally dropped, to binding an opponent to buy time for you. If you are unconscious or in great need, the cursed spirit can merge with your body to assume control over it, transforming you into a symbiotic hybrid of each other, like the case of Tsurugi Okkotsu. This amplifies both of your abilities tenfold, gradually healing you, and allow the spirit to pilot your body. Though once the form is relinquished, you cannot access the rings functions nor the cursed spirit for the next 24 hours. Note: If the cursed spirit is defeated or exorcised, it will gradually restore itself within the ring until it's ready to be summoned again.
objects.title: Cursed Ring (Jujutsu Kaisen)

objects.text:
You find yourself in possession of a collection of the specialized equipment used by the Defense Force, used by their soldiers to eradicate Kaiju, and crafted from their flesh. This collection includes one bodysuit (with an additional gasmask), several blades of various designs, and different types of firearms, with optional attachments. They will all be kept in a biometrically locked chest, which is about the size of a fridge, if not a little smaller. By default, only you can open the chest.

Each weapon has been forged from an alloy using a Kaiju's bones, and contains a Uni-Organ, the part of the Kaiju's body that allows them to exhibit special abilities. The bodysuit is interwoven with Kaiju muscle fibers and nerves, allowing it to connect to the wearer's nervous system. The purpose for this is to allow the user to draw upon the suit's power, granting superhuman levels of strength, agility, reflexes, and durability depending on the percentage of power one can activate. The suit's fibers can also compress and regenerate to cover wounds that might pierce it. For weapons, the percentage of activation will exponentially increase their cutting or penetrative power. For firearms in particular, different Uni-Organs can be swapped out to grant ammunition different qualities, such as fire, ice, acid or explosive.

Upon first acquiring this equipment, assuming you possess a baseline human body, you will become able to draw out anywhere from 5% to 10% of your suit and weapons' full power, increasing over time with training and effort.

Ammunition for firearms will be automatically be replenished every few hours from the chest. The chest will also repair and maintain all equipment stored inside.

If any equipment were to be broken or completely destroyed, they will all be restored in one month's time, starting with when the first was broken.
objects.title: Defense Force Anti-Kaiju Equipment (Kaiju No. 8)

addons.text: You now possess the knowledge of the Decadriver’s true function, to enable to creation of a destroyer of worlds. Not only do you become more powerful, but you can also imprint cards with warriors you have defeated instead of making bonds with them.
addons.title: Violent Emotion

objects.text:
A transformation belt that can be used to allow you to become a Kamen Rider. A masked warrior, granted great abilities and armaments to fight with! Whether it be for justice, or for evil.

To add on, this belt comes with a variety of cards, many of which blank and ready to be imprinted with a warrior that you have made a significant bond with to earn their power. With different cards, whether to change into their form, access their alternative forms and abilities, to wield a finisher based off of them, or even to temporarily reform them into a weapon for your use!
objects.title: Decadriver (Kamen Rider)

objects.text:
You have discovered a device that can transform the user into a masked rider, typically known as a Kamen Rider. These riders possess extraordinary powers and tools to combat evil, often in the name of justice. However, the device can be used for both noble and nefarious purposes, as some users have assumed roles as heroes while others have embraced villainy. Each Kamen Rider device is unique in its abilities and design. Over time, your abilities as a Kamen Rider will strengthen, unlocking the full potential that resides within you. Your journey as a Kamen Rider is just beginning.

Every Kamen Rider can transform by activating the device while wearing it. This transformation envelops the user in an armored suit that bestows unique abilities based on the user's personality, such as time manipulation, magic, vampire-like powers, and more. The transformation also provides distinct gadgets, including a motorcycle, a sword, or a gun, each with unique abilities linked to the user's powers. These weapons can unleash powerful moves by activating them, similar to the belt's transformation process.

When the user needs extra power, they can reactivate the device to achieve a super form. This transformation significantly boosts the user's abilities and introduces a unique power that enhances the previously granted ability. In some cases, it may even provide a completely new ability.

Additionally, you may acquire any Canon Transformation Gear instead of a generic Transformation Gear. However, this gear will operate at the level it had at the beginning of the Kamen Rider's journey, gradually evolving into its full potential as you progress through your adventure, and may even surpass the might of the original.
objects.title: Kamen Rider Transformation Gear (Kamen Rider)

objects.text:
You gain the Bear Onesie, as well as other equipment related to the set. Each of these items has unique abilities:

Bear Onesie: It doesn’t get dirty, releasing a pleasant scent and neutralising bad ones. Heat resistant, cold resistant and water repellent. Grants boosted stats and aim assist. Area Detection and Mapping. Wearing the hood grants the ability to analyse the effects of tools and weapons. 

Black Bear's Glove: Boost damage dealt. Magic amplification. Grants the ability to summon Swaying Bear.

White Bear’s Glove: Boost defense. Magic amplification. Grants the ability to summon Hugging Bear.

Black Bear’s Shoe/White Bear’s Shoe: Increases speed and grants limitless stamina when walking.

Bear Underwear: Does not get dirty, no matter how much sweat and other stuff tries to stick to it. A more pleasant scent replaces the smell of sweat. The size changes as the wearer grows.

Magic used when wearing the set is greatly boosted, and gains a bear theme
objects.title: Bear Onesie (Kuma Kuma Kuma Bear)

addons.text: Doran's Ring for regeneration and the Mana Cube for amplification—both are essential tools for any aspiring mage. These two items resonate with each other, creating a synergy that elevates them beyond their individual capabilities. With this evolution, Doran's Ring can now store up to five spells of your choosing per day, and its regeneration rate has been enhanced to 65%. Additionally, the ring boosts your Mana Cube's effectiveness, amplifying its power to 65% as well.
addons.title: Basic Mage's Kit

objects.text: A simple magical ring, crafted by the Wuju Master Doran, wearing it gives a trio of abilities. While wearing the ring, you gain a minor magical boost in strength or effectiveness to any of your supernatural powers. Additionally, it increases the regeneration of any magic or power's energy by 50% as long as the ring is on. Lastly, wearing the ring grants a minor increase to your constitution, enabling you to heal slightly faster.
objects.title: Doran's Ring (League of Legends)

objects.text:
You gain the ability to wield the masks of Termina, legendary artifacts imbued with the spirits and abilities of beings tied to their history. These masks are divided into three distinct categories: Magical Masks, Transformative Masks, and Locked Masks. You can choose 5 Magical Masks, 3 Transformative Masks, and 1 Locked Mask to form your mask collection. 

Magical Masks grant you limited but potent powers without altering your form. For example, the Mask of Truth allows you to read the minds of objects, animals, and people you touch, while the Stone Mask makes others ignore your presence as if you were were invisible. 

Transformative Masks allow you to transform instantly into powerful forms, granting you the strengths and abilities of the entities they represent. Removing a Transformative Mask returns you to your original state. These masks include the Deku Mask, which grants agility, bubble magic, and water-skipping; the Goron Mask, which gives immense strength and rolling speed; the Zora Mask, which enhances swimming and grants aquatic abilities; and the Giant’s Mask, which temporarily increases your size and strength. Additionally, you can select a mask tied to another limited magical race, such as Elves, Dwarves, Tieflings, Nymphs, or Centaurs, each offering unique transformations based on that race's traits.

Locked Masks are the most powerful but require you to prove your worth before they will grant their strength. For instance, the Fierce Deity Mask, a divine artifact crafted by the gods themselves, transforms you into a towering warrior of unmatched might, while the Majora’s Mask, tied to an ancient evil, offers incredible destructive power at the cost of potential corruption. Locked Masks can also represent other powerful races or forces, such as a Dragon Mask that imbues you with draconic might or an Angel Mask tied to celestial power. These masks must be unlocked through trials, challenges, or by demonstrating mastery over their essence. 

You can only wear one mask at a time, and transformations require brief moments of focus. Switching masks mid-battle requires careful timing and tactical foresight. While Termina’s masks cannot be destroyed, they remain physical objects and can be lost or stolen if not guarded carefully. However, their spiritual bond to you ensures that they may always find a way back, should you prove worthy.
objects.title: Masks of Termina (Legend of Zelda)

objects.text:
The secret stones are artifacts which amplify the talents of their wielders to grant them immense, potentially godlike power. 

Examples include Rauru, whose affinity for light magic was boosted until he could wipe out armies with a single blast, and Ganondorf, who gained the power to drown entire kingdoms in Gloom and summon endless hordes of obedient monsters. Both had a great deal of natural power, so don't expect to become a living god with this alone, but if you're strong enough you could be raised to a level that dwarfs even them. 

Additionally, you can perform the forbidden act of draconification by swallowing your stone, transforming you into an immortal dragon incomparably more powerful than even your boosted state but consuming your mind and reducing you to animal instinct only vaguely guided by your previous emotions.
objects.title: Secret Stone (Legend of Zelda)

objects.text:
You have received a dwarven mask of the kingdom of Belegost. These full-head greathelms, fitted with retractable visors, were forged by some of the greatest dwarven smiths of the first age. 

As with all dwarf-craft, dwarven masks are exceptionally durable, but unlike others they also bear other powerful protective enchantments. 

When the visor of a dwarven mask is closed the wearer becomes nigh-immune to fire or heat equivalent to dragon-flame, smoke, and poisonous gases, and also gain great resistance to mind-affecting curses such as Dragonspell (although these protections only remain in place while the visor remains closed and a typical wearer of a dwarven mask with an unclosed visor is as vulnerable as any other individual would be).

It was the mask-wearing bodyguard of Azaghâl, Lord of Belegost, who stood against the First Dragon Glaurung and forced him to flee the Nirnaeth Arnoediad (the Battle of Unnumbered Tears) out of injury, when no other part of the allied faithful-human, dwarven, and elven force of the Union of Maedhros could withstand the dragon’s fiery breath.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​ 

The sacrifice of many of Azaghâl’s guard, and their lord, allowed the Sons of Fëanor and the others of the Eastern Host who survived Ulfang’s treachery to retreat from the battle: although afterwards no force retained sufficient strength to openly oppose Morgoth, until the coming of the host of Valinor and the War of Wrath.
objects.title: Dwarven Mask (Lord of the Rings)

objects.text:
You have gained a coat of Dwarf-made Ringmail, a creation on par with the greatest armour in Middle-earth, barring the use of exotic metals such as Mithril or Galvorn.

This mail requires little to no maintenance as it will neither rust nor weaken with age, and the rings of which it is comprised are extremely resistant to damage compared with any regular armour. Further, the mail is rather lighter than one might expect for its composition, and its component rings shall subtly shift on their own to partially cushion incoming blows, rendering the use of padding underneath unnecessary in most situations.

However, the coat is still made up of metal rings, so thin enough blades may push through gaps in its coverage, and it is far from indestructible; a hard enough strike with a sufficiently sharp and strong blade (or a particularly heavy club or maul) shall still cause injury to the wearer. The mail also provides no significant protection beyond what regular armour offers against anything other than physical damage, although many enchanted weapons will struggle to pierce it.
objects.title: Dwarven Ringmail (Lord of the Rings)

objects.text:
You have gained a Lesser Ring, one of hundreds crafted by the Elven-smiths of Eregion as an "essay in craft" during their early experiments in ring-making. Though only a shallow reflection of the Great Rings, it still enhances the wearer's natural abilities and strength of spirit: albeit to a far lesser degree; and allows them to become invisible to most by half-stepping into the Unseen World.

This Ring is subject to the control of the One, should it exist in your world. However, it is so weak in comparison that the One’s wielder would be unlikely to expend the effort to dominate you unless they were greatly weakened.
objects.title: Lesser Ring (Lord of the Rings)

addons.text: The Ring no longer contains a mere fragment of Sauron’s power, but his entire being. All his dark cunning and wisdom is yours to command. From within the ring, Sauron can act as advisor and mentor, teaching you all manner of magics and other skills. With his aid, you could even learn to make new rings of power, binding them to you. Sauron will be irrevocably trapped within the ring, never able to escape, and he will be made perfectly aware of this fact. He will instead try to manipulate you to his ends. While you might no longer be capable of fully taking over the ring, you may instead earn Sauron's respect, eventually having him view you as his worthy successor, leaving things to your judgment.
addons.title: The Lord in the Ring

objects.text:
“One Ring to rule them all, One Ring to find them, One Ring to bring them all and in the darkness bind them.”

Crafted in secret by the Dark Lord Sauron in the fire of Orodruin, the ring contains a fragment of his power. Contained within is the power of a Maiar; those who wear the ring feel its power seeping into them, gaining the might once held by Sauron.

The most basic and first power to manifest is invisibility, except for those who can see beyond the non-physical mortal plain. This invisibility is not true invisibility, only shunting your body between dimensions so as not to be seen.

Following the manifestation of the previous power, you would see a noticeable increase in defense when wearing the one ring, gaining an enhanced body being able to bear attacks far greater than previously able to, as well as enhanced senses and immortality given so long as the ring is worn or near the bearer.

The previous two abilities would be projecting a false vision of reality to others, appearing superior to before, affecting the minds of others, and granting inspiration to others. Furthermore, you also gain the ability to naturally understand the speech of evil creatures and an increased understanding of language in general. 

Should you master the power within the ring, the ring will acknowledge you as its new master, allowing you access to the power hidden inside the ring augmenting your abilities to further heights, such as the power of the Maiar. Sauron, held inside, can Dominate others, in addition to his other abilities as a Maiar. This ring is loyal now only to you so long as you have gained mastery, and the sentience of the ring corrupts all others wishing to get back to you. The ring has all the powers of the other rings, but to a far greater extent given that it was created with the might of a Maiar.
objects.title: The One Ring (Lord of the Rings)

objects.text:
You have gained a Djinn, a powerful magical lifeform now residing within an object in your possession—such as a weapon or accessory—transforming it into a Metal Vessel. Djinn are Lawful Neutral beings created from the Rukh and retain the memories and personalities of specific individuals from the various races of Alma Torran. These entities bestow immense power upon those they bond with.

Typically, a Djinn is obtained by conquering a dungeon created by a Magi, after which the victor becomes a King Vessel. The Djinn then inhabits an item the individual possessed at the time. Although Djinns do not battle directly, they can manifest from their Metal Vessels to communicate with their wielder. Allies close to you may also be granted Household Vessels—objects that carry a fragment of the Djinn's power.

A Metal Vessel grants access to two transformative abilities: Djinn Weapon Equip and Djinn Equip. While channeling a Djinn’s power typically requires training and discipline, you already possess full mastery over your Djinn, allowing you to access both forms at will. However, using these abilities consumes Magoi—the energy source required for magic—and can be physically taxing without proper control.

Djinn Weapon Equip surrounds the Metal Vessel with Magoi, condensing it into a powerful weapon imbued with the Djinn's magic. Djinn Equip, on the other hand, allows you to assume a humanoid form of the Djinn itself, granting you their magic, elemental affinity, and incredible physical and magical enhancements.

In this form, your strength, speed, and power are significantly amplified—enough to reshape landscapes or destroy a small country with ease. Djinn Equip users can also fly at high speeds, regenerate from injuries, and replenish their Magoi by absorbing the same element associated with their Djinn (e.g., lava for a fire Djinn).

You also gain access to your Djinn's ultimate technique: Extreme Magic. This powerful ability requires a chant to activate and consumes a vast amount of Magoi, making it a trump card used only in dire situations. Extreme Magic is capable of unleashing destruction on a massive scale, such as summoning a tsunami capable of leveling a city.

In some cases, Metal Vessels attuned to the same type of magic can synchronize their powers, provided the Djinns are all contracted to the same King Vessel. However, in your case, you can only use two Djinns of the same magic type together at a time.

Each time you select this option, you receive one Djinn already sealed within a Metal Vessel of your choice. You may freely choose the type and element of the Djinn. However, you cannot possess more than seven Djinns, as the human body cannot withstand channeling the power of more. You also gain a considerable amount of Magoi, enabling you to access and sustain your Djinn Weapon Equip and Djinn Equip effectively.
objects.title: Metal Vessel (Magi: The Labyrinth of Magic)

addons.text:
When the Astral Diving Suit and Astral Harpoon are combined, they form the Astral Diving Set, a seamlessly integrated system designed to enhance underwater survival and combat capabilities. The harpoon attaches securely to the suit’s left forearm through a reinforced mounting bracket, which uses durable clamps and magnetic locks to ensure stability even during intense use. The integration connects the harpoon to the suit’s HUD, allowing real-time tracking of its status, including the remaining tether length, impact alerts, and retraction tension. A simple crosshair overlay in the HUD provides rudimentary targeting assistance. The harpoon’s diesel engine is bypassed in favor of drawing power directly from the suit’s diesel-electric hybrid system, reducing its weight and simplifying fuel management.

For convenience, the harpoon can be holstered on the back of the suit when not in use, secured by a foldable bracket that allows quick deployment. The suit’s propulsion jets automatically counteract the recoil of firing the harpoon, providing stability and control underwater, though the bulk and weight of the combined set make movement on land even more cumbersome.

Comes with a laminated manual titled, “So You’ve Got an Astral Diving Set!”, featuring overly cheerful illustrations and a troubleshooting section filled with ominous warnings about “tentacle misfires.”
addons.title: Astral Diving Set (Magical Girl ☆Sym-tan☆)

objects.text:
You own the Astral Diving Suit, a rugged and utilitarian underwater suit designed for deep-sea exploration and survival in hostile aquatic environments. Weighing a hefty 500 lbs, the suit is constructed from pressure-resistant titanium alloy and reinforced with tungsten carbide plates. This combination provides durability against crushing depths and underwater hazards. Its surface has a dark, matte finish with subtle, reflective flecks that give it an otherworldly glow in dim light. The suit is not sleek or elegant; its blocky, utilitarian design emphasizes function over aesthetics, and it shows signs of wear from years of use.

The suit’s helmet is a key feature, incorporating a reinforced polycarbonate dome with a thin titanium framework for protection. A basic HUD is projected onto the visor, displaying essential information such as depth, oxygen levels, and directional bearings. The HUD also includes a rudimentary compass and a light sensor to warn you of sudden changes in visibility. Illumination is provided by two mounted headlamps on either side of the helmet, offering a decent but not overwhelming beam to cut through the gloom. These lamps run on a simple rechargeable battery pack that can be swapped out or recharged using the suit’s solar panels when above water.

The life support system is built for simplicity and reliability. The suit can sustain a wearer for up to 24 hours, recycling oxygen through a compact, cartridge-based filtration system. While it cannot extract oxygen from the water, the suit includes a backup tank for emergencies. A small valve allows for quick tank replacement, though the suit requires the wearer to manually manage their oxygen supply—a potentially dangerous limitation in high-pressure situations. 

Mobility in water is achieved through rudimentary propulsion jets on the back and legs. These jets are powered by a diesel-electric hybrid engine built into the suit’s torso, allowing for a maximum speed of 5 knots. The design sacrifices speed for durability; the propulsion system is noisy and clunky, but it will function even after taking damage. The suit’s joints are articulated, allowing for a reasonable range of motion underwater, though movement remains sluggish.

While designed primarily for underwater use, the Astral Diving Suit can function on land, albeit awkwardly. Hydraulic pistons in the legs and arms enable limited movement outside water, though the wearer must contend with the suit’s weight, making every step feel like dragging a sandbag uphill. Walking on land drains power rapidly, making this feature impractical for extended use but invaluable in emergencies.

The suit includes several practical survival features, though nothing excessive. A small, chest-mounted storage compartment allows for carrying essential tools or rations. There’s a retractable, wrist-mounted utility blade, useful for cutting through tangled nets or ropes, and a basic grappling system with a manual crank for scaling short distances or anchoring in strong currents. The communication system is limited to short-range radio transmissions, with a simple Morse code feature in case the primary system fails.

The Astral Diving Suit’s rugged construction makes it resistant to physical damage, but it’s far from invincible. The seals require regular maintenance to prevent leaks, and the propulsion system is prone to clogging if debris enters the intakes. The lack of sophisticated tech means the suit relies heavily on the wearer’s skill and judgment, making it as much a test of endurance as a tool for survival. 

Legend has it that the Astral Diving Suit was not merely designed for survival, but forged as a bulwark against the will of ancient sea gods, eldritch entities that once stirred from the ocean’s abyssal depths to challenge humanity. Its origins are steeped in tales of desperation and ingenuity, with whispers suggesting it was constructed from the wreckage of a vessel dragged to the bottom of the sea by these otherworldly beings. Salvaged from cursed timber and twisted metals warped by the pressure of the deep, the suit is believed to carry a faint residue of the entities’ presence, rendering it resistant to direct manipulation by magic or supernatural powers.

Supernatural legends aside, the suit is a reliable, no-frills piece of equipment, valued more for its practicality than any fanciful features.

(Note: You only have one diving suit. It comes with a free, water resistant plush starfish companion, which can magnetically attach to the suit for decoration.)
objects.title: Astral Diving Suit (Magical Girl ☆Sym-tan☆)

objects.text:
You have been chosen by the Cloak of Levitation as its master. Be gracious, for it is a fickle and willful. While wearing the cloak, you will be able to fly through the air and levitate at will. The cloak will occasionally protect you from attacks it perceives, making it nearly impossible to catch you off guard.

If damaged, the cloak will slowly repair itself, although this process can be sped up if supplied with thread. Managing to damage the cloak is a feat of its own. Although its known for its remarkable red, your cloak can come in a color of your choosing.
objects.title: Cloak of Levitation (Marvel)

objects.text:
The Eternity Mask is a magical artifact created by a group of renegade occultists using a fragment of Eternity’s own essence, intended to make ordinary peasants the equals of Arthur’s knights. This powerful item has influenced some of the most significant events in human history.

Whoever wears the mask gains power equal to that of any opponent, so long as the opponent’s natural ability is not below the wearer’s. This means an untrained peasant could battle the Black Knight for three days straight or face cosmic beings like the Beyonder and Phoenix Force on equal footing.

However, the mask is powerless in the hands of those who intend to commit evil. It also grants the wearer a guiding awareness, compelling them to lead others toward places and events where they are most needed to resolve coming crises. Still, its power cannot exceed that of Eternity itself, making it ineffective against beings who surpass abstract entities.
objects.title: Eternity Mask (Marvel)

addons.text:
Your Symbiote has been converted into the Wet Skin, a weapon once meant to replace the Hard Skin made from a lobotomised Klyntar prisoner of war.

Your Symbiote can now burrow into your skin, replacing your blood while retaining its Klyntar properties, allowing it to both remain concealed and break out to fulfil its role. Similarly, as its consciousness has been completely eradicated it is under your complete control rather than being a symbiotic partner.
addons.title: Wet Skin

objects.text:
Designed by the Shi’ar Kin Crimson, the Hard Skin is a set of implants that allow the user to create and control a form of hard-light ‘Red Light’. Traditionally this is used to manifest a set of red armour on command, but this is far from its only use.

The Hard Skin’s manipulation of this ‘Red Light’ is most often used to create hard-light constructs. From simple forcefields, to swords and the aforementioned armour, to multiple autonomous duplicates of enemies. Similarly, these constructs can be used to allow the user flight.

Beyond this however, it can also sustain the user in deep space for a limited time (though high-speed spaceflight would still require a ship).
objects.title: Hard Skin (Marvel)

objects.text:
While worn, the Crown grants the wearer the powers of Hela Odinsdottir. The wearer's physical capabilities are boosted to those of an Asgardian, granting immense strength, speed, durability, and stamina. It enables the creation of weapons and armor at will, including swords, spears, axes, bows, and more. The weapons created carry a necromantic taint; any wound by them takes much longer to heal. The Crown also grants the wearer complete mastery over every weapon it creates.

The Crown serves as a focus for divine and magical powers, greatly helping in those related to Death. The Crown itself is invulnerable to all but the strongest of weapons and even then can repair itself.
objects.title: Hela's Crown (Marvel)

addons.title: Abyss Scarab
addons.text:
Your Klyntar and Scarab have combined, becoming a new creature known as an Abyss Scarab. Not only does it possess all the abilities of a Klyntar and a Reach Scarab, but the Abyss Scarab is also much stronger and no longer has the vulnerabilities to fire and sound. The Scarab is physically strong enough to overpower members of a Lantern Corps, and it no longer has the issue of removing it from the user's spine being lethal. As a Klyntar, it can remove itself with a command and even attach itself to the host on a genetic level.

The Scarab's AI has also merged with the Klyntar's consciousness, granting it superintelligence on top of a Klyntar's ability to connect to a host's mind. This allows the Abyss Scarab to possess human-like empathy and share its mental capacity and knowledge with the host, allowing them to do things such as maintain multiple thought processes and download information directly into their mind. However, the Abyss Scarab's primary ability will always be its adaptability, which has been further enhanced by the merge.

The Scarab now possesses the ability to alter the host's body without harming the host or their consciousness, granting the user a new capacity for shapeshifting, such as transforming into animals, vehicles, or other forms. Combined with a Klyntar's ability to generate matter, this gives the Abyss Scarab a nearly endless capacity to create, mix, and match weapons, making the only limits the user's imagination and knowledge. Additionally, due to possessing a Klyntar's abilities, the Scarab can now change to any color with a command, and not only can it have offspring, but any offspring it produces will also possess all the abilities of an Abyss Scarab.

objects.text:
The Symbiotes, or Klyntars, are an inorganic, amorphous, and symbiotic species created from the Living Abyss at the dawn of the universe by the elder god of darkness, Knull. An incident that destabilized the symbiote hive-mind led to the Klyntars rebelling against their creator, ultimately imprisoning him within an artificial planet. They named both the planet and themselves "Klyntar," meaning "cage" in their language.

Symbiotes are genderless beings that reproduce asexually, and while they lack individual names without a host, they differentiate themselves through unique emotional patterns. They feed on their host’s adrenaline and have a craving for phenethylamine, a chemical found in brains, which has led some symbiotes to consume the brains of other creatures. Fortunately, phenethylamine is also found in chocolate.

When bonded with a host, Klyntars enhance their partner’s physical abilities and powers. They boost strength, durability, stamina, speed, agility, and can even provide a healing factor. For example, a normal human bonded with a symbiote could match or even surpass Spider-Man in strength.

They also possess a range of other abilities, including ageless immortality, shapeshifting, mental communication with their host, reading the host’s memories, and controlling the host's actions to some degree (although strong-willed hosts can resist and even reverse this control). Klyntars can provide survival in extreme environments like space or underwater and possess a danger sense. Their latent psychic abilities make them resistant to telepaths as well.

Symbiotes leave behind traces of the Living Abyss in their hosts, granting those they bond with access to the powers of previous hosts, regardless of how long the bond lasted. Even supernatural beings can be infused with symbiote codices. Additionally, Klyntars have a genetic memory, allowing them access to their parent's knowledge and powers. For instance, Venom's descendants inherited Spider-Man's abilities. While symbiotes grow stronger with each new host, their genetic memory also gives them psychosomatic weaknesses to intense fire and sound, a vulnerability carried down from their painful creation by Knull.

As creatures born from the Living Abyss, Klyntars can bond with inorganic materials, allowing them to interface, augment, and merge with machinery, such as Iron Man’s armor or spaceships. They are also capable of killing gods and absorbing their divinity. However, their most dangerous ability is the power to corrupt all of creation with darkness, making it an extension of their own being.

You can choose which symbiote to bond with, whether it’s an established one like Venom or Sleeper, or even create your own. Rest assured, your symbiote will never betray you.
objects.title: Klyntar (Marvel)

objects.text: You’ve stumbled upon the ruined ship of the great Makulan explorer Axonn-Karr, having traveled the cosmos in search of intelligent life, only to be mistaken as a monster and mortally wounded by scared natives once he had found them. Having directed his ship into hiding while he attempted to abate his injuries, he nonetheless would succumb to them, his people unaware of his location he would remain alone, forgotten for millennia until luck would have you stumbling upon it. The vast majority of the ship’s technology is defunct, having long since withered and rusted away, but thankfully for you perhaps the most important piece of Makulan technology managed to survive. The Rings are ten cylinders of Makulan technology, each housing the soul of a long dead cosmic warrior, trapped in a phantasmal state by the devices. Each of the rings provide a different set of abilities. The first is the Remaker, which will allow the one who wears it the ability to manipulate the atomic and molecular structure of matter. This can be used to solidify gas, change lead to gold, to even healing others. The second is Influence, allows the manipulation of force, predominantly in the form of concussive and sonic beams and blasts. The third is Spin, which allows the manipulation of air. Most often used to create a powerful vortex, this ring can be used to propel the wearer through the air and levitate and manipulate objects. This can be used as a form of pseudo-telekinesis. The fourth is Spectral, which can be used to project beams that destroy the bonds between atoms and molecules, causing whatever was hit to disintegrate. Has a secondary ability that can allow the user to turn invisible. The fifth is Nightbringer, which can enshroud a large area in darkness. The sixth is Daimonic, amongst the most versatile of the rings, this one allows the manipulation of electromagnetic energy. This can be used to create powerful blinding blasts of light, magnetic levitation and manipulation, and can be used to create holographic images. Also grants some control over gravity. The seventh is Incandescence, which allows the wearer to produce blasts of infrared to produce flame or ignite combustible materials. The eighth is The Liar, which grants the wearer powerful telepathic abilities, allowing one to tap into and manipulate the thoughts of others, cast illusions, and even paralyze others. The ninth is Lightning, which allows one to project powerful blasts of electrical energy. The tenth and final one is Zero, which allows the user to project powerful waves and blasts of intense cold and ice, capable of flashing freezing within seconds.
objects.title: Mandarin Rings (Marvel)

objects.text: You have acquired a Nova Corps Helmet – a standalone, self-powered marvel of gravimetric engineering forged by a now-forgotten civilization. Unlike those tied to the Marvel multiverse, these helmets function independently, containing their own Nova Core reactors and embedded AIs. They operate without a Worldmind or central command, relying entirely on your growing synergy and mastery to unlock their full potential. Your journey begins with a Corpsman-class helmet, but through rigorous use, combat experience and understanding of gravimetric control, your helmet will evolve – unlocking higher ranks as your bond with it deepens. Each rank improves the helmet’s Nova Core output, AI capabilities and combat efficiency Corpsman A standard-issue combat helmet for entry-level users. Grants moderate superhuman strength, subsonic flight and energy blasts strong enough to pierce armor or knock out light vehicles. Offers limited durability – protection from bullets, extreme temperatures and vacuum for brief periods. AI provides basic translation, HUD readouts and auto-targeting. Once you have sufficiently adapted to its systems, the helmet will recalibrate and elevate its protocols—unlocking the Millennian stage. Millennian An upgraded rank focused on exploration and fleet combat. Enhanced Nova Core output allows extended deep-space survival and supersonic flight. Energy blasts now carry enough force to disable small starcrafts or fortified barriers. AI integration allows for multi-language communication, threat hierarchy and limited predictive combat. Mastering battlefield navigation and energetic modulation allows ascension to the Denarian class. Denarian A specialist combatant and tactician’s helmet. Superior gravimetric channeling allows flight at near-light speeds and strength high enough to tear through tanks or mechs. Can generate forcefields capable of withstanding heavy artillery and vacuum exposure indefinitely. AI includes battle sim algorithms, squad support overlays and advanced enemy analysis. One you demonstrate command-level adaptability and precision, the helmet reconfigures into the elite Centurion rank. Centurion Elite command-rank helmet. Your gravimetric manipulation rivals orbital weaponry – mass manipulation, focused beam attacks, and singularity-like pulse are possible. Durability reaches the level of surviving atmospheric reentry and direct hits from starship weapons. The AI allows multi-target coordination, sub-network creation (for squad-linked helmets), and advanced spatial warping for tactical movement. With enough experience and internal harmony the helmet’s core begins to resonate with your will – paving the way for optional upgrades like the Nova Prime Helmet or the Supernova Helmet, should you choose to wield greater command or overwhelming force. But such advancements require lifetimes worth of commitment and experience
objects.title: Nova Corps Helmet (Marvel)

objects.text:
A sleek, belt-mounted module or wristband—your choice in design—this device allows you to safely generate, store, and manipulate Pym Particles for your own use. Designed with redundant safeguards, it ensures size-shifting is smooth, stable, and entirely under your control.

With this device, you gain the ability to alter your size at will, shrinking down to subatomic scale or growing to towering, kaiju-like proportions. While miniature, your physical strength remains unchanged, letting you strike with full power despite your reduced stature. As you grow larger, your strength, durability, and endurance rise exponentially, making each step a seismic threat. You bypass the square-cube law entirely, allowing your body to remain fully functional no matter how much your size changes.

Shrinking beyond the limits of ordinary matter lets you slip into the Microverse, a strange, alternate realm accessible only through extreme miniaturization. Likewise, expanding your body far enough allows you to briefly brush against Overspace, a vast higher-dimensional domain. While shrunken, you do not require air, food, or water to survive—your body is sustained directly through the effects of the Pym Particles themselves.

In addition, the harness subtly enhances your control over your own density. You can make yourself lighter than air or denser than steel, enabling feats like gliding, phasing through certain materials, or withstanding powerful blows. Your physiology is also reinforced against the strain of such extreme transformation. Your muscles, bones, and organs adjust in real-time to prevent collapse or injury, allowing you to fight, maneuver, and survive under otherwise impossible conditions.
objects.title: Pym Particle Harness (Marvel)

objects.text:
The Quantum Bands, bestowed upon chosen Protectors of the Universe by the cosmic being Eon, are unparalleled artifacts of energy manipulation and boundless power. These legendary devices channel quantum energy to produce a vast array of extraordinary effects, granting their bearer mastery over the entire electromagnetic spectrum—from radio waves to gamma radiation.

With the Bands, a wielder can project, absorb, and manipulate countless forms of energy, even drawing upon the life-force of highly energized beings. They can shape this energy into complex constructs, ranging from planetary-scale satellite networks to shields capable of withstanding simultaneous assaults from titans like Hulk and Thor—each feat demanding immense focus and time to realize.

Beyond their raw power, the Quantum Bands enhance the user’s physical capabilities to superhuman levels, endowing strength and durability to rival cosmic entities such as the Watchers. They also enable interstellar flight, instantaneous teleportation, and protection against psychic intrusion through the emission of a unique jamming wave that nullifies mind-control attempts.
objects.title: Quantum Bands (Marvel)

addons.text:
The Darkhawk Amulet has merged with your Omnitrix, allowing it access to Null-Space, where it would usually store your body. This has expanded its shapeshifting to take cues from your alien device, letting it transform as you do. However, the Raptor’s adaptive suite will naturally work to ‘improve’ these forms, creating weapons and functionalities that grow from their various abilities and powers, and mitigating or even nullifying notable weaknesses to them.

The Raptor keeps a dedicated library of its adaptations through the Datasong it can transmit to you and call on at any time, even without transforming, though it may need to make more changes to make themes sustainable.
addons.title: Omnikix+

addons.text:
The Omega-1 Nanite has been woven through the Raptor android as integral pieces. This has had the dual effect of making the Nanites incredibly difficult to remove from you due to their presence in Null Space, and the division of the Amulet amongst them, allowing you to switch places with the Android on a whim even without the Amulet itself present. 

The adaptive capabilities of the Android has also been overclocked, able to make rapid and acute adaptations to situations as opposed to relying on downtime modifications and preset ‘modes’. In a similar way the Raptor’s connection to Null Space allows it to use it as a kind of constantly available active pocket dimension more than before.

Similarly, as the Android has been fully merged with the nanites, the Datasong and its processors have not only enhanced their individual processing power massively, but greatly increased your fine control over the nanites and the constructions you make from them. This control is so fine that the android’s cataloguing of various attacks and energies could easily be adapted to copy any number of power sources such as X-Genes and Ionic energies; alternatively, it could adapt its scanners to scrape entire civilisations for technology to integrate into its systems, as has already been done with the Shi’ar.
addons.title: Theta Nanite

addons.text:
You are the intelligence stored within the android itself rather than its wielder. As the Android itself you administrate the Datasong and your adaptations to help the Host. 

More than this though is the most insidious adaptation of the Fraternity of Raptors. With enough time to integrate yourself with your host, you can force them out of the ‘driver’s seat’ so to speak, trapping them within the Tree of Shadows inNull Space, essentially stealing their place in real space to act as you will.
addons.title: Razor

objects.text:
You have gained the Darkhawk Amulet. Constructed by the Shi’ar, the amulet itself has a simple function, exchanging the place of the user with a winged android designed for war. The android is usually kept within a crystal in Null Space, but while the bodies are exchanged, the user can control the raptor android as if it were their own body.

The centrepiece of a Raptor’s capabilities is the ability to absorb and manipulate vast quantities and varieties of energies such as optic blasts, heat based cutting tools, defensive shielding or teleportation to name a few, with a mind towards utilising and analysing novel forms of energy discovered while the android is in use.

The android itself possesses dramatically greater physical abilities than a mundane human. Vastly Faster, stronger, and more durable, able to shrug off artillery fire like the wind and tear through starship hulls with strength alone. Additionally, they possess a sensory array complete with telescopic, microscopic, and infra-red vision and AI assisted targeting. 

The android is also possessed of flight capabilities, though these are locked to Trans-sonic speeds in atmosphere, once a safe distance away this cap is rescinded to true Trans-Light speed for interstellar travel.

Not only that, but they possess advanced adaptability technology, allowing them to adjust themselves on the fly through the same mechanisms as their self-repair systems. This allows the pilot to manifest weaponry and entire complex systems from the android through their concentration.

These constructions extend to full alternate modes, though these take time to develop, most Raptors begin with a full suite for various mission types (Strike Mode, Disguise Skin Mode, Warflight  Mode etc). Similarly, though they are not innately magical, they can be used as a conduit for magic with their user while exchanged, and can even be enchanted as any other object.

Finally, the Raptor connects to the user’s brain through a mechanism known as the Datasong. This telepathic mechanism acts both as universal translator and knowledge repository, imparting both complete control of the Raptor’s systems to the user and anything kept in the specific android’s logs.
objects.title: Raptor Amulet (Marvel)

objects.text:
The apex of Asgardian military engineering, the indestructible Destroyer is mystic armor created by Odin that could contain vast amounts of the gods' energies in order to battle the Celestials. The durability of the armor far surpasses that of adamantium and uru.

The Destroyer armor boasts an array of formidable powers, activated when inhabited or remotely piloted by the spirit of a sentient being. These include superhuman strength that matches the Hulk and blasts that can exceed Thor's raw power, allowing it to shatter planets and even slice through uru, such as Thor's Mjolnir.

While inhabited, the user of the Destroyer possesses virtually limitless superhuman stamina in all activities. The armor possesses superhuman speed and agility, defying the physical limits of ordinary beings. It exhibits invulnerability, enduring various forms of damage, and is practically impervious to physical harm.

Besides its raw strength, it's capable of flight at tremendous speeds, manipulating energy, projecting powerful beams of heat, electricity, plasma, anti-matter, and magnetic force, while its matter manipulation enables control over molecular structures and transmutation.

You may choose to have it act as your personal bodyguard. Despite the armor being able to corrupt even a deity, you won't suffer this side effect even if you wear it.
objects.title: The Asgardian Destroyer (Marvel)

objects.text:
These three amulets-one tiger-shaped and two claw-shaped-grant their wielders enhanced strength, speed, agility, reflexes, stamina, healing factor, and animal-like senses. While wearing an amulet, the user can blend seamlessly into their surroundings as long as they remain still. The amulets also detect nearby mystical energy and provide resistance to psychic intrusion.

As a bearer becomes more adept with the amulet, they develop increasingly feline traits: elongated canines, glowing green eyes, wilder hair, and nails that lengthen into claws. Their strength, agility, and other physical abilities continue to grow. Ultimately, a master of the amulet gains control over tigers and other feline creatures.

The three amulets may be worn separately by different users, but their powers are significantly magnified when all are worn by a single individual.

Warning: The amulet requires focused willpower. If the user loses control, they risk transforming into a feral white tiger, only capable of growling—though in this state, the amulet’s abilities reach their maximum potential.
objects.title: White Tiger Amulets (Marvel)

addons.text:
"After all, you can't lose what you've never lost."

Thanks to the Warranty, the magic of your Nanny's Magic Bag has just received a small nudge in the right direction. Now, any item you store inside will be magically restored to its ideal condition, no matter the previous damage or curse! 

But that’s not all! Any item you store in the bag will not only be restored, but it will also be covered by the Warranty. So if something is lost, destroyed, or disappears, you can recover it once a week and bring it back as good as new.

And the best part? Any Object of Power covered by the Warranty (with the only exception being the Magic Bag itself) can be magically summoned into the bag at any time! No hassle, no fuss—just a quick, easy, and secure way to keep your most important items within reach whenever you need them.
addons.title: The Place Where Lost Things Go

addons.text:
"Just a spoonful of sugar helps the medicine go down, in the most delightful way~"

The magic of your bag has responded to your sheer depth of skill and ability to care for others, gaining new abilities in the process.

First and foremost, your bag is able to create 'rooms' within itself, essentially pocket dimensions—about the size of a cosy cottage—where those inside can relax and recover while under your care. While inside, you will be able to monitor their well-being, letting you know if there is anything amiss, such as sickness, depression, and all other forms of ills, along with a general idea of how to help them.

There is no limit to the number of 'active rooms' in your bag at any one time, save for three conditions: people can only enter their room when you use your umbrella to teleport them in, either through a tap of the tip or by creating a portal by drawing it on a way with your umbrella; you must be actively caring for them or they will be teleported out of the bag, safe and sound (and by "actively," that means checking in on them daily for at least a minute), and you cannot benefit from a room yourself, as it's for others.

While in these rooms, those inside experience both a faster and more profound healing process, with them being provided meals that would equal any you cooked yourself, especially for them, and can have access to any media and games that are common in our world or in the world you're currently in. People can visit one another in these different rooms, can ban others from entering aside from yourself, and can leave whenever they want, so long as it's safe for them to do so.
addons.title: A Spoonful of Sugar

objects.text:
"Never judge things by their appearance... even carpetbags. I'm sure I never do."

Congratulations! You are now the proud owner of two iconic items once belonging to a legendary nanny from a children's story. Upon waking up, you will find the Nanny's Magic Bag and Flying Umbrella resting by your side, ready to accompany you on your next adventure.

The Nanny's Magic Bag has infinite storage, allowing it to hold an unlimited number of items, including living creatures, and it weighs almost nothing, making it incredibly easy to carry, no matter what’s inside. You can trust that it will carry everything you need effortlessly and perfectly preserved, as time stops inside the bag, ensuring that everything you store will not deteriorate, no matter how much time passes.

On the other hand, the Flying Umbrella is much more than just a shield from the rain. It has the incredible ability to fly and perform various magical feats. Lightweight, elegant, and easy to use, it ensures that you stay dry and comfortable in any weather, from a light drizzle to 100-mile-per-hour winds with hailstones the size of a minivan, on top of adding a general charisma boost with an air of nobility and trustworthiness.

But the most remarkable feature of all is its ability to take you wherever you're needed; by holding the umbrella and allowing the 'wind' to carry you, it will take you to people who need your abilities and skills.

These little adventures not only allow you to help others but also help you gain control over your powers and abilities, subtly refine them, and build a network of connections with the people you meet along the way. It won’t be long before you find a friendly face wherever you go.

Note: As a side effect of owning this set, a small portion of its magic has slowed your aging; it's not anything too extreme, but you could be 80 and still look as though you're in your 20s or 30s.
objects.title: Nanny's Magic Set (Mary Poppins)

addons.text:
Your Radiant is perfectly poised to take advantage of the Infinity Gem you have, allowing you to ad-hoc merge with the stone by incorporating it into your Radiant. 

While this means that your Radiant would be forever changed, sacrificing its own ability. It would instead augment the stone with the power it would otherwise be using, allowing it to be used safely without mastery. 

This can be done for as many of the stones as you possess, and additionally, the stones themselves can be safely kept inside of Existence rather than on your person, summoned with the Radiant when needed.
addons.title: Radiant Gem

objects.text: You have been given a Radiant Orb. By absorbing it, you can temporarily become ‘one with existence’. In actuality, this takes the form of a near skin-tight suit that grants the user the ability to channel ‘existence’ through them, providing a number of strange abilities. After bonding to it, the wielder can summon their Radiant to them from seemingly anywhere. Firstly, the Radiant itself grants a specific power tied to the aspect of ‘existence’. This power is unique, but equivalent to 15sp in strength. Known examples include Radiant Black (Gravity Manipulation), Pink (Portal Creation), Red (Material Absorption), and Yellow (Future Sight). Apart from this, the suit can project powerful blasts of energy regardless of the specific power it grants. Connected to each Radiant is a giant robot floating somewhere in ‘Existence’. While this is a completely sapient entity that largely exists to support the wielder by telepathically connecting to them, it can also be summoned directly into the real world, either piecemeal such as a single arm or entirely. However, these are incredibly powerful machines of war that should not be used lightly, especially as they can have distinct opinions of their own. Likewise the Radiant can pull you into ‘Existence’ to converse with them more fully. This connection also allows the user to survive in incredibly hostile situations, not needing to eat, breathe, or sleep, though it would be unwise to go without for excessively long periods. Notably, Radiants are not limited to a single user and can be shared with others, but this spreads the power across everyone with it if you’re both active at once. Finally, the full connection to Existence allows you to temporarily ‘Supercharge’ yourself, temporarily enhancing your powers allowing them to perform more impressive feats (and even granting a quite fashionable cape) though this transformation is only temporary.
objects.title: Radiant (Massive-verse: Radiant Black)

addons.text:
Your connection to the Sun Stone has become more intimate, becoming nestled into your own soul. With the Stone acting as a personal plane, and your ability to pull your soulbound demons outwards, you’ve gained the ability to push your own demiplane into the real world likewise.
