As any thing, within the Sunstone is your property, you can mould them at will, turning the plane itself into a localised area of your complete control, suffused with your own magic. When projected outwards this gives you control over the physical space it’s replacing, allowing you to shape and distort the landscape as you please, and the ambient magic within it, in essence making the entire area actively hostile to opposing magic. When sealed back into the Sun Stone, this becomes a borderline dominion, making you able to shape and control the environment however you best see fit.

The plane inside the Sunstone would override the local surroundings while it’s being ‘pulled’ outwards in this manner. While this would naturally allow any demons held within the Sun Stone to become active at once in the material world, it would also notably allow any former users of the Sun Stone who remain inside of it (complete with their armours) to emerge into the world as an army and legacy both.

This extends beyond just the former hosts and your captured demons however, as your Spirit of Vengeance can manifest fully independently from you within the Sun Stone or its vicinity once overlaid on reality. The exact effect of this can vary depending on the exact nature of your spirit. Within the Sunstone your Spirit would take much the same role as a Custodian, though again with great variance. A Spirit of Vengeance like Zarathos would likely become a marauding force of nature or jailor while others like the Leviathan may become true custodians and unifiers within. 

As the connection to the stone’s realm has become much more fluid, you wouldn’t need to use the stare to take people into it anymore, gaining the ability to drag their souls into the plain with a small chain of your power. From within the stone, anyone within would ‘count’ as a demon you’re bonded with, able to take their forms, gain their strengths, and summon them besides you as normal.

Alternatively, souls inside your Sun Stone can be forged into material. This can be used either to reinforce the plane (and stone) itself acting as both a defense and a means to increase its relative might, or to forge more personal arms. This includes transforming the souls of those trapped into armour and equipment, but also enhancing what you already possess with your trapped souls. This can even be applied to the ‘residents’ bestowing those you favour with more and more power while also tying them more firmly into your realm.

As the number of souls trapped within your plane, and indeed used to reinforce it, grows so will your power. Eventually you could reach heights not unlike Lady Blaze, who once usurped hell from Satanus and Neuron with her own pocket plane of tormented souls.

Much like Blaze and her ilk by taking in people’s souls, either by force or through a deal of some kind, you can alter them much like if they were in your demiplane. By twisting a soul into different shapes you can bestow a fragment of your power onto them. This can take many forms; enhanced characteristics, making someone into a world class fighter in seconds, magics that, while minor, would be able to fend off most mundane threats, or even transformations like Lycanthropy or ‘loaned’ demonic forms from your realm. As a guideline these powers would be at most 20sp in strength but can be scaled down depending on your preference. These deals are notably one sided however, as no matter how powerful they may become, you now have ownership of their soul to do with as you please. 

While this power does come from your realm and thus technically weakens you, as it is from their soul (which you now own) their empowerment is only a temporary trade, as when they return to your realm they can be easily reforged as you please. Furthermore any ‘piece’ of your demiplane, such as someone whose soul you own, or a demon who's bonded to it, can be taken over by yourself, able to take actions with their bodies or use your powers through them as though they were you, returning to the plane should their body die.

As it’s a part of you, you can summon the Sun Stone to you at an time you please, and other Sun Stones will slowly generate form within your realm.
addons.title: Morningstar

objects.text:
You’ve been given a Sun Stone, allowing you to take the mantle of the Rogue Sun. This ‘Sun Stone’ is a small pebble that when activated engulfs the user in flame before revealing a set of dark metal flaming armour giving them a number of abilities, this stone is sufficiently small that it could comfortably be made into a bracelet or ring without issue. 

Firstly, being armoured makes you considerably more durable than you would have been outside of it, ancillary to this while wearing it you regenerate slightly faster, but usually only so much as would keep you active in the fight and this quickly wears off when outside the suit. Being stabbed in the shoulder wouldn’t disable your arm, for instance. Similarly your strength is augmented when using it, able to shatter reinforced concrete to dust with a swift kick and tear through steel reinforced walls with ease.

Secondly, the armour allows you to control the fire seeping from it. While this can be used to create powerful blasts of magically-enhanced flame (and its more potent but heatless counterpart ‘black-fire’) you can also use this to achieve flight, essentially turning yourself into a jet engine rocketing forwards at incredible speed, but with such fine control you could choose to merely hover. In extremis, you can even put more of the suit’s energy into a single blast, though this will temporarily exhaust it, reducing its consistent output until it can recharge. You can control this fire enough that you could completely extinguish it if you desired for stealth or other reasons.

As the black-fire is inherently magical it can be used to support numerous magical effects. The only two ‘native’ effects appear to be the ability to manifest a weapon composed of the same flames and dark metal of the armour of your choice, and the ability to store other items within the same space, turning you into a veritable armoury.

Additionally, as the suit is magical, it gives you slight protections from magical attacks, though this should be used as a last resort.

The Sun Stone itself has another property however. Inside of it it stores the souls of each former wielder. By default it projects the latest wielder to the current one, allowing them to give tactical advice and act as a ‘mentor’ to their heir despite being deceased. However, inside of the Sunstone is every wielder it has ever had, which can cause significant conflict should they feel the current ‘spirit’ is teaching their protege wrong (though they cannot depose them without the current wielder’s consent).
objects.title: Sun Stone (Massive-verse: Rogue Sun)

addons.text:
Due to your Hot-Bloodedness and familiarity with the original Mazinger Z and its successors, your control over Zet has greatly expanded, allowing you to more easily manage the bio-armor without losing focus or will while using it. The use of super moves becomes instinctual; even if you do not consciously know it, you will perform the super move best suited for the situation.

Furthermore, you are able to generate Photon Power and use it to enhance the armor, amplifying its already monstrous abilities. When enough Photon Power is stored, the armor will turn golden, making you impervious to almost all attacks and allowing you to damage any foe with your will and spirit, further magnifying the powers of Zet.

Even if parts of the armor are broken off, these fragments will still contain lingering elements of your will and power, subtly influencing the area, people, and probability around them depending on the size of the fragment. These influences can include things such as sharing information, nudging people away from an area, or saving the lives of others. Should a large enough fragment, such as an entire forearm, be left behind, it would be able to influence things as though you were there yourself.

It would be understandable for people who did not know any better to think that you were a shining, All-Knowing, and All-Powerful God while in this state, inspiring myths about you.
addons.title: Z Mazinger

addons.text:
"From the beginning, the concept of Mazinger is the power to surpass Humanity, even when Humanity has surpassed Gods and Demons; that remains true."

Zet has tapped into your Spiral Power and undergone a significant evolution, becoming several times more powerful and enhancing its existing abilities while massively lessening the burden of using it. One example of this evolution is the ability to create mounts for yourself, increasing both speed and attack power. Whether these mounts take the form of a horse or a motorcycle is up to your imagination.

The Infinite Potential of Spiral Power and Zet has come together to create a force any God or Devil would be wise to be wary of. The two feed into one another, giving rise to an exponentially growing power that could allow you to tower over entire worlds, only to grow and evolve further from there.
addons.title: Demon God Emperor

addons.text:
Will is the power that drives Zet, but Imagination shapes that power. Due to your powerful imagination, your attacks and constructs become more potent, as their increased detail makes them greater than they were before. By infusing extra power into these constructs, you can make them truly real, no longer reliant on you to exist—perfect if you need to loan out a sword, gun, or war motorcycle to those in need.

Thanks to your powerful imagination, you can push Zet's abilities further and create allies to fight alongside you. Using clairvoyance to gather the necessary information, you can employ your Imagination and Will to create these allies, whether they are simple animals or towering Mechas. The larger a created ally is, the more of your power is required to maintain them. Initially, you can create one Mecha the size of a Mazinger to fight alongside you, but this ability can grow with time, training, and other powers or perks. However, the power these creations possess cannot surpass your own, meaning you can only create one that is equal to yourself, leaving you unable to create or maintain other creations.
addons.title: The Power of Imagination

objects.text:
You awoke to find in your possession a fearsome helmet composed of a material known as Super Spiritual Alloy Z. When you put it on, it expands to cover you in bio-mechanical armor, transforming you into a version of Mazinger and granting you untold power.

The most basic of these powers is a threefold increase in your abilities, allowing you to fight numerous enemies and monsters at once without much issue, even if you were an ordinary human. You can also create an energy barrier to protect yourself and others, which can be called upon even when not wearing the helmet. However, this is just a fraction of the power this armor grants you; with a strong will and imagination, you could rival Gods.

The true scope of power possessed by this bio-mechanical armor is unknown, but it includes many abilities typically associated with Mazingers, such as the Rocket Punch, Breast Fire, Rust Hurricane, Mazinger Sword, Photon Beam, and flight. Additionally, it also possesses other powers like freely controlling its size and mass, teleportation, and powerful clairvoyance that allows you to know everything that takes place in a city like Tokyo, down to minute details, whether in the past, present, or a bit into the future, to name a few.

All of these powers are fueled by your will and spirit while shaped by your imagination—a double-edged sword. If you lose your concentration, the will to fight, or the ability to visualize your victory in any form, the power of Zet will falter, making it vulnerable to attacks and even causing it to bleed. Using Zet is both physically and mentally draining, but this can be improved through training and self-reflection.

However, due to this bio-mechanical armor connecting with the spiritual energies within yourself, such as the seven chakras, those powers can be used through Zet, amplifying their potency by several magnitudes and strengthening the armor along with your other abilities in turn. For example, Negative Emotion Drive can be used to transform Zet into its Demon Mode, while Positive Emotion Drive can be used to enter an Angelic God Mode.

Zet is somewhat sentient and will aid you in small ways, preventing anyone but you from wielding its power.
objects.title: Zet (MazinSaga)

addons.text:
With possessing both “Jetstream” Sam’s Exoskeleton and HF Muramasa, the only thing missing is his absurd skills, which you now possess.

You gain Sam's unfathomable mind and skills in combat, which allowed him to fight against those who went through the Perfect Soldier program, which involved extreme amounts of physiological conditioning and brainwashing, along with various enhancements despite being a completely normal human. In addition, you gain Sam’s ability to expertly read opponents like an open book, allowing you to grasp their mindset, fighting style, and any weakness they possess with only a few exchanges with an opponent.

Additionally, you gain the ability to use Blade Mode, a heightened state of focus that, combined with your Exoskeleton, allows you to perform countless attacks with perfect precision. Normally, only full conversion cyborgs could use Blade Mode, but you can do so anyway, though using it does consume a considerable amount of stamina, such that it should be used sparingly.

This also comes with mastery of Sam’s “Rodrigues New Shadow School” fighting style, which incorporates Brazilian Kenjutsu, Jiu-jitsu,  Judo, and other maneuvers added over generations of fighters, combined with Sam’s personal experience and knowledge.
addons.title: Jetstream Legacy

objects.text:
You receive a next-generation Exoskeleton, a suit that combines extremely advanced cybernetic and artificial biology to grant its wearer unbelievable physical enhancement.

This Exoskeleton enhances the user's physical abilities through a mix of cutting-edge meta materials and nanomachines combined with artificial biological muscle fibers. Through nanotechnology, the Exoskeleton can seamlessly integrate with the user, acting like a second skin, enhancing the wearer's natural physical strength. It can allow someone elderly to regain and enhance the strength they would have had while in their prime, and allow a physically crippled wearer to move normally to continue to fight far beyond what should be possible.

The Exoskeleton grants strength capable of lifting and tossing mecha that weigh over ten thousand tons and striking with similar absurd strength. It also grants speed and agility, allowing its user to move at Sub-Relativistic speeds of a few percent of the speed of light while also vastly enhancing the user's agility to an insane degree. This Exoskeleton also possesses extreme durability, allowing it to withstand attacks from other Exoskeleton users with similar strength that could destroy cities or entire mountains. Additionally, it possesses technology such as an oxygen pump combined with nanomachines, which pushes the wearer's body to be able to compete with full conversion cyborgs for a short time, and provides semi-limited self-healing abilities.

While this Exoskeleton offers unimaginable physical enhancement, it does have some limitations. The Exoskeleton heavily relies on a reservoir of nanomachines for its functions and for repairing itself and healing the wearer. Should it run out of nanomachines, it will begin to lose effectiveness until they are refilled or repairs are done. Also, the suit requires occasional recharging to keep functioning, especially during prolonged heavy usage.

You are given a toolkit that allows you to create new nanomachines to refill the Exoskeleton's reserves, recharge it, and perform maintenance with provided instructions on how to do so.
objects.title: Next Gen Exoskeleton (Metal Gear)

addons.text: The infusion of Chozo and Metroid DNA hasn't just changed you, but your Power Suit as well. Its appearance has changed, becoming more organic looking. Its bond with you has improved as well, to the point it feels like an extension of your body rather than armor. Moreover, it now shares any biological powers you may have, working in sync with them while adapting its form and systems to enhance their strength and efficiency while mitigating their drawbacks. For example, it will improve your Metroid energy draining abilities to the point you could suck an entire spaceship dry in seconds, and then use that energy to massively empower your arm cannon, while at the same time nearly removing your weakness to the cold. Finally, if you drain the energy of an organism, the suit will allow you to add any unique biological abilities they possess to your own arsenal, whether as a new piece of equipment or as part of your physiology. You can change the suit to any of its other appearances at any time.
addons.title: Fusion

addons.text: Your insight into Chozo Technology has empowered you to generate and harness Aeion energy for personal use. Native from SR388, it is a mystical and powerful energy source the planet catalyzes for its planet’s inhabitants, something the Chozo come to study and utilize. Your body can generate this energy which then your Power Suit can use to produce a pulse to scan your surroundings and hidden details, imbuing your suit with lightning green aura protecting you from attacks or external damage, enhancing your beam’s rate-of-fire and potency, muffling your sounds and turn invisible at the cost of movement, and travel to any direction instantaneously up to three times in consecutively.
addons.title: Aeion

objects.text:
You've received a Chozo Power Suit. This armor is bonded to your body and mind, becoming like a second skin. It can be summoned or dismissed at will, and will be held in a pocket dimension when not in use. Using this armor usually requires intense focus, but you are able to use it with ease. 

The armor protects you by projecting an energy shield which will drain proportionately with damage taken, and when depleted puts you in danger. This shield is fairly powerful too, a thug with a pistol won't even be noticed, higher calibers and explosives will drain about 10 to 20 percent a tank, and mid-tier Brutes will drain much more. Something on the level of the Triumvirate or an Endbringer can probably knock off entire Tanks at a time. Fortunately, this shield can be recharged by draining the energy of fallen enemies or from any nearby source of power. It will also slowly recharge itself over time. 

The suit will also increase your physical abilities, making you stronger and able to jump higher and farther. It has a built in arm cannon that fires energy bolts as its basic attack, which can be charged for even more destructive blasts, and a missile launcher that can fire different types of missiles. It also possesses a built in scanner capable of analyzing lifeforms and objects you come across and accessing most computer systems.

But its most important feature is its ability to adapt nearly any sort of technological device for itself, so long as it isn't larger than the suit itself and it has the energy to use it in the first place. 

Finally, this version comes with every weapon and piece of equipment seen in the games, and will never end up being reverted to its base form. If critically damaged, its self-repair systems will eventually restore it back to full functionality.
objects.title: Chozo Power Suit (Metroid)

objects.text:
Now in your possession is a complete set of the signature rings of the organization known as Akatsuki. Each ring allows you to summon a former member of the organization who once wore it. Those summoned arrive with all their equipment, and anyone who possesses a Ring can summon or dismiss the shinobi bound to it. Though the rings don't force obedience they prevent the wearer from being attacked by those they summon. Those summoned by the rings are dependent on their summoner to remain in the world. If the ring is removed, or the bearer perishes the shinobi summoned will disappear. Each ring allows the wearer to telepathically communicate with the Shinobi summoned, and all others who wear one of the rings.

The ring on the Right Thumb once belonged to Pain, the formidable leader of the Akatsuki. Bearing the legendary Rinnegan, Pain commands the bodies of six deceased shinobi—each imbued with a fragment of the Rinnegan’s immense power.

The ring on the Right Index was worn by Deidara, the explosive artist. Master of Explosion Release, Deidara has performed a forbidden technique, causing the creation of mouths upon his palms, which he uses to imbue his specially crafted clay with devastating explosive power.

The ring on the Right Middle Finger belonged to Konan, often called the Angel. An expert in Paper and Origami techniques, she wields her sheets of paper in a flexible balance between utility, offence, and defence in combat.

The ring on the Right Ring Finger was carried by Itachi Uchiha, the infamous Uchiha prodigy and assassin. Possessing the legendary Mangekyō Sharingan, he excels in genjutsu and illusion-based attacks that can incapacitate even the strongest foes.

The ring on the Right Little Finger belonged to Zetsu, the enigmatic spy and scout. Able to manipulate Wood Release and travel swiftly by merging with the ground and plants through his Mayfly technique, Zetsu's abilities make him a master of infiltration.

The ring on the Left Little Finger was held by Orochimaru, the Snake Sannin. A legendary serpent sage and scientist, Orochimaru is known for his dark experiments, mastery of serpents, and possession of the Kusanagi sword.

The ring on the Left Ring Finger was worn by Kisame Hoshigaki, the tailless tailed beast. Once a member of the Seven Swordsmen of the Mist, Kisame wields the legendary sword Samehada to drain chakra and flesh from opponents, complemented by his vast chakra reserves and mastery of water-style jutsu.

The ring on the Left Middle Finger belonged to Kakuzu, the Five Hearts. A fearsome shinobi who once attempted to assassinate the First Hokage, Kakuzu survived by using Earth Grudge Fear—an forbidden jutsu that allows him to steal hearts and chakra natures from his enemies.

The ring on the Left Index was owned by Hidan, the Jashinist. With a blood sacrifice, Hidan can reflect injuries back onto his foes—causing devastating self-inflicted wounds that often lead opponents to their demise, while he remains remarkably resilient against even fatal blows.

The ring on the Left Thumb belonged to Sasori of the Red Sands, a master puppeteer. Sasori’s skill in transforming fallen enemies’ bodies into deadly puppets—among them the third Kazekage—makes him one of the most feared  in the ninja world.
objects.title: Akatsuki Rings (Naruto)

objects.text:
You receive a visor of the same model as the one belonging to the head of the Human Instrumentality Committee of Seele, Keel Lorenz. This visor can store information in the forms of knowledge, memory, or even entire consciousness and souls inside it. Initially, it is empty, but you or other people can copy to it any knowledge and/or memories they want by putting the visor on. It’s also possible to remove/copy souls/consciousness and store them in the visor, but the one that is doing it must be willing.

You can safely access any stored information or program the visor to transfer all or some of it to the next person that puts the visor on. But be careful as to not leave the receiving person comatose or brainwashed by the sudden transfer of massive amount of information directly into their brain, or worse, overwritten by some personality inside the visor. Unless, of course, that was your goal. Additionally, if the visor contains souls/consciousness, then the one putting on the visor may converse with them in a virtual environment if you allow it.

But for you, this visor hold one additional purpose. When you put a copy of your soul in it, it will lay dormant (unless you wish otherwise), and in case of your death, your true soul will be attracted to and merge with the copy inside the visor. Inside, you will be able to fall into a sort of dreamless sleep at will, only awakening when someone puts the visor on, then you will have a choice to either converse with them, or take over their body, with their soul removed and stored in the visor.

At any point, you may program the visor to transfer ownership of it to anybody else, and then they will be able to utilise this soul recovery function instead of you.
objects.title: Keel Lorenz’s Visor (Neon Genesis Evangelion: Anima Jump)

objects.text:
Made to face the many dangers in space, the Exosuit is an exemplary piece of technology that covers many bases without cutting corners. Your Exosuit came equipped with a robust life support system, protecting you from environmental hazards such as radiation, toxins and extreme heat and cold. As it builds up stress, you can either feed it carbon to replenish its protection, or wait a few minutes in a safe environment to be in peak condition again. It can filter your oxygen for a day before needing to be refueled. 

A Shields module gives protection against threats comparable to an assault rifle for a minute, though when brought down it will need 30 seconds to be restored. The Jetpack, while not allowing you to fly truly, will bolster your mobility and allow you to reach up to 50 meters above before needing to charge up again. 

Your suit also came equipped with a Storage system, allowing you to store anything you could hold, up to 50 cubic meters of matter, which can be easily stored and retrieved via an interface on the suit. Finally, you can use a Fabricator to build new things with the material in your Storage. You initially will only be able to create simple objects and the components needed to maintain and repair your Exosuit. Adding new things to the database is easy, though the Fabricator has a limit on how big and complex something can be to be built.
objects.title: Exosuit (No Man's Sky)

objects.text:
This ring is a symbol of your potential as a hero, transforming you into a never-before-seen Sentai Red (red ranger) with armor reflecting your mental image of a hero. The suit's design and color accents are up to you, with them slowly changing to suit your preferences as you grow into your role as a leader and hero. 

In your transformed state you gain an enhanced body, fighting instincts, as well as both a weapon and power suited to your personality and fighting style, whether that be focused around a sword, gun, or something less conventional. Your presence will empower those who fight alongside you, improving their morale and natural capacity for teamwork. This ring does not come with the potential to let others transform, but even without a team you will be able to forge a legend of heroism that is entirely your own.
objects.title: Original Sentai Ring (No. 1 Sentai Gozyuger)

objects.text:
Congratulations! You have become the possessor of the coveted Overlord Gauntlet, a legendary artifact of immense power once wielded by the Big Bad Evil Overlords. This ancient and enigmatic gauntlet grants you dominion over dark and chaotic energies, endowing you with abilities beyond mortal comprehension.

As you don the gauntlet, you immediately feel a surge of potent energy coursing through your veins. It empowers you to wield devastating spells and curses, capable of unleashing destruction upon your foes with a mere gesture of your hand. Fireballs erupt from your fingertips, lightning crackles in your wake, and shadows twist to your command. The very elements of nature bend to your will, empowering you to obliterate any opposition that dares stand in your way.

But the true might of the Overlord Gauntlet lies beyond the grasp of mere sorcery. It enhances your physical prowess to supernatural levels, making you stronger, faster, and more resilient. Your senses become keener, your reflexes sharper, and your endurance seemingly limitless. In combat, you are a formidable force, capable of facing hordes of adversaries and emerging victorious.

However, the Overlord Gauntlet's most remarkable aspect is its ability to command and manipulate minions. With the gauntlet's power, you can summon a legion of loyal and fearsome creatures to serve as your faithful followers. These minions heed your every order, carrying out your bidding with unswerving loyalty. They become extensions of your will, and you can lead them to conquer territories, accomplish tasks, and achieve your grandest ambitions.
objects.title: Evil Always Finds A Way! (Overlord)

objects.text:
The Shooting Star is a rare magic item with the power to grant wishes. It appears as a simple, undecorated band with three engraved shooting stars that emit a faint silver glow. The ring allows its wearer to cast the powerful spell [Wish Upon a Star], drawing on the user’s own experience points (XP) to fuel its magic. Each wish cast consumes a portion of this XP, with the potency of the wish scaling according to the amount of XP sacrificed. By spending more XP, the ring can grant wishes of greater magnitude, allowing outcomes that might otherwise be impossible.

Without a visible measure like a gamer system, XP is more like an internalized reservoir of life force or personal energy. Using the ring to make a wish feels like drawing on one’s own essence. Sacrificing XP leaves the caster physically weakened, mentally fatigued, or spiritually drained. For small wishes, the caster may only feel tired, but greater sacrifices could result in days of lethargy, dulled reflexes, or a subtle loss of skill in areas they once excelled at. The cost also affects their spirit, sometimes leaving them emotionally hollow or detached, as if part of their very soul was spent in casting the wish. Such losses require time, rest, and the accumulation of new experience to fully recover.
 
The ring can store up to three wishes at a time, regaining one charge each month.
objects.title: The Shooting Star (Overlord)

objects.text:
This is something that should never have fallen into mortal hands... and yet now it's landed in yours. The legendary Helm of Darkness, the symbol of power of the Lord of the Underworld is somehow in your possession.

By default the Helm takes the form of Corinthian style Grecian helmet made of Celestial Bronze, however it is capable of shifting its form into any form of headgear you the wielder can imagine. Caps, wreathes, helmets, etc.

The Helm is well known for two abilities, first is the ability to make the wearer akin to a shadow, invisible, inaudible, and intangible allowing them to sneak and access anywhere. Next is the aura the helm can produce, death, horror and terror can be projected with pinpoint precision across entire battlefields. This aura brings out the fears almost every creature possesses in the darkest depths of their minds, a fear so potent, so powerful that it can cause the targets hearts to stop, or their minds to shatter into complete insanity.

Lastly, you can create lesser copies of the Helm to gift out to your allies. These copies can only imitate the smallest of fragments of the true Helms power. A helm able to bring fear upon those who see it, a cap that makes the wearer invisible, or even something else entirely.
objects.title: The Helm of Darkness (Percy Jackson)

objects.text:
The Orpheus Armlet is a revolutionary device designed to unlock the full cognitive potential of its wearer, pushing the mind to its absolute limits. By stimulating specific regions of the brain, it essentially "overclocks" the wearer's mental capacity, allowing them to operate at a level far beyond the ordinary.

At its core, the Armlet repurposes the emotional centers of the brain, redirecting them towards enhanced logical reasoning. This transformation allows the wearer to approach any situation with razor-sharp analytical focus, unaffected by the emotional distractions that typically cloud human judgment. In high-pressure situations, the Armlet automatically activates, triggering a subtle but noticeable change in the wearer. Their body emits a golden glow, and their demeanor shifts to one of cold, calculating composure. One eye often glows crimson, marking the full activation of its power.

In this heightened state, the wearer’s mind becomes capable of perceiving patterns in chaos, identifying weaknesses in structures or systems, and devising ingenious solutions to the most complex challenges. Whether solving intellectual puzzles, navigating intricate problems, or overcoming physical obstacles, the wearer’s cognitive abilities are vastly enhanced, enabling them to accomplish what would otherwise be impossible.
However, the immense power of the Armlet comes at a significant cost. The mental strain of constantly pushing the mind to such extremes can lead to debilitating side effects. These include headaches, sensory degradation, and hallucinations, which can escalate to vivid visions of despair or catastrophic futures. Over time, these mental disturbances destabilize the user’s psyche, making the wearer's grip on reality tenuous at best.
If the wearer’s emotional stability deteriorates, the Armlet enters a dangerous state known as Reverse Rampage. In this state, the logic-driven focus shifts, and negative emotions surge uncontrollably, overwhelming the wearer. The Armlet attempts to suppress this emotional upheaval by emitting a blinding white light and delivering erratic artificial shocks, but these only intensify the instability. This feedback loop of suppression rapidly degrades the wearer’s mental state, and prolonged exposure risks neural overload. If the strain becomes too much, the wearer may lose their ability to function mentally, or worse, become permanently bound to the Armlet, their mind forever dependent on its power.
objects.title: Orpheus Armlet/Ring (Phi Brain: Kami no Puzzle)

objects.text:
A Morpher is a device used by an unpowered individual to transform into a Power Ranger. A masked warrior, granted great abilities and armaments to fight with! Whether it be for justice, or for evil. They tend to fight in groups and their full power requires more than one. You automatically have five of these Morphers, they can be from whatever series you want.

Every Morpher comes with a matching Zord. Zords come in many different forms. Some take the form of animals, both current, mythical, and extinct. When individual Zords are inadequate for the task, they can join together into a more powerful form (usually a humanoid robot) called a Megazord.
objects.title: Morpher (Power Rangers)

objects.text:
You gain your own Ninja Mask and NinjaNomicon, when worn, the mask will turn into a ninja suit that gives you superhuman physicality, a hammerspace that stores items like weapons and smoke bombs, Resistance to magic as well as enabling the use of magic ninja skills.

Your NinjaNomicon is an ancient book that puts you into a trance and takes your mind inside the book to grant you wisdom and/or skills depending on your needs, the skills are both mundane and of magic abilities of the ninja, the book is precognitive in nature so it knows what to teach every time it's opened but you can choose to go to a specific lesson if you're determined enough.

If you have good enough character then you will not go mad if you don't mind-wipe yourself using the ultimate lesson for more than 4 years but you can still choose to do it, removing your memories, wisdom and skills as a ninja, integrating them into the Nomicon and making the enhanced abilities pass into a new suitable ninja.
objects.title: Ninja Gear (Randy Cunningham 9th Grade Ninja)

objects.text: No one can recognize you with this robe on.
objects.title: Recognition Obstruction Robe Enchantment (Re:Zero)

objects.text:
The Shield Belt is a standard for protection on any Rimworld. With a press of a button, it can create a spherical energy shield around the user, protecting them from any incoming projectiles.

It can hold its own against small guns, but against large caliber bullets like a sniper rifle, it can withstand only a handful of shots before overloading. A strong explosion, like a RPG, will also break the energy shield in one hit. 

When overloaded, the shield will take thirty seconds to come back online, and a full minute to go back to full strength. The shield only works against projectiles, so melee attacks and other effects like radiation can pass through, and you can't shoot inside of it without hitting your own shield.
objects.title: Shield Belt (Rimworld)

objects.text:
You have been given a seemingly ordinary newsboy cap. While wearing it, the user becomes completely unnoticeable, fading into the background of everyone else's perception. Even after the cap is removed, anyone who observed the wearer retains little to no memory of them. This effect also extends to electronic surveillance; photographs become blurred, and video recordings turn grainy or distorted.

Only the wearer can intentionally break the effect by speaking aloud to an observer, physically interacting with them, or removing the cap. Even then, observers gradually begin ignoring the wearer again for as long as the cap remains worn.

The longer the cap is worn in a single stretch, the stronger its effects become. Eventually, neither physical contact nor speaking is enough to fully draw attention to the wearer. After approximately 20 continuous hours of use, the effect begins to persist even after the cap has been removed.

Repeated use deepens the wearer's attunement to the cap, causing its abilities to grow even stronger. At higher levels of attunement, the wearer can make requests of nearby observers, who will comply without questioning them and retain no memory of having done so afterward.

Warning: Wearing the cap for excessive periods may cause its effects to become permanent, rendering the user effectively unnoticeable and eventually unable to meaningfully interact with anyone.
objects.title: Cap of Neglect: SCP-268 (SCP Foundation)

objects.text:
You have acquired the Shinobi Prosthetic, a modular prosthetic arm designed by the former shinobi Orangutan. It comes equipped with the Grappling Hook and every Prosthetic Tool the Sculptor can create, with all upgrades already unlocked. Tools that normally require Spirit Emblems, such as the Shinobi Firecrackers and the Shuriken Wheel, instead have unlimited ammunition. Prosthetic Tools can be swapped instantaneously at will.

If you would rather keep both of your arms, the prosthetic may instead take the form of a gauntlet that grants all of the same functions and capabilities.
objects.title: Shinobi Prosthetic (Sekiro)

objects.text:
Weaver's Mask is the Memory Sunless received from a corpse beneath the Ruined Cathedral. The mask is a Class VII, Divine Rank Memory—the highest rank and class possible—and was crafted by none other than Weaver, the Demon of Fate.

The Mask of Weaver was part of the ceremonial garb worn by the priests and priestesses of the Nightmare Spell, allowing them to escape the gaze of their pursuers and follow in the footsteps of the Demon of Fate. However, only two Divine Memories of Weaver’s Mask were ever created, entrusted to the High Priest and High Priestess of the Nightmare Spell.

As a Divine Rank Memory, Weaver’s Mask is extraordinarily powerful and durable—so much so that only a god could damage it. The mask bears three enchantments engraved into it: [Mantle of Lies], [Where Is My Eye?], and [Simple Trick].

[Mantle of Lies] functions passively, concealing the wearer’s identity from all beings, whether mortal or divine. However, the wearer may still be recognized by those to whom they willingly reveal their identity, even after donning the mask.

[Simple Trick] may seem insignificant from a god’s perspective, but it demonstrates the extraordinary skill and power of Weaver. This enchantment passively reverses the effect of the wearer’s Flaw. For Sunless, whose Flaw prevented him from lying, it instead forced him to lie whenever he was asked a question while wearing the mask. By extension, this will invert any weaknesses or drawbacks that affect only you, causing them to manifest in the opposite manner—though not necessarily in a beneficial way.

[Where Is My Eye?], despite its absurd name, is the most powerful—and dangerous—of the three. When activated, it allows the wearer to peer into the tapestry of fate itself, to touch its threads and glimpse fragments of its meaning. However, a mortal mind lacks the capacity to comprehend the strings of fate. As a result, activating the enchantment can overwhelm the mind, potentially killing the wearer instantly. Should they somehow survive, they will endure excruciating, indescribable pain until the enchantment is deactivated.
objects.title: Weaver's Mask (Shadow Slave)

objects.text:
Your body has now merged with a living and sentient demonic armor that hungers for power and thrives on the essence of fallen adversaries. This malevolent armor grants extraordinary abilities and transforming you into a powerful force on the battlefield.

Once bonded, the armor evolves and adapts, its sinewy tendrils pulsating with an otherworldly energy. Its appearance morphs, revealing twisted and macabre forms, as if plucked from the nightmares of forgotten realms. With each transformation, the armor grants you new and unimaginable abilities, elevating you to the pinnacle of demonic might. This symbiotic relationship allows you to harness the armor's vast potential, tapping into its vast catalog of spells and attacks called Mantra's. 

Caution is advised, for the armors demonic influence may tempt their host into relinquishing their humanity.
objects.title: Avatar Tuner: Fiend (Shin Megami Tensei: Digital Devil Saga)

objects.text:
A pendant that grants pseudo-immortality, at the cost of time. Each time you die, you will age an entire year. Each subsequent death will increase the amount of years you age by 1 year. Meaning if you die 3 times, you'll age by 4 years when you die again. This death counter resets each day. For each day you live, you will age backwards until you are at your natural age. When you die, the amount of years that is taken from you is spent in combat experience, spent on that particular battle where you died.

The pendant has 5 coins, and if you age 10 years within a single day, a coin will permanently break. If you lose all 5 coins, then you are on your last life.

This pendant must be on your person to work, and any other person can use it if they get their hands on it.
objects.title: Sifu's Pendant (Sifu)

objects.text:
The Dynamo Cage is a device capable of absorbing, converting and storing a vast amount of any and all kinds of energy, regardless of source or form. As well as being a conduit for the user to project and manipulate that energy as if it was their own, or amplify their own abilities. Compounding into a stockpile of power ready to be deployed and combined for a myriad of purposes.

For reference, when Surge the Tenrec used the device, she was able to absorb electricity, laser fire, a Chaos Drive, and the Wisps to enhance her own physical abilities and electrokinesis beyond their limits. Which later evolved into manipulating several Wisp powers such as Green Hover for levitation, Pink Spikes to shoot buzzsaw projectiles, Blue Cube to suspend several cubes in the air, and Cyan Laser to fire eye lasers. All at the same time. 

Which eventually led to overloading and destroying the machine, causing her to pass out. You won't have such issues, but the energy of the cage can still run out, which will prompt you to recharge it. 

As a general rule, the more overall power you absorb, the more fuel the cage has, and the greater amount of it you draw from, the faster you burn through said fuel.
objects.title: Dynamo Cage (Sonic the Hedgehog)

addons.text:
The Genie's ring picked up on your 108 Skills, and upgraded alongside it. Within this ring is a HUD that showcases all the skills from Sonic and the Secret Rings, which you can equip onto 4 loadouts and switch at anytime. 

Each skill has a cost ranging from 1-5 SP based on overall power, but the ring itself can only hold 20 SP worth of powers, and the skills themselves start at Level 1. Overtime the skills can upgrade to Level 99, with the max price of each being 10 SP, and the ring can hold a maximum of 100 SP worth of powers. 

You can develop new skills based on your own powers, what you need, or by copying the ones from those around you.
addons.title: Skill Ring

addons.text:
You can assume the Darkspine Form when absorbing the Chaos Emeralds. It's similar in strength to your Super Form with some unique abilities: Pyrokinesis, Speed Break, and Time Break. If you have the Skill Ring addon, your Soul Gauge and these powers are at Level 99 in this form. 

Speed Break makes you move at speeds akin to Sonic’s Boost, with the bonus of automatically making you move in the most optimal way for speed while avoiding or defeating enemies and obstacles. 

Time Break is a psuedo Chaos Control that slows time around you to a crawl, which you use to act with greater precision, outspeed your enemies, or buy time to think. 

Unlike Sonic when he gained this form, the Chaos Emeralds act as the 7 World Rings, granting a reservoir of unique abilities and potential Chaos Powers based on what they represent: Prayers, Sadness, Rage, Hatred, Joy, Pleasure, and Wishes. 

You can wield these powers outside of your Darkspine Form through the Chaos Emeralds, which you can customize if you wish.
addons.title: Seven Rings in Hand

addons.text:
Your Genie now meets the standard of what you'd expect of them, with greater potency in their magic, and wish granting. The same rules of the Djinn still apply, with a little extra as a token of their gratitude. 

They have a second set of three wishes called “Simple Wishes”. Some examples of what you can wish for are: Mundane items worth up to $10 USD, curing a cold, summoning your lost phone, making you clean, locating objects, minor buffs and debuffs, etc.

Unlike normal wishes, Simple Wishes can be recharged the next day after all are spent.

Alternatively, you can gain a second Genie with the same customization options as before. The first retains their previous level of power, with the addition of Simple Wishes. The second will have the power of the djinn within the lamp.
addons.title: Erazor Djinn

objects.text:
Ever wanted a genie as a companion? Well now you do! Being summoned the moment you touched a ring you swear wasn't there before, and binding itself to your finger. This genie cannot grant wishes, but has enough power and versatility in magic to be considered well above average for their kind. You can skew this in anyway you see fit, and they're capable of learning and growing their aptitude in any form of mystical arts. They can also fly, turn into smoke, or a ball of colored light, move fast enough to keep up with you, and provide insight on your adventures.

You gain access to two techniques from the Ring; Speed Break and Time Break. The former allows you to move at speeds comparable to a certain blue blur, with the same acrobatic skill, reflexes, and coolness. The latter will slow your perception of time to a crawl, to the point that a fired bullet will move at the speed of molasses. But also consumes your stamina, or other energy reserves until you either halt the process or are depleted. (This is omitted if you possess the Soul Gauge Addon under Fastest Thing Alive).

You may choose if the genie is Shahra, or a different one entirely.
objects.title: Genie of the Ring (Sonic the Hedgehog)

addons.text:
You've summoned the Prism Energy within you and learned to harness it. Allowing for construct creation, which starts at small intangible objects, that with practice can become fully tangible and sentient beings like the Grim, Chaos Sonic, and the Prismatic Titan. You can also create afterimages as functional clones as you move at sonic speeds 

This becomes incredibly boosted by the Chaos Emeralds, your Super Form, or the Paradox Prism.

By channeling Chaos Energy, Prism Energy, or running in a straight line for a fixed amount of time, you can travel through the Shatterverse and even other dimensions. You will first appear in The Void, an infinite space-like plane with platforms, and portals. Peering through them allows you to see alternate versions of reality, or other worlds if you have Homecoming.

These worlds will often have different versions of the people you've known, but are still recognizable at a glance. Perhaps your best friend is now a girl, your Firebending companion is now a Waterbender, your powerless sister is now a psychic, etc.
addons.title: Shatterverse

addons.text:
You gain all the technological knowledge to make the creations of Nine. From his exoskeleton tails, all the way to empowering technology, and the mass production of the Grim using Prism Energy, or any equivalent energy.

You can also tinker the Regulators with any modifications you wish, or are capable of.

As a bonus, you gain his wits, allowing you to casually outsmart others, extract information, or find exploits while having a casual conversation, or the most “I don't care” look on your face.
addons.title: Nine Tails

objects.text: Four disc-like devices become bound to the back of your hands and feet/shoes, afterwards, you feel a small burst of esoteric energy: Prism Energy. If you didn't take Fastest Thing Alive, you gain a lesser version of that power that caps at Mach 1. Otherwise, your new devices will regulate the Prism Energy coursing through you. They have the same capabilities showcased by Sonic and established by Nine in Sonic Prime, with a few changes. Its compass feature can now detect any Object of Power, instead of just Prism Shards, glowing brighter and beeping louder the closer you approach it until acquisition. This is adjustable, and can be heard by only you or others you trust. It can switch to any of the 3 alternate modes throughout Sonic Prime at any time: Boscage Mode to arm you with Wolverine style claws that can dig and climb any surface. No Place Mode to hover and run on water. Grim Mode to create energy platforms that let you run and suspend yourself in mid-air. You can communicate with any contacts you know through it. Including phone calls, walkie-talkies, radios, etc. As a bonus, your footwear becomes extremely stylish and is impervious to the effects of superspeed. You may customize the appearance of the alternate modes.
objects.title: Regulators (Sonic the Hedgehog)

addons.text: You inherit what's left of Starline's latest base, a repurposed Eggman base. Not only do you have hundreds or potentially thousands of the Doctor's robots at your beck and call, but a vast amount of his and Starline's resources to do as you please. Eggtech is noted by Tails to be notoriously weird and hard to work with, but you don't have to deal with such inconveniences. Most importantly, you find two stasis pods containing his unfinished masterpieces—Surge and Kit, or another name if you wish. They are cybernetically enhanced mobians that take the framework of Sonic and Tails, and improve upon them. No, they Perfect them. Both have a variant of the Fastest Thing Alive Power, with the bonus of manipulating a single element, and are loyal to you. Their further potential remains to be explored and realized, but that's where you come in. To make this work of perverse perfection see the light of day. You may edit them with a new appearance, gender, and basic personality.
addons.title: Starline Base Sigma

objects.text: ”I won't be conquering the world to prove myself to Dr. Eggman. I'll conquer it to prove it to myself. And I won't be proving I'm Eggman’s equal. I'll prove I'm his superior replacement.” You inherit the items left behind as one of the legacies of Doctor Starline, all compacted into a single glove. Such is the work of a visionary. The glove has several abilities compiled from all of his innovations in one. The Hypno Gear allows you to give a command to a single target, who will obey it without fail. You must open your palm towards them, and be at least 20 feet away for it to take effect. As a precision instrument, it cannot be used for affecting multiple people at once. The extent of the hypnosis itself ranges from giving simple commands like “Sleep” and being very prone to suggestion, to the point of rewriting someone's memories and personality on a subconscious level—but requires multiple sessions of constant suggestion over time. The Warp Topaz creates “windows” that allow you to peer and travel around the world in an instant. However, this is limited by your knowledge of the world and your ability to visualize its location—a general mental image of your destination will suffice, but the more specific and detailed, the better. Alternatively, you can observe events from afar with these portals. The Tricore bestows you the powers of Sonic’s speed, Tails' flight, and Knuckles’ strength all in one. These powers are formidable enough to give you an edge over your adversaries. With strength great enough to create massive dents in Eggman’s toughest war robots, or lift objects over 20 times your size, speed comparable to Sonic without outrunning him, and flight of similar swiftness and jumping prowess. As a trump card, you can deploy the Tricore Blast. An attack of similar scale to the Team Blast from Sonic Heroes—specifically Team Sonic’s version—that rains hell on the battlefield and all obstacles in your wake, but depletes all the powers of the glove until completing a 24 hour recharge.
objects.title: Starline's Glove (Sonic the Hedgehog)

objects.text:
Ever wanted your hat as a companion? Well now you do! Well more accurately, it's a ghost-like being with the characteristics of a hat called a Bonneter. It also takes the appearance of a top hat or tiara, with eyeballs depending on gender. 

While resting on your head, you can throw the cap in any direction as an attack, to pick up items, or a platform to jump from. It can stay spinning after you've thrown it if you wish, but will eventually boomerang back to your head. Also, you can only throw it about 10 to 15 feet away. 

If thrown to an object or living being within that range however, you can activate the "Capture" ability. Making your entire body, mind, and spirit possess the target, and gain their abilities. This possession is absolute, but characteristics of "you" will still be glaringly visible, like your mustache and red cap. The target's head must also be free from any headgear for this work. 

When thrown at objects, you gain complete control over its functions and can even use them for various purposes. If you capture a rocket, you will know how to control, power, and steer it. A power cable allows you to travel through them at lightspeed, as if you were an electron yourself. A vine to fling yourself in any direction, etc. 

You can release yourself from your "host" at any time, returning to your original body, alongside your hat companion. Who can also shapeshift into any hat to wish. As a bonus, you can perform all the movement techniques from Super Mario Odyssey.
objects.title: Cappy (Super Mario)

objects.text: The Super Crown is a mystical power-up item of incredible power and ability. It will transform the recipient into a female princess of unparalleled beauty resembling a certain Princess Peach of the Mushroom Kingdom. You radiate an unparalleled charm, and even a crass attitude will look attractive on you. You are able to use all you powers in this form. A crown fit for royalty.
objects.title: Super Crown (Super Mario)

objects.text:
Death's Ring is no ordinary piece of jewellery, a symbol of authority worn by the original primordial concept of Death and one of the Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse. You have acquired Death's Ring, once worn by anyone(including average humans), they will instantly possess the powers that Death once possessed, becoming the new embodiment of Death for as long as they wear the Ring, possessing all the abilities that Death once possessed.

As Death, you will possess several abilities, including but not limited to control over the flow of life and Death, holding absolute dominion over the forces beyond any other god, as the personification of Death, being able to kill things with just a touch or revive those who have died. You will also not be visible to anyone unless you want to be seen or by those who have died. You possess the ability to teleport anywhere to perform your duties as Death. As the concept of Death, when wearing the Ring, you can only be killed by your own Scythe. 

Once worn Death's Ring, it also grants two unique items along with the Ring: Death's Scythe and the Library of Death. Deaths Scythe being a unique weapon tied to your powers that act as an extension of your duties as Death being able to reap beings on the level of Chuck or the Darkness where your death touch or Reapers would be unable to act in your stead to claim the lives of those whose time has come to an end capable of being summoned to your location at will. The Library of Death will act as a repository of knowledge containing the details of every person who is going to die until your human mind can manage to contain the information.

Additionally, any abilities you possess connected to Death as a concept are drastically boosted thanks to being wielded in tandem with Death's Ring, which channels them through the Domain of Death that the Ring possesses.
objects.title: Death’s Ring (Supernatural)

objects.text: An ancient ring attuned to the elemental planes, the Ring of the Pact allows its bearer to summon and forge contracts with the great Summon Spirits from the “Tales Of” series like Ifrit, Undine, and Volt. While normally separate rings with different gemstones are used for each Summon Spirit, this singular artifact created by the King of Summon Spirits, Origin, can be a used to summon any one Summon Spirit at a time. Upon first summoning, each Summon Spirit will demand the bearer to make a Worthy Pact with the Summon Spirit before they will lend their power. The nature of this trial is shaped by the spirit’s element, personality, and values. While a single action or vow may suffice to multiple spirits, each spirt defines worthiness differently. Fire may demand resolve. Water may demand compassion. Lightning may demand willpower. So long as the pact is honored, the bearer may temporarily call upon these powerful elemental beings to aid them. A single Summon Spirit can devastate battlefields in moments or reshape the entire environments. However, each summoning taxes both the user and the spirit, and repeated or careless use may even harm the elemental planes themselves. Even without an active summoning, the ring enhances the user's magical and spiritual abilities in a chosen element. With focused effort, this attunement can be shifted, granting unparalleled versatility without the need for multiple rings. It should be remembered that the Ring of the Pact is not a tool of command, but of communion. Those who wield it become emissaries between humanity and the primal forces that shape existence. Should a pact be broken—whether through betrayal, arrogance, or neglect—the ring will offer no protection. And the spirit you wronged may return not as an ally, but as vengeance made manifest. Use it wisely. Speak truly. And above all, honor your word.
objects.title: Ring of the Pact (Tales of: Symphonia)

objects.text:
An unassuming, intricately carved stone pendant that allows the wearer to perceive hidden or overlapping realities. Once worn, the talisman grants the ability to distinguish between different layers of reality or hidden locations that are normally invisible to others. 

This can reveal secret doors, hidden passageways, or places that are in plain sight yet “overlaid” on top of another space. The wearer can see these anomalies permanently, but the talisman doesn’t grant access to the hidden spaces; it merely reveals them.
objects.title: Talisman of Forgotten Paths (The City & The City)

objects.text:
The Nine Divines of Tamriel; Akatosh, Arkay, Dibella, Julianos, Kynareth, Mara, Stendarr, Zenithar, and Talos; have chosen you to be their knight, and in turn have granted you Eight Aedric artifacts.

The Helm, created by Dibella the Divine of Love and Beauty, grants the wearer a serene beauty, which assists in things such as persuasion and bartering, but also boosts the wearer’s ability to craft and spin illusions.

The Cuirass, created by either Mara the Mother-Divine of Love and Compassion or Akatosh the Dragon-Divine of Time, grants the wearer a magical defense. Along with boosting the durability of the wearer and burning the undead or the unholy, such as Daedra or demons.

The Boots, created by Kynareth the Divine of Nature, grants the wearer the blessing to be at peace with nature, meaning that animals will never attack said wearer of their own free will. It also gives the wearer a boost in their faith and willpower.

The Shield, created by Julianos the Divine of Wisdom and Logic, reflects spells cast back at their caster, or deflects them entirely.

The Gauntlets, created by Stendarr the Divine of Mercy and Justice, grants the wearer great resistance to disease.

The Greaves, created by either Mara the Mother-Divine of Love, Compasion, and Agriculture or Akatosh the Dragon-Divine of Time, grants the wearer the ability to bless others with magical protection, as well as boosting the ability of the user to cast destructive spells.

All pieces of armor individually increase the ability of the wearer to heal and shield with magic, wearing the entire set allows for a greater boost. The armor has the weight of the light variant while providing the protection of the heavy variant.

The Sword, created by Arkay the Divine of the Cycle of Life and Death, and the Mace, created by Zenithar the Divine of Crafts, sets those it strikes ablaze. Striking with the Sword causes the recipient of the strike to have their mana or other magical energy drained from them. Striking the undead with the Mace drains the willpower of said undead, causing the weaker willed to flee.

You also receive the blessing of Talos, the Hero-God of Man and possibly the successor to Shezarr, the Traitor-God of Man. Increasing your durability and allowing you to kill immortals.

You do not lose these artifacts if you act in a way unbefitting of your title and position. Instead, by acting in a manner which befits a Knight of the Nine, following the commandments of the Divines, and spreading the good word the power of the artifacts and their blessings will increase. These Artifacts are unable to be used by those who have not been chosen by the Divines.
objects.title: Relics of the Crusader (The Elder Scrolls)

objects.text: A Royal signet ring, given to the ruler of Morrowind to cement their authority over the province by the grace of both the Tribunal gods, and the Emperor of the Tamrielic Empire. This ring has the effect of giving its wearer compete immunity to magical effects, and then reflecting said magic back at the one who cast it in the first place. It also constantly regenerates the stamina and health of the person wearing it and gives immunity to paralysing effects. Needless to say, this ring is one of the most effective protective artifacts ever found in the world of Tamriel.
objects.title: Royal Signet Ring (The Elder Scrolls)

objects.text: You have been granted a set of Enchanted Master Robes. These robes enhance your magic regeneration by 150% and decrease the cost of one school of magic chosen from Alteration, Destruction, Restoration, Conjuration, Illusion, or a school of magic from another magic system by 22%. With each additional purchase, you can gain another set of Enchanted Robes for a different school of magic. The look and style of these robes can vary depending on the school of magic they enhance.
objects.title: Master Robes (The Elder Scrolls: Skyrim)

objects.text: The Robe of the Sage is incredibly resistant to physical attacks and can be summoned and de-summoned whenever. You can switch to attack mode which trades the suits defense for overwhelming attack power. The suit can be designed to whatever you desire. It is also sentient to the point where it can protect you from dangers you aren’t aware of. At no point can this robe be permanently destroyed, reforming itself in time no matter its condition.
objects.title: Robe of the Sage (The God of High School)
Lucky Pants (The Grim Adventures of Billy and Mandy)
objects.text:
You have somehow acquired Harold’s Lucky Pants.

As for why these orange plaid pants are lucky is simple, they and by extension their wearer are completely immune to supernatural powers, lasers, and mustard.

Note: They do not make you invincible, as they cannot stop an individual from just removing them, thus rendering you vulnerable once more

I, Arthur, anointed Heir to the Kingdom, claim this Key and with it the Mastery of the Far Reaches. I claim it by blood and bone and contest, out of truth, in testament, and against all trouble.

Arthur Penhaligon

 Upon your hands now reside the form of the Second Key. By default, this is a pair of gauntlets made of a flexible silver metal, but they can take the form and style of any glove you wish without trouble. A Key can lock and unlock, bind, unbind, open, close, animate, petrify, illuminate, darken, translate, befuddle, heal, harm, kill, protect its user from harm, grant them wings, and, in general, manipulate the surrounding environment in a variety of ways. Keys can only be freely given; no amount of force can remove them from your possession. Each Key has a “specialization”—an aspect of reality that it controls best. The Second Key holds absolute command of matter, able to create matter from the void of nothing and shape it into anything the user can imagine—and that can exist without breaking the laws of reality—and just as easily reshape it into something else or return it to the void of nothing from which all creation originated. The Second Key also protects its wearer from the harmful effects of raw nothing, which normally erodes matter upon contact. However, a Key is only at full power within its own domain inside the House—for the Second Key, the Far Reaches—or during one of the seven days of the week in the Secondary Realms—for the Second Key, a Tuesday. Otherwise, it can only perform small workings and is unable to harness its grander, more formidable powers. Should you possess another Key, it can grant you the ability to use the Second Key’s powers within its demesne and day.
objects.title: The Second Key (The Keys to the Kingdom)

objects.text:
Some say it was created by the god of mischief, Loki; others say it was made through voodoo. What we do know is that every wearer of the mask is granted the power to turn their wildest dreams into reality—at the cost of their own sanity.

The mask bestows upon its wearer a power known as "Toon Force." You essentially become a living cartoon, free from the constraints of physics. You could be flattened into the ground and bounce back unscathed, explode and reform without harm, or pull impossible weapons and tools from your pockets. The only limit to what you can do is your imagination.

Though the mask can be stolen from you, it cannot be removed while you're wearing it—unless you willingly take it off. Unlike most wearers, you retain control of yourself while wearing the mask. However, you do become slightly unhinged and feel compelled to behave in a humorous, eccentric manner.

You may choose the movie, comic, or cartoon version of the mask. Only the comic version doesn't affect others with Toon Force.
objects.title: The Mask (The Mask)

objects.text:
You have Balor's Magical Eye which is a magic item of Merlin that can measure pure fighting prowess as a magical number. A person's total power level is the sum of three different values:

Magic: a measure of supernatural power.
Strength: a measure of physical ability.
Spirit: a measure of composure, determination, and perseverance.

This is just an overall rough estimate of someone's combat prowess and depending on the circumstances the values can change.
objects.title: Balor's Magical Eye (The Seven Deadly Sins)

objects.text:
The Beta Suit is a prototype time-traveling power armor. It is lightly armored with a mixture of Carbon fiber, Metal, and rubber. The Beta suit features an Onboard AI Chip called S.S.A.M. that controls suit functions and allows the user to hack into computers and receive radio transmissions. It is also used to prevent temporal paradoxes.

The suit can jump to a chosen point in time and back. Its powers can vastly improve a person's effectiveness in combat by allowing them to use three time-shifting abilities. These include: stop, slow, and rewind (all of which can be used in conjunction to perform manoeuvres against the enemy)
objects.title: Beta Suit (Time Shift)

objects.text:
The Apex Armor is another one of the Iacon Relics. Upon placement on the user's chest, it makes the wearer largely invulnerable and grants strength rivaling that of a Prime. Whether it be physical punches, bombs, energy attacks or even the crippling pressure of the ocean floor, the wearer wouldn't feel a thing. Furthermore the armor itself can shift it's size to be worn by humans, Cybertronians and everything in between.

It appears as a disc while not in use.
objects.title: Apex Armor (Transformers)

objects.text: Attached to your wrist is the Phase Shifter, one of the Iacon relics. The device lets the user phase through objects, making them physically invulnerable. The device is intuitive, activating at the user's mental commands or in accordance with any situation they are in. Note: While originally meant for Cybertronians, this one has the capability to resize itself to its user.
objects.title: Phase Shifter (Transformers)

objects.text:
A magical item that should not exist—a crystallized manifestation of the wisdom Sigurd gained by consuming the heart of a dragon. Crystallized Wisdom takes the form of a simple pair of glasses, granting its user a form of true sight.

The glasses provide their user with insight into anything they perceive, revealing the nature and secrets of objects or individuals. With it, you might discern the optimal way to wield a sword, uncover the identity of a heroic spirit, predict your opponent's next move, or unravel the intricacies of a spell. 

However, this unparalleled wisdom comes at a cost. The relentless flow of information is immense, constantly feeding knowledge about everything the wearer sees. For an untrained user, this overwhelming influx can cause severe headaches or confusion. Mastering the ability to parse and manage this barrage of information requires time and practice.

Crystallized Wisdom can be reshaped into any form of eyewear or reverted to its original form as a draconic mask.
objects.title: Crystallized Wisdom (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
A divine set of golden armor (Kavacha) and a golden earring (Kundala) given to Karna. Kavacha and Kundala are powerful defensive armor that emits the radiance of the sun, integrating with your body. Because it's light itself taking shape, it is difficult to destroy, even for gods.

While this armor doesn't nullify all attacks, attacks of B-Rank and below are blocked, and attacks higher than B will instead have their damage reduced to one-tenth of the damage you would normally receive. For instance, stakes that would normally penetrate the armor and stab you countless times all over your body will be reduced to mere scratches that are barely noticeable. By forcefully invoking the True Name "Kavacha and Kundala: O' Sun, Become Armor," you will momentarily become the very radiance of the sun, as the armor is imbued with Surya's power. This vastly raises the defensive abilities of the armor to a level where you would be able to survive attacks from someone wielding the power of multiple high-level gods, attacking you with their full power all at once for 5 seconds.
objects.title: Kavacha and Kundala: O' Sun, Become Armor (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
The endpoint for Origin Items, the Mythological Mystic Code. It harnesses the power of Human History, reaching into the very core of your being, the parts of yourself that you can never know and unlocks the truth found at your very conception. In layman's terms, it brings out the full potential of a servant, unbinding them from the restrictions of their feeble containers and temporarily granting them the tremendous power of a full Heroic Spirit. 

Regardless of whether or not you are a servant, donning the Mythological Mystic Code releases your spiritual limiter and raises your rank to a realm far beyond your previous limits. Even without any other powers, it will elevate you to the level of Ten Crowns BB as a minimum and grant you new abilities befitting of your general theme. For No Name, it granted him the power of all nameless soldiers in history. 

Should you already be at the level of a Heroic Spirit or above, donning the Mystic Code will still give a proportional boost in strength and ability as if your unaugmented self were a mere servant. 

Normally, the puny frame of a servant cannot withstand the sheer power output of the Mystic Code for long. They would only be able to use it once and at great cost to themselves, but this restriction has been waivered for you in particular. Nonetheless, it will require a truly astronomical amount of magical energy to use.
objects.title: Mythological Mystic Code (Type-Moon)

objects.text: You now possess all ten Rings of King Solomon, a set of rings that were granted to Solomon by the Almighty himself to show his approval toward the King of Israel. The rings which are said to be the origin of modern Magecraft granted the user complete and total control of all Magecraft performed by mankind in both utilization and nullification. The rings allows you to use all known Magecraft and construct any mystic code that has been shown in the Nasuverse on a level equal to True Magic.
objects.title: Rings of Solomon (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
You have received a transformation device that allows you to assume the form of a giant known as Ultraman after becoming the host to an Ultra—a member of a powerful alien species driven by compassion and justice, dedicated to promoting peace across the universe. You may choose the form your transformation device takes, such as a bracelet, stick, ring, or another item, as well as how it is activated.

As Ultraman (or Ultrawoman), you transform into a giant typically ranging from 40 to 50 meters tall, gaining superhuman strength, durability, speed, longevity, flight, and the ability to survive in the vacuum of space. You can lift kaiju-sized enemies over your head, endure massive impacts and extreme heat, live for thousands of years and travel interstellar or even intergalactic distances. You can also alter your size to match a human’s, communicate telepathically across vast distances, and teleport instantly across great spans.

You are capable of manipulating energy for powerful energy attacks such as the Ultra Beam, which can destroy monsters in a single strike. You can levitate objects, create energy barriers, and even heal others through your inner light.

Additionally, you can gain new transformations that further enhance your power and combat capabilities. You also grow stronger through your bonds with others, enabling you to overcome powerful foes you previously struggled with or even unlock entirely new forms in critical moments.

Unlike most Ultras, who can only maintain their giant form for up to three minutes on Earth due to the atmosphere filtering out most incoming light, you are able to remain in your Ultraman form indefinitely.

You may decide the origin of both your transformation device and the Ultra bonded to you—whether they hail from the Showa, Heisei, or New Generation eras, or if they are an entirely original creation.
objects.title: Transformation Device (Ultraman Series)
Shanhara Armor (Valiant)
objects.text:
Made as a result of the desperate efforts of a great scientist, combining cutting-edge bionics and the flowers of the Hara Vine on Loam, and named after the scientist’s daughter Shamhara after sacrificing herself for the primitive species that would become the Vine, the Shamhara Armor, is sentient armor made of plant, machine, Shamhara’s consciousness that is said to be the mightiest weapon of the Universe (or one among many).

The armor’s capabilities are equally wide and varied as its adaptability, forming a symbiotic bond with its user to share and coordinate what it’s capable of. Capabilities range from enhancing strength to the point of catching and absorbing a meteor’s momentum before impact, improving speed to the point of flying 4.5 light-years under a day, becoming durable enough to barely survive crashing into an asteroid or through a supernova, blasting and manipulating energy in several shapes and forms, and many more.

Due to the armor’s adaptability and symbiotic bond, it is also a conscious entity that assists when faced with a challenge. Unable to communicate and experiencing culture shock from being out of time by centuries? It will upload all you need to know (common sense included), along with Earth’s tongues, to accustom yourself. Being attacked by technopaths? It’ll adapt and develop similar powers and defenses against it.

The Philadelphia Experiment was an attempt by the U.S. Navy to make its ships invisible to enemy radar using high-powered magnets. While the experiment was only partially successful, it did manage to make the ship disappear from radar for a brief 47 seconds.

This particular barometer has the unique ability to replicate the effects of the Philadelphia Experiment, freezing time within a limited area for exactly 47 seconds. During this period, the activator and anyone in contact with the barometer can move freely within the frozen space, unaffected by the time freeze.

However, although the barometer can be reactivated immediately after this short time lapse, repeated use within a short span can lead to severe side effects for the user. These side effects include nausea, memory lapses, disorientation, and symptoms similar to those seen in individuals exposed to extreme doses of electromagnetic radiation.
objects.title: Barometer from the USS Eldridge (DE-173) (Warehouse 13)

addons.text:
While holding a transference link with your warframe, you are capable of fueling its abilities with your own incredible reserves of void energy, adding your skill with its powers to its own, doubling or even tripling its strength.

You are also capable of summoning a linked warframe to your current position.
addons.title: Void Power

addons.text: You are now capable of modifying your warframes with ease, allowing you to adjust its strengths and weaknesses or even grafting a portion of the powers from one warframe onto another.
addons.title: Modular Infusion

addons.text:
You are capable of remotely linking the Somatic Link to your warframe, allowing for a better quality transference link with your warframe.
