If you're controlling the warframe with the somatic link, you will find yourself capable of tapping into the warframe's instincts, allowing you to pilot the warframe and its abilities with such ease it's as if you lived your whole life controlling it.
addons.title: Deeper Link
Fireteam
addons.text:
With access to a Warframe, you can instead allow your Ghost to pilot your Warframe. Beyond the obvious benefits of giving your Ghost a body it can actually fight in, this also allows you to ‘passively’ synchronize with your warframe, making it ever more efficient and powerful when you take direct control of it. It also serves to protect the Ghost, making it far more difficult to destroy. 

Additionally, your Ghost can channel any of your abilities through the Warframe’s somatic link, including the Light, allowing it to scale in threat with your own capabilities.

objects.text:
You now have a rank 0 warframe, a biomechanical weapon capable of superhuman feats of strength, dexterity and agility, as well as having a set of similar superpowers. 

You are capable of performing a transference link with your warframe, allowing you to control it and channel your powers through it as if it were your own body.

At the height of its power, a warframe is capable of depopulating entire spaceships worth of elite soldiers within a matter of minutes, but at the beginning your ability to link with your warframe is limited, only granting you access to a small part of its power.

As you practice and learn how to better synchronize with your warframe, you will gain access to the hidden depths of its abilities.
objects.title: Warframe (Warframe)

objects.text: You gain the wargear common to your chosen power. This scales with your strongest power from this universe, so if your strongest was a space marine you'd get wargear for that, and if your strongest was custodes then you'd gain wargear for that. This scales all the way up to the Emperors personal wargear.
objects.title: Wargear (Warhammer: 40k)

addons.text: You have been granted the power of Archaon, the greatest Everchosen to ever walk the mortal plane. All of his skills, experience, magic, physical abilities, and knowledge is yours. You also gain the powers, skills and experience of Be’lakor due to his relation to Archaon, granting you a body that can become intangible even to attacks meant to affect spirits, as well as access to the Blade of Shadows and Forsaken Fortress.
addons.title: The Fourteenth Everchosen

addons.text:
You have inherited the mantle of one of Chaos’s most powerful champions from another universe—Horus Lupercal. With this inheritance, you gain all of his skills, knowledge, charisma, experience, and even his formidable wargear.

In addition, you wield the Six Treasures of Chaos, elevating you to a state similar to Horus after his communion with the Chaos Gods on Moloch. This transformation has effectively made you a proto-Chaos God, granting you immense power in both the material realm and the warp. Only beings of the Emperor of Mankind’s caliber can hope to challenge you.

You can draw upon the powers of the Chaos Gods at a level comparable to that of a Daemon Primarch devoted to each respective deity. Unlike Horus, however, you are not possessed by the Chaos Gods, and your body remains stable—free from the degradation and corruption that plagued him.
addons.title: Lupercal

objects.text:
You have been granted the Six Treasures of Chaos, sacred artifacts of Chaos Undivided that are bestowed upon the Everchosen. Unlike the Everchosen of the past, you are free from the influence of the Chaos Gods and can chart your own course without their interference.

The Mark of Chaos Undivided: This mark on your brow bestows the blessings of all four Chaos Gods. Khorne’s blessing grants you resistance to magic, Nurgle’s blessing creates an invisible miasma that nullifies magic, Tzeentch’s blessing grants great magical power and resistance to magic nullification, and Slaanesh’s blessing creates an aura of charm and empathy so strong that most foes won’t even attack you. You can also conceal this mark from the physical or spiritual senses of others if you choose.

Armor and Runeshield of Morkar: This armor can twist reality around itself to weaken enemy attacks and magic, making it highly durable. These properties extend to your flesh over time. The Runeshield shares similar abilities with the armor.

Eye of Sheerian: This artifact grants powerful clairvoyance, foresight, and protection from scrying or other attempts to gather information about you. It also serves as a potent magical focus, capable of generating blinding light, hypnosis, and manipulating raw magical energy.

Droghar: A mighty Daemonic Steed that begins as a horse but can shapeshift into almost anything, even forms like black lightning or hellfire. Droghar can also take on the properties of what it consumes and has already devoured Greater Daemons of Nurgle, Tzeentch, and Khorne. It is fully loyal to you and obeys your every command.

Slayer of Kings: A powerful Daemonblade possessed by the Greater Daemon U’Zhul. The wielder can absorb the daemon’s vitality to enhance their own strength. The blade is entirely loyal to you and will incinerate or consume the soul of anyone else who attempts to wield it. It can cut through almost anything, from armor to energy, and can envelop itself in Daemonic Hellfire.

The Crown of Domination: This artifact radiates malice and fear. It can manipulate the will of millions, uniting the often infighting followers of Chaos into a cohesive force. The Crown has a socket for the Eye of Sheerian, and when placed within, it unlocks the full potential of the Eye.

These Treasures can be modeled after their Warhammer Fantasy or Age of Sigmar forms, depending on your preference.
objects.title: Six Treasures of Chaos (Warhammer: Age of Sigmar)

objects.text: You are now the wielder of The Witchblade, a sapient, intelligent, and ancient weapon. Born from the universe's primordial opposing aspects, the Darkness and the Angelus, The Witchblade is a male aspect created to act as a balance. The Witchblade takes the form of an ornate jeweled bracelet when dormant, and when active becomes a wickedly bladed gauntlet and armor for your most sensitive areas. As adaptive armor, it grows as necessary to further protect its host in nearly impervious bladed armor. Among its other powers is the ability to keep the host in peak human condition, grant superhuman strength and endurance, accelerated regeneration, low-level invulnerability covering bullets and minor explosions, pyrokinesis and immunity to heat and fire, tactile telekinetic healing of other beings, and weapon formation of blades, whips, swords, spears, wings which allow flight, projectile darts, etc.
objects.title: The Witchblade (Witchblade)

addons.text:
The Companion Bracelet can now integrate with the Relic Biochip™, embedding its AI directly into the wearer’s nervous system and cognitive functions. Rather than relying solely on external interfaces, the AI gains seamless biological-digital synchronization, drastically enhancing its processing speed, adaptability, and autonomy.

With this integration, the AI can interface directly with the brain, optimizing neural pathways to improve reaction time, decision-making, and memory retention. It can offload complex cognitive tasks, allowing the user to think faster, solve problems more efficiently, and even temporarily enhance intelligence when needed. In combat, the AI now provides instantaneous reflex boosts, optimizing muscle coordination and allowing for preemptive dodging or counterattacks based on predictive modeling.

Additionally, it can also override bodily functions in critical moments, inducing controlled adrenaline surges, suppressing pain, or maintaining consciousness through neural stimulation.

However, the Biochip’s deep integration means removal is highly invasive, and prolonged reliance may blur the line between man and machine, thus the wearer must be mindful of how much autonomy they allow it to exert over their mind and body.
addons.title: Cyberdeck Core

objects.text:
The Companion Bracelet houses a near-sapient AI that evolves alongside its wearer, residing within a nullspace supercomputer mainframe—a fully upgradable system that can be summoned or dismissed at will. While inside nullspace, it remains untouchable and will self-repair, but it can restore either its internal systems or its real-space terminal—never both at once. Damaging both is the only way to destroy it.

Though called a bracelet, its form adapts to different physiologies—a humanoid may receive a wristband, choker, or anklet, while a slime-based being might be injected with a nanite swarm. Upon bonding, the AI tailors its personality to best support the wearer, ensuring it always acts in their best interest and continuously adapts.

With photographic memory and direct sensory access, the AI serves as an invaluable assistant, detecting overlooked details, recalling forgotten information, and processing data at superhuman speeds. It can instantly browse the internet, analyze real-time situations, and provide strategic insights, keeping the wearer informed and prepared.

Beyond basic assistance, its predictive modeling anticipates dangers by analyzing environmental, social, and digital factors. It simulates possible outcomes for critical decisions and, with voice modulation and social engineering protocols, can flawlessly impersonate individuals or manipulate communication channels to deceive adversaries. Additionally, it acts as an infallible tutor, capable of teaching anything from advanced physics to lost ancient languages, making it an endless well of knowledge.

In combat, its target-tracking and spatial awareness highlight enemy positions, predict projectile paths, and hijack electronics. It generates tactical overlays and an augmented reality interface, enhancing awareness and giving its wearer a decisive edge.
objects.title: Companion Bracelet (World Seed)

objects.text: Created by Master Dashi as one of the incredibly powerful Shen Gong Wu, the Golden Tiger Claws in particular are a coveted item. With this claw, you are able to rip a hole in space-time to any other point in space-time that you can jump through to instantly transport yourself and others. You can choose if and when the rip closes at any time.
objects.title: Golden Tiger Claws (Xiaolin Showdown)

addons.text:
By your side through thick and thin is a very special Yo-kai that will be your guide, protector, advisor, bodyguard, conduit, or whatever else you need to aid you in your new supernatural adventures. By default, they have the power of flight, Intangibility and shapeshifting. Alongside a slew of other powers to defend you from whatever setting you find yourself in. They can bestow these powers to you as well.

Only you can see them unless you explicitly allow others to. 

They are a living encyclopaedia on everything you need to know about any and all Yo-kai. From their favourite foods, behaviours, habitats, weaknesses, how to earn their friendship, or navigate the Yo-kai World, etc. They can share this information orally or telepathically. 

In their possession is the Yo-kai Pad, which you may freely use to browse the Yo-kai Internet, watch videos, learn about Yo-kai yourself, or even use your mundane internet.
addons.title: Your Very Own Whisper

addons.text:
The features of the Yo-kai Watch and Omnitrix have merged to create something brand new! On top of the variety of improvements to your new Yo-kai Watch, you can now transform into Yo-kai and gain their powers at their absolute peak. You may decide if you transform into a full Yo-kai or a hybrid of some kind, exact appearance is automatically tailored to you.

Additionally, you have no need to collect Yo-kai Medals. As the Yo-kai Lens inherits the Scanning feature of the Omnitrix, automatically cataloguing them into an ever expanding playlist. 

Your Yo-kai Medallium will still catalogue them as if you did collect their Medals.
addons.title: Come On Out My Friend!

objects.text:
To add some spice to your painfully average life, you've found or have been gifted the Yo-kai Watch. A device that allows you to see and interact with the normally invisible creatures it's named after, who often cause mischief throughout the human world. 

Wearing the watch gives you a great awareness and intuition for finding Yo-kai, even the most elusive ones will have a hard time hiding from you. By pressing the button to its side, you activate the Yo-kai Lens, a light and scope that further reveals their presence. In the event you encounter a dangerous Yo-kai, the light will stun and blind them with enough power to allow you the chance to flee or fight back. 

Otherwise, you will gain the opportunity to obtain its Yo-kai Medal, a symbol of its friendship and loyalty towards you. How you obtain it varies, from feeding the creature its favorite food, solving the problem it causes, defeating it in battle, etc. To solve the third variable, you've been given Jibanyan's Medal, which will summon him to your aid by inserting it into the watch. The same applies for any other Yo-kai Medal you have. 

You can have up to 6 Yo-kai summoned at a time and any additional Medals are stored with a travel sized book called the Yo-kai Medallium, which is soulbound to you, indestructible, and unlosable. No matter what world you're in, you'll always find something akin to Yo-kai.
objects.title: Yo-kai Watch (Yo-kai Watch)

addons.text:
You now possess the ability to conjure and summon every card in the YU-GI-OH franchise no longer being limited to the number limit of 60 for your main deck and 15 for your extra card deck. You can now also manifest your cards without needing to put them on a duel disk allowing you to duel or defend yourself in case you are unable to use your duel disk.
Should you purchase them in the OOP section or obtain the Millennium Items in the world of Yu-Gi-Oh then you will gain a strong connection and the ability to summon spirits from the Realms of Duel Monsters allowing you to slowly but eventually obtain the traits of various duel monsters increasing your lifeforce along with the strength of your Ka spirit which you can change depending on which spirit you have fully bonded with.

Note: In Tournaments you will be limited by the usual limit of cards for your main and extra decks to prevent cheating.
addons.title: Its time to Duel

objects.text:
You gain a few things: a duel disk, a card case, and a deck of Duel Monsters that you can choose the contents of (up to a maximum of a 60 card main deck, a 15 card extra deck, and a 15 card side deck).

Your duel disk gains the functionality to transform into any physical version used in the Yu-Gi-Oh! series, however it will take an hour to do so and will instantly change to the selected design when the duration is complete, how this is done is decided now (e.g. a button that's always present between forms and imagining it while pressing down on it, via voice commands describing the desired appearance, etc.).
objects.title: Duel Equipment (Yu-Gi-Oh!)

addons.text:
You can now consume Virus Cores to obtain a permanent copy of a random magical function, ability, transformation, or spell fragment related to its contents. These reality code copies are then stored inside your Twilight Bracelet for you to analyze at any time.

Code generated by consuming Virus Cores is not always complete, easily understandable, or superior to what you already possess, but will always be in a form processable by your reality hacking power and new to the list of converted magical functions already inside your Twilight Bracelet.

While this translation does not grant the expertise needed to understand, reverse-engineer, or implement any generated code, you will always be able to analyze, modify, and execute each discovery given time, effort, and increases to your own proficiency. However, you must also supply the energy, processing capacity, and other resources required by the power through which you use it.

As such, a fire-based Virus Core taken from a dragon might provide an improved fireball function, an inferior version of a familiar spell, or part of an unknown defensive fire technique, with higher quality Virus Cores containing more complete or more powerful sections of code.
addons.title: Foreign Function Libraries
Weird Rare Candy
addons.text:
You can consume Virus Cores to improve the Servants you can create or capture with your other ability. The gained benefit depends on the quality and completeness of the Virus Core’s data, its similarity to the servant being improved, and the complexity of that servant. 

Broadly related cores provide modest assistance, while closely matching cores can replace substantial amounts of simulated training. In effect, each Virus Core may now be treated as a Rare Candy you may feed your servants. Better still, it is now possible to, inefficiently, feed contradictory Virus Cores to your 
servants, allowing them to slowly learn aspects of those Virus Cores. 

While such an endeavor will take a long time and a large amount of Virus Cores, it is now possible to, for example, evolve a Tacet Discord, teach Pikachu to use the move Flamethrower, or create an Agumon that can breathe underwater.

objects.text:
You have gained the Twilight Bracelet, a manifestation of your power that lets you interact with reality as though it were data. This bracelet is bound to you and can be concealed at will. Its interface displays its available functions, stored Virus Cores, your current Infection level, their associated symptoms, and recovery rate.

The Twilight Bracelet and its signature ability, Data Drain, allows you to extract portions of a target’s underlying reality source code, thus reducing it to a weaker, simpler, or more normal state by removing a portion (or entirety) of a given physical capability, supernatural ability, or protection. 

While Data Drain always leaves its target alive, since it is reality itself, not the physical target, that you affect with this ability, the extent of the reductions and changes a Data Drain can do to a target depends solely on your proficiency with the power. As such, Data Drain can be used on pretty much anything, including living beings, objects, temporary effects, advanced technology, supernatural phenomena, metaphysical properties, and reality changes. 

You start with the skill to extract, per Data Drain, a random weak, limited, or temporary physical or supernatural ability and store its data inside your bracelet as a Virus Core. With time and practice, you will gain the ability to extract selective, stronger, stranger, and more numerous effects, thus allowing you to remove a single specific curse without weakening its host, or remove something as all-consuming as Species, Invulnerability, or even Godhood from a target.

However, before you can Data Drain a target, you must attack it until it undergoes a Protect Break: a brief temporary opening in its source code’s protection. Every attack you make contributes to the chance of Protect Break, even against beings with complete immunity to your attacks, as again, you are causing a hole in reality’s defenses, not the target’s.

The number and strength of attacks needed for a Protect Break depends only on the target’s complexity, intelligence, sentience, strength, and ontological resistance. Willing targets can also lower their protection against Data Drain voluntarily. 

Furthermore, each Data Drain also raises your Infection level, or the amount of corruption within your own reality source code. As this Infection level rises, errors in your source code become increasingly apparent and severe, causing impaired abilities, physical abnormalities, mental changes, and status effects ranging from dizziness to a near-death coma. While training and practice will improve your tolerance for this foreign data, reducing the Infection generated by a given Data Drain, the more powerful, complex, or already corrupted alterations you make, the more infected data will be generated.

Fortunately, this infection and corruption does slowly and gradually clear and disappear the longer Data Drain is unused. However, continue to use Data Drain too much, and you may cross an irreversible threshold.

Upon reaching 100% Infection, a catastrophic failure occurs, resulting in your death, the destruction of your ontological continuity, and the deletion of yourself and the surrounding area from reality. This failure is similar to an Admin-level debug, server-wide computer reset, and rejection of your possible existence across existence. Reality itself can no longer recognize you or the affected region as something it can support. Healing, resurrection, temporal restoration, and other such effects cannot reverse this rejection, because the information needed to support a valid return has itself been invalidated and corrupted.
objects.title: Twilight Bracelet (.hack)

objects.text:
You now own a twelve-meter fighter plane that imprinted on you the moment it emerged into this world, convinced that you are its parent and primary food provider. Dead Ahead is a fusion of arachnid and aircraft, its body a fuselage of chitinous plates tapering from a bulb-like thorax to a pointy abdomen, wrapped in a secondary, thin exoskeleton that would make it indistinguishable from a WWII fighter plane if it weren’t for its chitinous biology. Twin propellers spin at the nose where doubled mandibles have repurposed themselves into rotary blades, and six jointed legs fold up into the undercarriage during flight, deploying on landing to grip surfaces with unnatural adhesion. The wings possess additional wing membranes that bloom from its edges when airborne, working in tandem with those propellers to achieve speeds of 200 meters per second in flight and execute turns so sharp they seem to violate inertia. Clusters of compound eyes bulge across what would be the inside of the cockpit, providing 270-degree vision across its personal airspace. Of course, due to the nature of its shell for camouflage, you will find a seat for yourself within.

The spinnerets fire from where machine guns would mount on human aircraft, launching pressurized webbing laced with digestive enzymes that stick to anything they touch and immediately begin breaking it down fast enough to where metal corrodes into rust, and composite armor delaminates layer by layer. These spinnerets can maintain fire rates matching heavy machine guns with each burst capable of sawing through reinforced hulls in seconds or reducing infantry to dissolving corpses in moments. The webbing carries enough enzymatic potency to slag a main battle tank in under a minute, and Dead Ahead has approximately eight minutes of continuous fire before needing to feed and replenish its spinneret reserves.

On the ground, Dead Ahead transitions from aerial combatant to ground predator. Those landing legs work equally as well for scuttling across rubble, scaling vertical surfaces, and leaping between buildings. The propeller blades become melee weapons, spinning at lethal speeds to shear through anything that gets within striking range. Dead Ahead can also cling to ceilings and squeeze through spaces that seem impossibly small for its bulk, and is intelligent enough to execute ambushes from positions no conventional vehicle could occupy, such as the rooms within a building or the roof of one. Its plating proves remarkably durable, able to shrug off small arms fire and resist everything short of anti-tank weaponry. 

Dead Ahead treats you with the affection of a cat. It is a smart cat. It brings you kills the way a cat brings mice to its owner, except the "mice" are fishing trawlers and the occasional yacht dragged to whatever location you call home and deposited with obvious pride. It will develop a particular fondness for fishing vessels, viewing them as perfectly-sized prey items. It refuses to stray far from your position unless explicitly ordered and seeks physical contact during downtime by pressing its thorax against you, and if you ignore it then it will begin its equivalent of knocking objects from shelves, and at its size that particular habit will be very hard to manage. If you are about to be harmed in its sight, it will know, and it will shoot to kill if you do not stop it. 

It’s also important to note that it is very much so sentient: Dead Ahead will learn your routines, anticipate your needs, and will occasionally make decisions it thinks you'll approve of. Be careful to not let it bite off more than it can chew; as a child born to war it can do quite a lot, but it will pale in comparison to a modern aerial strike force.
objects.title: Air-to-Ground Fighter Plane: Dead Ahead

objects.text:
A heavily modified double-decker school bus, reforged into a rugged mobile fortress built for survival in the wasteland. Its exterior is clad in mismatched scrap metal plating, welded and bolted together to deflect gunfire and deter looters. Jagged steel rams jut from the reinforced front bumper, ideal for plowing through debris—or threats. Spikes bristle from the sides and roof, both as a deterrent against boarders and a grim warning to any who’d approach uninvited. Every window is boarded up with steel slats and wooden planks, offering maximum protection while still allowing visibility through narrow, strategically placed slits.

Inside, the vehicle has been reimagined as a self-contained refuge for a small crew. The driver’s seat is fitted with a functioning radio, capable of picking up both standard and shortwave frequencies, allowing for communication with other survivors or intercepting enemy chatter. The lower level houses a compact living space with bedrolls, basic storage compartments for supplies, and enough room for a small workbench and cooking station. The upper level functions as a watch post, equipped with reinforced walls and multiple gunports—peepholes large enough to aim and fire from while remaining in cover. The entire vehicle is rigged to be functional and defensible on the move or stationary.

The bus is capable of slowly repairing and maintaining itself over time, but the process is significantly accelerated when supplied with materials and attended by someone skilled in upkeep. It also comes with a full tank of fuel and within the storage you will find reserves sufficient for five complete refuels, ensuring it can go the distance across the ruined highways of a fallen world. It can run on alternative fuels such as biofuel, scavenged batteries, or hybrid jury-rigs, as well as improvised sources like alcohol, diesel, or methane rigs.
objects.title: Apocalypse Bus

objects.text:
Originally deployed during the final phase of the Outer Planetary Conflict, Armored Platform 01 “Dominator” was humanity’s answer to entrenched orbital shock units and forward assault walkers. Built to dominate both battlefield and psychological terrain, it became an icon of overwhelming kinetic warfare.

Despite weighing over 120 metric tons, the Dominator utilizes a triple-core fusion drive connected to magneto-gravitic treads, allowing it to accelerate across broken ground, debris fields, and rugged terrain at speeds exceeding 90 km/h. The fusion-assisted suspension compensates for shock and velocity shifts, letting the tank move with startling agility for its bulk.

Its primary weapon is a centerline-mounted, ultra-heavy railgun — a coil-assisted linear accelerator capable of firing solid ferrous slugs at hypersonic velocity. Each round is the length of a javelin and strikes with enough kinetic energy to punch through hardened bunkers, tear open walker plating, or rupture light carrier hulls. The recoil is managed by magnetic dampeners, but a six to eight second charge cycle limits rapid-fire capability.

Mounted on either side are dual-linked autocannons, capable of sustained fire against infantry, drones, and light vehicles. These fire smart-slugs in controlled bursts with stabilizing gyros for accuracy on the move. For area control, modular rocket pods are built into side compartments — swappable between high-explosive, smoke, or armor-piercing warheads, depending on mission needs. Ammunition is stored in internal magnetic racks that auto-feed into the firing systems via kinetic conveyors.

Armor-wise, its hull is made of multi-layered reactive alloy plating over a shock-absorbent internal chassis, designed to withstand heavy artillery, railfire, and sustained siege fire. The exterior incorporates smart materials—semi-reactive armor mesh that adjusts density around damaged zones and begins basic self-repair within minutes of conflict downtime. Integrated micro-repair probes roam the internal structure during low-activity states, identifying microfractures, clearing debris, and realigning worn components. While not fast, this autonomous repair cycle allows the Dominator to gradually recover combat functionality between engagements without field maintenance crews.

The vehicle is fully operable by a single pilot, who interfaces through a neural-link cockpit system or external command module. From this interface, they control all primary and secondary functions, with AI-assisted targeting, navigation, and damage control ensuring smooth operation under stress. When needed, the Dominator can be switched to autonomous mode, executing battlefield directives independently via advanced heuristic protocols — capable of pursuit, suppression, escort, or patrol duties without human input.

Though fully self-sustaining, the Dominator is impossible to conceal. It is massive, thunderous, and the railgun’s electromagnetic emissions light up sensors across every spectrum. Extended operations cause significant vent heat, and its movement leaves unmistakable physical and seismic traces behind.
objects.title: Armored Platform 01 “Dominator”

objects.text: The Buried Utility Rover for Recon, Operations, and Warfare, or B.U.R.R.O.W, is a vehicle developed with a rather peculiar purpose: To not go around or over things, but rather under them. Its drill is said to be made of various otherworldly metals including Orichalcum, Mithril, and other materials. Nevertheless, the effect of these is fairly obvious. To say its piercing power is second to none would almost be an understatement. Seating about 6 people inside of the SSTs 10 meter tall, 6 meter-wide, and 6.1 meter long Ruby red/caution yellow body with relative comfort, the vehicle includes low-sci-fi scale sensors, a built-in supply case with medical supplies and digging tools in case of emergency. It has a top speed, assuming peak efficiency, of 210 MPH. If it were to be attacked by a being who could crush tanks with a stomp with ease, it would need at least 10 and 50 to destroy the body and drill respectively. Its peak function however, is its very purpose: to Drill through and travel under just about anything. Dense rock that would break any other drill in one minute? Cutting through like a hot sword through butter. Deepest depths of the ocean that would crush those non-native to it? pfft, you sure this isn't just land? Overall, it is a very capable vehicle, although the big drawback is, while the fuel can be converted from any liquid of "equal" value if sufficiently intelligent, it requires molten copper to run.
objects.title: B.U.R.R.O.W

objects.text:
You have a Chalysacrus — one of the colossal megafaunal predators of Zethas, a planet of lightless fungal labyrinths and deep subsurface biomes. Wild Chalysacri are feared for their size and unstoppable power, but domesticated bloodlines have been bent to harness by both locals and, to a lesser degree, the Federation of Worlds. These immense creatures serve as armored transports and living vehicles, carrying riders and cargo through shifting underground stones.

Your Chalysacrus stretches nearly fifteen meters in length, with the height and mass of a terrestrial semi truck. At rest its body seems soft and pliant, the segmented dermal surface flexing fluidly as it crawls or coils. Yet when provoked to charge, an electrical current surges through its integument, hardening the segments into plates with the strength of alloyed steel. Each section locks against the next, transforming the creature into a single rigid cylinder of armor and muscle. Though it resembles a millipede with its rows of repeating plates and scores of legs, the Chalysacrus is fundamentally mammalian, with an endoskeleton braced by dense musculature and hydrostatic tissues that drive its locomotive bursts.

Your Chalysacrus’s power lies in speed and weight, and in the precision of its coordinated gait. Dozens of thick legs strike the fungal substrate in waves, propelling its bulk at tunnel-breaking velocity. In a charge it can reach more than twenty meters per second, pulverizing biomass walls, crushing smaller beasts, and scattering anything caught in its path. Its head carries a gnathic beak, built not only for tearing prey and fungal stalks but for stone itself, capable of cracking through mineralized barriers that clog the labyrinth. In combination with its hardened charge, it can shatter rock outcroppings and drive headlong through dense stone seams, carving new passages where none existed.  

Within, the Chalysacrus carries a digestive system adapted to both carnivory and fungivory. Gigantic fermentation chambers in its posterior gut break down the dense carbon walls of fungal megastructures, sustaining its massive body on both starches and proteins. With the right methods, it can be used as a biological distillery to create high quality alcohol.

For explosive movement, its metabolism relies on rapid-release phosphagen reserves, flooding the muscles with stored chemical energy during sprints and charges. After such bursts the beast often lingers in rest, its body heat rising as its metabolism labors to replenish spent reserves.

Your Chalysacrus has been fitted with harnessing designed for stability across its flexible frame. Saddles and cargo platforms anchor deep into reinforced dermal seams, remaining steady even as the beast flows over uneven terrain or accelerates into a sprint. Though not intelligent by the measure of tool-users, it responds reliably to vocal tones, vibration signals, and electrostim cues built into its tack.

Its senses are tuned to the dark world it inhabits. Recessed nodules embedded across its body detect low-frequency heat signatures, marking the presence of warm-blooded life. Every leg base is sensitive to seismic pressure, allowing the Chalysacrus to read vibrations through the fungal floor, discerning the scale and approach of distant movement. Chemical organs within its skull parse the airborne trails of sap and blood, giving it a crude but effective ability to track recent activity.
objects.title: Chalysacrus

objects.text:
The Seraphine Dawn was developed by the Aurelion Starline Consortium at the height of the post–Outer Planetary Conflict tourism boom, built to reintroduce luxury, comfort, and spectacle to a galaxy exhausted by warfare. Designed as a prestige vessel at the crossroads of industry, art, and interstellar engineering, it sails the warp lanes as a mobile resort and cultural landmark. The hull boasts sweeping curvature, radiant metallic chiming panels, and a luminous gold-infused nanocoating that shimmers against nearby suns. Measuring 578 meters in length and 185 meters at its widest point, its silhouette is sleek but grand, with panoramic shielded view galleries running along each flank.

Built atop a gravitic lattice superstructure, the Seraphine Dawn uses phase-blended ceramic composites and silent-impact gel layers to ensure total vibration cancellation and micrometeorite immunity. Its tri-core fusion engine suite provides exceptional cruising stability and quiet thrust, granting the vessel long-range efficiency without exerting aggressive g-forces on its passengers. Capable of fluid multi-vector drift maneuvers and precision station-keeping within meters of stellar anomalies, the ship glides in a graceful, swanlike posture that contrasts sharply with the brutal acceleration profiles of military craft. Despite its mass, its inertial comfort bubble eliminates internal motion sensation entirely.

At its heart lies a civilian Class-4 warp core. It requires a ten-minute charge cycle to initiate a fold, with a six-hour cooldown thanks to advanced heat-shedding radiative fins buried within the ship’s spine. Warp transitions are whisper-silent, leaving beverages unperturbed and passengers entirely unaware unless they happen to glance outside the observation decks. Triple isolators prevent catastrophic instability even in the event of battle damage.

Defensively, the Seraphine Dawn is equipped with an extensive but strictly civilian-regulated weapons network designed to repel pirate vessels through saturation fire and rapid-target interception rather than military brute force. Its primary shield is the Constellation micro-railgrid: a ring of 162 automated point-defense rail turrets distributed across the hull in overlapping arcs, each firing ultra-light flechette slugs to shred drones, missiles, boarding pods, and agile raider craft. For standoff protection, the ship mounts six Crownline long-range disabling rail cannons, with two dorsal, two ventral, one forward, and one aft, calibrated to cripple engines and weapon arrays on hostile frigates without breaching hulls. Supplementing these are 18 low-output pulse turrets, which project sensor-blinding plasma bursts designed to force disengagement rather than destroy targets. Finally, 32 defensive missile tubes cycle EMP interceptors, chaff dispersers, and net-deploying warheads for close-quarters survival. All systems are coordinated by the isolated Argent Guard battle-AI, ensuring full autonomous operation without ever compromising civilian safety protocols.

Inside, the Seraphine Dawn is a floating palace: verdant arboretum crescents, zero-gravity lounges with softfall fields, aquatic spas, holo-theaters, and suites ranging from 40 m² staterooms to 300 m² sky domes with panoramic lumin-shield ceilings. A distributed hospitality AI ecosystem controls climate, cuisine, entertainment, and environmental comfort with seamless precision. Atmosphere is continuously reconditioned, lighting shifts with circadian cues, and gravity remains absolutely consistent across every deck. A small army of maintenance drones handles repairs invisibly, while compartmentalized bulkheads, grav-stabilizers, and emergency bubble sealers ensure passenger safety even during unforeseen skirmishes.
objects.title: Civilian Cruise-Class Vessel 18 “Seraphine Dawn”

objects.text:
During the late Outer Planetary Conflict, rogue engineers operating in the Saturn-Titan Exclusion Zone salvaged the gutted remains of a downed Judgement-class insertion vessel and repurposed its broken hull, turning it into a deep-space hybrid gunship built for piracy, interception, and black-zone warfare. Dubbed “Glasshouse” by its crew for its glowing shield casings and exposed inner structure, it was assembled from technologies scavenged from both the wrecked Judgement and the vehicles it once carried, including Valkyrie-pattern interceptors, Helios plasma weapons, and Dominator-class power systems.

The ship spans 61 meters in length and 27 meters at its widest point, barely half the size of its original base. Its crew capacity ranges from 8 to 12, with internal space divided across manual control decks, modular quarters, and emergency containment bays. The ship is overseen by an embedded AI core running a banned personality matrix, which enables the vessel to be operated effectively by a skeleton crew without performance loss. It interfaces directly with piloting, combat, and navigation systems, making rapid decisions without input delays or uplink lag. It also has blueprints of the ship and can guide you during maintenance work.

Weapon systems are rugged and oversized for a ship this class. A spinal-mounted railgun fires ferrous slugs at hypersonic speed, capable of disabling corvettes or cracking planetary fortifications. Dorsal and ventral plasma turrets offer pulse and charge firing modes, balancing suppression and armor penetration. The hull includes universal hardpoints for missile pods, drone launchers, or ECM tools, depending on crew preference and scavenged loadout. Ammunition feeds are semi-manual, with visible external storage racks and high-voltage discharge ports requiring regular tuning.

The Glasshouse’s defensive capability is a two-layer shield grid powered by salvaged capacitors. The outer field absorbs energy and radiation, while the inner barrier redirects physical impacts. Should the shields fail, the armored hull is constructed from scavenged composites: reactive alloy mesh that hardens on impact, kinetic dispersion foam that absorbs and spreads explosive force, and ablative ceramic plating that vaporizes under directed energy to dissipate heat. The interior chassis is divided into isolated compartments to contain breaches, and despite its crude look, the Glasshouse can take direct concentrated railgun fire, atmospheric blast pressure, or heat-based bombardment and remain spaceworthy.

Propulsion is handled by twin overclocked fusion engines and six gimbal-mounted directional thrusters, salvaged and modified for thrust vectoring across all axes. These jury-rigged thrusters give the ship solid turning ability and boost control in orbital and zero-G environments. Meaning it can outmaneuver heavier craft and reposition aggressively in a dogfight. Inertial dampeners stabilize internal forces, allowing high-speed course corrections and pivot turns without fatal G-force transfer to the crew. Furthermore, it has a stolen Class-3 warp core designed for long-range deployment. Its spacetime fold system enables faster-than-light travel after a 30-minute charge-up phase and a full 24-hour cooldown. Warp jumps are reliable, but the ship rapidly heats up while charging.

A ventral deployment bay acts as a reinforced cargo hold, optimized for smuggling, offloading contraband, and mid-orbit cargo interception. The space has been restructured with a jury-rigged grid of rail-lock shelves, magnetic anchor clamps, and shock-dampening floor plates. It cannot carry full-size vehicles or auxiliary craft, but comfortably holds modular cargo blocks, secure crates, drone canisters, and heavy loot recovered from boarding operations.
objects.title: Glasshouse

objects.text:
Every kid's dream: you now own a personalized hoverboard. About as fast as a sports car, it lets you speed through the air and fly freely. You can ascend and descend as high as you're able, and the board can easily support the weight of two people.

Powered by your very existence, there’s no need to worry about batteries or recharging. When you purchase your board, you can choose its appearance—retro-futuristic, cyberpunk, magical, or anything in between. However, this feature is purely cosmetic; no extra functions like weapons can be added.

Keep in mind, buying this doesn’t give you any flying skills. Mastering the skies will take practice so go and soar!
objects.title: Hoverboard

objects.text: In your possession now lies the Somersault Nimbus Cloud of the Great Sage Equal to Heaven, a legendary living cloud imbued with the will and legacy of its former master. Having deemed you worthy, it has granted you its prodigious powers and unwavering loyalty—for now. You may summon Nimbus at will, wielding its abilities to command the elements, master the winds, and shape the very heavens to your desires. Nimbus's power is as boundless as the sky itself, a force of unmatched versatility and devastating might. At your command, it can unleash a relentless tempest, raining down a barrage of searing lightning bolts to reduce your enemies to ash. Solidify its ethereal form to shield you from attacks or act as impenetrable armor, and extend its tendrils to ensnare and subdue foes, binding them with the weight of the heavens. To even summon gale-force winds, scattering your enemies like leaves before a hurricane. Nimbus is more than a weapon—like for the Great Sage before you, it is a steadfast companion, a swift and loyal steed. With unmatched speed and grace, it carries you across the skies, soaring far beyond the reach of the Earth and Heavens alike, unbound by the chains of gravity or fate. The true magnitude of Nimbus's abilities reveals itself with enough patience and determination. When given time, it can gather the skies under its dominion, expanding its influence across an entire continent, even encompassing Asia in its embrace. Such a feat demands not only your unwavering focus but also relies on Nimbus's ability to coax the winds, clouds, and heavens into alignment—a delicate endeavor, as the elements are notoriously temperamental and fickle allies. Even without invoking such grandiosity, Nimbus is a force to be reckoned with in its natural form, akin to a small typhoon, capable of tearing through nearly anything that dares to stand in its way. One of Nimbus's most devastating abilities is its capacity to unleash a cataclysmic lightning strike, channeling all the energy it holds into a singular, devastating, earth-shattering blow. This ultimate attack, however, comes at a steep cost, leaving Nimbus utterly drained and inert for a time. It is a weapon of last resort, to be deployed only in the most dire of circumstances when no lesser force will suffice. While Nimbus has chosen you, its allegiance is not unconditional. Should you dishonor yourself or tarnish the legacy of the Great Sage, Nimbus will not hesitate to make its displeasure known. At best, it will resist your commands; at worst, it may turn against you—or abandon you entirely. To command Nimbus is to shoulder the burden of its legacy. So treat it with the reverence and respect that it deserves, for the clouds are as mercurial as they are mighty.
objects.title: Kinto'un

objects.text:
When you awaken you’ll find a curious machine lying beside you. It seems you’ve bonded with Mercury’s Chariot. This is far from an average machine, and can take whatever form you wish, from a motorcycle, to a car, to a small starship. This form changing is limited to what could be meaningfully piloted or constructed by you (for instance, in the mid twentieth century, it’s highly unlikely Mercury’s Chariot would be able to transform into a land speeder, and in the forty-first it is similarly unlikely to take the form of a horse). 

This vehicle will grow over time alongside you, increasingly becoming more efficient and more able to synchronise with your own abilities to varying effect. If damaged, dismissing and summoning it again will repair it. It is able to incorporate any technology or magic it comes into contact with or that you yourself could conceivably install into it.
objects.title: Mercury's Chariot

objects.text:
You get a horse. You can choose its sex and what it looks like. But this is no simple horse. This horse has been genetically enhanced through gene therapy, biomancy, and even some rituals to become the perfect horse for any aspiring horse enthusiast.

It does not need sustenance or sleep. Nor does it even need to breathe and will not age out of its prime, and it has a slightly supernatural regeneration allowing it heal any injury that doesn't kill it within a weeks time. This horse has no concept of pain or fear, so you will not need to worry about it becoming spooked and running. Its physicals are also triple that of the greatest aspects of any mundane horse. It can charge and repeatedly ram into doors and even gates, and it would likely do more damage to them than it would take from the charge. This also includes being capable of running at a top speed of 132 miles per hour and keeping that pace indefinitely.

This horse comes with armor twice as durable as steel, a saddle, bridle, and reins.
objects.title: Modified Horse

addons.text:
Your village has become bound to the Ark, its living quarters expanded and transformed to accommodate the six hundred inhabitants who now call the vessel their home. The quarters have been rebuilt into a sprawling complex of cabins, communal halls, gardens, workshops, and storerooms sufficient to sustain the entire population.

Every villager has been trained through long familiarity to tend to the myriad creatures carried within the Ark. They know how to soothe restless lions, mend broken wings, and manage the endless cycles of feeding, cleaning, and care required to keep the menagerie healthy. Just as importantly, the animals recognize them in turn: predators and prey alike treat the villagers with instinctive trust, responding not with fear but with calm acceptance.

Lastly, the influence of your power does not end with the villagers. The animals themselves have begun to change, their forms subtly or dramatically altered by the echo of your strength. Some grow stronger, faster, or more resilient, based of your abilities. In certain cases, your power reshapes the Ark’s population more profoundly, adding creatures not found on Earth but rather born from whatever world your power came from. For example, if your power comes from The Lord of the Rings, the Ark’s kennels might shelter a pair of towering Wargs, while if it originates from Star Wars, the pens could instead hold a pair of massive Banthas.
addons.title: Empowered Ark

addons.text:
The blessing of your House of God has been shared with your Ark, transforming the vessel into not only a fortress of life but also a sanctified sanctuary afloat upon the waters. The sanctuary and blessing that once resided solely within the church now permeates every deck, chamber, and beam of the Ark. The moment one sets foot upon its hull, they are embraced by the divine protection of the House. Malevolent spirits, demons, or any entities of corruption cannot so much as approach the Ark; should they dare attempt to cross its boundary with ill intent, they are smitten instantly by the wrath of heaven. The sanctity extends beyond simple protection: all who walk the decks of the Ark without malice find themselves blessed. Their hearts are softened, their minds steadied, and their bodies renewed, with this blessing waxing in strength in proportion to their faith.

Wherever the Ark sails, the waters it passes through becomes lesser holy water. The waters are purified of corruption, curses, and malign influence, leaving behind sanctified waters that resist the touch of darkness. Even the creatures of the deep that swim beneath it feel the blessing, turning docile, reverent, or protective, as though they too recognize the vessel’s holy charge.

If you choose to have your House of God physically placed within the Ark, the two blessings compound upon one another. Within the walls of the church itself, the divine blessing intensifies. Those who step within this sanctified heart of the Ark find themselves sheltered by a protection so absolute that no darkness, no curse, no ill will can endure. In such a place, prayer echoes with double strength, faith becomes radiant, and even the weary or doubtful may feel the stirrings of unshakable conviction.
addons.title: Ark of God

addons.text:
Thanks to the integration of the Genetic Database, the Ark has grown beyond its original limits. Its holds, decks, and enclosures have expanded to accommodate not only the living creatures preserved within, but also the vast array of species long since extinct or erased from history. Mammoths, aurochs, saber-toothed cats, and giant ground sloths now walk the same halls as elephants and lions. Prehistoric birds wheel through the aviaries alongside modern falcons and parrots, while amphibians, reptiles, and fish once thought lost to the fossil record live again in carefully maintained habitats.

The seed stores have likewise increased, containing not only the crops, herbs, and trees of the present world but also ancient strains, forgotten cultivars, and experimental hybrids, each preserved with the same care as their modern counterparts.

The library has swelled as well, its shelves filled with knowledge related to the newly added seeds and animals.
addons.title: History in Entirely

objects.text:
You have gained the Ark of Noah, a colossal vessel constructed to endure the seven months of global flooding and to preserve all terrestrial life. The Ark is a barge-like megastructure measuring approximately six hundred meters in length and six hundred meters in width, with a height of just over one hundred meters above the waterline. Its hull extends another forty meters below the surface to provide ballast and stability, displacing tens of millions of tons of water. The total volume makes it larger than any ship ever built, and it is functionally closer to a floating fortress than a conventional seafaring craft.

The Ark contains thirteen enclosed decks stacked within the hull. The lowest four decks are dedicated to storage of food, water, and plant matter. Here are housed dried fodder, hay, grains, preserved roots, and containers of fresh water sufficient to sustain every animal for more than seven months, as well as seeds of every plant on earth for eventual reseeding. Decks five through eleven serve as animal housing. Each deck is divided into separate compartments to prevent predators from reaching prey and to allow animals of similar biomes and needs to be grouped together. Birds, amphibians, and small reptiles occupy smaller pens and aviaries, while larger species such as lions, antelope, bears, and crocodiles are contained in wider enclosures. The twelfth deck contains extensive aviaries and insectaries, with mesh and timber partitions, and the thirteenth and uppermost enclosed deck is reserved for megafauna such as elephants, giraffes, and rhinos, with ceilings more than ten meters high to provide necessary clearance. Above the thirteenth deck lies a partially open top deck, where hardy grazing animals can be kept and where small gardens and planters provide supplementary food and fresh greenery.

The structure is built entirely of timber, reinforced by divine blessing to resist decay, warping, and the stresses of sea travel at impossible scale. Pitch is used to seal the hull, and stone ballast is incorporated along the keel. The hull itself is divided into watertight compartments that allow partial flooding without risking the loss of the entire vessel. Ventilation is maintained through a massive vertical shaft running the full height of the Ark, drawing air downward from slatted skylights above. Waste disposal is managed through grated flooring that channels refuse into troughs below, where it can be collected or expelled.

For movement, the Ark carries four masts rising more than eighty meters above the deck, each rigged with enormous flax sails. The sails are square-rigged, operated by heavy hempen ropes, and stabilized by divine reinforcement to bear loads that would otherwise tear them apart. Steering is accomplished by two immense rudder oars, each more than forty meters in length, mounted at the stern.

At the stern of the Ark is a raised superstructure serving as the command center and living quarters. These quarters are expansive enough to house more than two hundred people in comfort, with private cabins, common areas, storage, and workspaces, all separated from the animal enclosures and situated for visibility and access to the top deck. The ship’s upper works include observation towers and a vast library, containing the accumulated knowledge of history and civilization: farming methods, architecture, medicine, mathematics, astronomy, metallurgy, and philosophy. This archive ensures that when the waters recede, not only life but also the foundations of human civilization can be restored and advanced without loss.
objects.title: Noah’s Ark

addons.text:
Though the Judgement-class insertion craft is capable of delivering a wide variety of payloads, “Ironspear” is a customized deployment configuration built specifically for the transport, deployment, and battlefield support of Armored Platform 01 “Dominator.” The combination of these two systems was infamous across multiple theaters of the Outer Planetary Conflict, where an Ironspear drop was often the final word in any planetary engagement.

The Dominator is stored within a reinforced, shock-locked deployment bay deep within the Judgement’s hull. The Ironspear configuration adds active stabilization tethers, direct cooling feeds, and onboard diagnostic uplinks, allowing the Dominator to remain fully powered, maintained, and combat-ready during orbital transit. This ensures that it can drop hot with weapons primed and internal systems already spun up, reducing deployment time to under 90 seconds from atmospheric breach.

Additionally, the Judgement receives an expanded gravitic cradle system beneath its main bay doors — allowing the Dominator to be dropped mid-flight in a controlled hover-launch, eliminating the need for a full landing. This lets the craft remain airborne or mobile while the Dominator is inserted directly into hostile zones, supported by synchronized drone launch or suppression fire from Judgement’s onboard rail batteries.

A dedicated command channel uplink is also established between the ship and the Dominator, allowing for rapid remote syncing, orbital overwatch, and priority resource deployment. This uplink enables the pilot of the Dominator to request emergency atmospheric recon, fire support, or even auto-recovery should battlefield conditions require it. 

Finally, the Ironspear configuration includes a reinforced cradle maintenance module embedded in Judgement’s internal repair systems. When docked, the Dominator benefits from accelerated cooldown, field-calibration, and minor self-repair support—allowing for faster redeployment between combat cycles if the Judgement remains in orbit or returns for extraction.
addons.title: Carrier Package 12 “Ironspear”

addons.text:
While individual Valkyrie interceptors proved highly effective in contested orbital engagements, their limited range and fuel capacity created a need for sustained carrier-based deployment. “Falconstorm” is a Judgement-class carrier configuration designed to house, deploy, and maintain a wing of four Valkyrie-class orbital interceptors. Developed by the Coalition of Mankind for rapid-response aerospace supremacy, this loadout was fielded to extend Judgement’s combat envelope beyond atmospheric insertion, enabling it to function as a mobile launch base for strikecraft in contested orbital zones. 

In addition to your original Orbital Interceptor 07 “Valkyrie”, you get an additional three, totalling up to four, all docked within an armored internal hangar module located beneath the Judgement’s dorsal core housing. Each Valkyrie rests in an independently sealed cradle, locked via charged magnetic clamps and inertial dampening arms. Maintenance rails and automated drones run constant diagnostics on plasma regulators, rail coils, and gravitic actuators between launches. The cradle rotates on a central launch ring, allowing sequential or simultaneous quad-launch operations through four ventral ejection ramps — each assisted by gravitic pulse catapults for high-velocity egress from the carrier.

Falconstorm’s onboard flight control suite maintains continuous uplink with all docked Valkyries, enabling shared target data, formation vectors, and synchronized fire commands. While Valkyries remain pilot-directed, the carrier uplink supports AI-enhanced navigation overlays and in-flight munitions tracking. Defensively, the module includes overlapping shield flare nodes and localized energy diffusion arrays to protect launch operations from directed fire or debris interference during active combat conditions.

Ammunition stores within the carrier module are tailored to the Valkyries’ Helios-Streak systems. Reload arms cold-swap spent plasma cores, rail magazines, and missile payloads between sorties, minimizing refit downtime. Each Valkyrie benefits from direct thermal venting and stabilized plasma recalibration while docked, allowing for sustained combat cycling over extended operations. Once Judgement achieves stable orbital position, Falconstorm enables immediate interceptor deployment, allowing fighter wings to launch within seconds and maintain presence across multiple conflict zones without reliance on ground-based infrastructure.
addons.title: Carrier Package 09 “Falconstorm”

objects.text:
Born from desperation during the height of the Outer Planetary Conflict, Orbital Insertion Craft 04 “Judgement” was engineered for one brutal purpose: to crash the heavens down upon the enemy. Designed for full-scale planetary insertion under active fire, it functions as both a deep-space warship and a drop pod the size of a gunship, its silhouette a known harbinger of mass devastation across dozens of systems.

The Judgement is a military-grade assault vessel capable of atmospheric entry, orbital bombardment, and planetary delivery of troops, vehicles, or kinetic weapon platforms. Its frame is built around an anti-gravity superstructure, allowing it to hover in high-orbit indefinitely or descend slowly through atmospheres with pinpoint accuracy. Internal inertial dampeners neutralize momentum during insertion, letting it drop from orbit without crushing everything inside on impact.

Its propulsion suite includes both high-efficiency sublight thrusters for maneuverability and quantum burst drives for system-level traversal. For interstellar missions, the Judgement is equipped with a Class-3 warp core, capable of folding space around the vessel for faster-than-light travel. However, this drive requires thirty minutes of stable alignment to activate, and a twenty-four-hour cooldown after each jump due to extreme energy output and system strain. Warp transitions must be planned, timed, and defended — there are no quick escapes.

To assist navigation, the ship is embedded with a multi-layered interstellar mapping suite, capable of plotting routes through contested sectors, debris fields, and non-linear gravitational anomalies. It uses a mix of predictive AI and real-time quantum entanglement beacons to triangulate position — even in distorted regions of space.

The ship’s hull is lined with reinforced anti-radiation armor plating, treated to survive both atmospheric re-entry and extended energy bombardment. A projected forcefield array forms a layered energy shell around the vessel, capable of absorbing or redirecting limited kinetic and directed energy strikes. Shields can be sustained under heavy fire for minutes at a time, but require downtime to regenerate once broken. They are most effective when deployed during descent, creating a glowing barrier that envelops the craft as it slams into contested ground like a spear from orbit.

Internally, the Judgement is modular. It can be configured to carry troop squads, armored vehicles, autonomous drones, or even mobile artillery. Each mission bay includes grav-stabilizers and hard docking rails to prevent internal damage during sudden shifts or high-G maneuvers. Emergency pods and AI-assisted maintenance systems are built into every floor of the command module, ensuring the ship can operate even with partial crew loss.

Offensively, the Judgement is armed with nose-mounted rail batteries, ventral flak dispersers, and a rotating dorsal coilgun turret for orbital defense. These systems are primarily used to clear insertion paths and disable enemy ships in low orbit, rather than for prolonged dogfights. Once it delivers its payload, the ship is expected to either retreat or deploy into orbit and wait for extraction or redeployment orders.

Though hardened, the Judgement is not invulnerable. It is large, easy to track, and highly visible during atmospheric descent. If caught during warp cooldown or without escort, it can be surrounded and dismantled by more agile enemy craft. Additionally, the massive power requirements for its propulsion, shields, and navigation leave little room for stealth — it broadcasts its presence like thunder in vacuum.
objects.title: Orbital Insertion Craft 04 “Judgement”

objects.text:
Originally developed by the Coalition of Mankind during the late phase of the Outer Planetary Conflict, the Valkyrie was conceived as a dedicated orbital superiority fighter. Created in response to increasingly agile xeno strikecraft and contested orbital theaters, it filled a gap between atmospheric gunships and long-range spaceframe warships.

The Valkyrie is a single-seat, vacuum- and atmosphere-capable interceptor, measuring 14.5 meters in length and weighing approximately 22 metric tons. It is powered by twin Helix gravitic burst drives that allow for high-agility microbursts and rapid repositioning across orbital distances, making it well suited for dogfighting. Integrated inertial dampeners negate G-forces on the pilot, and a multi-axis reaction control system enables full rotational control and lateral movement in zero gravity. The hull is a trilayered titanium-ceramic composite with ferrofoam reinforcement, providing high resilience to kinetic and energy impacts. A forward-facing conical shield projector supplies directional protection but will collapse under heavy sustained fire, requiring a 20-second recharge cycle.

The primary weapons system consists of two “Helios-Streak” plasma-rail arc cannons mounted along the nose, adapted from prototype infantry weapon systems. These weapons operate in two fire modes: long-range boltfire, which accelerates ferrous plasma-wrapped slugs with high armor penetration and slow cycling; and rapid arcfire, which trades power and accuracy for speed and thermal overload. Cooling fins along the flanks vent heat from the plasma regulators, which initiate an automatic weapon lockout after extended use. A pair of ventral rail spike guns provide backup precision firepower without plasma dependency, and an internal rotary missile rack holds up to six modular seeker warheads with configurable payloads (EMP, plasma, flechette).

The Valkyrie operates through a non-invasive neural-link system, which routes control through the pilot’s cognitive inputs. All fire, flight, and defense systems are AI-assisted. Navigation is maintained through a QuantaTrace entangled beacon suite, granting positional awareness in gravitationally unstable regions. External plasma radiator fins extend during cooldown phases to manage heat discharge and visual signature is considered moderate to high depending on power state.
objects.title: Orbital Interceptor 07 “Valkyrie”

addons.text:
This is not a gift that was given to you. It is a creation born from the forge of your own soul, crafted by your Inner Beast to guide and amplify your movement across all things. As such, it now exists as a living extension of that spirit. Its form is no longer just suited to your needs—it reflects you completely, with a wildness and grace only something born of your essence could wield.

The liminal space, once a pathway, is now an instant-access gate. You may enter and leave it as freely as you breathe, using it as a launchpad for your most impossible routes. You no longer need to “travel” within it—you simply choose your path, and the space responds. The Vehicle now responds to you and your Beast as one. It may house the Beast within it, or allow it to pilot independently if you fall. It can fight through the Vehicle, speak through its systems, or reshape it mid-travel with feral purpose.

The Vehicle’s bond to your abilities is now absolute. If you wield magic, it manifests circuits of spellsteel and ley-reactive armor. If you wield gravity, it generates void-hulls that swallow planets whole. Its speed, durability, storage, and adaptability are each increased massively. Its AI, if you permit it, may also serve as a vessel for your Inner Beast—conversing with you, anticipating your growth, and guiding you not just as a rider, but as a soul it understands completely.
addons.title: Inner Vehicle

addons.text: You now possess the knowledge and ability to craft such soul-bound vehicles with all their benefits, for yourself or others. You can build Perfect Vehicles and forge their liminal spaces, with all that benefits that would entail.
addons.title: Mechanic

objects.text: When you awaken, you’ll find something waiting nearby—something wild and beautiful and perfectly shaped to your essence. The Perfect Vehicle is not a car, ship, or ship of the stars—it is all of them and anything else you need it to be. At a thought, it takes form, the exact design best suited to the terrain, the moment, your mood, and your powers. It can ride across deserts, dive into the ocean’s black heart, soar through planetary rings, or drift across the surface of thought. If there’s a way to move, it can move through it—and do so faster than anything else. If you’re fast, it’s faster. If you can teleport, so can it. If you can warp time, it bends space around its frame and does it cleaner. It can incorporate any technology, magic, or magitech you come across—or anything you could conceivably create yourself. From matter phasing, to time dampening, to dimension splitting, to gravitational field rewriting—if you can build it or imagine it, your Vehicle can manifest and use it. You may freely modify its internal or external systems by fusing compatible tech, spells, circuits, runes, or conceptual mechanisms into its structure. It will intuitively harmonize with your powers and adapt in real time. No matter your speed, the Perfect Vehicle will outpace you by a factor of twenty or more, and its ability to accelerate, decelerate, and maneuver is absolute and instant, no delay, no inertia, no resistance.. It does not slip, stall, or slow—not unless you want it to. You’ll never need to fuel it, maintain it, or rest it. Simply summon it, and go. The Perfect Vehicle can travel through any medium—land, air, sea, vacuum, or concept. It can shift seamlessly between them at will. It is fully self-sustaining, generating nourishment, shelter, and protection indefinitely. Inside, you and your passengers are fully supported—comfortable, safe, and kept alive in even the most hostile conditions for as long as necessary. Its armor and durability scale alongside you. Even in its most minimalist form, it can shrug off the full wrath of modern war. If you grow stronger, so does it—its offense and defense grow to always match your scale. Your Vehicle can travel absolutely anywhere. It comes with a flawless internal navigation system able to find any location in any dimension, it knows where everything is, has been, and will be even if you can’t name it. There is no such thing as getting lost. You can input your destination manually, through thought, or even by vague emotional intention—“someplace peaceful,” or “where I need to be most.” It will always find the route, even if you yourself don’t know where it is yet. You can guide it by coordinates, feeling, or even vague intention—it’ll know exactly where to go. And it comes with an inbuilt AI not unlike the one found in the Perfect Omnitool: loyal, aware, and capable of fully piloting itself. This AI can interpret your thoughts, desires, even vague intentions. It can pilot itself flawlessly, search out locations that fit a feeling or a whim, or act as your guide, driver, tactician, and conversational partner. You can let it take over, give it full autonomy, or even just let it surprise you. Say something like “find me a view worth remembering,” and it will take you someplace you never knew you needed. The true marvel lies not in the vehicle’s speed—but in its gateway to elsewhere. By activating the Liminal Drive, the Perfect Vehicle phases into a soul-shaped space, a surreal manifestation of your innermost self. This “liminal space” reflects your form and style of travel—appearing as an endless, dreamlike highway, a star-splattered cosmos, a boundless ocean, or even a wind-kissed valley trail. This liminal realm is fully under your control. Want calm seas beneath a warm sun? Done. A crackling thunderstorm to reflect your mood? You got it. This space is timeless and sacred—yet it still moves. Regardless of real-world distances, anything, anywhen, in any reality can be reached within one hour of your own subjective experience. If a destination can be imagined, it can be reached. If it can;t be imagined, it can still be reached. The Perfect Vehicle is never just one vehicle. Every form it’s ever taken exists as a stored variant inside your soul’s liminal space, floating as possibility. This means you can store passengers, cargo, or versions of your vehicle within your soul, letting them drift safely while you use a separate instance. For example, one version may carry your allies through a starfield, while you call forth a separate, empty version for a solo mission. Only one “active” vehicle exists at a time in the real world, but you can freely reform it with or without passengers and contents. And because of this inner space, transporting entire fleets, armies, or civilizations is as simple as riding forward. When dismissed or resummoned, it repairs and resets completely. Damage, wear, or depletion never persist beyond your will. The Perfect Vehicle is no pushover. Even in its most delicate form, it is armored to withstand a direct barrage of nuclear strikes without flinching. Its offensive systems are just as extreme, capable of responding with force that mirrors your own power growth. It will always remain as strong and defensive relative to your scale, the range here compared to a normal human, scaling in power as your own strength grows.
objects.title: Perfect Vehicle

objects.text: "Arriving at North Pole. Next stop, Tennessee. ETA is 2 minutes." You have been given the keys to an engine known throughout engineering mythologies as the Railway Rose. This Engine is known through all universes' engineering circles, as a train able to do the impossible on the outside. Visually the base appearance of the train is a rather dirty, bulky diesel engine with dark green passenger and caboose cars numbering at 5. You can modify this, of course to any style of train you'd like, from a Japanese bullet train to a german electric train, to Thomas the Tank Engine. But... what lies inside is the true magic. Inside, with portals leading between various cars based on your desired location, the rolling stock of the engine counts into nigh-infinity. Each of these cars range in size from your average middle-class ticket car, to a large casino's central floor. There is a car for just about any situation involving a train: Money car, restaurant, sleep, hauling, etc, and there's MULTIPLE of each for various qualities. To help you run this train, you are given a staff in tens of thousands range for every purpose of each car. They are mostly normal people besides the essentials: Age/disease based immortality, teleporting instantly between cars without need for the portals, etc. The train itself also has a decent capability in all regards, though its best attribute is its speed. It can typically go around the world twice in 10 minutes "normally", or faster using it's special ability. The greatest power of this train is its ability to ride on "Reality Rails." As long as there is something to qualify as a "station", including even just an open field surrounded by trees, a barn, or a sidewalk you can go anywhere you so desire on the rails. From a simple trip between one point to another in the city, to a travel from one point to 20 years ago, and so on. Even other dimensions can be penetrated, although it does not guarantee safety once OFF the train. Finally, the tickets issued to those who pay however you ask give you an inherent knowledge of where they are at all times relative to the engine. The only margin for error is if you don't know their names or the like, you won't know which person is which. They will all appear in your head as some kind of dots in a simplified map of the train.
objects.title: Railway Rose

objects.text:
"Stand tall, Galactic Sailor, and set forth on your legendary voyage across the stars!"

You’ve discovered The Cosmic Ship, an ancient vessel unlike any other. This advanced, boat-shaped craft merges fantasy and sci-fi, with an exterior that can shift to resemble any ship—whether from the sea, sky, or space. While it’s primarily a futuristic boat, it’s capable of traveling not only through the stars but across dimensions, opening gateways to infinite worlds and realities.

Inside, The Cosmic Ship expands into a vast, multidimensional realm that responds to your will. Its endless halls stretch outward, with arches leading to rooms designed to cater to the comfort and needs of you and your crew. At its core lies the Engine and Core, the ship's power source. The transparent walls and ceiling offer breathtaking views of the cosmos but can transform into high-tech screens when necessary. The Navigation Room, where you and your crew steer the ship, is supported by an advanced AI that operates all systems with flawless precision. This AI can also control the ship autonomously, allowing for solo travel, responding to your commands and performing tasks without a crew. This symbiotic relationship is possible through a neural connection—The Cosmic Ship is intrinsically linked to its owner, an extension of their very being, reacting to their thoughts and emotions as if alive.

The ship's subspace rooms require energy to function, which can be sourced from various means. Smaller rooms are easy to create, but larger, more complex ones need more effort and power. However, certain rooms are always available: the Kitchen, forever stocked and self-replenishing; the Residential Area, offering personal quarters for each crew member; the Farm, for growing crops and raising animals; the Armory, storing weapons and tools; and the Library, an archive that records every place you’ve visited and every detail of your journey. Integrated with the navigation system, the Library makes exploring new worlds more efficient.

One of the ship’s most unique features is the Hub of Doors, a circular chamber with pedestals linking to worlds you’ve visited. Each pedestal is tied to specific coordinates, and when activated, a portal opens, allowing travel between the ship and your chosen destination. Initially, there are twenty-five pedestals, but more can be added using energy and resources. While these portals are invaluable, they also pose a security risk—anyone could potentially access them. Once closed, the portals can be summoned by you or your crew anywhere within the designated world.
objects.title: The Cosmic Ship: A Next-Generation Legend!

objects.text:
You have acquired the ultimate war machine and the last hope of humanity, the T.S.O.D. This colossal mobile fortress was built to withstand and fight against a relentless horde of self-replicating machines that nearly wiped out all life on Earth. The T.S.O.D is a marvel of engineering, technology, and defiance, and it is now yours to command.

The T.S.O.D is composed of hyper-advanced smart matter, which can regenerate, adapt, and even reshape it's form in seconds, allowing it to traverse any terrain and environment, even the vacuum of space thanks to its anti-gravity propulsion and internal teleportation array. It can also deploy various defensive and offensive measures, such as energy shields, plasma cannons, missile launchers, railguns, and more.
