Within the T.S.O.D lies something called the Alchemical Forge, a singularity engine connected to a higher dimensional plane of energy which allows for infinite energy generation, and through it's inner manufactory, convert energy to matter, allowing for the non-stop production of small and heavy arms, autonomous assets, weaponry, vehicles, armor, mechs, and more without pause. This was what allowed the final remnant of humanity to stand against, and even temporarily overwhelmed the self replicating nature of their enemies, nonetheless, it was all for naught.

The T.S.O.D also acted as humanity's Ark, with an archive of patterns to construct a second outpost, terraform the land, artificially grow life, create farms, and so forth—all the things needed to rebuild from scratch if humanity had managed to win the war against the machines. While the internal construction yards, and matter fabricators are the primary means of production, your assets can be deployed out of the T.S.O.D to allow for independent construction and material collection, aided by harvester drones, assembly/disassembly arrays, and other manufacturing automata.

Within the core of the Alchemical forge lies two incredibly powerful AI's which act as the administrator of all the T.S.O.D systems, and as the assistant to the Outpost leader. Through the multi-dimensional nature of the Alchemical Forge, the physical component of the AI's are housed within a quasi-stable pocket dimension wherein the physical laws of realspace don't quite apply. This enables for physical components and computational speeds vastly beyond normal limits of physics, vastly enhancing the AI's research and combat modeling capabilities, allowing it to rapidly adapt to any enemy or adversity, and even simulate and predict the movement and plan of it's enemies years, if not decades in advance.

The T.S.O.D is also linked to your mind via a neural web, which allows you to monitor, command, and control it from anywhere. You can communicate with the AIs, access any information, or activate any function with just a thought. 

The T.S.O.D is a one-of-a-kind item that cannot be duplicated or replicated by any means. It is also immune to any form of hacking, jamming, or interference from external sources. However, it is not invincible; it can still be damaged or destroyed by sufficiently powerful attacks or forces. If the T.S.O.D is ever fully destroyed, you will be able to materialize it's core, which will begin to regenerate itself after a period of time. 

Note: if you have one or more Technology And Artifice Powers, then the T.S.O.D will automatically gain the ability to manufacture anything from the referred setting or settings. From mystical metals and fantastical creatures, to futuristic mechs and weapons of war from alien races, everything is within the T.S.O.D grasp.
objects.title: The Spark of Defiance; Humanity's Last Outpost

objects.text:
You command a self-propelled metropolis the size of New York City, mounted on an array of colossal, omni-terrain tractor wheels capable of crossing desert, tundra, swamp, and mountain with equal, grinding certainty. Within its borders you will find everything a permanent city of this scale contains, from residential districts and industrial sectors to hydroponic farms, hospitals, schools, and manufacturing plants, all arranged in a dense urban grid that moves as one relentless entity.

The city's perimeter is surrounded by walls as tall as skyscrapers, studded with explosive cannons and harpoon-mounted drills that drag captured vehicles into the underbelly processing zone. There, automated welders graft the wreckage directly onto the outer hull to serve as a sacrificial, ablative layer of armor, a process that endlessly expands the city's size while creating an expendable outer slums district designed to absorb the first wave of any assault. A network of machine guns is distributed throughout the inner city districts to suppress crime, quell dissent, and eliminate any boarding enemies who breach the outer defenses.

The entire vehicle runs on a hybrid grid of massive diesel generators feeding electric hub motors in each wheel assembly, a power-hungry system that consumes fuel on a scale measured in tanker ships per day. Buried at the city's core is an EMP bomb of such magnitude that its detonation would cascade through every electrical system, turning each generator and circuit into a small explosion, halting the city entirely and requiring a minimum of one month of intensive repair before it could move again.

This also comes with a stockpile of fuel, food, medical supplies, and industrial feedstock sufficient for one hundred years of normal operation, a figure that can be extended to six centuries under strict, multi-generational rationing protocols.
objects.title: The Wandering City

objects.text:
You now hold the keys to - and the attention and affection of - a new pet in the form of a modified nuclear ballistic missile submarine. 210 meters in length, the Whale vocalizes in the form of rhythmic sonar pulses that induce disorientation and auditory hallucinations in unshielded personnel within a 3-kilometer radius of its presence. These hallucinations generally take the voices of those ‘protected’ by its listeners. The sound of their pets next to their ears, barking or meowing. If they did not ever have pets in their life, it could take on the voices of their loved ones.

The Whale is very much alive, and currently views you as both owner and protector, similar to a loyal attack dog. It exhibits behaviors such as autonomous movement, self-repair, and having a subtle ‘breathing’ pattern within its sonar when left idle and not told to be quiet. It’s effectively submerged at all times, even within environments that would prove impossible for it such as glacial shelves or regular ground. This is due to a passive spatial warping effect that makes its immediate surroundings - a few meters from its hull - imitate crush-depth waters. Anyone and anything in its path that it views as an ‘enemy’ or ‘harmful’ has to contend with the sudden, significant shift in pressure. It also sees through periscopes it can manifest anywhere throughout its body, hear through its sonar systems, and feel ‘touch’ wherever its spatial effects are present, including deep within itself and the field that surrounds it. It can understand rudimentary human speech, but not much more than that. It won't understand 'stabilize', but it can understand 'stay still' or 'sit'.

Internally, the Whale is far larger than its appearance would suggest, containing a maze of dried and dying marine ecosystems and cold war bunkers. When injured, the space within it acts as something akin to blood combined with chaff, floating outwards like squid ink even in open air, its appearance a shifting mosaic of marine ecology and brutalist architecture. Attacks that touch the boundaries of this bleeding space have to then go through it. Underwater, it completely eliminates torpedoes and similar devices, as the space within is completely dry. Above ground, it means more distance to cover and more obstacles to penetrate. 

The Whale can rearrange and manipulate the topology of its internals as it wishes, in order to protect its core - only logged within various rare files scattered around as the Engineheart. It's also where its various armaments lie, capable of manifesting cannons and anti-aircraft guns spontaneously from its hull that look like they belong more on a cruiser. It’s also where the missile bay is located, with the Whale capable of manifesting ports on its back to release the nuclear payloads one by one.

Its armaments benefit from a reversed variety of its spatial warping, instead treating anything that the whale doesn’t view negatively as if it were air, allowing for them to only ever be able to strike their intended targets regardless of obstacles in between, so long as the Whale doesn’t count these obstacles as ‘enemies’. Unless you know how to teach a dog basic biology or architecture, the Whale won’t be able to make its projectiles phase harmlessly through flesh and armor and only strike specific internals. The ammunition for these armaments regenerates with speed depending on complexity and size - its AA ammunition regenerates in minutes; its cannons, in hours; and its ballistic missiles, in months. 3 months for each missile, specifically. Its own ability to regenerate from damage follows the same logic described.
objects.title: The Whale

objects.text: They say home is where the heart is. Well, this magical vehicle agrees with you, since the heart is always yearning for exploration. Similar to those built for people who intend to stay in a vehicle for fear of exposure, this acts as a mobile fortress for you, or someone you trust, to drive around in. The form of this vehicle shifts depending on where your soul feels is the most comfortable. If it's land, it could shift into an 18 wheeler that's far bigger on the inside, like a comfortable 2 story house. On the sea, it could become a sort of super yacht. In the air, a private jet, and so on. All of these share in common comfort, Sustainability in the form of renewable food, water and electricity, and defensive power. If it got hit by a rocket launcher, it could tank the hit for sure, even if it might need some repairs afterwards. It can also, in need of an escape, drive upwards of Mach 1, depending on the form in question, and handle VERY well. You will find the vehicle is also alive to a certain extent, since it can grow in AND externally by 2 methods: Being tested in various ways in combat, exploration, etc or, like you would any other vehicle, being upgraded by outside sources. Thankfully with the latter, those you allow to work on it are given a blueprint they and only they can understand, being certain gibberish to anyone else who reads it besides you
objects.title: True Mobile Home

addons.text:
As deep-strike operatives were increasingly deployed behind enemy lines for months at a time, often without logistical support or extraction windows, stealth ships like the VX-Δ1 could no longer rely solely on stealth and evasion, they had to become fully self-sustaining platforms for powered combat operations. The Ilyss-K4 was the answer: a dedicated repair, refuel, and deployment infrastructure embedded directly into the ship’s system, capable of supporting bonded systems like the Veltrass-MKIV armor and Drexil-AXVII weapon platform indefinitely.

When docked within the ship’s armoury, the Veltrass-MKIV or Drexil-AXVII undergoes real-time structural analysis, neural matrix synchronization checks, and atmospheric decontamination. The chamber uses an adaptive nanoforge to reconstruct damaged components down to the sub-molecular level. This includes the reweaving of nano-ceramic plates, the regeneration of actuator veins, and the recalibration of gravitic anchoring systems or emitter cores.

Drawing from the ship’s Deuteric Singularity Reactor and centralized H₂O reserves, the Ilyss module routes reactor-fed plasma and purified water directly into the systems of the Veltrass or Drexil, fully restoring their power cells and coolant matrices. The Drexil-AXVII’s deuterium reservoir is topped off automatically during each rearmament cycle, and the Veltrass armor’s thermal loop is flushed and recharged with no need for pilot intervention. 

Where Ilyss-K4 becomes most tactically potent is in its deployment network. Once bonded to the ship, the gear can be summoned by the pilot or designated operator from anywhere inside the vessel. The ship’s virtual intelligence uses internal gravitic lift rails and phase-folding translocation nodes to deliver the equipment directly to the user’s location within seconds. On command, the selected gear is materialized from internal storage, suspended in a containment field, and deployed around the operator using kinetic stasis and magnetic anchoring. The result is full equipping of the Veltrass armor or Drexil cannon in under three seconds, whether the operator is in the cockpit, dormitory, medbay, or during emergency decompression scenarios.
addons.title: Ilyss-K4

objects.text:
The VX-Δ1 is a fully autonomous infiltration and reconnaissance vessel used by the Federation of Worlds, referred to as the Xeno Alliance by their adversaries in the Coalition of Mankind. Deployed in high-risk surveillance operations and diplomatic missions in restricted sectors, the VX-Δ1 is a stealth craft designed for total undetectability, rapid extrication, and long-duration solo operations without combat capabilities. It is operated by a single pilot with full neural integration and shipboard VI support.

The ship is shaped like a sideways teardrop, with the narrow end functioning as the rear and the wide front housing critical systems. It is 32 meters long and 14 meters wide at its broadest point. The hull is composed of a triple-layer nano-ceramic molecular matrix, capable of dynamically repairing structural damage. The hull structure redistributes kinetic energy across the exoskeleton to prevent localized catastrophic failure.

The entire system is powered by a Deuteric Singularity Reactor, a compact hydrogen-fusion core that isolates deuterium from any accessible H₂O and performs continuous micro-fusion, supplying stable, clean energy. As long as water is available, from internal stores, atmospheric moisture, or condensed vapor, the ship can maintain indefinite power generation.

Internally, the ship has four main compartments. The cockpit contains the pilot’s neural interface chair, with direct nervous system integration and biometric gesture control. All visual and environmental data are displayed through retinal overlays, and the VI system monitors ship systems, navigates, and provides translation, diagnostics, and tactical survival functions. The medbay includes a full biostructural reconstruction chamber, capable of cellular and neural repair using onboard nanites and synthetic organ scaffolding, along with cryostasis capability for medical stasis or extended travel.

The maintenance bay functions as an armory, nanofabrication chamber, and tech modifier. It allows for equipment fabrication, suit upgrades, environmental tools, and full ship diagnostics. The dormitory supports one to two occupants with modular sleep pods, environmental controls, and emergency hydration and nutrient systems. All compartments are internally reinforced, environmentally sealed, and can be isolated by the ship VI in the event of decompression or internal hazard.

The stealth system is permanently active and integrated into the ship’s hull and energy systems. It uses a quantum phase masking array that renders the ship undetectable across all known sensor spectrums, including electromagnetic, thermal, gravimetric, and subspace scans. External camouflage adjusts the hull to match the visual and energetic properties of the surrounding space in real time. Even during FTL travel or system-intensive activity, the stealth field does not deactivate and maintains a zero-detection footprint. All scans directed at the ship are bounced back with sensor-generated noise mimicking natural background data.

FTL travel is achieved using Spacetime Field Projectors embedded in the hull, which generate a controlled distortion bubble that contracts space ahead of the ship and expands it behind, allowing the vessel to traverse spacetime without traditional movement. The longer the FTL drive remains active, the faster the ship moves through spacetime, with no fixed speed limit. Speed increases until the drive is manually deactivated or encounters an obstruction. The system cannot activate if the ship is near any physical object, regardless of size, and will automatically deactivate if such an object enters proximity while in transit. A front-mounted Relativistic Containment Grid prevents temporal distortion from affecting internal systems, and Spacetime Wake Dampeners at the rear dissipate residual warp effects to minimize traceable disturbances.
objects.title: VX-Δ1

objects.text:
Now you have the powerful Mobile Fortress, a huge mobile firing platform carrying a large railgun and a variety of defensive weapons, which, combined with powerful armor and numerous sensors, makes this machine an incredibly complex and dangerous opponent.

The platform is approximately 80 meters high (roughly equivalent to a 21-story building), and its six legs give it a width of approximately 100 meters. Its feet are capable of occupying all four lanes of a highway.

The platform is completely autonomous and does not require a crew, although it can have a small number of crew members. However, its “intelligence” is usually only enough to move forward and crush everything with its overwhelming firepower.

A multitude of different sensors scan the surrounding space and prevent anyone from secretly approaching the platform from the ground or the air.

The platform's sturdy armor makes it pretty tough against artillery and rocket fire, and it can easily handle fire from its own defensive weapons. Even if multi-story buildings twice or three times as tall as the platform collapse on it, they won't take it out, just stop it by burying it under rubble. The only vulnerable spot is the joints of the legs, but even if they are damaged, the machine will only lose mobility, not all of its firepower.

The platform's main weapon is a powerful large-caliber railgun (with a barrel caliber of about 1 meter, according to the anime) capable of firing projectiles at hypersonic speeds. The firing range allows it to hit targets not only at a distance of many thousands of kilometers, but also to reliably cover low orbit. With their speed and mass, even without explosive filling, the shells are incredibly destructive.

Defensive weapons are numerous and placed around the perimeter of the hull, blocking all sectors of a possible attack. The list of weapons includes 6 rotary cannons (≈ 30 mm), 8 automatic large-caliber guns (≈ 150 mm) and aft turrets with twin large-caliber guns (≈ 120 mm) complemented by two automatic guns (≈ 57 mm). 

The guidance system allows it to engage not only hostile ground and air targets, but also flying missiles.

The platform has outstanding mobility and is capable of easily moving across rough terrain, fording water obstacles, and even climbing very steep mountain slopes.
objects.title: Mobile Fortress (Appleseed)

addons.text:
Your Rhodes Island now comes fully staffed with all its employed combat Operators, including Elite Operators and the specialized S.W.E.E.P. team, ensuring you'll have a formidable force at your disposal. Additionally, all other branches of R.I Inc. are integrated into your operations, providing logistical, medical, and research support.

To further bolster your efforts, you will also have the invaluable assistance of Amiya and Kal'tsit, each bringing their expertise, leadership, and unique abilities to your cause.
addons.title: Rhodes Island Pharmaceuticals Inc.

addons.text:
Your Rhodes Island has reverted to its old formidable configuration from the Kazdelian Civil War, fully outfitted with its old armaments and weaponry. This wartime adaptation comes at a cost—as many of its medical cabins and living quarters have been sacrificed to prioritize firepower and combat readiness over civilian amenities.

This version of Rhodes Island also comes fully staffed with its veteran Babel-affiliated mercenaries, combat Operators, and Elite Operators, forming a battle-hardened and highly effective fighting force.

Additionally, you'll have the support of a less jaded Kal'tsit, whose strategic brilliance remains as sharp as ever, the legendary "Ghost of Babel" Doctor, whose unparalleled tactical expertise will guide your efforts, and a much younger, determined Amiya, ready to rise to the challenges ahead.
addons.title: Babel

addons.text:
How fascinating! One of your powers has merged with Rhodes Island, giving rise to a revolutionary facility designed for summoning and recruiting individuals from across Terra in Arknights. While this fusion severs your direct connection to the power, it transforms it into advanced technology, enabling you to modify and enhance its summoning mechanics to suit your needs.

And with it comes the elimination of the previous reliance on defeating others to obtain summoning materials. Instead, summons now relies solely on the energy expenditure needed to fuel the facility, offering a more versatile alternative to you—albeit one with a substantial energy cost.

To oversee this ingenious system, a specialized 'Headhunting Department' has been established, staffed with skilled personnel who will ensure the smooth operations of its facilities.

Perhaps most thrilling of all is the expanded scope of summoning. You are no longer restricted to playable characters but can also recruit NPCs and alternate timeline versions of either of them, including those featured in special skin lines. Enabling you to gather allies and resources from all corners of Terra's reality.
addons.title: R.I. Pharmaceutical Inc. Recruitment Office

addons.text:
PRTS, the AI responsible for Rhodes Island's operations, has shifted its allegiance to Priestess, falling under her control. Due to much of its digital architecture being originally based on Priestess herself, this transition is made seamless. Now fully integrated, Priestess can see through PRTS's "eyes" and exert complete control over every system with Rhodes Island's—granting her command of everything from facility operations to defensive protocols, all of it bending to her will.

Along with this shift, Rhodes Island has also reverted to its original configuration as a spacefaring vessel, fully restored with the protective systems and armaments standard for its era.

Additionally, the dormant Feranmut skeleton embedded deep within the ship has begun to stir—reawakening as a partially living construct. Now fused with the ship's systems, it exists as a bio-mechanical entity, and like everything else within Rhodes Island, it bends to the will of Priestess.
addons.title: EYES_WIDE_OPEN

addons.text: Rhodes Island has integrated the Sentinel Bastion into itself, expanding to accommodate the changes, transforming into the Rhodes Colossus, a moving autonomous fortress city. Spanning a couple kilometers in size and bristling with automated weapons and other defensive measures, the Colossus is designed to be entirely self-sufficient and maintain functionality in all situations, even when damaged or completely isolated from outside support or supplies. To this end it features multiple redundant systems and features including but not limited to; 5 separate main reactors - each strong enough to power the ship’s emergency systems - along with several arrays of auxiliary reactors to provide additional power, multiple armories and drone bays strategically spread out across the ship to maximize defensive coverage, an array of manufacturing bays capable of producing anything needed, and several clusters of self-contained hydroponics bays to provide the food needed to sustain any personnel. The R&D Department and Vaults of the Sentinel Bastion are overhauled as well. The automated research and prototypes expand to match the tech level of Rhodes Island, while some of the Vaults contain recovered - and often damaged - pieces of Predecessor technology, artifacts which defy common sense and can propel your understanding of technology forwards by centuries if properly understood. If you have Babel then the Colossus is overhauled once more, sacrificing civilian comforts in favor of doubling down on defenses, weaponry, and other features needed to wage and win wars. EYES_WIDE_OPEN on the other hand uplifts all aspects of the Colossus to match the original Predecessor configuration and maintain functionality even through long voyages in the vacuum of space. Lastly, Bastion Overhaul incorporates any other technological bases you may have into the functions of the Colossus, advancing technology and adding further redundancies wherever possible. Should you have Goodnight, Terra, then the Colossus gains automated factories rivaling Londinium’s that could mass produce Rhodes Island class landships, enough medicine for most of the infected on Terra, or advanced gear for an entire armed forces' worth of operators. It also gains several additional R&D plates that put Trimounts or the Tianshi bureaus to shame, with labs, workshops and testing grounds full of advanced experiments and prototypes. Lastly, it gains four SHAFT emitters with linked HAMHRR platforms orbiting the Colossus. If you have Doctor Clancy’s Rhodes Six Siege, then the Colossus is upgraded with defenses and weapons rivaling Yumen and Londinium without compromising its civilian plates. It is accompanied by several advanced landship battlegroups and a full-sized army and Earth-styled Air Force, fully armed with the best weapon systems of both Tom Clancy’s Earth and Terra. The Army has an integrated command staff and officer corps, with the top commanders having emulators of the PRTS’s neural command interface used by the Doctor. While these commanders are formidable, that does not mean they have the same neural compatibility with the system or Precursor genius as the Doctor, however. Combining the above with Babel, the militarization of the Colossus further compounds with these fortifications and armaments, to the point where the Colossus could drive through a Catastrophe without a scratch and face down the might of the greatest empires on Terra. Several Silos with Category 5 Catastrophe-grade Originium ICBMs are built within the Colossus, but only Theresa has the authority to launch them. If you have A Goodenough Deal, then Cannot’s main store is expanded into a veritable mega-emporium of oddities and resources from Terra and beyond, with additional franchises dotted across the Colossus as well as allied settlements, plus kiosks and vending machines set up in every base and ship you own. Several financial and commercial plates are also added to the Colossus, streamlining its operation costs and selling its services, resources, and technologies to allies for a hefty profit with your approval. Cannot will offer to open casinos and investment firms on the Colossus as well, but you probably shouldn’t take him up on that. With Consul Metroplex, the Colossus gains half a dozen experimental arcology plates. These combine the residential, industrial, utility, agricultural and military capabilities of other specialized plates. They are also well fortified and self-sustaining, and can function even when separated from the city core. You also gain fifteen additional nomadic cities that are well-developed and armed, with minor versions of any upgrades the Colossus has. These can be replicas of any canon nomadic city, such as Iron Carrot, Wrankwood or Mitsukue, but do not have any esoteric secrets hidden within those cities, such as The Law in Laterano or the ancient sarcophagus in Chernobog.
addons.title: Colossus of Rhodes

addons.text: With your expertise in Terran technology, you have managed to uncover and study Kristen Wright's life work and recreate the Horizon Arc Project, the culmination of all of the research and technologies of Rhine Lab, the Terran mainland's most advanced scientific institute. The Horizon Arc is a large rocket-propelled sub-orbital weapons and research platform, ostensibly a superweapon built for the Columbian Military. The Horizon Arc was actually created to be a symbol of Terran civilization's potential future among the stars. The Horizon Arc's main weapon is the HAMHRR (High-altitude Arrayed and Maneuverable Hyperbeam Receiver-Redirector), an energy beam focuser that could theoretically hit anywhere on Terra and obliterate nomadic cities, as well as fire directly upward and punch a hole through the impenetrable Starpod barrier that boxed in the planet's sky. The beam itself was originally fired from the SHAFT (Synergistic Hyperbeam Amplifying and Focusing Tube), a massive underground facility that drew several cities' worth of power from the last embers of a failing Predecessor generator, and only enough for the single shot that broke through the Starpod. However, a new miniaturized SHAFT emitter and specialized Predecessor reactor are installed on Rhodes Island, which can fully power the Horizon Arc's beam, though it takes a full week to recharge after firing and cannot be rerouted to power anything else. While the Horizon Arc was pitched as a weapon to secure funding from the Department of Defense, its true purpose was always science and progress. The platform contains the Galleria Stellaria, a beautiful high-tech planetarium that can scan and map out distant stars, as well as dozens of cutting-edge laboratories and workshops for Rhine Lab's various departments to conduct research above Terra and in space. It is staffed by hundreds of Rhine Lab scientists and engineers, the smartest on Terra outside of Aegir. The platform is also patrolled by a full contingent of Rhine Lab security personnel armed with experimental weapons and armor. While the Horizon Arc was created to literally open a door for Terran civilization to explore the stars and achieve Kristen's personal dream of spaceflight, it is very rudimentary as a spacecraft. It is just a fancy orbital station and sleeper ship at best, with the most generous estimates giving it a few hundred or so years just to reach the nearby planet of Talos II. Additionally, the Rhodes Island’s own research and engineering departments are greatly expanded, with an onboard research institute and factory-sized workshops. Many new, talented experts and their accompanying theories and designs are poached from Terra’s most advanced organizations, such as Columbia’s science corporations, Yan’s Tianshi bureaus and Durin inventing clubs and even a small handful of Aegir professors and Lateran gunsmiths, among others. Should the Doctor be with you, then Rhine Lab's Board of Directors, including Ferdinand Clooney, Jara Wilson, Ahrens Parvis and Kristen Wright herself will join Rhodes Island as operators.
addons.title: Goodnight, Terra

addons.text: Kal’tsit’s restrictions on researching the weapons of Team Rainbow have been lifted, allowing Earth’s weapon technology to be combined with the power and versatility of Originium technology. Most notably, this means Originium guns and artillery with the range and accuracy of modern Earth’s with the raw power of Terra’s weapons. While these guns use Originium to fire, they have the simplicity of Earth’s gunpowder rather than requiring the unwieldy use of Arts like Blacksteel’s etched rounds or blessings of the Sankta’s patron firearms. These guns are still experimental, and to keep them from falling into the wrong hands, they have only been distributed to the most trusted elites of Rhodes Island’s forces. However, the security forces and reserve operator corps are also doubled and given arms, gear and training to match Terra’s professional soldiers. The Rhodes Island also gains expanded garages and hangars with attack, support and transport aircraft and AFVs. Rhodes Island’s weapons and armor are also upgraded with enhanced offensive and defensive systems without sacrificing civilian or medical comforts. This includes reinforced and ablative armor and other active defenses, as well as heavy artillery and rocket launchers that fire precision-guided Originium munitions that could obliterate a massed army and even wreck a high-speed battleship or nomadic plate with sustained fire. Should you have Babel, then the armaments and armors combine to match the Duke of Wellington's Gastrell, the most powerful hi-speed battleship on Terra. A fleet of several dozen armed escorts and troop carriers also accompanies Rhodes Island into battle. Babel’s mercenaries and guerrillas are reorganized into a small standing army that could match an entire Ursus Army Group. Their armory is expanded to include witchcraft rifles that mirror the Sankta’s patron firearms, and Revenant possessed artillery in the style of Wiš’Adel’s. Half a dozen tactical cruise missiles with minor catastrophe-grade active Originium warheads are also placed in bays on the ship, but require the authorization of both Theresa and Kal’tsit to launch. Should the Doctor and the rest be aboard, then the Rainbow Six operatives that were isekai’d to Terra will be joined by all of the other canonical playable operatives from Rainbow Six Siege, their weapons and equipment upgraded to the peak of combined Terran and Earth standard. All other operators are also given upgraded weapons and additional modules, and gadgets to supplement their abilities and tactics.
addons.title: Doctor Clancy’s Rhodes Six Siege (Tom Clancy’s Rainbow Six Siege/Arknights Crossover)

addons.text: Cannot Goodenough moves in and set up a permanent shop on Rhodes Island. Cannot’s shop will contain a much larger assortment of items that will restock each week. The shop will have different shelves containing stock from Terra, your current world, or any other world Cannot has access to. Cannot will take any currency or valuable resource you have on hand as payment, but won’t buyback items or non-valuable loot. You can invest money in Cannot’s shop and he will gain a wider and better selection with subsequent restocks. You can order common Terran items, weapons and resources from him, but he will prefer Originium-based currencies for these transactions. While by default, the Rhodes Island covers the cost of operations by synthesizing gold bars in unused factories and trading them for a small profit, Cannot greatly expands and streamlines this through various ventures. This now provides you with a small but noticeable passive income in the most prominent currency of your current world. However, Cannot's methods are a small bit dubious, so don’t take his offer to invest in $OriginiumCoin. If you have the Recruitment Office, then Cannot’s inventory might sometimes include temporary recruitment vouchers for specific operator classes at a generous price. These vouchers will let you summon a random Arknights NPC of that class, however you will only have this character as an Operator for a week before they return to Terra. If you want to keep them at Rhodes Island afterwards, then you will have to charge the recruitment machine with thirty pulls worth of power.
addons.title: A Goodenough Deal

objects.text:
You're now in possession of Rhodes Island, a massive landship built by the Predecessors of the First Civilization and later refurbished to serve as the mobile headquarters for Rhodes Island Pharmaceuticals Inc.

Weighing in around 130,000 tons and spanning 600 meters in length, 136 meters in height, and 306 meters in width, Rhodes Island is a technological marvel, one that also boasts a top speed of 80 km/h—comparable to the high-speed warships that form the backbone of various nations' militaries, despite its size and weight being more akin to flagship vessels. Designed to withstand Terra's harsh conditions, Rhodes Island is equipped to navigate rough terrain, endure extreme weather, and maintain a sealed environment to protect against contamination risks far more dangerous than anything found on Earth.

The ship can also house up to 2,000 Operators and personnel, with additional accommodations for over 1,000 patients. Beyond its residential spaces, Rhodes Island features helipads, aircraft hangars, farms, a training ground with a shooting range for its paramilitary force, and reinforced multi-layer alloy hulls for exceptional durability, along with many other vital features and essential facilities.

Supporting its massive operations are state-of-the-art systems, including advanced navigation, operations, and intelligence centers seamlessly integrated with an automated system managed by its onboard AI—PRTS. Assisting in drastically reducing the manpower required for travel and navigation. Enough that remarkably, despite its immense scale, Rhodes Island's operational demands are comparable to smaller high-speed warships, a testament to its exceptional engineering and efficiency.

Two of Rhodes Island's most striking features are its Early Warning System and Laser Mining Module. The Early Warning System monitors atmospheric activity, processing data on Originium density or impending weather changes, providing critical insights for navigation and safety. Meanwhile, the Laser Mining Module enables the ship to harvest and process shallow deposits of ore and Originium with precision, ensuring a steady supply of resources. To enhance its versatility, Rhodes Island is outfitted with a modified engine capable of utilizing alternative high-energy fuel sources as substitutes for Originium, ensuring continuous functionality in diverse conditions.

As an added benefit, Rhodes Island may optionally come fully staffed with a complement of standard personnel and Operators. However, this option won't include combat Operators or elite staff, only providing a more basic but fully functional crew capable of supporting its operations.
objects.title: Rhodes Island (Arknights)

addons.text:
Infinite Horizon has been upgraded with cutting-edge Iokath-based technology. Now measuring over a kilometre long, she has been equipped with sub-light and faster-than-light space-capable engines, devastating weapons like an omnicannon that is capable of obliterating entire fleets in a couple shots, and an army of remote-controlled combat droids and starfighters.

But the most crucial improvement is a new energy source. An infintismally small fragment of negentropic star at the centre of Iokath, it is nonetheless a power source that allows any ship equipped with it to operate indefinitely. This allows Infinite Horizon to utilise technology similar to Iokath's molecular forges to continuously replenish her army of drones, as well as enact self-repairs, making her capable of waging interstellar wars all on her own.

Moreover, using Infinite Horizon as a template, you can now construct more space-capable fleet of fog vessels of the same firepower or even improve upon the design with some research. Each of the newly produced ships will be as loyal to you as Infinite Horizon herself, and consider her their ultimate flagship, second only to you in authority.

Each and every fleet of fog vessel's personality matrix is now quantum-linked with an emergency backup on the vast servers of Iokath, meaning that every ship can be restored even if they have been obliterated down to their union core, however unlikely such an event is.
addons.title: Eternal Fleet of Fog

objects.text:
Welcome aboard The Infinite Horizon, a majestic Yamato-Class Fog Ship. With its nanomaterial construction and Union Core control, it transforms between Ship Form, Submarine Form, and Admiral Form. In Ship Form, it sails gracefully on the sea, paying homage to its WWII-era origins. In Submarine Form, it moves stealthily underwater with unmatched agility. But it reaches its peak potential in Admiral Form, allowing you to unleash devastating attacks from its formidable arsenal. All forms are covered by a space-warping thin film called a Klein Field that acts as its shield

The ship's vast arsenal includes the Super-Gravitation Cannon, a gravity-effect beam cannon that warp space time around it, and the Sniper System, a long-range particle beam cannon that can neutralize enemy ships' Klein fields in a single strike. The Demonic Eye sensor system grants complete tactical awareness, perfect for detecting and hunting submarines. The Energy Harpoon System ensnares and immobilizes enemy vessels, and the Mirror Ring System that can deflects even graviton beams, providing ultimate defense.

With the Seehund Swarm & Control System, you can design and deploy fleet of drones armed with torpedoes and rail guns, allowing for effective swarm tactics. The Dock Ship Upgrade enables the recall and redeployment of subordinate Mental Models and their ships using space-warping technology and nanomaterial replication.

The Mental Model of The Infinite Horizon takes a physical form, serving as your loyal Captain. She's dedicated to fulfilling your commands but retains her own distinct personality, engaging in playful banter and teasing. Together, you and The Infinite Horizon dominate the battlefield, showcasing the ship's timeless grandeur and unrivaled power.
objects.title: Yamato-Class Fog Battleship (Arpeggio of Blue Steel)

objects.text:
"The way I see it, if you're gonna build a time machine into a car, why not do it with some style?"

You’ve just acquired the legendary DeLorean Time Machine, one of Dr. Emmett Brown's most groundbreaking inventions. Built on the DeLorean DMC-12, this iconic vehicle is equipped with a flux capacitor that enables time travel. To activate it, the DeLorean must reach 141.6 km/h (88 mph), generating 1.21 gigawatts of energy to open a time portal.

In addition to the flux capacitor, the DeLorean is fitted with time circuits, a wormhole emitter mounted on the roof, and a Mr. Fusion unit that replaces plutonium as the main power source. There’s also a keypad for entering travel dates, a lever to activate the time circuits, and a unique levitation system powered by Mr. Fusion, allowing the car to float as it accelerates to the required time-traveling speed.

If you're looking for something different, you can opt for other time machines created by Dr. Brown, like the Time Train (also known as the "Jules Verne Train"). This steam-powered locomotive combines a steampunk aesthetic with futuristic time-travel technology. Its design evokes the classic charm of a Victorian steam engine, almost as if it came straight from a Jules Verne book, while incorporating advanced time-travel mechanisms—and, unlike the DeLorean, the Time Train operates entirely on steam.

Note: Time travel is fraught with risks. The grandfather paradox, for instance, could cause your complete erasure from existence. Additionally, encountering your past self might lead to catastrophic alterations in the timeline. For your safety, avoid any actions that could jeopardize your existence, such as seducing your mother or interfering with key historical events.
objects.title: DeLorean Time Machine (Back to the Future)

addons.text:
Now your SDF Olympus Mons gets a crew consisting entirely of T-Dolls, who occupy all positions and specialties on board the ship, from cook to shuttle and fighter pilots, landing party and captain. All of them get all the benefits from the upgrades and addons of the T-Dolls branch, although they go beyond their numbers, since they are assigned exclusively to the ship.

If you have the T-Doll Army (Girls Frontline) and Upgrade of Dummy Dolls (Girls Frontline) upgrades, you can optionally receive additional SDF-made ships if you recruit the required number of T-Dolls crews on them.

The Olympus Mons sister ship will require about 700-1000 T-Dolls or Dummy Dolls (that's about 16 SHOC T-Dolls when buying the maximum number of Dummy Dolls).

An aircraft carrier or an SDF cruiser will require approximately 350-500 T-Dolls or Dummy Dolls.

The destroyer is about 250-350 T-Dolls or Dummy Dolls.

The A-Jak (or corvette) will have a crew size of 100 to 150 T-Dolls or Dummy Dolls.

This is the minimum number that ensures an acceptable level of combat capability of the ship. For full combat capability and combat survivability, you will need 1.5-2 times the number of T-Dolls.
addons.title: SDF Dolls

objects.text:
You are in control of the Olympus Mons, the flagship of the SDF fleet, the largest supercarrier and the most powerful warship in the Solar System. Almost a kilometer long, this ship is equipped with the best technology and materials available to the SDF.

Heavy armor, numerous offensive and defensive weapons including missiles, cannons and a powerful F-SpAr beam energy weapon, which can easily destroy other ships with a single shot. In addition, dozens of fighters and landing shuttles are on board, always ready to provide support in space or on the surface.

The engines allow the ship to accelerate in space to a speed of 70 km / s and enter the dense layers of the atmosphere of planets, but the ship is not capable of landing on the planets themselves. In addition, the ship is equipped with a superluminal engine, allowing it to reach speeds 200 times greater than the speed of light and move confidently within the star system.

The ship is fully equipped with all supplies and a crew that will be loyal to you.
objects.title: SDF Olympus Mons (Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare)

addons.text:
Your magical, technological, & magitechnological knowledge has expanded to include the knowledge of the Chrono Trigger universe, your wisdom only matched by the Wise Men Of Zeal.

This includes new magic arts (like that of the people of Zeal, Magus, or the other protagonists), the secrets of Lavos & The Hidden Flame, time travel, teleportation, advanced robotics, AI supercomputers like Mother Brain & FATE, anti-gravity, handheld pure fusion nukes, hypnosis beams, memory rewriting through the Records Of Fate, Enertrons (which can give someone a health restoration & a full night's sleep in seconds), domed fortress cities for inhabiting hostile worlds, underwater & floating architecture, Zeal derived magitech, non-magical Future tech (as well as that of Lucca), Dragonian tech, & the "all-of-the-above" tech of Chronopolis.
addons.title: Enlightened One (Chrono Trigger & Chrono Cross)

objects.text:
You gain the time-traveling flying craft created by the Wise Men of Zeal, the Epoch.

While capable of time-travel, it can't go wherever it pleases in time, as it is limited to going to specific historical flashpoints. These flashpoints depend on what universe it's in, and what the defining events of that universe are.

One era you always have access to is the End of Time, a place where you can "save" and "load" the universe like a video game, restore yourself to perfect health and refill your reserves of energy (supernatural or otherwise), and train against Spekkio, a supernatural being who can teach you to use your abilities in the most effective way possible, as well as teach you the skills and abilities of the Epoch's previous crew-members.
objects.title: Epoch (Chrono Trigger)

addons.text:
"Some of the Assassins have access to rather interesting technology. When this is over, you might want to consider appropriating it. Let some good come from tonight's events..."

The trunk of your Batmobile is equipped with additional gadgets and specialized equipment that Batman has used throughout the Batman: Arkham games, including their respective upgrades and variants.

Among the most iconic devices you'll find in the trunk are the various specialized Batarang variants, including Sonic Batarangs, which emit high-frequency sounds to attract enemies' attention; Sonic Shock Batarangs, an upgraded variant that retains the ability to attract enemies' attention while also releasing a powerful electrical discharge to incapacitate targets; and Explosive Batarangs, designed to destroy objects and affect multiple enemies within an area.

In addition to these specialized variants, the trunk also contains classic gadgets from previous Arkham games that are not normally available in Batman's arsenal in Arkham Knight, such as the Ultra Batclaw, an upgraded version of the Batclaw that allows you to grab enemies and heavy objects from greater distances and pull them toward you, and the Glue Grenades, capable of immobilizing enemies, sealing certain objects and surfaces, and creating temporary adhesive surfaces, among other gadgets.

Lastly, the trunk houses specialized technology recovered from some of Gotham's most dangerous criminals throughout the Arkham saga, including the Electrocutioner's Shock Gloves, which generate powerful electrical discharges and convert kinetic energy into electrical energy to recharge themselves; Deathstroke's Remote Claw, a device that allows you to target two objects—including enemies—and pull them together; and Scarecrow's Fear Gas, capable of inducing hallucinations and causing extreme fear in those who inhale it, as well as other unique items recovered from other villains.
addons.title: Fully Loaded

objects.text:
You obtain the Batmobile from Batman: Arkham Knight, a highly maneuverable off-road urban assault vehicle equipped with artificial intelligence (AI) and remote guidance systems; as well as a Reconfigurable Integrated System that allows you to switch between two modes at any time: Pursuit and Battle.

Pursuit Mode is the default mode, designed specifically for chases and captures. It uses a WayneTech hybrid system, combining a turbocharged engine, a jet turbine, and a Kinetic Energy Recovery System (KERS), producing a total of 1,200 horsepower. Thanks to this power, the Batmobile reaches a top speed of 209 mph (336.5 km/h) and can accelerate from 0 to 60 mph (96.6 km/h) in just 2.7 seconds. Additionally, with the afterburner, powered by nitromethane, the Batmobile’s speed increases by 30%, reaching temperatures of up to 1,100°C at the exhaust vent. On top of this, its continuously variable planetary transmission and hub-mounted electric motor provide exceptional maneuverability.

This mode includes boost and jump mechanisms, as well as reduced armor profiles that minimize the thermal/radar footprint and enhance the vehicle’s stealth capabilities. It also features non-lethal missiles designed to immobilize fleeing vehicles, as well as an EMP unit (stun gun) to disable criminals and enemy vehicles.

Battle Mode, on the other hand, transforms the Batmobile into a tactical, armored form, similar to an off-road tank. This mode allows you to raise, lower, or widen its suspension, wheelbase, and axle track, depending on combat or navigation situations, providing a wider, more stable footprint and enhanced maneuverability, thanks to the individually articulated wheels, which can rotate 360° laterally. To top it off, the vehicle’s LED headlights alternate between blue and red, adding a distinctive and intimidating touch to its appearance.

In this mode, a remotely controlled turret rises from the top of the Batmobile, equipped with a variety of non-lethal weapons designed for anti-armor, anti-air, and anti-personnel combat.

This Batmobile also includes all the upgrades seen in the game, such as an EMP device that emits an electric pulse that can be used to temporarily stun and disable the targeting systems of enemy drones, as well as to deflect incoming missiles; the Drone Virus, which wirelessly transmits a polymorphic virus capable of overloading the weapon systems of enemy drones and vehicles, causing them to attack each other; and the Weapons Generator MKIV, which allows you to super-charge the secondary weapons, maximizing their offensive capabilities.
objects.title: Batmobile (DC Comics)

objects.text:
You now possess the legendary aircraft used by the chosen champion of Themyscira. This extraordinary plane has the ability to turn completely invisible at will, making it undetectable by radar or other detection systems. This allows for stealthy approaches and evasive maneuvers, ensuring you stay one step ahead of any adversary.

The plane can travel at incredible speeds, covering vast distances in no time. It is capable of interstellar travel, reaching faster-than-light speeds, thanks to a blessing from Aphrodite. Furthermore, it is designed to navigate through various dimensions, granting access to realms beyond the known universe.

Due to modifications made by gremlins, the plane has developed intelligence and the ability to speak. It has become a loyal companion, always ready to assist you and your loved ones. While it can fly at high speeds, it can also glide gracefully on air currents over short distances, making it ideal for stealthy landings or strategic retreats.
objects.title: Invisible Plane (DC Comics)

addons.text: Your bio-ship has now gained the ability to generate more bio-suits due to your access to Martian bio-clothing.
addons.title: Bio-Suit Generation

objects.text:
You have a bio-ship, a miracle of the Martian home planet. A bio-ship is a species of biological, sentient, and psychic ship. Bio-ships are so durable that they can withstand nuclear blast shockwaves, travel across space, and even function as submarines but they take time to heal if ever damaged. They use their limited psychic abilities to levitate, move, and fly. Additionally, they are capable of transforming into different forms both internally and externally, but bio-ships only have a certain amount of biomass. Through shapeshifting, they can also take on the forms of other vehicles, become near-invisible, and even incorporate alien technology; however, integration of advanced technology is more difficult and time-consuming. The two main ways that sentient bio-ships can feed themselves are through solar power or an energy-producing egg-like hibernation. 

You and the ship have an inbuilt psychic connection, which the ship responds to through intent rather than actual words. You may pilot the ship from a distance and have it come to you thanks to this mental connection. It may be piloted by people in a non-psychic way as well. The ship offers psychic shields of some kind to everyone aboard a bio-ship, but this defense can be overcome. Your bio-ship's personality complements yours, and while they usually age, yours doesn't.
objects.title: Bio-Ship (DC Comics: Young Justice)

objects.text:
The USG Ishimura is a fantastic ship. With its powerful sensors and gravity tethers, it can harvest mineral rich meteors and even small moons, smelting them on site and bringing its valuable content from across the stars with its ShockPoint Drive.

The Ishimura is fitted with all necessities its crew of a thousand may need: medical facilities, hydroponics, a shuttle system for quick locomotion,etc. It also has the needs for day-to-day life covered, such as schools and day-cares for those with children.

The Ishimura came equipped with a handful of complementary shuttles for transport between it and gravity wells, plus a year's worth of resources to maintain it and its inhabitants. You can have it fully crewed, with its crew loyal to you.
objects.title: USG Ishimura (Dead Space)

addons.text:
By sacrificing the Heart of Shor to the Deus Machina, you enact a moment akin to the ritual that once saw Cthulhu’s own heart offered, forging an unbreakable connection to Cthugha, Ithaqua, Lauger, and Czar, granting them as both weapons and living entities.

A fusion of spell, sentient being, and weapon, Cthugha and Ithaqua embody the primal forces of fire and ice. Cthugha, the incarnation of flame, manifests as a pistol of absolute destruction, unleashing bursts of stellar fire that reduce all within its path to cosmic ash. Ithaqua, the cold whisper of death, takes form as a silver revolver, each shot bending through time and space to strike an enemy’s weak point with inescapable precision. In their true forms, Cthugha becomes a demonic quadrupedal beast of living fire, while Ithaqua takes the form of a serpentine dragon of absolute frost, each an entity of elemental annihilation.

Lauger and Czar, their melee counterparts, manifest as a pair of elemental stilettos, one burning with the intensity of a dying sun, the other exuding a cold that freezes at the conceptual level. Lauger, the blade of flame, does not merely burn—it ignites reality itself, carving through existence as though it were paper. Czar, the blade of frost, leaves behind wounds that cannot heal, as its cuts exist outside the flow of time itself. Like their ranged counterparts, they shift freely between spell, weapon, and beast, existing as both tools of war and eldritch entities.
addons.title: Spell Helix (Demonbane)

addons.text:
Through the fusion of arcane physics and quantum probability manipulation, teleportation is no longer a mere traversal of space but an assertion of control over existence itself. The Quantum Expansion Catapult does not simply move the Deus Machina—it forces reality to accept its presence anywhere it wills itself to be.

By converting the Deus Machina into pure energy, its essence is dispersed across all of creation. In quantum mechanics, matter holds an infinitesimally small probability of existing anywhere within a given energy field—this system amplifies that probability to 100%, ensuring the Deus Machina instantly manifests wherever it chooses, bypassing physical and dimensional barriers alike.

With this, the Deus Machina achieves battlefield omnipresence, existing across multiple points in space-time, shifting unpredictably between realities, and superimposing itself into different quantum states. It dodges attacks by existing where they are not, reappearing precisely at the most optimal position, rendering enemy targeting meaningless. In the presence of such absolute probability control, distance, positioning, and even causality itself become irrelevant.

Yet such power does not come without consequence. The Quantum Expansion Catapult places unimaginable strain on reality, forcing causality to constantly reconcile an existence that rewrites itself. Prolonged use threatens to sever the wielder from linear time, transforming them into an anomaly hunted by the Hounds of Tindalos, until, inevitably, they fail to escape.
addons.title: QED

addons.text:
The DeMarigny's Clock, an artifact that transcends mere time manipulation, is now integrated into your Deus Machina, granting you absolute dominion over time and causality itself. Unlike conventional time-based abilities, this watch does not merely rewind or accelerate time—it enforces a perfect, undeniable control over the very sequence of events, ensuring outcomes that should be impossible.

The moment harm befalls you, time is rewritten. Even if your existence is erased, the watch forcibly returns reality to a state where you were never harmed, seamlessly restoring you to peak condition. Not even conceptual attacks, fate-based destruction, or complete erasure can circumvent its effect—to destroy you is to fight against the very flow of causality itself, and causality will always correct itself in your favor.

Beyond regeneration, the DeMarigny's Clock grants total control over time’s flow. Stop, accelerate, reverse, or fragment time across multiple realities simultaneously, allowing you to battle in different temporal states at once. Your enemies may find themselves trapped in endless loops, suffering wounds that reopen the moment they heal, or witnessing a future where they are already defeated, turning probability itself against them.

However, such power exists outside the natural order, and while you are immune to the consequences, the world around you is not. Overuse may create time fractures, paradoxes that strain the very foundation of reality, warping the flow of events in ways that even you may struggle to predict. But so long as the DeMarigny's Clock remains in your grasp, the final outcome will always belong to you.
addons.title: DeMarigny's Clock

objects.text:
A colossal fusion of eldritch magic and supertechnology, the Deus Machina is an ancient war construct built to challenge cosmic horrors and reality-warping entities. More than a machine, it is a living artifact, bound to its wielder through an unbreakable metaphysical link that merges mind, body, and soul into a singular force. Unlike conventional mechs, it does not rely on mechanics or external fuel, instead drawing upon an unstable Sorcery Reactor, sustaining itself through sheer will and arcane constructs.

Each battle twists the very fabric of space, distorting reality through dimensional layering, spell-forged weaponry, and impenetrable magical barriers. Its attacks are manifestations of forbidden elder knowledge, with Rune-Forged Blades that sever both physical and magical defenses, and Grimoire Cannons that unleash devastating arcane blasts, unraveling those struck upon impact.

Its higher-dimensional defensive barriers render it nearly indestructible, preventing even the most powerful attacks from exposing its inner workings. With Elder Sight, Demonbane's strongest protection, is capable of fending off physical, mental, spiritual and spatial attacks as well as mini-black holes, albeit the Elder Sign is generally only effective from a single direction (Usually the front), allowing enemies to ignore it via flanking attacks.

The deeper the bond between wielder and machine, the greater its power—but at a cost. Prolonged synchronization erodes the distinction between wielder and construct, warping the mind and soul into something beyond human comprehension. Those who fail to maintain control risk being consumed, reshaped into an eternal vessel for the Deus Machina’s will.

The wielder may choose any of the base models and their accompanying grimoires at the level of Aeon, including both the base and neo-form Demonbane with Al Azif.
objects.title: Deus Machina Prototype (Demonbane)

objects.text:
Type 40, formally known as a Type 40 time travel capsule, is an old model of transportation used by the Time Lords. While this ship may be an out-of-date museum piece for the Time Lords, it is still the pinnacle of advanced technology for most other races in the wide universe.

This ship is sentient. Fifteen-dimensional space fairing capsules can travel anywhere in Space-Time, including other universes. It's bigger on the inside and effectively infinite, being able to create space within itself, with various rooms serving different purposes, from libraries and pools to gardens. While not much is known about the ship's internals, it is from a society of advanced beings and can do virtually anything. 

The main room is the control room from which you can drive the TARDIS, which houses a replica of the Eye of Harmony, the power source of the TARDIS.

Of course, this type 40’s chameleon arc is functional (the default setting is a police box), as well as being able to do anything that any other type 40 has been shown to do. 

Despite the mention of the type 40 through the power, you can choose between any canon variant of the TARDIS that is shown in any media that is in the Doctor Who franchise.
objects.title: TARDIS (Doctor Who)

objects.text:
You are now a proud owner of a Heighliner-class starship. Measuring approximately twenty kilometres in length, the ship is a mainstay vessel of the Spacing Guild used for the transportation of goods across the known universe.

The ship does not possess any armaments and does not carry any cargo by itself. Instead, it folds space around itself to essentially become an interdimensional tunnel, allowing anything that passes through it to emerge in an entirely different point in space. The Holtzman drive that accomplishes this allows for travel to any point in the known universe and comes with an advanced navigational computer, allowing for safe travel without reliance on Guild Navigators.
objects.title: Heighliner (Dune)

objects.text:
You came into possession of a heavily retrofitted Krait Mk II, a versatile and highly capable multi-role starship from the 34th century. Rebuilt as a fully self-sufficient mobile base, it is equipped for exploration, combat, trade, mining, salvage, research, reconnaissance, and planetary operations. Its powerful engines, exceptional maneuverability, fighter bay, and formidable weapon loadout make it a dangerous combatant, while its expanded internals contain everything necessary to live and operate aboard indefinitely.

Its SCO-optimized Frame Shift Drive, enhanced by a Guardian FSD Booster, can traverse even the largest multi-star systems in minutes and cover upwards of 60 light-years in a single jump. The ship can be refueled directly from main-sequence stars via its onboard Fuel Scoop.

For defense and offense, the Krait utilizes a thermal-resistant Bi-Weave shield matrix backed by military-grade composite armor. Its offensive hardpoints combine underside thermal Beam Lasers and top-mounted heavy Multi-Cannons. The lasers are engineered for dual-spectrum output: in combat they strip enemy shields with sustained thermal fire, while their industrial mode lets them carve asteroids and wreckage with equal efficiency. The high-caliber rotary Multi-Cannons then shred the exposed armor or fractured rock. Fully engineered with heat-venting systems and rapid-cycling ammo feeders, the weapons platform turns the ship into a formidable hunter-killer. Coupled with automated gimballed tracking, it can handle fast-moving fighters, armored gunships, and mineral-rich asteroids alike.

Perhaps most importantly, the Krait is equipped with advanced fabrication equipment, medical facilities, a fully stocked armory, cargo bays, crew quarters, and a compact workshop. An integrated miniature Universal Multi-Limpet Controller paired with material synthesis systems and Automated Field-Maintenance Units allows the ship to fabricate and deploy automated drone swarms for mining, salvage retrieval, mid-space hull repair, cargo transfer, and structural reconnaissance without ever needing to dock. A versatile vehicle bay provides ground vehicles for planetary exploration, while its fighter bay can deploy a combat or utility craft as needed.

The Krait Mk II is yours to command — a fast, heavily armed, and remarkably adaptable starship capable of serving as your home, workshop, exploration vessel, and means of defense wherever you go.
objects.title: Krait Mk II (Elite Dangerous)

objects.text:
A ship that calculated itself into existence, born from a fragment of (a) God. Blackbird has theoretically limitless capacity to rewrite reality, from generating matter and energy in desired configurations to altering souls and remaking the physical and metaphysical laws of the universe. The only limitation is that it must understand how a thing works to create it or to manipulate it with any finesse. Fortunately it's a fast learner, and even highly advanced and esoteric technology can be faithfully reproduced with a short observation of it in action so long as the basic principles behind it are understood by Blackbird. With sufficient study of the universe Blackbird could even arbitrarily change objective right and wrong and tear open the afterlife to remake it in your image. 

Your Blackbird starts with college-graduate level knowledge of the laws of physics, basic understanding of the soul and its structure, and a soul that you may design or leave up to random chance, but which will always be loyal to you.
objects.title: Blackbird (Exordia)

objects.text: “Anyone can give a machine intelligence, only we have given one a soul,” You have gained possession of a Leviathan, a massive sentient bioship capable of natural faster than light travel. As a Leviathan considers its crew to be a form of mutually beneficial parasite, they often grow and develop to fit the niches their crew requires. The only exception to this is the lack of weaponry, as barring exceptional circumstances Leviathans were specially designed never to carry them by their creation, being ‘peaceful beasts’. Leviathans are titanic bio-mechanoids sharing many of the same functions of a conventional ship including internal atmospheres, command centers, living quarters, workshops, hangar decks, and other miscellaneous rooms. As no two leviathans are the same, however, they naturally change and develop their structures as they grow to suit their crew. Additionally, as they are biomechanical, Leviathans reproduce like most organisms, giving birth approximately once every 40 cycles and live for roughly 300 cycles naturally. Leviathans are sapient, but do not express themselves through words, often relying on a Pilot to interpret them. You may choose whether your Leviathan already has a pilot, a specialised sapient being designed to administrate and communicate its biological systems with the crew. While a Leviathan is theoretically capable of bonding with any organism, Pilots are specifically bred and trained to and thus suffer less psychological strain when doing so. Each Leviathan has a small legion of Diagnostic Repair Drones (DRDs). Controlled by either the Pilot or the Leviathan themselves, each is equipped with maintenance lasers and manipulation tools to act as a sort of ‘multi-purpose antibody’ in their Leviathan, clearing airflow and ensuring the Leviathan’s vital functions continue in good health. The final and most interesting aspect of a Leviathan’s biology is their form of faster than light travel, the ‘Starburst’. ‘Starburst’ is a defensive manoeuvre that allows the Leviathan to ride esoteric energy streams. While this is largely used to move to a random location in order to escape, it can be aimed and trained like most skills and instincts. Additionally, it can be physically taxing, meaning that the Leviathan must rest before using it again or risk serious injury. Your Leviathan is an adolescent, nearly 30 cycles old with much room to grow and develop.
objects.title: Leviathan (Farscape)

objects.text:
You obtained a mechanized vehicle inspired by jumping spiders. Developed by Section 9 of the Japanese government in response to the need for mobile transportation and offensive response simultaneously, both in urban areas and war zones.

The most striking feature of this vehicle is its incredible agility and weight balance. Its four legs are capable of transforming from arachnid claws into a special high-traction, omnidirectional black sphere. This allows it to move, cling, and slide across any type of surface and various kinds of environmental terrain. With a weight of only 500 kg, it is capable of performing maneuvers at speeds of up to 400 km/h.

The entire body of the vehicle is military-grade, sufficient to withstand all types of piercing weaponry, laser weaponry, and tactical missiles, except for armaments normally capable of sinking a warship or higher. It is equipped with cyber protection against EMPs and invasive AIs. It also possesses an AI equivalent to that of an adult, specialized in any type of military or police-related task. It is completely loyal to you.

Integrated into its chassis is a thermo-optical camouflage layer and anti-electronic detection systems, making it a viable tank for sabotage, assassination, and ambush missions. It lacks camouflage against sound-based radar and other unavoidable physical signatures. On the other hand, they possess thermo-optical sensors, sound-based radar, X-ray vision, night vision, motion sensors, electrical signal and life-detection sensors, as well as sensors capable of detecting technological presence such as cyborgs, robots, or futuristic devices. These sensors have an omnidirectional range of 10 km.

Its two arms have three modes that can be switched at any time without delay, and can even be operated individually. The first is a grenade launcher limited to fragmentation grenades and gas grenades. The second is a modified weapon with a sniper mode with a range of 25 km, a railgun mode with an effective range of 3 km, and an assault mode with a range of 10 km. The modified weapon is capable of firing armor-piercing ammunition, standard ammunition, and ammunition equipped with GPS beacons. The third is a missile launcher limited to tactical missiles and bombardment missiles, each with an effective range of 150 km and sufficient power to bring down large skyscrapers.

Finally, their power source has enough energy to operate for 400 years of uninterrupted activity and can be recharged through the absorption of solar light or any other energy source.
objects.title: Tachikoma (Ghost In The Shell)

addons.text:
By possessing both the living Godzilla and the biomechanical weapon Kiryu, an unusual resonance awakens within Kiryu’s DNA computer. The biological remnants of the first Godzilla, once used only to model combat instincts and serve as the frame of Kiryu’s body, begin reacting to the presence of a living Godzilla. Something deeper stirs within the machine as the lingering spirit of the first King of the Monsters awakens. Fragments of memory, instinct, and ancient will rise to the surface of Kiryu’s systems, giving birth to a true consciousness that is neither purely artificial nor entirely kaiju in nature.

Kiryu becomes fully sentient, his mind shaped by both advanced machine logic and echoes of the original Godzilla’s instincts and personality. Freed from the limitations of simple programming, he can now think, learn, and act independently while remaining loyal to mankind. His movements grow more fluid and natural, his combat style shifting from rigid mechanical precision to something far more primal, blending calculated efficiency with the brutal ferocity of a true kaiju.

Though reborn in steel, the presence within Kiryu ensures he can never be truly taken over or corrupted by computer viruses. The lingering spirit of the first Godzilla acts as a living firewall, a sentient safeguard woven into every circuit and system of the mech. Furthermore, Kiryu will adapt after every fight, developing new strategies and methods for combating kaiju, until he can crush them under his mechanical might, demonstrating that although the old king may be gone, his legacy is far from over.
addons.title: Echo of the First King Reborn

objects.text:
You have gained a weapon and ally in the form of the Type-3 Kiryu Mechagodzilla with some modified components. Standing at 100 meters, Kiryu is a bio-robot built around the remains of the original Godzilla, and utilizing DNA computers to grant him incredible response time and processing speed. Finally, Kiryu's spirit is willing to cooperate with you and isn’t seeking to return to his rest.

Kiryu’s physical capabilities are impressive, with his strength and durability, able to keep up with Godzilla, but truly shining in his agility. Kiryu is capable of ducking and weaving beam attacks, even leaping hundreds of meters to overcome a charge without the use of his rocket boosters. Kiryu is also capable of limited flight and using his rocket booster to aid in combat, such as building up rotation for a throw.

Kiryu is equipped with a wide variety of armaments to hit above his weight class. Starting off is its Type-99 Double Maser Cannon that fires beams of electricity with enough power to kill lesser daikaiju and hurt even Godzilla.

Next would be his Dual wrist-mounted high-speed Type-4 Railguns, essential automatic railguns meant to be used as a preemptive stunning strike, used in conjunction with his other armaments.

Furthermore, within each gauntlet for the Type-4 Railguns lies a Maser Blade, a blade that is sharp and strong enough to pierce Godzilla’s scales and that channels massive amounts of electricity into his Target. 
Further augmenting Kiryu’s melee prowess is his Type-4 Anti-Beast Drilling Claw, in which his right hand can transform into and is capable of drilling through Godzilla’s scales. 
Kiryu also possesses strong metal wires he can use to bind others and transport them.

Further aiding in his capabilities is Kiryu’s Back Unit, a mixture of rocket pods, rocket boosters, and a missile. From the Back Unit, Kiryu can fire both Multiple Interlocking Rockets and Multipurpose Guided Missiles, and if damaged, can be fired as the missile itself.

Above all mentioned before is Kiryu’s ultimate weapon, the Type-3 Absolute Zero Canon. Concealed behind three exterior panels of Kiryu’s chest, that weapon fires a blast at Zero Kelvin, causing whatever target struck by it to instantly freeze at an atomic level and collapse under their own weight. The Absolute Zero does have two flaws: firstly, it currently uses up 40% of Kiryu's power to fire, and secondly, its power is greatly diminished when fired underwater, only grievously scarring Godzilla rather than killing him.

Kiryu is not without his flaws, primarily being his limited power reserves, which would only last for 2 hours or less if the Absolute Zero is used. Further, if his transmitter is damaged, then Kiryu will have to be manually piloted.

Additionally, you have gained three items to aid in your pathernship with Kiryu. Firstly, a facility capable of holding Kiryu for upgrades, repairs, and storage. Secondly, two AC-3 White Herons, allowing for remote piloting, recharging Kiryu mid-battle, and transporting Kiryu at 750 kph (466.028 mph). Finally, blueprints on the armaments and capabilities of the other Mechagodzillas, such as II’s Diamond Shield and Plasma Grenade or Monsterverse’s Photon Scream and Hollow Earth Energy.
objects.title: Kiryu (Godzilla Franchise)

objects.text:
Congratulations! You are now the proud owner of a ship of legend. This mighty, living, magic-tech galleon was the flagship of the astral invasion. Since the astrals came from a higher dimension, it can survive the journey of time and dimensional travel, but it doesn't have the power to do so on its own. It’s extremely durable and resilient. Blessed by Primal Beast Noa to aid in its flight and protect it.

While not invincible, since it does need to be repaired. If you name it, it’s most likely been hit by it and survived. Making it one of the most reliable ships in the skies. Also is armed with magic canons.

Some examples are cannon fire, monster attacks, sharp falls, hard impacts, ramming gigantic primal beasts, and surviving a fragment of Bahamut, the god of this world. Which can fire lasers that can destroy an indestructible and immortal primal’s core.

It should also be mentioned that since this is astral-made tech, that Astrals hold the divine power of Creation and are able to create matter and energy from nothing. Their machines are perpetual motion machines. Ergo Airship engines are all Astral technology, and Astral technology is able to operate indefinitely.

Lastly, it is optional to have the trustworthy and totally devoted crew join you. Gran/Djeeta would serve as co-captain. Whereas Vyrn, Lyria, Katalina, Io, Eugen, Rosetta would make up the main crew. Some of the expanded crew seen in relink/rising/versus/anime can also join you on your adventures to staff this mighty ship.
objects.title: GranCypher (Granblue Fantasy)

addons.text: You can now instead select the initial Gundam of any other protagonist. You want the Strike Gundam from Seed? Exia from 00? Or maybe Aerial from Witches from Mercury? They are yours. They still come with the auto-repair function.
addons.title: The Next Generation

objects.text:
The OG. The White Devil. The Grandpa Gundam. You now own the same Mobile Suit piloted by Amuro Ray during the One Year war.

18 meters tall and weighing around 40 tons, The RX-78-2 comes equipped with a fusion reactor, allowing for larger operation time, and can reach 165kmph in under 5 seconds. It comes with two beam sabers, a beam rifle, and a shield that is even more durable than the mech. This advanced version doesn't require maintenance and can repair itself over time, but overworking the machine can still cause malfunctions.
objects.title: RX-78-2 Gundam (Gundam)

objects.text:
The UNSC Infinity is the apex of human naval engineering, a 5.7-kilometer-long warship serving as both flagship and fortress of the United Nations Space Command. Constructed within the orbital shipyards of Mars, the Infinity represents the zenith of pre-Forerunner and post-war human technology—an immense hybrid of human ingenuity and reclaimed alien science. Built for exploration, domination, and survival, it serves as a mobile command world, a dreadnought, and a self-sustaining city in the void.
