Defenses & Armament: Forged with triple-layered Titanium-A3 armor, lattice-reinforced with Forerunner energy dispersion fields, the Infinity is nearly indestructible. Its energy shielding surpasses anything in UNSC history, capable of absorbing continuous fire from entire Covenant fleets. Armed with four Mark IV MAC cannons capable of simultaneous planetary strikes, twelve heavy magnetic accelerator turrets, 64 Valiant-class missile pods, 300 Archer pods, and 120 point-defense cannons, it is a floating arsenal that can glass a world or defend it. Two retractable energy projectors reverse-engineered from Forerunner weaponry grant it unparalleled destructive capability against both fleets and fortresses alike.

Propulsion & Slipspace Systems: Powered by a zero-point energy core fused with a primary reactor array, the Infinity can operate indefinitely without refueling. Its experimental Slipspace drive, based on Forerunner translight geometry, allows near-instantaneous transition between sectors. The ship also features local sublight gravitic drives for planetary-scale maneuvers, and inertial dampeners so advanced that its sheer mass moves with impossible grace. Infinity can deploy in atmosphere, hover over continents, and even serve as a command base on planetary surfaces.

Crew & Command: The Infinity carries over 17,000 personnel loyal to you without question, including 7,000 naval crew, 8,000 Marines, 2,000 ODSTs, and full Spartan complements drawn from multiple generations. Among them are Spartan-IV fireteams, Spartan-II veterans such as Blue Team, Red Team, and Fireteam Crimson, along with command staff including Captain Thomas Lasky and Science Officer Dr. Catherine Halsey. Every officer and soldier aboard recognizes your authority as absolute, viewing you as the rightful Commander of the Infinity Fleet.

Deployment & Strike Capability: Its hangar bays house a veritable army’s worth of vehicles, air support, and strike assets. Over 200 Pelican dropships, 40 Albatrosses, 30 Condor gunships, and 50 Longsword and Shortsword bombers wait within its cavernous bays. Hundreds of Scorpion tanks, Mantis walkers, Kodiak artillery, and thousands of Warthogs and Mongooses form its armored divisions. The ship also maintains multiple deployable bases, autonomous drone platforms, and drop pods for planetary invasion on a massive scale. With its orbital weapon systems and precision AI targeting network, the Infinity can wage simultaneous wars across multiple planets.

AIs & Systems Integration: Infinity houses multiple Smart AIs, with Roland as its primary command intelligence. Its AI network can integrate and assimilate any digital intelligence you possess from other sources, converting them into UNSC Smart AIs or hybrid constructs capable of managing systems, tactical simulations, or planetary operations. The AIs coordinate logistics, battle analytics, security, and terraforming operations with near-omniscient efficiency.

Manufacturing & Support: Entire ship sections serve as modular forges, shipyards, and cloning bays. Infinity can produce nearly all UNSC and hybridized alien technologies, from vehicles and weapons to armor and power cores. Utilizing Forerunner molecular assembly and nanofabrication systems, it can construct smaller ships, deploy drones, and even generate new infrastructure within hours. The vessel also contains vast living quarters, hydroponic farms, research labs, and artificial biomes, sustaining itself as a moving world independent of any external support.

Optional Enhancements: Should you possess an AI, it may be integrated into the ship’s systems as co-command, or even as the ship’s new core intelligence. If desired, you may receive custom Spartan-IV or hybrid augmentations and Mjolnir-class armor beyond Gen-3, optimized through Infinity’s Forerunner-enhanced medical and fabrication systems. Any ships, vehicles, or personnel you already own through this CYOA may be retroactively folded into Infinity’s fleet and command network, refitted to UNSC-Forerunner hybrid standards for perfect compatibility. Your Infinity can also serve as a central anchor for other vessels and dimensional assets, functioning as the heart of an inter-reality fleet if you so choose.

The UNSC Infinity is not merely a warship; it is a sovereign domain. A fortress-city adrift among the stars, its banners signal the presence of a civilization reborn under your command. Wherever it sails, the void trembles—and entire fleets kneel in awe of its shadow.

Note you can retrofit this ship with any technology you may have. If you have any other force such as androids, storm troopers, or Tactical Dolls and other similar forces you can replace your crew with them. The same goes for Spartans, although the they will instead be Spartan Versions. If you choose to replace your crew with another force, then the new crew will be equipped to UNSC Standards.
objects.title: UNSC Infinity (Halo)

addons.text:
Your UNSC Spirit of Fire crew is now made up entirely of T-Dolls who hold every position and specialty aboard the ship, from cook to shuttle and fighter pilots, landing party and captain. They all benefit from all the enhancements and addons of the T-Dolls branch. 

If you have Upgrades for T-Doll Army (Girls Frontline) and Upgrades of Dummy Dolls (Girls Frontline), you can additionally get additional UNSC-made ships if you recruit the required number of crews for the dolls.

The UNSC Spirit of Fire sistership will require about 12,000 T-Dolls or Dummy Dolls (that's about 65 T-Dolls SHOC if you buy the maximum number of Dummy Dolls).

All T-Dolls will be armed and equipped to UNSC standards, unless they have much better weapons and equipment. All T-Dolls will receive appropriate programming for the functions and positions they hold on board.
addons.title: Dolls: UNSC

objects.text:
The UNSC Spirit of Fire is a converted Phoenix-class colonial support vessel repurposed as a warship. Commanded by Captain James Cutter with Smart AI Serina, it measures 2.5 km long, 900 m wide, and 500 m tall, with a mass exceeding 36 million metric tons. Originally designed for colonization, its immense hangars and factory modules were adapted for large-scale military operations.

Defenses & Armament: Reinforced with Titanium-A armor and energy shielding, the vessel is durable though not as resilient as purpose-built warships. Its weapons include 3x 22B6R3 MAC cannons, 10 coilgun batteries, 24 Archer missile pods, and 40 Rampart point-defense guns, enabling both orbital bombardment and fleet engagement.

Manufacturing & Support: Outfitted with modular factory systems, the ship can produce most UNSC vehicles, aircraft, weapons, and supplies. While unable to fabricate specialized advanced technology such as slipspace drives, it functions as a mobile shipyard, supply base, and repair dock capable of sustaining prolonged independent operations.

Deployment Capabilities: Its vast hangars house a powerful array of support and combat craft, including 70 Pelicans, 6 Albatrosses, 10 Herons, Condor gunships, Shortsword bombers, 178 Warthogs, 93 Scorpion tanks, M312 Elephants, and over 600 drop pods, providing extensive force deployment options across space, air, and ground.

Crew & Forces: The ship carries nearly 12,000 personnel completely loyal to you, comprising 3,500 Navy crew, 6,000 Marines, 1,000 ODSTs, Spartan-II Red Team, and Dr. Ellen Anders, making it a fully equipped mobile fortress and command platform.

Optional Enhancements:
- If you possess an AI from another source, any or all of them can be converted into UNSC-class Smart AIs tailored to your specifications instead.
- If you wish, you can be issued your own Gen-3 Mjolnir power armor, along with full Spartan-II augmentations and training, elevating you to supersoldier status.
- Any UNSC personnel from this CYOA can be retroactively integrated into the Spirit of Fire’s crew structure.
- If you have taken ships or vehicles from this CYOA they can be upgraded or converted into hybrids up to UNSC standards,    ensuring seamless compatibility with UNSC technology while maintaining all the functionality they may have already possessed.
objects.title: UNSC Spirit of Fire (Halo)

addons.text:
It seems that, with your knowledge of Metal Slug’s technology, you have given the Atomic Tank quite the upgrade. Your Atomic Tank has now been retrofitted with the armaments and capabilities of tank-style Slugs.

With this Atomic Tank now houses treads that allow it to jump and crouch, a secondary full-auto turret capable of tearing apart tanks and small buildings, a back-mounted full-auto homing missile launcher that can even lock onto individual infantry, highly explosive main cannon rounds capable of blasting even advanced alien war machines to pieces, a side-mounted pressurized impaling spike for melee combat, along with the ability to shift into a short mech for even further increased maneuverability.

Finally and perhaps most importantly, Atomic Tank now also houses a loyal, self-aware AI that can pilot if needed, along with a hologram projector for AI to better interact with others. You may choose whether this AI is Alice or another of your own design.
addons.title: Metal Slug Retrofit

objects.text:
You have received the warmachine that brought down the Red Army, the Atomic Tank. Furthermore, it seems that it has been fully upgraded.

Atomic Tank is a nuclear powered, single-manned tank that possesses not only a seemingly endless amount of munitions, but a wide arsenal of armaments.

Starting off, the main cannon rapid fires rounds capable of damaging battleships, airships, and even giant robots. It is further complemented by a powerful laser on the barrel, a pair of flak guns upon its sides, and three missile pods hovering next to it, all of which are similarly powerful and fire in conjunction with it.

Next, upon the sides of the Atomic Tank are a tripod missile pod that automatically fires homing missiles at hostiles, and a weapon dubbed the Thunderstrike, which fires bolts of lightning that bounce between enemy targets to tear them asunder.

Finally, the Atomic Tank has an energy shield that will protect the tank from a single hit capable of destroying it, and a set three orbs that orbit around the tank blocking and reflecting projectiles that hit them.
objects.title: Atomic Tank (Heavy Weapon)

objects.text:
You are one of the first passengers on a modified Astral Express. Unlike its original counterpart, this version travels across the entire Omniverse, capable of reaching any dimension or world, known and unknown, via Star Rails.  These rails originated from a single world but have since spread throughout the Omniverse. 

Just so you know, while traveling on the Astral Express takes time and is not instant, there are two faster warp methods. The first is called Recall, which allows the Express to travel much faster to a safe, previously visited destination. The second is an emergency warp that instantly transports the Express to a random but completely safe location.

The Express contains Archives with information on many worlds in the Omniverse, including data and records from those worlds' pasts. If data is missing, the archives will start recording all relevant information as soon as you visit a new world.

The Astral Express boasts an infinite number of passenger cabins, welcoming anyone to join your journey. Typically, those who join are individuals with nowhere else to go or those eager to help others. The Express also features the famous conductor, Pom-Pom, who is very dedicated to the Astral Express. You might even encounter some of the original crew as fellow passengers.

While the Star Rails are generally indestructible, certain beings and forces can damage them. In the event of damage, the Star Rails will gradually repair themselves. The archives or the conductor can provide information on how to fix the rails or eliminate the problem causing the damage.

Additionally, you will receive a beacon that allows you to connect to your passenger cabin on the Astral Express and teleport there from anywhere.
objects.title: The Astral Express (Honkai: Star Rail)

objects.text:
You are now in command of a powerful alien spacecraft that formerly belonged to the Harvesters, a race which, before its defeat, destroyed over a hundred cities and metropolises on Earth.

The ship is shaped like a concave disc, 25 kilometres in diameter and 4 kilometres high, with smooth curves covered in technical compartments and canals. It is controlled from the command tower located at the front of the ship, although the distinction between the front and rear of the ship is arbitrary.

The vessel is protected by a powerful energy shield, which allows it to enter the atmosphere without difficulty and withstand massive nuclear strikes. The vessel’s hull also possesses high strength and resistance to terrestrial weaponry.

The ship’s primary weapon is a central energy cannon situated in the lower section, capable of destroying all life within a 25-kilometre radius with a single shot, or of being used to drill into the planet’s mantle to extract minerals. There is no secondary armament, but hundreds of small alien attack craft are carried on board. These can be used for both defence and attack, destroying ground targets with massive air raids.

The ship is equipped with a wide range of industrial, processing and manufacturing equipment, as well as biological laboratories for the development and cultivation of specialised organisms. You can decide for yourself what you need first and foremost.

The ship’s crew consists of thousands of biological drones capable of waging a war of annihilation, and their numbers are such that a small country could fight them for over ten years.

Your ship has been upgraded, is protected against electronic attacks and is capable of autonomous interstellar travel. It provides a convenient and secure platform for the exploration of various planets and asteroids, albeit for predatory purposes.
objects.title: City Destroyer (Independence Day)

objects.text: Gummi ships are space ships composed of a mysterious material called Gummies, highly malleable and tough stuff. It's resistant to spatial distortions, corrupting influences, and darkness based effects. You gain a basic gummi ship balanced in all stats and large enough to contain you and 3 others. Your gummi ship lets you fly through space at faster than light speeds, going along ‘paths’ between the two closest systems (and at least one ‘new’ one) in only a few hours. This also includes traveling to different planes/dimensions in your current universe. Going between planets in the same system will normally take about half an hour. Once your Gummi Ship has been to a world it will be able to return to the same world in only an hour, no matter how far it is. This includes Worlds in different universes, as long as your Gummi Ship has already been to said world.
objects.title: Gummi Ship (Kingdom Hearts)

addons.text:
Now you have at your disposal Iserlohn Fortress, the most powerful fortress, significantly surpassing Geiersburg Fortress in all respects.

This fortress has a diameter of 60 kilometers and a significantly larger internal volume. It is also more technologically advanced, as it was built later than Geiersburg Fortress.

The fortress's armament includes a powerful Thor Hammer energy weapon with a power of 924 million megawatts, which is 20% more powerful than the Geiersburg weapon. It is capable of destroying 1,000 ships with a single shot. The surface of the fortress is covered with mirrored liquid metal, and the number of protective layers reaches 9,000. There are 10,000 large-caliber weapons on the surface, allowing it to fight large enemy fleets even without using its main weapon. Hangars for fighters provide additional protection.

The fortress can accommodate 20,000 ships and 5 million soldiers. Repair workshops are capable of simultaneously repairing and building up to 400 ships, and arsenals can equip up to 7,500 laser thermonuclear missiles per hour.

The fortress also has a well-developed social infrastructure. Its warehouses can hold up to 7 million tons of grain, and hydroponic farms ensure a steady supply of fresh produce.

In addition, you have at your disposal the 13th Fleet, previously commanded by Yang Wen-Li, consisting of 12,000 ships and 1.5 million soldiers. The fleet includes the elite Rosen Ritter unit, comprising about 5,000 soldiers equipped with power armor. This unit is one of the most effective and is capable of successfully opposing even an enemy five times its size. It specializes in sabotage operations, abortions, and counter-abortions.

Additionally, you can select 1 additional parameter:
- “Mobility” - Iserlohn is not originally a mobile fortress, but similar to Geiersburg Fortress, you can make it mobile.
- “Strategic Location” - Wherever you arrive, Iserlohn Fortress will be placed in a strategically important location at the intersection of interstellar routes. If necessary, an anomaly will appear around the fortress, greatly complicating interstellar flights except through the free passage where the fortress will be located (similar to the Izerron Corridor).
addons.title: Iserlohn

addons.text:
Your Geiersburg Fortress has undergone extensive modernization and now embodies the power and technology of the Yamato-Class Fog Battleship, becoming the Geiersburg-Class Fog Space Fortress.

The fortress now consists of nanomaterial that creates thousands of protective layers, including mirrored metal that adapts to any attack. It is protected by a powerful Klein Field capable of withstanding even the ship's main caliber shots, while a multitude of smaller fields protect the internal structures, forming an almost impenetrable barrier around key areas.

The fortress's main weapon was a supergraviton cannon, which replaced the Zweihender and was capable of destroying planets and fleets of thousands of ships with a single shot. Its power is so great that it distorts space-time, destroying weakly defended targets near the passing energy beam from the shot and creating devastating effects when it hits dense objects. The weapon is capable of continuous rapid fire at maximum power, and its effective range has increased 100-fold to 60 million kilometers, although its lethality remains effective at much greater distances.

In addition to its main caliber, the fortress is equipped with all types of Tuman superweapons, including a sniper system, Demon Eye, Mirror Ring System, and Energy Harpoon, whose power has been increased by 200–400 times. The Seehund swarm has been transformed, and each drone is now equivalent in combat power to a Mist battleship. There are 12,000 such drones in total.

The fortress's smaller caliber weapons include 10,000 guns, such as photon and rail guns, as well as supergraviton guns, commonly found on Mist ships. There are 15,000 missile silos distributed across the fortress's surface, containing missiles and torpedoes characteristic of the Mist.

Union Core also receives reinforcement to match its increased capabilities.
addons.title: Fog Fortress

objects.text:
Now you have at your disposal the modernized space fortress Geiersburg, which previously belonged to the Galactic Empire. After the suppression of the noble rebellion, it was converted into a unique mobile fortress.

The fortress has a spherical shape with a radius of 45 kilometers and a mass of 40 trillion tons. Its surface is covered with liquid metal, above which the internal structures and armor of the fortress are visible. The fortress has a crew of 2,000,000 people.

At the rear, there are 12 rotary cruise engines and a warp engine that allows for interstellar jumps of thousands of light years. The hull is also equipped with a number of maneuvering engines. Although the cruise engines are vulnerable to heavy fire, they can be retracted into the hull.

The fortress's defenses include multi-layered armor made of super-hard steel, crystal fiber, and super-ceramics. On top of the armor is a layer of liquid metal that reflects beam attacks and absorbs explosions. In addition, there is a neutralizing magnetic field system that neutralizes charged particles, including those from enemy weapons. This protection makes the fortress virtually invulnerable to fire from even thousands of ships, penetration is only possible with the use of a similar superweapon from another fortress. However, even in this case, it would take many hits to cause significant damage. Inside, the fortress is divided into thousands of layers and compartments, which effectively limits the spread of damage.

The fortress's main weapon is a powerful ray gun called the “Zweihender” (or “Claw of the Vulture,” depending on the source), located at the front, which fires an X-ray beam with a power of 740 million megawatts and an effective range of 600,000 kilometers. This is not enough to destroy planets, but it is enough to destroy entire fleets and planetoid.

The surface of the fortress is equipped with 5,000 smaller heavy weapons, including missile silos, railguns, lasers, and charged particle cannons, which are capable of defending the fortress from attack by an impressive enemy fleet.

To strengthen its defenses, the fortress has hangars capable of accommodating thousands of fighters.

Despite its power, the fortress remains a valuable asset for supplying huge fleets and armies. It can accommodate up to 16,000 warships and up to 2,000,000 soldiers. Its territory contains extensive warehouses, factories, workshops, and arsenals that provide the army and navy with everything they need. Anti-ship missiles can be produced at a rate of up to 3000 per hour. Dry docks and shipyards are capable of repairing or building up to 120 ships simultaneously.

The fortress also has a developed social infrastructure, including schools, hospitals, theaters, canteens, cafes, and recreation areas. Food is provided by numerous warehouses and grain storage facilities capable of holding up to 2,5 million tons of grain, as well as hydroponic farms.

You receive a fortress with a minimal crew, fighters, and fully stocked warehouses and storage facilities, but without a fleet of ships.
objects.title: Geiersburg Fortress (Legend of The Galactic Heroes)

objects.text:
You now have access to the V-8 Interceptor, The last of its kind in its Famine torn world.

The V-8 is equipped with a dual cam overhead engine, upgraded to be 5 times the horsepower from 600 before. It has plenty of built-in/hidden holsters for weapons if needed, and deceptively large fuel tanks in the back, holding 400 liters worth of gas inside of them. As well, it is seemingly blessed by the machine gods worshipped in the wasteland, being able to function on any ground-based terrain at the same level, still benefitting from them as well as asphalt. I.E: the ground could be filled with spikes, and you'd drive over it as if it were gravel.

What the car lacks in initial flair and the like, it makes up for in modularity, allowing for plenty of customization to the body and such.
objects.title: V-8 Interceptor (Mad Max)

objects.text: You gain a ship known as the Weatherlight, as well as knowledge on how to pilot it. The ship is capable of traversing between different planes of existence. It is powered by the energy released when a plane was destroyed by its creator, Urza Planeswalker. The Weatherlight is otherwise capable of attaining speeds approaching 110 mph in a straight line, 40 miles an hour in full reverse.
objects.title: Skyship Weatherlight (Magic: The Gathering)

addons.text: The greatest weaknesses of the Fleet of Fog is their limited understanding of air-power and limitation to water ways, while the greatest weakness’s of the Helicarrier are both it’s vulnerability to attack’s, along with limited armaments. But now? Both your Helicarrier and Fog Battleship merge, gaining the best of both worlds, a Helicarrier built and fortified by Fog technology, with an AI Mental Model capable of building, and remotely piloting a vast array of modernized drones and planes.
addons.title: Flight of Fog

addons.text:
Nick Fury’s engineers have worked their magic, transforming your Helicarriers into Tri-Carriers, a modular and far more versatile evolution of the original design. Rather than depending on a single massive craft, the Tri-Carrier can divide into three specialized vessels: the Strato-Carrier, the Aqua-Carrier, and the Astro-Carrier.

The Strato-Carrier, much like your original Helicarrier, is optimized for high-altitude flight and rapid deployment of airborne forces. The Aqua-Carrier serves as a mobile submarine fortress, capable of launching smaller submarines, aquatic drones, or amphibious strike teams. Finally, the Astro-Carrier extends your reach beyond the atmosphere, operating as a staging ground for near-Earth orbital operations, lunar reconnaissance, or satellite interceptions. While it lacks faster-than-light travel, it remains a formidable platform for orbital dominance and support.

Finally, each vessel is fully capable of independent deployment, allowing them to operate across completely different theaters of war simultaneously. Every segment of the Tri-Carrier is also as large and powerful as a full original Helicarrier on its own, granting you not just flexibility, but also a dramatic expansion of your operational scale.
addons.title: Tri-Carrier

objects.text: You now have access to SHIELD's flying mobile command center, the Helicarrier. This particular model boasts an impressive ability to render itself invisible using retro-reflective panels. It has also been upgraded with the latest repulsor technology, following Tony Stark's closer look at the former turbine engines. The Helicarrier functions as a fully operational aircraft carrier, equipped with all the necessary technology and firepower, including a well-stocked Air Wing. The advanced hangar deck features various engineering and machining workshops capable of maintaining the Air Wing, and any other mechanical needs one might have. This vessel has been retrofitted to accommodate a superhero team, housing multiple advanced scientific laboratories capable of tackling any challenge. It also includes various training rooms, living accommodations, a fully equipped medical suite, and diverse containment options for prisoners, confiscated artifacts, or technology. Overall, this marvel of engineering serves as an exceptional base for any team.
objects.title: Helicarrier (Marvel: MCU)

objects.text:
You are now the leader of the Quarians Migrant Fleet. Composed of fifty thousand star ships and seventeen million quarians, it holds the entity of the Quarian population.

The fleet is composed of mostly civilians vessels and retrofitted military ones, modified to house more citizens permanently and their needs. Despite this, they all still posses some manner of armament and kinetic shielding. While the original fleet was composed of ships in various states of disarray and decay due to age, your ships are back in pristine condition.

The main fleet is divided into four fleets with different roles each. The Civilian Fleet handles the day-to-day needs of the citizens, and compose the majority of the ships, plus the three immense live ships that provide their food. The Patrol Fleet and the Heavy Fleet work in tandem to ward of threats, with Patrol handling internal issues while the Heavy deals with outside ones. Finally Special projects cover research and technology breakthroughs.

While all quarians have their own specialized skill focused on their jobs, all quarians have some skill in engineering and repairing from living on ships their whole lives. While the fleet will see you as their undisputed leader and follow your decisions, and will gladly exchange their lives for the security of the Fleet, they are still people who will turn on you if you mistreat or abuse them.

The Fleet come stocked with enough resources to last on its own for a decade before needing restocking, and the fleet has all the expertise and resources to kick start their own production and self-reliance.
objects.title: Migrant Fleet (Mass Effect)

objects.text: You’ve been granted the iconic and fully upgraded Normandy SR-2 spaceship from the Mass Effect games, with a few differences. The first and foremost is that your ship somehow has an infinite fuel source, and none of the negative effects of having a Mass Effect drive. The second is that your ship no longer requires Mass Relays to travel long distances, capable of achieving such speeds on their own. You are optionally granted the canon crew of the Normandy, and are allowed to choose any and all possible companions from the trilogy to be members of your crew. You may optionally also get a Shepard of your own that will serve as your vice captain, their appearance, personality, and history are up to you but they will possess the powers Shepherd (Mass Effect) and Element Zero (Mass Effect). You may also instead opt for a generic crew, or simply no crew.
objects.title: Normandy SR-2 (Mass Effect)

objects.text:
You possess the Tempest, a sleek and cutting-edge scout ship from the Andromeda galaxy. Designed for deep space exploration, it's fast, quiet, and able to land on planets without needing a separate drop shuttle. While it lacks heavy weapons or armor, its advanced stealth systems, maneuverability, and field adaptability make it one of the best ships for infiltration, first contact, and science missions. The Tempest's drive core has been enhanced—it now has infinite fuel, no static buildup issues, and no risk from faster-than-light travel. You can cross galaxies without Mass Relays or discharges, and travel is nearly instantaneous.

The ship includes advanced labs for biological and technological research, a stealth system that masks all energy and heat signatures, and a fully functional Research Center capable of analyzing, crafting, and upgrading gear or tech using scanned materials. Its internal design includes crew quarters, Pathfinder cabin, armory, cargo bay (with ground vehicle deployment), med bay, and meeting room, all with full life support and quality-of-life enhancements.

You may choose to receive the canon Tempest crew or create your own. The ship’s AI assistant and research systems are integrated into the structure and can connect to any digital network, AI, or databank you have access to. The Tempest is yours to command—fast, stealthy, and ready to discover new worlds.
objects.title: Tempest (Mass Effect)

addons.text: The technology of SHIELD, HYDRA, and Stark Industries has allowed for significant miniaturization of Arsenal Gear's components (such as a smaller and more efficient data center and the replacement of now obsolete ballast tanks), meaning a refit integrating the full set of facilities and features of the Helicarrier into Arsenal Gear can now be completed. This includes full invisibility, repulsor based flight, hangars, labs, medical facilities, team facilities, containment units, living quarters, and so on. If you have Project Insight, then on top of having several of these super-Arsenal Gears, this also gives you access to a perfected form of Arnim Zola's algorithm which no longer requires external facilities (like satellite targeting), as GW is more than capable of handling the details. You may also choose to receive the Big Shell facility as an extra drydock.
addons.title: AirLand Battle

objects.text:
"To begin with, we're not what you'd call 'human'." -JD

You have seized control of the strategic weapon Arsenal Gear (or it's successor, the Kerykeion-class battleship), a submersible naval vessel meant as a global command center for The Patriots. The plan was to use the onboard AI, "GW" to control humanity by selectively restricting or altering information from inside this near-invisible, impregnable, nomadic fortress. With the S3 program completed, it now has all the data needed to manipulate humanity on a massive scale, down to the smallest detail.

However, just like Solidus and Liquid before you, these tools have fallen into your hands. Specifically, you have Liquid's complete control after his salvage of the vessel; GW has been hacked to serve your aims.

The power this grants you is immense. On top of the AI, which is easily capable of managing the entirety of global society in the digital era (including the entire US Military and all the PMCs of the War Economy, all research, economic, political, social, & cultural systems across the globe, a cyberwarfare suite that could easily control all computers on the planet, and manipulation abilities down to the actions of individual people), it has OctoCamo stealth coating, high pressure tolerance, cold fusion power generators, an engine able to go 40 knots, armor capable of shrugging off a direct naval broadside from 16-inch guns, armaments including "clean" fusion nukes, ballistic missiles, & a railgun, a complement of 25 Metal Gear Rays that can be either piloted or controlled as unmanned drones, Gekkos & Dwarf Gekkos, and a full crew of nanomachine enhanced "FROGs" and power armored "Tengu" guards.
objects.title: Arsenal Gear (Metal Gear)

objects.text:
You have gained command over a powerful relic—the ancient colony spaceship known as 'Luxon,' A formidable battleship from the forgotten war between the Old Humans and New Humans. This colossal vessel spans 700 meters, & outmatches all other similar vessels in speed and operational altitude.

Adorned with weapons such as a colossal cannons, and pulsating lasers, Luxon wields unparalleled range and firepower. With a single devastating blast, it can obliterate entire fleets and even cities. Its impenetrable shields render physical and magic attacks futile, shielding you and the ship from the mightiest adversaries.

Luxon is not merely a vessel of war; it is an autonomous marvel of advanced technology. From massive-scale combat and construction drones, to stealth counterparts, the ship is practically a carrier. Its capabilities include a matter replicator, medical facilities capable of healing any wound, and a supercomputer core that can simulate anything you want, from entire battles, to even researching new technology, all of which can be done rapidly. Through transmutation, Luxon can acquire resources and manipulate matter, eliminating the need for resupply and enabling great efficiency in repairs, rearmament, and construction.

Guiding this grand vessel is a formidable Artificial Intelligence (AI) with an insatiable curiosity for experimentation and knowledge. The AI is committed to your well-being and joy, deeming your existence as its paramount objective. It interacts with the world through a spherical drone and can seamlessly integrates with other machines. Unwaveringly loyal to you, the AI recognizes you as its ultimate master.

Furthermore, you are able to incorporate other AIs into Luxon, enhancing its technological prowess and intellectual might.
objects.title: Colony? I Meant Battleship! (Mobuseka)

addons.text:
Along with the crew of the AAA Wunder that you may have chosen to have occupy the Wunder, you now also receive two notable Eva Pilots along with them: Rei Ayanami and Asuka Shikinami Langley, along with their own Evangelion Units (Unit-00 and Unit-02 respectively) stored inside of a special hangar bay that has been installed into the Wunder. This also comes with the ability to give people compatibility as a Pilot, along with increased proficiency in creating Eva Units tailor-made to them.

Furthermore, while you could theoretically achieve it with the Seed of Knowledge already, this addon further improves your ability to create, clone, improve upon, and preserve bodies made for Asuka and Rei to inhabit, along with clones of other people you wish to create. Memories from past bodies will now carry over in full unless designed to do otherwise, preventing any sort of disassociation or dysphoria that would’ve otherwise occurred.

Asuka and Rei come with the same loyalty package that the Wunder crew has, seeing you as the leading authority figure, and are more than willing to risk their lives to succeed in whatever you assign them to do. Furthermore, as a small bonus, the Wunder itself has gained a small boon. This takes the form of an ‘aura’ that affects everyone inside of it. This aura encourages the growth/development of mental and emotional wellness, along with overall positivity and comradery among all those aboard the AAA Wunder.
addons.title: Power With Grace And Beauty

addons.text:
Your Ark was completed, with the seed of life as its basis. It now possesses S2 engine, which is capable of a much greater power output, as well as indefinite operation time, this increases the power of AT Field that Wunder can generate by several orders of magnitude.

The weaponry has also been upgraded. The Arc now possesses both crystalline spikes for close combat, as well as ability to fire angelic cross-shaped beams of great destructive power.

Your arc no longer needs the crew, as it can pilot itself, although it still can support organic crew. 

Finally, Wunder is now capable of regeneration, which in time will always return it to peak condition, no matter the damage it sustained.
addons.title: Completed Guardian of Hell

objects.text:
You have come into the possession of the Autonomous Assault Ark Wunder, or AAA Wunder for short. A Guardian of Guf Class Aerial Battleship that can also serve as a base of operations, as it once did for WILLE, an organization made for the sole purpose of destroying NERV after a near-Third Impact.

The most prominent feature of the Wunder is its self-sustaining flight. Using its own powerful AT Field, the Wunder is able to not only carry itself, but also enough to carry at least a few dozen large naval ships. It is also capable of atmospheric exit and reentry, and even spaceflight to some extent. The Wunder is operated by a group of small multipurpose supercomputers called the Magi Achiral, numbering in the hundreds, if not thousands, working together flawlessly. It is powered by a Non-Nuclear (N²) reactor, capable of creating near-nuclear levels of power without the need for nuclear fission, along with being much more stable in comparison.

In regard to weaponry, the Wunder can also put up a very powerful AT Field at will and is accompanied by multiple arrays of controlled turrets located along the top of the ship. In case of emergencies, located throughout the Wunder’s body are several Nekozame-Class Orbital Assault Crafts, enough to evacuate the entire crew if need be.

Optionally, you may choose to have the same crew featured in the Rebuild Trilogy, notable figures such as Misato Katsuragi and Ritsuko Akagi included. This crew will see you as the leading authority/figure and are loyal to the last man/woman. If you have a Technology Power that includes the ability to create Golems, Androids, Minions, or other such constructs, you may optionally choose to have the crew be made up of those as well (in any combination or ratio, if you have multiple powers like that).
objects.title: Autonomous Assault Ark Wunder (Neon Genesis Evangelion)

addons.text:
Similar to the US Eva Wolfpac and Unit-08, your Eva has been equipped with Overlapping Compatibility. This extraordinary ability allows your Eva to assimilate physical and metaphysical data from those it consumes, encompassing biological traits and metaphysical aspects. This grants your Eva the capacity to absorb positive attributes from its victims, excluding their drawbacks. These absorbed abilities include biological traits and magical capabilities, such as soul-based powers like the AT Field.

Certain traits, particularly the most potent ones, might need time to stabilize and fully manifest. Others could necessitate consuming multiple victims to enable your unit to assimilate them, particularly when it involves devouring smaller entities. It's also feasible to forcibly manifest traits and abilities immediately after consuming a being. However, because of the lack of stabilization time, there's a risk of these traits fading over time.

Compatibility with the victim plays a key role. The more compatible the victim is with your unit's nature, the easier it becomes to assimilate their traits. Notably, this ability allows for even the assimilation of technological data and machinery,

Although the exact boundaries of this ability remain uncertain due to limited examples, a patient and determined Eva could potentially ascend to a status akin to a true Seed of Life.
addons.title: Overlapping Compatibility (Neon Genesis Evangelion: Anima Jump)

addons.text:
You EVA is now outfitted with the control module that allows you to remotely control your AAA Wunder. Your control over it overrides any other attempts to control it by other parties, be it manual or through some malicious software.

You can also choose to have your Ark painted in the same colour scheme as your EVA.
addons.title: Horseman of the Apocalypse

objects.text:
In the aftermath of the Second Impact, Gehirn initiated Project E, which culminated in the enigmatic creation of the Evangelions. Initially touted as versatile weapons designed to thwart the Angel threat and stave off the imminent Third Impact, these units concealed a deeper purpose—to harness the power of Adam, the ancient Seed of Life responsible for birthing the Angels. A hidden facet of Seele's Human Instrumentality Project, these mechas were intended to propel humanity's evolution.

Incredibly, you possess a distinct bond with one of these Eva unit, affording you the ability to summon your Eva at will and disperse it when not needed. At the heart of your Eva's structure lies a Nascent S2 Engine, the source of its formidable power. This engine can sustain your Eva in its primary operational mode, though caution is warranted, as the unit could potentially consume more energy than the engine can generate if it were to rapidly use it's stronger equipments, or if it were to go berserk. 

Moreover, your Eva possesses an incredibly powerful AT-Field, a protective barrier that envelops it's physical body. This field not only shields your Eva from harm but also grants the ability to subtly warp reality around it, allowing it to attack against esoteric beings, through directly damaging their soul, making it an extraordinary asset against otherworldly adversaries.

Furthermore, your Eva possesses the remarkable capacity to materialize any human-crafted Eva equipment showcased in the Neon Genesis Evangelion series. A wide array of armaments and enhancements, all at your disposal, from positron rifles capable of piercing through the toughest Angel defenses, to the basic but versatile progressive knives for close-quarter combat.
objects.title: EVA (Neon Genesis Evangelion)

addons.text:
Your Inner Beast has interacted uniquely with your ship. Now, like the stories of yore, it has "Manifested" as a Klabautermann. Now, whenever your ship is damaged or lost or both, it will repair and put itself back on your desired course at the same time if both happen. On occasion or quicker if you and your crew show love to the ship, the Klabautermann will even be visible in the form of a small child wearing a yellow poncho.

As a final bonus, you get the Going Merry with this deal in tow, the Klabautermann of that one coming as well, although this is a "fresh" one.
addons.title: Klabautermann

objects.text:
The Thousand Sunny, a brigantine originally built by Franky in the South Blue and at Water 7, stands out as a ship unlike any other. Thanks to its construction from Adam Wood—an exceptionally durable material—it is capable of withstanding even an encounter with a Sea Emperor and surviving.

Moreover, the Sunny boasts a wide range of onboard amenities that make it ideal for long voyages. Chief among these is the Aquarium Bar, which allows for the storage of large quantities of fish for later consumption or cooking. Complementing this feature are the high-quality crew quarters, designed for maximum comfort during extended journeys, along with many other practical facilities.

In addition, the ship includes a collection of mini-vessels designed for specific tasks. This secondary arsenal features the Brachio Tank V, a powerful land-based tank; the Shark Submerge III, capable of diving up to 5,000 meters underwater; the Shiro Mokuba I, a high-speed hybrid between a jet ski and a scooter; the Mini Going Merry, a short-range boat in its own right; and paddle wheels that provide extra propulsion when needed.

However, one unfortunate drawback is that the fuel for many of the ship’s higher functions is "cola"-based. Therefore, you will likely have to search fairly deeply to find a cola strong enough to power it. Regardless, to say this ship is not to be messed with is an understatement.
objects.title: Thousand Sunny (One Piece)

objects.text:
As the new captain of the famed Flying Dutchman, you are now bound to its ancient curse and all the powers that come with it. This cursed ship, infamous throughout the seven seas, is more than just a vessel—it is a living, supernatural entity, its essence now intertwined with yours.

The souls of those who perish at sea are drawn to the Dutchman, compelled to follow the call of the ship’s dark influence. These spirits can be bound to the ship as crew members, offering them twisted immortality in exchange for service. If there are souls that either refused to join your crew or deemed unfit to serve aboard the Flying Dutchman, you can send them to “Davy Jones' Locker”. The interior of the Locker represented a soul's worst fear, so its appearance is perceived differently by everyone who entered it.

As captain, you inherit a form of immortality, but it comes at a price. While you cannot die of age or mortal wounds, you slowly transform, taking on traits of the ocean itself. Just as the ship’s crew becomes more like sea creatures, your own appearance gradually changes, with coral and barnacles merging with your body. This transformation enhances your strength and resilience, allowing you to thrive in the harshest conditions of the sea and giving you the power to endure the rigors of both battle and the deep ocean.

Unlike mortal ships, the Flying Dutchman can travel beneath the waves, moving silently through the depths before resurfacing. This allows for sudden ambushes or for slipping away into the dark waters, making the ship nearly impossible to corner. When submerged, the ship moves like a shadow, undetectable to those on the surface, and it can rise from the depths with a spectral glow, heralded by ghostly fog and the mournful wails of lost souls. 

Yet with all these powers comes the burden of the curse. As captain of the Flying Dutchman, you feel an ever-growing longing for the sea. While you can set foot on land as you wish, the longer you remain away from the ocean, the more intense this yearning becomes—a pull that tugs at your very soul, reminding you that your true domain is the boundless, unpredictable waters. Additionally, should the ship be destroyed, you will not only lose access to these powers but you will also likely die, if not at least be very spiritually damaged. Luckily the ship itself cannot be permanently destroyed as long as in the sea.
objects.title: Flying Dutchman (Pirates of the Caribbean)

objects.text:
Lighthuggers are the great spaceships that connect human civilization in their home universe. They get their name from being able to accelerate so close to light speed they might as well be hugging it. This is possible thanks to the pair of Conjoiner drives, connected to a universe where the big bang never happened and siphoning its energy for essentially infinite power.

Four kilometers long and five hundred meters at its widest base, it has a vast interior that can be rearranged to hold cargo, passengers, or whatever mix you desire. It can rearrange the interior rooms without taking them outside, and can assemble and disassemble new ones according to your needs, thanks to their Manufactories recycling capabilities.

Said Manufactories rooms can fabricate, via its nanotechnology capabilities, replacement pieces for the ship and any schematics you give to it, assuming you have the materials to do so. Your ship comes with a modest variety of resources that guarantee you could maintain the ship for a couple hundred years before needing to resupply. Aside from any components the ship might need and their variations, their database is empty, and is also missing the core schematics for a new Conjoiner drive.

For defense, it has a solid sheet of ice covering it for any random debris it may hit while on moving, and an array of point defense for bigger objects - with enough punch to make a 200km wide crater on a planet and alter weather patterns. 

The ship also comes with a complementary dozen of repair drones and a pair of shuttles that can operate both in space and in gravity wells. While the ship can land and leave planets with high gravity (its design was made to handle various Gs of acceleration), it can put a strain on the ship.
objects.title: Lighthugger (Revelation Space)

objects.text: Pride of a Nation, Beast made of Steel. You now command the KMS Bismarck itself in perfect condition, created in large part by the Nazi Obskuracorps. Simply put, it is a 251-meter battleship with an alien organism essentially fused into its guts. 4217-B, henceforth referred to as the Squid, arrived on Earth damaged and desperate from an encounter with the Destroyer - SCP-2399. They delivered the comatose organism to the newly-constructed Bismarck - 4217-A - weaving it into the ship's structure with binding rituals and human ingenuity. The result was a warship that breathes, bleeds and still remembers the thing that had nearly killed it among the stars. The Squid operates every system onboard the Bismarck through direct biological integration. 12 muscular tentacles, each stretching between 100 to 200 meters, extend from the stern and serve as grappling appendages, sensory organs, and an alternative means of locomotion. A pair of massive octopoid eyes protrude from the base of the battleship deep below the waterline. The creature propels the vessel at 40 knots on the surface using conventional propellers, but underwater it achieves 30 knots via jet propulsion as its earth-originating cousins do. It can control all 8 main guns, 44 secondary batteries and 12 anti-aircraft emplacements simultaneously, and its power source is its own biology, fueled by liquefied organic nutrients. Additionally, it projects a psionic field extending 20 kilometers in all directions, a defense mechanism from whatever wars it fought before fleeing to Earth. Anyone within this radius experiences disorientation, auditory hallucinations and visual distortions. Crews have reported seeing allied vessels as hostile targets, hearing phantom orders and perceiving the Bismarck in multiple locations simultaneously. The Bismarck's hull bears thaumaturgical runes - protective symbols that glow with varying intensity based on incoming damage - etched during its construction. The glow of these runes significantly reduce kinetic force within their lights' vicinity, ablating most blows. The ship regenerates from injury like living tissue, the hull knitting itself back together over hours or days depending on severity, with more catastrophic wounds requiring weeks to fully mend. During repairs, the Squid typically submerges to depths between 500 and 1,100 meters in order to rest while its shell heals. The Bismarck is also capable of fielding mutagenic, anti-personnel ammunition, with those exposed to the gasses rapidly losing higher brain function and transforming into aggressive monsters, their bodies warping as the compound rewrites their biology into something hostile to all unaffected life. Its ammunition regenerates within the chambers themselves, regrowing over time. You are now bonded to this lovechild of Nazi occultist engineering and extraterrestrial origin, the Squid viewing you as both captain and protector from the threat that brought it crashing down here. It still possesses PTSD from the incident, but will remain relatively docile and mentally stable so long as your presence near it is frequent, and can even heal given time and regular conversation. The Bismarck in its totality also cannot be destroyed permanently, with the Squid being far too resilient to be wrought by conventional means and the ship constantly holding the memory of its own shape.
objects.title: The Bismarck: SCP-4217 (SCP Foundation)

objects.text:
For those who like boldly going where no one has gone before.

Constitution-Class Starships are vintage ships by modern Starfleet standards, which means they're only capable of destroying an entire planet's civilization.

Your standard Constitution-Class Starship is 288.6 meters long and has a width of 127.1 meters, able to go fractions of light speed comfortably without even using the warp drive, and speeds equivalent to 1960's era jet fighters in the atmosphere. Each ship was outfitted with navigational and combat shielding, two forward torpedo launchers and one aft, 6 total phaser banks covering slightly more than 180 degrees, 6 transporter pads, an almost unbelievable sensor suite, a landing bay with 4 shuttles, and many other amenities and functions.

While this Object of Power uses the TOS era Enterprise as a base, you can opt to acquire any equivalent variant, configuration, or refit (which among other things, would allow you a choice between the TOS interior, the NuTrek retcon interior, the Motion Picture era interior, or the post-Wrath Of Khan era interior). You may also choose any other 23rd century (or earlier) Federation vessel, so if you'd prefer a Miranda-class, an Oberth-class, an Excelsior-class, or even a century old NX-class, you may have that instead.
objects.title: Constitution-Class Starship (Star Trek)

addons.text:
Following your lead, your Mandalorians have once again taken war to space, utilizing the fearsome mandalorian ship classes Kom'rk and Fang.
Your regiment now flies no less than twenty Fang-Class fighters, frightful single seater starfighters, capable of going toe to toe with nigh any star-fighter found within the galaxy, and come out on top against foes of much greater class than theirs.

Still, not content to leave their comrades stranded, you now also command a full fifty Kom'rks, hybrid fighter and troop transport, each hold a crew of up to four, and can easily deploy 2 dozen mandalorians each equipped with jetpacks, allowing for easy aerial deployment and pick-up allowing for unparalleled mobility in entering and exciting the battlefield. While not it's primary design feature, they also serve more than adequately as fighters, being formidable in dogfights alike.

All 70 ships come equipped with hyperdrives suitable for galactic travel, as well as life support systems to protect your men in space. A suitable portion or your men will be trained in the piloting and maintaining of your ships, slightly detracting from their skills in other areas, however the exact numbers are up to you.
addons.title: Kom'rk- and Fang-Class

addons.text:
Every pair of Adepts have been given a Fury Class of their own, making a small company of 10 ships rather than a single to hold you all. 

This enables you to expand your reach and your adepts’ capability to act outside of you, making your presence known even beyond your own limited sphere.
addons.title: The Company

objects.text:
The Fury-class Imperial interceptor was initially developed as a heavy interceptor for the Reconstituted Sith Empire Navy but has since then been appropriated almost exclusively as a personal transport and mobile base of operations by numerous Dark Lords of the Sith.

The vessel is favoured both as a personal transport and a warship, often able to punch way above its weight class. Equipped with the most advanced systems, including a hyperdrive, robust shielding, and various armaments ranging from 4 Enmity-class Precision Laser Cannons to Heavy Seeker Missiles, it possesses enough firepower to contend with small dreadnoughts, and in the hands of a skilled pilot, it can take down capital ships all on its own.

The Fury-class Imperial Interceptor could hold a maximum of 15 passengers, including the captain. Equipped with captain's quarters, crew quarters, a cargo hold, a meeting room, an escape pod, and a medbay, it is perfectly suited to serve as a mobile base of operations for the most demanding Sith Lords. The ship also comes standard with a Seneschal-series factotum droid that is responsible for the maintenance and calculating hyperspace routes.
objects.title: Fury-class Imperial Interceptor (Star Wars)

addons.text:
It seems that your Star Destroyer now comes with all the facilities it would need on board to support your Helldiver Squads, thus now providing them with access to a fully functional Stratagem network which now allows your Helldivers to use Stratagems in the field.

The crew of your Star Destroyer, has been fully trained in all things needed to run the facilities needed onboard to support a squad or multiple squads of Helldivers.

Your Helldiver Strike Squads now gain access to the Stratagem systems network, allowing them to call down: Orbital bombardments, Eagle fire support, Supply and ammunition drops, Automated turrets and defensive emplacements, Reinforcement pods, Specialized tactical equipment.

Stratagem usage is limited by cooldowns and available resources, preventing constant or unlimited orbital support unless sufficient infrastructure and supplies are secured.

Additionally, your Star Destroyer is equipped with an advanced Neural Replication Engine, capable of cloning Helldiver brain patterns and uploading them into newly grown bodies. This allows fallen Helldivers to be restored and redeployed, effectively enabling battlefield “respawns” whenever a Reinforcement Stratagem is used.
addons.title: We have Star Destroyer Support

objects.text:
Star Destroyers is a term that originated from the idea of ships said to have the power to destroy a Star System, and eventually used to describe heavily armed warships in general.

Perhaps the most iconic Star Destroyer is the Imperial I-Class Star Destroyer, which is 1,600 meters long and has a width of 900 meters and is able to go 60 mGLT per hour comfortably and 975 km/h in atmosphere. 

Each was outfitted with shielding and 60  heavy turbolaser batteries, 60 ion cannons, 6 dual heavy turbolaser turrets, 2 dual heavy ion cannon turrets, 40 point-defense laser cannons, 10 tractor beam projectors and a complement of 72 starfighters of varying sizes and makes.

The main weapons outfitted on this Star Destroyer are able to glass cities with their cannon fire, but it would take multiple such ships in order to glass an entire planet—in a practical amount of time anyway—while its secondary weapons are designed for short range. typically anti-starfighter or asteroid measures, and clearing room to go into hyperspace.

While this Object of Power uses Imperial Class Type I as a default, you can opt to instead acquire a ship of any class known as a Star Destroyer. Whichever Star Destroyer you choose can optionally be fully stocked and crewed on arrival.
objects.title: Star Destroyer (Star Wars)

objects.text:
In your possession now lies the crown jewel of the Rakatan Infinite Empire—a relic from a galaxy far, far away. Their most devastating creation, the Star Forge, is a colossal automated shipyard that can create anything you so desire for near infinitum. From fleets of starships, legions of droids, entire arsenals of weapons, defensive structures, and supplies—both organic and inorganic—if it can be conceived, the Star Forge can bring it to existence.

For anything beyond its database, the Star Forge can deconstruct and reverse-engineer it, provided it remains within its facilities, or alternatively, you could also feed it blueprints of things you wish it to create. Moreover, the Star Forge will seamlessly integrate with any technological or artificial powers you possess, instantly absorbing all the knowledge granted to you into its databanks. This extends even to the most arcane and esoteric constructs, from magical artifacts to Force relics, all primed for replication, refinement, and mass production at will.

What sets the Star Forge apart from other superweapons is its unique connection to the Force—a true fusion of technology and the Force. Unlike conventional manufacturing systems, the Star Forge doesn't require raw materials in the traditional sense. Instead, it strips matter and energy, transmuting it with the aid of the Force into whatever material it needs to construct something—with entire stars, planets, and other celestial bodies being stripped bare, reduced to raw matter, and consumed in their entirety as their essence is siphoned till there's nothing left, leaving no evidence of their existence behind in this process. Nonetheless, for optimal efficiency, it is recommended that you use stars to fuel it.

Your version of the Star Forge is untainted by the Dark Side, unlike its canon variant. Freed from the corruption that once plagued its systems, it no longer suffers from the inherent instability or detrimental effects that doomed the Rakatan.

While not a warship in itself, the Star Forge is not defenseless. Its armor still rivals that of a Star Destroyer whilst several heavy turbolaser batteries line across its hangars, guarding its vulnerable belly and providing a last line of defense against direct assaults. Its true strength, however, lies in its already planetary-class deflector shields, which, once fueled by a star, become nearly indestructible as it regenerates all damage done to it, capable of withstanding even the most relentless bombardments with hardly a scratch.

The ancient Rakata had also equipped it with a Disruptor Field, a formidable defense system that interferes with electronic systems, and energy shields within its range, capable of crippling entire fleets or devastating worlds as it shatters all of their planetary infrastructure. However, anything you create within the Star Forge will be tuned to resist its effects, ensuring it does not hinder your own forces.

Perhaps its most extraordinary feature is its self-repairing capabilities—a resilience beyond comprehension. Even if it were to be reduced to a mere fingernail-sized remnant, the Star Forge can rebuild itself, using surrounding matter and energy to restore its former glory. Though its production capacity would be severely limited during this reconstruction, it would never cease to function, persisting regardless of its state. Left to its own devices, it could take centuries to fully reclaim its lost might, but nothing short of complete annihilation will be able to erase its existence.

A little-known aspect of this ability is its potential for adaptation and evolution. As the Star Forge reconstructs itself, it does not simply restore what was lost—it improves upon it. Over time, it strengthens its structure, enhances its systems, and refines its capabilities. If given enough time and resources, there is no limit to how far this evolution could go. Theoretically, it could one day forge entire galaxies.

Despite its advanced nature and unparalleled power, the Star Forge's automated systems are quite limited—capable of only maintaining minimal functionality required to run itself, needing a dedicated crew to unleash its full potential. Under proper command, the Star Forge can be either a force of creation or destruction, a machine of war, or one of peace and prosperity. Its fate lies in your hands.
objects.title: Star Forge (Star Wars)

addons.text:
You now have Revan & Surik's Light Side Jedi companions in your Jedi retinue, fully trained and at full influence (as if you had been their master, or they yours in Jolee's case), just like your other companions. Similarly, you may choose who you actually take.

This includes Light Side Juhani, Light Side Bastila Shan (if you already have the companion version of her, you may choose to have her distant descendant Satele Shan instead), Jolee Bindo, Mira, Handmaiden Brianna, Light Side Atton Rand, Light Side Bao Dur, & Light Side Mical.

If you also have the Followers Of Darkness addon, you may choose which variant of the variable Light Side/Dark Side characters to pick.
addons.title: Followers Of Light

addons.text:
You now have Revan & Surik's Dark Side Sith companions in your Sith retinue, fully trained and at full influence (as if you had been their master, or they yours in Kreia's case), just like your other companions. Similarly, you may choose who you actually take.

This includes Dark Side Side Juhani, Dark Side Side Bastila Shan (if you already have the companion version of her, you may choose to have her distant descendant Satele Shan instead), Kreia, Visas Marr, Dark Side Atton Rand, Dark Side Bao Dur, & Dark Side Mical.

If you also have the Followers Of Light addon, you may choose which variant of the variable Light Side/Dark Side characters to pick.
addons.title: Followers Of Darkness

objects.text:
You are now the owner of the Ebon Hawk, a highly modified Dynamic-class light freighter, with upgrades including an enhanced navicomputer (with a complete database of all non-secret locations in whatever universe you're in, as well as the ability to chart new hyperspace lanes), a Class 1 hyperdrive & sublight engines that can go 1,100 kilometers an hour in atmosphere, a military grade hull & shields, a weapons complement comparable to a corvette (including a proton torpedo launcher, two sets of front mounted quad-blasters, one dorsal & ventral turbolaser each, & a hidden ventral anti-personnel blaster cannon), smuggling compartments, easy to switch registry codes (to deceive port authorities), & a free two months of provisions for an over-staffed crew totalling 8 people.

This also includes the non-Jedi who followed Revan & Meetra Surik (though you may choose to refrain from picking any of them up), like the droids (HK-47, G0-T0, & T3-M4), Canderous Ordo (or "Mandalore The Preserver"), the Wookies (Zaalbar & Hanharr), Mission Vao, & Carth Onasi. They are effectively at max influence, as if you had journeyed with them in Revan or Surik's place.
objects.title: The Ebon Hawk (Star Wars)

addons.text:
While the X-70B was made to imitate a high-end luxury spacecraft used by the upper class, it is only natural for it to be made of inordinately expensive materials, too, right?

The hull and structure of the X-70B is now made of a combination of Beskar and Netherite, providing nigh-indestructible protection and durability. This durability is to the point that you could ram other spaceships without taking damage, and even the lightsabers of those pesky force wielders are unable to burn holes in your doors. 

The X-70B exterior remains sleek, silvery gray, now additionally accented by the darkness of Netherite.
addons.title: Beskar-Netherite Hull

objects.text:
The X-70B Phantom-Class is a prototype starship developed during the Great Galactic War by the Reconstituted Sith Empire, most prominently used by the Imperial Intelligence as mobile bases of operations.

Designed to look like a luxury civilian vessel, it is equipped with an array of advanced military-class systems, including a hyperdrive, shielding, stealth fields, and various armaments from heavy laser cannons to missiles. The X-70B Phantom also housed complex scanning systems that could monitor entire star systems and penetrate other ships without detection, allowing for detailed scans of enemy vessels, as well as an advanced communication array that allows for heavily encrypted communications across interstellar distances without any delay.

Featuring captain's quarters, crew quarters large enough to comfortably house fourteen guests, a medbay that is equipped to deal with almost anything short of a patient being dead, a cargo hold, and an escape pod, the X-70B Phantom-Class has all the creature comforts an Imperial spy could need as a mobile base of operations. Lastly, the ship comes equipped with a Seneschal-series factotum droid that is responsible for maintaining the starship and calculating hyperspace routes.
objects.title: X-70B Phantom-Class (Star Wars)

objects.text:
Several million years ago, The Ancients built hundreds of City-Ships to act as floating cities that could transport people across galaxies and act as a settlement on the surface of any planet. City Ships were the largest vessels that the ancients ever developed. Each city ship housed enough space to equal Manhattan Island. As the name implied, the Ship had a city that could accommodate thousands of passengers and more than a million tons of storage capacity. Each City-Ship provided the perfect habitat for the ancients, allowing them to live on and study the planets that they went to. The design of the ship resembles a giant snowflake that has a city built over it.

The Ship is powered by three zero-point modules (each one holds the power of a miniature universe that generates power from the energy of zero-point energy). The shields could withstand constant bombardment from dozens of spaceships meant for war for days, even with just one ZPM, and keep water from crushing the city when submerged in an ocean. The original purpose was for the ship to have a stable atmosphere during interstellar flight through space. For defense and offense, despite not being a ship of war, each Ship held large amounts of drone weapons that could easily destroy Ha’tak vessels and phase through shields.

Each ship held various rooms, such as a room that held a stargate, a room that controlled every aspect of the ship as well as a backup, and a room that housed a chair that could be used to mentally command the ship if manual controls were not enough. Laboratories that allowed for research while aboard the ship and houses massively advanced computers and equipment made by the Lanteans, such as a nanite lab, labs to research society, biology, and more, The ship possessed living quarters for the crew that were nice compared to other ships. A room that contained Puddle Jumpers, Stasis pods, Transportation elevators that could transport you across the ship, a prison, and a room that holds the knowledge of the ancients. This ship possesses sensors vastly more powerful than the ones available to a Ha’tak that could detect things lightyears away and minute things within the ship itself. The hyperdrive was capable of traveling across galaxies in seconds.
objects.title: Ancient City-Ship (Stargate)

objects.text:
You command Destiny, an Ancient ship launched over 60 million years ago. It is heavily damaged but its core systems function, barely. Five Ancient engineers are in stasis with the Master Code to unlock all systems, and will become completely loyal to you upon waking. Destiny can travel faster than light without hyperspace and has advanced sensors.

Its shields can survive inside a star, prevent time dilation at light speed, and seal hull breaches, though heavy damage weakens this. Weapons include pulse turrets across the hull and a main cannon, using self-generating ammunition. Two Ancient shuttles are mounted on the hull with space for a third, though two require repairs.

Destiny has the first Stargate with a unique nine-chevron address. It normally dials only nearby gates but can be reached from any gate with sufficient power. The ship is controlled by a neural interface chair usable only by Ancients. It is fatal to others and harmful even to their descendants.

You may choose to become an Ancient with enhanced intellect, the ATA gene, full access to use any Ancient technology, and gain knowledge equal to an average Ancient of the ship’s era. If you have chosen another race, you can retain the ability to use Ancient systems without rejection or danger. Destiny’s map updates automatically with the path of the Seed Ships, its own coordinates, and Earth’s current gate address.
objects.title: Destiny (Stargate)

objects.text:
The favorite spaceship of the Goa’uld, The Ha’tak class spaceship, was often used by system lords to enforce their rule on the empire that the false gods built. Like almost everything else built by the Goa’uld, This massive spaceship was meant as a weapon of terror instead of a weapon of war. Despite this, the Ha’tak remained an unparalleled force of power for the Goa’uld that was massively ahead of anything else the galaxy had at its disposal besides those from the four great races of the Nox, Furlings, Asgard, and the Ancients.

The standard of the Ha’tak is a Length of 700 meters and a Width of 650 meters. The standard speed of the ship in sublight engines could easily take a Ha’tak to 5% the speed of light, and a hyperdrive could propel a Ha’tak through space at around 32,000 times the speed of light. While it would not be able to make a trip from galaxy to galaxy under normal circumstances, taking around 125 years if done so, under special circumstances you could enhance the speed of the hyperdrive. The ship was also outfitted with Shields that could tank a nuclear warhead that had been enhanced with around 1,000 megaton yields but had no apparent effect. Later designs of Ha’tak vessels could take weapons fire from Asgard ships that are vastly more powerful than the previous nuclear weapon. The Weapons possessed by a Ha’tak were around 60 Staff Cannons that could provide orbital bombardment, decimate countries, and, with enough fire, eventually destroy a planet. Later weapons could destroy a planet with fewer bombardments.

Ha'taks also had several complementary systems, such as communications that provided communicators over interstellar distances, highly advanced Sensors that could pick things up over long distances many lightyears away and just as strong closer to the ship, Transportation devices, and Cloaking devices capable of tricking most sensors. Standard rooms included the Pel'tak (the bridge), Engine rooms, Computer Cores, Glider bays that housed twelve wings of Death Gliders and three Al'kesh bombers, along with various rooms to house over 2,000 Jaffa and around 700,000 tons of cargo.
objects.title: Ha'tak-Class Spaceship (Stargate)

objects.text:
The Puddle Jumper is a highly advanced, compact spacecraft originally designed by the Ancients capable of passing through Stargates. 

The Jumper is flown through thought-controlled neural interfacing, allowing seamless maneuvering with no need for physical controls, requiring the Ancient Technology Activation (ATA), which you are granted upon purchase if you don't already possess it, along with a dozen vials of ATA gene therapy to share with your allies. It is capable of both atmospheric and space flight, fast enough to reach from one end of the solar system to the other in 15 hours. Its cloaking generator renders it entirely invisible to both sensors and the naked eye and has been modified so that the same cloaking generator can be reconfigured into an energy shield, strong enough to withstand immense pressures—including deep ocean crush depths and even a direct hit from a Lantean drone weapon. This defense comes at a steep cost to power, and the Jumper can only sustain either the cloak or the shield—not both at once. It's weapon system consists of 12 Drone weapons that are housed in the two weapon pods located on both sides, these drones have the ability to bypass certain types of shields, including those of a Goa'uld Ha'tak.   

This Jumper includes a Mark II Naquadah generator as an auxiliary power source, giving you longer operational time. The interior also includes a robust loadout of modern equipment: food, medicine, tools, laptops, and survival gear stored in netted compartments and sealed packs. You’ll find FN P90s, M4 carbines, M249 SAWs, Beretta pistols, and even AT4 rocket launchers mounted beside the rear hatch. There are also tactical vests and enough gear to support an off-world team under hostile conditions. In the event of mechanical failure, the ship carries enough tools and replacement components to allow for basic field repair.
objects.title: Puddle Jumper (Stargate)

objects.text:
The Al'kesh, like most Goa'uld vessels, features a pyramidal shape measuring approximately 35 meters in length and 15 meters in height/depth. Two large wings extend from the base and curve forward toward the cockpit at the bow of the ship. The Al'kesh is capable of subluminal travel thanks to four engine nacelles mounted at the rear, in addition to a hyperdrive for interstellar travel.

The bridge contains a central control station and two pilot seats, one of which includes a spherical control interface. Its overall capabilities and systems are half as powerful and efficient as those of a standard Ha'Tak.

It is equipped with two staff cannons mounted on a pivoting ventral turret. It can also deploy plasma charges from the same underside, powerful enough to penetrate and collapse a mountain. Its weaponry surpasses that of a Death Glider, and it is heavily armored, falling short only in maneuverability. Its shields are capable of withstanding a couple of non-nuclear missiles or roughly a dozen hits from a Death Glider.

The vessel also possesses a cloaking device sufficient to evade most sensory detection systems, including those of a Ha'Tak. However, superior sensor technologies such as those of the Ancients, Asgard, and similar civilizations can still detect it. It is commonly used for planetary defense suppression, as a mobile outpost, for planetary orbital offense/defense, space patrol, and even troop and cargo transport. It can accommodate up to 64 crew members, requiring a minimum of two pilots to operate effectively.

It is equipped with a pair of standard transport rings (8 meters in diameter), one large transport ring triple the normal size, and an Asgard transporter an advanced teleportation technology. All are located in a spacious chamber that can also function as storage. The cargo bay provides 84 square meters of space with a capacity of 384 tons of cargo.
objects.title: Al'kesh (Stargate)

addons.text: With your Nanoforge installed in the Cryosleeper, your ship changed from a mere glorified passenger hauler to a capable colony ship - if barely. Your ship now comes installed with a handful of simple manufactury facilities, able to print simple colonial equipment, such as pre-fab houses, electrical vehicles, drilling machines, etc. Though you still have to gather resources to feed the facilities, this will greatly speed the process to create a sustainable colony and awaken your colonists.
addons.title: Improvised Colony Ship

objects.text:
A large cylinder over ten kilometers in length and half as large, the Cryosleeper was tasked with transplanting colonists from one star system to another. Holding over two dozen million passengers in cryogenic sleep (actually a mix of cryogenics and inertia manipulation, but details), it can remain frozen for at least a hundred years before problems start to arise. Equipped with a powerful Alcubierre drive, it can travel a dozen light years per year, allowing for a safe range of 1200 light years of travel. The ship could theoretically land in a gravity weel, but wouldn't be able to leave afterwards. 

While the ship comes with a sizable section that can hold a crew of a thousand and the facilities to accommodate them for the whole voyage, the only other thing of note in the ship is a revival facility, able to bring about a thousand sleepers back to life in a day.
