Most of the ship is storage space for the sleepers, with vast berths to hold them and the service corridors where servitors travel through to maintain the ship and move the cryosleepers for awakening. You receive a schematic on how to build more awakening facilities to speed up the awakening process. 

The colonists composition can be anything you want, from a balanced mix to start a new civilization to exclusively soldiers or scientists. While they do not harbour any supernatural loyalty towards you, all of them are on board with your initial plans for the population and accept you as their leader, as if they signed to join your endeavour. Retaining their loyalty is completely up to you.
objects.title: Cryosleeper Ship (Starsector)

addons.text: Your Nanoforge can integrate with the ship manufacturing system. Now beyond producing more ammo and the occasional parts for repairs, you production capabilities multiply. At full capacity, you could produce another Onslaught every month, thought you would still need to acquire the schematics of it.
addons.title: Expanded Assembly System

addons.text: Your ship now host an Alpha core. Capable of micromanaging an entire planet logistics, this AI when installed on your ship could run it by itself perfectly, while also reducing maintenance cost, create an energy surplus, improve repair speed and boost overhaul manufacturing speed five fold. It could run the ship by itself, thought you can still have your crew if you wish. Is naturally loyal to you, and so long you don’t shove it in a dark room to be forgotten, it would be fine with being installed somewhere else.
addons.title: Complimentary Alpha Core AI

objects.text:
Once serving as the enforcers of the Domain of Man, the Onslaught is a secular war machine that outclasses many modern ships to this day.

With a heavy load of ballistic turrets, missile silos, and a pair of frontal high-yield thermal pulse cannons, the Onslaught can deliver a heavy barrage of damage. Naturally, it can receive its fair share of punishment as well. Its kilometres-long hull is covered by a thick armour and a reinforced hull frame, allowing it to receive heavy damage before combat readiness decreases.

Its main method of transport is the Traverse Drive, allowing it to access a Hyperspace where distance is different, allowing it to travel a light-year in a day.

Due to its sheer size, it is a relatively slow ship and has a high maintenance cost. And though it was adapted to have an energy shield, its original design didn't have one in mind, reducing its efficacy and being able to project it only around half of the ship at a time.

Your ship comes fully supplied and with a fully trained and loyal crew. It also has an experimental generator that creates energy ex nihilo, allowing for an endless sustained burn.
objects.title: Onslaught (Starsector)

objects.text: It seems the Mario Kart gods have blessed you with their perfect chariot. This kart, at base being Mario's World kart design, has a 200cc engine, although this can of course be upgraded to higher levels of horsepower if you are sufficiently knowledgeable. It also has the capability of Anti-Gravity wheels and systems, while also having an innate ability to Parkour if handled in the right way. Parachutes and gliders can emerge from the kart to give you the ability to glide down from immense heights, with an insane amount of midair handling making it almost idiot proof. But one of the biggest benefits of this kart is how when you drive it, it will occasionally put Mario Kart items in front of you to drive through and use. The only drawback is that you cannot select what you get, the only form of influence for you being if in your current situation, you are doing good, which will give you bananas to always slip up your opponent on contact or coins which can increase your kart's top speed once 10 are in your possession, or bad, with a blue shell that will always at least stun your opponent or possibly even defeat them depending on your strength gap and a Starman for temporary invincibility and speed boosts. Finally, you can customize the kart from any and all parts in the series, the kart overall being very durable and... possibly indestructible by most normal forces on Earth. It's also assisted by the fact that the Kart is all terrain.
objects.title: Super Mario Kart (Super Mario)

objects.text:
From the outside this shop looks like an ordinary red van. If you step inside you’ll find a seemingly endless, shifting space of winding corridors and floors, filled to the brim with strange wares.

The Awesome Store sells every sort of cursed artifact imaginable, from a universal TV remote that can manipulate the universe to a magic lamp that makes anything the holder wishes for become real, a computer that can rewrite anything, a knockoff game console that transports the user into the game, the Evil Turtle, a snow globe that causes winter, and far more. These are generally unpredictable and often dangerous to the user, but if you know what you’re doing the risk can be mitigated. There are also more mundane offerings like military grade fireworks, a doctor’s license, or a mounted swordfish. There’s no clear organization or labelling on any items in the store.

The store’s stock will be replenished by mysterious means so that you never run out of items. The van can be destroyed, but it will reappear unharmed and fully-stocked shortly afterwards. You will possess an intuitive sense for the effect and rules of each item in your store so you know how to use them safely and what cryptic warnings to give your customers.

If you grow tired of running the store you may pass it on to another, giving them the benefits of being the owner of The Awesome Store. The process is as simple as declaring them the owner, because your operation is very illegal so there’s no paperwork. Since you paid SP for it, you’ll be allowed to take the store back at anytime if you decide to leave retirement.
objects.title: The Awesome Store (The Amazing World of Gumball)

objects.text: ”It’s a magic carpet on a rail, never takes a rest! Flying through the mountains and the snow! You can ride for free and join the fun, if you just say ‘Yes!’ ’Cause that’s the way things happen on the Polar Express!” Welcome, Dreamer, to the Polar Express! The most magical train in the world! Only officially appearing once a year to children across the world, offering a round trip to the North Pole, this locomotive is something of a holiday myth. Now, it lands in your care, always ready to rekindle the spark of hope and joy in the hearts of all. Along with the hard-working beauty herself, you receive a set of our conductor’s outfit and a functioning replica of his watch. Our lovely locomotive includes our Conductor, a group of waiters to assist in serving refreshments, and our fireman and engineer duo who maintain and operate the train. The Polar Express, as previously stated, is magical. She generates magical energy passively, but generates much more as she speeds up. She uses this energy to manifest tracks for her to use to traverse the environment, allowing her to go where no train should have any right to be. But there’s more to it. Not only does she use this to travel, but she also has Time Magic! Now, this ability isn’t fully stopping time, rather the magic slows it to a crawl, while keeping anything inside of it unaffected. The only ‘downside’ of this magic is that the Polar Express must be perpetually moving at least half of her maximum speed to meet the upkeep for the magic. If she stays in one place for too long or slows down enough, then the effect will begin to fade and (if the effect fully dissipates) will have to be reapplied again by having her speed up to 88 mph (142 kph), which stresses her out quite a bit. Magical energy made from higher speeds than what is needed to maintain the effect can be used to counter the erosion of the Time Magic, allowing you to stop for a bit so that passengers can board or exit. The watch you’ll receive keeps track of the Time Magic and compares the erosion of the Time Magic’s effect to your current destination on a scale of ‘Late’, ‘On-Time’, and ‘Early’. If the effect will wear off before you reach your destination (or if you simply need to speed up), the watch’s hand will start leaning towards ‘Late’ to tell you to get a move on. If the Polar Express remains consistent or even outdoes herself, the hand will move towards ‘On-Time’ or ‘Early’. Provided that you stay ‘On-Time’ for the whole trip, the Time Magic should ensure that a round trip (As in ‘Point A to B, then back to A’, including any boarding passengers) should take about 5 minutes or so in real time.
objects.title: The Polar Express (The Polar Express)

objects.text:
The main battle horse for a pilot, an imposing and robust mechanical marvel equipped with an extensive array of tactical systems and formidable weaponry. It seamlessly integrates with its pilot, establishing a natural connection that allows for flawless communication and coordination, even across dimensional distances. Standing at an impressive height of 20 feet, the titan combines its immense stature with exceptional agility, enabling it to sprint and sidestep with remarkable dexterity.

The titan's arsenal encompasses highly destructive weaponry, energy shields, and magnetic fields capable of intercepting incoming projectiles and redirecting them towards the assailant. This comprehensive suite of offensive and defensive versatility positions the titan as the ultimate embodiment of both protection and attack. The titan can operates autonomously, requiring no hand on piloting due to its advanced AI, has no need for external energy sources to operate, and seemingly possesses limitless ammunition to sustain its devastating onslaught.

You can customize the appearance of your titan and once bonded with it, the titan becomes an unwavering ally, responding exclusively to the pilot's commands and faithfully executing them. As an extra bonus, the cockpit that enables you to assume full control of the titan, has exceptionally comfortable seating arrangement. So kick back and relax as you venture out together with your unstoppable killing machine.
objects.title: Titan (Titanfall)

objects.text:
A marvel of alien engineering and esoteric power, the Transtector is a fully functional Transformer body—mechanized, adaptable, and entirely devoid of an independent Spark. Unlike living Cybertronians, a Transtector is inert without a pilot or core consciousness to animate it. Upon acquisition, you are granted full synchronization with the Transtector via a neural uplink and a interface armor.

You may customize your Transtector completely. Choose its robot form's gender (male, female, or neutral), its personality traits (if any), and its alt-mode, which can be as mundane or fantastical as your setting allows: car, jet, tank, motorcycle, wolf, dragon, train, spaceship, submarine, or even be a triple-changer.

Though non-sentient by default, the Transtector operates with near-instinctual responsiveness, mirroring your will as if it were an extension of your own body. It is forged from adaptive Cybertronian alloys, self-repairing over time and immune to most forms of EMP, corruption, or hacking unless allowed by you. It boasts full mobility, integrated flight systems (if appropriate), strength rivaling Prime-tier Transformers, and access to a customizable weapons loadout—plasma cannons, melee weapons, missiles, sonic disruptors, null rays, energy shields, etc.

More than a simple mech, the Transtector integrates with your existing powers. If you wield magic, psionics, or any other type of power, the Transtector will harmonize with them, amplifying your power through its structure.

If you possess a AI you may choose to allow it to inhabit the Transtector independently, granting it a semi-sentient or fully sapient identity of its own. In this case, the Transtector develops a true Spark and can act independently while retaining loyalty to you. If not granted independence, it remains entirely under your control—obedient, unwavering, and deadly.
objects.title: Transtector (Transformers)

objects.text:
Taken from the bones of the Nautilus, fused with Triton’s power whilst being constructed using Hephaestus Kilironomia, the Dimensional Boundary Perforation Vessel: Storm Border is a ship utilized as the base of operations for Chaldea during the Lostbelt Crisis.

Larger than a modern nuclear submarine, this houses everything the security organisation may need in its mission to save Human Order. This includes the Shadow Border, a twelve-wheeled armoured vehicle strengthened through modern and Conceptual Magecraft, or the Human Order Foundation Display to measure how deviated the timeline is from proper human history.

Even if the path is blocked by land, the storm border may fly in the air using six Triton engines powered by the imaginary numbers dimension. In addition to this, the Storm Border is armed with both magically enhanced torpedoes and Hume-Barrel, which uses Excalibur’s light as ammunition to damage powerful foes.

But the main objective of the Storm Border is to travel through different dimensions. Any dimension you wish to travel into is now open to you through this submarine’s abilities, as long as the dimension isn't warded against your specific mode of dimensional breaching.

Vessels of this size cannot be operated alone. Therefore, you get a complement of copies of Captain Nemo to run every system found within. While these copies are technically Servants, their combat ability is minimal.
objects.title: Storm Border (Type-Moon)

addons.text:
It seems the computational abilities have been updated by the Perfect Computer, surpassing even The Moon Cell itself.

With such a massive upgrade, any other Magecraft you have is now cast at the EX level while sitting on the chair, though you're still limited by the amount of mana you have. Along with that, your ever faithful AI is now a Pseudo-Spiritron, allowing it to act autonomously though still as loyal as it was before. It may be manifested as a Supreme Mystic Code through Throne Creation, creating its own body.

The throne has also inherited the soulbound properties, allowing access to it no matter the circumstances. Though you’d still have to be physically sitting on the Throne to use its non-computer abilities such as the skill Throne Creation.

As an added bonus, you may summon more than bobas along with snacks. The peripherals including the Throne itself may also be changed to any brand or model, even allowing multiple monitors. Also, new functions may also be added for comfort as long as they are purely for comfort.

-# Note: It still retains its abilities from before so yes, it can be a flying office chair.
addons.title: Throne of Greater YHWH

objects.text:
You possess the Throne of Lesser YHWH, or the Throne of Metatron. Even after the Archangel of Sloth Metatron modified this Throne into a gaming chair, it remains worthy of being placed next to God's own Throne.

As a gaming chair, it has an in-built all-in-one computer with truly mind-boggling specs and performance rivalling that of the Moon Cell while taking up barely a millionth of its size.

This computer, like the strongest of Incarnated Gods, is unbound by the time axis and can treat spatial or dimensional bounds as suggestions, leaving it capable of connecting to the wifi of any time period, world, or dimension, regardless of where and when it is.

This throne also imbues those who sit on it with the skill of [Throne Creation] at the EX rank. As a higher form of Territory Creation, it allows you to alter the properties of the surroundings, like creating near-impenetrable barriers, altering natural or metaphysical laws, buffing or weakening those within its range, or creating temporary pocket dimensions.

The chair itself is capable of teleportation and flight, allowing you to use it as a vehicle for transportation, and it is incredibly comfortable, having an in-built massager and heating. 

This throne also comes with the corresponding peripherals, such as a keyboard, mouse, headset, and even a smartphone, as well as a limitless supply of boba tea.
objects.title: Throne of Lesser YHWH (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
You now have in your possession one of the greatest war machines ever made, a walking fortress capable of single-handedly ending a city. Its most notable trait is its immense size, large enough that it houses an entire city upon its back that’s fully liveable and capable of supporting thousands of people.
 
Along with its size are its methods of attack and defence, the most vital being the lightning spear, a gigantic cannon that can fire blasts of lightning strong enough to reduce cities to rubble. The main method of defence the Earthmover holds is the onboard shield generator that’s durable enough to take hundreds of shots from its own lightning spear without so much as a crack. The Earthmover also has access to several methods to defend itself; if an attacker manages to get onto it, it has a small army of machines within it that act like antibodies with various purposes, a sniper capable of firing high-calibre rounds from immense distances with high accuracy, robots that are more akin to bipedal tanks than anything else, and many more. The Earthmover has a dedicated defence system to defend the entrance to its inside.

Despite it all, this avatar of destruction has one weak point, its brain, yet even then destroying the brain is no easy feat as it has a series of lasers and mortars as well as a barrier protecting its brain. In the unlikely event that the brain is destroyed, the Earthmover has a last resort; it will initiate a self-destruct sequence that, after a countdown, will obliterate the machine and any unfortunate soul still inside.

The Earthmover runs on blood and solar power; the machines inside run on just blood. You start off with a blood supply to fuel the Earthmover and its robotic defenders for around a decade in order to give you enough time to get a steady or alternate power supply.
objects.title: 1000-THR "Earthmover" (ULTRAKILL)

objects.text: You gain the five Voltron Lions that combine to form the legendary robot guardian. The Lions have an affinity for specific elements, powerful claws capable of rending steel, a laser hidden in their tails, thrusters along their back legs and paws, various cannons, and a measure of intelligence. The Black Lion forms the head and torso of Voltron and has an affinity for the element of sky. Its wing thrusters give it the ability to fly at high speeds and phase through matter. Those same wings transform into Voltron’s shield when necessary. The Blue Lion is the right leg of Voltron, with an affinity for the element of water. It is designed for enhanced mobility and speed underwater and built to withstand higher pressures. Its mouth contains a freeze ray, and it has sonic cannons mounted on its back. The Red Lion is the right arm of Voltron, with an affinity for the element of fire. It is designed to endure much higher temperatures, with its mouth containing a heat ray capable of melting metal, and its back bearing powerful plasma cannons. The Yellow Lion is the left leg of Voltron, with an affinity for the element of land. It has larger, more powerful claws, enhanced strength, and greater stability on hazardous terrain. The Green Lion is the left arm of Voltron, with an affinity for the element of forest. It holds a vine cannon on its back capable of rapidly growing plants and is equipped with a cloaking device that can render it invisible. As the “owner” of the Voltron Lions, all of the Lions acknowledge you and would allow you—or anyone else of your choosing—to become their Paladin. Paladins gain their own uniform: a black spacesuit with white armor plates accented with the colors of their Lion. The suit comes with high-speed data links capable of connecting to any network, a self-contained independent air supply, computer systems, energy shields, and a jetpack. Each Paladin is equipped with a Bayard—a device that summons a weapon designed to suit the wielder. With practice, you can cause the Bayard to take the form of other weapons instead. The Bayards can be used in conjunction with a Lion to manifest weapons for Voltron, with more Bayards resulting in greater, more powerful weapons.
objects.title: Lions of Voltron (Voltron: Legendary Defender)

addons.title: Arsenal
addons.text:
In addition to the Foundry’s more mundane uses, you can now use it to build Warframes which can then be stored in your Arsenal (though you will still need to gather the necessary resources). While you can still only pilot one Warframe at a time, this does allow you to hold a vastly greater selection. 

In addition to these new frames, your Foundry now has blueprints for additional devices that can aide your Warframe, such as the Archwing, a personal spaceflight device, or the Nechromech, a precursor to the warframe that’s vastly more heavily armed and armoured, but far more cumbersome. Your Infirmary likewise has access to their schematics, allowing it to completely subsume warframes in order to graft their abilities onto others.

addons.title: Cephalon
addons.text:
Your Orbiter has been outfitted with a Ship Cephalon. A form of uploaded intelligence, Cephalons are incredibly intense computational systems that are innately connected to the ‘cephalon weave’ a kind of supernetwork that allows all cephalons to piggyback off the other’s processes.

Ship cephalons are not only perfectly situated to control all of your orbiter’s systems but adapt on the fly like any other sentient being completely dedicated to serving the ship and you as its operator. This allows the Orbiter to be vastly more efficient and to act on your commands without you physically being at its controls as the cephalon commands its systems.

Cephalons are notably more stable than NHPs, and can shoulder exceptional data loads, even if they will begin to show quirks after a few hundred years with little maintenance.

objects.text:
You’ve been given an Orbiter, a biotechnological spacecraft fitted with all the amenities you could want. 

The bridge is simple, with multiple screens tracking your whereabouts and history, a codex of things you’ve encountered, relevant news, contacts, and a live link to any relevant markets in your current solar system. This is also where the Star Chart is located, directly before the primary window to the outside, from which you can plan your journey and administrate certain tasks.

In addition, the orbiter contains; some highly customisable and luxurious personal quarters, a personal foundry (a fabricator capable of manufacturing virtually anything as long as you possess the blueprints necessary to do so), the Mod and Arcane Workbenches, which can adjust and enhance equipment you possess when supplied with funds and material, an arsenal to contain your equipment. There’s also a small ‘incubator’ tank capable of incubating and growing animal companions.

The infirmary meanwhile is more strange. Covered in fleshy tendrils of Helminth, the ‘Infirmary’ is more than a place to heal, it’s capable of autonomously completing intensive and esoteric surgeries, going so far as to be able to dismember and graft the abilities of different creatures together, akin to one of bonesaw’s chimeras.

As the Orbiter itself was never built to land, it comes with two smaller vehicles, a small landing craft, and a ‘Railjack’. In addition to being a well made, armed, and heavily armoured machine, the Lander comes with a singular accommodation that’s so deeply inbuilt it would need a full refit in order to change. This range from enhanced scanners to deployable mass sedatives, to even deploying a squad of mundane marines. 

The Railjack meanwhile is an interceptor designed for space combat, with a higher cargo capacity than the Orbiter, it’s capable of containing five people all in various stations from weapons to engines and a pilot. This comes with various amenities, such as an ‘Omni’ to put out fires and seal hull breaches. Additionally, the railjack, unlike the Orbiter itself, is theoretically capable of long-distance interplanetary travel under its own power, though it would be highly dangerous as this relies on the ‘reliquary drive’, a device holding the severed finger of a godlike void entity.
objects.title: Orbiter (Warframe)

objects.text:
You have gained possession of an Imperial Knight of a design of your choice, be that Questoris, Dominus, Cerastus, Arcastus or more under the Knight classification. 

Up to roughly 12 meters tall, possessed of powerful defensive Ion Shields, and various arrays of weaponry, a Knight is more akin to a CAT Excavator retrofitted into a weapon of incredible violence. An elegantly gilded status symbol as much as a weapon of war, Knights have been known to wipe entire regiments from the face of a battle swiftly and singlehandedly.

Each Knight has within it a Throne Mechanicus, acting as its control centre, but also housing a Machine Spirit (usually composed of its base principles and the echoes of the Knight’s former pilots) which the pilot has to deal with and wrangle in order to pilot with key efficiency.
objects.title: Knight (Warhammer: 40k)

addons.text: You are no longer limited to the ships available to the Imperium generally, and you may now choose any kind of voidship available to the Adeptus Mechanicus or the Leagues of Votann, including Explorator vessels. Its crew may include far more advanced members of the Tech-Adepts such as Magi or Archmagi, as well as being automated to a far greater degree than standard Imperial vessels.
addons.title: Basilikon Astra

addons.text: You may now choose any voidship used by the T'au military or merchant marine, and its crew can include any combination of species present in the T'au Empire or Farsight Enclaves.
addons.title: Air Caste

addons.text: Youz can make da ship any ship wot da boyz use if'n it be an Ork ship and not a Krork ship, and yer krew can have any group of Greenskins wot you fancy (again, as long as dey don't be Krorks).
addons.title: Freebootaz

addons.text:
The crew of your Voidship is now made up entirely of T-Dolls, who hold all positions and specialties aboard the ship, from cook to shuttle and fighter pilots, landing party and captain. They all benefit from all the enhancements and addons of the T-Dolls branch. 

If you have Upgrades for T-Doll Army (Girls Frontline) and Upgrades of Dummy Dolls (Girls Frontline), you can additionally get additional ships related to Navis Imperialis or available to any other privateer (particularly Rogue Trader), but only if you recruit the required number of crews from T-Dolls and Dummy Dolls.

A Lunar-class Cruiser will require ≈ 95,000 T-Dolls or Dummy Dolls (that's about 2000 T-Dolls SHOC if you buy the maximum number of Dummy Dolls).

All T-Dolls can be armed and equipped to Navis Imperialis standards, unless they have much better armament and equipment. All T-Dolls will receive appropriate programming for their roles and positions on board.
addons.title: Dolls: Navis Imperialis

objects.text:
You now possess a single vessel equal to those found in the Emperor's mighty voidfleet. This vessel may be any vessel available to either the core Imperial Navy or any vessel available to private citizens of the Imperium such as Rogue Traders, Nobles, or the Navigator Houses.

The vessels are generally manned by enormous crews, often numbering in the thousands. It is for this reason that a bigger vessel is not necessarily better; more crew means more mouths to feed and more mutineers if you fail in this task. As an addendum to that point, while the menials can of course be replaced with perfectly loyal Servitors or made largely redundant with things like Macrocannon autoloaders, the ship also requires a large officer corps to direct them, a large Tech-Priest corps for the operation of the vessel, & numerous Psykers for both the Astropathic Choir & The Navigator's Throne, none of which can really be automated away with the technology generally available on such vessels. These ones have a sterling personal loyalty to you.

If you wish, you can have the companions & crew of the von Valancius Rogue Trader or the officers from Battlefleet Gothic become members of the crew.
objects.title: Voidship (Warhammer: 40k)

objects.text:
A relic of the Ancients, the Incorruptus is not merely armor but a living weapon of war, bound to its wielder through the Pact System. When invoked through its Ark, the Pactmaker is enveloped and transformed into the colossal seven-meter form of the Knight, their body and soul merged with the construct. This bond makes the Incorruptus an extension of its master’s will, capable of unleashing power far beyond mortal limits.

In battle, the Incorruptus grants overwhelming strength, speed, and endurance. Wielding arcane-forged weapons of impossible scale, it can deliver strikes that shatter fortifications and scatter armies. Each Knight bears unique gifts—some unleashing torrents of fire or light, others channeling healing energy, elemental fury, or even the power of flight. Its armor is forged from ancient magics, resisting destruction and sustaining its form through regenerative enchantments. Against conventional arms, an Incorruptus is virtually indestructible, able to endure battles that would devastate entire cities.

Yet this power is inseparable from its cost. The Pact demands absolute unity between Knight and Pactmaker, fusing their minds so completely that the wielder often hears the voice of the Incorruptus within their thoughts. Prolonged use strains both body and soul, with each transformation risking collapse under the immense burden of its energy if not allowed to rest. 

The bond itself is unbreakable save through death.
objects.title: Incorruptus (White Knight Chronicles)

objects.text:
You come into possession of a modern Vinean shuttle and its supporting equipment. This craft is 40 meters long, with a tube-shaped forward section, which houses the cockpit, passenger, and cargo compartments, and a triangular rear section, with a wing span of 35 meters, where the technical bay, engines, and smaller crafts are housed.

The shuttle is capable of atmospheric flight at hypersonic speeds and the engines can provide enough trust to reach a stable orbit in minutes. The auxiliary thrusters enable vertical take-off and landing as well as precise orbital maneuvers. The engines consume a special, highly efficient, cryogenic fuel stored in spherical tanks in the engine bay; this shuttle is equipped with a fuel converter that can crack conventional hydrocarbons and biomatter into the appropriate mixture.

The shuttle is also equipped with two built-in photonic engines that allows transit at up to 10% of the speed of light; for long-distance inter-planetary travel, the shuttle can dock with an auxiliary module equipped with one large photon engine, which enables travel up to near light speed. However, you are not exempt from the laws of physics, any time spent accelerating must also be spent decelerating, and faster than light travel is impossible. The exotic fuel for these engines is stored in spherical magnetic containment tanks directly before them and can be synthesized while in orbit or during a sunny day on the ground.

This shuttle is also designed for aquatic environments, where special turbines and jets allow it to maneuver with ease; the reinforced hull can easily withstand very high depths and other high-pressure environments like the surface of a gas giant.

The shuttle is equipped with advanced avionics and the flight computer can easily plot and execute take-off and landing, complex docking maneuvers, and inter-planetary transit autonomously. It is also equipped with two forward disintegrator canons under the cockpit, in case you need to drill through a stubborn bulkhead or intercept a fleeing probe. There is, however, no in-flight entertainment system, so pack your own books or Walkman if you need some distractions. The shuttle's systems are powered by the on-board reactor, which consumes the same exotic fuel as the photon engines, and is equipped with large batteries; both can be tapped to power other systems through several ports inside and outside the craft.

Lastly, the shuttle is furnished with enough space suits for a full crew complement, and it is highly recommended you wear them in case of emergency, a case of portable disintegrators for maintenance work and in case "negotiations" are required, a case of headbands that function as universal Vinean translators and enable short-range telepathic communication, as well as other necessities. The technical bay hosts eight magnetic stasis tubes, one two-seat "dragonfly" atmospheric hovercraft, one two-seat "spider" orbital shuttle, and two manipulator spheres.
objects.title: Vinean Shuttle (Yoko Tsuno)

addons.text:
Your Zoid isn't coming alone—it also brings its very own Organoid, which will be linked to your Inner Beast or Omnitool, allowing them to manifest through it.

The Organoid System is a special device implanted in certain Zoids, like yours. It takes the form of a special egg or embryo that is inserted into the Zoid Core, significantly enhancing its combat capabilities.

In addition to boosting your Zoid's abilities, Organoids can alter the Zoid's shape and size. They can even resurrect a destroyed Zoid, repairing and maintaining it in top condition at all times.

Organoids also have flight capabilities and can carry passengers inside their body, which is useful if you need to escape danger. And not only that: your Organoid also functions as a data storage device, with information that will be released into your mind when you enter its body!
addons.title: Organoid System

objects.text:
"I am a transporter of the wasteland; I drive my buddy, the Gustav, through the desert land!"

You acquire a Zoid, a mechanical creature of advanced technology from the planet Zi, powered by a Zoid Core, which serves as the Zoid’s heart and brain.

With so many different Zoids to choose from—each offering unique classes, designs, and abilities—you’re sure to find one that perfectly suits your style.

Take the Blade Liger (RZ-028) as an example. This impressive lion-type Zoid stands 12.2 meters tall and weighs 124 tons. Designed for extreme speed and agility, it reaches a maximum speed of 305 km/h. Its advanced weaponry includes Laser Blades, Strike Claws, Laser Sabers, AZ Double-Barreled Shock Cannon, and Pulse Laser Guns, making it a formidable opponent in battle. Additionally, the Blade Liger is equipped with E-Shield Generators, Completion Refrigerators, Multi-Blade Antennas, 3D Dual Sensors, and Rocket Boosters—ensuring exceptional performance on the battlefield. Its Rear Thrusters provide additional mobility, making it even deadlier in fast-paced, strategic encounters.

The Blade Liger is just one of over 200 different bio-mechanical creatures that make up the diverse world of Zoids in the TOMY franchise.

Do you prefer speed and agility, dodging attacks as you go? Or would you rather dominate the battlefield with overwhelming firepower and defense? Or perhaps, like Moonbay, cruise the wasteland with your trusty Gustav? Choose your Zoid and get ready: the day has come when a new world of adventures awaits you!
objects.title: Zoic Androids (Zoids)

rows.title: Vehicle Objects of Power
rows.titleText: Note: All non-consumable Objects of Powers can be transferred to another person. When this happens, you do not lose any abilities the object unlocked or awakened (physical alterations, magic independent of the object, etc.) but any soul bonds transferred to the new owner.

objects.text:
You are now the proud owner of the 221 Baker Street, this lodging house is split roughly into four areas across three floors.

The ground floor contains 221A Baker Street and the lobby area. 221A Baker Street is a one bedroom flat occupying roughly two thirds of this floor, it is lightly furnished and may be rented out or used for other purposes at your leisure. The lobby takes up the rest of the ground floor, this may either be a waiting area for potential clients or a small store front such as a sandwich shop that doubles as one. In the case of it being a store front, you may have 221A Baker Street come with a renter that runs it.

The third area is 221B Baker Street, it is the second flat in the building, more importantly it is the place where mysteries come to be solved. 221B Baker Street is a two bedroom flat, the majority of it occupying the first floor of the building, except the second bedroom which is on the second floor. The last area is simply a large storage space taking up the rest of the second floor.

The living room of 221B Baker Street has various bits of technology and substance that are useful in solving mysteries strewn around it, there is also a bookcase containing books on a multitude of topics, from forensics, to music and even boxing. There is a desk holding either a typewriter or some form of computer, as you solve mysteries this device will automatically type out manuscripts of your adventures.

Whenever you're trying to solve a mystery, relevant information just seems to turn up at this building. A newspaper could arrive with a lead even if you aren't subscribed to any, the TV might randomly turn on to a relevant news broadcast, or maybe you could walk out the front door and get hit in the face by flyer. These won't directly solve cases for you, but they are bound to be leads in the right direction.
objects.title: 221 Baker Street

addons.text:
The Miracle Candle has touched the heart of your bakery, whose own magic absorbs and channels part of the Candle’s Miracle, thus awakening a kind and protective spirit that animates the building as if it were alive.

The bakery’s spirit can subtly reorganize the interior space according to the needs of the moment: expanding the workspace when the oven is full, creating cozy corners for customers, or facilitating movement during the busiest hours, while assisting with daily tasks, keeping the place clean, tidy, and running with near-magical efficiency.

In addition, your bakery will also gain a protection that prevents evil from taking root within the place; this protection is neither aggressive nor punitive, it simply ensures that anyone entering the bakery with malicious, violent, or harmful intentions will immediately feel uncomfortable—their thoughts will become clouded, the environment will feel oppressive, and, without knowing exactly why, they will be compelled to leave before causing any harm.

Finally, thanks to the influence of the Miracle Candle, hidden rooms begin to manifest, linked to the nature of the bakery, which appear gradually and always in response to a real need; these can include impossibly large storage rooms, cozy tea rooms or cafés where time seems to flow more gently, or kitchens that magically adapt to the user, adjusting tools, surfaces, and layout to facilitate their work.

As long as harmony reigns within your family, the bakery will thrive without economic crises; the spirit will remain strong, the magic stable, and the place will continue to be a safe refuge, filled with sweet aromas, warmth, and small everyday miracles.

Note: If you own the Sweet Home add-on "Hearthfire", then the Miracle Candle will combine with both Sweet Home and the Bakery of Delights, resulting in the number of Guest Houses active at the same time being multiplied by 5, and you can optionally choose for Bakeries of Delights to appear instead of Guest Houses.
addons.title: Delightful Little Miracles

addons.text:
"Run, run, as fast as you can, you can't catch me, I'm the Gingerbread Man!"

The magic of your Bakery of Delights now responds not only to the heat of the oven and the aroma of freshly baked bread, but also to your culinary talent, allowing you to bake gingerbread figures that come to life as they emerge from the oven.

Each figure possesses its own personality, shaped by the nuances of the spices and the care with which it was made; some are cheerful and helpful, others curious and slightly mischievous, but all share a deep connection to the bakery that gave them life, which also recognizes them as part of its essence and gently guides them, preventing their enthusiasm from causing major mishaps.

These gingerbread figures will move freely throughout the establishment and can assist with simple tasks such as setting tables, carrying light ingredients, or decorating products with surprising precision; moreover, you can keep multiple figures active at the same time, although their number will depend on your dedication and practice, and if they are damaged or consumed, they can be rebaked at no additional cost beyond the basic ingredients.

Over time and with experience, your kitchen will be able to create much more than simple gingerbread figures: from sweet living creatures inspired by cakes and desserts—think something like a Dachsbun or an Alcremie from Pokémon—to actual gingerbread houses for people to live in; you could even go as far as giving your creations specialized themes or classes for specific tasks within the bakery—like a chevalier made of choux à la crème wielding a candy sword, horse included and all!
addons.title: La Douce Magie de la Cuisine

addons.text:
Thanks to your fortune, your Bakery of Delights is no longer just a charming little shop — it has become the heart of a growing confectionery empire.

You now own a magical production factory capable of replicating your enchanted goods on a large scale without losing quality or special properties (you are free to choose whether this will be your own bakery or a separate facility), along with multiple bakery branches strategically distributed throughout your world of arrival and connected to the original headquarters via magical links.

And naturally, you are free to design your factories and branches in true Willy Wonka style: rooms made entirely of sweets, chocolate rivers winding through pastry halls, macaron trees blooming in cozy indoor gardens, and fountains of golden crème pâtissière that never run dry; each nook and cranny can be as whimsical and delightful as your imagination allows.

Your factory and all its branches are discreetly protected by both mundane security measures and magical defenses, ensuring that your sweet empire remains safe from any harm.

Note: Should you possess the Delightful Little Miracles add-on, then the spirit of the bakery won’t be confined to the original building—its awareness and gentle influence will extend to your factory and every one of your branches as well, watching over them with the same warmth and care!
addons.title: Château des Délices

addons.text:
Your pleasant bakery has been given a special futuristic touch through your Grillabyte cook.

Thanks to its immense knowledge, it can bake any dessert in the universe for your bakery, even ones thought not to exist anymore, as well as, thanks to the magic interacting with Grillabyte's data files and hardware, it can do well with material conservation, making delicious cake even with access to fewer ingredients than it might call for.

It, of course, also interacts with other addons for the Bakery; Château des Délices gives EVERY location a Grillabyte of similar quality, and in fact they can all interface and learn from each other on recipes (<small>note: will not lead to robot revolution</small>); La Douce Magie de la Cuisine: Grillabyte is able to specifically design its creations with personalities and intelligence, allowing them to act as more effective workers or even near-sentient beings in their own regard; and finally, Delightful Little Miracles will always count Grillabyte as a loyal and joyful source of harmony, assuring that even if the candle weakens, it'll never actually go out.
addons.title: Grillabyte Approved!

objects.text:
Congratulations! You’re now the proud owner of a bakery—but not just any bakery! This one is magical. Whether you inherited it or fate led you to this special little corner, this enchanting place now belongs to you.

The bakery welcomes anyone who steps through the door with an irresistible aroma: a mix of freshly baked bread and a hint of magic that wraps around each visitor, leaving them with a warm, comforting feeling.

The best part? Thanks to its own little magic, you don’t need to be a master baker or use rare ingredients to make something delicious. Every loaf, every cake that comes out of your oven is unique. From soft croissants to irresistible chocolate bread and delightful cakes, everything you bake becomes a true feast for the senses.

And there you are, behind the counter, flour on your nose and a smile in your heart! The doors are open, the oven’s warm, and who knows who will be the next visitor enchanted by your cozy magic. Do you love to bake too? Great! Grab your apron—let’s fill the air with sweetness together!
objects.title: Bakery of Delights

objects.text:
You are in possession of the headquarters of a cultivator sect. The center is the sect master's palace (now yours), built on a spiritual vein that not only releases qi into the earth and entrusts cultivation, but also generates spiritual stones. Surrounding the sect master's palace are numerous facilities, including dormitories and mansions for disciples and elders, a technique library, artifact-making facilities, spiritual plant gardens, beast-breeding pens, and other places for practicing one of the countless cultivator arts.

The sect is divided into the sect master's palace, the inner sect, and the outer sect. All three are surrounded by walls and defensive formations, with which you are connected and have mini-control, giving you not only control over the defense but also awareness of the sect's various facilities and any intruders.

Although the sect is empty, the formations keep everything clean and pristine and will continue to do so for centuries to come, but they will eventually require maintenance.

With your first purchase, you receive a small, village-sized local sect whose equipment and knowledge only cover the lowest level of cultivation, where lifespans are no longer than mortals', and most techniques are at the level of a fireball the size of a basketball. Except perhaps for a secret sect technique known only to elders and their personal disciples, the sect's defensive formation can be breached by a massive artillery barrage. Any facilities, cultivation techniques, and spiritual vein barely worthy of the name will only help you at the beginning of your cultivation journey. To have a chance at immortality at this point without additional assistance, you must be an unparalleled genius capable of continuously developing your cultivation method without any reference point.

With each subsequent purchase, the sect is upgraded until, with the fifth purchase, everything in it reaches the level of the immortal sect. The defensive formations are capable of withstanding direct attacks from immortals capable of destroying continents at a lower level, among many other functions. The sect is the size of a small country (Lithuania/Latvia). This sect will allow you, even without spiritual roots, to obtain them through spiritual plants from its gardens and then cultivate them up to Nascent Soul even if you don't have a drop of talent, but it has information on how to reach the level of the previously mentioned immortals.
objects.title: Cultivation Sect

objects.text: You have become a Dungeon Master, the designated caretaker of the Dungeon Core. You have been given the role of guiding the Dungeon Core’s growth, managing its systems, and utilising the environment it creates to make a functional Dungeon. The Core’s operation begins by selecting a fixed, immovable location and placing the Core upon it. The Core then anchors itself to that specific point in space, with attempts to move it resulting in the entire dungeon unraveling, all mana lost, and the Core resetting to a dormant, unanchored state. The Core, upon anchoring, releases an instantaneous wave of mana that assimilates the raw materials within a spherical volume of 200 cubic meters centered on itself. This infused territory becomes your absolute domain, forming the Core Chamber, your central locus of control. Your most fundamental power as Dungeon Master is Basic Manipulation. By interfacing with the Core, you can reshape the matter of any area infused with your dungeon's mana at no mana cost. This allows you to sculpt walls, excavate passages, raise pillars, open shafts, and create simple structural traps like pits or dead-falls, but only using already-infused materials, not foreign matter brought from outside. From this foundation, Advanced Systems allows for Material Transmutation, which alters the intrinsic properties of infused matter. You could fortify a wall to be as tough as seasoned oak, create a pool of crystal-clear drinking water, or cause a tunnel to retain geothermal warmth. If an alteration creates an effect impossible in nature (e.g., stone harder than steel, water granting night vision), it crosses into active magic. Such a feature is no longer a transmuted material but a Magical Trap, requiring both an upfront mana cost and a continuous trickle of mana to sustain its supernatural function. Further advanced functions include the creation of Spawners and Magical Traps. Spawners are living mana-nodes that generate semi-sentient Dungeon Monsters, sustained by mana. Upkeep costs scale with their power, intelligence, and abilities, but can be reduced by introducing weaknesses. They are incapable of leaving the dungeon without instantly turning to dust bar those made specifically to do so. Through the interface of the Core, you can directly possess any of the created Dungeon Monsters. Magical Traps are complex constructs (e.g., shifting walls, glyphs of flame) that require both an initial mana investment and a continuous draw to remain active. The pinnacle of the crafting arts is Treasure Creation. The Core can forge permanent, fully functional magical items: a sword that burns with flame, a potion that mends wounds, a ring that muffles sound. It’s exorbitantly expensive mana-wise, surpassing the cost of a lethal trap. In exchange, completed items requires no continuous mana, making them perfect as bait, rewards, or equipment for your creations. These systems can be woven together into sophisticated Integrated Systems. A Boss Arena can feature a uniquely powerful monster whose lair includes magically-fortified terrain and a crafted artifact weapon. A Challenge Gauntlet could be a sequence of rooms pairing specific monster types with environmental traps. A Swarm Encounter can use fortified choke points to funnel intruders into a kill zone populated by numerous weak spawners. A critical limitation governing all these powers is the Proximity Lock. The Core’s systems cannot be altered, created, or dismantled within the immediate vicinity of an intruder or any unallied creature. You cannot conjure spikes beneath a foe, vanish a wall behind them, or deactivate a trap they are triggering. All changes must be made proactively in unoccupied areas or ahead of an intruder's progress. The Core’s functions are governed by a strict Mana Economy. Following the initial infusion, the Core generates a base amount of mana each day, equivalent to the energy needed to claim an additional 200 cubic meters of territory. This base amount increases accordingly in proportion to the amount of ambient mana there is in the anchored location. While Basic Manipulation is free, Advanced Systems require constant upkeep. Spending your entire daily allowance on expansion will cause existing systems to fail from lack of upkeep. To increase your daily mana generation, you must feed the Core. Mana Acquisition occurs primarily through Life-Force Harvesting. The death of a creature within your dungeon yields a large burst of mana proportional to its strength. Alternatively, the sustained presence of living beings provides a smaller, continuous trickle, scaling with their inherent power. A secondary method is Object Assimilation. Any organic matter (like corpses or plants) or magical items within your infused territory can be instantly broken down into mana, with more powerful or complex objects yielding greater returns. This allows for the recycling of loot or failed creations, though always at a net loss compared to their original creation cost. Finally, you can supplement the Core's resources directly by converting your own personal reserves of mana or similar arcane energy into the Core’s systems.
objects.title: Dungeon Core

objects.text:
The EX-EYE is the pinnacle of Machine Hive intelligence warfare. Whenever an EX-EYE is located, both the Federation of Worlds and the Coalition of Mankind will temporarily cease their own war, uniting all available forces in a desperate attempt to find and destroy it before it can uncover their secrets. The few times organic forces have successfully destroyed one, the celebration was galaxy-wide, treated as a victory greater than any territorial conquest.

The EX-EYE is a three-layered cloud of trillions of independent modules orbiting a dead white dwarf star. The innermost layer appears as a glittering fog of car-sized quantum processors, so densely packed they create a shimmering sphere that catches starlight like metallic mist. The middle layer consists of millions of massive ring-shaped stations, each several kilometers across, arranged in interlocking orbits that create a complex geometric lattice. The outermost layer is a sparse cloud of pylon-sized collectors spread across millions of kilometers From a distance, the EX-EYE resembles a vast eye socket with a white dwarf pupil, surrounded by concentric rings of increasing darkness.

The quantum processors of the inner layer are embedded within a rigid, macro-scale structure of continuous monocrystal to shield the delicate quantum states from external interference and distributes any residual force across the entire weave. The structural frames of the gravitic ring stations are built from a network of Gravitic Anchors that generate intense, localized compression fields to contain the ferocious tidal forces of its micro-singularities. The outer collector pylons are sheathed in a specialized, porous Carbon-Carbon Composite, its lattice engineered to undergo a controlled exothermic phase shift when interacting with exotic particles, converting their anomalous energy into a harmless, dissipating plasma bloom.

The EX-EYE operates by exploiting three different physics principles simultaneously to observe locations galaxies away in real-time. The innermost quantum processor layer contains clouds of entangled particles. A sensory pattern is imprinted onto one particle, and the EX-EYE infers that pattern from its entangled partner across any distance. This creates a computational foundation with quintillions of tiny quantum sensors all reporting probability states simultaneously. The middle layer of gravitic ring stations powers up their micro-singularities to bend spacetime itself, reshaping it into a funnel that brings the quantum probability field of a distant target location into local space where the inner layer processors can read it. It essentially temporarily connects two regions of spacetime at the quantum information level, making them adjacent for observation purposes even though they remain separated by light-years physically.

The outer layer completes the system by detecting tachyon particles. When the gravitic lens creates its spacetime funnel and the quantum processors begin resolving the target’s quantum state, the system is reading information that is always slightly delayed by the time it takes to propagate. The tachyon catchers detect the retro-causal echoes of these particles, essentially seeing a few seconds into the past of the target location, which allows the processors to correct for the light-speed delay and compile an image that is effectively real-time or even slightly precognitive. The result is that the EX-EYE can observe any point in the galaxy with perfect clarity, seeing not just ships and planets but reading data screens, hearing conversations, and observing troop movements as if a Hive intelligence was physically present. 

The EX-EYE’s greatest strengths come paired with crippling vulnerabilities. Every scrying operation consumes the entire energy output of the central white dwarf star for its duration, meaning the system cannot remain active continuously and requires days or weeks of cooldown and quantum recalibration between major observation sessions. While observing, it is completely immobile, locked in a fixed orbital configuration, and even when not scrying it moves at sub-light speeds only with steering thrusters designed for course corrections over years, not tactical maneuvering, making it as maneuverable as a drifting asteroid in a universe of FTL warships. The gravitic lensing process creates massive spacetime distortions that register on sensors across multiple galaxies when active, a celestial alarm that announces the EX-EYE’s location and operational status to anyone paying attention. Lastly, even the passive operational process bleeds catastrophic exotic radiation that render multiple surrounding solar systems into permanent wasteland that is hostile to biological life, even with protective suits and ships, creating a natural defensive perimeter but also further advertising the structure’s presence.
objects.title: EX-EYE

objects.text:
Fortress Millennia is a magnificent stronghold that masterfully combines the opulence of a noble’s residence with cutting-edge defenses. It is reinforced with multiple layers of magic, crafted to fortify its structure, repel external threats, and mend any damage. Intricate wards cloak the fortress, obscuring it from mundane perception and distorting most forms of supernatural detection.

The most extraordinary feature of Fortress Millennia is its portability. You can shrink the entire structure into a compact form, making it easy to carry wherever you go. When needed, you can expand it back to its full size, allowing you to access all its features and functions again. However, the reactivation process requires about an hour to complete.

The fortress is fully staffed with one hundred loyal servants, each inherently skilled in a basic profession such as guard, maid, or accountant. Upon acquiring the fortress, you can customize their appearance or race to whatever you wish, provided their changes don’t exceed peak human abilities. These servants are unwaveringly loyal and can be revived as long as you remain the fortress’s owner, though reviving each one requires a week.

Designed for growth, Fortress Millennia readily accepts new enchantments, with its ancient magic slowly strengthening over time. Both the fortress and its servants grow more powerful as the years pass, though this process unfolds over centuries or even millennia before significant boosts become evident.
objects.title: Fortress Millennia

addons.text:
Your cloning vat has fused with your lab. You may choose to retain the original appearances—keeping the vat sleek and modern beside the crackling, shadow-drenched lab—or blend the two into a unified visual identity. Whether you prefer a vat encased in brass and leather, pulsing with arcane glyphs, or a lab reimagined in sterile chrome and bio-reactive glass, the change is entirely stylistic, with no effect on functionality.

Beyond that, there are a few new additions thanks to their fusion. The tools in your lab are now better than any modern equipment. They have many new features that make your work easy. Even a novice with no training in medicine or alchemy can perform simple surgical procedures with flawless accuracy and zero risk of failure.

Your former flesh golem assistants, once crude but serviceable, have been replaced by fully realized homunculi. Each homunculus is now skilled in a designated role: alchemists who can independently brew potions, researchers who can copy and decode grimoires, surgeons with steady hands and quick minds. They retain the loyalty and diligence of their predecessors but now offer genuine expertise, autonomy, and even distinct personalities shaped by their duties.

The Cloning Vat, now empowered by the lab’s arcane infrastructure, no longer suffers from its original bottleneck. It can cultivate and grow any number of clones simultaneously, provided you supply the necessary biological materials. All previous limitations regarding lifespan, memory blankness, and power cap (50% of the original’s potency) still apply, but logistical throughput is no longer a concern.
addons.title: Ingolstadt

objects.text:
You possess a magical laboratory, a dark, crackling space reminiscent of the legendary workshop of Dr. Frankenstein.

Scattered throughout the lab are detailed research notes concerning the formation and crafting of homunculi, scribbled diagrams, and partially translated grimoires. Among these are formulas for artificial bodies, blueprints for piecing together life, and anatomical studies of magical beasts. Sealed bottles containing artificial souls rest on the shelves and carefully preserved body parts from rare and magical creatures are stored throughout the lab, each piece meticulously labeled. There is enough materials that they can last years without needing restocking, and their quality is high enough that even a newbie alchemist would be able to create a basic homunculus with relative ease. 

The lab is fully equipped with specialized workstations for precision surgery, complex alchemical processes, and the endless task of documentation. All of the tools and devices come from the technology of the 1700s—brass instruments, crude bone saws, manual presses, and thick glass equipment—yet thanks to the enchantments woven into every surface and tool, they function with the speed, precision, and reliability of modern equipment. Scalpel cuts are flawless, chemical reactions stabilize in moments, and handwritten notes seem to process and store themselves as efficiently as digital files.

Lastly, scuttling through the lab are your loyal minions: tiny, misshapen flesh golems, ugly but diligent, created solely for menial tasks. They handle heavy lifting, fetch tools, assist in cleanup, and manage the less glamorous aspects of your work. Despite their forms they are dexterous and precise, as well as obedient, and they seem to possess just enough awareness to bicker among themselves as they work.
objects.title: Frankenstein’s Lab

addons.text:
Your Sanctuary has evolved further through the Harry Potter magic system into an improved version of Newt Scamander's briefcase. This briefcase includes every magical creature that has ever inhabited the suitcase, including a now hatched Ashwinder, along with a mate for them, with the only exception being the Obscurus as a result of it not being natural. Your sanctuary now also has a version of the undetectable expansion charm, which allows it to remain hidden from normal eyes and magically sealed from those who would mean you or something inside the suitcase harm. Lastly, you gain all of Newt Scamander's knowledge of both magic and magical creatures, along with his talent in magizoology.

Note: If you have the Obscurial Form upgrade then your Suitcase also includes a Obscurus
addons.title: Scamander's Briefcase

objects.text:
Gaia's Sanctuary is a Self-sustaining pocket dimension located inside a physical object that can look like a suitcase or trunk. The Sanctuary has two entrances; it can be accessed through the physical form or some dimensional travel power. The Sanctuary's Physical Form was enchanted with many different spells from multiple magic systems to protect it.

The very center of the Sanctuary is the living area, which includes a Manor, Library, Workshop for Tinkering, Alchemy and Potions Lab, and a warehouse for materials. On Each side of the center lies a bubble that has been dimensionally expanded, each one containing a different area.

The Bubbles Contain An Animal Area, a Mining Area, A Plant and Fauna Area, and a Tree Area. Each one is expanded with different biomes for each type of subject, and each bubble has some form of time dilation. Each bubble contains magical, non-magical, extinct, and mythical forms of animals, trees, plants, and even different types of ores. Any Being who can find the Sanctuary can get in; it is not truly safe.
objects.title: Gaia's Sanctuary

objects.text:
You are now the CEO and the sole owner of a gigantic interdimensional corporation. You can retroactively insert a branch of this corporation into any universe you visit, as well as decide what specialty each branch will have. You can have a trade empire in one universe and a luxury starship yard in another. Your corporation easily outmatches any possible competition by the same degree to which a tech giant outmatches a street food vendor's stall.

The incomes your corporation generates only technically do not grant you all the money in the universe, and that is only because other people need to have something to pay you with. This also nets you an incredible amount of political influence. In fantasy worlds you can have entire kingdoms in your pocket, and in space and interstellar settings you can casually have entire star systems in private ownership.

All the company properties are dimensionally interconnected, allowing you to move through the universes your corporation is present in through company warehouses and offices. You can also extend your services into the multiverse, providing trade and transfer between entirely different universes.

You can place any company property into a dedicated pocket dimension tethered to you, where it will remain in perfect stasis until such time as you need it again, whereupon you can import it freely into the world.

Lastly, the company comes with a private security force consisting of trained professional soldiers equipped with the most advanced weaponry your company has or what is available in the branch's world.
objects.title: Gigacorp

objects.text:
A fusion of two of man’s dreams: an invincible fortress and mechs. This entity is a humanoid mountain of overlapping armored plates, standing as tall as Mount Everest, its silhouette blotting out the horizon. Its form is a moving citadel, a titan of carved metal and stone the scale of a planetary monument, within which an entire metropolis thrives.

At its core lies a captured and bound segment of a planetary leyline, the Thaumic Heart. This conduit of raw, flowing magical energy powers the fundamental systems of the internal city. The city itself, a vast arcology of stacked districts and automated industry, is nestled within the torso and limbs. Its internal architecture mirrors the exterior, a labyrinth of vaulted brass halls, cathedral-like engine rooms, and cobbled streets lit by gas-lamps and arcing tesla coils, all governed by distributed intelligence.

The city is protected from the titan’s movements by a permanent, city-wide inertial dampening field. A kinetic siphon system in the feet converts the seismic force of each step into usable power. Environmental systems provide perfect climate control, and molecular recompositors ensure total waste reclamation, creating a perfectly balanced, closed-loop ecosystem for its inhabitants within the brass-and-stone vaults. 

The Colossus is arrayed with overlapping weapon systems blending medieval and industrial design. This includes 2 primary shoulder-mounted, furnace-like plasma lances; 24 torso-mounted piston-driven kinetic bombardment silos; 200 heavy, clockwork-automated ballista clusters; 150 fortified magi-catapult arrays of iron and oak; and 500 rapid-fire, swiveling ballista turrets. Every projectile is enchanted with armor-piercing runes, while artillery volleys can be infused with wide-area effects like gravity wells or cryogenic stasis fields. Wrist-mounted particle shield projectors and melee-enhancement runes on its stone-and-iron fists provide close-in defense.

Powered by the Thaumic Heart, a permanent city-scale magical barrier projects from the crest on its head. An army of 50,000 autonomous, steam-venting maintenance golems of iron and brass, sustained by the same energy, perpetually services the structure. The Heart’s energy also fuels internal alchemical vats that organically synthesize and replenish all necessary food, atmospheric gases, and basic raw materials, rendering the Colossus entirely self-sufficient indefinitely.
objects.title: Great City Colossus

addons.text:
Due to being an exorcist yourself, the church has received massive upgrades. Now hidden within the church, accessible only to staff members, is a vast library filled with holy texts, anti-evil spirit scriptures, and anti-demonic writings. Additionally, all staff members have received at least basic exorcist training, including the blessing of holy water.

The church now also hosts 10 to 20 three-man teams of highly trained and experienced senior exorcists. Finally, due to your piety and status as a senior exorcist, you are now being personally trained by the acting Archbishop to eventually assume their position.
addons.title: The Armed Men of God

addons.text:
Due to your acquisition of Holy Light the church has been upgraded. First off the area itself is bathed in Holy Light, which not only massively enhances all its sanctification effects but also promotes the growth of the Holy Light in people. The sanctification is at such a level that as the rays of the rising dawn shine upon the stained glass windows, the church is illuminated in a cleansing light that heals all but the most deadly of ailments and weakens even those. 

Not only that but all the church's innate staff members have a strong holy factor and any who join will not only gain Holy Light themselves but also have a high natural affinity towards it. Lastly, the church now gains access to basic holy light weaponry but not any knowledge of how to produce more.
addons.title: Holy Land

addons.text:
Your nature as a devil that infiltrated the Church and inherited it has made changes to it. Now the Holy Light of the Church is corrupted, harming both light and dark being with exception that you decides on. The Corrupted Light can break down the purity of the members of your church, making them revel in sins but they will never be considered corrupted by god due to your infiltration being so successful.

You also have the option to shift the worship of the church to yourself instead of a barely present god, nuns and priest being fully loyal to you instead of being loyal to God first because in their mind, you are their God.

If you have the Holy Land addon, your Corrupted Light is able to harm and heal in equal measure and your staff now has access to this corrupted light for themselves as well as a small amount of demonic energy to use Imagination Magic.

If you have The Armed Men of God addon, you can now get cultist in addition to exorcists, those cultist will invent ritual in your name that will boost your power slowly but surely as they gather the energy to give to you during their rituals. The Exorcists now don’t just hunt the Heretics and Unholy, but also the Holy and Pure at your command, equipped with knowledge on how to corrupt even the purest of souls with time.
addons.title: Corrupted Church

objects.text:
You have been given a church, complete with holy silver gates, nuns, priests, and a bishop. These nuns, priests, and bishops are all profoundly religious but kind. This church naturally draws those who believe in God, who want to be religious, or who, for some reason, need the help of a priest or the church. Not only that, but this ground is highly sanctified, and any malevolent spirit or demon is not only naturally repelled from it, but if they decided to step onto its ground with malicious intent of any kind towards someone affiliated with the church, are smited. 

Alongside this, anyone who merely walks onto this church's grounds, specifically when they have no ill intent, is minorly blessed with an anti-ill intent and demon effect that scales with how much they believe in God. This effect also extends to objects with any water brought in naturally turning into lesser holy water and any cross being sanctified. Alongside this, any inside the church has improved mental, physical, and spiritual recovery.

Lastly, the church itself, due to the blessing of God, naturally repels misfortune or any attempt to corrupt it.

Note: This church can be at most as big as the biggest church on earth.
objects.title: House of God

objects.text:
You have been given a castle, complete with Demons and all varieties of it like Harpies and Goatmen, Imps, Hellhounds, Witches, etc. These Demons see you as their true Lord/Lady, and wouldn't dream of betraying you, even if they still have autonomy. This castle naturally draws those who believe in evil, those who wish serve a 'true power', or those who simply need sanctuary from those who would punish them for sin. This Castle is said to be ripped straight from Lucifer himself, and it would be hard to see any other possibility. 

Even against Holy Arms and Powers, it is so potent and fortified that it could survive a brief attack from Gods army, and almost indestructible to normal weaponry. The Castle also has that which is known as Devil Brew. If served to unsuspecting, or possibly even willing guests, they will become unbelievably drunk, to a cartoonish degree even after one glass. The more they drink, the further guaranteed they will both work for you, and even if they die, their souls will belong to you to torment, or even turn into a servant of the castle itself in any form you desire.

The Castle also has many rituals and spells cast meant to kill, entangle, and disorient intruders. Finally, anyone who you don't invite or is pure of heart will find themselves be nearly unable to enter the castle, or move so slow, their runs will be casual walks.

Finally, you will find yourself with special servants who answer directly to you. It could be a demoness with illusion magic to spy for you, or a goblin who can upgrade the castle if given materials it needs, and so on.
objects.title: House of Hell

addons.title: Mansion of Havoc
addons.text:
It seems your castle has become the "Disney Castle" of your hell-infused Disneyland. Now, true denizens of the afterlife have come to reside here, although the more nefarious and evil ones are attracted more than good hearted ones. They will also find themselves bent to your will, serving as new employees for the park.

When it comes to your castle, the attraction is known as the "Mansion of Havoc." In this attraction, a tour through the castle will pull upon their subconscious and use personal tailored fears and phobias to truly make them horrified. By the end of the ride, which can be subtly influenced by you on its contents, they will be a crying mass of piss on the floor, or if you truly desire... a new hellish creature for your service.

objects.text:
Welcome to the House of Horror, an eerie and thrilling haunted theme park that materializes wherever you desire, seamlessly blending into its surroundings as if it has always been a part of the landscape. Step into a realm of spine-chilling attractions and macabre delights, where the line between the living and the dead blurs into a chilling dance of the supernatural.

As the proprietor of this dark spectacle, you wield the power to shape the House of Horror according to your twisted imagination. Every detail, from the rides to the layout and decorations, is under your command. The park comes alive with a sinister energy, its atmosphere tinged with anticipation and a hint of malevolence.

However, what sets the House of Horror apart is its staff, who are not your ordinary park employees. Instead, they consist of ghostly entities, ethereal yokai, animated corpses, and other macabre beings. Bound to the park itself, these otherworldly beings feeds of the fear of guests to grow. As employees they are dedicated to the maintenance, financial aspects, and overall operation. They possess an uncanny knowledge of the park's secrets and are ever vigilant in ensuring its dark wonders continue to captivate visitors.

But beware, for those who meet their demise within the House of Horror become eternally linked to its spectral realm. Their souls become bound to the park, forever trapped in this macabre paradise. As part of the park's staff, they assist in creating a truly immersive and terrifying experience for all who dare to venture within its haunted halls.

With the House of Horror at your command, you can unleash your darkest fantasies and create an otherworldly haven of frightful entertainment. This haunted theme park is yours to command. And with an unseen Benefactor handling all legal matters, you can focus solely on embracing the eerie delights of the House of Horror.
objects.title: House of Horror

objects.text:
You are now the sole franchisee of the famous Interdimensional Combination Taco Bell, Pizza Hut, and KFC™ (also referred to as the ICTBPHKFC). This fast food joint is what it says in the title—a combination of a Taco Bell, Pizza Hut, and KFC—that is able to serve the multiverse.

The ICTBPHKFC is staffed by human-like automatons that initially resemble in aesthetics, mannerisms, and attitudes—teenaged, human, minimum-wage employees. Despite their monotone voice and unenthusiastic tones, they perform all the tasks of their job efficiently, completing pretty much every order within three minutes. You may reprogram them with new personalities if you have the necessary programming knowledge. The supply of ingredients is replenishing—every hour, new supplies appear, replacing used supplies. Supplies also do not go bad or spoil, and are of high-quality.

The menu is the complete menu of each of the Combination restaurants, including not only the full modern menu but also regional and discontinued items such as the Steakhouse Burrito for Taco Bell, the Bigfoot-sized pizza for Pizza Hut, and the Japanese Christmas KFC Bucket. The Soda fountains contain both Pepsi and Coke products, also with their full line-up as well as discontinued and regional items, ranging from the original Coke recipe, New Coke, and Crystal Pepsi as well as sweet and iced tea, lemonade, and coffee. You may add more options if you have access to at least a bottle of the stuff, anything from RC Cola to Nuka Cola to Potions and any liquid.

The ICTBPHKFC is infinite in size. However, its space is folded so that it seems like a normally-sized fast food joint, but a free seat is always easily located—the same goes for the restrooms. You can also easily get to the back of the ICTBPHKFC if you simply desire to be there and walk.

The Interdimensional part of the ICTBPHKFC comes by the ability of the ICTBPHKFC to exist in multiple places at once—you may choose a world you know, or leave it to chance. Once connected, patrons will be able to come in through any one of the infinite doors (again, folded space). Inside the ICTBPHKFC, violence and theft is prohibited and impossible. Any attempts will end in slapstick backfires or the perpetrator just phasing through their target. No radiation, dark energy, diseases, or otherwise harmful ambient effects will take root either. The store self-cleans and you'll not have to worry about horrible bathrooms or anything like that.
