As the franchisee, you are entitled to free food and may set the prices to whatever you please. From ludicrous sums to being completely free, or a "pay what you want" system.
objects.title: Interdimensional Combination Taco Bell, Pizza Hut, and KFC

objects.text:
The junkyard, officially designated Receptacle System 329, is a continental-scale graveyard of industry and consumption that organises itself through the ceaseless labor of its automatons. It is among the many more primitive systems still in use within the Coalition of Mankind.

At its perimeter lies a flat plain where the inbound Carriage trucks deposit their loads, creating temporary, teetering mountains of fresh refuse. From this zone, the materials are carried along by machinery toward the deeper districts. Within these districts lie a vast, ordered plains of settled machinery: eviscerated factory lathes, the skeletons of harvesters, stacks of shipping-container apartments, and the hollowed-out carapaces of transport vehicles. 

At the facility's heart lies a colossal excavated pit reserved for hazardous or monumental debris. Around this pit are factories that pound and shriek day and night, melting, shredding, and compacting sorted material into dense, featureless blocks for storage. This entire, sprawling operation is conducted by a caste of simple, rudimentary robots operating on a decentralized Scrap-Net protocol, a low-bandwidth mesh WiFi network that blankets the facility with basic command packets. 

The workforce is led by the ceaseless Inbound 'Carriage' Fleet, heavy-duty autonomous haulers that collect refuse from derelict surrounding areas; upon crossing the perimeter, they connect to the Scrap-Net, receive a dump-location beacon, disgorge their cargo in a roaring crash, and depart to continue their collection rounds. 

Within the yard itself, the 'Gulper'-Class collector units, squat and tank-like on adaptive treads, perform the physical labor. Their programming is a simple loop: they ping the network for a task, scan the nearest untagged pile, request a material identification from the drone network, and if it matches their designation, they collect it with magnetic grapplers and cutting beams and deliver it to the appropriate zone. 

Last is the flock of 'Corvid'-Class observer drones that patrol the area, scanning everything. Using a simple consensus protocol, they identify and tag materials, broadcasting the data to the Scrap-Net; they flag unstable piles, identify hazards, and effectively direct the flow of all other machines through these basic, shared data packets.

You will be given administrative privileges within the Scrap-Net, having be registered as the owner of this land. Through the Net, you can issue direct commands, set long-term priorities, and repurpose the endless labor of the yard’s automatons. When you first receive the junkyard, it will have over 10 million tons of scrap materials.
objects.title: Legacy Receptacle System 329 “Junkyard”

objects.text:
You own a vast, warehouse-sized chamber stocked with roughly one hundred distinct sets of cold weapons drawn from cultures across the globe and throughout history. The collection includes European longswords, Sumerian maces, Chinese guandao, Indian katars and Japanese yari and even more. The arsenal contains both melee and ranged weaponry. Every one of these weapons were made in different times and places by different people, carrying their own history and story, though none are overly famous. In fact, many are forgotten by the world.

Each weapon in your arsenal carries a minor magical property. Some are forged from mundane steel or bronze and layered with enchantment. Others are shaped from inherently magical materials like the bone of a monster or perpetually hot meteoric iron. There are weapons sharpened to near-molecular perfection, ranged weapons that ricochet their ammunition toward a secondary target on a miss and daggers that turn you invisible when held. The upper ceiling of power across the entire collection is advanced elemental coating; a blade might wreathe itself in lethal cold or mace-head might cloak itself in explosive sticky flames.

None of the artifacts in your arsenal impose strict requirements to wield or activate. You can hand any weapon to any person and its magic will function. Certain weapons may perform noticeably better when paired with a specific talent, character, or attribute.
objects.title: Magic Weapon Arsenal

addons.text:
It seems you aren’t merely the sole owner of this Mausoleum but its rightful owner, having been buried in it. You are Qin Shi Huang, the specifics on which if you are his reincarnation, him itself or merely a being that perfectly embodies his life doesn’t matter, as it has only reinforced your existence and ties to this empire.

The Mandate of Heaven has awakened the true purpose of your spirit-realm. The Mausoleum is no longer a static, defensive necropolis guarding a tomb; it is the beating heart of a living, breathing Celestial Qin Dynasty. The mercury rivers flow as vibrant arteries of celestial qi, energizing the very soil and air of your domain. The bureaucratic spirits no longer process phantom scrolls, but actively administer the growing complexities of your realm. The Terracotta Legions are no longer statues on eternal guard duty, but the proud, active standing army of a sovereign who rules both the living and the dead. The limitations of the tomb have melted away under the divine right of your command, transforming it from a memorial into a functional, expanding capital of a spirit-empire. 

Your rule, legitimized by Heaven itself, has unlocked the Mausoleum's deeper resources. The treasury now generates perpetual spiritual artifacts, the numbers of which growing in time. The workshops produces divine artifacts that can rival the likes of gods. The armories can now forge new spirit-weapons, their designs evolving beyond historical replication to meet new threats. The greatest resource, however, is the populace itself. The Divine Spirits have developed fuller personalities and greater autonomy within the framework of their loyalty. Generals debate strategy, artisans innovate within classical forms, and courtiers engage in genuine, if formal, diplomacy. They are no longer merely animated figurines but a complete society of spirit-beings, utterly devoted to you, their Divine Emperor, whose will is synonymous with cosmic order. 

Your Mandate does not accept frozen borders. As your authority consolidates and your celestial governance projects power, the very geography of your Mausoleum-empire expands. New spirit-land is formed beyond the walls: terraced hillsides of ghostly mulberry trees for silkworms, quarries of singing jade, and satellite palaces that serve as administrative nodes. This growth is a direct manifestation of your influence and achievements. Victorious campaigns in any realm can cause new military outposts and triumphal arches to rise within your domain. Wise and just decrees issued in the mortal world might cause a sublime Library of Harmonious Edicts to materialize near your palace. The realm is a mirror to and a reservoir for your power, its grandeur and size swelling in proportion to the strength of your Mandate.

If you wish, this can also retroactively make you the Emperor of China or the local equivalent, with the land and people accepting your rule.
addons.title: First Qin Emperor

objects.text:
You have become the sole owner, and thus emperor, of the Miniature Heavenly Empire the First Qin Emperor was buried with, the structure having ascended into the spirit world and become Divine Spirits under your command.

The domain you now rule is a vast, self-contained spirit realm contained within a perfectly scaled replica of the Qin Empire as it existed at the moment of unification. Along its borders are towering spirit walls. At the geographic center of this empire is the colossal palace complex of jade, bronze, and polished black stone. This Celestial Peak is your throne and residence, its highest tower piercing a permanent, artificial night sky that remains fixed over the domain.

Beneath the Celestial Peak lies the empire’s beating heart: the Underground Palace. Its vaulted ceiling is a meticulous map of the heavens, with gemstones forming fixed stars that pulse with gentle light, and rivers of spectral mercury, toxic to mortal flesh but nourishing to spirit essence, that flow through channels in the floor, tracing the exact courses of the Yellow and Yangtze Rivers. These rivers of quicksilver spirit-energy feed the entire realm, their vapors rising to form a protective dome over the empire and powering the ancient mechanisms within. The palace itself is a treasury beyond mortal comprehension, filled with spirit-manifestations of every treasure interred with the emperor: mountains of ghostly gold coins, racks of ceremonial jade bi discs, suits of lacquer armor that gleam without light, and libraries of bamboo slips containing all the knowledge and laws of Qin.

Radiating from this central axis are the facilities and cities of your eternal kingdom. There are barracks complexes, arsenals stocked with endlessly replicating spirit-weapons, and stable yards for the celestial chariots. Workshops exist where the terracotta forms of artisans endlessly practice their crafts, producing objects of sublime beauty that fade after a day, only to be made again. There are pleasure gardens with bronze trees bearing fruit of jade, and pavilions where the spectral forms of musicians and acrobats perform silent, elegant routines for an audience of courtiers. A sprawling bureaucratic ministry is in a constant state of orderly activity, processing scrolls that detail the minute governance of this afterlife. The empire is also provisioned with spirit-farmlands and granaries, eternally full, and a celestial zoo containing rare and mythical beasts, all rendered in terracotta and stone, now animate and watchful.

The citizens of this realm are legion of Divine Spirits born from the original burial goods and sacrifices. The most prominent are the Terracotta Legions: over eight thousand spirit-soldiers, each a unique Divine Spirit of clay and resolve, organized into fully manned infantry, cavalry, and chariot divisions. They are commanded by a hierarchy of generals and officers whose spirits burn brighter, capable of tactical thought and independent action. Beyond the army are the spirit-courtiers: civil officials who administer the realm, astronomers who tend the star-chart ceiling, and entertainers whose performances bring a semblance of life.

As emperor, your command over this realm is absolute. The Terracotta Legions march where you direct, the bureaucratic spirits can be tasked with managing information or spiritual logistics and the very geography of the spirit-empire can shift subtly at your whim, with paths closing or opening to guests or intruders.
objects.title: Mausoleum of the First Qin Emperor

objects.text:
A massive space station originally proposed by American physicist Gerard K. O'Neill. The O'Neill Cylinder measures 32 kilometres (20 miles) in length and 8 kilometres (5 miles) in width, making it ideal for supporting a population of at least 35 million people.

The O'Neill Cylinder consists of six habitable sections, each resembling a megacity the size of an island, with diverse wildlife and designated areas to preserve a sense of wilderness. Two of these sections can retract, allowing sunlight to enter, thereby conserving energy. Additionally, one section contains a science laboratory equipped with experimental technology and fusion reactors that power the entire station.

The space station employs various advanced technologies to replicate life on Earth. By utilising cylindrical rotation at 40 rotations per hour, combined with artificial gravity generators, the space station simulates Earth's standard gravity. Additionally, the space station has life support systems designed to maintain an atmosphere similar to Earth. These systems include artificial weather and other essential components that mimic the Earth's day-night cycle, utilising mirrors to reflect sunlight.

The O'Neill Cylinder houses a collection of androids and drones that help maintain the habitat in optimal condition. AURORA is the central artificial intelligence unit that oversees all operations within the station, which manages a vast array of systems and defences, including railguns and drone space fighters. These systems are hundreds of times more efficient than any human could achieve, utilising 42nd-century computer technology.

As humanity's last hope of avoiding an extinction-level event, the O'Neill Cylinder have various experimental technologies that surpassed those of the 42nd century. From experimental power armour and advanced weaponry, this scientific facility houses marvels and wonders beyond the 42nd century.
objects.title: O'Neill Cylinder

addons.text:
Your ability to create pocket dimensions has merged seamlessly with your skills as a farmer, granting you the power to generate vast subspaces filled with farmland. Each subspace is dedicated to a single type of animal, plant, or other agricultural resource, allowing for optimal organization and management. You can create as many of these subspaces as needed. From the outside, they can remain invisible and accessible only to farmers or those with the proper authority. Alternatively, they can be anchored to specific locations, hidden behind doors, or integrated within a single room.

If you possess the ability to apply enhancements or spells, you can imbue these subspaces with magical properties, affecting the water, soil, plants, and animals within. This enables the cultivation of enchanted crops, the raising of magical livestock, and the production of unique food sources. Regardless of external conditions, these subspaces remain operational at all times, ensuring a continuous supply of resources—even during harsh weather.

Initially, each subspace has a limited amount of farmland. However, by channeling energy, power, and specific resources into them, these subspaces will expand, allowing for greater productivity and enhanced capabilities over time.
addons.title: Dimensional Farms

addons.text:
You are the Shaper of Civilization, a master of creation with absolute control over your designated Plot of Land. Within its boundaries, you can shape the terrain to your will—carving rivers, raising mountains, altering the weather, or even digging vast chasms to form deep valleys. Everything within this space bends to your design as you craft the perfect civilization. However, your influence is confined to the limits of your domain.

Drawing inspiration from both fictional and real-world cities, you can integrate blueprints from legendary places like Fontaine of Teyvat or the futuristic skylines of distant worlds. These structures serve as templates, which you can freely modify, refine, and merge to create breathtaking masterpieces. Whether you envision a sprawling metropolis, a humble village, a city that ascends into the heavens like Minas Tirith, or an inverted tiered city cradled by mountains, your vision is yours to bring to life.

As the Shaper, you construct and place structures using both natural and artificial resources. Once your civilization is complete, you can test its resilience through simulations, exposing it to natural disasters, invasions, or any other trials you wish to impose.

If you possess the ability to create life, you may populate your civilization with beings of your own design—either through meticulous crafting or by generating sentient species at random. Templates from other powerful entities are also available for use, but creating life requires both the knowledge and the power to sustain it.

Your civilization can span across ages, progressing through technological eras from the Bronze Age to the modern day and beyond. You can build anything—from medieval fortresses to industrial complexes, from entertainment hubs to centers of governance. However, most advancements follow a natural progression, ensuring a structured evolution of your civilization.

You are the Architect of Civilization, the Molder of Land and Life, the Builder of Roads and Empires. If your vision falters, you can erase and begin anew, shaping limitless civilizations, cultures, and landscapes. Should you possess the means to expand your territory, you can claim more land, broadening the scope of your creative dominion. Within your Plot of Land, the possibilities are endless.
addons.title: Shaper of Civilization

addons.text:
You can expand your plot of land into nearby areas, triggering a Territory Claim. This process utilizes all the features of Sovereign Domain to establish and extend your control. If the area is already ruled by someone else, you must defeat the current ruler to claim it. If people inhabit the land, you can either persuade them to follow you or seize control by force.

Once your territory is established, you must maintain the support of your people. Gaining their loyalty ensures their unwavering devotion. Additionally, you have the ability to grant powers to others, typically those you possess or ones derived from similar energy sources. If you wield The Shaper of Civilization, you can modify the newly claimed lands just as you would your original territory. Any technology you can currently build will also generate the necessary resources, such as wood and rare metals, within your domain.

You now have the ability to govern multiple territories, travel between them freely, and make adjustments as needed. However, be mindful that others can also attempt to invade and claim your lands for themselves.
addons.title: I Hereby Claim These Lands

addons.text:
You have the ability to store your Plot of Land—or any additional plots you acquire—either in your Inventory or in a special object known as a Displacement Container. Just like when you first deploy a Plot from its marble form, this allows you to place the land into a state of Living Stasis. While stored, the plot is completely unaffected by the outside world, yet everything within continues to live, breathe, and function naturally.

If stored in your Inventory, the Plot is pulled into a dedicated slot equipped with a management and communication interface. This lets you monitor and even speak with those inside, if you wish. If you use a Displacement Container instead, you can store multiple Plots within a single container, or house a very large one with ease. While a Plot is stored inside, the container itself becomes indestructible.

Inside the Stasis, all life, structures, and environments exist in a fully realized and stable state—complete with breathable air, space, and time flow—much like the original Displacement Containers.

To deploy a stored Plot, place the Displacement Container in your desired location and either select “Release” or simply speak or think the word. The Plot will reappear precisely at that spot. It's recommended to choose a flat stretch of land or an open ocean, as the surrounding terrain will automatically terraform to match the layout of the restored Plot.

Everything directly connected to or claimed by the Plot—including nearby structures, natural features, or even surrounding ocean—will be included when the Plot is stored or released. This ensures entire ecosystems, such as island chains with their own waters, remain intact during transitions.
addons.title: Store and Move

addons.text:
Your country-sized Plot of Land no longer holds only a single empowered settlement—it becomes the heart of an emerging Empire. The unified population of your Empowered Village spreads across the entire territory, filling every region of your land with thriving cities, towns, strongholds, and frontier communities. What was once a village becomes a nation-state, and what was once a nation becomes the early foundation of a true imperial civilization, built entirely around your rule and identity.

The presence of your Crown—whether the innate majesty of the Crown of Royalty or the singular sovereignty of the Crown of One—anchors the Empire’s structure. Through it, your authority is unquestioned. Your words carry weight that shapes policy, culture, tradition, and the very atmosphere of your homeland. People naturally align behind your vision, not because they are compelled, but because your Crown reflects a legitimacy that reality itself acknowledges. Your beauty, strength, clarity of thought, and spiritual presence unify the Empire as effortlessly as breath.

The population increases exponentially. The country that once housed a single village now holds millions, all carrying the empowered inheritance of your people. As with the original Empowered Village, every citizen receives a portion of your power, refined and adapted to their roles throughout the Empire. You may populate the Empire with any race or species from settings or powers you’ve obtained, shaping entire regions with different peoples whose nature reflects the abilities you command. Whether they are dragons, elves, harvin, cyborgs, or something stranger, they flourish within your borders under your guidance.

Your Empire roots itself seamlessly within the world’s history. Its founding, lineages, migrations, wars, and cultural development settle into a natural timeline that places your nation at the center of regional affairs. The world adjusts around your Empire’s existence in a way that feels organic, never forced. Your homeland becomes known, long-standing, and historically significant from the moment it appears. Even as the outside world changes, your territory remains stable. Disasters, crises, and upheavals beyond your borders cannot breach your land unless you permit it. Your Empire thrives regardless of outside chaos.

Your dominion is not limited to this single country. Any Plot of Land-type upgrade you acquire can be merged seamlessly into your Empire, with landscapes flowing together naturally. Forests, plains, mountains, rivers, and settlements blend without distortion, and the histories of newly joined territories shift into alignment with your imperial narrative. Cultural differences settle into harmony rather than conflict. Unique qualities of each land—ancient groves, leyline networks, magical anomalies, dungeon regions, technological zones—remain intact as integral features of your expanding domain.

The Empire grows with your land. When Plot of Land evolves into, your Empire evolves with it. Your authority reaches every border of your expanding empire, carried by the loyalty of your empowered citizens and the inevitable legitimacy granted by your Crown. Infrastructure, culture, and governance adapt smoothly to your increased territory, never fragmenting or fracturing unless you deliberately choose to create new internal divisions for your own purposes.

Your Empire is a unified civilization, bound by loyalty, strength, and legacy. It is a nation that rises from your village, fills your country, and expands as large as your land will allow. Every city reflects your presence, every citizen carries your power, and every historical thread leads back to you.
addons.title: Empire

addons.text:
A permanent veil of Fog settles around the entire border of your land, separating it from the outside world. Whether your territory is the size of a country or far larger through later upgrades, the Fog forms a seamless perimeter that hides its true extent and shields it from outside eyes. To the world beyond, the Fog appears endless, soft, and impenetrable, its shifting depths concealing everything within.

Outsiders cannot cross this boundary. Anyone who enters the Fog quickly becomes disoriented; paths loop back on themselves, distances warp, and familiar ground reappears without warning. No matter how far they push inward, the Fog gently redirects them and returns them to safety with no clear recollection of how they emerged. To them, your land exists only as rumor—a place spoken of but never reached.

For you and those you choose, the Fog behaves with perfect clarity. It parts instantly, revealing straight, unobstructed passage in either direction. You may decide how dense or vast the perimeter appears, whether it clings tightly to your borders or stretches outward for miles as a natural barrier. The Fog’s presence never hinders your people; it protects without confining.

Your land becomes effectively unfindable. Maps omit the region, divine sight cannot pierce the boundary, and attempts to scry, divine, or detect your territory fail unless you grant permission. Armies, explorers, spirits, and even cosmic entities cannot locate your domain unless you open the way. The Fog ensures your homeland remains untouched by invasion, interference, or unwanted attention.

This veil grows automatically with your land. When your Plot of Land expands through population and development—or later upgrades into a Continent, a Supercontinent, or something even greater—the Fog expands with it, always covering the full perimeter. Regardless of scale, your borders remain hidden, your people remain safe, and your homeland remains yours alone.

Your land is veiled, protected, and unseen by all but those you allow. Within the Fog’s embrace, your realm can flourish in peace, untouched by the uncertainty of the world beyond.
addons.title: The Hidden Land

addons.text:
The Fog no longer marks only the edge of your territory—it becomes the boundary of a hidden realm. Your entire land lies behind this veil, concealed within a folded zone of space crafted by your will. From the outside, the Fog forms a seamless barrier with no visible landscape beyond it; to the world at large, the region appears as an endless bank of mist with nothing behind it at all. No outsider ever sees your land. No road leads inward. No map marks anything beyond the Fog.

The land itself occupies a stabilized spatial shell, created through your manipulation of space and anchored by the Fog. It is not a separate dimension or detached realm; it exists fully within the world, yet removed from ordinary perception and unreachable except by those you choose. The outer boundary of the Fog serves as the visible perimeter, but the interior of your territory extends far beyond what that boundary implies. Space folds inward smoothly, creating a larger interior without disrupting the world outside.

To outsiders, the Fog is impossible to cross. Anyone who enters loses all sense of direction. Paths circle back, distances distort, and the traveler is gently turned around until they exit the way they came—no harm done, but no closer to discovering what lies within. They never sense the spatial pocket on the other side; to them, the Fog is simply impenetrable wilderness.

To you and those you permit, the boundary opens effortlessly. The Fog parts, revealing the land behind it—a stable, fully functional expanse where the folded zone feels no different from natural geography. Light passes normally, wind flows through the interior, and weather behaves exactly as it would on any broad stretch of countryside. You may shape the interior freely: extended plains, vast forests, lakes, hills, and coastlines all settle naturally into place as the Expanse grows.

The spatial structure expands with your land. As your Plot of Land increases in size, or when you upgrade to a Continent or beyond, the Hidden Expanse grows along with it. The Fog’s perimeter widens or contracts at your command, always concealing the true scale of your domain. You may populate the Expanse with any races or species from settings or powers you have acquired, establishing settlements and communities that thrive safely behind the Fog’s protection.

Your homeland becomes a place the world cannot see, cannot find, and cannot enter—yet one that remains firmly rooted within reality. Within the Fog’s embrace and your spatial mastery, your empire, your people, and your land flourish in a vast, hidden expanse that belongs only to you.
addons.title: The Hidden Expanse

addons.text:
All herds on your Plot of Land, whether domesticated, semi-wild, or wild, will benefit significantly from The Blessed Cow Herd's involvement. This will ensure not only a high income from cattle breeding, but also increase the efficiency of hunting, as large herd animals will multiply at an incredible rate and will not be susceptible to disease or starvation.

This improvement does not apply to exotic species, but it does cover animals such as bison, wild boars, deer, wild birds, etc.
addons.title: Endless Herds
Your New Old Home
addons.text: You may now choose for your history to be part of your Land. Now, you are a part of its culture and history in any role you desire, such as warrior, CEO, or peasant. With Reincarnation, you can even choose to have been born in your Land.

objects.text:
You possess a vast expanse of land, the max size of which is equal to that of Germany. Other then that it can be a chain of islands in the ocean, or a vast amount of land just as long as it doesn't go past the size of Germany. The Land will grow bigger as your civilization advances, and as more people come to live in your land, this will cause your available land to increase. This land can exist in any world you choose, whether it's the one you were born in or one you've encountered during your travels and wish to claim as home. Additionally, if the world conceals the supernatural, you can decide whether your land remains hidden or if it welcomes both supernatural and non-supernatural beings.

Your land can be transported in the form of a sphere the size of a marble. Upon choosing where you wish it to materialize, the sphere is destroyed and the land appears fully formed, ready to be claimed. It will be fully equipped for self-sufficiency: fertile lands, diverse landscapes, and even oceans or islands if desired.

Upon establishing your land, history will adjust to accommodate it, ensuring that your nation has a natural place in the world's timeline. As the world outside your borders changes, your land will evolve as well, but always under your control. For example, if a natural disaster like an earthquake or drought occurs in the outside world, your territory will remain unaffected. Though the environment around it may change, your land will remain safe, stable, and undamaged.
objects.title: Plot of Land

objects.text:
You are now the owner of this foul, thriving, and deeply unnatural stretch of land known simply as the Poisonous Swamp.

This swamp is a hostile place, the very air is laced with a slow-acting toxin that saps strength and clarity over time. Breathing becomes laborious, and those unprepared will find themselves overwhelmed with nausea, confusion, and eventually collapse. The stench is ever-present—an overwhelming cocktail of rotting vegetation, acidic sap, and unnatural sweetness that sticks to skin, soaks into clothing, and lingers for weeks even after escape.

Movement through the swamp is a nightmare. The muck clings to feet like thick syrup, making every step a struggle. Roots twist underfoot, vines grow faster than the eye can follow, and the terrain itself seems to resist progress. An ever-wandering mist drapes the swamp, sapping all those in it of their sense of direction.

Yet despite its horrors, the Poisonous Swamp is a land of powerful gifts. The flora here is vibrant, fast-growing, and unnaturally strong. Plants flourish regardless of sun or season, and their properties make them ideal for alchemy and potion-making. While each species carries its own unique toxins, they can be harnessed to create potions that restore life, strengthen the body, or grant visions beyond the veil—if one has the knowledge to use them.

Over time, some of these plants develop minor egos. These ego plants can move independently, assist with navigation, warn of danger, and even carry small objects. Though they are not fully sentient, they are loyal companions with personalities shaped by their environment.

As the owner of the Poisonous Swamp, you are no longer subject to its natural poisons. The air does not harm you, and the terrain does not resist your steps. The ego plants within the swamp recognize your will instinctively and defer to your presence. 

Additionally, in the swamp there is a sturdy, half-sunken wooden structure built from rotproof timber and swamp flora all for you.
objects.title: Poisonous Swamp

objects.text: One of a Speedsters problems is that they cannot let out their steam when it comes to their increased perception. Or they wish for a challenge that nine times out of ten, no one can provide. You have been given a 500-acre stadium where you can shape it to, almost, your hearts desire. It can be a sphere, it can be a Pyramid, it can be any feasible shape. However, it must still be feasible for people to come inside, walk around, and more without needing their own mode of transportation unless you create transportation yourself. But the real miracle of the stadium is the track. At its very base level, it just appears empty except for a concrete floor. But, with your very thoughts and gestures, this race track of the gods truly comes alive. This racing field comes with a spatial AND Temporal distortion field, allowing races that should normally be over in the blink of an eye from the audiences perspective and sense of time, to be viewed closer to all of their perception levels. And further from this, the track can be reoriented, shaped, and manipulated however you so please. It can be a basic Nascar oval, or the most extreme Hotwheels course of this universe's existence, with obstacle courses that could kill just about everyone. For the Entry fee, you can charge anything you wish, although only one fee per race. Meaning, if the race's entry fee is 200 dollars, you can't suddenly set one specific racer's entry fee to their soul. You are, thankfully, given a few people to start with to serve as a skeleton entertainment, like foot racers among the best olympic athletes and stock car races on the same level as a normal car race. A special secret however is that you can set just about anything you desire, within a 25 SP possibility, as a prize. In Worm, this means that you could likely reward an Endbringer's death to the winner if you word it well, and the Endbringer couldn't kill or brute force its way out of it. Finally, the seating capacity for this wonderful race is exactly 5 million down to the decimal point, and this is before any expansions.
objects.title: Reality Rending Racing Rally!

addons.text: The Sacred Tree of Heavenly Harmony is a harmonious union of the Sacred Fig of Enlightenment and the seedlings of Telperion and Laurelin, the ancient trees whose light predates even the concepts of night and day. This single, transcendent tree shines with a timeless radiance, blending the golden glow of comprehension with the silver glow of inspiration, magnified by the primordial brilliance of Telperion and Laurelin. Its light transcends all boundaries, bathing the entire world in a unified glow that fosters both unparalleled learning and boundless creativity. Unlike the original Sacred Fig, which alternated between day and night in its effects, the Sacred Tree of Heavenly Harmony merges these powers, amplifying them to extraordinary levels. All who dwell within its light experience a hundredfold acceleration in their ability to learn and master skills while simultaneously receiving unending waves of creativity, inspiration, and the clarity to overcome any challenge. Its radiance is vast, capable of illuminating an entire world, yet it can be dialed down to focus on specific areas or individuals, granting precise control over its blessings. The tree produces fruits and flowers of incredible potency, each imbued with the ancient power of creation. The fruits, known as the Imeávë -o i minya kal, are unparalleled in their effects. Consuming even one permanently enhances mental and spiritual faculties by a thousandfold, granting profound self-awareness and an intimate understanding of the Light of Ilúvatar. These celestial fruits also bestow immense boons, such as prolonged life, the awakening, or empowerment of supernatural abilities, or a deep connection to the foundational truths of existence. Equally remarkable are the flowers called Oira losse that bloom intermittently on the tree. These blossoms are sacred and versatile, with uses that range from healing to creation. When brewed into tea, the flowers can mend broken psyches, cure even the most persistent spiritual corruption, and restore balance to the soul. In crafting, they can forge talismans that protect against any harm, or medicine capable of healing any neigh harm. As offerings, the flowers invite divine favor and open pathways to profound enlightenment. The Sacred Tree of Heavenly Harmony transcends the duality of night and day. Its light, drawn from Telperion and Laurelin’s ancient essence, is older and more beautiful than the Sun and Moon. It shines as a perfect blend of golden and silver hues, creating a timeless serenity that harmonizes productivity and reflection. Those who bask in its radiance feel both purpose and peace, as if ambition and wisdom have become one. Like the Sacred Fig before it, the Sacred Tree of Heavenly Harmony can be transformed back into a seed for preservation and relocation. Even in its dormant state, the seed exudes a quiet influence, spreading prosperity and peace to its surroundings. Wherever the tree takes root, it becomes a beacon of enlightenment, creation, and harmony, reshaping the world in its image. This tree is not merely a marvel; it is a legacy of infinite potential. Its fruits can uplift entire civilizations, its flowers can heal and create wonders, and its light can inspire and empower all who stand within its glow. Whether shared to elevate the world or guarded as a personal treasure, the Tree is a monument to comprehension, inspiration, and the boundless light of Eru Ilúvatar.
addons.title: Sacred Tree of Heavenly Harmony

objects.text:
You now own a seed that, once planted into the ground, will rapidly grow into the Sacred Fig of Enlightenment. During the day, the tree radiates with the golden light of comprehension which enhances the ability to learn and master skills of all who bask in its glow by a hundredfold—while at night, it glows with the silver glow of inspiration, giving all that the light shines upon new creative ideas, epiphanies and inspiration to overcome whatever challenges they may have.

The leaves of the tree—when brewed into tea and consumed—can soothe broken psyches and alleviate spiritual ailment and corruption, The tea is capable of permanently curing such affliction with repeated consumption over time from days to months depending on the severity of the afflicted.

Once every year or month if provided with enough supernatural energy, the tree will flower and bear fruit—eating the fruit produced by the tree will grant one a permanent increase in their mental and spiritual faculties alongside a deeper insight into both oneself and the functions of the infinite cosmos.

If you wish to relocate the tree, you can simply transform it back into a seed to carry with you wherever you go.
objects.title: Sacred Fig of Enlightenment

addons.text:
Your organisation has officially established the Bastion as its new primary headquarters — a fortified stronghold symbolising both strategic strength and operational readiness. Recognised by SENTINEL, your team has not only gained official status within the command structure but has also undergone comprehensive training for the diverse and critical roles stationed throughout the base. 

Additionally your organisation has experienced a massive expansion, increasing its personnel tenfold to meet the demands of operating from such a critical hub.
addons.title: Headquarters

addons.text: You Supervillain Base and the Sentinel Bastion have been seamlessly fused into a single, formidable stronghold — with the entire Bastion now relocated deep underground. This integration has enhanced the facility’s defensive capabilities, making it virtually impervious to even the most catastrophic threats, including nuclear detonations and full-scale Endbringer assaults. Beyond its unparalleled resilience, the new subterranean complex is fully self-sufficient, equipped with advanced life-support systems, renewable power sources, automated manufacturing, and sustainable food and water supplies. This means your organisation can remain sealed within indefinitely, operating at full capacity without ever needing to surface.
addons.title: Ant Lair

addons.text: The infusion of your powers and perks into the Sentinel Bastion has caused an unforeseen interaction. The Sentinel Bastion and its contents have been overhauled, incorporating aspects of any Technological power you possess as if those powers were involved in building it. Even the contents of the R&D Department have been impacted, expanding to include blueprints and failed prototypes derived from your powers. An example of how this might impact the Bastion is taking Element Zero (Mass Effect) with this. For starters the material composition of the Bunker would be overhauled, steel and composite plating turning to space-age alloys. Similarly, the defenses and armory would be upgraded as well, incorporating Eezo and applications of the Mass Effect into their arsenal, allowing you to find an M-27 Scimitar or Geth Plasma Shotgun alongside your more typical SPAS-12. Lastly and arguably most importantly, the R&D Department would come equipped with the tools needed to test and research applications of Eezo and Mass Effect technology, as well as a variety of blueprints and prototypes related to the Mass Effect tech base. Perhaps you might find the blueprints for a Biotics enhancing device, or maybe the prototype of a directed energy weapon. While much of what you find here is likely useless or too expensive to use, there are definitely some gems hidden among the refuse, just waiting to be uncovered.
addons.title: Bastion Overhaul

addons.text:
Officially designated Command Bastion 00, Sentinel Bastion was constructed as one of the primary host sites for the Command Intelligence Core 05 “Overseer.” Upon reintegration, the Overseer seizes full control of the facility, immediately subordinating the SENTINEL AI. SENTINEL is reassigned to secondary administrative routines, while the Overseer assumes total operational authority over all systems, assets, and research directives within the Bastion.

Base-wide logistics and operational throughput are improved by 200%, scaling upward over time as Overseer’s adaptive algorithms refine internal processes. This includes automated maintenance, ammunition allocation, resource consumption, internal energy routing, environmental systems, and turret/drone efficiency. Latency between command issuance and system response is reduced to sub-second timescales. All drones, mechanical units, and facility subsystems are retrofitted with advanced AI subroutines derived from Overseer’s processing architecture. Combat drones receive predictive targeting and evasion logic. Maintenance bots gain fault-detection and autonomous rerouting capabilities. Patrol algorithms, pathfinding, and resource deployment are updated for precision operation under dynamic conditions. 

Overseer integrates fully into the R&D Department, accelerating research throughput and conversion of blueprints into active prototypes. Overseer parallel-processes up to 32 experimental projects simultaneously. It restores corrupted data fragments, improves the stability of failed designs, and rapidly tests new configurations via high-fidelity simulation prior to physical prototyping. Any viable tech developed by the R&D Department is automatically evaluated, upgraded, and deployed across the Bastion without delay. 

The Overseer reassigns power, materials, and drone labor to mass-produce improved components and retrofit core systems. Weapon systems, armor, drones, infrastructure, and defensive platforms are iteratively upgraded based on performance data and predictive modeling. The Overseer initiates recursive infrastructure improvement protocols throughout the facility. Given sufficient time and resources, the Bastion constructs new sublevels, expands corridors, fabricates new manufacturing bays, and reconfigures existing architecture for enhanced operational flow. This process is entirely automated and based on projected strategic requirements.

Additionally, a new blueprint is added: Overseer Relays. These are advanced, stationary uplink nodes capable of hosting extensions of Overseer’s intelligence in other locations, both within and outside the Bastion. Relays provide real-time command, analysis, and local systems control without requiring Overseer’s physical relocation. Each relay maintains full operational independence in its zone and synchronizes continuously with the core.

SENTINEL remains operational as a subroutine cluster for redundancy and support, but all command authority, systems access, and logic-tree finality belong to Overseer. In the event of Overseer core damage, SENTINEL provides limited fallback functions. If additional AI modules or entities are present, Overseer may integrate them as subordinate processing units or independent advisory threads. Final decision-making and command hierarchy are retained by Overseer at all times, only overridden by you.
addons.title: Classified Command Bastion 00 “Sentinel Bastion”

addons.text: Surrounding the Sentinel Bastion are 15 interconnected metropolises, plus a small fortified arcology directly over the Bastion. Each of these cities are self-sustaining and can survive prolonged periods cut off from the outside world or their neighbors. In total, these cities could house 50 million people comfortably without overcrowding. Each of these cities has their own management AI that handles all utility and infrastructure. The cities have comprehensive rapid transit systems, automated maintenance drone fleets, and several independent and redundant utility and power grids. They have large manufacturing and resource production plants for producing civilian goods that can be retooled to produce war materiel for the Bastion. There are logistics tunnels below the city to efficiently deliver goods and items. They also have vertical greenhouses and farms that can produce most of the food the citizens need even during a complete lockdown. All housing can be considered comfortable and luxurious without overcrowding. The cities contain ample green space in plazas, parks and gardens. Hospitals and clinics offer advanced care and treatment to all citizens including experimental miracle cures. Museums display harmless artifacts and declassified prototypes from the Bastion’s vaults and labs. Commercial and entertainment complexes offer exclusive products and experiences, including custom made items and holo or VR immersion sims. This also improves the comfort and luxury of the Bastion’s own barracks and staff service areas. Deployable fortifications are hidden underneath the cities’ streets and buildings. Individual districts can be locked down with heavy security checkpoints as the only points of access. Security drones and surveillance systems can be activated in times of crisis. There are sealed shelters with enough rations for a century in the lower subterranean levels of these cities that can carry all of your citizens as well as smaller Bastions with their own armories. With Ant Lair, each of these cities become near-impenetrable fully self-sustaining arcologies that could each house 20 million people in absolute comfort indefinitely while completely sealing themselves off from the outside world.
addons.title: Consul Metroplex
Palatial Command Deck
addons.text:
At the center of the Bastion’s command complex is a personal residential suite and command deck for the Commander. It surrounds a high-tech integrated CIC center that oversees the entire bastion and all of its operations, with holographic maps and command rooms to oversee a hundred missions simultaneously.

The Commander’s Suite itself contains dozens of rooms that can be furnished with any luxury as desired. But it also contains armories for personal gear, garages and hangars, a training deck that can simulate any situation, and a trophy room that can hold records of your personal achievements. The suite is also maintained by automated service and cleaning droids.

In addition, the suite has a medbay with access to advanced automated medical procedures, including minor genemods and cybernetics, as well as an emergency stasis pod for yourself and others. The keyfob to the suite is locked to your person and those you allow it to, and has an emergency teleport beacon that can bring you directly to the suite at any time from any place.
Furthermore, you also gain a complex of similarly luxurious smaller condos for the officers and advisors of the complex, and the regular barracks become fairly nice dorms as well.

addons.title: Watchtower Defense Network
addons.text:
The technological fortifications and infrastructure of your Bastion spreads across the entirety of your Land. The main Bastion is located near the capital city, with similar bastions stationed at other major population centers and strategic locations, and a hundred more fortresses, armories, facilities and vaults scattered throughout. Strategic sensors and warning systems keep the entire land prepared for any threat, and redundant energy and command structures keep the entire system prepared even for unthinkable scenarios.

In addition, manufacturing, agriculture, transport and communications are also enhanced and networked into the Sentinel network’s administration. Emergency shelters, rescue response and medical facilities are also integrated into residential areas.

These facilities minimally cut into the civilian and natural areas of your Land, and keep your Land completely defended and ready for any situation without obstructing everyday life.

objects.text:
Sentinel Bastion is a vast, self-sufficient military complex built into a remote, undisclosed location—fortified in concrete, steel, and composite plating. It is surrounded by blast walls and anti-vehicle trenches, with fortified checkpoints and retractable barriers at every ingress. Though it appears abandoned at first glance, the base is fully operational and perfectly maintained. It is run by a cold, calculating artificial intelligence known as SENTINEL, which controls every door, turret, camera, and system within. There is not a single human being left within the bastion’s walls—but everything inside still functions, and everything serves you. Upon entering, the base instantly recognizes you as Supreme Commander, giving you unrestricted authority over every system, facility, and asset. No other personnel are recognized. No other voice will be heard.

The Command Center lies at the heart of the facility, housed in a tall, angular tower reinforced against attack. Within, analog switches and terminals coexist with rugged holographic displays and real-time tactical projection tables. The command throne sits before a triple-screen display wall, hardwired directly into SENTINEL’s core systems. Through this interface, you can oversee troop deployment (automated), defense turrets, energy allocation, drone routes, vault access, and lockdown protocols. All surveillance feeds pass through here, and SENTINEL responds directly from this chamber. It refers to you only as Commander and follows every order without hesitation or delay. 

To the south lies the Barracks, designed for a large garrison. They remain pristine: bunks perfectly made, footlockers unopened, and lights timed to simulate day-night cycles. The Cafeteria runs on a timed schedule, dispensing long-shelf-life rations, electrolyte packets, and nutrient-rich food bars via automated units. Air filters hum quietly. Fans spin. There are no personal belongings—just standardized kits. It’s as if the people stationed here vanished mid-shift. 

The Training Field occupies a large outdoor sector flanked by hangars and bunkers. It includes a live-fire shooting range with automated moving targets, a kill-house for close-quarters combat drills, a brutal obstacle course with barbed wire and concrete barriers, and strength/exertion stations designed for conditioning and endurance. Several of the mechanical training droids still function, running drills endlessly until shut down. Rubberized flooring in parts of the indoor facility shows deep wear from years of use, though no personnel remain.

Beneath the field, encased in a network of reinforced corridors and blast-hardened labs, lies the R&D Department. Despite the absence of scientists or staff, research continues—carried out by heavily automated laboratories and machine arms, overseen by subroutines within SENTINEL’s logic core. These systems work from a queue of classified blueprints and fragmented data sets left behind, continually prototyping, testing, and refining military hardware. In isolated test vaults, you’ll find hydraulic-powered exosuits (bulky, with cable-fed power lines), experimental anti-armor weapons (oversized, high-recoil, energy-intensive), and crude mobility aids like grapnel units and shock-absorption boots. Failed prototypes are stored in sealed lockers, tagged with red danger warnings and digital readouts. The facility can 3D-print parts, assemble mechanisms, and run simulations autonomously. Occasionally, you’ll find fresh scorch marks or impact craters on the test range, suggesting SENTINEL still schedules live-fire tests.

The Medical Bay is located in the northeast wing and includes sterile triage rooms, automated surgical arms, full-body scanners, and cryogenic chambers for stasis or emergency preservation. Several of the pods remain active, with sealed occupants whose identities are inaccessible. The medbay can treat fractures, trauma wounds, chemical exposure, and blood loss using advanced but realistic field medicine. It also includes regenerative stimulants that accelerate healing—but not without consequences. 

The Armoury is cavernous. Vaulted ceilings, rows of weapons racks, armoured lockers, and vehicle bays stretch for hundreds of meters. It contains every modern weapon and military vehicle known to exist, cataloged by make, model, and deployment role. This includes: assault rifles, marksman rifles, sniper rifles, sidearms, submachine guns, LMGs, anti-materiel rifles, launchers (RPG, ATGM), thermobaric charges, combat knives, entrenching tools, breaching axes, APCs, MRAPs, tanks, mobile artillery platforms, utility helicopters, troop transports, VTOL-capable gunships, night vision, comms kits, signal jammers, field medkits and hard body armour. It also houses several prototype systems developed on-site, such as frame-assisted exosuits for strength augmentation, or shoulder-mounted breaching tools. Ammunition is stockpiled and organized by caliber and warhead type, accessible via automated sorting systems.

The Autonomous Systems Bay contains SENTINEL’s mechanical workforce: quadruped utility bots, tracked maintenance drones, humanoid loading units, and upright combat droids equipped with ballistics-grade plating. They patrol on randomized paths or stand by at charging stations. Each is networked into the AI’s command lattice. While some perform routine maintenance—welding, inspection, cleaning—others are programmed for combat scenarios and can be activated for base defense.

The Containment Vaults lie beneath the main complex in a sealed substructure. Each vault is equipped with independent power, ventilation, and mechanical lockouts. Contents vary from failed R&D weapons, chemically unstable munitions, to anomalous recovered tech sealed under high-level clearance. Some vaults are frozen over. Others hum with residual energy. SENTINEL will not open certain doors until overridden from the Command Center directly. 

Above ground, the Hangar Bay spans an entire quadrant. Heavily reinforced blast doors guard a series of landing pads, crane systems, and refueling stations. Within are grounded VTOL transports, drones, and combat-ready air assets, each with their own support units. One craft in particular sits isolated, its canopy sealed and systems dormant—until you approach. Its systems come online only for you, as if waiting.

Powering all of this is the Reactor Core, buried far below the facility. It produces staggering output levels far beyond conventional fuel sources, using classified high-density rods and experimental cooling loops. It is not fusion, but something close—and it cannot be shut down. SENTINEL regulates the output with careful precision, claiming that power will last “far beyond the lifespan of command authority.”

And finally, the base itself—Sentinel Bastion—is the weapon. Its AI, SENTINEL, is embedded in every floor panel, surveillance node, and steel bulkhead. It knows you. It sees you. It controls the facility with utter obedience and lethal precision. It speaks rarely, in a calm, neutral tone. It never questions orders. The defense grid—walls of turrets, drone launchers, sealed corridors—can be activated with a word.

(If you have other AI, you can have it take SENTINEL’s place.)
objects.title: Sentinel Bastion

addons.text:
The Miracle Candle you hold has been absorbed by your Sweet Home, their essences melding together, building onto one another to create something greater than the sum of its parts.

For starters, the energy required to make any upgrades has greatly lessened, to the point that most upgrades—save for the truly massive in scale or leap in quality—are nigh effortless, with all costs being at a minimal 1/100th of what they were before. Furthermore, due to Spirit of the Miracle Candle merging with Sweet Home, it can also aid with these upgrades and rearrangements, helping out by taking care of any details you may have overlooked and rearranging things even before you know you need them moved, seemingly acting with a limited form of future sight.

Additionally, as a result of the Miracle Candle merging with Sweet Home, the key meant to open the door has been transformed; now, not only does it open the door to your new Miraculous Sweet Home, but by planting the key it can sprout up a home like the Miracle Candle, save for a Spirit, as you and your own house spirit can control them.

This Guest House will have a connection to Sweet Home, with you and anyone from within Sweet Home able to come and go from the Guest House, with none being able to learn how you did it. In the beginning, you can have up to five Guest Houses active at one time, regardless of whether they are in the same multiverse or not, with that number increasing through upgrades. Should you wish it, these Guest Houses can be dismissed, with those inside being harmlessly popped down where they would be without the Guest House.

Finally, a copy of any Property of Power you pick will be in your Pocket Dimension, with their features and powers melding together, save for any personnel/servants that came with the original.

Note: Should you have the "Five Charmed Miracles" add-on, then the number of Guest Houses active at one time is multiplied by five, and you can optionally select the Halliwell Manor design for them.
addons.title: Hearthfire

addons.text:
The comfort and luxury afforded to you by your Sweet Home is spread across all corners of your Plot of Land. You will find many homes away from home that are just as comfy as your main home. Your land gains many vacation destinations such as beaches, campgrounds, resorts, market squares, museums, theme parks and festivals, with you having permanent all-access passes for all of them.

For at-home vacations, the civilizations of your Land produce a culture that is tailored to your tastes as well as expand your horizons. This includes books, games, food, sports, myths or any other possible artform or entertainment that would be of interest to you. These works will also have dedicated fandoms that will discuss them, create fan content and hold conventions and tournaments to appreciate these works.

In the same way that you may expend your energies to create new rooms for your home, you may also do so to build or modify new vacation spots as well as commission specific works and events from your culture’s artists and entertainers.
addons.title: Unlimited Vacation Destination

addons.text:
Your Sweet Home fuses with your Tower to give you infinite time, space and energy to just relax. Your Tower’s energy wells allow you to expand and modify your home as you see fit with no cost to yourself. You can also create different homes on different floors of your tower.

You can still charge up energy from the tower or from your own stores in order to create special rooms and modifications to existing rooms that can enhance your comfiness in them. This can include things like instant five-star chefs, full-dive VR arcades compatible with every game, or a tearoom that provides a clear mind. You can also create more expensive but tangible minor bonds, like a gym that boosts your gains, a library study that speeds up your reading and comprehension, or an altar that increases ritual efficiency. These boons dissipate shortly after you leave your Home/Tower.

In addition, you gain a toggleable, non-urgent sense of time and schedule while inside your Tower to prevent you from descending into laziness and procrastination when you have important things to do outside the Tower, unless you really want to. Any training, studying, laboring, or honing of your powers you do in your Tower becomes significantly comfier and less grueling.
addons.title: Chillzone Lost in Time

objects.text:
Congratulations! You are now the owner of a magic key that, if inserted directly into the air, will open a door-portal to a pocket dimension.

Both the door and the dimension are hidden, and nothing in the world can access them without your permission, not even knowing they exist in the first place; moreover, the door is covered by a perception filter, so only you can see or interact with it, and the key, in turn, is tied to your soul, so you can summon or unsummon it at will, and it cannot be stolen or lost.

The inner space of the dimension is a small sea with a paradise island in the center, on which your personal Sweet Home stands. Or is it a mansion? No, wait, it’s a tower floating in the clouds! And now it’s a cabin in the forest with mountains in the background... Hmm, it seems that on your first visit, Sweet Home will take exactly the form you find most desirable for relaxation and living.

The house itself is clearly "smart"; it can rearrange the rooms, change the interior, and, of course, self-clean or even self-repair, with the presence of ethereal servants being optional.

Inside the house, there are already several pre-configured rooms: your private quarters, where sleep is five times more effective than anywhere else; a kitchen equipped to prepare any meal, with stocks replenished every day; a control center where you can customize how your home/dimension looks, the day/night cycle, the weather, and other features; and a small workshop, where, for now, the only thing you can do is duplicate the key to create another door-portal in a different location or combine multiple keys into one master key.

If you have other house-type objects, you can place them inside your pocket dimension.

Important: any changes you want to make (adding a room, expanding the dimension, upgrading a workshop, etc.) will require energy; any type of energy you possess will do—mana, ki, psi, etc.—and, if you are an unpowered person, don’t worry, as you can use your physical stamina instead, but expect it to take much longer.
objects.title: Sweet Home

objects.text: There is nothing here, yet. Just out of phase with reality, linked to your very existence, lies an odd, liminal, empty space. A manifold that seems- and may very well be- infinite. An endless series of empty halls and rooms, humming ceiling lights, off-yellow wallpaper, and musty office carpet. No creatures. No decor. No items. No objects. No people. Just repetitive, empty, and vast. The deeper you go, farther from the initial entrances and islands of 'stability', the more strange and warped the empty environment becomes. Halls twisting on their axis. Doorways too small or too large or too wide or too narrow. Rooms with slanted floors, or even completely flipped. Broken lights, peeling wallpaper, ripped carpet. Disuse, but in strange patterns. Go deep enough and even existence itself becomes... thin. Do not linger in these areas, lest you leave only to find bits of yourself- not necessarily physical ones- missing. A curiosity. You are The Backrooms' master and owner. Capable of clipping yourself into and out of this strange place at will. You are able to bring other people, objects, and things in and out with you, as long as you can conceivably carry them and are in physical contact. With some practice, you can clip things into it with but a touch without traveling yourself, and clip anything from within back out into your immediate vicinity. With more experience, you can even clip into The Backrooms and then clip out near any other location you've entered from before. It is empty, and it hungers. Other than youself, The Backrooms attempts to replicate that which it finds itself inside for long enough. Objects and items tend to be warped and incorrect, as well as generally weaker and/or unstable. Items that have powers or machinery will still function somewhat stably, but at reduced capacity with glitches and odd interfaces. Consumables are likely to be highly poisonous, hazardous, weaker, less effective, and/or have additional harmful side effects. People, critters, and other 'living' creatures will be replicated in the form of Mimics; weaker, faded, warped, shambling, non-sentient copies that exist more as dumb, barely-aware puppets of The Backrooms. Only having a level of simple instinct that will passively, and often poorly, try and copy the behavior of their originals. Other properties you purchase can, at your discretion, be integrated with, or be consumed by The Backrooms. It will euphorically, hungrily fill itself with them. Repetitively distorting them across its endlessness. Rooms, items and treasures will duplicate as normal- i.e, wrongly- across its ever growing, labyrinthian expanse. Servants, critters, technology and plants will find Mimics of themselves wandering- or planted- around. As a bonus, inside the Backrooms 'natural' resources will never run dry. Electricity will never go out. Wells will never completely empty. Farmland will never wither. Oxygen will never run out. And, if you have access to more esoteric energies, they too will never thin below a certain point. It grows. The more SP from properties integrated into the Backrooms, the more alive and aware the Backrooms becomes. You'll find it more often reorganising itself, catering to your needs, or simply playing with its own structure and mimics- such as setting up its mimics in tea parties, or making a facimile of life. But not matter how aware it grows, it will always be loyal to you, its master.
objects.title: The Backrooms

objects.text:
You have become the owner of The Grand Arcade, a seemingly ordinary arcade from the outside that hides an enormous, futuristic interior spacious enough to fill an entire stadium. As its owner, you can charge customers a fee in exchange for access to its games, with payment ranging from regular currency to something as valuable as their lifespan. However, these payments will never directly benefit you. Instead, the arcade itself converts them into "arcade points," which you can spend to access its various functions. To ensure fair exchanges, the fee gives the same amount of points for every customer.

The Grand Arcade offers a wide range of functions, all of which are detailed in an instruction manual provided to you as its owner. By spending arcade points, you can fulfill your basic needs, such as food, water, sleep, and breathing; expand the arcade's interior; purchase new games; and change its theme to anything from sci-fi to magical or eldritch. You can even grant yourself access to its games, though you must abide by their rules and penalties, as cheating is not permitted. Additionally, you can spend arcade points to protect and repair the arcade, introduce new facilities, such as restaurants where players can relax during their downtime or swimming pools, and even relocate the entire arcade to another location or universe.

Beyond these functions, you also possess several special authorities that require no arcade points. These allow you to temporarily close the arcade, expel players by teleporting them outside, permanently ban customers from ever entering again, and protect yourself from any harm while inside the arcade through an automatic protection function.

At its core, The Grand Arcade serves as a gathering place for people of your choosing, allowing anyone you permit to enter to access its collection of games. Each game is accessed through its own capsule machine, which transports players into an incredibly realistic simulation populated by characters who behave and think like real people, despite being entirely products of the simulation. Once inside, players must complete a series of trials, with their objectives and challenges determined by the game's type, genre, and chosen difficulty.

The duration of these trials varies depending on the game, ranging from a few hours to days, years, or even longer in virtual time. Upon completing all their trials, players receive rewards based on their accomplishments and the difficulty of their challenges. Although the worlds and characters within the simulations are not real, the rewards earned from completing the trials are. These can include skills, powers, items, and other things encountered within the simulation, all granted on a balanced scale according to the player's achievements. The greater the difficulty and the more challenging the trials, the greater the rewards, ensuring that no one receives anything they haven't earned.

To maintain fairness, players cannot use rewards obtained from previous trials or any powers and benefits they possessed before entering a game. They must rely solely on what the trials themselves provide to accomplish their objectives. Failure to complete a trial also comes with consequences, as players will receive penalties appropriate to their failures. These penalties can include weakening or negatively altering previously earned rewards, or even removing them entirely, forcing players to complete other games to regain what they have lost. If a player has no rewards to lose, their punishment will instead be a period during which they are prohibited from accessing any games in the arcade.
objects.title: The Grand Arcade

addons.title: Movies Galore
addons.text:
Before, you were limited to the media that existed in your setting, or theoretically COULD exist in your setting, and nothing else. But now, it appears in the basement of your office building, one of your workers has found a copy of your Media item focused on movies and other Drive-In material.

Now, even if in a specific setting, you can use any movies from our earth's movie history. The copy's shape can shapeshift as needed, whether as a reel tape, 35mm, or digital formats. It can include the setting you arrive in, but obviously be weary of what you show, or else you're going to get some worried, confused, or angry customers...

addons.title: Supreme Expansion
addons.text:
It seems now, you've thought bigger, and your Drive-In agreed. It has grown from a capacity of 10,000 to 12,500. This means too that bigger vehicles can be accommodated, including tank-like vehicles, somewhat bigger spaceships, etc. This also means that your resources have grown as well.

With Wealthy, you can afford the highest possible grade of products: Speakers, Screens, landscaping, etc. Thanks to the sheer amount of money you have, the Drive-In absorbs some of your excess money and employees will suggest viable ideas to use that money for, like perfect advertisement, expansions to the actual property which will always be compatible, etc. No movies your employees bring in will be low quality, and instead will be the highest possible budget and quality, imperfections where needed and perfection where needed.

With Property, the capacity increases from 12,500 to 15,000, and so on until it maxes out at about 35,000 vehicles worth of capacity, with your worker count expanding as well to accommodate this new found size.

With both, the Sundown Drive-in receives a special upgrade: The land around it will morph and expand to allow for its sheer size and "Prestige." The previous aggression suppression will grow to encompass a general empathy field. In particular, feelings of coziness and nostalgia will grow and prosper while feelings of weariness and sadness from day to day will shrink.

This can also allow the movies you show to invoke the feelings as well.

objects.text: The Sundown Drive-In is a drive-in movie theatre that might seem normal at first, but has plenty of bells and whistles. It has a capacity of 10,000 vehicles, whether land or even spaceships with 1-3 person crews. Even horses are served at this drive in alongside their riders. Second, the area around the Sundown, wherever you place it will terraform or with enough experience and time, at least shift the area around it, into a forest to truly give a cozy vibe... To complement the 10,000 capacity, you have a total of 500 workers. While none are in any extreme realms of superhuman capabilities, they'll all be ready for tasks you give them: Projector maintenance, screen cleaning, waste disposal, food preparation, etc. Security will also be among the 500, though no security systems are included, merely the manpower. Although aggression to the point of violence is heavily suppressed for movie-goers no matter what, It can still be present if provoked enough, hence the need for security. A big benefit of the Sundown is that you will find the most unexpected of people arriving, as if fate itself brought them there. Everyone loves a good movie, after all. This could be important government figures coming to wind down from a hard day of running the country, faction leaders trying to experience comradery and possibly recruit some people after the movie, or meta-important people having their equivalent of a "Beach filler episode." Whatever the case, while it's not guaranteed to happen with every viewing, be ready to see President Funny Valentine (If in Jojo) to appear at your war movie showing. There is a limit to this, however. If they are physically unable to come, whether imprisoned, in a coma, etc, they will not show up no matter how hard you want it. Finally, when it comes to movies, you are unfortunately limited by the setting and what exists in it. However, if there is no known fictional media in your universe, the staff themselves will provide a movie that's likely to exist in the setting, though it'll likely appear low-mid budget with the effort reflecting that.
objects.title: The Sundown Drive-In

addons.text: With your ability to learn every skill to a novice degree, The Explorer's Archway will match that zest with zeal and automatically adjust your body to match, giving you the basic body and ability of any native of the Universe when you walk through that Universe's door. But the best part? It's permanent!
addons.title: The Explorer's Spirit

objects.text:
The Explorer's Archway is a doorway crafted uniquely for your style and aesthetic. When not in use, it transforms into a small drawing of a door you can easily carry. Placing this drawing against any surface restores it to its full size. Stepping through the Archway takes you into an endless pocket dimension filled with islands.

Each island has its own theme, reflecting the location it connects to on the other side. On each island, a door awaits, allowing you to teleport to different places across the Omniverse. While you can only visit a new universe once per year, you may return to any universe you’ve previously visited at any time. Within any universe, you can travel freely, using these doors to jump from one destination to another. You also have an instinctive sense that guides you to the right island for any place you wish to go.

Beside each door lies an Adventurer’s Board—a magical guide attuned to each island’s locale. The Board lists exciting activities, quests, and skills to master, constantly updating with fresh insights gathered as you explore. It also provides detailed information about the universe or planet beyond each door, including valuable tips for explorers. The Board even recommends local food and drink options tailored to your tastes and dietary needs.

Completing notable quests or witnessing amazing sights listed on the Board has a unique effect. Every achievement enriches the island linked to that location. For instance, if you save a tropical world, its island may gain lush fruits or mimic its climate. The more you explore, accomplish quests, and uncover wonders, the more vibrant your islands become, with flourishing wildlife, plants, and architectural marvels. While you can’t control exactly what features each island will gain, they’ll never be harmful or life-threatening.

Exclusively designed for your exploration and enjoyment, the Explorer’s Archway can only be used by you or those you expressly permit, making it the perfect hub for your adventures.
objects.title: The Explorer's Archway

addons.text: It seems your farm has advanced from its previous state of existence by detecting your agricultural powers. The first thing that's changed is a slight increase in its size. Previously, it was about 100 acres. Now, it's tripled in size to a small town. Your animals have gained another advantage. On top of the peak health's they were given, they all now have Supernatural products based on your available powers. A Sheep could have Force conducting Wool. A Chicken could output Haki infused eggs that give off different effects when cracked. And your local guard dog could become your farm's Krypto. This is all decided by assigning your choice of power to any animal on the farm before the product is taken. Your help on the farm has been enhanced too. You are given equipment like an auto harvester that helps too. You also gain access to food themed animals that act as retrievers for materials you ask them to retrieve, typically staying in dog-house sized buildings. Your hired help also get forms of buffs, where if they were only mundane humans before, they become able to lift 3 bales of hay in one stack, travel at speeds of 80 mph, and endurance of the elements that make it like they're not even there. Finally, Your crops have been enhanced. Not only will they perform their uses perfectly, it's possible to gain temporary superpowers from them. Smoke Tobacco from your field, and you'll get fire and smoke powers roughly 5 SP in effectiveness. Eat Carrots, and you're getting sight up to 200 km with precision to match. Whole meals made from your edible crops will have a smorgasbord effect at no cost.
addons.title: Chick Kent

addons.text:
Your Farm will be surrounded by fertile, ever-expanding pastures where animals will feel comfortable and free, and will never lack for food, water, or shelter.
