Each structure is interconnected with bridges, or rooms that directly lead to another. With every room able to house everything from a modest workshop, a bathhouse, storage room, to something as grand as an amusement park, either pre-generated or can be added by your own power.

The full three dimensional space of this dimension is yours to command. Able to rotate, twist, turn, and flip a single room or the entire structure in any direction, teleport to any room in an instant, or open and close any door with but a thought.

You can enter and leave the castle just as easily.
objects.title: The Infinity Castle (Demon Slayer)

addons.text:
With the Book of Shadows in your possession, the Miracle Candle has gained a new aspect for, along with the Miracle, comes newfound magical power, transforming the Miracle Candle into a Spiritual Nexus, making your home much like Halliwell Manor; however, unlike the Spiritual Nexus under the control of the Charmed Ones, your Spiritual Nexus can only be used by you and those you would approve of.

As a Spiritual Nexus, all the abilities of you, your descendants, and allies are greatly empowered while in and around the house, as the power of the Nexus will help fuel abilities to perform better than normal, cutting the cost required; and, while it works for all abilities, it is most potent with magic and rituals.

The Nexus isn't limited to just strengthening abilities, but can also grant them to those with a strong connection to it; conjuration, barrier creation, possession of others, and telekinesis are merely examples of the powers granted to those with such a connection; and, while initially limited to just yourself, you can help your descendants build a strong connection to the Miracle and Nexus, allowing them to gain these abilities as well.

However, the influence of the Spiritual Nexus is not limited to just your home, as it can influence the world around it, causing the world to shift to be more in line with yourself, making it more positive or negative; and to help strengthen itself, the Spiritual Nexus can take in power from the surroundings within its range, connecting to already existing or even creating its own locations with a connection to the elements of Fire, Water, Metal, Wood, and Earth, drawing in power from its surroundings and empowering them as the area around the Spiritual Nexus becomes more—more potent in energies, more prosperous, more fortunate, and much more.

The greater the amount of power around it, the stronger the Spiritual Nexus becomes, growing slowly over time and storing it away. In the event you have to move the Miracle Candle, all the gathered power will be stored away for later use, either for your use and your descendants' or to aid in constructing a new home, and with it gone, the effects on the local area will begin to slowly fade unless you wish for them to persist in some form.​
addons.title: Five Charmed Miracle

addons.text:
Through your connection with Those Who Came Before and Inheritance, you access the spiritual memory of the original Miracle, giving you a natural bond with—and access to—all the Gifts that have ever appeared in the Madrigal family.

This means you can now heal others with the food you cook like Julieta; influence the weather with your emotions like Pepa; see possible futures like Bruno; control plants like Isabela; possess incredible strength, resilience, and durability like Luisa; hear even the slightest sounds like Dolores; change your appearance at will like Camilo; and even communicate with animals like Antonio.

Unlike individual members of the Madrigal family, you don't have these Gifts as separate, fixed, or constant abilities, but rather, you develop them over time through understanding, practice, and attunement, inheriting the experiences, emotions, and techniques of those who mastered them before you, which allows you to adapt, combine, and express the Gifts in your own unique ways; for example, your power over plants might not depend solely on your emotions, but also let you relate to them in a way similar to how Antonio communicates with animals.
addons.title: Madrigal Mementos

objects.text:
You receive an ever-burning magical candle, with warm and peaceful glow. With this candle, you may choose a safe location, at which point it will create a magical house providing protection and shelter for you, your family and your allies. Any that seek to do you harm will find themselves misled and driven away by the miracle.

The house this creates will be similar to the Madrigal House, animated with a kind and helpful spirit, using its ability to rearrange its features to suit the family's needs, aid them in their daily routines and protect them should it be needed.

Each of your descendants, be they biological or adopted, will receive a power matching their personality as a Gift alongside a door leading to a matching bedroom, larger on the inside and made for comfort and to make best use of their Gift.

As long as harmony reigns within your family, the magical flame of the candle will never go out and its wax will show no signs of melting, and as long as the candle continues to burn brightly the magic will always remain.
objects.title: Miracle Candle (Disney)

objects.text: Amidst the raging chaos of battle, every hero yearns for a sanctuary—a haven where they can find solace, regain strength, and unravel the mysteries that lie in wait. Behold the awe-inspiring Fortress of DOOM, a majestic citadel carved into the heart of an ancient colossal rock. More than a mere structure, it is a celestial bastion, a spacefaring station empowered by the divine and arcane knowledge of the Makyr. With its enigmatic ability to traverse the cosmos, it becomes an omnipresent fortress, silently observing the stars while defying the laws of spatial confinement. Within its sacred walls, arcane fabrication machines hum with the power to forge personalized armaments, while an expansive bay serves as the cradle for colossal war machines like the legendary Atlan. And as you retire to your own private quarters, a panoramic vista unfolds, granting you a breathtaking glimpse of a world forever indebted to your valor. But this fortress of wonders does not stop there, for within its depths, a dark prison awaits—a proving ground where your indomitable powers can be tested upon the demonic horde. And when the call to adventure beckons, a portal device, pulsating with cosmic energies, stands ready to whisk you away to the very edges of existence.
objects.title: The Fortress of Doom (DOOM)

objects.text:
Dr Gero's Laboratory, the birthplace of the cause of the apocalyptic events of the future timeline. A Laboratory used by the brilliant scientist Dr Gero in his quest for revenge against Goku, this facility lies hidden inside a mountainside. This Laboratory holds all the tools necessary for the production of more Androids, including Dr Gero's inventions, such as infinite energy models and energy-draining models. 

This facility has over 20 pods used for creating new androids. Although the name is a misnomer, since the facility is capable of producing both fully robotic entities and cybernetic entities, the materials available to you are limited to making around 5 Androids or 1 Bio-Android using the 20 pods, which can be reprogrammed or used for maintenance on damaged Androids. 

Dr Gero created an Artificial Intelligence capable of computing and designing Androids. Should he ever be incapacitated, however, the computer is not as efficient as he would have been, taking far longer to create new Androids and coming up with new, unique designs. This Artificial Intelligence Super Computer also has access to small robotic drones that the original Dr Gero created to scan the DNA of Alien lifeforms and various techniques that they possess, not genetic in nature, to implant into his Androids. The Laboratory also has samples of aliens that Dr Gero was able to scan, such as Goku, Vegeta, Piccolo, Freeza and King Cold. Should you use the microscopic spybots created by Dr Gero, the Artificial Intelligence Super Computer could have more data to work with.

The Super Computer currently has access to a database of every Ki technique that the various Z Fighters have displayed up until the start of the Cell Saga. You may optionally choose whether the Super Computer's voice is Vomi or Gero.
objects.title: Dr. Gero's Laboratory (Dragon Ball Series)

objects.text:
Now you don’t have to worry about how long you must train yourself or others! 

You gained an entryway to the time-compressed dimension of the Room of Spirit and Time, besides proper accommodations to better take advantage of the Chamber’s environment. Using Dende’s improvements as part of the schematics, common limitations such as limited usage (two times only) aren’t a factor, accompanied by the portable quality: an unassuming key, once you insert it in any door acts as a gateway to the Chamber.

What sets apart this one from the others, is the plethora of possible avenues of training this possesses, taking inspiration from other counterparts across the Dragon Ball franchise and then some: Every 10km the gravity increases by a factor of 10, the temperature fluctuates from frigid to scalding, air pressure is comparably a quarter that of the Earth, you can probably go mad at the endless expanse of the Chamber, bringing physical mirages of past opponents to serve as training partners, those are among the most distinguished features of your Chamber.

Last but not least, the Chamber’s passage of time is compressed, lengthening from one day to one year within the Chamber. Goes without saying, no?
objects.title: Hyperbolic Time Chamber (Dragon Ball Series)

objects.text:
You now have complete ownership and authority over a small, seemingly bucolic town called Eureka and the surrounding area. While on the surface it’s filled with small-town charm, in reality, it’s home to some of the smartest minds in the world, pushing the boundaries of science in ways you can scarcely imagine.

From brilliant geniuses like Henry Deacon—a jack-of-all-trades and former rocket engineer—to Nathan Stark—a Nobel Prize-winning mathematician—along with quirky residents like Jim Taggart—a biological containment specialist, veterinarian, and crypto-zoologist—to its ever-watchful protectors, Sheriff Jack Carter and Jo Lupo. Eureka is filled with a variety of colorful characters. Though some may have come and gone throughout its lifetime, this version of Eureka will feature any and all of your favorite Eureka citizens, all happy for the change in ownership, and ready to get back to science. 

You can optionally name yourself head of Global Dynamics, the largest employer around, where next generation technology and inventions are always being developed. Or perhaps something more like being the Mayor of Eureka would be more your speed? Someone needs to give the townsfolk a voice after all. Alternatively you could leave these positions in the watchful hands that have steered Eureka well in the past. The choice is yours.

By default, Eureka starts in a pocket dimension encompassing the town, Lake Archimedes, Global Dynamics, and all the various labs and locations spread around it. You can choose to integrate Eureka into the wider world, where it will find a place to seamlessly blend in, or incorporate it into any of your other Properties. While some of the aesthetics may change, underneath it will still be Eureka. Of course, you can also return Eureka to its pocket dimension if you wish.

Welcome to Eureka.
objects.title: Eureka (Eureka)

addons.text:
The Big MT has been integrated with several other major American research groups, including Black Mesa and Aperture Science, upgrading the "baseline" level of technology from the 1950s to the early 2000s. This doesn't mean that everywhere has received full renovations yet, just that if you find a terminal it will have a GUI and transistors instead of vacuum tubes, if you find a nuclear reactor it will have modern safety features, guards will be equipped with Iraq era gear rather than Vietnam era gear, or so on.

You receive the New Mexico Black Mesa facility, The Santego Military Base in Arizona, Black Mesa East, White Forest Silo, Kleiner's Lab, & Russell's Lab (all located in Eastern Europe), the Aperture Science Enrichment Center in Michigan, the USS Borealis teleportation research ship, & Black Mesa's extradimensional research posts. These can either be fully integrated into the Big MT campus or kept separate at your discretion.

In terms of personnel, this includes the Black Mesa staff (such as Dr. Freeman, Dr. Kleiner, Dr. Vance, Dr. Breen, Dr. Magnusson, Dr. Cross, Dr. Green, Dr. Rosenberg, Dr. Keller, Barney Calhoun, and many more), the HECU and Black Ops teams (including Adrien Shepard), Resistance personnel (such as Alyx Vance, Odessa Cubbage, Father Grigori, Dr. Mossman, & the Vortigaunts), & the Aperture AI Cores (though you need to purchase the GLaDOS companion separately, otherwise Wheatley will run the Aperture Science section.)

If you have access to the Abiotic Factor addon, Big MT also merges with the GATE Foundation, granting access to the Cascade Research Facility, Flathill, Voussoir, Shadowgate, Dunkeltaler Forest, Albatross, Rise Biolab, Torii, The Temple Of Stone, The Winter Cabin, GATE Staff, The Gatekeepers, and the various Portal World research posts.
addons.title: Black Mesa Research Facility (Half-Life)

objects.text:
The Big MT Research Facility, formally known as the Big Mountain Research and Development Centre, or referred to as the Big Empty, is a pre-war scientific facility recognised for numerous advancements that contributed significantly to America's war efforts.

The Big MT Research Facility, a privately owned establishment, was constructed within a cave system beneath a prominent mountain. It is not an exaggeration to assert that Big MT was the future of humanity, developing technology without constraints, neither moral nor technical. The facility was home to some of the most talented pre-war scientists of the era. Their exploration into the vast unknown of SCIENCE! Created new fields of research and revolutionised existing fields, despite the unethical nature of some developments.

The layout of the facility is centred around the main dome, known as the Think Tank, connected to various other facilities by walkways and tram systems. Each facility focused on different branches of science, such as the X-42 Robo-Warfare Facility, which dealt with robotics and later became known as the Forbidden Zone; the X-22 Facility, which specialised in floral research; and the X-7B Facility, which concentrated on explosives, among many others. If you can imagine any invention from the Fallout universe, there is a significant possibility that a research facility dedicated to its study exists within the Big MT Research Facility.

You have become the chairman, or perhaps a fellow scientist, to Mobius, Klein, Dala, 0, 8, and Borous. The various experiments will not harm you, as they see you as a creator. Therefore, you have nothing to fear from the lobotomites, robo-scorpions, Securitron units, cazadors, or any other experiments.
objects.title: Big MT (Fallout)

objects.text:
You have received an intact version of the Mariposa Military Base untouched by the nuclear wasteland. Housed inside of a mountain similar in nature to the Cheyenne Mountain Complex Mariposa was created as a top-secret military facility meant to house and conduct research on what was originally just supposed to be a cure for the New Plague created by West-Tek, however after experimentation lead to the possibility of creating superhuman soldiers the project would later be confiscated by the military and the strain for the biological agent was later renamed to the Forced Evolutionary Virus

The Mariposa Military Base has five levels, not including the surface level, which houses the defences on the exterior of the mountain complex, along with the vents that provide fresh, clean air for the entire complex. The first level had various force fields and robotic personnel to prevent any intruders from sabotaging the base. The second level mainly housed the living quarters, medical facilities and armoury, with the various facilities stockpiled with as many resources as they could accommodate. 

The third level was where they conducted and housed many of the human experiments on prisoners using the FEV, having an elevator going down to the final level that housed the containers of FEV, as well as the ZAX Supercomputer that ran the computers of the Mariposa facility, which has continued to do experiments on FEV in the absence of any commander.

Not only will the Supercomputer AI recognise you as the new commander of the military facility, but it will also help you conduct any new experiments you may wish to run. Perhaps you could do the impossible and find the theoretical fix to the one flaw in the creation of Super Mutants with enough time and experimentation.
objects.title: Mariposa Military Base (Fallout)

addons.text:
By uniting your standing within the Continental Hotel network with ownership of the Lucky 38, you transform the old casino tower into something far greater: a legendary sanctuary of luxury, secrecy, and influence known as The Continental 38. Rising above the skyline as both palace and fortress, it becomes a destination for assassins, executives, smugglers, mercenaries, nobles, and power brokers alike, serving as the premier western branch of the Continental. Its casino floor serves as neutral ground where fortunes are wagered, disputes are settled, and dangerous people conduct business beneath a veneer of elegance. Not to mention a variety of barely legal rigging mechanisms that allow for you, the house, to almost always win in any betting, gambling, or other casino-related business.

The hidden traditions of the Continental merge with the technological genius of the Lucky 38. RobCo systems and House’s AI oversee reservations, communications, surveillance, and logistics with flawless precision, while Securitrons enforce the sacred rule of neutrality. Violence, theft, or betrayal within your walls is met with swift and decisive consequences. Meanwhile, the sommelier, tailor, doctor, and other discreet services gain access to RobCo’s industrial capabilities, allowing custom weapons, armored attire, cybernetic treatment, forged identities, and rare equipment to be prepared for trusted guests without delay.

As master of the Continental 38, you inherit authority recognized throughout the Continental’s hidden world. You may deny entry, revoke privileges, freeze access to services, or blacklist individuals across the network for violations of its rules. In severe cases, you may declare targets Excommunicado, stripping them of sanctuary, support, credit, and protection while alerting interested parties to their fall from favor. Conversely, you may grant clemency, restore status, or extend sanctuary even to hunted figures, making your favor and judgment highly sought after.
addons.title: The Continental 38

objects.text: The House Always Wins A literal ivory tower overlooking the city of New Vegas, a pre-war casino built by Mr House to act as his Citadel for his massive economic empire. A building that stood the test of time thanks to Houses' predictions, surviving centuries in the wasteland unmarred by the apocalypse. The Lucky 38 features multiple floors, with the ground floor housing the casino, filled with gambling tables and slot machines, and safeguarded with a fleet of Securitrons. The next few floors of the Lucky 38 feature a diverse range of hotel rooms for VIP guests decked out in the most luxurious decorations in Pre-War America. The next floor, one level below the Penthouse Suite and Presidential Suite, is the Cocktail Lounge, featuring a fully stocked bar. The Lucky 38 also possesses a hidden room deep underground that houses a cryogenics chamber used by House to connect to the rest of the Lucky 38, acting as a digital consciousness controlling any machine connected to his system. The Penthouse and Presidential Suite used to be where Robert House would relax, housing the most advanced computers fitted with an artificial intelligence based on House himself in the event of his own death that is now loyal to you along with an experimental Cold Fusion Reactor that powers the hotel and the Securitron Army upgraded with the Platinum Chip, giving access to an army of Securitrons with upgraded coding due to the Platinum Chip. As the new owner of the Lucky 38, you have taken House's place not only as the owner of the Lucky 38 but also as the CEO of RobCo Industries, with the Lucky 38 acting as your base of operations so that you can monitor any of your businesses as the new CEO of RobCo Industries, with the artificial Robert House to guide you should you not have the experience to run such an industrial giant.
objects.title: The Lucky 38 (Fallout)

objects.text:
You receive a genuine, freshly minted, Vault-Tec Vault! And have subsequently been given the title of Overseer. A Vault is a subterranean shelter designed and constructed by the Vault-Tec Corporation under a joint operation contract with the United States government under Project Safehouse with the goal of protecting at least some American citizens from nuclear war and the following nuclear winter. Living in, close to, Pre-War conditions long enough for radiation to disperse... At least that's the public reasoning. In truth the majority of Vaults were inhumane biological, chemical, and sociological experiments. But you need not worry, as you have received a Control Vault. That being a Vault with no experiment.

The Vault itself is protected by thick composite walls of alternating layers of concrete, lead, and steel. The front door is the iconic gear shaped door that is strong enough to survive a direct strike from a nuclear missile around 98 percent of the time. There's also an automated security system of turrets along the hallways and rooms, ranging from small caliber rounds to high caliber machine guns. There's also a security office, a stocked armory, and a brig/prison/jail for your security force to use.

The Vault has a water purifier, running on a water chip, turning brackish irradiated water into pure and thirst quenching water; a generator, able to draw energy from a fusion reactor or thermal energy; a Hydroponics bay, able to grow all kinds of food and plants for your vault. The Vault has manufacturing center. A place where automated machines can build essentially any manufacturable item from Fallout. Vault suits, guns, ammunition, Pip-Boys, computers, chemicals, medicine, and more. However it is only able to create when provided materials, energy, and schematics. Things like the G.E.C.K., Water Chip, and Cryo-pods are out of the picture.

Vault standards of living are quite high. Your Vault has:
- An Atrium. Where things like hairdressers, bars, stores, casinos, jukebox diners, and other recreational activities take place.
- An exercise area. Containing a gymnasium, swimming pool, track, and an artificial field to play things like baseball and soccer.
- A Cafeteria. Where food is usually served.
- Living Areas. Ranging from single family apartments, dormitories, or segregated sex bunks.

Finally, there is your office. The Overseer's office. Connected to the Vault in many ways. From here you have access and control to the turret security system. You can use many cameras, hidden and not, to watch your residents. You have access to a Vault wide intercom system. Lastly, you have control over the Vault door. Able to choose when and if to lock it or open it.

You may place your Vault anywhere, but a geologically stable area such as a mountain that is not a volcano, dormant or active, is recommended. Your Vault is built to house 5,000 people. You may choose your Vault number.
objects.title: Vault (Fallout)

addons.text: “Some stories are reborn, while others are shared—but either way, you’re part of mine now. Whether you carry me or stand beside me, you’ll always be family.” — Tifa Lockhart The Seventh Heaven remembers its heart, but its legend awakens only within someone carrying Tifa Lockhart’s determination to surpass every limit. When Limit Breaker surges through your soul, the tavern lets you choose your true place within Tifa’s life and its family. If Tifa is not your companion, you may become her reincarnation: not a copy, but Tifa’s genuine return in a new life. Her soul and history join yours without erasing your identity, memories, powers, or relationships. You inherit her complete martial ability: unarmed combat, supernatural techniques, chain-strike rhythm, instincts, and every Limit Break she possessed or could develop. Her experiences and talents also become yours, from cooking and bartending to managing the Seventh Heaven and comforting others. Her warmth, courage, and resolve may influence you if desired, but never overwhelm your free will. You may retain your appearance, assume Tifa’s original form, or blend her features with your own. Avalanche recognizes you as Tifa truly reborn, not a stranger carrying borrowed memories. If Tifa is already your companion, you remain separate people and instead choose your bond. You may be her sibling, child, relative, friend, student, mentor, guardian, partner, fellow Avalanche member, or nearly any other connection. The bond may arise through blood, adoption, marriage, friendship, shared hardship, or something beyond conventional definitions. It may have always existed or begin now. For an established bond, the Seventh Heaven integrates you seamlessly into Tifa’s history. Both of you possess genuine memories, experiences, and emotional foundations suited to it, whether you grew up together, lived as family, trained beside her, or shared years of friendship and hardship. Your ages, histories, and family trees adjust only as necessary. Your lineage may remain intact, connect to Tifa’s, or merge with it. No valued relationship is erased, no one is displaced, and no harmful contradiction is created. Alternatively, history remains unchanged and your relationship begins in the present. No past is invented; you meet under circumstances suited to the desired bond and build it through your own choices. Whatever bond you select is authentic and mutually recognized. Tifa retains her identity, personality, agency, and free will. The power establishes only its history, circumstances, and emotional foundation; everything afterward remains shaped by both of you. In either path, you inherit Tifa’s martial talents, Limit Breaks, instincts, and everyday skills without diminishing her. If she remains separate, you may teach one another and share Limit Breaks, combat techniques, and developments achieved through Limit Breaker, letting both of you grow without weakening either. Unrelated powers are not shared automatically. Your appearance may gain a natural resemblance suited to the relationship. Relatives might share features or coloration, while unrelated companions require none. These changes remain under your control. Your place in Tifa’s life extends naturally to Cloud, Barret, Jessie, Biggs, and Wedge. With a shared history, they remember you as someone who lived, worked, and fought beside them. Otherwise, they accept you through your present bond with Tifa. This addon creates no copies, echoes, recreations, replacements, or alternate versions. It grants you a genuine place among Tifa and Avalanche. Whether you are Tifa reborn, her family, closest friend, trusted partner, or someone newly welcomed into her life, you become a true Heart of the Bar, forever possessing a place beside its hearth and among those who call it home.
addons.title: The Heart of the Bar

objects.text: “There will always be a place for you here—a place to lay down your burdens, share a drink, plan the next fight, or remember what you’re fighting for. It’s the people who gather here that make this a heaven worth keeping.” — Tifa Lockhart The Seventh Heaven appears to be a bar filled with warmth, laughter, and shared secrets. Beneath it lies a hearth bound to you across every realm: a sanctuary, home, and gathering place carrying fellowship wherever you travel. Larger within than without, it begins with a bar, kitchen, cellar, living quarters, and private rooms, but may grow into an inn, headquarters, or command hall. You may add floors, workshops, training rooms, passages, and specialized wings, altering its layout and atmosphere at will. Everything within remains safe while it is dismissed. You may summon it on a city street, in a forest, beside a battlefield, or upon a distant world. It settles naturally into its surroundings, then folds into your essence when dismissed. It cannot be permanently destroyed, stolen, sealed away, or separated from you. Within its walls, malice weakens, curses unravel, and violence requires your permission. Hostile visitors may be denied entry, restrained, or expelled. Rest restores body, mind, and spirit, healing wounds, cleansing poisons, easing exhaustion, and treating supernatural afflictions. Its food and drink provide perfect nourishment while restoring hope, courage, and resolve. Its greatest secret lies in its doors. Passages may appear behind the counter or along its shifting halls, each leading to another Property or Structure-Object of Power you own. Any residence, stronghold, vessel, workshop, or personal domain may be connected, joining your havens into one seamless network. You and recognized co-owners may use these passages freely and determine who else receives access. If you or a co-owner can travel between worlds, a second front door may open into random realities, while the tavern may exist in multiple worlds as one continuous Property. Visitors normally return only to their world of origin; other realities and private Properties require permission. After visiting a world, you may establish a permanent doorway between it and the tavern. Each may be opened, closed, concealed, restricted, relocated, or removed at will, creating a secure crossroads without surrendering control of your home. You decide who comes with it: all six original members of Avalanche, Tifa alone, or none of them. With the whole group, Tifa tends the bar, Cloud and Barret lend their strength, while Jessie, Biggs, and Wedge serve, repair, and plan missions. Those included are the original, living people—not copies, echoes, recreations, projections, or alternate versions. Each retains their genuine body, soul, identity, memories, personality, abilities, and equipment. The dead return to life and health, while the living arrive safely. They retain their agency and may leave, accompany you, pursue their own lives, grow, and return whenever they wish. They recognize the Seventh Heaven as home and accept you as its owner, trusted ally, and family. If any already accompany you, no duplicate appears; the Property recognizes them as the original and connects them to the tavern. If you choose Tifa alone while she is already your companion, that same Tifa becomes part of it. As your legend grows, the tavern may become a vast home, interdimensional crossroads, and central hearth of every Property you possess. Its reputation spreads wherever wounds heal, secrets change hands, friendships form, and heroes gather before returning to the dark. To own the Seventh Heaven is to carry more than a bar. It is a sanctuary that cannot be stolen, a base that cannot be lost, and a home that adapts to its family: rebellion’s cradle, hope’s refuge, and a hearth where legends share a drink before the next adventure.
objects.title: The Seventh Heaven (Final Fantasy VII)

objects.text: "Uh, Hello? Hello, Hello! Uh, Hi. Welcome to Freddy Fazbears Pizza." You have been deemed worthy of being a Freddy Fazbears Franchisee, free of arson-related death likelihood. This building, about 3000 square meters in size with a layout that is yours to decide, has room to make you plenty of money. You also find you'll have access to a store catalogue that can order you supplies exclusively for the building. When it comes to the bread and butter of the building, the animatronics, you are only limited to Animatronics that physically exist, so unfortunately Phantoms and Nightmares are out of the question. You start with a total of four animatronics. In this building, there is also a field of energy that makes it so no matter what happens inside, you will find yourself able to shed any liability, death, or injury as if it barely had any financial effect, as if you had the best lawyers in reality.
objects.title: Freddy Fazbears Pizza (Five Nights At Freddy's)

addons.text:
Now your Enkanomiya is no longer abandoned or in ruins. It is inhabited by its people and thrives under your leadership. The mystical arts and craftsmanship have not been lost, allowing your subjects to continue creating and advancing their knowledge and civilization.

Additionally, you receive a blessing of wisdom from Istaroth, the Lady of Time, similar to the one received by Aberaku no Mikoto (or Aberax). This blessing will allow you to recreate the Dainichi Mikoshi, as well as improve it or use it as a foundation for creating new and wondrous mechanisms.

Although the Enkanomiya civilization may initially resemble Ancient Greece or Atlantis, you can choose its aesthetic yourself and adjust its backstory as you see fit. All the benefits of the Empowered Village will also be available to your Enkanomiya.
addons.title: Ancient Enkanomiya

addons.text:
Previously, there was no Archon in Enkanomiya, but now one has appeared. You, the eighth Archon in succession, possess all the innate abilities and power of the Archons.

As the absolute ruler of Enkanomiya, you will gain dominion over light, similar to that held by Dainichi Mikoshi. Moreover, you will be able to conceal your existence and that of your country even from the divine gaze.

Within Enkanomiya, you will receive powerful support by drawing on mystical energies, and you will be able to understand and comprehend everything related to the light of Dainichi Mikoshi.

You will see everything that Dainichi Mikoshi's light touches in your realm, even if it tries to hide from your gaze.
addons.title: The Archon of the Enkanomiya

addons.text:
In Enkanomiya, there was originally a phenomenon known as the “Shade of Tokoyo”—a, also known as "Sinshades", ghostly phantom of a human being that arises from intense emotions and is capable of existing until it realizes its nature as a reflection. Once it realizes the nature of its existence, it vanishes.

With the arrival of Spiegel, the mechanism by which these phantoms arise has changed. The fusion of Spiegel’s nature with that of the Shade of Tokoyo has led to a situation where anyone who invades Enkanomiya with aggression begins to generate “Reflections of Sin.” These reflections arise from dark emotions, sinful thoughts, and acts of cruelty. They possess partial memories, self-awareness, and the abilities of their “creators” . However, they suffer from their existence and seek to end it, which is possible through dissipation or by participating in battles to defend Enkanomiya.

“Reflections of Sin” are phantoms with an elemental nature close to light, which makes them weaker than their “creators” and Spiegel clones. They possess the advantages of phantoms, such as flight and immateriality, and their numbers can be vast. An evil, emotional, and cruel person is capable of spawning many “Reflections of Sin” that will seek to fight against him. In any case, a particularly cruel enemy will be surprised to find himself facing an army of phantoms representing themselves and their sins.
addons.title: Reflection of Sin

objects.text:
The underground realm of Enkanomiya, formerly known as Byakuyakoku or Tokoyokoku, is entirely at your disposal. It is illuminated by the artificial sun Dainichi Mikoshi, or Helios. Access to Enkanomiya is through a hidden passage protected by mystical arts. You can customize the access settings yourself.

Enkanomiya is an archipelago of islands separated by deep chasms. Convenient passages and bridges connect the islands. Some islands are hidden from view and can only be found by fulfilling certain conditions or possessing specific traits. Among them are Yachimatahiko’s Locus, Yachimatahime’s Locus, and Kunado’s Locus. On these islands stand the Towers of the Three Realms, capable of controlling the flow of mystical energy and interacting with the energies of the human world, the world of light, or the abyss.

The central place in Enkanomiya is occupied by Dainichi Mikoshi, or Helios—the source of light that illuminates the entire realm and wards off hostile creatures. You can manually control the cycle of day and night or set it to change automatically.

Enkanomiya has survived the wars of the gods and the cataclysms that ravaged the surface, remaining hidden and unscathed. And you can be sure that it will remain just as protected and hidden in the future.

Despite its secluded location, Enkanomiya is abandoned and in ruins. Here you can find functioning systems and mechanisms, as well as vast hoards of treasure and abandoned libraries. By driving out the monsters and putting in enough effort, you can settle Enkanomiya and restore it to its former glory under your rule.
objects.title: Enkanomiya (Genshin Impact)

addons.text:
As an elemental god, your connection to Irminsul has been significantly strengthened. Like Nahida, your consciousness is now directly linked to and in control of the tree.

This grants you the ability not only to access but also to alter the information stored within the tree, thereby changing the perception of everyone around you and historical records according to the new information. However, be aware that any being free from the influence of fate or those with a will strong enough to rival an entire world cannot have their memories altered by this capability.

You can also control the roots of Irminsul and, consequently, the leyline system, allowing you to cause natural disasters at will or terraform the environment as you see fit.

Additionally, any supernatural energy you possess will now be generated and regulated by the root system.
addons.title: Irminsul Avatar

addons.text:
Thanks to your ability to use magic from the age of gods, your Irminsul seedling has taken on the trait of the fantasy tree that sustains a Lostbelt.

The tree now recognizes you as its King and grants you great authority to shape the world wherever its influence reaches.

These powers grow in strength as the tree forcefully integrates itself into the fabric of reality wherever it is planted, becoming an integral part of the world and imposing its rule over it.
addons.title: Fantasy Tree (Type-Moon)

addons.text:
As a Dragon Sovereign and lord of the elements, your absolute control over elemental forces has caused Irminsul to evolve beyond its original limits. It has transformed from a mere part of the world into a framework designed to gestate new worlds.

Initially, Irminsul will have gestated only one world at its heart, equivalent in size to our solar system. The fundamental foundation of this world will be elemental energy, along with any other form of energy you possess.

As the world continues to develop and flourish with life, the tree will convert the generated memory and information into energy. This energy will be used both to fuel the growth of the world and to begin the gestation of new worlds.

This process will create a feedback loop. As more worlds are created, new life will form, bringing more memory and experience to further fuel the growth of additional worlds.

In time, Irminsul might even come to rival the Imaginary Tree, with each of the countless branches in its canopy being a universe in its own right. However, this is in the far future, millions if not billions of years away from the humble single world it has now.
addons.title: New Yggdrasil

addons.text:
By incorporating the Moon Cell into itself, Irminsul has not only gained all of its capabilities and functions but has also grown tremendously thanks to the 4.6 billion years of data and records provided by the Moon Cell.

This growth has allowed Irminsul to create an exact replica of planet Earth, complete with all its textures and inhabitants, as it existed in Type-Moon, within a reality marble.

Your connection to the tree grants you the privilege to wield any form of mystery that has ever existed on Type-Moon Earth, including but not limited to every form of magecraft, psychic power, magic from the Age of Gods, true magic, and divine authority.

If you also have the Irminsul avatar add-on, you will become an existence similar to the will of the planet Gaia and Alaya, giving you full access to a Counter Force and a Throne of Heroes of your own.
addons.title: Gaia Reborn

addons.text: Your affinity for Positivity or Negativity has mutated your Irminsul Sapling into something more, flowering with the beginnings of “apples” which are manifestations of pure Emotion. While they aren’t ready yet, as your sapling matures so too do the blooms which grow there until they eventually bear fruit. If you possess Essence of Darkness your tree grows Black Apples of Negativity, while Essence of Light would have it grow Golden Apples of Positivity. Once the apples are mature you can pluck and eat them, empowering you on a fundamental level as the energy within is absorbed, enhancing your connection with your Emotion. Should you eat 200 apples then you could achieve a connection comparable to the Avatar of Negativity/Avatar of Positivity upgrades. Lastly, everywhere your tree has influence it spreads and reinforces the emotions you hold an affinity for, empowering you within its domain. In fact, should you possess both Essence of Darkness and Essence of Light then you can actively manage the emotional influence, selectively targeting some areas with increased Negativity while increasing Positivity everywhere else.
addons.title: Tree of Feelings

addons.text: Through Imaginary Energy and the Authority of Finality, your Irminsul Sapling has metamorphosed into a higher existence altogether, an emulation of the Imaginary Tree and an endless font of Imaginary Energy. As your Imaginary Tree assimilates into the fabric of reality, it does more than simply regulate and record. As it grows it’s roots spread not just outwards but deeper as well, worming their way into the fundamental layers of reality, suborning natural functions and in time granting you the ability to govern the fundamental laws of reality for the world it is planted in, effortlessly reshaping all within your Tree’s domain. What’s more, through your Authority of the Void your Tree’s influence can cross dimensional boundaries as well, roots spreading into adjacent worlds, allowing you to manifest your Authority upon worlds without ever being present. Where you can modify reality and the lengths to which you can do so are determined by how mature your Tree is, however with time you can reshape the very fabric of reality across entire worlds. With God of the Collapse, your Divinity and increased connection to the Imaginary Tree causes your emulation to become more, less an emulation and more a small fragment of the Tree itself made manifest, with all the conceptual weight and potential that entails.
addons.title: Imaginary Tree Simulacra

objects.text:
You have gained something incredible: the seedling of Irminsul, the world tree of Teyvat.

Once planted, the seedling will begin to assimilate into the fabric of reality of whichever world it is placed in. Its roots will start absorbing energy, memory, and information from the world to grow the tree.

Besides absorbing memory, the roots will also become the new leyline system of that world, generating and regulating the flow of elemental energy within the land.

If there is already a leyline system in the world, it will slowly be assimilated into the root system. From then on, the form of energy flowing through the original system will also be generated and regulated by Irminsul.

As the one who planted the tree, you are granted a special connection to it, allowing you to access its repository of information and harness the energy generated by its roots to fuel whatever power you may have.

Beware that particularly hazardous energy or information, such as forbidden knowledge or eldritch truths, will be harder for the tree to record and integrate into its system. This will cause dangerous anomalies to appear in the world until the tree adapts to such energy/knowledge and everything is incorporated.
objects.title: Irminsul (Genshin Impact)

addons.text:
In the absence of the Night Kingdom, the sacred flame has instead connected to Irminsul and its leyline network. By linking with this robust and properly established leyline system, the flame can draw upon the energy generated by Irminsul to fuel its power. In return, it provides the leyline system with a level of protection it previously lacked.

Phlogiston now flows through the tree’s leylines like sap, serving as a potent source of fuel and energy. With the proper method, it can even be used to transfer the knowledge and memories within the tree to others.

This connection significantly reduces the flame's reliance on the emotions of you and your allies to recharge its power. Moreover, the immense energy stored within the leyline network can now be harnessed to amplify the flame’s strength to unimaginable levels, far surpassing its previous capabilities.

The flame can even consume the leyline system itself as fuel to unleash catastrophic, world-shattering power. However, this should only be employed as a last resort, as the consequences of such an action could be cataclysmic.

The purifying and corruption-purging properties of the flame now flow through Irminsul as well. This enhancement aids the tree in absorbing hazardous energy and information, greatly improving its resilience. As a result, the risk of dangerous anomalies forming during the tree's integration of such energy and information is drastically reduced, if not entirely eliminated
addons.title: Leyline Connection

addons.text:
As a master of all mystical and technological arts in Teyvat, the Keeper of the Sacred Flame, and a bearer of an ancient name, you have discovered a way to enhance the empowerment of ancient name bearers through the Night Soul Blessing and enabling them to resurrect themselves when they fall in combat.

By significantly strengthening the connection between the ancient name and the Sacred Flame, you can allow an ancient name bearer to draw vastly greater power from the flame. This enhancement permits them to return to life at the site of the Sacred Flame whenever they fall in battle, regardless of the circumstances of their death or their distance from the flame even without the Ode of Resurrection.

Furthermore, you can create these modified ancient names for others. However, those aspiring to bear an ancient name must first achieve a remarkable feat or live a life of significance, worthy of being recorded into the annals of ancient names.

Resurrection and empowerment draw upon the accumulated power within the Sacred Flame. If there is insufficient power to complete a resurrection, the process will fail, and the souls of the fallen will linger within the Sacred Flame until enough energy is available to revive them.
addons.title: Blazing Name Engraver

objects.text:
Now, you wield the sacred flame of Natlan, a flame fueled by your and your allies' hope, dreams, and fighting spirit. This flame has the power to burn away corruption and repel malevolent forces.

During combat, you and your allies can draw upon the sacred flame's power to receive the Night Soul Blessing, significantly amplifying their abilities.

Once enough power has been accumulated within the sacred flame, you can activate the Incandescent Ode of Resurrection. This grants all those under your protection the night soul blessing and resurrects them to their peak strength each time they fall in battle.

Moreover, the Incandescent Ode of Resurrection allows you to enter a supercharged state, where even a mortal can rival the strength of a dragon sovereign or an abyssal god. In this form, you can summon the Sword of a Thousand Blazing Suns a blade forged from the sacred flame itself. This weapon can unleash a devastating torrent of purifying flame, a force deadly to all corrupted and malevolent beings.

The sword's power and the enhancements the Ode granted are directly proportional to the amount of energy accumulated within the sacred flame. The flame will never be extinguished as long as you and your allies retain the will to fight. Even if it is extinguished, it can be rekindled as long as you find the resolve to continue your struggle.

The flame is soul-bound to you, allowing you to store it within yourself or relocate it to the outside world as needed.
objects.title: The Sacred Flame (Genshin Impact)

objects.text:
You are now the owner of a floating, continent-sized island resort. It features amenities such as an alchemy lab, a personal villa, a port city with artisan districts, hot spring resorts, and office spaces. There's also some towns spread around. The island's water, flora, and fauna are self-replenishing, rapidly regenerating even if entirely depleted in a short period.

These locations can be staffed by a mix of peoples, its population can be made up of any races shown in the Granblue Fantasy Universe, such as Draphs, Erunes, Humans, Harvin and more. It can also be made up of any species, races, or other physical forms you’ve bought in the CYOA. You can also choose to fill it with races/species from the world you’ll be entering, or from settings you have bought powers from as long as the races/species don’t exceed your own abilities.

This location can appear in your starting world or hidden in a pocket dimension if need be.
objects.title: Personal Sky Island (Granblue Fantasy)

addons.text:
A British moor stretches out in a vast expanse South beyond the borders of Hogwarts School of Witchcraft & Wizardry, a treasure trove of magical wonder.

Within this enchanted landscape, a significant portion is dedicated to a magnificent magical creature reserve, home to an astonishing array of species. From majestic dragons to diminutive doxies, almost every known magical creature can be found here, with one notable exception: serpents of any kind are mysteriously absent.

Each species inhabits its own custom-designed habitat, carefully crafted to ensure their happiness and comfort. The habitats are designed to mimic the creatures' natural environments, providing them with the perfect conditions to thrive. This remarkable reserve is not only a sanctuary for the magical creatures but also a place of education and research, where students and professors can learn about and study these fascinating beings.

Beyond the creature reserve, the moors are dotted with magical settlements, inhabited by skilled practitioners who have dedicated their lives to harvesting necessary ingredients from these creatures without causing harm. These settlers have developed innovative techniques for cultivating and harvesting magical resources, ensuring that the needs of the wizarding world are met while respecting the well-being of the creatures that inhabit this enchanted land.

The settlements themselves are charming and rustic, blending seamlessly into the natural surroundings. The air is filled with the sweet scent of blooming wildflowers, and the soft chirping of enchanted birds can be heard in the distance. It is here that one can find rare and precious ingredients, carefully crafted into potions, elixirs, and other magical concoctions.

As one explores the moors, it becomes clear that this is a place where magic and nature harmonize in perfect balance.
addons.title: Gryffindor, from Wild Moor

addons.text:
Beyond the boundary of Hogwarts, Scottish mountains stretch out to the north, shrouded in mystery and adventure, with their peaks lost in the clouds. The Dwarves, ancient craftsmen of stone and magic, have carved out their cities within the heart of these mountains, their expertise in mining and stone-masonry unparalleled.

The mines of the Dwarves are a marvel, extracting stones imbued with magical properties that are coveted by the wizarding world. These stones, known as Warding Stones, are used to construct and reinforce magical barriers, walls, and fortifications. The mines are a slow but steady source of these precious materials, replenishing themselves over time through ancient magical processes.

Scattered throughout the mountains are small settlements, each with its own unique expertise in Warding. The inhabitants of these settlements are masters of their craft, able to sense the subtle energies that flow through the land. They spend their days honing their skills, studying the ancient art of Warding, and perfecting their techniques.

High above the mountains, on windswept crags and ledges, nestle the Rowena's majestic eagle friends. These giant birds are a unique species, bred by Rowena herself to serve as rides for those who possess the wisdom and intelligence to gain their trust. Each eagle is capable of carrying a rider on a windswept journey across the world, soaring on updrafts and thermals, traversing vast distances with ease.

Theses eagle's feathers are said to possess mystical properties, imbuing those who wear them with wisdom. Those who seek adventure and danger may find themselves drawn to the these mountains, seeking out the Dwarves' wisdom and guidance or hoping to earn the right to ride one of these magnificent creatures.
addons.title: Ravenclaw, from Mountain Glen

addons.text:
Beyond the borders of Hogwarts, a vast expanse of broad Welsh valleys stretches out westward like a tapestry of wonder, their slopes adorned with a patchwork of settlements,  where the air is sweet with the scent of freshly baked bread and the sound of hammering on metal can be heard from dawn till dusk. 

Goblins, small and wiry with skin like rough bark, toil tirelessly in the numerous mines, each extracting a different metal or gem from the earth – from the common copper, silver, gold, emerald, topaz, diamond, to the rare mithril, orichalcum, and adamantium. For each new type of gem, or metal you find, your Goblin miners will soon break open a new mine dedicated to extracting it.

Deep within the mines, the Goblins work in shifts, their hands moving deftly as they chip away at the rock face, their laughter echoing off the walls as they uncover veins of glittering ore. These mines are operated by a loyal clan of Goblins, who have honed their skills over generations to extract even the most elusive ores. They are masters of their craft, able to coax forth treasures from the earth that would be impossible for any other to find.

On the surface, the settlements bustle with activity, home to some of the finest magical artisans and enchanters in the wizarding world. Here skilled artisans craft intricate magical devices and enchanted trinkets.  These master craftsmen can be found hammering away at their anvils, shaping intricate wooden wands or delicately etching gemstones with precision spells.

As you wander through the valleys' verdant floors, you'll encounter vast tracts of fertile farmland, where winding rivers flow gently through the landscape. Experienced farmers, armed with generations of knowledge and expertise in magical agriculture, coax an astonishing yield from the land. They can produce tenfold the amount of food for the same amount of land, thanks to their mastery of enchanted techniques and ancient secrets passed down through their families.

The farmland stretches as far as the eye can see, a patchwork quilt of fields and pastures where crops grow taller than a man and flowers bloom in every color of the rainbow. The farmers work in harmony with nature, using charms and spells to nurture their crops and protect them from pests and disease. It is truly a place where magic is woven into every thread of life.
addons.title: Hufflepuff, from Valley Broad

addons.text:
To the east of Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry lies a vast wetland area known as the Fen. Within this magical landscape, expansive stretches are dedicated to farms and greenhouses that cultivate a diverse array of both magical and non-magical plants in substantial quantities. Here, you can find everything from dittany to mandrakes, gillyweed to devil’s snare; if a plant possesses useful magical properties, it's likely found in this enchanted region.

The fen is home to numerous Master Herbologists who specialize in enhancing the growth of these valuable plants through their expertise in specialized magics. They utilize clever enchantments to ensure these plants thrive year-round, regardless of weather or conditions.

Adjacent to the cultivation areas are smaller settlements focused on exploring the applications of these plants. Skilled Potion Masters brew both common and rare potions while also experimenting with the creation of new recipes.

Lastly, a community of Druids inhabits this sanctuary of magical nature. These shape-shifting protectors are known for their secretive nature. Salazar Slytherin once served as their leader, and this historical link provides a pathway to learn the magic that the Druids keep hidden from outsiders.

The Druids magic is a unique version of Animagus magic. To use this ability, a user must establish physical contact with the desired animal while concentrating. This process induces a trance-like state in the animal, allowing the user to connect with it on a deeper level. With time and practice, one gains intuitive skills with assuming the animal's form and using its innate physical capabilities; however, any specific powers possessed by the animal will take longer to understand fully. This technique is not limited to a single animal, and with practice a user can take a partial form, or even merge forms in a chimeric fashion.
addons.title: Slytherin, from Shadowed Fen

addons.text:
Deep within the ancient walls of Hogwarts, a hidden workshop lies in wait, awaiting the arrival of its rightful heir. This mystical forge, where the legendary Godric once toiled, is a place of wonder and magic, where the art of crafting weapons, armor, and golems is an honored tradition.

Within these hallowed halls, Godric left behind an impressive array of creations, including an army of golems, standing at attention and ready to rise to the defense of Hogwarts at a moment's notice. Each golem, imbued with the power of the ancient magic that flows through this place, is a testament to Godric's ingenuity and skill.

The workshop itself is a marvel of magical engineering, boasting several extraordinary abilities that make it an invaluable resource for any heir who claims it. Among its many wonders is the capacity to heat any material to its required temperature in an instant, without fail. The forge's magical properties allow it to reach the precise temperature necessary for crafting even the most delicate or complex items.

Furthermore, the workshop's layout is enchanted for maximum efficiency, with every tool and station spelled to be within arm's reach. This allows users to focus on their craft without interruption or delay. Perhaps most crucially, the forge has the ability to replicate any ore or metal brought within it, making a virtually limitless source of raw materials for even the most ambitious projects.

As one explores this magnificent workshop, it becomes clear that Godric's legacy extends far beyond his own lifetime. The secrets and techniques contained within these walls hold the power to shape the future of magic itself. The heir who claims this workshop will be tasked with carrying on this tradition of innovation and creativity, ensuring that the magic of Hogwarts continues to thrive for generations to come.
addons.title: Gryffindor's Forge

addons.text:
Hidden with the ancient walls of Hogwarts, lies the hidden library of the famed founder Rowena Ravenclaw, awaiting her heir. This collection of magical knowledge curated by her, is a place of quiet learning, and study.


Upon these enchanted shelves, Rowena arranged the greatest collection of magical knowledge, known to Wizarding kind. The library contains many unique and useful features, for example each tome is spelled to be perfectly understandable in any language, while the library overall is enchanted so that one may always find the knowledge one seeks. The magic of the library prevents any damage to the collection, while an observant heir will notice the library’s collections expand to include new magical methods encountered


The library contains many small workshops attached to it, that contain the many projects of the Witch, among those include the masterpiece that is the Room of Requirements, and architectural plans for the legendary castle itself, along with it’s famed wards. With access to this, one might modify the castle to suit one’s own needs, or even construct a new castle for themselves.

Above, the ceiling of the library is enchanted to provide a constant view of with which to track the movements of the stars themselves, Enchantments have been placed upon it, such that the this view may be had whether by day or by night, and regardless of the weather, always granting a crystal clear view of the stars above
addons.title: Ravenclaw's Library

addons.text:
As you step through the storied halls of Hogwarts, the hidden Sanctuary of Hufflepuff awaits. This space is a testament to the legendary Founder's dedication to creating a haven for students. The massive stone firepit, eternally lit, projects a comforting glow, banishing any chill from the air. The magical warmth projecting an enveloping aura of comfort and safety.

As you enter, you're greeted by the House-Elves of Hogwarts, their bright eyes shining with loyalty and dedication. According to legend, Helga Hufflepuff, one of the four founders of Hogwarts, bound the willing elves to the school’s service, through her bloodline. As a result, all House-Elves are now bound to the heir of Hufflepuff, serving as loyal companions and caregivers.

The walls of the hall are lined with cupboards and drawers, each one filled with an array of perfectly preserved ingredients for cooking of any form.

Several side rooms branch off, each dedicated to some aspect of Helga's love of healing and crafting. One section houses potions laboratories, stocked with an impressive array of cauldrons and shelves filled with an assortment of dried herbs, powders, and mysterious ingredients.

Another area is dedicated to metalworking and blacksmithing. The massive forge is stocked with an impressive array of tools and raw materials, ready for users to shape and craft their own creations.

Lastly, there's a room filled with beds, enchanted to aid in the swift recovery of those who reside within. Soft blankets and plush pillows seem to cradle you in comfort as you rest, helping to soothe any fatigue or injury. The air is filled with a calming energy, with the very fabric of the room woven with magic to promote healing and rejuvenation.
addons.title: Hufflepuff's Sanctuary

addons.text:
Deep within the dungeons of Hogwarts lies Salazar Slytherin’s,  hidden Scriptorium, a secret sanctuary awaiting the arrival of his true heir. This secluded chamber was once the legendary founder’s personal study—a place where he honed his mastery of magic, delving into both arcane knowledge and forbidden arts.

The entrance is guarded by a cruel requirement: to gain access the cruciatus curse must be cast upon another sentient being. This heinous curse unleashes agonizing pain, activating every nerve and receptor in the target’s body. But this is no ordinary test of magical prowess; it is a true test of character. To succeed, one must either find someone willing to accept this torment—a voluntary sacrifice—or be prepared to endure the curse oneself, accepting their own suffering to unlock the secrets within.

Once inside, Slytherin’s Scriptorium is revealed in all its dark grandeur. The walls are lined with ancient tomes, fragile journals, and meticulously detailed notes—many of which detail the founder’s obsession with the Dark Arts and the intricate methods of counteracting their most dangerous curses. The air is thick with the scent of aged parchment and potent magic, whispering of forbidden knowledge.

Unfinished on a central desk lies a collection of revolutionary ideas—what many might consider impossible: methods to shield oneself from the influence of the Imperius Curse, the excruciating pain of the Cruciatus, and the deadly finality of the Killing Curse, Avada Kedavra.

Salazar’s notes contain the secrets of how he achieved these feats—knowledge that, if understood and replicated, could allow a skilled wizard or witch to reverse engineer any spell or curse, forging powerful countermeasures. Could this knowledge help you resist the deadly gaze of the Basilisk? Or perhaps nullify the despair-inducing aura of Dementors? Who knows what might be possible.
addons.title: Slytherin's Scriptorium

addons.text: Throughout history, humanity—both Muggles and wizards alike—has been captivated by the allure of infinite gold and the pursuit of eternal life. Alchemists, both magical and mundane, have tirelessly searched for ways to create these tantalizing dreams. Yet only one alchemist is known to have succeeded: the legendary Nicolas Flamel. He alone mastered the art of crafting the Philosopher’s Stone...until now. The ruby-red crystal of the Philosopher’s Stone stands as Nicolas Flamel’s most celebrated achievement, and now the secrets of its creation and use are in your hands. One of the most famous tales about this gem is its ability to produce the Elixir of Life, a substance which extends the drinker's natural lifespan, granting them eternal life. However, caution is advised; using the stone for this purpose will lead to a dependency on the Elixir once the drinker's natural lifespan ends. Additionally, the Elixir can only prevent a natural death, not one caused by misfortune or violence. Another well-known feature of the stone is its ability to transform base metals into pure gold or silver. While this is indeed true, it represents only a small portion of the stone's transmutation potential. In skilled hands, the Philosopher’s Stone can convert any non-living matter into another non-living material. The only requirement is a clear understanding of the desired outcome—pure elements or simple substances are relatively easy to achieve, while more complex materials can be much more challenging. Among the stone’s lesser-known abilities is its power to make spells permanent, from simple charms to intricate Transfigurations and everything in between. Be careful, just because a spell can be made permanent, does not mean it should. Finally, the Philosopher’s Stone has the potential to serve as a virtually limitless source of magical energy, capable of powering magical wards and artifacts. In theory, it could even enable a mere Muggle to cast spells like a natural wizard. However, it is important to note that while it would provide power, it would not impart the skill or knowledge necessary to wield that power effectively. I do advise keeping this knowledge to yourself. There are many individuals willing to allow their morals to slip for the possibility to gain access to such secrets.
addons.title: The Philosopher's Stone

addons.text:
Deep beneath the legendary stronghold of Hogwarts lies Salazar Slytherin’s hidden Chamber of Secrets, awaiting the arrival of one who speaks the serpent’s tongue. This secret space was said to have been created by the Founder shortly before he left the castle, to rid the school of all those he perceived as “unworthy” of performing magic. Whatever the truth may be, you have discovered the access to this hidden chamber and all that it conceals.

When you first discover it, the chamber appears to consist of a single room containing a statue and a pool of water. However, over time, you can drain the water away, revealing deeper levels filled with magically protected alcoves that house Slytherin’s prized collection of both magical and mundane serpents.

Within Salazar’s work area rests one of his greatest accomplishments: an experimental ritual designed to bind a basilisk to the command of the user and their descendants. This ritual also modifies the beast, enabling it to control its lethal gaze and venom. The surviving test subject—proof of the ritual’s success—is sealed within the statue above, serving as the guardian of the chamber. That serpent will not obey you unless you happen to be Salazar’s heir.
addons.title: The Chamber of Secrets

addons.text:
Sirius Black is the only Wizard known to have escaped from Azkaban—at least on his own. His escape triggered a nationwide manhunt, and as a result, the soul-sucking guards of Azkaban were stationed at all known entrances to Hogwarts.

Now, these sinister creatures guard the gates to Hogwarts once more, but this time, under your complete control. The Dementors have been enchanted and bound to obey any restrictions you impose. You can command them to suppress the despair aura they normally emit, preventing them from draining happiness from those nearby, and you can also prohibit them from performing their dreaded Kiss on any victim without your explicit permission.

In exchange for accepting this binding, the Dementors gain the ability to feed upon the nearly limitless reservoir of happiness stored within the castle. This reservoir is replenished by siphoning a small, nearly imperceptible portion of the happiness from everyone residing here, supplemented by an ‘artificial emotion of happiness’ generated through powerful ancient magic. While this substitute may not be the Dementors’ favorite fare, it provides a sustainable source of nourishment without issue.

Alternatively, you may choose to take control of Azkaban itself—a dread fortress guarded by the same foul creatures. This prison can contain any known resident of Azkaban, allowing you to imprison your foes if desired. By default, the fortress will appear at the furthest reaches of the Hogwarts valley, but it can be placed anywhere within your world that you see fit.
addons.title: The Prisoner of Azkaban

addons.text: You now possess the legendary Goblet of Fire, an enchanted cup designed to select the most worthy candidates for a competition. As the new owner of the Goblet, you have control over the type of tournament it will be used for, the criteria for selection, and the number of candidates to be chosen. Traditionally, the Goblet only accepts the names of those who willingly write their names. Should you have chosen the Holy Grail however, as the owner, you can enter any name you wish into the cup and bind that individual to the contract. When a name emerges from the Goblet, the individual is bound to an unbreakable magical contract that strips anyone who breaches it of their supernatural abilities. If you possess the Fountain of Youth then additionally, you have the option to remove the supernatural abilities of those who lose the tournament, effectively containing them within the cup and allowing you to ‘drink’ to gain their powers.
addons.title: The Goblet of Fire

addons.text: With the loyalty of a Phoenix——namely Fawkes——you now stand as the new leader of The Order of the Phoenix an organization dedicated originally to combatting the forces of the Dark Lord Voldemort, now however it stands ready to aid you in whatever battles lie ahead. With the support of your new companion, you have the undivided loyalty and support of the entire Order and all of it’s many members in their entirety, from the more powerful members like Albus Dumbledore and Harry Potter, to lesser well known members like Caradoc Dearborn and Dorcas Meadows.
addons.title: The Order of the Phoenix

addons.text:
Severus Snape coined the term “The Half-Blood Prince” to refer to himself during his time at Hogwarts. The title is a nod to his mother’s family, the Princes, and his own status as a Half-Blood. Interestingly, despite the blood purist ideology viewing Half-Bloods as inferior, Snape was nonetheless welcomed into the inner circle of the Death Eaters and was even trusted by Voldemort.

Now, you achieve a similar feat—where you can be perceived as partly something, you have the ability to present yourself as fully something—or fully not—when it serves your purpose. This doesn’t change what you are capable of; rather, it changes how the world and its inhabitants considers you.

Do you possess the blood of the gods within your veins? You could have yourself considered a full deity. Does being a god prevent you from entering certain places or performing specific actions? You can choose to seen as fully a mortal.
addons.title: The Half-Blood Prince

addons.text: To those who know of the tales of the Deathly Hallows, the legend goes, “He who unites the Deathly Hallows shall become the Master of Death.” There's never been one known to have truly united the Hallows, so the true potential of that title is unknown... Well, until now, that is. Master, you have united my hallows, gaining possession of the Elder Wand, the Resurrection Stone, and my old Cloak of Invisibility, making you now the Master of Death with all the powers that may bring. What powers are those? My dear Master, you had only to ask. I, your Servant, shall happily explain. Your power is to command me, [DEATH], in whatsoever way you choose. Shall I slaughter your enemies where they stand? Shall I command the fallen to rise as your unending army? Shall I force the gods who depend on my power to kneel before you? You have only to give the word, and I shall obey. But I suppose you want to know what the more direct benefits to you may be? The Cloak shall act as something of an “all-access” pass to the realms; anywhere I may go shall always allow your entry as well. The Stone is able to act as something akin to a signet ring—any soul marked by it, I’ll keep a close watch on, and ensure their safety. The Wand will let all existences with some form of connection to me know exactly what position you hold over me—though you may certainly hide that should you wish. Lastly is this Castle. It has no connection to me, but due to its importance to you, I’ll leave those who would defend it be untouched... while they’re needed to defend it, at least. As to who bound me? Why, the only one who could bind me—myself, of course! A reason? ...It gets boring as an 'almighty' immortal. This is my way of having what I suppose you could call a “vacation.” I’ll serve faithfully, in any capacity you need—until you no longer want that power... Master.
addons.title: The Deathly Hallows

addons.text: Twas Gryffindor who found the way, He whipped me off his head The founders put some brains in me So I could choose instead! With this item, you acquire the Hogwarts Sorting Hat, enchanted by the four legendary Founders of Hogwarts. This magical artifact has the ability to peer into the minds of its wearers to determine an answer, Primarily which Hogwarts House they belong to. The Sorting Hat excels at making such choices and can help find the perfect answer for its wearers, for such questions as, “Which Lantern Ring suits me?” or “Which Starter Pokémon should I choose?” In addition to its sorting abilities, the Hat serves as a knowledgeable advisor, drawing from its 1,000 years of experience. Due to it’s nature as a mind reading hat, it can assist the wearer in creating and testing mental defences. Typically it would refuse to violate the privacy of another, however should you be the heir of it’s creators, it will do so – allowing it to be used to gather information directly from the minds of others. In battle, the Hat connects to the user’s mind, acting as an extra pair of eyes and ears. It can even take control of minions or other magical items, thereby enhancing the user’s combat capabilities. Lastly, the Hat features an expanded pocket dimension for storage, allowing it to hold an extensive collection of useful books, tools, and weapons for the wearer’s convenience.
addons.title: The Sorting Hat

addons.text: Now your Grimoire evolves into this legendary Hogwarts artifact, the Book of Admittance. This book provides a written record of all those with sufficient magical ability. Should you possess them then you’re freely able to add other supernatural abilities to the book to record, other powers like Chakra, The Force, Ki, and so many more. Any names recorded are protected with powerful magic's, only you or the Headmaster may reveal them to others.
addons.title: The Book of Admittance

addons.text: Now your Self-Writing Quill evolves into this legendary Hogwarts artifact, the Quill of Acceptance. This beautiful magical Quill is charmed to detect all those who possess magical potential. If you possess them you’ll also be able to freely add other supernatural powers for the Quill to detect such as Chakra, The Force, Ki, and so many more. The Quill creates a binding contract for the target to attend Hogwarts, and be educated on their powers, however you or the Headmaster may enforce or dismiss this contract as you see fit.
addons.title: The Quill of Acceptance

addons.text: With the combination of these two artifacts they gain a powerful new ability in your hands. The Quill of Acceptance can now do far more than merely detect if someone is magical, by writing their names within the Book of Admittance that individual will gain all the magical capabilities of the average wizard. Any similar types of supernatural powers that you possess can be granted by writing the recipients name, and the desired ability to be shared beside it. The recipient only gains the most basic levels of the power, and will need to learn how to manifest and manipulate this new gift, to achieve higher results. further more if a power is granted that would normally be inheritable by the recipient’s descendants, you can optionally allow the granted power to be transferred to their descendants as well. Lastly, the staff of Hogwarts can optionally gain the ability to teach any such shared powers, with all the skill and capability they can teach Witchcraft & Wizardry.
addons.title: The Book of Admittance & The Quill of Acceptance

addons.text:
Your mastery of Arcane Magic has allowed you to contact the other worlds of the Prime Material Plane. With this, you were able to use "Wish" to clone many of the educational institutions, instructors, & students of the Prime Material Plane (particularly Neverwinter Academy, due to its innovative and broad curriculum) into a perfect fusion of Hogwarts and these institutions, as if they were always just part of the campus, their staff just part of the faculty, & their students always enrolled. Now the students of Hogwarts may learn Arcane Magic as part of their studies.

As implied earlier, Neverwinter Academy had a unique curriculum in that it was for adventurers generally rather than wizards specifically; not only does this give your students a more well-rounded education, but if you have other D&D or Pathfinder powers you can open educational facilities for those skills as well, such as a Temple for teaching Divine Magic and Warlock pacts, a Bardic College for teaching the Bardic and Rogueish arts, or a Combat Room for teaching the Sublime Way and other martial skills.
addons.title: Neverwinter Academy (D&D)

addons.text:
