Upon a jutting pillar of rock now stands the College of Winterhold, a new addition to the greater Hogwarts campus. This fortress of stone hosts one of the greatest collections of magical knowledge known.

The College contains a vast Arcanaeum, a library also known as the Ysmir Collective, and containing a collection of books, scrolls and general knowledge that stretches back entire eras. A written record of every publicly known spell, enchantment, potion, and general magical knowledge can be found here.

Accompanying this, are vast wings of greenhouses full of various magical plants, insect-life, and small animals ready to be harvested for various potions, and stores of pre-filled Soul Gems ready for the study of Enchanting and Alchemy. These supplies are infinite, with each resource replenishing itself as it's used.

But what is a College without faculty to teach within it? The College will generate NPC professors to teach any branch of Nirn's magical arts, though some courses may be less... advertised, or may even be outright restricted. These staff members may optionally be any appropriate mage from the source.

Next the College will admit a healthy amount of students as needed. These students can be generic NPCs, be characters from Nirn ready to learn magic, or recruits from the world you find yourself in.

Finally, the College is protected by a powerful magical barrier, capable of weathering nature's fury indefinitely, and preventing the very ground from being eroded out from beneath the institution.
addons.title: College of Winterhold (The Elder Scrolls)

addons.text: Now perched atop the peak of the highest mountain surrounding the Hogwarts campus is the ancient stone monastery of High Hrothgar. Home to the order of monks known as the Greybeards, who study and practice the Voice of the Sky also known as the Thu'um, a magical art involving the use of the Language of the Dragons to warp reality in various ways. This order accepts and teaches all who manage to brave the seven thousand steps, and gain entry to this sanctuary. The Greybeards can teach anyone to access and use the power of the Voice, with it taking on average six to twelve months to master the basic language structure, and manifest the power of their first word. After that progress is relatively swift, learning on average a new word every week of dedicated practice and training, all without having to go out and slay dragons for their souls. As an added bonus, anyone taught the Voice of the Sky within these halls, will find they never lose control of their Voice, and the power it now wields. The Greybeards are initially led by the Dragon Paarthurnax, a dragon who has willingly forsaken violence in an attempt to redeem himself. Paarthurnax, is well versed in convincing his more violent kin, to abandon their aggressive ways and seek peace and cooperation. This ability of persuasion extends to all entities that could be considered a Dragon. Optionally, you can have Paarthurnax step aside as leader of the Greybeards, so that you as Dragonborn can take his place. Finally, the Greybeards as a while are a group renowned for their almost complete impartiality. This reputation allows them to call, under a banner of truce, any and all relevant parties to attempt to find a diplomatic outcome. Some differences and issues may be too contentious to be resolved peacefully, but all parties will respect this truce, and give an honest attempt to come to a peaceful conclusion.
addons.title: High Hrothgar (The Elder Scrolls)

addons.text:
Your mastery of the Sorcery practiced in distant realms like The Lands Between and Lordran necessitates the expansion of Hogwarts, if such a subject is to be properly taught. Thankfully, due to political instability in The Lands Between, a famous Liurnian school has agreed to merge its campus with Hogwarts.

Now standing alongside Hogwarts is the Academy of Raya Lucaria, connected by a series of bridges and teleportation points. The resources of the Academy can teach Soulsborne magic alongside the Potterverse magic usually taught, allowing for the students and teachers to have more well-rounded abilities. The faculty and student body have merged as well, meaning that a whole new house (House Rennala) will have to be created, and the likes of Rennala, Rogier, Thops, Miriel, Sellen, and so on, will be teaching the new Sorcery based classes.
addons.title: Raya Lucaria Academy (Elden Ring)
Duel Academy
addons.text: Upon a volcanic island is the newest addition to the greater Hogwarts campus: Duel Academy, specializing in teaching young Duelists the art of Dueling. On the surface, it might appear to be only an ordinary—if card-focused—high school, but beneath the surface, it teaches Psychic Dueling and Egyptian Shadow magic to students with the capability—and fortitude—to learn such arts. The island is also home to various research facilities dedicated to pushing the bounds of Dueling further, achieving new heights, and developing Dueling technology further. Duel Spirits wander this land, a place where the boundaries between the human world and the various realms of spirits are weakened. Though some of the more powerful, dangerous Spirits have long been sealed away. The island hosts one of the most complete collections of Duel Monsters cards and related paraphernalia. While the rarest—or outright unique—cards won’t be found here, most cards have plenty of copies available to build whatever decks you desire. You’ll also find enough resources to develop and print as many new cards as you wish—these resources can only be used for making cards—though the more powerful the card, the greater the resources required. Finally, Duel Academy is well known for its various satellite campuses spread throughout the world. If you wish, Hogwarts will now be the same. You’ll find a branch of Hogwarts in almost every major city or important location. These satellite campuses generally operate independently but ultimately answer to you, as needed. You can choose for them to specialize in a specific type of magic, be generalists, or even serve as feeder schools to send the best students to the main campus. Just remember to “Get your game on” once in a while.

addons.title: Shin'ō Academy
addons.text:
The newest addition to the Hogwarts Campus is a branch of Shin'ō Academy, the Spiritual Arts Academy teaching those with enough spiritual power the skills and core techniques of the Shinigami. The curriculum includes four classes collectively known as Zankensoki, or Zanjutsu, Hakuda, Hohō, and Kidō.

Zanjutsu is the art of swordsmanship, utilizing Zanpakutō—the soul-cutter swords—that are a reflection of their wielder’s very soul. The Academy provides each student in this class with a blank Zanpakutō, an Asauchi. As the wielder spends time with the blade, it will eventually awaken its own unique spirit and abilities that the user can call upon.

Hakuda is the art of hand-to-hand combat, using one’s strength and speed to overwhelm the opponent.

Hohō is the art of speed and fast movement. Its most famous technique, known as “Shunpo” or “Flash Steps,” allows one to reduce the number of steps needed to travel and move faster than the eye can see.

Kidō is the art of magic, creating blasts of energy, powerful barriers, healing, and much more. Kidō typically requires an incantation to be most effective, though experienced practitioners can bypass this requirement.

addons.title: The Hogwarts Express
addons.text:
Now, you are the owner of the world's most magical train company, Wizarding Rail, and the trains it runs. Your trains have the ability to generate temporary tracks—allowing them to go where they need to go—the ability to temporarily force objects out of the way—similar to the Knight Bus—and to warp time in and around the train—enabling passengers to enjoy the experience, while the overall journey only takes about five minutes outside.

The train’s consist will automatically expand itself, generating carriages as needed, and changing its internal and external appearance to suit the requirements of any route it may be covering. Sleeper cabins, dining cars, observation cars, lounges, baggage cars, and even freight cars—if you need them.

Some of your most famous routes include an express service dedicated to transporting students to and from Hogwarts several times a year, and the annual route to the North Pole. However, you are free to add more services between any destinations you can imagine. You have the ability to set whatever categories of tickets you wish, at whatever prices you choose, with Hogwarts covering the fares for its students and the North Pole covering the costs for its famous run. 

One benefit of being the owner of such trains, when you need to travel there will always be a train available to take you to your destination, wherever that might be. You could also make quite a significant profit by providing such a service to others, if you wish.

addons.title: Kaer Ardwood
addons.text:
Further up the mountain than Hogwarts and close to the upper reaches of the Forbidden Forest, there is now an old keep by the name of Kaer Ardwood, where wizards and witches are trained in ancient methods to deal with the many dangerous beasts of the Wizarding World (or any setting you insert Hogwarts into). It is well-staffed and holds all the facilities required to train the students’ body, mind and magic.

These students are, for all practical purposes, witchers (with, admittedly, much greater magical proficiency). They undergo permanent alterations using highly specific potions, they make use of enchanted weapons as much as wands to deal with magically resistant creatures, and they most often work as mercenaries for the various magical governments, magical creature preserves, or any community or individual with a pest problem the authorities aren’t dealing with fast enough.

Witchers typically have some visible sign of their mutations (such as the eyes, which are universally inhuman) that requires them to be much purposeful in their disguise when dealing with the Muggle world. This has led them to be much more adept at blending in with and understanding Muggles and their world, which helps prevent their targets from causing too much ruckus among the mundane populace before being brought down.

objects.text: Now you own Hogwarts, a stronghold of ancient magic and said to be the foremost school for Witchcraft and Wizardry in the world, along with the Hogsmeade Valley that surrounds it. The ancient castle and its surroundings are located in a pocket dimension and can be seamlessly “installed” in any location you desire, then returned to the pocket dimension at will. The school itself can be staffed by any combination of canonically known staff members, with the option for you to become the Headmaster of Hogwarts or to leave it in the capable hands of another. You can also have any named character become a student here. If you practice a different magic system beyond Witchcraft & Wizardry, you can choose for Hogwarts to hold classes in that magic and begin accepting students skilled in those arts. Perhaps a class on the Force, Chakra or Magecraft? The Mystic Arts, the Clever Craft, or Gramarye? As a building created from, and infused with, over a millennium of magic, the school can change its layout to suit your needs. Entire rooms or even floors can appear or disappear as you see fit. However, the school will always contain key facilities such as the Great Hall, the Kitchens, the Library, the Common Rooms, the Hospital Wing, and the Headmaster’s Office. The grounds feature greenhouses filled with magical plants, the Quidditch Pitch, and the Owlery. Not far from the school lies Hogsmeade Village, a settlement home to many magical beings, with a variety of shops and services, including branches of Gringotts, Ollivanders, and more. The valley itself also contains several smaller wizarding hamlets for you to discover. The Forbidden Forest is home to all manner of magical plants and creatures hidden within its depths, including settlements of Centaurs, Acromantula, and Werewolves. The Black Lake contains one of the greatest collections of aquatic magical plants and creatures, with the giant squid patrolling the surface and villages of merfolk along the bottom. Note: You can optionally choose to have the staff, students, and inhabitants here be loyal to you.
objects.title: Hogwarts School of Witchcraft & Wizardry (Harry Potter)

objects.text:
The Room of Requirement, also called the Come and Go Room, is a secret room said to be created by Rowena Ravenclaw. It is able to transform into any type of room you need, whether it's a storage room, a training room, a library, or any other type of room you wish. The room is capable of "responding" to simple commands. However, there are a few rules to keep in mind: the room cannot generate any consumables, you cannot take out anything created by the room, and it cannot create any new knowledge. The room, however, is able to gather information from everything within itself and the near vicinity.

When summoned, a blank door will appear on the nearest wall or in front of the user, in case there are no walls nearby. The user or whoever is in front of the door must then walk in front of it three times while thinking of the kind of room they want. The door and the room are indestructible. When leaving the room, the user can leave from any location within a 50-meter radius. The user is also able to forcefully eject people who are still inside if they wish to do so.
objects.title: Room of Requirement (Harry Potter)

addons.text:
It seems it is far more than simply inhabiting the Pale King’s husk within the dream. By walking the path of a Higher Being and claiming dominion over the White Palace, you have inherited the true legacy of the ancient Wyrm. His essence runs through you, and with it comes the totality of his power.

You may freely assume any of three forms: your original self, the regal insect-shape of the Pale King, or the vast, serpentine majesty of the Wyrm. In the Pale King’s form, you radiate authority and divine presence, a mantle that inspires awe and devotion from lesser beings. In the Wyrm’s body, colossal and ageless, you embody primordial power itself, able to coil through realms with an immensity that dwarfs mountains and reshapes the land by your passing. Shifting between forms requires no effort, for all are now authentically yours.

Beyond mere transformation, you bear the gifts once wielded by Hallownest’s god-king. Your very will can awaken intelligence in lesser creatures, breathing sapience into the mindless or elevating the simple-minded to awareness. Those touched by your power will recognize you instinctively as sovereign, offering loyalty as freely as their first breath of thought. Such devotion is not compelled, but flows naturally, as it once did when the Pale King drew even the moths away from their radiant creator.

Your foresight, too, mirrors his: a piercing intuition that allows you to see the shape of possibilities and to design with precision the structures of civilization. You are not omniscient, but your insight lets you anticipate growth, conflict, and outcome with a clarity that others mistake for prophecy. With this gift, you may build kingdoms of your own—whether within the dream-palace of your mind or upon the soil of waking lands.
addons.title: Wyrm

objects.text:
You have claimed ownership over the White Palace, a luminous fortress adrift in the Dream Realm. It is yours entirely: a domain you may enter at will, stepping through its great gates by thought alone. When you depart, the dream unravels, leaving you once more at the location where you first entered. 

Within its towering halls you command the loyalty of the Royal Retainers, the Kingsmould, and the Wingmould. These beings, once bound to the Pale King, now recognize you as master. They carry out your will in silent obedience, whether as attendants in the dream’s halls or as warriors in its defense. The Palace exists as part of your mind, allowing you to enter it non-physically through sleep. When you dream yourself into the Palace, you will inhabit the husk of the Pale King himself, moving through the chambers in his shape and bearing.

The White Palace is fluid in its structure. With the dream’s logic at your command, you can bend the palace’s form to your desire, altering its corridors and rooms, moving instantly from one chamber to another. Its windows open onto radiant skies, its gardens bloom or wither at your command, and its halls may be endless or constricting, as you will them.

Because the White Palace exists inside your mind, it serves as your stronghold against mental intrusion. Any who would trespass upon your thoughts are dragged into its dreamscape, where you dictate the laws of space and passage. Invaders may be forced into the Path of Pain, a nightmare gauntlet of thorns, blades, and endless ascent, until their strength and resolve shatter. Should they attack the Palace itself, the Kingsmould and Wingmould descend upon them, relentless guardians forged from void and will. In this place, your mind is a fortress as impenetrable as the Pale King once envisioned his kingdom to be.
objects.title: White Palace (Hollow Knight)

addons.text:
With Clair as your companion, the bond between her role as a Dragon Master and your dominion over the Hidden World is strengthened, establishing a direct connection between both.

Dragon-type Pokémon under Clair's care may be transferred to the Hidden World with her consent or your own, where they may reside permanently or semi-permanently depending on the circumstances, including both her personal team and any Dragon-type Pokémon she has rescued, trained, or taken in throughout her career as a Gym Leader, and even, under appropriate circumstances and with the necessary consent, some of her cousin Lance's Pokémon, such as his Dragonite, may eventually be integrated into the Hidden World.

Once within the Hidden World, these dragons not only adapt to the ecosystem, but may also form bonds, pair, and raise their own offspring, allowing the natural growth of draconic lineages within the sanctuary, with those born there being fully integrated into its ecosystem and its hierarchies and natural dynamics from birth.

This does not sever Clair's relationship with her Pokémon nor force her to part with them, but instead establishes her role as a continuous source of draconic lineage for the growth, diversification, and continuity of the Hidden World.​
addons.title: Draconic Sanctuary

objects.text:
"Not just a nest, Hiccup, but a land from which all dragons come."

With this Property, you gain access to the Hidden World: a vast underground sanctuary for dragons, now existing as a private pocket dimension bound to you.

This world lies within a massive volcanic caldera, serving as a portal to an infinite labyrinth of chambers and volcanic tubes winding beneath the earth, teeming with life and natural wonders: bioluminescent fungi illuminate the ceilings and walls; corals and sparkling crystals glimmer throughout the vast caverns and antechambers; waterfalls that filter through cracks in the earth form crystalline pools atop coral platforms, while the water reaching the bottom of the caldera is heated by magma, generating steam and a warm, humid tropical atmosphere, ideal for dragon life.

Within this realm dwell all dragon species seen throughout the How to Train Your Dragon films and series, from the tiniest Terrible Terror to the mightiest Screaming Death; all known species thrive in a balanced, self-sustaining ecosystem, with natural hierarchies and behaviors.

Upon claiming this Property, you may optionally designate a single Alpha dragon to rule over the Hidden World. However, leadership does not guarantee loyalty: whether you are able to train —or earn the respect of— this Alpha is entirely up to you; should you succeed, the Alpha's authority extends to you, placing all dragons of the Hidden World at your command.

The Hidden World may be accessed at will and functions as both refuge and domain, limited only by your ability to interact with its inhabitants.

Note: If you befriend, bond with, ride, or own any dragon, you can bring them to the Hidden World; regardless of their size or nature, there will always be a special place prepared for them with the proper environment to meet their needs.
objects.title: The Hidden World (How to Train Your Dragon)

addons.text:
By incorporating the Archway into your house, its power now spreads throughout it, transforming its structure and expanding its Ways across the multiverse. Now, whenever you travel to a new world, the house shall extend into the 'island' for that world provided by the Archway, quickly growing into a brand new house connect to the old one. The new house will have all the baseline features of the old one, but may incorporate special qualities and aesthetics of whatever world it's connected to.

Optionally, the front and back door of the house may come with a new special knob, to let you select an already discovered world and open the door into it.
addons.title: Vacation Homes

objects.text:
You've been given a nice, quaint little cottage. It's got a comfortable living room, a spacious kitchen, and a nice back yard with a well for water, modern conveniences and utilities...wait, that's it? Well no, of course not! This is the House of Many Ways, a house built by a wizard who had a talent for folding space.

If you stand in certain parts of the house, such as the door between the living room and kitchen, and turn or step in a particular direction, you will be transported to other parts of the house. This means the bedrooms are well-hidden enough that someone who doesn't know about the house's qualities would never be able to find them, making you quite safe at night. All of the rooms are well-furnished, perfect for kicking back and relaxing anywhere you like. There's even a pool and an orchard somewhere! You just need to go the right way.

The house also comes with certain enchantments. For instance, a small trolley in the living room will conjure tea and cakes when you ask it for 'afternoon tea' or 'morning coffee.' The pantry in the kitchen is empty, but will fill with ingredients when asked for a meal. The kitchen, gardening and other chores are handled by tiny blue Kobolds, who will do everything dutifully. Just don't ask them to grow flowers in any color other than blue on the front lawn; it's more trouble than it's worth.

You won't be left completely floundering when it comes to navigating the house either. An extensive map is provided to you; one side shows a simplified version with the parts of the house you'll likely use most, the other the full picture. In addition, you may ask aloud how to get to other parts, whereupon the voice of the house's previous owner will politely tell you how to find it.

Finally, the house's longer Ways can sometimes lead outside the house, into places of import in the world around you. Maybe it's a hidden pool in the mountains that is a leyline node, or a secret passage into the local castle. No matter how far the house is from civilization, you'll always have a shortcut to the nearest town. The library will even have some books to let you study some simple magic. Just make sure the books don't try to play pranks on you by turning pages when you're not looking...
objects.title: The House of Many Ways (Howl's Moving Castle)

objects.text:
In a realm beyond time and space, suspended between light and dark, lies a Victorian-era town cobbled together from the remnants of destroyed worlds, under a sky of eternal night. This is Traverse Town—a home for those who have lost everything.

Acting as a sanctuary for the displaced, the town is connected to every universe and realm, opening its doors to those with nowhere else to go. From homes consumed by darkness to worlds shattered by disasters, those with nowhere left to go will find themselves in the safety of the town. Yet Traverse Town is selective. It offers no refuge to hostile entities; the town seeks to preserve life, but only for those who are able to coexist with others peacefully.

Within Traverse Town, various districts allow survivors to live, trade, and find rest. Each district serves a distinct purpose, shaping its environment to the specific needs of its people while providing bountiful resources for all. Regardless of biology or origin, all beings are able to live side by side; for example, those who require extreme cold and those who thrive in intense heat can coexist without hardship, each finding a space suited to their nature. As more survivors arrive, the districts expand without limit, allowing the town to grow endlessly.

Countless Moogles work throughout the town to support this community. They regulate the economy, guide newcomers as they acclimate, and assist residents in establishing the shops and services.

You will serve as Traverse Town’s representative: a trusted figure who helps survivors and refugees inside Traverse Town. You will be respected, and people will listen to you, so long as you do not abuse their goodwill and trust. And you must be ready to protect this world from any threats that arise. As Traverse Town is not immune to danger. Villains and malicious beings can still enter, and some may seek to exploit its hospitality or seize control for their own ends. Beyond its borders, even greater threats loom that can threaten that world.

But you will not face these threats alone. Traverse Town is home to heroes who stand ready to help, including Scrooge McDuck, Donald Duck’s nephews, Aerith Gainsborough, Yuffie Kisaragi, and Squall Leonhart. Beyond them are the many refugees who have made Traverse Town their home—ordinary people and seasoned warriors alike who are willing to defend the town and protect those who cannot protect themselves.

Traverse Town is a refuge for those who have lost everything and need a place to belong. It cares for its residents, allowing them to live in safety while offering a way back should their own world, by some miracle, be restored. No matter where their journey leads, Traverse Town will always welcome them with open arms—offering hope, sanctuary, and a place to call home.
objects.title: Traverse Town (Kingdom Hearts)

objects.text: "This was a cathedral of corpses, but instead of appearing eerie, it was filled with holiness!" You have acquired the legendary Corpse Cathedral, created with the corpses of the Ancient Gods as well as their subordinate races. It appears as a majestic cathedral with pitch-black stone columns. Inside this cathedral, each column, arch, and dome’s surface is embedded with the bones of different races. In the middle is a religious symbol of your choosing, over a 100 meters tall. It appears as if there were countless souls sealed inside. The cathedral has several abilities corresponding to the Ancient Gods used to create it: Elf King Soniathrym - Amplifies all of your abilities when you are fighting inside of the cathedral, as well as weakens those of your opponents. Giant King Aurmir - The cathedral has a 1km aura that obliterates undead, spirits, and wraiths. All enemies present in the aura, regardless of their alignment, slowly feel their soul being sapped. Dragon of Imagination Ankewelt - You can "envision" various items and rooms inside the cathedral. You can instantaneously create grand thrones, vast meeting rooms, and magic items. These items cannot exist more than 1km away from the cathedral. You can even project memories, books, holograms, maps, etc. to make communication easier. For physical objects, you must understand the inner workings of what you create, so you cannot create magic golems unless you know how to craft a golem Phoenix Ancestor Gregrace - The cathedral is completely isolated from all realms, dimensions, and planes. Nobody can enter or exit without your permission. If you no longer wish for somebody to be in your cathedral, you can teleport them out. Beings with the same/higher power level than you can forcefully leave, though at a great personal cost. Shards are temporarily disconnected from their hosts in the cathedral. Mutated King Kvastir - You can seal various spirits and entities into the cathedral, gradually draining them of their power and essence while preventing them from taking any action. The energy is used to recharge the attacks of the cathedral. You can telepathically converse with sealed beings at will, though they cannot initiate conversation. Demonic Wolf Flegrea - Your cathedral and everything/everyone contained within is completely and utterly concealed. Nothing can detect or scry at their locations. Furthermore, your entry into the cathedral is untraceable, and nothing can follow you inside if you wish to flee. As the owner, you can turn off or dial back these effects as you please. Furthermore, the cathedral was the site in which the Ancient Sun God was betrayed and usurped by his 3 most trusted angels. The cathedral has thus inherited a portion of his divinity, and has a corresponding honorific name which can be prayed to. You can create an algorithm to answer prayers, ignore them entirely, or answer some of them yourself. In the last moments before his death, the Ancient Sun God also left a trump card contained within the cathedral. You may recite the phrase he uttered when waking from the Chaos Sea: "Let there be light!" Upon doing so, the cathedral releases an omnidirectional burst of light which erases all matter in a 500 meter radius. You can choose to exempt individuals/objects from obliteration. However, the actual light travels further, so the entire planet is blinded for a few seconds. This light is harmless. This ability has a massive cooldown, and can only be used once every 5 years. You can speed up the recharge time by spending time praying inside the cathedral. You do not have to pray to any particular deity and can be general about your prayers. You can even pray to yourself. The process can also be sped up by having other people pray to the cathedral itself. Due to its nature as a pseudo-Divine Kingdom, the cathedral simultaneously does and does not exist, much like Sefirah Castle. You can manifest it "physically" centered around you, in front of you, or behind you. However, by relying on its property of "nonexistence", the cathedral is extremely resistant to damage when manifested in this way. You can unsummon and resummon it to fully heal it of all damage. Furthermore, you yourself can flee with a simple thought to the cathedral while it is "nonexistent" and not physically manifested, making it nearly impossible to catch you. The cathedral is "stored" within your soul and cannot be stolen from you by any means. When summoned or unsummoned, an ominous bell rings from the cathedral and it fades into/emerges from blue mist. Any living beings caught in the radius are trapped within. You can prioritize which area/room appears first. If you kill any more divine or spiritual beings and/or genocide their races, you can add their corpses to the cathedral for a corresponding ability.
objects.title: Corpse Cathedral (Lord of The Mysteries)

addons.text:
Your dragon form has merged with the river of fate, now taking the form of a scaleless white serpent with wheels depicting the constantly turning of fate engraved on your skin, or any other appropriate form of your choosing.

As the dragon of Fate, your control over Fate becomes more finessed and ingrained. As a result, you no longer need to consciously influence Fate, and can guide a future with vague details, like "fulfillment", or "happiness", essentially allowing you to will Fate into whatever you desire.

If you possess True Dragon (Tensura), you can store your memories within the river, preventing personality loss in the event of your demise.
addons.title: Serpent of Mercury

objects.text:
You are now the sovereign of the River of Fate, and possess full control over it. The River of Fate is known to have appeared as a mercury or silver colored illusory river of light woven from complex symbols, a slowly rotating segmented wheel or a giant serpent that had its head and tail connected. Though as it's ruler, you can change it's appearance however you so please. To you, the Fates of people, objects and even ideas appear like a tributary, which you can guide into the River of Fate.

Using the authority you hold over these Fates, you can consciously weave them, allowing you to split a Fate into different parts, granting it infinite possibilities and ensuring it never falls into a dead end. You can also subsume tributaries of others into one, allowing the substitution and replacement the past of others. You can even completely sever the tributary of a person, causing them to lose their abilities, authorities, and influence over the world. 

If your body were to be completely destroyed, your spirit and consciousness can return from the River of Fate and manifest a new body, letting you resurrect. You also possess and can bless others with absolute good fortune.
objects.title: River of Fate (Lord of The Mysteries)

addons.text:
Rather than receiving a Mallorn grove, you have instead received the fully populated realm of Lothlórien, including Caras Galadhon, the Nimrodel stream with its cleansing waters, and the Celebrant river; the Mirror of Galadriel, and inhabitants skilled in the crafting of Lembas, Elven cordial, and all other works associated with Lothlórien as depicted in the books. 

As with the grove option you may place it wherever you please.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​

Galadriel’s protection on the woods that works to help prevent enemies from entering shall do so without your direct attention save for the strongest entities and should you focus you may be aware of every square centimetre of the 960,000 acres of woods.
addons.title: Lothlorien the Fair!

objects.text:
You have received a small grove of Mallorn trees, planted at a location of your choosing. These trees are of incredible beauty, with silver trunks and silver-backed leaves that turn gold in autumn yet do not fall until spring, when the branches burst into golden flowers. Wanderers in Mallorn woods find themselves surrounded by gleaming silver trunks beneath a canopy of silver and gold, walking upon a golden floor of fallen leaves.

Even individuals of little to no magical ability can sense the profound vitality emanating from the trees, and the feeling is profoundly relaxing while strengthening any natural magic. This sanctifying presence enlivens Mallorn forests, allowing the growth of rare and wondrous plants such as Niphredil, Elven corn, and Athelas within their bounds.
Mallorn trees do not die of old age and do not rot naturally, their branches also do not grow below three fathoms (about 5.5m) and are exceptionally sturdy, makes them ideal bases for tree-born structures. Their wood is easy to work yet remarkably strong — though it is rarely used, as few desire to fell them. Only the occasional fallen tree or the pruning of smaller branches yields usable timber.

These trees originated in Valinor, and were brought to Tol Eressëa by the Telerí elves; from which they were first brought to Númenor, where they grew to near 600 feet tall. From Númenor seeds were later carried to Middle-earth, and their planting in the Elven realm of Lorinand transformed it into the place known as Lothlórien: the Wood of Blooming Gold, although the Mellyrn of Lórien only grew to a third of the size of their Númenorian ancestors.
objects.title: Mallorn Grove (Lord of the Rings)

objects.text: Telperion and Laurelin were the greatest trees to exist. The only source of light in the world after the destruction of the lamps and before the creation of the Sun and Moon. With leaves of gold upon the one and leaves of silver upon the other, they shone with a beautiful light that the Sun and Moon are but pale imitations of. Ungoliant destroyed these trees, draining their light and increasing her might. Somehow, two seedlings of the trees have survived and ended up in your hands. These seedlings, when planted will sprout and over the course of a few years grow into new trees with the same light. These are hallowed and sacred things. Bring light back to this realm, or perhaps hoard it for yourself and see what you can gain from exploiting such great lights.
objects.title: Seedlings of the Trees (Lord of The Rings)

addons.text: We’re not savages you know? This slip of paper, particularly the password written on it, grants you access to the Kamar-Taj WiFi. This WiFi is unparalleled—offering no lag, interference, or downtime, and featuring top-tier security. As the Sorcerer Supreme of Kamar-Taj, you have the authority to grant or revoke access to this WiFi. It can connect to any Internet or Internet analogue available on alternate Earths to which you have a connection. Additionally, as the owner of Kamar-Taj, you will always know the Wifi password, and you can change the password at your convenience. Truly this must be a miracle only possible through magic.
addons.title: Shamballa

addons.text: As Sorcerer Supreme you have access to one of the most treasured relics of the Masters of the Mystic Arts, the amulet known as the Eye of Agamotto. This magical device allows the wearer to safely contain and control the powers of the Infinity Stone within. You also now have the knowledge and skill to be able to construct more such containment devices as you need.
addons.title: Eye of Agamotto

objects.text:
Kamar-Taj is the Headquarters of the Masters of the Mystic Arts, traditionally found in Kathmandu, Nepal, and lead by the Sorcerer Supreme, a title you now hold. You may freely choose where to locate the entrance to Kamar-Taj—now in it’s own private pocket dimension—whether in it’s traditional location in Nepal, or somewhere more local, either way this entrance location may be changed as you wish.

Founded by the legendary first Sorcerer Supreme Agamotto thousands of years ago, the Masters of the Mystic Arts are committed to the protection of the Earth from mystical threats, they train to deal with such threats as dark sorcerer’s, ghosts, demons, and dark gods, those that would seek to enter our world with intent to harm.

To aid them in their endeavors, they maintain a magical barrier designed to ward away threats, and to protect the world from dimensional threats, even capable of being used to weaken the dimensional abilities of the Entities. This magical barrier has anchor points located in Sanctums in New York, Hong Kong, and London—or any other three cities of ‘significance’ within the world you enter.

These Sanctums, along with Kamar-Taj itself, are filled with books, tomes, and magical tools and instruments to allow one to flourish as a sorcerer
objects.title: Kamar-Taj (Marvel: MCU)

addons.text: It’s always good to have staff. The Bar Sinister has now been outfitted with only the best for your needs, that is to say, yourself. Specialist clones of yourself manufactured to precision for their duties, from guards to scientists, from lawyers to doctors. Naturally, each of them has been fitted with a devotion to your true self, wouldn’t want any messy accidents after all.
addons.title: Home Sweet Home

addons.text: The Bar Sinister has been fitted with all manner of mystical additions. Great scrying mirrors, near endless reagent stocks for your alchemical pursuits, and your very own arcane library. In addition, it’s arcane defences have been improved dramatically, enough to become a safe haven for any aspiring sorcerer making notable enemies.
addons.title: Bar Mystica

addons.text: The Bar Sinister has had its facilities greatly improved. In addition to the facilities for mutant sciences, there’s now countless amenities for the sciences. Technologies capable of building armoured suits, Gamma ray projectors, Serum manufacture basins. A smorgasbord of niche equipment to facilitate your scientific endeavours. Additionally, you will have access to DNA samples from various heroes and villains in the Marvel Universe, provided they have spent a significant time on Earth.
addons.title: Multidisciplinarian

objects.text:
Whenever you wish, you can tap a sensor on the inside of your wrist and take a diamond-shaped portal to an island contained inside a pocket dimension; the Bar Sinister. 

The Krakoan Habitat of ‘Bar Sinister’, once a piece of Battleworld, is a self-contained fortress containing enough space and supplies for a full city of occupants. While this in itself is useful, It’s greatest feature is the massive genetic research laboratory that makes up most of it’s scientific quarters. Surgical bays and cloning pods stretch as far as the eyes can see, and the central data bank is rife with the genetic repository of all mutant-kind, all fit and ready for any experimentation you could desire. Furthermore, it possesses a legion of Genetic Collection Drones, in order to continue growing the collection, and ensure you never fall too far behind the biological arms race. 

The final, most monstrous, and most impressive aspect of the Bar Sinister is the secret lab. Below the island, there is a sealed laboratory only accessible by overwhelming ordinance, or verified teleportation. Such is its defences the interior is specifically shielded from temporal intrusion, ensuring it remains completely airtight. Within this lab sits the finest facilities, monitoring suite and Nathaniel Essex’s crowning achievement; The Moira Engine.

The Moira Engine is a device formed from a series of clones of Moira Mctaggart, a mutant whose gift is ‘complete timeline renewal’, restoring the timeline to the moment of her conception upon her death. By forming it into a network of clone vats, the Moira Engine allows the user to selectively activate braindead Moira clones, beginning a ‘timeline’ sequence. From this sequence they can at any time kill the moira in the tank, and send a message back to themselves at the ‘start’ of the sequence, to keep them bereft of future variables in the works.

Each moira has ten lives, meaning multiple Moira clones will be required for any extensive use of the engine. Due to how Moira X’s mutation works, these timelines are destroyed and restarted, not simulated, making them able to be accessed by atemporal means, but unable to continue past the point of the clone’s death.

You can remove the Bar Sinister from its pocket dimensions and return it to physical reality (or any other space you have access to that is large enough to contain it) if you wish, but both deploying it and returning it to a pocket dimension are very energy intensive.
objects.title: The Bar Sinister (Marvel: X-Men)

addons.text:
Rather than only the Xavier School, you can also have access to Attilan, the island of the Inhumans. 

Much like the Xavier School, Attilan is surrounded by an intense forcefield. Unlike the school however, Attilan contains a full population, containing thousands of both inhumans (pre and post-terragenisis) and a set of their Alpha-Primitive slave-caste underneath the island maintaining its machinery.

In addition, Attilan contains numerous examples of Kree technology, tirelessly maintained by the aforementioned slaves, as well as a stockpile of Teregen Mist in order to induce Terragenesis in the population (though this mist is horrifically deadly to Mutants).
addons.title: Attilan

objects.text:
You have the deed to the Greymalkin Habitat, alternately known as Xavier's School for Gifted Youngsters, The Jean Grey School for Higher Learning, and many other aliases. 

The school maintains a consistently high quality set of facilities as a mundane boarding school, with dormitories, classrooms and other expected equipment and area to be found in a school. 

Where the Institute excels however, is the mountain of advanced technology within its walls. The vast majority of this technology is either looted from an apocalyptic timeline, or adapted from the Shi’ar empire. These technologies include state of the art medical tech, surveillance systems, a vehicle hanger, Holding cells, and a joint ‘force-field’ and ‘Not-My-Problem’ field around the school to protect it from damage.

The two greatest tools of the school however, are Cerebro and the Danger Room.

Cerebro is a piece of psychic technology that exists in order to locate individuals either with superpowers or the potential to gain superpowers. When used by a regular human, this is all it can do, however when used by a psychic it acts as a worldwide range extender, making them capable of bringing their full force to bear anywhere on the planet.

The Danger Room meanwhile, is a holographic expanse capable of generating almost anything for its training programs piloted by an AI designed to avoid permanent injury to the students using it. It’s also furnished with an observation deck for the teachers to be given hands-on control.

Optionally you may gain a small contingent of mundane staff capable of teaching within the facilities as they currently stand.
objects.title: Xavier’s School for Gifted Youngsters (Marvel: X-Men)

addons.text:
Naquadah is a rare, super-heavy, super-dense chemical element. Despite its rarity, it’s used by a wide variety of races for a multitude of uses.

The most basic use of Naquadah is as a weapon, Naquadah naturally amplifies energy, especially that of explosions. But harm isn't all this metal can do, The Ancients used Naquadah for the construction of the legendary Star Gates, with the material being durable enough to be able to handle the repeated activation of the wormholes created.

Omega’s mine’s now also produce a near limitless supply of this precious metal. Use with care.
addons.title: Naquadah (Stargate)

addons.text:
Vibranium is a nearly indestructible element, found in crash-landed meteorites. By pure mass it’s stronger than steel, while being a third of the weight, It acts as a near-perfect absorber of all vibrations which renders it all but impervious to damage.

As a metal found in meteor’s then its only natural that such a resource might be found in Omega isn't it? Omega’s mine’s are filled with abundant amounts of this wonder metal, use responsibly.
addons.title: Vibranium (Marvel: MCU)

objects.text: This massive asteroid rich in the fantastic material Element Zero is the dark ‘twin’ to the Citadel, where the Citadel stands as a bastion of law and order, Omega is a haven of crime and corruption. Omega is a hub of narcotics, weapons and eezo trafficking, without even a pretense of a normal civilian government or military control. Only the various mercenary groups have managed to carve out a limited order... Until now. The Eclipse, The Blood Pack, The Blue Suns, & Aria’s Organization. These are the factions that vied for control over Omega and the immense potential for wealth it possesses, and now each and every one of them answers solely to you. The Blood Pack gain their numbers from the Krogan and the Vorcha, serving now as the sword, in situations where violence is the answer, these bloodthirsty Mercenaries are the first into the fray. The Blue Suns originally founded by Zaeed Masani and Vido Santiago are made up of Human, Turian and Batarian forces, with a speciality in protection rackets. Highly disciplined and well equipped, they act as the closest thing to law enforcement Omega has. The Eclipse formed by Asari commando Jona Sederis favor stealth, discrimination, and “intelligent” methods of conducting business. While not as steeped in discipline like their rivals the Blue Suns, Eclipse makes up for it with cutting edge equipment and weaponry, and extensive biotics. Made of of Asari, Salarians, and Humans, the Eclipse specialize in smuggling Finally is Aria T’Loak the ‘Pirate Queen of Omega’ herself, this powerful Asari biotic all but ruled Omega before you, and is loathe to surrender that power. Her pride will never allow her to admit it, but Aria does have the interests of Omega’s people in mind. In exchange for her being able to retain her power, Aria now acts as you lieutenant, managing the minutia of running Omega. It’s mines, it crimes, and everything else about it. Her organization maintains a large fleet of raiding ships, all the better to plunder the wealth of those voyaging the stars. A portion of this wealth is put aside for you, and should you need it this motley fleet of vessels will sally forth into battle. With Omega’s gangs now under control, what about it’s people? It’s people are made up of a mix of peoples, its population can be made up of any races shown in the Mass Effect Universe, such as the Asari, Drell, Humans, Krogans and more. It can also be made up of any species, races, or other physical forms you’ve bought in the CYOA. You can also choose to fill it with races/species from the world you’ll be entering, or from settings you have bought powers from as long as the races/species don’t exceed your own abilities. Finally is it’s ‘legendary’ mine’s, they seem to have a negentropic property, they flow forth their riches endlessly. Omega always seems to be able to find a new, rich vein of Element Zero to draw forth, and it has many other mines of more ‘common’ elements as well. As the ruler of this Space Rock, a portion of the materials mined can be put aside as you need it. This station will exist somewhere in the galaxy, and a Mass Relay will be in the solar system of the world of your choosing. If you do not have a method of travelling to it easily, there will be a starship that will arrive in a few days to pick you up and provide transit services for you.
objects.title: Omega (Mass Effect)

objects.text:
This massive space station is one of the crowning achievements of any civilization, practically guaranteed to be a center of most spacefaring galactic civilizations. 

This station possesses a biosphere and can comfortably house millions of people, and it will not require any kind of maintenance as there is a built in A.I. that manages everything in the Citadel that is absolutely loyal to you. It will keep the station viable for millennia without any additional resources, and is easily capable of retrieving any resources it needs. 

This also includes an entire network of Mass Relays around the galaxy to help move between, an existing infrastructure and technology needed to maintain and sustain the network, Citadel, and population as well as allowing them to continue to grow, improve, and expand as well as easily move throughout the galaxy, 

You can also choose to prefill the Citadel with a large population already on the station. The population cap is 13 million, but you can choose less. The population is absolutely loyal to you and sees you as their ruler, and will continue to be loyal to you and your heirs regardless of how many generations pass. They are also perfectly capable of self governing as well and will do so when you do not wish to take a direct handle on things, or they can do some mixture of administration duties for you, and will alter it as you wish. 

This population can be made up of any races shown in the Mass Effect Universe, such as the Asari, Drell, Humans, Krogans and more. It can also be made up of any species, races, or other physical forms you’ve bought in the CYOA. You can also choose to fill it with races/species from the world you’ll be entering, or from settings you have bought powers from as long as the races/species don’t exceed your own abilities.

If you were to buy an option that somehow grants companions, followers, locations and/or territories of some sort, you can merge them with this allowing you to extend each other’s benefits to one another without overtaking the other. 

If you have any companions and/or followers, you can choose for them to already be on The Citadel and a member of the population there, without going against the population limit. This also allows you to extend the benefits members of the The Citadel have, such understanding of the tech of the mass effect world like a native, and potentially the racial/species powers you’ve bought. 

This will exist somewhere in the galaxy, and a Mass Relay will be in the solar system of the world of your choosing. If you do not have a method of traveling to it easily, there will be a starship that will arrive in a few days to pick you up and provide transit services for you.
objects.title: The Citadel (Mass Effect)

objects.text:
You've received a modified offshore oil rig or geothermal research station. This seasteading project is not merely a military base, but the capital of a mercenary nation, a true superpower for hire.

This includes barracks & living quarters, training grounds, command centers, mess halls, prisons, R&D labs, a conservation zoo, a quarantine platform, medical facilities, resource extraction & processing platforms, salvage & construction sites, industrial sites & factories, logistics & support facilities (such as warehouses & greenhouses), long range meteorology & weather control equipment, Fulton recovery tools, SIGINT, HUMINT, OSINT, GEOINT, MASINT, & IMINT based intelligence facilities (for both operations & training), a runway and hangar, missile launchers (for many different ranges & uses), an internal mail system, transport catapults for rapidly moving things between platforms in an emergency, a site for the development & storage of nuclear weapons (as well as payload delivery systems like the Metal Gears), & even a sauna.

Naturally, your Mother Base is staffed with the best of the best that Big Boss (and his shadow) ever recruited. Not only can you expect a consistently high level of skill from your troops, but they'll be led by Miller & Ocelot, supported by Quiet, D-Dog, D-Horse, Pequod, The Sandanistas (like Paz, Chico, Amanda, & Cécile), & The Child Soldier Unit (including Eli), & equipped by Strangelove, Code Talker, & Huey (who, given what he's done, is now required to be the subject whenever Ocelot gives interrogation training).

You may choose to use the interlocking hexagonal platforms of the Caribbean Mother Base or the more traditional oil rig style construction of the Seychelles Mother Base. Either way, the prefab design is infinitely & cheaply expandable, including in the form of non-contiguous Forward Operating Bases (or "FOBs").
objects.title: Mother Base (Metal Gear)

objects.text: "Go Beyond! Plus Ultra!" You are the proud owner of the number one hero school in Japan, U.A. Academy. For generations, inexperienced kids armed with only dreams and their Quirks have walked in and came out as adult Pro Heroes, with every ounce of their potential brought to the surface. It's armed with all the mundane facilities you'd expect from a prestigious high school, and infrastructure to train young heroes that are borderline supernatural. Tournament stadiums that dwarf even the largest football fields, indoor and outdoor mock ups that simulate all aspects of heroics, entire departments dedicated to hero work beyond the battlefield, training grounds fit for a superhuman military, etc. You don't just gain the building, but its faculty. Principal (or Vice Principal) Nezu as top representative, Recovery Girl as a one woman nurse, Lunch Rush as the top chef, Power Loader who leads the Support Course, and your choice of 10 Pro Heroes as additional staff. It's also armed with a security system just as legendary, able to alert and fight back against foreigners entering the campus near instantly, assuming they somehow did in the first place. Additionally, it has an underground emergency shelter with just as much fortified security, a barrier made of the strongest metals, and propulsion jets that turn it into a flying fortress. Note: Should you find yourself in another Superhero themed setting, or as a personal choice, you can also select heroes from other worlds as staff.
objects.title: U.A. Academy (My Hero Academia)

objects.text: Within its own personal pocket dimension lies Konohagakure no Sato, the Village Hidden in the Leaves, and its immediate surroundings. The village can be left within this pocket dimension or “installed” into the world in a place of your choosing—and just as easily “returned” to its pocket dimension when you wish. You can either select a version of Konoha from the series or create a version that mixes and matches elements from different eras to craft your “perfect” Konoha. The village population can include anyone who has ever been a member of the village, regardless of where their choices led them. Otherwise, Konoha will self-populate with generic villagers and shinobi. This object doesn’t grant you any physical power by itself; instead, you fulfill the role of Daimyō, the feudal lord, with the loyalty of the Hokage and the village in your hands. You have the right to appoint or dismiss the Hokage at will and call upon the village’s services as needed. Typically, the Daimyō would reside in the nation’s capital; however, you’ll find a luxurious palace upon the Hokage Rock, set back far enough from the edge to remain unseen. Konoha will begin to offer its services to the world when you enter, accepting missions from anyone capable of paying for the services of its shinobi. However, it will never act against your interests, without you giving the village real cause to do so.
objects.title: Konoha (Naruto)

addons.text: With the use of your powers, you managed to recuperate the corrupted data from the Bunker. While you already knew how to build anything from its vast databases, the true treasure is the Androids minds inside of it. Now you can recreate any android from the series, even if they werent a YoRHA droid.
addons.title: [E]veryone is here!

addons.text: The bunker communication function is extended. Now any machine that makes a connection to it can maintain its connection regardless of distance. Not only that, data can never be truly lost. So long a single device remains, the data can be recovered.
addons.title: [B]ack up within backups

objects.text:
A center of operations that once hosted dozens of androids, the Bunker is an orbital facility made to coordinate the Androids against the Aliens invaders and their Machine army. While most of the facility is in prestine condition, the data servers of the Bunker are corrupted. While the record of the genetic information of dozens of millions of humans and the bunker schematics are intact, the rest of its petabytes of data are corrupted. Devoid of its occupants, the bunker still has its uses. 

Firstly, the Bunker is mostly self-sufficient. Without any outside interference, it could run its computers and life-support for decades. It can safely accommodate two hundred humans, if a little cramped. 

Advanced 3D printers and automated workshop machines are capable of producing advanced machinery, munition and other goods, so long they are feed materials, and the vehicle bay contains a handful of service shuttles with fuel to traverse Earth and back. The cargo hold is full of diverse material for manufacturing, and the fuel reserves are enough for the shuttles to make the Earth-bunker travel at least a dozen times.

The most powerful function of the Bunker is its broadcast capability. Together with a vast array of satellites, it allows for instant, seamless communication and data transfer between the Bunker and any device that is connected to it on the planet.
objects.title: The Bunker (NieR: Automata)

objects.text:
You are now the owner of the Space Anomaly, a giant, pristine, mobile space station that exists outside of time and space. It can be visited by any experienced Traveller during their journeys, serving as a large social hub accessible from anywhere in the universe.

It can be summoned almost anywhere in space, appearing instantaneously, and can also exist in multiple places at the same time due to its extradimensional nature. Because of this, it can protect those inside from timeline alterations.

Several kilometers long and capable of distorting space within itself to be “bigger on the inside,” it can easily house several hundred people, as well as dozens of starships and corvettes.

Inside, you will find numerous scientific and technological facilities that allow for the development of starship upgrades, teleportation terminals, exosuit technology, multi-tool modules, base-building technology, exocraft upgrades, the creation of living ships or custom corvettes, and all other advanced technologies related to No Man’s Sky.

You may dismiss the Space Anomaly, returning it to the spaces between. Optionally, you may retain the original crew of the Space Anomaly, including Nada and Polo.
objects.title: Space Anomaly (No Man's Sky)

objects.text:
You have a sapling that produces weird fruit each and every week. Each one of these fruits is a devil fruit, each one possessing mystical and strange powers that seem to be born of the dreams of humans. As time passes and the sapling grows, the time between each fruit decreases and the number of fruits it produces increases. Any devil fruits that have already grown on the tree will not regrow.

When a devil fruit user dies, their fruit is reincarnated as the closest fruit of the same type as the original devil fruit. If no such fruit exists, it will have a chance to regrow on the devil fruit tree, but it is not guaranteed to regrow the next time the devil fruit tree blooms, so a devil fruit might never reappear if its base fruit becomes extinct.
objects.title: Devil Fruit Tree (One Piece)

addons.title: Vegapunk City!
addons.text: Vegapunk himself, along with his Satellites, have now returned to Egghead with even more knowledge. All 7 beings now come complete with all the knowledge given by the Technology and Artifice Power, Blacksmithing and all. They also come complete with their replacement parts, Vegapunk's perfect clone technology, and even the technology to let you make your own satellites for yourself. With this, you can now split aspects of yourself into different mechanical beings, although HOW this is done is up to you.

objects.text:
It seems you've stumbled upon a marvel of the world, as you now own Egghead Island. This Technological wonderland is home to machines that can marvel the world, a retro-futurists paradise. This Island has all that's been shown it to have, including the Lightsaber-like Beam Saber, the blueprints to make Living Zoan weapons, and even the research of the Lineage Factor of a being.

The Island itself is meant to have a wintery climate, but thanks to the Climate Control device on the island, it resembles more of a tropical rainforest the closer in you get. Further out however, it does indeed become snowier.

But the biggest benefit of this Island is known as Punk Records. A brain that contains all the knowledge and information of the One Piece world that Vegapunk himself knew, although he and his Satellites do not come with this Island, same with their Satellite technology.
objects.title: Egghead Island (One Piece)

addons.text: Some members of the Ainz Ooal Gown guild will now come along with you as companions. If you have A Medium Organization the whole guild will come along, even Bellriver.
addons.title: Guildmates

addons.text:
An additional area has been integrated into your Great Tomb of Nazarick, echoing the Dwelling of Spirits, the domain of the Demon Lord Ramiris. 

Your Dwelling of Spirits functions as a spawn point for Lesser Elemental Pop Monsters. By default, these mobs are essentially egoless, functioning as little more than balls of elemental energy that follow simple orders and defend their area. However, over time, these elementals can gain experience and develop their egos to the point where they can act independently and follow complex commands, at which point they will become Medium Elementals, though that will be the limit of their natural evolution.

While normally these naturally occurring elementals can only be aligned with one of the Five Great Elements or the two Higher Elements, should you possess any of the Strange Elements, they can also spawn with that alignment. Additionally, you may invest a portion of your own power to elevate spirits of your element(s) to a higher evolutionary state. Be warned though, this is an expensive process, so raising an elemental to your current level could leave you in a crippled state.

Finally, your Dwelling comes with a new Area Guardian NPC, a Greater Elemental of your element(s) roughly equivalent in strength to one of YGGDRASIL’s Primal Elementals. You may design their appearance and background setting content.
addons.title: Dwelling of Spirits

objects.text:
Congratulations! You have taken the Great Tomb of Nazarick and the title of Guildmaster right from under Momonga's nose. With this purchase, you not only get the complete contents of the tomb, including everything in the treasury and the NPCs who are absolutely fanatically loyal to you and you alone, but this is the most complete self-sufficient version of it! This means that everything inside has been slightly remodelled to make room for self-sustaining things like farms and respawning mines made up of every type of mineral from the novel.

Separated in its own pocket dimension that only you will know the way to open is Nazarick, your impregnable fortress. This fortress responds to your will by sitting on the world item 'The Throne of Kings'. If you want to take it to another world you want to visit, just sit upon the throne and select a space for it to occupy in that world, and it will teleport seamlessly there as if it has always been there. Your throne is always accessible to you, no matter where you are, even if you are sealed away.
objects.title: The Great Tomb (Overlord)

objects.text: The path to power is a long and challenging one that is hard to circumvent, until now, of course. You have a soulbound key that opens a gateway to a Pokemon Daycare that exists outside of space itself and is bound to the passage of time for you instead of that of any one universe. When you keep Pokemon or some other type of animal/monster inside for an extended period of time, they’ll naturally get stronger by 1% of their current power every 24 hours up to their natural limit.
objects.title: Daycare (Pokemon)

objects.text: Lets Go Gambling!~ You have come into possession of a business of a Game Corner; a building filled to the brim with countless games that can be played many of them in use for Gambling such as various slot machines, roulette wheel, Card Games and various other methods of Gambling however that is not all that the Game Corner has to offer as it also has a wide selection of different arcade machines. People without a Coin Case or those who wish to purchase Chips for use in various Games can exchange money at the Service Desk. To take part in the activities one would simply need to have access to a Coin Case; revealing a section of the building dedicated to such games, through winning Coins anyone could buy the different prizes exchanged for Coins at the Prize Corner that include several Pokémon: Abra, Clefairy, Nidorina, Dratini, Scyther, Porygon, Pikachu, Horsea, Vulpix, Wigglytuff, Pinsir, Mr. Mime, Eevee, Sandshrew, Ekans, Cubone and several Items that are beneficial such as Health Potions, Revives and other items. Deep beneath the Game Corner lies a secret, A hidden base for the villainous organization known as Team Rocket; you have taken the place of an Admin in the organization are now in charge of the base in this location a branch of the greater Team Rocket having resources that would be unavailable for lesser branches you possess a few hundred grunts and higher ranked members of team rocket although none higher than your own rank you also command several Team Rocket scientists capable of cloning Pokémon to restock the Game Corner Pokémon Prize pool. Koffing, Weezing, Zubat, Golbat, Ekans, Arbok, Sandshrew, Sandslash, Rattata, Raticate, Murkrow, Machop, Machocke, Grimer, Muk, Drowzee, Hypno, Cubone, Marrowak, Mewoth, Gloom, and Houndoom are all Pokémon used by Team Rocket.
objects.title: Game Corner (Pokemon)

objects.text:
You have managed to acquire a copy of the Pokémon Box-linked paradise that is the Alolan Poké Pelago islets off of Akala's eastern coastline, complete with a caretaker and maintainer of the place like Mohn that lives in a floating Raft Hut in the middle of the islets' formation. Despite the islets' size, the Pokémon you have caught can occasionally be found here, enjoying the tropic atmosphere, even the Ice types. To expand / level up the islets, you need to box a certain amount of Pokémon and a payment of Beans.

<u>Isle Abeens</u>: The beans that grow here are not just good macro-friendly eats; Poké Beans are also Poké Pelago's currency, and this islet’s iconic beanstalk is your money printer. Upgrading this island gives you bigger bean hauls after shaking the beanstalk. Wild Pokémon occasionally will find their way to this isle, and can join you.

<u>Isle Aplenny</u>: This islet has great potential for agriculture, with eternally healthy black soil that can feed Berry crops for generations.

<u>Isle Aphun</u>: An islet with a bigger on the inside cavern system that Pokémon can explore at your command to find various types of mineable materials like Shards, evo stones, and fossils, depending on the adventure you sent them on.

<u>Isle Evelup</u>: An islet that your Pokemon can play on training equipment that can handle even the heaviest mons out there. Drinks are handed out to the hard playing Pokémon to keep them hydrated, which also allows better gains to stats or EXP.

<u>Isle Avue</u>: An islet famous for its mineral-rich hot springs. Pokémon that bathe in these waters, including the Ice types, will like you more, though they can overheat. The springs also serve to help speed up the hatching of any Eggs placed in their waters.
objects.title: Poké Pelago (Pokémon [Ultra] Sun / [Ultra] Moon)

objects.text:
Congratulations, you managed to obtain an Explorer's Kit, and with it, access to the winding yet very well lit and ventilated hallways of the Grand Underground, a labyrinthine mining operation underneath the Sinnoh Region that have 6 distinct subregions.

Here, you can mine the regenerating walls for various treasures like fossils, evo stones, and the like with either the mining tools that came with the Kit or your own you might have on hand.

While here, you can carve out a Secret Base that will serve as your little corner of the world with a Super Digger Drill that came with your Explorer Kit. Unlike the normal Digger Drill, which burns out and breaks pretty quickly after doing its job of making your Base, the Super one will not. Not only that, but you are also able to make up to two basement floors for your Secret Base, connected by ladders.

Vendors down here will trade you TMs and decorations like podiums, mats, and plushies for your underground base in exchange for Spheres, gemstones of varying sizes you can mine from these walls. You can even exchange Spheres of one size for the other if you need more of a certain size. Do note that you may have only one Secret Base; if you try to make another, everything in your old one will be packed up and the entrance will be closed up.

Unlike the original Underground, the Grand Underground has cavernous habitats that are the home to Pokémon that are both not normally found within Sinnoh's borders and those native to the region.
objects.title: Grand Underground (Pokemon Brilliant Diamond / Shining Pearl)

objects.text:
You have managed to find a panopticon formation of hingeless green or purple doors that will take you into a Hyperspace version of any Pokémon city or town you wish to visit. The doors will be marked by type symbols and rating stars, with the green doors leading to wild Pokémon of unknown origins, while the purple ones have Trainers of equally unknown origins behind it. Once you return from Hyperspace, the door will vanish, but it will respawn by nightfall / next morning, which also randomizes the door's ratings, common Pokémon type, and trial type.

The original Hyperspace version of Lumiose City was a sub dimension that mirrored the real city, created by a Rogue Mega Darkrai that absorbed the leftover Mega Energy gathered by the Ange super-weapon, the root of Lumiose's Rogue Mega Evolution problem, that was activated 5 years after the Ultimate Weapon was fired in Geosenge Town. 

All Pokémon, either found or brought into Hyperspace, become hyper-empowered by the sub dimension's energy, allowing even the weakest Pokémon to be leagues stronger than normal Pokémon, up to Lv. 200. As soon as wild Hyperspace Pokémon are caught, however, that energy leaves them, leaving them with their natural strength. You can occasionally find floating piñata-like golden Poké Balls that can drop Hyperspace Berries, bags of Gimmighoul Coins and rarely even specific evolution items like Feebas’s Prism Scales once broken into.

Normally, entering Hyperspace portals would require a Hoopa, then making and feeding it donuts with regular and/or Hyperspace Berries to calorically empower the Mischief Pokémon. The Network, however, can circumvent the Hoopa & the donut requirements with any form of energy, including but not limited to Type Energy, Cursed Energy, Haki, Chakra, etc.
objects.title: Hyperspace City Portal Network (Pokémon Legends ZA: Mega Dimensions)

objects.text: Founded in 1919 in response to an early draft of the 18th Amendment, which would ban not only alcohol but also games and entertainment as a whole, The Inventory (using the renovated basement of a games factory) remains as a home away from home for all game enthusiasts, developers, and characters alike. And with this purchase, you are its sole owner. Included with The Inventory is Dick and Kent’s Games and Amusement Factory, placed in a convenient location for you with all legal matters filled out and handled retroactively. The Inventory is connected to numerous worlds, acting as a sort of venue/hub area for people from said worlds to relax and play a variety of games (Card, board, video, or otherwise). Using these connections, you and your clients can travel to and from these worlds. You gain revenue from the buy-ins, donations, and purchases from clients, and are able to use these funds to connect to more worlds and/or renovate and upgrade The Inventory, gaining even more clients and providing more services to them in turn, generating more profits, so on and so forth. Due to a clause in inheriting The Inventory from the previous owner, our connections have temporarily been closed down. Starting out, you will have a connection to 10 worlds. When a new connection is made to a world, you can send up to 10 letters through the connection, which will find people and invite them to The Inventory, with the offer being indefinite until you or the recipient choose to rescind the invitation. When rescinding an invitation, any memory the client may have of The Inventory’s existence is erased. The Inventory strictly forbids any acts of violence or harm, with any who break this rule being punished accordingly. If a client dies in their world for whatever reason, you may send out another letter to their respective world and invite someone to replace their spot. Of course, you cannot run The Inventory on your own forever. You can give any clients you have offers for positions as staff for The Inventory, and should they accept, this will free up their spot for you to give to another. The Inventory prides itself for being hidden away from anything and anyone wanting to take away the freedom of entertainment, and as such has effectively absolute protections towards precognition, postcognition, divination, observation, and other such methods of finding The Inventory or anything inside without using an invitation. The invitations are also bound to the person meant to have them, so other people cannot use the invitations for themselves. With consent from you, however, this rule can be bent by allowing the client to bring a trusted tag-along.
objects.title: The Inventory (Poker Night at The Inventory)

addons.text:
What’s a cutting-edge orbital research station without a crew to bring it to life? Having the Chief Director and a descendant of the Founders as a companion, it would indeed be unusual to operate such a facility without a capable team supporting its operations. With this add-on, Talos-1 comes fully staffed, ensuring every role on the station is filled by qualified personnel.

Your station will now host a complete and highly trained crew, with redundancies built into critical roles. The staff includes scientists, astronauts, cosmonauts, engineers, security personnel, janitors, and an assortment of backup team members to ensure smooth functionality. Human personnel are further complemented by a robust network of Operators, providing automated assistance and maintaining operational efficiency.

This cohesive workforce ensures that Talos-1 not only functions as intended but thrives as a hub for innovation, exploration, and security. Whether conducting groundbreaking research, managing day-to-day tasks, or responding to emergencies, your crew and Operators stand ready to support the station’s ambitious endeavors.
addons.title: Trained Personnel

addons.text:
Leveraging your complete technological knowledge and peak research capabilities of the Talos-1, your station now operates at a level beyond cutting-edge. Your Operators have been significantly upgraded, with humanoid variants running modified neural frameworks composed of all Neuromods available in the station's database. Each sector is now overseen by a version of Morgan(a) Yu Operator, ensuring unparalleled efficiency in design, testing, and research processes.

The station’s fabricators and recyclers have also advanced to extraordinary levels. With enough time and resources, these systems can construct an entire new station with minimal material loss. This development greatly enhances the sustainability and scalability of your operations. Research into Typhon materials has similarly reached new heights, enabling the creation of synthetic variants that reduce the inherent risks of studying such formidable lifeforms.

Talos-1’s modular design and adaptability have been enhanced to unprecedented levels. Should the need arise for secure containment cells or specialized research facilities, the station can "print" new sections. These additions are equipped with state-of-the-art safety measures, including rapid deployment capabilities and self-destruct systems for emergency containment. Each module is entirely self-sustaining, featuring integrated Plasma-Fusion Reactors, Solar Panels, and Magnetosphere Generators. These upgrades allow the station to function independently, even in harsh environments such as orbits around Venus or Mercury.

Talos-1 is now more than just a research hub; it is a fully adaptable, self-replicating technological marvel, prepared to tackle the most ambitious challenges in the cosmos.
addons.title: Above the Cutting-edge

addons.text:
Your science team initially thought the Klyntar was just another Typhon anomaly, a strange lifeforms discovered within a satellite, responding to life signals. However, after donating a sample, they realized its vast potential. Now, you wield full control over Klyntar biology, similar to how you manipulate the Typhon. You can force them to create offshoots, generate valuable raw materials, or tap into their Hive-Mind for collective coordination.

The Klyntar Hive-Mind offers more than just synchronization; it grants access to an immense reservoir of shared knowledge.
