You can harness this intelligence to streamline large-scale operations, research, and innovation. Additionally, you can genetically modify the Klyntar to produce bio-engineered materials, such as self-replicating nanobots, bio-metals, and even biological weaponry. Their remarkable adaptability makes them ideal for designing self-sustaining ecosystems, both for research and practical applications.

Taking this further, you can experiment by integrating Klyntar matter with other species, creating hybrid symbiotic organisms. These enhancements could lead to improved human or alien capabilities, such as augmented strength, cognition, or sensory abilities. By merging Klyntar biology with technology, you could also develop organic interfaces, bio-computers, or sentient weapons. This power opens doors to revolutionary breakthroughs in biotechnology, human augmentation, and perhaps even interdimensional warfare, with the potential to shape the future of both organic and synthetic life.
addons.title: Another Extra-Dimensional Menace

objects.text:
Talos-1 is a massive orbital research station, stretching nearly 800 meters in length, and located in high lunar orbit. Originally constructed during the Cold War as the Soviet-American Kletka station, it was repurposed and expanded in the 2030s by TranStar Corporation into a cutting-edge scientific hub. Combining the art-deco elegance of its corporate redesign with its utilitarian origins, Talos-1 stands as a testament to human ambition and technological progress. Its modular design allows for unparalleled adaptability, accommodating a wide array of research fields and ensuring its relevance in the ever-evolving landscape of scientific innovation.

The station’s primary mission is the development of Neuromod technology, which integrates Typhon-derived neural pathways to enhance human abilities. Research takes place in specialized labs, such as the Neuromod Division, Psychotronics Lab, and Hardware Labs, supported by essential infrastructure like the Arboretum, Crew Quarters, and Life Support Systems sustain the staff, while areas like Deep Storage and the Power Plant or Solar Panels ensure operational security and energy supply. These labs are critical for advancing human enhancement, studying alien biology, and exploring new materials, placing Talos-1 at the forefront of both scientific discovery and applied Engineering.

Designed to operate autonomously, Talos-1 employs advanced AI and a fleet of Operator robots to oversee daily operations. These systems manage routine tasks, supply logistics, and emergency responses with minimal human oversight. This high degree of automation allows researchers to focus entirely on their work, pushing the boundaries of scientific discovery. The station’s modular design further ensures that its facilities can be reconfigured quickly to accommodate new research needs, making it a highly adaptable platform for innovation.

The station is equipped with fail-safes and safety protocols to prevent catastrophic outcomes, such as Grey Goo scenarios or viral pandemics. These systems automatically halt dangerous experiments, ensuring safety, though they can be compromised by human error or sabotage. Despite these protections, Talos-1 remains vulnerable to breaches from Tinkers or Thinkers.

Talos-1 accelerates research through access to Typhon materials and TranStar’s cutting-edge technology, allowing for breakthroughs that would be impossible elsewhere. The station’s work environment is optimized for creativity and rapid innovation, with researchers benefiting from hands-on involvement in projects that further enhance productivity.

Talos-1 represents the pinnacle of human ambition, with its self-sustaining, highly automated systems ensuring smooth operation while advancing groundbreaking science at the edge of human knowledge.
objects.title: Talos-1 Station (Prey)

objects.text:
Congratulations. You have gained complete and total control over The Head, and have effectively become the ruler of humanity as a result. 

The Head is the central governing body of The City, a gargantuan country sized metropolitan area housing divided into 26 districts housing 7 billion people. The Head itself is comprised of 3 conglomerates, that being A-Corp, B-Corp, and C-Corp. The 3 corporations together control the 3 central districts of The City, containing around 800 million people, all of which will be loyal to you.

As the sole central authority of The City, The Head naturally possess access to all technologies ever created by the denizens of The City, including the ever so coveted Singularities, technologies so advanced they appear to defy physics and cross into the realm of magic. An example of a Singularity would be the power to open things on a conceptual level. The Head utilizes these Singularities to maintain order in The City with the creation of 3 types of enforcers: Arbiters, Beholders, and Claws. 

As their name suggests, Claws are equipped with an armored bionic arm ending in a clawed hand, as well as a multitude of other enhancements. Claws are the foot soldiers of The Head, dispatched to deal with low level threats such as tax evaders. Despite this, they are each still capable of ripping apart the strongest of The City in moments with sheer physicality or when injected with one of their many Singularity enhanced serums, bolstering their already formidable power even further.

Arbiters are the aces of The Head, each with the same physical prowess of a Claw while also having lesser versions of Singularities merged into their bodies, effectively allowing them to do magic. Abilities such as locking away an opponent's abilities, opening permanent wounds, creating massive shockwaves, and energy manipulation are all powers which an Arbiter can be expected to possess.

To keep a watchful eye over The City, Beholders are made. They act as invisible and unseen information gatherers. They know and see all which occurs within the confines of The City, allowing The Head to punish any and all dissent with impunity the moment it occurs. In conjunction with the Arbiters and Claws, Beholders ensure that the rule of The Head remains uncontested.

The Head may be retroactively inserted onto your world in a location of your choosing, or if you have a pocket dimension, it may be located there instead.
objects.title: The Head (Project Moon)

addons.text: You no longer recieve an empty Library, but instead The Library as it is at the end of Impuritias Civitatis before Angela releases the light. This means you gain all its abnormalities, the books of everybody the Library has ever faced, including the Reverberation Ensemble, and all Patron Librarians. All of whom will be loyal to you. Optionally, you may relinquish control of The Library to Angela to have her resume her role as Head Librarian.
addons.title: The Library of Ruina
Come to The Library, We Are No Longer Asking
addons.text:
The Library, once a purely static location, has fused with your Reality Marble to become deployable at a moment's notice, forcing people into it whether they like it or not. Alternatively, you can choose to simply drop the entire structure on somebody. 

Furthermore, partial manifestation of your Reality Marble within your own body will allow you to utilize the powers of people's books even if you are outside The Library.

objects.text:
The Library is no ordinary building, but rather an E.G.O., a manifestation of the mind. This gives The Library many unique properties, first of which being that it is much larger on the inside than the outside. Moreover, due to it being a manifestation of the mind, you can freely decide on the architectural style for each of its floors and rearrange its books at will. 

Speaking of the books, anyone who perishes within the confines of The Library (including allies) will become books, in them, a recounting of the booked person's life and aspirations. In addition, pages from these books may be "equipped" to gain the abilities and skills of the defeated to bolster you or your allies. Should you choose to be merciful, booked persons can be released, wherein they will gradually reform into their proper bodies over a long period of time.

This process differs when it comes to inhuman monsters, as they will instead be perfectly contained within The Library when defeated. When intense emotion is generated within a floor holding a monster during a battle, certain benefits based on the contained monster will be given to your allies depending on if the emotions generated are positive or negative. Positive emotion will give general improvements, while negative emotion will give stronger benefits at a cost.

(It is possible to have both positive emotion and negative emotion empowerments simultaneously.)

As its Head Librarian, you may send invitations to The Library to anyone you wish, even across other dimensions. Once they sign the invitation, the recipient will instantly be transported to The Library. Should you wish to barr entry into The Library instead, you may choose to deploy a thick fog to ensroud The Library, shrouding it from view and preventing anyone who cannot travel between dimensions to enter. However, this does not prevent guests in The Library from escaping. Invitations will still work when the fog is deployed.

While currently empty with only 1 floor, as you collect more books, The Library will gradually expand ever upward, gaining more and more floors as its shelves fill ever higher.
objects.title: The Library (Project Moon)

objects.text:
You find yourself in a possesion of the Academy City's and, by extension, the entire world's most powerful supercomputer.

Located aboard the Orihime-1 satellite, Tree Diagram is mostly used for research purposes, with the computer being able to accurately predict the outcomes of experiments that would've been too dangerous or too costly to actually carry out. Its calculation capacity is so high that it can accurately predict weather for months by analysing the movement of particles in the air.

But its most valuable function is its ability to calculate the most efficient ways of power development. If you provide the Tree Diagram with comprehensive description of your powers, or, better still, allow it to scan you, it will be able to provide you with step-by-step plans on how to achieve any desired breakthrough. The more information Tree Diagram has, the more efficient these plans will be.

Of course, the harder it is in general to achieve new level of power in your power system - the more complex and time-consuming the plans will be, but as long as it is at all possible to achieve your desired result - Tree Diagram will be able to guide you.
objects.title: Tree Diagram (Raildex)

addons.text:
It seems you have gained the ability to create Mabeasts of all types and strengths through magic alone. With sufficient time, effort, and resources, you could raise entire armies of creatures comparable to Shaula or even the Three Great Mabeasts. Given enough dedication, it is possible to engineer Mabeasts capable of rivaling the Witches of Sin themselves in both power and horror.

Your mastery extends even further, allowing you to create entirely new Witch Factors with custom rules, Authorities, conditions, and requirements tailored to your design. However, any Witch Factors you create are forever incompatible with yourself, rendering you incapable of wielding them personally.

This ability is not limited to Mabeasts alone. You are also capable of creating any race found upon Od Laguna, whether sapient or non-sapient in nature.
addons.title: Mabeast Designer

addons.text:
You have somehow discovered a miraculous procedure, one that can be performed through mere touch, that fundamentally alters the very nature of Miasma itself. From that moment onward, all within the Tower who are granted this power experience Miasma in an entirely transformed state.

No longer is it a corruptive, black, sickly mist: a toxic waste-energy born from Witch Factors, lethal to plants and catastrophic to the minds and souls of sapient/near-sapient or spiritual beings. Instead, it has become something akin to divine purification, a “cleansing of sin.” What was once the byproduct of spiritual corruption has been remade into the residue of a soul-cleansing force bestowed upon those you empower.

Its effects remain overwhelming, but its nature has changed completely. Rather than poisoning life and driving mortals into madness, this new Miasma purges sin, corruption, darkness, and spiritual impurity's. Those exposed to it are no longer driven to insanity, but instead are consumed by intense, fanatical loyalty toward those who exude it. Plants no longer wither in its presence; they flourish with vitality and accelerated growth. Spiritual beings similarly thrive beneath its influence, becoming stronger, more harmonious, and deeply devoted.

This transformation also gives rise to an entirely new class of spirits: Holy Spirits of Light. These beings are primarily born from the combined aura shared by you and Satella. Though radiant, cheerful, and warm in demeanor, they remain fundamentally alien in the same unsettling manner as all spirits. Their kindness possesses an inhuman purity to it, comforting, yet deeply unnatural. Because they are formed directly from your altered aura, they possess absolute loyalty, devotion, and protectiveness toward both you and Satella.

Yet your aura does not create Light alone.

It also gives birth to the opposing counterpart: Spirits of Demonic Darkness, living manifestations of purified Miasma itself. These spirits share the same absolute loyalty, devotion, and reverence toward their creators, but their nature reflects the darker aspect of your transformed power. Where the Holy Spirits are serene and radiant, the Demonic Spirits are prideful, aggressive, and terrifyingly violent toward any who are not you or Satella. They embody domination, wrath, and predatory instinct, carrying themselves with an almost regal arrogance befitting beings born from the shadow of divinity. Even so, before you and Satella they are utterly obedient, fiercely protective creatures that regard the two of you with worshipful adoration.

As a consequence of this miracle, you automatically form contracts with both the Great Spirit of Holy Light and the Great Spirit of Demonic Darkness. You may freely determine the form each spirit takes, as well as the precise nature of your relationship with them. Regardless of these choices, however, both spirits remain eternally and unbreakably loyal, devoted, and bound to your will.
addons.title: The Holy Spirits

addons.text:
The Watchtower has now become a Guild Base of Yggdrasil, with you as its Guild Master and Supreme Being. In this new form, the Watchtower possesses defensive capabilities far surpassing the original Pleiades Watchtower and even the Great Tomb itself. Its barriers, traps, magical systems, protections, and anti-intrusion measures are considered unparalleled, making it the most fortified Guild Base ever created.

The Guild is granted 5,000 NPC Levels, and you may gain more. 1,000 Levels are used to create ten fully min-maxed Level 100 NPCs of your choosing. 100 Levels are granted to Volcanica, restoring his mind to the absolute peak of his prime. Shaula receives 100 Levels, Rui Arneb, and her sister NPC, Spica, both also gain 100 levels each, and Reid Astrea likewise gains 100 Levels, all of their Classes are a perfect fit for them and enhance them beyond their base power. Satella is a natural NPC of the Guild, as a World Enemy "The Great Witch of Grief and Envy", this has granted her more power, and means of growing and using her original powers. Her lore is identical to that of what actually happened on Od Laguna, including the fact that “your” death was the catalyst for her descent into catastrophe. 

The remaining NPC Levels may be distributed however you desire, though you have a separate 50K level 10 Maids, Butlers, and Workers, though you will get more for free for any other Property you gain/claim, whether from this CYOA, or other means, to maintain and keep the Guild functional and Beautiful. You may fuse any properties you gain into the Tower.

The Guild is equal to a top 3 Yggdrasil Guild Base. Powerful Pop Monsters, ranging from Level 40 downward, though some can be above that, now spawn in your territory, endlessly restocking mines filled with every unique material found within Yggdrasil. The more powerful the material, the fewer resources each mine produces and the more difficult the material becomes to mine or harvest, it also produces mines with the same properties for any other powers you possess.

All NPCs within the Guild regard you as their beloved Supreme Being, the master who never abandoned them. In contrast, they view your Guild Members as traitors who forsook you and the Guild.

You gain a Treasury on the scale of Nazarick’s own, overflowing with infinite Yggdrasil Coins. These funds may be used to resurrect any fallen NPC without limit and many many more uses beyond being solid Mystic Gold Coins. The Treasury additionally contains a near-infinite stockpile of equipment, consumables, crafting materials, artifacts, and magical items up to Divine Class in quality, alongside eleven World Items of your choice, on top of the already existing twelve you had from The Great Tomb (Overlord). 

You acquire a System identical to the one Players possessed. You begin at Level 1 and level up without limit, acquire classes, and more. Any racial abilities or supernatural species traits you already possess are converted into equivalent racial classes, and these racial classes may continue evolving into forms or evolutions that never originally existed within Yggdrasil or the universe they are from.

Your NPCs interpret this state as the price you paid to save them from the destruction of Yggdrasil itself, further deepening their love, loyalty, and reverence toward you. You also acquire a more regal appearance, an unnaturally commanding voice, and a naturally dignified demeanor befitting an absolute ruler.
addons.title: The Guild Of The Stars

addons.text:
You have gained the ability to create Angels at will, producing beings that exist in three distinct categories, each shaped entirely by your authority as a Supreme Being. The first are the Native Angels of Yggdrasil, entities whose appearances are formed from varying combinations of Mechanical, Classical, and Biblical. Every Angel is unique, with no two possessing the exact same balance of traits. Their morality, personality, and fundamental nature are determined entirely by you during their creation. The dominant aspect of an Angel’s appearance heavily influences its mindset and behavior. Mechanical Angels are cold, hyper-logical beings driven by precision and efficiency above all else. Classical Angels are more humanlike and personable, often cheerful, emotional, or charismatic in nature. Biblical Angels, by contrast, are eldritch and awe-inspiring entities whose thoughts and presence are nearly incomprehensible to mortal minds, radiating instinctive worship and divine reverence toward their creator. Most Angels exist as mixtures of these archetypes, with any proportion possible between the three.

The second consists of the Fallen Angels, former Yggdrasil Angels who have violated the nature and purpose originally granted to them. Their fall is never born from rebellion, but instead from perceived failures, overwhelming guilt, and resentment over harm brought to you. Despite turning away from the roles you created them for, they remain NPCs born from your divine authority, and thus their identities still revolve entirely around you. Fallen Angels are generally despised by other NPCs and often by one another, resulting in a culture defined by self-hatred, fanatic repentance, and violent devotion. Many seek redemption through endless warfare, suffering, punishment, martyrdom, or acts of brutal religious zeal.

The final category are the “True Angels,” though they resemble primordial eldritch entities more than conventional celestial beings. They appear as though formed from the First Light that existed before the Void itself, possessing nearly incomprehensible forms that shift constantly between abstraction and divinity. Though wildly random in appearance, they are almost always predominantly pure white with radiant golden accents. These entities possess shapeshifting and mimicry abilities surpassing even those of Doppelgängers, allowing them to perfectly imitate voices, forms, and mannerisms. While they usually default to humanoid forms similar to the more humanlike Biblical Angels, their true appearances are impossible masses of living light, eyes, wings, halos, and impossible geometries that lesser minds struggle to comprehend without fear or madness. To most beings they are utterly unknowable, yet despite this alien nature they are beyond the Fanatical Worship of the other NPC's.

Within your hierarchy, the Native Yggdrasil Angels serve as the backbone of your divine armies, functioning as elite foot soldiers and frontline powerhouses typically ranging from Level 10 to Level 80. Fallen Angels occupy the roles of preachers, berserkers, inquisitors, and enforcers, believing that endless violence and unwavering service are necessary acts of repentance for abandoning the nature you originally bestowed upon them. The True Angels serve as infiltrators, spies, special forces operatives, and overwhelming apex entities whose power far exceeds most others under your command. These eldritch beings commonly range from Level 80 to Level 120, standing among the most dangerous and terrifying servants within your Guild.
addons.title: Army of Angels

addons.text:
You have gained the ability to create three distinct kinds of Automatons at will, each possessing their own unique traits, origins, and functions within your domain. The first are the standard Yggdrasil Automatons, encompassing every imaginable specialization, appearance, combat role, and level range. These Automatons resemble highly advanced Tactical Dolls, though far more powerful and more human. Despite their mechanical nature, they possess humanlike mannerisms, personalities, but very Dulled emotion, of most types. Any upgrades, enhancements, or modifications applicable to Tactical Dolls grant them corresponding free racial levels, allowing them to evolve far beyond their original frameworks.

The second category are biological pseudo-homunculi, artificial lifeforms that blur the line between engineered organism, and alchemical construct. Unlike the standard Automatons, these beings are organic and possess highly individualized, often exotic appearances. One may possess flawless golden skin that shines like polished metal, while another may have gemstone irises, crystalline bones, silver blood, or other unnatural biological anomalies. Despite their uniqueness, these entities possess a strict maximum level of 25, making them largely unsuited for direct combat against the overwhelmingly powerful beings that dominate higher-level battlefields. However, what they lack in raw power they compensate for with a complete absence of the concept of death. They do not naturally understand mortality, fear, or the permanence of destruction, granting them an eerie innocence and detachment from suffering that often unsettles even other NPCs. They are also Very Self Sacrificial, actively throwing themselves into any and all danger towards you, no matter how small. Do note they still feel pain. 

The final category are the Undead Automatons, perhaps the strangest and most unsettling of all your creations. These beings exist as grotesque unions of undeath and machinery, combining necromantic horror with artificial construction. Some are undead entities such as Elder Liches or Overlords whose skeletal or decayed bodies have been entirely replaced with living metal and mechanical frameworks, transforming them into immortal machine-like sovereigns of death. Others appear almost human at first glance, resembling unnaturally pale corpses covered in blood, exposed machinery, surgical wounds, and mechanical augmentations hidden beneath torn flesh. Their existence creates a disturbing contradiction between life, death, and artificiality, making them deeply uncanny even among other NPCs.

Regardless of category, all Automatons possess the same overwhelming fanaticism and cult-like devotion shared by your other creations, though often to an even greater extreme. To them, you are not merely a ruler or deity, but the singular reason they exist at all. This knowledge drives many of them toward obsessive loyalty, reverence, and absolute devotion, causing even the most logical or emotionless among them to regard your will as the highest and most sacred truth in existence.
addons.title: Automatons of The Guild Master

addons.text:
You possess the ability to create three distinct categories of Demons from your blood, each embodying different aspects of corruption, fear, and devotion to your will. The first are the Demons of Sin, beings born directly from the concepts of vice and spiritual corruption. You may create Demons aligned with any Sin imaginable, such as the Nine Great Sins to countless lesser flaws and obsessions that plague mortal minds. The Nine Great Sins stand above all others as transcendent entities of terrifying power, each existing at approximately Level 150 and functioning as near-absolute embodiments of their respective concepts.

Lesser Sin Demons, while weaker, are still immensely dangerous entities generally ranging from Level 90 to 100. Unlike the Great Sins, they are typically less specialized and instead possess balanced builds that combine overwhelming magical ability with martial prowess. Each possesses unique skills, curses, and supernatural abilities directly tied to the Sin they embody.

The second category are the Daemons, entities that exist within the domains of mind and soul. These beings cannot naturally manifest in reality, existing solely within the Soul Space or Mind Space of the beings they inhabit. Daemons serve as torturers, manipulators, corrupters, and deal-makers whose true power lies in spiritual intrusion. Above all else, Daemons desire to exist within your own soul and mind, viewing such existence as the highest possible form of fulfillment. Only while dwelling within you do they experience genuine peace or happiness. This has caused in them a unique Obsession with you, even more protective then any other NPC, this causes them great torment as they are unable to help in any way due to their fully Spiritual and Psychic nature.

Because they reside directly within your soul, Daemons are exempt from the loss of memories caused by Resetting with Return By Death. They retain awareness across deaths, making them uniquely dangerous and Unstable, they are able to use your Memories of Dying to torture those they bring in, as they are also able to amplify the pain and emotions and cast it onto them. They generally look like how they wish to look. Daemons possess the ability to drag the souls of their victims into your Soul Space, their own internal realms, or the mental landscapes of others they inhabit. Within these spaces they subject victims to endless psychological torment, existential horror, manipulation, or revelation until the target’s mind completely fractures. Once their “correction” is complete, Daemons often return their victims to the moment of their birth. This process almost invariably leaves the victim catastrophically unstable, and deeply insane.

The final category are the Shadow Demons, Your assassins, hunters, and executioners. These beings almost never exist openly in the physical world, instead dwelling within shadows. They move through darkness, slipping between shadows as though traversing an unseen dimension hidden beneath reality itself. Merely being near a Shadow Demon instills overwhelming supernatural terror capable of paralyzing even powerful opponents with primal fear. Their claws and teeth carry an innate Instant Death effect, allowing even minor wounds to become lethally fatal if the victim lacks sufficient resistance or immunity. Shadow Demons are feared not for grand displays of destruction, but for their silence, inevitability, and ability to appear from darkness without warning.

If you possess the addon “Army of Angels,” you additionally gain the ability to create Angels of Virtue, celestial counterparts to the Demons of Sin. These beings embody virtues rather than corruption and are generally far more support-oriented in both ability and temperament.

If you possess the addon “Automatons of the Guild Master,” you may also create Daemon Constructs: specialized artificial vessels capable of permanently housing Daemons within physical reality. These constructs allow Daemons to interact with the outside world indefinitely without needing to remain confined to a soul or mind space, effectively granting them stable physical existence while preserving all of their spiritual and psychological abilities.
addons.title: Army of Demons

addons.text:
Od Laguna itself has become a part of your Watchtower, having developed a profound infatuation with you. This development comes with a number of obvious benefits.

First and foremost, Od Laguna can now actively defend you, and the Watchtower itself, wielding the power of an entire planetary generator of magic encompassing every flavor, attribute, and type. Second, you may now request (Read: Beg) that Od Laguna bestow Divine Protections upon your allies. Conversely, it can also grant a new category of "blessing" to your enemies: gifts that appear benevolent in name but instead burden, hinder, or otherwise negatively affect their recipients.

If you possess the Holy Spirits addon, you may now create spirits of any type, expanding your ability to shape and command spiritual beings.

If you possess the Mabeast Designer add-on, you gain the ability to create Mabeast-Spirit hybrids. The exact nature of these hybrids is largely up to your interpretation, provided it remains within reasonable limits.

If you possess the Guild of the Stars add-on, Od Laguna gains 250 levels distributed among classes of its choosing. In addition, it receives a unique title and class, World Protector. Despite its newfound power and status, it remains willingly and loyally bound to you.

Finally, if you possess any of the following add-ons, Army of Angels, Automatons of the Guild Master, or Army of Demons, Od Laguna may designate one member of each species you create as a chosen progenitor. These individuals receive a special class and blessing specifically tailored to enhance their natural abilities and class progression. They effectively become the royalty and founding ancestor of their species, capable of creating additional members of their kind just beneath your own ability to create them.
addons.title: Od Laguna of The Watchtower

addons.text:
You have gained a Pit within the Guild of the Stars. This Pit serves as the ultimate defense against invaders and the ultimate reward for your most beloved NPCs.

To your enemies, the Pit is an object of absolute terror. Should they fall into its depths, they will be forever corrupted, transformed into utterly loyal servants. Their former selves are erased, their identities subsumed, and for the remainder of their souls' existence they exist only to serve you.

To your beloved NPCs, however, the Pit is a blessing beyond compare. Formed from your own power, it resonates with those you cherish. Any individual you willingly allow to enter gains a personal Unique Skill crafted specifically for them. In addition, their affection, loyalty, and devotion toward you are greatly amplified.

The Pit also serves as the resting place for the Witch Factors you create. Once placed within its depths, these Factors become connected to the Watchtower itself, further integrating their power into your domain. While you may not enter the Pit to acquire additional Authorities or powers from these Factors yourself, you may grant your NPCs and allies the opportunity to inherit a Power of Sin, should they prove capable of bearing it.
addons.title: THE PIT

addons.text: Due to your presence, and Authority over The Watchtower, it seems Satella has been granted a slightly looser prison. She is permitted to move freely throughout the entirety of the Tower and within the boundaries of the Sand Time barrier, provided both she and Envy remain well-behaved. Even then, she remains incapable of significantly harming the Tower’s residents except in cases of self-defense, if they Violate the Rules, or in defense of you.
addons.title: Satella "Freed"

objects.text:
You have been made the Administrator of the Tower of the Great Sage. This position grants numerous benefits, foremost among them command over the Tower’s natural defenses, the surrounding dunes, the Seal containing Satella, and the various residents of the Tower itself. Alongside this authority, you gain an instinctive understanding of the Tower: its construction, mechanisms, functions, and the methods required to recreate its contents. You also possess the knowledge necessary to manufacture any unique materials used within the Tower or found upon Od Laguna itself.

In addition, you gain a Basic Gate comparable to that of an average adult, a very minor Spirit Affinity, and average affinities across all elemental attributes. While unremarkable at first, these talents provide the potential to one day become the second Great Sage through sufficient dedication and effort.

The Tower also contains the personal library of the Great Sage himself. Within it resides knowledge of all skills, magic, and information within the world of Re:Zero. Hidden among its countless volumes are methods capable of enhancing every attribute this Origin grants, though such methods are often immensely time-consuming, dangerous, and expensive to pursue.

Among the Tower’s greatest protections is the Sand Time, a spatial-temporal barrier so absolute that even the Sword Saint Reinhard himself could not force his way through it, and its furthar enhanced such that the strongest of the world you are on are also incapable of forcing their way through. The only openings occur during brutal storms that create brief passages to the Tower. Countless varieties of Mabeasts roam within and around this barrier, serving as an additional layer of defense. These storms adapt themselves to both the world and biome in which the Tower resides, amplifying the natural dangers of the surrounding environment.
Those who survive Sand Time must then cross the Flower Fields. Unlike the original fields surrounding the Watchtower, these are composed of genuine flowers of your choosing, provided their effects are harmful in nature. Examples include flowers that release pollen capable of reducing victims into mindless, zombie-like husks who are greatly enhanced, and immensly hostile to any being that is not you, or who you choose to spare. The region is populated by vast numbers of Mabeasts of every variety beneath the level of the Three Great Mabeasts and Shaula herself.

Within portions of the Watchtower leaks an overwhelming density of Miasma, potent enough to drive immensely willful individuals insane within hours of exposure.

The final line of the Tower’s natural defenses consists of Shaula, Reid Astrea, Rui Arneb, and Volcanica himself. Though Volcanica exists only as a diminished husk of his former self, unless you possess the Addon “Alter Reborn,” all four are bound to you with absolute and unbreakable loyalty. You may decide the precise nature of their attitudes toward you.

Any who enter the Tower are automatically bound by an unbreakable contract governed by the following rules:

It is forbidden to leave the Tower without completing the Trials.
It is forbidden to violate the rules of the Trials.
It is forbidden to disrespect the Library.
It is forbidden to damage the Tower.
It is forbidden to destroy the Trials.

The Tower itself contains countless mechanisms, traps, and hidden defenses, all of which are keyed to your signature and to any individuals you personally designate, ensuring they never activate against you. Through unknown and unbreakable means, the Tower’s interior is spatially expanded to contain the equivalent space of an entire mountain.

You may freely customize these mechanisms and traps. Perhaps the stairways loop endlessly through distorted space and time while subtly shoving intruders off balance. Perhaps trespassers are compelled to read a random Book of the Dead before proceeding. The Tower’s architecture bends naturally toward the surreal, the oppressive, and the impossible.

You also gain possession of the Library of Taygeta, repository of the Books of the Dead. These books function as forced experiential records, allowing readers to relive the lives and memories of the deceased firsthand. The Library contains the complete histories of all the dead and forgotten of Od Laguna, as well as any new dead or forgotten souls from whatever world the Tower inhabits. Furthermore, the Library contains a separate dimension that may function as a pseudo-afterlife should you desire it.
objects.title: The Pleiades Watchtower (Re:Zero)

objects.text:
Through means that are best left unexplained, you have become the owner of an otherwise ordinary municipal park.

At least, that's what it appears to be.

The park contains vast stretches of forest, rolling fields, winding trails, and scenic lakes, alongside a wide variety of recreational and support facilities. Sports fields, playgrounds, picnic areas, maintenance buildings, storage yards, employee housing, and countless hidden locations left to explore.

The park comes staffed by its long-time management team, which includes people you should know like Benson, Pops, Skips, Mordecai, Rigby, Muscle Man, and Hi Five Ghost. They retain their personalities, memories, skills, and relationships while recognizing you as the rightful owner of the park.

Unlike ordinary employees, this crew has accumulated an absurd amount of experience dealing with impossible situations. Possessing knowledge of magic, martial arts, connection to various strange individuals, cosmic power, and dozens of other fields that should not reasonably appear on a maintenance resume.

The staff do not age while employed by the Park and will eventually return after death, disappearance, possession, being erased from time, or similarly inconvenient circumstances. But it may take time depending on the severity of the incident.

As its owner, you possess a unique connection to the park itself. You always know the general condition of every structure, facility, and employee. Damaged areas slowly repair themselves over time so long as the park remains operational.

Though be warned, this park has an alarming tendency to attract eldritch horrors, anomalous artifacts, wizards, time travelers, magical contests, and problems that somehow begin with two employees slacking off work.

On the bright side, this kind of thing usually works out by the end of the day.
objects.title: The Park (Regular Show)

objects.text:
You find yourself the proud owner of an ultra luxurious resort about one square kilometer in size.

It contains every possible amenity one could need. Within its grounds lies a complete ecosystem of leisure and comfort: unlimited electricity and seamless Wi-Fi, a small zoological park, multiple world-class restaurants, a casino, arcade, daycare facilities, an amusement park, grand ballrooms, spas, expansive swimming pools, and even a fully equipped cineplex.

The resort is staffed by robots indistinguishable from humans to the naked eye. The staff are hyperspecialized in their fields, but their capabilities do not exceed human-level capability. Food supplies are automatically replenished daily, ensuring consistent access to fresh, high-quality meals.

What really makes this place special is an Immortality Field around the resort. All damage taken within is regenerated, and all deaths are resurrected. The device maintaining the field is placed in the very center of the resort making a translucent blue spherical field around the entire area. It would be best to ensure that this device is well protected.

You also get the blueprints of the Immortality Field allowing for maintenance, repair, or reconstruction if necessary.
objects.title: Immortality Field Resort (Rick and Morty)

objects.text:
The legendary floating castle from a certain infamous game is now yours in all its grandeur—only this time, it's no longer a digital illusion but a tangible, mystical fortress towering in reality.

Aincrad consists of 100 separate dimensions stacked like ascending planes, each brimming with extraordinary resources, hidden treasures, and an array of unique skills to be discovered and mastered. However, its towns, and cities stand eerily uninhabited by players or NPCs, offering a blank slate of possibility.

However, Aincrad is far from empty. Monsters still roam the castle freely, now unshackled by prior pathing restrictions, allowing them to move, hunt, and defend as they please. They are utterly loyal to you, their Master, while remaining ferociously hostile to all others. Even the 99 mighty Bosses guarding the floors answer your command, their destructive potential capable of spilling out of the castle to wreak havoc upon the world whenever and should you so desire.

Ascending Aincrad is no simple feat for potential invaders. The castle is protected by an unyielding storm of mystical laws, making it impossible to bypass floors or ascend directly to higher levels. Any attempt to fly past the first-floor results in crashing into an impenetrable invisible barrier. The only way forward is the hard way—clearing dungeons, defeating Bosses, and claiming victory one floor at a time.

But Aincrad is more than a fortress—it is a living, adaptable structure. It can move between worlds, hovering above landscapes as the penultimate harbinger of change. With your permission, it can begin to bridge realms, bringing its floors and unmatched defenses outwards wherever you deem necessary. However, this process would take immense time.
objects.title: Floating Castle Aincrad (SAO)
The Lampeter: SCP-7005 (SCP Foundation)
objects.text:
You have bought up and recommissioned a significant amount of assets of the Lampeter Non-Euclidian Shipping Company, which managed the Lampeter network, a vast highway of trains, planes, ships, ski-lifts, yams and other forms of transportation between universes. This network carried unimaginable amounts of cargo, information, and passengers in one of the most widespread and convenient forms of interdimensional travel in the multiverse. The Network itself has fallen into heavy decline following the insolvency of the L-NESC, and is maintained by small local networks of stationmasters and volunteers, leaving many multiversal clusters and individual realities isolated from their neighbors. This Lampeter is from a multiversal mirror where the Neon God did not emerge, but the company still went bankrupt anyway.

Your portion of the Lampeter covers only a few million worlds that are mostly just historical variations of your starting universe, with a handful of stranger ones. As you expand, you will find many more different and stranger realities. Your job is to rebuild and expand this trans-dimensional infrastructure, recommissioning abandoned L-NESC hubworlds, and reconnecting realities and meeting up with other sections of the network that are still running. You will find sections of the Lampeter also exist in other multiverses you find your way to that can be connected to your own network.

You need to discover rifts, holes and weakspots in the dimensions of the multiverse, and build the most suitable transport methods to exploit and connect each one. You can use other vehicles and interdimensional powers and technologies you possess or discover to expand and upgrade your network. Maintaining the Lampeter Network requires the GDP of many realities, but the profits and benefits are immense. Despite the impossibly mind-boggling scale of the L-NESC’s operations across countless realities, you will find that the effort to manage and run the company is not much harder than running a large single-dimension transport company.

Murals painted on vehicles, stations and depots, legends written in manifests and manuals, and oral traditions of porters and stationmasters, tell the history and secrets of the Lampeter family who built and managed the network for generations. This can guide you to abandoned hubworlds and archives of the old company, as well as make headway into new innovations in interdimensional travel. In time, you can use this information to not only reconnect the entire multiversal network, and eventually expand the Lampeter beyond what the old family and company could even dream of.

"Your people will rebuild the ancient ruins and will raise up the age-old foundations; you will be called Repairer of Broken Walls, Restorer of Streets with Dwellings."
-Isaiah 58:12

The city of Tokyo, destroyed in the Great Cataclysm, has risen from the ashes like a phoenix!

From the center of the Basilica, where the Order Of Messiah & their mortal enemies, the Ring Of Gaea, survived YHWH's flood, the rebuilding began. Led by a hero from the old world, they were able to put aside their differences & live in peace, for a time.

You receive your Tokyo Millennium in a strange, amalgamated version of that time. The Center's Bishops have yet to seize power, & are only in as much control as you wish them to be. Under your rule, Gaeans, Demons, & Mutants can roam the streets freely, if you desire.

On the other hand, the districts, many of whom only appeared under the rule of the Bishops, are fully available to you.

There is the Underground, the ruins of Old Tokyo, where those whom the Messian's Millennium Kingdom had no place for dwelled. Perhaps you will restore it to its former glory?

There is Valhalla, where freedom & Chaos reigns, naturally making it the most populous area of the city. In it, bloodsports, gambling, music, lechery, substances, occultism, commerce, & every other aspect of the human condition The Center found obnoxious or inconvenient can be found.

There is Holytown, a wealthier neighborhood intended for the city's naturally pious (of course, it's a ghost town). Use it as you please.

There is Arcadia, a highly advanced research district which is a font of bleeding-edge technology, but is presently focused on using full-dive VR systems to 'wargame' creating a Utopia. Maybe you have a use for this research, or maybe you want them to change tracks?

There is The Factory, where Demonoids (artificial half-demons created for specific purposes, like Demi-Nandi's for meat, "Spartans" for combat or policing, "Oracles" for anything requiring intelligence or psychic powers, or "Slaves", "Frankens", & "Heracles" for labor) provide for the needs of the city, both agricultural & industrial.

Finally, there is The Center, the aptly named central control node of the city, where the leaders direct the population, and where the Artificial Messiah & Megiddo Ark Starship projects proceed apace.

Finally, the citizenry is yours to command; from Temple Knights, to Gaean Cultists, to Robots & Demonoids, to the Demons & Mutants hiding underground, to even the native kami of this land, to the named figures in charge of the districts (like Madam & Gimmel), everyone reveres you as the return of the hero, a voice of moderation & stability in a time of madness.
objects.title: Tokyo Millennium (Shin Megami Tensei)

addons.text: Know my name, for it is legion. The Song Of Eternity once more reverberates throughout the Golden Castle. And so, the distinction between the quality of souls vanishes, allowing you to harness their power without limitation. For within the infinite Immortal Army, a Beggar becomes equal to a King. Any and all souls you gather become those of extremely high quality. Those slain by you are eternally bound to your castle, granting you all their memories, knowledge, and abilities. You can summon these Einherjar of Valhalla to fight by your side, and they are unkillable; even if their bodies are destroyed, their souls shattered, they will arise once more within Gladsheimr, ready to serve once again. All Einherjar retain all the strength, knowledge, and equipment they possessed in life and can even grow stronger over time, but their loyalty to you is unbreakable.
addons.title: The Open Gates of Valhalla

objects.text: No mortal man under the sun, no powers that be, no chains that bind shall constrain him, For he dwells in the nether, a soul from the grave is He. The Eternal Golden Castle. When it was created it retroactively gave mankind the dream of a place called hell, becoming the very basis of the idea of Afterlives. It manifests as a devilish castle, a sprawling fortress of despair and darkness, as the embodiment of eternal suffering. The castle uses souls as fuel for all its operations. These souls may be used to build offensive weapons like cannons which fire blasts hotter than nuclear warheads, as defensive structures that can expand space infinitely, and support structures like computational nodes that can map out infinite futures. The acquisition of new souls won't be a problem as you may summon the castle wherever you please, the mere act of its summoning tearing out and feeding to you the souls of any man for several hundred kilometers around the castle. The castle gives shape to pain itself, housing as many hells as there are Souls. Each soul within it chooses their personalized hell, be it a sea of fire, a hellish tundra, or something even more twisted, all of which are made manifest by the castle's dark power. You are always aware of and can control every inch of the castle if you desire. As it is a singularity that shatters the law of God, the castle can teleport to any location throughout All Of Creation, even through time, allowing the user to use it as transit to any place he wishes or to simply detach himself and the castle to be outside of reality. However, this would require it to be operating at peak efficiency, which is reached at 3 million souls at which point its capabilities become virtually limitless. Fortunately, the castle is a perpetual motion machine, souls that are expanded will simply regenerate over time, for no one shall ever leave the Golden Castle. The Eternal Castle stands as the absolute finality, fueled by the very essence of those it consumes, holding control over the fates of all who dare to exist within its shadow.
objects.title: Golden Universe Gladsheimr (Shinza Bansho)

addons.text:
Turns out the island floats due to Chaos Energy, the stuff that oozes from those seven rocks you got there. The island now has a hidden shrine you can store them in for safe keeping, with only you knowing its location. Some security measures were taken by someone who was definitely here before, but they're either old or less than ideal. 

Within that shrine also houses a giant green gemstone called The Master Emerald, the real reason behind why the island floats. Holding more power than all of the Chaos Emeralds combined, to the point of granting you a Super Form by itself, and being a power source of infinite energy. It can also neutralize the power of the Chaos Emeralds, forcing them to cut ties with who or whatever is using them, then scatter or return them back to the island. 

Alternatively, the Chaos Emeralds can combine to form The Master Emerald, but small enough to fit in the palm of your hand. Finally, a red orb of light appears from the green gemstone, materializing as a mobian echidna named Tikal, who holds ancient knowledge about the history of this island.
addons.title: The Master Emerald

objects.text:
You now have your own private island that can float in the sky. How, you ask? No idea it just can! Something about leftover Chaos or whatever. The island itself is absolutely massive, enough to hold an entire civilization and then some, with a surplus of natural resources to match. Alongside many different biomes ranging from forests, underwater cities, a carnival, desert, sanctuary in the sky, and more. 

You're allowed to change these biomes, or remodel it entirely. 

The island can float in the sky indefinitely, descend to the sea at your discretion, and even move through both at your will.
objects.title: Angel Island (Sonic the Hedgehog)

addons.text:
Due to the extremely malleable nature of Chao, they are prime candidates to become familiars, or as we like to call them, “Buddies”. Every single chao within your garden has the potential to become a Buddy of one of three rarities — Normal, Rare and Super Rare — and will provide a variety of boons and effects to you by merely existing. They can also act on their own accord and at your command, whether to find an object, attack a foe, cast a spell for you, etc.

All Buddies, regardless of initial rarity, have the potential to improve and evolve over time. Also, you aren’t limited to just chao as Buddies. As you may occasionally, or even frequently find items, creatures, and chibi versions of Sonic characters suddenly appearing in your garden. They won’t be the actual characters, but will act as you’d expect them to.
addons.title: Buddies

addons.text:
Through exposure to Chaos Energy, your Chao have evolved into more humanoid creatures composed of pure energy, resembling the Ancients and Chaos 0. 

Each of these evolved Chao keep characteristics and abilities they had before, but enhanced tenfold, with a natural instinct towards guardianship of both you and the Chaos Emeralds. Their bodies are also composed of a single element that they can manipulate and shapeshift with, just as easily as Chaos himself.

By absorbing a Chaos Emerald, they will transform into a much more advanced state, scaling with the amount consumed until they become akin to Perfect Chaos.
addons.title: Chaos Garden

addons.text: You can now treat taking care of your Chao as you would a pet simulator, with a treasure trove of new features added to your Gamer System to boot. To start, you can view all details about each Chao and additional information easily, displayed in anyway suited to you. This is so advanced that you can fine-tune and monitor the growth of each Chao down to the most miniscule of details to ensure your exact end results. They also gain a lesser variant of the System and can grow their abilities to match 25% of your total power. If they are an evolved or more special variant of Chao, this ceiling increases to 50%. Finally, the System develops an autopilot function to take care of your Chao Garden on its own. Note: If you possess the Buddies Addon, you can have a Gacha System to roll for various Buddies.
addons.title: Pet Simulator

objects.text:
You have a soulbound key that opens a pocket dimension to your very own Chao Garden, modeled exactly after its depiction in Sonic Adventure 2, or your own design. 

This dimension is the habitat of small, fairy-like creatures called Chao, that come in all kinds of varieties. From the average blue chao, angelic Hero Chao, the mischievous Dark Chao, to some having traits akin to animal or frankenstein mutation.

What they share in common is their expressive and various personalities, ability to adapt the characteristics of other lifeforms, and evolve into more advanced forms through nuture or a reincarnation cycle.

The garden has infinite supplies and resources needed to take care of them, with a comprehensive guide for such installed directly into your brain. You can also summon and dismiss Chao to and from this dimension with a thought. 

Your Chao Garden begins with up to 5 freshly hatched Chao.
objects.title: Chao Garden (Sonic the Hedgehog)

objects.text:
Positioned in geostationary orbit over any chosen planet, the Beltino Orbital Gate is the pinnacle of warp gate research and technology in the Lylat System. Designed to study and generate wormholes, this advanced station can create warp gates linking its generator to any known location in the universe. As a result, it enables the near-instantaneous teleportation of capital-class starships across vast distances, provided the exit location is known.

The system’s bidirectional wormholes allow not only outbound travel but also inbound journeys—ships and personnel can simply wait for a gate to open at their location and move through. This innovation, along with similar installations, transformed Corneria into a thriving intergalactic trade hub, facilitating commerce and military deployments across known space.

Despite its immense utility, the Orbital Gate has two key limitations. First, it must calculate the precise exit point before generating a warp gate, though even intergalactic jumps typically take only minutes to compute. Second, the system cannot visually confirm the destination before opening a gate, meaning there is always a risk of emerging into an ambush or hazardous environment with no way to detect threats beforehand.
objects.title: Orbital Gate (Star Fox)

addons.text:
Your Imperial Star Destroyer has undergone significant retrofitting, incorporating advanced upgrades similar to the notorious Arc Hammer Imperial Dreadnought. This transformation has enhanced your Star Destroyer into a formidable mobile factory ship, specifically designed for the mass production of droids on the battlefield. 

Within your vessel, state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities exist, and the efficient assembly of various droid models are already underway, turning your star destroyer into a mobile factory for droids. Among your schematics for droids is the Dark Trooper Project, the initiative spearheaded by General Rom Mohc to create a superior class of stormtrooper with cybernetics that evolved into battle droids and later power armour for human soldiers.

Your Star Destroyer is now equipped with a substantial crew complement that includes approximately 100,000 B1 battle droids, providing a means with which to command the ship. In addition to this, you command a vast army of specialist droids: 400 Droidekas; 6,900 B2 battle droids; and 400 BX-series droids, implemented with advanced tactical data that makes them more strategic than the B1 droids. Additionally, you possess 10 Phase II Dark Troopers at your disposal. You also have under your command a super tactical droid that can coordinate the various droids you have under your command.

Your Star Destroyer is equipped with a central computer that the Droids can connect to, further enhancing the computational power they possess, making them a more effective force overall.
addons.title: Arc Hammer

addons.text:
Your factory has undergone an upgrade; the programming used by the droids was enhanced with techniques from the cyberpunk universe. All droids created in the factory have had significant increases to combat and other vital systems; no longer will they have to worry about a droid experiencing information overload by collecting too much data, as the droids created in the factory have had their processors enhanced, having more room for data.

Your factory can also produce cybernetic upgrades for both you and the droids it creates. Have you ever wondered what would happen if you gave a Sandevistan to a B1 battle droid or equipped a B2 unit with the equivalent of gorilla arms? Now, with the enhancements to your droid factory, you no longer need to wonder what would happen; you can augment your droid soldiers for enhanced combat. The future is now.
addons.title: Corpo Prototype Designs

addons.text:
Your droid factory has received an upgrade; not only has the rate of production increased, but it has also implemented changes allowing it to take advantage of the new technology in the creation of droids using methods gained from The Villain's Reversal in the creation of new droids.  No longer will the droids produced in this factory have to worry about experiencing information overload by collecting too much data, as the droids created in the factory have had their processors enhanced, providing more room for data. 

It's not just the design of the droids that will receive a boost; the programming has also undergone significant improvements to enhance combat and other vital systems. Even a B1 unit will act as if it has received a retrofit similar to that of a BX unit, and a single BX unit will have its programming enhanced to outperform a squad BX unit easily. The more battle droids are in an area, the smarter they become, thanks to the speciality of mind-machine interface and digitalisation, allowing for a network of droid minds to form with every battle droid in a squad, enhancing the overall intelligence of the network.
addons.title: Efficient Design

objects.text:
A droid factory created by the Geonosians for the Confederacy of Independent Systems used to produce and supply thousands of droids for the Clone Wars. The factory is completely automated and hazardous to anyone attempting to enter it. 

The droid factory is a gigantic production facility, allowing it to produce every droid that the Confederacy of Independent Systems would ever need during its war with the Republic including, but not limited to, the simple B1 Battle Droids, BX-series droids, IG-100 MagnaGuards, B2-RP battle droids, OOM-series battle droids, Droidekas, and many other droids that the Confederacy of Independent Systems was capable of fielding, even prototype designs and ground vehicles.

The droid factory can produce anywhere from 10,000 droids in a day to 3,000, depending on how many materials you have at hand to put into production. The facility has enough resources to produce droids for a week before requiring a resupply. The droid factory also has several security measures, including a squad of 100 already produced B1 Battle Droids that patrol the facility, as well as several high-tech security measures.
objects.title: Droid Factory (Star Wars)

objects.text:
Fear will keep the local systems in line, fear of this battlestation. The Death Star was a monumental effort to produce by the Galactic Empire over the course of 20 years to create this 160 Kilometer wide battle moon, and now it is yours to command. The Death Star has a power output greater than that of a star, and is heavily armed and armored with state-of-the-art shielding units, and tens of thousands of turbolasers, Ion Cannons, Concussion Missile Launchers, Laser Cannons and Tractor Beams - and is equipped with an equally vast complement of smallcraft from thousands of Starfighters, Shuttles, landing craft and armored warfare vehicles like the AT-TE. A crew count of over a million operators, as well as hundreds of thousands of Stormtroopers & Imperial Army Personnel. 

But most importantly to its design is its primary weapon system: The Mk I Concave Dish Composite Beam Superlaser, which possesses enough fire power to completely annihilate a planet in a single devastating blast, leaving nothing but intergalactic dust and debris in its wake. However after firing the main weapon with a primary reactor ignition, it requires a 24 hour period to recharge for another planet-killing attack. However the Superlaser may also be fired at lower, single-reaction ignitions to engage smaller targets - such as capital ships, or smashing planets with a short, but devastating attack that could leave them somewhat in one piece - but expect living conditions across the planet surface to be… radically different from what they once were. Would also be ideal for planet-cracking for resource mining a planet’s deep core. 

Unlike the Death Star whose service life was cut short at the Battle of Yavin, your Death Star lacks the same Exhaust Port weakness the proved to be the demise of its Imperial counterpart. This station is now the ultimate power in the universe, I suggest you use it.
objects.title: DS-1 Orbital Battle Station "Death Star" (Star Wars)

objects.text:
You are now the headmaster of the Sith Academy; the Sith Academy can appear in any location you desire. The Sith Academy is an ancient facility steeped in Sith lore, housing knowledge of Sith Lords from the past. The Sith Academy is considered the best place to instruct Sith in the ways of the Dark Side.

Inside the academy, you will find a cadre of non-human educators—droids programmed to impart knowledge of Sith teachings and techniques. These droids, each equipped with unique programming, have been designed to ensure that students grasp the complex lessons of the dark arts of the Sith, cultivating the next generation of Sith. 

The Sith Inquisitorious Sanctum houses the knowledge gathered by the Sith Lords, a library that various members of the Imperial Inquisition and Sith Inquisitors have preserved throughout the millennia. Housed inside the Sanctum is knowledge of various Sith techniques. It also houses technology from the Era of the Sith Empire. Inside, you could learn how to build technology to bring about another Sith Empire.

Situated just outside the Sith Academy is the Valley of the Dark Lords: a resting place for every Sith killed throughout the centuries. Buried deep beneath the surface, the Valley of the Dark Lords houses not just holocrons from ancient Sith but also the spirits of those long departed who would teach you the methods of the Dark Side if you can impress them. Even Sith from the future can be located within the Valley of the Dark Lords through the nature of the Force.

This also grants you a connection to the Force, and the ability to “enroll” in the Sith Academy as an initiate, regardless of your age or connections.
objects.title: Sith Academy (Star Wars)

addons.text: Grand Master is a title used to describe the recognized head of the Jedi Order, you have mastered the Jedi’s teachings, being well versed and experienced with all aspects of the Light Side of the Force, and now hold this prestigious title. The appointment of the Jedi Grand Master is a requires a unanimous vote of all of the High Council members to install a Jedi in the position, where they serve until death, or choosing to relinquish the post. Bestowed only upon the greatest, and wisest of the Jedi Masters, the Grand Master represents the Order’s interests to outside parties when required, renders final judgements in situations where the High Council is evenly divided on an issue, and serves to lead the Jedi overall. Now your loyal Jedi eagerly await your leadership, ready to follow you into battle if need be.
addons.title: Grand Master of the Order

objects.text: The Jedi Temple on Coruscant has stood as the Headquarters of the Jedi Order for millennia. Rising atop the sacred spire—a mountain peak imbued with a powerful light side convergence—the temple replaced the ancient Shrine in the Depths, where the Sith once attempted to twist the convergence towards the Dark Side of the Force. Architecturally, the temple is a colossal ziggurat crowned by five towering spires that pierce the sky. Its base comprises grand pillared halls and serene meditation chambers, including the renowned Room of a Thousand Fountains and a vast rotunda chapel. Ascending higher, the structure houses sophisticated medical centers staffed by Jedi Healers, containment cells for hostile Force-Users, and a network of workshops and maintenance bays dedicated to the temple’s upkeep. At the summit of the ziggurat lies the Jedi Archives—one of the galaxy’s most extensive repositories of knowledge—and the Holocron Vault, where countless holocrons—containing the deepest secrets of the Force—are carefully stored. Throughout the temple, the Jedi Academy flourished. Dormitories and classrooms provided housing and education for future Jedi, complemented by holographic training suites and lightsaber construction workshops, to equip future Jedi with all they need. The five spires of atop the temple each serve their own purpose, the north-western tower is overseen by the Council of First Knowledge, which runs the Jedi Academy, and guards the proliferation of Jedi Knowledge. The South-western tower holds the High Council which lead the Order, serving as the administrative center of the Jedi Order. The North-eastern tower is home the Council of Reassignment, which houses the Jedi Service Corps—The Agriculture Corps, the Medical Corps, the Educational Corps, and the Exploration Corps. The South-eastern tower holds the offices of the Council of Reconciliation, the diplomatic heart of the Jedi Order, and home to the legendary Jedi Seers. The Central Spire, known as the Temple Spire, contains the expansive Hall of Knighthood, where aspiring Padawans are elevated to Jedi Knights. Its very peak guards the most sacred and ancient records of the Jedi, some dating back to the Order’s founding thousands of years ago. This monumental, ancient edifice, along with all its contents and the entire Jedi Order it sheltered, initially exists within a “small” pocket dimension accessible only to you. You possess the power to “install” this magnificent temple anywhere in any world or other pocket dimension you have access to—reality will bend seamlessly to accommodate its presence—and you can choose to return it to “storage” at any time you wish. This also grants you a connection to the Force, and the ability to “enroll” in the Jedi Academy as an initiate, regardless of your age or connections. Perhaps the Order now allows older applicants? Or maybe you gained a special exemption, and one-on-one training?
objects.title: The Jedi Temple of Coruscant (Star Wars)

addons.text:
Now your L-Cluster is home to a developed and thriving civilization that has colonized and populated all habitable planets.

The population of these worlds ranges from tens of millions to billions of people. They all receive the same benefits as in OoP “Empowered Village.” The base level of development is up to you and can be chosen from the late 19th and early 21st centuries, although nothing prevents you from choosing an earlier period, such as the Middle Ages or the ancient world.

If you have any powers from Technology and Artifice Powers, your civilization will receive the same technologies, which can significantly affect both the level of civilization itself and the degree of space exploration of the L-Cluster.
addons.title: Empowered Civilization

addons.text:
Upon arriving at the L-Cluster (Stellaris), you will discover a single megastructure, a colossal mega-structure representing the pinnacle of engineering in the Stellaris universe.

You can choose any megastructure available in the Stellaris game and place it in a convenient location in the L-Cluster.

You can place 3 Habitats anywhere in the L-Cluster.
addons.title: Megastructures

addons.text:
Your Spiegel will become an integral part of your L-Cluster and will grow to the size of a crystalline planetoid hidden deep within the star cluster.

Its influence will spread throughout the entire L-Cluster, and it will be able to copy any enemy, even the most mystical and esoteric ones, as well as enemy fleets. In any case, this only guarantees that the enemy will first have to fight itself and its own forces, and then fight copies of your forces and your own forces. And at the same time, try to win before the copies are restored.

As for possible weaknesses, the copies are no longer able to leave the L-Cluster, just like Spiegel itself.
addons.title: Mirror Guard.
The Cluster Network
addons.text:
The isolation of the L-Cluster is absolute, its borders barred to every known form of faster-than-light travel. Yet within that sealed expanse, a lattice of Ancient technology awakens—true Stargates, identical in design and function to those built by the Ancients themselves. Each ring hums with the familiar rhythm of chevrons locking and addresses dialing, capable of forming a stable wormhole to any other gate in its family, whether standing on a planetary surface or drifting in the void as a space-gate.

Across the L-Cluster, hundreds of these gates anchor themselves to orbital platforms, moons, planets, outposts, and waystations. Their power cores burn silently with energies capable of lasting for millions of years, just as their predecessors once did across the galaxies of the Ancients. Inside the cluster, the network creates a map of instant pathways; distance loses meaning as worlds separated by light-years become a heartbeat apart. A simple dialing sequence on any gate opens a shimmering blue event horizon on another, just as reliably and effortlessly as in the legends of the Milky Way and Pegasus.

At the outer edges of the cluster, the L-Gates integrate a companion structure—an outward-facing Stargate whose address does not appear anywhere in the galaxy’s public networks. Each one is positioned exactly as the Ancients would have placed it, capable of forming wormholes with any standard gate beyond the cluster. When one of these outer gates dials inward, its signal reaches the paired gate inside the cluster—but a connection only forms if you allow it. The wormhole cannot stabilize without your authorization; the moment you deny it, the sequence collapses harmlessly before the gate can open.

When you choose to permit a link, an ordinary Stargate in the connected galaxy generates the event horizon and sends its travelers forward. They emerge within the L-Cluster through the network’s internal gates, stepping seamlessly from the wider galaxy into the sealed sanctuary. From there, they can travel the cluster freely using its internal network: surface gates, orbital gates, deep-space gates, all functioning exactly as the Ancients intended.

This structure creates a quiet balance. The outer galaxy never gains uncontrolled access to the L-Cluster, but the cluster is never cut off unless you wish it. You can enable exchange, trade, diplomacy, migration, or exploration, all through familiar Stargate architecture that never compromises the cluster’s security. If danger rises—if empires fall, invasions spread, or cataclysms threaten—the gates can be silenced instantly. Wormholes collapse, addresses become unreachable, and the cluster returns to perfect isolation.

The Cluster Network gives your hidden star-realm a way to breathe without ever exposing its heart. A sealed galaxy becomes a crossroads, but only when you choose it to be.

Note: You have gained the ability to seed additional L-Gates. If you have some way to seed stargates like the Ancient Drydock, then any stargate seeded ends up connected to the Cluster Network, this method can also be used to seed L-Gates.  You can connect to any galaxies seeded with L-gates or Stargates.

objects.text:
You now have a unique natural phenomenon—a compact extragalactic star cluster with a diameter of 10 light-years, isolated from the rest of the galaxy by an anomaly that completely blocks any FTL interstellar travel.

The cluster is connected to the “galaxy” via L-Gates, through which even large ships and fleets can pass. However, these gates are completely under your control: you can open or close them, and once closed, it will take 180 days to reopen them. There is always one gate in the cluster, but 10 more can be placed throughout the galaxy, and they will only be connected to your “home” L-Gates.

The number of available systems is 300-500 star systems. You can determine the structure of individual star systems yourself (or use the Planets and Star System Generator). 

A cluster can have 30-50 star systems with habitable planets and other astronomical objects, such as asteroid belts and planets. These systems will be rich in rare, unique, or exotic resources (if you have access to any exotic resources, you will be able to find them in the form of large deposits). There should be at least 3 large astronomical objects in these systems.

If you don't have a spaceship, you will receive a primitive vessel capable of interstellar travel. Inside the cluster, interstellar travel is accelerated, allowing you to quickly reach other systems even in such a ship.

This provides you with a safe haven protected from most galactic cataclysms and disasters, which your enemies can only reach by means of sublight interstellar travel, which can take tens or hundreds of thousands of years.
objects.title: L-Cluster (Stellaris)

objects.text: Congratulations! You're the next in line to inherit the throne after King Bowser, making you the new Koopa King. Well partially, since you mainly get the castle, but your subjects don't need to know that. Its interior and exterior design can be modeled after any appearance within the Super Mario series or your own vision. Alongside a legion of loyal minions at your beck and call, fully trained for war and many other professions. From goombas all the way to the koopalings, and all their variations. You have free reign to assign these yourself beforehand. You inherit many of Bowser’s assets and treasures, from the clown car as personal transport, airships to conquer kingdoms from the sky, the Star Rod from Paper Mario 64, Bowser Jr's paintbrush, the pixies from 3D World, and much, much more. Additional functionalities can be added if you have other Mario Powers from this CYOA.
objects.title: Bowser's Castle (Super Mario)

objects.text:
The Comet Observatory is a hub to take you and others to any place in the Universe. While initially it will know of only a few locations of interest in your local galaxy, as time passes it will on its own search and catalogue new destinations, reaching other galaxies and eventually the whole Universe. To do so the Comet Observatory uses its Beacon on its core to power itself and its search function. While the Beacon will generate energy forever and can store an infinite amount of it, it has a limit of how much it can generate at once. With some elbow grease and patience, you can learn how to fuel it with different sources.

Transport is done via a Launch Star, which will propel you in seconds to your destination, no matter the distance. When done so, another Launch Star will be created at the destination to let you come back. If you have the coordinates of where you want to go, you can input them on the Observatory. You start with six Launch Stars on the Observatory which you can set up the destination.

With time and energy, the Comet Observatory will grow and expand. The Beacon will generate more power, it will create more Launch Stars, grow in space to customize, and eventually it will be able to function as a space ship, able to reach any known destination in a matter of hours, no matter how far away.
objects.title: Comet Observatory (Super Mario)

objects.text:
Congratulations! You're the next in line to inherit the throne after Princess Peach, making you the new ruler of the Mushroom Kingdom. Well partially, since you mainly get the castle, but your subjects don't need to know that. 

Its interior and exterior design can be modeled after any appearance within the Super Mario series or your own vision. Alongside a legion of loyal Toads at your beck and call, fully trained in many professions such as guards, cook, maid, advisor, generals, etc. You have free reign to assign these yourself beforehand. 

There's several secrets hidden within the castle, housing various treasures from the Mario Universe. By default, you have a storage room full of Power-Ups that magically restock when empty, Power Stars that supply the castle with infinite energy and resources, and Paintings that act as teleporters to various locations or worlds you've visited.
