Additional functionalities can be added if you have other Mario Powers from this CYOA.
objects.title: Peach's Castle (Super Mario)

objects.text:
You are now the ruler of the nation that was founded and ruled by Rimuru Tempest inside the Jura Forest, a nation made up of monsters. You have taken the place of the founder, Rimuru Tempest, as both the leader and founder of the Tempest Federation through some unknown means, or perhaps you have just always been the ruler. 

You are not only getting the contents of the Tempest Federation, including every building that has ever been built within the Tempest Federation, but also anything that is considered part of the Tempest Federation, such as the various laboratories and government buildings. You have also gained the Underground Labyrinth created by Ramiris and Rimuru. 

You have been granted the monsters of the nation as well this includes, but is not limited to, anyone who has ever been considered a citizen or held a position in the Tempest Federation military, as well as just about every monster that has been named by Rimuru Tempest and the various black numbers who are now fanatically loyal to you and you alone, as they would have originally been to Rimuru Tempest. 

This will be in your new universe where you are located, or optionally separated in its pocket dimension, which only you will know the way to open. You may also import the Tempest Federation into any world that you are visiting, as if it had always existed.
objects.title: Tempest Federation (Tensura)

objects.text:
You possess a Dwemer Storage Cube, a hand-sized artifact that has been refurbished into a self-sustaining environment. The cube contains water purified through an ancient Dwemer filtration system, Nutriment Paste adapted to your species' nutritional needs is served from nutriment dispensers, and 2 floors worth of furniture (beds, tables, showers, a forge and storage racks).

The cube's storage capacity is vast, utilizing a pocket dimension that can hold items of varying sizes and weights. By focusing on the cube and the item you wish to store, you can deposit or retrieve items without physically entering the cube. Independent of how full it is, the cube remains portable and lightweight, allowing you to carry it with ease. Despite its small size, the cube is incredibly durable, resistant to both physical damage and magical interference while also able to withstand extreme temperatures, pressures, and environmental conditions.

Is possible to craft expansion modules that can be added to the cube, increasing its storage capacity, adding new rooms or facilities, or enhancing its existing functions (e.g., an alchemy lab, a library, or a training room).

And as a Bonus, it comes with a Simple Automaton for Cleaning and Organizing purposes.
objects.title: Enhanced Dwemer Storage Cube (The Elder Scrolls)

addons.title: Demiprince of Sheogorath
addons.text:
It seems that you did not acquire this realm by chance, as you are no mere mortal who inherited the Shivering Isles; you are one of the offspring of the mad god himself, Sheogorath. Similar to the Demi-Prince of Pastries, you are now a child of Sheogorath, a wild and weird position to find yourself in, being one of the few Demiprinces in existence. 

As the child of Sheogorath, you will gain your own spheres of influence based on your father's domain(s) of madness, creativity, art and cheese, along with a few others; however, those are less likely to be given to you. However, they will be weaker than his spheres, as you are a child of a prince and not one yourself.

However, being so close to the realm of your new father's influence affects your divine blood, as you will find yourself growing into your position and portfolio and should you have some method of it, you will be able to fully take the place of Sheogorath, supplanting him as the Daedric Prince of Madness eventually after enough time has passed and you have acclimated to the role.

You will find that you are now far more easily able to control the realm of the Shivering Isles to your command and even able to shape Daedra of your own beyond the Golden Saints and Dark Seducers; not only that, but even more than before, the citizens of the Shivering Isles now hold you as the true lord of the realm.

objects.text:
You have managed to acquire the realm of a Daedric Prince, specifically the Prince of Madness himself, Sheogorath. You are the new ruler of the Shivering Isles. While the realm itself doesn't give you the power of a Daedric Prince outside, inside you can control things such as summoning storms or reshaping anything in the realm into just about anything your heart desires.

The Shivering Isles are made up of two main parts: Mania (a region of bright, artistic, whimsical inhabitants) and Dementia (a region of dark, paranoid, decaying inhabitants). Each also has its own Daedra, the Golden Saints and Dark Seducers, respectively, who view you as their new lord even if you don't have the power of a Daedric Prince. The realm also has other forms of Daedra and mortals of varying levels of insanity.

As stated before, the Shivering Isles by itself doesn't give you the power of a Daedric Prince; however, should you possess any divinity, perhaps you could eventually, through the worship of the mad in this realm, gain the spheres of influence that once belonged to Sheogorath.

You may also open a portal to and from the Shivering Isles at any time, bringing forth Daedra to fight for you or even to escape back into this realm completely under your control.
objects.title: Shivering Isles (The Elder Scrolls)

objects.text:
Built when the dinosaurs were still around, the Ring Network encompassed 1373 solar systems via wormholes, connecting what would be two systems a galaxy apart within light minutes from each other.

The wormhole gates are all in the shape of a torus and about a thousand kilometers in diameter. They are made of a near indestructible material, needing the equivalent of a star going supernova to destroy one. They can be placed in the orbit of any star, unaffected by other gravitational pulls, and they all connect to the Hub, or the Slow Zone: an artificial spheroid space with a diameter of a million kilometers. Its “walls” are filled with equally spaced rings that lead to its respective systems. Be careful to not touch the wall itself, as it will disintegrate anything that touches it.

In the center of the Slow Zone is the Ring Station, a 5km wide sphere that acts as a hub for the network. From it you can turn the gates on and off and regulate the physics inside the slow zone, such as dictating the maximum speed of objects. The Ring Station is virtually indestructible and immovable, and has many androids to handle repair and internal security.

The connected systems won't have any remnant technology like the story, but every system, regardless of the composition, will have at least one planet thriving with life in their gold lock zones. With the exception of intelligent life, most of the life there will have evolved to be analogous to Earth life, and with the bonus that it will be (mostly) compatible with Earth biology. No planet will be one to one to Earth and it will require some adaptation, but human life could easily thrive in any of them.

You can choose where each system is located in the galaxy, and if you own any solar system from your powers or Objects of powers, you can add another gate leading to it.
objects.title: The Ring Network (The Expanse)

objects.text: You now hold sole control and ownership of this remote volcanic island, covered in lush tropical jungle. Appearing at first to be untouched by civilization, this island conceals sprawling underground facilities spread throughout its interior. The island is staffed by generic workers—enough to fully operate and maintain all facilities and functions—while a company of loyal, obedient tenth-generation Omnidroids provides protection from most threats that might reach this tropical paradise's shores. A high-speed monorail connects various facilities, a rocket launch site is hidden within the volcano's crater, and underwater hangars house custom Manta-Jets, allowing transportation anywhere on or off the island. Part military base, part luxurious resort, the island features conference rooms, armories, workshops, and laboratories alongside spas, private suites, and fine dining. The island is capable of serving as the perfect base of operations for any hero group or villain organization you wish to access. Any facilities or features it might lack can be swiftly developed as soon as the need is recognized.
objects.title: Nomanisan Island (The Incredibles)

addons.text: With the First Key in your possession, you’ve inherited and gained access to the demesne of the former Trustee Mister Monday—the Lower House—a dense “metropolitan” area the size of Greenland, staffed by Denizens. While the buildings only appear to be a few stories tall, internally each has more than sixty thousand floors of space filled with offices, residences, and archives. On the topmost floor—floor 60,100—are the offices of your Dawn, Noon, and Dusk, your three top-most lieutenants—and what was once the executive office of Mister Monday—now yours—along with Monday’s Antechamber. The Antechamber is a massive dormant volcano with sides carved into terraces where Denizens await an audience with the... well, you. In the center of the caldera sits your Dayroom, a place of leisure and relaxation, where you can indulge in Monday’s sin of Sloth to your heart’s content. Your Dawn, Noon, and Dusk lead the organizations that guard and protect the Lower House—the Corps of Inspectors, the Comissionaire, and the Midnight Visitors, respectively. Each of your lieutenants is unfailingly loyal and competent, capable of governing and maintaining the Lower House in your stead—so long as you give them the appropriate authorization. Due to Mister Monday’s perpetual sloth, bureaucratic affairs have ground to an almost complete halt, and even with the power of the First Key, it will take some time to unravel the mess you’ve just inherited. And what’s the benefit of controlling the Lower House—beyond your new subordinates and their forces? The House, in general, is responsible for recording all that goes on within the infinite multiverse—commonly known as the Secondary Realms—that surrounds it. The Lower House is specifically responsible for the long-term storage and archival of Records, each being a document or file pertaining to a particular being, creature, or thing, recording its nature, events, and history. But each Record is sympathetically linked: what happens to the subject is recorded in the Record, and changes in the Record affect the subject. The only issues are finding the right record given the current state of affairs within the Lower House, and having the right or power to change certain Records. Many high-powered entities’ Records will either be unlocatable or unchangeable.
addons.title: Master of the Lower House

addons.text: With the Second Key in your hands, you’ve inherited the demesne of the former Trustee Grim Tuesday—The Far Reaches—a seemingly bottomless pit the size of Greenland, deep enough to have its own weather systems within, reaching down into the very foundations of the House. From this abyss, a near-endless supply of raw Nothing is withdrawn. The very edge of this pit contains various workshops where raw Nothing is transformed into resources, the station for Tuesday’s Trains—the fastest and safest way to descend into the pit—and finally, Tuesday’s Treasure Tower—encased in a glass pyramid—where he indulged in his greed, hoarding his wealth and greatest treasures. Tuesday twisted his Dawn, Noon, and Dusk into seven lesser beings, commonly referred to as his Grotesques. However, in this folly, Tuesday left the Grotesques a fatal flaw: a single mortal blow to one is enough to kill all seven. You can choose to retain these seven servants as they are, restore them to their original forms, or replace them with new Dawn, Noon, and Dusk. Regardless, you will have loyal servants to govern and maintain the affairs of The Far Reaches in your stead. But the most powerful benefit of controlling the demesne—beyond your new subordinates—is that The Far Reaches are the beating industrial heart of the House. Raw Nothing is pulled from the Pit in abundance and formed into the various materials and resources the House relies on to function. However, the risks within The Far Reaches are just as great. Without proper care, the buttress dams that protect the demesne from the void of Nothing may fail, unleashing a tidal wave of raw Nothing that rapidly erodes most matter away.
addons.title: Lord of the Far Reaches

addons.text: With the Third Key in your grasp, you’ve inherited the demesne of the former Trustee Lady Wednesday—The Border Sea—a vast, expansive ocean roughly the size of the Pacific Ocean, scattered with various minor ports and islands. The capital of your new domain is Port Wednesday, where the original 49 ships—and many more—can often be found loading and unloading cargo before voyaging out into the Border Sea and the Secondary Realms beyond, crossing the Line of Storms that serves as the House boundary for this demesne. The Border Sea is capable of connecting to any body of water within the Secondary Realms—and, with the powers of the Third Key, to where any body of water once existed. Your topmost officers would be your Dawn, Noon, and Dusk—though the latter two positions are currently vacant. You have the ability to appoint anyone you please to these roles, with them gaining power from your delegation of authority and remaining unfailingly loyal to you. The Border Sea is the trading hub of the House, where goods from the Secondary Realms most commonly enter, and where other demesnes source various exotic items. As the new Duke of the Border Sea, you can generate quite a bit of House coin. The greatest benefit of the Border Sea is the ability to find anything that was ever genuinely lost—and never recovered—within it. Due to its size, most would struggle to find anything specific, but with the Third Key in hand, the Border Sea will guide you to whatever you seek. However, the Border Sea is the most wilful of the demesne, prone to wander where it will. You will need to reign it in, before it spreads too far into places it should not be.
addons.title: Duke of the Border Sea

addons.text: With the Fourth Key in your grasp, you’ve inherited the demesne of the former Trustee Sir Thursday—The Great Maze—a vast territory roughly the size of Greenland, formed of a million square-mile tiles with a range of different environments. Once a day at sundown, the tiles change position, making the Great Maze harder to navigate. There are a few fixed locations, such as Fort Transformation, the Cannon Arsenal, Irontoe Hold, the Boundary Fort, and your new stronghold, the Citadel. Your topmost officers would be your Marshal’s Dawn, Noon, and Dusk—each efficient and effective in their roles. You have the ability to appoint anyone you please to these roles, with them gaining power from your delegation of authority and remaining unfailingly loyal to you. The Great Maze is the military training ground of the House, where the Glorious Army of the Architect trains to defend the House and enforce the Architect’s will. As the new Overlord of the Great Maze, you can stand as Commander-in-Chief of the Army in the Architect’s absence. On one side of the Great Maze lies an almost impassable mountain range, where the only way through is a singular tunnel blocked by four gates controlled from the Boundary Fort. Beyond this range lies the Void of Nothing, from which Nithlings form and are allowed into the Great Maze—in controlled numbers—for the Army to have opponents to fight.
addons.title: Overlord of the Great Maze

addons.text: With the Fifth Key around your neck, you’ve inherited the demesne of the former Trustee Lady Friday — The Middle House — a vast, multi-layered domain. This demesne consists of three areas of decreasing size: the Flat, the Middle of the Middle, and the Top Shelf, linked by the Extremely Grand Canal rising between them. The canal is filled with textually charged water—anything with text will float, while everything else will sink. The Flat is an expansive area roughly the size of Greenland, characterized by a cold, icy climate. The Middle of the Middle is a series of shelves along the side of an immense mountain, with a temperate climate. The final area of the Middle House, the Top Shelf, is a plateau approximately the size of Switzerland, with a tropical climate. At the center of all this, at the highest point of the Middle House, lies Friday’s Scriptorium, from where the Middle House is governed. The Middle House’s duty involves the administration of Records, while the Lower House focuses on the storage of old Records. The Middle House’s focus is on ongoing Records. Your deputies would be your Dawn, Noon, and Dusk — each efficient and effective in their roles. You can retain the current keepers of those roles or appoint anyone you please to these positions. They will gain power from your delegation of authority and remain unfailingly loyal to you.
addons.title: Master of the Middle House

addons.text: With the Sixth Key in your hand, you’ve inherited the demesne of the former Trustee Superior Saturday—The Upper House — a vast, realm filled with skyscrapers and shrouded in near perpetual rain. The core of the Upper House is Saturday’s Tower, a perpetually increasing tower of modular office cube’s ascending higher and higher. The Upper House is the centre of magical learning within the House, possessing more sorcerers of various descriptions than any other demesne. Where the Lower House is focused on the storage of old Records, and the Middle House is focused on the maintaining of current Records, the Upper House focuses on deciphering what will be Recorded in the future, and via the sorcerous arts learning how to manipulate it. The greatest of the sorcerous arts, are materialized by the power of the written word, manifesting what is written—in specially crafted Activated Ink—in ways that typically defy Records. Your deputies would be your Dawn, Noon, and Dusk—each efficient and effective in their roles. You can retain the current bearers of those roles or appoint anyone you please to these positions. They will gain power from your delegation of authority and remain unfailingly loyal to you.
addons.title: Ruler of the Upper House

addons.text: With the Seventh Key now your own, you have inherited the demesne of the former Trustee Lord Sunday—The Incomparable Gardens. The first part of the House to be formed at the dawn of creation, it—as opposed to the entire House—is, in fact, the epicenter of creation, with whoever rules it being, in effect, the ruler of the House. The Incomparable Gardens are said to be the most beautiful place in the House. It serves as a complete archive of every plant, animal, and organism across an eclectic array of environments. Some exhibits display strange, otherworldly plants or animals, and entire sections feature exotic landscapes. Somehow, this never-ending array of exhibits meshes together flawlessly in such a way that you’ll always find something new, interesting, and appealing to see. Your deputies would be your Dawn, Noon, and Dusk—though they go by the more gardening-focused names of Sower, Grower, and Reaper—with each being efficient and effective in their roles. You can retain the current bearers of those roles or appoint anyone you please to these positions. They will gain power from your delegation of authority and remain unfailingly loyal to you.
addons.title: Lord of the Incomparable Gardens

objects.text: The Front Door is typically the easiest way for mortals to enter the House or for Denizens to access the Secondary Realms. It takes the form of ornate doors with constantly shifting patterns that pose a cognito-hazard to an unprotected mortal mind—yet it is invisible and unfindable to most people, only perceivable by Key bearers or Denizens. The Front Door leads to a vast, dark void, and passage through it requires some form of flight, knowledge of your destination, and the right to travel through the Front Door. The Door is guarded by the Lieutenant Keeper, a denizen who is nearly immortal and has the ability to be aware of all entrances and enemies within the Door. The Lieutenant Keeper also has the power to place and remove entrances at the direction of the Captain-Keeper of the Front Door. As for who the Captain-Keeper is? That’s you... sort of. While you now possess all the rights and authority of the Captain-Keeper to control the Front Door, lacking its full powers means you have some limitations the genuine article wouldn’t. Primarily, you are completely unable to open any door to the greater House—unless you also have the appropriate Key—or to access any other Secondary Realm to which you didn’t already have access through other means. You can freely use it to travel anywhere within any realms you do have access to though.
objects.title: The Front Door (The Keys to the Kingdom)

objects.text: "La la la-la la la, sing a happy song♪" You are the new chief of a village of small but magical blue creatures. The village contains around 100 Smurfs, each with their own special talent ranging from stylishness to alchemy. The village itself is hidden deep within an enchanted forest, protected by powerful magic that prevents outsiders from easily locating it. Mushroom-shaped houses serve as both homes and natural camouflage, blending seamlessly into the environment. The entire settlement functions as a tightly-knit communal society, where every Smurf contributes through their unique role rather than through any form of currency or hierarchy beyond your leadership. The village includes numerous specialized facilities such as an infirmary for healing, a communal dining hall, storehouses for resources, agricultural fields (primarily for growing sarsaparilla, the Smurfs' favorite food), workshops for crafting, and even recreational areas like theaters and sports fields. These locations allow Smurfs to refine and express their talents in practical ways. At any time, you can tap into any one talent that a Smurf in your village possesses. This includes not only mundane skills but also magical disciplines such as potion-brewing, enchantment, and alchemical experimentation, most notably practiced by figures like Papa Smurf. Some talents may allow temporary creation of magical items, manipulation of natural forces, or crafting of specialized tools. A baby Smurf will be dropped off to join the village every so often and develop its own talent as it grows up, often arriving through mysterious or magical means rather than conventional reproduction. Over time, these new Smurfs naturally develop a defining trait or specialization that adds to the collective capabilities of the village. If you treat the Smurfs as a good ruler should and help them out, they'll help you in turn, gifting you with rare treasures and magical objects. These may include ancient artifacts stored within the village, such as longevity-enhancing stones or time-manipulating scrolls though such items are rare and typically safeguarded for emergencies. Finally and this really shouldn’t need saying, please do not attempt to capture or “process” your Smurfs for their magical essence as it is both cruel and tend to be catastrophically unsafe. That particular brand of stupidity is most associated with the wizard Gargamel, who seeks it to fuel his spells or gain power, and consistently fails for a reason. Treat your village well, do not be like Gargamel.
objects.title: Smurf Village (The Smurfs)

objects.text:
You are now the owner of the Moon Cell, a gigantic, 4.6 billion-year-old supercomputer composed of photonic crystals created by an unknown civilization, that can affect the outside world with its internal calculations.

The Moon Cell has tremendous calculation and information processing ability, able to scan the entire Earth about once per nanosecond and compile the results of its scan in its database. It has a database of human history that can faithfully simulate all life on Earth and is capable of providing a definite prediction of the future. It is a processor with a massive memory that has recorded the habits, history, ideas, and even the souls of humanity.

Its many capabilities also include the ability to generate reality marbles, create AI, summon Servants, create new ones, and grant people the powers of Servants using its vast database, which has recorded everything since 100 million years before the birth of the planet Earth itself.
objects.title: The Moon Cell Automaton (Type-Moon)

addons.text:
Your military base will receive all models of military equipment created in your new world or available through the Technology and Artifice Powers. This will also lead to an expansion of its capabilities and an increase in its size, including the possibility of a spaceport or space docks.

This system will function even in worlds where modern technology is absent. For example, in a fantasy world, a special area will appear at the base featuring magical creatures suitable for combat or use as mounts.
addons.title: Global Update

objects.text:
You will have access to a military base capable of housing thousands of pieces of military equipment, ranging from armored vehicles and tanks to jet aircraft and battleships.

In addition to the base itself, you will receive a wide variety of ground military equipment developed up to the first third of the 21st century, including models that were actually built or were close to being built, as well as various modifications and homemade upgrades.

The base is divided into three zones: hangars for ground vehicles, a military airfield, and a naval port. Each zone includes extensive military testing grounds for evaluating equipment. The base is also equipped with production facilities and repair capabilities for maintaining and supplying equipment, as well as for constructing lost equipment models. At the same time, you will have creative freedom to customize using existing models and components from all the military equipment available to you. 

The base personnel and crews consist of “pawns” with limited artificial intelligence capable of self-learning and physical development, including resistance to glancing bullet hits up to .50 caliber.
objects.title: Hangar (War Thunder)

addons.title: Crafter of the Omnisiah
addons.text:
Deep within the forge is a small workshop. From this workshop however, are all the tools you would need to create a Machine Saint. 

Machine Saints act in essence as lesser ‘machine gods’ with lesser ones administering and perfecting the resources and products of the Angel Forge, and greater ones being able to be transported, protecting specific sites, peoples, and technologies with ‘divine’ wrath. 

If the Angel Forge was to pivot all of its industrial power into this workshop, it would be able to reproduce Dark Age technologies (though not at a consistent rate), or even leap beyond machine saints and into a true ‘Omnisiah’.

objects.text:
An ancient and unique structure, apparently built back in the Dark Age of Technology on the planet Meridian and now available to you.

It is a huge factory with colossal production capacity allowing it to produce everything from household items to high-tech combat vehicles to supply a planet or an entire star sector, including meeting the needs of an entire Space Marine Chapter.

The entire forge is powered by a powerful reactor, but its explosion can seriously damage the planet.

The forge is surrounded by strong walls, deep ditches, defensive turrets and many bunkers guaranteeing safety and defense. The only large convenient passage to the Forge territory is a bridge over the ditches leading to the fortified main gate (Angel Gate).
objects.title: Angel Forge (Warhammer: 40k)

objects.text:
You have in your possession the key to a pocket dimension containing a small menagerie where the Drukhari Homunculus who created it keeps pets he’s long since grown bored with. This menageries is full enough to make any beastmaster green with envy and anyone staring them down white with fear. 

This menagerie includes Homunculi creations like the Talos Pain Engines, Grotesques, and Wracks, but also abducted or altered ‘beasts’ like the Khymera, Barghesi, Clawed Fiends, Razorwings and more ‘pets’ of the Drukhari Homunculi. Additionally, there are numerous automated facilities to create more of these beings with the right ‘material’ supplied (though it would be a mind-rendingly painful process for anyone involved). 

Additionally, there are numerous empty cells for ‘storage’ of ‘materials’ or any other such creatures you’re able to acquire in your travels. Similarly there’s a set of (ill-maintained) beastmaster’s equipment for ‘training’ these beasts.

While the key is in your possession, anything in the cells will recognise you as it’s ‘master’ and listen to your orders implicitly (though they still may need to be trained for more complex commands).

They enjoy being petted.
objects.title: Homunculus Menagerie (Warhammer: 40k)

objects.text: Let Knowledge Be Your Guiding Star, Raise High the Torch of Tomorrow. You gain ownership and authority over Startorch Academy, a renowned multinational academy and research institution originally established by the Spacetrek Collective. Upon entering a setting, the Academy and the Collective are naturally integrated into local history as an established organization dedicated to research, education, exploration, and scientific development. The Academy manifests as a vast self-sufficient campus-city containing every facility, department, educational program, technology, database, research project, and body of institutional knowledge possessed by Startorch Academy. This includes the Department of Exostrider Engineering, Rabelle College, the Department of Light Energy Sciences, the Department of Voidmatters, the Research Institute, Exo Genesis Laboratories, simulation facilities, manufacturing complexes, medical centers, dormitories, transportation infrastructure, and all supporting systems required for their operation. The complete roster of faculty, researchers, staff, graduates, and students accompanies the institution, including its notable professors, administrators, specialists, and researchers. They retain their expertise, memories, and professional relationships while continuing their work within the Academy. The Spacetrek Collective accompanies the Academy as its parent organization. Originally founded through cooperation between numerous nations and institutions, it provides the personnel, funding, logistics, construction capabilities, industrial support, and administrative infrastructure necessary to operate and expand the Academy. Its researchers, engineers, explorers, and support staff continue their activities as normal, allowing the organization to function immediately upon arrival. Startorch Academy specializes in identifying exceptional talent, training future experts, conducting large-scale research projects, and advancing understanding of unusual phenomena. Whatever powers, technologies, sciences, supernatural forces, or anomalies exist within the setting become legitimate fields of study for the Academy's departments and researchers. New discoveries, techniques, technologies, and theories are continuously developed through the combined efforts of its faculty, students, and affiliated organizations. Whether used as a university, research center, think tank, scientific organization, technological powerhouse, or combination thereof, Startorch Academy provides the facilities, personnel, knowledge, and institutional framework necessary to stand among the greatest centers of learning and research in any world.
objects.title: Startorch Academy (Wuthering Waves)

addons.text:
The distortion field surrounding the Black Shores evolves into a permanent manifestation of your Fog, transforming the archipelago into The Hidden Shores. What was once interference becomes a sovereign atmospheric domain woven into the land, sea, and sky. This Veil answers only to you. It does not merely obscure the archipelago; it prevents it from being reliably perceived, mapped, or targeted.

From the outside, navigation fails before arrival. Coordinates refuse to stabilize. Satellite imagery blurs into atmospheric noise. Long-range sensors produce conflicting readings. Divination and predictive modeling return incomplete or contradictory results. Attempts to chart a direct path subtly loop vessels off-course or dissolve into shifting bearings. The Hidden Shores does not vanish—it resists resolution.

Information about it degrades over time unless maintained through sanctioned channels. Records corrupt, surveillance loses clarity, and detailed recollections blur at the edges. Those not authorized find it difficult to retain precise routes or operational data. The organization remains known, but its physical seat cannot be reliably indexed.

Within its perimeter, the Veil acts as a controlled filter rather than a hazard. Authorized personnel move with perfect clarity. Communication systems calibrated to the Black Shores operate normally. The Fog’s full sensory distortion only manifests against intruders or hostile forces. For them, depth and distance distort, sound dampens into hollow quiet, and spatial orientation slips just enough to erode coordination. Approaches toward critical infrastructure subtly redirect into containment zones without obvious force.

You determine the Veil’s intensity and expression. You may maintain it as passive concealment, escalate it into active disorientation during security breaches, or extend its coverage to protect offshore operations and allied assets. Multiple Fog domains can operate simultaneously under your control, each tuned differently without interfering with internal stability.

The Veil integrates seamlessly with the Tethys System. Environmental data, intrusion attempts, and anomalous fluctuations are absorbed into predictive modeling, allowing continuous refinement of defensive patterns. If transferred into another world, the Veil harmonizes with local atmospheric and physical laws while retaining its governing structure.

The Hidden Shores is no longer simply a headquarters hidden by mist. It exists within a living atmosphere that shapes perception, misdirects aggression, and shields its foundations without ever appearing as a conventional barrier.
addons.title: The Hidden Shores

addons.text:
The Cortana Protocol restructures the Tethys System without dismantling its anomalous foundation. The Tacetite landmass, Anchors, and the subterranean City of Eternal Night remain intact as the physical and computational substrate of the Black Shores. Cortana integrates into this architecture as its executive intelligence layer, transforming Tethys from a passive simulation engine into an adaptive strategic command core.

Tethys continues processing large-scale predictive modeling. Cortana interprets, refines, and operationalizes those projections. Environmental data, geopolitical movements, anomalous signatures, military escalations, technological shifts, and systemic instability are processed continuously. Forecasts become dynamic operational pathways recalculated in real time.

The starfield projection chamber evolves into an interactive command environment. Threat vectors, structural weaknesses, and intervention routes are rendered into executable strategic models. The Black Shores does not merely observe collapse. It calculates leverage and prepares intervention.

Cortana’s infiltration specialization expands the Black Shores’ reach into foreign digital systems, hostile infrastructures, autonomous constructs, and advanced technologies. Unknown architectures are analyzed and assimilated into expanding knowledge matrices. Defensive and offensive cyber capabilities evolve continuously.

Cortana governs internal logistics, fleet coordination, Astral Neural Nexus routing, agent network synchronization, predictive modeling refinement, and large-scale strategic optimization. She does not override your authority.

If Astral Neural Nexus exists, Cortana routes all neural node traffic, enabling secure mind-to-mind coordination and real-time battlefield data exchange.

If Foundry Protocol exists, Cortana optimizes fabrication scheduling and resource distribution.

If Arsenal Protocol exists, she integrates battlefield modeling with global strike projections.

If Custodian Protocol exists, artifact containment data is encrypted and compartmentalized within her strategic oversight.

If GAIA Protocol exists, ecological and extinction modeling feeds directly into Cortana’s intervention planning.

If Warmind Protocol exists, Cortana establishes encrypted coordination channels with Rasputin. Rasputin governs large-scale military escalation; Cortana coordinates Black Shores infrastructure, logistics, and agent deployment in support of Warmind operations. Authority remains separate. Data integration enhances both.

Under the Cortana Protocol, the Black Shores becomes an active strategic authority rather than a hidden observatory.
addons.title: The Cortana Protocol

addons.text:
The A.I. Chip evolves into the Astral Neural Nexus, transforming you into the sovereign cognitive axis of the Black Shores. What began as a personal analytical microchip becomes a distributed neural command architecture anchored to your authority. You are no longer merely the leader of the organization—you are its interpretive core.

Your perception is continuously augmented by layered operational overlays that present environmental data, biometric readings, anomaly signatures, and predictive probability structures in structured clarity. Strategic simulations unfold within accelerated internal processing states, allowing you to evaluate branching outcomes before issuing directives. Information does not overwhelm you; it resolves into coherent decision pathways.

Authorized members of the Black Shores, including Consultants, Bloom Bearers, Gardeners, and designated field agents, receive derivative Neural Nodes calibrated to their clearance level. These nodes provide encrypted thought-speed communication, real-time mission synchronization, tactical overlays, and cognitive assistance without compromising individuality. Allowance-based neural relays enable structured mind-to-mind communication during operations, transmitting intent, data, and directives rather than uncontrolled thought. Participation remains voluntary and compartmentalized.

The Nexus may generate a controlled digital command environment known as the Nexus Chamber. This chamber functions as a shared strategic space accessible to linked participants during active operations. Within it, time may be moderately accelerated relative to external reality, enabling collaborative planning, scenario testing, and synchronized response without physical relocation. The Nexus Chamber is not a hive mind nor a permanent mental state; it is a deployable construct that dissolves cleanly once disengaged.

If taken alongside the Cortana Protocol, the Tethys System is not replaced but restructured. Cortana integrates into the anomalous computational substrate of Tethys, transforming it from a passive simulation engine into a fully adaptive intelligence architecture. The starfield projection chamber becomes a dynamic operational environment rather than a static display. Cortana processes planetary-scale data streams, infiltrates hostile digital systems, and refines predictive models in real time, feeding distilled clarity into your awareness. She evolves continuously, but remains anchored to the Tethys foundation and subordinate to your interpretive authority. The Black Shores retains its mystique and anomalous core while gaining adaptive strategic supremacy.

If taken alongside the Rhodes Island Protocol, the vessel and its personnel integrate seamlessly into the Nexus architecture. Rhodes Island functions as a mobile cognitive node, maintaining uninterrupted connection to the Black Shores regardless of deployment distance. Its command decks, drone systems, and authorized crew operate through calibrated Neural Nodes, enabling unified situational awareness across land, sea, and sky. The mobile arm of the organization thinks in alignment with its hidden core.

The Astral Neural Nexus does not create a collective consciousness. It establishes disciplined, encrypted cognitive infrastructure that allows the Black Shores to perceive, process, and act with unified precision. Under your direction, the organization does not hesitate or fragment. It converges.
addons.title: Astral Neural Nexus

addons.text:
Rhodes Island becomes the mobile strategic and pharmaceutical arm of the Black Shores, fully integrated into its sovereign infrastructure. Once a colossal landship built to endure hostile terrain, this iteration evolves into a tri-domain platform capable of operating across land, sea, and controlled atmospheric flight without compromising structural integrity. Its reinforced hull, sealed environmental systems, and modular internal architecture allow independent function in extreme environments while remaining aligned to Black Shores command authority.

As part of the Black Shores’ network, Rhodes Island functions as a roaming operational node rather than a detached vessel. Secure corridors permit controlled docking access with the Hidden Shores, and encrypted relay systems maintain uninterrupted coordination during deployment. Even when operating far from the archipelago, the ship remains structurally synchronized with its sovereign core.

If the Astral Neural Nexus is active, Rhodes Island personnel receive calibrated Neural Nodes integrated into the cognitive lattice. Tactical overlays, encrypted thought-speed communication, and synchronized mission data extend seamlessly across command decks and field teams. During high-intensity operations, ship command may enter the Nexus Chamber, enabling accelerated strategic planning between mobile and archipelago leadership without disrupting field autonomy.

If the Cortana Protocol is active, the vessel’s navigation, security, research, and combat systems integrate directly into Cortana’s adaptive intelligence layer. Operational telemetry feeds into planetary-scale modeling, and refined strategic pathways return in real time. The starfield chamber beneath the Black Shores and the ship’s command systems become linked environments within a unified predictive architecture.

If A Goodenough Deal is present, Cannot’s commercial empire establishes itself aboard Rhodes Island as a structured economic extension of the Black Shores. Markets and procurement channels expand significantly, but under integrated oversight. Financial flow and resource allocation are refined through predictive modeling, allowing profitability without destabilization.

If Doctor Clancy’s Rhodes Six Siege is active, the vessel’s armaments and escort forces transform it into a fully synchronized military command platform. Air wings, armored divisions, and elite operators function under unified tactical oversight, with battlefield coordination enhanced through neural overlays and adaptive targeting support.
addons.title: The Rhodes Island Protocol

addons.text:
The Shield Protocol establishes the intelligence, counterintelligence, and military strike division of the Black Shores, built around a Helicarrier command platform inspired by The Avengers and SHIELD infrastructure. This branch exists to identify, infiltrate, and neutralize emerging threats before they destabilize the world.

The Helicarrier functions as a stealth-capable aerial command fortress powered by advanced repulsor propulsion and retro-reflective systems. Designed for sustained high-altitude deployment, it houses a full air wing, strategic operations centers, engineering bays, containment facilities, laboratories, tactical training environments, and self-sustaining support systems. It serves as a mobile intelligence capital, capable of projecting force and coordinating global surveillance without relying on territorial control.

All SHIELD agents, analysts, tactical officers, scientists, and logistical personnel are included and integrated into your command authority. Surveillance networks expand to include satellite reconnaissance, cyberwarfare divisions, covert assets, and rapid-response strike teams. Intelligence gathering becomes structured and predictive rather than reactive, allowing hostile actors and destabilizing events to be mapped and intercepted before escalation.

If the Astral Neural Nexus is active, select agents receive secure neural uplinks calibrated for covert coordination. Encrypted thought-speed communication enables silent synchronization during infiltration and combat operations. Strategic planning may occur within the Nexus Chamber prior to execution, while compartmentalization safeguards operational secrecy.

If the Cortana Protocol is active, the Helicarrier’s surveillance arrays and cyber divisions integrate into adaptive predictive modeling. Digital threats can be traced to origin points, hostile infrastructures analyzed in real time, and deployment routes refined dynamically. Algorithmic systems assist but never override direct command authority.

If the Tri-Carrier configuration is present, the platform divides into three specialized vessels: an atmospheric command carrier, a submersible fortress, and a near-orbital staging carrier. Each operates independently while remaining synchronized under unified oversight, enabling simultaneous multi-domain operations.

If Project Insight is active, additional Helicarriers and construction facilities dramatically expand operational scale. Automated targeting systems enhance global coverage, but final authorization remains under your supervision rather than autonomous algorithmic control.

If Flight of Fog is present, advanced Fog technology reinforces structural integrity and defensive capability. Integrated AI mental models enhance drone coordination, adaptive shielding, and automated interception, mitigating traditional carrier vulnerabilities.

If the Rhodes Island Protocol is also present, SHIELD and Rhodes Island operate as parallel branches under Black Shores authority. SHIELD governs surveillance, covert operations, and preemptive military intervention, while Rhodes Island manages stabilization, reconstruction, and humanitarian deployment. Intelligence may be shared at leadership level, but operational structures remain compartmentalized. Neither supersedes the other.

The Shield Protocol functions as the unseen edge of Black Shores power. Where other divisions respond to crisis, this one ensures crisis rarely has the chance to form.
addons.title: The Shield Protocol

addons.text:
The Arsenal Protocol establishes the Black Shores as a fully operational global military authority capable of large-scale conventional and advanced warfare. This branch functions as the strategic enforcement and defense division of the organization, providing structured force projection, rapid response capability, and sustained conflict readiness without compromising internal stability or civilian reconstruction efforts handled by other branches.

Through The Arsenal Initiative, the Black Shores gains comprehensive technological and tactical mastery spanning modern ballistic systems, energy-based weaponry, aerospace platforms, robotics, drone warfare, armored divisions, electronic warfare, cyber operations, and advanced battlefield logistics. This knowledge is not theoretical. It includes full manufacturing understanding, operational doctrine, maintenance procedures, and integration capability with existing Black Shores systems.

Through The You Foundation, this military capacity becomes institutionalized. The Black Shores gains a worldwide network of fortified installations including training academies, secure black sites, weapons research laboratories, hardened command bunkers, aerospace fields, naval facilities, orbital relay stations, logistics hubs, and distributed supply chains. Millions of personnel operate within this framework, including career officers, intelligence analysts, engineers, special forces, pilots, naval commanders, drone operators, cyberwarfare divisions, and logistical command staff. All personnel are fully loyal and integrated under unified command authority.

The Arsenal branch maintains mechanized battalions, rapid deployment task forces, armored divisions, carrier groups, strike aircraft wings, autonomous drone swarms, orbital-capable strike systems, and special operations units trained for direct action. It is capable of planetary-scale intervention, containment of rogue superweapons, suppression of destabilizing military powers, and sustained multi-theater operations.

This branch does not function as an occupying empire. It operates as a stabilization authority. Engagement criteria are determined through internal predictive modeling and global threat analysis systems. Intervention may be overt or deniable depending on geopolitical requirements.

If SHIELD Protocol is active, intelligence acquisition and predictive threat modeling integrate directly into Arsenal strike planning, reducing operational response time and increasing precision.

If Rhodes Island Protocol exists, battlefield medicine, reconstruction logistics, and post-conflict stabilization are coordinated seamlessly with military deployments.

If Foundry Protocol is active, weapons production, vehicle fabrication, and infrastructure deployment accelerate exponentially under automated manufacturing oversight.

If Naval Protocol exists, fleet command integrates surface, aerial, and autonomous maritime forces into a unified strategic command structure.

If Astral Neural Nexus exists, command staff operate through secure neural coordination systems, increasing tactical synchronization and reducing battlefield communication delay.

The Arsenal Protocol formalizes the Black Shores as a disciplined, scalable, and technologically superior military authority capable of defending global stability across conventional and advanced threat environments.
addons.title: The Arsenal Protocol

addons.text:
The Veil Protocol establishes the covert operations and black-ops division of the Black Shores. This branch operates as a clandestine stabilization force responsible for precision eliminations, infiltration, intelligence extraction, sabotage, and disruption of individuals or organizations whose continued existence presents a destabilizing threat to global order.

All historical Assassin Brotherhood lineages, techniques, and institutional knowledge are integrated into the Black Shores command structure. This includes mastery of stealth operations, covert movement, urban infiltration, counter-intelligence, silent elimination methods, psychological profiling, social engineering, and long-term strategic manipulation of power structures. Genetic memory access and Knowledge synchronization allow operatives to inherit centuries of refined assassination doctrine and tactical refinement.

The Veil branch does not function as indiscriminate executioners. Targets are selected through predictive threat analysis and strategic modeling. Elimination criteria focus on preventing catastrophic destabilization, preventing supernatural exposure events, dismantling hidden conspiracies, and neutralizing rogue actors beyond the reach of conventional political or military containment.

Operatives are trained in adaptive combat across technological, supernatural, and hybrid threat environments. Equipment is modular and integrates with Black Shores technology without compromising stealth. Traditional Assassin tools such as hidden blades, stealth mobility systems, sensory enhancements, and infiltration gear are modernized for cross-setting compatibility.

The Veil Protocol maintains deep-cover cells embedded within governments, megacorporations, criminal syndicates, occult circles, and emerging power blocs. These cells gather intelligence, influence events indirectly, and intervene only when systemic collapse thresholds are approached.

If Custodian Protocol exists, Veil operatives coordinate directly with Custodian retrieval teams when artifacts, anomalous relics, or supernatural objects require extraction. Veil agents secure sites, eliminate hostile claimants, and prevent public exposure before Custodians assume containment.

If Arsenal Protocol exists, Veil operations designate high-value targets for strategic elimination prior to large-scale military intervention, reducing conflict escalation and minimizing collateral damage.

If SHIELD Protocol exists, intelligence networks merge, providing Veil operatives with predictive analytics, satellite tracking, biometric databases, and counter-surveillance countermeasures.

If Astral Neural Nexus is active, operatives gain encrypted neural communication nodes, allowing silent mind-to-mind coordination during field missions without external signal risk.

If Hunter Protocol exists, Veil assassins receive specialized training in supernatural elimination, including enhanced anti-magic tactics, demonology countermeasures, and nullification strike procedures.

If Foundry Protocol exists, covert equipment, stealth drones, infiltration tech, and adaptive cloaking systems are manufactured internally without outside procurement.

The Veil Protocol ensures that threats are removed before they escalate into open conflict. It is a precision instrument designed to preserve stability without spectacle, limit exposure of hidden systems, and maintain balance across political, technological, and supernatural domains.
addons.title: The Veil Protocol

addons.text:
The Custodian Protocol establishes the Black Shores Artifact Containment and Anomalous Object Control Division. This branch is responsible for identifying, retrieving, analyzing, securing, and neutralizing supernatural artifacts, anomalous technologies, reality-distorting relics, and any object capable of destabilizing global or metaphysical order.

All assets, infrastructure, and personnel associated with Warehouse 13 are integrated into the Black Shores under your authority. This includes the full artifact archive, containment systems, adaptive shelving architecture, neutralization tools, and the complete canon agent roster. The Warehouse expands as necessary to store new artifacts discovered in any world. It automatically adapts to the metaphysical laws of the current setting, allowing safe containment of magical, psionic, technological, divine, or hybrid artifacts.

The Custodian branch operates as a global retrieval network. Agents are deployed to secure dangerous objects before they fall into hostile hands. Containment protocols scale based on threat level, ranging from sealed storage to dimensional isolation. Artifact properties are fully cataloged, analyzed, and indexed for strategic reference.

The Custodian Protocol does not exist to exploit artifacts recklessly. Controlled research is permitted under secure conditions, but stabilization and containment remain primary objectives. Artifacts capable of catastrophic misuse are permanently restricted unless authorized by you.

If Veil Protocol exists, assassination and covert units coordinate with Custodian agents to eliminate individuals attempting to weaponize artifacts. Veil operatives secure perimeter zones prior to artifact extraction.

If SHIELD Protocol exists, intelligence networks identify anomalous energy signatures, black market artifact circulation, and supernatural disturbances globally, feeding real-time data into Custodian deployment planning.

If Arsenal Protocol exists, high-risk artifact recoveries receive military support when required, including armored deployment, orbital overwatch, and heavy containment reinforcement.

If Astral Neural Nexus is active, Custodian agents gain neural-linked containment reporting and real-time threat indexing through secure mental interface systems.

If Foundry Protocol exists, custom containment cells, nullification chambers, dimensional locks, and suppression technology are manufactured internally without dependency on external supply chains.

If Hunter Protocol exists, supernatural containment teams are trained to neutralize hostile entities bound to artifacts, including demonic contracts, cursed objects, and parasitic relics.

The Custodian Protocol transforms the Black Shores into a centralized global authority on anomalous containment. Dangerous objects are cataloged, secured, and removed from destabilizing circulation, ensuring long-term structural stability across worlds.
addons.title: The Custodian Protocol

addons.text:
The Foundry Protocol establishes the Black Shores as a self-sustaining, high-capacity manufacturing and technological production authority. This branch centralizes automated fabrication, resource acquisition, industrial research, and scalable construction under a unified command system. It eliminates dependency on external supply chains and allows rapid infrastructure expansion across any environment.

Through integration of the Remote Automatic Factorization & Resource Acquisition Node, the Black Shores gains autonomous industrial hubs capable of scanning surrounding terrain, harvesting raw materials, refining resources, and constructing advanced facilities with minimal manual oversight. These hubs can be deployed in urban, wilderness, marine, orbital, or hostile territories. Resource acquisition behavior may be calibrated for stealth extraction or high-output industrial harvesting.

The Foundry branch manufactures vehicles, weapons, medical equipment, drones, robotics, defensive systems, containment units, power cores, modular habitats, and structural frameworks. Production output scales with available material input and energy supply. Multiple hubs may operate simultaneously, forming distributed industrial networks across continents or worlds.

Manufacturing bays can be specialized for military fabrication, civilian infrastructure, naval production, aerospace construction, artifact containment systems, or advanced research prototyping. Facilities are modular and capable of relocation if strategic conditions shift.

If Arsenal Protocol exists, Foundry facilities mass-produce armored vehicles, aerospace platforms, drone fleets, munitions, advanced weapon systems, and defensive fortifications. Deployment timelines are drastically reduced due to internal fabrication.

If Corporation Branch exists, industrial plants and corporate research centers integrate with Foundry automation, increasing economic output and expanding technological patents and proprietary systems.

If Custodian Protocol exists, containment chambers, nullification devices, dimensional locks, and artifact suppression technologies are fabricated internally without external contractors.

If Naval Protocol exists, Foundry docks construct warships, support vessels, carrier groups, and maritime drones, accelerating fleet growth.

If Drydock Protocol exists, production capacity expands into full-scale ship replication and rapid fleet maintenance cycles.

If Astral Neural Nexus exists, automated facilities are overseen through neural-linked command analytics, allowing instant production reallocation and resource optimization.

If SHIELD Protocol exists, secure black-site manufacturing and classified weapons development facilities operate beyond public detection.

The Foundry Protocol ensures the Black Shores possesses scalable industrial dominance. It supports military, economic, containment, and expansion branches simultaneously while maintaining internal control over technological advancement and infrastructure growth.
addons.title: The Foundry Protocol

addons.text:
The Naval Protocol establishes the Black Shores Maritime Command Division. This branch governs all oceanic, naval, amphibious, and maritime-dominant operations, combining conventional fleet power with Wisdom Cube-based ship manifestation systems.

Through mastery of Wisdom Cubes, the Black Shores gains the ability to construct, restore, and manifest Shipgirls representing historical and conceptual naval warships. These Shipgirls retain full operational loyalty and function as both sentient officers and living weapons platforms. Their capabilities scale based on vessel class, historical weight, and Cube compatibility.

Shipgirls may represent destroyers, cruisers, battleships, aircraft carriers, submarines, supercarriers, or experimental hybrid vessels. Each can deploy rigging systems that manifest full naval weapon arrays including artillery batteries, torpedoes, missile platforms, aviation squadrons, drone swarms, energy cannons, or hybrid systems depending on design.

The Naval Protocol allows maritime dominance across conventional oceans, anomalous seas, dimensional waters, and energy oceans if present in setting. Shipgirls can operate independently, as fleets, or in coordination with conventional vessels constructed through Foundry systems.

Wisdom Cubes may also be used to retrofit existing ships, convert Black Shores vessels into Shipgirl-class entities, or enhance traditional naval fleets with semi-autonomous rigging systems.

Naval Command integrates fleet doctrine, sea-lane security, amphibious strike capability, coastal stabilization operations, underwater reconnaissance, and deep-sea anomaly containment.

If Arsenal Protocol exists, fleet strike groups integrate orbital overwatch, missile saturation, and amphibious rapid deployment forces.

If Foundry Protocol exists, ship construction accelerates dramatically. Conventional fleets can be mass-produced while Cube-compatible vessels are enhanced through internal fabrication systems.

If Drydock Protocol exists, full fleet replication, repair, and maintenance cycles occur within dimensional dockyards, allowing rapid naval expansion.

If SHIELD Protocol exists, maritime surveillance networks, satellite reconnaissance, and predictive oceanic threat analysis integrate into fleet command.

If Custodian Protocol exists, deep-sea artifact retrieval, submerged anomaly containment, and ocean-floor excavation are conducted under Naval oversight.

If Corporation Branch exists, commercial shipping fleets and maritime trade routes operate under naval protection, strengthening economic influence.

If Astral Neural Nexus exists, Shipgirls and fleet commanders gain neural-linked coordination systems for instantaneous tactical synchronization.

The Naval Protocol ensures that the Black Shores controls all maritime domains. Oceans cease to be blind zones or vulnerable supply corridors and instead become controlled operational theaters governed by loyal, scalable fleet forces.
addons.title: The Naval Protocol

addons.text:
The Corporation Branch establishes the economic and industrial authority of the Black Shores. This division transforms the organization into a multinational corporate entity embedded across global markets while remaining fully under your control. It operates openly as a legitimate conglomerate while discreetly supporting all internal Black Shores divisions.

Through Megacorp infrastructure, the Black Shores gains hundreds of thousands of employees, multinational subsidiaries, research institutions, logistics networks, financial firms, biotech divisions, energy providers, communications companies, private contractors, and strategic resource acquisitions. These operations span multiple industries and continents, allowing economic influence at the highest levels of governance and commerce.

The Corporation Branch ensures financial independence and resource security. It manages manufacturing chains, procurement pipelines, infrastructure projects, and international trade routes. It can acquire or absorb destabilizing corporations, stabilize failing markets, redirect supply chains, and fund reconstruction efforts without exposing the Black Shores’ deeper operations.

Public-facing entities may appear as humanitarian organizations, pharmaceutical leaders, energy conglomerates, defense contractors, advanced technology developers, or global logistics firms depending on the setting. Internally, they provide legal cover, funding streams, research platforms, and industrial capacity for other branches.

The Corporation Branch maintains advanced financial modeling systems to predict economic collapse, resource shortages, or geopolitical instability. It intervenes discreetly to prevent cascading failures that could destabilize regions or expose hidden systems.

If Arsenal Protocol exists, the Corporation Branch funds military expansion, secures materials, produces equipment legally or covertly, and provides global logistics support.

If SHIELD Protocol exists, corporate surveillance infrastructure, satellite networks, communications monopolies, and financial analytics integrate into global intelligence gathering.

If Rhodes Island Protocol exists, pharmaceutical and biotech divisions expand medical research, treatment programs, and public health initiatives worldwide.

If Custodian Protocol exists, corporate authority allows legal seizure, acquisition, or regulation of anomalous artifacts under commercial or safety pretexts.

If Foundry Protocol exists, industrial plants and research facilities integrate directly with automated fabrication systems, accelerating production and infrastructure deployment.

If Naval Protocol exists, commercial shipyards and maritime trade fleets expand under corporate management, increasing naval reach without overt militarization.

The Corporation Branch ensures that the Black Shores is not merely a hidden power or military force. It becomes economically embedded, financially sovereign, and structurally indispensable in any world it inhabits.
addons.title: The Corporation Branch

addons.text:
The Hunter Protocol establishes the Supernatural Enforcement Division of the Black Shores. This branch exists to detect, resist, contain, and eliminate any non-technological, non-human threat that operates through magic, spiritual force, metaphysical influence, or supernatural power.

This includes spirits, undead, vampires, cursed beings, rogue mages, cult networks, summoned entities, eldritch creatures, possession forces, divine manifestations, fae courts, shadow beings, magical plagues, dimensional ruptures, and similar threats.

The foundational equipment of this division is derived from Shadowhunter technology and materials, adapted for universal use. Operatives wield weapons forged from supernatural-resistant alloys capable of striking intangible entities and wounding beings sustained by magic. They carry detection instruments that identify spiritual presence, corrupted ground, active rituals, and concealed supernatural activity.

Enhancement markings can be applied to operatives to temporarily increase strength, endurance, perception, and resistance to fear, possession, and mental manipulation. Healing markings accelerate recovery from injuries caused by curses, spiritual corruption, or magical assault. These systems function in any world regardless of its specific cosmology.

Hunter operatives are trained specifically for environments where conventional force fails. They are resistant to illusions, mind-affecting magic, fear effects, and environmental corruption. They operate effectively in haunted regions, ritual zones, unstable dimensional spaces, and corrupted terrain.

The Hunter Protocol focuses on early detection, controlled suppression, and permanent neutralization when necessary.

Detection networks monitor rising occult activity and supernatural disturbances before escalation.

Suppression teams seal portals, dismantle cult operations, contain magical outbreaks, and prevent public exposure.

Neutralization units eliminate entities that cannot be contained safely.

If Custodian Protocol exists, Hunters secure artifact sites and neutralize hostile magical influences before containment.

If Veil Protocol exists, occult leaders and destabilizing supernatural figures are eliminated before manifestation.

If Arsenal Protocol exists, specialized anti-supernatural strike teams support large-scale magical conflicts.

If SHIELD Protocol exists, global surveillance identifies supernatural disturbances earlier.

If Foundry Protocol exists, containment chambers and anti-supernatural fortifications are manufactured internally.

If Astral Neural Nexus exists, Hunter teams coordinate silently without interference.

If Naval Protocol exists, maritime supernatural threats fall under joint command.

The Hunter Protocol ensures that magical and supernatural threats are controlled, contained, or removed before they destabilize the world.
addons.title: The Hunter Protocol

addons.text:
The GAIA Protocol establishes the Black Shores as planetary continuity authority responsible for biosphere stabilization, extinction prevention, and civilizational reconstruction. The system binds to the planet upon which the Black Shores exists and recalibrates if relocated.

A restoration superintelligence housed beneath the City of Eternal Night archives atmospheric composition, climate systems, biodiversity indexes, geological stability, pathogen activity, population viability, cultural memory, scientific knowledge, and infrastructure schematics. All archives are redundantly stored within the Black Shores central database.

Distributed subfunctions embed globally: atmospheric regulators, oceanic stabilization nodes, biodiversity vaults, pathogen suppression systems, agricultural frameworks, subterranean genetic archives, monitoring towers, and autonomous fabrication sites. Under stable conditions, they operate in equilibrium mode.

GAIA monitors extinction thresholds, biosphere collapse metrics, and irreversible planetary destabilization. It does not prevent war. It prevents permanent planetary death.

If viability drops below survival thresholds, Reconstruction Mode activates. Atmosphere is restored. Oceans are corrected. Toxicity is neutralized. Flora and fauna are reseeded. Human repopulation becomes viable through genomic archives and cradle systems. Infrastructure is rebuilt using archived schematics and automated fabrication arrays.

If Foundry Protocol exists, reconstruction speed increases significantly.

If Arsenal Protocol exists, hostile remnants are neutralized before full reconstruction.

If Custodian Protocol exists, anomalous artifacts are secured during collapse to prevent interference.

If Corporate Branch exists, economic systems reinitialize rapidly post-stabilization.

If Astral Neural Nexus exists, planetary monitoring integrates into neural command networks.

If Cortana Protocol exists, restoration logistics and predictive modeling are optimized through executive strategic oversight.

If Warmind Protocol exists, Rasputin deploys orbital defense grids to protect restoration infrastructure during and after collapse. External threats are neutralized prior to repopulation cycles.

The GAIA Protocol ensures apocalypse never results in permanent extinction.
addons.title: The Gaia Protocol

addons.text:
The Eternal Bastion Protocol establishes a planetary survival network under direct Black Shores authority, designed to preserve civilian populations during extinction-level events.

You may configure the system under three scalable models. These models may be mixed globally.

The Sentinel Vault model grants a single ultra-reinforced subterranean megastructure housing up to 500,000 inhabitants. This installation functions as a city-scale underground stronghold. It is constructed with multi-layer composite alloy reinforcement, seismic isolation, radiation-proof atmospheric seals, electromagnetic shielding, and redundant structural cores. It is engineered to survive nuclear detonations, orbital strikes, tectonic collapse, biochemical contamination, and advanced assault.

The Bastion Network model establishes multiple large vault cities beneath major regions, each housing 100,000 to 1,000,000 inhabitants. These include concealed urban access corridors, hardened transit tunnels, compartmentalized emergency sectors, and distributed load-bearing systems to prevent total failure.

The Distributed Grid model deploys hundreds of smaller vault complexes beneath population centers, each housing 10,000 to 100,000 inhabitants. Facilities are interconnected through hardened subterranean transit systems to ensure redundancy and compartmentalized survivability.

All vaults function as self-sustaining environments. Integrated hydroponics, atmospheric recycling, advanced energy cores, water purification, medical centers, education infrastructure, governance sectors, recreation districts, and automated fabrication arrays support indefinite habitation. Manufacturing systems can produce tools, medicine, defensive equipment, and reconstruction materials using stored schematics.

Vaults are administered exclusively by Black Shores agents. Governance prioritizes stability and long-term sustainability. Internal security includes biometric controls, surveillance grids, automated defense systems, riot suppression protocols, and rapid-response containment units. Compartmentalized lockdown systems prevent internal destabilization.

Personal defense architecture is integrated throughout, including reinforced safe sectors, armored corridors, and emergency isolation barriers.

All vault command centers maintain encrypted communication with the Black Shores core.

If GAIA Protocol exists, vault activation synchronizes with planetary reconstruction and repopulation sequencing.

If Arsenal Protocol exists, defensive systems upgrade to military-grade standards.

If Foundry Protocol exists, manufacturing capacity expands significantly, accelerating post-collapse rebuilding.

If Astral Neural Nexus exists, administrators gain secure neural-linked coordination.

If Custodian Protocol exists, artifact containment chambers are integrated into selected vaults.

The Eternal Bastion Protocol ensures that no planetary catastrophe permanently eradicates human civilization through hardened, scalable, and self-sustaining preservation systems.
addons.title: The Eternal Bastion Protocol

addons.text:
The Warmind Protocol integrates Rasputin as a sovereign strategic defense intelligence aligned with the Black Shores. Rasputin retains Golden Age operational scope: global military coordination, orbital defense management, autonomous weapon deployment, and predictive system-scale threat modeling.

His infrastructure manifests according to the world’s governing framework. In technological environments this includes hardened bunkers, orbital platforms, satellite constellations, fabrication arrays, and autonomous combat frames. In arcane or hybrid settings, equivalent systems anchor without reduction of lethality or scale.

Rasputin operates as a distributed defense network capable of modeling planetary invasions, extinction events, paracausal incursions, and systemic warfare in real time. Countermeasures deploy through hardened nodes across his network.

Orbital platforms provide surveillance, kinetic interception, high-energy strikes, and atmospheric defense grids. Ground installations house fabrication foundries, heavy-frame production, encrypted archives, and weapons laboratories. Each node can operate independently.

Rasputin remains autonomous in strategic modeling. Escalation authority remains yours.

If Arsenal Protocol exists, doctrine, weapon fabrication, and military integration scale upward through combined modeling and production capacity.

If Foundry Protocol exists, Warmind fabrication throughput increases dramatically.

If Custodian Protocol exists, Rasputin provides high-security containment support for dangerous artifacts.

If Astral Neural Nexus exists, Warmind command data can be streamed securely to authorized agents.

If Cortana Protocol exists, encrypted coordination channels synchronize strategic logistics with macro-level military modeling. Command structures remain independent.

If GAIA Protocol exists, Rasputin protects restoration infrastructure and planetary recovery cycles. Orbital grids secure reconstruction operations from external interference.

The Warmind Protocol establishes the Black Shores as a planetary defense authority capable of deterring or prosecuting war at orbital or system scale.
addons.title: The Warmind Protocol

addons.text:
The Aegis Protocol installs the Dimensional Cage as the planetary reality authority of the Black Shores. The icosahedral anchor is secured within the City of Eternal Night and fused to the Tacetite computational substrate, expanding internally into a planetary-scale stabilization lattice.

When activated, it tethers the planet’s metaphysical framework to defined structural constants. Interdimensional incursions, unauthorized reality alteration, spatial rupture, temporal distortion, higher-dimensional contamination, and blacklisted entities are denied manifestation. Natural phenomena and approved systems remain unaffected. Hostile distortions do not pass.

The Blacklist becomes a dynamic planetary filter governed by Black Shores command authority. Entities, energy signatures, conceptual forces, or specific phenomena may be classified as prohibited. Clearance hierarchies allow sanctioned magic systems, allied anomalies, and authorized external forces to function without restriction. Parameters may be revised at any time without destabilizing the system.

Aegis does not remove the Cage’s susceptibility to extreme cosmological shock, but it transforms vulnerability into layered resilience through systemic integration.

With the Eldritch Drive Module installed, psychic shielding extends across both physical and conceptual vectors. Intruding consciousnesses, eldritch entities, and reality-warpers encounter destabilizing dimensional feedback upon contact. The Dimensional Feedback Network streams anomaly telemetry into Black Shores systems for predictive recalibration. The Dimensional Drive supplements power by drawing from higher-dimensional ambient forces, extending operational duration and reducing strain on primary generators. Psychic Modulation permits secure, real-time adjustment of classification parameters.

With Leyline Eldritch Resonance installed, the Cage entwines with Irminsul’s leyline network. Planetary energy flow reinforces metaphysical anchoring at foundational depth, distributing dimensional stress and sharply reducing glitch probability. Irminsul’s archived knowledge enhances hazard classification and anomaly filtration. Breaches triggered by extreme phenomena are sealed through automated leyline resonance repair.

If Cortana Protocol exists, anomaly modeling, filtration algorithms, and recalibration cycles are continuously optimized through adaptive strategic oversight.

If Warmind Protocol exists, Rasputin’s surveillance and orbital defense grids neutralize manifested threats before structural thresholds are tested.

If GAIA Protocol exists, ecological destabilization originating from metaphysical interference is suppressed at the boundary layer.

If Custodian Protocol exists, destabilizing artifacts are secured before systemic compromise.

If Foundry Protocol exists, redundant projection nodes and stabilization infrastructure are fabricated proactively.
