If Astral Neural Nexus exists, authorized personnel receive real-time integrity telemetry and dimensional fluctuation data.

The Aegis Protocol establishes the Black Shores as planetary gatekeeper. Local reality operates within enforced structural continuity. External destabilization is filtered, denied, or neutralized before it can take hold.
addons.title: The Aegis Protocol

addons.text:
The Homeland Protocol integrates the Strategic Homeland Division into the Black Shores command structure, transforming the organization from a hidden world-stabilization authority into a fully realized global response and recovery network capable of operating during every stage of societal disruption, from localized crises to civilization-scale collapse.

The Black Shores remains the strategic and predictive core of the system. The Tethys System continues modeling futures, forecasting disasters, and identifying instability before it manifests. The Strategic Homeland Division becomes the operational arm responsible for acting upon those predictions.

Black Shores Consultants, Bloom Bearers, Gardeners, and deployed personnel are integrated into SHD command architecture. Rather than functioning as isolated specialists, they become part of a decentralized global response network capable of coordinating thousands of simultaneous operations across multiple regions.

The SHD Network is integrated into the Black Shores Beacon infrastructure, forming a unified communications and logistics lattice. ISAC becomes the tactical interpretation layer of Tethys, translating large-scale forecasts into actionable objectives, deployment priorities, and operational directives. The ECHO System expands through Black Shores anomalous technologies, allowing reconstruction of events from conventional data, residual energies, spiritual imprints, dimensional disturbances, and similar traces. A global network of safehouses, intelligence cells, supply caches, and rapid-response facilities supports stabilization efforts and automatically shifts into emergency operations during major crises.

Black Shores no longer merely predicts the collapse of civilizations.

It possesses a dedicated apparatus capable of intervening before, during, and after the crisis.

If Cortana Protocol exists, Cortana serves as the executive coordination layer between ISAC and Tethys. Strategic forecasts, agent deployments, logistics, and intelligence operations are continuously optimized through her oversight.

If Warmind Protocol exists, Homeland assets support Rasputin's operations by securing populations, infrastructure, and operational zones.

If GAIA Protocol exists, recovery operations integrate with planetary restoration, ecological rehabilitation, and reconstruction efforts.

If The Foundry Protocol exists, Homeland personnel gain priority access to Foundry production and logistics networks.

If Custodian Protocol exists, Homeland agents receive specialized training and authorization for artifact containment, anomalous object recovery, and secure transport operations.

If Arsenal Protocol exists, Homeland forces gain access to network-wide armories and emergency stockpiles.

Under the Homeland Protocol, the Black Shores gains something it previously lacked.

Not merely the ability to foresee disaster.

But the ability to place trusted operatives exactly where they are needed when the world begins to fall apart.
addons.title: The Homeland Protocol

addons.text:
The Dry Dock Protocol establishes the Fleet Production and Maintenance Division of the Black Shores. This branch governs large-scale ship construction, vessel replication, rapid repair cycles, and fleet logistics across sea, air, and space domains.

Through access to pocket-dimension dry docks, the Black Shores gains fully automated shipyards capable of repairing, refitting, refueling, and reconstructing any ship or large vehicle within a single operational cycle. Maintenance and restoration occur regardless of external supply chain disruption.

Each drydock slot can produce ships or vehicles proportional to its assigned capacity. Production speed scales based on the combined value and complexity of vessels owned. Existing ships can be replicated. Custom blueprints may be uploaded for construction, provided materials or energy are available.

These drydocks are not limited to naval vessels. They can service maritime fleets, aerospace carriers, orbital platforms, dimensional vessels, heavy transport craft, and mobile command ships.

Fleet standardization becomes possible. Weapon systems, shielding, propulsion, structural reinforcement, and control systems may be unified across all constructed vessels.

If Foundry Protocol exists, material acquisition and fabrication accelerate ship production exponentially, allowing parallel construction across multiple docks.

If Naval Protocol exists, Shipgirl-compatible hulls and conventional fleets are produced simultaneously. Rigging systems and maritime weapon arrays are integrated at construction level.

If Arsenal Protocol exists, capital ships are armed with advanced missile systems, aerospace deployment bays, and orbital strike compatibility.

If SHIELD Protocol exists, stealth coatings, electronic countermeasure systems, and satellite integration are installed during construction.

If Corporation Branch exists, commercial shipyards operate as legal fronts while primary production occurs within secured drydock dimensions.

If Astral Neural Nexus exists, fleet command and vessel coordination integrate into neural-linked command systems.

If Space-oriented expansions are later acquired, the Drydock Protocol scales to service interstellar or slipspace-capable vessels without structural redesign.

The Drydock Protocol ensures that the Black Shores can replace losses, expand fleets, and modernize vessels continuously. No fleet remains static. No ship remains outdated. Production and repair become controlled internal processes independent of external infrastructure.
addons.title: Dry Dock Protocol

objects.text:
You possess the Black Shores in its entirety, the exact organization and archipelago from Wuthering Waves, fully adapted for use in any setting while retaining its structure, personnel, and technological depth. The Black Shores is a sovereign, globally active organization headquartered upon a hidden archipelago formed from an anomalous mineral landmass that continuously emits distortion frequencies. These emissions create a persistent perceptual haze and signal interference field that renders the islands unreachable by conventional navigation, surveillance, or communication. Only those recognized by the organization, invited, or carrying its insignia may locate or physically access its shores. All external contact is routed exclusively through a proprietary Beacon relay network under your control.

The Black Shores functions as an independent world-stabilization authority. Its mission automatically adapts to the setting it occupies, identifying and countering catastrophic phenomena, existential threats, anomalous incursions, dimensional instability, or civilization-ending events. It maintains diplomatic relationships with global powers while remaining politically neutral and strategically autonomous. Its advanced technologies are shared selectively, though their true origin and full capabilities remain known only to inner leadership.

You are the Founder, Chief Steward, and Astral Modulator, the supreme administrative authority of the organization. You may co-lead if desired, but final command authority rests with you. All personnel are present and loyal, including the Shorekeeper, the Bloom Bearers stationed within headquarters, the globally deployed Consultants, the administrative Gardeners, and the autonomous KU-series robots. Each fulfills their canon roles with full competence. The Shorekeeper resides beneath the archipelago within the subterranean data-realm known as the City of Eternal Night, overseeing system integrity and long-range monitoring as Guardian of Secrets.

At the core of the Black Shores operates the Tethys System, a civilization-scale simulation engine that functions without visible infrastructure. It is powered by the anomalous landmass itself and projects its calculations as a vast starfield within the underground data space. The system models global conditions in real time, predicts large-scale crises, and simulates potential futures to guide intervention strategies. Its robotic terminals possess distinct personalities and direct access privileges, functioning as both assistants and extensions of the system’s cognition. Their study has advanced artificial psychology and adaptive machine consciousness.

A global observatory network gathers anomalous data, environmental readings, and hostile activity reports from across the world. This information is processed into compressed Stellar Matrices, vast data constructs capable of simulating disasters, civilizations, or full environmental collapse scenarios. Faulty or corrupted matrices are consumed by an internal deletion construct analogous to a gravitational singularity, ensuring system integrity. Stabilizing Anchors positioned throughout the archipelago regulate the island’s distortion field, isolate the simulation layer from baseline reality, and monitor surrounding dimensional conditions without reliance on external infrastructure.

The archipelago contains fully developed research hubs, habitation districts, fabrication facilities, and strategic deployment centers. Living quarters are personalized for staff morale and long-term residency. Mobility systems, secure gateways, and a submerged data descent point provide controlled access to the subterranean simulation domain. All facilities are self-sustaining and capable of indefinite operation without outside supply.

The Black Shores cannot be seized, replicated, infiltrated, or overridden without your consent. Its distortion field adapts to new detection technologies. Its systems recalibrate to local physics if transferred between worlds. Its global authority remains intact regardless of setting.

You do not merely own an island. You command a hidden civilization dedicated to preventing the end of the world—whatever form that end may take.

Note: All canon members of the Black Shore are included. You also gain the entire database containing thousands of years worth of records, but modified to fit with whatever setting or world your in.
objects.title: The Black Shores (Wuthering Waves)

rows.title: Property Objects of Power
rows.titleText: Note: All non-consumable Objects of Powers can be transferred to another person. When this happens, you do not lose any abilities the object unlocked or awakened (physical alterations, magic independent of the object, etc.) but any soul bonds transferred to the new owner.

objects.text:
A tome without end, its pages rewriting themselves as new magic enters existence. It records all magic and magical disciplines which have ever been developed in the world, giving detailed information on how to learn and use it, as well as in depth analysis and commentary on the spells and schools of magic. It does not have any information on magic which has yet to be developed or created, though it will update itself in real time whenever something new is made.

Holding the tome will allow one to bypass the need to learn the magic one wishes to cast, even bypassing any other restrictions, such as bloodline requirements or elemental affinities, though you still use your own pool of energy to power the spells. As long as one is touching the book one can instinctively cast any spell held within it, though holding it does not make you aware of what spells are held within, so one has to have already heard of, or read of, the spell one wishes to use.

The book has a search function, where it will seek to provide the contents its reader wishes to see, however this is not a perfect function. As an example if one wishes to learn magic which can heal the book, having many differing spells which can accomplish such a thing picks one that fits the criteria at random. So instead of a generic “healing light” you might get a spell which uses blood to knit a wound closed, or a school of magic dealing with restoring an already dead body to better use it to create undead servants later. If one knows of a specific school of magic, meaning its name and uses, one can narrow down this search greatly. 

Finally this book updates itself every time it enters a new world, so it is a great boon to any aspiring Planeswalker.
objects.title: A Nameless Book of Spells

addons.text: Through your grimoire, your Basic Supernatural Guide has now been granted more knowledge of magical effects. This upgrade specifically contains information on how your chosen magic systems can counteract the supernatural effects listed in the guide. This knowledge also has now evolved to contain any magical effect that any of your magic systems canonically have knowledge on a way to cause.
addons.title: Basic Magical Compendium

addons.text:
Through your connection to the occult and your occultic knowledge, your guide has evolved. Your guide now contains a treasure trove of occultic rituals, specifically occultic rituals meant to protect people, harm or contain supernatural creatures, or remove curses or other negative supernatural effects. Your guide now also contains knowledge on how to summon certain supernatural creatures and how to contain them. Lastly, your guide now contains information on how to harvest parts of supernatural creatures, which parts are the most useful, and knowledge of the basic ways to use the parts. 

Alongside this increase in information for your guide, you have also been granted a refilling supply of magically conductive chalk for use in rituals. This chalk will naturally increase the stability of any ritual it is used in while also making setting up a ritual circle far easier and quicker, but it's more effective for lower-level rituals compared to higher-level ones. This chalk circle can optionally be used up in the ritual, so you don't have to clean it up.
addons.title: An Occultists Guide

addons.text: Your Basic Supernatural Guide has now combined with your journal, with it also gaining new abilities. Its new and most important ability is to catalog the basic information of any supernatural creature you have contact with, even if you yourself have no information on them. Secondly, the basic description of supernatural creatures or effects has now naturally been expanded to include more information than it did before. Lastly, any supernatural knowledge contained in this guide will be expanded and contain more information the more you encounter it. The only requirement these abilities have is that they require that knowledge to be available somewhere in that world.
addons.title: Evolving Guide

objects.text:
You have now gained a book filled with knowledge about most supernatural creatures or effects. You may choose the basic design of this book with it always appearing that size no matter how much information it contains. This guide will also contain an index, which allows you to quickly and immediately access the recorded information.

Every creature recorded in this guide contains a basic description, a basic drawing of them, while also covering tips on identifying and counteracting them, with more common creatures providing more detailed descriptions. This book also contains basic knowledge of general magical or supernatural effects, with a focus on basic ways to spot them and basic ways to counteract them. If you are some kind of supernatural creature, then it will also contain in-depth knowledge of your species relative to the universe you are in. Using your own knowledge, you can also manually add to the book.

Note: This does not contain any knowledge on how to actually cast magical effects or counteract them through magic.
objects.title: Basic Supernatural Guide

objects.text:
At first glance, it appears to be little more than an ancient tome. The binding is not simple leather, but the tanned and preserved skin of Abel, the first victim of mortal sin. The cover is impressed with the outline of a human hand, Cain’s own, scorched into the flesh when he pressed it down after writing the last line. It is a single volume containing Cain’s studies, theories, and understandings of magic drawn from the act of sin itself, written with Abel’s blood. It passes through history by unknown means, always resurfacing in the hands of those who become the greatest source of evil in their time.

This is not a spellbook, but a compilation of complete magical theory. The book is divided into several sections that each dissect different disciplines, all of which are “dark” magic. Each section explains not finished spells but the framework to create them; the mathematical, alchemical, and metaphysical relationships that govern cause and consequence. A reader capable of grasping the underlying structure can design their own spells from these principles. There are only a few complete examples written by Cain himself, but they are mostly made to supplement rather than be used independently.

Over centuries, the book has gathered annotations from its various owners. These notes range from clarifications and reinterpretations to entire added theories, arguments, and warnings. Together, they form the most complete surviving framework of dark magical theory in existence. Many sections appear contradictory, the result of centuries of different magi refining, correcting, or misunderstanding Cain’s original writing. But in aggregate, the Codex covers almost every known form of defilement magic: necromantic regeneration, soul tethering, homunculus design, spiritual possession, and the alteration of human anatomy.

On a practical level, this book can enable a trained reader to scale from minor workings to world-altering rituals. With comprehension of its simplest sections, one could reanimate a corpse for manual labor, alter a limb, or create minor curses that erode vitality. Intermediate understanding enables soul-binding, the extraction and storage of consciousness, and controlled mutations of flesh to create hybrid entities. Complete mastery would allow acts equivalent to divine intervention: resurrection without sanctity, reshaping of species, permanent control of free will, and localized redefinition of natural law. The book provides no direct power but gives the method to build these outcomes systematically.

The cost of the knowledge is explicit and absolute. All workings described demands a living payment. The smallest examples, preservation of tissue or blood-based wards, require blood or small amounts of life essence, often drawn through pain. Reanimation or transmutation requires the complete consumption of a soul or the reduction of a human mind to fuel. Larger workings scale proportionally: animating a group of corpses drains multiple lives, while transfiguring a living being demands their full vitality, permanently erasing their consciousness. The book defines a precise exchange rate between essence and effect: for every act of creation, equal destruction must occur.

The book itself is in no way magical outside of how it resists decay through a basic preservation charm, sufficient to prevent erosion but not to maintain appearance, leaving it aged and weathered but intact. There is no lingering will nor curses on the book. Its significance is purely informational: it is a complete textbook of forbidden magic written by the first killer.
objects.title: Book of Cain

objects.text:
You have obtained a small booklet containing a wide variety of useful local contacts.

When first received, the book comes filled with several dozen pages of names relevant to your starting location. Each entry includes a brief blurb about the person, the services they offer, and a method or location where they can be contacted. The booklet does not guarantee that anyone listed within will agree to work with you.

Once per day, you may request three new contacts, whether you are looking for a detective, assassin, guard, merchant, or something else entirely. When used, the book will find suitable contacts and add three new entries that most closely match your request.

However, the book can only find contacts you could realistically meet. For example, if you are still an ordinary human with no access to space travel, attempting to obtain an alien contact would be impossible.

No one else can read its contents unless you allow them to, and its pages will continue to fill indefinitely without the booklet growing any larger.
objects.title: Book of Contacts

objects.text:
You've managed to get your hands on a rather special book, a Book of Vengeance.

When someone wrongs you, the book records their offense, and when you act to punish them for it, you gain a Vengeance Tattoo.

A Vengeance Tattoo is a general status enhancer that's strength is decided by the severity of the offense, multiplied by the severity of the punishment given.

You may, at the time of creation, decide to have a tattoo only enhance specific stats instead, with the strength of the enhancement increasing the narrower its focus.

When you run out of space upon your body for new tattoos, old ones will be enhanced instead.

You may optionally have your tattoos only be visible during use.
objects.title: Book of Vengeance

objects.text:
You have now in your possession, a simple unadorned book. Though you shouldn’t let its plainness fool you, for this is the first holy book of Christianity itself. The very first bible, compiled by saint Peter, blessed by the Lord, and containing the unabridged and unaltered writings, teachings, anecdotes, and thought of Jesus Christ himself. This is a powerful holy artifact capable of channeling faith into miracles. Every passage, every sentence, every word of this book is holy in and of itself. Simply opening it and reading a short part aloud would annihilate most unholy or unnatural creatures, sending demons and their ilk back to whence they came, turning a vampire to dust, and so on.

But that is far from all, it can also redeem, this depends on the recipient, and your own faith. But the forgiveness of God lives in this work, and should the demon, vampire, or other inhuman being feel remorse, shame over its sins, or simple seek peace the forgiveness of God may flow through you and into them. Turning the demon or fallen angel back into an angel, or vampire back into a human. Furthermore, reading aloud the passages heals the mind, body, and soul of any who hear it. The teachings brought forth when it is opened always seeming to hit at the core of whatever issue is facing those reading it and providing help and advise for the situation. Though this can be quite cryptic and metaphorical.

The book is written in not the language of men, not even that before the fall of babel, nay it is written in the tongue of Heaven. One need not understand a single letter or symbol to know what it says and means, perfect understanding simply exists within all who witness the sublime words.

The Codex has the ability to directly interface with heaven in several ways. First is its ability to actualize miracles as seen in Christian mythology. What this means is that the wielder can, depending on their level of faith, essentially petition a miracle, reading a passage about leviathan might allow you to calm down and break leviathans’ chains and shackles, stopping Eidolon from controlling the Endbringer, or you might even decide to control it yourself directly, and command it with the word of god. reading a passage regarding a miracle of healing might allow you to heal all around you of their wounds, and reading one regarding free will and choice would allow you to break all and any master powers over any who hear it as another example.

The second way is that by aligning oneself with the teachings and philosophies found inside, one might reach closer and closer to heaven, and thereby perfection. Growing supernaturally, strong, fast, and tough. Increasing ones magical or holy energies, increasing ones skills and abilities even beyond the realm of logic and sense. Each step growing closer to heaven. Though this takes dedication and commitment. It takes moral and character growth, virtues must be cultivated and sins overcome. This path can take you far, so far as to be neigh undefeatable by any but the Almighty themselves, but it is not easy, and it is not casual. Be prepared to live a very pious, humble life if you wish to tread this path.

Lastly the book, though seeming outwardly unimpressive is an incredibly powerful foci for any holy magic. Any Light based or otherwise holy adjacent magic and abilities are massively multiplied when channeled through the codex, even if they don’t originate from or have anything to do with the Christian god. Though after it has been channeled through this book it was act as though it has
objects.title: Codex Beatus Sanctus Benedictus

addons.text:
Your manual now includes specialized techniques designed to harmonize the artificially granted golden core with your foundational cultivation practices. These techniques ensure that the golden core not only enhances your mind, body, and soul but also fortifies your foundational energy pathways, reducing the risk of energy imbalances or internal conflict. By integrating the core’s continuous cycling of Essence, Qi, and Spirit into your cultivation, your manual helps you stabilize and strengthen your base, transforming the core from a mere enhancement into a powerful catalyst for long-term growth.

Additionally, the manual provides advanced strategies to overcome the artificial limitations of the golden core, guiding you toward breakthroughs beyond the mortal realm. These include methods for refining your core to match the natural progression of cultivation, allowing for gradual evolution toward divine or demonic realms. Furthermore, the manual offers techniques to manage and reduce the cost of accelerating the elixir’s refill process, such as crafting energy-rich pills, designing intricate energy arrays, and performing resource-efficient rituals.
addons.title: Golden Cultivation Technique

addons.text:
In your Cultivation Manual, a new section has appeared. The section is about Cultivation Pills. Cultivation Pills are alchemical creations imbued with condensed energy and essence extracted from supernatural creatures, or plants. Each pill serves a specific purpose, offering boosts to cultivation, combat effectiveness, or physical and metaphysical attributes. By drawing on the encyclopedic knowledge within your Basic Supernatural Guide, you can identify and harvest ingredients that align with the intended effect of each pill, whether it involves refining the fiery core of a salamander or the resilient bone dust of an undead warrior.

Crafting cultivation pills is a delicate balance of art and science, with each type serving a distinct purpose in a cultivator’s journey. Temporary Boost Pills provide a rapid surge of power or energy, ideal for critical moments like battles or emergencies. While effective, their effects are short-lived and overuse can destabilize your energy. Permanent Enhancement Pills, on the other hand, are designed for long-term growth, gradually strengthening the body, soul, or cultivation foundation. These pills require rare and potent ingredients, and their precise crafting ensures their effects are lasting and harmonious with the user’s energy. Finally, Specialty Pills target specific needs, such as improving elemental affinities, sharpening mental clarity, or purging spiritual impurities.

However, the process is not without risks. Improper refinement or unstable ingredients can lead to devastating backlashes, such as energy deviation or spiritual injury, while harvesting essence from sentient or powerful beings may carry unforeseen consequences like karmic entanglements. Over-reliance on pills can also stagnate natural growth, making their judicious use essential.
addons.title: Cultivation Pills

addons.text: Due to your affinity and sheer talent with swords, you gain instructions and a foundation in Sword Cultivation. The premise of Sword Cultivation is to become one with your sword, for it to become an extension of your very soul. With this union comes the ability to treat yourself as a sword, to hone your spirit and body to a razor edge capable of cutting all which opposes you. If you have The Way of the Sword then advancements in Sword Cultivation greatly accelerate your ability to harness its more abstract applications, while having The Swordsman includes more prominent aspects of Body Cultivation, leveraging the connection between sword and body to turn your body into living weapon of mass destruction. If you were to have both Nascent Sword Saint then your sheer talent and affinity for swords would make breaking through to higher realms a piece of cake and essentially remove bottlenecks in cultivation, allowing you to easily ascend to higher realms and punch way outside your weight class. Your ability to progress in Sword Cultivation is heavily tied to your mindset, you need to think and act as a “sword” in order to make any true progress. And lastly, a word of advice for any aspiring Sword Cultivator, remember that the truest purpose of a sword is to cut.
addons.title: Sword Cultivation

addons.text:
Your ability to tame and empower animals has compounded with your knowledge of Cultivation to provide instructions and a foundation in Spirit Beast Cultivation. The premise of Spirit Beast Cultivation is to cultivate alongside an animal, elevating their existence and copying traits from them as you do so. This can be done with multiple animals at once; however, the gains you receive are dependent on how your companion beast grows, so splitting your attention and resources between multiple beasts may hamper your own growth.

Still, with patience and the right resources, you can cultivate even a simple garden snake into a grand dragon, all while benefiting from its growth as well, such as gaining a physique which mimics its divine scales or an technique to replicate its graceful flight.
addons.title: Spirit Beast Cultivation

addons.text: Upon consumption of the Dragon’s Blood, the blood and essence of a Dragon within you compounds with your Cultivation Foundation to create a product greater than the sum of its parts. As you cultivate, you refine the essence of a dragon which flows in your veins and suffuses your spirit, increasing its purity and power, such that you might become a dragon in body as well as in spirit. The more draconic you become, the greater your mystical strength and talent for cultivation. Additionally, even as you fully become a dragon, you maintain the ability to selectively hide your draconic traits, up to taking a form indistinguishable from a normal human. As one who carries the blood of dragons, you exude an aura that compels those weaker than you to obey you and even weakens them if they attempt to fight you, with only those possessing strength and glory on a level equal or greater than yours being able to resist. As the purity of your blood increases, you will come to find that it carries the very same benefits as Dragon’s Blood when consumed, for what is your blood if not the blood of a dragon? Additionally, those who drink your blood will be considered your progeny, establishing a bond that allows you to sense their location and well-being. On a more spiritual level, your mana core has become akin to a dantian, able to store and even create Qi in vast quantities. Going hand in hand with this is your newfound talent for harnessing mana and Qi into various mystical techniques and arts, with ones mimicking the abilities of a dragon—eastern or western—such as weather control, water manipulation, luck manipulation, fire breathing, etc. being especially easy to grasp.
addons.title: Divine Dragon Cultivation

addons.text:
By bonding with the Genie or Caliburn, you get to choose one of two paths: Genie Cultivation and King Arthur Cultivation. Threading both paths is not impossible, but highly challenging on your own.

In either choice, you gain the Soul Gauge Technique, which drains your chi reserves to greatly empower yourself in all aspects for as long as you maintain it. If you run out of chi, you simply have to replenish it.

Genie Cultivation involves channeling aspects of djinns. You will not be learning how to grant wishes for a long time, but can learn how to manipulate your chi to achieve feats of magic. From elemental manipulation, teleportation, flight, shapeshifting, etc to sealing techniques, creating magical artifacts, and turning yourself into smoke. 

You also learn the Speed Break and Time Break techniques, used for bursts of speed, or precision of slowed time.

King Arthur Cultivation involves channeling aspects of the late knight himself, such as his charisma to convert once enemies to your side, his leadership that inspired fierce loyalty, or his swordplay. You also learn the Soul Surge Technique, to cut down hordes of enemies, parry attacks with ease, or rain slashes of breakneck speeds.

Regardless of the path you take, your companion will be a priceless asset to your journey.
addons.title: Soul Gauge Cultivation

addons.text:
The drunken sages of the Swaying Gourd Sect discovered that alcohol holds not just pleasure, but power. By refining its essence, they forged a path of cultivation that feeds on intoxication. From wine to spirit, they turned drunkenness into divine energy.

The cultivation technique developed from this revelation is as potent as it is heretical: the Way of the Swaying Gourd, an inner alchemical method that transmutes alcohol into a volatile form of Qi known as Jiu Qi—Spirit Wine Essence. Once ingested, your meridians adapt to the fiery flow of Jiu Qi, transforming your dantian into a furnace that refines drunkenness into raw spiritual power. Over time, the intoxication that would cripple an ordinary cultivator instead floods you with strength, clarity of instinct, and a deepened connection to the chaos of the universe.

Mechanically, this cultivation technique significantly enhances your use of Drunken Fist. While intoxicated, your physical capabilities exceed mortal limits: your strikes become faster, heavier, and more erratic, empowered by the explosive surges of Jiu Qi coursing through your limbs. Your balance warps into a supernatural state—every fall turns into an advantage, every stumble becomes a strike. Your resilience increases, pain dulls beneath the current of spiritual drunkenness, and your body recovers faster, flushed with the warmth of internalized alcohol essence.

As you ascend through the stages of the Way of the Swaying Gourd, ordinary spirits no longer suffice. Your body begins to crave purity and potency—stronger, rarer brews are needed to fuel your cultivation. In time, you gain an innate sense for alcohol: its quality, age, and strength known at a glance, your instincts guiding you like a connoisseur of power.
addons.title: Way of the Swaying Gourd

addons.text:
The principles of Yin, Yang, and Balance resonate with your Cultivation. Your spiritual energy and Qi from Cultivation become one in the same, with Yin and Yang energies being created by intentionally aspecting your Neutral Qi towards one. This allows for more esoteric and abstract usages of these energies, and also makes the generation of Yin and Yang energies easier as you can simply convert your Qi into the respective energies.

Of course, by doing so, you are intentionally altering the natural state of Qi, so you still need to take care not to convert too much Qi into Yin or Yang, lest you permanently disrupt your internal energy balance, which can have far reaching consequences for your health and Cultivation. Additionally, your Cultivation Manual’s instructions accelerate your progress in mastering the Yin and Yang Fists and reaching enlightenment.
addons.title: Taiji

addons.text:
The blood of a Heavenly Immortal resides within you, fundamentally transforming your Qi. As you advance your cultivation, you increase the purity of your divine blood, transforming your Qi into Divine Qi and dragging you ever closer to true enlightenment and cosmic power.

Divine Qi is vastly more potent than its mortal counterpart, resonating with cosmic and conceptual laws, being immune to corruption, and holding such power that even the simplest of techniques can be infused with godlike power. This ability to resonate with cosmic laws makes abstract and conceptual techniques vastly easier to create and use.

Though this path offers no flashy abilities, it grants profound adaptability and long-term power. Each success elevates you further along the celestial path, slowly reshaping you into a being of unparalleled might and Authority, perfectly suited to rule the Heavens.
addons.title: Immortal Celestial

addons.text:
The Cultivation Manual expands, now including new techniques incorporating the Hercules Method and ways to use it for Cultivation, mainly for body cultivation and full body Qi absorption, or advanced cultivation-based martial arts incorporating the Hercules Method to result in unprecedented advancement and power. 

But all of these are merely side benefits, the main feature is the creation of a new section within the Cultivation Manual, this new section describes ways for the user to use the Hercules Method to modify their body to gain any possible form of Cultivator Special Physique, in addition to the teaching how to create your own Cultivator Special Physique. 

A Cultivator Special Physique is a special mutation some Cultivators are born with or develop through esoteric means that grants their body powerful benefits, affinities, or improves their Cultivation base in various beneficial ways. However, these Special Physiques will come with odd quirks in the form of physical signs or changes to their personality or mentality.

To start, the Cultivation Manual will have instructions on how to create various basic starting physiques, like physiques that automatically gather Qi or that are more attuned to one element or more elements. With enough study, experimentation, and training, you may upgrade them and even combine them, although depending on the Physiques, these may be more difficult and may lead to complications.
addons.title: Physique Builder

addons.text:
Through your enlightened oneness with a concept, your essence has aligned itself with that concept, being fundamentally “tainted” by it. This “taint” isn’t actually bad, it merely means that your Qi is naturally aspected towards your concept, carrying traces of it. Purchasing additional Enlightenments adds more aspects to your Qi.

You find it easy and intuitive to form techniques based around the subject of your enlightenment, allowing you to create functional if rough techniques in the moment as needed. Furthermore, the neutral leanings of the teachings within the Cultivation Manual means that with practice you can learn to cleanse your Qi of the conceptual traces left by your enlightenment and return it to neutral state should you need it that way.

At as you break through to a higher state of existence, so to does the effects of your enlightenment grow with you, bestowing a sort of metaphysical understand of the concept on all levels, allowing for the creation of truly conceptual techniques.
addons.title: Nascent Dao

addons.text:
Through the twisted teachings of the Fifth Heresy you can gain profound knowledge, the secrets of the heavens and cosmos unveiling themselves to you, albeit in a warped and distorted form. When combined with the balanced teachings of the Cultivation Manual, a new path emerges.

When reading the Fifth Heresy you achieve a sort of enlightened fugue state where you have two options; attempt to glean as many secrets as possible before the knowledge fades, or focus on and study a few secrets, achieving a much more fundamental understanding of them even once the knowledge fades.

The first method catapults your cultivation forwards, easily breaking through to higher levels, yet also destabilizes your foundation, your reckless growth not stopping to shore up your foundations before reaching ever higher. The second method is slower but more stable, integrating your newfound understanding into your cultivation without compromising stability.
addons.title: Warped Enlightenment

addons.text:
In your Cultivation Manual, a new section has appeared. The section is about the Art of Puppet Crafting. A puppet to a cultivator is a construct made typically exotic materials that can at least semi-autonomously follow instructions, being closer in nature to an android rather than the puppets you may be familiar with. While simple puppets may be crude and clumsy, a masterfully crafted one can move more gracefully than trained warriors and can even be installed with the ability to use specific combat techniques and further refined with better materials to further increase in power.

To a cultivator one of the core advantages of a puppet is that the power of a puppet can vastly surpass that of the cultivator with no risk of disobedience or betrayal.

The encyclopedic knowledge of your Basic Cultivation Guide's section will help you identify materials suitable for the crafting and improvement of puppets, how to craft and effectively program them into a combat asset. While starting with the instructions to create a relatively simple puppet, with enough time and resources you'll be able to eventually create a puppet that can snuff out stars and overturn the heavens with a twist of the hand, all at your whim.
addons.title: Puppet Crafting

addons.text:
For every young master who has endless treasures and medicines heaped upon them by their clan, there are dozens who are ignored or overlooked. For every once a generation genius, with the physiques and affinities to let them ascend higher and further than anyone ever has in their realm, there are thousands with only acceptable talent. And for every heaven-defying, unique individual, given every fortuitous event needed to ascend to the peak, there are endless people who never receive a chance. What can mere mortals do against such beings? Why, the same things are done to defeat any foe larger and stronger than themselves, find and exploit their weaknesses.

Now, beyond basic martial techniques, the manual contains a wealth of methods anyone can learn, all designed to fight and defeat cultivators and other users of internal energy. Strikes designed to avoid or break the common defenses, tells in both body language and energy signatures, and diagrams labeling weak points in energy circulation systems.

Furthermore, the style contains methods for absorbing the energy released by your injured and dying foes, strengthening you while weakening them.
addons.title: Immortal Felling Style
Myriad Poison Path
addons.text:
Your affinity for poison has led to the creation of the Myriad Poison Path, a cultivation method centered around consuming, refining, and creating toxins. Poison is treated as a form of spiritual nourishment, with every toxin you ingest becoming another source of power and another weapon to add to your arsenal.

Cultivation gradually develops the Ten Thousand Poisons Physique, transforming your body into a living vessel of venom. Your blood, flesh, and Qi become poisonous, with the toxicity of your existence increasing alongside your cultivation. Even from the beginning merely coming into contact with you is dangerous for those not resistant to poison and in time your mere presence poisons those around you.

The Path also teaches supernatural applications of poison, allowing you to manipulate and weaponize your creations in combat. You can coat weapons, poison attacks, create clouds and fields of venom, or directly inject your Qi into an enemy to poison their body, energy, or soul. Additionally, your ability to create poison improves alongside your cultivation, eventually allowing you to produce substances far beyond mundane biology.

Every poison you survive and refine expands your repertoire. Rare toxins grant rare properties, supernatural poisons grant supernatural effects, and sufficiently powerful poisons can fundamentally alter what your venom is capable of. At the highest realms, your poison ceases to be something that merely kills—it becomes a force capable of destroying souls, worlds, and everything between.

addons.title: Sage's Profound Scriptures
addons.text:
Killed and transmigrated into the Naruto world, a powerful cultivator managed to recreated their lost cultivation using Chakra and Natural energy. Your Cultivation Manual now contains their completed ten-realm system, granting you the ability to practice it.

You begin at the first realm. Every breakthrough brings a profound increase in raw power alongside a qualitative transformation of your body, soul, and energy, greatly increasing your capabilities, reserves, and lifespan. All else being equal, even the peak of one realm cannot rival the beginning of the next.

The first realm, Natural Energy Sensing, teaches you to absorb natural energy and refine your foundation. The second, Chakra Coil Tempering, reforges your pathways to withstand increasingly potent natural energy, making senjutsu and Sage Mode far more accessible and powerful at its peak. The third, Senjutsu Rebirth, transforms your personal chakra into naturally replenishing senjutsu chakra, massively expands your reserves, and makes Sage Mode's enhancements your permanent baseline, strengthened further through cultivation.

The fourth, Sage Core Formation, condenses a powerful core and refinery, vastly increasing energy density, capacity, and output. The fifth, Sage Soul Formation, transforms your soul, allowing direct manipulation of external natural energy and the natural world without spending internal reserves. Infusing this external energy with your senjutsu chakra greatly amplifies its potency and control.

The sixth, Six Paths Unity, unifies body, core, and soul, allowing you to naturally produce Six Paths sage chakra. The seventh, Sage Dominion, extends this foundation into your surroundings, making natural energy circulate as an extension of your chakra system while vastly elevating your personal power, perception, and techniques.

The eighth, Divine Principle Integration, incorporates supernatural principles into yourself and your dominion, making shinjutsu accessible through cultivation. The manual guides their development, but individual techniques require separate training; specific abilities, bloodlines, and eyes are not automatically granted.

The ninth, Transcendent Existence, allows your spiritual foundation to survive bodily destruction and reconstruct a vessel. The tenth, Sage Ascension, unifies your entire foundation into an ascended existence no longer dependent on a physical body, accompanied by a final immense increase in power.

Beginning with Senjutsu Rebirth, each realm adds a century to your natural lifespan, culminating in agelessness at Sage Ascension. This prevents death by old age, not destruction.

Compatible ambient energies can substitute for natural energy in other worlds. Advancement requires training,and understanding, with failed breakthroughs risking crippling injury or death.

objects.text:
You possess a book titled “The Foundational Arts of Cultivation”. In it contains the teachings of a cultivation technique. This technique stands out not for its flashiness or specialized benefits, but for its simplicity and versatility. It is alignment-neutral, making it accessible to anyone regardless of their background or affinity. While it does not grant unique powers or affinities, its strength lies in its universality.

The technique focuses on harmonizing with the energy of the world around them, drawing it in and refining it to nourish the user’s body and soul. By practicing it, you can steadily expel impurities from your being, both physical and metaphysical, resulting in gradual but holistic improvement.

Over time, as your energy grows purer and more potent, you’ll reach natural plateaus known as bottlenecks. At these stages, further progress is impossible without undergoing a breakthrough, a transformative and perilous process. During this process, the very fabric of your being is refined—your genetics, your core essence, and even your soul undergo an intense transformation. If successful, you emerge stronger, healthier, and more in tune with the world’s energy. However, the risk is great, as failure can lead to severe setbacks, including the loss of your cultivation or even death.

In addition to the cultivation technique, the book also contains a selection of basic combat techniques, allowing practitioners to choose from disciplines such as swordsmanship, spear mastery, martial arts, and more. These complementary techniques are designed to integrate seamlessly with the cultivation method, ensuring a balanced development of both internal energy and external combat prowess.

This technique is adaptive, allowing you to harmonize with and cultivate the energy of whatever world you inhabit—whether it be Chakra in the world of Naruto, Nen in the world of Hunter x Hunter, or any other energy system.
objects.title: Cultivation Manual
Fundamental Theorem of [X]
objects.text:
A comprehensive tome containing the most fundamental and significant theorems concerning a chosen subject, such as psionics, magic, souls, meta-or-normal physics, or the multiverse.

The book's contents are primarily derived from the underlying logic of your starting universe, presenting its most fundamental truths in a form that can be applied across most universes you visit. While local differences in laws and principles may require adaptation, the book's theories remain broadly valid and provide a reliable foundation for understanding the subject.

Each volume contains a carefully organized collection of established theorems, axioms, proofs, derivations, and corollaries. Rather than merely describing how a phenomenon works, it explains the fundamental relationships governing it, why those relationships exist, and what can be derived from them. The contents may cover multiple disciplines and their interactions, provided they are relevant to the chosen subject.

The book prioritizes information according to its fundamental importance, building from basic principles toward increasingly complex theories and applications. It includes explanations, examples, practical implications, known limitations, and connections to other established principles. The information is presented in a way that allows you to understand and apply it, rather than merely memorizing its conclusions.

Note: The book does not automatically contain every possible application, undiscovered phenomenon, or piece of knowledge, only the Axions of the choosen subject.

Each additional purchase grants another volume. You may select a different subject or continue expanding upon the same subject. A subsequent volume contains further fundamental theorems, deeper principles, and more advanced relationships that build upon the knowledge of previous volumes. It does not simply repeat the contents of earlier volumes.

You've obtained the spellbook of the elusive Heromaker (real name James), which contains several libraries' worth of books, his personal research notes and journals that chronicle his journey through dimensions, and his massive collection of spells. The book is the size of a regular sheet of paper and seems to hold about a hundred pages. The covers and spine are made of wood and wrapped in black cloth embossed with a strange geometric symbol and six black jewels.

The book is enchanted to have an infinite number of pages and functions like a wiki, where each page has a unique numeric identifier, an optional human-readable name that can be referenced from other pages, and tags that can be used to group pages together. The book features an auto-generated index but no table of contents. You can mentally request the book open on a specific page when opened and use the same system to search for pages with specific titles or keywords, which will display a list of matching pages, but the algorithm isn't very advanced.

The majority of the spells in the book are written down as code, in a programming language similar to Python, and make heavy use of wiki references for function calls and libraries. The book contains a staggering array of spells, from basic cantrips like laser (pointer) eyes and hover sneakers, more advanced spells that can open invisible portals or create an ablative suit of armor around the caster, to highly complex workings that allow the creation of powerful legendary weapons, capsule-like spaceships capable of inter-dimensional travel, and Von-Neumann devices that can harvest entire planets for matter or magical energy. The latter is not only incredibly costly but also, like many other spells, lacks any safety features that would prevent it from being cast on the world you currently reside in. The spells are generally not shielded against outside interference either, so a seasoned mage can interfere or even hijack the spells from the book.

In the book, you will also find a collection of scans that cover objects, like plants and minerals, furniture and technology, but also animals and people, even one of Heromaker himself, as well as spells cast by other mages. There are spells in the book to take your own scans, analyze and modify the scan data, and reproduce the objects or spells. Useful if you find yourself stranded somewhere and in need of a cooked rabbit or some precious gems to trade with. To reproduce an object, some existing matter is required.

The book has its own reserves of magical energy, which powers the enchantments and can be drawn from to power the spells within. The battery is very large, enough to cast simple cantrips septillions of times, but still finite. Not even Heromaker knows what happens if you empty the magical battery but it's probably not a good idea. There is no easy way to check the charge level, but there are probably spells in the book that can help you with that, if you can find them, or make your own. You can recharge the book and cast the spells yourself if you generate your own magical energy.

Since you are unable to actually cast the spells inside the book (unless you are a mage), you receive a small gold pendant with a black diamond set inside within, along with the book. It allows you to store the book, recall it from a distance, and access it directly in your mind, even when not in your presence. The pendant is also the dormant form of one of the legendary weapons mentioned above, which can be awakened and tweaked with the right spells.

One thing to note is that the book stores all of its information in physical form, so damage to the gems on the cover, the pages, or the necklace will corrupt the data in the book. If you manage to discover the secrets behind its creation, you will be able to engineer your own grimoire in whatever form you want.
objects.title: Heromaker's Legacy

addons.text: Your journal now acts in a similar way to Lossy’s journal. Your journal retains all of it’s previous function, but now, your journal is also able to record down much more supernatural aspects of your experiences. It records down every moment you experience in the form of pictures as well as details and background of the people you interact with, allowing you to encapsulate moments and revisit them with perfect clarity and sensation. In addition, the records in your journal can act as stabilisers of reality, ensuring and enforcing reality such that information it records holds true.
addons.title: Journal of Lost Word

addons.text:
The power of your Primal Tatau has seeped into and merged with you journal empowering it with a new connection to nature, with it your journal now records the marks of your Primal Tattoo showing a depiction of it, it's meaning and how you got it. With this it's possible for someone to recreate a Primal Tatau however it will be at it's most base form, you can also place limits on who can re-create or use a Primal Tatau through this method.

But that's not all as due to the connection to nature your journal provides greater information on flora, fauna and generally all aspects of the natural world along with recipes and instructions needed to create drugs, medicines, tools and weapons from your environment. In the beginning you have access to all recipes from the Far Cry series but through encountering new materials, research and experimentation the list of recipes will continue to grow until it becomes akin to a How To guide for starting civilization.

In the very of the journal you will find a small compartment able to generate syringes filled with any recipe that would fit inside it, the quality being the best you could have made it in ideal conditions, and after use the syringes disappear.

Opening and closing the journal refreshes the selection of syringes with the only limits being after one syringe is created you can't unmake it to reclaim the materials used and you are limited by the resources you personally possess and those you can realistically get from the area around you within a 30 minute time frame.
addons.title: Primal Footnotes

addons.text:
A strange thing has happened: your Journal has taken steps to complement your impressive culinary skills, resulting in the creation of a new section called The Cookbook.

This section is constantly updated and contains precise, detailed information on how to prepare anything you've seen, touched, or learned about in enough detail. If it has taste, shape, or texture—whether plant, animal, mineral, or even creatures of a more unusual origin—The Cookbook can generate perfect preparation techniques. These include methods for cleaning, seasoning, temperature control, preparation time, presentation, nutritional data, effects on different physiologies, and potential risks.

The content adapts to your dietary requirements, cooking skill level, and available equipment. As you improve as a cook, the instructions become more precise and elaborate. Additionally, it offers various preparation styles for each entry, such as convenient, gourmet, ritual, survival, medicinal, and even psychological methods, like those intended to boost morale.

Whenever the section encounters an unfamiliar ingredient, it begins gathering information in the background, typically based on sight, smell, or taste. Once enough data has been collected, a new entry is added.
addons.title: The Cookbook

addons.text:
Due to the amount of medical knowledge you possess a new section of the Journal has been added, one dedicated to all things related to the medical field. In this section is records and details of all the medical knowledge you have along with any topics that can be applied to it, when you encounter a new patient or generally anyone with an illness the journal will narrow down the cause(s) with the search becoming more effective the more information you have along with a list of treatments known by you or those within 300 kilometres of you or the journal.

It can also flag new discoveries such as mutated virus or whole new conditions. Any progress made in your medical research is saved in the journal with contradictions and faulty data being pointed out, like if it was being peer reviewed by a hundred other specialists.

Should you have 'MD in the HOUSE' then this section evolves into something greater as now it will passively perform medical research as if you dedicated your whole being to the task with endless funding and resources, the results of this research will be recorded in you journal along with the step by step process involved. Any new medical information such as techniques, medicines, conditions, etc, will be added to the journal's pages with it creating research pursuits.

But it's not wholly about the physical health as this section draws upon your other skills and powers to compile information focused on the medical field. Some examples would include Culinary (Skill) providing an optimized meal plan for a long and healthy life for an individual, Psychology, Healer, or Harmful (Skill) giving you an expansive knowledge regarding mental health and how to treat such condition, Animal Husbandry (Skill) would give comparable Veterinarian for all animals you encounter and how their could be used to make medicines and Mechanical Engineer (Skill) would passively research new medical equipment.​
addons.title: Medical Journal

addons.text:
Due to your emotional connections with others and your ability to understand what truly makes them happy, your Journal has unlocked a special section called "The Memory Album."

Here, you'll not only be able to view photos, but also capture deeper details about those experiences (such as places, associated emotions, and even a brief description of what happened), along with "important memories" related to those people, such as the first time you met or a significant event.

Additionally, the Journal will not only track your experiences but also begin to record the events and stories shared by the people you know. For example, if someone shares a meaningful moment or story from their past, the Journal will be able to record it in your album as if it had happened to you.

As your album grows and the more you learn about the people closest to you, you'll be able to receive suggestions on how to improve your relationship with them through small actions, allowing you to plan special moments as well.

For example, if you notice someone has had a rough day, the Journal might suggest, through a little sticky note in the album: "Remember the café on the corner: a place [name] loves and always lifts their mood," alongside a photo of the place.
addons.title: The Memory Album

addons.text:
As your artistic talents reach new heights with Greatest Content Creator, your Journal unlocks a special section: Dreamer's Doodles. This tool doesn't create finished works, but it's essential to the birth of all great ones.

Here, you can capture raw ideas—loose lines, fragments of songs, set designs, gestures for a scene, or sketches of emotions not yet fully formed. Dreamer's Doodles gives you a space to release your creative flow without judgment, ensuring no spark of inspiration is lost in the whirlwind of your genius.

As you perform, write, or design, Dreamer's Doodles watches. It helps you notice narrative inconsistencies, visual elements that feel off, or potential wardrobe malfunctions before they become real problems. It may also offer intuitive connections—like finding the exact imagery that resonates with a melody you've already composed.

In tandem with Greatest Content Creator, this tool becomes your invisible workshop, where ideas mature and take shape. While one builds the masterpiece, the other protects and nurtures the seed.

Because even the greatest artist needs a place to dream without limits.
addons.title: Dreamer's Doodles

addons.text:
Due to your extensive scientific knowledge, a new section has been added to your Journal—one dedicated to all matters related to the Natural Sciences. In this section, all knowledge and details you possess about various scientific fields are recorded, along with any related information that can be applied to them.

When you conduct research, all progress is automatically recorded in your Journal, and any faulty or contradictory data is highlighted as though your work had been peer-reviewed by dozens of experts. Additionally, your Journal provides suggestions on how to improve the efficiency of your research, which topics you should prioritize based on your current situation and limitations, and examples of practical applications for your findings.

Furthermore, your Journal seamlessly incorporates any other skills you may have to assist you in your scientific pursuits. For example, Mechanical Engineer (Skill) would help you design and optimize scientific equipment, while Economics (Skill) would help you market your research and inventions.
addons.title: Science Journal

addons.text:
Thanks to your ownership of a Cultivation Manual, a new section has been added to your Journal—one entirely dedicated to analyzing your cultivation progress.

This section will automatically identify bottlenecks, inefficiencies, and instability in your energy flow, along with recommendations on how to resolve them. It will also flag when you are approaching a breakthrough and estimate the associated risk levels.

Additionally, the Journal can record failed experiments, dangerous techniques, and “don’t do this again” notes alongside highlighting optimal training conditions (location, energy density, mental state).
addons.title: Cultivation Journal

addons.text:
Due to your extensive knowledge of engineering, a new section has been opened in your Journal. This section records everything you know about both hardware and software engineering, along with any information that can be applied to them.

You can create blueprints for devices, structures, and machinery in the Journal, with it delivering a detailed breakdown of moving parts, stress points, wear states, and failure risks. It can also provide estimates on repair difficulty and the tools or materials required to build your designs. When examining a foreign device, the Journal will recreate its blueprint based on your examination and deliver an equally thorough breakdown of its features.

Likewise, you can write software programs in your Journal and have a limited ability to run simulations to determine whether the code is functional, with the Journal noting errors and inefficiencies. It also has the useful ability to flawlessly translate a program from one coding language into any other language you are proficient in.
addons.title: Engineer's Journal

addons.text:
Due to your extensive knowledge of the Occult, a new section has opened in your Journal. In this section, all knowledge you possess about the Occult is recorded, as well as any related information that can be applied to it.

Every time you attempt a ritual, the Journal will automatically log the attempt as a “trial” and note deviations, partial successes, failures, and side effects.

Additionally, every time you encounter an occult phenomenon, ritual, entity, or symbol, the Journal will analyze it through the lens of your occult knowledge—cross-referencing it with known traditions, highlighting likely purposes and failure points, identifying symbolic mismatches, and flagging contradictions between the intended outcome and the observed effects of a ritual.
addons.title: Occultist’s Journal

addons.text:
Due to your extensive knowledge of history and culture, a new section has been added to your Journal—one dedicated to the study and understanding of different cultures.

Whenever you encounter a new culture, whether it is still alive or merely the remains of one long gone, your Journal will automatically record any information you learn about it. This includes all aspects, from its history and traditions to its societal dynamics and behavioral tendencies.

However, the Journal does more than simply record knowledge. It analyzes and cross-references information to aid you in your research, forming hypotheses about why certain societal developments occurred. It is even capable of making predictions about the development and trajectory of a given culture in both the near and distant future.

These predictions can focus on specific aspects of a society—such as a single industry—or on the society as a whole, depending on your preference. The accuracy of these predictions will initially be low but will improve as you continue to research and learn more about the culture.

If you possess additional skills, they will seamlessly synergize with the Culture Journal. For example, scientific and technical skills would help you better understand a culture’s technology and scientific progress, while social skills would help you grasp its deeper essence or “soul.”
addons.title: Culture Journal

addons.text:
In addition to all of its other functions, your Journal can now transform into a Palm Quire: a small, circular notepad for the use of drawing spells. Not only can it instantly record and reproduce any spell you've drawn before, you may also mentally draw on its pages, producing markings made with Silverwood ink without requiring pen in hand.

As a precaution, spells reproduced in your Palm Quire will sport an incomplete circle; you must consciously choose to close it in order to activate a spell. However, an instant of focus is better than a spell spontaneously going off in your hand before you're ready, no?
addons.title: Palm Quire (Witch Hat Atelier)

addons.text: Your Journal can be use as a Grimoire, it can record any number of spells up to 6th level, and be used to cast them, but it can only have four of each level prepared at any one time. (Note: You need to be able to cast the spells normally to cast them with the Arcanist's Treatise.)
addons.title: Arcanist's Treatise
Botany Journal
addons.text:
Due to your extensive knowledge and expertise in the care of plants, a new section has been unlocked in your Journal—the Botany Journal. Whenever you encounter a plant, fungus, algae, or similar plant-like organism, your Botany Journal will automatically record everything you learn about it.

This includes information about its biology, life cycle, habitat, nutritional requirements, medicinal properties, uses, weaknesses, methods of cultivation, optimal harvesting conditions, and anything else relevant to its care or utilization. The information will automatically update as you learn more.

But it doesn't just record what you know; it can also act as a cultivation assistant. By analyzing the plants under your care, it can provide detailed recommendations on how to improve their growth. Rather than simply telling you what is wrong with a plant, it can explain why the problem is occurring and provide step-by-step instructions for correcting it. It can account for interactions between soil composition, weather, neighboring plants, fertilizers, pests, seasonal conditions, and other environmental factors.

When encountering unknown flora, it cannot conjure information from nothing, but it can combine its existing botanical knowledge with observations of the new organism to provide useful hypotheses.

Finally, it can act as a research tool by recording your botanical experiments and cross-referencing the results to determine whether there may be additional benefits or risks you have overlooked. For example, if you develop a particular fertilizer that makes one species grow faster, your Journal can determine whether other related species in your database might benefit from it as well.

addons.title: Navigator's Journal
addons.text:
Due to your exceptional knowledge of navigation and cartography, a new section has been unlocked in your Journal—the Navigator's Journal. Whenever you explore a new location, your Navigator's Journal will automatically record relevant geographical and navigational information, updating its entries as you learn more.

This includes information about terrain, landmarks, routes, distances, elevations, bodies of water, hazards, settlements, points of interest, and other features relevant to navigation. The Journal will also record information from maps you create or encounter, allowing you to continually refine and update your maps as your knowledge of an area improves.

By using your maps and accumulated geographical knowledge, the Journal can help determine the best route to a desired location. Simply provide a destination, and the Journal can identify potential routes while taking known hazards and your capabilities into account. If circumstances change during your journey, the Journal can automatically recalculate your route and provide alternatives.

When entering an unfamiliar environment, the Journal can combine your observations with its existing geographical knowledge to construct a preliminary map. The more you explore, the more accurate and detailed the map becomes.

Finally, the Navigator's Journal can combine its maps with other information contained within your Journal.

For example, if your Botany Journal has recorded where a particular plant grows, the Navigator's Journal can mark those locations on your map. Similarly, information about monsters, resources, settlements, jobs, or other points of interest can be displayed alongside your geographical maps.

objects.text: You gain access to an automatically updating, indestructible, unlosable journal that keeps track of information for you. Jobs, rumors, bestiary, maps, places, item values, number of sweet rolls you've stolen and far more are all recorded as you encounter them. Ordinarily only you can read anything within the journal, for anyone else it will appear blank. However, you can choose to show an individual specific entries if you wish, though they will still remain unable to read it by themselves. You will automatically know if any major new additions are made to the journal and can, when opening it, turn straight to the page with the information that you desire to read.
objects.title: Journal

objects.text:
This isn't a fake; it's not some novelty book made by some human to sell in a shop.

What you have here is the Lesser Key of Solomon. This grimoire contains a massive amount of knowledge on the summoning, contracting, and even binding of various supernatural beings. Each page contains either a specific species or a specific being's general information and the proper procedure to summon them to you—from the proper circle, correct incantation, what day and time to use, what sacrifice is needed, and, if possible, their specific binding or way to unsummon them in case of danger.

This ranges from the smallest of nature spirits to various pagan and even well-known gods. And of course, it contains the knowledge on Ars Goetia, the 72 devil pillars of hell, as well as all extra clans. Of course, while you may have the knowledge on how to summon such beings, whether they answer the call or are even still alive is another matter. And while things like mere nature spirits would be easy to permanently bind to your command to increase your power, more powerful beings like a devil or god would either require more personal power to force into submission or the right offer to convince them to give you what you want.

This grimoire updates itself for whatever world you go to.
objects.title: Lesser Key of Solomon

objects.text: A book based around teaching the practice of a magic system to beginners. Which magic system? Well, that's up to you, but it has to be one that can be learned by anyone, although rituals or tools being required to use the magic system work as well so long as their creation or use are taught in this book. This could take the form of a Wizard's spellbook or an Archivist's prayerbook from D&D, Gwen's Spellbook from Ben 10, or an Encantus from Doofquest, just for some examples. This spellbook very well could act as a focus or be enchanted in some minor ways such as shifting into pocket size and back, but not an actual magical artifact into itself.
objects.title: Magic for Dummies

objects.text:
This ornate grimoire is filled with complex arcane formula that allow the wielder to channel the aether into spells. When you attune with the grimoire, you gain a reserve of aether and a basic understanding of the art of arcanum, symbols of powers derived from geometric shapes that are used to shape aether, and can decode the basic formulas within the grimoire. Among these formula are the ones used to summon your familiars, Carbuncle and Selene, using the gems embedded in the grimoire as catalysts.

At the beginning, you can cast minor offensive, defensive, and support spells on par with the effects possible through the Magick power, though more versatile. However, you will need to refine your understanding of the art to master the more complex magicks.

Your familiars start out weak but will be faithful companions in your adventures and grow alongside you. They are able to cast spells using their own aether reserves, smaller than your own. Carbuncle is focused on offensive elemental magic and can act as a front line fighter if necessary. Selene the fairy is focused on defense and support magic but is best kept away from the front line as she is fragile. As your understanding of the arcanum arts increases, you will be able to empower your familiars using the gems of your grimoire.
objects.title: Magitek Grimoire

objects.text:
The spare grimoire of one of the vilest, most evil, arch wizards to ever live. Interdimensional war criminal at the age of 12, Instigator of the wizarding wars, founding member of THE Shadow Wizard Money Gang, and wanted in 8 out of 10 known planes and realities. The one who escaped the Super Space Nuremberg trials and is still at large, Tim the Accursed.

The spells this tome holds, written in pink crayon, are nearly all banned by the Grand interdimensional wizard counsel for being cruel and unusual, as well as inhumane or just plain fucked up to cast in a wizarding duel. Some of the lower-level spells include things such as: Mend Butt crack, Power word: Explosive Diarrhoea, Testicular torsion, Balls to Tungsten, Extremely itchy Ovaries, Induce chronic backpain, Ray of male pattern baldness, Dab of power, Lobotomy ray, Undo therapy, Bestow kidney stones, Minor amnesia: Favorite piece of media, Permanently full bladder, Invert skin, Instant asbestos lungs, Teleport spine, Cure traumatic backstory, Dominate Kidney, Banish: Detroit, Raise rent, Bewitchment: UwU speak, Colon Taste bud Transfiguration, And so on. We’d be here all day if I had to list them all.

These are merely some of the lesser spells inscribed in this vile and forbidden book. There are also some conventional spells, though only very few. 

As your arcane abilities increase, and you understand more of wizarding and spell casting you might turn your attention to some of the middling spells such as: Cause economic recession, Phantom sensation: Hyena birth, Induce FaceTime call: Nyarlathotep. Summon 5th dimensional gigolo, Mass Animate skeleton (skeleton does NOT have to be outside the body), Mass Bestow Allergies, Instant hold corporate meeting, Make Favourite niche hobby mainstream, Annihilate Net Worth, Smallpox rain, Chant of Turbo tax fraud, And many more. They are fewer of these than the lesser spells, but still many I have not listed.

If you are talented enough, the high level spells inscribed upon these accursed papers might be revealed to you, I do not wish to speak long about some of these, but a few of them are as follows: Transmute rain to dead gnomes (can be scaled from local to worldwide), Summon Elder Clown God, Greater permanent post nut clarity (goes from single target to worldwide effect), Transmute Seas to Soda, Power word: Induce labour, Aura of Greater homelessness, Summon Greater celestial Cocaine elemental, Induce horrible ending in Favourite media, Mass create tragic backstory, Greater Ritual: Opposite day, Teleportation to Big Bang. Thankfully these are somewhat rare, with only a few pages more of these types of spells.

Lastly the book also holds Tim's own notes and formula for spell creation, and his thoughts behind the endeavour, allowing you to create your own crimes against nature in due time.
