These are some of the most dangerous and feared spells in the multiverse and using them is a war crime in most realities, yes even outside of wartimes. I pray that you use this with great care and responsibility.
objects.title: Perditorum Usuum Tribulationes Inferorum Schedula - Spellbook of Vile Evil

addons.text: You now know how to forge this map with all the benefits that it entails for you and for others.
addons.title: Fabulous Cartographer

objects.text:
You have acquired a map or something that appears to be a map. In its base form, it looks like a typical yellowed parchment scroll from the 15th century, with torn edges, size A0. However, it has the ability to change its appearance and size at will and is fully customizable.

The way the map is visualized can be transmitted through various formats regardless of its physical form. These include a holographic map, an illusion-based projection, a mental image through psychic powers, and more. If you possess any supernatural ability that allows for the visualization of information, the map will automatically adopt that medium. The interface is intuitive and easy to understand for the holder, regardless of the amount or complexity of the data being presented.

It is capable of recording everything that exists within the local universe you are currently in. Any mythical or dimensional place such as Heaven, Asgard, and others will be out of range, but you’ll still be able to locate the entrance to such destinations.

If in the future you acquire maps or information beyond the current effective range, the map will automatically update and expand accordingly. All functions of the map will be included in this new expansion. You can manage the new locations as separate files or distinct maps, allowing you to switch perspectives from one area to another as needed.

The map’s interaction features are highly versatile. They provide immersive real-time tracking of targets, and as a result, the map will reveal everything in depth, such as their history, secrets, stats, and more. You’ll be able to observe them from a third-person view or set a personalized viewpoint without the target ever noticing your observation.

Due to the sheer volume and complexity of information, a built-in search engine is included. It can locate anything you ask for as long as it’s within the map’s range. Even with vague or imprecise descriptions, the map will attempt a search; otherwise, it will provide a list of possible matches.

It also includes a filter system for better precision and efficiency. Furthermore, both the search engine and filter can operate based on the user’s intent without requiring a detailed description. And if you truly lack any knowledge or description of the target, it can even reference any directly or indirectly related sample.

Optionally, you can assign a built-in AI that is included with the map. This AI will be loyal and adapt to your personality. It can serve as your assistant to help you work more efficiently, or as an ideal guide to help you locate anything or understand everything around you.

Want to find a gold mine? Your AI will show you the path to the closest one from your current position.

Want to know the password of a magical wall blocking your path to a coveted treasure? Your AI will reveal the password or the conditions required to unlock it.

No barrier, camouflage, or isolation method will prevent the map from tracking a target unless the target is outside of its universal range. 

Whether you are conscious or unconscious, the map will trigger an alarm to warn you of inherent dangers along the path you’re following or blindly exploring before it’s too late. In addition to alarms, it can display the enemy’s position, the number of enemies, their individual threat levels, and their personal information, without missing even the smallest detail.
objects.title: Perfect Map

objects.text:
This is the personal diary of the renowned alchemist (among other things) Rendall Othric Balthazar, gifted to him by his mother when he left to study at the Central Yarlford Occult Academy, which fell between the couch cushions and somehow landed into your possession. It takes the appearance of a small leather-bound journal held closed by a leather strap with a holder for a black fountain pen.

In the diary, you will find … a lot of things, his personal diary that chronicle his time at the academy, notes he took while in class or at the library, drafts and copies of papers he had to submit, notes on his personal research and experiments, even full copies of multiple books — in direct violation of the Draconian Magical Copyright Act — and everything else needed to turn a complete novice into a master of the arcane, occult, and everything else magical. Not to mention all of the notes in the margins, which can range from mindless doodles, to deep insights into magic theory, sometimes the difference isn't obvious.

The journal is enchanted to have an infinite number of pages and Rendall took this as a challenge. However, Rendall also believed in keeping his mind sharp, so most sections of the journal are locked behind puzzles and riddles that you'll have to solve to access the contents within. Some could consist of end of year exam questions for a specific subject while others could be complex alchemical equations or runic sequence that need to be solved. Once you have solved a puzzle, the section is permanently unlocked. The journal will, from time to time, require passing a "remedial exam" to access parts you haven't read in a while, to ensure your skills are still fresh.

While this book does not give you the ability to wield magic by itself (unless you already have it, of course), there are sections that detail rituals and potions that can unlock that ability, even on worlds where magic does not exist.
objects.title: Rendall's Diary

addons.text:
Your patron doesn't exist, they cannot exist, and yet you have sealed this pact.
You draw your powers not from another version of yourself, but from the very paradox that makes the core of your singular being, the fact that there is no other "You".
The "You" in this very moment is the only "You" that exists, there are no alternate or future selves for you to commune with and draw on.

The origin of this power is twofold, you let your future possibilities  collapse into the singularity of the present and consume the cast-of past that more standard temporal beings leave behind each time they leave the current "now" for the next one.
addons.title: Patron Paradox

objects.text:
Through whatever circumstance has led you here, from inheriting the Book from a recently dead and distant relative, or merely praying for assistance and it falling into your lap, the result is the same. You now possess the Black Book, an ancient tome filled with rituals and spells, including an easy-to-perform ritual to invoke the name of and hold court with the entity connected to the Black Book, that being… You?

To be specific, it is an alternate version of you, one much more powerful than you are now. Be it a Creator God, a Primordial Eldritch Horror, or merely just you from the far-flung future, you may choose the nature of this being, so long as it is inherently or reasonably more powerful than you. The Book will allow you to commune with them and enter a sort of contract with them as your Patron, similar to that of a Warlock.

The powers and spells the Book can provide you can vary slightly depending on the type of being your Patron is, but each of them generally revolve around the core ideas and concepts that make up you and your Patron. From a person who spends most of their time with their head in the clouds being able to interact or travel through dreams, a person who deeply cares for their appearance draining the youth of another to preserve their own. Whatever the case, the Black Book will suit the core essential ideas that represent you to a T. With enough practical experience and good rapport with your Patron, you could crudely influence the behavior or tendencies of a city with your power.

Of course, almost none of these powers are free unless the Patron themselves decide to cover it for you. Every spell has its cost, beyond the basic fundamentals like stealing someone's soul or communicating with your Patron, which is free so long as you don't get on their bad side. From fulfilling missions given to you by your Patron, siphoning hours from your lifespan, taking the soul of another, to giving up the thing you cherish most. Greater powers and spells have greater and more personal costs. The price is often known or recorded in the Book, but special favors may have equally special requests or prices in exchange. 

A word of caution to this slippery slope you take, however. This being may be a version of you and does hold most, or maybe even all of your qualities and beliefs in some way, shape, or form. Regardless, they are still your superior, separate from yourself. Treat them with the respect they deserve and serve them admirably, and you will be rewarded generously in turn.
objects.title: The Black Book of "You"

addons.text: Your collection of books now contains collected papers, theories and proposals on how to integrate supernatural principles and powers into various different jobs and industries. These are simply experiments rather than fully developed applications, and you will have to put the work in to make them practical.
addons.title: Applied Theories
Class Textbooks
addons.text:
Your books contain collections of guides and memoirs for every Class available to you. This includes treatises on specific techniques and strategies for classes of all levels, secrets of unlocking and progressing different classes. This provides you a full map of progression by those who have mastered them before, allowing you to blaze directly to your desired class.

You can also study the skills and abilities of different classes, even if you haven’t unlocked them. You can then add them to other classes you have unlocked. however you can only add a handful of cross-class skills or abilities per class, and they are only half as effective as they are on their main class.

objects.text:
You come across a large selection of books that will teach you how to quickly master any mundane non-combat skill. You can find any job, hobby or ability that can be found in your world, such as rock climbing, architecture, cardiology, or basketweaving.

You learn and comprehend the basics of these books supernaturally fast. It should only take a night of studying these books to gain a handle on a certain skill at a basic professional level. A full week of dedicated studying and practice in a specific field can make you a certified expert.

In addition, the books are filled with scrawled notes and anecdotes by masters and experts that hint at tricks they used to perform their skills and talents even better, and if you can study and synthesize all of these hints and tricks, you might even become preternaturally talented at a few specific skills.
objects.title: Skill Books

objects.text: Through what might have been a freak accident, or maybe even fate. The Book of Prophecy has fallen into your possession. It is no mere book, for it was created to catalog all things the wielder comes across in case the world is ever destroyed, so that its stored knowledge can be used to recreate the world better than it had been before. To do this endeavor, it comes with three major functions on top of its ability to restore the world. Code Scanning: By touching any creature, object, or location with the open page of the book, it will scan them and add them to a page. This captures their history, attributes, personality, likes and dislikes, etc. Such things are known as codes. Editing Codes: Once you have scanned something, you have gained the ability to edit their codes. This appears as a 3x3 grid box that, over time, will grow to a 3x4 then 4x4 grid. With this box, you can add or remove codes, causing whatever you've edited to either change, weaken, or be strengthened. This can be from removing illness codes to heal someone, removing an iron code from the entire iron slime species to make them into normal slime, or adding a fire code to something to give it a fire attribute. Each code removed is kept in a bank for further use. They also all take up one slot on a grid, and stacking the same code would strengthen that code. This does not allow you to alter the mind, personality, or soul of a person. You cannot Scan and Edit yourself. Guidance and Knowledge: The more codes you collect, the more interesting people you meet, and the more encounters you have will eventually lead to the book giving you hints of the future as visions shown on its page, guiding you to new encounters or meeting more people of interest. This also gives you an ever-expanding map of a location that shows people and points of interest. Once the book grows strong enough, you will be able to teleport to places scanned in the book. Small objects that can fit through the open book, such as weapons or food, can be manifested from their code without needing any other power to do it, and you can return them the same way when you don't need to use them. You can also scan recipes of all objects and use the codes to reproduce such objects or modify them. Be warned: the book is not indestructible and can be destroyed. While only you can use the book, it can be stolen, so be sure to never let your guard down. Even if the world is not destroyed, should you have something like a pocket dimension, your own planet, or a power centered on created, you could bring everything you have recorded back into existence using these codes.
objects.title: Book of Prophecy (Avalon Code)

addons.text:
Your Grimoire has created a special spell upon coming into contact with your Archive. Now, if it is simply to learn, you do not need to go into your mindscape to read or experiment with your powers. By opening your Grimoire, it will write instructions on how to learn or use spells, blueprints, techniques, and other powers while unconsciously feeding the steps into your head to help you learn without actually practicing yourself.

The speed at which you learn this way is as fast as if you were truly dedicating several hours a day to studying. Once you have mastered that thing, a new entry will appear in your Grimoire, allowing you to either learn the next step or something completely different.

This only teaches you the technical aspects—it won’t physically train you or increase your energy, for example, as you're not physically training. It also won’t magically create items or other things you would need to build using blueprints.
addons.title: Speed Reading

objects.text: Grimoires are special books made of mana that greatly enhance the owners' magical capabilities, enabling them to use more complex magic. These books also serve as written records of the owners' spells. Most of a grimoire's pages are empty at first; as a grimoire owner grows and develops as a person, the grimoire grows and develops with them, and new magic spells are inscribed into the book, filling the blank pages.
objects.title: Grimoire (Black Clover)

addons.text: One of the most important features of the book is the guardians who serve to protect it. With this, you gain the Guardian Beast of the Sun – Keroberos. Keroberos is a physical protector and mentor to those who would lay claim to the title of Cardcaptor, serving to teach and explain the various mechanics and features of the Clow Cards. While his true form is a fully grown winged lion, Keroberos is capable of taking more subtle diminutive forms such as a common cat, or plush toy. As the representation of the Immortal Sun Keroberos represents the Western Magic within the Clow Cards and oversees the The Light, The Firey, and The Earthy—and their subordinate cards—and can with a Cardcaptor’s permission command them in battle. Note: You may if you wish take Spinel Sun instead as the Guardian of the Sun
addons.title: Keroberos

addons.text: Yue is the Spiritual protector, and final judge of those who would lay claim to the title of Cardcaptor, deciding if the wielder is truly worthy to be Master of the Clow. While his true form is akin to that of an angel in white, Yue is capable of taking on the more subtle form of an ordinary human. As the Child of Luna, Yue represents the Eastern Magic within the Clow Cards, and oversees The Dark, the Watery, and the Windy—along with all of their subordinate cards—and can with the Cardcaptor’s permission command them in battle if needed. Note: You may if you wish take Ruby Moon as the Guardian of the Moon instead.
addons.title: Yue

objects.text:
The Book of Clow is a storage and containment device for the eponymous Clow Cards, a set of 52 magical cards designed and created to unify Eastern and Western magic’s, each with their own spirit inside possessing its own special abilities. The Book keeps the Cards securely sealed away in a dormant state, until released from their slumber within by the small ornate key attached.

Unlocking the seal, and opening the book awakens the cards within, unleashing them into the world—though with luck you may be able to keep hold of one. To fully master the powers of the Clow Cards, you will need to track them down, defeat them, and seal them with the power of the Sealing Wand. Each spirit is full of curiosity and mischief, causing chaos from playfulness more than malice.

The Sealing Wand is the literal key to the Book of Clow, and by itself an effective magical focus. It adjusts its shape and form to suit your needs, while also being capable of retaking the form of the key required to lock and unlock the Book. The Wand is designed to channel the powers of the Clow Cards safely, and reliably.

Over time, the Book, the Key and the Cards within will evolve to better align with the user's magic and personality. Through practice and experience, the wielder may even manage to craft new cards.
objects.title: Book of Clow (Cardcaptor Sakura)

addons.text:
Thanks to your connection with the Book of Shadows and the generations of witches who have protected it, by reciting the Dominus Trinus spell, you have awakened the Power of Three within yourself.

This power not only amplifies your spells, potions, and active abilities, but also grants you three exceptional gifts:

-Telekinesis: The ability to move objects and beings with the mind. This was Prue Halliwell’s primary power as a witch, which she could channel through her eyes or hand gestures.

-Molecular Immobilization: more commonly referred to as freezing, is the ability to slow down molecules to the point where they move so slowly that objects and people appear completely motionless, simulating the stoppage of time. This is Piper Halliwell’s primary power, which she channels through her hands.

-Premonition: The ability to perceive events from the past, present, or future. This is Phoebe Halliwell’s primary Wiccan power. It also allows the creation of psychic links, enabling you to receive, share, or trigger visions with other psychics.

These abilities, once held by the Halliwell sisters and their ancestor Melinda Warren, have now been passed down to you—along with the potential to evolve them into advanced forms or unlock derivative sub-powers such as Telematerialization, Molecular Combustion, and Astral Premonition.

Additionally, the Power of Three grants you a rare trait: extraordinary resistance to physical and magical damage, allowing you to survive attacks that would otherwise be fatal.
addons.title: Three Together as One

addons.text:
"To my three beautiful girls. May this give you the light to find the shadows. The power of three will set you free."

The Book of Shadows will become a magical legacy passed down to your descendants, from generation to generation within your family, just as it once did with the Warren Line of Witches.

Furthermore, should your descendants ever need it, they will inherit the Power of Three, just as the Halliwell sisters did. This power will guide them on their own journeys, just as it once guided you.

Note: If you wish, you may choose Melinda Warren to be one of your ancestors, either by direct bloodline or magical adoption (for example, if Melinda adopted one of your ancestors into her lineage).

By being part of her line—by blood or adoption—you will be able to cast the Call Upon Our Ancestors spell. This spell invokes the collective power of every witch in the Warren line to vanquish a greater threat. When recited, the witches will respond to your call and fight by your side.
addons.title: Forever Charmed

objects.text:
"The Book will grow as you grow. Sometimes you'll add to it, and sometimes it teaches you."

You are now the guardian of the Book of Shadows, a magical tome created by Melinda Warren in the 17th century and passed down through generations within the Warren witch lineage; and although you may not be a member of this family, the Book has recognized you as its new and rightful owner.

This Book holds the magical knowledge accumulated over the centuries; the spells it contains are accessible to any magical being, and as long as you possess magic, you will be able to cast them without difficulty, and each one comes with its respective formula, the required intention, and the precise components needed to ensure its proper execution.

In addition to spells, the Book also offers records and detailed descriptions of various magical entities, such as demons, dark witches, and other evil creatures; each of these entries includes information on how to identify them, as well as their weaknesses; spells, rituals, and potion recipes specifically designed to combat, seal, or even banish them.

Finally, the Book of Shadows cannot be touched by evil, thanks to the shielding and sensing powers with which it was blessed; because of this, the Book cannot be opened unless it is in the possession of you, good magical beings, or non-magical mortals; similarly, evil creatures such as demons cannot even approach the Book or the person holding it without triggering its defensive properties.

Note: Using magic from the Book for personal gain will backfire. Spells must be cast with pure intentions, as selfish motives will distort the outcomes and may result in unexpected—and potentially dangerous—consequences.
objects.title: The Book of Shadows (Charmed)

addons.text:
With your grasp, the Necronomicon has transformed into the Lovebound Grimoire, an otherworldly tome brimming with forbidden knowledge and secrets with the purpose of  guiding you to summon and date eldritch gods. Its boundless pages now hold tips, guidance, and knowledge on how to best establish relationships with these enigmatic beings.

(Note:  The Lovebound Grimoire retains all previous functions and knowledge from the Necronomicon, this just updates it's contents.)
addons.title: The Lovebound Grimoire

objects.text:
You are the possessor of an alternate dimensional grimoire known as the True Necronomicon, a sentient and boundless tome of occult knowledge. With its pages continually expanding, it serves as a repository for an ever-growing wealth of esoteric wisdom. Unlike the limited version of it's copies, this book grants you the ability to inscribe new laws into the fabric of reality. The intricate rituals within invoke the power of the Eldritch, enabling you to shape and redefine the very nature of the world you inhabit.

While the True Necronomicon's form and size can adapt to suit your needs, it typically manifests as a weighty tome. Although the Necronomicon lacks an index or search feature, its sentience compensates for this limitation. Its inherent understanding of your intentions ensures that you are directed to the precise information you desire or need at any given moment. It also possesses a passive perception filter that protects readers from descending into complete insanity while delving into its unfathomable depths. It's worth noting, however, that this filter applies universally, and the book contains the works of myriad authors in an array of languages, including many that are non-human. 

Through highlighting certain words, the Necronomicon can communicates directly with you, ensuring that you always find the relevant knowledge or guidance you require. This unique communication method enhances your interaction with the tome, enabling a more seamless and efficient exploration of its boundless contents.

Should you desire, the True Necronomicon can assimilate other spellbooks, tomes of lore, and occult knowledge, incorporating their contents into its ever-expanding compendium.
objects.title: The Necronomicon (Cthulhu Mythos)
Nether Scrolls (D&D)
objects.text:
The Nether Scrolls are among the most influential magical artifacts in the world of Toril. Originally known as the Golden Skins of the World Serpent, they were created around -30,000 DR by a secret society of the creator races known as the Ba'etith. The discovery of a complete set of these scrolls helped trigger the rise of the Netheril empire. Most importantly they provided the knowledge by which the arcanists were able to create mass-produced magic items and sever mountaintops to construct Netheril's iconic flying cities.

Composed of 50 individual sheets of magically flexible gold and platinum, these completely indestructible scrolls do not grant direct magical power; rather they serve as an exhaustive, adaptive codex of fundamental magical theory. As a reader studies them, the shimmering silver text dynamically alters and reforms, revealing deeper layers of infinite arcane knowledge that adapt directly to the user's evolving mystical comprehension.

The text is organized into five distinct chapters, each containing ten individual scrolls focused on a foundational pillar of the Art. The first chapter, Arcanus Fundare, establishes the absolute foundations of magic and spellcraft. It is followed by Magicus Creare, which covers the creation of magical items, and Maior Creare, which details the engineering of complex constructs and golems. The final two chapters are Planus Mechanus, an exhaustive study of planar mechanics, and Ars Factum, a section that outlines the theoretical creation of artifacts (unique, exceptionally powerful magic items that are nearly indestructible except through specific, obscure methods). Fully mastering even a single chapter requires years of rigorous study but rewards the reader with peerless, transformative arcane efficiency and knowledge. Unlike the originals reading your set of Nether scrolls unshielded will not cause you to go insane, nor will prolonged study drive you to extreme obsession, paranoia, or dangerous hubris. No matter how your fundamental understanding of reality is altered.

Finally your set of Nether scrolls is adaptive to both the universe that you are in, and the magical powers that you select. Traveling to a new universe simply expands the knowledge you have access to.

objects.title: Books of Stat Increases (D&D/Pathfinder)
objects.text:
You gain a complete collection of attribute increasing manuals from the world of Dungeons & Dragons and the world of Pathfinder.

Within this collection you will find the following:

Manual of Gainful Exercise (Strength)
Manual of Quickness of Action (Dexterity)
Manual of Bodily Health (Constitution)
Tome of Clear Thought (Intelligence)
Tome of Understanding (Wisdom)
Tome of Leadership and Influence (Charisma)

These tomes allow you to increase the relevant stat by 2 points after 48 hours of study over a period of a week or less based on your learning speed. You will be treated as having the normal for each stat that a normal human adult has, which is 10, despite what other powers you possess that would raise your attributes. After you have used each book you will be unable to use them for one month, however this cooldown will increase greatly with each additional use. Once your attributes have passed 18 you will find the cooldown to increase exponentially, to the point where you will need to wait one or more years before being able to reuse them.

addons.text:
Your ability to "perceive death" with your Mystic Eyes has granted you the function of the Shinigami Eyes, allowing you to see people's name & lifespan (supposing you don't intervene), by looking at their unobstructed face. This has obvious utility to a Death Note user.

Notably, you don't have to give up half your lifespan for these; you didn't make a deal with a Shinigami for them, after all. For this same reason, you wouldn't have to renegotiate for them if you forfeited ownership of the Death Note and then retrieved it, like Misa did; it's just part of having your Mystic Eyes combined with the Death Note.
addons.title: Shinigami Eyes (Death Note)

addons.text:
As the personification of Death itself, the true power of the Death Note is revealed to you, unshackled from its limitations.

Manifesting as a plain tome with no distinguishing features, the Book possesses seemingly endless pages despite being small enough to comfortably hold in one hand. Additionally, it can take the shape of any book or other object meant to hold written information you desire.

Each page matches up with one thing in existence, from mortals and gods to the very stars or even conceptual entities themselves. Upon that is inscribed the name and destined death of that being, listing where, when, and how they die, as well as any other relevant information. Whenever you open the Book with something in mind, it automatically opens to their entry.

At will you may rewrite any entry within the Book, changing the details of their death however you see fit. You can command a god to drop dead instantly, prevent a mortal from dying, or even erase all the details of an entry entirely and render the subject unable to die. Lastly, as you are the personification of Death you naturally do not need to know the face of someone to kill them.
addons.title: Book of Death

objects.text:
The Death Note is a supernatural notebook owned by the Shinigami, which has the ability to kill anyone whose name is written in it. It grants the user the power to determine the exact time, date and cause of death of any individual. Simply by writing the name of the intended victim and visualizing their face, the user is able to instantly kill that person. The Death Note also contains instructions for how to use it, as well as various rules and limitations that the user must follow in order to successfully manipulate the fates of others.

The rules are:

-The human whose name is written in this note shall die.
-This note will not take effect unless the writer has the person's face in their mind when writing his/her name. Therefore, people sharing the same name will not be affected.
-If the cause of death is written within the next 40 seconds of writing the person's name, it will happen.
-If the cause of death is not specified, the person will simply die of a heart attack.
-After writing the cause of death, details of the death should be written in the next 6 minutes and 40 seconds.
objects.title: Death Note (Death Note)

objects.text:
Only those who have the holy blood of Naga may call upon her power. Those who have her blessings feel empowered by merely have the tome in their direct posession, experiencing a doubling of their skill in landing regular and critical attacks, combat speed, and both physical and magical defenses. Directly calling on the tome's power will invoke a golden visage of Naga's dragon form that will smite the targeted opponent with her divine might. This attack will always be performed at full potency, regardless of magical effects an opponent may use to diminish the effect of magic used on them. Against other dragons, this magic will be three times as effective.

If you were a Divine Dragon yourself, this tome would instead transform into being your own tome—with it's appearance and effects changing depending on what kind of dragon you are. It would also be able to be used by anyone you give your blood to, with the ability to potentially possess them.
objects.title: Naga's Tome (Fire Emblem)

objects.text:
The Hero Books are a series of 100 superhero comic books created by Scott Weller. When held by individuals with strong imaginations—known as Readers—and when the name of the titular Hero Book superhero is spoken aloud, the superhero is summoned into the real world. Those without imagination cannot summon Heroes. In order for a Hero to return to their Hero Book, the Reader must command them to “Return,” or the Hero must become fully exhausted of their power. When summoned, the Reader and the Hero are psychically linked, allowing the Reader to command the Hero to perform any action as long as their voice can reach them, regardless of the Hero’s personal wishes. However, Heroes are still capable of acting independently when not given direct commands.

Every Hero Book Hero possesses a special ability known as Comicalize, which requires the Reader to call out, “Comicalize! (Attack Name)!” These attacks are powerful and often highly exaggerated, such as Sylph becoming a massive tornado or Sugar Sugar Pang Pang transforming an airplane into a giant fruit. However, using Comicalize consumes a significant amount of the Reader’s imagination, often leaving them exhausted and causing the Hero to return to their Hero Book. Some Readers, such as Mike and Scott, possess imagination strong enough to create entirely new Comicalize abilities on the spot, a technique known as Create Comicalize.

While most Readers can summon only one Hero at a time, certain individuals are capable of summoning multiple Heroes simultaneously, though doing so is extremely taxing. For example, Mike once managed to summon five Heroes at once—an unprecedented feat—but was left exhausted for an extended period afterward. Summoning Super Scott is especially difficult, as he is oppressed by the core function of his own existential being, making him resistant to being called forth.

Heroes can also be used for evil purposes if their Readers are morally corrupt, as a Hero’s core function is to obey the commands of their original Reader. If another Reader takes possession of a Hero Book while the Hero is already summoned, the original Reader may still issue commands to that Hero. However, if the other Reader orders the Hero to “Return,” ownership of the Hero reverts to them.

The currently known Heroes include: Gravity, Great Finger, Crying Man, Black Knight, Mummy Girl, Lucky, Sparkules, Disco Duo, Humming Birdman, Mr. Justice, Jelly King, Professor Z, Super Scott, Mag B, Ginseng Man, Toxo, Locust, Sylph, Firehead, Leora, Chameli, Mist, 25 Cent, Hairy Harry, Kayoh, Bit Dave, Kung-Fu 7, and Carrie.

Each time you select this option, you receive 10 Hero Books, with each subsequent selection granting an additional 10, up to the full collection of 100 Hero Books.
objects.title: Hero Books (Hero Inside)

objects.text:
Congratulations, you are now the sole and exclusive owner of the Urban Legends Chronicles, an anomalous book governed by three core resources: Lifespan, Legend Points, and Good/Evil Points.

Lifespan, unlike the original, is not your natural life but a stored reserve of extra life that you can use. It is capped at 100 and won't decrease unless you die. If you die, the book automatically expends one day of Lifespan to revive you. However, if your reserve ever reaches zero, you will die as normal. You begin with 1000 Legend Points.

Legend Points are accumulated by spreading and reinforcing the presence of your creations, urban legends that grow stronger the more they are feared, believed, or talked about. These points act as your primary currency, allowing you to create new entities, objects, or phenomena, with more powerful or complex creations demanding a greater cost. They can also be used to restore your Lifespan, creating a loop to sustain your continued existence.

Good and Evil Points are generated through the manipulation of karma, typically via impactful actions, often involving harm or death carried out either by you or indirectly through your creations. These points can be used to enhance your own spiritual abilities, which may extend to physical augmentation or other supernatural effects, as well as to strengthen your creations or even revive those that have been destroyed. The book also records the consequences of your creations’ actions on their individual pages.

The scope of your creations is extremely broad. Your urban legends could, for example, create a series of eyes in cracks in the walls and similar spaces to watch those who commit abusive acts in a relationship, driving them mad and into a heart-attack through growing dread. You could create a vengeful ghost that can make deals with people, creating a supernatural website that spreads through rumors, and appears at midnight, allowing someone to name a person that has harmed them to summon the vengeful ghost to make a deal. The only limit to how strong your creations are depends on how many Legend Points you have.

These creations can be bound by rules and costs of your choosing, which you may adjust for instance, replacing a soul-binding punishment with a more measured exchange like draining a small amount of lifespans of the victim to satisfy the cost part.

Despite the risks inherent in dealing with supernatural beings, your creations are absolutely loyal. They cannot betray you under any circumstance, always retain a baseline level of affection regardless of your treatment, and remain permanently linked to you. You are always aware of their status and emotional state, and they can only be summoned through a ritual exclusive to you.

The book itself is bound to you alone it cannot be stolen, copied, or used by others. While its primary uses are understood, there are indications that additional functions and deeper mechanics exist within, it is likely that its full potential has yet to be fully uncovered.
objects.title: Urban Legends Chronicles (I Created an Urban Legend)

objects.text: You've discovered a remarkable book. By writing your experiences within its pages, you accrue experience points (exp). The more unique the experience, the greater the exp reward. Repeated experiences grant diminishing exp returns. You can then invest these exp points into acquiring [Experiences]. The more exp you invest, the more potent the [Experience] becomes. For example, you can invest some exp to gain the [Experiences] of a swordsman who trained and master the blade. Or you can invest some exp to gain the [Experiences] of a doctor, whose understanding of the human body is second to none. These experiences will also alter your body to a degree, making it appear as if you truly experienced these [Experiences], giving you the muscles of a swordsman or the precision of a doctor.
objects.title: Book of Experience (I Stack Experience Through Writing Books)

objects.text:
You have come into possession of one of the Blasphamy Slates, formed from the remains of either the Primordial God Almighty or the Ancient Sun God. These take the form of a grey-ish stone slate engraved with highly information-dense language. This language is the origin of all other languages, and thus, anyone can understand the writings on the slates.

The blasphemy slates contain detailed knowledge of the pathways system, including all the formulas and rituals for all 22 pathways. They also include era-appropriate substitute ingredients where possible, as some ingredients changed names or went extinct over time.

The blasphemy slate can impose a worldwide order, reducing the effectiveness of outer gods and other forms of otherworldly ‘’invaders’’ while weakening them. You can use this to briefly cut off outer gods from interfering with the world.

The Blasphemy Slates also possess a connection to the Chaos Sea Sefirot, which beyonders of the pathways under the Chaos Sea can use to enhance their powers and gain preliminary control over the Chaos Sea, which significantly increases their chances of becoming a Great Old One.
objects.title: Blasphemy Slate (Lord of the Mysteries)

objects.text:
The Trunsoest Brass Book appears like a weighty tome bound in thin silvery-brass sheets. It's pages are similarly made of brass, and the words within are colored like mercury. You are the owner of the artifact, meaning it is permanently bound to you. Despite its appearance, the book is indestructible and can change form to suit the owner. 

The first half of the book is filled with underlying rules of [Order]. Depending on your location, it describes unique environmental conditions and rules of your location, as well as a detailed overview of laws in the current area you reside in. This analysis is conceptual, so factors such as "cultural norms" and "law of the jungle" will be accounted for when providing information.

The second half is blank, allowing for the user to write [Laws]. An owner of the book may declare a [Law] by writing within the book or speaking out loud while in the book's vicinity. The more specific the [Law], the more effective it is. A [Law] can either have a defined punishment or make the action impossible to perform for others besides you. You can choose which effect occurs, and the effective radius for your [Laws] is a large city.

[Laws] are conceptual in nature. For example, you could seal teleportation with "Teleportation is forbidden!", or stop conceptual power theft with "Acts of theft are prohibited!" When facing beings of the same power level as you, general [Laws] such as "ability use is forbidden" are nearly impossible to apply. More specific [Laws] such as forbidding a single ability can take effect for minutes. Similarly, punishments for violating a [Law] are only partially imposed similar strength beings and may be disregarded completely if the [Law] is too broad.

If you run out of pages, you can clear the 2nd half of the book by declaring "All the following laws are ineffective." This is automatically done if the [Laws] you write are contradictory in nature.
objects.title: Trunsoest Brass Book (Lord of the Mysteries)

objects.text:
Also called the Immemorial Celestial Book, it is a book capable of forming a spiritual contract or blood bond with any entity it establishes one with. It has no limit on the number of entities you can bind and turn into your personal summons, transforming the entity into a Contracted Beast. It only works if the entity submits to your will by any possible means.

In addition to this, you will be able to develop an Inherent Ability and Guardian Beast of your own. Both gifts will grow and evolve at the same time as the bearer of the Grimoire grows. The initial quality of these gifts is directly proportional to the quality of the bearer’s soul.

Your initial rank is level 1 and can only be improved through constant use of the Grimoire, experience in real combat, meditation, cultivation of any type of supernatural energy, and personal experiences through records or feats that you consider extraordinary and occur rarely in your daily life. All of this condenses into Experience. For each level the Grimoire improves, you will gain another Inherent Ability and Guardian Beast. Level 9 is the maximum rank.

An Inherent Ability can be of any type of power with active or passive effects. From a classic elemental manipulation power to a divine power capable of becoming omnipotent. It can also perform synergy or fusion between multiple Inherent Abilities, resulting in a completely new one. These will count as another Inherent Ability in your repertoire of powers. Even if a synergy or fusion attempt fails, your powers will remain intact but will become stronger in the process. 

Meanwhile, a Guardian Beast is a spiritual entity that is bound to both the Grimoire and your soul. It will obey any order you give. It has its own will, personality, and appearance, as well as its own Inherent Ability. They do not die, as long as the bearer is alive. They can resurrect, but depending on the power level of the entity, their resurrection time and the amount of supernatural energy required as payment will vary.

A Guardian Beast comparable to a divine being could take millennia to revive, as well as a supernatural energy amount comparable to that of a big bang or supernova. A Guardian Beast at the level of a stray dog could take minutes to revive with almost no supernatural energy.

Please note that Contracted Beasts do not share the same privileges as Guardian Beasts. However, the characteristic that they will always obey any order from the Grimoire's owner remains in effect.

Both gifts can be anything that has been revealed or hinted at in the Long Live Summon series. Alternatively, you can create your own gifts. It is compatible with any supernatural energy to maintain the functions of the Grimoire of Summoning.

Last but not least, it has its own dimensional pocket. Initially, it will be a space where only Guardian Beasts can reside and be limited to sleeping. You can also store any object as long as the storage does not exceed 3 cubic meters of space and time can still affect them.

This dimensional space also grows and evolves along with the bearer of the Grimoire of Summoning. Eventually, you could create your own universe within it in which you could also live, and even the time of the dimension relative to the outside could be different.
objects.title: Grimoire of Summoning (Long Live Summon)

objects.text:
You have gained the legendary book of Botanical Magic, the Lexica Botania. Within this tome, one shall learn the secret of how to generate mana from the creation of magical flora, from Munchdews that devour nearby leaves, to even the humble Endoflames that will burn any fuel source you give it.

This, however, is not the end of what lies with this tome, as one will learn how to infuse mana into cloth, stone, metal, and gems to create magical armor, weapons, and tools to further your arcane botany.

From Manasteel, Living stone/wood, and even a portal to Alfheim, these are but a few of the wonders that Botanical magic is capable of, and that you may continue to expand beyond even what the Lexica Botania shows.

(Note that you may use the knowledge from addon mods such as mythical botany and botanic additions, so long as they remain addons to Botania.)
objects.title: Lexica Botania (Modded Minecraft)

objects.text: You’ve obtained a page from the Book of Life, one of two books that God made during the Ten Days of Judgment. This page grants you two abilities. One allows instantaneous teleportation to a location within line-of-sight, keeping your current momentum after teleporting. The second ability of the page acts as a mystical compass of sorts, with it being retrofitted to unconsciously draw you near, and glow brighter the closer you are to something you currently seek.
objects.title: Page from the Book of Life (Neon White)

objects.text:
Blood is sound... Sounds are words... And words are power!

This is an ancient tome of profound wisdom! Supposedly, anyway. This is a book capable of using the Sealed Verses, powerful spells that Weiss is capable of casting, with a total of 8 Sealed Verses. Weiss is capable of being in incredible sync with his partner, allowing him to prepare the desired spell of his partner without even needing to hear a word. He is also able to fly and “anchor” himself to his partner, allowing his partner to not have to worry about losing him by running too fast.

It takes about 1 minute and 20 seconds before his reserves are filled. Do beware, though, that if he is continuously used over long periods of time, he can risk permanent damage or worse.

Weiss is also capable of assigning a word to something within your possessions (an object, a weapon, a spell or even yourself). You can enhance the target with the propriety of the word applied. The effects are often minor but are powerful advantages. He is only capable of placing two words on most things, although he can place up to four on people.

It is important to note that Weiss IS his own person. He was originally a man who had his Gestalt, or soul in simpler terms, implanted into the tome. He can be prideful, dramatic, and grouchy. He possesses a sharp tongue and an inflated ego. He is often impatient, with a habit of insulting others. Although he would proclaim otherwise, he is a caring person who enjoys looking after people.

Within his pages holds his memory, thoughts, and feelings. It is all in the Angelic language, though, so reading it would be a tough job. Another important thing is that he isn’t just a magical tome; he’s more akin to magitech, the result of science and magic used in conjunction.
objects.title: Grimoire Weiss (NieR: Replicant)

objects.text:
You have come into possession of the complete set of Esoteric Texts; the secret scrolls and forbidden manuals that contain the deepest, most dangerous techniques of the shinobi, the Ashina style, the Prosthetic Arts, the Senpou Temple monks, and the ancient Mushin techniques of the Divine Heir’s lineage.

These texts are not mere books. Through rigorous study and mastery of their techniques, they can turn even the most normal and powerless of people into superhuman living weapons that match and defeat even the likes of Isshin and Owl at the peak of their power. Though for an average person, it might take years if not decades of training.

if you have already purchased the arts in this book, you will reach true mastery in the art or arts you bought in record time.
objects.title: Esoteric Texts (Sekiro)

objects.text: "Every Holocron is unique, based on the teachings held inside. You have to hear what it's trying to tell you before it will open." ―Luke Skywalker Holocrons are devices used to store information by force users that could fit in the palm of someone's hand and fit a decade's worth of information inside. Over the years, many Jedi have made thousands of Holocrons. However, one Holocron has more information about the Jedi than any other. The oldest Holocron that has been passed from Jedi Master to Jedi Master—the Great Holocron. Inside, this Holocron contains everything a Jedi would need to become a master, from lightsaber training to obscure uses of the Force. The Holocron has various masters that can help guide you to becoming a better Jedi, including but not limited to: Obi-Wan Kenobi, Yoda, Dooku, Mace Windu, and Qui-Gon Jinn, to name a few. Once you become more skilled in the Force, more is unlocked in the Holocron as it teaches you more about the Light Side of the Force.
objects.title: Great Holocron (Star Wars)

objects.text: "All that we know, we shall share freely with you. All we ask in return is that you keep an open mind, and use this knowledge for the benefit of only one being: yourself. It is not out of greed that we ask this of you, but out of respect. Of all those who might have stumbled upon this device, no one is more deserving of our knowledge than you." When the Sith were first founded, they created a Holocron that held all the knowledge of the Sith. A repository of wisdom and dark secrets of the force. It was passed down through the generations of Sith Lords, gaining more knowledge as those who possessed it poured everything they knew into the Holocron. This Holocron holds secrets of the Sith that few others know and holds guardians of various Sith Lords through history, including but not limited to: Ajunta Pall, Naga Sadow, Darth Bane, Darth Revan, and Sidious, to name a few of the more prominent Sith to be in possession and inscribe themselves into the Holocron. The Holocron contains information about the entire Sith, from its start to its fall, all knowledge that the Sith has come to learn through training on the Dark Side. From Sith Alchemy and the lost lore of the Dark Side to the basics of lightsaber training.
objects.title: Telos Holocron (Star Wars)

objects.text:
This album of infinite pages contains every Battle Sticker from Paper Mario Sticker Star, including all of their variations. By selecting one of them, you can choose to gain its associated powers and perform the action Mario would take in the game. A jump sticker will give you his jumping ability to leap right above a target’s head, or over any obstacle, and stomp on your foes with crushing force. A hammer sticker will spawn a hammer out of nowhere that you can swing with ease. A fire flower sticker will give you pyrokinesis, etc.

These are only temporarily for whatever purpose you need them for, and the kind of stickers you have are always random. But on the brightside, you have multiple copies of each sticker. Three at minimum and ten at most, and the album refills with new ones once a page of them has been used up.

You also have a few special stickers called “Things”, which allow you to summon mundane items infused with Toon Force. A simple fan that can generate the winds of a hurricane, air conditioner that can freeze the landscape, baseball bat to knock someone into the stratosphere, and a ball to knock down mountains like bowling pins are only some of the many things they’re capable of.

As long as you have possession of the album, it forms a link with your mind, allowing you to use its functions telepathically should you need to, or are in a pinch.
objects.title: Sticker Album (Super Mario)

objects.text:
The Words of God are indestructible clay tablets inscribed by Metatron, containing the divine blueprint of creation as spoken by God Himself. They grant no strength or supernatural powers, only knowledge so profound that it can reshape reality itself.

Each tablet—such as the Demon Tablet, Angel Tablet, or Leviathan Tablet—reveals truths tied to a specific facet of existence, including life, death, time, space, and the delicate balance between chaos and order. The power of the tablets lies in the knowledge and rituals they provide, not in granting direct abilities.

For example, the Demon Tablet offers insight into demonic entities, allowing you to seal hell, create a new one, banish demons en masse, or strip them of their powers. The Angel Tablet provides knowledge to sever celestial connections to Heaven, empower or weaken angels, or rewrite the laws of divine intervention. Similarly, the Leviathan Tablet reveals ways to control, neutralize, or erase primordial forces of chaos.

However, the tablets are not without danger as while their knowledge can be understood and used by anyone capable, they also run the risk of learning knowledge dangerous to the human mind. Misuse or misinterpretation can also result in catastrophic consequences, destabilizing reality or unleashing forces beyond control.
objects.title: Words of God (Supernatural)

objects.text: An Elder Scroll, a powerful artifact of immense power. Though it may take the form of a scroll and hold the name of one, it is no mere scroll, instead being a fragment of creation from outside time and space. The Elder Scrolls record past and future events within themselves, and simultaneously do not exist yet have always existed. Reading an Elder Scroll is a dangerous and difficult endeavor, which can leave the reader blind or driven to madness in the best scenarios, but the insights into the inner workings of reality could be a major boon to those willing to risk it. Though they can be used to make prophecies, this is but a fragment of their full power.
objects.title: Elder Scroll (The Elder Scrolls)

objects.text:
Now in your hands lie two of Ancient Egypt’s greatest treasures: the Golden Book of the Living and the Black Book of the Dead. Typically, each book requires a unique puzzle box to serve as a key to open them; however, while in your hands, each book springs open effortlessly.

The Golden Book of the Living, also known as the Golden Book of Amun-Ra, is made of pure gold. Its pages contain ancient spells and incantations designed to combat and destroy demons, the undead, and all manner of dark creatures and abominations of the Underworld.

The Black Book of the Dead is made of pure obsidian. It also holds ancient spells and incantations, but instead of spells focusing on light and life, it holds those that resurrect the dead, summon dark creatures, and control various abominations of the Underworld.

Though each appears to consist of only a few pages, these books contain nearly limitless knowledge in their respective fields. They possess a limited sentience, with their pages always displaying the most appropriate magic to respond to any given situation.
objects.title: The Books of the Living and the Dead (The Mummy)

addons.text:
As a person with actual magical aptitude, you can unleash even more of Prelati’s Spellbook’s power with even greater ease.

Most fundamentally, you and the spellbook can supplement each others’ magical energy when needed. As such, you can draw from the book’s energy supply to power your own Magecraft, allowing you to cast well beyond your means. Likewise, your own magical energy can assist the tome in circumstances where it would normally need to divert its power away from its summons, allowing it to regenerate from nearly any damage without sacrificing your existing creatures. 

More notable, however, are the spells you can draw from the book as a proper Magus. You are capable of rituals that allow you to craft and control horrors independent of outside magical energy, twisted approximations of true lifeforms which can sustain and even propagate themselves when cut off from your power, provided they manage to meet their needs as living things. Beyond that, instead of merely summoning creatures from the deep, you can, with great preparation and effort, summon forth the deep itself to paint over the world with a landscape of madness that produces horrors without end, though all such horrors will dissolve if their origin point is destroyed.

At your grandest, you could even weave those two arts together, giving you a truly infinitesimal chance of shaping your summoned deep into an autonomous world-thing, which independently grows and twists the world into the deep while endlessly spawning lesser true horrors, not too dissimilar from true Outer Gods from beyond the universe. Though even beginning to control such a being would be utterly beyond you, even with the assistance of something on the level of a Holy Grail.
addons.title: Scholar of Madness

addons.text:
With your expertise as an Alchemist, you can draw new capabilities from your grimoire.

Chiefly, you have learned how to manufacture specialized horrors that function as semi-autonomous summoning mystic codes. Though these living mystic codes may not be able to sustain as many creatures as Prelati’s Spellbook itself, or summon them as quickly, they can be used to mitigate the grimoire’s primary weakness. 

By allocating your many thought processes among both the spellbook and your summoning mystic codes you can form a redundant summoning network, which prevents your horrors from dissolving should the book ever take damage. You could even focus your mental faculties on fewer living mystic codes to increase their individual effectiveness, though doing so would sacrifice some of your network’s redundancy.

In addition to that, you can combine the tome’s eldritch summoning with your other alchemic skills, be it otherwise enhancing your creatures with your manufactured items, or employing their alien flesh and maddening geometries for your own body modifications and creations.

Keeping with that, you could even integrate Prelati’s Spellbook itself into your body, massively enhancing both its summoning capabilities and your ability to modify the resulting creatures. Though such a fusion would likely come at great risk to your sanity.
addons.title: Artifice of the Deep

objects.text:
You have acquired the vile grimoire penned by the 15th-century magus François Prelati, who, in a drug-fueled stupor, somehow connected the tome to an Outer God.

The book itself is both a powerful Mystic Code and a monster that independently produces a large amount of magical energy.

Just with its own supply of magical energy, the spellbook can be used to summon a near endless supply of Eldritch Horrors, with each of them being more than capable of reducing an ordinary human to chunks, at the bare minimum. Even stronger creatures can be summoned with sufficient preparation and even sacrifices. Even the corpses of the summoned horrors themselves can be used as sacrifices to enhance the book's powers, allowing you to seamlessly revive and even increase your army’s numbers as long as their corpses remain.

The greatest weakness of the spellbook’s summons is their need to receive a constant, if minimal, supply of magical energy to sustain themselves. Should the book’s energy be diverted for any other purpose, such as regenerating the book in the event it sustains damage, the summoned horrors will immediately dissolve into pools of gore.

You do not need any kind of magical inclination to use Prelati’s Spellbook’s power, since it’s an independent creature that supplies its own magical energy and even does all the heavy lifting for casting the spells themselves. The downside of this independence is that the book can be put to sleep or otherwise disabled, reducing it to a mere compendium of eldritch spells and curses. In such a case, you might need to rely on one of the many grisly rituals recorded in the book, should you lack other means to secure the magical energy needed to jump-start the grimoire.
objects.title: Prelati's Spellbook (Type-Moon)

addons.text:
The Book of Grudges now allows you to take revenge not only for your own grievances, but also for those of others. All you need to do is know about it, sympathize with the victim, and be someone who would also be offended by a similar action.

However, with this approach, the amount of information available will be halved. But over time, more will become available.

At the same time, if you find yourself in a world where there are dwarves, you will be able to fully avenge their grievances without penalties. And the Book of Grudges itself will persistently whisper to you about the atrocities committed against them and point out those responsible.
addons.title: F***g Elves!

objects.text:
You get your own Book of Grievances, similar to those that are so popular among dwarves and are an important part of their culture and history. But your book is special and has its own magical power.

This book is written in your blood (or the inscriptions can be burned out by any energy taken from you), which creates a strong connection with what is written. Only you will be able to make entries and only you will be able to delete them.

By writing down any atrocity, crime, betrayal, deception or neglect committed against you, you not only consolidate a blood commitment to revenge, but you can also get additional information that your Book of Grievances will reveal to you. In the form of mental images upon re-reading, or in the form of additional notes that appeared during writing, this information will give you additional information that will allow you to find out the names of those who are behind the atrocities, no matter how they hide and no matter what intrigues they undertake. This is especially true if their hands are stained with your blood.

The longer you keep your Book of Grievances, the more knowledge will be revealed to you during recording and the more accurate the information you receive.

In a separate part, the Book will keep a list of "grudged" names, a list of your enemies whose atrocities are so severe and so numerous that just the fact of their lives will be enough to be considered the most terrible insult.

With the passage of time, the number of entries, and the grudges avenged, you can begin to discover small notes in the margins and between your entries. Thus, your Book will "whisper" to you the most effective way to take revenge and the most painful way to make your enemies regret the atrocities against you, as well as point out to you the strengths and weaknesses of your opponents, especially if they are particularly distinguished and their names are most often found among the recorded atrocities.
objects.title: Book of Grudges (Warhammer: Fantasy)

objects.text:
Nagash, the supreme lord of undeath and creator of necromancy, once wrote down all he knew about necromancy into nine books, each holding a piece of his power. Contained within were secrets to all Nagash’s knowledge and grand rituals of the necromancy and dark magics, and seeing as he was the one who created most, if not all, necromancy and holds a chokehold on dark magics within each book contains all there is to know on the subject. 

With even one of the books, the most novice practitioner of the winds of magic could become a master of the dark necromantic magics that could rival the most powerful of necromancers; perhaps if they held a modicum of talent, they could surpass even the creator of the art himself, Nagash, after years of study with all nine. 

Even if you do not use the books, just being in the presence of one boosts your magic, and should all nine be near you when you cast a spell, you shall find any magic you cast tripled in potency. As the books possess a portion of Nagash, they hold a facsimile intelligence of the lord of undeath and will record any new magic they come into contact with. They can also advise and teach the one who holds the books; however, you will not need to worry about them betraying you.

The queen of Lahmia was able to recreate the Elixir of Life and create the First Vampires using just one of the books you now possess. Reading through all nine books, you could discover the secrets to all arcane rituals Nagash invented or used, including the spells he used to raise the dead on the planet.
objects.title: Nine Books of Nagash (Warhammer: Fantasy)

rows.title: Book Objects of Power
rows.titleText: Note: All non-consumable Objects of Powers can be transferred to another person. When this happens, you do not lose any abilities the object unlocked or awakened (physical alterations, magic independent of the object, etc.) but any soul bonds transferred to the new owner.

objects.text:
The flagpole of the forgotten—a myth born from the heart of lost, yearning for home. The ever-distant light of nostalgia, always beyond reach, yet held so close.

A dream of a better time, where laughter rang, and spirits were light; for days long gone, recalling an age of heartfelt innocence, and the eternal wish to protect it.

It is the crystallization of the prayer called "longing," and the concept it etched into the hearts of all who behold it—illuminating the battlefield with its pale light, hanging above the land like the moon, stirring memories of home: the tearful wish of those who died beneath its banner to see another day, to come home.

A dream of hope and sorrow, one forever steeped in nostalgia.

There, within its dim radiance, all beneath its glow shall bear the will to press onward and make it back home—pushed by the collective dream of those who never could. That same light shelters them in turn, forming a Bounded Field which can turn what would have been fatal wounds into merely painful ones, slowly mending them so long as the bearer still wishes to live, if only for another day.

The range and effect of this nameless Noble Phantasm depend on the scale of the battlefield and its threat. The greater the land it is carried to or planted upon, the wider its reach. At its maximum range, it can span the entirety of Britain. Likewise, its healing scales with the level of peril faced: the greater the danger pressing down upon you and yours, the faster and more comprehensive its restoration becomes.
objects.title: ■■■■■■■: A Promise of Another Tomorrow

addons.title: Arpatha: The Crystal Core
addons.text:
Being made of pure mana, your connection with Apartha is incredibly deep. This has allowed it to become a true part of your form as well as giving you unparalleled control over both its baseline morphing and its development. 

Firstly, by channeling your mana through it can become a truly polymorphic object that can take any form you can imagine through the application of your mana. While more complex or ambitious forms may take more mana, experience, and practice to achieve, virtually nothing is impossible with enough of each. This control also extends to Arpatha’s development, which you can now guide with greater specificity to suit your needs.

Additionally, as it is now a part of you, you’re able to use the crystal itself as a vessel for your own mana, allowing you to shed your mortal body to instead use Arpatha as a ‘core’ for your anodite form to solidify around, giving you access your true form with far greater ease than you originally would.

objects.text: Born from crystalized potential, unable to be broken, a forever constant of existence. Arpatha bonds itself to the first person to pour their energy into it. Once bound, the binder will find themselves with the capacity to know where Arpatha is in space at all times. No one can wield Arpatha in any form without the binder's permission. Arpatha has an unlimited capacity for energy, which can be retrieved at any time without loss in efficiency. It will forever be the best catalyst for you, replacing any wand, staff, or athame you could hope for. As Arpatha is used more and more, you will find that the crystal’s shape, size, and density grows increasingly malleable. In one instant it could be as light as a feather, the next, as dense as a star. As the bond solidifies, the user will discover the even after Arpatha leaves their grasp it still remains controllable. With time Arpatha will begin to develop itself in ways that will only benefit you. Constantly improving itself through comparison to other weapons, never settling to be less than anything than the best option for you. Bear it with pride.
objects.title: Arpatha: The Living Crystal

objects.text:
In her final moment, the Magic King refused a quiet death. She used her body as a catalyst for her final spell, a working so vast it set the world ablaze upon her death. For six days the entire world burned, the skies red and the seas drying, before finally the flames cooled and vanished on the seventh day. Nothing of her body remained but smouldering ashes saturated with the undiluted wrath of the last dragon in the world. It was later gathered and forged into a whistle, a small, grim object that screams with a dragon's roar when you force your breath through it.

When you blow the whistle, you summon a spectral dragon that erupts from the whistle, a wraith the size of an elephant, woven from ambient mana and the distilled hatred that makes up the ashes. It is a nightmare of horns, wings, and claws, but its body is a translucent storm of energy. It can breathe a torrent of spectral flames that clings and consumes both matter and morale. It has the strength to shatter fortress gates with its incorporeal claws and the speed to outpace cavalry via its wings. Mundane weapons deal little to no damage, needed something on the level of a nuke to bypass its physical defences. 

The creature harbors no intelligence beyond a feral, obsessive need to annihilate, and its loyalty is a loose directive to spare you as it rampages. On the battlefield, it cannot distinguish friend from foe. You can direct its attention, point it at a castle or an army, but the finer points of tactics are ignored by it. The summon lasts for six minutes before the wraith unravels. The whistle then falls into a seven-hour dormancy, after which it can be used again.
objects.title: Ashes of the Last Dragon

objects.text:
These magical bagpipes have been enchanted with an almost paradoxical form of magic that allow the user to choose to become completely invisible and undetectable at will while playing them at full volume. HOWEVER, be warned that this does NOT stop or conceal the sound of the bagpipes, but does prevent them from knowing where the noise is coming from. 

Alongside these bagpipes, you are also granted a full Highland Gear set with a Kilt and tartan that can change its pattern and color to suit your desires. This outfit has minor repair abilities and is self cleaning ensuring it will keep itself clean and in perfect condition so you always look your best for your performances. 

If you have any magic abilities or Bardic powers these bagpipes can also be used as a focus granting a 100% increase in their strength and range.
objects.title: Bagpipes of Invisibility

objects.text: Somehow now within your hands lies the Chalice of Aquarius, said to be the cup born by Ganymede in his service as cupbearer to the gods. The vessel brims eternally full of the water of life, and yet never spills a drop. Anyone granted the right to drink from the cup will find their aches and ailments cured, as the vitality of their body is restored, and even age being undone, with every sip restoring a year of life. One who drinks from the cup without permission, will find their life drained, ageing a year for every sip taken. The Cup’s ties to the Constellation of Aquarius, however, grant it its greatest power. While Aquarius only shows for part of the year—and only on Earth—with this vessel in hand, you can cause the star sign to appear in the sky, regardless of the world, dimension, realm or location. With the Constellation overhead, you can cause the Chalice to overflow, spilling the water of life upon the ground granting even the driest desert great fertility and growth. This effect can only be activated once every 12 days. Finally, while the default form of the Chalice of Aquarius is that of a chalice formed from bronze, the cup is capable of taking the form of any other drinking vessel, and transforming itself into a small pin of Aquarius for easy transport and storage.
objects.title: Chalice of Aquarius

objects.text:
You have received a small slightly curved, bronze-banded medieval hunting horn; which is only about 12cm long. 

The horn will make a strangely loud call for its size: able to be heard clearly by any being the sounder wishes (allies, enemies, prey, specific persons) within 5km of them, no matter the environmental conditions. Although it will be able to be heard by anyone with 1km.

Further, the horn’s sound can produce minor magical effects (cause a minor burst of fear in enemies, send short subconscious messages or instructions to allies or pets, etc) on its own; and can be used as a focus for more significant effects by individuals with magical abilities or knowledge.
objects.title: Clear-Ringing Horn

objects.text:
This is the primordial substance—the very same divine clay once used in the shaping of the first humans. Now, it rests in your hands, inert yet brimming with potential. You are granted exactly 62,000 cubic centimeters of it, the precise amount required to sculpt an average-sized human male. But you are not limited to human shapes. Anything that can be classified as alive—be it animal, chimera, monstrous construct, or an entirely original design—can be formed from this material, so long as your skill and imagination can bring it into being.

The clay is fully obedient to your will. At any moment, you may command it to revert back to its raw state, allowing for endless reworkings, refinements, or complete overhauls. Whether fixing a minor flaw or reshaping a creature from the ground up, you are never locked into a single form.

The effectiveness of your creations depends entirely on your sculpting ability. The clay provides no shortcuts—only raw potential. A poorly shaped construct might shamble, stumble, or collapse under its own weight, while a carefully crafted one could walk, speak, and mimic life with unsettling realism. Its strength, mobility, coordination, and expression are determined by the precision of your work, not by any innate magic in the clay itself.

Like the Demiurge, you are a shaper of bodies, not souls. Your creations lack the animating spark of true life. While they can move, think in programmed patterns, and respond to stimuli, they have no soul, and thus no inner world. This absence does not hinder them in most practical ways, but it does place hard limits on what they can interact with. They cannot use or be affected by soul-based phenomena or any magic that relies on a true inner self. 

Additionally, because these vessels lack any spiritual core, they are highly susceptible to external possession. Ghosts, wraiths, and disembodied spirits will find it far easier to inhabit and control them than they would a living being.

Each month, another 62,000 cubic centimeters of clay is added, ready to be shaped. You may create entirely new beings, fuse the new clay with old designs, or simply continue perfecting your craft.
objects.title: Clay of Life

objects.text:
You gain a peculiar coffin unlike any other. Its exterior is adorned with intricate carvings of ethereal beings, shimmering with an otherworldly allure. But it's not the craftsmanship that draws attention; it's the eerie aura that emanates from within.

Should an ordinary person be placed inside it, they are swiftly consumed by the necromantic energies that suffuse the coffin's interior. In an instant, life fades away, and after a day of being suffused with necromantic energy, they will rise again as middle-tier undead.

Yet the coffin's malevolent power does not end there. It generates ludicrous amounts of necromantic energy. Should its lid remain open for more than a week, the very earth nearby begins to stir with an unholy fervor. Corpses, once dormant, rise from their eternal slumber, transformed into low-tier undead minions under the sway of the coffin's necromantic influence.

If an undead stays inside the coffin for a long period of time, they will undergo a transformation. Slowly but surely, the undead within the coffin start to grow, both in stature and in power. Their decrepit forms begin to swell with necromantic energy, their bodies bulging with newfound strength as their once-lifeless eyes flicker with a sinister gleam. 

The longer an undead stays inside the coffin, the greater their connection with the coffin becomes, allowing said undead to control the necromantic energy generated by the coffin. Through this, they can gain control over any undead created by the coffin, as long as its of a lower rank than they themselves are.
objects.title: Coffin of Eternal Sleep

addons.text: With the treasures of Capricorn, Taurus and Virgo now within your possession, and their constellations shining high in the sky, you have unlocked more of the power of the relics of the Triune of Earth. The Cornucopia of Capricorn unlocks the ability to generate food enhanced with magical effects, such as regeneration, magic resistance or enhanced strength. Such effects are always minor, but still inevitably useful. The Helm of Taurus- unleashes more of the Bull’s strength, allowing to lift buildings or small mountains with some effort. The Sword of Virgo reveals the ability to reflect energy based attacks, and protect the wielder from contaminants such as poison, disease or even radiation. Finally, the relics’ strongest powers—linked to their respective signs—can now be used once every 3 days.
addons.title: Triune of Earth

objects.text:
Also known as the Horn of Plenty, the Cornucopia is the horn of the goat Amalthea that nursed baby Zeus in antiquity. Accidentally broken from her head by infant Zeus, the horn remained to become the iconic symbol of abundance and nourishment while Amalthea was eventually placed into the heavens to form the constellation of Capricorn.
