As for the powers of the Cornucopia itself? At the will of its wielder, the Cornucopia can spill forth as much food and drink as the user needs, with its bounty always being perfectly suited to whoever will be partaking of it. The horn can create any form of food or drink, from raw ingredients, to fully cooked meals, even the divine Ambrosia and Nectar of the gods is not beyond the horn’s power.

While the powers of the horn itself are useful, it is the link to the constellation Capricorn that grants the greatest power. While typically Capricorn only shines in the night sky for few months out of the year—and only on Earth of course—however with the Cornucopia in your possession, you can cause Capricorn to shine high in the heavens throughout the year, and in any world, dimension,  or realm. 

And with Capricorn shining in the sky above you, Amalthea’s power blesses the lands of you and your allies, ensuring perpetual abundance with the bounty of the land seeming to be never-ending. From crops regrowing over night, herds and flocks only birthing twins—or more—every day, even the mines and quarries replenishing their veins almost as fast as they can be mined.
objects.title: Cornucopia of Capricorn

addons.text:
You now stand as a newly acknowledged child of the Dagda, with all that it brings. Larger than life, with a strong affinity for Nature, the Dagda is the Lord of all Druids and passes much of that affinity on to you. The ability to command the elements, to speak the secret languages of animals, to take their forms, and to possess knowledge of plants and magical potions are among the many things now available to you.

Lastly, should you manage to gain support, you have the right to lay claim to the title of King of the Tuatha Dé Danann, once held by your divine father.

Your divine heritage also unlocks the greatest trick of the Cup of Murias. Its final ability is to draw upon its user’s energies to ‘recall’ any substance it has in its ‘memory’, from a wide variety of magical potions, to food and drink fit for the gods themselves. Truly, this is a cup of plenty.
addons.title: Child of the Dagda

objects.text:
A relic straight out of Celtic legend, and known by many names. This is the Cup of the City of Murias, brought to Ireland by The Dagda with the Tuatha De Danaan’s migration there.

This cup has a wide history of use by the Dagda to feed and heal the masses. It’s most basic ability is to change it’s size, with whatever being inside it at the time being increased or decreased so that the proportion of filled volume remains the same.

This can allow one to put miniscule amounts of something in a cup the size of a thimble, to turn it into large quantities in the size of a cauldron. This can be done with anything from water and soup, to healing potions of legend. Thus allowing this vessel to live up to perhaps it's most famous name as "The Cauldron of Plenty".
objects.title: Cup of Murias

objects.text:
You have a cursed gold coin, a disc of thirty millimeters in diameter and five millimeters in thickness, engraved with a broken crown upon its face and bearing the inscription “Here Lies Riches” along its edge. Its material is 100% pure gold, yet it’s self repairing/cleaning. Created by the Magic King after a kingdom executed her daughter, every aspect of its creation was steeped in vengeful grief.

This coin passively bends luck and probability to draw other treasures toward it, ensuring that it will always accumulate more gold and valuables. A merchant who finds it might suddenly discover a buried chest of silver coins beneath his floorboards while a pirate who steals it could see the cargo of sunken ships wash onto his beach. Given sufficient time, the coin will amass a hoard so vast that even a dragon would feel envy.

However, the curse ensures that anyone who possesses this coin becomes a target for those greedier than themselves, so the hoard may never belong to a single owner for long. A farmer who keeps it will be murdered by his own brother for a handful of copper, a noble who locks it in a vault will find her guards turning against her for a share of the growing pile. With each killing the hoard adds the new owner’s riches to its hoard, while the curse infects the treasures in said hoard. The cursed treasures are drawn to one another so any coin, gem, or relic tainted by this magic will always find its way back to the others, bringing whatever hoard it has accumulated to merge with the greater pile, unless destroyed.

You have been named the true owner of this gold, so you may wield and grow this wealth without punishment. You may also designate others to share your immunity, though such power should be granted with care. Lastly, you can always sense where all cursed riches are, so letting others suffer the curse to amass a great hoard before reclaiming it is completely possible.
objects.title: Cursed Gold Coin

objects.text: When the angel stayed the hand of a vengeful king, it remade the sword. The original Curtana was pulled from the king's grasp, held aloft by a being of pure mercy, and when it was returned, its point was gone. In its place was an absence, a void where death used to live. That absence became the sword's soul. From that moment, Curtana could no longer kill. Any strike made with this sword is incapable of hurting a life, no matter the wielder's strength, the target's durability, or the intent behind the blow. A thrust through the heart would be felt as nothing more than a nudge, and a swing meant to decapitate would simply turn aside, as if deflected by an invisible shield. This is an absolute law woven into the sword's existence by divine intervention. Yet this inability to hurt does not render the blade harmless. Attacks inflicted by Curtana bypass all physical and magical defenses to deliver spiritual correction directly to the target's soul. The proud are stripped of their arrogance and forced to confront their own insignificance. The cruel are shown every sin they have committed and made to feel the weight of each one. The wrathful find their anger extinguished, replaced by a cold clarity about their own nature. The sword does not take life. It takes the reasons people feel entitled to take life from others. Every target survives, but every target is transformed, carrying the memory of this forced humility forever. But while it is a Sword of Selection, Curtana is not Caliburn. It is not the sword that is wielded by the king. It is the sword that officiates the king, held by one hand to consecrate another. When the blade is laid upon the shoulder of a candidate for kingship in the proper ritual, it judges the recipient. If the candidate possesses the capacity for mercy and the soul to rule justly, the sword makes them a True Ruler in the most literal sense. They gain the full Class abilities of the Ruler: True Name Discernment allowing them to see through any disguise or deception; a personalized God's Resolution granting one absolute royal decree per reign that cannot be disobeyed by any subject within their domain; Magic Resistance of the highest rank rendering them immune to all but the most world altering spells; and complete immunity to mental interference or coercion of any kind. They have been transformed into an impartial arbiter of their own realm. If the candidate is unworthy, the sword simply refuses to act. The candidate themselves feel this dismissal with absolute certainty, an internal truth rising from somewhere deeper than thought or desire. They cannot rationalize it away. They cannot blame others or rewrite history in their own mind. They simply know they have been found wanting. Even if they rule afterwards, they will always know they were never truly made king.
objects.title: Curtana: The Broken Sword that Upholds the Crown

objects.text:
Congratulations, it seems you have managed to acquire quite the artifact, The Dragon Cauldron.

The Dragon Cauldron is a lidded cauldron that is enchanted to when closed to combine and convert the ingredients placed inside it into a corresponding dragon. Furthermore, the power of the dragons will primarily depend on the quality of ingredients used and secondarily on the quantity, whilst their size will depend on how long they were allowed to settle within the cauldron at around two days equaling one year.

For example, an adult sword dragon made from a bundle of regular swords could threaten city blocks and modern military forces, whilst one made from a legendary mystic sword could be a living calamity that could level nations.

Note: The dragons you make will be loyal to you, so long as you don’t trample upon their pride.
objects.title: Dragon Cauldron

objects.text:
This beautiful smoking pipe is a true masterpiece of enchantment. It does not require refilling with tobacco and is not harmful to health. To use it you don't need fire, just start smoking.

The pipe can change its flavors according to your desire, or you can, so to speak, "spin the gacha" and get a random taste, which can be absolutely anything.

Also, when smoking, you get a variety of small buffs that depend on your current taste. Like, for example, mint will make you focused and allow you to process information faster and easier or watermelon will quench your thirst. Although the power of such buffs cannot exceed 1-3 SP. The shape of the pipe can be changed too.
objects.title: Enchanted Smoking Pipe

objects.text:
You've discovered a crystalline shard of power that resides within your spirit. This shard possesses various functions, all centered around the concept of Naming. Every existing entity, be it an object or a creature, has a true name. Initially, you can channel your willpower through the shard to study and discern the true name of what you're examining. As you delve deeper into understanding something and approach the realization of its true name, you gain conceptual power over it. However, dealing with sentient beings requires contesting, defeating, or subduing them before exercising full control.

This process may vary in difficulty, especially when it comes to your own true name. Accepting uncomfortable truths about yourself is often necessary to fully grasp your true name. Upon learning the foundational true name of something, the Key of Names crystallizes a version of it. You can then manifest and control these crystallized copies in the real world, as well as mantle other things with their true names.

Mantling involves overlaying a true name onto something to conceptually manifest the named thing's aspects. For instance, mantling the true name of a sword onto yourself might enable your punches to cut like a sword or transform yourself into the sword's form. Choosing which aspects are transferred during mantling is within your control.

The Key of Names bestows increasing spacetime control over crystallized true names. This allows you to summon or banish any true names you've crystallized at the foundational level, including your own, granting you temporal-spatial control over yourself. Sending named things back in time requires a high degree of mastery.

Additionally, the Key can be used to name places and things, but overwriting the true names of things demands mastery of their true names. Naming can alter various aspects of the object, with more significant conceptual changes requiring greater mastery. For example, changing a car's color is easier than transforming its engine. Naming a location requires realizing a few foundational true names and begins with a small area, expanding as mastery grows. Focusing on specific boundaries, such as a forest rather than a broad area, facilitates narrowing down a place's true name.

As mastery of the Key advances, you can realize the true names of indirect concepts and gain control over them. However, initially, only tangible things that engage your senses can be studied and have their true names realized.
objects.title: Key of Names

addons.text:
Your mastery over the Eye of Magnus has dramatically enhanced the potential of your Ley Line Seeds. No longer limited to a single sprouting, you may now forge additional Ley Line Seeds with only a modest infusion of magical energy, each one attuned through the Eye’s vast reservoir of arcane insight.

These Seeds now mature at ten times their natural rate, swiftly establishing themselves as potent nexuses of supernatural power. Once planted, they immediately begin weaving new ley Line threads or seamlessly binding to existing ones—threads which the Eye can shape, shift, or extend according to your will.

Your Staff of Magnus has likewise grown more attuned to these ley Line networks. Regardless of distance, it can now draw upon the energies coursing through your seeded ley Lines, enhancing its power with a constant pulse of reclaimed magic.

Finally, your evolving bond with the Seeds has awakened a deeper resonance with the Eye itself. With sufficient concentration, you can now commune with the Eye remotely through your ley Line network, channeling its influence across the threads you’ve anchored in the world.
addons.title: Veins of Magnus

addons.text: The ley line you plant now exerts a profoundly amplified influence on their surroundings. Where once it would take decades for ambient supernatural energy to subtly alter the environment, your presence accelerates the process exponentially. Within a year of maturation, your ley line's energy begins to reshape the land—infusing stone, soil, flora, and even living beings with its energy.
addons.title: Awakened Ley Line

addons.text: The Ley Line Seed no longer functions as a separate entity from you, but instead becomes an extension of your own essence. From the moment it is planted, the ley line it produces resonates perfectly with your soul. This bond deepens the ley line’s permanence. When you uproot the seed, the currents it generated continues to flow, saturating the land with the same richness as before, though it loses the capacity to expand further without the seed’s continued presence.
addons.title: Personal Seed

objects.text:
You possess a metaphysical seed with the potential to awaken into a ley Line, an invisible wellspring of supernatural energy flowing beneath the earth. When planted, the seed begins to draw in and attune to any mystical energies present in its surroundings, or those you consciously feed it. Its growth depends on the ambient currents of magic; in places thick with arcane power, it matures swiftly, but even in barren or mundane lands, it will reach full maturity within a year.

Upon maturation, the seed transforms into a living wellspring of supernatural energy, steadily channeling the particular force to which it is attuned during its growth. This energy pulses outward along unseen veins, subtly reshaping the land and strengthening the flow of magic in the area. If the world itself holds native magical energies or forces, the seed will harmonize with them, weaving its power seamlessly into the natural weave of the environment. As the seed’s planter, you maintain a quiet, intuitive bond with it, granting you limited sway over its influence, such as tuning the size of its reach. Over time, this bond may deepen, allowing you greater command over the Ley Line’s burgeoning power.

At any moment, you may uproot the seed, severing its link to the land and silencing its flow. Though this destroys the Ley Line it has formed, it grants you the ability to carry and replant the seed elsewhere, sparking the cycle anew.
objects.title: Ley Line Seed

addons.text:
Rather than receiving the standard living wood artifact befitting a budding Druid, your father, The Dagda, has intervened. In its place, you now possess a perfect copy of his legendary two-ended Great Staff, or Club: the Lorg Mór.

In addition to all the abilities of a normal living wood staff, this one is capped at either end with enchanted iron: one end smooth, one end rough.

Touch the smooth end to anything dead and devoid of life, and vitality shall flood back into it: resurrecting the dead (though not healing injuries beyond what you yourself could mend) or bringing life to barren rock.

Strike anything with the rough end, barring entities of truly awesome power, and they shall instantly drop dead without any sign of cause or injury, allowing you to kill nine men or more with a single swing.

Thanks to the living wood nature of your staff, it is not as overwhelmingly heavy as the true Lorg Mór, and requires no wheels to be moved. Its potency as a focus for nature magic is only strengthened by this form, while any necromantic abilities you may possess are bolstered in equal measure.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​
addons.title: Lorg Mór

objects.text:
You have gained an artifact carved from living wood, thick with ancient, raw energy. Deeply attuned to nature, it can repair and reshape itself, shifting between four forms: seed, branch, staff, and tree. You may change its form by willing it and channeling a small amount of magical energy, drawn from yourself or the artifact.

In its seed form, it appears as a small acorn, generating, gathering, and storing ambient nature-aligned magic over time. Initially, it can sprout a sapling or revive wilted flora, but as your bond with the artifact and the wild deepens, it can store more mana and gain new abilities.

In its branch form, it becomes a sturdy weapon resembling a thick branch. It passively strengthens any nature magic cast on yourself and channels nearby natural mana to enhance your body, boosting your strength, speed, and resilience. To complement this form, you also gain access to the Shillelagh spell to empower its strikes with nature magic.

As a staff, the artifact serves as a magical focus and amplifies your link to the natural world. Nature spells cast through it are tripled in power, and the staff strengthens nearby plant life. With a stronger connection, this power may grow even further.

By planting the artifact in any form and willing it to grow, you may activate its tree form. This creates a temporary, nature magic-rich domain that supports nearby allies, empowers plant life, and hinders foes. Additionally, you gain a vague sense of anything within its reach through its mana. You may end this form by touching the tree and willing it back into its seed form. It requires a full day before it can be used again.

Due to ancient druidic rites, the artifact shifts with your changing forms, beast, spirit, or elemental. It bends and twists to remain with you, fading only when you cannot carry or use it, then returning when you can.

Note: You may design and shape the look of all its forms.
objects.title: Living Wood Artifact

objects.text:
You possess a seemingly ordinary Magic Eight Ball, but unlike its mundane counterpart, this one holds true prophetic power. When you shake the ball and ask it a question, it provides an answer from the classic set of responses—such as “Yes, definitely,” “Ask again later,” or “Outlook not so good.” However, the key difference is that this Eight Ball is never wrong. Its cryptic yet simple answers always reflect the truth, though they may sometimes be frustratingly vague or open to interpretation.

For instance, if you ask, “Will I find treasure in the cave?” and the ball responds with “Better not tell you now,” it may indicate that your fate is uncertain or that knowing too much could influence the outcome. If you ask, “Is the king’s advisor betraying him?” and it replies with “Without a doubt,” you can be sure treachery is afoot.

While undeniably powerful, the Eight Ball’s format can make it challenging to extract detailed or nuanced information. Asking broad or poorly worded questions might lead to misleading answers, such as “Will I succeed in my mission?” yielding “Reply hazy, try again,” leaving you with more questions than before.
objects.title: Magical Eight Ball

objects.text:
These four needle-shaped devices around two feet long are made of white and blue crystal capable of conducting aether and focus its effects. When you attune with the nouliths, you gain the ability to control the nouliths mentally, a reserve of aether, and a basic understanding of the art of somanoutics. All four of them can be directed independently and can fly up to fifteen meters away from you. 

Using the nouliths as foci, you can cast a variety of minor offensive, defensive, and support spells on par with the effects possible through the Magick power, though more versatile. For single target spells, you will need to aim the nouliths at the target, while spells that affect an area will require you to position the nouliths to define it. Finally, you will need to refine your understanding of the art to master the more complex magicks.

You can also shrink the nouliths to the size of a fountain pen since they are rather large and cumbersome to transport but they cannot be used to channel aether in that form.
objects.title: Magitek Nouliths

objects.text:
This magical contraption allows its wielder to draw on the ether through the ancient art of astrology and divination. In its standby configuration, the planisphere appears as a golden metal disc surrounded by a silver circle sixty centimeters across with crosses at each cardinal directions. The surface is intricately carved with occult symbols. In its energized state, which can be turned on or off at will while in your possession, the planisphere is shrouded in ether and hovers near you, directed by your thoughts. While active, the planisphere has two functions. 

The first allows the wielder to draw the ethereal cards that orbit around the planisphere when active. You do not need to physically reach for the cards, only focus on the action and the cards will manifest in your hands. The deck you draw from contains two sets, the astral set give three cards that have defensive or support spells while the umbral set gives three cards that have offensive spells. These spells are comparable in strength to a 5 SP power. You can only draw one hand every thirty seconds but can play all three cards at once after they are drawn.
 
The second function synergizes with your other magic powers. When a hand is drawn or card is played, you recover a small part of your mana reserves. Additionally, the deck you can draw from expands to include sets that match the different traditions you have access to. You can choose which set you draw from but are still constrained by the global cooldown. You can modify the spells in the deck through a simple ritual while the planisphere is inactive. Drawing from these extra sets costs a fixed amount of mana higher than what is recovered but can cast spells of any strength for that cost.

For convenience, the planisphere can also be shrunk to the size of a small medal that hangs on a plain silver chain. If the planisphere is activated while under or inside of your clothes, it will first fly out.
objects.title: Magitek Planisphere

objects.text:
The Memory Metal Flask is a powerful artifact that holds within it a remarkable material known as Memory Metal. Memory Metal is a special form of liquid metal that can be controlled by you through your thoughts, thanks to the soul bond you now share with this flask.  

You can use Memory Metal in a vast number of ways, from simply controlling it like water to using it to form any metallic items you can imagine. Such items include weapons, armor, and tools. Memory metal can also be used as a ranged weapon and can be manipulated and even fired as a ranged weapon, with strength dependent on your physique. You can also use it to cover yourself in a durable form-fitting armor that can be freely shaped into any design you desire. Or use it to create any other item you could need, as long as it can be made from metal that is not technological in nature. Once you are done using it, you can transform it back into a liquid and return it to the flask.

The Memory Metal Flask and the Memory Metal within the flask is completely weightless to you yet still retain its full weight when interacting with anything it touch. This allows you to use it freely without worry about its weight, yet still use its great weight to your benefit.

The Flask holds an amount of Memory Metal equal to one cubic meter, which you can use as you wish. 

Note that Memory Metal, despite its remarkable properties, it is still only as durable as normal high-grade carbon steel and can be broken. Should any Memory Metal be damaged or lost, you can replace it through a ritual that involves mixing molten metal with your blood in a process that takes 5 minutes and placing it into the flask. You can speed up this process by using a small amount of remaining Memory Metal into the mixture and having it combine and then absorbed into the flask. Over time, by mixing your blood into the Memory Metal within the flask and creating more when it is spent, it will grow even stronger and gradually be able to hold more within the flask.
objects.title: Memory Metal Flask

objects.text:
The Magic King forged this tool as a gift of peace to a fledgling ruler for a growing nation. For decades it sat as a symbol of trust, until the same hands that once received the star used it against the daughter of the Magic King, ultimately killing her.

The Millennium Star is a spherical construct of layered barriers locked into recursive spatial folds, a configuration that creates an absolute one-way membrane: nothing from the outside can ever breach the shell. However, everything inside can exit without resistance. What resides inside is mana, so much mana that it exceeds the total amount of energy a group of archmages would naturally generate should they live over 1000 years, meaning the Millennium Star contains more usable mana than a full circle of archmages could produce across a millennium of life.

You have bound the Millennium Star to your soul, and from it you can draw upon its mana with no upper boundary on discharge rate. The only limit is that the mana inside cannot be replenished in any way. Exhausting the star leaves you with nothing but an empty shell bound to your soul forever. This reserve is wholly separate from your personal mana pool and will not benefit from anything that enhances your mana pool.
objects.title: Millennium Star

objects.text:
You have found yourself soulbound to the Nexus Arcanum, a magical focus of the highest degree. In its true form you will find that the Nexus Arcanum takes the shape of a perfectly fitting indestructible palm-sized orb that alternatively takes the shape of a ring of your own design. Alongside the Nexus Arcanum you will find a source of magic within yourself that grows with use and is directed by your intent. At any instant you are able to recall your focus to your hand, additionally your focus can be stored inside and summoned from your magic source with a moment of concentration. 

As a novice wizard beginning to embark on your journey, the Nexus Arcanum starts off as a basic magical focus with no enchantments. However, as you grow in knowledge and power, you will have the opportunity to layer and weave new enchantments onto the surface of its true form, the orb. Each enchantment should be carefully chosen to serve a specific magical purpose or theme, such as enhancing elemental spells, amplifying telekinetic abilities, or delving into the realm of rituals. Spells can be cast through the focus without any enchantments, although they will be lacking in magnitude compared to spells enhanced by numerous enchantments. 

With each enchantment added, the Nexus Arcanum gains more depth and potential, becoming a repository of magical knowledge and abilities. However, the true marvel lies in the Nexus Arcanum’s capacity to reach a critical point in its development, where it can perform a remarkable feat: condensing all the enchantments on the object's surface into a single, minuscule grain.

As the enchantments merge and condense, the magical energy within the Nexus Arcanum intensifies exponentially, amplifying the potency of the enchantments manifold. The single grain becomes the base of the object, serving as the core of the Nexus Arcanum's ever-evolving magic.

You can then begin the process anew, enchanting the surface with a different theme, layering more magic, and, once again, achieving the critical point where the enchantments converge into a new, condensed grain of power. This cycle of enchanting, condensing, and amplifying can continue ad infinitum, allowing the Nexus Arcanum to grow in potency and diversity with each iteration.
objects.title: Nexus Arcanum

objects.text:
What you have currently in your possession is a heart of unknown origins—one disconnected from any physical body yet still beating. Capable of producing a form of "blood" that, depending on your desire, can manifest as either a liquid or a radiating aura of energy.

This blood is also a powerful, universally compatible energy source. That can seamlessly adapt to any system, be it magic, psionic, solar, radiation, chakra, etc. — making it an exceptionally versatile tool.

Beyond that, the blood has strong restorative properties, healing whatever it touches and extending the lifespan of anyone who regularly absorbs it, reversing and keeping them in prime condition.

And, although the heart itself can produce an endless amount of its blood, its output is limited to only a finite rate at any given moment. However, because it never stops generating—this means that, so long as you have it in your possession, you'll always have a reliable and self-sustaining power source that never runs out.

If you have the capacity, you could even have the heart surgically implanted. Once fully integrated with your body, it'll start circulating its blood through your veins, granting you a perpetual source of energy and vitality.
objects.title: Perpetual Heart

addons.text:
The Phylactery and the anchor granted by lichdom has fused, transcending its former limitations.

Your improved phylactery has developed an echo of your mind. This reflection is wholly obedient, incapable of rebellion, and functions as a second self. Though not strong enough to replace you, it can perceive its surroundings, communicate telepathically with you, and subtly interact with others.

This echo possesses a limited necromantic capability of its own. It can animate a handful of corpses, sustain or command minor undead, and weave small curses. While nowhere near the breadth of your full power, these abilities allow the phylactery to defend itself, raise useful servants, or spread your shadow independently.

Its main ability, however, lies in its ability to influence minds. Those who carry it, guard it, or remain in its presence for long periods slowly fall under its sway. Their thoughts and emotions grow pliant, aligning with your will until they willingly protect and obey it as if compelled by their own desires. Over weeks or months, the phylactery may turn such mortals into fanatical guardians who will fight and die to keep it safe.

Finally, the fusion has reforged its durability. Gone is the brittleness of the original phylactery, your soul’s anchor is now resilient, capable of withstanding mundane force or accidents. Only deliberate supernatural forces can damage it.
addons.title: Improved Phylactery

objects.text: An empty soul container, its form entirely up to you, so long as it does not exceed one cubic meter. It can be a ring, a gemstone, a statue, or any object you choose. The Phylactery is designed to hold a soul, able to contain the soul of any living being, with the effects of the Phylactery applying to whoever’s soul it is bound to. Once a soul is placed inside, that person gains immortality. No injury, no sickness, not even the total destruction of the body will bring true death as long as the Phylactery remains intact. However, this immortality is not perfect. The body still ages, decays, and suffers natural wear. Wounds heal at normal rates, diseases still cause pain, and the body can break down entirely. Luckily, when the soul is sealed inside, the Phylactery grants basic necromantic understanding, just enough to control one’s body even when it is no longer structurally sound—such as animating a skeleton or controlling withered limbs. This necromantic power naturally grows stronger the longer the soul remains inside. Over months and years, it develops into potent instinctive necromancy, able to command other corpses, raise the dead, and more. There is a limit. Unless the person bound to the Phylactery has Well Adjusted, the farther they travel from the Phylactery, the weaker emotional capacity becomes, dulling their ability to feel and eroding their sense of self. Their Phylactery-born necromantic abilities become also fades with distance. This only applies to the necromancy granted by the Phylactery—it does not weaken necromantic powers gained from other sources. The Phylactery itself is fragile, often no stronger than ceramic. A solid strike, a drop from the wrong height, or even simple accidents can destroy it. If the Phylactery shatters, the soul bound to it is immediately and permanently destroyed.
objects.title: Phylactery

objects.text:
You hold in your hand a crystal cube the size of a die. It is ventablack, absorbing all light that touches it, yet along its edges runs a sheen of holographic purple. This is Ras Nega, a mystic code from a pruned timeline. It was created by the greatest magus of that lost world, a Tohsaka who never was. The Counter Force intervened directly and destroyed the Mystic Code before it turned into an Ultimate One that could sail the Imaginary Sea. This shard of the original Mystic Code is all that has been salvaged.

When you activate Ras Nega, it begins to generate crystalline growths from any matter it touches. The crystals are the crystallised Imaginary Element “Nothingness,” identical in appearance to the core itself. They are nearly indestructible, resisting mundane weapons and most forms of magecraft with ease. Any crystal created by Ras Nega can itself generate more crystals from matter it touches, replacing what they consume with more of themselves while retaining the properties of the consumed. A crystallized blade remains sharp. A crystallized circuit remains functional. 

However, the fragment is imperfect and constrained by the law of thermodynamics. Growth is exponentially slower with each new crystal formed within a single sustained activation. Large scale assimilation requires days or weeks. But if you allow the core to rest between uses, it recovers, allowing you to achieve the a high rate of expansion in bursts. You can direct the growth to create tools, weapons, or structures from available matter.

Ras Nega's crystals can infect and replace flesh and spirit simultaneously, rebuilding living creatures as crystalline entities that retain their memories, skills, and personalities, but twisted toward the crystal's will. They become Alters of themselves: immune to conventional harm, feeling no pain, and utterly loyal to you.

So long as you hold the core fragment, you can sense the general location of the crystals you have created and issue commands that they must obey. You can choose to halt the transformation process at any stage, leaving partial crystallizations that function as living tools or symbiotic enhancements, but what is transformed can never return to what it was.

This shard was fished from the turbulent depths of the Imaginary Sea, where it drifted for countless ages after its timeline's destruction. As such, it remains permanently connected to that extradimensional space, existing partially within it. With research and access to the Imaginary Sea, it is possible to achieve the operation of the Second Magic.
objects.title: Ras Nega

objects.text:
You now possess a Replication Box, a smooth obsidian box like object etched with near invisible fractal patterns. Within its interior lies a pocket dimension of stabilized possibility: a spatial fold that sucks in any sized object that someone attempts to place inside.

When you place an item within the box and the lid closed, the artifact analyzes the object’s conceptual blueprint and then begins to endlessly produce perfect duplicates of said object. However, The stronger or more metaphysically significant the object, the longer the replication will take.

A mundane item or weak artifact (≈1 SP) requires only 1 day to produce a single perfect clone. Items stronger than that will take significantly more time with objects of 15sp taking almost a month to duplicate.

Regardless of the amount of time the first duplication take, production does not stop after, instead the Replication Box continues to spawn additional copies at the same interval, indefinitely, until a new object is placed within to overwrite its imprint.

While the Replication Box can duplicate any item including people, any biological matter the box will only have dead duplicates generated.
objects.title: Replication Box

addons.text: Your gain the ability to view the flow of geomantic energies through the HUD rather than just being able to sense it, as well as being able to see the qualities present in that energy directly. You are able to design structures whos purpose is to effect geomantic flows in the same way that a Locus is able to, as well as augmenting the Locuses that you design specifically to interface with those structures. Structures designed  for specific workings or categories of workings make those spells cheaper and more efficient to cast, and can allow for increased complexity in their effects. These augmented workings if cast onto the specifically designed structures are able to effect a much wider area.
addons.title: Geomatic Architecture

addons.text:
You can create physical additions designed to fit onto, around, or attached to the Rod of the Geomancer such as endcaps for staffs, toppers for canes, or handles for wands. These additions will change size with the Rod as it does, as well as being able to slot into the rod perfectly with the rod holding onto it better than any glue or screw, Theses addons can allow you to develop workings or spells that make use of the geography or environment based on the designs or based on the specific technology worked into the cane. The Rod will perfectly slot theses additions into the physical structure of itself always insuring things perfectly stay together and connected. These spells are specifically utility based in nature such as spells relating to cartography or divination tied to the local area. A compass could allow you to create spells that let you find specific Loci in the area, or allow you to magically draw out finely detailed maps of the area in question. The can could be designed to link back to a book to fill in with maps, or information about the area.
The more familiar you are geomanticlly with the flow of the area, more information about the area you can divine such as underground water sources, or what sort of materials exist in the area. At the level of having a lens for a place you could even use it to locate specific items or people in the area with only the slightest information of what you are looking for.
addons.title: Geomancer's Magitechnology

objects.text:
You have become bound to the Geomancers Rod, the material and shape of which can change and shift over time, but will always take the form of a rod that fits into your hand, it can be as long as you are tall, or as small as a standard wooden pencil. The rod allows you to sense the flows of geomantic Energy that underlie the world, different geographical areas produce different qualities of Geomantic energy such as somewhere with a large river having particularly fast flowing or maybe even chaotic and hard to control energy. It can also take on different elemental affinities depending on the environment, the shape of the land, or specific geographical features, with geographical features also directing how geomantic energy flows within its area. 

Using the geomancers rod you can tap into this flow of geomantic energy and direct it for your own purpose in several ways, all of which are collectively called geomantic spells. Different locations with their different qualities and flow states of geomantic energy lend themselves better to different kinds of shaping, from the element that makes up the attack such as fire, water, or rock, as well as affecting your control over the spell and its final output. However physical force as an elemental effect can be used anywhere.

Geomantic Shaping is a short-duration direct application of geomantic energy such as a ranged magical attack like a rock blast or a fire bolt, or at its most basic, applications of raw physical force shaped in various ways. 

Geomantic Workings are spells that are cast with ritual actions and preparations, which have longer or permanent durations, as well as having more complex effects such as warming a person's body directly instead of using shaping to wrap warmer winds around yourself and having to repeatedly cast that. The actions and preparations needed for each working is different and specific to each working. While you don't require any material components to cast a working you will need at least some amount of verbal and somatic actions that are repeated in specific ways. 

Geomantic Locuses are geomantic energy structures that are created in the flow of geomantic energy using several layered Workings, a locus is a permanent energetic structure that is used to interact and change the flow of geomantic energy in the area in some way, like gathering and directing greater amounts of geomantic energy over a larger area or changing the quality of geomantic energy to better amplify and control the Shapings or Workings you are preforming better.

As you work with an area and its energy better, as well as developing more spells based on its energy you will be able to create from the staff small trinkets or additions to the rod that remain connected to it called Lenses, which allow you to channel the geomantic energy you are working with through to change its qualities to that of the are the Lens represents, this does have a small amount of energy lost in the quality change. 

The geomancers rod also allows you to augment, alter, or just boost your other spells and magical actions with geomantic energy allowing you to use geomantic spells with those other magic system's mechanics and spells, or just augment the spells of the other system with geomantic energy.
objects.title: Rod Of the Geomancer

addons.text: With the treasures of Gemini, Libra, and Aquarius now within your possession, and their constellations shining high in the sky, you have unlocked more of the powers of the relics of the Triune of Air. The Mask of Gemini will duplicate your items and abilities, instead of spreading them out. The Scale of Libra will permit you to guide it’s non-existent hand, no longer risking harming allies, or empowering foes. The Chalice of Aquarius allows the wielder to resurrect the dead by pouring forth the waters of life over their bodies. Finally, the relics’ strongest powers—linked to their respective signs—can now be used once every 3 days.
addons.title: Triune of Air

objects.text:
The Scale of Judgement and Balance was placed high in the heavens to watch over all mankind, now a reflection of its power resides in your hands. The Scale of Libra allows all who wield it to cause a targets moral and ethical worth to be evaluated, and decide if they are worthy of forgiveness or punishment.

The Scale allows you judge a person on almost anything, whether they’re worthy of salvation or damnation, of possessing certain artifacts, skills or abilities, even of life and death, fate and fortune, love and loyalty. It's punishments can strip the target of anything they possess—even such esoteric things as skills, or abilities.

All that the Scale deems a judged target to be unworthy of, is stored within the artifact itself, able to bestowed as a reward upon a worthy recipient—should one be found at least—or utilized by it’s wielder.

But be careful, the Scale forces all being judged before it, to be judged equally and without bias. You may just find yourself bestowing one you consider a foe with powers you never wished them to have, or stripping an Ally of their powers.

While it’s powers over Judgement are great, it’s powers over balance are restricted to the Constellation of Libra itself. While the star sign only shines for a few months of the year—and only on Earth—with this echo of Libra in your hands you can cause the Constellation to shine high in the sky throughout the year, regardless of world, dimension, realm or location.

With Libra shining high overhead, the Scale can bring down the force of their power upon the world, and bring “balance”, though exactly which “balance” is specifically being brought about is up to you. Perhaps balance between Day and Night? The Seasons? War and Peace? Life and Death? Chaos and Order? Whatever you choose, the Scales will bring it about... at least for a time. The Scale cannot stop the march of time,  whatever “balance” you create will eventually crumble, and a single use of this ability will exhaust the powers of the Constellation for 30 days.

Finally, the Scale of Libra is capable of taking the form of any other form of Scale, and even transforming itself into a small pin of the Constellation of Libra for ease of transport and storage.
objects.title: Scale of Libra

addons.text:
Your Sorcerer’s Focus and Mage’s Trapping have harmonized, creating the Sorcerer’s Regalia. This Regalia enhances and shares the abilities of both the Focus and Trapping, resulting in something greater than what was. Now, your Regalia can repair itself just like your Trappings, and it does so at an enhanced rate. Even if it is fully destroyed, it can restore itself completely within 30 minutes from its image carved into your soul.

Now your Focus’s scaling ability does so faster, and you benefit from a scaling increase in casting speed on top of everything else, allowing you to cast a true barrage of spells at your opponents. Your Sorcerer’s Focus and Mage’s Trapping ability to absorb and store energy has been improved by leaps and bounds. Now they store energy at a 1:5 ratio instead of the previous 1:1 it used before.

Your Regalia now has a new ability called Arcane Shield. If you receive damage that would normally put you in critical condition, it will instead create an impenetrable barrier that absorbs all attacks directed at you. This barrier will recharge its energy store, accommodating kinetic, magical, or even more esoteric types of attacks. The shield lasts for 10 minutes and takes 24 hours to fully recharge, but the duration can be extended with the right enchantment.
addons.title: Sorcerer’s Regalia

objects.text:
You have acquired a Sorcerer's Focus, a mystical tool designed to harness all types of supernatural energy, regardless of how esoteric they may be. Initially, the focus appears as a glowing platinum orb. However, once you attune to it, it will transform into the form that suits you best—whether that be a ring, a wand, a staff, or even a tesseract labyrinth. Upon attuning to the Sorcerer's Focus, you will gain an energy core, unless you already possess one. In that case, the Focus will bind itself to your existing core and grant you a variety of abilities that depend on the growth of that core.

At the beginning, you will receive a scaling bonus that enhances the potency of any energy channeled through the Sorcerer's Focus. This bonus is determined by your maximum energy pool; the larger your energy capacity, the greater the bonus. Additionally, you will benefit from a scaling reduction in the energy cost required to cast any spell-like effects that follow the same principle. You can also bypass some of the material costs of components; the larger your energy pool, the more of this cost you can bypass.

Your focus acts as a supernatural battery, allowing you to store excess energy at a 1:1 ratio. There is no limit to how much energy your Focus can hold. This internal energy can be used to replenish your own reserves or to cast pre-set spells that you have stored, with a maximum capacity of ten spells. You can keep your Sorcerer's Focus within your soul and summon it whenever you wish. Additionally, because the Sorcerer's Focus is an ideal tool for channeling and storing energy, it can hold an unlimited number of enchantments.
objects.title: Sorcerer’s Focus

addons.text:
With this, you now possess the Four Legendary Treasures of Ireland: the Sword of Findias, once wielded by Nuada; the Cup of Murias, once cared for by the Dagda; the Spear of Gorias, treasured by Lugh; and lastly, perhaps most importantly, the Stone of Falias.

Now, the Stone of Falias, the Lia Fáil, roars with joy at your very presence, announcing to all across the land the beginning of your new reign as King of Ireland.

As the King, your rule is absolute. Your people willingly kneel before you, with a government loyal and obedient to enact your will upon your new kingdom. You could be simply the “figurehead” while your government rules, or you could take the reins and dictate your will to your people, able to change this as needed.

This status as King of Ireland will follow you wherever you may go, with every alternate world that has anything remotely related to ‘Ireland’ acknowledging your right as King.

<small>Note: You can disable the Stone's "roar" when needed</small>
addons.title: King at Tara

addons.text:
Now, with the divine blood of three of the most legendary Kings of the Tuatha Dé Danann, along with their prized treasures, you may claim what has always been only a possibility: your birthright as King of the Tuatha Dé Danann, King of the Gods.

From one-armed Nuada, you gain command over the waters—the rivers, the lakes, and the seas. From the mysterious Dagda, you gain command over the earth—the hills and valleys, the forests and beasts. From brilliant Lugh, you gain command over the skies—the rain, the wind, and the lightning.

Your new divine subjects are typically a rambunctious lot, prone to arguments and strife among themselves. But to you, they hold no trouble at all, being loyal and obedient. They form a willing army to fight your battles and loyal subjects to tend to your new domain. With this command over the Tuatha Dé Danann, all of the Celtic Otherworld stands open before you—with it's treasures and mysteries to be discovered.
addons.title: King of the Tuatha Dé Danann

objects.text:
A stone said to proclaim the King of Ireland—or, at least, the ruler of the country within which it resides. This flattened stone pillar is the legendary artifact of the City of Falias. It was brought to Ireland by the Tuatha Dé Danann long ago and is one of the legendary Four Treasures of Ireland.

The stone is utterly invulnerable to any conventional damage and can be moved telekinetically at the user’s will. You could even ride it, reaching speeds of about 160 kilometers per hour. The stone can also increase or decrease its size to fit the user’s needs.

While touching the stone, any power that might be used to control or command the user fails instantly, while any ability the user possesses is greatly enhanced.

Lastly, the stone has the ability to grant powerful regenerative powers to anyone touching it—at the user’s discretion—allowing them to gain the equivalent of a full day of the best rest possible for every minute of contact.
objects.title: Stone of Falias

objects.text: The Sublime Tool of Actualizing Fantasy and Fulfillment, or S.T.A.F.F. for short, is the ideal magical artifact for those with massive amounts of magical energy, but not enough control over it to make use of it in more precise or volatile spells and rituals. It is a masterwork imbued with the concept of ‘Wish-Granting’. This has given it an ability most unique, allowing for its wielder to pour magical energy into it and essentially brute-force the wielder's desired result into being, ‘granting’ a ‘wish’ provided that it is fueled with enough energy to make it happen. Of course, the more difficult, time-consuming, or improbable a desired result is, the more magical energy is required to make it so, scaling very heavily the more outright impossible the 'wish' is. Using the S.T.A.F.F. to fill out a ritual circle in an instant when you have the tools to create it properly and the knowledge on how it's supposed to look and work, is much cheaper compared to if you didn't have the tools or the knowledge, let alone both. 'Wishes' are not required to be large or impossible, meaning that the wielder can use it to harmlessly cut corners in their work by expending small amounts of their magical energy to smooth things over. On its own, it is not capable of much, if anything at all without someone who already has access to magical energy. It requires magical energy to perform its only function, and as such is effectively a fancy paperweight to anyone who doesn't have any.
objects.title: Sublime Tool of Actualizing Fantasy and Fulfillment

addons.text:
Your Summoner's Staff has synergized with your Trappings, making them into Regalia. This grants your summons an additional 100% boost, bringing their total enhancement to 200% of their parameters. The energy-absorbing properties of your Regalia have also further improved your energy efficiency, reducing the energy required for upkeep to just 50% of what it would normally be.

Even if your Trappings are utterly destroyed, they can still be summoned back like your staff. Your summon has gained the ability to shapeshift just like your Trappings. It cannot shapeshift into something that exceeds its original combat capabilities, but it can change into things that might lose effectiveness in one area in exchange for increasing effectiveness in another.
addons.title: Summoner's Regalia

addons.text:
Your staff has evolved into the Celestial Weapon, Nirvana. Its enhancement when used on Aeons is 300% instead of 100%. Your self-designed summon counts as both an Aeon and a Guardian. They can even potentially become your "Final Aeon" with enough time to grow, and they won’t kill you like a normal Final Aeon would. Nirvana has also gained the ability to double the rate at which you grow stronger and learn new abilities—this is not shared with any Guardians you may have besides your self-designed summon.

All spells you cast are now capped so that, even at full potency, they will use 1% of your maximum mana at most. This does not weaken the spells or cause spells that cost less to use more mana.

As a final bonus, you and all your Aeons will gain Overdrives at three times the normal rate. None of these will take up Auto-Ability slots.
addons.title: Nirvana

addons.text:
The Klironomia has had a unique interaction with your Summoner's Staff. It somehow scanned the nanomachines of the gods and began replicating the all-powerful Twelve Machine Gods of Olympus. However, they don’t appear as imposing as one might expect. You start with one Olympian Machine God of your choice, and your staff will create a small version of them—ranging from small enough to sit on your shoulder to just big enough to ride. This miniaturized form can either resemble their original ship form or take on an alternate shape representing their essence, like a mechanical owl for Athena.

These miniature Machine Gods retain all their powers and divine essence, but at a level equivalent to an average Servant, not counting any enhancement from the staff. While initially diminished, they will gradually regain their former strength, either by simply waiting ten years or through frequent battles against worthy opponents, which accelerates their growth. Every week, or each time you make significant progress in strengthening your current Olympus Mon(s), you will gain another Machine God, continuing until you possess all Twelve.

All Olympus Mons are unwaveringly loyal to you and will work toward your benefit and protection.
addons.title: Olympus Mons

objects.text:
This staff is a must-have for all aspiring summoners who want to make sure they get their bang for their buck in helping support their allies or minions.

A summon is a being that is called upon to fight for you or serve you. This can include projections, familiars, or even entities that form a contract with you, relying on your power to sustain themselves, much like Heroic Spirits. Any summon you have now gains a 100% boost in all areas. You can temporarily increase this by using your personal energy through the staff to enhance them, for as long as you keep funneling energy. Additionally, the upkeep of your summons has become more efficient, as this staff has refined the energy you use to sustain your summons, reducing the amount of energy needed to sustain them by 25%.

Effectiveness of any magic cast is increased by 100%; casting support healing spells, though, is an increase by 150% instead.

You also gain a free loyal summon of your own design. They run on your supernatural energy, but if you have none, they use stamina. They start off being able to do minor healing, temporary shields and some magic attacks. As you grow stronger or over a long period, they will gain new abilities and become more powerful. If they die, you can revive them by expending a large amount of energy or stamina or by waiting an hour. Whether they're sentient or sapient or not is up to you.

This staff is bound to your soul and can be summoned to you whenever you wish; if it breaks, it can be unsummoned and then resummoned, good as new. You can choose its appearance as you purchase it.
objects.title: Summoner's Staff

objects.text:
You have a complete deck of tarot cards. Any answer it gives through a reading is always correct. However, how clear and detailed the answer is can change.

If the information you seek is hidden or secret, the answer will be less clear, with details being more speculative. If magic or similar abilities were used to hide it, the answer will be even more unclear and hard to understand. Asking about the future always gives less clear answers than asking about the past or present, because the future is naturally hidden from view.

The deck can also be used to help with other magic that tells the future. When used this way, the cards make that kind of magic stronger and easier to control.
objects.title: Tarot Cards

objects.text:
Are you tired of waiting for that one machine to finish? Or perhaps you'd like to age an object, like a bottle of wine, more quickly? Then this item is just for you!

The Temporal Pouch is a mystical item with the ability to accumulate Sands of Time over… well, time. When sprinkled over an inanimate object, it accelerates the object to twice its current speed, up to a maximum of 256 times.
objects.title: Temporal Pouch

objects.text:
Despite its name, it is not exactly a scroll. It can shift fluidly, becoming whatever medium best suits the reader—an ornate scroll, a classic hardback, a crisp magazine, or even a glowing screen. It adapts not only in shape, but in texture, weight, and feel, always becoming exactly what feels most natural in the moment.

Inside is an infinite collection of fictional stories. Every work is entirely original, with each narrative complete and vivid, rich characters, layered worlds, and plots that captivate from the first line to the last. Genres shift and blend—epic fantasy, surreal mystery, quiet literary pieces, speculative science fiction—each presented with an authenticity that makes them feel as though they’ve always existed, waiting to be found. Due to each being original, you will not find stories that already exist, nor will you find any derivatives or fanfictions of those already existing stories.

There is no need to search or select. The material presented adjusts instinctively to the reader’s current mood, interests, and unspoken desires. Whether in the mood for a sweeping historical saga, a quiet piece of speculative fiction, or something strange and undefinable, the next story is always precisely right.
objects.title: The Endless Scroll of Stories

objects.text:
You possess a long, ink-stained strip of parchment, coiled around a bone spool. Upon its surface are lines of scripture—familiar in form but corrupted in meaning. These writings give off a strange resonance, their rhythm clashing with the sacred, as if the heavens themselves reject them.

When read, the scripture does not speak to the ears but to the mind directly. It bypasses ordinary language and implants concepts too vast, too alien to hold. Most who attempt to comprehend it suffer momentary collapse—triggering brief but disturbing visions such as false revelations, twisted symbols, and whispers that unsettle the mind. These are not mere heresies, but warped reflections of divine words—scripture rewritten by something no longer aligned with the sacred. The effect is temporary, as the knowledge is purged almost as quickly as it is grasped, the mind instinctively sealing itself against the threat.

Yet for those who endure the storm and succeed in holding the meaning, even briefly, the rewards are immense. The scripture contains truths twisted from their divine origin but still potent—insights that can leapfrog years of study. Whether in science, magic, philosophy, or war, the reader who grasps it without breaking will find their understanding sharpened with unnatural speed. Exercise caution in applying this knowledge; its distorted nature renders it unstable, and employing it without full understanding or restraint invites consequences equal to its power.
objects.title: The Fifth Heresy

addons.text: Anyone can steal an object, they're typically not even attended. Stealing a skill, however, is a much more impressive feat. It only makes sense your Deck would reward such talent. You may seal your skills into your Combino Deck, allowing them to be used as fusion components like any regular item.
addons.title: To The Victor Go The Spoils

addons.text:
The blessing of Guiding Hands of Midas infuses your Combino Cards.

When the result of fusion would be something you would find valuable, the two component cards will glow gold, the strength of the glow determines how valuable the result will be. If the result of combining two cards is especially valuable, they will even have a slight attraction to each other.

The kleptomaniac tendencies of the deck and blessing stack together, you are filled with an uncontrollable desire to steal things you find valuable.
addons.title: Golden Fusions

objects.text:
A deck of 78 blank faced tarot cards is bound to your very soul.

These cards have the magical ability to seal and unseal anything into themselves, though this is not the true power of the cards. No, their true power lies in the ability to combine the things you've sealed in them. For example, if you take a "Gun" card and combine it with a "Lighter" card, you create a gun that shoots fireballs instead of bullets.

The cards also give you the ability of a professional magician: acrobatics, sleight of hand, mentalism skills and so on. There are some unfortunate side effects though. You get urges of kleptomania and theatrics.
objects.title: The Phantom Magus Combino Deck

objects.text:
You now possess the legendary flute of the Pied Piper, an enchanted instrument capable of bending the will of those who hear its haunting melodies. Each note you play carries an irresistible, supernatural influence, allowing you to command creatures and people alike. Different tones and tunes grant control over various entities, from swarms of rodents to groups of mesmerized children, and possibly even more powerful beings. 

However, your skill in playing it directly affects how strongly you can control others. A flawless performance can place entire crowds under your spell, while a clumsy tune may result in weak or unpredictable influence. 

The flute’s magic can be amplified by any supernatural abilities you wield, enhancing your music to hypnotize, lure, or manipulate your targets with unparalleled precision.
objects.title: The Piper’s Enchanted Flute

objects.text:
You have been entrusted with the Rod of Asclepius — the legendary staff once wielded by Asclepius himself, the demigod turned god renowned for his power to heal even the dead. Imbued with his divine essence as the God of Medicine, the rod amplifies all healing arts channeled through it by 500%.

Far more than a tool of restoration, this rod embodies Asclepius’s greatest achievement—the power to undo death itself. By channeling your will and divine or magical energy into it, you can perfectly resurrect a recently departed soul, using even the faintest shard of their being—whether DNA or soul—as a focal point. This resurrection is so complete that it can even restore a soul that was once utterly destroyed.

Though immensely powerful, the rod demands ever greater divine or magical energy the longer a soul has lingered beyond the veil, the more frequently it has dwelled there, and the more spiritual damage the soul has sustained.
objects.title: The Rod of Asclepius

objects.text:
You hold the wand of a fighter who once pretended to be a wizard to win the heart of a sorcerer, unaware she saw through his bluff from the start and simply found his desperate, bumbling attempts too endearing to expose.

The wand can develop a spell by having you speak instructions to it, defining the effect you want along with specific conditions and restrictions that limit its use. The wand then reverse-engineers these martial parameters into a functional magical formula over a period of time that scales with the spell's complexity. A simple effect like a concussive blast takes hours, while a complicated enchantment can take days or weeks. Every restriction you impose, such as reducing range, limiting valid targets to a specific creature type, requiring the spell to originate from a weapon strike, or something else, shortens the development time.

Once a spell is fully developed, you can access it in a library of spell and store it into one of the wand's three crystalline chambers, each acting as an independent spell slot. The chosen slot then begins to fill with mana, taking a minimum of one minute for a minor spell and progressively longer for stronger ones. Once a slot is fully charged, you can cast the stored spell with no cost or casting time. After you cast the spell the slot immediately begins refilling its mana. You can swap spells between the library and the slots at will, but doing so empties a slot's charge and forces it to begin refilling from nothing.
objects.title: Wand of the Fighter

objects.text:
You have acquired a modified version of the Heavenly Palm Bottle, a treasure born from the primordial chaos before creation itself. Within it reside the three thousand Daos.

The bottle possesses several extraordinary abilities. First, it can absorb moonlight or your own energy and condense it into a jade-green liquid. This liquid can transform ordinary plants into spiritual plants, restore damaged plants, and greatly accelerate the growth and maturation of spiritual plants.

Unlike the original liquid, this version can be safely consumed by any living being without causing their bodies to mutate or rapidly expand and explode. Instead, it removes impurities from the body, strengthens it, and purifies and enhances bloodlines. Given enough time, it is even capable of transforming ordinary beasts into their spiritual counterparts.

The bottle is also capable of producing a special type of grain that contains fragments of a Dao or a Law. To produce these grains, you must supply the bottle with any form of energy you possess. It can also absorb the energy contained within magical or supernatural items, treasures, materials, artifacts, and other resources at your disposal.

These grains can be used to comprehend and ultimately master the Dao or Law they embody. While the original bottle could only produce grains containing the Dao of Time, this enhanced version can generate grains containing any of the three thousand Daos.

Furthermore, anyone can now directly consume as many grains as they wish without suffering any drawbacks. Instead, doing so will greatly enhance and accelerate their comprehension and mastery of the Daos and Laws contained within the grains. The grains can also be used to refine and upgrade treasures. 

If you travel to another world with different Laws or Dao, the bottle will automatically imprint those new Daos or Laws within one month and begin producing corresponding grains.

You have complete control over the Heavenly Palm Bottle. You can summon a holographic list of all the Dao and Law grains the bottle can produce. The list automatically updates whenever a new Dao or Law is added, and you need only think of which Dao or Law a grain should contain for the bottle to produce it.

The jade-green liquid, as well as the Dao and Law grains, can be consumed safely regardless of anyone's level of power. Neither the jade-green liquid nor the grains will cause any drawbacks or adverse effects to anyone's body, mind, or soul. Additionally, you may choose whether or not the bottle contains a living spirit.
objects.title: The Heavenly Palm Bottle (A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality)

objects.text:
This is Sonam’s legendary staff, a relic thought to have unlimited access to spiritual power. It is said to be able to enhance a bender’s power beyond even that of the Avatar and to grant bending abilities to a nonbender.

Simply touching the staff will grant you the ability to bend an element of your choice, though you’ll have to start from scratch. The staff contains a residual imprint of the benders it has encountered, allowing you to learn and recreate their techniques over time. Eventually, once you have mastered your element, the staff will enable you to unlock the next element in the cycle akin to the Avatar.

You can grant others the power of bending by touching them with this staff, giving them the ability to bend an element of your choice. Such gifts of bending can be temporary or permanent, at your discretion.

Sonam’s staff also enhances your bending power, giving you strength roughly equal to that of an Avatar in the Avatar State in any element you master.
objects.title: Sonam's Staff (Avatar: The Last Airbender)

objects.text:
The Eyes of the World, also known as the Left Eye of Darkness and the Right Eye of Light, were crafted by the god of chaos, Aesir, and bestowed upon humanity. Through them, he granted his power to oversee and shape history, giving humanity free will—at the inadvertent cost of splitting himself into two. The Right Eye was entrusted to the Lumen Sages, while the Umbra Witches were given custody of the Left Eye.

The Eyes grant the power of creation that Aesir originally possessed, allowing the creation of concepts such as free will, fear, and humiliation, and even enabling manipulation of reality itself. Individually, each Eye provides a form of limited omniscience, granting the wielder perception nearly equal to that of a god and allowing them to witness the truth of history through the Remembrances of Time.

In the hands of an unprepared user, the Eyes can only express a fraction of their power; however, a skilled wielder can see through deception by observing events across time and can even unleash a beam of light powerful enough to destroy a planet. When united, the Eyes possess the power to merge the Trinity of Realities into one and grant nigh-omniscience to their wielder.

The first time you select this option, you receive one of the Eyes; the second time, you obtain both. The Eyes of the World typically choose their candidates by applying the Anthropological Principle, selecting those most capable of altering the course of history. However, in your case, you are able to wield the Eyes regardless of qualification.
objects.title: Eyes of the World (Bayonetta)

addons.text:
Your connection to the Alpha Rune has caused the Room of Requirement to evolve.
Once confined to a hidden sub-dimension, it has now become the Door to Anywhere—a gateway capable of reaching any dimension, including the Room of Requirement’s original pocket realm.

This extraordinary power, however, comes at a cost. Bound to the true name of magic, the door requires you to speak the true name of your intended destination to unlock the path.

The Come and Go Room can now truly live up to its name—it can come and go anywhere.

Note: The true name of the Room of Requirement’s dimension is, appropriately, "Room of Requirement."
addons.title: Door to Anywhere
Ruler of Legerdomain
addons.text: Your tower is now located within the Legerdomain and has been transformed into the headquarters of the dimension's former rulers. Not only is it filled with tomes of knowledge amassed by Addwaitya and Charmcaster, but it also utilizes the security measures they created—constantly shifting its true name and dimensional coordinates—to make accessing your domain extremely difficult, though not impossible. The tower retains the ability to control time dilation, allowing you to alter the flow of time within the Legerdomain and imbuing the dimansion with all the energies previously present in the tower.

objects.text:
Currently around your neck rests one of the most formidable magical artifacts: the Alpha Rune, the True Name of Magic—the keystone upon which all of Legerdomain, the Realm of Magic, is built.

The Alpha Rune bestows its bearer with complete immunity to magic and an endless well of magical power. It also amplifies the wielder’s magic, with this amulet in their possession even non-magicians are capable of casting spells.

It’s greatest ability lies in its control over Legerdomain itself. Created and sustained by the Alpha Rune, this realm teems with raw magical energy. With the Rune, you can freely alter the form and layout of Legerdomain, reshaping it to suit your needs and desires. Every time a gate to this realm is opened, some of its immense magic spills out, granting the opening point a surge of power. Within Legerdomain, time flows faster than on Earth—what feels like days here may be mere minutes on the outside.

Legerdomain’s stability is intrinsically tied to the Alpha Rune. Typically, removing or destroying the Rune would destabilize—or even destroy it——the realm. Yet, it remains surprisingly resilient: you can remove the Alpha Rune without immediate collapse, and if it’s destroyed, it will be restored within Legerdomain upon your next entry.
objects.title: The Alpha Rune (Ben 10)

objects.text: In your possession is a set of six yellow and six green rings, made by Andrew Ketterley out of magical dust. When touching a yellow ring with your bare skin, or touching someone else who is touching the ring, it will transport you to a Wood Between the Worlds, a forest-like realm with a number of small pools. Each pool corresponds to a different universe, such as the worlds of Narnia or Charn, for example. If the world is yet to be born, the pool will be shallow, with a dark, unreflective surface, and when the world ends, the corresponding pool will dry up. When arriving in the forest, you will appear next to a pool that leads to the world you came from. When touching a green ring—or someone in contact with the ring—and submerging yourself in a pool, you will be transported into a corresponding universe, with a few-second-long transition period within which, if you stop holding onto the ring and touch the yellow one, you will emerge back in the Wood Between the Worlds. Nearly any possible universe is accessible via one of the pools in this forest, albeit you have no means to tell which pool leads where unless you try it. Do note that rings activate regardless if you wish to be transported or not so long as you are touching them, so handle them carefully.
objects.title: Andrew Ketterley's Magic Rings (The Chronicles of Narnia)

objects.text:
You now own a wand that contains a single 1st level spell. For each time you buy, you can raise the level of a wand up to 4th level, or you can get another wand.

Each wand has fifty charges and doesn't hold more than that, and regains one charge per day multiplied per spell level (so one charge per day for a level one, and one charge each four days for a fourth level one). If you have some sort of magic source, you can try to recharge your wands manually.
objects.title: Magical Wand (D&D)

objects.text:
You now own a staff that contains one cantrip and one 1st level spell. For each time you buy this choice, you can do one of the following: add two spells of any existing levels; add two spells that are one level higher than the current maximum; increase the number of charges the staff can hold by 10; or gain a new staff. Each staff can have up to 6 spells of each level up to the 3rd level, 5 spells of each level up to 6th level, and 4 spells of each level up to 9th level.

The spells in the staff are fixed, unless you have the magical expertise necessary to swap them out. Each staff has 10 charges and regains half of them every day. Spells expend a number of charges equal to their level when cast, with the exception of cantrips. If you have some sort of magic source, you can try to recharge the staff manually; at most, you can increase the number of charges in the staff up to twice its normal capacity, and only one full set of charges can be regained per day.
objects.title: Magical Staff (D&D/Pathfinder)

objects.text: The artifact known as Kanai’s Cube is said to have incomprehensible powers of transmutation. With the potential for transmutation and alchemy, it can do more than transmute one material into another and one gem into a different gem. The Kanai's Cube can upgrade items into legendary treasures and open portals to teleport from one place to another. It can even break down legendary artifacts to passively grant you its power without even wearing it.
objects.title: Kanai's Cube (Diablo)

objects.text: "What can I say except, you're welcome~🎶" You receive a divine gift once owned by the trickster demigod, Maui. This hook grants you the ability to shapeshift into a wide variety of animals at will or by swinging it. You aren't stuck in that form upon doing so, easily able to switch from one to another and back to your normal form instantly. While in an animal form, the hook vanishes into a pocket dimension, and is summoned again when in your normal form. You can turn into all the animals Maui himself has changed into, and any mundane animal from Earth, or present within the world you're in. Turning into supernatural animals, like dragons, a pegasus, or cerberus is possible, but are beyond your mortal limits. The hook is also a great weapon, able to easily cut stone like paper and severely injure divine beings. In time, you can perform the same feats as Maui in the stories, like pulling an island out of the ocean, or lassoing the sun.
objects.title: Maui's Fish Hook (Disney: Moana)

objects.text: "Once upon a time, a single drop of sunlight fell from the Heavens, and from this single drop of sunlight grew a magical golden flower." This magical flower holds power over the sun, healing, life, defense, light, and purification. You also get a scroll containing the Healing and Hope Incantation. The Healing Incantation lets one heal any wound or illness, grant youth and can even revive the recently dead. The Hope Incantation bolsters the spirit of the user and those around them, and purifies their surrounding.
