As one experiments with the flower, they would find new ways of using its magic such as embodying the Sun's raw essence for empowerment, manipulating solar energies to generate and redirect beams, levitating with the power of Sun, or fully tapping the Sundrop's innermost power. If you somehow consume the flower, you become the Sundrop.
objects.title: Sundrop Flower (Disney: Tangled)

objects.text:
This Magic Hammer possesses extremely powerful regenerative properties. With a single strike, it can repair any damaged or broken inanimate object, restoring it to its pristine condition. When used on a person, it can heal any injury or physical ailment restoring them to their natural peak condition.

The hammer can also strengthen undamaged objects, increasing their durability and resilience beyond their normal limits.

Be careful to remember that the hammer has no destructive power whatsoever. It cannot injure, damage, or destroy living beings or objects. If the hammer is used to attack someone, every strike will instead heal and strengthen them.
objects.title: Magic Hammer (Disney: Wreck it Ralph)

addons.text:
You gain the ability to summon the spectral echoes of every creature that roams the lands of Elden Ring, calling them to your side in battle or for other purposes.

At first, your grasp over the bell’s power is tenuous, limiting you to summoning a single entity whose strength matches your own. However, as you attune yourself to the bell and grow accustomed to wielding its eldritch energies, your command over the spirits will increase. With time and mastery, you will be able to summon beings stronger than yourself.

Note: Unlike the in-game mechanics, this version of the Spirit Calling Bell allows you to summon any entity from Elden Ring, even those that are not normally summonable. Whether it be demigods, legendary warriors, or eldritch horrors that should not answer mortal calls, all may be drawn forth.
addons.title: Elden Lord

objects.text:
You possess the fabled Spirit Calling Bell, an artifact that allows you to beckon forth spirits from beyond the veil. To summon a being, you must first claim its essence by obtaining its Spirit Ash, a spectral imprint left behind upon its defeat.

Fortunately, the bell aids you in this process. Any entity you personally slay has a chance of leaving behind its Spirit Ash, which the bell will automatically absorb upon their death. The greater the foe, the rarer and more powerful its Ash, allowing you to bind its spirit to your call. However, some beings may resist this process, requiring special conditions or powerful bindings to claim their essence.

There are no restrictions on what you may summon—beasts, warriors, demigods, or even eldritch nightmares—so long as you have bested them and taken their Ash. However, the number of spirits you can call forth at once is limited by your own familiarity with the bell. In the beginning, you can summon only one entity at a time, but as you grow more attuned to its power, your capacity expands, allowing you to command multiple spirits simultaneously.

These spirits are bound to you, answering your summons with unwavering loyalty. They retain their full strength, abilities, and knowledge, making them invaluable allies—but they are still spectral echoes, not immortal beings. They can be struck down, dispelled, or even resisted by those with the right protections. Mastery of the bell is not just about collecting powerful spirits, but learning when and how to summon them for maximum effect.
objects.title: Spirit Calling Bell (Elden Ring)
The Paintbrush (Epic Mickey)
objects.text:
In your hands is a tool of endless imagination, the magic Paintbrush of Yen Sid that he used to create a world for forgotten Toons which would come to be known as the Wasteland.

At its core, The Paintbrush has two pools of energy that it pulls from, those being Paint and Thinner with it firing out either a stream or a shotgun blast of both out from the brush tip. Paint is creation and animation, it forms the structure of a thing and can be used to reform anything that Thinner destroys, with mastery of Paint one may even be able to bring life to their own Toon or repair unpainted things. Thinner is destruction and strips paint away, useful for clearing rubble or opening up a new door through a wall and when used on Toons it will melt them but not kill as a splash of Paint will bring them right back, with mastery of Thinner one can even melt through unpainted things and end a Toon for good.

When used properly and with care, The Paintbrush can be used to create wonders straight from the users thoughts as castles and amusement parks form with the flick of the wrist, but if used recklessly can lead to catastrophic creations, a small figure of a mouse ballooning into a monster as Paint and Thinner mix into volatile Ink.

The Paintbrush can also change sizes depend on the users will with it's normal form being the same size as a 9.5mm paint brush and it's maximum sizes is more like a club. Regardless of size The Paintbrush is as durable as steel.

Breidablik is a legendary relic that was sealed in Askr, it takes the form of a white and gold object shaped like a pistol. Breidablik uses Orbs as ammunition to fire heroes from it, summoning them from other worlds. Your version is not limited to heroes from the Fire Emblem series. You are able to summon people you might have connections with, otherwise, you cannot choose who you summon. It takes 5 Orbs to summon. The person you summon cannot harm you, however you cannot control them either. Breidablik allows you to heal and revive people that you summon, and you can dismiss people you summon at any time, returning them to their original world. It also allows you to use the abilities of people you summon, however you lose access to them if you dismiss that summon. You gain 1 Orb every day.
objects.title: Breidablik (Fire Emblem: Heroes)

objects.text:
Once mighty artifacts that formed the barrier between the worlds of Abeir and Toril, these fragmented stones are now mere shadows of their former selves, created directly by the Overgod Ao. By a miraculous twist of fate, the broken tablets have found it's way into your soul. Is it providence? Destiny? Such concepts are meaningless to you. Even a small piece of the tablet is enough to obscure your place in the cosmic order, blinding you to prophecy and protecting your Fate from manipulation.

Though shattered, this fragment still holds tremendous potential. Once, it housed the records of all the gods and primordials in the universe. A sliver of that power remains, waiting to be unlocked. A magician might use it to create a mythical artifact, a cultivator might gain insight into great daos from studying it, or a fellow god might evolve by studying the records of primordials. But figuring out how to use its true potential is up to you.
objects.title: Broken Tablet of Fate (Forgotten Realms)

objects.text:
Whenever two creatures standing on the carpet accumulate a sufficient static charge and make physical contact, their consciousnesses instantly swap bodies.

The effect functions regardless of species, allowing body swaps between humans, animals, and other living creatures.
objects.title: Electron Carpet (Gravity Falls)

objects.text: This unassuming set of cards is the Deck of X-Playing Cards, 52 in total. Each card is absolutely indestructible and grants its wielder a unique power when activated by the word “Play” followed by the card’s name. While a typical X-Playing Card is said to “choose” its wielder—more commonly referred to as the “Player”—all cards you purchase here will answer to you or anyone you decide to grant a card to. When activated, the X-Playing Card transforms into gloves, tailored to its respective ability and bearing the symbol of its suite. While active, the card also provides a general physical boost corresponding to the value of the card, with Aces providing something close to a Brute 6 or 7, while a Two would barely be considered more than peak human. The Suit of Clubs—including Metallic Parade, Green Green, Wing Wind, G Round, Shallow Blue, Lethal Scoville, Sinking Shadow, Rising Light, Million Volt, Coming Home, Gladiator, Reaper’s Hand, and Another Lives—grants its players the ability to control natural elements and forces such as metal, plants, wind, earth, water, fire, shadow, light, electricity, attractive force, repulsive force, death touch, and corpse control. The Suit of Hearts—including Jelly Crawler, Rockin’ Rock, Agent S, Calorie High, THE Zoo, Chameleon, Mun Pheremone Mun, Marvelous Genius, Sensitive Sense, Sky Dancer, Sonic Move, Masculine Parfait, and Faceless—bestows powers that affect the body, such as increased strength, speed, durability, or senses, as well as abilities like flight, regeneration, pheromone manipulation, invisibility, animal hybridism and the ability to copy the appearance—and Cards—of someone else. The Suit of Spades—including Neo New Nambu, USHENBAN, Clear Lance, Brain Buster, Juggling Gun, Interceptor, All Kaboom, BOKKA, Honest Straight, Noah Metal, Gorgon Whip, San Galgano, and Love & Peace—provides its players with various objects and items such as swords, guns, motorcycles, armor, and explosives. The Suit of Diamonds—including Love Connection, Marble Rumble, Time Mime, Greatest Man, 13 Stairs, Never No Dollars, Red Labyrinth, No Mercy, Unlucky Poky, Out of Five, Balor, Round & Rounnd and Dynamic Kinesis——grants more random powers such as object linking, age manipulation, animal uplifting, door connection, energy absorption, luck manipulation, sensory control, and telekinesis. It's possible to play multiple cards together to form a legal poker hand, called an X-Hand. Playing such a hand grants the player the combined abilities and physical boosts of all the played cards but typically imposes a much greater toll on the player, often risking death. However, this deck lacks that risk, and it will never allow you to activate more than five cards at once.
objects.title: Royal Flush? (HIGH CARD)

addons.text:
Your Evil Pieces have changed into Brave Saint Cards. As a result, you no longer have 16 Evil Pieces, but instead 13 Cards of a Single Suit: clubs (♣), diamonds (♦), hearts (♥), or spades (♠). 

Each card instead of reincarnating people into Devils can reincarnate any ensouled beings into permeant Angels. Meaning that even aliens and soul having AI can become Angels. Any Angels made this way will never become a Fallen, no matter their actions. 

Angels made from Brave Saint Cards start with a single pair of wings and the ability to wield Holy Light, and over time with training and effort will gain more power and wings.

Also to make up for the reduced number of cards, each card can now reincarnate any being so long as they are weaker than you are currently and have equal or less potential than an Endbringer. 

Angels made this way can also receive a massive power boost when working with other angels who’s card values equal “Black Jack” or 21. Plus, any Evil Pieces that would have become mutated, instead become Joker Cards which can reincarnate far more powerful beings and can “Black Jack” with any other Angels.
addons.title: Brave Saints

addons.text:
Your Evil Pieces have changed into Fallen Saint Cards. As a result, you no longer have 16 Evil Pieces, but instead 13 Cards of a Single Suit: clubs (♣), diamonds (♦), hearts (♥), or spades (♠). 

Each card instead of reincarnating people into Devils can reincarnate any ensouled beings into permeant Fallen Angels. Meaning that even aliens and soul having AI can become Fallen Angels.

Fallen Angels made from Fallen Saint Cards start with a single pair of wings and the ability to wield Holy Light, and over time with training and effort will gain more power and wings. Like all Fallen Angels, they will also gain complete understanding of all seductive, charisma, and sin.

Also to make up for the reduced number of cards, each card can now reincarnate any being so long as they are weaker than you are currently and have equal or less potential than an Endbringer. 

Fallen Angels made this way can also receive a massive power boost when working with other angels who’s card values equal “Black Jack” or 21. Plus, any Evil Pieces that would have become mutated, instead become Joker Cards which can reincarnate far more powerful beings and can “Black Jack” with any other Fallen Angels.
addons.title: Fallen Saints

addons.text:
All your Evil Pieces have changed to perfect transformation spell-stones. Now the power of each Evil Piece is greatly boosted making each equal in power to a regular mutate Evil Piece. 

Each of your new Evil Pieces can now reincarnate just about any non-divine being into an Angel-Fallen-Devil hybrid, or any combination of species you are. Reincarnated full hybrids will not only have both devil magic and holy light, but also be vastly more powerful right from the beginning. 

Full hybrids are also, like you, capable of bypassing barriers that ward against evil or good, learn powers that are normally exclusive to good or evil beings, and gain immunity against all types of lie detection, with every supernatural power always treating your words as truth. These additional powers do not work on you without your consent (you can be mastered into giving consent).
addons.title: Complete Harmony

objects.text:
Evil Pieces work by reincarnating a non-devil being into a devil. The reincarnated devil gains devil-like abilities such as devil magic, the ability to speak any language, and the ability to understand any spoken language. However, the reincarnated devil also inherits the weaknesses of the devil race. 

Evil Pieces are chess piece-shaped objects that come in a set of 15. The set includes one Queen (♛), two Rooks (♜), two Bishops (♝), two Knights (♞), and eight Pawns (♟). Each piece has unique abilities and strengths that differ depending on the type.

Evil Pieces are capable of transforming other beings into devils through reincarnation. However, the success of the reincarnation process depends on the strength of the king and the potential of the being. If the being is too powerful, it cannot be reincarnated, regardless of the number of Evil Pieces used. Interestingly, even recently deceased beings can be reborn with an Evil Piece.

Evil Pieces are a set of chess-like pieces that possess demonic powers. In this set, the queen is the most powerful piece, worth nine pawns, and has all the characteristics of the other evil pieces. Those who are given a queen piece are usually considered the right-hand person of the peerage. Rooks are worth five pawns and are known for their supernatural strength and durability, which they lend to the team. Bishops gain more demonic power and magical abilities. Bishops perform well in support or offense roles. They are worth three pawns, but their strength lies in the spells they conjure. Knights have increased speed and mobility. They are also worth three pawns. Finally, pawns possess the ability to promote themselves to other Evil Pieces when they are in enemy territory or have permission from their king.

In some cases, Evil Pieces can become mutated, granting the user more power and requiring fewer pieces to reincarnate.
objects.title: Evil Pieces (High School DxD)

addons.text: You are no longer nurturing a mere seed of divinity—you now command a fully established Pantheon. If you have Seraph, it will follow the biblical interpretation of Heaven, while Imaginary Number District would be more inspired by the study of Aleister Crowley, and Artificial Heaven would be a freely built Heaven. A template to follow if chosen with Seraph. At the heart lies The Infinite Heaven, a boundless, ever-expanding sanctuary where most souls find eternal rest, peace, or reincarnation—a self-sustaining reservoir of belief and spiritual energy. Nearby stands The Divine Research Center, a fusion of science, theology, and cosmology, where the laws of existence are studied and their workings and effects on the System are refined by angelic scholars and divine intelligence. Floating far above the others is The Pitch-Black Heaven, a starless abyss reserved for deep contemplation and interstellar observation. It doubles as a prison of unmatched security, where entities too dangerous to destroy are bound in silence. Below it, the Seraph Headquarters serves as the strategic and spiritual nerve center of your angelic hierarchy—its command staff composed of the highest-ranking celestial beings, overseeing miracles, incarnations, and metaphysical warfare. At the core of all divine creation lies the Garden of Eden, a realm of perfection untouched by sin, where the Tree of Life pulses with the raw essence of creation. This garden nourishes the system itself, fueling miracles and sustaining your holy order with its fruits and divine waters. While the system now functions autonomously, it lacks the full authority of the original God’s throne. The highest Heaven, from which the divine code could be written and the system altered with a thought, remains sealed unless you obtain the Heaven's Terror add-on. As it stands, you can maintain and expand your divine dominion, but only at the level of DxD Michael.
addons.title: Seven Heavens (High School DxD)
Seat of Power
addons.text:
Your World serves as the perfect “home territory” and place of origin for your nascent cosmology.

Your World’s isolated nature and your absolute ownership of it allows for the development of your system to rapidly progress once you finish hardcoding the foundation of your cosmology, for in your World your nascent cosmology is the only one to exist and as such can grow and develop unopposed.

In the same breath, your developing cosmology provides the metaphysical infrastructure to expand your World and develop it beyond being a simple planet in a pocket dimension. As your cosmology grows and develops or integrates new realms, your World comes to take center stage as the seat of power for your Cosmology.

As your World becomes increasingly integrated with the S.E.E.D., your control over it deepens accordingly. You can shape not only its physical environment but also its metaphysical properties, defining how its natural laws, magical systems, and other supernatural phenomena function within its boundaries. What was once simply a world you owned gradually becomes the physical foundation upon which your entire cosmology is built.

Eventually, your World effectively becomes your Seat of Divinity, serving as the central anchor through which you administer and expand your cosmology. The S.E.E.D. can use it as a controlled foundation for developing new divine infrastructure, while the World itself continuously adapts to accommodate whatever your growing cosmology requires. New realms, divine systems, and metaphysical laws can be connected back to your World, making it the heart from which your entire cosmology grows.

objects.text:
You possess a S.E.E.D. of Heaven, the primordial construct used by the God of the Bible to forge his celestial realm. Although referred to as a "seed," it is in truth a hypercomplex blend of thaumaturgical, magical, and technological systems, capable of growing into a fully realized metaphysical divine artifact, serving as the cornerstone for an entire pantheon, a self-expanding framework for myth, faith, and cosmic infrastructure.

At its initial Stage 0: The Divine Workshop, the seed exists in a state of perfect malleability. Within a boundless mental command space, your own Seat of Divinity, you may define every foundational element: cosmological structure, theological paradigm, aesthetic theme. From familiar frameworks like the classical Heaven and Hell, to Norse Asgard, Japanese Takamagahara, or entirely custom mythos, the seed simulates ideal materials, environmental needs, and final configuration, offering complete oversight from the most abstract using interfaces to the most bare-bones of logical magical matrices and theological phenomena. This stage allows you to conceptualize abstract metaphysics, program repeatable miracles as divine "code", and define fundamental cosmic laws, ensuring coherence before manifestation.

Stage 1: Foundation begins when the seed is planted/anchored to a specific belief structure, whether monotheistic, polytheistic, or something wholly abstract. This stage hardcodes the laws, cause-effect dynamics, and metaphysical architecture through which your system will function, such as how prayer fuels miracles or the fundamental nature of morality within your cosmos. Flaws introduced here can have significant and lasting consequences.

Stage 2: Ignition activates with the spark of belief, pulling in raw faith energy to initiate divine processes. However, at this stage, your budding Heaven is vulnerable; without innate defenses, foreign ideologies, hostile entities, or corrupted faith can interfere or destabilize the construct. Careful management of this influx is crucial.

In Stage 3: Expansion, the system expands its complexity—your pantheon begins to form. This includes assigning layers or domains of function, crafting afterlives as belief farms, generating realms of punishment as reservoirs of souls, designing autonomous miracle engines, and the creation of your "angels" – including their dwellings, armories, and logistical centers. This stage builds out the functional infrastructure of your divine system.

Each layer reinforces the system’s ability to sustain faith, produce divine acts, and establish your authority.

Finally, Stage 4: Apotheosis completes the tethering of your Heaven to the fabric of reality. It integrates so deeply into existence that even universal collapse cannot erase it; should it be destroyed, it will resurrect itself from conceptual anchors embedded in space-time. From this point forward, the system enters a passive growth phase, continuously expanding by harvesting resources, belief, and souls to develop new facilities and divine infrastructure, potentially self-augmenting, converting conquests into new realms (e.g., annexing hellscapes to fuel paradise).
objects.title: S.E.E.D. of Heaven (High School DxD)

addons.text:
Through the fusion of spiritual will and divine essence, your weapon transcends the boundaries of ordinary Asauchi and Sacred Gears, evolving into something greater—your Soul Gear, a manifestation of your very being. Unlike conventional weapons, a Soul Gear is not just an extension of your power but the very embodiment of your soul, ambitions, and destiny, growing alongside you, evolving in ways no predefined system could ever anticipate.

A Soul Gear does not merely possess power; it is alive, an extension of your will, reacting dynamically to your growth, emotions, and battle experience. Whether through martial mastery, spiritual refinement, or sheer willpower, it continuously evolves, adapting its abilities to match your path. Unlike conventional Sacred Gears or Asauchi, this weapon does not follow preset evolutionary lines—instead, its potential is shaped by your unique soul and experiences, granting abilities impossible for others to replicate.

At its core, a Soul Gear is a living concept, drawing upon your very existence to unleash abilities beyond traditional magic, ki, or reiryoku. It can forge connections to multiple energy systems, integrating different supernatural forces, making it capable of wielding conceptual, divine, or reality-defying abilities without limitations. This allows for fusions of techniques, bloodline powers, and supernatural affinities that would otherwise be incompatible.

However, because a Soul Gear is an extension of its wielder’s soul and will, its power is deeply tied to one’s mental and spiritual stability. Those who lack the conviction, determination, or self-awareness to wield such a weapon risk instability, as the Soul Gear will always reflect the true nature of its wielder—for better or worse. Should one falter, their weapon may fracture, lose its power, or even reject them entirely.

With this, your path is your own. Unlike other warriors bound by static evolution's or preordained strengths, you are free to define your power, forging a weapon that is uniquely yours, a Soul Gear without limits.
addons.title: Soul Gear

objects.text:
A Sacred Gear is an object containing the power, abilities, and soul of some mythical creature defeated and imprisoned within by God of the Abrahamic faiths.

The gear is placed securely in your soul and while the creature can communicate with you, it is sentient and sapient, and shares its supernatural essence with you. It cannot in any way harm you without your consent.

You can pick any Sacred Gear shown in canon including the Longinus-class Gears. You only start out with their basic abilities and forms and have to work your way up to their true power, Balance Breaker states and beyond.

Any Sacred Gear you pick that is not Longinus-class has the ability to evolve into that level of power.

Be aware that while they are securely contained within your soul, their essence still somewhat leaks out into you, leading to a person having a draconic Sacred Gear to becoming a bit more draconic themselves, and gaining a faint dragon-like aura as an example.
objects.title: Sacred Gear (High School DxD)

addons.text:
You have uncovered the long-forgotten legacy of your heritage as a direct descendant of Helga Hufflepuff, one of the famous Hogwarts Founders. With no other known heirs, you claim your rightful place within the castle's storied walls.

The Founder once resided in a luxurious suite of rooms within the castle, and now they open before you, containing the knowledge and treasures from Helga’s life.

As you delve deeper into your newfound heritage, you find a natural affinity for Herbology, Potions, and Enchantments. You also gain a strong connection to the element of earth.

Finally you unlock the last secrets of Helga’s legendary Cup. It has the ability to reproduce any liquid it has ever contained, and its very presence brings fertility to the lands you own, filling them with life and vitality.
addons.title: True Heir of Hufflepuff

objects.text:
This golden cup, said to have been created by the Hogwarts Founder, Helga Hufflepuff herself, holds a variety of secrets. It’s most basic feature is the ability to change its size and shape, allowing it to take the form of any vessel that can hold liquid the user desires. The cup automatically maintains optimal conditions for any liquid within, which the founder often used to ensure potions and elixirs were brewed to perfection.

The cup can auto-brew any potion the user desires, provided the ingredients are present and the recipe is known. It also enables the user to bypass external constraints such as time or lunar phases.

Its greatest aspect, however, is its capacity for internal transmutation. This powerful artifact allows the user to transform any liquid within the cup into any other liquid known to the user. With this a user can effortlessly convert water into blood, wine, Liquid Luck, or even molten gold, the cup even prevents any residue sticking to the sides when poured.

Do note that once a liquid leaves the confines of the cup, any magic maintaining it as a liquid will cease. This can have dangerous and unexpected consequences.
objects.title: Cup of Helga Hufflepuff (Harry Potter)

addons.text:
Your ability to slay the greatest enemy of leaders everywhere has enhanced your Self-Writing Quill beyond what it was originally designed for. Your quill can now complete your paperwork in the same timeframe as if you had done it yourself, with your only input being to tell it to do it for you.

In addition, your quill can now channel your magic and other esoteric abilities, allowing you to use it to set up an entire ritual by itself in no more than 30 minutes as if you fully dedicated yourself to it.
addons.title: Phoenix Feather

objects.text: Weasleys' Wizard Wheezes, known for its innovative magical gadgets, offers a unique product that is sure to impress: the Self-Writing Quill. The quill is imbued with advanced magical abilities, allowing it to write on its own, only requiring minimal input from its user. It is connected to the user's mind, allowing them to communicate telepathically with the quill, telling it what to write. The quill is also capable of limited flight, allowing it to hover and follow its user around, and has limitless ink, meaning it can never run out. Its handwriting is also exceptional, making it the perfect tool for writing formal documents, taking notes in class, or simply recording your thoughts. With its advanced features and convenient design, the Self-Writing Quill is a must-have for any wizard or witch looking to improve their writing efficiency.
objects.title: Self-Writing Quill (Harry Potter)

addons.text:
As the personification of Death itself, the true power of the Elder Wand is revealed to you.

The Wand can take the form of any weapon or focus you desire and serves as the perfect conduit and focus for all of your powers. The boost to magic you cast extends to all powers channeled through the Wand, and the boost is further amplified when channeling abilities related to life and death. Furthermore, all abilities related to life and death have their costs drastically reduced when channeled through the Wand, to the point of being effectively free to use.

The mastery of magic the Wand bestows upon you has ingrained itself into your soul, making the usage of all forms of magic and other supernatural energies much smoother for you. Your power effortlessly flows within you and seems almost eager to follow your command, providing an intuitive understanding of the intricacies of your own spells.
addons.title: Scythe of Death

objects.text: The Elder Wand is one of the three Deathly Hallows, and you have become its master. This wand will always be loyal to you and you alone, significantly amplifying any magic it casts. You can make charms and transfigurations permanent, and charms become more potent. In a duel, you will almost always emerge victorious against someone weaker than you, but you will be challenged when it comes to someone of equal or greater strength.
objects.title: The Elder Wand (Harry Potter)

addons.text: Now, instead of being limited to cabinets, you can build and link in wardrobes. Thanks to their increased size, they’re much more convenient to travel through, though a little harder to transport. The wardrobes also inherit the ability of Andrew Ketterley’s rings to travel between worlds. They can send you to the Wood Between the Worlds or to any world you know, but the trip is one-way. To return home, you’ll need another wardrobe at your destination, which you can then link to the Wardrobe Network.
addons.title: The Wardrobe

objects.text: You gain a matching set of Vanishing Cabinets, items of furniture that can transfer whatever they contain between themselves, bypassing all defences and restrictions. These cabinets are most often used in pairs as hidden passageways for escape or discreet travel. The cabinets come with built-in secrecy charms that prevent anyone who doesn’t already know of their existence from discovering them or noticing them being used. They can also change their appearance to better suit their surroundings, though they will still clearly be cabinets. If you possess Witchcraft & Wizardry, you’ll find yourself able to easily recreate these cabinets and link them all together into a “network.” To travel to a specific cabinet, you need only think of its name—which you can choose—or its location. The Vanishing Cabinets don’t care about distance. A cabinet could travel to the other side of the universe, if you could somehow get one there.
objects.title: Vanishing Cabinets (Harry Potter)
Titan Amulet (Huntik: Secrets and Seekers)
objects.text:
You receive a magical amulet that will let you summon an otherworldy being known as a titan. That once summoned will do your bidding until you dismiss it or until it receives enough damage to forcibly send it back to the titan world until it heals.

Titans have been around since the ancient times. Many legends, myths or folklores were in fact retellings of encounters between titans and ancient humans. Because of this, most titans resemble and have abilities similar to those of some mythological creatures like centaurs, mermaids, golems and many, many more.

You can choose any non-legendary titan that appeared in the series or tie in comics.

You also get some measure of control over the form the amulet takes, it doesn't have to be the same that the original series. You could turn it from a ring to a collar, a hairpin or whatever small jewel you can think of.

The mana cube is one of the most basic yet highly efficient tools for mages. This simple device amplifies a caster's spells, boosting their power by 50% when channeled through the cube. It also serves as a casting aid, allowing incantations and material requirements to be sped up or lowered, depending on the spell. Its greatest strength lies in its simplicity; even a novice mage can easily learn to craft one with some study. This ease of production makes it easily reproducible. Only a single cube can be wielded at a time so stacking cubes is impossible. But studying its creation paves the way for crafting powerful tools with the mana cube as its foundation. Despite its name, the cube can be utilized with any type of magical energy—whether it's Qi, Ether, Spirit, or others.
objects.title: Mana Cube (I Am the Sorcerer King)

objects.text: You have gained the Twelve Talismans of Shendu. These Talismans are a powerful set of magical items, each magically ripped from Shendu to form the keys to his prison, each representing a power originally stolen from the twelve animals of the Chinese zodiac. Each Talisman possesses its own unique power that can be harnessed at the will of its user. The Rat Talisman grants the Power of Animation. It allows the user to bring inanimate objects to life. Should a statue or similar work represent a known being such as Superman, the animated object will have those powers as well. Though it will at all times retain the durability of the original object. The Ox Talisman grants the Power of Super Strength. It allows the user the ability to effortlessly lift multiple tons, and knock back larger opponents with ease. The Tiger Talisman grants the Power of Spiritual Balance. It allows the user to smoothly utilize multiple Talismans, and even allows the binding of the Talismans powers to oneself. It can also be used with a piece of an object to find the missing pieces. This particular Talisman has a noticeable vulnerability, it’s easily broken in half, when this happens the users light and dark sides will be split forming two doppelgangers who represent either side of the user. The Rabbit Talisman grants the Power of Super speed. It allows the user to move and react at speeds faster than the speed of sound. It can also be used to increase the speed of objects and vessels such as cars, or planes. The Dragon Talisman grants the Power of Combustion. It allows the user to shoot powerful blasts of fire, capable of enormous levels of destruction. This power draws strength from the user’s emotions, can can even be used for a degree of limited flight. The Snake Talisman grants the Power of Invisibility. It allows the user to grant themselves (and their clothing) invisibility, and can also be used to grant invisibility to other objects as well. The Horse Talisman grants the Power of Healing. It allows the user to heal themselves or others through regeneration and is capable of dealing with all sorts of ills and ailments from simple injuries or diseases, to complex poisons, and life threatening injuries. It’s also capable of repairing broken objects as well. The Sheep Talisman grants the Power of Astral Projection. It allows the user to eject their soul from their body and wander as a spirit. In this form, one is invisible, inaudible, able to fly through the air, pass through walls, and even enter another person’s dreams. The user is capable of ejecting the souls of others, and therefore with some effort able to be used to swap bodies with another being. The Monkey Talisman grants the Power of Shapeshifting. It allows the user to permanently turn anyone and anything into any animal that has ever existed. It is also capable of reverting any such changes made to the original forms. The Rooster Talisman grants the Power of Telekinesis. It allows the user to telekinetically fly, and lift objects multiple times their own weight. The stronger the user’s mental strength and willpower are, the more weight and speed could be achieved. The Dog Talisman grants the Power of Immortality. It allows the user to remain completely immune to injuries and attacks, though does not fully prevent the sensation of pain. The talisman also restores one’s energies from mental and physical, to the more esoteric. The Pig Talisman grants the Power of Thermal Vision. It allows the user to shoot beams of heat from their eyes, with enough power and precision to cut through armored plate with precision. It also allows the user to see the invisible, and to see in the dark.
objects.title: The Shendu Talismans (Jackie Chan Adventures)

objects.text:
This piano, which constantly changes materials whenever it is unobserved, carries within it a strange, otherworldly music. It requires no tuning, and when left alone, it plays by itself endlessly, producing a song that carries notes that should not be possible.

As the owner of the Noetic Piano, you will hear this song inside your head constantly, no matter where you are. The piano's song changes and warps with everything you experience, almost like a living thing. You are likewise given a perfect recall of every section of the endless song, and can play it on the piano itself. Each part of the song is, in fact, a record of every phenomenon you have ever encountered and observed, and by playing it, you may reproduce that phenomenon, encoding it within yourself as a single-use power. Similarly, you may impart that imprint on others with similar limitations. You may play and store any number of phenomena within yourself, as well as multiple instances of the same one.

As a bonus, you are now a virtuoso with the piano.
objects.title: Noetic Piano (Laboratorium CYOA)

objects.text:
You receive a full World Rune. The World Runes are potent symbols in the realm that hold a deep connection to the planet itself. These ancient runes possess immense magical energy and are tied to the very essence of the world you arrive.

Each World Rune represents a specific aspect of the planet, embodying its elements, ecosystems, or natural forces. They serve as conduits of power, tapping into the fundamental energies that shape Runeterra's landscapes, flora, and fauna.

They have the ability to grant extraordinary abilities and augment the wielder's connection to the planet. By harnessing a World Rune, you can tap into its energy, gaining heightened control over related elements or unlocking unique abilities specific to the rune's domain.

However, their utilization requires great caution, as tampering with these runes can disrupt the delicate balance of the planet and have catastrophic consequences.
objects.title: World Rune (League of Legends)

objects.text:
The Ocarina of Time is a powerful divine artifact passed down from the royal family of Hyrule; it is an orb-shaped flute that can create extremely powerful magical effects depending on the songs played with it.

You are granted the knowledge and ability to play the various songs from the game—several of which you can use to warp to specific locations, depending on the melody used—these include:

- Saria’s Song: This can be used to communicate with someone, no matter the distance between you.

- The Song of Storms: Can summon a massive thunderstorm in seconds and change the weather according to your desires.

- The Song of Time: The most famous and powerful song in the game, which allows its user to control time, commonly used for time travel, but with further experimentation, it can be used in other ways.

- The Sun Song: Possibly a variant of the Song of Time, it allows the user to change day to night, skipping forward in time.

As a divine artifact, the true limits of the Ocarina are boundless; with enough talent and effort, you can create new songs with various powerful effects.
objects.title: The Ocarina of Time (Legend of Zelda)

addons.text:
As the bearer of all three Triforce pieces, you unlock the full potential of the Triforce of Courage, becoming the ultimate inheritor of its combined legacy. By channeling the Triforce of Courage’s power to recall the past, you gain the complete knowledge, skills, and abilities of Zelda and Ganondorf, including their vast physical and magical powers. 

This mastery allows you to wield their spells, techniques, and combat abilities as though they were your own.

Additionally, you can freely transform your gender and race, shifting seamlessly between Gerudo, Hylian, and Sheikah forms. This transformation does not diminish your power or abilities but allows you to adapt to different situations.

However, the knowledge and power of the divine entities Hylia, Demise, and the Fierce Deity remain beyond your reach. These higher powers are beyond the grasp of any mortal, no matter how mighty.

Unlike traditional bearers of the Triforce, who receive a single omnipotent wish upon unifying the artifact, you do not gain such a wish. Instead, the Triforce is irrevocably bound to you, ensuring it cannot leave your possession or seek another bearer. No force can separate you from its divine power, making you the eternal master of all three fragments.

With the full Triforce unified within you, you are a living embodiment of balance and mastery, wielding the combined power of courage, wisdom, and strength.
addons.title: Threefold Inheritor

objects.text:
You are the chosen bearer of the Triforce of Courage, a fragment of the Farore’s resolve and a remnant of her divine spirit. This artifact fills you with unshakable bravery, granting the strength to face any challenge, no matter how dire, without hesitation or fear. With the courage bestowed by this fragment, you embody the spirit of an unyielding hero.

The Triforce of Courage also grants mastery over weapons and artifacts. Any tool or weapon, no matter how complex or foreign, becomes an extension of your will within moments. You wield these with unparalleled skill, unlocking their full potential and using them with precision and power. 

Additionally, you gain the collective knowledge and experience of all previous bearers of the Triforce of Courage, including the countless reincarnations of the legendary hero, Link.

This fragment marks you with a heroic presence, inspiring allies and intimidating foes. Those who stand with you are emboldened, drawing strength from your courage, while your enemies falter in the face of your unwavering resolve.

You are the living embodiment of bravery and strength, wielding a fragment of a goddess’s indomitable will to conquer any trial and defend the realms from darkness. But take care that if somebody embodies and showcase Courage greater than yours, the Triforce can leave you.
objects.title: Triforce of Courage (Legend of Zelda)

objects.text:
You are the chosen bearer of the Triforce of Power, a fragment of Din’s divine might and a remnant of the goddess's own strength. This artifact infuses you with an endless pool of power that increases vitality, energy, and strength, elevating you far beyond other mortals. 

As long as you hold the Triforce of Power, your life force, magic energy, and stamina are infinitely regenerating, incapable of depletion no matter how much you exert yourself. Injuries, ailments, and even curses are nullified, leaving you perpetually at your peak.

This power also grants you immortality. Even if your body is destroyed, your soul obliterated, or your essence scattered across the planes, the Triforce of Power ensures your inevitable return.

Seals or imprisonment are only temporary setbacks; given time, all barriers weaken, and you will escape to continue your existence. As long as this divine fragment resides within you, nothing can truly end your being.

The Triforce of Power also marks you with an undeniable aura of dominance, a symbol of its divine origin. Those in your presence feel the weight of your power, and lesser beings often cower before you.

You are the living embodiment of strength, wielding a fragment of a goddess’s unyielding essence. But take care that if somebody embodies and desire Power more than you, the Triforce can leave you.
objects.title: Triforce of Power (Legend of Zelda)

objects.text:
You are the chosen bearer of the Triforce of Wisdom, a fragment of Nayru’s insight and a remnant of her divine understanding. This artifact imbues you with unmatched magical energy, unparalleled control over your power, and an innate mastery of universal truths. 

As its wielder, you are attuned to the structure of reality itself, perceiving the threads that bind existence and understanding the correct course of action in any situation.

The Triforce of Wisdom grants you vast knowledge of divine laws, the arcane arts, and the workings of the Zelda Universe. You can effortlessly learn and master any form of magic within its realm, from the most ancient spells to the arcane techniques of modern practice. 

With this divine wisdom, you gain the ability to manipulate time itself, glimpsing into the past or future and even altering the flow of events.

This artifact radiates a serene yet commanding aura, a reflection of its divine origin. Those in your presence instinctively sense your profound intellect and understanding, often deferring to your judgment. With the Triforce of Wisdom, you are not only a beacon of knowledge but a guardian of balance, ensuring that the truths of the universe are upheld.

You are the embodiment of foresight and wisdom, wielding a fragment of a goddess’s infinite intellect to guide, protect, and reshape reality itself. But take care that if somebody embodies and exercises their Wisdom better than you, the Triforce can leave you.
objects.title: Triforce of Wisdom (Legend of Zelda)

objects.text:
You have acquired the six supernatural artefacts known as the Treasures of Amset-Ra. They are the Golden Crystal, Golden Staff, Golden Scarab Shield, Soul Diamond, Golden Sword, and Golden Neme. Each possesses a unique supernatural ability that, when united, had granted Amset-Ra the potential to conquer the world.

The Golden Crystal grants the ability to control all the beasts of the desert, from the smallest beetle to the largest crocodile.

The Golden Staff increases the strength of the forces its wielder commands tenfold and mystically protects them against damage and harm.

The Golden Scarab Shield mystically shields the wielder from all attacks, further making it so the wielder cannot even be touched unless they allow so, rendering them invulnerable.

The Soul Diamond grants the ability to create mirages and illusions, even on a large scale, such as making a sandstorm have the appearance of a clear sunny day.

The Golden Sword grants its wielder the might and skill of Egypt’s mightiest warriors.

The Golden Neme grants the wearer visions of the future and allows the usage of the united power of the Treasures of Amset-Ra.
objects.title: Treasures of Amset-Ra (LEGO Pharaoh’s Quest)

objects.text:
You are now in possession of a demigod-level sealed artefact, a beautiful silver mirror that a certain spirit uses to communicate through. Although it is called a sealed artefact, it lacks the required Beyonder characteristics. This deficit does not affect its ability to use the powers of seq 3 of both the Tyrant and White Tower pathways, granting it access to knowledge throughout most of the known world, including other worlds like the astral world or spirit world, for example.

To access its knowledge, one must ask it a question; it can answer by writing on its surface, mimicking the voices of people or by showing the moment on its surface, akin to a video.

However, when you ask a question, it also requires something in return. This can come in the form of a question, a mission, or a punishment, depending on what you ask of it. Also, it chooses to only answer questions in the presence of others. For questions, it can choose anything but normally likes to ask questions about embarrassing or awkward topics for the user. As for punishments, the spirit can summon lightning to strike you; it normally delivers punishment if you ask impossible questions or have the intent to risk it. An example of an impossible question is a math formula that hasn't been solved yet or a classical paradox. It can also punish you if you fail to complete the mission it gives you or if you choose punishment.

Be warned, as there are things it can't or won't show you, as it cannot show things that are hidden beyond normal means, such as closed-off, concealed, or isolated spaces. The mirror will also refuse to look into dangerous things that are able to look back at it during its scrying.
objects.title: Arrodes (Lord of the Mysteries)

objects.text: The Mightstone is an artifact that can be used to empower any other artifacts within its range. It can increase the strength and speed of golems, make ornithopters travel faster and make lasers hotter and more focused.
objects.title: Mightstone (Magic: The Gathering)

objects.text: The Weakstone is an artifact that can be used to weaken any other artifacts within its range. It can decrease the strength and speed of golems, make ornithopters travel slower and make lasers cooler and less focused.
objects.title: Weakstone (Magic: The Gathering)

objects.text:
You are the proud owner of the Astral Chair, a magical artifact that alters how others perceive the person sitting on top of it. While it doesn't change the user's power level, how to put this, it improves the user's Rizz levels. It W Aura Farms like fam.

The longer a person sits on it, the more it cultivates an image in the person. Leaving an impression that can intimidate foes and look cool to allies. However, the longer you spend off the chair reduces your charisma back to normal levels.
objects.title: Astral Chair (Magical Girl ☆Sym-tan☆)

objects.text: “All forces must have an equivalent and opposite reaction.” As the metaphysical counterpart to The Astral Spoon, instead of empowering one good person, The Astral Fork seeks to make an army of Dark Magical Girls. As the (temporary) owner of The Astral Fork, you will be given ‘one’ chance to prove yourself and become a Dark Magical Girl, as the Astral Fork will seek a new potential to empower afterwards. As the first recruit, you will have time to build up your power base before that happens. The Empowerment Process requires you to break through a previously unbreakable moral you had; however, the moral you broke will become your new primary power, so choose wisely. An example would be stealing from your mother, letting you steal other powers. How young and innocent you originally were raises the initial increase, to the point where an obedient 10-year-old could destroy a city when using their powers for the first time. Your newfound power can be exponentially increased by recruiting another potential Magical Girl to your side, as you also gain a boosted version of their power. This will come into effect as well if your underlings recruit more potentials into The Dark Side, though at an obviously lesser extent than if you recruited them yourself. Be warned, however, that if you were to ever die, you would live on as a Dark Mascot, only capable of interacting with those who possess potential, their power instead being fed into regaining your body after successful recruitment. If you were to ever chance upon The Astral Fork again, take it, and you will be capable of gaining more powers without recruitment by breaking more morals. Be warned that other recruits will still take it if they were to defeat you in combat, so you must practice constant vigilance. Now go forth and show your superiority!
objects.title: Astral Fork (Magical Girl ☆Sym-tan☆)

objects.text:
The Astral Spoon is an extraordinary divine artifact, revered for its unparalleled ability to bestow the powers of Magical Girls upon its possessor. This artifact operates through a gradual infusion process, imbuing its owner with the essence of Spooneth over time. As the essence permeates the user, it elevates them to progressively higher levels of power. However, it is crucial for the owner to maintain possession of the Astral Spoon for an equivalent duration to any period of separation to restore their growth trajectory, long enough distance from the spoon and you instead start developing powers more associated with Kamen Riders or Superheros. Essentially, this artifact has the potential to grant its bearer any desired power, albeit through a meticulously paced process.

It is important to note that the Astral Spoon is not merely a passive instrument of power augmentation. The user must actively engage in specific actions to harness and accelerate the development of their Magical Girl abilities. For instance, engaging in singing can expedite the manifestation of the Symphogear Magical Girl’s powers. Similarly, experiencing spider bites under unusual circumstances can hasten the emergence of the Magical Spider-Girl’s abilities. Additionally, sunbathing in the vacuum of space can accelerate the development of the powers associated with Sailor Krypton.

Upon achieving their initial Magical Girl power, the user is bestowed with the Eternal Flame, a form of conceptual immortality that brings you back to peak condition no matter what. The Astral Spoon also ignores all drawbacks and even powers stronger than Paragon, and no sell thinker powers with illogical nonsense. This is an AI-generated prompt of low quality and a hodgepodge of different powers all at your disposal. As this was allowed to be added, I am disappointed.

The Astral Spoon, therefore, stands as a beacon of potential and transformation, offering a path to extraordinary abilities through both time and personal endeavor. Its divine nature and the intricate process of power acquisition make it a coveted artifact among those seeking to transcend limitations and embrace the extraordinary.
objects.title: Astral Spoon (Magical Girl ☆Sym-tan☆)

objects.text:
“Great job killing me, good luck doing it again” Unhinged Laughter.

- Sym-tan

It is no small feat to kill a Magical Girl who possesses a Soul Gem Phylactery, which grants them an extremely potent form of limited immortality. The Soul Gem Phylactery, at first glance, may be mistaken for a Soul Gem created by a certain White Demon, but their soul gems might as well be cheap knock-offs compared to the glorious splendor of the Soul Gem Phylactery. These Soul Gems are both ethical and eco-friendly compared to a more typical Lich's Phylactery or the creation of the White Demon. The Soul Gem Phylactery takes the form of an egg-sized gem held within a gilded cage, with its color and design reflecting your soul and mentality. Despite looking fragil it is actually remarkably durable, possessing durability that is stronger than titanium, which is further increased by an amount equal to 25% of your body's durability. Should it be damage it can self-repair slowly over a week, or much faster if you give any form of supernatural energy. You can bind your own soul to the Soul Gem Phylactery such that in the event you die, your soul will be transferred inside. Your body can be any distance away from the Soul Gem Phylactery, even an entirely different dimension, and still be able to move into the Soul Gem Phylactery upon death. After this has occured a new body will begin to grow within over the course of a day, after which you will be released inhabiting your new body at peak of health and fighting condition. You can also set a separate location where your body will reappear, a short distance away from the location of the Soul Gem Phylactery. However, the Soul Gem Phylactery has the following limits. Once it has been activated, it will consume one of the three maximum charges, allowing you to avoid death three times before needing to be recharged. In order to be recharged, it must be fed an amount of your blood equal to your body mass, and 500% of your maximum supernatural energy reserves, which it can slowly syphon over time or be fed directly by you from any distance away from it. For as long as your soul is bonded to the Soul Gem Phylactery, you can ignore any damage done to your body; even losing your head or heart won't stop you. You can also draw forth from the Soul Gem Phylactery’s reserves to rapidly regenerate any damage done to you or recover your energy by tapping into the charges held within the Soul Gem Phylactery. However, doing so may end up consuming entire charges if overused, so it is best to use it carefully and sparingly. Lastly, should the Soul Gem Phylactery ever be destroyed, it will send a horrible but brief spasm of pain to your body and soul, but it will not kill you or damage your soul.
objects.title: Soul Gem Phylactery (​​Magical Girl ☆Sym-tan☆)

objects.text:
You now have in your possession the Staff of Wizilur, the First Wizard. Made of ashwood and being six foot long, this plain looking staff is covered in bronze at both ends with smoothed almost illegible runes carved across them, with the lack of a crook or crystal at its top making it look like some sort of walking stick. Despite its appearance, its actually a powerful magical focus, increasing tenfold the strength and control of any element cast through it, with this strength a fire spell of yours could almost kill someone protected by magical shields and stone in one hit.

In truth, there's more to this staff, a potential purposefully hidden by its original wielder, it is in actuality the Staff of Imbalance—the Ninth Element. The world is composed of a harmony between the Eight Elements, when a spell is cast its opposing elements manifest somewhere else in order to maintain Balance, but Balance itself must also be balanced, thus its counterpart could only be Imbalance—and that is the Ninth Element.

The Staff is made from a branch of Yggdrasil—the Cosmic Axis upon which all worlds cross—and that allows someone to take advantage of the brief weakening of Balance in moments where a significant cosmic phenomena happened across countless worlds in order to become one with the elements through an invocation called the Rite of Imbalance—which has been implanted in your mind though you will need to pronounce its words carefully yourself, together with a instinctive sense of when the conditions will be met. The invocation must be done beneath a full moon during one of those moments of weakness while standing on top of a ritual circle made of runes carved on marble, you must also have a high amount of willpower or mastery of magic in order to remain yourself during the merge instead of being corrupted into a mindless vessel of pure power, and finally even after the merge starts it takes a bit to complete and in that inbetween stage you can theorically be stopped by anyone that saw the eyecatching rainbow pillar unleashed by the ritual.

If you succeed you will have permanently achieved ultimate power. Through this union you are no longer bound by the rules of magic because now you make them, you could mix opposing elements, ignore the maximum limit of 5 elements per spell, create any Magicks you want at will, manipulate the spells of others, create brand new elements, and more.
objects.title: Staff of the First Wizard (Magicka: The Ninth Element)

objects.text:
The Wan Wan Wand was created from a distant wonder star by the Wonder Clan. It’s a magical stick that can transform based on the user’s imagination into various shapes and tools. It can turn into a dowsing wand that can locate whatever you imagine, work similar like a whip by extending a long ribbon, and creating food if the user desires it.

Whoever possesses the Wan Wan Wand will turn into a Magical Girl, granting them an enhanced physique and the ability to create projections of their limbs as giant dog paws. They are more durable and gain the ability to speak with other beings. If they possess magical abilities, the Wan Wan Wand will amplify it.

The Wan Wan Wand can only be used by dogs, and upon finding a suitable host will turn the dog into a Magical Girl with dog ears and a dog tail. Despite gaining the ability to speak, the Magical Girl Dog will still retain instincts and behaviors of a dog.
objects.title: Wan Wan Wand (Mahou Shiba Inu★Hanamaru)

objects.text:
Gifted by Merlyn and Rama, the Sword of Might and Amulet of Right each possess the same ability. It transforms you into the guardian of the realm, the world’s defender, Captain Britain. While you wear the regalia of Captain Britain, you gain access to the following powers;

As Captain Britain, you’re a gateway to interdimensional energies, granting you incredible strength, durability, speed and reflexes to a level where you could contest the Mighty Thor for a time. Additionally, by using the energy as a field you can fly fast enough to pass the speed of sound.

Your senses are also enhanced, allowing you to not only perceive more along the normal spectrums of sight and hearing, but the ability to detect interdimensional fluctuations you can use to enhance your abilities temporarily, or even travel across worlds if the tear is large enough.

The Captain Britain Corps exists in order to defend their universes from mutual threats, and can call upon each other for aid in most dire straits. As a new member, you have this privilege, but also the duty to respond in kind. The transformation can be sustained by either the Amulet of Right or the Sword of Might individually, technically giving you a backup in case your preferred option is… misplaced.

You are also now British, either in Nationality, Ancestry, or Spirit.
objects.title: Sword of Might and Amulet of Right (Marvel)

addons.text: Somehow your divine essence as an Asgardian has combined with the residual divinity of Nezha in the Ten Rings, resulting in you being declared Nezha’s heir. Your already impressive power as an Asgardian is increased to the point where you could fight with beings on par with Sun Wukong and walk away with a broken shoulder at worst. You gain the ability to control and generate Samahdi Fire, an extremely potent form of fire that cannot be extinguished by conventional means. You also gain the ability to regenerate and grow extra limbs, and knowledge of various magic such as casting illusions. Finally you inherit the remaining weapons originally possessed by Nezha, including the Fire-Tipped Spear, Red Armillary Sash, and Wind-Fire Wheels.
addons.title: Fourth Lotus Prince

objects.text:
The Ten Rings are a legendary set of mystical iron rings that once formed the Universe Ring, a divine artifact owned by the god Nezha. In ancient times, Nezha wielded the ring to defeat and seal the Wyrm of Desolation in a pocket dimension. The Wyrm had sought to consume the Taoist gods of Ta Lo, but despite its defeat, it managed to corrupt Nezha’s spirit. After Nezha’s death, the Jade Emperor shattered the Universe Ring into ten separate pieces—the Ten Rings—to ensure the Wyrm could never be freed.

Each of the Ten Rings grants its wielder a vast array of powers, including superhuman strength, durability, speed, stamina, and flight—enough to overpower cosmic beings such as Terrax. They are capable of tearing through stone as if it were paper and destroying metals even when magically reinforced. The Rings can be telekinetically manipulated in numerous ways, functioning as high-speed projectiles, restraints, or even a means of transportation. They can also alter their size to fit the user’s wrists or to ensnare opponents.

The Ten Rings project an aura whose color shifts depending on the wielder, and this aura can be unleashed as devastating energy blasts. They can also magnify the user’s physical strikes by projecting massive energized constructs or multiple solid duplicates of whatever passes through their openings, imitating, enhancing, and replicating the attack on impact. Furthermore, the Ten Rings can imbue weapons with amplified destructive potential and grant telepathic control over those empowered arms.
objects.title: Ten Rings (Marvel)

objects.text:
Created in Dinosaur World by the Hag of the Pits to save the world—fearing the eventual judgments of the gods—the Fossilized Amulet was originally a singular relic containing all the unique metaphysical powers of the Cretaceous Plane, meant for the Chosen One to protect the world. However, when the Hag sent it to Earth, its powers were split, leaving it with only a fraction of its full strength.

The Fossilized Amulet grants its user the strength of prehistoric animals, allowing partial or full transformation into prehistoric creatures of any size, such as Tyrannosaurus, Triceratops, Velociraptors, and Pterodactyls. Transformations can also be limited to enhancing senses like vision, hearing, and smell. Additionally, you can sense the presence and emotions of dinosaurs, though you have no control over them. You recover much faster while in your dinosaur forms, and your transformations are always red-colored. However, you can maintain only one transformation at a time and may lose control to your more feral instincts while in dinosaur form.
objects.title: Fossilized Amulet (Marvel)

objects.text: You find in your possession the staple of any mystic arts practitioner's equipment. While wearing this two-fingered ring, by concentrating on and visualising the desired destination, you can open a circular portal leading there anywhere within a few metres of yourself. You also can open portals remotely, although for this you need to concentrate on both ends of the portal. The Sling Ring allows you to travel anywhere within the universe and its neighbouring dimensions and can even, on occasion, open portals to different universes entirely, although these universes will need to be connected via some kind of a passageway or a rift. The portals can persist for as long as you desire, and the ring can also be used to close existing spatial rifts and portals. The ring needs only intent and focus, allowing even a novice without an ounce of magic to successfully use one. Lastly, the ring in your possession also allows you to open a portal to a Mirror Dimension. This dimension is, essentially, a mirror reflection of the real world, with nothing happening here affecting the real world, allowing a safe space for practicing potentially dangerous spells or for fighting opponents without having to worry about collateral damage.
objects.title: Sling Ring (Marvel: MCU)

objects.text:
Congratulations! You have become the newest Guardian in a long line charged with protecting the legendary Chinese Miracle Box—a container for the world’s most powerful Miraculouses.

Miraculouses are magical jewels bonded to Kwamis: mysterious, cosmic beings each born from an abstract concept. There are nineteen Miraculouses in the Chinese Miracle Box, each linked to a unique animal and granting distinct powers—from creation and destruction to time manipulation, illusions, and beyond—each embodying a different concept through its Kwami. When a person bonds with a Miraculous, the Kwami grants them extraordinary superpowers in exchange for a connection to the physical world.

By uttering a unique phrase, you can activate a Miraculous and transform into a super-powered hero. Upon transformation, you gain a costume shaped by your subconscious, heightened physical abilities, a specialized tool (which doubles as both weapon and communication device), and most importantly, you receive a special power tied to your Miraculous’s Kwami and its concept.The costume is bound by a mystical geas that renders you unrecognizable to ordinary eyes, cloaking your identity perfectly; however, advanced artificial intelligences possess the ability to see through this veil, discerning your true form.

Veteran users can wield multiple Miraculouses at once—a process known as Miraculous Unification—merging their powers and abilities.
When the Ladybug’s Kwami (Tikki), embodying the concept of Creation, and the Cat’s Kwami (Plagg), representing Destruction, are united by a mature and worthy holder, they merge into Gimmi, the Supreme Kwami of Reality. Gimmi’s power, known as the Wish, enables the user to reshape Reality itself by granting a single wish—however, there is always a profound and unpredictable cost elsewhere in the world.

As the holder, you serve as both partner and commander to your Kwami. Bound by a mystical geas, the Kwami is compelled to obey your commands while you wield their Miraculous. Despite this enchantment, the relationship between holder and Kwami is most harmonious—and powerful—when built on trust and mutual respect.

If your body is not yet fully mature, using your superpower will automatically detransform you after five minutes to prevent harm. Adult users, however, are exempt from this limitation.

Prepare yourself for the responsibility and adventure that comes with being a Guardian. The fate of the Miraculouses—and perhaps much more—now rests in your hands.
objects.title: Miracle Box (Miraculous)

objects.text: "O Lord, bless this thy hand grenade, that with it thou mayst blow thine enemies to tiny bits, in thy mercy." What you hold in your hands is the Holy Hand Grenade of Antioch. The grenade has a blast radius of about 1 metre. All dark or demonic beings caught within the explosion are utterly annihilated with no possibility of resurrection. Against non-demonic or non-dark beings, it functions as a mundane hand grenade. To activate it, one must first remove the Holy Pin and then perform the sacred invocation: counting aloud to three, no more, no less, before hurling the grenade at your unholy adversary. The invocation remains effective even if spoken in parts. The grenade is bound to the bearer of the Holy Pin and can always be summoned back to them. After detonation, its divine power is expended, requiring one week to fully recharge. However, it restores itself to a mundane, non-holy explosive state after approximately one hour. Placing the grenade in a site of worship or near holy relics reduces its recharge time.
objects.title: Holy Hand Grenade of Antioch (Monty Python and the Holy Grail)

objects.text:
Crafted in Ancient Egypt, the Tablet of Ahkmenrah is a powerful artifact imbued with the ability to animate the inanimate. Blessed by Khonsu, the Tablet’s magic activates exclusively after sunset. It can bring to life paintings, statues, and other objects within the same building as the Tablet.

Beyond animation, the Tablet can even resurrect corpses, restoring them to their physical prime. It's powers also extend to the living, rejuvenating their strength and vitality while under its influence.

Moreover, the Tablet’s inscriptions can be altered, enabling the user to access the Duat, the Egyptian Underworld.

However, there is a crucial limitation: all beings reanimated by the Tablet must return to their originating building before sunrise. Failure to do so results in their bodies turning to dust, as the Tablet’s magic only works during the night.

It is important to note that while the resurrected can use their superpowers, the animated cannot.
objects.title: Tablet of Ahkmenrah (Night at the Museum)

objects.text:
The Fleece of the Golden Ram, Chrysomallus, was once fiercely guarded by a mighty dragon within a sacred grove in Colchis, before being claimed by Jason and his legendary Argonauts.

This mystical fleece grants its bearer extraordinary powers over vitality and health. When worn, it visibly amplifies regenerative abilities—almost instantly healing all injuries and ailments—and can even prevent death from injury or illness.

Beyond personal healing, the Fleece can be wielded to strengthen defenses and promote growth across vast regions. Its influence causes vines and trees to ripen and bear fruit endlessly, fostering abundance and vitality wherever it touches.

Perhaps the most remarkable power of the Fleece lies in its celestial connection. As the Golden Ram, Chrysomallus, is linked to the constellation Aries, the Fleece can harness this bond to resurrect the dead whenever the Sun enters Aries and shines upon the fleece. On other worlds where this constellation would not normally be visible, the user may choose to have it shine regardless, or to activate the resurrection effect for a fixed period—equivalent to 1/12th of a year.

Finally, the Mist allows the user to reshape the Fleece’s appearance to suit their needs. Despite these transformations, the Fleece always maintains a roughly consistent size and bears subtle signs of its true, divine nature.
objects.title: The Golden Fleece (Percy Jackson)

objects.text:
Jack Sparrow's compass, also known as Tia Dalma's compass, was an extraordinary navigational instrument most notably used by Captain Jack Sparrow, having previously been bartered from the voodoo mystic Tia Dalma and inherited from Captain Morgan. Unlike a typical compass, this mystical device pointed to what the owner desired most, rather than to magnetic north, making it a key to everything for those who understood its power.

Even if the bearer did not consciously know the nature or location of their desires, the compass could still guide them, making it invaluable for purposes like treasure hunting and navigation. The compass's effect extended beyond locating places and objects; it could also reveal the user's deepest desires towards other people, even if those desires involved danger or conflict. The compass seemed to possess a special supernatural connection with its owner, obeying their will faithfully as long as the owner remained loyal in return. Remarkably, even when held by another, the compass would subtly conspire to fulfill its true owner's inner desires.

Should the possessor be indecisive or conflicted about what they truly want, the compass's needle would spin erratically, reflecting their inner turmoil. Despite its unwavering loyalty, the compass was not without its own form of justice. If the owner betrayed the compass by dishonorably trading or giving it away without the expectation of its return, it would unleash the owner's greatest fear in retaliation. The compass's power in this regard was vast, capable of summoning formidable forces from anywhere in the world to exact its retribution. However, when passed honorably and willingly to a successor, the compass's punitive powers were nullified, continuing its loyal service without malice.
objects.title: Jack Sparrow's Compass (Pirates of the Caribbean)

addons.text: In addition to acquiring Blasting Rod, you have mastered a style of magic that pairs exceptionally well with it. You are a master of Spiritual Tripping, a style of magic where you use simple gestures to drive the image of a weapon or a tool directly into the target's brain, along with the power associated with them. After that, you can use this imaginary weapon on a target, with it ignoring any and all defences and obstructions and interacting solely with the target itself, leaving any surrounding objects completely unharmed. For the magic to work properly, the target has to witness the gestures the user makes and has to be able to 'picture' the image in their mind. If the target's perception is distorted, there is a chance that Spiritual Tripping may not function properly. On the other hand, if the gesture is seen by the target, then spiritual tripping would work even if the target has never seen and has no knowledge of the imitated weapon. You are able to mimic a wide variety of objects. From regular weapons, such as pistols, swords, mines, etc., to magical items, including the Blasting Rod itself, to even imaginary bombs with the power of the Big Bang, as well as a massive variety of other tools for non-combat applications, such as X-rays, CT scans, MRIs, blood tests, gas chromatography, ultrasound, centrifuges, transmission electron microscopes, polymerase chain reaction DNA tests, and a cyclotron particle accelerator.
addons.title: Spiritual Tripping

objects.text:
Blasting Rod, otherwise known as the Staff of Impact, a magical staff of great power originally belonging to the magician of the Golden Dawn, Allan Bennett, and later his student and friend, Aleister Crowley, is now in your possession. Originally thought of as only being able to destabilise magical energy, rendering your opponents unconscious, this was a lie perpetuated by Allan to avoid jealousy of other mages.

The staff's true power is to amplify the effects of any magic you perform, be it spell or ritual, to ten times what the intended target thinks it is (this includes power, range, size, duration, etc.). Additionally, subsequent uses of the magic together with the Blasting Rod will be further amplified due to the target's expectations affecting the basis for the amplification (i.e., if they subsequently imagine it will be 10 times as powerful, it will be 100 times as powerful, and so on).
objects.title: Blasting Rod (Raildex)

objects.text:
In your hands is an original grimoire, Secrets of the Black Cat Ritual, housing the thought entity Reading Thoth 78, the recreation of the magician Mina Mothers. While her true form is a black, nearly indestructible book that constantly emits a protective field around itself, she can—at will—assume the form of her template, with the addition of cat ears and a tail.

As a grimoire, she is incapable of producing her own magical energy to cast spells, but she can absorb ambient energy, as well as make use of your own should you possess it and permit the transfer. Being a magical recreation, she holds all the knowledge her template possessed in life—which is mainly cat-related magic—as well as a tremendous calculation capability rivalling that of most supercomputers, inherited from her time as an AI system.

Her vast processing power allows her to cast spells with incredible efficiency, as well as optimise your own spells on the fly should you use the grimoire as a casting focus. Additionally, due to her origin as a techno-magic system, Mina can interface with and control other technology, from hacking into secured devices to taking over entire networks.

Magic knowledge, contained in true grimoires, is a poison for the mind. While you are immune to it, Mina can still utilise this poison on others for a variety of effects, from deliberately harming the minds of targets to destroying foreign influences, effectively burning out things like mind control or even magic-enforced contracts.

Lastly, with sufficient data, Mina can create replicas of other beings using a deck of tarot cards as a medium, albeit the quality will depend both on how much data she possesses and the availability of magical energy to sustain the replicas.
objects.title: Reading Thoth 78 (Raildex)

objects.text:
You now possess an empty SCP-963, a beautifully crafted amulet of white gold, roughly 15 centimeters in diameter. Its surface is adorned with thirteen brilliant-cut diamonds surrounding a deep crimson ruby, arranged in an intricate starburst pattern. It is invulnerable to damage.

At the moment, the amulet is dormant—an empty vessel awaiting its first occupant.
