The moment someone wears SCP-963 and dies while in contact with it, their soul, mind, and consciousness will be bound to the object. Their body may perish, but their existence will persist within the amulet, unable to escape. From that point forward, SCP-963 will serve as their anchor to the world, offering a form of immortality.

If another living creature makes direct skin contact with the amulet, the bound soul will immediately override their body, taking full control. The previous consciousness of the host will be completely erased, leaving only the entity stored within SCP-963 to inhabit the flesh. If the amulet remains in contact with a single host for thirty consecutive days, their brain will permanently reconfigure to match the stored consciousness, even if SCP-963 is removed.
objects.title: SCP-963 (SCP Foundation)

objects.text:
Shadowhunters utilize various equipment and tools to aid them in their battle against supernatural threats. Here are some of the basic equipment commonly used by Shadowhunters:

Seraph Blades: Seraph Blades are the primary weapons of Shadowhunters. These are glowing, blade-like weapons made of adamas, a strong and durable material. Seraph Blades can take different forms and are activated by the Shadowhunter's will. They are effective against demons and other supernatural creatures.

Stele: A stele is a wand-like instrument used by Shadowhunters to draw and activate runes. Runes are powerful symbols inscribed on the skin, granting Shadowhunters various abilities. The stele acts as a conduit for the Shadowhunter's power, allowing them to create, modify, or activate runes quickly.

Sensor: Sensors are handheld devices used by Shadowhunters to detect the presence of demons. They emit a high-pitched sound when demons are nearby, alerting the Shadowhunter to their presence. Sensors are especially useful for tracking and locating supernatural beings.

Witchlight: Witchlight is a glowing crystal that emits a bright light. Shadowhunters use it as a source of illumination, particularly in dark or shadowy environments. Witchlights are typically worn on a necklace or carried as a small, portable light source.

Adamas: Adamas is a versatile material used by Shadowhunters to create various tools and weapons. It is extremely durable and can withstand supernatural forces. Seraph Blades, steles, and other specialized equipment are often made of adamas.

Iratze: Iratze is a healing rune used by Shadowhunters to mend wounds. When activated, it accelerates the natural healing process, allowing Shadowhunters to recover from injuries more rapidly. Shadowhunters often carry small vials of a healing potion called an iratze, which contains the essence of the rune.

Runes and Spellbooks: Shadowhunters study and memorize various runes and spells to enhance their abilities and combat prowess. They often carry spellbooks or reference materials containing knowledge about magical symbols, incantations, and rituals.

Parabatai Tracking Rings: Parabatai tracking rings are special rings worn by parabatai—a pair of Shadowhunters bound by a sacred bond. These rings allow parabatai to track each other's locations and sense if the other is in distress or danger.

You are also given a nice suit of basic shadow hunter armor
These are some of the basic equipment and tools utilized by Shadowhunters in their quest to protect the human world from supernatural threats. 
(All this equipment will repair itself if damaged, broken, reappear if lost, an refill after a few day after use)
objects.title: Basic Shadowhunter Equipment (Shadowhunters)

objects.text: In your hands now lies one of the Mortal Instruments, given to the first Shadowhunter, Jonathan, by the Angel Raziel: the Mortal Cup. Formed from Adamas and dipped in gold, the cup is the size of an ordinary wine glass, though much heavier. Though Raziel’s blood no longer sits within the cup, those who drink from it become Nephilim—Shadowhunters as if they had consumed Raziel’s blood, much like Jonathan Shadowhunter did centuries prior. Any Nephilim created by the cup will pass this trait on to their children. Nephilim gain enhanced strength, agility, stamina, and coordination—roughly equivalent to that of an Olympic athlete—along with the ability to see through most illusions, use heavenly weapons, and learn to use Angelic Runes known as Shadowmarks. While drinking from the Mortal Cup doesn’t directly grant you knowledge of any Angelic Runes, you’ll find yourself instinctively discovering these Runes over time.
objects.title: The Mortal Cup (Shadowhunters)

objects.text:
You have access to a set of Shardplate and a Shardblade or Honorblade of  
You have access to a set of Shardplate and a Shardblade of your choosing. A Shardblade is a powerful weapon capable of slicing rock and severing souls and can be dematerialized and rematerialized when you wish. Shardplate is magical armor that can block even Shardblades, and grants you enhanced strength. Your Shardplate will naturally replenish Stormlight and repair itself.

With enough time and effort you can form a strong enough relationship with the spirit(s) that make up the Plate and Blade, you can become one of the Unoathed, able to instantly summon, and alter the form of both. choosing. A Shardblade is a powerful weapon capable of slicing rock and severing souls and can be dematerialized and rematerialized when you wish. Honorblades are stronger versions of Shardblades that grant you magical abilities known as "Surgebinding". Shardplate is magical armor that can block even Shardblades and grants you enhanced strength. Your Shardplate will naturally replenish Stormlight and repair itself.
objects.title: Shardbearer (Stormlight Archives)

objects.text:
A simple scroll showing a painting of a mountainous landscape parted by a river to everyone else, you have unlocked this artifact's secret, that being a pocket-dimension containing a mountain range interrupted by rivers spanning tens of thousands of miles. The entire dimension is filled with a seemingly endless amount of heavenly energy, making it not only a perfect place to cultivate as well as growing spiritual and otherwise supernatural plants and animals, but even repairing and gradually strengthening any magical artifact you keep inside it.

Additionally, hidden and sealed away within this vast realms are a number of Deity Roots. By finding and unsealing these roots, which will always be extremly difficult regardless of what powers you have, they will form floating islands called Deity Lakes which will begin to produce spiritual stones. Spiritual stones can be used to enhance your own powers, especially any cultivation-based powers you may have, nourish any supernatural plant or animal you're keeping within the Painting, as well as use them as currency should you be in a Cultivation-based world or have a Different World-Option turning your world into one. There are different tiers of Deity Roots, the better they are the more and better spiritual stones they produce, but the more difficult they are to find and unseal.

There may well be other secrets hidden within this realm, but it'll be up to you to find them.
objects.title: Myriad Miles Mountains and Rivers Painting (Tales of Demons and Gods)

objects.text:
You have come into possession of the Heart of Tengu, this mystical artifact was created by the Ninja Tribunal to bind the Foot Mystics, five elemental beings that served the Tengu Shredder. While this binding allows the owner of the Heart of Tengu to control the mystics, it also weakens them.

The mystics are composed of and can perform limited manipulation different elements, Metal, Earth, Fire, Water, and Wind. They are incredibly hard to permanently kill, impossibly so without mystical power unconnected to the Mystics. The Mystics are weaker to things that would logically effect their elements, like melting metal or extinguishing fire. 

The source of the Mystics regeneration and durability, is their elemental control. This is because it applies to not just outside material, but also their own bodies, allowing them to reform themselves and perform limited shapeshifting. This can be overcome with enough damage, though mundane sources will never be able to truly kill them.

All five mystics are versed in black magic, though the majority of their magic power is sealed away. The mystics can fly, scry, and launch spiritual attacks through the astral plane, though this requires all five mystics to channel their powers together. They are also skilled in the ways of the ninja, knowing the various techniques of the Foot Clan.
objects.title: Heart of Tengu (Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles)

objects.text:
Gluttony is one of the legendary Seven Sins Grimoires, each forged with a singular purpose. Gluttony’s goal: to reach and consume the Akashic Record, the primal source of all knowledge and existence. Though it ultimately failed in this endeavor, the failure was not its own but that of its final wielder, Theodore Miller, who refused to ascend into omniscience and omnipotence.

Sentient and self-aware, Gluttony possesses a mischievous personality and often jokes with its wielder. Upon bonding with a new master, it manifests a small, ever-hungry mouth in the wielder’s palm, a physical echo of its true form, which resides in a higher dimension beyond mortal comprehension.

By devouring magical items or tomes imbued with arcane knowledge, Gluttony empowers its wielder with enhanced magical capabilities and improved spellcasting. In the case of books, the more deeply the wielder understands the contents before consumption, the greater the benefits they receive.

Should the consumed book be penned by its original author, Gluttony allows the wielder to form a connection with the author’s soul. This bond grants temporary access to the author's knowledge, experiences, and abilities or, if needed, allows the author to possess the wielder’s body to aid them directly.

Gluttony also serves as a repository of power. It can store spells for instant release and maintains an extradimensional inventory space for storing physical items. Within its depths lies an ancient archive: a vast collection of every magical book and artifact it has devoured across countless dimensions, as well as the lingering souls of master magicians deemed worthy by gluttony to be preserved from one age to the next. The wielder can tap into this wellspring of wisdom and power at will.

A few modifications have been made to Gluttony, granting you the same authority as its original creator, making it so that Gluttony is completely loyal to you, and it wouldn’t eat you should it be neglected and not have any magical artifact or mystical tome to eat.
objects.title: Gluttony Grimoire (The Book Eating Magician)

addons.title: Avatar of Akatosh
addons.text:
You are a true dragonborn; you are no longer just a stand-in wielder of the Amulet of Kings but a true bearer of Akatosh's blood. Your status as a Dragonborn grants you a special connection to the Amulet of Kings, similar to Martin. You can now briefly take the form of Akatosh, but only a mere avatar.

This form lasts only a short duration, and the second you detransform, a sudden wave of drowsiness will beset you, and you will fall unconscious for a day.

When you take on the form of Akatosh, you become a massive gold dragon and are no longer constrained by the mortal usage of the Thu'um. As an avatar of Akatosh, you will also possess some of his metaphysical weight and be able to use his powers.

With time, you will master this form and maybe even mantle Akatosh himself; however, that will be in the distant future. Each time you use this form, you will be unable to enter it again for some time, directly correlating to how heavily you used the form's abilities.

objects.text: "This shall also be a token to you of our joined blood and pledged faith. So long as you and your descendants shall wear the Amulet of Kings, then shall this dragonfire burn―an eternal flame―as a sign to all men and gods of our faithfulness." ―Akatosh A diamond formed from the blood of the god Lorkhan during his battle against Trinimac and the other gods. The blood fell into an Ayleid well and fused into a crystal, polished by the Ayleids; they titled the resulting artefact Chim-el Adabal. During the pact between Akatosh and Saint Alessia, Akatosh augmented the Chim-el Adabal with his blood, creating the amulet that defends Mundus with dragonfire and prevents those alien and unnatural to the world from taking root. The amulet's main power is that, as long as someone with dragon blood wears it, a barrier protects the world from extraplanar invasion. The barrier prevents gods and other beings from manifesting, even as avatars, on the plane you are on. The barrier also prevents these beings from using their abilities. Should you go near them, it will also greatly weaken them. It also stores the souls of every emperor who wore it, allowing them to guide you and, in times of need, boost your power, as it did with the Vestige in their defeat of Molag Bal during the Second Era. The amulet also resonates with you so that those who see you wear it know that you are a noble of some kind. Even though you are not one of the dragon-blooded emperors, you may still wear this amulet. Note: What the amulet considers natural or alien is very loose and can also affect alien beings or other things beyond just divine beings, as even someone like Scion would be affected by the amulet.
objects.title: Amulet of Kings (The Elder Scrolls)

objects.text:
You now possess the heart of a god ripped from the body of the Doom Drum and flung across the world from the bow of Akatosh; this still-beating heart of a god pulses with the beat of a world. The heart of Shor is a Divine Spark, a divine artifact that no other artifact could ever hope to match. The blood that pumps through the heart can create the material known as ebony, which can be forged into weapons and armor.

The heart yet beats, and with ancient power, should you find some way to harness the power within this artifact, you could wield virtually infinite energy, being only held back by how much energy you can wield at once. Perhaps with time and the right tools you could use the heart in the same fashion that the Tribunal or Dagoth Ur once performed to approach the realm of divinity: becoming a dreamer yourself or awakening from the dream.

Be warned that few have wielded the artifact and still live to tell the tale. Should you not practice caution when handling this artifact, you could collapse into yourself and wipe all traces of yourself from ever existing in the first place.
objects.title: Heart of Shor (The Elder Scrolls)

objects.text:
In your hands now rests what may be considered one of the most powerful magical artifacts in all of Nirn: the Staff of Magnus. Its immense power contained within a sleek ebony shaft topped by a gleaming crystal sphere.

This staff grants you the ability to suppress magic, ward off hostile spells, and restore your health. It can absorb a target’s spells, magical reserves, and ultimately their life force, replenishing your own power in the process. Its capable of transforming lengthwise to suit your needs. It can shorten to serve as a mace, extend into a warhammer’s reach, and everything in between.

Traditionally, the Staff of Magnus eventually abandons its user, driven by an inscrutable need to maintain a mysterious ‘balance.’ Yet, in your possession, the staff seems unexpectedly loyal—almost reluctant to leave your side, as if bound by an unseen tether.
objects.title: The Staff of Magnus (The Elder Scrolls)

objects.text:
The tools of Kagrenac were three magitech items created by the Dwemer Tonal Architect, Kagrenac, to manipulate the divine power of the Heart of Lorkhan. When wielded all at once, their power increases greatly. The three tools were:

Wraithguard: An enchanted gauntlet necessary to safely wield the other two tools, as they cause mortal wounds when wielded unaided. It also protects against a myriad of other effects, reducing almost all other sources of damage by one-tenth.

Sunder: Used to draw out a specific amount of power from the Heart for use, it also doubles as a very powerful enchanted hammer for beating people to death with.

Keening: Used after Sunder to shape & focus the power drawn out by it into specific effects. It is also a powerful enchanted blade in it's own right, which increases the user's physical & magical abilities greatly when wielded.

Note that you don't necessarily need the Heart of Lorkhan to perform Tonal Architecture. As demonstrated by Sotha Sil's artificial heart, anything of suitable magical or divine power can be substituted.
objects.title: Tools of Kagrenac (The Elder Scrolls)

objects.text:
It seems that you managed to pass its test and now hold Horror’s Hand.

Horror’s Hand is a large left-handed bronze gauntlet with an eye in the center of its palm, which has the power to manifest a target’s greatest fears into reality, even combining multiple fears into a horrific creature should either there be multiple targets, or a single target is afraid of many things. 

Further, the manifested fears can only be vanquished by either the will of hand’s current holder or the target overcoming said fear, with any outside interference rendered useless.

Finally, should others seek to hold Horror’s Hand, they must face and overcome their worst nightmares. Notably, should an individual already be living in their worst nightmare the hand will freak out and be unable to affect them.
objects.title: Horror’s Hand (The Grim Adventures of Billy and Mandy)

objects.text:
I, Arthur, anointed Heir to the Kingdom, claim this Key and with it the Mastery of the Middle House. I claim it by blood and bone and contest, out of truth, in testament, and against all trouble.

Arthur Penhaligon

 Around your neck now lies the form of the Fifth Key, taking the shape of a small mirror on a fine chain. It has the capacity to change its size and shape to suit its wielder’s needs, though it will always be recognizably a mirror. A Key can lock and unlock, bind, unbind, open, close, animate, petrify, illuminate, darken, translate, befuddle, heal, harm, kill, protect its user from harm, grant them wings, and, in general, manipulate the surrounding environment in a variety of ways. Keys can only be freely given; no amount of force can remove them from your possession. Each Key has a “specialization”—an aspect of reality that it controls best. The Fifth Key holds absolute command over Souls, capable of manipulating, controlling, distorting, and bending them in a variety of ways to suit the wielder's needs. It can grant or remove souls, break them, repair them, drain them of their emotions and experiences, or grant them anew. The Fifth Key also has the ability to allow the user to communicate through or travel to any reflective surface. However, a Key is only at full power within its own domain inside the House—for the Fifth Key, the Middle House—or during one of the seven days of the week in the Secondary Realms. For the Fifth Key, that day is Friday. Otherwise, it can only perform minor workings and is unable to harness its grander, more formidable powers. Should you possess another Key, it can grant you the ability to use the Fifth Key’s powers within its demesne and on its day.
objects.title: The Fifth Key (The Keys to the Kingdom)

objects.text:
I, Arthur, anointed Heir to the Kingdom, claim this Key and with it the Mastery of the Incomparable Gardens. I claim it by blood and bone and contest, out of truth, in testament, and against all trouble.

Arthur Penhaligon

 Upon a fine golden chain around your neck lies the tiny form of the Seventh Key, taking the shape of a golden key. It has the ability to change its size and shape to suit its wielder’s need, though will always be recognizably a key. A Key can lock and unlock, bind, unbind, open, close, animate, petrify, illuminate, darken, translate, befuddle, heal, harm, kill, protect its user from harm, grant them wings, and, in general, manipulate the surrounding environment in a variety of ways. Keys can only be freely given; no amount of force can remove them from your possession. Each Key has a “specialization”—an aspect of reality that it controls best. The Seventh Key holds absolute control over Energy, able to produce limitless amounts of it, and enhance, manipulate, and control, it in a variety of ways to suit its needs. The Seventh Key specializes in locking and unlocking, able to unleash such esoteric things as potential, or seal them away. Unique amongst the Keys to the Kingdom, the Seventh Key is able to even provide some limited ability to affect other Keys with effort preventing their use, though unable to truly usurp them. However, even the Seventh Key is only at full power within its own domain inside the House—for this Key, the Incomparable Gardens—or during one of the seven days of the week in the Secondary Realms. For the Seventh Key, that day is Sunday. Otherwise, while it retains more power than other Keys, the Seventh Key is still limited to only performing minor workings and is unable to fully harness its grander, more formidable powers. Should you possess another Key, it can grant you the ability to use the Seventh Key’s powers within its demesne and on its day.
objects.title: The Seventh Key (The Keys to the Kingdom)

objects.text:
I, Arthur, anointed Heir to the Kingdom, claim this Key and with it the Mastery of the Upper House. I claim it by blood and bone and contest, out of truth, in testament, and against all trouble.

Arthur Penhaligon

 In your hand now lies the form of the Sixth Key, taking the shape of a metallic quill. The Key has the ability to be used as either a writing implement or a dagger, and can change its shape and form to suit its users needs, though will always still be recognizable for what it is. A Key can lock and unlock, bind, unbind, open, close, animate, petrify, illuminate, darken, translate, befuddle, heal, harm, kill, protect its user from harm, grant them wings, and, in general, manipulate the surrounding environment in a variety of ways. Keys can only be freely given; no amount of force can remove them from your possession. Each Key has a “specialization”—an aspect of reality that it controls best. The Sixth Key holds absolute command over Magic, able to change the underlying rules of existence and warp reality on a whim. The Sixth Key is capable of manifesting anything the user writes, so long as it doesn’t infringe upon the domains of another Key. However, a Key is only at full power within its own domain inside the House—for the Sixth Key, the Upper House—or during one of the seven days of the week in the Secondary Realms. For the Sixth Key, that day is Saturday. Otherwise, it can only perform minor workings and is unable to harness its grander, more formidable powers. Should you possess another Key, it can grant you the ability to use the Sixth Key’s powers within its demesne and on its day.
objects.title: The Sixth Key (The Keys to the Kingdom)

objects.text:
The Kur Stone is often described as both a map and a key to the legendary Tomb of the King Monsters—Kur himself. However, in truth, it functions more as a prison, trapping his soul and power within it.

The Stone grants the wielder the ability to access the powers of Kur sealed inside, particularly its control over Cryptids—creatures believed to be nonexistent or supernatural in nature.

While the Kur Stone is capable of imprisoning even the most powerful entities, it is relatively fragile. Dropping it risks releasing the trapped being, along with all the power contained within.

Finally, you gain the knowledge to craft more of these ancient prisons—capable of trapping other powerful entities, whether demons, spirits, monsters, or other supernatural beings.
objects.title: The Kur Stone (The Secret Saturdays)

addons.text:
You gain her unusual aptitude for magic and her savant-level abilities in learning and using all forms of magic. This talent is so great that you can accomplish what would take an average magic user decades in a matter of months or a few years tops. In addition, you gain her vast knowledge of magic that she has studied and encountered in Gensokyo. Also, you gain her rather curious eye for spotting and borrowing/stealing things and getting away with them, usually scot-free. 

You now gain the full knowledge, abilities, and items of Marisa Kirisame. 

This includes her vast knowledge of different magics and crafting principles. She is especially gifted in the art of alchemy, focusing on using various forms of fungi that are often extremely poisonous. Though she has an insane level of toxic resistance, able to eat things that should kill her countless times over.

Her various forms of magic, which focus on light and heat, often mixed with various forms of crafted items to supplement her attacks and spells. Also, every last one of her Spell Cards are now known to you in both how to perform and create them.

Lastly, you gain all of her equipment. Including an outfit based on her own, filled to the brim with her creation, and holding enough to fight in any situation. Her signature Magician's Hat also filled with all manner of items. As well as her broom, with you gaining her insane level of skill in riding it, to the point you can easily ride it like a surfboard. Finally, you gain her forgotten wand and other various equipment she would have for crafting.
addons.title: Ordinary Magician’s legacy

objects.text:
The Mini Hakkero is a magitech recreation of the mythical magical furnace of the Jade Emperor from Journey to the West, which he used to purify the Golden Elixir. In short, the Mini Hakkero is a miniature energy purification and storage device that functions on the Tao philosophy of the Eight Trigrams, which govern reality. It is comparable to a large nuclear reactor in the amount of energy it constantly generates, and can hold an immense amount more energy than even that.

This Mini Hakkero is the upgraded version made from Hihi'irokane, a mythical metal comparable to Orichalcum or Mithril, and is the same metal that the Sword of Kusanagi was crafted from, and is thus immensely durable. 

The Mini Hakkero also acts as a powerful magical focus for any form of magic and can massively amplify any magic cast. Its primary abilities are the ability to fire an insanely powerful laser that you can modulate or even enhance further with your own magic, the ability to be used as a magical rocket booster allowing movement at insane speeds, and finally, as a source of magic and a magical battery. It is also a deep source of magical knowledge of the Tao philosophy of the Eight Trigrams. 

Finally, the Mini Hakkero is an insanely useful tool for crafting, using its ability to purify objects and energy.
objects.title: Mini Hakkero (Touhou Project)

objects.text:
You possess a personalized grimoire that acts as an interface to the Archive, adapting itself to your nature and preferred method of use. Upon bonding, it takes on a form that feels intuitive to you—whether a tome, device, weapon, or abstract construct—and remains stable unless deliberately reforged through introspection and ritual.

At the moment of attunement, you align with a single Thema, your core magical principle. The grimoire organizes all magic through this lens, structuring spells as coherent formulas that match your way of thinking. Every technique you develop is refined to better express and reinforce that Thema, creating a consistent and scalable magical system unique to you.

The grimoire maintains a complete internal record of your magic. Every spell, variation, failure, and theoretical model is stored, indexed, and immediately accessible. You can replay castings, analyze structures in slowed detail, and break down complex formulas into understandable components, allowing rapid iteration and refinement.

It also provides active casting support. The grimoire helps stabilize incomplete formulas, smooth out inefficiencies, and prevent structural collapse during spell construction. This allows you to safely experiment with new magic and push the limits of your current understanding without losing control.

As your skill improves, the grimoire develops an interactive interface—an expression of your magical logic given form. This presence offers real-time feedback, highlights flaws in your formulas, and assists in optimizing spell design, acting as a constant analytical partner in your growth.

Your magic develops as a structured system rather than a collection of tricks. Every spell feeds back into your understanding, every refinement strengthens your foundation, and your growth compounds over time through study, iteration, and mastery.

Optionally, you can choose for this to be one of the existing grimoires, such as Astil Manuscript or Solomon's Gate, for example.
objects.title: Adaptive Magus Grimoire (Trinity Seven)

addons.text: Unlike before, where your Class Cards contained only a portion of a Heroic Spirit's power, your Kaleidostick now allows them to unleash the full power of a proper Servant summoned by the Holy Grail.
addons.title: Full Manifestation

addons.text: As a Perfect Host, you can now use multiple Class Cards simultaneously without the risk of bursting from manifesting so many Servants at once. This ability is not limited by the starting slots granted by Perfect Host, allowing you to wield as many cards at once as you possess.
addons.title: High-Vessel

objects.text:
Class Cards, also known as Servant Cards, are powerful artifacts created for the Ainsworth Holy Grail War. These mystical items encapsulate the essence of Heroic Spirits, subsuming their wills and converting their power into a form that can be wielded by Magi. Functioning similarly to Pseudo-Servants and Demi-Servants, Class Cards allow individuals to access a Heroic Spirit’s power by becoming vessels for their abilities.

Each Class Card corresponds to one of the seven standard Servant classes: Saber, Archer, Lancer, Rider, Caster, Assassin, or Berserker. While the Heroic Spirit is not fully summoned, a portion of their existence—along with their strength, skills, and Noble Phantasms—is sealed within the card. In essence, the card is the Heroic Spirit, allowing the user to channel their power through either a Mystic Code or their own body.

There are two primary methods of using a Class Card. The first is the "Include" command, which temporarily manifests the weapon or Noble Phantasm of the Heroic Spirit. This effect can be ended with the "Uninclude" command.

The second and main method is "Install," which fuses the card directly with the user’s body. This transformation grants access to the Heroic Spirit's Noble Phantasms, Class Skills, Personal Skills, and even their clothing. During this state, the user essentially becomes a facsimile of the Heroic Spirit. The transformation can be ended with the "Uninstall" command, returning the user to their original form.

By selecting this option, you gain access to seven Class Cards—one for each of the core Servant classes. You may freely choose which Heroic Spirits are sealed within each card. However, you can only have one card active at a time and cannot maintain Includes or Installs for extended periods, as they consume your stamina/life energy—unless you possess an external energy source capable of sustaining the transformation for longer durations.
objects.title: Class Cards (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
The Mystic Code and greatest treasure of the Einzbern family, the Dress of Heaven is originally designed to be the control mechanism for the holy grail and was hoped to allow the family to gain their most desperate desire, the Third True Magic: Heaven's Feel.  

It takes the form of a beautiful white dress, created from the sacrifice of Illyasviel's loyal maid, Leysritt. It's appearance is deceiving; Though it looks like it is made of harmless white cloth, any human who dares to touch the dress will instantly be turned to gold, save for yourself or any non-human.

With the dress, you can now manipulate the soul with ease, as if you were a master of spiritual surgery such as Kirei Kotomine. Eventually, it will allow you to materialise the soul for a few short moments, a reproduction of the third magic writ small; With this you could transfer a soul to a puppet body or even donate some of your own body to stabilize someone who was expiring right in front of you. However you will never be able to reach the heights of an actual magician just by using this mystic code, as trying to use it for such things is like careful knitting.

Finally, your ability to heal, restore or resurrect with magical energy, whilst using the Dress of Heaven, is greatly magnified. With the amount of mana needed to close a small wound, you can now heal people with life ending injuries.
objects.title: Dress of Heaven (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
You have gained possession of a Holy Grail, one of the most sought-after artifacts in mage society. A Holy Grail is essentially a condensed mass of pure magical energy that can react to the wishes of its holder to grant them their wishes.

Besides wish granting, the Grail can also serve as a powerful magical battery with limitless capacity, capable of being the catalyst for powerful spells and rituals or enhance its wielder's magic to a great extent. Your Grail has a small connection to the Root which allows it to recharge in the case where you exhausted its power, or continue to accumulate more and more magical power over time.

When exhausted, it will take a month for the Grail to regain its original potency. You could also store your excess magical power by placing it within the Grail. Your Grail starts off at the same level as the Art Graph Holy Grails' present in the Solomon 7 singularity.
objects.title: Holy Grail (Type-Moon)

objects.text: A sheath of compressed wind surrounding and concealing the weapon it's bound to—Invisible Air: Barrier of the Wind King is a bounded field of high-pressure air, woven from multiple layers of wind and immense magical energy. Created by Merlin to conceal their king's legendary blade, it bends light around itself, distorts perception, and renders the weapon completely invisible. It may even serve as a seal, muting the radiance and power of a Divine Construct like Excalibur. That said, its application isn't limited to swords. You can easily and quickly bind it to other weapons, objects, places, or even yourself, forming a wind barrier that grants both concealment and protection. However, using it this way demands far more magical energy to maintain than simply cloaking a weapon. And as a wind-based Noble Phantasm, when turned inward, it may also enhance movement and agility. Deceptively simple, it's brutally effective in close combat. The whirling winds act like blades, amplifying the cutting power of any weapon—or adding one where there wasn't. Each strike releases visible surges of magical energy, and the barrier's distortion makes it nearly impossible to judge reach, size, or angle. Thrusts become especially deceptive, offering a decisive edge in early exchanges. Still, trained eyes can adapt—once the illusion is "pierced," it'd be little more than wind on steel. Though that's not all, Invisible Air can be released at any time. If unleashed indiscriminately, it bursts outward in a violent gale, creating a vacuum strong enough to scatter crowds and shake trees like a typhoon. In a more controlled form, it becomes Strike Air: Hammer of the Wind King—a single-use, long-range blast of compressed wind that hits like a battering ram and lance, capable of toppling armies or hurling multi-ton slabs into the sky. Its power stays constant regardless of your condition and can only be blocked by overwhelming it with magical energy. Depending on your handling of it, Strike Air may also help to launch you forward at blistering speeds. Once released, you can recall it by compressing the surrounding air to reform the barrier.
objects.title: Invisible Air (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
The Kaleidostick is a mystic code created by none other than Kischur Zelretch Schweinorg and imbued with artificial intelligence. The Kaleidostick is capable of making contracts with the user in order to boost their energy and provide them with virtually an infinite supply of magical energy through the use of the second magic, allowing the user to make use of the second magic to transform or overlay themselves into alternate versions of themselves, such as an alternate version of themselves who is proficient with swords or a version of themselves who is a master chef.
 
Through artificial intelligence, the wand allows for the manifesting of clothing that both the AI and the user find enjoyable. This AI is also able to use several of the wand’s functions if the wielder is incapable of doing them, such as in the middle of a fight. The wand has impressive durability, being able to tank attacks from King Arthur and Hercules.
 
Through the second magic, the Kaleidostick can create a barrier around an area that separates it from the world, creating a pocket dimension in which no damage will reach the outside world. Other abilities the wand is able to provide include, but are not limited to, a magical shield to block physical or magical attacks, healing, increased strength, and physical abilities through magic reinforcement, the ability to fly, or the ability to create magic blasts. The limits to what the Kaleidostick can do with magic are solely up to the wielder and the amount of energy they are willing to use through the second magic.

Should you find a class card, you could use that to Include and Install the ability or weapon pertaining to the heroic spirit within.
objects.title: Kaleidostick (Type-Moon)

addons.text:
With this you gain the ancient Egyptian version of a Duel Disk, it uses the wearer’s spirit energy or ‘Ba’, to summon spirit monster’s or ‘Ka’ from their stone tablet prisons, and command them into battle. You gain the knowledge of how to create the specialized stone tablets, along with the process to create more DiaDhank. 

Unlike the modern Duel Disk, the DiaDhank can only control upto 3 monsters at once, and instead of a counter for ‘Life Points’ their is instead the Eye of Wdjat acting as a golden meter of the user’s lifeforce.

Summoning a monster drains the wearer’s lifeforce, heavily limiting the power and number of monsters one can summon. However users of a Millennium Item gain an enhanced regeneration and capacity of this lifeforce allowing them to both summon greater monsters, and more often.
addons.title: DiaDhank

addons.text:
With this, you may now claim the title of Pharaoh of Egypt, or any appropriate analogue. Even if the original monarchy is no more, the nations inhabitants will still gladly consider you eligible for the throne. 

With this you may rule as the sole and absolute monarch, with all the power and privilege, or simply be considered the Head of State, with an expert, loyal and incorruptible government to care for your new subjects. Either way the position of Pharaoh comes with the loyalty of the Tomb Keepers, a enigmatic faction that seeks to protect the nations historic past.

 You gain a talent for government, and leadership, along with an affinity for games. You recieve a large selection of stone tablets, some already binding ‘Ka’ and some ready for new ‘Ka’ to be bound to. 
Do note all of this is optional, should you not wish to be Pharaoh, or even abdicate the position it is easily done, or undone as desired.
addons.title: Duelist's Kingdom

addons.text:
With this you now gain access to the most powerful magics of ancient Egypt, the ability to host the divine might and powers of a god. Normally the Path of the Gods, connects you to the divinity most compatible with you, now however you seem to be compatible with the entire Pantheon, allowing you to choose and channel the various powers of it’s Gods without risk or harm to yourself. 

As the Pharaoh of Egypt is the link between the mortal and the Divine, should you possess that title you also gain the ability to bless others with the ability to follow the Path of the Gods, and host a singular god. Though this will require them to uphold Ma’at, serving the Pharaoh.
addons.title: Eye of Divinity

objects.text: With this, you gain one of the seven Millennium Items for your own, each acts as a conduit for the magic of the Shadow Games. With the item drawing upon the user's lifeforce to power its functions, remaining loyal unless lost as a stake in a Shadow Game. Although each item possesses unique abilities, they share several fundamental traits. They protect their user against the specific powers of the other items and enable communication with spirits both human and Duel Monster alike. The powers of the Millennium Items can also manifest 'Ka' spirits, to serve the users needs. Each Item also has the power to separate the spirit monster or ‘Ka’ from an individual, and to bind it in specialized stone tablets, once defeated. Each item gives the bearer an increased lifeforce capable of the frequent summoning of monsters, though some of the most powerful will remain beyond your reach. One of the most significant shared abilities is the creation of a “Shadow Game,” which transports participants to an isolated pocket dimension, enforcing its rules with lethal consequences. Victors are rewarded, while the defeated face punishment. Another bearer of a Millennium Item is capable of entering the Shadow Game’s space but is prevented from interfering. Millennium Eye: This item can read the minds of others and peer into the depths of their souls. It possesses the power to extract the souls of those defeated by its wielder and seal them within objects. Additionally, it enables its user to see spirits and can merge with the user's eye, and be removed without harm. Millennium Ring: The Ring directs its wielder towards what they seek, its prongs lifting to indicate the way. It can also seal entire souls or fragments of them within other objects. This item can optionally include the soul of Thief King Bakura, should you desire it. Millennium Rod: This item grants its bearer the ability to control another's mind and communicate telepathically with their thralls. It can seal 'Ka' spirits in stone tablets, and hidden within its shaft is a blade that can be utilized in various ways. Millennium Key: The Key allows its owner to enter the chamber of a person’s soul, providing a view into their personality and memories. With effort, one can 'redecorate' these chambers to alter the victim’s personality according to the Key user’s desires. Millennium Necklace: This item gives its wearer the ability to view the past, observe the present world, and gain insights into the future. Millennium Scale: The Scale grants its keeper the ability to weigh the soul of another, measuring the weight of their heart against the feather of Ma’at. Those deemed truly evil and unrepentant are consumed by the Devourer of the Dead, Ammit. It also possesses the power to fuse 'Ka' together into new powerful forms. Millennium Puzzle: This item summons and controls 'Ka' spirits, including the legendary Egyptian God Monsters. It allows the user to sense the impending arrival of powerful 'Ka' or Duel Monsters, enhances the wearer’s luck, and enables them to detect emotions. This item gives a further enhancement to the users lifeforce, allowing the summon and use of even the greatest of monsters. It can optionally contain the spirit of the Pharaoh Atem, should you desire it. Each selection from this collection will grant you one of these ancient artifacts, should you choose to acquire all seven items, you will also gain the Millennium Stone and the Millennium Spellbook. Millennium Stone: This ancient relic acts as a 'gate' to an alternate dimension, completely isolated from all others. With the seven Millennium Items acting as 'keys,' it can serve as a trap or prison for anything the owner can force inside. It currently rests empty, waiting to be used. Millennium Spellbook: This tome contains the forbidden knowledge of the creation of the Millennium Items, allowing you to craft new artifacts. However, be warned—the creation of such relics comes at great cost.
objects.title: Millennium Items (Yu-Gi-Oh!)

rows.title: Magical Objects of Power
rows.titleText: Note: All non-consumable Objects of Powers can be transferred to another person. When this happens, you do not lose any abilities the object unlocked or awakened (physical alterations, magic independent of the object, etc.) but any soul bonds transferred to the new owner.

addons.title: Code Injection
addons.text:
By overclocking the Regulus, you’re able to inject fully formatted sections into the Black Code. While this can only be done in one shot, and is far from permanent, it can completely rewrite the rules of reality in the area edited for a time. 

Creating objects and phenomena is obvious, erasing the ‘space’ between two locations for instant travel less so but equally possible, as is instantly taming certain Black-code creatures and ‘familiars’. With more finesse, you may be able to create code that wouldn’t be rejected or corrected so easily, though it would require some serious experience.

objects.text: When you enter, you may feel a sharp pain in your cerebellum. This is because you’ve just had had the [🜲] model tissue connector installed. Designed by the technognostic Menagerie, the [🜲] allows you to connect to the underlying Black Code of the universe, and allowing for its manipulation and augmentation. Black Code is a form of source code that is connected to the lowest level of reality, acting essentially with the relationship that a system has to its code, hence the name. Very few things from higher reality can affect Black Code, but from within it, it can have effects on places higher. The pressure of its data is so immense that the [🜲] exists primarily to allow the user to survive connection with it and not be crushed under its weight. From the [🜲], the user can twist small lines of this code to affect the material world around them, with their ability only growing greater the more they understand the underlying language and logic of the Black Code. The Menagerie used it to render worlds habitable, heat vacuum and create matter where none was before. At their height they were colonising worlds with colonists constructed mere hours before. However, things live in the Black Code. Intelligences with no clear form that swim in its data. The larger or more intensive the changes a user of the [🜲] are, the more likely it is that one of these creatures will notice. Some may dive through angled time into the flesh to consume their prey, while others may twist their code to their own ends, or yet others that may simply attempt to devour the [🜲] conduit whole and hollow its user out. The Menagerie after all, used to make stars. But these creatures are intelligences, and while many are brutal and simple, some can be tamed, taught, and made to aid a user. After all, it’s hard to create a menagerie without animals.
objects.title: [🜲] Model Regulus

objects.text:
Connected to your brain in between your lobes is a small implant named the ‘Fortress’ designed to stop any unwelcome mental intrusion or influence via controlled electric shocks to the relevant portion of the brain, ‘resetting’ them to normal so to speak.

By default this is designed to go off no more than once every five seconds when detecting an abnormality to avoid lasting brain damage. While the device itself draws power from your own bioelectricity, it’s not especially shielded and can be deactivated by conventional electromagnetic pulses, from which it will take about three minutes to return to functioning.
objects.title: “Fortress” Model Brain Implant

addons.title: Can’t Stop The Schmoovement!
addons.text: With the Utility fog’s facilities integrated into your armour, you can use it to natively assist your own movement. This ranges from creating grind rails and boost-pads for your hoverboard to tether-points for your grappling hook to ensure you’re never stopping unless you want to. To enable this, a section of your pocket dimension has been allocated to store the Fog when not in use. This pocket can also be used to make the Utility Fog repair your armour in emergencies, though this will likely mean the Utility Fog will need to re-build its full strength after.

objects.text:
You command a Cloud of Adaptive Utility Fog—a swarm of microscopic nanomachines that obey your mental commands. It functions as the ultimate physical toolkit, forming into virtually any solid object you can clearly envision, from robust structures like stairs and shelters to precision instruments like micro-scalpels and calibrated components.

Its true power lies in creative and technical application. For an engineer or scientist, it is a dynamic workshop for rapid prototyping, capable of materializing specialized tools or mechanical prototypes down to microscopic detail. This versatility is bounded by a core constraint: the fog operates with a single, fixed set of material properties. It can shape this material with incredible fidelity but cannot alter its fundamental nature to replicate electronics, facilitate complex chemistry, or achieve properties like transparency.

Acquiring this object downloads its complete schematics and manufacturing principles directly into your mind, granting you the inherent understanding to maintain, analyze, and potentially reproduce it with sufficient resources.
objects.title: Adaptive Utility Fog

objects.text:
Hey, you know how in base building games or survival games, the player characters are able to craft items and construct structures instantly without any explanation? Well, let me tell you a secret—it's all because of the Base Builder 9000!

The Base Builder 9000 is an incredibly advanced ring that bestows its wearer with an array of extraordinary abilities. With this remarkable accessory, you gain a customizable heads-up display (HUD) that allows you to craft and build things instantly, as long as you possess the required materials. No more tedious crafting times or laborious construction efforts; the Base Builder 9000 streamlines the process like magic.

But that's not all! This ingenious ring grants you access to a pocket dimension inventory, capable of storing anything you touch or in close proximity to you. Even vehicles and giant boulders can be stored away instantly—talk about convenience! However, while it can accommodate almost anything, buildings remain outside of its storage capabilities.

Gone are the days of laboriously mining for resources. With the Base Builder 9000, you can effortlessly collect resources from your surroundings, instantly filling your inventory. 

The Base Builder 9000 also allows you to automatically convert a material from your inventory into either its basic components or into its refined state. Anything in your inventory can be used to craft any item or structure you know how to build or possess the blueprints for. With access to a vast catalog of modern Earth blueprints on its own, the Base Builder 9000 offers a wide range of options.

But wait, there's more! The Base Builder 9000 boasts an internal designer function that lets you create rough blueprints. As you outline your ideas, the system fills in the details, enabling you to build structures and items even if they are not already in its vast catalog. However, the technology has its limitations—it can't generate anything too advanced beyond what it currently knows.
objects.title: Base Builder 9000

objects.text:
The Bezerk Chip is an illegal pirate-made override device designed to close the technological gap between insurgents and Coalition soldiers. It was created specifically for use in warzones where conventional hardware cannot keep up with Coalition military-grade systems.

The chip is the size of a modern SIM card, measuring roughly 12×15×1 mm. It is built on a graphene-polymer substrate with nano-capacitor layers for burst current handling. Despite its performance, it is structurally fragile: the casing can be cracked by a hard drop, immersion in fluids will short it out, and even low-caliber ballistic impacts can destroy it. Exposure to strong electromagnetic pulses often corrupts the program permanently.

The chip is inserted directly into a compatible hardware slot, cyberware interface, or jury-rigged machine connection. Once installed, it bypasses system safeguards and installs its kernel override into the host. Within seconds the host device, cybernetic enhancement, or networked system is fully subsumed by its processes. It spreads to all linked personal systems, implants, and wireless connections such as smart weapon links or neural links.

When active, the chip forces a universal overclock across processors, actuators, and neuralware, boosting system performance by 300%. It streamlines instruction handling, prunes inefficient processes, and reroutes all resources toward combat or destructive efficiency. It also removes all safety limiters and cooldowns. Preloaded combat heuristics allow immediate access to libraries of maneuvers, targeting solutions, and destructive tactics. The chip can permutate stored and real-time data to create hybridized outcomes. The result is a host optimized entirely for killing efficiency, with heightened reflexes, improved processing of incoming data, and precise violent output. 

The chip simulates emotion and cognition inside host systems. This effect manifests as artificially generated sapience, limited to violent intent. Machines and cyberware-linked humans experience overwhelming hatred toward all external stimuli, redirecting all thought into violence. Cybernetically enhanced humans can partially resist this effect, though doing so requires significant willpower to prevent full behavioral takeover.

Due to forced overclocking, the hardware suffers rapid mechanical wear. Processors, actuators, and implants accumulate microfractures and material fatigue with each use, leading to permanent system degradation if used extensively without maintenance or component replacement. Data space is finite, and permutations eventually degrade into redundant noise, reducing tactical precision in extended sessions. Lastly, extended use creates a mild addictive response in human users due to withdrawal from the dopamine surges generated by hyper-aggressive neural stimulation.

When removed, the host system immediately loses access to the preloaded database of violent heuristics. For machines this resets them fully to their original state with no residual imprint. For cybernetically enhanced humans, removal produces acute headaches and a phantom sense of lost capability, which can develop into mild psychological dependency. Beyond this, there are no permanent side effects or risks once the chip is disconnected. All permutations generated by the chip is pruned after it is disconnected, leaving only its base datasets.
objects.title: Bezerk Chip

objects.text:
The Blackbox Shard “Brick” was built by pirate engineers as a disposable tool to cripple Coalition systems. It uses an outlawed AI seed designed for sabotage, letting raiders disable or destroy advanced tech without conventional firepower. Although banned, Bricks circulate through smuggling rings and privateers.

The outer casing of the Brick is a rectangular block measuring 17 cm × 9.5 cm × 4.5 cm, made from a titanium-aluminum alloy shell lined with a Faraday cage interior. The unit weighs approximately 1.1 kilograms. The casing is rugged enough to withstand sustained vibration, electrical discharge, and low-caliber ballistic impacts such as 9mm pistol rounds without compromising internal systems.

Internally it carries encrypted memory holding the compressed AI seed and a neuromorphic breach processor, optimized for short-term brute-force intrusion rather than sustained operation. Reactive thermal gel channels cool the unit during breaches, keeping it functional for several hours. Electromagnetic shielding prevents corruption of the payload.

The Brick is activated via a recessed toggle switch and applied physically to the target through a multi-layer contact pad. The pad establishes both a direct data link and an inductive coupling field, allowing for simultaneous transfer of the AI seed and destabilization surges. Breach duration depends on target security level: unsecured civilian systems can be compromised in seconds, while hardened military devices can require several hours of uninterrupted contact. Once the breach is complete, a copy of the AI is transferred fully, and the Brick can be removed without interrupting the infection. 

Inside the host, the AI seizes local processors, memory, and power regulation to sustain itself. It embeds itself into both the firmware and bootloaders so that rebooting doesn’t help. From there it replicates aggressively to saturate resources, overloading hardware through continuous maximum load cycles. Root-level firmware and storage are corrupted while thermal and electrical controls are destabilized, driving overheating and eventual collapse. Before final failure, the AI attempts to propagate across connected devices or networks, embedding itself further.

The Brick is not infallible. If a target system’s protective layers are too robust, the breach phase can extend into days without success. Even if a breach is achieved, if the system has defensive architectures capable of purging or eliminating the AI seed faster than it can replicate, the attack will also fail before lasting damage is inflicted. These limitations make the Brick unreliable against the highest-tier machinery and devices, though still effective against most civilian or moderately defended targets.

The user interface is intentionally minimal, designed for simplicity and speed in the field. A single recessed switch controls activation, with no secondary inputs or configuration options available. A two-color LED indicator provides status feedback: green when the unit is dormant, solid red when active, and flashing red during an ongoing breach. Upon successful breach, the LED returns to solid green, signaling that the Brick can be detached. No other interaction is possible, as the AI operates autonomously once deployed.
objects.title: Blackbox Shard “Brick”

addons.title: Improved Cloning Vats
addons.text:
Your two cloning-systems have combined, improving each other and removing previous limitations.

The previous cap of 50% effectiveness is removed, with each clone now having the full potential of their original, making them perfect clones. This includes all of the original’s reflexes, skills, and memories up to the moment the sample the clone was created from was separated from the original, though the behavioral programming interface ensures that the clones will not share their originals’ allegiances and loyalties unless you deliberately choose to keep them.

Creating a clone now takes only two weeks, and your improved vats can grow up to ten clones simultaneously without any errors or defects occurring. The accelerated aging of your clones slows to 5 times faster than normal aging once your clone has reached full physical maturity, while its growth before that point is accelerated to 20 times faster than normal human development, ensuring that the clones will be ready for deployment even faster.

objects.text:
You possess a sophisticated and self-contained cloning vat—a sleek, humming piece of biotechnology designed to replicate organic beings from raw genetic material.

Clones created within this vat begin their existence as embryos and develop rapidly, aging at a rate ten times faster than normal. This accelerated growth enables quick deployment, but also shortens their natural lifespan significantly. Each clone is a biological replica, carrying the physical traits and innate powers of the original being—though these powers function at only half their original potency, with a hard cap of 50% effectiveness.

The vat is limited in capacity and can sustain the development of no more than three clones simultaneously. Attempting to exceed this limit causes failure or degradation in the cloning process. Furthermore, clones emerge without the memories or experiences of their originals; they are blank slates in mind, if not in form or potential.

To initiate cloning, a genetic sample or equivalent biological marker is required—blood, tissue, bone, or something more exotic if the subject demands it. Your own DNA is automatically registered into the vat’s systems, granting you the ability to replicate yourself at will.

Another feature of this vat is its behavioral programming interface. Before activation, you may predefine the psychological and behavioral traits of the resulting clone. This includes loyalty protocols, moral alignments, emotional tendencies, and more. These parameters can be finely adjusted—added, removed, or edited—to suit your goals.
objects.title: Cloning Vat

addons.text:
It seems you aren’t just any commander, but a member of the High Council of the Coalition of Mankind. As such, the Overseer has been overridden and fully granted you access to its systems. Your 50-terabit per second Councilor's neural uplink has a new dedicated quantum-entangled channel with the Overseer's core processor. This creates a closed-loop cognitive circuit, where the Overseer's predictive modeling, resource networks, and tactical databanks are integrated into your own neural architecture. The Councilor's Knot bioprocessor and the Overseer's quantum core operate in a continuous feedback loop, allowing your will to be translated into system-wide commands with zero procedural latency.

This provides you with the Overseer's complete operational databank, a layered repository that includes real-time strategic telemetry from all assets available, centuries of archived military doctrine, and the full spectrum of civic management algorithms. It also contains the encrypted neural-state backups and decision-tree logs of every prior High Councillor who has ever interfaced with an Overseer unit or its predecessor systems. This grants you experiential access to their Long-Term Strategic Foresight models, their Ethical Calculus Module outputs for historical crises, and the meta-policy frameworks they synthesized, effectively creating a cumulative wisdom database of optimized governance.

Your core skills are now executed through the Overseer's physical infrastructure. Your Resource Calculus directly manipulates the Overseer's control over extraction pipelines and economic protocols. Your Multi-Sector Crisis Management is augmented by the Overseer's ability to run millions of predictive models in real time, providing constantly updated solution pathways for each concurrent emergency. Your Meta-Policy Synthesis is instantly operationalized, as the Overseer's recursive learning algorithms decompose your principles into specific, adaptive commands for every subordinate AI and administrative department within its vast network.
addons.title: Operational Override Code 001

objects.text:
Made to replace the need for administration and lighten the load on human resources, the Coalition of Mankind designed the Command Intelligence Core 05 “Overseer.” This AI-driven unit was created to act as a centralized authority for managing both military and civil operations across star systems, removing the need for human oversight at every level of strategic planning.

The Overseer is optimized for control and coordination across military, civil, economic, and logistical domains. It functions as a centralized intelligence system capable of simultaneously managing multiple complex networks, including planetary defense grids, population infrastructure, resource extraction pipelines, interstellar fleet movements, and economic regulation protocols. It runs millions of predictive models in real time using quantum processing, narrowing down to the most efficient solutions with minimum input delay. Its plans are effective even in low-data environments, maintaining a base success probability of 50% or higher through predictive heuristics and system efficiencies.

The Overseer’s databanks are layered with centuries of compiled human governance data, military doctrine, tactical theory, and civic management algorithms, gathered from both historical archives and real-time observation. It is capable of recursive learning, using each outcome to refine its predictive models and develop new adaptive strategies. The more it is used, the more effective it becomes, learning not just from direct action, but from passive environmental shifts, population behavior, and systemic stress patterns. It is also able to analyze entire sociopolitical structures and predict future unrest, collapse, or economic failure, often years in advance.

The physical form of the Overseer is a tall, monolithic construct resembling a fortified obelisk, fabricated from dense armor composites and lined with reactive cooling channels to support its quantum core. Despite its size and bulk, the Overseer is technically mobile, though only at slow, deliberate speeds. It moves using heavy internal stabilizers and retractable treads for basic repositioning, but relies primarily on a suite of dedicated support drones for full relocation. These autonomous drones, which are stored within its armored frame, handle structural integrity checks, environmental adaptation, external systems interface, and, when necessary, complete transport of the Overseer across facilities or battlefields.

Upon activation, the Overseer will designate you as its commanding officer. It adapts its personality matrix to match your command style and communication preferences, evolving over time to better assist you. It will serve faithfully, with complete loyalty, and continually refine its performance based on your decisions and outcomes.
objects.title: Command Intelligence Core 05 “Overseer”

objects.text:
You have a set of biomechanical tentacle arms ready to go at a thought. The whole system sits inside a smooth, armored bag worn across your upper back. Inside, built-in repulsor tech cancels out most of its weight, making it feel almost weightless no matter who carries it. When you switch it on, the pack tightens and opens a spinal interface that connects into your nervous system or whatever the local equivalent is, creating a direct neural link so the tentacles move just like extra limbs. You can deactivate it and take the bag off whenever you wish.

Four tentacles slide out from the pack, each able to stretch up to ten meters long or coil back in tight for storage. They’re thicker near the base for strength and stability, narrowing toward the tips for speed and control, with a smooth biomechanical surface that bends like living tissue wrapped around a flexible metal core. Each one ends in a sharp, pincer-style claw with extremely fine control, strong enough to crush metal but precise enough to handle tiny parts, letting you switch between brute force and delicate work effortlessly.

Inside every tentacle runs a mix of artificial muscles, gravity-based systems, and tiny tractor beam emitters. When you grab something, the claws physically clamp down while short-range tractor fields kick in along the gripping surfaces, pulling the object inward and locking it into a tight gravity hold that makes slipping or breaking free almost impossible. Spread along the arms are gravitic anchor points that can push against nearby walls, floors, or solid objects, keeping you stable during heavy lifting, fast movement, sudden impacts, or when climbing by creating controlled gravity suction that sticks the tentacles firmly in place. This is mostly used for bracing against the environment due to inertia.
objects.title: Doc Ock’s Envy

objects.text:
The Coalition of Mankind strictly prohibits the possession, use, or research of Fixit Gel. The technology was developed in clandestine Corporate labs for deep-space black ops, but the schematics were stolen in the Antarean Raids, eventually proliferating among pirate flotillas and insurrectionists. This direct nanofabrication method, which bypasses all safety interlocks and ignores material intellectual property encryption, provided the foundational replication and self-repair logic later adapted by the first rogue Machine Hives.

The machine, called a "Putty Pump," was a single, solid box about as big as a large toolbox. It was shaped like a rectangle and had no separate parts. On its top sat a heavy container for raw material, and coming out of it was a bendy hose that ended in a handle, like a glue gun. It didn't have any screens, buttons, or controls. The only things you could interact with were one simple lever to turn it on and one small light to show if it was working.

You could pour in any kind of metal or mineral scraps into the top hopper. The machine would then use that material to make a special repair putty. The putty could be programmed to fix a specific machine. To program it, you had to scan the broken machine first by touching the nozzle of the hose against a part that was still undamaged.

The putty that comes out is thick, grey, and feels like stiff clay. Inside its gel-like material are trillions of tiny, sleeping repair machines, all connected in a web. To use it, you apply the putty directly into cracks or over the broken area. Once in place, the putty activates. The tiny machines inside it rearrange themselves, atom by atom, to copy the blueprint from the scan. They then lock themselves permanently onto the broken object, merging with it. In just a few minutes, it can fix almost any break, crack, or mechanical damage.

It however cannot synthesize biological materials, quantum cores, or proprietary alloys it has not scanned; it will instead merely replicates bulk material properties, often resulting in a weaker, functionally inferior patch if used without scanning beforehand. However, even if scanned, the quality of the feed affects the resulting putty, as it cannot easily create advanced materials from scratch. The scanning process is also easily corrupted by excessive damage or composite materials, requiring an intact "template" section, and the gel's bonding is permanent, making flawed repairs catastrophic.
objects.title: Fixit Gel “Putty”

addons.text:
Your fulldive system can convert almost any form of media into a functional immersive simulation, allowing you to buy any media instead of being limited to games.

Books become explorable environments. Films become interactive spaces. Traditional games gain full sensory immersion and expanded environmental logic.

Missing information is filled in automatically so the world behaves like a consistent setting rather than a rigid narrative.

If you possess Comprehensive Media item upgrade, media formats can also be converted between forms. A game can become a novel, a novel can become a film, or a film can become a playable immersive simulation.
addons.title: Emulator Suite

addons.text:
Your system can connect directly to the reality from which a piece of media originates.

Instead of entering a simulation, you link to the actual world behind the story. The fulldive interface acts as a translation layer and safety buffer while allowing direct interaction with its inhabitants and events.

This allows you to participate alongside the original protagonists and experience the setting as a real environment rather than a recreation.
addons.title: Playing With Everyone

addons.text:
A true MMO isn’t complete with only one player, and a shooter without other people quickly loses its appeal. With this add-on, the games you select no longer remain personal simulations if you choose to.

Any game you brought through your Fulldive Gear can begin to appear within the world itself. The change is gradual and natural from the setting’s perspective. The technology, infrastructure, and player base emerge over time as if they had always been developing.

Maybe someone perfected virtual reality years before Ziz appeared and the industry simply grew from there. Maybe a Thinker with a passion for games pushed the technology forward. Maybe the system exists because Zion fight would be easier.

Whatever the cause, the result is the same: the game becomes part of the setting. Other people can play it, communities form around it, and the world treats it as a normal piece of entertainment or technology rather than something that appeared out of nowhere.
addons.title: They Have It Here Too?

objects.text:
A compact neural interface built around a self-correcting core. When activated, it allows true fulldive immersion: full sensory input, motor override, cognitive feedback, and controlled time dilation with no noticeable latency. Sight, sound, touch, balance, and even pain can be simulated and adjusted within safe limits.

The system comes preloaded with five fulldive titles of your choice, with 5 more with each selection.

These can be taken from any fictional or real game setting. Examples include MMOs such as Sword Art Online, Yggdrasil, Only Sense Online, or Shangri-La Frontier; shooters like Escape from Tarkov or Half-Life: Alyx; or any other genre, whether single-player or multiplayer.

The device also includes a training environment: a configurable white-room simulation used to test mechanics, calibrate sensory feedback, or practice freely, similar to the training programs seen in The Matrix.

The unit is self-powered and highly resistant to conventional damage. Age restrictions and content limitations are removed, allowing access to violent or mature titles such as DOOM or Wolfenstein without restriction.

By default, the system only functions for you and anyone you personally allow to use the device. If the setting you inhabit already contains compatible virtual worlds or games, the interface can connect to them directly.
objects.title: Fulldive Gear

objects.text:
A compact, self-contained traversal tool built around advanced material science and precision control systems. Designed for reliability, adaptability, and minimal user strain, the Grapple Gun V1.03a turns verticality and distance into trivial obstacles.

The projectile consists of a gel-based adhesion head utilizing Van der Waals forces. Upon contact, a controlled electric charge activates the gel, allowing it to bond securely to virtually any surface such as metal, concrete, glass, wood, and even irregular or rough terrain.

An onboard targeting computer continuously adjusts launch velocity and impact force in real time. Softer or fragile materials are struck with reduced force to prevent breakage, while harder surfaces receive higher-energy deployment to ensure a secure anchor. This system also compensates for distance, angle, and environmental factors such as wind resistance.

The cable is constructed from a shape memory alloy filament, extending and retracting via small electrical charges. This removes the need for fuel, relying only on a rechargeable battery. It remains strong and flexible, capable of supporting the user during rapid movement. The cable maintains high tensile strength while remaining flexible, allowing it to support the user’s weight and sudden dynamic loads without failure. 

A modular attachment mount is integrated directly above the grapple barrel, allowing for additional modules or upgrades.

To mitigate physical strain, the system includes a shoulder-to-arm harness that distributes force across the user’s body. This reduces recoil stress during rapid movement, and ensures the device remains secured even if released mid-use.

A user manual is included, detailing operation, maintenance, safety protocols, and recommended usage techniques for optimal performance.
objects.title: Grapple Gun V1.03a

objects.text:
You have a 15-meter-tall, quadrupedal gorilla-form machine with an extremely thick armored frame and a recessed, heavily armored head. You pilot from within a nutrient gel immersion vat deep in its chest; you float in the liquid, wearing a breathing mask and a neural helmet to control the mech and see through its sensors.

The Tecton possesses immense physical strength, allowing it to lift and crush armored vehicles or military-grade fortifications with its raw mass. Its primary movement is through ballistic pouncing, using its oversized arms to throw its mass in arcs of 300-500 meters. Its walking speed is slow, approximately 30 km/h. Its raw, unshielded durability is extreme; its layered hybrid armor is rated to withstand the thermal and kinetic edge of a tactical nuclear detonation with only superficial damage. It is fully sealed for operations in deep space, underwater, or toxic environments.

Your primary weapon is the pair of Tectonic Drivers housed in its arms. These kinetic-hammer systems store energy in torque-flywheels and deliver it through pile-driver actuators. When striking the ground, they inject tuned vibrations to trigger fault line resonance, building on each hit, with seismic events peaking at a magnitude 8 earthquake. When striking a target directly, they deliver that same catastrophic vibrational energy inward, causing the target’s structure to resonate and violently disintegrate from the inside out.

Each full-power seismic strike or maximum-distance jump requires a significant energy diversion from your fusion core, imposing a mandatory 15-second recharge and cool-down cycle. Tecton is also highly vulnerable to focused bombardment or being overwhelmed by fast, agile opponents. You possess no precision or ranged attack capabilities outside of causing massive, indiscriminate collateral damage or using your entire body as a ballistic projectile to crash into foes.
objects.title: GX-9 Tecton

objects.text:
It seems you have come across a foundational piece of technology from a race of beings known as the Rainwardians, who were desperately attempting to escape their dying world and ultimately perished because of it. The Heart From Above is a spherical, clouded gem like device surrounded by deep gray metal that flows around its body, accompanied by intricate, flowing etched markings.

This device is capable of drawing energy from a higher-dimensional source known as the Great River on High, making an incredible number of functions possible. A basic Heart From Above is simultaneously a supercomputer, a large scale energy storage system, an advanced energy converter, and an energy generator. It can convert the higher-dimensional energy into several usable forms, such as electricity and heat, with extremely low energy loss. As a generator, a standard HFA can produce up to 9–10 GW continuously, providing approximately 216–240 GWh of energy per day. With the proper energy infrastructure, a single Heart From Above could provide enough electricity to power an entire city on the scale of New York City. The HFA can also store up to 25 GWh of energy when necessary.

You also don't need to construct an advanced power infrastructure just to use one. The Heart From Above can adapt itself to external systems through a hardened energy field and wireless power integration. It will scan the infrastructure it is connected to and determine whether it is capable of safely handling the power being supplied. If the existing system is insufficient, the HFA can use its hardened energy fields to manage the load and prevent the connected infrastructure from being damaged.
