This allows a Heart From Above to function even when connected to a crude or jury-rigged power grid. Give it a system it doesn't recognize, and it will figure out how to integrate with it. Hell, wrap some copper wire around it and it will determine how to properly deliver power through it.

The item also comes with the blueprints necessary to manufacture additional Hearts From Above. These new HFAs can be specialized so that one of their functions becomes significantly more powerful than the standard model. You could create one focused on energy storage, allowing it to store roughly three times as much energy as a basic HFA while also supporting multiple forms of stored energy. Another could be designed specifically for computation, functioning as an extraordinarily powerful supercomputer that other Tinkers would kill to get their hands on. You could even produce a specialized generator capable of producing up to 20 GW for 16 hours, or an HFA dedicated to energy conversion that can process and transform other forms of energy with even greater efficiency, approaching virtually zero energy loss.
objects.title: Heart From Above

objects.text:
The Heart of Continuance is a compact bronze sphere about the size and weight of a football. Its surface is smooth but marked with faint, interlocking engravings that look like orbital paths or clockwork patterns. Through thin seams in the metal, the faint glimmer of moving mechanisms can be seen: gears, rotors, and crystal-like bearings turning in complex rhythm.

The Heart works as a self-sustaining perpetual motion engine. It produces a small but steady amount of energy that keeps it running forever and provides some extra that can be used. Inside is an intricate arrangement of interlocking parts that convert small changes in movement or energy from the environment into mechanical rotation. This process stays perfectly balanced, so any energy lost through heat or friction is immediately replaced by the device’s own motion.

When placed near machines or batteries, the Heart creates an invisible current that charges nearby systems. It does not need direct contact; being close is enough for the transfer to happen. For example, keeping it within a meter of a drained power cell will slowly recharge it. The Heart can also keep low-energy systems running without pause, such as turning gears, automating simple mechanisms, or powering small sensors.

While durable in design, the Heart’s inner workings are delicate. If it is shaken, cracked, or otherwise disturbed, it automatically redirects all its energy inward to repair itself. During this time, it cannot supply any external energy and only maintains the bare minimum motion needed to restore its balance. The repair process may take minutes or days depending on the damage. Once restored, it resumes normal operation. Furthermore, while it produces infinite energy in principle, the rate of energy it can release at any given time is limited. It is akin to an ocean of power confined to flow through a narrow tap; vast reserves bound by a finite output.
objects.title: Heart of Continuance

addons.title: HAUF
addons.text: Your AUF has been integrated into the HAND. Firstly this allows it to be used to create far larger creations including fully functional vehicles following the same rules as the HAND’s own construction. Secondly, the swarm inherits the HAND’s ability to channel anything you have access to, turning the swarm into a force multiplier on your abilities, building supportive technologies as they become necessary. Unfortunately, without Advanced Programmable Matter they remain only able to use a single ‘kind’ of matter to construct these, but by rationing the materials in your HAND you can lightly circumvent this with it taking the form of the most necessary components the AUF cannot replicate.

addons.title: Psychoshock
addons.text:
By channelling the PSU through your HAND you not only gain more control over the directed portions of it such as psionic constructs and their creation, but you can aim the psychoforms themselves.

By ‘Loading’ a psychoform into the Hand you can use them as ammunition. While this is a highly limited resource as you’d need to replace them to use their skill again, it’s also an incredibly potent weapon, as their skill naturally informs the shot to a far greater extent.

This ranges from a bullet that possesses the target hit to a pyrokinetic becoming a city-destroying laser, to a precognitive sword that hits the exact weak spot in the exact moment it would need to.

addons.title: Repository
addons.text: By routing the trick ammo through the HAND you can simulate a huge variety of novel energies to imbue it with, in addition to its usual function which can be used as though the HAND were any usual weapon.

objects.text:
You have been given a shapeshifting prosthetic hand capable of channelling and enhancing exotic energies through it.

The hand attaches to the wrist with a series of small spikes forming a ‘port’ for it to easily slot into. This ‘port’ also contains a large amount of nanobots connected to the hand, allowing it to alter its shape and function to an extent as long as the new shape would not be more than 1m³. 

Additionally, the prosthetic uses the port to draw power from its user, allowing it to be imbued with both their abilities and any esoteric energies they may have access to. For instance, the hand could easily become a regular gun, or incorporate a form of plasma the user has access to to replace the projectile with this superheated plasma. 

The HAND can create complex tools and weapons instantly into itself using it's nanobots, creating any design the user either has access to copy or can design themselves (assuming they maintain under 1m³ of total material).

You can detach the hand at will, though it will be locked in its current mode and must be reattached in order to shift its form.
objects.title: Holistic Active Network Driver

objects.text:
You possess a small handheld projector able to produce stunningly realistic holograms as long as they’re up to ten meters squared, indistinguishable from the real thing to the naked eye. 

These holograms are able to produce sound and light to mimic any number of things programmed into them, be that image transmissions, video playback, illusory structures, or merely projecting an interface for a linked technology.

Notably, while the holograms appear solid, they are not, being merely projected light.
objects.title: Holographic Projection Unit

addons.title: Scan Complete
addons.text:
The IGS has been coupled with your armour and its Perk system. Not only can the IGS produce ‘perks’ that automatically open up to your selection, or minor powers of its own within the suit, or modifying ones you would have gained anyway. 

Similarly, anything it creates can be instantly added to your armour’s pocket dimension.

addons.title: Iconic Surge
addons.text: By overclocking your IGS, you can ensure a certain expression for its rewards. If you would normally get a weapon for instance, you could overclock it as it’s about to generate your equipment and instead force it to create an armour piece, or a utility item of some kind.

addons.title: Disposables
addons.text: In addition to your Trick ammo working with most weapons gained though the IGS, By linking your Trick Ammo pouch to your IGS it can now generate ‘disposable’ equipment from your ambient narrative energy. These range from throwing knives that dissolve in the target to single use super-drugs.

objects.text: You have been given the ‘Iconics’ Generation System™. This is a small drone that when not in use folds itself onto your shoulder not unlike a singular guard. Devised largely so Malkuth Company mercenaries could go on long-term operations and still receive equipment upgrades when needed and not on the company’s card, the Iconics Generation System is a small Narrative-dimensional manifold contained within the drone from which it pulls energy out of to convert into ‘rewards’ for thematically pleasing events. When you surpass a significant obstacle in your path, be that defeating a notable enemy, achieving a victory, performing a great feat of strength, etc, the system leeches off the ‘narrative catharsis’ energy present and produces a thematically relevant piece of equipment for you. This equipment ranges from weapons (which are common for violent confrontations) of all stripes from wands to sniper-rifles, to armour, to even cybernetics and other implants that can convey a host of abilities. Most of these pieces will have special effects or modification applied, like a railgun that somehow remains non-lethal despite launching a solid slug at 9000mps. Each individual piece of equipment's special effects cannot surpass 5sp in strength. The IGC is capable of limited flight, but has no native defense systems (though it does come with an auto repair). Buy now for the low low cost of 9.50SP! (+tax)
objects.title: Iconics Generation System PROTOTYPE [NOT FOR MARKET RELEASE]

addons.text: The Manus has fused with the core, allowing you to use it to weave the disparate threads of impressions into not only entirely new concepts to be applied but more cohesive and directed ones in kind, allowing a greater specificity in application.
addons.title: Threading

objects.text:
You have acquired a Menagerie Impression core. This fist-sized orb allows its user to absorb ‘impressions’ from their surroundings and project them onto other objects, the environment, or even the user themselves. 

Designed by the Technognostic ‘Menagerie’, the impression core first steals an impression form a nearby element, removing it from the environment and storing it in a virtual repository. These impressions take the forms of qualities (hardness, value, etc), conditions (whole, injured, alight, etc), and forces (moving, at rest, etc), which can each be applied as the user wishes at the cost of removing them from the source that once housed the quality. 

Layering ‘Hardness’ over oneself taken from stone for instance would increase the user’s durability, but not to the same level as Hardness taken from ‘steel’ would.
objects.title: Impression Core

objects.text:
Within your bloodstream, you have nanomachines. Most nanomachines are powerful, but this one is quite... underwhelming in comparison to others. It's capable of minor regeneration, keeping you alive if you are in severe condition, helping purge poison, cancer, and most things mundane, given enough time.

It also very slowly improves your mundane body to be stronger, faster, and all that entails. This doesn't help much though if you are already peak human, or beyond.

The nanomachines have a solid firewall, capable of holding off most mundane attempts at hacking it. Although if it were to ever be breached, your life would be in the hands of the hacker.

Do note that while the nanomachines can keep you alive longer in extreme conditions, it can't do so if you have no more resources in your body.
objects.title: Low-Quality Nanomachines

addons.text: The nanomachine network has latched onto the endless source of energy within you. No longer requiring any outside sources of matter or energy to replicate, the whole network now perpetually operates at peak efficiency.
addons.title: Perpetual Motion (Nano)Machines

objects.text:
You possess a small vial that contains a sample of special nanomachines. These nanomachines are capable of free manoeuvring in three dimensions, as well as consuming any kind of ambient energy or even matter for self-replication.

The most unique aspect, however, is the ability of those machines to influence their surroundings by vibrating at the right frequencies. While the effect of one nanomachine can barely be noticed with precise equipment, if enough of them are dedicated to the task, there is nothing they cannot accomplish, from creating fireballs or crushing mountains to igniting stars or tearing dimensions apart.

These machines reproduce incredibly fast where there is enough energy or matter to consume and are extremely adaptable to their surroundings, allowing them to infiltrate even higher and metaphysical dimensions, eventually spreading to every corner of the multiverse.

You are registered as the central authority of the hive. You can establish rules it operates under, even transfer your consciousness completely into the network or let masses of these machines aggregate inside and attune to other living beings, allowing those beings to wield a fraction of the power of the network, essentially creating a system of supernatural powers. The more attuned people experiment with the use of machines to produce various phenomena, the faster the network evolves, allowing for more complex effects.

The network's capabilities are only constrained by its calculation capability—which grows with the total number of machines—and the number of machines at any point in space, allowing you to achieve practically anything given enough time.
objects.title: Magicae Ex Machina

objects.text:
This sophisticated wrist-mounted computer boasts advanced technology, offering the flexibility for users to customize its appearance according to their preferences. The device is designed with a neural interface, facilitating seamless interaction with all its functions and features. It serves two primary purposes.

Firstly, it functions as a tool for traversing the meta-multiverse. Users write or declare the desired world and timeline for their visit. Once in the chosen world, they are restricted from leaving for a year. The method of travel can be tailored to the user's preference, whether it involves a journey from their current world to the new one or instantaneous transportation.

As its secondary function, the device grants access to a private world. Within this realm, individuals have the liberty to modify rules as per their liking. Time stands still, and inhabitants do not age or suffer from health issues. The user's soul is tethered to a beacon in this world, ensuring their revival upon death, albeit with the need to reconstruct their bodies, a straightforward process. The private world remains concealed, and anyone or anything entering must adhere to the user's rules unless they wield greater power.

Moreover, the device is designed to evolve over time, introducing additional functions and features for its users.
objects.title: Meta-verse Controller

objects.text:
You have an 11.8-meter-tall, lanky humanoid machine with a pronounced hunched posture and light, fibrous armor plating. The cockpit is accessed via a dorsal hatch in its upper torso; inside, you lie prone before a panoramic display, controlling the mech’s movements through a direct neural link while managing systems through manual overrides.

The Hunter possesses moderate physical strength, suitable for lifting light vehicles, but its primary attribute is speed, capable of a baseline of 145 km/h, outpacing most main battle tanks. Its raw, unshielded durability is low; without its Hex-Net active, its armor can be pierced by heavy machine gun fire (e.g., 25mm AP rounds) and would be catastrophically destroyed by a single direct hit from a tank's main cannon.

Your primary weapon is a gatling cannon mounted in the machine’s “mouth,” firing hypersonic slugs in a devastating torrent. Secondary weapons are rocket-propelled, breech-loading cannons mounted on each forearm, firing high-explosive rounds ideal for punching through armor at close range before a swift retreat.

Your key defense is the Distributed Hex-Net, an array of invisible, hexagonal force fields projected in a beehive-like lattice just millimeters over the plating, flashing blue-white when struck. Each hexagon can dissipate the kinetic energy equivalent to a single 120mm tank cannon shell; if overwhelmed by a hit exceeding that threshold, it shatters, leaving that specific panel of armor exposed. Five generators (one in each limb and the torso) power the system. As long as one generator functions, shattered hexagons will regenerate, but each generator destroyed doubles the recharge time for all hexagons, from a base of 3 seconds up to 48 seconds. If all five generators are destroyed, the Hex-Net fails permanently.
objects.title: MK. II Hunter

objects.text:
The MonoNoAware is the vanity project of a Corpo who wanted to “look dangerous” among the gangs of Night City. This implant replaces the lower jaw and upper lip, encasing the lower face in matte white ceramic with gold filigree. At rest, it’s an elegant mask with synth-skin lips, allowing flawless expression and speech. You can optionally have it either implanted into yourself, or have the cyberware in a sterile, satin-lined case.

When activated, the synth-skin retracts. The jaw splits into lateral mandibles as the upper section peels back, revealing a pair of articulated arms tipped with glass vials etched with nano-fluidic channels. Below each vial is single, elongated fang of black diamond-coated monofilament that is sharp enough to pierce ballistics weave.

Upon a successful bite and penetration, the fangs anchor themselves via microscopic barbs and begin a violent siphon. Blood is drawn into the vials, where a centrifuge isolates plasma for coolant, hemoglobin for a metabolic oxygen boost, and crucial biomatter: stem cells, platelets, and DNA. A dedicated micro-AI housed behind the sinuses manages the harvest. It directs stem cells to urgent traumas, sealing bullet wounds and repairing muscle tears rapidly. Surplus biomatter creates temporary protein scaffolds around tissues, granting temporary surges of strength or reflexes.

The device interfaces with other cyberware via a subdermal data-bus. Electrolytes and thermal energy from blood can be converted into direct current, allowing a cost-free overclock to connected systems.

Micropumps in the apparatus also connect to sacs of a custom Biotechnica neuro-paralytic, a Tetrodotoxin derivative. Upon command, it injects through the microtubules, silencing voluntary motor neurons, leaving the target conscious, with a still-beating heart.

The MonoNoAware is shackled to compatible biological humanoid targets; it’s useless against full-conversion ‘borgs, synths, or drones. Deployment requires point-blank contact with a viable victim, creating a significant tactical vulnerability. Additionally, all biological enhancements are temporary, often breaking down within hours as the immune system attacks the foreign cells, with the foreign cells then turned to fuel for the body after being broken down.
objects.title: MonoNoAware

objects.text:
You have been given a prosthetic limb of middling quality. While compared to conventional prosthetics of your world it’s rather advanced and responds as a regular arm would when attached, it contains no additional technology other than what’s required to make it this functional and as responsive. The arm does not have any sensory feedback like a regular arm.

You may select the initial aesthetic of the prosthetic when you purchase it.

For each selection you gain another prosthetic of your choice. Optionally it can replace one of your original limbs.
objects.title: Neo-Prosthetic

addons.title: Vampiric Overclock Driver
addons.text: When you absorb energy, you can instead of metabolising it to fuel yourself, feed it into the reactor, causing it to recharge at an accelerated rate depending largely on the amount of energy you channel into it.

objects.text:
You have an implanted micro-reactor that draws energy from a small pocket between dimensions, letting you overclock your other equipment. 

Equipped with a universal adaptor that lets it morph and connect to any sufficiently advanced machine, this reactor is only able to be used to supercharge what already exists, needing at least a small amount of energy to kickstart its own processes. 

When connected to another device, the reactor can be activated to overclock it, increasing its power and relevant capabilities by up to 50% for ten minutes. If this was applied to a weapon for instance it would be able to fire more powerful shots at far greater speeds, while a communicator may be able to cut through interference and make longer distance calls.

The reactor regenerates one charge every six hours natively, which can be used in succession to overclock a single device up to 337.5% its normal strength, though this will exhaust all of it’s charges, needing 18 hours to regenerate them fully.
objects.title: Overclock Reactor

addons.text: You no longer need to operate the computer. Because you are the computer. Your brain is host to every single byte of its data, can search this data, and perform every single task it can do, all with just a thought. Naturally, this gives your mind an unrivaled level of multitasking and processing power that even the best computers cannot replicate. Knowledge never leaves you, as it's permanently saved within your memory, unless you delete it. This also affects you physically, with an array of powers dedicated to manipulating technology. With a glance or touch, you can “communicate” with a computer or other kinds of tech the same way a USB port or wireless connection would, gaining access to any and everything within it, give telepathic commands, manipulate it with no limits, and much more. Further, you can maintain these connections on a multiversal scale. Finally, the assistant becomes your soulbound and ever faithful companion. They can manifest as a voice in your head, an image in your mind's eye, or project themself as a hardlight hologram that will take a form appealing to you. They are physically interactable in this form.
addons.title: Inner Computer

addons.text: You now know how to forge such computers with all their benefits for either yourself or others.
addons.title: Microsoft

objects.text:
You've obtained the ultimate treasure of all gamers, programmers, software engineers, casuals and others alike. The Omni-Computer. It has infinite battery life, memory, free wifi connection to any universe, a boundlessly powerful CPU, graphics card, cores, firewalls, VPN, and all other attachments necessary.

It is soulbound to you and cannot be stolen, destroyed, hacked, by malicious malware. And even then, you can summon and dismiss it as good as new. It can morph into any kind of computer you wish, even supercomputers. It will always operate at the highest performance, no matter how many applications are running, or how taxing they are on a normal computer. It is omni-compatible with any kind of accessory or device that can connect to it, and also comes with a USB port for said purpose. 

This computer comes pre-downloaded with applications tailored to you, on top of the basic ones. If you are a composer, it will have the only DAW you will ever need. The same extends to mod managers for games, modeling programs for inventors, data analyzers for scientists, or even a program to teach you about magic in an interactive format, etc. But that’s not all, as some of these applications are based on your own powers, which open possibilities you couldn’t even dream of before.

By running them, you can gain a comprehensive guide on your powers, intricate information on their practitioners and history, run simulations and algorithms for experimentation, write code and create programs for your powers, and much more. If you have magic for example, you can write a piece of code that automatically casts a spell on your behalf if a condition you set has been met. Or if you have a crafting power, you can read a wiki showcasing all the things you could make, and the ingredients required.

It also comes with an AI assistant that can perform tasks on the computer, or give you advice as you operate it.
objects.title: Perfect Computer

addons.text: You can make all technology created by Project Build, such as the Build Driver, Transteam gun, and the Sclash system. Additionally, you can also make Nebula Gas, though you will not be immune to its effects.
addons.title: Project Build

addons.text: You know now how to create such forges with all it’s benefits for either yourself or others.
addons.title: Forge Maker
Inner Forge
addons.text: This force is not just perfect, but what your Inner Beast uses to create your gifts. Your Perfect Forge is no longer a physical place, but something nestled deep into your soul that your inner Beast can create wonders from. Materialising miraculous materials from seemingly nowhere it will never run out of material or hands to work it, with your beast taking the place of an entire production line, many hands working in complete unison to create projects far faster and more complex than would be otherwise possible, creating and modifying objects to create anything you can think of.

objects.text:
You no longer need a workshop, forge, or lab, you are the crafting station. The Perfect Forge is a soul-bound, adaptive workstation that manifests instantly in any form you imagine: an enchanted anvil, a hot furnace, an alchemy table, or whatever suits your needs and style. It vanishes when not in use and reforms on demand.

This Forge allows you to craft anything you could reasonably build, given your knowledge and abilities. It can replicate any crafting tool, interface, or magical apparatus you’ve encountered or could understand. Materials can come from your own stores or by transmutation from matter/energy to a resource you sufficiently understand the properties of.

Creation is fast, with simple items taking moments and complex projects forming as quickly as you can conceptualize them. You can also deconstruct items for parts and/or analysis, gaining intuitive understanding of how they work and how to make them yourself. Your Forge evolves with you, eventually supporting the creation of conceptual or metaphysical artifacts.

You may integrate other crafting stations or tools into it to expand its capabilities. With the Perfect Forge, your ideas are no longer limited by space, time, or tools, only by your own imagination.
objects.title: Perfect Forge

addons.text:
Your Mecha was crafted by your Inner Beast for your benefit.

In the modern world, as an average human, if your cannon could collapse small buildings, now it can take down skyscrapers with its energy bursts. The general power level of your Mecha has increased by an order of magnitude.

It would take a nuke to even begin to damage the paint, let alone break through your energy shield. Its weapons are all top of the line, at least 200 years better than whatever world you end up in. Its VI has updated into a true AI ran by your Inner Beast, allowing it to run the Mecha by your thoughts and move with absolutely no lag, with a fluidity that makes it feel as if you were moving your own body.

With its battle analysis software, it can rapidly tune or create weapons and armor specifically to counter whatever foe you're facing. From creating a sword that cuts through space to damage a foe who has time-locked themselves for invincibility to making a temporal scrambler to stop precogs or time manipulators from trying to defeat you in any way but a straight battle.
addons.title: Inner Mecha

addons.text: You now know how to build more mechas with all their benefits for either yourself or others.
addons.title: Hangar 18

objects.text:
Sometimes, punching someone with your own two hands isn't enough. Sometimes, you need to bring out the big guns.

You have a Mecha. Its appearance can be of your own design, and its height and overall power are based on your own. A normal human on modern, mundane Earth with this Mecha will have one at five meters tall, with the firepower to collapse small buildings with a well-placed shot from its cannon and the durability to shrug off attacks weaker than a battleship cannon's bombardment—if they even break through your energy shield, which can take dozens of those direct shots before needing to recharge. By default, it can create any weapons made by modern humanity, scaled up or down for its use, as well as some energy shields. This updates for whatever world you're in.

This Mecha comes with a highly intelligent VI system capable of generating oxygen ex nihilo and regulating cockpit pressure, allowing for deep-sea or space combat. The VI can also do things such as hack into communication systems, distinguish friends from foes, suggest optimal weapons for specific enemies, and even run virtual combat simulations to help you rapidly improve as a pilot.

It can integrate any powers you have, any technology it encounters, and—if you have knowledge of how to conceivably create certain weaponry or armor—it can manifest them without the need for physical materials. Connected to your soul, the Mecha can be summoned or dismissed with a thought. If damaged or destroyed, doing this will repair it. Its weapons appear in its hands or attach to it as needed with a thought, and it does not require ammunition or an external power source to function.

For as long as you're in your Mecha and it is not completely destroyed, no hostile attacks or actions can affect you. Enemies would need to destroy your Mecha first and break open the cockpit to attack you directly.
objects.title: Perfect Mecha

addons.text: The omnitool was no mere extraordinary find but a thoughtful gift crafted by the beast inside. It now performs functions much more efficiently and at a greater scope. Alongside this, it also possesses a veritable endless library of information about your powers and skills and will quickly build one for any setting or world you visit, and is capable of creating training courses that are perfect for you. It can help your research at a much greater pace. The Inner Beast can also manifest itself through the device as the A.I. and can channel your abilities through wherever it is.
addons.title: Inner Omnitool

addons.text: You know now how to forge such tools with all it’s benefits for either yourself or others.

addons.text:
Your Ghost has absorbed the Perfect Omnitool and fused with it becoming something far greater. From the fusion, it has gained all the abilities of the Perfect Omnitool on top of its abilities but even more was gained from it.

Your ghost can now revive you from anywhere and without needing your corpse so the technique of the warlords of old won't work on you now. Its ability to hide in your Light and hide items in it has been greatly expanded being functionally infinite, this effectively grants you infinite inventory size on top of your ghost being undetectable by any means, even the Traveler won't be able to sense it now.

Your Ghost can now use your Light to assist you in battle wielding it as if they were a Lightbearer themselves instead of just a conduit. Its ability to heal has also been greatly expanded if you were an Exo they would be able to heal any kind of damage done to you instead of reviving you for facilitating maintenance.
addons.title: Ghost of the Traveler (Destiny)

objects.text:
When you awaken, you’ll find a curious little thing calling out to you. It seems you’ve lucked upon and bonded with the Perfect Omnitool. This item can take whatever form you wish—from a watch or a smartphone to a book whose pages seem to shift and change or even a small device capable of floating around and materialising and dematerialising at will—as well as change its form at will. The Omnitool can also be stored inside your soul, where it will perform its functions.

It is inhabited by a perfectly loyal and specifically catered to you A.I. that will continue to change alongside you so that your bond is perfect. It can communicate with you telepathically as a result of neural symbiosis. This device will grow over time, developing new functions and a greater range so that it will always be useful. If damaged, dismissing and summoning it again will repair it. Your Omnitool can incorporate any technology or magic it comes into contact with, or that you yourself could conceivably build or wield, into it.

Its first function is its superb ability to scan, analyse, and interpret all forms of data that it comes across. Starting off with, if there is any kind of network of any kind, such as the internet or even a telepathic web, then it can seamlessly tap in, manipulate, and access everything on it. Alongside this, it possesses the ability to scan and record absolutely anything within a 10-mile radius, from conversations across the city to how much force someone is using to strike a punching bag with. Your Omnitool can store and analyse a limitless amount of information and even perform research at your request, such as developing a new spell, and can relay the information to you at any time.

Its next ability is its ability to manipulate the physical world in minor ways. It can create and control hard light, use it to create AR for you, wrap light around you to provide invisibility, or even provide fragile but nonetheless dangerous weapons. It also possesses the ability to manipulate matter on a small scale, allowing it to heal you if wounded or even revive you from total death provided it can find some of your remains. If given time, it can even create items with enough material.

Its final ability is that, as it is directly connected to you via neural symbiosis, it can generate a perfect virtual world that you can freely access and manipulate at any time. A small bonus is that the A.I. can also generate, at your request or automatically, any kind of content that you would like, whether video games, stories, or even TV series, and it’ll all be perfect for your liking even if you never would have thought about it.
objects.title: Perfect Omnitool

addons.text:
This phone wasn’t just something you stumbled upon; it was something the beast within you designed specifically for you. All your apps now operate with significantly higher efficiency than ever before. The planetary map doesn’t just display points of interest; it also reveals everything from various lifeforms and small villages to the names and locations of forests, rivers, and even hidden treasures.

Having Homecoming will fill your phone with an extensive media library and catalog while also granting the phone the ability to open portals, allowing you to explore the vast multiverse. Magic apps go beyond simple step-by-step guides, offering detailed insights into every spell you could potentially learn. They also work to craft entirely new spells and abilities, while also enabling your phone to generate mana that can be used to replenish your reserves or as an independent power source, much like a wand.

The Inner Beast or MUSE can also be an advanced AI integrated into your phone. It manages existing apps with remarkable speed and even creates new ones tailored to your needs, ensuring you’re always prepared for whatever challenges come your way.
addons.title: Inner Phone

addons.title: Apple

objects.text:
This phone is no ordinary phone it has an infinite battery life, infinity memory storage, free wifi connection to any universes if you end up in a universe that has it. If not it can connect to the internet of neighboring universes. It is connected to your soul and cannot be stolen from you, should it be destroyed you can simply unsummon and resummon it completely repaired. The appearance of the phone will change to any kind of design you would prefer as long as it's conceivably be considered a phone that can be held and used by you.

But that is not all, this phone is the Perfect Phone you could ever have or ever need. It gains apps and enhancements to current apps that are based on your own abilities, magics, skills or the situation of the world you're in. For example, it will as default have a planetary map and GPS of whatever world you're on allowing you to know where you and all points of interests would be. If you were to have a gamer power it would gain an app to allow you to see your stats and manipulate your system , if you were to have homecoming or some teleportation power your map would update to allow you to use it as both an enhancer and waypoint feature for your power to allow longer reach and more precise teleportation. If you have magic you'll get an app filled with all the spells your magic could conceivably know and step by step guides on how to learn to and do them. If you're a craftsman you will get an app with how to videos on new recipes or ways to learn how to enhance your craft while also having your map update to show good nodes or ingredients you can either farm in the wild or shops that sell them.

The true unique power of this phone is that it allows you to call anyone, period. Whether they be across the universe, dead, in a completely different universe, an alternate version of them, asleep, sealed, or not even have a phone. They will be forced to pick up the phone call, a video call, or see your texts in some way either by a magical screen showing infront of them or as a thought in their head. This does not force them to do what you say or make them unable to "hang up" but it does make sure they have to answer the call.

You do not have to worry about your brain spontaneously melting from hearing or speaking to Eldritch beings while on the phone or worry about them tracking your location across the omniverse to get you as this Phone comes with state of the art reality warping VPN and Firewall protection.

This phone can both integrate other magics, technologies, and abilities of a similar phone type or something that could become an app, and over time all your apps will naturally grow and change to best suit you.
objects.title: Perfect Phone

objects.text: PROT0•Type uses one of these bad boys to lock up all the light that falls over the American Wacky Epic States Of Mega Epicness. objects.text:
This briefcase holds a volume of programmable matter—an advanced, self-assembling substance that looks like clear slime in its base state. The substance is composed of microscopic units that can change shape, texture, density, strength, conductivity, and other properties based on external commands or pre-programmed instructions. It can flow like liquid, harden like steel, become transparent, conduct electricity, insulate heat, or even mimic biological materials.

To use the programmable matter effectively, the user must understand the fundamental principles of what they want it to become and provide the necessary energy to maintain and transition between states. The container also comes with a comprehensive manual detailing how to create more programmable matter and build the infrastructure needed to fabricate, maintain, and control it.
objects.title: Programmable Matter

objects.text:
The Remote Automatic Factorization & Resource Acquisition Node is a rare, high-tier piece of autonomous technology, so advanced that entire nations would kill to get their hands on it. Shaped like a smooth, 9-foot-wide sphere that floats above the ground, this unit links to its High Administrator (you) through direct touch, granting full control via onboard AI and remote command. At its core, the Unit builds fully automated facilities capable of producing nearly anything; vehicles, weapons, food, construction materials, even military hardware. So long as it has blueprints and the necessary resources. It starts by scanning the surrounding environment for raw materials and then uses ambient energy and matter to build the initial resource acquisition units as well as an adaptive command center where you can physically go if need to. The factory includes dedicated wings for processing, fabrication, inspection, packaging, maintenance, security, and storage. A fully constructed facility is about 75,000 sq ft and 50 feet tall.

Its Resource Acquisition division will scan a 5km radius, once completed it will fabricate custom drones to gather specific resources (metal, wood, water, chemicals, gas, biomass, etc.). Once they have been obtained it creates a transport fleet for efficient delivery back to the facility. Acquisition behavior can be toggled between Indiscriminate Mode (high-volume harvesting, even from urban environments or living beings) and Stealth Mode (quiet, hidden operations in populated or hostile areas). The unit controls all forms of logistics completely under you control and authority, be comfortably with the fact the Unit will never betray you and its loyalty is eternal.

With sufficient resources, the facility can output hundreds of tons of goods per day. You can even pack up and relocate the Unit to establish additional hubs, each optimized for different purposes or environments. While ideal for modern tech, the Unit can integrate advanced or exotic schematics—though it cannot process arcane or supernatural tech without outside support (e.g., magitech integration). If you have a Tinker power this Object will integrate that specialty into its design. If you have Detection and Analysis, its scanning capabilities will be greatly enhanced making it so that breaking objects down are no longer needed as a deep scan can figure out how a piece of tech works and what its made of in one scan. Manton Limits will make it so the whole facility cant be influenced by unknown parahumans especially technopaths, while E=MC^2 will have the facility create mass printers that create objects by converting energy directly into Matter. With so much potential, it'd be best to keep this quiet.
objects.title: R.AF & R.A.N Unit

objects.text: The system surrounding you comprises a set of advanced miniature artillery units and their support mechanisms. This includes 30 orb-shaped plasma cannons, four arrow-shaped scanners, and a specialized headset that allows you links to the entire network for seamless control with your thoughts alone. Each of these orb-shaped weapons fires from it a concentrated bolt of plasma with the same destructive force and range of a 155mm artillery piece. Thanks to their inbuilt AI and integration with the scanners, these shots achieve exceptional precision by automatically calculating trajectory, positioning, and other variables. Additionally, you can amplify the energy output for more destructive power, although this requires a significant amount of energy. The scanners can be deployed within a 15 km radius, providing detailed reconnaissance and ensuring pinpoint targeting through the interconnected display on your headset. With this system, you can remotely observe and strike targets with unparalleled accuracy. For added convenience, the R.C.A.S.D.A.S. (Remote-Controlled Autonomous Self-Defense Artillery System) can compact itself into a suitcase-sized form for easy transport when not in use. This system is highly efficient and requires minimal recharging. When energy depletion does occur, recharging is straightforward: place the system on a stable surface, activate its "digestion" mode, and feed it any material that fits into its fist-sized intake. It can process any substance with 99% efficiency, converting 1 kg of mass into a full recharge.
objects.title: Remote-Controlled Automanous Self-Defense Artillery System

objects.text:
You come into possession of the "Replicating Hand Grenade" (in two identical copies) — a product of incomprehensibly advanced technology and, probably, some kind of magic. The grenade looks unlike any of the types you know, but its style clearly indicates its belonging to this category of items. The grenade has two combat modes.
  • "Device Replication Mode" — the grenade reproduces a previously copied activation effect of another device. This effect always matches, in its basic power and radius, what one would expect from a combat hand grenade. For weaker samples, the effect is scaled upward, and for stronger ones — downward.
    To copy such an effect into the device's database, brief contact with any explosive device or any non-explosive device is required. Only ordinary devices are suitable for copying, but with the appropriate knowledge and skills, it is also possible to work with technomagical and other extraordinary devices.
  • "Substance Replication Mode" — the grenade scatters (splashes, sprays) a previously copied substance. This effect is always minimal in its power but acts within the radius expected of a combat hand grenade. The amount of substance will be approximately equal to the base mass of the grenade itself.
    To copy such a substance into the device's database, brief contact with any desired substance is required. Only ordinary substances are suitable for copying, but with the appropriate knowledge and skills, it is also possible to work with alchemical, magical, and other extraordinary substances.
Switching between combat modes and previously saved samples can be done instantly at any moment. All combat characteristics of the grenade (each individually) can be adjusted within very wide limits: effect power, blast radius, amount of dispersed substance, activation conditions (upon strong impact, by timer, by command, upon enemy approach). After activation (explosion), the grenade teleports back to its owner in an intact but weakened state. Full restoration of the assigned combat characteristics takes from seconds to minutes (depending on the complexity and power of the reproduced effect, the complexity and amount of dispersed substance, and the blast radius). Until full restoration, the grenade can still be used, but with proportionally reduced combat characteristics. This recovery time can be reduced to zero if a large amount of energy is supplied to the grenade. With prior supply of excess energy, it is possible to temporarily exceed the maximum permissible characteristics of the grenade. In the grenade settings, you are listed as their sole owner, with full rights to operate them. You can modify this as well as any other aspects of its behavior. The grenade is extremely resistant to EMP, strong impacts, extreme temperatures, and other factors harmful to ordinary devices, making unauthorized detonation virtually impossible. In case of any damage or malfunctions, the grenade will quickly restore its functionality and return to you.
objects.title: Replicating Hand Grenade

objects.text:
Made in the labs of a now-defunct private security subsidiary, the Sibyl's Mantle was a tool of psychological pacification issued to elite corporate enforcers and high-value extraction specialists. Its design philosophy was one of total denial; a weapon you could not see, hear, or prove was being used against you. It was embedded directly into the thoracic and lumbar vertebrae. You can optionally have it either implanted into yourself, or have the cyberware in a sterile, satin-lined case.

When activated, the Mantle emits a targeted field of infrasound at 17 Hz, a frequency below the range of human hearing. It travels through the air and solid material as a pressure wave, causing micro-vibrations in the ocular cavities and major muscle groups, inducing an immediate, inexplicable physical tax. Movements become leaden, breath feels shallow, and a profound, bone-deep sense of fatigue and heaviness presses down on anyone within its radius, as if the very atmosphere has thickened into syrup around the implant’s host.

Simultaneously, micro-capillaries within the subcutaneous lattice release a synthesized cocktail of volatile organic compounds. This odorless aerosol includes analogues of mammalian alarm pheromones and stress-signaling steroids. It bypasses conscious olfactory processing to target the amygdala directly, triggering a primal fear response. This chemical signal synergizes perfectly with the physical weight of the infrasound, convincing the hindbrain on two fronts that the host is not just a threat, but a predatory apex presence. 

Together, this creates a cold tension coiling at the base of other’s spine, an instinctive recoil they cannot logically explain. Crowds instinctively part, eyes avert, and voices drop to a whisper. The aura imposes a minor social quarantine, making the user the center of an invisible circle of discomfort. For the host, when this implant is activated it has a constant draw on the body’s bio-kinetic energy, manifesting as a lingering chill in the bones and a low-grade neural static.
objects.title: Sibyl's Mantle

objects.text:
You have a special mask that, when worn, seals softly around your jaw and temples, tightening in minute increments until the interior optics, sensors, and neural contacts align perfectly with your bone structure and eye spacing. Across the exterior, a dense micro LED mesh renders a living digital face that mirrors your eyes, mouth, and brows in real time, translating muscle signals into smooth expression. Through neural input you can tune its colour and glow, loop simple images or give different expressions from your real face. Its default has your eyes as a pair of X and simple lines for your mouth.

Inside, the visor behaves as smart glasses layered over reality, correcting vision, enhancing contrast, and filtering glare while dozens of sensors map depth, motion, sound, temperature, and bio signals around you. A constant HUD floats just beyond focus, projecting a rotating tactical map, distance markers, movement highlights, and environmental alerts without blocking your sight. All data streams directly into your neural link, letting you feel direction, proximity, and urgency as part of your own senses rather than numbers, turning navigation and awareness into a subconscious sense.

Functionally the mask replaces every role of a phone, projecting messages, calls, media, documents, and apps into your visual field while responding to eye focus, micro gestures, or thought commands. You can capture photos through embedded cameras, stream live feeds, access networks, manage schedules, and store encrypted data without touching a screen. Integrated directional speakers let you optionally modulating your voice to sound natural, masked, synthesized, or anonymised in real time. The mask can also wirelessly link to any device you’re have access to, pulling their live data into your HUD while letting you control its systems directly through the mask.
objects.title: Smiling Face

addons.text:
The Neural Weave Cradle, designated "Teacher," represents the ultimate luxury upgrade for Chrysalis clients, transforming the system from a mere life-preservation tool into a dynamic cognitive forge. It allows the Coalition's elite to treat their own consciousness as a portfolio to be actively managed, augmented, and refined in real-time. The Teacher is a sleek, cylindrical module crafted from the same polished titanium alloy as the Chrysalis. It is inserted into a dedicated housing on the top of the sarcophagus, just above the head unit, forming a seamless physical and neural bridge. One end features a multi-pin, gold-plated Coalition Standard Nexus Port, from which the user's standard Aether neural wreath can be docked or removed as needed.

Once connected, the Teacher supercharges the Aether, creating a closed-loop system of perpetual learning. While the Aether is designed for short, regulated sleep cycles, the Teacher leverages the Chrysalis's perpetual stasis to run the Aether's cognitive processes on a continuous, uninterrupted loop.

The unit features an automated, high-capacity magazine for Coalition Data Chips (CDCs). This allows a user to queue a complete curriculum to be woven into the user's neural architecture over weeks or months of stasis. The key differentiator is the feedback loop it creates with the Proxy. Knowledge absorbed by the dormant mind is immediately accessible to the active Proxy. More importantly, the Proxy's practice and experience using this knowledge acts as a potent reinforcement signal, accelerating the consolidation of knowledge far beyond passive learning alone.
addons.title: Neural Weave Cradle 09 "Teacher"

objects.text:
Chrysalis is a high-end life preservation and projection system built by Neuropan Systems under license from Coalition Defense Research. It is sold as an insurance product for the wealthy and influential, an expensive and heavily regulated option for staying “in play” when risk is unacceptable. Though a few military branches use it for high-clearance field work, most units belong to private clients, tucked inside underground villas or orbiting habitats, where their owners sleep in frozen safety while their proxies live and act in their place.

Physically, the Chrysalis looks like a metallic sarcophagus crossed with advanced medical equipment. Its outer shell is a polished titanium alloy etched with faint sensor lines that glow in slow, steady pulses when active. Transparent panels along the sides reveal the resting body, suspended in a thick, glassy cryogel that preserves every cell in perfect stillness. At the head of the chamber sits a woven graphene crown that touches the scalp to form the neural connection.

When activated, Chrysalis lowers the user’s metabolism to near-zero using advanced cryoprotectant nanofluids that prevent any ice from forming inside the body. Microscopic repair drones drift through the bloodstream, maintaining tissue integrity and monitoring vital structures while the subject sleeps in total stasis. Once the suspension phase stabilizes, the system brings its Entanglement Relay Array online, a hybrid of quantum processors and neuromorphic chips that mirrors the user’s brain state in real time. This link forms a continuous bridge between the frozen body and a newly constructed biological duplicate called a proxy.

The Entanglement Relay Array functions like a perfect mirror. It keeps the user’s brain and the proxy’s artificial neural structure in constant synchronization. Every movement, thought, and sense experienced by the proxy is reflected back to the original brain through the quantum link. Once active, the proxy body feels and responds exactly like a normal human form. Every sense is transmitted with full fidelity and negligible delay. From the user’s perspective, there is no disconnection between the frozen body in the chamber and the living one walking the world. However, due to limitations of the brain, only one proxy can exist at a time. 

The proxies created by the Chrysalis are refined bio-synthetic bodies designed for peak performance. While they match the user’s overall appearance, their internal structure is mostly synthetic. At a baseline they have physical strength equivalent to that of an elite athlete, capable of lifting 250 kilograms and performing short-burst actions at several times normal human reaction speed. Their bones are reinforced with carbon-ceramic lattices, while their cardiovascular and respiratory systems are miniaturized and oxygen-efficient, circulating perfluorocarbon-based blood that can sustain effort under low-oxygen or toxic environments.

For efficiency, the proxies exclude unnecessary internal systems such as reproductive or digestive tracts, relying instead on closed-loop micro-refineries and perfluorocarbon oxygen carriers. Because they are grown purely from organic templates, any cybernetic implants or augmentations that existed in the original body are not reproduced.

The fabrication system also allows for minor cosmetic alterations with each regeneration cycle. Users can adjust their proxy’s skin tone, eye color, muscle definition, or include purely aesthetic features such as scars, tattoos, or stylized markings. These customizations are entirely surface-level and do not alter the performance of the proxy.
objects.title: Suspension Proxy Unit 05 “Chrysalis”

objects.text:
In its inert state, the system is a featureless, translucent white mask. To put it on, you press the entire inner surface firmly against your face, holding it in place for a few seconds. A cool sensation spreads across your skin as the porous inner layer secretes the nano-gel, which actively spreads to coat every contour from your hairline to your jaw and down the front of your throat.

The mask interfaces with your brain through direct neural contact, allowing you to mentally access the onboard database of ten thousand digitised facial templates. You visualise the catalogue in your mind where you can scroll through, select, and even splice features from multiple faces together, with the onboard processor automatically blending your choices into a coherent whole. Once a face is chosen, the nano-gel sculpts itself, complete with the skin texture, subsurface scattering, and pigmentation of the target. 

The mask translates your expressions in real time, so every smile, furrowed brow, and reflexive micro-expression you intend plays out perfectly across the new face. Your voice changes with it as the gel reshapes your resonance and pitch at the source to match the newly formed vocal tract. Only the areas in direct contact with the gel are altered, meaning your hands, body shape, build, posture, and any other part of you beyond its bounds remain exactly as they are.

To remove the mask, you press your fingers along its edge at the throat and peel gently, the action commanding the nano-gel to lose adhesion and flow back into the mask until it’s once again a clean, dry, blank oval that leaves no residue on your skin. It is stored inside a sealed box filled with a translucent hydrogel that performs all necessary maintenance, breaking down biological contaminants, recalibrating the nano-particle structures, and restoring everything to factory condition between uses.
objects.title: Ten Thousand Face System

addons.text:
Driven by idle curiosity, you slid the ever-shifting scroll into the waiting input of the machine. What followed was not a malfunction, but a transformation. The systems merged with quiet precision, as if this connection had always been intended. And like the saying goes, “Curiosity killed the cat, but satisfaction brought it back”—except in this case, satisfaction arrived in formats beyond imagination.

With the endless well of stories now integrated, the device no longer waits for input—it creates continually. It draws from an infinite reservoir of original fiction and reinterprets each tale through every conceivable medium. From cinematic epic with sweeping scores and flawless casting to a fully realised open-world video game, complete with dynamic dialogue, environmental storytelling, and emotional weight. Even formats such as a VR experience where you become the protagonist are available. You can even create concept albums that translate narrative beats into haunting melodies and lyrics. Animated series, stage plays, interactive fiction—it shifts and experiments without ever sacrificing quality or coherence.

Each piece remains deeply rooted in narrative integrity. These aren't shallow adaptations, but fully realised creative works, shaped by the original story’s core essence. Whether a quiet romance turned into a lyrical short film, or a political thriller expanded into a gripping multi-season series and a companion ARG, the result is always absorbing, faithful, and strikingly imaginative.
addons.title: The Story-Splicer Interface

addons.text:
With your Game Dev power, The Movie/Series-inator evolves to generate video games. By feeding it any form of media, it can generate the absolute best and most enjoyable game possible from it.

How good the game is depends on the media; a small, three line poem might yield something like Dangerous Dave, while feeding it even a half decent story that nonetheless goes on for a while would give you a game with hundreds of hours of playability, deep and complex storylines, an extraordinary breadth of moves and characters—all that and more.

Graphics and such—things that depend on the device itself—remain flawless no matter what. No game developed here can be hacked or develop glitches, though whether cheating is possible remains up to your prerogative. You get infinite copies of every game, and the device can disseminate it however you’d like. You can create games for any platform you want or encounter.
addons.title: Worldshaper

addons.text:
You are now not the only one who gets to enjoy the media created by the Movie/Series-inator. By scanning any piece of media you have access to through a special module, you can reach out across the multiverse to a massive dedicated fandom for that media.

Through this you can discover boards for discussions, theories, fanfics and CYOAs, a video platform for edits, guides, video essays and songs, boorus for fanart, memes and cosplays, a special game launcher for group finding, tournaments, streams and mods, and a shopping platform for official and custom merch, commissions and zines, among other types of fan spaces. You can even find containment boards for shipping, powerscaling, simping, agendaposting and other degenerate fandom behavior.

These communities are guaranteed to be free of any of the inherent drama and toxicity of usual fandoms and always be healthy and active. Any ongoing fan projects won’t suddenly be abandoned because of the creator losing interest or burning out. You will always be able to locate the exact kind of fan content you want as well.
addons.title: The Fandometric Communicator

objects.text:
At first glance, it’s just a chunky metal box, but this gadget is anything but ordinary. Both the input and output stations shift and adapt depending on what you're feeding into it—be it a thick paperback, a stack of handwritten pages, or a tablet loaded with your latest novel or game. Just slot your story in, sit back, and let the magic happen.

The Movie/Series-inator will read every page, soak in the characters, tone, pacing, and even the quiet little moments that make the story special. Then, it'll spit out a fully-formed, high-quality movie or series adaptation, ready to watch. Every aspect of the production is executed flawlessly: the cast is perfectly chosen based on personality, performance history, and visual likeness; the CGI is of such quality that it blurs the line between digital effects and reality; and the adaptation stays remarkably faithful to the original story, while adding cinematic twists that enhance pacing, tension, and emotional resonance without betraying the source material. The result is a professionally polished film or series that feels as though it were created by a team of top-tier directors, screenwriters, and designers.
objects.title: The Movie/Series-inator

objects.text: The Void Traveler’s Gift is a smooth, cylindrical data core containing an adaptive artificial intelligence, created by the Ni’Dexions, a coalition of highly advanced, psionically capable species who survived the collapse of their galaxy. That collapse was caused not by war, but by system-scale entities and reality-distorting anomalies that rendered space unstable and travel unreliable. In response, the Ni’Dexions abandoned expansion and rebuilt their civilization around a single principle: survival through remaining unseen. This core was created to pass on that philosophy alongside the means to enact it. Upon bonding to a sapient user, the AI rapidly adapts to their cognition and teaches its contents in a way they can fully understand, ensuring not just access to its knowledge, but the ability to apply and expand upon it. The core contains advanced designs for self-sustaining voidcraft and stations capable of supporting multi-generational populations in isolation in the hundreds of millions, built for extreme durability, redundancy, and long-term habitation in hostile environments. It also includes extensive psionic augmentation frameworks, enhancing cognition, perception, and adaptability through both genetic and technological means, alongside systems for integrating psionics directly with advanced technology. To counter environmental threats, the Gift provides reality stabilization devices capable of anchoring local space and suppressing anomalies across scales ranging from personal to stellar, with effectiveness decreasing as range increases. Faster-than-light travel is achieved through specialized drives that sacrifice speed for complete concealment, masking all traces of transit, trajectory, and arrival. Additional systems include advanced medical, fabrication, and infrastructure technologies sufficient to guide a civilization to interstellar capability, all designed with an emphasis on self-sufficiency, longevity, and minimal detectability. The Void Traveler’s Gift does not grant power through dominance, but through absence; providing the tools to build, survive, and endure without ever being found. "Live a long life in the darkness, friend. They will not find you within it."
objects.title: The Void Traveler's Gift

objects.text:
You have a 13-meter-tall, sleekly angular humanoid machine with a small, hydrodynamic head and long, digitigrade legs. You pilot from a self-repairing fluid-core neural link pod in its chest, suspended in a reactive damping gel that floods your system with neural accelerants under high-G stress, seeing through its panoramic sensor feeds as if they were your own eyes.

The Revenant's primary armor is capable of shrugging off sustained heavy machine gun fire and directly surviving, though not ignoring, hits from modern tank-fired kinetic penetrators or equivalent energy weapons with localized, contained damage. Its greatest resilience is thermal; it has exceptional resistance to plasma weaponry, prolonged atmospheric re-entry, and the immense waste heat of its own systems.

Your primary weapons are retractable gatling cannons housed in each of your forearms. They fire a continuous stream, with the projectiles gaining significant additional kinetic energy and penetrating power over extreme range, making them particularly devastating when fired from high altitude. At max power, they are capable of chewing through heavy fortification. At close range however they can only damage heavily reinforced vehicles. The weapons remain fully recessed within the armored limbs until the moment of deployment to maintain the mech's perfect external aerodynamics and stealth profile.

Its wing array provides omnidirectional thrust, stability, and acts as a primary heat radiator. The wings can reconfigure from a fully deployed 30-meter span for stable hovering, or be folded tightly to a minimum 5-meter profile for high-speed flight or docking. The wings are rather fragile compared to the rest, as a tank’s main canon can completely shut down the entire system with a direct hit.
objects.title: Type-F Revenant

objects.text:
You gain a supernatural Utility Sticker Catalog, a compact booklet containing stickers, each representing a different common household utility interface found anywhere in the world. These include electrical outlets, light switches, water taps, USB ports, ethernet jacks, coax ports, gas valves, drainage inlets, and other standard domestic utility connections.

Each sticker can be placed on any inorganic dead flat surface. Once applied, it functions exactly like the real utility it mimics—fully operational, durable, and safe to use.
Examples:
• A European Type-F power socket sticker delivers functioning 230V electricity.
• A “cold water tap” sticker produces potable cold water on demand.
• A USB-C port sticker can power or connect devices normally.
• A “natural gas valve” sticker outputs household-grade cooking gas.

Limitations:
• The stickers only replicate utilities commonly found in households worldwide.
• They cannot replicate industrial, military, or highly specialized infrastructure (e.g., argon lines, gasoline pumps, medical oxygen feeds, server-grade fiber uplinks, etc.).
• Output matches what a typical home connection provides—no enhanced or supernatural performance.

Regeneration:
The booklet regenerates one sticker per day, up to its cap of 50. Stickers applied to surfaces last up to 24 hours unless intentionally removed or the surface they sit stops being flat and/or inorganic/dead.
objects.title: Utility Sticker

addons.text:
One of the greatest weaknesses of morphing is the necessity of getting close to potentially dangerous animals to acquire new morphs. The average house pet might pose little risk, but something more exotic like a tiger or a bear can be perilous—sometimes even life-threatening.

Fortunately, that obstacle is now a thing of the past. With your enhanced abilities, you can obtain genetic samples from any creature within your line of sight, no matter how distant it might be—up to approximately 10 meters away.

During the acquisition process, the creature will continue to behave normally while being ‘acquired’. The only trade-off is that the process now takes significantly longer—roughly 10 minutes or so. Of course, if preferred or circumstances demand, you can still choose the traditional method of close physical contact to acquire a morph.
addons.title: Yoink!

addons.text:
You are an Estreen, a rare individual born with innate talent and exceptional control over the art of Morphing. Unlike most, who must rely on concentration and practice, you possess a natural affinity that grants you a heightened mastery of the process. This allows you to direct your morphing with precision, enabling the creation of partial morphs—selective transformations that alter only specific parts of your body or form—rather than complete changes.

Additionally, you are capable of temporary chimeric fusions—the seamless blending of two morphs—either combining two different animal forms or integrating aspects of your original human self with a creature’s traits.

Thanks to your innate talent, your morphing speed is vastly improved. Where others might take several minutes to fully transform, you can achieve a complete morph in as little as 10 seconds or less—a speed that makes combat morphing not only feasible but highly effective.

As a small side benefit of your natural talent means that you rarely struggle with the instincts of a morph.
addons.title: Estreen

addons.text:
Morphing was originally developed as a weapon of war. Typically, when you acquire a Morph, it simply reflects the physical form of the chosen animal or creature—its shape, musculature, and features are directly inherited from the genetic blueprint, resulting in a form that is biologically consistent but not necessarily optimized for any particular purpose.

War Morphs, on the other hand, are optimized with purpose-driven engineering. Every aspect of their DNA has been carefully edited: inefficiencies are eliminated, and traits that confer advantages—such as enhanced strength, resilience, speed, or sensory acuity—are amplified and fine-tuned. 

The result is a Morph that is not just a biological copy of an animal but an enhanced purpose-built tool of war—designed to maximize effectiveness in the field. For example, a War Morph might feature reinforced bones and muscles for increased durability, sharper claws for combat, or heightened reflexes and senses for battlefield awareness. It may also include traits that improve stamina or recovery, ensuring prolonged effectiveness during extended conflicts.

In essence, while standard Morphs replicate the natural form of the animal, War Morphs are engineered with a focus on combat performance and survivability, transforming biological forms into lethal, efficient weapons of war.
addons.title: War Morphs

objects.text: This glowing blue cube of alien technology is the Escafil Device, also often referred to as The Morphing Cube. When properly activated, it grants all those who touch it the power of Morphing. Morphing involves the absorption of genetic material from an animal through direct physical contact—typically lasting around two minutes—during which the user must focus their mind on the chosen creature. The process is often, but not always, accompanied by the animal entering a state of docility, allowing for easier DNA transfer. It’s important to note that morphing only confers genetic traits; it does not transfer non-genetic features such as injuries, scars, or disabilities. It does, however, grant you enough of the instincts and knowledge to be able to use the form's abilities from the outset, such as a bird taking flight. Once the DNA is acquired, the user can begin the transformation process. Morphing requires a period of concentration—initially several minutes—to fully assume the new form. However, with experience, training, or under extreme circumstances, this time can be shortened to mere seconds, approaching instant transformation. Transitioning from one Morph to another is challenging; most individuals prefer to revert to their original human form first before adopting a new animal shape. Initially, only the user themselves can change form. Yet, with practice and mastery, it becomes possible to take on skintight clothing—such as leotards or bike shorts—without losing the Morph. Ultimately, skilled morphers can even morph in normal clothing like jeans, jackets and shoes. One last ability granted by the Escafil Device is Thought-Speak, a telepathic communication ability inherited from its alien creators—the Andalites. Thought-Speak allows the user to transmit their thoughts directly to another individual, bypassing language barriers. Thought-Speak has two modes—Open Thought-Speak, which broadcasts the thought to anyone within the vicinity, while Closed Thought-Speak directs your thoughts exclusively to a specific individual. One final word of caution, prolonged stay in a Morph—specifically beyond approximately two Earth hours—risks becoming permanently trapped in that animal form. However, you will always be aware of how long you’ve been in a Morph, and how much time remains before reaching that limit. Note: If you gain the Morph of a creature with inherently genetic powers of its own, your morph will have those abilities. But there may be a learning curve to mastering those powers.
objects.title: The Escafil Device (Animorphs)

objects.text:
This extraordinary sphere created from the fragment of a star holds nigh infinite positive energy, that can be used to power any machinery you've created. This includes but isn't limited to robots, armor, nano-tech and any form of sentient machinery you possess.

It can also repair and rejuvenate machinery to an astonishing degree, even the most broken and ancient of technology can be revived with just a sliver of its power. Furthermore your creations will become empowered to awesome degrees, with even your weakest war machine suddenly able to perform feats of immense strength, speed and durability.

But only for a good cause, as the effect of the core makes its host a peace loving individual. Assuming it is capable of sentience to begin with.
objects.title: Blue Core (Astroboy)

objects.text:
This unstable and corruptive sphere created from the fragment of a star holds nigh infinite negative energy, that can be used to power any machinery you've created. This includes but isn't limited to robots, armor, nano-tech and any form of sentient machinery you possess.

It grants its host the ability to regenerate, assimilate anything into its own being and assume absolute control over it, growing stronger and gaining new abilities. Further more, it has enough destructive capability to destroy anything to the cellular level.

Proceed with caution, as any creation capable of sentience can become walking engines of destruction.
objects.title: Red Core (Astroboy)

objects.text:
A Valkyrie core is a white sphere whose size ranges from a golf to a tennis ball. When synched it is absorbed into the person’s body.

A Valkyrie Core essentially comes with an ever expanding hammerspace that can store any nonliving objects into it as long as it has space. Any object can be repaired or improved while in storage space and any technology can be integrated allowing it to be used when either stored or expressed externally. Cores tend to develop personalities overtime but other than Durga’s occasional shows of sapience only Kandakara has demonstrated an actual human like personality during its failed attempts to communicate with Koujirou.

Impeller fields are capable of all sorts of bullshit. They essentially act as exotic force fields at their most basic level. Your Impeller also allows you for the manipulation of object within its radius including the human body. It also allows you to perform various forms of spatial manipulation, such as teleportation, at the cost of current Impeller strength. Your Impeller constantly recharges, though the amount it recharges and your Impeller’s total strength is determined by a combination of the total number of hours synched to your Valkyrie Core, compatibility rating, total equipment integrated, and the complexity of that equipment.
objects.title: Valkyrie Core (BAHHSCQ)

objects.text:
You have harnessed the mysterious technology of... Barcodes!

Through highly advanced alien technology, you have a device that can scan barcodes from any source, whether it be products or special cards with barcodes already on them. Your tech would then proceed to create for you a small mech which you can fit in. What kind of mech is summoned and their abilities are all based on the barcode you scanned. With some even taking in properties of the products you've scanned to create them. You gotta get that product placement money somehow.

The mechs range from as big as cars to as big as medium sized houses. Their abilities can range from warrior types which focuses on melee, and wizard types which are range specialists. The mechs are also resistant to most natural damage such as the cold or the heat. They are also bulletproof. You may also use the mechs to travel underwater or fly high altitudes, of course, depending on what mech you end up scanning. Finally, you can always store your barcodes at the ready, so you have a library of mechs just on your disposal. The possibilities are as endless as there are many barcodes.

Finally, you can improve your mechs by scanning Items or other Mechs into your device. Item Barcodes serve as equipment that temporarily boosts your mech. While scanning another Mech when you've already summoned one causes the two Mechs to fuse, giving you even more possibilities (though keep in mind, they also inherit the drawbacks of each parts of the fusion).

Overall, this new technology is in your hands. It's time to scan your way into victory.
objects.title: Barcode Battler (Barcode Fighter)

objects.text:
This strange contraption, hidden deep within the core of Piscciss, is the Centripetal Accelerator—an ancient device that held the mostly aquatic planet together.

The Centripetal Accelerator grants its wielder the power to command and control gravity. It can be configured to perform the singular, formidable task of holding a planet together with relative ease. However, using it for everyday purposes will, at least initially, trade off some of its power and range in favor of greater precision and control.

With enough practice and skill, the device’s capabilities can be expanded to emulate a wide range of superpowers, including super strength, flight, telekinesis, super speed, heightened agility, and much more.

Over time, mastery of the Centripetal Accelerator will allow you to create, manipulate, and dispel such phenomena as black holes—and even tow planets and stars through space.

Initially, the device’s influence—at least for casual use—is confined to a radius spanning several city blocks. Yet, with time—roughly a decade—its range is destined to expand dramatically, eventually allowing the user to influence entire star systems. And even then, its potential for growth remains vast.
objects.title: The Centripetal Accelerator (Ben 10)

objects.text:
