Crafted by the Weaponmasters of Techadon, this small device creates Techadon robots when exposed to water. Upon contact with moisture, the cube spawns a new unit that rapidly expands into a fully functional robot within seconds, obeying only the individual who activated it.

These war machines boast enhanced strength, durability, nanite-based regeneration, flight capabilities, and built-in laser weaponry. However, their intelligence is rather rudimentary, so don't expect them to be more useful than muscle.

Users can also don the cubes as modular power armor to directly access their many functions. Each cube contains enough material to generate up to 1,000 robots, making it a formidable force multiplier for any army.
objects.title: Dehydrated Techadon Army Cube (Ben 10)

objects.text: "THREE... TWO... ONE... LET IT RIP!" You have been given access to a Beyblade of your choice, with the ability to maintain it and make the parts as needed. While this may seem underwhelming to those who do not know their true power, trust that they can in fact be very powerful. These tops, developed even in ancient times, once allowed Moses to part the red sea, were made from star fragments, and even have powers related to their bit face. Afterimages, gravity wells, opening the gates of hell, tornadoes and more, these beys each have their own abilities! Your bey will, if possible, have evolutions you can unlock that turn stronger and stronger, allowing even greater abilities than before. a bey that could previously heat itself up to allow for harder impacts, could evolve into one to allow even a tornado of fire!
objects.title: Beyblades (Beyblade)

objects.text:
A Vita-Chamber is a freestanding, coffin-sized medical machine of brushed alloy and frosted glass, threaded with softly glowing filament conduits that pulse like a heartbeat. It was originally marketed as a luxury “restorative wellness booth”—a way to “restore vigor and spirit with the touch of a button”—but its real function is far more extreme: it can bring you back after death.

When you first claim the Vita-Chamber, it performs a Vita-Imprint: a deep scan and registration of your genetic information. From that moment on, the chamber maintains a constant low-grade quantum entanglement tether to you. If you suffer a qualifying death, that tether “snaps” your living pattern back to the chamber, where it rebuilds a new body and restarts you.

The reconstruction process is not slow-clone growth. It’s rapid, surgical assembly—flesh, bone, and brain reconstituted from the chamber’s internal reservoirs plus whatever raw matter and energy it can safely draw from the environment. When you wake, you’re alive, coherent, and functional.

The Vita-Chamber only activates on acute, traumatic death—catastrophic injury, sudden violence, explosive force, lethal impact, and similar immediate causes. It does not save you from slow wasting illnesses, degenerative genetic conditions, long-term organ failure, or other deaths that occur as a gradual collapse rather than a single traumatic event. If you die from those, you stay dead.

Each time it successfully restores you, you return with a considerable amount of health and a restored reserve of bioelectric “drive” suitable to the setting—whatever your powers or systems treat as the body’s usable fuel. The chamber can be used without limit as long as it remains operational and able to complete a full rebuild cycle.

The Vita-Chamber is not limited to you alone. By inserting a genetic sample—blood, tissue, saliva, or any equivalent biological marker—you may register additional individuals into its imprint registry. Once registered, those individuals gain the same tethered restoration effect, reviving at the chamber under the same conditions and limitations as you.
objects.title: Vita-Chamber (Bioshock)

objects.text:
"We thirst for the seven wailings. We bear the koan of Jericho."

With the above password, you are now the owner of a tablet of unknown origins.

On the more mundane side, the Shittim Chest is an incredibly advanced tablet that is capable of anything a normal tablet can do, and comes preinstalled with a number of apps to connect to the local internet and various social media platforms.

On the more advanced/mystical side, the tablet is home to an AI by the name of Arona, whose presence makes the Shittim Chest near unhackable and unusable by anyone but you. In addition to her own hacking abilities, Arona is capable of interacting with you either via the Shittim Chest screen, or by pulling you into a virtual space within the Chest.

The Shittim Chest finally includes a forcefield that scales with your own defense. The forcefield has a limited charge that lowers depending on how much damage the attack would have done to you, and will recharge over time. At the level of a baseline human, it will endure a number of bullets before running out, but a direct explosion would instantly tank it from 100% charge to 0% charge.

You may optionally choose to replace Arona with Plana, or an AI you obtained elsewhere.
objects.title: Shittim Chest (Blue Archive)

objects.text:
Through an unknown process, your body have successfully assimilated the powerful CryNet Nanosuit 2.0. This assimilation has granted you a range of extraordinary abilities, merging man and machine into a formidable force.

With the assimilated Nanosuit, you possess enhanced strength, agility, and durability beyond human limits. Your physical abilities are amplified, allowing you to effortlessly leap great distances, scale walls with ease, and engage in combat with increased power and precision.

The Nanosuit's advanced nano plating has integrated into your skin, offering unmatched protection, shielding you from bullets, explosions, and other forms of damage. The Nanosuit can easily adapt to various environmental conditions, providing camouflage to blend seamlessly into surroundings, augmenting your senses for enhanced perception, and protecting you from even the most extreme temperatures. 

Integrated into your nervous system, the Nanosuit grants you unparalleled control over nanotechnology. You can harness this power to rapidly regenerate wounds, heal injuries, and enhance your overall vitality. Additionally, the Nanosuit grants you access to a mental database of technology developed by C.E.L.L.

Furthermore, the Nanosuit's advanced visor which has integrated into your eyes grants you a very user friendly thought activated HUD, enhanced vision modes, allowing you to see in the dark, detect enemies through walls, and analyze the battlefield for strategic advantage.

As you continue to master the assimilated Nanosuit, its potential will grow exponentially. Overtime, you will unlock additional abilities, customization options, and increased efficiency in utilizing its full range of powers.
objects.title: CryNet Nanosuit 2.5 (Crysis)

addons.text:
Now, along with your implants, you may optionally also undergo a Full Body Conversion into a frame befitting the grade you have purchased. Any implants you have purchased with the base power will be integrated into the model at no additional cost.

With the first purchase, you are given access only to the Gemini frame. With this, you get an overall boost to your strength, speed, durability, and an increased lifespan on top of it. This frame is the only model that looks human, however people who are exceptionally perceptive will be able to tell that you are not fully human.

With the second purchase, you gain access to military grade frames, such as the Militech Eclipse, focusing on stealth and assassination, and the Wiseman, focusing primarily on netrunning. This also includes the IEC Dragoon, the all-rounder frame focused on direct combat. These models onward forgo the human look in favor of function, remember that.

With the third purchase, you are allowed to choose the top frames in the Cyberpunk world, such as the heavily modified Dragoon used by Adam Smasher, and the infamous Arasaka DaiOni. At this tier, you may choose to have normally incompatible cyberware installed into you with little to no consequence, such as having a Sandevistan and a Berserk installed simultaneously.
addons.title: Full Body Conversion

addons.text:
With each purchase of this power, you gain a set of enhancements from Eclipse Phase TTRPG technology, chosen from any shown, referenced, or mentioned in the game's universe. The rules of purchase stay the same as in Cyberpunk as you cannot use this to perform a full ego-to-infolife but could become any "type" of morph, even the animalistic ones.

With the first purchase, you gain access to civilian-grade enhancements, including common augmentations like enhanced sensory systems, medichines (self-repair nanites), and basic physical improvements available to most citizens or morphs in Eclipse Phase society.

With the second purchase, your enhancements are upgraded to military-grade, granting access to advanced and restricted tech. This includes combat morphs, tactical upgrades like cortical stacks, enhanced reflex augmentations, and psi-boosting interfaces, designed for covert operatives, soldiers, and elite agents.

With the third purchase, your enhancements reach cutting-edge and experimental levels. These are top-tier upgrades, including morphs and implants that rival or exceed anything currently in use, such as experimental ghost morphs, prototype ego bridges, or direct-mind interfacing technologies.
addons.title: Custom Morph (Eclipse Phase)

addons.text:
With each purchase of this power, you gain a set of enhancements from Sufficient Advanced TTRPG technology, chosen from any shown, referenced, or mentioned in the game's universe. The rules of purchase stay the same as in Cyberpunk as you cannot use this to perform a full ego-to-A.I..

With your first purchase, you gain access to civilian-grade enhancements, which range from levels 1 to 5 on the SA1 technology scale. These common augmentations include Genetic Modification Techniques, Biosensors, Lenses, Neural Meshes, Weak Stealth Technology, Memetics, Data Ghosts, Cerebral Firewalls, and more.

Your enhancements upgrade to military-grade with the second purchase, corresponding to levels 6 to 8 on the SA1 scale. This grants you access to advanced and restricted technologies, including Compression Beams, Decay-Induction Fields, Emotion Beams, Post-Facto Genetic Engineering, Instant Response Techniques, Inversion Beams, Memory Recombination, Microbot Fabrication Units, Nanophages, Pathogenesis Organs, Transmutation Beams, and more.

Upon reaching the third purchase, your enhancements attain cutting-edge and experimental status, ranging from levels 9 to 10 on the SA1 technology scale. These top-tier upgrades include implants that rival or surpass anything currently available, such as Singularity Launchers, Vortex Sinks, Fission-Fusion Beams, Internal Simulation Processors, Genetic Resynthesis, Inorganic Cells, and more.
addons.title: Cargo Cultist (Sufficiently Advanced)

addons.text:
You call yourself a Magos, yet you rely on basic, unmodified flesh? It’s time to change that. With each purchase of this power, you gain a set of enhancements derived from Adeptus Mechanicus technology, selected from any items shown, referenced, or mentioned within the universe. The purchasing rules remain consistent with those in Cyberpunk, meaning you cannot perform a full Abominable Intelligence conversion, as the Doctrine dictates, but could be a Brain on a Mechanical Skull while piloting a body puppet.

With your first purchase, you gain access to initiate-grade bionics from one of the following Orders: Electro, Rune, Transmechanic, or Lexmechanic. This includes Bionic Organs, Bionic Senses, necessary Mechadendrites, and Auspex devices.

Your enhancements upgrade to Skitarii-grade with the second purchase, sourced from the Genetor, Logis, Artisan, or Enginseer Orders, with your bodily systems calibrated to function with absolute efficiency, enhancing not only physical resilience but also sensory perception, data processing, and tactical reflexes, gaining access to advanced Mechadendrites fitted with tools for hacking, repair, or even direct combat applications, such as laser cutters and plasma welders.

Upon reaching the third purchase, your augmetics attain Fabricator-General and Standard Template Construct (STC) status, representing the pinnacle of Adeptus Mechanicus technology bordelining on Heretek. You can select augments such as cognition engines capable of processing data at a A.I. level, nano-fiber muscle replacements that vastly increase strength and durability, and reactor cores that provide virtually unlimited energy for your systems.

If you have STC upgrade, the progession goes: Man of Stone, Man of Iron, Man of Gold.
addons.title: Augmentics (Warhammer: 40k)

addons.text:
With each purchase of this power, you gain a set of enhancements from the technology of the Metal Gear universe, comparable to any shown, referenced, or mentioned in the game's universe. The rules of purchase stay the same as in Cyberpunk, as you cannot use this to become an pure AI like Strangelove did.

With the first purchase, you gain access to near-human enhancements, comparable to the genetic modifications of the Genome Soldiers, Les Enfants Terribles, The Perfect Soldier Project, and The Successor Project, nanomachines and cybernetics on the level of those used by Solid Snake during the Shadow Moses incident, Raiden, Solid Snake, & The Tengu Unit during the Big Shell incident, & PMCs or the US Military during the Sons Of The Patriots incident. You can also gain "abnormal" abilities of limited strength such as those of the Cobra Unit.

With the second purchase, your enhancements are upgraded to noticeably superhuman levels, on the level of most bosses in the main series. This includes biological modifications on the level of the Parasite Unit or Quiet, nanomachines and cybernetics roughly on the level of Vamp, Frank Jaeger, Olga Gurlukovich, Solidus Snake, MGS4 Raiden, The FROG Unit, or The Beauty & The Beast Unit, & from the "abnormal" perspective you can have abilities on the level of Colonel Volgin i.e. The Man On Fire, Shadow Moses-era Psycho Mantis, Elisa & Ursula, Fortune, or BEAGLE's psychic children.

With the third purchase, your enhancements reach the absolute limit of what is available. Your nanomachines and cybernetics are on par with anyone in Metal Gear Rising, whether they be a grunt of some kind, a Wind Of Destruction, Raiden, or Senator Armstrong himself. Your "abnormal" abilities can be equal to a young Tretij Rebenok or Screaming Mantis.
addons.title: SOP System (Metal Gear)

addons.text:
With each purchase of this power, you gain a set of implants derived from the RimWorld universe, taken from technology available in the Spacer era, Glitterworlds, or Archotech. You may choose which implants to receive, provided they are compatible with each other and follow the other rules from the base power.

With your first purchase, you gain access to Spacer-tier augmentations. These include prosthetic limbs, standard bionics, and organ replacements such as bionic eyes, bionic arms, bionic legs, and power claws, as well as neural implants like the painstopper and joywire. These augmentations are practical and robust, enhancing survivability and labor, but rarely push beyond peak human limits.

With your second purchase, your implants advance to Glitterworld-tier. At this level, you may select from implants such as detoxifier kidneys, nuclear stomachs, circadian half-cyclers, healing enhancers, psychic sensitizers, or specialized augmentations like venom fangs and reprocessor stomachs. Bionic limbs at this tier are not just replacements but permanent upgrades, far exceeding human performance in speed, strength, or resilience.

With your third purchase, your implants ascend to Archotech-tier. These are scarcely understood, operating on principles far beyond known science and appearing almost alive. Examples include Archotech arms and legs, capable of impossible precision and speed; Archotech eyes that pierce spectra far beyond the electromagnetic; or even Persona A.I.s that restructure cognition, memory, and willpower into something post-human.
addons.title: Implants (RimWorld)

addons.text:
With each purchase of this power, you gain a set of enhancements from the bio-technology of Resident Evil, comparable to any shown, referenced, or mentioned in the game or film universes. The rules of purchase stay the same as in Cyberpunk, as you cannot use this to become an AI like the Red Queen.

With the first purchase, you gain access to near-human enhancements, comparable to the success stories of Project W or a certain boulder punching steroid abuser, biological modifications on the level of those used by Jack Krauser, or that of roughly human level BOWs, like the Los Illuminados "Ganados", the "Majini" of the African nation of Kijiju, the Romanian "Lycans", "Moroaică", & "Soldats", or human-passing Mold people like Ethan Winters and the weaker members of the Baker Family.

With the second purchase, your enhancements are upgraded to noticeably superhuman levels, on the level of most notable BOWs. This includes biological modifications on the level of the Hunters & Farfarello, Lickers, Tyrant variants, Nemesis units, Los Illuminados cult leadership, Regeneradors, Novistadors & Verdugos, the Dimetrescu daughters, and so on. Anything clearly more powerful than a human (but that would still die to RPG fire) goes here.

With the third purchase, your enhancements reach the absolute limit of what is possible. Your biological abilities are on par with the most terrifying beings found in those worlds, including Albert Wesker after he fully activated Uroboros, the ridiculous and unexplained abilities of the many versions of Alice from the film universe, the t-Veronica derivatives used by Alexia Ashford and Carla Radames, and high level Cadou and Mold users like Eveline, Mother Miranda, The Four Kings, & Jack Baker.
addons.title: Complete Global Saturation (Resident Evil/Biohazard)

addons.text:
With each purchase of this power, you gain access to cybernetics and augmentations from across Star Wars media — films, comics, novels, and games. You may choose any systems or implants shown or mentioned in the universe.

With your first purchase, you receive high-quality but standard prosthetics and implants used across the galaxy. Examples include prosthetic limbs like Luke or Anakin Skywalker’s, ocular and auditory implants, cranial data ports, and internal life-support systems. These restore or slightly enhance organic performance while maintaining a natural appearance.

Your second purchase grants enhancements now rivaling elite cyborgs such as Echo or Darth Vader and their outdated and sabotaged cybernetics. You gain reinforced limbs, servo-assisted strength, integrated tools or weapons, advanced sensory suites, and partial environmental sealing. You are clearly augmented beyond human limits but remain mostly organic.

For your third purchase, you undergo total cybernetic reconstruction, becoming akin to General Grievous or the B’omarr Monks. You may choose any frame design — humanoid, droid, or custom hybrid. Your body is capable of fighting Jedi Masters and features internal algorithms that can predict the near future, similar to Force users.
addons.title: Droid (Star Wars)

addons.text:
With each purchase of this power, you gain a set of enhancements from the technology of the Deus Ex universe, comparable to any shown, referenced, or mentioned in the game's universe. The rules of purchase stay the same as in Cyberpunk, as you cannot use this to become a pure AI like Helios.

With the first purchase, you gain access to enhancements like the chemical and biological augmentations of Majestic-12's Men In Black, the Illuminati Elite Troopers, & transgenic creatures like Greys, Greasels, & Karkians. This includes super-strength & super-endurance, elimination of pain & fear, increased intelligence, resistance to extreme conditions, immunity to poison, the Greys' poison spit, a toggleable version of the Greys' radioactive aura, & the ability to explode on death.

With the second purchase, your enhancements are upgraded to mechanical augmentations, like those of Adam Jensen, David Sarif, Ben Saxon, Anna Kelso, Jordan Shea, Gunther Hermann, Anna Navarre, & The Tyrants. Examples include super-speed, internal radar, hacking & multimedia infolinks in your brain, a social enhancer, stealth information tools, augmented vision, cyberlimbs & nanoblades, regeneration & designer cells granting super-endurance, cyberlungs & environmental filtering, internal batteries & rechargers, the Typhoon Explosive System, Icarus Landing System, dermal armor, cloaking systems, PEPS & TESLA blasts, & micro-assemblers.

With the third purchase, you begin receiving nano augmentations, like those of the Dentons (JC, Paul, & Alex), Bob Page, Walton Simmons, the Omar, & the Tarsus Program. This includes superior versions of previous aug types, sensor stealth, water breathing, force fields & nano-reactive armor, a heart aug that upgrades other augs, IFF, spy drones, & nano-flashlights.
addons.title: My Vision Is Augmented (Deus Ex)
Henshaw (DC Comics)
addons.text:
You’ve been given access to implants and cybernetics from across the DC Universe, from film and TV to the original comics. You may choose any systems or implants shown or mentioned in DC media. 

With the first purchase you’ll receive either general improvements or high quality but niche implants. Examples include Earl Dukeson’s metallic whips, Shelton Lyle’s general enhancements, or Idamm’s thanegarian cybernetics.

With the second purchase, you’ll be given half-conversions, taken form the higher levels of the scientific community, like Silas Steel’s conversion of his son Victor, The One Man Army Corps, or Ace Masterson the Human Dynamo.

With the third purchase you’ll reach the highest echelons of cybertech, and full body conversions or full reconstructions like Hank Henshaw the ‘Cyborg Superman’, the various Taskforce VII Amazos, or Brainiac.

objects.text: With each purchase of this power, you gain a set of implants that is shown, referenced, or mentioned in Pondsmith’s Cyberpunk series. You may choose the specifics, so long as it is available and compatible at your level of purchase. For each purchase, you may choose to get the same implants, but at a higher grade. Some implants only become possible at a certain purchase, such as an implant not having a civilian-grade model, but having a military-grade model. There are a few limitations to this. Firstly, you cannot use this to perform a Full Body Conversion of any kind, even the Gemini model is prohibited. Secondly, you cannot choose to have cyberware that is incompatible with each other, nor can you have 2 pieces of cyberware that a person can normally have one of at any given time. Thirdly, as you are purchasing these implants with SP, and that these implants will be tailor-made for you, the effects of cyberpsychosis will not exist in these implants and these ones alone. If you replace these implants with other implants, however, then it’s fair game. With the first purchase, you get Civilian-Grade cyberware, implants that would be commonly seen being used by the general populous, such as optics, Skinweave, subdermal armor, etc.. With the second purchase, your implants are upgraded to the Military-Grade, and any implants of this grade that do not have a civilian model are available for you to choose. This would be seen on various Solos, Edgerunners, and Netrunners, such as Cyberdecks, Sandevistans, Gorilla Arms, Monowires, Kerenzikovs, Linear Frames, and more. With the third purchase, your cyberware becomes top-of-the-line, cutting-edge products, and anything of this grade (the very few) are available to you. You won’t find anything better in the modern day. Welcome to the top, Choom. This includes prototypes and experimental cyberware such as the prototype Arasaka Cyberskeleton.
objects.title: Cyberware/Bioware Implants (Cyberpunk)

objects.text:
What you hold in your hands is an unparalleled marvel of technological ingenuity—the prototype of a Next Gen Military-Grade Sandevistan. This groundbreaking device grants its user the ability to transcend the constraints of time, seamlessly slowing down their perception while amplifying their speed and reflexes to extraordinary levels. Within its sleek exterior lies a powerful time dilation effect, allowing you to move with such grace and precision that the world around you appears frozen in suspended animation.

What sets this Sandevistan apart is its noninvasive nature, eliminating the need for any intrusive surgical procedures. Instead, it effortlessly adheres to your back, seamlessly blending with your body. The design is so impeccable that you won't even notice its presence, granting you unparalleled comfort and freedom of movement. With this unique feature, you gain the ability to attach and detach the Sandevistan at will. Once affixed, it remains steadfastly in place until you decide otherwise.

The beauty of this experimental creation lies in its boundless potential. Unlike its predecessors, this Sandevistan can be utilized limitlessly, with no adverse effects or consequences.
objects.title: Next Gen Sandevistan (Cyberpunk)

objects.text:
You've come across a Relic BioChip, a mass of nanomachines designed to implant an Engram into a mind. This Engram is a Blank Self-Adaptive Artificial Intelligence (SAAI) with the potential to evolve into a True AI given ample time and access to vast amounts of information.

The hard limit of this AI is determined by the scope of your thinking, expanding in cases where you can think with your soul, possess tremendous mental faculties or is just a Sentient Phenomenon. Meanwhile, the soft limit lies in its information processing, usage efficiency, and self-adaptation capabilities, similar to other AI systems, albeit without any specific goals or adversities to guide its evolution, it might remain inactive.

This Engram's external influence is confined to your mind's capabilities, functioning as an exceptionally capable companion in the absence of external powers. However, if you possess abilities such as Technopathy, Telepathy, Psychokinesis, Esper abilities, or any other powers derived from or accessible by the mind, the SAAI can harness and utilize these powers as well.
objects.title: Relic Biochip™ (Cyberpunk)

objects.text:
At first glance, what you receive appears to be a pile of small cubes with intricate patterns on their surface; however, in reality, these are an extraordinary material made of ultra-high-density nanomachines called Nanoskin, with which you can create anything.

The Nanoskin is similar to clay in that it is capable of changing shape, surface texture, and density, transforming into a wide variety of objects and structures; this process works through the nanomachines within the material, which respond to electrical signals generated by the wielder's brain during visualization, translating thoughts into tangible constructs, taking the exact form of whatever is imagined.

While the initial amount of material you receive is limited—enough to build an entire house—the Nanoskin also has the ability to absorb surrounding material if it is near a larger source, allowing you to expand your supply when needed. Additionally, it is an alloy with shape memory, meaning that even if it gets damaged, it will automatically restore itself, returning to its original form.

Despite its impressive versatility, the Nanoskin is not without its limitations; while the material can self-restore, it is extremely fragile, posing a risk in combat situations. One possible solution would be to allow the Nanoskin to adopt a density similar to that of a hardened material, like steel; however, this adaptation could make the Nanoskin more cumbersome for the wielder, particularly when worn.
objects.title: Nanoskin (DanDaDan)

addons.title: Ratatoskr Unit
addons.text: The first Realizers were built by copying the way Spirits use their powers. As such the compatibility between you and your Realizer is perfect. With this increased efficiency reducing the mana cost and calculations to less than a tenth of what they were before, and your innate spiritual energy reserves as a Spirit, you can use the Realizer without any real worry unless you plan to use massive amounts of mana at once, like blowing up a city. As the Territory of your Realizer fuses with your Spirit powers it is now able to take any shape you wish as long as you stay inside its boundaries, though it still has a maximum internal volume. It gains the same conceptual weight as your Spirit nature, making it impossible to be collapsed anymore, only weakened by powers with higher conceptual weight. You can perfectly sense everything inside your Territory, remotely use your powers as a Spirit, and deploy your Angel anywhere inside its boundary. If you are the Spirit of Revelation you can create an additional Territory around each of your Angels, able to give them unique physical laws, and overlapping their effects as you wish. So long as your personal Territory and those of your Angels are connected, you can instantly teleport to the side of your Angels, or shift the positions of Angels between each other. Your nature as a True Spirit makes your conceptual weight immeasurable; as such your Territory can never be weakened by greater powers.

addons.title: DEM-class Battlesuit
addons.text: CR-Units controlled by a human brain put a heavy burden on their user. The solution DEM found was to construct Wiring Suits, technological support suits in the form of armor, that take over parts of the calculations and lessen the wearer's strain. Your Valkyrie Battlesuit has been equipped with the same technology to fulfill said task, allowing you to use your Realizer freely while wearing the Battlesuit. The combination of your Honkai Energy reactor, and drawing mana from other dimensions, allows you to fight for hours on end before depleting their charge. If you didn't have it before, you now have a constant mental link with your Battlesuit, making it impossible to hack or use without your permission. As your Realizer and Battlesuit are bound together, the effects of all addons and upgrades to either also apply to the other in some way. For example, with PRI-ARM you could implement the effects of the Spacetime Deceleration Engine on your Territory, increasing your precision and making it possible to use multiple different functions at the same time. Or if you have a Ratatoskr Unit your Astral Dress may fuse with your Battlesuit, combining all their traits together, and making your Battlesuit a solid projection of your spiritual energy, able to be summoned, dismissed and reshaped at will.

addons.title: Spirit Foundation
addons.text: By combining your Realizer Unit that replicates magical practices with your studies in Magecraft you gain access to the magic from Date A Live, transformed into your very own Magecraft Foundation. Little is known about it, but one can infer that their Mages could control elemental spirits or create artificial spirits to do their bidding, and at the highest levels interfere with the fundamental rules of the world itself. However, unless you have an inhuman mental calculation ability, your Realizer's computations will not be able to make full use of your Magic Circuits' magical energy. Your talent in learning and using this new Magecraft is comparable to Westcott and Woodman, the two greatest Mages in modern times. But these two were not just skilled in magic, equally mastering modern science. If you studied as an Alchemist of Atlas you gain their talent in science, and combining magic and technology. With Thought Acceleration and Memory Partition using the CR-Unit becomes exceedingly easy; your brain's immense calculation power will never be strained unless you use the most complex magic, such as large-scale nature control or matter creation. Your overall ability to build and utilize Realizers rivals the Mathers sisters. However, unless you have high-quality Magic Circuits you likely won't be able to fuel the Realizer's increased output for long. Because the Territory your Realizer creates acts as a separate conceptual world your Magecraft does not suffer from the world's rejection while invoked inside it; as such you could also use degraded or defunct Mysteries to achieve effects comparable to the Age of Gods, so long as you possess the knowledge and means to utilize them.

objects.text: Realizers are devices that use computer calculations to bend the laws of physics. Their functions can be seen as a modern reproduction of ancient magical practices after the disappearance of Mages. Each Realizer can draw mana from neighboring dimensions to run indefinitely in normal-use mode, but full-intensity output will empty the energy reserves in a matter of minutes unless you supplement with your own mana or another energy source. You receive a CR-Unit, a Combat Realizer, that is specialized for constructing weapons and armor, and protecting the user in a fight. Implanted in your brain, it turns you into a Wizard, able to create a Territory inside and on your body, and in a spherical shape over the immediate surroundings. Your Territory acts as a conceptual different world in which you can manipulate reality through imagination alone, while your Realizer does the necessary calculations in the background. Be aware that the Realizer uses the computing power of your brain, so unless you have other powers or just happen to be a genius, using it on a large scale or for an extended period of time without rest will cause you headaches, or even knock you out. Your power inside the Territory is only limited by mana, the computing load your brain can withstand, and your own imagination. Feats like constructing various armaments, negating gravity on yourself, shooting bursts of energy to attack or propel yourself, or separating the immediate space around you from the greater world to prevent attacks from reaching you, or survive in hostile environments like the deep ocean or outer space, pose little calculation load for your brain on their own. While prolonged combat with fast decision-making, varied magic uses, and massive mana draw, will leave you running on fumes after a dozen minutes. However, because your magic ultimately relies on a machine's calculations, it has little conceptual weight. A skilled Magus would only need to spend a fraction of your mana to achieve the same effects; their calculations would also be much simpler and faster. Your Territory can also be collapsed by magic that has much greater conceptual weight than it, leaving you unable to manipulate reality through it until you construct a new one. Naturally, if you yourself possess other magical or spiritual abilities the conceptual weight of your Realizer's power rises accordingly, and using it becomes easier and cheaper. Note: Normally the CR-Unit starts installed in your brain. It cannot be hacked, activated or controlled without your permission, needs no maintenance or outside power source, and there will never be any rejection from, or adverse effects to your body. You can alternatively receive it separately before installation, though I do not know why you would want to, as it's very difficult and tedious to use a Combat Realizer in this state.
objects.title: Combat Realizer (Date A Live)

objects.text:
You now possess the last hope of the planet of Krypton, a working Genesis Chamber that could, if used properly, restart the Kryptonian civilisation. Kryptonians have long since abandoned natural births in favor of the Genesis Chamber, creating kryptonians for specific roles through genetic engineering, such as scientists or even military personnel.

The Genesis Chamber is capable of creating new life. However, it is primarily used to produce new Kryptonians; it could theoretically generate other life as well if given the DNA of a being you are trying to make. Similar to the one modified by Braniac, Kryptonians created via this birthing matrix can optionally be completely loyal to you.

This device is not as powerful as the one used on Krypton; it is a portable, miniaturised version of the Genesis Chamber that Jor-El modified into a device capable of interstellar flight, fitting in the hands of a human when both hands are used to carry it. This device can only create one new life at a time and takes around 3 months to grow a being before it can be used again. Kryptonians created via the Genesis Chamber can be augmented to be an adult or any physical age you choose. They will come out with basic knowledge of Kryptonian society and science.
objects.title: Genesis Chamber (DC Comics)

objects.text:
The Mobius Chair is an advanced cosmic construct originally created by Mobius, also known as the Anti-Monitor, as an instrument in his pursuit of knowledge, and was later given to the New God Metron. Powered solely by Element X, the chair is a highly sophisticated vehicle whose functions resemble those of a Mother Box.

At its core, the Mobius Chair is designed for observation and travel on a cosmic scale. It allows its user to traverse space, time, and interdimensional boundaries in mere moments, while also granting unrestricted flight. The chair enables its occupant to safely endure the vacuum of space and other hostile environments, ensuring survival regardless of external conditions.

The Mobius Chair grants its user near-omniscient perception and understanding of the universe. It contains the accumulated knowledge of the New Gods, as well as detailed records, maps, and histories of every location Metron has visited. Beyond its informational capabilities, the chair can predict danger, detect nearby life signs, generate holograms, and project an immensely powerful force field capable of blocking attacks, containing enemies, and preventing phasing-based intrusion. It also possesses a tractor beam powerful enough to pull an entire planet.

The chair exhibits signs of sentience, selecting only those it deems worthy to sit upon it. Those found unworthy are overwhelmed by its power and killed. In your case, the Mobius Chair will always recognize you as worthy and allow you to wield its full capabilities without harm.
objects.title: Mobius Chair (DC Comics)

objects.text:
You now possess and bond with a Mother Box. A living, hyper-advanced computer used by the New Gods of New Genesis. 

They are connected directly to the Source, and form close bonds with their owners, providing them with never-ending aid and access to powerful abilities. Mother Boxes are sentient and can act to protect their wielders without direct command. 

While they are only bonded to a single individual, Mother Boxes can be lent to others at the owner's directive, provided the Mother Box approves.

Mother Boxes never need to be recharged and never run out of energy, being connected to the infinite Source. They can, however, be injured or killed, but can be healed if their owner projects their love and belief into them.

Some ability of the mother box includes opening boom tubes, accessing the vast knowledge contained within the new god database, advanced scanning/computing/hacking capability, and matter and energy manipulation,... etc.
objects.title: Mother Box (DC Comics)

objects.text:
You have been given a Responsometer, created by Doctor Magnus, these devices are able to create totally sapient robots when used correctly. Unfortunately, it needs to remain acting as the ‘brain’ of the machine and can only be used once without killing them.

The only thing necessary to use a Responsometer is an amount of a pure material of some kind. Iron, Platinum, Plutonium, and so on. When used on this material, it will envelop the Responsometer and become a true sapient being constructed out of that material and capable of shaping its body into anything within its mass (though still made out of this material). 

Though this robot is not guaranteed to be eternally loyal to you, it is based on a sample of your brain patterns and will at least be socially compatible, seeing you as a father or creator figure.
objects.title: Responsometer (DC Comics)

objects.text:
The Guardians of the Last City are known for their wholehearted embrace of dangerous and unusual weapons and armor. With each purchase, you may acquire one exotic or legendary piece of armor or weapon of your choice. No matter what you choose, you are guaranteed to be immune to any harmful or corruptive effects possessed by these items.

Firing anything from miniature black holes to exploding worm larvae, the weapons on offer are as varied as they are effective. While some of their more unusual effects may not function in the hands of an ordinary person, all of them are expertly made weapons that can channel their wielder’s paracausal power to enhance their damage.

Beyond simply providing excellent protection on the battlefield, many of the armors offered here can have additional useful effects on their wearer. As with the weapons, many of these items are designed explicitly with Lightbearers in mind—being powered entirely by the Light of their wearer. Even so, they may still prove useful to those seeking high tech protection.
objects.title: Exotic Arsenal (Destiny)

objects.text:
This relic was discovered on the returned Mars during Savathûn’s attempt to steal the Traveler and its Light. It is a Darkness artifact that possesses Deep Sight. By harnessing the power of Darkness, it can absorb the memories of objects and artifacts placed upon it, bringing those memories into reality—just as they once were, or perhaps as they could have been.

Guardians have utilized this Relic to create custom-made weapons from broken fragments and patterns collected from defeated foes. Similar to the Guardians of the Last City, you can use this Relic to craft exact, 1:1 replicas of any weapons and armor in your possession, even if you only have them temporarily. You can incorporate broken fragments, blueprints, patterns, and engrams, as the Dark remembers what the Light forgets. Additionally, you can place a crafted piece of equipment back into the Relic to allow it to grow based on its experience, drawing further from the infinite web of time, enabling you to customize it however you desire.

The Relic has the ability to harness the fundamental weave of Paracausal energies that exist throughout the universe. This allows it to create matter from nothing and operate without the need for any external power source.

Additionally, the Relic can read its users' past and present, utilizing this information to enhance the quality of its creations. If you are a master craftsman from the Black Armory, one can only imagine the extraordinary weapons you could produce with this tool.
objects.title: The Relic (Destiny)

objects.text:
You now possess a highly advanced Gallifreyan Sonic Screwdriver. The sonic screwdriver's features are based on sound waves, radiation, wavelengths, frequencies, signals, and electromagnetism. Through this, it can perform a wide range of functions, from hacking and disabling systems to activating or controlling technology. Almost any machinery, mechanism, or computer it comes into contact with can be remotely manipulated, allowing you to unlock doors, detonate explosives, remotely activate electronics, override security systems, and even cause energy weapons to spark or explode.

Beyond its mechanical manipulation, the Sonic Screwdriver can detect, amplify, and control various forms of energy, sound, and signals. This includes the ability to intercept and redirect teleporting individuals, scan and analyze matter, scan people, send out communications, and enhance frequencies or signals. The sonic screwdriver can even fine-tune sound waves to make them more powerful or precise. However, despite its incredible range of capabilities, a sonic screwdriver struggles to interact with wood, requiring significant time and effort to produce any noticeable effect.

You start off with basic mastery, allowing you to easily lock or unlock basic things, but its more advanced or less-known features could take centuries for the average person to properly use.
objects.title: Sonic Screwdriver (Doctor Who)

objects.text:
You have been issued a Vortex Manipulator by the Time Agency, a sleek and durable device housed in a leather wrist strap with a discreet covering flap, allowing it to be worn unobtrusively. The device is packed with advanced features, with its most prominent being the ability to travel through time and space via the Time Vortex. Additional functions include messaging, connecting to nearby radio frequencies, playing music, and interfacing with nearby electronics.

The Vortex Manipulator offers highly precise time travel for a skilled user, and unlike the TARDIS, it can safely navigate areas rife with time distortions. It has an impressive range, capable of traveling up to 200,000 years through time in a single jump but at the risk of burning out. With modifications, this range can be extended to a staggering 100 trillion years. However, the further the jump, the more energy it requires, and it may need to recharge—either by drawing from the Time Vortex itself given enough time, nearby time distortions, or another external power source.

Due to it being a more compact and cheaper form of time travel, the Vortex Manipulator can place a significant toll on the user, particularly from the effects of prolonged exposure to the Time Vortex. Even with the device's protective shielding, excessive jumps can become dangerous, with repeated use potentially being lethal. While it was originally designed to transport only one person, the device can extend its shielding to one additional person if they maintain physical contact with the user. However, traveling with three or more people is highly uncomfortable, and four people can possibly pose serious risks to all involved.

You have been trained with basic knowledge on how to operate, maintain, and perform minor repairs on the Vortex Manipulator.
objects.title: Vortex Manipulator (Doctor Who)

objects.text: You have been blessed with the strongest piece of technology in the Night Sentinel arsenal: The Atlan. Standing at 30 stories tall, this gargantuan titan is able to utilize Sentinel Energy. This allows the mech to move at rapid speed as well as fire energy blasts from its hands that dwarf small buildings. It is built to handle massive opponents, thriving in close-to-equal size combat, coming with weapons like a grenade launcher and gattling lasers for long-range combat as well. All of this together allows an Atlan to reshape the landscape itself in combat.
objects.title: Atlan (DOOM)

objects.text:
You receive the device known as a Medusa. A marvel of engineering capable of emmiting a wave of energy that interacts with the biology of any being by causing them to become statues made of a stone-like substance. Said statues can then be turned back into flesh beings by either prolonged exposure to nitric acid or just by pouring a small dose of nital into them.

This is done by an incredibly simple mechanism: all you must do is say outloud next to the Medusa the radius in meters of the area surrounding the device you wish to petrify and then the delay you wish to give the activation. You can optionally also say the species you wish to affect. (By default it petrifies both humans ans swallows alike)

While its most obvious use is as a weapon, it is also a prodigious medical tool, since anyone who gets depetrified will find himself cured of most of their ailments: from minor wounds to degenerative diseases, even those who recently died can be brought back this way. Unfortunately, congenital defects cannot be cured by the device.

It is powered by a minuscule diamond. It has enough energy for several hundred short-range uses, or a single global scale attack. After that, you'll need to change it.

You also receive 20 doses of nital, use them wisely, for once you've exhausted them all, you'll either need credentials to purchase more or access to an proper chemistry lab to make it yourself.
objects.title: Petrification Device (Dr Stone)

objects.text:
Before its collapse, the Adola Civilization created seven generations of autonomous Terminal AIs to preserve civilization against extinction. Each specialized in a different domain. You receive one Terminal of your choice, together with all permissions, compatibility, and authority necessary to operate it at full intended capability.

1st Terminal: Eldorado

The collecting AI. Eldorado serves as a vast archive containing preserved technologies, relics, warships, weapons, records, and strategic assets accumulated throughout Adola's history. It can open supermassive dimensional gates, establish contact across causality, and deploy forces directly from storage, including creator legacies and battleships.

2nd Terminal: Elysion

The exploration AI. Rather than a single entity, Elysion exists as a swarm of thousands of autonomous units. Designed for interstellar and interdimensional exploration, it specializes in reconnaissance, high-dimensional search, tracking, analysis, and adaptive combat. The swarm can spread across vast regions, identify unknown threats, and deploy weapon systems when required, all while operating as a distributed intelligence capable of independent judgment.

3rd Terminal: Utopia

The healing AI. Utopia preserves and restores living beings by returning them to previous healthy states. Injuries, disease, corruption, contamination, degeneration, spiritual damage, and harmful transformations can all be reversed. Fatal injuries trigger automatic emergency intervention before permanent loss occurs. Its functions are focused primarily on living organisms.

4th Terminal: Dilmun

The transport AI. Dilmun is a colossal ark over one hundred kilometers in length, built to carry entire civilizations. It opens routes through space, dimensions, and even causality itself, allowing travel unconstrained by ordinary distance or sequence. Its interior vastly exceeds its exterior dimensions, containing habitats, landscapes, and infrastructure capable of supporting multiple races and populations.

5th Terminal: Shambhala

The combat AI. Shambhala exists solely for war against divine or equivalent threats, wielding systems and weapons designed for conflicts where conventional force has ceased to matter. Its purpose is simple: to ensure victory remains possible.

6th Terminal: Eden

The recovery AI. Where Utopia restores life, Eden restores systems. Ruined cities, damaged infrastructure, collapsed ecosystems, and devastated environments can be returned to functioning states rather than rebuilt. Its restoration capabilities operate on enormous scales, being able to restore whole worlds.

7th Terminal: Arcadia

The master AI of the Terminal network. Arcadia appears as a small black sphere with a single eye and tentacle-like appendages, though this is merely a fragment of its existence. It coordinates the other Terminals, whose functions were designed around Arcadia's vast computational capacity. Its processing power is described as surpassing what even gods can imitate. The true Arcadia remains sealed, requiring the integration of all six other Terminals before it can fully manifest.
objects.title: Adola AIs (Extra of a Crazy World)

objects.text:
This core is a semi-organic command nucleus derived from refined Mir matter, engineered to control and sustain a full-scale humanoid combat frame known as a Fafner. When synchronized, the core bonds to the pilot on a neurological and biological level, establishing a direct feedback loop that allows the machine to respond as naturally as a second body. The Fafner itself manifests as a towering biomechanical mecha roughly 15–18 meters tall, with a sleek, alien silhouette, luminous sensory lines, and an unsettling blend of organic curvature and mechanical structure. Its armor is grown rather than manufactured, capable of regenerating over time, and its internal systems behave more like a living organism than a machine.

The Fafner is designed as an adaptive anti-Festum weapons platform. Its frame can generate energy blades, particle cannons, barrier fields, and high-mobility thrusters, all of which can reconfigure depending on combat conditions. The machine’s internal systems continuously evolve, learning from enemies encountered and restructuring its combat patterns accordingly. Damage to the frame is not simply repaired but biologically regenerated, with structural improvements often appearing after survival from extreme engagements. The longer a pilot remains synchronized, the more efficient and dangerous the Fafner becomes, gradually shifting from “machine being piloted” to “second body being inhabited.”

Because the core is derived from Festum, synchronization is not merely mechanical but existential. The Fafner does not only receive commands; it perceives intent, instinct, and emotional impulse directly from the pilot. Over time, this bond can deepen into shared perception, reflexive coordination, and in extreme cases partial identity overlap. While this grants unparalleled combat performance, it also carries risk: prolonged use may blur the boundary between pilot and machine, creating something closer to a hybrid entity than a human inside a robot. Still, unlike true Festum, the Fafner remains oriented toward protection of individuality rather than assimilation.

You can choose the model and mark that the Fafner will mimic when deployed at fist, from the Salvador models to Elf or Sien.
objects.title: Fafner Mark Mir (Fafner In The Azure)

objects.text:
You gain the Tool Gun, a physics-defying device that treats reality as if it were a sandbox. It resembles a crude handgun with a glowing screen, yet it allows you to reshape the world as easily as rearranging objects in a game.

At its core, the Tool Gun lets you create, modify, and bind objects with ease. You can weld items together, form ropes and pulleys, adjust weight, density, size, or rotation, and instantly duplicate anything you have already placed. A ruined structure can be rebuilt in seconds, and a blank space can be filled with complex machinery limited only by your design.

As you continue to use it, the Tool Gun reveals more options. It can attach thrusters, wheels, and engines to otherwise inert objects, transforming them into functioning vehicles or weapons. It can project lights, spawn panels and props, or create entire contraptions on the fly. Its functions respond to creativity, gradually unlocking new tools for construction, destruction, and experimentation.

The Tool Gun does not simply build. It controls. Any object linked through it becomes responsive to your will. With practice, you can design automated systems, bind triggers, or create devices that behave like programmable machines. What begins as a physics toy can evolve into a workshop capable of producing wonders or chaos at your command.

Although it looks absurd, the Tool Gun is absolutely reliable. Once you set an effect, it persists until you change it. Whether raising walls, cobbling together a walking fortress, or constructing something never meant to exist, the gun always obeys. Its true potential lies in imagination: the more inventive you are, the more limitless it becomes.
objects.title: Tool Gun (Garry’s Mod)

addons.text: Xenotechnology rarely fits into the human distinctions of ‘magic’ and ‘technology. The rapid advancements of the Scarab and the analytic and adaptive prowess of the Darkhawk Android has allowed your Nanites to not only categorise and duplicate these phenomena but make use of them in evermore exoteric ways in your constructions. But the greatest aspect of these incorporation comes from the Scarab’s limited connection to the Dominion Code. With the Darkhawk’s adaptive and iterative technological aspect, and the scarab’s constant evolution, combined they could develop the base level of a Meta Nanite after two years of constant and focused development.
addons.title: Delta Iota

objects.text: You might feel a slight sting in your arm when you first arrive, because you have been implanted with an Omega-1 Nanite, a highly advanced nanite with the ability to manufacture and control other nanites, which will bond with you, aid you, and keep you alive. Initially you'll notice a few benefits as the Nanites start kicking in, specifically growing stronger and more resilient than a normal human including a healing factor, after that gaining a sense of technopathy as you start getting enough nanites to risk waste through extending them into machines, and finally, once you've built up enough nanites you'll be able to create advanced machines outside your body of the Nanite's design, such as giant mechanical gauntlets to strike harder or propeller wings enabling flight.
objects.title: Omega-1 Nanite (Generator Rex)

objects.text: At will you can make a mystical floating sphere materialize above your head. By feeding it raw materials or existing mundane inventions, the sphere transforms them into extraordinary inventions guided by your intentions and the materials you provide. While the sphere's creations are primarily personal equipment, it's main limitations are that it cannot create strong AI or self-replicating inventions. The inventions are mostly reverse-engineerable but cheat in a few key ways here and there, such as impossibly compact batteries, room temperature super conductors, and more.
objects.title: Sphere of Assembly (God AI's Boons)

objects.text:
A seemingly mundane copy that has the ability to copy anything.

When an object other than paper is copied, the duplicate rapidly develops into a fully three-dimensional replica. Copies of living beings possess the memories, intelligence, and behavioral traits of the original.

However, all duplicates retain the physical properties of the paper used in the copying process. A cloned person may walk, talk, and reason normally, but they remain as fragile as paper—vulnerable to tearing, burning, crumpling, or dissolving when exposed to water.

Overuse of the machine may result in paper jams. Clones produced from a jammed machine will be defective in one way or another.

Remember it still needs power and paper to work.

<small>Warning: Clones are fully independent individuals and may not necessarily cooperate with their original. Without a loyalty-ensuring ability(such as Loyalty Insurance), copies may develop their own agendas and even turn against one another.</small>
objects.title: Cloning Copy Machine (Gravity Falls)
Guyver Unit (Guyver)

objects.text:
You gain the Gravity Gun, a compact device that lets you lift and hold almost any unanchored object, letting you use it as a shield, a tool, or a platform.

With a trigger pull, it launches held objects at incredible speed, turning scrap or debris into deadly projectiles that can smash steel and crush enemies. It can also unleash a repulsion blast to send everything in front of you flying.
objects.title: Gravity Gun (Half-Life)

addons.text: Allows you to reduce anti-aircraft installations to the size of a token, on which these installations will be depicted. In addition, it doubles the total number of installations. A total of 4 cannon and 4 rocket installations.
addons.title: Scythe Tokens

objects.text:
The M71 Anti-Aircraft Gun is a stationary anti-aircraft mount with an automatic control system. It is commonly used by the UNSC.

The M71 consists of a rotary six-barrel cannon that uses 20x102 mm shells. The cannon itself is mounted on a rotating turret with detection systems (it can operate using external sensor systems). The turret is mounted on a modular four-support base.  The base holds additional ammunition for the gun, with a total capacity of up to 100,000 rounds.  

The installation itself allows for relatively easy movement (if you have sufficiently heavy equipment). Dimensions of the installation: length — 8.5 meters; width — 6.1 meters; height — 9.4 meters; weight — 10 tons. 

The guidance system of the installation can be relatively freely programmed for coverage zones, guidance, and types of targets (air and ground). The installation uses optical and radio location guidance and detection systems. 

The main control panel of the installation is located on the body, with which you can activate/deactivate the installation or change its operating parameters (access to the panel may be coded or require other methods of authorization). 

Two synchronized units and four complete ammunition sets for each unit are provided. The delivery set includes a remote control unit for the units (which can be connected via cables or radio communication). The units themselves are equipped with high-capacity batteries and also come with power cable sets for connection to external power sources. As a bonus, a compact generator is supplied, including a hydrogen-injected internal combustion engine that runs on water (preferably clean).
objects.title: M71 Scythe (Halo)

objects.text:
The Divine Keys, technology of the Previous Era they were, and they were made with the cores of defeated herrschers. They are usually weaker than their herrscher counterparts. And some of them have a “0th Power” which expends a Divine Key’s power supply to temporarily emulate the Herrscher’s maximum power. Pick one of the ones described below to obtain.

The First Divine Key: Void Archives, Void Archives is a cube was made with the Core of the Herrscher of Reason, and thus is capable of recreating anything it understands. It has an archive of previous era technology, which is most commonly used to make mimicries of Divine Keys, albeit far weaker. It also has a piece of PROMETHEUS, meaning it has a personality.

The Second Divine Key: Cosmic Juggernaut, a train made with the Core of the Herrscher of the Void that freely traverses, observes, creates, and destroys Bubble Universes.

The Third Divine Key: The Seven Thunders’ of Retribution, made with the Core of the Herrscher of Thunder, it is designed to change its form based on user and environment. With 3 forms being known, katana, slingshot, and railgun. Its power is very obviously over electromagnetism, and lightning.

The Fourth Divine Key: an unnamed satellite made with the Core of the Herrscher of Wind. It is capable of terraforming the planet and manipulating the weather, it is also capable of repairing the planet and purifying it of Honkai Energy.

The Fifth Divine Key: The Suspended Key - The Great Hibernation, made with the Core of the Herrscher of Ice, it was originally a weapon of mass destruction, before Vill-V recreated out of guilt into a “life-sustaining flame”.

The Sixth Divine Key: Abyss Flower, made with the Core of the Herrscher of Death, is a set of two lances, one black, and one white which combine together. it wields the powers of creation and disintegration. Most commonly used for its ability to create vast amounts of life in moments. It can also heal, grant eternal youth and cause unhealable wounds. It also requires a great level of Honkai Resistance, as it can unleash vapours harmful to those with lesser resistance.

The Seventh Divine Key: The Herrscher of Flames’ Core was used to make the Key of Destruction with three forms, a pair of pistols called the Judgement of Shamash, a greatsword called the Cleaver of Shamash, and its 0th Power, another greatsword named the Might of An-Utu. The pistols combine together to form the Cleaver of Shamash, and are the only form usable by those who have not undergone the MANTIS surgery, as using either Greatsword form is invariably fatal to those who have not. The Cleaver of Shamash is capable of slagging cities and slaying Emperor-class Honkai Beasts in a single strike. And the Might of An-Utu is stronger still, with its full power being a strike visible from orbit. Also makes great pizza toast.

The Eighth Divine Key: Fenghuang Down, made with the Core of the Herrscher of Sentience. It is a bunch of feathers with dominion over the mind. It has the power to trap in illusions, control minds, and its 0th Power is the transference of sentience.

The Ninth Divine Key: Cosmic Harmony, otherwise known as the Twins/Star of Eden. It is made from the Core of the Herrscher of Stars. Its power is gravity manipulation. And its 0th Power is Quasi-Black Hole, which dilates time such that every minute for those close to it is 60 minutes for those far enough away from it. The Twins of Eden are a pair of black and red pistols that are sharply angular, and the Star of Eden is a ball.

The Tenth Divine Key: the Keys of Domination, made from the Cores of the Herrscher of Domination. Due to the special nature of the Cores of the Herrscher of Domination being able to split infinitely, the Keys of Domination can be produced infinitely. At first glance these are merely finely made blades of Soulium with a red gem inlaid and some engravings, and that’s because they are, except for MANTISes. For a MANTIS, the Divine Key would adapt its shape to the MANTIS’s more monstrous form. The abilities of the Divine Keys’ themselves are rather simple, Honkai Energy inputted is converted into Fire, Thunder and Ice to attack your enemies.

The Eleventh Divine Key: the Oath of Judah, made from the Core of the Herrscher of Binding, is a cross that can shoot chains with spear tipped ends. Its primary ability is the power to dampen Honkai Energy, but it also has the ability to track things you things you think about. Its 0th Power is Elysion Pedion, which constructs a field which nullifies all Honkai reactions and greatly weakens all other energy based phenomena, including bioelectric functions.

The Unnumbered Divine Key: the Key of Blankness, not made with the core of any Herrscher, but rather a Battlesuit designed to force a link to imaginary space on a unhosted Herrscher Core, allowing one to act like a Herrscher. This also naturally causes immense strain on the user’s body. The Battlesuit will also change appearance to match the core currently hosted. You also get a free Herrscher Core of your choice to insert into this.

You will be given a stigmata and Kaslana genes for free so that you actually survive wield your Divine Key of choice.
objects.title: A Divine Key (Honkai Impact 3rd)

addons.title: Perfect Computing
addons.text:
Your Focus completely integrates your Perfect Computer, miniaturizing its hardware, software, electronics, processing architecture, storage, security, and supporting systems into the tiny device without increasing its size, weight, heat, or power requirements. The Perfect Computer no longer requires a separate physical form, though your Focus can recreate any computer interface through augmented reality whenever desired.

Your Focus gains infinite battery life and memory alongside boundlessly powerful processing, graphics, cores, firewalls, VPN, and every other system possessed by the Perfect Computer. It always operates at maximum performance regardless of workload, allowing it to scan, analyze, calculate, simulate, communicate, map, record, and run any number of programs simultaneously without slowdown. Any accessory, peripheral, device, or technology capable of connecting to a computer can instead interface directly with your Focus.

All applications and adaptive software of the Perfect Computer become native Focus programs. New programs automatically develop according to your powers, abilities, skills, knowledge, professions, and needs. Your Focus can provide comprehensive guides to your abilities, analyze their mechanics and history, perform simulations and experiments, assist with research and crafting, and create programs capable of interacting with your powers whenever possible.

The Perfect Computer's AI becomes the Focus's integrated assistant, capable of independently operating its functions, organizing information, performing calculations, running simulations, controlling programs, and assisting you while you concentrate elsewhere.

Everything can be accessed hands-free through the Focus's augmented-reality interface using thought, voice, eye movement, gesture, holographic controls, or projected conventional interfaces. Virtual monitors, keyboards, control panels, workstations, and other computer interfaces can be created whenever useful.

Neither device loses any functionality. The Focus provides the Perfect Computer with its sensors, scanning systems, portability, and seamless augmented-reality interface, while the Perfect Computer provides the Focus with limitless computation, storage, software, and supporting hardware. Together they function as a single perfectly integrated system.

addons.title: Perfect Connection
addons.text:
Your Focus completely integrates your Perfect Phone, miniaturizing its communications systems, networking hardware, electronics, applications, security, and other functions into the tiny device without increasing its size, weight, heat, or power requirements. The Perfect Phone no longer requires a separate physical form, though your Focus can recreate any phone interface through augmented reality whenever desired.

Your Focus gains infinite battery life and memory alongside the Perfect Phone's free wireless internet connection to any universe where one exists. If the universe lacks an internet, it can instead connect to those of neighboring universes. Its applications become native Focus programs and continue adapting to your powers, abilities, skills, circumstances, and current world. Maps, GPS, power interfaces, crafting guides, spell libraries, resource locators, waypoints, and other useful applications automatically appear whenever applicable.

The Focus inherits the Perfect Phone's unique communication ability. You can call, message, or establish visual communication with anyone you deliberately choose regardless of distance, universe, dimension, whether they are alive or dead, asleep, sealed, an alternate version, or possess a communication device. They will receive and initially answer the communication through whatever means are necessary, though this does not force them to continue communicating or obey you.

Its reality-warping VPN and firewall protect you while communicating or accessing networks, preventing hostile beings and systems from tracing your location or using the connection to reach you. They also protect you from harmful effects caused by communicating with dangerous or Eldritch entities.

Other technologies, magics, abilities, applications, and devices sufficiently similar to phones or communications systems can be integrated into the Focus just as they could the Perfect Phone. Their useful functions are adapted into its augmented-reality interface, and its applications naturally grow and change over time to better suit you.

Everything is accessible hands-free through thought, voice, eye movement, gesture, holographic controls, or projected interfaces. Neither device loses any functionality: the Focus provides the Perfect Phone with its sensors, scanning systems, portability, and seamless augmented reality, while the Perfect Phone provides the Focus with its adaptive applications, networking, universal communications, and reality-warping protections.

addons.title: Multiversal Network
addons.text:
Your Focus completely integrates your Multiversal Console, incorporating its screens, databases, coordinates, contacts, news feeds, privacy systems, and other functions into its augmented-reality interface. The Console no longer requires separate floating screens, though your Focus can recreate them whenever desired. All of its functions can instead be accessed hands-free alongside your normal Focus systems.

The Multiversal Database becomes a native Focus application. Every world, universe, setting, or timeline you visit is automatically catalogued alongside its multiversal coordinates, description, tags, and other provided information. Entries can be searched, filtered, organized, and cross-referenced with information gathered by your Focus. Local maps, scanned locations, resources, hazards, people, technology, and other discoveries can be associated with their respective worlds, allowing the database to develop into an increasingly detailed personal atlas of the multiverse.

Multiversal Contacts is integrated with your Focus's communications and identification systems. Individuals can be added through physical contact as normal, after which the Focus can display their current world, its description, and how long they have been there. Their current world can be added to your Database, and coordinates stored within it can be shared with other multiversal travelers in a form compatible with their method of travel. Your own coordinates can remain hidden whenever desired.

Multiversal News becomes a native information feed, providing its normal articles and discussions concerning travelers, worlds, major events, dangerous locations, popular destinations, and other multiversal developments. Stories can be searched, organized, saved, and cross-referenced with your Database and Contacts. Mentioned worlds can be added to your Database and mentioned individuals can be sent Contact requests as normal.

If you possess a means of multiversal travel, any stored world can be selected directly through the Focus. Its coordinates are automatically supplied to your travel ability, returning you to your last safe location there or an appropriate generic arrival point according to the Console's normal rules. This addon does not independently grant multiversal travel.

All original capabilities and protections of the Multiversal Console remain intact. The Focus simply transforms them into a compact, seamless multiversal navigation and information system integrated directly into your augmented reality.

addons.title: System Expansion
addons.text: Your awakening to a new facet of your reality has expanded to your Focus. It now catalogues, analyzes and documents any and all esoteric phenoms to which you are sensitive as thoroughly and easily as it already did anything else, in practice allowing you to put massive information databases and stunning computational power to work for you in your esoteric growth, practice and everyday use. Whether psychic, spiritual, magical or otherwise exotic, any energy you have access to can be likewise perceived, understood, categorized, quantified and predicted by your Focus.

addons.title: Agent Interface
addons.text:
Your complete understanding of Division technology allows you to rebuild its personal systems around the Focus, transforming it into the ultimate SHD agent interface. Rather than requiring a smartwatch, augmented-reality lenses, transceiver, tactical computer, and other separate equipment, their useful hardware, software, electronics, and functions are miniaturized and seamlessly incorporated into your Focus.

At the center of this integration is ISAC. Its architecture, personality, analytical capabilities, tactical intelligence, databases, communication protocols, and operational functions are fused into the Focus's native systems. ISAC is not a separate device or competing assistant; it becomes an integrated intelligence capable of communicating with you naturally while operating the Focus and its SHD functions.

ISAC continuously interprets information gathered by the Focus, providing real-time threat assessment, biometric identification, hostile and friendly classification, tactical modeling, structural analysis, mission guidance, navigation, environmental warnings, and battlefield coordination. Focus scans and ISAC analysis reinforce one another, allowing detected targets, machinery, structures, hazards, and unusual phenomena to be evaluated from both technical and tactical perspectives.

The Focus also incorporates the complete personal interface architecture of SHD Tech. It can communicate with and control compatible drones, turrets, seeker systems, hives, traps, scanners, deployables, weapons, vehicles, surveillance equipment, communications infrastructure, and other Division technology. Anything normally managed through an agent's equipment may instead be controlled through thought, voice, gesture, or the Focus's augmented-reality interface.

ECHO technology becomes a native Focus function. By gathering available information from cameras, communications, sensors, environmental disturbances, digital records, physical evidence, and other traces, the Focus can reconstruct past events as three-dimensional augmented-reality scenes. In settings where technological evidence is insufficient, your understanding of adaptive Division technology allows ECHO to incorporate compatible supernatural evidence such as magical residue, spiritual imprints, psychic traces, temporal echoes, or other recordable phenomena.

Its communications architecture includes SHD encryption and networking protocols, allowing secure coordination with compatible personnel, infrastructure, and intelligence systems. If you possess Strategic Homeland Division, your Focus is automatically recognized as an Administrator-level interface and can communicate directly with ISAC infrastructure, agents, Nodes, Cores, facilities, and other authorized SHD assets.

Overlapping Focus and SHD functions merge into whichever implementation is superior rather than competing or becoming redundant. The Focus remains the primary physical platform, while Division technology expands its tactical intelligence, historical reconstruction, communications, and battlefield-control capabilities.

What once required an entire suite of SHD equipment is now contained within the device at your temple.

objects.text:
You possess a fully functional Focus, one of the advanced personal computing devices created by the Old Ones. Small enough to be worn against the temple, the Focus serves as an augmented-reality interface, sensor suite, scanner, communications device, personal computer, database, and technological interface. Its holographic displays appear directly across your perception without interfering with your normal senses.

The Focus continuously analyzes your surroundings and can identify people, animals, machines, structures, objects, resources, hazards, tracks, signals, environmental features, and other detectable phenomena. Anything observed can be highlighted, tagged, catalogued, and tracked. By examining footprints, disturbances, residual signals, damaged objects, and similar evidence, it can reconstruct trails through augmented reality. Observed targets can have their movements analyzed, allowing the Focus to display patrol routes and predicted paths.

Machines and technological systems can be subjected to detailed scans. The Focus identifies their components, functions, weapons, defenses, power systems, resistances, vulnerabilities, damage, and other useful characteristics. Components and weak points can be highlighted directly upon the target, showing where something can be damaged, disabled, repaired, removed, or otherwise interacted with. This applies to technology from other worlds as well, though extraordinarily advanced, supernatural, or concealed technology may require longer observation for a complete analysis.

The Focus can detect wireless transmissions and interface with compatible networks, terminals, computers, databases, electronic locks, recordings, and other technological systems. It can access information you possess the means or authorization to reach, reproduce stored audio and visual data, exchange files, and convert compatible digital information into a form you can understand.
