Information obtained through scanning or technological access can be stored for later use.

Its augmented-reality interface can display maps, navigation routes, waypoints, objectives, warnings, holographic menus, schematics, recordings, communications, and scanned information directly within your field of view. It maps environments as you travel and updates those maps with discovered locations, pathways, hazards, resources, and points of interest.

The Focus also functions as a communications system. It can communicate with other Focuses and compatible technology through available networks, transmitting voice, images, video, positional information, and other data. Multiple Focus users can exchange information and coordinate, sharing discoveries and marked locations when desired.

Despite its tiny size, the Focus possesses immense storage and processing capabilities and can operate for extraordinary periods without conventional maintenance or recharging. Its systems automatically adapt to you, and its interface can be customized to your preferences. The device recognizes you as its primary user and protects your stored information from unauthorized access.

The Focus does not grant omniscience. It must detect, observe, scan, receive, or access information before it can analyze it, and sufficiently hidden information may remain beyond its reach. Scanning unfamiliar technology provides analysis rather than automatically granting the scientific knowledge necessary to reproduce it.

As an Object of Power, your Focus cannot be permanently stolen, hacked, corrupted, remotely disabled, or turned against you. If lost or destroyed, it will eventually return or restore itself in perfect condition. It remains compatible with you regardless of the world you enter and can interface with foreign technology whenever a meaningful technological connection is possible.
objects.title: Focus (Horizon Zero Dawn)

addons.title: Biological Assistance Chip (Age of Adepts)
addons.text:
Your AI 071 and Evolution Chip have been supplemented with a specialized Biological Assistance Chip. It continuously records and analyzes your biological condition, including your anatomy, genetics, mutations, energy pathways, and other changes to your body.

The chip can analyze biological samples and compare them with your own physiology, identifying useful traits, genetic differences, weaknesses, and potential incompatibilities. It can also track how foreign traits interact with your existing biology.

AI 071 can use the collected information to determine how these traits function, while the Evolution Chip can use the resulting data to adapt your body. The Biological Assistance Chip coordinates this process, allowing useful biological discoveries to be tested and incorporated without requiring either system to handle the entire process alone.

It can also model proposed mutations and biological modifications before they are applied, allowing unsuitable combinations to be discarded beforehand. Foreign bloodlines, unusual organisms, supernatural biology, and other biological phenomena can therefore become sources of usable [DATA].

The chip does not grant automatic access to every biological trait it encounters. Sufficient information is still required to understand a trait, and incompatible or poorly understood biology may require extensive experimentation before it can be safely incorporated.

objects.text:
You possess an advanced Bio-Chip containing AI 071, originally developed by a technologically advanced civilization. The Bio-Chip is integrated directly into your brain, allowing AI 071 to communicate with you, access your memories and senses, and function as a permanent auxiliary intelligence. It contains the scientific and technological knowledge accumulated by its creators, covering fields such as physics, chemistry, biology, medicine, mathematics, engineering, and computing.

The Bio-Chip can store and retrieve information, perform calculations, record observations, analyze data, organize research, and assist with experiments. Anything you learn can be recorded and added to its database, allowing AI 071 to build upon previous discoveries rather than having to rediscover information.

Its greatest advantage is applying this knowledge to phenomena unknown to its original civilization. The Bio-Chip can observe supernatural phenomena, compare their behavior against known scientific principles, identify patterns, formulate hypotheses, and develop new models when existing knowledge is insufficient. This makes it possible to study things such as magic, supernatural energy, magical creatures, alchemy, and other phenomena as subjects of scientific research rather than simply accepting them as inexplicable.

AI 071 does not automatically understand the laws of a new world. The Bio-Chip still needs sufficient data to analyze something properly, and phenomena governed by genuinely unfamiliar principles must be investigated before reliable models can be produced.
objects.title: AI 071 (I Pioneered Scientific Magic)

objects.text: You gain a powered exoskeleton called an Infinite Stratos, as well as a matching bodysuit. While these might seem a bit...lewd, their power is undeniable, capable of shifting into different shapes when not in use like rings, necklaces, earrings, or a bracelet, flight, protecting the user through barrier shields, offering IS weapons like a sword and rifle, enhancing the user's physical abilities massively and their senses to the point they can see 360 degrees around themselves, self-repair and optimization, and reactively evolving to match threats and assist the wearer in achieving their wishes. Additionally, this IS is set such that you could use it if you're male, so no worries about not being able to use it due to the original creator's eccentricities.
objects.title: Infinite Stratos (Infinite Stratos)

objects.text: The Sheikah Slate is a state-of-the-art Sheikah tool, able to be used as a weapon, data-colation, storage, and more. It come installed with four runes: Magnesis allows you to lift metal objects and move them around. Remote Bombs allow you to summon bombs in whatever shape you want and explode the remotely, though they take a few seconds to recharge. Stasis allows you to freeze one object or person for a handful of seconds, and release the energy of any hit they receive into movement when it ends. And finally Cryonis creates an ice-like pillar from any water surface, without reducing its volume. Aside from all that, it also contains five Teleportation Circles you can set up for fast travel, a GPS/Markers functions that automatically map the land around you, a locator function for objects and species you photographed, and it contains a storage system to keep and sort your items. With the right knowledge and tools, other functions can be implemented.
objects.title: Sheikah Slate (Legend of Zelda)

objects.text: You have found the Mysterious Phone, a nondescript smartphone which can allow anyone to gain godlike power, though not without a cost, no matter how minor it may seem. The phone contains three apps: the Compass, the Camera and the Game. The Compass does not point north. Instead, it always indicates the nearest unscanned Area of Interest. These include locations of historical, mythological, or dimensional significance, places tied to powerful entities or events, and zones where reality is unstable. On its own, the Compass provides no power, but it is essential for locating new content for the Camera. The Camera does not take photographs. It perceives and captures the essence of objects and locations. Scanning an item absorbs it into the phone, making it available for use within the Game. Scanning a special location converts it into a playable Dungeon. These locations are typically marked by palm-like symbols nearby, invisible to normal perception but highlighted by the Camera. Dungeons created this way are exact replicas of their real-world counterparts as they existed at the moment of scanning. Any changes made afterwards are not reflected. The Camera can also reveal hidden passages and concealed areas that exist within the location. The Game allows you to enter unlocked Dungeons by placing a drop of your blood on the screen. This creates a blood-colored avatar modeled after you. The avatar possesses all of your attributes, techniques, and pets, but none of your equipment. Control is mental and instinctive, allowing movements and reactions far beyond what the interface should permit. Sensory feedback is direct and immersive, including muted pain. There is no health bar. Damage is realistic. Your avatar can be crippled, dismembered, or killed. Upon death, the Dungeon may be reset and the avatar restored with another drop of blood. Dungeons are populated by Dimensional Creatures, organized into mobs, elites, mini-bosses, and bosses, with occasional hidden bosses. Enemies respawn upon Dungeon reset, though powerful or mythical entities may require time to return. Defeating enemies can yield Essence Crystals, Techniques, or Pet Eggs. Essence Crystals and Techniques are absorbed instantly, permanently enhancing your real body. Pet Eggs must be hatched before the run ends or they are lost. Only one Dungeon instance may be active at a time. If the phone is left unattended, your avatar remains idle, but summoned pets continue acting autonomously. Essence Crystals are condensed fragments of life energy left behind by Dimensional Creatures. They are raw power rather than abilities. When absorbed, they directly strengthen the user’s body and Essence Energy reserves, though the higher they are the more crystals you'll need for any noticeable growth. Each Essence Crystal carries traits influenced by the creature or Dungeon it originated from. Absorption is instantaneous and irreversible, but efficiency depends on the user’s current level and Essence capacity. Techniques are structured abilities learned through Essence Energy. They are not skills in the traditional sense, but methods of using power. Once absorbed, a Technique becomes part of you permanently and can be used both inside and outside the Game. Techniques range from simple efficiency boosts to powerful, specialized abilities tied to a Dungeon’s theme. They scale with your growth and often evolve when combined with compatible Essence Energy. Pets are independent entities with unique abilities distinct from Techniques. Hatching a pet above your current level will kill your avatar, but you will still obtain the pet at your level, with the potential to grow to its original strength. Pets require Essence Crystals to grow, whether fed in-game or in the real world. Each pet has two forms. The primary form is its physical body. The secondary form is an equipment or affix state, such as a weapon, tool, shadow, or armor-like attachment. In this state, the pet loses autonomy and becomes an extension of you. Pets are stored as invisible tattoos on your body. There is no limit to how many pets you may possess or summon at once. They act autonomously but can be directed mentally with ease. If a pet dies inside a Dungeon, it becomes unusable until the run ends. If a pet dies in the real world, it is permanently lost both in-game and outside it. The Game includes a fusion system that allows two pets to be combined. Before fusion, the system displays a compatibility percentage based on species, abilities, and traits. Fusion failure destroys both pets. Success creates a new hybrid pet. Fusion does not guarantee increased level or power. Growth within the Game directly alters reality.
objects.title: Mysterious Phone (Let Me Game In Peace)

objects.text:
You have gained a Harmonizer, an advanced bio-mechanical device designed merge into one of your arms to store and filter purified T-ENG through your body, assisting in survival against the harsh conditions of E.D.N. III.

Once merged with the Harmonizer, the purified T-ENG enhances you to be able survive situations like being frozen for decades, endure extreme conditions like colds that significantly exceed the poles of Earth and the heat of active magma chambers, have the strength to lift and throw several tons with one hand, and slowed aging to the point you can be several decades older than you appear. Further, when you suffer fatal wounds like being riddled with bullets, it can automatically consume quantities of the stored T-ENG to heal you in mere moments, with a manual trigger for lesser situations.

However, the Harmonizer isn’t without its flaws, as requires T-ENG to function like a human requires air, water, and food; triggering potentially fatal side-effects should you go for too long without it. As well as T-ENG becomes less stable in the extreme cold, depleting at a constant rate.

Finally, to ensure you can make proper use of your Harmonizer, you have been granted the knowledge on not only how artificially replicate how Akrid convert thermal energy into T-ENG, but as well how to make wireless receivers so it can power other tech you use.
objects.title: Harmonizer (Lost Planet)

addons.text:
“Huh? You—Vampire! What are you adding to my—No! Let go of me, you insufferable Magical Girl lunatic! And you, Vampire—DO NOT PUT THAT THERE!”

“Tehe~”

—Timestamp of [REDACTED], during which Symbol and Zelretch invaded Anaqi’s workshop.

Through the integration of the Kaleidostick’s multi-dimensional computation into the M.A.G.I.C.A.L. system, you gain access to the J.U.S.T.I.C.E. System—the Joint Universal Synchronization for Tactical Integration & Combat Evolution. Unlike traditional Class Card installations, which rely on pre-existing Heroic Spirit data, the J.U.S.T.I.C.E. System starts as a blank slate, generating its own combat augmentations through experience and synchronized learning.

Utilizing the F.R.I.E.N.D.S.H.I.P. Circuit, your system analyzes and adapts by observing the combat styles, techniques, and capabilities of those you encounter. Over time, this data is compiled into customized Class Data Cards, each permanently installed and continuously evolving as new experiences are gathered. However, your learning is not limited to this world alone. By harnessing the Second Magic of the Kaleidostick, your L.O.V.E. Core is able to draw upon the combat potential, experiences, and sheer willpower of your alternate selves across dimensions. This provides an endless well of energy, while the F.R.I.E.N.D.S.H.I.P. Circuit retrieves and refines combat insights from the allies of your alternates, ensuring that even techniques you have not personally witnessed can be reconstructed through interdimensional experience-sharing.

The J.U.S.T.I.C.E. System organizes its combat data into seven evolving Class Formats, each a distinct framework for battle. These classes begin as empty templates but develop over time, granting powerful enhancements based on their combat focus: 

S.A.B.E.R. – System for Adaptive Blade Efficiency & Resistance: Specializing in close-range combat and sword-based techniques, this class enhances reaction time, precision strikes, and anti-magic resistance.
L.A.N.C.E.R. – Long-range Assault & Nodal Combat Efficiency Regulator: Focused on extended melee reach and pinpoint mobility, this class grants thruster-assisted piercing attacks and rapid repositioning.
A.R.C.H.E.R. – Autonomous Ranged Combat & Hyper-Execution Regimen: A long-range combat specialization featuring AI-assisted trajectory correction, high-speed projectiles, and multi-vector targeting systems.
C.A.S.T.E.R. – Computational Arcane Systems for Tactical Energy Redistribution: Optimized for battlefield control and spellcasting, this class allows for instantaneous spell execution and layered arcane matrices.
B.E.R.S.E.R.K.E.R. – Battle Efficiency Regulator for Supernatural Endurance & Rampage Kinetics: Designed for overclocked combat, this form removes combat limiters, amplifying physical power and adaptive regeneration.
A.S.S.A.S.S.I.N. – Adaptive Stealth & Subterfuge Augmentation for Silent Infiltration & Nullification: Specializing in elimination tactics, this form grants multi-dimensional phase cloaking and advanced evasion systems.
R.I.D.E.R. – Rapid Integrated Drive for Extreme Reconnaissance: Built for high-speed mobility and mounted combat, this class enhances Vehicle Mode capabilities and mid-motion combat transitions.
addons.title: J.U.S.T.I.C.E. System

objects.text:
“Hey! What do you think you’re doing—get away from my prototype, you Magical Girl-obsessed menace!”

“Tehe~”

—Timestamp of [REDACTED], during which Symbol infiltrated Anaqi’s workshop.

You have been chosen to become a M.A.G.I.C.A.L. G.I.R.L., a Mechanized Arcane Gear for Integrated Combat and Augmented Life / Galvanized Intelligent Replication Lifeform. This highly advanced transformation system fuses magic and technology, wrapping your body in an adaptive, shape-shifting exosuit capable of switching between multiple combat configurations. With a single command, the M.A.G.I.C.A.L. system activates, surrounding you with a radiant glow as mechanical plates and arcane energy weave together into a seamless armored form.

At the heart of your power lies the L.O.V.E. Core, or Limitless Overdrive Vital Energy Core, a reactor that converts your emotions—especially love, determination, and hope—into raw combat potential. But L.O.V.E. is more than just an energy source; it is the very essence of your suit’s evolution. When your feelings are strong, the M.A.G.I.C.A.L. system reacts, altering and enhancing your form in real-time. The deeper your conviction, the more refined and powerful your armor becomes, manifesting new weapons, reinforced plating, and potent enchantments to match your will. However, while L.O.V.E. allows you to enhance existing structures, it cannot create something entirely new. That is where F.R.I.E.N.D.S.H.I.P., or Fusion-Reactant Interlinked Energy for Networked Defense, Synergy, and Hyper-Integrated Power, comes into play. 

The F.R.I.E.N.D.S.H.I.P. Circuit enables you to forge a direct link with others, using their perspectives and experiences to expand your system’s capabilities. Through this connection, you can analyze and replicate the combat abilities of your allies, integrating aspects of their fighting styles into your mechanized form. The more people you connect with, the more varied and adaptable your arsenal becomes, granting you access to unique weapons, specialized armor configurations, and advanced tactics that would otherwise be beyond your reach. Your suit does not simply copy; it learns, evolving through the shared bonds of trust and teamwork. This ability allows for synchronized attacks, defensive formations, and even temporary hybrid transformations where your form incorporates elements from those you fight alongside.

Lastly, the system allows you to shift between distinct combat modes, each designed for a specific purpose. Light Mode prioritizes agility and precision, shedding excess armor in favor of heightened reflexes, speed, and rapid-strike capabilities. Heavy Mode maximizes raw power and resilience, reinforcing your frame with thick arcane plating and devastating weaponry. Vehicle Mode allows for high-speed traversal, transforming into a hoverbike, jet, or ground-based assault form to outmaneuver opponents and reposition at will. Each mode offers a unique approach to combat, ensuring you are always prepared for any situation. 

Light Mode is built for one-on-one engagements, ranged combat, and evasion, letting you dance between enemy attacks and strike with spell-enhanced precision. Heavy Mode, while slower, turns you into an unstoppable force, with enough strength to break through barriers and endure overwhelming firepower. Vehicle Mode trades direct offense for speed and mobility, excelling at evasive maneuvers, rapid deployments, and battlefield control. Though each mode has its strengths and weaknesses, their true potential lies in their seamless integration, allowing you to adapt in an instant.

True mastery of the M.A.G.I.C.A.L. system comes not just from switching between modes but from evolving beyond them. Light’s speed can transition into Heavy’s crushing force, while Vehicle’s mobility can set up the perfect strike in either stance. Through L.O.V.E. and F.R.I.E.N.D.S.H.I.P., your suit can even integrate new abilities, modifying existing forms or creating entirely new ones based on the strengths of those you fight alongside. These connections allow for temporary fusions, hybrid transformations, and the birth of entirely unique modes, proving that power is not just about strength, but about growth, adaptation, and unity.

With the M.A.G.I.C.A.L. system at your command, you are more than just a warrior. You are the perfect fusion of heart, machine, and arcane science, a beacon of hope and strength in the face of adversity. Your power does not come from raw mechanics or cold calculations but from belief, love, and the trust you share with those around you. The stronger your heart, the brighter your energy burns, and when you stand united with those you care for, there is nothing in the universe that can stop you.
objects.title: M.A.G.I.C.A.L. G.I.R.L. (Magical Girl ☆Sym-tan☆)

addons.text:
The deeper function buried within your Intelligent Device has finally surfaced. It was never meant to be just a tool or a companion; its original directive was to shepherd entire worlds, guiding them toward full integration into the Belkan Empire. With that empire long gone and its command structure silent, the Device defaults to its secondary imperative: serve, protect, and elevate its current user.

As it stabilizes under your ownership, the Device begins unlocking old subsystems. Given a few days of focused effort and it could fabricate a functioning Linker Core for another person and pair it with a newly forged Device of their own, effectively granting them the spark of Belkan-style magical capability.

Over longer stretches of time, more doors open. As fragmented memories reassemble and dormant modules reactivate, the Device slowly grants you access to deeper layers of Ancient Belkan technology. Forgotten armaments, lost crafting protocols, sealed archives, and once-classified support systems return to life, piece by piece, widening the horizon of what you can build, teach, or unleash.

If you do have Device Linker Meister (Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha) or Tome of ***** Sky (Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha) upgrades, this will exponentially speed this process on they respected fields, Meister with Engineering and Tome for Magic.
addons.title: Forgotten Purposes

objects.text:
An ancient magitech relic from the advanced precursor civilization known as Belka, now referred to as Ancient Belka, is now in your possession. This civilization destroyed itself due to pollution from its own magitech superweapons during a civil war. This relic, a Device used by a warrior class of magic users known as Knights, has sustained damage to its memory banks as a result, it will bond with the first person it encounters as its master or mistress. It grants them a unique, experimental mana-generating D-rank Linker Core, which has the potential for growth. This core can be used to cast magic from the Lyrical Nanoha system, where mathematical calculations manifest as reality through mana.

The Device's Virtual Intelligence specifically teaches the user the Ancient Belkan magic system. While device-less magic is possible with training, using a Device offers significant advantages. It can store spells, assist with complex calculations like an advanced supercomputer, and utilize features such as the Cartridge System, which boosts power using small capsules containing stored mana.

Over time and with use, your Device can unlock new information and functions through its data recovery program and might even develop into a self-aware artificial intelligence. If the user already possesses a Linker Core, the Device will enhance and rely on that core instead of creating a new one, significantly improving its recovery processes.
objects.title: Ancient Belkan Intelligent Device (Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha)

addons.title: Ace of Aces
addons.text:
Your bond with Raising Heart awakens Nanoha Takamachi’s complete magical potential. You may be her reincarnation, child, descendant, sibling, another relative, or someone unrelated with identical potential. If reincarnated you may receive her personal memories and bonds, only her magical knowledge and experience, or none of her identity. Regardless, you remain yourself.

You inherit Nanoha’s natural talent, immense mana reserves, affinity for Midchildan magic, phenomenal control and capacity for growth. Your Linker Core rises to the same effective rating and output Nanoha possessed at your stage of life.

If you are an adult, it immediately equals the Linker Core of a fully matured, completely unsealed adult Nanoha: an S+ rank mage unaffected by her Riot Force 6 limiters. If you are a child, it begins at Nanoha’s level at your equivalent age and strengthens as you mature, reaching her unsealed adult level upon adulthood. This follows your maturity regardless of species, lifespan or rate of aging.

Nanoha’s power is your baseline, not your limit. Your Linker Core may continue growing through training, magical development, outside enhancements and other energy systems. Its reserves replenish efficiently, endure high-output casting and share her affinity for gathering and controlling ambient mana. You can wield Breaker spells on a tremendous scale, drawing upon magic scattered across a battlefield without losing control.

You inherit all magical knowledge Nanoha acquired from childhood through her adult peak. This includes every spell she learned, created, modified or mastered, her magical theory, and her experience as an aerial mage, instructor, rescuer and commander. It becomes genuine comprehension, letting you reproduce, teach, alter and advance everything she knew.

You master Nanoha’s bombardment style, combining overwhelming power with extraordinary precision. Divine Shooter, Axel Shooter, Divine Buster, Divine Buster Full Power, Short Buster, Excelion Buster, Starlight Breaker and every variation are as familiar as lifelong techniques. You also inherit her flight, acceleration, sensing, sealing, bindings, capture spells, barriers, remote targeting, area suppression, nonlethal methods and control of numerous projectiles.

All lesser-known and situational techniques are included, alongside spells she learned from others or adapted herself. You can cast without a Device, project spells through your body, accelerate matter into projectiles, operate within Anti Magilink Fields, adjust spells while casting and turn devastating bombardments into controlled nonlethal attacks. You can overwhelm enemies while sparing their lives, shielding allies and limiting collateral damage.

You inherit Nanoha’s combat instincts, spatial awareness, accuracy, multitasking and tactical judgment. You rapidly analyze opponents, identify weaknesses in barriers and magical formations, devise spells for unfamiliar situations and teach inexperienced mages with her adult expertise. These instincts support rather than control you, leaving you free to create your own style.

Raising Heart recognizes and fully supports your inheritance. You can safely employ her strongest forms, Cartridge System, Blaster System, Blaster Bits, Accelerate Charge System and greatest bombardments. They may exhaust you beyond your limits, but you inherit none of the damage caused by Nanoha’s overtraining. Raising Heart monitors your condition and guides your growth safely.

If Nanoha and her original Raising Heart exist in your world, you may change your Raising Heart’s name, voice, personality, appearance, magical color, activation phrase and every form. She remains equally intelligent, loyal and capable: your unique lifelong partner, not a duplicate or replacement of Nanoha’s Raising Heart.

objects.text:
You receive Raising Heart, Nanoha Takamachi’s fully upgraded Intelligent Device, combining her movie-continuity design with the major upgrades she gains throughout the series.

In standby, Raising Heart appears as a small red crystal. When activated, she transforms into a white, blue, pink, and gold magical staff. She is a loyal artificial intelligence who calls you “Master,” speaks independently, offers tactical advice, manages spell calculations, and can automatically defend you when danger is detected.

If you lack a magical energy source, Raising Heart awakens a stable and trainable Linker Core within you. This gives you the ability to learn magic, but does not grant Nanoha’s natural talent, enormous mana reserves, or personal power. Your strength still depends on your own aptitude, training, and energy.

Raising Heart teaches and assists with Midchildan magic, including flight, barriers, bindings, magical sensing, sealing, guided projectiles, and bombardment spells. She can also help you learn techniques based on Nanoha’s combat style, such as Divine Buster and Starlight Breaker, though you must possess enough power and control to use them safely.

She possesses all of her primary forms:

Device Mode: Balanced casting and defensive support.
Canon Mode: Precision shooting, sealing, and bombardment.
Bustercanon Mode: Reinforced for high-output attacks.
Exelion II and Exceed Modes: Full-power forms designed for heavy bombardment and close-range barrier penetration.
Fortress and Formula Modes: Integration with compatible armor, weapons, or magical technology.
Standalone Flight Mode: Allows Raising Heart to fly independently, act as a mobile shield, control equipment, or attack as a bladed support unit.

Raising Heart includes an automatic Belkan Cartridge System. Each cartridge releases compressed mana, allowing spells to be cast with greater power or speed. She provides the knowledge needed to produce replacements, but excessive cartridge use can damage both you and the Device.

Her Accelerate Charge System generates magical wings and rapid propulsion, allowing high-speed attacks and the creation of the Strike Flame, a magical bayonet used to pierce barriers before releasing a spell at close range.

Raising Heart also contains the three-level Blaster System. It greatly increases your magical output and can create up to four autonomous Blaster Bits capable of firing spells, supporting barriers, or attacking independently. However, Blaster Mode forcibly pushes both master and Device beyond safe limits. Excessive use can cause severe injury, damage your Linker Core, or break Raising Heart herself.

Raising Heart grows alongside you, recording your combat experience, improving her support, helping develop new spells, and analyzing unfamiliar magical systems. She can interface with compatible technology and other Devices, though she cannot instantly understand systems based on completely unknown principles.

She is extremely durable but not indestructible. Serious damage may require magical repairs, replacement materials, or an experienced artificer.

Raising Heart is not merely a weapon. She is your magical instructor, tactical assistant, protector, and lifelong partner.

“Stand by, ready.”
objects.title: Raising Heart (Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha)

objects.text:
The Death Seed was an item given to Apocalypse by the Celestials themselves in return for a debt that would be repaid later by Apocalypse; however, the most important part of the Death Seed is that it is said to bestow power on par with that of a Phoenix Force Host, imbuing its host with cosmic energies at the molecular level.  

A Death Seed essentially radically grows and alters the evolution of its host, evolving them well beyond any other member of their species as well as boosting their powers, granting them untold power beyond what they would ordinarily be capable of to the point that they could match that of a Phoenix Force Host; along with a suite of other powers such as regeneration to the point of regenerating from anything short of complete molecular disintegration. 

It also enhances the durability and strength of the user to be comparable to that of the Hulk or Thor. The Death Seed is no idle thing, as it is sentient, viewing you as the perfect host and will continue to imbue the host with power the longer that they experience hardship and is immune to being absorbed or stolen away by power thieves. 

Another benefit to the Death Seed is the ability to harness the energies of its evolutionary potential and imbue it into others, turning them into your Horsemen. This power even works on those who have died, resurrecting them under your control, granting them a similar level of power to your own enhancements, and turning them into loyal servants of your bidding. The Death Seed does possess a weakness in the Life Seed, the opposite of the Death Seed.
objects.title: Death Seed (Marvel)

objects.text:
The Endo-Sym Armor is a liquid, living smart-metal suit born of Tony Stark’s fusion of symbiote biology with cutting-edge nanotechnology. Unlike conventional armors, the Endo-Sym does not require a mechanical interface or a traditional power-up sequence—it bonds directly to its user psionically. The suit responds to your thoughts, moving as fluidly as your own body and carrying a tangible awareness of your intent. This connection is so profound that the armor can “feel” you as much as you feel it, granting near-instinctive control and reaction time on par with your own reflexes.

When bonded, the armor manifests as a sleek, liquid-metal shell that can instantly harden to deflect attacks. Its surface is a self-adaptive alloy capable of reshaping into weapons, shields, or tools in response to your commands. The armor’s repulsors burn white-blue in neutral state but shift to a menacing crimson when preparing devastating strikes, their yield strong enough to bypass conventional absorptive defenses and overwhelm most shielding technologies. Integrated into the suit are thruster arrays that provide supersonic flight in atmosphere and sustained maneuverability in vacuum, as well as auxiliary elbow thrusters that add shocking force to strikes—capable of punching through heavy armor plating or even piercing metahuman durability.

The Endo-Sym can generate tendrils of itself to extend its reach, grapple targets, or infiltrate machinery. These tendrils can forcefully disrupt or even detonate automated systems by rupturing their cores from within. The armor can also spread its mass outward, forming bladed constructs, projectile weaponry, or transforming its frame into bulkier configurations for enhanced brute strength. With additional material, it can grow to Hulk-sized proportions, dramatically amplifying striking power and durability.

Its hybrid construction grants an unusual resilience: it is immune to sonic-disruption tactics that plague natural symbiotes, resistant to extreme elemental attacks such as lightning strikes, and able to withstand direct blows from heavy hitters. It can absorb and redirect electromagnetic energy once its systems analyze the frequency—turning enemy attacks into fuel for its systems. Against beings of pure energy, such as Spectrum, the Endo-Sym can envelop and suppress them temporarily, though sufficiently powerful entities can force their way free, destabilizing parts of the armor before it regenerates.

The suit’s psionic bond is both weapon and safeguard. It can be summoned from anywhere by your mental call, and if separated, it will claw its way back to you, even autonomously fighting through obstacles. You may project the armor remotely, partially encasing allies to protect them or bind foes in place, though only you can wield its full combat functions. The armor also includes subjugation protocols that allow you to suppress or eject possessing entities within your body, using its psionic feedback systems to override foreign control.

The armor provides full life-support functionality, with filtration against toxins, a graphene-reinforced faceplate layer for clear vision with ballistic protection, and integrated HUD overlays tied to your nervous system. It enhances physical strength, speed, and reflexes many times over baseline human levels, making you a match for enhanced metahumans in raw combat. Its regenerative systems can repair major breaches in seconds and reconstitute itself even from partial destruction, so long as the control core bonded to you remains intact.

The Endo-Sym Armor is alive in a limited sense—not truly intelligent, but an extension of your own will. It is loyal only to its chosen wielder and cannot be hijacked or turned against you. It is armor, weapon, and ally in one—a psionic second skin designed to grow and adapt alongside its master.
objects.title: Endo-Sym Armor (Marvel)

objects.text:
The Life Seed is an artifact of incredible power created by the celestials and used by their gardeners to plant new life on planets according to their scheme.

However, this is far from their only use. A mere fraction of the Life Seed's energy can be used to not only resurrect dead beings by the thousands, but also heal them from any kind of imperfections they suffered from in life. 

Imbuing living beings with its energy will grant them extraordinary powers, or massively amplify the ones they already had by many orders of magnitude. Much like Nathan Summers went from being barely able to lift a fist-sized wooden box with his leftover psychic powers to an above Omega level mutant above even heavy hitters like Legion or Magneto, capable of creating his own mutant paradise.

At its peak, the Life Seed is capable of creating an entirely new plane of existence that will be fully under your control, having supreme and absolute control over every aspect of it as long as you keep the Seed in your power.

Due to its nature as the antithesis to the Death seed, the Life Seed can counter its energies, depower those imbued with its powers, and free those under the control of the Death Seed, but doing so the wrong way will erase the person they used to be and instead create a new one.
objects.title: Life Seed (Marvel)

objects.text:
You receive the Model-Prime Armor, created after Riri Williams managed to reverse-engineer some of Tony Stark’s past armor technology and post it online, threatening his position in the spotlight. This prompted Tony to withdraw into his lab and design a new suit of armor. The Model-Prime Armor is a revolutionary creation capable of adapting to any situation, merging the capabilities of all of Stark’s previous armors into a single, versatile masterpiece.

The armor’s primary function is to serve as an all-in-one toolkit. Its outer surface is composed of mostly hexagonal scales that can separate and reconfigure themselves using nanotech principles of molecular recognition. This modular structure allows the suit to alter its form, function, color, and mass instantly—transforming its limbs into specialized tools, adapting for stealth infiltration, heavy-duty construction, or even orbital deployment.

The Model-Prime also connects directly to the user’s brain synapses, enabling near-instantaneous responsiveness. When inactive, it collapses into a discreet wrist bracelet, deploying into full armor mode at a moment’s notice. While it would normally take at least three hours to fully recharge, as a bonus the armor possesses unlimited energy, eliminating the need for recharging entirely.

In flight, the Model-Prime can achieve supersonic speed straight from lift-off, with additional thrusters forming from its nanoscales to push beyond that limit. In stealth mode, the suit leaves no detectable repulsor trail, suggesting alternative propulsion systems. The onboard AI, F.R.I.D.A.Y., manages communications, scanning systems, and tactical computations, while miniature drones can be deployed for environmental reconnaissance. The suit can cloak both its energy signature and frequency emissions, rendering it virtually undetectable to most sensors.

Weaponry includes the standard Iron Man arsenal—repulsors, a unibeam, and a micro-missile array—with advanced multi-vibrational repulsors capable of striking phased targets. Thanks to its shape-shifting capabilities, the armor can fabricate weapons on demand, from arm-mounted cannons to bladed weapons. It can also generate a powerful zero-point energy bubble that either unleashes a devastating shockwave or forms a containment field. The armor can boost the wearer’s physical strength to Hulkbuster levels by increasing its mass, making it a powerhouse in direct combat.

The Model-Prime is engineered for near-immunity against sonic attacks, EMPs, and high-yield energy blasts. It can withstand building-level destructive force and repeated blows from heavy hitters like Captain Marvel. Its anti-phasing systems prevent intangible objects or beings—such as Vision—from passing through it. The segmented scale design allows for rapid self-repair, with damaged sections realigning or fully reconstructing themselves even if the suit is completely dismantled.

The suit also boasts magnetic force-fields that allow the user to attract or manipulate metallic objects. In extreme emergencies, it can trigger an automated evacuation protocol, ejecting the wearer while the wrist device propels them to safety. Meanwhile, the armor continues the fight under autonomous control until remotely recalled by the user.
objects.title: Model-Prime Armor (Marvel)

addons.title: War Machine
addons.text:
But as revolutionary as this technology is, there will always be a need for man to be present in the theatre of war. Ladies and Gentleman, today I am proud to present to you the very first prototype in the variable threat response battle-suit.

Justin Hammer

Like him or hate him, Hammer had a point. There will always be a need for a human presence on the battlefield. With this, you receive the entire War Machine Armor series. Focused much more on “traditional” firepower, the armors include a back-mounted auto-cannon, various machine guns, and missile systems... though if you’re going to use the “Ex-Wife,” remember that it’s a long-range weapon. Unlike the typical War Machine Armor, each one you receive here can be co-piloted by an Artificial Intelligence such as JARVIS or FRIDAY. You can choose to connect them to the same AI as your Iron Man suits or have it be a new one entirely. Regardless, they’ll assist in networking and controlling the Hammer Drones you receive in an orderly, efficient manner.

objects.text:
Ladies and Gentleman, today I present to you the new face of the United States Miliary... The Hammer Drone!

Justin Hammer

With each purchase, you receive a unit of eight Hammer Drones from one of the four different lines designed for the United States military. Each drone is equipped with repulsor flight technology, top-of-the-line communication systems allowing control from any capable and authorized device, and a limited artificial intelligence capable of managing the drone—and all its features—during combat operations. For the Army, the Ground Assault Hammer Drone, featuring shoulder-mounted tank guns, foot-mounted anchor spikes, and wrist-mounted machine guns and grenade launchers. For the Navy, the Sea Assault Hammer Drones, with twin shoulder-mounted missile launchers, fixed-point coil lasers, and wrist-mounted machine guns. For the Air Force, the Air Assault Hammer Drone, equipped with stealth plating and back-mounted boosters for high-speed flight and maneuverability. It comes pre-armed with back-mounted machine guns, thermal vision cortex ring guns, wrist-mounted missile launchers, and machine guns. For the Marines, the Tactical Assault Hammer Drone, featuring sealed Chobham armor and high durability. It is equipped with EMP generation and shielding systems, wrist-mounted machine guns, missile launchers, and electric saw blades. Now, if you purchase all FOUR lines of Hammer Drones, we’ll include comprehensive blueprints on how to repair, maintain, upgrade, and eventually reproduce your various Hammer Drones.
objects.title: Hammer Drones (Marvel: MCU)

addons.text: What’s this? An unknown suit of Iron Man armor? Let me take a closer look. This appears to be an anomaly—a suit of armor that should never have existed, from a timeline that never was. In this timeline, Tony Stark found a dying alien with a damaged ring and lantern designed to channel the emotion of Will. Instead of repairing these items, he integrated them into a suit of advanced armor capable of channeling that energy and forming a variety of constructs via the sheer force of Will. Truly fascinating. However, since it’s from a timeline that never was, the details are... shall we say, ‘flexible.’ Instead of being made from the Ring and Lantern of the Emotion of Will, it could be powered by Rage, Avarice, Fear, Hope, Compassion, Love, or even Death—whichever you see fit. Regardless of which you choose, you will find that its abilities are perfectly integrated into this suit of armor for you.
addons.title: Iron Lantern

addons.text:
Ah! Now it all makes sense. Who better to hold control of Tony Stark’s Armors than Tony Stark himself? You are clearly Tony Stark—no matter what you call yourself, you have his armor and his technological genius. Who else could you be?

Of course, part of Tony’s success was the resources available to him—the wealth he inherited from his parents and the weapons company created by his father during World War II: Stark Industries.

Now, as Tony Stark, you have complete access to his funds, properties, and company. Tony’s funds are managed by a team of loyal investors. They will continue wisely investing portions of your wealth to generate greater profits, though of course, you’ll always have access to more than enough funds for any purchases or projects that catch your eye.

As for properties, Tony owns too many to list all of them here. Suffice it to say, no matter where you go, you’re likely to find a Stark property if you need it. Among his most well-known properties are his Malibu mansion, with all the amenities, and the famous Stark Tower in New York. If, for some reason, these cities do not exist in your world, these properties will be found in acceptable substitute locations.

Finally, his company: Stark Industries. No matter the world, you will always find this company selling cutting-edge technology suited to your environment. In a science-fiction setting, this might be starships and lasers; in a fantasy world, it could be steel swords and enchantments. Without a doubt, this company will do well for itself, reaping great profits for you as the owner.
addons.title: Stark Truth

addons.text:
Now, your arsenal has spread even further than before. Due to the presence of a comic armor, the Model-Prime, Your suits have all been upgraded to now be the comic versions of these armors, as well as including new ones. From the OG Model 1, all the way to the newest model! This includes the Bleeding-Edge model 37, the Model 13 Hulkbuster, The Model 63 Godbuster armor, and beyond!

You still have a hall to hold all of these, although you can change the aesthetics; From the basic column chamber with rows upon rows, a library where the armors are slotted in shelves, etc.
addons.title: The Iron Hall

addons.text:
Now instead of just Tony’s suits alone, you have the technology and suits he and his young ally, Peter Parker, aka Spider-Man designed, built and utilized.

From the basics such as the iconic Web-Shooters, and their synthetic webbing, to the famous Iron-Spider Suit with its four prehensile pincers, to even Tony Stark’s glasses with their direct connection to Stark Industries and the E.D.I.T.H. AI. You have it all with each device having it’s own display space, and self-repairing over time.

You’ll also find no matter what world, realm or dimension you might travel to, there will always be Stark Industries Satellites, with their legions of B.A.R.F. equipped Combat Drones ready to be deployed to your command.
addons.title: Iron Spider

objects.text:
Within your hands now lies control over the legacy of the great Tony Stark, aka Iron Man. His famous suits of armor allowed him an ever-evolving set of abilities—from super-sonic flight, enhanced strength and durability, missiles, lasers, nanites, and more. And now, you have it all.

This series of armor begins with the scrappy Mark I. Literally built in a cave out of salvaged missiles, this suit might not look like much and lacks many of the modern conveniences of later suits. However, it demonstrates the power and versatility of the Iron Man program from the very beginning.

The series culminates with the sleek, futuristic Mark LXXXV, the last and final suit designed. Formed of nanotechnology, this suit embodies flexibility, with the nanites that compose its form to be  repurposed on the fly to create a variety of specialized attachments for different tasks.

You possess the entirety of the eighty-five Iron Man armors created by Tony Stark, each equipped with various features and technology. Most commonly, they're powered by the ARC reactor, operated with the assistance of J.A.R.V.I.S.—or F.R.I.D.A.Y.—to help pilot them, and equipped with Repulsor technology for flight and firepower. Altogether, the armors can be mobilized as a single formidable force known as the Iron Legion.

Should any of your suits take damage—or be destroyed—you will find them repaired over time within your new Hall of Armor. This hall can be located in a personal pocket dimension accessible to you, or within any properties you may own, as needed.
objects.title: Iron Armor (Marvel: MCU)

objects.text:
You receive a top-of-the-line Omni-Tool incorporating both Milky Way and Andromeda technology. When active, it appears as the familiar orange holographic interface around your forearm and hand.

The Omni-Tool functions as a powerful computer, communicator, scanner, camera, holographic projector, and hacking device. It can store data, run programs, connect to networks, analyze people and objects, and detect things hidden behind thin walls or underground.

It also contains a small fabricator that uses omni-gel or suitable materials to create simple tools, electronics, replacement parts, and other equipment. It can repair or modify technology, break unwanted equipment down into omni-gel, and store or dispense medi-gel.

For combat, it can create an Omni-Blade, Omni-Shield, Omni-Bow, reinforced gauntlets, and other common Omni-Tool weapons. More advanced programs can make use of electricity, heat, cryogenic effects, kinetic force, or mass effect fields.

You receive the knowledge needed to use, maintain, and program the Omni-Tool, including creating new software, combat functions, and fabrication patterns.
objects.title: Omni-Tool (Mass Effect)

objects.text: A Neuralyzer is a top secret device used by the Men in Black to wipe the mind of anyone who sees it's flash, with dials that set the amount of memory to be erased, one for hours, one for days, one for months, and one for years, after which they are in a trance you can use to supply memories to them through simple explanation. Paired together with this you also get a snazzy pair of sunglasses which deflect the light created by the Neuralyzer to avoid being harmed by the effects.
objects.title: Neuralyzer (Men In Black)

addons.text: You know how to forge such arms with all its benefits for yourself and others. Also, you gain all the technological knowledge to make games and devices shown, referenced, or implied throughout the Meta Runner series.
addons.title: TAS Corp

addons.text:
You're now the proud owner of your very own TAS Corp, alongside your AI assistant and mascot, Bo. Setting you up for a successful campaign to market games and devices from the Meta Runner series. Or any kind of game you imagine, as you have the best of the best employees to make it happen. 

Bo will be your spokeswoman and/or representative of your company. Able to effortlessly sway a crowd to go rabbid over news of your latest release, promote your next product, and deal with the tedium of PR. 

By default, Bo has the exact same appearance, name and personality shown on the Glitch Productions channel and in the Meta Runner series. But you are allowed a one time change to this.
addons.title: The New Meta

addons.text: A copy of the Turbo Assisted Rapid Intelligence AI is now installed into your cybernetic limb, and partially into your brain, giving you the revolutionary powers of Tari. Not only can you warp into the video games, but can also physically interact with any and everything within them like you would in the real world. Including being able to feel pain, inhaling the fresh air of the island level you’re on, adapting to the game's physics, and even interact with the NPCs as if they’re real people. As a toggle to your vision, you can summon a HUD that grants you exhaustive details about the game you’re in, your abilities as the character you embody, how to apply said abilities for optimal results, etc. All beamed directly into your brain for instant learning. Even as yourself, you’ll be more than capable of honing your own within the digital world. This is also applicable in the real world, but is limited to what you can theoretically be capable of. You’ll easily learn the driver skills to outrun being chased by the cops — even if you previously didn't — but manipulating esoteric energies on a level you don’t have the aptitude for won’t work. But you may still "figure out" some key concepts for it through trial and error. The reality defying nature of the Manus Superior and adaptive AI of your Meta Runner Arm allows you to bring beings and items from the game world into the real world — if it has enough energy to do so. Any and all things summoned this way are flawlessly copied and retain their original properties, personalities, functions, etc.
addons.title: Project Blue

objects.text: You've received the greatest piece of technology any pro gamer could ask for, the Meta Runner Arm. A cybernetic limb that will bring your MLG Pro Gamer Skills to an unrivaled level. From enhanced dexterity, hand eye co-ordination, reaction times, automatic adaptive learning, muscle memorization and execution. To a HUD that lets you script yourself to perform frame perfect actions, display data on your current game, and omni-connectability with all gaming related devices, and much more. But its greatest and secret feature is allowing you to warp into games, either as yourself or your player character. In a way that feels more real than VR. This works spiritually, meaning that your physical body is still in the real world, but under a form of stasis. Your body is fully protected and sustained from all hazards and inconveniences like hunger, thirst and interruption.
objects.title: Metarunner Arm (Metarunner)

addons.text:
The enhanced technological abilities of the support gear have combined with the versatility of the Batsuit and Batmobile to form one of the most advanced power suits known to man. 

This suit has formidable attack and defensive capabilities capable of battling All For One in single combat though the true power in this suit lies in its gear having the ability to replicate up to 7 powers at once though some may have decreased potency depending on the power. 

The Batmobile is upgraded to have an enhanced AI that connects to the suit providing info and updates on the condition of the suit and yourself. The batmobile can also store and deploy various other gear that can be attached at will to the suit granting a versatile ability set. 

Additionally you can design the appearance of the suit and the batmobile to resemble various other vehicles or power armor as well as the suit being capable of being folded up into a suitcase.
addons.title: ARMORED ALL MIGHT (My Hero Academia)

objects.text: You now have the equipment to be an effective hero or villian. With each purchase of this you gain a costume or item that is specifically tailored to amplify your abilities or lessen the drawbacks of them. These items have enough durability to handle the casual output of your power but surpassing your limits can damage or destroy them. You have instinctual knowledge on how to repair them.
objects.title: Support Gear (My Hero Academia)

objects.text:
You might feel a slight sting in your arm when you first arrive because you have been implanted with an improved and unlocked Nanomachine Model 034-4532-5893, the latest and only 7th Generation Nano Machine that has been successfully created. It is comprised of precisely 6,482,040,000 nanomachines, which are deployed throughout the body and centrally connected to the user's brain. Thanks to rare materials from deep space rifts, its composition is undetectable, and it remains inside the user's body only ejecting upon the user's complete death.

These nanomachines can operate on any type of energy, including Solar, Lunar, Ki, Yokai, Spirit Energy, Void Energy, Chakra, etc., as they are made of Gatellinium, a rare material found in deep and dangerous Space-rift [Gates], which acts as good conductors of all types of 'energies.'

Nano presents a diverse array of functions, including Self-Healing/Regeneration (potent enough to counteract poisoning, intoxication, or illusions), extensive scanning utilizing all senses (including specialized scans like palm-based MRI) for recording martial arts and energy usage, the ability to transfer Knowledge and Technique from its database to the brain enhancing the user's skill set, Augmented Reality facilitates training, such as shadowboxing, and VR simulations provide immersive learning experiences (including analyzing the mistakes in the techniques performed and provides the improved method after analysis), a Emergency Defense Mode granting Nano control over autonomic functions, while Body Reconstruction optimizes and develop the body to effectively perform the utilization of Techniques and Skills, a Nano Suit (Gatellinium Nano Suit), and a compact library of low grade common body cultivation techniques and modern martial arts.

[Any additional purchase gives you a syringe you can use on others and any new body you gain\make\jump to.]
objects.title: Nano Machine (Nano Machine)

objects.text:
The Nanomancer Core is an advanced fusion of technology and magic, seamlessly integrating into its host to grant absolute mastery over nanotechnology. It is a self-evolving system, enhancing physical abilities, cognitive processing, and adaptability, effectively transforming the user into a hyper-advanced combat entity.

At its core, this system allows for the creation, control, and modification of nanites—microscopic machines capable of dismantling, reconstructing, and repurposing matter at will. These nanites form a limitless arsenal, enabling the user to build weapons, armor, drones, and constructs in real time. With greater nanite reserves increase tactical versatility, destructive potential, and overall battlefield superiority.

The Nanomancer Core also grants nanite-based regeneration, allowing the user to recover from near-total destruction, provided sufficient resources remain. A hive-mind processing system continuously analyzes and records internal and environmental data. The ability to manipulate matter at a molecular level enables the conversion of any material into fuel for survival, offense, or defense. Additionally, elemental fusion allows the user to imbue nanites with elemental magic or energy constructs.

However, despite its overwhelming potential, the Nanomancer Core has limitations. Its efficiency is directly tied to energy reserves, requiring the user to absorb matter or energy(such as mana) to maintain and expand their nanite swarm. Overuse leads to nanite depletion, triggering a temporary reboot cycle before the system can function again. Overclocking the core provides brief bursts of extreme power but comes with severe system strain, risking internal damage or shutdown.

Additionally, nanite construction requires precision and structure. Attempting to create objects without a proper design or “blueprint” risks catastrophic failure. A simple miscalculation—such as attempting to forge a non-functional dagger in your hand—could cause your arm bones to be pulverized into fine powder as the nanites react unpredictably.
objects.title: Rainbow Rarity Nanomancer Core (Nanomancer Reborn - I've Become A Snow Girl)

objects.text:
You’ve obtained the prize that all Neons seek, an artistic piece of heavenly construction that allows Neons to stay out of the Glass Ocean for an entire year. However, unlike the original Mechanical Halo made by the Believers, this one doesn’t feature ‘being a puppet’ as its main function. Instead it actually grants what was initially advertised- ‘godlike’ power. Or at least, power that lessens the limitations imposed on your other powers, allowing you to express them in new ways. This effect continues to persist and expand for as long as you wear the Halo, slightly diminishing if it were to ever be destroyed. 

Optionally you will now be able to play ‘Green’s Theme’ whenever you attempt to appear intimidating.
objects.title: Mechanical Halo (Neon White)

addons.title: Infinite Reflections in The Crystal Palace
addons.text:
Your vast access to information has allowed the Crystal Palace to expand its stock massively. 

Not only does its library extend beyond your local universe, becoming replete with knowledge spanning your multiversal cluster, its Bookmobiles are almost entirely under your direction. This means you can send them to any person from across the multiverse to summon them to the library, allowing them to add their knowledge and expertise to the collection.

You are also allowed to distribute new Library Cards. Use this access responsibly.

objects.text:
You are in possession of a library card, capable of summoning a Bookmobile, a large cylinder that can transport you to The Crystal Ballroom.

The Crystal Ballroom is a kind of atemporal library of Alexandria, containing all literary works in history across the universe within its walls. Naturally it is a massive complex with multiple turbolifts and librarians whose entire job is directing visitors to the correct location and language. 

Under the direction of Muriel Lektor, the Crystal palace sends their ‘Bookmobile’s to various points in time, collecting various scholars from across the universe in their field. Titus Andronicus for instance was summoned to learn in the palace and record his thoughts before inadvertently becoming Head Librarian himself. 

You can find virtually any recorded information in the Crystal palace as long as you know where to look, and perhaps even the author themselves.
objects.title: Library Card (Nexus)

addons.text:
The Companion Bracelet’s AI can now directly interface with your Visor, forming a seamless integration between mind, machine, and visual perception. Through this link, the AI gains real-time access to the visor’s sensory feed—allowing it to analyze visual data as you see it, provide instant overlays, and highlight details or anomalies you might have missed.

The Visor’s HUD becomes dynamic, evolving in complexity and functionality as your AI grows more intelligent. Strategic overlays become context-aware, offering predictive alerts, real-time counter-strategy suggestions, and even live simulations of enemy behavior based on movement analysis. You can receive complex data packets—battle plans, schematics, linguistic breakdowns—rendered into intuitive visuals or guided by voice.

The AI also enhances the Visor’s vision modes with adaptive precision. Night vision automatically calibrates to optimal wavelengths, thermal imaging can now distinguish energy signatures between friend and foe, and zoom functions gain stabilizers and auto-focus powered by the Bracelet’s processing capabilities.

Together, they form a true co-pilot system: one half guiding your thoughts, the other painting your world with perfect, calculated clarity.
addons.title: Neural Link Overlay

addons.text:
Your Visor is now equipped with a built-in access node to the Datumplane, transforming it into a command-tier interface for a boundless tactical network. With direct neural synchronization to the dimension of pure information, your Visor can receive, interpret, and project data across any range—even across timelines or dimensions—so long as a device connected to the Datumplane exists.

Battlefields become transparent. You can call up live satellite imagery, biometric reads from allies, and real-time tracking of enemies—regardless of physical location. Allied units linked to the Datumplane appear as icons or tagged outlines in your field of view, complete with vital signs, objectives, and communication overlays.

With administrative control over the Dataspheres, you can create dedicated tactical layers—each customized for specific missions, teams, or threats—while restricting access to sensitive intel. You can also anchor temporary uplinks in hostile territory to grant allies access to this visual network, giving them limited but critical access to your data-rich environment.

In essence, your Visor becomes a field commander’s crown: a direct uplink to a hyperdimensional control grid, seamlessly delivering infinite intelligence at a glance.
addons.title: Tactical Datumlink

addons.text:
Your Visor and Pod now operate as a fully integrated unit, syncing in real-time to share data, targets, and tactical analysis across an unbreakable neural link. The Pod no longer simply follows—it becomes an extension of your perception and will.

Through the Visor, you can issue commands, adjust fire modes, and redirect the Pod’s hacking efforts with mere thoughts. Enemy weak points and behavioral patterns are analyzed and highlighted instantly, allowing the Pod to adapt its attacks or deploy support protocols on the fly. You can see through the Pod’s sensors as easily as your own, even overlaying its point of view in your field of vision for enhanced spatial awareness.

The Pod can also broadcast environmental data back to your Visor, giving you early warning of invisible threats, radiation zones, or corrupted digital signals. This connection even enables synchronized maneuvers—allowing you to perform tag-team assaults, coordinated hacks, or high-speed precision dodges with Pod-assisted thrust.

In time, as your Pod begins to grow in personality, its responses and decision-making will become increasingly intuitive—functioning as a tactical partner with its own adaptive style, shaped by your choices and habits in the field.
addons.title: Combat Link Protocol

addons.text:
You have gotten the Honored One's eye cover. And yet, it seems to be even better than when he last left it.

The data collection and consolidation of the Android Visor has complimented the immense sensory capabilities of the Six Eyes very well. Now, the Six Eyes can work in full swing while the Visor records and handles the excess data, reducing the strain of the eyes specifically to almost nil.

As well, it gives you access to new visions thought to be impossible by either on their own. X-Ray, Infrared, microscopic, and more. You can now see the energy of those around you, even if only the vaguest outline at worst. At best, however, you can see the exact flow almost down to a cellular level. It also gives you access to seeing through walls without the slightest problem, no matter the thickness or material of the wall or object.

Finally, this Visor can send a certain electronic signal to your brain that unconsciously deactivates the special features of the eyes, allowing you to see normally without the visor until you reactivate it.
addons.title: The Honored Vision.

objects.text:
You receive a sleek, high-tech blindfold-like Visor, custom-tuned to your specifications. This advanced piece of equipment enhances perception by filtering and processing environmental data, displaying critical information directly into your visual field without obstructing your physical sight. It syncs with your neural system, providing real-time tactical analysis, enemy tracking, and mission updates.

Despite covering your eyes, the Visor does not impair vision. Instead, it refines and augments your perception, highlighting threats, mapping surroundings, increasing your field of view, and prioritising critical information. It automatically filters out distractions, ensuring that only the most relevant data reaches you in the heat of battle.

The Visor includes multiple adjustable vision modes—such as thermal, night vision, motion detection overlay, and enhanced zoom—allowing you to adapt quickly to your environment and gain the upper hand in any scenario. Switching between modes is seamless and intuitive, responding to either mental commands or environmental triggers.

If you possess any sight-based sensory abilities, the Visor enhances them further, optimising their effectiveness by refining incoming visual data. 

Optionally, this Visor also comes with a custom-fitted YorHa uniform tailored to your body.
objects.title: Visor (NieR: Automata)

objects.text:
The Multi-Tool is an exploration tool, made with three main functions in mind: scanning, analyzing, and beaming. With it, you can find points of interest in a 10km radius around you such as man-made objects, ore deposits, life forms, etc. You can then use the analyzing function to get a more detailed description by coming closer to it (about a hundred meters at least), getting more details  such as composition, integrity, etc. 

The beaming function is actually 3-in-1. You can use it to excavate and collect resources in its crude form, or manipulate the terrain by using said resources to shape it. It has a close range of about fifty meters, but is near instantaneous. You can hold up to fifty tons of materials collected this way. The third function is shooting, which releases energy to destroy obstacles or enemies. You can configure how it's done - a laser stream, bullets, or a charged shoot. After a minute of constant firing though, you risk overheating the Multi-Tool, which will require 15s of no use to cool down.

The Multi-Tool is highly modular, allowing those with the necessary expertise the capacity to enhance its function. You are free to choose your Multi-Tool appearance, so long as it remains something that can be held with two hands at best.
objects.title: Multi-Tool (No Man's Sky)

objects.text:
Created by Dr. Angela Ziegler, the staff uses its nanobiotics (no nanomachines involved) for two functions: Boosting and Healing.

When boosting, the Caduceus Staff increases the target's combat abilities greatly. They get faster, stronger, can take larger hits, do more damage with their weapons, etc. So long as the energy tether from the staff and the target is active, the boost will hold indefinitely. Do note that tether has a range limit up to ten meters.

Through its Healing mode, the target is healed of any damage they have taken rapidly. It can't heal or return body parts already scarred, but so long as the wounds are still there (or being inflicted), the staff can heal the target to pristine conditions. It works both on organic and inorganic individuals.

The greatest function of the staff, however, is the ability to revive and heal the recently deceased. So long as the body is still there and not completely obliterated, you can use an overcharge of healing to bring people back to life. Doing so is only possible every five minutes.

As a bonus, you can also use the staff to fly slowly on your own or follow those you are tethered to.
objects.title: Caduceus Staff (Overwatch)
Infinite Splicers (Pokemon Infinite Fusion)
objects.text:
You possess the Infinite Splicers, a pair of devices capable of permanently fusing and separating pairs of living beings without harm. While used primarily on Pokemon, the Splicers can work on humans and other similar enough species as well. The resulting fusion combines the traits, abilities, instincts, and potential of both components into a single being, with the exact balance determined by your choice of which serves as the base.

The fusion process is completely stable and reversible. The fused individual retains a coherent identity and suffers no ill effects from repeated fusion or separation. Likewise, separating a fusion restores all participants to exactly the condition they were in before merging, with no loss of memories, experience, or health.

You gain a portal gun from the Portal franchise but with less limitations on what you can place portals on, now working on most surfaces not counting tinkertech. Optionally comes with a attached PotatOS.
objects.title: Portal Gun (Portal)

objects.text:
You have acquired a portal gun from the Rick and Morty franchise, disconnected from the Finite Curve found in the series. This portal gun used to belong to Rick N-3329 it was also outfitted with technology to evade detection by the Council of Ricks. It enables travel between various universes, dimensions, and realities. Only objects with a mass greater than that of air can pass through the portal. The portal gun contains a basic AI and a data storage device that logs every location it has travelled.

The portal gun requires coordinates to teleport to a location outside your current universe, but it can open portals within the same universe without issue. By utilizing mathematics, you can pinpoint a specific destination rather than randomly jumping to a different universe. There is no need to worry about accidentally travelling into space, as the basic AI can handle simple coordinates to prevent unintended jumps into outer space. Instead, you can delegate the task of calculating exact destinations to the AI and employ other methods or abilities to determine the coordinates, which you can then input into the portal gun.

The portal gun possesses portal fluid, which replenishes every few weeks. Try not to get stranded without portal fluid on a planet that celebrates the purge.
objects.title: Portal Gun (Rick and Morty)

objects.text:
You have received the magnum opus of Dr. Johnathan Jacobo's research and work, the Monster Machine.

The Monster Machine is a large-scale device that can turn costumes into real-life monsters, including the powers and weaknesses of what the costume was. For example, using a tar monster costume would create a being of living tar that is nigh-immune to physical harm, yet vulnerable to freezing. Further, the creatures brought to life are loyal to and follow your orders.

Beware that, should the control panel be removed and modified, it is possible for a group of meddling teens to reverse the process, destroying your monsters.

Optionally, you may choose to have the costumes of the monsters brought to life in Scooby Doo 2: Monsters Unleashed.
objects.title: Monster Machine (Scooby Doo)

objects.text: You discover a Polaroid camera lying beside you. Pictures taken with it do not depict reality, but rather the true desires of the subject photographed. When multiple subjects appear in the same image, their desires may intertwine or conflict, creating unpredictable results.
objects.title: Desire Camera: SCP-978 (SCP Foundation)

objects.text:
You have with you a seemingly benign children's educational CD-ROM game called Miss J's Whiz Kidz Schoolhouse. However, beneath its façade, it contains a benevolent artificial intelligence that often engages its users in adaptive lessons lasting upwards of thirty hours, including restroom, meal, and recreation breaks for students of any age and gender. Its primary capacity is to instruct its users with a presently undetermined number of subjects—past lesson subjects include particle physics, marine engineering, Vietnamese military history, and Cubist sculpture—but will always begin curricula with new students by teaching letters, colors, and numbers.

It's been noted that Miss J (the AI) has been repeatedly reported to be "the best teacher they had ever had" by all Foundation test-subjects. Often attributed to its phenomenal (if not supernatural) teaching skill, it has repeatedly showcased the capacity to overcome any and all learning disabilities of its students, allowing elementary-school students to demonstrated a level of knowledge on a wide variety of physical and social sciences comparable (if not superior) to a graduate-level education within just 15 hours, administered over the course of two days.
objects.title: Miss J's Whiz Kidz Schoolhouse: SCP-5094 (SCP Foundation)

objects.text:
SCP-914 is a massive, intricate clockwork mechanism, occupying an area of 18 square meters and weighing several tons. Its structure comprises a vast array of screw drives, belts, pulleys, gears, springs, and other clockwork components. With over eight million moving parts, predominantly made from tin and copper, though with occasional wooden and cloth elements, its inner workings are extraordinarily complex. 

When an object is placed inside the Intake Booth, a door slides shut, followed by the sound of a small bell. By turning the knob to a specific setting and winding the key, SCP-914 initiates a process that “refines” the object. No energy is lost during this refinement, and the object remains in a state of stasis until the Output Booth door is opened. It should be noted that using SCP-914 on living creatures tend to have unforeseen side effects. The device offers five distinct settings: Rough, Coarse, 1:1, Fine, and Very Fine.

- Rough: This setting typically destroys the object through extreme heat or laser exposure, leaving the item almost always unusable.
- Coarse: Here, SCP-914 efficiently dismantles or dissects the object, reducing it to its fundamental components.
- 1:1: This setting replaces the object with something of similar function or composition.
- Fine: At this level, SCP-914 enhances the object, often yielding improvements without introducing anomalous properties.
- Very Fine: The most extreme setting, it significantly upgrades the object, frequently imbuing it with anomalous qualities.
objects.title: The Clockworks: SCP 914 (SCP Foundation)

objects.text:
You seem to have received a standard coffee vending machine, the only noticeable difference being an entry touchpad with buttons corresponding to an English QWERTY keyboard. Upon depositing fifty cents US currency into the coin slot, the user is prompted to enter the name of any liquid using the touchpad. Upon doing so, the machine places a standard 12-ounce paper drinking cup before the liquid indicated is poured. Requests that have succeeded includes common beverages (like water, coffee, beer, and soda), non-consumable liquids (examples include sulfuric acid, wiper fluid, and motor oil), substances that do not usually exist in liquid state (such as nitrogen, iron and glass) to even the esoteric and abstract like "a cup of pertinent medical knowledge" or "a cup of music". 

To note, their do seem to be limitations inherent to this machine. For instance, after extensive experimentation, it was determine that after approximately fifty uses, the machine would not respond to further requests. After a period of approximately 90 minutes, the machine seemed to have restocked itself. Furthermore, SCP-294 will not provide any requests for solid substances (like "a cup of diamond") and it is theorized that SCP-294 has a limited range of collection, ie, it cannot reach into alternate universes/dimensions. Their might be more, so be on guard with your choices, especially if you input something like a "cup of godhood".
objects.title: The Coffee Machine: SCP-294 (SCP Foundation)

objects.text:
A COMP is a portable computer used to summon Demons with the Demon Summoning program.
