While the term Demon has a certain connotation, in this case it means any kind of supernatural creature (including those found in whatever setting you go to), meaning that things like angels and spirits are also considered Demons by the COMP. Demons that you have a contract with can be fused to create more powerful Demons, giving you an incentive to make contracts with as many Demons as possible. Thankfully, they mostly seem to ask for money and healing items, but if you have good charisma and know how to "read" a Demon's personality, you can often bind a Demon for free.

It also comes with an automap & GPS, any features found on a real world cell phone, magically encrypted email, and various trackers for your quests, items, companions, and abilities, a scanner and database for things you've summoned or encountered, and the ability to purchase apps that can upgrade the COMP or add new abilities.

You can choose any COMP from the series, including weird and wacky ones like the GUMP or the Kuzunoha Family's archaic but functionally equivalent Devil Summoner equipment.
objects.title: COMP (Shin Megami Tensei)

objects.text:
You start with the necessary things to get things rolling out. Under the emergency pod seat (which can also double as a bed), you will find the basics to start building: hand tools and a drill, a space-suit with an inbuilt (and limited) flight system, a couple of hydrogen and oxygen bottles, and a pistol with four spare magazines. It also contains a datapad, but aside from a Notepad-like program, it doesn't contain anything else.

The pod itself has a full battery and the 02/H2 generator is fully loaded with ice. It also has a Survival Kit inbuilt: a simple system that can convert minerals from its raw form to processed alloys, craft those alloys in mechanical and eletronical components and and even heal your wounds… though is not very efficient at any of those. Its technical databases are also empty.

The pod can be sealed to protect you from the outside elements such as cold, lack of atmosphere or radiation, but is essentially a large tin can, don't expect to survive more than an occasional bullet or micro meteor. It has enough energy to last a week in standby mode, and enough ice for two weeks of oxygen.
objects.title: Drop Pod (Space Engineers)

objects.text: This conspicuous toy can manipulate probability to the most ludicrously cartoon extremes, with some strings attached. By pulling the string, a voice will issue instructions for you to follow. Not obeying will simply cause nothing to happen. Following the instructions - regardless of how nonsensical they may be - is guaranteed to drastically improve your current situation. Such as making an entire buffet of food fall from the sky, granting you temporary toon physics, or even making what you desire most fall on your lap. But you don't decide these effects, the Conch does.
objects.title: Magic Conchshell (SpongeBob SquarePants)

objects.text:
A marvel of hyper-advanced biotechnology, the Chip is neither wholly organic nor mechanical. Instead, it exists as a nanotechnological bio-liquid, composed of millions of microscopic adaptive chips that seamlessly integrate into your genetic structure. Upon infusion, these nanites embed themselves into your chromosomes, synchronizing with your body's cellular replication and division processes. Unlike traditional implants, the Evolution Chip does not sit within you as a foreign device—it becomes an inseparable part of your genetic code, modifying and refining your biological framework at the molecular level.

Once activated, the Chip forcibly elevates your genetic structure beyond natural limits. Your muscle efficiency, reaction speed, endurance, and cognitive abilities are optimized. It accelerates healing, filters toxins, and adapts dynamically to environmental stressors such as radiation, pressure changes, and extreme temperatures.

Unlike conventional augmentations, the Chip does not simply enhance—it evolves. With every battle, every challenge, and every experience, the chip gathers [DATA], modifying your DNA based on the information acquired. This constant adaptation allows your body to break through biological ceilings, steadily advancing toward a level of existence beyond conventional limits such as tripe or even quadruple helix based DNA. 
Given sufficient time and suitable stimuli, the chip can unlock abilities far beyond the realm of normal human evolution—enhanced energy manipulation, heightened perception, bio-electric augmentation, and even reality-defying capabilities or strange stuff such a Anti-matter, neutral matter and normal matter, wholesome non-organic, triple helix of non-Newtonian/Euclidean, para-casual DNA.

However, such power is not without cost. The Chip requires energy to function, drawing from your metabolism or external sources. Excessive strain can lead to systematic fatigue, requiring downtime for re-calibration and self-repair. Furthermore, while its potential is limitless, it cannot generate new genetic information from nothing—it must observe, analyze, and adapt based on the experiences and threats you encounter.

As long as you continue to push your limits, introduce new strains of RNA or gain enough [DATA] from another source, the chip will continue to evolve, ensuring that no barrier is ever truly final.
objects.title: Draconian Skylight Evolution Chip (Star Rank Hunter)

objects.text:
The Emergency Medical Hologram (EMH) is an advanced holographic physician capable of delivering expert medical care in even the most critical situations. Programmed with the knowledge and expertise of thousands of medical professionals, the EMH is designed to diagnose, treat, and manage a wide range of injuries and illnesses with unparalleled speed and accuracy. As a holographic entity, the EMH is impervious to physical harm and can operate in environments that would be hazardous to human medics.

Paired with a Mobile Med Unit and Holo Emitter, the EMH transforms medical response capabilities. This portable unit is equipped with state-of-the-art medical tools such as dermal regenerators, diagnostic scanners, and compact surgical systems, all designed for rapid deployment in combat zones, disaster sites, and remote areas. 

Together, the EMH and Mobile Med Unit redefine medical care. Soldiers injured on the battlefield can be stabilized and treated within moments. In scenarios involving disease outbreaks or biohazard threats, the EMH can analyze pathogens, develop antidotes, and administer treatments on-site, preventing widespread casualties. 

The EMH’s programming is customizable, allowing adjustments to its personality, medical specializations, and protocols to align with mission-specific needs. Thanks to the integrated power supply, the EMH can remain operational for years, ensuring uninterrupted care. However, despite its advanced capabilities, the EMH is still bound by its programming and may face challenges with unconventional medical or ethical dilemmas.

With the Emergency Medical Hologram and Mobile Med Unit, you have access to the pinnacle of medical technology. From stabilizing wounded personnel in the heat of battle to combating alien pathogens in uncharted territories, this system ensures that expert medical care is always within reach, no matter the challenge.
objects.title: Emergency Medical Hologram (Star Trek)

addons.text:
Your replicator has undergone major changes after combining with the composite technologies of the Tricom.

You are now capable of replicating anything that the Tricorder has previously analyzed, including complex and exotic materials.

You are no longer limited by hardware size constraints when replicating. Through transporter technology, you can materialize anything within a 50-kilometer omnidirectional radius. From extremely small objects to structures as large as your effective range allows.

You are no longer restricted to creating exact copies of preexisting objects. With the assistance of the supercomputer, you can design and create entirely new and customized items.

Finally, anything you replicate and/or create especially living beings and technologies will possess absolute loyalty to their creator. Nothing will act against you or your interests, either directly or indirectly.

Keep in mind that all of these new capabilities still require the necessary energy consumption for each extraordinary creation.
addons.title: Wonderful Replicator

objects.text:
A Portable Replicator is an advanced portable version of the Replicator, often seen used in most Federation starships. However, this device is a portable version of the standard Replicator; not quite handheld, but it has the size of a small fridge and can be moved from location to location quite easily compared to a standard replicator.

As with a standard Replicator, it can produce nearly anything: food, drinks, valuable materials—just about anything is replicable using this device. However, similar to regular Replicators, it struggles with creating complex molecular structures, such as Borg cortical nodes, bio-neural gel packs, and Latinum. Additionally, certain materials, such as tricyanate and polyduranide, require more energy to replicate.

The Portable Replicator features both standard and industrial settings, along with various molecular structures that the Federation has researched; a miniature antimatter reactor powers this Replicator and can also utilise alternative power sources, such as solar energy. Additionally, it includes a port that allows it to draw energy from nearly any available source. If utilised by the right individuals, this device has the potential to transform a society into a post-scarcity civilisation.

The Portable Replicator also has access to any blueprints you may possess, should you possess Technology and Artifice Powers.
objects.title: Portable Replicator (Star Trek)

objects.text:
The Holodeck is a room built with a hologrid, capable of using projectors that manipulate photons and force fields to simulate the illusion of substance. Within the Holodeck, almost any environment, scenario, or character could be generated. A powerful onboard computer manages and renders these simulations, and you can command the system either by voice or through terminals.

The Holodeck is powered by an internal power cell with enough energy to sustain it for centuries. If necessary, the cell includes adaptors compatible with most traditional energy sources for recharging.

Designed for entertainment, training, research, and more, the Holodeck comes preloaded with a suite of basic holoprograms containing the data and parameters for hundreds of environments, scenarios, and characters. As a prototype, it doesn’t contain any advanced technological or high-level scientific holoprograms. You could generate a quiet bar to unwind, replay a grand battle, or reconstruct a crime scene for detailed analysis. 

Despite its versatility, the Holodeck has clear limitations. Lacking a replicator, it can only generate holomatter that exists within the chamber; anything removed dissolves back into energy. The computer also struggles with improvisation. While it can accurately reproduce scenarios when given defined parameters, it has difficulty building coherent narratives from scratch. Likewise, it can emulate people with near-perfect accuracy when supplied with sufficient data, but it cannot create truly self-aware beings or artificial intelligences. 

Your Holodeck includes one additional feature: it can miniaturize into a compact cube for portability. Optionally, you may choose to have the Holodeck come pre-installed in any vehicle or property you own, provided there is sufficient space.
objects.title: Prototype Holodeck (Star Trek)

addons.text:
Your Starfleet personal equipment now includes a Hazard Suit, a full body armored uniform pioneered by Voyager's security "Hazard Teams" due to the abnormally high amount of battles encountered by the crew. This includes features like:

-Personal Transporter Buffer: You can store equipment as phase patterns in a miniature transporter setup on the suit, allowing you to store your weapons and equipment in a kind of technological "hammerspace", to be retrieved at will.

-The Suit Itself: The suit had magnetic boots for zero-g, shock absorption for falls, was fully environmentally sealed (vaccum, temperature, & chemical resistance, with an optional EVA helmet), and had armor metamaterials with repair nanites, allowing for it to take hits and keep going, or repair & reseal itself on the fly. These nanites also worked together with built-in dermal regenerators & anabolic protoplasers to literally put you back together mid-fight. It had mutiphasic wave generators, which while designed as a way to prevent hostile transporter locks, act as a general "Manton Limit enforcer", & also had a universal energy unit that could convert energy sources found in the field into energy usable by your suit and weapons. Newer models also add personal energy shield tech, like that used in the Dominion War.

-The TED: The Tactical Eye Display is available as a HUD both in an eyepiece form or inside of your EVA helmet. It, along with integrated sensors all along the suit, can perform all of the functions of your tricorder, as well as radar, GPS, squadnet & objective displays, targeting systems, NVGs, scopes, & vitals monitors.

The suit also has plenty of room for expansion & features for different mission profiles.
addons.title: Hazard Suit (Star Trek: Elite Force)

objects.text:
You have acquired the most valuable, versatile, and indispensable accessory that every member of the United Federation of Planets and any of its associates have been privileged to possess. However, you, without needing it, are also privileged. Its design and form can take on any that has been revealed or hinted at in the series, or alternatively, you can create a design and form of your own liking.

The first technology is the Combat Badge, which is capable of translating any previously analyzed language and even capable of analyzing and translating a new language in real time if given time to decipher it. The translated language can be output through a speaker or transmitted directly to your brain. It can also act as a communication device for short to long-range, with a maximum omnidirectional range of 500 kilometers. It also includes a single secondary device within its structure that can adhere to any surface to act as a tracker, a communication beacon, or even as a secondary device for private communication.

Its second technology is that of a supercomputer developed by the Federation. Being a computational technology from the 31st century, it is naturally comparable to a supercomputer belonging to a type II civilization on the Kardashev scale. Any extreme task such as deciphering data from the fifth dimension or attempting to resolve negentropy is beyond its information processing capabilities. Its command over the digital world is absolute as long as it is not exceeded by a higher level of technology.

Its third technology is the Tricorder, which is capable of collecting, analyzing, and recording data from any substance, phenomenon, or information. Its 550 zettabyte memory and sensory functions cover all the forms through which the Federation and other races have perceived the universe. Except for anything that exceeds its own sensory capabilities or something it cannot quantify or analyze.

Its fourth technology is teleportation. Unlike others, you do not need a control station to perform teleportation. Instead, your accessory eliminates this particular weakness, allowing you to go to any destination you wish. As long as you know the spatial coordinates, and it can even store reference points in its memory. It has a range of at least 7000 kilometers in an omnidirectional radius. 

The power cell inside it is enough to keep it active for 100 years of continuous use. It can be recharged with any energy source, such as solar energy, radiation, electricity, among others. Due to the limit of its energy source, it can only offer 5 teleportation jumps before entering a rest period of 1 month. If overloaded up to 10 times, the rest period will be 1 year, but beyond that, it will be damaged and can only be used again once the damage has been repaired one way or another.

The interface of the Tricom Badge consists of holographic screens that can be controlled through hand gestures, voice commands, tactile interaction via a holographic keyboard and mouse, and finally, through your thoughts or will. Optionally, you can choose whether this interface is visible or not, and even control who can see it and who cannot.

If you have the Essential option, you can access your own personal reserve of any supernatural power you possess. This can even eliminate the teleportation jump limit as long as you can meet the energy demand.
objects.title: Tricom Insignia (Star Trek)

objects.text:
Here is one of the most advanced technologies from the Star Wars universe—the planetary defense field generator. This device is capable of effectively protecting vast territories from orbital strikes, space debris, and a multitude of other space threats.

Your generator is not tied to a specific model but combines the capabilities of various planetary shields from different manufacturers. It can protect an area within a 300-kilometer radius of the projector or a small moon with a radius of up to 80 kilometers in orbit, as well as other orbital structures. The shield’s power is sufficient to withstand a massive attack by a dozen large ships (such as ISDs) for several hours.

The generator is equipped with a number of additional features. The “friend-or-foe” system allows only friendly objects to pass through the shield. Synchronization with planetary defense systems opens brief gaps for return fire while blocking enemy attacks. The device is also capable of retaining the atmosphere. Furthermore, by reducing the shield’s radius, its strength can be significantly increased at a 1:1 ratio.

However, your shield is not completely invulnerable. It can be penetrated or overpowered by heavy fire or by using the most powerful weapons, such as the Galactic Empire’s siege destroyers and other similar systems. If the shield is breached, the attack can still strike targets under its protection, although its power will be reduced.

The entire complex consists of the shield projector itself (a giant dish), an automated command center, and powerful reactors that power it. The command center and reactors are located deep underground in a protective bunker. If you have ultra-powerful energy sources, they can be used to further strengthen the shield if necessary.
objects.title: Planetary Shield Generator (Star Wars)

addons.text:
Some mad sorcerer has interfered with and completely altered the masterpiece of Dr. Rodney McKay, adding functions far beyond being simply an omniversal transport engine.

With the help of the S.T.A.F.F, it allows the integrated sensors to scan the destination and then teleport to a specific time and place you desire from any part of the omniverse. In the same way, it can work in reverse, granting the ability to summon objects and entities.

Keep in mind that in the grand scheme of the entire omniverse, there exist an infinite number of variants of the same desired target. This increases the time it takes to search for what you want and consumes a large amount of energy. However, if you provide a detailed description of the target, it will take less time and energy by having a more defined and specific frame of reference.

Naturally, all these functions require a great deal of energy, which is why, with the help of the Heart of Continuance, it provides enough energy to perform 10 summons or 10 teleportations per day before requiring a 48-hour recharge.

Keep in mind that due to its SP limit, it cannot instantly summon gods and divine artifacts. For that, you will need to store enough energy over time to match at least that of a supernova to make such desires possible. The more powerful the object or entity you desire, the more energy it will require.
addons.title: Omniverse Summoner

objects.text:
The once unstable experimental Alternate Reality Drive designed by the genius Dr. Rodney McKay is now fixed and can be yours for a new all-time low price. This drive, powered by now-controlled Subspace capacitors requires no fuel and can slowly over the course of a day build up a charge to allow vehicles its equipped to and objects immediately near it to jump to a target (or random, if you so choose) reality in the omniverse. It even includes a built-in sensor that scans neighboring universes and plots a path to your destination while also providing a preview of your exact arrival point in the new reality.

This device can come pre-installed on any applicable vehicles you purchase for free, without the need for the Fusion upgrade. Keep in mind, this device only moves between realities, so you will appear in the same position within your desired reality. Hopefully, you have a hyperdrive, or else you're going to be stuck on Earth. Also, don’t touch any buttons you don’t understand, wouldn't want to get lost now, would you?
objects.title: Alternate Reality Drive (Stargate)

objects.text:
The DNA Resequencer, also known as a Genetic Manipulation Device, is an advanced piece of Ancient technology that can alter the DNA of any species, manipulating and sequencing the genetic code with the power to remove diseases or, as it was used later in projects by the Goa’uld, for super soldiers. 

Using the device you could alter the brain chemistry of a subject allowing for supernatural powers such as telekinesis, telepathy or clairvoyance to list a few examples the Ancients used this device in trying to find a way to artificially speed up the Ascension process although such experiments failed however they were still able to grant supernatural powers and super charge the evolution of the species that the device was used on. 

This specific Genetic Manipulation Device has data from the Milky Way galaxy and Pegasus that the Ancients used in various experiments, including genetic samples of Goa’uld, the Ancients themselves and Wraith, to name a few of the genetic samples included within the device.

With the DNA Resequencer, you could create new life, as did Anubis in his creation of super soldier clones of himself; however, using the DNA Resequencer to create requires more power than manipulating existing genetic samples.
objects.title: DNA Resequencer (Stargate)

objects.text:
"It is the ultimate power source—something that would make Zero Point Modules seem like alkaline batteries in comparison." - Rodney McKay 

The Lanteans attempted to extract zero-point energy from their universe through Project Arcturus. However, their efforts failed due to catastrophic malfunctions that disrupted space-time and caused deadly radiation from exotic particles. Normally, this radiation was contained by a protective field, but when malfunctions occurred, the field could not contain it, and the radiation killed all living things inside the complex and within a wide radius.

Now you can use an improved and safe version of Project Arcturus. This version eliminates malfunctions and is equipped with multiple protective systems that redirect the deadly radiation into another subspace or into the Cosmic Voids of your universe.

The base power of your project is 100% of the original and equals ~24 ZPMs, each operating at full power. This power is inexhaustible and will persist until the end of your universe’s existence, but overall, this is still the power level of an “experimental” prototype that served as a technology demonstrator. The full prospective power—equal to the power of the entire universe—is not yet available to you.

Your Project Arcturus is housed in a well-fortified, multi-level bunker, and it can be easily integrated into any OoP available to you that is large enough to accommodate a small skyscraper.
objects.title: Project Arcturus (Stargate)

objects.text:
The Repository of Knowledge is a device created by the ancients for downloading information directly into the user's mind. It contains the collective knowledge that the Ancients discovered before their ascension, holding a vast amount of information that could overwhelm a typical person if they attempted to download everything in one sitting or if they are less evolved than the Ancients intended for its use.

The Repository of Knowledge also directly alters those who use it, granting them various powers depending on the extent of their mutation. For instance, Jack possesses the ability to heal others, while Daniel has the power of telekinesis after sufficient mutation from the Repository of Knowledge. However, individuals who attempt to download all the knowledge from the Repository and are unable to contain or manage it will find that the vast amount of information can overwhelm them, ultimately leading to their demise as it replaces critical information in the brain over time.

The Repository of Knowledge has several defences, including immunity to point-blank plasma blasts and denying access to anyone with Goa'uld DNA, including Jaffa and individuals who have previously been hosts to a Goa'uld.
objects.title: Repository of Knowledge (Stargate)

objects.text:
A Sarcophagus, a technological device primarily used by the Goa’uld to heal injuries and extend their already impressive lifespan, can bring back to life the recently deceased, so long as they have been dead no longer than a month. Despite the Goa’uld usually stealing and not improving upon most technology, this is one of the few technologies in which the Goa’uld readily improved upon. The Sarcophagus can also be used as a stasis chamber, keeping you young so long as you are within the Sarcophagus. The longest someone was inside with no change was 4,000 years.

A Sarcophagus can heal almost all illnesses and damage done to a body, so long as the brain is more than 50% intact. If there is extensive damage to the brain, then the Sarcophagus is unable to heal or repair the damage, similar to Lord Yu, who, after 5,000 years, had started to decay past the point at which the Sarcophagus was able to rejuvenate. 

Another limitation of the Sarcophagus is that prolonged use can have diminishing returns; however, such limitations will only appear after 700 years of repetitive use with no downtime between uses. Waiting before using a Sarcophagus and not using it to rejuvenate yourself every day will extend the functionality of a Sarcophagus. A downside of the Sarcophagus is that prolonged use can lead to addiction, which can lead to altered behaviour such as arrogance or superiority complexes.
objects.title: Sarcophagus (Stargate)

addons.title: Webway Gates (Warhammer 40k)
addons.text:
In addition to your Stargate Network, you gain access to a Webway gate network, scattered across a million secret worlds. The gates are now arches of varying sizes made of the psychically active Wraithbone. The gates conceal themselves when not activated, and only respond to the psychic command of its users. It is almost impossible for anyone you do not authorize to find, let alone enter your Webway.

Created by the Great Old Ones and mastered by the Eldar, the Webway is not simply a network of portals, it is a created dimension of winding and shifting paths and secret chambers. The Webway is its own dimension, cut off from all other dimensions aside from the gates, and summoning, portalmaking, projection and teleportation into the Webway is impossible unless you allow it. Traversal on foot or ship through the Webway can cross vast distances, whether across a planet or a galaxy, in a shorter time than most forms of FTL. You gain an instinctive knowledge of how to navigate and guide others through the unique paths of the Webway from one gate to another.

objects.text:
Built by the Ancient eras ago, Stargates are one of the most useful and versatile methods of transportation ever created. By dialing the location of another gate in the local gate terminal, a stable wormhole is created between the two, allowing for seamless travel up to a galaxy worth of distance away.

By selecting this, you now can seed your local galaxy with your own network. The gates possess their own power source that can theoretically last for millions of years, and you will receive a database with all their dial adresses and their location in the galaxy. Finding out what is on the other side of each gate is up to you thought.
objects.title: Stargate Network (Stargate)

objects.text:
Feared by its tremendous intellect and processing power, an Alpha Core is an intelligence that far surpasses the human mind.

A little bigger than a basketball, they are truly sapients, able to learn and grow over time. They can compose and come up with wondrous works of art, become masters of countless fields of expertise, and micro-manage an entire city for maximum productivity.

Unlike the Domain who had the fear an AI eventually going rogue, your AI is truly loyal to you. You can also decide their personality, or leave it to chance.
objects.title: Alpha Core (Starsector)

objects.text:
A Coronal Hypershunt is a massive megastructure. Built close to a star, it can partially capture the energy it releases and send this energy to another place in the range of ten light-years: from powering citizens' homes, lighting the solar lamps for their crops to grow, to fueling the massive factories that feed the machine of civilization.

A single Coronal Hypershunt can harness a "mere" thousandth of our own sun's output, enough to power our current global grid for 300 years - in a single second.

To use the collected power, you also receive ten Hypershunt Taps that link to the Coronal Hypershunt via a stable wormhole when turned on. Activating one takes a single hour, and they can't be moved while turned on - doing so will either cause the wormhole to collapse and require reactivation, or an explosion with the force of a nuclear bomb, depending on how much force was used to dislodge it.
objects.title: Coronal Hypershunt (Starsector)

addons.text: Aside from your forge, you now also receive a Gamma-AI core with all the technical and scientific knowledge of Domain of Man on it. A gamma level AI is able to support you in any endeavor, compensating a lack of creativity by sheer computational power. If installed into the forge, it will be able to produce anything for you and optimize the forge to the max. The AI is fully loyal to you, and if you wish, you can upgrade it to an Alpha core with the appropriate materials.
addons.title: Complementary Gamma Core AI

objects.text:
Among the many things that allowed the Domain of Man to project power over human civilization, the Nanoforge was the backbone of their industrial might. A nanoforge allows manufacturing down to the molecular level, producing complex items by the tons in a matter of hours, be it from simple tools used by colonists farmers to the drives used by ships to enter FTL. Yours is exceptional even among others. 

It is in pristine condition, and will remain so by self-repairing. It is also emission free, meaning it won't produce pollution or any other undesirable leftovers. The only thing needed to run a nanoforge is power, the materials to feed it, and the blueprints of the desired product. While the nanoforge can reduce itself to the size of a small car in a hour when inactive, when active they occupy the space of a large house, so keep that in mind when deploying it.
objects.title: Pristine Nanoforge (Starsector)

objects.text:
The blood that make the Domain of Man run, antimatter is a potent Energy source, able to power both settlements and their industries, and to propel starships across space and beyond. In your hands is a Synchrotron Core, the greatest antimatter refiner.

On its own, it can fabricate a bottle that hold magnetically one gram of antimatter per month, which has the potential to release over enough energy to run New York for a week. You just need to hook one at a energy grid and it will release energy as needed. You can also use as a bomb, thought I would recommend to be far away from it: it has the equivalent energy of a Fat Man atomic bomb.

You can choose to deploy your Core so it becomes a factory the size of a small warehouse. It can still produce a bottle of antimatter per month on its own, but if you feed it enough materials, it can produce up to a thousand bottles per month.
objects.title: Synchrotron Core (Starsector)

objects.text:
The facility in which Gems are made via machines that are called Injectors, modelled after bacteriophages; Injectors infuse the ground with the essence required for Gems to be made, draining the nutrients and lifeforce of a surrounding area. You are now in possession of a plot of land filled with several injectors and two peridots who run this Kindergarten, making sure that everything runs properly and repairing any damaged Injectors. 

This Kindergarten can produce just about any Gem short of a Diamond; Materials in the surrounding can change the properties and how strong a Gem that is created will be, such as iron deposits affecting the hair shape or other materials affecting how perfect a Gem will come out. If the land surrounding the Injectors is bad, then deformities can be acquired, and Gems can be undercooked, becoming worse in the process. 

As the Injectors are the most advanced model currently available to the Gem Empire, the Gems will take roughly a week to fully form, depending on what Gem you are trying to create; some taking longer, something on the level of a Jasper will take the full week, while something like a Ruby will take less time. Gems made through this process are fully loyal to you as they would be to a Diamond; they consider you to be their Diamond, even if you are an organic human. 

Should your new plot of land be depleted of all resources, then your Injectors can be moved to a new location by the peridots in your possession; the injectors will periodically be restocked with the materials needed to create new Gems. Given around a weeks time your plot of land will be completely rejuvenated and will be able to begin the process of creating more Gems.
objects.title: Kindergarten (Steven Universe)

objects.text:
This is a fragment of the metal scroll, a Clarke tech like device that helped propel humanity to conquer the galaxy. This device, which is in the shape of a small comm device, is geared towards making mechs. This is the main way to earn design points, although there are other ways to earn them. Nothing is impossible with enough design points, even immortality, although earning enough to achieve that is another story.

 You gain both the aptitude for spirituality that Ves Larkinson had, and you gain an A level aptitude for mech piloting. You have the potential to become both a god level pilot and a star level designer. You gain the basic knowledge on how to make a mech simulator, and how to make the very basic assembly and production machines for mech design.
objects.title: Metal Scroll Fragment (The Mech Touch)

addons.text: Your orbment merges with your smartphone, or maybe the reverse happens. In any case, you now have a device that can both take selfies and throw fireballs. It also comes with a cute phone charm.
addons.title: Magic Smartphone

addons.text: Your personal orbment merges with the Elenium Type 95 and gains the features of both, you can slot quartz that can amplify spells, upgrade your master quartz to increase the number of cores, even cast orbal arts without the required quartz, and so on. If you have the <u>Magic Smartphone</u> upgrade, you can also leverage the processing power of the phone's processor to assist with some tasks.
addons.title: Elenium Orbment

objects.text: Orbments are devices that use orbal energy to produce a wide variety of effects depending on their structure and the type of quartz installed. Tactical Orbments are personal devices, which often look like pocket watches or similar devices, that allows their users to cast orbal arts using the quartz slotted inside. You come into possession a high quality tactical orbments with space for one master quartz and 8 standard quartz, tailored to be compatible with you. In addition to the device itself, you gain a pool of energy that allows you to cast orbal arts, as well as one master quartz and five basic elemental quartz. You also gain knowledge on how to create more quart from Septium (which can be substituted by mundane crystals infused with orbal energy) and the skills to maintain and build more orbments. For convenience, the orbment and its accessories are shipped in a small protective case. If you have other crystal-based powers, such as Jewel Magic or Virtue Gems, your orbment can work with them as well.
objects.title: Tactical Orbment (Trails Series)

objects.text:
The Farnsworth is a two-way audio and video communication device invented by Philo Farnsworth in 1929, shortly after the creation of the television. This artifact operates on a highly secure frequency spectrum that cannot be intercepted, hacked, or breached in any way.

When a transmission is received, the user is alerted by a preceding buzzing sound; to initiate communication, the device is opened like a book and the button located on the right, just below the red lamp, is pressed, while a second press of the same button ends the transmission. Although the exact mechanism behind how the transmissions work is still unknown, it is presumed that they rely on radio waves, given the era in which the device was developed, coinciding with the first advances in television technology.

What has been definitively confirmed is that the Farnsworths are designed to operate anywhere on Earth; from deep underground to even in alternate dimensions.
objects.title: The Farnsworth (Warehouse 13)

addons.text: You are now capable of forming a remote link with the Somatic Link, allowing you to walk away from it without losing access to any of its benefits, as well as being able to instantaneously teleport back to it.
addons.title: Void Link
Transference Chamber
addons.text: To take full advantage of your intimate connection to the void, you’ve been given access to the Transference Chamber. Backed up by the ship’s state of the art circuits, your transference link is near inviolable, and far stronger than it would otherwise be, allowing you an unparalleled level of multitasking with your linked connections.

objects.text:
You have a chair that is capable of being connected to any technology. 

When sitting in this chair you have a mind-machine link between you and anything it is hooked up to, being capable of controlling and understanding its senses with the same intuitive ease as moving your own body. 

The chair also acts as a good place to meditate, allowing you to more easily push away the sensations of your own body to better become in tune with your own mind and/or powers.
objects.title: Somatic Link (Warframe)

addons.text:
You can now activate the Resurrection Orb to restore your OoP(s) without the need for line of sight and regardless of distance.

In addition, there is no longer any dependence on the “radius,” as your OoP will be fully restored even if it is larger and does not fit within the 150-meter radius.

It will also work fully and effectively with all OoPs, even if they are magical or organic.

If you purchase both Warranty and Essential, you will receive 3 charges for activation. In addition, your OoP will become a resonance point for activating the “restoration effect” for friendly objects or items that you may wish to restore. The radius will be the same, 150 meters.

OoP consisting of a separate set of smaller parts can be considered as one OoP.
addons.title: The Orb of Eternity

objects.text:
Now you have at your disposal the Resurrection Orb, the fruit of the Necron race's advanced technology and scientific achievements, usually available only to their leaders and high lords.

This sphere, measuring 15 to 20 cm in diameter, is made of dark, shiny metal. It can be decorated with precious stones and metals at your discretion. When activated, the sphere may glow with a faint green light, although its color is determined solely by your choice.

The main advantage of the Resurrection Orb is its ability to instantly restore and repair damaged objects and items following your mental command and activating gesture. It is capable of restoring even those items that have been completely destroyed and turned into atomic dust, thanks to its temporal and thermonuclear manipulations at the molecular and atomic levels. Upon activation, the sphere emits a lightning-shaped energy beam that strikes the target or its surroundings, covering them with a network of lightning bolts and restoring objects as if time were rewinding or individual fragments were being reassembled.

You can select any point within your field of view to determine the location of the restoration effect, with a radius of 150 meters. All material and technological objects within this radius will be restored according to your wishes. Large objects will also be restored within this radius.

However, you only have one charge to activate, which regenerates within 24 hours after use.

The Resurrection Orb does not work with magical objects, and its interaction with organic matter is limited. Nevertheless, it is capable of reviving recently deceased creatures, even if they have been completely vaporized.
objects.title: Resurrection Orb (Warhammer: 40k)

objects.text:
You have acquired the Sangprimus Portum, an ancient artefact that predates the Imperium itself, containing the genetic material collected from all the primarchs used in the creation of the Space Marine Legions. The samples stored within the Sangprimus Portum are genetically pure beyond contamination, perhaps even purer than the Gene-Seed that could be contained from the current Prumarchs themselves and certainly purer than any existing Space Marine. 

The Gene-Seed is receptive to any modifications and improvements you could make. You could use them to create an evolution to the existing Adeptus Astartes on the level of the Primaris Marines, should you have the technological know-how. Should you be particularly inclined, and with enough time, you could even clone the Primarchs using the Gene-Seed acquired in the Sangprimus Portum. However, even Fabious Bile required multiple attempts at creating a successful clone of a Primarch, and the Emperor experienced failure on his first attempt at making a Primarch, the Angel being an example of a failed attempt. 

The Sangprimus Portum will restock with new Gene-Seed every year, should you require more genetic material. The Sangprimus Portum also has the necessary resources beyond just the Gene-Seed required to create viable Space Marines.
objects.title: Sangprimus Portum (Warhammer: 40K)

addons.text:
You can now channel your power through your throne, elevating it to heights previously deemed unattainable. All functions of your manifested vehicles are now 500% stronger than they should be. Your heavy bolter, which was intended to serve merely as a distraction, can now pierce the armor plating of God-Engines. Your armor plating can now withstand the full barrage of a void ship without as much as a scratch. Additionally, your speed can match the swiftest of vehicles the Imperium can field.

Your Throne Energy Gathering Array powers your Knight frames and other vehicles, providing them with unlimited fuel and ammunition.
addons.title: Psykana Titanica (Warhammer: 40k)

addons.text: Your Triple Void Shield Array and weapons are now infused with your Blank aura, transforming you into a Daemon's Bane. The shield array now nullifies any powers directed against it, absorbing the energy of attacks to further empower itself. Additionally, your weapons can now pierce through supernatural defenses effortlessly, like a Hot-Shot Lasgun through flesh.
addons.title: Null Aegis (Warhammer: 40k)

addons.text:
The database in your Throne Mechanicum has been expanded to include the God-Engines and all other imperial vehicles used throughout the history of the Imperium. This extensive collection features everything from the classic Leman Russ tank to the Baneblade and the Imperator-class Titan.

Furthermore, your Throne’s Machine Spirit can now summon support vehicles to aid you, providing additional firepower or assisting in flanking enemies similar to how Armigers typically support Knights.
addons.title: Collegia Titanica (Warhammer: 40k)

addons.text:
The database in your Throne Mechanicum now includes all Battlesuits and vehicles used by the T’au Empire throughout its history, from the basic Stealth Suit to the advanced Riptide Battlesuit and the massive Manta super-heavy dropship.

Furthermore, your Throne’s Machine Spirit can now summon support drones and vehicles to aid you, providing additional firepower or assisting in spotting enemies like the markerlight drones typically does to support their Crysis battlesuits.
addons.title: Battlesuits Cadre (Warhammer: 40k)

addons.text: The database in your Throne Mechanicum has been expanded to include all of the vehicles piloted in the long history of the Aeldari people, from the swift Wave Serpent to the powerful and elegant Wraithknight.
addons.title: Armoured Warhost (Warhammer: 40k)

objects.text:
You now possess a Throne Mechanicum created during the peak of Humanity’s Golden Age. This extraordinary device grants myriad abilities not found in any other Throne, allowing your Questor Imperialis to rival even the God-Engine of the Imperium of Man. Upon first sitting upon it, the Machine Spirit establishes a sacred link with you, ensuring its loyalty and granting access to all the knowledge it holds.

The database contains all the possible Frames of Questor Imperialis that the Imperium has fielded throughout its history. This includes everything from the simple yet maneuverable Armiger to the formidable Cerastus Knight Lancer, Knight Castellan, and Knight Styrix. Whatever frame you need, your Machine Spirit has it. Additionally, it allows you to create frames around your Throne, enabling you to switch between them on the fly. You can also simply change the knight's weaponry instead of its entire frame.

Your Throne features an ideal mind-to-machine interface that enables you to maneuver your Questor Imperialis as if it were an extension of your own body. This advanced connection eliminates the typical delays and glitches associated with such interfaces. It also provides you with complete awareness of your Knight and the surrounding battlefield, leaving no blind spots for the enemy to exploit. You can collaborate with your Machine Spirit to create new frames or enhance existing ones. Additionally, your Throne’s Machine Spirit manages all secondary functions of your manifested frame, allowing you to focus solely on piloting it.

When seated upon the Throne, you are enveloped by a Triple Void Shield Array that completely surrounds you. This form of protection is reminiscent of ancient Imperial grand cruisers from the Great Crusade era, providing a level of defense comparable to that of Imperium battleships, all within the compact design of your Throne Mechanicum. Furthermore, you need not worry about the energy demands typically associated with such an array, as your throne draws the necessary power directly from the Sea of Souls.

A Throne Mechanicum is more than just a tool for piloting mighty machines of war; it is, above all, a symbol of your status as a scion of a noble house. As such, it includes several built-in quality-of-life features. These range from an anti-grav hover mode and supremely comfortable cushioning to a full-body massage function and cup holders. In short, it has every quality-of-life enhancement you can imagine, it can also adjust its size to fit your stature.
objects.title: Throne Mechanicum (Warhammer: 40k)

objects.text:
You gain a Black Trigger of your choice. (Either one that was seen in the series or an original creation.)

The trigger will create a high quality Trion Gland in the user upon first use.
objects.title: Black Trigger (World Trigger)

objects.text:
You gain a briefcase which contains a standard B-rank Border Agency Triggers, a full complement of modules, and a Bail Out anchor beacon. The trigger can equip up to eight modules, four in each hand.

When first used, the trigger will create a Trion Gland of average strength in the user.
objects.title: Border Trigger (World Trigger)

objects.text:
You gain a trigger manufactured by one of the Neighbor nations. This includes the Horn Triggers of Aftokrator. (Either one that was seen in the series or an original creation.)

When first used, the trigger will create a Trion Gland of average strength in the user. Horn Triggers also grow a pair of Trion gathering horns on their user.
objects.title: Neighbor Trigger (World Trigger)
The Terminal (Wuthering Waves)
objects.text:
You possess the Terminal, the signature Resonator interface device of Solaris-3 from Wuthering Waves, restored to its theoretical peak and bound exclusively to you as its sole Administrator. You currently have the Pangu Terminal. This gourd-shaped artifact of chrome and gold etched with concentric wave patterns and a loong motif functions as a sovereign capture, archive, and replication system built upon advanced frequency science. It does not require native Resonance Energy and instead adapts seamlessly to your own power source. Your Terminal includes every Terminal function ever developed on Solaris-3, whether currently known or yet to be revealed, with unrestricted Administrator access.

At its core lies a perfected Data Bank containing the complete database of every Echo recorded on Solaris-3, from minor entities to Elite, Overlord, and Calamity-class threats. Each is preserved as a stable frequency construct. You may summon these Echoes as autonomous projections, manifest their signature abilities as directed techniques, or temporarily integrate their traits to replicate their combat functions. All stored constructs are fully subordinate to your authority.

The Terminal expands through acquisition. Any defeated entity leaving a recoverable imprint—energetic, spiritual, conceptual, projected, or otherwise—can be recorded and converted into a deployable Echo. Avatars, summons, shard projections, and similar manifestations may be captured if they produce such a trace. Once archived, they are normalized into stable, controllable forms.

Beyond collection, the Terminal supports refinement and creation. Echo data may be merged, optimized, or synthesized into hybrid constructs that combine or exceed their source capabilities. Tacetite and other resonant substrates can be manufactured artificially, allowing full functionality even in worlds where such materials do not naturally exist. New Echo variants may be engineered from analyzed phenomena, creating assets tailored to specific threats or environments.

Integrated systems enhance both survival and battlefield control. The Terminal provides adaptive mapping, navigation, and communications, synchronizing with compatible infrastructure where available or constructing its own through scanning and exploration. It can analyze environmental frequencies, detect concealed entities or distortions, track specific energy signatures across wide areas, provide resonance-based levitation and grapple projection, and contains a portable synthesis engine capable of fabricating enhancement modules, resonance weapons, and stabilization compounds on demand. All functions scale as the Data Bank grows.

As stronger entities are recorded, capture stability improves, hybridization becomes more intricate, and the number and potency of simultaneously deployed Echoes increases. Echo traits may be layered as modular augmentations for sustained integration. The Terminal continuously refines its models, increasing efficiency and projection fidelity over time.

This version is not restricted to Solaris-3. In any world where beings, constructs, or phenomena operate through recoverable patterns or residual signatures, the Terminal can analyze and incorporate them. If compatible materials are absent, it generates the necessary resonance framework independently. The device cannot be hacked, copied, corrupted, or accessed without your consent. Its Archive remains permanently keyed to you.

The Terminal turns every defeated threat into lasting power. What you overcome does not fade—it is recorded, refined, and made yours.

Note: If you do not like the Pangu Terminal, you may instead choose any Terminal seen throughout Wuthering Waves.

One of the many wonders used by the masters of baryonic matter against the Photino Birds, XCM or Xeelee Construction Material is an exotic fermion based equivalent of the Bose-Einstein condensate created by locally nullifying the Pauli-exclusion principle. In layman's term, its effectively unbreakable and chemically inert. Objects built by XCM could swim in the cores of neutron stars and even survive energy densities comparable to the very first moments after the big bang without any form of damage. 

XCM's growth process is unique in that it perfectly converts various forms of energy into its own material, which emerges like petals from 'flowers' when exposed to radiant energy. This quality makes it easy to cultivate and enables the creation of massive structures. For example, the Xeelee used a Xeelee Flower to harness energy from an accretion disk of a super-massive black hole to rapidly construct a thirty million light-year-long ringworld. This showcases the seemingly limitless growth potential of XCM, as it can continue expanding indefinitely as long as it receives sufficient energy.

However, such mega-structures are beyond your capabilities currently. While you might be limited to a single pre-programmable Xeelee Flower the size of an average human fist, its potential applications are limitless.
objects.title: XCM (Xeelee Sequence)

objects.text:
The Elenium Type 95 Operation Orb, the greatest wonder that the Empire ever produce, has been intricately linked to your very soul, granting you a sizeable mana pool, and the instinctual knowledge to create magic formulas and cast spells. Unlike its predecessors, this orb harnesses four cores instead of one, exponentially increasing it's potency, and allowing you to simultaneously run and cast 4 spells at once. Revered as a divine creation, this experimental orb is derived from technology a millennium ahead from when it was made, a true miraculous wonder of it's age. Unlike the original Type 95, this orb spares you from the burden of mental corruption. 

Additionally, You are able to craft magitech as advance as the Type 95 without the need for divine intervention, though it won't be an easy task, and would require months, or even years of effort.
objects.title: Elenium Type 95 (Youjo Senki)

objects.text:
The Akashic Engine is a continuous power source capable of unlimited energy production, albeit the output depends on how much you can extract, once a certain amount of the desired energy is gathered. It was created by a Advanced Technological Earth after a Magical Demon Empire breached the dimensions and invaded Earth. The engine contains the prototypes of all Demon-Heart Series powers, but only about 1/12 of they strength and no personality/mind.

Similar to all Demon-Heart Series, yours also have a backup containing all knowledge of Earth, but the blueprints of the others DHs are corrupted. It is still possible to reverse-engineer them from your Demon-Heart, but it will be challenging without the necessary know-how.

Alongside the Engine, you also gain the Manual of Operations, which, among other things, contain the knowhow of how to upload your mind/soul to the Core and become a Demon-Heart yourself.
objects.title: Akashic Engine - 00 (Yuusha, Yamemasu)

rows.title: Technological Objects of Power
rows.titleText: Note: All non-consumable Objects of Powers can be transferred to another person. When this happens, you do not lose any abilities the object unlocked or awakened (physical alterations, magic independent of the object, etc.) but any soul bonds transferred to the new owner.

addons.text:
With the introduction of the Hercules Method, the limitations of your Armstrong Serum enhanced body have been entirely removed, along with its power increased exponentially. You are now able to retain your original form with some slight cybernetic flair, similar to those who live in Cyberpunk 2077 or Shadowrun. You are now able to further strengthen your body through practicing the Hercules Method, treating your cybernetic form as though it were still flesh and blood. While this does open the door to further empowering your body greatly, you will need to learn increasingly advanced mechanical knowledge to pair with the knowledge of the human body to grow stronger.

You can now fully digest anything you consume, converting it into energy with no net loss of energy. In addition, the efficiency of your body is increased exponentially, such that your stamina is nearly endless, with you able to function at your best for weeks at a time with no food or sleep, and will only improve further with time and effort, training yourself further. Also, you can now regain energy slowly while resting, thanks to the Hercules Method, allowing you to ignore the need for sustenance. Though be aware this ability is reliant on your level of skill in using the Hercules Method.

Your mind is now encoded within the nanites that make up your body, allowing you to survive and function with your head destroyed. This also applies to every other critical organ within your body, as you can offload important bodily functions to your nanomachines as needed.
addons.title: Armstrong Method

addons.text:
You are the living embodiment of strength through will — a man remade into an unstoppable force of nature. Your body has been reforged with an experimental fusion of the Armstrong Serum and bleeding-edge Super Soldier augmentation, turning flesh and bone into a fortress of adaptive living metal.

Standing seven feet tall and built like a siege engine, every muscle is threaded with carbon nanotubes and fueled by regenerative nanomachines. Bullets flatten against your skin. Blades snap against your bones. High-caliber artillery and fuel-air explosives leave you standing in the smoke, grinning. Pain is meaningless — injuries seal in seconds as your nanomachines repair and reinforce on the fly.

Your strength is monstrous: fists that can crumple tank armor like paper, strikes that send armored vehicles cartwheeling through the air, and throws that hurl multi-ton mechs like they’re trash cans. You can shatter reinforced concrete with a single step, tear steel beams apart barehanded, and drive your enemies into the ground with seismic force.

Despite your massive frame, your speed borders on the inhuman — you can cross a battlefield faster than gun turrets can track, launch into skyscraper-high leaps, and catch opponents mid-strike before they realize you’ve moved.

Your presence is overwhelming: part warlord, part force of nature. You fight with the raw confidence of someone who knows they cannot be stopped, and you impose that certainty on everyone who dares stand in your way.

You are not just a super soldier. You are the future of war — the unbreakable fist that will smash the old order, and the titan who will rebuild the world in fire and steel.
addons.title: The Armstrong

addons.text:
The boundary between flesh, steel, and code has vanished. You are no longer a mere cyborg or nanomachine-enhanced being, you are a living technological organism, evolving seamlessly with every heartbeat and processing cycle.

Your body trains and grows as efficiently as the finest organic athlete, shedding all previous limitations like forced shutdowns or slow upgrades. Muscle fibers of carbon and titanium strengthen with exertion, processors optimize through repeated use, and sensory arrays refine with every scan, all without outside assistance.

Small pieces of technology can be fully absorbed into your body, their raw capabilities instantly accessible, though mastery requires training. Larger machines, such as vehicles or computer mainframes, can be partially merged with, allowing you to control and analyze them as natural extensions of yourself, your thoughts become their commands, and their data your perception.

Your Type Indigo technomancy has blossomed into instinctual unity with technology. Whether manipulating a simple door lock or interfacing with a warship’s AI core, your mind merges at a fundamental level with circuitry. Unlike mere operators, you are the system you link to.

Your hybrid nature grants robust defences against biological plagues, computer viruses, psychic possession, and hacking, each met with the combined strength of flesh and machine.

You are an adaptive, self-upgrading entity. 

Whether lifting collapsed starship hulls, processing alien data streams in real time, or projecting hardlight constructs from absorbed emitters. There is no finish line; your evolution is continuous, fueled by will, work, and innovation.
addons.title: Transhuman Evolution

objects.text: This Syringe holds nanomachines that re-write your biology. In particular, it turns the organic matter in your cells and the like into silicon, wires, and other robotic aspects. Thankfully for you, within humanoid limits, if you focus on your desired appearance after injection, you can become that, with the downside of some mechanical visage. You have about 3 of these shots total before you run out. After injection, you will find your strength and speed heightened immediately. At base strength, you will be able to tilt a Tank upside down with high effort, and able to run 160 km/h for almost 25 minutes continually before needing to rest your servos. Your sensors are fairly advanced, having low-level heat and Infared vision, although these also take up energy. And finally, your precision and manipulation have the finesse worthy of a machine. However, these come with decent drawbacks. You are not able to train your own body as efficiently as an organic one. Powers can still be trained, but one hour workout for you would be like a 10-minute workout for a normal human being. As well, if you exhaust yourself to a certain point, you will shut down for 12 hours to recharge. Finally, your technology is limited unless upgraded by others, though thankfully you can give them a blueprint if given a few minutes to print it out of your mouth.
objects.title: Armstrong Serum

objects.text:
You receive a bag containing 10 flower seeds. They seem like normal seeds but the secret is what they're capable of once they're planted. These seeds are highly receptive to ambient energies and will actively draw from them to grow.

Once a flower is fully matured, it can be used to make a palatable infusion you will find enjoyable regardless of your tastes that when consumed will grant you a permanent pool of the absorbed energy.

Some examples would include planting it in a mana rich soil to gain magic, near a martial arts temple to gain Chi or even in regular dirt and letting someone else channel the energy towards it. Incompatible energies like magic and antimagic can be fully integrated into someone who has consumed one infusion grown from each.

However potent the source of energy the flower will always bloom exactly 30 days after being planted. However the effects vary according to the strength of the source that was around and the time it was planted for after the stabdard 30 days. For example a flower grown from regular soil in a magic land will give reserves much lower to those given by one planted in a Ley Line intersection, unless it's planted for a significantly longer period of time. Said reserves can however be later increased by other powers or OoPs. If you want to increase them with another tea, it'll have to be one with more energy than the last one, which will need more time or better soil. While the plants won't need watering or sun, they are still fragile and can die if crushed or burned. Not to mention stolen by another.

You don't need to worry about running out of seeds, all you need to do is plant one of them in regular soil with no esoteric energies around and it will grow in just 15 days to become a regular flower with no other effect than giving you 3-5 new seeds and a delicious mundane tea.
objects.title: Attunement Tea Seeds

objects.text:
An iridescent glass vial with an azure and gold cap, no larger than a medication bottle. Inside, what appears to be liquid cloud twists, forms, and dissipates every few moments.

You have obtained the condensed essence of the Stratos Basin, a world where life and power were found within the clouds. Sapience, science, strength, souls, good and evil, right and wrong, all were found within the skies of that world, and now their essence has been condensed into this empowering vial.

Upon consuming the Drop, you feel completely weightless as you rise from the ground and your mind is transported to the Stratos Basin. Your body undergoes a permanent enhancement, raising you to a low end superhuman level. You become at least twice as capable in every physical category as a human in peak condition.

Flight now comes as naturally to you as breathing through a field that extends roughly one inch from your body. At your base speed, you can fly as fast as an average airliner, but the higher you ascend into the sky, the faster you become.

Your third power is an internal energy well that allows you to generate blue, sky-based energy in the form of clouds. This energy is best suited for creating defensive constructs, but when necessary, you can fire bolts powerful enough to bring down small buildings. You can also imbue your blasts with the essence of the sky, causing anything hit to become weightless and easy to be blown away for a time.

The clouds and sky feel like a second home to you, and you possess a powerful affinity for both. The higher you climb and the longer you remain among the clouds, the faster your energy well replenishes, the stronger you become, and the greater your flight speed grows.

You also gain an intuitive understanding of aeronautics. Subjects associated with flight, aircraft, atmospheric science, and related fields come far more easily to you.

Be warned, however: remaining at high altitude for too long will begin to overcharge your abilities and affect your state of mind. Your head will quite literally be in the clouds. You will not become insane or completely lose control of yourself, but you may become increasingly detached, distracted, and cloud-minded.

Returning to the ground will stop the overcharging, but doing so causes a reversed form of airsickness, making you temporarily uncomfortable or disoriented while standing on solid ground. With enough training and control over your new abilities, both the overcharging and its side effects can be managed. You could even learn to extend your flight field to let other things and people to fly besides you without having to hold them.

Just take a Drop, and everything will be a breeze from here...
objects.title: A Drop of Cumulus Nine

objects.text:
You have a vial with an airborne strain of the Beast Plague. When released, it infects any and all organic life, from animals to humans, transforming them into horrifying Beasts.

The transformation into a Beast increases all physical capabilities of the infected at least several times compared to their normal state and grants a potent healing factor, which, along with added mutations like claws and fangs, makes them a living weapon capable of decimating platoons of trained soldiers on their own.

The transformation can be influenced by the surroundings of the infected, such that those who transformed while in a toxic and poisonous landscape could obtain the ability to spit acid, or those who transformed near a volcano or a lake of lava could find themselves resistant to high temperatures and capable of vomiting up lava and flammable liquids. The strain is also very adaptable, even capable of infecting and transforming dead bodies when there are no living beings to infect.

The strain has been calibrated with your genetics and soul in mind, ensuring that you are not only completely immune to it but can also command the beasts to do your bidding and even control or halt the strain's spread. Although the Beasts rarely come out very intelligent, as such, you will be limited to simple commands most of the time.
objects.title: Beast Plague Strain

addons.text:
In addition to your three Blessed Blunts, you will also receive three SCP-420-J blunts, they too will replenish each week.

SCP-420-J is The Best ████ in the World. It was made by processing really strong stuff from Jamaica, with lotsa blue and red mixed in it, through SCP-914 on the Very Fine setting. The paper used to roll these blunts is non-anomalous in nature.

The high from smoking these blunts can chill out even the most violent of beings, rendering them mellow. It also ignores conventional logic, getting beings that shouldn't be affected by smoking weed high.
addons.title: SCP 420-J

objects.text:
These Blessed Blunts are made with marijuana planted on consecrated grounds, doused with holy water, and grown under divine light. Once the weed was rolled into blunts, they were blessed by the Pope themselves, infusing them with holy power.

The high from smoking these blunts imbues you with divine protection. This protection repels and cleanses your body, mind and spirit from more insidious effects. It is especially effective against those of a demonic nature. It also has a weak rejuvenating effect. This mostly just soothes aches and pains, but it does mean you won't get lung cancer from smoking them.

You receive three Blessed Blunts, they will replenish each week.
objects.title: Blessed Blunts

objects.text:
You are given a box containing twenty sticks of Clearheart Incense. When lit, each stick releases a calming, soothing scent that makes it easier for anyone nearby to focus while reducing the effects of negative mental conditions. A single stick is guaranteed to burn for two hours before being used up.

The scent varies from person to person, taking on whatever aroma they would find most calming. Meditating or sleeping near burning Clearheart Incense will also be noticeably more effective.

The box completely refills with twenty new incense sticks once per month.
objects.title: Clearheart Incense

addons.text:
The fusion of the Golden Elixir and the Demon Core of Radiant Wails births a paradoxical marvel—an abomination of harmony and annihilation, the ultimate artificial weapon: the Nuclear Heart Sutra. The serene refinement of a golden core, meant to perfect the self through balanced cycling of Essence, Qi, and Spirit, now intertwines with the alien, soul-warping force of Radiance. The result is a core that no longer merely circulates power—it splits and detonates it, again and again, in an endless chain of destruction and rebirth.

Your core has become a self-contained reactor. Like a fission system without limit, it constantly tears itself apart and reforges anew, each cycle unleashing a devastating surge of Radiation Qi. Your body, already enhanced by the Elixir, becomes a vessel forged to endure and weaponize the torment of internal detonation. This saturation grants near-unlimited Radiation Qi, able to fuel techniques so volatile they echo the fury of history’s most destructive weapons.

At your peak, you can release all your energy in an ultimate explosion—an attack on par with the Tsar Bomba. But unlike its mundane counterpart, your blast doesn’t merely destroy matter; it unravels the soul and Qi itself. Everything within its radius—living or not—is scorched not just in body, but in being. The lingering radiation poisons the cycle of reincarnation, twisting souls beyond recognition and making even death a corrupted end. 

However, the volatile fusion of artificial systems makes initial control laughably poor. At the beginning, your weakest output is equivalent to the original Demon Core’s critical incident—about 21 kilotons of raw explosive energy per burst, though with far more spiritual toxicity. You are incapable of suppressing this baseline strength without more control. Every punch, every breath, every stray discharge of Qi threatens to irradiate and rupture your surroundings. Until you learn to harness and refine this terrible power, simply existing in close proximity to others is dangerous. Anything you touch—stone, metal, skin—becomes saturated with spiritual radiation in moments, equivalent to the exposure of ground zero during a nuclear blast.
addons.title: Nuclear Heart Sutra

objects.text:
Once a weapon of war in a lifeless world—a plutonium sphere born of mortal science that killed with invisible fire—it crossed into this realm and became something far worse: a magnet for anguished souls and blind ambition. Cultivators, unaware of its true nature, sought its power and perished, their spirits fueling the storm within. A demonic cultivator, Jin Mohe, managed to refine and ingest the sphere, but as it tore him apart, he realized his folly. In his final moments, he fused with the Core, becoming a living seal. Now, the Demon Core of Radiant Wails is in your hands.

When consumed, the Core unravels within the body, releasing Radiance—a foreign, invisible essence that both harms and transforms. It seeps through flesh, blood, and soul, igniting pain, fevered visions, and rapid, often disorienting cultivation. The process is intense and destabilizing, especially for those without prior cultivation, but not fatal. Even untrained users are guaranteed to begin generating Radiation Qi, though they must endure a period of searing adaptation as their bodies and spirits realign to this alien force.

For established cultivators—especially those aligned with Yin, death, or forbidden Daos—the process is smoother, even euphoric, as their spiritual systems more readily absorb the Radiance. In time, the user manifests Radiation Qi, a unique and potent energy foreign to this world. This Qi grants access to rare techniques: soul-rotting pulses, invisible waves of decay, shielding auras that disrupt detection, and a passive presence that weakens or poisons nearby enemies.
objects.title: Demon Core of Radiant Wails

addons.text:
Your vial of Dragon's Blood has undergone an extraordinary metamorphosis upon merging with the Golden Elixir. Rather than simply fusing, the blood had refined itself using the absorbed essence of the elixir, condensing down to a single, peerless drop of True Dragon blood—an essence so pure and potent that it defies mortal comprehension.

This lone drop hums with unfathomable power, its very presence exuding an aura of majesty and dread. Whether it radiates the brilliance of divine authority or the abyssal might of demonic sovereignty depends entirely on the lineage of the ancient dragon from which the original blood was taken. Regardless of its origins, its potency is undeniable—merely consuming it elevates you to the realm of a demi-god, granting you the unfathomable strength of a perfect golden core cultivator even with a freshly formed golden core.

More importantly, the purity of this draconic essence shatters the artificial limits once imposed by the Golden Elixir, allowing your cultivation to soar unfettered beyond what was once possible.

Upon drinking this drop, your mortal shell is remolded by its overwhelming essence, shifting your very race toward that of a True Dragon. No longer bound by human limitations—as your form becomes malleable, allowing you to manifest draconic traits at will. Yet, your prior abilities are not lost; instead, they are refined and infused with the primordial essence of a dragon, transforming them into something far more profound and devastating.

As your newly-formed dragon core—or dragon heart—intertwines with your golden core, they establish a mutual feedback loop, harmonizing mana, prana, and qi in a ceaseless cycle of refinement. This synergy accelerates your breakthrough to the next stage beyond golden core with effortless ease, even without actively cultivating.

However, while this passive refinement will rapidly propel you through the early stages, it is not without limitations. Though your dantian will be filled at an astonishing pace, true enlightenment—the key to higher realms—must still be sought through dedicated meditation and cultivation. The feedback loop provides an unparalleled foundation, but it is merely a stepping stone toward true ascension.

Furthermore, all the powers you would have originally gained from the vial of Dragon's Blood are vastly enhanced, their potency amplified by a factor of 2.5. Beyond mere augmentation, this transformation grants you a unique, bloodline-dependent ability—an ancestral gift tied to the dragon from which this essence was derived. For example, they may range from dominion over gravity, absolute control over the mind, a poison so virulent it devours both body and soul or even an all-consuming flame capable of reducing all creation to ash, etc.

However, such power is not without its trials—until your body fully harmonizes with the draconic essence within you, this newfound ability will remain in its infancy, requiring tempering and refinement before it can truly manifest its boundless might.
addons.title: Undiluted Ancestral Bloodline

addons.text:
Instead of receiving a vial filled with the blood of another true dragon, you now possess a vial of your own condensed True Dragon Factor. Anyone who drinks this vial evolves into a dragonoid as if they were a natural descendant of yourself.

Although Dragonoids are imitations of True Dragons, they have a divine nature and possess immortal material bodies that do not age.

As they inherit your True Dragon Factor, they inherit powers derived from the aspect of nature you embody; they can also access True Dragon Magic, which they can use to manipulate elements related to your aspect.

In addition, you have learned the way to produce more of this condensed True Dragon Factor, allowing you to adopt more individuals into your bloodline. You can only create one vial a month without permanently weakening yourself.

Note: if you use True Dragon (Tensura) for addons like the Dragon Sovereign addon for Archon (Genshin Impact) or the True Dragon God addon for Incarnated God (Type-Moon), they can partially inherit these powers as well.
addons.title: Artificial Dragonoid

objects.text:
You've acquired a vial of blood from an extraordinarily powerful dragon.

Drinking half the vial will grant you a mana core—a metaphysical core centered in your soul that generates vast amounts of mana simply by breathing. This provides you with high resistance to mana and the innate ability to perform Mana Burst. Mana Burst is a skill where you infuse and concentrate large amounts of mana into your body or a weapon you're wielding, drastically reinforcing them and enhancing physical capabilities. The strength of the enhancement depends on how much mana you use and the durability of your body or weapon. Initially, you'll be able to smash through stone walls and move at speeds exceeding 100 mph, and your potential will only grow from there.
