Drinking the entire vial will further amplify the capacity and regeneration rate of your mana core, making it nearly impossible to exhaust your mana reserves. Additionally, your body will undergo significant enhancement from the dragon's blood. Your skin will become more durable than steel. Your body loses the need for sustenance and no longer ages. Additionally, you gain a moderate healing factor that can heal scratches in seconds, mild wounds in minutes, and large wounds in hours, with limbs taking days to regenerate. This healing ability can be enhanced by expending massive amounts of mana; however, attempting to restore a limb in seconds is one of the few ways you could deplete your mana. Losing over a quarter of your brain will still kill you.

Be warned: this vial is neither indestructible nor soulbound so do not lose it before you drink it.
objects.title: Dragon's Blood

objects.text: She came down to the human kingdom her mother protected, Drawn by laughter and the promise of fun. But the Sword Saint's shadow loomed too large, And mortal steel could never match her blade. The tools of old were not enough to save them, So they hungered for a greater power. They knew what flowed in dragon veins, And what power came from a dragon’s end. The daughter came in friendship, And they gave her death. From the corpse a single tear, A pearl crystallised by a friend's betrayal. By swallowing the tear, which takes the form of a candy sized clear pearl, it dissolve directly into your soul. This transforms you into a magical prodigy overnight. Your body begins a constant, passive self-optimisation that never ceases: your mana pool swells continuously, your senses sharpen to perceive ambient magic with instinctual clarity, and complex magical theorems that would take decades to understand now become as easy to learn as basic mathematics. However, the transformation has diminishing returns. The initial surge makes you a genius, but each subsequent refinement yields less dramatic improvement, ensuring that while your growth never truly stops, the days of explosive, overnight ascension are contained. This also stains your soul with the blood of dragons, meaning dragons and creatures related to them will feel immense dread around you. Even extremely distantly related creatures like mundane lizards will flee at your presence.
objects.title: Dragon's Tear

objects.text:
Developed in the latter half of the Xeno Conflict, Emergency Mutation Capsule 13—codenamed “Grimjaw”—was engineered by the Coalition of Mankind as a desperate answer to the biologically superior forces of the Xeno Alliance.

Once injected, Grimjaw activates within ten seconds. The subject’s metabolism spikes violently, triggering rapid genetic overclocking as synthetic retroviral agents hijack stem cells and initiate temporary mutations. Muscles swell, bones harden, and flesh tears and rebuilds in real time, crafting a form tailored for destruction—complete with claws, plated skin, and a skeletal frame that can bear monstrous force. The user becomes a biological weapon: capable of lifting several tons, leaping multiple stories, shrugging off bullets, and regenerating minor wounds mid-combat. During this period, which lasts around 25 minutes, the user exists in a heightened primal state, where instinct, pain suppression, and reflexes are amplified beyond human capacity.

After the 25-minute peak window ends, the transformation begins to collapse. Mutated tissue rapidly deteriorates as the body purges unstable cellular matter through violent shedding: claws fall away, muscle mass reduces, and armored plating cracks and dissolves into bio-waste. For about 10–15 minutes afterward, the user is physically drained—weak, sore, vulnerable and back to their baseline. However, once the body stabilizes, it enters a slow regenerative period. 

If used with care, and enough recovery time is given between doses, Grimjaw leaves lasting effects. Each full cycle—mutation, burnout, recovery—results in minor but permanent genetic refinement. Muscles become denser. Bones thicken microscopically. Reflexes improve. Nerves fire faster. These benefits stack, and as long as the user respects the natural rhythm of transformation and re-synchronization, the body continues to evolve in subtle, powerful ways. However, the more stabilized traits you accumulate, the longer the body takes to complete its genetic recovery—turning a three-day window into a week, then two, then more.

If the serum is taken again before this resynchronization is complete, the body, it begins to fold in on itself. Bone structures clash, muscles rupture under their own weight, and tissue growth overlaps into grotesque, cancerous masses. The immune system panics, attacking newly formed structures as if they were foreign invaders. Users suffer seizures, hallucinations, and often permanent disfigurement. Worse still, repeated reckless use shortens the delay between mutation and rejection, meaning the transformation itself can fail mid-battle—leaving a broken, half-mutated ruin where a super-soldier once stood.

You begin with a hardened suitcase containing five Grimjaw syringes. A new dose is automatically supplied to you every seven days. Use them wisely.
objects.title: Emergency Mutation Capsule 13 “Grimjaw”

objects.text: ”My Dreams taste like coffee." How did you get this? No matter how you did, it’s yours now. This Schrodinger’s Fluid, born from the infinite, dreamlike chaos of a deity's Muse, has a few functions. As the symbol of power for a whimsical deity, it can refill itself infinitely with whatever liquid you desire, from premium coffee, to chamomile tea, to the divine nectar of Olympus, to pure and thrice-blessed Sanctified Holy Water, to even the logic-defying primordial Eldritch Ichor found in the corpses of ancient gods. If you possess a supernatural energy, it will refill that energy to max capacity, as well as slightly increase your capability to store that energy. What is truly miraculous about this item, however, is what would happen if you were to drink the entire cup in one go, absorbing even its ability to regenerate itself. For you, it would work only with a pact with a higher deity, turning you into an Avatar of theirs so long as you don't cut the connection yourself. For any one person you give it to, even a baseline human, it would turn them into your worshipper by creating an Ether Drinker, an infinitely adaptable Warlock that can interface with any system, real or fictional. On top of that, absorbing the regenerative aspect of the Ether Brew ensures that whatever the max capacity of energy was in the past, the drinker can no longer go beneath that capacity, with limitless potential for growth. As you only have the one cup, sacrificing it in this manner will require you to refill it with something akin to a Holy Grail from Type-Moon or the favor of a pantheon’s Chief Deity.
objects.title: Ether Brew

objects.text:
A shimmering gold coin engraved with ancient binary runes that when carried attunes itself to your essence and phases into your being, allowing you to hold it within yourself.

If you are slain while bonded to the coin, it activates instantly. Your body, mind, and spirit are restored to their prime state, erasing the moment of death as though it never occurred. Temporary enchantments, consumables, and buffs may fade in the process, but your memories, equipment, and inherent abilities are also fully restored.

Furthermore, the coin cannot be lost, stolen, or destroyed while bound to you. It can only be transferred willingly by gifting it to another. Once gifted, it binds to the recipient in the same way, granting them its protection instead of you. If gifted upon someone who has already dead, the coin activates immediately, resurrecting them regardless of how long they have been dead or what caused their death.

Regardless of how the coin is activated it is consumed upon being used, leaving no trace of it or how it worked.
objects.title: Extra Life Coin

addons.text:
After countless failures to recreate the lone Super Soldier, desperation led Coalition scientists to reason that if ordinary human bodies couldn’t survive the surgery, perhaps a Wendigo might survive the ordeal. The attempt was almost successful: the Wendigo endured the Soldier’s reconstruction, but the hybrid body collapsed under the strain of two incompatible extremes. While it had failed, in the margins of same files lies a hypothetical designation: Scion, the imagined equilibrium. You are that equilibrium. 

The excessive caloric demands of Wendigos are eliminated. Your integrated energy-regulation system produces and recycles bioelectric and metabolic output efficiently, powering both organic tissues and cybernetic components without external surplus. You no longer risk starvation or food debt, and your body maintains consistent performance under all conditions.

Your senses, once the greatest liability of Wendigos, have been mastered. Your brain, reinforced by the neural lattice of the Super Soldier, not only processes the endless flood of sensory data, it filters it — amplifying what you need, muting what you don’t. You can see in total darkness, track heat signatures, read ultraviolet traces, and hear ultrasonic frequencies — but unlike the unstable Wendigos, you are never overwhelmed. 

Your reflexes, guided by semi-autonomous limb-clusters, are now harmonized with the combat doctrine of the Super Soldier. Each strike is not only heuristically designed to be perfect but also tactically precise. 

Cognition achieves stable integration: Wendigo acceleration and Super Soldier tactical programming align into a synchronized decision engine. Time no longer drags as with Wendigos, nor does machine rigidity dominate as in the Super Soldier. You perceive reality at variable speeds, either shifting between microsecond analysis and natural flow without detachment or existing in both simultaneously.

Your strength is not only immense but also perfectly controlled. The uncontrolled destruction of Wendigos has been replaced with surgical precision. You can shatter tanks with a strike, yet also type on a keyboard without breaking it. Your neural-feedback system has been adapted for Wendigo musculature, locking your strength into refined, deliberate expression.
addons.title: Hypothetical Subject “Scion”

objects.text:
While only one true super soldier was considered a success by the Coalition of Mankind, that wasn't to say all the failures died, only most of them did. The rest merely didn't meet expectations. Genetic Reformat Serum 07 “Wendigo” was one such "failure". Despite early successes, the project was deemed a critical failure due to its unstable side effects, escalating logistical demands, and the psychological fallout experienced by subjects. Taking the form of a simple syringe, to use all you need to do is inject it into the subject, yourself or otherwise.

When injected, the Wendigo Serum triggers an irreversible metamorphosis, the process taking up to an entire day, with the subject being extremely weak throughout. The recipient’s musculature expands and compacts, increasing density and fiber tension to levels capable of lifting the equivalent of three mid-sized cars. A single unrestrained strike can deliver enough force to crush reinforced steel or send a person flying several meters. Speed increases, allowing sprint bursts faster than most land animals and even some vehicles and reflexes become effectively precognitive due to the installation of peripheral neural clusters. Each limb acts with semi-autonomous processing, housing neural density rivaling a small mammal, enabling localized, near-instantaneous combat reflexes.

Internally, all major organs are reinforced with redundant sub-organs, such as extra hearts, backup adrenal glands, and a modular liver system ensure that failure in one system doesn’t result in total collapse. Additionally, independent combat reflexes replace base instincts. Each automatic twitch, feint, and strike executed with the same kill certainty found in apex predators. The subject is constantly guided by deeply encoded instinctual heuristics designed to overwhelm, isolate, and eliminate targets.

Sensory systems are overclocked to the extreme. The eyes develop a range of color detection, granting perfect night vision in conditions of total darkness and full-spectrum detection across infrared, ultraviolet, and beyond. Hearing spans from sub-bass vibrations below the range of human hearing to ultrasonic frequencies beyond what even dogs or bats can perceive, and mechanoreceptors in the skin can detect surface variations smaller than a bacterium. Due to melanin suppression and altered gene expression, subjects develop total albinism: snow-white skin and hair, and reflective silver irises. The serum disables the body’s ability to faint or shut down, forcing subjects remain conscious even during psychological breakdown or sensory overload, the latter being common as even sunlight will both blind them and feel like fire on the skin.

Wendigos burn more than ten times the daily energy of an elite athlete just to survive. While they can enter a “food debt” state, the caloric repayment must significantly exceed what was missed. After a few days without intake, they must consume an amount of food that would feed a dozen people for a week or begin to cannibalize muscle mass, brain tissue, and internal organs. Their oxygen processing ability surpasses even the fittest marathon runner, allowing sustained exertion for hours without pause. However, their immense strength is not naturally intuitive. Everyday actions like turning doorknobs or holding tools can cause destruction without deliberate training. Regaining control requires years of continuous neuro-muscular conditioning.

Lastly, there is the cognitive fallout. With cognitive power rivaling supercomputers and sub-millisecond reaction speeds, Wendigos perceive time as slowed. Normal interaction becomes unbearable, leading to detachment and apathy. Wendigos are sterile due to the complete breakdown of the hypothalamic-pituitary-gonadal axis, with gonadal tissues becoming vestigial.
objects.title: Genetic Reformat Serum 07 “Wendigo”

objects.text:
This flask has a unique property: any liquid poured into it is instantly transformed into a pure, potent form of holy water. Regardless of the original substance—be it wine, poison, or seawater—the contents become a radiant, sanctified fluid that restores both body and spirit.

Anyone who drinks from the flask is healed. Wounds seal, sickness vanishes, broken bones mend, and even those on the brink of death—or already beyond it, so long as their soul remains nearby—can be revived within moments. It also mends metaphysical damage such as severed soul fragments, corruption, fractured destinies, and damage to one's spiritual or conceptual self are all restored. It also replenishes all energy reserves, whether physical or mental: stamina, qi, mana, prana, od, chakra, chi, haki, and all other forms of energy.

The flask’s contents are purely beneficial and cannot be corrupted, poisoned, or altered once transformed. It can also match the taste of any liquid the drinker has ever had before, and the temperature can adjust to whatever the drinker prefers—ice-cold, scalding hot, or anywhere in between.
objects.title: Holy Flask

objects.text:
You’ve managed to get your hands on some Ichor Steel. Enough to make a full set of tools and a reasonably sized weapon, or some armor.

Nearly indestructible, Ichor Steel requires the secret blood magics of the Fylakes Istorias or tools made of Ichor Steel to harvest.

But aside from its durability, it is also highly receptive to magical energy, with enchantments and blessings only requiring a fifth the energy to apply.

This receptiveness is inverted when used for defensive purposes however, with hostile or negative effects being reduced to a fifth of their effect.
objects.title: Ichor Steel

objects.text:
You have acquired a significantly lesser version of the Genie’s Lamp from Aladdin’s story. You get, as per usual, 3 wishes, but! These are extremely limited in scope. 

The first limitation is that the genie itself, its lamp, and any other genies or their linked objects are entirely out of bounds for any wish you make. The genie is a person, guaranteed to have an at worst neutral impression of you when you first meet, but they can hold a grudge or get you stuck in their craw like anyone else. They are incapable of violating the spirit OR the letter of the wish, for or against you, and they can’t directly lie to you about wishes, at least as objective truth extends; but they also don’t have to volunteer information or their own personal opinion.


The second limitation is that your wish may not meddle with time, space, death, or reality itself. No grand workings or miraculous boons for you, I’m afraid.


The third limitation is that all wishes must be centered around a person, such as yourself, so wishing for world peace or an end to famine is not an option. Furthermore, as you are technically the beneficiary of this, the wishes are at their highest cap when centered around you. 

If centered around someone like your spouse, your parents, your children, your sibling, your best friend, or someone equally close, the wishes are half as strong, and if you take another step away from your own person the strength halves again. 

Given the way humans work, there are about 200 people at most that you could feasibly center a wish around, and around half of them would limit that wish to at most “this person will have a pretty good/bad day”.

The fourth limitation is that your wish may not give you (much less anyone else) superpowers by the standards of your world (though it may get you close with some creativity by enhancing your natural parameters within the range of your reality), mess with your natural lifespan, or create life- though inanimate matter is fine. If you sacrifice two other wishes, you may bend this rule further and even break it, but only slightly- for instance, you couldn’t make yourself immortal or ageless, but you might be able to rejuvenate yourself by a decade.

The lamp will fall dormant once you’ve made your third wish. It will cease to be an Object of Power for as long as it is dormant. Five years after it goes dormant, it will be ready to be awoken again (by anyone, not just you, so keep an eye on it), and the cycle may repeat. If you make a wish that breaks the 4th limitation by sacrificing two others, it will instead take 10 years for the lamp to recharge.

These are minor wishes. Don’t expect them to change your world, you’ll have to be smart with them to even change your life.
objects.title: Lamp of Minor Wishes

objects.text:
The Limit Breaker Potion changes the drinker's very being, making them limitless. No ceilings, no walls to constrain their growth when consumed, all artificial or natural restrictions on growth, ability, etc. The whole "you can only get so far" saying is irrelevant.

A regular athlete who could once only imagine shaving a few seconds off a sprint might, through relentless effort, eventually outrun race cars, then fighter jets, and someday the very speed of light. A street thief might climb the ladder from lifting coins to snatching away someone’s luck, their memories, even their time — or they could get so good at sneaking that they hide inside someone's shadow or their memories. A telekinetic who once couldn’t budge a chair could, with enough practice and experience, hurl mountains, then planets, and eventually whole galaxies like skipping stones on a lake.

The potion does not just open the doors to unlimited expansion — it also ensures no effort is ever wasted, no matter how marginal the gain, no matter how incremental the climb, the user will always move forward if they continue training, practicing, or pushing on.

Stagnation is never an option; all effort, every droplet of sweat, every bite of learning acquired points toward improvement. Every time the consumer takes action or trains, they will see small but noticeable gains, which increase based on the difficulty or amount of effort invested in that activity.
Even though the growth may not be big, it guarantees that sooner or later, they will be able to penetrate walls once considered impassable. With perseverance and time, there can only be progress, and there is no longer any limit to where that progress will lead you.
objects.title: Limit Breaker Potion

objects.text:
This cigarette pack is a relatively modern invention developed by the Shinobi. The cigarettes themselves are held in an elegant box, small and absolutely black with gold embossing around the edges, making it look no worse than some kind of jewelry box in which the family heirlooms are kept.

When one of these cigarettes is lit, the smoke immediately infuses the smoker, steeling their body against external venom and sickness. While smoking, the smoker gains a powerful, temporary shield against all types of poisons and contaminated air, allowing them to traverse foul areas without harm. Even long after the smoke is gone, the body retains a small, lasting resilience that permanently helps the smoker resist harmful substances.

For a quick attack or desperate escape, the user can chew the cigarette itself and instantly releases a potent agent, exhaling it as a massive, pitch-black cloud of poison. This cloud can cover an entire lecture hall, and while it isn't strong enough to kill quickly, breathing it in feels like acid to anyone caught in it, instantly incapacitating them. The act of chewing the cig makes the user totally immune to the cloud.

The box contains twenty-five of these cigarettes.
objects.title: Ninja Tool: Cigarettes

objects.text: ”Unconquered are the faithful. So says Americanus." How did you get this? No matter how you did, it’s yours now. This bright and shiny angel feather, born from the infinite, exceptional will of a deity’s Muse, has a few functions. As the symbol of power for an order-focused deity, it can become any singular supernatural effect tied to a word, any word, that measures your will or faith, whichever is stronger. If you use the feather as a magical quill to write with, you can inscribe a single word, in any language, to produce a supernatural effect tied to whatever you wrote on, limited to a maximum of 20 SP. Either way, you are limited to only one word at a time, but there are virtually no limitations outside this and the SP cap. It can also be used as a battery. If you possess a supernatural energy, it will refill that energy to max capacity, as well as slightly increase your capability to store that energy. What is truly miraculous about this item, however, is what would happen if you were to burn it in a sacrificial ritual, absorbing even its ability to regenerate itself. For you, it would work only with a pact with a higher deity, turning you into an Avatar of theirs so long as you don't cut the connection yourself. For any one person you give it to, even a baseline human, it would turn them into your worshipper by creating a Dedica Anim, an Angelic Cleric (actually a Warlock) that can speak, read, and write in the Angelic Language of Americanus Almighty. Such would let them use an unlimited amount of singular words in any language, usually Latin, to produce supernatural effects with a potential of up to 20 SP, including a sacrificial one-time Wish named after the feather itself that boosts that potential to 30 SP before they lose their powers. On top of that, absorbing the regenerative aspect of the Omnis Feather ensures that whatever the max capacity of energy was in the past, the Angel can no longer go beneath that capacity, even if they may struggle to grow. Too many words in quick succession can cause mental degradation before the body adjusts. As you only have the one feather, sacrificing it in this manner will require you to acquire another with something akin to a Holy Grail from Type-Moon or the favor of a pantheon’s Chief Deity.
objects.title: Omnis Feather

objects.text:
Grown in the Queen Mother’s Peach Orchard, the Peach of Immortality is a divine delicacy cherished by gods and immortals alike. Through sheer luck, you've obtained a single peach of the weakest variety—but even this grants incredible benefits.

Fully consuming the peach grants immortality. You will no longer age or experience spiritual decay, allowing your body and soul to remain in their prime. However, you are not invincible and can still be killed. If consumed in old age, you will be restored to your youth, while a child will continue growing until they reach their physical peak. Additionally, the peach’s pure immortal energy cleanses impurities from both body and spirit, enhancing your physique and strengthening your soul.

The peach’s pit can grow into a mundane yet exceptional peach tree, but with immense resources and power, it may be cultivated into another immortal-bearing tree. Even if you succeed, these divine fruits take thousands of years to ripen.
objects.title: Peach Of Immortality

objects.text:
You did it, you managed to obtain the elusive Philosopher's Cocaine.

It's the perfect drug that will affect you no matter how resistant or powerful you are. You'll experience the full effect as if you took it for the first time, every time, with no drawbacks. A microdose of this will be more than enough to feel its effects.

You may also choose to sprinkle this in with other drugs to nullify their drawbacks (the addictive nature or potentially overdosing) while still getting their respective highs.

You'll also experience enlightenment during your high, which grants a huge boost to creativity.

You'll start with an ounce in a container of your choice that refreshes every week.
objects.title: Philosopher's Cocaine

addons.text:
Your paradoxical drink container may now assume the form of a battered yet strangely dependable Vault 13 canteen, carrying with it the same improbable luck and usefulness spoken of in wasteland legend. While in this form, it retains all the properties of Schrödinger’s Stein, but also becomes exceptionally durable, easy to carry, and almost impossible to permanently lose. No matter where you set it down, it always seems to find its way back to you when needed.

In addition to ordinary beverages, you may now fill the canteen with any drink found within the Fallout universe. This includes common refreshments such as Nuka-Cola, Sunset Sarsaparilla, purified or irradiated water, wasteland liquors, coffee substitutes, and rarer concoctions such as Battle Brew or other regional specialties. On top of all this, you may designate a single Fallout chem to be infused into every sip. Each drink grants the effects of that chem in clean, measured doses alongside normal hydration. Choose Buffout for enhanced strength and toughness, Mentats for heightened focus and intellect, Jet for sharpened reflexes and speed, Psycho for increased combat ferocity, Med-X for pain resistance, or any other Fallout Chem of your choice. The beverage’s taste and temperature still adjust to the drinker’s preference, often masking the infusion entirely.

The canteen also carries a touch of the strange luck for which Vault 13 legends are known. If kept in a pocket, pouch, or holster near chest height, it is fated to save your life at least once in a dramatic moment, such as by catching a bullet meant for your heart, deflecting shrapnel, softening a lethal blow, or otherwise placing itself between you and death through improbable coincidence. Once this miracle has been spent, it becomes only as durable as before, though still difficult to lose and fully functional. It will regain this lucky ability once a full month has passed.
addons.title: Lucky Vault 13 Canteen

objects.text:
You have a cup, bottle, or other such container filled with one beverage of your choice. You may change the beverage and container whenever you wish. This cannot be used for offensive purposes, nor can it be spilled. It is merely a cup/bottle/etc. filled with an endless amount of any one beverage. If someone besides the person drinking from the cup directly observes the beverage being drunk, the beverage will no longer be endless and function like a regular cup filled with that beverage. The cup will gain back its paradoxical qualities either when the cup is empty, which will make it slowly refill itself or when no one is looking directly at the cup, which will refill it instantly.
The beverage will never expire or degrade in quality, and will change its taste, temperature, etc. to best match the preference of the person drinking it.
objects.title: Schrödinger's Stein

objects.text: A small vial, containing a neutralizing liquid. When ingested by someone with powers, the formula will act to neutralize the active manifestation of powers: a changer would turn back into their regular form, but someone permanently mutated wouldn't, though any other power they might have, like laser beams, wouldn't work. A full vial can counter the equivalent to 50SP of powers, if the ingested have more than that, their power will be only proportionally weakened. It lasts 12h hours if ingested, 24h if injected, and 6h if consumed aerosolized. The vial is indestructible and replenished from empty to full over a day.
objects.title: Suppression Compound

addons.text:
The peach of immortality was used as an ingredient in the brewing of the Golden Elixir, which greatly enhanced the quality of the elixir.

The golden core the elixir creates is now much closer to a natural golden core, although it remains artificial. This increases the speed of your passive cultivation, and you can reach heights that would otherwise be beyond you; that being said, you still cannot truly advance your cultivation stage without external means.

Due to the influence of the Peach of Immortality, your golden core will purify your impurities over time. Eventually, you will form a unique bodily and spiritual constitution of Flawlessness, which gives you immunity to all forms of taint and corruption.
addons.title: Elixir of Immortality

objects.text:
A bottle containing the goal of cultivation—one sip of this elixir grants the user a golden core. The golden core is the fusion of Essence, Qi, and Spirit, pulling all aspects of your being into perfect harmony. With this core, your entire self is enhanced and elevated. The golden core offers numerous benefits, including an extended lifespan, stretching up to a millennium. It also elevates your mind, body, and soul to near-superhuman levels. You will even gain the ability to fly, though not at great speeds.

The most valuable aspect of the golden core, however, is its continuous cycling of Essence, Qi, and Spirit. This ongoing process refines your inner self, allowing for continuous growth and strengthening. As long as your golden core remains, it will steadily cultivate and enhance your mind, body, and soul. But reaching the level of gods and immortals will be beyond you. Due to the artificial nature of this core, breaking through to higher realms will be impossible without external methods.

A single bottle of this golden elixir can grant anyone a golden core. The bottle refills itself once every century, though the process can be accelerated by pouring energy or resources into it. However, increasing the refill rate is extremely costly.
objects.title: The Golden Elixir

objects.text: This potion is rumored to be made by the collaboration of many gods of love: Aphrodite, Freyja, Hathor, Kuni, and more. A potion that, unlike those in many stories... doesn't actually make others fall in love. Indeed, on the surface, this refillable potion of hot pink liquid the size of a mature woman's hand from base to outstretched fingers, would seem rather useless as it does not induce instant love in whoever drinks it. But, it's purpose IS the same, but through another means: enhancement. When drank, your love with a certain person is enhanced to be quite strong, and the same is so for the other person. As well, an 8.9 cm indestructible, in every sense of the word, thick red ribbon will wrap around their wrists once together. While the ribbon itself will not physically force them together, it is a universal symbol of their love that even gods will acknowledge. This potion assures that even if shyness or fear clouds both of you, you will indeed come together and assure the love never dies. But another effect of this comes from the "enhancement." When you use any powers or abilities together, whether in combat, at home, or any situations, they will be unable to hurt you or your spouse as well as strengthened. Even if you were engulfed in the hottest fire by your spouse in an AOE attack, the most you will feel is a slight increase in temperature. If your spouse was caught in a magical lightning strike, they will just feel like they got a static shock.
objects.title: The Love Potion

objects.text:
A cauldron that keeps itself perpetually in perfect boiling temperature, it comes already filled with whatever broth you may like. By filling the cauldron with ingredients and eating the stew, you receive minor benefits from it, such as always being warm from peppers, extra strength from meat, endurance from potatoes, etc. Magical ingredients will give their benefits as well, such as Senzu Beans improving your natural healing or increased resilience from a Minecraft Enchanted Apple. 

Keep in mind that the effects will always be diluted, and there is only so much of the cauldron. While the cauldron will always remember what was inside of it and thus gave some fraction of its benefits, the more recent the food the more prominent its effects will have on the Stew.

The cauldron will always keep the food safe to consume, and will refill itself with broth as it is consumed.
objects.title: The Perpetual Stew

objects.text:
This injectable, glowing serum gives off a strange pressure as you hold it. It is called the Vitalis Serum, and it is another humanity’s answer to a supernatural invasion. In its original world, a civilization built around magic, soul-based technology, and artificial spirits tore open a passage into an ordinary Earth after suffering a catastrophe of its own. They colonized the planet, devastated human society, and enslaved much of its population. Decades later, a resistance movement combined stolen supernatural knowledge with its own research to create this new weapon.

After injection, the serum completely reconstructs the recipient. It purges the body of waste and toxins before forming a cocoon of hardened muscle and bone around them. Their body is broken down and rebuilt from the cellular level upward, leaving them with physical capabilities at least three times greater than those of a peak human.

The serum also creates a metaphysical framework anchored directly into the user's biology. Its creators combined natural life force with a spiritual nexus modeled after the artificial spirits of their enemies, allowing the user to instinctively generate and manipulate both life force and spiritual energy. When combined, these forces become Vitalis, an energy capable of interacting with and harming supernatural beings.

Vitalis can also be circulated through the body in a specific pattern, creating an ethereal aura that doubles the user's physical capabilities while active. The circulation provides additional protection against mystic and spiritual attacks, reducing their damage to half of what they would otherwise inflict after the user's natural Vitalis resistance.

A Vitalis Human can perceive spiritual and mystical energies, physically interact with immaterial beings and structures, and resist supernatural surveillance and precognition. Curses gradually lose their hold on them, while their enhanced healing can restore damage to both body and soul. Their soul is difficult to corrupt, remove, or destroy, and their life force is similarly difficult to drain. It is also poisonous to spirits and other supernatural creatures. If the recipient has no soul, the serum will create one, though it will be an unnatural soul.

Each user possesses an internal well of Vitalis that can be released as blasts and beams, infused into objects, or shaped into more advanced techniques. With practice, users can develop homing attacks, forking projectiles, and attacks capable of bending around obstacles. Vitalis is especially suited to creating constructs such as weapons, shields, and tools, which become stronger and more durable with continued use and greater investment of energy.

Over time, constructs can harden into an increasingly solid energy form, eventually bordering on matter itself. Advanced constructs can even become self-sustaining and permanent without continuously drawing from their creator's well. Vitalis is especially deadly to spiritual beings; spirits killed by it cannot return through their normal means of regeneration or resurrection. A highly trained Vitalis Human can contend with several spiritual beings powerful enough to threaten entire cities.

Take this serum and let those from beyond know that they can't run and hide anymore.
objects.title: Vitalis Serum

addons.text:
Similar to Obelix, you are now under the effects of The Magic Potion permanently, as though you bathed in it as an infant. You are now what could be described as a Viking super-soldier, able to handle entire armies and perform feats of strength that defy conventional logic. Should a desperate situation arise, you can microdose yourself with even more potion, massively increasing your absurd strength even more. Doing so will increase your strength to such a level that you can effortlessly lift the Great Pyramids of Egypt or run faster than the speed of sound without needing to break the sound barrier. Though be warned that drinking much more than a few drops may turn you to stone or worse.

As a slight side effect, you will grow in size similar to a bodybuilder and will require much more nutrition, especially when using your full strength.
addons.title: Potion Baby

addons.text:
You gain the abilities and knowledge of a Druid of Gaul on the same level as Getafix. He was, in fact, your teacher and taught you everything he knows in druidic arts. As Getafix’s true student, you have gained every one of his potion recipes. Most notably The Magic Potion, but also many other creations which are a mix of strange and useful.

As a Druid, you gain a magic golden sickle which, when used to harvest ingredients, will preserve them indefinitely. This sickle is not meant to be used as a weapon but more as a tool to be used to gather and shape materials.

The natural world around you is your domain, with the ability to almost swim between trees, leaping and navigating nature without effort. You may commune with nature with a supernatural grace, able to talk to animals or figure out what properties a plant or animal would add to your potions. The potions that this discipline creates use rather conventional ingredients that may be easily gathered from nature. Though that is not to say more esoteric ingredients might be needed, such as THE SECRET FINAL INGREDIENT for The Magic Potion, an ingredient so secret no one even knows what it is, but you now do.
addons.title: Legacy of Getafix

objects.text:
You receive a small hip flask filled with Magic Potion. With enough Magic Potion to grant you its powers for 8 hours and refilling every 24 hours. The Magic Potion can taste like whatever you desire and may be changed whenever it refills.

The Magic Potion is the magnum opus of the Druid Getafix of Gaul. Drinking it grants superhuman strength, durability, speed, stamina, and resistance to harmful effects. Over many years of drinking the Magic Potion, one’s physical abilities will slowly increase such that even without drinking the Magic Potion, one will have mild super-human physical ability.

Whomever drinks the potion can access their full peak physical ability without backlash, further increased 10-fold. An old man or baby would gain the effects as though they were in their prime age. While under the effects of the potion, one's stamina increases 5-fold and quickly recovers over time. The drinker also gains a moderate level of resistance versus esoteric attacks such as drugs, magic, or advanced weapons. Such as sleeping drugs, fireball spells, or a shrinking ray. Those under the effects of the potion also gain a very mild form of toon force, making their bodies like rubber and able to survive a great amount of blunt damage. Such as a falling boulder or falling from a cliff, or granting the ability to launch someone into orbit, leaving nothing but their shoes behind.

The Magic Potion also functions as a powerful healing tonic able to boost the rate of healing and recovering lost stamina, and it can heal physical disabilities such as a lost voice.

Do note that the potion makes you “Very strong but not Invulnerable” towards damage, and it does have limits. Do not try to drink more of the potion while already under its effects. Or try to combine it with other magical potions. Failure to follow these warnings may cause one to turn to stone or worse.
objects.title: The Magic Potion of Getafix (Asterix The Gaul)

addons.text:
The combination of ADAM and Compound V+ in your system has turned into quite a winning combination. Now, you're not just as strong as Homelander, you've surpassed him. Each of your plasmids are guaranteed to above those of Homelanders own powers. Winter Blast becomes able to counteract lava itself, Incinerate! able to reach temperatures of around 6000 degrees Celsius, Telekinesis being able to lift up to 50,000 tons with extreme focus and more.

In addition to what's in the manual, you will get Plasmid making instructions, including certain genetic steps on recreating the Sea Slugs that make ADAM. Besides the powers themselves being insanely heightened, your physiology has reacted uniquely to the ADAM and Compound V+ flowing through your veins. The EVE needed to use your Plasmids/vigors has been significantly reduced, able to make a gallon of EVE last 2 whole months compared to around 3 weeks before.
addons.title: EDEN

objects.text:
In the multiverse of Bioshock, one thing reigns supreme: Genetic manipulation via sea slugs into giving super powers! From Shock Jockey making you able to expel and control electricity like a sith, to Winter Blast allowing you to freeze areas around you, all the way to Peeping Tom letting you use X-Ray vision while immobile to see through walls! 

While Vigors and Plasmids are remarkably similar, there are differences between them. Normally, Both are caused by a substance called ADAM, which if not supplied continually, will cause insanity and genetic unravel within the subject.

Thankfully, for each purchase of these fine syringes/bottles, you get them without any requirement for Adam, and a refillable Eve supply (about 10 gallons in a container of your choosing per bi-weekly).

Each purchase gives you one game's worth of Plasmids, From Bioshock 1, to 2, to Infinite, eventually giving you all Vigors and Plasmids in the franchise.
objects.title: Plasmids/Vigors (Bioshock franchise)

objects.text:
This is a truly spectacular pill that glows a stark fluorescent orange. It is a fusion of 9 supernatural liquids capable of granting boons to their consumers. 

You’ll find your whole body more durable to the point that you can stay in motion even after taking a few rounds of small arms ammunition to the chest. If something does manage to pierce your reinforced skin, you'll find it healing far faster than normal. While you certainly can't regrow your arm, fighting off an infection or even closing a gash in your side would take no more than a few hours. 

Speed is the name of the game and you know how to play. You are art in motion, able to weave through even the tightest spots without losing momentum. You run faster and further. Marathons await. 

Dexterity is your calling. You could reload a rifle in a quarter of the time necessary. Repairing things, even without the proper knowledge, comes naturally to you. Nimble fingers make the world go around, and you have more than enough to spare. 

Projectile-based weapons are your bread and butter! While you won't be firing two bullets at once, it'll certainly feel like it due to all projectiles' increased damage and penetration. Your bullets are almost magnetic in how accurate you are. Don't be afraid to laugh at your enemies when they inevitably call you a cheater! Never fear, if you wish to take the non-lethal route you'll find your dastardly bullets hitting the safest places to reduce the risk of death.

The amount of ammunition and weaponry you can fit on your person at a time is almost comedic. Your ability to pack and manage your available space is supernatural. 

While you won't be able to cover sources of unwanted contact in webbing, you'll find an extremely sensitive sixth sense lingering in the back of your head, keeping an eye for danger you might not even be conscious of.
objects.title: Perkaholic (Call of Duty Zombies)
Rainbow Shell (Chrono Trigger)
objects.text:
You've somehow acquired the legendary Rainbow Shell, the fossilized remains of an enormous ancient sea creature, refined by the impossible energies released when Lavos crashed into the planet millions of years ago. Its existence has been preserved in myths and legends across countless civilizations, all speaking of its beauty and power.

The entire Shell is yours, though moving it is no simple task. Its immense weight requires a group of people, or preferably heavy machinery, to transport.

As a crafting material, the Rainbow Shell is exceptionally durable and highly receptive to supernatural energy. Anything crafted from it inherits its durability and can readily channel magical and supernatural effects.

It has an innate affinity for enchantments and supernatural energies, massively amplifying their effects to unparalleled levels. However, its immense hardness makes it exceptionally difficult to work with, requiring a master craftsman to shape it into anything useful.

objects.title: Sun Stone (Chrono Trigger)
objects.text:
You've acquired the legendary Sun Stone, an ancient material containing an immense reservoir of Solar and magical energy. Once the foremost source of elemental power for the people of Zeal, it aided in the rise of their civilization and was used to create countless magical weapons, armor, and artifacts.

The Sun Stone contains an enormous store of solar energy that can be absorbed, stored, and released as mana without energy loss, allowing it to function as both a powerful magical catalyst and battery. It has an infinite storage capacity, though there is a limit to how much energy can be released at once.

Its energy can be refined into different elemental effects and used to create or imbue weapons, armor, tools, and artifacts with powerful supernatural properties. Items crafted directly from the Sun Stone will be far superior to those merely imbued with its energy.

The Sun Stone's energy and mere presence also affect beings inherently vulnerable to the Sun, such as Vampires. Even those who have overcome their weakness to sunlight will remain partially affected by its presence.

Its greatest limitation is that while its storage capacity is infinite, its energy reserves are finite and take millions of years to fully recharge to their current level.

addons.title: Sun Stone Recharger
addons.text:
As you possess a supernatural means of generating Solar Energy, you can rapidly replenish the Sun Stone's energy reserves, bypassing the millions of years normally required for it to return to its current level of energy.

Even without your supernatural means of generating Solar Energy, the Sun Stone has become far more efficient at absorbing solar energy. Leaving it exposed to sunlight for a single year would provide it with the equivalent of ten thousand years' worth of solar energy.

That said, your own Solar Energy is far more effective and efficient. at a base level without any practice a single day spent focusing your Solar Energy into the Sun Stone would provide more energy than leaving it exposed to sunlight for an entire year.

The Effectiveness and Efficiency is also based off your chosen powers, meaning that having multiple powers that generate Solar Energy would stack with one another. not every power is equal, Immortal Sun by itself without training could allow you to provide a hundred thousand years worth of Solar Energy to be stored.

addons.title: Evolutionary Stone
addons.text:
The Sun Stone has gained an additional property reminiscent of the evolutionary stones found in the Pokémon world. By exposing a compatible Pokémon to its energy, you can trigger an evolution that would normally require a Sun Stone, with the Pokémon gaining a noticeable boost compared to evolving with a regular Sun Stone.

The Sun Stone can also use large amounts of its stored Solar Energy to evolve any Pokémon that normally evolves through an Evolutionary Stone, transforming them into a completely new species akin to a Regional Form.

While Pokémon would no doubt find their new evolutions beneficial, the exact effects depend on the species, and some Pokémon may be negatively affected by their new evolution.

objects.text:
Have you ever been traveling and wished you had something to make your meals a little more flavored?

Well with this handy pouch, you can have any spice/seasoning you want, including fresh ones like cilantro! To use it, simply reach in and state which spice or seasoning you want (salt, pepper, saffron, paprika, ect.), remove a pinch amount, then add it to your food. 

A pinch will perfectly season your meal despite the pinch amount. You may use multiple different spices on the same meal without conflict.

The ingredients must be edible by the consumer. There is no limit on the amount of spices you can pull out.
objects.title: Heward's Handy Spice Pouch (D&D)

objects.text:
"Heh, I finally… met a Batman more prepared than I am."

You receive an advanced version of Batman's famous Shark Repellent Spray, a specialized chemical compound designed to repel, incapacitate, and neutralize sharks through a combination of artificial pheromones, chemical warning signals, and compounds developed with Wayne Enterprises technology.

Although it was originally created to repel ordinary sharks, this improved version has been modified to work against humanoid or hybrid beings with shark-related physiology, senses, or instincts, causing a strong rejection response that generates extreme discomfort, disorientation, temporary loss of aggression, and an instinctive urge to move away from the user or leave the area.

On the other hand, creatures completely unrelated to shark characteristics may not be fully affected, though they would still experience minor effects similar to pepper spray; in turn, the device possesses a high-precision dispersal system that allows it to be applied directly to a target or released as a short-range defensive cloud to protect the user during combat situations.​
objects.title: Shark Repellent Spray (DC Comics)

objects.text:
Venom is a highly addictive super-steroid originally derived from Hourman’s Miraclo formula. This powerful compound instantly enhances the user's physical abilities, transforming them into a hulking powerhouse of raw strength, with the effect lasting for 12 hours. When injected, Venom grants the ability to lift up to 15 tons, allowing feats such as effortlessly lifting and hurling massive boulders, breaking through reinforced steel doors, and hoisting an entire storage container with ease.

However, once the 12-hour limit expires, the user rapidly returns to their original state—or in some cases, an even weaker condition. Without a constant infusion, the body suffers immense withdrawal symptoms, including extreme weakness and terrifying hallucinations. This dependence makes prolonged use incredibly dangerous, as the body begins to crave the drug to maintain its enhanced state.

By selecting this choice, you receive an apparatus similar to Bane’s, allowing you to inject yourself with Venom at will. Unlike the original version, your supply is inexhaustible, and it does not come with its addictive properties.
objects.title: Venom (DC Comics)

addons.text: Your personal realm or property acts as the perfect permanent resting ground for the Tree of Might. Your Tree now has access to an endless amount of energy, which can produce the maximum amount of fruits constantly or as desired. Such that you can have it only produce a single fruit, which may hold the equivalent energy of any number of fruits per your discretion.
addons.title: Garden of Might

addons.text:
The Fruit and Seed of the Tree have merged with the Chakra fruit, creating an unholy combination which will empower far beyond what either would normally be able to on their own. Once eaten, you instantly gain Chakra beyond the Shinju and comparable to Ōtsutsuki who have eaten multiple Chakra Fruits. You also gain a powerful custom Doujutsu with power beyond the Rinne Sharingan. Also, you gain your choice of any 3 bloodlines from Naruto or entirely original bloodlines to your liking. 

After consuming the fruit, your physical abilities and other forms of supernatural energy from both fruits are further increased to 20 times compared to the original 15 times. In addition, the maximum benefit of eating a single fruit can grant is increased to 20 fold. Also, each time you consume an additional fruit, you may choose to further enhance your Doujutsu, a bloodline you possess, or develop an entirely new bloodline.
addons.title: Chakra Fruit of Might

objects.text:
The Tree of Might is a fearsome parasitic organism that takes the form of a colossal tree that stretches to the stratosphere and can be easily seen from space. Once planted deep into the land, it will quickly mature in a matter of days, upon which it will begin to drain the energy and life-force from the entire planet and all organisms which live upon it. 

After consuming enough energy, it will begin growing spiky orange fruits which, if eaten, will grant the eater a portion of the stolen energy and life-force taken by the tree. Once a fruit is eaten, the eater's physical attributes and all forms of supernatural energy will be increased by upwards of 15 times. Anyone who eats a fruit will also have their body experience a burst of increased muscle development. Their lifespan will also be increased based on the amount of energy within a fruit. Note that eating more fruit in rapid succession will see diminishing returns unless one waits for their body to finish processing the energy of previous fruits.

To start, you are given a single fruit that will increase your strength and supernatural energy by 15 fold. You will also discover a seed within this fruit, which you may then plant in a deep hole it will begin to grow. It will finish growing upwards of a week, after which it will begin to grow fruits at a rate based on the amount of energy it takes from the planet, with more life-abundant planets granting the most fruits. At most, you can expect the tree to grow around a dozen fruits a day. Within a month, the tree will completely drain a planet dry, leaving it a barren world filled with dead wastelands with no water left. 

After the tree is done, it will produce a single fruit with a seed, which can then be used on another world to harvest and repeat the process.
objects.title: Fruit and Seed of the Tree of Might (Dragon Ball Series)

objects.text:
You get a bag with two dozen Senzu Beans.

Mystical beans that restore a person's physical condition near-instantly to its physical peak, healing any kind of injury, including missing limbs once eaten. Fatigue disappears, and stamina and all your energy reserves are fully restored. While they can heal poisoning, they cannot heal people of sickness or diseases. Eating a Senzu Bean can keep a regular person fed for 10 days.
objects.title: Senzu Bean Bag (Dragon Ball Series)

objects.text:
The world crumbles. And yet light, forgetful of its own path, still seeks a follower to bestow guidance upon, summoning again grace once lost.

Even if you were battered banged, and dead, this small piece of grace will come to your aid just once if it's on your person. It will bring you back to life at somewhat damaged, and restore the remaining parts of to full health over time.

Each time you purchase, you’ll receive a number of Wending Grace equal to how many times you’ve bought it. Buy once and get 1, buy twice and get 2, buy three times and get 3 for a total of 6.

It's warm to the touch as well.
objects.title: Wending Grace (Elden Ring: Nightreign)

addons.text: Through Snack Supply’s connection to the world of Epic Battle Fantasy and your skill with swordsmanship, you have inherited the power, knowledge, skill, and equipment of Matt. This includes any skills, spells, or equipment Matt is potentially capable of learning or wielding in all games he’s in, as well as knowledge he would possess, such as how to properly wield all sorts of weapons from spears and swords to hammers and hockey sticks.
addons.title: Matt

addons.text: Through Snack Supply’s connection to the world of Epic Battle Fantasy and your skill as a mage, you have inherited the power, knowledge, skill, and equipment of Natalie. This includes any skills, spells, or equipment Natalie is potentially capable of learning or wielding in all games she’s in, as well as knowledge she would possess, such as a formal college education or how to properly defend yourself and fight using a staff.
addons.title: Natalie

addons.text: Through Snack Supply’s connection to the world of Epic Battle Fantasy and your skills with guns and machinery, you have inherited the power, knowledge, skill, and equipment of Lance. This includes any skills, spells, or equipment Lance is potentially capable of learning or wielding in all games he’s in, as well as knowledge he would possess, such as how to create the various mechanical Foes Lance canonically creates or how to drive a tank.
addons.title: Lance

addons.text: Through Snack Supply’s connection to the world of Epic Battle Fantasy and your skill as a ranger, you have inherited the power, knowledge, skill, and equipment of Anna. This includes any skills, spells, or equipment Anna is potentially capable of learning or wielding in all games she’s in, as well as knowledge she would possess, such as wood totem creation or flute playing.
addons.title: Anna

addons.text: Through Snack Supply’s connection to the world of Epic Battle Fantasy and your skill with swordsmanship and feline nature, you have inherited the power, knowledge, skill, and equipment of NoLegs. This includes any skills, spells, or equipment NoLegs is potentially capable of learning or wielding in all games he’s in, as well as knowledge he would possess, such as how to effectively wield weapons as a cat.
addons.title: NoLegs

objects.text:
You have obtained a bag filled with a variety of delicious snacks and drinks, each with special properties. Most of these foods function similarly to potions. They can be consumed to heal, recover magic power, dispel debuffs, provide temporary buffs, or even revive the recently deceased.

However, the most prized items in the bag are snacks categorized as "steroids," which boost a specific stat by 2% when consumed.

The bag holds 30 of each type of snack and refills itself every week. While inside the bag, the food remains fresh. Once taken outside of the bag, the items are subject to natural spoilage, and their effects degrade based on their overall condition.

For example, a pizza can heal a person back to 100% HP, but if left overnight in the fridge and not reheated, its effectiveness decreases to only 50% HP recovery when consumed.

The snack will be generic brands as default but it can come in the variety and flavors that you want but the benefit they provide will not change.
objects.title: Snack Supply (Epic Battle Fantasy)

objects.text: Somehow, you have received a Magic Muffin from Fairy World, a privilege normally only given to Godchildren who have managed to keep their Fairy Godparents for an entire year. The Magic Muffin, when consumed, grants one or more “Rule Free Wishes” per Da Rules of Fairy World, with the strength and scope of the wish based on the amount consumed. A few small crumbs can fulfill minor wishes, while consuming the entire muffin can rewrite reality at the macro scale without limits. Despite its unfathomable power, The Magic Muffin tastes terrible, and the one wish it Absolutely cannot grant is making it taste better.
objects.title: Magic Muffin (Fairly Odd Parents)

objects.text:
You have been given a vial of translator microbes. A minor species of telepathic bacterium that colonises the brainstem, these microbes translate any language the host hears into their native language. 

The only exceptions to this translation are concepts for which the main species does not have words for, during which they will simply default to not translating the word or phrase. 

These microbes can be injected into any organism and they will migrate to the brain over a span of one to five minutes, with a vial being enough to dose three people.
objects.title: Translator Microbes (Farscape)

objects.text:
You receive a phial of one of the Wizarding World's most fantastic and difficult potions: Felix Felicis, better known as Liquid Luck. The phial contains enough of the golden liquid to grant you 24 hours of extraordinary luck, resulting in a "perfect" day.

The phial will replenish any of the potion consumed, one week after it has been used. Typically, this potion is toxic if overused and can cause the user to become giddy and reckless. However, the version of the potion held within this phial lacks those drawbacks, at the cost that nothing can increase the amount of this variant of the potion you have available.
objects.title: Felix Felicis (Harry Potter)

objects.text: You now hold a pair of phials containing the legendary truth serum Veritaserum and its antidote. The phials replenish their contents as quickly as they are consumed, though anything that leaves the phial's containment and is not ingested soon after will disappear. Veritaserum is clear and odorless, capable of being mixed with any food or drink. Three drops are enough to compel the consumer to answer any question truthfully. It can be resisted by those who have drunk the antidote or who have strong mental defenses, but with enough time, they will ultimately reveal their secrets. The antidote, when ingested prior to Veritaserum, allows one to resist its compulsion. While Veritaserum still prevents the consumer from lying, the antidote provides enough leeway for the user to misdirect the questioner. When taken after Veritaserum, it acts as a swift counteragent, nullifying the potion's effects within a few seconds.
objects.title: Veritaserum (Harry Potter)

addons.text:
Now a third option is generated, born from an unexpected mutation. A multicolored crystallized heart with wings that contains within it an exact inscription of the ritual that connects to the Throne of Heroes. These hearts are capable of summoning a Nen Servant, a self-sustaining and fully autonomous existence thanks to its dual nature as both a parasite and a Heroic Spirit.

Your summon is no longer tied to your soul nor to Command Spells. Even so, it will remain loyal. Its appearance, personality, and abilities still depend on its compatibility with its creator/master. However, you also have the option of generating one using a catalyst. This catalyst must be connected or inspired by some entity whether real or fictional. But you can only summon an entity whose strength is on par with your soul’s level.

Their Noble Phantasms, or any kind of ultimate ability they possessed, are now treated as Hatsu, belonging both to the summoned Servant and to the summoner. They require no energy cost, as long as you fulfill the established conditions, you may activate them as many times as you wish.

From the qualities of the Nen Beast comes the ability to share part of its powers with its master. Through this connection, you can become a Demi-Servant, or temporarily inherit part of their powers in a basic form.

With a stronger and well-trained bond, you can directly transform into a Servant or Nen Beast yourself. With full mastery, you can maintain your transformations indefinitely, or integrate their inherited powers into something completely your own.

If you possess the Replenishing Command Seal (Type-Moon) upgrade, you gain the ability to create this mutated artifact as well, but only once. Its cooldown period is 1 month.
addons.title: Nen Summon

objects.text:
You have acquired a kind of crystallized multicolored heart with small feathered wings on its sides, the size of the palm of your hand. Upon eating it, a Nen Beast will be immediately generated.

Its appearance, personality, and soul strength will be based on those of its host. Optionally, you can choose an existing entity that has been shown or hinted at in the Hunter x Hunter series or create your own.

As a creature born from the Nen affinities of Conjuration, Manipulation, Emission, and finally cursing techniques, it naturally becomes a parasitic type that feeds on any supernatural energy both from the host and from the environment itself. Even if they lack any supernatural energy power, it will proceed to consume their life force or souls as a second option.

Its initial level of autonomy will be as basic and almost inert as in the case of Shizuku Murasaki. Over time and with the strength of the host’s soul, the entity will gain more autonomy. Even so, it will be absolutely loyal to the host and is very overprotective against any danger and negative influence.

As an entity completely independent from the host, it grants the advantage of counting as another Nen expert. It can even have its own Nen affinity, Hatsu, and make Vows. However, the means by which it performs all its powers is through the host as a conduit. They can evolve and grow together with the host.

Due to the bond between the Nen Beast and the host, it will end up awakening and even amplifying the host’s natural talent in the fundamentals of Nen, like in the case of Tserriednich Hui Guo Rou. This blessing does not grant knowledge or experience; at the very least, you can access the powers of your own Nen Beast and try to develop your own foundation of Nen from it.
objects.title: Nen Beast (Hunter X Hunter)

objects.text:
Before you is a completed Tan elixir—being the finished product, it can gift those who drink it immortality or revive the dead. However, it is not without risk, since you will have a high chance of undergoing arborification if you're unable to handle the Flower Tao's influence.

Should you be one of the few lucky ones, the elixir shall make you into a true immortal, causing you to cease aging entirely and allowing you to return from death itself so long as you still cling to life.

It'll also grant a never-ending supply of lifeforce (Tao) equivalent to millions, bestowing you with inhuman physical abilities that far surpass even Rien's own, alongside regeneration that can heal any wound—all simply due to the sheer amount involved.
objects.title: Elixir of Life (Jigokuraku)
Datenseki (Kagurabachi)
objects.text:
Somehow you've gotten your hands on something potent indeed...and also dangerous. You've acquired 20kg of Datenseki, a mysterious ore that exponentially amplifies the spiritual power channeled through it.

When used, Datenseki magnifies any supernatural power tenfold, causing said power to manifest in a visual form, visible even to those without supernatural senses. In amounts as small as 5 grams, this can provide a massive boost to even the weakest fighters, but will cause death after a few minutes. While you will not die from using it in this manner, you will be thoroughly exhausted once the boost has worn off.

In its raw form, the sheer power it conveys is enough to cause a person using it to explode with extreme force. However, in the hands of a skilled enough craftsman, it could be alloyed with other metals to produce weapons of extreme power, requiring it to be worked into the metal in trace amounts, forging micro-veins to properly and stably channel power. 

Your best bet will be to forge the Datenseki into a weapon of some sort, or to find someone with the skill to do so...

addons.title: Super Alloy
addons.text:
You absolute madman! Datenseki was already dangerous enough on its own, but now you've gone and combined it with other supernatural materials?! You're lucky it doesn't just explode in your face!

Well, the good news is that the material that Datenseki has combined with has been massively enhanced. In the case of Soul Materials, Acceleron now grants speed that can cut down dozens of men in the blink of an eye, Graviton now grants actual control over gravity, Sacred Ashwood can now be grown and manipulated at will, spells cast through Magicite can now obliterate an entire fortress, Helio's light possesses sharpness to cut through just about any defense, and so on and so forth. The only Soul Materials not affected by this fusion are Nega-Plating and Evermetal, though the latter stabilizes the Datenseki by a great deal.

Ichor Steel, meanwhile, now boosts any enchantments placed on it to the level of any 15 SP power, though it is now hard capped at 3 enchantments per object created with it. Additionally, offensive magics are reduced to almost nothing when used against it.

objects.text:
You now hold a magical Golden Ticket that opens the door to the world of cinema. This world operates by its own rules, following the scripts and genre conventions of the selected film.

To enter, tear the ticket into two parts: the “visitor’s portion” and the “control portion.” The “control portion” will serve as an anchor, while the “visitor’s portion” will allow you to open the door back to your original world. Both characters and objects can pass through this door, but all supernatural abilities and properties will disappear if they are foreign to the world of original reality. However, this is just as true for you; you will be required to obey the laws of the genre of the selected film.

The entry point is always located at the screen, and the return door can be placed in any convenient location. This part of the ticket also allows you to open doors to other movies, both in the real world and in the world of the selected film. Keep in mind that time in the movie may pass differently than in your reality. When you leave the movie, you will pause it.

It’s important to note that your ticket is compatible with any form of media: movies, TV shows, audio recordings, comics, or images. This may affect some details, but the core functionality will remain the same. Photos and newsreels will most likely transport you to a world indistinguishable from reality.
objects.title: Golden Ticket (Last Action Hero)

objects.text:
NZT is a nootropic drug that is used to enhance human memory and intelligence. A pharmaceutical miracle, the pill allows those who take it to turn their brain into a veritable biological supercomputer, increasing the intelligence of the user to such a degree that the myth of humans only using 10% of the brain might seem true. You have gained five pills and will find them replenished every week.
 
The pill has a variety of supernatural capabilities, not limited to just the increased level of intellectual and cognitive proficiency, allowing for a massive amount of information to be processed without information overload and running countless simulations and calculations that would otherwise be impossible, rapidly correlating the information that the user has processed. 
 
The user can flawlessly remember and recall everything that they have ever experienced or learned in their lifetime with no risk, with unlimited storage capacity for information. The user can rapidly learn skills from preexisting data. The user also gains the ability to plan or find a path leading to success from data that has been analyzed flawlessly, create elaborate plans, and execute them perfectly. With unlimited storage capacity for information and with supernatural dexterity and muscle control gained from the drug, you can copy any movement or action after seeing it performed, and you are even able to control your vocal cords to emulate someone else's voice.

The pill has a variety of other effects, such as supernatural charisma, synesthesia, and the ability to perform multiple tasks at once, such as solving a Rubik’s cube with one hand and making a perfect copy of the Mona Lisa with the other. However, the pill also has a variety of side effects, such as memory loss, extreme paranoia, accelerated aging, blurred vision, losing track of time, and death to name a few.
objects.title: NZT-48 (Limitless)

addons.text:
You have replicated the "Ergo" joint project between the Crudelis family of Atlas, Wuzhiqi of the Summit Court, and Ziz from the Wandering Sea. By merging the divine bodies of Type-Moon and the Beyonder characteristics of LOTM, you have created an ideal path for consuming the divine as a means of usurping their divine throne.

Within each suitcase, you effectively have a significant part of the mutilated corpse of a deity, which, through alchemical magecraft, has been brewed into a drinkable potion, conferring a part of the deity's power, authority, and status when drunk.

With each potion you drink, your Od generation and output increase exponentially, and you may also develop racial traits depending on the pathway, with visionary turning you into a pure-blooded dragon, and multiple pathways under the Chaos Sea turning you into a genuine abrahamic angel.

This leaves your initial strength at Sequence Two, but with all the abilities and authority of your pathway, just weaker and more limited. With time and practice, you digest the concentrated divine essence you have consumed, and you grow into your full divine power, leaving you on par with other Sequence Zero: True Gods.

Through consuming the divine, you too shall share in the vaulted status of godhood.
addons.title: Great Old Dominator Diet Supplement

objects.text: You receive an antique 19th-century Victorian leather suitcase. This suitcase contains everything a person needs to ascend to divinity. This includes ten pre-prepared beyonder potions and a short pamphlet containing the rituals needed to maintain your sanity when you advance, as well as some details of the acting method. As the acting method is not universal even for beyonders of the same pathway, the pamphlet only gives information about the acting method itself, that is, the need to act according to the potion label and the reminder that they are only acting. Notably, the potions are stored in special indestructible 200 ml glass bottles, which, unlike normal glass bottles, can safely contain beyonder characteristics for prolonged periods of time without absorbing the beyonder characteristics and becoming a sealed artifact. These potion bottles are labeled according to the sequence the potion contains, so the seventh sequence sun potion would be labeled ‘’Sequence 7:Solar High Priest’’. As the uniqueness exists in the form of a Sequence 0 potion, it cannot be used as a sealed artifact. Unlike Beyonder (Lord of the Mysteries), these contain the same risks as the native Beyonder pathway system. For each multiselect, you get another suitcase containing a different pathway's potions. You can choose any canon pathway, even the paths not present on Earth, such as the pathways of the outer deities.
objects.title: Beyonder Sequence Zero Ascension Kit (Lord of the Mysteries)

objects.text: A dose of Abraham Erskine's Supersoldier Serum, enough to make one person into the next Captain America. For immediate results, inject into multiple places and bombard the patient with Vita Radiation, otherwise the serum will gradually take effect over the next year. Purchase includes recipe and Vita Ray machine blueprints. Good luck powering the machine, vibranium frisbee sold seperately.
objects.title: Erskine Serum (Marvel)

addons.text:
You are not just any Black Panther; you have inherited your talents from the greatest Black Panther, T'Challa. You are a genius in not only any field of science you decide to pursue but also in combat and ruling your kingdom. 

As a great king, not only do you flourish, but your kingdom must also follow suit. Like Wakanda, your kingdom has been granted time to grow without the intervention of lesser men. Not only that, but being a part of your kingdom or community promotes innovation and draws in geniuses to join your leadership.

Lastly, you have gained an ancestral vibranium spear used by the second Wakandan king, called the Spear of Bashenga.
addons.title: Heir of Wakanda

objects.text:
You are given four heart-shaped herbs, which you can plant and grow more of with the right environment. Once taken, this herb increases the user's speed, agility, strength, endurance, proprioceptiveness, durability, and healing to Super-Soldier levels.

Along with this increase, the herb enhances senses to a superhuman level, allowing them to hear the heartbeats of their enemies, have night vision, and track others by scent. They are also granted a higher magical affinity and a strong affinity towards necromancy, with them being able to learn to form ectoplasmic constructs through significant time and training. 

However, as a result of being magical in nature, this herb may reject those Bast would find unworthy, but you will instinctively know if they will be accepted or not if you attempt to give it to them. You are guaranteed to be worthy if you choose to consume the herb.

You gain four antidotes for the heart-shaped herb, which will remove its abilities.
objects.title: Heart-Shaped Herbs (Marvel)

objects.text:
You’ve been given a small supply (10 doses) of Mutant Growth Hormone from random donors. 

M.G.H (Sometimes called IGH, Diamond, or Banshee) is a drug usually extracted from Mutants, Inhumans, and Mutates. When used on baseline Humans it will give them temporary superpowers like Flight, Teleportation, super-intellect, etc. Most of the time this power is derived from whoever the initial donor happened to be. 

When used on powered individuals however, it increases their own abilities not unlike a steroid for power use. This is strong enough that even depowered mutants could return to their baseline strength after one dose.
objects.title: Mutant Growth Hormone (Marvel)

objects.text: A vial of venom from a radioactive spider. Enough to give one person spider powers. This dose is a little weak, it will allow you to walk on walls and ceilings, lift cars, outrun mopeds, and sense that there is danger... somewhere, thanks to spideytingle. Web shooters sold seperately.
objects.title: Radioactive-Spider Venom (Marvel)

objects.text:
An apple for a god.

If this apple is eaten, you will obtain a metaphorical shield that will absorb all damage you take, up to 90% of your durability. You will be able to regenerate your entire body in 20 seconds as long as your brain isn't completely destroyed. You are also completely immune to heat and fire, and take 80% less damage.

The effects last for 5 minutes, and you receive a new one every week within a pocket dimension for Gapples that only you can access, with no limit on how many you can have.
