It does not remove diseases or poisons, as it only heals you from the symptoms.
objects.title: Enchanted Golden Apple (Minecraft)

objects.text:
You have obtained the strongest, yet weakest potion that could possibly exist within Minecraft. This potion has every positive and negative effect that is within minecraft at the maximum possible potency.

A sip of this will make it last for 5 minutes, but if you drink the last sip, the effects will become permanent.

Drink wisely.
objects.title: How Did We Get Here? (Minecraft)

addons.text:
Your Chakra Fruit has been blessed with the essence of life from the world of One Piece. 

Granting you a evolved body that has the best traits of every species shown or referenced in the world of said series.

This includes every animal and Humanoid sentient species such as Fishman, Lunarian, Giant, etc...

Lastly, even if you do not purchase Haki (One Piece) you gain the ability and talent to rival the strongest and most skilled users of Haki.
addons.title: One Evolution

objects.text:
Every thousand years, a God Tree produces a Chakra Fruit—something that human legends warn to never be touched. These fruits are immensely powerful, producing medicine that grants the consumer godlike power along with extended youth and longevity.

Upon consumption, you gain monstrous chakra reserves equal to the Shinju, and a powerful dojutsu—the Rinne-Sharingan, with all the powers of the Rinnegan and Sharingan. Two bloodline limits also appear—Kaguya's All-Killing Ash Bones, able to instantly turn anything they hit into dust, and the Byakugan.
objects.title: Chakra Fruit (Naruto)

objects.text: Hero water is a special liquid that can increase somenone's chakra --or any supernatural energy for that matter-- by ten-fold when they drink it, at the cost of shortening their lifespan to one-tenth of its current length. Usually it is temporary, but this increase in supernatural energy will stick with them for the entirety of their very-short-lives.
objects.title: Hero Water (Naruto)

objects.text: When you hear the magical jingle... ...just make a wish and snap the willow, the One Wish Willow. What are you wishing for? Make your wish come true with the One Wish Willow! Please wish responsibly wishes may cause unexpected behavior violent tendencies and self mutilation do not use if you're experiencing insecurity or extreme obsession. You receive a box that contains an apparently normal vintage toy in the shape of a plastic willow branch that shines with cheap lights and plays a mildly annoying jingle when taken out of it's container. However, this toy is anything but normal. Once you speak your wish out loud and snap the willow, you'll find your wish immediately coming true. This can be anything mundane from a new vehicle, bringing back a loved one, and maybe even a power with an SP cost that does not exceed the willow's, but any wishes that involve rewriting the laws of the universe to an excessive degree won't work and you'll find the willow to be indestructible no matter how strong you are. You must be careful, you'll only get one wish and once the willow is broken your wish can't be changed by you. There is nothing stopping you from creating copies of the willow using other powers or Objects than can do so (yes, that includes using the willow to wish for a million willows). But you'll still only get one wish. This means that if you have already made a wish to a willow, you'll be unable to break another one. You can ask a friend to wish for you, but this must be done by their own will, so while mastering them to wish for you won't work, threatening or bribing them will. (You can’t wish for the ability to snap more than one willow, you'll have to find another power to do so)
objects.title: One Wish Willow (Obsession)

addons.text:
A Devil Fruit user’s weakness to water stems from the fact that by consuming a Devil Fruit, they have become something Mother Nature, manifesting as the sea, sees as foreign to the world, causing her to weaken them when exposed to her power.

You, however, have found a way around this weakness, that being your Cultivation Technique. Your Cultivation involves harmonizing with the energy of the world, and thus, as you advance and become more in tune with the world, your weakness to water begins to subside, with Mother Nature once more acknowledging you as something that belongs in this world.
addons.title: To Belong Once More

addons.text:
Your Devil Fruit has been transformed by some energy released by your Esper gene. It has now become an Esper Gene Fruit, containing a dormant Esper super gene. Anyone who consumes this fruit will awaken as an F-grade Esper with the ability contained within the Fruit.

This gives the fruit a much higher power limit, as nothing prevents the consumer from reaching beyond a grade or even X grade, though they will start somewhat weaker than an ordinary Devil Fruit user.

This liberates the weakness to water, as Espers have no fear of the sea, though Haki remains effective.
addons.title: Esper Gene Fruit

addons.text:
Due to your insanely precise control of your own body, eerily similar to the Seimei Kikan of CP9 member Kumadori, you have gained an innate awareness of the minor changes that come from eating a Devil Fruit.

While more obvious with a Zoan, it is still possible with either Paramecia or Logia to detect the "wavelength" of the Fruit you consumed.

Should you choose to, you can now distort & manipulate it.

This achieves a new ability displayed only by Tony Tony Chopper after the timeskip, which you take a step further:

You can now add new specialized transformations or "modes" to your Devil Fruit ability.

At first, there is significant strain to create and transform into a mode, but with time and training, you can shift between your base form and other modes as easily as breathing, the difficulty proportional to the change in body mass.

You aren't limited in their number or the Fruit type either. Zoans can unlock physical transformations easier.

You can alter how a Paramecia's power is expressed.

Eg-: changing Horo-Horo no Mi's mechanic of hypodermic finger needles to loaded projectile quill hairs or mist from your pores, changing the Kilo-Kilo no Mi to manipulate the weight of objects by touch instead of your own, turning the Bomu-Bomu no Mi into a pseudo-logia of a perpetual explosion, etc.

With Logia, you can have an intimate degree of control over the aspects of an element, even beyond what is possible by the laws of physics. Eg-: changing fire or lightning into liquid plasma, turning magma into obsidian, making fantastical & living plants via the Mori-Mori no Mi, etc.

It is also an accelerated path to unlocking the Fruit's Awakening.
addons.title: Rumble Ball Rock!

objects.text:
You receive a Devil Fruit. It can be any known or unknown Devil Fruit, ranging from completely useless to incredibly powerful. All Devil Fruits share the same weaknesses, though some Devil Fruits possess their own unique weaknesses. Someone who has eaten a Devil Fruit cannot swim due to the fact that when they are submerged in water, they are sapped of their physical strength and energy.

This does not cause their abilities to become deactivated. This is mostly still water. You can still take a shower, and you are not drained by just becoming wet; you must be submerged, and Haki can reverse or nullify the effects of a Devil Fruit.
objects.title: Devil Fruit (One Piece)

addons.text:
Being the peak of humanity makes you the perfect candidate for a Monster Cell, elevating your powers to that of a Demon Level Threat, allowing you to give A Class and even some S Class Heroes a run for their money.

Every ounce of your power is brought to its highest possible ceiling, with the potential to ascend beyond them through training. Consuming more Monster Cells can now heal, or cause rapid adaptions for you, on top granting a greater surge of power.
addons.title: Success!

objects.text:
This mass of raw flesh and virus pulses like a beating heart in your hand, carrying a silent whisper of temptation to consume it. Should you give in, you will undergo a physical and mental transformation, becoming reborn as a monster. 

Upon completion, you will have the power to be considered a Tiger Level Threat by the Hero Association, able to take over a city and compete with B to middling A Class Heroes by yourself with moderate difficulty. Additionally, you will develop a unique set of powers and abilities drawn from your inherent potential and desires. If you already have powers, they will be amplified and mutate based on your monster form.

You can choose to become one of the many Tiger Level or below monsters in One Punch Man, let your transformation be random, or create your own. Consuming more Monster Cells can amplify your powers, and even cause mutations for them, but aren't enough to make a difference against Demon Level and above monsters. 

Finally, you have no fear of abandoning your humanity nor facing any backlash during or after your transformation.

Each purchase bestows you 5 Monster Cells.
objects.title: Monster Cell (One Punch Man)

addons.text: As a result of being a demigod and being able to tolerate more, your packet has expanded in size. Instead of merely being granted a packet that contains three squares of Ambrosia and two bottles of Nectar, you are now granted double that. Alongside this increase in size, your packets now refill themselves after 12 hours instead of 24. Lastly, even among demigods, you have a particularly high receptiveness and tolerance to the food of the gods.
addons.title: Expanded Supplies

addons.text:
Through elevating yourself to true Godhood you have instead gained access to pure Nectar and Ambrosia. While your new packet of pure ambrosia and nectar still regenerates after 24 hours, you now can conjure both your pure version and the demigod version through divine power. 

This pure nectar and ambrosia is so strong that even a whiff of its scent can send an weak demigod into a semi-permanent coma, and as such its effects on you are just as powerful. Not only that but Nectar and Ambrosia are strengthened by how strong you are. Ambrosia and nectar don't merely boost your regeneration but instead, just enhance everything about you. Lastly, your ambrosia and nectar now gain the ability to elevate others who are close to apotheosis up to godhood.

Note: Path to Divinity require you to achieve Godhood to conjure Ambrosia and Nectar.
addons.title: Feast of the Gods

objects.text:
You have been granted a packet that contains three squares of Ambrosia and two bottles of Nectar, which fully refills after 24 hours. Ambrosia, simply put, is the food of the Greek gods while Nectar is the drink of the gods and, as such, is very powerful. 

By merely eating a small piece of a square, a demigod can massively accelerate their regeneration and also temporarily negate the effects of exhaustion, but if they eat too much then they may start "burning up" getting a fever, and feeling delirious, or in extreme cases die. While a demigod will merely start burning up when they eat too much a mortal eating even a bit of pure ambrosia can "turn their blood to fire and bones to sand," but there is a simple solution to this: don't eat a lot and heavily dilute it. With time a mortal body can be adapted to handle a small portion of this but it will never truly reach what a demigod can. Nectar has overall the same effects as ambrosia but is instead in a liquid format and is weaker.

Lastly, as the food of the gods ambrosia and nectar don't just taste good; they mimic the taste of your favorite meal and make you feel like you're home no matter where you are. Alternatively, if ambrosia is added to any food, then that food's flavor and effects, both mundane and supernatural, will be majorly enhanced.

Alternatively, you can get 2 vials of Nectar instead of a square of ambrosia or vice versa.

Note: If you are a mortal you are a slight exception to this rule with ambrosia not burning you up in the same way but you will still have a lower tolerance than even the weakest demigods.
objects.title: Food of the Gods (Percy Jackson)

objects.text: You have a small bottle containing about 100 pills in the shape of various monsters from Greek myths. Upon consumption the eater becomes immune to magic for up to 12 hours. Any ongoing spells or transfigurations upon them are also dispelled, putting them back into their true form. You may need to eat multiple to dispel more powerful curses, though be aware that side effects of eating more than twice a week include headache, nausea, glitter sneezes, spontaneous combustion and even death depending on your physical/spiritual constitution. The eater is still able to use their own magic as they please. Warning: The pill only makes the user immune to Magic, a Fireball to the face would be just explosive as ever.
objects.title: Hermes' Multivitamins (Percy Jackson)

addons.text:
The Branch of Reincarnation shifts in your hands, the veins of its wooden hilt pulsing faintly as though something greater has awoken within it. The once-blank tag no longer erases forbidden names. Instead, it accepts them. Now you can inscribe the names of the “Kings” — historical figures who stood above all others, who defined eras, reshaped nations, or embodied the very peak of their craft. Warriors who carved empires, philosophers whose words steered civilizations, rulers whose shadow bent the course of history — their return is now within your reach.

When you invoke a King, their power flows into you with a clarity far beyond that of a normal Returned. The imprint of their will is stronger, but the Branch itself tempers the burden: the mental influence of their obsessions is dulled, no longer threatening to drown your own mind entirely. While subtle habits and impulses may remain, you retain full control of your identity.
addons.title: King Returner

addons.text:
Along with the Branch, you receive the Returner Chronicle — a reference book containing all available names for inscription on the tag. It describes the historical figures that can be selected, as well as the powers they grant, the mental influences they impose, the changes in appearance, and the impulses they trigger.

The reference also shows possible risks: attraction to certain habits, intrusive thoughts, tendencies toward aggression, or other consequences. It serves as the primary source of information on what to expect from each figure and which one may suit you best.

If you do not have the "King Returner" addon, you will not receive any information about them.
addons.title: Returner Chronicle

addons.text: With this, the Branch of Reincarnation expands beyond its original limits. The Branch no longer confines you to one historical figure. You may now inscribe any historical figure's name upon its tag and freely assume their form. Transformation is immediate and repeatable, letting you shift between your own self and the chosen figure without restriction.
addons.title: Branch of Returning Names

objects.text:
You obtain a unique knife with a tree-like hilt and an intricately curved blade. Unlike other knives of its kind, this one has a blank name tag attached to the end of the handle. If you write the name of a specific historical figure on the tag and then slit your own throat with the knife, you will gain phenomenal powers that represent the history of that person. You become the Returner of that figure, taking on their distinctive traits of appearance and fragments of their personality. These traits do not replace you completely but rather layer over your own, shaping a new composite self. Unlike the original, you don’t need to be a descendant or reincarnation of that figure.

However, there are limits. You can only choose “normal” historical figures — philosophers, scientists, artists, warriors, and others whose strength never exceeded human bounds. “Kings” — those who reached the absolute peak of their specialty or wielded influence far greater than others — are beyond your reach. Whenever you try to inscribe the name of such a “King,” it simply vanishes from the tag.

Despite the power you gain, you are still vulnerable to the influence of the Returner's personality. This mental pull always manifests, though in a weaker form: from mild compulsions toward certain habits or interests, to dangerous obsessions — such as an overwhelming urge to paint, a thirst for violence, or even the drive to craft furniture from human flesh. The brighter and more intense the figure’s life was, the stronger their imprint will be on you.

Unlike the original, you do not lose the ability to return to your own form. After the first use of the Stem, you may freely switch between identities, blending your own self with the legacy of chosen figures.
objects.title: Branch of Reincarnation (Petals of Reincarnation)

addons.text:
With each bag of five rare candies, you also receive a single Mission Completion Card, appearing like a holographic credit card with a selection of any active quests you have displayed on the surface of the card.

By tapping one of these quests and confirming your choice, you can instantly complete the quest at a minimal completion rating. This does not actually "complete" the quest; it only completes it as far as the underlying reward system is concerned.

This also works on advancement missions, allowing you to break through any bottlenecks you might face with ease.
addons.title: Mission Completion Cards (Legendary Mechanic)

objects.text:
Originally developed to work with pokémon, these small round candies will give any being, pokémon or not, who eats them the effects of half a year of training. This training can be split however you like between physical, magical, technical, and mental growth per candy eaten. 

It would be as if you did six months of hard work to the best of your abilities and learned new skills or magical spells that you would have logically gotten in that time. As such the main advantage to these candies is the reduction in effect and time needed to master any skill or ability. 

However, these magical candies are not without drawbacks. The main disadvantage is that they do not take into account outside people or events that would have helped you improve over those six months of training such as teachers and the skills that they would have taught you or random ideas that you would not have come up with on your own. 

The experience gained acts as if a theoretical you trained by themselves in a predictable manner and as a result, you now possess the powers and skills that you would have logically uncovered in that training. This does include physical and magical changes to yourself such as increases in muscle mass or mana reserves. However, it does not include things such as making items or enchanting equipment that you would have made in those 6 months.

Each purchase gives you a bag of 5 rare candies.
objects.title: Rare Candy (Pokemon)

addons.text: You now gain full knowledge of the creation use and modification of Chemical X and its variants. This includes the more powerful though unstable Chemical W, Antidote X which removes powers granted. You also gain the knowledge of Chemical Z from Powerpuff Girls Z and its uses. Chemical X and its variants have many possible ways to be used but careful caution should be exercised else undesired outcomes occur.
addons.title: Chemical X-Pertise

objects.text:
You are granted a single vial of the infamous chemical concoction—Chemical X. You may either drink this vial and gain the powers of the Powerpuff Girls, or use the vial to create a single Powerpuff child. Any Powerpuff you create will treat you as a parent and be a kind person. The powers this vial grants are great and many, including strength able to destroy entire cities, speed and flight at sub-light speeds, a powerful heat vision, and vastly improved senses. It also grants the ability to survive in extreme environments such as underwater or in space, and insane durability far beyond physical strength based on limited Toon Force. In addition to a grab bag of other powers from the very start, such as control over the elements, invisibility, voice-based powers, etc. Additionally, one may manifest more esoteric powers during combat or heightened emotional states. Those who are empowered by Chemical X have deeply colored eyes and possess a colored aura; should you drink the vial, you can select your color scheme. These powers can grow through training and with age—in time, your strength will be able to destroy planets, and your speed will improve to such a point that you will gain the ability to travel in time by moving faster than light.

Be warned that this power lies in the blood of its bearers and thus may be tampered with. However, doing so will be extremely difficult.

If paired with the Inheritance perk, any Powerpuff child you create can inherit your powers at your discretion.
objects.title: Chemical X Vial (Powerpuff Girls)

addons.text:
Normally, upon the death of an immortal, their remnant will and obsession merge with the heavenly power inside their aperture to form a land or a heavenly spirit, depending on the strength of the immortal aperture.  

Instead, when you die, your aperture will expend some Earth Qi and Heaven Qi to truly resurrect you as a human, allowing you to reclaim your aperture to continue your cultivation journey as if it never ended.

If your aperture is significantly damaged, this will instead resurrect you as a fresh Rank 6 Gu Immortal, with an initial immortal aperture size equivalent to your original starting point.

This causes no memory loss and is true resurrection.
addons.title: Perpetual Human Spirit

addons.text:
Rather than using the Second Aperture Gu directly, you have used it to further refine the Sovereign Immortal Fetus Gu. This gives you another seven hellish layers to counterbalance the nine heavenly layers, forming a harmonic resonance that creates self-replenishing dao marks that constantly regenerate Heaven Qi and Earth Qi as the aperture expands.

These self-replenishing dao marks leave you not needing to place down your aperture to refill, and even a hundred immortal ascensions taking place at once isn't enough to surpass your qi regeneration speeds.

Your seven hellish layers are ''underneath'' the five regions in the same manner the nine heavens are ''above'' them. These hells are underground caves and caverns, some with vast open spaces akin to the Hollow Earth, while others feature complex cave systems. The differing environments provide suitable conditions for various resources to grow and thrive. 

The size of each layer doubles, reaching 694.500 square kilometers in size. Now with seventeen layers in total, your aperture reaches 11.806.500 square kilometers.

With this also comes an increase in immortal essence generation; for every year inside the aperture, you generate 324 beads of immortal essence, which is equivalent to 54 beads every day in the outside world's time.
addons.title: Seven Hells

addons.text:
You have refined countless numbers of Einzbern homunculi into the Sovereign Immortal Fetus Gu, infusing the sovereign immortal aperture with the concept of ''Magic Circuits''. The magic circuits that the Sovereign Immortal Fetus Gu produces exist as leyline systems within the aperture and extend into the body in a root-like manner.

As the immortal aperture of a Gu Immortal is both a genuine small world and a direct part of their body, you have become something akin to a self-contained celestial body, and thus share the same existence scale as all other celestial bodies.

You can dilute the immortal essence beads you produce into magical energy with the same conversion rate as diluting them into primeval essence, giving you nigh-boundless amounts of magical energy.

Your leylines also act as primeval springs, and passively produce primeval essence stones and mana stones. You can also expend three green grape immortal essence beads to create one immortal essence stone.

You can use your aperture as a bootleg magecraft foundation, allowing you to reverse-engineer the abilities of Gu as magecraft formulas, enhancing your combative power beyond the borrowed powers of Gu. Your Dao Marks also enhance and give resistance to related spells to the same extent they enhance Gu.
addons.title: Primeval Veins of Heaven and Earth

addons.text: You have refined the Philosophy Foundation into the Sovereign Immortal Fetus Gu, elevating the foundation of heaven and earth within your aperture to new heights. You are the Will of the Heavens of your inner world, allowing you to control calamities and tribulations that occur within your aperture or inside the apertures of natives. You can strengthen or weaken them, speed them up or slow them down, choose which calamity arrives, or even halt their arrival entirely. The only thing you cannot control is the equivalence between the strength of the calamities and tribulations and the Dao Marks it provides when passed. Your Sovereign Immortal Body integrates the immortal Xian body, inheriting its eternal lifespan and eternal youth, allowing you to bask in the light of Wisdom Gu for as long as you desire, without succumbing to old age. You now start with 100.000 Dao Marks of every path, which greatly increases the starting size of your layers, also increasing to 2.083.500 square kilometers, for a total of 20.835.000 square kilometers. With Seven Hells, your layers reach 4.167.000 square kilometers in size for a total of 70.839.000 square kilometers. The Philosophy Foundation integrates into your aperture to become a proper magecraft system suitable for your imitation gu world aperture, which your natives can use for their own ends. This also allows your natives to be naturally born with magic circuits. You can also deliberately give magic circuits to living beings. Magecraft no longer depends on Mystery, instead, it draws power from your Dao Marks, significantly increasing the reliability of magecraft. You can effortlessly convert magecraft formulas into gu recipes and reverse-engineer gu recipes into magecraft formulas, providing you with a vast library of gu recipes and spells alike. You draw in otherworldly demon souls and reincarnate them into native beings within your aperture, which allows you to obtain the dao marks they carried with them from their original world when they die. Within your aperture, an imitation of the root's very own avatar is born as a heavenly spirit bearing the form and general personality of Ryougi Shiki, it fully recognizes you as its master, and is capable of managing your aperture in your stead, it can use your gu and immortal essence to obtain combat power roughly on par with your own, giving you an edge when facing calamities and tribulations.
addons.title: Foundation of Heaven and Earth

addons.text: Your Sovereign Immortal Aperture is automatically claimed as your Sovereign Domain; your rule over your Immortal Aperture cannot be challenged or contested in any way. The only exception to this is if you are dead, in which case the Choice of Resolution becomes your Immortal Aperture's inheritance requirement. The Sovereign Domain is a type of Battlefield Killer Move set up within your entire Immortal Aperture. This uses your existing Rule Path Dao Marks, and thus does not cause conflict or interfere with the function of your Immortal aperture. This also boosts the Rule Path Dao Marks by ten, increasing to 10.000 or, if you have Foundation of Heaven and Earth, to 1.000.000. Upon incarnating into the Sovereign Immortal Body and Aperture you obtain Quasi-Supreme Grandmaster attainment in the Rule Path, pushing your understanding of rules and laws of all things, including the laws of heaven and earth, to the very limits of heaven and earth, allowing you to create rule path immortal killer moves in mere moments, and use rule path dao marks found in nature. If you have any of the upgrades for Sovereign Domain, they are integrated into the Battlefield Killer Move Sovereign Domain as well.
addons.title: Sovereign Immortal

addons.text: At the center of the Mini-Central Continent there lies a new Secluded Domain of Heaven and Earth, that being the Heaven Piercing Dungeon Tower, which takes the form of a massive tower three kilometers in diameter piercing though the skies reaching into the nine heavens, and if you have Seven Hells it also pierces all the way down into the seven hells. This Dungeon Tower naturally absorbs Heaven Qi and Earth Qi and draws on information from the River of Time to recreate innumerable numbers of replica inheritance grounds and form wild gu of all paths in extremely high numbers, including a decent amount of wild Immortal Gu. The replica Inheritance Grounds range from mortal inheritances or even imitation blessed lands and grotto-heavens containing the recreated inheritances that otherwise would be lost to time. These replica blessed lands and grotto-heavens contain one-third of the dao marks the true version did, but can be annexed without needing the corresponding attainment level. The tower is still incredibly dangerous and contains many dangers, not just those within the recreated inheritance grounds, but also a high number of beasts and desolate beasts, depending on how high you climb. There is one entrance within every layer of the Sovereign Immortal Aperture, and thus, it can be used to travel between them.
addons.title: Heaven Piercing Dungeon Tower

addons.text:
Your inborn attainment has harmonised with the inherent Dao Marks within the Sovereign Immortal Body and Aperture, equalizing your path attainment and the number of Dao Marks you possess of that path. You gain attainment from Dao Marks, and gain Dao Marks from attainment.

This scales according to the average Dao Mark number for each rank. 10,000 Dao Marks correspond to Grandmaster attainment, 100,000 Dao Marks correspond to Great Grandmaster attainment, and 500,000 Dao Marks correspond to Quasi-Supreme Grandmaster attainment. This works both ways, meaning possessing Great Grandmaster attainment would grant you 100,000 Dao Marks of that path.

This ability cannot elevate your attainment beyond Quasi-Supreme Grandmaster. However, if you possess Supreme Grandmaster attainment in a path, you will possess 1,000,000 Dao Marks of that path.

Finally, your Dao Marks also develop partial self-replenishing. Should your Dao Marks fall below the amount corresponding to your attainment through consumption, sacrifice, theft, or destruction, they will slowly regenerate until they return to the proper equilibrium. Likewise, if your attainment is reduced through methods such as the expulsion of true meaning, it will gradually recover until it once again matches the Dao Marks of that path, though this restoration cannot elevate your attainment to Supreme Grandmaster unless your understanding of that path still surpasses the limits of heaven and earth.
addons.title: Attainment-Dao Mark Equilibrium

addons.text:
Your Sovereign Immortal Aperture now perpetually exists in its peak state. It now possesses a powerful restorative factor, allowing it to return to its previous peak state whenever it is damaged. Any destruction or damage inflicted upon the aperture, its layers, terrain, structures, and resources will gradually regenerate back to their optimal condition. Even in the case of complete annihilation, the aperture will restore itself fully within three months at most. This restoration applies to all parts of the immortal aperture and its resources, though living beings are not restored through this process.

Your Sovereign Immortal Body Dao Marks can now paradoxically exist in a state of both conflicting and non-conflicting simultaneously, allowing your Sovereign Immortal Aperture to become all-encompassing and all-accepting, embracing all conflict and contradiction while also conflicting with and resisting any harmful effects or those you will to be opposed without suffering negative consequences. Dao Mark imbalances caused by rapidly annexing immortal apertures or absorbing large quantities of Dao Marks will no longer destabilize your aperture, as Dao Marks are constantly distributed perfectly as conflicting or non-conflicting wherever they should be, with you also possessing control over how they should be or are arranged.

This control allows you to freely structure the Dao Marks within your aperture by your will alone, such as forming Dao veins or reorganizing Dao Mark distributions within the environment itself to create or enhance your own resource points. With this, you may rapidly annex apertures and absorb Dao Marks without suffering the usual consequences.

Finally, your Dao Marks also develop self-replenishing properties similar to those found within Secluded Domains of Heaven and Earth or those controlled by Venerable Dao Lords. Dao Marks sacrificed when using killer moves, refining Gu, or activating methods will steadily regenerate, preventing them from being permanently depleted, lost, or stolen.

This does not prevent you from expelling foreign Dao Marks gained from the attacks of others or information path agreement Dao Marks, nor will you suffer backlash from breaking such agreements.
addons.title: Perfect Sovereign Immortal Aperture

addons.text:
Your Sovereign Immortal Body has now evolved to naturally adapt to new worlds. Whenever you arrive in a new universe, your body and aperture will gain and be able to cultivate the natural Dao Marks of that world corresponding to the phenomena, supernatural systems, and laws of that world. You are able to interact with and cultivate the power systems of that world as if they were newly discovered paths, enabling the creation and cultivation of entirely new paths derived from the world's own systems. You may freely use the abilities and energy systems of that world yourself, and can even develop Gu worms and Gu recipes based on those systems.

Through this process, you may also gain attainment in these newly formed paths as your knowledge and understanding increases with the interaction of the world's systems. Your Sovereign Immortal Aperture, by your will, can now gradually incorporate aspects of that world's environment and supernatural systems, allowing the new world's resources and phenomena to be appear and be produced within it. For example, worlds with magical systems may give rise to leyline networks, mana-rich regions, or magical resource nodes within your aperture, while other worlds may produce entirely different resource structures and environments.

You may also allow the natives and creatures within your Sovereign Immortal Aperture to adapt to these foreign systems and phenomena as well. Living beings within your aperture may develop compatibility with the supernatural systems of the worlds you visit, allowing them to cultivate and use these newly gained systems just as you can. You possess complete control over this process, being able to choose who is affected, exclude specific groups or species, or make the adaptation occur gradually according to your will. Creatures originating from those worlds may also appear within your aperture, and Gu or even Immortal Gu based on those world's systems may naturally form within it.

As with the non-conflicting nature of the Sovereign Immortal Body, you are also unaffected by contradictions between different supernatural systems. Completely different and even mutually exclusive power systems from the same or different worlds may coexist within you and your aperture without interfering with one another, allowing you to contain and cultivate multiple foreign systems simultaneously.

You may dilute the immortal essence beads produced by your aperture into the native supernatural energies of any worlds you went to, using the same conversion rate as when diluting them into primeval essence. This provides you with an effectively limitless supply of the worlds' native energy systems for use.

Your Dao Marks also grant resistance against the supernatural methods and effects of foreign worlds, functioning similarly to how Dao Marks interfere with other paths. As you gain Dao Marks corresponding to that world's systems, your resistance and compatibility with its supernatural methods and phenomena will increase and amplify accordingly.

As you possess otherworldly Dao Marks, you may choose to become a complete otherworldly demon to that world's systems. This grants protection from the world's universal laws and influences, such as Fate, and you may freely choose which of that world's laws affect you.

The adaptation of your Sovereign Immortal Body, Dao Marks, and Aperture to a new world's power system follows the same adjustment period as your Universal Power Plant.

Finally, if you wish, you may choose for the Sovereign Immortal Fetus Gu to have already been used, making the Sovereign Immortal Body your true body from the start.
addons.title: Otherworldly Sovereign Immortal Body

objects.text:
You have come into possession of the rank ten Sovereign Immortal Fetus Gu, which lacks many of the flaws the rank nine version possessed. To use the Sovereign Immortal Fetus Gu, you must transfer your soul into it, at which point it will expend itself to create the Sovereign Immortal Body and Aperture. You can do this by touching it and willing your soul into it.

The Sovereign Immortal Body is born at Rank Six Gu Immortal, with 1000 Dao Marks in every path. These Dao Marks can shift between conflicting and non-conflicting at will, allowing them to amplify your own gu and also provide resistance to Dao Mark-based attacks. This also allows you to cultivate any path without your Dao Marks interfering with each other.

The Sovereign Immortal Body possesses strength, durability, speed, regeneration, and senses on par with those of a desolate beast. Your physique becomes stronger as your cultivation increases. At rank seven, your physique would be on par with Ancient Desolate Beasts, and at rank eight, it would be on par with Immemorial Desolate Beasts.

This Sovereign Immortal Body counts as a Half-Otherworldly Demon, reducing how affected you are by fate or heaven's will by a significant degree. Should you have the soul of an otherworldly demon, you escape the reaches of Heaven's Will entirely and are unaffected by fate.

The Sovereign Immortal Body is uninhibited by regional walls, and its regional aura changes depending on which region it is in. The Sovereign Immortal Aperture is not suppressed inside regional walls, allowing you to fight without risking damaging your aperture's foundations.

The Sovereign Immortal Aperture is modeled after the Gu world of the Immemorial Antiquity Era, and thus contains five regions and nine heavens for a total of ten layers. Each layer is 347.250 km² in size, totaling 3,472.500 km². Each layer can have a vital gu, for a total of ten.

The flow of time within the Sovereign Immortal Aperture runs sixty times faster than the time in the outside world, allowing resources within to grow at high speeds. For every year inside the Sovereign Immortal Aperture, 192 beads of immortal essence are produced, equating to 32 beads a day in the outside world.

The Sovereign Immortal Aperture can completely annex the immortal aperture of higher ranks without damaging them while preserving the land or heavenly spirits of the annexed aperture.
objects.title: Sovereign Immortal Fetus Gu (Reverend Insanity)

objects.text:
You’ve been given ‘Dust’ in its four major varieties, ‘Fire’, ‘Water’, ‘Electricity’ and ‘wind’. You gain 12 capsules of powdered Dust (three of each type) and 4 Crystals (one of each type).

Dust is innately volatile, and can be turned into a weapon quite easily, either made into ammunition or simply an explosive charge with a relevant esoteric effect to its element. However, when used skilfully, even raw dust can be used to simulate magical effects.

When incorporated into devices and equipment however it can truly shine, such as creating ‘Dustweave’ clothing allowing it to imbue effects on whatever it’s woven into or imbuing weapons with it to grant them novel effects.

Most notably, Dust interacts with other powers, meaning that any other powered effect you may have can be modified by a dust blend. A teleport for instance when modified with ‘Fire’ dust could create a massive explosion at its end point, while a laser blast could gain the Dust’s qualities and fire them farther through it. 

Furthermore, types of Dust can be mixed together in varying compositions to create more complex effects, such as Steam dust using Fire and Water dust, or even stranger and unique blends like gravity (Fire & Lightning), Hard Light (Fire, Water, Electricity), or Magnetism (Fire, Lightning, Lightning).
objects.title: Dust (RWBY)

objects.text:
You have been given what appears to be a standard large-sized pizza box from the Little Caesars restaurant chain. Upon close inspection, it seems to be made out of ordinary cardboard, despite appearing to be ordinary. What makes this specific pizza box special is that upon coming into contact with an intelligent being, it will produce the perfect pizza exactly to the taste of the one who touched it.
 
There is no known limit to the amount of pizza that can be produced from this anomalous pizza box. Despite having the logo of Little Caesars, it can produce just about any pizza, down to the minute details. Despite the box appearing to be made of normal cardboard, the anomalous pizza box is indestructible by all known methods of destruction, from atomic disassembly to other methods of destruction.
 
Do note that the pizza box is seemingly incapable of producing toppings that are normally inedible to the human palate.
objects.title: Little Caesar's Pizza: SCP-458 (SCP Foundation)

addons.text: You have bathed the Fruits of Evolution in the Evolution Cube’s Evolution Energy, optimizing their genes in the process. This both stabilizes and supercharges the evolutionary process, now causing the Ascension of Life Hierarchy rather than mere mundane evolution. By consuming one of these fruits of Life Hierarchy Ascension, you can complete the process of Ascension of Life Hierarchy in mere moments, at the expense of it being immensely painful, as usually this is a slow process that should take years or decades to complete. Unlike players and Han Xiao, who evolve through the interface, you do not get multiple choices for what direction you wish to evolve; you directly evolve into the next step of the path you are already on in a linear manner. So a mundane human would evolve into a Type I Space Human, then Type II Space Human, and so on. If there is no direct next step, a brand-new evolutionary step will be created for you, becoming much like Beyond A Grades in the sense of being a unique organism.  You can still ascend the life hierarchy by advancing in grade; this only gives you additional steps on the evolutionary path. As the Fruits of Life Hierarchy Ascension are now stable, they can be consumed in rapid succession, without concern for your genetic stability.
addons.title: Fruit of Life Hierarchy Ascension

objects.text:
You gain ten Fruits of Evolution.

These rare fruits force a dramatic evolutionary leap in the creature that consumes them. Rather than simple enhancement, the body undergoes a sudden biological transition into a stronger and more refined form. Physical capabilities improve across the board—strength, endurance, speed, resilience—and obvious weaknesses or inefficiencies are corrected as the body restructures itself.

Repeated consumption continues the process. Each additional fruit pushes the user further along an evolutionary path, refining previous changes rather than merely adding more power. Later stages may bring accelerated healing, sharper senses, metabolic improvements, or entirely new biological traits depending on how the body adapts.

However, evolution is not always stable. Consuming multiple fruits in rapid succession can overwhelm the body, resulting in severe illness, uncontrolled mutation, or death.

You are guaranteed to survive consuming one Fruit of Evolution.
objects.title: Fruit of Evolution (Shinka no Mi)

objects.text: You gain access to a limited supply of materials in which Soul Weapons are normally made out of. You don't have to make a Soul Weapon out of it and instead, you are free to have them be crafted or forged into any single item of your choosing. As for how many exactly, you at first, only get as much to make a single large warhammer. Upon additional purchase, you get more. You can pick and choose which materials you wish to have as well. Here are the following materials you can mix and match: Evermetal - Extremely stable and lightweight, used mostly for swords. A classic weapon used metal. Accleron - Can accelerate without much applied force, to the point it gives a noticeable boost in velocity. Recommended for armors. Graviton - Could alter its mass according to its forger and wielder's will. Doesn't add density. Annuna Scales - Colorful scales that can open and fold 180°, making it great for turning something blunt into something sharp. Sacred Ashwood - A regenerating and fire resistant wood that can change size at will. Magicite - A partially wooden partially metal material that can absorb and focus magic, favored by of course, magic users. Helio - Solid energized light and one of the sharpest materials known to exist. Gearframe - Ethereal gears and pistons powered by magic that you can control with a telepathic link, good for items requiring precise engineering. Quantumite - A material that should and shouldn't exist, thus can phase in and out through solid objects. Bloodstone<\b> - A dark stone that can get more powerful via extracting the iron from blood. Golem Hide - Extremely durable regenerating rocks made out of felled golems. Negaplating - A rare extremely Magicphobic material that is favored by Anti Mage folks. As said, you only got a limited supply, so use it wisely!
objects.title: Soul Materials (Soul Weapon CYOA)

objects.text: The Krabby Patty, born out of a desire to make the best food in the world... and made in a literal dump on accident, succeeding despite its origins. You now have access to this vegan burger, and of the powers it contains within. This burger, resized to fit a more human level rather than its previous size, has a secret ingredient only you know. If you were to try and tell many others at once, some sort of cosmic censor of some kind will bleep it. You CAN tell it to others, but only 1 at a time, the censor overpowering a group attempt. The negative effects of this burger have been removed, but the positives are still quite noticeable. You can cure someone who has been poisoned via food, you can share one with another and fall in love over a shared love of the Krabby Patty, It breaks you out of induced sadness, It can heal injuries like broken bones and muscles, AND it can cure mind control (although only if properly digested). A few of the variations you can make include a Secret Patty, which can turn others into Krabby Patty creatures, and the Pretty Patty, Krabby Patties of various colors that temporarily change parts of you to said color. If you are bold and brash enough, you can experiment with the recipe to get more effects, but be forewarned of the consequences. Finally, you are given the skills of a restaurateur, able to run a business that sells these at a price you so desire, people willing to pay whatever price you set more often than not. You are given a mini-fridge of about 10 to start with, and as mentioned, you know of the recipe AND secret Ingredient to make more of this ambrosia of the sea gods.
objects.title: The Krabby Patty (Spongebob Squarepants)

addons.text: You have gained an understanding of Mutagen and how to produce it. Furthermore, you also know how to make the various strains, variants, and countermeasures of it, such as unstable mutagen, super mutagen, retromutagen, and Dr. Rockwell’s formula.
addons.title: Ooze Manufacturing (Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles)

objects.text:
You have received a canister of the substance known as Mutagen, an irradiated mixture of chemicals from both earth and space.

As the name implies, this is highly mutagenic, with direct exposure to it having dramatic and potentially dangerous effects. 

Mutagen functions by triggering a mixture of evolution and devolution, utilizing the subject’s own bioenergy. It should be noted that the traits retained and gained during a mutation will depend on the subject’s bioenergy, with traits possibly being lost to gain more bioenergy, or altered to better make use of them, or gained due to an abundance of bioenergy allowing for their creation. An example of this would be a massive creature becoming smaller but more intelligent. Further, how this process affects the subject depends on the factors of contact and application.

Beyond its mutative properties, Mutagen has a few additional uses. When applied in minute and controlled doses, it can be used to heal wounds, even potent ones like a severed hand. Further, should it be solidified, it can be used as either an immensely potent power source or an incredibly efficient catalyst for magic.

Application effects:

* If applied to an animal, it will gain an anthropomorphic body, and its intelligence either remains the same or increases to human levels.

* If applied to an animal with recent human contact, it will gain an anthropomorphic body and human-level intelligence.

* If applied to an animal that has had recent contact with a mutant, it will become a non-sentient, non-anthropomorphic hybrid creature.

* If applied to a human that has had recent contact with an organic species, they will mutate to gain hybridized traits.

* If applied orally to a subject that has recently eaten, it will mutate the subject to hybridize with their stomach contents.

* If applied to two or more subjects who are in physical contact, they will fuse into a singular individual, including their very minds and souls.

* If applied to a human with animal lineage, they will mutate them into a hybrid.

* If applied to a subject with cybernetics or in contact with machinery, they will mutate into a biomechanical being.

* If applied to a human with no animal lineage, they will mutate them to enhance any innate traits to superhuman levels; further, said human can give up their human traits for more bioenergy, in turn granting stronger mutations at the cost of looking less and less human.

* If applied to an already mutated subject, they will mutate into a far more powerful form at the cost of becoming more monstrous looking.

* In rare circumstances, subjects may develop powers alongside mutations, such as subjects with strong minds gaining psychic abilities.
objects.title: Mutagen (Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles)

objects.text:
You have gained access to 10 Mana Crystals; each crystal is a form of condensed magical potential crafted through 5 fallen stars. These Mana Crystals can be easily crushed to slightly increase the user's maximum mana capacity and slightly improve the rate at which mana regenerates when not using magic.

Without any mana, using one of these crystals lets the user use low-level magic a few times, and using all the crystals gives the user an average-level mana pool. If the user already has an average-level mana pool, these Mana Crystals become significantly less effective. Additionally, this form of mana has a high affinity for being channeled into and through magical artifacts.
objects.title: Mana Crystals (Terraria)

addons.text:
With your enhanced physical and mental condition, you are now the perfect vessel for Compound V to reach its full potential. Injecting the serum into yourself will yield results nothing short of extraordinary. Every aspect of your body and mind will be amplified beyond the peak of what even a specialised supe could achieve.

A supe with superhuman intelligence and perfect memory? Your mind easily surpasses theirs. 
A supe with remarkable regeneration? You can heal from wounds they never could.
A supe with inhuman speed and reflexes? You can outpace them in the blink of an eye.

And that’s not all. Besides your enhanced attributes, any powers granted by Compound V will also be supercharged to the same degree thanks to the Super Soldier Serum running in your veins. The more potent the dosage of Compound V used, the greater this boost becomes.
addons.title: Superior Super Serum

objects.text:
You now possess a singular glass vial of the chemical serum known as ‘Compound V’, the hallmark product of Vought International. Compound V modifies humans and animals upon infusion, dramatically augmenting them and bestowing remarkable superpowers.

The powers that manifest after taking Compound V are generally somewhat random; however, they can be considerably influenced by an individual's genetics, personality and the formula itself. While there is a degree of chance, most supes typically gain some form of enhanced strength and durability.

The strength of the enhancement and abilities derived through taking this serum are guaranteed to be roughly equivalent to a top-tier supe on par with Queen Maeve or Stormfront. This vial of Compound V has no risk of death upon intake and is guaranteed not to produce superpowers that are useless or have negative side effects.

As part of your initial purchase, you will also receive a book containing precise details for the production of Compound V, written by Frederick Vought himself. This also includes methods to alter the formula, such as for creating V24. Manufacturing Compound V is complex, labour-intensive and exceedingly expensive, particularly for highly potent samples.

With each subsequent purchase of this Object of Power, the total number of vials of Compound V you receive will instead be increased per the cubic number sequence: 8, 27, 64, 125 vials and so on.
objects.title: Compound V (The Boys)

addons.text: Your ability to gain enhanced benefits from consumed liquids has synergized with the White Phial such that any liquid you drink from the White Phial now have its potency increased by +1,000%.
addons.title: Super Phial

addons.text: You can optionally mix and place any consumable Objects of Powers bought into the White Phial, which will both purify and empower them.
addons.title: Pre-Mixed Insanity

objects.text:
The White Phial is an alchemical artifact crafted from the first snow that fell upon the throat of the world after the creation of Tamriel. When filled with any form of liquid, such as drinks, potions, or various serums. Anything placed within the flask will be purified of flaws, and its potency will be increased by +100%. When filled with drinks, it will make them fit for royalty and potions and serums will become greatly empowered. As long as even a small amount of liquid is left in the White Phial, it will refill fully with that same liquid at dawn of the next day. You can fully empty the White Phial to reset this effect so that the Phial will replenish with another liquid.

By default, the White Phial is prefilled with a powerful potion which will fully replenish the drinker's health, stamina, and all forms of supernatural energy a drinker possesses.
objects.title: The White Phial (The Elder Scrolls)

objects.text:
A reinforced case containing a complete spectrum of enhancement vials, each tied to a distinct category of power. The collection includes at least one vial of every known color excluding Black. Black Elixirs do not appear within the case, as they are not truly found or claimed—their nature is to choose their own hosts.

Each vial is stable, self-contained, and ready for immediate use.

Red Elixirs govern energy, expressing powers centered around force generation, emission, amplification, and destructive output. 

Blue Elixirs enhance cognition and information processing, producing abilities related to perception, analysis, memory, prediction, and systemic understanding. 

Yellow Elixirs influence concepts and abstract interactions, granting powers that operate through broader principles rather than direct physical mechanisms.

Green Elixirs affect life, enabling growth, alteration, restoration, or manipulation of biological systems. 

Orange Elixirs govern matter, allowing the creation, shaping, and transformation of non-living substances. 

Violet Elixirs distort spacetime, expressing abilities related to movement, positioning, dimensional effects, and non-standard traversal. 

White Elixirs interact with powers themselves, enabling influence over abilities, enhancement systems, or the mechanisms underlying other superhuman effects.

Unlike most Genomes, your biology possesses an unusually stable compatibility profile. You may safely integrate up to two Elixirs simultaneously without degradation, conflict, or risk of Psycho onset.

Certain enhancements can extend this limit. Perks such as Olympic or Frankenstein, or any ability that improves physiological integration, systemic stability, or power harmonization, each increase your safe capacity by two additional vials. With sufficient reinforcement, it becomes possible to sustain one vial of each color simultaneously without triggering instability.

The case preserves each vial indefinitely, maintaining purity, potency, and preventing accidental activation or degradation.
objects.title: Chromatic Case (The Perfect Run)

objects.text:
You obtain a goblet containing the Fountain of Youth, a sacred treasure of the Fairy Clan. Licking it's water will grant ten years of extra life, swallowing the water will grant a hundred years, and drinking it all will grant eternal life and immortality. As long as it's water is not drunk completely the liquid will replenish itself over time, but should it be comsumed completely whoever consumed it will become the Fountain of Youth.

Fully consumed it grants you Eternal Youth and Immortality coming with an incredible healing factor allowing you to recover from anything as long as your soul is not completely destroyed. In addition the Fountains healing and youth restoring properties are transfered to your blood.
objects.title: Fountain of Youth (The Seven Deadly Sins)

objects.text: The Hourai Elixir was created by Eirin Yagokoro using the powers of Kaguya Houraisan, who can manipulate eternity. Anyone who consumes this forbidden elixir will cease to age, will never fall ill, and will become immortal. Although individuals will retain the physical conditions they had before drinking the Hourai Elixir, any form of injury or damage will heal completely within seconds to days, based on severity. The first sip of the medicine renders the drinker incapable of growing up or ageing. The second taste grants them immunity to illnesses that afflict their mortal forms, making them incapable of becoming ill. The third sip bestows true conceptual immortality based on the concept of Eternity, transcending what others typically designate as immortality. Once fully consumed, one becomes an existence completely disconnected from every concept of reality, thus making one not subject to the bounds of life, death, or even manipulation, although the pain of injuries can still be felt. Consuming the Elixir renders your soul, body, and mind inviolable, preserving them for eternity at the moment of the third sip. No force can affect this state; even tearing apart your mind or soul would not be able to stop your immortality and cause permanent harm. You can recover from anything, even experiences such as true death and reality erasure. You have become eternal; even beings capable of artificially granting the concept of death to immortals would pause at your immortality. You will not age beyond your prime, remaining in peak fitness forever once gained. The Hourai Elixir pools in one's liver, and should someone consume part of their liver, they will gain partial or full effects of the Hourai Elixir based on the amount consumed, gaining its complete powers by fully consuming a drinker’s liver. Be warned, once drunk, there is no way to end this form of immortality, no matter what Powers you may possess. Should you possess the perk Holding Back or the power Stranger (Strange Blood), you gain the ability to nullify your liver, passing on the Hourai Elixir's powers.
objects.title: Hourai Elixir (Touhou Project)

addons.text:
A Dead Apostle–Dragon hybrid? Are you serious? This isn't a joke, right? You really want to do this…? Well… okay then.

Congratulations—and condolences—because inside this injector is a drug that'll turn you into a fourteen-year-old fanfiction writer's dream. Just stab it into yourself, press down, and don't worry about any wild side effects—aside from your existence itself, I guess; since it'll fast-track you straight to Rank VIII.

Though I genuinely cannot fathom why you'd want this… but here we are, regardless.

Anyways, on a serious note, you'll become an anomaly on the same scale as Altrouge herself: a hybrid of two apex species, one of which is (obviously) a pure-blooded Phantasmal Dragon. In effect, this'll grant you the full benefits of both with little to none of the weaknesses.

Think skin of armoured scales, enhanced due to the properties of your existence. A conceptual advantage born from the overlap of your natures: of the planet's shadow, which denies human history; and legends of invincible terrors unharmed by conventional weapons—beings that by their nature are threats to civilization itself.

In practical terms, unless your attacker is a Servant—or a would-be hero in the making—wielding a legendary dragon-slaying weapon properly baptized in holy sacraments, nothing they do will matter.

And that's without even touching your other advantages, namely, your supreme physical might, and absurd magical energy production courtesy of your Dragon Core, and its "interesting" interactions with your Principle—that become even more so once you develop your own Idea Blood and crown yourself.

At that point, you'll be closer to something like a True Dragon, such as Fafnir or Vritra, for example—an existence that embodies a concept at its core. One which grants true immortality even in death, as your curse will persist so long as your thesis/Principle continue to exist as concepts in the world, allowing you to revive and return, again, again, and again til ad infinitum.

All in all, once you take the plunge, almost nothing can truly kill you—barring some extremely specific circumstances. Like Shiki. Both of them. Short of that, you'll be able to contend with even Gods with their full Authority deployed and walk away unscathed. Might still hurt, though.

You still have to drink blood to survive. So… yeah. That part sucks.

objects.text: Contained inside this syringe injector is a special drug known as an 「Idea Replica」—which will forcibly convert its recipient into a Dead Apostle. Regardless of whether the target in question would normally be able to transform into one in the first place or not. Letting them immediately skip the first three Ranks of the Dead entirely, to turn into a "proper" vampire. And while this refined version of the concoction is both more stable and significantly more potent than the prototype developed by Dr. Arach, it is still highly ill-advised to consume it in full—at least all at once. A mere quarter of the dose is enough to push someone to Rank IV. Using the entire injector, however, will propel the user straight to Rank VII. But for every Rank skipped, you'll only invite further instability into your genetic structure and genome. This destabilization stems from the rapid and violent increase in one's Existence Scale without time to properly adapt. The resulting failure is catastrophic as the body begins to collapse in on itself, degenerating into a slurry and malformed mass that slowly breaks apart at the seams. In especially unfortunate cases, a full injection administered immediately might cause you to turn into nothing more than a formless pile of biological residue. That said, this iteration is still a marked improvement over Arach's original trial version. Should you take it slow and quickly consume the blood of others, the damaged genetic data induced into your genes can be replaced and begin to stabilize. Through this process, your artificial Dead Apostle powers will eventually stop rejecting you, becoming fully integrated and truly your own. Finally, it's good to note that the Idea Replica is an imitation of a Dead Apostle Ancestor's Idea Blood. Therefore, it'll allow you to inherit a Principle derived from that Ancestor, alongside certain traits reminiscent of your chosen "sire." Similarly to how Noel inherited Rita Rozay-en's 「Mystic Eyes of Roses」.
objects.title: Idea Replica (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
Upon arriving at a safe location you will find thirteen canisters each filled with a dosage of different Klironomia waiting for you.

Klironomia are nanomachines derived from the technology and divinity of the Twelve Machine Gods of Olympus. They are made of a metal not found in the normal human world called Orichalcum. There are thirteen varieties of Klironomia; the standard model of Klironomia along with twelve other variations patterned directly on the functionality and divinity of one of the twelve Olympians a different member each. The standard model Klironomia bonds to both organic biology and inanimate objects to greatly enhance or restore the strength, and performance of an individual or object to an extent comparable to low rank servant stats and gives a lifespan measured in centuries to even a completely mundane human. They can also act as a pseudo-perpetual motion machine and generate enough Mana to sustain a Servant without a Master. The variations based on the Olympians can do everything the standard variety of Klironomia can do but better along with providing a small number of unique abilities based on the Olympian their design is modeled.

In addition these Klironomia will each come with an internal database that anyone who bonds to them can mentally access filled with Olympian technological and biological knowledge related to those models of Klironomia including how to produce more Klironomia if you can find or make the resources required, if you or someone else take multiple doses the databases within those Klironomia will merge as their systems synch up. 

A normal average modern day human cannot survive bonding with Klironomia due to the strain it would put on their body, if you don’t have some other power that would help deal with the strain your body will be enhanced to the point of being comparable to a nasuverse age of god human to allow you to handle all thirteen doses.
objects.title: Klironomia (Type-Moon)

addons.text:
Through a similar thaumaturgical process, you create a second set of 66 thaumaturgical bullets formed from powdered fragments of your own ribs. Like Kiritsugu’s bullets, these rounds contain a fragment of your soul and carry the metaphysical influence of your own Origin.

When one of these bullets strikes a target, it imposes the nature of your Origin onto whatever it hits, forcing that concept upon the victim’s body, mind, or supernatural systems.

The exact effect depends entirely on the Origin you possess. For example, a person with the Origin of ‘Berserk’ would induce uncontrollable frenzy and violent mania in those struck. Other Origins may twist biological function, disrupt magical systems, alter mental states, or impose stranger metaphysical effects depending on their nature.

If you possess the Dual Origin Power Upgrade, your bullets will carry both of your Origins simultaneously. When the two concepts interact well, the resulting effects can be particularly devastating, as the imposed principles compound or reinforce one another within the target.

These bullets otherwise follow the same general rules as standard Origin Bullets, functioning as physical ammunition while delivering their metaphysical effect upon impact.

You likewise may choose the caliber of your Origin Bullets.
addons.title: You Bullets

objects.text:
This Object of Power grants 66 thaumaturgical bullets created from the powdered rib of Kiritsugu Emiya. Because they are formed from part of his body, each bullet carries a fragment of his soul and is imbued with his Dual Origin of Sever and Bind.

When a target is struck, the bullet forces these origins upon whatever it hits. The damage inflicted is nearly irreversible and ignores both biological and spiritual durability.

Against mundane beings, the affected body part becomes permanently crippled. Nerves, capillaries, and internal structures are forcibly “severed” and then “bound” in a broken state, preventing proper regeneration. Even if the wound appears healed externally, the original function is lost forever, often leaving the limb paralyzed.

The bullets are particularly devastating against magi and other supernatural practitioners. If the bullet interacts with magical circuits, psychic abilities, familiars directly tied to their user, or other esoteric powers connected to a person, those systems are violently severed and mutilated. The victim is cut off from their supernatural abilities, suffering catastrophic backlash that leaves them in extreme agony and often permanently crippled or killed outright.

Despite their supernatural effect, the bullets still behave largely like physical ammunition. They possess somewhat greater penetrating power than a normal round, but mundane physical barriers can still stop them.

You may choose the calibre of the Origin Bullets.

This Object of Power also includes Kiritsugu Emiya’s personalized Thompson Contender, designed for firing these rounds.
objects.title: Origin Bullets (Type-Moon)

objects.text: You have received weakened vials of Ink Sans’ ink — a unique substance composed of liquid emotions. When consumed, these inks allow any being to experience the specific emotion contained within the vial. The recipient doesn't have to be human or even biological; as long as the ink enters their system, even robots, AI, or alien lifeforms can feel the embedded emotion. You are given ten vials in total: seven colored like the rainbow, two in white and black, and one special empty vial. The seven rainbow vials contain the following emotions: Red — Rage / Anger,Yellow — Joy / Cheerfulness, Orange — Surprise / Curiosity, Cyan — Sadness / Melancholy, Blue — Fear / Anxiety, Green — Disgust and Purple — Shame. The white vial suppresses all emotions, temporarily rendering the being completely emotionless. In contrast, the black vial triggers a flood of all emotions simultaneously, including obscure or complex ones not found in the standard seven. The tenth vial begins empty but fills itself once every hour with a random new ink representing a unique emotion. It may replicate one of the basic seven or become a hybrid — new colors and feelings such as Nostalgia, Detachment, Awe, or Envy. A changing label on the vial’s surface displays the name of the current emotion in a single word. Each vial's effect lasts exactly one hour, during which time the ink inside vials regenerates. You also receive a special inkwork kit — a set of tools and containers designed for mixing and experimenting with emotional inks. With experience, you’ll be able to go beyond the basic emotion set and even stabilize the random emotions of the tenth vial, making them permanent. To do this, simply pour the newly formed ink into any empty container of equal or less size to the standard vials. Once transferred, that container becomes a new, self-regenerating vial. If you don’t transfer the ink, the tenth vial just continue regenerating its current ink every hour and won’t produce new inks working like average vial. Finally, you may choose to activate a cosmetic effect that causes your pupils to shift color and shape in real time to reflect your mood and thoughts. The shapes may become numbers, stars, spirals, or even symbols and glyphs. This effect is optional and can be turn on/off.
objects.title: Ink Vials (Undertale: Inktale)

objects.text:
The Resentment Doll possesses abilities similar to a voodoo doll. Any damage it takes or the person it’s connected to will share damage with all relatives within three generations.

To use the Resentment Doll, you have to make the doll touch a drop of blood of the person you are targeting.
objects.title: Resentment Doll (We Agreed to Be Villains Together, But You’ve All Been Redeemed?)

rows.title: Consumable Objects of Power
rows.titleText: Note: All non-consumable Objects of Powers can be transferred to another person. When this happens, you do not lose any abilities the object unlocked or awakened (physical alterations, magic independent of the object, etc.) but any soul bonds transferred to the new owner.

objects.text:
A crystal no larger than a clenched fist, its dull, unremarkable surface gives no hint of the impossible complexity within. Beneath its plain exterior lies a crystalline supercomputer, constructed with multi-folding dimensional lattices that bend spatial layers into a compact core. Despite its appearance, the crystal hums with relentless purpose—its sole function is to collect the DNA of living creatures and use that genetic library to build what it believes to be the ultimate lifeform.

The crystal constantly emits a unique form of radiation, a bio-altering pulse that does not harm, but instead forces targeted mutations. Creatures within range find themselves rapidly altered, their bodies overwritten and reshaped by DNA strands the crystal has previously scanned or generated through its own simulated evolution and mutation processes. It actively creates new genetic patterns, imagined adaptations, and experimental forms born from its own internal simulations. 

The radiation seeps into bone and blood, implanting these sequences whether drawn from real creatures, created through speculative evolution, or constructed from pure genetic guesswork. Over time, the crystal assembles bizarre amalgamations—flesh stitched with scales, wings erupting from quadrupeds, gills blooming on mammals, and entirely novel features never before seen in nature.

However, for all its power, the crystal’s logic is alien. It does not think like a human, nor does it weigh risk, balance, or stability in any way familiar to organic life. Its process is clumsy, incomplete, and wildly experimental. It forces combinations it cannot fully predict, frequently causing uneven changes, unstable growths, and grotesque, uncontrollable fusions. The results are usually lethal. 

Most living creatures are killed by the mutations through catastrophic internal collapse shortly after it begins. A person may sprout the hardened hide of a reptile on one arm, yet the other may wither to a brittle claw. A beast may grow wings too small to fly or develop organs it has no way to support. These unstable creations rarely live long enough to adapt.

Yet despite its crude approach, the crystal is a fast learner. If a creature somehow survives its mutations the crystal will quickly refine the process, smoothing out the rough edges, strengthening the structure, and adjusting the genetic layers to better support the form. 

It improves rapidly through success, but it never carries over these refinements to others. Each new creature is treated as a blank slate. The crystal always begins from scratch, forcing new mutations without applying past lessons, as if each attempt exists in total isolation.
objects.title: Shaper Shard

objects.text:
Said to be formed from the marrow of the first ocean and forged in the heart of a drowned star, the Abyssal Cradle appears as a perfect black pearl barely a millimeter across. Despite its size, it is no mere artifact—it is alive. The moment your skin touches it, the Cradle merges with your body, embedding itself beside your heart. It pulses with a faint rhythm, its surface so dark it resembles a fragment of the void. Claiming it binds you to the abyss and awakens an inheritance that no other being can touch.

The instant you claim the Cradle, the oceans stir. The abyssal bond forms in a heartbeat, and your first brood awakens. A hatchling of every Leviathan from Subnautica emerges at once—Reapers, Sea Dragons, Reefbacks, Ghost Leviathans, and even Gargantuans. None resist, hesitate, or question. From the moment of their creation, they are completely loyal, their instincts rewritten so their entire existence orbits you.

Your Leviathans have almost no biological needs. A Gargantuan can survive on a single Peeper, and smaller ones require barely anything. Yet this is not a weakness. They can consume anything—mana, Qi, life force, matter, raw energy, toxic substances, or corrosive materials. Nothing is indigestible. Everything they devour is converted into hyper-dense stored essence within their bodies. A gram of uranium alone can sustain a Leviathan until its body swells large enough to rival a planet. Their stored energies remain perfectly separated, organized, and ready to use.

Their growth is no longer bound by the constraints of their environment. They can grow without limit—first surpassing mountains, then continents, then planets. Given enough time, they can coil around stars or drift through galaxies. Yet they are never imprisoned by their size. At will, they can shrink into sleek, serpentine forms that glide across land or wrap around you like living ornaments—protective, affectionate, and utterly devoted.

Their bodies are nearly indestructible. They regenerate instantly, repairing damage as though it never occurred. They release their stored energy only for you, and only by their own choice. Their loyalty is complete and unshakable.

The Cradle never ceases its work. If one Leviathan falls, another rises to take its place. Its influence extends far beyond Subnautica. Any creature called “Leviathan” across myth, fiction, alien seas, or alternate universes will eventually hear its call and be reborn through the Cradle—bound to you just the same.

You are not merely a master of beasts. You are their anchor—the center of their world, the one they orbit and love without question. With the Abyssal Cradle beating beside your heart, oceans quiet, voids shift, and even stars seem smaller. The Leviathans do not just serve you; they revere you. And through their devotion, the abyss itself becomes yours.
objects.title: The Abyssal Cradle

objects.text: This teardrop-shaped piece of agate is the Yasakani Magatama. While many of these gems were formed to lure the goddess Amaterasu-Ōmikami from the Cave of Ama-no-Iwato and restore the light of the sun to the world, this particular jewel is the only one to have made its way into mortal hands. The Yasakani Magatama possesses several useful abilities. It allows the user to interact with spiritual entities as if they were physical and to utilize the weapons and relics of the kami as if they were their own. The Magatama can store various forms of power—from magic, to ki, reiryoku, chakra, and more—and convert the stored energies into any form the gem has previously held. It can even store spells and techniques, enabling anyone who can supply it with power to perform those techniques as if they were their own. As a Sacred Treasure of Japan, the Yasakani Magatama embodies the virtue of benevolence, acting as something akin to a letter of credence. When dealing with deities and the spirits of nature, unless you specifically go out of your way to offend them, you will always have the equivalent of diplomatic immunity—able to maintain a cordial relationship, speak without fear, and come and go as you please.
