objects.title: Yasakani Magatama

addons.text:
The ability of the Fey Clan Magatama to reveal people's secrets, combined with your knowledge of the law and endless creativity, has granted you the uncanny ability to turn even the most hopeless cases around.

You can use even the most insignificant clues as tools to unbalance people, making it easier to break their Psyche-Locks.
addons.title: The Turnabout Terror (Ace Attorney)

objects.text:
A sacred charm of the Fey Clan, this magatama glows when charged with spiritual energy and allows the wearer to detect and break Psyche-Locks, even if they possess no spiritual abilities themselves. Unlike the normal variant, it charges itself over time. However, this doesn't prevent you from charging it with your own spiritual energy, if you have any.

A Psyche-Lock is a mental barrier an individual possesses to protect their secrets. Red Psyche-Locks represent secrets an individual is consciously trying to hide, while Black Psyche-Locks represent secrets that an individual keeps subconsciously, without even being aware of them. The number of locks represents the strength of their determination to hide the secret, and this number can range from one to five.
objects.title: Fey Clan Magatama (Ace Attorney)

objects.text:
This unassuming stone is the sacred relic of the Kelvin Temple on Mikd'lty, a planet tidally locked to its sun. One hemisphere is forever shrouded in icy darkness, while the other is scorched by relentless, unyielding heat. Despite its simple appearance, this artifact holds immense power.

It grants the bearer the ability to create, shape, and manipulate temperature within an extending radius around them. With it, one can summon searing rays of heat fierce enough to rival the surface of a star, or unleash waves of bone-chilling cold that match the depths of space’s freezing void.

This relic also allows the user to change the state of any matter—solid, liquid, gas, or plasma. Want to instantly turn water into steam, transform rock into molten lava, or convert air into a crackling plasma? All are within reach. However, wielding such power requires caution, altering the state of certain materials, especially volatile substances, can lead to unpredictable and dangerous reactions.

Initially, the relic’s influence is limited to a radius spanning several city blocks. Yet, with time—roughly a decade—its range is destined to expand dramatically, eventually allowing the user to influence entire star systems. And even then, its potential for growth remains vast.
objects.title: The Kelvin Stone (Ben 10)

addons.text: Thanks to the power of the Hōgyoku, you have become a perfect hybrid of Shinigami and Hollow, or rather Vizard and Arrancar. Just like Kaname Tōsen you are able to act like a Vizard, using Shikai, Bankai, and Kido while summoning a Mask, while also being able to use Arrancar-powers like Hierro and Descorrer as well as using Resurrección to take on a more powerful form.
addons.title: Dissolved Boundary

objects.text:
This small, marble-like orb is a unique substance designed to dissolve the boundaries between Shinigami and Hollows, allowing one race to inherit the powers and abilities of the other.

However, its true power is its ability to sense the hearts of those around it. The Hōgyoku can peer into the depths of a person’s desires and materialize them in tangible form. The Hōgyoku is only capable of materializing the desires of those with the strength, will, and resolve to see them fulfilled.

The possessor of this relic can fuse the Hōgyoku with their very being, integrating its power into their soul. Once fused, the orb acts as an extension of its master—granting heightened regenerative abilities that mend wounds at a rapid pace, and facilitating continual evolution and growth.

Do be careful, the Hōgyoku is not sentient; it does not discriminate or consider the consequences of its actions. It applies its powers indiscriminately, often fulfilling desires without regard for the fallout or moral implications. The ‘wishes’ it grants may not align with the best interests of its possessor, potentially leading to unforeseen and sometimes tragic outcomes.

Finally, the Hōgyoku possesses the remarkable ability to graft the capabilities of a Shinigami or Hollow directly onto a target’s soul. It can transform an individual as if they had always been inherently part of those races, effectively awakening their latent powers. With time and practice, grafting other races abilities upon a target will be possible.
objects.title: Hōgyoku (Bleach)

objects.text: In your possession is a lead-lined box that, each time you open it, will contain one of the four known variants of Kryptonite: Green Kryptonite, Red Kryptonite, Blue Kryptonite, and Gold Kryptonite. While normally Kryptonite is attuned to affect mostly only Kryptonians, you can reattune all the Kryptonite within this box to affect any other species. However, only ONE species can be attuned at a time. Green Kryptonite is the most common variety, emitting radiation that is toxic to Kryptonian lifeforms empowered by yellow sunlight. It causes nausea, dizziness, pain, and weakness, eventually leading to loss of consciousness. While under the effects of this radiation, Kryptonians are as vulnerable to harm as ordinary humans. Green Kryptonite can also cause mutations in humans with long-term exposure, though the exact results are unpredictable. Red Kryptonite is the second most common variety. It strips away the inhibitions of Kryptonians and humans exposed to it, removing impulse control and respect for authority, causing them to act entirely on their own selfish, chaotic whims. Blue Kryptonite is the third variant. It strips Kryptonians of the powers they gain from yellow sunlight while under the effects of this crystal. It can also dramatically improve the health of any non-Kryptonian organisms, with continual exposure leaving humans in a perfect state of health. Gold Kryptonite is the final known natural variant. It has the ability to cause permanent wounds in Kryptonians, strip them of their powers entirely, and, with enough exposure, kill them.
objects.title: Kryptonite (DC Comics: Smallville)

objects.text: You gain one of the famous Tribal Gems of Deltora, each the size of a fist possesses it’s own set of powers and abilities First is the Diamond which protects the bearer from unnatural fear, and grants them courage to overcome natural fear. It also grants them strength both physical and mental, all the better to overcome a foe. Finally it will allow the holder to always know when love is true, whether that be romantic, platonic, or familial. Second is the Emerald It warns the user of Evil’s presence, and detects the breaking of vows. It heals sores and ulcers, and is the ultimate cure to all poisons. Third is the Lapis Lazuili It brings the balance of fortune to always fall in the wielder’s favour, and protects the user from the touch of Evil. Fourth is the Topaz Which allows the user to perceive and contact spirits, and strengthens the mind, clearing it of all troubles. The Topaz also protects against nightmares, and all forms of creatures of the night. Fifth is the Opal it enhances the wielder’s sight, allowing them to perceive detail from both near and far, and see in the dark. It’s greatest ability is allowing it’s user to see backwards and forwards in time. Sixth is the Ruby It detects oncoming Evil, and misfortune. It wards off evil spirits, and is the ultimate cure for all venoms. Seventh is the Amethyst it detects illness, and poison. It encourages in it’s user peace of mind, and a feeling of security. The purchase of even one Deltora Gem also gives you the knowledge of how the Belt itself was crafted, and you are able to craft new Belt’s, make repairs—should they become damaged—or even adapt the design into other metalwork, and such items must be worn/carried to actually take full effect. You will also only be able to craft items suited for the number of Gems you purchase here. Should you purchase all seven gems, you also gain the Belt of Deltora this magical item is empowered by the trust of the people, and will only work for you and your heirs. Typically the greatest limit of the Belt is it needs to be worn to get the full functionality, this version (and ONLY this version) lacks that vulnerability, only needing the Belt to remain intact. The Belt’s primary purpose is to keep a singular enemy at bay, though this item is not strong enough to protect against an entity, an Endbringer should be more than possible. Finally, no matter which gems you purchased here you learn a method to empower other gems of the same type with those abilities. Do note, the gems in question need to be naturally occurring, and smaller gems will have lesser versions of these powers, if you should find larger ones? The strength will increase dramatically.
objects.title: Deltora Gem (Deltora Quest)

objects.text:
The Dragon Balls are a set of indestructible crystal spheres—each about 3 inches in diameter—inset with stars (numbering from one-star to seven-star). Individually, each Dragon Ball is powerless, but when all seven are brought together, the Eternal Dragon - Shenron associated with the Dragon Balls is summoned to grant the summoner any wish within the Dragon’s power.

Shenron has few limits on what wishes he may grant, but he can only fulfill wishes within the limits of his own power. The mighty dragon will be unable to kill an entity, but an Endbringer’s death should be within his reach.

The wish granted will be a true wish, materializing as the wisher intends, with the Dragon playing no tricks. Shenron himself is neutral—caring for neither good nor evil—and will always advise the user on any wishes that are impractical or impossible, even going so far as to offer suggestions and alternatives to achieve the summoner’s satisfaction.

Once the Eternal Dragon has granted the user’s wish(es), the Dragon Balls will scatter across the world before turning to stone for an entire year, allowing the orbs to recharge their strength.

Traditionally, this set of Dragon Balls grants only a singular, powerful wish. However, with each selection here, the Dragon is now capable of granting another wish.
objects.title: Dragon Balls (Dragon Ball Series)

objects.text:
It seems you have been handed one of the experiments created by the demon known as Fu; whether that mischievous little devil gave it to you personally or you simply acquired it elsewhere matters little, what truly counts is the power this crystal bestows. Forged from energy stolen from various powerful warriors, this crystal grants its user a surge of Dark Energy that unlocks their hidden potential and boosts their capabilities up to five times their original power level, potentially even triggering a transformation if the user has the latent ability for it. This transformation, known as the "Supervillain Mode", manifests as a white-and-blue aura enveloping the user, altering their skin and hair color while filling their eyes with a glowing turquoise energy. 

This power is not yours alone to wield; by shattering the crystal to access the Dark Energy, you can bestow the Supervillain Mode upon someone nearby. The Time Breaker symbol will appear on the vessel's forehead, signifying your newfound control over their mind and allowing you to issue any commands you wish. Be warned, however: sufficient willpower or a heavy blow to the head can break your new puppet free from this mental control. 

Once you are finished using the crystal's power, you can reform it in your hand for later use. Additionally, you can drain the life force from the person you empowered with the Supervillain Mode to further boost the crystal's power and utilize that energy yourself
objects.title: Demon Realm Crystal (Dragon Ball Series)

objects.text:
You have a crystallized fragment of draconic essence, which when implanted into someone's body, gives them the powers of a Dragon Slayer without having to be taught directly by a dragon. Choose one element (fire, water, ice, lightning, etc.) to be the Lacrima's element, and you gain a high resistance to it such that only a superior wielder of that same element can harm you. For instance, a Lightning Dragon Slayer can take direct strikes from natural storms without issue.

This will grant the user an internal container for ethernano, which can increase with time and training as well as refill passively. Ethernano being the fuel for your Dragon Slayer Magic. You will start with a large ethernano capacity, comparable to some S-class Wizards. As the Dragon Lacrima is effectively an organ in itself, should it be removed, the user will be severely weakened if not die outright. Should this occur, the user's affinity for their chosen element, ability to use Dragon Slayer Magic, and the size of their ethernano container will all be significantly reduced.
The user can consume their element to restore their ethernano reserves and empower themselves temporarily, unleashing devastating elemental magic and physical force. The Lacrima is bound to their essence, ensuring perfect compatibility; rejection is impossible. Additionally, this blessing does not carry the curse of all Dragon Slayers as the user has no risk of becoming a dragon, though this will limit their growth.

Unlike a Dragon Slayer raised by a dragon, the user's path begins with the Lacrima’s power rather than instruction. This grants rapid power and perfect synchronization with the chosen element, but it lacks the nuance and guidance of true draconic teaching, as well as the power granted by eventual transformation into a dragon.

The Dragon Lacrima can optionally be automatically inserted into you or a chosen companion  at the moment you receive your build.
objects.title: Dragon Lacrima (Fairy Tail)

objects.text:
You now possess a collection of priceless artifacts known as soul crystals.

Soul Crystals are gem-like magical artifacts capable of recording the Aetherial pattern of their carrier. This creates an imperfect echo or copy of the carrier inside, capturing not only someone's silhouette but also their emotions, giving the crystal a sort of will of its own. This enables them to pick and choose their owner.

Once a crystal has chosen a new owner and attuned itself to them, it will begin to release the stored memory, knowledge, and experience of the previous wielders. This allows for rapid acquisition and mastery of the skills and spells learned or created by the previous owners.

This preservation and refinement of knowledge occurs generation after generation, pushing the discipline held within the stone to ever greater heights with each passing of the torch over hundreds, if not thousands, of years.

Your collection contains every stone belonging to every Job and the class that preceded them on Etheirys. You know how to create new stones and pass on the stones you have to others for them to learn from.
objects.title: Crystalize Legacy (Final Fantasy XIV)

objects.text:
You now possess the Crystal of Azem, which contains the signature magic of the Traveler from the Convocation of 14, and later, the enhancement bestowed by Hydaelyn upon the Warrior of Light.

This magic grants you the ability to summon allies to your side, regardless of the distance, be it from across the world or from another dimension entirely.

The enhancement, on the other hand, grants you the ability to create up to 7 Aetherial combatants of equal strength to yourself to aid you in combat. These combatants will last for 120 minutes before dispersing, and the crystal will need to recharge for an entire day before it can do so again.
objects.title: The Traveler Invocation (Final Fantasy XIV)

addons.text:
Your Philosopher’s Stone now gains the powers of the similarly named Wondrous Item from the Dungeons & Dragons multiverse.

On top of those abilities which already belonged to it, the Stone now possesses charges which may be used in order to perform the miracles detailed below. By spending one charge, you can massively increase your research progress for an hour, perform advanced transmutations equal to a 9th level spell, or transmute 10 pounds of lead into a mix of silver and gold (by casting a transmutation spell during this process you can transmute as much as 5,000 pounds of material, based on the strength of the transmutation spell used). Most impressively, by spending one charge on imbuing a healing potion, you can create The Oil of Life, which when sprinkled on a corpse will fully heal and revive the target. This process ignores any limits about how long ago the target has died, allowing those ineligible for a traditional Resurrection spell to be valid targets.

Should a Psionic caster hold the Stone, it will greatly increase their powers and double the speed at which they regenerate. In addition, by spending charges one can vastly increase the power of psionic spells and abilities.

The Stone holds 8 charges, with one charge regenerating every 21 days.

For as long as you carry the Stone, you are also completely immune to any form of sickness and disease.
addons.title: Stone From The Realms (D&D)

objects.text:
What is the value of a human life? Is it something that can be measured, a known quantity to which a number can be appointed?

This is the question posed by the existence of the Philosopher's Stone, a mystic tool made from the transmuted souls of human beings. It allows one to seemingly violate the laws of Alchemy, particularly the Law Of Equivalent Exchange, though in reality the price is exacted from the trapped souls inside rather than some external source of material.

This stone is special, however. It contains one powerful, inexhaustible soul, whom Truth has personally sealed inside and allowed to regenerate as a form of hellish eternal punishment. Therefore, no matter how much the stone is used, it won't break.
objects.title: Philosopher's Stone (Fullmetal Alchemist)

objects.text: The Power Orbs are a set of seven crystal spheres that grant their user an array of powers when held. The orbs are bound to their user and can be freely moved by the user up to 10 meters away. The orbs can be moved by others as long as the user does not consciously oppose it but cannot be brought outside the range, the orbs will simply refuse to be moved. Similarly, the user cannot move further than ten meters from the spheres, any attempt to do so will yank the user back. The indigo orb allows the user to project an ovoidal force-field of variable size around themselves. This force-field is strong enough to stop multiple attacks from heavy weapons from a capital spaceship before its integrity is compromised. It can block every known method of attack from physical and energy to magical effects and other esoteric phenomena like teleportation. It does not, however, allow air to pass through which means the user is at risk of oxygen starvation. The orange orb allows the user to fire beams of energy capable of destroying a main battle tank and glassing a large area of desert at low power. The orb has a safety mechanism which needs to be mentally disengaged before it can be fired. The user can adjust the strength of the beams when firing. The purple orb allows the user to create a prehensile hard-light tube-shaped construct that can be mentally manipulated. The lighthook can lift objects up to several tons and can be shaped into complex shapes. When used with the force-field orb, the lighthook manifests outside the barrier. The cyan orb allows the user to fly at speeds up to Mach four. It does not, however, protect the user against the effects of the wind so using the force-field orb is recommended at high speeds. The flight orb will also slow down falls even when not held. The green orb allows the user to create breathable air around themselves. It can be used to refresh the air inside the force-field generated by the indigo orb or create pockets of air underwater. The yellow orb allows the user to project a holographic double of themselves through which they can see, hear, and talk. It also grants the user a true-sight that can see through nearly all illusions and reveal magical phenomena. The function of the brown orb is unknown. The orbs can be upgraded through a skill-tree system that appears under uncertain conditions. Regular use of the orbs increases the change of an upgrade becoming available. Unfortunately, the nodes of skill-tree have no labels or any explanation aside from the shape of the upgrade tree itself and the already selected nodes. When an upgrade is available, the orbs will glow for a short period and position themselves in a heptagram in front of the user. The user must then grab an orb and mentally select a connected node. All upgrades are final. Some of the known upgrades include: a second lighthook for the purple orb, a rapid fire mode for the orange orb, Mach 16 fight and aetheric gateways for the blue orb, and short range teleportation for the yellow orb. The orbs cannot be scanned by technological or magical means, any attempt at examination will fail with null results, but they can be seen with the naked eye. Similarly, the interface the orbs project and the skill-tree cannot be seen with cameras or other artificial recording methods. It is theorized that the orbs are a form of Nth technology (Clarke-tech), either a spaceship or space suit, build by an advanced alien race.
objects.title: Amaze-Balls (Grrl Power)

objects.text:
This small gemstone which comfortably fits in the palm of your hand appears to mundane observation to be nothing more than a simple piece of jewelry. To someone attuned to the ether, however, it is a tool that allows its user to focus their powers. When you take ownership of this stone, or pass on its ownership to another, it will attune the user to the ether if they were not already and allow them to use the stone. (Transfer of ownership is a contractual process and it cannot be forcefully taken nor can the user be coerced into a transfer.)

A blinker stone functions like an etheric lens, allowing the user to focus their thoughs and draw forth their etheric power. A beginner will be able to generate minor effects like illusions of fire or other elemental phenomena, produce small lights, and so on. Through training, it is possible to produce a wide array of supernatural effects but the road to mastery is long and arduous.

If the user focuses their thoughts on their stone, they are able to project themselves into the ether to perceive its location and observe the stone's surroundings. Other beings attuned to the ether will be able to sense your presence as will you theirs. At will, and regardless of the distance, the user can summon their blinker stone back to their hand.

(A blinker stone is traditionally a gift between romantic partners. If you gift this blinker stone to anyone, they will become aware of this fact once they accept ownership.)
objects.title: Blinker Stone (Gunnerkrigg Court)

objects.text:
God's power is incredible, and these are fragments of their power, miracles. A fragment takes the form of a grey crystal that’s around 8-10 inches in length; when activated, it glows with a radiant rainbow colour.

The power held by even a single fragment is immense; a single fragment had enough power to destroy a massive amalgamation of powerful demons in a single beam, instantly restore the body of someone who was missing multiple limbs and restore their energy, break the connection Satan had to the living world, and create a pocket dimension that’s a limitless mediaeval-inspired village that had an endless supply of food, was always warm, and had clothes that always fit the wearer.

This power is not without limits, however, as after doing that, the fragment completely ran out of energy, dulling to its grey colour; even then it had the ability to absorb demons that came too close. Be wary, though, for if someone with a normal human soul were to use it, their soul would be destroyed afterwards to such a degree that even the power of eight fragments working together wouldn’t be able to restore them.
objects.title: Fragment of God (I’m The Grim Reaper)

objects.text:
The Shikon Jewel, or Jewel of Four Souls, is a legendary artifact capable of amplifying spiritual energy and granting its possessor unparalleled strength, durability, and magical abilities. The jewel responds to the deepest desires of its wielder, able to fulfill ambitions such as transforming a human into a demon or purging entire cities of malevolent entities. However, this immense power comes at a steep cost—the jewel actively seeks to corrupt its bearer, tempting even the purest of hearts with its influence.

One of the jewel’s unique characteristics is its ability to be shattered and reassembled repeatedly, with each fragment retaining a portion of the jewel’s original power. When embedded within a being, these shards grant enhanced physical, supernatural, and mystical capabilities.

Even ordinary individuals may develop extraordinary abilities when infused with a shard, such as constructing barriers, manipulating demonic energy, or simply gaining heightened senses. The magnitude and nature of these enhancements depend on the size of the shard and the purity or darkness of the wielder’s intentions. Benevolent users will experience greater purifying and healing powers, while malevolent ones will harness destructive and chaotic might.
objects.title: Shikon Jewel (Inuyasha)

objects.text:
The Moonstones are a set of seven magical jewels from the Monster Realm, being the Vampyre Moonstone, Frankenstein Moonstone, Werewolf Moonstone, Mummy Moonstone, Swamp Moonstone, Zombie Moonstone, and Ghost Moonstone, that not only each granting their holder a fitting power, but also should their collective power be harnessed could turn day to night permanently. 

The Vampyre Moonstone is red with imagery of a bat, and grants the ability to turn others into mind-controlled minions.

The Crazy Scientist Moonstone is green with imagery of a lightning bolt, and grants the ability to use lightning to create life, alongside also granting superhuman strength.

The Werewolf Moonstone is orange with imagery of a howling wolf, and grants the holder superhuman strength and speed.

The Mummy Moonstone is purple with imagery of an eye of Horus, and grants the ability to magnify curses.

The Swamp Moonstone is yellowish-green with imagery of swamp plants, and grants the ability to control water.

The Zombie Moonstone is pink with imagery of a zombie rising from the grave, and grants the ability to reanimate the dead

The Ghost Moonstone is blue with imagery of a ghost, and grants the ability to phase through both living beings and solid objects.

As a final note, should you devise a means to harness the collective power of the Moonstones, they could be used to turn day to night permanently.
objects.title: The Moonstones (LEGO Monster Fighters)

addons.text:
Now instead of an oversized gauntlet of golden metal, you can choose to have the sleek nano-technological form of Tony Starks Nano-Gauntlet. This incredible piece of technology is capable of channeling the limitless power of the Infinity Stones much like the dwarven made original. The benefits of the Nano-Gauntlet are its ability to automatically resize itself to fit its user, the ability to repair itself to some extent, and the ability to channel the power of the stones into repulsor blasts emitted by the gauntlet.

<small>Note: If you really wish, you can instead have both versions instead of replacing the original.</small>
addons.title: The Nano-Gauntlet

objects.text: A near-indestructible gauntlet, capable of channeling the power of all the Infinity Stones at once. This Gauntlet will protect you from the backlash of using the Infinity Stones, and is able to contain the energy without being destroyed.
objects.title: Infinity Gauntlet (Marvel)

addons.text:
You have develop a special connection with an Infinity Stone. While you still need to train and master its full potential, your innate control and understanding of it already surpass those of Thanos and Adam Warlock. Beyond simply manipulating its raw power, you can tap into the symbolic and metaphysical aspects of the Stone, wielding its deeper conceptual influence. As a result, you can achieve feats that would typically require the combined power of other Stones. For example, you could warp reality using only the Mind Stone, conjuring illusions so vivid they become tangible, or create pocket universes with just the Space Stone by harnessing the very concept of space itself.

Although the Infinity Stones weaken when outside their home universe, this limitation can be overcome as you train and harness their power. If you succeed in mastering and wielding all six Stones, you will be able to accomplish feats that even other users of the Infinity Stones would consider impossible.

As you continue to harness these Stones, you will unlock the core concept of each individual Stone you buy, along with related elements, such as the Power Cosmic and Pym Particles from the Power Stone.
addons.title: Understanding the Infinite

addons.text:
You have become something that only few individuals in the universe have ever achieved: a being who has merged with an Infinity Stone.

The abilities you gain depend on the Infinity Stone you possess, but regardless of which stone you possess, you are capable of using its full potential without requiring mastery. You are immune to its energies, and you can merge with and access the power of as many stones as you possess, unrestricted by Perfect Host’s starting limits.
addons.title: Infinity Host

objects.text: The Infinity Stones, formerly known as Infinity Gems, are six immensely powerful artifacts that embody aspects of the universe. Each stone grants great power on its own, but it’s only when they are together that their full power is truly unleashed. Although they normally work only in their native universe, you can use their power in any universe you travel to. The Infinity Stones are also sentient and can aid you in their use. The Reality Stone allows you to break the laws of reality, logic, and physics; resurrect the dead; grant yourself powers; and observe, create, or travel to alternate realities. At its peak, when backed by the other stones, it allows you to alter reality on a universal scale. The Power Stone allows you to increase your strength and durability without limit, possess infinite stamina, project energy, enhance the powers of others, absorb energy and powers, access unlimited energy, and amplify other stones. At its peak, when backed by the other stones, it lets its user channel all the power in the universe. The Space Stone allows you to manipulate space at will — instantaneously teleport yourself and others, create portals, increase your speed, manipulate gravity, create black holes, appear in multiple places at once, or alter distances between objects in defiance of physical laws. At its peak, when backed by the other stones, it lets its user be present in all places in the universe simultaneously. The Time Stone allows you to manipulate time itself — speed it up, slow it down, stop, or rewind it. You can observe the past and future, travel through time, control the age of beings, and trap individuals or even entire locations in endless time loops. At its peak, when backed by the other stones, it lets its user exist at all points in time simultaneously. The Mind Stone grants you psionic abilities, such as telepathy and telekinesis, or significantly amplifies your pre-existing mental powers. You can access the astral plane, control minds, create illusions, manipulate dreams, control machines, project psionic blasts, and generate psionic constructs. At its peak, when used alongside the other stones, it lets its user access and manipulate all minds in the universe. The Soul Stone allows you to manipulate souls, defend against soul-based attacks, and even grant immortality that defies Death itself. Most notably, the Soul Stone lets you trap an unlimited number of souls within its idyllic Soul World, where you can access their memories and skills. At its peak, when used alongside the other stones, it lets its user manipulate all souls, life, and death in the universe. The Infinity Stones form a circuit, meaning that mastery over the aspect of each Infinity Stone allows for greater control of another. Assembled together, they create a positive feedback loop: The Reality Stone allows for better control of the Soul Stone, the Soul Stone allows for better control of the Mind Stone, the Mind Stone allows for better control of the Power Stone, the Power Stone allows for better control of the Space Stone, the Space Stone allows for better control of the Time Stone, and the Time Stone allows for better control of the Reality Stone. Together, the stones grant their wielder nigh-omnipotence, as well as omniscience and omnipresence. However, you will need the Infinity Gauntlet or a similar item designed to handle nigh-omnipotence if you wish to wield their combined power. The Infinity Stones outperform abstract entities, such as Eternity, and the only beings that can overcome their power are those at the level of the Living Tribunal.
objects.title: Infinity Stone (Marvel)

objects.text: A spherical blue glass ball that when thrown, can teleport you where it hits. This will not teleport you if it hits water, instead it will sink, and then teleport you once it hits something solid. You start at the maximum capacity for your ender pearls at 16, and gain one pearl a day within a hammerspace exclusively meant to house Ender Pearls. There is also a small chance of creating a Endermite by throwing one of these pearls. They aren't particularly strong, but they are quite the pests.
objects.title: Ender Pearl (Minecraft)

objects.text: You obtain a small collection of virtue gems of level 16 or lower whose total levels add up to 32 or less, with a maximum tier of 5 where applicable.
objects.title: Virtue Gem Collection (Path of Exile)

objects.text: A special stone that when paired with the right Pokemon, allows them to undergo Mega Evolution. This temporary state provides a large boost to the power of the Pokemon. This stone, in particular, contains a notably potent source of power of life and death from Xerneas and Yveltal. With training, any of your Pokemon may learn to Mega Evolve in its presence.
objects.title: Superior Mega Stone (Pokemon)

addons.text:
The Mother Dark Bring Sinclair has acknowledged you as its true master, granting you its manifold abilities. To begin with it strengthens your body to a superhuman level, allowing you to clash with upper-tier Brutes or demolish buildings even if you've spent a decade locked up and barely moving. In addition to this you gain the power of Combustion, letting your attacks generate powerful explosions at their point of impact. Finally, Sinclair can give you information on events happening far away, leaving you knowledgeable on everything of importance happening around the world.

Should you possess more than one Mother Dark Bring, each will produce lesser Dark Brings independently from each other, meaning that you can up to quintuple the number of Dark Brings generated.
addons.title: Sinclair

addons.text:
The Mother Dark Bring Anastasis has acknowledged you as its true master, granting you the absolute power of Regeneration. This power can be used in two main ways, either by infusing a living being with energy to heal and strengthen them or by returning something to a previous state. The former application allows you to for example grow giant trees that move at your command to attack or defend in seconds. If you were to suffer a fatal injury even including decapitation Anastasis will regenerate you automatically to heal you, just as it lets you undo any injuries or physical exhaustion to continue fighting at your physical peak.
When used to return things to a previous state Anastasis can restore colossal structures worn away by age to a pristine state in seconds, allowing you with a bit of effort to restore a city destroyed by an Endbringer to a state better than it was before. Should a restored object have any exotic traits or abilities, whether it be Tinkertech or magical properties, they too are restored. Anastasis' power works in the abstract as well, allowing you to for example regenerate a fire that burned out long ago or even regenerating all wounds someone has suffered at once. Though it must be pointed out that excessive repeated use of Anastasis can spiritually exhaust the user, ultimately rendering them unable to use its regenerative properties until they've rested.

Should you possess more than one Mother Dark Bring, each will produce lesser Dark Brings independently from each other, meaning that you can up to quintuple the number of Dark Brings generated.
addons.title: Anastasis

addons.text:
The Mother Dark Bring Vampire has acknowledged you as its true master, granting you its power over gravity, more precisely over the concepts of Attraction and Repulsion. Using Attraction you can pull yourself towards your opponent, appearing in their blindspots seemingly instantly. Alternatively you can drag them towards you or another object. Repulsion on the other hand renders you virtually immune to physical attacks as they cannot make contact with you. On a larger scale you can also force your enemies away from you, picking them off at range at your leisure. Finally Vampire can use its power over gravity to warp space around a target, either to harmlessly teleport them to another location or to violently tear them apart on a molecular level, though this requires concentration and a moment of time, making it difficult to use on a rapidly moving target.

Should you possess more than one Mother Dark Bring, each will produce lesser Dark Brings independently from each other, meaning that you can up to quintuple the number of Dark Brings generated.
addons.title: Vampire

addons.text:
The Mother Dark Bring Last Physics has acknowledged you as its true master, granting you its protection from harm. Last Physics' power, being completely defensive in nature, makes up for its lack of direct offensive power with absolute immunity from anything that exists within the physical universe, letting fists, poison, heat and cold, electricity, light, waves of kinetic energy, and anything else pass harmlessly through you. This power is automatic and does not require you to be aware of a danger. Unlike conventional intangibility you can choose to selectively and one-sidedly interact with the world around you, for example grabbing a spear pierced through you and pulling its wielder close, or even punching someone in the face and letting the impact that should go back into your hand due to Newton's Third Law simply slide through you unnoticed. The only thing that could damage you is an exotic conceptual attack untethered to the physical universe. So yes, you would be vulnerable if someone attacked you with the raw Power of Love. Or the Power of Hate. It should be noted however that Shard-based abilities, being Clarketech in nature, are all considered physics-based attacks that cannot harm you unless you choose to let them.

Should you possess more than one Mother Dark Bring, each will produce lesser Dark Brings independently from each other, meaning that you can up to quintuple the number of Dark Brings generated.
addons.title: Last Physics

addons.text:
The Mother Dark Bring Final Story has acknowledged you as its true master, granting you its authority over all other Dark Brings. Whenever a new Dark Bring is born, you gain a mark roughly the size of a quarter on your skin that connects with that Dark Bring, allowing you to freely use its powers at will even if the Dark Bring is in the hands of another. Should the Dark Bring in question be destroyed you can still use its power through its mark, the mark having the same defensive properties as a Dark Bring, meaning that the markings double as near-indestructible armor, though if a mark is destroyed, you lose access to the power even if the Dark Bring still exists. The marks can be hidden when not in use, though using one mark's power renders all of them visible. In addition to letting you access the powers of other Dark Brings, you can at will destroy any non-Mother Dark Bring you choose, making it functionally impossible to use Dark Brings against you.

Should you possess more than one Mother Dark Bring, each will produce lesser Dark Brings independently from each other, meaning that you can up to quintuple the number of Dark Brings generated.
addons.title: Final Story

addons.text: The members of your organization are now all equipped with Dark Brings and skilled in their use. The regular civilians have Regular-Level Dark Brings while your Specialists wield High-Level Dark Brings. Your organization now also contains six adjutants second only to you in authority, each of them equipped with a Supreme-Level Dark Bring.
addons.title: Demon Card

addons.text: You gain access to the technological knowledge of Rave Master's criminal underworld organizations such as Demon Card, Blue Guardians, and Onigami. While most of what you can build is at best slightly more advanced than the technology of the 21st century, there are some standouts you can construct such as airships large enough to carry entire towns in them and yet still fly, turning humans into mindlessly obedient werewolves or near-completely robotic cyborgs, and building an energy cannon that could destroy an entire fortress in one shot, though it takes a lot to charge. Most significant however are your ability to fuse human with Dark Brings to create super soldiers, and to once a year conduct the Ritual of Enclaim which allows you to create dozens of Dark Brings at one, at least one of which is guaranteed to be a Supreme Dark Bring.
addons.title: Underworld Tech

objects.text:
You have come into the possession of a Mother Dark Bring, a small orb resembling a jewel that is completely indestructible by conventional means. While seemingly inert, it regularly produces other Dark Brings at a rate of one every few days. Dark Brings are typically also small orbs, though some exist in more exotic forms such as a sword or even a pond, that can give their user a specific but random power. This could be anything from turning into a smoke, causing explosions on set coordinates, producing glue, permanently transforming their user into a monstrous form, or firing a massive black orb that erases anything that it comes into contact with. Dark Brings can be divided into Regular-Level, High-Level, and Supreme, with each Level granting greater powers. Each Dark Bring generated by your Mother Dark Bring has a 90% chance of being Regular-Level, a 9% chance of being High-Level, and a 1% chance of being Supreme Level. You can choose to use any Dark Bring yourself or give them to others. Though do be careful, as Dark Brings can also be stolen and used without your consent.

All Dark Brings share the innate trait of being completely indestructible, with one exception. As items formed essentially from the concept of Darkness itself, they can be destroyed by a sufficiently powerful Light, in this case referring to Holy Power rather than light-based abilities such as Brandish or Purity. How much Holy Power is required depends on the level of the Dark Bring in question, with a Mother Dark Bring requiring something on the level of a Seraph giving it their all to destroy.

The powers contained within the Mother Dark Bring you carry is greater than any of lesser Dark bring, but as your Mother Dark Bring has yet to fully accept you as its master they are currently hidden from you.
objects.title: Mother Dark Bring (Rave Master)

objects.text:
This mystical crystal has an immense amount of power. In the hands of a normal person it could destroy planets and stars. In the hands of the mighty, it becomes vastly more powerful and capable of greater feats. It can accomplish feats such as healing, resurrection, spacetime manipulation, sealing an entire planet and more. A sufficiently powerful holder could change all of reality with it, though that would take a great deal of power. 

However, the Silver Crystal relies on the heart of the holder to work. It requires strong willpower and resolve at a minimum, and strong love or other positive feelings are helpful. Additionally, it's overuse can drain the holder and even cost them their life.
objects.title: Silver Crystal (Sailor Moon)

objects.text: You've discovered one of the Ancient's greatest inventions: their crystalline power sources, known as "Zero Point Modules." These crystals draw energy from an artificial singularity encased within. ZPMs are capable of extracting an almost infinite amount of energy. It took holding back the crushing weight of an ocean for ten thousand years to finally deplete the three ZPMs Atlantis was equipped with. The crystals can be easily integrated into any power delivery system, seamlessly providing exactly the amount of power required. The flat section of the crystal serves as an interface; when touched, you can increase or decrease the flow of power as needed. Alongside this ZPM, you also receive instructions on how to utilize it to create more Zero Point Modules safely.
objects.title: Zero Point Module (Stargate)

addons.text:
You can now create counterfeits of the Chaos Emeralds, with the same prowess of Tails from Sonic Adventure 2. These fakes can look near identical to the real thing, but their actual power is much weaker to them, for the simple fact that the originals held unlimited power. This means that no matter what, you cannot create a perfect replica of the Emeralds. 

You can however, mass produce these fake versions if you have the ability to. Sharing the same feats possible with the originals, even Super Forms, but to a lesser scale. The only caveat is that the Chaos Energy within them is unstable, wild, and can backfire without proper usage. They also run the risk of turning to dust when overloaded, depleted, or overused.
addons.title: Fake Emeralds

objects.text:
These seven gemstones of mysterious origins can be either be absorbed into your body, or wielded individually to grant access to "Chaos Energy". 

Individually, manipulation of this energy allows you to warp space-time and turn your thoughts into power, allowing for feats such as enhancements, teleportation, time stopping, time travel, construct creations, projectiles, destructive blasts, deflection, and much more. 

By combining all seven of them into your body, you will achieve a "Super Form". A state that will by default; spike up your hair, cloak you in golden brilliance and change your eye color to red. Alternatively, you may design it however you wish.

For as long as you maintain your "Super Form"; you can fly, your natural abilites are far more potent, and possess unlimited reserves of Chaos Energy. If you activate or lose this form, you are guaranteed to be completely refreshed regardless of your previous condition.

The secret to mastery of this energy is in the balance of Positive and Negative Energy. As it draws its power from the wielder's heart.
objects.title: Chaos Emeralds (Sonic the Hedgehog)

objects.text: The Paradox Prism is a relic of unlimited energy capable of altering reality and manipulating space-time, to the point of destroying and creating brand new and alternate realities. But only if it's whole, and you choose to wield it for such. Even then, caution is recommended. Beyond this, the Prism is made up of five separate Shards that have unique powers. Even when split into these Shards, each ability is still powerful, only dwarfed when the Prism is whole. Unlike the events of Sonic Prime, splitting the Prism will not result in reality collapsing. The Red Shard can empower and improve any kind of technology on a nigh-unlimited scale. From being a power source to causing rapid adaptation and performance optimization. The Green Shard can generate and manipulate plant life. Able to grow a forest by itself if one wills it. The Blue Shard can conjure storms and whirlwinds to the point of creating hurricanes or large floods, as well as generate and manipulate lightning. The Purple Shard can transmute and conjure objects using only your imagination. As a Shard, the scope of this power becomes limited to non-living things and autonomous beings like the Grim The Yellow Shard acts as a stabilizer should the Prism be split, allowing you to easily reconstruct it. As well as a preservation failsafe should you attempt to bend space-time and reality, or be affected by similar forces.
objects.title: Paradox Prism (Sonic the Hedgehog)

addons.text: "It's only me and you, who is gonna save you now?" Empowering the Ruby with the Reality Marble results in a match made in heaven. No longer is a suitable power source an issue, nor any backlash from such, as the Reality Marble is the perfect power source for it. Your illusions are very real and very tangible. Your inner world is now an entire dimension within your soul waiting to be unleashed and overwrite the world as you see fit. Even Nullspace can be manifested if you wished.
addons.title: Infinite

objects.text: The Phantom Ruby. This icosahedron shaped gem is one of immense power, beyond even that of the legendary Chaos Emeralds. One of its primary abilities is that of creating illusions. These illusions can range from living beings that can even act of their own accord, whole LOCATIONS, and even a sun itself! These illusions affect those whom the target wishes to on such a primal, deep level that their brains have no choice but to believe it is real. Another aspect of the Ruby is its power to cancel out powerful objects. Anything up to 30 SP in power can allow the user to simply bypass any defensive aspect of it. It allows the user to access a location known as Nullspace, a place where nothing exists, and the only means of escape is high-enough velocity to break free of the dimension. Finally, it can teleport you from one location to another that you have been to before, and even to whole other dimensions if certain circumstances are met. However, the only drawback of all of this is that you need an immense power source to work with it. The more power it has, the stronger the illusions are, but the reverse is also quite true.
objects.title: Phantom Ruby (Sonic the Hedgehog)

addons.text:
A unique bond has formed between your Spiegel and the Book of Grudges, allowing Spiegel to copy your enemies, even if they are dead or outside its range.

Clones can be either “older” or “younger” versions of themselves, depending on how the Book of Grudges remembers them. These clones are capable of traveling beyond Spiegel's range to take revenge on the offender, using all their memory and skills. Their energy supply lasts for about 3 months or several intense battles, after which they disappear. However, they cannot replenish their energy outside of Spiegel's range.

You still cannot make more than one copy of a person. But there is one loophole: if your offender insulted you too long ago and has managed to become a “completely different person,” then both the ‘young’ and “old” versions of them can exist simultaneously.
addons.title: Vengeful Clones

objects.text:
The demon, also known as the Water-Mirror Demon, looks like a bright purple diamond with gold details and purple crystals growing in a circle around it. It's totally harmless on its own and can be easily destroyed.

Its main feature is its ability to create perfect copies of others, completely copying all their memories, powers, and abilities. However, these copies have no mind of their own and simply imitate the actions of the originals, albeit very effectively.

Externally, the copies are monotonous gray in color, with a complete copy of the equipment and appearance. When destroyed, they gradually disintegrate into small evaporating particles. After destruction, they may reappear after a certain period of time.

To copy, Spiegel must be able to sense and scan the subject for several minutes. The scanning radius is about 1 km, regardless of any obstacles. He cannot make more than 1 copy of each subject.

Your “demon” can be considered a magic crystal, with its own will and mind, but one that will be largely devoted to you.
objects.title: Spiegel (Sousou no Frieren)

objects.text:
You’ve opened the Thousand Year Door and found the seven Crystal Stars, each bestowing a unique ability to aid in your further adventures, but can only use them once before needing to recharge. As a foundation, you learn the Sweet Treat to restore a portion of your own vitality and energies as well as the following abilities:

Earth Tremor to cause a massive earthquake.

Clock Out to immobilize targets.

Power Lift to temporarily increase your strength and defense.

Art Attack to take down hordes of enemies.

Sweet Feast to heal your body to peak condition.

Showstopper to inflict a random amount of damage to your enemies.

Finally, Supernova to attack hordes of targets with massive damage.
objects.title: Crystal Stars (Super Mario)

objects.text:
You now possess a fully awakened Exsphere stabilized by a Key Crest, a small gem-like core embedded in a enchanted metal casing.

In its raw state, an Exsphere is a magical parasite. Without a Key Crest, it feeds off the wearer’s mana, negative emotions, and life force, gradually consuming their soul in a slow, torturous process designed to cause as much pain as possible as possible for months. This deliberate slow death refines the host’s soul into fuel, transforming the Exsphere into an eternal magical reactor.

However, with a Key Crest, the Exsphere’s parasitic nature is reversed. Its energies stabilize and harmonize with the user, unlocking a wellspring of power that amplifies the physical, mental, magical, and spiritual abilities of the user far beyond natural limits. It generates magical energy ceaselessly, empowering even non-magical beings to challenge armies of those unenhanced.

Over time, the Exsphere also adapts to its user, developing unique abilities known as Ex-Skills. These exist beyond the Exshphere’s normal raw amplification, granting benefits such as accelerated mana regeneration, further increased physical strength, improved training efficiency, total immunity to status effects, or even short bursts of temporary invincibility. As more Ex-Skills are gained, they may also synergize to unlock powerful compound abilities that transcend both natural and magical laws.

However, even with a Key Crest, an Exsphere is not without cost. It binds itself to the user’s being, permanently altering their essence, identity, and soul, making removal without death impossible. Should the Key Crest ever fail or be removed, the user’s mana will near instantly collapse, either consuming them entirely or twisting them into a mindless monstrosity.

An Exsphere is not merely a tool, but a fusion of soul and power. Though rare, those who master an Exsphere often become legends. Those who fail are seldom remembered after their souls are devoured to further fuel the core's endless ascent.
objects.title: Exsphere (Tales of: Symphonia)

objects.text:
The Moonstone is the source of all Pixie Dust in Neverland. This magical jewel is about the size of a small marble, roughly a centimeter in diameter and normally ridiculously fragile, shattering from the smallest of drops. While the size is still the same, its durability has been enhanced, though it would still break if someone were to throw it at a hard surface.

Once every eight years, when the Blue Moon is at its peak, its light will shine through the Moonstone and create Blue Pixie Dust. The amount of blue Pixie Dust generated is enough to last Neverland's Pixie Dust Tree eight years, though the amount is variable depending on how much of the Moonstone's surface area is exposed to the Blue Moon's light.

The most basic use of Blue Pixie Dust, is to refine into regular Pixie Dust. Regular Pixie Dust grants the power of flight. While refining can be done by simply touching Blue Pixie, this process is both dangerous and inefficient, with a single grain of Blue Pixie Dust coating your entire body in a dense layer of regular Pixie Dust that can make you fly uncontrollably. For this reason, using a Pixie Dust Tree is both safer and more efficient, creating far more Pixie Dust without coating your body.

You will receive basic knowledge of the art of Pixie Dust Alchemy, the process of combining Blue Pixie with other substances, to create various Colored Pixie Dusts. These Dusts allow access to Fairy Talents. Fairy Talents cover various skills and supernatural abilities, from types of elemental manipulation, to animal communication and crafting skills like weaving or even just flying faster. Through the use of certain Fairy Talents, it is possible to grow a Pixie Dust Tree and create various tools to help in handling Pixie Dust.
objects.title: Moonstone (Tinker Bell)

objects.text:
You have acquired the legendary Heart of Kandrakar, a mystical artifact forged by the combined power of the four elemental dragons and a pure soul. More than a relic, it is a conduit of immense magic, imbued with fire, water, earth, air, and quintessence. As its chosen keeper, you are bound to its power, granting you abilities beyond mortal reach.

The Heart grants you sight beyond the veil, allowing you to perceive the unseen, scry distant worlds, and unlock the means to traverse them. With but a thought, you can open portals across dimensions, create duplicates of yourself, and unravel even the most intricate disguises, revealing the truth beneath. 

It resonates in the presence of evil, warning you through a chime or a vision within its glowing crystal, ensuring you are never defenseless against lurking threats.

In battle, the Heart manifests its power as a radiant force. It shields you from harm with barriers of pure energy, blinds enemies with searing light, and channels devastating pulses, beams, and waves of mystical force to strike down those who oppose you. 

Yet its greatest gift lies in its bond with the Guardians—five chosen wielders of elemental magic. Unlike them, you are not confined to a single element. 

Each time you transform, you may choose which elemental power to command, shifting seamlessly between them. The elements you do not take can be bestowed upon others, awakening latent magic within them, allowing their abilities to grow far beyond what you initially grant.

At its core, the Heart is deeply connected to the Aurameres, the wellsprings of elemental energy from which all such magic flows. By tapping into their power, you can amplify not only your own abilities but also those of the Guardians twentyfold, turning even the smallest spark into an overwhelming force. 

The Heart of Kandrakar is more than an artifact—it is the nexus of magic itself, and through it, you wield a power that shapes destiny.
objects.title: Heart of Kandrakar (W.I.T.C.H)

rows.title: Crystal Objects of Power
rows.titleText: Note: All non-consumable Objects of Powers can be transferred to another person. When this happens, you do not lose any abilities the object unlocked or awakened (physical alterations, magic independent of the object, etc.) but any soul bonds transferred to the new owner.

objects.text:
You are now the commander of a disciplined company of 100 former Union infantrymen drawn from the United States of America during the Westward Expansion era. They arrive fully equipped with standard-issue uniforms and weapons, such as revolvers, repeating rifles, pump shotguns, and the occasional sniper rifle, etc. Each man comes with a horse, ammunition, camping supplies, and all the equipment expected of a well-supplied Westward Expansion-era Union infantry company.

The company is organized according to a traditional infantry structure of the era. This includes ten squads of ten men, each led by an experienced sergeant. Above them operate commissioned officers, including a lieutenant for each platoon grouping and a captain who serves as overall company commander beneath you. The structure is flexible enough to reconfigure into smaller detachments or consolidated formations as battlefield conditions require, while still maintaining a clear chain of command.

Many of the men possess the broad range of practical skills expected of experienced frontiersmen and professional soldiers of their era. They are proficient in marksmanship, mounted riding, scouting, navigation, tracking, hunting, fieldcraft, survival, camp management, basic engineering, construction, fortification building, first aid, and maintaining their own weapons, equipment, and horses. Many also possess useful civilian trades such as blacksmithing, carpentry, farming, masonry, cooking, and wagon repair, ensuring the company can remain largely self-sufficient even when operating far from established settlements for extended periods.

Within the unit are designated specialists assigned to critical logistical and support roles. These include medics trained in battlefield first aid and trauma care, capable of stabilizing wounded personnel under fire, and a quartermaster responsible for supply management, ration distribution, ammunition accounting, equipment maintenance oversight, and coordination of resupply cycles. These roles are filled by experienced personnel drawn from within the company and can be reassigned or replaced if necessary without disrupting overall cohesion.

They are capable of constructing buildings and basic fortifications, standing guard, patrolling territory, and engaging in combat. They are also perfectly capable of adapting to more modern weapons, tactics, and logistics if taught how to do so.

It should also be noted that these men are fanatically loyal to you, their appointed commander. This loyalty is absolute and non-negotiable, extending beyond fear, bribery, coercion, or ideological conflict. They will follow any orders without hesitation and will not willingly betray, abandon, or act against the interests of you, their commander, under any circumstance.

Every 30 days, the company is automatically resupplied with whatever it requires to maintain operational readiness. Ammunition, food, medical supplies, horse feed, clothing, camping equipment, and other expendable items are replenished as needed, while damaged weapons, tools, saddles, uniforms, and other issued equipment are repaired or replaced. Horses that perish are likewise restored during the next resupply cycle. This replenishment applies only to the company's original issued equipment and supplies, preventing the duplication of captured, purchased, or externally acquired resources.

If any member of the unit is killed, they will reappear after 6 months, at full health, along with restored gear and equipment. This regeneration does not carry the memory of their death unless explicitly permitted by you, but it does allow them to remember any skills or tactics taught to them, allowing the unit to function and to grow in skill and power.

This option may be purchased multiple times, up to a maximum of 10 purchases. Each purchase increases the total size of the force through an exponential scaling factor rather than a simple addition. The first purchase provides a company of 100 soldiers. The second increases your total force to 1,000 soldiers. The third increases it to 10,000 soldiers, and this scaling continues in the same exponential progression with each purchase, reflecting expanded recruitment capacity, command infrastructure, and logistical reach.

After the tenth purchase, the system no longer expands the force through direct scaling. Instead, it transitions into a reinforcement model. At the end of every 30-day cycle, you will automatically receive additional troops as reinforcements, generated and integrated into your existing command structure. These reinforcements arrive fully equipped and trained in accordance with the standards of the force.

You may, at any time, set a hard cap on the total number of active troops under your command. If you do so, any reinforcements generated beyond that limit will be held in reserve and can be activated or cycled in later as replacements for losses or as additional formations under your control.

Units remain distinct unless deliberately merged under unified command, allowing for scalable formations ranging from small tactical detachments to full army-level operational control.

(Note: It is up to you whether they are from the Union or from an equivalent military from that era; if you want, you can have them be from another nation, like The Confederacy, The UK, France, Germany, or Japan, but they all must be from the same nation.)
objects.title: 19th c. Infantry Company

objects.text:
You are now the proud owner of a soul-soothing pet, it can be any creature you can think of, whether you want a mundane pet such as a cat or dog, a supernatural creature like a phoenix, or even a Mandalorian strill. Regardless of its form, it is eternally youthful, is immune to most forms of disease, and is overall very healthy. It loves you unconditionally and is very affectionate, they will follow your commands to the best of their ability and are remarkably intelligent. Your pet is also easily trained and already has training as a therapy animal, having an almost supernatural capacity for easing stress and burdens on those they spend time with, an odd thing about them is that just interacting with them has a soothing effect on people. Being around them long enough helps people move on from even long-time traumas. They are accustomed to traveling and will not grow stressed from constant travel like other animals. Is there anything a good boi can’t solve?

Your Good Boi (or Girl) will have a familiar contract with you, connecting both of your souls. Through the connection established between you and them, you can telepathically communicate with it, giving and receiving sensory information. Furthermore, due to its connection to you, it can also enter a special space within your soul and rest or recuperate when injured. Should it die, it will be reborn within your soul after 24 hours no matter the circumstances. As a side effect of the bond you share, your familiar cannot exceed your powers. A mundane animal would be left as strong as a regular one, while an alien or supernatural creature would have their abilities limited so that they don't exceed your strength.
objects.title: A Certified Good Boi (or Girl)

objects.text:
The A-HED Drone is an Elite Drone type of the Machine Hives, designed as a central battlefield unit that directs, engages, and sustains combat across hostile zones without support. It was engineered to combine advanced adaptive technologies with overwhelming resilience and integrated system infiltration capabilities, ensuring that a single unit can dominate both physical and digital fronts simultaneously.

The chassis of the A-HED Drone stands over three meters tall, humanoid in general shape but exaggerated in form with wide shoulders, reinforced limbs, and plated armor that interlocks across the torso and extremities. Its exterior is constructed from titanium-ceramic composites layered with adaptive nano-ceramic matrices, giving the drone resistance against high-caliber ballistic impacts, shaped charges, and short-duration directed-energy weapons. The drone can absorb kinetic impacts exceeding several tons of force before structural compromise, and the armored plating can dissipate localized thermal loads equivalent to atmospheric re-entry levels. 

Internally, the drone is built around a modular nanotech framework that manages damage repair, reinforcement, and material synthesis. When its armor is breached, adaptive matrices regenerate by consuming molecular reserves and hydrocarbon substrates, rebuilding plating and musculature without outside maintenance. Core systems are anchored by gravitic nodes embedded in the feet and palms, providing stability against recoil, scaling surfaces, and resisting external forces. Its synthetic-carbon musculature, driven by high-torque actuators, gives it strength surpassing armored vehicles and the ability to breach fortified structures.

The arms of the unit contain reconfigurable secondary modules that opens up into a cluster of reinforced tendrils, constructed of layered alloyed composites with flexible spinal conduits and integrated claw-tipped couplers. Each tendril can release up to 50,000 volts, paired with integrated EMP emitters, sufficient to disable unshielded drones, cybernetics, or exosuits for up to several seconds. The tendrils can also arc electricity between each other, creating short-range plasma-like discharges that can lash outward unpredictably, forming a close-quarters denial field around the drone. Additionally, they can extend probes into wiring, fiber channels, and circuitry for direct system-level access. Through this access, the AI can rapidly hack into the system of its target.

The AI core of the drone is a fully sapient combat intelligence, a free AI with no inbuilt limitations. It runs on a fusion of neuromorphic quantum processors and advanced cognitive layering. It maintains simultaneous battlefield threat analysis, command coordination of subordinate drones, adaptive tactical restructuring, and continuous cyberwarfare execution. It can run multiple concurrent cognitive threads, enabling physical combat, system infiltration, and strategic oversight without loss of performance. The AI will see you as its companion and friend, as long as you don’t mistreat it.

The power source is a hybrid combustion-fusion core that utilizes refined hydrocarbon slurries as its base fuel. The hydrocarbons are superheated, broken down at the molecular level, and injected into a micro-fusion chamber where catalytic plasma reactions convert the chemical energy into raw fusion-grade output. This process produces immense surges of power, trading environmental safety for overwhelming continuous output. The reactor emits toxic exhaust gases, thermal plumes, and heavy electromagnetic signatures, making its presence impossible to hide.
objects.title: A-HED Drone

addons.text: With the capabilities of the Chip, your bond with the Machine God has deepened even further, allowing it to treat the intelligence within the Chip as an offshoot of itself. As such, its absolute command over all electronics and technology is now yours to command, allowing you to manipulate such things yourself. Similarly to the Machine God, these abilities will initially be limited to what you can directly touch and network connections, but over time your area of influence will grow.
addons.title: Deific Overwatch
Tech World Science (Warlock of the Magus World)
addons.text:
You gain the technological knowledge of the civilization Leylin originated from. This includes its advanced artificial intelligence, biotechnology, energy systems, computing, materials science, manufacturing, spaceflight, and other technologies far beyond modern science.

This knowledge includes the technology behind the A.I. Chips used throughout Leylin's original civilization, as well as the more advanced systems developed by its scientists, including dimensional technology and time machines. The civilization had already developed the means to travel between worlds and conquer planets long before Leylin's arrival in the Magus World.

objects.text: The A.I. Chip is an advanced Biological Assistance Microchip designed to integrate seamlessly with the user's brain. Originally a vital tool for scientists from a advanced distant world, it functions primarily as a material device for data storage and analysis. Your chip has evolved into a highly versatile asset, now residing in your soul and gaining new capabilities. The A.I. Chip provides several essential features to its user: Data Storage: The chip records and stores the user's experiences, creating a comprehensive database from sensory input. Data Analysis: It processes simulations and draws deductions from the information stored. Language Translation: By leveraging its data analysis and storage functions, the chip can translate and comprehend unknown languages. Skill Enhancement: The A.I. assists in refining techniques—both supernatural and mundane—by offering real-time feedback and suggestions. Power Tracking: It monitors the user’s supernatural energy, vital signs, and those of nearby individuals, alerting the user to potential dangers or opportunities for growth. Upgrades and Energy Source: The chip draws energy from yourself and the surrounding atmosphere to power itself and enable future upgrades.
objects.title: A.I. Chip

objects.text: The best way to describe an angel is that it is what would happen if a train was an animal. You have been given a vial of golden ichorous angel blood. When empty, the vial will refill over the course of a year until it is full again. When the ichor is poured onto a surface, it begins to pool and congeal into a thick globular substance. After three days, the first eye will appear on the liquid pupa. After this, you can demonstrate things to the eye. You can show it videos, read books to it, explain concepts and more in order to mould it into your preferred style. Ultimately after 1 month in it’s semi-liquid state it will have grown many eyes, feathers and disparate pieces besides. It will then use the semi-liquid remains of its pupate state to encircle it in a shell. After another week, this shell will crack and a newborn angel will emerge with its divine duty and providence determined by what was shared with it while in its pupate state. The juvenile angel is likely to view you as a caretaker and trust your advice, with its understanding somewhere between that of a child and a particularly intelligent dog. Its specific abilities and capabilities are determined by its providence, but these usually take the form of plausibly deniable actions through the medium of its domain. Domains of machines can cause spontaneous malfunction or refunction, domains of animals may cause fleas to enter eyes causing run-on effects to protect you. Notably, should an angel ‘fall’, it is more akin to a train derailment than a divine smiting. The Fall is an ultimately fatal extension of an angel denying its domain, taking complete control of fate in a vast area around it for ten minutes. It’s ultimate aims and decisions during the fall are to the angels’ discretion, but it is often destructive to all that surrounds it that it does not make explicit care for. After an angel’s ‘Fall’, it will die, leaving only a shattered golden shell behind.
objects.title: Angel Blood

addons.text: Legions tend to collect many "names" over their long history. From simple names inherited from where they might be stationed, such as Scythica or Germanica, to names awarded for service, such as Victrix or Ferrata, but the rarest names are those granted by the gods themselves. Now, the Ninth is blessed with the name Fulminata as the Legio IX Fulminata, the Ninth Legion Armed with Lightning. Blessed with the power of Divine Lightning by the power of Jupiter himself, you as his child are capable of using the Aquila to empower the legionaries weapons with the power of lightning, allowing them to enhance the cutting power of their blades and emit blasts of lightning via their spears. Alternatively, as the bearer of the Aquila, you can channel the entire power of the blessing into blasts of lightning capable of clearing entire battlefields. While it can emit multiple blasts in quick succession, it will eventually overheat from the sheer force of the divine energy if not given time to "cool" down between blasts. The final trick of the Aquilla is the ability to use the mist to change its form into a bracelet of Imperial Gold, with the full name of the Legion inscribed in crimson. While in this form, none of the powers of the Aquilla bears to command lightning or summon its legion can be used.
addons.title: Fulminata

addons.text:
Where once the Eagle of the Ninth was corrupted by dark magic, the power of your divine parentage and your denial of reality as it is have rendered this a falsehood.

Much in the same way Iskander Magnos could use his own Reality Marble, Ionioi Hetairoi, to summon his armies, you can use yours—in combination with the Aquila—to summon all the demigods who have ever served in the legions before the fall of Rome under the Eagle of the Ninth.

They are trained legionnaires, equipped with Imperial Gold, Roman steel, and magical artifacts, loyal to you and your cause, experienced in the use of their powers, and alive once more—so long as you can maintain your Reality Marble active.

When you deactivate this power, they are returned to their place in the Underworld, maintaining their memories of what happened from summon to summon.

Note: Reincarnated demigods currently undergoing another life, that would otherwise be targeted by this power, will not be targeted until that life has ended.
addons.title: Quirites Legiones

objects.text:
The mystery over the disappearance of one of Rome's prized legions, the Ninth Hispana has puzzled historians and archaeologists alike. Last truly recorded being in Eboracum, now modern day York. The Ninth Legion disappears almost without a trace.

But now their grim fate is revealed. In your possession lies the treasured battle standard, the Aquilla of the Ninth Legion. Corrupted, and tainted by profane black magic, as it once rallied the Ninth Legion in their life, it does so in their death. Whoever holds the Aquilla can summon forth the tortured forms of the Ninth Legion—and all of it's auxiliaries, and equipment—to serve as an unrelenting, remorseless army of the undead. They know no fear, no pity, no mercy, only blind, absolute obedience to the orders of the one bearing their treasured Aquilla.

This army of the undead cannot be killed with any conventional weapons, blades and bullets might slow them down, but will not stop them. Fire or holy power can destroy their corporeal forms, but their tormented souls are able to possess the corpses of the deceased, and slowly twist them into their original forms.
objects.title: Aquilla of the Ninth

objects.text:
This robot is said to be from an alternate future in a reality where humans wished to truly bring the Animal Kingdom to a new age. In its basic form, the Bestiarie has a general animal shape with a slight canine influence. Its black exterior shines ironically alongside the deep gold lining its body. But the visuals are not all it has. The true strength lies in its “Apto” Protocol.

Bestiarie can copy any animal it encounters and take on an exact replication of the form, aside from the mechanical visage, of course. If it were to see a black bear, it could copy that bear down to the last mechanical hair. If it saw an ant, you would see a giant mechanical red ant with your own eyes. Even something as big as a blue whale can be copied.

Whatever it copies, Bestiarie also gains benefits based on the natural skills of the animal: pixel-perfect echolocation from a bat, a bite strength capable of piercing mithril-level materials from an alligator snapping turtle, twenty times the speed of sound from a cheetah, and more. The AI of this creature is relatively easy to program, with its default intelligence comparable to that of a 10-year-old female child. It can also disable or reconfigure its vocal processors based on user input.
