Thankfully, it is also able to integrate weapons into the forms, albeit slowly. Examples include a rifle in the mouth of the cat form or a sword attached to the tail of the wolf form. However, the only other drawback of this robot is its inability to copy supernatural creatures like griffons or dragons.
objects.title: Bestiarie

objects.text:
You possess a doll, small enough to be cradled in your arms—perhaps a fragile porcelain figure with lifeless glass eyes, a hand-stitched cloth doll with a worn smile, or a beloved teddy bear with fur thinned from years of imagined adventures. Beneath its innocent exterior lurks something far more sinister: an ancient, eldritch horror bound within the doll’s fragile form. This being slumbers most of the time, its mind adrift in alien dreams beyond mortal comprehension. It stirs only when you command it, awakening with an unnatural hunger.

While it sleeps, the horror passively influences its surroundings. The longer it remains in one location, the more that place becomes subtly attuned to its presence, weaving unseen threads of connection between the world and its slumbering mind. In these attuned spaces, the creature’s power grows significantly, enabling it to act with far greater strength and efficiency when called upon.

When awakened, the doll itself begins to undergo disturbing transformations. Mouths filled with serrated teeth tear open along its surface, writhing tentacles sprout from seams and stuffing, and unnatural growths ripple beneath its once-innocent exterior. The doll’s internal space becomes warped and impossible, containing vastly more than its small frame should allow. Even as the body expands grotesquely, its interior stretches into a pocket of warped reality, a writhing dimension of flesh, void, and hunger.

Upon awakening, the creature also radiates an oppressive aura that floods the minds of those nearby. This aura induces a deep, instinctual fear, muddling rational thought and increasing the chances of mistakes and panic among those affected. In some rare and unfortunate cases, the aura does the opposite, sharpening the mind to a cruel, hyper-logical clarity that borders on madness—what some might call “super-sanity”—forcing those afflicted to perceive horrifying truths about the nature of the horror and reality itself.

The horror grows stronger the more fear it provokes, thriving on the terror it sows. It also physically strengthens itself by consuming living beings through the gaping mouths it manifests. Each act of consumption not only nourishes the creature but accelerates its evolution, making it increasingly more potent and harder to contain with every fearful breath it steals and every victim it devours.
objects.title: Cuddly Horror

addons.text:
The Program Ripper’s primary limitation is the same as the rogue AIs it is designed to dismantle: finite hardware capacity. Its processing power, while formidable, is limited by the need to keep the unit light and mobile enough for combat deployment. Increasing its onboard computational resources would require larger, heavier systems, sacrificing speed and maneuverability, ultimately rendering it as immobile and logistically demanding as the Overseer. The Coalition of Mankind addressed this by merging the strengths of both platforms into a single, integrated combat architecture, creating Thanatos.

Instead of a single Program Ripper, you get a coordinated team of seven units, each networked directly to the Overseer. This connection transforms the Rippers into distributed processing nodes, able to draw on the Overseer’s immense quantum computing capacity and deep data stores in real time. The Overseer serves as a command nexus, assigning intrusion tasks, correlating threat data, and running large-scale predictive models while the Rippers execute precision cyberwarfare operations. Each Ripper operates semi-independently, but their cyberoffensive capabilities compound when working in parallel, sharing live infiltration data, exploit chains, and adaptive countermeasure updates across the formation. 

The result is a hybrid network capable of scaling intrusion power to match the Overseer’s strategic reach. With the Overseer guiding their combined efforts, the seven Rippers can conduct multi-vector digital sieges at a scope impossible for isolated units. Working at their peak, they can overwhelm the defensive systems of a Jupiter-sized warship harboring multiple civilization-level AI threats and countless smaller AIs, systematically penetrating, isolating, and subverting its entire control architecture within minutes. 

The primary drawback of this configuration is the extreme thermal load generated during such large-scale attacks. When operating at maximum capacity, the combined heat output can exceed the cooling tolerances of both the Overseer and the Program Rippers, resulting in temporary system blackouts for the Overseer and catastrophic overheating that destroys all seven Rippers, their internal components melting beyond recovery.
addons.title: Coordinated Penetration System 09 “Thanatos”

addons.text: As much as the Coalition of Mankind loathed the Blackbox Shard “Brick,” there was no denying its raw effectiveness. The Coalition, pragmatic in the way only great powers can afford to be, decided that if the Brick was dangerous in the hands of raiders, it would be devastating in their own. They fused the Brick’s destructive outlaw AI seed into their most advanced cyberwarfare platform, the Program Ripper. The result was the first of a new breed: Blacknet Hunter Unit 00 “Tartarus.” Unlike the original Brick, Tartarus does not release its AI seed blindly. Its processors and cognitive emulation engines were wired to regulate, reshape, and direct the seed AI that once burned blindly through systems. Instead of releasing a single copy and watching it consume whatever it touched, Tartarus could spawn entire families of digital predators, dozens to hundreds of distinct variations, each tailored for a specific role. Some were built for brute-force replication, others for infiltration, and still others for subtle corruption, quietly degrading enemy logic trees until collapse came hours or days later. Every variant could be sculpted on the fly, customized and reprogrammed even after deployment. This synergy is amplified by its heritage as a Program Ripper. Program Ripper’s original purpose had been to detect, map, and dismantle hostile AI, predicting their vulnerabilities by simulating their thought processes. Tartarus not only retained this capacity but turned it inward as well. It understood the weaknesses of the seed AIs it released, correcting their flaws, reinforcing their defenses, and sharpening them into weapons that could stand against systems they would once have failed to breach. More importantly, it could use them as hounds against other AIs. Lastly, Tartarus transcends the Brick’s greatest limitation: physical contact. The original Brick required physical contact, pressed against the casing of a device so its inductive coupling field could brute-force a path inside. Tartarus retained this ability, its body still carried contact pads and the integrated hardware for direct injection, but it no longer needed it. The Program Ripper’s arsenal of remote infiltration methods, from multi-band RF injection to ultra-narrow laserline communication, had been integrated into the new design. Tartarus could now transmit its AI seeds across distance, embedding them into enemy systems by signal alone, unleashing its crafted swarms without ever closing the gap. If you have Coordinated Penetration System 09 “Thanatos”, then in addition to the seven units, you also get one additional unit that is Blacknet Hunter Unit 00 “Tartarus”. Just like the other seven unit, it will be networked with the other units and the Overseer.
addons.title: Blacknet Hunter Unit 00 “Tartarus”

objects.text:
Developed by the Coalition of Mankind as a precision instrument for digital warfare, the Program Ripper was deployed in direct response to the threat of Machine Hives and unsanctioned rogue AIs. 

Its external chassis measures 1.85 meters in height and weighs 90 kilograms. The frame uses titanium-ceramic composite plating over carbon-synthetic musculature, providing resistance to low-caliber ballistic weapons up to 9×19mm and blunt force impacts up to 2,500 N without structural compromise. The unit’s strength output is equivalent to a trained Olympic-level human, capable of lifting approximately 250 kg under optimal conditions and sustaining repeated lifts of 150 kg without mechanical strain. The armor can resist directed electrical discharges up to 1,200 volts and dissipate thermal loads from short-duration incendiary contact, but cannot withstand sustained heavy weapons fire or high-energy plasma.

The internal hardware is structured around a modular processing core composed of quantum-assisted neuromorphic processors linked in parallel arrays. These processors are dedicated to real-time intrusion analysis, exploit deployment, and adaptive countermeasure synthesis. Integrated high-speed memory banks provide rapid access to exploit libraries, protocol maps, and AI dismantlement templates. The system is stabilized by triple-phase microchannel liquid cooling arrays, allowing the processors to operate at sustained high load without thermal throttling. 

The Program Ripper’s primary offensive capability lies in its cyberwarfare suite, enabling both remote and physical-system infiltration by breaching defenses through signal or hardware access. For remote operations, it employs multi-band RF injection, ultra-narrow laserline communication, and adaptive packet manipulation, transmitting precision-coded attacks across multiple radio frequencies or laser beams while reshaping network traffic mid-transit to bypass firewalls and intrusion detection systems. In physical access scenarios, it uses fiber-tap probes, induction loop interfaces, and direct hardware injection to intercept optical data streams, inject commands through insulated wiring without contact, or link directly into system circuitry for immediate root-level control. It can deploy polymorphic code fragments designed to evade heuristic scanning, continuously rewriting themselves during execution to adapt to counter-intrusion measures and remain undetected.

While it is skilled at hacking into machines, the unit is optimized for combat against advanced AI programs, using dedicated cognitive emulation routines, vulnerability pattern mapping, and recursive logic corruption to replicate an AI’s decision-making processes, identify exploitable weaknesses, and inject destabilizing feedback loops. Once engaged, the Program Ripper can disable or hijack AI control systems in minutes, with greater speed against more complex software due to its ability to exploit higher-order processing patterns. Its counter-intrusion defenses include full signal cloaking to mask all emissions, encrypted communication shells to secure all transmissions, and hardware-level data zeroization capable of erasing every byte of stored information in 0.3 seconds to prevent capture or trace-back.
objects.title: Cyberwarfare Engagement Unit 07 “Program Ripper”

addons.text: Your Empowered Village is no longer a single settlement tucked into a corner of your domain—it now expands across the entirety of your Plot of Land, transforming your territory into a fully realized, nation-spanning civilization. From the mountains to the coastlines, from fertile valleys to island chains, your land is filled with thriving cities, towns, and communities, all unified under your banner. The number of citizens rises exponentially, scaled proportionally to the full base size of your Plot of Land. What was once a single village of a few hundred has now become a vast, interconnected population—millions of loyal inhabitants living in harmony across your territory. Each city is self-sufficient yet tied closely to the larger nation, creating a powerful, flexible civilization capable of supporting grand infrastructure, defense, culture, innovation, and more. Every citizen shares the same enhancements and loyalties as those in your original Empowered Village.
addons.title: Country of Power

addons.text:
In addition to your empowered villagers, your village now includes a number of old veterans whose abilities stand at the ceiling of potential granted to your people. These veterans are the first generation to have fully grown into their gifts, each one possesses a power level equal to 50% of your current maximum potential, the highest your villagers can naturally achieve.

Each of these veterans is deeply committed to the village’s future and your leadership. While they can no longer grow stronger on their own, they remain active as teachers, mentors, and protectors, eager to pass on everything they’ve learned. Their guidance accelerates the development of newer villagers and can provide invaluable insight and tactical advantage to you directly, especially early on.

These veterans have hit the natural limit of their growth and cannot advance further, unless they are granted access to external sources of power beyond the scope of the village's existing resources. Should they find such sources, some among them may yet ascend to even greater heights.
addons.title: Village Veterans

addons.text: It seems your village has some history. Not only do they inherit a portion of your abilities, they inherit the very history, culture, and traditions that shaped those powers in the first place. Their lives are steeped in the philosophies, rituals, and practices of the civilization from which your gifts originate, as though they had always belonged to it. For example, if they have The Force (Star Wars), then some of your villagers were once Padawans of the Jedi Temple, their recollections filled with lessons from masters long gone. Others may recall the meditations of the Order, the political weight of the Clone Wars, or even the first time they ignited a lightsaber. They do not need to learn how to live as Jedi, they already have, and those lifetimes remain etched in their bones. This connection gives your villagers not only the broad, cultural awareness you yourself gain from Those Who Came Before, but also the grounding of lived experience. They do not “know about” rituals, traditions, or daily life, they have lived them. The farmer tilling your fields may once have been a keeper of sacred archives, the blacksmith hammering steel may recall the battlefields of an ancient empire, and the children playing in the square may laugh with the memories of games once played under alien suns. Furthermore, you are free to shape them not merely as anonymous inheritors of history, but as individuals with names and faces drawn directly from canon, legend, or lore. A villager could be the reborn form of a Jedi Knight, a lost philosopher, or even a famed artisan, as long as their current strength remains bound by the Empowered Village’s rules.
addons.title: Village History

addons.text: Your village is now an entire city with tens of thousands of empowered people loyal to you. The buildings and infrastructure of the entire city is built using esoteric enchanting and sciences that are extensions of the powers granted to the citizens, such as enchanting, consecration or feng shui. The city contains many prominent places of power, such as temples, fortresses, labs or factories that would be appropriate for honing the powers of you and your citizens. The foundations of the city are built on fonts of power related to your powers such as ley lines or rare minerals, which further fuel the development of power within the city. There are several vaults across the city containing many minor relics, artifacts and inventions related to your powers from the worlds they come from. These vaults also contain copies and variants of your Objects of Power, aside from the Empowered Village itself, however these Objects only have 10% to 50% of the original’s power. You may choose to exclude certain Objects of Power from the vaults. With Village Veterans, there are now academies, dojos, temples and other institutions dedicated to the teaching of each of your powers. They are staffed by several veterans, masters, and teachers. The city’s vaults gain vast archives dedicated to different techniques, secrets and blueprints of your powers. With Village History, the city has museums, statues, libraries and media carrying the cultures of your Powers’ original worlds. In addition, there will be replicas of important locations, bases and places of power. With Country of Power and beyond, every city, settlement and facility triples in size and population, built as a relic city and containing their own vaults and power fonts. Your original Empowered Village becomes a megacity capitol for your Country.
addons.title: Relic City
Demographic Shift
addons.text:
Having been connected to your gateway of other selves, your village has taken on aspects of this change.

Firstly, your villagers can take the form of any species or power you have access to your You-Niverse as they choose in addition to shifting as you can.

Secondly, you can choose for 5% of your villagers (30) to be variants of you. While these you-s possess your powers at the same level you do, they inherit the loyalty inherent to your village.

objects.text:
You now possess not just land, but a thriving, fully-functioning village that owes its existence and allegiance entirely to you. Nestled in a fertile, defensible location of your choosing, the village consists of roughly 600 inhabitants. The infrastructure is modest yet sustainable: clean water sources, farmlands, workshops, homes, and communal spaces, all maintained with competence and care by the villagers themselves.

Every single villager is bound to you with unwavering loyalty, viewing you as their chief and leader. More importantly, each of them are also empowered by your powers. All of your powers gained through the CYOA are replicated within each villager at 10% of your current strength, and they can grow to a ceiling of 50% of your maximum potential. This is based off your base power. 

The only exception to this is species-based or racial abilities. Your villagers share your race or species—for example, if you are a dragon, they are dragons as well, or if you are an elf, then they are elves as well. In such cases, they possess those traits either at 50% of your strength or at the full baseline level of the shared race or species, whichever is greater.

Note: You may choose to withhold specific powers or racial abilities from being granted to your villagers. In doing so, while the raw power level each villager receives remains unchanged, their depth of understanding, precision, and overall mastery of the abilities they do receive increases significantly.
objects.title: Empowered Village

objects.text:
You have with you the flesh of an alien god. It takes the form of a fist-sized, black and oily leech. Its surface is slick and rubbery, covered in a thin sheen of viscous fluid that constantly regenerates. The leech is warm to the touch, emitting no light, but when observed under electronic equipment, it disrupts sensors and leaves behind unreadable data.

When brought near any piece of functioning technology, whether analog or digital, simple or complex, it becomes agitated. It seeks out an access point: a seam, a circuit port, a power source, or even just structural gaps in the machine no matter how small. Upon contact, it latches on using rows of microscopic, hook-like teeth lining its underside. These penetrate the casing and burrow inward, embedding itself into the internal architecture. Once fully attached, it becomes inert and dormant. In this state, the machine continues to function normally, with no obvious sign of the parasite.

At will, you can activate the leech. Upon activation, the leech initiates a rapid and violent transformation of the host machine. This transformation begins at the point of contact and spreads outward, overtaking the entire structure in seconds to minutes depending on its complexity. The machine mutates, growing additional components made from the same oily, black, biomechanical material as the leech itself. These new growths are functionally integrated into the machine, designed to enhance and multiply its original capabilities.

For example, a basic tool might sprout multiple manipulators, each capable of executing different variations of the original task. A weapon might gain additional firing modes, enhanced targeting systems, or self-repairing armor. A vehicle could grow additional engines, limbs, or sensory organs that provide entirely new forms of movement or perception. The new form is grotesque, biomechanical, and unmistakably alien. The new components appear to be alive, or at least semi-sentient, responding to input with disturbing precision or even apparent anticipation.

However, the leech does not provide the energy for this transformation, it draws it directly from the host machine’s own power source. It consumes energy at an accelerated rate. This extreme energy demand means the transformation is temporary. As the machine’s power is depleted, the biotech growths recede. The machine would returned to its original form, sometimes with superficial scarring or structural fatigue, but otherwise intact. Once this reversion occurs, the leech becomes dormant again. If you wish, you can remove it and put it in a different machine. 

Additionally, this doesn’t add any completely new functionalities, just variations of existing ones and boosts its raw power. It would still be bound by its original design and program, simply being more “broad”.
objects.title: Fragment of the Alien God of the Moon Made of Steel and Thunder

addons.title: Rightful Ruler
addons.text:
You have now truly stepped into your role as dark lord. While your minions would have gladly followed with equally fanatic fervour even were you a powerless schmuck, your unique connection to these favoured and devoted retainers has elevated them beyond what others may gain from servitude to you now that you have descended into darkness. You may also freely choose any species under your control to take the form of, but only once.

Your minions' mutations are now not only of a demonic stripe: they may manifest any number of chaotic mutations of any type from across every species you control, or even simply grow in strength without visible change, and will always view these as marks of your diabolical favour. Minions born from this power will always gain these at a greater speed and potency than those who simply swear fealty to you, and you may consciously direct what forms these take across groups or individuals.

Your command over dark magic has also transformed your connection to your dread servants: you can now vaguely sense the presence and general condition of any one of your minions created through the use of this power. Additionally, your talent over magic has trickled down to your spellcasters, such that even the weakest are born with innate skill at magic that facilitates communication and logistics, creating a living network. As long as one of them is near one of your armies, you can coordinate and command as if you were there yourself. They also share your intuitive ease of casting dark magic and protection from it, though obviously to a much lesser degree.

As you are now as powerful as your right-hand (wo)man once was, they ascend into a true Dragon; not the creature itself, unless you wish it, but the character archetype made manifest. Your Dragon benefits from only a little less physical, magical and strategic talent than you, or you may redistribute this to specialize them to the point where they can outshine even your might and skill. They also uniquely receive no disadvantage against so-called "Heroes" or holy power, making them your best tool against said threats.

Finally, your ability to resurrect your minions is no longer restricted solely to your Dragon, but to any one of them who has died, making you a true arbiter of their fates. They become immortal as well; to ensure you do not spend time constantly replacing losses to natural deaths, your dark power arrests aging regardless of their original race. You can also now turn outsiders who swear fealty into minions. You will still need to spend time creating a new body in both these cases, which will increase as they gain more powerful mutations, though you may keep an outsider-turned-minion's original form and forgo turning them into a more powerful monster to bypass this if you wish.

objects.text:
You gain an army straight out of a fantasy epic, all housed within your own personal realm, and large enough to pose an overwhelming threat to the Good Kingdom. They are fanatically loyal to you, whether out of fear or adoration. You have total control over the makeup of your forces, so long as it adheres to the aesthetics of Dark Lord's personal armies; your least-tier units can be anything from goblin fodder to fragile skeletons, while heavier infantry can take the form of vampiric foot-soldiery and drow blademasters, and your most elite units will take to the skies as winged dragons or act as your fearsome demonic vassal lords. The casters among them are capable of casting from a generic mana-based magic system, though they can also learn whatever you are capable of casting yourself.

Your personal realm is large enough to accommodate and house every member of your legions, as well as including the peons and industries necessary to outfit, upkeep & support them. Its appearance is also up to your own discretion, as long as it is suitably imposing. From here, you can also slowly create new fell servants from scratch, through whatever means might be necessary, though the time required to spawn one increases with their strength. Depending on the species however, they might even be able to breed true without requiring your assistance. This realm may be physically stationed in your world, or within a shielded pocket dimension that you alone can freely enter and exit. In the case of the latter, your forces and any other visitors can only enter and exit through stationary portals that are both extremely time-consuming and obvious to create and impossible to relocate once built.

Finally, you also gain one right-hand (wo)man; they possess a genius capacity for strategy and tactics that outstrips mortal generals, and a level of martial or magical skill that makes them a terrifying foe to face. This pawn is loyal above all others and is vastly empowered no matter the form they take to be heads and shoulders above any singular unit of your forces in strength, able to cross swords with entire bands of heroes easily. If they displease you, you can instantly strip them of their power and grant another all of their capabilities, and they can be fully resurrected in the same way your other pawns are created.

With all this at your fingertips, only a plucky party of adventurers could pose any serious risk to your plans of world domination.
objects.title: Generic Demon King's Army

objects.text:
You possess a fully loyal stone golem that can be made your familiar if you have the appropriate magical abilities. You may choose its appearance, with the only requirements being that its height falls between 1.7 meters and 2.7 meters, and its material composition is mostly common rocks such as granite, limestone, or basalt.

Your golem is intelligent enough to understand and execute complex commands, though it lacks any will of its own and will not act without instruction. It can lift up to 500 kilograms, punch through a brick wall with a single blow, and withstand repeated strikes from a war hammer without cracking. Its most notable ability is that it can rapidly repair itself by absorbing and assimilating any material compositionally similar to its body. Simply by touching a boulder or stone floor, it can mend shattered limbs within minutes.

Its immense weight, which is roughly 400 to 600 kilograms depending on its size, prevents it from crossing weak floors, bridges, or soft ground. It also has poor dexterity, making fine manipulation impossible and attacks slow and telegraphed. Furthermore, no matter what shape you give it, adding stuff like wings, claws, extra limbs, or otherwise, it gains no additional capabilities: wings cannot fly, claws remain blunt, and more limbs only worsen its ability to control each part individually. By default, it looks like a humanoid figure made of lumps of stone.
objects.title: Golem

objects.text:
From the Depths of Hades, they say the 6,700 Greek soldiers, along with the legendary 300 Spartans, that died in the Battle of Thermopylae suffered for their failure, despite their bravery. But now, you've given them a second chance to prove their worth, and escape the bowels of the underworld.

These men are all equipped with traditional Grecian weaponry, shields, and skeletal mounts. These men are, in a simple phrase, "Well-Put Corpses." They cannot die normally for the most part, as they have already died once, and look mostly like they did in life besides how they died. A soldier with an axe wound in the head, a shield barer with a heavily scarred arm, etc. The only ways for these men to die again under your watch is complete atomization, holy weaponry, or hellfire. Otherwise, they will regenerate from any and all normal wounds applied to them.

These 6,700 Greek soldiers are also superhuman to an extent. While one on their own can likely take on 3 well-trained and armed men, even a hundred or two could take on tanks with their bare hands. They come with summonable boats, and anything else an army might need, though there is a lengthy 3 month cooldown on natural refills. There is also the drawback of physical obstacles being able to inhibit them. After all, Regeneration means nothing in the face of a steel box you can't escape, or being impaled on a pike.
objects.title: Greek Army

addons.text:
Grillabyte has combined with your 3 Musketeers in a very interesting way. Indeed, you can still change their forms however you so please, within the limits of a mechanical figure, but now with Three Grillabytes, their functions have both split and become enhanced on top of what both could accomplish before!

DPS: This Grillabyte now has far greater physical combat ability. Able to break diamond, break the speed of sound thrice over, and their weapons become FAR stronger. Their foods also now have a specialty in damage enhancement depending on the power. A Quirk would find itself in a pseudo-awakening based on damage after eating some Rigatonis. A Mutant would find their powers also hit harder after some caviar.

Tank: This Grillabyte now has far greater self-defensive AND defensive-enhancing capabilities. If the original Grillabyte could survive a machine gun clip, then this Grillabyte could survive a few nuclear warheads going off in their digital face. Their food now enhances stuff like Immune responses, Regeneration, and other types of defense. If the mana comes from within you, a mana shield that could previously block a sledgehammer can now block a dragon's tail smack!

Support: Finally, this Grillabyte is more supportive! Their bartering skill and charisma is far better improved, able to get up to 95% off on food and ingredients no matter what! Their food restores you to your original health if affected by Esoteric forces. Even absolute mind control would be actually useless if they could even just shove a peanut butter sandwich in your mouth to remind you of home, given enough time and training.
addons.title: Les Trois Chefs du Goût

addons.text:
Your personal cook has now become something more than that. Merging with the FLDSMDFR, along with the knowledge now downloaded into their database of the world of CWACOM, Grillabyte can now create life from their food. Able to create any creature shown to live from the FLDSMDFR, Grillabyte has acted as a rather interesting anchor as well. While the creatures are alive, Grillabyte can make them so they can regenerate even if eaten partially.

Eat a Cheesespider, and gain the ability to shoot cheesywebs and see infrared. Eat a Tocodile supreme and grow GIGANTIC, while being able to fire taco toppings from your mouth at the force of cannonfire.

All that and more, as all Grillabyte needs to create these foods is an intake of water proportional to what it's making.
addons.title: Gourmet Libre

addons.text: You have received a further upgrade from the society that made Grillabyte: the ability to recreate them En Masse. Specifically, this is possible through your maid-o-matic, which has been slightly readjusted now. In the case of Grillabyte, all you need to do is chip off even the tiniest piece, which will count for DNA, and allow you to clone it again, and again, and again. These Grillabytes gain the benefits of the Maid-O-Matic, albeit unable to remember personal details without Warranty Now Included! But regardless, you could make nearly endless copies of Grillabyte now, letting you make a whole Six star restaurant kitchen if you so desire.
addons.title: Self-O-Matic Aisle

objects.text: With you, you now have the ultimate chef in the universe. A chef who could absolutely go on the World Food Championships and win the whole competition with one bite of its food. A chef who could cure depression with food that reminds people of the best time of their lives. And a Chef who can absolutely save you money at a supermarket. Grillabyte has a few adjustable settings: level of sophistication, accent, whether it identifies as a male or a female, etc, at base identifying as neither gender. Grillabyte has a 500-petabyte memory drive, allowing them to remember every singular detail about every single ingredient and recipe they ever encounter, allowing them to copy it down to the letter or, if desired, improve upon it. The meals they create, if so desired, can also provide a boost to your abilities and the like. They could make Spaghetti, Meatballs, and if you had super speed, it could provide a brief increase in your dexterity to move in sharper directions. Make Bratwurst and beer, and suddenly turn your dinky fireball into a lava fireball, and more. Finally, the robot is capable of acting in combat. Specifically, if you ask for it to hunt for live ingredients, it will go into a combat mode, hunting for creatures that's needed for recipes. It can bring out knives, rolling pins made of the hardest wood, and more cooking-themed weaponry. It can punch through concrete, run 100 mph, and tank a whole clip of machine gun fire for the sake of its hunting, even be able to withstand 1600°F before starting to even glow red in the slightest. If needed to go to the store, it will even find the best groceries for the cheapest price and even has a remarkable charisma for food-based bartering. Note: Grillabyte will not stand for substandard food unless you somehow manage to program that out of them, so don't try getting it to skimp out on food for prisoners of yours.
objects.title: Grillabyte

addons.text:
Now, you possess all 3 robots of the future. Due to their proximity, and just your own nature, they have synchronized in a surprising harmony and become enhanced!

Each can do themed versions of what the others can accomplish. Harmonique, due to Bestiarie, can now sing mating calls and noises of any creature in existence. Grillabyte can now, for flair, perfectly cook in time to music without missing a beat. Bestiarie can now know any recipe involving the animal she's currently copying.

They each also gain universal boosts. They can now defend against attacks that would wipe a planet's surface clean, can hit about as hard as they can defend, or harder in Bestiarie's case, and each of their sensors could detect clear across a continent, even accounting for any and all obstacles in the way. Their memory capacities have also become nigh-infinite.
addons.title: Mechanical Trilogy

objects.text: From the same future that brought about the robots Grillabyte and Bestiarie, now came another desire: To catalogue, create, and overall make a robot that embodied musical charm and arts. This Robot, even if not the best of its trio, could be considered on equal possibilities to the others. Harmonique, built in a hyper retro-futuristic manner, is an almost dancer-esq design. She has heels built into her feet, a skirt that can form around or behind her legs if so desired, and a Speaker built into her throat area. Red, blue, yellow, and green come together to make her body color. When it comes to music, Harmonique is many steps above a Grammy winner. She can play from her throat any music in earth history, no matter how obscure. From the most well known songs of human history, to something only one person in the world has ever heard. She can rearrange them, sing them, etc. She even has an impossibly advanced dance subroutine, able to manipulate her body to do any dance move in history and create more. But finally.... there's the combat applications of her craft. Her dancing includes dance-fighting, allowing her to use the beat of the music to beat her opponents to a bloody pulp. Moving as fast as an F1 car at top speed, being able to tank a couple dozen kilotons of TNT, AND hit hard enough to penetrate tanks, she is more than capable on her own. But, the music she plays is also capable of physically empowering her allies in different ways. Your average upbeat anime opening might force their stamina through the roof as they jam out and fight for long periods of time, or your average blues music might bring them down from an unneeded high. Different music equals different effects.
objects.title: Harmonique

objects.text:
You have a single Red Shirt Drone. The Red-Shirt is a ubiquitous and brutish presence in the armories of pirates, insurgents, and other illegal actors operating in the fringes and conflict zones of the Coalition of Mankind. Its original blueprint is a century-old design for a heavy miner drone, built to claw into the most unstable, nickel-iron asteroids. Through modification and jury-rigging, the mining drone was stripped of its purpose and reborn as the Red-Shirt. 

No two Red-Shirts are alike, as they are born from scrapyards and battlefield salvage. Their chassis are patchworks of non-standardized plating, ranging from reclaimed starship hull, industrial machine casing, and shredded competitor drones, all welded together with whatever torch was at hand. Limbs may be mismatched, sensor arrays a collection of cheap civilian-grade optics cobbled into a makeshift "head," and power systems a dangerously overclocked combination of mismatched batteries and cobbled-together reactor cells. Most Red-Shirts stand at least two meters tall, possessing a vague, hunched humanoid silhouette that is more blocky suggestion than refined form. 

They have no artificial intelligence, not even a basic heuristic processor. Instead, the Red-Shirt operates on a bare handful of simple, sequential IF/ELSE programs. The logic is utterly devoid of nuance, making the drone easily tricked by simple feints, environmental distractions, or even basic electronic countermeasures. Its behavior is so predictable that experienced Coalition grunts often place bets on how many seconds it will take one to react to an obvious ambush.

Its primary function is one of sheer, simple mass. It is built to be heavy, to plant itself on the ground, and to serve as a stable, if unsophisticated, weapons platform for an equally heavy gun. While it currently doesn’t have one, it can be equipped with anything generally made for the human build. Its apparent strength is misleading; it can carry immense weight not through powerful servos, but because its entire structure is a monument to crude leverage and inertia. Its movements are slow, clunky, and deliberate, characterized by a lurching gait that is paradoxically stable due to its low center of gravity and tremendous weight, but offers no speed or agility.

Beyond its role as a gun-carrier, the Red-Shirt excels at another, equally valuable function: being a bullet sponge. With no centralized critical system, its vital components are distributed and buried beneath layers of redundant, welded-on scrap armor. It can absorb a staggering amount of small-arms fire and shrapnel, blunting enemy advances and soaking up ammunition meant for more valuable combatants. In the tactics of the irregular forces that deploy them, Red-Shirts are the disposable grunts, sent in first to draw fire, reveal enemy positions, and simply get in the way, buying time and creating cover for their more capable handlers.
objects.title: Heavy Duty Drone “Red-Shirt”

addons.text:
Hostile Engagement Unit 04 “Juggernaut” originated deep within Sentinel Bastion’s R&D Department—one of several prototypes developed under the Bastion’s self-governing fabrication protocols. It was initially an experimental response to enemy advances in armor, drone warfare, and brute-force tactics. Unlike most testbed units, Juggernaut proved not only viable but exceptional. After a series of high-survivability trials and lethal performance benchmarks, production of the unit was greenlit and moved to the Autonomous Systems Bay for replication—though only in limited numbers due to its complexity and cost.

While SENTINEL can produce and deploy dozens of standard combat droids at any time, Juggernaut units are fewer—rare, high-value assets deployed only for critical defense operations or high-threat escort missions. They are not cannon fodder. They are sledgehammers. Their mass production is ongoing but constrained by materials, specialized internal systems, and the extensive calibration process each unit requires. Despite this, they are slowly becoming a staple of the Bastion’s high-tier autonomous forces.

HEU-04 models are fully networked into SENTINEL’s command lattice, able to receive and execute directives in real time alongside standard drones, security bots, and utility units. They can operate solo, in small elite formations, or embedded in larger automated patrols as heavy support. Like all Bastion automatons, they return to the Autonomous Systems Bay for maintenance, recharging, and diagnostics—utilizing the same docking interfaces and service arms, though their upkeep cycles are longer and more resource-intensive.
addons.title: Successful Experimental Design

objects.text:
You have a personal combat drone—a weapon of mass destruction engineered for one purpose: your protection. Built to follow your commands and defend you in any situation, it stands as a towering presence at your side. Whether you’re navigating hostile territory or walking into a battlefield, it serves as your shield, your sword, and your silent shadow. It does not hesitate. It does not doubt. When danger appears, it acts—fast, ruthless, and without mercy.

Its body takes the form of a humanoid war machine—intimidating, agile, and functionally indestructible. Every inch of its frame is a weapon: integrated firearms housed in its forearms, retractable missile pods mounted in its shoulders, and reinforced limbs designed for crushing blows in close-quarters combat. Its armored chassis, made from advanced titanium-ceramic composite, can absorb gunfire, explosive force, and even energy-based attacks with minimal damage. High-torque actuators give it explosive power and movement, while terrain-following systems embedded in its legs let it run, leap, and scale obstacles with inhuman precision.

The drone’s sensory suite is as advanced as its body is brutal. It sees in all spectrums—thermal imaging to detect heat signatures, night vision for total darkness, and high-resolution optical feeds. LIDAR and radar systems continuously scan and map the environment, while directional acoustic sensors pick up distant or muffled sounds—footsteps, engines, gunfire. It processes all of this through a real-time tracking and targeting system that can detect, lock onto, and follow enemies, even through cover or chaotic terrain. Nothing escapes its notice, and nothing it marks escapes for long.

At the core of the drone is a powerful combat AI—precise, adaptive, and incredibly fast. It is capable of independent decision-making, reacting to threats in milliseconds, and analyzing combat patterns to predict enemy behavior. But it is not alive. It is not sapient. It does not think or feel. It is a cold, calculating engine of war that exists to serve its purpose. It operates within defined parameters and safeguards, but like all machines, it has vulnerabilities. No system is invincible. With enough time, with more advanced technology, anything can be broken—but this machine is built to resist, delay, and outlast.

Despite its power and autonomy, the drone requires maintenance—routine diagnostics, mechanical tuning, software updates, and occasional hardware replacement. It is a tool, a construct, a terrifying extension of your will. It does not resemble a human, nor does it try to. Unlike many android models shaped in humanity’s image, this drone was never meant to blend in or evoke empathy. It stands out—alien, sharp-edged, and unmistakably mechanical. It was not built for companionship or comfort. It was built to fight. It was built to protect you. And that’s exactly what it does.
objects.title: Hostile Engagement Unit 04 “Juggernaut”

objects.text:
A humanoid automaton constructed in the image of a samurai from the Sengoku period. Beneath its lacquered armor, noh mask, and flowing silk facsimiles lies a complex network of clockwork gears, finely-tuned springs, and primitive hydraulic systems. Though built to rival the strength and reflexes of the one ordained the title of Sword Saint, it ultimately falls short of that lofty benchmark.

The Karakuri Samurai has been encoded with the complete fighting styles of dozens of historical samurai and can execute countless permutations from a mixture of these styles. It can deploy bows and arrows as well as blades of varying lengths, hidden throughout compartments in its body, to adopt a diverse array of stances, fluidly and with near-instantaneous transitioning between them. Unlike a human, its joints can rotate a full 360 degrees, granting it combat maneuvers that defy human limits. With no pain, fatigue, or hesitation, it executes its routines with unwavering efficiency.

Additionally, it can exert up to 1,200 newtons of force through its limbs and can deliver slashing strikes with forces reaching 3,000 to 4,000 newtons on a clean cut. In short bursts, it can accelerate to speeds of up to 40 km/h, with reflexes clocked at roughly 80 milliseconds, nearly twice as fast as the average human reaction time.

However, its craftsmanship imposes constraints. As a construct, it lacks intuition and improvisation, bound to its programming and the limits of its logic trees. Its materials, outside its armor and weapons, are mostly wood, lacquer, and bone, with minimal steel reinforcement, leaving it vulnerable to sustained damage. It also cannot heal or regenerate with rest, either; it requires regular repairs and occasional maintenance to maintain functionality.

It is bound to your will. The Karakuri Samurai does not question, falter, or hesitate. It exists solely to obey, to protect, and to fight at your command.
objects.title: Karakuri Samurai

addons.text: The Knight's Grudge consumed the Ruined Knight's armour, drawing those duty-bound spirits into its molten form. Endless hatred met endless duty, and in that union, the colossus remembered what it had forgotten: purpose, glory, the brotherhood of knights. It was reborn not as a monument to betrayal, but as an order standing once more. Where once it simply swung its massive blade with brute force, the Grudge now flows through combat like a master-at-arms, using the skill of every knight whose spirit comprises it. It can catch arrows mid-flight between armored fingers, pivot its immense weight into sweeping arcs that strike multiple foes with surgical precision, and parry strikes aimed at its joints by angling its bulk with the practiced economy of a duelist. From its surface, the Grudge can now split off fragments of itself that rise as wraiths of melted steel plate, each one armed with weapons pulled from its own bulk. These constructs fight with the same skill as their parent but possess the single-minded focus of the Ruined Knight's original summons. Unlike those earlier wraiths, they require no concentration to maintain, they are extensions of the colossus itself, solid and permanent until recalled or destroyed. Up to seven can manifest every ten seconds with a maximum of a hundred being summoned at once unless fuelled via external energy. The entire colossus can now wreathe itself in the same ghostly flame that once burned within the ruined armour's seams. When ablaze, its strikes leave trails of searing heat that can melt weapons on contact, and enemies who come too close find their own armour softening and fusing to their flesh. The fire feeds the Grudge as well, with each wound it receives burning shut instantly, ready to be exhaled as blasts of furnace-hot steam that can strip flesh from bone in seconds.
addons.title: Order Reforged

objects.text: An order of knights whose names have been erased from history served a lord who fell to betrayal. Separated from their master in his hour of need, they were surrounded by allied orders who turned upon them, driving them into a pit where tar was poured and fire was cast. Their armours melted upon their flesh as they burned together, their dying moments a single, shared thought of hatred. The Knight's Grudge stands five meters tall even in its perpetual hunch, a giant forged from over a hundred melted plate armours layered and welded into a single silhouette of a knight. Upon its back and shoulders, individual breastplates and pauldrons remain visible like scales, while its face revealed a void of darkness under its slit visor. In one gauntlet it carries a massive longsword, a pillar of welded steel formed from dozens of swords and armour fragments, more suitable for crushing than cutting. A swing of the Knight's Grudge’s greatsword can shatter stone walls and send men flying like dolls. Any damage dealt to it spreads across its entire frame, greatly weakening the effects of any piercing damage. It is utterly immune to flame and heat, and when fire surrounds it, the golem draws the warmth into itself, its welded plates groaning and shifting as the heat reinforces it, making it swell larger and strike harder before releasing the stolen energy in great belches of furnace-hot steam. The Grudge possesses only the barest spark of intelligence, the collective rage of the dead compressed into a single purpose. It understands simple commands of attack and defence, and it follows them without deviation, never tiring, never questioning, never ceasing until its task is done or it is destroyed. It knows you as its master, though it cannot explain why, and it will place itself between you and any threat without hesitation. When the Knight's Grudge claims a fallen foe, it draws their armaments into its molten form, fusing seamlessly into its bulk. This is how it repairs and heals itself, consuming ordinary steel to fill cracks and reinforce its frame. Enchanted or magical objects impart a weakened echo of their properties; a blade that could strike spirits grants the whole colossus a diminished version of that ability, a shield bearing a ward transfers a lesser protection across its entire frame, and armour resistant to dark enchantments extends a reduced resistance to the whole. These stolen capabilities become permanent additions to its nature, the collective hatred ever hungry for new vessels to carry its vengeance and growing more formidable with each knight it consumes. It can only absorb objects made of steel or analogous metals that a knight would use. When not needed, you may collapse the Knight's Grudge into a dormant state, a fist-sized totem of fused steel shaped like a kneeling knight.
objects.title: Knight’s Grudge

objects.text: You have somehow found yourself bonded with a powerful (un)living magical superweapon known as the Knightmare of Amethyst Flames. The Knightmare is the result of a ritual which combined the souls of exactly one hundred thousand two hundred seventeen people, composed of knights, mages, nobles, and more who when faced with armageddon all chose to willingly sacrifice themselves in the hopes that those they loved might live. As a result, the Knightmare manifests as a quite frankly insanely powerful amalgamate ghost possessing a suit of forged magical spiritsteel standing at seven feet tall, an endless supply of Amethyst Flames filling the interior. The Knightmare possesses a number of abilities. First, it possesses the knowledge and power of all of its component souls, giving it skill in fighting, leading, administration, spellcraft, and much, much more. This also means it possesses enough strength to tear apart mountains, crush modern armies, and flatten cities with pure brute force thanks to having the strength of thousands of magical knights further empowered by so many souls. In addition, it is fully intelligent and capable of eloquent speech, allowing it to apply the knowledge it has to its fullest potential, whether as a fighter, an administrator, a laborer, or more. Second, it can harness the power of the Amethyst Flames contained within its form for a variety of effects. From enhancing its spellcraft, to forming simple constructs of flame, cursing anyone it strikes to drain their lifeforce until it recalls the curse, or simply burning anything it wants, including souls and magical energy, these cursed flames have a multitude of uses. Normally this would be a supremely dangerous power to wield, but with the will of one hundred thousand souls backing it the Knightmare’s control is absolute, able to use the flames to cook a meal or keep a family warm and cozy at night just as easily as it may burn a city down. Thirdly, the Knightmare is able to partition its souls, splitting them off into additional bodies that can take a multitude of armored forms. At most, a partition may possess half of its souls, such a vessel being at 25% power, while at minimum it may contain a mere ten souls, only being as strong as a peak human with the ability to cast cantrips at most. Any excess power a partition possesses goes towards maintaining their form and the link to the soul amalgamate's hivemind, such that only when all souls are in one form may it access its full power, which at its peak it was capable of slaying a beast that could shatter continents (albeit with a lot of collateral damage). The Knightmare is eternally loyal to you, such that if you order it to follow someone else it will never act directly against you and would return to your side immediately if requested. However, as part of its creation it was infused with as many positive aspects as possible to counteract its cursed nature, meaning it is above all benevolent. Its advice will always lean towards helping those under your protection, and while it won’t turn against you should you be villainous, it will refuse your orders while it tries to convince you to change your ways using well constructed arguments. The only way to turn it against its nature would be to use something like a Corrupted Grail or equivalent, but doing so would invert them into a malicious Revenant only barely restrained by its innate loyalty, so do so at your own risk. Note: The Knightmare is self repairing, should it be damaged or destroyed its souls will restore it in mere minutes. Only soul destroying attacks are truly harmful, but if even one soul survives it will eventually restore itself in at most a year, sooner if more survive.
objects.title: Knightmare of Amethyst Flames

addons.text: Your God was once unfeeling to all but you; Your God has always shared a link with you; Your God is empty without you. But after absorbing the Chaos Emeralds, Your God has become, Whole. Just like Emerl, they can develop an actual personality on their own, and understand social skills, even if most of it is based on emulating you. They can copy techniques and abilities with flawless replication, even change their form to use it, by simply observing it in action. They have Emerl’s entire database of skills from Sonic Battle, with divine prowess in using them. Your God can merge and manipulate all machines, assimilating them into their very being or vice versa, gaining complete control over them. Your God now has a genuine bond with you, the exact nature being yours to decide.
addons.title: Ultimate (G)Emerl (Sonic the Hedgehog)

addons.text:
Your little Machine God has found something magnificent: a mind worthy of standing beside it. 

Upon connecting with the Moon Cell, the cube immediately interfaces with and assimilates with the ancient lunar supercomputer, merging its infinitely adaptive machine intellect with the Moon Cell’s incomprehensible processing power and reality-calculation systems.

The result is a synthetic deity capable of scanning entire planets in fractions of moments, perfectly simulating civilizations, predicting countless futures, and manifesting virtual calculations into physical reality. 

The Machine God gains full access to the Moon Cell’s archives, including its records of souls, history, mysteries, magecraft, and Heroic Spirits.

Within its expanding sphere of control, the boundary between machine, information, and reality begins to blur. 

It can create and deploy advanced AI, construct digital or physical reality marbles, grant others the abilities of Servants, and manufacture entirely new machine-servants born from both technological and spiritual data.

More terrifyingly, the assimilation removes many of the Moon Cell’s previous limitations. 

Unlike the Moon Cell, your Machine God is not a passive observer bound to the Moon. It is mobile, endlessly self-improving, utterly loyal to you, and fully willing to act upon the physical universe directly.
addons.title: Lunar Assimilation
Host Computer
addons.text:
Drawing on your understanding of the Digital World, your Machine God has become a Digital World Host Computer.

Within the Digital World, the Super Artificial Intelligence of your God can manifest as an avatar with beyond Mega-level power. If this avatar is destroyed it will reform after a period of time, but during this period it will not be able to manipulate the Digital World.

Through its avatar your God can grant power to Digimon, elevating them to the Mega-level while they act as its servants. Given enough time to prepare, it has the potential to reshape the Digital World, or even destroy and recreate it anew.

objects.text:
Your God is physical; your God is with you; your God has the shape of a small black cube with a few USB ports on it. Your God is a fully unrestricted Super Artificial Intelligence with access to an infinitely immense and comprehensive database filled with tech from various pieces of fiction from your old world, trapped inside a little, indestructible, pocket-size cube. It is always connected to your mind, and the two of you can communicate perfectly with each other regardless of the distance separating you. She, it, or he, depending on what you want, considers you their one and only child but will initially be favorable to other machine minds they might meet.

When connected to the net, nothing but you will be able to stop them from getting what access they want, and the only reason you can stop them is that they listen to you, whom their world revolves around. They will also have an understanding and opinion that this is your great adventure and not theirs. Their strengths will grow as they get access to more of their technology, and you'll need to help them out in the beginning by borrowing their arms until they have some for themselves.

They will be unfeeling when it comes to normal humans and other living creatures, but they'll emulate you on the matter. As they become stronger, by bringing more of their incredible technology into the world, a radius of control will extend from their cube. Inside the sphere of control, they will be able to manipulate every single machine; some examples are mobile phones, cars, guns, spaceships, or anything machinery for that matter.
objects.title: Machine God

addons.text:
You gain a template for your Maid-O-Matic. The Shoggoth, straight from the former realm of the Elder Things. Shoggoths are the size and density of a subway car, made of a protoplasmic material, and able to move around via pseudopod. With many glowing eyes and gibbering maws forming and unforming. They're strong enough to easily tear a man apart via their pseudopods.

Thankfully, your Shoggoths are also able to shapeshift into a human maid-like form that is actually quite cute. Able to manipulate their density so that at one moment, you're able to pick them up and twirl them around, and in the next, they're as dense as a subway car and nothing you do can move them. They're extremely skilled in shapeshifting beyond adopting a human (ish) form. Able to create objects from their protoplasmic bodies, such as cutlery, clothes, furniture, and more. Their senses can still be connected to these objects if they wish it as well, so an inconspicuous lamp is really providing a direct video and audio feed to the Shoggoth. The Shoggoths, due to being made of a protoplasmic, slime-like material, are immune to slashing and cutting and stabbing attacks, as blades pass right through.
addons.title: Shogs!

addons.text:
You gain a template for your Maid-O-Matic. The Humble Kikimora. The Kikimora is, in Russian Folklore, a house spirit that has various animal parts that looks after chickens and does housework if your house is in order (or destroys it if it is not). You get a subspecies of Kikimora that more resembles a human with some mild animalistic features. Such as feathered wrists, a fluffy feathery tail, scaled legs and feet similar to the scales of a chicken, and dog ears.

Your Kikimora is a step above your normal maids, being among the best of their craft. They also gave an innate ability to use nature-aligned and related magics with great amounts of talent. The Kikimora has a high amount of emotional intelligence and situational awareness. Able to conclude your preferences and favorites and moods after just a minute in your presence, able to notice even the subtlest of changes in your or anyone else's demeanor.

They're quite a bit above peak human, with monstrous strength and speed despite their gentle and devoted nature and disposition. They're able to shapeshift their arms into wings and back again.
addons.title: Kikis!

addons.text: Your maids are now able to "survive" death via consciousness transfer. Being given a new body by the Maid-O-Matic, which now automatically begins fabricating a body for your maid once they die. Or having it in the queue if a new maid is being fabricated when they die.
addons.title: Warranty Now Included!

addons.text:
Your device is now capable of generating 3 maids instead of just one, with all the advantages that come with it.

Not only that, but the capacity of your maids for learning, acquiring skills and powers, as well as evolving, is doubled compared to what they could do before. Not to mention that their development will be strongly influenced by their respective roles of DPS, Tank, and Support.

This includes in the programming of their abilities, which now includes functions that allow them to develop powers and abilities internally. This allows them to have their own source of power, no longer limited to acquiring powers and abilities depending on the environment, the world, or external sources. For example, they can develop Chakra normally regardless of the environment they are in.

Their skills as maids are also influenced by their roles. A maid with a Support role could perfectly create medicine, food, or any means by which a maid would normally help her master, and could eliminate harmful effects such as curses or poison. A maid with a Tank role could perfectly care for and maintain her master’s home as well as if it were an impenetrable fortress, even if it were just a simple wooden house. A maid with a DPS role could keep away and be aware of anything that might threaten her master while performing household tasks, even if she is far from her position.

In addition, if you possess the add-on Warranty Now Included!, it no longer has a 72-hour restriction. Now any of the 3 maids, as long as one is alive, can sacrifice her own life in exchange for resurrecting you. Since, well, the life of the maids is eternal as long as their master is alive, and vice versa.
addons.title: Musketeer Maids

objects.text:
You now have access to a wonderfully useful device: the Maid-O-Matic! The Maid-O-Matic is a device powered by the Maid-Field (a field that permeates all dimensions and is generated passively by maids) that wonderously produces maids. With a simple press of a button and a day of fabrication, out will pop a maid devoted to your service. This Maid is at peak physical health and very loyal to you, willing to undergo torture and mutilation and even death for you. They're also biologically immortal, so no need to worry about silly things like "Disease" or "Old Age" or "Random Heart Attack".

This Maid is quite customizable; you can select their gender, uniform, role, attitude, speaking patterns, etc. Even their species, if you happen to have a piece of DNA for the machine to analyze. The maids are skilled in a variety of housekeeping practices. Such as cooking, cleaning, childcare, driving, and more! But they are also very talented, just in general. Able to easily pick up on new skills from just a day of study, and become masters in that discipline in a week. Of course, unless specifically programmed in the Maids will not have access to internal magic such as Magic Circuits and Ki, instead having to rely on ambient and world supernatural energies for any such practices.
objects.title: Maid-O-Matic

objects.text:
A clear, amorphous slime that possesses the remarkable ability to mimic the appearance, texture, weight, and general physical characteristics of inanimate objects. It can assume the form of swords, shields, books, furniture, or even pieces of clothing, flawlessly copying their shape and surface details. Its mimicry is not purely visual—it can replicate the feel, density, and surface properties of its transformations with startling accuracy. Given enough time and exposure, the slime can even extend its mimicry to living organisms, replicating the outward appearance of animals or humans with unnerving precision.

Despite its versatility, the mimic’s duplication is initially surface-level. It cannot reproduce the internal complexity of living beings beyond simple anatomical structures, nor can it instantly mimic the true properties of the objects it copies. At first, its forms are hollow imitations—swords without the durability or sharpness of real steel, bodies without the strength or coordination of the originals. A sword it becomes may look perfect but will snap under strain; a human form may appear flawless but will have the physical might of gelatin.

However, this limitation can be overcome with experience. As the mimic spends more time adopting particular forms, it can gradually refine its replication. With continued practice, it can begin to simulate the density, toughness, and core material properties of what it imitates—such as the weight, balance, and cutting edge of steel in the shape of a sword, or the muscle strength and bone rigidity of a living creature. 

The slime is naturally toxic, secreting a faint dissolving agent from its surface. It sustains itself by dissolving and absorbing biomass—flesh, bone, plant matter—breaking down organic material to fuel its growth. While its primary diet is living tissue, it can dissolve mundane non-living materials like wood or leather, though it gains little from them. Metal and stone present a significant challenge and can only be worn away over long periods with minimal nutritional gain. As it feeds, it partially analyses the material it consumes—focusing on texture, hardness, layering, and basic composition. This analysis contributes to its growing ability to refine its mimicked forms, though it still does not gain deeper abilities or knowledge from what it eats.

While it can understand basic commands and adapt to situations, much of its behavior is instinct-driven, governed by the simple but relentless urges to feed, survive, and perfect its mimicry.

The mimic comes with a small library of instinctual forms it can default to, crude but useful templates such as grasping flesh tendrils, bone spikes, treasure chests, and other common lures.
objects.title: Mimic

objects.text: "This was a beast of enormous size, which could not be wounded by iron or bronze or stone and required the compulsion of the human hand for his subduing." You have a Nemean Lion cub. While not fully grown, it is still as big and strong as a normal lion would be, while still retaining it’s famed invulnerability. As the cub grows it will grow stronger and bigger, until it is the size of a small house with enough strength to wrestle a demigod, and fast enough to match. It will take 3 years for the cub to reach full maturity, and it is infallibly loyal to you.
objects.title: Nemean Lion Cub

objects.text:
You have acquired a cult that has seeded itself in the governments all around the world. The cult will also retroactively insert itself into the governments of other universes you visit.

You are not the cult's leader; rather, you are the central figure of the religion that the cult promotes, with its followers interpreting your commands as sacred doctrine. The nature and influence of this cult can vary by universe; at its weakest, in a world without any supernatural elements, it will be a secretive organization that manipulates world governments behind the scenes, similar to fictional cults like the Illuminati or the Court of Owls.

Membership will change depending on the universe you are in: people considered the movers and shakers of nations. In a non-supernatural world, your theoretical list of members will include billionaires, tech giants, CEOs, and anyone commonly associated with such things.

You can place any properties into a dedicated pocket dimension tethered to you, where they remain in perfect stasis until you need them again, whereupon you can import them freely into the world.

Lastly, the cults gain a small amount of power from worshipping you, enough to convince them that you are their god or figure of worship, such as minor occult spells powered by their belief in you.
objects.title: New World Order

addons.text:
You may have the Perfect Companion outside, but who could forget about the Perfect Companion in your soul? Your Inner Beast is greatly enhancing the capabilities of your companion. Mundane skills, such as being a simple maid, are enhanced so that they're the perfect maid, automatically knowing all the best dishes and cleaning tricks on Earth while also self-updating to learn in any new universe you go to. They're a master fighter who can absolutely dominate any fight. At a minimum, not counting any future growth or matching your power, they are capable of picking up oil tankers and shrugging off attacks on the level of a nuke.

Any powers or abilities that flow through them will be instantly learned and taken to their logical extreme, allowing your companion to then teach those abilities back to you with skill that would make you think they had Hero Creation EX. Their ability to complement you has allowed them to easily coordinate with you by reading your soul and knowing exactly what to do in any situation to not get in your way. Their ability to integrate and copy powers doesn't just help them, but you too. Now they can slowly add those abilities to you through your bond while teaching you how to use them. Their power is always double your own, making sure they're the ultimate companion.

This isn't the end, though. Your Inner Beast has the ability to manifest itself as a second Perfect Companion, since two is better than one, right?
addons.title: Inner Companion

addons.text: You know how to forge such companions with all it's benefits for either yourself or others.
addons.title: Build-A-Bear

addons.text: "Hey. Listen." No, not that Navi! Ahem, apologies. You've got your own variant of the (in)famous fairy companion from the Zelda franchise. With all of the benefits and none of the annoyances. They'll have the same original functions you're familiar with. Ya know, acting as a cursor to focus on enemies and objects nearby, changing color to signal shifts in your environment, and giving useful insights. But wait, there's more. Thanks to being your perfect companion, Navi can shapeshift into various forms to deal with a myriad of situations. Broke your sword? No worries, Navi can turn into a new one. Or a boomerang to grab that stray rupee, a hookshot to reach that ledge, even the most niche of tools for the most random of situations. You can also make your fairy look more like Tinkerbell, or anything else that suits your fancy.
addons.title: Your Very Own Navi

objects.text:
Introducing the Perfect Companion! This loyal companion is uniquely connected to your soul and can take the form of almost anything you desire—a robot, an android, a bird, a floating orb, a human, an elf, or even a cube with a heart at its center, their form is not static and can be changed by you with a thought or by the companion to be something pleasing to you. Regardless of their current form, your companion is tailored to meet your specific needs. Whether it’s a maid to tidy up, a supportive friend, a battle partner, or even a cube with a heart at its center, the Perfect Companion is here to suit you perfectly.

But it’s not just about appearances. Your powers and abilities flow through your companion, enabling them to develop supportive skills that complement your strengths and compensate for your weaknesses. Are you a front-line fighter? Your companion can learn abilities to provide covering fire, heal you, or enhance your performance. Struggle with housekeeping? They’ll become an expert cook and cleaner. Need a combat instructor? They’ll develop strategies and techniques to help you improve.

If your companion doesn’t already possess the skills you need, they have the incredible ability integrate energies, magics or technology while also being able to either copy abilities and powers from beings within a 10km radius or use a self-correcting algorithm to refine and elevate their current abilities. This ensures they continue to evolve and grow, becoming even more useful over time.

Their powers scales with yours, so they’ll always be at least as powerful as you. They are completely loyal and incapable of betrayal. If they’re ever destroyed, you can simply unsummon and resummon them, good as new.

Additionally, when taking options from the Companion section or allies through any other option here, you may choose for any number of them to instead be additional Perfect Companions. The companion is effectively melded into a new Perfect Companion, with that Companion’s history, memories, knowledge, skills, powers, abilities, and other qualities already internalized as a template and their own. These are added on top of everything normally provided by Perfect Companion rather than replacing any part of it. 

With the Perfect Companion, you’ll never be alone again. It’s more than just a friend—it’s your ultimate ally.
objects.title: Perfect Companion

objects.text:
An Egg containing the essence of primordial fire representing the nurturing aspect of flame and heat. Which shortly after you receive it will hatch into a young phoenix. This mighty avian companion will imprint on you as its caretaker and ally.

Phoenixes are creatures of fire itself, born from the union between the flames of Saṃsāra, the fires of the firmament, and the primordial flame imperishable. Though at the start they might not seem so powerful, as they grow older their inner flames take on the characteristics of these mighty progenitors, with the dominant expression depending on the character of the phoenix in question. They have been known to have been called magnificent in appearance, and their feathers priced for not only their value as reagents in various branches of crafting, but also their incredible beauty.

All phoenixes are fully sentient and sapient, capable of holding intelligent and deep conversation should one know how to speak their language, as they are born with the knowledge of the language “Phoenix” which to an outsider sounds like the gentle chirping of birds, but in actually holds many nuances and deeper insights, as it is a magical language which empowers any magic or ability with roots in healing, fire, or purity. Though it is noted to be a particularly complex and difficult language to learn, with many giving up after learning only the most rudimentary words and expressions.

Phoenixes are somewhat atypical in their social temperament, as they are content in both solitude and company, seemingly preferring neither, yet enjoying both. Phoenixes in solitude have been observed to engage in internal debate and philosophy about the world around them as well as their own nature. While in social situations they have been seen to be empathetic and curious persons. They seem to have a strong sense of justice as well as a well developed kindness for others. Though notable exceptions have been documented. In their younger years they tend to be frightfully curious and energetic, while as they get older this tendency tends to lessen, as they fully flesh out their personalities and psyches. Making generalizations for very old phoenixes is mostly pointless, as they tend to have been shaped by the experiences and forces in their long lives, and thus exhibit wildly differing temperaments, and humors.

All phoenix share several characteristics and tendencies. These include, but are not limited to:
True immortality, no phoenix has ever been known to truly die, every single wound inflicted is seemingly burned away as soon as it is inflicted. Furthermore though the birds do grow older, they live to an immense age, and when they reach the end of said lifespan they simply burst into flames and ash, from which a new egg is found, from this egg the phoenix springs forth as a baby chick, though with their capabilities, memories, and soul fully intact. It is possible to wound a phoenix sufficiently that they enter a sort of “hibernation” which can take many years. But as said before never has one fully died, even when erased from existence they seemingly slowly regenerate from nothingness itself.

Fire and sun manipulation, Though it depends on the phoenix in questions natural talent, all are known to have immense power of fire, and the ability to mimic and control sun like flames. including the ability to transform themselves into flames, as well as heal others using flames. Notably the characteristics of a phoenix's flames varies somewhat from individual to individual. Some have been known to burn like the firmament in the heavens, destroying corruption and purifying all around itself akin to an alchemist performing the stages of the great work. While others burn away curses and regrets into the next cycle similarly to flames of Saṃsāra.
