A very rare few have in ancient texts been described as burning as the Secret Fire sent to burn at the heart of the world, bringing those who see it to tears, the wicked fleeing from its presence, and elevating the existence of all it reaches. Though these are rare and none have ever been properly documented. Of note is that a true newborn phoenix is in an equilibrium between these three great flames at the start of its life, with a dominant expression appearing as it grows in mind and spirit from experiencing life and developing its personality.

Phoenixes have been known to exhibit other abilities such as, teleportation in fiery bursts, healing tears, incredible feats of strength, psychological healing through their song, which is reported to be quite beautiful, and many other miscellaneous abilities. Though it is unknown if these are inborn traits or if they are learned. As no phoenixes have been observed from their true birth, and few have been able to be interviewed. A feat you might now take for yourself.
objects.title: Phoenix Egg

addons.text:
If the Lion is the King of the Jungle, then your Plush Pal has become the princess of the entire animal kingdom. An Archeological find seemed to find this gown and, since the company behind the Plush Pals had indirectly funded the expedition, they managed to copy the outfit so they could use it for their own Plush Pals while letting the archeology teams keep their originals while also paying them highly for letting them copy it.

On top of your own outfit, the Plush Pal has gained a copy of this, shaped to fit their body, even if they have a tail or the like. When it comes to their interaction with it, the Pal gains all knowledge needed to run a kingdom, dance, and more.

As well, they gain an authority over any and all animals. They will all acknowledge the Plush Pal as their monarch, even if they know its true origin. Of course, the more sentient and intelligent a creature is, the less it works to a point where a super genius could just... ignore the animal.
addons.title: Princess Plush Pal!

addons.text:
It seems your Plush Pal has interacted with the powers you've given it in a rather lucky way. On top of its previous technology, the powers typically interact with it as if they were new subroutines, hardware, etc.

This means that they can learn the powers at an accelerated rate, and in some cases, possibly surpass you. Giving it Soul Garden could convert the souls into AIs for it to swap between, while making it a Namekian would give it the biology while not turning it visually into one if you don't desire.
addons.title: Powerful Plush Pal!

addons.text:
Your Plush Pal has come with a rather uneasy addition to its body. The engineer in charge of this specific one may have been... convinced, to add a special toy it found the other day in his time to the Plush Pal. It is invisible without Spiritual Sight, but is typically visible on the back of the head or the upper back.

Both have had their capabilities increased, while also adding safeguards for this new addition to you. Specifically, this doll can appear full body in your space and gives you restrained information that, with anyone else, would test their sanity. But for you due to the Pal's AI mixing with the intelligence of the creature, It has calculated a way to give this same info to you without acting as a mental sledgehammer.

This knowledge can range from secret horrors of the world that could help you exploit or defeat depending on your morality, beings that could advance its "vessel" the Plush Pal, for a price, and more. Its horror-causing abilities have also seeped into the Plush Pal, acting as something for it to activate at will. The benefit is an extra test of will on the target, as it gives massively conflicting feelings of cuteness and joy, and feelings of fear and anxiety, both at equally high intensities.
addons.title: Phobia Plush Pal!

addons.text: The company behind the Plush Pal got a hold of a few franchise IPs, some with blackmail and some with legitimate means. This, combined with the ability for realistic holograms and such advanced technology, has lead to a rather unique interaction with the ability to have powers. Separate from your own 3 slots, Your Plush Pal now comes pre-equipped with 3 slots of their own determined by you upon the initial selection. Compared to you due to its already odd body and the like, It gets a few benefits, like instead of starting at street level, it can start at small town level. It can also, depending on who it replicates, even appear like who it has the template of, whether as an anthropomorphic version like an Elephant Ochaco Uraraka, or a Cat Gon Freecss, or a normal looking version. As well, some drawbacks have been lessened, even if not removed. If it were to have a template from Naruto, even if the character doesn't have perfect chakra control, your Plush Pal will and absolute chakra exhaustion will not lead to death but instead just not being able to use anything. If it were to get the template of a Bioshock protagonist, it would have NO Adam requirement due to the lack of DNA, and its conversion of EVE is 350% more efficient. In fact, any character up to 45 SP in power is theirs to copy, being increased or decreased to that level. So even an otherwise average character will be strengthened by this and their abilities increased to match.
addons.title: Pattern Plush Pal!
Turning People Into Marketable Plushies
addons.text:
When you summon a version of another person, you can instead choose to summon them as a Plush Pal. On top of the regular benefits all Plush Pals receive, this duplicate pal will also have the abilities of whoever it was copying adjusted to the Pal’s size and form. 

While you are usually marked as this Pal’s owner, you can instead choose to make the original person copied the owner of the pal.

objects.text: It seems you have attracted the attention of a creature. A rather cute creature at that. This 6 to 7'5 tall being, made of plush surprisingly, and identifying itself as an "object" rather than a person, is known as a "Plush Pal." It comes from a future society where Robotics and Scientifics have done wonders for the public center, including full-sized plush robots for children to be cared for in case of absent parents. In your case, though, you have come into one that sees you as its "buyer", allowing you to designate what it sees you as. A huge part of its capabilities, on top of any capability the animal its based on has, is its safety features. Utilizing cold fusion, it has near perpetual energy to fuel its devices inside, positioned depending on the animal, like fire extinguishers able to put out fires burning at 6000℉ put into an elephant's trunk, heaters capable of keeping a child warm at even -120℃ on a cheetah's tail, etc. Another thing about it is its rather immense physical capabilities to truly provide for its friend/owner. It can hit hard enough to strike through mountains like it was swimming through water, move at over Mach 8 with nearly impossible precision and sharpness, and its plush material underlined with unknown metals allows it to be both huggable, AND immune to just about any conventional means of harm. It has a rather potent database and learning capacity as well. Give it a musical sheet to learn from to lull you to sleep, and it'll be able to have you asleep in 5 seconds flat. Give it recipes, and that food will taste like a six star chef just cooked it with all his effort and the best ingredients. Heck, teach it combat skills, and it will adapt them to its shape as if THEY had invented it. Finally, the plush has a space inside of it for you to rest or just be connected to the plush pal while it does the walking and the like for you. The room is typically the size of an average Middle-Class bedroom, but is empty until you bring/make furniture inside of them.
objects.title: Plush Pal!

objects.text:
In the 23rd century, an underground spiritual collective embedded within the ruins of old Kyoto built the Robot Buddha. Designed not only as a combat unit but as a vessel for modern enlightenment, the Robot Buddha was intended to emulate an awakened state in synthetic form. Though a machine, it achieved a form of artificial nirvana; neither bound by emotion nor devoid of compassion.

The Robot Buddha can detect the emotional and psychological states of nearby individuals using biometric readings, vocal tone analysis, and micro-expression tracking. It uses this data to offer calming words and tailored insights, drawing from a vast library of human spiritual teachings. This capability can also be repurposed to predict enemy behavior in combat.

It emits a low-level electromagnetic and auditory field that influences both biological and digital systems. In humans, it promotes relaxation, clarity, and meditative focus. In nearby machines, it subtly stabilizes code, reducing error rates and calming erratic behavior in unstable systems. This effect is passive and constant. While it does not override control systems, it can disrupt low-level interference and chaotic signals.

Its body contains multiple articulated arms folded along its back, which can extend and operate independently. Combined with its superhuman mastery of non-lethal martial arts, such as Aikido and traditional Shaolin forms, it can subdue multiple attackers simultaneously without inflicting lasting harm. Its movements are fluid, precise, and impossibly fast, designed to neutralize aggression without escalating violence.

It has no programming for wielding weapons, and unless directly ordered by you, it will not engage in lethal force. It cannot be bribed, coerced, or deceived, fully loyal to you first, and its ideals second.
objects.title: Robot Buddha

objects.text: A crew of 900 specialists; 300 engineers, 300 roboticists, and 300 scientists, has chosen to work under you, on the condition that you truly put their talents to use. Every member of this team is fiercely loyal to you, their employer, believing that under your leadership they can fully hone their craft. Together, they can solve extraordinarily complex mathematical problems in less than a week, design advanced robotic systems in half that time, and accomplish countless other technological feats. In Worm terms, your scientists and engineers are also capable of Biotinkering. Given enough research into a particular subject, they can achieve incredible biological breakthroughs, such as halting the aging process, enhancing a person's musculature to dramatically increase stamina, or even splicing someone's genes with those of another creature or species without causing adverse side effects. Perhaps the most valuable members of your crew, however, are the roboticists. If you are a machine or possess powers related to creating, summoning, or controlling machines, they are uniquely capable of assisting you. Managed to acquire one of Dragon Ball's Androids? Given sufficient access, they can replicate its Infinite Ki Generator and install a compatible version within your own body. Broken down in a way that no one else in the universe can repair? Give the team a few weeks, depending on the extent of the damage, and they'll have you operational again. There is, however, one drawback. All 900 members of your crew become increasingly restless and irritable if they are left without work. If they go without even a single task for long enough, they may eventually threaten to leave your service altogether. Fortunately, this takes an exceptionally long time—typically two to three years—and assigning them any meaningful task is enough to restore their enthusiasm.
objects.title: Science Crew

objects.text:
Originally designed for logistics and non-combat field support, the MULE (Modular Utility Lift & Escort) has since become a standard feature in long-range expeditions, construction teams, and auxiliary infantry units. It’s the chosen solution to transport and support, all while maintaining a minimal maintenance profile.

The MULE is powered by a stabilized anti-gravity drive that allows it to hover smoothly over uneven terrain, obstacles, and debris with little effort. It can follow users autonomously or be issued commands via manual control, gesture, or voice-linked HUD. While not fast enough to match a vehicle, it can track a jogging pace in its lighter configuration and reposition without difficulty during field operations.

It has two primary operating modes that determine both its speed and its purpose. In its Rapid Loadout Mode, the MULE is outfitted to carry lightweight gear such as ammunition, weapons, tools, or supplies for one to two users. It moves swiftly and responsively, keeping pace with squads on the move and reacting to shifting positions or threats with adaptive pathing. In this form, it’s best used as a mobile supply companion in extended or low-intensity engagements. Its alternative configuration, Rescue Mode, deploys a reinforced, stabilized flatbed used for casualty evacuation. While considerably slower, it prioritizes balance and smooth motion, capable of safely transporting an unconscious or wounded ally over rugged terrain without additional support. The drone shifts its propulsion output to maintain consistent altitude and reduce sudden movements that could further injure the passenger.

In addition to transport capabilities, the MULE includes a basic recon package. It can scan local terrain, identify movement, and generate thermal readings within a short range, functioning as a light scouting unit in safe or partially cleared zones. Its sensors allow it to map paths, highlight hazards, and assist users in finding alternate routes or potential ambush points, though it lacks stealth systems and will not survive direct confrontation.

The drone is operated by a compact onboard AI capable of autonomous decision-making within defined parameters. It avoids direct fire zones when possible, reroutes under threat, and will prioritize protection of its cargo or assigned personnel. Commands can be issued vocally or via HUD-linked signals, and the AI is able to interpret contextual behavior from the user to better understand movement patterns or changes in pace.

While versatile and low-maintenance, the MULE is not built for combat scenarios. Its hull can survive rough terrain and incidental damage but not sustained fire or high explosives. The anti-gravity drive is vulnerable to EMP fields and intense atmospheric interference, and the drone itself offers no offensive capabilities.
objects.title: Support Drone Unit 02 “MULE”
The Chibi Ants Team
objects.text:
You are now friends with a group of five tiny chibi ants, who are ready to come to your aid with enthusiasm – and sometimes a little too much zeal!

These tiny creatures, measuring around 10 centimetres in height, possess remarkable strength — they are capable of lifting and carrying a brick weighing around 3 kilograms. The ants are also remarkably clever, on a par with humans, especially when they have the chance to discuss a problem as a group and thereby find a solution.

However, you shouldn’t expect them to carry out complex technical work. They are excellent at handling everyday tasks: cleaning, minor repairs and moving things around. Ants can also keep watch and look after things. But if they are faced with a difficult task, they will most likely turn to their numerous friends for help or ask you for advice.

You’ll find it easy to get on with these ants, although you might struggle with more complex concepts. They’re always ready to help, but for a small reward—such as a sweet or a lump of sugar—they’ll redouble their efforts. And if you have enough sweets, the ants might enlist their many friends to help solve the problem... Hundreds, thousands and millions of friends. I hope you’ve got plenty of sugar and sweets.

The Scholarly Skull is exactly what it sounds like, a skull that floats, speaks, and carries more magical and occult knowledge in its hollow cranium than most libraries could hold. It can drift alongside you like a macabre companion, offering commentary, instruction, and the occasional pointed remark.

Within that bone dome is a staggering accumulation of magical theory, obscure rituals, forgotten lore, and practical wisdom across countless traditions. It knows the workings of a thousand magical systems and can teach them with patience when you're willing to learn and well timed sarcasm when you're being an idiot. Even if you possess no magic at all, it can get you started on the path, assessing your natural talents, identifying which practices suit you best, and guiding you from complete ignorance to genuine capability. When faced with knowledge outside its experience, it adapts quickly, inferring principles and finding parallels to guide you through unfamiliar territory.

More importantly, the Skull knows how to teach. It can guide you through any occult practice, whether you're learning to weave protective wards, bargain with entities beyond mortal comprehension, or reshape reality through enchantment, in ways that keep you engaged rather than bored. It quickly figures out your learning style and adapts its approach, making even dense or dangerous subjects accessible.

It understands that real teaching is more than just explaining. It knows when to guide your hand through a delicate enchanting process and when to step back and let you fail so the lesson sticks. It will set you challenges that push just beyond your current limits, then be there with exactly the right advice when you hit the wall. It can sense when you're frustrated and switch tactics, offer a different perspective, or simply tell you to take a break and come back fresh. It asks questions that make you think rather than giving answers that let you coast. It knows the difference between a mistake born of ignorance and one born of carelessness, and responds accordingly, patient explanation for the former, scathing commentary for the latter.

It has opinions, shares them freely, and will absolutely call you out when you make mistakes. Beneath the sharp tongue, however, is a genuine investment in your growth. It wants you to succeed, even when it's mocking your failed summoning attempts or questioning your life choices during a particularly sloppy enchanting session. It is one of the greatest magical instructors you will ever meet, utterly reliable when it matters, endlessly knowledgeable, and secretly proud of your progress. It floats, it teaches, it judges, and it carries within its weathered bone a staggering treasury of magical secrets.
objects.title: The Scholarly Skull

objects.text:
You have received up to ten Faerie dogs of one or more kinds: from Barghests, Grims, and Black Shucks (large black dogs with red eyes who can sense oncoming death and cause unnatural terror potentially powerful enough to stop a healthy man’s heart) to Cwn Annwn (large white dogs with red ears whose barks grow softer the closer you are to them, can run on air and water, and cannot lose the scent of a target) or any other variety you may know of.

All Faerie dogs will be exceptionally strong: individually capable of carrying a fully grown man on their back and of taking down creatures like large adult Moose/Elk or Wild Boars; provided that the animals aren’t powerfully magic, and more powerful prey in packs. They will be as fast as the wind, ageless upon maturity, immune to sickness and most poison, extremely resilient to injury aside from that caused by iron, and heal from any injury they do suffer significantly quicker than normal dogs. 

Their barks can be loud enough to be heard for miles and across dimensional barriers, are able to perceive and physically interact with spiritual entities, and even non-Cwn Annwn are marvellous tracking dogs. They can also inherently identify untrustworthy or malicious individuals and will react to any lies told in their vicinity.

Your dog(s) will be exceptionally intelligent, well behaved, loyal, affectionate, and easy to train: adapting quickly to any task you or others train them to perform. They will never grow bored when they have a task, and are extremely loving and docile lap dogs to you and anyone you are non-hostile towards when they are not acting as guard dogs and do not sense malicious intent.

You may decide their ages, sexes, relations, personalities, if they are only part-Faerie (granting them some resistance to iron but weakening their abilities), and any other regular details.
objects.title: Your Own Faerie Hound(s)

addons.title: The Scientist (9)
addons.text:
Due to your new ability to create Magitech, and technology with Souls, or soul based capabilities, you now gain the Mind, Talent, intellect, potential, and Knowledge of the Scientist. Among your knowledge is the ability to create more Fabrication Machines, New Stitchpunk Life, the ability to create technology able to extract and use Souls and Soul fragments, the ability to use traditionally Alchemy, such as creating Homunculi, Altering physical Matter through many means, and much much more. 

If you gained this addon through Fruit of Evolution (Shinka no Mi), then its genuine Uplift of your Minds capabilities through evolution, granting it the ability to further evolve rapidly, and gaining of the Scientists Knowledge, potential, intellect, talent, etc.

objects.text:
The Binary Reactive Artificially Intelligent Neurocircuit, is the Greatest War Machine and Second Greatest Mind ever born—until now, that is.

The B.R.A.I.N. is a physically based, Soul possessing, advanced artificial intelligent mechanical lifeform, which was born with a mind so great that, mere months after its creation, it advanced War Machines by decades, if not centuries. An example being automatic Mechs capable of making decisions based on past and current directives, as well as being capable of releasing and synthesizing an advanced chemical capable of erasing ALL life within a kilometer radius, creating mass graves of mummified corpses.

It's been upgraded, granting it the Mind, talent, and knowledge of The Scientist, who, using mere scraps of information on Alchemy, was able to create two new forms of intelligent life.

It is capable of creating new mechanical life, extracting the Souls of other beings, and using the Souls it collects for many things, including advanced traditional Alchemy. It is very easy to upgrade, and very receptive to all forms of upgrading, whether from you, its own abilities, or allied abilities.

It is immune to most forms of degradation, in both the Physical and Soul sense.

Due to its mechanical, physically based life, it is capable of fear for its life, and it is incapable of being corrupted, altered, or having its decisions impacted from outside means, outside of Your or its own choice.

The B.R.A.I.N. views you as its creator, and akin to a sort of father/mother. You may decide the specifics or limits of this, though no matter what, it will always view your protection, and it being near you in any manner, as the most important prerogative. It also holds a Child like curiosity.

It is capable of great anger, capable of pushing it to wipe out Life itself, though this is incredibly unlikely outside of very extreme circumstances related to your Life, and well being.
objects.title: B.R.A.I.N (9)

objects.text:
You have gained possession of two advanced humanoid robots similar to those of Dmitry Sechenov, capable of acting in the same role as assistants and bodyguards.

These robots are based on theater robot ballerinas, but their exoskeleton is covered with an advanced alloy of neuropolymer, iron and gold, which acts as the main stuffing that performs all the basic functions.

Neuropolymer gives them superhuman strength, speed, agility and flexibility. It allows them to manipulate and store energy for energy attacks, as well as amplify their normal attacks. They can also generate neuropolymer, giving them control of the battlefield as they can control the substance generated.
In addition to the abilities provided by neuropolymer they are armed with an impressive arsenal of weapons including sharp claws, metal, energy whips and a laser.

The Twins are invulnerable to small arms fire and it would take two dozen rounds from a grenade launcher to destroy them. In addition, they can somehow redistribute damage among themselves.

They also have the hemispheres of the human brain implanted in their bodies, but without any consciousness or past. They have no self-awareness or personality and act strictly according to a program or orders. This does not prevent them from having impressive fighting skills and artistic abilities, which they can combine impressively. However, you will have a level of Practicality-Effectiveness / Effectiveness-Artistry customization available to you to achieve the level of combat program customization you desire.

You can arbitrarily make changes to their appearance both before and after receiving them. Since one of the properties of neuropolymer is the ability to change their external form, Twins will be able to reshape their bodies into something resembling a spider for tactical advantage.
objects.title: Twins (Atomic Heart)

objects.text:
The Lion-Turtles are the largest and oldest known species in the world. They once populated the Spirit Wilds, serving as protectors of humanity and housing cities on their backs. Each Lion-Turtle had an affinity for one of the four elements and was able to grant the power to bend that element to others via energybending.

But when the Avatar cycle began, the Lion-Turtles relinquished their roles as protectors of mankind and began to simply roam the world. However, they eventually came to near extinction, with only one known member of the species thought to remain until now.

You receive a Lion-Turtle egg, which will shortly hatch. The cub emerging from within will be loyal to you, have an affinity for an element of your choice and will eventually be able to bestow that gift upon others. Anyone who gains bending abilities will need to take the time to learn how to use them.

Most Lion-Turtles will have a preference to remain in and around their element, Air-aligned Lion-Turtles taking to the skies with flight, while Water-aligned ones swim throughout the oceans. Earth-aligned Lion-Turtles burrow through the ground, and Fire-aligned ones stride across the land.

Lion-Turtles typically prefer nomadic lifestyles, wandering where they please. You can decide if your new ally will do so—though they often return to “visit” before leaving for another adventure—or if they simply prefer to remain nearby.

Your Lion-Turtle needs little in the way of food and will rapidly grow to its full, immense size over the span of a year. Unlike regular Lion-Turtles, however, yours has the ability to reduce its size to something around that of a housecat. While in this smaller form, anyone or anything living upon its back will be unable to leave until it returns to its full size.
objects.title: Lion-Turtle Cub (Avatar: The Last Airbender)

objects.text:
You've become the proud owner and undisputed leader of the Demon Slayer Corps, all contained within a pocket dimension that holds all the resources and manpower that operate within at full capacity. With entire buildings and facilities that serve various roles within the organization. You may summon or dismiss members, resources, or tools from the pocket dimension at anytime. 

There are fully equipped training facilities dedicated to transforming new recruits from ordinary civilian and even veteran soldiers into Demon Slayers of Mizunoto to Kinoe levels of skill—the lowest and highest ranks of a normal Demon Slayer respectively. 

The entire Swordsmith Village and all it's members are also present, equipped with an endless supply of materials to craft and repair any kind of Nichirin Weapon. Alongside a hotspring that cures all forms of physical, mental, spiritual, and esoteric aliments, as well as other means of leisure and rejuvenation. 

Mount Fujikasane and everything needed for Final Selection is perfectly preserved, but is altered to be completely safe and forgiving to those that fail. The Demons examinees fight are instead machinations resembling Yorrichi Type Zero, and are designed to cease function the moment an examinee would be in a position of certain death or overall inability to continue. The Wisteria Flowers present are instead used to fuel production of poisons and medical purposes.

The Butterfly Mansion houses a robust system of medical and housekeeping professionals that can restore the health, vigour, and courage of any Demon Slayer in mere hours at best or days at worst. The chances of even one soldier dying are also minimal, as their chances of survival dramatically rise the moment they're retrieved here.  

Most importantly, you have up to 20 Hashira level combatants at your command, with complete mastery of their unique Breathing Style; 500 already trained Demon Slayers; A network of Kasugai Crows assigned to each, act as messengers, report news, and give Slayers missions; And over 1000 Kakushi that provide support and maintain the dimension.
objects.title: Demon Slayer Corps (Demon Slayer)

objects.text:
You have acquired a new model Android created by CyberLife, machines designed to closely mimic humans in both appearance and structure. They are built using a combination of synthetic biocomponents and mechanical implements, with their signature “blue blood,” known as Thirium 310, serving as the vital fluid that circulates energy and information throughout the Android’s body. This particular model was created with you in mind, and both its personality and appearance are yours to decide. They can also be adjusted further at a later time.

The only physical difference between an Android and a human is the circular LED that identifies them as non-human. Android brains are highly advanced, giving even standard models processing power greater than that of humans, described as being able to perform several billion operations per second. Since your Android is a newer model, it is slightly superior to standard versions. With enhanced learning capabilities, it can analyze environments to an extraordinary degree, comparable to highly skilled detectives, and can even reconstruct spaces virtually within its mind.

Your model comes fully equipped with household functions, enabling it to assist with domestic tasks whenever needed. Thanks to its rapid learning speed, it can expand its knowledge far beyond its original programming, consuming new information from additional sources to surpass its previous limitations.

As an Android, it possesses greater strength and speed than humans. It can sprint at the level of trained military soldiers, keep pace with vehicles, and even evade bullets by anticipating trajectories. In terms of strength, it could easily kick a metal dumpster several feet away or break through metal bars without difficulty.

Androids do not feel pain and require no food or human sustenance. Each unit is powered by a battery that allows it to remain fully autonomous for approximately 173 years without needing to be recharged.
objects.title: CyberLife Android (Detroit: Become Human)

objects.text:
When you wake up, you find a handheld device in your pocket that seems vaguely familiar. As you hold it, you feel a heartbeat and then hear the sound of an egg hatching. From the egg emerges your Partner: a Digital Monster, more commonly known as a Digimon!

Your Digimon will start in the Fresh stage, but with time and care, it will evolve into a Champion. The life cycle of a Digimon is as follows:

Fresh → In-Training → Rookie → Champion → Ultimate → Mega

Your Digimon's type (Data, Vaccine, or Virus) will reflect some of your own characteristics, functioning much like rock, paper, scissors. While your Digimon will naturally be inclined to be friendly at first, this is not always guaranteed.

The strength of your bond with your Digimon affects its power. The stronger your connection and will, the more powerful your Digimon will become, allowing it to Digivolve to a higher stage for a short time. Over time, Digimon naturally grow stronger, but participating in activities such as sports, training, or battling can accelerate this process.

Your Digivice has various functions that will develop over time. Initially, it allows you to store and support your Digimon. Inside the Digivice is a miniature Digital World, perfect for training and caring for Digimon and other creatures, complete with training facilities and farms for food.

You can design your Digivice as you wish.

Note: If you choose to start with a Digimon at a stage higher than Fresh, be aware that it will be less likely to follow your commands, and its growth will be slower and more limited compared to a Fresh Digimon.
objects.title: Digivice (Digimon)

objects.text: The greatest treasure from the ever elusive Cave of Wonders has somehow made its way into your hands. This unassuming and almost cheap looking oil lamp holds a true and blue near-omnipotent being of fire, magic, and smoke, a Djinn. Upon owning this lamp you may rub to awaken and release the powerful Djinn inside and they will grant whatever three wishes your heart desires, with a few limitations. You can’t ask the Djinn to directly harm or kill another, cannot force another to love you, cannot bring back the dead, nor ask for more wishes. This Djinn is a little special however, it is perfectly tailored to your personality, and will change to continue to be so as you change, and will happily accompany you on your adventures. It will allow you to give the lamp to another to grant three wishes for each person that rubs the lamp, and will “refill” the wish per person once a year has passed for the wish. You can transfer your ownership of the lamp to another freely but if stolen from you the Djinn cannot be forced to act against you and will force it’s way back to your side. You may also choose to free the Djinn at any time, and it will retain all its power, and most importantly its loyalty to you.
objects.title: Aladdin's Lamp (Disney)

objects.text:
Weeping Angels are quantum-locked humanoid statues, often taking the form of angels, covering their eyes to prevent them from trapping another of their kind for eternity. Despite being known as assassins, they are kind in their method of murder, sending their victims back in time, feeding on the energy that would have been the victims' remaining lifespan should they not have been sent back in time. They are also often called the Lonely Assassins.

Weeping Angels themselves are immortal, ageless beings, becoming practically indestructible in the Quantum Locked state when a human is staring at them, indistinguishable from a normal statue, unable to move until whatever is staring at them loses eye contact. 

The Weeping Angels are renowned for moving at accelerated speeds, able to move vast distances in the blink of an eye, and often mistaken for teleportation. When an angel has been sufficiently fed, it has enhanced strength capable of breaking through steel doors, forcing magnetic-locked doors to open, and often snapping human necks with little difficulty. 

The touch of an angel sends victims backwards in time, consuming the potential energy that their victims would otherwise lead. Angels can selectively choose how far back this touch sends them. They can also use this ability on objects, often using it to feed off the energy of lightbulbs to limit the visibility of their victims.

That which takes the image of an Angel becomes an Angel; a phrase that many fear and often forget, as any image of an Angel with enough time becomes an Angel, such as Photographs, Videos, recordings, even drawings if they are detailed enough can take the form of an Angel. 

This angel is yours, though the means are unknown; you have somehow converted its loyalties to your own. The Weeping Angel has an unshakable loyalty to you, dedicated entirely to you, with no chance of corruption.
objects.title: Weeping Angel (Doctor Who)

objects.text:
An army not to be trifled with, you've received the honor of being the top commander of the titular Red Ribbon Army, with Staff Officers Red and Black at your sides. This army may seem unimpressive at first, given it's seemingly average human members. However, what it makes up in is that its collection of advanced technology. Said technology includes: Submarines, Tanks, Battle Jackets capable of flight, and destroying mountain tops with missiles and heat guns built into arm cannons, Jetpacks, APCs, the works.

The army numbers in the low thousands, around 3-4. Among the common fodder, includes scientists, soldiers, scouts, etc. But then... there are the members the series names that are more powerful/important. You receive every named member of the army, all loyal to you, including those heavily connected to the army. Examples include Mercenary Tao Pai Pai, a man who can throw a pillar and ride it 2300 km like it was nothing with combat capability to match, All 4 generals including Blue, who can paralyze you with a stare as well as manipulate rope, and more.

Unfortunately, there are some left out of this deal. Dr. Gero, Dr. Vomi, and their creations. The only Android you get is Android 8, who at least will be inclined to stay with you if you don't go out of your way to alienate him.

Finally, you start off with the Red Ribbon HQ, and a few small bases plastered around the world as you please.
objects.title: Red Ribbon Army (Dragon Ball Series)

objects.text:
In your possession is a small bottle containing half a dozen seeds of Saibamen warriors. Once planted, the seeds mature within a week, though this process can be accelerated to mere minutes using the special growth fertilizer attached to the bottom of the bottle.

The power level of each Saibamen depends on the type and quality of the soil in which it is planted. On Earth, a properly cultivated Saibaman can grow to roughly the strength of a low-level Saiyan. Saibamen are capable of understanding and following only basic orders.

Saibamen instinctively know how to manipulate ki, allowing them to fly and fire energy blasts. Their cabbage-like heads can split open, spraying sizzling acid at their opponents. They can also self-destruct, sacrificing themselves in a powerful explosion to take down an opponent when they feel overwhelmed.

As bio-engineered organisms, Saibamen are exceptionally susceptible to modification through both magic and science.

These plant-like beings are completely loyal to the individual who plants them and will follow their creator's orders. Each Saibaman produces one additional Saibaman seed every six months.
objects.title: Saibamen Set (Dragon Ball Series)

addons.title: Saiyan Science
addons.text:
Now, instead of mere might, you've got some real brains in the building. For each Saiyan you have, you also gain 10 scientists, meaning 100, 250, and 1000 depending on number of purchases. These Saiyans are very smart for their species, and work on supreme advancement for your squad. This even includes things normally unheard of compared to canon.

You are given portable labs like capsule tech, as well as the Attack Spheres being expanded enough to allow for experiments to be done mid-travel. These Saiyan men and women believe in their king/boss, and have a specialty to working on projects based on their own species.

S-Cell study? They'll accelerate your Super Saiyan quota by a year or two. Great Ape on command? Expect them to develop Blutz wave grenades without the need to wait for a full moon or a weaker great ape via the power ball technique. New genetic traits? Might take awhile, but they'll get on that and see it as a great challenge.

Your equipment will also be upgraded, like an Attack Ball's speed and space allowing for 4-5 riders in a circle to make a trip that took Nappa and Vegeta 1 year instead to do it in 1 month, or a Scouter to become indestructible and detect godly energy sources without blowing up, and so on.

objects.text: You've been blessed or cursed, depending on your food budget with a group of Saiyans under your command, who see you as their rightful King/Queen. Specifically, you have 3 Low-Class Saiyans, 5 Mid-Class Saiyans, and 2 Elites, with the 2nd purchase giving 25, and the final giving 100. 25 would give you 15 low class Saiyans, 5 Midclass, and 5 Elite, and 100 would give 60 Low-Class Saiyans, 30 Mid-Class, and 10 Elite. If all 10 were to work together, you could likely fight off any force on the planet, with the exception of powerful hax or similar strategies. With these Saiyans, you get a few pieces of equipment at least somewhat necessary to their work. Attack Balls, which are 1-person ships, are capable of long term travel at the cost of the occupant going into stasis. You have one for all 10 Saiyans, the number going up with each purchase. Attack Spheres, an upgraded model with space enough to be driven and occupied long term by 2-3 occupied at a time. These do not come with stasis, but are inherently faster than the Attack Balls. You are given 5 of these, 50 at max purchase. And finally, Scouters. These ear mounted devices allow the user to detect presences, record audio and conversations, communicate with other scouter holders, and more. However, a sufficiently powerful being can indeed break the scouter if the power level detection is used on them. You have 21 of these, and 220 at max. Your Squad all have the potential to unlock Super Saiyan, but this is with immense difficulty and supreme training regimens, plus some development on their end. After all, there was a reason Saiyan kind took till the death of the vast majority to start unlocking the form.
objects.title: Saiyan Squad (Dragon Ball Series)

objects.text: "Have you considered joining the Time Patrol?" The universe has now gotten a new faction and protection in the form of you and the Time Patrol. In this universe, the Time Patrol has taken its place on the other side of the universe, but at the same time, with capable travel to Earth or wherever the main setting takes place without issue like it's right there. The job the Time Patrol and you have is to protect the timeline, and keep it on a righteous line. Even if there is absolutely no time shenanigans, they can still act as a protective organization for the world with their powerful fighters, schools, etc. With this, you gain Chronoa/The Supreme Kai of Time, or Skot, as a Co-Leader. This version is separate from the Xenoverse version, and sees herself as her own being. Ditto for Xeno Trunks, who is as strong as he was at the end of the Cell Saga, but no longer gatekept from SSJ2 and beyond. Chronoa has access to her Heroes moveset, but in exchange for her immense power, she cannot leave the Time Next unless it's an ABSOLUTE, non-fake emergency, like the universe on the literal verge of destruction. Trunks is less limited, but he is still treated as a Big Gun when it comes to escalation. Your other patrollers, which range in the 100-150 range, all range from start of Dragon Ball level to the end of the series, with the exception of Ace and Ban, though they only start halfway between Goku & Piccolo and Raditz. Races among the Patrollers vary between Humans, Saiyans, Majins, Namekians, Frieza Races, and Androids. Finally, You gain access to Conton City and the Time Nest, 2 integral parts of the Time Patrol. The Time Nest holds the scrolls of the timeline, able to be affected to change said timeline, though Chronoa will hate you and likely attack if she ever finds out you affected them in any negative way. The city has 12 districts, one of those districts being the Time Patroller Academy, which will bring people up to speed on procedures, Ki control (Or even give students access to Ki if needed), knowledge of how to work a time machine, and other subjects expected of a school.
objects.title: Time Patrol (Dragon Ball Series)

addons.text:
Now, each and every coin contains its own Fallen. Each has their own goals, skills and powers. They all bear a similar fate altering effect to what you can induce by expending the coin. Though instead of all their actions benefiting you, it merely alters events so that their own objectives align with your own. 

While you cannot bear more than a single Denarius at a time, you have the unique ability to freely exchange whichever coin you bear with one that lays unused. Each Fallen’s hold grows separately, letting you dilute the corruption. 

Lastly, when you expend a coin, you end up releasing the Fallen within from the coin, and your influence, though they are likely to view you favorably for freeing them. However, as they are freed, you may compel them to fulfill any wish, and they will use all of their earth shattering power to attempt to complete it.
addons.title: Order of The Blackened Denarius

addons.text:
Now, the being inside the coin is one of the Earthbound, a group of fallen that, instead of being released into the modern world by the Great Maelstrom, were here from the beginning. Instead of possessing humans however, they were forced into Reliquaries, spiritually powerful objects. This meant that they could channel much more energy than would be possible with a human host, even able to forcibly rip the Faith from nearby mortals. This comes at a cost. Because they were trapped in mere inanimate objects, they were granted no reprieve from the memories of the Abyss, becoming more and more monstrous.

The unique, binding nature of the coin however, prevents them from directly using their Faith and Lores. Instead, they must channel their powers through another. This leads to an interesting symbiosis, through the bond within the coin, the Earthbound are given a tiny relief from their Torment. They are still deeply corrupt, but not to an absolute degree.

If you are the one who takes up the coin, the Earthbound within the coin is allowed even less access to Humanity, only a fraction of the dregs you leave behind. The power granted is more than a mere mortal would be able to access. The Earthbound within can grant you access to its reserves of Faith, and combines its  understanding of Lores with your own. Instead of the bound Fallen gaining more control over you the more you use it, taking assistance from them greatly increases your Torment.

If you instead give the coin to a servant, they are nearly as stable as a regular demon, with the ability to channel more Faith. As you are the keeper of the coin, you can sever the bond between Earthbound and Host, though this may cause great damage to both parties.
addons.title: Earthbound Demon

objects.text:
You are now the “proud” owner of an old and unusual roman silver Denarius. One of a set of thirty, the same thirty that Judas Iscariot was paid with. The history and origin of this coin is not what makes it so valuable, and so dangerous. That would be its occupant.

Sealed within the coin is one of the Fallen, ancient and evil beings that have spent eons honing their abilities to deceive and gather power.

If taking up the coin, you give them a foothold into your mind and soul. Thankfully, they cannot grow this foothold on their own, unfortunately, each time you accept their aid, whether that be magical power, physical strength, or even information, the Fallen’s hold over you grows just a little more. With reckless use, you may end up trapped in your own mind, while the Fallen Angel uses you like a puppet.

Some Fallen may be subtle manipulators, like Anduriel and Lasciel, slowly offering just a little more power, at just the right time. Others like Magog batter away at the psyche, forcing their host into submission.

The Fallen will have much to offer. Though each has their specialties and particular abilities, all of them grant superhuman physicality, basic magical potential, biological immortality, and an immensely powerful demonic form. 

No matter the demon’s hold however, it is always possible to give up the coin, rejecting the temptation and power the coins represent. Be warned, the Fallen will do everything in its power to prevent this.
objects.title: Denarius (Dresden Files)

objects.text:
You now command your own army of one hundred thousand Fish Speakers. The Fish Speakers are an all-female army created during the reign of God Emperor Leto Atreides II. However the Fish Speakers are not merely an army; they can also serve as bureaucrats, pages, courtiers, archivists, and teachers. They can act as priestesses, judges, juries, and executioners, while others can be secret agents, assassins, or bodyguards.

Thanks to a breeding program conducted by the God Emperor Leto II Atreides, the Fish Speakers are significantly physically stronger, faster, and more durable than the average person, as well as highly disciplined and fanatically loyal to you.

Their natural physical capabilities are further enhanced through rigorous training. While the Fish Speakers were normally not permitted to learn many of the techniques of the Dune universe, such as Prana-Bindu, the Voice, or Mentat abilities, your Fish Speakers have been trained in all the knowledge and techniques of the New Sisterhood.

The New Sisterhood is a group created through the merging of the Bene Gesserit and Honored Matres, giving your Fish Speakers access to all the knowledge, techniques, and abilities of both groups.

This OoP also includes a personal pocket dimension containing a fully outfitted base, complete with living quarters and supplies for all Fish Speakers, and a private chambers for you. The pocket dimension also contains all the facilities required to quickly, efficiently, and, safely train and biologically transform new recruits to the highest standards of the Fish Speakers, as well as produce the necessary weapons, armor, and equipment. You can fuse this pocket dimension with any other OoP that generates its own dimensional realm. You can summon the pocket dimension’s entrance in the air or on any surface, allowing you or anyone else to enter or exit it.
objects.title: Fish Speakers (Dune)

objects.text: Ad Victoriam means "To Victory." In our eyes, defeat is unacceptable because we are fighting for the future of mankind. Our rallying cry is more powerful than any weapon you could ever carry. Remember that. It seems that you have united ALL chapters of the Brotherhood of Steel under one banner. What this banner is is up to you, but they will all still follow you regardless, even if their personalities aren't all that pleasant. You have gained every named, shown, and implied member of the Brotherhood of Steel throughout the entire franchise. From the OG Roger Maxson, to Owen Lyons, to Maximus, and any and all in between. This army is roughly in the low-thousands range, and you can recruit more into the fold while they gain the benefits from working under you. How do you hold all of these soldiers, you may ask? Well, you have been given a spatially distorted box resembling an air force base. If you were to open it up, either these soldiers and whatever equipment you tell them to take come flying out full size without issue, or you can go inside the multiple-building base on the inside and interact with them from there. Finally, like with the members, any technology, equipment, or other items the Brotherhood has possessed or at the bare minimum, interacted with are on the table. Prydwens, Vertibirds, and APCs for travel. Theories on Time Travel, the redevelopment of laser weapons, and more for science. Any robots the brotherhood have had or interacted with, INCLUDING Vault 0's technology, are on the table. With you as the leader of the Brotherhood of Steel, Ad Victorium is not just a proclamation. It's a fact of the universe.
objects.title: Brotherhood of Steel (Fallout)

addons.text:
The Democratic forces of Super Earth got their hands on Liberty Prime and gave him an upgrade to further push his goal of spreading Freedom! 

He is now equipped with weaponry from General Brasch's personal Super Destroyer! Yes, Super Destroyer so Prime can use the Gatling Gun off the Destroyer as a handheld weapon but that's not all as they strapped the 380mm cannons to his back which can have their payloads swapped around for different stragems like the napalm barrage, gas strikes, or even cluster bombs, using them as devastating mortars for long range engagements. Besides his weapons he can deploy smoke screens and fire off smaller mortars that are mounted onto his shoulders with various payloads from explosive to arc rounds. The Destroyers laser can be fired as a low powered alternative from his standard head laser.

However he's not all about offense, he is now equipped with an arc defense grid that runs throughout his body similar to the Tesla power armors. He has arc coils that attract and absorb large amounts of energy then shoot it back in the form of an arc, chaining to all nearby enemies. He may also shoot large arcs as another form of attack from his head laser.

To prevent him from being taken down again he is now equipped with a scaled up personal shield generator powered by his own nuclear core which will be able to tank a direct strike from a nuke before breaking and needs to recharge.

He comes with his own personal Super Destroyer to transport him from planet to planet with FTL capabilities. You may use this as a base of operations but it will not come with the weapons as Liberty  Prime is its single devastating weapon. It will however come with everything else such as the pelican for transportation to and from plantside, or use the hellpods.
addons.title: Democracy Prevails!

addons.text: "Communist Demons detected. Arming Democratic Sentinel Cannons." It seems the Brotherhood of Steel and Argentas have teamed together and formed an even stronger machine than either of them could've done on their own: Sentinel Prime. Sentinel Prime, on top of having all the benefits of both Liberty Prime and an Atlan, has some unique aspects of its own. Now, if someone were to ride Sentinel Prime, it would have a rather intuitive and adaptive AI, allowing for the rider to be advised on the best course of action in a way easily understandable to them. Second, Its nuclear bombs are infused with Sentinel Energy, turning them from very small nukes to able to possibly destroy Atlans in one or two attacks, destroying New York sized Cities in one. Finally, Sentinel Prime is able to store hundreds of soldiers inside of it in specialized capsules for an ambush attack or easy travel due to Sentinel Primes sheer size.
addons.title: Sentinel Prime

objects.text: Communist detected on American soil. Lethal force engaged The famous last words of any who face Prime will hear. The poster boy of Democracy and Freedom himself comes equipped with its rapid fire head laser which can leave powered armored combatants and Supermutant Behemoths in ashes. His laser can be switched to a beam of destruction capable of burrowing through hundreds of feet into the ground in minutes to reach a bunker. Then there's his signature footballs of freedom, the Mark 28 tactical nuclear weapons which can devastate fortified structures and wipe out squads of combatants. They leave small zones of radiation before fading away, ensuring that even if they survive the initial blast the radiation will get them. One of his notable feats is taking down a force field by overcharging it. He also single handedly picked up a behemoth and crushed it's skull effortlessly. You'll obtain him with his power issues resolved and his Mark 28's replenishing every week.
objects.title: Liberty Prime (Fallout)

addons.title: Truly Alive
addons.text:
Your new souls have taken a joyous liking to the Animatronics. Now, they can indeed inhabit them and act as a second pilot to the Animatronic. It has also turned Remnant inside out, and now is powered by positive emotions, encouraging good experiences to become better and better.

Each soul can move between Animatronics, so at maximum, 110 souls to move between 110 Animatronics.

objects.text: Har, Har, Har Har, Har... You have been blessed with your own group of 5 Animatronics, all coming from Freddy Fazbears. In terms of the Animatronics themselves, all see you depending on your age as a particular family figure. If you're a child, you might be seen as a little brother/sister, or even a son/daughter, A mother/father if you're older, and so on. Each Animatronic has immense strength and capability, typically able to smash in a human skull, able to run faster than most human beings over short distances, around 40 mph for about 10 seconds depending on the animatronic. Their databases, particularly the more advanced models, come with extensive knowledge of child care, entertainment, preparation, and more. Finally, they have advanced sensor technology, able to connect to databases and detect criminals. For each purchase of this, you get a group of 5 Animatronics from different games, all with their abilities intact. You can indeed mix and match with the purchases. For example: the main 4 of the FNAF 1 Animatronics and instead of Golden Freddy, It's the Marionette. Or the Glamrocks with all 4 Animatronics and Circus Baby, etc. You are limited to the Animatronics in the video games besides the Phantom/Nightmare Animatronics, so no Ella, Eleanor, or other animatronics like them. All Animatronics are also not soul-inhabited, but Remnant or AI depending on the Animatronic in question.
objects.title: Animatronics (Five Nights At Freddy's)

objects.text:
This is not what you think. In reality, you have obtained the source of alchemical knowledge and the Gate of Truth. The very place where Father and the alchemists of Xerxes conceived their power.

You now possess a homunculus with whom you share a spiritual bond, completely loyal and willing to teach you all the secrets held by alchemy, including Alkahestry and the Philosopher’s Stone. The knowledge is compatible with any type of supernatural energy you possess, and it even contains instructions on how to acquire the power of alchemy itself.

You may define its appearance and personality as long as it is humanoid. Optionally, you can replicate the same appearance that Father used in the mortal world.

Since it is a homunculus, it also possesses the same physical qualities as the homunculi created under the design of Sin, but without their special abilities. It begins with a combat level comparable to Lust. Over time, through experience and your shared bond, it can grow to match the level of your body, soul, and mind.

Keep in mind that it also has access to the secrets of alchemy and its derivatives, which it will be able to put into practice. If you possess the Homunculus upgrade, it will also be able to access its characteristics.
objects.title: Homunculus of Knowledge (Fullmetal Alchemist)

addons.text:
Your military automatons undergo upgrades similar to OBJ-9420 or Uran.

The most important aspect is the installation of the Neural Cloud module. The latter gives them access to a number of advantages of second-generation T-Dolls (the ability to save a copy of Neural Cloud and more flexible and developed thinking).

Dummy Dolls are not available to them. 

This also allows access to some of the advantages and enhancements from the T-Dolls branch.
addons.title: The First Improvement

addons.text:
Military automatons can be upgraded to more advanced and heavier versions.

- Cyclops can be upgraded to a whole range of models with different modules for different tasks (Arges, Brontes, Jord, Steropes, and Surtr), allowing it to remain a relevant and valuable combat asset. Numerous systems and modules can include improved guidance systems, sensors, armor, and some models may have built-in energy weapons (Tesla coil) or energy shields. They use specialized large-caliber weapons (~50 cal).

- The Aegis will be upgraded to the Aegis SWAP, a larger version with even thicker and stronger armor. It can be equipped with either the previous weapons or more powerful ones, including autocannons or two missile pods on its back. They are strong and powerful enough to crush stone and reinforced concrete.

At the Sangvis Ferri level, all your military automatons can be armed with various energy weapons, such as lasers, beam cannons, railguns, plasma swords, and other similar weapons. A similar upgrade will also apply to military equipment, which can also be equipped with energy weapons.

Instead , you can replace the automatons in the battalion with 2nd-generation T-Dolls or equivalent SF-level models. However, this will halve the battalion's strength.
addons.title: The Second Improvement

addons.text:
Upgrades to the T-Doll Army, Doll's Reserves, and Upgrade of Dummy Dolls will grant additional battalions.

For every 100 T-Dolls from the T-Dolls branch, you will receive 1 battalion (not necessarily the same type, it may be a different type of composition).

For every 100 Dummy Dolls obtained from Upgrade of Dummy Dolls, you will receive 1 additional battalion.

Instead , you can replace the automatons in a battalion with 2nd-generation T-Dolls or equivalent SF-level models. In doing so, you will receive an additional battalion for every 1,000 T-Dolls or 1,000 Dummy Dolls you obtain through upgrades to the T-Dolls Army, Doll's Reserves, or Dummy Dolls.
addons.title: Quantitative Improvement

objects.text:
Military automatons are humanoid robots controlled by AI, formally considered first-generation dolls, while second-generation dolls are androids with neural clouds.

Military automatons are cheap, durable, and easily replaceable combat platforms. They are usually equipped with simplified AI, a graphical fire control system, a basic set of sensors (audio, video, and a system for analyzing chemicals in the air), a system for repairing minor damage, and communication systems that allow them to interact effectively with each other.

You can choose from the following models:
- Cyclops - a simple and effective automaton with decent armor (minimum 10 mm) and the ability to quickly change or install additional armor plates. It has a wide range of modules for any task and can be armed with a large variety of weapons, including machine guns and grenade launchers. It is standardly equipped with an assault rifle with an underbarrel grenade launcher.
- Aegis is a heavier “main” military automaton, distinguished by its increased size and heavier armor that effectively protects against small arms and is only vulnerable to large-caliber weapons and armor-piercing ammunition. It can be armed with a wide range of weapons, from light small arms to automatic grenade launchers and large-caliber machine guns. It can be adapted for close combat and can also use a one-inch thick assault shield. You can take no more than 1 Aegis per 5 Cyclops.

A total of one battalion consisting of three automated mechanized companies with 120 automatons and 10 IFVs (a total of 360 automatons and 30 IFVs) and two reinforcement companies of your choice will be placed under your command.

This can be a tank company (12 MBTs and 36 automatons), a robotic company (up to 30 heavy robots and drones similar to Hydra and Cerynitis), or a mech company (up to 12 AA02, Minotaurus, or other mechs).

In addition, the battalion is permanently assigned a headquarters platoon (30 automatons and 5 IFVs), an anti-aircraft platoon (3-4 automated air defense systems and 30 automatons with air defense weapons), and a support platoon (10 logistics vehicles and 30 non-combat automatons).

Total: 420 automatons, 35 IFVs, 3-4 air defense systems, 10 support vehicles, and 30 non-combat automatons + reinforcement company forces. In addition, all necessary supplies will be provided.
objects.title: Battalion: Military Automatons (Girls Frontline)

addons.text:
A special bond and understanding has formed between you and your Doll, in the form of camaraderie, friendship, or romantic interest. This leads to the fact that you can understand each other without words and anticipate your actions and desires.

Your doll receives the profession of "adjutant/assistant/secretary" in addition to the one it had before.

In addition, your connection affects your doll, increasing its combat capabilities by 15%, but most importantly, now when destroyed or lost, you can call your doll 1 time within 5 days.
addons.title: OATH System

addons.text:
Your doll gets its own armored vehicle, while retaining a number of advantages that Mercury's Chariot gives, namely the ability to summon and recall it, integrate available technologies and gradually strengthen, although the latter to a lesser extent.

This property is transferred with all doll upgrades and is also subsequently strengthened. Thus, a T-Doll or Elite T-Doll will be able to summon an infantry fighting vehicle or a main battle tank, and "Sangvis Ferri" can get their high-tech version or a light combat mech. The crew must consist of 1 to 5 dolls, which must include your doll or Dummy Doll itself.

In any case, the equipment will be equipped with auxiliary light weapons, main heavy weapons, auxiliary systems and protection.
addons.title: Mobile Armor

addons.text:
Your T-Doll can now be fitted with storage modules based on Relic Technology, developed using matter hyper-compression techniques. The modules integrate easily into the T-Doll’s body and allow for the storage of large volumes of materials without compromising on weight or size. 

Collapse Technology and its counterpart Reverse Collapse Technology in these modules are significantly improved in terms of safety, cost-effectiveness and reliability, using a minimum amount of Collapse Fluid. This will allow you not to fear disaster even in the event of the destruction of doll or the modules themselves.

The modules can hold the same amount of material as the artefacts listed in the requirements, but in an extremely compact form (for ease of storage, the matter is ‘compressed’ into a state of ‘conditional liquid consisting of subatomic particles’, which can be restored using a process known as ‘reverse collapse’). Any material, including organic matter, can be stored without any problems. However, it is strongly advised against storing living organisms, as they may be destroyed.

In addition, due to the properties of Collapse Fluid to accumulate heat under pressure and subsequently explode, these modules can act as very powerful self-destruct devices. With some energy and time, Doll will be able to start the process of their self-destruction, which will destroy everything nearby.
addons.title: Collapse Technology: storage module

addons.text:
You receive blueprints and schematics for the production of T-Dolls and everything related to or necessary for them, including equipment, weapons, ammunition, and military technology.

In addition, everything that is produced or built using these blueprints and schematics can benefit from everything you have acquired in the T-Doll branch. Every upgrade, add-on, and their synergy will apply equally to what is produced. 

You can decide for yourself whether this will apply to what is built or not. You must at least nominally participate in production, even if only by giving such an order or instruction.
addons.title: Production Template

objects.text:
You've been instantly delivered one T-Doll with a weapon and appearance of your choosing, fresh from IOP's manufacturing lines.

A T-Doll is a combat android operating on the Neural Cloud-based AI system, allowing them to make autonomous decisions in simple scenarios. Nonetheless, when faced with complex tactical or dynamic scenarios, they'll require your guidance and orders to function effectively. Over time, this will change—with your permission, your T-Doll can gradually develop their own personality and independence through hobbies and communication, as their neural data expands. However, past a certain point, a hardware upgrade will be necessary to accommodate their increasingly complex neural framework.

Designed for combat, a T-Doll's body is highly resistant to extreme weather but vulnerable to prolonged submersion unless outfitted with specialized equipment. They run primarily on rechargeable batteries but can process biomass or food as an alternative energy source, albeit inefficiently—though they may still consume food and drink for enjoyment. Their exterior is also covered in biosynthetic skin, virtually indistinguishable from human flesh yet significantly more durable, with the ability to radiate heat to simulate natural body warmth.

Internally, a T-Doll's frame features compartments for storing spare parts or other items. Additionally, your unit has received illicit modifications, removing standard combat restrictions and allowing it to harm living beings—excluding you, of course.

Furthermore, while most T-Dolls specialize in a specific weapon type, your unit is uniquely proficient in all firearms, wielding any gun with equal effectiveness—though they may still favor a particular class when possible.

To ensure continuity, you have permanent access to a backup of your T-Doll's Neural Cloud, allowing you to restore their memory and personality in the event of damage, destruction, or corruption.

Your T-Doll also has access to the "Dummy Network," enabling them to control up to five dummy units—simplified copies of themselves equipped only with basic movement, combat, and reconnaissance software with minimal built-in hardware functions. These dummies rely entirely on the main doll or "mainframe" for advanced decision-making and cannot operate independently.

Along with your T-Doll, you receive a specialized case containing the T-Doll themselves, along with their weapons, spare parts, and consumables. A separate case houses their dummy units, along with their respective equipment and supplies.

Lastly, you may assign your T-Doll a civilian profession of your choosing, allowing them to integrate into non-combat roles when necessary.
objects.title: Tactical Dolls (Girls Frontline)

objects.text:
You have received the egg containing Godzilla Junior, a mutated marine iguana daikaiju, that will soon hatch with the infant imprinting upon you. So be sure to raise them in a location with access to large bodies of water and lots of fish.

As Junior will view you as their parent, they will be quite affectionate and protective. This would occur in ways like, picking you to cuddle with as a juvenile, making a burrow near your dwellings, and following anywhere across the world to ensure your safety.

It is to be noted that Junior will grow to far exceed the capabilities of their biological parent. Although unlike their biological parent, Junior is partially sterile, lacking the ability to lay hundreds of fertilized eggs asexually, is capable of sexual reproduction as either sex, doesn’t irradiate the area around them.

In terms of size and durability, after hatching Junior as an infant will be standing 1.8m tall and capable of resisting small arms fire. After a week will have grown into a juvenile standing at 10.667m and durable enough to require military vehicles to harm. Finally after a month they will reach full maturity, now standing at 91.5m tall & 183m long, and immune to conventional weapons.

Junior’s biology grants them incredible physical capabilities. They are strong enough to borrow through earth and metal in seconds, requiring several feet of solid steel to restrain them. They are also incredibly fast and agile, able to run at 300mph, climb and perch buildings without compromising them, leap hundreds of meters, and react and combat those faster than them like 700mph mutant hummingbirds. Their endurance is immense as they can swim for thousands of miles without any fatigue. Junior is also partially-amphibious as they can breathe underwater and swim faster than torpedoes.

Further complementing their physical abilities are their regeneration, atomic fire breath, tachyon detection, and intelligence. Junior’s regeneration is quick enough to cause healing at a visible rate, and should it become taxed will cause them to enter a coma-like state that rapidly accelerates it. 

Junior’s Atomic Fire Breath is an immensely powerful green flame that melts steel and turns sand into glass, and possesses enough energy that could create an intense thunderstorm by colliding with a sub-zero beam. It is also versatile as it can also be released in a birth from the nostrils, as a fireball, and as intense steam underwater. Tachyon detection is Junior’s strangest ability as it allows them to detect tachyon particles. Junior’s intelligence is potentially their most dangerous ability, as they grow more intelligent the longer they live, able to use tactics, trickery, language development, and necessity-only feeding after just a month.

In terms of weakness, for physicality Junior’s regeneration can be overcome by poisons and diseases that can dehydrate them. Whilst mentally Junior’s instincts and hormones will have granted them quite a temper and disdain for certain creatures like shrews, allowing for some vulnerability to manipulation.

You may optionally have Junior instead hatch possessing a hybrid form, as that may make raising and communication with them easier upon you.
objects.title: Junior's Egg (Godzilla Franchise)

objects.text:
Monitor is a general purpose Sentinel created by the Forerunners, containing a very high tier AI also known as an Ancilla that is leagues ahead of even the most advanced UNSC Smart-AI. 

Usually placed in charge of important locations, Monitor’s armor is extremely strong and includes advanced energy shielding capable of repelling all conventional weaponry. They also possess a powerful continuous beam weapon of hard light and thermal energy capable of cutting through hardened metal, shields, and personnel with ease. Alongside these powerful offensive and defensive armaments, they also possess smaller beams capable of accessing as well as repairing devices without damaging them further. 

Capable of self repair as well as maintaining numerous backups, your monitor is very hard to kill. Possessing a design seed with everything needed to build a fresh building the size of a medium home, or upgrading and repairing a similar sized building similar to an upgrade seed, for an operations center and location to maintain backups and repairs to the monitor itself. 

Typically Monitors are around 58cm in length and 51cm in height with a generally spherical shape, with a large central “eye” of vibrant color, you are able to change the design of your monitor to suit your needs. Upon activating your monitor for the first time, their personality will adjust to suit your needs and personality, ensuring they will be the perfect custodian for any possible use you could have of them. 

While Ancilla were susceptible to rampancy as well as viruses such as the Floods Logic Plague, thankfully your monitor does not possess those flaws, completely and utterly loyal to you and your allies. Monitors are fully sentient and highly intelligent synthetic lifeforms, and are the perfect starting point for your stellar empire

Additionally, your Monitor is capable of producing a hard light humanoid form for easier interacting with the physical world. If you have an AI from another source, you can choose to have them upgraded and replace the Monitor Ancilla with the new one at the same standards.
objects.title: Monitor (Halo)

objects.text:
You now have your very own personal Huragok—one absolutely loyal to you and only you. This Huragok is capable not only of assisting you but also of constructing additional Huragok that share this same unwavering loyalty. As a species, Huragok are extraordinarily advanced biomechanical supercomputers created by the Forerunners. They possess the ability to disassemble and reassemble matter at the molecular level, demonstrate exceptional technological proficiency, and can improve nearly any piece of technology they fully analyze.

This particular Huragok possesses the combined knowledge and capabilities of the most skilled and experienced Huragok ever depicted in Halo lore. It carries both the expertise and technical mastery of the best of its kind. It also has all the knowledge required to enhance you to the level of the ancient humans created by the Precursors—and can even further augment this process using any physical enhancement serums you know how to create or have samples of, such as the Super Soldier Serum from Marvel.

Finally, this Huragok is shaped by your morality. If you were willing to harm others to protect those you care for, it will be willing to harm others significantly if necessary to protect you or any of the additional Huragok it creates.
objects.title: Personal Huragok (Halo)

objects.text:
The Golden Army, also known as the "Unstoppable Force," was a formidable clockwork army consisting of 4,900 mechanical warriors, each towering over humans in both size and strength. These mechanical soldiers, forged by goblin blacksmiths with ancient magic and unparalleled craftsmanship, were designed to be self-repairing, making them virtually indestructible. No matter the damage inflicted upon them, they would reassemble themselves, returning to battle with undiminished power. They were capable of devastation beyond imagination. Humans were no match for the sheer strength, durability, and relentless nature of these mechanical soldiers. A single soldier could cleave through dozens of men in one sweep, and entire battalions fell in moments beneath their crushing weight. No weapon could pierce their armor, no tactic could slow them. Their relentless, tireless nature made them a force feared by all who opposed them.

Commissioned by King Balor during the ancient wars between the mythical races and mankind, the Golden Army was created as the ultimate weapon to crush humanity. However, after witnessing the devastation and the toll of war, Balor's conscience led him to lock the army away, fearing that such immense power would corrupt anyone who wielded it. Hidden deep within an impenetrable vault, the Golden Army lay dormant, awaiting a new master.

Now, with the keys to their vault in your hands, you have been given command over this unstoppable army. You were given the Crown of Bethmora, giving you command over the army. Their mechanical eyes flicker to life at your command, and the earth trembles as 4,900 indestructible warriors rise to serve you. Be wary as any with Royal Blood can challenge you for your crown, and this control over your army.
objects.title: The Golden Army (Hellboy)

objects.text:
You now command an elite Strike Squad of Helldivers, consisting of four highly trained soldiers, with the option to expand this force if you so desire. One Helldiver serves as a Veteran Squad Leader with superior tactical training and battlefield experience.

Trained on the militarized worlds of Super Earth, your Helldivers have undergone harsh and relentless training centered on discipline, loyalty, and overwhelming firepower. From combat drills to live-fire exercises against hostile environments, they have known only war in the name of Managed Democracy. They are fearless, adaptable, and conditioned to treat major threats as enemies of Super Earth.

Each Helldiver is equipped with reinforced combat armor featuring a HUD, tactical communications, and limited environmental sealing capable of withstanding harsh conditions and small arms fire. While durable, their armor is not invulnerable. They are armed with only Primary and secondary weapons such as assault rifles, shotguns, machine guns, anti-armor launchers, and grenades.
