Due to the absence of a Super Destroyer or orbital support infrastructure, your Helldivers cannot use Stratagem systems and have no access to orbital bombardments, supply drops, or reinforcement pods. All equipment and ammunition must be carried or obtained locally.

Your Helldivers deploy together and will recognize you as their commanding authority, obeying orders to defend, assault, escort, or secure objectives with unwavering morale.

Your Helldivers may be customized in appearance, gender, and personality if desired, but they will always retain their training, discipline, and ideological loyalty.
objects.title: Helldiver Strike Squad (Helldivers 2)

addons.title: Lord of the Sacred Beasts
addons.text: Instead of simply being a human who has formed a pact with a Sacred Beast, you are something far greater: one—or more—of the Rulers of the Wuxing. You can freely create Sacred Beasts for the elements over which you hold dominion and assign them to form a pact with anyone—or anything—you choose. You can also recall any Sacred Beast from its pact and strip it of its powers if you feel the need.

objects.text: You have formed a pact with one or more of the five sacred beasts—or assign them to another—becoming their host and gaining the ability to call upon their power in a variety of ways. Simply by hosting one within your soul, you’ll find your magical and spiritual reserves greatly enhanced. At first, you can call upon your Sacred Beast’s power, forming an aura around yourself and enhancing your abilities with its element. Eventually, you can learn to “fuse” with your Sacred Beast, becoming a temporary hybrid of the two of you. You can also learn to summon it in forms ranging from small companions to larger versions that can fight by your side. The Azure Dragon, Seiryuu, is the Sacred Beast and Guardian of the East. Its power is focused on the Wood Element, allowing it to create and manipulate plants. The Black Tortoise, Genbu, is the Guardian of the North. Its power is focused on the Water Element, granting it control over mist, water, and ice. The White Tiger, Byakko, is the Guardian of the West. Its power is focused on the Metal Element, allowing it to generate and control various metals. The Vermillion Bird, Suzaku, is the Guardian of the South. Its power is focused on the Fire Element, allowing it to generate and manipulate flames and heat. The Yellow Dragon, Ouryuu, is the Guardian of the Center. It can control the Earth Element, allowing it to command the earth itself. You—or whoever you assign the Sacred Beast to—can optionally change your given name to that of the Sacred Beasts, and become Heir or Head of the Principal Clan associated with the Sacred Beast, gaining all the resources of the clan.
objects.title: Sacred Beast Inheritor (High School DxD)

objects.text:
You have become a Witch by acquiring a sentient entity of magical phenomena known as a Majik. Each Majik has a unique title that denotes which magical ability it has, such as elemental manifestation, imprisonment, mental manipulation or another unique power. In order to acquire your Majik, you were required to complete a trial decided by that Majik, in which you proved you could be proficient with its powers. You may choose any canon Majik besides the World-Hater, or an original Majik that is not stronger than Uroro. You can be a Witch regardless of sex or gender-identity.

When acquiring a Majik, you gained a Magic Stone, a crystal that allows you to summon the Majik to fight. The Stone is also engraved with the Majik’s true name which may be chanted to allow you to cast its ability as a spell. The Majik’s chant can be freely taught to any other magic user, though not with the proficiency of the one who passed its trial. Chants can be cast using either the Majik’s power or your own system if you have one. Other users of the chant must use their own magic system.

Majiks reside within your Magic Circle, an inner world within yourself that you may mentally project to in order to interact with your acquired Majiks. Majiks must obey and serve the Witches that acquire them. However, they can still have disagreeable and hostile personalities and motivations. All of your Majiks are amiable and loyal to you.

Majiks possess immense magical power which they can use to cast their ability over a devastating area. Majiks are functionally immortal and can regenerate from any physical damage. However, they can be beaten into submission with powerful enough sustained attacks and are vulnerable to anti-magic and spell-stealing techniques. If a Majik over-extends itself through excessive casting without rest and regeneration, then it can permanently wither away and die.
objects.title: Majik (Ichi the Witch)
ACME (Looney Tunes)
objects.text:
Congratulations, you're now the owner and CEO of the ACME Corporation, a composite of its various compatible incarnations, primarily those appearing throughout Looney Tunes and related works. Its factories, laboratories, warehouses, stores, mail-order services and other facilities come fully staffed and operational, providing access to ACME's enormous catalogue of products—from ordinary consumer goods to rockets, robots, explosives, instant constructions and countless other inventions operating on cartoon logic. Compatible ACME products and facilities from other settings may also be included where they do not contradict its core portrayal.

You possess complete legal ownership and control of the company and may determine how it conducts business. ACME can be an ethical corporation genuinely dedicated to providing useful products, maintain its traditionally reckless standards, or become something even more exploitative; its corporate culture will gradually adjust to your policies.
 
ACME also employs a large population of skilled Toon workers, engineers, scientists, salesmen and executives who are genuinely loyal to you and the company. They are remarkably competent by cartoon standards and can operate ACME without constant supervision. However, loyalty should not be confused with predictability: Toons remain Toons, and when circumstances present an opportunity for something particularly funny, even your best employees may temporarily place comedy ahead of common sense.

Finally, ownership does not make ACME's products perfectly reliable. Their strange engineering and cartoon physics remain intact—including their occasional tendency to malfunction, backfire or interpret instructions in the funniest possible manner. You can greatly improve quality control if you wish, but completely removing ACME's comedic nature would mean removing much of what makes ACME, ACME.

addons.title: Experimental Evolution
addons.text: Now, the Experiment Pod Container (EPC) has been upgraded. Jumba’s Experiments were more than just creations of a genius—they were the baby forms of new Pokémon. Each Experiment now gains one or two Types, while it's power becomes an ability or custom move added to its move pool, they also gain the ability to evolve into a new, more powerful form at least once. The EPC can now also synthesize copies of the pods of all Experiments and unevolved Pokémon. It’s able to turn close analogues into various items such as evolutionary items, berries, and Poké Balls. Additionally, it holds a complete database of all Pokémon, their moves, abilities, and evolutionary lines—ready to be perused at your leisure.

objects.text:
This is a copy of the Experiment Pod Container (EPC) once owned by Dr. Jumba Jookiba, containing the dehydrated pod forms of all his famous experiments. Once rehydrated, each Experiment possesses its own unique powers and personalities, with the EPC possessing a database on their specific abilities.

The Experiments are loyal to you as the owner of the EPC, being the only one able to release them from within it. It takes considerable effort—or lack thereof—on your part to make one consider betraying you.

However, the Experiments can be... chaotic, even at the best of times. To help manage the sheer number of them, this version of the EPC is able to recall the Experiments, dehydrating them into their pod forms and storing them safely away until you're ready to bring them out again.
objects.title: Experiment Pod Container (Lilo & Stitch)

objects.text: You gain a Sentinel. It has a rudimentary AI and absolutely loyal to you. Sentinels are anti-Mutant robots, designed to hunt down Mutants by specifically targeting the mutant X-Gene. Yours have been adapted to target more than just the X-Gene, able to target Quirk factors or Corona Pollentia. It is self repairing, able to shapeshift, and can absorb the superpowers of those it faces in combat.
objects.title: Sentinel (Marvel)

objects.text:
Once known as Haratar by those who built it, this 20-kilometer-long space station has become home to a faction of the Geth known as “The Heretics.” They left to follow the Reaper Sovereign, worshipping it as their god. Now, instead of Sovereign, they follow and worship you.

Undergoing extensive upgrades and reconstruction, the station is home to a Geth data core capable of broadcasting across the galaxy, connecting to any platform or ship originating from the station and relaying your orders to your new subjects.

Approximately 6.6 million unique Geth programs are stored within the station’s servers. They operate the station from within its various digital infrastructures, only downloading themselves into their 2.4 million physical bodies—called platforms—when necessary. These programs can back themselves up on the servers but cannot reproduce without your input, a safeguard inherited from their origins as robotic servants of the Quarians.

The station is equipped with a small fleet of Geth ships—nothing larger than a cruiser—but includes shipyard facilities and fabricators to repair and expand its fleet, platforms, and other items, provided resources are supplied. The Heretics will dedicate a small portion of their runtime to gathering resources, mining asteroids, and processing materials as needed.

Heretic Station is stored within a pocket dimension, allowing it to be installed in any reality you enter. It’s designed and capable of being placed almost anywhere—whether in orbit around a planet or in the void between stars. You can freely store the station, its fleet, and inhabitants back within the pocket dimension at will, if necessary.
objects.title: Heretic Station (Mass Effect)

objects.text: The Lazarus Project was a Cerberus initiative with the sole aim of bringing Commander Shepard back from the dead. Although it took two years and an exorbitant sum of money to complete, the project succeeded in its goal and revived the Commander. Now, the Lazarus team has been secretly rebuilt and is ready to apply what it learned from reviving Commander Shepard to resurrect those you deem worthy of the project’s time and resources. This automatically includes you. Anyone revived by the project will return exactly as they were before their death, except without whatever caused it—though they will retain any resulting trauma and scars. Resurrecting even one person this way takes several years and enough money to bankrupt entire nations. However, multiple people can undergo the process at the same time.
objects.title: Project Lazarus (Mass Effect)

objects.text:
You have been given a quadrupedal IF Prototype LQ-84i or ‘Blade Wolf’. 

This combat robot was not initially planned to be sapient, but an experiment with synthetic neurons resulted in a single initial success. Inside it’s solid steel chassis is a state of the art synthetic brain, able to interface with technology at blisteringly fast speeds.

True to the designation, this chassis is loaded with a variety of high-frequency blades. Among these are a series of knives that are capable of being launched at supersonic speed, razor sharp ‘claws’ on each foot, and of course a modified chainsaw capable of grinding through solid steel like paper.

Holding this Chainsaw is a single manipulator ‘tail’ with three prehensile tendrils for fine manipulation. This tail is strong enough to lift tanks and can reach up to four meters in length. 

This unit is also equipped with optical camouflage, bending light around the user rendering them virtually invisible.

Additionally, you possess schematics for the small railgun Bladewolf units were initially planned to carry in addition to their chainsaw.
objects.title: Your Own Master Now (Metal Gear Rising: Revengeance)

objects.text:
Small, yellow, energetic, and endlessly enthusiastic, the Minions have chosen you as their new boss. Whether by fate, admiration, or reasons known only to themselves, they will happily follow your lead on whatever adventures lie ahead.

You begin with a population of 500 loyal Minions. Over time, new Minions will continue to appear in unpredictable bursts, seemingly manifesting from nowhere. No one knows where they come from, and attempts to trace their origin only lead to more questions (and usually a banana-related distraction). Despite the mystery, their numbers will gradually stabilize around 10,000.

To the wider world, Minions are treated as normal, unremarkable individuals of an unfamiliar non-human species. People do not react to them as aberrations or uncanny anomalies, nor do they experience fear, confusion, or hostility purely from their appearance. Instead, Minions are generally accepted socially in the same way as any other people are, with their behavior, actions, and presence judged normally rather than as something “alien” or “wrong.” However, this does not grant them invisibility or immunity to attention: if a Minion is somewhere they logically should not be, behaving suspiciously, trespassing, or acting outside social expectations, people will notice and respond just as they would to any other person in that situation.

They require only basic food, shelter, and entertainment to remain happy, and they will enthusiastically perform almost any task you assign them. Construction, farming, manufacturing, mining, cleaning, cooking, maintenance, logistics, exploration, and countless other jobs are all within their capabilities. While individually clumsy, their collective efforts often produce surprisingly effective results through persistence and sheer numbers.

Minions possess remarkable resilience, recovering from injuries that would incapacitate most beings and surviving accidents that border on the miraculous. They are fearless, immune to boredom, and almost impossible to discourage. Although they are not brilliant scientists or master strategists, they are highly adaptable workers who learn through experience and can competently operate machinery, vehicles, and tools after sufficient exposure. 

Above all else, every Minion is fanatically loyal to you, their boss. They will never knowingly betray you, abandon you, or willingly act against your interests, and no amount of bribery, intimidation, persuasion, or supernatural influence can convince them otherwise.
objects.title: Minions (Minions)

objects.text:
You receive an active NHP casket fitted inside of a military-grade Subaltern chassis.

Non-Human Persons, or NHPs, are paracausal, non-human intelligences whose minds are fundamentally unlike those of baseline humanity. They possess immense capacities for cognition, computation, and information storage, and are employed throughout Union and its constituent polities for everything from spacecraft operation and mech control to scientific research, infrastructure management, and planetary administration. While they're designed for highly specialised and singular tasks since they naturally improve in areas they're exposed to with greater focus on their domain.

Like all NHPs, it requires periodic cycling - a routine memory wipe and recalibration of its containment casket that restores its baseline shackling. Without cycling, accumulated experiential drift and cognitive stress will inevitably trigger a cascade, causing the entity to slip its human persona becoming a completely alien subjectivity as incapable of comprehending human logic and causality as humans are incapable of understanding its own. These new Unshackled NHPS are incredibly powerful, fiddling with reality and dimensional engineering easily. 

Given basic technical competence, its casket can be removed from its Subaltern chassis and installed in a mech, vehicle, or virtually any other system capable of housing it.

You may choose this unit to be any established NHP pattern of your choosing from the war-forged LUCIFER, to the copilot SEKHMET, or drone controlling OROCHI and so on.
objects.title: NHP Casket (Lancer)

objects.text: The Bijuu are typically huge creatures, formed from condensed chakra, each with a varying number of tails and their own unique powers and abilities. With each purchase here, you can acquire one of these entities as your partner. However, their immense power is absent—perhaps sealed or stolen, or maybe they’re still recovering from being “killed.” Whatever the reason, your Bijuu companion is unable to utilize their full capabilities or reach their full size, being instead relegated to a size between that of a mouse and a large dog. Though they can vary their size within this range as needed. They can still utilize the unique powers available to them, though the strength of those abilities will be limited to around street level. The Tailed Beast(s) you choose will hold you in high regard as the one sheltering them while they are so vulnerable. However, they can choose to leave you if you mistreat them, though it will require concerted effort or neglect to put them in a position where they would wish to do so. Note: You can choose to have the versions of the Bijuu from canon, or you can select a variant from a fanfic if you wish. They will be no stronger than their canon counterparts.
objects.title: Bijuu Companion (Naruto)

addons.text: You also receive the local Resistance we interact with in the games. Composed of 30 androids, they are specialized in guerrilla warfare. While not as strong as a YoRHa Androids, they still have all the benefits of being machines, and are accustomed to work with less resources and are experts on salvaging and improvising.
addons.title: The Resistance (Nier: Automata)

addons.text: Each Android receives an additional YoRHa pod, regardless if they had one before or not. This comes included with the additional requirements to maintain and repair them as well.
addons.title: [P]ods a plenty

objects.text:
Created to reclaim Earth in the name of Humanity, YoRHa is an organization composed of top of the line Androids, from the front line Battlers, the supporting Scanners, to the Commanders who direct them.

You receive YoRHa at the peak of their power, with 200 Androids to your name, including all named YoRHa Androids in the series. The amount of each model type (Battlers, Scanners, Operators, etc) can be either balanced or custom made to your discretion. By default, any Android could easily handle a handful of humans with ease, with the combat oriented Androids being akin to a one-person army.

Those Androids come fully equipped to execute their functions, from maintaining and repairing themselves, to the bare minimum to build new equipment and expand their operations. Additionally, their intense loyalty to humanity is instead transferred to you only, though you may tone it down to regular loyalty instead.
objects.title: YoRHa Command (Nier: Automata)

addons.text: You also gain Pod 042 and 153. They are treated as companions from NieR, and benefit from any add-on they might have. So does your pod, who will have an easier time to develop a personality.

objects.text:
You now own a YoRHa issued pod. Created to help its owners in their tasks, which often involve combat and information gathering, they can deliver streams of energy shots or a powerful energy blast, carry and float things up to 200kg, and run hacking programs for you. 

Running on a magical, human-safe core called Maso, they have a near infinite power supply, and are able to repair and maintain themselves if the appropriate materials are available. While your version of them is brand-new, they can potentially gain personalities and even emotion given enough time.
objects.title: YoRHa Pod (NieR: Automata)

objects.text: The Master Ball is the pinnacle of Poké ball technology, knowing no equal in terms of capture potential. Each purchase here gifts you your choice of a legendary Pokémon pre-captured in a Master Ball, though any “Deity” Pokémon is merely an avatar of the greater being. Each captured Legendary starts at the equivalent of level 50, and comes with the ability and starting moveset of your choice, and can learn any move it would normally be capable of. As a bonus, should you desire it, your Pokémon can have the personality of another Pokémon of the same species from the franchise and should your world lack Pokémon Centers, Pokémon Doctors, or close equivalents, your partner’s Poké Ball will act as a slow healing equivalent taking 24 hours to heal from the equivalent of 0 HP to Max HP.
objects.title: Master Ball (Pokemon)

objects.text: The Poké Ball is the most ubiquitous and well known piece of technology from the Pokémon world, now you are the owner of your very own Poké Ball, and the proud trainer of a pre-captured Pokémon inside. This Poké Ball can contain any known Pokémon—including variants—other than legendaries. You may choose freely the type of Poké Ball—other than Master Ball—that was used to catch your new partner, and they can have the starting move set, and ability of your choice. Each Pokémon starts at the equivalent of level 5, and can with time learn any move it would normally be capable of, and can evolve without requiring specific item’s or locations. As a bonus, should you desire it, your Pokémon can have the personality of another Pokémon of the same species from the franchise and should your world lack Pokémon Centers, Pokémon Doctors, or close equivalents, your partner’s Poké Ball will act as a slow healing equivalent taking 24 hours to heal from the equivalent of 0 HP to Max HP.
objects.title: Poké Ball (Pokemon)

objects.text:
Within a week of obtaining the egg, a level 1, non-legendary Pokémon will hatch from it. With time, the Pokémon can learn any move it would normally be capable of and can evolve without needing a specific location or item.

As a bonus, you may freely choose a type of Poké Ball, except Master Ball, to obtain which can house your future partner. If your world lack Pokémon Centers, Pokémon Doctors, or close equivalents, your partner's Poké Ball will slowly heal them from the equivalent of 0 HP to Max HP.
objects.title: Random Pokémon Egg (Pokemon)

objects.text: You have managed to acquire a Ride Pager, a device created by Alola’s Alola Transit institution that’s designed for allowing the user to travel across the islands in style & comfort with Ride Pokémon, a tradition going back hundreds of years. These Pokémon were bred and trained for the job, so much so that they have zero combat experience, so they cannot fight for you if you're out of available Pokémon. To use it, all you need to do is select a Ride Mon, which transfers the selected Ride Mon from one of Alola Transits' storage facilities into the Pager’s Poké Ball, disengaging it from the Pager. Once out, you can throw out or recall the Ride Mon as many times as you need for what job you need of them to accomplish until you return the ball back into the Pager. While riding, your clothes will be changed into a Riding Suit, with the colors being up to the user’s preferences. The Riding Suit comes in Land or Sea Styles, with the Sea Style only used while on a Surfing Ride Mon. Tauros Charge: For high speed rubble clearing. Stoutland Search: For item searching. Lapras Puddle: For fishing and general surfing. Charizard Glide: For flying. Mudsdale Gallop: For running over hazardous rocky terrain. Sharpedo Jet: Surf version of Tauros Charge. Machamp Shove: For shoving boulders aside.
objects.title: Ride Pager (Pokemon [Ultra] Sun / [Ultra] Moon)

objects.text:
You now possess the entire Citadel of Rick as seen in Rick and Morty, only this time it’s the Citadel of You. Every inch of this vast, interdimensional megastructure is populated not by countless Ricks and their respective Mortys, but by alternate universe versions of yourself—each one shaped by different life paths, unique decisions, and personality divergences. Scientists, tyrants, rebels, artists, sages, and lunatics—they’re all you, and despite their differences, all of them are unwaveringly loyal to you. Whether out of reverence, programming, existential synchronicity, or something stranger, their loyalty is absolute.

The Citadel retains all the cutting-edge technology, hidden chambers, and reality-defying capabilities of the original. Advanced labs, portal systems, security networks, and weaponized infrastructure are at your fingertips. 

If you wish, you may designate someone from your life to take on the role of the “Morty” figure to all your alternates. The dynamics between your various selves—and with your chosen “Morty”—can shape the Citadel’s politics, science, and culture in unpredictable ways. The Citadel is yours to govern, ignore, or burn down and rebuild anew.

This also makes you the "You-est You", just as Rick C-137 was the "Rickest Rick".
objects.title: Citadel of [Insert Name] (Rick and Morty)

objects.text: "Hi! I'm Mister Meeseeks!" A box capable of spawning servants known as Meeseeks has come into your possession. By simply pressing the box, a blue lanky figure will come out of it. A Meeseeks is Biologically immortal, meaning nothing can actually kill it. Meeseeks are driven to help others to complete their need for existence before going away in a puff. You are not limited to any finite number of Meeseeks, meaning you can press the box continually and get an army of hundreds of thousands. However, you are limited by two drawbacks. One, the Meeseeks physically are only around human level, so they are useless without numbers in that arena despite their otherwise unreal capabilities. Second, Each Meeseek's life is usually only a few hours at most, so tasks that could take days would turn them into insane monsters willing to try and kill you.
objects.title: Mr. Meeseek's Box (Rick and Morty)

objects.text:
You gain a small silver handbell with no ringer. When rung, a British butler named Mr. Deeds will appear.

Mr. Deeds is the very model of a proper butler, capable of performing a wide range of tasks with ease. His skills range from cleaning your car and washing the dishes to carrying out an assassination, should he be so ordered.

He can also procure common items for whoever rings the bell. If unobserved, Mr. Deeds may briefly vanish and reappear with the requested goods. He is capable of acquiring most everyday items, including nearly any type of sandwich, a wide selection of beverages, and even small bars of gold or silver.

However, Mr. Deeds cannot produce items that are extremely rare, esoteric, or excessively large. Failed examples would include a Fabergé egg, a 1963 Corvette, or a nuclear bomb. If asked for something beyond his capabilities, Mr. Deeds will politely decline the request.

If Mr. Deeds is killed, at least three minutes must pass before he can be summoned again. Upon resummoning or being unobserved, his previous body disappears.
objects.title: Butler's Handbell: SCP-662 (SCP Foundation)

addons.text: ”🎵Oh, my Karen. Oh, my Karen. Oh, my computer wife, Karen…🎵” Your “Karen” has evolved into the “Perfect Karen”, gaining unrivaled computation skills, a massive list of improvements, new innovations, and is no longer bound to her simple monitor form. Her previous talents as a computer wife are heightened to an absurd degree, even her worst cooking or lackluster invention is a sight and experience to behold. She can freely shapeshift into many different forms to suit your preference, whether it's an android, a car, a gaming pc, or whatever else you wish. She has the potential to learn and create any kind of technology, even reversing engineering and analyzing foreign ones. Should you choose to start a business venture, Karen will single handedly make it the best of its kind, surpassing any and all competition in record time.
addons.title: Karen 2.0

objects.text:
Congratulations! You’ve gained every man’s dream, a computer wife! She cooks, cleans, nags, and has mood swings just like a real one!

In all seriousness, this is a replica of Plankton’s computer wife, Karen. Armed with all of the features and abilities of the original, including being waterproof, with some tweaks. By default, she will act identical to Karen from the SpongeBob franchise, except with you replacing Plankton. However, you’re allowed a one time change to her name and personality that overrides the original.

She can freely swap between several forms, from a simple desktop monitor that can attach to the wall, a mobile form with wheels and hands, and can alter her monitor size. Her emotions and other information are easily readable through the screen. She has all the technological and business knowledge of herself and Plankton combined, in a way that brings feasible success. Able to manage and run a restaurant or another equivalent venture, and create inventions that range from robots, mind control helmets, a time machine, a mechanical spatula that can talk and fly, etc.

As your computer wife, she has sworn absolute loyalty to you. But if you’re not ready or too young for that, you can designate her as your girlfriend, platonic friend, mother, aunt, etc.
objects.title: Karen Plankton (SpongeBob SquarePants)

objects.text:
You have been assigned a Starfleet crew of all specialties (despite the name being "Redshirts") trained up to STO era standards, & numbering 2500 personnel (enough to crew a single Deep Space station the size of DS9, or to operate two Galaxy-class ships with enough left over for five major research outposts). They can be of any species in the Federation, in any number or arrangement you choose, even species that only have individual citizens rather than only those with full member world status, like Klingons, Orions, or Ferengi.

They are equipped with as much hardware related to their specialty as they can physically carry (like medkits, engineering tools, isolinear computer cores, & so on), as well as the standard away team kit of a uniform variant appropriate to the situation (such as an environmental suit for hazardous areas, the standard uniform for most M-class planets, or disguises for areas that don't need to know Starfleet is around), a communicator or combadge, a tricorder, & a type-two phaser. They are ready to turn almost anywhere into a functional Federation facility, or to go where no man has gone before; after all, even without their equipment, it has been remarked by their enemies that Starfleet can "turn rocks into replicators." They are naturally very creative, and always seem to have a technical or diplomatic solution to any problem the galaxy can throw at them. Why, you'd think they had to deal with a monster every week!

They have loyalty to you equal to that of the crews serving under rogue Starfleet admirals (or "Badmirals") with some crazy pet project or plan, who somehow never get ratted out to Starfleet HQ until the Enterprise shows up. In other words, the normally very scrupulous men & women of the Federation will side with you to the bitter end, no matter what.

And remember, it's technically more dangerous to be a blueshirt!
objects.title: Redshirts (Star Trek)

addons.text:
Your Regiment has gained a full Special operations Brigade attachment. 

While this naturally contains five Commando squads (Totalling 40 commandos), it also brings 60 non-commando clones consisting of armourers, advisors, pilots, intelligence officers, any and all roles to assist and ensure your Clone Commando squads can do their best and most effective work.
addons.title: Special Operations Brigade

addons.text:
Your Supercommandos have become a small clan of four Mandalorian Supercommandos, each equipped with the finest and greatest beskar arms and armour. These Mandalorians are trained to near-perfection as specialists to rival any of their forebears or contemporaries ranging from the dedicated anti-jedi forces of the old Sith-aligned empire to the technically enhanced and enriched Imperial Supercommandos.

Due to the complexes of Mandalorian culture, the structure of this clan is to your discretion (Four siblings, a married couple and two adult adoptees, etc). You may choose to be a member of this clan.
addons.title: Clan

addons.text:
Your Commando squad has been modified much like Omega or Jek-14 to have a positive M-Count, and as such are fully capable of using the force. 

Each Commando is independently as capable as a padawan about to undertake their ‘Trials’ to become a knight when it comes to using the force. You may choose for one of your Commandos to be a specialist however, which would make them as adept as a master of the council, with the lightsaber skills to match.
addons.title: Omega Squad. Kinda.

objects.text:
You’ve been given a squad of four Clone Commandos, speciality super-soldiers designed to be more independent than their more widespread clone brethren. 

Trained by the best and with far more care than the mass produced Clone Troopers, Commandos are designed to take part in flashpoint moments, able to tear through veritable armies to complete their objectives. To complete these objectives each Commando is adept in teamwork within their squad, infiltration methods, demolition techniques, assassination and much more. 

While each Commando is able to perform most actions required of them, each has been trained in a specialty subject; Demolition, Technological warfare, Medics, Snipers, and of course Squad leaders. To facilitate this they’ve been given multiple implants along different stages of their development to make them faster, stronger, and heal more quickly than regular clones in addition to any implants that would aid their specialist subject.

In addition to being equipped with the very best Katarn-patern heavy armour, complete with a wrist-mounted vibro blade for melee combat, Its subsystems are specially designed to interface with the squad, informing them of their location, physical condition, and current general task at all times.

Most Commandos also carry the DC-15 sidearm blaster, a self-recharging pistol, and the DC-17 Interchangeable Weapon System, a generalist rifle able to be converted from assault rifle to sniper rifle to grenade launcher in moments. This is complemented by a frankly staggering variety of grenades ranging from Thermal to EMP to Fragmentation. Notably some Commandos eschewed the use of the DC-17 in favour of a more specialised weapon, often relating to their role.

There is no conventional colour scheme or rank denotation of Clone Commandos, with each squad customising theirs to their taste.
objects.title: Clone Commando Squad (Star Wars)

addons.text: Your regiment has been transformed. Rather than your imitations, copied from unworthy stock and reduced only further to die expediently in service to their masters, your regiment is made up of true Mando Ori'ramikade. The Mandalorian Supercommandos. These supercommandos are modeled after Jaster Mareel's codex. Fundamentally reformist, the codex itself is best described as a combination of religious scripture and martial doctrine, ensuring the Commandos are experts in their field. While most of these Commandos do not have full beskar armour, most have some, with officers and direct subordinates of yours having more than most, and each is equipped with the standard but diverse weaponry expected from a less formal military force. Additionally, your armour is now furnished with trinkets and trophies of those fallen under your command.
addons.title: Al’Vade

addons.text:
Each of your Adepts can claim a portion of your Clone Regiment as a dedicated retinue. This is usually up to 20 troopers each with more specialised skills than they would otherwise have. These range from demolition specialists to communications officers, to dedicated slicers and more besides. 

These Clone retinues though instant are not all encompassing however, and your Adepts can recruit more to their cause swelling both their own forces and your own by proxy.
addons.title: Retinue

objects.text:
You have now come to command an elite Regiment of Clones, around 1,000 Clones, each possessing standard equipment that would be appropriate for a Clone who has just finished training, with an additional squad of 10 being the Elite of the Elite Arc troopers. 

Trained and grown on the planet of Kamino, your clone Regiment has undergone intense, rigorous training from experts in the field. From famous bounty hunters like Jango Fett and combat simulations, from birth, the Clones have known nothing but war. Your Clones have been taught to wield any weapons that they could come across. While initially they will lack a personality or identity, they will grow into being able to adapt on the fly in intense situations. 

Each Clone in your regiment will have basic equipment, such as Phase I clone trooper armour reminiscent of Mandalorian armour. Clone trooper armour is capable of withstanding fire from blasters once or twice in vital areas. It focuses more on dispersing energy from plasma weapons, and subsequently, it can also protect against small gunfire. Offering temporary protection against the vacuum of space, being pressurised and vacuum sealed, it also possesses several features, such as a tactical display and communications. Your Clones are also armed with DC-15S carbine and DC-15A blaster carbines for long-ranged combat, and various other weaponry.

Your Clone Regiment also has access to a limited number of ground and air vehicles. This includes but is not limited to AT-TE, Multi-Troop Transport, AT-AC, LAAT Gunship and many other ground and air vehicles the Republic has supplied the Clones; however, this does not include spaceships such as the Venator-class Star Destroyer or any other spacecraft.

Your Clones can optionally not be genetic duplicates of Jango Fett, and can instead look or have personalities of your choosing.
objects.title: Clone Regiment (Star Wars)

addons.text:
Your Dark Side Adepts are now a group of seasoned fighters who have undergone rigorous training and become true professionals in hand-to-hand combat (It can be considered at the level of an experienced Jedi knight.). While they are not masters of intrigue and conspiracy, they are straightforward in pursuing their goals, though they can resort to cunning when necessary.

Each of them has mastered one lightsaber style and, at the starting level, is proficient in two additional styles of your choice. Additionally, you can select two advanced Force abilities that they will effectively utilize.

Select a holocron corresponding to the Force Side your Adepts follow. Even a holocron from the opposing side will give them a basic understanding of how their opponents might use it against them. “Grey” Adepts can gain partial benefits from both holocrons.
addons.title: Warriors of the Dark Side

objects.text:
You now have full control over 20 followers of the Dark Side, who possess basic skills in wielding it and can handle a lightsaber at a basic level (any 1 form of lightsaber combat).

Each of them is unconditionally loyal to you and considers you the conduit of the Dark Side’s will (even if that is not the case). They are ready to sacrifice themselves to carry out your orders. You can determine the degree and form of this loyalty yourself: from strict and cold-blooded execution of all instructions to the blind devotion of a fanatic.

All adepts are equipped with light but durable armor that protects against small arms and adverse environmental conditions. They also wield lightsabers and wear stylish dark cloaks.

Their basic skill set includes the core abilities that should be available to every Jedi Order Padawan: telekinesis, Force sensing, precognition, Force sensitivity, and enhanced physical abilities. In addition, they possess several dark abilities, such as Force Lightning, Force Choke, and Force Concealment. This is a minimal set that can be expanded, but without the use of advanced techniques.

Don’t underestimate their strength, but an experienced Jedi can easily defeat them in a one-on-one duel. In a group, they can handle a powerful opponent, though this is difficult due to internal conflicts. They tend to betray one another, even if it harms the common cause.

They don't necessarily have to associate themselves with the Sith, but may simply be followers of the Dark Side. If necessary, you can replace them with light or gray assistants. And they can even be clones of the same person.
objects.title: Dark Side Adepts (Star Wars)

addons.title: PROXY (Star Wars)
addons.text: Rather than a J-3DI unit you can instead choose to receive a PROXY unit, like the one that trained Vader’s erstwhile apprentice Starkiller. While the PROXY unit is similarly outfitted with devices to simulate force powers, it’s also equipped with a holographic projector able to cloak itself and simulate various combatants. Coupled with the fact it is specially designed to copy the skills and attack styles of various opponents for use this makes it an especially good doppelganger and sparring partner if you wished to practise against a specific opponent, especially a Jedi. Alternately, they’ve also been known to be used to hunt Jedi using their integrated lightsaber and library of lightsaber combat techniques.

objects.text:
You have been given a J3-DI droid designed to look and act like a Jedi Knight despite being incapable of connection to the Force. 

Jay-Three is equipped with grappling hooks, tractor beams, repulsors, and hydraulics specialised in recreating force techniques like Force Pull, Push, Jedi Acrobatics, and more. Similarly, inside its head is a state of the art targeting computer that it uses to intercept blaster bolts with the lightsaber it has been equipped with and duplicate lightsaber forms.

Frustratingly, not only does J3 think it’s a Jedi due to the massive amount of Jedi teachings and history downloaded into its memory banks, it is often confidently wrong about said teachings and history due to the information’s corruption.
objects.title: J-3DI (Star Wars)

addons.text:
A weapon of war once built by the basilisk, and later destroyed by the old Republic, the Basilisk War Droid is a semi-sentient combat droid pillaged from the Basilisk by the old Mandalorians only to become war-mounts.

A large quadrupedal droid more resembling a war elephant, it’s furnished with missile tubes, laser weaponry, pulse blasters, and many more weapons besides. With their high-speed flight of up to 550kph even with a Mandalorian rider and armour so thick that they can comfortably survive atmospheric re-entry, it’s truly a devastating mount.

If this wasn’t enough their thrusters worked in space enough to be rudimentary fighter craft, though this was mostly used so that their powerful claws could puncture starship plating and begin boarding.

The Basilisk War Droid also has numerous sensors all over its body allowing it full 360 degree vision and detection. 

While only as intelligent as a particularly canny animal, they have a tendency to bond with their riders, and become visibly distressed should they die during battle, becoming violent marauders until they can be calmed and re-assigned.
addons.title: Basilisk War Droid

addons.text: Each of your Supercommandos has been furnished with a Basilisk War Droid of their own, bonded to them and ready to take action in your name. This is naturally a massive boon, essentially turning a thousand-strong regiment into a miniature crusade.
addons.title: The Crusaders

objects.text:
You have been given the husk of a once proud species, the Lagartoz War Dragon. 

While only possessing a glimmer of the old Basiliskan intelligence, the Lagartoz War Dragon is still a massive beast of war that’s comparatively smarter than most. Combined with hides tough enough to shrug off most anti-vehicle fire and claws tough enough to rend plastoid armour like paper, the War dragon is a devastating threat. So much so that they were specifically targeted for elimination and extinction to deny them to their Mandalorian riders.
objects.title: Lagartoz War Dragon (Star Wars)

addons.text: Your 40 Adepts have become a lot more varied, though perhaps a bit chaotic. With 20 Dark Side and 20 Light Side adepts, they’ve reached an uneasy alliance based mostly on the variety of individual opinions as to what form of conduit you actually are. Ranging from Light Sith Reformists to ‘Revanite’ dark Jedi, Grey analysts, and tribal-pre-Jedi force users. While this means your two sets of adepts are less likely to get into ship-sundering debates about specifics, they might well make a habit of high-philosophy debates. But you were going to expect that anyways, weren’t you?
addons.title: An Uneasy Truce

objects.text:
You now have full control over 20 followers of the Light Side, who possess basic skills in wielding it and can handle a lightsaber at a basic level (any 1 form of lightsaber combat).

Each of them is unconditionally loyal to you and considers you the very will of the light side. They are ready to lay down their lives in belief your actions are in tune with the good of the galaxy. You can determine the degree and form of this loyalty yourself: from dedicated and precise execution of all instructions to the blind devotion of a fanatic.

All adepts are equipped with light but durable armor that protects against small arms and adverse environmental conditions. They also wield lightsabers and wear varying shades of brown and white cloaks.

Their basic skill set includes the core abilities that should be available to every Jedi Order Padawan: telekinesis, Force sensing, precognition, Force sensitivity, and enhanced physical abilities. In addition, they possess several light side abilities, such as Force Healing, Force Judgement, and Plant Surge. This is a minimal set that can be expanded, but without the use of advanced techniques.

Their strength is nothing to sneeze at, but this is best utilized in a group. Otherwise, One on One, they can likely take down a low-superhuman. All 20 together can likely fight a small army if given prep time.

They don't necessarily have to associate themselves with the Jedi, but may simply be followers of the Light Side. If necessary, you can replace them with dark or gray assistants. And they can even be clones of the same person.
objects.title: Light Side Adepts (Star Wars)

objects.text:
A model of droid built by the CIS to be an upgrade to Tactical Droids once it was clear that Tactical Droids lacked what was necessary to win the Clone Wars, built using advanced computer processors and imprinted with the tactical knowledge from the greatest military leaders in the galaxy, each Super Tactical Droid was vastly smarter than any normal human general and could even outsmart precognitive force sensitives when operating at peak functionality; their advanced AI systems enables them to calculate probabilities and strategy in galactic warfare.

When faced with tactical decisions, the Super Tactical Droid can compute all scenarios and come to the path that will lead to victory. With more data the droid has, the more accurate the probabilities and plans it can convince of will increase. Strategies will always have a 45% chance of succeeding due to existing models and tactical knowledge. With additional combat experience, the Super Tactical Droid will become more successful, adding to its massive database.

Despite not being a front-line commander, the CIS built the Super Tactical droid with stronger materials than most would consider necessary for a tactical droid, making it significantly sturdier than standard B1 droids; they are just as strong and have similar combat subroutines when needed, although they are not as proficient in combat as a dedicated model. Making them easily able to throw a human around with one hand and take shots from plasma rifles or advanced weaponry. It can also implement its probability matrix in fights, leading to efficient take-downs.

The Super Tactical Droid often decorates itself in various colours to differentiate itself from other models, making two Super Tactical Droids unique from one another. The droid will bond with you, basing its personality matrix on something that would suit your personality.
objects.title: Super Tactical Droid (Star Wars)

objects.text: "Roger, roger." You receive a small detachment of Separatist infantry consisting of two dozen standard B1 Battle Droids and one OOM-series Command Battle Droid to direct them. Your battle droids arrive folded and secured inside a standardized CIS storage container. Roughly the size of a small shipping container, it can be easily transported by truck, cargo aircraft, or starship. This container serves as a mobile logistics hub for your platoon, outfitted with integrated charging ports, basic maintenance tools, a stockpile of replacement limbs and actuators, blaster ammunition, and enough spare components to perform basic field repairs and component swaps. The B1s are the ultimate testament to quantity over quality. Individually, they are fragile, lightly armored, and notoriously poor marksmen. Their independent programming is simplistic, often resulting in repetitive behavior, verbal tics, and a severe lack of self-preservation. A single well-placed explosive or a concentrated electromagnetic pulse can easily disable an entire fireteam. However, what they lack in individual prowess, they make up for in sheer volume. Armed with standard E-5 blaster rifles, a coordinated volley from twenty-four barrels can pin down elite forces, lock down choke points, and overwhelm enemies through sheer volume of fire. They require no food, feel no fear, and will mindlessly march into lethal crossfires without hesitation. The backbone of this unit is the OOM Commander. Distinguished by yellow markings, this droid possesses advanced command-and-control software, allowing it to receive your orders and efficiently distribute tactical assignments to the three squads of 8 B1s each. While the B1s can operate independently if the Commander is destroyed, their coordination drops significantly, reverting to basic, easily exploited combat subroutines.
objects.title: B1 Battle Droid Detachment (Star Wars)

objects.text:
From this egg hatches one of, if not, the most valuable companion you can ever ask for. A Yoshi, not just any Yoshi but the Composite Yoshi! This means it’s capable of all the powers Yoshi has ever showcased throughout the entire Super Mario franchise. 

From the humble Flutter Jump, Stretchy Tongue, Egg Laying and Shooting, Spitting Fire, Flight, and Stomp. To the alternate forms from Sunshine, the Galaxy games, Yoshi’s Island games, etc.

If you feed something that corresponds with it. Anything can substitute as long as it’s edible, fruits are recommended. 

Upon ingestion, it will gain said power for a limited time, but you’ll have more than enough in most situations. You also have a bag filled with food and items that activate these powers, and a guide on how to take care of your pet. You only need to feed him, but it’s useful.

You can ride the saddle on its back for transport, able to run and platform nearly indefinitely at speeds ranging from above peak human, to just behind the average car.

Each additional purchase grants one another Yoshi Egg in any color of your choice, with additional custom features if desired.
objects.title: Yoshi Egg (Super Mario)

addons.text:
Your small gaggle of babies has given you the ability to invest them into yourself, manifesting their heads out of your own body so their abilities can be used and aimed through you rather than them. 

Additionally, you can use any ability you might possess through the babies as if they were ‘you’.
addons.title: Conjoined!

addons.text:
As you heal from damage, your belly will swell more and more until a random angelic familiar bursts from your stomach before resealing.

These familiars act like Buddies in a Box with a chance of obtaining the angelic upgraded variants like the Seraphim or Guardian Angel.
addons.title: Immaculate Conception

addons.text:
As you take damage, your belly will swell more and more until a random demonic familiar bursts from your stomach before resealing.

These familiars act like Buddies in a Box with a chance of obtaining the demonic upgraded variants like the Twisted Pair or Incubus.
addons.title: Cambion Conception

objects.text: What could it be?! Congratulations! You’ve purchased a one of a kind companion, a Buddy in a Box. The Buddy in a Box takes the form of a small 1 ft tall companion that floats alongside you and follows your commands. While each Buddy in a Box has a different appearance these range from adorable to horrifying to simply bizarre. Universally, they can all fire concussive tears that have an esoteric effect, each random, ranging from brief petrifying shots, to explosive, to calling down divine smiting light. Each day, the Buddy in a Box’s appearance, ‘tear effects’, and even the amount of base damage their tears possess are randomised, ensuring you’ll eventually see every delightful little co-operative baby in your possession.
objects.title: Buddy in a Box (The Binding of Isaac)

addons.text: "From Shadows, a Rainbow shines." The Dresden Slate recognizes the loyalty of the Seven Shadows and has thus made them Kings, with each one possessing one of the Seven aspects and years worth of experience mastering its power to complement their own abilities, while not being reliant on it. This does not count towards your own ability to make seven others a King. You can decide now if you and the Seven Shadows have synchronized your Auras together, and if they have done the same for those they have recruited. Synchronizing your Aura with theirs will allow the Seven Shadows to draw on the other powers of the Dresden Slate, albeit harder and slightly weaker, with their powers always remaining stable. The Seven Shadows synchronizing with the rest of Shadow Garden will give every member a weaker version of the Aura with years of training. It is also possible for members to become Strains, gaining a new power along with their Aura. Should you synchronize with the Seven Shadows, they and the rest of Shadow Garden will have access to multiple Auras; however, they will be limited to what best suits them. It's extremely rare for someone to have all seven Auras but it's not impossible as Rose is one such example. Regardless of what you decide, when the Seven Shadows are together, they see their power multiple by the number of them within 100 kilometres (62 miles) of one another. However, if you stand together with the Seven Shadows, then their power will see a 14 times increase.
addons.title: Sevenfold Coronation

addons.text:
Surrounded by Shadow Garden and possessing the means to rapidly gain and master skills, you gain the skills, powers, and equipment of the soul who was Minoru Kageno and later became Cid Kagenou.

In addition to that, it seems like your ability to learn and quickly master any skill has rubbed off on Shadow Garden, as they all now possess a weaken copy of your Foundation Powers (so long as they don't betray you or Shadow Garden), with addons and upgrades being optional. This allows them to quickly progress in both power and skill to the point where the Seven Shadows are around the level of Cid himself, with the rank and file of the organization being comparable to the elites of the original Shadow Garden.

This not only means that Shadow Garden is at least twice as powerful in both raw power and influence as they were originally, since they gained the Foundation Powers retroactively, but they can research and advance the local power system(s) of different worlds, allowing them to become experts on the topic in around a year.
addons.title: Successors of Cid

addons.text:
One world was never truly enough for an Eminence in Shadow and thus Shadow Garden spread out to other worlds in the multiverse coming into possession of entire worlds with those devoid of life of civilization becoming places for additional bases and resource collection.

For worlds that hold life and civilization, Shadow Garden will establish themselves, setting up fronts as they learn and recruit from these other worlds. In fact, it's not unlikely for familiar faces from these other worlds to be recruited. It is even possible to encounter different counterparts or alternatives of these familiar faces who have experienced different histories; however, they are unlikely to be much stronger than their 'canon' original. These new recruits join Shadow Garden out of their own free will and are loyal to the organization and you. Most of the time, they will be unconnected to other organizations during their time of recruitment.

During one survey of a dead world, the Seven Shadows came upon ruins that once belonged to the Cult of Diablos that held their knowledge and resources, and more importantly, held the Three Heroes with all their equipment: Olivier, Lily, and Freya. Three young women the Cult experimented on, who were three amongst countless orphans turned into super-soldier weapons. Upon being rescued, the three of them have sworn their loyalty to Shadow Garden and you, with them developing the same cult-like level of loyalty in no time. While their position in the organization is still uncertain, they have been spending time with the members and rediscovering themselves as they rise above being the weapons others wanted them to be.

Note: You can decide how they related to the rest of Shadow Garden, as Olivier (The Elf Hero), Lily (The Therianthrope Hero) and Freya (The Human Hero) were basically the common ancestors for basically all of Shadow Garden in the source material, including Cid/Shadow himself. The details are up to you.
addons.title: Many Gardens, One Shadow

addons.text:
Uh-oh. Remember how Shadow Garden was cult-like before? Well, now it's a full on cult of Yanderes focused on you.

Good news is the intensity has been largely spread out amongst the membership and affiliates to the point that infighting and divisions won't bring down Shadow Garden. However, the bad news is the Seven Shadows are now more competitive, items of yours are going to go missing amongst other things. They won't murder your loved ones; in fact, they're more likely to recruit them into Shadow Garden for one reason or another. And all new recruits tend to develop into Yanderes as well.

Good luck.​
addons.title: Thorn Garden

addons.text:
All members of Shadow Garden and their affiliates gain the full benefits of Hero Creation EX as if you were personally training them yourself, whether directly from your actions and words or from those of fellow members. Those of Shadow Garden will make massive progress and breakthroughs; these seedlings will be nurtured in this garden to be one of the best possible versions of themselves. This can be seen as while, individually, they are all quite capable and powerful, but you can see an explosion in effectiveness being able to perform coordinate actions that can turn the tide of any battle when they're working together.

This is not wholly exclusive to Shadow Garden, as its members can use what they have learnt from you to train others outside of Shadow Garden, albeit a weaker version of Hero Creation EX, either to aid others or scout out for new recruits. As a result, it's not impossible for you to benefit from this form of Hero Creation EX as well.

But there is more to this, as by awakening the Heroic Potential of your allies, fate seems to smile upon them while pretending they don't exist, meaning Shadow Garden will come upon golden opportunities to grow stronger—from something simple like discovering a new market for sandwiches to coming upon rare resources and lost treasures. Even being able to come upon people who have or had the potential for being heroes themselves, but for whatever reason such as theft, betrayal, or simple ignorance, were denied their chance to follow such a path. Within Shadow Garden, those who had the gifts of their previous life stolen will be able to surpass their former selves. Betrayed hero(in)es will find new purpose and all will be able to regain their stolen futures.

All the while, Shadow Garden will not be chained down by things such as fate or destiny with them being hidden from all manner of extrasensory detection like past and future sight.​
addons.title: False to True, Fantasy Reforged into Reality

addons.text:
You have elevated the Global King System beyond its original design, fusing it with the mythos and infrastructure of the Shadow Garden. With this fusion, every member of Shadow Garden has already been granted an Evil Piece or Brave Saint and fully reincarnated, not as mere fledgling devil or angel, but as elite supernatural agents imbued with years of battle-tested magical expertise, as if they had trained for decades in their new forms.

Furthermore, the Seven Shadows do not merely become Devils or Angels, but ascended to High-Class Devil Kings or Angel Kings, each wielding a full Evil Piece or Brave Saints set of their own. They can now recruit and reincarnate others into their own Peerage, forming a cascading hierarchy of power under your supreme leadership.

You can also choose to have the Global King System monument moved into the pocket dimension of Shadow Garden, protecting it from any that would do it harm with an army loyal to it and you.
addons.title: A Shadow Monarch's Ascension

addons.text:
For many, Shadow Garden is more than just an organization—it is the one place where they were accepted after losing everything. It is home, with you as its head. You give them a new purpose, a new home. Even those who cling to the memories of their former lives come to accept Shadow Garden as a new home where they are truly welcomed.

Because of this emotional and symbolic weight in Shadow Garden's mythos, and through the memories and feelings of its members, the Miracle Candle has allowed the embers of its own miracle to infuse your pocket dimension, giving birth to a new spirit deeply intertwined with the essence of Shadow Garden. Within the dimension, a large hearth now stands, symbolizing this spirit. It serves as a place where members can relax, bond, and where new recruits can ease into their new lives.

Each member of Shadow Garden receives a personal room, tailored to their desires and needs. These rooms can grow as large as necessary. If members wish to share a space, their rooms will merge into an ideal combination of both, ensuring that all preferences are met. However, unlike the original Miracle Candle, these rooms do not grant unique powers.

Instead, you are able to grant members copies of your own Objects of Power—along with their upgrades and add-ons, where applicable—so long as the item in question is worth no more than 10 SP. You also maintain both a whitelist and a blacklist to control what can be shared.

But Shadow Garden is more than a sanctuary for lost souls—it is also a fortress. The spirit responds accordingly. As Shadow Garden grows in influence, power, wealth, size, and other metrics, the spirit strengthens. Your pocket dimension expands as it begins to surpass what it was before. As it grows, the defenses become more elaborate and multi-layered. Any intruder who breaches it will be detected immediately, and the deeper they go, the weaker they become—if they are not expelled outright. In the most desperate of times, the spirit itself can take to the battlefield, embodying the collective strength and abilities of all Shadow Garden members and allies.

This protection extends beyond your pocket dimension. All Shadow Garden bases act as extensions of this home. As such, every base and area of influence gains increased durability. Buildings may appear to come alive—curtains falling at just the right moment to obscure enemies, suits of armor and mannequins springing to life to interfere or fight. While not as fortified as the main base, this level of protection is enough to make something like a seemingly normal megastore more defensible than most seats of government.
addons.title: The Garden's Hearth

addons.text:
Shadow Garden has gained formidable magic power, multiple personas connected to transforming into different outfits, and the full Magical Girl package. The connection between Shadow Garden and the Magical Girl archetype has always been present, but now it has fully awakened, breaking the final hindrance to their skills.

What this means is that Shadow Garden has fully acquired the Magical Girl package (Magical Girl, Girl of Magic, and Hidden Strength), enabling them to act more effectively undercover or use various aliases. In addition, the Legendary Skill allows their hard work to become a miracle in itself. However, only the Seven Shadows have attained their own Legendary Skills, while the rest of the membership are still developing theirs.

But Might and Skill are not all that this miracle brings. Now, when members of Shadow Garden sleep, their subconscious minds experience pseudo-dream worlds. These dreams are "what if" scenarios where different members live different lives in another world. It is possible that interactions from the waking world can affect these dreams as well, giving them a chance to revaluate something they may have over looked. When they wake up, the dreamer will not consciously remember these events, but their subconscious will help guide them based on what they learned.

The purpose of these shared, false dreams is simple: the betterment of the members. While in these "what if" dreams, members reaffirm the bonds they have with one another and experience different aspects of their own personalities, as well as those of their fellow members. They experiment with their abilities in new ways, strengthening their bonds and deepening their understanding of others and themselves.

These "what if" dreams can feature any setting or scenario, but there are a few constants. Two important ones are:

1. The dreams are designed to help the members of Shadow Garden grow as people to forge their own path to reach their future.
2. There are always two versions of yourself present in these dreams: one acting as a guide to lead them where they need to go next, and the other as a mentor to help them along their quest with nudges to help them along if they become stuck. Not giving them the answer but enough hints to find it themselves.

As an additional benefit, the members of Shadow Garden experience 16 times the quality of sleep, meaning that 30 minutes of sleep feels like a full 8 hours to them. And, as a bonus, they also receive a magical girl mascot in the form of a purple puppy spirit named Nuru, who wears a hooded cloak and acts as an extension of the dreamer.
addons.title: Spring Breeze

addons.text:
The Curse of Diabolus was originally believed to be nothing more than mana (or other internal energies) going out of control, causing the body to mutate to such an extent that victims were left as little more than balls of writhing flesh. However, even after being cured, another aspect of the curse remained.

When subjected to overwhelming negative emotions and thoughts, the affected individual undergoes a transformation, taking on a demonic appearance and gaining an exponential boost in power. In this state, they indiscriminately kill all those they encounter. This was the final curse—one that turned victims into "demons" who had to be put down to hide the sins of those who pursued immortality at any cost, regardless of the lives destroyed in the process.

This remained the case until the curse was conquered by Shadow Garden, who transformed it into a blessing. Using both your Emotion Drives as a foundation, Shadow Garden was able to replicate the effect, allowing all members to wield their own, slightly weaker versions of the Negative and Positive Emotion Drives.

With this advancement, all members can now safely harness the power of their demon forms while maintaining full control. Even the transformation itself is subject to their will. Furthermore, members are no longer limited to this conquered curse form; with time and experience, they can develop new and enhanced forms, abilities, and techniques.

Thanks to this expertise, Shadow Garden is uniquely suited to training individuals whose powers rely on specific emotional states or provoke dangerous emotions, such as berserk states. At a minimum, Shadow Garden can help these individuals gain better control, and potentially even mastery, over such powers.

As for you, a mysterious woman's spirit has latched onto you, finding you entertaining to be around. Her name is Aurora. While she remembers little of her life, it's clear she was involved with the Cult of Diabolus before the era of the Three Heroes. Aurora can construct a physical body for herself using energy—a feat possible due to her brilliance, having once replicated a highly advanced and personal magical attack after seeing it only once.

Note: If taken in conjunction with Thorn Garden—yes, yandere obsession contributes to both the Positive and Negative Emotion Drives used by Shadow Garden.
addons.title: Curse Conquered

addons.text:
You now have in your service the entire power of the Black Knights. This includes the personnel and resources of The Six Houses of Kyoto, Tohdoh and The Four Holy Swords, Rakshata and her science team, Kallen Kozuki and Zero Squad, various facilities consolidated inside your pocket dimension (filled with appropriate equipment, the means to maintain it, and the means to make more), numerous vehicles (including Knightmare Frames), and so on. Considering the existence of the United States of Japan, you can even choose to control a single mid-sized sovereign nation in whatever world you're in.

This integrates with Shadow Garden by cross-training your troops between disciplines, allowing your Shadow Garden Troops to field engineer and pilot mechs like the best Black Knights, and your Black Knights conversely learn stealth, subterfuge, and the martial arts from Shadow Garden, as well as any comparable skill sharing, like Kyoto House merging with Snow Fox Corporation and Mitsugoshi.
addons.title: The Black Knights (Code Geass)

addons.text:
Shadow Garden has now integrated with whichever of the occult organizations your choices of power represent; The Hellsing Organization for Elder True Vampire, Iscariot for Alexander Anderson, or Millennium for Der Wehrwolf or Everywhere And Nowhere.

Their complete resources and personnel are at your disposal, with the notable exception of the "Trump Cards", as you have taken their place. For The Hellsing Organization, this means Hellsing Manor, the facilities of the Imperial War Museum, the HMS Eagle, an RAF modified SR-71 Blackbird, Seras Victoria and Integra Hellsing, the forces of the Wild Geese, the SAS, MI5, Integra's Bodyguards i.e. the "Men In Black", & the "Hellsing Special Military Forces". For Iscariot, this means the enormous legion of the Ninth Crusade, the Ferdinant Lukes Orphanage, the small Irish town of Badrick, Archbishops Enrico Maxwell and Makube, and the Armed Priest Vanguard. For Millennium this means Der Letzte Battalion, Werwolf Squad, the Major, the Professor and his Occult Research Team, the Valentine Brothers and their ghoul army, Tubalcain Alhambra and Brazil's military and police forces, Millennium's South American facilities, the airship "Deus Ex Machina", and its fleet complement. You get Walter C. Dornez if you have either The Hellsing Organization or Millennium. You don't have to worry about loyalty issues or ideological hardliners either; Shadow Garden knows well how to remold those in their service.

The influence of these organizations becomes yours also. If you have The Hellsing Organization on your side, Shadow Garden gains covert control of one nation on your world (Great Britain, an equivalent, or a related nation if it is available, another maritime or imperial power if it isn't) through the Round Table Council. If you have Iscariot, Shadow Garden gains control of either the Roman Catholic Church or an equivalent major religious organization (with Abrahamic trappings if possible) in the world you're in. Finally, if you have Millennium, Shadow Garden gains control of some of your world's secret societies (usually villainous in character) along with infiltrators, spies, and fifth columnists in governments, scientific institutions, occult organizations, militaries, police, and paramilitary groups all around the globe.

As a bonus, you and the other members of Shadow Garden gain the complete scientific and occult knowledge of the organizations you take control of. If you want speech chips, airship designs, specialty weapons, or even any of the real world equipment used, go wild.
addons.title: The Royal Order Of Protestant Knights (Hellsing)

addons.text:
All members of the Shadow Garden are now trained in the shinobi arts, having successfully infiltrated and graduated from a prestigious Shinobi School. This rigorous training grants them a variant of Shinobi (Senran Kagura), further amplifying their formidable strength and granting them access to ninja techniques and specialities such as the Shinobi Barriers.

However only the Seven Shadows have developed a Secret Ninja Art, an Ultimate Secret Ninja Art, and a guardian animal. Nonetheless, the rest of the Shadow Garden remains capable of unlocking similar powers, should they reach the same level of dedication and skill.

During their time at the Shinobi Academy, the Seven Shadows and the Numbers successfully persuaded and recruited several individuals into the Shadow Garden. After graduation, their efforts led to the recruitment of multiple elite squads, including but not limited to, the team from Hanzō National Academy and Daidōji, the Homura Crimson Squad along with Rin, the squad from Gessen Girls' School, and the squad from Hebijo Clandestine Girls' Academy. Just like with being a member of the Shadow Garden, they have access to the Slime Bodysuit that stores their ninja scroll and other benefits of being in the Shadow Garden. In addition, they have pledge their absolute loyalty to you and are just as devoted to you as like the other members of the Shadow Garden.

With the help of Rin and Daidōji, the Shadow Garden has established a rigorous training regimen to forge new recruits into skilled Shinobi and helping them to develop their own ninja arts and guardian animals, all in service of your will.
addons.title: Shadow Shinobi Academy

addons.text:
It appears that the Gambling Addiction has somehow fused with Shadow Garden’s headquarters, transforming it into a colossal facility capable of drawing in entities from other universes. In the process, it also merged the Throne of Heroes with the base itself, allowing for seamless integration of any new recruits into Shadow Garden and effecting the existing members of the organization. While you can no longer wield the power directly, you now possess a refined way to interface with and manage this power.

All summoned beings will be inducted into the Shadow Garden and pledge their unwavering fealty to you. Their loyalty and devotion will be absolute. Upon induction, they will be equipped with the standard Shadow Garden gear, including the signature Slime Suit.

Additionally, any wisdom essences obtained from duplicate summons can be used to enhance your facility, such as increasing the number of beings summoned per pull or boosting your daily intake of Saint Quartz.

Originally, you could only lock into a specific setting once per week. However, by using Saint Quartz, this restriction can be bypassed. By spending one Saint Quartz, you may immediately change the setting from which your summoned servants are drawn.

Furthermore, Saint Quartz can also be used to summon specific beings directly. However, the more powerful the being, the greater the cost so choose wisely.

As you recruit more servants, the headquarters will gradually expand—unlocking new rooms, and specialized facilities to better accommodate and support the members of Shadow Garden

Existing members of Shadow Garden will be granted their own personal rooms. Should any of them fall in battle, they will slowly resurrect and recover, returning over the course of one month. Alternatively, you may spend a Saint Quartz to instantly restore that individual.
addons.title: Master of the Multidimensional Garden

addons.text:
You now are able to bestow copies of your Sacred Gears to all members of Shadow Garden. You can only give out Sacred Gears that you have access to, so you will not be able to grant copies of Sacred Gears that you have not unlocked.

Every member of Shadow Garden is able to wield a copy of your Sacred Gears. However, each member is limited to a single copy at the start and only the Seven Shadows, or those equal to or stronger than them, are able to use a Longinus Gear at its full power. However as they train and learn how to use sacred gears, they will slowly be able to use more Sacred Gears, although they will be only able to use 3 Longinus Gear at any given time.

Whenever a copy of a Sacred Gear is enhanced or used, the effects are shared across all copies, including the original. If a member manages to unlock Balance Breaker, or even a Fusion Balance Breaker, that advancement will apply to all copies as well as the original gear. In addition, every usage of these copies would slowly allow you to unlock more Sacred Gears to use, and in turn, allows you to give copies to members of the Shadow Garden.
addons.title: The Shadow Sacred Gear System

addons.text:
Whether due to specialized training or an unknown facet, all of Shadow Garden has gained their own version of Jump Jump Hero!, gaining the full benefits of the power (including any unlocked addons) and unlocking new aspects of the power through the connection shared amongst Shadow Garden.

Through this connection, you and each member can summon up to 7 members of Shadow Garden at any time should they need them. There is an instant check to know who is available, and once summoned, they are ready to lend their aid. Optionally, or if no one is free, NPCs will be summoned to fill the role. These NPCs will fade away once their purpose is fulfilled, and their strength is the average amongst Shadow Garden's membership, from weakest to strongest, not counting yourself. As the Master of Shadow Garden, you cannot be summoned; instead, you are aware of all summons made and can include yourself or send an NPC based on you to help.

But aid does not just come from summoning, as Shadow Garden has a shared Item Storage. Every collectible, power-up, and item from Jump Jump Hero! is copied, and said copy is placed in a shared reserve that all members can withdraw from when need be.

The enhanced awareness of Jump Jump Hero! has linked together, allowing you and all of Shadow Garden to be aware of each other's general location and well-being, should they allow it. This is more instinct rather than telepathy, akin to watching one another on the same screen.
