A facet that will come in handy as new Trail Areas requiring multiple people to complete will grant new rewards, either more powerful than others or providing a benefit to an overlooked area.

Finally, you and all of Shadow Garden have access to Costume Skins, an ability that applies a perception filter over yourself, making it appear you are all wearing different outfits—whether recolors of what you already have or something brand new. These are not real; they are just something to personalize yourselves with or try out new looks.
addons.title: Changing the Gamer
Hermit Order Reborn
addons.text:
It seems that through you possessing both the abilities and creation knowledge of beyonders as well as a hidden space related to an ancient order your Shadow Garden has become something akin to a successor to the Hermit Order. 

This means that almost every recruit now is a low sequence beyonder of one of the 22 pathways with the Seven Shadows are in the sequence 2 with the potential to achieve sequence 0, another benefit is that due to the structure of the Shadow Garden every member now functions as an anchor for both you and the Seven Shadow. 

Also, due to the Shadow Garden's vast resources you can quickly acquire various ingredients for potions as well as a collection of sealed artifacts at your disposal.

objects.text:
You are the new Shadow, the undisputed master of Shadow Garden and the sole keeper of its Master Key. The organization’s headquarters resides in a pocket dimension—a bastion crafted from the best elements of every Shadow Garden base. Within this realm lies, all the artifacts, manpower, and resources ever utilized by Shadow Garden, all awaiting your command.

The signature artifact of Shadow Garden is the Slime Bodysuit. These adaptable creations can shapeshift into weapons, regenerate themselves, and serve as a powerful defense.

You have a vast stockpile of these bodysuits, along with an arsenal that includes other notable artifacts used by Shadow Garden, like Magical Training Weights, Anti-Magic Nullifier, and Locator of Possess.

Your organization includes every member recruited by Cid Kagenou, whether directly or indirectly. From the elite Seven Shadows to the extensive network of Numbers and base-level operatives, all pledge their absolute loyalty to you. Even affiliates like Yukime and Rose are included. Every member is deeply devoted to you in a near cult-like manner, ready to sacrifice their lives without hesitation. Moreover, the backstories of your agents have been altered to align with your starting world, cementing their loyalty to you instead of Cid.

As the inheritor of Shadow Garden’s wealth and influence, you command the immense material resources amassed by the Mitsugoshi Company and Snow Fox Company. Their immense reserves of wealth are easily convertible on any world, granting you unparalleled economic power. Additionally, your headquarters retains their production capabilities and their networking expertise, allowing you to swiftly establish dominance in any new environment.

The pocket dimension is accessible only through specially crafted keys, which you alone possess the power to create. Anyone who holds a key can open a gate to Shadow Garden, so guard them carefully.
objects.title: Shadow Garden (The Eminence In the Shadow)

objects.text:
This disk will let you form a contract with a Starfarer, a powerful being whose life is tied to your own and whose power is expressed through your body. You can choose if they will be a pre-existing Starfarer, such as one of the twins, Asphodene and Eridani, or a new one, tailored to match your personality. They will sometimes chat with you or offer advice in addition to their true utility: combating conventionally unsolvable threats, such as those who put the very universe in danger. 

While initially weak, your Starfarer will grow in power as you defeat stronger and stronger enemies, manifesting their power for you to use as passive buffs of your various attributes and equipment resembling items from fictional stories you've encountered, as well as items to summon 'pets' resembling fictional characters which while invulnerable, cannot help you fight. In addition to this, your starfarer can instead help you by sending you on Cosmic Voyages, sending you into pocket dimensions called sub-worlds filled with resources to obtain and enemies to fight. With enough time and triumphs, you will likely become unrivaled in power.
objects.title: Spatial Disk (The Stars Above)

addons.text:
Your warriors will be equipped with weapons, armor, and gear that are specifically tailored to the setting or created using your Technology and Artifice Powers. These items will possess properties unique to your army, including the ability to vanish when a warrior dies.

However, the primary focus will be on melee weapons and light armor that does not restrict movement. This does not apply to combination weapons, such as the ma'tok (the Jaffa staff from the Stargate universe) or similar weapons. Your army is known for its ferocity, fearlessness, and ability to act swiftly and with brute force; choose weapons and equipment based on these principles.
addons.title: Arsenal of Many Faces

addons.text:
Your army—now entirely and without exception yours—whose soldiers will mirror the beastly traits and characteristics of your divine form, as well as employ your favorite tactics, weapons, and behavior, while retaining their core advantages from the Army of Anubis.

Furthermore, your army has become an integral part of you, and no one will be able to prevent you from summoning it to your aid or restrict its use.

If you have the Multiple Power Sources (Gods of Egypt) upgrade, with each purchase you will receive an additional legion of 96,000 warriors corresponding to your additional power source or aspect.
addons.title: Your Divine Army

objects.text:
You become the ruler of the Army of Anubis, the host of the Underworld that was previously under the command of the King of Scorpions. You have not made any pacts or sold your soul, but if you die, your army will vanish along with you.

Your army consists of 96,000 warriors—muscular, lean humanoids standing about 2.7 meters tall, with jackal heads and certain canine physical features, such as legs, claws on their hands, and dog-like mouths with sharp teeth. Each warrior possesses incredible strength, speed, and mastery of bladed weapons. They can run as fast as a horse and knock riders from their saddles with a single blow. These warriors are bloodthirsty, brutal, and nearly fearless.

All warriors are armed with bronze bladed weapons, including spears, double-edged double-headed axes, khopesh and clubs. Officers may wear light gilded armor and headgear resembling the nemes—the headdress of the pharaohs.

However, the most important thing is that the warriors in your army are immortal, and they cannot be permanently destroyed as long as you are alive. The only way to neutralize them is to cut off their heads, after which their bodies will crumble into sand and flakes of darkness. The same thing will happen if you sever their limbs, but this will not kill them. A slain warrior will return to your command the following night, emerging from the darkness.

You can summon and recall your army by projecting a cloud of thickening darkness from your shadow. The process of summoning the army may take several minutes.
objects.title: Army of Anubis (The Mummy).

objects.text:
You are the owner of an extraordinarily unordinary pair of a cat and a mouse. Despite their small size, both possess a limited form of "Toonforce," allowing them to bend the rules of reality in minor, comedic ways. While impressive as it may sound, these effects are tightly limited and remain grounded in small-scale cartoon physics.

They may survive impacts that would normally be fatal, flatten and reinflate, pull objects from improbable places, or briefly ignore momentum and structure during a chase. However, this does not extend to large-scale reality manipulation as they cannot alter the wider world, affect anything beyond their immediate surroundings, or perform feats such as creating matter from nothing on a meaningful scale, stopping time, or causing massive environmental destruction.

As their owner, you possess a form of resistance to Toonforce yourself. This grants you an innate resilience to their antics, allowing you to survive explosions, impacts, and collateral damage that would otherwise be fatal. Additionally, as their owner you can exert a subtle but absolute authority over the pair when necessary, allowing you to reign them in if they get too rowdy.

Despite their sapience, the duo remain fundamentally animalistic in behavior. They will frequently ignore instructions in favor of chasing one another, becoming fixated on gags, or engaging in elaborate setups purely for the payoff of a joke. However, if you treat them well and be a good owner, they will both come to help you if you get yourself in trouble.
objects.title: Cat & Mouse (Tom and Jerry)

objects.text:
You gain full authority over your own Strategic Homeland Division, a sovereign, globally operating intelligence and stabilization network designed to endure societal collapse and function with unrestricted operational latitude. This is a complete SHD deployment containing its full infrastructure, activated Cores and Nodes, secure facilities, supply architecture, black-site installations, and unrestricted command access. It adapts to any setting—technological, magical, futuristic, or hybrid—translating its systems into equivalent paradigms without loss of scope, authority, or lethality.

The SHD Network operates on a global scale by default. It is not restricted to a single nation unless you deliberately impose that limitation. Satellite arrays, dimensional relays, arcane signal nexuses, or equivalent infrastructure ensure worldwide coverage and persistent connectivity. The system is decentralized and redundant; the destruction of a regional node does not collapse the network. Processing and routing automatically redistribute across remaining assets to preserve operational continuity.

All canon Division agents exist within this deployment as active or reserve assets. This includes named operatives and high-value personnel drawn directly from established continuity. They are loyal to you as Supreme Director of the Network and will not go rogue unless you explicitly permit deviation. Their skills, experience, and reputations remain intact, adapted to the current setting’s metaphysical or technological framework as needed.

All agents are equipped with SHD Tech, including transceiver devices equivalent to the iconic smartwatch, AR lenses, encrypted communications, deployable combat skills, and tactical support systems. Through this interface they access ISAC, the Intelligent System Analytic Computer, an advanced assimilative intelligence derived from DARPA’s CALO architecture. ISAC provides real-time threat detection, biometric identification, predictive tactical modeling, encrypted global communications, and mission guidance. It identifies hostiles through physiological markers, tracks movement patterns, marks objectives, analyzes structural weaknesses, and maintains secure coordination between all activated agents.

The ECHO system reconstructs past events by aggregating ambient data into three-dimensional holographic overlays. In technological worlds this draws from cameras, satellites, drones, and signal traces; in arcane or supernatural settings it interprets residual energies, soul imprints, or temporal echoes without degradation in fidelity.

Directive 51 functions as a universal crisis mandate. During collapse-level or existential events, your Division may requisition resources, override infrastructure, bypass legal systems, and act with full operational impunity across the globe. In worlds without formal governance, it instead manifests as a crisis authority protocol granting your Division uncontested logistical dominance necessary to stabilize or control the situation.

You possess full command-level access and may operate either as an enhanced field agent or as strategic overseer of the entire network. The SHD Network is a top-tier intelligence, logistics, and tactical control asset capable of stabilizing continents, dismantling insurgencies, suppressing rogue superhumans, or rebuilding civilization from systemic failure in any universe.

Most agents are regular civilians who have been given the best training, and the legal authority and right to do whatever they need to do. You can choose to activate groups of agents, or activate indiviudal agents of your choice. You can also choose to combine magical, technological, and supernatural methods as well.
objects.title: Strategic Homeland Division (Tom Clancy's The Division)

objects.text:
A squad of four soldiers is entirely at your disposal, whose physical and mental capabilities are comparable to Delta Force in terms of surgical operations and Rangers in terms of aggressive operations. They are essentially soldiers trained to an elite level with an all-around and adaptive approach.

They possess hand-to-hand combat training and marksmanship with all types of firearms, modern martial arts (which can follow military standards, various existing martial arts, or both), blades, and modern military gadgets for all types of situations. Individually, they can all operate all types of vehicles, while transports that require teamwork are handled with such cohesion that there are no discrepancies or mistakes between them.

They also possess the knowledge and experience required to perform tasks and use specialized tools that would normally require a specialist. This ranges from hacking cameras to demolition work or interrogation to extract information from a target. Each one can easily carry up to 80 kilograms in their military backpack, although exceeding this amount reduces their mobility. They possess sufficient supplies for long-term missions. This grants them an autonomous operational capacity of three months before needing to resupply.

Their mental capabilities are sufficiently tempered to withstand stress, loneliness, and pain. Where others might break down or suffer from TEPT, they would fight tooth and nail to complete the mission without suffering any mental burden. In terms of stubbornness and determination, they are even willing to undertake suicide missions.

The gender, appearance, age, and personality of each squad member are customizable or can be directly inspired by anyone who has been hinted at or revealed in Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon. They are completely loyal to you.
objects.title: Nomads (Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon)

addons.text:
It appears you have gained authority over the entirety of the Faithful, both past and present, along with the complete skill sets, authority, and knowledge of the Yüzbaşı, the War Prophets, the Shrine Anchorites, the Supreme Pontiff, and more. In doing so, you have effectively become the absolute ruler of all Faithful who have ever existed. This dominion extends across all their people, soldiers, creations, assets, territories, resources, and every other possession accumulated throughout their history. You also gain control over all three known Holy Beings who have been part of, or have appeared within, the Faithful, as well as the means to locate or create additional ones. Alongside this comes command of, and access to, an immense library containing the knowledge and skills of every being who has ever belonged to the Faithful, including any entity that has ever appeared within lands under Faithful control, whether in the past or present.

Among the Faithful are numerous factions and orders, including the Trench Pilgrims who bear the Procession of the Sacred Affliction, the Cavalcade of the Tenth Plague, the Order of St. Methodius, and the Iron Sultanate’s Fida’i of Alamut, also known as the Cabal of Assassins. They are joined by the House of Wisdom, the Defenders of the Iron Wall, and the Crusader Knights, which include the Sacred Order of the Dragon. In addition, there are many other forces such as the Synod of Strategic Prophecy, the Lithuanian-Polish Commonwealth Hussars, the remnants of the Varangian Guard, the Solomonic Empire of Abyssinia, the New Syncretic Orthodox Church, and the Hebrew Knights, among others.

Furthermore, you gain a two new overarching factions: the Exorcists of the Faith. This effectively grants all associated individuals the powers of The Exorcist (FAITH: The Unholy Trinity). They merge seamlessly into your dimension from the Faithful of New Antioch (Trench Crusade), and all such entities will regard you in the same manner as the Faithful of New Antioch do within their own context, recognizing your authority as absolute within their alignment and doctrine. And a second in The Exorcists of The Holy Light, who all wield the power Holy Light (High school DxD), at varying levels. They merge seamlessly into your dimension from the Faithful of New Antioch (Trench Crusade), and all such entities will regard you in the same manner as the Faithful of New Antioch do within their own context, recognizing your authority as absolute within their alignment and doctrine.
addons.title: The Faithful (Trench Crusade)

addons.text:
It seems you have gained the Divine majesty of an Angel. Your presence has become akin to an unending nuclear explosion of pure Holy power and Divine wrath. Any being not equally Holy—or spared by your mercy—finds their eyes burned to ash by the mere act of beholding you. Creatures burdened by Sin are slain outright unless you spare them. Those you spare instead endure agonizing purification, their sins seared from their souls. In the aftermath, they come to perceive you as the ultimate and only true holy and divine being.

At the same time, you radiate such Divine Light that any land touched by your presence becomes forever sanctified, transformed into an impossibly pure Holy domain. To the unholy, or any force opposed to your nature, these lands are unbearable—terrifying, poisonous, and painfully hostile, as though reality itself rejects their existence. You possess the potential to ascend to the same heights as the greatest Angels of the Lord.

You may freely incorporate additional elements, affinities, and aspects into your aura and power, provided you already possess them. If you have Grigori Cadre (High School DxD), you will manifest an alt form: a complete inversion of your Holy and Divine nature, as though you fell alongside the rest of the Fallen Angels, who were corrupted into Demons. In this state, you would hold the same potential as your primary Divine and Holy form, capable of descending to ultimate unholy might, just like Lucifer and Moloch. You will also possess all the knowledge Hell holds within its unholy minds and libraries. You may separate or merge these opposing manifestations at will, seamlessly shifting between absolute holiness, absolute unholiness, or a terrifying fusion of both.
addons.title: Angel of The Lord (Trench Crusade)

addons.text:
It seems the Lord Himself has chosen you as His successor in a world where He is powerless to shield His beloved creations from sin and ruin.

You begin with the abilities of all seven known Meta-Christs. Each embodies a miracle, teaching, or event from Christ’s life, twisted into something both divine and unsettling. The Second Meta-Christ bears a corrupted echo of the Last Supper: every bit of their body, becomes a sacred sacrament capable of elevating any living being that consumes it to superhuman and holy heights. The Seventh carries the power of Resurrection, though not in its pure form. They may return ordinary living beings to life only as Martyr Penitents—mindless holy warriors stripped of fear, freed from pain, and driven solely to fight in the name of divine purpose.

You additionally gain the knowledge and capability to create all the works of the Faithful from Trench Crusade, as well as the power, stature, and abilities of the Twelve Paladins of the Faithful.

Of the Seven, only three abilities are truly known. The remaining four are mysteries lost to time and revelation. You may decide what forms these powers take, provided each is a twisted interpretation of one of Christ’s miracles, teachings, or pivotal moments from His life, or you may leave them to chance.

Beyond the authority of the Meta-Christs, you are granted additional Divinities on top of your previous chosen one(s). These dominions encompass holiness, light, divine power, creation, life, sealing, humanity, animals, justice, knowledge, and creation itself. Through them, you may eventually reach heights equal to—or beyond—those of the Lord Himself.
addons.title: The Successor of The Lord (Trench Crusade)

addons.text:
It seems your Guardian Angel has inherited the full power, authority, intellect, experience, and transcendent nature of one of the Lord’s Seraphim—the choice of which Seraph is entirely yours. As a consequence, the conceptual attribute that places its existence twenty-five times above yours at all times has evolved as well. Now, the gap between you and your Guardian Angel mirrors the incomprehensible gulf between a true Seraph of the Lord, and an utterly ordinary human being. No matter how powerful you become, that Gulf of power remains absolute and unbreakable.

To be clear, even the weakest and most insignificant angelic being under the Lord’s dominion emanates a presence comparable to an eternal nuclear detonation of pure Divine Light, holy power, and sacred wrath. Any being lacking equal holiness—or not explicitly spared by its mercy—has their eyes burned to ash for daring to gaze upon you, the being it worships above all else. Those burdened by sin are annihilated instantly unless the angel chooses to spare them. Those who are spared are subjected to unbearable purification as their sins are seared from their souls in agonizing radiance. Once purified, they emerge utterly transformed, coming to recognize you as the one true and ultimate divine existence. Overwhelmed with reverence, they become compelled to spread worship of you to all who cross their path and to elevate themselves so that they may be of use to you. The extent of their worship and zeal is shaped by their character, what they have endured in life, how much they have suffered, and how sinful they once were—just as the angel itself ceaselessly does.

Simultaneously, the Divine Light radiated by your Guardian Angel sanctifies all lands touched by its presence forever. Entire regions are transformed into impossibly pure holy domains where the air itself hums with sacred authority. To forces aligned against you—or, God forbid, openly hostile to you—these sanctified lands are intolerable: poisonous, terrifying, and violently hostile, as though reality itself rejects their existence and seeks to erase them.

Your Guardian Angel has become, in every sense, an Angel of You. This remains unchanged even after inheriting the majesty of a Seraphim of God. The only difference is the scale of its devotion: it now perceives you as the one true God above all creation and believes its sole purpose is to worship you eternally and spread that worship without end. In the same way that the Seraphim exist to endlessly proclaim the holiness of the Lord God Himself, your Guardian Angel now exists to endlessly exalt yours.
addons.title: Your Guardian Angel (Trench Crusade)

addons.text:
You have seemingly gained the allegiance of the entirety of the Cult of the Black Grail. In doing so, you have inherited the complete skill sets, authority, and knowledge of Beelzubub of the Black Grail, but you gain none of his actual personal power or abilities, beyond complete control over The Black Grail plague, becoming the absolute ruler of the Cult in its entirety, along with everything tied to it. 

This authority encompasses all domains under the Cult’s control: its acolytes, plaguebound legions, alchemical abominations, relic-bearing operatives, and every forbidden archive ever compiled within its reach. You also gain control over all three known Meta-Christs, as well as the means to locate or create additional ones. Alongside this comes command of the Grailbound Paladins and access to an immense repository containing the knowledge and abilities of every being who has ever been part of the Cult of the Black Grail, including any entity that has ever manifested within lands touched by its influence.

The military and institutional structure of the Cult of the Black Grail is vast and horrifying in scope. At its core are the Black Grail Shocktroopers, elite and heavily augmented soldiers who form the backbone of its offensive and defensive might. Supporting them are the Grail Mechanized Infantry and the Red Host, hardened troops engineered for brutal attrition warfare and prolonged campaigns of annihilation. Combat Engineer Covens serve as both tacticians and artificers, maintaining siege engines, constructing blighted fortifications, and deploying forbidden experimental technologies on the battlefield. Artillery Broods wield devastating siege instruments capable of rupturing enemy formations and fortifications alike through relentless, plague-soaked bombardments.

Beyond the battlefield lies the Office of the Propagation of Blight, a grim internal authority functioning as intelligence service, internal security apparatus, and doctrinal enforcement body. They safeguard the Cult’s darkest secrets and enforce unwavering obedience to its corrupted creed. Hidden beneath its domains are the Black Grail Laboratories, clandestine facilities where horrific transmutations and biological aberrations are engineered through human experimentation, producing monstrosities such as the Communicants for deployment against all opposition.

The cult views you as the Absolute Authority, ruler, and God of the Infernal Heretics of Hell, this compels absolute recognition of your authority, as well as having a form of Enforced Loyalty and Worship. 

Additionally, all things a part of this is fused into an alternate layer of your personal Dimension, and all who are added will have an uneasy alliance with the rest of the Pocket dimension only through mutual worship and loyalty to you, and any that step out of that line are immediately hunted down, for various purposes, by everyone.
addons.title: Cult of The Black Grail (Trench Crusade)

addons.text:
It appears you have gained authority over the entirety of the Heretics of Hell and the assembled Legions of Hell, excluding Hell itself as a sovereign domain, along with the complete skill sets, authority, and knowledge of the Seven Infernal Rulers, but none of their powers, who have been Usurped by fully loyal Demons, who all worship you and the very ground you walk on, and any and all parts of you they can get their hands on. In doing so, you have effectively become the absolute ruler of all Heretics of Hell. This dominion extends across all their creations, assets, territories, infernal strongholds, resources, and every other possession accumulated throughout their corrupted and war-torn history.

This authority spans all factions, cults, and warbands aligned under the Heretics of Hell, including their legions, abyss-forged armies, war covens, infernal assassins, and all subordinate forces operating beneath their banner. Alongside this comes command of the Infernal Warlords and access to an immense archive containing the knowledge and skills of every being who has ever belonged to the Heretics of Hell or the Legions of Hell, including any entity that has ever appeared within their controlled territories.

The governing structure of the Heretics of Hell is vast, fractured, and brutally efficient in scope. At its core now stand the Seven Infernal Usurpers, who have supplanted the original rulers of Hells hierarchy as absolute sovereign powers over the Heretics and their legions. Operating across all levels of internal control is the Black Doctrine Directorate, a grim enforcement and intelligence structure that ensures absolute obedience to the Usurpers creed, purging dissent and preserving their darkest secrets through fear, manipulation, Worship of you, and annihilation.

Beneath their war-torn domains lie the Infernal Convergence Forges, clandestine and blasphemous facilities where abominations are engineered, bound, and weaponized for use against rival powers and existential threats. These forges produce entities, constructs, and bound infernal soldiers designed to surpass mortal limits and serve as instruments of total war.

They will all view you with absolute loyalty and Worship, seeing you as the Absolute and only God in all of creation.

Additionally, all things a part of this is fused into the alternate layer of your personal Dimension, and all who are added will have an uneasy alliance with the rest of the Pocket dimension only through mutual worship and loyalty to you, and any that step out of that line are immediately hunted down, for various purposes, by everyone., If you have the Addon "The Faithful (Trench Crusade)" then you may choose to gain the Entire Alternate earth of Trench Crusade in your Personal Dimension, as well as Hell and Heaven itself, with the Abscence of The Lord himself, which are fully functional, automated Afterlives, all as a fully, Fanatically Loyal, Endlessly Devoted, and in some cases even Zealous personal Dimension. you may Fuse this with any and all other Dimensions or Property OoP you gain, with this CYOA, or without.
addons.title: The Heretics of Hell (Trench Crusade)

objects.text:
You have seemingly gained the allegiance of a portion of the Faithful and the entirety of the Principality of New Antioch. In doing so, you have inherited the complete skill sets, authority, and knowledge of both the Duke and the Pope, effectively becoming the absolute ruler of both New and Old Antioch, along with everything tied to them. This dominion extends over their people, soldiers, creations, assets, territories, holy sites, burial grounds, laboratories, resources, and countless other holdings accumulated throughout their history. You also gain control over all three known Meta-Christs, as well as the means to locate or create additional ones. Alongside this comes command of the Paladins and access to an immense library containing the knowledge and abilities of every being who has ever been part of either Old or New Antioch, including any entity that has ever appeared within lands under Antioch’s control.

The military and institutional structure of Antioch is vast and terrifying in scope. At its core are the New Antioch Shocktroopers, elite and heavily armed soldiers who form the backbone of the city’s offensive and defensive might. Supporting them are the New Antioch Mechanized Infantry and The Red Brigade, hardened troops equipped specifically for brutal trench warfare and prolonged campaigns. Combat Engineer Units serve as both tacticians and technicians, maintaining siege weaponry, constructing fortifications, and deploying experimental technologies on the battlefield. Artillery Battalions wield devastating siege weapons capable of shattering demonic lines and breaching enemy strongholds with relentless bombardments.

Beyond the battlefield lies the Office of the Propagation of Virtue, a grim organization functioning as internal security, intelligence service, and religious police. They safeguard the city’s darkest secrets and enforce unwavering obedience to Church doctrine. Hidden beneath Antioch are the Church Laboratories, clandestine facilities where horrific experiments are performed upon humans in order to create superhuman monstrosities, such as the Communicants, for use against the forces of Hell. Towering above it all are the Shrine Anchorites: metallic battle shrines embedded with entombed martyrs and fused into the seventy-seven colossal towers of New Antioch’s walls, where they maintain an eternal vigil day and night.

You may also decide how the Principality of New Antioch perceives you, ensuring their loyalty and obedience. They may see you as a Meta-Christ, Christ Himself, a Paladin, the Lord incarnate, or any other figure that would compel them to recognize your authority. Should you choose to appear as a Meta-Christ, the faction within New Antioch devoted most fervently to that specific figure will experience greatly heightened zeal and worship. If you choose to appear as Christ Himself, all factions that venerate the Meta-Christs will likewise unite beneath your rule with fanatical devotion. However, if you possess any add-ons connected to this Object of Power, the people of Antioch will inevitably perceive you as that entity, regardless of your own wishes. Additionally, all things a part of this OoP are in a personal Dimension, which if you wish you can seamlessly and retroactively fuse with the world where you choose. You can access the pocket dimension at will, and grant others access to through specialized Alchemical alterations you can grant with a touch, and a small amount of biomass, these also enhance them to beyond Peak Human ability, though still below all Communicant's.
objects.title: The Faithful of New Antioch (Trench Crusade)

addons.text:
Your Cursed Energy Manipulation has turned you into a Taboo Child, an abnormal human who inherently attracts curses. Due to the misfortunate circumstances that cause curses to gather around you so easily, aberrations occur with great frequency in your vicinity. You possess the ability to manipulate the Curse directly, allowing you to freely create Amasogi at will. Amasogi are objects that bear a powerful wish from a Host and are imbued with large quantities of cursed energy, transforming them into supernatural entities that lack sentience and human-like bodies, driven solely to fulfill their user’s wish.

With sufficient time and effort, you are capable of creating a Tsukumogami in a far shorter time frame than one would naturally require to form. You may also use curse manipulation to imbue spiritual energy into others, whether human or Tsukumogami. Unlike the original method, this ability requires only physical contact to activate, and with enough practice, it may even be performed from a distance.

Lastly, you gain access to Domination, a technique that stands in opposition to both Ascension and Possession. Rather than the Tsukumogami inhabiting the human host, Domination allows the human to possess the Tsukumogami instead, forcibly drawing out power beyond its natural limits. As with Ascension, the user gains superhuman physical capabilities and can channel the Tsukumogami’s power through their own body. However, as the inverse of Ascension, Domination actively drains the Tsukumogami’s energy, placing immense strain upon it and potentially causing it to break.
addons.title: Taboo Child (Tsugumomo)

objects.text:
You have become the owner of a Tsukumogami, specifically a Tsugumomo: an object that has developed a soul over a long period of time. Tsugumomo were once ordinary objects or tools that gained life and the ability to assume human form at will, thanks to the influence of humans and the Curse. You may choose any kind of object or tool to be your Tsugumomo, as there is no limit to the type—any object can potentially become one, given enough time for the manifestation to occur. You may also determine your Tsugumomo’s personality and appearance. Additionally, by calling your Tsugumomo by their true name, you may give them an order they cannot refuse, provided it is not unreasonable.

A Tsugumomo can die from injuries just like any ordinary person. When this happens, they revert to their object form in a broken state, which may be repaired—unless the damage is beyond restoration, in which case they are truly dead. While they can eat food, they require spiritual energy from a human each day to survive, gained through their bond of ownership. Without this, a Tsugumomo’s energy will quickly deplete until they revert to an ordinary object—a state considered death for them, from which they are unlikely to return.

A Tsugumomo’s abilities fall into two broad categories: fundamental abilities and personal abilities. Fundamental abilities stem from their physical form and require little spiritual energy to perform. These include changing between human and object form, creating clone bodies, or altering size. Tsugumomo can also partially manifest their object form while in human shape, such as projecting a weapon’s blade from an arm or producing a complete version of themselves as a tool for personal use. Over time, they may refine these powers, developing new techniques and ways to manipulate their object form.

Personal abilities, on the other hand, are more varied and unique to each Tsugumomo, requiring greater energy to use. These are tied to the object’s original nature and often possess supernatural qualities—for example, an hourglass capable of manipulating time or dice capable of influencing fate. However, Tsugumomo are also bound by the limitations of their original forms, such as sheaths or covers, which can immobilize them if applied. They are also vulnerable to items with symbolic significance against them.

Finally, you may achieve Ascension with your Tsugumomo, a state that requires not only a high level of mastery and skill but also a deep bond with them. In Ascension, you and your Tsugumomo enter perfect synchronization, merging minds to drastically enhance combat ability—though it can only be initiated through mutual agreement. During this state, your hair turns white, a spiral sigil appears on your forehead, and your irises become ringed in white. Ascension grants temporary superhuman feats and greatly amplifies your power, but its duration depends on your stamina. Once it ends, you are left severely weakened—exhausted, drained of energy, and unable to move for an extended period. For this reason, it should be used only as a last-resort trump card.
objects.title: Tsukumogami (Tsugumomo)

addons.text:
You have subdued and subjugated the Bull of Heaven, binding its immense power to your will. Through this, you have assimilated Gugalanna, fully mechanized it, and transformed it into an Aletheian Ship of the same class as yourself. Now reborn as your subordinate vessel, its allegiance has shifted entirely to you and your Pantheon, abandoning all of its old loyalties.

This monumental process has come at the cost of a portion of your Functionality/Authority. Yet, in return, elevating Gugalanna to unparalleled heights. Its power now rivals that of a Flagship vessel, capable of blanketing entire planets in storms so cataclysmic they echo the eternal raging tempests of Jupiter itself. Furthermore, you have gained the ability to combine with Gugalanna, merging your might and its into a singular, transcendent form that amplifies both your Functionalities/Authorities to unprecedented levels, far eclipsing your zenith even before the sacrifice.

Armed with this new capability, you stand poised to claim the ultimate prize—the Divine Vessel Annulus Kronos-Crown. With Gugalanna at your side, you may seize the throne as the rightful Flagship of your fleet, cementing your dominance once and all.
addons.title: Planetary Environmental Annihilation Combat Fortress Gugalanna

addons.text:
Your dominion over the heavens has reached its pinnacle. By securing the absolute loyalty of the Bull of Heaven itself, Nimbus has deemed you worthy of its complete devotion—for if even Gugalanna bows to your will, then so too shall it. In recognition of your supremacy, the two have undergone a most profound fusion, intertwining their essence into a singular, cohesive entity, reforged to serve you without question.

This symbiosis has unified their command over the sky, winds, storms, and clouds, reshaping their Mysteries into a seamless existence. Nimbus, in this act, now fully envelops Gugalanna, becoming its flesh, muscle, and hide while taking control of the perpetual storm that once wreathed the beast. In this new form, Nimbus can summon and command all clouds within its reach, bending the heavens themselves to its will and forgoing all niceties.

Gugalanna's physical might, on the other hand, has been vastly enhanced, its resilience bolstered beyond measure. Nimbus's storm-forged body serves as both armor and lifeblood—its cloud-flesh hardens against attacks, regenerates by drawing in new material, and grows denser through compression. At its core, this fusion retains nearly all of Gugalanna's original power, ensuring that even in this new state, it shall remain a force of nature incarnate. More than that, the boundless energy within Nimbus enables the beast to accumulate and unleash staggering storms, its form acting as a vast reservoir of static charge—an endless tempest contained within its very being.

With this transformation comes newfound abilities. You may now conjure lesser manifestations of Gugalanna's skeletal form, shaped from Nimbus's cloud-flesh, to serve you in battle. These spectral echoes can act as shields, forming rib-like barriers to guard against attacks, strike down foes with the force of a descending hoof, or crash into the battlefield as storm-wrought constructs. The fusion's sheer resilience may also allow you to wield its vast reserves of lightning with little restraint, knowing that Nimbus can swiftly replenish its stores.

What once stood as two titanic forces of nature has now become one—a relentless storm and an unstoppable beast—fused in perfect harmony.
addons.title: [Lord of the Upper Planes]

objects.text:
Gugalanna, the Bull of Heaven—the greatest Divine Beast of Mesopotamia. When unleashed, this colossal creature heralds doom across the lands. Its earth-shaking bellows resound across the heavens like thunder, reverberating through mountains and valleys alike. Wherever it moves, storm clouds converge, veiling the sky in ominous darkness whilst cascading rains descend, drowning the lands in unending floods. While its very breath commands the wind, unleashing ferocious gales, shredding and clawing the earth itself, and uprooting all that stands in their path.

Only the combined might of Enkidu and Gilgamesh, at the zenith of their power, managed to bring down this creature, and even then, theirs was a fierce and grueling battle—a testament to the beast's boundless might.

To call Gugalanna large would be an understatement, a description that scarcely does justice to the grandeur of its form. This towering beast rivals mountains in stature, casting a shadow vast enough to swallow entire cities. With a single step of its mighty hoof, Gugalanna can lay waste to whole metropolises, shattering the earth beneath its crushing weight and reducing them to naught but mere rubble.

While encircling, it is a perpetual tempest—a hurricane stretching 500 km wide, a vortex of roaring winds and darkened skies that bends to its every whim. In its dominion over the storms, skies, and winds, Gugalanna can expand, command, and magnify this colossal tempest as it desires, an awe-inspiring authority capable of shaping the heavens and earth alike.

You now possess the ability to summon and command Gugalanna as you see fit. But, be warned—each time you call upon this beast, it shall bring calamities in its wake, capable of razing cities and toppling nations. And if, by some minuscule chance, Gugalanna were to be slain, you shall be able to summon it once more after a week has passed since it had been laid to rest.
objects.title: Bull of Heaven (Type-Moon)

addons.text:
Finally…

Trimmau has achieved the ultimate dream she always longed for and took pride in.

Becoming a Terminator.

With an amorphous liquid-mercury body, her specialty in statistical analysis and pattern recognition made it possible for her to assimilate and perfectly replicate the technological marvels of Cyberdyne Systems, both from Skynet’s timeline and from Legion’s. She is also capable of imitating the feats of any Terminator model.

All of this, of course, is only possible so long as her magic and inherent abilities allow her to mimic their technology to a reasonable extent. For example, without a magic or mechanism that permits time manipulation, she cannot replicate the time-travel technology Skynet designed during the war.
addons.title: Trimanator

objects.text:
Supreme Mystic Code: Volumen Hydrargyrum (also known as Trimmau) is seen as the summit of both the El-Melloi and automata magecraft. Consisting of liquid mercury, she can turn into a nearly infinite number of shapes such as a maid, various weapons and a horse. While the automata is in maid form, she is adept in a multitude of professions like bodyguarding and cleaning.

However, this is not Volumen Hydragyum’s true purpose. Trimmau specialises in statistical analysis and pattern recognition. This can be used track footprints or analyse data to come to a conclusion much like a computer can.  Both magical and mundane hacking come easy to Trimmau due to these abilities.

If you have some sort of magical ability, Trimmau may be used as a familiar to increase the preciseness of your control and to link senses with her.
objects.title: Volumen Hydrargyrum (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
You have acquired your own order of the Adepta Sororitas, known as the Sisters of Battle, the Daughters of the Emperor, and, plainly, the Sisterhood. Whether they view you as the Emperor reborn, a living saint, or something else entirely, you are now the undisputed leader of the order. The sisters are ferocious warriors, feared by any who dare to stand before their wrath.

What sets them apart from the regular fighters is not only their strength but also their unwavering devotion to you. Their loyalty is unshakeable and unbreakable; their resolve is so fierce, so absolute, that it drives them beyond the limits of mortals. Whatever expectation one might place upon them, they will strive to exceed it.

The Sisters under your command number anywhere from 5,000 to 50,000 members; Additional members can be gathered from any world, and trained easily to become just as experienced as the rest of the members in record time.

Your branch of the Adepta Sororitas also includes any famous members of the order, both living and dead, such as Alicia Dominica, Ephrael Stern, Saint Celestine, and many other individuals. This is not even accounting for the various members who are not notable, but have still spent years training to become Adepta Sororitas.

Some members of the Order have a chance of being a psyker, as well as a small contingent being navigators. Optionally, as they are separate from the warp dangers, the powers they wield can be mitigated should you wish.

As the new leader of the Adepta Sororitas, you possess a palace pocket dimension with all the facilities required to house all members of the order, train new recruits, and produce all the necessary wargear.
objects.title: Adepta Sororitas Sanctorum (Warhammer: 40k)

addons.text:
You have gained command of a standard-sized regiment of elite Catachan Jungle Fighters—approximately 25,000 highly trained special forces operatives.

Catachans are physically superior to peak human standards, possessing immense muscle mass (though still far below that of Space Marines). They are capable of carrying and firing a heavy bolter—typically a crew-served or vehicle-mounted weapon—as if it were a standard rifle. Renowned for their resilience, they can survive injuries that would be instantly fatal to others and endure environmental toxins and poisons that would kill an ordinary human within seconds.

Hailing from a high-gravity death world, their physiology has adapted to constant strain, resulting in exceptional strength, endurance, and muscle density. They are highly proficient in hand-to-hand combat and are known to engage Orks in close quarters and prevail.

Catachans commonly wield weapons such as the “Catachan Fang,” a massive 20-inch blade, and the “Devil’s Claw,” a sword-like weapon with a hollow spine partially filled with mercury to enhance balance and striking power. Their sheer toughness and physicality have earned them the nickname “baby Ogryns.”

In addition, you possess the means to artificially “evolve” new Catachans, as well as domesticated and forever loyal versions of Catachans Fauna and Flora, ensuring that the regiment can be replenished should it suffer significant losses.
addons.title: Catachan Jungle Fighters

addons.text:
You possess the means to train, create, and indoctrinate your own Death Korps of Krieg, though you arent limited to merely using any of these new methods to make Kriegers. You begin with approximately 100,000 Kriegers, all of whom revere you as the Emperor himself.

They believe their ancestors’ sins were so grave that only unending sacrifice—fighting and dying in your name—can atone for them. Guided by the creed, “In life, war. In death, atonement,” they will fight to the bitter end regardless of the outcome. Retreat is unthinkable to them; instead, they willingly undertake suicidal charges as acts of repentance, earning their reputation as a “cult of sacrifice.”

Uniquely, these Kriegers possess the ability to “respawn.” Upon death, they are reborn within a designated area of your pocket dimension, fully restored and equipped with all their original gear. Their previous bodies, and gear vanish upon this rebirth. However, the process is not immediate—it takes approximately one year for each fallen soldier to return.
addons.title: Death Korps of Krieg

addons.text:
Every one of your soldiers has attained the absolute pinnacle of Cadian training, layered atop all prior experience. On Cadia, discipline began the moment a child could hold a weapon—learning to field-strip and fire a lasgun before they could read. As teenagers, they served in “Whiteshield” platoons, gaining real combat experience against threats from the Eye of Terror before formally joining the Imperial Guard. Cadia was a world where every citizen was a soldier, forging individuals mentally hardened against horrors that would break ordinary humans.

As a result, your entire force is elevated to beyond peak human proficiency in all aspects of warfare, maintaining the highest attainable levels of physical capability, mental resilience, and tactical skill at all times.

In addition, all of your forces are completely immune to corruption. Even if the Ruinous Powers themselves focused their full will upon them, not a single soldier would falter in their loyalty or devotion to you.

You may also choose for any or all of them to develop minor beneficial mutations, reflecting their "proximity" to the Eye of Terror during their "upbringing".
addons.title: Training of a Cadian

objects.text:
You have gained command of a vast Astra Militarum battlegroup—roughly one million soldiers equipped with full 42nd Millennium wargear. These troops are drawn from a wide variety of planets, Generally they will be "Generic" Guardsmen of no particular note, though you may include any kind or amount of Abhumans in your Battlegroup.

Every soldier under your command is unwaveringly loyal, highly motivated, and utterly devoted to you and whatever cause you choose. You may also determine how they perceive you: as the Emperor himself, inspiring fanatical zeal; as a Primarch, commanding absolute reverence; or simply as a Commissar, earning disciplined respect. Regardless, their loyalty remains unbreakable.

They are equipped with top-tier gear appropriate to their roles. While lasguns are often jokingly referred to as “flashlights,” this reputation stems from the fact that they are commonly used against threats massively far beyond humans.

In addition, you possess a pocket dimension that you can enter at will and allow others to access as well. This space contains effectively limitless and restocking food, water, shelter, gear, and entertainment, along with extensive propaganda systems that maintain exceptionally high morale and can indoctrinate new recruits to share the same loyalty and perception of you as your existing forces, albeit with individual minor varience in the view. It also includes full infrastructure for training new soldiers from any population you encounter.

However, caution is advised when recruiting visibly mutated individuals, abhumans, or non-humans. Your forces originate from the deeply xenophobic and human-supremacist Imperium of Man, and such differences may create tension despite their loyalty, and even extremely high amounts of Self hatred in said Non human, mutated, or abhuman forces.
objects.title: Astra Militarum Battlegroup (Warhammer: 40K)

objects.text:
You are now the proud owner of a Gyrinx, a creature that resembles a large Terran domestic cat. The Gyrinx can grow up to a metre in length and has very thick, fluffy fur, and bright eyes. Gyrinx are not truly sentient, but they possess an astounding ability to empathise with other creatures, forming a mental bond with their owner that is comparable to true friendship. This empathic connection is of great benefit to the owner, as it enhances the speed of thought and action while the Gyrinx is nearby.

What benefit the Gyrinx gains from this relationship is unclear. However, there is evidently some deep-seated need being fulfilled, as a Gyrinx without an owner will actively seek out and adopt another sentient creature.

Curiously, after bonding with a new owner the Gyrinx undergo a gradual metabolic change that allows them to come to resemble their owner physically, temperamentally, and in habit. It takes a period of several solar weeks to establish a complete relationship with the new owner.
objects.title: Gyrinx (Warhammer: 40k)

addons.text:
Now you are a true Warboss—the mightiest, greenest, and smartest Ork in your horde.

You are always twice as big as any other Ork in your horde, and you are a master at leading and commanding it. All you need to do is strike hard against the discontented and lead your Orks into new battles.

In addition, your horde grows tenfold in every respect: up to 10,000 Boyz, 100,000 Gretchin, and Snotlings. You are joined by 1,000 Ork Nobz and hundreds of specialists (Oddboyz).

Ork clans with their own unique aesthetics, abilities, and culture are forming within your horde.

It may be a small WAAAGH—but perhaps it’s just the beginning of something grand. You can reach for the stars and... Turn them GREEN!
addons.title: I'm a Warboss!!!

addons.text:
By standard orkish measures, your horde stands out for its “un-orky” nature. It thrives on skills uncharacteristic of orks, such as tactics, strategic planning, and… The ability to hide or retreat.

Your fighters aren’t just mindless savages who charge at the enemy by the shortest route. They possess tactical thinking, cunning, and a capacity for calculation. And they not only possess these skills but also quickly hone them.

In essence, your entire horde consists of orcish Kommandos who can outmatch even the most prepared opponents in stealth and treachery.
addons.title: Blood Axes (Warhammer: 40k)

addons.text:
Your horde has grown to unprecedented proportions and has become a true WAAAGH!! capable of shaking the very stars.

You now command 10 million Orks, and the number of Gretchins exceeds that tenfold.

Your horde includes every type of Ork, every clan, and the Oddboyz. Your forces include not only powerful planetary troops, but also several dozen ships capable of transporting the horde to new planets for further conquests.

Now you are not just a Warboss, but a figure closely watched by Gorka and Morka. With enough effort, you can make the entire Galaxy tremble at your might.
addons.title: The Great WAAAGH!!! (Warhammer: 40k)

addons.text:
Now your orks boyz know the legendary art of painting themselves, their weapons, and their equipment purple. What does this mean? It means invisibility.

One has only to remember that painted weapons and equipment are easy to lose and will have to be searched by touch. And your boyz... If they get too carried away with this "tricky" art, they may forget that they themselves do not exist and simply disappear.
addons.title: The Legendary Purple Orks (Warhammer: meme)

objects.text:
You have become the recognized Warboss of your own Ork horde, whom the Orks regard as the BIGGEST and GREENEST—even if you're not an orc, a little magical fairy.

Your horde consists of 1,000 regular Ork boyz and about 10,000 Gretchin and Snotlings, who will provide support.

At the start, you won’t have specialists, ranks, or clans, but with every battle, your horde will grow, and the surviving Orks will develop. The fallen will be replaced by new boyz. As long as you are alive, your horde cannot be completely destroyed.

You can guide the horde’s development, but for the most part it will evolve as a self-sustaining ecosystem (including Squigs and mushroom beer), allowing it to handle challenges and threats on its own. The ecosystem will generate the most suitable types of Orkoids and Oddboyz, specialized Orks such as Mekboyz or Weirdboyz, as well as specific cultural subgroups, including clans and other “hobby” movements.

For your safety, you can disable the “uncontrolled” growth of the Ork ecosystem via spores, ensuring only the level necessary to sustain the horde. Without you or your horde, the remaining ecosystem will quickly fall into ruin and die out.

If you don’t want to lead the troops yourself, you can appoint one ork as Warboss. He will gain increased growth and development rates. You’ll remain safe, as no one will pay you any unnecessary attention or act aggressively toward you. The appointed Warboss will regard you as a highly valued advisor.
objects.title: Horde of Orks (Warhammer: 40k)

objects.text:
You gain the lifelong allegiance of a squad of five Ironkin — true machine intelligences clad in rugged, void-hardened steel chassis.

Each is custom-forged and specialized for a distinct role of your choosing: Steeljack shock troopers, engineers, medics, logistics specialists, combat pilots, miners, surveyors, artisans, scientists, Wayfinders, or nearly any other vocation known among the Kin. Their frames and equipment are tailored to excel in that role while remaining fully capable individuals beyond it. Over time they continue to learn, refine their skills, upgrade their chassis, and, when circumstance demands, develop entirely new areas of expertise.

Though each possesses their own personality, preferences, and mannerisms, they regard you as a trusted companion and equal. They operate with professionalism, sound judgement, and genuine willingness to support the group’s goals. They require little supervision, readily interpret complex instructions, devise creative solutions, and adapt to the unexpected.

Should an Ironkin’s body suffer catastrophic destruction, the microfield generators woven into their Cerebral Unit almost always ensure the core survives intact. The CU can later be installed into a newly forged chassis with no loss of memory, identity, or accumulated experience. Nevertheless, the loss of a body is a deeply personal and traumatic event for them, and should never be treated lightly.
objects.title: Ironkin Cohort (Warhammer: 40k)

addons.title: Mechanical Guards
addons.text:
Now, Angel Forge is protected by nearly a thousand battle-automatas or its own full-fledged Legio Cybernetica cohort consisting of 200 manipulus. This formidable and fearless force is capable of tearing apart, crushing, and incinerating any enemy that dares to attack your forge.

If you have 2 Legio Cybernetica purchases, Angel Forge will begin producing 1 full-fledged Legio Cybernetica cohort once a year without any effort or resources on your part.

If you have the Battleclade Servitor upgrade, the cohort guarding the Angel Forge will receive the exact same enhancement, and every newly produced Legio Cybernetica cohort will also be enhanced.

objects.text:
With your first purchase, you gain access to a formidable force—a full squad of 5 battle automata from the Legio Cybernetica. These can be any commonly used Imperial Robot models (also known as battle-automata) in any base configuration of your choice; you can select different models or stick to a single model with a selection of individual weapon configurations.

By default, the battle-automata of the Legio Cybernetics follow a fairly rigid programming system based on combat protocols, due to the techpriests’ fear of a Silica Animus (or AI) uprising; this significantly limits their flexibility and requires constant supervision. However, you can opt for a more “heretical” approach and grant the machines greater autonomy in decision-making within the framework of your commands or your chosen doctrine of operations, though this will require insight, talent, or a reckless disregard for collateral damage.

In addition to the robots, you’ll receive a neural archive containing all the skills and knowledge needed to operate your manipula, perform maintenance, and manage it, including basic combat situations.

In addition to the basic systems, your robots will be equipped with several archeotech systems, such as an auto-repair module (though it can only be used for repairs outside of combat) and a nearly inexhaustible energy source.

With your second purchase, you’ll receive a full cohort consisting of 200 manipulas (or ~1,000 robots), which were usually enough to destroy entire cities and countries. You’re free to choose any models and weapon configurations for them from those available to the Adeptus Mechanicus.

While these machines may be a pale shadow of what was once available to humanity, their destructive power remains as impressive as ever.
objects.title: Legio Cybernetica (Warhammer: 40k)
Officio Assassinorum Temples (Warhammer: 40k)

addons.title: Soul Restored
addons.text:
You have done something that the Necrons have been searching for a while to accomplish. You have managed to give the Necrons the souls they lost, and they are free, no longer shackled by the weight of not being able to feel emotions, and they have regained all memories that were corrupted by not having souls. Along with this, while they don't have their biological bodies back, they still possess their necrodermis, and their soul has somehow made the necrodermis vastly more effective.

This also allows them to seemingly invent new things at a pace exceeding what they could before. Now that the spark of their soul is back, they can innovate at a much faster pace; before, it might have been halted by their lack of a soul; they can create new technology faster.

Another benefit to this is that they no longer need to worry about permanently dying, as they have figured out how to do something similar to the Eldar now that they have their souls back in that they can move their souls into new bodies, so even if a Necrodermis body would be beyond repair to the normal Necron, where they would ordinarily be forced to stop fixing a Necron that couldn't be resurrected anymore, they can instead transfer their soul into a new body, thus never truly dying unless they are destroyed at the soul level.

addons.title: Body Restored
addons.text: You have done something that the Necrons have been searching for a while to accomplish. You have managed to give the Necrons the biological bodies they lost. Several Necrons have all been attempting to figure out how to transfer themselves into the bodies of humans, such as the Cryptek Illuminor Szeras, who has been experimenting on humans, Aeldari and other species in an attempt to download the Necron consciousness back into flesh-and-blood bodies. Through the Omnitrix, you have returned the Necrons to their original bodies of the Necrontyr; however, they are no longer afflicted by the sickness that plagued their original Necrontyr bodies. Of course, this doesn't just mean that they completely lose the Necrodermis bodies, as that has been replaced both by Necrodermis body armour and the ability for the Necrons to transfer their minds into the Necron bodies they left behind when fighting enemies, allowing for them to get the best of both worlds in being alive again but still being the unkillable force that they are known for. However, unless you have taken Souls Restored, they still don't have souls. Another benefit is that your Omnitix now also has access to a Necron transformation as well as a Necrontyr transformation. The Necron transformation would be their Necrodermis bodies with the ability to survive attacks that would kill an ordinary person, and technology literally built into their forms. The Necrontyr transformation would be the biological body of the Necron. You would also have several subspecies transformations for the Necron body, with enough differences in their bodies from their caste system to warrant a few subspecies transformations.

objects.text:
What is this? You have somehow got your hands on some activation codes for a Necron Legion straight from the hands of Szarekh, also known as the Silent King. With these codes you have gained control over a substantial army of Necrons under your command that all view you as their overlord or perhaps even on the same level as the Silent King given that you are using these codes to activate them even if you happen to be a human. 

While you don't exactly have a Tomb World you do have the next best thing in the vast Necron Legion that consists of 1000 Necron Warriors,100 Lychguards, 10 Crypteks and thousands of Canoptek Spyders that repair and maintain the various Necrons under your command.

Each of these Necrons has the experience of fighting in the War in Heaven  and beyond into the 41 Millenium. They have the skills necessary to back up the claim that the Necron practically won the War in Heaven with how badly they were beating the old ones. However that sadly does mean that the Necron under your command do not posses souls as that got eaten by the C’tan just like every other Necron they would very much appreciate it if you could find some way to give them their souls back or return them to a normal Necrontyr body.

This also comes with everything necessary for the maintenance of the Necron and the resurrection protocols necessary for the Necron to return to your base and self repair before the enemy can completely destroy them along with various weapons that the Necron are known for when sending out Necron Warriors and Lychguards.
objects.title: Undying Legions (Warhammer: 40k)

objects.text:
You now command your own Vigil of Anathema Psykana—Sisters of Silence—numbering roughly one thousand elite null-maidens. Their potent blank/pariah genes allow them to negate and suppress any form of psychic ability as well as any power derived from extradimensional or dimensional entities, completely nullifying Parahumans in the process. They also have extensive modifications that bestow them with physical abilities on the level of Adeptus Astartes, with skill in combat on the same level. 

This Vigil possesses full conscious control over their null nature and knows that you are the reason they can wield it so precisely, a fact that fuels a level of zealotry toward you so intense it would make even the Imperium’s most fanatical citizens uneasy. 

This includes a personal pocket dimension containing a fully outfitted military base, complete living quarters for all Sisters, private chambers for you, and the knowledge required to craft specialized implants granting others controlled access to the dimensional space. You may optionally fuse this pocket dimension with any other Object of Power that generates its own dimensional realm, such as Shadow Garden (eminence in shadow).
objects.title: Vigil of Sisters Of Silence (Warhammer: 40k)

objects.text:
A fully manned and equipped cohort is placed under your command, consisting of Skitarii—cybernetically enhanced soldiers of the Adeptus Mechanicus cult—who are distinguished by their tireless endurance, fanatical religious devotion, and terrifying, mathematically precise efficiency.

The Skitarii’s bodies are filled with various cybernetic implants that transform them into terrifyingly lethal and resilient fighters. Cybernetic limb prostheses allow them to march and fight tirelessly for many days and weeks without rest, while sensors and targeting systems enable them to deliver deadly-accurate fire at any range. Neurosync implants and communication systems allow them to fight in perfect synchronization and continuously exchange information both with each other and with command. If one of them sees something, every soldier sees it.

Your Skitarii are equipped with the deadliest weapons that the Adeptus Mechanicus grants only to its most loyal servants, along with effective protective gear and equipment.

Under your command will be a full Skitarii Cohort consisting of 3 maniples of 120 Skitarii each (a total of 360 Skitarii), supported by 48 Sydonian Dragoons and 12 Onager Dunecrawlers. You can choose the specialization of your Skitarii yourself (Ranger, Vanguard, or another) and freely select weapons for them from the available arsenal, as well as replace the support vehicles with other models—even those typically used by the Astra Militarum (though in your case, these may be the rarest and most technologically advanced models)—while maintaining the same numbers: 48 light vehicles and 12 tanks.

Despite their small numbers, the warriors of the Machine God will easily outmatch even ten times as many ordinary mortal soldiers, bringing death to the latter in dozens of the most brutal ways.
objects.title: Skitarii Cohort (Warhammer: 40k)

addons.text:
Your company has recently acquired the company which embodies the Weaver's presence on Earth, the Japanese keiretsu Shinzui. The staff of this company includes as many supernaturals as their (former, now that you own them both) competitors at Pentex. Their association with the Weaver means that their products are generally higher quality & better for society, but they discourage individuality and freedom (if anyone embodies the concept of proprietary software, it's Shinzui).

Rather than Formori, they use "Drones", beings possessed by a Stasis spirit, emptied of all individuality and subordinated to the vast machine of society that the Weaver represents. They are part of a hivemind known as "OneSong".

Just as with Pentex and the Wyrm, Shinzui employees are loyal to you above the Weaver, and the company will also establish itself in any other worlds you visit.
addons.title: Shinzui Industries

addons.text: Pentex has expanded and now possesses the business responsible for Mystic Eye Collection. For some reason, you have replaced Rita Rozay-en as the person in charge of the collection and dispersion of Mystic Eyes; this includes the train, Rail Zeppelin, that houses auctions across Europe. Pentex has found a way to clone Mystic Eye, although not at the same level as the original; perhaps with time, they will eventually be able to match the potency that an authentic Mystic Eye would produce. Your current stock of Mystic Eyes has any that would naturally be collected; however, with time, perhaps this new branch responsible for creating new Mystic Eyes could find a way to create new, original Mystic Eyes.
addons.title: Rail Zeppelin

addons.text:
Pentex has made a few mergers and acquisitions with some other supernatural firms, as well as having their lawyers win a couple important court battles, meaning that now your company isn't just as wealthy as an entire nation, it effectively is one. The extraterritoriality ruling now spreads to whatever world you've introduced Pentex to, allowing you to create sovereign corporate exclaves on your owned land. This means that you don't have to pay any taxes on the majority of your assets, and things like "laws" and "regulations" basically don't apply (unless you yourself wrote them, of course!).

On top of this, you gain many of the assets of the Sixth World's megacorporations. If you only own Pentex, you get the corporations from North America and their assets, like Ares Macrotechnology, Horizon, NeoNET, Aztechnology, Cross Applied Technologies, Trans-Orbital, DocWagon, Lone Star, The Atlantean Foundation, Universal Omnitech, various real world brands, and so on. If you have Shinzui as well, then on top of that you gain the Japanacorps and their assets, like Renraku Computer Systems, Mitsuhama Computer Technologies, Evo (formerly Yamatetsu), Shiawase, the former Fuchi Industrial Electronics, Shibata Construction & Engineering, Yakashima Technologies, Yokogawa, Monobe International, various real world brands, & so on. Either way, you also gain the resources of the Corporate Court as an organization, including the Zürich-Orbital Gemeinschaftsbank and their space station.
addons.title: The Corporate Council (Shadowrun)

addons.text:
Pentex has acquired the assets of the numerous "Wings" of "The City" as part of their expansion into South Korean and extradimensional markets. This includes the Lobotomy Corporation & Limbus Company, Hongyuan Bioengineering Group, K-CORP, MDM Enterprises, Nagel und Hammer, RRR, Salpippyeo Agroindustries, TimeTrack Corporation, WARP Corp, the Head (A Corp), Eyes (B Corp), & Claws (C Corp), several Fixer Offices (such as MultiCrack, Fanghunt, Firefist, Tri-Axe, Hook, Dawn, Full-Stop, Streetlight, Gaze, Wedge, Cane, The Udjat, Jeong's Office, Yun's Office, Rosespanner Workshop, Molar Office & Molar Boatworks, and many more), the Associations (such as Hana, Zwei, Shi, Liu, Seven, and the others less detailed), and the other Wings about which not as much is generally known.

This will allow for new opportunities in effectively instantaneous transit, miraculous energy generation, medical panaceas, human cloning for medical or military purposes, security and PMC services, augmentations fitting any taste or methodology, specialized anomalous retrieval and capture services beyond the current capabilities of Pentex First Teams, anomalous containment and research, and a great deal of new real estate.
addons.title: Wings Of The World (Project Moon)

addons.text:
Pentex is now expanding it's operations to the interstellar scale, thanks to your inheritance of the von Valancius estate. Due to certain heretical fields of research pursued by the late Theodora von Valancius, the sections of the Koronus Expanse owned by the dynasty have been spatially condensed into the inside of a cloudy glass sphere by means of some form of Warp art or Xenos technology, ready to be deployed in realspace wherever you wish. It may be retracted back inside the sphere at your command, and you may enter or leave the sphere at will with anything in your possession.

While this is an entire Imperial sector at your disposal, some highlights of your holdings include the paradise-like Agri-World and Eldar Maiden World of Janus, the exceptionally productive Industrial World of Kiava Gamma, the Civilized World of Dargonus which serves as your administrative capital, the Shrine World of Foulstone and its cloistered monastic orders, the Penal World of Vheabos VI with its slave labor economy, Navigator House Orsellio's fortress at Eurac V, the grand spaceports of Footfall and Port Wander, as well as the possessions of the other Rogue Traders in the Expanse, such as the Winterscale & Calligos dynasties.
addons.title: The von Valancius Protectorate (Warhammer: 40k)

objects.text:
Congratulations! You are now the proud new owner and CEO of the infamous mega-corporation known as Pentex. This behemoth of a corporation overshadows its competitors with an extensive network of subsidiary companies. However, it is not as simple of a company as it would appear at first glance, as those in a higher position than the average worker are not human; those in management positions are supernatural creatures such as vampires and demons, and the security guards are werewolves who have strayed from their path and fallen into Pentex's clutches.

Pentex's influence spans multiple sectors, providing the company a diverse array of revenue streams and unparalleled market control. Its extensive operations not only dominate various industries but also exert a significant influence on the global financial infrastructure, positioning the company to rival the economic power of entire nations. Pentex is involved in numerous sectors, from entertainment and food production to weapons manufacturing. Its reach goes far beyond the ordinary. Just about any field will have a shell corp funded by Pentex that rivals the top of its competitors.

With annual profits that rival the GDP of small countries, Pentex possesses the resources to shape policies, influence markets, and steer the direction of technological advancements. As you step into this pivotal role, you hold the reins of a corporation that transcends traditional business boundaries, capable of making significant impacts in political, social, and environmental arenas. Welcome to the helm of an empire that stands at the forefront of global commerce and innovation.

Pentex will accompany you across various universes, establishing branches in each universe you enter. The company possesses the influence necessary to prevent itself from being compelled to divide, despite its status as a monopoly. Those employed by Pentex are loyal to you, rather than the Wyrm like in canon. They won't be dumping toxic chemicals in nature reserves for the sole purpose of pissing off the Garou, designing video games or brewing booze that drives people insane, or making customer service at O'Tolley's or Sunburst Tech Support worse to intentionally ruin people's days anymore (unless you want them to for some reason). This somehow even applies to beings purely of the Wyrm like Banes or Fomori.
objects.title: Pentex (World of Darkness - Werewolf: The Apocalypse)

objects.text:
You gain the legendary Aegis from the Xenoblade universe, a weapon of immense power capable of localized reality manipulation through higher-dimensional energy drawn from the Conduit. In simpler terms, it allows you to transform your imagination into reality, limited only by your power output and the laws of balance inherent to the universe. Your Aegis’s connection to the Conduit is entirely secure, immune to external tampering or interference, ensuring no repeat of past calamities tied to this legendary force.

The Aegis is not just a weapon but a living being, deeply connected to you as its wielder. This blade-persona can manifest as the Monado (Ontos/Alvis/Alpha), Logos’s (Malos), Pneuma’s duality (Pyra and Mythra) or the Lucky Seven, depending on your preference. While their appearance may differ, they are fundamentally the same individual. Resonating and cooperating with your blade will enhance your synergy, exponentially increasing the power you can wield.
objects.title: Aegis (Xenoblade Chronicles Trilogy)

objects.text: You have forged an unbreakable bond with a single Duel Monster Spirit of four stars or below, making them your Spirit Partner and manifesting them in the real world. Possible equivalents would be up to rank 4 or link-2. You may choose this spirit freely, though if you build a deck you have to include their card in it. Your bond can appear in any form you wish, be it a friendship, rivalry, or romantic relationship, but they will always stand loyal to you in the end. Duel Spirits can only be seen by other spirits or those with spiritual senses, and can control their degree of interaction with physical laws, such as making themselves intangible, or floating by ignoring gravity. The power they can impart on the real world is roughly equal to what a peak-strength human could achieve.
