While you yourself cannot perceive other spirits, your Spirit Partner can interact with them, and freely access the specific Spirit Realm where they come from. Even if they don't speak your language you can understand your Spirit Partner, and they can translate for other spirits. In a duel you may choose to have your Spirit Partner replace your next draw at any time, though only once per duel. Depending on the Duel Spirit's nature they will also have other powers, such as magic, fighting or crafting skills, or command abilities. With enough practice you can deepen the bond with your Spirit Partner further, gaining a part of their power and knowledge for yourself. If you are a Spirit Duelist you may bond with multiple spirits instead of a single one. They must be unique from another, four stars or below, and their combined strength cannot exceed twelve stars. All spirits you bond with must be included in your deck, and during a duel you may replace your next draw with your Spirit Partners once each per duel. If you are the King of Games you start out with an eight-star or below monster (or rank 8 or link-4) in addition to your weaker Spirit Partner(s). While much stronger than any four-star monster, their influence on the physical world is still limited, only able to destroy buildings with their attacks. Even if you train your spiritual power and deepen your bond your Spirit Partner's power will not grow past half of their strength in the Spirit Realm. By summoning spirits in physical bodies they will be able to remain in the real world and deepen their connection to it, reaching their full power with practice and experience. If you manage to bond with free spirits in any worlds you enter they do not fall under the previous limitations, though they still cannot exert their full power without a deep connection to the physical world.
objects.title: Bonded Spirit (Yu-Gi-Oh!)

objects.text:
You have acquired a Tsugai. These are beings commonly associated with yōkai, ghosts, shikigami, cryptids, and all kinds of anomalous entities of a supernatural or divine nature. Their defining characteristic is that they always exist as a pair, functioning as a single entity despite being two completely independent individuals. Furthermore, they cast no shadow of their own and cannot be detected while manifesting as spiritual entities in the physical world. They also have a lifespan of only one hundred years before suffering existential deterioration and eventually fading from existence entirely.

Whether you inherited them from a long-standing family lineage, encountered them by chance, or were simply chosen by them, the outcome is the same you have been chosen and have become a Master. There is no need for a blood contract or ritual, as you already share a spiritual bond. Unlike other Masters, your contract is stable and the Tsugai are completely loyal to you. They may serve as your bodyguards, attendants, or in whatever relationship you wish to establish with them. Keep in mind, however, that they will faithfully obey any command you give them.

The appearance, personality, and morality of your Tsugai are entirely of your own choosing. You may also design their powers, though they must always possess a dual nature. For example, a Tsugai with elemental abilities could manipulate only Fire and Water, with each member of the pair wielding its respective element. There is no restriction on the type of abilities they may possess they may range from elemental powers to magical or conceptual abilities capable of elevating their Master into a transcendent being. 

Their versatility and overall power are limited by the SP cap, but they possess the potential to grow and evolve over time. Alternatively, you may choose an existing Tsugai that has appeared or been referenced in the anime, manga, or novel.

The nature of your Tsugai toward other individuals is entirely determined by you. If you decide they are of the Kami type, they will be friendly toward everyone. If you choose the Yōkai type, they will possess a demonic nature and be extremely hostile toward anyone they encounter.

Finally, whenever a Tsugai is seriously injured or completely exhausted, it returns to its Totem form, taking the shape of a physical object whose appearance symbolizes its existence or the nature of its powers. The time required before it can be summoned again depends on the severity of its injuries or exhaustion. However, with the aid of spiritual or magical powers and a constant supply of energy, it can recover far more quickly than it normally would. The destruction of a Tsugai's Totem is equivalent to destroying its very existence.
objects.title: Tsugai (Yomi no Tsugai)

rows.title: Ally Objects of Power
rows.titleText: Note: All non-consumable Objects of Powers can be transferred to another person. When this happens, you do not lose any abilities the object unlocked or awakened (physical alterations, magic independent of the object, etc.) but any soul bonds transferred to the new owner.

objects.text: You have in your possession a rock, but not just any rock. No, you have the rock. This rock is perfectly ordinary save for three aspects. The first aspect is that it is now bound to you, and you can never lose it. No matter how hard something tries, this rock will always appear within arm's reach when no one is looking or when you intentionally summon it. The second aspect is that the rock is capable of changing its size and shape to suit your desires. From a small and smooth pebble to a rough and sharp boulder, the rock will always be in the shape you need it to be. The last and most impressive aspect is that, aside from the previously mentioned ability to change its shape and size to suit your needs, the rock is completely and totally inviolable and immutable. Nothing is capable of harming or otherwise changing the rock, no matter its potency. From high-level reality warping to universe-destroying blasts, this rock will weather all obstacles as if they didn't even exist. The rock could bathe in the physical manifestation of conceptual nothingness and destruction and it wouldn't even so much as chip. Hell, every universe across the infinite multiverses could cease to exist, and this rock will still exist, floating in the infinite nothingness as if nothing changed.
objects.title: An Ordinary Rock

objects.text:
You possess an unassuming black payment card connected to a functionally limitless supply of money.

The card can be used anywhere payment is possible and will automatically adapt to whatever form the transaction requires. Whether something would normally be purchased by card, cash, transfer, financing, escrow, or some other financial instrument, the necessary payment can be produced without limit and without creating debt or requiring repayment.

The card shift forms to accomplish this task, whether turning into a check book, a sack full of cash, or other payment method. 

Any money provided by the card is completely legitimate. The power automatically smooths over the financial records surrounding your wealth, ensuring that banks, governments, businesses, auditors, and other relevant systems always find a reasonable and internally consistent explanation for where the money came from. 

Necessary documentation, transaction histories, taxes, and proof of funds will exist as appropriate, preventing your spending from creating unexplained discrepancies or financial scrutiny simply because of its source or scale.

Money can freely be transferred away from the card into accounts, investments, businesses, trusts, physical cash, or other assets and remains legitimate afterward. In practical terms, there is no meaningful distinction between money generated through the card and ordinary wealth that you already owned.

The card does not force anyone to accept an offer or make something available for purchase. It simply ensures that whenever money is the obstacle, you possess as much as necessary.

Only you and those you permit possession of the card can access its supernatural funds.

For all practical purposes, you possess unlimited wealth, with the card quietly handling everything necessary to make that wealth function normally.
objects.title: Black Card
Conversion Token Generator
objects.text:
You have a device which, when fed a DNA sample, will produce small, coin sized tokens with a picture of the donor sample's species on the face.

When pressed to another creatures flesh and activated with a drop of their blood the token will seamlessly convert the creature into the same species as the donor sample. 

The creature will receive all of the advantages and disadvantages inherent to its new species as if it had been born that way, replacing all of the original traits with those of the new species.

addons.title: Evolution Tokens
addons.text:
The Token Generator has absorbed your Evolution Cube or Upgrade Token and gained new functions.

The machine is now capable of producing Evolution Tokens which advance the species of the creature they are used upon to a new level. 

If the creature in question had some kind of levelling system, the Evolution Token also resets the system back to the starting point. 

The creature's former levelled stats and skills become the baseline for its new species. 

Where before it had only one button and could produce only a single kind of Token, it now possess a digital interface, and the function of the Tokens generated can be customised, allowing the creation of hybrid Tokens.

If you unlocked this through Upgrade Tokens, the machine is now capable of producing those as well.

addons.title: Loyalty Tokens
addons.text:
The Token Generator now possesses additional settings and a second donor input. These allow for Loyalty Tokens to be created. Loyalty Tokens induce enforced loyalty to the donor sample used in the second input.

Additionally, the machine is now capable of producing Adoption Tokens, which not only adjust the species to match the donor sample, but are also capable of making the creature a part of the donor's bloodline. This adoption is both genetic and metaphysical. The exact relationship between donor and recipient is configurable.

When creating an Adoption Token, the second input can be used to input the other parent if desired.

addons.title: Tokens of Awakening
addons.text:
The device has a configurable digital display and an energy storage crystal and is now capable of creating Ability tokens.

Ability tokens are capable of imprinting a power or ability from the donor sample on the receiving creature. If the ability is not linked to the donor's genetics in some way, it will require a sample of the donor's energy to be stored in the crystal.

Ability tokens can not replicate skills. Only discrete abilities. A mutant power, or the ability to use magic, for example, are possible. A particular magical spell is not.

This upgrade greatly increases customisation options when creating other tokens. It is now possible to create tokens which exclude particular traits from the donor, or which no longer remove all, or even specific special traits from the recipient creature.

objects.text: This is the blade the biblical Dalilah used in the Book of Judges to cut the hair of Samson causing him to lose his inhuman strength. Legend has crystallized into making a tool that can depower anyone who's hair is cut by it until it grows back to it's original length. By some means it has ended up in your hands. In spite of it's name the Razor can take all manner of forms so long as they can feasibly be used to cut someones hair, from common barber instruments to a dagger. The blade is useless as a weapon acting as if it's completely dull but when used to cut hair it cuts regardless of resistance and durability no matter how esoteric.
objects.title: Dalilah's Razor

addons.text:
The cage is enhanced with psychic shielding derived from eldritch technologies. These psychic-infused barriers can repel both physical threats and attacks on the metaphysical plane, including mental intrusions, psychic projections, and eldritch horrors from beyond the veil. The eldritch properties of the shield make it particularly resistant to cosmic entities and dark gods, providing a versatile and nearly impenetrable defense. Any eldritch beings or reality-warpers attempting to breach the cage will face overwhelming psychic feedback, disrupting their very existence.

The module also upgrades the tethering mechanism with a <n>Dimensional Feedback Network (DFN)</n>. This network feeds real-time data on cosmic disturbances, eldritch anomalies, and dimensional shifts into the system, enabling faster and more adaptive responses to breaches or potential threats.

A Dimensional Drive (D-Drive) is incorporated, serving as a secondary power source. Drawing energy from ambient arcane forces and higher-dimensional planes, the D-Drive ensures the cage remains operational even if its primary generators are damaged or depleted. This reduces strain on the plants powering the cage and extends its longevity, potentially sustaining it for millennia. Additionally, the D-Drive allows for rapid stabilization after glitches or breaches, ensuring instant repairs in the face of cosmic phenomena.

The Blacklist feature is upgraded with Psychic Modulation, granting the user the ability to telepathically adjust the barrier’s parameters in real time. Moreover, this link enhances the user’s psychic abilities, channeling leftover computational power and excess energy to strengthen their mental prowess.
addons.title: Eldritch Drive Module

addons.text:
With the addition of the Irminsul Seedling, the Dimensional Cage forms a symbiotic connection with the leyline network created by the world tree’s roots. This connection enhances the cage’s planetary protection, fortifying it with Irminsul’s natural energy flow and the knowledge absorbed from the world. The roots entwine with the Dimensional Cage's tethering system, stabilizing reality on a deeper metaphysical level.

By tapping into the elemental energy circulating through the Irminsul-enhanced leyline network, the barrier is strengthened against reality-warping forces. This enhancement allows the cage to better resist dimensional rifts, cosmic disturbances, and energy-based attacks. The natural flow of energy also makes the barrier more fluid and adaptive to external fluctuations, minimizing glitches or vulnerabilities caused by cosmic forces.

The Blacklist feature benefits from Irminsul’s knowledge of hazardous energies and forbidden information, particularly in combating eldritch forces. While integrating chaotic data into the tree’s system can cause anomalies, the Dimensional Cage gains improved pre-emptive filtering to prevent immediate destabilization. Over time, both Irminsul and the cage adapt to these chaotic energies, increasing their resilience.

Disruptions or breaches caused by extreme cosmic events can now be automatically repaired through leyline resonance. Irminsul’s roots draw energy from the planet to heal the Dimensional Cage, closing any gaps in protection swiftly. As the leyline system becomes more established, repairs become faster and more efficient.

For optimal effect, the Dimensional Cage and Irminsul must coexist within the same dimensional reality. The natural flow of energy and information between the two ensures the planet remains secure, even under intense cosmic stress. While dangerous knowledge or chaotic energies may still cause anomalies, the combined power of the tree and the cage contains these disruptions more effectively.
addons.title: Leyline Eldritch Resonance

addons.text:
The Tablet enhances the Dimensional Cage with the ability to shield the planet not only from physical and dimensional threats but also from cosmic prophecy and fate manipulation. With the tablet fragment embedded, future outcomes, divine schemes, and predestined events involving the planet or its inhabitants are obscured from the sight of gods, fate-weavers, and other entities capable of manipulating destiny. This renders the planet’s fate entirely undetectable and impervious to outside interference.

The tablet’s ancient knowledge of Gods and Primordials further attunes the Dimensional Cage to cosmic forces. It can now recognize and categorize interdimensional or divine entities with greater precision, offering enhanced protection against Primordial Forces and Eldritch Invaders. Additionally, the Cage can provide insights into these beings’ nature, allowing for more tailored defenses based on their unique attributes.

The Fragment of Fate also grants the Dimensional Cage a <n>Reality Override</n> feature, enabling it to alter small but critical aspects of fate within its protective field. For example, certain outcomes tied to Prophecy or Cosmic Balance can be temporarily suspended, granting the planet’s inhabitants greater control over their destinies. However, the more significant the override, the more energy and focus the Cage must expend to stabilize reality afterward.

A new feature, Temporal Stasis, is imbued by the tablet fragment. When faced with severe cosmic disturbances or catastrophic breaches, such as the corpse of a GOD or a universe collision, the Cage can temporarily halt time within its barrier. This stasis effect freezes the affected area, preventing further damage and allowing repairs to proceed without further deterioration, thus ensuring reality remains intact during moments of crisis.

Finally, the tablet fragment offers a boon to sentient beings. As its holder, you can access its latent potential through the Dimensional Cage, or allow its influence to permeate the planet. This could lead to profound insights into ancient cosmic laws or the evolution of abilities based on divine and primordial powers. However, unlocking this potential requires study, experimentation, and possibly collaboration with other powerful entities.
addons.title: Database of Broken Destinies

objects.title: Dimensional Cage

objects.text:
Displacement Containers are extraordinary artifacts created by a mysterious entity. These containers are designed to store and transport entire nations, worlds, dimensions, or subspaces. Their internal space is infinite, capable of holding anything regardless of size—people, structures, animals, machines, or entire ecosystems. The contents can be preserved in stasis, halting time entirely, or allowed to progress normally, with the container simulating a fully functional environment. These containers bear similarities to those used by Brainiac in their concept and functionality.

You are provided with a set of 10 Displacement Containers. Each container is reusable, but the container must be empty in order for it to be reused. If a container is destroyed during the absorption process, it will automatically regenerate, though the process will be interrupted. 

The functionality of Displacement Containers is highly versatile. You can adjust their settings to allow for rapid absorption, though larger targets require more time. Once absorbed, the target is completely secure and cannot escape. Similarly, external forces cannot break into or compromise the container. While the absorption process is underway, the container is vulnerable to destruction, but as mentioned, it will regenerate if this occurs.

The containers have two primary features: Absorption and Placement. Absorption draws the target into the container, where it remains until you decide to release it. Placement allows you to transport the absorbed target to a new location—be it a different land, world, dimension, or subspace.  When the target is released, it will return to its normal size, so it’s important that there is enough space in the chosen location to accommodate the displaced target. Once released, the container can be reused.

Additionally, you have the ability to selectively manage the contents of the container. If harmful or malevolent elements are absorbed alongside the target, you can choose to delete these entities entirely. The containers also allow for selective absorption, enabling you to capture only specific elements, such as people or structures, for future placement.
objects.title: Displacement Containers

objects.text:
You possess a dragon egg the size of a watermelon, its surface a matte obsidian-black shell traced with faint veins of molten crimson. It weighs as much as a block of tungsten of identical volume, making it impossibly dense and requiring supernatural strength, a sturdy mount, or a fixed sanctum to move or house. The shell is functionally immune to all natural elements, shrugging off magma, deep pressure, lightning strikes, and absolute cold without a scratch, and it cannot be damaged by any mundane physical force.

Left undisturbed, the egg will hatch in one year into a classic fire-breathing dragon, a creature of immense physical power and a furnace of flame within its chest. You can accelerate this incubation by pressing supernatural materials against the shell, which it absorbs directly into itself, shaving weeks or months off the remaining time and altering the dragon's final form. Feeding it elemental essences, magical beast remains, enchanted metals, or other rare reagents causes the hatchling to integrate those properties, gaining additional breath weapons, resistances, physical mutations, or entirely new categories of magical ability commensurate with what was consumed.

The dragon inside is fully sapient and is hatched with the raw intelligence of a human infant, learning language, social cues, and morality through your direct tutelage as it matures over the years. It starts to reach maturity after 15 years and fully matures at 20, it’s aging slowing noticeably afterwards with a lifespan up to and beyond a thousand years.

The egg is imprinted solely to you as its parent and master, recognizing your presence and commands at an instinctual level that no force can overwrite. Upon hatching, the dragon can serve as your familiar provided you possess the capability to have a familiar.
objects.title: Dragon Egg

objects.text:
The Gameforge Console is a compact, impossibly advanced device capable of accepting any video game cartridge, disc, file, or digital format imaginable. Once a game is inserted, the console scans it and displays a menu allowing you to choose a difficulty level ranging from Casual to Impossible++.

When a difficulty is selected, the console activates and teleports you into a fully realized roguelike dungeon shaped from the game’s enemies, mechanics, and internal logic. Higher difficulties drastically alter the dungeon, introducing elite foes, sprawling layouts, hidden traps, special modifiers, time limits, boss gauntlets, unique win conditions, or even sealing the realm entirely to prevent premature escape. Some titles may become literally unbeatable without powers or items earned from previous runs.

Regardless of difficulty, the dungeon is not a simulation. Every monster is real, every wound bleeds, and every injury you suffer follows you back into the real world. Death inside the dungeon is as permanent as death outside it, and only your skill, strategy, and luck determine whether you walk out again. Sometimes the wisest choice is simply retreating to the entrance and abandoning the run for another day.

However, if you do clear the dungeon, you earn tangible rewards shaped by the difficulty you chose, the inherent danger of the inserted game, and your overall performance. These may take the form of weapons, artifacts, vehicles, spells, or abilities translated directly from the game’s ruleset—stat boosts, passive traits, or full-fledged superpowers. Lower difficulties or gentler games provide minor enhancements or thematic trinkets, while higher-difficulty or high-threat titles can grant legendary weapons, potent magic, powerful companions, or even reality-bending abilities.

A Casual Dragon Age run, for example, might throw you against a lone darkspawn and reward only a simple healing draught, while a Nightmare-tier Mass Effect dungeon might force you to solo the infamous Suicide Mission but grant you a loyal N7 strike team. At the highest extremes, an Impossible++ Halo dungeon may require you to survive the Fall of Reach on foot—from New Alexandria to the Pillar of Autumn—yet reward your victory with the UNSC Infinity.

Regardless of the worlds you explore, you cannot bring other people or items not physically on your person into the dungeon unless its ruleset specifically allows it, and the console requires a 24-hour cooldown after completing or escaping any run.
objects.title: Gameforge Console

objects.text:
You now own a powerful escape card that could save your life. This small, ornate card lets its owner set a specific location as their personal getaway point. Once marked, the card becomes bound to its owner—it cannot be stolen, broken, or given away unless the owner willingly removes the marker.

If you ever take fatal damage or need a quick escape, the card will instantly teleport you to the marked location. This teleportation is absolute, bypassing all forces, traps, laws, and even divine interference to ensure your escape. However, only the user can teleport—no one else can come along. Upon arrival, the location will transform into a safe zone for one hour, making it untraceable and protected from any powers. 

You will also receive minor healing to avoid death, though it won’t be a complete recovery. Poisons, curses, and crippling injuries will be weakened to stave off immediate danger, but they won’t be entirely cured.

Only one active marker can exist at a time, and after each use, the card requires a week to recharge.
objects.title: Get Out Of Jail Free Card

objects.text:
One day, a Thinker saw something they shouldn't have and tried to tell the world.

They were caught. But out of that grizzly end came the Heart, a macabre device that carries on that Thinker's self-appointed role.

The Heart is a strange device that gives off a minor S.E.P (Somebody Else's Problem) field relating to itself, causing those that perceive it to believe it unimportant and uninteresting. However, you have an immunity to this effect, allowing you to see it for what it truly is.

By directing the Heart at a subject, it will begin to whisper to you the secrets it sees, beginning with mere rumors and conjecture, but slowly building up to revealing long buried truths. This works better the more informed the heart already is, working off existing data points. You cannot direct the type of information the Heart finds, although it will generally trend towards what you don't know, or at least a fresh perspective on things that you do know.

Keep in mind that while the heart is never wrong, it doesn't always tell the full truth of the matter either and sometimes its strange choice of wording and omissions can imply deeper meaning when there is none there.

You should be able to get roughly an hour of (non-consecutive) use out of the Heart per day, albeit when it's being pushed to the end of that hour the quality of the answers will begin to drop by a noticeable amount.
objects.title: Heart of a Tattletale

addons.text: You gain the knowledge of how to create new Homunculus bodies.
addons.title: Homunculus Formula

objects.text:
An artificial body without a soul or mind. Closer to a doll than an organic or mechanical being, this vessel has the ability to shape itself to accommodate a sentience. Be it an AI, a soul, or a mental imprint, so long as the being has a conscience, the homunculus body will shelter it. 

Its true power, however, is the ability to shape itself into the ideal form to accommodate its new owner, which will happen in the course of a couple of hours. The owner has some control over the process: an AI might want to be an organic human, remain in a robotic body, or be a furry; I don't judge.

The final product's parameters must remain within the limits of what a human body could achieve, both in strength and size. While the final product can't create any ability beyond what a regular human could have, any ability inherent to the conscience will remain, such as a shinigami's spiritual energy, a psion's psychic might, or an AI's intellectual prowess.
objects.title: Homunculus

objects.text:
In many worlds, there are things you simply aren’t free to do. Sometimes needing authorization for safety or because of bureaucracy. To do those things legally, you can often get a “license” of some sort, which can be tedious or difficult to obtain.

However, with this small card, anyone who checks it will see that you are fully licensed to do whatever it is you’re trying to do, regardless of the circumstances. Never driven before, but now getting behind the wheel? You somehow have a license to drive. A ten-year-old trying to buy a gun? Your license covers that, too. It doesn’t just cover activities that would normally require a license; you could be “licensed to kill” or “licensed to commit fraud” if needed.

This license means that the government will never prosecute you or impose consequences for your actions. It doesn’t give you the skills or abilities you’re supposedly licensed for, nor does it prevent private individuals or organizations from trying to hold you accountable.
objects.title: License to ____

objects.text: This Transdimensional Enigma manifests itself as an enigmatic mystery box that spontaneously unlocks upon your arrival in your predetermined universe. Within its confines, it bestows upon you a singular power, chosen at random from the comprehensive selection of powers contained within this CYOA for free. Ranging from low-tier 1SP powers to the awe-inspiring paragon powers. Irrespective of the specific power granted, its acquisition is indelible and unalterable, becoming a permanent facet of your capabilities.
objects.title: Mystery Box

objects.text:
Originally found in Xeno territory by traitors of the Coalition of Mankind, Nyxora Sentis was smuggled back to the Inner Worlds where it quickly became a black market sensation under the street name “Mindbloom.” It became one of the most in-demand illicit botanicals for emotional enhancement, earning cult-like reverence among the underground.

The plant itself is deep matte black in color, with wide velvet-textured leaves and thick, twisting vines that shimmer faintly with iridescent blue and purple when exposed to low-wavelength light. It thrives only in high humidity and near-constant hydration, a direct result of its origin on Thalnaris V, a storm-drenched exoplanet cloaked in dense cloud cover with minimal sunlight. Direct exposure to strong sun causes its leaves to dry and curl within an hour, effectively killing the plant if not rehydrated.

Nyxora Sentis reproduces aggressively when in ideal conditions. Its root systems fragment and self-replicate with alarming speed, and during post-rain periods it releases microscopic black spores into the air that can embed into any damp surface. Colonies form overnight, and if left unchecked, the vines can dominate entire biomes in days.

In its drug form, Nyxora Sentis is harvested at night and dried to preserve the active compound Sentivexin-9. Once dried, the flower buds are crushed and cured in sealed humidifiers before being rolled into thick paper cones or packed into glass inhalers. The smoke burns violet-blue and carries a sweet, metallic tang. Users feel a slow, creeping onset, followed by sudden emotional lucidity and euphoric unity with others in proximity. Conversation flows effortlessly, personal boundaries soften, and even long-standing rivalries can melt into moments of shared understanding.

The drug bathes the user in serotonin and dopamine, creating a deeply pleasurable, floaty euphoria akin to a lucid dream. In addition, it activates key empathy centers in the brain, particularly the medial prefrontal cortex, insula, and anterior cingulate cortex, effectively pushing users into an open, emotionally permeable state. It blunts fear, softens ego defenses, and accelerates the brain’s natural ability to simulate and understand the thoughts and feelings of others. Side effects include emotional overload, emotional mimicking with nearby users, and temporary dissociation from personal identity, though most consider this a feature rather than a flaw.

You get a flowerpot worth of unprocessed Nyxora Sentis. This comes packaged with preparation recipes — including curing ratios, humidity levels, and traditional infusion methods — to properly manufacture and preserve its psychoactive properties. It also includes medical usages for the drug.
objects.title: Nyxora Sentis “Mindbloom”

objects.text: You receive one or more objects that hold powers from the shard and shardless sections of the CYOA. The amount of SP you can spend is equivalent to the total price of this choice. All the existing restrictions apply which means you cannot gain an object with Ascension or Paragon powers. You can choose the general form each each object takes but their exact appearance will be influenced by the power itself. For example, a magic power in the form of a ring would be engraved with runes while a technology power with the same form would have circuit board traces. The objects grant the power to whoever has then in their possession and can be stolen unless Essential is chosen. For powers that depend on physical of spiritual structures, like magic circuits or a chakra network, the object abstracts them away and does not change the user. As a general rule, you lose access to all powers granted by an object if you transfer it to someone else or lose possession of it.
objects.title: Object(s) of Power

addons.text: It seems that the soul you've received has accidentally been modified, and it mimics the properties of your Malleable/Smart Soul. Due to the soul's lack of sentience, it's adaptation is shaped by a much greater degree by both the environment and your own will. As with other addons, you can choose for this not to be the case, and if you purchase multiple you can choose whether some, none, or all of them possess this property.
addons.title: What Do You Mean? Souls Are Supposed To Wiggle

addons.text: The soul you've received, through totally natural processes, is of the same purity as your own soul. As with other addons, you can choose for this not to be the case, and if you purchase multiple you can choose whether some, none, or all of them possess this property.
addons.title: I Swear It's Organic

objects.text: A small mason jar containing one ethically sourced, gluten-free, non-GMO human soul. This soul is 'new', and as such lacks sentience; The jar counts as it's 'body', and any means used to study the soul within will pass through without interference. Opening the jar will allow you to remove the soul without harm, though this doesn't provide the means to do so should you not have any. If you purchase multiple, you may choose for them to either share a single jar or be divided among a number of them. Due to the jar being what counts as the body, this still qualifies as free-range by USDA standards.
objects.title: One Human Soul

objects.text:
Through the whims of coincidence, or simply due to a certain person's entertainment, you have acquired a special and somewhat unnatural music box.

This hand-sized device has the power to analyze the minds and souls of any people that touch it and play specific music that will reveal how a person is feeling, describe their personality, or reveal deep secrets, as well as take into consideration the current 'mood' and context of the people surrounding them.

Because of this, it rarely replays a song for the same individual twice, unless specifically asked to, but it does keep a tracklist of all songs played as well as for whom it was played.

It has access to all music that has ever been created or ever will exist, and it is able to remix it a bit in order to deliver a more personalized result, as well as being able to create a mini light show and manifest a floating disco ball around the area, depending on the song.

If you specifically ask it to play a 'Lullaby,' it will produce a tone that will put anyone inside an enclosed space, excluding you, to sleep. If played outdoors, that range will be limited to 50 meters.
objects.title: Sir Lull's Little Music Box

objects.text:
You have become the owner of a herd consisting of 200 cows and approximately 200 calves. Your herd has unique qualities: it never gets sick, produces maximum output, and all the necessary paperwork is always in order.

Every animal can be considered ideal in terms of productivity. The output is distinguished by its high quality and quantity.

You don’t have to manage the herd personally. You can think of it as being far away, even though you can always physically reach it. Regardless of your location, the animals receive everything they need and the best care, ensuring 100% of the potential income from their production.

If you decide to manage the herd yourself, you will be provided with all the necessary tools, equipment, and skills. Your involvement in the work will allow you to increase productivity by up to 200%. It won’t be easy, but the result is worth the effort.

Initially, the herd consists of cows, but you can replace them with other farm animals, such as sheep or pigs, in the same proportion, taking into account the average price per animal. The same rules will apply to these animals. However, they must be basic farm species.

Although it’s not gold or money, for the medieval or ancient world, this is true wealth. You’ll be able to produce about 2,400 tons of fresh milk and dairy products per year and 30 tons of meat, including 3 tons of meat byproducts, in a delivery format convenient for you, or sell a certain percentage of the produce at local prices. This doesn’t include byproducts such as manure, hides, and bones, should you need them. Milk and dairy products can be harvested daily, while meat is harvested once a week. Over the course of a year, the herd will grow by 20%.
objects.title: The Blessed Cow Herd

objects.text:
This is a small leather pouch containing thirty silver coins that were given to Judas Iscariot for betraying Jesus. Whatever were the reasons for this treachery, it served God's plan all the same, and the coins now embody this inevitability of divine will.

Each of these thirty coins can be used to 'bribe' the destiny of one single person. This will align fate in such a way that no matter the actions this person undertakes—however small or grandiose—they will always be beneficial to you, without the person even being aware of the fact. For example, an enemy general might give their army logically and strategically sound orders which will, due to some unforeseen circumstances, still lead to your victory. Someone might try to prosecute you, and yet the investigation that follows will uncover damning evidence against the prosecution themselves.

Inside the pouch you will also find a piece of parchment, inscribed with instructions and incantations to activate the coins. Once used, the coin vanishes, cementing its influence, with nothing—including death—being able to override its effect.
objects.title: Thirty Pieces of Silver

objects.text:
You possess a grand and ancient treasury, vast beyond ordinary comprehension. At its most basic level, it holds enough riches—gold, jewels, priceless heirlooms, and rare materials—to sustain you and your descendants in opulent luxury for no fewer than seven generations, all without the need to work a single day. Lavish estates, indulgent lifestyles, and boundless excess are all easily within reach. However, this wealth is not infinite. With enough time, even this mighty hoard will be diminished.

Yet the true power of the treasury lies not merely in its financial value, but in the way its contents reflect the nature of your abilities. The vault seems to have been shaped in accordance with your current powers, filled not just with riches but with treasures tailored to your strengths. Should you possess chakra, you may find weapons akin to the swords used by the 7 Swordsman of the Hidden Mist. If you wield magic, you might discover enchanted relics, arcane tomes, or powerful artifacts humming with mystical energy. The strength of these treasures scale to the amount of SP you used on your powers.

Be wary of robbers.
objects.title: Treasury

addons.title: Downgrade
addons.text: You can use Fission to retrieve Upgrade Tokens from objects you've used them on, this will revert the effected object back to its prior state.

objects.text:
A gold token that is capable of upgrading any object. Broken objects become functional again. A object that is functionable will be upgraded into the best possible version it can feasibly be. For the purposes of magical objects, or any supernatural object, they are already considered at their best if they are not notably damaged, decharged, or unusable.

The next upgrade will push the objects intended purpose a even further. The growth is flat, so extremely powerful objects won't notice any difference. A bed though for example, that is already the best bed, can be upgraded that just melts away stress, eases your mind, and allows you to sleep within minutes. Further upgrades will make this process faster, but it won't be anything special, beyond just durability.

This does not work however on anything biologically sapient, souls, or purely spiritual objects.

Each purchase gives you five  tokens. A token can be used by making it be in contact with an object, and simply will it. This works for the last person who held the object.
objects.title: Upgrade Token
Comfy Bed
objects.text:
You now own the ultimate comfortable bed, able to transform into any type of bed you know of. 

It has many features tailored for perfect rest such as changing itself to best fit its owner, able to make you instantly fall asleep if you let it, wakes you up at a time of your choosing with you being perfectly rested, fully heals you of any illness or injury over time, self cleaning and self repairing.

The rate of healing is 10% per hour of sleep.

You gain a Teigu of your choice made to be compatible with you which also unlocks and enhances your spiritual power, granting you General-level potential. If you choose Demon's Extract, you'll need to drink it yourself, but you'll be guaranteed to be able to push through it's insanity inducement thanks to your compatibility so long as you can focus on doing so for a while after drinking it. Teigu have capabilities unshown in canon, as all of them can grow alongside their user and some of their capabilities were subtle, like Wave's Grand Chariot enhancing his development speed like Incursio's evolution enhanced Tatsumi to the point he survived wielding two Teigu at once. The one thing this is guaranteed to be unable to do is bring back the dead. Additionally, if you get into a battle with another Teigu user, and both of you hold killing intent, one is certain to die.
objects.title: Teigu (Akame ga Kill)

objects.text:
"In this world, is the destiny of mankind controlled by some transcendental entity or law? Is it like the hand of God hovering above? At least it is true that man has no control, even over his own will."

You have been granted a Behelit, giving you an Apostle form of your choice, immense physical power even outside your Apostle form, & the ability to create Pseudo-Apostles. Best of all, you didn't even have to do anything monstrous or soul destroying to get it.

Your power is equivalent to an average named Apostle, like The Count, Mozgus, Grunbeld, or Rosine.
objects.title: Behelit (Berserk)

objects.text: You now have a small collection of various gadgets and tools, both those of Shinigami origin, such as Gigai made in your likeness, Denreishinki, and Urahara's Reiatsu-concealing cloaks, but also items of Quincy origin as well, like Ginto, Seele Schneider, and even Sanrei Gloves. You even have a copy of the Tenshintai of your own, though it still comes with many of the same risks.
objects.title: Urahara's Stash (Bleach)

objects.text:
Eldritch do not die naturally unless they are slain by even greater forces of power, they cannot give birth themselves even though they long for true children, these facts are immutable for the horrors of the Cosmos. So they use humans as incubation chambers for their young, those even these young are almost never true godlings. Humans have long sought ascension and you my friend have found the way ahead. 
Every purchase of this will give you one-third of an umbilical cord. Each third, when consumed, will grant you incredible insight into the workings of the universe and when all three are consumed you will ascend to Eldritch Godhood. Though this method bypasses many stages and so it have quite a few drawbacks, most prominent being that you will basically need to be nurtured and cared for like a normal baby by someone you trust for around 25 years and even then you will still not be as strong as even the Moon Presence for another 175 years. It will take you 10,000 years to become as strong as Nascent Eldritch in the CYOA starts at though admittedly by that point almost nothing will be able to challenge you anyway and those years will merely be a blip on your infinite lifespan.
objects.title: Three-Thirds Umbilical Cords (Bloodborne)

addons.text: The Golden Chest will not abide cheaters with infinite wealth but is willing to compromise. Each week you gain a single Golden Key which will allow you to open the chest with items of guaranteed maximum rarity.
addons.title: Golden Keys

addons.text:
The Golden Chest may now give Class Mods. Items which will empower one of your classes in various useful ways. Each Class Mod will also grant an Action Skill. Action Skills are powerful abilities that may be used on a cooldown and their properties may be changed based on the Class Mod you have equipped.

Typically a Class mod will have up to 6 lines which boost your stats upwards of 100% as well as upwards of 6 lines which will increase the power of skills your Class grants you upwards of 50% more power. Also Class Mods can extremely powerful modifications to your Class’s powers but often with some form of minor drawback for more powerful modifications.

You may only have one Class Mod equipped and active for each Class Slot you have access to.
addons.title: Class Mods

addons.text:
You now also gain access to the wonderful creations imagined by Tina Tina from Dragon’s Keep DLC and Wonderlands game. This includes magical and magictech weapons including both melee and ranged as well as Wards, Spellbooks, rings, and amulets.

Wards act as Shields but are magical in nature and you can dump large amounts of mana into them to recharge instantly. However, each time you do you the Ward will demand more mana until you let it rest for 10 minutes.

Spellbooks are spells that do not cost any mana to cast and instead have a cooldown. Those who are able to use magic will find great usage for these as they function as prepared spells. You may use your own mana to recharge and even empower the spells granted but each time will require more mana until you let them rest for 10 minutes. Should you put in the effort it is possible to learn to use these spells without the Spellbook. Though they will be stronger while using the Spellbook and mastery the spell while using a Spellbook will massively empower a spell. You may have up to two Spellbooks equipped and ready to use.

Rings will grant minor boons to your ability to use guns and magic empowering spells by minor amounts or possibly granting your spell the ability to critically hit for various amounts of increased damage. You may only wear two Rings at a time

Amulets may grant broader and potentially stronger buffs. However you can only wear a single Amulet.

Also, you may toggle the effects of this addon so that you can gain regular items or Tina items.
addons.title: Tina Tech

objects.text:
You gain a large golden chest which can spawn all manner of weapons from guns, rocket launchers and grandes to shield projectors, Oz Kits, or relics from the Borderlands franchise. This chest will provide an endless arsenal of equipment fit for any Vault Hunter or adventurer.

In order to open the chest you must give it money. Any form of money or physical valuables can be sacrificed to the Chest. The Golden Chest can also hold an infinite amount of value and be spent in amounts as desired. The Golden Chest has a minimum of needing $10,000 worth of valuables needed in order to be opened. However you can spend up to a $1,000,000 in order to increase the guaranteed rarity of items found once opened. However each time you open the chest it will cost slightly more each time quickly bloating the cost only to reset once a month.

Once opened you will find up to 6 items of random rarity based on their size within the chest with larger items lowering the number. Along with items the chest will contain a decent amount of ammo of each type when opened.

Items you can find in the chest come in the following rarities which determine their power and effects: common (white) -> uncommon (green) -> rare (blue) -> epic (purple) -> legendary (orange) -> special rarity which includes Pearlescent, Effervescent, and other rarity types beyond legendary.

The chest will also have notecards with detailed information on whatever items it spawns. Items within the chest are not just limited to ones shown in the games and may spawn items never seen before of similar power to ones known. Also items of higher colors and rarities will in fact be more powerful than lower ones and while you will often find trash usually higher rarity items will be of some of use for you.
objects.title: Golden Chest of Epic Loot (Borderlands)

objects.text:
You have acquired the LGM’s Uni-Mind, a mystical orb that allowed them to join their minds as one.

Essentially, the Uni-Mind facilitates the creation of a hive-mind, that also retains individualism. This resulting in all members both the collective knowledge and skills of the whole, and able to think, act, and work perfectly as one. Whilst, still retaining the all the benefits creative and innovative benefits of an individualism.

Due be wary, as whilst the Uni-Mind is innately a positive force, should it be corrupted and weaponized, it can become capable of enslaving worlds under a single mind.
objects.title: Uni-Mind (Buzz Lightyear of Star Command)

objects.text: You are drawn to a warehouse, left to its own devices after some time and strangely undisturbed from loiters or vagabonds. There’s a stench in the air, an air that feels off to your instincts, yet feels welcoming all the same. The hollow boom of the deadbolt reverberates through, and the first thing you notice is the collection. The cartridge collection, the archives, what’s beneath the archive, a heavily noted hard-cover book about cryptids, monsters, and urban legends. You know these stories; you’ve been hearing them your whole life. You’re now an owner of the greatest collection of haunted items in the world. Based on Creepypastas and horror stories you might know, you’ll receive an archive of cartridges, tools, items, video tapes, and antiques, with one thing in common: they are either horrifically haunted or connected with the dark side of the supernatural. For instance, you have a haunted copy of Sonic.EXE in your collection that containing X with some of its variants that inhabit other games in your collection, or the haunted Wii that hosts “eteled” or Henry, as he once came to be named, among many examples. This collection is useful when the archive has already been warded off for you, so they can’t act against your life without some difficulty, and can assist or comply with your orders or desire with no choice to comply, in the loosest sense of the word. That aside, you also an owner of the greatest supernatural archive recording every legend or creature from Horror or Creepypasta, where to find them, and, last but not least, create a “beneficial” covenant with the entity to act as an ally in times of need. Be warned, though: these entities aren't to be trifled with, so make a deal or talk at your own risk. Lord knows Slenderman would take up your offer or not… NOTE: And for the love of God, DON’T YOU EVER dare to call He Who Waits Behind the Wall. Nobody’s that stupid.
objects.title: Haunted Collection (Creepypasta Mythos)

addons.text: The Omnitrix and the H-Dial are two sides of the same coin. One turns you into what could be, another into what is. Now, you can not only use the two independently, but conjoined. Dialing in a hero while in the form of a Petrosapien, for instance, could have a vastly increase chance of getting a similarly Petrosapien hero from the H-Dial, enhancing and building from the abilities naturally possessed by the species.
addons.title: A Two Headed Coin…

addons.text:
By combining the H-Dial and the Foma Dominae, you can force a connection to the metaphysical Heroverse through the Forma. When using the two in concert, your transformations come out significantly more developed than they otherwise would be upon immediate creation.

These ‘Character’ transformations are more akin to the H-Dial’s randomised heroes, but due to the Dominae’s magical connection, the ‘Secret Origin’ of these transformations is retroactively constructed into reality for the duration of this transformation, whenever it is used. Did they fall into a vat of acid? A mutative vat of acid has appeared in some abandoned factory in some random city. Were they chosen by a divine entity? Then your new god is watching as long as you’re their ‘chosen’.
addons.title: A Secret Origin

objects.text:
“Welcome. If you wish to escape. If you wish to be magnificent. If you wish to discover yourself. Dial H!”

You’ve gained possession of one of the most dangerous objects that DC Prime Earth has to offer… A rotary phone dial.

The H-Dial is an unassuming device, appearing most often as a rotary phone dial, though this changes along these lines. The Dial itself is almost indestructible, and fate tends to conspire to have it find at least one suitable host for its primary function.

The H-Dial is a conduit, through which the primordial power beyond the realm of gods flows, the Heroverse. When you dial ‘H’ on the rotary dial, the conduit opens and you experience a trickle of the Heroverse, creating an artificial link, coming in two parts.

Firstly, you embody a hero never before seen, and perhaps never seen again. These heroes have histories, personalities, and powers pulled from thin air, and at complete random. One dial, you may become Lacrimosa, whose grief fuels incredible strength, or Chimp Change, a grizzled detective whose animal instinct guides her to the dirty truth. These are not guaranteed in any way, as they are completely random. Similarly, most transformations have a limit of ten minutes, or until you redial H. As you have their memories, your personality may be adjusted in kind to match them and their approach to the situation.

The Second, and lesser known aspect of the link, is the other letters. By dialing S, you can become a Sidekick; a Villain through V; Through G, the Dial itself can turn into gadgets temporarily; and J can cause the user to jump through worlds (albeit randomly without guidance), along with many more. These all have the time limit imposed by the dial.
objects.title: H-Dial (DC Comics)

addons.text: The fragment within the Sigil has awakened to become your sentient familiar. In doing so, it has become more than a tool as it is now a teacher, bearing the Endless’s accumulated experience and knowledge to help guide you as you grow into your power. As this fragment was once part of an omnipresent, nigh-omnipotent force that bound and shaped all existence, it holds the copy of all the memories and experiences of the Endless that the Sigil represents—from the beginning of time to its potential end. With this immense well of knowledge, the fragment can guide you in wielding the Sigil with greater precision, teaching not only its proper use but also a deeper understanding of the very concept it embodies. Through this, you can master the Sigil in a remarkably short time, as the fragment will adapts its instruction to your morals, mindset, and intentions. Ensuring that the Sigil’s power is wielded in a way that you want, rather than how the Endless it represents would wield it. For the fragment bound to the Sigil is loyal to you—and to you alone. The fragment can speak to you or manifest at your side in a physical form. You determine its appearance and personality: it may resemble the Endless to whom the Sigil belongs, take the form of an entirely unique being born from the fragment itself, or exist somewhere in between. However, if it appears in physical form, it must remain close to you, and near the Sigil you hold. If you possess the Endless Realm(s) Addon, the fragments bound within the Sigils are capable of governing these realms in your stead. They will cultivate and expand the realms and protect your Personal World from any threats it may face. They may also appear both within your realms and in your Personal World. The fragment will manage your realm according to your wishes and mindset. You will not have to fear the Despair Sigil killing entire planets to harvest despair, nor the Delirium Sigil driving entire civilizations into madness. The fragments may also create inhabitants within their realms. For example, a fragment of the Dream-Helm Sigil might populate your Dreaming with beings akin to Matthew the Raven, Merv Pumpkinhead, or Fiddler’s Green, reflections of Dream’s own domain in your realm. All inhabitants created through a fragment will show you the same loyalty and respect they show their creator, recognizing your authority as absolute. If you possess multiple Sigils that have become your familiars, you may be required to act as a mediator between them. Much like the Endless themselves, the fragments share complex relationships with one another. While you need not fear them destroying one another, you will have to ensure they coexist peacefully.
addons.title: Awaken Fragments

objects.text:
In the DC Universe, there exist beings older and more powerful than the gods themselves—ancient, cosmic entities who have existed since the dawn of life. They are wave functions, primordial ideas, and eternal patterns that ripple through the very fabric of the cosmos, who shape and define all that is, and all that ever will be. They are the Endless—embodiments of fundamental forces, each one a living manifestation of an eternal concept.

These primordial entities have shaped the course of mortal history since the very first spark of life. They have favored and condemned in equal measure, their whims as unpredictable as the forces they embody. Yet you, unlike any other before you, have achieved what was once thought impossible. You have not only earned their favor but gained their trust and they have willingly granted you a copy of one of their sigils, the sacred symbols that represent their dominion over the very concepts they govern. These sigils are not mere emblems; within them lies a sliver of their boundless power, a fragment of their essence, granting you the ability to wield their concept as your own.

These sigils are yours and yours alone to wield. They grant you the power to manipulate their underlying concepts as your own, allowing you to alter both the physical and metaphysical worlds by tapping into their symbolic essence. Their authority is absolute, on par with that of the Endless, and their applications are limitless. With enough effort, you can even control the opposing aspects of their concepts, as the Endless themselves are defined by their inherent dualities. For example, with the sigil of Despair, you can control Hope, and with Destruction, you can wield Creation. As long as the action is related to the core concept in some way, it is within your reach. However, despite their vast power, the sigils do have their limitations.

The power of these sigils is bound by the depth of your understanding and the mastery. Their true potential can only be unlocked through rigorous training and continuous usage. Even then, while you may come to rival the skill and authority of the Endless in their use of their concept, know that no amount of mastery will grant you their full, unfathomable power. The Endless, with their full might, can directly shape existence itself; but even with perfect command of a sigil, you would only be able to directly affect the world. 

However, these sigils hold the capacity to amplify and focus effects. When used in harmony with their respective concepts, they can exponentially enhance the potency of your abilities. For example, a fireball capable of breaking a pebble could, when channeled through the Sword Sigil, obliterate an entire city.

Book Sigil: This infinite tome grants you the power to shape the very fabric of destiny. You can decree that a peasant becomes a king, and it will be so—forever. Or you could save a tragic hero from their inevitable demise, defying the threads of fate itself. Within its pages lies the written account of all existence, from its beginning to its eventual end. However, navigating this boundless book to find specific information can be a time-consuming challenge, as it stretches on endlessly.

Ankh Sigil: With it, you wield Death’s authority. You can open a path to any and all afterlives, entering and leaving at will, for you walk in the shadow of Death herself. You can search, find, and resurrect the souls of the departed, though those lost to time may take longer to locate. With a mere touch, you can end a life instantly or grant everlasting immortality, as if Death herself had decreed it.

Dream-Helm Sigil: A helmet crafted from the skull of a long dead god, with this you have godlike authority over dreams. With it, you can crafts dreams that can break the strongest will or inspire someone to become the greatest hero of their generations. You can strip a group of immoral serial killers of their dreams of grandeur and self-importance, forcing them to confront their sins, or make the impossible a reality—like teaching a girl to fly in the waking world through the power of her dreams.

Sword Sigil: This sword possesses the power to annihilate everything—both the physical and the abstract. You can effortlessly slice through Kryptonians as if they were nothing, erase a meme with the power of a single scream, or devise a plan to bring an entire nation to ruin overnight. And if you focus, you can craft weapons so devastating that even the greatest armaments of the gods would appear as mere firecrackers in comparison.

Heart Sigil: With this glass heart, you can become the most charismatic being to have ever lived. You can convince a god to become your servant, a king to surrender his throne, or even persuade a fallen angel to repent. You can convert emotions into energy, harnessing and manipulating them at will. And if there’s something beyond your immediate grasp, the glass heart will whisper the steps needed to bring your deepest desires into reality.

Hook Sigil: To wield its power, you must pierce yourself with the hook. Once bound to it, you gain dominion over despair itself. You can instill terror in gods with but a few words, or cause entire nations to unravel in chaos. With this hook, your willpower becomes unshakable, enabling you to endure any trial or torment. The devil himself could torment you for eternity, and you would laugh in his face, unwavering and resolute, enduring to the very end.

Rainbow Fish Sigil: Wielding this rainbow fish sigil allows you to inflict madness with a glance. You can drive people permanently insane, having small imaginary ants crawling up their skin till the end of time even after death. You can also provide clarity and peace to those who already mad, permanently curing them of their insanity or provide epiphany or ideas born from randomness and delirium. You can also have intuitive precognition, allowing you to read order from chaos, allowing you to find plans and information through a slew of random informations that most people wouldn’t find sensible.
objects.title: Sigils of the Endless (DC Comics)
The Life Equation (DC Comics)
objects.text: Companionship + understanding + assurance + joy + altruism ÷ respect ÷ commendation ÷ sympathy × innocence × dignity × success × acceptance y=n where y=despair and n=caution, love=truth, death=rebirth, and... self=light side. You have within your grasp the Life Equation, the mathematical and ontological proof that life, indeed, is worth living, representing hope, free will, and the endless potential for life. With a connection to the Source, the Life Equation is an all-consuming power that has the capability to restructure reality by changing its formula, representing the attributes of life itself pertaining to change and variance. Previous wielders were capable of reigniting stars, shaping energy and matter, flawlessly resurrecting entire species, banishing primordial evils and nonexistent entities, as well as freeing the entire universe from mind control and restoring hope to the cosmos by merely uttering its formula. The formula naturally protects you from everything that would tamper with your freedom, such as mind control, manipulating your fate, restraining you, or erasing you from existence. However, you are not able to access all its insurmountable power, as attempting to do so all at once would quite literally burn your soul, mind, and body away. The user must be at absolute peace and have a complete understanding of themselves in order to temper with the Life Equation's output, not letting it run amok trying to turn the universe into a Utopia or assimilate you into the Source. You will start with basic proficiency, being able to influence an area the size of a country, with the potential to master it to a degree beyond Kyle Rayner and the Highfather; with time, practice, and exposure, you will muster enough resilience and wisdom to shoulder its usage.

objects.title: The Anti-Life Equation (DC Comics)
objects.text: I am Anti-Life, the Beast of Judgment. I am the dark at the end of everything. The end of universes, gods, worlds... of everything. In your hands is the completed Anti-Life Equation. The antithesis of life and free will, the mathematical certainty that freedom and hope are futile concepts, filling the minds of whose who hear it spoken aloud with a noise devoid of meaning until all that remains is the thought of submission to the wielder of the Equation. Anti-Life is not merely an equation, it is a fundamental part of reality, a living piece of the great Source from which all things sprang forth. As such, its applications are nigh infinite. Past wielders have used it to take the powers of their enemies, ressurect the dead, and slay crowds of gods by making their minds, bodies, and emotions cease function. But most infamous of all, the Equation is able to strip the free-will from individuals, turning them into extensions of the wielder's will. Of course, mortal as you are, foolishly attempting to access the entirety of the Equation's power will certainly end in your downfall, either cursed to become a slave to Anti-Life yourself or any other manner of horrific fate. You begin with basic proficiency of its most fundamental ability, able to influence entire nations at a time with the possibility to surpass even Darkseid in mastery with time and practice. Indeed, it's as if the Equation itself wishes to be yours.

A notebook's worth of Psychic Paper, paper that taps into the mind of others to show them an illusion of what they expect to see. Unfortunately, particularly strong-willed, dull, highly intelligent, or psionically-resistant individuals can negate this, but still, with creativity this is amazingly useful.
objects.title: Psychic Paper (Doctor Who)

addons.text:
The Rainbow Chest has experienced a curious “glitch” thanks to the presence of your Gun Magic, which will cause it to contain every Bullet Modifier item from the base game and even some from mods (any that are not overpowered). You can selectively toggle the effects of any Bullet Modifying item, allowing you to mix and match their effects for devastating results.

Beyond just gaining a huge number of Bullet Modifying items, you also gain the knowledge of how to apply these effects to your Magic Bullet, allowing you to double-dip and empower them beyond just the passive effects from your collection of Bullet Modifier items.

With this, every bullet you fire becomes an unpredictable nightmare for anyone who would dare to stare at the end of your gun(s) barrel.
addons.title: Manifold Magic Bullet

objects.text:
You receive a single unopened Rainbow Chest from the Gungeon. This slightly modified Rainbow Chest will contain your choice of 3 guns, 3 passive items, and 2 active items from the Gungeons vast number of goodies. You may select any rarity of item (with the exception of the Gun that Kills the Past), including cursed items, which will be cleansed of any Curse they would normally have.

Any items you select will have a restock timer based on their strength, ranging from 1 day to 1 month for stronger items.

Within the chest, you will also find ammo that fits any guns you select. Each day, this chest will refill with a full stockpile of ammo for each of your guns. The Rainbow Chest has a special pocket dimension that will store any excess ammo.

Note that you can select items from mods, however any item stronger than those in the base game will be brought down to the same level.
objects.title: Rainbow Chest (Enter the Gungeon)

objects.text:
You have bonded with The Primordial Assimilation Stele. This item now exists inside your soul and acts as a shortcut for mastering powers, skills, and techniques. You gain access to a holographic or mental informational panel visible only to you, which displays every skill, power, martial, or cultivation art, and technique you have learned, and only a beginner’s understanding is required to add new entries to it.

By spending the appropriate number of points, you can further develop these abilities all the way to perfection. These points can be obtained by converting anything you possess, such as the bodies and cores of monsters, beasts, and humans, as well as magical, or supernatural resources, treasures, materials, items, artifacts, and more.

Mastery levels progress as follows: Beginner → Minor Accomplishment → Medium Accomplishment → Major Accomplishment → Perfection. The cost of upgrading increases depending on the difficulty and complexity of the skill or technique you wish to master.

By spending points, you instantly gain all the associated benefits, whether they involve muscle memory, technical expertise, combat instincts, or practical experience.

You also gain any form of understanding, mental state, epiphany, enlightenment, or realisation required to properly master a skill. For example, if a sword technique requires comprehension of Sword Intent or part of Sword Dao, you will automatically acquire the precise level of insight necessary to learn and utilise it. Sword Intent and part of that Dao will then be added to your panel as a separate ability that can be further improved.

If you possess a book or text that details techniques, powers, or skills you can learn, you may acquire them at the beginner level by spending the appropriate number of points.
objects.title: The Primordial Assimilation Stele (Fortune belongs to those that steal it)

objects.text:
The Oratrice is a sophisticated mechanical construct resembling a grand weighing scale, located within the court of Fontaine’s Opera Epiclese. While the one in your possession is not an exact replica, it is equally, if not more, powerful than the original. This version of the Oratrice harnesses the people's belief in justice, converting their faith into a potent energy known as Indemnitium. This energy serves as a power source, accessible to anyone who understands how to wield it.

Possessing a consciousness of its own, the Oratrice delivers precise and unwavering judgments, whether during trials or when assessing an individual’s actions. Your Oratrice is entirely soulbound, allowing you to summon it at will to judge any being across time—the past, present, and future. It is an instrument of absolute justice, taking into account all actions, evidence, thoughts, and even the very nature of an individual’s soul.

This version has the ability to perceive the entirety of existence—past, present, and future—while also reading minds and souls. It evaluates ideals, morals, and character to deliver fitting judgments, including appropriate punishment when necessary. No being, regardless of their power, is exempt from its authority, as it operates according to the fundamental laws of justice governing the omniverse. While its primary function is judicial, it can also enforce sentences by stripping individuals of their power, sealing them away, or even executing them if deemed necessary. Only you, along with entities that transcend the laws of justice itself, are immune to its effects.

Your Oratrice begins with a reserve of Indemnitium equivalent to 500 years' worth of power and can replenish its energy through your own reserves, faith in justice, or the accumulated beliefs of others. Indemnitium is incredibly dense compared to most forms of energy, allowing it to affect even gods and other powerful beings when used in significant quantities. Due to your deep connection with the Oratrice, you can use small amounts of Indemnitium to grow stronger, evolve, and cultivate your abilities to new heights.

Because the Oratrice operates largely on faith and belief in justice, you have the potential to ascend into true godhood, much like Focalors and the Ludex of Fontaine. Furthermore, it contains the memories, powers, and skills of both Focalors and Neuvillette, granting you control over the very essence of water—an ability that can be strengthened over time. With enough growth, you could eventually reach the level of the Hydro Archon or even the Hydro Dragon.

The Oratrice is an impartial and infallible arbiter of justice—no being can deceive it, and none can escape its judgment. If you so choose, you may also have Focalors reside within the Oratrice, further enhancing its presence and authority.
objects.title: Oratrice Mecanique d'Analyse Cardinale (Genshin Impact)

objects.text: You receive a box of prank items from Harry Potters most popular prank shop. This includes things like trick wands, dungbombs, fanged frisbees, and stink pellets. Despite being prank items, a clever enough person may find ways to use these in combat.
objects.title: Zonko’s box of Magic Prank Items (Harry Potter)

objects.text:
“A rare and precious bloom, gifted from a distant land. Its beauty is matched only by its fragility.”

The Delicate Flower is a sacred object originating from a distant land beyond Hallownest’s borders. Pale and softly luminous, it emits a gentle aura of purity—subtle, yet deeply affecting to those nearby.

Though beautiful, the flower is astonishingly fragile. The lightest impact—a stumble, a fall, a sudden lurch, or even teleportation—will cause it to shatter instantly.

Despite this, it radiates a peculiar power that seems to resist the influence of Higher Beings. 

Its presence repels divine corruption in a subtle, almost passive manner. Strangely, the flower instills a sense of calm and solemnity in those who bear it. 

Warriors find their minds at peace, and even those who have lost their minds have been known to falter momentarily in its presence.

When carried, the Delicate Flower cannot endure harsh treatment. But if destroyed, during rest it will mysteriously reappear, whole and unmarred.

If planted, it takes root gently, never spreading invasive seeds or upsetting the delicate balance of local ecosystems. In time, it will sprout others like it.
objects.title: Delicate Flower (Hollow Knight)

objects.text:
The Sylladex is an inventory system consisting of two decks of cards: the Captchalogue Deck and the Strife Deck. Your Sylladex looks like a wallet and holds an unlimited number of Captchalogue Cards, much like a regular wallet holds cash in the billfold. You will intuitively know the position of each item in the Captchalogue Deck.

To store an item, touch it or a stack of items with a blank Captchalogue card, and they will fill the card. To release an item, hold the card it's in and think about wanting the item back.

The Captchalogue Deck is where any items are stored on Captchalogue Cards. Items of a similar nature, such as cans of shaving cream or pipe tobacco, can be stored in ludicrously large piles on a single card and removed individually. Items of any weight and size can be stored in Captchalogue Cards with no upper limit, and they weigh nothing while inside, like a Bag of Holding.

Living things can also be Captchalogued, and any Captchalogued items are put in stasis. Any items stored in a Captchalogue card have a captcha code on the back, designed to be used with the Alchemy machines.

In a separate area of your Sylladex is the Strife Portfolio, where you put your weapons. Captchalogued weapons must be put in the Strife Portfolio and can be summoned to your hand and banished back into their Captchalogue card and the Strife Portfolio at will. Your version of the Sylladex can hold as many types of weapons as you would like, even umbrellas or bowling pins, so long as they are only used for combat purposes.

Your Sylladex comes with a separate section containing unlimited amounts of blank Captchalogue Cards.
objects.title: Sylladex (Homestuck)

addons.text: You have gained more than just canon Stigma pieces, you have gained a Set of 3 Stigma pieces which perfectly compliment your MANTIS and/or Herrscher abilities. For instance, if you were to have pyrokinetic abilities your personal Stigma might give you the ability to deal more damage to burning enemies or maybe heal when killing burning enemies. Additionally, your increased ability to handle Honkai Energy greatly increases the size of Honkai reserves.
addons.title: Personalized Stigma

addons.text:
Your ability to create Stigma has, for lack of a better word, “learned” from your Stigma. This allows you to create Stigma more along the lines of the game-like Stigma you possess, using Honkai Energy to bestow unique powers. This allows you to not only create custom Stigma but also bestow these unique Stigma upon others.

You start with both knowledge of the basic principles of how to assemble the patterns/circuits which Stigmata use to bestow abilities, as well as knowledge of the blueprints to create any Stigma you purchased. You also possess any innate talent for converting studied phenomena into Stigma abilities, allowing you to potentially replicate any ability with enough time and studying.
addons.title: Stigma Creation

addons.text: Your Stigma is no longer reliant on just Honkai Energy, now gaining the ability to use any form of energy you possess to function. This is a part of the blueprint of the Stigma itself, so if you possess Stigma Creation you can have your created Stigma rely on energies other than Honkai Energy.
addons.title: Cross Compatibility
Stigma Consciousness
addons.text:
Stigmata were originally tools to link human consciousness with the Honkai, allowing bearers to wield Honkai energy through their mortal bodies, and pass on their knowledge and techniques to future generations. But something happened that caused your Stigma to malfunction.
