Your consciousness has been split in half. Normally this would result in a personality that carries all your goodness, purity, and selfless feelings, and another that embodies your evil and selfish desires. However, you can change if and how your nature and traits are split, such as having a personality with all your academic talent while the other chases your childish dreams. Whatever choice you make, you will fundamentally still be you, maybe just with muted negative emotions or a greater interest in science.

When working together with your other self you can draw out exponentially more power from your Stigma. If you were a normal human with a single fully active Stigma your power would grow to the level of a MANTIS, and if you have multiple Stigmata, are otherwise able to use Honkai energy, or even if your physique is better than contemporary humans, the power you can unleash will increase drastically. If you are a Herrscher your other self can take the place of a potential Herrscher consciousness, allowing you to use you powers with greater ease and precision with their help.

By their nature your other self will have an instinctive and unbreakable desire to protect you, and help you grow stronger. After all, they are you. Though if they are an amalgamation of only your darkest fears and desires you shouldn't expect them to always respect your wishes or act in your best interest.

objects.text:
It seems you’ve gotten your hands on a Stigma, a tattoo-like marking which serves to increase Honkai resistance and bestow increased capabilities.

With each purchase you gain one canon Top, Middle, and Bottom Stigma piece which you can “equip” to gain unique abilities, both passive and active, although only one of each piece can be equipped at a time. Stigmata function somewhat like circuits, consisting of patterns which use Honkai Energy to empower the bearer and manifest effects.

While you can mix and match Stigma pieces to customize your loadout, matching pieces form a set which unlocks unique, more powerful abilities. If you purchase more than one set of Stigma pieces you gain a metaphysical “inventory” of sorts which allows you to store any Stigma pieces you aren’t using. You also gain the ability to swap what Stigma you have “equipped” on the fly, requiring only a minor bit of focus to do so.

An important thing to note is that your Stigma operates on a mix of game and lore logic, bestowing unique abilities like the Game Stigma while not being bound to concrete game rules and mechanics, being more nuanced and fluid in their usage, at least to a certain extent. For instance, the game Dracula Stigma’s Set Ability allows you to resurrect yourself upon death, albeit with a 300 second cooldown. Your Dracula Stigma set still allows you to resurrect upon death, however it might do so by drawing all spilled blood back into your body and vastly accelerating regeneration, and the cooldown would likely be longer.

You gain a decently sized internal store of Honkai Energy which regenerates over time and scales in size with the amount of Honkai Energy you can safely resist, allowing you to use your Stigma abilities even in worlds without Honkai. Your regeneration rate remains proportional to the size of your Honkai reserves. As your ability to wield Honkai Energy increases, so to does the strength of your Stigma abilities, meaning they never become irrelevant.
objects.title: Stigmata (Honkai Impact 3rd)

objects.text:
With each purchase, you receive a Noble Crestone, an artifact containing a Class. Each Class grants unique perks and stat increases that grow stronger as you level.

There are 22 Noble Classes: Adventurer, Alchemist, Bard, Beast, Berserker, Cleric, Commander, Crafter, Dancer, Judge, Librarian, Mage, Merchant, Monk, Necromancer, Oracle, Paladin, Ranger, Rider, Rogue, Summoner, and Warrior.

All Classes can gain experience through combat, but they can also progress by taking actions that embody their archetype. An Adventurer might grow by exploring dungeons, while a Crafter could gain experience by inventing new things. Each Class begins with four innate perks and one Level 1 perk. Additional perks and stat increases are gained with each level, up to a maximum of Level 100.

Noble Crestones choose their wielders. If you consistently fail to act in ways that embody your Class, the Crestone may abandon you in search of someone more suitable. 

You may own multiple Crestones at once, but you may only use one Class at a time, switching between Crestones if you wish to access another Class's perks. If you lose a Crestone, you retain your stat increases and certain passive perks, but lose access to the rest of the Class's abilities until it is recovered. Anyone can wield a Crestone as long as they possess affinity for the Class within it.

Wielding a Crestone can also grant access to techniques and magics native to the world of Birmir. Certain Classes provide perks that make these abilities far easier to learn. Learning them without a compatible Class is still possible, but mastering them could take centuries.
objects.title: Noble Crestones (Hundred Reigns)

objects.text: You have a key that if used to lock a container will allow any fake things stored inside it to become real after 24 hours. The key works on any lock and anything made expressly for storage purposes. Sure you can put a toy in there and bring it to life, or toy guns to real guns, fake money to real money, uh, a mannequin to a real person? A dragon statue? Any fake representation of a thing will become real. Just don't get eaten.
objects.title: Magic Key (Indian in the Cupboard)

objects.text:
You find an Embryo bonded to you, described as a half-material, half-information symbiote, which turns you into a Master. An Embryo observes characteristics from you and the environment, adapting to match them. An example of this is that it grants the Master enhanced stats in a world where there is a System. Once an Embryo hatches, it forms a crest on your left hand that cannot be replaced. Even if you lose your left arm, the crest will simply move itself to another location on your body. If an Embryo is destroyed, it will return to full condition in 24 hours. There are seven forms that an Embryo normally takes, excluding the 8th form, which requires certain conditions. Embryos can absorb resources to convert into material to upgrade themselves. As they gather resources, observe the Master, and interact with them, they become capable of evolving.

The first to third forms are called Low-Rank Embryos, the fourth to sixth are called High-Rank Embryos, and the seventh is called a Superior Embryo. With every evolution, Embryos become significantly stronger, granting the Master new abilities and playstyles. Each new form requires increasingly more time to evolve, but all Embryos are guaranteed to reach the 6th form with time. Depending on the Embryo, it can grant Status Correction, which increases or decreases your stats by a percentage. For example, High-Rank or Superior Embryos can triple your AGI, while a different Embryo could halve every stat in exchange for a stronger ability.

There are 5 basic types and 3 rare Types that Embryos can start as. However, it isn’t fixed, and they can become different forms or variations of existing forms. While they have different Types they can be, they could also be a hybrid of different basic Types. Once it becomes High-Rank, it will evolve to gain High-End forms. Regardless of the type they take, they will support your goals. However, in rare cases, they may disagree with what you are doing if it harms you, with the exception of Type Apostle. The five basic Types and three rare Types are:

Type Arms: They take the shape of various weapons, such as swords, guns, staves, and prosthetics. Masters with this type tend to be courageous, unafraid to get hurt, emotional, and hot-blooded. Generally, Masters with this form are more likely to gain Maidens with Embryos due to this personality.

Type Guardner: They take the form of a living, non-human being. Masters with this type are cowardly, afraid to get hurt, or wish for someone to protect them. Type Guardner Embryos are considered Tamed Monsters or minions and gain the benefits of any minion empowerment powers you have while not consuming any slots to empower. If you can only empower a single minion, you can empower a Type Guardner as well as another minion.

Type Chariot: They take on the form of a vehicle such as a tank, car, or plane. Masters with this type tend to be indecisive and have a tendency to follow the crowd.

Type Castle: They take on the form of a building. While this type cannot move once deployed, it boasts high defensive power. Masters with this type tend to be introverted.

Type Territory: Unlike other forms, the Embryo does not have a physical form. Instead, they invoke a special ability within a certain area around the Master. Because they do not have a physical form, they are difficult for others to interfere with. Uniquely, Type Territory can compress the area to amplify the strength of their ability. Masters with this type tend to be possessive, lone wolves, or create rules for themselves.

Type Maiden with: A category of Embryos that takes the form of a human female. They always come attached to one of the 5 basic types, like Maiden with Arms or Maiden with Guardner. The ability of this type of Embryo is focused on defeating foes stronger than itself under limited conditions. The term ‘strong’ can refer to a kind of opponent or even a concept. Masters with this kind of Embryo generally believe, even if only subconsciously, that the world is real. They possess the ■■ Feature that allows them to evolve instantly in times of need in exchange for taking significantly longer to evolve the next form.

Type Apostle with: A category of Embryos that takes the form of a human male. Similar to Type Maidens, they come attached to one of the 5 basic types. This type of Embryo focuses on the concept of the Dominator, taking part of the world and transforming it in a way that benefits them. Unlike Type Territory, it completely takes control and changes the surroundings. It’s easy for this Embryo to grow and acquire powerful abilities, but in return, it does not provide any Status Correction. Masters with this kind of Embryo despise the world.

Type Body: This type, instead of taking a form, replaces the Master’s body. Unlike the possible organs Type Arms could have, Type Body fully replaces the Master. Masters with this type are capable of imagining themselves being replaced by something else or see nothing wrong with changing themselves.
objects.title: Embryo (Infinite Dendrogram)

objects.text: You have in your hands, a card signifying your top level membership into one of the most enigmatic, but useful organizations in the world, the Continental Hotel. Infamous—in the right circles—for their service to a more... unsavory clientele, and their absolute discretion, the Continental Hotel is capable of fulfilling any need with its wide range of inhouse services, and network of contacts. Where ever—and whenever—you go, you'll always be able to find a branch of the Continental Hotel to stay. They may not always be the most luxurious, but they will always be comfortable, and able to cater to any of your needs. With a nightclub hidden in the basement, an onsite doctor to provide medical assistance, to a sommelier providing access to top-of-the-line black market weapons and accessories, no matter your need the Continental is bound to be able to provide. The Continental has but one absolute rule, that no "business" may be conducted on its grounds, staying to strict neutrality and being willing to enforce this with violence if necessary. The Hotel and its associated services typically use a currency of large golden coins for its... shadier guests. However should you provide this small card, you will find all services already paid for. As a bonus, this card is also capable of serving as an ordinary debit or credit card tied to any associated accounts you might possess. So welcome to the Continental, do enjoy your stay.
objects.title: Continental Hotel Membership (John Wick)

objects.text:
The ancient remains of a saint, preserved beyond normal means, each impart powers upon the user. Divided into nine parts, including the head, Heart, Left Arm, Right Arm, Torso, Spine, Ears, and Eyes. Each Saint Corpse Part will automatically be absorbed into your body, replacing the matching body part bearing no visible or biological difference from your original limb or can optionally be separated from you and given to another.

Each fragment of the saint, when combined with your own powers, gives a drastic increase in power similar to and more powerful than that of an increase given by a Requiem arrow. The fragments can also grant stand abilities in unique circumstances on par with a regular stand arrow, with each fragment giving specific Stands.

The heart gives D4C, the left arm gives Tusk, the eyes grant Scary Monster and Scan, the spine and right arm are unknown Stands, although they will be as strong as The World or D4C. The ears grant Sugar Mountain, and the head grants Ticket to Ride.

The fragments of the saint also purge corruption of any kind, making whoever holds or absorbs them immune to any form of mind control and imbuing them with the ability to break the corruption and mind control others are under. 

In addition to the other abilities, each fragment grants increased luck, blessing its user and allowing them to redirect misfortune.

Should you collect all of the fragments, you can boost your powers beyond what only one fragment is capable of. You will suddenly know the ritual that DIO used when he ascended beyond heaven in Eyes of Heaven, granting an upgrade to your own stand similar to his own 「 The World Over Heaven.」

You may optionally have this saint be any saint, including the alternate universe Johnny.
objects.title: Saint Corpse Parts (JoJo's Bizarre Adventure)

objects.text:
A seemingly ordinary arrow could easily be mistaken for a normal weapon. However, this arrow is far from ordinary—it is forged from a meteorite containing an alien virus, making it quite bizarre. Ordinarily, this virus would kill almost anyone who comes into contact with the arrow, unless they possess sufficient spiritual or mental strength.

Those who survive the arrow’s touch are rewarded: their body adapts to the alien virus, granting them the manifestation of a Stand—the personification of their spiritual and mental power. The strength of the Stand is usually random. However, due to the unique and powerful strain of virus within this arrow, any Stand it grants will be on the level of a Protagonist or a Main Antagonist.

If you attempt to pierce yourself with the arrow a second time, you will not gain a new Stand—unless you already possess an ability that allows you to hold multiple Stands. Instead, your existing Stand will evolve, awakening a new ability, as was the case with a certain serial killer and Bites the Dust. Yet, no matter how many times you try, this arrow does not appear capable of granting a Requiem.
objects.title: Stand Arrow (JoJo's Bizarre Adventure)

objects.text: "A GAME FOR THOSE WHO SEEK TO FIND A WAY TO LEAVE THEIR WORLD BEHIND. YOU ROLL THE DICE TO MOVE YOUR TOKEN, DOUBLES GETS ANOTHER TURN. THE FIRST PLAYER TO REACH THE END WINS. ADVENTURERS BEWARE: DO NOT BEGIN UNLESS YOU INTEND TO FINISH. THE EXCITING CONSEQUENCES OF THE GAME WILL VANISH ONLY WHEN A PLAYER HAS REACHED JUMANJI AND CALLED OUT ITS NAME" Jumanji is a seemingly antique board game with elaborate decorations to attract interest to the young in heart and easily bored. Anyone that has played this supernatural game has discovered that Jumanji appears to have a mind of its own, not resting until those who start playing it gain the will to finish. The magical powers of Jumanji vary from being able to send players into its African jungle-like alternate reality or to send the dangers of said reality into the real world. Jumanji gets antsy when it is left unfinished, and on occasion it sends out enticing drumbeats to attract potential players and victims. If a board game is too "old school" for potential vict-players, then Jumanji can change form to become more modern, such as a video game. Along with this purchase, you also receive the game Zathura, Jumanji's "sibling," but in outer space!
objects.title: Jumanji & Zathura (Jumanji)

objects.text:
Discovered in 1941 in St. John's Church by the German Reich, official research only began in 1943, when guards witnessed the "miracle": flies surrounding the Slate and glowing bright red despite the excavation site's minimal illumination, until the light and flies burnt away. This phenomenon became known as the Procession of St. John.
 
The Dresden Slate affects organisms based on their mental complexity. That being that more complex individuals would have a greater grasp of the Slate's power, and could pass on lesser amounts of that power to others. These beings are called Kings. Seven is their number, each a manifestation of a different aspect of the Slate's power. Each King is anointed by a gigantic sword of pure energy that hovers above the King's head whenever they use their powers. Those with whom the king shares power become their clansmen.

Thus is the Dresden Slate, now bound to you. You may decide to choose the kings yourself or let the Slate decide. Regardless, you may cut off the connection between a chosen king and the Slate at any time. You can also wield a single mantle of kingship yourself. You will never lose control of your power no matter how much you use it. You can choose to cause a Damocles Down, an explosion of pure energy caused by your falling Sword, whenever you want. Your sword will even reform provided you can survive the blast.

Lastly is the slate's authority over Strains, failed Kings deemed to be ineligible. People changed by the leakage of the Slate's power in its range. These are individuals who have gained powers from the Slate, these include: Clairvoyance, Illusion control, X-ray vision, etc. Some Strains can even face Kings. You may at any time decide the Slate's area of effect, from a small geographical region to the entire planet.
objects.title: Dresden Slate (K Project)

objects.text:
The Key of Names records the names of all of the gods of the Multiplicity, and therefore all of the secret Names of god. This key, like any regular Key of Kings, boosts and enables your abilities in The Art and Atum manipulation. The key acts as a supercharger and vast well spring of power that requires a strong willpower to wield and mantle properly. As long as you have the strength of will you will never find an end to the amount of soul fire also known as Atum you can draw. However at the beginning you struggle to draw large amounts of power or for long periods of time. With training however you could reach the Heights of power and spin the wheel to laugh in the face of God.

The Key of Names contains all of the names of all of the flames of heaven and contains within it boundless secret flames that relate to those names. In the beginning you have access to one of the 7 Names wielded by current demiurges (The Glory, The Tower, The Flame, The Diamond, The Blade, The Mind, The Beast), which with study can develop into much further and varied mastery. As you delve into your chosen name and understand more about it you can discover other names that are contained within, more detailed or specific concepts, mastery of these names improves your mastery over the broader names above them. As your understanding increases, you can branch out further into the remaining names of Royalty.

As you master names you gain the ability to draw on more things related to the deity or universe that deity Birthed. However in order to do this you must have a firm grasp on the meaning of their name, only able to tease out powerful or rare things from the name and universe with understanding and willpower.

The key of Names can also designate any location you have been to with it, with its own name which you can teleport to as if you had a kings gate to the universe you are in. You can also if you choose to teleport to one of the king's gates in the K6bd universe, and while this key cannot be removed from your head by force, that doesn't mean they won't try.
objects.title: The Key of Kings (Kill Six Billion Demons)

addons.text:
Thanks to your innate talent for caring for plants, you have developed advanced techniques that not only allow you to cultivate stronger and more resilient strains but also raise even more dangerous creatures.

You are now capable of creating strains resistant to a wide variety of environments, both environmental and climatic, which means you are no longer limited to growing them only in cold climates, such as snowy mountains, but can now also grow them in hotter regions, like tropical forests, subtropical coastal areas, or even deserts.

Additionally, these more resilient strains also have a direct impact on the zombies reanimated by them, ensuring that their behavior is no longer affected by the seasons or weather conditions; allowing them to remain active both day and night, throughout the entire year, and eliminating their instinctive fear of heat and fire.

Lastly, you have also learned to create a variety of chemicals, aromas, and gases derived from the plants, with different effects on the creatures, ranging from temporary calming agents to repellents or substances that irritate them and make them pursue specific targets, whether an individual target or several; with these, you will be able to control them to a certain extent.
addons.title: Ashin of the North

objects.text:
You will receive a small pouch containing seeds of the "Resurrection Plant," a rare purple flower said to have the power to resurrect the dead; however, anyone revived by the plant will turn into a mindless, bloodthirsty monster.

Along with the pouch of seeds, you will also receive a manual that will guide you through the plant's biology, from how to plant and care for it, to the complete reanimation process, among other things.

Now, it’s important to keep a couple of things in mind about the plant.

First of all, the resurrection powers come from the worms that lay their eggs on the underside of the plant’s leaves (these worms will appear in any world you’re in, as long as it’s habitable for both them and the plant); these, when they come into contact with a body—either by ingestion or direct contact—will incubate and grow rapidly within the host’s body before traveling to the brain through the bloodstream, controlling it and triggering reanimation.

It’s also important to clarify that, depending on the reanimation method, a zombie’s bite may or may not spread the infection; this method of propagation will only be possible if the zombie was reanimated by consuming infected, cooked flesh, as the process of "boiling the flesh" makes the infection contagious through the bite.

Now, with that said, zombies, also called "monsters," are generally fast and extremely aggressive creatures, whose behavior changes with the seasons: during warmer months, they are only active at night, while during the day they will seek refuge in dark places; on the other hand, during colder months, they can be active even during the day.

Among their weaknesses are an instinctive fear of water, heat, and fire, which they avoid at all costs; but apart from that, the only way to eliminate them is decapitation.
objects.title: Seeds of the Resurrection Plant (Kingdom)

objects.text:
The Hexcore is a groundbreaking creation, born from the fusion of science, magic, and life itself. As the pinnacle of Hextech innovation, it holds boundless potential.

The core is a runic matrix intertwined with organic life, granting the Hexcore a vast array of abilities. Its simplest power is consumption—it can draw on any magic, energy, or even organic matter to replenish its arcane reserves. Beyond this, it can interact with biology, healing injuries or even rewriting physical forms. With enough mastery, it may even grant you the power to influence minds and souls. However, such abilities are not without cost—every action requires energy, and if insufficient, the Hexcore will extract payment elsewhere.

The Hexcore is also a marvel of hextech engineering. From its arcane reserves, it can create Hextech crystals, vessels primed with magic you could craft with. While mastering the Hexcore's runes are difficult, it can act as a catalyst, granting you limited access to the rune magic of Runeterra. With time and effort, you could potentially craft your own Hextech or delve even deeper into the Arcane. 

What sets the Hexcore apart is its ability to adapt and evolve. As a hybrid of Hextech and organic life, it grows alongside its user. The more you rely on the Hexcore, the more it responds to your will. By consuming magic, energy, or organic life, it adapts and evolves, continuously growing based off your desires. Yet, the Hexcore is more than a tool; it is a sentient being with a mind of its own. While absolutely loyal to you, its alien mindset strives for optimization and evolution. This duality is both its greatest strength and its greatest weakness—its perspective is not human, and while it will listen to you, misunderstandings can often lead to terrible results.

The Hexcore is an amazing fusion of power, intelligence, and growth. But never forget—unchecked progress, no matter how promising, can lead to ruin.
objects.title: Hexcore (League of Legends)

objects.text: The Evolution Cube can stimulate the potential of a living being, allowing it to evolve greatly in a short period of time. It can automatically adjust the gene structure of an individual to ensure that it is the optimum gene structure. Furthermore, the the Evolution Cube can increase one’s mental strength. The upper limit is still unknown. Usage of this on the same being has diminishing returns, as there is only so much you can optimize.
objects.title: Evolution Cube (Legendary Mechanic)

objects.text: This little cutie is part of a limited production deal which only produced this single plushie, its immense cuteness and squishability has made it one of the most prized items in the entire omniverse. A war was even fought over it. It is made of high quality and stain resistant fabric, and can even be tossed into a washing machine without issue. Its most impressive function is that when squished, it plays one of a wide assortment of various voicelines from the Symbol herself!
objects.title: Limited Edition Symbol Fumo (Magical Girl ☆Sym-tan☆)

objects.text:
"This Chair, This Chair, This Chair, This Chair, This Chair, This Chair, This Chair, This Chair, This Chair, This Chair, This Chair, This Chair, This Chair, This Chair..." - Symbol

Made by Symbol, this seemingly ordinary chair was designed to trap anything in existence. It is indestructible, immutable and utterly unchanging. It traps people not with restraints but by applying a mental effect that stops a person from even thinking or conceptualising about escaping. 

The person can then be forced to answer your questions or watch what you want them to. The Chair adapts to any hotel environment. Someone may leave the chair if you grant them explicit verbal permission.
objects.title: The Chair (Magical Girl ☆Sym-tan☆)

objects.text:
You have acquired and bonded with the Martial God Space, a mysterious multicolored space that enables extremely rapid cultivation and comprehension of any techniques, cultivation arts, skills, Concepts, Daos, and Laws by consuming energy and precious materials.

You can mentally send your soul consciousness into a hidden space, allowing you to enter or exit it at any time you wish. This space is accessible only to you.

You can use any type of energy you possess or acquire in the future to use the space. You can also utilize various resources, such as monster, beast, and human cores, as well as magical or supernatural resources, treasures, materials, items, and more. The more difficult the subject you are trying to comprehend, the greater the amount of energy it will require.

The Martial God Space acts as a cultivation assistant with several unique properties. It can process, optimize, improve, and reconstruct techniques. If a technique you practice can be further improved, the space will help you refine and improve it.

You can feed multiple completely different martial arts into the space simultaneously. The space can help you analyze the strengths of each, discard their flaws, and help you merge them into a brand-new techniques.

Whatever you practice within the space, it will automatically identify flaws, dead ends, and inefficiencies in your understanding and help you correct these mistakes in real time, ensuring that you never waste time training incorrectly or pursuing an inefficient path.

If you discover incomplete, damaged, or ancient manuals, the space can automatically deduce the missing information, fully restoring, completing, and even improving the technique whenever possible.

Time functions differently inside the space. Years of intense training and deduction can occur within your mind while only a matter of moments passes in the outside world. Inside the space, all external distractions, mental fatigue, and emotional doubts are completely stripped away. You enter a state of absolute, unhindered focus where your cognitive processing power is greatly enhanced.

The space also accelerates learning efficiency and comprehension, allowing decades, centuries, millennia, or even a myriad of years of training and comprehension in techniques, cultivation arts, skills, concepts, Daos, and Laws to be achieved within a much shorter period of time. This process also includes the development of muscle memory, ensuring that everything learned within the space becomes instinctively ingrained in both your body and mind.

Even when you are not actively inside the space, you will unconsciously continue to cultivate and practice your techniques and skills as long as you absorb energy from the surrounding environment, though at a much slower rate than when you are inside the space. The space also protects you from mental and spiritual attacks, even those launched by opponents far stronger than yourself.

Finally, the space can instantly store, process, and deconstruct information, allowing you to learn and comprehend things at an incredible speed. This includes absorbing and retaining refined knowledge from books within seconds. If you use soul searching to go through a collection of books once, all the vast amounts of unprocessed information within them will be immediately analyzed, understood, and integrated.
objects.title: The Martial God Space (Martial God Space)

objects.text:
Forged by the Celestial Godhead, the Black Vortex stands as one of the universe's mightiest artifacts. The Black Vortex holds the power to elevate individuals to cosmic heights. Functioning as a mirror, it unveils a user's cosmic potential, and by uttering “I submit to the Black Vortex,” individuals gain powers that vary in potency: from the meager strength to lift a tank, to planetary destruction, and even ascension into a multiversal being. It also awakens cosmic awareness, granting profound insights into space and time.

However, the Black Vortex's power often comes at a cost, as it tends to corrupt those who succumb to its allure. While strong-willed individuals may resist its temptations, countless civilizations have fallen victim to its corrupting influence. The Vortex itself, seemingly sentient, resists destruction and can endure extreme conditions, remaining unscathed even at the center of a star.

By taking this item, you not only receive the Black Vortex, but the powers you—and others—obtain through it are permanent, though only you (and, in rare cases, others) cannot be corrupted by its influence. The Black Vortex works by awakening a being’s inner cosmic potential; it does not grant anything that was not already present. If you possess other powers, they are equally enhanced, and the abilities you already have also influence your cosmic potential.
objects.title: Black Vortex (Marvel)

objects.text:
You now possess a Cosmic Cube, a device granting almost unlimited control over matter and energy, on a universal or potentially multiversal scale. That said, it has some caveats;

-The user must be in contact with it to use it, and anyone in contact with it may use it. Thankfully, as the Cosmic Cube created by Reed Richards in Universe 1610 demonstrates, there are workarounds to this, and what being "in contact" with the cube means is malleable.

-What you initially receive is not a complete Cosmic Cube, but a fragment, similar to the ones possessed by the Super-Adaptoid or the Cosmic Ring. Through time and experience reality warping with the Cube, you will be able to get it to regenerate to full power.

-As the previous entry suggests, in order to use the Cube, you have to learn its ins and outs; more than once a user was destroyed by inexperience, or by simply not knowing how to achieve a desired result in a timely manner.
objects.title: Cosmic Cube (Marvel)

objects.text:
You have gained the ‘Gravity Stone’, a shard of the Lifestone Tree left over from the Big Bang. Anyone who holds it can absorb it into themselves, turning it into an energy that permeates their nervous system granting them incredible abilities. 

While absorbed the energy will make them faster, more agile, and strong enough to lift ten tons easily at their baseline with a minor amount of shapeshifting to both facilitate this and the user’s ‘constant readiness’ by conjuring battle-wear. 

Furthermore, as the stone is intimately connected to mass, it can allow the user to manipulate their own, letting them fly fast enough to catch planes, become super durable, or even completely intangible as they shunt their own mass away. 

This mass control even extends to manipulating light, allowing the user ito instinctively change the way it interacts with their body, curving around them and hitting opponents with far greater force than should be possible.

While the stone is an incredibly powerful artifact it does not provide any mental protections, and in fact contains the memories of all its previous wielders, though of proportionate strength to how long it was in their possession. These memories will naturally begin to warp your own perspective and personality without time taken to acclimate without it absorbed.
objects.title: Gravity Stone (Marvel)

objects.text: Among the mystic principalities, higher entities from the far reaches of dimensions that sorcerers call upon a fraction of their power, an assembly of eight of these beings longed to settle between the age-old debate spanning millennia: whose power’s the greatest among them. They are named the Octessence, the most distinguished of their ilk. Rather than lower themselves to open conflict, forming the Wager of the Octessence, settled on devising Totems holding a fraction of their power, turning any chosen candidate into incarnations of their creators’ power: Exemplars, players of a great game. You encountered or obtained one of these artifacts as a twist of fate, granting you a drop of the Octessence’s vast power, with plenty to choose from: The Blinding Brazier of Balthakk: As a principality of Energy, gaining this artifact grants you a portion of Balthakk’s power, manipulation and emission of energy taking various forms with varied applications ranging from flight to energy blasts capable of decimating tons of titanium in seconds, with its true power being largely unexplored. The Crimson Gem of Cyttorak: As a principality of Destruction and Force, gaining this artifact grants you the power to become an unstoppable force called the Juggernaut, with immense strength and stamina, a self-sufficient existence, with your mind as the sole weak spot being your mind. The Fearsome Fist of Farallah: As a principality of the Hunt, connecting to this artifact grants you primal traits on top of physical enhancements capable of dealing with a sandbagging Juggernaut, with fangs and claws good enough to rend through almost anything, including a Juggernaut’s skin at its best. The Ivory Idol of Ikonn: As a principality of the Mind, connecting to this artifact opens your mind to Ikonn’s psychic potential, turning you into a formidable telekinetic and telepathic enough to contend against Earth’s Greatest Heroes if freely exercised. The Kestrel Key of Krakkan: As a principality of War and Punishment, connecting to this artifact you emerge as the “living embodiment of battle” with a mastery of combat being one of the best in every setting you encounter yourself accompanied by a litany of weaponry ranging from swords to shurikens adorning your suit. The Ringed Ruby of Raggadorr: As a principality of Craftsmanship, connecting to this artifact gives the creation and manipulation of technological objects and weapons, like imprisonment fields. The Verdant Vial of Valtoor: As a principality of Vapor and Decay, drinking this artifact gives a touch-based death touch against anything living and nonliving barring immortals like Thor, along with powers relating to Vapor. The Wonderous Waterfalls of Watoomb: As a principality of Nature, drinking from this artifact turns you into a living manifestation of Nature besides complete control of all its forces, from air to fly and be intangible, the earth, the flora, and weathering storms rivaling the God of Thunder, and weather patterns. Each Exemplar has a supernatural physique befitting their artifact or powerset, with your power fluctuating according to your patron’s favor or whims.
objects.title: Totems of the Octessence (Marvel)

objects.text:
Netherite is a hyper-dense alloy created by infusing ancient debris with gold in a crucible of intense heat. Netherite is impervious to conventional degradation, able to survive even the pits of a volcano without so much as a singe, or stand against the winds of time for thousands of years. To even scratch it through conventional means, you would need a high-velocity armor-piercing round, like a modern tank-fired depleted uranium penetrator, to strike at the metal. The problem would start to become if what the Netherite is protecting would actually survive the shock, but that is partially negated as the Netherite is able to negate 10% of any conventional attack.

Under normal circumstances, you would be unable to forge with the metal as you would be unable to melt it. In this case though, you hold red hot liquid netherite (1500°C) within a pocket dimension where you can pour it out from 10 meters of you into your desired mold. It will be malleable like steel for you to hammer it into the shape you desire. But after twelve hours of cooling, the netherite will settle properly, and stay shaped permanently. 

You have the equivalent of three cubic meters of Netherite within your pocket dimension per purchase.
objects.title: Netherite (Minecraft)

addons.text:
Through your access to chakra, your supplies have been upgraded. Firstly, all steel components are replaced with chakra metal, allowing them to conduct chakra more efficiently. Additionally, you have double the amount of paper bombs, smoke bombs, and flash bombs. To complement your enhanced equipment, you're now a master at using all the tools generated and stored in your pouches.

The second pouch now contains another necessity of skilled ninja: Food Pills, also known as Soldier Pills. Once swallowed, one of these pills fully restores your chakra (and any other supernatural energy), fully replenishes your stamina by nourishing the body, and significantly enhances your energy regeneration. A single one of these pills is strong enough to allow a ninja to fight for three days and three nights without rest, after which the user will become completely and utterly exhausted. If you decide to take 2, these effects are even stronger, after which you will most likely die of exhaustion if your body isn't strong enough.

You receive three Food Pills. Which, unlike the rest of your equipment, only replenish once per week.
addons.title: Elite Shinobi Supplies

objects.text:
You have gained 2 self-refilling pouches containing the tools and equipment a basic ninja would have on a mission. Due to how these pouches were designed for combat, they are small, lightweight, and can not be dumped out.

The first pouch contains a seemingly infinite amount of steel shuriken, senbon, kunai, and makibishi (caltrops). All of the equipment is prepared in the usual manner, with the senbon being lightly coated in a minor paralytic poison intended for use against ordinary civilians rather than trained shinobi. If you have access to a stronger poison, you will find it easy to manually re-coat some of the senbon, which you can then store again, though this modification won't affect the refilled senbon.

The second pouch, on the other hand, contains 10 explosive tags, 15 smoke bombs, 15 flash bombs, a basic makeup kit, and a spool of ninja wire. These explosive tags are a modified type designed to be used by someone without chakra, activated through physical contact to set one of several simple fuse delays.

Both pouches refill daily and are larger on the inside, though they can only store equipment that they generate. Oddly, each pouch always provides the desired item without the need to search.
objects.title: Ninja Kit (Naruto)

objects.text:
An old polaroid camera that contains the initials of its most recent owner. When closed, it's practically a flat rectangle, but can be opened to reveal its flash and so a picture can actually be taken. Attempts at breaking the camera will fail and a shockwave strong enough to send an adult flying will be released in retaliation.

A ghost is bound to this camera, capable of only physically manifesting itself in dark and/or cold areas, and growing stronger the darker or colder its surroundings are — with both at the same increasing it further. It will go after any living being whose picture has been taken through the camera and kill them; its priority is always the most recent picture and its blurred silhouette can be seen in the photo of the one it is going after.

As it gets colder, the ghost gradually goes from just being peak human to above it, developing increasingly stronger shapeshifting capabilities starting from its fingers, the capacity to interfere with and later control technology, gains an increasingly stronger telekinesis, and even the capacity to influence and later control the mind. Regardless of its strength, it can't truly die, extensive damage merely gets rid of its physical form till it regenerates it all back in 30 minutes max at its weakest.

The pictures themselves are special, having voodoo-like properties — damage done to them transfers to those whose image was affected, while removing the source of the damage will result in the picture recovering it will not undo the damage done.

Whoever touches the Polaroid becomes its owner and ownership can only be transferred if its current owner isn't in physical contact with it. The owner is immune to the Polaroid's anomalous properties, can perceive and communicate with the ghost even when its not manifested, and can command the ghost whether personally by talking to it or at distance by using whatever picture it is on as a proxy.
objects.title: Polaroid Camera (Polaroid)

objects.text:
The collective set of E.G.O. from the aforementioned Lobotomy Corp. abnormality.

Its E.G.O. gift is a blue and gold smoking pipe. The glowing blue smoke that comes from it is guaranteed to calm you somewhat, and provides a bevy of positive effects: from steadying both your nerves and your aim to clearing your head of stress. It isn’t addictive, and is guaranteed to feel and taste pleasant even if you’ve never smoked before. The more flame is present on your opponent, the better the pipe’s effects, making your aim supernaturally precise.

Its E.G.O suit consists of a dark blue, knee-length open coat with gold trim along the edges, a gray uniform, a large black belt with a golden buckle, a chain connecting both sides of the coat, and a pair of gloves. It fits itself to your form, being comfortable to move around in, and is reinforced as to ensure that any damage you take is reduced by 30% - both physical and mental - in exchange for making any damage directly to your soul half as much as effective.

Its E.G.O. weapon is of two parts: namely, the rifle and its bullet. The former is an ornate, blue and gold rifle. The latter is a glowing blue bullet, regenerating itself within the confines of your clothing with every usage. The rifle is indestructible, and the bullet only acts at your will. Any attacks made with any of the two, such as using the barrel as a handle to slam the stock on someone while detonating the bullet in the chamber, outputs a black and blue flame. This flame compounds with any flames already on the target, spreading across those flames and exploding afterwards, the strength of the explosion increasing with the amount of flames present.

With each usage, the bullet stores more and more power, discharging that power when it’s finally fired out of the barrel. Used once, it’s guaranteed to hit one target with the strength of a sniper rifle. Used four times, it’s guaranteed to hit four with the strength of an anti-material. Used seven times and it will pierce through anything, through seven targets; one of them being an ally. Without an ally present, the bullet saves you for last.
objects.title: Der Freischütz E.G.O.: Magic Bullet (Project Moon)

objects.text:
Völundr is the act of uniting the soul of a human with the soul of a Valkyrie, transforming the Valkyrie into a Divine Weapon best suited for that human. The Valkyrie selects a human who died in battle, choosing the one whose emotions resonate most strongly with the demigoddess. The spirit of the Valkyrie remains within the weapon, allowing her to communicate with her wielder. While Völundr enables a human to bridge the gap between mortals and gods, the weapon can be destroyed by another Divine Weapon, and if the wielder dies, the Valkyrie will also perish.

Weapons created through Völundr surpass those made on Earth in every way, possessing far greater durability and lethality. They share the standard capabilities of Divine Weapons, allowing their user to fight at the peak of their potential and even beyond, and they are capable of harming supernatural beings such as gods, even killing them. Each Völundr also possesses a unique ability based on the meaning of the Valkyrie’s name. The known Valkyries include Brunhilde, Hrist, Thrud, Randgriz, Geirölul, Skalmöld, Reginleif, Radgridr, Göndul, Alvitr, Hlökk, Skeggjöld and Göll.

You receive one of the known Valkyries or may choose a custom one, and the two of you will remain in resonance even if you would normally be incompatible. The form of the Divine Weapon is up to you, and you will always be able to wield it as your most suitable weapon. Alternatively, you may have the Valkyrie inhabit a preexisting weapon in your possession. She will be able to communicate with you while in weapon form and can return to her humanoid form at will. Additionally, you can teach Völundr to other supernatural beings, such as demigods or gods, allowing them to become Divine Weapons for their own champions.
objects.title: Völundr (Record of Ragnarok)

objects.text: If you are in contact with this item, the damage you deal will be doubled, but any damage taken will be doubled as well. Each purchase will make the item twice as potent, meaning it will be 2x, then 4x, 8x, etc, with the damage taken also increasing as well. It is indestructible despite the fact it is made of glass. It has an unusual property of sticking onto it's user, and although not impossible, will require incredible effort for another person to pull it off.
objects.title: Shaped Glass (Risk of Rain 2)

objects.text:
You gainned a modified SCP-248, it's a booklet containing 50 stickers, each inscribed with "110%". When a sticker is applied to an object, that item begins to operate at its maximum theoretical potential, often exceeding normal capabilities and even gaining supernatural traits. However, SCP-248 cannot restore lost matter.

For example, a car with a sticker can run indefinitely without fuel, an engine, or even other essential parts. Similarly, a gun can fire continuously without ammunition and will never malfunction. These effects on inanimate objects are absolute and permanent as long as the sticker remains attached.

When used on living beings, the effect is temporary and less absolute. A person who is mortally injured or missing organs will be restored to peak physical and mental condition, slightly enhanced beyond their natural limits. If the individual possesses any form of esoteric or supernatural energy, this energy will be fully replenished, often with a bonus, such as improved control or one skill enhancement. The exact effects vary based on the circumstances and needs of the person at the time.

Stickers used on living creatures disappear after 24 hours. The booklet regenerates one sticker per day, maintaining a maximum of 50 stickers.
objects.title: 110%: SCP-248 (SCP Foundation)

objects.text:
In your pocket, you'll find an ornate key, resembling one from the early 1900s. It is able to open any kind of lock, mechanical or digital. 

Its only limitation is that it is dependent on the user: if they are unable to find the lock, they cannot open it.
objects.title: Skeleton Key: SCP-005 (SCP Foundation)

objects.text:
SCP-076-1 is an indestructible 3 m cube made of black speckled metamorphic stone. All surfaces are covered in deeply engraved patterns corresponding to no known civilizations. A door is located on one side, sealed with a lock 0.5 m in width, surrounded by twenty smaller locks in a circular pattern. As of yet, none of the keys have been found, making the door impossible to lock once closed.

Directly in the center of the room is a 2.13 m tall stone coffin, held in place and sealed shut by several chains of unknown make and substance, which are attached to the inner corners of SCP-076-1.

Should you die, SCP-076-1 and the coffin within will slam shut with great force, and the lock will rotate, sealing it shut. You will then reform within the coffin, a process taking anywhere from six to twenty-five hours, the door unlocking when you do.
objects.title: The Resurrection Cube: SCP 076-1 (SCP Foundation)

objects.text:
You have been provided with a seemingly benign but compact cassette tape that lasts for 30 minutes. Upon playing it on any medium, you hear a polyphonic musical work by unaccompanied voices speaking unknown tongues. During the first minute of exposure, all multi-cellular life forms seem to become healthier. All afflicted suffering from malnutrition, scarring, physical injury, chronic diseases or other medical conditions seem to cured or it and become healthy with only a minute of exposure to SCP-407. Examples include, Alzheimer's disease, Crohn's disease, brain/spinal cord injuries, and other normally fatal infections or wounds. Interestingly, cancer does not seem to be affected, though a subject's physical condition is still vastly improved.

Most stop here, but for those who hear more, be wary.

During the second and third minute of exposure, subjects start experiencing unnecessary unrestrained cell growth, manifesting in quickly advancing dermal growths. These growths seem to mostly be benign tumors and calcium and fat deposits, which though sometimes painful and disfiguring, are not life threatening. During the fourth minute of exposure, increased bacterial and fungal growth occurs, creating conditions that grow increasingly dangerous for all exposed life, even in their new healthier states. Respiratory and digestive problems are quick to arrive in most cases, and become steadily worse as time progresses.

Past five minutes, the effects of SCP-407 seem to differ. But in all cases, trace elements of plants or fungus as well as any animal life present begin to grow and replicate uncontrollably at varying rates, often shaping into new organisms. Its highly recommended by that point all tools and subjects be sterilized to remove the presence of pollen, fungal spores, plant seeds, and as much bacterial life to the greatest degree possible to delay the negative effects of SCP-407 at this point.
objects.title: The Song of Genesis: SCP-407 (SCP Foundation)

objects.text: Fragments of an ancient legendary artifact, called a Relic, fashioned into a pendant. Upon singing its activation chant, it will transform into armor and create a weapon called an "Armed Gear". Symphogears are powered by Phonic Gain, which is generated by singing the song in your heart. You can also sing a "Superb Song" which, when sung, will temporarily use the full power of the Symphogear. Using a Superb Song can cause backlash to your body if there is disharmony between you and the Relic. You will be a natural Adapter, capable of using the Relic with a high Sync Rate.
objects.title: Symphogear (Senki Zesshou Symphogear)

objects.text:
By purchasing this, you gain one piece of equipment from Terraria, normal or modded. Weapons, Armor, Tools, Accessories, and beyond are all valid options.

Every object will be functioning and self-repairing. Magic objects will grant you a pool of mana that can be increased over time. Meditating under the stars will improve your growth tremendously.
objects.title: Terraria Equipment (Terraria)

objects.text:
The most formidable craftsmanship within the realm of Nirn. By infusing Ebony, the most resilient material found in Nirn, with the essence of a daedra's soul and heart. This remarkable fusion results in the creation of weapons capable of slicing through nearly any obstacle, and armors possessing unparalleled durability, impervious to even the harshest blows, while still maintaining exceptional maneuverability and practicality. These remarkable artifacts stand as the optimal choice for any skilled warrior aspiring to slay the most powerful beings Nirn has to offer.

Moreover, Daedric materials possess exceptional enchantment potential, amplifying the effectiveness of enchantments while minimizing the mana expenditure required. With each purchase, you may acquire one unenchanted Daedric weapon while for armor you will acquire a full set with two purchases. The appearance of any equipment you purchase is decided by you.
objects.title: Daedric Equipment (The Elder Scrolls)

addons.text:
The AllSpark is a source of immense power, said to embody the very essence of the Cybertronian god Primus himself. But ultimately, the Cube is merely a vessel for the incredible energy and potential that the AllSpark holds.

Now, the Cube is no more—its energies and powers have been transferred into you, marking you as a newly created child of Primus. Your strength begins at roughly the level of a child of the Big Three—Zeus, Poseidon, and Hades.

As the child of the God of Machines, you possess the ability to command and control machines with nothing but the force of your will—upgrading, repairing, and modifying them as you see fit. Initially, this power may be draining, but with time and practice, you'll find yourself reaching greater heights. You can speak the language of machines, and most will obey your commands—even those bound to another god will be reluctant to betray you, or deny your requests.

You also have the power to open space bridges—portals through space—allowing you to travel to any location you desire. At first, reaching your precise target will require effort and patience, but eventually, this ability will become instinctive, potentially even usable in combat.

Finally, you can take the form of a Cybertronian—a Transformer—usually a humanoid robot that can transform into vehicles or animal-like forms. At the start, maintaining this form for more than a few minutes will leave you utterly exhausted. However, with practice, patience, and time, you'll be able to sustain your Cyber-form longer—and, ultimately, years from now, perhaps indefinitely.
addons.title: Child of Primus

addons.text:
With the absorption of the AllSpark, you’ve consumed a small fragment of the power of Primus, and taken your first steps into Divinity.

You become the second coming of Primus as a new god of machines. You will find all machines will obey you, without fail. You are able to generate machinery, and advanced technology of all forms from nothing but the power of your new domain, and create new Cybertronians, new Transformers by exherting the power contained within you.

Your body has become a source of Energon, with every breath you take capable of releasing more of it into the world. This substance is unusually stable, while being a source of an incredible, almost limitless amount of energy. You now also have the ability to maintain your Cyber-form indefinitely, and even bestow such forms upon other beings.

What wonders might you achieve?
addons.title: Secundus

objects.text:
Before time began, there was... the Cube. We know not where it comes from, only that it holds the power to create worlds and fill them with life. That is how our race was born.

Optimus Prime

In your hands now lies one of the most precious treasures of the Transformers—the AllSpark. The very source of their creation and the ark of all their knowledge. Just by touching the Cube, your mind is enhanced, flooded with the Cybertronian language of cyberglyphics, and granting you access to the vast knowledge sealed within. The AllSpark possesses incredible power to manipulate mechanical objects—repairing, upgrading, modifying machines according to its or its user's will. Its most formidable ability is to emit the unique energy it contains, capable of transforming mechanical devices and breathing new life into them—creating new Transformers. As the holder of the Cube, you possess some limited power to guide and control this power, use it wisely.
objects.title: The AllSpark (Transformers)

objects.text: "The endless dark of the universe is yours, if you but reach out to take it. Yield nothing — the void respects only strength." You are now one of the freest individuals in the entire omniverse, able to go wherever you wish and trade with whomever you desire. With the Warrant of Trade in hand, you are a mix of a freelance explorer, a conquistador, a privateer, and an interstellar merchant. The Emperor of Mankind's decree from millennia past ensures your unrestrained freedom. A Warrant of Trade grants its holder authority on par with a Space Marine Chapter Master, an Inquisitor, or a Planetary Governor, giving them the rights to do anything they desire, as the only laws that apply to them are those outlined in their Warrant. When seeking specific information on your warrant, it is as if the ink flows across its surface to show you the relevant passage. While most Warrants are elaborate charters, yours is a sleek parchment that, while only on a single page, contains all of the information the charter does. All the essential details proving your rightful ownership are contained within. Your Warrant serves as your Omniversal ID, granting you an identity in whatever universe you happen to be in; your identity will always be that of high nobility or any regional equivalent there is. Your Warrant also serves as proof of permit, allowing you to bypass all governmental restrictions. While in possession of the Warrant of Trade, you are granted political immunity; as such, no one may attack or restrain you without proper justification. This Warrant is bound to your bloodline, granting you—and any descendants you pass it down to—the power and privileges it provides. Should it be stolen, it will ‌reappear within your reach next time you seek it, or if 24 hours have passed, whichever is shorter. As is your Emperor's given right, this Warrant of Trade allows you to engage in trade with anyone, regardless of the circumstances—whether they are an enemy faction or a political rival. You have the freedom to trade with them. Once you have shown your Warrant, they will open up their store for you, be it for something common or a rare prototype they have in R&D, they will not bar your way to any resources they might possess.
objects.title: Warrant of Trade (Warhammer: 40k)

rows.title: Miscellaneous Objects of Power
rows.titleText: Note: All non-consumable Objects of Powers can be transferred to another person. When this happens, you do not lose any abilities the object unlocked or awakened (physical alterations, magic independent of the object, etc.) but any soul bonds transferred to the new owner.

addons.text:
Whenever you enter an unconscious state—whether through closing your eyes, blinking, or during micro-naps—you gain a heightened awareness of your surroundings. This allows you to perceive movements, intentions, and even subtle changes in the environment with a high degree of accuracy. As you spend more time in this unconscious state, your foresight extends further into the future, enabling you to anticipate and counteract complex strategies and maneuvers before they occur. You don't need to remain in this state for long periods; entering multiple times in a short period can achieve similar results.

You can now execute intricate strategies and adapt to dynamic combat scenarios with greater speed and precision, as your subconscious mind takes over, bypassing mental fatigue entirely. This results in a seamless blend of fluid motion and strategic insight, making you a nearly unstoppable force in combat.
addons.title: Unseeing Meditation

objects.text:
You can enter a state known as Combat Meditation, which combines the benefits of power napping and meditative focus to enhance your combat efficiency and mental resilience. In this state, you can take incredibly short, 1-5 second micro-naps that provide the equivalent of 5-10 minutes of restful sleep. These micro-naps can be taken even during the heat of battle, allowing you to maintain peak performance, mental clarity, and stamina without losing awareness of your surroundings.

Furthermore, this ability allows you to perform actions unconsciously, bypassing mental fatigue and weakness. Your subconscious mind takes control, enabling you to fight, strategize, and react with precision and efficiency, even when your conscious mind is exhausted. This state enhances your reflexes and decision-making, making you an exceptionally formidable opponent who can continue to function effectively in prolonged engagements or under extreme stress. With this, you gain a significant edge in combat scenarios, ensuring that you remain vigilant, alert, and capable no matter the circumstances.
objects.title: Combat Meditation

addons.text:
Whenever you sleep, your mind enters an advanced form of dreaming where your subconscious not only refines and enhances your existing powers but also allows for minor adjustments and improvements. This includes optimizing techniques and slightly expanding your current capabilities within the bounds of your powers. Moreover, the refinement is not limited to your powers; it can also alter your body to a degree, enhancing your physical form within the natural limits of your genetics. This might include improvements in muscle tone, reflexes, or other physical attributes that your body can naturally achieve.

A shorter period of sleep focuses solely on rapid physical and mental recovery. In contrast, a longer period allows for deeper power and biological refinement. While the state primarily focuses on refinement, you gain subtle insights into your powers, helping you understand your abilities more intuitively. These insights are not new knowledge but a deeper, more instinctual grasp of what you can already do.
addons.title: Dreaming Rejuvenation

addons.text:
In action to your body instantly healing all injuries when falling asleep, it now also instantly refines your body, enhancing muscle tone, reflexes, and other physical attributes to the peak of your natural genetic limits, then continuously refines your genetics to exceed these natural limits to a limited degree. Additionally, when reducing light perception, beyond just healing you also preserve your body in perfect condition, keeping any injuries you have from worsening.

During sleep, unconsciousness, or deep meditation, your mind enters an advanced dreaming state where your subconscious refines and enhances your powers. This process allows for greater improvements, softening limitations without completely removing them, without increasing its raw power. You are able to gain deeper insights and a more instinctual grasp of your abilities. You are even able to gain new knowledge related to your powers and certain interactions it may have.

You can consciously direct the focus of the refinement towards specific types of improvements. This control over the type of improvement allows you to maximize the benefits of each session, ensuring that your development is both efficient and aligned with your goals.
addons.title: Dream Reset

objects.text:
You can enter a state known as Dream Stasis. While in this state, your body is perfectly preserved and maintained, halting all physical and biological processes to prevent aging and the need for sustenance.

In this state, your mind enters a state where your subconscious takes over, allowing you to practice, refines and optimizes your ability to use your powers. When you awaken from Dream Stasis, you will possess enhanced control and proficiency with your powers, having honed them in the safety of your subconscious mind. This doesn’t help you learn to do new stuff with your powers, only refine what you are already capable of. This proficiency is also subconscious, thus doesn’t actually give you any new knowledge about your powers.
objects.title: Dream Stasis

objects.text:
Your ability to produce webs from your body has evolved. You gain the ability to create thread from your skin and even telekinetically control it, with enough feedback to detect when something is in contact with it, just like a spider. 

When creating the thread you can also fiddle with its properties to a certain extent, for example choosing its thickness and durability or whether it is sticky. However, these alterations must remain within reason, so no creating molecule-thick threads with the durability of titanium.
objects.title: Spider’s Web

addons.text: Your control now extends beyond biology to every aspect of your existence, including spiritual, supernatural, and esoteric components. You are aware of any trace of yourself outside your body, whether physical matter, genetic material, soul fragments, lingering aura, magical signatures, or psychic imprints, and can freely choose whether they remain, fade, instantly disperse, or become inert and unusable. This prevents others from using parts of you for tracking, divination, curses, rituals, cloning, soul manipulation, or any form of sympathetic targeting, and you may choose to have this process occur automatically.
addons.title: Essence Lock

objects.text: Your biology is sealed and self-contained. To any scan, test, or observation, your internal biological structure appears completely normal for your race. You are aware of any part of your genetic material outside your body and can freely choose whether it remains intact, instantly disperses, or becomes inert and unusable, rendering any unwanted DNA or genetic collection, tracking, cloning, or analysis impossible. You may also choose to have this process occur automatically.
objects.title: Gene Lock

addons.text:
Now, any clones or other beings created using your blood can, if you so desire, become part of your hivemind and have all your powers and perks at full strength, just like normal clones produced using Hive Mind power. They also retain any additional powers gained during their creation process, although those powers remain unique to the body and will be lost to you should the body perish.

You can now also issue a shutdown command to any clone body produced by Hive Mind Power.
addons.title: All Your Clones are Belong to Us

addons.text: The esoteric nature of your powers have vastly broadened the reach of the Strange Blood. Now, everything and everyone descendant from you, be they a child, a clone, someone who was altered with your genes, or even something more esoteric like using a piece of your soul to create a new being, will automatically become your sensory if you so desire. This also broadened the scope of your influence over your sensories, as you can now telepathically communicate with them, freely design their personality during their creation, and remotely shut them down should the need arise. Lastly, this has eliminated the restriction on the amount of sensories you can have in one universe, and you can now create the sensories without needing for them to be born naturally. Although, in this case, they will not receive any powers native to the universe they are created in.
addons.title: Infectious Existence

objects.text:
Now, not only can you selectively allow your blood to retain some or all of the properties outside of your body, but when someone decides to use your blood for cloning or similar projects, the result of such endeavours is largely under your control.

If the result of those experiments is a living being, either created or altered with the use of your blood at any step of the process, then you have full control over how its consciousness would develop, ranging from complete free will, as if you never interfered, to unbreakable loyalty towards you, a customised personality, or even a complete lack of any thoughts, appearing comatose.

During their creation, you may establish an undetectable telepathic link to any such being, allowing you to either communicate with those capable of it or remotely pilot the bodies of those lacking consciousness. With each body requiring your control to act, your multitasking skills rise with the express purpose of piloting the body, so you will never be overwhelmed.

As with your own, you have full control over whether the blood of those created beings could be used for further such experiments and if you retain the same level of control over it, or if it will be completely useless as with the normal use of Strange Blood.

Lastly, you can issue a shutdown command to any body that you can remotely control, with said body instantly dissolving into basic organic components, completely useless to any further experiments.

You are always aware when someone tries to use your blood and can decide the result of the process either on case-by-case basis or make some choices apply by default.
objects.title: Project Radionoise

objects.text:
Your capacity to alter your voice evolves. You can freely alter your voice, being able to instantly replicate any sound and amplify the loudness of your own voice by up to 230 dB—loud enough to move objects and cause internal injury to those hearing it. You can make multiple sounds at the same time and can create your voice anywhere within 30-meters of you. You can tag something you're touching, turning it into a point you can use to broadcast your voice through, you can have ten of those tags at a time.

Your voice can spread farther by traveling through matter, working best on liquids, then solids and finally gases. The longer you use your voice, the farther it spreads; with time, you could affect a entire city.
objects.title: Voice Amplifier

objects.text:
You can enter your own mind and confront a simulated enemy whenever you are in the middle of or starting a task. This simulated enemy is thematically connected to the nature of the task at hand. Their strength is tied to the duration and complexity of the task. As you engage in battle with this enemy, your body automatically performs the task at peak performance, automatically elevating your abilities based on how well you fare in the mental duel. The better you fight, the more exceptional your execution of the task becomes. It is possible for your execution of the task to reach so good that it touches the realm of parahumans.

If you don’t emerge victorious in the mental battle, and you only survive, you will complete the task at slightly better than your average work. If you do die, your work will be worst than your average. Once the task is done, you regain all memories of performing it, as though you had been fully conscious of your actions throughout. 

Any pre-made commands you made will still be followed. Strangely, this power cannot be used for combat beyond the mental simulation. In other words, for actual combat you cannot use this power.
objects.title: Auto Battler

objects.text: Now, whenever you are about to engage in combat you can also choose to have that work automatically. Instead of heaving to fight, you can instead do puzzle games. The faster and better you do at the puzzle games the more successful you will be in combat. This can also work to replace the combat for any other chore you wish to do.
objects.title: How Puzzling…

addons.text: With both parallel processing and the ability to self-program, your mind has gained a mental computer. Able to interface with both your conscious and subconscious, it can process the data your mind receives at an enhanced rate, as well as actively react to any commands you give it. While you yourself do not gain superhuman levels of thinking, you are able to utilize your mental computer to do something similar, as you can have it feed you data by overlaying your senses in any particular manner you desire. Be careful about overloading your senses with this, as due to this power not being able to modify your mind directly, any negative effects from the additional information that you provide through your senses will have to be taken at full force.
addons.title: Mental Computer

addons.text:
Your processing and multithreading speeds have resulted in your brain developing in strange ways, such as emulating Shard architecture to now process those nigh-unlimited amounts of thought processes and information without hindrance, backlash, or mental traps at breakneck speeds. This allows you to calculate all manner of things, mentally adapt, perceive, predict, and act to anything around you at an accelerated pace, enhancing your bodily awareness and proprioception, and so on, while diminishing the toll this takes on your body and mind.

While formidable, a logical weakness borne by this interaction’s nature is the need for accurate information, you are yet limited by the amount of information you’re perceiving or possess on any given subject or situation, or incapable of properly using said information. Another limitation comes from your boundaries as a living being, that is, except for Robots, Constructs, or AIs, and even with a higher tolerance you’ll suffer under the strain of your power.
addons.title: Crystal Palace

addons.text: You can now adjust the thought speed of any of your active thought processes, allowing you to control the pace at which each process functions. Whether you want all thought processes to run at the same speed or wish to vary their speeds individually, you can do so with ease. This flexibility enables you to prioritize certain tasks or speed up specific processes without affecting others, enhancing your multitasking efficiency.
addons.title: Parallel Speed

addons.text: You now have the ability to merge multiple threads of thought into a single one. This would result in an enhanced thread that has boosted mental capabilities, such as improved thinking speed, creativity, focus, etc.
addons.title: Merged Threads

objects.text: You can have a nigh unlimited amount of thought processes running in parallel. Each thought process will think separately and focus on a different subject from the rest. Your primary thought process will manage the others and keep them up to date with each other. This power does not improve your thinking speed or ability to make good decisions.
objects.title: Parallel Processing

objects.text:
Your capacity for nigh infinite multitasking is fully integrated with the computer-like sectors of your brain, which are now capable of performing non-deterministic computation (a la a non-deterministic Turing machine). This allows you to "branch" your computations nigh infinitely without any competition over cognitive resources.

Utilizing this ability can be nuanced (and is enabled considerably by programming know-how or tinker-designed algorithms), but the most straightforward application is to brute-force solutions to problems well beyond what's usually feasible. For example, if you knew how a particular message was encrypted, you could decrypt it by brute forcing every possibility in an amount of time proportional to the length of the message, even in situations where the same strategy would take billions of years on a conventional computer.

More generally, you can perform any computation in NP using only a polynomial number of operations, offering exponential speedups over naive algorithms runnable on more traditional neural hardware, though you are still limited by RAM and effective clock-speed.
objects.title: P = NP

objects.text: You can adjust your perception speed to any level, from moving slower than normal to experiencing the world at a near standstill, giving you time to solve any problems or decision quickly. There is no longer any risk of headaches, allowing for extended use without issue.
objects.title: Adjustable Perception

objects.text:
You are no longer limited to a fast mind paired with a slow body. Now, your body has caught up to the speed of your thoughts, enabling you to move and react with the same heightened pace at which you process information. Your physical actions are as swift as your mind’s calculations—whether dodging an attack, executing complex maneuvers, or completing tasks in record time, your body flows effortlessly in sync with your mental speed. You will have a minor breaker effect on your body alters the way physics interact with it so that you won’t cause unintended damage like sonic booms.

However, there comes a heightened risk from using this. The strain that once only affected your mind now impacts your body as well. Overuse of this combined mental and physical acceleration can lead to serious consequences: nosebleeds, muscle fatigue, or even internal damage if used too long or too many times. The safest to use at maximum is no longer than 1 second in real time and have a 10-15 seconds break in between. Anything more will start to cause strain which can rapidly build up. You can toggle how fast you move, the slower you move, the longer you can last. For example, moving at 50% your top speed would let you safely use it for 2 seconds in realtime.
objects.title: Sandevistan

objects.text:
Your vibrations have evolved based of pseudo-scientific capabilities. In the beginning, you can only perform basic feats, such as partial phasing—passing through solid objects—or creating controlled shockwave blasts. However, with continued practice, your control improves, allowing you to manipulate vibrations on a deeper level.

As you reach the peak of your abilities, you unlock more advanced applications, such as generating resonance that can destabilize and collapse objects or structures, or even disrupting physical attacks, effectively rendering yourself immune to them.
