Eventually, you can acquire the ability to break through dimensional barriers by vibrating at precise frequencies, granting you access to other realities.
objects.title: Phasing

addons.text:
Your combat ability has elevated to an awe-inspiring level. With your sense of balance, flexibility, agility, and spatial awareness working in unison with your combat precognition, you have become a fighter like no other. You move with such expert grace that leaves others mistaking you for the wind itself—always a step ahead, always just out of reach. More akin to a dancer than a fighter, your movements flow elegantly, each action a masterpiece of fluidity and precision.

Your affinity for tools has also heightened, enabling you to turn anything, even the environment around you, into an advantage in battle. Every element within reach becomes a part of your rhythm, all dancing to your tune and amplifying your every move.
addons.title: Twilight Robin

addons.text: Your acrobatics inherit your boundless maneuverability, applicable to any environment or situation you find yourself in, both helping in freerunning activities and compensating for terrain. Now, you’re up to the task of any form of movement from animalistic to mechanical, performing any kind of activity, and with an athletic physique bordering on a Breaker effect to facilitate all your actions.
addons.title: Be like Water, Float like the Wind

objects.text:
You’ve become a one-person circus act capable of astonishing acrobatic feats. With an unbreakable sense of balance, you remain unshakable, unable to be knocked off your feet without your say-so. Expert control over your sense of nausea keeps you steady through even the most dizzying acts, and juggling comes effortlessly to you—stacking, balancing, and throwing objects with flawless precision.

Your flexibility and agility now reach superhuman levels, letting you perform and move in ways most would consider impossible. Having gained an intuitive understanding of which surfaces can be climbed or balanced on, you leverage this instinct to achieve unparalleled fluid and efficient movement. Running, scaling, and vaulting over obstacles have become second nature to you, turning you into an expert at freerunning and urban traversal.

You also possess a sixth sense of spatial awareness, letting you instantly orient yourself and judge distances with pinpoint accuracy, even while in mid-air, for leaps and climbs. As a bonus, you now know how to maintain a baseline of fitness, ensuring you stay in top form to support these skills.
objects.title: Circus Acrobatics

objects.text:
Your flawless healing has combined with the efficiency of your bodily functions, extending it to your DNA and processes such as cellular reproduction. This prevents the degradation of your cells and DNA as they undergo bodily functions such as mitosis. It even applies to telomeres, preventing them from shortening and extending your lifespan. 

Normally this wouldn’t actually be a good thing, as cells not degrading would result in cancer and mutations. However, the robustness of your bodily functions has miraculously avoided that, preventing genetic mutations and only stopping unwanted cell degradation, allowing for helpful and controlled cell death like apoptosis. This actually provides a minor resistance to the effects of radiation as your body simply cannot develop detrimental mutations and your cells resist uncontrolled cell death.
objects.title: Cellular Robustness

addons.text:
Due to the hyper-efficiency of your body and an additional stockpile of energy, the evolution you undergo through your triple helix DNA has become much greater; cutting each cycle's time in half and allowing for greater evolution and adaptability than before, with the same restrictions remaining.

Along with greater passive evolution, you can make these adaptations greater through tempering them with regular activities such as challenging your mind to puzzles or regularly exercising to push your adaptations to their limits and surpass them; given enough time, your mutations could even bend and break the known limits of biology.

Your resistance to biokinesis has grown stronger, allowing you to shrug off the weaker efforts; with your body working to undo force changes by using your evolution cycles to undo the mess, this also extends to your immune system, which will not only quickly locate and neutralize any hazards, but go a step further to create the type of antibodies needed to fight off similar threats and even hold off greater threats until a countermeasure can be created.
addons.title: Sportacus?

objects.text:
Your body is a marvel of constant, positive evolution. In addition to flawless healing and cellular robustness, your DNA undergoes a unique form of continuous, beneficial mutation. Your cells adapt and evolve at a steady rate, but instead of harmful or random changes, each mutation enhances your physiology. New biological systems emerge, stronger, more efficient, and more resilient with each cycle.

This process is rooted in your DNA, now structured in a triple helix formation. The third strand of the helix allows for increased genetic complexity, enabling faster adaptation to new stimuli and ensuring every mutation is constructive. The triple helix also boosts your body’s capacity for self-repair, adding another layer of redundancy to ensure any genetic damage is quickly corrected. This also gives you a heightened resistance to biokinesis. If you have a Shard, your powers also influence your growth, making it so that even if you lose access to your shard, you can use extremely weakened emulations through your biology. From these foundations, your body will continue to grow, evolving stronger and more refined mutations that push the limits of biology. 

Your enhanced genetics also grant you all positive, naturally occurring mutations known to science. For instance, you possess a mutation called COL5A1, associated with hypermobility, which provides remarkable joint flexibility, enabling an extraordinary range of motion and adaptability under physical strain. Another mutation, ACTN3, strengthens your muscle fibers, imbuing you with increased muscle density and endurance that can rival or surpass elite athletes.

However, while your mutations are powerful, you are not capable of developing features far removed from human physiology. For example, growing gills for underwater breathing or sprouting wings for flight is beyond the reach of your mutations, as they require biological systems too alien to your current form.
objects.title: Type: Humanity

objects.text:
Your medieval technology can now compete with modern equivalents. Crossbows now rival firearms in range and power, armor can absorb impacts like Kevlar, and chariots are capable of moving as fast as motorised vehicles.

Additionally, this effect applies to any modern technology you create, making it equivalent to futuristic versions. If you possess other tinker abilities, they are also affected by this boost.

This boost isn’t a tinker effect, instead it’s simply empowering them similar to Dauntless.
objects.title: Techno Medieval

objects.text:
You possess a formidable power package known as the Social Thinker. With this power set, you can instantly discern the social groups people belong to and gain an intuitive understanding of how to seamlessly integrate into any group. Upon joining, you immediately recognize the roles and relationships of each member, allowing you to subtly manipulate group dynamics to assume leadership or any role you prefer.

You can identify the strengths and weaknesses of group members with astonishing accuracy, uncovering even their most well-guarded secrets. With this knowledge, you can skillfully orchestrate conflicts, remaining blameless in the eyes of others, or expertly mend divisions, reconciling even the bitterest of rivals with a single conversation. Your ability to mediate earns you respect from all parties, and you are always aware of existing or brewing tensions.

Beyond groups, you have an extraordinary talent for earning people's trust and admiration, even from the most guarded and distrustful individuals. You can form connections with seemingly incompatible people, fostering friendships between those with clashing beliefs and ideals.
objects.title: Social Thinker

addons.text:
How curious, it seems that your ability to regulate temperatures has melded with your telekinesis, allowing you to create pockets of hot air high enough that it could start fires, cold air low enough that it could form a layer of frost over whatever it touches, and combine the two to create electrically charged pockets of air.

With your knowledge and understanding of weather and atmospheric science, you are able to combine these spheres of air to cause localized weather changes. Sudden and quick rainfall, fog, and weak lightning are possible examples of what you can do, but these are all weak and very localized around the pockets themselves.
addons.title: Weather Tricks

objects.text:
The rate at which you can transfer temperature has been enhanced, allowing you to quickly induce Hypo- or Hyperthermia in those you touch, with all the associated ailments they bring. Though it takes you about a minute to affect people strongly enough for them to die, you can still affect them beyond their death, either heating them up until their blood starts boiling, or until they freeze. You're also capable of reversing their temperature back to normal without any consequences, as long as their organs haven't been affected yet.

You can also affect objects this way. The bigger your target is, the slower and more straining it becomes to affect them. You are unfazed by the temperature of things you’ve affected, even boiling water, cold ice and heated iron wouldn’t affect you if it was that way due to your power. Your temperature range has also been expanded, ranging from -200°C to 1000°C. You're capable of selectively applying this effect, either to limit which of your or your subjects body parts are heated up or frozen.
objects.title: Thermal Dysregulation

addons.text:
You may now be more precise with what parts of your body you detach. This would allow for detachment of minor body parts such as mouths, ears, fingers, toes, and even inner organs in extreme cases. 

This also gives all parts of your body total graft tolerance for transplants. Additionally, the halved regrow time from Tenome now applies to your entire body.
addons.title: Precise Detachment

addons.text: You are now able to attach non-organic items to your body. With this you slot in a sword instead of an arm or wheels instead of legs.
addons.title: Prosthetic

objects.text:
You are no longer limited to just detaching hands, and may now detach any major parts of your body from another, such as your arms, legs, torso, or head. 

Additionally, your ability to slowly regrow body parts extends throughout your entire body, though it still does not help mitigate any symptoms of such injuries, including death. You may only have one torso at a time.
objects.title: Full Body Detachment

addons.text:
You have increased control over how your body interacts with the world, allowing you to telekinetically manipulate parts of your body independently. This allows for the ability to manipulate body parts independently, such as legs, heads, hair, or even blood.

You may also toggle the tangibility of your body parts, as long as you have some tangible body part remaining nearby to take in the rest.
addons.title: Complete Bodily Manipulation

objects.text: You have total control over both body and mind, whether it be your heart, brain, senses, limbs, or any other bodily functions or parts. This also removes any limits on how many body parts you may be in control of at once.
objects.title: Complete Bodily Management

addons.text: You can imbue your attributes, skills, or other elements in your Status Window with a "Seed of Potential." This seed accelerates their growth, allowing them to surpass current limits through training. You can apply up to three such enhancements simultaneously.
addons.title: Gamer-lite

addons.text:
Your bird's-eye view is now always active and displayed as a minimap at the edge of your vision. You can expand it at any time to see a more detailed map. The map shows your current location, and an area within a 1.2-mile (2 km) radius around you is continuously scanned and updated in real-time.

The map also automatically records any atlases or maps you hold in your hands, whether they depict local terrain, ocean currents, or elevation. Areas you visit personally are recorded with maximum detail, while atlases are saved as they are presented.
addons.title: Mini and Mega Map

addons.text:
Your pocket dimension is now synchronized with your Status Window, allowing you to easily manage its contents. You can create item groups, mark favorites, and interact with them directly. Instead of a single portal, you can now create an unlimited number of portals within a 5-meter (16-foot) radius around you.

The dimension now can store energy-based objects, and you can choose whether items inside remain in stasis or not. All your money placed into inventory is displayed separately for convenience.

You have also gained a second section — Store, which starts empty. This tab is filled with every items you place into your dimension, making them available for purchase using money from your inventory. The system works by converting the "Value" of the money into exact replicas of the items. Freshly printed money has no "Value," but money that has been in circulation for at least a year does.

The store can reproduce any mundane items but not supernatural objects or tinkertech. Prices are determined by the complexity and rarity of the item. For example, a full functional car would be expensive but still cheaper than a historical diamond.
addons.title: Storage and Store

addons.text:
Your pocket dimension is now synchronized with your Status Window, allowing you to easily manage its contents. You can create item groups, mark favorites, and interact with them directly. Instead of a single portal, you can now create an unlimited number of portals within a 5-meter (16-foot) radius around you.

Whenever a projectile is fired at you with the intent to cause harm, a portal to your inventory automatically opens in front of it, neutralizing the threat. You can chose whether the projectile is sent back to the attacker, is stored for later, or becomes mute. You may also adjust it for other uses.

The dimension now can store energy-based objects, and you can choose whether items inside remain in stasis or not. All your money placed into inventory is displayed separately for convenience.

You have also gained a second section — Store, which starts empty. This tab is filled with every items you place into your dimension, making them available for purchase using money from your inventory. The system works by converting the "Value" of the money into exact replicas of the items. Freshly printed money has no "Value," but money that has been in circulation for at least a year does.

The store can reproduce any mundane items but not supernatural objects or tinkertech. Prices are determined by the complexity and rarity of the item. For example, a full functional car would be expensive but still cheaper than a historical diamond.
addons.title: Auto Defensive Storage and Store

addons.text: You can now view exhaustive details about your powers. From how many calculations your Shard makes, to the exact details of your flight, including minimum and maximum speed, acceleration and deceleration, maximum height you can rise to, its interactions with your body and a lot more information going into minute details.
addons.title: Power HUD

addons.text:
With a touch, you can place special Marks that you can instantly teleport to using Blink. These Marks are visible only to you, and you can freely change their appearance for example, making them a pillar of light stretching into the sky, a glowing star, or a specific symbol.

You always know the exact coordinates of each created Mark and distance to them at any moment. Marks do not disappear over time and will remain active indefinitely until you choose to remove them.

If you have Mini and Mega Map, you gain the ability to place Marks directly on the map, including any locations you have previously visited, even if they are beyond your current line of sight.
addons.title: Blink Points

addons.text:
A new Gacha tab has been added, allowing you to spin and obtain random powers, items, or both—permanently.

However, each acquired power initially possesses only 1/6 of its full strength. To unlock its true potential, you must collect six identical copies of the same ability.

To participate in the Gacha, you will need Power Gems — a special currency earned by defeating enemies, completing certain quests, or performing other significant actions. The harder the challenge, the greater the reward.

Powers are extremely rare, and you will commonly receive items. However, after 100 spins, you are guaranteed to obtain a power. Additionally, the more you spin the Gacha, the higher your chances of getting the power you desire.
addons.title: Gachamania

addons.text:
Now you have two new tabs: Recycle and Synthesis, which let you upgrade and enhance the rarity of your items.

The Recycle tab allows you to break down unwanted items into Materials, which can be used to enhance other items. Upgrading an item makes it stronger, more durable, and more effective. A level 10 weapon will deal more damage, level 20 armor will provide better protection, and tools will work faster and last longer.

The maximum upgrade level is 100. Once an item reaches this level, further enhancement is only possible through one use of Synthesis.

The Synthesis tab lets you combine items to increase their rarity, quality, and even unlock special abilities or characteristics. For example, merging two level 1 common pistols with a level 100 common pistol will create a level 1 uncommon pistol. To use Synthesis, the main item must be level 100, while the others must be level 1 and of the same rarity as the main item.

If you have Gachamania, you can use these mechanics to upgrade your powers.
addons.title: Recycling and Synthesis

addons.text:
Have you ever wondered, “How would my powers A and B work together under certain conditions?” You no longer have to guess, the answer will always be in your status. Every time you imagine a possible synergy between your powers, your status automatically analyzes the idea and tells you whether it’s viable. If it is, it also provides brief advice and recommendations on how to achieve the synergy: What to focus on, what conditions are required, and what to avoid.

Additionally, when you touch another Parahuman and receive a report on their powers, the system automatically expands the report with a list of potential interactions and combinations between their powers and yours, as well as with the synergizes of other individuals whose powers you’ve already analyzed. This includes short descriptions, usage examples, and likely effects that may occur when combining your powers.
addons.title: Synergizes Advice

objects.text: Your HUD now displays not only your powers but also all your physical, mental or other stats, unique traits, skills, health point's, and energy reserves in a convenient numerical format. The HUD can be customized to suit your preferences. You can only watch, not interact.
objects.title: Status Window

objects.text:
Anything you need to do that doesn’t involve directly interacting with other people, such as a personal interactions, you can now set to be done on its own, exactly as you would have done it if you have it your full dedication and time without the hiccups you may have otherwise encountered. 

Research completes itself, tech is created and assembled, training is completed, all with the benefits of you having done it on your best day. 

This phantom version of you carries over all natural progressions it would have made over to you as if you would have done, training would make you stronger, research will have the knowledge in your mind, without any of the negative side effects.
objects.title: Offscreen

addons.text:
Thanks to the melding of different abilities on top of the three stand-ins able to interact with others you gain additional instances whose purpose is to work. You gain 34 Employment Focus instances in the beginning but they can grow with time and experience, they perform the jobs but social aspects are kept to a minimum. Just enough to work in teams and get promoted but it ends there, attending work-related events such as team building, going out for drinks and ensuring those they are responsible for are safe.

In the event of a crisis or disaster these instances can work outside the work-only restrictions but only for a short time, once the situation has been resolved they will return to their work-only routine. Should a job be lost then the instance ends with it, getting demoted or promoted does not end the instance.

However, you cannot double up on the same job as each instance must be either a different profession or working for a different employer. As usual no one will notice you working dozens of jobs at once or question it with even things like taxes, only knowing which job you want them to know while gaining all the benefits.

For the purposes of this power Volunteer Work counts as a job.
addons.title: Idle Work Life

addons.text:
Thanks to the melding of different abilities you have gained access to a new type of instance, one designed to maintain ongoing relationships. In the beginning you will have a single Relationship Slot to use, when in use an Instance of you will go out to maintain a relationship or attend social events.

A Relationship Instance acts as you would and will maintain a status quo of a relationship, not letting it degrade or worsen; however, when interacting with people you have not met before they will generally act neutral save for extreme cases such as violence or emergencies. You can make meaningful progress with relationships through an Instance but they will be limited to the choices presented via Dialogue.

Should someone who is empowering you be in need of help you can allow a Relationship Instance to appear near them and act as if you were there yourself with all your powers and abilities fully rested, it is tied to the person you have a connection with so if they die your Instance will end.

The number of Relationship Instances you can have can be increased through use and building relationships with others, with the deeper the relationship the more that goes towards gaining new Relationship Instances.
addons.title: Storied Personal Life

objects.text:
Your ability to push tasks “offscreen” no longer stops at the edge of personal interaction.

You may now assign actions that involve other people to be carried out in the background as well, as though handled by invisible, perfectly competent stand-ins acting entirely on your behalf. 

These interactions occur naturally and believably, with no physical presence performing them, no traceable source, and no observable anomaly. To everyone involved, the interaction is remembered as having genuinely happened, complete and unquestioned, unless you later draw attention to the impossibility of it.

At any given time, you may maintain up to three concurrent person-involved interactions, functioning as if you had three unseen duplicates acting independently, each capable of conversations, negotiations, coordination, instruction, or other social exchanges exactly as you would have conducted them yourself under the most ideal conditions and best possible outcome. 

These instances act with your intent, judgment, and discretion, but they hey cannot be detected, interrupted, targeted, or traced, because nothing exists to perceive.

Your power also now handles evidence a bit differently as well. 

Evidence, memory, and attribution are handled autonomously by the power. 

Rather than you deciding what persists, the power continuously determines—moment to moment, observer to observer—what information should exist, fade, contradict, or never form at all, based on what best serves your interests and objectives.

Different individuals present at the same event may retain entirely different recollections of you. One person may remember flirting with you vividly, recall your presence fondly, and believe the interaction meaningful, while another—despite spending more time near you—fails to recall you at all. Memories may weaken, sharpen, alter, or disappear if doing so becomes advantageous, even after the fact.

Physical and digital evidence follows the same adaptive premise. Photographs, recordings, paperwork, logs, and forensic traces may exist for some aspects of an event and not others, even when arising from the same setting. 

A group photo may depict you clearly at a party, while surveillance footage from a robbery at that same location contains no indication you were ever there. 

If circumstances change—such as scrutiny increasing or connections forming that would be inconvenient—the power may quietly revise what persists, erasing names, blurring recognition, or preventing realizations from fully forming.

Tasks that do not involve people remain unlimited in number and scope as before.
objects.title: Background Presence

objects.text: Congratulations! You've got the discount version of Ultra Instinct! If you're being swarmed by a flurry of punches, being shot at point-blank, facing raining arrows or anything similar, then you'll automatically dodge, tuck, roll, weave, flip and do whatever else is necessary to come out unscathed. Every. Single. Time. And if it's possible, you'll also automatically counter with a strike that's guaranteed to connect with your opponent. However, the catch is that you can't dodge what you can't see. So, watch your back.
objects.title: Sonic Sway

objects.text:
Now, you are able to not only accurately measure the dimensions of an object, but also obtain additional data such as the distance to the object, the time it would take to reach it based on your current speed, the number of details like windows, cracks, and other features. However, your power only works within your line of sight. If you can only see one side of an object, the power will assume symmetry. For asymmetrical or damaged objects, you will need to fully inspect them.

This ability also analyzes data based on your knowledge. For example, if you are familiar with concrete mix standards, you will be able to identify the type of concrete used. If you know medical information about skin diseases, you will be able to detect skin problems in a person. If you have knowledge of metals, your power will allow you to identify them even in complete darkness.

This power synergizes with your other powers.
objects.title: Object Data

objects.text:
Your very presence becomes an olfactory nightmare. At will, your body now exudes an invisible, caustic aura that affects all living beings with a sense of smell—or anything similar, like pheromone receptors in insects. Small creatures like bugs, rodents, or birds instinctively flee before they get close, as if hit by an overwhelming survival instinct. Humans and larger animals aren’t so lucky.

To each person, your smell becomes uniquely horrifying, manifesting as the worst thing they’ve ever encountered—or the most unbearable thing they can imagine. For one person, you might smell like rotting garbage left in the sun. For another, it could be burning rubber, or even something deeply personal, like the scent of a traumatic memory. Whatever it is, it’s impossible to ignore.

The smell isn’t just unpleasant; it’s persistent. It clings to the air around you, making prolonged exposure unbearable. Even people with masks or respirators aren’t entirely safe—your aura has a way of seeping into filtered systems, overwhelming them with a hint of that personal nightmare. Prolonged exposure to your scent goes beyond discomfort. After a few minutes in your presence, individuals begin to suffer the same painful, short-term effects as if they’d come into direct contact with your caustic sweat or saliva. Their skin might tingle and sting, their eyes could water uncontrollably, and their throats might burn as if inhaling corrosive fumes. Over time, the effects intensify, leading to red, irritated skin, shortness of breath, and dizziness.
objects.title: Stinky Pants

addons.text:
Your two muscle-based powers have fused, allowing you to push past your body’s natural constraints. You can now expand your muscle fibers beyond their normal limits, gradually increasing in mass and height, reaching a maximum of 50 feet tall over the course of five minutes. Unlike before, you no longer have an upper limit on how big you can get. In addition, this transformation does not reduce your fine control—your muscle fibers remain fully manipulable, letting you extend tendrils, create armor, form extra limbs, or even shape weapons from your own flesh.

Your muscle control extends to every fiber, allowing you to react with inhuman precision, shifting between brute-force destruction and surgical accuracy. Additionally, your ability to manipulate muscles in others is amplified—you can now extend control through physical contact, momentarily overriding someone’s movements or causing their muscles to lock, spasm, or tear with terrifying ease.

Lastly, you’re no longer limited your bodily reserves and bodily boundaries, allowing you to go all out without much worries.
addons.title: Body Builder

objects.text:
Now controlling your muscle mass stretches far as your muscular tissue in the same vein as Marquis is with bone tissue. It has developed into a fine control, fully bursting from your body that ranges from generating new muscle, using them prehensilely stretch them for handling objects around you or creating an armor made from your muscles, short and mid-range attacks, tensing one’s muscles to close wounds or heightening their density, a higher handle of enhancing and weakening your muscle mass and usage, among others. 

Seeing anyone in your line of sight with an open wound helps extend your power, controlling the motor skills through their muscles, causing them to underreact or overreact to their neural impulses, and flex their muscles so violently you rip their tendons and snap bone.

Unfortunately, you’re limited in your bodily reserves and bodily boundaries, meaning you generate muscle mass you’re theoretically capable of and within your body’s confines, as this doesn’t increase your bodily mass and height to accommodate greater muscle mass. This has the outcome of a higher calorie intake and accelerated metabolism, helping replenish your reserves.
objects.title: Muscular

objects.text:
You can apply the effects of your powers onto shadows within your vicinity, this manifests as either a lingering or generating effect. For example, if you can manipulate fire, you can increase the temperature of the area your shadow occupies or to generate your fire from your target's shadow. Your magic missiles can be fired from the pitch black around you, maybe even cause a fakeout punch with your own shadow, and whatever else you can think of.

The only limit is that you may only apply one effect at a time, one for each shadow.
objects.title: Lingering Shadows

addons.text:
Your shield now extends to provide a defense from non-physical attacks, including curses, poisons, sickness, Trumps, Masters, Strangers, temporal shenanigans, reality rewriters, and any power that directly affects others.

The strength of this protection scales with the strength of your shield; when your shield is damaged, this protection weakens relative to the percentage of your shield that is destroyed and recovers alongside it.
addons.title: Comprehensive Shielding
EVA Field
addons.text:
Your disparate forcefields have combined, and in doing so have evolved. 

From the vacuum of space to the crushing depths at the bottom of an ocean or ground zero of a bio-chemical hazard, your forcefield now provides everything you need to survive in all manner of hostile environments. For a while at least. 

Whilst it perfectly provides for details like temperature, pressure and air, as well as a hermetic seal, your EVA Field has a major limitation in that it can only provide actual sustenance when being fed by an energy source.

If you have SolarHouse of the Cell or Malachite Cells, you can now absorb their respective forms of energy directly through the EVA Field, and are now fully immune to even the most intense sources of radiation. 

If you have Minor Telekinesis your field will also provide you with a small amount of manoeuvrability in zero G environments - about one tenth of a G of acceleration.

Your EVA Field exists in two layers, both skin tight. In the event your protective field is punctured you will retain a secondary, intangible life support layer, which will only maintain atmospheric pressure and an air supply.

objects.text:
Your field’s durability and strength scale directly with your base defense, making it significantly more resilient. As your natural defenses improve, so does the forcefield’s capacity to absorb and mitigate damage, allowing it to withstand greater impacts without breaking.

The stronger your defense and the weaker the attack, the faster the field regenerates, allowing minor damage to repair almost instantaneously. For severe breaches caused by powerful strikes, the repair rate slows but never goes below five square inches per second.
objects.title: Shield Up

objects.text:
Your wings have evolved beyond their original limitations, granting you true flight, though with certain restrictions. If they are ever torn off, they will now regenerate over time, but the process is both slow and excruciatingly painful. Unlike before, where you could only glide, you can now take to the skies under your own power. However, your speed, endurance, and altitude are tied to your physical attributes.

Your maximum flight speed is equal to your top sprinting speed. The duration of your flight is directly linked to your endurance. Additionally, the maximum altitude you can reach is determined by your strength. At an average human level of fitness, you can maintain flight for approximately five kilometers and reach a height of around 100 meters before the strain becomes too great.
objects.title: True Wings

objects.text:
Your grip is no longer limited to just your hands and fingers. Any form of sustained hold—whether through joint locks, body clinches, bear hugs, or even using your legs or other parts of your body—counts as part of your grip. If you’re applying pressure, it’s considered a grip. 

Additionally, the longer you hold something in your grip, the stronger your grip becomes, allowing you to crush anything, with the exception of All-or-Nothings, if given enough time. This boosts your base grip strength, enough that you can leave minor, but noticeable, indents in reinforced steel.
objects.title: Crushing Grip

addons.title: Study Date
addons.text:
The potential you can draw upon from those with a spark of affection has grown, no longer strictly limited to power you are able to share talent subjects as well. The key word being talent, as while knowledge is shared, so to speak, it's mainly located in the subconscious, where it can act as a learning booster, intuition, or a eureka moment to aid in your development and that of those who care for you.

The scope of the effectiveness depends on the knowledge gap, expertise in the subject and level of affection. If you're smarter than all those who care for you you still get something of a learning boost but it would be hard to notice, meanwhile those whom you have a connection with will still fully benefit from this power.

addons.title: The Power of Bonds
addons.text:
Just as your bonds with others give you strength, you can now do the same for them, as the boost from Cheerer will be constantly applied to them, but that's not all as the effect has grown stronger as well.

Now if your connection with someone was deep enough to rival that a mother has for her child or a lifelong friend the boost from Cheerer is double what it was before, but if you were with the person it can grow to be four times greater as even your silent support becomes something to help them through whatever challenges they face. This boost also enhances the addons of Cheerer.

addons.title: The Over-Power of Bonds
addons.text:
It's safe to say you now count as your loved ones' cheat power.

The boosts from both 'The Power of Bonds' and 'Study Date' are greatly boosted and synergize, allowing all aspects of them to grow and refine themselves at formerly impossible rates, giving them seemingly protagonist-level talent and development speed.

But it goes further, as you can give them lesser versions of Assessment and Independent Review; at their peak, these versions are only half as strong as your own but will go a long way toward helping those who love you grow into the best possible versions of themselves on their paths in life through the consideration of hundreds of solutions and the removal of flaws and misconceptions.

Should you have any powers that boost training speed or grant powers, you can share them through this connection.

objects.text:
Your connection to others goes beyond just seeing how they feel about you, you become attuned to their very essence. You gain an innate awareness of everyone who holds positive feelings for you, no matter where they are. It’s like having a mental map that constantly updates, showing not just who cares about you, but exactly how much.

Anyone who has even a spark of affection for you becomes a source of potential. You can copy any power they possess, drawing on the bond created by their positive emotions. The strength and effectiveness of the copied power depend entirely on how deeply they feel about you. If someone likes you just a little, the copy will be weak, like a faint echo of the original. But if their feelings are strong—filled with admiration, love, or deep loyalty—the copy becomes much more powerful.

You need at minimum the equivalent of the the love a mother has for their child or the trust and affection a lifelong friend has for the copied power to be an exact replica, perfect in every detail, down with all the innate skills/knowledge the power comes with. Additionally, you can only use 3 powers at once.
objects.title: Affection Overload

objects.text:
Instead of only your organs, your entire body has adapted to withstand greater physical stress. Muscles, skin, and bones stretch and deform under force rather than breaking, allowing you to endure impacts that would normally cripple a human. Wounds heal faster, damage is less permanent, and your body resists infection more effectively. However, this resilience isn’t perfect—enough force will still break and tear you. The more injured you become, the tougher and less elastic your body gets, making you more rigid and vulnerable to further damage.

Your body also now instinctively flows with attacks to dissipate their force. Blunt strikes, slashes, and impacts lose effectiveness as your body bends, relaxing to a near-weightless state, minimising resistance to incoming blows. By flowing with attacks instead of meeting them with force, you can dissipate their energy, rendering punches, kicks, and slashes far less effective. However, the more injured you are, the harder it becomes to relax—your body instinctively stiffens, reducing this passive defense and making you more susceptible to damage.
objects.title: Spongey Body

objects.text:
Your control over your hair allows you unrestricted control over its growth, regeneration, reshaping, and length. It functions as a fully controllable appendage, capable of moving independently or acting in unison.

Integrated with your nervous system, your hair provides precise feedback and fine motor control, allowing delicate or forceful maneuvers with ease. Damage is inconsequential, as instant regeneration ensures no permanent loss. Your hair is also highly resistant to physical, thermal, and chemical harm, retaining its durability even in extreme conditions.

Its properties are fully adjustable, letting you modify density, volume, and flexibility at will. It can harden to steel-like strength for defense or offense or soften for intricate tasks. Colors and patterns are endlessly customizable, including dynamic glowing effects or shifting multi-toned hues.
objects.title: Comakinesis

addons.text:
You don’t just see the world as numbers—you see it as a vast, interconnected blueprint where every system, structure, and person is part of a complex equation. Physical objects, social dynamics, emotions, and even abstract concepts like influence and authority are all quantifiable variables woven into an elaborate framework that your mind processes effortlessly.

Buildings and machines unfold in your vision as layered schematics, revealing their structural weaknesses, stress points, and design flaws at a glance. In combat, an opponent’s stance, muscle tension, and breathing form a real-time model of their capabilities and vulnerabilities, letting you predict their moves with surgical precision.

But your perception goes beyond the physical. People are walking equations; emotions, motivations, relationships, and mental states are measurable as shifting values. Trust, fear, confidence, loyalty, and deception all have patterns you can read and manipulate. A simple conversation is like adjusting variables in an ongoing formula; you know exactly what to say or do to tilt the outcome in your favor, whether it’s defusing conflict, inspiring loyalty, or sowing doubt.

Your mind doesn’t just analyse these systems; it understands how to alter them with minimal input for maximum effect. By identifying key variables, whether it’s a load-bearing beam in a structure or a critical emotional trigger in a negotiation, you can create cascading effects that ripple through the entire system. You don’t need brute force to win; you just need to adjust the right number at the right time.
addons.title: Formula to Victory

objects.text:
You are a discount Number Man. Your mind doesn’t just process numbers—you see the world as numbers. Every object, person, and event is overlaid with a constant stream of data. Distances, angles, speeds, trajectories, force vectors, and structural stress points aren’t things you calculate after observation—they’re part of how you perceive reality, like color or shape.

Your raw measurement and calculation has turned into instinct. You don’t think about the length of a bridge or the arc of a falling object; you see it as clearly as you see its color. Moving objects leave trails of projected paths, allowing you to predict their future positions with pinpoint accuracy. When watching people, you subconsciously process micro-expressions, posture shifts, and movement patterns, turning behavior into statistical probabilities.

Complex calculations happen automatically in the background, without conscious effort. You can glance at a collapsing structure and immediately know which support beam is most critical or look at a thrown object and see exactly where it will land. Patterns emerge from chaos because your brain breaks everything down into quantifiable data, revealing connections and outcomes most people would miss.
objects.title: Numerical Boy

addons.text:
Your clothing now works in perfect harmony with your natural storage abilities. No matter how impractical your outfit, it will always have hidden compartments, pouches, or seamlessly integrated folds that function as extra storage. Whether you’re wearing a tight bodysuit, a flowing robe, or even just a swimsuit, you will always have discreet yet easily accessible spaces to stow small items.

These hidden storage spots do not add bulk, restrict movement, or become noticeable unless you intentionally reveal them. Need to retrieve a tool, weapon, or trinket? Your clothing subtly shifts to allow for quick, effortless access, ensuring that even the most cumbersome attire never slows you down when reaching for what you need.
addons.title: Seamless Storage

addons.text:
No matter what you’re wearing, your outfit will always look its best on camera. Whether you’re in motion or standing still, your clothes will adjust just enough to ensure they fall naturally into the most flattering and striking positions. Fabric will never bunch up awkwardly, cloaks and coats will billow at just the right moments, and even the most impractical outfits will arrange themselves to appear seamless and intentional.

Beyond just looking good, your clothing will always maintain a sharp, well-kept appearance, no matter the situation. Formal attire stays crisp and smooth, never wrinkling or getting stained, even in a fight. Suits and dresses remain perfectly fitted, never sagging or stretching out of shape. Even after intense movement, your clothes settle into place with an almost unnatural precision, ensuring that you look as composed at the end of a battle as you did at the start. If you’re wearing formalwear, it enhances your presence, making you appear more dignified and commanding, while casual wear never looks sloppy or out of place, keeping you effortlessly put-together in any scenario.
addons.title: Picture-Ready

addons.text: When you wear something impressive, your clothing not only enhances your appearance but also boosts your capabilities. The better your outfit looks, the more powerful it becomes. Whether you’re wearing a flashy gown or a complex suit of armor, your clothes gain significant boosts in flexibility, strength, durability, and speed. Even if the clothing has no special qualities, they will gain a functional benefit tailored to their design. This effect applies to your base clothes, not just when you activate (Striker/Tinker) Dress Up!. The better your outfit looks, the stronger and more functional it becomes on its own. A fancy dress with frills might gain resistance to damage and improve your agility, while a mechanical suit could become more durable and faster. However, once you take the clothes off, the boost fades—these enhancements are temporary and tied directly to the outfit’s appearance, disappearing when the clothes are removed.
addons.title: Fashion Overdrive

objects.text:
Your clothes will always work exactly how you need them to. No matter how impractical an outfit is, it won’t slow you down, restrict movement, or cause any inconvenience. Long dresses won’t trip you, heavy coats won’t weigh you down, and high heels feel as stable as sneakers.

This extends beyond just comfort—your clothing will never get in your way. Loose fabric won’t snag or catch, oversized armor won’t limit flexibility, and even the most ridiculous accessories, like massive hats or flowing capes, won’t block your vision or movement. If an outfit has pockets, they’ll always be easy to reach. If it doesn’t, anything you store will still stay secure.

Not only does your clothing never get in your way, but it actively works in your favor. Long coats and capes flow perfectly to mask your movements, skirts and robes shift to avoid interference while still providing coverage, and even bulky outfits somehow enhance balance rather than throw it off. High heels subtly adjust to keep you stable on any terrain, gloves improve your grip without sacrificing dexterity, and even the heaviest armor distributes its weight so efficiently that it feels like wearing everyday clothes. Exposed areas of armor, no matter how open or vulnerable they seem, are protected just as effectively as if they were fully covered, without altering its appearance.

Even if an outfit looks impractical, it will function as if it was designed for whatever you’re doing. You could run a marathon in formal wear, fight in a mascot costume, or climb a mountain in a full robe, and it would work just as well as wearing the best gear for the job.
objects.title: Functional Clothes

objects.text: Are you cheating? What hack client did you install? Because it seems like that whatever ranged attack you use, it hits your target with impossible trajectories and accuracy. Even if they hide behind a wall, the attack will go around the wall to hit your mark.
objects.title: Aimbotter

objects.text:
You can make any projectile you fire completely unaffected by drag, wind and gravity when in motion, travelling in a perfect straight line until it hits something. You could shoot a bullet upward and it would go into space, while a thrown pebble might travel for miles.

This has the side effect of increasing how much your projectiles can ricochet due to retaining momentum between impacts, though energy is still lost with each bounce. Your projectiles will also not create shockwaves due to no air resistance.
objects.title: Straight Shooter

addons.text: Now your clothing and armor will automatically resize and fit your current form. This can even modify your outfit slightly based on your physique, like a bulky form thickening your armor. This will also benefit all other humanoid changer forms you have.
addons.title: One Size Fits All

addons.text: Now you gain a secondary effect to your stranger power which can be toggled to act two different ways. First, you can make it, so no matter how obviously your opposite form is related to you, nobody will make the connection, always treating your forms as separate persons. Or you can toggle it into its opposite effect, making it, so nobody will differentiate between your forms, treating you the same person, completely ignoring your changing appearance and sex. While you can switch between the two effects, beings having concrete knowledge of you and your power will gain resistance to this stranger effect.
addons.title: Who Am I? None of your Business.

addons.text:
Thanks to your dual existence, both of your opposite forms count as a separate Breaker form, each gaining a permanent 10sp worth of power(s) you can choose when you gain this add-on. This also removes the limitation of your original powers being disabled, as you’re constantly in one of your forms, but you must choose different powers for your opposite forms. Thanks to your forms' linked nature, any training or power growth gained from this power(s) on one of your forms will be mirrored in a beneficial way to your other form’s counterpart power(s).

Your budget for these powers increases by 5sp for every 30sp you spend on powers in total. For example, your forms would gain a separate 15/20/25sp worth of power(s) at a total spending of 30/60/90sp.
addons.title: Power Switch

addons.text:
You have been bisected; however, instead of dividing what you were, your existence has effectively been quadrupled.

The bodies you control now require only one quarter of the sustenance, rest, and energy that a normal body would need. Rather than maintaining your original qualities unchanged, they are instead quadrupled across all bodies. You can even perform feats that would normally require synchronization or cooperation between bodies; and if you deliberately coordinate them, their effects are doubled.

Your bodies can now swap positions with one another regardless of distance or even dimensional separation. The recovery time after losing one body is drastically reduced to six hours, thanks to the combined capabilities of Living Opposites and Two in One.

Any benefit, growth, or modification applied to one body has its effects and qualities duplicated, whether affecting a single body or all of them.

You now possess a pair of male bodies and a pair of female bodies, all of which you can control through Two in One. You may also combine them all into a single body or maintain only a pair while keeping a second body as an emergency backup.
addons.title: Bisection

addons.text: Your scale of storage has doubled, as the pockets of your two bodies have become linked together; while doubling the amount of things you can carry at once is great, you can also swap the contents of the folds / pockets between the two bodies. For Wristpocket, the process is straightforward, and for Skinbelt, you just need to mime the gesture to retrieve the item.
addons.title: Shared Pockets

objects.text:
Now your own and opposite sex form separated while sharing your mind and powers and growth. You still have one body, but whenever you change into your opposite form, your previous state is stored in a hibernating state in which it can rest and recover physically. This allows you to swap your form when you become fatigued to let it recover naturally or even recover from injuries, albeit this by default doesn’t grant enhanced healing beyond what natural rest would grant. Changing your forms will take at least a few seconds depending on how drastically different the forms are.

Any power growth, practice and training are shared between both forms at once with your muscle memory naturally adapting to be able to use any skills and powers you have in both forms. For powers which affect your own biology, you can choose to apply them only to your current form or both at once.

If one of your forms perishes, you automatically switch to the opposite, which becomes your new default form, which will be mirrored into a new opposite form available to use after 24 hours. This effect also fully heals your resting form if it remains unused for the same 24 hours.
objects.title: Living Opposites

objects.text:
Rather than having the ability to shift between both sexes, you can alter your body type and sex characteristics independently from each other. The way this manifests is akin to having mental dials that you can tune to change your primary and secondary sexual characteristics and general body shape between masculine, feminine, and androgynous.

This maintains your appearance to be as if you were born this way naturally and is thus visibly recognizable as yourself or a close relative.

Regardless of what form you take, your muscle memory is adjusted to accommodate altered musculature to ensure you retain full mobility, and your mind remains unaffected by any gender dysphoria that otherwise might arise from changing biological sex.
objects.title: Bio-Dial

objects.text:
With a single touch, you gain full access to the factual data regarding any Parahuman’s powers. You instantly understand how their power functions, its nature, current strength, potential maximum and minimum limits, as well as any hidden or non-obvious traits, including side effects, unstable behaviors, or activation conditions.

All acquired information is automatically compiled into a PRT Power Testing Report style, or in any other analytical format accepted in your world—be it scientific analysis, military-grade specifications, or even visual interfaces. You are free to choose how the data is presented: as text, charts, visualizations, holograms, or any other method that suits you.

This effect requires no concentration and activates even on accidental contact, though you can choose to disable it if you prefer not to collect unnecessary data.
objects.title: Power Overview

objects.text:
You have now acquired a bootleg version of the gamer system. Your status window which displayed your qualities such as Health points, stamina, traits and so on has upgraded itself into having those traits act as if they were part of a gamer system. 

When you get hit, instead of being injured, your total HP displayed on your status window will be reduced, and you will feel no pain, and no amount of damage (unless it kills you) will debilitate you. Attack that would have severed your arms? It seems it just cut off over a quarter of your HP. And your limbs are still fine. This comes with the side benefit of any natural healing- if given enough time being able to completely heal you back unless your HP was reduced to zero, in which case you are dead. Of course this natural healing isn't like actual games, it may take months or years to heal what would be fatal injuries without medical assistance.

Additionally, you will be able to see your stats such as Strength, Dexterity, Intelligence and so on, and you will be able to level up and upgrade them, but you are soft capped at what is possible for a peak-human, after that point progress will be incredibly slow and inefficient unless you possess other limit breaking powers.

You can't gain new skills or new traits from Gamer-lite alone. But you may be able to fuse them to create something stronger.
objects.title: Gamer-Lite

objects.text:
Now instead of just snapshots, you can choose to replay the performed feat a maximum of three times from different angles and distances, like a video clip. There are no limits to how you can view and edit the footage, except for its length, as it will only last for as long as necessary to provide all the information you need. The whole footage and all details within are instantly beamed and photographically memorized into your brain. 

This power synergizes with other powers compatible with it. Such as a Gamer power to see the stats of all involved in the footage, a Telepathy power to send this information to your allies, a Precognition power that lets you see further than what the footage would allow, etc.
objects.title: Instant Replay

objects.text:
Any object you hold is immediately and forcefully elevated to its full potential, regardless of its current state. A dull blade becomes impossibly sharp, a cracked firearm fires with perfect precision, and even a worn-out tool functions as though it were brand new, operating at the absolute pinnacle of its intended design. 

This enhancement is not a repair or restoration, but a brute-force imposition of perfection upon the item—your power overrides flaws, decay, and limitations to extract ideal performance from whatever is in your hands. However, the act of pushing an object beyond its actual integrity inflicts accelerated damage upon it. 

Although your power continues to enforce peak functionality despite the accumulating wear, this becomes increasingly unsustainable. The more damaged an item becomes, the more rapidly it deteriorates under your grip, until eventually it crosses a critical threshold and breaks completely. At that point, your ability ceases to apply—after all, a sword with no blade cannot cut, and a shattered gun has nothing left to shoot.
objects.title: Full Potential

objects.text: A blessing, a curse. It's not just age anymore, you become truly immortal for as long as you goal is not accomplished; except your body does not gain regeneration in any way, it just means that even if your heart was destroyed you would be able to keep going until your goal is completed, but well, you aren't exactly dead if you are comatose. The truth is, you will always be able to still influence the world in some level even if doesn't feel like it, because you aren't a nobody anymore, but a wandering ghost trying to solve its last attachment to the mortal plane. For example, as a coma patient you might end up affecting the subconscious of those around you, making them seek to accomplish bits and pieces of what you planned; another example is that upon dying inside a costume, you and it fused into one in order to keep going; if your body was erased and completely destroyed, you would lived on as part of your now empty home and final resting place. You will accomplish what you set out to do all theses decades ago, even if it costs you everything.
objects.title: I Always Come Back

objects.text: Every selection allows you to be able to use one more goal to extend your life. You need to actually bind yourself to a goal for it to work.
objects.title: Extra Goals

addons.title: Thoughtform Emulation
addons.text:
The synergy of Social Thinker and Budget Mind Reader allows you to not only model somebody's thoughts, but also how they interact with the wider world, including other people. Using Compartmentalization, you can process these models into Thoughtforms, emulated copies of people, somewhat similar to the minds contained in the Butcher's mantle.

Thoughtforms can either be based on pure versions of the person, or can be altered to suit your needs, like removing certain memories or making them loyal to you. This can be used to test how someone may react to different information or situations. By simulating the same thing multiple times, you can predict ways the real interaction may play out.

addons.title: Imaginary Life
addons.text:
By combining your mind-clones with your tulpas, you can create mental constructs that are more life like than either. These can either be mind-clones with imaginary bodies, or tulpas that you have imbued basic thought into. In either case, this allows the mental construct to grow and diverge from its origin.

If you have Thoughtform Emulation, it is also possible to grant imaginary bodies to the Thoughtforms you create.

objects.text:
You can quarantine mental processes in your brain and layer your thoughts. This allows limited multi-tasking. You can turn these thought layers into mind-clones of yourself with whom you can talk and strategize with, you can decide what sort of mind-clones they are, like whether they’re a carpenter, psychologist, knight, mage or maybe even a child-version of you. They’ll act like the role they’re assigned to, though they can only use your own knowledge to act out their roles. 

This can include feelings and emotions, allowing you to give your subconscious a voice. If you’re schizophrenic or otherwise have more than the normal amount of voices in your head, you can likewise quarantine or separate them, whether by shoving them into the back of your mind where you no longer have to hear them, breaking them into pieces so that they can no longer string together a proper thought, or rebuilding them into something useful by removing parts of them that you deem unnecessary.
objects.title: Compartmentalization

addons.text: Each cell is now wrapped in a shell, providing localized defense and microscopic motility enhancements. The more solar energy your body holds, the stronger this cellular shielding becomes—resisting heat, cold, impact, and elemental degradation.
addons.title: Solar Kinesis

addons.text: Solar energy is your optimal fuel, but it's no longer your only one. Your biology now accepts ionizing radiation as a viable substitute for sunlight. From cosmic rays to fallout zones, you can feed off of ambient radiation with efficiency. You still suffer from the same side-effects as the base power unless you have Fusion Capacitors or Plasmalemma Mass Ejection.
addons.title: Fission Eater

addons.text: Your cells can now expel built-up solar energy as directed thermal effects. You can channel this release as a searing heatwave through your skin or project it as concentrated cold breath, flash-freezing surfaces or enemies.
addons.title: Nuclear Divergence

addons.text: Your sensory cortex now interprets radiant emissions on a cosmic level. Beyond ultraviolet and infrared, you can visually perceive gravity distortions, magnetic flux lines, ambient radiation, and kinetic vectors. This includes the ability to track fast-moving objects—like bullets—by observing atmospheric pressure shears, air displacement, and refractive warping in real time.
addons.title: Photonic Perception

addons.text: Your cells have been structurally reengineered into resilient micro-reservoirs capable of storing solar energy in highly condensed form. Exposure to intense solar input—such as concentrated mirrors or orbital reflectors—merely amplifies your storage potential. Where others would burn, you metabolize and convert the overload into heightened combat effectiveness.
addons.title: Fusion Capacitors

addons.text: By diverting stored solar energy into focused repair cycles, your healing accelerates to remarkable levels. Bruises fade in seconds; lacerations stitch closed by the time the moon rises. You can configure your biology to prioritize regeneration at the cost of long-term charge retention.
addons.title: Plasmalemma Mass Ejection
Laser Eyes
addons.text:
Your eyes have been modified to convert and discharge the solar energy stored by SolarHouse of the Cell as concentrated laser light. The modification is compatible with either your protected eyes or your altered eyes, integrating the laser system directly into the existing ocular structure.

You can discharge the energy in two primary modes. The first is a pulse laser, rapidly releasing a large amount of stored energy in extremely short bursts. This produces a powerful, instantaneous beam suited for piercing, cutting, or striking targets before they can react.

The second is a continuous beam, releasing energy at a much lower rate but maintaining the laser for as long as your reserves and heat management allow. This produces a sustained heating effect, allowing you to burn, melt, or gradually cut through materials rather than delivering a single powerful impact.

The beam's power depends on the amount of solar energy available to you and how much of your reserves you are willing to expend. Continuous use and high-power pulses rapidly consume your stored energy, while SolarHouse's normal absorption and storage functions allow you to replenish it.

Your eyes are also adapted to tolerate the energy they produce, preventing your own laser from damaging them. The modification does not otherwise increase your eyesight or grant additional sensory abilities.

addons.title: Sunset Overdriver
addons.text:
Due to your enhanced lung capabilities, you can push your solar abilities beyond their normal limits, allowing your body to temporarily exceed its usual energy capacity. Through a specific breathing method, you can rapidly absorb additional solar energy and concentrate your reserves rather than allowing them to remain evenly distributed throughout your body.

This energy can be concentrated anywhere in your body, dramatically enhancing your physical performance, accelerating recovery, and reinforcing your body against injury. You can develop techniques for powerful bursts, reinforcing attacks and maintaining enhanced physical performance for extended periods.

addons.title: Sun Through the Tea
addons.text:
Your control over solar energy becomes precise enough to selectively transmit it through matter without affecting the material carrying it. You can strike through a target without harming it, then release the energy into something behind it, allowing you to break the rock beneath a person without injuring them, or destroy an object hidden behind another.

With sufficient control, you can choose where the energy begins and ends, concentrating it into specific points or allowing it to travel through conductive materials before releasing it. This makes your attacks capable of bypassing layers of material, damaging something inside a container without breaking the container, or transmitting energy through a person to affect something beyond them.

addons.title: Radiative Transfer
addons.text:
Your extraordinary precision allows you to use energy with perfect efficiency. Whenever you expend energy for a task, you can control exactly how much is used and ensure that none of it is wasted, lost, or diverted into unintended effects. You can use precisely the amount of energy required for a task, or deliberately expend more when you want to overwhelm it.

Energy is not wasted through unnecessary heat, radiation, friction, leakage, inefficiency, or other losses under your control. If you have enough energy available, you can direct 100% of it toward its intended purpose, with no deviation between the energy you expend and the effect you intend to produce.

This applies to energy you generate, store, transfer, or otherwise control, allowing even extremely small amounts of energy to be used exactly as intended.

objects.text: Your individual cells now function as integrated hybrid battery/capacitors—simultaneously absorbing, storing, and channeling solar radiation. As your internal charge increases, so too does your physical and mental performance—reflexes sharpen, regeneration accelerates, and endurance surges. However, this comes at a cost: higher levels increase baseline consumption, meaning you'll burn through reserves faster unless you're continually recharging.
objects.title: SolarHouse of the Cell

addons.text:
Your replica has gone beyond merely being a tool predicting the weather and observing the environment; it is now a perfect, one-to-one replica of the planet it is displaying, from the largest animals to the tiniest amoebas and even humans; nothing can escape your sight.

Like the previous version, you have settings and options available to customize your viewing to your desire, like following a specific being or even peeking at their internals.
addons.title: Life Finder

objects.text:
You can conjure an illusory replica of the planet you are on and any planets you have been on before.

This replica shows you the general topography and weather of the planet you're on, updated in real time. It doesn't display any details of the environment, nor does it show the locations of creatures.

The globe has multiple adjustable settings that allow you to see things like underground caverns, the interior of structures, tectonic plates, and any natural phenomena, even things such as vibrations and earthquakes.

However, the true power of the replica lies in the fact that you can see the state of the planet ranging from its complete past up to a month in the future. Examples of its use include using it to predict wars by observing the collateral damage, finding deposits of natural resources, and, obviously, predicting the weather.

Have fun making primitive civilizations worship you.
objects.title: Eye in the sky

objects.text: Your mind will automatically utilize all the information at its disposal to generate as many possible solutions to any problem you're aware of. The moment a combat scenario begins, you will have several thousand escape routes in mind and hundreds of strategies for hundreds of possible powers your opponent may possess. When you sit down to develop technology, your mind will formulate millions of ways to assemble circuits, fuel cells, and motor components in a superweapon. This ability can only use information you’re aware of as fodder for these solution sets, and any solutions may be subject to your own ignorance or deception if these apply.
objects.title: Assessment (Power Creator Xenon)

objects.text: In any task, you become aware of flaws in what you have just done the moment a flaw or human error is committed, and your mind will simply never make that same mistake twice if you are capable of doing so. This, in essence, guarantees a totally flawless end product in any feat of design, and exponentially minimizes the possibility of natural error as you perform basic intellectual and physical tasks. It can be exploited to slowly but surely learn to perform tasks you are completely unfamiliar with through trial and error, such as high-level mathematics or otherwise.
objects.title: Independent Review (Power Creator Xenon)

objects.text:
You are capable of generating, mitigating, and manipulating all forms of mundane energy in small amounts. You would be able to produce enough electricity to charge a phone or enough heat to melt chunks of plastic. You could stop a bullet if you could react to it.

You can do more versatile things as well, such as generating radiation (both safe and ionizing) or making ice-cubes in a drink.

If you have Esoteric Knowledge or Shardless then you can do this with any supernatural energies you have access to as well, and if you have Budget Telekinetic then your limit will be increased even more to the being able to melt metals or jump a car.
objects.title: Minor Dynakinesis

objects.text:
The strength of your telekinesis scales directly with your own physical body's base strength, making it significantly more powerful, even without some form of enhanced strength. As your strength increases through training or powers, your telekinesis grows with it.

Your telekinesis can accelerate or move objects as fast as you can throw or push them, allowing you to throw darts across a room with little warning. But moving a fridge or a washing machine would still be a slow process, though your telekinesis would give you better leverage.
objects.title: Budget Telekinetic

objects.text:
You’ve used Thinker/Master (Emotional Magnet) to further develop your calculation matrix, generating a mental subsection dedicated to creating mental models of the human mind, both individually and for a comprehensive model of a unified human consciousness.

Now, the ability to visually perceive the brain’s neurological signals in other people emerges in real time, although conscious access or understanding is out of grasp; instead, it is used to produce and elaborate mental models of anyone who enters your line of sight, being utilized as a resource for developing your power’s model of the unified human consciousness.

Observing people going through their day-to-day, seeing their minds wandering and yearning, acting on reasons known to themselves or giving in to instinct or emotional whims, nails their mental models in accuracy, as with the grand model’s precision.

It can take varying amounts of time, which depends on the target’s age, mental depth or complexity, and influence from mind-altering substances the person is on. For neurotypicals, it may take 1 to 4 days of continuous observation to fully create an accurate model; those with deviating or peculiar mental structures can take from 16 hours to a week, taking previous factors into account.

Completing your grand unified human consciousness takes 13,400 fully developed neurotypical models; elaborating this model doesn’t count models with deviating thought patterns or mental structures.

As a result, when you complete an individual model taking your general model as a template, you elevate your ability to read their thoughts and emotions in real time, as long as they are in your visual focus anyway. This doesn't overwhelm you, and you can toggle this on and off.

When the grand unified human consciousness model is complete, you no longer need to develop individual models for neurotypical humans to read their minds, as your unified model is solid enough to function as a reference material for most, if not all, neurotypical humans; those whose thought processes deviate from the general norm require individual models.
objects.title: Budget Mind Reader

addons.text: Your “psionics” have learned the fear tactics that Stranger (King Engine) and Master (Intimidating Crepitation) thrive on; you have thus learned how to exert a “psychic” pressure on living beings within your 50-meter radius. This pressure induces fear, akin to an apex predator eyeing its lunch, and the feeling that the world is crushing them, greatly restricting their ability to move their bodies. This essentially functions by reducing the compatibility between their minds and bodies. You can selectively exclude or include certain individuals or groups from being affected by this pressure. If you have Psychic Influence, you can strengthen this pressure with eye contact, to the extent they can fall unconscious or even go comatose
addons.title: Psychic Pressure

addons.text:
Your understanding of hypnosis has allowed you to develop another expression of your “psychic” abilities: the ability to psionically influence the thoughts and emotions of others. 

By tapping into other people's minds, you can directly influence their thoughts and emotions, and, with time and practice, you can learn to alter their memories. 

Your alterations are not, however, instantaneous, and can take minutes to hours to take effect, depending on how subtle or long-lasting you want your influence to be. Emotions are much easier to control than thoughts, which are then easier to manipulate than memories. 

Given time, this allows you to rewrite someone's personality, emotional spectrum, thought patterns, emotional connections, and entire worldview. 

While permanently shifting an emotional connection from one person to another, swapping how they feel about an individual to instead focus on someone else, might take only 30 minutes, temporarily rewiring someone's entire personality and worldview could take upwards of six to twelve hours.

You can choose whether your influence is permanent or fades over time; generally, permanent changes take two to three times as long to take effect. Temporary changes last roughly three days but can be refreshed instantly as long as they remain within your 50-meter radius.

You can also use this for Thought to Thought communication, as this isn't a “change” to their minds, it doesn't take additional time, and can be done in real time.

As your psionic might grows stronger, your changes take less and less time to take effect, eventually becoming instantaneous.
addons.title: Psychic Influence

addons.text:
Your mental Bluetooth connection has merged with your budding psionics, merging its own range into the range of your psionics. This expands your range to up to 70 meters. Within this range, you can connect to any electronic device; you also no longer need line of sight to establish this connection. 

Through this, you have further developed your naturally adept programming skills. You can directly interface with the systems you connect to and hack into them with much greater ease than before.

This technopathy can leverage your brain’s calculation center, which speeds up your thoughts that are dedicated to technological interactions to horrific speeds, as your brain computes over 25 million processes a second.

This leaves no mortal human capable of competing with your sheer hacking capability; only the likes of digital software could, and unless you're competing with virtual or artificial intelligence, such software would be too rigid to fight against your intrusion.

Rejoice, for you have become the High Priest of the God(ess) in the Net.
addons.title: Budget Technopath

addons.text: By melding Dimensional Awareness and A Word into your budding psionics, your ability to detect parahumans and obtain information about their abilities has evolved significantly. By riding on the coattails of your psionics, you can detect any parahuman within your psionic range. And by reading the psionic imprint of this connection, you can obtain more information about the parahuman's abilities. This includes information such as the name of their shard, their range, what ability they have, along with sub-abilities such as flame teleportation for Burnscar or secondary abilities for cluster capes, etc. This, however, does not provide detailed information, such as how hot a pyrokinetic's flames might burn or exactly how strong a brute might be; only generalised knowledge of the power itself is configured. If you have Psychic Influence, you can induce hypnotic states akin to a second trigger to modify or tweak how a power expresses itself. This always carries some power loss, so reducing someone's range by 10% could increase their control by 8.5% or vice versa.
addons.title: [Query][Configuration]

objects.text:
Your budget mind-reading, telekinesis, and personal forcefield are brought together, turning you into a facsimile of a “psychic”. While this doesn't provide a significant initial boost to your abilities, it does allow you to train them like a muscle and unify their growth vectors.
