Your brain has developed further mutations to support your facsimile “psychic” might, as your own body produces your “psychic” abilities. Using them consumes calories at a rapid rate and can fluctuate in strength depending on your health. 

As your telekinesis, forcefield, and mind-reading are sourced from the same subsection of your brain, their strength and thus growth are unified. This “organ” can be trained as if it were a muscle, which then strengthens each of your “psychic” abilities, increasing your telekinetic might and your forcefield’s durability.

You no longer need Mind Models to read the minds of others; instead, you can sense human minds in a 50-meter radius, and “tap” into these minds, allowing you to sense their emotions, access their senses, and read their thoughts. With time and practice, you can even learn how to parse through their memories.

Your growth does have its limits: you can only grow to the point where your telekinesis and forcefield are 24 times stronger, or more durable, than your body. Though reaching the limits of your “psychic” potential can take years if not decades of dedicated training.

The strength and durability of your body still add to your telekinesis and forcefield’s strength; you are just no longer dependent on them.
objects.title: Budget Psychic

objects.text:
Your body is physically perfect, combining immense strength, endurance, and agility without any weaknesses. You do not age or deteriorate over time, remaining in peak condition indefinitely.

You possess strength at the absolute peak of human potential, capable of lifting up to 4,000 kg (8,800 lbs) under optimal conditions. Your endurance is limitless; you never tire, allowing you to exert yourself at full capacity indefinitely without the need for rest or recovery. Your durability is exceptional—your muscles and skin are as soft as silk to the touch yet resistant to extreme forces, withstanding low to medium-caliber bullets and immense pressure without harm.

Your speed and agility are unmatched. You move with the coordination of a master acrobat, reacting in milliseconds to any stimulus. Your body operates with absolute precision, ensuring that every motion is efficient and perfectly executed. No movement is wasted, no balance is lost, and no action is beyond your control.

Your lifespan extends far beyond that of ordinary beings. You are biologically immortal, able to live for thousands of years and more without experiencing physical decline. Time holds no power over you; you will never weaken, never wither, and never degrade. Your body does not scar, wrinkle, or suffer from wear, remaining as pristine and flawless as the day you were born.

Your appearance reflects this perfection. Every feature is symmetrical, every muscle ideally sculpted, and no imperfection mars your form. Whether in motion or at rest, you embody both power and grace, an existence without physical flaw or limitation.
objects.title: Golden Body

objects.text:
Your mind and brain are perfected to the limits of human biology, combining immense processing power, willpower, and creativity, effectively merging both intelligence and wisdom into a single mind, yours. Your mind does not decay or degrade over time, nor will you develop any form of mental illness, allowing you to live for thousands of years without risks of Alzheimer's, dementia, or other mental illnesses.

Your mental facilities reach the absolute peak of human potential, your thoughts flow like light, pushing what would be seconds into tens of years, you can hold two dozen separate thought processes, your mind does not tire, regardless of how much or how hard you work it.

You possess a truly perfect memory recall, allowing you to recall every piece of knowledge or experience you have ever perceived. Your ability to access these stored memories is flawless, leaving cross-referencing any new knowledge with previously learned information a breeze. This effectively increases your learning speed by a dozen times over, as not only do you not forget anything, but you can also put what you learn into practice with ease.

This mental excellence also extends towards science and technology, as your mind is akin to a complete and dedicated R&D team all on its own, from inventing new technology tens or even hundreds of years ahead of the current technological levels, to discovering cures for cancer and vaccines for most, if not all, diseases you come across. You are capable of rivaling tinkers, just without the blackboxing or acting in the bounds of ‘’specialities’’.

You do, however, require vastly more resources, time, and effort to achieve similar results, as you can not cheat the way their shard does.
objects.title: Golden Mind

objects.text: First, the foundation of this power: your mind is adjusted so that it can perfectly process and comprehend the information provided by your senses. This also makes it so that things like flashbangs no longer work on you. This also applies to all additional power-related senses you gain. A minor side-effect of this is that it is harder to trick you with illusions, because they have to trick more senses. Second, this power improves the depth perception of all your power-granted senses. This makes it easier to understand what you are perceiving. Third, you can use these senses to perceive what they do not reveal indirectly. The Photonic Perception addon's perception of magnetic flux begins to give you awareness of electric current, and your enhanced awareness of vibrations, smell, and taste add to give you material properties. Your awareness of gravity combines with Dimensional Awareness enhances your perception of space-time, so that you begin being able to navigate by it alone, know how the passage of time and distance change, and also know the time of day and date by your position’s relation to the sun and moon. You begin to see what is behind you, derived from what your other senses share. This is only a small example of what is revealed, and this strengthens from every additional power granted sense. Finally, you can use the above fact to refine the senses you do possess, allowing each one to perceive both a larger quantity of information and higher quality information. However, your senses are only refined if the information inferred is accurate.
objects.title: Golden Senses

objects.text:
Through the fusion of your Golden Mind and your Golden Body, your genetics have advanced another evolutionary step forward. From a genetic standpoint, you are as closely related to modern humans as they are to chimpanzees or Bonobos.

Thus, your body and mind vastly exceed those of mankind. Under optimal conditions, you can lift up to 12,000 kg (26455.47 lbs), and you can withstand modern firearms without damage, even a 50. caliber bullet to the eyeball would only feel like a light poke. Stronger grenades, missiles, and artillery cannons would be needed to severely damage or kill you.

Your body has become much more resilient to environmental or abnormal conditions; as such, you can tolerate up to 900 Gy of radiation, you can safely withstand temperatures up to 5500°C or below -269°C, you can withstand the crushing pressures at the abyssal depths or the void of space without equipment, you can withstand up to 990 vertical G-Forces and six times that in horizontal G-Forces.

While you technically still need to breathe, your body can recycle oxygen quite effectively, allowing you to survive for weeks if not months on a single breath.

Your immune system is more effective, rendering bacteria, viruses, parasites, prions, and fungi unable to enter your body, let alone affect you, even Tinkertech or power enhanced pathogens have a reduced effectiveness on you, allowing you to treat zombie plagues like a common cold, at most making you somewhat irritable and hungry.

Every aspect of your mind is elevated further, including creativity, abstract thinking, logical or deductive reasoning, imagination, and multitasking. With this, your mind can outperform thinkers in their own games, and your deductive reasoning allows you to deduce better than Tattletale, while being much less prone to faulty deductions. 

Your R&D capabilities also benefit from your increased intelligence; you can now rival higher-end tinkers, such as Armsmaster or Hero, and with a sufficient knowledge base, time, and resources, you can reverse engineer how Tinkertech functions and how to recreate similar technologies. For Tinkertech, that is purely powers expressed in the form of technology; you cannot reverse engineer them, as there is no real technology to reverse engineer.

Given infinite resources and a few decades of dedicated study, your techbase could reach the levels of clarketech. With fewer resources and less dedicated time for research, this can take much, much longer. Compared to you, even the most brilliant minds modern humans can produce are akin to toddlers.

As this is a genuine genetic uplift, it is hereditary, and your descendants will at least partially inherit these abilities.
objects.title: Platinum Genes

addons.text:
Your psychic “organ” evolves to take advantage of the immense energy reserves stored within your Malachite Cells. Rather than relying solely on metabolic output, your psionic abilities can now be fueled by absorbed energy, dramatically increasing endurance, output, and peak performance. 

All forms of psychic influence become vastly easier to sustain over long periods, while short bursts of extreme power can be achieved by rapidly converting stored energy. This also smooths energy expenditure, preventing the usual strain or inefficiency associated with high-output psychic usage.

More significantly, your telekinesis evolves beyond manipulating matter alone, gaining the ability to directly grasp and shape electromagnetic energy itself, allowing for rudimentary control of the electromagnetic spectrum at range.
addons.title: Electrum Neurons

addons.text: Your nascent psychic organ blossoms into a modular framework, capable of developing specialized substructures to support discrete applications of psionic power, even beyond what you were initially capable of. Furthermore, thanks to Mithril Newman’s extreme mutative malleability, these substructures can rapidly adapt and refine themselves, rapidly achieving growth that would normally take decades. A mutation derived from mind reading may result in clairvoyance or maybe psychometry, while telekinesis could evolve a subsection dedicated to personal flight or collaborating with your personal forcefield to project it at a distance. And once those mutations have settled, they can be iterated upon in turn.
addons.title: Iridium Cerebrum

objects.text: Your transcendent physiology and mind sourced from Platinum Genes has empowered the “organ” in your brain responsible for your nascent psychic powers, making your body not only able to properly support but also empower them. As baseline, your range and precision for your psychic powers has increased a hundredfold, your telekinetic strength and shield durability are strong enough to render all but the greatest modern weapons irrelevant, and you can completely rewrite someone’s world view in a matter of minutes. All this while also refining efficiency in order to sustain more frequent and long-term usage, and leaving room for growth.
objects.title: Orichalcum Synapses

objects.text: The supercharged growth from Platinum Genes has developed your energy feeding and electromagnetic abilities to greater heights. For starters, your cells can hold ridiculous quantities of energy while maintaining 99.9% efficiency for usage, allowing energy stores to last for vast quantities of time in between feeding. Furthermore, besides absorbing solar and ionizing radiation, you can also absorb electric charge with the same efficiency as solar radiation, providing yet another source of fuel. Platinum Genes has additionally amplified your ability to generate and direct electrical energy and magnetic fields to be more powerful and versatile. This allows for the manifestation of a variety of effects, such as releasing localized electromagnetic pulses, channeling thousands of volts through your body as a defensive measure, empowering your physical capabilities to ridiculous levels, or firing off crackling bolts of lightning.
objects.title: Malachite Cells

addons.text:
Your ability to manipulate electromagnetism introduces new evolutionary pressures, driving the development of mutations specifically tuned to interacting with the electromagnetic spectrum.

This opens a wide range of potential applications, from the evolution of sensory organs capable of perceiving infrared heat signatures, ultraviolet structural and chemical markers, and even radio or microwave emissions, to the emergence of specialized tissues that can emit or modulate targeted electromagnetic frequencies to mask your thermal signature, disrupt sensors, or facilitate advanced forms of camouflage.
addons.title: Magnetite Tissues

objects.text: Your genetics have further evolved, to the point that with your malleability it's a stretch to call you related to humans at all. You may look human, but you most definitely are not. Your limitation on what mutations can develop has been loosened; as long as you experience the appropriate stimuli then you can evolve an appropriate mutation, up to the level of speculative biology and even a bit beyond. Furthermore, you can somewhat direct the progression of mutations, putting a “finger on the scale” so to speak and weighting certain evolutionary directions. Lastly, evolutionary adaptations develop at a much faster pace, speedrunning generations of evolution in seconds and capable of going even faster at the expense of solar energy. You no longer need to even fully transplant an organ or body part to adapt your DNA to it, just a sample of the foreign DNA, with a simple blood transfusion being enough. Additionally, every mutation you develop comes out just as perfect and supercharged as the rest of your biology. You could copy a garter snake’s venom gland and come out with something surpassing even an Inland Taipan in terms of potency. Lastly, the ability to reverse any changes to your biology has evolved into what is essentially version control for your body, your DNA storing all previously manifested mutations and allowing you to undo and redo them as you see fit.
objects.title: Mithril Newman

addons.text:
Your bio-shards have adapted to take advantage of your cells’ ability to store energy, enabling them to sustain and enhance biological functions that would otherwise be impossible. 

Muscles generate force magnitudes greater than normal, bones can reshape or harden mid-motion to resist extreme stress, and vascular or neural shards can temporarily overclock functionality. 

This also allows for the existence of more fantastic and speculative mutations powered and supported by your internal energy stores: tissues that resonate with electromagnetic fields, organs that restructure themselves on the fly, and limbs or sensory arrays that operate beyond conventional physical or biochemical limits.

Your body effectively becomes a lattice of self-sufficient, supercharged bio-systems, each capable of realizing speculative evolutionary forms, maintaining stability, and executing coordinated feats that blur the line between biology and engineered, energy-driven mechanisms.
addons.title: Jade Flesh

addons.text:
Each of your bio-shards develops its own psionic capacity, allowing even the smallest structural or muscular unit to contribute to psychic effects. Neurons and other specialized “thinking” shards remain the most potent, but every muscle fiber, bone fragment, and organ shard can exhibit psionic effects, augmenting its own function in ways biology alone could never achieve. 

Muscle fibres can augment themselves with telekinesis, tendons can dynamically reroute stress to prevent injury, and eyes can draw upon extrasensory information—all by integrating psychic augmentation at the shard level. This distributed psionic capability also allows shards to specialize: some focus on precise telekinetic manipulation, others on localized forcefield reinforcement, and still others on sensory extension or environmental awareness. 

Each shard operates semi-autonomously, drawing on your psionic organ while remaining harmonized with the whole, effectively turning your body into a lattice of self-empowered, psychic-enhanced biological systems. The result is a physiology that can execute feats physically impossible for conventional biology, with each movement, contraction, or function amplified by intelligently directed psychic energy.
addons.title: Diamond Cortex

objects.text: Your genes have evolved and adapted to the sheer cognitive and calculative prowess of Crystal Palace, by devoting a parallel thought to each biological system in your body, along with each individual component of said systems, your body, alongside your mind, emulates how shards and entities are structured. Each system and component of your body has become a bio-systematic shard of your greater whole. For example, not only is your skeletal system itself a bio-shard, but each individual bone is also a smaller fragment of the greater skeletal bio-systematic shard. Your various bodily fluids are not bio-shards, however, as unlike true shards or entities, they are not Solid enough to support the biological architecture of your biosystematic shards, and are instead managed by other related or supporting bio-shards such as your bone marrow, blood vessel, or heart bio-shards. As each individual bio-shard has access to a truly humongous amount of calculative power, you have a much greater control over how your bio-shards mutate, not just having a “finger on the scale” but your mutations are deliberately and intelligently designed. This also allows you to mutate at will, directly choosing the kind of mutation you want and how it integrates with the rest of your existence. This deliberate mutation is not without downsides, and unlike your adaptive or random mutations, designing your mutations requires knowledge and understanding of exactly how a mutation could do what you want it to do. That is to say, a mutation cannot do anything you do not understand how to achieve through biological alterations or mutations. Without knowing how to design wings that could carry a human in flight, you cannot mutate yourself a pair of wings. The more knowledge you have on the subject, the stronger the mutation gets, and it is easier to design said bio-shards.
objects.title: Crystalline Humanoid

addons.text:
As you have grown in stature, your ability to store energy has grown exponentially, to the point that if you were a battery before, you would now be a full-scale power plant, able to store vast amounts of solar and radiation energy; at the most basic level, this helps address your increased stamina consumption in your True Size, but there is far more to that.

Your ability to manipulate temperatures and project them has grown by leaps and bounds, as your touch can now instantly freeze those you touch or reduce them to ashes in an instant, flash-freezing entire city blocks or igniting them into an inferno, and even coating your body in ice or flames without harm to yourself, as you become highly resistant to extreme temperatures, to the point you could comfortably swim in lava and move around unimpeded near absolute zero.

You can expend your reserve of stored energy to vastly increase your physical and mental abilities; the more energy you burn, the greater the boost, but the faster you will deplete your internal reserves—a high-risk, high-reward tactic, as while boosted you could realistically sink New York City's Manhattan Island with a single punch, or at least cause significant damage to it with preparations.
addons.title: Knock-Off Giant of Fire & Ice

addons.text:
Your telekinetic and forcefield powers have melded together and have greatly benefitted from your now-giant stature, with much of their power going into your wings.

Your strength and durability are both factored in for your forcefield and telekinesis, making them greater than the sum of their parts, but the greatest change comes with your wings. Weight is far less of a concern now as Shield Up and Budget Telekinetic allow you to fly much more easily for far longer and further, enough to escape Earth's atmosphere.

To help you achieve this, your brain has been empowered through the energy that now courses through your wings, giving you greater processing power to better react to changes in the environment and dodge obstacles; that same power also hardens and increases the durability of your wings, allowing them to be used as shields, or even weapons, depending on their shape.
addons.title: Knock-Off Nephilim

addons.text:
You gain yet another pair of arms that can emerge from your back, bringing the total up to four, with six arms, you come to resemble some depictions of the Asura, and like them, you are a master of combat, able to use your additional arms and size to great effect.

The density of your skin and muscles has increased further, making them effectively bio-armour even against enemies comparable to you in size and strength, with those denser muscles, your strength has tripled from what it was before, giving you more striking power and movement to make you a living weapon of mythical proportions.
addons.title: Knock-Off Asura

addons.text:
The effect of Functional Clothes has melded with Techno Medieval and Full Potential, allowing all items you pick up to scale to your height, be they armour, items, or weapons, with your True Size giving far greater mass for attack and durability to items, while Fun Size makes all aspects of them faster and more flexible.

Not only are all items you have enhanced to their more advanced counterparts, but they are, in turn, pushed to the absolute peak of what those future versions could be, pushing them far beyond what they would normally be capable of, with any drawback or inconvenience being smoothed over by Functional Clothes, which in turn has both Techno Medieval and Full Potential being applied to your clothes to increase their quality, durability, and comfort.

Note that this only applies to armour, weapons, and vehicles you are personally using, with the effects fading away until gone completely once away from your possession, whether it be physically touching them or via your powers.

Should you have the addon Objects of Low Power, then their effects are greatly empowered, reaching the level of 0.5 Tier Powers, with their peak being Tier 1; however, Tier 1-level Objects of Low Power would have very limited use, with their powers being used around 10 times before the item loses their enhancements, before it begins to break down completely.
addons.title: Legendary Knock-Offs

addons.text:
Your ability to generate light from your body has been empowered by having a larger body, and through it allowing you to take some inspiration from certain heroes of light from outer space.

To use this form requires storing both your male and female form into dual pocket dimensions, from where they can generate enough light to form a body of Light that can be up to 40 meters (131 feet) tall. By default, the form of this Light Body is an androgynous humanoid that is featureless; however, you can customize it to appear however you like, but its features will be a bit angular in the beginning.

While in this state, you experience an exponential growth in versatility and potency with your powers that is greater than the sum of its parts (your two selves), able to fire off blasts of light powerful enough to level city blocks, beams of light strong enough to level mountains completely with focused effort, and create constructs and barriers of light. You generate a passive light field that can carry your Intent rather than emotions; this can be turned on and off. Like your light blasts, your Light Body is unaffected by gravity, letting you fly, with air resistance being the main limiting factor; however, while in a vacuum (such as space), you can potentially reach Light Speed.

However, while powerful, this form can only be maintained for 3 minutes, after which the Light Body shall fade away, with one of your bodies appearing somewhere safe nearby. Both your bodies will be exhausted afterwards, needing time to recover. With training, the time limit can be increased and the fatigue curbed for the most part.

Should you have the addons 'Bisection' or 'Fivefold Squad,' you can use 2 of your additional bodies to create more Light Bodies or pool your additional selves to make one stronger.

Should you have the addon 'Power Switch,' your Light Body can have access to both sets of powers and use them at once.
addons.title: Knock-Off Giant of Light

addons.text:
Through your ability to survive underwater and inspire fear, you could come across as one of the Dark Titans of Irish myth, one of the Fomorians.

Each movement you make through your large stature inspires fear into all who witness you, with even kings and warriors seeking every possible alternative to avoid fighting you. This fear only grows more profound to all whom your shadow touches, as it becomes possible for you to drive the common people into hysterics and even outright madness, as Stinky Pants and Master (Intimidating Crepitation) become an assault on all the senses, more akin to a curse so horrible it can lead to someone setting themselves on fire to get any form of relief.

You can even wrap yourself in your own shadows to obscure your features, instilling the fear of the unknown into others; this manipulation of shadow growing deeper as, so long as you are underwater, you can spread out the range of your control to haunt and torment those who enter your range, seemingly embodying the dark side of nature itself.
addons.title: Knock-Off Fomorian

objects.text:
You have become similar to what many imagine humanity's mythical ancestors were like, before punishments from God, such as the Flood, albeit only in appearance.

Your new true height is 15 feet (457.2 cm), or 2.7 times your previous height if you prefer; with this increase in stature, your strength and durability skyrocket, turning you into a physical force not to be taken lightly, as the thickness of your skin has increased to be comparable to a rhinoceros's hide, with even the softest areas reaching nearly 4 cm in thickness, and your muscles, in turn, have become comparable to heavy construction machinery, as your strength is almost 20 times greater than before, making you capable of easily pinning a fully grown African elephant, along with other large and dangerous creatures.

Your body's ability to heal itself has greatly improved in potency and efficiency, causing injuries to take only a fraction of the time they once did to heal flawlessly, and your lifespan has increased to the point where you could easily live for thousands of years, even with a poor diet in a hostile environment. Even when forced to live in such places, you possess incredible resistance to all kinds of environmental hazards, such as extreme weather, to the point that even elevated radiation levels—those comparable to ancient Earth—do not affect you in the slightest.

But these changes are not related solely to physical strength, as your mind has expanded from 86 billion neurons to more than 1.6 trillion neurons, granting it the necessary resources to make your intelligence one of the greatest in history; through raw brain power alone, you are capable of condensing centuries of development into decades, with your ability to learn and master skills skyrocketing.

To help facilitate and maintain these changes, your DNA has gained an additional helix, further increasing its complexity, providing extra redundancies and enhancing the improvements your evolutionary cycles can bring, as your increased size allows for greater experimentation and sophistication.

If you need to be the size of a normal person, you can use Changer/Mover (Chibi) to regain your original size while gaining a boost to your speed and mobility, effectively having three sizes: your True Size, your Normal Size, and your Fun Size, with the effects of Chibi scaling to each size.

Be warned: your increased size significantly raises your weight due to the Square–Cube Law, and while in your True Size you will consume your stamina approximately 20 times faster than if you were in your Normal Size, without additional powers or perks.​
objects.title: Pre-Flood Knock-Off

objects.text: Rubber Ducky takes Hindsight and Understanding to widen the scope and reach of the problems and issue you work out loud, with the caveat of empowering your mind's capacity to figure out things with enough clarity and insight the more people witness your rants and monologues. The more you go into your mad ramblings, the clearer they are in a logical and retrospective point, usually connecting the dots and self-correcting gaps in knowledge or bias in real time, and quickly figuring out a highly complex and wide-scale problem or topic you wish to untangle in your brain. Oddly enough, this shares your powers of introspection and understanding to anybody who pays attention to your rants, easily taking in and digesting whatever comes out of mouth.
objects.title: The Soliloquy

addons.text: You can impart emotions into your light, enabling you to create similar emotion blasts to Gallant; however, you are more versatile in how your emotional light can manifest, as you are not limited to only blasts but can create happy light beams or emit a subtle relaxation AOE glow. You can only impart a single emotion into your light at a time, but you can rapidly change what emotion you are infusing into your light. Those illuminated or struck by your emotional light will have their emotions changed to the corresponding emotion, so a happy beam will make them happy, and so on.
addons.title: Emotional Light

addons.text: You can infuse your light with the effects of Thermal Dysregulation, allowing you to alter the temperature of your light within Thermal Dysregulation's temperature range of -200°C to 1000°C. This can be used to emit beams of light hot enough to melt metals with lower melting points, such as silver or aluminium. Or fire of blasts of light that are cold enough to cause oxygen to condense into a liquid. You can even emit your light as an aura around yourself, where you can dynamically transfer heat from one location to another, effectively allowing you to mobilise Striker (Heat Exchange) at a distance.
addons.title: Thermal Emissions

addons.text: You can now express your pseudo-scientific vibrational manipulation and generation through your light; this does not directly expand on what Phasing can do, it only gives you more convenient ways to express them. As such, you can cause your light to vibrate at specific frequencies to manifest different effects. As this operates on a pseudo-scientific level, your light can attune to even extra-dimensional frequencies and other such esoteric frequencies. Through this, your light can phase through solid objects, preventing them from blocking it from reaching your intended target. You can cause your light to disrupt molecular structures, allowing you to near-instantly destabilize and collapse objects, structures, and people, as you are not Manton limited. Really, anything Phasing could do, your light can now also do. You can cause your light to cling to your skin as a quasi-personal force field, which you can then tune to weaken the effect of or entirely negate physical or energy-based attacks.
addons.title: Silencer

addons.text: You can infuse your light with your radiation-absorbent and sound-muffling properties, along with allowing you to make your light Blinding without causing retinas to burn out, even if the brightness otherwise would have. Well, your light doesn't absorb radiation; it equalizes it with the surrounding non-radioactive environment, effectively snuffing it out so that it cannot harm anyone. This can be used on living beings to cure them of radiation poisoning, though it will not heal any damage the radiation has already done to them. Your light can muffle sound and weaken shockwaves, leaving anything within its influence in a mostly soundless environment. You can toggle how your light muffles sound on an individual level, from silencing voices to muffling only background noises, leaving voices unchanged.
addons.title: Muffler

objects.text:
The luminous bands that bloom along lines beneath your skin expand to underline your entire bodily surface, allowing you to emit light from any part of your skin.

You gain the ability to impart kinetic energy into your light emissions through these luminous bands. You can only impart kinetic energy equivalent to the strength of one of your punches under ideal conditions.

You can “bundle” light up into baseball-sized orbs and either anchor them in place or fire them at roughly forty kilometers an hour. These last for five minutes or until they hit something. They are not affected by gravity but are affected by air resistance, which causes them to slow down over time.

This allows you to light up areas without personally glowing like a lightbulb, or to impart kinetic energy into them, allowing you to attack others outside your range.

You have no control over what happens to these orbs after anchoring or firing them, and you cannot move them telekinetically.
objects.title: Photon Emission

objects.text:
You can cause anyone who sees you to become instantly aware of your powers, as well as the scale at which they can operate, and any trigger conditions they may have. You cannot falsify any information this power provides, but you can choose to conceal certain parts. This doesn't force people to believe the information they are handed, but they won't be able to say you didn't warn them.

You can choose for this to spread through images, and when people attempt to describe this effect to others it will be carried with their words to a lesser extent.
objects.title: Threat Display

objects.text:
Your brain and body skips the whole "practice makes perfect" grind entirely. The moment you understand the theory behind something, say you've read a detailed breakdown of how a Brazilian jiu-jitsu sweep works or you've studied the exact angle and pressure needed to insert a chest tube, your nervous system just clicks and you can do the thing as if you've been drilling it for years, gaining the full practical skills. You pick up the scalpel and your hand is steady, your cut is clean, and the depth is exactly right even though you've never touched a patient before. You step onto the mat and hit the timing and footwork of that sweep perfectly on your first attempt. 

There are two limitations to this. First one is your actual meat and bones. You might have the perfect motor pattern for a roundhouse kick burned into your brain, but your hip flexor and hamstring have never been stretched under that load before and they are not going to thank you for it. You'll pull something or tear something because your nervous system is writing checks your physical conditioning can't cash.

Second limitation that you can only do exactly what the information you consumed taught you to do. Knowing how to do a surgery by the book doesn't mean you know what every variation of human anatomy looks like inside a living body. Knowing how to throw a punch doesn't mean you know what to do when the guy doesn't fall down like the diagram showed. This can be fixed by reading up on your blind spots.
objects.title: Practical Advice

addons.title: Symbiotic Bio-Medi-Chines
addons.text:
Your body now houses a colony of Biological Medical Macro-Machinery, or Bio-Medi-Chines: artificial cells designed to perform highly specialized biological functions that normal evolution would have little reason to develop.

The colony lives within you as a genuine symbiotic organism, with specialized hives growing around lymph nodes, between organs, alongside major blood vessels, and in other suitable locations. They reproduce, repair themselves, and distribute throughout your body without requiring your conscious control.

Bio-Medi-Chines are not intelligent. Each type is a specialized biological tool that simply responds to specific stimuli, much like an ordinary cell responding to chemical signals. One may detect and neutralize a particular toxin, another rebuild a specific type of tissue, while another may regulate an otherwise dangerous metabolic process.

They can be made from artificial biology rather than necessarily using conventional carbon-based cells, allowing functions that ordinary biology could not reasonably support. New types can also be developed as needed, allowing your internal colony to gradually acquire specialized tools for increasingly unusual biological problems.

Your Distributed Self can coordinate their activity with the rest of your body, but the Bio-Medi-Chines remain an independent symbiotic colony rather than simply becoming another part of your body's intelligence.

objects.text:
Your body no longer depends entirely on a single centralized consciousness. Instead, every part of your biology possesses limited autonomous intelligence, functioning as cooperating components of a greater whole.

Dense nerve-clusters distributed throughout your body act as subsidiary processing centers. Each oversees the systems connected to it, continuously interpreting information, optimizing function, and making localized decisions without requiring conscious input.

Your organs, muscles, glands, and internal systems are no longer passive structures directed solely by the brain. Each actively works toward the survival, maintenance, and improvement of the larger system that is you.

Under normal conditions, this results in extreme internal coordination. Breathing, circulation, posture, metabolism, recovery, and countless smaller processes adjust automatically with precision beyond ordinary biology.

These systems can also respond independently to stress, injury, or inefficiency. Muscles alter movement patterns to reduce strain, organs optimize themselves under scarcity, and damaged structures reorganize to maintain function. Adaptation is directed and purposeful rather than random.

The different subsystems continuously exchange information, allowing improvements in one area to propagate compatible adjustments throughout the rest of the body.

If your primary consciousness is impaired, unconscious, or overloaded, these subsidiary intelligences can temporarily maintain movement, self-preservation, and simple goal-directed behavior through distributed coordination.

Your mind remains the dominant identity, but it is no longer the only thinking part of you.
objects.title: Distributed Self

addons.text: Your ability to alter materials is enhanced considerably while tinkering/crafting, merging with the subtle striker/shaker effects that already allow you to "cheat" while fabricating devices. While crafting, and only while crafting, the rules of Material Tuning are loosened, and you gain incredible intuitive proficiency in its use, in the same way that tinker powers provide proficiency in the more mundane aspects of the process already. An example could be triggering multistage alterations to your materials, with staggered time delays, allowing your ingredients to have different properties during the construction stage than they do in the final product. Or you could eliminate the need to synthesize mild super-materials by directly enhancing the ingredients already on hand. The net effect is to reduce the time, material, and tool requirements of your designs beyond even Heterodyning, via blatantly supernatural intervention in the tinkering processes. A side effect is that it's slightly easier to understand and reverse engineer your own technology. Indeed, you have full awareness of the effects of your striker power, and so the "cheating" that otherwise might go unnoticed during your tinkering is now directly visible to you. It's still a long journey to understand WHY you need to increase the resistance of a component by exactly 2.31 µΩ, but by participating directly in this part of the process you have a leg up over tinkers whose shards make these alterations without their knowledge.
addons.title: Full-Participant Tinker

objects.text: Your ability to alter materials becomes far more fine tuned and deliberate, allowing you to manipulate the properties of whatever you touch. Effectively any property of the material from density, conductivity, specific heat, elasticity, and any other intensive variable is now subject to your power. This allows you to exceed what would usually be the physical limits for a material, though you can never go too far outside the range of physical possibility. At its most extreme, you can bend steel with your bare hands, efficiently conduct electricity through masonry brick, crumple concrete with a tap, dramatically reduce the internal stress from metal, or shatter an enemies armor by making it brittle. This fine control only extends about 6 inches from the point of contact, though you can still choose to apply your broad Optimal state for whatever task at will. This pairs particularly well with tinker powers, but can be used for a very wide range of applications.
objects.title: Material Tuning

objects.text: Your Tier 0 powers can now add, remove, and change three letters at a time. Breaker (Icy Hot) could be turned into Breaker (very hot) where while you lose the temperature drop aspect, it turns the 100°C to about 115°C. Blaster (Thwip!) can become Blaster (Thwomp!), letting you make a projection that will fall on anyone walking under it, creating a dull, loud sound without actually doing any direct physical damage.
objects.title: Three Letter

objects.text: Each of your hands now has an unlimited amount of pocket dimensions rather than one, although you may reduce this to a finite amount of your choice if you want — you can only access one of them at a time, needing to cycle through them to store or retrieve an item. The rules for what they can store remain the same.
objects.title: Pocket Wheel

objects.text:
Your already unnaturally dense skeleton becomes a truly permanent foundation. The immense rigidity and durability of your bones increase further, allowing them to withstand repeated extreme stress, impacts, and pressure without accumulating wear or developing weaknesses over time.

Should your bones somehow crack or fracture, they heal rapidly and perfectly, restoring themselves without deformity or loss of strength. Unlike ordinary bones, damage never leaves lasting flaws, and repeated breakage does not make them weaker.

Even separated from the rest of your body, your bones remain unusually persistent and slow to decay, maintaining themselves as long as enough of the original structure survives.
objects.title: Unbreakable Bones

objects.text:
Your genome has been custom-designed to produce the ideal human body, as though perfected through centuries of safe genetic engineering. Medical examination would conclude you were an extensively engineered designer baby or the recipient of revolutionary gene therapy rather than naturally born.

Every organ, tissue, and cell operates at peak efficiency. Healing remains biologically paced but is always flawless, free of scars, improper unions, or long-term complications. Your immune system rapidly suppresses disease, your metabolism extracts more energy and nutrients from less food, toxins are processed with exceptional speed, and your autonomic systems constantly maintain ideal internal balance. Minor illnesses heal quickly, fatigue accumulates slowly, sleep is more efficient, and your natural lifespan and vitality are noticeably improved.

Vestigial flaws and biological imperfections have been corrected, while countless subtle optimizations improve strength, endurance, fertility, recovery, and resistance to disease without pushing you beyond human limits. Individually, each improvement is modest; together, they represent the difference between natural evolution and deliberate design. You are not superhuman—you are John Human 2.5.
objects.title: Efficient Template
Healing Trance
objects.text:
When meditating, your body's natural recovery processes go into overdrive, speeding up your healing by an order of magnitude. Natural healing is pretty slow, so a mere order of magnitude means that major injuries will still take a while to recover from, even if you meditate all day. But for minor cuts and bruises (and the general physical toll that comes from an active Cape lifestyle), it's a godsend.

As an additional bonus, this all-but-eliminates the recovery period you need after strenuous exercise, so long as you can fit a short meditation session in afterwards. And since "your body's natural recovery processes" includes the mechanisms that build muscle, you could easily fit a half-dozen major exercise sessions in a single day without any loss of effectiveness, speeding up physical conditioning by a correlate amount. Of course, you get the most out of this if you actually spend all day putting in the work.

objects.title: Baron(ess) of Time
objects.text:
Due to your two hearts and connection to time, you are somewhat similar to the species of a certain madman in a blue box.

Thanks to a combination of your powerful mind, senses, and interactions with further dimensions, you are able to simultaneously perceive the past, present, and future of anything within the range of your senses without issue. At first, you would be limited to a minute at most, but as you get used to it, you will be able to perceive further back and forward in time; you can influence how the future will happen by examining the most likely events to occur and how they would come about, however, your limit would be a week into the past and future without additional power / perks.

Your new connection to time allows you to draw upon your own future for answers, by locking one or more thought processes to focus on a solution to a problem—through a process called Quantum Locking, which isolates said processes from all else, leaving them completely isolated—you can gain an answer instantly as the solution is sent from the future back to you from the moment you activated the Quantum Lock. However, this does mean those additional trails of thought will be unavailable until they arrive at the answer, and they will only have the knowledge you had the moment the Quantum Lock started.

A similar process can happen in times of greatest need, as you are able to reach into your past and future for additional energy to rapidly repair any injury sustained and even undo death, creating an explosion of power that brings you back to prime with minute changes at most due to the rushed healing (hair a different colour, eyes a different tint) and a bit confused. Your past self will not be aware of the missing energy, and at a minimum, half of all future energy absorbed is sent back in time until the 'debt' is paid; you cannot use this again until the debt is paid, and if interrupted, the process is negated, but outside of that, there is no limit to the number of times you can do this.

objects.title: Lie Detector
objects.text: You are able to tell when you are being lied to. This works through both verbal and physical languages, though notably it doesn't work on things such as letters or notes. It will, however, work through both video and audio transmissions.

objects.title: Bounce Back
objects.text: Your ability to heal flawlessly has extended to encompass your entirety. This allows you to recover from things such as Mastering, Grey Boy loops, and other power effects such as some of Bakuda's bombs or Panacea's manipulations. If you die, you'll still be dead, but certain effects such as petrification leave you whole enough for your recovery to kick in. You still don't heal any quicker.

objects.title: Blue Tape
objects.text:
Any administrative, bureaucratic, legal, financial, organizational, or otherwise procedural matter you could reasonably involve yourself in can be completed instantly at your discretion. 

Activating the power resolves the entire matter from beginning to end in a single moment, rather than merely completing your side of it. 

Whatever actions, decisions, cooperation, timing, or circumstances would be necessary are handled as though guided by a combination of a perfect set of actions and luck and coincidences aligned as favorably as they possibly can toward your intended result.

The power can therefore do more than bypass paperwork or waiting periods. It can force any favorable outcome that could genuinely occur, even if it would ordinarily be unlikely, difficult, or take months or years to reach. 

A lawsuit could immediately conclude in the best realistically possible manner, a home purchase could close with the property ready for immediate possession, or some bureaucratic nightmare could simply be finished, with every involved person, institution, and circumstance having lined up exactly as needed. 

The power cannot produce an outcome that was fundamentally impossible, but possibility is enough; if there exists a way for the matter to resolve as you intend, it can make that resolution happen immediately.

Once completed, everything necessary to support the result is properly established. 

If you purchase a home, you not only finish the purchase agreement, the transaction closes immediately, ownership transfers properly, payment is settled, records are updated, keys and access are available, the property is ready for you to take possession of, and any ordinary matters that would have needed to occur beforehand are already resolved. The same process applies to other matters. 

Records, documents, payments, communications, ownership, access, rulings, approvals, and other consequences exist exactly as they should, without contradictions or suspicious gaps. 

You also immediately understand what occurred, why the matter resolved as it did, and anything important you need to know about the resulting situation.

addons.title: Skip Ahead
addons.text: Rather than being limited to procedural and other administrative tasks, you can now skip past any task you can assign to Offscreen. Rather than the task continuing invisibly in the background for however long it would normally require, the tasks simply go from not done to done.

objects.title: You And What Arm-y?
objects.text:
You are capable of deploying arms from any available surface on your body, with the exception of your new arms themselves. Due to the changes mentioned below, you can fit far more arms over your surface area than would be suggested by your frame.

Your clothes and such are warped to suit this form, up to and including dissappearing completely if needed. Your body also changes depending on where you first sprout them, which can range from you taking on a centipede like form or even just a 'ball of limbs.' This change in form functions such that you would be able to comfortable remain indefinitely if the need arose.

objects.title: Handy
objects.text:
Your precision affected your telekinesis, turning it into 8 flying hands that share that precision. They are essentially clones of your actual hands physically wise, but besides that their design is up to you.

You can summon and unsummon the hands whenever you want, leaving behind any held items. They will appear nearby you when summoned.

These hands cannot go farther than 20 meters from you. Within this range you can also see in black & white, functioning perfectly well even in the dark, allowing you to properly use them when they are outside your normal sight.

addons.text: Those you have awakened can naturally pass the powers you granted them down to their children, letting them in turn eventually pass them down to their children and so on, whether that be by being taught as secret family arts for skill-based powers like Qinggong or Illusion Magic, something they're born as for innate powers like Dwarf or Rule of Cool, or a mixture of both for powers like Amazonian.
addons.title: Heirloom

addons.text: When you empower someone, such as awakening their powers or granting them new ones whole-cloth, the effect of Loyalty Insurance, if you so desire, will extend to them as well.
addons.title: Faustian Bargain

addons.text: When those you've awakened pass on your gifts to the next generation, they, if you so choose, also pass along their unbreakable loyalty to you.
addons.title: Faustian Inheritance

addons.text:
With an intimate understanding of your powers, you are capable of awakening similar abilities in others much more precisely.

You can fully customise the power to suit your preferences or those of the person receiving it. For example, when a power has multiple expressions, each unique to every wielder, you can determine the exact expression that will be awakened.
addons.title: Precise Calibration

addons.text: For any power you awaken in others that invoke or otherwise draw power from a patron deity, you can designate yourself as their patron, making them your wards as opposed to leaving them to the whims of another deity.
addons.title: Divine Ward

addons.text:
You now have the ability to awaken your power systems in entire civilizations. To start, you can choose to allow those you personally empower to empower others themselves. However, this does not spread further down, so those they empower cannot further empower others. In addition, your disciples will also gain an increased intuition and understanding of the powers you grant them, given you also understand your own powers, allowing them to develop their own techniques and styles with the powers which they can teach to their own disciples.

As you and your disciples start awakening  more power users, other users will begin to be ambiently awakened around you. As the more you and your disciples personally awaken, the faster and wider this mass awakening may become. You still have control over the distribution, rate, and level of empowerment, as well as optional fine control across demographics, power limits, expression, and ratios. You cannot directly choose the specific individuals and groups that are empowered if you are not personally awakening them.

You and your disciples can also build the institutions these powers will be organized around, such as militaries, schools, clans or underground societies, which will allow you to further control and shape the growth and development of this mass empowerment. You can decide whether society recognizes you and your disciples as the founders and progenitors of these powers, simply the first geniuses/powerhouses of the system, or whether they believe it spontaneously happened unrelated to you.

Regardless of the amount of fame you claim, how you and your disciples’ conduct and present yourselves will be the premiere example of power users to the outside world. Through this you can influence the attitude of how society receives these new powers, whether seeing the empowered as novelties, chosen ones, freaks, something go be kept secret, or just letting society react however it normally would. The empowered will also subconsciously follow your example of how power users should publicly act and present themselves, such as as superheroes, wizards, priest, wrestlers, gangsters, ect. This does not influence their motivations, ideals or morality, however.
addons.title: Founder of Empowerment

addons.text: The world’s mass empowerment is now centered firmly arround you and your ideals. Your disciples will now instinctively know how to carry out your vision for an empowered world. Other empowered people will have a slight subconscious pull to use powers in ways you would approve of, with you being able to influence their motivations, ideals and morality. Your enemies will also find it very difficult to turn the empowered against you, unless you allow it.
addons.title: Emperor of Empowerment

addons.text: Every member of your organization may have had powers already awakened when you arrive. You may choose how many members have which powers and in which combinations. Parts or all of your organization may be split into groups focused on different aspects, expressions or usages of your powers. You may choose the background of the power users. You may have personally awakened them, they could have independently discovered or awakened their powers before coming together, or they could be an old order of hidden users. If your powers are physical or racial in nature, then they could be a hidden community. With Heirloom, many members of your organization already have children and/or apprentices who are starting to show affinity with their powers, though they are not old or powerful enough to be members of your organization. With Precise Calibration, some members of your organization have already become experts in certain aspects of the powers you have granted them, and have begun to note down research into the theory and techniques of power usage. With Founder of Empowerment, several people outside of your organization have begun awakening powers as well, and will begin gravitating towards your organization for guidance. Many other groups of power users will also begin forming. While they may not be inherently aligned with your causes and ideals, unless you have Emperor of Empowerment they won’t be necessarily opposed to you either. They also won’t become more powerful than your own organization.
addons.title: A Cabal

objects.text:
With just a touch, you can awaken in others the ability to wield any of the powers you possess yourself. Granted powers initially start at the level of a beginner, and should they require specific physiological changes, the target's biology will slowly transform until it can accept them. If the power you awaken is unique to every wielder, then the awakened will develop their own expression.

Awakening cannot grant any knowledge or skill. As such, the awakened will have to discover how to use the ability by themselves. If you personally train them, they will grow exponentially faster until they catch up to your level of proficiency.

You can limit the powers you give out in any way you desire, such as restricting them from developing past a certain strength threshold or from developing certain expressions.
objects.title: Awakener

objects.text:
You have the ability to, with the touch and on the willing participant, convert the powers of others into a power of the type you possess. You can also choose to convert only some expressions of the power, leaving the rest unchanged.

The less there are outward similarities between the old and new nature of the power, the harder it will be to convert, the longer it will take, and less powerful the result will be. For example, converting an entire magic system into a singular ability will be very taxing and require months of effort, while converting almost any shard-based power into an esper ability will be almost effortless and can be done in seconds.

After conversion, the power loses all of the drawbacks and weaknesses that stem from its source but may gain new ones, depending on the power's new nature. This does not eliminate any limitation that are simply inbuilt part of power's functionality, such as a Manton limit, but it is possible that those can be circumvented or even completely negated with experience and development due to new nature of the power.
objects.title: Conversion

addons.text: As possessing Endless Reserves means your reserves remain perpetually full, your energy sources will constantly replenish and overflow into your secondary pool of power. While this does render Spirit Reservoir’s original abilities redundant, this does result in a few new interactions. First is the ability to directly ‘cast’ from this secondary supply as if it was your main reserves, this could be used to cast spells or use techniques that depend on or are enhanced by synergy. The combination Ninjutsu from Naruto would be a good example. Second is an almost inversion, the ability to draw forth some of that stored energy within your Spirit Reservoir, up through your main reserves, and out into the world. Perfectly converted to be able to replenish someone—or something—else’s reserves instead. Lastly is the ability to condense your energy supplies within Spirit Reservoir, dense enough that they almost seem to crystallize into a small orb. Once you’ve done so drawing such an orb out, you can imbue that orb into another object or being to grant them the ability to produce and utilize that energy themselves.
addons.title: Reservoir of Power

objects.text: A limitless supply of energy… kind of. The owner of a Spirit Reservoir has a secondary reservoir of power within them that has an upper cap that is so high that it’s, for all intents and purposes, limitless. This reserve of power can be accessed at will—to refill your main reserves—as easily as breathing. So how does this work? The way is simple: slow and steady wins the race. Think of it like this, your normal energy supplies are like filling a bathtub over a void. Once the bathtub's full, you stop filling since there’s no reason to overflow it and waste water, right? Now? Beneath the bathtub is an empty ocean and your bathtub is never turned off. This causes it to overflow into the empty ocean below and begin filling that. Just remember, the overflow only happens if your bathtub is full. Still, every last drop of energy inside the ocean below is yours to utilize, to refill your reserves at will. This Reservoir can store an unlimited amount of different energies, each able to be independently stored, and reclaimed at will.
objects.title: Spirit Reservoir

objects.text:
Your reserves of any supernatural energy you might have, such as mana, psychic energy, chakra, spiritual power, or qi, are now made functionally limitless, being considered constantly, permanently filled to their maximum.

While this doesn't actually increase the size of your reserves directly, this does substantially increase the rate at which they grow indirectly, among other things, by allowing you to use 100% of your power at any and every moment without fear of running dry.
objects.title: Endless Reserves

objects.text:
Your reserves have become truly infinite. No longer do you have any constraints on how much mana, chakra, ki, or some other supernatural energy you can channel at once.

Whatever the case was before, your body can safely handle both storing and channelling these energies in any amount, never resulting in any adverse effects, even should you truly put an infinite amount of mana into a spell.
objects.title: Infinite Reserves

addons.text:
Every pool of supernatural energy you possess is not only endless but also ever-expanding, allowing you to draw out more and more power at once.

Every pool of energy you possess now doubles its size every month. Additionally, you can no longer suffer any debilitating drawbacks no matter how much energy you take from whatever source. When you are filled over your maximum capacity, this will only cause your reserves to rapidly expand to accommodate the new amount of energy.
addons.title: Ever-Expanding Reserves

objects.text:
Within the depths of your being, a wondrous and self-improving engine known as the "Engine of Escalation" now resides. This enigmatic engine has granted you a tremendous boon: an initial increase in the potency and range of all your powers by 300%. As you wield your powers, you'll notice a seamless and profound change in their functionality.

The Engine of Escalation draws its power from a unique source—the infinite energy generated inside you. It harnesses this boundless wellspring, employing a brute force approach to fuel its growth. The engine consumes this raw energy, converting it into a catalyst for progress and development.

With this, your powers are now intricately woven into a living network, feeding on this energy. As you use your abilities, the Engine of Escalation channels the surplus energy, amplifying their potential and pushing their boundaries. The sheer force of this energy infusion enables your powers to evolve and adapt at an unprecedented pace, surpassing conventional limitations.

The growth facilitated by the Engine of Escalation is not solely dependent on active utilization. Even in moments of respite or when your powers lie dormant, the engine tirelessly burns through the infinite energy, driving continuous advancement. Over time, this relentless process ensures that the potency of your powers doubles every five years, an automatic progression that reflects the engine's unwavering commitment to improvement. 

However, the engine's potential for growth is not limited to its passive operation. Through deliberate training and consistent usage of your powers, you can expedite the growth process exponentially. By actively engaging with your abilities, you unleash a torrent of energy that propels the engine into overdrive, allowing it to double the power of your abilities within a single year.
objects.title: Engine of Escalation

addons.text: Now, you are capable of controlling how the powers of those you share the benefits of the Engine of Escalation with grow and develop just as well as you can control the development of your own.
addons.title: Guided Advancement

objects.text:
Those in your presence now can, if you allow it, share in the benefits of your ever-improving nature.

The engine inside you will now extend its benefits to those around you, facilitating a rapid improvement, with it being faster the greater the gap in strength between you and the person benefitting from said improvement. This allows you to raise others closer to your level of strength exponentially faster than they would be able to progress on their own.
objects.title: Not so Lonely at the Top

addons.text: The more negative emotions you feel, the deeper you fall into despair. Negativity begets negativity and it becomes easier for you to be overwhelmed. You can use your exponentially increasing despair to enhance your magic, turning despair into strength and cleansing your Soul Gem. But you have the risk of losing yourself should you let it overcome you. You can choose to turn off the exponential grief spiral whenever you want, even automatically should you not be in the right mind.
addons.title: Grief Spiral

addons.text: You have a state of mind that is free from any internal influence and the emotions you feel do not affect your judgement. You can still experience your emotions, but they do not interfere with your decision-making. You have a clear and calm mind that allows you to control your actions and thoughts even in the face of intense negative emotions. You are not swayed by your emotions, but you are also not numb to them.
addons.title: Clarity

addons.text: You can absorb the negative emotions of those around you, sensing and taking their burden as your own. You can use the Inhabitants’ and Copies’ negative emotions as fuel to amplify your abilities. By taking their pain and suffering, you free them of their burdens and help them grow. With those in your paradise, you can overcome any limits you previously had by taking in their negative emotions.
addons.title: There is No Pain, No Suffering

objects.text:
You possess the rare Gift known as the Negative Emotion Drive, an innate technique that creates and stores energy from negative emotions to vastly accelerate your prowess with any and all kinds of powers. Using the Negative Emotion Drive, you can even strengthen and use abilities that require and can't normally be enhanced by emotions. With enough hate, anger, sadness, anguish, and other negative emotions, it can turn someone unsuited for learning the supernatural to become a powerful individual.

The Negative Emotion Drive can store the negative emotions you feel to be unleashed whenever you find the need for the negativity, oftentimes whenever you feel particularly desperate and full of negative emotions. Under these negative emotions, you’re advancing with your powers. This progression can enable you to acquire new abilities, discover unique applications of your existing skills, and enhance the ones you already possess. This means that your powers will be permanently strengthened by the growth you achieve with the Negative Emotion Drive, even when you are not using it. You can even break all kinds of limitations and obstacles in your growth with enough negative emotions. You can use powers at their full potential but surpass them. However, too many negative emotions can be extremely dangerous for one's mental health.
objects.title: Negative Emotion Drive (Magical Girl Tyrant Sylph)

addons.text: Whenever you are the primary reason for someone else’s positive emotions, their emotional state is copied and added onto your own at full strength, boosting the strength of your powers even further. This prevents ennui and listlessness as long as you continue spreading positivity due to you experiencing their positive emotions as vividly as they do.
addons.title: To Protect That Smile

addons.text: No longer are you empowered by just the highs and lows of your emotions- combined, the drives now cover even things that are difficult to quantify as emotions, since they sit in the middle. For example, Calmness/Indifference provides a slow but steady permanent power boost, Willpower provides large temporary bursts of power and Focusing on something rapidly increases your learning rate of whatever it is you have focused on. Ambivalence somehow fills both your positive and negative pools simultaneously. Thankfully, the drive still functions even with highs and lows, and this new neutral ground even reduces the mental damage too much negativity can cause.
addons.title: Emotion Drive

objects.text:
You possess the rarest once since the dawn of creation Gift known as the Positive Emotion Drive, an innate technique that creates and stores energy from positive emotions to vastly accelerate your prowess with any and all kinds of powers. Using the Positive Emotion Drive, you can even strengthen and use abilities that require and can’t normally be enhanced by emotions. With enough love, joy, hope, compassion, and other positive emotions, it can turn someone unsuited for learning the supernatural to become a powerful individual.

The Positive Emotion Drive can store the positive emotions you feel to be unleashed whenever you find the need for positivity, oftentimes whenever you feel particularly inspired and full of positive emotions. Under these positive emotions, you’re advancing with your powers. This progression can enable you to acquire new abilities, discover unique applications of your existing skills, and enhance the ones you already possess. This means that your powers will be permanently strengthened by the growth you achieve with the Positive Emotion Drive, even when you are not using it. You can even break all kinds of limitations and obstacles in your growth with enough positive emotions. You can use powers at their full potential but surpass them.
objects.title: Positive Emotion Drive (Magical Girl Tyrant Sylph)

addons.text:
Your alignment with the cosmic balance of karma is even more profound.

When your karma shines bright with positivity, you naturally gravitate towards virtuous souls, such as noble knights, who find solace in your presence. They see in you a kindred spirit, a beacon of goodness that draws them closer, fostering bonds of camaraderie and mutual respect.

Conversely, when shadows of negativity cloak your karma, you may find yourself drawn to darker companionship. Malevolent souls, like ruthless serial killers, are inexplicably drawn to your aura, seeing in you a reflection of their own darkness. To them, you are not a target, but a comrade, someone who understands and resonates with their twisted worldview.
addons.title: Karmic Action

objects.text:
Every action you take resonates with the cosmic balance of karma. Acts of kindness and selflessness tip the scales in your favor, earning you positive karma. With this positive karma, wielding benevolent powers like holy magic feels effortless.

Conversely, indulging in malevolence and cruelty stains your karma with darkness. Actions like murder, torture, and inflicting harm sow seeds of negative karma. With negative karma, forbidden arts like demonic magic become second nature.
objects.title: Karmic Alignment

objects.text:
"You're a strong independent being, you don't need no powerful being to use your power!"

With this, you don't just wield power; you become the entity embodying it. In practical terms, if you're a Jinchuriki, you would transform into the tailed beast itself (you have the option to shift back and forth to your original form), composed entirely of chakra. 

If you once had a Divine Patron, no god would hold your powers hostage, demanding you promote their religion. Instead, you would be that god, and it would be your own faith that needs to be advanced.

However, this transformation isn’t continuous and only activates once which is when you initially purchase a power with a being that would trigger this. 

You would also inherit their limitations and weaknesses. For instance, as a divine being, you would still need to gather followers at the same scale and rate your Patron did to perform the same miraculous feats.

This power does not give you any beings on it's own, so you will need to choose one that does for this to work.
objects.title: No Middleman

addons.text: You can now generate an endless amount of your chosen element, as well as make infinite sources of it, like a never-extinguishing fire, an endless well of water, or an infinite source of mana for use by yourself or others.
addons.title: White Hole

addons.text:
You can now program portions of your element with an algorithm for a certain behaviour, which it will continuously execute even if you are not in range to actively influence it, as if you were controlling it manually, or even allow this programmed portion to receive commands, mental or otherwise, from other designated users.

This will even allow you to create semi-conscious elementals, whose behaviour you can program in any way you want.
addons.title: Artifactorio

objects.text:
For one of your chosen powers that grants you control over some kind of domain, be it element, concept, or anything else, your connection to this domain becomes absolute, making you its sole embodiment and granting you absolute authority over it. If someone tries to manipulate your domain through any means, even if they possess perfect copies of your power, your authority will effortlessly supersede all their attempts to do so. Moreover, you are always aware of any such attempt and can block it if you so desire. You can limit the level of awareness so it does not become a constant distraction.

As your existence is irreversibly tied to your chosen domain, your ability to manipulate it cannot be separated from you by any means. Even if the power that originally allowed you to control the domain is stolen, suppressed, or otherwise manipulated, it will not hinder you in the slightest, and the power itself will eventually be restored.

Lastly, as you now embody your chosen domain, you will live as long as there is even the smallest trace of it in existence or even beyond it, constantly regenerating from the most grievous wounds or even complete obliteration. You also serve as an origin point, ensuring the endless generation of the element or concept constituting your domain in a self-perpetuating cycle.

Note: this upgrade does not grant the mastery over domain by itself; as such, it will be useless without some other power. And your initial ability to wield it will still be tied to this power, although you will be able to effortlessly discover new and creative uses of your domain.
objects.title: Absolute Authority

objects.text:
The domain you hold authority over evolves and expands continuously and without end.

With time, your authority will incorporate anything even remotely related to the initial domain that serves as the core. For example, should you start with authority over shadows, it may eventually evolve into control over darkness itself and from there to the void of space.

Your abilities within your domain also grow and expand, becoming more versatile and extending far beyond what was possible before. A simple authority over shadows, for example, may eventually evolve the ability to teleport through shadows, manifest items from your shadows, or even create entire pocket dimensions within shadows. Nearly any ability you can think of, even barely related to your domain, can be achieved with time and training.

The growth never stops even should you put in no effort at all but is the most active when you are in danger or in actual need of manifesting a new aspect or expanding your authority.
objects.title: Evolving Authority

objects.text:
Your enchanting powers have fused, exponentially increasing your potential in the field as a whole. 

The energy, charges, and/or time required to perform your method of enchanting is lessened by half, and your recovery of said energy or charges is doubled. 

Additionally you find it much easier to push the boundaries of your craft, finding the potency of your ‘enchantments’ being doubled across the board.

Any feature, application, advantage, and other benefits that one power may have now applies across the board, and any weaknesses that one may have that another doesn’t is shed entirely. 

Finally, you are never at a loss for inspiration, able to theorize new enchantments and ways to apply them continuously. 

Every additional requirement chosen doubles every facet of this again.
objects.title: Enchanter²

objects.text:
Is your power advancing at a frustratingly slow pace? Tired of dedicating decades or even centuries to relentless training just to reach a functional level? Then this upgrade is exactly what you need!

With every purchase, your power and skill growth rate gains an X2 multiplier.

Your first purchase of the upgrade lets you train and study twice as fast. A second purchase quadruples the rate, a third boosts it to six times, and the effect keeps stacking! The more you buy, the faster you grow.

(Terms and conditions apply. Certain unique power mechanics may prevent full benefits from this upgrade.)
objects.title: EXP Boost

objects.text: You now passively improve the density of all forms of energy you have access to, both internal and external. The higher the density, the more effective your energy is in the same quantity. By actively working to improve the density of your energies, you will eventually be able to increase the quality of the energy you are working on. Achieving an increase in quality is a momentous event, as a higher quality energy will be able to perform in an entirely different realm from the base form. Quality increases allow for more flexibility and creativity with the improved energy, loosening the bindings that you'd normally be subject to.
objects.title: Quality Over Quantity

objects.text:
Certain powers, spells, rituals, artifacts, or what have you, require multiple people to effectively use. Fortunately for you, you now count as multiple people as far as these are concerned. For each purchase of this upgrade, you now count as one additional order of magnitude of people for any effect that requires multiple people to activate.
