This can be any effect, from spells that require multiple people to donate energy to power them, to shields powered by the desires of those protected by them, to beings sustained by the faith and belief of their followers. Even more physical effects count for this, so a spell that is powered by blood will treat each drop of blood you spend on it as anything from several drops of blood to multiple swimming pools of it depending on how many purchases you have.

The way this manifests is different depending on how the power effect grows per participant. For strictly linear growth, this would make the first purchase treat you as 10 people, the second 100 people, etc. Meanwhile for exponential growth, this could be as low as treating you like 1 more person per purchase. Essentially, this is less 'you are now 10 people' and more like 'you are worth ten times the power output of people' per purchase, however many that actually is.

You may purchase this up to 10 times, making you worth 10 billion people (or approximately 1 whole planet) for effects with linear growth per participant.
objects.title: Team of One

addons.text:
Your knowledge on how to awaken powers in others has evolved to now include the Old Kai’s ritual.

The ritual takes about 5 hours of dancing around the person in question, 20 hours of meditation, and can increase depending on just how much potential an individual has.

While the full process is annoying, successfully completing it will allow you to not only give others the opportunity to use your powers, but the ability to unleash their potential with them right out of the gate. They will still need training to truly master these powers, however. Just because you are strong enough to wield a giant sword, doesn’t mean you know how to swing it right.
addons.title: Awakening Potential

objects.text:
You have undergone Old Kai’s ritual and have had your latent potential unlocked. Not only that but your latent potential rivals even Gohan. What this means is that you can use all your potential strength and energy whenever you want and can even focus your power to go beyond your full potential.

Being able to use your full potential has the neat side effect of removing the limit of how much power you can harness at once and how fast you can harness it, removing the strain of their usage. An example of these limitations would be having an ocean of Ki but only being able to bring it out you with a garden hose, with strain being any added pressure to the hose to make it go faster.

Your potential isn’t stagnant either, with training it is possible to have even more potential. By that same token however, it is also possible to lose your potential if you slack off training and do nothing with it. The same man who was bedridden can become an Olympic Athlete after all.

This doesn’t just apply to your physical strength, but every power that draws from yourself. In the case of a power being more external, you can more easily draw that power into yourself. It should be known that doing this recklessly may make you explode.
objects.title: Potential Unleashed (Dragon Ball Series)

objects.text:
You have gained an affinity for the supernatural in all its forms. Whether it be magic, ki, psionics, or something else altogether, you have incredible potential. You will find yourself grasping the supernatural with far greater ease, developing abilities at an accelerated rate, manipulating energies with far greater finesse, and theorising about the supernatural with remarkable creativity.

As a point of reference, this grants you the potential of individuals on the level of Dumbledore, Mordenkaine, or Quatach-Ichl, that is, the top 0.1%. These are people who possessed extraordinary talent but also had to work hard to achieve their heights. You will have to do the same. However, this practically guarantees that, given enough time and effort, you will become the equivalent of an Archmage.

This doesn't allow you to break the laws of the supernatural, increase your energy reserves, or grant you magical knowledge. You don't gain a special physique, bloodline abilities or secret techniques.

There will likely be those who are as talented as you, but also have additional advantages such as greater energy reserves, unique affinities, or blessings that allow them to outmatch you. Additionally, there exist monsters whose innate talents stand above even what this provides, such as Karsus.

You simply have the potential to match most of the greatest practitioners of whatever supernatural arts you encounter.
objects.title: Supernatural Affinity

objects.text:
You can choose for any of your franchise based powers to instead come from a generic universe that happens to possess a near-identical power system. Any named setting specific concepts are replaced with near-identical generic versions,

This does not change the capabilities, mechanics, or power level of the purchased power, and it functions exactly as described in the text of the CYOA. This does allow you to selectively ignore any other aspects of the setting not directly related to the selected power, however.

You may choose which powers you apply this to when you pick it.
objects.title: Legally Distinct

addons.title: Bound Form
addons.text:
Your human guise is no a simple disguise. Rather than merely concealing your true form, it seals it away.

While in your human form, your monstrous physiology, natural weapons, and any passive traits tied directly to your Case 53 body are condensed beneath a perfectly ordinary appearance. This grants you all the benefits of Human Guise, but at the cost of suppressing a portion of your physical and supernatural capabilities. Your powers are not lost, they are merely restrained by the limitations of the form you have chosen to wear. At an average, your human guise is only as fifty percent as strong as you truly are.

By releasing this restraint, you may partially or fully manifest your true nature to regain your lost power. Should you discard your human guise entirely, your full Case 53 form manifests, restoring your complete strength and allowing you to wield every aspect of your true power without restriction.

objects.text:
You possess the ability to seamlessly shift into a fully human form, regardless of your true nature or current species. Whether you are a kaiju, machine, dragon, cosmic being, or energy-based entity, this power grants you a flawless disguise—complete with biological mimicry, warmth, breathing, heartbeat, and scent. No mundane or magical senses can distinguish you from a true human unless you allow it.

Your human form is entirely customizable. You may decide your age, gender, race, and features within the bounds of plausibility. Your strength, powers, and abilities are not reduced or removed—merely hidden or made more compact in this guise. You can return to your original form fully at will and with practice, selectively reveal parts of your original form.

This power does not limit your original form—it merely adds another mask to your arsenal. You are still what you were... but now, the world will see only what you want them to see.
objects.title: Human Guise

objects.text:
Whatever shape-shifting, alternate bodies, or “true forms” your other powers grant—be they draconic, kaiju, elemental, mechanical, or anything else—you now move between them as naturally as breathing. The transformation answers a thought, flowing in one effortless motion and finishing in the span of a heartbeat. No energy is lost, no pain or disorientation follows, and each body manifests at its full, intended potency the moment you arrive in it.

If several different powers offer distinct forms, you may call upon any of them individually or layer compatible traits together, producing hybrid shapes that hold the strengths of each source without introducing new weaknesses. Size shifts, mass changes, and anatomical rearrangements never strain you; the physics simply resolve around your intent. Every form remains perfectly stable, letting you fight, cast spells, or perform delicate tasks immediately after the change.

Because the shift is an intrinsic expression of your will, hostile attempts to lock you out of a body, trap you mid-change, or weaponize the process fail unless you allow them. Should you ever be forced from one shape, your essence defaults to whichever form you designate as “resting,” letting you recover and retaliate without missing a beat.

Form Concordance does not add a new body of its own; it instead turns all existing and future form-granting powers into a single, fluid repertoire, ensuring you can enter or exit any of them whenever the moment demands.
objects.title: Form Concordance

addons.text:
Where once your body was built for a singular purpose, adapted to your unique abilities, now you’ve become an everchanging thing for all seasons. 

As any powers you have grow and change, so does your body, instinctively becoming perfect to use them. This also extends to any abilities you gain later, your form rippling to adapt to these too without disrupting your previous adaptations, and perhaps even enhancing them as new factors play in.
addons.title: Ultimate
Darwinian Demon
addons.text: You’ve become an anomaly in whatever world you’re in, and with the powers you have. Outliers are those who have what it takes to climb to heights of power only the strongest reach; your mind and body are perfected to seize this destiny. Your one-of-a-kind species is now made of a collection of glitches, bugs, and cheats on the law of reality, wrapped around millions of years of evolution mistaken for intelligent design engraved into your genetic code, translated as genetic freaks, devoted to offering innate advantages and untapped potential to every relevant aspect of your existence. A perfect storm of evolution. At a closer look, you don’t resemble a species that could exist, living or nonliving, because your existence is ever-changing, adjusting to your growth and progression. At first, you express this through everything you do or wish to pursue, able to get ahead of your fellow trailblazers in challenges of physique, intellect, and mastery over your powers. Nurturing this talent will be enough to win a war on your own, run a scheme through the setting, and become the most accomplished superpowered being all at once, cultivating them to an absurd degree. They’ll always be extreme outliers: those without your advantage but settle for nothing but perfection, once-in-a-lifetime geniuses, and fellow freaks of every caliber willing to put in the work or not; that’ll be in the race to be The Best and will do so, but you’ll outpace them with enough blood, sweat, and tears. Of course, it doesn’t account for everyone that achieves glitches, bugs, or cheats you have to get ahead in your setting, though. Of course, you can’t complain; that means you’ll have much to learn yet, doesn’t it?

objects.text:
Rather than a human (or whichever species you’ve bought in this CYOA) you are an entirely unique one-of-a-kind member of a new species. Whatever powers you have, your body and mind is retrofitted to maximize their effectiveness as though you were the latest in a lineage of billions of years of adaptation built around their use.

For example, if you have a magic power that requires hand-signs and chants then you could gain limbs with dozens of extra-flexible, extra-precise digits to form impossibly efficient or complex signs, spiracles dotting your body which “chant” for you when you blow air through them without taxing your respiratory system, and an instinctive knowledge of what movements and noises to make to invoke magical power. Of course, that’s on the mild end; just about any trait is possible, even ones very far from what would be recognizable to life as we know it.

No matter how many powers you have, the traits won’t become “diluted.” Each power will have its adaptations as though it were the single ability your species evolved to specialize in, and all of the traits that occur will somehow fit together without an issue.

Even with just one power you are likely to be very, very far from any other species taxonomically speaking. With many you’ll probably seem eldritch even without buying any eldritch powers. Still, you’ll almost definitely be the very best user of whatever powers you have, able to do things that would be impossible for other users of the same abilities.

This is a one-time rewriting of your species into one suited for using your powers, so unless there’s a lucky coincidental parallel in how new abilities you gain work and how one you already have does, you’ll have to work your way up in that one like any other species.
objects.title: Powerful Life-Form

addons.text: Whenever you change your form, you can do it in the coolest way imaginable. Perhaps you change into a Hollow as a knife is flying at you, perfectly exiting the hole in your body, or you kick up a massive dust storm your new body can stroll out of in a perfectly casual manner.
addons.title: Farming

objects.text:
Whenever you change your form, you can decide on its appearance and how it differs from the  ‘base’ appearance it would otherwise have. 

While this includes clothing and decorations, this cannot make any functional changes to the form or its abilities, only aesthetic ones.
objects.title: Fit Check

objects.text: Like Jennifer Walters, you have complete control over your ability to transform. Your alternate form is now no longer brutish, being aesthetically identical to your normal appearance save for coloration.
objects.title: Controlled Burn (Marvel)

objects.text: Though you are now permanently transformed, your affinity for the Gamma Radiation that saturates your being has caused your mental capabilities to skyrocket in all aspects. Additionally, as this is now your permanent form, your looks are now back up to your standard level if they weren't otherwise.
objects.title: Hulking Professor (Marvel)

objects.text: You have gained control over the Gamma energies that infuse you. This allows their projection for various abilities such as flight, energy blasts, and camouflage.
objects.title: Atom Bomb (Marvel)

objects.text: Your rage empowerment is no longer soft-capped, and you will scale much faster.
objects.title: World Breaker (Marvel)

objects.text:
You become an Immortal Hulk, a being linked to the "One Below All", as such, your powers grow stronger at nighttime and in dark places. This powers grants you various abilities, such as perceiving lies, self-sustenance, communicate with ethereal beings (such as spirits), detect gamma radiation, awareness about if you are being monitored, manipulate your body and even the power to absorb energies, gamma radiation, beings inside you and magic.

The most remarkable feature of this upgrade is that it grants you complete and total control over the "Green Door", which is what grants you, your immortality.

You can't ever be truly killed, because you will always come back.
objects.title: Immortal Hulk (Marvel)

objects.text: Your Gamma form is infused by the Fel, removing any concern for diminishing returns and physically empowering you even further. This also provides a massive level of magic resistance.
objects.title: Gamma Beast

objects.text:
Your empowerment was no mistake; through experimentation your physical being has merged with the very fabric of the universe. No longer do your energy reserves rely upon a sliver of an Infinity Stone, but rather a white hole, an interdimensional source of cosmic energy. You have an unlimited source of cosmic energy to use in the form of light, heat, and radiation.

Your base and empowered states have grown by a vast amount. Your strength has increased to the level of being able to destroy large asteroids, punch large craters into the moon, or lift a Celestial. Your durability now allows you to take hits from opponents such as Thanos, the Hulk, or Gladiator. Your energy absorption makes hanging out on the surface of stars trivial, or even allows you to temporarily absorb the Phoenix Force against its will.

Your energy output easily matches that of a star and will only go up over time as you grow to handle the power of the white hole. You can easily overcome the energy absorption abilities of others with your output and can even muster enough energy to block energy-based attacks that would overcome even your own impressive absorption.
objects.title: Binary (Marvel)

objects.text:
You have been upgraded into an Omega Prime Sentinel, the next evolutionary step beyond the Prime Sentinel program. While earlier models were derived from standard Sentinel technology, your nanotechnology is based on the advanced design principles of Nimrod Sentinels. Though you have not yet reached a Nimrod’s full level of power, you have inherited a measure of its famed adaptive capabilities.

This advancement allows you to generate nanobionic constructs for a wide range of applications and grants you a form of technopathy, enabling intuitive interaction and control over machines. Your energy projection systems have been vastly enhanced, permitting the generation and manipulation of heat, cold, electricity, plasma, and radiation across the electromagnetic spectrum. You can also create complex electromagnetic phenomena, including lightning strikes and magnetic induction. Your force fields are powerful enough to shield you from threats on the level of Magneto.

In addition, you possess extensive metamorphic abilities. Your body can stretch and reshape like living taffy, your limbs can be transformed into weapons or tools, and your appearance can be altered to infiltrate secure locations or seamlessly blend into your surroundings.

While you retain many of the same vulnerabilities as a Prime Sentinel, these weaknesses have been significantly reduced by your upgrades.
objects.title: Omega Prime Sentinel (Marvel)

objects.text:
You have become a Nimrod-series Sentinel, widely regarded as the pinnacle of Sentinel development. Your body is composed of nano-Sentinels, granting you the strength and durability to defeat Juggernaut in direct physical combat. Your form can be reconfigured into nearly any conceivable shape, including a human form and  the creation of fully functional duplicates that all share your human mind. This also extends to creating weapons, such as shock webs and cluster bombs with quantum targeting.

Your energy-projection capabilities include concussive, electric, plasma, and disintegration blasts, as well as magnetic fields, gravity manipulation, and sonic attacks powerful enough to render beings as resilient as Juggernaut unconscious. Your regenerative and adaptive systems are perpetually active, automatically generating countermeasures to any abilities detected by your sensors. These adaptations occur even without immediate threats, as your nano-Sentinels continuously refine defenses based on accumulated data. You are also capable of teleporting across vast distances—such as traveling from an orbital base to Earth—even while critically damaged.

Despite your immense power, you are not without weaknesses. You can be temporarily disabled or even shut down by massive surges of energy, though the amount required is astronomical. Any duplicates you create remain linked to you and share this vulnerability, which is amplified if multiple copies are affected simultaneously. Additionally, each duplicate consumes processing power and energy; creating too many at once can diminish your adaptive capabilities.
objects.title: Nimrod (Marvel)

objects.text:
Unfortunately, you’re in a similar predicament as Erik Josten, that being that you find it incredibly difficult to fully manifest a physical form. 

While you can rally your energy form together enough to be consistently conscious without a host, in order to use any of your abilities you need to imbue yourself into someone to act as a medium for you to act through. 

While imbuing someone, you both remain individuals, but the edges of your minds fray together. For instance, if your ‘host’ was a very confident or anxious person you’d feel that trait rubbing off on you while you’re expressing yourself through them and vice versa.
objects.title: Atlas (Marvel)

objects.text: Thanks to a synthesis between your Gamma Mutation and Kryptonian physiology, you had unlocked a transformation evocative of Doomsday, an ancient experiment created in efforts to create the Ultimate Lifeform through continuous “stress testing”, eventually forming within the creature innate hate to Life from its constant deaths and tribulations. The transformation is quite peculiar, with no baggage from Doomsday itself such as its unending vitriol for all that lives and its compulsive desire to kill it, and your transition between your base form and your Doomsday form is seemingly smooth… at first. As you become more accustomed to your new form, you will find it harder to revert back the longer you stay transformed, with the ultimate risk of never being able to change back into your original form. This metamorphosis essentially turns you into the ultimate killing machine, all physical abilities such their strength, speed, durability, and endurance are nothing but comparable to the paragons such as Superman in his prime with nothing holding him back, or Martian Manhunter at his most desperate, on top of your natural weaponry coming from your bone protrusions serving both as defense and offense. Its most prominent abilities are its adaptive resurrection and regeneration, both abilities elevating the beast to the threat it is known to today: Adaptive Resurrection assures you adapt to whatever it kills you, becoming either resistant or outright immune to it afterward, while Adaptive Regeneration ensures your survival no matter the obstacle or environment.
objects.title: Doomsday (DC Comics)

objects.text:
Your Doomsday form has been tainted, and saturated with the Fel fires of the Twisting Nether. Your Doomsday form’s physical abilities had been vastly empowered to a destructive scale, with a humongous size to boot. This corruption has a few destructive advantages, though, with projecting and breathing uncountable amounts of Fel energy, causing untold havoc and destruction to both your surroundings and unfortunate enemies.

Another feature resulting from your poisoning is the resulting creation of your personal infection: The Doomsday Virus, taking the toxic and infectious characteristics of the Fel and incorporating it into yourself, being capable of generating viral spores able to turn anyone into a being like yourself or if it's too much of a dosage, begin to rot and die, effectively dissolving them.
objects.title: Fel Beast

objects.text:
The handiwork of the gods shines brightly through your divine clay, elevating your very existence. Granted by Demeter, you are now "stronger than Hercules" and contain the potential to overpower a matured Superman. Your durability, also granted by Demeter, is enough for you to survive being punched from the Sun to the Earth, lightspeed attacks around the globe, and even the pressure of a black hole. Your speed, granted by Hermes, is high enough to keep pace with casual use of the Speed Force, and reflexes to match, and even exceeding those of Superman.

Demeter's blessing grants you a constant renewal, boosting your regeneration to the point of healing up to moderate injuries in seconds or minutes, and an immunity to poisons and toxins. Your very presence boosts the healing of and durability of those around you.

Athena's blessing grants you "The Sight of Athena", a broad improvement to your insight and an ability to sense the emotions of others. You are immune to illusions on the scale of the cast by Doctor Psycho to such a degree that their attempt to be used against you is more baffling than the illusions themselves.

The blessings of Artemis grant you the ability to communicate with all animals and bring a raging beast to a calm through just your presence. Your eyesight is vastly improved, being able to see much further and a "Hunter's Eye" to always hit your mark. Your sense of touch is acute enough that you can sense the subtle changes in air pressure around you, granting you a form of physical precognition.

You gain the full capacity as the finest warrior ever born among the Amazons of Themyscira and the over 1000 years of experience that the original Wonder Woman obtained while fighting with Thor and Superman in Valhalla.

Your wisdom and intelligence, heightened by the blessings of Athena, are now able to rival the likes of the Martian Manhunter and Batman.
objects.title: Princess of Themyscira (DC Comics)

objects.text:
Your nuclear condition has stabilized, transformed from an uncontrolled meltdown into a precision-engineered atomic powerhouse. No longer a walking inferno of phosphorus, your body has reconfigured into something more focused, more deliberate—an energy-reactive skeleton burning with charged plasma and volatile radiation.

Your burning phosphorus shell has been replaced with a blazing, radioactive skull that pulses with immense nuclear force. You no longer simply radiate destruction—you control it. Your body now functions as a compact particle accelerator, directing your power outward with tactical intent.

You are capable of launching focused bursts of nuclear energy in the form of high-intensity plasma beams or explosive skull-shaped blasts that erupt with enough force to destroy armored vehicles, level reinforced structures, or harm beings on par with Kryptonians.

Your strength and durability have both advanced significantly. You can now lift and throw heavy vehicles, punch through advanced armor plating, and endure high-impact blows, concussive force, and directed energy attacks. Your resilience places you firmly within the ranks of heavy metahuman combatants.

You can fly by generating directional atomic thrust, allowing for maneuverability and speed both in-atmosphere and through vacuum. You also gain the ability to suppress your radiation signature, operate safely near civilians, or focus your emissions for maximum offensive effect.

In addition, your body now passively absorbs ambient radiation and certain energy attacks, allowing you to recover energy, sustain your core output, and heal from injury over time.

While you no longer burn uncontrollably, you remain a terrifying figure—an exposed skeleton crowned in fire, the embodiment of humanity’s nuclear dread given will and purpose. You are not merely a hazard to be avoided. You are a weapon of precision, devastation, and lasting consequence.
You are the Atomic Skull.
objects.title: Atomic Skull (DC Comics)

objects.text: Either by developing the Resurrector, a device that administers a lethal neurotoxin to die in seconds, or any conceivable way in a comic book setting, you can revive with a pre-established powerset upon revival, and permanently imprint a defined or default group of powers while selecting one or more custom powers for yourself.
objects.title: One Million Resurrection Man (DC Comics)

objects.text: You’re not the One-Machine Attack Construct, a creation made in desperation to escape a leash, you’re an One Mind And Community, designed to hunt and replace Metahumans. Firstly, While as physically strong as you were before, your biology is now completely composed of nanomachines, capable of morphing into complex shapes and constructions ranging from disguises to plasma cannons. Additionally, as a Nanotech being, by producing more you can either create multiple bodies wholesale or infect others in order to create more OMACs that are linked to you in a Hive-Mind through Brother Eye. Your most dangerous abilities however, are the Oppositional Adaptation Suite and your Adaptive Suite. These are designed to automatically simulate potent countermeasures to any metahuman you’ve catalogued, ranging from simply dispensing flame-retarding foam to simulating the magical lightning required to return Captain Marvel to Billy Batson. If unprepared, creating a profile of an opponent would likely take a full minute of active combat, but assembling a file on them beforehand would make this system far more effective.
objects.title: One Mind And Community (DC Comics)

addons.title: Amazo (DC Comics)
addons.text:
Your Amazo-Cells are no longer the pilfered scraps, you’ve become a true blue Amazo unit. 

Your power replication has become massively more efficient, able to retain your stolen abilities for far longer than before, this includes complete duplication of equipment they may be using or outside sources of power. With enough time you could even integrate these outside sources into yourself and remove your reliance on copying it.

Furthermore, like the Taskforce VII Amazos you can selectively ‘lock’ a set of powers, making it so they’re no longer drained when you use them, and also do not return to their source, at the cost of no longer absorbing any more until the ‘lock’ is disabled.

addons.title: Newmazo
addons.text:
Beyond a regular Amazo, you’ve been enhanced with a Responsometer giving you far greater control over your own technology than you once had.

Much like the ‘Newmazo’ prototype, in addition to your regular abilities you have both an enhanced intellect and an innate form of technopathy. This not only allows you to construct complex machines using only your mind but to make the most out of the existing technology and powers already at your disposal within your body, using them far more efficiently than otherwise.

objects.text: Beyond the One Mind And Community, you’re the OMAC PRIME. Much of your abilities are the same, with one notable exception. Your adaptive suite has been massively improved with Amazo-Absorption Cells. These cells allow you to absorb the superpowers, natural skills, or equipment functionalities of anyone nearby, adapting and learning using these abilities and your existing countermeasures in tandem. Unfortunately these abilities are not permanent, the absorption cells that contain your stolen abilities being drained with each use. This does however mean that some can be kept for emergencies if unused.
objects.title: ONE MAN ARMY CORPS (DC Comics)

objects.text: Your ship is retrofitted into a hybrid, either an Aviation Cruiser or Aviation Battleship allowing you to get the best of both worlds. While your firepower or air projection is less than either type, your power is higher than the sum of your parts.
objects.title: Hybrid Shipgirl (Azur Lane/Kantai Collection)

objects.text:
Your ship is retrofitted with modern weapons and equipment giving you more projection power. This would bring you to the level of a ship from the end of the Cold War.

The technology level is determined by the setting but will be at least on par with 1970 earth technology, out of date but still serviceable.
objects.title: Cold War Retrofit (Azur Lane/Kantai Collection)

objects.text:
Warships were rarely born alone; they usually had their “sisterships” sharing their fate. Now your “sisters” follow you — ships of the same class and with the same fate.

Regardless of class, you are now surrounded by ships of the same type, whether they are built and launched, unfinished, or even those for which only the keel has been laid. These may be several like-minded cruisers or battleships, a noisy crowd of destroyers, or submarines. In any case, you can say with confidence that “the whole family is together.”

You can choose their appearance and character, but in most cases, they will reflect your own traits, to the point that a stranger will understand at first glance that you are related.

However, your sister ships will not become mindless slaves to your will and will not follow you silently. Each ship will have its own desires, thoughts, and possibly goals. Nevertheless, this will not interfere with your family relationship, and they will listen to your opinion more than anyone else's.

If your prototype did not have sister ships, they will still appear. If you have too many of them (this is especially true for science fiction ships), you will receive a number of sister ships corresponding to their average number during World War II for ships of the same class or size: battleships — about 4 ships; heavy cruisers — approximately 4–8 ships; destroyers — 12 to 24 ships.
objects.title: Sistership Fleet (Azur Lane/Kantai Collection)

objects.text:
With each selection you can choose any one type of ship. In addition to your own fleet you receive another fleet of shipgirls of that type as if you had chosen them via Sistership Fleet. Every selection also gives you one support vessel of your choice, like a Repair or Munitions Ship, or from the third selection onwards you can gain Installations instead. You may assign groups of ships freely to build mixed and balanced fleets.

Be aware that if you add heavy tonnage ships while you yourself are in a lighter tonnage, they may want to take battle command from you in an attempt to protect their little "sibling" if they see you as weaker than them.
objects.title: Burgeoning Navy (Azur Lane/Kantai Collection)

objects.text:
Your ship is retrofitted with advanced weapons and equipment, this includes drones, long range guided missiles, multipurpose guns, stealth coating, and more.

The technology level is determined by the setting but will be at least on par with 2020 earth technology.
objects.title: Modern Retrofit (Azur Lane/Kantai Collection)

objects.text:
Your ship-self is completely remade, transforming it into a fully functional spaceship. You lose the ability to walk on water but gain the freedom of the skies and beyond.

Your hull, weapons, propulsion, and other systems are upgraded to the technology level of a galactic spacefaring civilization (such as the Galactic Republic from Star Wars, the Federation in Star Trek, or the Asgard and Goa'uld from Stargate), based on your ship type. This includes energy weapons, shields, an faster-than-light drive, and more.
objects.title: Starship Retrofit (Azur Lane/Kantai Collection)

objects.text: Your ship-self is completely remade, transforming it into a fully functional Fleet of Fog warship. Typically with this you would lose the ability to manifest your “Rigging”, but gain the ability to operate both the Mental Model that is you, and your ship-self in tandem. Instead you gain the best of both worlds, able to operate your ship-self and manifest your "Rigging" upon your Mental Model self with ease. Your ship-self’s hull, weapons, defences and other technologies are upgraded to the level of the Fleet of Fog, from the Nanomaterials that form your hull and frame, to the force-field like Wave-Force Armor used to absorb the energy of incoming attacks, with Photon Cannons, and Corrosive Warhead Torpedo’s forming your armaments. Your Mental Model self is also formed of Nanomaterials around a Union Core containing powerful quantum computers, and various communications systems. This Nanomaterial body grants you a great deal of strength, speed & durability by itself, an ability to change it’s shape and appearance to suit your needs and desires and also comes equipped with a strong Wave-Force Armor of it’s own and the ability to manifest anti-personnel versions of your ship-self’s Photon Cannons.
objects.title: Fleet of Fog Retrofit (Arpeggio of Blue Steel)

addons.text:
Your Hybrid design combined with your Abyssal nature has turned you into a Re-Class.

But not just any Re-Class…

As a Princess you have become the Progenitor of the Re-Class; Kentucky.

With a mix of the late design of the Iowa Class and the Carrier capacity of a Converted Battleship. Your overall stats are similar to an Essex.

But that’s not all, you also have the capabilities of a Guided Missile Battleship and a Scrapper Crew that can break down your enemies after a battle into resources that you can use to repair yourself and restock.
addons.title: Re-Class

objects.text:
You become the dark counterpart of a shipgirl, a being born from the resentment of the souls lost at sea. Your rigging transforms into an eldritch shape that meshes organic elements with black metal. You can choose any Abyssal princess that matches your tonnage save for being an Installation. 

Furthermore, you gain the ability to summon subordinate vessels through a dark ritual fueled either through the use of some form of supernatural power or the sacrifice of materials that would be used in shipbuilding, with more powerful ships costing more to summon. 

Moreover, not only does the ritual only support summoning up to 5 ships at once, but is also spiritually exhausting and without supporting powers can only be performed once per day.
objects.title: Abyssal Princess (Kantai Collection)

objects.text:
You are a Siren, a shipgirl created by Aoste through unknown means. Your rigging and technology level is upgraded to include advanced technology such as energy weapons and shields which increase your force projection abilities. Your rigging also takes on a techno-eldritch appearance. You can choose to be any Elite siren that matches your tonnage. 

Furthermore, you gain the ability to summon subordinate vessels through the mirror sea either through the use of some form of supernatural power or the sacrifice of materials that would be used in shipbuilding, with more powerful ships costing more to summon. 

Moreover, not only does the summoning only support calling forth up to 5 ships at once, but is also spiritually exhausting and without supporting powers can only be performed once per day.
objects.title: Elite Siren (Azur Lane)

objects.text:
Well, it seems you're not entirely a Devil, but you're not exactly human either—more like a Devil-human hybrid, I suppose? Something along those lines. You must have struck quite the deal, huh? I don't know how you pulled it off, but it looks like you made a contract with a Devil and came out on top. Now you're the one in charge, with the Devil's heart acting as your own. Or maybe you took matters into your own hands and forcibly bound a Devil's heart to yourself. Either way, it's clear you're something extraordinary.

As a hybrid, you're not entirely bound by the nature of a full Devil, thanks to your human side. You can freely switch between your human and Devil forms at will, typically using some kind of trigger to initiate the transformation. Once your powers awaken, you'll stop aging entirely after a certain point, becoming functionally immortal—so long as your Devil's heart remains intact. Even if you're "killed" in battle, as long as your heart survives and someone activates your trigger, you'll come back as good as new.

Your regenerative abilities rival those of full Devils, allowing you to recover rapidly from injuries. The more blood you consume, the faster and more complete your regeneration becomes. Even if most of your body is destroyed, a bit of blood is all you'll need to spring back to life.

In your Devil form, you gain access to all the abilities of the Devil whose heart you carry. While you may lack some of the inherent weaknesses of full Devils, your power is still tied to the concept of fear. The less fear your Devil embodies, the weaker you'll become. However, this won't threaten your existence outright—you won't die because of diminished fear.

On the bright side, your hybrid nature grants you an edge. You can learn and innovate on your Devil's powers at an exceptional rate, honing your abilities and mastering the art of instilling fear in your enemies.
objects.title: Hybrid (Chainsaw Man)

objects.text:
You aren’t an ordinary devil, but a Primal Fear, marking you as the embodiment of one of the most ancient and fundamental fears of humanity. With this upgrade you assume the title of a concept that inherently invokes fear in all living beings, such as darkness, falling, or age.

Your power is unspeakably vast compared to other devils, as befits one whose fear is ingrained in all creatures from birth. You possess near-complete control over your concept and the ideas tied to it; as a Darkness Devil you could shroud the area in darkness within which space and time become distorted and invoke unknown or incomprehensible imagery into reality at will, while a Falling Devil could control gravity and force others to “fall” into despair, and an Aging Devil could manipulate the flow of time upon objects and creatures and banish living things into a pocket dimension where there is nothing to do except wait for centuries after centuries while they age without dying. Whatever your chosen primal fear is, the powers it grants you will be similarly great.

As the fear of your concept exists as an inherent and involuntary reaction for all lifeforms, you will never truly run out of fear to fuel your abilities.
objects.title: Primordial Terror (Chainsaw Man)

objects.text:
Unlike most Devils you aren’t just well-known in Hell, you’re an absolute legend. Every devil or similarly inherently evil being instinctively fears you. As long as they were born evil, every fiber of their existence screams of danger in your presence and so much as looking at you through a computer screen takes a considerable amount of energy and resolve from them. You will often find even evil divinities look the other way or send gifts to appease you as they desperately try not to draw your ire even if you’re weaker than them. Those around your level or stronger survival instincts will win out and they will dare to challenge you if they must, but even still they will find their capabilities impacted by facing their greatest natural fear head-on.

Your strength, speed, durability, and devil abilities are also almost peerless. You could fight hoards of devils for days and then take on two Primordial Fears at the same time back to back even if you embodied a fear that isn't well-known such as Chainsaw. You also possess the ability to change into other forms that suit you, like how you can turn into a cute animals when you are severely injured or need to recover.

Additionally, when you kill and eat something it pierces through one measure of immortality, whether it be, ignoring all the bound dolls they have taking damage for them or their divine immortality. Furthermore, if you cause their final death and consume them promptly then the things they stand for will be considerably weakened. Depending on their power, authority, and fame, this effect is bolstered. 

If you were to consume a dictator who stood for world domination and racial superiority, those ideals wouldn’t find hold in the populace for centuries and those following his banner would find themselves second-guessing their allegiance and forgetting what they stood for in the first place. If you were to kill a powerful being that was the literal embodiment of a concept then you would find that the concept is entirely forgotten or even erased from existence altogether in the world, causing sweeping changes throughout.

The erasure process can also be partial as after the War Devil was partially devoured, the concept of "War" has remained, but no more wars have broken out in the human world and you can choose which consumed beings you vomit back up. If you manage to erased a concept, it is still technically possible to revive or recreate the concepts that you devour from scratch reviving the fear that the masses have like how atomic bombs were recreated by the United States despite the Nuclear Weapons Devil have been erased since the radioactive components and the armaments to craft the nuclear weapons still exist.
objects.title: Hero of Hell (Chainsaw Man)

objects.text: Like the Fire Devil, you possess an additional method of accumulating power besides accumulating fear. You become more powerful with every contract you make, even if the contract doesn’t give you anything on its own. You can grant hundreds of thousands of humans power in exchange for nothing and end up stronger than you were when you began.
objects.title: Deal-Making Devil (Chainsaw Man)

objects.text:
The name you possess represents a particularly pervasive and powerful fear among human beings, marking you as an equal to the Horsemen. You’re in the upper echelon of power for a devil, falling just short of outliers like Pochita or the Primal Fears under normal circumstances but otherwise being handily above even powerhouses like the various weapon devils.

Of course, the major distinguishing mark that sets a Horseman apart from any random devil who happens to be strong is their abilities. The Horsemen have particularly powerful abilities which are conceptual in nature and tied to their own perceptions, like the Control Devil’s ability to dominate the minds of any creature she deems lesser to herself or the War Devil’s ability to turn anything she considers her property into a weapon. Like them, your abilities are based on your perception, allowing you to automatically affect anything you believe fits into a certain category. 

The War Devil Yoru, riding high on a recent surge of power and a rediscovered love for America, could turn entire US states into weapons. Although, at the same time getting tricked into a game of Rock Paper Scissors and losing was able to prevent her from turning a foe she’d practically beaten into a weapon, thanks to the mere subconscious feeling of having lost inconsequentially. There’s a fine line to walk between delusional enough to use your powers to their fullest potential and sane enough to be at all functional.

Horsemen typically possess an appearance highly similar to a human, with the only distinguishing mark being their ringed eyes; you may choose whether that is the case for you or if you remain like other, less humanoid devils in appearance. Horsemen also all have total face blindness, being unable to tell any human or devil apart by sight.
objects.title: The Fifth Horseman (Chainsaw Man)

objects.text:
Like the Death Devil you are both a Horseman and a Primal Fear, making your name a concept that all beings fear fundamentally above anything else. Whether you are Death itself or some new concept (possibly one of the other four potential ends to a life that were erased or a post-Death-erasure Bug Devil), your name is one which everything alive knows instinctively, is painfully aware of the eternal threat of, and wants to avoid at all costs, giving you a practically infinite amount of fear to work with.

Your power is great enough to defeat and subjugate even Primal Fears with ease, and you’re tough enough that even if you pulled all of your organs out and tried to kill yourself it wouldn’t work, or even slow you down. Your devil abilities are global in scale. They could affect the entire world, potentially wiping out all humans and devils depending on what they are. In fact, it’s likely that the major limiting factor on how you use your powers is the risk of massive uncontrollable collateral damage. The Death Devil, Li’l D, could supposedly kill even a major devil like War instantly, but it would have killed everyone else in the world too, without any way for Li’l D to spare people she wanted.
objects.title: The Great King of Terror (Chainsaw Man)

objects.text:
Embrace the pinnacle of terror as The King of Fear and Curses, combining the potent forces of Primordial Terror and Cursed Spirit. With this upgrade, your power reaches unparalleled heights, granting you true conceptual immortality, ensuring that as long as the fears you embody exist, you cannot die.

As The King of Fears, your power expands beyond the confines of a single fear, allowing you to embody multiple fears simultaneously, each fear enhancing and complementing the others in a twisted synergy that ensures you dwarf even the most potent Primordial Fears. This versatility grants you unparalleled control over the essence of fear and curse itself. As The King of Curses, your innate mastery of curses has been magnified a thousandfold, enabling you to create cursed techniques at will, imbue objects with cursed energy to create cursed artifacts, and spawn an army of Cursed Spirit servants from your twisted energy.

Across infinite realms, you alone stand as the Honored One, an embodiment of fears and curses that surpass all others.
objects.title: The King of Fear And Curses

objects.text: Ascend to the pinnacle of darkness as All the World's Evil, an entity that embodies the culmination of negative forces. With this upgrade, the potency of your power is magnified to unfathomable levels, surpassing even the mightiest super devils. Your body, a compressed negative dimension of evil, sin, death, fear, curse, and more, radiates an aura that strikes terror into the hearts of all who behold you. As All the World's Evil, you possess innate absolute mastery over demonic energy, dwarfing even the most formidable devils in its manipulation. Your demonic energy is fused with cursed energy and fear energy, creating a primordial energy that transcends individual forms, granting you unprecedented control over the essence of darkness itself. From your twisted energy, you can create devils and their primordial ancestors, demons, shaping them to serve your malevolent will. You wield the innate abilities of each of the 72 Pillars at an absurd potency, harnessing fire, destruction, regeneration, and countless other powers with effortless command. Your existence stands as the closest semblance to an Anti-God in the realm of monotheism, challenging the very foundations of divine forces. Across infinite realms, you alone reign as the embodiment of All the World's Evil, wielding power that consumes and subjugates all in its path.
objects.title: All the World's Evil

objects.text:
You transcend even the extraordinary. As a reincarnation of a mythological entity, your power eclipses all others. With a single punch, you can obliterate a fully unleashed reincarnator. Moving effortlessly at speeds millions of times faster than light, their strikes barely graze you. Your unleashed life energy is so immense that even the High Gods tremble and the very stars themselves tremor in its presence.

Upon transformation, you will acquire four divine powers that are uniquely attuned to the legend of your original self. These powers will surpass the might of the Monkey King's tools, such as Yeoui/Ryu Jingu Bang or Yongpyo. Alternatively, you have the option to manifest four original items, drawing inspiration from the powers and feats performed by your chosen entity, as long as they remain faithful to their authentic legend.

Embrace the full extent of your reincarnated divinity, for you possess an unparalleled strength that sends ripples through the fabric of existence. With your newfound powers and artifacts, you shall leave an indomitable mark on the world, surpassing even the grandest of legends.
objects.title: Supreme Reincarnation (The God of High School)

objects.text:
You have reached the state of Nirvana that Mori Jin attained at the end of his journey, a truly transcendent power that far surpasses even that of a supreme incarnation, having ascended to a higher dimension, where you can govern the universe as you see fit.

Having broken free from fate, karma, and causality, any attempt to bind or control you with such forces is destined to fail. In fact, you can now wield these very forces against your opponents if you choose. 

You possess the power to defy the natural order: reversing the flow of time, teleporting stars and planets across millions or billions of light-years with a mere wave of your hand, manipulating the laws of physics, creating matter and energy from nothing, or erasing them into nothingness.

You can effortlessly strip a being on par with a supreme incarnation of all their power. Furthermore, you can enter a state of cosmic awareness, allowing you to perceive the entirety of the universe and project yourself to any point in space or time.

Your physical capabilities are equally absurd. You can lift the entirety of a universe's space-time continuum with your bare hands. You could travel from Earth to the edge of the universe in just 0.1 seconds and patrol the entire cosmos, checking every nook and cranny, in the span of a single year.

May your reign as the universe’s new Supreme Being be just, wise, and merciful, for there is little, if anything, that can challenge you now.
objects.title: Nirvana (The God of High School)

addons.text: Your blood percentage is increased once again, matching those directly related to Great Ones demi-divines if you will. Your magic/eldritch power is once again enhanced by 5 times(Total stack of 25x base power in these stats) and so are all subsequent potency enhancements. You gain access to every spell/ritual mentioned in game and lore including things like the Augur and A Call Beyond and the like, you also gain 44 more spells and rituals in all categories. You are naturally at least neutral to all Eldritch creatures lower than Great Ones and even they are naturally drawn to you, you may summon/intimately contact 1 every 24 hours for free magically speaking and they will always at least hear you out before making the call.
addons.title: Pthumerian

objects.text:
The potency of your Eldritch blood was always unlimited in scale, the percent of your blood that was Eldritch however was locked. 

Now that has changed, 
the percentage has been significantly upped and your magic/Eldritch power has dramatically increased. Your magic power and the power of your blood and its enhancements is increased by 5 times and every subsequent improvement in potency is 5 times what it would have been. 

You also gain an instinctual understanding of Eldritch spells, summons, rituals and Blood spells, enhancements and rituals as well as immediate access to several of spells and rituals in every category mentioned including normal magic (6 spells and 6 rituals per category) all of which are useful to you in one way or another.
objects.title: Vile Blood (Bloodborne)

objects.text:
Age begets experience and wisdom, in your case your physical age is largely unchanged but you have been through millions of fights against the greatest of beasts and even those who dip into the power of the beyond, living the same yet millions of different lives all for the sake of sanity, power, and survival. 

Your raw power both physically and magically is enough to rend continents asunder and your speed makes light seem slow. 

Your talent in battle has been honed though fights unending, you adapt to opponents on the fly in combat and are nothing short of equal to the best in history with 10 weapons of your choice, due to your experience and talent any weapon you pick up will be wielded with nothing less than expert level skill no matter how strange or esoteric as long as you can wield it it will be used expertly. 

You have regained an ability that was lost to hunters during the current age, you may now perform the Quickstep an arcane ability which grants you massively buffed speed and a level of invulnerability. 

Your physical senses span city blocks and your magical/Eldritch senses cover entire towns, you now live up to your name as a hunter having supernatural skill in tracking and investigation as well as an internal bestiary which updates supernaturally with more information as you kill more and more of a species. 

Your battles with beasts are incredibly in your favor as all of your power is massively augmented when faced with those that fit in the category.

Your Eldritch blood is of incredible potency now, other eldritch of lesser strength will recognize yours and be naturally avoidant unless specifically provoked and all blood magic and enhancements are incomparably stronger than before. 

Even normal magic is learned, mastered, and improved on much easier than before making you a true talent in the arts. 
 Your resolve is hardened now and the terrors of the night bring you little fear, though you inflict plenty in them. 

Your inner beastial nature in now much more easily soothed as you have long since won the battle against your bloodlust and despair and can be called on to boost your physical strength in battle, though be careful overuse could reawaken those long suppressed dangers.
objects.title: Old Hunter (Bloodborne)

objects.text:
Your Titan forms and your giant body have fused, giving you all the powers and the terrifying form of Beefcake, or his human name, Marugori. 

You now tower at over 270 meters tall, a colossal figure of raw muscle and unrelenting power. Your veins bulge grotesquely beneath your surface, and your musculature has expanded to absurd proportions. You resemble an enormous human stripped of skin, with muscle and tendon exposed in horrifying detail. Thick, white, bone-like armor plates cover your most critical muscle groups, forming a natural exoskeleton around your shoulders, arms, and chest. Two massive tubes now protrude from your chest and wrap over your shoulders to your back, throbbing with unnatural energy and constantly venting steam, giving you the appearance of a living war engine barely contained by its own structure.

At your base level, you are classified as a Demon-level threat, already powerful enough to reduce an entire city to rubble and overwhelm conventional military response. However, your potential quickly escalates to Dragon-level, meaning you have the ability to endanger and destroy multiple cities with ease. Your sheer size grants you monstrous physical power; a single punch from your fist can generate shockwaves capable of demolishing buildings across an entire city, while the impact alone can leave wide scars in the earth. When you stomp the ground, the result is a massive crater spanning over 100 meters in diameter, the seismic force enough to trigger localized quakes and obliterate anything standing nearby. Despite your tremendous size, you are anything but slow. You possess a terrifying degree of speed and coordination, able to unleash high-speed combos in seconds, pummeling opponents with devastating flurries of strikes before they even have time to register your movements.

Your durability is equally monstrous. Attacks that would annihilate conventional titans or shatter giant bones barely faze you. Your Titan Shifter regeneration is fully intact, and it is even enhanced by your fusion with ancient giant biology. No matter the damage inflicted upon your body—whether it’s from advanced weaponry, concentrated energy blasts, or direct blows from other titanic beings—you can regenerate as long as your will to live remains unbroken. Pain only fuels your rage, and destruction only sharpens your resolve.

You retain the full scope of abilities from both your Titan Shifter heritage and your Ancient Giant race. Your titan powers are no longer limited to a transformation—they are now your natural state, always active, with all the abilities of the Nine Titans integrated seamlessly into your body. From the Founding Titan’s authority to the War Hammer’s weapon creation and the Colossal Titan’s explosive might, you command these powers instinctively, layered atop your already overwhelming physical strength and durability. Likewise, your Ancient Giant physiology grants you immense endurance, unnatural longevity, and battlefield presence that can dominate even among other giants.
objects.title: Beefcake (One Punch Man)

objects.text:
You have managed to avoid your fate of Spontaneous Human Combustion by having compatibility with your Doppelgänger. This has awakened within you special pyrokinetic abilities. Notably, your ability to control fire is much greater than your peers, granting you both Second and Third Generation abilities. You are immune to fire and being burned, but are still capable of feeling heat.

As a Second Generation pyrokinetic, you can control and manipulate any flames that exist in your surroundings, whether they are natural or produced by other pyrokinetics. Your control might manifest as the ability to construct a wide barrier around yourself through which fire and heat are unable to pass, the ability to manipulate the flames and explosion(s) formed when firing a gun to control the velocity and trajectory of bullets, or even absorbing kinetic energy and releasing it after conversion into thermal energy.

As a Third Generation pyrokinetic, you possess a unique way of forming and using flames from your body known as an Ignition Ability. This might take the form of producing jets of flames from your feet, allowing for flight or enhanced kicks, form and launch arrows of fire from your index finger as if from a bow, to generating fire within your body to massively increase your strength and durability.

Your pyrokinetic and martial arts abilities put you on par with those of Benimaru Shinmon; you can choose to have the same set of martial arts techniques as Benimaru, or an equivalent set of your choosing. You have mastered Hysterical Strength, allowing you to maximize your potential and utilize 100% of your pyrokinetic abilities. Your strength and pyrokinetic abilities are nearly peerless. Your durability allows you to take hits from the likes of Dragon, who was able to split the Sea with his blasts of fire and shatter the Moon's crust with his punches. Your speed allows you to easily react to and outpace individuals who can move at hypersonic speeds.
objects.title: Hybrid Pyrokinetic (Fire Force)

objects.text:
Adolla is an alternate dimension connected to the collective unconsciousness of humanity. It is the home to entities like the Evangelist and Doppelgängers for every person on Earth, living or deceased.

It is a realm of pale skies and black flames, fueled by the despair and fear for death of humanity, capable of nearly destroying anything. Normally, they are weakened by the hope and positivity of humanity, but you can exert your influence over your connection to humanity's unconsciousness to mitigate this to some degree. You now find yourself the master of this realm, standing above even the likes of the Evangelist.

This dimension exists outside the normal world and is extremely overwhelming to any ordinary human; any human who experiences a connection with Adolla will experience physical damage of some sort known as a Stigma. As the master of Adolla, you possess the ability to grant your Grace to individuals of your choosing, allowing them to experience the dimension without harm.

You have full control over the Adolla Burst, which are the flames that originate within Adolla. Your original flame is pure and unimaginably powerful. As the Genesis Flame, it can bring fuel creation by restoring life and greenery to barren lands or produce unlimited energy. As the Flame of Destruction, it is potent enough to cause great cataclysms consisting of worldwide wildfires, continents torn apart, obliterated nations, or even the warping of reality that results in an altered visage of the world to that of an anime or manga-styled world.

You can release sparks of your Adolla Burst into the mortal world to give rise to Infernals and other pyrokinetics.

Anyone you grant your Adolla Grace to will awaken a Third Generation ability if they hadn't already, and will be known as a Fourth Generation pyrokinetic. Fourth Generation pyrokinetics receive a piece of your Adolla Burst that greatly enhances their pyrokinesis to the point of affecting the very laws of physics. Using their Adolla Burst, one might be able to decrease the heat of everything around them, preventing the expansion of the universe and stopping time, or disintegrating their bodies into particles of light to attain lightspeed movement or brief moments of acausality.

Anyone with an Adolla Burst can form an Adolla Link to another with some sort of connection to Adolla, whether that's their own Burst, Grace, or Stigma. Someone without your Grace that still awakens an Adolla Burst can receive brief moments of empowerment by forming a Link to someone who does have your Grace.

As the master of this dimension, connected to human unconsciousness, you will find yourself capable of using any form of Ignition Ability that evolves within humanity, including all of those shown in official media. You can manifest a barrier-like construct anywhere on Earth that grants physical travel between Adolla and Earth to those you choose. Your connection to Adolla is so strong that your existence can be considered immutable. While your physical body might be able to be overcome, it can be compared to nothing less than the peak pyrokinetics connected to your domain; should your body take damage, you can fully heal yourself or reform within the fires of Adolla. Nothing short of overwriting the entire universe can permanently harm you.
objects.title: Master of Adolla (Fire Force)

addons.text:
You have access to the complete arsenal of weapons and gear featured in the DOOM series, including iconic tools of destruction like the Soul Cube, the Unmaykr, the BFG 9000, the Dreadmace, the Praetor Suit, and a fully armed Royal Atlan. Every weapon and piece of equipment comes fully upgraded, with all modifications unlocked and unlimited ammunition or charges.

In addition, you can temporarily activate enhanced states such as Berserk and Haste to gain a decisive edge in combat.

Finally, you gain Serrat as a summonable companion, ready to fight by your side whenever called upon. Should Serrat end up perishing he will resurrect in 24 hours.
addons.title: Run and Gun, Jump and Shoot, Stand and Fight

addons.text: You have become a paradox the likes of which none has ever seen. It seems that your human spirit, combined with your godly heritage, has lead to an inhuman will and strength that rivals all others. In particular, your physical strength and speed have now increased manyfold. If before you had a chance against gods barehanded, now it'd be harder for you to LOSE than win. You could legitimately go against beings the size of moons and kill them, although the process will go faster with weaponry. Your intelligence and durability has increased as well, your Spartan strategic skills adding on to your space marine combat skills to make you a monster in combat AND puzzles, while your durability could let you be shot all the way from a moon to the planets surface and shrug it off. Speaking of which, you have found yourself blessed with any and all weapons the men known as the Ghost of Sparta and the Slayer has had over their lifetimes. From the Blade of Olympus, to the BFG9000. From the Blades of Chaos and all of its variations, to the Gauss Cannon, and so on. These are all summoned from a divine sanctuary, though you can of course put them on your body. Finally, you have found yourself able to call on your rage in a way that combines the two's forms of anger. A controlled Berserk state to tear through demons like air, and a Spartan Rage to kill even among the strongest divines...
addons.title: World's Most Determined Atheist

objects.text:
Throughout the eons of relentless strife against the malevolent forces of Hell, one name resonates with resounding might—the Doom Slayer. Timeless and unyielding, this revered warrior of indomitable willpower stands as the beacon of hope and the bane of demonic existence. Like the legendary Doom Slayer before you, your spirit is an unbreakable fortress, repelling corruption with an unwavering resolve. Your sheer strength knows no bounds, rending through metal barriers as if they were naught but fleeting mirages. Massive demons quiver before your might, their colossal forms shattered under your relentless onslaught, while your eternal essence defies the ravages of time, forever immune to aging's touch. As you stride forth, the demonic hordes tremble, for they shall never know freedom from the eternal vigilance of The Doom Slayer.

Moreover, mastery of resourcefulness is your art, akin to a maestro conducting a symphony of chaos. Every object becomes a potential weapon in your hands, a key to unlock new possibilities. Should a portal be required, an Argent Accumulator shall meet its spectacular destiny under your calculated guidance. And when swiftness is demanded, an orbital defense cannon shall serve as your launch pad to reach unparalleled destinations. Conventional constraints hold no dominion over you, for you unveil unprecedented solutions that leave your adversaries astounded. The skeptics witness the impossible seamlessly materialize within your grand design, as you navigate the impossible with graceful ingenuity. As The Doom Slayer, your legacy is etched in the annals of valor, heralding the advent of an unyielding champion and the eternal guardian against the forces of darkness.
objects.title: Rip And Tear, Until It Is Done (DOOM)

objects.text: You have developed a deeper connection to your clones, allowing you to continue existing as long as you have at least one clone remaining. Upon the death of your main body, your soul will transfer into the body of one of your clones. While retaining all your powers, any physical progress not already present in the clone will be lost; your new body is essentially that of the clone. This includes any strength gains, scars, tattoos, or changes to the main body. After the demise of your main body, you have a very brief window to select which body you will be "revived" in, based on distance.
objects.title: Linked Life

objects.text:
You now start with 24 activations instead; again, divided between enhancing your physical abilities and the power of your Halo Effect as you desire. You possess incredible innate control over your abilities, easily matching the skills of any other Battleship Class Übermensch although some of their feats will be beyond you unless you’re able to match their activations.

If you were to have an equal distribution of activations between your physical condition and your Halo Effect, your resulting physique would ensure that you’d be unscathed after taking a direct hit from a large naval cannon while simultaneously able to tear apart dozens of Destroyer Class Übermensch with your bare hands.

Your Halo Effect could project destructive beams capable of levelling entire towns and your ability to transmute matter would be similarly enhanced; giving you the power to construct huge structures out of the earth while simultaneously possessing an extreme level of precision such as manipulating a singular blood vessel. Having an uneven distribution of activations would push you to even greater heights of power and possibilities.
objects.title: Battleship Class (Über)

objects.text: You are now the Übermensch. You possess a full 48 activations equally divided between your physical condition and the Halo Effect, placing you far beyond any single Battleship Class Übermensch. You can physically withstand a direct nuclear explosion with minimal injury, run at supersonic speeds and are able to throw tanks over 20 miles. Through your Halo Effect, you can now precisely manipulate matter and even warp fundamental forces at an atomic level such as instantaneously transmuting air into solid steel, regenerating wounds with ease or producing Wöden’s Blood itself. You no longer get physically tired or a headache from continuous use of your Halo Effect. You are also no longer limited in the total number of activations you can go through although it will take exponentially more time and effort to acclimatise yourself after every new activation. With significant time and training you are even capable of replicating the abilities of the more exotic Übermensch such as the Geltmensch, the Zephyrs and beyond.
objects.title: The Übermensch (Über)

objects.text:
You’ve unlocked the ability to transmute your surroundings—ground, buildings, and other inanimate objects—into strings that can be utilized for much stronger attacks and defense. 

This power, however, has its limitations. You cannot transmute living beings, nor can you transmute objects while midair—you must be in physical contact with the target to initiate the process. Once in contact, you gain the ability to transmute not just the object itself but everything physically connected to it, allowing for a cascading transformation across the surrounding area. The area of effect is confined to a radius of  500 meters, with you at its center. This radius can be further widened with time and practice.

The transmuted strings inherit the properties of the strings you currently can produce from your body. For example, if your strings are currently as strong as steel, the transmuted strings will share that strength. However, should your strings evolve to become indestructible, the transmuted strings will likewise reach that unparalleled level of durability.
objects.title: Bundle World

objects.text:
You have pierced your heart with the Nail of Helena, one of the nails used in the crucifixion of Jesus Christ, and also one of the holiest artefacts in the Iscariot's arsenal. From this act, you have now become a 'Monster of God'.

Every aspect of your physical form has been significantly enhanced to the extent that you could easily outclass a True Vampire or werewolf in terms of strength, speed and durability alone. Beyond this, enormous amounts of holy vines now spread through and out of your body from your heart, acting as a form of regeneration by nigh-instantaneously replacing any destroyed tissue with these holy vines. You can generate and control enormous quantities of these vines with each vine possessing enough strength to rip an average vampire in half and durability able to easily block anti-tank rounds.

Your body, along with your vines, has become equal to the Nail of Helena in terms of holiness. As such, your mere touch or any of your vines will cause any 'unholy' or 'demonic' beings to be instantly set alight with white-hot divine fire. Even beings as powerful as Dracula himself would be placed in immense pain from these flames. You have full control over these holy flames produced, can ignite them at will and could potentially cause wildfires devouring entire city blocks if you so wished. This also grants you extreme innate resistance to anything that is 'unholy' or 'demonic'. 

You can freely turn into this 'Monster of God' form and then back into your normal form at will. Unlike Father Anderson, you will not lose your sense of self when in this form. However, if the nail, along with your heart, is destroyed then you will die.
objects.title: Helena's Nail (Hellsing)

addons.text:
Your deep connection to the Lifestream and your Jenova cells have made you the heir to Sephiroth, the strongest warrior ever to be part of SOLDIER. You inherit his combat prowess, intelligence, ability to cast spells without Materia, and the vast knowledge he gained from falling into the Lifestream, among other abilities. You can also materialize and wield any weapon used by Sephiroth or his remnants with great skill.

You also gain the abilities and skills of others who underwent the SOLDIER process, including Genesis, Angeal, Zack, Nero the Sable, Weiss the Immaculate, and the other Tsviets. You can also manifest and use their weapons of choice with mastery.
addons.title: One Winged Angel(s)

objects.text: ‘ When the war of the beasts brings about the world's end The goddess descends from the sky Wings of light and dark spread afar She guides us to bliss, her gift everlasting ‘ -LOVELESS Prologue It turns out you’re somewhat special. Either your constitution took to the mako infusion too well, or maybe your body accepted the Jenova cells much better than the competition. Regardless, you’re the cream of the crop when it comes to SOLDIER. Every facet of your original SOLDIER abilities has been massively upgraded, allowing you to take on platoons of 2nd and 3rd class SOLDIER’s with ease. Only after days of fighting thousands of SOLDIERS could you possibly be brought low. Also your masterful proficiency at using materia allows you to cast them for an even longer period before becoming even remotely tired. One notable ability unlocked by becoming a 1st class SOLDIER is the Limit Break state, which after taking a certain threshold of damage or gathering enough mako allows you to massively boost your stats across the board for a temporary amount of time. This ability requires a long cooldown as it is immensely taxing on the body. Lastly as a 1st class SOLDIER, you are given some of the best materia Shinra can provide, granting you multiple materia from the summoning, command, magic, support, and independent types.
objects.title: SOLDIER 1st Class (Final Fantasy VII)

objects.text: You have been blessed with a fragment of the gift once granted to Gawain by the Lion King. This is the power of Nightless. It means the effects of Numeral of the Saint are always active for you, regardless of whether the sun is up or not. This is because you embody the sun itself, and thus it will always shine upon you. As a result, your triple boost to all parameters and related benefits is permanently active.
objects.title: Nightless Charisma (Type-Moon)

addons.text:
The extent of abilities gained from the circuits are enhanced exponentially. Now instead of just the above abilities, you have the full moveset and Burst Techniques from all the bosses Kai faced throughout his journey. Your own abilities are also bolstered to match.

This ranges from Ray’s Burning Laser to fire a massive beam of fire so strong it pushes you back, Trace’s Reanimate matter to create minions out of trash or other materials, Blade’s Freezing Cycle to create a tornado of ice that freezes, and so much more.
addons.title: Commander Circuit

objects.text:
Your capabilities as a Circuit have been upgraded and expanded, granting you all the unique abilities of each individual Circuit.

From Kai; You gain greater yields of Burst Energy and every Burst Technique he's ever wielded. Giving you a multitude of tools for power, defense, mobility and utility.

From Ray; You can shoot a beam of fire from your hands as a devastating attack, propulsion for aerial maneuvers, simple fireballs, and other applications.

From Trace: Landing melee attacks on other beings heal you by a small amount on hit. Melee Burst Techniques produce a greater yield. Also, you can substitute the cost of a Burst Technique with an equal portion of your vitality.

From Blade; You can air dash and have a reduced falling speed.

From Cable; You can fire arcs of electrical energy, which can also be imbued into your melee attacks for extra damage.

From Bit; You gain a great increase to your speed, so much so that you form an aura in-front of you that knocks back most objects and enemies.

From Medley; You can perform a Spin Attack that turns into a rapidly moving cyclone, that you can fully control.

From Crash; Your strength increases to the point of causing mini-earthquakes, making sizable craters, or lifting entire tanks.

From Hash; You can morph into a digital sphere that floats across the air for a limited time.

From Nega; You can summon a cube to your hands that can remotely detonate at will. Once, if you were to die, you will instead be auto-revived and left at "1 HP" instead. This resets after a day
objects.title: Ultimate Blend (Gravity Circuit)

objects.text:
It seems you have mutated into a true monster among your kin. A cannibal of cannibals.

You have mutated to be akin to a predator of your own kind, gaining two very useful abilities. Firstly, should you devour your fellow zombies it will cause your form to rapidly heal, replacing what has been lost proportionally with what has been devoured.
