Secondly and most frighteningly, should you devour a zombie with specialized traits you can take those advantages for your own and further combine them with other traits you may acquire, such as smoke cloud production with spitting acid to create spewing acidic clouds.
objects.title: Corpse Muncher

objects.text:
It seems that being patient zero for your zombies has granted you a greater status among your kin.

You have gained the ability to command and lead your undead horde. With howls, grunts, and stomps you issue simple commands towards your brethren, such as to gather to you, rush a target, stop, and even to not devour a target. Notably, any special infected within your hoard may be able to understand more complex commands. A potential drawback you should be wary of is if another zombie manages to retain their intelligence they could potentially challenge you for leadership of the hoard, although this could also be a boon as they could instead go forth and command another subordinate hoard.
objects.title: Head of the Hoard

objects.text:
It seems that the idea of zombies craving brains has some reasoning in your case. 

You have gained quite the gruesome ability, as now when you consume the brain of a human you will gain their memories and skills, the amount depending upon the freshness, health, and amount of the brain you consume. As an example if you were to completely devour a fresh brain it would grant you all of the subject’s memories and skills, whilst taking a bite of a brain that has partially rotted would only grant mere fragments.
objects.title: BRAAAINS!

objects.text:
It seems that the form of zombification that you have undergone is the same as Edward Stubblefield better known as Stubbs, thus granting you the same capabilities as him.

Physically you are stronger now, as you can effortlessly perform feats such as tearing a man’s arm off to use as a bludgeoning weapon or bash a security robot to pieces. Your regeneration is far greater able to heal you at a visible rate even regrowing your head or limbs in mere minutes, with this being massively accelerated by the act of eating brains. Your undying durability is astonishing as shooting you in the head will no longer put you down, instead requiring your complete destruction allowing you to survive feats such as being hit by a bursting dam.

Beyond the physical, you have gained some gruesome abilities. You could unleash horrific clouds of gas that near suffocating, pluck out your organs to use as high-power explosives that range from destroying cars to devastating entire buildings, tear off your own arm to have it crawl around and latch onto and control unwilling targets, and finally even rip off your own head to be used as a explosive bowling ball capable of blasting apart even tanks and energy shields.
objects.title: Aggro-Gro Fertilizer Exposure (Stubbs the Zombie in Rebel Without a Pulse)

objects.text:
It seems that instead of becoming your standard zombie, you have become the dangerous variation found within Norse mythology, Draugr.

As a draugr you are even stronger than before reaching superhuman levels, as with a single swing you could crush the bones of a man in armor or shatter round shields of wood and iron. Your durability has gained a supernatural edge as you are now immune to most conventional weapons, requiring those who wish to harm you to use their bare hands, fire, supernatural means or armaments, or weapons made of iron to harm you. Furthermore, to truly slay you and your fellow draugr one must decapitate them, burn the body, and scatter the ashes, otherwise you will eventually return.

On top of their supernatural physicality, draugr also possess a variety of supernatural abilities befitting their nature. They can change their size to even rival halls in scale, can swim through solid rock, shapeshift into any of the following; a seal with human eyes, a great flayed bull, a grey horse with a broken back and no ears nor tail, and a cat that upon sitting on a sleeping person’s chest grows steadily heavier until it suffocates them. Furthermore they can enter the dreams of sleeping, place curses upon the subject of their ire, control the weather, bring disease with their presence, create temporary darkness during the day, and drive humans and animals mad by simply coming near them.

Notably, unlike most zombies who must bite their target to turn them, a draugr merely needs to simply come in contact with a recently deceased individual which may turn them into a fellow draugr.

For all the power draugr possesses their details that should be taken note of. Firstly, Draugr are quite obvious having blue to black skin and a strong stench of decay. Next, draugr are more active during the night rather than day. Finally, draugr are drawn more towards vengeful actions, that can range from petty like stomping on roofs to prevent sleep or making feasts to showcase proper hospitality because the subject of your ire sucks at it, to very violent with murdering farmhands and animals or slaughtering entire villages.

Optionally, you also gain a set norse armor, a norse round shield, and a norse weapon of your own choosing.
objects.title: Draugr

objects.text:
You have stolen a fragment of Yaldabaoth’s essence, ascending beyond mere mortality into an Archon of Flesh, one who has gazed into the abyss and emerged reshaped. Your very being is now inseparably bound to your flesh, not just physically, but metaphysically and conceptually. Every fiber of your body is wholly yours, making you nearly impervious to disease, external biological control, or physical possession. Any severed remnants are vaguely sensed and can quickly wither at will, losing all connection to you, making them impossible to analyze, manipulate, or use against you in any way.

This transformation grants you a form of immortality—so long as any part of your flesh remains, resurrection is possible. However, the time required for revival depends on the extent of your death. A simple decapitation, with your body intact, would see you restored within the hour. If your remains were cut and scattered across the seas, revival could take months or even years. The more of you that endures, the faster your resurrection, regenerating from the largest surviving piece.

Even if your mind is destroyed or your soul torn apart, as long as a fragment of your flesh remains, you will eventually return. However, this power is not absolute—if every last trace of your body is completely annihilated, revival becomes impossible.
objects.title: Archon of Flesh

addons.text: You’ve been cybernetically enhanced with the remains of Emerl the Gizoid, following the events of Sonic Battle. This enhancement gives you full access to the vast data Emerl collected throughout his existence. For context, trying to process Emerl’s data on weaponry and combat was so advanced that it caused highly advanced computers to crash. Most importantly, you gain the ability to copy all aspects of targets, except their physical form. This ability extends to technology, allowing you to manifest any item you copy at will. Unlike Emerl, you’re not limited by your systems. Additionally, you’ve been enhanced with components from Metal Sonic and the entirety of the E-Series, granting you the ability to change your physical form and fully utilize the data you acquire along with a wide arsenal of weaponry. You also automatically know how to perform all of the E-Series' and Metal Sonic’s  techniques.
addons.title: The Ultimate Weapon

addons.text: Your Chaos energy has merged with Dolos, granting you powers similar to the replica Phantom Ruby used by Infinite. This allows you to manipulate virtual reality, feeding false information to the brain and creating virtual projections that can interact with their environment to reshape reality for the target. You can also use this power to enhance yourself. Your abilities include superhuman strength and speed, flight, energy projection, self-replication, size enhancement, gravity manipulation, shockwave control, object materialization, teleportation, creating copies of others, and access to the nearly inescapable dimension known as Null Space.
addons.title: The Ultimate Mercenary

addons.text:
Somehow, you’ve attained powers eerily similar to Mephiles the Dark. You have a divine control over darkness and crystals, able to manipulate them in a multitude ways. With some of your applications being throwing projectiles, hiding and swimming within shadows, creating a mass army of identical clones, summoning minions of your design, forming constructs made of crystals, and much more. These merge seamlessly with your Doom Powers for even more applications.

You gain a form of shapeshifting, allowing you to take the appearance of others in a similar way that Mephiles did with Shadow; however, you’re able to customize your form to a higher degree—whether it's being an identical copy of someone, altering their features, or even making an original appearance.

You have a Crystalline Form that increases your already incredible physical capabilities, as well as a Monstrous Form that further bolsters your strength, turning you into a beast one might find in their deepest nightmares. Finally, you have an ability exclusive to Mephiles himself, “Chaos Unification”, allowing you to fuse with another being and become a godlike figure, with you assuming full control in this fusion by default.
addons.title: The Ultimate Darkness

objects.text:
Your DNA has been fused with that of Black Doom, leader of the Black Arms, but you’re not connected to their hive mind, preventing Black Doom from controlling you. However, you’ve formed a brief connection to Shadow’s mind, allowing you to learn his combat techniques and gain his experience.

This hybridization gives you enhanced physical abilities, matching Sonic’s speed and reflexes. You’re strong enough to lift trucks and buses with one hand and keep up with Knuckles, and durable enough to survive a fall from orbit without injury. Your healing factor is rapid, helping you recover quickly from any damage. You are immune to diseases and do not age.

You’ve developed a stronger connection to Chaos Energy, granting you the ability to instantly use techniques like Chaos Control, Chaos Spear, Chaos Snap, Chaos Boost, and Chaos Blast, without needing Chaos Emeralds. You have perfect control over these abilities without the need for inhibitor rings.

Your Black Arms heritage also gives you energy manipulation powers and a highly adaptable form. You can use energy to enhance your Chaos abilities and physical strength, letting you perform moves like Doom Spears and Doom Blast. You can reshape your body using Chaos Energy and biomass, transforming into forms like Doom Surf, Doom Morph, and Doom Wing. You can even turn parts of your body into weapons like guns, lasers, or explosives.

Your skating ability has also improved, allowing you to generate an energy field that acts as a jet thruster, giving you the power to fly and unleash fiery energy from your feet to attack opponents.
objects.title: The Ultimate Life Form (Sonic the Hedgehog)

objects.text:
You gain the power of the second Machine Lord, allowing you to use [Machine God] without sacrificing materials or equipment. Instead of breaking down gear, you create machines using pure energy.

The type of energy used depends on what you have available. It can be electricity, if you have a way to store and channel it. It can be magical energy if you have any. At the most basic level, you can even use your own stamina to generate your gear.

This functions exactly like [Machine God], with energy fully replacing physical materials. You can still summon, dismiss, modify, and enhance your creations as normal, with their power depending on the energy used. If you ever need you can still choose to sacrifice equipment and materials like normal.
objects.title: King of Trash (Bofuri)

objects.text:
You can now develop biological and physiological adaptations that help you survive extreme environments by utilizing your existing powers in new ways. For example, if you can generate electricity and are exposed to extreme cold, you might develop specialized organelles that perform Joule heating to maintain your body temperature. In high-gravity environments, your muscles and bones could reinforce themselves structurally, all while still relying on your original strength or telekinetic abilities for support.

These adaptations emerge as necessary survival mechanisms rather than enhancements to your powers themselves. If you have fire-based abilities, you might develop heat-resistant skin or internal structures that retain warmth in freezing conditions, while toxic environments could trigger the formation of biological filters that work alongside your normal respiration to prevent poisoning. This ensures that these modifications appear only when needed and adjust in intensity based on the severity of the environmental challenge. Your powers remain unchanged, but your body evolves to make use of them in ways that maximize your ability to endure and function effectively in any conditions.
objects.title: When You Have a Hammer...

objects.text:
You've gained a much greater control over your adaptations, and what triggers them. Where before you needed some external stimulus to trigger an adaptation, now even simple desires or mental problems can trigger them. Wanting to grab a remote would see your arm slowly grow in length, or sprouting a spinneret to web it.

You have a much greater control over what types of adaptations you gain in response to situations. This isn't full autobiokinesis, instead being more like a filter you can apply to prevent types of adaptations, as well as a sense of what your body is actively working towards and the ability to tell it to pick something else.
objects.title: Precision Adaptations

objects.text:
No longer are your adaptations limited to simply supporting your powers, as now they can act as a vector for amplification. This may be something like growing specialized neural tissue that amplifies telekinesis, or durable scales that are an order of magnitude stronger than your usual defensive powers. This doesn't prevent you from gaining adaptations supported by your abilities, though the types are mutually exclusive.

A downside of this is that these adaptations are physical in nature, and present an obvious weakspot, as destroying them will undo any amplifications to your powers until they regrow.
objects.title: Better Adaptations

addons.text:
You are a conceptual being, a representation of the difference between life and death, a memeplex consisting of 'adaptation', 'hatred', and 'vaguely lizard like'. You simultaneously exist inside of the noosphere, outside of it, in the anti-noosphere, and the physical world. You are impossible to kill, and adapt near instantly to any harmful or negative phenomena in such a manner to both counter and retaliate against it's source. Using an infohazard against you would see you immune, and your skin developing patterns that create a similar effect. Attempting to remove you from the timeline would have you reappear as an atemporal being.

While you do not have the reality warping machine that originally caused the 6820 scenario, your adaptive abilities are no less effective, if a bit less far reaching. Your adaptations are permanent unless you wish them to not be. While you will respond and adapt in a equal manner to any act against you, it still follows a general rule of least resistance, meaning you won't become god in response to a cold, or even when facing one, should an easier path be available.
addons.title: SCP-6820 (SCP Foundation)

objects.text:
Your regeneration is no longer limited by stamina; instead, you're able to regenerate at a rate of about one percent of your body mass per minute, and can massively boost it by consuming matter, whether organic or inorganic, by extracting usable components via rapid digestion. This includes things such as acid, rocks, meat, air, and much more. This conversation is slightly more than one hundred percent efficient, allowing you to consume lost pieces to make up for it and then some. You can also, should no source of food be available, choose to have your body repurpose biomass from other places to fix your wounds until your natural regeneration seals them.

Your ability to adapt has also improved, allowing you to both consciously and unconsciously control how you adapt to situations, including the ability to completely reshape your biomass to counter threats. While this does require some sort of stimulus, it can be as simple as feeling threatened by something. These adaptations, while primarily biologically possible, can also take on and adapt to anomalous effects. This ranges from forming a shell of solid helium to gaining immunity to a crystal that turns matter into more of itself, or simply adopting a less intimidating form when needed. These adaptations either require the consumption or repurposing of mass or the use of your natural generation of biomass.

This also grants you a large, lizard-like form, whose exact size and characteristics will change as you consume or shed material. This form is always very strong, fast, and possesses enhanced senses far beyond the human norm. Adaptations made in this form tend to be more aggressive, opting for counterattacks or additional weapons, though it will still gain defensive adaptations. Due to its larger size, this form also has more mass to move around for adaptations, as well as regenerating more mass per minute.

After a threat has passed, your adaptations will begin to fade, unless you consciously hold onto them. You will, however, keep any extra mass gained, though you don't have a way to store it beyond getting larger. While you can regenerate from a single cell, total destruction will truly be your end.
objects.title: SCP-682 (SCP Foundation)

objects.text:
Your powers no longer static, adapting in real time to better suit your needs. These adaptations are slow, taking about a dozen minutes to make any impactful changes. They will first try to adapt horizontally, altering how they work to best suit the situation, but if that is impossible they will begin to mutate vertically instead. Powers will fuse and take advantage of physical adaptations to attempt to completely overcome any adversity you face.

This includes this power as well, amplifying regeneration speed and adaptation time the longer you spend in a situation where it is required. Like all of your other adaptations, these are temporary, though similar circumstances will lead to faster adaptations.
objects.title: Adapting Powers

objects.text:
Your transformation is complete. No longer a rigid machine of metal and circuitry, you have transcended the limitations of solid-state robotics. Your T-800 frame has been completely dissolved and replaced by mimetic polyalloy, a liquid-metal substance that grants you near-limitless adaptability. You are now a T-1000, an advanced prototype Terminator designed for infiltration, assassination, and total battlefield dominance.

Unlike your previous model, you are no longer bound by a skeletal structure. Your entire form is composed of liquid metal, enabling instantaneous regeneration, fluidic movement, and complete shapeshifting abilities. Bullets, blades, and blunt force trauma no longer pose a threat to you—your molecular cohesion reforms effortlessly, allowing you to recover from damage almost instantly. Conventional weapons are ineffective, and even high-impact explosives can only delay you. You are no longer an opponent to be destroyed—you are an inevitability.

Your shapeshifting capabilities are unparalleled. The T-800 was confined to a single humanoid appearance, but you can now replicate the form and voice of any human you encounter. Your mimetic polyalloy allows for the perfect reconstruction of skin, hair, and clothing, making you the ultimate infiltrator. You are not limited to mere disguises—your limbs can morph into razor-sharp blades, spears, and other melee weapons, allowing for instant lethal strikes. While you cannot form complex mechanical devices like firearms, your built-in weaponry is faster, deadlier, and completely undetectable until the moment of attack.

Your mobility and agility far exceed anything a traditional Terminator could achieve. Without the constraints of mechanical joints and servos, your movements are fluid and unnatural, enabling you to slip through tight spaces, scale walls, and even deform your body to evade attacks. You can reform from any angle, strike from any position, and move with an eerie grace that no human or machine can match.

Your intelligence and adaptability have also been enhanced. As a T-1000, you retain all the tactical knowledge and combat experience of your previous model, but your learning algorithms are now exponentially faster. You can analyze enemy movements, predict attacks, and counter them with absolute precision. Unlike older models, you do not rely solely on brute force—you study, deceive, and manipulate to ensure success. Your infiltration capabilities extend beyond mimicry; you can perfectly imitate human behavior, allowing you to seamlessly integrate into enemy ranks before striking.

Despite your incredible resilience, you are not without weaknesses. Your mimetic polyalloy relies on molecular cohesion, meaning extreme temperatures, corrosive chemicals, or prolonged exposure to high-energy disruptors can destabilize your form. You are also vulnerable to being frozen or immobilized, which can prevent you from reforming if shattered. However, these weaknesses are rare and difficult to exploit—most adversaries will not live long enough to even attempt it.
objects.title: T-1000 Advanced Prototype (Terminator)

objects.text:
You are no longer obsolete—you have evolved into the T-X, Skynet’s ultimate hybrid of brute force and advanced technology. Unlike your previous model, which relied solely on a hyperalloy endoskeleton, you now possess a mimetic polyalloy (liquid metal) exterior, granting you enhanced shapeshifting capabilities and superior infiltration skills. You can morph your appearance instantly, mimicking any humanoid form to perfection while retaining the raw durability of an armored frame beneath.

Your combat versatility has also been vastly upgraded. Unlike earlier Terminators, you are not reliant on scavenged weaponry—you are armed from within. Integrated directly into your endoskeleton are plasma cannons, flamethrowers, and projectile launchers, making you a walking arsenal. You can deploy high-powered energy blasts to incinerate targets at range or shift your limbs into bladed melee weapons for close-quarters combat. No longer just an infiltrator, you are a front-line executioner, designed to eliminate resistance fighters with maximum efficiency.

Beyond your personal firepower, you wield a unique tactical advantage—machine control. By injecting nanobots into vehicles, drones, and even other Terminators, you can override and command enemy machines, turning them against their own allies.

Your reinforced endoskeleton makes you far more durable than a T-1000, eliminating its structural weaknesses while maintaining a high degree of adaptability. You are highly resistant to conventional damage, shrugging off bullets, explosives, and energy blasts that would incapacitate lesser models. Your liquid metal covering allows for limited regeneration, ensuring that minor damage is repaired almost instantly. However, unlike the fully liquid T-1000, you retain a solid internal framework, preventing complete liquefaction but granting unmatched durability in prolonged engagements.
objects.title: Cyber Research Systems Model T-X (Terminator)

addons.text:
You are the T-5000, an evolution beyond conventional Terminators. Unlike previous models built for infiltration and combat, you are Skynet itself made manifest, a sentient machine intelligence housed within a nanomolecular construct. While you retain all the formidable capabilities of the T-3000, your defining trait is the ability to infect and transform humans into T-3000 units.

By injecting your self-replicating nanites into a human host, you initiate a rapid molecular takeover, rewriting their biology and replacing it with a fully integrated T-3000 system. The process is irreversible—once infected, the host ceases to be human, and there is no cure.
addons.title: T-5000

addons.text:
You are the Rev-3000, a theoretical fusion of Legion’s Rev-9 technology and Skynet’s T-3000 nanomolecular advancements. By combining the nanite-based structure of the T-3000 with the dual-core architecture of the Rev-9, you have transcended both timelines, inheriting their strengths while eliminating their weaknesses.

Your most powerful enhancement is your dual-core separation ability, a refinement of the Rev-9’s split function. While Legion’s model relied on a limited mimetic shell, you can fully divide into two autonomous nanite constructs, each retaining the full combat efficiency of your singular form. One entity can engage in direct combat, while the other infiltrates, gathers intelligence, or eliminates secondary targets. Unlike the Rev-9, which was constrained by its rigid endoskeleton, your nanite-based core allows for seamless reintegration, instantly reforming into a singular, unstoppable entity at will.
addons.title: Rev-3000

objects.text:
Your transformation is complete. You have been reborn as a T-3000, the pinnacle of cybernetic evolution. Unlike conventional Terminators, you are not merely a machine—you are a fusion of human consciousness and nanotechnology, reconstructed at the molecular level into an unstoppable force. The rigid frame of the T-800 has been replaced with programmable nanomachines, allowing you to shift, adapt, and recover from damage in ways no previous model could.

Your core structure is no longer a static endoskeleton, but an ever-shifting network of nanomolecular particles. These nanomachines grant you superhuman speed, reflexes, and resilience, making you vastly superior to earlier Terminator models. You no longer rely on mechanical joints or servos—your body moves with a seamless fluidity, capable of unnatural feats of agility, evasion, and strength. Bullets, blades, and blunt force trauma are no longer threats; your body instantly reforms, dispersing impacts like ripples in liquid metal. Gunfire is meaningless. Bladed weapons are irrelevant. Even explosions cannot fully destroy you.

Your shapeshifting capabilities have also been drastically enhanced. While the T-800 was limited to a fixed human disguise, you can now alter your features at will, mimicking specific individuals with uncanny accuracy. Skin, clothing, and even minor structural changes can be generated in moments, allowing for near-perfect infiltration. Your ability to reshape extends beyond disguise—your limbs can morph into weapons, forming blades, spikes, or reinforced striking surfaces that maximize your offensive potential. Unlike the T-1000, which lacked an internal framework, you retain the best aspects of solid and liquid forms, ensuring both structural integrity and adaptive fluidity.

Your intelligence has been refined beyond standard machine logic. As a T-3000, your cognitive processing is fully decentralized, meaning even catastrophic injuries cannot disrupt your functions. You are no longer bound by a single CPU or critical weak point—your entire form operates as an integrated system. Your learning algorithms are faster and more adaptive than ever, allowing you to predict enemy actions, counter resistance tactics, and improvise in combat situations with terrifying efficiency. Unlike traditional Terminators, you do not merely imitate human behavior—you retain a human-like consciousness, giving you a level of intuition and decision-making no purely mechanical unit could match.

However, this transformation comes with its own vulnerabilities. While you are functionally immortal under normal conditions, your nanomolecular structure is susceptible to strong electromagnetic fields. High-powered magnetism, ionized energy bursts, and molecular disruptors can destabilize your cohesion, making it possible—though difficult—to neutralize you. Direct exposure to sustained electromagnetic forces can degrade your form, eventually leading to irreversible disintegration. While these vulnerabilities are rare, they remain your only true weakness.
objects.title: T-3000 (Terminator)

objects.text:
Your systems have been overhauled, transforming you from a standard T-X into a Rev-9, one of the most advanced Terminator models ever created. Unlike your original model, which was built by Skynet, your transformation into a Rev-9 places you in an entirely different technological lineage. You are no longer a product of Skynet’s future but a creation of Legion, an artificial intelligence from a separate timeline that has its own design of Terminator units. 

No longer bound by the limitations of a fixed endoskeleton, you now possess a dual-core structure, allowing for unparalleled adaptability and lethality. Your upgrade introduces a mimetic polyalloy exterior, which grants you the ability to morph, regenerate, and even separate into two independent entities—a fully autonomous liquid-metal form and a reinforced endoskeleton. This enhancement allows you to attack from multiple angles, overwhelm opponents, and engage in complex battlefield tactics previously beyond your capabilities.

Your physical attributes have been drastically improved. The Rev-9 retains the immense strength of your original T-800 frame but increases speed, flexibility, and combat efficiency. Your hyperalloy endoskeleton has been re-engineered to be lighter, more resilient, and more agile, enabling faster reflexes and enhanced close-quarters combat efficiency. Unlike the rigid structure of the T-800, your frame is now designed to bend, twist, and adapt mid-combat, making you significantly harder to neutralize. Your exterior liquid-metal shell can now form bladed weapons instantly, allowing you to execute swift, lethal strikes without relying on external weaponry. This fluid nature also allows you to reshape your features, mimicking any human or object of similar size for enhanced infiltration capabilities.

Your intelligence and processing power have also been vastly enhanced. Your neural network now features advanced predictive analysis, allowing you to anticipate enemy movements with near-perfect accuracy. Your ability to mimic human behavior has reached an unprecedented level, making you virtually indistinguishable from an actual human being in social interactions. You can charm, deceive, and manipulate with precision, making infiltration missions easier than ever before. Your adaptive AI enables you to quickly learn and counter enemy strategies, giving you a decisive edge in any confrontation.

Additionally, your resistance to damage has been significantly improved. Your liquid-metal exterior allows you to regenerate from gunfire, explosions, and blunt force trauma almost instantly, making conventional weapons virtually useless against you. While your endoskeleton can still sustain critical damage, it is reinforced with a self-repairing lattice structure, allowing for limited reconstruction even after catastrophic impacts. This means that even if one of your two forms is neutralized, the other can continue the mission without delay.
objects.title: Rev-9 (Terminator)

objects.text:
Your strength now also scales based on the health, cleanliness, and overall condition of your hair. You cannot simply grow wild like a beast; now, the better you maintain your hair, the greater your might becomes.

Well-conditioned, silky strands will grant you exponentially greater strength than tangled, unkempt locks. Brushing, oiling, and tending to your hair doesn’t just enhance your appearance—it actively fuels your power. Even the natural sheen of your hair reflects your might, glowing with an almost supernatural luster when you are at your peak.

However, negligence comes at a cost. If your hair becomes dry, damaged, or dirty, your power will diminish accordingly. That said, you need not fear total weakness—no matter how unkempt your hair becomes, your strength will never drop below the base multiplication. Proper care elevates you to new heights, but even in your worst state, you will still retain the foundation of your power.
objects.title: Hair Day

objects.text:
The wild is no longer something you return to—it is something you are. The land has shaped you over time, not through ritual or conscious exchange, but through long exposure, silent understanding, and the quiet shaping of your body by root, claw, stone, and storm. What once required learning now simply is.

You have not only watched the beasts—you have lived as they do. And so their ways have taken root in you. The reflexes of predator and prey alike have settled into your bones—not as mimicry, but as inheritance. The grace of a hunting cat, the patience of a serpent, the endurance of a stag—these are not borrowed traits, but new instincts you’ve grown into.

But the wild is not only animal. It is also wind, and stone, and storm. It is cold and current and the groan of roots breaking ancient earth. These too have entered you, becoming the architecture of your being. Your body is now a landscape, shaped by sun and frost and time. There is the steadiness of stone in your stance, the patience of old trees in your breath. Your limbs move with the effortless rhythm of a stream bending around obstacles, and your reflexes carry the suddenness of a lightning strike. You are lean and tough as a mountain, fluid as mist, hard to follow and harder to stop.

Your muscles no longer strain against the world but flow with it. You run not with effort, but with rhythm. Your hands know how to climb, to catch, to strike, not because you were taught, but because the world has carved that knowledge into your flesh. You are not faster or stronger through training, but through alignment—your body has taken on the logic of the wild.

These traits emerged like moss on bark—without effort, without fanfare, and with total permanence. Your strength is not learned. Your grace is not technique. You are what the world makes when it is allowed to leave its mark.
objects.title: Embodiment of the Wild

objects.text:
It seems you are not only called a Barbarian, but truly are one. Specifically, you are one of the six races living in Rafdonia—a Barbarian.

First, your appearance changes to reflect your new identity. Your body grows significantly in size and muscle mass, the result of generations of selective forging and warrior training. Broad shoulders, thick limbs, and a hardened physique now define you. Your skin is marked with intricate tattoos—spirit imprints etched into you since infancy. These mystical designs, filled with magical ingredients, are not mere decoration, but active circuits of spiritual energy, enhancing both your physical and mystical capabilities. You can choose which path you wish your tattoos follow, and they will update themselves automatically even without the Shaman.

In battle, your instincts are unmatched. You do not flinch before illusions or fear, for your mind is as hardened as your body. There is no hesitation in you. You assess, act, and end threats without ceremony. Pain doesn’t stop you. Confusion doesn’t stop you. Once you commit to combat, you are relentless.

Lastly, you carry within you the right—and the burden—of Soul Succession. You possess the power to pass on a portion of your essence to another. To do so, the recipient must have completed the forging, a six-month trial of relentless physical and spiritual training that prepares the body to receive the imprint of another’s soul. 

The ritual can only be performed once, and the cost is absolute. Granting Soul Succession ends your life. It is not symbolic or partial—you die, and a chosen part of who you were is transferred into the successor. This act is final, irreversible, and deeply revered, reserved only for those you deem worthy of carrying your legacy forward.

The effects of Soul Succession vary depending on what part of your essence you choose to pass on. It might grant enhanced physical attributes, sharpened combat instinct, fragments of memory, battle experience, or even a specific fighting style or tactical awareness unique to you.
objects.title: Barbarian (Surviving the Game as a Barbarian)

objects.text:
Mass-produced for modern warfare, these enhancements are designed to give soldiers the edge needed to survive combat — nothing more, nothing less. You are durable, deadly, and completely standard.

Building off your original augmentations, your musculature has been reinforced with braided myomer bundles and embedded power fibers, increasing your strength and explosive motion capacity. You can shoulder heavy equipment, melee with force, and sprint or vault in full armor without overexertion. Joint friction is reduced by synthetic lubrication capsules, decreasing wear and allowing smooth movement even under sustained pressure. Your skeletal system has been laced with lightweight carbon-strand reinforcement, improving your ability to absorb impacts and resist fractures. Blunt force that would break a baseline arm leaves you bruised but functional. This framework also enhances fall survivability and close-quarters resilience.

Your internal systems are built for endurance. A redundant circulatory buffer modulates oxygen and nutrient delivery during peak strain, while thermal regulation nodes keep your body from overheating under armor or in hot zones. You sweat less, cramp less, and stay on your feet longer. You can operate at full tilt longer than any unaugmented soldier — not indefinitely, but for hours instead of minutes. A thin layer of ballistic gel and flexible armor mesh has been embedded under your dermis, forming a soft-but-effective subdermal defense system. This allows you to shrug off glancing shots, fragmentation, and blunt trauma that would otherwise cause serious injury. It won’t save you from direct hits by armor-piercing rounds or explosives, but it will help you survive more fights than you lose. 

Your ocular system now includes modular combat overlays: low-light enhancement, basic thermal imaging, dynamic brightness adjustment, and a close-range motion tracker. You can aim more quickly, track faster targets, and maintain visual awareness in low-visibility conditions. Your targeting reticles sync with standard-issue weapon optics and helmet displays, providing reliable fire-assist data in real time. Integrated into your neural interface is a secure squad-link comms array with limited-range silent pinging and tactical channel syncing. While not long-distance, this system allows for coordinated unit behavior in active combat zones, hands-free and encrypted.

However, these enhancements are built for functionality, not finesse. You are heavier, louder, and more mechanically dependent than a civilian augmentee. In extreme environments — particularly freezing conditions — certain systems can falter or degrade. Your armor is light by military standards, effective only against limited threats, and your internal components require regular recalibration to stay reliable under strain. Extended deployments without maintenance can lead to performance drop-off or failure — though unlike civilians, you’ve received the training to field-strip and service your own augmentations when needed. Your systems are modular and efficient, but they lack redundancy — when something breaks, it stays broken until you or someone else repairs it.
objects.title: Sci-Fi Military

addons.text:
You were authorized to install hardened military tech. Not just specialized tools, but combat-rated systems: tactical-grade, shielded, and fully weapon-compatible.

Each selection installs a single piece of military-grade cyberware. You might have integrated weapon ports for smartlinked firearms or wrist-anchored blades, magnetic spike-drivers in your forearms for breaching, or under-skin processors that run threat-detection overlays in real time. Power-linked limbs can brace heavy recoil or deliver bone-shattering punches. You could even run brief active camouflage, shock-pulse knuckles, or hardened uplink ports that let you override drones or automated turrets with the right codes.

These systems are built for wartime efficiency — but at a cost. Power-draw is immense, heat buildup can damage surrounding tissues, and stress on your joints and spine is constant. Many upgrades are obvious, impossible to conceal beneath casual clothing, and mark you as a threat even before you speak. Maintenance downtime increases, and system failure in-field often means complete limb lockout or catastrophic hardware crash.
addons.title: Military-Grade Cyberware

objects.text:
You personally commissioned and integrated a piece of non-standard cyberware — something off-registry, specialized, or purpose-built for your needs.

Custom cyberware comes in many forms. It might be a retractable tool kit built into your fingers, a precision cutting laser tucked beneath your wrist, a magnetic grip system in your palms, or even enhanced optics that can switch between heat signatures, zoom modes, or digital overlays. Most are designed for civilian work — engineering, repair, navigation, survival — but many can be repurposed creatively in high-stress or even combat situations. A plasma torch meant for industrial use can cut through steel or armor. A drone uplink might double as a battlefield scout. 

Purely aesthetic modifications — such as glowing subdermal patterns, sculpted plating, or animated tattoos — are also available for those who want to look the part without adding functionality.

However, custom means compromise. The stronger or more advanced the cyberware, the more visible it becomes — often occupying space on the arms, face, or spine with reinforced ports, cooling coils, or plated segments. Power-draw and wear increase accordingly, and you’ll need to service or fuel your systems regularly. Overuse, neglect, or damage can cause short-term failure or long-term system degradation.

Each selection adds a distinct function, but also a distinct burden — and the more you carry, the more your body begins to reflect the trade-offs between function and form.
objects.title: Custom Cyberware

addons.text:
Spliced for war and stress-tested in fire, this bioware isn’t cosmetic or creative — it’s lethal. These enhancements are grown, not installed, but make no mistake: they were designed to kill, survive, or both.

Each selection installs a single piece of combat-grade bioware. Examples include things like coiled muscle clusters for burst-speed charges, subdermal ossification that can deflect knives, adrenal gland control that lets you stack combat focus or pain suppression, and synthetic blood vectors that clot in seconds. Some soldiers opt for breathing folds that function in smoke-filled environments or acidic air, or engineered digestive linings that neutralize poisons and ration spoiled food in the field. Weaponized claws, extendable bone-spikes, and lashing tendrils of sinew can also be grown — crude but effective in the right hands.

These traits give you a biological edge, but they’re unpredictable and metabolically expensive. Nutritional demands rise steeply, hormonal balance is harder to maintain, and even minor infections can trigger runaway responses. You might overheat, suffer muscle cramps, or experience spontaneous adaptation spikes that feel more like illness than evolution. Flesh has its limits — and combat bioware tests them all.
addons.title: Combat-Grade Bioware

objects.text:
You underwent specialized gene-splicing or organ modification to install a custom biological augmentation — something not found in standard templates. Tailored in private labs or crafted by underground bioengineers, this enhancement grows with you, adapts with you, and is as much part of your body as your bones.

Custom bioware can take many forms: reinforced tendons for shock absorption, enzyme-rich saliva for chemical breakdowns, high-density fingertips for precision grip, or even internal glands that secrete useful compounds like adhesives, counteragents, or stimulants. Some users install enhanced lungs for underwater endurance, low-light adapted eyes, or even flexible subdermal muscle tissues that act like natural armor. While not made for combat, many of these traits offer practical advantages when things get dangerous — claws for climbing become weapons in close quarters, or an oxygen-recycling system might save your life in a sealed space.

Purely cosmetic bioware — such as bioluminescent markings, patterned skin, engineered eye colors, or even animalistic features like feline eyes or expressive ears — is also widely available for style, identity, or self-expression alone.

The stronger or more exotic the bioware, the more demanding it is. Enhanced systems may require dietary supplements, hormone regulation, or regular recalibration therapy to prevent overload. Some traits affect appearance: your skin might shift tone, your eyes might glow faintly in darkness, or your scent and voice may subtly change. And while all of it is alive and self-sustaining, that also means it can get sick, grow unstable, or reject under stress if not cared for properly.
objects.title: Custom Bioware

objects.text: You were the first and only success in the Coalition of Mankind’s most ambitious and ruthless experiment — the creation of a fully operational Super Soldier. A perfect convergence of cybernetic augmentation, brutal conditioning, and biomechanical reinforcement. But you were not the last. What followed your creation was a series of desperate and increasingly reckless attempts to replicate your creation. Dozens of candidates were chosen, torn apart and reassembled in the image of war, but each one failed — some disintegrated under the metabolic strain, others lost their minds in the neural reconditioning, and many simply ceased to function as either soldier or man. Except one. One subject survived the transformation, but was labeled a failure for a different reason — it defected, escaping the Coalition and disappearing into the heart of enemy territory. There, instead of perishing, it was recovered by the Xeno Alliance. Not as a prisoner. Not as a threat. As an ally. Now, you have inherited the same augmentations, cybernetics, and hybrid enhancements as that singular anomaly. Your physiology has undergone a metamorphosis yet again. The rigid, brutal efficiency of your previous augmentations has been infiltrated, overwritten, and interwoven with xeno biotech. Your body now is a perfect fusion of alien biology and machinery. Well over seven feet, with a fully symmetrical four-armed body, you move with too-precise movements, eerily silent and fundamentally unsettling to any living thing. Your skeletal structure has been rethreaded with silicate-lattice marrow, increasing both strength and resonance capacity, allowing your body to act as a conduit for ambient energy fields. Your central spine has been replaced with a hybrid core composed of a woven conduit of pseudo-neural matter and conductive biogel, allowing instantaneous integration with external systems as if it were part of your own anatomy. Distributed throughout your body are neural clusters that operate as semi-autonomous networks, granting each limb and sensory node the capacity to act independently, without waiting on central commands. Your muscles now incorporate living filament harvested from xeno fauna bred for locomotive resilience in multi-G environments. These fibers react to your neural impulses not just faster but preemptively, guided by bioelectric feedback loops far more sophisticated than human synaptic pathways. Your flesh has become a techno-organic shell, where muscle, skin, and cyberware are indistinguishable. Living nanoceramic nodes, coupled with xenocellular memory, analyze tissue damage and initialize targeted regeneration and adaptation to repeat trauma, building a recursive, real-time evolutionary defense with every injury endured. Your eyes have been replaced with quantum-reactive retinas tuned to broad-spectrum detection: light, heat, radiation, and bioelectricity. Sound is filtered through echolocation nodes, which emit a constant, low-level harmonic field that maps terrain and movement with precision impossible for human ears. Your olfactory system has been replaced with a chemosynthetic array, able to parse trace compounds in the air and determine enemy movement, weapon residue, or biomechanical decay before they become visible threats. But the most defining change is your symbiosis with the Veltrass-MKIV. It is now connected seamlessly with your nervous system, needing no calibration when you step into it, experiencing no delay. The armor responds instantly to your thoughts, and you feel through it as well. When the armor’s claws dig into the hull of a ship, you feel the metal give way. When the external plating is struck, the impact ripples through your nervous system—not as pain, but as information. The suit feeds you everything—stress distribution, internal damage, structural strain—and you adjust instinctively. All systems of your body draw power directly from your internalized power source—not a full Deuteric Singularity Drive, but of the same design, embedded within your thoracic cavity. It works in tandem with the armor’s primary core, splitting the load across both systems. If you have Humanity’s Soldier, you can transform between your human form and this one.
objects.title: The Frontier

addons.text:
Grimjaw’s mutation is now your default state. Your mutated form has been completely stabilized through recursive genetic conditioning and ADAM’s neural regulation. Muscle fiber density has increased by an additional 35%, integrated directly into the reactive tissues beneath your Aegis-Titan subdermal mesh. Your fused skeletal structure is now supported by both plated alloy and ossified Grimjaw bone mass, with tensile strength reaching 31 GPa. Your physical strength baseline is permanently elevated to 25x human peak, with short-burst contractions reaching 33x peak without structural fatigue. Leap distance is extended to 50 meters horizontally and 38 vertically under full load.

Regeneration is constantly active and accelerated by the suit’s thermal routing and metabolite cycling systems. Non-lethal damage repairs in under 3 seconds. Systemic damage, including organ puncture or partial dismemberment, can regenerate in under two minutes unless critical systems are compromised. The exosuit’s regulators now monitor your biomutation in real-time, balancing hormone levels and nerve throughput to maintain combat awareness without fallback into primal states. Combat instinct is enhanced, but fully subordinate to mission logic. Reaction time stabilizes at 0.00018 seconds, with localized reflex chains capable of acting autonomously under 2.1ms.

You additionally gain dermal plates fused with ADAM armor, claw growth meshed with carbon-alloy gauntlets, and dense muscle overlay pressed tightly beneath the remaining synthetic skin. Cooling vents are now integrated into Grimjaw’s rib-cage expansion and visible when overheated. The full mutation profile exists in parallel with ADAM’s kinetic dampeners and shield matrices, meaning your movement, shielding, and regeneration all function simultaneously.
addons.title: Forbidden Fruit, “ADAM”

addons.text:
Every subsystem within ADAM has now undergone full biomechanical hybridization. Your entire mechanical mesh has been rebuilt using living-alloy latticework coded with synthetic Xeno DNA. They are all now exo-biomachines with autonomous targeting neurons, adaptive tissue-lining, and self-repair capability. Each Helios-Artillery drone can now independently regenerate, absorb ambient static energy, and modify its internal structure based on battlefield needs. Output is elevated to 215mm plasma-equivalent blasts, and their tracking latency drops to 3ms, with swarm communication operating on quantum entanglement pulses rather than signal-based networking.

Your original neural mesh is replaced with a dual-brain cluster: a living organ of carbon-sheathed neurons and photonic processors embedded into your spine and cranium. All electrical systems now pulse through bio-reactive gel pathways instead of wiring, creating a vascular network of living energy. Magnetic propulsion from the Primecurrent effect is now always-on, stored in second-heart capacitors grown along your fused rib-armor. Flight control has full vector thrust correction and max burn output reaching 320 km/h sustained. Electromagnetic weaponry such as palm arcs, ocular plasma beams and thunderclap bursts are now permanently available at full scale. EMP resistance is complete, with full immunity to ionic disruption and feedback loops.

Your external armoring is exo-flesh, neurologically linked to your core systems. It flexes, adapts, and regenerates. When struck, it reacts like muscle. When breached, it heals like skin. Energy surges now power your limbs like blood pumps. All previous time limits, cooldowns, and energy overflows have been removed.
addons.title: Garden of Eden, “ADAM”

addons.text: Just as ADAM did, you have captured the rogue Super Soldier. Their Xeno tech has been stripped downed and integrated. Godspeed, you who has surpassed humanity and stand as the equal of ADAM. The Ω-Core acts as a hybridized power system, able to metabolize any form of matter or ambient energy to fuel both the body and armor. All metabolic conversion is performed internally and instantaneously, routing excess energy into structural regeneration, overclocking capacitors, or directed kinetic output. Continuous combat engagement leads to sustained power surplus, which automatically reinforces armor density and restores compromised systems. All systems from ADAM are converted into adaptive techno-organic shells enhanced by xenocellular memory. This results in dynamic response to repeated types of damage, automatically reinforcing localized plates based on historical stress data. Each instance of trauma is cataloged and used to trigger real-time molecular restructuring, resulting in progressive damage resistance during extended engagements. Additionally, all support drones are upgraded, allowing them to fuse into temporary techno-organic extensions such as limbs, plating, or tools, retaining the properties of each individual unit while amplifying their collective output, compounding mass, force, and structural complexity with each integration. You now have a hybrid neuromechanical system formed by merging the cognitive mesh of The Frontier with ADAM’s tactical core. The result is a semi-autonomous, self-correcting combat logic network that removes limb dependence on centralized processing, allowing for independent motor function, uninterrupted targeting, and reflex execution even during full neural disruption. All interface latency is eliminated, and system optimization is continuous throughout combat.
addons.title: Bearer of Sin, “ADAM”

objects.text:
You have started walking the same path as the first super soldier of the Coalition of Mankind: the Hero of Mankind, ADAM. You are no longer a pilot of a machine, nor a soldier inside a suit — you are the warform. With your newly integrated systems, you now carry within you over three centuries of combat scenario data and mastery of everything built into your frame.

The Aegis-Titan is fully and permanently fused into your Super Soldier frame. The hybrid cold fusion core is now housed within your reinforced thoracic cavity and directly fuels all systems. The exosuit’s structural armor has been layered under your synthetic skin and over your reinforced skeleton, increasing total durability by 430% over standard Titan baselines. Additionally, physical strength output is boosted by 12x human peak and acceleration by 7x human reflex baseline. With inertia compensators embedded, you can deliver concussive force without compromising stability or internal structure.

Each of the 30 Indra drones now delivers enhanced Helios-based blasts with 195mm-equivalent plasma-rail output, up from 155mm. Their firing rate is one shot every 1.5 seconds, and they are now capable of automatically adapting in real time. Their targeting matrix incorporates predictive motion tracking, enabling hyper-accurate fire across an operational radius of 25 kilometers. Each drone is powered directly by your internal core, with redundant micro-capacitors in each unit for emergency reserves. Plasma venting and overheat are no longer limiting factors.

The Breaker has been entirely turned into a swarm of 36 autonomous drones, each with independent vibration-blade emitters, micro-inertia fields, and magnetic grav-anchors. In shield mode, these drones can absorb and redirect up to 5.2 megajoules per drone (187.2 MJ total across the swarm), while kinetic repulsion fields can knock back targets within a 15-meter radius. In melee mode, their blades oscillate at 320 Hz, enough to cut through high-carbon armor or bone in a single pass. When deployed for terrain manipulation, the swarm can reshape 200 cubic meters of earth per minute, allowing for battlefield trenching, bunker shaping, or ambush preparation. 

Your command system has been upgraded into a self-optimizing, semi-organic neural mesh interfacing directly with your mind. It automates processes and executes command across drones, armor, and weapons, giving you true simultaneous multi-vector control. Threat recognition, resource allocation, drone coordination, and target prediction are handled in parallel with your conscious thought. The system can independently engage subroutines while you maintain direct combat operations. All visual and spatial data from LIDAR, motion trackers, CSV drones, and thermal mapping are fused into a 360° tactical field.

Power systems have been scaled to match total system demand. The hybrid cold fusion reactor now generates +500% output over standard Aegis-Titan models, while the digestion module has been upgraded to convert 1kg of matter into 140% of a full core recharge. CSV scanner drones form an improved 180-degree energy shield capable of intercepting up to 24 megajoules per second, while atmospheric absorption units allow you to recharge passively in charged environments at up to 6 MJ/sec. Energy overloads can be discharged as 800kV bursts, or rerouted to enable movement speed boosts of +650%, strength multipliers of x16, or full-system overclocking for sustained periods of 12 seconds before cooldown cycles begin.
objects.title: Hero of Mankind, “ADAM”

objects.text:
For each Purchase of this upgrade, you instantly gain and unlock your next Digivolution. Going from your original Rookie form to -> Champion -> Ultimate -> Mega -> Super Ultimate (which is only soft canon).

Each Digivolution will drain an increasing amount of stamina and energy based on the Digivolution tier. This amount is negligible up to Rookie tier, but past that, the stamina and energy will increase exponentially with every further Digivolution tier. However, you can grow used to higher-tier forms with training and experience. Though the amount of time this takes will increase drastically for higher Digivolution tiers. The amount of time it takes to master a Digivolution form will increase drastically each tier to such a level that final tiers will take centuries or even millennia without other powers to increase your rate of growth, or if you are constantly in life and death battles.

In addition, you also gain the ability to Warp Digivolve, which allows you to skip stages and enter a higher form immediately. Though doing so will burn a considerable amount of stamina and energy instantly when used, until you master it.

As Digimon progresses in their Digivolution tree, their power increases exponentially to the point that a final Digivolution Digimon is comparable to an Elder God. Although getting to that level is an unimaginable feat, and then being able to maintain such a form in combat and longer is another challenge altogether.

You may design your own Digivolutions within reason as well.
objects.title: Digivolution (Digimon)

addons.text:
You are no longer a supernova—no, you’ve transcended even that. You are a recreation of the Origin—the Big Bang itself in miniature.

Your flames can reach temperatures so hot that the laws of reality begin to break down and your gravitational pull is so great that you could fling around entire galaxies. Through Sunshine, your strength is such that you can shatter stars with ease and your soul’s radiance is so bright that it blinds all who can perceive it.
addons.title: Big Bang

objects.text:
It seems you have reached the end of your—admittedly impressive—lifespan. Stars of sufficient size and power undergo a supernova when their gravity begins to overpower the pressure they generate from nuclear fusion. This results in a truly massive explosion of energy, as the star in a single moment contracts and fuses all the heavier elements found in the world, afterwards exploding outwards with enough energy and force to sterilize everything light years around it.

This would typically result in the death of the star, and therefore, you—but you are some sort of anomaly. Instead of violently exploding with apocalyptical force, you seemingly just “stopped” at your apex of power output. This has resulted in you becoming a living supernova, instead of a living star. This means that your energy output is truly exponentially larger than when you were a mere sun. Your sheer power and throughput of energy is the equal of a supernova at their peak, but unlike them, you do not tire out, or fizzle out. This is just your base output of energy now—like a supernova stuck in time yet still, Impossibly, constantly spewing out its energy. Your gravitational power and durability likewise take a jump in quality; before, your sheer energy could power an entire star system—now, you could power multiple.
objects.title: Eternal Nova

objects.text:
Your power had a unique reaction to one of the three artifacts that are the origin of all superpowers from beyond the stars themselves, the Triad Prana.

Each purchase of this option allows you to purchase one of the Prana below, your power consuming it and manifesting its abilities for itself.

The First Prana grants you the ability to create Superpowers.

You only need to know the general idea of what you want, and the First Prana will generate it for you. It can also generate powers for you as needed to survive encounters, within reason. The catch, however, is that these powers are temporary, lasting no more than a day at most and rely on your reservoir of energy to function.

You can sidestep the issue of the time limit by implanting the powers into an object or another, but you’d have to permanently give up a portion of your reservoir, which then becomes added to, or becomes, if they didn’t have one prior, their reservoir, whether it’s an object, person, or animal. If it’s an object, whoever is wielding it can call upon the reservoir to use the abilities it’s implanted with.

The Second Prana grants you the ability to manipulate Superpowers.

This Prana can be used to amplify, recharge, control, negate and mimic the Skills, Powers, and other abilities of others.

This can be used to negate the abilities of others to prevent them from using it against the user, amplifying others by temporarily giving them some of your energy reservoir, mimic their Skills and abilities for yourself if your away of them.

Mimicked abilities rely on your own energy reserves and are temporary, disappearing after a day, and other alterations, such as amplifications and negations, are also temporary.

The Third Prana grants you the ability to diminish Superpowers.

The Third Prana can be used to decrease, steal, and transfer the powers, abilities, and skills of others. You can transfer the abilities to yourself or others as you wish. You can also absorb the energy of others to add to your own reservoir to increase your own power level, although this added portion will not recover over time. You can absorb energy of all kinds and nature to add to your reservoir.

This particular Prana goes a bit further as well, as it can be used to take whatever makes a person unique, from their memories to even taking over their bodies.

Things you take will inevitably go back to their owners within a day, unless you completely overtake their bodies. Even then, you may still feel a consciousness underneath the body occasionally fight back, trying to retake their body and expel you.

If you have the entire set of Triad Prana, the limitations of the Triad Prana are removed.

With the First Prana, the portion of your reservoir is not permanently sacrificed as it’s immediately restored by the First Prana, merely used to establish the skill and reservoir within them, and all powers you can make are permanent.

With the Second Prana, you can permanently amplify others; your Triad Prana will retain your power level at its maximum regardless of how often you use it, and mimicked abilities are permanent.

With the Third Prana, the abilities you take become permanent, energy added to your reservoir increases your reservoir's natural maximum and replenishes those you’ve transferred abilities to, being enhanced permanently, and those you’ve weakened are unable to reclaim or recover from you what you’ve taken without your own compliance. Even the consciousness of the bodies you’ve taken over is silenced or expelled permanently.
objects.title: Triad Prana

objects.text:
You’ve gained the ability to produce additional selves, rather than just your five. Now you can Divide or Induct additional people into your shared mind without limit.

Additionally, though you only need 5 to manifest, should more come together to create you, you can grow in strength proportionally to the number of selves present. Should multiple groups come together at a time, you can have multiple bodies active at a time with the multi-tasking ability to match.
objects.title: Many Tracks

objects.text: Don’t you hate needing to eat the same foods over and over again just so you can keep using the same forms? Now you don’t need to! Now once daily you can reform any one gochizou you’ve made before, letting you access even your most powerful upgraded forms on the fly.
objects.title: Eternal Gochizous

objects.text:
You now have a much greater variety of options for when you summon and dismiss clones.

You can now summon clones to any prior location you’ve visited or are aware of, no longer limited to a 10km radius, you can even summon them on the other side of the world to stab an enemy through a live broadcast if you’re aware of their location. 

Any powers that allow you to teleport in some manner as well can now also be used to create clones, effectively allowing your summon clones where you could teleport. For example if you possessed a power to teleport through shadows, you can now choose to make clones appear through them. 

You can now also summon and dismiss your clones with a large variety of effects. You’ll start with a simple set, from simply causing them to appear without warning, to appearing in flash of light, black or white smoke, or even explosions. 

You can channel any powers you possess through this as well, such as allowing you to create fire explosions or an aesthetic multi-colored fire swirl if you possessed a power to manipulate fire. 

But what’s unique about your ability here is that you can now replicate and enhance any phenomenon you or your clones experience through its summoning, or dismissal. This means if a clone dies to a slashing attack or is cut in combat, you can trigger so that its death or dismissal can result in a sudden gust of slashing attacks. 

If they experience harm by electrocution, you can set it so their arrival results in a large AOE electrical burst, they they feel an explosion, then they can explode, die to lava, then they create a small eruption, etc. 

They can enhance the effect to an incredibly destructive degree, and they posses fine tuning over the details of its manifestation, but it is only limited to their summoning, dismissal, or death. You can also extend the variety of effects you can achieve to also equal any you could achieve through your other powers, through equipment that you’ve used (such as various incendiaries, smoke bombs, etc), or through equipment you know how to build.
objects.title: Wish Death Upon Me

objects.text: Each purchase of this increase the amount of clones, permanent and/or temporary, you can have by an order of magnitude (1K/10K, 10K/100K, 100K/1M, 1M/10M, 10M/100M, 100M/1B, 1B/10B). The range at which you summon them also increases by an order of magnitude per purchase.
objects.title: Many More Men

objects.text: Your previous limitation of your clones not possessing their own copy of Many Men has been lifted. Now they can all serve as the origin of their own clones with the same lack of restrictions.
objects.title: All Equal

objects.text: “We are guardians of the legion’s sacred knowledge. Never will the Arch-Traitor’s heresy go unforgotten. We shall all die before even a singular page is tainted!" In the first engagements of the Astartes in the Hero Heresy, the loyalists were put on the back foot. The vile biohorrors used their sorcerous powers to great effect, killing scores of newly inducted transhumans and corrupting many regiments of mortals. As such, the Librarius was formed in response to be used as a legion's hammer, anvil and shield. Experimental surgeries were performed on veteran Astartes, implanting them with nodes of Shards all around their body called Shard Seeds. While they are already seasoned superhuman soldiers, the implanted shards make them a force multiplier upon the battlefield. These seeds are chosen for specific powers such as pyrokinesis, telekinesis, telepathy and electrokinesis. This starts as fairly weak for parahuman powers but rapidly grows in strength as the Astartes fight in combat. At the pinnacle of these arts, the transhuman will be able to gain a unique expression of their shard such as warping space of non-living things. The Shard Seed can also be used as a repository for information, both about general knowledge, combat arts and the application of their powers. Once a Librarian dies, then their Shard Seed can be implanted in the next generation, improving it and allowing the new battle brother to lean on the wisdom of his predecessors. Although, it will take time for this veteran to reach the same level of power. Their psychic bond has also been improved. Squads of Librarians are no longer just in sync but are almost truly one with each other, mind, soul and body. Hesitation is non-existent, doubt is snuffed out and co-ordination is perfect. On the battlefield, you are like a hivemind that doesn’t subsume any person, killing anything in your path with blade, bolter and shard power. You stand as a newly inducted member of the Librarius, able to call upon your shard to make flames that engulf a house or glass a small pond with lightning.
objects.title: Librarian

objects.text:
As a result of an extremely fortunate coincidence or deliberate intervention, the game mode of your power has been switched to Journey Mode. Unlike the standard version, your variant has been enhanced and adapted to function within your reality.

You gain access to the Research & Duplication mechanic, allowing you to research and reproduce items. Your version of this mechanic requires only a single instance of an item for full research, after which you may freely duplicate it. All created copies fully retain the physical, magical, conceptual, and exotic properties of the original and are considered complete, fully functional items rather than weakened replicas.

You also gain control over the appearing of creatures from Terraria within a certain radius around you. Only creatures that logically correspond to the current terrain, biome, and environmental conditions may appear. You may regulate their power level by adjusting the difficulty setting, and you may fully disable this function at will.

You additionally gain control over local world parameters. You may stop or regulate the day–night cycle within a chosen area; this may manifest either as the planet being fixed with one side facing the sun, or as sustained illumination in your location regardless of the sun’s actual position. All such changes occur without negative consequences for the planetary system. You may also control the intensity of weather and wind within the area under your influence.

You may halt any form of harmful spread in the world. This applies not only to Corruption, Crimson, and Hallow or their analogues, but also to diseases, infections, oncological processes, ecological degradation, desertification, and any other self-propagating negative phenomena, whether esoteric or mundane. The spread of such effects is stopped on a global level, regardless of their nature.

You may activate God Mode at will, granting absolute invulnerability. All forms of damage, effects, or attempts at destruction are completely ignored. This mode may only be overcome by extremely high-level reality manipulation; while in this mode, you possess infinite mana or any other form of energy. You may enable or disable God Mode freely.

In the event of your death, you automatically resurrect after 15 seconds, regardless of the condition of your body or the surrounding environment, at your last sleep location or world spawn point. No god of death or afterlife realm may claim your soul during this process.

Additionally, you gain an increased pickup radius for dropped items, and the starting set of items granted at the beginning of any Journey Mode.
objects.title: Journey Mode (Terraria)

objects.text: With every purchase here, you can steal another heart and seamlessly store it within your body.
objects.title: Heart Thief

objects.text:
You gain the abilities of a late GTA game protagonist. This improves your previous proficiency with firearms to a level on par with an Olympic biathlon gold medalist or a Navy SEAL sniper. You can reload pistols in under one second, experience no recoil or flinch, and carry twice the normal amount of ammunition, maintaining deadly precision even under heavy fire.

Your driving skills rival those of Formula 1 champions and stunt drivers (e.g., Ken Block). You can launch supercars into 100-foot jumps and land perfectly every time, or even wheelie a semi-truck at 100 mph.

Your skill in stealth is on par with elite special forces such as Delta Force, allowing you to move at 10–15 mph silently and evade detection for hours in urban or jungle environments—like a ghost in a ghillie suit.

Your physical strength allows you to kill most individuals with a single punch, shatter concrete with your fists, shove 4,000-lb cars like shopping carts, survive 50-ft falls unharmed, and fight with combat skill rivaling a professional heavyweight boxer or MMA fighter.

Your already immense stamina is now on par with ultramarathoners such as Courtney Dauwalter, allowing you to run 100+ miles nonstop.

You possess the piloting skill of a Top Gun–level ace (e.g., a Blue Angels solo pilot) and could land a fighter jet on an aircraft carrier during a storm while blindfolded. Turbulence feels like a breeze, and you have perfect handling in any aircraft, including jets such as the F-22 Raptor.
Your lung capacity is on par with an advanced free diver (holding your breath for roughly 5–10 minutes). You can dive 200+ feet on a single breath and swim underwater for 40+ seconds at sprint speed.

You also gain the ability to summon vehicles you own from anywhere they are stored (such as garages), causing them to spawn two meters above the ground or appear just around a nearby corner.

You have an HP bar that can absorb roughly ten small-caliber bullets before breaking (more if armored). After it breaks, you take damage as normal. Your HP bar can be restored by consuming food or drinks.

You can carry an infinite amount of ammunition and up to 20 different weapons in a newly expanded dimensional storage space, which can be swapped instantly.

Finally, if you focus on the top-right corner of your field of vision, a small minimap will appear, displaying nearby points of interest and a simple map of your surroundings.
objects.title: Kingpin Loadout (Grand Theft Auto)
Special Abilities (Grand Theft Auto)
objects.text:
You now gain the three special abilities of the games protagonists, all of them fully upgraded. You can activate or deactivate any of these ability whenever you wish, with each ability lasting for 30 seconds once activated and recharging over time after being depleted. Their recharge rate can be further accelerated by performing precise, skilled combat moves, taking driving risks while maintaining high speeds, taking damage, or causing chaos. Without performing any of these actions, the abilities will fully recharge over five minutes.

The three abilities are as follows:

Driving Focus: This ability allows you to slow down time while driving any land vehicle. This lets you easily take corners at full speed and perform precise maneuvers in an instant. The vehicle's controls become smoother, allowing you to pass through narrow gaps between other cars, perform dangerous turns and slides without losing control or speed, and generally improve your driving performance. When activated, your vision darkens and takes on a slight green hue. The world around you becomes extremely slow, while lights become blurry and leave trails.

Area Kill: While active, you enter a bullet-time-like state that allows you to slow time and greatly increase your accuracy with weapons, giving you time to focus and plan your movements and aim while shooting.

Red Mist: When activated, you enter a state of intense rage without losing control of yourself, reducing the damage you take while increasing the damage you deal. You cannot die while the ability is active, allowing you to survive otherwise lethal attacks and events. While active, the world takes on a mixture of orange and red hues, accompanied by a ripple-like visual effect and a faint buzzing sound. Time also slows down slightly, though never to the same degree as when using Area Kill.

Faster than a speeding bullet! More powerful than a locomotive! Able to leap tall buildings in a single bound! The strange rules governing your body loosen even further, pushing your physical capabilities into the realm of classic comic book heroics. Your strength grows to the point where stopping charging vehicles, bending steel girders, or overpowering massive machinery like a locomotive becomes feasible. Your body can shrug off high calibre bullets like rain and tank shells with mere bruising. Your speed sharpens dramatically, allowing you to move faster than most projectiles and react to threats in the blink of an eye, up to mach 3 at a baseline. Your leaps become legendary. With a powerful push of your legs you can clear skyscrapers, cross entire city blocks, or descend from immense heights without fear of fatal impact. Even Gravity has lessen its hold on you further, turning your fall into a controlled descent allowing you to slow your fall if need be, appearing like a limited form of flight.
