What once seemed like incredible athleticism now resembles the feats of the earliest comic book champions. While you still don't possess flashy supernatural abilities, under the relaxed rules that govern you, your body now performs at the level people would expect from the very first generation of legendary costumed heroes.
objects.title: You Truly Are A Super-

objects.text: Welcome to the Golden Age of Champions! The already-loosened rules governing your body give way even further, pushing your physicality into a realm where scale and consequence become exaggerated far beyond conventional limits. Your strength increases massively, allowing you to exert force on a scale that dwarfs anything before. You can lift and manipulate thousand-ton objects with manageable effort, tear through reinforced materials without resistance, and generate shockwaves through sheer physical strikes. Collisions between you and solid structures result in the environment giving way before your body does, and sustained exertion does little to diminish your output. Your durability reaches a point where extreme forces become largely negligible. Heavy ordnance, high-velocity impacts, crushing pressure, and violent environmental hazards fail to inflict meaningful damage. You can withstand repeated large-scale impacts, such as being driven through multiple structures or striking the ground at immense speed with little more than superficial scuffing. Your speed advances into consistent hypersonic ranges, with acceleration that borders on instantaneous. You can cross vast distances in moments, chain movements together without loss of momentum, and react to events faster than most can perceive. Your body handles these speeds without strain, allowing precise control even during rapid directional changes. Your senses sharpen dramatically, granting extreme clarity and range. You can track fast-moving objects effortlessly, pick out fine details across great distances, and process multiple streams of sensory information simultaneously without overload. Your awareness of your surroundings becomes constant and highly reliable, even in chaotic environments. Your leaps and movement become overwhelmingly potent. A single push can launch you across kilometers, clear massive vertical distances, or carry you through dense obstacles without losing momentum. This also grants precise control over the force of your landings and impacts. You can completely negate kinetic energy, landing silently and harmlessly regardless of height or speed, leaving no damage behind. Alternatively, you may focus that same energy into a single point, turning your descent into an you shaped meteor strike capable of forming large craters and releasing powerful shockwaves through the surrounding area. Your body now operates on a level where physical action alone can produce effects that feel disproportionate, dramatic, and unmistakably larger than life, same as the iconic comicbook champions of the Golden Age.
objects.title: Golden Age

objects.text: A strange visitor from another world… a champion beyond mortal limits! The rules that once bent around you now yield almost completely, elevating your existence into the realm of the Silver Age champions. Your physical capabilities grow yet again, surpassing even your prior extremes. Your strength, speed, and durability now operate on a scale where even the most catastrophic forces struggle to challenge you. You gain the power of true flight, moving freely through the air with effortless control at extreme speeds, unbound by terrain or gravity. Your body is fully self-sustaining, capable of surviving indefinitely in the vacuum of space, resisting radiation, temperature extremes, and the absence of atmosphere without harm. Your physiology develops powerful secondary expressions of your strength. Your breath can be expelled with immense force, capable of generating hurricane-level winds or freezing targets with controlled bursts of super-cooled air. Your vision and perception evolve further, granting you the ability to see across vast distances, perceive through obstacles, and emit focused energy capable of cutting or burning through even resilient materials. Your hearing expands to match, able to isolate and track sounds across incredible ranges with precision. At this stage, your presence alone embodies the ideals of the Silver Age comic book champions. Beings who casually defy reality, achieving the impossible just to create spectacles for those needing Inspiration and Hope.
objects.title: Silver Age

addons.text:
Your ability to learn the skills of those native to Kivotos has expanded with your understanding of the principles of Mystics, allowing you to begin to synchronize with other Archetypes beyond your natural one. By acting in accordance with a given archetype—living its ideals, reenacting its legends, or embodying its defining traits—you gradually bring your Mystic into synchronization with that conceptual identity.

Once synchronization is achieved, your Halo can temporarily align your Mystic with that archetype, allowing you to develop new Mystic applications reflecting it. Synchronizing with a warrior archetype may grant overwhelming martial instincts and weapon-based Mystic techniques; aligning with a prophet or sage may develop foresight, intuition, or information-based abilities; embodying a figure like the Buddha might produce calming fields, spiritual resilience, or abilities centered on enlightenment and inner balance.

Your enhanced Halo functions as a stabilizing element during these alignments. Rather than replacing your original Mystic, it layers additional archetypes onto it, allowing you to experiment with multiple conceptual expressions without destabilizing into Terror. These archetypal synchronizations deepen over time through continued embodiment, gradually refining the abilities they grant and allowing your Mystic to adapt them more naturally into your overall power set.
addons.title: Archetype Resonance

objects.text: You awaken the ability to harness your Mystic, drawn from your Sublime—the conceptual essence that defines your existence beyond mere body or mind. Where your Halo previously served as a source of durability and strength, it now becomes an active interface between your physical self and the deeper archetype that underlies who you are. In simpler terms, your Halo no longer simply protects you; it begins expressing the underlying concept that you embody, spanning anything from divine beings to mathematical equations. Your Mystic allows you to develop personalized manifestations beyond just generic enhancements. This may take a variety of forms ranging from subtle supernatural effects or techniques to conceptual abilities tied to your identity—such as manipulating forces like gravity, possessing prophetic intuition, extraordinary luck, or other thematic abilities reflecting your archetype; for example a Mystic of e=mc^2 allowing for energy-matter transmutation. These manifestations start small and instinctive but can grow stronger and more refined and controlled with practice, experience, and understanding of your own nature. Despite this awakening, your Mystic remains stable and regulated through your Halo. Rather than your connection to your Sublime running rampant and unleashing an uncontrollable state of Terror, your Halo acts as a limiter and stabilizer, allowing your deeper essence to manifest safely in the physical world. The more you understand yourself and the concept your Sublime represents, the more your Mystic can develop into unique and powerful abilities without destabilizing your existence.
objects.title: Applied Mystics (Blue Archive)

objects.text:
Through a deeper understanding of your own nature, you learn to consciously touch the other side of your existence. By deliberately destabilizing the balance between your Mystic and the deeper conceptual identity beneath it, you can temporarily invoke a controlled Terror—an inversion of your usual state where the conceptual aspect of your Sublime becomes dominant over your physical self.

During this state your Halo fractures or distorts in appearance, reflecting the shift in your nature. Your abilities become far more potent and abstract, with your Mystic expressing itself closer to its archetypal origin rather than its restrained physical manifestation. Powers tied to your concept may become broader, more symbolic, or less bound by conventional limitations, as your existence briefly approaches its true form.

Unlike natural Terror transformations, your Halo and Sublime maintain a stabilizing framework that prevents total loss of control. The transformation is temporary and taxing, lasting only a short period before your Halo forces your nature back into balance. However, repeated use and deeper self-understanding can extend the duration and precision of this inverted state, allowing you to safely wield the destructive and transcendent potential normally associated with Terror without losing yourself to it.
objects.title: Inverted Sublime (Blue Archive)

objects.text: Beyond consumption, you can take Trophies from your kills. These trophies give you supernatural benefits but unfortunately, only one can come from any one kill, as there's no point displaying more than one trophy from one enemy. For instance, a Breastbone displayed prominently might take a fatal hit for you but break in the process, or a skullcap increasing your intelligence, while a claw could make your unarmed strikes incredibly lethal. Much like Consumer, you have to have killed the entity yourself in order to gain benefits from the trophy, and the potency of their strength scales with the power of the being they were harvested from.
objects.title: Collector

objects.text:
Your body, circuits, and spiritual essence of The Saint have coalesced with the Hercules Method. You have inherited the nature of Adam Kadmon as The Primordial Idea of Man, a being made in the image of God, who has no participation in any corruptible or earthlike essence.

As the Heavenly Man, the perfect image of the "Logos," is neither man nor woman but an incorporeal, ineffable intelligence, purely an idea, who existed before the First Day of Creation, you have inherited qualities that are usually exclusive to God.

In contrast to earthly man, you are completely made of divine light, maintaining an eternal existence through God's Light. You are capable of assuming any human form at will, but often assume a default androgynous appearance that makes it impossible to tell. As your existence predates the Fall of Babel, you are capable of communicating with any being, regardless of their language—be it animals, humans, or angels.

As you do not belong to this world, as a being whose existence is a platonic ideal, any damage done to you would only show the divine light that makes up your form underneath. Any conceptual influence that would seek to change your form will be immediately purified and restored without error, as it is not part of God's idea of Man.

Your "Method of Regression" has been completed and achieved its pinnacle, granting all its perks and making it so that anything born from a mind or body resembling humanity's will be under your control and rendered useless against you, be it technology, weapons, special abilities, traits, or much more.

With your magic circuits matching perfectly the Ten Sephiroth, you are able to handle an unlimited capacity of energy. This allows you to channel the power of the Son of God endlessly and gives you the strength to defeat multiple chief pagan gods with ease. You lose your vulnerability to the weapons and attacks that harmed the Son of God.

You are naturally beloved and respected by all of God's creation. Should you have any divine or light-related powers, they might be elevated in utterly incomprehensible ways, and your affinity and potential with them will be second only to the Almighty.
objects.title: Adam Kadmon

objects.text:
Like the Shrike himself, you are now a towering 3-meter-tall, four-armed monster composed of blades and spikes sharper than a monofilament wire, although, if need be, you can freely change your shape to be indistinguishable from a normal human. Your durability is such that, even while not phase-shifted, only extreme esoteric attacks that heavily deal in time and space can somewhat scratch you; you can easily move and react at relativistic speed, and your strength is enough to tear apart cyborgs like Rhadamanth Nemes and spaceship hulls as if they were made from wet paper. Your senses and mind are also amplified to a ridiculous degree, as you can scan everything within the radius of hundreds of astronomical units and process all this information in mere moments.

Your ability to access the consciousness of others through the Void has been greatly expanded: you can now converse with people from the past, present, and future, which can cause various changes in the timeline due to your influence, instantaneously search through a multitude of minds in the Void for necessary information, and even invade the dreams of others. Although you are still not capable of direct mind control.

Your Freecasting ability evolved into True Farcasting, granting you near-complete lordship over spacetime itself. You no longer need any anchors, and in addition to any point in space, you can now farcast to the past, future, alternate timelines, and parallel universes with ease.

Your ability to emit anti-entropic and hyper-entropic fields allows you to send whole areas into the past or the future, as well as control such things as age, granting some immortality or cursing someone with Merlin's sickness, which will make them age backwards until they are erased from existence. With a wave of your hand, you can send people or whole starships to the other side of the universe, to the beginning of time, or to the heat death of the universe and beyond.

No longer limited to speeding up your own time, you now have the power to move through it unrestricted: move forward, backward, completely stop it, or even loop it to summon billions of temporal clones to your side. When moving in fast-time even others capable of phase-shifting will appear completely frozen, and your attacks while phase-shifted will tear through other space-time effects without encountering any resistance.

Lastly, rudimentary technopathic abilities inherited from the Noble Guard cyborgs have been greatly amplified to the level where you can freely control any and all technology after establishing physical contact. Or even remotely in case the device in question is connected to the Void Which Binds.
objects.title: Angel of Final Atonement (Hyperion Cantos)

objects.text:
You can now encase yourself in a crystalline shell whenever you go into hibernation. The process is almost instantaneous, albeit it will take a few minutes for the shell to dissolve. You can regain awareness and go back to sleep without having to dissolve your crystal armour.

The shell is completely and totally indestructible and impervious to all outside influence regardless of the magnitude or complexity.
objects.title: Crystal Shell

objects.text:
Instead of completely encasing yourself within a crystal, you can now, at will, transmute the flesh of your body into an organic-crystallyne pseudo-flesh. When transformed, you retain the absolute invincibility of the shell, being impervious to any and all outside influence, regardless of complexity or magnitude.

Additionally, in this form you do not age, never tire, and have no need for sustenance of any kind. Do note, however, that your new form does not give you any supernatural strength, so you can be restrained the same as a regular human.
objects.title: Crystal Flesh

objects.text:
You have been granted the great, terrible, and mysterious power that is the source of all the suffering within the setting of Attack on Titan.

The first benefit is that your regeneration has been massively enhanced, to the point that if your body isn’t completely destroyed instantly, you can regenerate.

Next, you have the ability to enter a spiritual plane of existence that is entirely your domain, and within its empty and sandy expanse, you are god. You can change the flow of time within the expanse, making it so that one second outside of it is over a billion years inside. If you were ever to take someone into this plane, usually by making them a 'part' of you through feeding them some of your biological makeup, their souls would become yours in both life and death.

You are also able to manipulate the surroundings to craft anything you desire, from models of buildings to monstrous beings of biology with supernatural abilities. Through crafting these things within this plane of existence, called the Paths, you may force those things into reality. 

However, there are a few restrictions.

The first restriction is that any creature you want to make real has to come from your biology in some way, whether that be cutting off a hand and forcing the severed limb to mutate, or by forcing some part of yourself into another living thing and forcing that entity to mutate and become an effective extension of yourself.

The second restriction is that you can't directly change non-biological matter, and connected to this, you cannot generate any non-biological matter that is not a titan's hardening. While you can still create the famous crystal hardening growths that normal Titans are capable of, and you can further change the properties of these crystals, you cannot create any other non-organic matter.

Besides these restrictions however, you are practically a divinity of life itself, able to create untold wonders and horrors beyond the average mortal's comprehension.
objects.title: Source of All Living Matter (Attack on Titan)

objects.text:
The human body is only so big, even for worms as small as they are, so eventually it would become inevitable that the worms would get to a point where they would evolve and create a civilisation so vast that there would be nowhere left in your body to make more places for their culture or use too much of your body's resources when making their own civilisation. However, that is no longer a problem for you or the worms, as your body has seemingly gotten to the point where it is like there is a miniature universe inside of you for your worms to evolve into; the gut where they currently reside is relegated to simply being a singular planet in that universe, their own version of Earth.

Now their civilisation could quite literally become a space-faring race without ever leaving your own body or needing to worry about using too much of your body's resources. Furthermore this also boosts the rate at which the worms inside your body advance in technology with each new progress in their technological civilisation being a leap forward into realms that could go beyond what humanity is currently capable of and boosting your body even further blending their technology with your body to the point where it becomes a miniature ecosystem of various planets creating a miniature civilisation by the worms boosting the effects of your whole body vastly more than before.

Additionally, should you have any Technology and Artifice Powers, the worms would be able to use the technology that you know how to make in their own hyper-evolving civilisation because they are connected to your brain and can use this technology you have, further enhancing your body and abilities.
objects.title: Parasite Empire

objects.text: Your heart has awakened to its true potential. The Elixir of Life which once flowed through your veins has evolved into the primordial Essence of Life, transforming you into the Embodiment of Life itself, the source of all living beings in creation. Your immortality has become absolute. No method can ever make harm done to you stick, for you are Life Itself. Nothing can slow or prevent your regeneration, not even conceptual damage. However, This does not make you invulnerable. You can still be hurt, and you can still be sealed away. You have absolute authority over the dominion of life, able to effortlessly shape the biology of yourself and others to your whims and create new life from nothing. Living beings will instinctually defer to your orders, seeing you as a beloved parent. In your presence, life flourishes. Barren landscapes become flourishing ecosystems, and creatures afflicted with ailments of any kind are cured and brought to the peak of health. You can pluck spirits from the afterlife and grant them new life, regardless of the consent of any gods of the dead. Your heart has condensed into a limitless wellspring of lifeforce which can act as the power source for any supernatural power you may have. Weak Mana and Chi can be substituted for the Essence of Life, magnifying the power of your abilities a thousand times over. Finally, you may imbue those you deem worthy with the Essence of Life, granting them the effects of Fons Vitae.
objects.title: Genesis

objects.text: So being quintsected wasn't enough for you? For each selection of this, you will be split into one additional being, with all that entails.
objects.title: Additional Minds

objects.text:
You are not just any human android, your build is based on Chitti, a military robot built by the renowned Dr Vaseegaran. Unlike how he was in the movie however, you are free to look however you please instead of looking like a copy of your scientist creator.

You possess similar strength, speed and durability as a Terminator, but with a few more extra skills to add to your arsenal. In particular, you have electromagnetism which allows for fine control over anything metallic, technopathy with a brain capable of connecting to the internet, self duplication through a factory you have access to, and finally, the ability to make complex constructs with your copies, connecting with your duplicates to form weaponized balls or other mechanical monstrosities for creative use in combat.

Your main weakness however is a susceptibility to flashing lights, causing your vision to bleach for a moment. Your battery life isn't the best either, though you only need to absorb the bare minimum electricity to recharge in a matter of seconds. Finally, while you are durable, particularly focused attacks like getting hacked by an axe could dismantle you, so do make sure to favor dodging over tanking with this build.
objects.title: Chippi (Enthiran)

addons.text:
Your will becomes so potent that if you are utterly defeated, or seemingly killed, you still arise. No, not just that, you become reborn, recharged, and regenerated back to peak condition in a spectacle that stunts all for words. In this state, you become empowered to directly match your opponent in all aspects, even if they outclassed you before.

This boost only lasts for as long as the fight continues, and leaves when your objective is fulfilled, making you suffer the side effects as normal. This cannot happen again until you are fully well rested.
addons.title: Revival Unit

addons.text:
In the heat of the moment, when your back is against the wall, or are very desperate, the well of power within you boils, then erupts into a transformation. 

This can mean getting your Potential Unleashed, going Super Saiyan (or an equivalent), or even fusion if you have a partner. (You can choose any fusion method, ignoring its rules).

This form propels all aspects of yourself to match or slightly surpass your opposition, with all health, energy, and stamina refreshed to continue fighting, and fades once the battle is over.

You cannot gain permanent transformations from this power.
addons.title: Transforming Unit

addons.text: "You Foooooool!" Your natural talent at fighting allows you to see "windows" of opportunity during your battles. Acting on them allows you to counter your opponents with flawless precision, manifesting as surprise attacks, acting faster, overpowering their attacks in a single blow, gaining distance, etc. This doesn't make every counter guaranteed, as you must still act "correctly". Choosing to contest an attack clearly stronger than yours would be the wrong answer compared to attempting to deflect it.
addons.title: Counter!

objects.text: Losing fights in Dragon Ball is very, very painful, but that’s what makes the victories so rewarding. Let’s be honest though, you’re not willing to go through that unless you have a few screws loose. So to make this easier, you gain the mechanics of a Dragon Ball Legends and FighterZ character. This is only some of them, you’re not abusing people in the corner or farming Rising Rushes. You can perform one or more of your Ki Techniques like any beam, or sequence of physical attacks near instantly, at the cost of equivalent Ki, spending more can make it charge or act faster. You must do it in a cool way though, not like that’s a real requirement. By remaining stationary and doing a pose, stunt, catchphrase, or even block your opponent in a cool way, you perform a Special Arts move. You’ll know you’ve done it when time freezes for a few seconds, feel a surge of energy, and hear a sound effect. Special Arts can buff you by making you stronger, more durable, resistant to esoteric effects, gain distance, hamper your opponent, counter, and more. If you’re brave enough, this can chain with your Ki Techniques to guarantee some damage. Once per fight, you can perform an Ultimate Arts that either flies straight to your opponent, or hits them with a beam. You better lock in if successful, because that’s your window to either deal massive damage or end the fight right there in a grand spectacle, worthy to be preserved in cinema history.
objects.title: Dramatic Finish! (Dragon Ball Series)

objects.text:
Instead of being a half-blooded Saiyan hybrid, you are a pure-blooded Saiyan with your potential being lower compared to a hybrid but being on par with an elite-class Saiyan like Nappa. 

Your Saiyan traits are more prominent than a hybrid. 

Your instincts are more primal such as having a nose comparable to a dog's and a powerful sense of touch that alerts you to vibrations in the ground and shifts in the air. 

Like any Saiyan, you have an inborn desire to fight and will find it hard not to fight strong opponents unless you possess a strong will to resist. 

You have a much longer life span than an earthling and even as you get older you will stay in peak physical performance, health, and appearance. 

Lastly, you can design how your hair looks but it must be colored black unless you have power that can change it.
objects.title: Pure-Blooded Saiyan (Dragon Ball Series)

objects.text: Whether it be a genetic mutation, a 1000th-year prophecy, or both; you’re a one-of-a-kind Saiyan: The Legendary Super Saiyan—you are a Saiyan of exceptional potential and might. Your potential manifests in leaps and bounds, notably tied to your emotional state (e.g. anger or any kind of extreme emotion like rage or sorrow, most of the time), which causes it to fluctuate wildly. Your talent for battle and your Saiyan instincts results in a prodigious learning curve, adaptively overcoming opposition and obstacles as you fight. This implies an ease of gaining Zenkais from any hurdle and injury you overcome in the heat of battle, growing in raw power at an accelerated rate. Stoking the flames of your potential and talent for combat with training will give a fivefold boost to your growth rate. This power displays several highlights, too: you’re instinctively attuned to your Oozaru, or feral side, the angrier you get, slipping into the Ikari form. It is characteristically hard to control without training or emotional control. The Ikari or Wrathful form simply uses the Oozaru’s power in your base form, causing intense pain due to the outpouring of energy and the feeling that your body is too small for the Oozaru’s power. It delivers up to tenfold your base; your natural affinity for Ki loses any restrictions as you generate it in exceedingly huge quantities to the point that releasing it will lessen the strain it has on your body, from every bodily part; your SSJ transformations gain a fivefold boost, instead of a twofold boost on normal forms (SSJ1 being x100 instead of the usual x50 for normal Saiyans), fully tapping into it with your Full Power transformation (SSJ1FP being x250 as opposed to the usual x50 for normal Saiyans). Unfortunately, you are plagued by a feral and brutal side. Knowing that your power is tied to your emotions, you sink into a berserker-like rage whenever you exert or stress yourself. Your transformations, more so, leaves you under a haze of a feral beast with very little rationality. You require training, anchors, and strides in emotional control to conquer this power. But once you do, you truly become Legendary.
objects.title: Legendary Super Saiyan (Dragon Ball Series)
Power… Overflowing!!
objects.text: You know, the Hulk shares a lot in common with Broly, more so in later incarnations, most notably the power they gain through Rage. By sharing the same core mechanic, your Gamma-infused physiology causes further deviation from your mutated Saiyan genetics, where intense emotions are metabolized into gamma-mutated Zenkais. Your issues with your out-of-control Ki reserves straining the body are indirectly addressed by your Gamma Mutation converting excess Ki into raw mass and physicality, raising your Ki reserves’ ceiling by forcing your body through an abnormal Zenkai. A feedback loop where the angrier you get, the more your Ki spikes, and the more Ki spikes, the more Gamma cells force your body to mutate and acclimatize to your new baseline, while growing larger and constantly secreting adrenaline through this process, feeding back into the rage. Unfortunately, unless you find further reasons to stay mad, this bonus is only temporary, a bonus that you slowly come down if you hit your plateau or calm yourself. However, after coming down, you permanently keep 25% of the gains from this process. And that’s only on your Base form or any of your SSJ transformations, which, in this case, adds another twofold boost to each. The real meat comes with Gamma’s spiritual roots: your Alter Ego. The feral and brutal parts take the role of your Alter Ego, with their personality depending on your deepest issues and relationship with brutality and violence, becoming a bloodthirsty psychotic warrior like Z Broly or just a near-mindless wild lashing out at the world like Super Broly, that can be tapped into—more so-called—by sinking yourself into the Ikari form. Your Ikari form subsumes your Gamma transformation, while gaining relative control how this transformation takes form—from usual markings of Ikari, at first to a more brutish form and radioactive veins protruding out of the body the more you let yourself go—fully tapping into the Oozaru’s power and completing your transformation, it’ll torturously contort your body until you become a radioactive greenish black sasquatch, with dense, leathery hide and fuzzy forest green coat of hair compressed into an agile, muscle-bound Wrathful Hulk form. Under this transformation, your powers are heightened at x25 your base, and your Gamma-Zenkai feedback loop unleashes greater mutations depending on the conflict you experience and have difficulty with, e.g., gaining the ability to breathe underwater when facing an aquatic opponent, etc. Your Ki is changed by Gamma, able to weaponize it. By blasting Ki in an entire city, you may spontaneously trigger a nuclear explosion, poison the area, leaving a toxic, irradiated wasteland that drains the life of anyone nearby to feed your body. However, control is crucial to fully take advantage of these abilities, as you require focus and caution: recklessness may lead to a meltdown, your body collapsing under the sheer amount of Ki unless you pace yourself and let your body mutated and be used to your reserves, and dealing with a wrathful voice in your head urging to do things you’d rather do without, and the rage that lies within.

addons.title: Tempered Wrath
addons.text: Avid control over one’s Gamma transformation changes your relationship with your Alter Ego, softening and tempering their hard edges, comparable to Joe Fixit in terms of the lengths you can bargain with your other self. In turn, they’ll be more open to your long-term goals and desires, or even integrate back into your larger Self, resulting in a more humanized Wrathful Hulk form. While relatively aware of your actions, you’ll experience the haze of rage, albeit a calm, cold wrath favorable to strategic thinking and better channeling and mastery of your abilities.

addons.title: Walking Calamity
addons.text: Fully controlling your Gamma energies amplifies the density and potency of your Ki, elevating its dangerous traits to lethal proportions, taking aspects of Gamma’s destructive and mutative roots to the One Below comparable to the Hakaishin in potential.

addons.title: Breaker-Apart
addons.text: The heights of power you attain by fueling your rage are now unfettered, removing your body’s maximum with your wrathful feedback loop, where you’re constantly adapting and mutating at an overwhelming pace. The same holds with your connection to the One Below, where every time you come back, it exploits your immortality by instantly resurrecting yourself with a permanent Gamma-fueled Zenkai in case an enemy is powerful enough to defeat you.

Whatever method you used to break the limits of mortals to obtain God Ki has filled you to the brim with ki. Your fur takes on a more magenta coloration and your hair becomes more crimson as your God Ki flows through you. Your aura takes on a purple-flowing appearance with a skin-tight white aura that remains with or without your primary aura.

You power in this form explodes further, granting you the power to fight with even more of the most powerful warriors in the universe. This form causes you to transcend past the limits of your previous form. Entering this form is capable of completely restoring you to full power should you have been on the losing side before.
addons.title: Limit Breaker

addons.text:
In each universe, there is a being in charge of keeping the balance of life and death. This being is known as a God of Destruction, a creature of almost unlimited power that destroys entire worlds that have run their course or disturbed the balance, working in tandem with the Supreme Kai to create and destroy as needed. You have become a God of Destruction, a being that is only outmatched by the Angels and a scant few mortals of terrifying might. Your Destruction ability has been increased matching that of Beerus, allowing you to direct your ki to destroy things with a touch, obliterating even ghosts or souls that draw your ire. You can use it without being focused on destruction and nothing else.

You also gain access to a perfected and mastered version of Ultra Ego, which not only grants the power increase from damage of the Ultra Ego State but without the heightened battle lust if you choose to, this also makes you exponentially more powerful than before and allows your power to progress faster without instinct as your fighting spirit increases.

Optionally, you may receive an Angel companion of your own design. They will both serve you and help train you. They are irrevocably loyal to you and come with an Angel Attendant's Staff. While being immune to any rules an Angel has to follow, they will guide you in learning the martial arts and in how to maintain a universe's health, as well as almost any other subject you care to take an interest in.

Last but not least, you now gain access to an entire universe along with it's own Supreme Kai for you to maintain over.
addons.title: Hakaishin

objects.text: "You know, it's funny. When I'm at this power level, it's hard for me to listen to reason. You see, I just lose control!" You have pushed your limits beyond: attaining the form of a Golden Great Ape while retaining your humanity in control. Everything that is the Great Ape form has been condensed within you, causing your power to explode into a new tier. Your power is the stuff of legends and is great enough to fast track you to the status of God of Destruction, should you wish to go that route. Taking this form adorns your body in a crimson fur and matching lining around your eyes; should you not be in your prime body, your body will transform in to the prime of your adult body while maintaining this power. The mastery over your ki has smoothed it to the point of lacking any electrical discharges in your golden aura. This form takes you to the edge of your limits, in every regard. You can easily be considered thousands of times more powerful than your base form and can supercharge any of your signature abilities by several orders of magnitudes. You have the ability to absorb the energy of your opponent's attacks to strength your own, and an ability to adapt to your opponent's attacks in real time. Most attacks will only be capable of harming or affecting you once or twice before this form naturally adapts your defenses to leave you unaffected. Enter this form perfects everything about you for the purpose of defeating your opponent, whether that boosts your battle IQ, numbs your rationality, or simply banishes your mental blocks to violence. This perfection means that it will take negligible amounts of ki to remain in this form, and you will never have to wory about stamina issues.
objects.title: Super Saiyan 4 (Dragon Ball Series)

objects.text:
The Majin genes have now been infused into your extensive cellular genetic makeup, with it gaining a new transformation, granting you access to a Majin form at will. This Majin from gives you the physical properties and abilities characteristic of the Majin race, including their unique rubber-like physiology and much more.

Your new Majin heritage also complements your existing genetic legacy. You retain all the abilities inherited from your genetic pool gained through Cell, the Frost Demon race, the Saiyans, and more. 

You have the freedom to choose the appearance of your normal base form, but your Majin transformation must have some physical characteristics shared by the Majin race (pink skin, tail,,,etc).
objects.title: 21 (Dragon Ball Series)

objects.text:
You have ascended to the form and existence of an Alicorn after performing a great feat of friendship and magic. As an Alicorn you gain the abilities of all three Equestrian tribes greatly amplified.  However, as an Alicorn your very Cutie Mark will evolve. Gaining a connection and domain over a powerful aspect of existence such as The Heavenly bodies, Emotions, or even Magic in its entirety. You can draw power from this and use it for powerful spells far beyond any mortal Equestrian could muster. Your mana pool is also vastly expanded and may grow even further through mastering your domain, along with training and over time. Alicorns are ageless and possess a moderate healing factor. 

Note that you will not need to worry about losing your connection to your domain should you travel outside your starting setting or suffer any conflicts with your domains in other worlds you visit.
objects.title: Alicorn (My Little Pony: Friendship is Magic)

objects.text: You gain every Alpha level or below power. This doesn't change your physical appearance unless you wish it to.
objects.title: Rogue (Marvel)

objects.text: Your X-Gene has experienced a unique phenomenon known as a secondary mutation. Instead of possessing a single mutant power, you now have an additional mutant ability. With only the Base Homo Superior power, your secondary mutation is limited to Alpha level. However, if you have an upgrade that elevates your mutations to Omega level, your additional mutant power will be proportionate to your original mutation.
objects.title: Secondary Mutation (Marvel)

addons.text:
You’ve been ennobled with a great Fate. The circumstances of your existence have led to an event where you’ll be entrusted with a role in the next iteration of the Universe, inheriting from a previous being. Meanwhile, you’ve gained a power comparable to Beyond Omega-Level Mutants such as Franklin Richards, Nathaniel Grey, or Matthew Malloy and/or the abilities of Galactus and Moridun in terms of the Power Cosmic once you take up the mantle and merge with the Sentience of the Cosmos (or an equivalent in any place you end up in).

At first, a spark or drop of this power will be available to you, and with time it’ll trickle and be stocked the closer you are to the destined end of the Universe.
addons.title: Anointed Prince(ss)

addons.text: You are now a being infused with a Cosmic Cube's essence, similar to Owen Reece or the child Beyonder. Like Owen Reece, you are still required to understand what you want and what you're doing to achieve a desired result.
addons.title: I Come From Beyond!

addons.text:
To be a mutant is to endure an existence defined by unending struggle—a ceaseless war between what you are and what the world demands you to be. Now, you are that struggle incarnate. The full force of Onslaught—an entity wrought from the fractured psyches of Charles Xavier and Magneto—surges within you. You are not merely a vessel for their darkness; you are its evolution, its perfected fury.

Within you burns the raw, searing power of telepathy and telekinesis, capable of reshaping minds and warping reality with thought alone. Magneto’s command of the electromagnetic spectrum now answers to your will; metal twists, lightning dances, and magnetic storms rise at your command. Yet, your might is not bound to the mind or field alone—your body too is a weapon of devastation. Your strength rivals the Juggernaut, your durability challenges the Hulk; titans fall before your wrath.

But it is your connection to the Immaterium—the shifting chaos of the Astral Plane—that truly elevates you. Like the original Onslaught, you can manipulate matter and energy with terrifying precision, forging new forms from thought, unraveling the world at its seams. And more than that, you consume. With every being you overpower, you absorb their essence—their powers, their knowledge, their very identity. Where Onslaught was bound to the blood of mutants, you transcend such limits. Any soul you conquer becomes part of your growing dominion.

You are no longer just a mutant. You are the storm that breaks the cycle—the herald of a new order, or the end of all things.
addons.title: Omega Level Daemon

objects.text: You may have the Omega level ability of your choice, except for Franklin Richards & Nate Grey.
objects.title: Omega-Level Mutant (Marvel)

addons.text:
With mastery of the biological, the magical, the posthuman,  of earth and beyond, you've begun to take your first steps into being a Dominion. A great interstellar intelligence unrivaled in strength and aptitude. To many, it can be considered borderline omnipotent. Once you achieve this rank, you will exist outside of time and space, and will always have existed beyond it. 

It may take years, decades, centuries or millennia, but with such a depth and breadth of knowledge at your hands, such a pace will be a small price to pay. Your biomechanical ascension will not be stayed, reaching evolutionary infinity and technological omnipotence. When you achieve it, it will be your crown and scepter. Walk the path you know, realise your potential, and seize infinity.
addons.title: A Suit of Sinisters

addons.text: Your technological and intellectual mutant acumen has transcended the boundaries of what’s possible, gaining access to the scientific and applied understanding from Marvel Multiverse in your efforts to amass the entirety of theoretical knowledge necessary to accomplish your transformation into a Dominion, but a mystical missing piece leaves you naught with a Titan’s equivalent of possible knowledge. If it’s any consolation, your knowledge encompasses the comprehensive archive of cutting-edge inventions and projects from both terrestrial and galactic civilizations existing across the Marvel Multiverse, including iterations of similar projects to comparatively improve or culminate them. From the prospect of technological endeavors bordering on fantastical in the case of Kang’s temporal technology, and scientific potential from the likes of the Kree, the Shi’ar, Galactus, The Stranger, High Evolutionary, the Technarchy/Phalanx, the Entity on the Moon’s Nubotechnology, the Celestials, etc. This might be enough to halve the process of your metamorphosis into a Dominion by a great amount if you so wish to complete your final magical journey.
addons.title: Astonishing Tech: Three Aces of a Kind

objects.text:
You aren't satisfied with being a mere mutant, you find it far too limited for your ambitions.

You have become capable of recreating any technology prominently featured or implied to be available in the X-Men series and its spinoffs (X-Force, X-Factor, New Mutants, Excalibur, Marauders, etc.), but this is only the start of your power. You are now an unparalleled genius with regards to biology and other related fields, particularly genetics. You are even capable of altering the X-Gene itself, allowing you to research and give yourself or others Mutant powers.

Mutation is a blank canvas to you, and you its finest artist. If you wish for more Omega level powers, build them. If you wish to advance mankind into a new species, do so. If you wanted to build Sentinels, you could. Your potential is unlimited, but it is up to you to seize it.
objects.title: Mister Sinister (Marvel)

objects.text:
You have now acquired an additional similar mutant power to Legion, an Omega-level mutant with the power to induce spontaneous mutations within himself and so manifest new mutant powers.

Your version of this Omega-level ability is far more controlled than Legion's as you can gain powers as you wish. The caveat of this is that the stronger and more specific the power desired, the longer the time needed to manifest it. A completely random low-level mutant power would take under an hour, while a specific Omega-level ability could take multiple months to manifest. 

You lack the alternative personalities present within Legion, but the process of generating powers is noticeably mentally taxing; if you carelessly produce dozens of random low-level mutations or formidable detailed powers without taking your time to acclimatise to them, this can lead to symptoms such as hallucinations, psychosis or worse.

Your powers cannot exceed Omega-level in strength, but otherwise, there are almost no limits to the powers you can acquire. No power you manifest will negatively affect your existence or possess significant drawbacks.
objects.title: Legion (Marvel)

objects.text:
Your Mutant body has been integrated with Celestial technology, giving you the abilities of En Sabah Nur, better known as Apocalypse.

You can control your own body on the atomic level, being able to evolve, adapt, & overcome anything life throws at you. You cannot be permanently killed, as you are an External, and will simply resurrect. You can rapidly heal from anything that fails to instantly kill you, you can morph your body to change size in whatever way is convenient to you on the fly, from size to shape, you have the physical ability to tussle with Asgardians & Gamma Mutants, you have psychic power that can best Jean Grey, and many many more abilities I can't adequately list here. Suffice to say, with your perfect self-alteration, incredible genius for evolution & mutation, & Celestial technology, anything you cannot do is simply something you need to spend a little more time evolving towards.
objects.title: And Behold, A White Horse (Marvel)

objects.text:
Your mutant powers surpass even those of Omega-Level Mutants—one could say you are beyond them.

You may possess a Beyond Omega mutant ability of your choice, whether it be an original power, an elevated version of an existing mutant ability, or the power of a known Beyond Omega mutant such as Franklin Richards, Nate Grey, Vulcan, or Matthew Malloy.
objects.title: Beyond Omega (Marvel)

objects.text:
You are no natural mutant, but an engineered animal-mutant-hybrid designed to hunt and kill them with multitudes of stolen mutations. 

As Predator X, you’re specially designed to hunt mutants, to this end you can sense the X-Gene and similar genetic factors over thousands of miles. Similarly, when touching blood, a psychic connection forms between you and your prey, allowing you to both see flashes of their memories  and more precisely track them.

To aid in hunting, your muscles are designed to make you faster, stronger and less tiring. Similarly, you heal rapidly from injuries, though this can still be overwhelmed. The most notable aspect of your form however is your liquid-metal skin shielding you from most attacks unless they’re delivered directly past this shield, though even that is dangerous due to your acidic blood.

The most dangerous aspect of any Predator X however is their ability to steal any of the genetic attributes of their prey upon consumption, including the powers they were tacked with. By consuming enough prey you could become a truly unstoppable juggernaut.
objects.title: Predator X (Marvel)

addons.text: You have been given the powers and blood of Marvel 616-Thor, awakening his Domains of Storms, Strength, War, and so on... But this also changes your blood from just a Royal Asgardian to an Elder God Hybrid, as Thor is the child of the Elder Goddess Gaea, giving you the potential to perform feats surpassing all other Gods - for you are not a mere God, but Elder. As a child of Gaea, this allows your very blood to bring life to the Earth, and draw strength from it while in its Domain. Optionally, you may gain memories of Thor and his other equipment, such as his Belt that Doubles his Strength, durability and power or his Axe Jarnbjorn, or any other item that he has collected over the years. If you so choose you can also call upon Thor's trusty Animal-God companions Toothgnasher and Toothgrinder
addons.title: The Power of Thor

addons.text: You have been given the powers and blood of Marvel 616-Loki, The Trickster god, awakening his domains of mischief, Evil, Lies, and so on. The Wizard of Lies: While you still keep your abilities as an Asgardian, you are no longer one; instead, you are half Frost Giant. This further increases your talent with magic so that you have less trouble producing spells with Magicbabble, the Mystic Arts, or just magic in general, with a peculiarly superior aptitude for spells that lie in Illusions, Enchantment, and ice manipulation. Optionally, you may gain memories of Loki and his other equipment, such as his scepter or any other item that he has collected over the years. If you so choose you can also call upon Loki's animal companions such as Fenrir or Jormungand.
addons.title: The Power of Loki

addons.text: You have the power of Thor (ᚦᛟᚾᚨᚱ), the berserker and god of Strength, Thunder, lightning, and other domains. You have the might to smash mountains and lift Jörmungandr, the world serpent, drink enough water to lower the water of the world by a substantial amount, and give a fair fight to the personification of age. However, you don't only gain the powers of the Thor known to the world through Norse Myth; you also gain the powers of every interpretation of Thor. Additionally, this does not only affect you, as both Mjolnir are affected, bringing them back to what Mjolnir should have originally been if not for Loki messing with the dwarfs in a bid to not get his head removed from his body. This changes Mjolnir so that it is three times as strong, as well as combining them into a war hammer. You can also transform them back into their separate forms to dual-wield, although this lowers the boost to only being two times as strong as normal.
addons.title: Thor (ᚦᛟᚾᚨᚱ)

objects.text: The Blood of Asgard's greatest Gods runs through you. You gain even greater physical attributes and the choice of a divine domain, like Wisdom, War, Thunder, Storm, and so on. Your potential becomes equal to the greatest in Asgardian history, such as Odin and Rune King Thor.
objects.title: Royal Blood (Marvel)

addons.text: You have been given the powers and blood of Marvel 616-Odin, The Skyfather, awakening his domains of Wisdom, Life, and so on. This further increases your connection to the Odin Force, allowing for a more refined use and control of it and increasing your strength to be equal to the Skyfather. Optionally, you may gain the memories of Odin and his other equipment, such as his scepter and sword, or any other item that he has collected over the years. If you so choose you can also call upon Odin's trusty Animal-God companions Hugin and Munin, Geri and Freki, and Sleipnir.
addons.title: The Power of Odin

addons.text: You now wield the full might of Odin, Norse God of Knowledge, Wisdom, Magic, Royalty, War, Death, among countless other titles. With the cunning to outmaneuver Gods, a prowess in battle that shines above all others, and the magical might to bring entire realms to heel. Whatever Odin could do, then it stands to reason that you can as well. However, this does not only encompass the Odin of Norse Myth. No, this Addon makes you into the embodiment of every interpretation of Odin. Not only that, but the two versions of Gungnir you wield have been fused together, creating something that is far greater than the sum of its parts. This new Gungnir holds the might of both components and boosts it to thrice their original power. As it is, this may very well be among the most potent magical foci to ever exist. If you wish to dual wield the spears you bought, then you may split the fused Gungnir back into its separate components, but the boost applied to both will only be twice as potent instead of thrice. Go forth and ride, King of the Aesir. Let all of creation know what you are. Let all know your name. “I am called Glad-of-War, Grim, Raider, and Third. I am One-Eyed, I am also called Highest and True-Guesser. I am Grimnir, and The Hooded One. I am Allfather, Gondlir Wand-Bearer! I have as many Names as there are Winds, as many Titles as there are Ways to Die! My Ravens, are Huginn and Muninn, Thought and Memory! My Wolves are Freki and Geri! My Horse is the Gallowed!” ”I AM… ODIN!”
addons.title: Odin (ᚢᚦᛁᚾ)

addons.text:
By attaining the Power Cosmic alongside the power of Thor after he ascended as the new All-Father of Asgard, you have permanently inherited one of Thor's most powerful states: the Herald of Thunder.

In this form, your power transcends all limits—immeasurable and incomprehensible—rising far beyond that of Skyfathers or even Elder Gods, placing you on par with the mightiest cosmic beings, such as Galactus and the Celestials.

You have not only mastered the Odinforce but also the Power Cosmic itself. Your strength is so great that you could effortlessly absorb and strip away the power of a fully empowered Galactus, as well as battle and defeat cosmic entities on the level of the Black Winter—the very being who once slew the sixth iteration of Eternity.

Hail to thee, Herald of Thunder. Hail to thee, Herald of None—for few now dare call themselves your equal. May you wield this newfound might for good, for should you choose otherwise, you would become a threat of multiversal proportions.
addons.title: Herald of Thunder

addons.text:
You now gain the powers of Rune King Thor, one of the most powerful versions of Thor in Marvel Comics. This form is achieved when Thor acquires the Odinforce and the knowledge of the Runes by sacrificing both eyes and hanging from Yggdrasil—though, luckily for you, no sacrifice is required unless you choose otherwise.

In this form, there are few beings stronger than you. You can fight and defeat—if not outright kill—Those Who Sit Above in Shadow. Rune magic is the ultimate form of magic, you can perceive the past, present, and future simultaneously, understand the quantum and cosmic architecture of reality, erase immensely powerful beings like Mangog from existence with a mere thought, and manipulate space, time, and matter at will.

You can communicate telepathically with anyone across the galaxy, teleport across vast distances, and even end the eternal cycle of Ragnarok by destroying the Tapestry of Fate and severing the Loom—a feat that had eluded all previous All-Fathers.
addons.title: The Rune King Thor (Marvel)

objects.text:
You have been given the Odin Force, the power of the Kings of Asgard since the time of Odin. It is only a shadow of itself at the moment, but will grow to the full force in time.

This power is near-infinite and seems to allow Odin, and later Thor, to become almost invincible, and seems to allow its wielders to rival the powers of the strongest beings in the universe. The limits of its power are unknown, but it adapts to its holder, enhancing all aspects of their power, from physical, to magical, to divine, allowing for just about anything, only limited by your power & imagination.

Beware of overuse, for if overused you will be forced to enter a deep sleep to recover from overreach - leaving you vulnerable in the process.
objects.title: The All-Father (Marvel)

objects.text:
Mistress Death has seen the Entities and their plans to escape her DEATH itself, so she has decided to intervene by adding a little bit extra to your conversion process into an Eternal, gifting you the complete legacy of the Mad Titan Thanos from Universe 616 without causing any changes you do not want to your mind & soul.

This legacy gives you the bionic amplification and mystical enhancement that Thanos did to himself, and Mistress Death did when she resurrected him as her Avatar. These enhancements have increased your strength beyond the original limits of even the strongest Eternals. You will be able to fight Worthy Thor, who is using the Power Gem, defeat the likes of the Silver Surfer, and physically subdue an Angry Hulk with ease. All of this can still be enhanced with cosmic energy when needed.

Your durability is now nigh-invulnerable, such that even a point-blank, planet-destroying hit from Power Gem-wielding Thor leaves only a bloody nose, or three full screams from Black Bolt, leaving no significant damage aside from damaging your clothes. While blasts from Odin and Galactus leave you wounded but coming back for more. You can survive the extreme environment of a 2-light-year-wide black hole and only be covered in light wounds.

Your energy projection abilities are now at the level where your blasts are capable of knocking down the likes of the Hulk and Thor, and are even able to graze Galactus's armor as well as blast someone of his level off his feet and send him across the moon.

Your mind is all but invulnerable to most forms of psychic attack, to the level of the Mind Gem in power. Even people as skilled as Moondragon or Mantis wouldn't be able to break your defenses. Your skill with the Mind is so great that you can mess with minds on the level of Reed Richards'. These powers, combined with Thanos's great charisma, have allowed him to turn even hated foes to his side temporarily. You also have access to his most dangerous technique, the Time-Mind Sync Warp, a move that plunges the victim's mind into a psychedelic dimension of insanity, causing death or incapacitation.

The greatest part of this legacy is Thanos's intelligence and knowledge, which makes Thanos one of the most dangerous beings in the Multiverse. Thanos is a genius in virtually all known fields of advanced science and has created technology far exceeding contemporary Earth science created by Tony Stark, Bruce Banner, and Reed Richards. Considering such people smart for a human but children to someone like him. As well as being one of the greatest fighters in the universe.

You can summon Thanos's Space Throne, a throne linked to you through techno-magic. It is capable of faster-than-light travel, teleportation, and dimension travel. The Throne was also capable of working as a focus for your power to generate powerful force fields and energy blasts.

As an Avatar of Death, you can bring Death to that which cannot Die, and with Thanos's skill with Magic and his and your status as an avatar of Death, your understanding of Death and Necromancy are raised to the highest possible.

Until you defeat the Entities, you are banned from Death itself, rendering you truly immortal. You can still die, but you will always return, no matter the severity of any injury.
objects.title: MAD TITAN (Marvel)

objects.text:
Your body has been further genetically manipulated by an entity named the Queen enhancing all of your baseline abilities and granting you a couple more. For instance your baseline strength now enables you to lift upwards of 15 tons.

You've also gained a psychic alignment with your environment, specifically a more empathic and sympathetic relationship with spiders and insects. You cannot communicate or command these insects, but you can sense and interact with the world through them.

Additionally, if you didn't have it before, you can now produce your own silk webbing from glands within your forearms, limited by your body's health and nutrition. It would take a heavy duty saw several hours to cut through them due to their supernatural tensile strength. You can innately choose the duration it would take for your webs to decay, from 10 minutes, to upwards of 1 week.
objects.title: Queen's Mutation (Marvel)

objects.text:
Your abilities have been intensified by becoming a receptacle for a spider-deity closely linked with your totemic nature and the Web of Life and Destiny, The Other. His purpose in the large scheme of things is mysterious, yet its boons are plenty. To name a few, your lifting strength goes to 20 tons, with the rest of your physicality similarly enhanced even further, able to react much quicker than before.

One of the few highlights of being an Other host is your enhancement to your Spider-sense, psychic alignment from your proximity to spiders and insects, and natural senses: a night vision to traverse in pitch-black environments; your psychic awareness expands as a result of improvements to your Spider-sense and arachnid connection, developing fine sensing of your surroundings allowing to roam without fear obstacle or opposition regardless of blindness or darkness plus distinguishing between threatening and non-threatening factors with your spider-sense; finally, your senses, your touch in particular, evolved an unnatural sensitivity, sensing air currents and vibrations around you and through your webbing being most effective.

The Other additionally broadens and evolves your mutations: from your empathic connection with spiders grows into full telepathic control, while starting to grow spider’s natural weaponry like fangs and stingers (being venomous if you so choose), to a monstrous transformation varying from a hybrid form to a Man-Spider-like creature in case of mortal danger or extreme rage.
objects.title: The Other's Evolution (Marvel)

addons.text:
Your doppelganger now acts as your own equivalent to the Sentry’s Void, being the dark reflection of yourself who will act as the counterforce to you, doing the opposite of whatever you do. This does potentially make them significantly more ruthless, as if you are a heroic individual who saves lives it will even kill people to undo your good, though if you are a cruel person it will instead be helpful to others. The Void simply does whatever you will not do, forcing a net neutral result to any of your actions. Though your Void can manifest separately from you, it is a manifestation of your own inner conflict and will exist as long as you do.

Fortunately, it is still possible to reconcile with your Void, even if it is incredibly difficult. If the two of you are able to make peace you can even merge together, becoming whole and combining your powers.
addons.title: The Void

objects.text:
Instead of receiving the Super-Soldier Serum, you gained your powers through the Golden Sentry Serum—a project designed to replicate the serum that created Captain America. This serum altered your molecular structure, rendering you partially out of sync with normal reality. It also triggered a photosynthetic reaction within your body, resulting in a hyperstate of consciousness. You now possess what has been described as the power of a million exploding suns, with abilities that appear to stem from reality-warping. Unlike Robert Reynolds, however, you are not burdened by the Void.

Your powers allow you to accomplish virtually anything you desire, making you one of the most powerful beings in the universe. Among your abilities are superhuman intelligence, biokinesis, subatomic matter manipulation, immortality, and a powerful healing factor that enables you to recover from nearly any injury—even the complete disintegration of your molecular structure.

You possess superhuman strength capable of rivaling a World Breaker Hulk, along with enhanced agility, reflexes, speed, and faster-than-light flight. You are nearly indestructible unless you will yourself to be harmed, allowing you to withstand direct nuclear blasts without injury. Additionally, you are completely self-sustaining, requiring no food, water, or oxygen.

Your abilities also include resurrection, allowing you to bring both yourself and others back from death. You are powerful enough to slay gods like Ares and battle cosmic entities such as Galactus. You can emit intense light and energy from your body and possess heightened senses that enable you to detect events and beings across entire continents.

You can teleport at will, absorb and manipulate any form of energy—including solar energy and energy from the Negative Zone—and even bestow your power upon others. You also possess psionic abilities and can manipulate darkness.
objects.title: Golden Sentry Serum (Marvel)

objects.text:
Your Osmosian abilities have evolved to emulate those of Carl “Crusher” Creel, the Absorbing Man.

You can now absorb not just solid matter, but also liquids, gases, and even energy. When you activate your power, your body undergoes a complete transformation, physically and physiologically becoming the substance you’re in contact with. Despite this change, you retain full awareness and sentience—even when your brain is composed of that same material.

You also have the ability to control your size and shape, depending on the properties of what you’ve absorbed. If your body is ever dispersed, you can easily reconstitute yourself. Beyond simple material transformation, you can absorb specific traits from what you touch. For example, by touching a balloon, you become lighter than air and can float. Contact with a magnet allows you to attract or repel metal. If you come into contact with a mystic object, such as Mjolnir, you can harness its magical properties—like commanding thunder and lightning. Objects that store or generate energy, like batteries or blast furnaces, allow you to absorb that energy to enhance your strength or release it as a weapon.

You can even absorb DNA without risking mental instability, though you’re still limited to accessing only one-tenth of the original being’s power. Unlike Creel, your absorption is completely under your control—you only take on properties when you choose to.
objects.title: Crusher Creel (Marvel)

objects.text:
Your genetics have been altered with the goal of maximizing your potential, much like Black Bolt, who was exposed to the Terrigen Mist while still an embryo. Regardless of the ability you choose—whether an original power or one drawn from an existing Inhuman—your genes have been tampered with to place you on par with some of the most powerful Inhumans, such as Black Bolt, Ahura Boltagon, and Ulysses Cain.

For example, Black Bolt’s greatest weapon was his voice, capable of leveling a city with a whisper, while a hypersonic shout could even affect cosmic beings such as Galactus. Your abilities are likewise not static and can grow stronger through use and practice.
objects.title: Genetic Override (Marvel)

objects.text:
You have become the Prime Eternal, the title given to the leader of Earth’s Eternals. As the Prime Eternal, you are capable of initiating the creation of the Uni-Mind, a collective life-form formed through the physical and mental merging of a significant number of Eternals, greatly amplifying the combined powers of those involved in the process. While a Prime Eternal is typically selected through an election held within a Uni-Mind—where the candidate who receives the most votes is chosen—your position as Prime Eternal cannot be revoked.

Your Eternal abilities have also been massively enhanced, elevating you to the level of the strongest Eternals, such as Zuras. At baseline, your physical capabilities vastly surpass those of an average Eternal, and like Zuras, you are more powerful and accomplished in a chosen Eternal discipline than any other Eternal. Whether this discipline is physical augmentation, shapeshifting, matter manipulation, or telepathy, your mastery would place you far beyond specialists such as Gilgamesh, Makkari, or Sersi—so much so that, were your specialization cosmic energy manipulation, you could even contend with a Skyfather like Zeus.
objects.title: Prime Eternal (Marvel)

objects.text:
Your heat vision has evolved into a more sophisticated form of solar manipulation, becoming more potent and versatile than ever before. You can now manipulate solar energy from any part of your body, enabling you to produce various types of blasts and beams. Furthermore, you have gained unparalleled control over their trajectory, as they can bend, curve, and rotate at any angle you desire.

Additionally, your body has become more efficient in its use of solar energy, providing you with greater power and potency for less energy while significantly reducing strain. This efficiency allows you to use more strenuous abilities for extended periods without experiencing any adverse side effects.
objects.title: Solar Flare (DC Comics)

objects.text:
Sent away from a doomed planet by loving parents Jor-El and Lara to Earth, it was predicted that Kal-El would gain extraordinary powers based on the power of Earth’s sun. However, it is unclear if in that moment, Jor-El truly understood that Kal would effectively become a god of the material universe in all but name.

It is not simply that Kryptonians of this strength have such incredible physical prowess that it would take armies of metahumans led by multiple Post-Crisis Kryptonians to even have a hope of pinning one down without exploiting their weaknesses—their physical feats don’t make sense, and treat kinetic force as more of an artistic medium than anything. Towing entire systems of planets around on a giant chain? Child’s play. Gathering millions of meteors from across the universe to fuse into artificial planets for the homeless? Easy. Clapping lightning into existence, squeezing diamonds into coal, accurately throwing a jewel around the world back to its original position, and viewing events happening in the far corners of the universe? Just another day in the life of the Man of Steel. Try going back and forth in time, taking anything you can carry with you for something approaching a challenge-and even then mainly because of the risk of accidentally going to a parallel universe and endangering it with time paradoxes. 

Kryptonian powers of this era are also oddly modular and responsive to external stimuli; by catching a cold, Superman’s heat vision briefly became cold vision; after touching an alien spacecraft, he gained the power to create a miniature version of himself with his powers; through sheer anger and prolonged violence, Superboy Prime could retcon the past of targets he punched. It is no exaggeration to say that with enough sunlight to sustain your powers, even truly fundamental beings such as the Anti-Monitor could be beaten to death by your fists.
objects.title: Silver Age Kryptonian (DC Comics)

objects.text: You’ve unlocked the ancestral secrets of Mars itself, and undone the manipulations of the accursed Guardians. Your Martian DNA has been dramatically enhanced in all attributes. Your psychic might is greater than ever, and your physiology is even more advanced than before, following the legacy of a people who brought their sector to its knees. The Burning Martians could rival Kryptonians in raw strength and durability, and regenerative abilities that would put earthbound creatures to shame. Additionally, Burning Martians possessed two abilities that their descendants had had removed from them. Firstly, an affinity for Pyrokinesis, coupled with an enhancement while around such flame and heat. Secondly, Bio-fission—the ability to reproduce asexually, by splitting into a second, fully mature, Martian after feeding from the negative thoughts of others.
objects.title: Burner of Mars (DC Comics)

objects.text:
The Alpha Effect and the Omega Effect are immensely powerful energies wielded by the most elite of the New Gods. Both originate directly from the Source and possess limitless potential. These energies not only grant incredible abilities but also dramatically enhance the physical forms of their users to handle such immense power.

As a wielder, you can choose to harness the Alpha Effect or the Omega Effect. However, it’s important to note that your version will not be as potent as that of Darkseid or Highfather. Instead, your abilities will be more in line with those seen in characters like Grail or Mister Miracle.

Omega Beams, a manifestation of the Omega Effect, are among the most feared weapons in existence. They can vaporize, erase, or transmute any matter—living or non-living—and can transport targets across time, space, dimensions, or even universes. Once locked on a target, Omega Beams are nearly impossible to dodge, with only beings as fast as the Flash or as durable as Superman having a chance to withstand them. Victims can be recreated at the user’s will or banished to the Omega Sanction—a tormenting existence that slowly breaks the soul through endless suffering.

In contrast, the Alpha Effect offers a more constructive and restorative form of power. While it can mimic many of the Omega Effect’s abilities through “Alpha Bullets,” it can also heal, resurrect, and incapacitate without causing pain. Uniquely, the Alpha Effect can drain energy from other gods, overpowering them even against their will. It has even repelled an avatar of Death itself.
objects.title: Omega/Alpha Effect (DC Comics)

objects.text:
The Delta Effect can be considered an opposite force to Darkseid’s Omega Effect; while the Omega Effect inflicts ultimate entropy on its subject, the Delta Effect reverses energy, imposes order, and separates the useful from the dross.

Like the daughter of the Source, Kuzuko, you can wield the Delta Effect, harnessing its power to repair and improve whatever you want to target with it. It can refine crude ore into pure orichalcum, a material with reality warping properties, restore technology as advanced as a Mother Box to full functionality from obliterated remains inside a pile of metal slag, and elevate people to the full extent of their physical and moral potential.
objects.title: Delta Effect (DC Comics)

addons.text: "I don't need to be stronger than you to kill you. I can just make you weaker. Just as you'll do whatever it takes to stay alive, I... No, we will do whatever it takes to kill you." Shinobu Kochou’s Legacy has been subsumed by your demon nature, forging you into one of the two demons to escape the clutches of Muzan Kibutsuji. You gain the wisdom, experience and talents of Tamayo, who has lived over 900 years in the effort to defeat the King of Demons. Through this, you may create demons yourself, but with altered physiology compared to traditional demons, such as being able to subsist on only a singular drop of blood and many more things. In addition to this, your Blood Demon Art has been supercharged. It can now be inoculated with any poison or medicine you ingest your body weight in, meaning you may spread these concoctions to whoever breathes it in. While your Insect Breathing has not gotten any better than before, you now have many more years to hone and perfect your techniques.
addons.title: Tamayo

addons.text:
Sun Blessed and your own ability to push past your inherent weaknesses has allowed you to acclimate your existence to the Sun, at least to a certain extent, granting a facsimile of the trait coveted by Muzan, a resistance to the Sun.

As a baseline you can survive exposure to the Sun for minutes before beginning to burn, and it’ll take over an hour of continued exposure for you to fully succumb. Furthermore, by actively using the One Breath you can stave off death for several hours by revitalizing yourself. 

However, just because the Sun’s light doesn’t kill you doesn’t mean it can’t inconvenience you. Exposure to the Sun’s light greatly weakens you, as most of your strength is diverted to resisting it. 

As a side effect, this renders Nichirin weapons near useless against you as the traces of sunlight within them are insufficient to truly harm you, and even the fabled Crimson Blade is mostly ineffective.
addons.title: Sun Touched

addons.text:
Your raw potential as a True Oni has pushed your resistance to the sun to even greater heights, more akin to a false conqueror of the sun.

Even without using the One Breath you can survive the sun for hours on end and with it you can resist it indefinitely. Furthermore, while it does still hinder you, it does so to a much lesser extent, freeing up more of your strength.

Additionally, your Blood Demon Art paradoxically carries traces of the Sun’s energy, allowing it to kill other Demons and remain undisrupted by the Sun’s light.

Lastly, Nichirin weapons are entirely useless against you and even the Crimson Blade suffers from massively reduced effectiveness, needing to be used against you when the Sun is at its strongest in order to be even remotely close to effective.
addons.title: False Conqueror

objects.text:
Your Demon blood has increased, and your strength has reached incredible heights. You are absolutely unparalleled in strength when compared to even the strongest of Lower Moon demons. Your hunger for humans is still insatiable, and like before, you will never truly be full; however, the craving is much easier to resist, and it will continue to weaken as you grow in strength.

 You are now so fast that your movement looks like teleportation to most humans and Lower Moons. Your strength would now allow you to destroy multiple city blocks at once, and your Blood Demon Art is now strong enough to destroy an entire district or a small village. Your healing is now so fast that non-weakness imposed wounds, such as a normal katana or a gunshot, close as they are formed, a slash's start point would be closed by the time the slash finishes and entire limbs will regrow in around 5-10 minutes. Your senses cover even greater distances with even greater accuracy and acuteness.

You are still weak to everything you were as a Lower Moon, but these weaknesses will decrease in effectiveness as you grow in strength, though the weakness to both the sun and decapitation with a sun-powered weapon will never vanish, through training and/or eating humans.
