 Due to your increase in demon blood, you can now create lesser demons. These demons' potential will scale with your own, but the limit is always 6 tiers below you. Upper 6 could create demons up to the strength of Lower 6, Upper 5 to Lower 5, etc.
objects.title: Upper Moon (Demon Slayer)

objects.text:
Your demon blood and power are now equal to only one other demon in history, Muzan Kibutsuji, the demon king. Much like him, you gain pinkish-red catlike eyes and absolutely incredible self-biokinesis—you have intimate knowledge of every cell of your body which allows you to change yourself in any way you need or want, from making new limbs like bone whips and new mouths to completely disguising yourself by changing your size, sex, smell, your heartbeat, breathing pattern, or even your unique eyes. You also have massively increased intelligence and thinking power due to your evolution, giving you 5 brains and 7 hearts.

Your strength is immense, you can easily destroy a town to a small city, and your speed is equally incredible, being able to cover vast distances in an instant—many, many times faster than even the fastest Upper Moon. Your senses can cover entire cities at once with ease, and when focused, can go even farther. These senses are so strong that you could differentiate people by their heartbeats from miles away. Finally, your regeneration, instant, even for total limb destruction, unless the injury was imposed by a weakness like a sun-fused weapon, and even then, it would only slow you down unless the power was already stronger than your own.

You can make new ones or use any mentioned Blood Demon Art with experimentation and study. Their power scales with your own, always being strong enough to be considered an ultimate move.

Even the absolute best Wisteria poisons would only be enough to slow you down and annoy you until you adapted. Sun-infused weaponry does little unless it is significantly stronger than you already are, and decapitation is completely ineffective. Death will only come to you if you are completely disintegrated or all of your hearts and brains are obliterated by powerful sun weaponry, difficult considering you can move and change them at will, and they naturally move around in erratic patterns. The sun itself will still completely kill you, though you at least have a second or two to escape it before you die completely.

You are still insatiable and will never truly be full, but the craving for humans can be easily suppressed, and you will never feel real hunger ever again.

You can make demons of incredible strength; their max potential still scales with your own, and they will never have the strength to challenge you. All demons made are fervently loyal to you and will do anything for you and your goals, even die. Optionally, you may get all of the 12 Upper Moons from Demon Slayer, even Nakime and Kaigaku.
objects.title: Progenitor (Demon Slayer)

objects.text:
No demon in history has reached the level where you now reside; you have surpassed all demon weaknesses, and it would take complete obliteration and nothing less to kill you. Nothing can weaken your strength or regeneration anymore. If even a single partial cell of you lives, you can reform from it in under a second. You now no longer need to eat humans to grow stronger, though it will give you significant boosts in power; you passively gain strength for every day you exist. Where once the sun would signify your weakness and your need to hide, now it signifies your ever-growing strength. You are many, many times more powerful than you were as a Progenitor; your strength is enough to level mountains with relative ease and even islands when pushed. Your speed is now around 10-12% percent the speed of light.

You can now easily make demons on the level of Muzan. Your demons' weaknesses are weakened, but still exist until they reach a level of power equal to Muzan. Even then, you may choose whether they keep them or not.
objects.title: Sun Conqueror (Demon Slayer)

objects.text:
Instead of being half-demon, only 1/4 of your blood carries the power of the legendary dark knight like Nero. 

While this might seem like a detriment rather than a benefit it is not, for human blood can nurture demonic power and make it grow. This has allowed Nero to match both Dante and Vergil despite being in his mid-20s while the sons of Sparda were in their early 40s.

You start off weaker compared to Demon hybrids like Dante and Vergil but you grow in power much faster and you have greater potential.
objects.title: The Next Generation Demon Slayer (Devil May Cry)

objects.text: Demons experience an uncontrollable and intense burst of emotion and power known as Evil Cycle when their stress level reaches a critical point. This loss of reason can lead them to commit acts of violence and sadism without regard for their inhibitions or limits. An Evil Cycle can enhance the user's magical abilities, but it also consumes their mana quickly and reduces their inhibitions. As such, triggering an Evil Cycle requires a great deal of training, and it is associated with a Return to the Origin—a state of wild, destructive behavior that harkens back to the primordial demons. Each individual's Evil Cycle is influenced by their sense of self and their bloodline, an example being Asmodeus demons whose origins were known to govern both Virtue and Destruction. In their cycle they becomes less friendly and turn more lustful and sadistic, craving destruction while being elegant. This power can make you formidable, but it also carries with it the risk of losing control.
objects.title: Evil Cycle (Welcome to Demon School Iruma-kun)

objects.text:
The devil's half of your DNA belongs to one of the 72 Pillars, granting you the power of one of the Pillars. These abilities range from the fire and regeneration abilities of the Phenex Pillar to the Power of Destruction of the Bael Pillar.

The reserves of your demonic energy are doubled, and all of your physical attributes are significantly above those of a normal half-devil.
objects.title: Blood of the 72 Pillars (High School DxD)

addons.text: Like Tarasque, you are the child of the Biblical Leviathan. You have strongly inherited both Leviathan’s aspect as a Demon Prince of Envy and as the Divine Beast of the Sea of biblical myth. As a Divine Beast, you share your progenitor’s indestructible hide, your skin and scales being impervious to all harm from anything besides certain ‘’omnipotent’’ divine authorities or the highest of divine constructs such as EA or Excalibur, anything else just helplessly shrugs off, incapable of even scratching you. As the Demon Prince of Envy, you can manipulate envy on a symbolic level, allowing you to incite envy and sow dissatisfaction in anything from mortals to gods or even abstract concepts. The latter can have disastrous effects on the target, as having the concepts of life or fate dissatisfied with you could easily leave them in an early grave. You also gain another Clan Trait, The Infernal Sea of Demonic Life, which allows you to infuse demonic energy into your Sea Magic, creating a red-ish black sea of infernal water, which corrupts the souls and mutates the bodies of those in contact with it into becoming a devil under your control. You can freely choose the extent of your control, from inducing loyalty to completely rewiring their personality, memories, and emotions, or no control whatsoever. As a perfect devil-dragon hybrid, you have become among the strongest of Ultimate-class devils in both physicality and magical prowess. You also have six pairs of devil wings.
addons.title: Dragon Blood of the Leviathan

objects.text: You are a descendant of Leviathan, the Prince of Envy, and one of the original Satans. You have inherited the clan trait of the Leviathan bloodline—Sea Serpent of the End. This, in addition to your sea magical affinity, gives you the ability to transform into a long, serpent-like dragon. In this form, you temporarily turn into a genuine dragon, giving you all the abilities and weaknesses inherent to dragon-kind, in addition to your original devil abilities and weaknesses. Given enough time and effort, you can permanently become a devil-dragon hybrid, making its strength enhancements permanent. Your dragon form strengthens your Sea Magic by an order of magnitude. If you could manipulate a small inflatable pool before, you can control an Olympic swimming pool in your draconic form. This further scales as your Sea Magic improves. You have two variations of your dragon breath. The first is a breath of pure demonic energy strong enough to flatten mountains. The second is imbuing your breath with your Sea Magic, which then alters it into a thin beam of extremely high-pressure seawater. This beam drains the energy of anyone it hits while having strong piercing power. As a Satan descendant, you have vast demonic energy reserves, easily ten times larger than those of typical High-class devils, and you naturally grow into Ultimate-class upon reaching adulthood. Unlike non-Satan descendant devils, you also develop more wings as your power increases, up to twelve wings total or six pairs.
objects.title: Sea Serpent of the End (High School DxD)

objects.text: You are a descendant of Lucifer, the King of Devils, and the original Satan. You have inherited the clan trait of the Lucifer bloodline, the Demonic Brilliance of Evil Light. This changes your golden holy light into pitch-black demonic light, merging demonic energy with the light element. Thus, it is akin to a spiritual poison to both creatures of darkness and creatures of light, damaging the souls and having the damage reflect onto the material form rather than targeting the fleshy body directly. You can form this Evil Light into constructs like weapons, armor, or structures, or you can fire it off as black light beams or blasts. You can also “bless” objects with Evil Light to bestow its Demonic-Light properties to them, allowing you to enhance the damage they cause to both holy and demonic beings. As a Satan descendant, you have vast demonic energy reserves, easily ten times larger than those of typical High-class devils, and you naturally grow into Ultimate-class upon reaching adulthood. Unlike non-Satan descendant devils, you also develop more wings as your power increases, up to twelve wings total or six pairs.
objects.title: Demonic Brilliance of Evil Light (High School DxD)

addons.title: Ancient Heritage
addons.text:
Your Heritage is even older than that of the 72 Pillars, allowing you to either pick or design another custom ability that represents your Heritage; your bloodline abilities grow and evolve with use, even creating new developments wherever there is overlap between the two abilities.

The reserves of your demonic energy have doubled once again; your physical attributes are incredible for a Pure-Blooded Devil of your age.

objects.text:
Your DNA has been fully replaced with that of a Pure-Blooded Devil, granting you even greater speed, strength, and durability on the level of a High-Class Devil. Your vision is now perfect in all conditions.

The reserves of your demonic energy are doubled, and your growth speed and potential will be significantly higher than other devils.
objects.title: Pure-Blooded Devil (High School DxD)

objects.text:
You are now a Super Devil, also known as a Transcendental Being, that surpasses all known Devils. Your growth speed and potential are now multiplied by a magnitude. Your bloodline abilities are increasingly versatile, as you will now discover new uses for your abilities with ease. Your growth will never slow down due to your increasing power. You will be able to delve into new fields of magic that would be otherwise deemed impossible.

Your reserves of demonic energy have been further multiplied fivefold, and your growth speed and potential are now multiplied by a magnitude on top of any previous bonuses.
objects.title: Super Devil (High School DxD)

objects.text:
You become a dhampir, which is a half-human vampire. Meanwhile, this is usually frowned upon by pure-blooded vampires; it actually reduces all of your vampiric weaknesses into mild annoyances like easily getting sunburns, feeling uncomfortable entering spaces you are not invited to, and such, without weakening any of your vampiric powers. As your power grows, you might also overcome your weaknesses completely. You can also still drink blood to gain power, but you can also live off a normal human diet.

Your peerage will also benefit from your dhampir nature, making them turn into dhampirs as well, retaining the features and powers of their previous race. You will also gain a sixth sense for detecting if your victim can handle the ritual or succumb to it, becoming undead.

If you have any other racial powers, you can also have your peerage inherit them during the ritual, although the powers will be weakened to the strength of an average freshly turned vampire, which they will have to train up to their original power level.
objects.title: Dhampir (High School DxD)

objects.text:
You have grown to reach the level of the Five Dragon Kings.

Your newfound power is great enough to wipe away nations and rival beings such as the Four Satans. As an example, Satan Leviathan could cover all of Japan in ice in moments if she desired.

It should be noted that how your newfound power could be manifested will depend on the field of growth you chose.

Mastering one’s innate characteristics would grant you the power to overwhelm those before you—being unscratched by attacks that would vaporize mountains, breathe fire with power akin to a meteor, and survive attacks from dragon-slaying weapons that would slay other Dragon Kings.

Mastering various magics would have you be weaker in terms of raw power than your fellow Dragon Kings, but would be incredibly versatile and a pain to face in combat—being able to perform feats such as creating tendrils that absorb an enemy's lifeforce, spells that negate specific phenomena, and convert offensive spells into support or mundane one and vice versa, and many more are among the list of things you could do now.

Min-maxing a specific ability would grant you raw capabilities in the middle of Dragon Kings, with a singular ability that allows you to hit above your weight class—inextinguishable flames, scales that other dragons would struggle to damage, or a venom so potent that it melts organic material in seconds.
objects.title: Dragon King (High School DxD)

objects.text: You have finally reached the monstrous level of the Heavenly Dragons. In terms of power, you are now a world-ending threat—a being with the power to rival the heavens and potentially destroy the world itself should you put everything you have into it. It should be noted that how your newfound power could be manifested will depend on the field of growth you chose. Taking the path of mastering one’s innate characteristics to the realms of the Heavenly Dragons would have you be equal in sheer might to Crom Cruach, who could perform feats such as taking a dragon-slaying attack that could kill other Heavenly Dragons and only lose a single wing, block Ddraig’s Penetrate, catch an attack that previously killed him in his teeth, and physically break through spatial attacks with overwhelming force. Taking the path of mastering various magics to the realms of the Heavenly Dragons would have you rival the skill and knowledge of Aži Dahāka, who knew thousands of magics, could perform dozens of spells simultaneously, create hundreds of perfect clones of himself, create illusory worlds tailor-made to drain a target's willpower, effortlessly perform rare and forbidden magics, and single-handedly defeat an army of gods. Taking the path of min-maxing a specific ability to the realms of the Heavenly Dragons would have you be akin to Ddraig and Albion, who possessed specialized abilities that attack the body and soul of a target and could fell gods with ease, further develop new abilities diverged from the original should an opponent unable to be beat by the specialization arrives, and with their capabilities, required the Biblical God himself to bring them down.
objects.title: Heavenly Dragon (High School DxD)

addons.text:
Unlike the flawed Dragon Gods of Draconic Deus, whose supposed embodiment of a concept falls apart under scrutiny, your power removes such inconsistencies. Not only do you have conceptual control over your element, but you also become an entity that is the true embodiment of it—the very concept itself. This is not a mere claim of power but an undeniable reality of your new ascended existence.

As a true conceptual entity, your survival is no longer tied to your physical form but to the very existence of your concept. So long as it exists, you cannot truly be permanently destroyed, and as long as you exist, the concept itself will always persist. Your form, essence, and power are extensions of yourself that are deeply intertwined with your concept, allowing you to control and manipulate it at the most fundamental level with ease, with also gaining an inherent understanding of your domain that is similar to beings who govern universal constants. You’re not merely made of the element itself but of the very concepts that define it. For instance, if you embody infinity, your soul, essence, and being can be considered infinite, while embodying dreams allows you to take on the nature of what could be considered a dream itself, granting you the ability to dream aspects of your existence into being, such as your strength, or dreaming away injuries or even death. As the living concept itself, you’re able to shape its nature, define its boundaries, and impose its influence and absolute authority across all different dimensions and realities. Whether it is fire, time, death, or something more abstract, you are its sovereign. Unlike the hollow titles of Great Red or Ophis, your embodiment is not just a title, but a reflection of what you truly are, with you now also gaining the inherent powers that comes to beings of similar elevated natures. In essence, you become the ultimate representation of your chosen concept, unbound by the contradictions of lesser beings.
addons.title: True Embodiment

objects.text: You have reached the pinnacle of power found within the world of Draconic Deus—you are now a Dragon God. Your sheer power is apocalyptic, as you actually unleashing your power would be enough to destroy the world right then and there. The sheer scope of your power could drive weak-willed individuals mad. Your mere presence would be enough to destabilize dimensions. In terms of how you would perceive power in comparison to yourself is that a power twice the combined power of Ddraig and Albion would be seen as very weak. In actual combat, your power is devastating as seen with the other Dragon Gods. Trihexa, the weakest in raw power, was able to destroy three layers of Heaven with a blast, and it took the combined might of every pantheon’s strongest fighters thousands of years of non-stop attrition to potentially defeat it. Beyond your sheer power, you have become like your fellow Dragon Gods who embody a concept, such as how Great Red is the Dream, Ophis is the Infinite, and whatever Trihexa embodies. This is seen with how Ophis possesses infinite energy and could hear even the most minute sounds in the Dimensional Gap, how Great Red is connected to all dreams in the past, present, and future, and how Trihexa can regenerate from almost anything near instantly including having its soul erased.
objects.title: Dragon God (High School DxD)

objects.text:
Your physical abilities are now equal to the Grand Regent of the Viltrum Empire, Thragg. Whether coming from selective breeding, training or a special bloodline, you are now much faster and stronger than your regular Viltrumite contemporaries—you treat even Veteran Viltrumites how they would treat Young Viltrumites.

Your regeneration and endurance are also pushed to their peak, allowing you to heal much faster than other members of your species and fight for days or even longer while severely wounded. Along with your increased might comes the education in all manner of Viltrumite combat, capable of matching the most skilled warriors in the universe.

Your power, just by your lonesome, is enough to destroy civilizations or possibly even worlds.
objects.title: Grand Regent (Invincible)

objects.text:
The Calaquendi are those elves that travelled to the west to the eternal land of Valinor in the days when the trees lit the sky. 

They have the seen the Valar in person and lived in beauty and peace.
You are of the Calaquendi. Although not an elf, Having beheld the light of the trees and the land of Aman you are mightier than others of your kind. 

Others can see the Light of Aman upon your face, either finding their spirits bolstered as your allies or fleeing in fear of the light if they are your enemies.
objects.title: Light of Aman (Lord of The Rings)

addons.text:
The One Ring recognizes you as its true master, the soul of Sauron in the One Ring, lighting a spark in your Maiar powers. The divine flame within your spirit has been ignited. You have inherited the power of Sauron at his prime. The eponymous Lord of the Rings is one of the Maiar who helped Eru Ilúvatar create the world and was the apprentice of Aulë. Your majesty has been enhanced as your power rises to match Mairon, the strongest of the Maiar. 

Not only do your powers as an Ainur grow, but you also gain experience in wielding the music of the Ainur. You have gained the knowledge and abilities of Mairon, or, as he would later be called, Sauron, and are now able to use several of the abilities he lost, such as his shapeshifting and greater expression of the song.

However, keep in mind that Mairon was originally a smith, and while later in his long life he learned many things, such as necromancy and other powers unrelated to his original duty, he is still a smith first and foremost, and so the majority of his power as a Maiar is better suited towards creating objects of power such as the One Ring or enchanted objects.

As you have regained the power of Mairon at his prime while retaining the power that is in the One Ring, you could eventually grow in power equal to that of Melkor or even greater.
addons.title: Mairon

objects.text:
The Maiar are those spirits who descended to the world at the dawn of creation to help the Valar craft Arda. They are angelic beings that serve the mightier Valar. Each Maiar is associated with a certain Valar and as the Thoughts of Iluvatar have some power over a single concept, be it Water, Light, Metal, and more esoteric things. Pick a single concept to have some power over.

The Maiar are impressive beings, filled with the light and music of Iluvatar and possessed of a spark of the divine. Some burn brighter than others and are able to fill themselves with such majesty and to leave others in awe. You are one such brightly burning Maiar.

You may reveal all of your light at anytime and burn with such Majesty and Splendor as to freeze your allies and enemies in awe or fear, should you wish it. The Secret Fire also burns more brightly within you, bringing you much closer to the might of the Valar than the rest of your brethren.

The Maiar are holy beings that serve Iluvatar. As such they possess a sacred light and portion of the divine. They are able to bless things, giving them supernatural protection and durability. They may share their light with others and protect them from darkness and corruption. 

You are particularly Hallowed. Remove evil spirits with a touch, bless a blade to cleave through the undead like paper, and with enough focus and effort you can remove taint and corruption from evil lands.
objects.title: Majesty and Splendor (Lord of The Rings)

objects.text:
Varda, the Lady of Stars is the most beautiful being in creation. The light of Iluvatar rests on her face. Her light and beauty is such that Melkor loved her, her rejection leading him to hate and fear her over many others. 

You are now invested with a portion of Varda’s beauty. People of all races will be caught off guard by how beautiful you are. Men and women will be in awe of your light and even your most dire enemies will need more pushing to physically harm you.
objects.title: Beauty Too Great For Words (Lord of The Rings)

objects.text:
Entering the realm of the supernatural, you take on a more fairy-like existence. You are now able to take on the full form of a bipedal domestic cat, about the size of a dog, and sport a notable white tuft of fur on your chest. You are capable of conversing with people in your cat form and are able to move without making a sound. You can freely transform back into your base catfolk form whenever you like. As a type of fairy, you gain knowledge of and awareness of any other fey in your general surroundings and are able to travel to places restricted to fey in general.

Should you be in the presence of someone at the time of their death, you can claim their soul before it passes on into any afterlife or some other god’s domain. As a supernatural creature, you now have an extended lifespan, much longer than what it would have been. Any souls you claim can be used to extend your lifespan further.

Your presence brings blessings to those in your good graces. You are able to confer heightened luck and augment positive emotions of those around you. Those around you will find a boost to their general health, being able to shake illnesses sooner or even survive illnesses that might have won otherwise. You can focus your blessings on individual people or objects to improve their potency. Your blessings can bring protection from minor curses, including negation or removal of ones that stay within your presence long enough. Those that cross you can expect to face household-level famine as one of your primary forms of curses. Over time and with sufficient practice, you will come to learn how to develop your existing blessings to new levels and discover even new ways to share them with others.
objects.title: Cait Sidhe

objects.text:
Your feline connection has inverted, increasing the prevalence of your cat-like features. This grants you more potent feline abilities. As you master your abilities and body, you will learn to suppress the visual flair of this form to return to your base catfolk visage.

Your new form has risen to embody the nature of the cheetah. You have gained a vast improvement to your running speed and agility. When pushing yourself, the peak that humanity could ever hope to achieve would seem slow to you. Your body sense sees a proportional increase as well, allowing you to perfectly react at the necessary speeds to act at your top speed. With enough lead time, you can perceive and track bullets mid-trajectory and easily aim-dodge them. This is where you begin, as long as you continue to push yourself, you will find yourself running to new heights.
objects.title: Cheetah

objects.text:
The cat within your inner spirit has finally grown to a proper maturity, granting you a new form. You are able to assume a large, seemingly normal, quadrupedal cat form. The most notable feature, aside from your size, is your forked tail. As you continue to grow, your tail will eventually split into two full tails. Once this happens, your original tail will fork once again. Every tail you grow in this manner represents an extra life you can expend to continue should the worst come to rear its head. You will never be able to grow more than nine tails in total, however. As the number of your tails increases, you will find a corresponding decrease in the rate at which you age.

You will find that your senses have taken another leap in potency. Your vision is now capable of seeing in complete darkness, but will be reminiscent of low-light conditions rather than day-like. You are also able to see and hear spirits and other spiritual entities in your viscinity.

Your main supernatural ability in this form arises in the manipulation of a special ghost-like fire that you can emit from the tips of your tails or paws. Emitting these flames from your paws can allow you a form of flight by running on the air itself and leaping further than should be possible for the amount of force you use. Fire emitted from your tails take-on a more spiritual nature and is capable of harming ghosts, spirits, and other similar entities. Your fire can interact with souls, themselves, allowing you to harm someone without damaging their body. With time and practice, your flames can take the place of a soul for the purpose of reanimating and controlling the recently deceased. As you learn to manipulate your flames, you will come to learn how to affect their properties to cast impressive illusions. At the peak of your manipulation, you will find the ability to fully consume any object that is completely engulfed in your fire, with no harm to yourself.
objects.title: Nekomata

objects.text:
Pushing your inner feline to its limit has seen it take a step forward. Your inner desire to have the abilities to go wherever you please has been heard. Your new form has paradoxically taken the path of specializing in the general, granting you a beyond peak level of athleticism and mastery over the way your body moves.

You have the strength to casually table-flip a large SUV and toss people around like ragdolls. You can leap several stories, to easily travel in any direction. Your claws are sharp enough to shred the densest of terrestrial metals and strong enough to support much more than your weight, allowing you to climb nearly any surface you come across. Your enhanced musculature tends to increase in density to a much further degree than in size, allowing you to maintain your supernaturally adorable form. This comes with the added benefit of a durability that grows faster than your strength.

Your muscles don’t just grow in density, but also in efficiency. This vastly improves your endurance, eventually allowing you to act at near peak performance for days or weeks at your peak. As you push your body and strength to its limit, you will eventually find yourself capable of punching with speeds capable of igniting the air around your fists.
objects.title: Leopard

addons.text:
The joining of your two halves has seen your light grow beyond bounds. You now claim the entirety of the sun’s light as your and any light on earth as your divine eyes. Every photon, from the dimmest embers of a dying flame to the lonely spark traveling the expanse of the cosmos, is an extension of yourself.

Merging with your martial half has brought a whole host of empowerment and blessings you may confer to those that bask in your peaceful rays. A mere spark of your divine grace is enough to send any of your blessed beyond their limits. However, be careful not to overcharge your followers too much, for only the most resolute will be able to handle the full weight of your light.
addons.title: Through the Eyes of the Sun

objects.text:
Your spiritual and fairy natures have come together and expanded beyond what either would ever hope to become alone. You have awakened, within you, an Eye of Ra, granting you the full creative power of the sun goddess you are destined to embody.

Wherever you look, the sun shall shine. Whatever bathes within your sunlight will find itself restored, should you wish it. No sickness or injury, physical, spiritual, or esoteric in nature will be able to resist the restorative power of your light. With little effort, your light is capable of restoring the fertility to the lands of an entire nation and beyond. Your sight shall never be denied to you, and you can easily direct your light upon yourself, banishing the concept of injury and unwanted harm on your being.

You can take your restorative abilities a step further and bring life into being, either within yourself or within those that receive your sunlight. Any life that is brought to bear in this way is guaranteed to be born with perfect health, devoid of any illness, genetic, random, or otherwise. Any that carry your life are guaranteed to undergo the process without issue or harm, and will experience it at an expedited rate.

As a master of life, you are not obligated to share your grace with others, and can even rescind your gift with a mere touch. A touch is all you need to claim the life-force of anyone you please in any quantity. As an extension of your fey and spiritual abilities, you can fully manipulate the souls within others, push, pull, or twist them into whatever configuration suits your needs. The amount of ghostly fire you can conjure is now able to match the output of the sun itself. Your presence can evoke a great sense of peace and can fully soothe the wrathful. Pushing your divine presence enforces serenity upon your surroundings, negating aggressive drives in those around you.
objects.title: Bastet

addons.text:
The merging of your two halves has seen a great expansion to what you claim as your purview. You are intimately aware of everything within your light and fully capable of processing that information to whatever amount you wish. You don’t need precognition because the rate at which you gather information is instantaneous, but like any other limit, that won’t stop you. The flow of information within your light flows faster for you than anyone else, granting you your own form of precognition as you learn what happens before causality makes it so. This is your Morning Star.

As the Herald of your solar might, your Morning Star grants you free travel to anywhere within your light, at whichever speed you demand. As you grow in strength, so will your Morning Star. In time, you will be able to claim the authority of other sources of light throughout the cosmos in increasing orders of magnitude. No matter where you find yourself in the cosmos, you will always see yourself able to stand before the entirety of the dominant species that shares your home.
addons.title: Heralded by the Morning Star

objects.text:
Your mastery over your body has reached its limit and refused to stop. Igniting the power of your soul has incinerated the limits that once held you back. You have taken more than a step, or even a leap and a bound, forward into the realm of gods. As the fire within you stabilizes and fills you with its warmth, you open an Eye of Ra, granting you the vengeful power and heat of the sun befitting the warrior goddess that beckons your destiny.

With a mere breath, you can bring forth the fiery might of the sun to bear against your enemies. The heat at your control can burn away and banish the very notion of evil, destroying its vessels and warding against its return. Should you wish it, you can bring your heat against the world itself, giving rise to massive deserts.

Those that bask in your heat will find disease and other ailments fail to progress, allowing them to recover at expedited rates. So long as your heat remains, those in your heat will continue to enjoy an absence of disease in any form. In the unlikely event you shall find yourself defeated, you need only wait no longer than a day as you find yourself fully renewed upon the dawn of a new day. Yet, before you get to that point, you can turn your flames upon yourself and burn away the concept of your injuries to reforge yourself into peak condition.

While your power is a vengeful one, you still hold a mastery over it, and thus can freely choose how your fire and heat interact with the world around you. You can blast an entire nation into a desert of glass without touching a single hair on the head of any of its citizens. You can embue the concept of your heat into objects and foods, giving birth to potent weapons capable of defeating evil, and creating medicines and tonics capable of burning away what ails a person. Your martial might is enough to stand against the whole of humanity and bring them to their end should another god not come to distract you.

Taking the visage of a lion, your presence can evoke a great sense to act and work towards one’s ambitions. Pushing the weight and authority of your presence, the ferocity of your royal visage can bring the most boisterous and arrogant to heel.
objects.title: Sekhmet

objects.text:
No matter what kind of Conduit you choose to be, your powerset has received three specific upgrades, overcoming weaknesses common to almost all Conduits.

The first upgrade is that you can now turn temporarily intangible, regardless of the element, material, or energy your Conduit abilities revolve around. Some Conduits, such as Delsin (Smoke), already possess such an ability, but it is now available to you even if you are an Ice Conduit or an Electricity Conduit like Cole, for example. With naturally diffuse or volatile elements such as Smoke, this intangible form can also be maintained for as long as you want, not just the duration of a brief dash and controlled with much greater precision, allowing you to, say, swiftly enter a target's lungs through their mouth before exploding them from the inside.

The second upgrade is that you are no longer limited to simply gliding through the air (Electricity, Smoke) or briefly propelling yourself upward (Ice). You can now fly by propelling yourself with your element, controlling your speed and trajectory with precision, for as long as you want.

The third upgrade is that you no longer need to recharge your internal reserves by absorbing your element from external sources, such as drawing smoke from a burning car. Your internal elemental stamina is always at its maximum, allowing you to use any of your powers for as long and as many times as you want without growing tired. As a side effect, you can charge any of your moves for a second or two to tap into that unlimited reserve and unleash a significantly more powerful version of it. As a Smoke Conduit, for example, a normal Cinder Missile might be powerful enough to destroy a military vehicle, while a fully charged version could destroy a small building instead.
objects.title: Evolved Conduit (Infamous)

objects.text:
With this power, no matter what kind of Conduit you choose to be, you gain access to every technique and move ever displayed by a playable powerset in the Infamous series, each adapted to your chosen element. In essence, your element becomes more of an aesthetic and thematic choice than a powerset limitation, with the entirety of the series' currently playable moves becoming part of your arsenal, the effects and level of damage associated to the original versions of these moves remaining identical after the elemental conversion.

For example, even as an Electricity Conduit like Cole, you would gain access to Neon's time bending abilities and super speed, though you would propel yourself forward as a super fast humanoid bolt of lightning rather than a silhouette of neon light. As a Smoke Conduit, if you were to perform a Radiant Sweep, it would be an Ardent Sweep firing massive bolts of cinder instead, and your version of Video's invisibility would turn you into a humanoid mass of invisible hot air rather than manipulating the light around you. As a Concrete Conduit, your replication of all the variants of Cole's electrical bolts, such as the Pincer Bolt, would be in the form of homing concrete projectiles. Etc.

Of course, the fact that you now got all these abilities does not prevent you to push your power further and discover and invent new techniques with time and practice, like a regular Conduit.

As a small side bonus, you're now able to freely choose the color of your element and change it on the fly, even beyond the usual karmic colors. Green electricity, purple ice? You can have it.
objects.title: Arsenal Unification (Infamous)

objects.text:
You are no mere Conduit—you're the very driving force of human evolution. You're the pinnacle of Conduit potential and far more. Your body now possesses the ability to instantly adapt to any new powers you possess, removing its negative side effects such as electrocuting yourself in water and can now gain new abilities by either absorbing massive amounts of your elements/energies, stressing your body and powers in new ways, or forcing RF energy into your body.

As a start, the base abilities you gain as a Conduit are enhanced by a ludicrous degree—your strength, speed, agility, stamina, durability, and basic regeneration are increased to put you as far away from Prime Conduits as they are from regular humans, allowing you to casually rip apart large structures and take even a 51-kiloton nuclear strike and recover in moments no worse for wear.

The Beast had the incredible ability to manipulate matter and energy, capable of breaking it down and absorbing or manipulating it for various purposes. You can perform transmutation, turning matter and energy into a different form of whatever you wish. You are now capable of performing feats such as absorbing and cleansing radiation, releasing blasts that can disintegrate most people, manipulating the structures of other beings at will to give them the Conduit gene, or even something as blasé as creating clothing for yourself. Through this power, you’ve also been given incredible control over the weather, allowing you to create blizzards, hurricanes and even raise volcanoes.

You possess the ability to manipulate gravity to a significant degree, able to create a localized singularity to absorb all nearby matter and energy or nullify its effects. You can choose to exclude some from the effects of your powers.

Perhaps The Beast’s most well known ability is his power to alter his own shape and size at will. You’ll start off with the instinctive skill to turn yourself into a giant lava-incarnate capable of toppling skyscrapers simply by moving, as well as turning yourself into a singularity to absorb massive amounts of matter and energy and nullify attacks against yourself. This particular power is also the reason behind your incredible regeneration, allowing you to absorb surrounding material to reform yourself from even a single atom. You are by no means limited to these forms, and can take a variety that best suits your needs.

As for his second most well known ability, that would be his ability to manipulate fire. You're now a pyrokinetic on a terrifying scale, capable of leveling cities and sinking ocean liners in a single blast. You also possess incredible precision, capable of using it to do nothing more than heating a homeless man in the middle of a blizzard on the other side of the city if you're feeling charitable. All your other elements are enhanced to the same degree of power and precision. 

And finally, the very ability that made The Beast an absolute threat to all of humanity as a whole—the manipulation of RF energy. You now naturally generate massive amounts of RF energy, which can be used in a number of ways. This passive generation will slowly increase your power over time. The most notorious use is that you can generate a massive and powerful blast that activates any nearby Conduits, greatly amplifying your own power, while simultaneously killing any nearby humans. This blast can be powerful enough to lay waste to the entire east coast, wiping entire cities off the map or even split the moon. Manipulation of RF energy allows you to manipulate the powers of other Conduits, making you capable of enhancing, negating, turning off their powers, or even granting them new ones. You may, instead of utilizing a blast, use the passively generated RF energy to awaken any new Conduits. The energy you produce doesn’t have any of the negative effects shown in the series, unless you intentionally use it for that.

Alongside his major abilities, you are granted the following powers of telepathy, allowing you to read and communicate directly with others through their mind even over massive distances; teleportation, allowing you to instantly travel large or short distances in the blink of an eye, as well as flight and levitation. As a bonus, you are also granted the powers of all the other Conduits shown in the series, with their elements being enhanced to be on par with The Beast’s fire, and the rest of their other abilities rising at a similar scale. You’ll also get Cole’s and Delsin, both good and evil versions, skills and experience to go with this. Your power also requires no more effort on your part than blinking, your power simply doing what you’d like it do.
objects.title: The Beast (Infamous)

addons.text: Your Second Quirk has undergone an Awakening alongside your first Quirk. Both of your Quirks will synergize no matter what they are. They will have additional aspects that you can develop through using both of your Quirks in harmony. Your Quirks will slowly grow to cover the weaknesses of each other.

objects.text: Your Quirk has Awakened, meaning it has undergone an evolution that raised it to a new level of strength and uncovered new aspects that can be developed. Training Quirks that have been through an Awakening is much easier than training Quirks that haven’t undergone an Awakening, as Awakened Quirks have their restrictions loosened and are incredibly malleable, allowing them to respond better to attempts to improve it.
objects.title: Quirk Awakening (My Hero Academia)

objects.text: You now have another Quirk alongside the one you initially received. This is still limited to any quirk that is not One for All or All for One. The synergies between the two quirks will not be entirely unfounded, do not expect synergies from two quirks that are diametrically opposed. That does not mean it is impossible to develop combinations between your first and second quirk. Two quirks that share some common ground will be able to work together effectively.
objects.title: Double Quirk (My Hero Academia)

objects.text:
You have the Quirk One for All, as Izuku Midoriya received it. You have an ocean of energy buzzing beneath your skin, augmenting your physical attributes immensely along with any other Quirks you might have. However, if you don’t have the muscle to withstand the power, you will receive massive backlash in the form of broken bones.

Like in canon, as you further your mastery of your abilities, the 7 Quirks of the previously wielders will reveal themselves. The previous wielders living inside your head is optional. Unlike canon, having other abilities along with this won’t kill you.

One for All's stockpile grows as you use it, in turn strengthening itself over time. If you give away One for All, through consenting and letting someone consume your DNA, you will lose the ability to generate the stockpile and have a limited amount left which eventually turns to nothing.
objects.title: One for All (My Hero Academia)

addons.text:
One for All’s nature evolves in effectiveness by covering all bases and issues arising from One for All’s stockpile. The Method and Hyper Alphas’ feedback on the body and mind allows an equilibrium between the One for All and your body; side-by-side with its loosened definition of ‘power’, it permanently enhances every part of your biological systems, acclimating and preparing you to greater heights: your mobility far surpasses Full Cowl in versatility and efficacy, freerunning from city-to-city at mind-numbingly speeds and maneuverability, regardless of your bulk on your ‘puffed up’ state and seamlessly traversing places with the perfect balance of agility and speed, leaving no cracks on the ground nor shows of strength, illustrating your control. This also develops in Quirk-like mutations further developing your body for drawing more of One for All’s stockpile and applying it in more ways than usual.

Transferring these benefits to previous and future bearers is taken for granted, creating a link between them akin to the One for All’s Vestige World, communicating through it, and heightening access to the One for All’s stockpile by a 50% margin, also affecting Quirks, both innate Quirks and within One for All… including being a reciprocal link, personally accessing their Quirks through the link.
addons.title: Bulwark

objects.text:
Now, you are truly worthy of the power of the World's Greatest Hero. For starters, the strain of One for All is now dramatically lessened, to the point where, even with a completely average physique, you could harness post-injury All Might's level of enhancement without any backlash or damage, and that limit only goes up as your body gets better.

Secondly, you now have access to a particular trick similar to the big blonde himself: With a bit of exertion and concentration, you can 'puff up' your body into a massive, ripped caricature of your ordinary state. This isn't just for show or disguise, either; while in this form, you actually do get stronger - not to the same absurd degree as you look, mind you, but still by a significant margin, which certainly helps with drawing out more strength from the Quirk. Do be careful not to lose focus and drop this form at a critical time, though.

Thirdly, One for All's link between its users, past and present, is enhanced as well, becoming a two-way road: Any former users, including you should you pass on the torch, will always have access to a small fraction of One for All's power, as well as all of its bearer's Quirks (and other genetic abnormalities). Furthermore, One for All no longer needs the sharing of genetic material such as blood to be passed on, only requiring either physical contact for new holders, or merely intent for previous holders, in case one needs to return it for whatever reason.

Lastly, and perhaps most importantly, the definition of the 'power' that One for All now stockpiles has become significantly more loose, to your benefit: Exploiting this new vagueness, you can harness its power for more than just as a physical enhancer, allowing feats such as enhancing additional aspects of yourself like senses and reflexes, tapping into a stockpile of stamina and vitality, and even emitting searing heat and electricity.

(Note: One for All may now potentially awaken Quirks in those without the requisite genetics, such as out-of-setting bearers. Potential quirks will usually be semi-random, determined by a mix of personality, background, and possibly species, should they be non-human.)
objects.title: Symbol of Peace (My Hero Academia)

addons.text: With the two Quirks reunited, the capabilities of both are taken even further beyond: In addition to enhancing any of your collected Quirks or other abilities in the same way as those stockpiled inside of One for All, All for One itself is also augmented, granting it the ability to steal genetic powers through any physical contact, boosting its metaphorical 'grip' on them to where you only need a fraction of the effort to take and maintain your hold on them, and multiplying your base capacity for using multiple quirks by five.
addons.title: Go Beyond

objects.text:
You have the Quirk All for One, though not quite at the same level as the man himself. You start out with ten Quirks aside from itself, which you may choose freely save for One for All, though Rewind, Overhaul, and New Order, due to their sheer power and versatility, are worth two, three, and five other Quirks, respectively. With just normal human physiology alone and no training, you can use about a dozen quirks or other stolen abilities at once, which scales upwards as either of the two factors is enhanced.

Be mindful of sharing too much of your collection with a single person, because the strain of so many abilities on their body might just break them if they're too weak.
objects.title: All for One (My Hero Academia)

addons.text:
All For One’s nature evolves in a more sophisticated direction. Apart from absorbing powers for oneself, you can take on a power’s “snapshot” when touching a person with supernatural abilities with 108 Skills, namely copying them without fully taking it from them, fueled by one’s energies, with the accuracy and integrity of said copy being dependent on how much time you maintain contact while archiving the power’s knowledge and Vestige for later use on Archive. As a result, your Quirk Stockpile increases tenfold.

Your handle over these powers has refined accordingly, your mind and power fully accustomed to the Vestiges, with no possibility of mutiny or insubordination through Parallel Processing dealing with the usual strain and complications from Vestiges just as improving the utility, combination, and synergy of all powers instead of brute-forcing some abilities at once, employing Archive’s findings to improve their capabilities and interactions. Ultimately, this aspect takes charge of organizing the power’s Vestiges within Archive, processing 108 Skills’ copy alongside the Vestige, and minimizing the hold it has over your power’s control.
addons.title: Scriviner

objects.text:
Now, you are truly worthy of the power of the World's Greatest Villain. For starters, not only is your initial stockpile of Quirks increased to twenty-five, but your Quirks are now all connected, woven into an intricate living network: As you use and combine them in different ways, they will 'ping' off of each other, filling in their gaps with adaptations and enhancements better than if you simply trained them alone. While they won't ever truly blend together into a single cohesive unit, they'll be so optimized and fine-tuned that they may as well behave like one.

In addition, as your Quirks strengthen and evolve, not only will they adapt and mutate to become better, but they will also quite literally grow, forming 'buds' of a sort both by themselves and with other Quirks, which will eventually bloom into fully-fledged Quirks of their own with abilities based on those of their 'parents'. Bear in mind, however, that this is a very slow process, taking at least one or more years for new Quirks to fully form, though this budding can potentially occur for every Quirk in your collection.
objects.title: Demon Lord (My Hero Academia)

objects.text:
In addition to your initial arsenal of Quirks, you now have in your stockpile: all Quirks that were or are owned by any user of the Quirk All For One. Any instances of the All for One Quirk counts, including imperfect copies.

These Quirks are in a usable state, thus Fierce Wings is actually intact and New Order won't mess up your stockpile.
objects.title: Symbol of Evil (My Hero Academia)

objects.text: One for All and All for One have merged into a singular Quirk called Musketeer that embodies and yet defies the Quirk Singularity Theory, with your Quirk stockpile possessing all Quirks that exists or has existed, with all of them in a perfectly usable state and supercharged by One for All's stockpile. Musketeer allows you to treat any Quirk within your stockpile as part of each other and even itself, allowing you to effectively merge Quirks without doing so. Your Quirks can essentially create offspring with each other, resulting in new Quirks that are stronger than their parents but will never be dangerous for you—which means you will never have a Dabi situation where a Quirk gives you no resistance to itself, for example—although the gestation generally takes 9 months, not only can your Quirks create multiple offspring simultaneously but with multiple different Quirks at the same time. You and your Vestige are now one and the same, meaning you are always aware within the Vestige World. Your consciousness infuses itself into any Quirks that exist within the same dimension as you, giving you perfect control over them and access to the knowledge and experience of their users. As long as Quirks exist, you are effectively immortal because you can take over the bodies of any Quirk users infused with your consciousness, and if you died, you would be able to restore all your Quirks within the body of a Quirk user of your choice.
objects.title: The Living Singularity (My Hero Academia)

objects.text:
It seems that along with inheriting the Quirk All for One, you’ve also acquired the phenomenon of Vestiges. These are lingering imprints of the consciousness or essence of a Quirk’s original owner, embedded within the Quirk itself. Normally, only a select few powers manifest such echoes, but in your case, this effect has been drastically amplified. Now, every Quirk or power you steal, no matter how minor or obscure, will generate a corresponding Vestige within you, even if that power was never supposed to leave behind such a trace.

These Vestiges possess thoughts, personalities, and insights that the original users held. With enough time, you could potentially converse with them, learn from them, or be influenced by their ideals and perspectives. This phenomenon turns your inner world into a kind of living archive, a mental realm populated by the fragments of every ability you’ve ever claimed. While this may offer a deep well of experience and potential cooperation, it also introduces the risk of internal conflict or mental strain depending on the nature and number of the minds within you.

Included with this is the optional presence of All for One’s own Vestige. Should you accept it, his echo will recognize you as his successor and may choose to guide or manipulate you accordingly. His vast experience with Quirks, strategies, and power dynamics could be an invaluable asset, but his ambition and ideology remain unchanged. Whether he becomes a mentor, an advisor, or a threat within your own mind will depend entirely on how you handle his lingering will.
objects.title: Vestiges (My Hero Academia)

objects.text:
Your Kagune has gone through an evolution, making you a Kakuja. Kakujas are ghouls with a specialized kagune that completely transforms their bodies. This transformation occurs through the process of cannibalism, where the ghoul absorbs high concentrations of Rc cells. Once the Rc cell concentration reaches a certain level, it triggers a mutation and a new type of kagune forms. In contrast to the standard predatory Kagune, a Kakuja possesses a specialized Kagune that serves as armour for the entire body, significantly enhancing their strength. Unlike most Kakuja, you are capable of retaining full control over yourself when in combat.

In addition to this, your Kagune has evolved to be able to take the shape of any of the 4 types of Kagune while you have your Kakuja armour on. This does not allow you to create Chimera Kagune or a Ghoul Specialty.
objects.title: Kakuja (Tokyo Ghoul)

objects.text:
It is a rare case among ghouls that allows you to have 2 or more kagune and they can be used simultaneously, this mitigates the defects of each type of kagune you possess and increasing the advantages when using them in combination.

You will also be able to fuse them into a new type of kagune that will be more than the sum of its parts, similar to the Eos kaneki, it all depends on how skilled you are.

With experience you will be able to manipulate the shape of the types of kagune you have.
objects.title: Chimera Kagune (Tokyo Ghoul)

objects.text: You can choose rare and unique abilities seen in other Ghouls: Pseudo-electrokinesis: You can generate/discharge condensed RC cells as electricity from your Kagune, a form of bio-electricity powerful enough to be mistaken for lightning. Capable of controlling the amount of electricity you can discharge at a time, going from light shocks to blowing apart a wall with ease. Pseudo-pyrokinesis: You can emit highly concentrated mutated RC cells from your Kagune that ignite and generate flames that reach 4000 °C. Capable of regulating the amount of fire produced, from a small stream to a large wave of fire that could engulf several enemies in one quick attack. RC energy wave: You can condense and release large amounts of RC cells from your Kagune as a highly concentrated beam or wave of energy. RC explosives: You can lob off pieces of your Kagune to use as explosives, with the strength of these explosions depending on the concentration/density of RC cells within the piece and how large it is. High-speed regeneration: You have incredible levels of regeneration, even among Ghouls, from reattaching severed limbs to regrowing a new lower half after being cut in twain. With your regeneration, you can survive injuries that would be fatal to most as long as you have enough RC cells to regenerate yourself. Shapeshifting: This allows you to warp and alter your body shape as you wish, able to model detailed facial features and body structures however you like. e.g., from transforming your hands into claws to imitating others' appearance well enough to fool even those familiar with the individual you're imitating, to even reversing your physical appearance to your prime to stay young. How far this can be pushed depends on your mastery. Kagune Healing: You can use your Kagune to heal injuries ranging from scrapes and bruises to fatal wounds. This ability works on other ghouls, humans (with some complications due to increased RC factors), and yourself, although recovery rates vary for each individual. This ability is not exclusively hereditary and can be learned. Kagune Manipulation: This ability allows you to transform your Kagune, contorting and shaping it into anything you can imagine, all to the whims of your desire, such as limbs, eyes, and mouths, and even imitating other Ghoul's Kagune appearances. Kagune Detachment: You can separate and control your Kagune for multiple purposes, maintaining its traits and functionality for a time, independently of the main body. For example, you could place and set traps with it, use it to form walls, control multiple pieces to attack independently of yourself and use it as a communication relay. The only limitation is your imagination and mastery over this ability. This ability synergizes very well with Kagune Manipulation.
objects.title: Ghoul Specialties (Tokyo Ghoul)

objects.text: It appears you weren't a ghoul, but rather a half-ghoul—more commonly known as a one-eyed ghoul, named for their singular kakugan. And a natural one at that. But even if you were an artificial one, it wouldn't change the fact: one-eyed ghouls are universally regarded as stronger than regular ghouls due to hybrid vigor, granting them greater strength and potential. Many of the most powerful ghouls in the series are, after all, half-ghouls. As a one-eyed ghoul, your potential will rival that of Kaneki Ken himself. You'll grow stronger at an accelerated pace, adapting quickly and mastering your kagune with ease. In fact, you are virtually guaranteed to reach the level of a kakuja in time, without the need for cannibalism. Even now, your strength is enough to face Jason in his kakuja form with little difficulty. Moreover, as a half-ghoul, you'll grow stronger the more you're injured and heal from it over time. In addition, your hybrid nature grants you a unique scent—something caught between human and ghoul. Whether it leans more toward one side or strikes a perfect balance depends on you; no matter the case, it's simply enticing to other ghouls, and not only that, since your flesh and blood will also carry a particularly appealing taste to it as well. Finally, as a natural one-eyed ghoul, you can eat and enjoy normal human food again without any adverse effects.
objects.title: One-Eyed Ghoul

objects.text:
As someone who has Gourmet Cells within your body, you crave evermore nutritious and delicious food which the earth simply cannot provide but fear not for You can now at will enter an endless dimension filled with all manner of dangerous, exotic, and most importantly delicious flora, fauna, and environment. The more dangerous, powerful, and difficult to cook an ingredient, the more delicious it will be.

Even ingredients that can rival the quality of Acacia full course or as powerful as the eight kings and beyond can be found here. hunt, devour, and cook to your heart's content for there is always something that will satisfy your tastebuds and stomach within this gourmet paradise.
objects.title: Gourmet Hunter Paradise (Toriko)

objects.text:
You have consumed all 8 courses of the legendary Full Course Menu of Acacia, the greatest Gourmet Hunter. Each of the dishes unlocks the full potential of your Gourmet Cells and grants you new abilities. Through this, you have also discovered that your cells have been possessed by an ancient spirit known as an Appetite Demon, roused from its slumber by the power of the meals you have consumed. 

All of the Gourmet Cells in your body have now fully awakened, allowing your body to fully take on the physical attributes and powers of the Appetite Demon within. You can also manifest the Appetite Demon as a separate entity to fight alongside you.

The courses also grant more esoteric powers, including access to an alternate dimension known as the Back Channel, the ability to gain nutrition from any existing matter, powerful regeneration, communication with the deceased, and techniques like Warp Road and Warp Kitchen. You also gain the required energy to use these powers without strain via consumption of the courses.
objects.title: Full Course Meal of the Bishokukushin (Toriko)

objects.text:
Your New God physiology, combined with your Gourmet Cells, has evolved into something immensely powerful. You now possess a second concept of Appetite, in addition to the concept you previously selected. This grants you full mastery over Appetite Energy, enabling you to replicate any technique seen in Toriko. This includes biological adaptations such as Sunny’s hair and Midora’s mirror neurons. You also gain access to martial techniques like Knocking, Food Luck, and Food Immersion, with expertise comparable to Jirou and Acacia.

You can summon kitchenware and weapons, such as the Cinderella Knife, effortlessly. As an interstellar predator, you are on par with Neo, capable of devouring entire galaxies. Unlike Neo, however, your appetite and powers are fully under your control.

But your power is not solely destructive. Appetite Energy also represents life force, and as such, you embody this duality. You can use your Appetite Energy to heal others and rejuvenate ecosystems, much like Midora’s Gourmet Spice ability. Just as the Gourmet Cells birthed ingredients and beings like the Nitro, you can create virtually any ingredient or life form from the Red or Blue Universe, and induce evolution within other ecosystems.

You stand at the crossroads of becoming a universe-devouring calamity or a renewer of life. The choice is yours.
objects.title: New God of Appetite

objects.text: You are the result of a loophole in nature—a child conceived by the original hybrid and a witch. You are an even more unnatural abomination than a vampire and werewolf hybrid. While a witch is someone who upholds the natural order of the world, vampires and werewolves are the antithesis of the world, unnatural beings that should not exist. Normally, such a creature with all three characteristics shouldn't have been allowed to happen. There are now no known limits on your abilities, as a coven of witches would normally require a great deal of energy to cast spells of the nature you can cast without a second thought. Your magic is so powerful that your only equals would be gods and Arcadius, someone who, upon his death, created an entire dimension under his control. Along with your magic, you have increased power in your vampiric and werewolf abilities, being able to compel beings to a greater degree than the original and even compel beings normally resistant to such abilities. With magic, your ability to grow in strength as you age has been further enhanced so that you can surpass the version of yourself a week earlier. Unlike Hope, you start with all your abilities already awakened, so you don't need to kill someone or die for them to awaken. Whilst your physical abilities are no longer your only avenue of attack, they are still strengthened to a level beyond what a hybrid can do, being able to crack continents with little effort, and with enough effort, you could crack the moon. Your speed has reached unmatched levels, and you can now move as fast as light and, with enough effort, faster. You may choose what color your eyes glow when using your abilities.
objects.title: Tribrid (Originals)

objects.text:
You have unlocked the full potential of your angelic heritage, enabling you to transform into a true Angel at will. This form enhances both your appearance and abilities, allowing you to emulate an existing Angel designs or a unique one of your own. You can effortlessly switch between your Half Angel and Full Angel forms at your convenience.

In your Angel form, your AT-Field reaches a level comparable to the mightiest Angels, such as Zeruel, Ramiel, and even Adam, allowing it to withstand even greater assaults, including N2 explosions, positron cannons, and even the Spear of Longinus. Furthermore, your AT-Field has the capacity to be shaped into intricate and potent forms like lasers, bombs, or even warping space-time around you to construct portals. You can even use your AT-Field to instantly regenerate you from any injury, even if your core is damaged or destroyed.

Moreover, your AT-Field now can also influence the souls of other entities, facilitating the creation of links that enable you to synchronize with beings or objects. This synchronization permits telepathic communication, sharing of information or memories, manipulation of actions or emotions, and even fusion with other entities or objects. This newfound power extends to weakening, strengthening, disrupting, or even absorbing the AT-Fields of others.

Inside of your Angel form is the N2 core—the wellspring of your vitality and might—that you have full control over. You can reposition it within your form, conceal it within your AT-Field, or divide it into multiple cores. Your core can also serve as a formidable weapon or explosive, either through detonation or as a projectile to assail adversaries.
objects.title: Child of Adam (Neon Genesis Evangelion)

objects.text:
You have the ability to create and control your own Angels, the mysterious and powerful beings that threaten humanity. You can design their appearance, abilities, and personalities, drawing inspiration from the existing Angels or your own imagination. You can have up to twelve Angels active at a time, each with a unique name and core. Your Angels are loyal to you and will follow your commands, unless you give them free will and let them act on their own. You can also communicate with them telepathically, sense their location and status, and recall them to your side at any time.

Your Angels are formidable foes for anyone who dares to oppose you. They possess strong AT Fields that can protect them from most attacks and manipulate reality in various ways. They can also use different forms of energy projection, such as beams, blasts, or waves, to attack from a distance or close range. Some of your Angels may have additional abilities, such as shapeshifting, regeneration, hacking, or mind control, depending on how you design them. Your Angels are also immune to conventional weapons and can only be harmed by other beings with AT Fields or esoteric weapons like them.

Creating an Angel requires a lot of energy, as such you can only create 3 per day. During the creation process you can infuse the Angels with the genetic material of other beings, through this, you can facilitate a unique Angel with the traits of their donors. You can also modify or upgrade your existing Angels by spending more energy and time on them. However, you cannot create an Angel that surpasses the power of Adam or Lilith.
An intriguing aspect of your Angels is they each boasts a secondary, miniaturized form, often referred to as their "Chibify" state. This form grants them the ability to shrink down to the size of a person or even as diminutive as a mouse. Furthermore, through a dematerialization process, you're able to deactivate, and store a selection of Angels, ensuring a versatile and adaptable active roster.
objects.title: Father of Angels (Neon Genesis Evangelion)

objects.text:
Through the fusion of the Seed of Life and the Seed of Knowledge, you have transcended mortal constraints, ascending to a realm akin to the First Ancestral Race. This newfound pinnacle of power shatters the previous limitations of your Adam and Lilith-based abilities, enabling you to create, and wield dominion over countless array of Angels that eclipse even the might of Adam and Lilith.

Moreover, your AT-Field has undergone a profound metamorphosis, evolving into an all-encompassing force that subsume reality itself to mold it according to your desires. The very fabric of existence bends to your will, facilitating accomplishments that were previously deemed unattainable. Whether it's effortlessly navigating the cosmos, breaching the confines of universes, crafting colossal constructs that dwarf moons, and even elevating individuals to higher states of being without necessitating an Impact, all these endeavors become effortless extensions of your newfound ascension.

In this state, you stand as a living testament to the legacy of the First Ancestral Race, inheriting every facet of their existence. From their esoteric technology to their god-like powers and collective knowledge, all lie within your grasp.
objects.title: The First Ancestral Race (Neon Genesis Evangelion)

addons.text: You have inherited Kratos' powers, from when he was a demigod on his quest to kill Ares, to when he became the God of War and ultimately defeated Zeus. This grants you all the skills, knowledge, weapons, and abilities he possessed during that time. Additionally, the Blades of Chaos become one of your symbols of power. While you can still choose a domain other than war, selecting one that synergizes well with war will significantly enhance your base power, elevating it to the level of Zeus himself.
addons.title: Ghost of Sparta

addons.text:
You have mantled the God of the Sky, Zeus. This has granted you his domains of the Sky, Thunder, Lightning, Storms, Hospitality, Law, Weather, Clouds, Justice, Fate, and the Heavens itself. You also gain all of his items, knowledge, skills, magic, abilities, and, if you wish, the memories he had in life.

The sheer amount of power you now possess grants you complete authority over the sky, allowing you to instantly create storms capable of covering a continent in a short amount of time and the entire world in at most a day. You have the ability to control every aspect of these storms, striking only your chosen targets with lightning bolts capable of destroying buildings in a single strike. These bolts grow in power and strength as you do.

Additionally, you are a masterful smith, able to create powerful divine weapons such as the Blade of Olympus by using the heavens and the earth itself as materials, as well as your own divine blood to enhance these creations. 

You also have some ability at touching and interacting with concepts. Such as using the concept of heavens and earth to make weapons or grabbing fear itself.

As the Ruler of the Olympians, you gain the ability to empower others to godhood of a similar nature to your own and revoke this gift at any time. You also gain Olympus itself as a base, which you can position anywhere and even move as you see fit. 

Furthermore, you retain your previous Major Domain and two Secondary Domains. Zeus' Blade of Olympus becomes a second symbol of power for you, in addition to the one you already possess. Having domains and a symbol of power that resonate with Zeus' essence will greatly enhance your strength.
addons.title: Lord of the Heavens

addons.text:
You have mantled the God of the Seas, Poseidon. This has granted you his domains of Seas, Rivers, Water, Storms, Tempests, Winds, Hurricanes, Rain, Floods, Drought, Earthquakes, and Horses. You also gain all his items, knowledge, skills, magic, abilities, and, if you wish, the memories he had in life.

This allows you to easily perform feats such as generating water ex nihilo, transforming into giant sea monsters, flooding a continent in a short amount of time, purifying all bodies of water at once on planetary scale, creating rain that revitalizes and heals the land or the people it touches, or even conjuring dangerous superstorms. You are effectively invincible as long as you are near water under your control.

You do not lose your previous Major Domain and two Secondary Domains. Poseidon's Trident becomes a second symbol of power for you, in addition to the one you already have. Possessing domains and a symbol of power that resonate with Poseidon's will greatly elevate your strength.
addons.title: Lord of the Seas

addons.text:
The entirety of Greek cosmology, after Kratos destroyed it, has merged with your Personal World and been completely restored. Due to the absence of any other gods, you have assumed the duties of all deities, with your Personal World automatically managing aspects like the weather and the underworld using your power.

All the mortals, whether dead or on the verge of death, know about the salvation and mercy you've done in saving them from a potential non existence. They have become fanatically loyal to you as their new God(dess). Through the immense number of prayers directed toward you and your newfound responsibilities, you have taken on the domains of every Olympian and Greek god, granting you power that dwarfs even Zeus and Kratos. Additionally, because all the gods have been slain and Kratos lost or abandoned his weapons, you have gained control of their weapons and artifacts, such as the Blade of Olympus, Poseidon’s Trident, and Artemis’ Sword. You have also inherited their structures as your personal seats of power, examples including Mount Olympus and Atlantis.

Your resistance to Fate, Time, and Destiny has evolved into complete immunity. To permanently kill you, one would have to eliminate all your worshippers, utterly destroy the underworld, and then defeat you in battle before you could resurrect them. Such a thing will be hard to do as your Personal World enforces your authority in all of Greece, weakening hostile foreign deities and eroding unwanted technology.

Moreover, you have the option to bring any monsters or supernatural beings from the Greek world into your Personal World. Their loyalty to you depends on their sentience and the extent of their fear of you.
addons.title: Successor of the Olympians

objects.text:
You are no longer a 'minor' god. You are a Major God on the level of Ares, able to even become more powerful than Zeus.

Your divine physiology is improved. Now, the only way you can even take damage is if the source has any divinity. Without anti-immortal or anti-divine weaponry, mortals are completely incapable of damaging you.

A demigod can hurt you, but even they are weak to your power.

Your strength grows leaps and bounds, able to temporarily keep all of Creation above your head, a strength immeasurable.

You gain significant protection against Fate, Time, and Destiny. 

Your power grows significantly with worship.

Attacks that target your soul are significantly weaker and your powers are incredibly hard to copy or take. Your domain grows significantly, becoming a Major Domain with two secondary minor domains.

Your shapeshifting increases significantly, allowing you to grow to sizes surpassing modern day skyscrapers. On top of all of this, you gain a weapon or pair of weapons that embody your domain. Hades had the Claws of Hades, allowing him to rip people's souls out of their bodies, even Titans. Using this, he could also summon souls anywhere from the claws.
