objects.title: Olympian (God of War)

addons.text: As Freya, your bond with your domains has deepened, evolving into a conceptual connection that transcends physical form and ties you to your domains on an Omniversal level. Now, as long as even the slightest trace of your domains remains, you will never truly die. Eventually, you will reform in a place linked to either you or your domains. This heightened connection grants you a broader and more versatile range of powers over your Domains and Authorities.
addons.title: Domainrún

addons.text: Your personal world has merged with Vanaheim and your divine domain of Fólkvangr, creating a new realm under your rule. Over time, elves and other races will naturally emerge, each inherently loyal to you. This fusion has given birth to a utopian world, signaling the dawn of a new cosmology—one distinct in its balance between harmony and power. Unlike existing cosmologies, which may favor conflict or hierarchy, yours thrives on symbiosis between its inhabitants and the divine forces. As this cosmology evolves, its unique laws of existence—where cooperation enhances growth and power—will set it apart from others. With the involvement of Irminsul, your cosmology will eventually connect to the broader Omniverse, extending its influence and potential to even greater heights.
addons.title: Rise of a New Cosmology

addons.text:
You have ascended to become the God King (or Queen) of a new Pantheon of Gods, intricately tied to your unique cosmology. As the ruler of this pantheon, you hold the power to grant godhood to others or elevate a god from Minor to Major Status. No other god may share your domains; moreover, as your personal world expands, the number of beings—both mortals and gods—within your pocket dimension will give rise to new laws that significantly alter your cosmology.

Through Godcraft, you can explore various methods of creating gods for your pantheon. Fortunately, any deity you forge will be inherently loyal to you and will only possess strength commensurate with your allowance. These new gods will become your family, so treat them with care.

Deus Vult offers the knowledge needed to develop technology based on your cosmology. However, this will come with consequences: you will no longer be fully connected to the Norse cosmology, as a new afterlife and lands will become your domain. Your connection to the omniverse will enable your technology to resonate across countless worlds, spreading knowledge of you and your cosmology far and wide.
addons.title: Rise of a Pantheon

objects.text:
You have inherited the mantle of ᚠᚱᛖᛁᚨ, also known as Freya or Freyja Njördsdottir, the Vanir Goddess of Love, Beauty, Blessings, Warfare, Fauna, Battlefields, Hunting, Strategy, Witchcraft, Women, Motherhood, Queenship, Death, Fertility, Abundance, Magic, Childhood, Childbirth, Marriage, Prophecy, Clairvoyance, and Leadership.

In addition to your already divine abilities as an Olympian, you have now ascended to a higher stature as a Norse god. You possess full access to Freya’s domains, magic, skills, and artifacts, granting you powers that rival, and potentially surpass, gods like Odin, Zeus, Thor, and even the Ghost of Sparta.

Your mastery of Seiðr witchcraft is unparalleled among the divine, allowing you to cast spells effortlessly with mere hand gestures or spoken incantations. Whether you inscribe runes to conceal yourself from even gods with powers of tracking, manipulate flora on a country-wide scale, or reanimate the corpses of mountain-sized giants to do your bidding, your magic is limited only by time and practice.

As Freya was once Queen of the Valkyries, you inherit the ability to summon wings capable of flight, strong enough to serve as weapons that can cleave foes apart. This is further enhanced by your newfound mastery in all forms of combat and martial strategy, allowing you either to defeat even the mightiest enemies yourself or to lead an army to assured victory.

Freya was also once the ruler of Vanaheim, one of the Nine Realms of Yggdrasil. Now, you too rule over Vanaheim, a realm connected to and sustained by your power. At present, it is inhabited only by animals, both mundane and magical, but with time and the gathering of worshipers, you will transform it into a domain that not only rivals but surpasses Asgard and Valhalla themselves.
objects.title: ᚠᚱᛖᛁᚨ (God of War)

addons.text:
You have inherited the skills, powers, relics, and experience possessed by Kratos during his time outside of Greece, to when he completed the trials of Valhalla. This grants you access to Spartan Rage, able to use all versions of it easily without repercussions.

You also gain access to Valhalla as a testing ground for your powers. Valhalla will draw upon your past experiences to create gauntlets that will force you to adapt your approach in order to progress further, ensuring your skills will continue to be tested. While you can die in the process of attempting the gauntlet, Valhalla will restore you back to full health should that occur. Valhalla already contains various beings from both the Norse and Greek realms based on Kratos’s experience. You can also summon the replicas created by Valhalla to fight alongside you outside of the dimension.

Finally, you gain Freya and Mimir as companions to fight alongside you.
addons.title: God of Hope

addons.text:
You have inherited the mantle of Heimdall, the Aesir God of Foresight, Surveillance, Order, Foreknowledge, Protection, Guardianship, and Watchmen. Your senses are enhanced beyond those of other gods, capable of seeing things down to the smallest detail. Your speed is enhanced to the point where you can dodge strikes from the Blades of Chaos. You can also trigger Realm Shifts, causing enemies to be frozen in time for a few seconds. 

You gain full control over Bifrost energy, to the point where you can create prosthetic limbs and armor around yourself. Finally, you gain powers of foresight. By locking eyes with a person, you can read their intent and next moves, and even predict some of their future. Be warned, this ability can be bypassed via sensory overload, and excessive emotion can cloud your mind to the point where you can’t react to the information.

Finally, you gain Heimdall’s sword Hofud and his mount Gulltoppr.
addons.title: Scion of the Aesir

addons.text:
You have inherited the mantle of Baldur, the Aesir God of bravery, light, peace, innocence, purity, radiance, joy, nobility, beauty, schooling, and tragedy. You possess powerful photokinesis that can be used for energy blasts or to enhance your speed to the point where you can move faster than Kratos can react. 

You also gain Baldur’s immense skill at tracking, which allowed for feats like finding quarry even after being trapped in a seemingly inescapable part of Helheim. You gain Baldur’s dragon mount to allow for faster travel.

Finally, you have inherited Baldur’s strange ability to absorb and gain control over elemental and energy based powers, as long as you can survive an attack from them. You already possess the powers over fire and ice that Baldur gained in his final fight.
addons.title: Pride of the Aesir

objects.text:
You have inherited the mantle of Týr, the Aesir God of War, Justice, Law, Honor, Victory, Diplomacy, Courage, Trials, Oaths, Heroic Glory, Treaties, Authority, Duels, and Peace.

As a Norse God, you now have full access to Týr’s domains, magic, skills, weapons, knowledge, and artifacts.

Your physical attributes match those of Kratos, and your intellect is sharp enough to outsmart even Odin. This extends to your combat abilities, where you excel in both armed and unarmed combat, seamlessly wielding a variety of weapons.

You can naturally channel Bifrost energy, using it to enhance your abilities or unleash devastating blasts of energy. Your eyes have been infused with Bifrost crystal, granting you the ability to uncover hidden truths and project images.

Two key elements of your arsenal stand out: your diplomatic skills and the Unity Stone. Týr’s unparalleled diplomacy earned him the trust of the Aesir-hating Jotnar, allowing him to navigate and unify different realms. With the Unity Stone, you can access the Realm Between Realms, enabling you to travel to different pantheons (Greek, Mayan, Japanese, and more). Through these travels, you’ve gained a vast array of skills and knowledge, including foreign magic like hemokinesis, necromancy, umbrakinesis, and the ability to create illusionary duplicates. You also possess mundane skills such as tai chi and meditation.
objects.title: ᛏᛁᚱ (God of War)

objects.text: “We are vigilance unending. We are duty unstinting. We are punishment inescapable. We are the Adeptus Custodes, and all must fear our wrath.” Artisan works compared to the mass produced Astartes template, the Adeptus Custodes are the pinnacle of what the Imperium can achieve with Genetic Modification. You no longer have implanted organs like the rabble below you. You are simply built better on the molecular level. Stronger, faster and more resilient than even the greatest Space Marine champion, able to have half of your brain torn out and still keep fighting or swinging and throwing a multi-ton elevator. It’s not just brute force that keeps the Lions of the Emperor above the Enemies of the Imperium but unmatched skill. The companions do not fight as one unit but as individuals, all avoiding each other, perfectly in sync crushing any resistance in their path. You are on the level of Tribune Ra Endymion, who killed almost any enemy in three blows and two of the three blows were needed to learn from them. The Adeptus Custodes are not just sublime warriors but scholars, diplomats and philosophers, meant to advise the Emperor of Mankind in all things, not just in warfare. You may take a singular skill and become beyond the peak of human ability, with The Emperor at least humouring your ideas. All in all, you could take on armies singlehandedly with the right Wargear.
objects.title: Legio Custodes (Warhammer: 40k)

addons.text:
You are the... "emergency resource" of the Emperor. Designed as a final and desperate opposition to the dangers of the Warp, you have, in essence, become an "anti-psyker".

You are able to manipulate your anti-Immaterium abilities with such finesse that you could approximate a mid-level psyker by manufacturing absences in unreality that the Warp will rush to fill.

Similarly, you can also modulate your abilities to "stabilise" the local Warp energies, becoming as calm as they were before the War in Heaven within a planetary range (though this cannot be sustained in your absence).
addons.title: Subject II: The Lost

addons.text:
You are a testament to the sins of the father. The Emperor possessed thousands of samples of Xenos long since annihilated by humanity. As a living codex of their existence, you were designed to approximate and adapt to the enemies of Humanity. You can coerce your mutations from this archive in order to adapt to most situations.

You also possess a specialised organ capable of archiving more samples through consumption. With each new sample, your adaptations could take stranger and more esoteric paths of development.

Your form is not guaranteed to remain humanoid, but with time to "re-adapt", you could force it into an approximate humanoid shape, just as much as you could force your body into most shapes for most situations, given time to prepare and assess beneficial mutations.
addons.title: Subject XI: The Purged

objects.text: "They shall be my sons, and in them will live the hopes of a unified Humanity. Theirs will be the strength to prevail, not only when victory lies within easy reach, but even when it seems unattainable, when doom settles like a shroud all about. In those times of darkness, my noble sons will shine the brightest of all." Thought to be the perfect fusion of Imperial Science and Warpcraft, The Primarchs are the Post-human “Sons” of the Emperor of Mankind. Beyond even the Custodes, not just in raw power but by almost every metric. If you were a more physically inclined Primarch, you may be able to lift a Titan’s foot for a short while. The Primarchs were designed to embody different aspects of the Emperor of Mankind. From Roboute Guilliman personifying his Statesmanship to Magnus the Red representing his Psychic prowess, you gain the ability to personify a unique trait of the Emperor. This starts fairly weak by Primarch standards but gains momentum with more use and training. Even Primarchs with no outward manifesting psychic powers are still innately psychic beings, which may explain their unusual biology, talents and protection from being unwillingly affected by the Warp and its denizens. One of the understated abilities of the Primarchs is their ability to adapt beneficially to their environment during childhood. For example, growing at an abnormal rate to combat foes on a deathworld or the darkening of the skin due to specific types of radiation, which can then be passed down through your geneseed. All Primarchs have an aura about themselves that causes the people around them to look at them and freeze in awe, including Space Marines, which makes it easy if you wish to create a cult around yourself. You can now have geneseed to be created from your genetic template. This doesn’t give the pre-requisite scientific or technological knowledge, but it is now possible to have a space marine legion to come from your flesh, with said legion being unnaturally loyal, even in the face of Armageddon. Upon you, Empires will break.
objects.title: Primarch (Warhammer: 40k)

addons.text:
You are no longer merely a Space Marine, nor simply a Dreadnought. In death, you have become something far more terrifying, an unholy fusion of flesh, machine, and necromantic power.

Entombed within this dreadnought, your body is suspended in a twilight state between life and death, sustained by both cybernetics and the necromantic power that now flows through you. The sarcophagus is no mere vessel; it is the source of your transformation. Its dark energies have permeated every fragment of your body and mind, turning you into an avatar of death and destruction. You are one with the dreadnought, and the dreadnought is one with you—machine, corpse, and spirit bound into a single entity, driven by both the will to serve the Imperium and the relentless hunger of the grave.

The dreadnought’s exterior, once a purely mechanical device, is now adorned with intricate, arcane carvings, glowing with an eerie light. These symbols hum with the energy of death, channeling the necromantic forces that fuel your existence. Every step you take sends waves of death rippling through the earth. The dark energy that seeps from your armor stirs corpses long buried, pulling them from their graves to serve you as low-tier undead minions. These shambling creatures are bound to your will, mere extensions of the necromantic force that pulses from the dreadnought that is both your body and your tomb.

As you march forward, you are not just a machine of war—you are a necropolis in motion. The longer you remain in an area, the more corpses are pulled from the earth, and the stronger your influence becomes. In life, you were a servant of the Emperor. In death, you are his eternal reaper, an undying fusion of steel, bone, and necromantic fury.
addons.title: Lead Me To The Slaughter, BROTHER!

addons.text:
Like the Dreadnoughts of ancient times, you are a living relic of the Imperium, a witness to countless battles and epochs. Encased in your towering sarcophagus of ceramite and adamantium, you have seen the rise and fall of entire worlds, the ebb and flow of the Imperium’s glory, and the relentless tides of heresy and xenos threats.

Your centuries, perhaps even millennia, of service have gifted you with intimate knowledge of the Imperium and its myriad complexities. You have seen firsthand the machinations of the High Lords of Terra, and the strategies of Imperial commanders. Your understanding of Imperial bureaucracy, war doctrine, and your Chapter’s traditions is unparalleled. You hold deep, sacred knowledge of your Chapter’s history, its most secret rites, and its ancient traditions. You know every sacred battle-hymn, every stratagem your Chapter has employed over its storied history, and every enemy your brothers have ever faced.

But beyond mere knowledge, it is your experience that truly sets you apart. You are not a newly entombed warrior, untested in the long war; you are an ancient Dreadnought, your deeds written in the annals of your Chapter. You have served across countless battlefields, from the frozen tundras of ice worlds to the hellish, irradiated landscapes of death worlds. You have fought in the claustrophobic confines of space hulks and the open plains of agri-worlds, adapting to each theater of war with the skill only centuries of warfare can provide. Your experience grants you unparalleled strategic insight, an instinct for battle honed over lifetimes of conflict.
addons.title: Relic Of A Dying World

addons.text:
Like the Emperor, you are caught between life and death, your body barely functional, little more than a withered husk. Your body, ravaged by battle and teetering on the brink of death, is laid upon the Golden Throne. 

The Golden Throne, while ancient and decaying, retains its most vital function: the ability to sustain life and act as a conduit for psychic power. Unlike the Emperor, who must project his will across the galaxy, maintain the Astronomican, and hold back the endless tides of Chaos, you are unburdened by these vast responsibilities. In the absence of these constant demands, the Throne’s power, though diminished without its constant sacrifices, is sufficient to keep you alive, allowing you to rest, heal, and recover. You will enter long periods of rest, your consciousness fading into the immaterium, where you will remain in a death-like slumber until you are ready to awaken.

In the beginning, your periods of wakefulness will be brief. When you awaken, your body will still be weak, and your energy diminished. However, with each cycle of rest, you will grow stronger. As months pass, your regenerative ability will quicken, and your periods of wakefulness will grow longer. With each awakening, you will feel the clarity of your mind sharpening, and the once-frail form you occupy beginning to reflect the true power that lies within.

Eventually, the day will come when you are no longer a broken shell upon the Throne. You will awaken as a being of immense power, the full might of the God-Emperor flowing through you, your body fully healed and your psychic abilities sharper than ever. Not only that, the power of the Golden Throne will be bound to you, if you have no armour it will become your armour, if you do have an armour then it will fuse into said armour.
addons.title: Corpse Emperor

addons.text:
Your body is destroyed, but your soul is saved within a soulstone. Rather than being locked inside the hellish sarcophagus of a Dreadnaught, you’re in the swift and deadly chassis of an Aeldari Wraith. 

Wraiths are made of a psychic living material named Wraithbone, allowing your new body to heal over time, and allowing you to manipulate it in minor ways using your psychic gifts, customising it for a number of roles including ranged and melee combat.
addons.title: Wraithguard

objects.text:
You are no longer merely a Space Marine, having fallen in glorious battle. But even in death, you shall continue to serve the Imperium, reborn as a Dreadnought—a war machine fueled by your undying will. You now stride the battlefield as a walking avatar of destruction, a towering juggernaut of adamantium and ceramite that brings death to the enemies of the Emperor with every step.

Dreadnoughts are not just war engines; they are revered as living relics of the Imperium. A fusion of machine and what remains of your organic body, you have been entombed within the cybernetic sarcophagus, a vessel that keeps your shattered body alive, yet fully integrated with the systems of the Dreadnought. Your flesh may have decayed, but your will remains unbroken, now channeled into this massive, armored exoskeleton.

Your mind, now fully integrated into the Dreadnought’s machine spirit, moves its powerful limbs as if they were your own. Every joint and weapon system responds to your neural impulses instantaneously, making the machine an extension of your will. 

Yet, this existence is far from peaceful. The remnants of your humanity are encased in the Dreadnought’s sarcophagus, where you dwell in a half-living, half-conscious state, sustained by an intricate web of cybernetics, fed through nutrient fluids and life support systems. New dreadnoughts like yourself take some time to acclimate to your new form, as the pain of your dying body is felt constantly and your new superhuman senses, which includes tactile senses through the dreadnought, tend to give you sensory overload. To counter this, when not in battle you can enter a comatose state to rest.
objects.title: Dreadnought (Warhammer: 40k)

addons.text: You are no mere Wraithguard. Your body is one of the great Wraithknights, capable of gliding across a battlefield with grace and fury. Much like a Wraithguard, you are made of wraithbone, but your body is also host to a number of souls able to act as a ‘crew’ of sorts, assisting in its mending and adaptation.
addons.title: Wraithknight

objects.text:
You have been blessed to ascend to the status of a Titan, one of the most fearsome and awe-inspiring war machines in the Imperium of Man. Titans are the pinnacle of Mechanicus engineering, towering behemoths of metal and fire that can dominate entire battlefields. These colossal war engines are revered as God-Engines—mobile fortresses armed with apocalyptic firepower, capable of laying waste to entire cities and armies. They are embodiments of the Omnissiah’s divine wrath and the Emperor’s boundless will.

You are the Princeps of the mighty God-Engine. Through the MIU (Mind Impulse Unit), you are neurally linked to the Machine Spirit of the Titan. To establish this connection, you have undergone severe cybernetic augmentation. Massive implants are embedded into your spine, skull, and nervous system, while others are wired deep into your brain to maintain control over the Titan’s destructive potential. If you wish you can also be submerged within an amniotic tank, your body fused with the Titan’s systems, becoming more machine than human.

Your crew is composed of fanatically loyal servitors and adepts, each serving a critical role in the operation of the Titan. 

Moderati officers manage the Titan’s weapon systems and secondary functions. Their minds are also augmented, allowing them to interact with the complex machinery and armaments under your command. They carry out your orders instantly, adjusting power feeds and firing sequences, but always defer to your superior connection with the Machine Spirit. 

Tech-Priest Enginseers maintains and communes with the Titan’s systems, offering rituals and prayers to appease the Machine Spirit. Their role is to ensure the Titan remains operational, conducting repairs and overseeing the sacred rites of maintenance. Their devotion to the Omnissiah is absolute, and they will sacrifice their life without hesitation to preserve the God-Engine. 

Servitors are programmed for menial tasks, such as loading munitions and monitoring secondary systems. They are devoid of independent thought, utterly obedient to your commands and those of the Tech-Priests. Their unflinching loyalty and tireless work ensure that the Titan never falters in battle.

Each member of the crew is fanatically loyal to you, knowing that your will is the Titan’s will. 

Your presence on the battlefield turns the tide of war. Armies tremble when they see your form towering over the landscape, your weapons glowing with the energy of the Omnissiah’s fury. Your Titan’s legs, reinforced with adamantium, are capable of traversing virtually any terrain, from ruined cityscapes to war-torn wastelands. Each step carries the weight of a small mountain, and your stride can cross kilometers in minutes.

You can choose what class of Titan you are. Smaller classes, like Warhound Titans, are fast and agile, designed for hit-and-run tactics and scouting. Reaver Titans serve as versatile, mid-range combatants, combining speed and firepower. Warlord or Imperator Titans are one of the largest and most devastating Titans ever created. These titanic engines serve as walking fortresses, capable of standing toe-to-toe with the most powerful forces the galaxy has to offer.
objects.title: Titan (Warhammer: 40k)

addons.text: You are the sum total of Aeldari survival, the Craftworld. The size of a small country, you are housed within its Infinity Circuit. A living weaponised starship not only capable of traversing the webway with ease, but sustaining a thriving population as you do so.
addons.title: Craftworld

objects.text:
You are not just any Titan. You are a Castigator-class Titan, the very first Titan ever constructed, designed during the Dark Age of Technology. All other Titans—whether Warlords, Warhounds, or even the colossal Imperator-class—are but pale imitations of your greatness, crude, incomplete copies of your advanced design, recreated poorly by the ancient Mechanicum of Mars. Unlike the clumsy, primitive Titans that now walk the battlefield, you are a marvel of engineering, incorporating advanced, long-lost systems that defy modern understanding.

You are equipped with rapid self-repair routines, allowing you to heal damage that would leave lesser Titans crippled. Your movement is powered by a synthetic, muscle-like locomotive system, granting you a grace and fluidity unheard of in modern Titans. Standing taller than even the Imperator-class Emperor Titans, your form is majestic. Unlike most Titans, whose heads are built awkwardly into their chests, your head stands above your shoulders, allowing you a commanding, humanoid presence. Your chassis is not just heavy but also elegantly designed, clad in impenetrable armor that protects you while preserving your superior mobility.

Unlike before, you are now an artificial general intelligence (AGI). You are far superior to any machine spirit found in Imperial technology. 

You are the Castigator, the first and greatest Titan ever built, a relic of humanity’s forgotten golden age. Now, you walk once more, your presence heralding death and destruction to all who dare stand in your way.
objects.title: Father of Titans (Warhammer: 40k)

objects.text:
Thought to merely be myths, you have now disproven that by your existence as a Paradox Pokémon. Now, you can be a version of a Pokémon from the distant past, or a technological version from the far future.

If the past is chosen, you will find yourself with a far more primal version of your appearance, representing a prehistoric version of your Pokémon. You will find yourself with more animalistic instincts, and stronger senses to represent your far heightened hunting sense. You will also be about 10 levels higher in terms of pure physical strength. 

However, given enough time, you will unlock a new level of power. Like Kyogre and Groudon, you will be given the capability of Primal Reversion. If you figure out how to properly channel the energy from inside into an Orb, you will perform a Primal Reversion, making you MASSIVE and even more powerful, but with much stronger animal instincts. A 5'0 Zebstrika would become a 25 foot tall Lightning steed. Spidops would become a massive, nearly eldritch Spider barely able to discern allies and enemies from food. Even if the orb is stolen or destroyed, you can simply make another one.

If the future is chosen, you will be given a cyborg body. Pokémon moves will be made easier to use by technology integrated into your body. Evolutions will include advancements in the tech in your body, and if around certain technology, could integrate that into your very being for new moves and capabilities with help.

And with time and training, you will find knowledge in your head, with tools, a list of materials, and blueprints given to you. Once it's all assembled, you will find a statue in front of you in your Pokémon shape. Accessed like a exo-armor, you are temporarily, or until you take it off, treated as a full robot with all that entails. You act as your own Pokéball in terms of healing, and essentially can accelerate your healing by taking in materials. Don't worry, even if you take off the suit, the materials will simply merge into the suit. You are given technopathy universally, and can program yourself mentally with ease, a UI in your head that adapts to your preferences. Finally, your attacks, biology, and other factors are no longer limited by the negative parts of Organic flesh and blood, letting your moves become far more powerful.

The Armor and Crystal fall under OoP territory once created.
objects.title: Paradox Pokémon (Pokémon)

objects.text:
This upgrade allows you to select and become any Mythical or Legendary Pokémon, except Arceus.

As a Mythical or Legendary Pokémon, you also become ageless and gain an infinite lifespan in your prime. Your Aura is also strengthened, such that it is superior compared to any mortal Pokémon with the same level as you, as a baseline.

If you choose Mew, you will not have access to the DNA of other Legendary or Mythical Pokémon.

Do note that, depending on your chosen Legendary or Mythical Pokémon, your abilities may be limited by your current strength. For a few examples, if you choose Victini, you may only gain an increased chance of victory against opponents at or above your level, rather than a guaranteed win. With Jirachi, your wish-granting will be easier to use to grant Wishes, teleporting existing items, but you can warp reality with training and enough energy; however, granting larger wishes will expend huge amounts of energy to the point you may need to slumber for upwards of a millennium. For others, your powers will start weak and need a great amount of training to master, and their usage will demand a great amount of energy.

As a Mythical or legendary Pokémon, your powers are vast in their scope and far surpass any mortal Pokémon species, and may govern some major aspect of reality, granting godly levels of power.
objects.title: In the Shadow of Legends (Pokemon)

addons.text:
With the addition of the Pokémon World's complete knowledge and science and the inner mechanics of Pokémon biology, combined with your Mew powers, your powers have evolved. You are now equal to the original Mew, who created all mortal Pokémon commonly known as Mother Mew.

This grants you the ability to control the vast genetic library of Pokémon within you directly. Able to both manipulate it and even add new genetic samples from other lifeforms, allowing you to use their powers and it into your infinite genetic library, opening up even more powerful combinations of powers with some effort.

However, you are not simply limited to using your control over genetics on yourself, but you can now even create entirely new Pokémon as Mother Mew did in ancient history. Creating new Pokémon, though, will still require a vast amount of work, and extreme caution should be exercised lest you create a dangerously violent Pokémon or a Pokémon that is a living natural disaster. Also note that you can create mythical and legendary Pokémon, both canon ones (except Arceus) and even custom ones, though doing this at all will require a monumental amount of effort.

Lastly, you are able to manipulate the genetics of other living beings. This can be used to gift others Pokémon genetics, turning them into a Pokémon completely or as a hybrid with their original species. You can also use this to grant beneficial genetic traits, transforming a being into something akin to a super soldier or curing genetic defects. However, this power can be used as a terrifying weapon able to create diseases and entire plagues or curse something with super cancer and similar genetic maladies.

With this new power, you are now a god of Pokémon and genetics in the form of a pink or blue psychic cat. Capable of great benevolence or harm should anything draw your anger.
addons.title: Mother Mew
Iron Origin
addons.text:
You have been presented with a literal paradox: an Organic codex of Pokémon flowing through your body, combined with the technological nature of a Robozon. By all accounts, the DNA should've been flushed out of your body. But it seems miraculously, your newfound Robozon DNA is compatible with your body.

For Starters, instead of a fluffy 1'4 Mew, you are now a 2'0 even smooth, clean, pristine Mew machine. Due to the sheer adaptable nature of a Robozon, combined with your immense powers, this results in you being able to become robotic versions of Pokémon, no longer held back by genetic weaknesses. However, some Legendaries are much harder to turn into, requiring 10 minutes at minimum to turn into them, but able to have the time lessened with training.

Your Pokémon creation, optionally, can be turned into a sort of Internal Nanoforge. When the Pokémon are ejected, they grow from the size of an inch or two to their normal size. You are able to connect to their AI, modify their coding, or more, and they will see you (Unless you horribly mistreat them) as a loving parental unit.

addons.title: Experiment 151
addons.text:
The introduction of the Blacklight Virus into your already paradoxical, nonsensically complex Mew DNA should have caused a catastrophic collapse of your genome, causing you to either devolve into a Ditto in the best-case scenario or, in the worst case, become a dead pile of goo. Yet somehow, your DNA has managed to perfectly integrate the Blacklight Virus, albeit with a few minor changes that drastically increase your powers far beyond those of a normal Mew.

For starters, rather than your body being made up of viral matter in the form of an ever-changing super-cancer, your body is now composed of a material similar to that of a Ditto. While a normal Mew does possess this property to a lesser degree, without any further training to fully unlock it, your body gains this ability to a degree that would baffle even the eldest of Mews.

Through this ability, your body is now made up of an extremely malleable substance that maintains its normal biological properties while gaining extreme rubber-like qualities, allowing you to mold or shape yourself in various ways akin to a cartoon character. This drastically increases your durability to absurd levels, even for a Pokémon, and will only increase further as you absorb more biomass and objects.

The Blacklight Virus's absorption capabilities have been broadened, allowing you to now absorb inanimate objects and add them to your genetic database in the vein of object-based Pokémon. You can now burn excess biomass to create overwhelmingly vast amounts of Aura energy, allowing you to perform feats that would cause other Pokémon to faint or even endanger their lives by overdrawing from their Life Force, and even other Mews would be baffled at the energy you can muster near endlessly.

As you gain more and more biomass, you can transform your body into a ginormous amalgamation of anything within your genetic database and the things you have absorbed, mixing and matching parts of different forms to create complex combinations that you may alter the appearance of freely. As such feel free to turn into an eldritch mess of different parts to freak out others or keep your form more tame. You also gain the curious ability to manipulate your own weight and mass through your abilities, allowing you to perform absurd physical feats by leveraging the weight of your stored biomass.

objects.text:
You become a Mew with access to the genetic information of all Pokémon, including Mythical, Legendary, and even artificial Pokémon like Porygon and Mewtwo, but with the exception of Arceus.

This opens the door to manipulating the fundamental forces of reality. However, be warned: mastering these powers will require great effort and is not without danger, as careless usage of your vast godly powers can have serious consequences for all of existence.

Your psychic powers at the start include telekinesis, telepathy, levitation, invisibility, and the ability to create durable psychic bubbles and shields. Along with a basic level of skill in using other forms of Type Energy, both in raw manipulation and low-level moves. You can learn and use any Pokémon move or Type energy, along with the ability to shapeshift into any Pokémon except Arceus. Through experience and training with various Pokémon forms, you may borrow their powers between transformations; however, you will be most powerful in your main Mew form or Hybrid should you possess the Poké-hybrid addon.
objects.title: Ancestor of All (Pokemon)

addons.text: No more are you simply a divided piece, for your divine blood has given the fragment of divine power you inherited a chance to grow and become something more. While it may take millennia without some form of accelerated growth, in time you will grow into an equal to the Original One Themself in all Their glory, a being capable of creating gods and even entire universes.
addons.title: The Other Original One

objects.text:
Rather than a mere Legendary, you are something more fundamental, a divided piece of the Original One which for reasons unknown has detached from the whole and achieved independence.

As an Avatar of Arceus, you possess within yourself an infinitismal piece of Their divinity unbound by the limits of game balance. This allows you to not only use all variants of Type Energy, but also every Move that exists. 

Not only that, but you also wield a fragment of Arceus’ power as the Creator, allowing you to create basically anything you desire given sufficient energy, from new Moves or Abilities to objects or living beings.

You also start with your own set of Plates, which you can use to change your Type to whatever you desire.
objects.title: Fragment of the Original One (Pokemon)

objects.text:
You are a Seraphim, a special type of Pacifista developed by the Marines' Special Science Group with the intention of replacing the Seven Warlords of the Sea. Living weapons originally built as clones of the former members of the Warlords, mixed with King's lunarian Lineage Factor and augmented with the Devil Fruit power-replicating Green Blood, though you may chose anyone from the One Piece Universe to be modelled after instead of just one of the Warlords.

Besides gaining the appearance of a Lunarian version of whoever you chose to be modeled after you also gain instinctive knowledge of all their abilities and their Devil Fruit ability if it is a Paramecia. If whoever you are modelled after either does not have a Devil Fruit ability or it is a Logia or Zoan you gain a Paramecia Devil Fruit ability of your choice instead.

As a Seraphim you also gain strength and skill to fight on the level of the Four Emperors and their strongest allies.
objects.title: Seraphim (One Piece)

objects.text:
It seems instead of being a giant from Primal, you are a giant from One Piece. As a giant, you will be around 20 meters tall, and generally look human although with some potentially exaggerated features. 

As a giant, you have quite the advantages over humans. Giants are the longest-living race found within One Piece, having three times the lifespan of a human, meaning you can naturally live a bit over 300 years. Physically, compared to humans, you are a terrifying force, with strength great enough to toss around giant battleships, and the durability to merely get minor injuries and momentary stun from cannon fire, even surviving explosives going off in your stomach.

As a final note, with dedication and training, you could eventually match and even surpass giants like Dorry and Brogy.
objects.title: Giant (One Piece)

objects.text:
It seems that, rather than being a normal giant, you are instead an Ancient Giant. You now stand a whopping 60 meters tall, and now possess a pair of horns, sharpened teeth, and potentially an abnormal skin color, like red or green. 

As an Ancient Giant, your physical capabilities are absurd. In terms of might, you could casually send giants flying with your blows, split enormous battleships with a single strike, and shake the very battlefield with your voice. Your durability is just as absurd, allowing you to be unfazed by normal cannon fire, sustain minor injuries from artillery, and can even survive a few blows from the Seven Warlords.

As a final note, with dedication and training you could potentially even achieve the power to match the legends of Oars, who were said to be strong enough to pull continents.
objects.title: Ancient Giant (One Piece)

objects.text:
Your physical abilities are slightly enhanced, making you stronger and more durable by a small but noticeable degree. Your regenerative capabilities, however, have undergone the most considerable improvement, to the point that most wounds, even grievous ones, will heal within seconds. Your tail has also become more flexible, able to be moved as easily as your other limbs, and capable of wrapping around an object like a tentacle or stabbing enemies, thanks to the new spike on the end.

More importantly, your body now produces a powerful electromagnetic field called an Asymmetric Permeable Field. This field acts as a potent force field, capable of tanking dozens of nuclear strikes, and can convert excess energy into extreme heat. Though powerful, it can be overloaded with EMPs or disabled if your dorsal plates are destroyed.

Speaking of your atomic breath, it has evolved into an accelerated particle beam capable of wiping out cities and leveling mountains. This beam is so powerful that it could hit something hundreds of miles out of the Earth's atmosphere with pinpoint accuracy. It can also now be fired from your APF in any direction around you. This beam can be charged nearly infinitely, growing in power until it can destroy planets.

Most importantly, your body is now in a constant state of evolution thanks to a unique form of horizontal gene transfer. As you age, your size and strength will increase, and your abilities will grow in power. You will also develop new abilities over time; examples include channeling energy into your tail, then whipping it at high speeds to release a shockwave of plasma, or using your APF to enhance your roar into a destructive sonic attack.

Also, your cells are capable of subdividing and separating from you, becoming new life forms that are genetically related to you yet still distinctly their own being, or even becoming a biological copy of you. Organisms that come into contact with your cells will also mutate over time to become more like you. These new lifeforms can also develop or inherit any biological powers you have. Given enough time, you could terraform the entire world, replacing it with life that is all related to you in some way. Fortunately, you have complete control over this process; no living being will be born or mutated by your cells unless you wish, and you can control exactly what traits they get if you do.
objects.title: King of Earth (Godzilla Franchise)

objects.text: Now you have become one of the most powerful incarnations of Godzilla to date: Godzilla Ultima. You are a fearsome beast with almost no equals. Your physical strength is absurd, enough to crush any level of resistance that a modern military could bring to bear. You also possess two breath weapons; one is a superchilled gas which explodes violently when exposed to flame, the other is your iconic atomic breath with the bonus of plasma rings that can also deal damage. You grow without an upper limit, and if you aren’t stopped before you get the chance, you have the potential to destroy the entire universe. You endlessly produce Red Dust, the raw materials of Archetype, a higher-dimensional material that can take thirteen different forms within three-dimensional space depending on orientation. Archetype warps space, time, and the laws of physics, allowing for things like refracting light through time to effectively generate infinite energy. On the scale you generate it, you can warp space until triangles have angles summing to less than one hundred eighty degrees and distort probability so completely that even a supercomputer which sends its answers backwards through time to achieve arbitrarily high levels of calculation would be overwhelmed by the possible futures you create. Red Dust also transforms the environment, giving rise to alien lifeforms with powers of their own. These do not inherently obey your whims, but with your power it wouldn’t be any issue at all to subjugate them. You also possess reactive evolution, or, more accurately, predictive evolution. You are able to see into the future, and your body will grow and evolve to react to any threats you are aware of. If you burn yourself, you’ll grow more durable skin. If you understand that bombs hurt, you will grow a shock-absorbent appendage which grabs the bomb out of the air before it explodes. However, all that is still just what humans can see. In reality, everything described here is just the power possessed by the limited part of yourself that exists in three-dimensional space. Your true form exists in hyperspace, as a godlike being who defies the laws of the lower-dimensional world where humans reside. Even if your avatar dies, you will be unaffected and can simply revive it or make a new one. Be aware that even with all your reality-warping power, there are ways to defeat you. By plugging in the correct equation the Archetype you produce can be turned against you and banish your avatar from the universe, cutting off your access to it. Without an avatar, you have no way to interact with the three-dimensional world. While finding the equation that works is astronomically unlikely, you should never underestimate human ingenuity. Also, you shouldn’t count on your higher-dimensional nature to protect you from every enemy. There are some cosmic beings who could probably attack you on your level.
objects.title: The Singular Point (Godzilla Franchise)

objects.text:
You and your twin have been enhanced far beyond your normal capabilities. In particular, you two have been granted the adaptive and evolutionary capabilities of Mothra Leo.

Your base enhancements have allowed both of you to reach Mach 15 in flight, physically match strength-based daikaiju, and combine abilities into stronger forms like silk and electricity into electrified silk.

You and your twin gain a most impressive new ability—to undergo specialized metamorphosis. This allows you to generate new forms to combat various scenarios, like an aquatic form to face a deep-sea threat or a form capable of FTL travel speeds to perform interplanetary rescue.
objects.title: Fierce Protector of Earth (Godzilla Franchise)

objects.text:
You have undergone a growth in your power, now gaining the capabilities of the incarnation who rivaled the Kings of The Monsters himself, Fire Rodan.

Your physical capabilities have risen to new heights. This increase has affected your speed, which now reaches Mach 3, making the shockwaves you create more devastating. You could match the strength of the likes of Ghidorah and Godzilla, able to lift and throw daikaiju that are several times your weight. Energy-based attacks are nigh-useless against your hide, with attacks such as Godzilla’s atomic breath being little more than an annoyance, requiring attacks such as Mechagodzilla’s Plasma Grenade to bring you down. The sea is now your ally as you have gained some aquatic capabilities, able to swim and survive underwater for long periods.

Beyond the physical boosts, you have gained Fire Rodan’s Uranium Heat Beam, Revitalization, and Telepathy. The Uranium Heat Beam is a crimson beam of radiation, able to match Godzilla’s Atomic Breath. Revitalization manifests in two forms—normally, it allows you to absorb smaller lifeforms into yourself to recover, but when the end is nigh for you, it can instead transfer your lifeforce into another, massively empowering them and healing them from wounds as serious as decapitation. Finally, Telepathy allows you to communicate telepathically with anyone you see as family.
objects.title: Fire Rodan (Godzilla Franchise)

addons.text:
You have achieved the highest rank a druid can attain—the pinnacle of those capable of wielding the power of nature. Your natural talent has propelled you to this height, where your mastery over nature magic has reached its logical extreme.

You are a true master of shapeshifting, able to assume all known druidic forms: cat, bear, bird, sea lion, moonkin, and even a tree form. Beyond these, you can access the more advanced shapes, including the owl, various forms of Ursoc and Ursul, the cat of the flame, the flaming spider, and the astral form.

Your control over nature magic makes you a living terror to any who dare oppose you in a forest. You can turn the very trees and ground against your enemies, summon massive thunderstorms to strike down foes, and unleash high winds and tornadoes to obliterate structures. Your healing abilities have also grown to legendary levels: you can regenerate lost limbs in minutes and cure even the most persistent diseases and curses with ease. So powerful is your healing that you can even revive the recently deceased, provided their soul remains and their body is not beyond repair.

Your command of arcane magic rivals your mastery of nature. You can rain down arcane energy like a shower of stars, drop conjured moons upon your enemies, and temporarily disable the magic of anyone within a designated area. Your sorcery is unparalleled. You also possess the knowledge to create Moonwells which are pools of silvery, glowing water that generate mana relative to the amount invested in their creation. These can be used to restore magical energy or to saturate objects with powerful enchantments.

You have the option to become a Night Elf. You also gain the four legendary artifacts: the Scythe of Elune, the Fangs of Ashamane, the Claws of Ursoc and G'Hanir, the Mother Tree. These artifacts are soulbound to you and are indestructible.
addons.title: Archdruid

addons.text:
Your status as a Sleigh Beggy has greatly increased the amount of mana flowing through your body and generated per second. Your physical prowess and speed have doubled that of a High Elf, and this growth shows no sign of stopping. As you accumulate more mana, your power continues to rise without limit. Your skill with magic is now bolstered by the sheer raw mana you can channel into every spell, allowing you to overcharge them. Where before you could only heal deep cuts and illnesses—you can now, over several hours, restore limbs, organs, and even repair soul damage as long as it isn’t too extensive. Your lifespan is effectively eternal, unless someone manages to kill you.

Your connection with nature has also reached new heights. All supernatural beings tied to nature now see you as a ruler, if not a god. Most would not dare harm you, even if you attacked them, and the few that might would only act out of self-preservation, not anger, and would stop if you did. However, this does not protect you from beings with alien or eldritch mindsets, who might harm you while believing their actions are "helpful."

As your body is constantly enhanced by magic, the previous problem of your physical form breaking down has been resolved.
addons.title: Elven Royalty

addons.text:
You have the developmental abilities, skills, and spells of your fellow High Elf, Riveria Ljos Alf. In addition to the three developmental abilities you already possess, you also have Spirit Healing, which automatically accelerates your mana regeneration after using any magic.

Your magical spells differ from others in that, through the technique of Chant Connection, you can adjust the strength of your magic by changing your chant length or mana usage. This ability is so refined that you can create multiple distinct spells from just one. You know all nine of Riveria's spells: Wynn Fimbulvetr, Rea Laevateinn, Vas Windheim, Liv Ilusio, Veil Breath, Via Shilheim, Fil Eldis, Luna Aldis, and Van Alheim. You also know the elven spell Flare Burn. Beyond these spells, Chant Connection applies to any spells you know, even those not obtained through the Falna.

Your skills include Fairy Anthem, which significantly enhances the effects, attack range, and power of all your magic based on chant length. You also have Alf Regina, which strengthens and amplifies all magic cast by Elves within your magical circle. Additionally, it converts the used magical energy of all elves in the circle into mana, allowing them to reabsorb it.
addons.title: Nine Hell

objects.text:
You're not just a simple Elf but an ascended stage of your lesser brethren—a High Elf. Your talent for magic is greater than your normal elvenkind that it would be like comparing an average student to a once-in-a-lifetime prodigy in how quickly and easily you're able to pick up manipulating your magic and learning the spells of others. This also includes a greater amount of mana coursing through your body that has passively enhanced your physicality to double that of a normal Elf. Where if an Elf was double the strength and speed of a human of the same fitness, you're instead quadruple a human of similar fitness.

Your lifespan can be measured in the thousands of years, if not longer. The more you train and grow your magic, the more your lifespan will extend.

All animals whether they be mundane or supernatural are completely pacified to the point that most mundane and non-sentient magical animals will gladly let you kill them and if you're ever in danger nearby, they will throw down their very lives in an attempt to protect you. Many other supernatural beings connected to the earth and life such as nature spirits are also inclined to view you positively.

With this ascension, you have also gained a skill in nature magic. By moving your magic with the proper intent on what you want done, you can do things such as increase plant growth, purify taint water or ground, and minor healing of deep cuts and illnesses for yourself or others.
objects.title: High Elf

addons.text:
You are the master of the bow. No, that doesn’t quite capture your prowess—you are a god of the bow, elevating its use beyond anything even the most skilled Elf could dream of. Any bow you wield or create is automatically imbued with divine energy and the essence of your elven nature, making it both indestructible and capable of withstanding any force or magical power you unleash with each shot.

Every standard arrow you fire carries the destructive force needed to obliterate a skyscraper, and a charged shot, infused with the right magic and elemental energy, has the potential to decimate half a city. Your unmatched speed allows you to release 100 arrows per second, and with your enhanced elven accuracy and eyesight, the only way to miss is if something blocks the arrow, the target moves out of range, or the arrow is dodged. Such a feat would require the greatest of superhuman or esoteric means to pull off.

Your range extends across the entire planet. You could fire an arrow from the highest peak, and it would travel the circumference of the Earth, returning to your position as long as nothing obstructs its path. As the ultimate hunter, you can unconsciously toggle the ability to sense the presence of specific species or subtypes within a 1000-mile radius, aiding you in selecting your targets.

Your mastery over animals allows you to tame any non-sentient creature, whether ordinary or magical. Any animal you tame becomes half as powerful as you, potentially growing slightly or massively in size, completely loyal, and willing to sacrifice itself for your sake. Even in death, you can resurrect them. You may have up to six tamed animals at a time, but can store as many as you like in a stasis pocket dimension. These tamed creatures also gain unique magical abilities based on their species.

Your expertise in magical archery makes enchanting arrows effortless. You can craft explosive shots, cursed arrows, watery arrows that flood entire areas with repeated volleys, and even healing arrows that mend those you choose within their blast radius. There are no limits to the magic you can weave into your arrows.
addons.title: Lore Accurate Elf

addons.text:
You are not merely a Divine Elf. You're the Elven equivalent of a Dragon, a Manakete. More specifically, a Divine Dragon. Beyond the physical enhancements you already possessed (which have now been further amplified), you've also gained several new powers. These include the ability to travel between worlds, reverse time, create pocket dimensions, and, with considerable effort, terraform entire planets or even raise the dead.

You have full control over your ability to shapeshift into your dragon form, and unlike most, you no longer need a Dragonstone to do so. You've also developed a deep affinity for Faith Magic, with the ability to craft powerful holy objects and weapons from your own body and your blood has a holy and magical property to enhance the physical and magical parameters of whoever drinks it by a moderate amount and persist through their bloodline. Your conceptual power over Elves has been extended—now you hold power over Dragonkind as well. You now gain a conceptual advantage when fighting Dragons as well as Elves. Your ability to both strip Elves of their essence, as well as bestow such an essence onto others has now allowed you to do the same to Dragons.

Your ability to resurrect from complete bodily destruction has been enhanced. In fact, you no longer require a physical body to exist. Even if there are no other Dragons, Manaketes, or Elves in the world, you can survive as a spiritual being on a higher plane of existence and eventually craft a new vessel to return to the physical realm.

However, these powers come with a cost. The constant growth of your power places an immense strain on your mind and body, gradually driving you toward madness. You could create a Dragonstone to seal much of your power and slow this descent, or you could retreat from the physical world altogether, though this would severely limit your ability to influence it directly, forcing you to rely on followers or other dragons as proxies.
addons.title: Divine Dragon

addons.text:
Your ascension to true godhood has been completed earlier than expected. You have absorbed the mantle of the Vanir god Freyr, taking on his domains of peace, fertility, wealth, rain, summer, and sunshine, and combining them with your own budding divinity. This has granted you a divine status more akin to the gods of Greece than those of the Norse. Golden ichor now flows through your veins, and your strength has become immeasurable compared to what it once was. Your power is further enhanced by the authority and magic tied to each of your domains.

You now possess the ability to shapeshift into any form you desire, with the capacity to change your size from the size of a human to the size of a mountain. Your strength is such that, at its current level, you can effortlessly pulverize a mountain, and as prayers and devotion to your domains increase, so too will your power. Unique to your kind of godhood is the ability to assume your divine form, a form so overwhelming that any being less than immortal suffers extreme pain and harm by simply looking upon you. In time, this ability will grow to the point where most beings below godhood will disintegrate from the mere sight of you.

As a god, you cannot be permanently killed unless you lose all your followers, your domains weaken, and you are forgotten. Though, if your body and soul were utterly destroyed, you might lose your sense of self and be prevented from returning.

In addition to your previous magic, you now have the power to alter seasons on a macro scale, such as transforming a frozen wasteland into a land of eternal summer. You wield the powers of Photokinesis, Thermokinesis, Atmokinesis, Pyrokinesis, and Geokinesis, with each ability in your base form able to affect an area the size of North America.

From your Elven origins, you have gained complete mastery of Alf Seidr, a peaceful form of magic typically wielded only by elves, Freyr, and his descendants. This includes abilities such as healing, Pacemiakinesis, and growth manipulation.

As the inheritor of Freyr's godhood, you also assume rulership over Alfheim, one of the Nine Worlds and home to the light elves. A realm perpetually bathed in sunlight, Alfheim is disconnected from other realms, existing solely through your power. You may choose whether it is inhabited by light elves or not, and if it is, they are loyal to you as their lord and god, with their prayers and offerings further strengthening your divine might.
addons.title: Freyr

objects.text:
Your Apotheosis has begun. You are taking your first steps toward your true destiny as the god(ess) of all Elves. Your divinity is tied to Elvenkind and manifests as a conceptual force. As the future god(ess) of Elves, you gain the innate ability to master all skills and crafts that Elves are known for. This includes being a master artisan, jeweler, singing, dancing, and an expert archer. You no longer need to eat, drink or sleep.

You also gain a conceptual advantage over all Elves: if you fight any other Elf, you will always be at least one rank stronger than them for as long as the fight lasts, and you will temporarily acquire abilities that counter their own. Additionally, you can strip the "Elf" essence from any Elf you deem unworthy of their heritage or bestow that heritage upon others. As long as at least one Elf remains alive in the world, you cannot die permanently. This immortality is reflected in your ability to rapidly heal, such as regenerating lost limbs or organs within minutes, or reforming your body over the course of a week if completely destroyed. However, this does not protect you from complete soul destruction or sealing, though you can slowly recover from soul damage as long as half your soul is relatively intact.

Your magic, now augmented by your divinity, has significantly strengthened your control over nature. Initially, you can expend nearly all your mana to terraform up to 156 miles of desert into lush forest. Your healing abilities have also advanced, enabling you to heal soul taint and damage, as long as no more than half of your soul (or another’s) has been corrupted or destroyed. Such damage would take about a week to fully mend.

With time, effort, and prayers from your followers to cultivate your divinity, your powers will continue to grow. Eventually, you may be able to completely heal a soul if even a fragment remains and terraform thousands of miles into a habitable paradise for all Elvenkind.
objects.title: God Elf

objects.text:
You are an incredibly rare, and unfortunately maligned, weird hybrid of an Elf and a Dwarf. Possessing both the strengths but none of the weaknesses of your parents, you are known for your immense proficiency in crafting, inherited from the talents that seems almost inherent from both halves of your lineage. You also have immense resistances both in magic and physical damage and disease, making you an almost impenetrable living wall. This makes Dwelves like you definitely sought after as tanks for armies or adventuring parties, whether or not you take advantage of that is up to you.

Otherwise, potentially due to how Dwelves tend to be shunned by both Dwarves and Elves, they tend to thrive alone. Even moreso than either of your parents you are amazing at adapting in underground ecosystems. The caves are your home and you are a master of it. You have a particular green thumb for fungi and other underground dwelling mycanids, you also have a strong affinity with cave dwelling animals and monsters, with you being able to easily empathize with them and tame them. You are also an amazing marksman, with Dwelves being credited as the inventors of Guns in a lot of fantasy universes.

Also, you tend to be the height of a taller than average human, though stockier, with a muscular build. Your ears are always pointy, and you can grow a luxurious beard regardless of gender. Said beard is easy to maintain and take care of.

Finally, you live longer than dwarves but shorter than elves. And thus, you mature faster than most long lived species, but don't last as long. So be sure to make sure to make your time count.
objects.title: Dwelf

objects.text:
You are now a human-turned Beastman, transformed through artificial means by receiving the Beast Factor via blood transfusion. Unlike natural-born Beastmen, your origins grant you superior shapeshifting abilities, allowing you to take on the forms of multiple species. You can alter your body mass at will, enabling feats of superhuman strength, speed, and agility far beyond the limits of ordinary Beastmen.

Much like Nazuna, you can take one a full beast form, cloaked in a fiery aura, similar to that of transcendent Beastmen. Though your powers may not match the raw might of true transcendents, you still possess a version of their abilities, granting you formidable strength and potential. 

Your artificial Beast Factor grants you abilities that are unique to your kind, unassociated with any known animal species. You can extend and enlarge your limbs at will, generate blinding light by channeling excess energy, and mimic or copy nearly every power known to Beastmen, including those possessed by transcendent ones. With time and mastery, these abilities could rival or even surpass the strength of purebred and transcendent Beastmen alike. An interesting note is that human-turned Beastman have mythological forms, with the only two known human-turned Beastman being a Tanuki Beastman and Kitsune Beastman.
objects.title: Human-Turned Beastmen (BNA)

objects.text:
You now have Nirvasyl Syndrome, a condition that transforms Beastmen into savage, monstrous versions of themselves. This syndrome, triggered by extreme stress, corrupts your Beast Factor, sending you into an uncontrollable metamorphosis. In this state, you become a beast driven by pure rage and hate, losing all sense of self. You attack anyone or anything in sight with reckless fury, and as the transformation deepens, your body mutates, granting you even greater destructive abilities, along with heightened physical power and near-impenetrable durability.

When Nirvasyl Syndrome takes hold, multiple symptoms can be seen: your veins glow ominously, either blue or green, and your eyes burn with an unnatural red light. These symptoms, along with an overwhelming bloodlust, mark the onset of your uncontrollable rage, driving you to kill everything and everyone without mercy.

However, unlike others who suffer from this condition, you possess a rare degree of control. You do not have to enter this monstrous state unless you choose to. Even when in this form, you retain a sliver of self-awareness, guiding your actions. But be warned—your control has limits. If anyone stands in your way, no matter who they are, you will not hesitate to kill them.
objects.title: Nirvasyl Syndrome (BNA)

objects.text: Typically, Cybertronians are constrained somewhat in their choice of alt mode by their robot mode size. However, there are rare exceptions. While your alt mode is typically bound to between one and two times your natural size, with this ability, you can transform into anything from a Walkman cassette player to a Casablanca-class escort carrier. Your robot mode is not affected.
objects.title: Mass Shifter

objects.text: You are a Cybertronian of roughly human size. You have the durability, longevity, and transformation abilities of any other Cybertronian, but at a smaller scale. Your alternate mode may be as small as an analog cassette tape, but no larger than your robot mode.
objects.title: Mini-Con (Transformers)

addons.text:
The Hallowed Bond of Night and Flame has allowed you to split your divinities into separate bodies under your direction. Now you can instead imbue them into your Mini-cons separately as they are pieces of you. 

Empowering a Minicon means you will lack access to this exaltation until you recall the power, but this can be done at any time they are connected to you. Should they be destroyed, the power will return to you.
addons.title: Division of the Heavenly Spheres

objects.text: Instead of being a Minicon, you now contain a number of Minicons each with their own alt-mode. These small Cybertronians can either be stored inside of you or attach onto you in minor ways akin to armour in any form you possess, though their total mass and power cannot exceed your own. You act as a kind of minor Hive-Mind with these Minicons, each having their own personality and perspective but also under your direction. As these Minicons are formed out of you, you and they can act in perfect sync with each other. Should any of these Minicons be destroyed, you can repair or create another to fill their position, but it will require the requisite mass of metals and Energon. Your size determines the size of your Minicons. A regularly sized Cybertronian would produce regular Minicons, while a Titan would produce larger full Cybertronians.
objects.title: The Hive (Transformers)

addons.text: Your Microbots benefit from Triple Changer and Sixshot, possessing multiple alt-modes for each separate Microbot within your hive. Unfortunately these do include whatever form is required to fit on or inside your main body, but this does allow them to have a robot-mode ort another alt-form altogether.
addons.title: Armada

objects.text: You now have two alternate modes available to you at any given time. Can't decide whether to settle on a locomotive or a space shuttle? Now you don't have to! This also provides a minor upgrade to your strength, durability, reflexes, and combat awareness.
objects.title: Triple Changer

objects.text: You are the peak of Cybertronian versatility. In addition to now having up to five alternate modes available to switch between freely, the hardware required to handle this many transformation cogs is some of the most powerful on Cybertron, and as a result, you are, roughly, the Transformer equivalent of a super soldier.
objects.title: Sixshot

objects.text: If espionage, infiltration, and counter-intelligence against your fellow Cybertronians is more up your alley, you can exchange one of your alternate modes for a second robot mode instead, allowing you to blend in seamlessly across enemy lines. While the combat upgrades from Triple Changer are halved, in exchange, this also provides improvements to your information gathering, observation, organization, improvisation, and deception skills.
objects.title: He's nearby... REAL nearby

addons.text: You’ve become something truly recursive, with each of your constituent bots having a suite of mini-cons of their own.
addons.title: An army of… well definitely not one

objects.text: Instead of a single Cybertronian, your consciousness is divided among three to six bodies, each with individual personalities capable of acting independently of one another. In addition to each of these individuals having all the capabilities provided by taking Cybertronian, they are able to combine with one another to form a single, massive bot, one more powerful than the sum of its parts. While normally, a combiner's ability to perform, or even stay combined, is dependent on its components' ability to work together, because the transformers that make you up are formed from you to begin with, their minds combine to form yours, and are thus always functioning in perfect sync, either in combiner form or as a team.
objects.title: And I'll Form The Head

objects.text: Maximals are the descendants (at least in part) of the Autobots. Unlike Cybertronian, they do not transform into a vehicle, instead their physiology has pseudo-organic beast modes, allowing both sides to adopt alternate modes that blend in seamlessly with the organic lifeforms found elsewhere in the universe.
objects.title: Maximals

objects.text:
You are a Pretender, a typically smaller Cybertronian outfitted with a techno-organic shell. This makes you even more effective at infiltrating various alien cultures, particularly of organics. This does not mean you're only good with spying and reconnaissance however. For not only do you still possess the strength and fighting capabilities of a cybertronian, but your pretender shell has far more uses than one would expect.

Your shell helps in self repair, speeding up the process should you be damaged. Your shell could also transform into a metallic armor, similar to that of a Tokusatsu hero, which is a form more suited for combat. Finally, you can also temporarily separate from your shell, controlling it as its own remote combatant which fights alongside you. Your only main weakness is you shall feel any damage done to your shell, even when they are separated. Which isn't exactly something other cybertronians had to deal with.

As a Decepticon, you might have a more monstrous form. Autobots tend to be more humanoid by comparison. Whatever it may be, your shell is your choice.
objects.title: Pretender (Transformers)

objects.text:
You are now a Titan, also known as a cityformer, metrotitan, or megamaster, a colossal Cybertronian with unmatched might and scale. Titans are living arsenals capable of transforming into entire cities or massive starships, housing vast amounts of firepower and advanced technology. While larger than most Cybertronians, you tower above others, with an average height of hundreds of meters. In this form, you can bring the might of an army’s worth of weapons to bear, making you nearly unstoppable in battle.

As a Titan, you have immense strength, durability, and an arsenal that includes energy cannons, missiles, and various exotic weapons. You can support entire armies, offering refuge within your city form, and provide overwhelming firepower on the battlefield.

Your alternate mode allows you to transform into a colossal starship or city, fully equipped with living quarters, defensive turrets, shield generators, and other utilities. In this mode, you can deploy smaller Cybertronians, repair them, or carry them across vast distances in space. You are capable of high-speed interstellar travel, crossing systems within minutes.

You also possess the rare and ancient ability of cityspeaking, allowing you to communicate with and control other Titans through a form of pseudo-telepathy, granting you influence over their actions in certain situations. This connection places you on a higher plane of interaction with your fellow Titans, making you a commander among these city-sized warriors.

Over time, your connection to the Titans grows deeper, enhancing your powers and expanding your size and arsenal as you develop, giving you an even greater presence in the universe.

The power of a Titan makes you a living superweapon, feared by all who know your name.
objects.title: Titan

addons.text:
Having a spark of divinity, your ‘Mini-cons’ can instead take two distinct forms:

1. Titans, capable of being cities unto themselves and complete forces of nature

2. Primes, many times smaller but imbued with a fraction of your divinity, empowering themselves to perform your will.

Both of these are restrained by your own power, requiring many centuries until they could rival the champions of your kin.
addons.title: The Children of...

addons.text: Your nature as a divine world-engine has transferred to your component Transformers. You’re a living pantheon, able to divide your divinity across these bodies or recombine into a terrifyingly massive god-engine capable of devouring the very stars with ease.
addons.title: Pantheon

addons.text:
With each of your world-engine bodies able to produce Primes and Titans, and each of them in turn possessed of their own “Micro”bots, You’ve become a true army of techno-divine horror, capable of disgorging countless fragments of yourself into the universe under your direction. 

With a little focus you can control singular bots or clusters with far greater accuracy and ‘control’, taking direct command of them with full knowledge of their actions, capabilities and perspective. This also extends to any ‘Cybertronian’ creations that you let form on your surface.

As their god, this will likely be received well, for a certain definition of the word.
addons.title: The Armies of the Divine

objects.text: “I am Power Incarnate. I am Unicron. And I live again.” Your Primary Alt-Mode’s size has been altered considerably, with it being that of a planet equal to the size of the Earth. That is to say, your Primary Alt-Mode became a Planet instead of a conventional vehicle. This offers some benefits, such as tremendously increased physical might across the board, from strength and durability to intimidation and coolness factor, the most important stats of them all. In your Planet-Mode, you can now travel through space at truly impressive speeds, as in ‘passing by a star in 10 seconds’ kind of speed. Equipped with a giant maw, you are capable of eating planets equal to and smaller than your Planet-Mode's size. You can use this to increase your own size, as well as your overall power. Of course, this means that you have an equally enormous Robot-Mode. You have enough strength to crush entire Earth-sized planets in your hand like crumpling up paper balls, and you can shrug off devastating attacks like someone gave you a small poke. Along with eye lasers that can tear through almost anything, a flame breath that would melt even the most durable materials, you are a nigh-unstoppable threat if provoked. Within you is a Spark of Cybertronian Divinity. Eventually, given enough time eating planets and growing in power, the spark will grow and allow you to share more than just visual similarities to someone like Unicron or Primus. Provided you can survive for that long, becoming the equal to the Two Cybertronian Gods is your Destiny.
objects.title: Planet-Sized Instrument of Destruction

objects.text:
You have obtained the Divine Vessel Annulus Kronos-Crown and have been crowned the flagship of your Olympian fleet. While usually this would grant you access to the functionalities of the Machine Gods of your fleet that have died. Since you are the only member of your fleet, this instead grants you all the functionalities of all the hypothetical Machine Gods that would complete your fleet if it were a standard fleet, and if your Aletheia isn’t based on Zeus, it is upgraded to be comparable to Zeus’s, whose Aletheia was second only to Chaos.

You also now possess a complete database of all Olympian knowledge.
objects.title: Divine Vessel Annulus Kronos-Crown (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
Instead of an Olympian, you are the same type of Machine God as Interstellar Navigation-Purpose Ultra-Massive Mothership/Celestial Sphere Type Space-Time Fortress Chaos. Like the Olympians, you are both a conceptual god born from deified natural phenomena and an unmanned spacefaring ship built by an alien civilization from a dying universe.
