Unlike the Olympians, you are also a dyson sphere built around a star which in terms of sheer scale, means you far surpass the entire planet Earth, making you a god that embodies every concept and natural phenomenon under the sun the Alien civilization could imagine which, as part of your construction, naturally gives you possession of all the functionalities of every Machine God no matter the generation and on a much higher level than any of the Olympians to the point you could accidentally destroy an Olympian with a reflexively released Arrow of Light stronger than anything Apollo could do in his prime.

You can make more Machine Gods, though creating a fleet similar to the Olympians' predecessors would reduce you to less than a tenth of your functionality.

You can make dimensional rifts to other distant dimensions that you can act through, though by quirk of design, you can’t travel through the rifts with this power alone; these rifts are also resource and energy-intensive to create, straining even your reserves and energy generation.

While fundamentally, your database of knowledge starts the same as the Olympians, the sheer scope of your processors, the strength of your knowledge functionalities, and the power you can throw behind both means you can come up with ideas that Athena would bow to and creations that Hephaestus would praise as beyond him.

Given the fact that your true body is now a Dyson Sphere, you won’t manifest on Earth Bet. Maybe you’ll appear surrounding the sun, or maybe you’ll appear a few light-years away from the solar system. You are free to choose any location within a few light-years of Earth, so long as it makes sense.

The location you choose in the setting section instead indicates the location where a terminal avatar of yours will appear. This avatar will be small enough to interact with humans and exist on Earth without destroying it while also possessing a fraction of your power.
objects.title: Mothership Chaos (Type-Moon)

addons.text: As a greater Dead Apostle, you have become deeply entrenched in Mystery. With each passing year, your Mystery continues to expand. Your immortal existence ensures your Mystery will never wane. Your Magecraft will never face issues of incompatibility, as you can access even human mysteries, regardless of your nature. Your growing Mystery enhances your Magecraft, amplifying any of your crafts and raising your talent as you pursue your Idea Blood.
addons.title: Sliver Of Mystery

objects.text:
You are a noble vampire, the embodiment of a living heresy, corrupting the world merely by existing. Enhanced by your curse, you have evolved into a monstrous being that not even a dozen executors would dare fight directly. You’ve mastered your vampiric nature, allowing you to effortlessly take flight, transform into mist, or create familiars. The potency of your curse of restoration has reached such heights that you can regenerate from just your heart, albeit at a great cost.

You stand as an abomination to human order, possessing a natural resistance to anything human-derived. Innovations of humanity falter against you: bullets barely register, grenades are minor irritants, and ordinary blades slide off without effect. Only the pinnacle of human achievement, whether it be heroes or technology, could potentially overwhelm you. However, magical or supernatural forces rooted in humanity can still penetrate your defenses.

You can spread your curse, enabling you to spawn dead apostles up to Rank VI that you can command. Moreover, you wield mystic eyes of enchantment, capable of subduing any being of weak will. Your body has also developed significant resistance to sunlight and sacraments, though overcoming them still requires considerable effort.

You have advanced and gained a hint towards your idea blood. This emerging principle brings you one step closer to attaining ancestor status. Within the confines of your idea blood, you can develop a unique ability, such as mild telekinesis, mist manipulation, or memory alteration.
objects.title: Rank VII/Greater Dead Apostle (Type-Moon)

addons.text: Among the Ancestors, many such as Van-Fem, Nrvnqsr Chaos, and Zelretch, have mastered the art of Magecraft. As an ascending Ancestor, your claim to knowledge is just as formidable. You gain a comprehensive compendium of Magecraft within your mind, meticulously tailored to complement your Idea Blood Principle and personal preferences. This compendium, which encompasses hundreds of years of research, grants you knowledge on par with the best magecraft-wielding Ancestors.
addons.title: Ancient Knowledge

addons.text:
Just as you stand at the very summit of vampire-kind, so too do you stand at the summit of alchemy, having inherited the skills, knowledge, and abilities of two of the greatest alchemists of Atlas turned Dead Apostles, Night of Wallachia and Dust of Osiris.

As such, your alchemic repertoire includes everything from the mighty Hermes spiritron computer to synthetic blood substitutes capable of sustaining you without harming any humans. Even your raw computational power alone is enough to suppress a rampaging Logos React, one of the Seven Superweapons of Atlas.

In addition to those benefits, you gain control over the TATARI phenomenon. The basic function of that phenomenon is to make malignant information, such as shared fears, paranoia, or rumors, into full-fledged reality. Generally, this occurs as a result of the gathered fears and anxieties shared among the surrounding intelligent life, but as an individual with immense computational abilities and an intact ego, you can also manually create information to manifest, though this becomes far more difficult the more you deviate from the information in the area.

With this power, you are capable of creating armies of small, relatively weak, nightmare manifestations (somewhat analogous to the Dead of other Ancestors) and can sustain each of them nearly indefinitely. On the upper end, you can create manifestations equal to yourself in power, though you could only sustain such a manifestation for the span of a single night.

That said, the nightmares you bring to life do not have any inherent loyalty to you and could simply begin attacking you upon their manifestation, depending on their disposition. You can resolve this by manually altering the information that forms them, though this is more difficult and results in a slightly degraded end product.

Your dominion over and attachment to the TATARI phenomenon also provides you an additional level of immortality, as in specific circumstances it could result in your manifestation, even after your complete destruction. This would require a large amount of malignant information close enough to your actual essence that the echoes of your identity tied to the phenomenon itself would fill in the gaps and bring about your manifestation.

However, this resurrection is by no means perfect or even particularly reliable, as it relies on the presence of thinking beings, capable of experiencing and sharing ill emotions. Even with the presence of compatible information, there isn’t any guarantee that you will be manifested at your full strength, should the depth or amount of it be insufficient to derive a life-scale as massive as your own. Likewise, as a mere manifestation, you can sustain yourself only a single night, leaving you a brief window to either leverage into a more complete revival or fade away until the stars align for your next manifestation.
addons.title: TATARI

objects.text:
You have ascended to the throne of an Ancestor, the zenith of what it means to be a Dead Apostle. You have acquired an Idea Blood: the Hemonomic Principle. This Idea Blood is a singularity, enabling you to rewrite the world's laws with nothing more than your blood. Each ancestor embodies a principle that defines their essence and grants them the power to reshape reality through it. You may choose any principle, gaining transcendent abilities based on your choice. However, be warned: your truth, your principle, becomes both the purpose of your existence and the source of your undying curse.

Vlov Arkhangel, an upstart ancestor with the principle of “freezing,” could conjure a blizzard over an entire city and freeze buildings with a mere thought. As a newly ascended ancestor, your capabilities eclipse his, allowing you to wield your principle with unparalleled ease. Your potential actions range from demolishing cities and enslaving legions to fracturing the very fabric of space itself.

Your ascent to Ancestorhood has elevated you to the pinnacle of what it means to be a Dead Apostle, with your vampiric abilities increasing by an order of magnitude. You are now capable of creating and commanding Dead Apostles up to Rank VIII. Your curse of restoration has become nearly flawless; destroying your heart is futile, as the only way to truly defeat you is to deplete your blood. You have transcended vulnerabilities like sunlight and holy sacraments.

Your ascendancy to Ancestorhood has rendered you a terror to Humanity. Human Order quakes in your presence. You can negate any mundane human innovation; tanks, missiles, and nukes are now trivial to you. Magical and supernatural phenomena employed by humans are significantly weakened; even the greatest of heroes will struggle to leave a mark on you. Only divine and alien forces pose a real threat to you.
objects.title: Rank IX/Dead Apostle Ancestor (Type-Moon)

addons.text: “Pseudo-personality suspended. Magical energy yield exceeds regulation. Second stage restraint rescinded.” “Sacred lance, removing restraints!” Add, or Logos React Replica, is the containment device used to preserve Rhongomyniad’s mystery into the current era. It can shapeshift into different weapons, such as a scythe that can absorb magical energy, a hammer that has strength on the strength of a D-Rank Mana Burst, or a Boomerang. When Add is fully restrained, very few people will be able to tell what is held inside of it. When the second and third level restraints are rescinded, Rhongomyniad can be used as normal. A copy of the mind of Sir Kay acts as a pseudo-intelligence of the weapon. As a last resort, Sir Kay may come out of Add as Spirit and use his Noble Phantasm, Camelot Image, a shield that defends and reflects attacks. However, you may not use any functions of Add while Sir Kay is in his Spirit Form due the strain it puts upon the device. You can now use Rhongomyniad Mythos, the true function of Rhongomyniad, able to anchor the world in place and prevent mystery from leaking to the outside. This will last for a decade without outside intervention.
addons.title: Add

objects.text: “Gray, Rave, Crave, Deprave. Grave me. Grave for you.” You are not just the inheritor of a famous person’s talents; you’ve been alchemically and magically modified to be the container of a Heroic Spirit’s soul, allowing for the full reincarnation of a Ghost Liner if summoned using your body as a catalyst. This would have overwritten your soul, killing you, but somehow you’ve managed to escape being used for such an event. You not only slowly gain the skills and talents, but also the powers and appearance. Your biology painfully adjusts itself to make itself a more adequate container, such as increasing muscle mass, grafting a dragon’s core to your body or changing your hair color. You also gain the weaknesses of the Hero, for example, if they had a dragon’s bloodline, then you would also gain a disadvantage from dragon-slaying weapons. Any weapon, armor or artifact that requires the bloodline of such an illustrious person can be used by you as if you were them in the flesh. For example, Caliburn would cleave your foes in twain, Camelot would open up its magnificent gates, and Lamrei would be subservient to you as if you were Artoria herself. Due to the experiments, you are also a sybil, a person who is incredibly sensitive to Ghosts, apparitions and spirits and can use them as a sort of divination, allowing you to form a connection to see their memories and past. You may be the inheritor of any Heroic Spirit’s legacy. Though the greater the Spirit’s power, the slower and more painful the changes occur. It would take five years plus to gain the full power of an A-rank Servant like Artoria Pendragon. Additionally, Heroic Spirits are beings of immense power and will eventually subsume your soul unless you find a cure in time, with using their powers decreasing the amount of time you have left. The immense strain of the process to create a vessel like you also means that only one of your bloodlines may be elevated to this level.
objects.title: In the Reflection of the King (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
As a member of a select and illustrious group among Terra's races, you hail from those who once sat upon thrones—lords and monarchs of ancient Terran nations, bearing plentiful aristocratic roots and noble vigor.

Unlike the Ancients, most Elders possess traits of mythical creatures rather than mundane beasts, setting them apart from the peasantry. Some, however, do exist as closely related subgroups of certain Ancient races, i.e., such as Pegasi, Nightzmoras, or Unicorns for the Kuranta.

Each Elder race carries the legacy of unique powers that once allowed them to rule Terra as god-kings, enforcing their dominion through "divine right" and overwhelming might. Yet time and the influence of Originium have been unforgiving, eroding much of that former grandeur.

In the modern age, these once-fantastical abilities are greatly diminished compared to their former status.

What now remains are fragments of that ancient glory—power that still lingers in the blood. This manifests as a heightened affinity for certain forms of Arts or bloodline-specific abilities unique to your lineage, remnants potent enough to rival even veteran Casters through sheer power alone.

But you are different. Within you still burns a stronger spark of that forgotten legacy—one that, with time, may allow you to potentially replicate feats long dismissed as nothing more than lofty tales and whispered legends.
objects.title: Elders (Arknights)

objects.text:
You've climbed to the status of a pure-blooded Sarkaz from one of the "Ten Kings" tribes of the Royal Court. Unlike your other mixed-blooded brethren or lesser tribesmen, you'll stand tall against the pack—wielding unique racial traits inherent to your heritage, alongside witchcraft, and rituals known only to the true Sarkaz elite.

These abilities vary from the hemokinetic Arts of the Vampires, the geokinetic Arts of the Gargoyles, the illusion and deception Arts of the Djaj, or the space manipulation Arts and immortality of the Liches, among others.

Each Royal Court tribe likewise harbors its own ancient secrets and dormant potential, waiting to be uncovered and mastered.

Regardless of the tribe chosen, you'll possess the potential to rival—or even surpass—the Lords and leaders of your tribe. Though the path to do so is neither a quick nor painless one, demanding not only a great deal of actual time and effort, but an unwavering dedication as well.
objects.title: Sarkaz Pure-blood (Arknights)

objects.text:
I suppose congratulations are in order, given what you’ve just replaced your heart with.

Inside your chest lies the crimson moon forged made the Father of Wolves, Duran. The benefits it grants are myriad, firstly, you are immortal, albeit not unkillable. Secondly, you no longer require food, drink, sleep, air, and can regenerate from getting stabbed for 700 years straight with no issues. Thirdly, whilst normally, your blood would convert foxians into borisin, it will convert humans instead on account of there being none in Worm.

Furthermore, as no Borisin Warhead has ever been weak, you are given a stature similar to Hoolay, who was as tall as 4 men and had the strength of a thousand. 

Finally as a last ditch move, you may tear the Crimson Moon out of your chest to drive every Borisin worldwide into a berserk rage.
objects.title: Warhead (Honkai: Star Rail)

objects.text:
You’re not simply another MANTIS. You are a MANTIS with strength far above your peers. You may now choose to be grafted with the genes of a Judgement-class Honkai Beast or even that of the dreaded Vipralopa-class. Even if you choose a much weaker Honkai Beast, the strength you gain from the surgery will still be elevated to allow you to slay the deadliest Honkai Beasts and fight toe-to-toe against the Herrschers.

Every one of your physical parameters is further enhanced, with strength that lets you raze cities in minutes and absurd survivability that lets you resist having all the energy in your body ripped out. Your Honkai Adaptability is further elevated, the enhancement provided by reinforcement being far stronger and more esoteric applications of Honkai energy becoming easier to achieve.

You lose the need to be mindful of your emotions to suppress your Active Honkai Reaction, but the transformation becomes addictive. The more time you spend in the form of your Honkai Beast, the more it will feel natural, and you will find it harder to return to your human form.

Your tremendous power stands at the level of the Flamechasers, the mightiest soldiers of Fire Moth and the only survivors of the Tragedy of Binding—with each and every member having been anomalies that stood out even before their surgery. In addition to your Honkai Beast’s abilities, you may choose to have a strange quirk or talent so monstrous it could be mistaken for a power. Whether it be Kevin’s monstrous fighting talent that allowed him to kill Honkai Beasts without any powers or training, Mobius’ inhuman intelligence that allowed her to speak from the moment of her birth, Eden’s genius in every form of art that elevated her to the wealthiest and most famous person in the Previous Era, Kalpas’ obscene strength that allowed him to beat a Herrscher to death even before his surgery or even Pardofelis’ absurd luck.
objects.title: Flamechaser (Honkai Impact 3rd)

addons.text:
An anomaly. Even before the surgeries you were already an exception among humanity, regardless of what talents you held, your body was the future of humanity. Before your enhancements you’d been capable of pulverizing concrete like paper and bending steel, your prodigious mind allowing you to at least keep up with monstrous geniuses despite your lack of interest in the sciences and allowing you to to become a qualified soldier in mere months of training.

Your very genes were the pinnacle of humanity and it allowed you to endure the unimaginable. Project SOLDIER was Fire Moth’s hopes in creating a force to fight back against the unending tide of Honkai yet creating the formidable MANTIS was an absurd gamble with the catastrophic failure rate. Project CHIMERA even more so with the grafting of even more ICHOR into a single host being an exponentially higher risk.

Yet your very body manages to withstand the grafting of not just another Honkai Beast, but all of them.  Every single Honkai Beast felled by Fire Moth, all of their genetic data implanted in you. You are the magnum opus of Project CHIMERA and the final hope of humanity. You’ve become the Brahma CHIMERA.

In having the genes of every Honkai Beast, you hold the potential of developing every single one of their abilities with your mastery of Honkai Energy. Mastery of the elements, bending space, harnessing the powers of life and death, even manipulating time. Through your Honkai Adaptability and your genetics, all these and more can eventually be mastered by you. Although it cannot be said to compare to the Authority of a Herrscher, you can still overwhelm them through raw power.

Be warned, for all your might still cannot compare to Finality, but with time you may perhaps grow enough to surpass it.

This is the power of humanity’s strongest. The ultimate hero of the Previous Era. Leader of the Flamechasers, the Deliverance. This is the power of Kevin.
addons.title: Kevin

objects.text:
The Flamechasers were the best and worst of humanity, yet even they fall short before you, the pinnacle of Project SOLDIER. You didn’t simply go through the Meta-Morph surgery once, but twice. Having braved and defied impossible odds, you stand above all as the proof of the success of Project CHIMERA, and humanity’s answer to eradicate the vile Honkai.

Due to having undergone the surgery yet again, the genes of yet another Honkai Beast are grafted onto you, granting you a second set of abilities and further empowering your existing ones. Even amongst the monsters of the Previous Era, almost none can stand against your strength except for Kevin himself and Finality. Your strikes fell nations, your stride allows you to circle the globe in minutes, and your chosen ability could even engulf an entire continent.

Project CHIMERA is perfected, and unlike regular MANTIS, you do not need to fear your Active Honkai Reaction, for the line between your beast form and humanity has been erased. Your control over your transformation is perfected and without flaw, even able to partially transform select traits while keeping the overall convenience and mobility of your human form.
objects.title: CHIMERA (Honkai Impact 3rd)

objects.text:
Your saintly nature has harmonized with the power of the Belmont bloodline, greatly enhancing both.

All your physical attributes such as strength, speed, durability, senses, and magical potential are amplified tenfold.

Your affinity for all forms of holy magic, particularly those rooted in the Abrahamic faith, has increased immensely, allowing you to advance at an extraordinary pace. Simply witnessing holy magic in action enables you to replicate the spell with ease, and after a few casts, you can further refine and evolve it. 

You can even draw inspiration from reading religious, mythological, and spiritual texts to create entirely new forms of holy magic.

Your resistance to harmful effects, originally granted by your bloodline, has evolved into complete immunity unless the opponent attempting to afflict you is vastly more powerful. Even in such cases, the harmful effects are significantly reduced.

Your holy nature has become so potent that you can sanctify and bless everything in your presence at will. You radiate an aura of holy energy that heals and empowers your allies, while simultaneously punishing enemies who come into contact with it by searing them with holy fire. The more corrupt, sinful, or vile the enemies, the more severe the damage they suffer.
objects.title: Bane of Darkness

addons.text:
Your Dragonstone has completely stopped your degeneration and allowed you to use your powers without risk of degenerating. On top of this your stone just by having it on your person gives you a passive boost in power to your strength, physical and magical defense, your speed, and your accuracy. 

You also cannot be easily permanently killed. Destroying your soul would make your body a soulless husk that would be a shadow of yourself but would regenerate your soul over time. Destroying your body would only free your soul and it would not take long for you to craft a new body as strong as your previous one to inhabit and get revenge. Destroying both would cause you to go into slumber for potentially a thousand years unless you were resurrected early. The only way to truly put you down is if you (or someone who can be considered you) killed yourself.
addons.title: Perfect Stone

objects.text:
You have fully shed the last traces of your humanity and become a true Dragon. Whether you're a Divine Dragon, Fell Dragon, Nabatean,  First Dragon, or an Astral Dragon, the immense power you wield is enough to inspire entire nations to worship you as their deity.

With this transformation, you gain a vast reservoir of mana and an exceptional aptitude for mastering and creating Faith and Reason Magic. Your magical prowess allows you to perform feats such as traveling to other worlds or dimensions, rewinding time, creating pocket dimensions, resurrecting the dead, and even terraforming a planet with considerable personal effort. You can also craft powerful artifacts and weapons from your own body parts, and your blood has a holy—or unholy—magical property that heals those who drink it of most injuries. It also grants them a permanent enhancement to all physical and magical attributes and can even extend their lifespan by centuries. These gifts can pass through their bloodline, and if you choose to bless them, they will bear a crest or mark somewhere on their body.

Even in your humanoid form, you possess extraordinary physical power—strong enough to punch through concrete, leap over buildings, defeat small armies of human knights, and survive falls from great heights such as cliffs, albeit with some injury. In your Dragon form, this power multiplies dramatically, allowing you to smash through buildings with ease. Depending on your dragon type, you may also breathe magical flames or unleash a laser that you can imbue with specific magical effects, such as healing whoever is hit or inflicting curses and poisonous effects onto where ever your breath lands.

However, this immense power comes at a cost. The constant growth of your power places a tremendous strain on your mind and body, slowly pushing you toward madness. To counter this, you may create a Dragonstone to seal most of your powers, slowing—or potentially halting—your degradation. However, this weakens you significantly, and you cannot transform without the Dragonstone, which can be stolen or lost. Alternatively, you could leave your body behind and retreat from the physical world altogether. This would severely limit your ability to influence the real world outside of communicating mentally with followers of your religion, any children you have or create, or through making temporary vessels.

A final option is to try to overcome your madness through unique applications of your powers or sheer will. Although the odds are slim, it is not entirely impossible.
objects.title: Divine Dragon (Fire Emblem)

addons.text:
Your existence as a Primordial Jötunn has fused with your other half as a Divine God. This conceptual union grants you access to the Norse Texture of the World—a realm destroyed centuries ago by Surtr during Ragnarök.

This connection allows you to gradually recreate the Texture, along with all the beings and magic it once contained, thanks to your life-giving properties. Over time, you will not only gain the Authorities of the Norse gods but also those of the Jötunn, including Surtr’s sword Laevatein and Fenrir’s Authority over Ice.

You can choose to "deploy" and project the Texture onto the current world, replacing its existing reality with your own, thereby destroying what is presently there. Alternatively, if you wish to avoid destruction, you can take the slower path of integrating the existing world into your Texture, gradually taking control of it.

Should you choose to deploy the Texture, the location where you do so becomes your "Throne". This Throne can take any form you desire, but if it is destroyed before the world’s destruction or integration, you will suffer immense backlash, with death being a possibility.

With time, you may truly become Ymir reborn and reign as the Sovereign you were always destined to be.
addons.title: Texture of Scandinavia

addons.text:
Through your divine blood and source of power, your Akh, or soul, is now intrinsically tied to Egypt—or Kemet, as it was known in antiquity. As a being capable of existing within the Darkness and the Primeval Ocean, you hold the power to Name and bring forth the Texture of Kemet from nothingness once more.

This power enables you to slowly Name all things within the Texture, restoring them to the World. As you do so, you will gain the ability to summon and control the beings within it, such as the Sphinx, which wards off spirits; the Bennu, which carries the soul for rebirth; and Ammit, the devourer of souls, among many others.

By Naming and recreating even the gods themselves, you become the All-Father of Kemet, inheriting their Authorities to shape the World as you see fit. You can assume their divine and animal forms, cementing your right to rule—a right that can neither be denied nor overturned, ensuring your eternal reign.

You can choose to "deploy" and project the Texture onto the current world, replacing its existing reality with your own, thereby destroying what is presently there. Alternatively, if you wish to avoid destruction, you can take the slower path of integrating the existing world into your Texture, gradually taking control of it.

Should you choose to deploy the Texture, the location where you do so becomes your "Throne". This Throne can take any form you desire, but if it is destroyed before the world’s destruction or integration, you will suffer immense backlash, with death being a possibility.
addons.title: Texture of Kemet

addons.text:
You now hold a Tie of En to the Texture of the Mesopotamian Gods through your ownership of the Great Bull of Heaven, Gugalanna. As the World Father, this connection grants you the power to recreate this Texture and all that exists within it.

Over time, you may slowly summon the various divine beasts of Mesopotamia, such as Anzu, the fire- and water-breathing bird, or Mushussu, the dragon-serpent that protects cities and enables travel between realms.

As you progress in the rebirth of the Texture, you will gradually lay claim to the Authorities of the gods and their Divine Armaments. For example, you may wield Ereshkigal's power to control the Underworld and bind even the gods who enter, or command the Axe of Marduk, a weapon that is the size of a building.

With Gugalanna, you have a choice: you may take his power, authority, and divine bull form for yourself, or allow him to remain a separate entity in your service.

You can choose to "deploy" and project the Texture onto the current world, replacing its existing reality with your own, thereby destroying what is presently there. Alternatively, if you wish to avoid destruction, you can take the slower path of integrating the existing world into your Texture, gradually taking control of it.

Should you choose to deploy the Texture, the location where you do so becomes your "Throne". This Throne can take any form you desire, but if it is destroyed before the world’s destruction or integration, you will suffer immense backlash, with death being a possibility.
addons.title: Texture of Mesopotamia

addons.text:
You, who share a connection to the Tiānxià Texture, now ascend to the mantle of the Primordial Giant Pangu, a being of your same exalted nature. This bond significantly enhances your abilities and accelerates your capacity to reforge the Tiānxià Texture. As Pangu’s inheritor, you embody his divine potential, standing as a cosmic force poised to shape the world.

However, like Pangu himself, you are bound by the necessity of growth. Though your power is heightened, it will take centuries of development before you achieve the true might required to part Heaven and Earth as Pangu once did. Until you reach this zenith, your strength remains immense yet incomplete, a promise of the unparalleled divinity that lies ahead.

Most crucially, you have inherited Pangu's Nameless Axe, the Heaven Splitting Axe that defined his legend. This mythical weapon, imbued with the essence of cosmic separation, is an equal to Ea, the Sword of Rupture of Mesopotamian myth. The axe's power is unparalleled, capable of splitting dimensions, cleaving through the fabric of reality, and bringing forth order from primordial chaos. Its existence marks you as a shaper of worlds, a being of supreme consequence in the cosmic hierarchy.

As Pangu's mantle-bearer, you are destined to walk the path of a creator and divider, balancing growth with the weight of a giant’s responsibility. Your bond with the Tiānxià Texture and mastery of the Heaven Splitting Axe mark the first steps of your journey to rival the deeds of the Primordial Giant himself.
addons.title: Pangu, Divider of Heaven & Earth

objects.text:
You are now akin to Ymir, a primordial being born from the Gap before the World. Your power and exalted nature are such that, if you were somehow killed, your very flesh could be shaped into a new Universe, with your body serving as the foundation for a new generation of Gods and Giants.

Yet, even while alive, you possess the ability to create and manipulate the phenomena of the World. You wield power and authority over all natural things, such as water, wind, earth, fire, metals, jewels, and trees, to name a few.

If you so desire, you can recreate the primordial realms of Niflheim and Muspelheim, drawing upon their essence to shape new worlds or even beings equal to yourself. However, such a feat would require centuries of effort, even for one as powerful as you.
objects.title: Father of the World

objects.text:
Your body has evolved into a veritable breeding ground for an array of new variants of the blacklight virus. Each moment that passes brings forth increasingly potent strains within you, rapidly outpacing their predecessors in both complexity and virulence. Through this extraordinary transformation, you have uncovered a remarkable ability: the power to infect others with these newly formed variants. This infection causes them to undergo drastic transformations, turning them into an array of evolved beings such as Walkers, Hunters, Hydras, Brawlers, Flyers, and more. You aren't limited to the types that have previously existed. As time passes, you will discover innovative methods to transform others, continually expanding as you evolve.

In addition to this remarkable capacity for transformation, you have developed a unique connection to every being you infect, creating a literal hive mind. This interconnectedness allows you to maintain control over the infected but also grants you a pivotal advantage: the ability to survive death. As long as at least one of your infected beings remains alive, you can continue to exist, ensuring your legacy and influence endure beyond your physical form.

Moreover, you possess the option to retain the intellect and personality of those you infect, granting them sentience while ensuring their loyalty.
objects.title: Queen (Prototype)

objects.text:
You have ascended to become the Monarch of Frost, the ruler of snow and ice, and one of the nine Monarchs. Your mastery over frost and stealth has grown into something legendary, while your physical and magical prowess now rivals the strongest warriors and sorcerers in existence.

With your newfound power, your physical capabilities have reached extraordinary levels. You are able to overpower even the most formidable opponents with sheer brute force with speed most enemies cannot keep up, appearing to vanish only to reappear in an instant. Your body itself has become a fortress, resilient against physical blows, magical attacks, and the harshest of environments.

Your connection to frost magic has evolved into total mastery. With just a thought, you can summon massive waves of ice, sculpt it into deadly weapons or impenetrable shields, and conjure devastating ice storms that blanket entire battlefields in freezing destruction. You hold the power to create living creatures from ice, commanding them to fight by your side as extensions of your will. Even your breath carries the chilling essence of your power, unleashing torrents of freezing air capable of turning entire landscapes into frozen wastelands and trapping enemies in unbreakable ice.

When pushed to your limits, you can activate your Spiritual Body Manifestation. In this form, your appearance becomes otherworldly. Your hair grows long and takes on a glowing, flame-like quality, while your elven features become sharper and more pronounced. In this state, your strength, speed, and magical abilities reach their absolute peak. The cold itself bends to your will. You are immune to even the most extreme icy conditions with your very presence lowering the temperature around you. Your ice freezes down to the soul itself, trapping all those you freeze.
objects.title: Monarch of Frost (Solo Leveling)

objects.text:
You took to the operation better than most. You're not just a run-of-the-mill Claymore but the strongest of your generation. Your 0% usage of Yoki is enough for you to kill a handful of weaker Claymores even when they are using 50% of their Yoki. Further Yoki usage would allow you to fight off hordes of mid-rank Claymores, requiring dozens of them working together to kill you—likely with near-total casualties.

You move and fight at least at Mach speed even without using Yoki and hit hard enough to bring down large houses with a single punch. With increased Yoki usage, your abilities will grow to the point where you can cross a country in a minute or slice through reinforced steel as if it were butter. You are also automatically the master of a powerful technique. It could be an already known one, such as the Quick Sword or moving so fast you create afterimages, or it could be a technique of your own creation.

Should you Awaken, you will take on a completely new form called an Abyssal One. At this level of power, it would take a No.1 Claymore herself Awakening to even hope to defeat you.
objects.title: Claymore No.1 (Claymore)

objects.text: Now instead of being a new member of the Order of the Dragon, you’re now a senior member of the Order, more particularly one of the Dragon Council. As a Councilor your ‘territory’ is no longer something so small as a region or a nation, now you watch over an entire continent. This no longer requires you to personally intervene in most issues, able to delegate that to the younger World Dragons within your territory, but does mean you have the task of making sure said World Dragons are up to the role they’ve been placed in. This could be as simple as further training & supplies, to the unfortunate step of having to replace a World Dragon not up to the task. With the purchase of this position, you get free pick of which continent you choose to be yours with it defaulting to the one you start within. One of the other tasks of a World Dragon is a blessing and a curse, you have the ability and knowledge of how to remove the Dragon magic within a Dragon, rendering them for all intents and purposes human. This is usually reserved for rule breakers so severe as to leave no other options, though I do suppose one might volunteer to have their magic removed if they wished to no longer be a Dragon. The other side of this power—the ‘blessing’—is available only to you from your purchase here. The ability to give another a tiny fragment of your Dragon magic, to ignite the ability within them, and turn them into a Dragon. Don’t worry the fragment you give away will replenish itself in time. Lastly in concert with any other Council Members is your task to set the ‘rules’ of the Magical World, setting the limits and boundaries upon the Magical Community, which they are expect to follow. This does require other Council members to exist and be able to contribute to said rules.
objects.title: Councilor (American Dragon)

addons.text: The Stella Populi expression of this expansion renders the world fluid, letting you warp the world around you as you do your own flesh, and allowing you to use any of your own abilities though it. This includes activating your Empowerments through the terrain, enhancing your mutability greatly, allowing you to potentially become one with the environment while this is active, and even allowing you to produce Seeds en masse within your territory. This territory is cantered on your ‘physical’ body.

The Astrum Populi expression of this expansion renders the world a rigid and hot hell, allowing you to reduce and break it’s features into molten rock, then to vapour, all the way to atoms if focused with enough time. Furthermore, you can activate your Dissent thorough the terrain, drawing any energies within the territory into your ‘Void’ as if it was your own body. Finally, you can use your Territory to produce Seeds en masse, creating a field of metaphysically judgemental artillery.
As legacy to both the Stella and Astrum Populi, you can seamlessly switch between these two ‘memories’, weaving together aspects of both to create a customised territory entirely your own.

objects.text: As legacy to the Stella or Astrum Populi, you’ve expanded your abilities, becoming the rock from which change spreads. As such, you can choose to anchor yourself in a particular location, causing the world around you to take the traits of the primordial universe your Seed came from.
objects.title: A Memory of a Kinder Age

objects.text:
You are now an advanced cybernetic variant of a Soong-type Android, similar to how the Borg Queen modified Data to have organic components (but the other way around), the positronic brain implants given to Barell Antos by Dr. Julian Bashir, the Juliana Tainer replica, or one timeline's later Soong "golems".

While many of your mental and physical capabilities were already equal or superior to an Android as a mighty Augment, there are certain technological faculties that biology as we know it cannot currently replicate, which you now also possess. These include the ability to directly interface with electronics, expanded visual senses like those of VISORs or ocular implants, super-hearing powerful enough to distinguish thousands of individual voices speaking at the same time, exact perfect memory & 24/7 uptime like that of a Noctis Cape, advanced multitasking via multithreaded computing, adjustable accelerated perception of time & movement, the durability to outright ignore mag-dumping from modern assault rifles because of your tripolymer frame, the ability to easily endure harsh conditions for long periods of time (like extreme heat, complete submersion in water, or hard vacuum), a modular design allowing for easy upgrades, and so on.
objects.title: I Am Fully Functional (Star Trek)

objects.text:
Your unusually powerful Laplace Factor has resonated with your incredible talent for wielding Battle Aura, causing you to mutate.

You now inherit the characteristics of the Demonic-Dragon King Laplace, the unfortunate being that would later be divided into the Demon God and the Technique God, including his incredibly powerful dragon body, potent Dragon Battle Aura, and immense Mana. 

In addition, you gain access to echoes of the skills and memories of him and both his divided halves, which become clearer as you grow stronger. These echoes will speed you along the path to matching or even surpassing Laplace, a man who created the enchanted masterwork that is the Fighting God Armor and instilled it with all of its techniques, mastered physical combat, and Battle Aura usage as the Technique God, and commanded nearly all forms of magic as the Demon God.
objects.title: Demonic-Dragon General Laplace (Mushoku Tensei)

objects.text:
You aren’t some newborn Noxraptora, but an Elder. Few of your kind ever live long enough to reach this stage, for where a Noxraptora hunts, a Chalysacrus prowls nearby. To most creatures, the Chalysacrus is a nightmare in motion — a colossal, millipede-shaped mammalian predator, the size of a semi-truck, clad in a segmented outer hide that can instantly stiffen to hardness rivaling alloyed steel. The two species are ancient enemies, predators and prey to each other in turn. For a Noxraptora to grow old, there is only one path: to become a killer of Chalysacruses. Not merely one or two, but for Chalysacruses to be your main, and only, prey. 

As an Elder, your form is larger and darker than any of your kin. Where the young stand at 2.4 meters extended, you rise above 5 meters when fully unfurled. Your plates of carbon-rich biomineral has dulled into a matte black surface, textured to swallow infrared and scatter even the faintest traces of reflected light. This gives you not just the appearance of health, but practical stealth. At a glance, you are a shadow even to those who see by heat, and your body chemistry has reached a state of peak efficiency, circulating nutrients and repairing damage faster than any younger Noxraptora could.

The most striking difference lies in your armor. You have not only grown your own plates thicker and stronger, but you have woven into your body the hardened dermis of your rival, the Chalysacrus. These colossal beasts are covered in a skin that appears like rigid exoskeleton but is in truth soft and flexible until an electric current courses through it, at which point the tissues crystallize into a barrier that rivals alloyed steel. By grafting these plates into your body, you have turned their unique defense into your own. 

Each segment remains biologically alive, capable of healing and is wired into your bioelectric system by anchoring tendrils. With a thought, you can send a signal through them, hardening the once-pliable dermis into steel-like armor. A direct rifle round of 9mm or even 5.56mm strikes sparks from the surface and leaves no more than a faint scorch mark. Against heavier calibers — .308 or similar — it takes repeated impacts in the same spot to fracture a plate, and even then, the damage is localized. Against most melee impacts, from claws to blunt strikes, you are entirely immune.

You can also refashion these plates at will along your limbs and torso, hardening them into scythe-like edges or spear-like protrusions that tear through armor with explosive bursts of strength. A single hardened limb can split a fungal stalk two meters thick or shear through a human body like tofu. In full extension, your body can generate over 9,000 newtons of piercing force per forelimb strike.

Your most fearsome adornment is the head of your prey, the Chalysacrus, worn as a mask and mantle over your own. With pseudotissue woven around it, you animate the skull and make it appear as though the beast itself still lives, its body continuing in mimicry behind you. Its gnathic beak can be used for tearing prey and even stone itself. The false head can be folded back into your armored form when stealth is required. 

In addition to all this, you will also have all the skills, experiences and expertise expected of an Elder. This ranges from hunting, stealth, and pure combat outside ambushes, be it in your true appearance or a false one. Most importantly, it comes with knowledge and sharpened instincts on how to kill creatures of all kinds in all situations.
objects.title: Elder Noxraptora

objects.text:
You aren’t a normal Noxraptora but a sub-variant with a mutation that appears rarely and is carried as a recessive trait. Your body houses a unique development within the brain: a specialized node. This node is a dense cluster of layered neural tissues, deeply interwoven with your chemical-sensory lobes and resonance memory. Its sole purpose is to read living creatures — not just their thermal or chemical signatures, but the subtle and fleeting signals that betray recognition, trust, and familiarity.

The new node functions as a predictive engine. It collects a torrent of data from the rest of your sensory system: the minute tightening of jaw muscles, the dilation of pupils, the tremor of an eyelid when a memory is triggered, the micro-changes in posture when fear relaxes into recognition. It does not stop with visual and muscular cues. The organ is chemically tuned to pheromone chains, stress hormones, and the volatile molecules that change in the air as a creature shifts from suspicion to relief.

The node then interprets the data it gathers as a model of social expectation. Every social animal carries compressed “templates” of familiar faces, scents, and voices — heuristic shortcuts the brain uses to identify kin or allies without recalculating every detail. Your node decodes those templates in real time, inferring the shape and tone of a trusted figure without ever having encountered them yourself. By running thousands of subtle predictions per second, the node builds a working mask from fragments of recognition.

At first, this mask is rough. The pseudotissue folds into a shape close enough to trigger familiarity but not exact enough to be fully convincing, causing the uncanny valley effect. The prey may hesitate, feeling that the features are recognizable but that something in the mannerisms is subtly wrong. The refinement process begins at this point. Every twitch of unease, every pulse of cortisol or tilt of the head feeds back into the node, which corrects and reshapes the disguise. The face smooths toward a better likeness, the vocal chamber adjusts timbre and cadence, the pheromone blend alters ratios. Each correction makes the prey’s subconscious relax, the recognition sharpening as the mask converges with memory.

In a matter of minutes, you can assume the perfect likeness, both appearance and personality, of someone your target trusts — family, companion, or ally — despite never having laid eyes on the person you transformed into before. The longer you analyse them, the more convincing the mask becomes.
objects.title: Psycho-Noxraptora

addons.text:
Perhaps it is in their nature to hunt the greatest prey it can find, for one within the line of Chalyraptora had turned even its own bloodline into quarry. This one named itself God Tamer, a Noxraptora that not only survived its Chalysacrus rival but eventually hunted and absorbed those of its own fused lineage.

With the Elder’s five-meter frame merged beneath the armored length of a semi-truck-sized Chalysacrus, its sheer size made the anchoring tendrils capable of extending in numbers and lengths never seen before. Each tendril has grafted the dermal armor of other Chalysacrus and is able to absorb kinetic energy from impact and transfer it instantly between bodies. A rifle round striking the Chalysacrus’s flank may dissipate its momentum into the Elder’s frame to fuel the Elder’s own lunging strike. The tendrils can also take on more forms in different places, such as protruding scythes erupting between plates mid-charge, spear-like tendrils braced against fungal walls, or shearing edges running down the flank to cut anything that dares approach the sides.

Its pseudoflesh has also evolved into a greater deception engine. With the Chalysacrus secreting a preservative fluid that sustains the tissue in the Elder’s absence, the creature can now craft temporary animated husks. These imitations are not true life but unsettling puppets, pliable frames clad in preserved hide and animated by twitching pseudomusculature. The most iconic manifestation is the false “rider”: a humanoid silhouette seated upon the Chalysacrus’s back, appearing as a commander directing the beast. Packs of husks can even be left behind to harry and disorient prey, although none can last for more than an hour before becoming rotted, putrid sludge. 

The bond between Elder and mount has reached a state of perfect integration. Their senses no longer complement each other but operate as one network, triangulating prey through seismic resonance, chemical trails, and heartbeat vibrations in ways no other organism on Zethas can match. Hunting strategies sharpened across centuries of survival are shared seamlessly — the Elder’s surgical precision and the Chalysacrus’s unstoppable force combine into a rhythm that embodies the act of killing itself.
addons.title: God Tamer

objects.text:
The Chalyraptora are a rare bonded subspecies born from predator and prey locked into mutual survival. Where most Noxraptora hunts the colossal Chalysacrus, one outlier learned to tame instead of kill. Over generations this pairing became hereditary, producing creatures that are no longer two individuals but one integrated organism — a predator hidden within a juggernaut, perfectly adapted to Zethas’s fungal labyrinths.

When a Noxraptora bonds with a Chalysacrus, its anchoring tendrils can hook directly into the dermal seams of the giant’s plates. These plates flex and part to create cavities where the Noxraptora can compress itself fully, hiding beneath the armored exoskeleton. Once inside, the Noxraptora can transmit electrochemical pulses into the Chalysacrus’s nervous system, effectively riding and guiding the beast as if it were its own extended body. These tendrils do not remain fixed only where the Noxraptora rests; they can emerge from any plate in the Chalysacrus’s body. This lets the Noxraptora steer with precision during a sprint, sprout manipulatory limbs mid-charge to seize prey, or patch wounds on segments too distant for the Chalysacrus to tend. If a fungal acid wound eats into the rear plating, tendrils can emerge directly at the injury, weaving pseudoflesh across the damage while the rest of the organism continues to fight. 

The Noxraptora can also create pseudoflesh across the Chalysacrus’s segmented armor to disguises the massive beast as another organism or even a part of the environment. It can mimic fungal ridges, chitin plating, or mammalian hides harvested from prey, making the creature appear harmless or inert until it springs into action. Unlike the Chalysacrus’s natural armor, which is purely defensive, pseudoflesh allows the fusion to adapt its form after each kill. A Chalyraptora may coat itself in the carapaces of fallen megafauna, gaining new natural weapons, ranging from new claws, teeth or even poisons. The Chalysacrus itself cannot generate pseudoflesh, but once coated, it maintains and nourishes the tissue independently via fluids it secretes naturally.

On its own, a Chalysacrus can sprint at twenty meters per second but cannot make sharp turns; with Noxraptora steering, it pivots smoothly through tunnels only a few meters wide. The Noxraptora can also launch itself from a sprinting Chalysacrus’s back, effectively doubling its leaping range from seven to over fourteen meters. Their senses combine into a single grid: seismic vibrations and thermal signatures from the Chalysacrus link seamlessly with heartbeat detection and chemical mapping from the Noxraptora.
objects.title: Chalyraptora

objects.text:
Each purchase gives you the complete mental, physical, and sensory experience of a successful hunt. You gain the reflexes, combat intuition, and terrain awareness as if you’d faced the prey yourself. Your body acclimates, your mind adjusts, and your instincts learn—not through repetition, but through perfect recall of the victory.

You can choose what kind of prey the hunt was against. Each hunt is generally of similar difficulty unless you choose multiple hunts of the same type. In that case, each subsequent hunt is significantly harder than the last. Specializing in a particular prey (e.g., humans, Xenomorphs, rival Yautja) causes your experience to compound exponentially—refining your timing, strike precision, and tactical superiority in that specific situation. However, choosing a wide variety of prey grants you an expansive, adaptable understanding of diverse ecosystems, species behaviors, and battlefield conditions.

You may optionally claim a trophy from each hunt—a fang, skull, tail-blade, bio-helmet, or another symbolic artifact. These trophies serve as marks of prestige, intimidation, or ceremonial use among your kind.
objects.title: The Hunt (Predator)

objects.text:
It seems that instead of being a normal Dinaurian you are instead akin to King Dynal, who was monstrously strong compared to his kin. Further, you also gain a pair of hairs to denote your nature.

Now in your Dinaurian form, you can defeat an Executor Dinaurian, who is able to wipe out an entire Dinaurian squad in a moment and fight on equal terms with Dinaurians in their Battle Form, with a single casual blow. 

In your Battle Form, you possess power that rivals and matches that of some of the strongest vivosaurs, who can create thunderstorms, summon earthquakes, spew out fireballs that can vaporize entire lakes, and endure just as much. Finally, you also possess the horrifying and destructive ability to fire beams of antimatter in your Battle Form.
objects.title: Dinaurian King (Fossil Fighters)

objects.text:
Your body is no longer bound by the limitations of ordinary physiology. Much like Raiden Tameemon, you were born cursed with prodigious muscle mass—so immense and overwhelming that, under normal circumstances, it would have crushed your own skeleton from the inside out.

And like Raiden, your monstrous musculature continues to grow even now, increasing in both mass and density without any effort on your part, an unstoppable biological force that defies logic. Yet where this grotesque excess would have destroyed a lesser being, you endured. Unlike Raiden, whose mastery required the bond of a Völundr to unlock his full potential, your control is entirely your own.

You have achieved complete dominance over your musculature. Every fiber, every strand of your being obeys your command with absolute precision. You can redistribute your muscle mass throughout your body at will, allowing you to shift and condense raw power into any area you choose—your fists can strike with the weight of a sledgehammer, your legs can propel you like a rocket, and your back can become a fortress of living armor.

This dynamic control grants you the ability to vastly enhance both your offensive and defensive capabilities in combat, turning your body into a living weapon capable of adapting on the fly to any threat.
objects.title: Peerless Rikishi (Record of Ragnarok)

addons.text:
You have gained the Legendary Kanohi, the Mask of Creation, alongside your previously chosen Kanohi.

The Mask of Creation functions by allowing its wielder to manifest almost any item they envision, depending on whether said item already exists or not. Should said item not exist, the mask will grant its wielder step-by-step instructions on how to make it, but should an envisioned item have already been made, the mask can now simply make the item out of thin air. Notably, its sole known creative limitation is that it is incapable of making living beings.

Finally, it should be noted that in a catastrophic case where the mask of creation is somehow destroyed it would render all beings within a planetary range of the mask no longer capable of creation anymore.
addons.title: Mask of Creation (BIONICLE)

addons.text:
You have gained the Legendary Kanohi, Ignika the Mask of Life, alongside your previously chosen Kanohi. 

Ignika functions by allowing its wielder to do virtually anything with life save resurrecting it. It has been shown to be able to create, absorb, and control life energies, bring inanimate objects to life, alter and control life-forms, enlarge life-forms to kaiju proportions, change one life-form into another, manipulate aging, evolve & devolve life-forms, accelerate life functions, and even restore Toa Power reverting a Turaga into a Toa. Notably, the limitation of the Ignika one being unable to resurrect life can be bypassed by the wielder spending their own life energy to fuel the process, the cost so long based upon the time the target was deceased and how strong it was.

Finally, it should be noted that, unlike other Kanohi, Ignika is fully cognizant and capable of acting of its own accord. Further, it is initially somewhat simple and ignorant of its capabilities, such as granting what most would consider a curse, believing it to be a blessing, thus many of its views and personality will be shaped by its wielder's actions and perspective.
addons.title: Mask of Life (BIONICLE)

addons.text:
You have gained the Legendary Kanohi, Vahi the Mask of Time, alongside your previously chosen Kanohi.

Vahi functions by allowing its wielder to either speed up or slow down time upon a target, and is controlled through its wielder’s willpower. Notably, it cannot be used for time travel.

Finally, it should be noted that in a catastrophic scenario where Vahi is either somehow destroyed or its wielder completely loses control, it would/can destroy the fabric of time within a planetary range of itself.
addons.title: Mask of Time (BIONICLE)

addons.text:
The presence of the super-soldier serum has transformed you in the same manner that Energized Protodermis transformed the Toa Nuva.

Starting off, your new form grants you greater armor and physical capabilities, estimated to be about a 50% increase.

Your elemental power has seen a massive increase in both power and control. For example, allowing a Toa of Stone to set its powers on an hour delay, once done, will reduce an entire stone fortress to dust.

Perhaps most impressively is that you may now share your Kanohi’s power with nearby allies, and in turn the willpower of nearby allies being affected can increase the power of your Kanohi.

Finally, unlike the Toa Nuva, you lack the limitation of your Elemental Power being linked to a Nuva Symbol.
addons.title: Energized Protodermis Exposure (BIONICLE)

addons.text:
Like the Toa Nuva you have been implemented with Adaptive Armor. 

Adaptive Armor is specialized protosteel armor made by Artakha, that possesses the remarkable ability to adapt and shapeshift to suit its wearer’s surroundings, but not oncoming attacks. For example, in an aerial environment it would generate jets, wings, and eye protection; in a desert environment it would generate sand filters, cooling systems, hydration packs, and shaded eye-protectors, and in space it would generate trust and navigation systems along with insulation for protection. Even specific surroundings like piloting a vehicle can generate adaptations.

It is noted that Adaptive Armor does include and affect Toa Tools, Kanohi, and launcher weapons in its adaptations.
addons.title: Adaptive Armor (BIONICLE)

objects.text:
You have undergone the grand transformation from Matoran into Toa.

As a Toa, you are still a biomechanical being retaining the same needs, feeding capabilities, and composition, although there are several differences. As Toa were designed by the Great Beings to protect the Matorans rather than for labor and construction, both their build and physical capabilities are different. Resulting in the Toa being nearly twice the size of a Matoran at about 2.2 meters on average, able to lift over a ton, casually smash through rock, and withstand gunfire.

The transformation is more than purely physical boons, as it has also caused your Kanohi (Mask) and Elemental Power to evolve into a greater form, granting you a Toa Tool, and finally access to Toa Power.

Starting off, a Toa Tool is a unique armament that allows a Toa to more finely control its powers and that will grow and change alongside its Toa, such as reshaping itself to still be wieldable even if it's Tao’s body has been forcibly mutated into a new form. Notable, these weapons will include features that allow them to be used in other situations, such as spikes doubling as snow shoes. You may choose what your Toa Tool is.

Next, your Kanohi evolved into one of the Noble or Great Kanohi seen within the series, which can grant you abilities such as flight, invisibility, water breathing, or even necromancy.

Your Elemental Power has grown tremendously beyond your minute elemental trait. You, as a Toa, can create, control, and absorb your element on both a minute and massive scale, such as small flames precise enough to make symbolic etchings in metal to battlefield covering infernos. The ultimate expression of this Nova Burst is in which a Toa unleashes all of their Elemental Power in a singular, very destructive burst that will leave the Toa physically exhausted and unable to use their Elemental Power until it replenishes. The Nova Burst itself is destructive enough to completely wipe out cities that rival New York City in scale. Finally, it should be noted that as a Toa you will still retain the minute elemental trait you possessed as a Matoran.

Finally, Toa Power is a non-replenishing reservoir of power that helps guide a Toa towards their destiny, and can be used to create Toa Stones to allow the creation of further Toas. Once a Toa has both exhausted their Toa Power and fulfilled their destiny, they will turn into a Turaga, a form that is weaker and limited, in exchange for great wisdom and leadership skills.
objects.title: Toa (BIONICLE)

objects.text:
You have transformed into a Makuta, who were a mighty race tasked with creating and controlling Rahi (Matoran Universe wildlife) and maintaining peace and stability within the Matoran Universe.

As a Makuta, you have evolved into a gaseous energy known as antidermis that is contained within immensely powerful protosteel armor. Due to this unique composition, you no longer tire and feel pain, nor do you need to eat, drink, or sleep anymore. Additionally, your Kanohi has changed to your pick of any Noble or Great Kanohi.

Further, the process of becoming a Makuta has resulted in you, like your kin, being gifted with knowledge of the entire workings of the Matoran Universe, and, by extension, how to manipulate it. Whilst this will be less useful outside the Matoran Universe, with study you could learn to apply this knowledge elsewhere, like how to control and reshape the wildlife of alien worlds like you would Rahi.

It should be noted that should either your armor be destroyed or your Kanohi be removed, your essence will leak out, which will eventually become fatal. Although it will take a few weeks for it to reach that point, and as a Makuta you possess a few means of rectifying that issue.

As befitting their duties, the Makuta possess a very wide variety of powers. 

Starting off, Makuta are telepaths able to read, detect, and interact with non-shielded minds, even capable of severing the mental connections and bonds of others. Further, this allows the Makuta a resistance to the psionic abilities of others, and is even retained when they lack a physical form.

Next, Makuta, when lacking a physical body, can possess either a robotic body or a living one that lacks a spirit. Although this came at the cost of limiting their own power, whilst allowing them to wield whatever power that their body already possesses.

The Makuta were gifted the element of shadows, which grants them the power to control, generate, and absorb shadows and darkness. With this you could create physical objects, vortexes, and shields from shadows, negate light and heat with darkness, communicate or spy upon others through shadows, create blasts of shadows and darkness that could envelop major cities, and even create the immensely useful Shadow Hands.

Shadow Hands are the ultimate expression of a Makuta’s elemental power. They are enormous hands made of shadows that can either be used to absorb others to both gain their mass and replenish one’s own strength or to channel one’s powers through for greater results. Notably, you possess control over your Shadow Hands like Makuta Chirox, who could use them as additional limbs.

Makuda can shapeshift, including their armor, allowing them to take all manner of forms and traits, like wings for flight or the guise of a Turaga for infiltration. When shapeshifting into smaller forms, their excess mass will be shunted off into a personal subspace, whilst conversely, growing larger will require them to attain additional mass from either their subspace or others. Further, shapeshifting can affect a Makuta’s physical capabilities to match their form, such as becoming larger, granting them superhuman strength and durability. Notably, shapeshifting cannot repair a Makuta’s armor.

Potentially most terrifying, Makuda possess a set of 42 powers that, whilst they can only wield one at a time, can be freely switched between. Further, Makuta are capable of creating loyal slug-like creatures known as Kraata (by extension Rahkshi) that can wield any one of the 42 powers themselves, although their creation will temporarily weaken a Makuta.

The following are the 42 powers: Accuracy, Adaptation, Anger, Chain Lightning, Chameleon, Confusion, Cyclone, Darkness, Density Control, Disintegration, Dodge, Elasticity, Electricity, Fear, Fire Resistance, Fragmentation, Gravity, Heat Vision, Hunger, Ice Resistance, Illusion, Insect Control, Laser Vision, Limited Invulnerability, Magnetism, Mind Reading, Molecular Disruption, Plant Control, Plasma, Poison, Power Scream, Quick Healing, Rahi Control, Silence, Sleep, Slow, Sonics, Stasis Field, Teleportation, Vacuum, and Weather Control.

Finally, it is possible that, through meditation over years, you could become akin to the Makuda of the Melding Universe, ridding yourself of the element of shadow and the powers of darkness, anger, and fear; in return, gaining the element of light and the powers of courage and peace.
objects.title: Makuta (BIONICLE)

addons.text:
By utilizing the collective technological knowledge of the BIONICLE universe you have upgraded yourself far beyond what your original parameters entailed.

Your newly enhanced gargantuan form is infused with Adaptive Armor, allowing you to reconfigure whatever situations the universe could throw at you. Onwards, unlike before when your offensive capabilities were purely for self-defense, now you possess a wide variety of armaments for more offensive means, such as shoulder-mounted blasters, power-channeling staffs, and even absurdly sized Toa Tools.

Upon your face now sits a Kanohi, which can transform into any existing Kanohi, allowing you to wield their power on a scale matching your own, such as using the Mask of Repulse to launch worlds away from you, or the Mask of Strength to allow you to obliterate planetoids with just a punch.

Further, you have regained the ability to wield the Makuta’s 42 powers, of course scaled to match your capabilities, like sonics creating sound waves that can shred a planet apart or darkness being able to snuff out a star.

Finally, your ability to enhance your inhabitants has been further refined, allowing you to grant them any enhancement you possess knowledge of, for example, upgrading all Matoran with Adaptive Armor.
addons.title: Refined Machine (BIONICLE)

objects.text:
You have ascended to the pinnacle of the Great Beings works known as the Great Spirit Robot. You are an enormous humanoid robot standing at 12,192 kilometers tall, around the same size as the diameter of Earth, created to travel across space towards inhabited planets to observe the life, civilizations, and cultures that would and have developed in hopes of aiding in the mending of Spherus Magna and solving future conflicts.

Your outer shell comprises metallic Protodermis, an artificial element far stronger than natural metals and alloys made from them. Your interior, known as the Matoran Universe, is comprised of domed islands that house the millions of loyal techno-organic lifeforms that ensure that you continue to function properly like the Matorans, Toa, and Makuda, along with seas of liquid Protodermis. This internal space is fully under your control, allowing you to perform acts such as adjusting the gravity and temperature of the islands individually.

Beyond your sheer power, your immense size would grant you also possess the ability to fire energy blasts and gravity bursts. Despite your offensive ability being solely meant for self-defense, you possess enough raw power that you can vaporize the oceans of oceanic worlds, move celestial bodies, and even destroy planets and stars.

Beyond your offensive capabilities lies your sheer durability. In order to bring you down, it requires an absurd amount of force to damage you, meaning it would require an act like being surprise hit in the back of the head by a planetoid several times earth’s size, or crashing into a planet with defenses down at interstellar travel speeds.

Enhancing your capabilities, is your ability to wield all the previously available elements (Fire, Water, Jungle, Rock, Sand, Ice, Earth, Air, Light, Shadow, Sonics, Gravity, Plasma, Magnetism, Lightning, Iron, and Psionics) on a scale matching your own. Further, should a threat attempt to attack you from within, you can infuse others like those that call you home with elemental powers transforming akin to the Toa and Makuta.

Finally, you also possess a variety of additional capabilities. Attached to your back when in space or orbiting the planet you are currently upon, the Red Star, is a space station that both aids you in exiting planets and retrieves, revives, and returns the deceased lifeforms native to the Matoran Universe. Within your feet are rockets that when used in conjunction with the Red Star allow you space flight. Within your face is an advanced camouflage system that will allow it to take the form of an island that matches the planet of observation’s natural wildlife and form, whilst the rest of the body remains submerged. You possess an ejection system to remove foreign or undesirable objects from your body and potentially off planet. Your body possesses an advanced automatic repair function that will not only repair you, but also go out and retrieve internal components should they somehow be ejected from the body. You also possess the very esoteric ability to sense and alter the destinies of those currently inside you.
objects.title: Great Spirit Robot (BIONICLE)

objects.text:
It seems you are a hybrid mutant Serpentine, possessing a parentage of differing tribes. Further you are an anomaly among the Serpentine, as unlike other hybrids who don’t inherit the abilities of their tribes, you fully do.

With each purchase you gain the abilities and lineage of another Serpentine tribe.
objects.title: Chimeric Serpentine (LEGO Ninjago)

objects.text:
You have gone a step beyond other Super Mutants. Now, you have become the cream of the crop among your kind once more. As a Nightkin, you have slightly enhanced physical capabilities compared to before in all areas, able to run about 50 mph now and able to smash concrete with a single right cross and so on. However, you now have something a normal Super Mutant wouldn't have as well: An arsenal and above all else, a Stealth Boy.

With this Stealth Boy, you can sneak around undetected. No human eye can see you when a Stealth Boy is active, and must rely on all other senses or advanced technological means to detect you. However, overusage of this technology can lead to your mental state deteriorating. Thankfully, your mind deteriorates slower than a vast majority of other Nightkin would, taking constant usage and 2-3 years of it to get your mind down to a certain point.

Finally, as mentioned, you are also gifted a small arsenal of weapons of your choice from the Fallout world: A melee weapon for your large arms, a Big gun for you to fire, and an energy weapon.
objects.title: Nightkin (Fallout)

objects.text:
Fuchsiabloods are the pinnacle of Troll society, maintaining a supply of only two, the empress and an intended heiress. Notably aquatic, fuchsiabloods have two primary advantages over the rest of the species. 

Firstly, they do not age, being capable of living for millions of years unaided. Secondly, they have access to any of the psychic talents of their species, with the caveat they have to learn to use them from scratch and train with them to reach proficiency.
objects.title: Fuchsia (Homestuck)

objects.text:
You are the direct child of Godzilla, inheriting his nuclear dominion and his authority as the King of Monsters. Unlike your father, you walk in two worlds: you retain a human form that lets you live among mortals, but within you lies the same nuclear core and saurian might that has made him the apex Titan of the modern age.

In human form, your physiology is already extraordinary. Your bones and muscles are denser than steel, resistant to weapons, pressure, and heat. Radiation flows through your veins as energy, accelerating healing, fueling your powers, and ensuring you grow stronger over time. Exposure to large bursts of radiation pushes you past your natural limits, mutating you into stronger states and allowing you to survive injuries that would kill anything else. If you reach the brink of death, an infusion of radiation can restore you, forcing an evolution that remakes you into something even more powerful.

Your first weapon is Godzilla’s signature attack: the Atomic Breath, a concentrated nuclear beam capable of annihilating armor, stone, and even Titans. As you mature, you unlock the Nuclear Pulse, unleashing a massive energy discharge that vaporizes anything in your immediate range. Both powers scale with age and the amount of radiation you absorb, rising from destructive bursts in youth to world-shattering attacks in your Titan state.

Your Kaiju Form grows alongside you, beginning with partial manifestations — glowing ridges, scaled skin, and energy auras — and eventually unfolding into a full Titan body over 100 meters tall. In this state, you possess immense physical strength, able to lift hundreds of tons and fight other Titans as an equal. Conventional weaponry becomes useless against you, nuclear detonations fail to end you, and only specialized anti-Titan weapons or other monsters of your scale can pose a real threat. Even then, your regenerative factor allows you to recover and adapt, so long as you survive the encounter.

Like your father, you embody balance. The radiation you release is not poisonous but restorative. Plants thrive in your presence, ecosystems recover, and life grows stronger around you. You can serve as both destroyer and restorer, depending on how you choose to use your inheritance.

You maintain full control of your forms. You may stay human while channeling Titan abilities, shift into a hybrid form where claws, scales, and dorsal ridges emerge, or assume your full Kaiju state. Each form is available at will and continues to strengthen with age, battle, and radiation intake.

As Godzilla’s child, you are more than a half-blooded Titan. You are heir to the King of Monsters, born with nuclear fire in your veins and destined to carve a place of sovereignty within the Monsterverse.
objects.title: Child of Godzilla

objects.text:
The foundation of your enhanced body is only the beginning. Buried deep within your very being lies your true ES ability, the gift that once belonged to Éclair herself—the power known simply as Power. It is not subtle, nor intricate, nor reliant on delicate manipulation. Power is the most primal truth: strength beyond limit, will that cannot be broken, and vitality that endures even the collapse of empires. To inherit this ability is to inherit Éclair’s mantle, and you may choose the shape of that inheritance.

As her successor, you carry her legend forward, chosen to wield her strength and continue the path she began. As her reincarnation, you awaken as Éclair reborn, inheriting not only her will but her very form, able to become her in body, attire, and weaponry. As her child, you inherit her bloodline and natural might, her infinite determination and legacy flowing through your veins, yet you remain yourself—your own form, your own presence, distinct from hers. In each case, Éclair’s essence is yours, but the expression of that inheritance depends on the bond you choose.

When Power awakens, your body becomes a channel for force so overwhelming that natural law bends around you. Walls, armor, starship hulls, and dimensional barriers yield before your advance. Your fists can tear through mechs, your leaps span impossible distances, and your movements blur into hyperspeed beyond the ability of machines to track. Explosions and energy beams lose their terror, for your form hardens and adapts to meet every assault. The nanomachines within you reinforce bone and sinew, ensuring you are never destroyed by the very might you wield.
