Through auto-suggestion, you may limit or unlock this destructive strength, restraining yourself until the moment your will demands release. Where others are forced to calculate, to prepare, to outthink, you rely on the simplest truth: nothing can stop you.

Yet Power is not just the strength of muscle. It is Éclair’s essence, and through it, her infinite willpower becomes your own. You are not merely inheriting her force—you are inheriting her refusal to yield. When all odds are against you, when the universe itself declares defeat, you rise. Each failure only sharpens your determination, each setback fuels your resolve, and in this loop of defiance, your strength becomes inexhaustible. This is the heart of Éclair’s legend—that Power is not a gift of the body alone, but of the spirit that drives it beyond its limits.

From this essence also spring the subtler gifts hidden within raw might. Energy can be channeled outward, released in concussive bursts through weapon or hand alike, striking with the radiance of annihilation. Wounds that would cripple others knit closed, bones reform, and flesh renews itself under the current of endless vitality. Time itself bends before this force, granting renewal of youth and extension of life, the same power that let Éclair endure across centuries and rise again in each new era. Her strength is not only that of the warrior’s arm, but of the undying flame of life itself—fierce, unyielding, and self-renewing.

With this inheritance comes her form and legacy, but only in part, depending on your chosen bond. As a reincarnation, you may take on Éclair’s appearance at will, becoming her in flesh, in spirit, and in myth, complete with her crimson attire, her electromagnetic whip, and her ship, La Muse. As successor, you may wield her attire, weapon, and ship as extensions of her mantle, though you remain wholly yourself while carrying her name and myth. As her child, you inherit neither her full body nor appearance, but you may still summon her whip and ship as rightful heirlooms, and wield her strength as your birthright without losing your individuality.

Power grows with your will. The greater your resolve, the more unstoppable you become, until you are not merely wielding strength but embodying it. Your blows are inevitable, your defenses unassailable, your advance inexorable. The battlefield bends to your determination, and even the laws of the universe cannot deny you when your spirit demands victory.

To awaken Power is to inherit more than Éclair’s tools—it is to inherit her soul. Whether you are her chosen successor, her reincarnation, or her child, you carry her truth into the present: there is no obstacle too great, no enemy too strong, and no destiny so absolute that it cannot be shattered by the will to fight. With Power, you do not simply stand among heroes—you stand as a living myth, an unstoppable force, and the eternal continuation of Éclair’s legend.

Note: your Gift will awaken when you are in danger, through sheer force of will, or naturally.
objects.title: Power

objects.text: You are not merely the Composite of Humanity, you are the embodiment of Human Civilization itself — the living convergence of every dream, discovery, and triumph ever born from mortal hands. You are the pulse of progress, the echo of invention, and the spirit of ambition that has carried mankind from stone to steel to starfire. Every thought that built a shelter, every hand that raised a monument, every voice that spoke of tomorrow — they all live within you. You reflect the state of civilization itself. When humanity thrives — when cities bustle, art flourishes, and minds burn with curiosity — your essence shines like a living sun, power suffusing every iota of your body and soul. You radiate creation, ingenuity, and unity, your form brimming with the collective energy of countless generations striving forward. But when humanity falters — when knowledge burns, empires collapse, or apathy spreads — your vitality and strength wither as well. So long as humanity still exists, so too will you, unaging and undying, yet with their passing so too will you. You can summon any creation born of human thought — from the first spark struck by primitive hands to the most intricate machinery of modern design. Stone tools, engines, satellites, digital networks, and weapons of impossible precision — if humanity has conceived it, it is yours to command. Furthermore, your presence amplifies human potential. In your vicinity, creativity blossoms and invention accelerates; ideas flow like rivers through those who still dream. You can awaken the dormant spark in any mind, turning fear into curiosity and doubt into innovation. The world itself bends to your influence. Anything shaped by human touch recognizes you as its origin and its master. You can command cities as if they were limbs — streets shifting to form labyrinths or fortresses, skyscrapers bending like trees in the wind, machines awakening to obey your silent will. With a gesture, you can raise civilizations from the dust or reduce them to ruins, rebuild fallen empires or erase their traces from memory. Should you possess The Composite Genus, then you will be the Embodiment of Civilization of every species/race you exist as.
objects.title: Civilization Incarnate

objects.text:
Like Sigewinne, you drank a transformation potion, which allowed you to acquire a more human-like appearance.

You will gain five-fingered limbs, human skin color and tone, and the ability to change the color and shape of your eyes at will. But you can also keep your “horns,” tail, and wings if you wish and if you have them.

You can also choose a profession in which you can become a professional with decades of experience.
objects.title: Transformed Melusine (Genshin Impact)

objects.text:
Your Vision will be absorbed by you and become part of your essence, giving you control over your chosen element, but you will have a greater affinity with the water element than with other options.

In addition, you will receive any elemental weapon of your choice, through which you can more effectively and subtly manifest your chosen element. 

The weapon itself will function according to the OoP “Warranty” and “Essential” upgrade rules, in the form of the ability to summon it again if lost or destroyed, as well as gaining a basic skill in wielding it on an instinctive level. However, practice in using the elements and wielding weapons will be extremely useful to you. You will be able to summon or recall your weapon to a “spatial pocket” designed exclusively for it.

Your “father” Elynas will be happy to help you with advice and recommendations as you learn to wield your element and weapon, subtly noticing even the smallest nuances.
objects.title: On Guard of Justice.

objects.text: You gain access to a singular Changer form based on one of the amalgam forms seen across the franchise from known Osmosians, allowing you to shift between human & amalgam. The forms available are seperated by each purchase: The 1st purchase unlocks the Original Series' Kevin 11 (OG) and the Omniverse Rooters Flashback's Kevin 11 2.0 amalgams. The 2nd purchase unlocks the Alien Force's Kevin Elemental Levin & the 2015 Reboot's Monster Kevin The 3rd purchase unlocks Ultimate Alien's Ultimate Aggregor & Ultimate Kevin, as well as the Omniverse Kevin 11 amalgam. The 4th purchase gives you access to all the previousoy unlocked forms. You retain your sanity, clarity of thought, and self control in Changer form, but prolonged use may result in a potent combo of berserker rage & power high. Unlike the titular Osmosian bad boy, you have decent fine control due to a hyper-stable fusion of DNA. Meaning you can access more expressions of the different alien abilities, but at a notably lower level compensated by flexibility - even fusing powers over time. You also have the potential, by training long & hard, to reverse engineer the amalgam forms into new Changer form of a single alien species. With time, you can unlock all the different species that combine into your amalgam(s). You may even be able to achieve something similar to Kevin Levin's Antitrix in the Reboot, and purposely mutate the dexonstructed component alien's DNA to create a superior breed of the same species by using partial hybridisation ( or if you have access to Ultimate Kevin, the same Ultimization process ).
objects.title: Hybrid, Tribrid, wait- how many -brids?!

objects.text: It seems you have been blessed with a body above a Horse Girl/Boy. Now, you have the body of a Robot Horse Girl/Boy. Technology surges through your body, sensors, servos, etc. In particular, you have gone from "sustaining 65–70 km/h for several kilometers, accelerate to that pace in about 10 seconds, and reach bursts of 80–85 km/h at your maximum." to a whopping 1400 km/h for tens of thousands of kilometers, accelerating to it in 2.5 seconds, AND reaching bursts of 2800 for a solid minute. Your luck has enhanced just a bit more now. If you wanted to win a lottery Jackpot, you absolutely could. There would even be combat applications for your luck, if you focused hard, like guns jamming, or an opponent's power fizzing out to reduce the impact. And finally, your potential due to your machine and adaptive nature is quite terrifying, allowing you to get even stronger from there!
objects.title: MechaMusume (UmaMusume)

objects.text:
Rather than a Racing UmaMusume you are a different breed of UmaMusume.

Perhaps you are a Draft UmaMusume, who has the strength to carry 8000 pounds with ease, and the durability to match, but is rather slow.

Or perhaps you are a Show UmaMusume, who could have a crowd wrapped around your fingers with only a few words, but are rather fragile, being unable to really take a hit.

Or maybe you are even one of the legendary War UmaMusume, who are second only to the breeds which specialize in a particular field, while possessing the combat instincts to be a threat to armies.
objects.title: A Different Breed

objects.text:
The blueprint for the purposed organism you've has been refined further, you may select one of the following variants.

The Artificer, this variant has the ability to secrete an explosive compound, this necessitates having a resistance to explosions, where a regular being may die it will only be momentarily stunned. It can detonate small amounts on it's body, this can stun nearby beings or change it's direction mid air.

The Gourmand, this variant is larger to put it nicely, this rotundness comes with some upsides, including greater muscle mass to handle the added weight. Through the power of bioengineering it's stomach can transmute matter into various things, from beehives to a live grenade, though it can't quite control what it will get. It is also quite apt at crafting things using the objects it regurgitates.

The Rivulet, this variant is semi-aquatic in nature, with both lungs for breathing air and gills for breathing under water. It's general agility is also enhanced, moving faster, jumping further, and dodging easier then normal. This means that in the water it's agility is even greater, swimming at astounding speeds.

The Spearmaster, this variant can convert it's biomass into spear like needles attached to it's tail. These needles have thin tubes connecting back to it, this allows it to drain nutrients from other creatures. It has received a general enhancement and natural skill in spear techniques, the added dexterity, strength and skill allows it to wield two spears at once, as well as throw them further.
objects.title: Next Generation Slugcat

addons.text: Thanks to Dual Embodiment, you have handily cheated the great challenge of mastering your Purple Dragon powers such that you can now not only safely use the light or dark sides freely without any danger of losing control. This also helps you master the many aspects of Aether much faster than normal. You also gain the ability to instantaneously create and use the opposite forms of any Elements you can use.
addons.title: Pure Aether

addons.text:
Your power of clairvoyance has not only been amplified but, in a sense, mastered to a level beyond what could normally be expected of a fully trained Purple Dragon. You can now not only peer into the future at will, but your accuracy has been greatly increased, such that you can view upwards of a week into the future. Your subconscious visions are also amplified such that any form of danger that would occur within a timespan of a week is granted to you with great clarity and minimized vagueness, though vision of the far distant future will remain vague, though somewhat less so. Also, your combat focused cliarvoyance is massively empowered, allowing you to see upwards of ten seconds into the future with perfect accuracy in a massive area around you.

However, beyond all of these boons, your greatest upgrade to your clairvoyance is the ability to view the past. Viewing the recent past is easy, but it will grow much more strenuous the farther you attempt to view past events.

Do note that while this newly upgraded clairvoyance is powerful, using it recklessly is dangerous as it still places strain upon you, though a bit less than originally.
addons.title: Mastered Clairvoyance

addons.text:
Your Dragon Time power has not been massively empowered with your enhanced affinity to Time Manipulation. You can now slow time to an absolute crawl such that the world around you moves at a glacial speed. This grants you an unimaginable increase to your speed, which you can use to devastating effect in combat or to give you near-endless time to think in a single second. 

In addition, your ability to stop time has likewise been drastically boosted, allowing you to stop time for multiple minutes before signs of strain begin and its energy consumption begins to increase.

Lastly, the strain Dragon Time places upon you and its energy consumption is greatly lessened, allowing you to use it much longer before needing to stop and take a break from using it.
addons.title: Mastered Dragon Time

addons.text:
Your power over controlling Space has been massively upgrades allow you to teleport short distances with extreme energy efficiency in quick succession. You can now teleport long distances much more easily, such that you are only limited by your knowledge of an area you wish to teleport to, which can be handily filled in with your power of Clarivoyance, and you can teleport there instantly with no need to focus for multiple minutes.

Additionally, you gain the knowledge and ability to create permanent portals, which you may place and then connect across any two locations. Note that this ability will consume a lot of energy, which will drastically increase based on the distance between portals.
addons.title: Mastered Dragon Space

objects.text:
You are no simple, ordinary dragon; you are instead the next Purple Dragon. Purple Dragons are dragons who possess power above all others and are akin to demi-deities. Your innate Element is changed to the Aether Element, a primordial form of mana which grants you domain over the fundamental aspects of reality, only limited by your mastery of it and your personal power.

As a Purple Dragon, you are the absolute pinnacle of dragon-kind and possess power leagues above any other Dragon. Even at only a few decades old, you can fight fully trained adult dragons despite being inexperienced. As the bearer of the Aether Element, you can use all other Dragon Elements and even create your own with effort. Aether is mana in its most pure raw form and possesses the power of the light of creation and the darkness of destruction. Through using its light side, you can heal, create, or change matter. Through its dark side, you can breathe a concentrated beam of unimaginable power that can vaporize anything at the atomic level. Aether can also be used to create portals across reality, though this ability is hard to learn and master. Until then, you can teleport short distances or longer ones with knowledge of a location and time to focus.

Purple Dragons also possess the power of clairvoyance that will occasionally give random, vague visions of the future, focusing on important events or future danger. This clairvoyance can also be used to see very briefly into the future, drastically increasing your combat ability and making it nigh impossible to ambush you unaware. In addition, you gain the Dragon Time power, which at the start allows you too slow or accelerate time to around 50% in either direction or stop time for a few seconds. Using Dragon Time places great strain upon you and consumes large amounts of energy, which only increases the more you use it in quick succession, so you should use it sparingly and strategically.

Despite being a nearly all-powerful dragon, your powers are not without their own dangers. Overusing or pushing your powers beyond your current capabilities may temporarily weaken you and lock away aspects of your power until you recover or train them back up. Also, failure to balance the light and dark aspects of Aether may corrupt you into a twisted version of yourself. You must also learn to manage your emotions, as if they go out of control, they may cause you to lose control of your powers. Also, fully mastering your powers will take many years of effort, both in training and personal growth.
objects.title: Purple Dragon (Spyro Series)

objects.text:
You are now a Shinso Vampire, possessing a terrifying and immense aura that has been described as “darkness darker than the night sky.” Your base abilities—strength, speed, reflexes, and more—are increased to a level far greater than that of average S-class vampires, as is your potential for learning new or previously lost sets of powers.

With Wealth of Power, you are now able to turn your body into a liquid/elastic form capable of stretching and morphing as you please, you can fire your own blood from your palm in the form of bullets, and while in this state you are largely unfazed by physical injury, as you can easily reform your body. You have complete control over this power, and can remain in this form for as long as you wish without difficulty. You always retain your true form—your original identity—which you can return to at any time.

Shinso also possess a unique ability called Blood Link, which allows them to sense when another Shinso is experiencing emotional stress. You can levitate, and are capable of absorbing other monsters.

Shinso are often referred to as immortal due to their immense healing factor, which allows them to recover from nearly any injury as long as they have enough blood remaining in their body—even healing after being cut in half at the waist.

Shinso Vampires also possess a unique ability known as Creation, which involves mixing Yōki into one’s own blood and controlling it at will. This blood can be transformed into an explosive substance capable of reducing an opponent to fragments, or shaped into a suit of armor around the body. The full range of applications for this ability is unknown; however, since it is described as a form of matter creation, it is implied to have a wide variety of uses, making it exceptionally powerful in the right hands.

You will be as strong as Inner Moka at the end of the series.
objects.title: Shinso Vampire (Rosario Vampire)

objects.text:
You are now something more than a parasite that plays at being a god, instead you are now one of the Aboleth, a race that was there, waiting in the cold dark before the gods were even born.

  You have grown massively in size and strength, enough to be a noticeable physical threat.

  Obviously can no longer burrow into a body and control a creature that way. Instead you have two new methods of enslavement.

  Firstly you produce a mutating slime that, when touched, changes them until they are unable to live in anything other than dark, deep water, your domain. Their skin is replaced with a thin, nearly transparent membrane unable to hold moisture or protect against UV light, and lungs are replaced with gills.

  The second method you can use is your powerful psionics. You can telepathically enslave weaker minds, where after establishing mental contact you can dominate lesser beings, forcing them to bend to your will and obey your commands. Even if someone is strong enough to avoid being enthralled you can project various illusions into their minds, causing them to hallucinate.

  Your ancestral memory also expands to include that of the Aboleth race, which dates back to the dawn of time, and has seen empires rise and fall.
objects.title: Aboleth (D&D/Pathfinder)

objects.text: Your abnormality is no longer limited to just the world you enter, but extends to every setting where your powers originate from. Any ability you possess carries the nature of its system with it, and your body, spirit, and existence adjust so that you stand as all those system's natural outliers as well. If those settings possess greater physical strength, tougher bodies, stronger souls, or more developed spiritual, magical, or esoteric traits, your own will rise to match and surpass what all those systems consider exceptional, placing you above their baseline from the very start, with traits from different settings synchronizing together as one and their advantages also able to compound on each other. This applies across all sources of your powers. Having Haki from One Piece could see you develop the monstrous physiology of its inhabitants and develop the traits of figures like Big Mom or Kaido. Drawing from the world of Jujutsu Kaisen could place you as the second coming of Ryomen Sukuna. Possessing magic from a setting like Black Clover could shape you into a prodigy rivaling Julius Novachrono or Yuno. This adjustment will only be upward and you will never be reduced by powers from weaker worlds, with any of their beneficial traits, should they have any, becoming incorperated. Instead, you gain the inborn advantages and potential that define the greatest anomalies of each setting your powers come from, becoming the monster above all other monsters. You may choose to exclude specific settings from your powers of this effect.
objects.title: One Monster Above All

objects.text:
You have sublimated your flesh into a higher existence, evolving further along the correct path for (Demi-)humans to evolve, awakening yourself as a saint.

As a spiritual life form, you are made of pure willpower and energy. As a result, you have immensely vast energy reserves. With your inherent affinity for magical precision, you can casually cast highly draining spells without worrying about running out of energy.

With your flesh sublimated, your physical strength is vast enough to allow you to defeat a demon lord seed while relying on your physical strength alone. 

Your body's composition is almost entirely spiritual, liberating you from human limitations such as needing air, food, and rest. You have complete and total control over your body and its functions, from altering your appearance to healing yourself by simply willing your injuries away.

Despite your body being nearly entirely spiritual in composition, you have not yet transcended the material realm entirely. While your lifespan is hundreds of thousands of years, eventually, you will fade with time.

As a spiritual life form, there are only two ways to reliably defeat you: the complete destruction of your heart core and the total deprivation of your energy; defeat or death by any other means will be temporary, with you being reborn elsewhere in the world after some time. However, this can cause you to lose some memories or parts of your personality.

Despite becoming a spiritual life form, you are still fundamentally (Demi-)human.
objects.title: Saint (Tensura)

objects.text:
You have conquered your vampiric racial weaknesses, evolving into a surmounter. No longer do you burn in the light of the sun, nor are you dependent on the blood of others to sustain yourself.

Rather than needing the blood of humanoids for sustenance, you can sustain your existence by absorbing the life force of living beings directly. To support this, you gain the ability to absorb the lifeforce of any living being you are in physical contact with; this is fast enough to turn an ordinary human into a husk in a handful of seconds, with longer-lived beings requiring more time.

In addition, your intrinsic skill, Self-Regeneration, has evolved into Ultraspeed Regeneration, which allows you to regenerate any injury and damage that doesn’t instantaneously kill you with incredible speed enough to restore a torn-off limb before it even hits the ground. 

However, this regeneration is blocked when a wound has been caused by spiritrons, for example, via the holy magic spell Disintegration. Also, this regeneration is incapable of regenerating spiritual damage, only your material body.
objects.title: Surmounter (Tensura)

objects.text:
You have reached the level of power needed to condense your energy into divinity, which has allowed you to fully sublimate your body into a spiritual composition, evolving you into the final stage of the correct (Demi-)human evolutionary pathway, becoming a Divine (Demi-) human.

As a divine-natured (Demi-) human, you possess an unaging immortal material body and the ability to freely convert your material body between material and spiritual form.

As with any other divine-natured being, you possess divinity. It is different from a conceptual God, and beings who possess it are not omnipotent. They are, however, extremely powerful.

You possess Divine Ki, a unique form of aura that elevates your attack and defensive power to be equivalent to the god grade when imbued into your body or equipment.

You have monstrous levels of physical and magical power. At this point, you can singlehandedly match the entire military forces of a large nation and have a significant chance of coming out on top. With time and effort, you have the potential to match true dragons.

Your magical energy reserves are sufficient to allow you to cast even the highest of magics, like Disintegration or Nuclear Flame, in quick succession.

As long as your heart core remains intact and you have sufficient energy, you can regenerate endlessly from even the complete destruction of your body or soul. Dying does not risk memory or personality loss.

Despite your nature as a divine spiritual lifeform, you remain fundamentally (Demi-)human.
objects.title: Divine (Demi-)Human (Tensura)

objects.text:
You are a rarity among Elementals, aligned with more than one Element.

Choose another Element from the Five Great Elements: Water, Fire, Earth, Space, and Wind, or the Higher Elements: Light and Darkness. 

You gain the 3 associated Intrinsic Skills and Elemental Magic for your newly chosen Element.
objects.title: Additional Element (Tensura)

objects.text:
You are a vanishingly rare kind of Elemental, aligned with one of the known non-standard Elements: Battle, Fantasy, and Time. You may choose one of these Elements per purchase, either gaining it as an additional Element or replacing your original one.

The qualities of these Elements triumph over all others, though as compensation they are often difficult to wield effectively and may not grant their Elementals some of the standard features of their more normal counterparts.

Battle is perhaps the most simple of all the strange elements; its effects are neither strange nor esoteric. This Element’s most fundamental effect is Attribute Neutralization, the ability to ignore resistances and elemental relations, essentially reducing all combat to a pure competition of power output, at least for you. As recompense for not providing any actual magic, possessing the Battle element gives you savant aptitude for Battlewill and all derivative Arts. Finally, choosing this Element grants the following Intrinsic Skill: Divine Release, which allows you to temporarily take on the qualities of a Divinity, letting your fight at the Ultimate level, at a steep energy cost.

Fantasy is the Element of the mind; taking it allows you to use Elemental Magic with powerful influence over the mind and spirit. At its most basic, this magic can produce convincing illusions, phantom sensations, or influence the minds of others. At higher levels you could produce illusions that start to bleed into reality or take complete control of another’s mind. Finally, choosing this element gives you the following Intrinsic Skills: Spiritual Attack Nullification, and Spiritual Manipulation.

Time is most commonly referred to as the Supreme Element, and it is certainly true that its effects triumph over all others. With Time Elemental Magic it’s possible to stop time, travel through time, or even directly override the data particles that define a being’s existence. That said, feats like that all carry immense energy costs, such that they would even be cumbersome for beings on the level of a True Dragon. Even attempting one of them, as you are, is likely to completely deplete you of all your energy, extinguishing your life without producing any notable effect. At your current level you are capable of doing things like accelerating or decelerating things (proportional to your energy expenditure) and reading the near future; with some finesse, you could even send just your consciousness into the past. Be wary though, it’s deceptively easy to end up trapped in a paradox or an infinite time loop of suffering with this Element. Finally you gain the Intrinsic Skill: Temporal Manipulation.
objects.title: Strange Element (Tensura)

objects.text:
You are no mere elemental; you are a higher existence known as an Elemental Soul, a Divine Spiritual Lifeform with true authority over a part of the world. As a result of this evolution, you possess the strength to compete on even grounds with the likes of True Demon Lords and Chosen Heroes and have the energy stores to match.

As a divine being, you are far closer to true immortality, with the ability to freely convert your Spiritual Body into an unaging material body and vice versa. Additionally, all of your vital processes occur within your Heart Core. In practice, that means most “deaths” are little more than temporary setbacks for you, as you can eventually reconstitute from anything short of the destruction of your soul’s Heart Core or the complete depletion of your impressive energy reserves.

Your Elemental Magic has evolved alongside you, becoming Soul Magic, granting you authority over the laws of nature rather than just the phenomena that result from them. This magic grants you Ultimate-Level power over your Element, meaning your spells are near-irresistible to any being without Divinity, an Ultimate Skill, or mastered God-Class equipment. 

One of your Intrinsic Skills has likewise progressed:

[Element] Domination: Flatly improved version of your manipulation skill, with greater power, precision, and efficiency. Your control over your Element is now refined down to the molecular level and as natural to you as breathing.
objects.title: Elemental Soul (Tensura)

addons.title: Inheritor of the Stars
addons.text:
Despite having no direct relation to him, you have inherited a fragment of the Dragon Factor and Authority of Veldanava, the Star King Dragon. All of your attributes are greater by an order of magnitude at the very least, and your Dragon Factor grows qualitatively, becoming vastly more potent.

Due to possessing even a fragment of Veldanava’s Authority, you are heavily favored by the Voice of the World, to the point where it is practically falling over itself to give you skills and information, and chance-based effects are extremely in your favor. As a side effect, your Unique Skill is automatically upgraded to an Ultimate Skill and is guaranteed to have a World System Subskill.

You also gain much better control over the energies of Turn Null, especially its usage in creating things. This allows you to immediately start producing almost anything you can think of, although things on the level of the Voice of the World or conceptual laws are still beyond you for now. You also gain immediate immunity to Turn Null, allowing you to use it without fear for your own safety.

addons.title: Avatar of Nature
addons.text:
Rather than immediately creating an avatar for themselves, the Omnipotent and Omniscient Will created a prototype of the species that would ultimately become the True Dragons.

The Will created you in an attempt to create an avatar that could contain the full scope of his being in the form of a being. While this was ultimately unsuccessful, you stand as a microcosm of nature, an avatar of nature in its entirety.

Even though you failed to meet the WIl’s hopes, your attributes are leagues stronger than those of your younger kin. Whereas True dragons inherently exist at the “Ultimate” level, allowing them to match the effects of ultimate skills through their inherent power alone. As the first being created by the omnipotent Will, you exist at the level of “Origin” which allows you to match the effects of Origin skills with your intrinsic power alone. (Some examples of Origin-level skills include infinite generation and output of energy, unrestricted skill recreation, and near-unrestricted probability manipulation.)

Due to embodying nature in its entirety rather than just a single concept like acceleration or convergence, your true dragon magic is incredibly versatile, and you can replicate the abilities of others, even abilities not native to Tensura, through your True Dragon magic.

Additionally to this, you also gain the following Resist-Type Skills as intrinsic skills:

Abnormal Condition Nullification: this completely negates effects like corrosion, poison, paralysis, petrification, and such abnormal conditions.

Spiritual Attack Nullification: this completely negates the effects (mind control, mind reading, etc.) and damage to the mind and spiritual body.

Physical Attack Nullification: this completely negates all physical damage, regardless of type, be it Slashing, Piercing, Blunt, or other physical ways of harm.

Natural Effects Nullification: this completely negates natural effects such as elements, temperature, electricity, and other phenomena found in the natural world.

Holy-Demonic Attack Resistance: a higher form of magic resistance that offers even higher protection from magical effects, reducing magical effects to negligence regardless of the type of magic used.

You can weaken your resist-type skills, which would be required to get drunk, as alcohol is a type of poison.

addons.title: True Universal Perception
addons.text:
Your universal perception has integrated 'The Eyes That See Through the World' into itself, utilizing its range and reach while maintaining the detail and breadth of the different senses that universal perception possesses.

You can scale your perception down to a level barely above that of a mundane human, and even if you don't, you are not overwhelmed by your universal perception.

You can use this to cross-reference vast amounts of information related to objects or locations simultaneously; for instance, you can locate where a photo was taken just by examining the photograph.

addons.title: Ultimate Transfiguration
addons.text:
Your Intrinsic Skill: Universal Shapeshift has been massively enhanced in both potency and versatility by your Authority of Lust.

You can now assume any form you have knowledge of, regardless of its material or spiritual composition, so long as it remains below an order of magnitude stronger than your base form. This means your shapeshifting now extends to non-physical and inorganic forms, allowing you to take on the characteristics of other spiritual lifeforms or even equipment.

Similarly, your ability to permanently enhance yourself through the consumption of organic material, like magical blood, has also been extended into the spiritual and inorganic realms. In effect, this means you can consume just about anything to imbue yourself with at least some of its traits and abilities, much like Vega’s Unique Skill: Scavenger.

Additionally, your existing ability to split your consciousness between multiple bodies has been recognized in Skill form, granting you the Extra Skill: Parallel Existence. This allows you the option to split your soul and give flesh to independent alter egos of yourself, referred to as other bodies. Each of these other bodies is a completely self-sufficient instance of you, complete with its own instance of your soul and mind, connected through soul corridors that allow for instant and seamless communication, sense sharing, and energy transfer.

The only notable drawback of the skill is how many other bodies can be active at once. For each other body created, at least 10% of the user's maximum energy is used as collateral and subtracted from the user's total energy pool. This collateral will return to the user upon dispelling the other body, subtracting any damage sustained by said other body; if said other body is destroyed, this energy is lost and must be recovered normally.

addons.title: Velda Reborn
addons.text:
You, the flawed result of attempting to create a vessel capable of housing the Omnipotent Will’s essence in full, have acquired a piece of Veldanava’s Authority and the power he forsook when he forged Creation.

An existence capable of acting on the ‘Origin’ level, the power of Creation and Destruction, and the essence of the Creator himself. Together, these three factors have merged and catapulted your existence to the very pinnacle as Veldanava reborn.

For starters, you gain all the knowledge, power, and Authority Veldanava possessed before he conceived Milim, including his full Dragon Factor. However, this is just the beginning, for the flaws in your existence have been corrected, turning you into an existence capable of safely wielding the full power of the Original Will.

While you do not yet possess this level of power, as time passes, your Turn Null will passively “complete” you. Of course, without some method to accelerate the process, it will likely take centuries if not millennia to reach a level of strength matching the Original Will. Still, with time, you will become equal to the existence that forged an entire multiverse under its own power.

objects.text:
True Dragons are the highest-ranking beings in existence. They're nigh-invulnerable and nigh-unstoppable avatars of nature that serve as the pillars of all creation. You are free to choose where you sit as an avatar of nature, whether that's an aspect of your own creation or one that is similar to the other True Dragons.

True Dragons, as spiritual life-forms, do not have a set singular appearance or form and can assume the appearance and properties of whatever they wish, with no real attachment to their bodies. As spiritual beings, whatever form they assume will be affected by their own personal self-image and individuality. True Dragons typically have a more traditional draconic form, in addition to a secondary human-like form. Their large draconic form is capable of taking and dealing much more damage, while their human form is far more energy efficient and is better suited for long-term battles.

Once born, a True Dragon may never be truly killed. Even if their body is killed, they will be born again elsewhere with the same natural characteristics and memories. The process of rebirth may result in loss or change of some aspects of their personality, yet they will understand the nature of their new existence immediately after birth.

If left unchecked, the magicules from your aura will eventually permeate into your surroundings, mutating organic and inorganic matter to give rise to monsters or other magicule-based lifeforms, and magicule-rich ores and other materials.

True Dragons have three intrinsic skills their kind shares, otherwise they are unique.

Dragon Spirit Haki: Powerful Haki that imbues the user's aura with magical and physical properties, shredding anything it comes into contact with.

Universal Sense: Allows the user to perceive almost all sensations, including but not limited to light, sound, smell, and heat in a wide radius.

Universal Shapeshift: Allows the user to freely change their body's properties and disguise their appearance.

Upon your first incarnation, you will develop a Unique Skill that synchronizes and synergizes with your aspect of nature, allowing you to fully realize your command over the natural world. With enough effort and introspection, you will be able to evolve your Unique Skill into an appropriately related Ultimate Skill that will take your command over your natural aspect even further. Your Ultimate Skill will be potent enough to potentially contain a World System Subskill, giving you the ability to create a unique world related in some way to your aspect.
objects.title: True Dragon (Tensura)

objects.text: You are a one of a kind Elemental, one that should have never been able to exist, and by all natural laws, truly should not. In addition to your original Element, you have awakened another "Element," one unlike any other: Magic. This all-encompassing Element is not tied to any force of nature, but instead embodies the primordial foundation from which all forms of magic, and Magicule effects, supernatural phenomena, and mystical power originate. As an Elemental of Magic, your very existence is intertwined with the fundamental principles that govern spells, Skills, rituals, enchantments, and supernatural abilities. You become a living nexus of magical knowledge and manipulation, instinctively perceiving the underlying structure of mystical phenomena and comprehending magical principles that would take even the greatest archmages centuries to understand, instantly. Through observation, experimentation, and study, you can rapidly unravel magical techniques, refine them beyond their original limitations, merge entirely different systems of magic into cohesive new disciplines, and recreate abilities that should be impossible to replicate. No magical system is truly alien to you, as every form of sorcery is merely another expression of the same primordial Arcane that flows through your existence. You gain the following Intinsic Skills on the Unique level: Intrinsic Skill: Magicule Domination This Intrinsic Skill grants Absolute, Total, and Unconditional authority over all Magic, and Magicules in your area, you could use Outside Magicules/Mana to cast spells, stop others from using Magic, and much more. Intrinsic Skill: Magicule Transformation This Intrinsic Skill grants you the ability to transform into any form you understand. You start with your Elemental form, which is a combination of all of the Elements under your control, in a shape/foprm of your wish, your Old Body, and the Body you would get from the Appearence section. you may use powers that effects appearence as alt forms, and add attributes to any of your forms from them, such as enhancing your Looks with the power "Idol (Oshi No Ko)". Intrinsic Skill: Magic Nullification Absolute immunity to any and all Magic. Beyond even the ability of True Giants, though not by much. Intrinsic Skill: Infon Sense This Intrinsic Skill grants the ability to see, comprehend, and understand any and all information you see, including Skills, Souls, Magic, Particals, Spiritrons, and grants greatly enhanced Senses, as well as thsose senses in the first place, more. Intrinsic Skill: Chant Annulment This Intrinsic Skill gives you the ability to cast any and all effects that requires a Chant, without a Chant. Intrinsic Skill: Arcane Supremacy This Intrinsic Skill grants the ability to instantly Copy, Comprehend, Improve, and Refine any and all magic, and Magicule based effects you see, including some types of Skills as Magical effects, though it makes it much easier to gain the skills, Such as the [Effect] Manipulation Skills, and Skills like Analytical Appraisal. Unlike conventional Elementals, your greatest strength does not lie in overwhelming elemental force, but in your absolute affinity for magic itself. Your magical perception borders on instinct, your control is perfect, your efficiency is perfect, and your capacity to learn is limitless. Your Race has slightly more favor from The Voice of The World, making it easier, and cheaper to gain skills, though this is useless without the Power, or being on the Cardinal World. The only "Drawback" is an unrelenting obsession with learning any and all magic of any kind, up to and beyond even the Voice of The World. Your type of elemental starts on the Demon Lord Seed level, of a creature of your choice, on the lower end being a Orc Disaster, on the higher being Slimes of any type, and Arch Daemons/Serephs. There are three other levels of Evolution for your race, and many more depending on how you choose to grow.
objects.title: Magic Elemental

objects.text: You are a one-of-a-kind Elemental, one that should have never been able to exist. In addition to your original Element, you have awakened another "Element," one unlike any other: Science. This all-encompassing Element is not tied to any single force of nature, but instead embodies the fundamental principles behind the physical world itself—the laws governing matter, energy, forces, life, space, time, Gravity, information, and the interactions between them. As an Elemental of Science, your very existence is intertwined with the fundamental principles that govern reality. You become a living nexus of scientific knowledge, observation, experimentation, and technological understanding. You perceive the underlying structure of physical phenomena and comprehend scientific principles that would take even the greatest scholars centuries to understand, instantly. Through observation, experimentation, and study, you can rapidly unravel natural phenomena, determine the mechanisms behind them, refine existing technologies beyond their original limitations, combine entirely different fields of science into cohesive new disciplines, and recreate phenomena that should be impossible to reproduce. No scientific principle is truly alien to you, as every phenomenon is merely another expression of the fundamental laws that govern reality. You gain the following Intrinsic Skills on the Unique level: Intrinsic Skill: Physical Law Domination This Intrinsic Skill grants you absolute, total, and unconditional authority over the physical laws and natural phenomena within your area of influence. You can manipulate matter, energy, forces, pressure, temperature, electromagnetic phenomena, and other physical interactions with extreme precision. Intrinsic Skill: Scientific Transformation This Intrinsic Skill grants you the ability to transform into any physical form you understand. You begin with your Elemental form, which is a combination of all Elements under your control, shaped however you desire, alongside your Old Body and the Body you would receive from the Appearance section. You may use scientifically understood properties and phenomena as alternate forms or incorporate their attributes into your existing forms. Intrinsic Skill: Physical Nullification Absolute immunity to all naturally occurring physical, or Natural phenomena. Intrinsic Skill: Information Sense This Intrinsic Skill grants you the ability to perceive, analyze, comprehend, and understand information related to the physical world down to the Quark level. Intrinsic Skill: Scientific Reproduction This Intrinsic Skill grants you the ability to instantly analyze, reproduce, improve, and refine any technology, scientific process, physical or natural phenomenon, or biological mechanism you observe and understand. Intrinsic Skill: Causal Analysis This Intrinsic Skill allows you to perceive the relationships between cause and effect within physical systems. By observing an event, you can trace the chain of physical interactions that produced it, determine what variables influenced the outcome, identify weaknesses within a system, and predict the consequences of altering those variables. With sufficient information, you can effectively reverse-engineer almost any physical phenomenon, and predict the likely future, using Present, and past information Unlike conventional Elementals, your greatest strength does not lie in overwhelming elemental force, but in your affinity for Science itself. Your scientific perception is near instinct, your calculations are perfect, and your capacity to learn is limitless. Your understanding of science is not restricted to the modern sciences of your original world. If you encounter a civilization with completely different scientific principles, technologies, or methods of understanding reality, you can study them and immediately begin integrating their discoveries into your own knowledge. The only "Drawbacks" are an obsession with discovering how everything works. Any unknown phenomenon becomes an irresistible mystery. Any unexplained event becomes a problem demanding investigation. Any technology, biological organism, supernatural phenomenon, or strange physical law you encounter becomes something you instinctively wish to analyze, understand, reproduce, and improve into just another Science. And the inability to just manifest things like a boulder of earth and hurl it like any other Elemental, you would need to find some earth, manipulate it using stuff like Gravity, Electromagnetics, or wind, and then hurl it, whether this is a pure downside or not is up to you. Your type of Elemental starts on the Demon Lord Seed level, with a creature of your choice. On the lower end are creatures such as an Orc Disaster, while on the higher end are Slimes of any type, Arch Daemons, and Seraphs. However, unlike ordinary beings, your growth is fundamentally tied to understanding. The more of reality you comprehend, the more you can manipulate it. And because Science itself has no true endpoint, there is theoretically no upper limit to how far your understanding—and therefore your power—can eventually develop. There are three other levels of Evolution for your race, and many more depending on how you choose to grow.
objects.title: Elemental of Science

objects.text:
You’re no mere modified human. You are a fraction of infinity, a god in the flesh.

As an equal to Krishna, you are far above even the wildest dream of the greatest superwarrior. You aren’t just thousands of times better than the greatest human, you’re trillions of time better, if you can be measured at all. The greatest forces of the Third Age couldn’t hope to stand against you if you chose to fight. If you were to side with an army, even if you refused to fight yourself, the sheer inspiration of your presence (and whatever advice you chose to dispense) would lead it to victory over a force which outnumbered them six million to four. If you were to unveil your true divinity the intensity of your being would bid the entire world to pause for a moment to recognize you; birds will cease to flap their wings or sing, the wind will slow to a stop, and armies will ceasefire and stand in place transfixed by you.

You possess cosmic awareness allowing you to perceive events happening across the universe with all your senses at a level of clarity most savants don’t have witnessing events right in front of their nose. It even extends through time, allowing you to see into the past and, more importantly, future. You could predict with perfect accuracy when a new age will start, what will happen in it over the course of thousands of years, and what key moments will determine the path it takes.

Due to your understanding and innate connection to the universe you are capable of influencing the natural world around you. If you become angry it can start fires and cause vicious storms. This is not some vulgar sorcery but rather a direct expression of the cosmic order, creating miraculous effects as natural to reality as though they had happened on their own.
objects.title: Living God (Grant Morrison’s 18 Days)

objects.text: Each selection of this upgrade increases the Category of your Kaiju form by one.
objects.title: Category Increase

objects.text:
The blood of Old Valyria answers your call with every purchase of this upgrade. You receive five healthy dragon eggs, each containing a living dragon. Every one of these eggs is guaranteed to hatch, ensuring that none are barren or petrified. The hatchlings are naturally loyal to you or to any individual you willingly choose as their rider, provided a bond is successfully formed. Aside from this guaranteed viability, these dragons develop normally, with their size, temperament, coloration, and ultimate potential depending on how they are raised. This upgrade may be purchased multiple times, granting five additional dragon eggs with each purchase.

(Note: It should be noted that you can have the dragons you get from the eggs come with specific physical features in mind as long as it is possible for the dragons to possess them in the world of "A Song of Ice and Fire").
objects.title: Additional Dragon Eggs

objects.text:
You have ascended into a stable Archon, a gestalt consciousness rivaling Uldrezaj himself. Unlike Uldrezaj, whose form was born solely from the union of Dark Templar, your essence is forged from Protoss of every caste and every path. Khalai, Nerazim, and Tal’darim alike have become one within you. The memories, disciplines, and lifetimes of Preservers, Centurions, Blood Hunters, High Templars, and other Protoss warriors and mystics now exist as a single, harmonious consciousness.

Their collective mastery is yours. You wield both the Khala and the Void in perfect concert, seamlessly weaving energies long thought irreconcilable. The vast chorus of souls that comprise your being elevates your psionic might to heights unattainable by any solitary Protoss, your presence resonating through the psionic spectrum like a blazing star.

The accumulated wisdom of millennia, coupled with the martial traditions of every Protoss civilization, has made you a peerless combatant. Every blade form, every psionic discipline, every strategy ever committed to memory by those who became part of you is yours to call upon in an instant. Few beings in the Koprulu Sector could hope to stand against you in open battle.

Yet even an Archon is not beyond harm. Though your psionic shell is immensely resilient, concentrated energy weaponry, overwhelming force, or foes of truly extraordinary power can still wound you. Your ascension has made you one of the greatest psionic entities in existence—not an invulnerable one.
objects.title: Archon of the Daelaam (StarCraft)

objects.text:
You have ascended beyond mortality via the union of Purity of Form and Purity of Essence, becoming one of the enigmatic Xel’Naga—the ancient progenitors from whom countless civilizations trace their origins. Your existence is now that of a transcendent cosmic being, equally at home within the physical universe and the immaterial realms that lie beyond it.

Your body has become an avatar of impossibly advanced biology and psionic evolution. Even without relying on your greater powers, your physical and mental capabilities far surpass those of any Protoss, Zerg, or Terran, while your lifespan is effectively limitless. Conventional needs such as food, air, and sleep have become optional, and your form possesses phenomenal resilience, recovering from even catastrophic injuries so long as your essence remains intact. You can alter your form at will to fit your preferences.

As a Xel’Naga, you wield both pure psionic power and the energies of the Void with perfect harmony. You can shape either into devastating attacks, impregnable barriers, or intricate constructs, effortlessly manipulating matter, energy, thought, and space on a massive scale. Telepathy, teleportation, dimensional travel, and the creation of pocket realms are all natural expressions of your power. Your command over these forces is precise enough to empower allies, suppress hostile energies, or unravel supernatural effects with little effort.

Perhaps your greatest gift is that of creation. You possess an innate understanding of life in all its forms, allowing you to guide the evolution of existing species or create entirely new ones. Given sufficient time and resources, you can uplift primitive civilizations, engineer organisms for virtually any purpose, or reshape ecosystems on a planetary scale.
objects.title: The First Ones (Starcraft)

objects.text: Unfortunately, it seems that your eyes and gaze are closer to myth now. Now, the petrification effect is now always active, making interacting with others quite a challenge.
objects.title: Cursed Gaze

objects.text:
Oh my, it seems that your gorgon nature has evolved, gaining traits and abilities akin to several of those descended from the gorgons of old.

Your size increases severalfold, with your physical might growing to match. Further, trailing behind you now, is a long serpent-like tail, ending with the head of a snake, this new limb both possessing the strength to causally shatter fortified structures and the dexterity to perform tasks like writing. Along with the ability to spew flames from your various mouths.

With a new brass-like shine, your scales grow more potent, rendering you nigh-impervious to mundane weapons. Further, your fangs can now be planted to grow fully armored & trained warriors unshakably loyal to you, and you no longer have the need to sleep and rest.

Perhaps most terrifyingly, both are the newfound potency of your harmful blood and venom, and your regenerative capabilities. Your harmful blood and venom are both now instantly fatal for mortals, and so incredibly painful for those either immortal or powerful enough that they wished they had died. Whilst your regenerative capabilities render you unaging past your prime, and having all wounds, even decapitation, healing in mere minutes, unless sealed by flames.

Finally, you can alter any future offspring to gain entirely new monstrous and chimeric traits. Furthermore, should you possess some form of supernatural energy, you could instead create said offspring from it.
objects.title: Enhanced Lineage
Multiple Gazes
objects.text: It seems that you have become far more dangerous, as not only does meeting the eyes of your snakes also counts for triggering petrification, but you can use and manifest any other ocular abilities you possess through them as well.

objects.title: Threnodian (Wuthering Waves)
objects.text:
You have surpassed the limitations of a normal Tacet Discord. Your Tacet Core has transformed into a <i>Threnodian Core<i>, allowing you to draw power not only from frequencies, but also from the collective will of intelligent beings.

Every Threnodian represents a certain fear of struggle found within civilization. War, isolation, control and countless other ideas can manifest a Threnodian. You may choose the concept you embody, and it will influence your instincts, abilities and appearance.

You can create your Threnodian form or you may choose the appearance of any known Threnodian. 

Even if your body and <i>Threnodian Core<i> are destroyed, your existence can continue as long as the concept you represent remains present within civilization. Given enough time and sufficient fear or conflict, you can reform wherever your concept has gathered enough strength.

Civilizations unconsciously sustain you whenever people experience the struggle connected to your concept. You can sense these emotions across great distances and draw upon them as a source of power. Larger and more developed civilizations provide you with greater potential strength whilst you are also able to use this energy to heal damage and and enhance your abilities.
With being a new Threnodian, you possess your own <i>Unique Waveworn Phenomenon<i>. Waveworn Phenomena are anomalies created by the influence of Threnodians. You can choose a <i>Unique Waveworn Phenomenon<i>(e.g. Retroract Rain, The Dark Tide, Void Storm etc.) of an existing Threnodian, or you could create your own. The phenomenon must either be widespread with minor effects or, it could be powerful but concentrated on your local area.

You possess the ability to create Tacet Discords from your own power. These beings are extensions of your resonance, allowing you to populate areas under your influence with creatures born from your concept. You can create simple beasts driven by instinct or more sophisticated Tacet Discords capable of intelligence, unique abilities, and specialized roles. The nature and strength of the Discords you create depend upon the amount of power you invest into them, and particularly powerful creations can inherit aspects of your own abilities.

You also possess the ability to choose a Resonator and share a portion of your power with them. You can establish a direct bond with a compatible individual, granting them access to a portion of your abilities. Your chosen Resonator becomes a vessel for your power, gaining abilities derived from your concept and whatever aspects of your power you choose to share. You can communicate with them across great distances through your bond, sense their condition, and reclaim or alter the power you have granted them.

The strength of the Resonator depends upon how much of your power you entrust to them. A greater portion allows them to wield vastly greater abilities, but also creates a stronger connection between the two of you. 

As civilization changes, so do you. New fears can strengthen you, new conflicts can reshape you, and new interpretations of your concept can cause new abilities to develop.

You are no longer merely a monster that feeds on the world.

You are the <b>Dark Side of Civilization<b>.

You have ascended beyond a mere Lesser Demon, reaching the highest level that most demons ever reach.

At this stage, you are around an order of magnitude more powerful than you were as a Lesser Demon in nearly every respect. This means you have far more magical power, which increases the potency of both your instinctive self-enhancement and your magic. You're now physically strong enough to qualify as a living siege engine, battering down fortress gates with brute strength alone. Likewise, you can now actualize magic with the strength of artillery fire through will alone, with the ability to manifest much more potent effects through the Divine Spirit Language.

All of that, however, is just the beginning. Through your evolution, you have manifested a unique ability, which exemplifies your individual traits as a demon. This ability can be anything from simple generation and manipulation of a given element, telepathy, to even something as esoteric as minor probability manipulation.

As a Greater Demon, your ability on its own is only powerful enough to broadly affect the area of a small town, though this can be focused for greater precision and power or even combined with the Divine Spirit Language for even greater effect.

Using this ability is instinctual for you, coming as easily as breathing, and far more energy efficient than any of your other demonic abilities.
objects.title: Greater Demon (Akuma Koujo)

objects.text:
You are now counted among the strongest demons in the Netherworld, just a single step from the very apex of your kind.

At this stage, your power has once again risen by about an order of magnitude. This means you have far more magical power, increasing the potency of both your instinctive self-enhancement and your magic. You're now physically strong enough to qualify as a living natural disaster; no longer are you limited to just battering down fortress gates, you can even reduce the walls themselves to rubble with your brute strength. Likewise, you can now actualize magic with the strength of a bombing run through will alone, with the ability to manifest much more potent effects through the Divine Spirit Language.

Your magical power has reached such a potency that even releasing your power generates a dangerous miasma that decays anything in your surroundings. With inanimate objects rapidly deteriorating, as if they were left to the elements for decades, and living beings beginning to wither under the caustic influence of your unrestrained presence.
 
Likewise, your unique ability has increased in both raw power and versatility, perhaps even gaining a conceptual edge. As an example, if your ability once allowed you to set an entire small town ablaze, now you would be able to incinerate the better part of a large city or even ignite a beastly rage in that city’s entire population.

Perhaps most importantly, as an Archdemon, your ego is strong enough to survive even spiritual core destruction. While such an event no longer means your guaranteed end, it does existentially weaken you in proportion to the damage to your core and leave your broken pieces to coalesce in the Abyss, the most hostile environment in the already hostile Netherworld. Meaning in the worst case, you might find yourself needing to crawl out of the Abyss as an Infant Demon, albeit with the added bonuses of your weakened unique ability and powerful ego.

At this point, the only threats you truly need to fear are mental attacks that directly wear away your sense of self or attacks that result in your entire core being consumed, altered, or otherwise prevented from returning to the Abyss. Barring that, there will always be a path for you to return to your former strength, even if it may take centuries or even millennia.
objects.title: Archdemon (Akuma Koujo)

addons.text:
Your Reality Marble has been altered and granted a secondary expression by your nature as a Supreme Demon, gaining utility and power to serve you as a spiritual being.

While this expression of your inner world reflects the qualities of your unique ability by default, you now have a degree of control over its properties, rather than it being completely defined and immutable like normal Reality Marbles. This allows you, with some effort, to alter its environment, effects, and targets.

Additionally, this inner world functions as an infinite extra-dimensional storage bank for magical power, which is notably not lost if you’re banished back to the Netherworld or even in the event your core is destroyed. Meaning, if you have enough power stockpiled, you could consume that magical power to quickly evolve yourself from infancy all the way to the final evolutionary stage you currently occupy.

Other, more advanced, uses of this inner world are possible. For example, one particularly ancient Demon Lord was known to have established a connection between her world and the Abyss, granting her and others she favors a reliable method to escape its hostile environments and accelerate their recovery.
addons.title: Demonic World

addons.text:
You are something that, rightfully, should not exist. A being that possesses the characteristics of both the highest level of demons and the highest level of spirits, existences that should normally be anathema to one another.

Spirits and demons each have distinct ecological roles in maintaining the many worlds they’re present in. Spirits can be thought of as functioning sort of like red blood cells for a given world, in that they manage the natural flow of elements, magic, and souls such that the world remains stable. Similarly, Demons can be thought of as something like white blood cells for a given world, in that they eliminate dangerous elements from a given world that threaten the stability of the world. To ensure this separation of existence and purpose, demons and spirits are normally incompatible existences, so their mutually corrosive powers normally result in any attempted fusions ending in complete destruction.

Following this line of thought, you are now a mutated cell that has the characteristics of both red and white blood cells, a being that has escaped the world’s natural mechanisms and responses.

This heretical fusion has boosted your pre-existing powers immensely, such that you could easily affect the better part of a planet with your element(s) or unique ability, without even using the Divine Spirit Language. Additionally, you can now more easily gather and refine magical power from the natural world, assuming it’s not devoid of your element(s), giving you a reliable passive stream of power that is not dependent on the gathering of souls. Similarly, you’re now exempt from the normal incompatibility between spiritual and demonic power, allowing you to easily wield either in its pure form or fuse them into something more potent.

All that being the case, your power has grown considerably. Even as a newly born existence, you are now able to fight evenly with the oldest and most powerful Pillars of the Netherworld, countering all the experience and power accrued over their countless millennia with your raw power and versatility.
addons.title: Aberrant Existence

objects.text:
No longer are you a mere step away from the apex of demon-kind, for you have already evolved into one of the veritable gods of the Netherworld.

These Supreme Demons of the Netherworld can be generally categorized into 3 different types—Demon Beasts, Devils, and Demon Lords:

Demon Beasts are solitary predators that mostly forgo the humanoid form usual to their level, instead optimizing for raw combat strength and wreaking havoc on whatever catches their attention. They have exceptional base capabilities among other demons of their class, including raw strength, speed, and magic output, but generally less finesse with their magic and unique ability.

Devils are whimsical world-hopping tricksters, travelling from world to world, dimension to dimension, artfully stealing souls all the way using their incredible charm and finesse. While their basic capabilities fall short compared to other demons of their class, Devils excel in magical finesse and versatility.

Demon Lords are proper sovereigns, notable for forging actual organizations and territories from the otherwise completely self-interested demons of the Netherworld. Their actual capabilities generally fall in between Demon Beasts and Devils, with a reasonable balance of both raw strength and finesse and a tendency to have more developed unique abilities to compensate.

Regardless of your exact categorization, your power is truly immense. Your command over magic has increased in power and refinement to the point that each and every one of your actions has the potential to equal or even exceed the power of an Archdemon leveraging the totality of their unique ability. A mere wave of your hand could reduce a fortress to rubble, a single step could carry you miles, and a single command could summon the force of a mountain-destroying natural disaster.

Your miasma is now so intense that even powerful combatants that could otherwise hold their own against Greater Demons would find their flesh slowly withering in your immediate vicinity, and anyone weaker than that might find themselves reduced to just bones after mere moments of exposure. At this level, beings with insufficient mental fortitude might instinctively offer their souls to you, as they give up on life itself in response to your terrifying presence.

Your unique ability has once again increased massively in effectiveness and versatility. With it, you can now easily decimate an entire (relatively small) country at once, and with some time, you could drive all life on a given world to extinction.

You are at the end state of demonkind; any further natural growth can only come from the gains provided by consuming powerful souls, refining your skills, or some very extraordinary circumstances.
objects.title: Pillar of the Netherworld (Akuma Koujo)

objects.text:
You now hold the baseline attributes and form of another type of Supreme Demon, amplifying their shared qualities and supplementing each type's deficiencies.

A Supreme Demon with the qualities of both a Demon Beast and a Devil would outperform comparable examples of all single-type demons in both raw strength and finesse, while being able to seamlessly shift between humanoid and bestial forms that best take advantage of their hybrid nature.

A Supreme Demon with the qualities of both a Demon Lord and a Demon Beast would find their raw strength far surpasses a comparable Demon Beast, and their unique ability becomes apocalyptically potent. A Supreme Demon with the qualities of both a Demon Lord and a Devil would find themself similarly enhanced, but with their finesse and the precision of their unique ability instead.

A Supreme Demon with the qualities of all 3 types would stand at the very summit of demon-kind. Exceptional in every respect, possessing more ferocity and power than a Demon Beast, more refinement and charm than a Devil, and a more developed, unique ability than a Demon Lord.
objects.title: Additional Attribute (Akuma Koujo)

objects.text: Now, instead of being a young Bijuu just starting to learn how to use the various powers and abilities available to you, you are fully grown and have mastered your powers.
objects.title: Bijuu (Naruto)

objects.text:
All of your transformations become recorded within your soul, with a pool of internal energy that allows you to transform into them by yourself, and grows overtime. This process is more difficult and taxing on you from not having the corresponding Rider present to bond with, but will gradually diminish. You still retain the full strength of the your chosen form with no further consequences.

You may even learn to become hybrid forms and switch to different ones on your own with enough training.
objects.title: Solo Rider

addons.title: Murex (Warframe)
addons.text:
You’ve become integrated into your Orbiter, becoming a great Murex. 

Created as a form of self-maintaining outpost, the Murex is a massive sentient organism capable of everything your Orbiter could and more, Internally filled with hostile immune systems and resource-containing and gathering creatures. Additionally it’s able to produce an astronomical amount of Sentients, with a single one being able to subdue an unprepared world. 

Murex are also vastly more resilient than normal Sentients, adapting to damage far faster, being able to take full broadsides with little harm, and theoretically absorb a sun’s full energy to fuel interstellar transport. The only form of damage able to seriously wound a Murex appears to be Void energy, though other esoteric effects may find purchase presuming it cannot adapt to them.

objects.text:
No longer one of the lower Sentients, you’ve become one of the greater machines of war, ranging from the mighty Eidolons, to the great Hunhullus. Each of these is capable of bringing great destruction to bear, with singular Hunhullus being known to command entire battlefields. 

Each of these is served by a bevy of smaller Sentients that are a part of their hive minds, such as the diminutive Vomvalists that serve to heal their masters and harry their foes while they take larger action. 

Each of these towers above normal sentients, with exceptionally potent Cores capable of holding and projecting massive amounts of Tau energy. Teams of Tenno were usually despatched to deal with a single one of these threats, and their Warframes only occasionally returned. 

The greatest of these, the Great and Terrible Hunhow was able not only to hibernate beneath Neptune for centuries without being disturbed, but immediately force a system wide panic when he awoke, even with the Tenno now active. At his peak he was more than able to destroy worlds that would not surrender to his great Sentient armies.
objects.title: I REMAIN, THE GREAT AND TERRIBLE (Warframe)

objects.text: "I have crushed stars! What chance have you against me!" You've become the godlike alien known as Pyron, inheriting all his strength and abilities. Your body is made of flames instead of flesh, making you virtually invulnerable and untouchable, which you can also shapeshift and manipulate these flames for limitless applications. Your power is greater than even that of S Class Darkstalkers and can fly beyond lightspeed for interstellar travel. Unlike Pyron, you need not worry about feeding on worlds to maintain your strength.
objects.title: Pyron (Darkstalkers)

objects.text: You are no simple user of Hokuto Shinken, you are a grand master with strength and skill equal to Kenshiro at the end of his Journey. You now possess physical strength that can destroy entire continents and move at sub-light speeds without even needing to use any power amplifying techniques. Such is your mastery of Hokuto Shinken, you have unlocked the ultimate secret technique, Musu Tensei. Without having to suffer greatly to unlock it as you would normally. This technique allows you to use the power of Nothingness, granting them the ability to become intangible, effectively removing oneself from reality, while also greatly increasing the user's speed, becoming faster than light. Through this ability, you gain the ability to commune with the souls of fallen allies, and lastly borrow their techniques at their full strength.
objects.title: Musu Tensei (Fist Of The North Star)

addons.text: "Just as still waters turn foul, stagnation leads to decay. Warriors must remain ever drifting." You have learned the deadly fighting style used by Malenia, the Undefeated Valkyrie, and her teacher, the Blue Dancer. You move akin to a flowing river in combat, never staying in one place and always moving gracefully. You can quickly move into counters and have mastered the art of allowing your opponent to strike so as to leave them vulnerable to a well-timed reply. You also add insidious delays and pauses in between strikes, making you hard to predict and block. You can use any sword techniques displayed by Malenia in her boss fight, such as rapid lunging grabs across the arena, insanely fast curved slices, and the dreaded Waterfowl Dance. This technique involves leaping into the air before unleashing a maelstrom of slashes while closing the gap with dashes. This technique is almost impossible to dodge or block, requiring methods such as intangibility to avoid it consistently. You also gain mastery over the swordsmanship techniques used by the Blue Dancer to defeat the Outer Deity of Rot in combat. Finally, you gain the ability of the style to overcome decay and stagnation. Every strike reinvigorates you, both physically and mentally. Whenever you land an attack on your opponent, you instantaneously recover a portion of your health. Furthermore, your determination and willpower only increase when you attack or get attacked. Even getting pierced by thousands of needles at once would only ignite your desire to strike the enemy and win.
addons.title: Flowing River

objects.text:
You stand as the epitome of this generation's newest Sword Saint, blessed with a divine skill that transcends the realms of mortal skill. Your swordsmanship is a testament to this, as you effortlessly wield the blade, crafting arts like the revered One Mind Technique and similar divine techniques. However, your prowess extends far beyond the confines of the sword.

With any weapon in hand, you become a masterful combatant, displaying an unrivaled proficiency that echoes your divine heritage. Whether it be the staff, bow, or any other weapon that crosses your path, you wield it with the same level of expertise and finesse. The fluidity of your movements, whether slashing with a sword or launching arrows, is a sight to behold.
