In addition to your mastery of various weapons, your speed is akin to lightning. The force behind your blows is insane, capable of effortlessly shattering buildings and structures with minimal effort, and your durability allows you to endure similar forces with no effort.
objects.title: Sword Saint (Sekiro)

objects.text:
You have inherited the might of the Corrupted Monk, having eaten the same infested carp meat that granted her immortality. This act has imbued you with formidable powers, reflecting the deep corruption that now courses through your being.

You gain incredible strength and agility as well as an unnatural vitality granted by the infested carp meat, enabling you to perform acrobatic feats and deliver devastating blows. You wield a long naginata with the same level of skill and mastery as the True Corrupted Monk, able to utilise its extended reach to keep foes at bay while executing precise and powerful strikes. You also inherit her prowess in Senpou arts, gaining mastery of all Senpou Arts.

Inside you, a grotesque centipede lives, able to bursts out of your neck. This parasite not only marks your state as an infested but also further enhances your power, allowing you access to its terror inducing slime. 

Additionally, you have knowledge of rituals and dark practices that allow you to manipulate the spirit realm and draw upon its energy, being able to do stuff such as creating multiple illusions of yourself or becoming invisible. Another use is creating a spectral clone of yourself, however said clone will be tied to a singular spot.
objects.title: True Monk (Sekiro)

objects.text:
You are no novice, taking their first step into the way of the Shinobi. You are a grandmaster, a veteran, who has mastered its ways. Your presence resonates like the wisdom of the ages, your mastery surpassing mere skill, delving into the realm of legend.

Your prowess echoes that of the Great Shinobi Owl, having unparalleled cunning, resourcefulness, and strength. Through years of dedication, you've attained mastery over all Shinobi Arts, wielding them with the finesse of a true master.

In addition to your mastery of the Shinobi Arts, you possess the ability to summon an ethereal animal of your choice. With a thought, you can conjure this creature, seeing through its eyes. Moreover, you can seamlessly teleport to its side whenever the need arises.

In the world of the Shinobi, you are not just a practitioner; you are a living legend, a force to be reckoned with, whose very existence inspires awe and fear in equal measure.
objects.title: Great Shinobi (Sekiro)

addons.text:
You are now a blacksmith equal to Muramasa, renowned for forging some of the world’s most powerful weapons. You can forge, temper, and refine weapons to their peak potential, such as transforming a simple wooden sword into the devastating “Unlabored Flawlessness.”

In addition, you possess extensive knowledge of the occult, allowing you to create any item sold in Muramasa’s shop from any NG media.

Finally, you gain Muramasa’s mastery of the sword, which enabled him to almost instantly dispatch large numbers of the elite Black Spider Clan with the fewest possible strikes, cleanly slicing their bodies apart.
addons.title: The Legendary Blacksmith (Ninja Gaiden)

objects.text:
Your mastery of the arts of ninjutsu has conferred upon you the abilities, ninpo, & equipment of all the playable characters in Ninja Gaiden history, at their apex and maximum extent.

This includes both true Ninja, like Ryu Hayabusa, Kasumi, Ayane, Yakumo, & Yaiba Kamikaze, as well as unusual warriors like Rachel & Momji.

Wall Jump, Flying Swallow, and Izuna Drop to your hearts content.
objects.title: The OTHER Dragon Lineage (Ninja Gaiden)

objects.text:
"Screw justice and screw evil too. All I want is to make them understand I'm here to fight for underdogs everywhere. Good? Evil? I reject them both!" — Garou

Thanks to your skills as a martial artist capable of adapting to any fighting style you face, your very being has evolved, granting you the strength, martial prowess, monstruos quantity of willpower and adaptability of the "Hero Hunter" Garou. 

Your strength and durability are high enough to go toe-to-toe with S-Class heroes like Tank Top Master and Metal Bat; your superhuman reflexes and speed allow you to deflect a minigun's barrage of bullets and keep pace with beings as fast as Genos; your senses are sharp enough to detect surprise attacks in the dead of night or sense when you are being watched; and your already supernatural martial arts skill has reached a level where you can predict every move combination an opponent might use with just a single glance. Furthermore, your martial arts repertoire now includes the Water Stream Rock Smashing Fist and—most importantly—the Awakening Breath, allowing you to fight at 100% capacity regardless of your physical condition and surpass your strength limits.

But ultimately, Garou wouldn't have gotten very far in his crusade to become the "Absolute Evil" if his strength had stagnated. Like that legendary hero hunter, your willpower grants you the ability to adapt to any obstacle placed before you. This applies to challenges of skill, where your martial arts evolve to copy and counter your opponent; challenges of raw power, where your body undergoes changes similar to Garou's, gaining strength through sheer rage, your inmense willpower and a "monsterization" process that, through repeated life-or-death situations, could allow you to reach the power levels demonstrated by Monster Garou; and finally, you can adapt to more esoteric obstacles, ranging from your body becoming heat-resistant when facing flames capable of melting entire buildings, to becoming immune to psychic powers after being exposed to them. 

This adaptability also makes you practically unkillable; you could be poisoned, starving, and with a couple of broken bones, yet still able to fight at near-peak performance, all backed by a healing factor that evolves alongside your strength and accelerates when you are well-nourished, making you capable of fighting without rest as long as your head remains intact.

Go forth, new Hero Hunter; show everyone the might of your techniques and become that "Absolute Evil' that Garou once dreamed of becoming.
objects.title: Hero Hunter (One Punch Man)

addons.text: Your Ninja Training has combined with your cosmic power to grant you the powers and skills of the Leader of the Ninja Village, Empty Void. This grants you mastery of all of the techniques of the Ninja Village, along with the divine technique Dimension Slash, allowing you to wreak havoc from the safety of hyperspace. Your mastery of Dimension Slash allows you to use the technique instinctively without hand seals. Finally, unlike Empty Void, your power grants you the ability to create weapons from your own power, ensuring you can always remain armed in battle. You do not have to worry about being deformed by this power.
addons.title: Cosmic Shinobi

objects.text:
Something waiting. Something watching. Something has imparted you with power—the power of a god. This new power has altered your appearance; while you still maintain your general shape, your body takes on the appearance of a featureless void filled with stars and galaxies.

Your abilities have been catapulted into the absurd, being able to take and trade blows with others who have broken their limits to possess unlimited potential. You are able to withstand many blows that would have utterly annihilated you without this godly power.

You have obtained an unparalleled knowledge of the flow of energy and workings of the cosmos. You are able to manipulate the energies of the universe to perform powerful attacks of cosmic energy. You naturally emit dangerous levels of ionizing radiation to such a degree that anyone in your presence, powerful regenerative abilities or not, will quickly succumb to acute radiation syndrome. Your levels of emission are high enough to end all life on Earth. Your knowledge and control of cosmic energy allows you to easily suppress this emission.

Your divine nature is easily felt by those in your presence, imparting overwhelming levels of awe or fear at your discretion. Only the most resolute will find the willpower to stand against you. All others will be struck with an insurmountable urge to flee your presence or give in to your divinity.

Your supernatural ability to learn martial arts has received its own place in the sun—no longer are you limited to adapting other techniques. Instead, you can now use your ability to understand an opponent's abilities and techniques with your cosmic knowledge to fully duplicate their abilities once you witness them, even if you previously lacked the capacity. If you lack the anatomy, your creativity and knowledge with synergize to allow you to find the closest and best approximation for your current body.

In time, your cosmic knowledge will allow you to shift your skills inward, allowing you to manipulate the particles within your body on a sub-atomic level. Forcing them to behave like anti-particles will lead you on the path of developing time travel.
objects.title: Cosmic Fear (One Punch Man)

addons.text:
You have inherited all the knowledge and power that Garou possessed just before his encounter with God. This includes mastery over his ultimate martial art—the Monster Calamity God Slayer Fist—a perfected style forged from everything he learned throughout his evolution as a fighter.

Along with his technique, you’ve gained Garou’s monstrous adaptability and explosive growth potential. Your body can evolve in response to any threat, granting abilities such as near-instant regeneration, resistance to psychic attacks, and even the spontaneous growth of wings, extra limbs, or entirely new powers as needed.

Your raw strength is overwhelming—capable of cleaving continent-sized beings in half with a single strike. Your speed defies comprehension, allowing you to generate geometric light constructs and deliver hundreds of thousands of blows in just 1.3 milliseconds. Combined with your martial arts mastery, your attacks can shift tectonic plates, lift landmasses on the opposite side of the world, and even distort the planet’s magnetic and gravitational fields.
addons.title: Monster Calamity God Slayer Fist

objects.text:
You’ve evolved into a being reminiscent of Orochi, the leader of the Monster Association. Your body is composed of countless serpentine dragons, which you can coil and reshape into a variety of forms, allowing you to alter your structure and size at will. This flexibility also lets you stretch your body like taffy, dramatically extending your range. If your form is ever shattered, you can regenerate by absorbing other lifeforms.

Your control over your body is extraordinary—each individual dragon is capable of executing martial arts techniques with the same skill and precision as you. These dragons can also unleash powerful heat beams capable of melting solid rock, and you can absorb ambient energy to enhance their destructive power.

Despite your monstrous appearance, you’ve retained all your martial prowess. You can flawlessly replicate another fighter’s technique just by observing their stance. Combined with your new physiology and the supernatural strength and speed it grants, this allows you to push your martial arts to new heights—so much so that even prodigies on the level of Garou would struggle to keep pace.

Finally, you possess the ability to produce Monster Cells from your own body. These cells can transform those who consume them into Mysterious Beings of varying power levels. Unlike Orochi, however, the beings you create are more inclined to serve you with unwavering loyalty.
objects.title: Orochi (One Punch Man)

objects.text: You have achieved what few others have managed to achieve in the history of martial arts and that is to join the esteemed rank of Legendary Master. You are considered invincible in the martial art world, capable of fighting and defeating multiple grandmaster-level opponents with relative ease. You possess immense strength even compared to grandmaster-level fighters, you could move at a speed so fast that even a high-speed camera slowed down to 1/1000 of a second could barely catch a blurry glimpse of your movement, your Ki is so ridiculously vast that it could even change the local weather and you have enough durability to survive an explosion that can level a small town. You have mastered Both Ki types of Sei and Dou and can switch between them or use both together at will. But beyond your physical strength, your skill in martial arts has advanced a step beyond, absorbing and breaking down the essence of all that you have learned, combining and developing an entirely new martial style that is perfectly fit for you—both in body and spirit. This further enhances and combines all the martial art power(s) you may have, using the strength of one to eliminate the weaknesses and shortcomings of another.
objects.title: Legendary Master Martial Artist (History Strongest Disciple Kenichi)

objects.text:
You have become the inheritor of the Ryozanpaku Dojo and have been granted all the skills and knowledge of the various masters and disciples who once called this place home.

This inheritance extends beyond martial arts and includes their other abilities as well, such as Akisame Koetsuji's polymathic talents, which allowed him to master multiple fields of study; Kensei Ma’s expertise in medicine; Shigure Kosaka’s blacksmithing skills; and even Apachai’s ability to communicate with animals.

The dojo itself is a spacious facility equipped with running water, electricity, a fully stocked kitchen that restocks daily, medical supplies, and a Wi-Fi connection. It also houses various training equipment that adapts to the power level of its user, ensuring optimal effectiveness. Furthermore, the dojo possesses a unique multiplier effect that amplifies all benefits gained from training and studying within it by a factor of ten.
objects.title: Ryozanpaku (History Strongest Disciple Kenichi)

objects.text: You have transcended mere mastery, honing your martial arts skills to perfectly align with yourself, allowing you to wield martial arts at 120% effectiveness. This journey has led you to enlightenment and a metamorphosis, enhancing your bones and flesh to superhuman standards. Your internal energy capacity has increased substantially, allowing you to fight for an entire day without exhausting your reserves. Enlightenment grants you the ability to solidify your internal energy, unlocking versatile applications such as generating protective auras, energy slashes, or transforming your qi into elemental forces. Despite its versatility, your solidified qi remains limited to the martial arts you have mastered.
objects.title: Unrestrained Realm Martial Artist (Volcanic Age)

objects.text: You have touched upon the Profound. Going beyond the martial arts you’ve learned you’ve redefined yourself creating a new path. Transcending your limits you’ve learned to materialize your own state of mind granting you an ability that reflects who you are. You can create an ability in a similar vein to Joo Seo-Cheon’s Return, The Blood Demon’s Demonic Blood, or The Heavenly Demon’s Void. By adventuring into the unknown and creating something entirely new you’re body, mind, and technique have reached a perfect harmony. The flow of your internal energy has become flawless and your martial arts are always executed with perfection. This benefits the execution of any other powers or skills as well.
objects.title: Profound Realm Martial Artist (Volcanic Age)

objects.text:
You have reached the pinnacle of Murim. You are a god among men. Your mastery of martial arts and your profound will have coalesced into something greater. No longer are you merely materializing your state of mind; it has evolved into the will of a master that can shake the world itself. Your master's will enhances your previous profound ability, increasing its scale and power fivefold. You are no longer bound to a single ability; through self-study and self-examination, your master's will can manifest more profound abilities. Beware, though, as blindly seeking power is an easy path toward deviation. True Enlightenment must be earned, not sought, or all that's left for you will be madness. Manifesting new abilities is the work of years even for a Martial God.

Your internal energy reserves are as vast as an ocean, allowing you to fully wield Qi for seven days and nights as if you were a demon of the battlefield. Your body can barely be called human. Your will and Qi have refined your body into the perfect vessel for martial arts. Every action you take is seamless and you can apply your martial skills to anything.
objects.title: Martial God

objects.text:
Your Titanfall gear now gains access to a piece of tactical technology from the Titanfall games. Each tactical ability is slightly altered to become more realistic while also granting you more control. You are also granted basic knowledge on how to use these abilities, and your HUD has basic knowledge of how to repair them if they are ever damaged, but no knowledge on how to actually make them or how they function.

Most ability timers are instead based on recharging energy. There are a few exceptions with Stim, which is instead based on the time it takes to regenerate the resource used, with it being possible to speed it up through expending energy, and Grapple, which is based on the time it takes to reload the launching mechanism while using at most minimal energy. This battery charge is universal to all abilities and is scientific in nature. 

Some notable changes include Phase Shift now only making you transparent instead of actually invisible, with you becoming intangible. Active Radar Pulse and Pulse Blade are now just two variations of one ability, with Active Radar Pulse using you as an epicenter and Pulse Blade giving you the ability to connect it to a throwable projectile, using it as an epicenter instead. Lastly, Holo Pilot can now follow pre-built commands instead of just mimicking you.

The tactical abilities you can choose from are: Cloak, Stim, Grapple, A-Wall, Phase Shift, Pulse Blade/Active Radar Pulse, and Holo Pilot.
objects.title: Tactical Gear (Titanfall)

objects.text:
You are now the true inheritor of the Connector, Shen Wulong.

You possess all the memories, skills and knowledge from every single iteration of the Connector that has ever existed. This grants you unparalleled mastery in martial arts, including over your own mind and body. Through your understanding of the ‘principles’ behind martial arts, you can use the precise movement and exact amount of force necessary to defeat almost any other martial artist with minimal effort.

You can control your muscles' power output, your joints' range of motion and even disable specific functions of your brain and nervous system. You also know the technique of ‘Breathlessness’, a form of yogic breathing that slows the ageing process by a significant degree.

The Connector uses a form of pseudo-immortality called ‘Huisheng' in which all their memories are transferred to his inheritor via continuous repetition, brainwashing them. Your version of ‘Huisheng’ has become true immortality as you can transfer your consciousness into a new body via touch. This will result in the brain death of your previous body and the overwriting of the receiving body’s consciousness. You cannot transfer your consciousness if the receiving individual resists.
objects.title: The Connector (Kengan Ashura/Omega)

objects.text:
This allows you to ascend through the ranks of the martial art, unlocking the necessary cybernetic enhancements and skills at each level. The first purchase elevates you from Anfänger (Beginner) to Tzereter (Enthusiast), marking your first step toward mastery.

Subsequent purchases take you through the ranks of Lehrling (Apprentice), Geselle (War Artisan), Krieger (Warrior), Hoher Krieger (High Warrior), Meister (Master), Adept (Licensed Master), and finally to Altmeister (Elder).

With each increase in rank, your cybernetics are enhanced accordingly, and you gain access to more advanced techniques. Once you reach Altmeister, you unlock the ability to fully utilise all Geheimnis, the “secret techniques” of Panzer Kunst.
objects.title: Panzer Kunst Ranking

objects.text: A Qinggong technique born from the essence of shadow, Shadowless Soul Flight was created to mirror their intangible nature while simultaneously erasing the user's presence. It is the art of motion without marks, of silence without weight. Those who walk this path move with such lightness, swiftness, and grace that they leave neither shadow nor trace—slipping through the world like a breath exhaled in darkness. By mastering this art, the practitioner becomes as formless as the shadow they seek to discard, embodying its elusive nature to transcend existence itself. At its highest level, this technique allows one to sever ties with the world entirely. Such masters become undetectable by any sensory technique or power, their presence vanishing into pure nothingness. With a single step, they may distort the concept of distance, instantly arriving at their desired destination. As you are now, you've only brushed the edges of this art, reaching the stage known as Traceless. At this level, you'll leave behind no physical traces or evidence of your movements. And even subtly disorienting supernatural senses, flickering in and out of perception as they struggle to follow you—so long as you don't linger within their field of detection. To those who seek to find you, you are but a fleeting phantom.
objects.title: Shadowless Soul Flight

objects.text:
You've learned an incomplete Qinggong style that channels the essence of thunder and lightning. Its unknown creator sought to embody these natural forces through this footwork—a desire etched into the very fabric of the technique. Though they never achieved their goal, the remnants of that dream remain within the form, waiting for someone to realize its full potential.

Despite its unfinished state, the Thundercalling Step is a fearsome art. It allows you to dash forward at such a high speed that you become a blur to ordinary eyes—though only in a straight line. However, by chaining these dashes together, you can weave a disorienting web of motion. The faster you go, the more difficult it becomes to control, as your senses may struggle to keep up with your momentum. Without keen perception and sharp kinetic vision, you risk outpacing your awareness.

Each use of this footwork releases a sharp, thunderous crack, echoing like a storm chasing at your heel. With greater mastery and refined inner energy, you can learn to muffle or redirect this sound.

Though incomplete, this technique still holds untapped potential. With your talent, you may yet fulfill its creator's forgotten wish—and truly move as lightning.
objects.title: Thundercalling Step

objects.text:
A Qinggong technique developed to fulfill humanity’s ancient desire to soar through the skies like a bird in flight.

Unlike other Qinggong arts, this technique does not offer the flashiest footwork or the highest speed. However, it is unmatched in terms of agility, allowing the practitioner to change direction at will without losing momentum or velocity.

Moreover, it enables the user to ascend into the air and “fly” by stepping on the very wind itself. Through this art, one can manipulate the air with their feet and make their body so light it becomes nearly weightless, allowing them to float skyward, drift like a balloon, or stand in midair as effortlessly as standing on solid ground.

It is said that true masters of this art seldom let their feet touch the earth again, perpetually hovering inches or feet above it. They are known to nap on drifting clouds, ride on the jet stream, or conjure their own wind currents to carry them wherever they wish.

Legends even claim that those who reach the pinnacle of mastery can summon storms and hurricanes simply by running in circles.
objects.title: Soaring Wind God Step

objects.text: You have mastered Illusionary Floral Shift—a beguiling footwork technique as elegant as it is elusive. By harmonizing your movements with the rhythm of your opponent's energy and intent, you flow along the path of their strikes, weaving a delicate illusion of distance—seemingly always within reach, yet remaining just beyond grasp, tempting them into your tempo. Built on razor-thin margins and precise timing, it is a style of deceptive stillness where a single misstep could prove fatal. Like petals caught adrift on a spring breeze, you dance across the battlefield with effortless grace, weightless and ethereal. Strikes pass harmlessly through where you once were, chasing vanishing traces and lingering fragrance. Even your foes' aggression seems to help only carry you farther from harm, their momentum turning against them with every failed attempt. But beneath its beautiful, almost theatrical veneer lies a quiet, deliberate efficiency. Each fluid motion is minimal but meaningful, conserving energy with every breath and step. While others tire, you endure. As the fight wears on, their precision erodes, their focus wavers, and frustration takes hold. Eventually, their composure cracks, guard faltering. And in the haze of misjudged strikes, the perfect opening for a decisive counter appears. True to its name, this art evokes the spirit of blooming flowers. Your passage leaves behind a faint floral trace that slowly clouds the senses, subtly disorienting your foes. Masters of this style can even scatter ephemeral illusionary petals in their wake—obscuring evasions, setting feints, or veiling sudden ripostes in a storm of falling phantasmal blossoms.
objects.title: Illusionary Floral Shift

objects.text:
You have acquired and gained basic proficiency in Minute Subtlety. This technique teaches the practitioner how to evade an enemy's attacks with the smallest possible movements, greatly reducing flaws and unnecessary motions in one's footwork and body movements. It also teaches how to remain close to an opponent and launch a counterattack just as the opponent's move is nearing completion.

Minute Subtlety is divided into several stages:

Introductory Stage, gain precise control over your body, allowing you to evade attacks with the smallest possible movements. The efficiency of your movements exceeds 90%.

Small Success Stage, sense the opponent's "force" and use it to power your own movements. At this stage, you can redirect an opponent's strength back against them.

Large Success Stage, sense the "force" of Heaven and Earth, merge yourself with the surrounding space, and transform the area around you into your absolute territory.
objects.title: The Minute Subtlety (True Martial World)

objects.text:
Developed for the Coalition of Mankind’s elites, TITAN CQC is the classified evolution of AEGIS CQC: an elite, kill-focused martial system intended for high-command enforcers, shock specialists, and special response units. Unlike AEGIS, which was built for survival, control, and restraint, TITAN CQC is a terminal system, engineered to weaponize the full capacity of an augmented frame. Only those with sufficient military augmentation and frame conditioning are cleared to receive its training.

At its core, TITAN CQC transforms the body into a rotating engine of continuous force, utilizing momentum as both weapon and shield. TITAN builds and amplifies kinetic energy through motion, flowing from one action to the next without pause, storing rotational force in the limbs and torso until it can be unleashed explosively. Strikes are moments in a greater rhythm: punches curve into spins, spins collapse into grapples, grapples twist into throws that redirect mass and momentum into devastating slams.

The flow of motion is punctuated by explosive interrupts, carefully-timed bursts of muscular output that fracture the opponent’s body or structure the moment they commit to a movement. Your body’s myomer webbing is now enhanced further with neurological load limiters and tension-release channels, specially integrated nodes in the muscular-skeletal interface that allow the user to pre-load a limb with energy, hold it under resistance, and then release it in a burst of controlled trauma. This allows, for example, a redirected throw to build pressure in the hips and shoulders mid-spin, then suddenly collapse into a joint-crushing slam without losing flow. 

You adapt to all gravity environments with precision. In high or standard gravity, you use weight and vertical drop as tools of destruction, turning falls, stomps, and collisions into concussive pressure. Your reinforced spine and buffered vertebral system let you absorb high-impact force without damaging your frame. In low or zero gravity, you shift to torque-based combat. You extend your limbs to build rotational inertia, then snap them inward to deliver high-speed, high-impact strikes. Your internal gyroscopic core and enhanced motor control systems stabilize you mid-spin, maintaining balance and precision even without footing.

If struck, a TITAN user tenses their frame to absorb and redirect energy through their own structure. The vibrational gel layer, embedded beneath the subdermal armor mesh, catches incoming shock and channels it along neuro-conductive pathways, allowing it to be redirected into a strike, a throw, or even back into the enemy via direct contact.

A fully trained TITAN CQC practitioner can collapse a small mech with a single, well-timed rotational lock, using redirected momentum to tear reinforced limbs from their mountings. Muscles as dense as armor plating can be ruptured by a precision strike, vibrating at a tuned resonant, while torsion-augmented throws can launch targets weighing over 3 tons across a small field.

However, the biomechanical strain required to maintain continuous motion while executing explosive interrupts pushes the user’s frame toward critical fatigue with every exchange. Even with kinetic buffering and recovery implants, the risk of internal shearing, tendon rupture, or frame destabilization increases the greater the force outputted. TITAN CQC is not a style built for balance or longevity. It is a method of absolute violence, optimized for overwhelming results in the shortest possible timeframe. As such, is best paired alongside AEGIS CQC rather than fully relying on TITAN CQC.
objects.title: TITAN CQC

addons.text:
Your status as being both The Shredder and a Demon Lord has compounded, resulting in you gaining the powers, skills, knowledge, and memories of the Tengu Shredder.

As the Tengu Shredder, your physical and magical capabilities have skyrocketed. Your might allows you to trade blows with giant monsters and come out victorious, smash through modern structures, and toss your foes hundreds of feet away. Whilst your magic allows you to threaten humanity, with dark magic capable of causally blasting away builds, creating armies of undying demons and undead, summoning all manner of demonic weapons and steeds, and transmuting your surroundings from as minute as a holy sword into a snake to as grand as all of New York City into Hell on Earth. At the pinnacle of your power, you can even transform into a demonic dragon.

Finally, as the Tengu Shredder, your immortal nature has resulted in the nature of your weaknesses changing. The Holy-attribute is now far less effective against you, with being decapitated by a holy sword or having a watermelon-sized hole blasted through you with holy water being healed nigh-instantly. Instead, now your greatest weakness are those of a truly heroic nature, as should that nature be combined with mystic might could allow an individual to deal wounds upon your very soul and even sever your own raw power from you.
addons.title: Tengu Shredder (Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles)

addons.text:
Your status as both The Shredder and being an Infomorph has compounded, resulting in you gaining the powers, skills, knowledge, and memories of the Cyber Shredder, the AI/Virus copy of Utrom Shredder.

As the Cyber Shredder, your power in cyberspace, combat skills, and technological knowledge have skyrocketed. 

Within cyberspace, you are a monster, able to freely alter the world around you, manifest near-instantly wherever you wish, control the minds of those who enter cyberspace, take control of machinery on a city-wide scale, create energy blasts and shields, and even alter your form mid-battle such as growing additional arms or stretching your limbs and blades across a battlefield. 

Your combat skill and experience are now measured in centuries, as inherited from Utrom Shredder, and further refined and enhanced with machine precision and timing, allowing you to bring down super-humans with ease. 

Your technological knowledge has grown to encompass the technological knowledge of The Foot Clan, with inventions like swords that fire building-leveling energy blasts, combat mechs, robotic exoskeletons, spacecraft, and even the highly mutagenic Ooze.

Finally, being the Cyber Shredder has also taken away the fragility of your physical form, as you retain much of your power even in the physical world. In particular, within the physical world, you are still capable of creating energy blasts, manifesting shields, and altering your body mid-combat, along with being both strong and durable enough to take and match the blows to those who could casually blast apart buildings like the Tengu Shredder.
addons.title: Cyber Shredder (Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles)

addons.text:
By both being the Shredder and having Mutagen has resulted in you gaining the abilities of the various incarnations of Super Shredder.

As Super Shredder, your physical capabilities become monstrous, able to toss armored vehicles like toys, bring down buildings with your blows, shatter swords against your skin, endure buildings collapsing on top of you, and even survive being jumped by the combined might of multiple teams of superhumans.

Beyond the physical enhancements, you gain the ability to fire blasts of lightning from your hands and chest, perform short-range teleportation ranging a few meters, and a body composed of a biometal that further enhances your durability and allows you to generate and retract blades from your body.

Finally, you may choose which version of Super Shredder you wish to have the appearance style of.
addons.title: Super Shredder (Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles)

addons.text:
You are no longer just an acolyte; you have now become the fifth member of the Ninja Tribunal, taking the place that would have belonged to Oroku Saki had he not succumbed to corruption.

You are now a true master of ninjutsu in all its forms, both mundane and mystical. You have mastered the art of espionage and stealth, as well as the ability to manipulate chi to shatter boulders with ease. You can dash down winding mountain paths and across bodies of water as if it were a simple stroll. Additionally, you have the skill to seamlessly shift into and out of your spirit avatar forms.

As a member of the Ninja Tribunal, you have perfected techniques such as the Death Dragon, the Sato Oshi strike, and the Dragon’s Tail with flawless grace and precision. You have also learned the Kuji-kiri, or the Nine Symbolic Cuts, which consists of nine hand gestures that allow you to focus your chi to perform specific techniques such as astral projection, Bushin no Jutsu, sensing falsehoods, and revealing hidden truths.

Your mastery of chi has reached a level where you can perform mystical techniques not only from the Ninja Tribunal but also from the foot mystics. This grants you the ability to create and manipulate the elements of Wind, Fire, Water, Metal, and Earth, as well as banish and summon demons. An added benefit is that you will become ageless, as your potent chi is capable of keeping you in your prime almost indefinitely.

Lastly, your Shredder armor can optionally take on a more customized form similar to that of the Ninja Tribunal. By default, it will share characteristics of your spirit avatar and bear the symbol of the Three-Toed Dragon.
addons.title: The Fifth Dragon

objects.text:
It seems that instead of being a member of The Foot Clan, you are its head, The Shredder. In particular, you are the human incarnation with all the skills, knowledge, and memories that implies.

As a result of being The Shredder, your body has been conditioned to super-human levels, able to perform feats like moving faster than the naked-eye can see, striking with enough force to break concrete and send car-sized mutants flying, and shrugging off and surviving attacks like being in the jaws of a humongous mutant alligator or a water-tower falling upon you.

Far more impressive is that, due to inheriting the Shredder’s skills, you are now a master of both combat and various other disciplines. You could run an international criminal organization like it is second nature, turn a child into a master combatant under your teachings, take over and rule cities akin to New York from the shadows, and even face masters of combat like Batman as an equal.

Finally, if you choose to accept the optional Foot Clan gear, it is now upgraded into Shredder’s Gear, which is limited in strength to what the human incarnations had access to. You may choose which version of Shredder this gear takes the appearance of.
objects.title: The Shredder (Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles)

objects.text:
It seems that instead of being a member of the Foot Clan, you are instead its greatest foe, Master Splinter. In particular, you have gained the abilities, body, skills, and knowledge of the various incarnations of Master Splinter.

As a result of being Splinter, you possess a physique capable of feats like casually punching through concrete, flinging around fellow mutants, biting through steel, matching strength with power armor, tossing around humans with just your tail, dodging close-range gunfire, and shrugging off being knocked through concrete. Additionally, your rat-like features allow you to detect the exact number of individuals in nearby rooms with just your hearing and smell, and can extend and retract your tail that itself is nearly prehensile.

Perhaps more importantly, as Splinter, you have a large repertoire of skills to draw upon. You are a master of many martial arts, able to effectively use any part of your body as a weapon, face individuals like Batman and the Shredder as equals skill-wise, and can defeat dozens of skilled combatants whilst blindfolded and remain untouched. Further, your usage of pressure points and ninjutsu are especially notable, being able to generate micro-shockwaves with precision strikes, find the use pressure points to knock out bullet-proof mutants and aliens, hold knowledge of forbidden and lost techniques, and casually pull a Batman on other ninjas. Beyond combat-means, you can perform first aid, are a professional actor, speak several languages fluently, and have midwife training. Notably, you could even train others to eventually surpass you in time.

On the mystic end, you have the know-how on how to use chi to achieve feats like healing yourself and others, separating your body and spirit to face either spiritual beings or traverse the astral plane, blocking out telepaths, sensing the intents of others, having premonitions of the future, and telepathically communicate with others with greater effectiveness on rats.

Finally, if you choose to accept the optional Foot Clan gear, it can now instead be Splinter’s Gear. You may choose which version of Splinter this gear takes the appearance of. As an added bonus you may decide how rat-like you wish your mutated form to be.
objects.title: Splinter (Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles)

objects.text:
You’ve ascended to a form beyond the power of a Shinobi Transformation, through the acquisition of a Super-Secret Ninja Art Scroll like Asuka and Homura, as an effect of your Ultimate Secret Ninja Art like Yumi and Miyabi, or another method. 

All of your abilities become enhanced to absurd degrees, and you gain brand new techniques to match. These can be taken from the Senran Kagura series, of your own design, or even a complete overhaul of your abilities.

The design of this form is yours to decide.
objects.title: Awakened (Senran Kagura)

addons.text:
Your Will has refined. No longer the explosive fire of youth, it is now tempered, concentrated, much like forged steel. It is colder, quieter, and more enduring. This is not the Will that shouts in defiance, but the one that never breaks, never bends, and never stops moving forward.

Your Will reserve is now effectively infinite. While your usable output remains capped, that cap has increased tenfold compared to its prior limit. This usable capacity continues to grow steadily through disciplined training, survival under intense pressure, and prolonged exposure to adversity. In effect, you can now exert far more power, more often, with greater control and consistency.

All of your actions are now passively reinforced by your Will. You do not need to consciously channel it, everything from combat, tactics, leadership, and logistical tasks are enhanced at baseline. This reinforcement improves precision, impact, and resistance to external interference. Every motion, decision, or command carries unseen weight, backed by the full force of your resolve.

Mentally, you are unshakable. Your Will now provides full resistance to mind-affecting effects, fear, emotional manipulation, and external domination, including magical, divine, or narrative-level compulsions such as fate or prophecy. Your thoughts and choices are your own. Your sense of self is absolute.

Your Will reinforces growth under pressure. In high-stress, high-stakes scenarios, your clarity, focus, and control increase instead of deteriorating. Fatigue sharpens you. Adversity centers you. The harder the situation, the more efficiently your mind and body respond, not by instinct, but by sheer inner resolve refusing to falter. This allows you to sustain peak performance longer, endure more strain without breakdown, and maintain total composure in situations that would overwhelm even seasoned warriors.

Your presence functions as an anchor in hostile environments. Allies near you benefit from morale stabilization, fear immunity, and faster psychological and stamina recovery. Your Will radiates outward as a passive aura that sustains cohesion and discipline even in the face of overwhelming odds. It does not require active effort, as it is simply who you are.
addons.title: Will of Steel

objects.text: "Knights are those of us who've cast off the shackles of regular humanity and stepped into the realm of heroes. Men and women who can no longer be defined or bound by such petty things as impossibility—shattering boundaries, defying belief, and smashing every misconception that we mortals hold. They prove that yes, it is possible. That we can always rise higher. That nothing is truly beyond reach. Trailblazers. Bearers of the immortal flame of hope. Breakers of the millstone of fate that threatens to grind us all into dust." You are a valiant and great wandering Knight—one who has yet to find a Lord to pledge yourself to, yet still upholding the tenets of chivalry you once sought to embody as a humble Squire. Through hardship and trial, you have earned what once eluded you. Now a master of your craft, having completed your education and cast off what you once lacked, you step into the realm of the impossible. To even compare you to the common soldiery would be an insult to both yourself and them. Mastership of combat unmatched by all but the greatest of Knights. Any weapon, no matter how foreign, feels as natural in your hands as wings do to a bird, an extension of your being that allows you to soar high amongst the clouds. A force on the battlefield, one who breaks tides of bodies, shatters enemy lines, holds defenses against overwhelming odds, and adapts fluidly to every shift in combat. A single Knight is enough to turn the tide of a battle—or even war. And as a Knight, you possess a resource that makes your feats possible—Will. One so strong and unbreakable it can shatter the world, allowing you to Overcome whatever stands in your way. It is the line that separates ordinary men from Knights. To simply be more. So long as this Will burns within you, there is nothing you cannot accomplish. But to wield it properly, you must first know your limits—see them, accept them, acknowledge that they exist, yet remain unyielding. Never satisfied. Always reaching, always striving to become something greater. With Will, you can augment everything you do, capable of crushing stone in your grip, cleaving through castle walls, move with the speed of the swiftest bird, fight for days without rest, recover from wounds that should have slain you, shrug off the mightiest magics as they break against your skin. So long as your Will and spirit are sufficient, nothing shall be beyond your reach. But know this—the greater the act, the more it shall take a toll on your soul. This burning Will of yours also amplifies your charisma, drawing others into your orbit as they witness you, unyielding in the face of adversity, triumphing over impossible odds. In that moment, you become a beacon of hope to those crushed beneath the weight of the world.
objects.title: Knight-Errant

addons.text:
Your oath has become a living link, forming a direct metaphysical connection between your Will and that of your Lord. This bond is constant, active, and mutual. It transmits intent, emotion, and strength without the need for words. You are not simply a protector and a leader. You are now unified agents of the same purpose, acting as one.

You sense your Lord’s emotional state, decisions, and moments of danger in real time. They, in turn, feel the stability of your Will at all times. This awareness leads to seamless coordination. You respond to their needs before they are spoken. They act with more clarity and confidence in your presence. Every movement is supported by shared understanding.

As your Lord advances in strength, conviction, or leadership, you advance as well. Their personal growth reinforces your own. Your Will becomes sharper, your focus more refined, and your capacity greater. The bond flows in both directions. When you improve through battle, discipline, or hardship, that strength passes back through the link. Your presence anchors them. Your achievements empower their resolve.

Through this connection, your Lord gains access to the force that defines you. They become capable of drawing on Will directly. While their control is limited compared to yours, they may now channel it to resist fear, enhance their leadership, or push beyond natural limits in moments of extreme need. This access grows stronger the more your bond is tested and affirmed.

When your goals align fully, your Wills converge. This creates a brief elevation of strength, clarity, and effectiveness for both of you. You strike harder. They lead with absolute certainty. The two of you act as one force with shared momentum. This state can only occur when there is full alignment of trust, purpose, and belief.

The power of this bond scales with mutual respect and shared conviction. The more tested your loyalty and the more aligned your vision, the stronger the connection becomes. Through this unity, you rise together. Neither of you is ever alone.
addons.title: Oathbound Unity

objects.text:
You can swear yourself to a Lord—someone you deem worthy of your oath. This vow must be forged from mutual trust and confidence. You must see something in them worth believing in, trusting that they will do right by you and the world. In turn, they must place their faith in you to uphold your duty and achieve the impossible where others might falter.

From this bond, both of you will draw strength. Through it, a fragment of your "Will" will flow into your Lord, guiding them to grow into the person you believe they can become. And through their trust in you, you too will be empowered. So long as that faith remains unbroken, a deep well of strength will answer your call in moments of need—a merging of two Wills.

You will not be bound to obey every command. But the ones you choose to follow—the duties you accept—you will carry out with uncanny clarity, whether it be through cunning and insight, or sheer strength and resolve.
objects.title: Knight Protector

objects.text:
It has been centuries since the last person achieved this technique. To an outside observer, it would seem supernatural, almost divine — steam comes off the body, and the body is hot to the touch.

Using the technique allows for speed faster than trained fighters can see, and strength is at the very least doubled if not tripled.

The truth of the matter is that the technique isn’t supernatural but follows the principles of the Tibetan breathing practice known as Tummo, taken to a supreme level.
objects.title: The Elixir (Convict Colosseum)

objects.text:
Your mastery over your Nail has improved to the level of the Great Nail Sage Sly.

Your physical power no longer has to fit your body type; even if you had the height of a toddler, you could output the same amount of power as someone fifteen times your size easily. You can also easily wield a Nail that is multiple times larger than you.

There’s also your Nail Arts: not only can you seamlessly blend and lead one Nail Art into another, but you can now activate your Nail Arts instantly without needing to focus.

Finally, your ability to teach Nail Arts has improved dramatically—for example, you could teach someone who has no talent with the Nail into a Nail Master.
objects.title: Great Nail Sage (Hollow Knight)

objects.text:
In addition to your mastery of Nailmanship, you have also trained in and perfected the techniques of the destroyed Pinstress Order of Farloom.

You wield your Nail as though it were a Needle, blending the refined precision of Farloom’s Needle Arts with the disciplined strength of Hallownest’s Nail Arts, creating an unpredictable and elegant style all your own.

Your Nail of Object of Power also possesses a unique gift: it can freely transform between Nail and Needle, or even divide into two, allowing you to dual-wield both weapons.
objects.title: Heir of the Pinstress (Hollow Knight)

addons.text:
For most elves, their long lifespans make urgency alien to them. To train every day, let alone every hour, would feel like practicing every second of a day for a human. Most elves, even warriors, train slowly, periodically, letting centuries shape them in leisure. The Sword King was not like them. He trained not like an elf, but like a human. He abandoned the natural rhythms of his race to master his nameless style. As an elf, you are not merely a user of the Sword King’s style; you are a true successor, one whose elven physiology has been sculpted to match the Sword King himself.

Your body stretches taller and leaner, yet denser, your body full of compressed muscle fibers layered like steel cabling. Your bones are hollowed out, but what remains is reinforced to absurd degrees, giving you explosive agility without sacrificing durability. Your ears elongate and become finely tuned sensory instruments. They detect micro-reverberations through the air and ground, giving you an almost bat-like echolocation tied to your footwork. Your body becomes entirely hairless, with your skin being hyper-sensitive, capable of detecting shifts in air pressure, letting you “see” incoming attacks by how the air moves around them. At top speed, you remain fully conscious and present, your senses sharp enough to navigate the battlefield at near-supersonic movement.

Through a reversion into a more primal and animalistic version of your race, you can, at will, extend five claws from each hand, each the size of a tiger’s claw, yet has the toughness of a steel greatsword. Each claw is functionally a blade, fully compatible with the Sword King style. Each of your longer fingers can move independently, executing cuts in unique vectors without interference. Swiping a hand is akin to delivering five full-speed greatsword strikes at once, each with separate direction, angle, and intent. With both hands, you become a ten-blade storm, each strike faster than the eye can follow, each capable of shearing through metal, magic, and armor alike.

Every claw swing creates both the air blade and shockwave effect from the Sword King style. The vacuum trails they leave behind do not merely displace enemies; they drag them in ten directions at once, capable of ripping a man from the opposing drag. You can chain claw strikes like blade strikes, transferring momentum between fingers and hands to produce nonstop multi-vector barrages. The compressed air arcs from each finger fan out across a wide area, allowing you to shred entire squads with a single gesture.
addons.title: Disciple of the Sword King

objects.text:
The creator of the Swift Blade was a man long disciplined in the Standard Blade, a man tormented by a mosquito. In his humiliation at its hands, he struck faster than his eyes could track, swinging not at the insect, but through the very air it flew in. He never learned if he succeeded at striking his foe, for he had cleaved his house into too many pieces to count, down to its stone foundation, and became enlightened.

Your body’s muscle memory has evolved into pure momentum. Your footwork has become light and reactive, but not weightless. Even when idle, you now make micro-adjustments in stance and balance, tiny twitching shifts in heel, toe, and spine that echo the silent geometry of a predator preparing to pounce. You can dash in any direction faster than a sports car accelerating off the line, covering up to 20 meters before a gun’s trigger can be pulled. When focused, this can chain into successive dashes without ground contact, appearing as if you are skipping across air. Your stops are so abrupt they leave sonic cracks in stone underfoot.

The Swift Blade itself is a form of hyper-aggressive swordplay that treats every strike as a movement, and every movement as a strike. You can swing your blade faster than a drone rotor spins at full speed, each one at near-supersonic speed. The air pressure generated by these swings forms compressed arcs of wind that strike ahead of the physical blade by a full arm’s length, extending your reach without warning. These air blades can slice flesh and light armor, and with critical momentum, shear light vehicle plating like it were nothing.

Each swing generates a vacuum behind it, a displacement of space that snaps back milliseconds after your cut completes. This creates a second, delayed pressure wave that lands after your original cut but cannot be blocked without preemptive defense. Against slower enemies, this renders traditional parries ineffective, as defending against one strike guarantees a hit from the next.

However, it is not without its faults. The Swift Blade sacrifices endurance for overwhelming force. At your current level, you cannot maintain full-speed attacks for more than 15 consecutive seconds without risking muscle strain or spatial disorientation. Worse still, at peak speed, even you can’t keep up with yourself. Your eyes blur. Your perception lags behind your body. The blade moves faster than your mind can process. You fight effectively blind. You can only rely entirely on a deep, internal map of your surroundings: a sharpened spatial sense, a memory of distance and position measured down to the inch.
objects.title: The Swift Blade

addons.text:
Throughout history, few knew the style that the Sword King, a lone elf, used. Many thought it to be some kind of noble style, one with distinction, history, a noble and righteous style. In reality, he was a user of both the Swift and Heavy Sword, a mere slave who was sold by his country and forced to learn these ignoble styles. It was through his long life that vastly exceeded humans and through the dedication gained from the Standard Blade, a dedication his kind naturally lacked due to their long lives, that he was able to create this nameless style, a fusion between the Heavy and Swift Blade.

The muscle built through the Heavy Blade has expanded further, with dense, reactive fibers that flex like coiled steel cables. Every major muscle group works in exact synchrony, distributing load and tension with mathematical efficiency. Your spine and hips have thickened to withstand rotational torque from high-speed strikes, and your calves and thighs carry so much explosive strength that you can break stone with a short step. You possess the muscular infrastructure to maintain both power or speed at once, without mechanical failure.

The Sword King style allows you to swing with the full velocity of the Swift Blade, but each blow still lands with the crushing weight of the Heavy Blade. Each movement is a full-body motion: you launch with your legs, rotate with your spine, and release with your arms in one continuous action. The result is a strike that moves faster than the eye can track and hits with force sufficient to shatter reinforced barriers. Every swing produces a concussive shockwave as expected from the Heavy Blade, but also releases sharp, compressed air arcs that extend the edge of the attack zone by several feet. These air blades travel ahead of the shockwave, cutting into enemies just before the true impact lands.

The vacuum effect from your swings now functions as a battlefield tool. When your blade cuts through the air, it leaves behind a violent pressure void that pulls enemies toward your follow-through. Armored enemies are dragged off-balance mid-step. Lighter enemies can be physically lifted into your strike. When used in tight formations, your strikes can tear apart unit cohesion before you even close the distance.

The precision of the Swift Blade still governs your footwork. You retain your ability to dash and pivot in any direction with extreme acceleration, but now with significantly more control. The strength of the Heavy Blade augments your directional momentum, making even micro-adjustments in foot placement into explosive movements. Your ability to cancel or redirect an attack mid-motion is preserved, but instead of interrupting power, you simply transfer it into the next vector, making your style appear continuous and overwhelming.

The drawbacks of the parent styles are no longer fully present, though not erased entirely. Your endurance, built through sheer muscle capacity and refined efficiency, allows you to fight at high output for the full duration of extended engagements. Speed no longer blinds you; your spatial awareness has adapted, and your internal map now updates in real time with full clarity. While your weapon strain remains significant, your improved control means you can now adjust pressure mid-swing to reduce breakage. Telegraphing is no longer a critical flaw; your acceleration is fast enough to hide commitment, and your recovery is rapid enough to maintain initiative even if your first strike fails.
addons.title: Style of The Sword King

objects.text:
The Heavy Blade was born in desperation, when a lone swordsman, trapped beneath a collapsed mountain pass, spent three days and three nights beneath stone and darkness. Food gone, water gone, light gone. The only thing he had left was his broken sword. So he swung. Over and over. Thousands of strikes against rock, bone, and will. On the dawn of the fourth day, he emerged, broken but alive, having carved his way out through solid stone. That man was the first to use the Heavy Sword.

Your body has been reshaped by this philosophy. Where once you were merely efficient, now you are immense. Your back and shoulders ripple with corded mass; your arms are sculpted for violence. You can lift and wield weapons weighing three times your body weight with full control. You can shatter stone blocks with overhead strikes, hold a tower shield aloft for hours without strain, and swing a full-length blade for days at a time without pause, sleep, or rest. Your bones have thickened; your tendons are like steel cables. The resilience of the Standard Blade has been forged into brutal, unrelenting strength.

The Heavy Blade abandons economy in favor of devastation. Each strike is a weapon in itself, even before the blade connects. The sheer momentum of your swing creates a shockwave, capable of blowing back a line of enemies, scattering lighter projectiles mid-air, and stripping bark from trees. When your blade does land, it does not cut; it rips, creating jagged tears like that of animalistic claws. You can cleave through war-forged plate, fracture defensive enchantments, and tear through fortress doors with brute force. The full-body motion of each attack uses your legs, spine, and arms in tandem, turning each strike into a moving avalanche of muscle and steel.

The style excels in close and mid-range power. You control space not with speed, but with fear. Few dare step into your kill zone. You don’t parry, you knock blades aside with enough force to break wrists. You don’t feint, you commit, and opponents must either escape or be destroyed. Once your swing begins, the pressure does not lift until the arc is complete, and even then, your recovery is fast enough to launch the next blow before enemies can recover their footing.

But the Heavy Blade comes with a cost. Each swing, though powerful, requires time to start, making it telegraphed, committed, and not easily redirected. Quick enemies can outmaneuver you if they don’t get caught in your range. Additionally, the weight and intensity of your style strain most weapons to their limit, causing frequent breaks in the middle of battle. You trade adaptability for force and must control the battlefield to maintain your rhythm. If your momentum is broken, recovery becomes difficult.
objects.title: The Heavy Blade

objects.text:
The Forgotten Human King, known by his true title as the Beast King, understood that the primal strength he sought lay not just in genetic memory, but in the divine blueprint that created humanity. Unlike Elves born of the World Tree or Dwarves forged by volcanoes, humans weren't born of nature nor were they a natural species, they were sculpted by the Human God in its image. Every subsequent generation has been a dilution, a shadow of that perfect, primordial template, corrupted by the mundane elements of the world influencing and corrupting their evolution. This technique, the final result of the King's work, reverses that dilution. By awakening the Gnosis within your soul you effectively reset your entire evolutionary clock. You are no longer merely biologically advanced; you are a Primordial Human, operating according to the flawless, ultimate image established by your creator.

Your physical capacity has become truly limitless, eliminating the previous energy debt incurred by utilizing enhanced biological states. The immense power derived from your perfected primal physiology is now perpetually sustained by the Gnosis, meaning chemical states that previously would have granted you the strength to lift a small sedan are now your standard low-end baseline, and you can maintain this indefinitely without fatigue or a metabolic crash. When you intentionally exert force, you are no longer bound by the basic rules of human physics; your dense bones and optimized muscle fibers allow you to generate kinetic energy far beyond mere muscle mass, easily achieving forces capable of shearing thick steel girders through a concentrated strike or accelerate and decelerate instantaneously without strain.

Furthermore, your body is at a superhuman equilibrium grants you control over your cellular integrity. Catastrophic physical damage, such as a deep abdominal laceration or even a ruptured organ, will result in your body instantaneously reordering its own molecular structure back to the divine template, sealing the wound and restoring integrity in seconds. This goes beyond simple accelerated healing; it is the immediate enforcement of the perfect biological blueprint. The same control extends to your own internal clock, granting you perfect biological stasis, effectively preventing cellular degradation and stopping the process of aging as your body endlessly renews itself back to its original peak form.

The Gnosis also grants you instinctual perfection, instantly turning you into the ultimate biological predator by fusing your higher thought with primal cunning. Your instincts act as a predictive calculus, allowing your body to generate the perfect chemical mix and execute the optimal action before your conscious mind even registers a threat, meaning you'll move to avoid a sudden ambush fractionally before the sound or sight of the attacker has fully registered. This innate supremacy also turns your very presence projects an aura of raw, hyper-efficient survival. This resonance bypasses the higher thought of other beings, triggering an instant, instinctual fear and submissiveness in their primal centers, causing them to subconsciously recognize you as the unchallenged apex predator in any environment.
objects.title: Disciple of the Beast King

objects.text:
Your legion of memories expands beyond humanity’s historical wars and into the endless, grinding conflicts of the 41st Millennium, for the combat experiences of the entire Astra Militarum are now yours. You carry the lived experiences of Cadian shock troops holding shattered lines against the impossible, Death Korps of Krieg marching into artillery fire with silent resolve, Armageddon Steel Legionaries fighting armored wars in choking ash wastes, and Catachan Jungle Fighters stalking nightmares through a planet where everything wants to eat you. All these, and so many more.

These memories grant you instinctive mastery over the wildly different methods of war each regiment embodies. You know how to fight siege wars that last decades, mechanized campaigns fought from within steel hulls, guerrilla conflicts where the environment is deadlier than the enemy, and wars against the horrors of thirsting gods.

You understand how culture, discipline, faith, and fatalism shape how soldiers fight and die, and you can shift seamlessly between doctrines, fighting with Cadian adaptability, Krieg fatalism, Catachan brutality, or Steel Legion precision as the situation demands.

The cost for this power deepen though, as mental contamination you already endure is compounded by the contradictions of the Guard: courage born of hope beside obedience born of despair, loyalty forged through pride alongside loyalty beaten into you from birth and reinforced by shame.
objects.title: Steel, Mud, and Faith (Warhammer: 40k)

objects.text:
Having walked many different paths of the warrior, and embodied many different aspects of Khaine, your understanding of warfare is unmatched among the Craftworlds. You now walk the Path of Command, becoming a master of tactics and strategy who leads the armies of entire Craftworlds.

For each purchase you take, you will have walked an additional path of war at a different Aspect Shrine. Not only will you have learned the weapons, techniques and philosophies of these different Aspect Warriors, you will be able to blend them into a single combined form that is unique to you. The different paths you have walked have also taught you how to utilize combined arms of many different types of warriors into a cohesive whole to strike your Craftworld’s enemies down.
objects.title: Autarch (Warhammer: 40k)

objects.text: "Private Parker! Did I say you could stop the mental exercises? This is the only way you won't get hypnotised by those Mages! You will get it right, or so help me god, you'll be scrubbing toilets with a toothbrush for weeks!" In contemporary media, the modern military often gets outclassed by zombies, sorcerers, bioweapons and more, just to allow the protagonist to have their hero moment. However, with your help, that will not happen anymore. Your extensive knowledge about the paranormal gives you insight into how to craft tactics and strategies that can both integrate and combat supernatural phenomena for modern military doctrine. Develop techniques to resist mind control for normal humans to small unit tactics that gives you the best chance to kill the creatures of the night. From Generals to the lowly privates, you can make sure they fully understand the intricacies of any magic system and how best to implement your designs. Additionally, craft mystical weapons specially designed for modern warfare. They may not be the most artfully designed but they definitely get the job done whilst being able to be mass produced.
objects.title: Anti-Anomaly Tactics

objects.text:
Beyond the Pinnacle lies the realm of Three Flowers Gather at the Summit, a stage considered mostly unattainable within the mortal world, with only a handful throughout history ever reaching it. You stand at the early stage of this realm, having stepped beyond the Peak Master realm and into a level where all Intent begins to be understood as fundamentally the same, no matter the form it takes. At this level, one becomes capable of contending with Qi Refining stage cultivators despite still walking the path of Martial Arts.

In the early stage, you come to fully understand Purple, no longer viewing Intent as separate forces, but as a unified whole. This allows you to read the Intent of others with extreme precision, ensuring that your movements and techniques are carried out without flaw or wasted motion. At this stage, you also form Gang Qi by connecting your Intent with the Intent flowing through the world and those around you, encasing it with your Internal Energy. Through this, you begin using Sword Gang, greatly increasing the power of your techniques to the point that defenses or barriers that could not be broken with Sword Silk can now be shattered directly.

To advance into the middle stage, you will need to begin perceiving the seven emotions within Intent itself and learn to infuse them into your Martial Arts. These emotions manifest as distinct colors and influences such as Joy, Anger, Sorrow, Pleasure, Love, Hate, and Desire. By incorporating these emotions into your Intent, your techniques begin to carry emotional qualities capable of influencing both your opponents and the surrounding world.

To advance into the late stage, you will need to perceive the infinite variations of these emotions, understanding that they cannot truly be separated into fixed categories. At this point, you realize that Martial Arts are not unfolded through your strength alone, but through the interaction between your Intent, your opponent’s Intent, and the Intent flowing throughout the world itself. Your techniques begin to respond dynamically to these flows, appearing almost alive, while your use of Gang Qi becomes increasingly refined and stable. Martial artists at this realm perceive the world entirely differently from those at the Peak Master realm, and individuals who reach this stage are exceedingly rare.

Beyond even this realm lie further stages of Martial Arts, with the next said to require reading all emotions, something widely understood to be impossible. Yet for those capable of continuing to deepen their understanding of Intent, the path does not end here.
objects.title: Three Flowers (A Regressor’s Tale of Cultivation)

addons.text:
Through your mastery of martial arts, you have attained the first stage of Manifestation, allowing you to materialize your deepest desire and heart essence into reality as an ability unique to you.

Manifestation is the materialization of a being’s obsession and desire. It requires such tremendous longing that it forces the inner and outer aspects of one’s soul to fuse completely. Upon attaining Manifestation, you will also develop a corresponding longing and obsession tied to your own manifestation.

Examples of Manifestation include the Formless Sword, which manifests from the desire to escape fate and can change its shape and form at will; the Surpassing Radiant Saber, which manifests from the desire to return home and reunite with one’s family, allowing its wielder to take the form of a Golden Peng bird capable of traveling at extreme speed; and Last Quarter, which manifests from the desire for sleep and allows its user to lure others into slumber through music.

Regardless of what form your Manifestation takes, it will always be applicable in combat.

The unique ability you gained as a Profound Realm martial artist has fully merged with your Manifestation, becoming one with it and strengthening it accordingly. As a result, although you are only at the first stage of Manifestation, your actual combat prowess is equal to that of the second stage.

This increase remains consistent with each rank you advance in the Heart Path. In other words, your actual combat prowess will always be one rank higher than your true cultivation realm within the Heart Path.

This also makes you a martial arts genius, allowing you to advance quickly through the Heart Path method. However, your progress is not as fast as that of someone with monstrous talent like Kim Young-hoon; your rate of advancement is only one-third of his.

If you possess the Golden Heavenly King Talent add-on, your talent increases to three times that of Kim Young-hoon.

If you possess the Record of Transcending Cultivation and Exhausting Martial Arts add-on, you will gain the Manifestations of both Kim Young-hoon and Seo Eun-hyun: the Surpassing Radiant Saber and the Formless Sword. You may merge their traits and attributes into your own Manifestation.

The Record of Transcending Cultivation and Exhausting Martial Arts also contains the compiled understanding and enlightenment of both Kim Young-hoon and Seo Eun-hyun, recorded in written form, up to the Martial Pinnacle Realm. However, whether you can comprehend these records depends entirely on your own ability.

If you possess both the Martial God Upgrade and the Golden Heavenly King Talent, your Manifestation will be strengthened even further, gaining power equal to a Manifestation two realms above its actual level. In addition, your talent will rise to the point where you are guaranteed to reach the Martial Pinnacle, provided you put in the necessary effort and live long enough to do so.
addons.title: Heart Path Manifestation

objects.text:
Beyond Three Flowers Gather at the Summit lies the realm of Five Energies Converging at the Origin, a stage regarded by many within the mortal world as the true peak of Martial Arts. Very few throughout history have ever reached this realm, with many believing it to be nothing more than a myth. You have reached this realm, attaining a level where the seven emotions are no longer viewed as separate, but as parts of an infinite whole formed through countless variations of Intent. At this level, one becomes capable of contending with Qi Building stage cultivators despite still walking the path of Martial Arts.

At this stage, your understanding of Intent has deepened to the point that divine consciousness has awakened. Through this, you possess the Five Elements Spiritual Root and a developed upper dantian, allowing you to perceive and interact directly with Spiritual Energy while possessing the qualifications necessary to cultivate Heaven Tribe methods.

The five fundamental spiritual energies within your body exist in balance alongside the Three Dantians and Spiritual Root, rebuilding your physique into a form far better suited for Martial Arts than that of an ordinary human. Your body and mind exist at their physical prime, while the purity and stability of your Internal Energy have reached an entirely different level from before. Even after reaching this realm, further transformations of the body through Martial Arts remain possible as your understanding and mastery continue to deepen.

Your control over Gang Qi has also deepened further, allowing you to imbue it into the flow of Qi around you rather than solely into your own techniques, enabling your Martial Arts to interact more directly with the surrounding world.

At this realm, the flow of energy throughout your body is exceptionally pure, naturally slowing the aging process by staving off cellular decay and continuously revitalizing the body through refined Internal Energy circulation. Martial artists at this stage have fully stepped beyond ordinary mortals, with their bodies and senses refined and enhanced to a level far removed from normal humans.

Those who have reached this realm are exceedingly rare within history, often appearing only after the passing of many generations, and are regarded as the absolute peak of the mortal world. Having reached this stage, your talent and potential in Martial Arts have likewise risen to stand among such exceptional individuals. Beyond this realm, mortals believe there to be no further stage of Martial Arts. Yet the path of Martial Arts is not truly fixed, and through sufficient understanding, innovation, and mastery, it remains possible to carve out realms beyond what was once thought to be the absolute limit.
objects.title: Five Energies (A Regressor’s Tale of Cultivation)

objects.text:
You have attained the Formless Sword and can use it at any power level without any drawback.

The formless sword is not a traditional physical weapon. It is not forged from any material substance; rather, it is a literal manifestation of your mind, will, and raw intent. By expending any form of energy you possess—even your own stamina—you can feed, sustain, and condense the sword's concept into reality. 

The sword lacks a fixed or concrete form. It functions as a fluid, invisible, or transparent blade, shifting entirely according to the user's intent. This allows you to launch attacks from impossible angles and directions. Rather than cutting by tracing a conventional path through physical space, the formless sword directly alters its trajectory, form, and length at your will.

The formless sword is neither fixed nor complete. It is a continuously evolving path, refined through understanding, effort, and experience. With time, training, deeper mastery, and a greater understanding of the world and the nature of reality itself, the formless sword will be able to cut through and adapt to virtually anything, including physical matter, conceptual constructs, dimensional planes, souls, space, time, karma, heart essence, abstract concepts, and much more.
objects.title: The Formless Sword (A Regressor’s Tale of Cultivation)

objects.text:
Beyond just being amazing at using lances, your skills also extend to a more unorthodox weapon. Your lance now takes a form of an umbrella or a parasol. This gives you proficiency not just in lances, but also canes and other umbrella like weaponry. Thus, expanding your arsenal and even upgrade your already mighty weapon.

Your lance now becomes an umbrella or a parasol. Its design and materials it is made out of is determined by you. Either way, it is an incredibly durable weapon with now new added benefits. Starting with its canopy, when unfurled, your umbrella could serve as an effective shield. Said canopy is also detachable, as well as have sharp edges, so you can send it flying and slashing at your opponents, or even ride them ala shield surfing.
