Finally, you gain slow fall with it open, gently falling like that of Mary Poppins, this property works incredibly well with your already established high jump height. Otherwise, when closing the umbrella, you can also send out a huge burst of kinetic energy, which can send your enemy staggering, enough to land a surprise blow. Who knows, maybe you can further upgrade this with bullets or magic? Your weapon is yours to make even better.

Overall, your arsenal just got an upgrade. You are now capable of utilizing these skills even when away from your primary weapon. Everyone must be sure to keep canes and umbrellas away from you, or else, they'll never see you coming.
objects.title: Umbrawlla

addons.text:
You have developed a new Breathing Technique—one which seamlessly fuses the grace of Flower Breathing, the precision of Insect Breathing, and the evasive elegance of your Illusionary Floral Shift qinggong. In doing so, you've inherited the best of each style while mitigating their respective flaws, creating a form that is at once highly technical, efficient, precise, and devastatingly effective.

Even those with frail bodies can, through this Style, unleash strikes equal in strength to those of Flower Breathing, without wasting excess energy—instead, relying on refined movement and calculated power to leverage everything to its utmost potential. With enough mastery, a skilled user could end a fight in a single breath, delivering a decisive blow with perfect timing and placement. So efficient is it that even someone of Shinobu's build might be capable of severing the head of an Upper Moon demon with a single well-executed strike, without exhausting herself.

However, achieving this level of mastery isn't so easily attained—for the Dance of the Resplendent Butterfly is an exacting and unforgiving art. It demands complete awareness, perfect timing, and absolute control, asking you to fight with everything you have, and more. A defensive style at heart, built upon the kinetic vision emphasized by Flower Breathing. It requires you to read your opponent thoroughly, following their movements, assessing their patterns, and exploiting their flaws.

Expected to not only endure their assault head-on, dodging each strike by a razor's edge, you must also turn their momentum and strength against them, using them to maximize the impact of every counterattack.

This form also refines the use of thrusts in addition to slashes, confusing foes with erratic angles and elusive movement. As you move, the scent of flowers and the fluttering sound of butterfly wings trail in your wake, subtly disorienting your enemies. With every breath, ephemeral petals and butterflies shimmer into being—an elegant illusion to mask your deadly intent.
addons.title: Dance of the Resplendent Butterfly

addons.text:
Your mastery of Total Concentration Breathing has allowed you to properly draw out Hamon from the One Breath and channel it through your Breathing Style.

As your Breathing Style now carries traces of energy identical to the Sun in it, it is more effective and can even kill Demons without using a Nichirin weapon.

Additionally, due to your enhanced connection to the Sun and One Breath’s ability to heal and revitalize you, Sun Breathing can now be used with minimal risk.
addons.title: Sun Blessed

objects.text:
The highest rank possible in the Demon Slayer Corps, you are now a Hashira-level combatant in whichever Breathing Styles you use. You've mastered the form so completely that you can even improve the Breathing Styles themselves, with effort and practice.

You're a master of Total Concentration Breathing: Constant, as well as the necessary breathing abilities like the other Hashira, along with Tanjiro's Recovery Breathing. All your physical abilities are pushed to their pinnacle, and your senses are enhanced beyond normal human limits.

You can take on strong demons like Lower Moons on your own, but you would need significant help for any Upper Moons, currently at least; one day, you may be able to fight the weaker ones on your own. Your previously enhanced senses are now even sharper, and your Breathing Styles no longer take a harsh toll on your body.

Sun Breathing is an exception, although even its dangers are weakened. You also gain master-level skill in your weapon of choice.
objects.title: Hashira (Demon Slayer)

objects.text: Years of grueling training and an unyielding talent have pushed you to a level only matched by the greatest Demon Slayers in history. Not only have your physical abilities and senses been pushed beyond their previous limits, but you've also gained abilities that transcend the ordinary. A Demon Slayer Mark appears and surges with power, boosting your abilities and Breathing Style tenfold. Upon activating the Demon Slayer Mark, your physical strength and speed are exponentially increased to the point where you can overpower and defeat the Upper Ranks of the Twelve Kizuki and grow in power comparable to the highest among them. The increase in your speed is quite astonishing, as you are capable of regularly out-speeding and even blitzing someone like Gyokko in his true form after activating your Mark, and keeping up with someone like Akaza. It also increases your healing rate, letting you almost fully recover from battles with beings like the Upper Rank demons just three days afterwards. You can choose what your Demon Slayer Mark looks like and where it appears. However, each time you unleash the power of your Demon Slayer Mark, your body is pushed to its absolute limit, a heart attack becoming a constant threat along with extreme temperatures reaching over 39° Celsius (102.2° Fahrenheit). These conditions can prove to be fatal in most cases. You gain the ability to see the Transparent World, a special form of ocular extrasensory perception that alters your vision when activated on a target, allowing you to perceive other living beings as if they were transparent, only being able to see the inner workings of their bodies. Most notably, you can perceive the flow of blood, breathing, muscular contractions and joint movements of the creature you're looking at. You can use the Transparent World's power to see inside an enemy's body as a way to predict and evade their attacks, as well as to find openings for your own strikes. The Transparent World can also be accessed if you are blind, with no difference from those who can see. Additionally, your perception of rapid and brief events is heightened to the point where normally incomprehensibly fast objects can be perceived naturally, thus dramatically increasing your movement speed and reflexes to the point that you can cut the hand of someone like Akaza in the midst of attacking, with no chance for them to respond. When both previous abilities are used in conjunction with each other, you can dye your Nichirin weapon a shining bright red color, mainly through clashing your blade with another Marked swordsman's or gripping it with tremendous force. Bright Red Nichirin weapons have the ability to generate intense heat and also hamper the regeneration of demons or malevolent entities, of which some of the former are on the level of the strongest Upper Ranks of the Twelve Kizuki, as well as the Demon King himself. With your newfound power, you can now face even the most formidable Upper Moons alone. And with a team of equally skilled warriors, you could even challenge the Demon King Kibutsuji Muzan himself. Your combat skill, honed with your chosen weapon, is now at its peak. You've mastered multiple Breathing Styles, allowing you to seamlessly switch between them or even blend them together. You even possess a natural talent for learning and creating new breathing techniques or altering existing ones in response to your opponents.
objects.title: Golden Age Slayer (Demon Slayer)

addons.text: You are a being of pure, unadulterated power, transcending the limitations of both Demon and Slayer. You are the apex predator, a being of unparalleled strength, speed, and perception. Your existence is a contradiction, a fusion of the demonic and the human, a being that defies the very fabric of reality, a being that embodies both the darkness and the light. Your newfound strength lets you effortlessly swat demons like Kibutsuji Muzan as if they were mere dust on your shoulders without your Demon Slayer Mark, and treat other Sun Conquerors like mere children. Your natural speed is enough that you can match a True Monster's Transparent World, even without activating your own. Your Demon Slayer Mark transcends its previous limitations upon activation, amplifying your strength fiftyfold. You are not just a force of nature; you are the embodiment of Divine Intervention. Your Transparent World has evolved—it's no longer just a glimpse into the future; it's a complete understanding of the present and the future. You can see every movement, every intention, and every breath of your opponent. Your perception has sharpened to the point where you can predict the actions of anyone who opposes you, even those considered too unpredictable or too insane to be anticipated. Activating the Transparent World is akin to stopping time—a moment extended into infinity. No longer will they move like banana slugs to you; they will not move at all. Your blows and actions will only be registered when you voluntarily choose to end the Transparent World or if you are incapacitated by a being far stronger and faster than you currently are. Keep in mind that this is not a true time stop; you are simply moving so fast that it appears that way. Effects that nullify or cancel time-related abilities will not affect you, as it is nothing but pure speed alone. Your Selfless State now lets you effectively become one with the world itself. It is impossible to detect you through any supernatural or mundane means, as the place you occupy appears to all senses to be just another part of the world. Even striking where you stand is useless, as they would be striking nothing but air—if an enemy cannot detect you, then how would their attacks know where to hit you? It is only when you move to attack that they become able to hit you, although they would still find themselves unable to perceive you through any of their senses. Your Breathing Styles combine with your Demon Blood Arts to transform into something corporeal, with your Thunder Breathing's electricity being able to electrocute your enemies and your Flame Breathing actually burning those hit by it, to say nothing of Breathing Styles like Stone Breathing, Sun Breathing, and Moon Breathing. If you have Enhanced Breath, your Demon Slayer Mark's boost becomes a hundred-fold. Woe to those who challenge you, for unless they hold esoteric powers or strength and speed far beyond you, even with your current boost, defeat is already assured for them.
addons.title: Wrath of Amaterasu

objects.text: Your power as a Slayer is unmatched. You could physically destroy even a being as powerful as Kibutsuji Muzan, and with your Demon Slayer Mark activated, your strength multiplies fifteenfold, a force of nature unleashed, without any cost to your lifespan or any of the negative side effects that usually accompany the Demon Slayer Mark. You are the strongest Demon Slayer. Your version of the Transparent World gains unmatched precision, a glimpse of the future in combat, and the ability to perceive every movement with incredible clarity. Your speed in your Transparent World becomes unparalleled and immeasurable—so fast that Golden Age Slayers with the Transparent World move like a banana slug compared to you—and your strikes are akin to countless, flickering lights to the eyes of someone like Kibutsuji Muzan, overwhelming them and striking fear into their hearts. No longer do you need to focus on your opponents to activate your Transparent World; you're free to toggle it on and off without focusing on anyone, as if you were blinking. You can dye your Nichirin weapon Bright Red at will and with unequaled strength, burning so hot that its blows will permanently injure any demon or malevolent entity that it hits. You are a master of every Breathing Style shown, hinted at, or referenced in the world of Demon Slayer/Kimetsu no Yaiba, capable of effortlessly creating and mastering new ones as needed. Your talent allows you to alter existing incompatible Breathing Styles like Moon Breathing to be perfectly viable in combat despite lacking the means to properly use them, like Blood Demon Arts. It also allows you to create and alter techniques on the spot, skipping the time, effort, and deliberation needed, jumping straight to defeating your opponent with the most optimum movements, skill, speed, strength, and technique. If you ever choose to teach people your Breathing Styles and breathing techniques, you can use this same talent to alter or create the perfect Breathing Styles for your students, along with being a really good teacher. Your combat prowess is unmatched due to this—a prodigy wielding your chosen weapon with monstrous talent and skill. Even at the tender age of seven, with no formal training, you could defeat a master swordsman with twenty years of experience or more, your natural talent defying all expectations. Additionally, you unlock an esoteric state of being—the Selfless State—known only to a select few and even fewer that can attain it. It is a state of profound tranquility, where your fighting spirit, your malice, your will to fight, and even your very presence fade away. You become one with the world, blending seamlessly into the environment like a whispering leaf in the wind. No supernatural sense can detect you, forcing your opponents to rely solely on their mundane senses. It is the ultimate state of physical combat, a mastery of presence and absence. The incapacity to perceive an individual in the Selfless State induces sensory confusion, resulting in a disorienting experience akin to battling against an inconspicuous intruder, like an out-of-place plant. By merging the Selfless State with the Transparent World, you become a phantom, a silent predator. Your perception slows, revealing the intricate dance of your opponent's muscles and organs, allowing you to predict their every move. You strike with surgical precision, a whisper of death in the stillness of the Selfless State. Your attacks are a blur of speed and a phantom touch, impossible to perceive and react to until it's too late.
objects.title: True Monster (Demon Slayer)

objects.text:
As you already possess Insect Breathing (a derivative of Flower Breathing), you now fully embrace the legacy of Shinobu Kocho.

You become a pharmaceutical and medical genius, able to use wisteria in a multitude of ways—such as hindering a demon’s regeneration, suppressing their extrasensory abilities, altering your body to host said poison, and much more.

You also inherit Shinobu’s keen intellect that allowed her to excel in combat alongside her indomitable will, which kept her fighting against the Upper Rank Two Demon, Doma, while experiencing massive blood loss and the inability to breathe.
objects.title: Legacy of the Insect Hashira (Demon Slayer)

objects.text: "The mark of my dignity, shall scar thy DNA" Instead of a mortal seeking enlightenment, you are a living god who's already attained it, as Gill was to the Illuminati. You've been genetically modified to the point of attaining godlike strength, surpassing all mortal fighters of the Street Fighter Universe, even Akuma himself. You also receive the powers and techniques of both Gill and Urien. You can manipulate fire and ice as easily as flexing the joints of your right and left hands respectively, can summon six wings from your back for flight, emit shockwaves of energy that can stretch farther than the eye can see, and are physically and spiritually immortal. Upon your death, you will resurrect like a phoenix rising from the ashes, though should your soul be directly destroyed, you will truly face death.
objects.title: Gill (Street Fighter)

objects.text: "Show me your power. All of it! Don't hold back." You weren't born to become the strongest Street Fighter, you were built to become it. Your consciousness is now host to a customizable humanoid synthetic body as an artificial intelligence, powered by the Tanden Engine. This body is powerful enough to be beyond the peak of mortal Street Fighters, and is free from biological needs and limits. The Tanden Engine takes the form of a core modelled after the Yin-Yang symbol that constantly generates and gathers Ki automatically, which can be manipulated just as easily, without conscious effort. This energy will constantly nourish, sustain, and fuel your body and abilities. It can also copy the techniques of your opponents by witnessing them near flawlessly, from the simplest kick to the most complex applications of Ki, even distort your own body to achieve it. Currently, you have all of Seth's original and copied techniques from Street Fighter 5, with more than enough storage in your memory banks for more.
objects.title: Seth (Street Fighter)

rows.title: Martial Arts and Technique Power Upgrades

objects.text:
From this moment on, you'll have a natural affinity for all forms of psychic arts—spiritual, cerebral, intuitive, or even dimensional in origin. Where others might struggle to grasp these forces, your mind adapts with ease, resonating with even the most obscure or alien of energies.

You're a rare vessel for channeling these arts. But while your affinity is remarkable, at first you won't feel much different from before. Most of your nascent psychic potential will actually remain dormant till it's stirred by contact with others of your kind. And only through connection, conflict, or shared purpose with them can your deeper abilities begin to awaken—slowly, steadily—until you finally copy or mimic their psychic powers for yourself.

Once you've learned a discipline, though, abilities like astral projection, telepathy, or psychometry, etc., will intuitively come to you. As you quickly pick up on their nuances and intricacies, displaying an aptitude that'll undeniably mark you as a once-in-a-millennium prodigy.

Even so, raw talent isn't the same as mastery. To truly realize your full potential, you'll still frankly need to train and practice using your abilities to develop them.

And no matter what world you end up in, the psychic systems native to that universe will always respond to you. Their rules might differ, but your affinity stays the same. With enough time and focus, you can adapt to any tradition and make it your own.
objects.title: Natural-Born Psychic

objects.text:
Whenever one of your passive or inherent defensive abilities—be it a mental shield, precognitive filter, conceptual immunity, or spiritual barrier—successfully blocks, negates, or neutralizes an external effect, you become perfectly aware of the event. This awareness provides an immediate, intuitive understanding of the nature of the attack that was just thwarted (e.g., a psychic probe, a fate-curse, a memetic hazard, a possession attempt) and the specific defense that intercepted it.

Furthermore, you instinctively gauge the magnitude and depth of the repelled effect. You understand whether the attack was a minor nuisance or an overwhelming assault, and whether it was a shallow, sweeping scan or a deep, focused probe intended to infiltrate your core self. Crucially, you also become aware of what the attack, in its failure, succeeded in doing. If it was a probe, you know what information, if any, was gleaned before it was stopped. If it was a transformative effect, you know what change or influence was attempted upon you. This perception allows you to discern the full scope of the threat and its limited consequences.

This power does not grant you information about the attacker's location, identity, or motives, nor does it apply to active defenses you consciously activate. It functions as a flawless internal alarm and damage assessment system for your own being, ensuring you are never left unaware of an unseen incursion and the exact state of your defenses after it has been repelled.
objects.title: Defensive Awareness

objects.text:
This upgrade allows you to decouple specific powers from the volatile emotions or mental states that fuel them. For any ability that requires a particular emotion (like rage), state of mind (like obsession), or altered consciousness (like a combat trance) to function, you can intuitively develop specialized conditioning techniques.

Through this training, you learn to access that power in your base, normal state of mind, at the level of strength it would normally have when triggered by the associated condition. This conditioned access becomes a reliable, permanent part of your abilities. If you later experience the original, raw emotion or state, its intensity is not required to use the power, but instead adds on top of your controlled baseline, creating a temporary surge in power—unless you consciously choose to suppress this additive effect to maintain perfect stability.
objects.title: Dispassionate Mastery

objects.text: Your mind has been broken and rebuilt ground up around your mental abilities, made to fully maximise them. This results in an alien architecture, a "mad genius" that simply doesn't think like other humans, instead thinks in a way that is distinctly alien, although not inhuman, to fully lean on your mental abilities. For example, if you have Invention, then your mind doesn't look at what already exists and ask how it could be improved. You don't build on old ideas because old ideas don't even enter your thinking process. Instead, completely new concepts just appear in your head out of nowhere, already finished and ready to go, like they were always there waiting for you to notice them. You just look at a problem and suddenly you understand a solution that has never occurred to anyone in the history of existence, using methods and principles nobody has ever thought to use before. Your memory works differently too. Most people remember facts and information to use later, but your brain treats old knowledge as something that's already been replaced by whatever new thing you've come up with since then. This is a one-time rewriting of your mind into one suited for using your powers. No matter the changes, the core of your identity will remain the same, and while your mind may become alien, it will not be inhuman.
objects.title: Alien Mind

objects.text:
A portion of your subconscious mind has mutated to handle all the calculations related to your abilities. If you previously had to consciously control some aspects, such as range, power, or what to affect by any of your powers, abilities, spells, etc., now, this new part of your mind automatically adjusts your abilities as if you personally used them with full concentration and perfect attention to details.

You can also channel any of your supernatural energies, such as mana, spiritual or psionic energy, or anything else to speed up this section of your mind and allow it to handle more information at once with no upper limit, allowing you to, potentially, cast millions of overlapping spells with but a stray thought.
objects.title: Territory of Starry Wisdom

objects.text:
You are now capable of allocating parts of your consciousness solely to the task of background managing of your powers. This allows you to essentially "program" the behaviour of your abilities as detailed as you want, from simply automatically attacking in response to a perceived threat to simulating complex behaviour.

While even the smallest part of your mind retains its infinite computational capability, allowing for the instructions of any complexity, it still relies on you being consciously or subconsciously aware of the required stimuli to initiate a response. You can program your power to automatically protect you from attacks as long as you can perceive them in any way, shape, or form, whether by conventional or supernatural senses, even if you are asleep or unconscious, as long as your mind still functions, but you cannot have your powers respond if you had no way to detect the attack in the first place.
objects.title: Script

objects.text:
You can grant full autonomy to any effects of your powers that are governed by your scripts and allow them to persist even completely outside the range at which you normally would've been able to use your ability. If you could control fire, for example, you could create a semi-sentient fire elemental; if you were a time manipulator, you would be able to create time-dilated zones that function without your direct control; or if you possessed the power of resurrection, you could set it to automatically revive you in case of your death.

Additionally, creating the scripts becomes easier than ever, as they now automatically compile based on your desires, allowing for effortless creation of even complex artificial personalities without needing to consider every possible variable yourself.

At all times, you maintain awareness of all running scripts, no matter the range, and can rewrite them at will.
objects.title: Autonomous Expression

objects.text:
Fuelled by the infinite might of your mind, all your mental and psychic powers and abilities evolve at a staggering pace. The mere act of casually using them pushes your powers beyond their previous capabilities, and dedicated training or high-pressure situations result in explosive, exponential growth, allowing you to overcome most challenges within moments. Coming up with novel and creative uses of your powers is easier than breathing, and the control you exhibit over them is perfect.

The previously established rules can be bent or broken entirely as your powers evolve and adapt, shedding their limitations and improving both in potency and versatility, as well as developing secondary abilities when they are found lacking.
objects.title: Cognitive Singularity

objects.text: Your ability to plan and make predictive deductions is truly staggering. Whether in a bout of fisticuffs or at the chessboard, you are dozens of steps ahead of your opponents, able to visualize entire engagements from beginning to end before the first blow is ever struck. This power includes minor supporting improvements to general intelligence, mental processing speed, multitasking ability, and senses.
objects.title: Sherlock Scan

addons.text: Your intellect now embodies the combined brilliance of Sherlock, Moriarty, and Mycroft, reaching unprecedented heights as you have finally ascended. You are now the most intelligent human on Earth. Your mind is incandescent—a mind of such genius that it could be described as "an era-defining intellect beyond Sir Isaac Newton." With your godlike intellect, you perceive truths beyond the scope of ordinary humans and even someone like Mycroft. Your foresight is so acute that you can practically see the future with uncanny accuracy, even down to the specific clothing and expressions of individuals in their older years. As a child of only five years old, you could orchestrate intricate murders that would remain unsolved for decades, masterfully utilize ciphers, and manipulate others to the point of enslavement—and your intellect will only continue to expand. Your adult intellectual capabilities are such that you could spend an hour on Twitter and then precisely predict the exact dates of three separate terrorist attacks on a country. Those who lack a similar level of intellect will be reprogrammed and thus "compromised"—puppets devoid of free will, unknowingly dancing to your will. With this, you possess all of Eurus Holmes' capabilities and more.
addons.title: Eurus

objects.text:
Sherlock Scan's minor supporting improvements and predictive deduction abilities have been vastly outclassed. You have now reached the level of Mycroft—Sherlock's older brother and the second most intelligent human in the world.

You possess incredible analytical and deductive abilities that utterly surpass Sherlock's, a genius-level intellect that ensures your victory in every deductive battle against him.

Your powers of deduction are such that you can glance at police reports and instantly understand what happened to a hiker, or perceive that a man underwent corrective laser surgery for short-sightedness simply by observing his clothing.

Your inhumanly intelligent mind grants you exceptional mental resistance, making you practically immune to mind probes from someone as intelligent as Sherlock, and able to resist the manipulation of someone as intelligent as Eurus despite their superior intellect.

With this, you possess all of Mycroft Holmes' capabilities and more.
objects.title: Mycroft

objects.text:
You're now the equal and antithesis of Sherlock Holmes; while he is the world's greatest detective, you are the 'Napoleon of Crime'.

You're still a genius of deduction and perception but your skills, abilities and knowledge have expanded to make you nearly unparalleled with regards to criminality and its planning in all its forms. You possess near-superhuman expertise and knowledge in every field of crime including forgery, blackmail, drug trafficking and more. You also have a powerful intuition regarding how best to apply your criminal expertise and knowledge to nearly any challenge you come up against. 

Your genius also encompasses Moriarty's greatest accomplishment, his global criminal network. You have an inhuman talent for setting up and controlling widespread, self-sustaining, successful criminal organisations with regard to any type of illicit activity. You can orchestrate and administrate these organisations in such a manner as to ensure their continuous secrecy and success.

You could potentially build a world-spanning criminal underground in a matter of years, force entire governments to bend to your whims and have lifelong criminals too terrified of you to even say your name.
objects.title: Moriarty

objects.text:
You have received the complete mental acuity, raw intellectual power, memory, creativity, fortitude, willpower, charisma, manipulation, domain knowledge (game theory, strategy, 18 languages including archaic ones, the secrets of every piece of media ever published in those languages, cold reading and much, much more), predictive ability, reflexes, skills, luck, and general "game sense" of both members of [ ] combined.

This allows you to use mind games on people into handing you victory before you even start, outwit people actively reading your mind, win fair and square no matter how much your opponent is cheating (with you having near instantly figured out how), and even defeat the most intelligent and well-read Flügel in a trivia contest.

As a bonus, you can choose to also gain [ ]'s complete collection of paraphernalia from their original world, meaning that you don't have to hope whatever world you're in has good games or useful non-fiction books.
objects.title: Theoretical Best Move (No Game No Life)

objects.text:
You have become the greatest in the criminal and legal worlds via the combined intellectual prowess of the greatest detective, L, and Light Yagami, The God Of The New World.

From L, you have gained deductive skills beyond human reason. You have a perfect memory, can instantly spot verbal and logical contradictions, find clues from minute details or actions, and have the ability to develop insidious verbal or physical traps that your opponents walk right into. However, your scariest power is your ability to psychoanalyze others. You can create a psychological profile and deduce crucial details of a target simply by knowing basic info about their actions, like time or location. You can narrow down suspects ridiculously quickly and find if they match your profile with a glance for most and a short conversation for the utmost perplexing cases.

From Kira, you have gained a raw intellect, easily surpassing the entire world. Even without experience or resources, you can throw together complex world-altering plots. Your observational capacity can piece together the minute actions of others into their deepest secrets, goals, or short-term plans. You can then devise counterplans immediately after. You also have a penchant for manipulating others, using various pressures to make them dance to your tune. Finally, you have gained a natural charisma with your words and actions that causes others to pay attention to you, whether to follow or fear you.

Your thinking speed, creativity, parallel processing, and learning have increased by a massive degree. You can solve unreasonably complex problems in minutes, master fields in hours, and establish secret societies in days. Depending on your personality, this level of intellectual superiority can lead to nihilistic viewpoints if you're unable to express it properly, like against a true rival.
objects.title: The World's Greatest (Death Note)

addons.text: Your power has expanded to include the skills, experience, and knowledge of the remaining members of the Batman Family. This includes Dick Grayson’s acrobatics, skill in espionage, and charisma, Barbara Gordon’s extreme proficiency with computers and hacking, Jason Todd’s skill with weaponry and knowledge from the All-Caste, and Tim Drake’s skill with analysis and deduction. You also gain access to the gear used by members of the Batman Family in their own standalone stories.
addons.title: The Legacy of the Bat

objects.text:
You are darkness. You are the night. You are Batman!

You gain the abilities and memories of every essentially "human level" variant of Bruce Wayne, including the versatility of the Arkham version, the grim manner of the DCAU version, the pseudo-toonforce of the Adam West & Joel Schumacher versions, the specialized skills of the many film versions, and the literal hundred years worth of feats of the various comics versions. Every skill of every Dark Knight, no matter how minor and insignificant, is yours.

You can also choose to gain an appropriate set of Bat-gear, composed of the majority of the equipment, tools, gadgets, facilities, and vehicles used by the many different versions of Batman across the multiverse.

This only includes the kind of tools Batman would use in standalone Batman content, rather than things he would use in the Justice League or in event comics (thus following the "Why Doesn't He Call Superman, Is He Stupid?" Principle). For example, this would give you Wayne Manor, The Batcave, The Batcomputer, nearly every Batmobile or other Bat-Vehicle, and the many holdings of Wayne Industries, but it wouldn't give you The Watchtower, Zeta Tubes, or Brother Eye right out of the box.
objects.title: World's Greatest Detective (DC Comics)

addons.text:
Some rulers delegate. Others hide behind soldiers, lieutenants, and hired killers. Not you.

Your combat instincts are flawlessly integrated with your role as the sovereign of the criminal world. When you choose to act personally within your territory or against anyone connected to your operations, you gain a suite of advantages that reflect your status as both the ruler and enforcer. 

Your reflexes and battlefield awareness become hyper-focused. You cannot be caught flat-footed, ambushed, or feinted in any combat situation you personally enter. You always act with optimal timing, not necessarily first in initiative, but at the moment that turns the tide. This applies to combat, negotiation, or social leverage scenarios. You exploit emotional, tactical, or psychological weaknesses with the same instinctive precision as you do physical ones.

When acting within your network’s sphere of influence, you automatically know the layout, escape routes, and areas of tactical control. Enemies are at a positional disadvantage while your allies gain enhanced coordination and morale while you are present. Those who serve you become sharper under your gaze. Those who oppose you feel the weight of your reputation and hesitate, even if they don’t understand why.

When you act against betrayal, insubordination, or failure within your organization, your actions carry finality. Any subordinate or rival within your web who witnesses your personal intervention understands, consciously or not, that their lives remain intact only because you allow it. Repeat offenses within the same region or faction are unlikely unless the structure is shattered entirely.
addons.title: The Don

addons.text:
You have become the figure who commands fear in darkness and admiration in light, with neither side seeing the full picture.

You possess the charisma, bearing, and strategic acumen necessary to maintain a flawless public identity, be it a philanthropist, reformer, civic leader or visionary. Your noble presence draws admiration, loyalty, and trust from civilians, city officials, and political institutions alike. You no longer need to hide from the public eye; you thrive in it, walking both worlds with elegance and control.

In the daylight, you are untouchable. Your words carry weight, and you wield soft power with terrifying precision. You can sway legislation, redirect scrutiny, and use your reputation as a shield for your operations. Even your “supposed” criminal empire can exist in plain sight, being the very image of civic virtue, and few are willing to believe otherwise.

Yet behind the mask, your network continues to grow, feeding you information, resources, and control. You shift seamlessly between noble grace and ruthless command, reading the room and speaking the language that suits the moment.

This dual nature crystallizes into a true embodiment of carrot and stick. Your criminal empire is no longer ruled by fear alone; it is governed by reward, opportunity, and prestige. Subordinates who serve you faithfully are granted wealth, influence, and a place in the daylight world you control. This makes your loyalty more desirable than any bribe, and your disappointment more terrifying than any threat. People don’t just fear betraying you, they fear displeasing you, losing your grace, being cast out from the light you provide.

You control not just territory, but narrative. You choose what story the world believes, and you choose what truth remains buried.
addons.title: The Capone

objects.text: You are no longer just a survivor of the streets or a mastermind of crime — you are the undisputed power behind the city’s underworld, a shadow monarch whose influence touches every alley, rooftop, and backroom deal. The localized web of contacts once granted by Alley Cat — personal relationships with thieves, beggars, and informants — have been completely subsumed and replaced by the immense reach and authority of your criminal empire. Your local ties have evolved into a layered, hierarchical criminal infrastructure — a scaled-down but fully functional version of the global criminal infrastructure you can make, tailored to the city you occupy. Informants, gangs, fences, smugglers, hackers, and corrupt officials are already in place. They recognize your authority — even if they don’t know your face — and act in coordination with your will. Information flows to you instantly. Black-market goods are secured effortlessly. Surveillance of urban threats or assets is all but complete. Furthermore, what once took years to build under Moriarty now begins to coalesce within months, guided by your innate grasp of urban psychology, social tension, and opportunity. Cities are no longer puzzles or battlegrounds — they are ecosystems, and you are their apex predator. Your criminal empires grow faster, mesh tighter, and reinforce one another, accelerating the rate at which power, fear, and profit feed your expanding machine. Each new asset creates more opportunities, each victory multiplies your influence, and each foothold opens doors to higher ground. Your network becomes exponential — sprawling, adaptive, and impossible to root out without gutting the city itself.
objects.title: Kingpin

objects.text:
"Only one thing is equal for all, and that is death."

There was someone so empty, so dangerous, so wicked. Made from a lie made of love. Groomed into the next step of an aging and delusional Fourth Reich. He wasn’t the face of Evil because he reveled in monstrous or defiling acts, no, he was the most despicable of all… because he saw no point in life at all. You now share a similar mind as Johan Liebert, inheriting both his and 511 Kinderheim’s skills at psychological warfare, brainwashing, human programming, and by extension, the “man’s” knack for manipulation and orchestration of horrendous acts and events—his ability to inflict the most amount of psychological damage to people. As the Monster with No Name, you don't just understand people’s motives and intentions, not only driving them to acts they'll find unthinkable, but you also unravel their being, as you're capable of psychologically analyzing their mindset and psyche with only a conversation. This understanding helps you rope them into circumstances where their resolve is tested or they mentally shatter, among other horrifying possibilities. Your expertise in manipulation takes another devious aspect of an almost supernatural skill, creating designs or schemes that cause or generate the most misery or chaos, by exploiting human failings and critical blindspots, almost seeming like a natural disaster, bringing the worst of humanity has to offer within everyone. But you? Aside from your acting talents, you become the masks you craft, almost blurring the lines between your identity and the masks you wear. But who is to care for a name? You’d be fine without one, anyway. As that's what you are… a Monster with No Name.
objects.title: The Nameless Monster (Monster)

objects.text:
Unornamented, the ultimate dream of all martial artists—the very peak one may achieve. Just as an archer no longer needs a bow to shoot an arrow, a martial artist need not strike, and a swordsman need not wield a sword to cut.

This technique transcends all others. Unornamented is the ultimate expression of mastery: you grasp the very fabric of the world, and your actions alter it directly.

Your attack becomes completely invisible to both normal and supernatural senses, detectable only by visualizing the trajectory.

Not only that, but this attack bypasses all forms of armor and defense. For example, a sword swing may cut through bone, muscle, and organs—yet leave the skin completely untouched.

Warning: The use of this technique places extreme strain on the body. A single use will kill a human at their physical peak. A second use could cause repercussions severe enough to kill even a god.

Without extreme durability or regeneration, the use of this technique will lead to certain death.
objects.title: Unornamented (Record of Ragnarok)

objects.text:
Elementary, My Dear: It's Quite Simple, My Friend is the Noble Phantasm acquired by Sherlock Holmes when materialized as a Servant. It is his Origin of "Elucidation" sublimated as a Noble Phantasm.

Even if the enigma that is being opposed is truly an unresolvable mystery, the route and the clues that will finally arrive at the truth of it will "appear" without exception. For example, even if the key to a treasure chest is lost, the key will end up "not being lost", and it appears that it can be definitely discovered somewhere in the world. (However, as one would expect, it does not suddenly appear in the middle of one's hand, and wherever it is, you and your collaborators must discover it.)
objects.title: Elementary, My Dear (Type-Moon)

objects.text: “Thou hast been deemed worthy. Thy potential, raw and untamed, is perfect steel yet to be forged—a blade destined to cut down the enemies of our Order. Now begins thy path. The mantle of the Old Man of the Mountain awaits, shouldst thou prove thyself.” You’ve been chosen—plucked from obscurity, marked by fate, and cast into the crucible of death and shadow. Now you walk the sacred, brutal path of the Hashshashin. Not merely an initiate, but a candidate for the title of Hassan-i-Sabbah, the Old Man of the Mountain. Your flesh has been broken, your will shattered and remade, and through that annihilation, you have been reborn—not as a person, but as an instrument of death. The imprint left by the Valley, once a dormant ember hidden deep within your soul, now pulses like a second heartbeat. Having treaded the precipice of oblivion so often that it knows your name. With each brush against the brink, your fear erodes and resilience forms, as you find acceptance in death’s embrace—tempered by every moment spent At the Boundary. Already, your presence carries the faint scent of the grave, a lingering whisper of finality clinging to your skin. In time, that aura will deepen, letting your touch embody the concept of death itself—to seize its mysteries and weaponize it. And as your exposure grows, death’s hold will wane; its grasp slips away, granting you complete immunity to instant-death, necromantic effects, and charm. Alongside this, your Presence Concealment has risen in Rank, becoming more intricate and refined. Though these are merely a few facets of your abilities, as a candidate of the Order, you have been trained in all the ancient disciplines of assassination and everything that entails. For now, however, you’re an E-rank Servant in all but name. Not yet a legend, but undeniably something far beyond the realm of ordinary men. Inevitably, during your journey down this path, you’ll find your specialty amongst these varied age-old arts; philosophies reflecting how you choose to walk with death, in whatever form your path takes. Whether that calling lies in thrown daggers, poisons, martial arts, magecraft, or some other. And one day, should your soul remain unbroken and conviction unshaken, you may reach far enough into the darkness to forge your own Zabaniya. Perhaps not just one, but many—each a unique expression of your spirit’s communion with the Valley, each a mirror of your soul, each a step closer to the legacy of the First Hassan.
objects.title: Hassan-i-Sabbah Candidate (Type-Moon)

objects.text: "Overflow With Agony: Zabanya" Your faith and zealotry has forged you into a perfect assassin. You've looked to the past Hassan-i-Sabbah with reverence and devoted yourself into learning all that you could from them, resulting in the Zabanya of Phantasmal Pedigree. It consists of the eighteen imitated techniques, which may be weaker or stronger, of past the Hassan-i-Sabbah. This includes Ichor of Reverie, a song that can control a human or even force a servant to their knees; Heretical Reminiscence, which blurs the line between yourself and the world to make you intangible or Unfeeling Patrolling Spirits which allows you to summon shadowy Jinniya. With time and training, you may bring those Zabaniya which are a pale shadow of what they could be up to level of the past Hassan-i-Sabbah's and perhaps even beyond them.
objects.title: Zealot (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
Your Mystic Eyes have synergized together with your other abilities and have granted you Miyamoto Musashi’s Heavenly Eye.

This goes beyond mere Skill or Instinct—the application of the Heavenly Eye is that "such and such location should be cut"; for example, seeking that "the opponent's right arm should be sliced off" will make you automatically perceive all potential outcomes and choose the optimal position, location, and action that minimizes injuries and maximizes damage.

You have started down the path of cutting upon the metaphysical level.
objects.title: Heavenly Eye (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
Held in the soul of the user, Revelation is a skill analogous to instinct, enabling the person to hear the voice of heaven. This grants the individual an incredible sixth sense in achieving all their goals, not just in combat, such as the best way to climb a tower or the best way to travel. 

This is not a comprehensive step-by-step guide on how to achieve your aims, but rather a hunch on taking the most optimal path. In addition to this, as the skill is rooted in your own feelings, it may be difficult to explain your reasoning for taking specific actions.

This does not remove or reduce your instincts in combat.
objects.title: Revelation (Type-Moon)

objects.text: The renaissance. The rebirth. The wisdom of mankind realised. The death knell of superstition and the beginnings of enlightenment. Around you, the transformation of society will come to pass, almost like a second renaissance. People will become smarter, more creative and more enlightened. That is not to say that it will be Utopia, but for some people it would be close. The research of technology will progress at an exponential rate, with your society rising from modern day technology to one on the Kardashev scale in a few short decades. Things like zero point energy, advanced medical procedures and beneficial AI companions are not just within reach but expectations. Mysteries that operate on the logic of the divine will slowly lose their power as those that operate on the logic of man increase in power, even beyond initial expectations. If your society has some supernatural framework then that will undergo a metamorphosis, entire new fields of study will be founded and the monstrous beasts that once plagued man will now be drowned under the weight of Humanity's Great Works. All of this has been conceptually baked into the fabric of civilization. Never will they fall into the Dark Age of Man. They will push ever forward into light of reason, casting off the shackles of ignorance. As the wellspring of this resurrection, you stand as the first among equals. Smarter, wiser and more reasoned on the level of people like Machiavelli or Leonardo Da Vinci. You may also direct how this renaissance grows, such as focusing it in one area, exponentially increasing it's rate of advancement. The Age of Gods is dead. Long live the Age of Man. If you wish, you may have your society to take on aspects of the Italian Renaissance at your pleasure.
objects.title: Age of Rebirth

objects.text: “Behold! What the gods have woven, Humanity shall sunder! Omnipotence no longer belongs to the divine!” The Age of Will has come. Humanity's ascension is now undeniable. Mankind has gone from the hysteria of ages past to the enlightenment of the present. Now it looks to the future and its infinite potential. Your magical foundation has been exalted. The knowledge and skill needed to understand and use the foundation that Elucidate Axiomata provides has been reduced down to the level that the average teenager could understand. It also has been inverted in comparison to regular magecraft, in that the more that the knowledge of a spell is spread across humanity, the more powerful it becomes. No phenomena, be it alien tech of the Olympians to the true magics, is beyond you. Immortality, time travel and dimension hopping is now birthright instead of the stuff of dreams. You have also transcended the need for flesh and blood, be it through an android body or a physiology much like a heroic spirit. The divine, The eldritch and the alien can no longer stand to be in the same plane of existence, if they were hostile and even if were not they would be weakened to the point of powerlessness. Every single human being has the star attribute carved into them on the metaphysical level. The ability to overturn human history and become living legends. Even the lowliest of Man can deny their fate and lead humanity into the future. Eventually, with effort, every human will be a miniature Ein Sof, transcending Pan Human History and its chains.
objects.title: Age of Will (Type-Moon)
Remnant of a Lost Age
objects.text: "You think it'll last forever, people and cars and concrete, but it won't. One day it's all gone... My planet's gone. It's dead. Just rocks and dust before its time." The Age your soul yearns for does not exist. Maybe it has never come to be. Maybe it has already fallen in a catastrophe. Mankind does not know the wonders you have seen. Yet still you remain, a living testament to this age of greatness. You retain all the abilities and traits humanity of this enlightened age possessed, as well as the common knowledge of their civilization. The further the current species is from the humans in your memory, the less you will feel you belong in this time, with a lingering longing to reclaim this great age. With enough time you might drag mankind back to the heights you remember, though you will have to do so by your own efforts without any help from the world itself. This does not decrease any of your powers or change what Age of Rebirth and Age of Will would give you personally, only influencing their effects on humanity as a whole.

addons.text:
The sword you wield is Excalibur. The clothes you wear? Excalibur. The vehicle you drive? Excalibur. Everything that you now own can be considered Excalibur, if held in your hands, this includes properties, magic and other esoteric things.

When calling out the true name, whilst using something other than a weapon, the item's function is supercharged for that moment. Armour will get more protective, magic will cut through things it shouldn't be capable of cutting through and vehicles will get even faster.
addons.title: Excalibur on the Brain

objects.text: "A road to glory, seeking a miracle! A crystallization of faith honouring that will! Sadly enough, the noble dream... Leads to the ends unhindered by anyone!" The dreams you've inherited from your childhood stories are no longer just fantasies. They has been branded into you and transformed your soul like it was a curse or a blessing. You now admire the echo of their footsteps, pushing you ever forward; you couldn't betray these dreams even if you tried. Ordinarily, it would only drive you to almost insane acts of recklessness to prove yourself to the characters that inspired you. However, thanks to this power, the more you embody the various stories of your dreams, the more the narrative twists to re-enact great legends. For example, if you held King Arthur in great esteem, perhaps the sword you called Excalibur truly turns into the genuine article; if you died in a lake, you may be taken to the ever-distant utopia, Avalon or you could even kill a dragon by re-enacting the myth of Artoria slaying Vortigern. The scale of these changes depends on your devotion to your ideals, the innate power that you hold, and how well the situation mirrors past events. With very little of these things, you could only summon up lesser-known weapons like Carwennan or repeat the small-scale legends of King Arthur. Be careful of pulling upon the legends of old too much as you may inadvertently include the tragic parts of said stories; The battle of Cammlann could be the final legend you embody.
objects.title: Avalonian (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
You have somehow achieved a Second Breakthrough, transforming you into a juvenile God-Spark. This process would normally require you to “stoke the flames of your Spark until it becomes an inferno,” which is typically done through exposure to esoteric energies or extremely dangerous experiments and inventions to force the awakening. Thankfully, your ascension was done entirely by your own merits and in an extremely stable manner. 

To crown this wondrous ascension, you gain a halo of eldritch symbols of your design around your head, which you can choose to hide or reveal at your leisure. Also, unlike other God-Sparks who have their wane over time and need to replenish it through a special ritual, your power is endless, though over-usage will require you to rest and let it recover.

This ascension both turbo-charges and refines your abilities as a Spark, granting you godlike power and intelligence. You are effectively a Spark squared, able to make other Sparks look like a joke as they do to normal scientists. You no longer need to use the Madness Places, though you still can if you choose to, as you are in a constant state of being 'Suspended in an Eternal Moment of Supreme Clarity'. This allows you to use and channel the power of the Madness Place without losing your rationality and allows you to build wondrous creations without entering a half-conscious fugue state.

You gain the ability to see “the levers of the universe” and to “touch them,” which manifests as psychic powers like telekinesis and telepathy. You can see in more than three dimensions, and even interact with beings beyond the mortal plane in several ways. You have the power to shapeshift freely, going from giant to normal in an instant, and acquiring any color, appearance, or form you desire. This power also grants you a kind of pseudo-reality warping around you, though this consumes an extreme amount of energy. Additionally this also grants you innate knowledge over the fundamental rules of the universe, allowing you to invent things which are seemingly magical in nature using eldritch knowledge that is, in actuality, fully mundane, but uses knowledge no one has ever heard of before that should you try to explain would almost certainly melt their brain trying to comprehend.

Thanks to your new psychic powers and further enhanced charisma, you can now possess willing minions or subjects and break any mind control or subversion on them. You also gain the ability to control energy in various forms, most of them rather unspecified, and you can create powerful blasts of pure energy to erase anything or anyone who draws your ire.

At the peak of your power as a God-Spark without further enhancing yourself, you could create a semi-permanent effect like keeping a sunken Great Britain from sinking to the bottom of the ocean and being crushed by water, and still have some power left over.
objects.title: Second Breakthrough (Girl Genius)

objects.text:
The designation given to most sanctioned psykers in the Imperium. With proper training, a Delta-level psyker can simultaneously read the minds of all the people in a good-sized town while still being able to crush a tank in seconds.

Should your destination be 40k, prepare to be visited by the Astra Telepathica to be placed in chains aboard the many Black Ships bound to Terra for re-education.

Alongside this, the concern of Daemonic possession will be a very real threat to your sanity if you use your powers unwisely, so be wary of what you see in the Warp without Witch Eye.
objects.title: Delta-Class Psyker (Warhammer: 40k)

objects.text:
Standing powerful even amongst the other sanctioned psykers in the Imperium, your designation will earn you both—a great deal of interest and concern in the Astra Telepathica of equal measure.

Gaining the ability to summon miniature warp storms to tear apart cities, seemingly bring the dead back to life, manipulate the threads of fate to see and distort the future and past, and finally even seal apart dimensional rifts caused by ambitious daemons from the Warp.

Be warned, your searing presence in the Warp has garnered the interest of countless daemons who desire your soul. Outside of 40k, this wouldn't be a bother, but in 40k, expect to spend the rest of your days fighting off advances from Lesser and Greater Daemons alike should you ever lose control over yourself.
objects.title: Gamma-Class Psyker (Warhammer: 40k)

objects.text:
The designation given to the unspoken powers of psykers that are feared even amongst the Imperium's Elite. Casually immolate entire islands with Warp-fire, or bewitch every mind inhabiting it to commit ritual suicide to summon a greater daemon to wreck apart entire country-spanning Hive cities.

Far surpassing the might of many of your generation, should you jump into 40k, expect to be forcibly recruited into Grey Knights to face the greater horrors in the wider galaxy, or picked apart amongst one of the many ravenous hands with the higher echelons of the Inquisitorial Orders for reeducation.

While staying in 40k, you will need to learn to exercise extreme mental discipline as Greater Daemons will haunt your mind, promising forbidden knowledge and power, but for a steep price.
objects.title: Beta-Class Psyker (Warhammer: 40k)

objects.text:
A rarity even amongst even the greatest of Imperium psykers. Even if moderately trained, you can turn a man inside-out with a glance, snap mountains in half with a flick of the wrist, speak a single word to turn an army upon itself in a frenzy of blood lust, and scar the surface of continents by summoning warp-storms.

You are capable of destroying and enslaving entire worlds—sometimes unintentionally. Your presence can be felt unconsciously in the minds of every living and unliving thing on the planet and star system you reside in, especially by the psychically attuned.
objects.title: Alpha-Class Psyker (Warhammer: 40k)

objects.text: A walking talking abomination of reality, your presence rejects the limits placed on the Materium plane. Comparable to the God Emperor of Man during the Great Crusade of the 30th Millennium, your mind has the bandwidth and processing power to scan and interact with every living thing in the galaxy using your psyker powers. With enough dedicated practice, you can focus your psychic might to send entire star systems screaming into the Warp.
objects.title: Alpha Plus-Class Psyker (Warhammer: 40k)

objects.text:
Your Psyker powers, at first a path seeming to lead to dangerous corruption, have now become holy and pure.

You gain access to the miracles & "holy" powers of the Adeptus Sororitas & the Ecclesiarchy, you can more easily purify corruption such as that of Chaos, and your "regular" psyker powers are rendered completely safe, removing problems such as Perils of The Warp or letting Chaos into a dimension it didn't previously have access to.
objects.title: Ephrael Stern (Warhammer: 40k)

addons.text:
You aren't just the First Human, nor are you just any Emperor. You are who all of humanity has descended from. You've seen your children rise and fall over and over until you decided to lend them your hand and guide them through the darkness. Any human you meet will have a subtle, yet instinctual bond to you. They may easily come to see you as a father figure, a superior, or even just someone worth following. As the first man, and as the Emperor of mankind, you have all the knowledge humanity has ever gained in your current universe. From when humanity first began, to the current era.

Your eyes are now able to see anywhere your incredible psyker powers are able to sense. Thus allowing you to copy abilities from light years away even. Your eyes also become more conceptual in nature, allowing you to replicate more esoteric abilities.
addons.title: The Mind of Man

objects.text:
“The universe has many horrors yet to throw at us. This is not the end of our struggle. This is just the beginning of our crusade to save Humanity. Be faithful! Be strong! Be vigilant!”

The Age of Strife ravaged humanity like no cataclysm before, save perhaps the cybernetic revolt. Humanity was left defenceless and divided to be preyed upon by the countless species surrounding them.

Until you came along.

You are The Emperor of Mankind. Master of a million worlds and commander of inexhaustible armies. You can be considered to be the very summit of mankind with psychic mastery beyond mortal comprehension, able to force an entire Space Marine legion to kneel and you have complete understanding of imperial psychic disciplines.

Horus required empowerment at the warp gate in Molech and the direct intervention of the Chaos Gods to be able to match The Emperor psychically and physically, meaning none but the most dangerous of foes may be able to match you in combat.

You have more scientific knowledge than what a normal human could spend a thousand lifetimes researching. Uplifting stone-age humans to the technological level of the twenty-first century would be hardly an effort and iterating upon current imperial technology would be more of an idle thought exercise than anything strenuous. 

Chaos, Dark, or Evil-aligned entities cannot stand to look at you. For you are The Anathema, the conceptual opposite of these creatures, being the symbol of order and light. 

You also have an unbreakable will, able to withstand the agonizing pain of holding back the teeming hordes of the four chaos gods from breaching the imperial palace and turning Terra into a new Eye of Terror, for over ten thousand years.

You may choose whether this is pre-Molech or post-Molech Emperor.

Be careful not to make the same mistakes twice, for Humanity lives or dies by your godlike hands.

You may also choose whether to inherit the Emperor of Mankind’s memories and decide how they will affect you, if at all.
objects.title: The Emperor of Mankind (Warhammer: 40k)

addons.text:
No longer is your Soul Garden a false afterlife, but instead the final destination of all of humanity's souls. Within your soul they will find rest, safe from any who would seek them harm, whether that be for corruption, interrogation, or simply predation. In consequence any use of necromancy that involves the summoning of souls will fail unless you consciously permit it, though mere animation of corpses not requiring souls is unaffected.

As humanity's true afterlife, all concepts of human afterlives can be found as separate realms within your garden, be they the Christian Heaven & Hell, the Egyptian Sekhet-Aaru, the Greek Three Realms of Hades, the Aztek Thirteen Heavens, the Norse Valhalla, the Sanzu River and the Japanese Yomi, all can be found within your Soul Garden, along with realms where intellectuals can meet peers for debate, warriors and athletes compete, grieving souls reunite with their loved ones, and the weary simply slumber and rest until their worn souls have recovered to seek out something else. Nothing of any of the afterlives can be removed from it, they are purely part of your Soul Garden for the souls who dwell within.

As humanity's afterlife incarnated all human souls will after death naturally be drawn towards you. Other forces can still snatch them away before they reach their destination, though to counteract your innate claim on humanity's soul they must either fight you for them or steal them away before your claim can take hold by using for example sacrificial rituals as a conduit. Even then, only those who have outright sold their souls to another Patron are truly beyond your reach, all other souls can be reclaimed or will eventually find their way to you, though the journey to reach you can take millennia and for how long these shredded soul-fragments must recover before they become recognizable as who they once were is anyone's guess.

You can freely communicate with the souls residing within your soul, both to gain information and to recruit them into your faith to help further empower you as the Divine of Humanity, as well as using your power to revive any of your followers, either as your Saint or using your biomantic skills to grant them true resurrection.

Mankind can rest easy, knowing their souls are kept safe from harm after their time has come. No matter what horrors may lurk in the unknown, The Emperor Protects.
addons.title: The Emperor Protects

objects.text:
You have reached a higher form of existence through the faith directed towards you by your people, ascending into a nascent Warp God, the very representation of humanity within the Warp. While normally interacting with the Materium would be harder due to you becoming a being of the Immaterium, you bypass this issue by having an anchor in the Materium Realm in the form of your physical body.
 
Having become a Divine of Humanity, you can now mark people claiming them as your champions. Those marked by you gain a few benefits without even drawing upon your powers. To start with, by receiving your mark, they now share your nature as an Anathema, becoming the natural counters and predators of the warp and the entities that are born from it. They are now immune to corruption in all of its forms, such as the corruption that comes from being in the presence of Chaos or the degradation of the mind that comes from interacting with the Eldritch. Your champion's presence will damage those born of the Immaterium, their strikes upon warp-born creatures and those corrupted by them will leave wounds that can never be recovered from, erasing a part of their souls with each blow struck. But most importantly, they can bypass the usual issue of Warp entities simply being banished from the Materium for a limited time and needing to reform in the Immaterium; now your Blessed Ones will inflict true death upon those creatures, causing them to never be able to be reborn no matter the circumstances.
 
Your marked ones can draw upon your powers in times of need, and you can grant them boons should you choose to. Which of your powers they can draw upon depends on you; you can create a sort of white-and-black list for which of your powers they can use and which they can't. But what they can draw upon isn't just limited to your strength; they can also draw upon your knowledge, such as how to seal Warp entities and turn them into safe batteries to power their forge or ship or how to wield the Warp in ways only known to you. The boons you can grant are as varied as your abilities, from simple enhanced durability to temporarily wielding a fraction of your might. Finally, for those Champions that accomplish worthy feats in your name, you may help them achieve apotheosis, becoming one of your saints, which is analogous to what Daemon Princes are to the 4 blasphemous ones.
 
The only limit to the number of marks you can grant is your own power; the stronger you are, the more beings you can claim as your champions and the more you can suppress chaos.
objects.title: Star Child (Warhammer: 40k)

addons.text:
What was believed to be forever shattered beyond any hope of recovery has been restored. The tattered remnants known as the WAAGH! have come together, and the true glory of the Krorkian Psychosphere has returned with you as its nexus, connecting with all Greenskins that may exist within your universe, multiplying the power of their individual Waagh-fields manifold, allowing much smaller groups to achieve far more. You can further magnify this effect, turning any Ork into an Oddboy of your choice, or rapidly evolve them into full Krorkhood. You can also evolve Gretchen into highly effective scouts and saboteurs, Snotlings into highly skilled technical, medical and general aides for delicate detail-work, and Squigs into awe-inspiring beasts of burden and war. This means that as all Greenskins in existence flock to your banner to follow your lead, you can quickly shape them into a WAAGH the likes of which has not been seen since the War in Heaven.

This restoration has also affected you directly. Your internal division has mended, Gork and Mork no longer separate. Your sibling has completely fused with you, leaving your state as Gorkamorka permanent. Your second head now no longer contains a independent mind to quarrel and argue with you at the worst times, but a pure extension of yourself as Gorkamorka, the Krorkian Psychosphere incarnated, fully restored.

However, with the restoration of the Psychosphere, something else has also returned: Memory of purpose. You and all Greenskins connected to you remember. You remember what you were made for, what the reason of your existence was. You remember being defenders of life, of waging the most brutal war imaginable with glee and determination so that others might live, so that life has a future. Now what you do with this knowledge, leading the Greenskins back into their old role or embracing the way of life they have turned to while using your new knowledge to refine the best ways to krump any git that comes before you... Well, that's up to you.
addons.title: Restored Throne of the True WAAGH!

objects.text:
Ya ain't no dumb git, ya got da spirit of a proper Krork, straight from da War in Heaven! Standin' tall at over 12 meters, ya make dem Primarchs look puny in comparison. But 'ere's da thing, ya ain't gotta ditch yer 'uman body! Ya can keep yer human form while still possessin' da might of a Krork. 

As a Krork, yer WAAAGH! unleashes a might dat can match a whole planet filled with Orks. From yer mighty self, spores burst forth, growin' into full-grown Krorks in just a few days. An' don't ya worry, even on yer own, ya can recreate any o' dem jaw-droppin' feats dem Orks pulled off durin' da War of da Beast. Ya can WAAAGH! so krumpin' hard, it punches a 'ole through space-time, lettin' ya travel anywhere ya want in a flash. Turn a moon into yer very own FTL ship, smashin' enemies left an' right with yer unstoppable power. Empower yer fist, an' ya can smash continents, reducin' 'em to rubble with a single wallop. Even scraps and trash can be transformed by yer Kustom-Mek skills into devices dat'll give dem zoggin' Necrons a propa fight, jus' like da good ol' days of da War in Heaven.
objects.title: Krork (Warhammer: 40k)

objects.text:
A Pariah is a designation given to a Blank whose Pariah Gene is dominant in their genetic makeup. This allows them to hold no presence within the Warp, thus showcasing no "soul", rendering them nearly immune to Daemonic Possession and other Warp afflictions. Your aura of "otherness" is so powerful that a baseline Human, let alone the psychic attuned, finds it impossible to be in your presence.

With your aura, this can quickly prove to be immediately fatal for any psykers within its area of effect. Unlike Blanks, true Pariahs can also siphon off and thrive on the psychic energy of psykers, breaking the connection between the Warp and the Materium wherever they go.
objects.title: Pariah (Warhammer: 40k)

addons.title: All-Consuming Void
addons.text: Your unheard-of negative psychic aura is bolstered and altered by exposure to your empowered Killing Intent, which in turn has been altered by your Lifehunt, unlocking new and terrible power. Rather than only targeting psychic manifestations, your null aura affects any supernatural effect or being in the same way warp phenomena, daemons & psykers are affected by normal blanks. That is to say, nullifying them and inflicting pain, horror, insanity or injury with your mere presence, to the point of causing lethal backlash with a touch. Mages will stare in horror as their magical senses perceive you as an unnatural black hole in the world, paladins will feel the spiritual terror of having their connection to whatever god they worship brutally ripped away, and even a warper of time and space will be brought screaming back to baseline reality. You could even project a bubble of stable reality around you to survive hostile and alien environments or dimensions. Lifehunt's properties ensure any supernatural entities can be given true death through your null aura, and even beings alien enough to never know fear will learn to do so in your presence. Stronger entities can always overpower your nature, but your Sea of Blood gives you the chance to surpass even them in time with enough slaughter.

objects.text:
Your power as a Null has been elevated beyond the previous maximum rank thought possible, making you the first and only Omega Minus Plus-level Pariah.

Your negative psychic power is so great that it can cover an entire city, and it is so strong that even psykers like Malcador the Sigillite and Magnus the Red would have their psychic power completely nullified in your presence.

Any Chaos Daemon foolish enough to get near you would be instantly obliterated and granted true death by your power. Even Greater Daemons can not resist your anti-psychic might.

Unlike normal Pariahs, you have great control over your power, capable of turning it on or off, dialing its intensity, or even choosing who will be hit with your ability and who will not.
objects.title: Omega Minus Plus Null (Warhammer: 40k)

addons.text:
You now possess the knowledge and mastery of stealth and asymmetrical warfare equal to Corvus Corax, Primarch of the Raven Guard. You are among the stealthiest beings in existence — an unseen predator who strikes swiftly, kills silently, and vanishes without a trace. As your ability to move and kill undetected grows, so too does your talent for leading others in covert operations.

Friend and foe alike will seldom know your true location unless you choose to be found. Attempts to detect your forces or track your fleets will almost always fail, even as you strike with full force. For many, the mere uncertainty of your presence becomes a weapon in itself, spreading fear and dread long before you attack.

You also gain Corvus Corax’s innate psychic ability: The Wraith-Slip. When activated, you can seemingly merge with the shadows themselves. At will, you may vanish from the minds of others; you do not become invisible machines and non-sentient entities can still perceive you, but sentient beings will simply fail to register your existence. Even if you walk past them or stand before them, their minds will refuse to acknowledge you. Should you trigger this ability while already being observed, it will appear as though you have simply ceased to exist.

At the pinnacle of this art, you can become one with the shadows and darkness itself. Your stealth becomes so absolute that should you wish to remain unseen that not even the Primarchs could perceive you.

You can also transform parts or the whole of your body into that of a raven. This transformation will be instantaneous and entirely under your control.
addons.title: The Raven Lord (Warhammer: 40k)

addons.text:
You are a master of demoralization and terror on the same level as Konrad Curze, the Night Hunter. You know every form of torture a Primarch could employ, every way to direct an army to maximize the destruction of enemy morale, and every method for cultivating dread. You can make a foe’s death even in the height of a battle so painful and messy that few would dare challenge you again. Why kill dozens when destroying one can have the same effect?

Your reputation can make so that all but the most inhumanly fearless opponents will choose flight over confrontation. Entire planets would rather surrender than suffer your personal attention. Publicly performed acts of mercy or otherwise uncharacteristically benevolent deeds can weaken this effect; to maintain it, you must avoid becoming known for kindness.

You also inherit Konrad Curze’s innate psychic power of precognition. You can see multiple possible futures, shift between them lightning-quick to detect danger, and select the optimal course of action. In combat, this precognitive ability allows you to predict when and how to dodge, block, counter, or strike. You can outmanoeuvre opponents both physically and strategically before they even make a move. Unlike Konrad Curze, you possess complete control over these visions.
addons.title: King of Terror (Warhammer: 40k)

addons.text: "That was the beauty of the Alpha Legion; it was everywhere, woven into the fabric of the Imperium." Imperial Stormtroopers. The Mor Deythan. The Freemen. All elite units of a faction found in various universes. Once supremely loyal to their chain of command, they have now been subverted by your agents. You can call upon a singular squad of an elite unit, found in the universe you are in, to perform whatever tasks you require of them. From Assassination to cracking open a fortress, they will complete these tasks without questions or complaints. Although it wouldn’t do to put an intelligence gathering unit into the hellscape of frontline combat.
