It also doesn’t stop people from wondering why this unit was completing tasks outside of their remit, but perhaps that's an advantage in itself. Over time, you may call upon more elite units, potentially from other factions, as your agents work to undermine the institutions they work for, if it aligns with your plans. However, you'll never be able to subvert named characters like Paul Atreides, Darth Vader or Nykona Sharrowkyn this way.
addons.title: The Rewards of Treachery

objects.text: “This is my record. And all the records are lies.” Infiltration, covert operations, misdirection, diversions, every manner of asymmetric warfare is known to you on the level of the pinnacle of the Alpha Legion. Information Networks are your bread and butter; You could sustain a network that spans the better part of the galaxy without strain, with your operatives acting with exceptional levels of self-sufficiency towards your goals. Like the Effrit Disruption Cadre, should you kill an army commander, then cohesion within that enemy force shall shatter. Individual units won’t communicate with each other, junior officers won’t step up to the plate, and factionalism will be rampant. This won’t stop you from getting mowed down by a machine gun team, but your adversary's battlefield coordination on the strategic level will be nonexistent. On the precipice of your victory, you may initiate The Harrowing, a culmination of the Alpha Legion’s art of war. Panic, Fear, and confusion are all strategically instilled into the enemy until the breaking point, before a combined arms assault to completely annihilate resistance. In addition to this, the more complex the battle plan, the less likely the enemy combatant is to overcome you. You also gain the Primarch Alpharius’ innate psychic abilities. The first is the ability to give another person an infusion of your blood, and they will be able to both look and act like you. Secondly, you can psychically diminish your presence; this is not true stealth like Konrad Curze or Corvus Corax, but the capacity to render yourself as a person of no consequence. Be careful not to lose yourself in what is true and what is not. You are Alpharius. This is a lie.
objects.title: I am Alpharius (Warhammer: 40k)

objects.text:
Because of their nature as semi-spiritual organs, the extradimensional energy of the Empyrean that suffuses your soul has altered the composition of your Magic Circuits.

These new Warp Circuits act as conduits for psychic energy, allowing you to channel greater amounts of power from the Immaterium without consequences, working in some ways comparable to a Psykana Collar. Your Warp Circuits can also convert excess psychic energy into magical energy, accelerating the regeneration of your Od.

Like normal Magic Circuits, these are an inheritable trait. The Imperium of Man may see this similarly to a Navigator's Warp Eye, an Abhuman mutation granting Psyker abilities.

Your paths as a Psyker and Magus are no longer separate. With time, research and effort, you may truly combine the arts of Sorcery and Magecraft into one.
objects.title: Warp Circuits

objects.text:
You possess a particularly strong Personal Reality and a comprehensive grasp over the phenomena on which your powers are based, resulting both in an increased growth rate and an exceptional talent in utilising your esper ability.

Much like Misaka Mikoto, just through training you can progress to Level 5 in at most a few months. You find it much easier to develop new applications of your power, as calculations for it come naturally, and your brain is more capable of handling the complex math required.

If you are a Gemstone Esper, you have a more in-depth understanding of your powers, which makes it similarly easier to train and develop.

Lastly, you are now capable, under extreme circumstances, of reaching Level 6, although unless you have a way to mitigate this, the power is almost guaranteed to either be completely unstable or result in a loss of personality.
objects.title: The Barrier Between Levels (Raildex)

addons.text:
Your enhanced mental capabilities, together with unprecedented talent for and understanding of your esper abilities, have pushed you to Level 5. You can now be considered a one-man army, with calculation capabilities rivalling that of a supercomputer.

An electromancer-type Level 5, for example, would be easily able to output billions of volts, launch multi-tonne projectiles so fast they are vaporised by air friction near-instantly, or create golems of iron sand hundreds of meters tall.

But what sets apart Level 5 from Level 4 is not simple firepower but unparalleled versatility. As an electromancer, for example, you will not be limited to direct control of lightning for offensive attacks. You could navigate by sensing electric currents, hack technology, fly, and much more.
addons.title: Level 5

objects.text:
You have obtained a much more comprehensive grasp over your own power, as well as elevated mental faculties, allowing you to more easily perform the necessary calculations, thus achieving Level 4.

Your ability has evolved to the point where you can be considered a tactical and strategic asset to an army. Some notable examples include mid-range teleportation or even, at the higher ends, limited recreations of other espers' powers. You may also be capable of temporarily exceeding your current power level and pushing into the level of firepower comparable to the lower end of the Level 5 espers, although you lack the capability to maintain this state safely and for a prolonged period of time.
objects.title: Level 4 (Raildex)

objects.text:
Your abilities have advanced to the point where you are as above most other Level 5 espers as they are above Level 1.

Your calculation capabilities well exceed that of multiple supercomputers, and it would take thousands of lower-level espers worth of processing power to approach an appreciable fraction of your mental prowess.

You can come up  with such complex applications of your power on the spot other Level 5s might have considered them their crowning achievement, and developing the ability to use your power on a planetary scale is only a matter of time. But most importantly, you are now capable of safely reaching Level 6 without the danger of power instability or personality loss, albeit it will still require a great deal of time and effort.

A distinctive feature of your power is an access to a particularly potent defensive application which makes you practically unkillable, like automatic vector shielding, defensive teleportation, or a mentally-networked clone hivemind. Albeit depending on your exact power, this may either  be an instinctive aspect of your power or need to be developed.

Lastly, no matter your power, you will be able to use it to affect practically anything, albeit exotic phenomena such as magic might not react as you expect, and you will need to develop a comprehensive understanding of each new thing you encounter to reliably affect it.
objects.title: The Main Plan (Raildex)

addons.text:
Your ability undergoes a profound metamorphosis. With the enhancement provided by the wings, there is now practically nothing you cannot manipulate; with the right preparation, the very physical and metaphysical laws of the universe can be bent, broken, or rewritten.

The enhancement provided by your angelic form in other aspects is also immense. Not only does your ability lose nearly all of its remaining limitations, but the scale on which you can apply it grows tremendously, to the point that a power that previously extended only a few millimeters around you can now be casually used at a galactic scale.
addons.title: The One Who Has Touched the Territory of God

objects.text:
You have completely mastered your power, obtaining a more thorough understanding than you might have even thought possible before. And now, you enter a new stage of evolution.

You can manifest wings made of unknown, incomprehensible material, which grant an immense boost to your calculation capability and can perform all the necessary math to support the use of your power by themselves, even if your brain is irreparably damaged. Additionally, when manifested, the wings remove some of the limitations from your esper ability. For example, a previously touch-based power might have its range extended to hundreds of metres.

Lastly, through exposure to exotic phenomena, as well as personal development, this state will evolve even further, developing new abilities and removing more restrictions.
objects.title: The One Who Wields the Power of God (Raildex)

addons.text: Your mind had already birthed a Phase of your own, and your body had already ascended into something capable of performing the calculations of a god. Through this combination, it can be said that your existence is an alternative approach to the title of Magic God, arriving at the same destination from the opposite direction. Your Personal Phase and Axiomatic Divinity have merged and synchronized into a single framework, drastically empowering your Phase’s weight. Not only that, but through Multi-Skill’s ability to develop new Esper powers you can expand your Phase’s breadth, eventually turning it into a complete metaphysical system defined by the laws you calculate. As its creator and anchor, you are effectively the Magic God of this domain. More than a normal Magic God however, your absolute ownership of your Phase allows it to effectively “deploy” it, enforcing its rules upon your local reality, introducing new constants and metaphysical rules derived from your calculations.
addons.title: Artificial Theurgy

objects.text: Your esper and psionic abilities coalesced into existence similar to a personal Phase proper. As it originates and is enclosed in the metaphysical landscape of your mindspace, it does not negatively affect the world, as well as cannot be accessed or otherwise interfered with by outside forces without your permission. Nevertheless, as a Phase, it now can serve as a source of power for practices similar to idol theory magic, that allows for the creation of 'spells' based off your esper abilities. A spell is a much more limited, single-purpose imitation of the application of your power. The spells become much harder to create and wield the more calculations the corresponding application of your ability requires. For example, if you possess electromaster-type ability, someone with access to your phase will be able to construct and wield primitive lightning spell rather easily, but something on the level of 'railgun' will require extensive research and practice, as well as deep understanding of the phenomenon behind this. You can grant and revoke access to anyone at any time, or even leave your phase as 'open access', allowing everyone in the world with sufficient knowledge to tap into it. No matter what, as you are the ultimate source from which each and every spell is derived, none of it can ever be used against you directly, with you having ultimate control over every created spell. Moreover, your own knowledge on how to apply your power is constantly updated with the information gained from various spells. If someone discovers a novel way in which your power can be used, creating a technique you havent thought of before, you will automatically be able to replicate the effect to a much greater degree with your actual power. Lastly, if someone delves too deep in research of a specific power of yours, they may slowly reach the status similar to true esper, seemingly obtaining the ability thematically close to their research, as well as their own nature. The power, however, is not truly theirs, rather, it is an accumulation of their experience crystallized as another one of your esper powers and added to your phase. While the one who achieved that power has access to it much deeper than anyone else aside from you, you still can block them from ever accessing it again, although it would be beneficial to you to let them wield and develop this power further.
objects.title: Artificial Magic

objects.text:
You have reached a previously unheard-of stage in the development of your esper abilities. In addition to your usual esper ability, you discovered a novel application of your AIM fields: by essentially making your powers work in reverse, instead of influencing the quantum microworld to produce macro effects like usual, you can now nullify any quantum disturbances.

Due to this development, you can now produce a 'Black Domain' effect: around you and anywhere in the presence of your AIM field this nullifies any esper powers or other reality-warping effects by making the quantum microlayer of reality unreceptive to foreign modulation, unless you allow it, as well as allows your powers to function untethered from any physical and metaphysical laws, imposing their own concept onto reality.

This power can be used offensively as well. By completely halting any change on the micro scale, the macro reality follows suit, thus producing complete Black Domains in which every phenomenon, mundane or esoteric, is frozen in place, in a complete quantum stasis. It is impossible, unless you specifically allow it, to interact with anything inside Black Domains.

No matter what, Black Domains and similar effects cannot affect your powers, and you can utilise both facets of your esper powers simultaneously.
objects.title: Black Domain

addons.text:
Your Imaginary Number District has merged fully into your phase. As such, you are no longer limited to deploying it in one area, as you can now manifest parts of the District wherever you desire, either making a semi-permanent District Area until you decide to collapse it, or only temporary bringing it into the world as a potent reality-stabilising effect.

The effects of the district that allow for the souls of dead espers to be safeguarded there now also have the same reach as your phase, now collecting them across the entire world.
addons.title: City of Shimmers

objects.text:
Using your AIM fields as medium, you can now construct Imaginary Number District, a layer of reality overlapping the real world. By default it will mirror the general features and structures of the area it overlaps, with the exception of living beings, periodically updating to reflect the changes in the real world, but you can freely customise the appearance of the District. You can effortlessly shift between the real world and the District, and any esper visiting the area overlayed by the District will automatically, if you so desire, connect to your Soul Garden and the District, safeguarding their souls should they perish.

With your powers alone, it starts with roughly the size of Tokyo, and the territory covered will increase both as your powers increase and with the addition of new espers, whose AIM fields will help to further propagate the district. When it is first constructed, it will remain in place even if you leave the covered area, although you can, if you wish, completely collapse the District and reconstruct it in another place. If you previously could not, you are now able to use your power anywhere inside the District area from anywhere in the world.

Its main function, aside from being an artificial afterlife for the espers, is to provide protection from various reality-altering phenomena. In passive mode, it will simply negate any reality-warping either originating from or acting upon the District and the area it overlays, aside from the effects you allow. In active mode, the District will start to exude more pressure on reality, resulting in any such action, unless allowed by you, to induce severe backlash in the perpetrator, possibly even killing them, depending on the scale of the action.

Finally, you are now able to create your own artificial angels, beings composed entirely out of the AIM fields. They can have any appearance you desire, as long as it is somewhat humanoid. You can put the soul of an esper inside one or create one from scratch. In case of the latter, you can grant the angel self-awareness and personality, in which case they might even develop their own esper power, make an angel just an extension of your will, piloting it remotely, or anything in-between. All angels, even without their own powers, are nigh-indestructible, with enough strength to crush mountains, and able to utilise energy wings for flight at massively hypersonic speed. Each angel is able to act as a terminal for your powers, if you allow, with those possessing their own esper abilities also able to draw upon your calculation capabilities to raise their powers to your level of strength, if they were not at that level already.

While inside the District or its corresponding territory in the real world, the angels will regenerate instantaneously from any damage, even complete annihilation. But, when leaving the area, they will rely on their 'core', a dense collection of aim fields somewhere inside their body, to maintain their connection to the District and the connection to the soul, which is safely stored inside the Garden, in case the angel had one. If the core is somehow destroyed, the angel will dissipate, although you will always be able to reconstruct them later, with their souls and minds completely intact. All angels can freely teleport to any place inside the District itself and the area it covers. You have a telepathic connection with each angel and can summon them instantly to your side.

Do note that sometimes espers, whose souls reside inside the Imaginary Number District will be able to create somewhat similar bodies for themselves to reappear in the real world. The stronger the esper, the higher concentration of AIM fields they produce, the stronger their angel-like body will be, with strongest level 5 espers almost rivalling your angels in pure strength and durability.
objects.title: Imaginary Number District (Raildex)

addons.text:
You have gone further than what the SYSTEM ever intended. Your nature as a budding Ein Sof and living Axiom has fully synchronized with your ascension, merging your light with your transcendent existence to create something fundamentally beyond comprehension.

You have managed to assimilate not only a full understanding of science, magic, and divinity, but also the fundamental principles by which any and all phenomena may occur.

You can create, change, and destroy axioms—the fundamental, self-evident truths that define the most basic logic of existence, from which all is derived. 

As such, this allows you to essentially redefine the rules of logic from the ground up. 

You may create an infinite number of phases, destroy all and return everything to the pure world or even establish a new cosmic hierarchy
addons.title: Tzimtzum

objects.text:
The SYSTEM’s goal is to understand the will of the heavens. To achieve it, the SYSTEM must find a human who surpasses humanity—an existence with a body beyond human limits, capable of performing God’s calculations. Though you have not attained such a state just yet, you have managed to carve your own path. 

The esoteric nature of your wings and the computational supremacy of your mind have catapulted your esper ability beyond the constraints of mortality and into the realm of divinity. 

Your control over your Personal Reality is so fundamental that there is no distinction between it and the real world. You can influence and manipulate reality on a seemingly universal scale, down to its most fundamental level. 

You now rival the capabilities of a Magic God, achieving physical godhood through sheer calculation. You may command and change the laws of the world at your leisure, and even enforce new metaphysical principles.

To contain such power, your body undergoes a forced transformation. You have forsaken your mortal form, taking on an alien appearance—like a human-shaped starry sky. This change is the price of housing something that was only dreamed of by the scientific side of the world. Although you may reassume a human appearance, any damage to it will reveal your true form underneath.
objects.title: Axiomatic Apotheosis

objects.text:
You arise from the Sunken Depths—a realm of collective unconscious, your true form takes shape—an entity made of thoughts, yet tainted by it's darkness, and turned into an Eldritch TRUTH. Through this, you can effortlessly command the shadows of the collective unconscious, shape thought constructs, summon formless horrors, assume mysterious disguises, and dispatch ethereal messengers. These shadows corrupt all they touch, but you can choose to suppress or embrace the corruption. The darkness that once tainted you now grants you control over the shadows.

Connected to fear and hysteria, you wield the power to invoke AFRAID—an overwhelming emotion that leaves others helpless. Specific fears and phobias become weapons, crippling your foes. Yet your true form, the complete TRUTH, devoid of shadows, is a mind-shattering horror beyond even the strongest will.

Invincible you are not, but your resilience renders brute force futile. Attempts to alter or erase you prove futile, as the TRUTH within rapidly unravels such changes. Reality distortion struggles to violate your existence, even banished you will always return. 

Boundaries hold no power over you as the TRUTH sets you free, granting passage through boundaries and effortless traversal of worlds. The darkness beneath the Abyss and similar realms of chaos become your dominion, unhindered by their perils.

Unveiling ancient forbidden truths, linked to the origins of the world, beckon you as shadows guide you toward their elusive secrets—fragments of a forgotten primordial TRUTHS long buried. Over time, you can intertwine and blur the line between reality and the Sunken Depths, allowing you to transform others into your vessels, trap the unwary to stumble through, and cast your silhouettes into every corner of reality.
objects.title: TRUTHS BEST FORGOTTEN (Omori)

objects.text:
Your mind has transcended its previous limits, as it now operates like a quantum computer capable of processing data at an unprecedented scale, far surpassing even the world's greatest supercomputers. Your mental prowess now extends to all things related to numbers, and through it, you gain the ability to simulate and analyse any scenario, even peering into the future with near absolute accuracy. With this, you can identify weak points, sense the surrounding area through vibrations, measure things perfectly with a glance, leverage your strength perfectly, effortlessly estimate your target's height, weight, age, muscle mass, and even predict their actions and thoughts. You can also use this to determine whether there are traps around you or detect the presence of external substances such as poisons.

With this newfound capability, you can peer into the future, foreseeing events with astonishing precision. While your predictions remain incredibly accurate, over 99.9%, within a span of a few weeks, calculating further into the future requires an extensive amount of data gathered to achieve higher than a 66.6% level of accuracy.

In addition to your advanced calculations and predictions, you discover the ability to apply Laplace's to yourself. By invoking this technique, you enter a profound state of contemplation, within which you are able to instantly assess the entirety of knowledge within your mind.

At the pinnacle of your power, when you unleash Laplace to its fullest extent, the floodgates of sensory information burst wide open. Your five senses become augmented, granting you unparalleled understanding of your surroundings. You can perceive the movements, conversations, expressions, and even the heartbeats of vast numbers of people within an entire city. No detail eludes you as you navigate through the intricate tapestry of existence.
objects.title: Laplace Determinism (Darwin's Game)

objects.text:
Your writing reaches a new level. To a limited degree, you can write about reality around you, changing it as to write. You can cause people to act out as your characters, and turn the world into your story.

But there is a restriction. To use this power, your writing must be flawless. Plot Holes, OOCs, forced events or any other amateurish writing failures will not be tolerated. Should you make any of these mistakes, your power strain against you, unwilling to create a second rated story
objects.title: The World Writer

addons.text: Your journal will also act as your diary which will reflect the reality from your own viewpoint, even having captions of yourself. Also, your diary having perfect accuracy will reduce the strain of your attempts to change history, and it will also allow you to change other details within your journal, like the favored resting place of a beast in your bestiary section, the entrance of a ruin on your map or even the number of sweet rolls you consumed.
addons.title: Self-Updating Chronicle

objects.text: Now your writing can also reach into the past in the form of writing a diary, which will allow you to edit minor or eventually major details in it, which will also rewrite both the diary and the past to reflect the changes you made. The world itself will resist your attempts to change history depending on the scale of the changes; undoing an injury or correcting a minor mistake is easy, but straight up removing a major “enemy” like an Endbringer from the diary would be extremely taxing and near impossible.
objects.title: The Diary of Lady Murasaki

objects.text:
The lines between what's real and what's fictional has become beautifully blurred around you! 

With this, your ability to manifest your dreams into reality reaches astounding heights. Imagination becomes tangible around you, as your wildest fantasies and desires take shape in the waking world. Whether it's whimsical landscapes, otherworldly creatures, or fantastical inventions, your dreams now have the power to transcend the realm of fiction and materialize around you.

But that's not all. In a heartwarming twist, you can now summon your cherished imaginary friends into the real world. Those delightful companions you once conjured solely in your mind are now real, tangible beings with personalities and feelings of their own. They become your faithful allies, and their presence infuses your reality with a sense of magic and camaraderie.

The dreamscape intertwines seamlessly with reality, creating a captivating blend of the fantastical and the concrete. This integration allows you to venture on extraordinary adventures, where every step takes you deeper into a realm of enchantment.
objects.title: Playground of Wonders and Imaginations

objects.text:
This is a talent, a talent of a Genius.

With it, you can employ all of your skills in the most efficient manner, fully entrusting your instincts to continuously fight on even when unconscious. Your body becomes a conduit for strategic analysis, adapting to your opponent's strengths with uncanny precision. Every skill within you is drawn out effortlessly, as you fight without hesitation or falter. At its peak, this ability can be used even when awake, allowing you to match the likes of the Shiro Oni.
objects.title: Ultra Instinct (PTJ Verse)

objects.text: You harness primal instincts, embodying the ferocity and survival drive of untamed creatures. In battle, you adopt a mindset rooted in the primal law of "kill or be killed." Every strike is aimed to maim or kill, employing ruthless tactics like biting or clawing your opponent. Even if you have the ability to copy or mimic the moves of others, you will subconsciously alter it into a more lethal and ruthless version. Guided by an acute danger perception and precognition, you anticipate and swiftly counter your opponent's every move with unparalleled precision. Your ferocity, unpredictable nature, resourcefulness and resilience are increased exponentially. Once mastered, you can stand toe-to-toe with the likes of Tom Lee, the Fighting Genius.
objects.title: Wild Instinct (PTJ Verse)

addons.text: Your knack for copying has merged with your Copy talent, emerging as something beyond this world, almost otherworldly. Technique Copy and Physical Copy have been assimilated into a transcendent power, Perfect Copy. There's no more distinction between Technique and Physical Copy. Perfect Copy does everything that they'd do and more. Upon seeing a move or a physique, it's perfectly copied and internalized, with even the subtlest nuances of whatever you're observing replicated seamlessly, like micro-movements, muscle twitches, etc. It's like your opponent's fighting a perfect mirror of their every move. You've broken through the limitation of needing specific training to copy certain fighting styles or techniques; one look is enough for you to copy it as if it were just a normal move. You can now copy moves like Taesoo Ma's Hard Fist and special fighting styles akin to the 1st Generation's and 0th Generation's. To put this into perspective, you can copy moves and fighting styles like Water Stream Rock Smashing Fist and Whirlwind Iron Cutting Fist with just a glance, negating the need for prior training to use them, thanks to Perfect Copy. However, the spiritual and esoteric aspects of your copied moves are still beyond you. Things like Gongseob Ji's domain of One Step, Taesoo Ma's Ultimate Fist, and Jaegyeon Na's Death Kick can be copied as easily as any other move, but their strength, speed, and overall "quality" are lesser than the original. This is because you haven't achieved a certain Mastery as they did, leading to a flawed result despite being a perfect copy. But if you did achieve it, then there's no more degradation of copied moves, as they're true perfect copies now. This goes true with things like Ki, Chakra, Haki, Reiryoku, etc. You need to have the same prerequisites that a copied move has; otherwise, it risks being "flawed". You don't have to be in person to copy something, not with Perfect Copy. For example, seeing the movements of a boxing legend on TV is enough for you to copy them as if you were there in person, witnessing them.
addons.title: Perfect Copy

addons.text: The rate at which you learn new techniques is off the charts, with any moves you copy being brought to their maximum potential and mastery right off the bat. Even learning an inferior version of a technique allows you to master it in a heartbeat, surpassing the teacher. Your knowledge of these techniques surpasses basic understanding, as you instinctively calculate the physics and timing behind your moves. You learn the entire evolution of how and why that move got to the point where it is. Your mind also makes up for the difference in body types, adapting the move to be as usable as possible in your current body, whatever it may be. You'd be able to replicate techniques just through similarities from techniques you already know, so long as they're at least a little bit common. Not only that, but your talent has been boosted further than before. You could learn a spell just by seeing someone cast it once, no matter how complex the spell is, or watch a master artist paint and copy their skills, becoming a master artist yourself, just like that. You copy things even if they didn't show you; in a fight, entire fighting styles your opponent hasn't used against you are unraveled beneath your gaze. Analyzed, internalized, optimized, and harnessed to its fullest potential within the blink of an eye. Fight Johan Seong, and you could use every single move that he's seen throughout his life as your own, even if he didn't show them all to you, and then perfect them in a way that they're overall more powerful and efficient than the original. Fight James Lee, and you can not only copy his grace and fighting style but also his "Invisible Attacks", and then perfect it so that they're truly invisible. Fight Goku, and you can copy the Kaio-Ken from him, even though he never once used that technique in front of you, as well as the rest of his techniques, Ki or not. You would be capable of flight, Instant Transmission, Solar Flare, and more within seconds of the fight, and then perfect them in a way that their Ki usage are reduced to near-zero. Fight Whis, and start effortlessly dodging his attacks as you copy the mindset and technique of Autonomous Ultra Instinct from him, then jumping straight to the perfected version mid-fight. If you have Perfect Copy, then I pity whoever stands in your way. You're now the ultimate Copycat, so much so that you can copy what should be unique to your opponent. In the PTJ Verse, you would be able to copy the Paths that Legends walk, something unique to them that no one else can attain, and bring them to the next level. You can copy Johan's Path as he's using it and start teleporting; copy Daniel's and you could achieve true precognition, etc. There's nothing stopping you from further walking down the Paths than their original users and the same goes true with other copied abilities. However, despite everything, you're still bound by your body; as a human, you can't copy Goku's Super Saiyan forms as you aren't a Saiyan, for example. Ultimate Prodigy lets you skip the blood, sweat, and tears to achieve complete mastery right off the bat just from seeing someone use it. For example, having Shrine, you can copy whatever Sukuna does with it including the WCS just by seeing it. If you have Legend's power, whatever Legend does with it, you can copy it. If you have Chakra, then you'll make the Sharingan's ability to copy jutsu absolutely obsolete compared to you. If you have Ki, then anything anyone does with Ki, you can do it too. As long as you have the prerequisite to something, you can copy it; otherwise, you can only make its closest equivalent using your existing skills, knowledge, powers, and/or abilities.
addons.title: Ultimate Prodigy

objects.text: A very unique and a one-in-a-million talent, present in less than a handful of fighters across three generations. This talent is so rare that only six people in all of the PTJ Verse have shown or been mentioned to have it. This talent allows its user to perfectly replicate in a 1:1 way the movement that's been observed. Furthermore, copying isn't limited to whoever originally possessed the technique or fighting style; if someone with Copy meets another who also has Copy, both of them can copy each other's moves. Thus, this talent makes people extremely dangerous, as they can increase their strength while fighting powerful opponents, copying every move with just a glance and returning them to their opponent either 1:1 or improved. The difference between this talent and simple imitation is that a fighter who does what their opponent just did is not necessarily someone who has Copy. The former is a cheap imitation, while the latter is the real deal, improving or even perfecting inferior moves they might've copied, making it better than the original if possible. You have the latter. Two types of the Copy talent have been granted to you. Technique Copy and Physical Copy. The standard copy and the copy of an individual's physique. Technique Copy is exactly as stated above: it allows you to perform and perfectly execute a movement you've seen. However, certain fighting styles or techniques that require specific training might render it difficult to copy. Your body must at least be capable of performing the copied move, or else your body might not keep up, leading to possible injury or the move not having the intended strength, speed, etc. The second type of Copy changes things. Physical Copy allows you to imitate the physique of anyone you've encountered for a short period, as long as their strength is biological and not something spiritual/esoteric like Ki, Chakra, Haki, Reiryoku, etc. Unless you do have those things; if so, then you can copy it along with the physique. The stronger the physique, the less time you have in this form before your body crumbles, as the physique might be so powerful that you can only use it for 10 seconds or three attacks. This can be mitigated with enough training and experience; however, there can be some physiques that are so strong that no amount of training can extend their duration. Therefore, it's extremely dangerous to try to go beyond the limits of this type of Copy, as when you do, it feels like your body's shattering and breaking into pieces.
objects.title: Copy (PTJ Verse)

objects.text:
Sometimes, the best way to solve your problem is not to beat your opponent into the ground but to have a genuine, heartfelt conversation with them. With this power, your supernatural charisma is boosted even further, making you capable of talking sense into even the most vile, tormented, and twisted people, changing their entire worldview with just a speech. Convincing them to see the error of their way converts them into seeing things your way, even overwriting any master effect they might have been under. This would only work if the following condition is met:
  • You must have in-depth and personal knowledge of the person you are trying to convince.
  • You must have defeated your opponent or have an 80% chance or above of beating them.
  • You truly believe they can change and become a better individual.
objects.title: Talk no Jutsu

objects.text:
Your charisma has reached those psyches unstained and yet to be broken, unyielding in the middle of an unforgiving world. These characters aren’t necessarily paragons of virtue; nevertheless, they’re admirable in the moral fiber or mettle to defy the world’s unfairness. This can result in stubbornness and a certain pushback against other people concerning their ideals and principles. That is, until they meet you.

Your usual magnetism of comfort shifts into an aura of understanding, a feeling of being a kindred spirit in their eyes, seeing in you a formidable ally.

You need to prove your grit, though, as folks like this must affirm their hopes and dreams through adversity. Among the many ways you can demonstrate this, it always depends on the person’s line of work and personality, ranging from pushing them to admit defeat in a court case to an outright fight to the death. At the climax of this struggle, they come to realize the depths of your desires and goals, now recognizing a peer every time they gaze upon you. Following this, you become the “sibling” they can’t let go, a solace in someone helping them in accomplishing dreams, theirs and yours.

While retaining your previous insights and abilities, your skills that turn anyone into a terrific contender to fight against develop more into a connection made in balance. The unbroken can temper the twisted, acting as a stabilizing element within the fighting unit and pushing them all to develop and grow beyond their demons, further bolstering your fighting unit.
objects.title: I Understand, I Keep Moving Forward

addons.text: Wherever you go, you leave behind more than just inspiration—you leave the road forward. People don’t just feel the urge to improve themselves near you; they see how. Your presence dispels the fog of doubt and confusion in others, letting them catch real glimpses of the person they could be, and the path it might take to get there. It’s not about perfection, it’s about clarity—about knowing there’s something worth striving for, and that it’s not out of reach. More than that, the world itself begins to agree with you. Fate bends slightly around those you’ve touched, subtly shifting to guide them forward. The lost stumble across books they need. The unsure find themselves in the right place at the right time. It’s never dramatic—but it’s consistent. Progress isn’t just a dream—it becomes possible, likely, and even natural. And when someone begins to grow under your light, that growth doesn’t stop with them. People who’ve been moved by you begin to carry a fragment of that spark. They speak with a little more hope. They listen with a little more heart. Their change plants the seed for others, even long after you’ve left. Your words echo in decisions they make years later. Your presence ripples forward in time, quietly, relentlessly. The fire you lit in one heart becomes a constellation across a lifetime, each star reminding the world: you were here.
addons.title: Guiding Flame

objects.text: You don’t just lead people anymore. You don’t just inspire them to stand, or dream, or keep going. Now, your very presence becomes a mirror—one that shows them a glimpse of the person they could be. Not just stronger, not just smarter, but better in every sense of the word. Kinder, wiser, braver, calmer. You ignite a longing within others to become their own ideal self, even if they never realized they had one. This doesn’t happen through speeches alone. You don’t need to convince them—they convince themselves. Being near you plants the seed, but when you offer encouragement, support, or even just a knowing smile, that spark blooms faster. Whether it’s a warrior seeking peace, a failure finding pride, or a villain remembering who they once were, your influence wraps around them like a quiet promise: you can be more. And that promise holds weight. As long as someone you’ve touched doesn’t give up, they will, one way or another, become their best self. The path may twist. They may fall. But they will rise again, and every time they do, they are closer to that version of themselves they long for—even if what they believe is best changes along the way, or isn’t quite what they expected at all. You don’t give people strength. You remind them it was always theirs. You don’t give them dreams. You remind them they’re worth chasing. You are the steady star in their sky, the reason they take one more step when they think they can’t. You are not just their leader anymore. You are the light they follow.
objects.title: The Light They Follow

objects.text: An Ultimate Talent well beyond those granted by the aforementioned Ultimate Talent power, this is a genetic mutation that turns the irises of your eyes red and grants you monstrous analytical capabilities to the point of being capable of predicting the future, creating Ultimate Talents such as becoming an Ultimate Fashionista through predicting and setting trends, and replicating the abilities of other Ultimate Talents through simple observation, with merely their peak abilities being beyond that ease. Of course, getting to this level will require some practice, and it does come with the drawback of inevitable boredom; however, this won't necessarily make you into a monster like Junko Enoshima, given the example of Hajime Hinata as the Ultimate Hope.
objects.title: Ultimate Analyst (Danganronpa)

objects.text: Rather than simply having one talent, you have every talent known to man at the level of an Ultimate Talent, as well as the talent of the Ultimate Analyst, complete with the noticeably red eyes. Naturally, there exists the risk of constant boredom, losing your empathy, and becoming a monster to a higher degree than that of the Ultimate Analyst; however, given the example of Hajime Hinata, it is possible to keep your empathy, perhaps not easily, but possible.
objects.title: Ultimate Hope (Danganronpa)

objects.text:
You have become a True Jedi/Sith, surpassing all who have lived for you alone have assimilated and gained access to every skill and ability from whichever Holocron you chose to merge with your being. Your knowledge encompasses everything that the Jedi/Sith have ever documented, even that which was lost to your respective order.

For the Sith, your encyclopaedic knowledge of Sith Alchemy and Sorcery allows you to twist and command the Force to do things that may be considered "unnatural".

For the Jedi, this encompasses lost techniques like the ability to shield others from Dark Side possession, Battle Meditation, Force Light, and the ability to sever the Force's connection with living beings (non-lethally, of course). It should be reminded that many techniques that don't have strong connections to either side of the Force are available to both the Sith and the Jedi.
objects.title: The Force is With Me (Star Wars)

objects.text:
Each time you take this you lose 2000 midichlorians, or the equivalent there-of, in your power with the Force.

Additionally, with each selection your physical attributes and lightsaber skill weaken commensurably.

Alternatively, you may choose to weaken some portion more to leave another proportionally undiminished.

Taking this all 15 times leaves you with no lightsaber skills to speak of, no physical enhancements, and no connection to the force, making you slightly resistant to it, but things have a tendency to just not work out for you.
objects.title: The Weak (Star Wars)

addons.text: Evenly tied to both the Light and Dark, you are a living monument to the idea of Balance in the Force, vastly expanding your power. Such is your strength that you could create an entire world and separate it from time, allowing time to pass within at an accelerated rate, or erase someone’s memories with but a touch, regardless of their mental strength.
addons.title: The Father

addons.text:
You have drunk from the Font of Power and bathed in the Pool of Knowledge and been transformed, becoming a scourge, a blight on the galaxy, a living font of the Dark, wielding enough power to single-handedly conquer entire star systems. 

Your psychic prowess is even greater, enough that your influence can beguile people across an entire galaxy, even sharing knowledge with them to increase your pawns’ strength. You are capable of possessing others, even multiple people at once. You are also capable of stealing the lifeforce and power of others, consuming their essence and growing stronger.

Even from the beginning, you are strong enough in the Force to affect people across an entire star system or craft Force-imbued objects capable of effects such as influencing others. Given time to grow power, you can eventually become strong enough that you can manifest in multiple places at once and have your mere presence alter physical reality, such as causing lava flows.
addons.title: The Mother

addons.text: Your nature as a Force Entity has intrinsically tied your essence to that of your planet, your own personal Wellspring. Due to being connected to an effectively infinite source of Force energy, your power has skyrocketed, effortlessly able to influence events in entirely different star systems. Lastly, due to binding your essence to the Wellspring itself,  you cannot die so long as it remains. If you ever perish, you’ll simply reform at the heart of the Wellspring, the core of your world.
addons.title: Guardian of the Wellspring

objects.text: Through the Force, you have transcended your mortality and became more. You are now a Force Entity tied to the side of the Force your Holocron represents, being a Light Side Entity if you chose Great Holocron and a Dark Side Entity if you chose Telos Holocron. As a Force Entity tied to a specific side of the Force, all possible permutations of that side are open to you, with every possible usage of the Light or Dark being at your fingertips, respectively. By your very nature, you are immortal, existing amongst the Force itself with no fixed material form and being unable to die outside of specific circumstances, such as being stabbed by a dagger designed specifically to harm immortals. Your formless and ethereal nature allows you to assume any physical form you desire and manifest wherever you choose, seemingly teleporting or even appearing directly in the dreams of others. As a manifestation of a side of the Force, you can grow in strength via the actions of others if they align with your side, with a Dark Side Entity growing stronger as others commit dark deeds. Lastly, you can bestow the ability to use the Force upon others.
objects.title: Child of Mortis (Star Wars)

objects.text:
You are more than just a user of the Force. Like Anakin Skywalker, you are its child, and for you, that specifically means something. Every layer of your essence is interwoven with the Force, such that it and you can never be separated simply because you carry a piece of it wherever you go, rendering your usage of the Force independent from Midichlorians and immune to any form of suppression, with no limit existing for how much power you can draw from the Force save for the risk of burning yourself out.

Lastly, as its beloved child, the Force is simply more helpful for you than others. It warns you of danger and lies without prompting, generally trying to assist you however it can.
objects.title: Child of the Force (Star Wars)

addons.text:
Mastery over the subtle and stranger parts of the force have coupled with your talents for them, letting you not only articulate sorceries like never before but create new and bespoke branches. 

Able to speak to people from across the galaxy, reprogram ships and droids through the force, with time you could even transform yourself into a Wound in the force not unlike Darth Nihilus, or stronger and stranger beings. You can even perform rituals to sever someone from the force or form Force Bonds at will.
addons.title: Look Into The Wellspring

addons.text: You can now use the Void and Flame to minimise the corruption you’ll suffer from the darker sorceries, burning it and it’s impulses away as you become free from its influence.
addons.title: Walk The Tightrope

objects.text:
You have an unnatural talent for ‘Magick’ and force sorceries. From those used by the Nightsisters of Dathomir to Sith Alchemy.

Force sorceries are not bound to Light and Dark like more conventional and rote abilities, instead drawing from the living tapestry and surroundings. This however makes it far more unpredictable, and difficult to guide and teach without surrendering yourself to it at least partially.

The Nightsisters for instance almost completely lost themselves over their lives becoming puppets to the harsh and dark energies in Dathomir’s force, though able to create dolls that transmitted pain across the galaxy, creating life from sand, and binding their souls to locations with relative ease. 

Within this however are many pathways that can be discovered. Sith Alchemy was minimally corruptive, and produced leviathan living machines of warfare, translation amulets, and bespoke viruses only through its manipulation. 

It’s a dangerous path to walk, but the results can be quite attractive.
objects.title: Many Abilities One Would Consider… Unnatural (Star Wars)

addons.text: Now, in addition to realities formed from the target’s deepest desires, you can instead form them from their deepest fears. These nightmare realities are equally as real as the Black Mercy’s paradises.
addons.title: Red Mercy

objects.text:
The shaping of dreams has evolved further to emulate the alien plant, the Black Mercy. This evolution has turned your dreams from mere fantasies you can inflict into entire realities.

The primary feature of the Black Mercy is that by probing the pleasure centers of the target’s mind, a nearly perfect world is created for the victim while their psychic energy is harvested and pulled back to you. During this, the victim is entirely paralyzed while they’re transported into the reality, and can only escape after noting small inconsistencies and actively willing themselves awake.

The true power of the Black Mercy, however, is that these are not illusions, not Dreams, but full realities that are created and projected from the victim’s desires. Every wife, child, street cleaner, cat or tree, all created and real as the ‘waking’ world. By waking up, they ultimately doom this reality to nothingness.
objects.title: Black Mercy (DC Comics)

objects.text:
Your Vibe powers have been upgraded to gain some more comic-accurate Cisco Ramon Vibe abilities. First off, whenever external tears across space, time, and reality emerge, your abilities grow stronger with each breach and incursion, giving you more control over your abilities. 

Your vibing ability has been enhanced to also innately sense inter-dimensional energy signatures, allowing you to feel when and where an excursion from a different dimension is either occurring or emanating from. Alongside this increase in sensitivity to inter-dimensional energy, it has also gained a sensitivity to time, which manifests as a powerful touch-based retrocognition that, at full power, can even effectively read the full past of a person. While this sensitivity to time has granted some precognition-based aspects, they only manifest when said events have inter-dimensional energy involved, have to deal with large-scale multi-versal events or large-scale time travel.

Not only are your vibrational blasts in general far stronger, but they are also far better at disrupting something's connection to dimensions or its dimensional abilities, and possibly even semi-permanently if you become powerful enough and the person has enough repeated exposure. But if the target has a strong enough connection to the dimension or its dimensional abilities, then it becomes nigh-impossible to affect them semi-permanently. Lastly, you now have more control over your vibrational manipulation, allowing you to do more than just blast from your hands, but this takes time and mastery to effectively use.
objects.title: Comic Vibe (DC Comics)

objects.text:
You now possess the ability to extend an astonishing ten thousand Unseen Hands simultaneously from your body, with an expanded range of up to 100 kilometers.

These hands are now intricately connected to the life force of all things, so in addition to their inherent destructive power, each hand possesses the ability to siphon the life force when in physical contact with a living being, and then transfer that life force to the user to either heal them or to enhance the overall strength of the hands, as per the user's intention. The targeted individual experiences extreme weakening as their life force is drained, as they shrivel and wither rapidly, leading to their expiration. The more the target is exposed to additional hands, the quicker the siphoning process, hastening their demise. Your Unseen Hands have also gained a high resistance towards psychic attacks of all forms.

You can choose at will whether the Unseen Hands engage in siphoning the life force of others.
objects.title: Ten Thousand Hands of Avalokiteshvara

objects.text:
A malevolent curse has tainted your Unseen Hands, transforming them into instruments of potent poison and malignant diseases.

Now, in addition to their inherent destructive power, each hand possesses the ability to infect a target with a myriad of rapidly acting diseases upon physical contact. Similar to venom injected through the poisonous fangs of a viper, these diseases will induce severe vertigo, convulsions, muscle paralysis, searing pain, internal hemorrhages, and organ failure within minutes of contact. If left untreated, the target is almost certain to expire within hours. The more the target is exposed to additional hands, the higher the dosage in their system, hastening their demise.

As the user, you are completely immune to the diseases carried by these hands, and you can choose at will whether the hands inject the diseases when in contact with others.
objects.title: Virulent Hands

addons.text:
Your ability to channel your Miasma through your hands has given rise to a new and more sinister application of it. When puppeting a living being, you can choose to flood them with your Miasma, twisting and warping their body and soul into a form more suited for your control.

This lessens the amount of exertion needed to control something, but is usually accompanied by physical mutations that turn the victim into a caricature of what they once were. Additionally, you can use your Authority through beings with your Miasma, allowing you to act from afar.
addons.title: Reshaping

objects.text:
With this upgrade, your Unseen Hands gain a new functionality, which is the ability to puppet things. At will, you can make a hand become out of phase with reality, embedding itself into something spiritually as opposed to physically.

By embedding a hand in something, you gain the ability to puppeteer it, controlling its movements as you see fit. However, there is a slight catch, that being that your control can be resisted. Of course, this catch can be mitigated as the influence each hand can exert is relative to the physical force it can exert, so combining hands increases the control you can exert through a hand.

While a single hand is enough to puppet inanimate objects or those weaker than you, beings of sufficient willpower or those equal to or greater than you in strength can require many more hands to control them, with a power gap in particular requiring exponentially more hands to bridge.
objects.title: Puppeteer

objects.text:
Now, with your consent, a hell mode can be activated for this power. In hell mode, whenever the facsimile successfully eliminates the target, it gains the ability to assume the target's body for one hour. The duration of this possession, as well as the revival time for the target, increases by one hour each time the facsimile kills the target. Conversely, each time the target defeats the facsimile, this duration decreases by one hour. If the target manages to kill the facsimile precisely at the one-hour mark, the influence of this power is entirely broken, as initially intended.

During the period of body assumption, the target is compelled to experience their life silently through the perspective of the facsimile, rather than facing the typical darkness associated with death.

Naturally, the loyalty of the facsimile is inherently unswerving and entirely devoted to you. However, it's important to note that, given the enigmatic nature of facsimiles, they inherently possess psychopathic tendencies, often exhibiting high levels of manipulation and sadism. You have the ability to deactivate hell mode at your discretion.
objects.title: Facsimile Override

objects.text:
Your mastery over both body and mind now reaches unprecedented heights, allowing you to even develop other types of mutations seen in the Alphas Show. The complexity of these mutations determines the time and margin for error in their growth, effectively making you start from Zero on the parts used in case of failure.

Mutations based on or related to HyperKinect and HyperCognitive abilities, such as Hyperadrenal or Elastic Alphas, will develop more stably and rapidly compared to entirely new mutations like Acid Generator or Influencer Alphas.
objects.title: Hyper Alphas

addons.text: Seeing as your Aura reserves are already functionally limitless, thanks to the unending abyss of energy within, the font of Plasma filling you - now also enhanced by that abyss - has been redirected purely to bolstering your Aura: The enhancement granted by it has escalated from just half-again in every aspect to a two-times multiplier for individual facets (or a reduction to half, for negative aspects). In addition, the growth speed of your Aura’s potency and the depth of its reserves has doubled as well.
addons.title: Plasma Surge

objects.text: Your body has been permanently suffused through and through with Plasma, the unique atmospheric energy that once filled Vilete and gave its denizens such strong Auras, ensuring their rule. Due to this constant exposure, the rate at which you replenish your Aura reserves at has utterly skyrocketed, such that what would’ve taken a few hours to fully recover now only takes a few minutes. On top of that, the energy now filling your body now enhances every facet of your Aura abilities by half-again (or reduced by one-third, in the case of negative aspects). While this might not seem like such a massive increase on the surface, this boost applies to each part of your abilities individually, such as power, speed, range, and so on, making it a fairly substantial boost. Furthermore, this boost and increased regeneration also applies to a lesser degree to any magical and psychic powers you possess, enhancing them by about half of your Aura’s benefits. As a free cosmetic bonus, you also gain a faint reddish-pink glow of Plasma around your body to signify this power, scaling in intensity with your Aura potency, and may dye all of your Aura abilities with this same color.
objects.title: Plasma Infusion (Timespinner)

addons.text: The endless wellspring within has further synergized with your supercharged Plasma reserves, amplifying the strength and reach of the Plasma-infused air around you even more. The base radius of your Charged Aura has skyrocketed from just the size of a house to roughly a mile in diameter, with your control over it similarly expanding to being able to exclude entire locations, and within its original range it has become especially condensed and potent, instead granting the effects of Plasma Surge rather than Plasma Infusion. And as one last bonus, this last increase in your Plasma’s strength has enhanced your Aura once again, to a staggering three-times stronger in all positive aspects, or a reduction to one-third for negatives.
addons.title: Charged Environment

objects.text: The well of Plasma inside you has grown even stronger, now: Rather than just being confined to your body, it now radiates outwards into your surroundings, creating a literal aura of Plasma energy around you that not only further strengthens yourself, but also any mages and psychics in your vicinity. You can selectively control who in your Plasma-aura receives this benefit, being able to exclude others from its boost at-will. Starting as roughly the size of a suburban house to begin with and scaling upwards as you train your Aura, the haze of Plasma surrounding you not only further enhances your own potency, increasing the baseline boost from half-again to two times, but also augments other magic/psychic-users in your radius, granting them the effects of Plasma Infusion for as long as they stay within. Additionally, those repeatedly or continually exposed to this Plasma energy may find themselves developing Aura of their own, though this takes quite a long time.
objects.title: Charged Aura (Timespinner)

addons.text:
"Living is an exercise of violence. Exercise of violence is the fate of living."

"Violence is circular. Perception is not circular and lacks flawlessness-therefore, rejoice in imperfect things, for their rareness is not lacking!"

"Reach heaven through violence."

Attained through clarity of mind and soul, you meditated upon the act of murder and have found enlightenment, a bodhisattva of violence, the wheel-smashing lord of the dharma of murder. All life is equal under your gaze, for all life is equal under the blade.

For violence, may one find the purpose of life, for all things return to violence. Its circular act grants you insight to extend your focus to everything you do. Constantly in a state of outward contemplative meditation, whether in combat or out of it. Mind and body move concisely as one, actions made with no delay, no hesitation, unnervingly precise, with unfailing control, towards the singular goal of parting your opponent's ghost from their corpse. The unlocking of one's mind's eye furthers one's insight into the principles of all things, peering beneath the veil of reality, all motion, all truths, all lies, captured within your eyes, mind calculating the best possible course of action to make ghosts from men, disregarding everything else that may distract you from completing this goal, a single-minded focus towards violence.

Once per battle, you may recite the Lotus Sutra to cleanse your mind of all adverse effects, rejuvenate your fighting spirit, and strengthen your willpower.

The unveiling of your purpose, your dharma, has forced an evolution of your combat prowess. The creation of new techniques, martial styles of both weapon or empty-handed, to spells and mantras, now comes naturally to you. They fit perfectly for whatever role you created them, easily integrating into your fighting style. With unmatched talent, capable of defeating a master at their art within a few hours of learning.

You may even apply the insight of your dharma to any skill you may have, reforging seemingly mundane and niche skills into blades to slaughter your foes.

By turning one's gaze inward and meditating, you can peer into the gates of determinism, a form of pseudo-precognition, in which you can determine and plan the effects of different actions and see the results all to your benefit. This inward contemplation can only view the results based on information you already know, but it can lead to you forming connections you would never have thought of. You can further enhance this precognitive state by chanting the Lotus Sutra.
addons.title: Circular Nature

objects.text:
"The essence of combat is murder."

When entering combat, you are capable of entering a state where your entire focus is on one thing — ensuring the death of your opponent. You gain a form of limited combat precognition and are capable of planning out and performing the ideal series of steps to lead to your victory with superhuman precision.

You also gain heightened senses, capable of detecting the position of your opponent through fluctuations in the air and changes in temperature. You can eavesdrop on a conversation from streets away and can easily pick out minute muscle movements of your opponents. Your brain is given heightened processing power to keep up with this sensory boost.

Furthermore, your willpower is massively increased, and you are capable of completely ignoring pain, heartbreaking revelations, and any emotions holding you back from the termination of your opponent.

Previous users who have achieved Clarity have stated that even after combat, the state of absolute focus helped them realize how small and unimportant their previous issues really were. After a few months of training, you can maintain a state of Clarity permanently.

As a bonus, you gain the ability to easily focus on important tasks at will.
objects.title: Clarity (Shadow Slave)

addons.text:
Through fate or sheer will, you have forged an unholy union between your ruthless Killing Intent and the demonic essence entwined with your soul, drawing ever closer to the destiny etched in blood laid out for you. No longer bound by the constraints of supernatural energy, your own Killing Intent now becomes your inexhaustible wellspring of power—growing with every battle, feeding upon every conflict. So, for as long as your malice lingers, your strength will never wane. Every strike, every motion resonates with the weight of your bloodstained will, a blade sharpened by wrath and tempered in destruction.

This ever-deepening abyss within you seeps into the foundation of your abilities, reshaping them in your image—a harbinger of ruin, an avatar of relentless carnage. The more you embrace this path, the more your powers shall shed their former shackles, refining themselves into the ultimate instrument of devastation. With every life extinguished, with every step forward, the distinction between your powers and your purpose erodes further, leaving only an undeniable truth: you are slaughter incarnate, a force bound to fate, a being whose very existence heralds calamity.

As a consequence, any supernatural energy you wield or cultivate will inevitably succumb to these changes—twisted and reshaped by your Intent, corrupted by your nature, and forever bound to the fate you have chosen.
addons.title: Demonic Soul Impulse

addons.text: You become a natural master of the Dao Of Assassination, a sister to the arts you've been born with. This has the effect of enhancing your previous skills granted to you by your occupation as an Assassin to a similar extent as your skills of slaughter, merging them with the natural instinct for death you possess. You also no longer need to justify certain skills to let them be improved upon by this power; skills such as infiltration, stealth, strategy, seduction, disguise and anything else utilized by your profession are considered tools of death-dealing by default.
addons.title: Dao Of Assassination

objects.text: Fate has bestowed upon you the mantle of Heaven's Killer, the harbinger of endings, the blade that sunders stagnation and cuts away the rot of ages. You are the storm before renewal, the force that drives heroes to rise or perish beneath your shadow. Whether as the catalyst for change or the fire that devours all in its wake, your existence is one of necessary destruction—clearing the old so the new may take root. Born beneath the ominous Heaven Slaughter Star, you are destruction incarnate, gifted with an innate understanding of how to break all things—be they structures of stone, bodies of flesh, or even the very essence of life itself. To you, all things bear a weakness, a point of collapse waiting to be struck, waiting for you to shatter and break. Your mind operates on this instinct, calculating with terrifying precision the most efficient path to total annihilation. Thus, you are a natural master of the Dao of Killing and Destruction, a talent rivaled only by the greatest of Heaven's blessed and chosen martial artists. This gift is not confined to your mind alone—as your very body moves with deadly purpose. Any skill, any technique, and any art that serves the purpose of eliminating obstacles, living or inanimate, will come naturally to you. Be it acrobatics, stealth, martial arts, footwork, blade work, or even something as mundane as dancing or cooking to the flick of a brush on parchment—if you can justify it to yourself as a means to aid you in the act of bringing death, you will learn it with frightening speed, weaving even the most benign motions into weapons of demise. Malevolent energies and chaotic forces bow before you, unable to corrupt what is already tainted beyond their reach. Cursed artifacts, demonic sorceries, and forbidden arts are mere tools in your grasp, their will subsumed by your own, twisted into obedient extensions of your power. But such a path is not without cost. For you are cursed with an unrelenting hunger for destruction, an all-consuming desire to kill, to break, to unmake. The thrill of taking a life, the ecstasy of reducing something to nothing—these pleasures will eclipse all others. Only with time, experience, and sheer force of will can you temper these urges, lest they consume you entirely.
objects.title: The Heaven Slaughter Star

addons.text: Your sheer charisma and force of personality shine through any and every medium! Making you a true influencer with people believing in you who believe in them! This will make your fans much more likely to partake in anything you enjoy and/or advertise, making you the true darling of any sponsor. But be careful not to abuse this too much; after all, bad influence will damage your own reputation.
addons.title: Influencer

objects.text:
Now that you are truly a magical Idol, your Parasocial relationships not only boost your strength but affect all of your other powers as well.

As your popularity grows, you will also gain new powers based on your theme and reputation. A great singer may truly charm their audience; having an infectious laugh actually infects people; a great animator could summon their iconic characters; and if you truly reach the top as a charity streamer, that will make you a true Messiah.

But beware, your reputation is not something you can firmly control and your own powers can affect you. A dark persona may actually surface in reality, and a reputation of being a show-off will give your powers more flair than substance. Even neutral fame and community beliefs might affect you, like your fans shipping you with somebody confusing you or memes changing your carefully built-up character.

In some cases, these powers can also manifest as a transformation if your persona is associated with a character instead of your real appearance, like being a Vtuber or appearing in your videos as an animated mascot.
objects.title: Omega Idol

addons.text:
Your pseudo-Nova Quantakinesis has grown; now rather than having equivalent power to a starting Nova, your power is closer to that of a highly powerful Nova, like Caestus Pax or Divis Mal.

Needless to say, the peculiar weaknesses of the Doyen do not apply to you; you are only affected by Quantum the way a Nova with a similarly energy based body would be, and even there you retain your ability to avoid Taint.
addons.title: Quantakinetic Majesty

objects.text: More than four million years ago, there evolved a highly psychically potent species, named the Doyen. The innately paranoid Doyen learned that in time, many species either destroyed themselves or were destroyed by another, more powerful species, spurring them to artificially accelerate their own evolution. This would transform them into a Noetic species inhabiting subtle realms invisible to all but the most potent of Psiads. Fearing the doom of their species, they rushed the process; instead of becoming nigh-unkillable Noetic beings, they became balls of tightly knit Noetic energy and charged plasma. You have inherited their legacy. As a result your psychic talents have grown far beyond their humble beginnings, having an intrinsic grasp of some disciplines like telepathy and telekinesis, and having a greater ease understanding and developing your abilities. Additionally, your body has become redundant and has been shed. You must construct a shell with Biokinesis if you wish to hold your form in mere meat. As a result, you’re immune to most forms of physical attack, sickness, and age, but you can still be harmed by electrical weapons. Additionally, the main weakness of the Doyen has become yours. You now find yourself weakened by Quantum energies, and a concerted attack with such a power may well be lethal.
objects.title: Heir to the Doyen (Trinity Continuum)

objects.text:
Your connection to technology has expanded, making you a genius hacker with the ability to access the genetic memory of Aiden Pierce. Not only that, but your Assassin gear has been upgraded and expanded with Watch Dogs tech and through the Tomb of Assassins. 

Your assassin robe now has AR technology built into it that allows you to disguise yourself into a saved appearance or a more basic default appearance constructed based on uniforms nearby. Your hidden blade was also upgraded with a hidden gun and a hidden dart launcher attachment. Lastly, you have now been given an Eagle Drone, which you can connect to and control through your connection with Knowledge, and that has the ability to self-destruct with an EMP blast. 

You gain knowledge on how to make berserker darts and repair and reconstruct your Eagle Drone. This equipment is affected by OoP upgrades.
objects.title: Watch Dogs (Watch Dogs: Legion)

objects.text: After completing many years of intellectual, physical, and emotional training to refine your Bene Gesserit abilities beyond the norm, you have been granted the opportunity to ingest and convert a normally deadly nootropic substance known as the Water of Life within your body, raising yourself to a higher state of awareness. With it, you unlock the genetic memory of all your female ancestors, resulting in a sudden and immense accumulation of knowledge and abilities.
objects.title: Reverend Mother (Dune)

objects.text:
Through 10,000 years of careful breeding, the genetic solution of a male Bene Gesserit whose organic mental powers could bridge space and time has arrived, and it's you. This bestows upon you three distinct boons. Firstly, unlike the Reverend Mother, you possess complete access to all your female and male ancestors' memories, knowledge, and abilities. Secondly, your senses border on the supernatural; you can intuitively discern minute nuances and compute complexities that confound even the greatest Mentats and Guild Navigators. Lastly, your mental prowess enables you to use higher dimensions, simultaneously perceiving the entirety of the past, present, and future—a fluid membrane where no possibility seems beyond your sight.

However, these gifts come with limits. Chief among them is the fallibility of the human mind. Despite its power, your perception may be clouded by the pressure of too many timelines. Additionally, while your vision of time spans broadly, traversing it inevitably narrows the sea of possibilities that can be influenced.
objects.title: Kwisatz Haderach (Dune)

objects.text: You have the gained the power to see. Any eye or perception-based powers become noticeably stronger and your vision cannot be obscured by any means—whether through illusions or attempts to physically blind you such as curses or darkness—as your eyes pierce through all which seeks to block your perception and allow you to gaze upon the Truth of this world. You have also gained the ability to project your vision outwards, conjuring innumerable phantasmal eyes through which you can see as if they were your own, matching and even surpassing your original eyes in terms of perceptive capability. These eyes count as your own eyes for the sake of any of your eye-based powers, meaning that if you have some kind of effect which only activates through line-of-sight, you can activate it through your eyes. This connection for powers is one-way, as only you can benefit from it. The eyes can fly in all directions at your running speed—or even teleport if you possess the ability to—and you can mentally control them, directing their movement as you see fit. There is no range limitation on how far these eyes can go from you; in fact, you can sense through them across dimensional boundaries, seeing through them even if you are entire worlds away. Furthermore, the eyes are not truly present in the world and are capable of phasing through matter and most protections—only held back by extremely powerful or specialized defenses—and can only be perceived if you will it or if the observer possesses equal or greater perception to your own. As you create eyes, your mind expands to accommodate them, spawning a new instance of thought for each eye you conjure, meaning you can never be overwhelmed by them. Your phantasmal eyes can be any shape or size, provided they resemble an eye in some way, ranging from anatomical replicas of your own eyes to stylized eyes made of flowing lines.
objects.title: Watcher of a Thousand Eyes

addons.text:
Your sheer might as an Esper has manifested a subconscious psychic entity, born from your mind. It functions as a temporary survival mechanism; when you either become unconscious under extreme stress or the physical vessel containing your mind is critically harmed, it is unleashed to protect you. 

In this form, it/you gain access to unlimited amounts of psychic energy and will fully wield this strength to destroy whatever it considers harmful or a threat. It/you could annihilate entire planets with its attacks, casually absorb the psychic power of Espers from across the world and perform any psychic technique you're capable of but on a tremendously larger scale. Do note that it will not care about collateral damage and could devastate entire landmasses with impunity.

Eventually, with training, experience and profound self-understanding, you may one day fully incorporate this entity into your mind as part of you and attain all its potency.

objects.text: "Hey, you. This is the first time this has happened. Can you feel it? My animosity?" You have become comparable to Shigeo Kageyama, better known as "Mob", the protagonist of Mob Psycho 100 and one of the most powerful espers in the series.
