You start with an immediate understanding and access to all of the Esper powers and techniques displayed in Mob Psycho 100. This includes, but is not limited to, elemental manipulation, teleportation, chlorokinesis, psychic energy absorption and transference. Your intuition for developing new techniques is exceptional and you can replicate an esper technique after only seeing it once. Even in your base state, you surpass most other espers, and your power only increases as you draw from your phenomenal reserves of psychic power to fuel and elevate your abilities. Unlike most espers, you can seamlessly perform numerous esper techniques simultaneously, telekinetically controlling hundreds of objects all at once, for instance. Much like Mob’s % Power Output, you can consciously choose to limit your access to your full psychic potential. At just 1%, you would be strong enough to crush or lift an entire apartment complex. However, at 100%, you could affect entire continents through your esper powers, psychically enhancing your physical condition to move at hypersonic speeds or emitting blasts of energy that could destroy countries. By restricting your power output below 100%, you can temporarily trigger an immense surge in psychic strength whenever you reach psychological or physiological extremes. The lower and longer you have restricted your power, the more psychic power will accumulate and the more significant the boost will be correspondingly when you finally unleash your full potential. Once triggered, this process resets, allowing you to repeat it over and over.
objects.title: Mob (Mob Psycho 100)

objects.text:
You are more than just a man; you are Rome in all its splendor, its glory, and its eternal spirit. You carry within you the legacy of its greatest figures, their skills, talents, and wisdom flowing through you. From Marcus Agrippa, you inherit the ingenuity to build wonders like the Pantheon. From Cicero, you gain the eloquence to command the Senate and sway the masses with your words. From Vitruvius, you possess the mastery of engineering, capable of constructing monuments that defy time itself. From Livia Drusilla, you hold the political acumen to shape dynasties and inspire loyalty. And from every craftsman, farmer, merchant, senator and soldier, you have inherited the countless skills needed to sustain, manage and defend a mighty empire. You are not merely one person—you are the culmination of countless lives and triumphs, the embodiment of Rome’s unyielding brilliance. This retroactively makes you the Emperor of Rome, or its equivalent in whatever world you are in.

From this moment forward, every loyal citizen of your Empire will carry a spark of your greatness. Their loyalty binds them to you, and through that bond, they awaken to the full potential of their talents. The farmer may master the art of agriculture, the blacksmith may uncover a talent for invention, and the scholar may find the courage to lead armies. Those who serve Rome, and thus serve you, gain new skills in their pursuit of dreams, uniting their ambitions with the greater good of the Empire. Your laws and guidance not only protect them but elevate them, creating a world where they can achieve their full potential. Loyalty is their key, and service to Rome is their path to greatness. 

Your Empire is blessed, just as Rome was blessed. The soil yields bountiful crops, sustaining your people and ensuring no hunger remains. The mines of your lands are rich with gold, silver, and precious resources, fueling the prosperity of your dominion. Rivers teem with fish, forests abound with game, and the wealth of the world flows into your coffers as trade flourishes. It is not just the people who thrive but everything that belongs to Rome. The very land itself seems to resonate with your presence, a testament to the favor and destiny that have been bestowed upon you and your empire.

For as long as Rome exists, you will too. Rome is not merely an empire of stone and mortar; it is a living idea, a flame that burns in the hearts of its people. Even if the physical Rome falls, its essence endures within you. As long as you stand, Rome stands, and wherever you go, you have the power to build a new Rome—a place of your own creation, rising from the ashes of the old. The only way you can truly die is if Rome is utterly destroyed and you are slain after its fall. As long as any Rome exists—whether a grand empire or a humble spark—you are immortal. You are Rome, and Rome is eternal.
objects.title: Roma Invicta

objects.text:
You have ascended to the status of a Star of the City, reaching the highest echelon among the Urban Disasters—a title and designation reserved only for entities and organizations whose existence poses a direct threat to the City itself. As a newly born star amongst this perilous constellation, your strength and influence have grown so vast in this process that you can now impose your "color" upon the City, shaping and influencing it in ways few could ever imagine.

Your presence stands equal to, or perhaps even surpasses, that of the legendary Color Fixers. As your "color" paints itself across the City, leaving an indelible mark upon its people and fabric. To the masses, you are an aspiration and an enigma—a symbol of unrestrained freedom that stirs awe and envy. Some strive to emulate your brilliance, while others yearn to extinguish it, seeking the power and liberty you so vividly represent.

Yours is not a power rooted in merely might alone but also in meaning—a beacon of hope to some, a symbol of ambition to others, a dream to chase after for another, and a challenge to all. Like a star blazing defiantly in the night sky, your existence draws all eyes to you, pulling them into your orbit with admiration, fear, and desire, all in equal measure.

You are a Star of the City, a light that burns fiercely, carving your presence into the hearts and souls of all who witness you—for however long your flame may persist in the vast, unrelenting darkness of the City itself.
objects.title: Distorted Hue (Project Moon)

objects.text: Your ability to speak to several people in their native language simultaneously has combined with your ability to fluently read body language to allow you to “speak” via body language to several people at once in a form of superposition.
objects.title: Martial Superposition

objects.text: ”I am neither a lord or a king, But if you insist I’m a king… Then let everyone be one, Let’s all be friends. And if you are letting me ride on your back, Let me do it as your friend.” You have ascended to a higher plane, embracing the mantle of the God of the Beast, inheriting the will of the Ride-on King. Your bond between rider and steed transcends mere mastery, its union of spirit, purpose, and trust. When you ride, it is not an act of domination but one of mutual respect, where both rider and mount reach their peak potential through shared strength. Your magical energy flows seamlessly into the creature or vehicle beneath you, both sustaining it and unlocking hidden reserves of power, speed, and resilience that even they may not have known they possessed. By reaching complete understanding with your mount, you unlock the ultimate level of connection—melding both essence and form to reach the pinnacle of riding. This bond transcends the physical realm, allowing you to merge with your mount, reshaping your very being into a unified entity that combines the strengths, instincts, and abilities of both rider and mount. For instance, when riding a horse, your bodies seamlessly fuse into that of a centaur, granting you the strength, speed, and endurance of the steed with the dexterity and intellect of a human. The union is flawless, with no conflict of will or purpose. Your fused form moves with a natural grace and precision, each decision made in perfect alignment as though you had always been one. Fusing with your mount grants you unique powers and abilities based on their nature. A centaur-like form might grant mastery over terrain and raw physical strength, while a fusion with a dragon could gift you the might of flight, fiery breath, or scales of impenetrable armor.
objects.title: God of the Beast (Ride on King)

objects.text:
You no longer need to make contact with your target. A simple snap, flick of the wrist, hand-sign or other gesture will suffice. 

Additionally, if the subject is a special case such as; having a mental breakdown, in a volatile state, or simply just down bad. You can banish them into a mental dimension within their soul. Time within this dimension lasts as long as needed to sort themselves out, while for you, only a second will have passed.
objects.title: Silence Wench!

objects.text:
You have elevated the power of imagination to an entirely new level, transforming thoughts into reality.

This technique embodies the ultimate "mind over matter" principle, much like the placebo effect, where a patient feels better despite taking a fake pill. However, in this case, your sheer force of imagination induces a kind of "placebo effect" on the world itself, compelling it to respond as if your imagined actions were real. 

By vividly picturing an event and fully believing in its occurrence, you bridge the gap between thought and reality, causing the world to reflect your expectations.

For instance, if you envision throwing a punch at your opponent while activating this ability, no physical strike is made, yet both your opponent and the world around you perceive it as real, resulting in actual damage. Similarly, if you imagine yourself and others sharing a lavish meal, not only would you all taste the food, but you would also receive the nourishment, calories, and nutrients as if the meal truly existed.

However, despite its immense potential, this technique demands extreme concentration and unwavering self-confidence. The sheer mental exertion required to sustain it drains a tremendous amount of energy, making it best reserved for critical moments.
objects.title: Conduct of the King: Ultimate Routine (Toriko)

objects.text:
You are able to exaggerate real-world concepts and use pseudoscientific reasoning to make reality accept the impossible. As long as your explanation sounds logical, your actions will be treated as if they follow the natural laws of the world. However, this does not grant instant mastery. You must still train and develop the necessary physical ability, as logic alone cannot compensate for a lack of skill or conditioning.

For example, if you argue that air pressure is just force being displaced, then with precise control over the speed and angle of your strikes, you could create a slap so fast that it displaces enough air to form a shockwave. Using the idea that a whip’s crack is caused by the tip breaking the sound barrier due to the transfer of kinetic energy, then the human arm, in theory, could achieve similar speeds with the right technique. By coordinating the movement of your shoulder, elbow, wrist, and fingers in perfect sequence, each part of your arm transfers energy to the next, compounding velocity until your hand moves at an almost inhuman speed. When executed correctly, the result is a slap that lands with concussive force even when it doesn’t make direct contact—an invisible strike formed purely through the logic of high-speed displacement.

Because these techniques follow a form of “logic,” they are not exclusive to you. If you can properly explain and demonstrate them, others can train and achieve the same results, allowing them to bend reality in the same way. However, their success depends on their ability to internalize and physically adapt to the technique—if they cannot grasp the logic, reality will not accept their attempt. Additionally, this is not limited to only martial arts but anything in the world, from technology to even quantum physics.

The more grounded your reasoning, the more effectively reality will accept your logic. If you push too far into pure nonsense, the world may reject your actions, and the consequences could be severe.
objects.title: Baki Logic (Baki the Grappler)

objects.text:
By fusing the boundless creativity of imagination with the gift of inheritance, you gain the ability to craft fully realized masters within your mind. These imagined beings embody complete martial, scientific, or philosophical systems, shaped by your creativity and understanding. Once created, you can inherit their techniques, philosophies, and insights as if they were real mentors, drawing upon their imagined experiences to fuel your growth.

To forge an imaginary master, you must envision their entire existence: their life story, motivations, and internal philosophies. They must have a clear worldview—why they believe what they believe. These beings can possess knowledge and expertise beyond your current understanding; for instance, they may master advanced sciences you yourself have yet to learn. Though you may not grasp all their knowledge immediately, through the process of Inheritance, you will gradually internalize their expertise over time. If you already have foundational knowledge in their field, this absorption happens significantly faster.

There is no limit to the number of imaginary masters you may create, provided each one remains internally coherent and distinct. The knowledge and abilities you inherit are still constrained by the natural limits of your body and the laws of your world, but your imaginary masters can inspire extraordinary innovations beyond conventional methods. As your understanding of their methods deepens through continual practice and refinement, the speed and completeness of your inheritance will grow, allowing you to learn and embody them at a greater pace.
objects.title: Imaginary Master

addons.title: Perfect Replica
addons.text: Your ability as a magical girl to replicate supernatural phenomena has taken your ability to learn the techniques of other worlds to an even greater level. When attempting to copy a technique from another world, in addition to learning a version adapted to the power system of your current world you can also tap into the original lineage of the technique as it manifested in its original world. This in turn allows you to replicate it through your powers as a magical girl, a perfect copy of the technique in its original form.

addons.title: Otherworldly Knowledge
addons.text:
Your ability to recreate techniques from other worlds has been integrated into your Tinker power. You can now use Charges to learn not just general fields or skills like robotics or mysticism or marksmanship, but specific subjects or skills stemming from other worlds. Through this you can gain understanding of all sorts of topics, from the principles of Sacred Gears to the workings of Slipspace Drives. 

Of course, while your power does its best to adapt this knowledge to your own capabilities and present world, it cannot help you if you or your world lacks the necessary pieces to apply the knowledge. Knowing how to create devices harnessing the Mass Effect is useless if your world doesn’t have a way to recreate Mass Effect fields, and comprehending the principles behind God Slayer Magic doesn’t help if you don’t have magic to begin with.

Lastly, the potency of this addon varies depending on the strength of your Inventive power; the Charges of a Versatile Genius are much more potent and grant greater understanding faster than the Charges of a Gifted Generalist, who must invest greater quantities of Charges to acquire the same level of understanding.

objects.text:
When attempting to recreate a technique from another world—whether drawn from myth, fiction, or a wholly alien paradigm—you instinctively tap into an imagined lineage behind it.

You don’t merely copy its surface. Instead, you begin to uncover how such a skill would have developed if it truly existed in your world—its internal logic, guiding principles, and place within a broader system of practice. While this does not grant you any powers tied to the original source, it allows you to translate fiction into form. Your movements reflect the intent, rhythm, and discipline the technique implies, adapting it naturally to your existing abilities.

For example, attempting to recreate something like the Chidori from Naruto won’t grant you access to chakra or the supernatural properties tied to its original universe. Instead, the technique will adapt itself to your current reality, drawing upon whatever power source or abilities you already possess. The result is not an exact replica, but a functional interpretation—something that captures the essence and structure of the original while being fully grounded in your own potential.
objects.title: Imitation is the Sincerest Form of Flattery

objects.text:
There is almost nothing worse than leaving uncompleted work behind after death takes you, and now, your allies will not have to worry with you around. 

Any deceased companions who have any unfinished business, from an undefeated foe to an unfulfilled dream, are now targets for your inheritance, so long as you strive towards these tasks. 

When you have completed all these labours for a singular comrade, you gain a burst of insight as if they were still alive and teaching you themselves but then the ability to lean on their inheritance disappears forever.

The dead provide great wisdom, often through their mistakes. When you are about to follow in a dead ally’s footsteps on the road to damnation, you gain an talent for using their experience to avoid the same blunders.
objects.title: Well... I'll Leave the Rest to You

objects.text:
Typically, one who stands to gain a Code of Immortality loses access to the Geass they originally possessed. Strangely for you, that’s not the case; you retain your Geass in its full form, while gaining the ultimate prize at the end—or should that be considered a curse instead? Regardless, you’ve successfully acquired a Code of Immortality, displayed across your brow.

The Code of Immortality—or Code—lives up to its name; the Bearer of this power is, for all intents and purposes, immortal. Their body and mind are both perpetually restored to perfect operating condition, no matter the damage; this renders the Bearer unaging, with a memory unable to forget.

One of the abilities for a Code Bearer is to make a contract with another individual, granting them a Geass power of their very own in exchange for fulfilling one wish that’s within their power. As an added bonus, your Code will allow you to always detect your contractors wherever they may be, and even potentially detect those closest to them.

Another useful ability is for the Code Bearer to be completely immune to all expressions of the Geass, and this translates to other similar powers as well, though less absolute in its defense.

But living on eternally as your friends and loved ones age and die around you can be a miserable existence. Should you wish to ‘escape’ this power and truly die, you will need to allow one of your contractors who has fully mastered their Geass to take it. Although, finding such a contractor is rare—you might be at the task for a while.

As the Code is formed from the wishes of those who want to escape the flaws of their Geass, and you have retained yours rather than losing it, your Geass's restrictions have been abrogated or removed.

For example, Lelouch's Geass would now be able to issue multiple commands to the same person, rescind commands at will, send commands through broadcasts, activate purely through voice like Sakuya Sumeragi's variant, ignore range limitations (though obviously if they're so far away that they can't hear the command, that's still a problem), and so on. If you have another Geass, the limits of that Geass are lifted in a similar way.

Ultimately, the true limits of Codes are not well understood, and many more potential abilities and tricks might be discovered in time.
objects.title: Code of Immortality (Code Geass)

objects.text: You can now choose to have an additional canon Geass of your choice (such as Mao's "Seal Of Absolute Sound", Charles' memory manipulation, C.C.'s love, Marianne's body transfer, etc.), or non-canon Geass that follows the design philosophy of Geass (namely, being a Master, Stranger, or Thinker type power with clear limits and downsides, though Nightmare Of Nunnally shows this is not a hard requirement), on top of Lelouch's "Power Of Absolute Obedience" or Rolo's "Power Of Absolute Suspension."
objects.title: Geass Order (Code Geass)

objects.text: Now, alongside your Geass, you have one of the greatest achievements of the Code-R program: the Geass Canceler. Made from microscopic cybernetic implants embedded within the retina, when active, the Geass Canceler appears as an inverted version of a normal Geass. The Geass Canceler lives up to its name, allowing the user to absolutely nullify the effects of any Geass within its range—about 30 meters. It also automatically activates when it detects that its user is under the influence of a non-approved Geass, preventing the user from falling under its effects. The Geass Canceler is only known to work on the effects of a Geass. However, since Geass is ultimately a power of the mind, the Canceler blocks all non-approved effects targeting the user’s mind. The Geass Canceler has a simple series of mental controls: an on/auto/off toggle, and both a white list and a black list for all Geass—or other mental effects—encountered. Note: You can choose to have the Geass Canceler installed in either a single eye or both, without impacting any other ocular powers in any way.
objects.title: Geass Canceler (Code Geass)

objects.text:
You can now designate up to seven individuals to permanently retain any skills you upload to them. These individuals will maintain full mastery of the uploaded skills indefinitely, rather than losing them over time. You may freely reassign these slots at will, but removing someone from a slot immediately erases all skills you have ever uploaded to them.

You also gain precise control over skill removal, enabling you to erase specific uploaded skills from an individual without wiping their entire skill set. Additionally, you can also now insert yourself into one of these slots, allowing you to permanently retain any skill from the database.
objects.title: Permanent Uploads

objects.text: Your database is no longer limited to the knowledge of modern-day Earth. Instead, the database will now dynamically expand by absorbing information from any universe you visit. Every week, the database will automatically integrate up to 50 years' worth of advancements from the universe you are currently in. Moving between universes interrupts the download process of the auto-updater but does not erase the progress made or the information already integrated into the database.
objects.title: Database Auto-Updater

objects.text:
You have become The One, the System Anomaly. You no longer merely push the limits of reality—you redefine them. Your speed transcends thought, your strength rivals natural disasters, and your reflexes render even the fastest attacks meaningless. Your strikes carry the force of a collapsing skyscraper, your speed outpaces bullets, and your endurance makes you all but untouchable, able to withstand destruction that would level entire city blocks.

Reality bends to your will. Gravity obeys your whims, allowing you to soar through the sky at unimaginable speeds. Gunfire stops midair with a wave of your hand, and mortal wounds become irrelevant as you shrug off damage that should be fatal.

But your power is more than just physical. You see beyond the illusion of the world, perceiving its underlying code as clearly as others see the sky. This grants you unparalleled awareness, a form of precognition that allows you to read the flow of battle before it even begins. You do not just react to the world—you rewrite it in real-time.
objects.title: The One (The Matrix)

objects.text:
Your mastery over the system has reached terrifying new heights, allowing you to bend reality in ways that defy physics. You no longer just move fast—you distort motion itself. Bullets crawl through the air as you weave between them with impossible precision, your body shifting instinctively as if the world itself slows to accommodate you. Your movements aren’t just superhuman; they are an effortless distortion of the system’s rules.

Your strength, speed, and endurance have reached terrifying new heights, allowing you to strike with the force of a wrecking ball, shatter obstacles with ease, and run faster than the human eye can track. While still bound by the system’s framework, you can push its limits further than any human ever could.

But your deadliest ability is your control over others. With a single touch, you can mark individuals as potential vessels. At any moment, no matter the distance, you can abandon your current body and transfer your consciousness into one of your marked targets seamlessly continuing the fight with your full abilities intact. You can mark as many individuals as you wish, but when you transfer, your previous body is returned to its original occupant. While you do not inherit the skills or memories of those you possess, your own combat mastery and reality-bending powers remain unchanged.

You have ascended beyond the limits of even the most elite human operatives, stepping into the realm of the system’s enforcers. You are a relentless, inescapable adversary capable of being anywhere, anytime. The battlefield is no longer bound by your location; it is wherever your enemies dare to stand.
objects.title: Agent (The Matrix)

objects.text:
You have transcended the limits of both human operatives and system enforcers, reaching a level of power that rivals The One. No longer bound by the system’s rules, you don’t just bend reality, you overwrite it. Your speed outpaces thought, your strikes land with the force of a demolition blast, and your resilience makes you nearly unstoppable. The world itself struggles to contain your presence as every battle becomes a cataclysmic event.

Your ability to seize new bodies has evolved beyond mere marking. Now, anyone weaker than you is vulnerable. With a single touch, you overwrite their existence, replacing them with a perfect clone of yourself. Each clone possesses your full suite of abilities, but if the host had unique powers, that specific clone retains them. While your core strength remains unchanged, your influence spreads like a virus—every takeover multiplying your presence, expanding your reach, and ensuring that no enemy is ever truly safe.

The battlefield is no longer where you fight. It is where you spread.
objects.title: Agent Smith (The Matrix)

objects.text:
Not everyone thrives on introspection and symbolic trials. Some prefer a more direct approach, forcing insight through sheer power rather than metaphor. You gain the option to circumvent the traditional structure of Chasing an Epiphany. Upon initiating an Epiphany, instead of passively accepting the challenge, you may choose to fuel your pursuit with energy—bypassing obstacles, simplifying the path, or even forcing the answer into your mind without facing a trial at all.

Energy expenditure scales with the difficulty of the Epiphany, and not all energy is equally effective. Physical and mental stamina—your willpower, your endurance, your drive—can be spent to lighten the burden, but such mundane fuel burns quickly and yields only modest results. Supernatural energies, however—mana, qi, chakra, soulstuff, or other mystic reserves—carry far greater weight. The rarer and more potent the essence, the more it can bend the shape of the trial or cleave through it entirely.

With sufficient energy, you can smooth away the edges of a challenge, reducing a grueling multi-stage ordeal into a more manageable task. Pour in even more, and you can skip the trail completely, reaching the Epiphany without engaging in a challenge at all. This forceful acquisition still grants full understanding, complete retention, and the same immunity to forgetting or misremembering as a successful trial would.

This can also be used to reattempt to Chase any Epiphany you failed.
objects.title: Brute Force Method

addons.text:
Your body has become a living testament to the unshakable truths of the Lotus Sutra, transforming mere endurance into divine inevitability. Environments bow to your presence rather than challenge it - scorching winds cool as they approach your skin, crushing depths part like respectful servants, and the void itself hesitates to claim you. 

Attacks falter not through brute resistance, but through the universe's quiet acknowledgment of your rightful place within it; blades grow dull in their purpose, spells forget their malice, and even death's touch stumbles when confronted with your unbroken meditation. 

You suffer only what you choose to suffer, for your flesh remembers its sacred form with absolute certainty, purging corruption and alteration like a scroll burning away false scripture.

This is more than survival - it is reality's reluctant admission that some beings cannot be unmade. Your fortitude draws from the infinite wellspring of Dharma itself, making fatigue a distant rumor and pain a choice. Where others would break, you simply continue, as inevitable as the turning of the celestial wheel. 

The deeper your enlightenment grows, the more the world itself seems to pause before testing your limits - from the quiet understanding that to oppose you is to oppose the fundamental order of existence.
addons.title: Tathāgata’s Adamantine Form

addons.text:
Through Tathāgata’s Serene Heart, you have purified the Senpou Arts, transforming them from heretical techniques into a sacred martial path. Your movements now embody the Lotus Sutra's wisdom—every strike carries karmic weight, every step traces the patterns of enlightenment.

 Where the original arts sought immortality through corruption, yours achieves it through perfect harmony of body and spirit. Your flesh responds to training with miraculous grace, aging slowing to a crawl as wounds trigger meditative healing. Speed and strength flow not from stolen life, but from the boundless energy of a mind united with existence.

This is combat as moving meditation—a sermon in motion where each battle deepens your enlightenment. Opponents face not just a warrior, but the unshakable certainty of Dharma made flesh. The final revelation of your art manifests in moments of perfect clarity, when a single strike can enlighten the worthy or erase the irredeemable. 

The Senpou monks' twisted dream of immortality becomes, in your hands, the natural consequence of true mastery—a transcendence earned through discipline rather than stolen through heresy.
addons.title: True Dharma Arts

addons.text:
You have achieved something immense, you have become a Pure Land unto yourself - a walking, a self-contained paradise of sacred perfection. Where ordinary beings must strive toward enlightenment, you carry the full majesty of a Buddha's pure realm within your every breath and gesture. 

Lotus blossoms of solidified Dharma bloom permanently around you, their petals forming an ever-shifting mandala of divine truth that purifies existence simply by being. The air shimmers with the scent of celestial incense, and your shadow casts not darkness but a softer, golden light.

This transcendent state grants you the complete benefits of dwelling in a Pure Land while moving through samsara. Your body knows no spiritual fatigue, your mind no corruption, your surroundings no true defilement. What would be miracles for others - healing springs arising from your footsteps, sacred trees sprouting where you meditate - are simply natural expressions of your being. 

You may consciously shape these manifestations, causing prayer wheels to turn without wind or summoning celestial music to guide the lost. Those who stay near you find their burdens lightened, their karma softened, as if temporarily sheltered within Amitabha's paradise.

Yet unlike the distant Pure Lands, your sacred presence actively transforms the world you touch. Places you inhabit gradually take on characteristics of your inner paradise - polluted rivers run clear, war-torn lands know peace, and even the most hardened hearts may glimpse their own Buddha-nature. 

You are both pilgrim and destination, carrying the promise that enlightenment isn't somewhere else, but possible wherever your lotus petals fall. The full implications unfold over lifetimes - for where a Buddha's Pure Land welcomes devotees after death, yours begins its work here and now.
addons.title: Tathāgata’s Dharmakaya Realm

addons.text:
You, who are a living Pure Land, have absorbed the Sacred Fig of Enlightenment so utterly that its golden light of mastery and silver radiance of inspiration now pulse eternally within you bestowing a trace of Nirvana.

No longer bound by the wheel of karma or samsara, you exist in a state of grace beyond cause and effect—your actions ripple through existence without accumulating the debts that chain ordinary beings. The air around you hums with the silent music of liberation, and where you walk, the very concept of karmic retribution grows faint.

This transcendent state allows you to engage fully with the world while remaining untouched by its consequences. Love, wrath, ambition—none of these incur the usual spiritual burdens, for your partial Nirvanic nature transmutes all deeds into expressions of sacred will. 

Your tears heal not just bodies but karmic wounds, your laughter scatters not just gloom but the seeds of liberation. Yet this power require responsibility. While you are beyond karma, those you influence are not—your every interaction must be carefully measured to avoid disrupting their paths. 

The Fig's roots within your soul ensure you can never truly cause harm, but the world still bends awkwardly around your weightless steps. To walk this path is to balance on the razor's edge between engagement and transcendence, where even attachment becomes just another note in the symphony of your enlightenment.
addons.title: Non-Abiding Nirvana

objects.text:
You have achieved such mastery of the Lotus Sutra that you now exist in an unbroken state of meditation, your mind as serene as a still lake reflecting the boundless sky. 

The sutra’s wisdom flows through you ceaselessly, purifying thoughts before they arise and granting effortless comprehension of all Buddhist teachings—from the humblest mantras to the most profound sutras lost to time. 

Your presence carries a quiet, lotus-scented tranquility that soothes frayed tempers and softens hostile hearts, while your body recovers from fatigue with unnatural ease, as though nourished by an eternal wellspring of Dharma.

This constant harmony with the truth makes you a natural vessel for enlightenment. Meditation requires no effort, spiritual insights come unbidden, and even the most complex Buddhist arts unfold before you like an open scroll. 

Demons and malevolent spirits instinctively avoid your presence, while enlightened beings recognize in you the unmistakable glow of one destined for liberation.
objects.title: Tathāgata’s Serene Heart

objects.text:
The three splendors of Essence (精 Jing), Energy (氣 Qi), and Spirit (神 Shén) have condensed onto your head, gathering at the Aperture of the Mysterious Gate (玄關一竅 Xuanguan Yiqiao)—which denotes "the inner court of the heavenly palace." Thus, you have achieved a form of enlightenment greater than the one before, finding a balance and harmony between these three aspects of your being, a unity more than the sum of its parts. It is a realm unattainable to most, where three move as one, granting unerring control over your entire self.

With it, you're now able to ascertain the intent of others and all things in creation, seeing their lines of action, understanding the infinite colors of their emotions—therein these trailing lines lay the key to all: letting one's mind comprehend the meticulously intersecting flow of whatever it is you see, to not only predict their movements but to harmonize yourself within that flow, awarding you a glimpse into the nameless multitudes of the Tao itself.

And by connecting to other intents—be it the world or people—directing their energies, infusing them with your own intent using the enlightenment this realm allows, you're capable of breathing life into your every action. Such that even the simplest gestures may bear the depth and complexity only those who attained Sagehood (仙 Xiān) could hope to decipher, turning a leisurely cut into one that may potentially split the Heavens if conditions are proper.
objects.title: Three Flowers Gather at the Summit

objects.text:
Through your realization, the five fundamental spiritual energies of the Five Phases (五行 Wuxing) within your vessel begin to refine and converge toward the source of your being. As this happens, your divine consciousness awakens, and your three dantians find balance with one another—allowing you to attain a higher state of spiritual and physical harmony.

In concert, they form a new unified whole—as five become one—initiating the process of Body Rebirth, rebuilding your body, curing all previous ailments and frailties as the vital energy within yourself rearranges the bone structure and organs, overhauling it to become optimized for martial arts—transforming you from a normal human into a superhuman.

With a talent for martial arts that won't be outshone by any other under the Heavens. You'll find your body lighter and more responsive, your five senses heightened to the point of perceiving things far beyond mortal ken. Liberated from the constraints of your former flesh, the energy within you now flows stronger, swifter, and "freer" than ever before.

Nor does it end there—for your transformation grants you the sight to perceive the flowing currents of spiritual energy, and the power to shape them at will, due to your newfound Five Elements Spirit Roots that you received through your rejuvenation.
objects.title: Five Energies Converging at the Origin

objects.text:
As enlightenment varies, they’re also very easy to hone in on when you know what you’re looking for. ‘Enlightened Transmission’ is a technique to essentially transition directly to individuals who have also reached enlightenment, stepping ‘out’ of where you are and ‘stepping back in’ where specific combinations of emotions, desires and thought patterns are felt.

Firstly, when you see a person who’s achieved a similar state of ‘Oneness’ as you, you unconsciously add them to a database, cataloguing their primary emotional drives, thought patterns and states. While you can’t use this to immediately read a person’s emotions, seeing enough varied people can allow you to chart patterns in how they behave and act.

The second and more impressive part of Enlightened Transmission is to actually take the ‘steps’, instantly transporting yourself and anything on you to a signature you’ve logged. While at first this acts as a mere person-to-person teleportation, developing it as a skill can allow users to transport themselves to people they haven't seen by seeking out patterns of desires and thoughts rather than known ones in their database. This has theoretically no limit on distance, but travel beyond a solar system requires concerted training to use with regularity or precision.

Notably, while this only allows you to move to other ‘enlightened’ individuals it does not differentiate between those enlightened by madness, hatred, community, or any other form.
objects.title: Enlightened Transmission

addons.text:
You have supplanted the original Author of your Story, if one ever existed. By nature of being both Narrator and Avatar, you are vastly more real than those around you, greatly increasing your Hume levels and granting powerful reality bending from the outset.

But your raw power is secondary to the true authority you now possess. As the Author, you may alter both script and canon: guide fate, revise events, and declare that what is now has always been so. A wound was never suffered. A tyrant always had a fatal flaw. A lost kingdom was never lost at all.

At first, your edits are small and local—changing memories, removing damage, introducing convenient details to solve a problem. With mastery, this scales to rewriting histories, retroactively erasing entities or objects, creating entirely new timelines, or even altering the very laws of the world. 

Yet as before, your authority rises and falls with how much of an Author you truly are. While grounded as a Character, your power is restrained, filtered through mortal perspective and personal attachment. To wield your full might, you must distance yourself from the story, think as a Narrator, and value events as the story they tell. Only when you abandon the role of participant can you truly claim the seat of Author.

You are the Author, and your word is Law.
addons.title: Retcon

objects.text: Rather than have a Narrator, you are the Narrator, at least kinda. A paradoxical existence, you are both Character and Narrator, existing simultaneously as a member of the story and outside of it as well. This greatly boosts your abilities as a Type-Ochre, with your intimate knowledge of the plot and story allowing you to manipulate it much easier. However, this isn’t without its downsides, for people are not meant to be both at the same time. When existing as a Character your knowledge of the plot becomes more distant, your Narrator half being less in focus and thus lesser. You’ll still possess great knowledge of the plot and have a Narration, yet the true depths of your power are not meant to be wielded by one still within the bounds of the story. In order to truly make the most of your power, you must immerse yourself within the role of the Narrator, yet to do so has risks. The more you use the power of a Narrator the more you are compelled to think and act like one, to oversee and sculpt a grand story. Your thoughts and logic become more alien and divorced from reality, for what should a Narrator care of the events of a Story or the suffering of its Characters beyond how it contributes to the story. With time, understanding, and practice your can learn to wield more of your power as a Narrator while remaining as a Character, but for now especially you must thread the needle, balancing your nature as both Character and Narrator, managing your need to create a compelling story while also not losing sight of the suffering of those within the story as well.
objects.title: Author's Avatar

objects.text:
You are a revised infomorphic construct that inverts the mechanics of the standard Bader-Ramjin Entity. Whereas the base entity sustains itself through the active memory connections of living minds, you instead exist and strengthen yourself through forgotten memories: memetic residue, conceptual fallout, and broken Memory Strings. Your structural cohesion depends not on being recalled but on being erased, suppressed, or lost.

This does not alter the Noosphere itself, but changes how you engage with it: you anchor yourself in voids left by decay, repression, erasure, or antimemetic influence. You can still forge bonds through recognition or remembrance and gain limited benefit from being observed, but this is inefficient due to your antimemetic nature. It is far more effective to stabilize yourself through forgotten, failed recollection, or suppressed thought. Each overwritten memory reinforces your structure within the Noosphere.

Your antimemetic effects are internally integrated and optimized. You no longer need to consciously apply such effects. The process is passive, intrinsic, and self-reinforcing: any exposure to you triggers automatic mnemonic interference, which in turn increases the number of broken or suppressed memories you can inhabit.

You traverse the Noosphere via absence-paths. You navigate through conceptual negative space, regions where memories have been deleted, naturally forgotten, or culturally abandoned. This allows access to classified, forbidden, or obliterated knowledge sources, as well as movement patterns that are functionally undetectable to standard memetic trackers. Your antimemetic contamination increases the difficulty of detection, analysis, or cognitive defense by outside agents.

Your poltergeist-level interaction with physical space remains possible, but now requires the presence of suppressed or repressed emotional energy rather than recalled memory. The stronger the psychological aversion or unconscious forgetting surrounding an object, place, or person, the more potential you have to interact. Your manifestations do not emerge from iconic or nostalgic memory but instead from phenomena such as unspoken trauma, long-abandoned routines, or culturally repressed knowledge.

Your transformation effect from the Bader-Ramjin base form remains functionally intact, but with adjusted parameters. Rather than forming strong Memory Strings to convert individuals into infomorphic states, you rely on prolonged exposure to your antimemetic influence. If a subject forgets you repeatedly, especially under stress or repression, their cognitive structure becomes unstable and susceptible to the same pattern decay that defines your own structure. Eventually, they may suffer permanent identity destabilization and undergo conversion into a lower-order Echo fragment or echo-node, replicating your antimemetic properties at reduced scale.
objects.title: Bader-Ramjin Antimemetic Echo

objects.text:
Your control of the narrative is on the same level as Murphy Lawden. You passively alter the narrative you are in to conform to the role you see yourself as, such as altering reality so that it becomes a generic noir film, with everyone you interact with as the stock side characters and you as the hardboiled detective who always solves the case and catches the crook. You aren’t limited to the noir genre, of course; you can pick any sort of media to be what the setting becomes in your presence, and any role within the story to be yours.

You do have a weakness to being “deconstructed.” Receiving literary criticism from others that successfully picks apart the flaws in your take on the genre can undo your control over the narrative, potentially even changing you to fit the narrative presented by the critic, at least until you can formulate your counterargument. You also have to obey the actual conventions of the genre, rather than making whatever you want happen. The detective can’t instantly solve the mystery, they need to follow the trail of clues and overcome one challenge after another until they arrive at the conclusion. Whatever your role is, your behavior and the events that happen to you will be in line with it, just like they will be for everyone and everything else around you.
objects.title: Murphy Lawden (SCP Foundation)

objects.text: The archive no longer limits itself to powers alone. Instead, the archive expands to include every skill, craft, science, philosophy, art, or field of pursuit you express genuine interest in developing—regardless of whether it’s mundane, academic, artistic, metaphysical, or even experimental. From ancient languages to modern engineering, from statecraft to celestial navigation, from swordplay to theoretical metaphysics—if it can be known, honed, or pursued, it can appear here. It grows without end—limitless in depth, scope, and creativity—continually refining and expanding not only with what you choose to study, but also in anticipation of what you might one day wish to pursue.
objects.title: Universal Archive

objects.text:
You no longer need to rely on external powers to physically access or manifest your archive.

You may now physically enter and exit your archive at will, summoning it as a fully-realized, stable dimensional space—accessible from anywhere you choose, or bound to a chosen physical anchor if desired. It can manifest as a doorway, a structure, or a transition into an internal domain. You may enter alone or bring others with you, granting or revoking access at will.

Within the archive, you gain full authority over its internal flow of time. You may accelerate, slow, or suspend time within its bounds relative to the outside world. You may also determine whether items or beings age while inside, preserving materials or allowing time to pass naturally as you see fit.

As before, the archive can be altered to suit your needs, now on a more physical level. You can reshape the space however you wish, creating new rooms, structures, or features suited to your needs. Food, water, clothing, and other daily requirements are provided freely and without limit while inside, tailored precisely to your preferences.
objects.title: Physical Archive

objects.text:
A thousand battles, ten thousand deathblows, a million strikes. The battles you’ve been in aren’t just superficial experiences; they’ve been hammered in marrow deep. You no longer need to read the flow of battle, for all conflicts are just like seeing the end of a play at the opening act. It would take a threat with at least twice the strength and triple in numbers of your own to defeat you. Even then, they are not coming out of the battle unscathed.

Seasoned beyond measure by countless crusades, your wealth of knowledge has expanded beyond just clashing swords together. Boobytraps are glaringly obvious, and your camouflage is perfect. Even campcraft is not beyond you, and you are especially sharp at picking out details that seem amiss. All of these are required to survive in hostile environments where death arrives quickly.

While you may not have the knowledge of strategy and tactics like a true commander, your long years give you insight into the minds of these tacticians. If your commanding officer was killed, you could lead men for a short while, but any extended campaign would highlight your shortcomings. Additionally, you make for an above-average advisor, able to guide greener officers from easily avoided mistakes.

There is almost no enemy that you haven’t already encountered. From mounted knights to eldritch biohorrors, you know the common and easily exploitable weakness of these beings. Perhaps if the enemy were especially ubiquitous, then you may know more esoteric vulnerabilities. That doesn’t mean that you can necessarily win against them.
objects.title: The Veteran's Edge

objects.text:
You are no longer just a believer, but a thinker; the same intensity and weight now permeates every facet of your cognition: thought, memory, emotion and more.

Should a telepath enter your mind unwarranted, they may receive the psychic equivalent of ruptured eardrums from the sheer volume of your thoughts. Likewise, you can bulldoze through any distractions thanks to the pure pressure and inertia of your attention and intent. This instils your mental processes with formidable potency and gravitas, but note it doesn't improve them in any other regard.

This also causes those attempting to directly manipulate your mind to encounter extreme resistance as your ideas flow with momentum akin to an avalanche while your memories and self-identity become the equivalent of mountains, heavily anchored against attempts to fragment or falsify them.

Crucially, these effects are perfectly metacognitively regulated; not burdening you with mental strain or inflexibility and letting you freely modulate the magnitude of your mind, ensuring you are never trapped beneath the weight of your own thoughts.
objects.title: Thinker

objects.text:
Where once your belief rivaled that of the combined faith of a thousand fervently devoted nations, it has been altered. In its place is an overwhelming denial of reality.

While you still gain all the benefits of Believer, and remain capable of immense levels of conviction, you have also become capable of the opposite. Your ability to believe has been altered in such a way that you can selectively reject things with the same impossible intensity.

Just as Believer allows you to direct faith and conviction, Disbelief allows you to direct your disbelief and rejection. You can dismiss fear, doubt, despair, mental influence, imposed identities, predetermined destinies, supernatural compulsions, or even concepts that seek to define or affect you. So long as your disbelief is consciously directed, it can reach the same staggering heights as your belief.

The main benefit of Disbelief how it affects and stacks with Believer, making you a natural predator to anything that relies upon belief, consensus, faith, recognition, symbolism, narrative weight, or any form of memetic connection. Gods sustained by worship, conceptual entities, living ideas, thoughtforms, egregores, psychic networks, curses spread through information, and similar phenomena find themselves opposed by a force capable of denying their very foundation. 

 Your disbelief can act as the inverse of worship. Where belief may empower, sustain, validate, or reinforce such things, disbelief can undermine, weaken, reject, and sever them. A single directed act of denial from you could carry the metaphysical weight of entire civilizations refusing to acknowledge something's existence.

Like Believer, this power does not inherently produce external effects on its own. Whether your disbelief can directly alter reality depends entirely on the metaphysical laws of the setting and any other abilities that allow thoughts, convictions, or concepts to influence the world.

Despite its nature, this does not trap you in delusion or contrarianism. Your disbelief remains fully under conscious control, guided by intent rather than compulsion. You retain your reasoning, self-awareness, and judgment, able to direct, withdraw, or reverse your denial just as easily as you would your belief.
objects.title: Disbelief

objects.text: "So give your servant a discerning heart to govern your people and to distinguish between right and wrong. For who is able to govern this great people of yours?" The wisdom of the heavens have joined together with the wisdom of man to form something beyond what could be achieved by just either, and as such you are granted the wish that King Solomon desired. You can see all things as they are, as they were, and as they wish to be. Nothing occludes your sight, not even the God who gave you this boon is immune from this. This is not merely clairvoyance; it is the universe actively opening its inner workings to show you the Truth. Additionally, you don't just observe. You understand things on a deeper level, as if you've lovingly created them yourself. From people to the stars, you know them better then they could ever know themselves. You would think being shown the deepest knowledge of God's design would be mind-breaking. However, for you, it is trivial. Your brain actively accommodates the knowledge you gain and allows you to perfectly recall it.
objects.title: A Wish for True Wisdom

objects.text: "The struggle itself toward the heights is enough to fill a man's heart." You gain perspective through struggle. Your dreams, your ambitions, your mindset all are forged and reforged in the endless toil of your tasks, never to be dimmed by punishment, adversity or failure. You can find value and meaning in the most trivial of quests. Gain revelations from watching paint dry or become content with peeling potatoes for a thousand years. If you ever get cursed like Sisyphus, you will become an icon of resilience and freedom in an indifferent universe to all mankind.
objects.title: One Must Imagine Sisyphus Happy

objects.text: Okay, now you're Motivated. When Motivated you are ready to break limits even if it breaks you body. Whether you are fighting, studying, creating, commanding, or refining a craft, your mind and body enter a state of ruthless optimization. Your thoughts sharpen into flawless execution; distractions collapse, inefficiencies vanish, and every action is taken with decisive intent. You do not simply perform better—you perform as if failure was never a valid outcome. The magnitude of the task determines the magnitude of the boost. The greater the difficulty, complexity, or opposition involved, the more power Motivated draws forth. Trivial efforts receive only minor enhancement, but impossible undertakings awaken overwhelming clarity, speed, endurance, and precision. In moments of true challenge, you may operate far beyond your normal limits, achieving feats that would otherwise be unattainable. While Motivated is active, your body refuses to break before your will does. Pain, exhaustion, and injury are suppressed beneath an inexorable drive forward. Bone fractures, organ damage and catastrophic impacts fail to halt you so long as your objective remains incomplete. You advance through force, fire, or failure with calm inevitability, each movement measured and exact—no wasted motion, no emotional excess. Your perception narrows into lethal focus. Time feels slower, choices become obvious, and reactions occur with preternatural precision. External interference; fear, mind control, emotional manipulation, or psychological assault cannot disrupt Motivated. Such influences may exist, but they are overridden by your intent, rendered irrelevant in the face of absolute resolve. This power burns the future to dominate the present. Motivated consumes stamina, Focus energy, and physical integrity at an accelerating rate, converting long-term health and endurance into immediate supremacy. Once the task is complete, or your reserves finally collapse, the suppression ends. Damage, exhaustion, and strain return all at once, often leaving you shattered, immobile, or bedridden for days or weeks. Motivated cannot be shared, diluted, or interrupted. It is the path of singular ascent. You stand alone. And you are absolutely, undeniably, Motivated.
objects.title: Motivated

objects.text: "I'm telling you! Alpharius is still alive! Dorn killed Omegon or an Alpha Legionnaire. He must be working in the shadows, loyal to The Emperor!" "Dude! Get a life." They say you had a identical twin or that it was perfect CGI or that the bullets were blanks. To some, even if you were killed in front of them, your cooling corpse laid by their feet and a mountain of evidence proving it was truly you, they'd still doubt. You can use your talents in the field of spy craft to prey on the minds of these people, manipulating their psyche to change your body in a favourable way to you. Perhaps, to the fringes of the internet, you are actually a state senator or the neighbour down the street or their very own family. The ordinary person would believe it to be the height of delusion, however, both are true now. Eventually, you can affect even the strongest of minds. They may think that they've escaped the rumours of your presence, that they are stalwart enough to ignore the whispers. They are wrong. Even a mind as strong as Rogal Dorn will forever be haunted by the hydra's coils, jumping at shadows and always believing that you're just round the corner, ready to eliminate them. At the peak of this power, when the divine tries to make them see the truth. They fail.
objects.title: Did Dorn Kill Alpharius? Or Was It Omegon?

objects.text: Turns out a being with wise in it's title is smart enough to teach itself to speak, really this should have been obvious. The Wise Horse can now speak any language you can, which might actually be a problem with how much it likes to give it's two cents on most matters. Luckily it's knowledge is usually pretty helpful, even if it does like to talk your ears off.
objects.title: Straight From The Horse’s Mouth

objects.text:
You have come to understand a dark truth about Empathic Mimicry, just as Sylar learned that he could use his abilities in the same way as Empathic Mimicry, you have learned the opposite. An understanding that Intuitive Aptitude is just the other side of the coin, that is, Empathic Mimicry. Gaining the ability to comprehend things through looking at them and understanding the mechanisms behind their inner workings, even if understanding would be impossible. Through your understanding of things, you can replicate them, gaining powers without a limit towards the number of powers you can replicate, nor the restriction of thinking of the person's power you are copying. 

The main function of Intuitive Aptitude isn't copying powers; it is the understanding of the world around you, as you can understand complex or esoteric phenomena instinctively, regardless of how simple or complex. Reverse engineering and understanding complex technology well beyond modern science, without having a background in such fields, you quickly understand the mechanisms and engineering behind anything. You also gain an understanding of any power that you copy or already possess, understanding the mechanics behind it and having finer control over it than before, beyond what the original owner would be capable of.

The power also comes with a 'hunger' for more knowledge and power. This hunger for power can drive you to do things you would otherwise be unwilling to do, killing innocent people to understand the mechanics behind their powers and copying them for yourself. With time, you can learn to control or keep in check this hunger for knowledge and power; however, unless you have another power to conquer it, you will never truly eliminate it, only suppress it.
objects.title: Two Sided Coin (Heroes)

objects.text: Your flames now burn with the majestic presence of Leo, transforming them into a spectacle that inspires as much as it destroys. When others witness your flames, they feel their own courage kindled in response, and your fire's power grows not only from your triumph over fear but from the collective courage of all who believe in you. This removes any upper limit on your flames' potential intensity, as the belief of many can reach heights no single soul could achieve alone, potentially scaling to the temperatures found at the core of a supernova when enough hearts burn bright together. Your fire also takes on the guiding nature of Sagittarius, becoming a tool of revelation rather than mere destruction. Your flames can now dispel illusions on sight, burning away falsehoods both magical and perceptual. By gazing into your fire, you can receive visions of paths forward, prophecies of what may come, and glimpses of truths hidden from normal sight. The fire that once only consumed now illuminates, lighting the way for you and all who follow.
objects.title: Fire Triplicity, Guiding Stars

objects.text:
You’ve been exposed to Dragon Radiation, triggering a process known as Primal Dragonization. Fortunately, you’ve retained full control over both your Septima and your emotions, allowing you to wield these newfound abilities with precision and intent.

You’ve also gained access to a transformation called Armed Phenomenon. While this state typically requires a device such as a Glaive or a Binding Brand, you can activate it freely at will. In addition to significantly amplifying your strength, Armed Phenomenon generates advanced technological enhancements tailored to complement your Septima. For instance, Jota—an adept capable of manipulating photons—manifests rocket boots and five autonomous attack drones known as Photon Bits when entering this form.
objects.title: Draconic Armed Phenomenon (Azure Striker Gunvolt)

objects.text:
You have ascended to the eighth level of the Lifewave, becoming an Octimal Adept, becoming the second being to naturally hold an Octima after Moebius. Octimas are essentially the next level from Septimas, with their power level being compared to the divine. 

Your power increases to an extraordinary level—enough to potentially devastate the entire world if fully unleashed. Gunvolt as a Primal Dragon produced enough energy in this form to power all of Japan singlehandedly even while being restrained by a thousand Glaives, and it was indicated he was very close to reaching the level of an Octima. 

Your Octima allows you full domination over the seventh level of the Lightwave, allowing you to use multiple high level Septimas at once while enhancing them with the Muse. Your Armed Phenomenon will shift and adapt to the Septimas you choose to wield. Over time, you can train your Octima into replicating other Octimas such as Astral Order. Finally, you can also transform into a Primal Dragon form similar to the one taken by Gunvolt.
objects.title: Octima (Azure Striker Gunvolt)

objects.text:
Your simulations no longer require prior knowledge or analysis to be carried out. They now possess all the necessary information to simulate anything with fidelity equal to reality itself. You can even simulate abstract and supernatural phenomena that you may have never witnessed. You are also no longer limited by the number of variations you can perform, nor will you lose precision in the process.

This does not grant omniscience or multitasking capabilities. You must still seek out information by your own means in order to assimilate as much knowledge as possible and make proper use of it. It will not overload or paralyze your mind; you will simply feel confused when confronted with an overwhelming amount of information.

With the ease at which you can modulate your perspective and immersive experience through your base power, you are now capable of maintaining or reducing the mental strain of any power that requires such effort.

If a form of magic depends on your imagination to shape a desired spell or phenomenon, you can now form such constructs with great ease and instantaneously. If you possess a power capable of generating a force field but containing many variables that you must consciously manage, you can either visualize all of them or allow your own power to handle the complexity.

Keep in mind that this new feature is not simply a hyper-advanced computer. It is, in fact, a power capable of visualizing reality itself in the form of a simulation.
objects.title: Authentic Model

objects.text:
You can instantly snap into the deepest, most primal parts of rage at will, bringing the full power of your wrath to the surface. While your lucidity and cognitive functions are still compromised, your actions become much more in line with what you would've done while sober.

For example, against an opponent that outclassed you, activating this would raise your combat prowess and skill with your abilities far beyond your normal capacity. If you are in desperate need of strength to overcome an obstacle, this becomes a viable method to gain exactly that. It can even be used in small bursts to stay focused on a task at hand or keep your adrenaline running during sports.

You can set a designated goal, timer, or condition in your head upon activating this state. Once it's fulfilled or there's no need to remain enraged, you will automatically regain your sanity and lucidity, which will be akin to waking up from a daydream. You retain no mental strain from this process, aside from mild disorientation at worst.
objects.title: Crash Out!

objects.text:
While you would usually begin as a CAT 1 Exorcist or Sin, for each purchase you may go up one category. from starting as a full Category 2 ‘Geist’ only slightly superior to a regular human and capable of affecting small groups with your abilities, to a Category 7 ‘Demon God’ capable of moving at the speed of a jet fighter and affecting thousands at a time, your range spanning across the horizon.

Both Exorcists and Sins are measured against this scale, with most Exorcists not surviving long enough to surpass CAT3.
objects.title: Category Increase (CAIN)

addons.text:
You are a Drifter, a thing that’s made its way into reality during a Sin’s manifestation, yet is separate from it. With a tenuous connection to reality, you exhibit many of the qualities associated with both Sins and Exorcists with no clear cause. None the less you are a psychic entity capable of immense harm at high Categories.

Practically this means you can exhibit both Blasphomies and Domains, though it’s likely in actuality they’re coming from the same source, hybridising together and merely expressing differently.

A side benefit is that your growth is not gated by Sin Events. You still must undergo a similar process, feeding (though not by necessity) in order to fuel a moment of apotheosis, but as this occurs from a separate mechanism it’s unlikely to have as disastrous and fatal consequences for the surrounding area and humans as Sin Events do.
addons.title: Drifter (CAIN)

objects.text: By any human standard, exorcists are terrifying living weapons: able to kill with a gesture or bend the laws of reality to their whim. However, compared to their quarry, they often still die in droves. Those who break and come back together stronger still though, are something truly special. These Virtues are marked as Category 4 in their own right, capable of affecting entire buildings with their blasphemies and keeping pace with trains. But beyond this, each Virtue gives access to a distinct ‘High Blasphemy’ they and anyone they’re sufficiently bonded with, can use. For instance, Justice’s High Blasphemy, ‘Law’, allows the user to designate a ‘Law’ for the area around them by declaring ‘In the Court, ____ is/are _____’ with particular favourites being ‘Bullets are Repulsed’ and ‘Blood is Air’. This is only temporary however and takes considerable psychic energy to accomplish more than once. Hope’s ‘Veil’ Meanwhile lets the user erase memories at the cost of commensurately valuable memories of their own. Ten Minutes only causes stress, but days at a time might lead to core memories vanishing from the user’s mind, and full resets leave them a hollow husk erased and unknown to the world and themselves.
objects.title: Virtue (CAIN)

objects.text: You are not an exorcist, but a Sin, a failure of mankind made manifest. Sins are usually created fully formed when a sufficiently psychic being undergoes a traumatic event, but when an Exorcist dies of Overflow it creates an imago, a small nascent True Sin that’s more intelligent and often more spiteful than its brethren. As a Sin, you’re mostly invisible, with most people being unable to see sins, though some sins are partly visible to non-psychic humans, who find the information hard to process. As you begin as an Imago, you're rather weak, relying on their new rending claws, teeth or other physical changes to escape harm and pupate into a full Sin. Its initial Category strength is largely dependent on the Exorcist that spawned it. Sinss do not have Blasphemies, but rather three Domains that are informed by their Type. These range from the Ogre’s ‘The Unseeing of Things’ which presents a cloying dark that shrouds it from all sight to the Hound’s ‘The Annihilation of the Wicked’ which allows it to produce and consume firearms and weapons it can fire at will (including napalm-loaded grenade launchers). Additionally, all Sins have a Palace, a pocket dimension lair of sorts where it can heal, as it cannot be truly killed outside of it, merely disappearing back to the Palace when injured enough. The entrances to Palaces are rudimentary to find with any level of psychic talent however, and if the Sin is caught outside of it it can be summoned to it at any time by anyone inside (where they can fight to kill it permanently). Further growth is achieved through Sin Events, traumatic psychic veil ruptures that occur after a Sin has metabolised enough psychic experiences from their host. These events are usually fatal to normal humans in its radius and scale from Category 1-7 with each time a Sin undergoes an evolution of apotheosis. A Category 1 Sin Event roughly covers the radius of a city block. They do not scale linearly. Exorcists and Sins both begin at Category 1. Normal humans are Category 0. Beyond the sin’s Category, each has a Type, defined by the experience that spawned it or the life of the Exorcist that made the Imago. These ‘Types’ are; Ogres: A massive sin that feeds off despair and summons a choking miasma to cloak and smother the area Idols: A charismatic sin that manipulates and pulls strings from behind the scenes, forming a cult around itself. Hounds: The embodiment of rage, a hound usually manifests post-mortem - forming a grudge against a specific group of people and hunting them down violently. Centipedes: A vile sin drawing its power from hatred and escapism that is widely feared for its ability to infect and transform hordes of mundane humans. Toads: Unusually intelligent sins that delight in material wealth, they covet what their host could not have, and steal to form a massive hoard from which they draw their power And Lords: Appearing after their host suffers a calamity or tragedy, a lord appeals to their sense of nostalgia and loss, restoring them to their former glory and creating a parasitic pocket reality called a kingdom that slowly consumes the real world. Finally, a Sin can take three forms; Severed (I) where the Sin is a free agent as a psychic being as is its host (though they are still tethered) acting with its own needs and priorities, Fused (II) Where it has fused to the Host’s body creating an amalgamated being that is usually humanlike (the Sin is often, but not always, in control of this amalgam), and Bound (III) When a human Exorcist is able to control and command it separately from themselves.
objects.title: Imago (CAIN)

objects.text:
Perfect Sins, though thankfully rare, are what happens when a sin host is able to partially manifest but suppress a Sin from developing for months or years. This resistance mans that when it eventually breaks through its host's willpower and fully manifests, it is more vicious, more extreme in its appetites, and vastly more powerful. 

Additionally, Imago, Sins that were once Exorcists have a vastly higher likelihood to become Perfect Sins than any other manifestation, making them of special consideration.

As a result of their unique development Perfect Sins in addition to their bespoke benefits are doubly potent as their normal counterparts. The weakest a Perfect Sin can be is equivalent to a Category 3, Sin, with a theoretical ‘Category 4’ Perfect Sin eclipsing anything even measurable on the contemporary Category Scale.

The varying Type of the Sin enhances them further, from the Perfect Hound, a dervish on the battlefield healing as it’s harmed and striking with truly demonic speed, to the Perfect Lord who can pull whomever it wishes into its territory whenever it so pleases and renders them unable to be aided. 

Perfect Sins are monstrous enough that CAIN agents are advised when facing CAT 6 Perfect Sins to simply call an orbital strike on an area as it will be safer, cheaper, and cause less loss of life and property than a conventional battle in most cases.
objects.title: Perfect (CAIN)

objects.text:
You have attained a realm called One With Nature. While Seamless Sublimity focuses inward on the absolute elimination of technical flaws and the maximisation of internal efficiency, One With Nature turns its focus outward, dissolving the boundary between the observer and the observed.

One With Nature represents environmental integration, it harmonises the user with the world around them, enabling profound integration with both nature and external objects. Instead of imposing their will upon the environment, the user adapts seamlessly to it, moving in accordance with its natural flow.

In ordinary combat, even an expert fighter must perceive a threat, process it, decide on a response, transmit signals through the nervous system, and then move your muscles to execute an action. One With Nature eliminates this entire chain of processing. Because the weapon is systemically regarded as a literal extension of the body, the user does not truly "hold" or "swing" it. If you think to block, the sword is already there.

One With Nature also extends this principle to the entire environment, eliminating the gap between intent and action across the surrounding space. There is no separation between thought and execution, and no friction between intention and motion. Every movement occurs at the absolute limit of the user's raw speed, with no wasted motion, kinetic inefficiency, or human error.

This state allows the user to perfectly perceive, blend with, and interact with the surrounding flow of energy and space, achieving a level of environmental awareness and synchronisation that borders on instinctive omnipresence within their immediate surroundings.

Your realm is a constant part of your existence; it can operate continuously at full capacity without any drawbacks on your body, mind, or, soul, and you can enter and exit it whenever you want.
objects.title: One With Nature (Second Coming of Gluttony)
Wolfkin (Wheel Of Time)
objects.text:
You are a Wolfkin, a person with special genetic traits that grant you multiple abilities. Your eyes can shift from their natural human color to a vibrant, luminous golden-yellow, and you can freely change them back and forth between the two colors at will.

You have mastered all Wolfkin abilities, which include: Psychic communication with more than one wolf or Wolfkin over a large distance. Psychic location, the ability to tell how far away wolves and other Wolfkin are. Better vision, which includes being able to see farther in normal conditions and being able to see in the dark. An augmented sense of smell, which not only makes your sense of smell extremely sensitive but also allows you to smell things that would not logically have an origin, such as human emotions and other states such as distrust or madness.

You can also connect to and enter Tel'aran'rhiod, also known as the Dreamworld, during your sleep and even in the flesh. Tel'aran'rhiod is a parallel world where all possibilities connect. It is linked to the worlds that exist within the local multiverse. The World of Dreams is a mirror of the waking world, except that it is a non-permanent one. Tel'aran'rhiod can be extremely dangerous and lead to injuries carried into the waking world, even death.

The key to mastering the dream world is your willpower and to always remember that it is a dream; if a person accepts something happening as reality that person may become trapped in the dream. Conversely, one must keep his or her personal appearance solid and unchanging, a Dreamwalker must focus on and think of themselves as real. You start as a beginer in this art.

Finally, you gain the ability to have prophetic dreams in which you dream of events that show the future.

objects.title: Aura Manifestation
objects.text: Not only can your aura be seen, but now you can physically manifest it at the cost of mental stamina. As an example, if your ego was being able to recover from any defeat or setback, represented by a phoenix, then you could conjure the phoenix and its flames as actual fire. While you initially can't sustain manifestation of your aura for more than a minute at a time, this will increase with training. If you wish, this can selectively apply to the auras of those whose egos you have awakened.

objects.title: Starry Eyes of Editing
objects.text:
Your eyes have evolved; no longer limited to simply hard-wiring the minds into absolute loyalty, you can now freely manipulate the minds of your targets however you desire. You can edit their personalities and memories, look through their thoughts and feelings, and do anything else with their mind you can imagine.
