Unlike inducing loyalty, this process requires much more concentration and, as such, can only be done on one person at a time unless you have the means of splitting your attention to multiple targets.

objects.title: Media Clone
objects.text:
Instead of simply acting within the recording, you can now manifest a fully physical body through any recording of yourself that is currently being viewed. The time and effort it takes depends on the quality of the recording, as well as the size of the viewing device, since you will need to physically crawl out of the screen. However, even should the device be too small for you to manifest, you can still project a body as a solid hologram-like apparition.

All bodies manifested in such a way retain all the powers you possessed at the moment a recording was taken, and are connected to you in a hive mindlike fashion, allowing you to command them all simultaneously.

addons.title: Theoretical Existence
addons.text:
Your entire existence is inseparably tied to information about yourself. In case of your death, you can resurrect yourself, with all your abilities intact, from any information related to you, from video recordings and memories to something as inconsequential and barely related as trace data in the targeting system logs of a weapon used to kill you.

The scarcer and more indirect the information, the longer it will take for you to resurrect, but eventually, you will be able to restore yourself completely even through something such as a statement about a theoretical possibility of your existence.

objects.title: Counterintelligence
objects.text:
Now, you are aware of every single bit of information related to you. Be it in someone's memories, a photo, a book, or even supernatural methods of divination or simulation.

You possess total control over all this information, able to change or erase it at will, and even—should the medium of the information allow it—act through it. For example, should someone actively think of you, you will be able to converse with them inside their mind; should someone try to scry on you, you can either deny any such attempts or even hijack them and insert whatever false information you desire.

Due to the possibly overwhelming amount of information you may need to manage, you can fully delegate this task to your subconsciousness, as it will modify any and all information just as you would've liked. Of course, you can assume direct conscious control whenever you desire.

objects.title: Merk! (Nexus)
objects.text: You no longer derive power from the Merk Drizripool, but instead are a Merk! A being of incredible psychic might. Where once your phenomenal power was restrained by your dealings with a higher power and the dreams to occupy you, you’re now free to use it as you wish. The Merk of Ylum for instance used this power to empower ‘lesser’ species like Humans, Thunes, and Demons to ‘police’ their species by killing mass murderers, and had enough to easily match millions of psychic heads acting in unison against one of these servants. You apply your telepathy to ambiently stabilise an impossible planetary orbit with little focus, drain the energy from a star, or begin your ‘ascension’ to higher planes. Alternatively, rather than a Merk you can choose to be from one of the other non-linear species, like the Hwang or the ❒.

addons.text: Not only can you make effects permanent, you can also amplify them over time. A shield that has been made permanent can increase in durability with each passing day, or a buff that has been turned permanent can become even more powerful and gain new effects. Time is now on your side. Whether you're enhancing the resilience of your shields or adding more functionalities to your powers, the possibilities are endless. The effects grow at a similar rate to dynamist jr.
addons.title: Perpetual Growth

objects.text: This is just unfair. You hold the power of Infinity, allowing you to extend the duration of any magic spell you cast for as long as you want, making it impossible for it to run out until you say it should end. Flames that burn forever, ice that never melts, and even stopping one’s own time are all within reach, normally impossible because of the energy drain they’d incur.
objects.title: Infinity (The Seven Deadly Sins)

objects.text: Now, you can extend the duration of any effect produced by any of your powers. Constructs never fade, opened portals can last forever, and a launched beam can travel endlessly until it hits something.
objects.title: Eternity

objects.text:
The laws of magic are something mages spend their whole lives trying to understand. To grasp these truths and to master them is what it means to be a magician. But you? You don't care about anything like petty laws. Laws exist for one reason: to be broken. 

You're a one-of-a-kind, a presence that makes magic itself tremble. You have incredible intuition towards sensing the boundaries and limitations of any magical system you encounter, and more importantly, you can break them.

Given enough time and understanding, even the most undeniable magical laws bend to your will. It starts with small changes—removing chants or bypassing components. Then, it progresses—crafting spells through loopholes or twisting energies to alter the very nature of your magic. Eventually, you reach the pinnacle: breaking the laws of magic.

However, despite your anomalous existence, this isn’t an instant win. You need time and effort to master each system, discovering the weaknesses and how to break each law in them. The more complex the magic, the longer it takes to break. With enough time and research, you can push any magic to its limits and achieve anything.
objects.title: Lawbreaker

addons.text: The upgrade to your mana capacity also applies to your Second Origin, essentially quadrupling your mana capacity with each purchase.
addons.title: Want Some More Mana with That Pool?

objects.text:
A Second Origin is a dormant container of magical power within a mage's body aside from their main one. By unlocking this container of magical power, you have doubled the amount of magical power that you originally had access to.

The magical power in this new container can be tapped into continuously or be reserved as a trump card for a more protracted battle.
objects.title: Second Origin Release (Fairy Tail)

objects.text: You have unlocked another dormant magical container. This container functions the same as your second origin release in every way, including addon interactions.
objects.title: Another One

objects.text:
Each purchase doubles the size of your mana pool. This increase, no matter how large, can't harm you and doesn't decrease your mana control.   

Note: This growth is exponential.
objects.title: Doubled Mana Capacity

objects.text:
Just as physical regeneration allows a user to recover health over time at an accelerated rate, mana regeneration enables the recovery of depleted internal magical energy at an enhanced pace. However, this ability does not grant you a source of internal magic if you don't already possess one. The mana regenerated is self-produced, meaning it does not come from the external environment. You remain limited by the maximum capacity of your internal magic reserves.

In addition to your natural recovery rate, the first purchase allows you to restore 25% of your maximum mana in 15 minutes. The second purchase increases this to 50% in 5 minutes, and the third purchase enables full recovery from empty to full within a single minute.
objects.title: Mana Regeneration

objects.text:
When your mana is full you continue to "regenerate" it. However instead of raising your capacity or overflowing into a buffer, the mana is instead expelled in the form of crystalline scales. The scales can be pulled off with minimal effort, however doing so hurts about as much as stubbing your toe. 

If not pulled off prematurely the scales will fall off an hour after they spawn. You can also choose a threshold of skin coverage to have them all fall of simultaneously when you obtain this power. This threshold cannot be changed unless you have holding back. 

The scales can be used in place of your internal mana or used to restore it. Each scale fully forms at roughly 5% of your maximum mana and contains it until used. Scales do not degrade over time but are rather fragile.
objects.title: Crystalline Scales

objects.text:
If you wish, you can keep your crystalline scales on your body indefinitely. They will no longer fall off automatically after one hour, remaining in place until you consciously choose to detach them. Scales that stay attached have their storage capacity doubled, with each one able to contain up to 10% of your maximum mana instead of the usual 5%. Note that scales occupying skin space reduce the area available for new scales to form, slowing your overall scale production while they remain attached.

Any mana you generate after your attached scales have reached their full storage capacity is used to permanently reinforce and fortify the scales' structure. This process continuously increases their durability and toughness without any upper limit, passively forging them into a formidable armor. If a reinforced scale is ever broken, its entire stored mana is either instantly transferred to refill your internal mana pool or used to temporarily surge your physical strength if you mana pool is full. Afterwards the broken scale detaches.

You may selectively keep the original one-hour auto-shedding timer for scales that form on specific areas of your body. This still doesn’t give you a mana pool if you don’t have one.
objects.title: Crystal Dragon

objects.text:
As a mage, you have a special talent and a knack for manipulating magical energy and effects, which allow you to wield magic at a level of optimization and efficiency far surpassing that of your peers of a similar level of skill and experience.

This lets you cast a spell with the same strength and power as others, but only at one-fourth of the cost.

For example, if a regular mage uses 10 mana to cast a fireball spell that deals 10 damage, then you could cast the same spell using only 2.5 mana, or cast it at full cost to deal 40 damage instead.

As you continue to hone this talent further, you could achieve an even greater level of optimization and efficiency. This, on its own, does not give you any magical power or spell; it simply enhances the use of what you already possess.
objects.title: Efficiency Casting

objects.text:
Casting one spell at a time is a limitation reserved for novices and beginners. Any mage worth their salt must have at least some proficiency in multi-casting to be considered a true professional. Fortunately, in this regard, you’re a natural.

You possess a rare talent for multitasking while casting spells. While others may struggle to maintain two or three spells simultaneously, you can effortlessly juggle a dozen at once.

From the start, you're capable of casting three times as many spells as a mage of your level typically could. As you continue to refine this talent, your capacity for multicasting will grow even further.

Just remember to pace yourself; blowing through all your magical reserves in one big fat load can leave you quite drained and exhausted afterward. This ability does not grant you any specific spells or magical power on its own; it simply enhances how many you can cast at once.
objects.title: Multi Casting

objects.text: You possess a unique talent known as Compound Casting—a form of magic that allows the caster to merge the power and properties of two or more spells into a single, enhanced effect. For example, you could combine fire and water to produce steam, earth and wind to summon a sandstorm, water and sunlight to generate a laser, or earth and fire to create lava—or even glass. A healing spell could be fused with a toxin-cleansing spell to perform both functions at once, while a binding spell could be paired with weakening curses to better restrain your enemy. With this talent, you instinctively understand how to blend spells into entirely new effects, even when the magics involved are seemingly opposed or incompatible. Another advantage of Compound Casting over traditional magic is that the resulting spell’s potency far exceeds the sum of its parts. The more spells you combine, the greater the multiplier effect. For instance, if a Fireball spell deals 10 damage and costs 10 mana, then: Combining two Fireballs would deal 40 damage for 20 mana. Combining three would deal 90 damage for 30 mana. Combining four would deal 160 damage for 40 mana. In short, the power of a compound spell equals the total potency of all contributing spells multiplied by the number of spells combined. Initially, you can merge up to four spells at once. With time and practice, this limit will increase. This talent synergizes especially well with Multi-Casting and Efficiency Casting. Keep in mind, however, that this ability does not grant you any spells or magical power on its own—it simply allows you to fuse multiple spells into one.
objects.title: Compound Casting

objects.text: Spell crafting is usually reserved for expert mages or magical researchers. But unlike many, you have a natural talent for spell crafting, the art of making or rewriting structured magical phenomena, be it through rewriting, combining, or even creating new magical effects. To complement this, you have an innate sense of whether what you're trying to craft is possible with your current knowledge and mastery of magic, or whether it's impossible with the magic system entirely. Additionally, you find spell crafting safer than it usually is, though only to the extent that its unlikely failed attempts would be lethal.
objects.title: Spell Engineer

objects.text:
You have gained the ability to naturally use more mana than you possess, at a cost. Whenever you use more mana than you have, you go into a "debt," and while in debt, you cannot access any of your mana until you naturally regenerate the amount you used. You can only draw a maximum of 5 times your mana pool's worth of debt. This debt applies the moment you stop using mana.

Note: This also removes the side effects of mana exhaustion.
objects.title: Mana Debt

objects.text:
Inside you is a vast reservoir of mana. Where a normal mage might exhaust themselves after an hour of nonstop casting, you can chain continuous high-level spells for a quarter of a day before depleting your mana reserves. Your mana also possesses two unique traits that set you apart from most magi.

The first trait is that each night at the stroke of midnight and each day at noon, your mana pool fully restores itself, regardless of how much energy you've expended or how much your pool has grown from its original size. During the witching hour (from midnight to 3 a.m.) and the zenith hour (from noon to 3 p.m.), your mana becomes effectively infinite, and the power of your spells doubles in strength.

The second trait is that you now possess a unique connection to the sun and the moon, which are often tied to and empower magic, which in turn grants you exceptional proficiency in any magic you choose to learn. Unlike most, who are limited by innate affinities, you can potentially master any form of magic, as long as it’s not an inborn or exclusive trait of a species. For instance, if you typically only have an affinity for Water magic, this ability would allow you to learn and wield Fire magic, even if it was previously impossible for you.

While this power grants you an immense amount of mana and full regeneration at midnight and midday, it comes with a limitation. Your mana from this power alone will not regenerate until either peaks happen, meaning if you somehow run dry before then, you will need alternative methods to replenish it.

This power doesn’t grant you specific spells or magical abilities. Instead, it functions as both an energy source and a significant enhancement to any magic you may learn.
objects.title: Equinox Well

addons.text:
Your ability to use alternative interpretations of magic and your ability to treat the world as if it were normal synergize, allowing you to treat magic as if it were mundane, and the mundane as if it included magic.

You can now see and interact with the world around you as if only the interpretations of magic you believe in were in effect, and any magic that doesn't follow your interpretation does not exist to you, and therefore cannot affect you.
addons.title: What Do You Mean Magic?

addons.text:
Your ability to use alternative interpretations of magic and your ability to possess alternative and opposite expressions synergize, giving you the ability to transform any magic you own to fit any scenario or situation. If you're unable to find a solution using your magic normally, then use its opposite; if that doesn't work, you can interpret it differently. If that still doesn't work, you can use the opposite of your interpretation, or an interpretation of the magic's opposite expression.

For example; you can use fire magic, interpreting it as heat magic as fire is just an exothermic reaction that releases energy in the form of heat, then you can use the opposite expression of heat magic, and as heat is just average kinetic energy, and the opposite of that is average potential energy, so now you can use your interpretive expression of fire magic to manipulate gravity.
addons.title: Interpretation begets Expression

addons.text: Your ability to use alternative expressions of magic and your ability to enforce the physical laws synergize. Now, similarly, yet differently from magic, you are able to interpret science. Now, science can truly explain everything; any miracle that happens to you, any phenomenon you come across, can be explained through science, and as such, be completely reproducible. Of course, some phenomena are harder to understand than most, but now, everything is explainable using science. Such things as "magic" and "mysteries" don't exist; it's all just science, and everything is explainable using the physical laws.
addons.title: This is Very Scientific

objects.text:
You are now able to use stranger and alternative interpretations of magic you own.

For example, you can now use creation magic to create antimatter, or strange quarks, or even matter with only up or down quarks, breaking the laws of physics. If you’re a necromancer, you can see spirits and souls of every living being, not just humans, including the Neanderthals, dinosaurs and giant insects, or even that of viruses, fungi, plants and bacteria.

When you create artifacts, instead of a fire spellsword, you can create a sword that spells out the word fire. Instead of a cloak of invisibility, you can create an invisible cloak, the interpretation of puns and homonyms.

You could also crush an air conditioner as an ingredient for potions for the symbolic meaning of circulation of air to cure fevers, or you could also crush a fridge into powder as material for a potion for the same effect. You are also able to use the internet as a transmission point for diseases, and you can treat death as a sickness to create a cure to death itself. Modern and abstract symbolism is still symbolism.

For elemental attributes, you could interpret the western fire, water, air and earth in a more eastern expression, in that of fire, water, wood, metal, and earth. As for how they correspond? It's your interpretation.

You could make somebody fall into an illusion in a dream, even if that wasn’t their physical form; since they can still talk, act and hit in the same way, then of course it’s plausible that this is the real world, causing somebody to fall into a dream in a dream.

The laws of magic and their interactions now bend to your interpretations of them.
objects.title: Mystical Interpretation

addons.text:
Your existence is a paradox, a living singularity where biological and arcane collide. When harmed, your physical form unravels into raw mana, only to coalesce anew from the very energy released in its destruction. It is almost impossible for you to die unless you run out of mana or face an attack strong enough to annihilate you in your entirety.

This cycle is no mere healing. Each time your body reforms, it slowly evolves. Survive dragon’s fire for long enough, and your skin will grow fireproof. Endure enough vampiric bites, and your blood will refuse to leave your veins. These adaptations are permanent, silent, and inevitable—an arms race against existence itself.

Your thaumavore appetite has transcended mere sustenance—it is a ravenous singularity. Spells you cast claw hungrily at the world, tearing life and mana from whatever they touch. Enemies struck find their strength siphoned, their magic drained to feed your inexorable tide, your own reserves slowly but surely growing with every victim consumed.

You are the apex predator of the arcane. To oppose you is to feed a storm that grows fiercer with every strike.
addons.title: Arcane Titan

objects.text:
Whenever you spend mana, you get 80% of it back as raw vitality that heals you, and any excess vitality is converted back into mana. Similarly, when you take damage, you gain mana equal to 80% of the vitality lost, and any excess mana is converted back into vitality.

Effectively, this means that casting a spell while unhurt recovers 80% of the mana spent. Likewise, if you were to get hurt while your mana is at full capacity, you would heal 80% of the damage.
objects.title: Arcane Life Cycle

objects.text:
You have unlocked a skill that significantly enhances your ability to perform magical incantations with unparalleled speed. At its core, High-Speed Incantation allows you to speak the words of a spell at an accelerated pace, drastically reducing the time required to cast.

As your mastery grows, this skill evolves further. You will gain the ability to compress complex phrases into a single word, making your spells even faster to perform. Upon reaching full mastery, you transcend the need for spoken words entirely, allowing you to cast spells instantly without the need for incantations.

This doesn’t give any magic by default, only enhances your ability to cast spells at higher speeds. While this can be used without magic, all it will do is allow you to speak really fast while somehow still being legible.
objects.title: High-Speed Incantation (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
Snap Cast is an ability that allows you to cast a spell without any of its usual requirements - effectively making the spell free. You bypass all normal casting conditions, including (but not limited to) mana costs, incantations, hand gestures, material components, charge times, and cast times.

Any spell that normally requires charging to reach its full power is treated as if it were fully charged when snap cast.

Using Snap Cast places it on cooldown. The cooldown depends on the energy cost and the amount of eschewed casting components. During this period, Snap Cast cannot be used. The cooldown can be reduced permanently through repeated use of Snap Cast, or temporarily by casting spells normally while the ability is on cooldown.

Note: Snap Cast does not grant the ability to use magic itself - it only allows you to bypass the requirements of spells you already know.
objects.title: Snap Cast (Mabinogi)

objects.text: You need only your thoughts and will to cast magic, removing the need to speak incantations, chants, or even components like handsigns, or preparing rituals entirely. This allows you to cast spells instantly and even multiple ones back to back, or at the same time.
objects.title: Silent Magician

objects.text:
You have unlocked the arts of Chanting and Naming, two powerful techniques that allow you to shape and amplify magic through ritualistic expression and recognition.

Chanting enhances any spell or mana-based ability by extending its invocation. The longer and more symbolic the chant, the more powerful the effect. Chants can be spoken, gestural, or a combination of both, with mixed forms yielding the best results.

Naming allows a spell or ability to be formally recognized by the world, reducing its mana cost and increasing its efficiency. The act of Naming is initially draining, but once established, the spell permanently benefits from the reduced cost and increased effectiveness. However, Named spells become harder to alter, as frequent changes weaken the world’s recognition of them. This also applies to passive abilities, which remain unchanged until their Named active effect is invoked. When activated, the ability temporarily surges in power before returning to its normal passive state, triggering a cooldown before it can be surged again.

Named spells can be used alongside Chanting, allowing for even greater enhancements. While simply invoking a Named spell grants its benefits, incorporating a chant further amplifies its power. Instead of just stating the spell’s name, you can weave it into a structured invocation, layering verses or movements to draw out more energy. This combination merges the efficiency of Naming with the raw potency of Chanting, creating spells that are not only easier to cast but also significantly stronger when fully invoked.

On its own, it does not grant new spells or magic.
objects.title: Naming! Chanting! Do You Speak It!?

objects.text:
You have the innate ability to draw upon any reservoir of mana or ambient mana to continuously reinforce your body. This process passively enhances your entire physique—from your skin and muscles to your bones and internal organs, whenever mana is available, making your body constantly enriched and fortified. You can take control of this already passive process to adjust the limit on how much mana it will draw from your passive amount to strengthen your body. You can also shift the mana strengthening your body to be more focused on specific parts of your body for greater reinforcement proportional to the expense of other areas.

The extent of this enhancement depends on how much mana you can access. Without any mana to draw upon, your body will quickly revert to its natural physical baseline. A small pool of mana might make you moderately stronger, giving the impression of being exceptionally fit—though this would only hold up under casual observation, not rigorous testing. However, with access to a large reservoir of mana, you could perform superhuman feats and potentially endure attacks powerful enough to destroy a house. The only limit is the amount of mana you can access or allow it to. Additionally, you can temporarily overcharge your physical abilities by deliberately channeling more mana into your body than usual.

While working out is not strictly necessary, maintaining a more physically fit body significantly increases the efficiency of mana enhancement. A fitter body allows you to gain greater benefits from the same amount of mana. Additionally, this ability provides a safeguard against the potential dangers of excess mana. Instead of breaking down or destroying your body, surplus mana will only serve to make you stronger.

It’s important to note that this ability does not grant its own mana pool but synergizes well with any mana sources you may acquire. This trait can optionally be hereditary.
objects.title: Mana Reinforced Body

objects.text:
It was a fleeting event, one unlikely to ever occur again. Yet, through some miraculous interdimensional accident, Od Laguna briefly linked with you, ultimately bestowing upon you a powerful version of the Divine Protection of Sorcery. This gift grants you complete compatibility with all affinities of any magic you currently know or will ever learn, while also elevating you to a level of mastery that rivals prodigies of legend.

For example, if you were a Magus, you would automatically surpass even an Average One, gaining the ability to wield the Five Great Elements as well as any other conceivable element, such as Imaginary Numbers, Nothingness, or Ether Clumps. Additionally, it would enhance your capacity to handle more esoteric magical energies, like Grain or True Ether. Your ability to learn magic would be so accelerated that you’d be considered a once-in-a-millennium prodigy, on par with the likes of Zelretch or Solomon.

The Divine Protection also greatly improves your ability to channel and regulate magical energy. You would be able to use the absolute minimum amount of energy required to perform any spell, significantly reducing strain and mitigating potential issues caused by excessive magic usage.

While this enhancement dramatically boosts your magical prowess, it doesn’t automatically teach you every spell of your chosen magic, allow you to break the inherent limits of your magical system, or make you completely immune to the drawbacks of certain magics. However, it does ensure that, in time, you will be considered one of the greatest—if not the greatest—practitioners of any magic you master.

As Od Laguna is not connected with you anymore, this ability is effectively yours and can't be lost like normal Divine Protections.
objects.title: Divine Protection of Sorcery (Re:Zero)

objects.text:
The strength of your magic now directly scales to your personal power. As you become more powerful, every spell, ritual, enchantment, and alchemical creation will naturally increase in potency. In the beginning, a simple fireball might only scorch a small area, but as you grow, that same fireball could evolve into a raging inferno, capable of reducing an entire city to ashes.

This progression applies to every form of magic you wield. A basic voice-altering spell might start as a subtle shift in tone, but over time, it could grant you the ability to mimic any sound, produce otherworldly voices, or even manipulate soundwaves on a global scale. Enchantments, potions, and rituals that once had limited effects or brief durations will become exponentially more powerful and long-lasting as your abilities develop—without requiring any extra effort.

Your magic doesn’t just scale with you; it evolves. As you grow stronger, your spells will refine themselves, unlocking new depths of power you never anticipated. Every cast, every creation, every enchantment will become sharper, more potent, and more profound. The stronger you become, the greater the impact of your magic.
objects.title: Magic Flux

objects.text:
You have the innate ability to solidify your spells into tangible, physical forms. This allows you to forge weapons, armor, or even semi-autonomous minions directly from your spells, giving them a lasting physical presence.

A sword forged from Fireball releases an explosion with each strike, an armor piece woven from Life Drain siphons the vitality of attackers to mend your wounds, and a staff sculpted from Arcane Amplification empowers every spell channeled through it.

Manifesting these constructs reserves a portion of your mana pool, effectively reducing your available reserves until they are dismissed or destroyed. The power of the spell, as well as the complexity and scale of the construct, determine the upkeep cost. Activating them requires additional mana, though only a fraction of what it would cost to cast the full spell.

Additionally, these spell constructs are extremely stable, allowing you to overcharge them with additional mana to temporarily amplify their effects beyond their normal limits. However, overcharging too much may destabilize the construct, risking unintended magical surges or other side effects.

This does not give you magic alone; it merely acts as a generic magical upgrade for any systems you purchase through the CYOA or gain during your journey.
objects.title: Manifested Arcana

objects.text:
Something vast now dwells within you—a latent greatness that allows you to attune to the elemental foundations of any magical world or system you enter. By itself, this won't grant you any magic, though it does awaken an affinity—an intuitive resonance with a single element of your choosing, whether that be Fire, Void, Stars, or some more esoteric force that can be classified as an 'element.'

This affinity will also adapt to the nature of the world around you, manifesting through either a tinted soul, a specialized spirit root, or another innate trait that binds the chosen element to your essence, etc.

This connection runs so deep, so instinctive, that you are considered a once-in-a-generation genius in that field. Your grasp of that element may push the boundaries of what's known, inspiring techniques and insights that echo through history.

With this affinity, you don't merely wield your element—you redefine it. So long as you're willing to put in the work, you can pioneer new spells, mystic arts, and methods of manipulation, elevating your element to heights never before imagined.
objects.title: Elemental Affinity

objects.text: You may now acquire additional elemental affinities—or choose to deepen your connection to an existing one. Each purchase spent on compounding an element enhances your mastery, refining your control and expression of its power greatly.
objects.title: Additional Affinities

objects.text:
Your affinity now extends beyond a single element—granting you access to multiple elemental forces. However, this comes at the cost of choice. The elements you gain are predetermined, drawn from the most fundamental building blocks of the magic system you're in: the classic four elements, the five of Wuxing, or similar core sets. These are not rare or esoteric, but they are the foundational elements any novice mage or wizard is expected to learn and master.

Over time, you can gain additional associated elements. This can be done by either deeply immersing yourself in the new element or by exploring the nuances of a related element you already possess.

For example, you might develop a Lightning affinity by interacting with electricity directly or by using Wind as a conceptual and symbolic bridge—though this does depend on the magic system in question. Using both methods together will accelerate the process. Once your connection deepens enough, the new element will "slot in," granting you the same natural talent as your starting ones.
objects.title: Loved by the Elements

addons.text:
The fusion of your physical might and magic has the curious effect of greatly increasing the effectiveness of your ability to Bonus Cast spells. Based on your physical strength, the percent chance of triggering Bonus Cast increases. This can lead to a 100% chance of triggering it one or multiple times, up to the maximum +5.

However, the amount of physical strength required to reach 100% at each level increases exponentially. Such that gaining a 100% chance to Bonus Cast +5 spells would require an unimaginable amount of physical might.
addons.title: Brute Luck

objects.text:
Your spells now possess the same ability as the fearsome Ogre Magi, in that whenever you cast a spell, it has a percent chance to be cast again at no additional mana cost, one or more times. This results in creating terrifyingly powerful spells for little mana cost. When this power triggers, you can optionally select to combine the separately cast spells into one larger spell or split them between multiple targets.

Your spells gain the following:
50% chance for +1 bonus spell cast
25% chance for +2 bonus spell casts
12% chance for +3 bonus spell casts
6% chance for +4 bonus spell casts
3% chance for +5 bonus spell casts
objects.title: Bonus Cast (Dota)

objects.text: 「THE ULTIMATE FORM OF MAGIC!」 「Ultra Amplification」 allows you to forcibly draw out the absolute utmost magical potential of any spell you so wish. With this unique ability, even something as trivial as a spell meant to produce a few flickering sparks to light a campfire can be elevated into a GIGANTIC fireball capable of blowing away the side of a mountain on its own. However, this power is not all sunshine and rainbows. If you cannot withstand its backlash, amplifying a spell even once can knock you out for days—or longer. Ultra Amplification also places an intense strain on your magical reserves. Whilst it won't consume the full amount of magical energy theoretically required to outright cast a spell up to that level through brute force alone, it'll still cost you a pretty penny regardless. In practice, even a seasoned mage with a decade of experience could be laid low by a single use.
objects.title: Ultra Amplification Magic

objects.text:
You can prepare and cast your spells beforehand. You must spend whatever material or esoteric cost upfront, plus a small amount of investiture proportional to the strength of the spells stored.

There is a limit to how many spells you can store at once that is directly proportional to your magic strength: a novice may be able to store a single spell, while a veteran wizard can store two dozen spells at once.
objects.title: Vancian Casting

objects.text:
You can now conjure physical objects that store your spells, which can be remotely and telekinetically controlled, manipulated, and released at anytime. These objects must be no larger than palm sized but can take on any form, as well as have pre-coded conditions to activate their designated spell. 

You can also learn to imbue multiple spells into the object overtime and will have an instinctive awareness of how many you currently have. Once the object activates its stored spell, it dissipates into nothing.
objects.title: Spell Bombs

objects.text:
Your magic is exceptionally stable and resilient. Your spells are significantly harder to dispel, unravel, or degrade, allowing them to persist through anti-magic fields, thrive in hostile environments, and prevail in elemental clashes.

Offensive spells partially bypass magical resistances (though true immunities still apply), while defensive spells are correspondingly harder to circumvent. Additionally, you are insulated from all forms of magical backlash, instability, or backfiring.

This upgrade does not increase the raw power, scale, or cost efficiency of your spells; it simply ensures that they work as intended, endure longer, and fail far less often.
objects.title: Reinforced Magic

objects.text:
You can now be like a trojan, making the system of magic you interact with grant you privileges normally reserved for people that hold identities or statuses that have metaphysical significance. Essentially, this lets you assume any metaphysical status when interacting with magical and mystical forces. For example, dependent on how the magic you use works, you could assume the status of a saint when using holy magic to empower it, or you could let yourself be treated as the owner to bypass magical security systems.

This doesn’t let you change the system of magic you use to contain new statuses, you can only work with statuses that exist currently. Furthermore, taking on a status that doesn’t exist within the system of magic you interact with simply does nothing.
objects.title: Canonized

objects.text:
You have gained the ability to enhance spells by using your emotions. This has two main requirements: you have to be feeling the emotion, and the emotion has to be compatible with the purpose of the spell.

When feeling a genuine emotion strongly enough, this has the potential to not only triple the strength of the spell but also give it a unique effect, though for weaker emotions, you will only boost the spell by a smaller amount. 

The unique effect granted will be dependent on the purpose of the spell, specifically what you're using the spell for, and the emotion used to enhance the spell. For example, one such enhancement might be enhancing attack magic with anger/hate and gaining the ability to penetrate magical defenses. Another example would be using love to enhance a defensive spell to the point where it can block a supposedly unblockable curse from one of the most powerful magic users alive.  

While you can use a non-genuine emotion to enhance your casting, it will be significantly less effective. With mastery over your emotions, you may gain control over what unique effect your spells are granted, but currently, you have no such power.
objects.title: Emotional Caster

objects.text:
You can now freely edit and modify how statuses in mystical systems you interact with work. You can change the effects certain statuses have on magic, making it so that holy magic is no longer empowered by being a priest. Not only this, but you can now also change what statuses others have. For example. you could make a celestial cultivator be treated as a demonic cultivator, changing how qi interacts with them.

However, when editing statuses in a magic system, you are limited to effects that are possible within the magic system you interact with.
objects.title: Theogony

objects.text:
The Soul of Raw Magic is the culmination of Force Magic’s shaping power and Atmospheric Mana Manipulation’s control. Where once you relied on your own stamina to forge constructs of pure energy, or on the presence of ambient magic to direct the environment, these boundaries no longer apply. You are no longer just a caster or a manipulator. You have become a living source of primordial magic, able to weave the world itself into your will.

You pull directly from the ambient flows of the world, shaping the raw energy instantly into shields, missiles, weapons, and barriers. In places where magic is plentiful, this allows for practically endless casting, as the environment itself fuels your art. But this goes further, you seed your own environment with raw magical energy, even in once barren places. The longer you remain in an area, the denser its magical field becomes, until what was once dead and mundane begins to bloom with a base-level atmosphere of mana. Over time, entire landscapes can be reshaped, leaving behind forests of magic, crystals of condensed power, or leyline-like currents that persist long after your departure.

By spending time in a location, you align its mana to your presence. This creates “attuned domains” where your control is absolute: your spells are cheaper, stronger, and harder to counter. Attuned domains persist even after you leave, allowing you to control them no matter how far you are from them. Spells cast by others within your domain can be bent, weakened, or unraveled with ease. Enemy magic is nothing more than displaced raw energy, and you may claim it, redirect it, or feed it into your own constructs. Within areas saturated by your influence, your authority becomes absolute: force constructs grow stronger, spells cheaper, and even the environment begins to bend toward your intent.

Ultimately, the Soul of Raw Magic transforms you into a living leyline, a walking font of creation that carries magic wherever you go. You are both the architect and the soil from which magical ecosystems sprout. Worlds without magic will awaken in your presence; worlds rich in magic will become your dominion. With enough time and focus, you could seed entire realms with power and sculpt civilizations upon them, making you not only a master of magic but its source and origin.
objects.title: Soul of Raw Magic

objects.text: You can establish connections with other beings, turning them into your apostles and allowing them to—with your permission—draw upon your arsenal of spells and magical techniques, performing them with the same level of power and prowess you yourself are capable of. This ability is not without its limitations. To perform any magic, your followers must sacrifice something of equal metaphysical value to the cost of any actions you yourself would have had to spend to perform the magic. For example, an apostle not possessing any magical power of their own may sacrifice some of their lifeforce or stamina to cast the spell, or even a portion of their wealth. Alternatively, you can fund the entire process, devoting some of your own reserves to allow some of your followers to perform spells with no effort on their part. When your apostles perform these spells, if you do not sponsor the process entirely, a small part of your follower's sacrifice will find its way to you, slowly but surely empowering you. For example, those who use their lifeforce in place of mana will lengthen your lifespan; those who sacrifice their stamina will have yours improved slightly; and those who possess mana of their own and use this as payment will see your own reserves increased. The connection can be established either through physical contact or through the prayer of one wishing to become your apostle. This need not be true religious devotion, but as long as the person praying to you is aware of your existence and is asking for your patronage, you will get a subconscious ping about the incoming link and can accept or reject it at will. You can block out any incoming attempts at establishing such links if you do not wish to be distracted. Lastly, the connection cannot be separated unless you explicitly desire so and will persist even across universes.
objects.title: Spell Broker

objects.text:
While you aren't actually the reincarnation of Merlin, people will certainly believe you are due to your magical prowess. You possess the innate ability to cast spells silently and without the use of a focus. Your magic flows effortlessly from within, unhindered by traditional means of spell-casting. Your efficiency and control of magic are instinctual, allowing you to execute spells swiftly without any decrease in their potency and even reduce the amount of magical energy required to cast.

No magic is beyond your reach. Through observation and exposure, you can quickly learn and master any spell, even those you have only witnessed once. Inborn magical traits and abilities are also within your grasp, as your mastery over magic extends to its very foundations. No magical knowledge, regardless of its corrupting or dangerous nature, can harm you. You are shielded from the detrimental effects that would afflict others, allowing you to explore and utilize even the most treacherous and forbidden spells without consequence. 

Each time you cast magic, your powers expand and evolve. The mere act of wielding magic fuels your progression, enabling you to uncover new spells, theories, and insights into the vast realm of magic. There is no limit to the magic you can discover and harness. The rules and limitations of magic are mere guidelines to you. You possess the extraordinary ability to bend and break the traditional boundaries of magical practice. This grants you the capability to cast spells that would otherwise be deemed impossible, pushing the boundaries of magical potential.

This does not give you magic alone, it merely acts as generic magical upgrade for any systems you purchase through the CYOA or gain during your journey.
objects.title: Merlin Reincarnated

objects.text:
No longer is your genius bound to solely magic. Your prowess extends to all supernatural energies, regardless of how esoteric or unique they are. All inborn abilities, traits, and physiques can be gained with enough dedication. No supernatural knowledge, regardless of its corrupting or dangerous nature, can harm you. You are shielded from the detrimental effects that would afflict others, allowing you to explore and utilize even the most treacherous and forbidden supernatural knowledge without consequence. 

Every time you use your supernatural energies, your powers expand and evolve. The mere act of wielding them fuels your progression, enabling you to uncover new uses, theories, and insights into the vast realm of the supernatural. There is no limit to the fields you can discover and harness. The rules and limitations of your various energies are mere guidelines to you. You possess the extraordinary ability to bend and break the traditional boundaries of each practice. This grants you the capability to use supernatural energies in ways that would otherwise be deemed impossible, pushing the boundaries of their potential.

This does not give you any supernatural energy on it’s own, it merely acts as an upgrade for all systems you purchase through the CYOA or gain during your journey.
objects.title: Seeker of All That is Supernatural

objects.text: You have a weird mutation that allows you to treat your magical energy like a muscle, increasing the amount of mana you generate and can store by using it. Completely expending your energy for example increases its generation rate and total capacity by a whole 5% at minimum by the time you fully replenish it. Even small constant uses result in even smaller but constant increases. Any passive magic ability you have as a result causes constant growth.
objects.title: Adaptive Mana Reservoir

objects.text:
You can take whatever magic you have access to and ignore every lesson, principle, and carefully established rule about how it's supposed to grow. 

Instead of learning to shape a fireball with precision, you just cram more mana into the basic spark until it becomes a fireball through sheer volume. Instead of studying the theoretical foundations of telekinesis, you pour power into your intent to move an object until the universe has no choice but to let it move. 

Every spell you own follows the same path legitimate mages would take, from cantrip to mastered art, but you achieve each stage by forcing mana down its throat until it chokes into the next level of existence. You get the exact same fireball a fire mage would have after years of study, except yours cost ten times the mana to create and you learned it in minutes instead of years.

This form of growth comes with three weaknesses. Because you never learned why spells work, only that you can make them work, your foundations are minimal, making further growth harder and teaching impossible. Every spell improved this way also costs grotesquely more than it should, resulting in you burning through your reserves. And eventually you will hit a bottleneck where the mana required to force the next stage exceeds your total capacity, and there you stay until you find more power from somewhere else or until you give up and actually learn something.

The one mercy is that once you brute force your way to a new level, you now have that level to work with. Through repeated actual use, you can naturally start to reverse engineer the principles you skipped. With this understanding, your foundations improve, the cost lowers and thus, you can brute force it into a higher level even with the same mana pool as before.

This grants no magic system or ability to use magic on its own.
objects.title: Brute Force Mage

addons.title: Forced Evolution
addons.text:
Your ability to brute-force magic allows you to forcefully evolve a spell by overloading it with magical energy while intending to evolve it. The cost of forcefully evolving a spell is dependent on how strong the spell is and how much mastery you have with it. Additionally, by channeling even more magical energy into the evolution, you can produce stronger evolved spells. 

The less mastery you have over a spell and the more you artificially strengthen the evolution, the more chaotic the result will be, and each forceful evolution will cause increasingly chaotic effects until you evolve it naturally, in which case the spell will stabilize.

objects.text:
You can now evolve a spell by reaching sufficient mastery of it. These evolutions alter the spell's structure and specifically focus on improving the spell's efficiency, power, flexibility, and adding new basic effects related to its purpose, though how it does this depends on the magic system itself. With focus, you can also guide the spell's evolution to an extent, allowing you to focus on specific aspects of the spell to enhance at the cost of reducing the improvement of other aspects. 

You will always be able to instinctively cast the spell and know the general effects of the spell, though this does not grant any understanding of the theory behind the evolved spell. Lastly, each evolution of a spell is slightly more effective than the last, but also makes each subsequent evolution harder, though enough changes to a spell can make it register as a completely new spell.
objects.title: Spell Evolution

addons.text: Your grimoires can now grant any of your powers and abilities as if you were to personally awaken them.
addons.title: Grimoire of Awakening

addons.text: You can make any of the grimoires you create cross-compatible, allowing the reader to cast the spell as long as they have enough mana and other components required for it, regardless of the metaphysical rules of the magic system they operate under.
addons.title: Cross-Compatibility

addons.text: You can create scrolls which hold a one-time use of any spell you know. Creating the scroll takes the same effort, mana, and components as simply casting a spell would've required. This counts as a separate spell from grimoire creation.
addons.title: Scroll Conjuring

objects.text:
For any magic spell you know, you can manifest a grimoire that, once read, will allow the reader to instantly learn the inscribed spell regardless of its difficulty. Do note, however, that simply knowing the spell is not always enough to cast it, as one must possess the necessary prerequisites, such as mana capacity or a compatible magic system, for example.

Each grimoire is one-time use only, vanishing after the spell has been learnt. Creating a grimoire requires a few seconds for it to manifest, and while not indestructible, grimoires are extremely wear-and-tear resistant, capable of lying forgotten in a chest for thousands of years and remaining completely intact.

This power also counts as a spell; thus, you can create a grimoire to teach it as well.
objects.title: Grimoire Manifestation

addons.text:
Your gacha is no longer limited to spellbooks, and may now also summon the Blueprints for powerful magical items.

However, as a consequence of having more options to narrow down, it now costs a bit more energy constrain your searches.
addons.title: Blueprint Gacha

objects.text:
In the infinite expanses of the multiverse, there undoubtedly exist any spell you might desire. Now, you can cast a spell to generate a grimoire that would contain knowledge of one completely random spell. This spell may be truly anything, from a relatively trivial one, like a spell to brew a perfect cup of tea, to something truly world-shattering, like a spell to become a god.

You can also constrain the selection of spells from which to pull by introducing various parameters, such as a particular school or a field of magic, the desired effect of the spell, or even the name and full description. However, the mana cost to perform this conjuration rises exponentially the more precise the restrictions are. Every spell you obtain will be perfectly adapted to function with the magic system you possess.
objects.title: Grimoire Gacha

objects.text:
You now know any one spell, technique, or a ritual of your choice, regardless of complexity, the time it normally would've taken to learn, or the magic system it originated from. This must be an existing spell or ritual, so you cannot just invent your own. Anything you learn this way will be perfectly adapted to the magic system you possess; however, depending on the differences between the magic system the spell originated from and your own, the spell might sometimes become easier or harder to cast.

Do note, however, that knowing a spell is not necessarily enough to perform it, as you do not get any of the other prerequisites, such as a large enough mana pool, for example.
objects.title: Mage's Privilege

objects.text:
You are hypersensitive to fluctuations in magical energy, capable of detecting even the most minute shifts in its composition. If you lack a dedicated magical sense, your mind instinctively translates these perceptions through one of your existing physical senses, allowing you to experience magic through a familiar medium.

As a result, you develop an intuitive feel for all forms of magical energy, both from within and without. You effortlessly gauge its presence and quantity with remarkable precision.
objects.title: Hypersensitivity

addons.title: Eternal Inscription
addons.text: You can infuse the inscriptions with the power of infinity, allowing them to be used without any energy requirements on the part of the recipient. You can also set the inscription to be continuously active, removing the ability of the recipient to deactivate it at will.

addons.title: Remote Control
addons.text: You maintain control over every inscribed spell, allowing you to remotely activate or deactivate any inscription and supply the necessary energy for the use of the spells yourself.

addons.title: Grimoire of Inscriptions
addons.text:
You can manifest grimoires containing multiple inscriptions. These do not grant the reader the knowledge of the inscribed spell but allow them to freely cast the spell whose page remains open so long as they hold a grimoire in their hands.

The holder of the grimoire still needs to have enough mana and/or meet other similar requirements to cast it but does not need any knowledge or mastery of magic.

addons.title: Family Crest Accumulation
addons.text:
Should you permit it, your inscriptions can become a legacy spell, passing down from parents to children. With each generation, the strain the inscription causes will lessen, allowing for new inscriptions to be added.

You can also permit the recipients to add their own spells onto the inscription, allowing for gradual accumulations of spell crests that eventually may contain an entire family library of spells.

objects.text:
You can inscribe a magic spell you know upon the soul of another, allowing the recipient to use the spell as if it were an in-born superpower. The inscribed spell will draw upon the resources of the user but require none of the mastery or knowledge of magic to use. The spell will automatically deactivate if there is a danger to the user's life, such as consuming all their life force or mana, but this function can be consciously overridden by the user.

Beware, however, that depending on the strength of the recipient's soul, the number of inscriptions they can accept before their soul becomes overloaded and irreversibly damaged may vary. A regular human may hold one or two, while a seasoned magician or a demigod may easily accept hundreds of inscriptions. You are always able to tell how many spells any given person may hold.

If you want, the inscription can manifest as a tattoo on the body of a recipient, igniting when the spell is in use.
objects.title: Spell Inscription
Elemental Expansion
objects.text:
A lot of magic systems are fond of earth, wind and fire, aren’t they? It can make you feel restricted in what they can do, even if it gives you a lot of room for conceptual interpretation.

Each purchase of this lets you add an additional three elements to any magical system that is based around a handful of specific elements. These can be adjacent elements like ice to water, classic expanded elements like light, death or soul, avant-garde like explosions or travel, or get cute and scientific with it like calcium and xenon.

New elements must be just as powerful and versatile and have the same mastery requirements as the original elements. If the base elements have relationships and affinities with other elements within the system, then the new elements will have similar relationships.

You are now an expert in combining martial and magic attacks. The two concepts combine into a greater sum than the parts that make it up. In addition to this, your magical strength and physical strength are connected, meaning that pumping weights will allow you to create a much better fireball and exercising your magic will beef you up as well.
objects.title: Spellsword (The Elder Scrolls)

objects.text: You find that your magicka pool has increased drastically, and alongside it, your raw magical power has as well. Where once one of your fireballs would merely disturb a room, now it could blow down the walls and gate of a castle. You have become a (metaphorical) living siege engine.
objects.title: Battlemage (The Elder Scrolls)

addons.text: Your ability to use Magitech now includes the ability to create the fabled technology of the Dwemer. This does include the Numidium; try not to zero-sum or make any Dragon Breaks.
addons.title: Dwemer Technology

objects.text:
You are now a true master of the arcane arts. Having completely mastered the schools of Illusion, Alteration, Destruction, Conjuration, Restoration, Mysticism, Thaumaturgy, and Enchantment. Amassing an impressive library of novice, adept, expert, and master level spell tomes, along with a few books on more esoteric magics. You have a sixth sense for creating spells, able to sense what you need to add to a spell to get the desired result, as well as a sense of anything you may have overlooked, such as the need to land for a spell that allows you to fly.

You also gain a beginning grasp of the more esoteric magics, such as blood magic, dark magic, mind magic, dream magic, flesh magic, shadow magic, soul magic, snake magic, time magic, void magic, Ayleid magic, nature magic, water magic, weather magic, telepathy, and the Thu’um. Though for the Thu’um, you’ll have to learn more like the Greybeards and less like the Dovahkiin.
objects.title: Arch-Mage (The Elder Scrolls)

objects.text:
You are no longer just a master of the arcane arts. You now match the might of the Ayleid Sorcerer Kings of old, who could topple entire kingdoms with a singular spell and knew magic older than any other mortal on Mundus. You are now on par with old mages like Celemaril Light-Bringer or the other Sorcerer Kings. 

As with the other Sorcerer Kings, you are also a master of two specific branches of magic that the Ayleid pioneered: dawn magic and flesh shaping. 

Also, your initial grasp of whatever esoteric magic you chose with the previous upgrade has evolved from being just a beginner to mastery instead of simply being a novice, and you are now a master in the other esoteric magics because your knowledge of magic runs so deep that even the long-forgotten arts are something you now possess.
objects.title: Sorcerer King (The Elder Scrolls)

objects.text:
You have done what few mortals have done before you, such as the ideal masters and Mankar Camoran, to name the two most well known examples and would put you on a level beyond that of a mortal, in that you have managed to create your own realm of Oblivion.

In creating your own realm of Oblivion, you have made an area outside of reality where you truly remain the complete master. A realm of Oblivion has much more purpose than simply being able to control whatever goes on inside the realm you have created, as not only can the realm itself be used to grant you power, like how Celemaril Light-Bringer drew power from Oblivion to power his spells. 

Your realm of Oblivion could also act as an afterlife for those who submit to your rule, and you may use souls in your realm for any number of purposes, similar to how the ideal masters used the souls of the soul cairn to make themselves stronger.

However, you are no Daedric Prince, although with your magic knowledge, perhaps you could pull a Manimarco and become a god through similar means to how he became a god of necromancy with enough souls to power your ascension.
objects.title: Daedric Noble (The Elder Scrolls)

objects.text:
You gain a dragon's egg, containing a highly magical, sentient, telepathic creature that, once hatched, will become soul-bound to you as a lifelong companion. 

As a result of this bond, you and your dragon gain several abilities, including sharing perks, telepathic communication over any distance, a natural minor mind meld, the ability to share energy, and you gain biological immortality due to the dragon's natural immortality. Dragon magic is tied to their emotions, so while dragons typically cannot use magic, in times of great emotion, they can perform powerful miracles, sometimes even those impossible for the best practitioners of Gramarye.

To better suit the role of a rider, you will gradually become more elf-like, enhancing your physical abilities to several times the peak of human potential. You will also be trained in rider martial arts and gain a rider's weapon: an expertly crafted, powerful magical weapon forged from a meteorite, capable of channeling and storing vast amounts of energy while being nearly indestructible. This weapon comes with a suite of enhancements that require no energy to maintain due to how they were added, including, but not limited to, being the color of your dragon, being forever sharp, requiring no maintenance, and incredible natural sharpness, which can easily be enhanced with "energy."

Your dragon's body contains an Eldunarí (dragon heartstone), which serves to contain the dragon's soul, magic, and consciousness if its body ever dies. Due to your soul bond, you can also reside in the Eldunarí if you die. The stone is theoretically strong enough to store both your soul and the dragon's, though it may be uncomfortable. This may allow the use of the Eldunarí to resurrect both you and your dragon. If the dragon dies and chooses not to store its soul in the Eldunarí, it will dissolve along with the dragon's body.
objects.title: Dragon Rider (Inheritance Cycle)

objects.text:
Upon Mount Erolas, on the Isle of Vroengard, lies the Rock of Kuthian — the only access point to the hidden Vault of Souls. Enchanted so that only you may remember it, the Rock and the vault it guards will always be discoverable in any world, from any mountain you might find.

But I suppose you might be wondering what the Vault contains. It holds the greatest and most precious treasures of the fallen Dragon Rider Order, through which one might restore it once more.

Within, you'll find dozens of texts on the magic of the Ancient Language and the knowledge of the Dragon Riders. There is an ever-replenishing supply of Brightsteel—the precious metal used to forge the famous Rider swords. The vault also contains hundreds of Eldunari, the heart crystals that bear the souls of dragons able to grant access to their ancient wisdom.

Finally, there is a cache of dragon eggs. While each egg is typically spelled to await a rider of its choosing, you can instead select a rider for an egg, and it will happily comply. As new Riders are discovered, more eggs will be found secured within the vault.
objects.title: Rock of Kuthian (Inheritance Cycle)

objects.text:
Instead of a basic understanding and vocabulary, you now possess a near complete mental lexicon of Ancient Language.

Furthermore, you also possess a greatly enhanced intuition for discovering the True Names of things within Ancient Language. A true name is a group of words in the Ancient Language that summarises someone's (or something's) existence and so knowing it grants you significant power over them, such as being able to compel absolute obedience from a person. 

You have even learned the Name of Names, the true name of the Ancient Language. Through this true name, you can control and manipulate the rules and functions of Ancient Language itself; from altering a spell’s mechanics, making some spells only work for specific individuals or even stopping them from working entirely. Keep in mind that the inherent energy costs involved with magic still remain.
objects.title: True Names (Inheritance Cycle)

objects.text:
You now have the powers, knowledge, and skills of Rashek, also known as The Lord Ruler.

Your Allomancy’s strength and scale are massively enhanced. For example your powers of emotional manipulation can cover entire city blocks
You are barely bothered by the rules that are nigh inviolable for lesser allomancers.

Your Feruchemical Compounding is pushed to its farthest limits. With it you can move fast enough that you can leave vacuums behind, and can heal from being burnt to nearly just your skeleton. 
The cost of this is that you have become somewhat reliant upon your Compounded enhancements, and when you stop you will be reduced to less than what you would have naturally.

Lastly, and perhaps most dangerous, is your new skill in Hemalurgy. Your abilities in the art were previously on a smaller scale, lending a few new abilities or perhaps enhancing existing ones. Now, using only a couple of spikes you know how to turn people into entirely new monsters. Previous Hemalurgic constructs include artificial and enhanced Mistborns called the Steel Inquisitors, immortal shapeshifters called Kaandra, and the giant savage soldiers known as the Koloss. 
You will never need to worry about your creations betraying you, as the warping of their souls that is an unavoidable part of their creation allows you to completely control them with only slight Allomantic effort.

Rejoice, for you now stand equal to the Sliver of Infinity.
objects.title: The Lord Ruler (Mistborn)

objects.text: You are a Bondsmith, an order that stands apart from the rest of the Knights Radiant. You have access to the surges of tension and adhesion, which allows you to manipulate connections between people and things to learn things such as languages as well as to steal the connections of others. You can also manipulate physical properties using tension. Bondsmiths are also bonded to unique spren as compared to the ordinary spren that the other Orders are bonded to. You can choose whether you are bonded to the Stormfather, the Sibling or the Nightwatcher.
objects.title: Bondsmith (Stormlight Archive)

addons.text: Your Divine Breath increases in value by the amount of Breaths you receive per interval. For example, at the start of every week, your Divine Breath's value will increase by three Breaths. As you further improve this supply, you will grow faster. Additionally, the conversation rate for your Divine Breath has been improved tremendously, and can further be improved with enough focused meditation.

The benefits of your Divine Breath improve as you raise its value. Your physical, mental, and spiritual capabilities will grow as you further refine your Divine Breath. Commands often used by you will become increasingly more effective, sometimes even allowing an object to act as if it has a will of its own, interpreting your Command as you'd best wish.

objects.text: You are a Returned, someone who has died and come back as a greater existence. As a Returned you gain a single distinct Divine Breath. Its initial value is equal to two thousand Breaths, bringing you to the Fifth Heightening. You are able to increase its value by feeding it normal Breaths at an imperfect conversion rate. Giving your Divine Breath to someone will heal them from anything short of death, at the cost of your own life. As a Returned, you also gain the ability to perceive the soul of an art piece, accurately interpreting abstract pieces of art based on what the artist was trying to convey. As a Returned, your appearance is in accordance with what you subconsciously think physical perfection is or how you see yourself. With training, you can potentially learn how to change your appearance to a reasonable extent. Lastly, you have increased strength and speed, can move inhumanly fast, and are immune to all toxins and most physical illnesses and ailments.
objects.title: Returned (Warbreaker)

addons.text: You are able to directly funnel Breaths into your Divine Breath at a near-perfect rate through dedicated mediation. This special form of meditation will not allow you to increase your stock of normal Breaths while in progress.

Slaying familiar types of entities increases the amount of Breaths you receive. Sometimes, upon recalling your Breaths from Awakened objects you consistently use, you will receive more than you put in.

objects.text: You are able to acquire more Breaths in various methods. By meditating, you can gather Breaths from the world around you. With enough experience, you will learn to increase the amount of Breaths you receive per week, and will even be able to lower the time between cycles. Killing other beings will allow you to gather Breaths from them.
objects.title: Breath Acquisition

addons.text: You can shave off slivers of your Divine Breath, granting any object a Divine Breath of its own. This sliver of divinity will fundamentally be tied to an object, and cannot be separated by any means. This special Breath will multiply the effectiveness of Commands used on the Awakened Object.

Objects that are commonly used by you will have the chance to generate a Breath of their own through use. Using a sword to slaughter an army would have the Breath count increasing without any active involvement from you.

objects.text: Objects that have been previously Awakened by you are improved proportionally to the amount of Breaths devoted. This improvement works across all aspects of the object, a sword would become more durable and much sharper, and even the object's materials would slowly improve in quality with every Awakening. These effects further bolster any future Awakenings done on the object.
objects.title: Breath Attunement

objects.text: You have gained the ability to manually choose when to generate breaths. For example, you can choose to wait several days before gaining all your new breaths at once. You can also convert Breaths from and into any form of magical energy at your disposal.
objects.title: Breath Conversion

objects.text: For each purchase here, you become a beginner at one more of the True Magics. This can be any of the 5 currently held in the Nasuverse or a new one, as long as it fits the criteria.
objects.title: Another True Magic (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
Your ability to summon Servants has greatly increased! The Servants you can summon with the Saint Quartz can now be from any universe, instead of a singular one. If you ever have a specific setting in mind, you can lock in a setting for a week. This would allow you to only pull Servants for that setting for said week. After that week is up, you may change the setting you are pulling servants from to a different setting, or back to any/all.

Eventually, you may gain too many Servants and not know what to do with them all, so now you will also be able to summon and unsummon them. When they are unsummoned, they will return to your own personal 'Throne of Heroes'. Each Servant has a personal room of their own design. Made perfectly for each individual Servant. In this 'Throne of Heroes', time will lose its meaning, allowing you to go centuries without resummoning a servant, but only feeling like a day for them. Your Servants can interact and communicate with one another in this Throne of Heroes, and should you desire it, be able to communicate telepathically with you. Although this connection can be turned off and on at will. Should a Servant die, they will return to your 'Throne of Heroes' where they will slowly resurrect and heal over the span of a month. This time can be sped up by using Saint Quartz on that individual Servant.
objects.title: Gambling Addiction

objects.text:
Your Mysteries will never decrease in effectiveness, only growing stronger with time. You will always be able to uncover new Mysteries with enough time and research. You will always be able to perform Magecraft regardless of location.

You are a Mystery on your own, fueling your Magecraft with the wisps of your endless future potential. Your circuits are no longer static, allowing you to craft new circuits and increase their quality with no limitation, making multiple Magic Crests is not an impossibility for you.

You can craft new Magic Circuits that are meant for a singular form of Magecraft, improving the initial efficacy of the specialized circuit tenfold at the cost of all non-specialized Magecraft being ineffective. Your soul will not be overloaded at any point due to too many circuits, removing the innate pain of Magecraft.

Given enough time and practice, every Mystery of yours can reach the realm of True Magic.
objects.title: Enigmatic Mysteries (Type-Moon)

addons.text:
You've kept access to your birthplace and have gained an intrinsic connection to Avalon in your pilgrimage to create Excalibur.

Within Avalon is the site of selection, a series of gateways you must go through to confront your bad memories as manifested enemies and observe all the good experiences you've had in life.

Doing this walk will count as if you waited 6 months for your pilgrimage; there are no limits to how many times you can do this, as the infinite fuel source of Avalon and the time manipulation of the Tower will act as if you did the full 6 months in the real world.

On top of this, if you were to ever die, you would quickly be reborn in Avalon. The only way to truly put you down for good would be for someone to somehow get to Avalon and destroy it utterly.

Such a feat, though, is unlikely to occur.
addons.title: Avalon Le Fae

addons.text:
You've skipped your steps and gained control of Excalibur...somehow. But it has been absorbed by you, and you have gained a new ability—Holy Sword Creation.

Now, once you undergo your first pilgrimage, you gain the power to infuse anything you make with the "Sword" attribute. This means you can infuse spells, items, and buildings with the qualities of Excalibur.

You also no longer lose six months per creation of your "Excalibur", whether that be the item or the spell, and every pilgrimage will have the option to make Excalibur or make your Holy Sword Creation stronger.
addons.title: Holy Sword Creation

addons.text:
Rhongomyniad has lost all its seals. With the power of a divine spirit added to your abilities as the Fairy of Paradise, you have ascended to the level of a living god. A single strike from your Rhongomyniad could destroy a fantasy tree or wipe out most of a continent's surface.

However, you don't have just one Rhongomyniad—rather, it has become a transcendent form of magecraft entirely bound to you. Its physical location is irrelevant; you can summon and wield it as effortlessly as casting a spell.

Each time you complete a pilgrimage, you gain another Rhongomyniad, entirely independent of Excalibur and unaffected by whether or not you’ve expended your accumulated power.
addons.title: Spirit Vein Closing Armament

addons.text:
You possess the ability to craft Mystic Codes and other magical items, potentially on the level of Noble Phantasms.

Your all-encompassing skill in various crafts, combined with fairy magic that allows you to do magic with just imagination and magical energy, enables you to transform ordinary materials—even basic dirt or raw magical energy—into high-grade resources. With just a thought, you can then shape these materials into the magical items you envision.

Although you don’t need to understand every detail of each crafting step, creating items without specialized knowledge will require significantly more magical energy than if you were a master in the relevant crafts.
addons.title: Item Construction EX

addons.text:
You're not just a Saberface, you're Morgan le Fay—also known as Aesc the Savior and Vivaine. You have the option to have everything: the body, the memories, the knowledge, the mana quantity, the items, even the soul—to merge with yourself, but with you as the dominant will. You're not a Servant, you're the real deal from Fairy Britain.

Your overall power has skyrocketed. You have, from the start, undergone the equivalent of ten pilgrimages.
