You have great knowledge in magic, allowing you to do things such as time travel, send foes through time with your Water Mirror spell, create clones of yourself with your exact abilities, wield a massive amount of magic resistance, and bestow others with gifted names from the Knights of the Round—thereby giving them their power.

In your possession are also all of Morgan's weapons and her throne. With barely any effort, you can summon her throne and use it either as a focal point to gather mana from a location or people in a set area, or to use her twelve Rhongomyniads that are located in the throne to strike down most foes.

If you wish, you could even rapidly rebuild Camelot in any area you claim as your own and take the mana and lifeforce of any living being who lives there.
addons.title: Queen of the Fairies

objects.text:
A Fairy of Paradise is a type of A-Ray dispatched from Avalon to persuade the fairies of the six clans to confess their sins and ultimately achieve the goal of creating the holy sword, Excalibur. While you may not be directly on this mission, you are, like Aesc and Artoria, a type of Greater Fairy sent from Avalon, endowed with all the advantages that come with this status.

You are granted a Staff of Selection, which begins with limited power but naturally grows stronger over time. This staff enhances any magic you cast through it. Though indestructible, it can still be stolen. Unlike other fairies, you are immune to the effects of iron. You also possess a unique skill in inventing and learning magecraft; due to your Fairy Patterns, the steps and calculations required for magecraft are so reduced that it feels more like improvising as you go. Additionally, you can learn foundational magecraft and various spells far faster than a human, mastering the basics within a year, even with minimal to no instruction from another.

A distinctive trait you have as a Fae is Fairy Eyes, which allow you to perceive all lies and reveal the truth. With these, you can discern the lies and true intentions of anyone you observe, and unlike others, you can activate or deactivate this ability at will.

Currently, your Fairy Patterns have not expanded, but over time, both the quantity and quality of your Fairy Patterns will greatly increase at the end of your first month, and will continue to do so every month until the sixth month which will be the final enhancement with all the months collectively being a x6 increase on the quality and quantity of your Fairy Patterns. This will repeat itself in a cycle of six months, over and over, to represent the pilgrimage the previous Fairies of Paradise have gone through ringing the six bells.

At the end of this six-month pilgrimage, you will acquire sufficient power to have the option to begin the process of creating the Holy Sword Excalibur and its sheath, Avalon. Ordinarily, this act would consume you, transforming you into the sword itself. However, in your case, the sword will instead absorb all of the power accumulated over the six months, leaving you as if you had never completed the pilgrimage. After another six months, you could decide to either reset yourself again to make another Excalibur, enhance the one you already possess and remove its seals or decide not to and keep that boost in power for yourself.

You have the option to be a Saberface.
objects.title: Fairy of Paradise (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
You’re an existence comparable to the Valkyries, demi-gods crafted from the corpse of the White Titan by the All-Father Odin.

As such, your inherent physical qualities have improved to the point that most Servants would find you a formidable threat, even before any magical enhancements you might cast on yourself.

Beyond your physique, your magical abilities are also exemplary, as your spiritual foundation comes pre-installed with Primordial Rune Magecraft by Odin himself, giving you true mastery of the art. In effect, this allows you to reliably enact Noble Phantasm-level effects from the very beginning, and enhance yourself to the point where you could compete evenly with powerful Servants like the Knights of the Round Table.

At your highest, your Magecraft is even capable of enacting Divine Mysteries, powers capable of building and destroying nations in a single act. Though attempting to reach so far beyond your station like this without extensive preparation and a truly immense stockpile of magical energy, each proportional to both the scale and depth of the intended effect, is liable to damage your spiritual core. In the best case, such damage will merely leave you existentially weakened, in the worst it could completely annihilate your spiritual foundation, erasing you from existence entirely.

Finally, a pair of powerful mystic codes, akin to Noble Phantasms, have been bestowed upon you by the All-Father’s grace:

Gungnir: A lesser copy of Odin’s own spear, enchanted to certainly hit its target once thrown.

Svanhvít: A white vestment, which bestows its wearer high-speed flight and powerful defenses. It defends against Magecraft that affects the mind and soul of the wearer, in addition to deflecting all physical attacks ranked B or lower.
objects.title: Valkyrie (Type-Moon)

addons.text:
Your angelic body has elevated your initial sequence to Sequence One, giving you initial control over the authorities of your Pathway and the ability to create an incomplete divine kingdom.

Depending on your pathway, this divine kingdom can either be mostly physical in nature, like the demoness pathway, which has the entirety of the mirror world as a divine kingdom, or, like the fool pathway, be rule-based, which imposes unique laws on reality based on your authority. Either way, your divine kingdom is an extension of your authority, which allows you to use your authority more intuitively and suppress your enemies within.

Your nature as an Angel of the Lord remains regardless of your pathway or the sequence you reach. So even if you merge with the Chaos Sea and become the Lord of the Astral World, ultimately, you fundamentally remain an angel, just an incredibly powerful one.
addons.title: Vessel of Angelic Power

addons.text:
As a Seraphim, your impressive magical energy generation allows you to draw out the Throne of Creation’s true power, allowing you to create and alter entire Textures with the same efficacy the Throne could previously alter its immediate surroundings.

Additionally, you have assimilated the Throne of Creation into your own Spiritual Origin, allowing you to manifest it and dismiss it at will, even in the event it is destroyed.

With that power, you are truly second only to YHWH, with each and every one of your Holy Magic spells acting as a particularly powerful Noble Phantasm, owing to the Almighty Authority granted by your throne.

You can even manufacture your own loyal angelic hosts by crafting vessels for your own divine power and imbuing them with lesser emanations of your own almighty Authority. By default, these angels will not have any will of their own, functioning only as mindless automatons that act according to your will; though, you can load personalities into them, be they custom-made or copies of existing beings, or leave them space to develop their own will over time. You can choose whether or not to leave the possibility for rebellion open to any given angel at the time of their creation.
addons.title: Right Hand of God

objects.text:
You have equipped an empty angelic conceptual dress, one corresponding to one of the many angels left unnamed in the Bible, transforming into a Transcendental Divine Spirit in the process. As one of the unnamed angels in the Bible, the purpose and authority you have is up to you to decide.

Your Seraph body serves as an ideal outer shell for containing the angelic vessel of power, allowing you to fully maintain your self-awareness and personality without distorting under your new angelic nature.

As you have incarnated in an angelic body, your Divine Core retains its full power without weakening as it would in a human vessel. It also increases energy generation and output to be comparable to three Holy Grails rather than one. Your wings merge, giving you three pairs rather than six pairs of wings.

Your holy light takes on the properties of True Ether and effectively replaces it entirely. This allows your holy magic spells to reach the level of Noble Phantasms as long as they fit your nature and authority as an angel of the Lord.

Additionally, as a Seraph, you gain an affinity for music in all its forms and a voice that is universally pleasant to listen to.

Despite being an angel, you are free to act as you see fit without worrying about falling or acting against God's will.

With this, you gain the following skills:

Divine Core of the Seraphim: A variant of divinity that denotes the user as one born into a perfect existence, this skill preserves the absoluteness of the mind and body, repelling all mental interference. It prevents the body from growing and the figure from changing, no matter how many calories are absorbed.

Independent Manifestation (Angel) allows the user to appear in any location where the concept of an "angel" has arisen. This can be used for teleportation and time travel because, as long as the concept of an ‘’angel’’ is present, there is no limit to where or when the user can appear.
objects.title: Transcendental Divine Spirit: Seraphim (Type-Moon)

objects.text: "Good sings, evil cries. Light fills everything, darkness perish. Its radiance itself is a miracle from the Lord. Grace, His laurels!" You've inherited the mantle of Metatron, the Scribe of Heaven and Executor of God's Will, which comes with a Spirit Origin with power equal to Tiamat. With the power of Metatron, you can change your size to whatever you wish, become immune to all curses and bindings, including Command Seals, and create contracts to enact miracles. All of this is on top of the awesome power that comes with being a Seraphim. That isn't mentioning her Noble Phantasms, of which she has a near infinite number of them. These include Saint-du-Mont Pilier, a laser that rivals Rhongomyniad in destructive ability and Univers Immortel Metatron, the act of Metatron unleashing her power and becoming "the most noble angel imaginable to man", with even a basic Bounded Field of hers needing a hundred Holy Grails to be breached.
objects.title: The One Who Attends God (Type-Moon)

addons.text: Your divinity and the True Ether that pulsates through your divine core have caused your evil pieces to transform into a Pantheon Reincarnation Set. Each evil piece becomes a lesser Divine Core that reincarnates whoever it is used on into a minor Divine Spirit (Minor Incarnated God if you have Incarnated God (Type-Moon)). These lesser Divine Cores have one-third (Half with Incarnated God) of the True Ether generation and output. These lesser Divine Cores gradually grow in True Ether generation and output, reaching the level of true Divine Cores over time and as the lesser deity trains. These reincarnated lesser deities also gain relatively narrow minor authorities, with your queen gaining three, your pawns gaining one, and the rest gaining two. As the Chief God of this pantheon, you have the ability to reclaim given Divine Cores so that you may reallocate them. In most cases, this results in the former deity losing their divinity and safely returning to a mortal form, but if their power is great enough, they may reform their own Divine Core, ascending as a deity under their own power, no longer reliant on your gifted Divine Core to maintain their divine status. The limit of not being able to reincarnate divine beings is lifted, and regardless of how strong or how much potential the target has, a single Divine Core is sufficient to reincarnate them as a deity. The time limit on reincarnating the dead is also gone; now, only an intact soul or body is required to reincarnate someone.
addons.title: Pantheon Reincarnation Set

addons.text: Never again will your feet touch the earth, for you are the Mistress of Heaven, Ishtar. You gain all the abilities, skills, memories of the Goddess of Venus. Including all of her Authorities, Charm and Noble Phantasm, which will make you unrivalled amongst Sumerian deities. This includes both alt versions of Ishtar who were summoned in the vessels of Rin Tohsaka and Fillia.
addons.title: Mistress of Heaven

addons.text: No longer are you only a host to humanity’s curses, for you are a true God of Curses. As such, you gain a host of additional powers drawn from your newfound authority. Most foundational among these is the ability to use gathered curses to strengthen yourself and alleviate the strain of using your authorities, in addition to the worship that all Divine Spirits can draw upon. That said, your curses can only enhance your other abilities for malicious effects. You could create life, but only beings like ravenous beasts or wicked spirits. You could create lands, but only with the most hostile environs. You could cure the masses of their ailments, but only by way of horrific mutation. With just your authority over curses, you have much finer control over their exact effects and severity. The curses you inflict can range from the most mild of ailments all the way to all the way to grand blights caustic to reality itself. You retain perfect control over who your curses affect and to what exact extent. By investing especially great quantities of curses, at least equal to all of the curses you currently host, you can weave a monstrous body that you can reside in, allowing you to exist and wield your authority as if you’re an Incarnated God, limited to malicious effects. Should you have the Incarnated God power, your divine form becomes a breeding ground of endlessly proliferating curses, which empower you and drive your growth.
addons.title: God of Curses

objects.text:
You have become a Divine Spirit, a being of Divine Mystery that embodies natural phenomena or abstract concepts that serve as the foundation of the world itself. As a god, you have enough power to battle and easily win against dozens of Heroic Spirits at once.

You possess a Divine Core, a source of True Ether that rivals that of a Holy Grail in terms of energy production and output. You are incredibly hard to kill and capable of regenerating even from the complete destruction of your soul whenever you wish to do so. The only way for you to be able to die is to be completely forgotten about, and even then, you would still need to be killed to put you down for good.

Your most potent ability as a Divine Spirit, however, is the ability to wield Authority, which is the divine right of gods, given to them by the planet itself, to shape and alter the world based on what phenomena or concepts they embody.

These are tremendously powerful and esoteric capabilities; they allow for miraculous feats such as creating a world, event shifting and inducement, time-flow manipulation, and kingdom-building, and much more.

While normal Skills and abilities "achieve a certain result based on some logical process or principle," Authorities "realize a result simply because the user has the right to do so."

As a Divine Spirit, invoking your Authority is very draining, and it is weaker in places where physics reigns supreme, where you must somewhat obey them. For instance, the Square Cube Law prevents you from becoming larger than a mountain.

This can be alleviated through Belief and Faith in you by humans, and by dedicating a Temple to your name. You also possess the usual weaknesses of Divine Spirits and can be influenced by human Faith to the extent that your appearance, mind, and strength are affected by it.

Your core Memories and Self remain unaffected, but depending on the area and Temple, how you appear and act towards your believers changes.
objects.title: Divine Spirit (Type-Moon)

addons.text:
But those are merely side benefits; more importantly, your very existence ensures the return of the Age of Gods and the overturning of the Age of Man. It undoes the 14,000-year Decay of Mystery brought about by the Light of Science and ensures that it cannot happen again, eternally preserving Mysteries.

Physics, Technology, and Magecraft no longer exist or function unless you allow them—and only in the ways you permit. Modern humanity cannot survive and would perish unless you choose to protect them or transform them into Age of Gods humans. This grants you complete authority over these aspects of Reality, including Humanity itself.

Previously, you could affect things related to your Authority, but now even that ability has been enhanced. You can now turn these extensions into new Authorities, gaining control over each one, and continue this process indefinitely—from Archery to Hunting, to Beasts, to Animals, to Husbandry, to Farming, and beyond.

Over time, you can even wield Mysteries from the Age of Genesis, including but not limited to: creation from nothing, transforming into a planet-sized giant, true resurrection, preventing the degradation of souls, bringing forth unique divine metals, creating artifacts that rival Ea, and giving birth to entire species like Tiamat, along with other Mysteries demonstrated by similarly ancient and powerful beings.

The most significant effect is that this places Gods as the Prime Species on the Seat of Primacy, making Gods favored by the World once more.

This replaces the Human Order with a Divine Order and prevents pruning by the Counter Force.
addons.title: Regression to the Age of Gods

addons.text:
You are no longer simply a god whose influence only extends over a single world; you are now a world unto yourself—a Primordial Goddess born from the essence of a galaxy. Your power has grown immensely, enabling you to generate vast quantities of True Ether and Mana on an unprecedented scale.

At first, your inner World, you'll find, will be a modest thing, barely containing a single-star system within. But here, you reign supreme, nurturing life, guiding its culture, and safeguarding the domains where that life may flourish. At the heart of this World lies your Shrine—often represented by the central star, but can also be a Temple in space.

This Shrine is your Throne, from which all things flow and return. Should it be damaged or destroyed, you will suffer profound weakness, and in the event of all your stars being snuffed out, your very existence is at risk. The Shrine is You, and You are it.

Over time, with some considerable effort, your singular star may multiply, filling the space within your inner World and expanding your influence and potential until you embody the vast galaxy you were always meant to be. This growth can be accelerated by absorbing existing universes, enabling you to become a universe unto yourself.

Any entity that enters your domain will fall under your influence, gaining the ability to bar or force their departure from your realm. You may also gain insight into their knowledge, prevent resurrection in case of death, and even absorb them to bolster your strength.

However, note that your Authority does not extend to Foreigners, especially if they belong to a Universe you are in the process of assimilating. This will remain so until you have assimilated the Universe, after which you can have Authority over it. 

In such instances, your Shrine will open for attacks, making it imperative to defend it carefully, as the consequences of its destruction are quite dire indeed. But as long as a small part of the Shrine survives, you can resurrect with time.
addons.title: Goddess of Civilization

addons.text:
As the Inheritor of the Imperial Regalia of the Mortal World and the Chrysanthemum Throne, so too do you Inherit the Throne of Heaven. As the one who sits upon the Heavenly Throne, you are the Sun that brings forth the Texture of the Japanese Kami.

With time and effort, you may shape the Light of Creation into the beings that lived before the divine left the World behind. Such as the Baku that eats dreams and nightmares, Amemasu, the ship-eating whale or the Kirin that grants protection.

As more of creation is brought back, you can inherit the Authorities of the Kami, Youkai, Monsters and wield them however you see fit. Whether that be the Jewels of Azumi-no-isora creating a path to his Palace, or perhaps those of Yamato-no-Orochi with the ability to create calamities.

You can either ”deploy” and project the Texture onto the World you are currently on, replacing what exists with your own World and destroying what is there currently. If you do not wish to destroy the World, you can take the slower path of integrating it into your Texture and slowly take control of it.

If you choose to deploy it, the location where you did becomes your ”Throne”, which can be any shape, and if it’s destroyed before the destruction or integration of the World, you will suffer immense backlash, with death being a possibility.
addons.title: Texture of Takama-Ga-Hara

addons.text:
You who has received the Spear of Indra, the King of Heaven, now hold claim to it. Through this connection, you may, with time, remake the Texture of India and become as Brahman who emanates all things.

As you wield your powers and bring about the Rebirth of Gods, Monsters and even Demons, you inherit their Authorities as they already stem from you. Whether that be Brahma, who can create all things; Vishnu, who preserves it and Shiva, who destroys and brings rebirth to all.

With time, you become more complete as you bring forth all things, recreate the Heavens & Earth, bring forth Dharma and guide all living things to Enlightenment.

You can either ”deploy” and project the Texture onto the World you are currently on, replacing what exists with your own World and destroying what is there currently. If you do not wish to destroy the World, you can take the slower path of integrating it into your Texture and slowly take control of it.

If you choose to deploy it, the location where you did becomes your ”Throne”, which can be any shape, and if it’s destroyed before the destruction or integration of the World, you will suffer immense backlash, with death being a possibility.
addons.title: Texture of Bharat

addons.text:
You who hold the Texture of Japan and India alongside the Wheel of Life & Death hold undeniable Karma to Buddhism. This Karma that you hold allows you to bring about the powers of Buddha, the Bodhisattvas and all things born of them, even of those who can be considered Demonic.

Rather than recreating a separate Texture, your two existing ones become "more" as they now hold Nirvana within them. You who Create the Wheel, Move the Wheel, Is the Wheel and exist Beyond the Wheel can now wield and access the Authorities of all Buddha, Bodhisattvas & Demons of Buddhism. 

You who are and hold the position of The Honored One exist beyond the reach of Karma, Dharma, Fate, Death and all things that want to control or influence you.

Your powers can now grow to the full extent of the Buddha, such as that controlling the Solar System is simple beyond measure and with time, you can hold even the Universe within the palm of your hand.
addons.title: Karma of Buddhism – Enlightenment of Nirvana

addons.text:
You now possess a Sacred bond to the God of Abraham manifested through a holy relic, tying you directly to the Abrahamic Texture—the divine foundation that binds Heaven, Earth, and all of existence. 

This connection allows you to resurrect the Abrahamic Texture, gradually restoring its divine elements: the Choirs of Angels, the Garden of Eden, the Throne of God, and the Kabbalah that governs cosmic order.

As you progress, you gain the ability to Name and recreate divine entities, such as the Archangels and The Three Great Beasts, showcasing your dominion over the World with the Authorities bestowed upon them such as—Michael's power over divine warfare, Gabriel’s dominion over messages and revelation, Raphael’s control over healing and protection, and the terrifying might of the beasts of Behemoth, Leviathan and Ziz.

However, as you grow in power, you also acquire control over the darker aspects of the Abrahamic narrative. Satan (Shaitan), the adversary and embodiment of rebellion, becomes another Authority you command.

This grants you dominion over aspects of temptation, destruction, and the ability to challenge and oppose divine will—an Authority that reflects both the divine test and the capacity for judgment. Shaitan's manipulation of pride, deception, and defiance allows you to influence the hearts and minds of mortals and gods alike, presenting you with the ability to create and shape the forces of opposition. This also includes all other Demons, Devils, Djinn and Spirits.

You are empowered to act as both Creator and Judge, bringing divine miracles and interventions into the mortal world, including the ability to command the Apocalypse or enact divine retribution, such as the Four Horsemen or the Beast of 666, signaling the end of times.

You can either ”deploy” and project the Texture onto the World you are currently on, replacing what exists with your own World and destroying what is there currently. If you do not wish to destroy the World, you can take the slower path of integrating it into your Texture and slowly take control of it.

Deployment establishes your Throne, a sacred and powerful center from which you reign—whether as a radiant temple, a cosmic palace, or a living embodiment of divine law. If your Throne is destroyed before the Texture is fully deployed or the world integrated, you face immense backlash, with death being a possibility.

With time, as you weave the Abrahamic Texture into the World, your authority extends over the Heavenly Hosts, the Underworld, and the elemental forces of creation, granting you dominion over the full breadth of existence. You ascend toward the ultimate divine embodiment, becoming the Almighty Himself—the Father of all Creation, the custodian of cosmic harmony, justice, and divine order.
addons.title: Texture of Abraham

addons.text: The Magicule Breeder Reactor merges with your Divine Core, increasing your energy generation and output by orders of magnitude; this is only really limited by the fact your body cannot handle the energy you can output and will start breaking apart from the inside out. Of course, as a god, you can withstand an incredible amount of energy before your body begins collapsing; in the beginning, you can safely maintain an output of the third planetary class, though given time and effort, your output can reach levels far beyond even stellar class. Typically, Incarnated Gods are made of True Ether. Instead, you are made of stardust, also known as space dust or Grain; this is the material from which celestial bodies are composed. This does not alter your appearance, and you are still made of flesh and blood, simply made from a different type of matter. Being made of stardust gives you the intrinsic ability to travel through space; this also allows you to travel between textures of planets, and your speed reaches massively faster than light, traveling a light year in about a standard Earth hour. Note: if you possess Imaginary Collapse, you gain authority over Creation, Destruction, and Energy. These authorities can be extended to the same extent as your original authority can. If you possess the True Dragon God Addon and Imaginary Collapse, the additional authorities gained from Imaginary Collapse are now also an inherent aspect of your existence.
addons.title: Divine Dust Reactor

addons.text:
As a True Dragon, you are the highest-ranked being in existence, which now holds up even within the world of Type-Moon. This does not mean or make you the strongest being in Type-Moon, only making it so no one is superior to you because of their race alone.

The aspect of nature you embody and your authority as a god are one and the same, akin to the functionalities of the Machine Gods; your authority is a natural part of you rather than something granted to you by the world. 

As a pillar of all creation, your ability to extend your authority to adjacent authorities can be used to access any authority related to the natural world. For example, this ability cannot access authorities that embody social constructs like war or love. However, authorities over storms or fire are available. This is applied through the lens of mystics and the lens of physics simultaneously, so Fire and Acceleration would be the same authority.

Your self-resurrection is perfected, and now, even if you are destroyed in body, mind, and soul, with your Divine Core and Heart Core completely destroyed, you can resurrect with your full memories and personality. 

Additionally, your True Dragon Factor restores itself over time, so you will not cripple yourself if you have children.
addons.title: True Dragon God

objects.text:
No longer are you just a mere Divine Spirit. You are now an Incarnated God, a true being of Flesh and Life. As an Incarnated God, you no longer need worship or faith to maintain your existence or power, being completely separate from Humanity. A return and resurrection from death is now possible even without believers.

You can now freely use your Authority without inducing strain or having damage inflicted upon you, just as you did during the Age of Gods. Your potential now allows you to grow to rival the chief gods of entire pantheons, such as Zeus, Amaterasu, and God Arjuna—beings so powerful that they are unbound by the time axis.

Through time, effort, and practice, you can see the Past, Future, alternate timelines, and the general trend of the Average Expression to prevent either pruning by the Counter Force or having Counter Guardians sent after you.

With the help of this perception, you can ensure there is always a possibility for progress by knowing what works and taking it from the Future. Additionally, you gain the ability to make retroactive changes to the Past if necessary, ensuring that the World Line you inhabit continues even with your presence in the Age of Man.

Your Authority is now much more expansive and nuanced, and the specific manifestations of your Authority are much less limited.

It is now possible to use it even on things that are not directly part of your Authority, as long as they are related. For example, if your Authority were 'Archery', it could extend to and affect areas like Hunting, Tracking, Beasts, and Leatherworking, to name a few.

This also immensely increases your power and grants you immunity to any Anti-Divine, Anti-Immortal, Anti-Mystery, and Instant Death effects.
objects.title: Incarnated God (Type-Moon)

addons.text: The enhancement to your vessel has released some of the limitations of Install. The strain and mana cost of maintaining your transformation are dramatically reduced to the point where you can maintain the transformation permanently if you choose. You are essentially breaking even in costs in this case. Additionally, any installed Servants that aren’t Grand Servants are scaled up as if they were summoned as one. Grand Servants are no longer scaled down.
addons.title: Of Silver and Steel

addons.text: Instead of summoning a specific Servant from The Throne of Heroes, you gain a sentient projection that can take on the form of any Servant from the Throne. Otherwise, they function exactly as if they were summoned as normal.
addons.title: Servant: Faker

addons.text: You can now Install the Servant at their full power as they were during life, in their legend, or as a Divine Spirit—whichever is the strongest. Additionally, maintaining your transformation is completely free. Utilizing their powers will still cost mana if it would have for the installed version of the Servant.
addons.title: and Legends Beyond

objects.text:
By utilizing your enhanced connection to the Throne of Heroes as well as your Servant physiology, you can install any Servant that has ever been recorded in the Throne of Heroes. In this state, you gain full access to their powers, skills, memories, and armaments as if they were incarnated as a Servant. If the Servant you are installing is a Grand Servant, they are scaled down to a regular one. You can choose how much the memories affect you, if at all, as well as the appearance and/or outfit of the Heroic Spirit you have transformed into.

For example, Install: Morgan Le Fey would grant you her memories and with them, her vast arcane knowledge, any spells she knew in Arthurian legend, all of her class and personal skills, as well as her various and magical armaments, along with her Noble Phantasm.

Anything you create or conjure while transformed remains, excluding the spirits' equipment. For example, King Arthur would have Avalon and Excalibur, but they would disappear if you ended the transformation. On the other hand, if you turned into Medea and crafted a magic item or set up wards, they would remain because they are not dependent on her powers to exist—only to be created. Similarly, if you were to turn into Merlin and train a hero, they would retain any information and powers you taught them.

The transformation requires large amounts of mana to maintain and places a strain on the user's Magic Circuits. As you use this power, it will slowly become easier and less costly to maintain, eventually leading to you being able to retain the ability indefinitely. Higher-quality Magic Circuits and mana will make this state cost less and last longer.
objects.title: Install: Phantasm Summon (Type-Moon)

addons.text:
You have become a living incarnation of Artoria and Arthur Pendragon, granting you all their memories (of which you may decide if and how they affect you), skills, abilities and blessings, as well as the numerous items and weapons that all the many versions of Artoria and Arthur have ever wielded in the Type-Moon franchise.

Notable examples of such treasures are the Space Armor version of Avalon and her Spaceship Dun Stallion II, wielded by a certain Mysterious Heroine; the Divine Spear and Core held by Goddess Rhongomyniad, who can summon the Knights of the Round Table—except Galahad and Bedivere—to aid her; and the sword Marmyadose, wielded by her Lostbelt Caster variant, said to exceed Excalibur in power alone.
addons.title: King of Knights

addons.text:
You have become a living incarnation of the world's first Hero, Gilgamesh, granting you all their memories (of which you may decide if and how they affect you), skills, abilities and blessings, as well as the numerous items and weapons that all the many versions of Gilgamesh have ever wielded in the Type-Moon franchise.

Notable examples of such power are the Child Gil's "the King's Smile," or Adult Gil's "A.U.O. Cast Off," able to paralyze even powerful supernatural beings with his raw charisma; Enkidu and his powers, as he considered himself one of Gilgamesh's possessions; and the incredible power he had in CCC, allowing him to directly contradict the will of the Moon Cell, as well as fight on completely equal terms with BB, and later (with some help) destroy Kiara Sessyoin.
addons.title: King of Heroes

addons.text: You are imbued with the essence of King Solomon, making you a living embodiment of the legendary mage. This bestowed upon you all of the memories, skills, abilities, and blessings held by Solomon, in addition to a multitude of powerful weapons and artifacts, such as his Clairvoyance of the past and future, the Ten Rings of Solomon, and his immense magical power that would allow you to fight against even the mightiest of foes. You are also able to summon and command the 72 Demon God Pillars, including Goetia. With these newfound powers, you are a formidable force, possessing the power of the great mage, enabling you to take on any challenge with confidence. Your abilities are unparalleled, and no obstacle will stand in your way, for you are a living incarnation of Solomon.
addons.title: King of Magecraft

addons.text: As a living incarnation of the great mage Merlin, you possess a wealth of knowledge, skills, abilities, and blessings. You have Merlin's memories, which you can choose to access at will, and all his experience. Your skills and abilities are unmatched, and you are capable of doing the extraordinary. In your arsenal, you have his legendary artifacts, including his Clairvoyance, which allows you to see anywhere in the present, and the Garden of Avalon, which you can call upon at your bidding. Not only that, you have access to his incubus bloodline, enabling you to enter the dreams of others and manipulate them to your liking. You are a force to be reckoned with, and nothing can stop you as you wield the power of the legendary mage.
addons.title: Magus of Flowers

addons.text: You have become the living incarnation of the Hero of Charity, Karna. This gives you all of his memories (how they affect you is up to you), skills, abilities, blessings, and various items and weapons from different versions of Karna in the Type-Moon franchise—including Archer, Rider, Santa, and even Super Karna (Burning Three Gods Karna), who wields the powers of Vishnu and Shiva.
addons.title: Hero of Charity

addons.text: You have become the living incarnation of Greece's greatest hero, Hercules. This grants you all the memories (how they affect you is for you to decide), skills, abilities/blessings, and numerous items & weapons from various versions of Hercules in the Type-Moon Franchise. These include Archer Hercules' Bow made from the Hydra, his Valor Skill, his corrupted version, Alcides' King's Order twelve-part Noble Phantasm, and Reincarnation Pandora, which allows him to absorb the powers and items of his opponents. Additionally, Saber Hercules wields "Marmyadose," a sword stronger than even Excalibur.
addons.title: Greatest Hero of Greece

addons.text:
You have become a living incarnation of Tamamo-No-Mae, granting you all their memories (of which you may decide if and how they affect you), skills, abilities, and blessings, as well as the numerous items and weapons that all the many versions of Tamamo have ever wielded in the Type-Moon franchise.

However, this power is dependent on the number of "tails" available to you at any one time. You start with only one tail, equal to Tamamo when she fought inside the Moon Cell, or other single-tailed Tamamos such as Tamamo Cat. You will grow more tails over time, dependent on your mastery of the Celestial Brush. The more tails you grow, the more powerful you become, with your final nine-tailed form equaling Amaterasu herself, a being that in raw power alone surpassed even Sefar.
addons.title: Sessho-Seki

addons.text:
You have become a living incarnation of the Buddhas featured in Type-Moon, granting you all their memories (of which you may decide if and how they affect you), skills, abilities, and blessings, as well as the numerous items and weapons that all the many Buddhas have ever wielded in the Type-Moon franchise.

In particular, this gives you the abilities of Shakyamuni himself, such as granting Moksha to anyone with Amita Amitābha, the abilities of Xuanzang, such as a Buddha Palm strong enough to destroy Divine Spirits in a single strike, the abilities of Ashoka, who inspired the very concept of "Chakravartin", & even those of Kiara Sessyoin and Kama/Mara, for Kiara was a Shingon practitioner, and both were said to be "similar to a Buddha."
addons.title: Arhat

addons.text:
You have become a living incarnation of the many variants of Cú Chulainn & Scathach featured in Type-Moon, granting you all their memories (of which you may decide if and how they affect you), skills, abilities, and blessings, as well as the numerous items and weapons that all the many variants of Cú & Scathach have ever wielded in the Type-Moon franchise.

This includes Gaé Bolg, Caster & Skadi's Rune Magecraft, including Ochd Deug Odin, Cú Alter's Curruid Coinchenn, Sétanta's Cruaidín Sétanta, Scathach's Gate of Skye, and even Scathach-Skadi's Gate of Aegir if you just want to enjoy a day at the beach.
addons.title: Hound of Ulster

addons.text:
You have become a living incarnation of the various versions of Hassan-i-Sabbah featured in Type-Moon, granting you all their memories (of which you may decide if and how they affect you), skills, abilities, and blessings, as well as the numerous items and weapons that all the many variants of Hassan have ever wielded in the Type-Moon franchise.

This includes Cursed Arm's Zabaniya: Delusional Heartbeat, King Hassan's Azrael, Serenity's Zabaniya: Delusional Poison Body, Hundred Face's Zabaniya: Delusional Illusion, Shining Star's Zabaniya: Thoughtless Framework, & the many Skills that those wearing the mantle of Hassan found gainful.
addons.title: Old Man of The Mountain

addons.text:
You have become a living incarnation of the various Oni featured in the Type-Moon franchise. This grants you all their memories (of which you may decide if and how they affect you) along with their skills, abilities, and blessings. You also gain access to the various tools, weapons, and techniques wielded by the many incarnations of Shuten-dōji, Ibaraki-douji and Tomoe Gozen.

Notable examples include the skill Intoxicating Aroma of Fruits and Battle Continuation. A few examples of the Noble Phantasm you gain are Multitude of Colors - Providential Oni Poison, a Noble Phantasm that was a poisonous sake drank by Shuten-douji, as well as the Noble Phantasm Great Grudge of Rashoumon, the right hand of Ibaraki-douji. You also gain items such as The Bone Sword, used by Ibaraki-douji and VR Shinkage-ryuu Hidden Art - Laser Blade Dual Wielding Style, used by Tomoe Gozen.
addons.title: Oni Kind

addons.text:
You have become a living incarnation of the various Roman Emperors featured in Type-Moon, granting you all their memories (of which you may decide if and how they affect you), skills, abilities, and blessings, as well as the numerous items and weapons that all of these eminent Romans have ever wielded in the Type-Moon franchise.

This includes Julius Caesar's Crocea Mors, Romulus' Magna Voluisse Magnum & Moles Necessarie, Romulus-Quirinius's Per Aspera Ad Astra & Nine Lives - Roma, Caligula's Flucticulus Diana, Nero Claudius' Aestus Domus Aurea, Saber Venus' Charitas Domus Aurora, & the many Skills that those wearing the laurel wreath found gainful.

You also gain the abilities of Hector & Paris (as the Romans claimed to be the descendants of the Trojans), & the abilities of Napoleon Bonaparte, a man who in every act consciously modeled his life after that of Caesar.
addons.title: Senatus Populusque Romanus

addons.text:
"Of ladies, knights, of passions and of wars, of courtliness, and of valiant deeds I sing."
-Ludovico Ariosto, Orlando Furioso

You have become a living incarnation of every version of Charlemagne and his Paladins featured in Type-Moon, granting you all their memories (of which you may decide if and how they affect you), skills, abilities, and blessings, as well as the numerous items and weapons that all of these famous Knights of The Continent have ever wielded in the Type-Moon franchise.

This includes Roland's Durandal & Roncevaux Olifant, Charlemagne's Joyeuse & Charles Patricius, Bradamante's Bouclier de Atlante & Angelica Cathay, Mandricardo's Serment de Durandal & Rêve de Durandal, Astolfo's surprisingly numerous amount of Noble Phantasms, & the abilities of the other Paladins, which are as of yet unknown.

You also gain the abilities of Lancelot, Jeanne d'Arc, Gilles de Rais, Jacques de Molay, & Chevalier d'Eon, for they too were all Knights of France.
addons.title: The Twelve Paladins of Charlemagne

addons.text:
You've become a Grand of the Extra Class—beyond the seven Main Classes—a feat thought to be impossible. A Class intrinsically tied to humanity's spirit of exploration, discovery, hope, and the unyielding desire to push forward and see the future. It is the shining star of possibility that humanity turns to in its darkest hours—a guiding light that inspires them to rise, to press on, and to continue ever onward into the unknown.

As the foremost Heroic Spirit of Navigation by default, you may choose to inherit the unique Skills and Noble Phantasm of the one who gave birth to this Class: Voyager-1. Alternatively, you can chart your own course among the sea of stars, carrying with you the dreams of your world and your people—creating new myths, Skills, and Noble Phantasms worthy of your legend.

Regardless of the path you choose, you gain the Independent Navigation and Contact with Civilization Skills at EX rank. Your Pioneer of the Stars Skill also evolves to EX rank—the very qualification required to be a Grand Voyager. You embody the pinnacle of one who makes the impossible possible, a being of limitless potential who inspires others to reach beyond their limits—to touch the untouchable, break the unbreakable.

Even if you lack the raw stats or combat prowess of other Grand Servants, you will always see the shining path that leads to victory. You possess a conceptual advantage that allows you to transcend the rules of any world you inhabit, granting you anti-world properties that let you defy the restrictions they impose on their inhabitants.
addons.title: Grand Voyager

addons.text:
You have become a living incarnation of every version of the heroes of the Trojan War (or those closely related to Homeric myth) featured in Type-Moon, granting you all their memories (of which you may decide if and how they affect you), skills, abilities, and blessings, as well as the numerous items and weapons that all of these noble Achaeans & Trojans have ever wielded in the Type-Moon franchise.

This includes Achilles "Troias Tragōidia", "Dromeus Komētēs", "Andreias Amarantos", "Diatrekhōn Astēr Lonkhē", & "Akhilleus Kosmos", Chiron's "Antares Snipe", Odysseus' "Penelope", "Aigis", & "Troia Hippos", Ajax's "Rho Aias", Hector's "Durindana Spada" & "Durindana Pilum", Paris' "Troia Velos" & "Distihia Milya", Penthesilea's "Outrage Amazon", "Trojan Reinforce", & "Goddess Of War", and Circe's "Metabole Piglets."
addons.title: To Sack Priam
Grand Foreigner
addons.text: You have mantled the impossible position of Grand Foreigner, and gained the abilities of ORT Xibalba. You are no longer tied to the Throne of Heroes. Instead, you have created an artificial version of it where you may simulate your own legend to alter your own Saint Graph to grant yourself new abilities and increase your power.

objects.text: Summoned by humans and meant for combat between individuals, ordinary Servants are the cheap, disposable containers instead of the extraordinary existences that are the Grand Class Servants. Unlike normal Servants, they are summoned by the World, purpose-built for combat against the threats that affect the Planet. You've ascended to The Station of the Crown; One of the seven strongest of the era, and your saint graph now reflects that meteoric rise. Abilities that were once out of reach for you are now within your grasp, and you're not dependent on humanity's recognition to grow in strength, as the World itself is confirming your existence. Instead of having a mortal master, your master is the World. This gives you an almost endless well of magical energy to fuel your abilities, and your power will rise the more your opponent endangers the Planet itself. Your status as a Grand Servant is not a static thing. You may give up your status for a considerable power boost, which may allow you to do things like shooting down a magic-tech god or enforcing death upon a deathless being. This does not stop you from regaining your title at a later point.
objects.title: Grand Servant (Type-Moon)

objects.text: A crown of horns rests on your head as a symbol for your candidacy and partial ascension as one of the Evils of Mankind, who were charged with punishing humanity. The act of becoming a Beast grants you several unique abilities. The first is Independent Manifestation, allowing the transportation and materialization of the soul across time and space. Travelling throughout the timeline and across the world is easy for you, taking a few minutes to discorporate and reincorporate when you do so. While the accuracy in the location of arrival can leave something to be desired, the time-travelling aspect is pinpoint. Second is the Authority of the Beast that you gain, an ability through which you gain an enormous advantage against all beings classified as Human. Any being such as this finds your powers to be far greater against them than against anyone else. Not to a degree that great heroes could not put up a fight, but enough to make that same fight feel almost impossible even for the greatest of the human heroes. The final aspect of all Beasts is the Nega attribute. Each Beast is a counter to a specific category of being, against which they receive additional and enormous advantages. A counter to Servants that negates their greatest abilities and grants the Beast additional buffs when fighting against that category of being. You may create your own Nega skill here, composed of negating some aspect of the power set of your chosen target range and gaining large increases in effectiveness against them. The smaller your range, the greater your negation and benefits will be.
objects.title: Evil Of Humanity (Type-Moon)

addons.text:
By sitting upon the divine throne and assimilating it into your own spiritual foundation, you have become more than a simple collective of daemons, you are Pandaemonium, the capital of Hell itself. 

As the living seat of daemonic power, you are composed of all the ruling daemons of Hell, even beyond Solomon’s 72 familiars, including the great rebels like Lucifer, Satan, and Iblis. As such, your power is second only to god himself, granting you hellish authority over all things save Heaven

Additionally, you have acquired the ability to create and name new daemons, just as Solomon once did to create his familiars. To accomplish this, you first need to spend time crafting a Unit Designation for your new daemon, which encompasses and shapes their entire being, before investing a sufficient amount of magical energy to truly bring it into being. 

Simple daemon foot soldiers (each capable of slaughtering ordinary magi) are trivial to create, and you are capable of creating dozens or even hundreds of them a day to populate your legions. Powerful daemons on the level of Solomon’s Daemon Gods are not so simple to create, with it taking months of dedicated effort and refinement to complete a single one.
addons.title: Throne of Pandaemonium

objects.text:
You have become Goetia, Beast I. You gain all of his abilities, skills and memories. The Demon Gods are now a part of you and yours to command. You gain the Temple of Time, also known as Ars Paulina, a workshop that exists outside of the universe and outside of time, located in the space of imaginary numbers.

Each Demon God has a distinct personality, but they exist as a unified being. Through the use of Ars Paulina, they are able to continuously revive no matter how many times they were fought. Killing Demon God Pillars requires destroying all 72 at once — if even one remains intact, they will resurrect their fallen members.

Their pillar forms, although varied in appearance, share a similar shape resembling a cephalopod tentacle with rings of eyes (either round or angular) in place of suckers. The colors of the pillars vary, with many having black skin and red eyes. The immense scale of the Demon God is difficult to grasp — the pupils of each pillar have diameters that are multiple times the size of a regular human, making them towering and horrifying figures. These giants are adorned with a surface layer of frozen human bodies, both young and old, beautiful and ugly, each with a distinct expression reflecting the moment of absorption: agony, pain, sadness, anger, and other emotions. This body pile is a staggering three meters deep, beneath which lie the actual muscles and blood vessels of the Demon God. Over time, as the bodies are assimilated and absorbed, they become covered in a blanket of deep red lines. Once these lines appear, the bodies will eventually break down, creating more "blood" for the Demon God.

The destruction of Ars Paulina will undo the union of the immortal colony of the 72, causing them to become individual Demons and preventing them from reviving their fallen numbers. The only way to destroy Ars Paulina is through your death or the use of the Noble Phantasm: Ars Nova.
objects.title: Demon Gods (Type-Moon)

objects.text: You have become Tiamat, Beast II. You gain all of her abilities, skills, and memories. The Sea of Life is at your disposal, allowing you to actively generate the black mud from your body at an alarming rate. You have also acquired a soothing voice that calms those around you and exudes a sort of motherly aura. The Sea of Life, made of the same black mud that Angra Mainyu used during the end of the 4th Holy Grail War, allows you to pollute any organism that comes into contact with it, fundamentally changing them into something befitting of being “A Child of Tiamat”. Upon emerging from the mud, those who were corrupted by the mud are eternally loyal to you and have a geas imposed upon them to become enemies of Humanity. They are given skills as well, such as Self-Modification, which allows your children to modify themselves to make up for certain weaknesses or empower themselves further. Not even Servants are immune to corruption. While you remain within or in physical contact with the Sea of Life, it will constantly heal you, along with supplying you with unlimited magical energy. Furthermore, to complement your massive regeneration, you lack the concept of death. Completely. This means that you, of course, cannot be killed in any meaningful way, unable to be stopped or put down. At best, your enemies could only seal you away and hope that it works, let alone lasts. You can still be hurt and feel pain, mind you, and something imposing the concept of death onto you will obviously circumvent your lack thereof, allowing you to be killed, but you won’t be going down without a fight. Self Modification, at Rank EX, allows you to mold your own saint graph, changing or adapting to the problems you currently face, such as making wings to take flight if you are unable to move on land. As a trump card, you can absorb the Sea of Life you generate from your body and take on a much larger form, often described as a ‘draconic body’, that towers over all at a height of ~60 meters. While in this form, you are incapable of taking any damage that is of Rank A++ or lower. This also massively boosts your strength and durability. In this state, you are no longer a Divine Spirit, but a genuine God among mortals. Finally, you have Tiamat’s Nega Skill, Nega Genesis. Nega Genesis allows you to generate a conceptual bounded field around yourself that replicates the Genesis of the Earth, rejecting the natural course of evolution. This means that Noble Phantasms are nullified inside or against the barrier. Nega Genesis is best described as a manifestation of your Authority, creating a new world and overwriting the old one, similar to a reality marble. Ever expanding, it denies all established forms of life, those whose lives are over and never died, instantly destroying beings such as Servants or Divine Spirits when coming into contact with it, while also giving you more space to create new life.
objects.title: Primordial Mother (Type-Moon)

addons.text: You can now fuse with Servants as powerful as Grand Servants.
addons.title: Alaya

objects.text:
You have acquired one of the highest arts of Spiritual Evocation Magecraft, Heroic Spirit Possession. 

This grants you the ability to fuse with your own Servant, giving you personal access to their parameters, skills, Noble Phantasms, and optionally their appearance and personality as well. 

Normally, a person would only be able to sustain such a state for a brief period of time before they start to collapse under the sheer power of their Servant. Luckily, you are also a Servant, meaning you can maintain your possession indefinitely.
objects.title: Heroic Spirit Possession (Type-Moon)

addons.text: You may now also fuse beasts.
addons.title: Beasts

objects.text:
You can now fuse multiple Servants at a time into your body, gaining the abilities of all of them, with overlapping abilities seeming to "stack."

You can also do this with your Servants, giving you a use for duplicates.
objects.title: High-Servant (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
With each purchase here, you can now perform the ritual to summon an additional Servant from the Throne of Heroes. Each new Servant is as self-sustaining as your first, and each one is one of the infinite variants of your desired Servant—the one most compatible with you.

Like your original Servant, if you exhaust your Command Seals or if your Servant is slain, you may perform the ritual again to summon a new Servant as a replacement.
objects.title: Additional Summons (Type-Moon)

objects.text: Normal Command seals are precious resources, hoarded by the Masters to command their Servants, and used only when absolutely necessary. But not yours, your Command Seals will now always replenish themselves over time, each taking 24 hours from the moment they were used until being available for use once more. Note: If you use up all of your Servants available Command Seals you can choose to summon a new Servant, this resets your seals to the full three.
objects.title: Replenishing Command Seal (Type-Moon)

objects.text: A summoned Servant comes with three Command Seals as standard, you however have managed to break this 'rule' and possess more Command Seals. Note: Each purchase of this upgrade gives you an extra Command Seal per servant if you have Additional Summons (Type-Moon).
objects.title: Additional Command Seal (Type-Moon)

objects.text: Your eyes have been upgraded to its prototypical form, turning into the Divine Eyes of Balor. Because of your eye's divine origin, you could actualize death simply by looking at the target and tracing the lines of death through your eyes. Moreover, these pair of eyes also work on beings not having the concept of death by impressing the concept of Death upon them, thereby making them mortal. The only limitation of the eyes are how far you can perceive and the range of your vision. The eyes may have further abilities which you may discover through time.
objects.title: Eyes of Balor (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
By being imbued with the Element of the Dragon, the blood and magical energy of a Dragon now run through your veins, coalescing your Magic Circuits into your heart and creating a unique type of Magic Circuits that transcend what can be achieved by normal humans and magi, called a Magic Core. Your new core functions as an enormous Magical Energy core with tremendous capacity that generates energy independent from your body simply through breathing like dragons. The amount of Magical Energy it generates rivals the heat of the Earth's core, allowing one to potentially fuel weapons on the level of the strongest of Noble Phantasms multiple times in a row.

Your Magic Core also grants you the natural ability to increase your performance by infusing your armaments and body with Magical Energy and instantly expelling it. Simply put, recreating the effect of a jet burst by expending large amounts of Magical Energy. With your immense magical power, it's possible to maintain a full body reinforcement with ease, allowing someone with the strength of an ordinary human to amplify their physicality to go toe-to-toe with even A-ranked Servants.

Your Dragon Factor - as well as enhancing your endurance and stamina - grants a great resistance to magical phenomena, though not necessarily on the level of a Saber-class Servant. As a side effect, you may find yourself with a much greater appetite and an increased capability to quickly digest food and have room for more. Any excess calories/nutrients are burned off by your Magic Core and turned into Magical Energy, should you need it for some reason.
objects.title: Factor of the Dragon (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
Like Melusine, you are the left hand of the Dragon Albion. Somehow, you were given a form, a mind, and a purpose, allowing you to be more than a mindless calamity. Though only a fragment of the original dragon, you are a powerful and deadly force.

In your “human” form, you possess extraordinary physical capabilities. Your strength and speed far surpass human limits. You can nullify air resistance, enabling you to move at astonishing speeds unhindered, reaching around 500 kilometers per hour in flight. Your agility in the air is exceptional, rivaling the most skilled aerial creatures.

You are adorned in futuristic and ornate armor that is predominantly metallic blue with cyan and silver accents. This metallic blue armour is adorned with glowing teal runes and geometric designs. It has a sleek, futuristic design resembling a dragon’s exoskeleton fused with robotic aesthetics. The armor fully covers your torso, arms, and legs, forming thigh-high armored boots, and can be summoned or dismissed at will.

Your primary weapon is crafted from your own crystallized magical energy and hardened scales. The sword rapidly expands when drawn, meaning you wield it for only brief moments in combat. Its attacks are devastating, serving as a point-blank ranged weapon capable of skewering and slicing enemies with precision.

When you revert to your true form, you take on the appearance of a smaller dragon, no larger than four meters in length. As you are only the 'left hand' that separated from the ancient Dragon of Albion and survived, you cannot fully return to the colossal size of the original dragon. In this form, you become a living weapon, drawing energy from the atmosphere without being affected by air pressure, temperature, or other physical constraints. Your wings allow for instantaneous acceleration, enabling you to surpass the sound barrier in less than half a second and maintain speeds above Mach 2.

Your most destructive attack is called Hollow Heart Albion. By releasing concentrated energy from your core, you unleash a ray of heat so intense it can cleave through the toughest defenses with ease. A single strike from this attack can burn through armor and barriers, leaving devastation in its wake.

You can freely shift between your human form and true form, enhancing your human appearance with draconic features.
objects.title: Left Hand of Albion

objects.text:
As a Pure-Blooded Dragon, you embody the apex of Phantasmal Species, possessing unparalleled power and magical prowess. Merely by breathing, you generate a tremendous amount of magical energy that can significantly impact the surrounding environment. Your scales, imbued with the innate resistance of a Dragon, provide an impervious barrier that allows only the most potent forms of Magecraft and Magic to penetrate.

Your mastery of magic surpasses even the most extraordinary feats witnessed during the Age of the Gods, effortlessly shattering the boundaries of what is considered possible. You can shift to and from your Human and Dragon form with ease, possibly creating a hybrid form between the two. Your body morphs itself to fit your vision, allowing you to change your appearance with a mere thought.

You will continue to exist, as no matter how much Mystery exists in the world, you are a Mystery in your own right. Your immortal existence only compounds its strength as it grows older.
objects.title: Phantasmal Species: Dragon (Type-Moon)

objects.text: No more are you merely the detached hand of Albion, now you are a Pure-Blooded Dragon in truth, almost its child in a way, or at least that’s what you would have been. However, through a combination of a transcendent physiology and regression to a previous state, you have become Albion in truth, a being as old as the planet itself with a Mystery spanning 4.6 billion years and the strength to match. Your size towers over mountains, your spells bend reality to your will, and your power eclipses most Gods. You are Albion Returned.
objects.title: Origin Dragon Returned

addons.text: The Root is not merely a compendium of Magecraft; it encompasses the knowledge of all things. To surpass the Root your Philosophy Foundation is no longer limited to Magecraft and magic alone. Your aptitude shines brightly in the infinite universe, enabling you to gather knowledge of all things into your Philosophy Foundation. Whether it be psychic powers, super sciences, or cosmic horrors, you can add it to your Foundation. Philosophy Key users can utilize, fuse, or create Magecraft with any type of knowledge placed into the Foundation.
addons.title: Trichiliocosm’s Knowledge

addons.text:
As the Embodiment of the hope and magecraft of the Xian of Tiānxià otherwise know as China, you now hold the ability to recreate the Texture that has been lost to the World.

Now rather than simply being a Xian you now hold the Position of; the Jade Emperor; the Highest Emperor; Great Emperor of Jade and Ruler of Heaven, and as such you can with time bring forth all your subjects, whether that is Erlang Shen the greatest warrior of heaven or maybe the dragons that control the ocean and rains.

Through embodying Heaven and Earth you can eventually gain control of the Authorities of the Chinese Gods, Monsters and Demons becoming that much closer to []. 

If you hold the capacity to recreate any other Texture you can seamlessly incorporate them into your Foundation and the Tiānxià Texture making both yourself and the Texture that much more Encompassing and stronger.

You can either ”deploy” and project the Texture onto the World you are currently on replacing what exists with your own World and destroying what is there currently. If you do not wish to destroy the World you can take the slower path of integrating it into your Texture and slowly take control of it.

If you choose to deploy it, the location where you did becomes your ”Throne”, which can be any shape, and if’s destroyed before the destruction or integration of the World you will suffer immense backlash with death being a possibility.
addons.title: Texture of Tiānxià

objects.text:
The Philosophy Foundation is a simulation of an artificial Root crafted by Xian from the Age of Gods. Originally a supreme Mystic Code fused into the planet, it is now woven directly into your existence. Akin to a massive library, the Philosophy Foundation contains the Magecraft practiced across mainland continental Asia, from China to the Middle East, since its creation thousands of years ago. As its vessel, you transform into a Xian, an immortal Sage with eternal youth. Your sagehood grants you high-quality circuits and a large amount of Od, comparable to the greatest modern geniuses like Rin Tohsaka, Flat Escardos, or Touko Aozaki.

You need to utilize a Philosophy Key to access and cast spells from the Foundation’s confines. As the vessel of the Philosophy Foundation, your Philosophy Key is of the highest rank, allowing you to access and use all its knowledge. You can also distribute Philosophy Keys to others, allowing them access to the Philosophy Foundation. As the administrator, you have the right to determine the level of Philosophy Keys you distribute and can raise or lower them as you see fit. You can gift high-level keys with access to extraordinary Magecraft or low-level keys that can only utilize cantrips. Like a library membership, the restrictions on their Philosophy Keys change what books they can borrow, but everyone is still using the same Philosophy Foundation.

You are talented in using Philosophy Magecraft and can cast spells at the same levels as Taigong Wang, who could utilize it to teleport hundreds of miles, clone himself dozens of times, and even seal gods. The goal of Philosophy Magecraft isn’t to reach the Root but to refine the Philosophy Foundation until it can surpass the Root itself. The Philosophy Foundation collects the thoughts and knowledge of its wielders’ Magecraft and continues to expand itself. You may also incorporate Western Magecraft or any other magic you discover into the Philosophy Foundation. As its vessel, the more refined the Philosophy Foundation becomes, the stronger you will grow.
objects.title: Philosophy Foundation (Type-Moon)

objects.text: As an heir to one of the prodigious 「Six Sources」 families—the founding lineages behind the Atlas Institute, equivalent to the Lords of the Clock Tower—you possess talent on the level of Atlas's greatest minds, considered to be a genius alchemist comparable to Sion Eltnam in terms of intellect and overall aptitude. Alongside a veritably "particular" affinity for your family's 「Traditional Feature」: internal techniques developed by the Six Sources to awaken and exploit the absolute potential of their bodies. With each family choosing to specialize in a different subsect of human physiology—such as the Crudelis's 「Exoform」 (bone manipulation), Eltnam's 「Etherlite」 (nerve manipulation), or Ishtario's 「Moleculeface」 (skin manipulation), among others. And due to being a member of the Six Sources, your body has special cells that can produce magical energy exclusively while within it, providing a partial workaround for your limited circuits. Their output, likewise, is twenty times that of an average Magus, with even faster regeneration rates. Note: You're now able to maintain up to seven active partitions and stretch a single second into a full minute, respectively, using Memory Partitioning and Thought Acceleration.
objects.title: Six Sources' Heir (Type-Moon)

objects.text: You acquire a Magic Crest, which serves as a repository of Magecraft of your choosing, contained within a large number of Magic Circuits that serve as its vessel. Each Magic Crest comes with 200 years of research, allowing you to cast any spell it holds. With each additional purchase, you can either double the existing Magecraft research or add another 200 years of research from a different branch of Magecraft. Research in any specific branch of Magecraft is limited to a maximum of 3200 years.
objects.title: Magic Crest (Type-Moon)

objects.text: You can now acquire additional Magic Circuits beyond your initial set. Upon your first selection, you'll receive a second set of circuits equal in both number and quality to your original ones. With every subsequent purchase afterward, doubling the amount gained. For example, if your original set contains 20 circuits, the first purchase adds 20 more (for a total of 40). The second doubles that 20 to 40, the third does this again to 80, the fourth to 160, and the fifth to 320—resulting in a final total of 340 circuits.
objects.title: Additional Magic Circuits (Type-Moon)

addons.text: You are Excalibur and Excalibur is Everything. What the fuck are you?!? You have been transformed into a universe-spanning, living reality marble much like Nursery Rhyme. Inside your reality marble resides a complete copy of the universe that you're in or the world of the Type-Moon; However, from the trees, to the stars, to the very fabric of space, all of them are formed out of Excalibur and can be summoned, out of your reality marble, to your side. The all-encompassing expanse that resides within your soul has been beyond conceptually attuned to the promise of victory; you could beat down a million gods with a summoned ant or your fists or even crush them with your magical energy. To your opponents, it wouldn't matter, for they will be felled all the same. You are Victorious. Period. This is due to your beyond insane obsession with Excalibur, shaping your narrative to make you triumphant eternally. Additionally, the amount of mana gained from the world, to use against threat to the planet, has been magnified by a significant margin.
addons.title: Excalibur Excalibur: The Excalibur of Promised Excalibur

objects.text: "Sheathed in the breath of the planet. A shining torrent of life. Victory is in our hands! And thus, the Sword of Promised Victory” The essence of "She Who Creates the Holy Sword" and "She Who Wields the Holy Sword" has been combined into a sum greater than the parts. You do not just own nor forge the sword. You are the promise of victory, a figment of glory that all men desire. You are Excalibur.. Every variation of the holy sword is conceptually integrated into your being. Victory is ever within reaching distance, especially when facing enemies of not just humanity but the very Planet itself. In such events, the very life force of the Planet is yours to command, meaning killing a being on the level of Sefar is not just possible but expected. The light of Excalibur may be unleashed from any part of your body or even in an aura if you wish. The purification value of this illumination is infinite, even the great demon Goetia would be harmed by your radiance. You actions are metaphysically reinforced with triumph. Every step, every attack, every breath is better than the one before, even if your talent shouldn't allow it. This is true power of Excalibur, those who wielded the holy sword were ever victorious. You are the second coming of paradise. Show mankind the hope found in victory.
objects.title: Convergence of the Holy Sword (Type-Moon)

addons.text:
Like Shiki Ryougi before you, your connection to the Root stems from your Origin of「　」however unlike her your Origin was not Awakened and thus your connection to it is lesser than her own, constraining your actions with limitations like magical energy expenditure. 

However, the Path of the Flaming Sword which achieves apotheosis through one’s Origin provides a way to fix such deficits. Assuming you choose to progress your own Pathway derived from your Origin, as you progress through the Sequences your connection to the Root deepens as the boundary between yourself and the Root grows thinner.

By Sequence 0 your connection rivals that of Shiki Ryougi, enough to be considered a part of the Root itself and effectively omnipotent via being able to simply will alterations to the Root into existence with no regard for magical energy expenditure. Additionally, as the origin of every event and phenomena that exists, the Root naturally functions as a Sefirah. 

Therefore, it is possible to achieve Above the Sequence through this Pathway, although this will be especially arduous due to the enormity of what you are trying to achieve. Should you achieve this ascension however, you will find that you are no longer a mere part of the Root but the Root in its entirety, the absolute incarnation of everything that Was, Is, and Could Be.

objects.text: The pathway potion system was derived from knowledge God Almighty left within the Blasphemy slate, and Magecraft was created from the vision God gave Solomon. From this, you have created the Path of the Flaming Sword. This transcendental magecraft focuses on apotheosis through an individual's "Origin" while retaining the ability to function as a person. This equalizes your Origin and the Sequence Zero of your pathway, with the latter derived from the former. This allows you to choose one of the canon Sequence Zeroes as your origin, or create a new Pathway derived from your Origin. Regardless of this choice, the endpoint remains the incarnation of universal symbology. As you ascend along the Path of the Flaming Sword, you gradually transform into a deity before transcending even that as a primordial embodying universal symbolism rather than a god embodying earthly authority. Due to this, your authority and symbolism are intrinsic characteristics you possess rather than something granted by the world. The Path of the Flaming Sword still follows the same sequence system as the Beyonder pathway system. With each advancement, regardless of the pathway, your Od generation and output increase exponentially. As you advance along your pathway, you gain the potential of Age of Gods magic; however, unless your pathway provides knowledge or abilities in magical domains, you would have to find a teacher or learn it yourself. As you advance, you develop the effects of Divine Spirit (Type-Moon) at sequence two and Incarnated God (Type-Moon) at sequence zero, with you becoming a universal primordial with your advancement to Above The Sequence. (If you purchase Divine Spirit (Type-Moon) or Incarnated God (Type-Moon), you immediately advance to the corresponding sequence.) You can create a ritual to condense uniqueness, allowing you to reach Sequence Zero even without buying Uniqueness (Lord of the Mysteries) separately. This ritual will be comparable to your apotheosis ritual in difficulty. Reaching Above The Sequence, however, will be beyond your reach without a sefirot obtained from the CYOA or one native to the world of LOTM. While you can teach this Magecraft to other magi, their pathway that forms will be up to their ''Origin'', and they will be unable to surpass Sequence Zero.
objects.title: Path of the Flaming Sword

objects.text: You are the peer of Lorelei Barthomeloi, the supreme mage of the present era and the current Vice Director of the Clocktower. Your magecraft isn’t esoteric or unconventional but the pinnacle of what ordinary magecraft can do, bordering on the level of True Magic. It is enough to combat Dead Apostle Ancestors at the peak of their power, blowing out walls and rooms of a Castle with average spells in the throws of battle, whilst it is a Red Moon. Your Magical Circuits have been transformed into Blue Blood: Noble Magic Circuits. They are perfect, immune to the degradation or mutilation that other mage families are prone to have. Additionally, the number of magic circuits you have exceeds the current Director of the Clocktower, a magus who has lived before the birth of Christ. You also have the Sorcery Trait, Almighty, which allows your magical phenomena to overcome other magical effects with a similar amount of energy. For example, if you created an unbreakable shield and an unstoppable spear was thrown at it, with relatively equal amounts of power, then your shield would prevail. As a Wizard Marshal, you seem to draw those who forgo self-serving goals such as wealth or the root to become Human weapons that destroy those in your path. They will also develop unnaturally strong magic and fighting abilities, being on the level of Branch Head. It is not just in magecraft that Barthomeloi reigns supreme in but as the zenith of Type-Moon’s Magical Aristocracy. You’ve been given all the training that the Heir of the Barthomeloi Family would require, such as magical tuition, politics, diplomacy and subterfuge.
objects.title: Queen of the Clocktower (Type-Moon)

addons.text:
Instead of becoming an ordinary True Ancestor, you were ‘’born’’ under a blue moon. You have deviated from Crimson Moon’s mold in the process.

Traditionally, True Ancestors are copies of Brunestud; they share his blond hair and red eyes. Instead, you have bright blue eyes and light blue hair; optionally, you can have dark blue skin. You also possess blue blood.

As a True Ancestor with the physical and magical power comparable to the moon itself, you are of incredible purity and possess a body close to, if not equal in scale to, Brunestud of the Crimson Moon himself. If not for your deviance, the Crimson Moon would have already taken over, but this is not a risk for you. Though fundamentally, you could be considered an Alter Ego of the Crimson Moon, formed from the same foundation but arriving at a different result.
