As the embodiment of the Blue Moon, you have absolute authority over the moon, allowing you to manipulate lunar phenomena freely, from summoning the night sky and altering tides to crashing the moon into the Earth.

You can recreate the Millennium Castle Brunestud through your Marble Phantasm. As you truly recreate the castle, it can remain indefinitely or until dispelled.

Unlike other True Ancestors, you do not have the psychological flaw of vampiric impulses. Due to this, you can use the full scope of your powers without risking your sanity. Even if you decide to drink blood for whatever reason, you are at no risk of falling into madness.

Any Dead Apostle sired by you will manifest a Mark of Possession at the site you bit them. This mark allows you to immediately possess them after death, ensuring that as long as a single Dead Apostle you sired remains alive, you can resurrect. While this will alter your nature from ‘’True Ancestor’’ to ‘’Dead Apostle’’, your powers and abilities will return over time.

Your Mystic Eyes increase in quality to Jewel Rank Mystic Eyes of Enchantment, allowing you to manipulate the souls of those within your line of sight.
addons.title: Vanitas of the Blue Moon

objects.text: You are a True Ancestor, an incarnated nature spirit often mistaken for a vampire, though in reality, you're a greater fairy created and sustained by the planet. Despite not being a true vampire, you have a psychological craving for blood. To avoid going into a frenzy and attacking anyone you can find, you must suppress this bloodlust with 70% of your power. Drinking someone's blood turns them into a Dead Apostle. As a planet-class spirit, you possess exceptional abilities that place you far above most beings. You can transform your hands into claws, shredding through enemies and tearing apart steel like paper. Your speed allows you to dodge bullets and even lightning. Your body develops resistance to any magic you've encountered, though powerful conceptual attacks can bypass this defense. Your immortality, known as the Curse of Restoration, allows your body to revert to its original state after injury. The severity of the wound determines how quickly you heal, ranging from instant recovery to several hours. Conceptual weapons designed to stop healing can temporarily or permanently disable this ability, but at night, your regeneration becomes so powerful that you are nearly invulnerable. This power peaks during a full moon, making you impervious to most conceptual attacks. You also wield the Mystic Eyes of Enchantment, which allows you to control the souls of those who meet your gaze, letting you implant suggestions or paralyze them in place. As an elemental, your magic circuits, known as Regression to the Age of Gods, grant you the capability to use all magic and magecraft from the Age of Gods. You become a beginner in the two schools of old magic you did not choose. You hold two powerful trump cards: Marble Phantasm: This allows you to alter reality through probability manipulation. You can, for example, turn the atmosphere into a vacuum to shred opponents or trap someone in a cube that disintegrates them. The only limitation is your imagination, and you cannot directly alter living beings like humans or animals. Backup from the Planet: As an entity created by the world, you can receive direct support from it. This power ensures that your fighting strength will always exceed that of your opponent by one rank. However, enemies can sever this connection by destroying the land around you or trapping you in a place where the planet cannot reach you.
objects.title: True Ancestor (Type-Moon)

addons.text: You are the Archetype of your Personal World. This grants your Marble Phantasm the power to envelop the entire planet, evolving in sync with it. You now have absolute control over every aspect of your Personal World. Where you once could only nudge things or passively adapt the world to suit your needs, you can now reshape the environment entirely, molding it into whatever you can imagine. Your world is draped in your texture, which you can continually expand. You could, for example, add a reverse side of the world dedicated solely to supernatural beings or even create an afterlife system. With enough time and practice, you may even learn to split your Personal World into branching timelines. This also allows for the creation of any beings, whether magical or mundane, sentient or not. You could craft your own humans, your own Phantasmal creatures—the only limits are your imagination and your knowledge. You have also gained the power to use Event Storage, the ability to conceptually and physically store things that have been cultivated on the surface of the planet. It's an ability on par with Divine Spirits' Authority. It manifests as a gravitational sphere that appears under your feet and has enough reach to store all textures in your world. Every creature that has appeared on the face of this planet is something that can be confiscated and requisitioned. Additionally, you've gained a new defensive ability. Your Personal World, along with its pocket dimension, now shares your immortality. To defeat you, one would need to kill you and destroy both your Personal World and its pocket dimension within a few minutes of each other, or you would simply return to life. You’ve also gained the ability to manifest an image of your world or moon and drop it upon targets you wish to crush.
addons.title: World's Authority

objects.text: You're not just an ascended True Ancestor but the Archetype of the planet. The brain and soul of the very planet itself. All your abilities have been boosted massively. You could kill multiple True Ancestors who have fallen to bloodlust and have access to all of their power without even gaining a scratch. Your Curse of Restoration has become a lack of concept of human death. Most conceptual weapons that could have impeded this no longer work. And the ones that can impose the concept of death on you may not be able to permanently kill you if the planet is still around, as you will eventually be able to make yourself a new body. Your Marble Phantasm has evolved; as the successor to Crimson Moon, you now have the right to summon the Millennium Castle. Your actual power with this and Regression to the Age of Gods has given you complete authority over the planet. You could melt all the ice at the north and south poles, or disrupt the planet's axis and play pinball with the continents. With this level of power, only an actual Ultimate One could hope to match and defeat you.
objects.title: Archetype (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
You have come into possession of the Magic Crest, which granted Edmond Dantès his soul-burning flames. A relic of the Assembly of the Eighth Sacrament with the power to burn sins, the flames conjured by this Crest are said to represent the despair of those without God, the flames of hell, and the void—an ability on par with magic from the Age of Gods.

The Crest allows you to convert your magical energy into potent and poisonous black flames capable of breaking magical barriers and even burning souls, nullifying regeneration and resurrection. As a side effect, the Crest also renders your body immune to all forms of poisons and some mental interference effects.
objects.title: Monte Cristo Mythologie (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
Your eyes have unlocked a power beyond its current form, returning it to its original/primordial state. Granting you a third ability—operating independently from your eyes, one more akin to an Authority. This ability allows you to swap the 'logic' of the world, warping reality around you. You can twist things governed by ancient Mystery into something that conforms to human reason, distorting the rational into the realm of delusion and fantasy, reshaping existence according to your mad logic.

For example, you could alter the once-known and understood laws of gravity into an incomprehensible force, an untamed Mystery of unimaginable power that evades all explanation. Conversely, you could reduce the profound Mystery of the soul into a mere scientific principle—something easily understood and woven into the very fabric of human knowledge. With this power, the boundaries between the known and the unknown blur, leaving the world open and malleable to your desires.

Accompanying this is a new, darker aspect: you have become a 'Logic Slayer,' drawing strength from the destruction of knowledge itself. By unraveling the fabric of understanding, you plunge the Human Order into an age of ignorance and fear, restoring both the world and its people to their primeval origins.

Yet, despite this immense power, you remain bound by shackles, old and new. The strain of using this power mirrors the toll of the Lie and Denial, its weight proportional to the magnitude and scale of the reality you seek to impose. The more profound the alteration, the heavier the toll and shorter it'll last. Additionally, you are constrained by an immutable rule: you can only swap up to three aspects of reality at any given time.

However, with each Mystery you slay and each 'Logic' you unravel, the burden you bear for using this power will gradually diminish. As your strength increases, you will develop an aura—an innate field that'll help to facilitate these shifts, allowing for the seamless blending and reshaping of the world with increasing ease, fluidity, and mastery.
objects.title: Delightful Delusion

addons.title: Paradox of Understanding
addons.text:
Your Magecraft exists as a paradox in a state of superposition, simultaneously a perfectly understood science and an untamable, ever-growing Mystery.

Nothing is beyond your comprehension. From the most primeval Divine Authority to the most advanced alien technology and everything in between, you can decipher the principles underlying anything you encounter and understand them with ease.

In fact it could be said that you have gone beyond merely understanding individual Mysteries and deciphered the very essence of Mystery itself. You have incorporated this understanding into your own existence, becoming both an entity capable of assimilating Mystery and a seemingly inexhaustible source of it.

Your Magecraft consequently possesses a passive cycle of growth. The potential for future development generates new Mystery within your Magecraft, which you immediately assimilate and comprehend. That newfound understanding in turn creates further potential for growth, establishing a self-sustaining feedback loop that continually expands your capabilities even without active research.

objects.text:
You are now an "Axiom," a beacon that pierces through all Mystery, with a light that grows stronger each day as it devours and assimilates Mysteries. Never must you rely on Mystery again—your magecraft has also been transformed into a science. One that, while complex, can be learned and practiced by anyone willing to grasp its intricacies. Armed with the knowledge to create a safe and perfected alternative to regular magic circuits, you now have the means to spread this new science far and wide. 

This new form of magecraft can be considered in the same realm as high-level quantum physics and rocket science. While accessible to all, true mastery is rare, demanding both a high level of intellect and dedication. Only a select few will become qualified practitioners and fewer still are true masters of the craft.

As a living, budding Ein Sof similar to the Swirl of the Root and Thaumaturgical Foundation, you have the unique ability to allow others to connect to your source—the "Axiom"—fueling the creation of new sciences and miracles. You hold the power to rewrite the laws of magecraft, ushering in a new age of reason and invention, blending science with the miraculous.
objects.title: Elucidate Axiomata

objects.text: "In the name of Ruler—of Jeanne d’Arc. I order all Servants gathered here with my Command Spells! Defeat the vampire who was once Vlad III!" Once just a tattoo filled with magical energy, your Stigma has now been transformed into fourteen command spells. While they can be used for their original function, they can now be used as control mechanisms for familiars or those you’ve created a mystical bond with. You may command them to do anything; however, if you are not powerful enough, more command spells may be needed to compel said person. Acts such as summoning someone via spatial transportation or forcing them to activate their abilities are possible with singular Seals. Command Seals favour short, simple commands that are unambiguous, such as "Come" or "Kill that man". Additionally, if you command a person to complete an objective that they were willing to go through with, then they will be empowered to fulfil said task. You may transfer these command spells to other people. These command spells you transfer cannot be regenerated by others; however, you may do so.
objects.title: God's Resolution (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
Now, as the wielder of the true Excalibur, you can evoke the level of power of the Sword of Promised Victory, depending on the object you’re wielding. 

Even a humble stick becomes more powerful and durable, capable of lasting a handful of strikes where it would’ve previously shattered after a single blow.

While wielding Excalibur itself, or a comparable item, you can draw out truly immense power, enough to wipe out entire textures, and ensure that victory will never be distant from you again.
objects.title: Sword of Never Distant Victory (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
You have become something akin to Thia—the ultimate result of 1,800 years of planning by the Escardos family to create a new Prime Species. Your very existence resembles a vast, living magic crest: a constant, hyper-dense vortex of Magical Energy that surrounds you, powerful enough to crush souls. Unlike Thia, however, you are a fully independent being with a body  entirely your own.

Your mastery of magecraft has grown to extraordinary heights, allowing you to contend with beings as powerful as Enkidu. You can draw mana directly from the atmosphere to fuel your spells or reshape your own body—growing wings, extra limbs, or other modifications as needed. Your perception of the world has also evolved: you perceive the magical structure underlying reality itself. Through all five senses, you can detect the flows, layers, and sediments of magical energy around you, allowing you to analyze, manipulate, or absorb them at will.

You also possess the ability to alter the pace of concepts within a given area. By expending sufficient energy, you can accelerate or slow phenomena such as Magical Energy, physical motion, or even the speed of thought. This control has limits—perfect stasis or true light-speed motion remains beyond reach—but within those bounds the effects can still be profound.

When combined with your magecraft, these abilities enable devastating feats. You can unleash blasts of magical energy that can level buildings, “hack” into spells or Noble Phantasms as formidable as Age of Babylon to dismantle them, drain their energy, or even turn them against their wielder. Most remarkable of all is your ability to create a magical accelerator cannon: by imbuing objects with magecraft and propelling them to their absolute limits, you can transform ordinary debris into catastrophic projectiles.
objects.title: True Human (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
You have somehow ended up consuming a rather significant portion of the flesh of the Progenitor Dragon Typhon. You possess superhuman physical characteristics, able to far surpass the limits of humans and even most servants, and you possess the ability to use the Chaos Tide to create monsters, similar to Echidna and Tiamat. You can shapeshift your body as you see fit, creating claws and wings. You also possess an Authority of terraforming that grants dominion over fire and wind, allowing you to change your environment to attack your foes with calamities like volcanic eruptions, superstorms, and poisonous gases.

You possess the Noble Phantasm Blaze of Etna, a representation of Typhon’s imprisonment under Mount Etna. This can be used as an armor with durability on par with Mount Etna, but is meant as a restraining tool to maintain your humanity and control your power. You can also condense your power into a single scale of the armor, which releases a “storm of scarlet scales” that carbonizes anything organic within the blast radius.

You possess the ability to steal the abilities of others, and already possess the Authorities of Zeus previously stolen by Typhon. These Authorities are the immortal killing scythe Harpe, which can take multiple forms like giant claws, floating swords, and autonomous drones capable of severing atomic bonds, and Nega-Keraunos, a powerful blast of lightning on par with Zeus at his peak.

Finally, you can assume the form of Typhon, albeit in an unconventional way. You have essentially become the “brain” of Typhon, allowing you to summon its original machine dragon body and “pilot” it. This essentially grants you full control over a Divine Beast with enough power to defeat Zeus.
objects.title: Ephemeros (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
Your Gear Cells have been upgraded to second-generation copies, significantly amplifying the benefits they bestow upon you. This upgrade elevates you to a level of power where an entire army of lesser Gears would pose no challenge, allowing you to dominate any battlefield you find yourself in.

The enhancements provided by your Gear Cells are now five times stronger than before, drastically increasing your capabilities across the board. Furthermore, the upper limit of their potential growth has been loosened, allowing you to reach unprecedented levels of strength and power. At their peak, your abilities will be capable of annihilating entire cities from the face of the Earth, with the durability to match such destructive feats.

Your regeneration has vastly improved, enabling you to instantly recover from moderate injuries and heal even crippling wounds within mere minutes. In cases of extreme damage, you can even fully regenerate from just a few drops of your own blood, ensuring you near immortality. Your speed has reached hypersonic levels, effortlessly shattering the sound barrier as you move.

Your cognitive ability has undergone a remarkable evolution, granting you the computational and analytical power of a supercomputer. Complex calculations, strategies, and decisions are processed effortlessly while your memory becomes virtually limitless. Your senses are enhanced to an extraordinary degree, surpassing any third-generation Gear, as you perceive the world in unimaginable detail, with a heightened awareness and perception that makes you nearly impossible to ambush or deceive.

Your mana pool expands to colossal proportions, with your regeneration capabilities increasing exponentially. You can now fully restore your mana reserves within an hour, granting you near-infinite magical resources if properly managed. This ensures that you remain a nearly unstoppable force, capable of wielding immense power for extended periods without tiring.

With these second-generation Gear Cells, you've ascended to an unparalleled realm of power and capability, elevating you far beyond that of the ordinary granting you unmatched dominance in battle, mastery over magic, and a peerless intellect.
objects.title: Second Generation Gear (Guilty Gear)

objects.text:
Your Gear Cells are no longer mere copies but one of the original twin Seeds the prime Gear Cells. These Seeds serve as twin nexuses within The Backyard, granting their bearer full and unrestricted access to its boundless power. The Backyard, a fundamental dimension underpinning reality itself, now lies at your fingertips. However, your Gear Cells have yet to fully mature, requiring centuries of growth or significantly less with intense effort and combat experience to unlock their ultimate potential.

Once fully matured, your Gear Cells will elevate you to a state of near-omnipotence. You will wield enough power to obliterate entire galaxies or withstand attacks of equivalent magnitude. Your speed will transcend the constraints of physics, enabling you to move at incomprehensible speeds far beyond the speed of light. Your mind will evolve beyond mortal comprehension, breaking free of reason to become a boundless, hyper-intelligent entity.

Your connection to The Backyard grants you flawless regeneration and true immortality. Moderate or catastrophic injuries are now meaningless, as your existence is now tethered to a fundamental cornerstone of reality. To truly kill you, one would need to destroy The Backyard itself a feat that would simultaneously unravel the main universe and all of creation.

In addition to these vast abilities, you possess a devastating trump card: Install. This transformation begins by altering approximately 20% of your body, manifesting as draconic (or another chosen creature's) limbs, encased in radiant red or blue energy. While in this state, you can draw immense amounts of energy directly from The Backyard, dramatically amplifying your power. However, this comes at a cost: the more energy you channel, the greater the physical strain and stamina drain you endure. With time and mastery, you will be able to wield Install without limitation, fully transforming into your chosen creature form and commanding the infinite energy of the universe with ease.

Unlike others, such as Sol Badguy or Justice, you require no limiter to maintain a human form. Your connection to The Backyard allows seamless control over your transformations, enabling you to partially or fully embrace your creature form at will.
objects.title: First Generation Gear - Seed of The Backyard (Guilty Gear)

addons.text: You gain absolutely complete knowledge of the Magic & technology (especially Old World technology) of Bastard!!, making you the true equal of the Ten Wise Men of Europa.
addons.title: Dragon Knight

objects.text:
This expands on the idea of "magic based on metal music", by granting you mastery of the Five Magics of the universe of Bastard!!, Personal Magic, Sacred Magic, Black Magic, Elemental Magic, & High Ancient Magic, as well as any other spell-like abilities appearing in the series, such as Miracles or Gara's physical abilities.

Your knowledge & ability are easily the equal of true masters like Dark Schneider, Kall-Su, Arshes Nei, & Abigail.
objects.title: Black Sabbath (Bastard!!)

addons.text:
You now possess the knowledge to create the Stormcast Eternals superhuman, nigh-immortal warriors. You can construct special incubation chambers that enable this transformation, a process that takes about a year. Within these pods, the chosen are struck by heavenly lightning, their bodies annihilated and their souls painstakingly remade by the divine winds of Azyr. Every being placed within a pod is guaranteed to survive the ordeal.

Those who emerge are effectively immortal. Though they still bear a resemblance to humans, their forms are idealized to near perfection so altered that they are almost unrecognizable to mortal eyes. A Stormcast typically stands around seven and a half feet tall, though some reach nine feet. They possess superhuman strength, speed, endurance, and durability.

When a Stormcast dies, their body dissolves into celestial lightning, their soul returning to your Soul Garden where they can be reforged anew. Normally, the Reforging process erodes a Stormcast’s humanity, stripping away their memories piece by piece. However, the healing essence of your Soul Garden prevents this decay no Stormcast under your care will ever lose their spirit, no matter how many times they are reforged.
For some Stormcast, especially those who have fallen and been reforged many times, their divine nature manifests visibly. Lightning may crackle from their fingertips, and their voices may rumble like thunder when angered.

You also hold the secret of creating Sigmarite, weapons, armour, and equipment worn by Stormcasts. Sigmarite is a magical, living metal from which all are forged. Each Sigmarite blade carries a fragment of the Realm of Azyr’s might: every strike resounds with the power of a thunderclap, and every arrow tipped with Sigmarite flies with the fury of lightning itself.

Finally you now know how to create many beasts used by the Stormcast Eternals, anything from: Dracoth to Aetherwing to Gryph-charger to Gryph-hounds and more. These beast can be created inside different incubation chambers which simply require biomass in the amount of their physical vessels.
addons.title: The Stormcast Eternals

objects.text: Qhaysh, also known as High Magic, is the art of weaving together all of the Winds of Magic. Qhaysh requires one to be incredibly precise, careful and calm. It is a delicate art, and one that takes centuries at the very least to master; but, the greatest spells known to the world have been weaved through Qhaysh, from the Vortex which drained the world of the infinite magic of the Aethyr, to the Deliverance of Itza, which banished every Daemon within Itza, the First City. You are far from those loft heights however, as it stand you are merely the equal of the average Elven Archmage, only being capable of turning the tide of battlefields, healing a great deal many people at once with your magic, and are capable of yet far more things, of which there are too many to list here.
objects.title: High Magic (Warhammer: Fantasy)

objects.text:
Dhar, more commonly known as Dark or Black Magic requires no skill or time to use. It is easy access to spells equal to that wielded by Elven Archmages; in exchange, the costs of it are equally great, oftentimes causing mutation, damage to reality, and corrupting & twisting the environment. The reason for these dangerous side effects to the caster and their surroundings is the wasteful and careless way in which Dhar must be casted. Indeed, the way to cast with Dhar is similarly destructive, demanding only incredible amounts of willpower and simply crushing them together.

There are 2 kinds of Dhar, Dhar and True Dhar. Dhar is using all the Winds of Magic for maximum effect in an unbalanced manner. True Dhar is made when all eight winds merge together so thoroughly that maintain an individual identity, stagnating in a metaphysical sense.

Where the Dhar used by regular wizards could perhaps be consider not evil; True Dhar is bent almost entirely towards dominating and deconstructing the physical world. True Dhar is just as difficult as Qhaysh to wield, but also carries a much higher risk of consuming the being who casts with it. True Dhar must be wrestled into shape, requiring a will and mind of such strength and narcissistic self-confidence that only the most mad humans could ever hope to have. And even the most stable of people will become absolutely self-obsessed in a relatively short amount of time when exposed to True Dhar.

This power makes you a natural talent for working with True Dhar, granting you the megalomaniacal self-confidence and nigh-absolute strength of will and mind to wield it. It also grants you enough skill to be on par with an average Supreme Sorceress; however even your average Supreme Sorceress is capable of turning the tide of entire battlefields and decimating large portions of enemy armies.

You do not need to purchase this to wield Dhar, this merely grants you the experience and skill required to do so somewhat safely.
objects.title: Dhar (Warhammer: Fantasy)

objects.text:
The Elven wizard Teclis once observed a Sigmarite Warrior-Priest performing his Miracles, and noticed that the power was not coming from an external source, but that the priest was unknowingly manipulating the Winds of Magic into the forms of his faith.

You are conscious of this fact, and can use the Winds of Magic to replicate the Miracles of the Old World's Pantheon. You can heal like a priest of Shallya or a Grail Damsel, enhance your wisdom and skill like a priest of Myrmidia or Verena, and enhance your strength like a priest of Sigmar or Ulric.
objects.title: Miracles (Warhammer: Fantasy)

objects.text:
You are no mere mortal mage, you wield knowledge and power on par with the first generation of Slann, whose mastery of magic was so great as to only be surpassed by the Gods themselves, and who were the only ones to ever speak with the Old Ones.

On your own, you can move mountains, cause earthquakes, call down meteors, destroy cities, resurrect the dead, and slaughter hundreds of thousands of Daemons.

Greater than even your personal power however, is your ability to recreate the Lizardman’s infrastructure, from the Sacred Spawning Pools, to the Temple Cities and Geomantic Web, you remember it all, and indeed might yet build a realm that spans the planet.

Despite the name, becoming a Slann is entirely optional, though regardless you will have their biological immortality.
objects.title: First Generation Slann (Warhammer: Fantasy)

addons.text:
Your psychic potential has unlocked your hidden potential as an Old One. No longer are you limited to simply being an Old One of the Fantasy universe, but instead, you have grown to match the Old Ones of the Warhammer 40k universe. The Old Ones are perhaps one of the oldest races in existence, having created many, if not all, of the species within the galaxy. 

Your biological knowledge has expanded to include the various races of the 40k universe that the Old Ones had a hand in creating or uplifting, granting you the ability to manufacture intelligent lifeforms of war such as the Krorks. 

Along with this advanced biological knowledge the various psychic technologies that the Old Ones had a hand in creating, such as the Webway, a galactic teleportation network, and more. Your abilities as a Psyker have been enhanced as an Old One, being more controlled and less unstable, along with being generally more powerful than a human or Eldar Psyker could ever hope to achieve at the same grade.
addons.title: Survivor of the War in Heaven (Warhammer: 40k)

objects.text:
Instead of a Slann, you are on par with their makers, the Old Ones themselves. This boosts your personal power even further, with spells like the Vortex being but child’s play to you, with moving planets being simple and only a mild annoyance. This also grants you intelligence on par with an Old One. You possess powers beyond that of a god, and could indeed bind and shape them to your will just as you could beings of flesh and blood. The mere act of speaking is enough to slay any being weaker than a First Generation Slann Mage-Priest, should you wish it.

Your mastery of magic and technology is where you truly shine however, for yours built an empire so grand it spans the universe itself and all of time. Entire races of servants might be built to fulfill your grand designs, and you know how to make gates going through the Aethyr that allows for instant travel between two places. Indeed magic and technology are but one and the same to you. Your mastery of biology is not merely limited to servant races either, for your kind molded from subpar materials the many races of Mallus, primarily Elves, Dwarves, and Humans.
objects.title: Heir of the Old Ones (Warhammer: Fantasy)

objects.text:
The Burning Legion now kneels under your command. The legion is a vast, innumerable army of demons and corrupted races who seek to destroy all life, originally molded by an evil god with the sole purpose of obliterating all life. 

From annihilating worlds to sowing chaos across the multiverse, this legion encompasses both non-sapient entities and highly intelligent sapient species, all born and fueled by Fel magic. The legion operates under a sophisticated hierarchy based on power and accomplishments. As its supreme ruler, you command Eredar, Pit Lords, Nathrezim, Doomguard, Terrorguards, Felguard, and numerous other entities. Your strongest soldiers would be ale to break planets with their might.

It's important to note that this legion is not the original Burning Legion commanded by Sargeras. Instead, it is an exact replica drawn from the vast tapestry of the omniverse. Each and every one of its limitless soldiers, whether consciously or unconsciously, acknowledge you as their supreme ruler, swearing unwavering fealty and eternal servitude to you throughout their immortal existence.

While the Burning Legion was once bound to the Twisting Nether—where they would reform upon death—it is now tethered to you. You can summon portals of any size and shape, connecting to the Twisting Nether, allowing your forces to move freely between worlds. However, the sheer power required to summon and control such vast numbers places an immense burden on you. The larger the portal, the more legions you summon, or the stronger the subordinates you call upon, the heavier the physical and mental toll. If overused, the strain can weaken you, disrupt your control, or even force you into slumber collapsing your portals until you awaken again. With time and practice, you can refine your mastery over the Nether, gradually reducing the strain until you are able to summon the Legion at will without issue. 

Additionally, you can traverse the Twisting Nether at will, for this infinite dimension belongs to the legion, and the legion belongs to you. This dimension is an exact replica of the original, only without Sargeras. As long as you are alive, the twisting nether realm will endure, ensuring the immortality of your legion.

The Nether realm will also start to corrupt other entities in your universe, and bring them under the legion, if you so wish it.
objects.title: Burning Legion (Warcraft)

addons.text:
You're the Aspect of Magic; your ability to use magic is second nature. Spells that would have been difficult to understand or master by mortals are effectively child's play to you, as your control over the arcane means bending it into the shape of whatever spell you require at the time is easy. Capable of pulling mana both from leylines and generating massive amounts of it, it would take little effort for you to rain down an army-killing amount of arcane bolts at once, teleport across the world and beyond, generate enough food to feed a kingdom out of nothing, and even create magical artifacts of great power.

With your authority, you can both disrupt and shut off others' magic, as well as use most forms of magic. Additionally, you can channel as much mana as you want without fear of corruption or damage, as magic is yours to command.
addons.title: The Spell-Weaver

addons.text:
As the Aspect of Nature, you hold authority over nature and the realm of dreams. With your magic, you can create and control forests in a matter of minutes, revive or create fauna, heal most wounds, and even bring the dead back to life. This power also allows you to teach others nature magic and strip them of it should they misuse it in ways you disapprove of.

The secondary part of your powers lies in dreaming and The Emerald Dream. With your breath, you can put any target to sleep, whether temporarily or forever. Additionally, you have your own personal realm, The Emerald Dream, which is cut off from the waking world and can only be accessed with your authority, either through dreaming or portals you create. This realm serves as a template of what the world would look like without sentient life, filled with lush forests and wildlife. Should you or others you've claimed die, they can appear in The Emerald Dream as spirits, with the potential to be revived by you and return to the waking world through a portal
addons.title: The Dreamer

addons.text:
Durable, powerful, resistant to the natural elements—capable of bathing in lava and not feeling a thing. That is you. You have near-complete control of the earth itself. From breathing a nigh-endless torrent of lava down on your enemies to causing massive earthquakes that will reshape maps, to even the finer points of control, such as creating metals and jewels by simply crushing earth together, your dominion over the world is both awe-inspiring and terrifying.

Your shamanistic abilities have been amplified. It no longer matters what a spirit, elemental, or even a nature god feels about you. The power is yours now. They can either be crushed and forced to submit to you, completely ignored as you use their powers anyway, or simply destroyed—your domain over the earth means you don’t really need them anymore, do you?
addons.title: The Earth-Warder

addons.text:
Time is completely yours to control. Whether it be traveling into the future, the past, parallel timelines, freezing time, detecting and undoing time anomalies, or even simply gifting others immortality by removing their natural lifespans, you have the authority and the right to do with time as you wish.

This grants you complete immunity to hostile time manipulation. Someone could attempt to kill your past self in hopes of retroactively removing you from existence, but it wouldn't matter—nor would it likely even work. You are completely removed from the natural timeline, meaning someone would have to face you directly to kill you.
addons.title: The Timeless One

addons.text:
Your powers are similar to the Green Flight, but instead of focusing primarily on nature and wildlife, you concentrate on life as a general concept. You possess massive amounts of vitality, and the speed at which you or those you bless regenerate health and generate supernatural energy is astronomical. You could lose an entire arm, and it would regenerate in under a minute, even without casting a healing spell. Your breath and spells can burn those you wish to harm while simultaneously healing and purifying those you wish to protect. You can turn a wasteland corrupted by foul magic into a beautiful, purified meadow of grass and flowers with a single pass of your flames.

Your healing abilities are so potent that you can revive the dead and repair almost any damage. Additionally, you have the ability to declare specific species as natural parts of life on whatever world you inhabit. Any invasive species that appear will immediately register to you, allowing you to sense their location on a planetary scale, enabling you to hunt them down and destroy them.
addons.title: The Life-Binder

objects.text:
You're beyond what you normally would be capable of; you have been blessed by one or even more of the Titans. Dropping your pitiful mortality, you have become a Dragon Aspect.

There are five flights: the Blue Flight, which are the masters of magic and the arcane; the Green Flight, who lay domain over nature and the realm of dreams; the Black Flight, who control and manipulate the earth itself; the Bronze Flight, the wardens of time; and the Red Flight, whose duty lies in taking care of life itself.

Regardless of which flight you are, you gain a massive modifier to your powers, an immortal lifespan, the ability to shift between your true dragon form and whatever mortal form you wish, the ability to bless others with your powers, and near-absolute dominion over your specific flight's powers, making it difficult if not impossible for most beings to wrest control of them from you.

 You can optionally for each flight you're the Aspect of, gain 1–6 mates for that specific flight, 300 Dragonkin Guards split between warriors and magi, and 300 Dragonkin specialized in protecting and raising whelps, as well as handling tasks such as cleaning and hunting. All of them are completely loyal to you, as you are their Aspect.
objects.title: Dragon Aspect (Warcraft)

objects.text:
You do not have just merely a couple of consorts and a few hundred dragonkin. You have the entirety of the flight behind you now.

Now, for each flight you're the Aspect of, you have the dragons, their dragonkin servants, and, if you wish, even the previous Aspect(s) of that flight are now subordinate to you. This varies between several hundred to a couple of thousand dragons, and around ten thousand to twenty thousand dragonkin per flight.

With the previous Aspects, they either knowingly acknowledge you as the new Aspect or believe you were always the Aspect and that they were just a very powerful dragon under your command. This includes Aspects who may have died—they aren’t as powerful as they were in their prime since they are no longer Aspects, but they and all your other dragons will grow stronger as you do. All Aspects, dragons, and dragonkin are cleared of any corruption they may have had and are completely loyal to you. Even if they hated each other, they would still begrudgingly work together under your command and in your best interests.

You also have a pocket dimension around twice the size of the Dragon Isles that houses said Isles, the Dragonshrines, and Wyrmrest Accord. Being the Aspect of multiple flights gives you the option to make all your fellow dragons into a stable fusion of all your flights, akin to the Chromatic Dragonflight.
objects.title: Dragonflights (Warcraft)

addons.text:
You generate Holy Light on a level no one has seen before. Not even Anduin or the Prophet Velen is your equal. With the Light, you have been infused with longevity that may very well be immortality. You can emit an aura that brings severe pain to most lesser dark-aligned beings or users of such powers; some may even turn to ash should you touch them. The ground you walk upon becomes purified with each step—if you were in a wasteland completely corrupted by foul magics, it would not take long for your immediate surroundings to begin transforming into sanctified ground covered in grass and flowers.

Your ability to wield the Light is such that, with full focus, you could call down massive rays of light upon a wide area, potentially slaying armies of foes numbering in the tens of thousands. Your healing is so great that even the most grievous of wounds would be completely restored in time. Things such as spirits possessing or corrupting one’s soul would be swiftly exorcised from the victim’s body without causing them harm. Other feats—such as releasing a halo of holy light to heal allies and damage enemies across a massive area, creating wells of holy light to heal and attack foes, or enchanting objects with the Light to make them more powerful-are all within your ability, limited only by your imagination.

Your ability to return from the dead is absolute, should you even wish to. You could equally choose to remain in the form of a Spirit Healer and return to human form whenever you desire.
addons.title: The Pure

addons.text:
Your raw talent and mastery of buffs have given you constantly active effects called Auras, you can use all of them at once. These Auras grant various effects to you and your allies within a range of up to 40 yards.

The current auras you know are: Devotion Aura, which reduces all damage taken by 10%; Retribution Aura, which imbues you with the Light to greatly increase your damage and healing for 12 seconds whenever an ally dies; Crusader Aura, which increases the speed of all mounts or vehicles by 20%; Vengeance Aura, which permanently imbues your weapons with the Light; Concentration Aura, which grants immunity to magic being sealed or interrupted and increases all spell casting speed by 30%; and Resistance Aura, which provides such high resistance to all known elements that, for example, a normal human could ignore the heat of a house fire.

You also know a buff called Aura Mastery, which triples the effects and range of all your auras for one minute, with a cooldown of one hour. Beyond your auras, buffs you cast to enhance yourself and your allies now last a minimum of one hour if they would have been shorter, and can be applied to all allies within 40 yards. You may also reapply them before they expire.
addons.title: Auramaxxing

addons.text:
The rituals were used to modify your warhorse, these were among the most powerful holy rites ever performed. Because of this, your horse has become a Golden Charger-a steed worthy of a Paladin to ride down the forces of evil.

You are able to summon your horse to you with a spell, no matter the distance or any restrictions that might otherwise prevent it. Your steed wears some of the most sanctified and masterfully forged armor possible, though it has no true need for it, as it can no longer be harmed or killed.

In terms of movement, in addition to its previous speed, it has gained an extra 100% of your own maximum movement speed on the ground, added directly to its own. Through the power of the Light, it is also capable of flight, moving at its original ground speed plus an additional 410% of your own speed-this can be increased further if you have Crusader Aura active.

This horse’s saddle comes with a free book of holy scripture to teach you the traditional techniques and spells of a Paladin, as well as a free war hammer.
addons.title: Golden Charger

objects.text: “In all things, paladins must reflect the Light, which supplements our strength. To strive to be divine for one of our kind does not mean we strive for godhood--we strive to be good in all actions. Although called upon to smite evil in these harsh times, you must always remember that it's aiding others that will truly set you apart from the other citizens. Compassion, patience, bravery--these things mean as much to a paladin as strength in battle.” You were trained in the ability to wield the light, to call upon its aid, to smite the forces of evil while bringing salvation to those who stand on the path of good. Your skills and powers in wielding the Holy Light match those of its greatest champions, and you have similar abilities imbued upon you that allow you to replicate their greatest feats. In combat, you're capable of calling upon the light to enhance your physical capabilities. If before you could only break stone, now you could fling a boulder some distance or shrug off being hit by one. With your light, you can release blasts of holy energy to strike your foes or project weapons made of light to throw at the ground, consecrating an area to damage enemies and heal allies. The strength of your attacks imbued by the light is enough to slay any lesser undead in one hit, you also have the ability to sense anyone either composed of or using dark energies such as necromancers or demons attempting to disguise themselves. On the non-combat side of your abilities, you're capable of creating healing barriers over a massive area, allowing you to protect and heal hundreds of allies, raising the dead of anyone whose soul is not being trapped by something or destroyed, divining the future to foresee dangerous events that may come to pass, and if you were to die you would temporarily take the form of an angelic being known as a Spirit Healer to heal your allies or kill your enemies. Even then, with how much holy light you have in your being, it is possible you may be able to resurrect yourself, should your body not be too destroyed. The Light, while working best to grant you powers based on belief (including the kind you would find in religion) is not an actual deity. This makes it perfect for one to use as a substitute in situations that would require praying to a divine for power, as in reality, the Light would grant it through your own dedication and strength of will.
objects.title: Knight of the Silver Hand (Warcraft)

objects.text: You have transcended the use of colored mana like Ugin, and now wield colorless mana. This can be used to achieve greater effects with greater precision, though it does not bar you from using colored mana.
objects.title: Transcension (Magic: The Gathering)

objects.text: You possess the mental abilities of Niv-Mizzet, granting you vastly increased mental abilities, to the level that experimentation with magic becomes entirely superflous, as you can perform them mentally. The degree of mental ability your magic gives you is enough that you can cast hundreds of spells in a moment that would take an ordinary master mage their full attention to form.
objects.title: Firemind (Magic: The Gathering)

objects.text: You have Nicol Bolas's innate mind-rending touch. With a single graze, you can instantly destroy the mind of a sentient being through psychic damage. With practice, you can gain control, and use your overwhelming telepathic touch based abilities to produce other effects, beyond just mental destruction. This also grants you a heightened ability with regards to mental and telepathic abilities. This can be controlled, so you don't accidentally do it.
objects.title: Mind-Rending Touch (Magic: The Gathering)

objects.text:
You are bonded to a World Soul, a consciousness that was once the entire awareness of a plane of existence. It's original plane of existence either no longer exists, or it has somehow become separated from it. Either way, this consciousness has found a new host inside yourself. This offers you a truly vast and incomprehensible amount of mana with which to cast your spells. The consciousness has an awareness that it can use to guide you, and improve your spells beyond what you would normally be capable of. You can use this to make spells simply more powerful than they otherwise would be, regardless of the mana at your disposal, or find ways to extend or improve them in other ways. This World Soul allows it's bearer to planeswalk as well, though it only makes you a post-mending planeswalker.

The World Soul will initially be relatively benevolent, and will be on your side for the most part. Of course, if you end up being someone who doesn't use their powers at all, it might feel that there's a more worthy host out there for it...
objects.title: World Soul (Magic: The Gathering)

objects.text:
As an Archmage, you have achieved Archmastery, denoted by a sixth dot in all Arcana without distinction. You are free from the constraints of mere awakened individual. Spells below the Master level no longer require mana to cast, and you no longer need to differentiate between Arcana, as your mastery of Inferior Arcana grows alongside your Ruling Arcana. Age no longer affects you, and you are immune to diseases, though not invincible. You possess heightened awareness of reality changes and are mostly immune to spells altering the fabric of the world, but remain vulnerable to direct magical effects.

Your mind has been hardened through the trials of the golden road, allowing you to comprehend and exploit symbolism and cosmic mysteries. Your mind becomes indestructible, capable of withstanding overwhelming experiences and finding new meaning in them.

As an Archmage, you gain the potential to cast Imperial Mysteries, potent spells fueled by Quintessence. You possess knowledge of the first level of these spells and can further develop your power rapidly over time. You have an exceptional ability to seek and find Quintessence, with quests taking up to a months for lower-tier sources and multiple years for the most powerful ones.

You have created your golden road, a place of power connecting the fallen world and the supernal. This road grants you access to broken realities and unknown realms, where your Cintamani resides. Your golden road is always accessible and cannot be blocked. Your Cintamani serves as your Supernal place of power and can be left to travel across the abyss with proper navigation skills. If banished, your golden road becomes your "Home," which you can access at will.

Furthermore, you possess a comprehensive understanding of High Speech, the language of magic known as the alphabet of Atlantis, empowers your magic, enhancing already potent spells to a higher level.
objects.title: The Ascendant Gnosis (Chronicles of Darkness - Mage: The Awakening)

addons.text: You have achieved impossibility, and crafted your golden road under the path of the Tremere. Whether a betrayal of their highest ideals or the purest expression is for you to prove now. Your mastery of the soul, and the paths of the awakened may have given you a head start over other novice Archmages, but rote learning rather than true experiential understanding will only get you so far.
addons.title: Beyond Impossibility

addons.text: Demons, those that steal souls and rend them, mangling them into piecemeal forms, and the Tremere, those who understand the soul, craft and abuse it in equal measure. As an heir to both, your understanding of how to warp, press and use the soul is greatly enhanced, allowing you to get more out of less, engineering greater cover from lesser pieces, and greater power form singular souls on both ends.
addons.title: The Nature of the Soul

objects.text: “Magic Must be tamed” Nothing in the world can deny an awakened soul. Inside you, is the legacy of the soul’s greatest Awakened scholars, the Tremere. A starting trail of the knowledge of the Left-Handed path is imparted to you, as well as the core tenets of their belief. You gain a House of your own, bound to it as any of your own students will be bound to it in time. The knowledge of binding gods, destroying the inhuman separating man from his awakened soul, and the secrets of the seven dragons lie open to find. The Tremere forsake their path, instead binding themselves to the Final Watchtower, this grants a number of esoteric benefits. For one, they cannot befoul spells with the abyss, and thus cannot become Scelesti, Nor can they truly ‘lose touch’ like other awakened, merely becoming a bestial lich called a Preta, more monster than mage and blessedly non-sentient. Additionally, a Tremere's ‘Gnosis’ is replaced with ‘Hollow’. While this acts functionally identically, it also grants them incredible power over the soul. They can perceive souls as if they were constantly using mage sight, can attach and detach souls to themselves, harvest mana from devouring souls, and can even stave off time itself by feeding from them (though at a lesser efficiency the higher a Tremere’s ‘hollow’ progressing form one soul a year to one a month at its greatest height). Finally, Tremere Liches can enter a state called ‘Koimaomai’, or ‘Sleep of the Soul-Dead’. This allows them to enter a dormancy for a predetermined length of time. However, a tremere loses Hollow the longer they are in Koimaomai without an attached soul to take the weight of years, equating to roughly twenty-five years a soul. These benefits, however, come at a cost, In the binding, Tremere are functionally soulless, needing to steal the souls of others to stay living and sane, lest they become Preta through starvation. Similarly, a tremere’s Nimbus is fainter than an average Awakened, and provides only weak connections without using souls to temporarily restore it to standard Awakened ability.
objects.title: Tremere: Magic Hungers

addons.text: Impossible and unwise, you’ve crossed the abyss, and found true reality wanting, diving back into the void you crossed. You are for all intents and purposes an Archmage and a Quipploth in one, capable of sucking people into your abyssal Verge, a horrific midpoint between reality and nothing where you control its impossible geometries. The greatest of Abyssal entities have taken notice of you. Aborted timelines like The Prince of 100,000 Leaves and species redacted from notion flock to you, capable of manifesting them with your Golden Paradox, harnessing them and imparting them into the world at your whim. As you descend and become less and less human, you will become less like a person, and more like a great and horrible abyssal entity yourself, one with one foot already in reality and ready to change it to your desires.
addons.title: Annunaki

objects.text: Most mages, fools that they are, deny the power of the abyss, and the worth of all that can be found in the bottomless well of nonexistence. You have cut yourself free of their dogma and happily plunge into its depths. Initially, you’ll ‘only’ be deliberately befouling spells, inviting paradox into the world in order to gain more power from your magic. As you develop however, you’ll begin gaining more and more dark power; from infusing abyssal beings into your flesh to deliberately destroying time to create pockets of What Couldn’t Be. Ultimately, you’ll push into the Dur-Abzu, The Ziggurats, the twisted reflection of your watchtower in order to gain complete control over your paradox and its potential might. Descending lower into your Ziggurat it’s only a matter of time until you become one with the abyss and lose yourself fully, but the power you’ll have while you are existent and relatively coherent may well be worth the terrible price.
objects.title: Scelesti (Chronicles of Darkness - Mage: The Awakening)

objects.text:
You gain access to all the Endowments of one of the Hunter Conspiracies of the Chronicles of Darkness setting. This could be, for example, the advanced technology of Task Force: VALKYRIE, the devilish powers of the Lucifuge's bloodline, the Church sacraments of the Malleus Maleficarum, or the knowledge in supernatural biology of the Cheiron Group. There is also more obscure Endowments such as the mystical tattoos of the Knights of Saint-Adrian and the Setto of the Hototogisu which allows to con monsters out of their powers and hold up to 5 of them at once.

You have all the necessary knowledge to craft or perform the Endowments you chose, and can teach it to others. For the rare innate ones, you possess the necessary biology. Many Endowments are very specialized, meant to work against specific supernatural beings or abilities; as such, you also gain the ability to create new Endowments of the category you chose to deal with beings or abilities that aren't covered by the original catalogue, though this takes time and research.

Each time you select this upgrade, you gain access to a new type of Endowments.
objects.title: Fighting Fire with Fire (Chronicles of Darkness - Hunter: the Vigil)

objects.text:
You are not a mere changeling - you are a lord of Arcadia, that which haunts every lived moment of those who escaped its confines. You are a True Fae, a being of stories both wondrous and terrifying.

You start with, within your grasp, two things that are immensely precious. Your Name and a single Title. The first could be your old name, or it could be a new one, and can be as simple as John up to as esoteric as the weaving of the wheat under a summer wind. Keep this Name forever secret, as any who know it has immense power over you. How esoteric it is will not save you from others knowing it, as a substitute works just as well once someone knows your Name.

Once someone knows your Name, they can speak it to achieve greater success while going against you. However, within this weakness also lies strength, as without speaking your Name, any damage you receive is superficial unless you broke an Oath within the hour or the damage is dealt through iron. Additionally, your Name cannot be found out through supernatural means - the only ways for someone to learn it is from you, someone else who knows it, or puzzling it out manually.

You can now greatly up the ante of your Bargains by swearing one upon your Name - your life. If you do so, the other party must also swear upon something as important to them, and if a party breaks the bargain, they lose what they swore it upon.

However, your true strength lies upon your Titles. Each Title you hold grants you much - a Title is a self, which can be switched between an Actor (a body as animals understand it), a Prop (a powerful magic item), a Realm (an entire location) or Wisps (a group of bodies, weaker than an Actor). Whichever manifestation you hold at any moment, you can perceive and use any of your powers through it, as well as control it. All the manifestations of a Title are static, depending upon what the Title is - the Weeping Grace of Twilight might appear as a beautiful sad lady with shimmering hair, a staff which drips water at sunset or waterfalls in a perpetual twilight. Your Name can also manifest as an Actor, though doing so renders it vulnerable.

Additionally, each Title and your Name can make deals with entire Regalia, granting you every Contract within that Regalia, though for each such Regalia, the Title must keep a physical representation of that Regalia within its manifestations. Each Title and your Name may have as many of those deals as the total amount of Titles and Name you hold, starting at two and growing as you gain new Titles. If your Name or a Title would die while it has two or more Regalia, it instead loses one of said Regalia and is shunted back to your Arcadian domain. Both your Name and your starting Title begin with two such deals.

New Titles can be gained by traveling to Arcadia, beyond the Hedge, and either grabbing them as they come into existence, forging new ones out of the raw stuff of Arcadia or stealing them from other True Fae. Within your domain in Arcadia, you are also all-powerful, able to shape anything within it as you wish, even other living beings.

Within the Hedge, such shaping of reality also comes to you much more easily than it does to changelings, and even within the mortal plane, you may somewhat influence reality to your whims without need for Contracts. Additionally, you hold absolute power upon any concept directly under the purview of one of your Titles - the Weeping Grace of Twilight could control light and darkness, sadness, beauty, liminal spaces and times, and many other related concepts.

Do keep in mind that every Title you hold also adds responsibility to you, as they are made out of Oaths, and breaking such an Oath would leave that Title at the mercy of whoever caused said breach.
objects.title: Gentry Among Fae (Chronicles of Darkness - Changeling: the Lost)

addons.text:
You are at the end of your journey, or at least very close. You are an Oracle, a being that is either fully Ascended, or just on the cusp, similar to a Bodhisattva (the Buddhist kind, not the Kindred Of The East kind).

You have full mastery of the Nine Spheres, the secret Tenth Sphere of Unity, the Qlippothic Spheres (though you probably still shouldn't use them, even as someone uniquely able to repair the damage to reality they cause), the corresponding Ten Arcana, all Practices & Rotes, mastery of the Realms Supernal & The Abyss, mastery of The Umbra, mastery of every Paradigm that is, was, or could have been (and you and your teachings can be considered their own Paradigm if you wish), a perfect Avatar, complete Gnosis and Arete (which renders you using a Paradigm unnecessary), and in general the very pinnacle of what any being, especially any Awakened, could ever be or do. You are truly one of the Pure Ones.

With the powers at your disposal, even the Exarchs and the Dark Lords Of The Nephandi live in terror, fearing the day you might turn your attention to them.
addons.title: Ascended Oracle

objects.text:
Congratulations and condolences are both in order it seems; you have broken through the perceived limitations on your powers you subconsciously imposed upon yourself, and you have gained more than 5 dots in a chosen Sphere, as well as your Arete. This should have been the moment in which you ascended, but for whatever reason your quest for power, knowledge, compassion for those who cannot yet leave the sinking ship that is the Tellurian, or something else has kept you here, and so you are now an Archmagi, feared and respected for your power, and pitied for missing out on your Ascension. Now you must take the long road. Ascension is still possible for you, but it will take far more time, effort, and hardship than it might have before. Indeed, some claim Ascension is impossible for one who has chosen the path of the Archmagi, though this is surely naught but a rumor.

In exchange for giving up on your Ascension and leaving the Tellurian behind in enlightenment, as Mages are meant to do when reaching the 5th dot in Arete, you gain power nearly unequalled. Having acquired knowledge of the spheres of magic beyond the 5th dot, you can do such things as create new dimensions and universes, view all of time at once, experience all of reality as a single point, granting you omnipresence, already being where you want, or even eliminate the distance between minds and souls to experience life from the point of view of any and all things you desire. Create new fundamental forces, destroy old ones, make yourself truly and utterly immortal, live as a thought Pattern in humanity's collective consciousness across all timelines and universes, remove Paradox from yourself entirely, or even manipulate it onto someone else. This is the realm of gods walking the Earth, and such heights are within your grasp as you delve into the studies of the Nine Spheres of Magic.

But such power does not come without loss; your sense of humanity can easily slip when you are so powerful, so far removed from the rest of your species. In fact most Archmagi cannot relate to normal humans anymore, finding it harder and harder to lead a human life, to connect to and relate to others and their struggles. They can easily go down dark paths due to this. Compounding this is that as an Archmagi, you discharge your Resonance; the constant current of your soul going against static reality, even without casting spells. As such, you are plagued by potent Paradox, making mundane life near impossible without some way to deal with it. Should you choose to sequester yourself away in a Horizon Realm, beware; many Archmagi before you have done this, and history has shown they tend to become quite unhinged and insane as a result, and frequently enter a state of "Quiet". Still, should you find your way to navigate these issues, power beyond imagining awaits you, and hopefully one day your Ascension and department from the Tellurian.
objects.title: Archmastery (World Of Darkness - Mage: The Ascension)

addons.text:
Archmages, mages of unbelievable might, now walk among the Nine Traditions to teach, mentor, and lead. Recognizing your authority, these proud masters have pledged their aid and help to your cause.

With the presence of the Archmages, the most potent resources of the 9 Traditions can now be accessed. Legendary Horizon Realms such as the spires of Doissetep, the retro-futurist Gernsback Continuum, or the safe haven of Horizon, have opened their gates, offering sanctuaries where mages can master the Spheres and unearth the deep secrets of the universe entirely free from the threat of Paradox. These realms serve as both research bases and fortified strongholds for those seeking refuge. Beyond mere sanctuary, these vaults offer access to a wealth of once-forbidden power. You now have access the ancient tomes and wondrous artifacts that the Archmages have hoarded across the centuries. At the center of it all lies Concordia, a sprawling hub nested within the Horizon itself. It will serve as the administrative and political heart of the Nine Traditions, providing a seat of power where you can coordinate efforts and meet with the leaders, Masters, and Archmages of the various Traditions. From this, you lead them into a new age.

The Archmages shall be there to help guide, mentor, and teach the various mages of the Nine Traditions. If a particular mage has become a Master of a specific Sphere, an Archmage of that Sphere shall mentor them, teaching them how to step beyond Mastery and become an Archmaster in their own right. This process will be long and arduous, but eventually, that mage will ascend to the rank of Archmage. And just like with the masters of the traditions, an Archmage shall also mentor you, helping you deepen your knowledge and skills of your spheres, and to listen to you commands and work with you to help spread magic and wonder throughout humanity. 

However, keep in mind that just like you, they are also plagued by potent Paradox making it nearly impossible for them return to mundane life and interact with normal humans. While all Archmages are loyal to you and the Nine Traditions, the more powerful they become, the less human they are, making it difficult for them to relate and communicate with other mages. They might misinterpret orders, taking them either too literally or far too metaphorically. Time and space are jumbled to them which may result in tasks being finished before they are assigned, never being done at all, or being performed in entirely the wrong place. Furthermore, their words are never straightforward. They speak in metaphors so dense and esoteric that they often make no sense to the listener, making direct communication nearly impossible.

With the Archmages' return, the Nine Traditions have grown significantly stronger. You now have access to realms and chantries that allow the Traditions to thrive even in the most inhospitable settings, providing sanctuaries where they can wield their mystical power and knowledge without fear of Paradox. With you at the helm of the Nine Traditions at the peak of its power, you are positioned to lead the Awakened into a wondrous and magical future.

By having any of the Awakened (World Of Darkness - Mage: The Ascension) addon of the Nine Traditions, you have the equivalent of 6 dots in the corresponding sphere, six dots would indicate that you are now a Archmage in that sphere of Magic in question.
addons.title: Archmages of the 9 Traditions

addons.text:
For centuries, the Council of Nine Mystic Traditions was forced to suffer the Consensus and endure the Lie, hiding their gifts and power from the masses lest they suffer the sting of Paradox. But now no longer the case.

Every Mage that is within or will join the Nine Traditions now possesses the potential to manipulate the structures of the Consensus and The Lie as a Sphere. In doing so, they can eventually command the causes and foundations of Paradox itself. With sufficient training and mastery, Paradox is no longer a cost to be paid, but a resource to be used. This shift has dramatically altered the fundamental philosophy of it in the Nine Traditions; they no longer fear it as a deterrent, but instead embrace it as a versatile tool, a potent fuel, and a devastating weapon. 

Who know what would happen if more Mages attained mastery over this power? The Consensus of the masses would no longer matter, as reality itself will be defined by a mage’s will. No longer would the Nine Traditions have to endure the sting of Paradox or the weight of the Lie; instead, they can command and redefine it. They could resurrect the dead on a mass scale, create matter and energy in plain view of Sleepers, and perhaps even cure a Kindred, turning them back into a human. The possibilities are limitless.

You have gained the equivalent of 5 dots in manipulating the Consensus and the Lie, making you the only master of this in the 9 Traditions.

With the Archmages of the 9 Traditions add-on, there are now various mages within the Nine Traditions who are Masters of this new discipline, along with many more who are Adepts and Disciples.

Although Archmasters lack training and knowledge in this sphere—as it was introduced after their Ascension—they remain capable of learning and utilizing it. Once they gain enough proficiency in controlling and manipulating Paradox, they can descend back into the world to interact with sleepers and lead mundane lives without the constant danger of Paradox. This, in turn, allows them to reclaim some of their humanity and restores their ability to truly connect with and relate to humans.

With the Archmastery (World Of Darkness - Mage: The Ascension), you have gained the equivalent of 6 dots in this Sphere. These six dots indicate that you are now the first and, so far, the only Archmage of this Sphere.
addons.title: Consensus & a Lie: Shattered

objects.text:
You are now the leader of The Council of Nine Mystic Traditions.

The Council of Nine Mystical Traditions is a global alliance of mages. Formed when science and reason overtook the world, stamping out wonder and magic, these nine mystical set aside their hostility and mutual hatred to unite for two goals: to prevent the Technocratic Union from exterminating magic from the human soul, and to allow every human being on the planet to ascend—to become a Mage—and to discover their own unique way of interacting with the universe and defining how reality functions, to live in a world of multiple truths.

Each of these traditions has a different philosophy and cultural view of magic, and each specializes in a specific Sphere of magic. These traditions are: Akashic Brotherhood (Sphere: Mind), Celestial Chorus (Sphere: Prime), Cult of Ecstasy(Sphere: Time), Dreamspeakers (Sphere: Spirit), Euthanatos (Sphere: Entropy), Order of Hermes (Sphere: Forces), Society of Ether (Sphere: Matter), Verbena (Sphere: Life), and Virtual Adepts (Sphere: Correspondence).

All nine Traditions have unanimously agreed that you will serve as their leader—one who will guide the council forward. Whether this decision was born of a vision of a future in which you lead them to their goals, or because you are the only mage whom all nine Traditions will listen, the Masters and members of each Tradition have pledged their loyalty to you.

From chantries that house and train young magi to master their abilities, to the numerous Nodes spread throughout the world that each Tradition maintains to draw raw Quintessence, as well as magical artifacts, ancient knowledge, grimoires, and rotes—you will have access to all the resources and creations of the Nine Traditions. And while the Nine Traditions have far less influence than the Technocracy, they still hold sway within certain subcultures. For example, the Verbena exert influence over environmental movements, while the Celestial Chorus maintains ties to religious institutions. Through these connections, they gather information, recruit Consors and Acolytes, and subtly influence these institutions and movements.

Under the presence of the Council of Nine Traditions, the masses around the world have the potential to Awaken, with Consors and Acolytes of the 9 Traditions quickly awakening after spending some time in the organization. When someone has Awakened their Avatar, members of the Nine Traditions nearest to them will rush to their location. There, they shall help guide and mentor them in learning their abilities while inviting them to join the Traditions. If the individual does not want to join—either because their Paradigm does not align with the Nine Traditions or they find the entire group too rigid for their liking—how the Council reacts will depend on your policy. They might harass the Mage to join, keep a close eye on them while providing just enough resources to continue their path independently, or, in extreme cases, kill them if their Paradigm is deemed too dangerous to allow unsupervised.

Keep in mind, that there is not enough resources and manpower for the 9 Traditions to track or assist every Sleeper on the cusp of Awakening. Often, they can only locate individuals after they have already Awakened, and those who have undergone the process alone may not have left that process unscathed. Some may become Marauders, mages permanently afflicted by the Quiet, whose insanity becomes the literal physical reality surrounding them. And worse, some of the Awaken could be complete sociopaths with Paradigms entirely self-serving and inherently dangerous to those around them, placing them on the very cusp of becoming a Nephandi.

Whichever choice you make, the Council of Nine Traditions will support you as you strive to uplift mankind and facilitate Mass Ascension. To allow every man, woman, and child to Awaken, creating a world of multiple truths and infinite possibilities where magic and wonder can truly exist. And know that as long as humanity yearns for the impossible and the fantastical, the Council of Nine Traditions shall stand firm, rising from death itself to help guide humanity into a wondrous future.

By having any of the Awakened (World Of Darkness - Mage: The Ascension) addon of the Nine Traditions, you have the equivalent of 5 dots in the corresponding sphere, five dots would indicate that you are now a master in that sphere of Magic in question.
objects.title: The Council of Nine Mystic Traditions (World Of Darkness - Mage: The Ascension)

addons.text:
Even with the Technocracy’s grip on the Consensus, they are not immune to the backlash of Paradox. This is why the Syndicate never again attempted to make everyone wealthy as this radical shift triggered a catastrophic Market Correction, undoing decades of work and collapsing the global economy. Or how the Progenitors never mass produced medicine that cures all diseases as doing so would cause the body to suffer Rejection, completely destroying the subject.

So the Technocracy must play the long game, where they exert influence over the masses for years, waiting for the Consensus to "catch up" to their Enlightened Science. However, this progress is often stalled, agonizingly slow, or outright rejected by the Sleepers. Despite their vast resources, the Union cannot directly dictate the beliefs of billions; they can only nudge humanity over centuries toward a world of reason and science. Even then, there will always be those who instinctively reject or ignore the "rational" reality the Technocracy seeks to impose.

But the Ascension War is now over. Every operative—present and future—now possesses the potential to master the Consensus and the Truth as a scientific discipline. While many agents and supervisors are now trained in this discipline, a select group of managers has already achieved complete mastery over it. Even the Inner Circle has begun rigorous experimentation, seeking to understand the full scope of its influence and determining if this can be expanded beyond Earth’s atmosphere.

No longer will the Union deal with “Statistical Inevitability,” “Market Corrections,” or “Rejection,” for they have control over consensus reality. Mankind will no longer live in the dark, forced to endure the predations of monsters and reality deviants. The Technocracy can easily enforce the crushing weight of Paradox upon the entire world, where even the smallest, most coincidental acts of magic must face and endure lethal paradox.

With this, the Technocracy can finally pull humanity into the light of order and reason, a world where science and logic govern all. In this new era, mankind can explore the stars, exist in equality, live free from diseases, and have universal access to the most advanced technologies imaginable.

You have gained the equivalent of 6 dots in this discipline, six dots would indicate that you are now the only Archmaster in the discipline of Enlightened Science so far.
addons.title: Meta-Reality Engineering

objects.text:
Congratulations are in order, Agent. For you are the sole, undisputed leader of the Technocracy.

The Technocratic Union is a powerful global organization divided into five Conventions that controls a specific aspect of human society: the New World Order (media, academia, law enforcement, communications), Iteration X (industry and digital infrastructure), the Progenitors (biotech and healthcare), the Syndicate (finance and corporations), and the Void Engineers (space, deep-sea, and advanced sciences). Together they built and control much of the modern world’s systems—finance, the internet, and global communications—granting immense influence and wealth, though their power and subtle control still have limits.

You have unprecedented and total control over the Technocracy.
