From the Inner Circle; which shapes the Union’s overall strategy, ideology, and goals and manages the five Convention, to Control, the collective consciousness of all knowledge, will, and authority of the Technocracy that coordinates and enforces major decisions, your will is now the Union’s mission. You can change its policies and redefine its purpose as you see fit.

From the highest-ranking official to the lowest Agent or Extraordinary Citizen, your word is law. No longer will the Conventions fight and argue over their ideals and methods; they will now follow your orders faithfully and without question.

The Pogrom, the Technocracy’s long-standing policy of hunting down and exterminating “Reality Deviants,” could be reformed into a system of surveillance and containment. The use of Room 101 could be regulated or abolished entirely. The rigid enforcement of the Consensus could also be relaxed, allowing the masses to believe in magic and the impossible once more.

However, this will carry significant risks and consequences, as the Technocracy’s paradigm is ill-equipped to nurture belief in magic as a positive force. At best, it could gradually release information, carefully monitor this growing belief, and contain it if it spirals out of control.

You have access to every piece of technology, infrastructure, and assets the Technocracy wield: the ability to manipulate global currencies at will, unrestricted entry to every database and digital footprint, and the power to deploy HIT Marks and elite Field Operatives against any target. Supercomputers bend to your command, predicting the future with terrifying precision, while Dyson spheres like the Autochthonia, orbital stations circling distant worlds, and countless voidships prowling the depths of space to extend your reach. And the managers and those in the Ivory Tower will help you in furthering your understanding of the Enlightened Sciences.

With the presence of the Technocracy, the masses around the world have the potential to Awaken. The Technocracy, with its vast reach, is able to monitor any Awakenings that may occur, identifying and flagging individuals who show the potential to become Enlightened. Through its front companies, research institutions, and corporate networks, the Union can quietly recruit those promising candidates and the Sleepers and Extraordinary Citizens already under the Technocracy employ may find themselves Awaken once they spend some time within the organization.

Individuals who fully Awaken, achieving what the Technocracy calls Enlightenment and manifesting their Genius (the Union’s term for an Avatar), are brought into the organization and trained in the principles of the Enlightened Sciences. Those who Awaken outside the Technocracy’s influence are located and approached, then encouraged/pressured into adopting the Technocratic paradigm.

For those who are unwilling or unable to conform to the Union’s worldview, the response depends on its internal policy. They may be reconditioned, neutralized, or released under continued surveillance. In those cases, they are given sanitized, generic terminology to help them conceptualize their abilities in ways that prevents a mage from destabilizing reality and creating paradox.

However, the Technocracy cannot properly train or nurture Awakened individuals whose powers operate outside, or directly contradict, the Technocratic paradigm. The Union’s methods of instruction rely on framing magic through the lens of the Enlightened Sciences. If a mage rejects this, meaningful guidance becomes impossible. In the best-case scenario, short of reconditioning or termination, the Union simply monitors the individual and intervenes only if their experiments push too far, risk Paradox backlash to their surroundings, or cause widespread disruption.

You stand at the helm of one of the most powerful organizations the world has ever known, a force that guided humanity out of the Dark Ages and into an era defined by reason and logic. Whether you choose to purge reality deviants and extinguish magic in the name of safety, or embrace the unknown for the promise of an uncertain future, the Technocracy will follow your command. And so long as humanity yearns for order, security, and science, it will endure  and rise from the ashes to protect and safeguard mankind.
objects.title: The Technocratic Union (World Of Darkness - Mage: The Ascension)

addons.text: The Disparate Alliance does have archmasters and archmages. Most have existed before the Alliance’s inception, while the rest are comprised of modern mages who were lucky, crazy, or stubborn enough to achieve archmastery on their own. It is worth noting that, compared to the Council of Nine Traditions or the Technocratic Union, the number of archmages and archmasters within the Disparate Alliance is small; at best, a single Craft might boast three. Furthermore, the more seasoned and powerful masters of these Crafts are gone—having been killed by the Technocratic Union, abandoned their Craft for the Council of Nine, or succumbed to Paradox. As a result, the remaining archmages and archmasters are significantly less experienced than the average peer in their position. However, these archmasters and archmages remain far more in touch with their humanity. Rather than staying in realms away from human affairs, they involve themselves in the daily struggles and occurrences of their Crafts. And, unlike the 9 Traditions or the Technocractic Union, these masters only serve in an advisory and teaching roles and have no official power or leadership over their Crafts. These masters have built and managed a Horizon Realm for their people—realms designed around the specific philosophy and culture of each respective Craft. These serve as sanctuaries where members can rest, train, and meet in safety. Furthermore, should a curious mage ever aspire to become an archmaster or archmage themselves, these masters shall teach them. By having any of the Awakened (World of Darkness - Mage: The Ascension) addons of the Nine Traditions and the Technocracy addon, the additional Crafts that have joined The Disparate Alliance will have their own Archmages and Archmasters. How each Craft views their archmages and archmasters depends entirely on their specific philosophy, culture, or paradigm. For example, a Craft following the Force might view their archmasters as something akin to the Mortis gods who will teach the Craft and help others become one with the Force. Meanwhile, a Craft following the path of Magicka might see their archmages as beings who have achieved CHIM and are on their way to Amaranth. It is important to remember that these Crafts are not actually drawing upon those external forces; rather, they are manipulating the Spheres to be perceived as those beings through the subjective lens of their own beliefs, paradigm, and Will.
addons.title: The Elders of the Alliance

addons.text: The Ahl-i-Batin are gonna spend years debating this. The Crafts of the Disparate Alliance are now able treat the Consensus, the Lie, and Paradox itself as a Sphere they can manipulate and control. Whether if this is truly Unity, the Tenth Sphere, or a completely unique sphere remains to be seen; regardless, the Disparate Alliance now can learn a way to permanently preserve their culture and Magick from the ravages of Consensus. From Templars using it to force monsters and devils to succumb to the ravages of Paradox, to the Taftâni weaving the Consensus to permit vulgar Magick in the open without fear, this Sphere has changes everything. The Consensus and Paradox are no longer hazards but tools and weapons that the Crafts can finally wield for themselves. However, the vast majority of the Alliance has yet to learn this. Only a handful of Mages in each Craft possess even the equivalent of 3 dots in this Sphere. You alone stand with the mastery of the equivalent of 5 dots in this sphere. In time, with your help, mages throughout the Alliance will be able to use this sphere, to manipulate and control the Consensus and Paradox to their own ends. With Archmastery (World Of Darkness - Mage: The Ascension), this has changed. Within each Craft, Masters, Adepts, and Disciples of this sphere now exist, ready to pass this knowledge to any who seek it. You have gain archmastery of this sphere, the equivalent of 6 dots. Within a Craft’s sphere of influence, the Consensus can be permanently rewritten, allowing vulgar Magick to flow freely and be cast instantly without the sting of Paradox. Nodes can be woven from nothing, forced into existence by a Consensus that now remembers them as having always been there. Even Archmasters and Archmages can walk the earth freely, no longer fearing the weight of Paradox gnawing at their souls. Miracles thought impossible such as the resurrection of the dead or the curing of the vampiric curse are now within reach. The outcome of the Ascension War has been rendered irrelevant. The Disparate Alliance now can decide for themselves what is real, and what is possible.
addons.title: The Tenth Sphere

objects.text: The underdogs of the underdogs. The Disparate Alliance is composed of various Crafts and sects that were exiled from, refused to join, or abandoned either the Nine Traditions or the Technocratic Union. In the modern age, they have formed a decentralized union—a third path for mages in the Ascension War. You will serve as their leader and advisor, the person who successfully united and moderate these clashing magical cultures and philosophies into a cohesive alliance of mutual defense and shared intelligence, where even the most rigid and conservative Craft will listen and respect. While the Nine Traditions seek to reclaim the past—returning the world to an era where senseless chaos reigned—and the Technocracy push toward the future—creating a world defined by cold and uncaring logic—the Disparate Alliance are focused on the present, where the various Crafts’s attention are on the needs of their communities and the survival of their cultures and philosophy. By rejecting the grand, abstract struggle for global paradigm dominance, the Disparate Alliance fight for the autonomy to practice their ancestral mystical arts and traditions in peace. The ten crafts that makes up this alliance are: The Ahl-i-Batin, Ngoma, The Wu Lung, The Hollow Ones, The Children of Knowledge, The Taftâni, Templar Knights, Sister of Hippolyta, The Bata’a, and The Kopa Loei. While the Disparate Alliance lacks the resources and influence of the Council of Nine Traditions, it more than makes up for it in its organizational structure. Because the Alliance is a decentralized coalition of various Crafts rather than a rigid hierarchy, each group is able to act independently without constant oversight. This allows for a level of autonomy and operational speed that far outpaces the Traditions, who are often bogged down by ancient grudges and internal bureaucracy. The Disparate Crafts also maintain deep ties to their specific cultures, religions, or philosophies. This groundedness allows their magic to be less hindered by the dangers of Paradox compared to the Traditions or the Technocratic Union. Furthermore, these Crafts have preserved records of ancient Rotes and lore that the Traditions have long since forgotten and the Technocracy has failed to scrub from history. As a leader, you have the ability to coordinate, manage, and moderate these diverse groups, along with a knack for recruiting new Crafts that may emerge. While the Alliance sees you as a respected guide, they are not subservient to your will. Should you implement inhumane policies or decisions that veer into Nephandi territory, the Crafts will not hesitate to rebel or abandon the Alliance entirely. Having less influence than the Council of 9 Traditions or the Technocratic Union, sleepers will gradually awaken within the influence of the Craft, and the Extraordinary Citizens and Acolytes will awaken as a mages after some time within those crafts. Recently awaken mages within those areas will be approached by the crafts to join. While those who awaken outside the Alliance's reach—or choose to remain independent—find a home in a growing, unofficial "11th Craft": the Orphans. There, mages will learn the Spheres and navigate the dangers of Paradox. Most importantly, the Orphans ensure that no paradigm becomes a threat to others or slips into Nephandi corruption. When a Mage seeks to codify their own paradigm into a new Craft, the Alliance provides the necessary infrastructure. As these new groups gain enough Mages and Acolytes, they are formally inducted into the Disparate Alliance. In time, the Alliance will evolve into a force capable of rivaling the Traditions and the Union, fostering a world where diverse Crafts flourish and humanity is protected. By having any of the Awakened (World of Darkness - Mage: The Ascension) addons of the Nine Traditions and the Technocracy addon, you can have an additional craft join the Disparate Alliance for each addon picked. These can be official Crafts that have yet to join the alliance such as the Navalon, a faction that broke away from the Technocracy and revere the ideals of Camelot and King Arthur, or the Uzoma, a Yoruba craft that worship the mysterious orishas. Because any belief system can serve as a paradigm, you can even create entirely unique Crafts, such as those who view magic as "The Force" or those seeking to transcend reality through CHIM. However, it is important to remember that these Mages are not literally using those external forces; rather, they are manipulating the Nine Spheres through the specific lens of their own subjective beliefs and Will.
objects.title: The Disparate Alliance (World Of Darkness - Mage: The Ascension)

objects.text:
Your already impressive memory and analytical capabilities have been improved even further. Your memory is expanded to become truly infinite, able to store all the knowledge you can collect. You can also modify and partition it at will. For example, you can temporarily lock away your knowledge of some book if you want to read and experience it yourself as if for the first time. 

Your analytical capabilities are such that you gain complete understanding of every bit of information the moment any of your senses come across it, without the need for studying or analysing. Additionally, the moment you encounter any problem, it is cross-referenced with the entirety of your knowledge, and you get a comprehensive understanding of both the challenge you face and possible solutions. This also makes you completely immune to any corruptive, madness-inducing effects or mental hazards, be they a natural consequence of the information you acquire or someone's deliberate actions, allowing you to collect any knowledge without fear.

Lastly, the library of knowledge you possess now constantly updates the moment you visit a universe with all the knowledge and information ever recorded and stored in any way, shape, or form, be it mundane, scientific, or supernatural. From stone tablets containing the original ten commandments to the newest scientific papers. No matter how rare or inaccessible the knowledge is, it can be found in the infinite library that is your mind.
objects.title: Librarian Of Akasha

addons.text: You didn't just steal the seat of the guildmaster from Momonga. No, Instead you were always the guildmaster. You were there since the formation of the guild when they were just a clan, and thus you were there throughout all of their adventures. Select three world items that are bound to you, similar to Momonga's personal world item that you've obtained on your journey with your friends. Speaking of friends, those world items are just the icing on the cake. The real addition is that you were a lot more convincing towards the end of the server, and you can optionally choose which of your guildmates stayed behind with you at the end. Not to worry, these guildmates aren't actually the gamers themselves, but npc avatars based on the lore they made for themselves. You can also choose your relationship with these people. They default to the rest of the tomb's default loyalty, though.
addons.title: The Will of the Guildmaster

addons.text:
As a master of all disciplines and schools of Tier Magic in addition to Wild Magic, you have unlocked a new Job Class, the World-Caster Class.

As a World-Caster, you can now choose to cast any of your spells as either Wild or Tier Magic, allowing you to cast Wild Magic spells for a commensurate amount of mana rather than souls, or Tier Magic spells for souls rather than mana. 

Additionally, you now have access to a new Meta-Magic modifier: World Magic. With this new modifier, you can expend both souls and mana to elevate a spell’s tier and power in addition to granting some of the relevant qualities of balance-breaking Wild Magic and World Items, such as the ability to penetrate otherwise absolute resistances like the Undead’s immunity to mind control.

With time, you could even develop World-Level Magic that eclipses even the immense powers of the greatest World Items.
addons.title: World-Caster

addons.text:
Your mastery of magic now extends to the so-called “magic of warriors”, otherwise known as Martial Arts. 

In recognition of this, you gain the passive skill Perfect Spellblade, which essentially functions as a more convenient version of the spell Perfect Warrior. This skill grants you the stats of a half-baked martial build, like Perfect Warrior does, but does not restrict your spellcasting or mana recovery rate. By making full use of your Martial Arts, you might even be able to match an equivalently leveled warrior with a proper build without even using your Tier Magic.

Should you be desperate enough to properly seal your spellcasting with Perfect Warrior, your stats improve to the point that you could reasonably compete with a top-class martial build like Warrior Takemikazuchi, and maybe even a World Champion like Touch Me.
addons.title: Perfect Spellblade

addons.text:
Not only are you an undisputed master of all magic, be it Tier Magic or Wild Magic, you are now also a top-class example of all other job-archetypes from YGGDRASIL, with all the stats and skills to match. All at once, you’re a mage that could out-burst Ulbert Alain Odle, a warrior that could out-fight Touch Me, an assassin that could out-maneuver Nishikienrai, and so much more.

Additionally, you’re capable of learning and improving upon any of the abilities present in the Overlord canon, from trump-cards like Ainz’s “The Goal of All Life is Death” to inherent Talents like Antilene Heran Fouche’s Psychometry.

All of that, however, is just your initial strength. Your level is now uncapped, meaning you now hold the potential for unlimited growth. Given enough time, you could reach a level where not even a full party of World Enemies would stand a chance against you alone. 

Not that you actually need to face such foes on your own, since you also possess the ability to perform a short ritual to bless others with your uncapped growth, be they guildmates, NPCs, or anyone else of your choosing. You can, at any time, remove this blessing from others by simply performing the ritual again.
addons.title: Heir of YGGDRASIL

objects.text:
Acquiring the body of a video game character, particularly one from the world of Yggdrasil, you now stand as the Supreme Being, comparable to Momonga, also known as Ainz, the level 100 Lich. Your ascension elevates you to the pinnacle of magical supremacy, endowing you with extraordinary passive abilities and traits, as well as unparalleled might and mastery.

Not only is your magical reserve multiplied a hundredfold, bestowing upon you an abundant and limitless source of mystical energy, but you also gain instant expertise in over a thousand spells up to the 10th tier from every school of magic that existed in Yggdrasil. Even the awe-inspiring Super Tier Magic lies within your grasp.

Your mastery extends to meta magic, granting you absolute control over spell manipulation. With unrivaled precision, you transcend the limitations of your spells, unlocking their true potential. You wield the ultimate power over magic, making you the unrivaled and supreme wielder of mystical forces in the world you inhabit.

Furthermore, as the Supreme Being, you gain access to powerful and unbreakable enchanted magical gear and items that fits you perfectly. This gear complements your magical prowess, enhancing your abilities and granting you additional formidable powers.
objects.title: Supreme Being (Overlord)

objects.text:
As a Magician, you are blessed with an intimate bond to the Wellspring, an internal wellspring of infinite magical energy. This mystical reservoir courses through every fiber of your being, empowering you to tap into its enchanting currents and unleash a vast array of magical abilities.

Inspired by the exceptional talents of Julia and Alice, your magical prowess transcends the boundaries of the standard Magician archetype. While specializing in your chosen Discipline, you also possess access to extraordinary powers that set you apart.

Your spellcasting abilities have been honed to an extraordinary level of mastery. Through precise and intricate control, you weave spells with exceptional finesse, channeling magical energy in elegant patterns. Each incantation is infused with heightened potency and efficacy, allowing you to unleash devastating magical assaults, manipulate the elements with grace and fluidity, and erect formidable barriers of protection. The seamless flow of your spells embodies the artistry of a true maestro of magic.

Within the depths of your being resides your own personal Wellspring, and yours bestows upon you unparalleled knowledge and insight. This extraordinary gift enables you to grasp intricate magical theories, decipher ancient texts written in cryptic languages, and penetrate the depths of hidden truths that elude the grasp of ordinary Magicians. By tapping into this well of knowledge, you gain a profound understanding of magical phenomena, unveil the ancient secrets woven into the fabric of the arcane, and unravel perplexing magical enigmas that confound others.
 
The harmonious convergence of these additional abilities, coupled with your unwavering connection to the Wellspring and your chosen Discipline, elevates you to the echelons of exceptional Magicians. Embrace your unique capabilities, delve into the depths of your chosen Discipline, and allow the boundless potential of the Wellspring to surge through you. As a true master of magic, you wield the power to reshape the very reality in which you exist, untangle the intricate mysteries that lie shrouded in ancient lore, and carve an indelible mark upon the tapestry of the magical world that surrounds you.
objects.title: Born to be a Magician (The Magicians)

objects.text:
Within your bloodline lies a previously hidden heritage, awakening a newfound potential that enhances your magical capabilities. This heritage bestows upon you the powers of a Traveler, a unique type of Magician with the extraordinary ability to teleport to distant locations through focused concentration or even spontaneous occurrences if your control over this power is not yet refined. With your Traveler abilities, you can traverse vast distances, teleporting to faraway planets, separate dimensions, and even other planes of existence within your local multiverse. Your teleportation can be further augmented and customized through spells and tattoos, allowing you to bring companions with you on your journeys. Remarkably, your ability to travel is not solely dependent on the presence of magic, granting you the freedom to teleport even in locations devoid of magical energy.

In addition to your teleportation prowess, Travelers possess inherent psychic gifts, making them natural telepaths. With ease, you can effortlessly delve into the thoughts and minds of those around you, perceiving their innermost musings as if it were second nature. This telepathic ability extends beyond mere mind-reading, enabling you to enter the dreams of others while they slumber or establish telepathic connections with individuals spanning worlds and dimensions.
objects.title: Traveller (The Magicians)

addons.text: Grief is fuel. It is an endless, intoxicating fuel that suffuses your whole being. Existence is suffering, so existence is what will fuel your unyielding soul. Your Soul Gem has been hardened by the travesty of life and the suffering you have endured. It has been hardened to the point where it is now impossible to shatter, only capable of being broken by one thing. The Power of Love. No matter the source of the attack, be it a reality warper who wants you gone, a Demon Lord which pities your existence, your Soul Gem, hardened as it is, will never shatter unless it is attacked by an outpouring of the united Love of an entire universe, solely designed to put you to rest. Lesser amounts of Love would still be capable of cracking your Gem without shattering it though. And if an unsuspecting fool were to ever touch your Soul Gem without protection, they would feel all of the suffering you have ever experienced condensed into a single moment. Those who break under this mental onslaught will become nothing more than a new puppet for you to control until they eventually recover from the pain. There are no limits to the amount of puppets you can control, and you can talk to them in their own minds if you wish.
addons.title: The Death of Innocence

objects.text:
You are a Magical Girl who has overcome your despair. Instead of becoming a Witch when your Soul Gem fills up, you can summon a fraction of your Witch’s power and merge it with your Magical Girl form. This is called a Doppel and it is a hybrid form that combines both your Magical Girl and Witch forms. A Doppel is much more formidable than a Magical Girl alone, but it does not reach the full potential of a Witch. Your Doppel is closer to a second stage to your Magical Girl form with the theme of your Witch.

Using your Doppel gives you access to some of the abilities and traits of your Witch, such as unique powers based on your Witch. Your Doppel also reflects your personality and wish but in a twisted and distorted way. Your Doppel has a different appearance from your Witch, but they are still connected to each other.

Your Doppel form is powered by the curses that have accumulated within your Soul Gem, and automatically activates should you have enough to start to turn into a Witch if you hadn't had this ability. When your collected curses run dry, so does this form.

(This is based off of the game continuity, so overusing your Doppel will not result in it taking you over permanently.)
objects.title: Doppel Syndrome (Puella Magi Madoka☆Magica)

objects.text:
Instead of manifesting your Doppel when your Soul Gem is full, you can now choose to temporarily transform your Soul Gem into a Grief Seed, allowing you to take the full form of your Witch. You may have become a Witch, but you still retain your mind and are fully immune to the effects of curses with no ill effects, and unlike with your Doppel, you don't lose Grief as you use this form. You can let go of this transformation at any time, reverting back to your Magical Girl form with a clean Soul Gem.

As a Witch, you can consume negative emotions from Humans or feed off other Witches to make yourself stronger. You can create Familiars which are miniature versions of you that work as an extension of your body. Familiars can feed off negative emotions to evolve into fully grown Witches. You can also create Barriers, pockets of separated space that reflect your despair, and a maze full of familiars to fight intruders. The size and complexity depend on your current strength and you possess a unique power based on your wish.

Alternatively, you can choose fully summon your Witch as an extension of yourself from your Soul Gem that you can control and use to fight.

Your starting power is based on how powerful you were as a Magical Girl. By having 80 or more karma you have enough Karma to completely rewrite reality to the size of an entire planet.
objects.title: Witch Out (Puella Magi Madoka☆Magica)

objects.text:
Your Soul Gem is the perfect phylactery. Even without a body, you are capable of conscious thought and can control your body without any range limitations. You can spend magic to create bodies for you to control. You can shape them to look like anything you want, be it human, animal, or monster. Each body has its own physical limitations, depending on how much magic you invested in making them. You can switch between bodies at will, or even multitask controlling several bodies at once. Your Magical Girl transformation is no longer reliant on your Soul Gem being with you, because of this you can now transform without needing your Soul Gem.

Additionally, you can crystallize your Karma to create additional Soul Gems that works as a decoy. You can store them in a safe place, or give them to someone you trust. Your Soul is in a state of superposition where the destroyed Soul Gem is not your main Soul Gem but instead a decoy. However, each time a decoy is destroyed, you lose the Karma spent on making that decoy.
objects.title: Perfect Lichdom (Puella Magi Madoka☆Magica)

objects.text:
Positive emotions can empower you and permanently enhance your soul, thereby improving your magic. Your Soul Gem can be filled with all kinds of different emotions; different kinds of emotions will cause your growth to develop in different ways based on that emotion. It’s important to balance your store of positive and negative emotions inside your Soul Gem.

The more negative emotions you have, the stronger your magic is, up to twice as strong when your soul gem is completely full; however, if you experience too many negative emotions, they can overwhelm you. Similarly, if you have too many positive emotions stored, you may not get as much benefit from the negative emotion enhancement. It’s important to note that if you have Doppel Syndrome or Witch Out, your negative emotions will also make them stronger. 

Additionally, your abilities to use magic are further enhanced and are a lot more flexible than before, and you possess a sharper instinct to your magical abilities. You can fully sense how much karma and grief you have left and have an instinct to tell how much grief will be created by your magic. You're also good at leveraging your unique magic to create rituals and facilities that work with it. For example, you could make a cloning lab, Evil Nuts that transform humans into Witches, or a self-sustaining spell that erases someone from everyone’s memory in a city.
objects.title: Humanity (Puella Magi Madoka☆Magica)

objects.text: You have entered the Gate of Truth, and as such, gained expansive knowledge of Alchemy on the level of using Alchemy without a transmutation circle - Clap Alchemy. Are you disappointed that you didn't lose a limb? As a result, you gain mastery in the three stages of Alchemy, which are Comprehension, Deconstruction, and Reconstruction. You can understand atomic compositions through Comprehension, disintegrate things through the use of Deconstruction, and alter matter into any form that you understand through Reconstruction. Naturally you have an advanced understanding of both Chemistry and Alchemical Circles, enabling you to make use of Alchemy in incredible ways with practice.
objects.title: Gate of Truth (Fullmetal Alchemist)

objects.text: You are familiar with the "Dragon's Pulse" used in Alkahestry, enabling Alkahestry through tapping into ambient Chi, or life energy, which can be used for ranged transmutations and healing.
objects.title: Alkahestry (Fullmetal Alchemist)

objects.text:
You are a Metamorphmagus, meaning you can change your body and appearance at will. You start out only able to do superficial changes, but with a bit of work you can change your looks however you like, and once you’ve mastered that you steadily become able to control each and every aspect of your body, internally and externally. You must retain a humanoid shape, but you can be any height between four and eight feet as an adult, and of proportionate width. Beyond that, go nuts. Colours, shapes, sizes, gender, age, everything is wide open, and hardly any limits apply.

Holding your transformations requires little to no effort, to the point that you can even sleep or fall unconscious without losing it. And unless you go really crazy, your magic will prevent any of your more ‘unconventional’ transformations from killing or seriously harming you, and will warn you if something you’re going to do is beyond its ability to mitigate.
objects.title: Metamorphism (Harry Potter)

objects.text: You can transform into an animal form that is innate to yourself. With extensive practice, you can seamlessly shift between human and animal form(s). This ability offers unique opportunities for stealth, exploration, and utilizing animal instincts and abilities.
objects.title: Animagus (Harry Potter)

addons.text: You now have a magical form in addition to the mundane ones you have. You are limited to only 1 magical form. For magical forms, the size limit is waived, but it must be a known magical form.
addons.title: Magical Beast

objects.text: You have multiple Animagus forms, instead of the standard one. Taking this power gives you the ability to transform into any mundane animal with no limits to how many forms you can take.
objects.title: Multi-Animagus (Harry Potter)

objects.text: Your animagus form isn’t a run-of-the-mill animal, but rather a magical being, such as a dragon or a unicorn. You have all the powers a normal specimen of this animal might have.
objects.title: Magical Animagus (Harry Potter)

objects.text:
You possess an Obscurus, a parasitical force born from suppressed magic and trauma. Unlike most Obscurials, you have attained a symbiotic relationship with your Obscurus, allowing you to harness its dark power without it harming you.

You can enter your Obscurial Form to unleash devastating magical surges that obliterate your surroundings. When transformed, you become a near-invisible, destructive force resistant to both magical and physical attacks.

Though extremely powerful, this form drains your magic to sustain itself, making it difficult to maintain for long periods. Over time, you can gain further control over your Obscurial Form, allowing you to direct the Obscurus' energy with greater precision and reduce the toll it takes on you when active.
objects.title: Obscurial Form (Harry Potter)

addons.text: Now you may also optionally gain the knowledge, skill and abilities of your legendary ancestor if you so desire. Should you possess all four Founders bloodlines, you will gain the knowledge of how the Founders created their greatest achievements including their legendary school, and what caused it to last more than a thousand years.
addons.title: Founding Knowledge

objects.text:
Your knowledge of magic has advanced to the level of living legends such as Voldemort, Gellert Grindlewald, and Albus Dumbledore.

You are now a veritable master in all fields of magic, being a genius when it comes to exploring the depths of magic and it’s effects. You can come up with new uses of magic just by thinking about it, using your imagination to shape reality with your magical power.

Instead of only the ability to create and enchant basic magical items, you have the talent of creating magical items far beyond the scope of the original canon of Harry Potter, akin to Fanon/non-canon enchanters.

You are now also able to use ancient magic. Magic that is beyond the scope of normal wizards has been all but forgotten by most modern wizards and witches. Just by possessing this magic, your powers in magic have been propelled to around five times greater levels, as well as being able to see magic and manipulate it to a greater degree than normal wizards.

Additionally, you can also optionally gain the knowledge and abilities of Voldemort, Grindelwald, and Dumbledore without the memories or the knowledge changing who you are as a person.
objects.title: Grand Sorcerer (Harry Potter)

objects.text:
With this, you somehow possess the most coveted ability of the Slytherin bloodline: Parseltongue. Parseltongue is primarily known as the magical ability to communicate with serpents of all forms, though this is not all that this gift has to offer.

While a Parselmouth can indeed communicate with snakes, this aspect of the gift runs much deeper. All serpents revere “Speakers”—possessors of this gift—and will not hesitate to aid them in whatever ways they can.

As a speaker of the serpent’s tongue, magic considers you a serpent yourself. This allows you to be regarded as a serpent whenever it benefits you, primarily providing immunity to the more dangerous abilities of serpents, such as their venom or the gaze of the legendary Basilisks.

This connection to the very concept of the serpent can, with time and experience, allow you to take on their form entirely—similar to, but not quite the same as, an Animagus transformation. You need to learn and understand the body of each serpent you wish to transform into, with more powerful ones being much more difficult.

The final ability of Parseltongue is one that is rarely mentioned, but often noticed: you will find that your magic has an affinity for healing of all kinds, making it more effective than that of others. This can even allow you to cure conditions many would consider “uncurable,” and potentially match the feats of the legendary Asclepius—“curing” death itself.
objects.title: Parseltongue (Harry Potter)

objects.text:
You are no ordinary witch or wizard; instead, you belong to a supernaturally enchanting magical species known as Veela. Traditionally, Veela are women, but you can be a rare exception to that rule.

One of your most recognizable abilities is the Allure—an innate magical aura that surrounds you, subtly enchanting those nearby. Under its influence, others experience a blissful, trance-like state where nothing seems to matter but you. They feel an overwhelming urge to impress or please you, often acting recklessly and without concern for their safety. Unlike most Veela, however, you possess more control over how this enchantment affects others and while not true mind control, you can steer their actions to an extent. Additionally, you gain basic knowledge on suppressing your Allure, although even with the best control, it can still flare up suddenly during moments of intense emotion.

As a part-magical being, you also possess a unique kind of magic that doesn’t rely on a wand. Veela magic is often expressed through music, amplifying your Allure, ethereal beauty, or enchanting the target. But while beautiful, when enraged, Veela undergoes a fearsome transformation: their faces sharpen into cruel, birdlike visages, and great scaly wings erupt from their backs and they gain powerful pyrokinetic abilities. With mastery, you may learn to summon this transformation—or aspects of it—at will.

Lastly, due to your nature, you have a natural affinity for fire and air, though you may find yourself slightly averse to water.

Optional: This can also make you French.
objects.title: Veela (Harry Potter)

objects.text: Your mark is the aberrant union of two existing dragonmarks. They grow in parallel.
objects.title: Aberrant Dragonmark (D&D)

objects.text: Once you have mastered the Greater spells of your mark, you can choose another one to add to your library. This can be repeated for every mark given enough time. If you have an Aberrant mark, you can train two marks in parallel.
objects.title: Elder Dragonmark (D&D)

objects.text: Throughout the long history of Dungeons & Dragons, there has been many monsters and creatures that have been created for the franchise, yet most have never made their way into the game’s latest editions. With this power, you can summon those forgotten beings. You are able to call forth every monster and creature that has ever appeared in the series, regardless of edition. From rare dragons such as Platinum and Ruby Dragons to the highest ranks of the Modrons, and even obscure creatures found only in early editions, like the Wind Walkers and Ear Seekers, nothing is beyond your reach. All of these creatures can be summoned at your beck and call.
objects.title: The Expanded Bestiary (D&D)

objects.text:
With the Expanded Bestiary, the limits on a creature’s magical cost have been shattered. This will allow you to summon epic-level monsters from Dungeons & Dragons 3rd Edition, directly from the Epic Level Handbook. These beings far surpass the Tarrasque in power, entities capable of threatening entire planes and challenging even the greatest adventurers.

From primal elementals, to living mobile Spheres of Annihilation, and horrifying abominations such as the Dream Larva and the Hecatoncheires, you can now summon and command these mighty monsters of legend.

And with the introduction of epic-level creatures, the CR cap for random summoning is increased, allowing you to randomly summon any creature with a CR of 20 or lower from any edition of Dungeons & Dragons at half the normal conjuration cost.
objects.title: The Epic Bestiary (D&D)

objects.text:
You now have the power to freely modify, add, remove, or adjust any aspect of a creature’s stat block, including alignment, size, speed, ability scores, attacks, skills, feats, special abilities, and even class levels. Altering a creature in any meaningful ways will raise or lower its Challenge Rating, which in turn increases or decreases the amount of energy required to create it.

With this, the possibilities are endless: A Lich could be lawful good, a Tarrasque could be reduced to CR 1 and die from a strong breeze, or a gelatinous cube could be given intelligence and become a 10th-level wizard. Monsters and creatures can also gain race-exclusive feats and unique class features that distinguish them from standard members of their species, ensuring that each creature feels truly unique rather than a generic example of its race.

If you do not have The Epic Bestiary, your creations will be capped at CR 30. However, you are free to experiment, and redefine what your creatures can be and shaping them to fit your needs.
objects.title: The Altered Bestiary (D&D)

objects.text:
Since the very beginning of D&D, players have used third-party content and homebrew materials to customize their campaigns, creating unique monsters and creatures to fit their stories. Altered Bestiary has evolved to allow you to summon monsters and beings from third-party D&D works, homebrew creations and even fully custom creatures of your own design.

From the False Hydra that devours entire towns and erases its victims from memory to majestic Void Dragons soaring across the cosmos to fully customizable creations rivaling the Avatar of Tiamat, the possibilities are endless. You can even construct custom abilities and feats for your creatures.

Keep in mind that these customized creatures, along with their abilities and feats, must remain within reasonable limits. You can't create a CR 5 monster and have it match an ancient dragon. Likewise, the greater the creature's power and its abilities, the higher the cost required to create it. For example, a god-like being may require energy equal to a CR in the hundreds or more.
objects.title: The Homebrew Bestiary (D&D)

objects.text: Within your body is a sleeping dragon, holding back the dragon seed to prevent your dragonization. The dragon will stay in your body until you have developed antibodies that will prevent you from dragonizing, at which point they will die. They will leave a portion of their magic behind, which you will be able to call on for a temporary boost in power, but it is not infinite and will be used up.
objects.title: Sleeping Dragon (Fairy Tail)

objects.text: Every Purchase of this allows you to prestige a rune of your choice. This works up until the final prestige, in which case you will need to buy a Capstone Prestige. You may choose the event in which you gained this Prestige and are able to heavily influence what the Talent you will gain. While you don't have total control over your talent, you will always be satisfied with what you receive.
objects.title: Prestige Rune

objects.text: This 10th prestige (also known as a Capstone) only comes into effect once you have a Rune at it's 9th Prestige. Even without a rune being at it's 9th prestige, you are still able to buy a Capstone that you can use once you have a 9th prestige rune. You are able to design your Capstone Talent in it's entirely with this, both the passive effect and the boosts other Talents receive.
objects.title: Capstone Prestige

objects.text: You’re possessed of an impossibly deep understanding, and an incredibly diplomatic mind. Each purchase of this upgrade increases your maximum amount of simultaneous bondings by one. You must follow the terms of any contract you made in return for these bonds as usual, but can use different abilities gained from Bondings simultaneously, even merging and using them synergistically. This does not allow you to Summon or Bind while bonded.
objects.title: Master of Bonds

objects.text: You’re a prodigy of the Art. Now you can initiate Bondings without worry of giving up the versatility of Summoning and Binding, being able to use both simultaneously. This does not allow you to take more bonds.
objects.title: Multidisciplinary Prodigy

objects.text:
After years of relentless study and unraveling the secrets of Formulaic magic, you have achieved a groundbreaking breakthrough—the Kankara Formula. With the Kankara Formula, your potential becomes limitless. Delving into the fabric of reality, you access equations governing the fundamental forces of the universe. Your magic circle transforms into an ethereal web of sigils pulsating with energy, resonating with the cosmic symphony.

The Kankara Formula allows you to rewrite the rules, bending the laws of nature to your whims. Illusion, hypnosis, healing, and enchantment become mere child's play compared to the vast potential at your fingertips.

Shape illusions so vivid and lifelike that they seamlessly blend with reality, fooling even astute observers. Control minds with precision, weaving webs of hypnosis that ensnare even the strongest-willed opponents.

Decipher the complex equations governing the body's processes. With a touch, mend grievous wounds, revitalizing life forces and restoring vitality beyond conventional magic. Unravel the secrets of the body's intricate systems.

Infuse objects with unparalleled power through meticulous calculations and manipulation of mystical forces. Create enchantments that defy understanding, from weapons rending reality to artifacts bending physics.

Traverse vast distances effortlessly. Your enhanced understanding of space-time mechanics allows precise teleportation, stepping through dimensions to reach hidden corners of existence.

Decipher and control the hidden equations of opponents' powers. Manipulate their attacks, transmuting fury into a harmonious symphony under your command.

Craft pocket dimensions where your calculations manifest as breathtaking landscapes. Fuse artistry with science, reshaping reality itself.

With each equation solved, you inch closer to harnessing forces once reserved for the Divine.
objects.title: Kankara Formula (High School DxD)

addons.text: You're the divine father of monsters, and everyone knows it. All NPC gain 100 levels, your guildmates, if you have them, gain 150, and you gain 50 more than the base 300. You gain 100 levels every other month, so you can optionally also craft your own NPCs using a character creation menu that can be opened through the throne.
addons.title: God of Monsters

objects.text:
Legends tell of the rise of heroes, but you are not among them. Instead, you have been chosen to become something far greater—a World Enemy, the embodiment of unparalleled might and unmatched mastery over magic. As a World Enemy, you rise above all others, reaching the pinnacle of existence. Your power rivals that of The Devourer of Nine Worlds, the Final Raid Boss of Yggdrasil, a being that can threaten entire guilds of max-level players and challenge dozens of them at a time. This grants you potent passive abilities and traits that can break the very rules of the world.

As the World Enemy, you possess the combined powers of a Mythic Rank 10 Archmage and three additional Rank 10 Mythic Paths of your choosing. These paths are integrated and adapted into the Yggdrasil system. 

Your magical reserves, regeneration, and potency are multiplied tenfold, allowing you to cast Super Tier spells and Mythic Spells without constraint. Moreover, you gain a vast catalog of spells from RPG games similar to Yggdrasil, including all versions of D&D and Pathfinder. You can even create new spells or reverse engineer existing magic, refining and improving your abilities over time.

Your magical gear and items are greatly enhanced, with your primary weapon reaching the level of a World Item. These artifacts bolster your already formidable powers, enabling you to break the very law of existence. 

Furthermore, you are immune to attacks below the equivalent of 10th-tier magic and impervious to the effects of those attempting to wield the power of artifacts like World Items against you. Your strikes now also possess the ability to bypass any protection, inflicting wounds that defy healing.

But your journey does not end here. As the World Enemy, you possess a unique ability to acquire additional Mythic Paths and raise their ranks effortlessly. By overcoming challenges and achieving great feats, you unlock new paths and further enhance your divine status.
objects.title: World Enemy

objects.text:
You've become truly beloved, as your allure to supernatural entities reaches unprecedented heights, transcending boundaries of morality and thought. Even entities with completely alien perspectives and moralities are drawn to you, their fascination with your presence surpassing any instinctual tendencies. They are inexplicably captivated by your charm, finding you endlessly intriguing and delightful.

These supernatural beings, whether gods, devils, or otherworldly creatures, view you not as prey or a mere mortal, but as a cherished companion or even beloved kin. Even from a single brief meeting, or just a passing sight, they will be compelled to extend their care and protection towards you, In fact, should anyone dare to threaten you, these supernatural beings may even come to your defense, angered by the audacity of such an act. They will protect you, their newfound fascination, against any who seek to harm you. Their love for you may be expressed in their own unique and unconventional ways, but it is genuine and heartfelt.

Moreover, time seems to warp and accelerate within your relationships, increasing the pace of connection and affection at an astounding rate. The bond that would typically take months to cultivate forms in mere weeks or even days. Passive interactions effortlessly forge deep connections, while actively pursuing a relationship allows you to compress years of courtship into a single week, defying the constraints of time for the sake of true love.

However, be warned that immersing yourself in the supernatural realm has granted you forbidden knowledge. Whether you become a cultist or not, you gain the ability to navigate their domains and craft rituals. But delving into these forbidden realms may pose a risk to your sanity, as the line between madness and enlightenment becomes blurred. Yet, the rewards granted by a god may make the perilous journey worthwhile.
objects.title: Fortunate Circumstance?

objects.text:
You have undergone a second Awakening and have become one of the strongest classes of Hunters, gaining the title of an S-Rank Hunter. The mana that is running through your body has been enhanced to levels beyond what the ordinary human body would be capable of handling, and your body has now adapted to your new level of mana. Sites dedicated to measuring and storing mana would be unable to comprehend the level of mana you now have.

Your body has evolved, growing significantly stronger, enhancing your physical capabilities so that you could destroy cities with concentrated effort. Your previous ability has undergone a radical change, no longer having limits to its growth. For example, if you happened to be a mage-type hunter who could throw fireballs, now you could throw them endlessly without feeling any drain on your reserves, and the damage that they would cause would be staggering, easily leveling buildings.
objects.title: S-Rank Hunter (Solo Leveling)

objects.text:
You are no mere Awakened human, for you are what is known as a Ruler—a being created by the Absolute Being from the primordial light that existed before anything else. You hold within yourself a Fragment of Luminosity; ordinarily, you would be one of the strongest beings in existence but the endless war between Light and Darkness has left you weakened, and now you inhabit the guise of a human. Your current level of power would make you around a National Level Hunter in regards to strength.

You have also gained two new abilities from your ascension to the role of Ruler. The first of which is called Ruler's Authority—a unique form of telekinesis that scales directly to the amount of mana you possess. This ability at its height could even affect Monarch-level fighters and despite scaling to the mana of the user, it does not cost any mana to use and can be used over a large radius.

The second would be the creation of gates—bridges between the human world and beyond the cracks of the universe. Through this power, you could not only awaken other people to become Hunters but you could travel the multiverse or even explore realms known as Dungeons that are inhabited by magical beasts—a good source of materials or rare items that happen to be in the dungeons.

You have also acquired Spiritual Body Manifestation, the ability to transform your body into its true form, enveloping yourself in an aura depending on your affiliation and your ability. Your physical appearance will change to reflect your identity and unique abilities, granting enhanced combat capabilities and exuding power in the form of a suppressing aura that can crush nearby opponents. As your abilities are new, your ability to manifest this form is limited and will develop as you unlock your full potential.
objects.title: Ruler (Solo Leveling)

addons.text:
You have both a Fragment of light and a Fragment of darkness. Beings of creation and destruction, respectively, similar to how the Absolute being created Ashborn, you have also been given both fragments of the primordial universe.

You would be equal to that of an absolute being; however, it starts small as you get used to your new power. You no longer need to explore the universe to find alternate dimensions, as you can create them yourself.

This allows you to create realms akin to dungeons, equal in size to the mana you can currently release. Initially, you would only be able to create a small dungeon, but with time, you could create true, wondrous dimensions. 

You are also no longer limited by your original Monarch or Ruler abilities as you can now create minions that are outside your sphere of influence, so even if for example you happened to be the Plague monarch you can now create minions outside of insect monsters.

Your existing minions are also stronger than they were before and can grow faster than if you only had the abilities of a monarch. It will take time but with time you will be able to create things similar to how the Absolute being was able to create things you could even create monarchs, rulers or even things such as the system that Sung Jin-woo possessed.
addons.title: Fledgling Itarim

objects.text:
You have acquired the power of a monarch, either through lineage or by obtaining its authority. You are no longer merely an awakened hunter; you are now imbued with one of the eight fragments of Darkness, given form by the will of the Absolute Being—a being of destruction. Ordinarily, you would rank among the strongest entities in existence, but the endless war between Light and Darkness has left you debilitated, and you now inhabit the guise of a human; your current level of power positions you at approximately the national tier of hunters in terms of strength.

The abilities you would acquire as a monarch are currently constrained by the fact that your body has not yet adapted to the powers of a monarch. Once your body has properly evolved, you will gain access to the powers of one of the eight established monarchs: the Monarch of Destruction, the Monarch of White Flames, the Monarch of Fangs, the Monarch of Frost, the Monarch of the Iron Body, the Monarch of the Beginning, the Monarch of Plagues, or the Monarch of Transfiguration. Alternatively, you may choose to become a completely new monarch.

As a monarch, you would gain control over the monsters within your domain. For example, the monarch of white flames could create and command demons, while the monarch of plagues could exert control over insects. Additionally, you possess the ability to create gates or bridges between the human world and the hidden realms beyond the universe. This power would not only allow you to awaken others to become hunters, but it would also enable you to traverse the multiverse and explore realms known as dungeons, which are inhabited by magical beasts. These dungeons can serve as valuable sources of materials and rare items. 

You have also acquired Spiritual Body Manifestation, the ability to transform your body into its true form, enveloping yourself in an aura depending on your affiliation and your ability. Your physical appearance will change to reflect your identity and unique abilities, granting enhanced combat capabilities and exuding power in the form of a suppressing aura that can crush nearby opponents. As your abilities are new, your ability to manifest this form is limited and will develop as you unlock your full potential.
objects.title: Monarch Descendant (Solo Leveling)

addons.text:
As a result of attaining power equal to his creator, you have become an existence beyond even Lord Death, the True God of the New World.

As a result, all the powers granted to you as the Master of Adolla are now products of your own immensely powerful Soul Wavelength, with Adolla merely being a spiritual Realm within you rather than the source of your powers. Bestowing anyone with a link to Adolla creates a soul bond between you, which allows you to increase the potency of your own Soul Wavelength in proportion to the strength of their connection to Adolla.

Additionally, you gain the potential to learn and improve upon any of the powers present in the Soul Eater canon. This gives you the potential to recreate and learn any kind of magic, from Medusa’s Vector Magic, to Eibon’s Demon Tool Creation, to Blair’s Pumpkin Magic. Likewise, you gain similarly increased potential for all soul-derived techniques, such as Meister Arts like Witch-Hunt, Reaper Powers like Death Claw, or even the magic-like abilities of the Death Scythes.

With time and effort, you could even learn to replicate other kinds of Soul-Wavelengths, such as the Anti-Demon Wavelength that repels madness, or even the Madness Wavelengths possessed by the other Great Old Ones, granting you access to all their unique qualities and abilities.
addons.title: True Great Old One

objects.text:
Your Maddening Witchery now reaches beyond the boundaries of mere shapeshifting. Allowing you to ascend and become the embodiment of a Great Old One's, the living embodiment of an Aspect of Madness. A mesmerizing Madness Wavelength emanates from your very being, allowing you to influence an entire country to succumb to the allure of your particular brand of madness. As a Great Old One, your soul is imbued with immense power, and your magical and physical abilities ascend to unparalleled heights, making you a formidable force capable of challenging the entire world.

Furthermore, the gift of the Demon Eye grants you access to the magic of Mabaa, the Queen of the Witch Order. Through your left eye, you can instantly cast a vast array of magical spell or rituals without the need for preparation. However, this gift comes with the limitation of finite energy, necessitating a charging period before unleashing your potent spellcasting abilities once more.
objects.title: Great Madness (Soul Eater)

addons.text: Your nine souls and nine tails have synchronized and bound together, enhancing each other’s potential: Any souls you lose to premature deaths in the future will now regenerate along your nine tails, which now start fully-formed alongside your spiritual status. Aside from the basis of having a full eighteen regenerating lives, this is further bolstered by your tails and souls also benefitting from a highly increased growth rate, courtesy of your combined cat-witch nature.
addons.title: Soulful

objects.text:
Well, this is quite interesting: You’re no Witch, you’re a cat! Specifically, a Monster Cat, a rare breed of intelligent feline gifted with the ability to assume human form, and the ability to use magic just like Witches. Unlike them, however, you completely lack the same destructive instinct - the ‘Pull of Magic’ - thus your allowing your newfound enhanced willpower to be freed up and used on more important matters.

As a Monster Cat, your magic is instead themed around some kind of flora, such as pumpkins or roses, and you may freely shift between human and cat forms as you please - though you do retain your ears and tail in human form. Your most important ability, however, is urban legends - not only do you really have nine lives, but you even have nine entire souls to boot, each entirely your own, with all that entails.
objects.title: Monster Cat (Soul Eater)

addons.text:
You have transcended the bounds of Mythos and become something far greater. You now wield the full power of the Ultima collective—the progenitor of the Eikons. This grants you complete access to the abilities and manifestations of the original eight Eikons, including their Egi. You can also assume the powerful forms of Ultima Prime, Ifrit Risen, and Ultima Risen at will. In addition, you have unlocked the elusive ninth element of magic: the typeless element, enabling you to cast spells such as Flare, Dominion, Proselytize, Holy, and Meteor.

Yet, your true strength lies in what sets you apart from the Ultima collective. As the Samusara, you have evolved beyond the need for external Aether. Your body naturally generates Aether in abundance, effortlessly sustaining even the most demanding spells—rewriting an entire world with Ultima’s Raise spell is mere child’s play.

This self-generated Aether not only fuels your magic but revitalizes the environment around you as it’s used, effectively rendering you and your chosen world immune to the devastation of the Blight. While your Aether is safe for others, you can willingly induce the Akashic state—or even the Blight—should you choose. You can also use your Aether to rapidly heal your own wounds, much like an Eikon restoring itself in battle.
addons.title: Beyond Logos

objects.text: You are the Mythos, a being beyond even the dominant that was intended to be the perfect vessel for Ultima. you and your Eikon have not just the power to command a single element but instead all of them, you are much stronger than the average dominant. You are no longer bound by the weakness of other Dominant and may use the power as you please without any side effect.
objects.title: Mythos (Final Fantasy XVI)

addons.text: Your Summons of the Astrals can now be made permanent additions to the world you inhabit at zero cost to you or any power slots. Just keep in mind that the average Astral is much bigger and stranger than your average Endbringer.
addons.title: Absolute Summons

addons.text:
Ardyn Lucis Caelum was to be the first Lucian King before he was betrayed by his brother and the Astrals. You now possess the ability of the man who should have been, the True Chosen Lucian King. 

Not only does this give you all the abilities of the Ardyn Lucis Caelum and the King of Kings (Noctis Lucis Caelum) but it also increases the ability of your Kingsguard and Kingsglaive. Now your Kingsglaive are as strong as a normal Kingsguard and your Kingsguard are now monsters capable of countering the likes of Alexandria or Legend. Furthermore, it not only boosts your your magical and physical abilities but removes all weaknesses you had to holy and purifying energy, thus making soul destroying attacks the only way to permanently kill you.
addons.title: The True King of Kings

objects.text:
The crystal from beyond has recognized you not just as its king but as the True Ruler of its lineage. As a result, the strength of you and Kingsguard has massively increased. The magical and physical abilities of your Kingsguard now makes them capable of fighting entire armies of normal individuals by themselves. They can sprint at speeds comparable to a car, lift tanks, and cast fireballs big enough to light entire city blocks ablaze. You, however, are so much more. Not only are you now capable of using 13 teleporting weapons known as your royal arms, but you can now fight with abilities to outclass all of your Kingsguard combined. Furthermore, you are also given 3 additional abilities that would only be possible to other Kings at the cost of their lives (or an extreme external magic source). However, for you these abilities are merely exhausting and can be trained over time to be mere annoyances, so much so that with training, it is possible to use all three abilities at once.
  • The Wall: a barrier cast over a whole city that can repel any being you do not wish to enter and can withstand assaults from even a nuclear explosion. Kingsguard, Kingsglaive, and Summons are boosted inside any city protect by a Wall.
  • The Summons: a projection of an Astral’s might onto the physical plane, a might capable of wiping out an entire city. Without Armiger you can summon only a single Summon at once, with it you can Summon all 6 Astrals at the same time.
  • The Armiger: a “limit break” super state that greatly boosts the abilities of the chosen King. Not only will you be able to access all 13 royal arms at once, but can fly, short range teleport to non-royal arm locations, and casts powerful spells on the scale of city killers. But the most important aspect is its ability to boost the power of your Wall and Summons. With all three abilities combined you could even temporarily surpass even an Endbringer with just your Summons and yourself.
The last addition to your arsenal is the Ring of the Lucii which can summon all consuming magical Black Holes at the cost of one’s life force (Alterna). It can also be used to strike out in perfect harmony against beings of light (Death) or beings of darkness (Holy)
objects.title: King of Kings (Final Fantasy XV)

objects.text:
You have become the warrior of light. A hero without equal, bearer of countless accolades, and the symbol of salvation and hope for the people of Etheiryst.

You have a knack for arriving when you are needed and meeting and befriending those who can help you solve the problem at hand. You have an indomitable will and an inspiring presence making those who have seen your action or heard your tale emboldened and strived to be the best they can be.

As a warrior your might in both martial and magical is tremendous, Capable of overcoming gods and demons. growing stronger with each and every trial you face.

Your fighting experience has been honed over the course of countless battles letting you adapt to your opponent's ability and tactic after seeing it once or twice, your echo combat precognition is so refined you can see an attack coming before your opponent can even decide what to do.
Even outside of combat, you are an Omnicrafter with phenomenal artisanal skill crafting masterpieces come naturally to you as breathing.

You have complete and total mastery of each and every job even the crafter and gatherer one. You also have access to a powerful set of relic weapons and armor which you can customize the look of as you please and can switch between equipment set at will mid-fight or no. You can also choose whether you inherited all the memory of the warrior of light or not.
objects.title: The Warrior of Light (Final Fantasy XIV)

objects.text:
Whether you were spared the fate of being sundered or have been rejoined later on you have become an Unsundered ancient of Etheirys. 

You have gained complete mastery of the echo and all of its power, the potency of the power itself is greatly increased. 

You are practically immortal, you do not age past your prime. Even when your body is completely destroyed you can simply fashion a new one. It would take the complete destruction of your soul to completely kill you but even then it would be difficult requiring a tremendous amount of magical power to destroy it.

Your personal reserve of magical power is immense and it is 14 times denser than before giving any magic you wield increased potency. You can also transform into a combat form the look of which you can customize.

This Aetherial density also allows you the ability to use creation magic which allows you to conjure and create anything you can think of and imagine as long as you know have enough magical power to create it, this even includes creating life itself. Thought creation magic takes great concentration to use and it is not an art that is commonly used in combat
objects.title: The Unsundered (Final Fantasy XIV)

objects.text:
As a Fal'Cie, you are a crystalline machine god created for a specfic purpose.

Your purpose might be to control an artificial sun to nurture the world, this would give you power over fire and light for example, or any other purpose you can imagine. You can also choose to take on a humanoid form like that of a species that inhabits the world you are on.

You are no longer bound by any higher entity, but instead, control and create I'Cie that use your power and magic to fulfill your will. With time you may grow beyond your purpose and approach the might of the Makers.

You have the power to manipulate the world around, alter the environment, touch time, and control vast magical forces, bending them to your will to suit your needs. Your body is a manifestation of pure magic and technology, granting you nearly limitless endurance, strength, and resistance.

With this newfound power, you can now create and assign focuses to others, transforming them into I'Cie under your command. You decide their mission and grant them the power to carry it out. Their growth and success directly enhance your own abilities, as their focus completion fuels your strength. 

You can change their focus at will, adjusting it to your desires, and guide them through challenges that strengthen both their powers and yours. Their fate is in your hands, and the harder the mission, the more you gain in power.
 
Additionally, your crystalline form evolves. You can now encase others in a stasis crystal, suspending them in time until they are needed. 
 
This crystal is an extension of your will, and you can maintain complete control over those within it, using the time inside to meditate, recuperate, or even train them without interference. 

When your I'Cie are inside the crystal, you can communicate with them directly, altering their focus or assisting them in their progress. As a Fal'Cie, the power to shape fate is no longer limited to yourself. You can amplify your abilities through the struggles of your I'Cie.

As they grow stronger in pursuit of their focuses, you gain new abilities and deeper control over the world around you. The more I'Cie you oversee, the more you can bend the world to your will.
objects.title: Fal'Ice (Final Fantasy XIII)

objects.text:
You have ascended beyond the limits of Fal'Cie, becoming an entity of immense power known as a Maker. As a Maker, you now command the very forces of creation, capable of shaping and destroying worlds with ease. Time, space, and the laws of nature no longer constrain you—they are tools at your disposal, allowing you to manipulate the fabric of reality itself.

In this exalted state, you gain the ability to craft worlds from nothing, guiding their evolution and determining their fates. You can create worlds, set the course of their histories, and influence their development. The civilizations within them grow or crumble according to your will, and the passage of time flows as you direct. The very structure of existence is malleable in your hands, and you can bend it to suit your divine vision.

Furthermore, you can create and empower Fal'Cie to act as the overseers of your creations. These divine beings will govern the worlds you’ve shaped, ensuring that your designs are carried out. They will regulate the flow of time, maintain order, and guide the fates of civilizations, all while ensuring that your will is upheld. Their power is an extension of yours, and they act as the living embodiment of your control over reality.

With this newfound power, you are no longer just a creator but a true force of the cosmos. Your influence spans not just the physical, but the very destinies of entire worlds. Whether you wish to see a civilization flourish or collapse, whether you want to rewrite the course of history or leave it in ruin, the choice is yours.

In time you might even be able to approach the exalted power of Bhunivelze. A being capable of fashioning whole universes from nothing.
objects.title: Maker (Final Fantasy XIII)

addons.text:
Through your own natural summoner abilities fusing with your other summoner ability, it has greatly enhanced your powers in calling forth Servants from the Throne of Heroes. Your status as a summoner has made your mana extremely efficient with handling the upkeep of Servants. Because of this, instead of one Servant, you're able to immediately summon two of them. Your Servants are treated as if they're Aeons, meaning they gain an enhancement to their stats, raising every single one by at least one rank, if not more, depending upon your own personal power. Over time, as you grow stronger and grow your magical stores, you will be able to summon more Servants.

To keep your Servants loyal, your gain an extra set of Command Spells for every new summon and each one used will regenerate after 24 hours. As your Servants are treated more akin to Aeons, should one die, they will instead disappear like an Aeon would and be able to summoned again from you after a 10-minute period. Though, you could also allow them to truly die and return to the Throne of Heroes if you wish to summon someone different and able to properly do their duty in protecting you.

All Servants can become your Guardians if you allow them, giving them the option to further grow in power. As an added bonus, all Servants either gain an Overdrive or have their Noble Phantasm enhanced by the bonus of an Overdrive.
addons.title: Summoner²

addons.text:
You have become a weird amalgamation of both a dominant and a summoner. The first benefit is that you gained all the known Eikons as alternate forms to prime or semi-prime into. The second is that all Aeons are now considered akin to Eikons, allowing you to partially or fully transform into them. And finally, all Eikons are able to be summoned as if they were Aeons with their full powers to bare upon your enemies.

In both situations. they're all still benefiting from the enhancement boost to their stats as if they were just summoned as Aeons.
addons.title: It's Primin' Time!

addons.text:
Your Inner Beast has become something akin to your own personal Fayth. This transformation has greatly enhanced your abilities as a summoner, making your potential surpass Lady Yunalesca and even Yu Yevon. All your Aeons have doubled in power, as your Inner Beast allows each of them to scale based on its own attributes as well. If you were to ever die. you would come back as an unsent which is a lingering spirit; if you or your Inner Beast know a resurrection spell, they can bring you back to life completely.

Empowered by your Inner Beast, your spells are now supercharged: a single Cure spell could regenerate limbs instantly, and more intensive spells cost only half as much, as your Inner Beast shoulders part of the cost. Your growth has accelerated to the point where, within a week, you could summon and expertly command all your Aeons. Additionally, with your own Fayth, you now have the ability to create new Aeons based on concepts and ideas. This process requires focus and alignment with specific archetypes—such as healing, fire, and avian qualities to form a Phoenix Aeon.

Moreover, your Inner Beast serves as both a Guardian and an Aeon, creating a synergy that, over time, could rival and even surpass the Final Aeon meant to defeat Sin—and eventually even Sin itself.
addons.title: High Summoner

objects.text:
You possess the powers and physiology of a summoner from the world of Spira. As a summoner, your magical reserves have expanded tremendously, and your talent for learning healing, support, and holy spells has grown, tripling your progress in mastering them. You possess a special type of ritualistic dance called Sending, which allows you to send the souls of the dead to the afterlife.

Your magic also allows you to imbue weapons and armor with "Auto-Abilities," which can range from magical and physical enhancements to automatic or continuous versions of spells you know. This starts at a low level but will increase as you train. Items have one to four slots for Auto-Abilities, depending on their quality and size.

Your titular ability is to summon Aeons. Aeons are linked to your magical strength, immune to most status effects, and able to reappear shortly after defeat. You start with Valefor, but over time, you can learn to summon all the other known Aeons. You can gain new Aeons through contracts with powerful beings, gaining some of their power and creating Aeons in their image. Your Aeons are sustained by your own power, ensuring they can never be lost. You may also choose whether they have individual wills of their own.

To aid in your journey, you can appoint others as Guardians, allowing them to gain magic and physical boosts from training as you do. However, only you possess summoner-specific abilities and the power to imbue items. Guardians lose these benefits if they are released from your service or if they betray you.

If ever required, you, your guardians, and Aeons all have a trump card called Overdrive. Overdrive charges over the course of combat, delivering a powerful attack or spell based on your own abilities, with at least ten times the strength of your standard techniques. All of you can unlock more over time.

With diligent training, it would take you at most two months to reach the same level Yuna was at when she defeated Sin.
objects.title: Summoner (Final Fantasy X)

objects.text: You can create new spells with ease, to have reached the level of Archmage is to make an impact on the future of Magic. You are able to pick or design a branch of magic to excel in. You will be able to recreate any magic made using your branch of magic upon witnessing it.
