You no longer have a cooldown between the creation of most spells, the strongest spells will still require time between each trial but it is negligible. Every once in a while you are guaranteed to have a bout of Insight that will never leave you disappointed, this Insight could be something as small as a spell that would connect well with your current repertoire or something grand, a sliver of truth of the fundamental rules of Magic. The bonuses feat previously provided that increased the amount of mana produced by you have been improved dramatically, allowing for even multiplicative boosts in the future. Creating entirely new branches of magic could give you a multiplier based on how important the new branch will be for the future of magic.
objects.title: Archmage (Ar'Kendrithyst)

objects.text: You have undergone more than just a physical change to become a Dragon, you have modified your very identity in order to enact this immortal evolution. You are able to meld into your Dragon form at any time, this quadrupedal form is roughly 40 meters long and 25 meters tall. All magic cast by you has twice the duration and range it normally would have. All Dragons are born with an absolute reduction damage threshold, invalidating all forms of attack that cannot manage to break through this resistance and further reducing all damage that breaches your defenses. These benefits will remain even in your human form. Your Dragon form will instinctually represent you, requiring no conscious thought to design it.
objects.title: Dragon (Ar'Kendrithyst)

objects.text:
Wizards are multidimensional beings that are able to overlay their own personal reality onto the reality around them. Every Wizard is aligned with one of three aspects, Creation, Destruction, and Paradox. Being a Wizard means that your capacity for mana production is unlimited, and is entirely dependent on your experiences. Some parts of Creation are simply antithetical to Destruction, like white and black don’t mix without producing gray. Paradox, which does both, will never fully understand the white and the black. An average Wizard of Creation in the height of their power could have an infinite and endless amount of magic in their core, allowing them to create entire worlds at a whim. A Wizard of Destruction could wipe away entire planets, or even destroy concepts. A Paradox Wizard could create a new form of magic that turns out to have existed from the very start of time, time travel with enough experience, and even survive death.

At the start, you will find yourself capable of Accretion starting at the First Foundation. At the end of this path lies the first true act of Wizardry, making mana and yourself at the same time. All Wizards must become a fully crystallized-mana being, granting them metaphysical weight while still maintaining a fleshy body. This is what it means to reach the Endless Foundation stage. Until then Directed Accretion will have to suffice. Directed Accretion is the process of siphoning personal mana towards parts of your spirit and body, be it in a general or detailed capacity. Even upon reaching Endless Foundation you will retain The Script. 

<center>Accretion Stages
First Foundation: gain a shard of a core.

Second Foundation: gain a solid core.

Third Foundation: gain a second core.

Fourth Foundation: gain an arbitrary number of cores.

Fifth Foundation / Endless Foundation: Crystallization, simultaneous absorbing of all cores, simultaneous body manifestation. True immortality and immutability.</center>
objects.title: Wizard (Ar'Kendrithyst)

objects.text: You are a vastly more powerful Skinchanger now. You can control animals without needing to spend time with them and can dominate humans and animals easily. You can view the past, present and future with great precision once you train yourself.
objects.title: Greenseer (A Song of Ice and Fire)

objects.text: You have become the Prime Meridian the successor of Merlin. Your powers are greatly increased to the point of no longer needing a focus to use magic. In addition, you gain a far greater talent for learning and using this kind of magic.
objects.title: Prime Merlinean (Sorcerer's Apprentice)

addons.text: Your nature as a Werewolf and the newfound animalistic side of your lunar abilities have combined and empowered each other: Your Werewolf side now benefits from all the abilities of your rabbit transformation in an altered form, instead gaining sheer strength and swapping to more offense-oriented powersets in exchange for the sacrificed durability, an increase in your regeneration speed due to synergy between it and your healing ability, and lastly having its weakness to silver and divine weapons greatly lessened - or even turned into enhancement at greater levels of power, such as the rank of Elder or Loup-Garou. Conversely, your now-Wererabbit form has been enhanced with all the traits of your Werewolf form - both old and new - plus any upgrades that you’ve taken, and can even be inherited alongside your Werewolf half if you choose to pass on your ‘curse’.
addons.title: Rabbit and Wolf

objects.text:
Your new lunar form has been even further blessed, granting you two additional abilities to use as you see fit: Your first new power is healing: You can radiate a pale light on your surroundings that phases through mundane materials, healing wounds or illnesses and soothing pain for all exposed. While this regeneration is incredibly strong, capable of undoing nearly any injury short of death, it is slow, taking hours to restore missing limbs and organs or cure terminal illnesses. While radiating this light at full strength requires at least some focus, you can still harness it passively at greatly reduced strength even when asleep or incapacitated - and you are not exempt from its healing, allowing you to benefit as well.

Your other new power is transformation: At will, you can shift into the form of a bipedal, snow-white rabbit-person, and with it gain further power; while transformed, you shed anywhere from half to nearly all of your durability to gain a proportionately massive increase in both speed, reflexes and senses, and alongside that your magic’s powersets are enhanced noticeably, both in quality and quantity.
objects.title: Usagihime

objects.text:
You now possess a heightened connection to the Void, allowing you to access it at will. This newfound connection enables you to turn your prison realm into a personal enclave within the Void, which you can designate as your Domain. You can extend invitations to others, allowing them to seek refuge within your Domain. However, this invitation comes with a protective blessing that shields them from the adverse effects of the Void. The Domain will be the size of a small city.

Within the confines of the Void, you are impervious to hostile entities that may venture into it as they succumb to the Void's effects and are erased. Nevertheless, the Void remains neutral and does not actively ensure your survival. You'll need protection or immortality to ensure you're safe.

Constant vigilance is essential for safeguarding your Domain, as it faces ongoing threats from the natural monsters dwelling within the Void.
Furthermore, your newfound ability to traverse the Void enables you to journey through it effortlessly, granting you access to any world near you within the multiverse you are currently in; note this does not give you full access to the multiverse, just a few worlds. All your Magic and Spells will be significantly enhanced.
objects.title: Entry To The Void

objects.text:
Your connection to the Void has ascended to its pinnacle. No longer just a mere Witch, you have transcended into a Child of the Void itself. The Void now pledges its unwavering support, ready to assist you whenever needed.

Your dominion has transformed into a regal Kingdom, a haven for the abandoned, forgotten, and exiled. These residents have undergone a metamorphosis, evolving into a unique race known as the Voidlings.
Your capacity for traversing realms has been enhanced, allowing you to journey to any corner of the multiverse you are currently in; with time, effort, and training, you will eventually be able to use the void to travel through the Omniverse.

Your soul has merged with the essence of the Void, embodying entropy and death. As a result, the specter of mortality eludes you, making it so that even if you somehow die, you will reform inside your domain.

Finally, when traveling outside your Domain or the void, most of your power will be sealed away because your full aura and presence warps reality; you can unseal your power for a short time if needed. Your Spells, specifically your Void blast, will now erase anything conceptually; any spell you can cast may be enhanced by concepts.
objects.title: Child Of The Void

objects.text:
You are now an exemplar of the Warrior class, as well as the martial classes in general.

While your might & skill easily equals that of Stark or Eisen, you may call on the abilities of any martial class user, such as those of Himmel the Hero, Archers like Wahrheit or Wolf, Monks like Kraft, the fighting skill of Übel (divorced from her visualization of course), and many like them.
objects.title: Strong As Iron (Sousou no Frieren)

addons.text: You have an easier time to read people, to understand them and what makes them tick. When you truly grasp someone's inner workings—their thoughts, feelings, and beliefs—you can mimic them, replicating their skills and/or magic. But mere understanding won't suffice. When you employ these copied skills, you'll subtly transform, adopting aspects of the person you've studied. Using the skills of someone cruel and indifferent will temporarily make you resemble them, in mannerism and personality, same if you use the skills of someone kind.
addons.title: Empathy

objects.text: Some might say you are insane, capable of detaching your minds visualisation from intelligence and common sense. To you, it doesn’t matter what magic might be imbued into a cloak, no matter how strong its defensive magic is, it’s a cloak and thus it can be cut. This applies to anything, wood is to be burned, earth is to be shattered. Your visualisation allows you to ignore the common sense of magic and supplement it with your own distorted view.
objects.title: Visualisation Mage (Sousou no Frieren)

objects.text:
Your magic capacity, skill, and general knowledge of spells has increased even further. You stand the peer of the Great Mage Frieren, one of the heroes who defeated the demon king. 

You have an enormous mana capacity, and the skill to hide and suppress it constantly. You know a large amount of spells, however most of them consist of spells geared towards combat or general quality of life spells. 

You can optionally have the extremely long lifespan of an Elf, a humanoid creature with a vast natural lifespan, easily lasting thousands of years. You won’t have the natural Elven issue of the inability to express your emotions easily.
objects.title: The Slayer (Sousou no Frieren)

objects.text: Your knowledge in magic is increased dramatically, to the level of Serie, the leader and Great Mage of the Continental Magic Association. You are essentially a living grimoire, someone who has learned almost every spell known to humanity, even spells long lost to the mythical age. Your mana capacity is increased even further, even greater than that of before. Your breadth of skill in magic and mana concealment is boosted further too, putting you as one of the greatest mages to have lived.
objects.title: Great Mage (Sousou no Frieren)

addons.text:
You now begin with far more powerful divine magic, leaving you capable of restoring lost limbs and dispelling curses equal to those cast by the Seven Sages of Destruction. Additionally, your base fighting strength with your divine magic is raised to the level of a first-class mage.

You have the potential to match Great Demons in single combat, while exclusively using your divine magic.
addons.title: Apostle of the Goddess

addons.text:
You’re now capable of truly divine feats with your Magic of the Goddess.

Raising the recently dead, teleportation, nigh-impenetrable barriers, and devastating offensive magic are all within your command from the very start.

With time, you could even reach the incredible heights of the Goddess herself, who was able to create a magic item capable of time-travel, that remained functional for eons without any sign of degradation.

Additionally, the Magic of the Goddess is now truly your own; as such, you can use it like any other, meaning you no longer require a copy of the scripture to cast your divine magic and fully understand its workings.
addons.title: Second-Coming of the Goddess

objects.text:
You possess the innate talent known as “The Blessing of the Goddess”, providing you a powerful resistance to curses and the potential to cast high-level divine magic, so long as you hold your scripture.

Such divine magic, otherwise known as the Magic of the Goddess, contains a great deal of healing, defensive, and support spells, in addition to a smaller number of offensive spells. This magic is capable of feats beyond humanity’s magic system, diagnosing and combating illnesses, injuries, and even curses; though it's characteristically inflexible as a result of running on largely unknown principles.

You have potential in this field equal to Hieter, and start with a copy of the scripture that you can summon just like you do your staff. However, you will initially only be capable of healing minor injuries and illnesses, and fighting with your divine magic at the level of an average third class mage. Sufficient study of your scripture and mana control practice will propel you to greater heights.
objects.title: Priest of the Goddess (Sousou no Frieren)

objects.text:
The Golden Divine Vessel. The absolute defense. The Holy Grail.

Yours is a body with the capacity to store an unlimited number of souls, powerful enough to act as a Holy Relic itself. It boasts an ultimate defense akin to an impenetrable fortress unlike any other.

Your own physical endurance is now simply unbelievable. In fact, it is now to the point that blows that could shatter planets would leave mere scratches.

Furthermore, your body is also layered with protective enchantments guarding against all sorts of phenomena. With anti-physical, anti-magical, anti-temporal, and anti-accident attributes, your already robust defense rises to a new height. To even reach this Grail, one must first penetrate this barrier.

The only things that could damage your body would be an absurd strength that surpasses your protections—a ridiculous idea—or, more plausibly, conceptual attacks, like a blow capable of felling anything in a single strike.

Do know that while your body can contain an infinite number of souls, should you take in more than two million, your own soul will begin to shatter, unable to support the weight it now carries.
objects.title: Heilige Eohl (Shinza Bansho)

addons.text:
Your soul is not static but ever-growing. With every passing day, the quality and strength of your soul doubles, and should you ever find yourself in battle or mortal danger, the rate of growth accelerates tremendously.

This allows you to not only power all your abilities by yourself, never consuming another soul, but also guarantees that with nothing but the passing of time, you will reach and master every stage of the Die Ewigkeit formula, eventually ascending to the Atziluth Stage without the need for a ritual or any external help.

The power of every stage of Ewigkeit is also amplified by an order of magnitude, unlocking new abilities and strengthening existing ones. But the most profound change becomes apparent once you reach the final stage.

No matter the type of godhood you attain, you gain an invincible Gudou core which constantly pushes your soul to higher levels. Your Taikyouku value becomes truly immeasurable and ever-growing, allowing you to transcend even other Hadou and Gudou gods without effort. And unlike one other soul that possessed the same ability, this does not come from an outside source of irritation but from your inherent desire to continuously become stronger, removing any weaknesses your enemies might exploit.
addons.title: Tumor (Shinza Bansho)

objects.text:
You possess a soul of extremely high quality. Even by itself, when merged with your relic, it can power it for centuries before you feel any kind of strain and grants you the same bonuses as thousands of lesser souls. Nigh-invincible, your soul can handle the weight of any number of lesser souls. But, as your body is still mortal, you are still limited to a few million at most before your body starts to crumble.

But the most important gift this bestows upon you is the ability to unlock the final stage of the Die Ewigkeit formula. A right determined the moment a soul is born, a gift almost unreachable by other means.

Atziluth, also called Emanation, is the fourth and final stage. In the distant past, in languages of forgotten Heavens, it was called Big Bang, then Rapture; now it is called Atziluth. The Supreme Origin: those who reach this level are transcendent in relation to any form of existence, any form of information, any form of duality, and any form of space-time, regardless of its complexity or its size; for all concepts in the world are born from the laws spun of this Emanation, and it predates, and is transcendent of, all such ideas and concepts.

Taikyoku, another name for Atziluth, originating from the most cruel of Heavens, and also a term for measuring the strength of those who reach this level, Gods. While transcendent of and unaffected by anything in existence, another god can affect a god with an equal or lower Taikyoku value. This value is determined at birth, and although it can rise after you reach the emanation stage, as you get more experienced, and your emanation takes its final form, it will inevitably settle at a final value, barring some extreme exceptions, such as the ability to strengthen your soul and craving.

The separation between Hadou and Gudou still remains. Those who possess a predominantly hegemonic desire, after reaching Atziluth, will become what is known as Hadou God. At this point, the craving transforms into a universal law, covering everything in existence, every dimension and universe, no matter how small or how vast, forming a new Heaven with the newly born Hadou God as the Supreme Deity ruling over all of creation. Be careful, though, as the Law under which the world will be reformed is supreme, and even you will struggle if ever you would wish to change it.

Those who possess a predominantly Gudou desire will find their law expanding inwards, transforming them into a walking universe of their own, a Transcendence God. Gudou gods transcend all things, even the Law of the reigning Hegemony. For example, the Law that fills the souls of every being in existence with the highest degree of narcissism, forcing them to kill everything around them, will not affect the mind of the Gudou. The Hadou god will have to physically eliminate you, using their active abilities and control over existence. Although this transcendence imposes some limitations on the Gudou gods. Unlike the Hadou, who can freely shape reality, Gudou gods have to physically strike the target for their abilities to take effect.

Once you reach Atziluth, the ability born in the Briah stage expands to an unfathomable degree, becoming a conceptual law, completely transcending the limits of thoughts and logic. Not that you have reached this stage yet. If you possess a hegemonic-type craving, you will need to use an immense arcane ritual requiring millions of souls to ascend from the Briah Stage.

Transcendence Godhood, on the other hand, requires only the deepest understanding and acceptance of oneself to reach. It can be acquired immediately upon the death of the physical body, but this is a path most dangerous, as without a physical body to anchor you in the wider universe, your soul will be stuck in the empty universe of your own making, doomed to eternal loneliness unless you find a way out or someone else finds a way to reach and free you. An almost impossible task, given that the universe you form transcends, and thus is unreachable for, most other beings in existence.
objects.title: To The Omnipotent Throne Of All Creation (Shinza Bansho)

objects.text:
Your body has been infused with the blood of Mercurius, transforming you into a living Relic. While normally one could wield only one Relic, lest their soul burns out immediately from the strain, you are now perfectly compatible with and can safely wield any Relic you come across, with the exception of the most temperamental that choose their own master.

Since Mercurius is the god of magic and astrology, his blood grants you an extraordinary natural ability for all forms of magic, enabling you to master complex magical practices like the Ewigkeit Formula in just a few days, while others would need to spend years.

Additionally, the blood of a God is an immensely potent source of power. Eventually, you will learn to draw from it, allowing you to fight on par with beings powered by millions of lesser souls and even ascend to the Atziluth stage without requiring a ritual or consumption of souls.

Lastly, as a relic, you no longer hold any limit on how many souls you can hold without any strain on your body or soul.
objects.title: Zarathrustra Ubermensch (Shinza Bansho)

objects.text:
You have acquired all the knowledge, skills, and abilities of the Golden Beast himself that he had just before ascending to godhood.

You are now undisputedly the most charismatic being in existence. When you talk, even two armies in the middle of combat will stop and listen. With a brief speech, you can convince everyone who hears you to kill themselves and pledge their souls to your eternal service.

Your body, mind, and soul are now impervious to nearly all forms of damage; as you have transcended the laws of reality, only conceptual attacks from beings of comparable or greater strength have any chance of ever harming you. And your attacks subsequently ignore any and all forms of defence, be they magical, psychic, physical, or any other, attacking on all layers of existence at once, with you embodying the concept of destruction only those much stronger than you have any hope of defending against them.

The speed at which you can move and react is nearly immeasurable, with you being able to fight on equal terms with beings who can infinitely accelerate themselves, as well as infinitely slow down their opponents. And you regenerate any damage you take near instantly.

Your senses are now elevated to an insane degree as well. You possess vision strong enough to peer into the void of the cosmos and discern individual beings on distant planets and hearing so acute that their every word spoken can be as loud to you as if you were having a conversation face to face. You also possess numerous supernatural senses, such as an ability to sense souls on a large scale. And to effectively process all the information your senses are receiving, your mind now operates at a scale and speed that will put any supercomputer to shame.

The Longinus Lance Testament and Gladsheimr are now one, yet could be wielded separately, and both are a part of you, representing Yetzirah and Briah stages of your ascention.

The Holy Lance is now restored to full power. When it is thrown, it will always strike true, being constantly faster than its target, even in places where the concept of speed does not exist or if a target itself is beyond such concepts, will always reach its target, even through infinite distance or if there is no concept of thereof, and will always instantly destroy its target on all layers of existence, physical, mental, spiritual, informational, etc., completely erasing them from reality, preventing any form of resurrection. Should you so desire, anyone who even sees the spear itself will be instantly annihilated, their soul burnt to ashes, and should anyone touch the spear, they will be annihilated as thoroughly as if struck by it.

The Golden Castle is empowered as well; it will now strive to protect you as well as attack your opponents with all its might even without your conscious input. You still have absolute control over it, as well as awareness of everything happening within it. With but a thought you are able to rearrange both the interior and exterior spaces of the castle. No longer does it need to conform to any physical laws of spacetime, allowing you to create mind-shattering non-euclidian infrastructure, as well as control the flow of time within the castle, should you wish to. Additionally, any soul bound to your castle you can raise to your level of strength for as long as required, with all their powers and abilities amplified to be on the same conceptual and metaphysical level yours are at, as well as wield any and all of their powers by yourself. Any being you kill can be added to your castle, even if they were erased by your spear.

Lastly, you receive all the souls that ever belonged to the Golden Beast's Legion. This includes more than three million people, most of whom are soldiers from both sides of World War II, along with all their wargear such as tanks, planes, and even battleships, as well as those that were part of the Obsidian Round Table, with most of them possessing extraordinarily powerful abilities of their own. At your discretion they may believe you to be the Lord of Destruction himself, or know that you usurped his place, but regardless of that, their eternal loyalty lies only with you and you alone.
objects.title: Golden Beast (Shinza Bansho)

addons.text: Your nature as a True Vampire and your Craving synergise and elevate all your abilities to new heights. No longer are you just a vampire; instead, you are the conceptual idea of vampirism, blood, and impalement itself. Even without your relic activated, you can cause the spikes of your crystallised blood to appear anywhere within your line of sight, even inside other beings, as well as generally control your blood however you wish outside of your body. Your mere presence is now enough to drain the strength of nearby beings, and when you activate your Briah, its effects can now spread over hundreds of kilometers, instantly ripping out the souls of everyone inside its effective range. Your strength and regeneration have also been improved. Your physical form can now be reformed and reshaped at will without expending any of the souls, even after total obliteration, with only highly esoteric attacks against your soul having any chance of affecting you. Any soul you have consumed can now be summoned as your loyal familiar without any loss of strength, and any familiar killed will reform in time. When Der Rosenkavalier Schwarzwald is activated, every familiar becomes completely immortal while inside your crimson forest, reforming instantly from any damage, and have their physical capabilities amplified to the same level as yours. Lastly, your ability to create other vampires has also been improved beyond its theoretical limit. Due to the nature of Briah, you create your own concept of vampirism, rather than embody the existing one. As such, you can infect just about anything with your particular brand of vampirism, from living beings to even inanimate objects or artificial and immaterial constructs such as AI. If you infect inanimate objects, you may optionally grant them souls and consciousness. Any newly created vampires will have, if you so desire, an unbreakable loyalty towards you and may possess any of the abilities you decide to share with them, even the ability to create more vampires, with their offsprings inheriting the same loyalty towards you.
addons.title: King of Vampires

addons.text:
As your soul grows stronger, you awaken the echoes of another life.

You now possess the power to become night itself. At will, you can cloak yourself in the 'armour of darkness', which, contrary to its name, can take the form of any armour, clothing, or remain as an invisible protective barrier around you. This armour allows you to absorb powers, abilities, attacks, defences, life force, luck, etc., from your opponent when making physical contact, snatching away anything non-mundane. At will, you can share this armour with others.

This ability also enhances all stages of your Die Ewigkeit formula. Your Assiah stage now equals in power your previous Yetzirah, allowing you to create an almost endless amount of spikes of night and blood with the same absorption properties your armour possesses. 

In the Yetzirah stage, your spikes can effortlessly tear apart mountains and cleave oceans. Should you desire, anyone who makes contact with your armour will be instantly torn to shreds by manifesting millions of spikes inside them.

Lastly, in the Briah stage, you fully become the night. The effect of the armour now spreads over the whole area of the briah, with the area itself increasing by an order of magnitude. Your body, on the other hand, becomes completely intangible, just as the night itself; you cannot be hurt by physical, spiritual, mental, or other types of attacks, yet you are still perfectly capable of attacking everyone else.
addons.title: Tenma Kessenka (Shinza Bansho)

objects.text: You are the reincarnation of the Seat IV of the obsidian round table, the vampire of the battlefield, Wilhelm Ehrenburg himself, inheriting all his skills, abilities, Holy Relic, and even his Craving and soul. The holy relic you fused with, Qliphoth Bacikal, is the crystallised blood of Vlad Tepes III, the Dracula. It already has thousands of souls stored inside it, letting you shrug off nukes, move at hypersonic speed, regenerate lost limbs and organs, effortlessly catch bullets, and much more. After activating the Yetzirah stage of your relic, you can expel your crystallised blood in the form of spikes, either for close combat, firing them at your opponents at the rate of hundreds of spikes per second, aiding your mobility, and much more. But your true power lies in your mastery of the third stage. Der Rosenkavalier Schwarzwald is a hegemony-type briah, stemming from the dual craving "I want to become a vampire, invincible at night" and "I want the night to last forever". When activated, Der Rosenkavalier Schwarzwald transforms you into a vampire and changes your surroundings in a 500-meter radius into night, regardless of the actual time of day, complete with a fake moon in the sky; and if the actual full moon is present, all your abilities become much more potent. Inside your Bria's area of effect, you are capable of absorbing the strength and energy of everything and everyone. The absorbed energy is then transferred to you, massively amplifying your speed, strength, durability, and regeneration. You can either absorb the energy indiscriminately from everything inside your effective range or focus on specific targets only, massively enhancing the rate of absorption, as well as further weakening the targets, inhibiting their senses, physical capabilities, and supernatural abilities. Your Briah also enhances your Yetzirah abilities. Now, you can create spikes instantly in any number anywhere inside your area of effect. Everything struck by your spikes will have its strength absorbed at an exponentially faster rate, withering to dust in mere moments. Inside this forest of death, you are the apex predator; you can make yourself completely undetectable to any natural or supernatural senses, appear anywhere instantly, and are fully aware of everything happening inside the Briah's range. Lastly, all of your powers can be amplified even further. Inside your soul resides another, the soul of Wilhelm's sister, Helga Ehrenburg. She is the conscious manifestation of your Briah, capable of activating it as well to protect you. When both your souls act in unison, the power of Der Rosenkavalier Schwarzwald is amplified to an absurd degree. The entire area changes into a forest of roses and thorns made of blood, constantly shifting to devour your opponents, making it so staying in a single spot for more than a moment becomes impossible, as well as cutting off every escape route. In this state, your regeneration reaches such a level that you can instantly heal from the most grievous injuries. Even attacks from other relics that would mutilate your mind, body, and soul will be shrugged off, letting you fight as if you were never injured at all.
objects.title: Kaziklu Bey (Shinza Bansho)

addons.text:
A relic of an era long gone, the ability originating from the unrealised world of eternal war. This is the burgeoning power to govern the concept of motion. Due to the heightened potential of your soul, every stage of the ewigkeit process has been drastically enhanced.

In the Assiah stage, you are now orders of magnitude faster than you were before. When you move, the world itself shifts around to let you pass, wind resistance decreases, and gravity bends to allow you to run on the walls, ceiling, or up the falling debris.

In Yetzirah, you no longer have any top speed at all, being able to accelerate endlessly. You can completely ignore any and all obstacles to your motion, becoming an unstoppable juggernaut. Anything that is not fast enough to get out of your way will be smashed to pieces. You also have a heightened control of the collateral damage your motion produces. You may allow the shockwaves to tear people into shreds or pass without so much as a breeze.

And in Briah, your ability comes closer than ever to your eventual godly domain. Not only can you perfectly control your own motion, but everything that touches you now is under your control as well. You may make it so that every attack bounces off of you at incredible speed or passes around you, or rip your attackers apart by forcing every cell of their bodies to instantly accelerate away from each other.

Lastly, while in Briah, you can summon a Kamunagara, a physical manifestation of your ability, in the form of a giant silver wolf. And you are also capable of shapeshifting, partially or fully, into a similar form.
addons.title: Shura Mandara - Sairou (Shinza Bansho)

objects.text: You are the reincarnation of the Seat XII of the obsidian round table, the white knight, Wolfgang Schreiber, inheriting all his skills, abilities, Holy Relic, and even his Craving and soul. Even without any supernatural powers, you are a specialist in killing everything you see, capable of subconsciously analysing the enemy by the direction of their gaze, facial expression, heart rate, sweating, and adrenaline levels, etc., as well as using anything as a weapon, from pencils to coffee mugs. A brief conversation over a cup of tea is enough to think of several hundred different ways to kill your opponent. Due to the influence of your craving, you also unconsciously dodge any attack aimed at you, even if you are entirely unaware of it. Your Holy Relic, Lyngvi Vánagandr, is, at first look, a completely ordinary Zündapp KS 750 motorcycle, but this one has been drenched in such an astronomical amount of blood and malice that it has far surpassed actual mythical objects. Containing several hundred thousand souls, the Relic grants you almost impenetrable spiritual armour; you could bathe inside the core of a star or shrug off world-ending spells, and all your other senses and physical capabilities have also improved to match. And while not being your Relic, you can also summon two guns, Luger P08 & Mauser C96 pistols. While appearing completely ordinary, their capabilities are the furthest thing from it, with each bullet attacking the target on multiple planes of existence, ricocheting even off the air itself to constantly pursue your target, and, due to being infected with an aspect of your relic, being always faster than the target. Activating the Yetzirah stage materialises your relic as a nearly indestructible motorcycle. While it is summoned, your speed rises dramatically, with even incredibly fast opponents that are capable of continuously accelerating their own time perceiving you as nothing but a blur. And when you ride atop your motorcycle, even laws of physics no longer bind you. You can freely manoeuvre in three dimensions, turning left, right, forward, backward, up, or down instantly and without regard for inertia. Even simple movements cause shockwaves that can topple buildings, and a touch from your motorcycle can cause impacts akin to a meteor, eradicating cities the size of Berlin and destroying every obstacle in its way, even souls. But all this power is completely eclipsed once you activate your Briah, Niflheimr Fenriswolf. Born from the Craving I don't want to be touched by anyone, this Transcendence-Type Briah bestows upon you the ability to always be faster than your opponent. In this state, partially fused with your Relic, you become truly impossible to reach, as your speed leaves the logic of the universe; as such, you can be faster than someone even while standing still, always acting first even in reaction to your opponent, dodging every attack, even those that break causality, outspeeding even instant teleportation, or moving inside areas where speed itself is irrelevant and time is stopped, as in your Briah you create your own concept of speed, not reliant on the outside world. Finally, in the unlikely event you do get reached, and you do get touched, or if you decide to activate it yourself, the second stage, your true Briah, awakens, born from the Craving I want to be embraced by someone. Yearning for love and denying it; two facets that cannot coexist cause a contradiction that leads to a collapse of your personal physical existence, resulting in your body having zero durability. In this state, the Relic is completely absorbed within your body, and even the guns disappear. While every part of you that is touched by someone else immediately disintegrates, your regeneration reaches such absurd levels that you do not react to injuries at all. You will run even if your head has been blown off, your body crystallised, and your limbs disintegrated. Every time you suffer any type of damage, your body completely restores itself, never losing any momentum. You can never be shackled, running on air or in the vacuum of space, changing directions as you please, and every single movement causing shockwaves that can atomise city blocks. As you have completely fused with your holy Relic, every part of you becomes a deadly weapon, infused with the unholy energies of Die Ewigkeit: the glint of your eyes, the smell of your breath, the sound of your voice. Your scream is enough to kill even other weaker apostles, and normal people will die instantly in your presence and have their souls devoured. The wind circling around your body as you run turns into a deadly hurricane that shreds everything in existence, and your fangs and claws are strong enough to crush even other holy relics. Unlike the original wielder of this power, you are fully lucid when in this state but can, at will, surrender yourself to berserk rage and let your instincts guide your body through the carnage.
objects.title: Hrozvitnir (Shinza Bansho)

objects.text: You are the reincarnation of the Seat V of the obsidian round table, the Maiden of War, Beatrice Waltrud von Kircheisen, inheriting all her skills, abilities, Holy Relic, and even her Craving and soul. Even without any enhancements, you are a trained soldier and a master fencer with decades worth of experience. Your relic is Thrud Walküre, the supposed blade of Thrud, daughter of Thor. It is infused with tens of thousands of souls. Your spiritual armour allows you to effortlessly shrug off nukes and world-ending spells and reality-warping effects. While your Assiah stage is a mystery, you have already mastered the Yetzirah and Briah stages of the Ewigkeit formula. In Yetzirah, the relic turns your blood into lightning, massively amplifying your physical capabilities and speed, to the point where you can now effortlessly move at triple-digit mach values and shatter mountains with your physical strikes. You can also discharge lightning strikes from your sword powerful enough to vaporise skyscrapers. Your Gudou-type Briah Donner Totentanz - Walküre, born from the desire I want to be the light that guides my comrades on the battlefield advances the transformation of the Yetzirah stage even further, turning you into lightning completely, granting you intangibility to conventional attacks and allowing you to achieve the same speed as natural lightning. However, due to being born of your own reality-warping desire, your state lacks the natural limitations and weaknesses of electricity, allowing you to ignore things like the electric resistance of air, for example, and giving you complete freedom of motion in three dimensions.
objects.title: Valkyria (Shinza Bansho)

addons.title: Eine Faust Scherzo
addons.text: Under the influence of Zarathustra's desire I don't want the dead to live, your Briah has mutated to birth the concept of destroying the living dead. While you retain the intangibility and strength granted by Donner Totentanz—Walküre, you achieve a much higher freedom in manipulating the lightning you create. You can produce lightning strikes from your fingertips, create homing lightning, and do almost anything else you can imagine. Your lightning also takes on the property of killing the living dead, which includes even other apostles whose lives are sustained by their relic. The death you bring is final, allowing for no resurrection or healing. This is potent enough to threaten and eventually destroy metaphysical structures like Golden Universe Gladsheimr that are built out of the souls of the dead.

objects.text:
You have bonded with the Margueritte Bois de Justice, a guillotine blade used centuries ago to execute a nascent Gudou goddess.

In Asiah stage, the relic provides you with the ability to manifest and launch invisible omnidirectional blades. These blades are incredibly sharp but relatively fragile. While they will cut almost any mundane material, even carve through steel and concrete effortlessly, they are far less effective against more esoteric defences.

When you activate the Yetzirah stage, the relic manifests as a scythe-like extension on your right arm. Besides the usual abilities of all relics, Margueritte Bois de Justice carries an echo of the curse of the Goddess it once slew, granting it the ability to kill any target instantly as long as it makes contact with the target's neck, no matter the defences or protections.

Finally, you unlock a Gudou-type Briah, Eine Faust Overture. When activated, it allows you to accelerate your own flow of time, which to the outside observer would look like superhuman speed. There is no upper limit to how much you can accelerate yourself, albeit you cannot do so instantly.

Do note that your relic does not hold any souls at the moment. You can safely use the Assiah and Yetzirah stages, at worst suffering minor fatigue if you overexert yourself. However, Briah is much more energy-intensive and will actively devour your own soul for fuel. Depending on the strength of your soul, it may be best to stock up on fuel.
objects.title: Eine Faust Overture (Shinza Bansho)

objects.text: You now have a connection to the most rare and powerful arcanum, the Stars Arcanum. There are few known creatures that exist with a connection to the Star Arcanum. The Star Arcanum is connected with vision, truth, intelligence, otherworldly, reality-altering, timelessness, mystery, destiny, and wishes. With time and mastery, you may be able to do anything with the Star Arcanum, but it is by far the most difficult Arcanum to master. This Arcanum replaces one of your chosen Arcanums; unless you buy all five, then it will be added on.
objects.title: Star Arcanum (The Dragon Prince)

objects.text: You choose an additional arcanum to have a connection to, excluding the Star Arcanum. Alongside this additional Arcanum, your connection to any Arcanum you possess is slightly strengthened.
objects.title: Additional Arcanum

objects.text:
Instead of resorting to reverse engineering other casting techniques, and failing on the case of 10 Master Clans secret ones, you now can purchase it.
You can choose another one technique of casting found in the Mahouka series, be it a secret magic casting technique; Non-Systematic-type Magic or Outer-Systematic Type Magic.
objects.title: Additional Casting Techniques (Mahouka Koukou no Rettousei)

objects.text:
You now possess a Magical Technique Singularity, commonly referred to as a Superpower. These superpowers are highly advanced and complex natural magical techniques that lack intricate activation sequences, cannot be turned off or replicated, and exact a significant toll on the caster and their calculation area/psion count. However, you are granted additional resources equivalent to the strain it imposes, resulting in zero strain on your base abilities.

Known superpowers include Elemental Sight from Kudou Minoru, Inherent Time Acceleration from Kurenai Anzu, Pyrokinesis from Alfred Fomalhaut, Yakusa no Ikazuchi from Kudou Minoru, and Regrowth from Shiba Tatsuya. Each acquisition grants access to one of these powers or another within the same spectrum, offering a diverse range of abilities to choose from.
objects.title: Superpower (Mahouka Koukou no Rettousei)

objects.text:
You gain progressive tiers of technological items, each building on the last to elevate your technical and magical capabilities.

First Purchase:
You acquire a Phantom Anzug Suit, a C.A.D. (Casting Assistance Device) like those used by students, a tablet equipped with the necessary apps for programming it, and essential tools for repair and maintenance.

Second Purchase:
Your equipment receives an upgrade with a Virtual Terminal Device for training, and you gain an Artificial Magic Calculation Area in addition to your natural one. Your C.A.D. is also upgraded to the latest version, with the option to convert it into the iconic Taurus Silver gun-shaped model. Your suit is enhanced to the Covert MOVAL Suit, offering greater utility and protection such as STEALTH.

Third Purchase:
Your equipment is further elevated: the suit becomes the Enhanced Freed Suit for even greater agility and defense. Your C.A.D. is now fully thought-operated, capable of casting any type of magic, and can store a nearly unlimited number of Magic Sequences, Activation Sequences, and spells in various forms. Finally, your Magic Calculation Area is moved to your conscious mind, allowing you to visualize, analyze, and understand any spell after observing it just once, unlike most magicians who require prolonged study.
objects.title: Tools to use the Tools (Mahouka Koukou no Rettousei)

objects.text:
Chaos is a sea of possibilities, a true vortex of madness and disorder. However, your deep experience with the great Chaos has granted you the insight to guide it subtly. While Chaos cannot be ordered, you have mastered four guides to channel your Chaos spells: Attack, Defend, Move, and Control. These four broad concepts are the best way to direct chaos to achieve your desired effects.

Using any of these concepts, you can consistently steer your chaotic spells within these constraints. But, the specific effect and scale still remains chaotically bound. For instance, imbuing a Chaos spell with the concept of 'Attack' might manifest in diverse ways: it could be as harmless as a dodgeball to the face, as soul-shattering as revealing secret desires to break an opponent's mind, as annoyingly painful as summoning rubbing alcohol on every open wound, or you could even summon an elephant on top of them.
objects.title: Guide the Tide

objects.text:
Your connection with Chaos has been refined, allowing you to channel Chaos spells with even greater focus. You now possess six metaphorical 'bullets' that give direction to your Chaos spells. Each bullet ensures that your chaos spell will act within a specific direction to a certain extent. For example, a bullet used for fire will always produce fire, but the exact type—be it nuclear fire, hellfire, or sparkling glitter fire—is still left to chance. The more you try to constrain a chaos spell, the more likely it is to backfire in unexpected ways. The vaguer, the better.

These six bullets can also be used to handle any misfires. If you cast a misfire or simply dislike the outcome of your most recent spell, you can sacrifice a bullet to nullify it. However, this can only affect the spell you've most recently cast. If you wish to undo a baleful polymorph or a charmed mind flayer spell you cast months ago, good luck. Indirect consequences of your spells aren't nullified either so don't think you can get away scott free if you accidently summon Godzilla on top of the White House.

The revolver's bullets replenish at a rate of one bullet every 10 minutes but frequent casting of Chaos spells will enhance your reload time. With time and practice, you can gain more 'bullets' to direct your chaos spells more effectively.
objects.title: Wild Revolver

objects.text:
You are now the descendant or clone of one of the legendary rulers of Ancient Belka or Galea, be it Saint King Olivie Sägebrecht, Claus Ingvalt the Hegemon of Shutra, Dahlgrun the Thunder Emperor, or even The Flame King of Hades, Ixveria. Upon your selection, you inherit the entirety of your ancestor's powers, with the option to absorb their memories should you choose. Should you opt for Olivie Sägebrecht, along with the Kaiserfarbe effect that transforms your Magic Color into a vibrant rainbow and grants you heterochromatic eyes, you also gain possession of Olivie's famed ship, The Saint's Cradle.

Your choice extends beyond mere inheritance; you can adopt the abilities of any of these illustrious figures. Whether it's the body manipulation magic and combat prowess of Olivie, the strength and close-ranged knightly combat style of Claus Ingvalt, or the lightning mana affinity of Dahlgrun, which also includes access to Viktoria's Thunder Emperor Fighting Style and her formidable Special Skill, God Thunder. Additionally, if you opt for Ixveria, you'll be endowed with the knowledge and powers to produce and control cores for the Mariage, creations that, while individually feeble, can rival the might of The Saint's Cradle when amassed. Furthermore, you'll possess the authority to command and direct the Mariage as you see fit.
objects.title: Bloodline of Saints and Kings (Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha)

objects.text:
You possess a rare skill, a magical prowess unique to an individual. Rare Skills are typically rooted in Ancient Belkan magic techniques and encompass a diverse array of abilities.

One such category is the Use of Summoning Magic, which allows for the creation or summoning of various creatures despite disregarding the conventional magic system. These include insects, Dragon Mounts, and Dragon Souls, as well as the ability to perform Transport Summoning and repatriation spells, which ensure the safe retrieval of summons; you can also use spells designed to create golems. Each facet of Summoning Magic entails its own set of spells and capabilities.

Another rare skill is Thought Investigation, which grants the mage the power to extract information and memories directly from others' minds.

Unendlichjagd, known as Infinite Hunting Dogs, manifests as the ability to summon spectral hounds, possessing remarkable combat and stealth skills. These hounds dutifully obey the summoner's every command.

Saints Armor, a defensive skill, offers unparalleled battle defense and exerts a potent Anti-Magic Field (AMF) effect. It weakens incoming magic and gradually dissolves binding spells cast upon the mage.

The Use of Collection rare skill allows the utilization of an extensive repertoire of both Ancient Belkan and Midchildan spells at full capacity. Additionally, this skill enables the reading, retention, and complete recollection of any spell for casting at maximum power. When paired with a linker core-absorbing device, one can access and employ any stored spells within the linker core.

Prophetinschriften, or the Book of The Prophet, bestows the ability to foresee events ranging from six months to several years into the future. These visions are recorded as poems in highly archaic Belkan language. This skill, usable once per year, is typically employed to predict and potentially prevent impending cataclysmic events. Moreover, it grants proficiency in reading and comprehending archaic Ancient Belkan text.

Please Note That there are an unknown amount of rare skills, so instead of choosing any of these or even just all of them, you could gain completely new rare skills.
objects.title: Rare Skills (Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha)

addons.text: Now your linked dolls have become animated, giving you the ability to ask questions, with the dolls answering with the knowledge of the linked target. You can also order them to do anything, like impale themselves on a needle if the person plans to betray you, or to use magical trinkets or potions that will affect the linked target. The dolls will also trap the souls of the target upon their deaths, turning them into your familiar, and with your magic, you can make deals with them, like giving them a new body or satisfying their desire of revenge for a price.
addons.title: Man With the Hex

objects.text: "I’ve got friends on the other side" Through practicing the occult magic, you become a full-fledged Voodoo practitioner on par with the infamous Shadow Man, Dr. Facilier. Your dark voodoo magic can accomplish anything as long as the price is paid, but you only gain full access to the full depth of your miraculous magic when it is powered by the desires of others and accomplished through deals. You can facilitate deals with any creature, tempting them to do your bidding. Your wide array of magical powers includes fortune-telling via objects like cards, creating trinkets and potions with magical effects, showing dreams and desires within a puff of smoke or in the reflections of a mirror, twisting shadows to manipulate others, animating objects with spirits and souls, and creating voodoo dolls to simply harm or curse others. With enough power, your magical wish-granting has no bounds. Your magic is also strongly affected by your own desires, and it can include a price to offset the cost of its magic; a potion to grow hair could grow it all over the entire body; a spell to make somebody young again could take away all of their memories to do so; the most delicious wedding cake could rot their teeth; or a trinket that brings wealth could do it by taking your love away. Your magical strength comes from making pacts with dark spirits known as the Loa, further enhancing all your magic and giving you the option to create miracles at a lesser cost. Finally, you also obtain great charisma, charm, and cunning to deceive and persuade others, but beware, as your own desires may twist your power against you, and any debts you have will catch up eventually.
objects.title: Witch Doctor (The Princess and the Frog)

addons.text:
Your mastery of Onmyōdō now extends to the Onmyōdō of early 20th century Tokyo, particularly the heretical Onmyōdō of First Lieutenant Yasunori Kato.

Things like flight, hypnotism, entering peoples dreams, the infliction of curses and mind control via poison, psychic energy blasts, telekinesis, dispelling other magic, creating powerful combat and infiltration shikigami, summoning Buddhist protective spirits, granting spirit medium powers to others, destroying cities by awakening ancient spirits, and much more become possible for you. After all, you received your Onmyōdō training in the same village as Abe No Seimei, or rather fused your spirit with one who did. You are also granted the extreme physical power, regenerative abilities (including the ability for severed limbs to rejoin your body), and agelessness of an oni, just like Lt. Kato.
addons.title: Doomed Megalopolis (Teito Monogatari)

objects.text:
You possess unparalleled knowledge of demonology, spanning the infamous Ars Goetia, the infernal hierarchies of Christian demonology, and the demonic beings found in other religions and mythologies. From the 72 Demons of Solomon, bound to serve those who know their rituals, to the cunning djinn of Islamic lore, the vengeful oni of Japanese folklore, and the powerful asuras of Hindu tradition, your understanding encompasses a wide array of demonic entities. You have studied their histories, roles, and cultural significance, allowing you to identify and work with or against them regardless of their origin.

Your expertise grants you the ability to summon, bind, and negotiate with these entities. You understand the sacred geometry, sigils, true names, and ancient rites required to establish control, ensuring these beings obey your commands rather than their own capricious whims. Beyond summoning, you are intimately familiar with the inner workings of their culture and hierarchies, including the ranks of Dukes, Kings, and Princes. Whether borrowing their powers for clairvoyance, influence, or elemental dominion, or simply seeking forbidden knowledge, you wield the tools necessary to navigate the complex interplay of authority and respect in dealings with the infernal. 

However, your mastery does not end with summoning. You are equally proficient in protective arts, capable of crafting wards, sanctifying spaces, and banishing spirits when needed. You understand that demons from different traditions require different approaches; Eastern spirits such as oni or djinn may not respond to Western exorcism rites and must instead be countered with culturally specific methods. Whether calling upon divine forces, invoking celestial guardians, or constructing ritual barriers, you can effectively oppose any demonic influence and protect those in need.

Your role as a demonologist is not without peril. To wield such forbidden knowledge is to walk a razor’s edge, constantly balancing ambition with caution. The beings you summon are ancient and cunning, and even the smallest mistake in a ritual could invite disaster. Negotiating pacts comes with immense risk, for demons rarely offer their aid without an ulterior motive. The price of their assistance—whether in the form of your vitality, your soul, or your freedom—can be devastating if not carefully managed. The deeper you delve into this dark art, the more it tests your resolve, as the lure of power threatens to consume your morality. To deal with these forces is to gamble with your very essence, and every success comes with the knowledge that one misstep could leave you bound to forces far beyond your control.
objects.title: Demonology

addons.text:
Your understanding of the supernatural has reached an unparalleled level, no longer confined to any single tradition or pantheon. Just as you mastered the intricacies of both demonic and heavenly hierarchies, you have now extended that depth of knowledge to all mythological and occult entities. From the veiled politics of the Fae Courts to the boundless ambitions of the djinn, from the grudges of ancient yokai to the celestial feuds of forgotten gods, your expertise spans the full spectrum of the supernatural world.

You are no longer merely summoning or binding these beings—you understand them on a fundamental level. You know their true names, the laws that govern them, the unspoken rules they must abide by, and the subtle details that shape their desires and fears. You recognize the exact phrasing a Fae cannot twist, the precise sigil that will force a djinn to obey, the correct gesture to placate an enraged oni. Even the most obscure spirits and forgotten deities are within your grasp, their myths laid bare before you.

With this depth of knowledge, your rituals evolve into something greater. No longer do you struggle to adapt to the nuances of different beings; instead, you weave occult traditions together with seamless precision. A yokai can be bound with infernal sigils, a demon can be tricked with a Fae’s double-edged bargain, a restless spirit may be calmed using forgotten rites from a distant pantheon.
addons.title: True Occultist

objects.text:
Your knowledge of the divine mirrors that of demonologists, but where they command the infernal, you wield an understanding of the sacred. You have studied the hierarchies of celestial beings across numerous religious and mythological traditions, from the archangels and seraphim of Christian and Jewish mysticism, to the kami of Shinto, the devas of Hinduism, and the divine messengers of countless cultures. You understand the complex relationships between gods, saints, spirits, and the cosmic laws that govern them, allowing you to recognize, invoke, and even entreat these entities.

With precise prayers, sigils, and rituals, you can attempt to summon, beseech, or bargain with holy beings. However, where demons may be forced into compliance through binding magic and true names, divine entities are far less susceptible to coercion. Their aid must often be earned, either through devotion, sacrifice, or proving yourself worthy of their attention. Some demand unwavering faith, while others adhere strictly to cosmic law, refusing to intervene unless certain conditions are met.

However, your knowledge is not limited to calling upon the divine; you are also trained in the art of resisting, defying, and banishing celestial forces. Just as an exorcist drives out demons, you can cast out angels, unravel blessings, and desecrate holy ground, severing the influence of the divine. You understand the weaknesses of gods and sacred beings, the rituals that break their protections, and the symbols that repel their presence. You can corrupt holy relics, subvert divine contracts, and exploit the cosmic laws that bind celestial entities, forcing them to retreat or bend to your will. Whether facing the judgment of an archangel, the wrath of an old god, or the suffocating order of a celestial hierarchy, you wield the forbidden knowledge necessary to stand against the forces of heaven itself. 

Yet, to walk this path is to bear the weight of divine scrutiny. Unlike demons, who can be manipulated or bound through cunning, holy entities operate under strict moral and cosmic laws. They judge your intentions, and should you invoke their power selfishly or deceitfully, you may find yourself forsaken—or worse, punished. Some celestial forces demand absolute devotion, while others test those who seek their aid with trials of faith and character. Even when acting with pure intentions, your dealings with the divine may attract the attention of higher forces beyond your understanding, some benevolent and others utterly indifferent to mortal affairs.

To practice theurgy is to stand between heaven and earth, a mortal who dares to call upon the sacred. You wield the authority to summon and command, to shield and to bless—but also to be judged. The power of the divine is immense, but to wield it improperly is to risk more than your life. Your very soul is at stake, and should you falter, you may find yourself not only abandoned but condemned.
objects.title: Theurgy
The Dark Priest (Fear & Hunger)
objects.text:
You gain access to Magic from the world of Fear and Hunger which is derived from the Old Gods—eldritch beings, each representing a different primordial concept, whose mere presence can corrupt lesser beings.

The magic you can learn usually depends on the god and the concept they embody. For example, Gro-goroth, the god of destruction, focuses on blood magic, offensive spells and necromancy. Sylvian, the god of creation, focuses on healing and utility magic. Upon taking this power you gain knowledge of four spells without any sacrifice needed, these spells are: Black Orb, Hurting, Necromancy and Loving whispers.

But to gain more you must raise your affinity with the Old Gods through prayer, sacrifice, or acts done in their name. You possess complete knowledge of all rituals, inscriptions, and sacrifices required to obtain every spell and hidden knowledge that exists in the world of Fear and Hunger, whether shown or not. However, casting these spells takes a toll on the mind, and attempting magic beyond your limits may result in corruption, madness or death.

You also know how to create Soul Stones and The Hexen Table, this object will allow you to learn every different skill that exists in the series instantly, but to do this you must sacrifice Soul Stones which are charged with souls. The table can also be used to turn normal items into Cursed items giving them addition buffs.

You are a Witch or a Warlock, a human gifted with the genetic heredity to use magic. Magic is the ability to influence the course of events via supernatural or mystical forces, you now possess an innate connection to the elements and forces of nature. Usually, warlocks are considered inferior to witches, but this will not affect you, and you will be able to rise to the level of the Alpha.

You will have general knowledge of all different magical disciplines, such as voodoo, spellcraft, rituals, potioncraft, demonology, and others. You will also have beginner-level access to the Seven Wonders, a category of magical abilities used by the Salem witches. These seven abilities are Telekinesis, Concilium the ability to impose their own will onto another person or animal, Pyrokinesis, Transmutation the ability to move instantaneously from one location to another, Vitalum Vitalis the ability to transfer their own life force into people or animals that are sick, injured or on the verge of death healing their injuries, Descensum the ability to descend into the netherworlds of the afterlife, and Divination.

With time, research, and training, you may be able to learn other abilities, such as Resurgence which allows you to resurrect yourself and other individuals from the dead, Tempus Infinitum a magical ability that allows you to manipulate the flow of time, Immortality, Chlorokinesis, Hydrokinesis, Scrying, Illusion Manipulation, and others.
objects.title: Magic (American Horror Story)

objects.text: As a more powerful furycrafter, you possess numerous, exceptionally strong furies, and your abilities can significantly influence the outcomes of entire battles. Additionally, with considerable effort, you can bind a fury to another person, beginning their journey as a Furycrafter.
objects.title: High Lord (Codex Alera)

objects.text: As the pinnacle furycrafting, your numerous and powerful furies can enact changes on a continental scale. Over time, with luck and effort, you may even bind and command the Greater Furies, representing vast natural forces like oceans and mountains.
objects.title: First Lord (Codex Alera)

objects.text:
Your study of the mystic arts has taken you down the road of the Essex’s grand design. The path of the righteous specializes in three realms. Sorceress Enhancement, Story magic, and Debt magic.

Sorceress Enhancement is simply the underpinning knowledge of sorcery. Knowing your basics like the back of your hand. It allows your development as a mystic practitioner to grow with increased speed, however, you still must seek answers and growth to achieve anything truly great.

Story magic ties you into specific webs. While under its influence, your life follows its whims and tropes. You can embody the trusted mentor, or the vile antagonist, but it will always twist fate to follow these designs. 

And finally, the greatest of Mother Rightous’s tricks. Debt magics function on a singular basis. When establishing a debt, be that a contract or an expression of gratitude simple as a ‘thank you’, you gain influence over the individual’s soul. Of the many things you can do with such a connection, the simplest are tracking, torturing, controlling, or even absorbing the life essence of the indebted individuals.

Be wary however, as both Story Magic and Debt Magics possess numerous loopholes. They may be magics so old that humanity has forgotten their old tricks, but you must always be wary they are not rediscovered. Your potential is unlimited, but it is up to you to seize it.
objects.title: Mother Righteous (Marvel)

addons.text:
In the days of the Earth's creation, long before the first human was born, the Demiurge Primordial created beings beyond mortal ken. When it was discovered that they could grow in power by consuming one another, a war of gods began. You are equal to those that survived that war; Set, Oshtur, Gaea, the Gods of Utgard, Tiwaz, Atum (also known as the Demogorge or Amon-Ra), & most importantly Chthon. Indeed, to be powerful like Chthon is notable, for he was also thought to be a Great Old One on top of being an Elder God, and one equal to Shuma Gorath. Now you are as well.

This means your reality warping is so much grander, so much more stable, and has just that much more depth (enough to create things like The Darkhold or The Book Of The Vishanti). However, you have not reached it's infinite potential yet; recall that the Elder Gods may fight one another as equals, that they were defeated by the Demiurge even working together, & that even Amon-Ra felt the need to join the Council of Godheads when the Celestials appeared on Earth.
addons.title: Elder God of Earth (Marvel)

addons.text:
You are now the seed of Earth's creation. You are both the Demiurge Primordial and the Demiurge-To-Come, having the power of William Kaplan and the being who was the true master and origin of Earth itself. Your power is enough to match every other Elder God combined.

It's not clear that there is a limit to your power, and if your reality warping isn't fully realized, it's at least very close.
addons.title: Demiurge Primordial (Marvel)

objects.text:
You have received some of the essence of Chthon, just as Wanda Maximoff did, giving you access to powerful innate chaos magic and a superior natural grasp of all other forms of magic. This in theory, would include a form of reality warping with few limits, though in practice this requires intense personal control & much training, otherwise it can horribly backfire.

As an unrelated matter, you are now also a Nexus Being, a being that represents freedom & infinite possibility. You have the potential to become an Ultimate Nexus Being, meaning that for you there is no such thing as "it's impossible" or "it can't be done." This isn't guaranteed victory in every situation, but the possibility will always exist.
objects.title: Daughter of Chthon (Marvel)

objects.text: You are an Infernal Savant, meaning that you are capable of wielding Infernal Magic instinctively, without risking any damage from the Infernal energies at all. You can intuitively figure out how Infernal Magic works as well.
objects.title: Infernal Savant (The Gods are Bastards)

addons.text: It seems you have undergone the same experimental procedure as Rosmontis, seemingly bereft of any of the same side effects as her, or any side effects at all. Having been implanted with an organ that turns you into a self-contained Arts Unit, you can push and use your Arts to its utmost limits without any risks of exasperating your condition. This organ regulates the Originium density within your cells and bloodstream. All while granting you immeasurable potential and aptitude for Arts, with incredible stability. You may be considered Infected, but it's hardly accurate to say that this is Oripathy.
addons.title: Prototype Containment

addons.text: "Pain. Pain means that you're still alive, it has been my old friend and enemy for as long as I could remember. Even as this disease slowly eats away at me, as long as I can still feel pain. It means I can live for just another day longer. So, I will keep pushing forward, no matter my condition, just to see another sunrise. " You have acquired an astonishing amount of power and strength. But this power comes at a cost, as the Oripathy afflicting you has progressed to its later stages, turning large portions of your body into crystal. Yet this hasn't stopped you because you are a survivor. This damn disease won't keep you from living. As long as the will to survive burns within you, the Originum crystals that cover your body will respond to that desire, forcing your ailing, broken self to rise and carry on. Having endured so much, your understanding of your condition has led to a profound evolution in your mastery of Arts. Your talent has grown exponentially, both in power and control. You've learned all the tricks to minimize strain while maximizing the effects of your abilities. Calling your actions 'efficient' would be an understatement, for mere efficiency would never be enough to survive. Even with all this, it is strongly advised not to overexert yourself or use Arts without a Casting Unit. While you may know ways to minimize the effects of using your Arts without one, it will still take a toll on your fragile condition if not used responsibly.
addons.title: Fight on Struggler

addons.text:
The corruptive and infectious nature of both the Apocalypse Virus and Originium have fused into a most splendid creation. Their ability to subsume organic material and esoteric properties now knows no bounds, twisting and perverting life from its original form, producing an endless pulsing well of power, warping reality with its every wake to what you desire. There is nothing so profane.

Your blasphemous descent has exalted your rulership, opposing the holiest of holies. Dominating this profane creation, its will, yours to mold, loyal, never to harm you. Fashioning armaments surpassing anything you could've imagined before with its assistance. These new Abyssal Arms awaken an individual unique Arts affinity, incorporating their innermost potential into itself, freeing those from their shackles, revealing the jewel that once lay hidden.

You are an Ark, a hyper-dimensional reality, an Empire of Consciousness made to store the deceased and living within yourself. For each mind your corruption touches, twisting their sanity and loyalties to yourself as their ruler. With each mind freed. You gain a facsimile of their unique Arts, growing stronger with each connection formed under your kingdom. You are the Unity of all Life.
addons.title: Crown of the Fallen

addons.text:
Bursting forth, the rage of stars. Your Herrscher core has assimilated your Oripathy into itself, merging their Honkai and Originium natures, causing a resonating effect from their esoteric/imaginative and corruptive/destructive properties. You are a tear in reality for the Honkai to push its influence through, corrupting all that is real. Now, with the help of the Honkai radiation, acting as the transmission vector, you quickly convert any organic lifeform touched by its reach, be they living or dead, into a silicon originium composite Befallen Beast.

With the new hybrid nature of your Herrscher core, you are bursting from the seems with newfound strength, able to draw power from the converted crystal lifeforms around you to supplement your strength in times of weakness or hardship. Your Arts and Honkai Authority are now the same, merging in spectacular form, granting you more versatility and reach in your domain, bringing forth more esoteric effects to reality.
addons.title: Herrscher Collapse

objects.text:
"I don't really care that I got Oripathy. Everyone here gets it, sooner or later. I'm one of the lucky ones. Funnel's little girl is five, and her left hand is almost entirely covered in crystals. Her sixth birthday is a few months away. Funnel's birthday present for her? A coffin."

- Hoederer of Kazdel

Being afflicted with Oripathy has upended the life you once knew. This slow, insidious disease steadily converts your cells into Originium—its crystalline march a painful ordeal to endure, leaving its horrid mark: the burning of flesh, the charring of skin, the agonizing eruption of crystal that splits apart flesh, the slow suffocation your body feels as it loses the strength to carry on. You are in the beginning stages of your infection; from here on out, you will find no respite. As a consequence of your condition, your Originium Arts Assimilation rate has increased dramatically. Through this process, you'll gain a unique, personalized Arts along with elevating your overall aptitude to be comparable to some elite Rhodes Island operators. Furthermore, your Oripathy now acts as both the source and catalyst for your power, substituting your own body itself as an Arts Unit to cast. However, being reliant on this aspect only hastens the disease's progression. Oripathy progresses in three known stages, with the final stage being terminally lethal—seeking medical intervention before this point is crucial. Yet, the further you descend into infection, the more your Arts swell in raw power. It's a tantalizing, perilous slope—one that promises strength, but offers only a single, inevitable end for those who chase power above all else. And should you die in the later stages, your body may either disintegrate into volatile Originium dust or, in rarer cases, detonate as the crystallized infection triggers a violent chain reaction. Both outcomes risk secondary exposure, spreading the disease through lingering dust or embedded shards. To manage your condition, you are equipped with an Infection Monitor to track your vitals and progression, alongside basic knowledge on treatment methods that can slow the spread and lessen its effects.
objects.title: Oripathy (Arknights)

objects.text: You seem to have been implanted with the "Voice" of the Witch King, a fragment of his power and will (soul). While its tone is weaker than its original form, it remains flawless—similar to what was implanted in Ebenholz. However, unlike Ebenholz, where it would gradually overpower him, turning him into a perfect vessel and host for the Witch King's return, you have achieved full reign over yours. Instead of succumbing, you were imparted the full breadth of Herkunftshorn's knowledge, granting access to his vast wealth of arcane wisdom at will, all for you to peruse and explore to your heart's content. In this exchange, you have also inherited the prodigious talents of the Witch King himself—his unparalleled skill in Originium Arts and profound mastery of music. Coupled with his genius for understanding and innovation, you now stand as the foremost expert in both fields. Your potential is endless, with the ability to pioneer and wield your crafts in ways that may transcend even the Witch King's greatest feats in time. Not just that, but even the grand Der Herkunftshorn and The Pavilion have responded to your presence, recognizing you as their master reborn. Unlike the phantasmal ruins seen in the series, these are now restored to their former glory—a spire and fortress of unimaginable might that once struck terror into the hearts of all who laid eyes upon them in Terra. Now, they are bound to your very soul, lying dormant in the Void between reality, also known as the Kargereich, awaiting your command. You hold the power to summon them at will, calling forth their ominous presence to descend upon reality, spreading dread wherever you go. No longer will you be caught unaware, as these ancient strongholds, loyal to you, may even respond on their own to your peril, descending upon reality to protect and reclaim you, unwilling to lose their master once more. The full might of your Spire and Fortress is at your fingertips, ready to crush any opposition in your wake.
