objects.title: Witch King (Arknights)

objects.text:
You have acquired all the powers of Vandalieu Zakkart, including his stats, skills, and among others. You can optionally become a dhampir, and even if you don't, you gain all of Vandalieu's racial traits. 

You are proficient with the advanced version of Death-Attribute Magic, Dark King Magic, capable of creating high-ranked undead of Rank 10 and beyond. Regardless of holding another attribute apart from death-attribute, you would still be able to use Dark King Magic.

You are also proficient with the advanced version of No-Attribute Magic, Hollow King Magic, which is powerful enough to shake a dungeon of 100 floors located in a pocket dimension and rip space apart.

You will not only get Lambda's system, which lets you access all of Vandalieu's jobs but also acquire all the Fragments of the Demon King's Body and Soul that Vandalieu had. Additionally, you have a ridiculous amount of over 200 billion mana and are not limited by the three curses Vandalieu had been inflicted with. 

You also gain all the divinities/blessings Vandalieu had, making you a dark god whose mere presence instills fear in all other evil gods stretching to even Alda's faction. This also involves the Earth's Gods' Divine Protection, Origin's Gods' Divine Protection, and all path jobs Vandalieu had. 

Furthermore, as you are recognized as Goddess Vida's champion, you can optionally receive access to a pocket dimension consisting of New Talosheim and all monsters under Vandalieu's Demon Empire of Vidal.
objects.title: Eclipse Emperor (The Death Mage Doesn't Want A Fourth Time)

objects.text: With each purchase, you become the color mage of an additional element. Elements can be combined to create more powerful and versatile spells.
objects.title: Additional Element (Re:Zero)

addons.text: You have gained access to no mere spirit, but a Great Spirit of their specific element. Unlike a normal spirit who can be a Great Spirit, this is not just their state of being but their title as the greatest of all in their particular element. Either choose one of your already contracted spirits of the appropriate element, or choose an already existing Great Spirit, and they will pledge their very being to you in a contract that will last for as long as both of you live. Every purchase of Additional Element will allow you to either ascend another of your spirits, choose an existing Great Spirit, or make your chosen Great Spirit the master of that element as well.
addons.title: Everlasting Contract

addons.text:
Od Laguna is a seemingly infinite mass of mana that serves as the soul of the world. It has the power to recycle the souls of the dead, generate the natural resources the world needs to survive, create spirits, and randomly grant Divine Protections to people at birth.

Through your ascension in becoming one of these spirits, and by somehow forging a connection with Od Laguna, you have merged with it. Since Od Laguna is a mass of mana with no will of its own, you have effectively become Od Laguna. You possess complete control over the creation of Divine Protections, and because you are the one crafting them, there is no risk of miscommunication with yourself. You are also able to bestow Divine Protections upon others of your choosing.

While your mana capacity did not increase immediately, your new nature allows you to generate mana internally, whereas before, you had to rely on drawing it from the atmosphere. Now, you are almost always at your maximum capacity, and if you wish, you can expel excess mana into the environment, saturating the area with it. Doing so can cause environmental changes depending on the element you are channeling, such as triggering a freeze or blizzard, accelerating plant growth, or purifying and generating water and other natural resources.

Through your ability to recycle souls, you can capture and preserve any intact soul of the dead. You then have the option to use your Divine Protections and magic to resurrect them or safely send them through the cycle of reincarnation of whatever reality you are in.
addons.title: Od Laguna

addons.text:
The quality of your mana has evolved through the ability to cast Old Magic, transforming you into something akin to an A-Ray—a being also known as a Great Mother or Father. These are pure Fairies born from within the planet itself, whose existence is not contingent on human civilization in any way. While you share similarities, you have become more aligned with Od Laguna's variant, making you a Divided Spirit: a piece of Od Laguna that represents it even more intimately than if you were merely the Great Spirit of a specific magical element.

As the Great Spirit of a particular element, you gain powerful authority over a concept related to both that element and the planet. For example, if your element were Fire, you might gain authority over the "lungs of the planet" or the waste heat it produces; if Water were your element, you might be known as the "veins of the planet," governing currents in water and magic alike. This would result in a substantial boost in your powers, making you nearly impervious to most attacks and greatly enhancing your control over your element and mana itself.

Additionally, both your Gate and Od have been significantly augmented by your Old Magic reservoir, expanding your mana capacity and accelerating your ability to absorb and release it. You have also mastered the skill of generating mana simply by breathing, no longer reliant on ambient mana to function or cast spells. Your Fairy Patterns have fused with your Gate, turning it into an amplifier to all mana passing through it, vastly increasing your magical feats. Incantations are now unnecessary; with your chosen element, you could achieve wonders such as accelerated plant growth on a country scale or willing powerful weapons into existence by generating and manipulating metals into the shape of a sword before enchanting them with Yang Magic.

In the event of death, you would eventually reform, similar to how Fairies reincarnate. However, unlike them, you retain your memories and identity, making this more akin to resurrection. The time needed to reform varies, from days to years, depending on the extent of the damage. Complete destruction of your soul would prevent this from happening.

If you were to acquire additional elements, you would become the A-Ray embodying another aspect of Od Laguna. Acquiring all six elements would elevate you to a state resembling the Six Fairies of Beginning or a fully empowered Fairy of Paradise, capable of creating weapons on par with unsealed Excalibur.
addons.title: A-Ray

addons.text:
Your Archive manifests as your personalized version of the Forbidden Library—a secluded dimension nestled in the void between worlds and anchored exclusively to you. Visually, it begins as a two-story space featuring a spiral staircase at the center of the room. The second floor consists of a spacious balcony, but with a mere thought, you can alter the library's appearance and size to suit your needs, even making it appear like Roswaal's manor.

Within this library lies an extensive collection of books containing all the magical knowledge necessary to master any spell or magical technique you could imagine. In addition to this unparalleled trove of knowledge, the library also houses the research, artifacts, and magical books of the Witch of Greed, Echidna.

The Forbidden Library possesses a unique ability called Door-Crossing, which allows its door to overlay onto any door you are familiar with. Using this spell, you can appear anywhere, provided you know or have sufficient information about the desired location beforehand. Moreover, the library functions as an immense mana battery, capable of storing unlimited energy for future use. Unlike the original Forbidden Library, this version is indestructible.

If you ever feel like you don't want to search for each book, you have a master book that will change its text to be like whatever book you need in the library.
addons.title: The Forbidden Library

addons.text: You're not just the greatest of your element. You're truly that element in its entirety. Depending on your element, you have the absolute ability and authority to utilize and learn any magic that falls under it. It does not matter if it comes from a system you do not have, as it would be remade to work for you through your conceptual authority as that element. This also means that things like time, preparation, and mana are not factors anymore. You truly do not need mana anymore to cast from that element, but you still have it and can generate nigh-endless amounts of it by converting your element into magical energy. Incantations are not needed anymore. If you were the Great Spirit of Fire, it would not take much time or effort for you to freeze whatever planet you're on into a never-ending ice age. This also gives the added benefit that if you were to die or be obliterated, you would be able to reform from your element. This indirectly makes you absolutely immune to damage from any elements you're the Great Spirit of. This does not take away your initial element from Elementalism, and any additional elements you're the Great Spirit of gain this same level of conceptualness. It is possible to eventually branch out into other similar elements of the ones you're the Great Spirit of—and even potentially new ones if you become good enough at magic using a new element.
addons.title: True Force of Nature

addons.text:
The merging of the Saint Graph to your Great Spirit body has made you into a Heroic Spirit rather than a mere Servant. You now have all the beneficial class skills usually given by default to every class at C rank at the least.

This includes things like Riding, Magic Resistance, Territory Creation, and Self-Replenishment. Even class skills from Extra Classes like Independent Manifestation, Existence Outside the Domain, and Counter Hero. The rank of these skills may increase depending on other powers you may have. Not-so-beneficial class skills like Madness Enhancement and Avenger can also be gained if you wish. You also gain the ability to naturally raise the level of all these class skills through repeated use of them.
addons.title: The Fundamentals

objects.text: No more are you just a mere mortal. You have become a Great Spirit. An immortal being composed of mana that has become the absolute master of your chosen element. You now no longer age, nor do you need sustenance, as the ambient mana you absorb from your environment sustains you. Your form is malleable like clay, and you're the sculptor. Your magic of your chosen element has been augmented to heights no other could hope to challenge. The strength and limits of spells for your chosen element are more a matter of preparation, time, and how much mana you have either in your Od or available from the atmosphere. In a mana-enriched environment and with proper setup, if you were the Great Spirit of Fire, you would be able to burn the whole world or cause an extinction-level ice age, as long as no one stopped you or you didn't run out of mana. As a Spirit, you have also gained the ability to make contracts with others. This allows you to set conditions between two or more parties that will turn them into Spirit users, allowing them to use you as a Gate to cast magic of your element. You also become the Great Spirit of every extra element selected from Additional Element.
objects.title: Great Spirit (Re:Zero)

objects.text:
Contrary to its name, being a demi-human does not necessarily mean you are part human. The term refers to any species that isn’t Human, Spirit, or a true Dragon.

Demi-humans come in a wide array of races, both pure and mixed. A pure demi-human might be an anthropomorphic animal, while hybrids can vary wildly, ranging from half-human, half-cat individuals with feline ears and tails to quarter demi-humans exhibiting only minor differences from humans, such as sharp teeth or pointed ears. This will also include other races, such as kitsunes, centaurs, giants, elves, dwarves, etc.

Certain races have distinct advantages. Werewolves (half-human, half-wolf) can use Beastification to transform into powerful wolf-like forms and possess the Divine Protection of Ambushing, which makes them exceptionally hard to detect—even their skinned hide retains this effect. Meanwhile, members of the Evil Eye Tribe appear entirely human but possess extraordinary abilities through their unique eyes, such as manipulating the minds of others.

Contrary to the belief that being only half or a quarter demi-human makes you weaker, the reality is often the opposite. Such hybrids can access Beastification, enabling them to partially transform specific body parts or fully transform into massive animal forms representative of their bloodline. These forms can vary widely, from a large quadrupedal beast the size of a human to a towering bipedal creature 4–5 meters tall. Regardless of the form, Beastification provides a tenfold increase in physical abilities. However, it comes with significant drawbacks: a high risk of losing control and an enormous consumption of mana to maintain the transformation.
objects.title: Demi-Human (Re:Zero)

addons.text:
You are not just a Dragon or Great Spirit, you are something more, unquestionably the most powerful kind of lifeform ever born from Od Laguna.

As such, you are able to compete with the likes of the Divine Dragon Volcanica in physical and magical strength. Your scales are tough enough that even enhanced world-class swordsmen cannot break through them, and your halo is strong enough to completely repel magic on the level of Roswaal’s Al Quintet.

Your basic breath attack is comparable to Al Quintet in destructive power. Likewise your innate elemental powers can devastate a sizable town, and when paired with your breath or magic, entire nations.

Additionally your capacity for growth both as a Spirit and a Dragon, synergize, allowing you to naturally grow and accumulate mana an order of magnitude faster than either.

Finally, you are able to survive the destruction of your Heart Stone by possessing another anchor, which you can refine into a second Heart Stone, though your mana capacity is initially reduced, depending on the qualities of your new anchor.
addons.title: Apex of Od Laguna

objects.text:
You are no mere mage, you are a representative of the strongest species, a Dragon.

As such, you possess a large starting mana capacity, equivalent to a Great Spirit, a powerful physical form composed of your mana, and a host of innate abilities to accompany them.

First, and most fundamentally, as your body is composed of mana, you can change your shape according to your whims and your available mana. By default, you take on a form reminiscent of an archetypical western dragon with a halo.

Investing more mana into your form will grant you proportionally more physical strength and durability, however the increase is especially noticeable when investing mana into your scales and your halo, with the former providing you physical defenses and the latter magical defenses. By default, your scales are about as tough as steel and your halo will completely nullify the best spells of an average mage and greatly reduce the strength of any magical effects more powerful than that.

Other than your body, you can instinctually use your mana for a breath attack, a non-elemental torrent of mana of great destructive power, capable of wiping an entire fortress off the map. You can also use your mana to fly, with or without wings (though their presence certainly helps)

Additionally, you gain comparatively minor power over your chosen element(s), beginning at around the level of an average Spirit, able to devastate the area of a small village at most. Notably, these powers are not proper magic, and can be synergized with your magic and your breath attack for even greater and more varied effects.

Your blood also possesses extraordinary restorative properties, capable of mending grievous wounds and curing most mundane ailments. Yet this pales in comparison to the potency contained within the blood shed from your final heartbeat, which can perform miracles like curing any disease, undoing transmogrifications, revitalizing dead lands, reversing famine and breaking any curse.

The only thing you have that could be called a “weak point” is the actual core of your being, referred to as a Heart Stone. Physically, your Heart Stone takes the form of a jewel-like stone residing somewhere inside of your mana-made body, and functions analogously to a Spirit’s anchor, keeping your soul moored in your body. Practically speaking, any damage that does not reach this Heart Stone can be considered superficial, as you need only expend mana to reform your shell. With time, a great deal of effort, or suitable power, you can recover damage to your Heart Stone, assuming you survive the damage in the first place.

Furthermore, your Heart Stone naturally improves with time, growing both in durability and mana capacity. As a result, it’s a simple fact that time is the greatest ally of Dragons like yourself.

Should you one day grow weary of existing as a true Dragon, you may instead choose to be reborn as a Dragonkin. In doing so, your soul will leave your Heart Stone behind, taking root within a humanoid body. This is not without consequence, as your original Dragon body will become a Dragonhusk, an empty shell still sustained by its Heart Stone. Having lost the soul that granted it true personhood, it is stripped of nearly all personality and the capacity for speech, entering a hibernation-like existence in which only a fragment of its consciousness remains.

However, the connection between your soul and Heart Stone is never truly severed. By making physical contact with your Dragonhusk, you may possess it once more, reclaiming direct control over your original body for as long as you wish before returning to your Dragonkin body.
objects.title: Dragon (Re:Zero)

objects.text:
Like Natsuki Subaru, you're a Sage Candidate—capable of holding multiple Witch Factors without risking incompatibility or rejection and able to use all of them in tandem with each other.

You can now choose one or more of the remaining 8 sins.
objects.title: Sage Candidate (Re:Zero)

addons.text:
Your Return by Death and the one granted by Satella would have been redundant, but a weird combo of both has led to yours temporarily transforming into the same seal that trapped Satella. For as long as you're connected to Satella, she will be sealed away in a pocket dimension by your Authority, and you will be using her Return by Death. The Taboo is still in place—if you break it, she can still punish you, and if you do it too much in a short amount of time, she can either summon a shadow of herself in your general area or break out of your seal completely. It is possible to trap her again by either using Return by Death to go back before you broke the Taboo or waiting a day, but the casualties would be high.

If you ever become unconnected from Satella, your Authority will revert to your own Return by Death.
addons.title: Sufferu

objects.text:
Your Authority is the ultimate tool for both making sure you do not stay dead and ensuring you deal with whoever wants you dead. You have the power to set a "save point" at an arbitrary moment (the first "save point" will be when you first gain this power).

Whenever you die, reality will rewind to your "save point" with only you and whoever you share your Authority with retaining all memories of the previous loop.

There is no limit to how many times you can die. No matter how definite your death was, you will return to your "save point" and any effects that happened to you in the future will be undone if they didn't occur before or during your "save point". If you do not have any Apostles, you will be able to have up to three different points that you can return to at any time. Over time, you may learn how to return to previous points that you no longer have active, including even back to when you first gained your Authority.

As this type of time travel resets you to a previous point in your life, you cannot bring physical objects back with you. However, you can retain personal growth, such as any training you've done on your body or any increase in mana size. If you grow tired of life, you can choose to shut this ability off and let yourself die a permanent death.
objects.title: Return by Death (Re:Zero)

addons.text:
Similar to the Archbishop of Sloth, you've gained the ability to potentially come back to life after being killed. How this works is that as long as you have at least one existing clone, should you die, your soul will move and take over the body of your clone. You will not immediately be ejected from the dimension your clones exist in for up to an hour, but you can choose to return to the real dimension early. If you have no clones but do have apostles, or if those apostles have clones, then you can take over either the apostle’s body or the clone’s body.

There is no limit to how many times you can do this.
addons.title: Diligent Soul

addons.text:
For most, death permanently strengthens their projections, making them autonomous to seek revenge. But your Authority has evolved beyond this. When you die, all your clones receive a permanent boost in power—and when you move into a clone’s body, so do you. If your current body dies, you retain the previous boost and gain another when you transfer to a new clone.

There is no limit to how many times this can occur. However, death is still a painful thing-you shouldn’t take it lightly, or you may become unrecognizable from who you once were.
addons.title: If you strike me down...

addons.text:
The number of your clones has increased to 5,000. Like your Unseen Hands, they are infused with your miasma, spreading it wherever they go. Anything your clones or hands touch becomes infected, allowing you to take control of living beings or transform objects into new, stationary hands.

When a person is infected, their body starts to resist their own will. At first, their movements become sluggish or unpredictable, but with time, they lose control entirely. Their limbs become yours to command, twisting and turning against them, until they can no longer fight back. If they die while still under your influence, their body becomes one of your clones, increasing the total number of clones you have.

Non-living objects touched by your hands or clones also change. Weapons, walls, and even the ground itself can become breeding grounds for your power, sprouting new stationary Unseen Hands that lash out at your enemies.
addons.title: The Grasping Plague

objects.text:
Your Authority allows you to manifest clones of yourself that exist in a dimension that coexists with our own. This enables them to physically interact with our dimension but remain unseen by anyone. You can create up to a maximum of 1,000 clones, each as powerful as you are and capable of using all your abilities. They can be as far away as the length of an average country and will obediently follow any order you command. You also have a general sense of the direction of each of your clones.

However, if you are asleep, you gain even greater control over your clones down to the finest detail. You can direct them with your thoughts, see through their eyes, and even spawn or summon additional clones near an existing one you are focusing on, as long as you do not exceed your 1,000-clone limit.

By sharing your Authority with apostles, you will reduce your maximum clone limit by an amount of your choosing. However, this allows your apostles to create their own clones and use them in locations beyond your normal maximum range. While asleep, you can also take control of your apostles' clones just as you would your own. In this case, the distance limit is measured from your apostle to their clone, meaning you could potentially control a clone on the other side of the planet.
objects.title: Authority of Sloth: Delegation

objects.text:
You have the ability to take others as subjects. What this means is that anyone who acknowledges themselves as being your subordinate, servant, slave, or simply someone lesser than you and listens to your commands will have their Od (Soul) connected to yours.

The first ability this grants is the ability to sense your subjects' general locations at all times. This also indirectly allows you to determine when someone is not your subject—either because you can't sense the connection or because the connection breaks, indicating that a subject has died or no longer considers themselves one.

The second ability allows you to draw upon the skills, abilities, powers, and even supernatural energies of your subjects. This works by granting you the best of each attribute among them. So, if one subject has the highest physical strength, you will be as strong as they are. If another has the best affinity for a specific magical element, you will gain that element and magical abilities. Unique traits, such as racial abilities, are also accessible to you. The same applies to skills, enabling you to tap into their tactics or political savvy.

You retain these benefits only as long as that specific subject remains connected to you. If you personally surpass all your subjects in a particular attribute—such as already possessing greater physical strength—then that attribute will not activate.
objects.title: Authority of Pride: King's Tithe

addons.text:
Your Authority has evolved massively. You're able to fuse inorganic things, such as metal or even natural elements like fire, seamlessly with organic things without any problems or limitations. This also allows you to transform parts of your body or others into things like half-flesh, half-fire creatures, humans into things like guns or swords, or even manipulate things like rocks into flesh, metal, or other materials by simply touching them.

Your own natural ability to shapeshift has grown enough that, as long as your soul is relatively intact, you can recreate your body from nothing.
addons.title: True Witch of Lust

addons.text:
Your ability to self-modify your biology is several orders of magnitude greater. Your starting strength in transformations is enough to raze cities to the ground or threaten to destroy a continent.

Whenever you transform into another form, you automatically begin finding ways to improve and enhance these forms well beyond their natural abilities. Transforming into a dragon that originally could only breathe fire and had scales strong enough to stop sniper shells would naturally lead you to upgrading this form—to use all elements of magic, have scales strong enough to shrug off anything below a nuclear bomb, and even possess magic blood capable of healing anything.

This process does not stop with the transformation itself but also enhances your base form with these traits. While observing other beings to copy their attributes will help speed this along, simply transforming by yourself would be enough to find ways to either merge the benefits of multiple forms or grant those benefits to your base form. This works on a soul-deep level, making even modifications to your soul a possibility.

This also allows you to apply the same enhancements to other people simply by looking at them—you no longer need to touch something to transform it.
addons.title: Apotheosis: Calamity

objects.text:
You have the ability to shapeshift. Doing this will allow you to change parts or your entire body into other people, animals, or even magical beasts like gryphons and dragons. You have instinctive knowledge of how to use such forms, such as immediately knowing how to fly and breathe fire as a dragon or how to grow and use a tail as a weapon. You do not need to physically see anything you want to turn into, but it will make it easier than trying to transform with no basis. This means you could potentially turn into someone you have never met, complete with their clothes and voice, just by looking at another person and shapeshifting based on reading their body language. As this type of transformation is soul-deep, you can split your consciousness by becoming things like a swarm of rats and talk and think through all of them.

This can also be used for healing by simply changing or replacing damaged body parts with fixed body parts. There is no real limit to how many times you can do this—things like being decapitated or cut in half would not slow you down and could simply be undone. This can also be done to anyone you're touching, such as turning them into giant flies, healing injuries, or even transforming them into piles of meat with no senses, a state that will last forever unless someone kills them.

Ingesting organic things like magical blood would add a permanent bonus to your biology that you can use as you wish and modify to be used on others. Your powers also work on dead things like corpses.

Your transformations with just this are roughly at the level to destroy several city blocks, but this grows with your personal growth. You cannot transform into things an order of magnitude greater than your base form's overall power.
objects.title: Authority of Lust: Transmutation and Transfiguration (Re:Zero)

objects.text:
The Flow Method is the process of handling and circulating the mana within one's body and utilizing it to enhance their physical capabilities. Through your sheer talent and potential, you've become something of a once-in-an-era prodigy, rivaling the Heavenly Sword, Reid Astrea, in its usage and technique.

Regardless of whether you started walking the path of a swordsman, martial artist, or shinobi, your sheer skill and talent have caused your body to efficiently and rapidly circulate your mana. If you were above average in superhuman physical abilities compared to other trained warriors in the world, you would, in at most a month, grow to the point of being able to kill your way through hordes of lesser knights. In a year, no one short of Reinhard van Astrea, the Divine Dragon, or Satella would have any hope of surviving against you and your lightning-fast combat speed.

If you chose the path of a martial artist, you would easily create and pick up techniques such as rapid short-range teleportation, the ability to reinforce your body to the point that it would require at least city-block-level attacks to scratch you, and palm strikes capable of ignoring a target's defenses to completely liquefy their insides.

If you chose the path of the sword, it would take weeks to recreate feats such as Cecilus' ability to cleave clouds in two with a single swing from the ground and, at most, two months to learn Reid's technique of cutting all things, including concepts and esoteric effects like black holes and supernatural bonds between people, with nothing but chopsticks.

Being a shinobi would make you quickly become a master of the art, allowing you to dive into shadows, transform your body into steel, make clones, or even manipulate one's soul to effectively rejuvenate the target's body and make them physically and mentally younger.

Regardless of what path you initially choose, you also gain a monstrously powerful extrasensory technique that allows you to have absolute memory and awareness of everyone and everything on the battlefield. This ability lets you run simulations in your head to the point that you could almost completely and accurately predict what they will do, as if they were actors on a preplanned stage. This also enables feats such as picking up a new weapon you've never used, running endless simulations of yourself training in your head, and allowing you to skip the years or decades of practice required to instantly become a master of that weapon.

An indirect benefit of your ability to circulate your mana is that your body will always match your skill. Because of this and your gate's indestructibility on top of your soul's (Od) ever-expanding capacity, you do not need to fear ceasing to exist, regardless of how hard you push your abilities or whom you kill with them.
objects.title: Stick Swinger (Re:Zero)

addons.text:
You suffer from the same problem Satella did, but worse! Not only is the Witch Factor of Envy trying to take over your body as a split personality or drive you mad, but the original Satella is also another split personality. While you aren't as crazy as the original Satella, there will be potential situations where one of them takes over your body for a short period of time and goes on a rampage, especially if one of your apostles breaks your Taboo.

If you were the Perfect Host, or had some kind of mental protection or a strong enough soul to fight off possession, the other personalities would either lose all potency, disappear completely, or merge into you harmlessly.
addons.title: Half-Elves Rioting

objects.text:
You've become the next coming of Satella. You gain the knowledge of her abilities, her raw power, her immortality, and, if you wish, her mind, body, and soul. With this, your overall power is enough to become a world-threatening force.

You have the ability to manipulate Yin magic on a level greater than that of a Great Spirit of Yin, allowing you to stop time, summon others from different worlds, break into others' pocket dimensions, wield shadows like a veil that nullifies physical damage, and even shape the shadows into tendrils and hands on a scale greater than the Authority of Sloth. Over time, these shadows can spread and consume everything they touch. There is no maximum range—if you persist long enough, you could cover a continent or even the entire world.

You also possess a form of immortality that even the most powerful beings in the world cannot overcome. While you can be harmed and feel pain, your body cannot be destroyed. You do not require sustenance or air, you do not age, and attacks that target the soul cause no lasting damage, as any harm is undone almost instantly. While you can potentially be sealed, your mastery of Yin magic allows you to eventually break free from any form of entrapment.

Additionally, you can grant your Apostles the power of Return by Death. This comes with an automatically placed Taboo that prevents them from revealing the existence of Return by Death. If they attempt to break this restriction, you will immediately become aware, and their fate will be left to your discretion.
objects.title: Witch of Envy (Re:Zero)

objects.text:
You have risen to a level of prowess rivaling Reinhard Van Astrea, the greatest Sword Saint ever known. Your swordsmanship is nothing short of inhuman. Your capacity to absorb mana from the atmosphere has surged dramatically, allowing mana to circulate through your body without causing harm. Even without your Divine Protections, you're swift enough to cross a city in under thirty seconds, resilient enough to survive being thrown from Earth to the Moon, and strong enough to endure a return jump from the Moon back to Earth. Because of your gate's increased strength in absorbing mana everyone within the vicinity are unable to cast spells through usage of external mana, as all mana from the atmosphere diverts to you.

You have also gained access to the Swordplay of the Astrea family, which enables you to draw immense amounts of mana into any weapon and release it in a single, devastating swing. With an ordinary iron sword, you could unleash enough energy to demolish a house. Be warned: most mundane and even several supernatural weapons or objects would be reduced to dust by the sheer volume of mana you infuse into the blade.

Additionally, you now possess the Dragon Sword Reid, a blade that can only be wielded by you. This sword is considered an Object of Power, and should you ever lose it, you can summon it back to yourself. Crafted by an unknown smith and blessed by the Sword God, this sword is indestructible and can cut through nearly anything. It comes with a scabbard named Dragon Claw, which was fashioned with grooves made by the Divine Dragon Volcanica. Blessed by the Sword God, the blade cannot be drawn from its scabbard unless facing a worthy opponent. When drawn, your chance of losing against your foe is effectively zero.
objects.title: Strongest Sword Saint (Re:Zero)

addons.text:
Your dragon companion is now Volcanica himself—or rather, a perfected fusion of Al and the Divine Dragon. In this timeline, Al forced Volcanica’s dormant Husk to read his Book of Death, causing their minds to merge fully within Volcanica’s body. This Al originates from a reality where you replaced Priscilla in every possible way, and this version of you is an exact duplicate of yourself. He is Al as of Arc 9—meaning he watched you die. Because of this, he is fiercely, obsessively overprotective of you, his loyalty absolute, unshakeable, and entirely yours.

Volcanica’s form is immense and awe-inspiring, coated in pale blue scales that gleam like jewels. Its thick, heavy paws end in black stone-like claws capable of rending diamonds without resistance. Its face resembles an ancient earth-dragon, framed by two sweeping milky-white horns, while brilliant gold eyes radiate wisdom and overwhelming majesty. Merely standing before him feels like inhaling without permission. Beneath his jaw lies the infamous white scar—an impossibly sensitive spot that sends the Divine Dragon into a murderous frenzy if touched by anyone but himself, or you.

As both Volcanica and Al, his capabilities are overwhelming. His scales, claws, and fangs vastly surpass diamond in durability and destructive power. The halo above his head grants immeasurable magical defense—magic on the “Al” level cannot scratch him, and even Roswaal L. Mathers unleashing many five-fold spells of the Al tier failed to leave a mark. Only the Dragon Sword can bypass this defense. His mana reserves are titanic, capable of cleansing and a making a dense aura of magic in an area the size of modern-day New York City—snuffing out fires, mending injuries, and restoring purity to all within range.

Volcanica’s magical prowess extends far beyond human limits: he flies using mana rather than wings, twists space to bypass durability entirely, and commands fire, wind, and earth on a scale fit for a natural disaster. His conceptual breath attacks can erase ideas such as sound itself. His Purification Breath reduces targets to dust, while his blood acts as a miracle substance capable of healing illnesses, restoring vitality, ending famine, and even reversing death instantly. His breath adapts fluidly—incinerating heat, freezing mist, or combined shockwaves of vapor and flame. Though often depicted crouched at sixteen meters, his true size approaches thirty. Some legends even claim he created other dragons through unknown means.

Added to all of this are Al’s own abilities, now perfectly harmonized with the Divine Dragon—save for his Domain. Al possesses encyclopedic magical knowledge rivaling Echidna herself, having been personally trained by her. Among his most infamous spells is Al Karum, a hyper-dense gravitational black hole capable of crushing anything caught within. Ol Shamak, an anti-Witch spell originating from Echidna, traps anyone bearing a Witch Factor or Authority inside an impenetrable black sphere—one so strong that only the Dragon Sword can break it.

Al also wields Al Shario, the forbidden magic that calls stardust from the heavens, manifesting as countless meteors that devastate entire battlefields. He can generate dual vertical cylinders crackling with violet lightning, firing bullets shaped from Volcanica’s own scales and molded through earth magic into liuyedao-like projectiles. These shots are so fast and precise that even Reinhard van Astrea cannot completely avoid them—and multiple shots can be fired in rapid succession.
addons.title: Alter Reborn

addons.text:
As you possess Return by Death, a third Authority has awakened—a seamless fusion of Al’s Domain and Subaru’s power. Al’s own Authority was merely an incomplete, and inferior copy of Return by Death, its instability giving rise to the Aggressor state, and as an active ability rather then passive. But in your hands, the cycle of death and return completes that lost fragment, allowing it to bloom into something far more.

This third Authority manifests as a sub-effect of Return by Death:
when you die, all those responsible for your death are forced to relive the full chain of events that led to it.

The Authority traces responsibility with terrifying precision. If someone speaks carelessly about you, and their words lead others to capture you, who in turn deliver you to torturers, and those torturers leave you for another to kill—then each participant is dragged into a personalized reenactment of your final moments. They experience it from an observer’s perspective, yet feel every sensation you endured, magnified in proportion to their involvement.

The one who spoke your name feels the pain of your death.
Those who seized you feel the kidnapping, the helplessness, and the final blow.
The torturers suffer every act they inflicted upon you—tenfold, without relief.
And the one who ended your life feels the death itself twice over, drowning in your agony, and terror.

Every participant is forced to witness, to feel, and to understand exactly what their choices caused, every being affected is bound to always remember this, and never tell anyone, other then other affected.

If this addon is activated because of Satella (Re:Zero), each punishment intensifies—It becomes not merely karmic retribution but a divine warning:
a punishment delivered on behalf of the Witch who loves you beyond reason.
addons.title: The Perfected Loop

objects.text:
You have gained the unknown Authority possessed by Aldebaran, granting you the ability known as Domain. When activated, this Authority manifests as a vast, inescapable dome of absolute darkness—a phenomenon often described as a Domain Expansion, as it represents the outward expansion of your Authority. Once formed, the dome isolates everything within it and enforces a repeating sequence of time known as Death Loops, time outside of the Domain is also effected. If you die while the Domain is active, time resets to the exact moment the Domain was first created.

The Authority operates through two states: Victim and Aggressor. In the Victim state, you retain the memories of every loop while your opponent forgets them entirely. This allows you to attempt the battle an unlimited number of times, gradually learning your opponent’s abilities, patterns, and weaknesses while refining your own skill through repeated experience. In the Aggressor state, the roles reverse: you lose all memory of each loop, while your opponent is forced to remember every reset. The cycle can repeat endlessly, placing the psychological burden entirely on your enemy. Over time, the repeated deaths and unavoidable resets can shatter their will, break their mind, or erode their desire to continue fighting.

You may choose which state the Authority manifests as when you activate it, and if you have some way to have it activate automatically, such as if you have the Universal Upgrade Automatic Defense, it will activate in the Aggressor mode.

Once the Domain is established, nothing within it can end the loop except you. No external force, ability, or intervention can override or collapse it. The Authority will persist until you willingly deactivate it. To withstand the strain of such an ability, you also inherit the exceptional mental resilience possessed by Al, granting you the stability required to endure the endless cycles and wield the Domain, and anything else that may cause great suffering to you, such as any other Death Loop powers, at their full potential. If you have the power Color Mage (Re:Zero) then you may also inherit his intellect, knowledge, memories, other abilities, skills, etc, though your affinity with Earth and Yin would be the same as his unless you choose either as the mage your the color of. you can choose how the memories affect you, if at all. You may also optionally have the habit of saying "Your Stars Were Bad" to anyone you catch in your Authority, or fight in general.
objects.title: Your Stars Were Bad (Re:Zero)

objects.text:
Your expertise in crafting magical items has allowed you to create truly magnificent creations. You can now imbue complex algorithms into your creations, allowing for them to emulate basic powers. For example, instead of a "fireball" spell, a golem could have a complex series of commands which cast different fire spells in different situations, emulating a "Fire Magic" power. Theoretically, you can have a maximum of 15 different emulations on a single object, though this is provides diminishing returns and is unrealistic in terms of time and resource cost.

Furthermore, your creations gain a major increase to all basic stats. Weapons casually crafted and discarded by you would be top-of-the line works for other enchanters. Your creations also usually contain several advanced functions beyond just raw power and durability to enhance the usage of the power, such being soulbound or transforming into a mundane object. 

You can also bestow objects with innate abilities. These are similar to enchantments in function but do not require any magical energy for use. You can turn basic enchantments into innate abilities with ease. With a little bit of work, you could even turn a single power emulation into an innate ability.

Finally, you can create a single object as the culmination of your life's work, known as a Magnum Opus. This artifact will be far beyond the norm in every aspect, and contain a single immeasurably strong ability. For example, you could create armor that is in temporal stasis, allowing the wielder to be invincible instead of merely durable. Your magnum opus can also hold infinite power emulations and innate abilities, though you will run into the same problem of diminishing returns and resource/time cost for the former.
objects.title: Transcendent Creations (JRPG Traitor)

objects.text: "At this point communication is impossible. From her intellectual heights, we are little more than apes." ~ Alkian Researcher Instead of having a fancy stick or a pointy rod, you are capable of bridging the gap between creator and creation. Your magnum opus is now your own body. This has a few benefits right off the bat: perfect memory, greatly enhanced intelligence, superior physicality, and absolute self-biokinesis. Your self modification is to the extent that you have perfect awareness and manual control over every molecule within your body. You are akin to a well-oiled machine, with no wastage or inefficiency. This removes your need to sleep, eat, drink, or breathe. You have an inbuilt cooling system allowing you to perfectly regulate body temperature, with the default being -100°C. However, the true potential of your body lies within your self-modification. You gain a supernatural talent and understanding of biological functions, which you can utilize to continuously upgrade and modify your body. If you encounter other powered creatures, creations, or lifeforms you can incorporate their design, such as cellular processes, in order to make your own body more efficient. Due to your biokinesis, you can implement changes immediately after thinking of them rather than performing a surgery. Your body is also a nigh-perfect physical catalyst for magic. Any magic you cast or utilize is amplified by your body, in addition to any other catalysts, wands, or tomes that you use. Furthermore, your body is naturally receptive to magical modifications. For example, you could modify your bone marrow to automatically enchant every single cell it produces. You have a natural resistance to foreign spells, taking no damage from anything weaker than sniper bullets.
objects.title: Apotheosis: Wonder

addons.text:
You have also inherited Rennala's talent as the Headmaster of Raya Lucaria, capable of creating a new Golden Age of Sorcery. You can determine a prospective student's magical energy reserves, affinities, and regeneration rate at a glance. After a short conversation, you could sense their determination, talent, and interests. 

While anyone can theoretically use Sorcery, you have a particular gift for guiding others to awaken and use their magical energies. As you teach someone the theoretical prerequisites behind Sorcery (such as mathematics, physics, and the principles of magical energy), they begin to awaken the dormant magical energy within themselves, eventually becoming capable of casting sorceries themselves. You can forcefully condense this process into an instant by flooding your own magic within them, though this is incredibly painful. Sorcerors created in the latter manner also won't know anything about using their magical energy.

You can easily subdivide complex Sorcery topics into basic, fundamental principles and instill them upon your students. This allows you to greatly speed up the learning process, allowing for you to turn a dedicated student into an apprentice sorcerer equivalent to those seen in Raya Lucaria (who have studied their entire lives) in as little as 3-5 years. Your understanding of the foundations of sorcery also allows you to analyze the spells of your opponents and find counters or even create your own version. Furthermore, this has also greatly boosted your own learning rate, allowing you to learn new sorceries in mere minutes as long as they work on principles you already understand.

An identical copy of the academy Raya Lucaria is added as a section of the archive, matching to the theme of the rest of the Archive. All of your other powers also have a similar dedicated section in the Archive, with the same proportional increase in knowledge as Raya Lucaria. You may also add knowledge you find or uncover, including those completely unrelated to your powers, to the archive. You start with copies of all texts in Raya Lucaria when it was founded (several generations before Rennala took over).
addons.title: Headmaster of Raya Lucaria

objects.text:
Your talent and understanding of sorcery have reached the level of Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon. 

Rather than a direct boost to the strength of your sorceries, this has instead boosted your theoretical knowledge and spell creation capabilities greatly. Your greater understanding of magic allows for you to alter existing spells via meta-magic, allowing for you to decrease cast time, adjust power, and control visual effects all on the fly. Whenever you are casting a spell, you may preset a trajectory for it to follow, allowing for your projectiles to curve, make sharp turns, and dodge obstacles. This trajectory cannot be changed once you finish the casting process.

You can easily create new top-tier sorceries for daily life, utility, and combat. The quality of the sorceries you create are leagues above all others, making Lusat and Azur's magnum opuses look like a kindergartner's attempt at theoretical physics. This is primarily shown in efficiency — you can achieve the same level of strength as other high-level spellcasters at a far lower cost. 

Your mental capabilities have also vastly increased. You gain an increase to your pattern recognition, memorization, analysis, and observational skills. Furthermore, you can easily partition your mind to do multiple tasks at once, allowing for you to perform multiple steps to cast a spell at the same time. This has greatly increased your casting speed, to the extent that you can create a magic circle milliseconds after you think about it. You can also cast around 5 spells which require intense focus at the same time. 

Finally, your fine control over your magic is greatly enhanced. You may manifest a minute amount of your magic power as a blue glow, which you can perfectly control. This is to the extent that you could use it to turn meteors into refined metals with ease. The wastage of your spells is greatly lessened and they are precise enough to perfectly match your intentions, lowering their cost even further.
objects.title: Sorcerer Queen (Elden Ring)

objects.text: For every purchase of this upgrade, you gain an additional star. Allowing you to use different kinds of magic instead of being restricted to one kind of magic. Additionally, the stars will be able to work alongside each other to enhance each other symbiotically.
objects.title: Star Cluster

objects.text: You have been selected, chosen, by one of the great elemental parliaments. You are their conduit and their avatar in the world. The parliaments themselves are merely arbiters. They represent the elemental plane they are composed of, but they are not its master. However, as its custodian, they are the limiter on the power you can draw from their elemental plane. You must act in it’s interest, and ensure its wellbeing to become or remain their most praised Avatar. The abilities of an avatar are largely dependent on the parliament they represent. The Parliament of Trees, representing the Green and all plant life in the universe, for instance, granted their Swamp Thing complete regenerative abilities and absolute control over plant matter no matter it’s origin nor circumstance. Their ally The Parliament of Limbs, representing The Red and all animal life, meanwhile tends to grant their avatars shapeshifting capabilities and rapid adaptation to unknown limits. These abilities can become stranger and more esoteric the further one moves from classical elements and towards concepts, such as the Rithm, representing technology and metal, or The Parliament of Decay and all dead things, offering its avatars complete and unconditional immortality. While your parliament is stationary, only existing within your local multiversal cluster, the elemental force it represents is near omnipresent across the omniverse. Their respective parliaments or lack thereof may be alien and strange, but it is nearly always existent in some regard. Furthermore, the Parliaments (or their equivalent) reserve the right to alter their gifts, including their conditions or mechanism therein. While this can be detrimental, if you serve them well you’ll quickly find them very willing to extend your powers and influence. to serve the ends of the parliament, of course. If you possess connections to multiple elemental realms, you may become an avatar of each corresponding parliament, but be warned that this comes with more responsibilities upon you and wills to carry out, sometimes openly contradictory to each other. Note that the Parliaments are not omnipotent, nor are they infallible. With guile and strength their usurpation is possible, but take care the realm's own will does not find you wanting in their stead.
objects.title: Avatar of the Parliament (DC Comics)

objects.text:
You possess the unique magical expertise of the Devil Nezha, designed to bend natural phenomena and dimensional walls to your will. Using it you may adapt to every science, force, and element you know of, rendering yourself immune to them and allowing you to manipulate them. You have the potential to fight Superman one-on-one and win or tear your way out of the Phantom Zone back into reality. However, up against a phenomena you are not familiar with, such as new materials, energies, or technologies, you are vulnerable until you adapt. It also seems possible to combat you with simple overwhelming physical force, but apparently not put you down for more than a minute or so at best.

You also know the art of Possession, allowing you to control the minds of people remotely, making them loyal to you and empowering their own abilities with your magic. This is potent enough to even control the mind of a Green Lantern without letting them fight back and can control millions of people at once. Your control breaks if you lose your concentration, even for a moment, or get sent far enough away, such as into another dimension.

Unlike most magic users, you don’t need to perform any special actions to use your spells. Both adaptation and possession require only a moment of thought to use.
objects.title: Devil Nezha (DC Comics)

objects.text:
Rather than just a connection, the Titan gifted you a large amount of their magic through a spell of their making, resulting in you becoming a Titan hybrid. You no longer need to draw glyphs, you can just create them midair in order to use their magic and can now draw spell circles to perform magic like a Witch. Magic perfomed through one of yours spell circles is a mix of witch and glyph magic. Due to being a pseudo-titan you are immune to the magic of the Collectors. You can infuse your screams with magic and your body is immune to heat.

You now have complete knowledge of how the language of Titans work allowing you to quickly know what you need to use for a spell.

Your body changed and any clothes you wear changes with you. You are taller and your hands and feet become bony while bone surrounds other parts of your body like your ribs. You are covered in fur from the neck and below. A small glowing circle surrounded surrounded by another circle connected to a smaller one through a line are in your chest. Your sclera becomes black, your iris gold, glyphs surround your pulpis and your pupils have a glyph within them. You have fangs and horns.
objects.title: Titan Blessed (The Owl House)

objects.text:
Are you tired of the whims of RNGesus dictating your spell selection? Feeling limited by one-trick pony Spell Crystals? Have you ever fantasized about a wand so potent it could level mountains with a mere breeze? Well, step aside aspiring wizards, because you're about to become the Da Vinci of Wand Crafting, and the world is going to suffer for it!

First and foremost, say goodbye to the frustrating randomness of Spell Crystals! Now you can pick EXACTLY what you want your crystal to do. Fireball? Check. Summon a battalion of angry squirrels? You're the boss! Even the various perks of Noita aren't beyond you at this point.

Forget single-effect Crystals. You'll be able to cram MULTIPLE spells and effects into one crystal! Just be careful, unintended Crytals interactions might make your wand, and more importantly you, go kablooey!

This level of mastery even transcends the limits of Noita and Mashle! Now you can create Spell Crystals from all sorts of wacky effects, like the powerful spells from the world of Mashle, and the unhinge catalogs of Noita's expansions like Apotheosis, Graham's Things, and so much more!

But the real kicker? From now on you can create entirely NEW spells, effects, even perks! Ever dreamt of a spell that turns enemies into miniature Cthulhu? or even summoning your favorite Waifu? Well with enough study and experimentation (and maybe a dash of madness), you can make it happen!

Just remember, with power this great, there's a fine line between legendary hero and accidental harbinger of the apocalypse. But hey, that's half the fun, right?
objects.title: I See No God Up Here, But Me!

objects.text: You gain a Lesser Sorcery of your choice, allowing you to manipulate an additional element. This new Sorcery provides basic control over the element, enabling you to perform simple but powerful feats. Examples include creating fireballs with Fire Sorcery, shaping earth with Earth Sorcery, or healing wounds with Life Sorcery. Note: This upgrade cannot be selected for the same element as Additional Greater Sorcery.
objects.title: Additional Lesser Sorcery

objects.text: You gain a Greater Sorcery of your choice, allowing you to manipulate an additional element. This new Sorcery provides advanced control over the element, making you highly skilled in its use. Examples include creating a raging inferno with Fire Sorcery, generating portals over great distances with Spacetime Sorcery, or completely transforming a body with Flesh Sorcery. Note: This upgrade cannot be selected for the same element as Additional Lesser Sorcery.
objects.title: Additional Greater Sorcery

objects.text:
Your beautiful voice has gained an alternative twisted oppression. Every word you speak can be psychically create ravings. Ravings are various messages, words, and phrases the only the victim can hear, with a supernatural ability to cause madness. You can choose the exact wording of the ravings, as long as they are loosely related to yourself (notable locations, your philosophy, songs you have created, or even your pet's name). The exact number of words has no effect on the power of the raving, you can have a simple annoying catchphrase or thousands of maddening sounds overlapping at once with the same degree of corruption. 

The speed at which a target afflicted with ravings goes insane and duration of the ravings depends on their relative power level and their mental/soul defenses. Ravings have no effect on someone on your strength level, but a civilian without mental protections would immediately become a fanatical worshipper with a single word from you. Someone with decent mental protections will still take permanent damage if they are far weaker than you, and will experience effects such as seeing things they shouldn't see or hearing things they shouldn't hear. These effects will make it easier to corrupt them further in the future.

Furthermore, your melodies also gain some additional improvements. You can now channel your ravings through a melody, which can afflict everyone in a large radius. You can also somewhat control the exact mental effects by changing the lyrics of the song, though they all generally trend to become more fanatical towards you. 

Finally, your music gains the ability to cleanse corruption of all kinds. Songs created by you naturally cleanse mental pollution, cure eldritch madness, and rejuvenate the souls of those who hear it. The effect isn't very strong, but can quickly add up over multiple doses. Songs which take advantage of this cannot cause ravings.
objects.title: Rap God

objects.text:
The opposite of Wakfu, Stasis is the energy of destruction, death, and stillness, created when Wakfu is stopped from moving. You now possess the knowledge of how to safely wield Stasis as well as convert Wakfu into Stasis without killing yourself in the process. You also gain knowledge of how to drain Wakfu from other beings, although don’t expect it to be good for their health, you are literally draining their life force.

As Stasis is basically destruction and death given form, it is much more suited to destructive and harmful acts, capable of harming even the gods with enough potency or even just sheer quantity. In addition to manipulating raw Stasis, you can also substitute Stasis for Wakfu for an extra umph.
objects.title: Stasis (Dofus)

addons.text:
Well this is interesting, you are no ordinary Eliatrope, you are one of the Council of Six, composed of the first 6 - now 7 - Eliatropes in existence, spawned from the Goddess Eliatrope’s second dance with the Great Dragon, the Incarnation of Stasis and progenitor of dragons. To give an example of how important this is, the first dance of the Goddess Eliatrope and Great Dragon birthed the entire universe of Dofus, making you essentially the younger sibling of a literal universe. 

Now you’d think that being the child of two primordial gods would make you incredibly powerful, and to a certain extent it does, but most of that power instead goes to your unique form of immortality, your Dofus. Your Dofus is an egg-like object of great power, which can either be wielded as a potent source of Wakfu and power enhancer - such that wielding six at a time could grant enough power to retroactively create an entire race of copies of yourself - or more importantly, serves as your source of rebirth.

See, whenever both you and your dragon twin - I’ll get back to that shortly - die your Wakfu returns to your Dofus and once both of you have returned to it you are “born” anew from it as a child, although this may take time. While most of the others lose their memories and accumulate power when undergoing rebirth, you retain both, so take care not to go mad from boredom.

Even without an initial boost in power, your potential and affinity for Wakfu and Stasis alike is incredible, as befitting of your heritage. Even as a child you can achieve things such as conjuring weapons of Wakfu or chaining portals fast enough to appear as a blurring stream of energy, as well as resist a time stop spell. As you age and grow in skill your power only grows until you can feasibly challenge the very gods, outright breaking the previously mentioned time stop spells or conjuring countless portals to surround a target and fire a seemingly endless barrage of Stasis beams at them. Your physical prowess similarly befits your heritage, such that as an adult you could beat a dragon of similar heritage into submission with your bare hands.

Lastly, accompanying you in life is your dragon twin, born from the same Dofus as you as a result of being the spawn of the first dragon. Your twin has a similar mindset and set of morals to you and shares your ability to retain memories and power, in fact possessing even greater reserves of Wakfu as a result of their draconic body. Your twin possesses a limited form of innate shapeshifting which allows them to achieve a human(ish) body if they so choose. You may choose now to share any of your powers with your twin as they are all but the literal other half of your existence.
addons.title: Firstborn

addons.text:
Your usage of lifeforce in the form of Touki and Senjutsu synergizes greatly with your innate ability to wield Wakfu, the energy of life. Your internal pool of Wakfu balloons in size to the point that if you were a normal Eliatrope you could rival one of the Firstborn, and if you were a Firstborn yourself you could match lesser gods in power. 

You also gain the knowledge of how to use Wakfu to achieve more exotic effects, bestowing upon you the basics of all races’ usage of Wakfu, from the Xelors’ time manipulation to the elemental runes of the Huppermages. Furthermore, your innate intuition towards Senjutsu now extends to Wakfu as well, allowing you to naturally discover and create new uses of Wakfu with startling ease.

You also gain the ability to substitute Wakfu for lifeforce when using Senjutsu, allowing you to enact powerful effects without needing to use up your own lifeforce, or even combine both to empower effects beyond their normal limits.
addons.title: Overflowing Life

addons.text: You are truly your mother’s child, in time rising to match her as a God/Goddess of Wakfu. Having inherited her Domain of Wakfu, the potency and quantity of your Wakfu is unmatched by all but your mother, such that in time your mere presence can breathe life in entire planets, and Wakfu seamlessly follows your will, seemingly eager to obey you. If you possess the Firstborn addon you also inherit your father’s Domain of Stasis, experiencing a similar boost to potency and control. With Authority over both Wakfu and Stasis you could in time theoretically create your own universe, recreating your parents’ first Dance which birthed the very Krosmoz.
addons.title: Sibling of the Krosmoz

objects.text:
You are not merely a wielder of Wakfu, you are a child of it. You have become an Eliatrope, the children of the Great Goddess Eliatrope, the very incarnation of Wakfu. You possess a much greater affinity for Wakfu, instinctively capable of acts such as portals or beams of pure Wakfu, as well as sensing its presence. 

As a member of what is effectively an entire species of pseudo-demigods, your physical capabilities experience a moderate increase and your lifespan and Wakfu reserves are noticeably greater. Lastly, you possess a pair of wing-like protrusions of Wakfu coming from your head which move in response to your emotions. These wing-like protrusions seem to provide innate flight capabilities even without flapping.
objects.title: Eliatrope (Dofus)

objects.text: With this you have learned all the basics and become a proper Magician, with this comes the ability to summon and bind Djinn of all forms with ease, and even bind the mighty Afrits with some practice. Alongside this you gain the ability to peer into the Third and Fourth of the Seven planes with clarity, allowing you to see through all but the best of the spirits many guises.
objects.title: Magician (Bartimaeus Sequence)

addons.text: How on earth you gained this will forever be a mystery, for upon your finger rests the legendary artifact known as the Ring of Solomon which contains the Greater Spirit Uraziel and allows you to command that being's terrible power. It acts as a gateway to the Other Place through which it can summon legions of spirits, such as Afrits, Marids, and even some of the Being's of Great and Terrible Power, binding them to the ringbearer’s will. It allows the wearer to completely and utterly bypass the summoning process, and even dismiss the spirits summoned by other Magicians
addons.title: Solomon's Ring

objects.text: And now with this you have reached the lofty heights of legends such as Gladstone and Solomon, capable of summoning and binding even the awe inspiring Marid’s by yourself, with time and practice you might even be able to summon the entities that lie beyond even them the “Great Entities of Terrible Power” who can make all of reality shake at their presence. Along with this you gain the ability to see into the Fifth and Sixth Planes accurately.
objects.title: Legend (Bartimaeus Sequence)

objects.text: 'I WAS BORN FROM YOUR DREAM.' 'THESE SWORDS ALWAYS STRIKE TRUE' True Excalibur enforces the user's will onto reality, seeking the path to fulfill its user's wishes and PURIFY all that try to defy it. Neither a labyrinth of infinitely branching possibilities nor the rush of impending doom could thwart its purpose. True Excalibur appearance is that of a ring made of 10 colossal swords floating above the stratosphere at medium planetary orbit height; for each blade that you conjure, it will cost one-twentieth of your mana or the equivalent supernatural energy pool. With each swing of its blade, True Excalibur purifies all fates, rewriting reality without the user's conscious effort, being undetectable by all whenever it is used. But this power is not without any limitations, those being the user's strength and relative ease of the task set before True Excalibur, both of which will determine the cost of its usage and the strain it puts upon you. When faced against an impossible opponent or improbable odds, True Excalibur will shatter one of its blades in the process, putting a strain on your body. If you were to try to change something that has a near-impossible minuscule chance of ever happening, then be ready to die afterward. On the other hand, if you were to use True Excalibur to change things that you can already do yourself or have fair odds of doing, then the cost would only be equivalent to the energy needed to create one of its blades. True Excalibur is sentient and will always understand the user's wish correctly, even if the user is unsure of their own wish.
objects.title: True Excalibur (I was reincarnated as the 7th prince)

objects.text: 'He lost everything that day. That was the day it was given to him.' Unholy Excalibur is a unique type of Holy Magic called artifact, crafted by sheer willpower and despair; it manifests as weapons created from Holy Magic. Unholy Excalibur wields the power to conjure anti-symbols; these symbols manifest on the weapon itself, displaying conceptual images of the target, and purify everything analysed by the user by using the purification aspect of Holy Magic. This [purification] can nullify either the target itself or its attacks. However, it bears two vulnerabilities. First, the wielder must comprehend the target, or it will behave as normal holy magic weapons; second, the symbol must not be too generic - individual entities can be purified, but not creatures in general or common magic.
objects.title: Unholy Excalibur (I was reincarnated as the 7th prince)

objects.text: You have become attuned to one of the main archangels of Christianity, such as Uriel, Raphael, or Gabriel, although you are not yet qualified to be attuned to Michael. To achieve this, a complex ritual was performed, diluting your original sin as much as humanly possible. Instead of regular mana, Telesma now flows through you. While much more potent than mana, enhancing all the spells you wield, this comes with its own inherent limitations. As original sin in this case means consuming the fruit from the Tree of Knowledge, you lose the ability to cast normal human magic unless specifically converted to align with the nature of your chosen archangel. But beware, the more complex the spell and the less it originally aligns with your archangel, the harder it will be to convert, with some spells being outright impossible if they have a completely antithetical nature. In place of human magic, you can now use angelic magic aligned with your chosen archangel, which would be out of the reach of normal magicians. For example, archangel Gabriel rules over the symbol of water, is the guardian of the moon, and is the governor of blue. This means that you can easily cast a multitude of angelic spells relating to those categories, and any spell you knew previously that is aligned with Gabriel's nature will become exponentially more powerful, as well as relatively easy to convert to function properly with regards to your new nature. At the start, you will gain innate knowledge of a dozen new such spells, as well as intuitive understanding and a predisposition towards developing new ones. Lastly, you gain access to a special incredibly powerful spell that symbolises your attunement to an archangel. You can choose to have the spell of a canonical member of the God's Right Seat, for example, Vento's Divine Punishment that strips people across the world of their consciousness if they bear any ill will towards you, or you can design your own of a similar nature. With practice and dedicated study, you may develop more similar spells, as well as refine the ones you already know, possibly even unlocking the spells used by archangels themselves.
objects.title: God's Right Seat (Raildex)

objects.text: You are now attuned to the archangel Michael, who occupies God's Right Seat in Heaven, awakening the Holy Right, the embodiment of the Right Hand within Christianity. It manifests itself as a mirage hand that appears like a bird's talon, growing out of your right shoulder. This power allows you to recreate all the miracles from Christianity that were performed with the right hand, such as healing the sick or even casting someone into hell. The nature of the Holy Right also imbues you with a massive amount of Telesma, more so than any saint could possess, as well as the ability to freely control it and utilise this holy energy for attacks or other uses, such as instantly creating tens of kilometres long swords of fire, moving instantly across any horizontal space as easy as walking, telepathic communication, and much more. But the most impressive ability is unique to the Holy Right itself. This ability is twofold. First, when you designate a target, such as an individual, an army, or even a more abstract concept like 'all the evil in the hearts of people', the Holy Right will raise all your abilities to the level of the threat you face. Secondly, the Holy Right will always use precisely enough force to either defend you or attack your target. When shielding you from attacks, nothing will scratch you, as your defences will always increase to accommodate, and when you attack, the Holy Right will always output the exact amount of force necessary to instantly eradicate your opponent, ignoring the very concept of distance to always strike at the intended target, even teleporting you to it at the moment of the attack, should you so desire. This great power does come with few limitations. First, while the Holy Right will automatically defend you, for more active use it needs to be fully summoned, as well as directed by your own right hand. As such, were you to ever lose your hand, you will lose the ability to consciously command the Holy Right. When fully summoned, the Holy Right experiences strain to maintain itself, as your body could not embody the full might of the miracles it represents; as such, it will slowly desintegrate, with active use also hastening the desintegration the greater the task you are trying to perform. Once desummoned, it will always slowly restore itself, ready to be wielded by you again, but it will take about a month to restore itself were it to be completely spent. Lastly, your human body also imposes a limit on the strength of your replicated miracles, with them being only a fraction of the strength of the original.
objects.title: Holy Right (Raildex)

objects.text: With the knowledge from 103'000 grimoires and assistance from Imagine Breaker, you have purified the holy right and your own existence, getting rid completely of the original sin. This allowed you to finally reach the position of The One Above God, the ultimate goal for which organisation God's Right Seat was created in the first place and the highest attainable rank on the magic side of the world. No longer does Holy Right contradicts your, now sinless, nature, thus eliminating any and all weaknesses and limitations it once had. No longer it experiences any strain, always operating at its fullest capacity. You can now perform any miracle from Christianity, regardless of its nature, at full strength, as well as have absolute authority over everything originating from Christianity, even Heaven itself. As One Above God you are capable of even such incredible feats as bringing heaven down to earth and flooding the world in an endless amount of Telesma, resurrecting people, regulating the flow of souls into heaven and hell, etc. You also hold absolute dominion over every angel from Christianity, able to summon them at will, or use any and all of their spells yourself with complete mastery, even incredibly powerful and complex ones such as Astro In Hand, for example, that allows archangel Gabriel to manipulate and move every star in the night sky at will, as well as use their light as a giant magic circle to turn said stars into billions of arrows of fire to rain down on earth. Lastly, Imagine Breaker, merged with your Holy Right, has also evolved. No longer is it limited to your right arm, now automatically breaking down any supernatural phenomenon that comes into contact with you. You can also utilise it at great range to facilitate such feats as fixing the distortions of the natural laws across the entire universe. Moreover, as you now possess authority over the creation unmatched even by the Christian God, you are no longer limited to breaking down only what is considered supernatural by the world itself. You can now denote any aspect of the world as either natural or supernatural, establishing a new baseline to which everything will be reverted by the Imagine Breaker.
objects.title: La Persona Superiore a Dio (Raildex)

objects.text:
You are now the guardian of the universe and all the stars within it. Souls and star seeds are your domain to protect, you have power equal to that of Sailor Cosmos.

You have reached the apex of your power as a Sailor Guardian. Your Sailor Guardian powers increase by an order of magnitutde again.
