You could go from Earth to the center of the galaxy in mere seconds, walk on a black hole with only minor discomfort, overcome temporal paradox and other incredible feats. Your power level is sufficient to protect the entire universe, and more in the fullness of time. 

You also gain the ability to transform others into Sailor Guardians with a touch. You can choose the powers and theme of their magical attacks or leave it to them to decide. Regardless, a planet can only have one Sailor Guardian at a time. Anyone you make a Sailor Guardian also gets a transformation item to transform. As you granted them their power and maintain a connection to their star seed, you can use this connection to access their star seed and use their Sailor Guardian powers for yourself. 

Finally, you can touch others to cause them to die and reincarnate. You can choose the details of their reincarnation, how much they remember and if they retain any powers. You can also choose to make them a Sailor Guardian in their new life.
objects.title: Sailor Cosmos

objects.text:
I am God

- Anaqi, The False God

You have inherited Anaqi’s gift of Unity and Synchronicity, a forbidden knowledge that allows you to blend souls, Shards, and energies into composite beings of incredible power. Souls bound together by your touch achieve a superstate of cooperative harmony, their abilities amplifying each other. When two or more souls or Shards are fused, they create a symbiotic fusion that embodies the best qualities of each component, forming a combined entity that is far greater than the sum of its parts. You are able to stabilize and harmonize these fusions, ensuring a lasting unity that would otherwise be impossible. Through these soul bonds, you can push beyond the limits of each Shard or soul individually, achieving feats of staggering complexity and potency. The true pinnacle of your power, however, lies in your ability to enter an apotheosis state, an echo of divinity itself. By merging with thousands of the strongest Shards and souls, you become a vessel that embodies Anaqi’s highest ambition: an imitation of the Great Goddess. In this state, you are not merely a wielder of power but a living font of creation and destruction, an embodiment of both the Faithful Shard Maker and Heretical Mayo Lich. While this form is transient and imperfect—a “pale and warped imitation”—it channels divine-level forces that can reshape landscapes, alter fates, and command the very flow of existence. You are a god-in-progress, a paradox of reverence and rebellion, with each apotheosis bringing you closer to the cosmic truth that Anaqi himself glimpsed. You have defied the limitations of mortality and claimed the legacy of Anaqi, transcending the line between creator and created, soul and shard, mortal and divinity.
objects.title: Synchrony and Unity

objects.text:
You have reclaimed the final piece of Anaqi’s lost ambition, achieving the power of the Prime Anaqi, the only variant of him in the multiverse that succeeded, by failing.

Your fusions no longer create stable, harmonious entities. Instead, they become crawling, writhing architectures of impossible existence, their components endlessly breaking and reforming, their abilities mutating into grotesque shapes that defy logic. Each failure within them does not weaken but propels them further, pushing them beyond their limits and becoming greater. What was once a fusion of order has become an engine of unknowable progress, a network of souls, shards, and all things constantly shredding and devouring themselves to achieve greater and greater states of existence.

You no longer need a thousand souls or Shards to enter your apotheosis state, instead you can freely enter your evolving, godlike state at will. You grow exponentially stronger by fusing with souls or Shards, with no upper limit to your power. Like with your fusions, your form is in constant flux, breaking and reforming without stability or control. Instead of a singular divine form, your existence is an unstable, shifting amalgamation of all you have consumed. Your body distorts endlessly—limbs, faces, and eyes emerge and vanish.
objects.title: Anaqi Prime

objects.text: “Humans need fantasy to be human. To be the place where the falling angel meets the rising ape.” In the world of the Disc, the number Eight holds great value, for Eight is the number of magic. An eighth child's eighth child will always be a wizard. But you...You are the Eighth child of an Eighth child of an Eighth child, a Wizard Squared, a new source of magic itself, a Sourcerer. The sheer raw magic inside you is enough to drown this world in a singular great flood of pure magic. Normal Wizards use background magic but you are instead a source of magic itself. You are effectively a being so intrinsically linked to magic that you can replicate or create the greatest of spells with ease. Really, Disc magic is telling the universe what you want it to be like, in terms it can't ignore. And now you can. Just simply tell it what to do and it happens. Whereas Wizards have to follow laws such as the Law of Conservation of Reality with their spells, you can throw these out the window by simply using your own generated magic. Every spell you use brings raw, wild, and most importantly new magic into the world. As your magic is massively more powerful than all others, spells such as creating matter out of nothing, producing timeless worlds, warping reality at will, and even imprisoning the gods themselves are possible. Of your kin, Maligree is remembered for his Wonderful Garden (The ideal realm which is the Disc's Garden of Eden), while the Klatchian Ajandurah is remembered for his Wand of Utter Negativity (Which causes the victim to not simply cease to exist, but also never to have existed). One of your kind led an expedition to Fourecks in centuries past (The Disc's version of Australia). Another sourcerer cursed several merchants after receiving bad service, forcing them never to close, and instead, they became the Wandering Shops plying their wares across all reality. And now, so can you.
objects.title: Sourcerous Story (Discworld)

objects.text: One of the most significant weaknesses of the Samusara has always been their vulnerability to the cycle of reincarnation. Despite their vast power, death still forces them into a prolonged cycle of rebirth. Upon reincarnation, it can take centuries to awaken their magic once more, assuming they even manage to do so in a given lifetime. This vulnerability leaves gaps in their influence over the world, during which magic risks diminishing or fading altogether. But this limitation is no more. You have ascended beyond the constraints of reincarnation, attaining a form of existence that defies mortality itself. Your connection to magic and life has evolved to such a degree that even death can no longer hinder you. Now, upon dying, you possess complete control over your fate: Rather than waiting for centuries to reincarnate and rediscover your powers, you can resurrect yourself immediately. Your return is swift, seamless, and entirely under your control, allowing you to continue spreading magic without interruption. Should you choose, you can still reincarnate, but on your own terms. You can: select the circumstances of your rebirth, including your lineage, environment, or even magical potential in your new life. As a being who exists beyond time, you are no longer bound by linear progression. You can reincarnate into the past of the world you inhabit, shaping its history and magical development in profound ways. Your mastery over the cycle of reincarnation extends beyond your own existence. You can interact with the flow of souls, manipulating the paths of others' reincarnations as well. Whether to guide a soul to a better destiny, delay their return, or alter the nature of their rebirth, the flow of life and death is now yours to command. Previously, as the Samusara, you were an endless and uncontrollable font of magic, continuously infusing the world with spiritual energy. While this made you a source of unparalleled creation, it also limited your ability to direct the flow and distribution of magic. Now, you have gained absolute control over this process: You can decide who has access to magic. Whether granting power to a chosen few, elevating an entire civilization, or restricting magic to yourself alone, the flow of magic bends entirely to your will. At any time, you can retract the magic you have given. This includes not only the raw power but also the knowledge, spells, and techniques that others have developed using your gifts. Their magical evolution becomes part of your own essence, absorbed back into you as if it were always yours. If you so desire, you can stop the flow of magic entirely. The world would return to an age of mundane existence, barren of magic, until you decide otherwise. Alternatively, you can channel all of the world's magic directly into yourself, achieving a level of power beyond comprehension. Your transformation as the Eternal Samusara heralds a new era, not just for yourself but for the world. You are no longer a passive source of magic; you are its absolute arbiter. Life, death, magic, and time are threads in your loom, and you alone weave the tapestry of existence. You are now a being that transcends reincarnation and mortality. "Hail the Eternal Samusara, the font from which all magic springs and to which all magic returns."
objects.title: Eternal Samusara

objects.text:
You have ascended to the heights of Disney magic, becoming a master of the magical arts depicted in Disney’s vast multiverse. You are now a true heir to the legacy of Yen Sid, the sorcerer whose wisdom shaped the very fabric of magical realms.

Your abilities now encompass a wide spectrum of Disney magic. You can freeze landscapes like Elsa, command the stars themselves as if you were the Blue Fairy, or weave spells of transformation and enchantment. 

You can also perform wish magic, though it is not as boundless as a genie’s power—each wish requires careful thought and carries consequences, much like the magic of Sleeping Beauty’s fairies.

You can create legendary artifacts, such as a mirror that shows the future, a brush that creates worlds, or a hat that gives the power of life. Your enchantments are as iconic as the stories themselves, capable of inspiring hope, healing hearts, or bringing joy to those around you.

As a master of Yen Sid’s legacy, you gain an innate connection to the Disney multiverse, allowing you to travel between worlds and draw power from each one. Whether it’s the underwater kingdom of Atlantica, the enchanted forests of Sleeping Beauty, or the mystical realms of Fantasia.

Your magic carries the essence of Disney itself—hope, wonder, and the power of dreams. You are a living legend, a master of magic, and a beacon of imagination made manifest. With this power, you can shape stories, inspire joy, and bring light to the darkest places.

This is the ultimate expression of Disney magic—a force as boundless as the stories themselves.
objects.title: Yen Sid’s Legacy (Disney)

addons.text:
Your curses have grown restless, spreading and evolving with a hunger that mirrors your own malice. You can now mold the Black Mud into Seeds of Corruption. These seeds can be planted into individuals—whether by physical contact, ingestion, or through blood—and take root within their very being.

As the curse grows, it begins to corrupt the host, slowly warping their body and soul into a Hybrid—a grotesque fusion of their original form and a manifestation of the curse infecting them. Hybrids become agents of your will. Infused with the essence of their curse, they gain its powers in addition to their twisted, monstrous forms.

Hybrids are not only cursed themselves—they become vectors for spreading their affliction. Each Hybrid gains the ability to produce a weaker version of Black Mud, imbued solely with the essence of their specific curse. This mud can spread the same curse to others, creating a ripple effect of corruption. Unlike your own Black Mud, their mud lacks the overwhelming power of universal malice and is confined to the influence of their singular curse.

Though the Hybrids retain fragments of their original selves, they are consumed by the nature of the curse, driven to propagate their affliction and fulfill your will. As the creator, you maintain dominance over their actions, and with a single thought, you can bend them to your desires or snuff out their existence should they falter.
addons.title: Cursed Seeds

objects.text:
Your affinity with curses reaches unparalleled heights, a harbinger of suffering and despair. Now, simply by focusing your will upon a target, your power reacts instinctively, invoking a cascade of malevolent curses designed to dismantle their very essence. Through fear, misfortune, destruction, and misery, an unending torrent of curses spills forth, crushing the victim beneath its insurmountable weight until nothing remains but echoes of their torment.

You can now also create a physical representation of your curses in the form of a Black Mud. You can mould this mud into twisted, monstrous forms. These creations act as living embodiments of your curses, each designed with a specific cursed nature. For example, curse embodying “Weakness” might become a grotesque fusion of leech and slug, cloaked in deep red mist, which latches onto victims, sapping vitality unnoticed. Growing stronger with every victim it drains, it becomes an unstoppable plague. Another example being a curse rooted in “Despair” could form into a ghostly wraith of shadowy tendrils, feeding on the hope of those who encounter it, leaving only emptiness and regret in its wake.

Beyond creating these abominable constructs, your curses evolve to affect not only individuals but their surroundings. Black Mud can seep into the earth, corrupting entire areas into barren, cursed wastelands where misfortune becomes a natural law. Villages might experience plagues, broken crops, and endless sorrow simply by standing on tainted ground.

Your mastery of curses evolves over time, granting access to the full spectrum of human malevolence. From subtle curses that sow paranoia and mistrust to catastrophic curses that unravel entire legacies, you shall become the embodiment of human malice, the holder of all the world's curses.
objects.title: Curses Without End

objects.text:
You are no longer merely a person who wields curses—you have become a group of one. Your body, blood, soul, and very existence are a mass of living, self-sustaining curses woven together in an ever-shifting network. You are a sentient curse colony that feeds upon itself to grow stronger, devouring, refining, and evolving in an endless cycle.

Your physical body is entirely composed of curses. Your flesh, your bones, your blood, and even your soul are formed from cursed magic made physical, layered and bound together. The only way to truly injure you is by using the same methods that one would use to dispel or purify a curse. All other forms of harm—physical, magical, or otherwise—are either completely meaningless or rapidly repair themselves as the curse ecosystem automatically restores your body. Unless an opponent can use curse-breaking, sacred purification, divine power, or other forms of curse negation, any injury inflicted upon you is merely temporary and the swarm of curses making up your existence can rebuild you over time.

The curses within you—curses you have created or consumed—are in an endless struggle, devouring weaker curses to refine the stronger ones. Through this relentless internal competition, your body continually strengthens itself, adapting and upgrading as new, more potent curses naturally evolve from the combined essence of those you have absorbed. Every curse you create or consume is absorbed into this living system, becoming part of your being. 

Over time, as you absorb more and more curses, your body evolves new curse mutations and unique abilities. This process may grant you new resistances, unusual curse effects, or innate abilities that no one else can replicate. Your power may grow into strange combinations born from the curses you have merged, such as a disease that causes misfortune or a hex that twists probability itself.

All the curses you create or devour are also integrated into physical form. You can selectively choose traits and magical effects from these curses and weave them directly into yourself. For example, consuming a curse of transformation could allow you to develop shapeshifting abilities, while devouring a freezing curse could grant you access to cold-based curse effects and abilities.
objects.title: Vessel of Curses

addons.text:
Before the gods shaped the world through names, before boundaries divided forms from their singular, unified existence, there was a state of essential being. This was the nameless and formless—the transient faith of all existences—when logic had no hold, and the land lacked earth. It was the essence of all things, a primordial temperament equivalent to the soul and essence itself. From this state arose the gods, and to it, gods return when faith in them wanes.

Now, through a profound transformation of your nature—both external and internal—you embody characteristics akin to this primordial existence. You have become the nameless essence to which all things revert after losing their boundaries. Yet paradoxically, you retain definition and form.

In essence, all existences—be they youkai, gods, spirits, or even the heavens, earth, and otherworlds—once originated from you. This grants you the ability to separate and manifest yourself into them, shaping them within any reality you inhabit.

Initially, this nature is indiscernible, lacking the strength to create forms of significant influence or impact. However, with time and nourishment through faith, you can grow, gradually gaining the power to manifest greater and more consequential forms.
addons.title: Nameless Nature

addons.text:
Your ability to freely apply your interpretations of magic and the unique guiding principle of your magic—“Reality is shaped by humanity’s collective belief”—synergise, allowing your alternative interpretations to transcend traditional logic. By combining ancient symbolism, modern abstractions, and personal creativity, your magical capabilities become nearly limitless.

You can now manipulate abstract and symbolic forces, shaping spells with unconventional interpretations. Magic transforms into a tool for reimagining metaphors, puns, and symbolic devices. For instance, instead of conjuring a standard fireball, you might summon the essence of fire—manifesting as unrelenting passion, consuming logic, or sparking metaphorical conflict. Artifacts crafted under this principle also reflect these interpretations: a “cloak of invisibility” might take the form of an intangible veil that blinds perception or a literal cloak made of air currents.

Your creation magic thrives on symbolic materials, and the extent which you can stretch these symbolisms drastically increase. For example, crushing an air conditioner can  represent air circulation for use in fever-healing potions,  however, it can also relate to urban legends of air conditioner caused deaths to symbolise invisible killers. How the air conditioner erased the problem of internal cooling mechanisms in the body can also be used as symbolic meaning of technology trumping nature. Your use of discarded or unconventional ideas, such as rejected theories of ether or vitalism to fuel are also more nuanced. For example, now the ether that was theorised in ancient times can now be connected to the axes of imaginary numbers, as well as the sea of quanta, due to them bother both being unreal things and both being invisible objects.

Necromancy is redefined, allowing you to perceive and interact with the spirits of all living and nonliving things, expanding far beyond humans. Communicate with extinct creatures, microorganisms, and even the conceptual "souls" of objects or ideas. For example, channel the spirit of an extinct plant to rejuvenate barren lands or summon the essence of an ancient bacterium to unravel diseases. This profound connection to the spiritual fabric of existence elevates necromancy to a universal art. 

Elemental magic adapts to your interpretation, bridging diverse cultural systems. Merge Western and Eastern elemental frameworks to craft unique phenomena, such as metallic firestorms or wooden tidal waves. This interpretive flexibility also permeates illusory magic, allowing you to construct recursive dreamscapes or layered illusions. Ensnare opponents in dreamlike realities where belief sustains tangibility, leaving them disoriented and vulnerable.

Most profoundly, the very laws of magic in Gensokyo now bend to your personal interpretations. Interactions between conflicting magical systems reflect your unique understanding, reshaping the battlefield in your favor. For instance, if another’s belief system opposes your own, your magic might bypass their barriers entirely by rendering them metaphorically “unreal” or irrelevant, a tactic that others struggle to comprehend or counter.

Overall, this synergy deepens your bond with the Land of Fantasy by embracing its essence of belief-driven reality. You wield the power to reinterpret forgotten and discarded ideas, transforming them into profound and unpredictable forces. Your magic, blending humor, logic, and abstraction, reshapes the fabric of any reality you inhabit, empowering you to push the boundaries of imagination and belief.
addons.title: Fantastical Interpretation

addons.text:
Your ability to summon Materials using symbolism and your magic based on fantastical ideas synergise, allowing you to summon Imaginary-Class Materials born from forgotten, discarded, or unrealised ideas such as obsolete scientific theories, debunked beliefs, and abstract concepts. These Materials transcend ordinary reality, drawing power from humanity’s once-held but abandoned thoughts. Examples include the Soul of Unwritten Words, representing untold stories, the Void of Unbelieved Gods, a god that never had followers, and the Spirit of N-Rays, a discredited form of radiation. These beings manipulate belief and forgotten knowledge, shaping reality itself by bending physical and abstract forces, such as gravity, light, or space.

The summoning system is deeply connected to the principle that reality is shaped by belief. Using this principle, you can call forth Materials that embody rejected or outdated ideas. For example, summoning the Ether Spirit invokes the once-popular concept of the aether to control light or gravity, while the God of Miasma embodies the ancient belief that diseases were caused by bad air, allowing you to manipulate health and air currents. By bringing these disproven concepts into the physical world, you alter both the physical and abstract realms, such as summoning the Phantom of the Flat Earth, which bends spatial concepts or creates illusions where the laws of physics seem different.

Summoning Imaginary-Class Materials requires deep engagement with symbolic resonance, where the physical materials used must align with the forgotten forces being summoned. For example, summoning the Unfinished Story traps enemies in an endless cycle of confusion, while invoking the God of Eugenics manipulates genetic traits based on outdated, dangerous theories.
addons.title: The Imaginary Summon

objects.text:
You now wield magic aligned with the reality of Gensokyo, the Land of Fantasy, where all things supernatural operate under one fundamental principle: “Reality is shaped by humanity’s collective belief.” Your magic adheres to this guiding tenet, allowing you to manipulate and apply concepts that are shaped by belief. Furthermore, the Land of Fantasy is a realm where the forgotten and abandoned reside. This extends to your magic, enabling you to harness discarded or rejected ideas—such as obsolete scientific theories like ether or vitalism—and incorporate them into your creations and workings.

Your magic follows a highly unconventional guiding principle, thus making it difficult to interact with other types of magic governed by different principles. The greater the disparity between these principles, the harder the interaction becomes. This discrepancy can manifest in unique ways; for instance, your magic might bypass another’s magical barrier entirely, as if it doesn’t exist, because your magic’s principle refuses to acknowledge theirs. This makes your magic inherently harder for others to comprehend, predict, or counter effectively.
objects.title: Magic in the Land of Fantasy (Touhou Project)

addons.text:
Scratch that, the Practitioner part of your family is alive and well, and they’ll be very welcoming to you, the heir to their legacy. This means that you’ll gain access to a lot more resources and support, not to mention their influence, both political and metaphysical. 

You can distribute the amount of family members you have, the more you have the weaker they’ll be, though the collective strength will stay the same, so you could have a single overpowered Practitioner, but there’s a strength in numbers beyond the Practitioner one, and weaker members might simply not have flourished to their full strength yet, not to mention how more Practitioners would mean more potential Familiars and thus allies.

While this is a mostly positive change, you’re now only the heir instead of their last descendant, and as such you’re no longer in ‘charge’ of the family, your voice will be heard and your opinion seriously considered, but you’re no longer the primary priority. The specialty you’ve chosen will have an influence on the general disposition of your family.
addons.title: Living Family

addons.text:
You can help Awaken others into the Practice, and as such can Awaken your family, granting them the same advantages that you enjoy due to your ancient families legacy, their birthright. As their leader and Patron you’ll gain more influence, but also become responsible for them, with major mistakes they make falling onto your shoulders. 
You also gain a lot more expertise in Awakening Rituals and how to better establish the most basic Practitioner skills, like how to develop Sight and the major Rituals. Allowing you to customize how your Awakening went or will go and grant others as well as yourself an initial power boost through it in addition to benefits you can customize yourself. Like making it so the Practices of their choice will be more impactful, protecting them from certain dangers and more, though the requirements might take rare reagents or necessitate a strict schedule to accomplishing certain tasks, depending on what you’re trying to get out of it. Like following a months long ritual to get multiple kinds of Sight.
addons.title: Awakening Rituals

objects.text:
You’re no longer someone that has simply stumbled upon the Practice, instead you gain the legacy of an Ancient Practitioner Family as part of your birthright. Be it becoming a descendant of Merlin, Solomon or of a family that has specialized in a subject for long enough to be acknowledged as such. This legacy will be equal in strength no matter what kind of family you choose, if you chose Merlin for example, you’d only gain access to what he learned in his lifetime, while an unknown family specializing in something like Abyssal Practices would grant you access to what multiple members of their family learned about it. 

You’ll inherit a Mansion, with a library filled with whatever the Family specialized in as well as introductions to some of its related Practices and access to a few magical items and bound Others relating to the Practice of your Family. You can deal with them as you please, be it taking them into your service, dissecting them for the power inherent in their body parts, or taking them as your Familiar, you may decide whether it’s a lot of weaker ones, a single strong one, or somewhere in between.
Your word will carry a lot more weight, as will your title and you’ll gain more power to draw from, as well as a dozen smaller gains, like Practices your Family used becoming easier to do and figure out, all due to gaining the backing of your family. A lot of Families also have something special about them, from a tradition to only birth and Awaken females, or only making the seventh son a Practitioner while killing the rest, to an ancient deal with a powerful Other granting you special Sight or an atypical Awakening ritual granting you a special physiology. Whichever you choose will grant you a bunch of benefits, the female-only family would have a talent for manipulating connections and would be much more effective with female-only rituals, while the seventh son would be a lot more talented across the board and have a lot more metaphysical weight.

No matter what specialty you choose, you’ll also gain access to a set of Historic Practices, allowing you to summon the Names that were once part of your family. These Names are physical manifestations of your ancestors and the people they were, allowing you to directly learn from your ancestors and use them as sources of knowledge, power and support. Despite gaining their legacy, your family will have no living Practitioners except for you.
objects.title: Ancient Family Legacy (Otherverse)

objects.text:
Practitioners often take on major rituals to increase their powers, and among them, there are three traditional ones with great weight behind them. These fundamentally shape the magic of the practitioner, and must therefore be chosen with great care. You can skip the soul-searching and attuning necessary, with each purchase here giving you one of a Demesne, Familiar or Implement that is perfectly suited to your magic, no matter the form they take. 

Your Implement can be any mundane object, and your Demesne can be placed anywhere, though depending on its location, you may have to defend your right to claim it. Alternatively, you can reserve the right to claim a Demesne, instead making it so that any future ritual will become so easy as to be effortless. Your Familiar can be any Other that does not hold the same level of power as a high-order angel or demon, including major gods and primordial forces. They will be perfectly subservient to your will, hold personalities you would find appealing, and have any issues that might occur from your bond removed. For example, taking a mid-tier demon akin to one like Barbatorem as your Familiar would leave none of the fatal degradation that would normally be received by your Self.
objects.title: Defining Rituals

objects.text: Increases the frequency of charges for Marvelous Mage. Each purchase halves the time between charges generated (every week, 3.5 days, 1.75 days, 21h).
objects.title: Increased Frequency (Marvelous Mage)

objects.text: You generate 6 additional freely allocatable charges and another 2 randomly distributed charges per cycle.
objects.title: Increased Charges (Marvelous Mage)

objects.text:
You now have complete control over all eight charges. The two previously random allocations are now freely assignable, allowing you to fully customize your magical growth without external interference.

Additionally, once per month, you may redistribute up to 1 level’s worth of charges from an already assigned field, allowing for limited restructuring of your expertise as your understanding of magic evolves.
objects.title: Arcane Precision

objects.text:
Something has gone wrong—you have glimpsed a secret beyond mortal ken, an impossible truth from beyond the veil. You are no longer a Sleeper, yet not truly Awakened. You have seen the hidden contours of the universe and emerged changed. You do not wield magic as the Awakened do, but neither are you shackled by ignorance.

Within you resides an impossible dream—a nascent reality shaped entirely by your will. Yet, for now, it is fragile, its power barely more than a flicker. In its earliest form, your pocket realm serves as a conduit, allowing you to channel magic and interact with the universe in ways beyond ordinary sorcerers. It anchors your rituals, strengthens your sorcery, and grants you greater resistance against outside magical influences. It also functions as a personal dimension, a sanctuary to store objects beyond the reach of the material world.

As your knowledge of magic deepens, so too will your dream. By incorporating new laws, materials, and arcane principles, you can slowly transform this fragment from a mere extension of yourself into a fully realized universe. In time, you will no longer rely on a universe’s laws—you will wield sorcery drawn entirely from the wellspring of your own reality.

With enough insight and mastery, your dream will expand into a domain of your own making—a shifting sea of chaotic magic, an ordered bastion of arcane law, or even a perfect reflection of the material world. Within this realm, you are, in essence, a god, free to experiment, shape existence, and uncover the deepest mysteries.

For now, your dream remains in its infancy, no more than a fragment of what it could become. The path to true ascension is long, spanning centuries or even millennia, but with enough will and power, your reality may one day eclipse even the mightiest of realms.
objects.title: Fragment Of A Dream

objects.text:
You have reached the level of a Master Sorcerer with the mana reserves and skill to match. You have a deep understand of the principles of Sorcery and the science behind them. 

You have a broad base of knowledge in a variety of fields from elemental magic and physical reinforcement to more obscure subjects like teleportation and healing.

You are also specialized in two to three fields which form the core of your magic style and signature spells, this could range from sound or gravity magic to teleportation or even temporal magic. You also have a second name which matches your style of Sorcery.
objects.title: Master Sorcerer (Archdemon's Dilemma)

objects.text:
You stand above Master Sorcerers have reached the level of an Archdemon Candidate with the mana reserves and skill to match. Your understanding of the principles of Sorcery as well the science behind it all is highly advanced. 

You have a broad and deep base of knowledge in a wide variety of fields but where you truly shine are your specializations which you have elevated to new heights. 

Your signature spells are incredibly refined and can bring about miracles or devastation on a grand scale.
objects.title: Archdemon Candidate (Archdemon's Dilemma)

objects.text:
You have been granted the title of Archdemon, a king among sorcerers. You received one of the thirteen Sigil of the Archdemon, a mysterious mark on your right hand that grants you incredible power.

While your mana reserves are practically infinite thanks to the Sigil, the power of your spells is still bound by your knowledge and skills. 

The Sigil also allows you to summon and control demons to a degree but take extreme caution, the eldritch beings you call forth are rarely worth the trouble and destruction they bring with them.
objects.title: Archdemon (Archdemon's Dilemma)

addons.text: You are a paradoxical existence, both an Archdemon and Archangel. The Sigil of the Archdemon doubles the number of Hex Wings you can manifest and the union of Sorcery and Mysticism allows you to wield world-shattering power.
addons.title: Orias

objects.text:
You can call upon the spirits to transform into a Nephilim, an angelic being with several Hex Wings which grant them near invulnerability and increases the power of their Mysticism and Sorcery by 50% for each pair. (Also applies to your other magical and spiritual powers.)

You start with two pairs of Hex Wings and can manifest more over the centuries or by using a special catalyst created with Celestial Mysticism.
objects.title: Nephilim (Archdemon's Dilemma)

objects.text:
Super Archive Magic is a highly advanced evolution of Archive Magic, designed for large-scale data management and real-time information processing. While it retains the core principles of its predecessor—storing, retrieving, and transmitting magical data—this version greatly enhances efficiency, allowing for instantaneous analysis, tracking, and manipulation of complex magical systems.

Unlike standard Archive Magic, which relies on traditional keyboard-like interfaces, Super Archive Magic employs a seamless, touch-based system, enabling the user to access and modify vast databases with just a thought. This makes it an invaluable tool for tactical warfare, intelligence gathering, and magical coordination on an unprecedented scale.

Abilities:
Real-Time Surveillance: The user can scan and monitor entire regions, tracking multiple individuals simultaneously and assessing their magical signatures.

Tactical Coordination: Instantly processes battlefield conditions, allowing for seamless communication and synchronized strategies among allies.

Link Manipulation: Detects and alters magical bonds between individuals, enabling the transfer or severing of magical connections.

Advanced Projection: Generates a detailed magical avatar of the user, allowing them to interact remotely without being physically present.

Instant Data Processing: Enhances the user's ability to analyze and adapt to new information at superhuman speeds, significantly reducing reaction time in combat.
objects.title: Super Archive Magic (Fairy Tail)

addons.text: You can assemble blueprints for your Autobuild in the Sheikah Slate rather than have to build them. Additionally, your slate will create a small amount of Zonaite when not in use.
addons.title: Zonai Interface

objects.text: The Autobuild is an extension of the Ultrahand: it can recall previously assembled things built with it, either by assembling with a nearby object that fits the criteria, or replacing said objects with Zonaite. With this power, you can now use this power, and more You will have access to a limited pocket dimension, of which you can store only two things: Zonaite and Zonai Devices. Zonaite is a highly energetic and malleable material, able to power things and take the necessary form with some coaxing. You are able to grow Zonaite by spending energy: magic, ki, stamina, etc. Zonai Devices are the machine parts that make your builds exceptional. With it, you can create lasers machines, flamethrowers, vehicles, automatons, and more. You know how to manufacture these parts with mundane materials and Zonaite. You can also shape Zonaite in your pocket dimension on any part as well, though it will consume more Zonaite then it normally would. You will start with a handful of every Zonai Device available, a sizable pile of Zonaite, and some basic schematics. You can also recall any previous builds you assembled.
objects.title: Autobuild (Legend of Zelda)

objects.text:
Jesters are the sharpened edge of the old Clown tradition—satirists, duelists, and stage-dominators trained to turn laughter into control. In courts, they are the only ones allowed to speak the truth, veiled behind jokes and spinning steel. You are now also a Jester.

In addition to casting your base magic through humor, you now draw power from spectacle—exaggerated motion, deliberate gestures, grand posture, and fluid stagecraft. Humor remains at the core of your power, but spectacle can replace it when wit fails or the moment demands silence, and it can also heighten your magic when both are used together. A slow, mocking bow or a sudden, theatrical stillness can carry just as much force as a perfectly timed punchline. Performance becomes your second language of spellwork, and your body is the script.

You can use your magic to mimic voices, gestures, and magical signatures with near-perfect accuracy, allowing you to impersonate individuals or bypass recognition-based wards. Your words can bypass magical silence or compel attention if delivered in the form of a joke, riddle, or dramatic performance. With focused intent, you can invoke magical confusion, shame, or hesitation in a target by publicly mocking them. You are able to create illusions as part of a performance, with it growing more realistic and solid the more the better the performance, and can shift fluidly between multiple roles mid-act, deceiving both mind and spell. 

In combat, you move unpredictably, converting near-misses into repositioning opportunities or magical counters. You can use props—such as juggling pins, scarves, masks, or canes—as enchanted or kinetic weapons, channeling your magic through them when used with flair. Each consecutive movement in battle that maintains spectacle increases the potency of your next action, culminating in a finishing strike or spell if the sequence is unbroken. Your dodges, flips, and taunts function as both physical and magical techniques, disorienting enemies while keeping your audience—foes or onlookers—under your control.
objects.title: Jester

objects.text:
Melanchants are performers who have stepped beyond laughter, shaping emotion itself into magic. Their art is not to entertain, but to weigh, to stir, to lift, or to burden the hearts of those who watch. You are now also a Melanchant.

Your magic now draws from resonance—the emotional intensity shared between you and others. This may be sorrow, awe, nostalgia, joy, or even silent dread, cultivated through memory, honesty, ritual, or atmosphere. It can replace humor entirely, or be used alongside it when the tone allows. It builds as you connect with your audience, and its depth determines the strength of your creations, the reach of your influence, and the clarity of your control. Even private grief or one-on-one vulnerability can build resonance—it’s the shared depth, not the size of the crowd, that matters.

As a Melanchant, you gain the ability to manipulate emotion directly—strengthening the spirits of allies or unraveling the resolve of enemies. You can burden foes with regret, slowness, or mental fatigue, while surrounding allies with surges of courage, lucidity, or emotional protection. You may link feelings between people, causing one’s despair to be shared, or another’s determination to spread like a pulse. Your magic can be released in bursts to purge negative states from your allies or flood your enemies with a wave of unfiltered sensation, leaving them stunned, shaken, or still. 

You may also create and command temporary carnival constructs—semi-living beings made from memory, grief, joy, or old stories. These take many forms: masked dancers, puppet beasts, weeping banners, lost friends returned in form only. You can shape a magical territory, a Living Stage, in which your creations grow stronger and your allies recover faster. While you perform within this space, the border becomes a Curtain’s Edge—difficult to cross, disorienting to outsiders, and resistant to hostile magic. The more deeply your audience feels, the more vivid and real your stage becomes.
objects.title: Melanchants

objects.text:
There are jokes that heal, and there are jokes that leave marks. Dark Humor is the latter—a forbidden art whispered of in ruined theaters and burned-down cabarets, where laughter once turned violent. You have learned this forbidden art.

Your magic now draws from contempt, a volatile force born from humiliation, cruelty, and self-destruction. You generate contempt by tearing down others with insult, or yourself through honest, public ridicule. The deeper the wound—whether emotional, social, or moral—the greater the contempt you accrue. It can replaces humor in your casting, and can combined to push your spells beyond normal limits. But every spell cast this way scars—mentally, emotionally, or otherwise—and too much contempt can stain the performer just as deeply as the audience.

With Dark Humor, your magic no longer simply entertains—it wounds. Spells delivered with cutting insults or brutal honesty linger after their effects fade, leaving targets weakened, paranoid, or socially marked. Those caught in your performance may find themselves hesitating, second-guessing, or haunted by shame that was never theirs to begin with. You can mock someone’s pride to unravel their defenses, force them to relive failures they buried, or weaponize your own trauma to lash out with psychic weight. An especially vicious performance might silence a room, shatter confidence, or leave reputations in ruins with a single line. 

You can also conjure pain by confessing your own. Self-deprecating performances—when genuine—amplify your magic through raw contempt, creating effects that rebound violently onto your enemies. The more uncomfortable your truth, the more damage it causes. Within this art, even taboo becomes a source of power; the unspeakable, once spoken, unravels the logic of polite reality. Over time, your presence itself becomes corrosive—those who spend too long around you grow uneasy, introspective, or quietly distressed, unable to explain why their laughter doesn’t feel like joy.
objects.title: Forbidden Magic: Dark Humor

objects.text:
There are just as many blessings across the omniverse as curses. With this upgrade you can eat those blessings just as you would a curse for power and with some training knowledge on how to replicate them.

This upgrade also makes you similarly gifted at making and understanding blessings as you are curses.
objects.title: Blessing Eater

objects.text:
"Magic is omnipotent. Once you understand that, you can achieve anything."

You possess a talent that equals or even surpasses that of Rudeus Greyrat himself; specifically, his future self, who accomplished countless feats and came to understand the mysteries of magic in the Six-Faced World better than anyone else.

Your control over mana is so refined that you could potentially create magical crystals and labyrinths from your surroundings or even from your own magical reserves. You are even capable of interrupting and stealing magical processes from other entities and objects, limited only by the amount of mana you possess. Thus, you cannot disrupt the magic of someone or something that far surpasses your own magical power.

Your offensive magic has reached a level where you can combine or create elements beyond the basic elemental categories. For example, you can create steam from fire and water, or directly form a new element like lightning, or variants of existing elements, such as creating metal or various types of minerals from earth magic.

Your healing magic has touched upon the mysteries of Blessings and Curses. For instance, you can replicate Kishirika Kishirisu’s ability to grant Demon Eyes, mimic the curse the first Dragon God placed on Orsted, or simply create something new or modify existing powers. Regarding your current magic, you can modify it however you see fit. For example, Divine Strike is no longer limited to evil entities; it can now affect benevolent beings or any target you identify as an enemy or objective.

Your summoning magic is no longer restricted to time-travel spells or calling beings from other dimensions. You are now capable of manipulating the space and time of reality itself, so long as you have perfect understanding and control of it. On top of that, you are no longer limited to artificially programmed spirits; you can now create and manipulate souls that can exist independently from their creator or source. The entities you create and summon are fully loyal to you.

Last but not least, you have mastered a school of magic no one else has, long believed to be the exclusive domain of the gods, the blessed, or the Six-Faced World itself. This is Inherent Magic, also known as Special Magic. Within this school, you can develop new spells or master existing ones that do not fall into the three primary categories of magic.

For example, you could study the innate abilities of a particular race, such as the Immortal Demon Tribe. You may even create something entirely new. Best of all, this school allows you to transform what you’ve learned into your own exclusive magic, which can be passed down through your bloodline, descendants, or by sharing a part of your soul.

As an added effect, it prevents others from imitating your special magical abilities unless they possess specific esoteric or magical means to bypass this protection. Alternatively, you can make this special magic something you can teach to others, though this depends on the talent and comprehension of the person learning it.

Thanks to this talent, your control over mana grants your magic a level of power and efficiency beyond your original classification. As with all new characteristics of each magic school, your potential is limited only by your imagination and your magical reserves.

Your mastery and knowledge of magic automatically classify you as a Saint-ranked mage. While the difficulty of reaching King rank and above has somewhat lessened, it still demands great effort and mastery. Pure talent is no longer enough; greater value is placed on those who follow the philosophy: "Knowledge Is Power."
objects.title: Catastrophe Class

objects.text:
Time Craft is the use of Craft to bend time to one’s will. Time Craft is so powerful and taxing that it can potentially kill the user if used recklessly. Its uses are myriad, ranging from making people age slower or faster, making bodies younger or older, hastening the growth of crops and plants, freezing people or objects, or going back in time and potentially rewriting history itself. 

Though feats like the last ones would be prohibitively expensive and require something as powerful as Wish Craft to use, if you're trying to rewind beyond a few minutes.
objects.title: Timecraft (In Stars and Time)

objects.text:
Wish Craft is the use of Craft to make the user’s wish become a reality. It also potentially allows the use of much costlier Craft rituals like Time Craft without having to spend all of your power at once. Due to the very nature of Wish Craft, there are technically no limits to what one can wish for. 

As such Wish Craft could be used to make colors disappear, make the world forget an entire Island, or to create a Time Loop, however all wishes require a different amount of people wishing for it, with the amount of people rising rapidly the more elaborate or difficult to fulfill it is, or requiring someone very powerful to make the wish.

The use of Wish Craft relies on two basic principles in order to work properly: the ritual used and the user’s desire to see their wish granted. 

The ritual is as follows:
“You choose a leaf, to represent yourself, you breathe your wish into it to make a link between you and whatever you’re wishing to. You repeat your wish three, six, seven, or thirteen times depending on which number feels right to you. And then you fold the wish into the leaf, to tether the link between you and the wish. Touching it.” 

This has to be done by the biggest tree in the area that people believe to be a Wishing Tree. 

There are several rituals that can increase the probability of a wish being granted, such as calling out to shooting stars, picking up a four-leaf clover, and wishing under a Wishing Tree the correct way. 

These rituals help create a link between the wish, the user and the Universe and give the wish a direction, thus making them the most important component of Wish Craft.
 
The user’s desire to see their wish granted also plays a part in the use of Wish Craft, to a somewhat lesser extent. A wish made with no true desire behind it has less chances of being granted than a wish made with a strong intent. Thus, if your desire to see your wish granted is strong enough or if enough people wish very hard for the same thing, their wish might become true anyway even if the correct ritual isn’t used, as long as you wish under the same Wishing Tree. 

Wish Craft isn’t always a straightforward process. It can give one's wish directly, or it can grant one the means to achieve their wish. Such as a wish to keep something perfect forever granting the ability to freeze people in time and someone’s wish to stay with their friends forever giving them the ability to loop back to a time before they have to leave them behind. If two wishes are in competition with each other, they will either cancel each other out or will make a compromise so that both wishes can become true at the same time. If the intent of two wishes are complementary, they might merge into one.

While it’s possible for you to make your lesser wishes come true with a simple ritual, and especially minor ones by simply spotting shooting stars or collecting four-leaf clovers, it will take many others all wishing for the same thing to make more difficult wishes come true, if a lot of similar wishes have been made at the Wishing Tree you make your wish, then there’s also a possibility that it will come true alongside your own, with a chance of the two merging or clashing depending on the specifics.

Wish Craft smells like sugar.
objects.title: Wish Craft (In Stars and Time)

addons.text:
The Crest of Thaumaturgy is the perfected form of Gaius’s magic system, reshaped into the Fifth Crest that functions as a complete thaumaturgical foundation. Instead of being limited to a single specialty, it contains all of Gaius’s research—his enchantments, soul-based sorcery, and itemcraft capable of powering cities—preserved inside the Crest as a permanent record.

As its bearer, you gain access to the same magical framework Gaius himself used in life. Your circuits and Od output rise to the standard of his Age of Gods, restoring the efficiency lost in modern decline. Unlike ordinary Magecraft, which weakens over time, the Crest enforces his world’s magical laws, allowing you to use them directly even in different settings.

The Crest also serves as a living archive. Every refinement or discovery you make is encoded into it, ensuring the system grows with you and can be passed on intact to future wielders, or maybe decompose it on one of the four constituent pieces. In effect, it is both a personal crest and a world-level foundation, harmonizing your magic with the environment while never losing its original strength.

Where modern magi struggle to maintain fragments of old Mysteries, you wield a fully preserved foundation: the culmination of Gaius’s life’s work, stabilized in a Crest that can never be diminished.
addons.title: Crest of Thaumaturgy

addons.text:
In this life, you are not merely the rebirth of Gaius the First Crest Sage, but of every Gaius that walked a different path. Each Sage bore the same genius, but each was bound by the single Crest they carried: one delved deepest into creation and enchantment, one into destructive sorcery, one into rapid-fire spellcraft, and one into the fusion of magic and body. None of them could ever unite these paths, but they researched intensively to the limit of what an incompatible crest would allow, and so each left behind only partial insights.

You inherit all of them. Their research, failures, and breakthroughs exist as layered memories within you, harmonizing instead of conflicting. The First’s mastery of enchanted craft is strengthened by the Second’s vast understanding of magical firepower, refined by the Third’s precision and rapid-casting methods, and embodied by the Fourth’s sorcery of the flesh. Where they were geniuses bound by their limits, you are their synthesis—every insight without the wall of a single Crest holding you back.

The result is not just more power, but more perspective: the ability to solve problems as any of them would, to combine solutions they could never reach, and to walk paths of magic that none alone could tread. You carry the full lineage of the Sages, the perfected reincarnation of every Gaius that ever was.
addons.title: And Another One, And Another One, And Another One.

objects.text:
You are no longer merely an anomaly with the Fifth Crest — you are the true reincarnation of Gaius, the Sage, the man who was said to have laid the foundations of all magic. Unlike Mathias, who carried only fragments of his soul, you awaken with the full weight of his genius intact, unhindered and unshackled.

This grants you the complete knowledge Gaius wielded in his prime: the crafting arts that produced constructs and artifacts on par with nuclear reactors, enchanted tools of boundless utility, and weapons that altered the course of entire wars. You inherit his most advanced spellcraft — magic that touches the soul directly, reshaping life, will, and destiny itself — the kind of transcendental sorcery that modern mages cannot even imagine, such as Reincarnation magic or magic items to generate fake souls to test soul compatibility with something.

With the Fifth Crest amplifying what Gaius never possessed but dreamed of having, you surpass even his legendary limits. His mastery of one but extensive knowledge of all four magical paths, combined with the perfect balance of your Crest, makes you not only the return of the Sage, but the evolution of his legacy.
objects.title: Sage Reincarnation (Shikkakumon no Saikyō Kenja)

addons.text:
The web of phylacteries that anchors your soul no longer serves as mere protection. Each phylactery now flowers into a locus of power, manifesting not a faint echo, but a greater avatar of yourself. These echoes are not hollow reflections, nor are they full duplicates of your soul, instead, they are semi-autonomous beings, fragments of your will with enough independence to act as your envoys and generals.

They are intelligent and cunning, capable of strategy and diplomacy, able to direct armies of undead generals as if you stood among them. They cannot create new Generals of their own, that remains your sole privilege as the master, but the undead they raise are mightier than those birthed by even your strongest Generals.

Additionally, the resilience of your Phylactery Web has grown. Where before the loss of a phylactery weakened you, now such destruction is only temporary. If one is broken, the others absorb its essence, digesting and reforging it into a new vessel. This resurrection of your anchors takes time, weeks for a single replacement, years if your network has been whittled to only a few, but permanence is yours as long as even one phylactery remains. In this way, your network is eternal, self-healing, and self-renewing, a reflection of the deathless tide you embody.
addons.title: Death Tide

objects.text:
Your affinity for death magic has deepened your necromantic magic, while the essence of your lich form has grown darker thanks to your necromantic knowledge. No longer merely an immortal sorcerer or a necromantic overlord, you are the apex of undeath — the source of an empire of corpses and souls, with your very presence twisting the world toward decay.

Now, any undead you personally create becomes undead generals, beings that can raise undead on their own. A vampire lord you raise can sire its own spawn, a wight may gather a hunting pack, and a death knight can lead an armored host, all of which are under your absolute dominion. These undead lieutenants form a chain of command beneath you, creating an army with layered autonomy, but always loyal to your will. This hierarchy makes your forces self-sustaining and endlessly expansive, spreading your influence without requiring you to micromanage every servant.

When your undead are killed, their essence does not simply vanish. Instead, fragments of their energy reassemble into new, lesser forms — skeleton shards knitting into crawling bones, zombies reforming as carrion husks, and so on until the last vestiges of their energy are drained. As a result, slaying your armies is a war of attrition, for they do not stay fallen unless truly annihilated.

Your presence alone shapes the battlefield. Your magic surrounds you, withering the air, stagnating life, and causes the dead nearby to stir. From unburied corpses rise lesser undead such as shambling zombies, clawing skeletons, or lingering wraiths, all birthed passively as your shadow spreads. Even where no corpses lie, mortals within your aura feel their strength erode, as entropy bleeds vitality away. 

Your lich body has grown darker, its bones blackened and etched with cursed sigils. Any living being that touches you is drained, their life siphoned into the void within you, and lingering curses cling to their flesh even after contact ends. Moreover, you may now wield death magic upon yourself as healing, mending shattered bones or restoring your frame with energies that would destroy mortals.

Most dread of all, your soul is no longer housed in a single vessel. Through painstaking ritual and sacrifice, you can create additional phylacteries and weave them into a Phylactery Web. These anchors are linked, sharing the burden of your existence. Destroying one phylactery weakens but does not end you, for the others restore what was lost. Only by shattering your entire network at once can your enemies hope to erase you fully. This makes you nearly impossible to destroy, your immortality reinforced by layers of soul-anchoring.
objects.title: Arch Lich

objects.text: Your ability has gained a new dimension upon itself, or rather, a new path opens to it through your mastery of Eidos and Acton, Kairon. It is not power in the same sense as Eidos and Acton are; it does not define Existence or Essence, but rather it connects. Your skill with Eidos and Acton are self contained, self governed. They confer upon you the ability to align your Imagination and Will upon reality. But there is an inherent limitation. Tai may allow one to force the Imagination upon reality through their Will, but it’s always a fight, a conflict for one against all else. Where a user does not define a flame’s color and heat, reality does; where they don’t define their strength, reality does; where one doesn’t define their location, reality does. Where one’s will falters, reality’s takes over, a flame of darkness that heals cannot exist within the universe without your enforcement, because the Universe’s Imagination and Will is different. What Kairon is is simple: your Eidon spreads, reshaping you not merely as self, but as part of the universe, as part of reality as a whole, Acton tying it in. What this does is two parts. The first is Awareness and Understanding. In this state, you intrinsically understand the rules of reality, how it works, how things ebb and flow, how things are, and why things are. Your awareness spreads, you can see how the wind flows an entire country away, the blades of grass as an enemy steps on them, you can see how heat coalesces, how cells function and mutate, etc. This will allow you much greater efficiency in controlling your power, as this innate understanding means that you can shape your Eidon to reflect the intrinsic nature of reality and Acton to enforce it with much greater ease. You can choose how to fuel your fire with various elements to massively increase its heat or give it new properties, rather than having to constantly pour more and more Acton to produce an effect that could not exist in reality as easily, such as simply commanding fire to be hotter and larger, when it would be easier to add more oxygen. The other aspect is that one can infuse their Eidon and Acton with reality, so that Reality’s Eidon and Acton coincide with the user. To use an example, one could shape a portal between two points on a planet, Eidon to shape and create its nature, Acton to enforce it, but without constant flow of Acton, reality’s Eidon and Acton take over and it can no longer exist, but with Kairon, one bridges the difference between World and Self, what is one’s Tai is the World’s Tai. Their Eidon becomes the world’s Eidon, their Acton becomes the world’s Acton, reality’s very Logos is your own, and as such, if you create a portal, you will not have to pour Acton into it to maintain it, for its existence becomes part of the world itself. The same applies to all other actions done this way, for you will not have to fight the world, but the world aligns with you.
objects.title: Kairon

objects.text: Your understanding and control over Tai has expanded, developed into a new skill for your repertoire. You’ve learned to shape your Eidos and Acton into form, not through language, but through intent made tangible. This discipline is known as Lex, the art of anchoring. A Lex is not a word, nor a symbol, nor any kind of hidden script. It is simply a vessel, a line, a gesture, a mark, or even an object that you imbue with your imagination and will. You could write fire and define comfort, warmth, and safety. You could write stone and define motion, swiftness, and grace. The form you choose to write in means nothing by itself; what defines it is what you mean when you create it. When you shape a Lex, you impress your Eidos into it, defining its nature and qualities, and then infuse it with Acton, enforcing those qualities into reality. You could draw a meaningless curve upon a coat and intend it to comfort, and it would keep the wearer warm in the cold, cool in heat, soft on stone, and restful in exhaustion. You could inscribe a simple line upon a wall and mean for it to protect, and the wall would stand firm no matter what struck it. You could inscribe the word steel upon cloth, letting Eidos shape it with the qualities of tempered metal and Acton reinforce it until it turns blades aside. You could etch the word light into a lantern, its glow now endless so long as your Acton sustains it. A sigil carved with the word soothe could radiate calm through its shape alone. You can inscribe the word fire upon someone to grant them a rudimentary ability to command fire, perhaps by using their own Acton or by another source of power. Lexis allows Tai to persist beyond yourself. Anything you write can hold an imprint of your imagination and will. Every Lex is a reflection of its creator’s understanding. Two users could draw the same mark, yet their results would differ entirely, for the symbol is only a mirror — the true meaning lives in the Eidos infused within it. To another, your Lex would seem inert, incomprehensible, its intent hidden unless they used their own Tai to connect and feel the structure of thought bound inside. A Lex can carry any number of possible functions, from combat, defense, transportation, storage, sealing, or simple comfort, and much more. It can also grow to be incredibly complex, and become mutable to itself. In many ways, it’s similar to teaching it to program itself, one can tie multiple symbols together, set it so that Lexes are working on one’s own Acton, the Lex merely carrying Eidon to help remove the need for focus, or have it work on a supply of Acton, or be able to recharge, or even generate it’s own. Some of the things one can do with this is create a stone that creates a barrier, acting as a physical barrier as well as a warning system for the user if someone breaches it, allowing one to sleep without worry. Or they can use it to enchant a blade with supernatural durability and sharpness, infuse a technique that grants one flight into a cape, so that they will not have to spend the focus and energy on that, or use them to be handed out as gifts to others for them to use.
objects.title: Lex

objects.text:
Your starting number of techniques and styles is increased to 8, allowing you to increase your starting versatility.

With each subsequent purchase of this upgrade, the total number of techniques you receive will instead be increased per the cubic number sequence: 8, 27, 64, 125 techniques and so on.
objects.title: Multiple Disciplines (Tai)

objects.text:
You are no mere beginner, no, you are an Archmage, a true master of magic who bends the world to their whim. You no longer need supplementary artifacts to enhance your power; now, you can call upon the power to decimate armies with only your own power, although with the right artifacts, you could outshine the gods themselves.

This vastly boosts the power of your magic, as well as your reserves of energy, allowing you to cast vast-reaching spells. It also increases your initial knowledge of magic, immediately granting you access to more potent and complex spells.
objects.title: Archmage

objects.text:
You are no longer limited to only summoning Aspects, though they continue to taint the process.

You can now summon all manner of beings, and more specialised creatures such as floronic elementals or manticores.

As Aspects still infect your summoning, each of these summons is affected by the surface they're summoned on in the same manner as your aspect.
objects.title: Enhanced Summoning

objects.text:
Too tired to train and short on patience? As it turns out, you can fast track your Cantrips into the big leagues.

Each selection of this upgrade grants you 39 points to invest into your Cantrips, bypassing the need for training. The points given per selection are sufficient to fully master a single Cantrip and unlock its Overmagic, assuming you invest all your points into it. 

Alternatively, you can choose to divide these points out among multiple different Cantrips instead, upgrading them as you see fit.
objects.title: Cantrip Cheat Code

objects.text: Rather than develop metamagics the hard way, you can purchase this upgrade to unlock them as if you had completed one of the Metamagic Quests. Each purchase lets you pick one Quest to receive the reward of as if you had already done it perfectly with all applicable Cantrips. The choices are: A Matter Of Time: Any Cantrips with a Duration can have said Duration multiplied by a maximum of 54 times. For example, a single casting of the Gate Cantrip at the Novice level can open a Rift that lasts for upwards of 9 hours rather than 10 minutes. Careful Caster: Any Cantrips that require Focus can now be used freely with up to 50 simultaneous castings maintained before you experience any strain. For example, as a Novice you could maintain up to 50 Globs of Faerie Fire at a time, only beginning to feel your Focus strain upon summoning the 51st Glob. Aim Close: Any Cantrips with a set Range can have their maximum Range increase by upwards of 39 times. For example, a Novice level use of the Magic Missile Cantrip could fire a bolt that travels a maximum distance of 1170 ft before dissipating instead of 30 ft. You are fully capable of controlling the strength of all of your Metamagics up to the limit listed, such that you could make a Magic Missile bolt dissipate after 500 ft instead, or even 5 ft, this upgrade merely improving your maximum possible capabilities. Note: You can still train to improve your Metamagics by limiting the usage of any affected Cantrips as per the original Quest, but you would have to use the unmodified values, so to improve Duration you could maintain a Gate for only 5 minutes max for a year as an example. In addition this increases the multiplier linearly rather than multiplicatively, so if you limit 5 Duration Cantrips for a year, your maximum Duration multiplier becomes x59 rather than x270.
objects.title: Metamagic Quest Completion (Cantrip CYOA)

objects.text:
Upon selecting this upgrade, your internal cycle of conjuration magic turns twice as fast, doubling the rate at which it accumulates energy.

Each additional purchase doubles the rotation speed again; increasing it up to four-times as fast, eight-times as fast and so on.
objects.title: Increased Cycle Speed (The Celestial Bestiary)

objects.text:
Upon selecting this upgrade, the required magical conjuration cost of all summons is halved.

Each additional purchase halves their costs again; reducing them to a quarter the original cost, an eighth and so on.
objects.title: Reduced Conjuration Cost (The Celestial Bestiary)

objects.text:
You inherit the full legacy of Adrianna Balbora Ceci, the first and greatest Magi Craft Meister—her genius, her instincts, her finesse, and the extraordinary magical control she developed across a lifetime of creation. You do not simply study her work: you remember it, the way Jin did when her knowledge, experience, and techniques flowed into him. Your foundations are no longer those of a novice but of a fully realized Meister.

Your magic power expands to a level capable of supporting high-grade Ether manipulation without strain. Fine control, rapid spell computation, and the delicate adjustments required for circuit inscription all become effortless. You can weave Ether threads as easily as breathing, layering complex circuits and composite runes with the speed and precision of a master engraver.

This inheritance elevates your talents far beyond standard magitech craftsmanship. You gain Adrianna’s deep understanding of Ether cores, Ether lines, conversion furnaces, material transmutation, high-density enchantment, and soul-matrix stabilization—the techniques that allowed her to produce autonomous constructs of remarkable intelligence and longevity. You can create, repair, and upgrade constructs with the same deftness and elegance that defined her era-spanning legacy.

Your capacity to analyze, refine, and innovate is similarly enhanced. Like Jin, you instinctively perceive the structure of unknown mechanisms, identify inefficiencies, and visualize improvements the moment you lay eyes on them. Ether flow, ambient magic, mechanical harmonics—every component becomes a readable, manipulatable part of a larger whole.
objects.title: Legacy of Adrianna Balbora Ceci (Magi Craft Meister)

objects.text:
You can now be considered an Archmage. These are people who have mastered more than one magical field. While most mages choose to dedicate their life to a single discipline, you have chosen to branch out further.

For each purchase, you are able to choose from the below available fields. You are considered an expert in the fields you select. 
Negation: Spells that dispel, disrupt or negate other spells. A must have discipline for every mage.
Animation: Spells that infuse a portion of the caster's mind into the target, allowing effects with a measure of autonomy and independence from the caster.
Divination: Spells that gather and organize information based on the caster's query.
Alteration: Spells that restructuring existing matter into other configurations.
Wards: Spells that protect a person, item or area from various threats.
Dimensionalism: Spells that manipulate space and time.
Conjuration: Spells that create ectoplasmic constructs and animate them for some purpose.
Transformation: Spells that transform the target into something else, in whole or in part.
 Summoning: Spells that contact a spiritual plane and allow a spirit to possess a prepared vessel – usually an ectoplasmic shell, a willing host, a corpse or an artificial body of some sort.
Illusionism: A multi-disciplinary magical discipline that deals with creation of highly realistic magical constructs, in order to deceive, distract or entertain the target.
Medical Magic: A multi-disciplinary field that deals with diagnosing illnesses via divination and then using a form of alteration to heal wounds, cure diseases and otherwise help the patient. Medical magic requires a great deal of knowledge about human anatomy and various biological processes in order to be effective.
Combat Magic: Utilizing other magical fields in order to produce offensive and defensive effects. 
Blood Magic: Spells that utilize the life force of the caster or others. Life force is a potent form of mana but the use of it is detrimental to the life force owner’s health. 
Ritual Magic: These are separate from normal invocations and unstructured magic, as they stress the caster’s concentration in a way that normal spells don’t and often make use of exotic material components, multiple casters and other oddities.
objects.title: Archmage (Mother Of Learning)

objects.text: Now instead of starting with access to a singular element, you can choose to have an additional one available. This can either be as another natural affinity, or as another mastered element.
objects.title: Multi-Element Fairy (Fate: The Winx Saga)

objects.text:
Your ability to create spells has evolved to the creation of whole magic systems. 

Each system is centered around a core idea that defines its principles, it might be the use of runes, magic circles, hand signs, or incantations, it could require careful study and preparation or simply visualization and willpower, it might need the user to build stronger spells by combining basic ones, it could use spell slots, or consume mana in discrete increments, or allow spells to be altered or merged when cast, only your imagination is the limit; the only requirement is that the system must use mana in some form. 

The creation process is simple and intuitive, and you can specify as much or as little as you want of the core concept. Once you have the idea, it takes from a few hours to a few days for the system to form, depending on how complex the system is and how much this power has to fill in the blanks. You can only create a new system every few days to weeks, the time depends on how complex your last creation was.

Every magic system starts at tier one and has its own mana pool, with its own capacity and recovery rate. At this point, you can start to create and cast spells, and the system will be roughly on-par with what Spell Crafter can do. 

You can tweak a magic system after its creation but only to a degree, to truly expand its capabilities and build on the concept, you need to spend mana. Once enough mana has been spent, usually between 20-30 full mana pools, the magic system will grow to the next tier, up to the maximum of tier 10. 

As with the creation process, you can specify the direction and finer details of this growth, but each tier usually brings major qualitative improvements and an increase in power of roughly 20%. For each tier, the capacity of the mana pool increases by 100% of the base value and the recovery rate by 150%. (ie: at tier 3, the mana pool will be 3x as big as it was at tier one).

At tiers 3, 6, and 9, the system gains one space for "extra" features, secondary abilities that built on core features of the system, like scaling spell slots, a secondary mana pool to fuel meta-magic or perks, etc. You can design and modify those abilities the same way as the main system. At every even tier (2, 4, 6, ...), the system gains one "perk" which is a minor ability, such as the ability to dual-cast or fuse spells; at tier 10, it gains a capstone perk, which can have more powerful benefits.

Once a system reaches tier 10, you have two options: prestige, which allows you to add a second core concept to the system, or fusion, which allows you to fuse two magic systems together; in both cases, the system will reset to tier 1 but with a 20% increase in growth rate (up to 500%). You can merge or prestige any number of times.

Upgrades that improve mana capacity or generation apply to the total value, across all systems, split between them based on their tier, so stronger systems will benefit more from this than weaker ones. You can integrate the magic systems you buy from the CYOA into this ability, they will start at a tier that matches their base power level.
objects.title: System Crafter

objects.text: You are the same sort of being as Kairos, the Overlord, the mysterious ruler of Terratus. This means that you have the ability to cast 'Edicts'. Edicts are a powerful sort of magic that enforce certain rules over a region. They are usually incredibly large in scale, affecting entire nations or armies.
