These edicts also require someone to speak them to whoever they are meant for, usually a herald of some sort. This process is dangerous and can kill if done repeatedly. Examples of Edicts include the Edict of Execution, which would kill everyone in a small nation if the armies of the Overlord did not successfully crush a rebellion by a certain date, or the Edict of Fire, which destroyed an entire city with incredible heat.
objects.title: Overlord (Tyranny)

addons.text:
Your mastery of magic no longer recognizes the boundaries between systems, schools, or traditions. Where others must learn, adapt, or discover, you simply are complete.

You possess an intrinsic, fully realized understanding of every category of magic that exists, has existed, or could exist across the multiverse. This does not grant you the pinnacle abilities of every magic system outright, but instead provides immediate, functional mastery over every type of magic, each at a level equivalent to a practitioner who has devoted a decade to that specific discipline. Legilimency, Alteration, Necromancy, Formalcraft, Chaos Magic, Soul Sorcery, and countless more schools of magic are yours to wield from the outset.

More importantly, these categories are not separate within you. Your magic operates as a unified spectrum rather than isolated schools. You may freely merge, layer, and restructure different types of magic into singular expressions. A spell is no longer defined by its traditional limitations, but by the aspects you choose to include. Fire may carry temporal destruction, healing may restore the soul while reinforcing the body, and destructive magic may be intertwined with spatial distortion effects.
addons.title: Prismatic Archmage

objects.text: White, Black, Red, Blue, and Green. All of these mages have advantages and disadvantages in their own arenas. But now, your study and ability to be all of these have merged into a new mage class: The Rainbow Mage. If the Red mage was a Jack of All trades, master of none, then that 'none' has been replaced by all. Any magic previously wielded by the mages have been gifted to you at full strength, with certain synergies being improved. White and Green has combined so that you can heal mental and even soul based damage. Black, blue, and Red have synergized so that any magic you copy will not just be as good, it'll be even better. A fireball copied from a dragon will become a hailstorm of the hottest fire in the realm. An Ice spike will become colder than absolute zero and sharp enough to almost cut atoms. Black Magic will also be far less at risk of any corruption or darkness in your heart.
objects.title: Rainbow Mage

addons.text: Your acquisition of cursed energy has combined with both you gun magic and your position as one of lockheed martins top magical guys(or gals). And has resulted in your abilities with firearm and artillery magic to combine into an innate cursed technique capable of summoning any weapon of war you might desire, from personal weaponry to tanks to helicopters, all able to be remotely controlled by you. The limitations of future tech and magical/cursed weaponry remains from before with you unlocking more as you master your technique. Furthermore you are able to perform your ultimate expression of jujutsu off the bat! Your Domain expansion creates an empty flat plain, where in the distance, forever out of reach, is an infinite amount of artillery ready and posed to fire at whatever you desire, as well the skies are filled with bombers and air support ready to fire at your will. Furthermore surrounding your adversary are countless guns and weaponry floating and ready to fire when you will it. You are able to remotely control every weapon and war machine in here in precise detail. Your domains sure hit effect naturally applies to every single piece of weaponry here. Meaning there is nowhere to run. Furthermore these will not disappear after 8-10 rounds and require no upkeep in cursed energy. You are able to equip them with any modern weaponry for absolutely free, and any fantastical or sci-fi ammunition or warmachines have their cost reduced to a fraction of a fraction of their normal costs. Furthermore the restrictions on what level of enhanced weaponry you can summon is somewhat lifted, with you being able to summon far beyond your normal limit while the domain is active, meaning Fx. That if you could normally summon something like an orbital bombardment you could now summon something like an Exterminatus round from Warhammer 40k. Between heaven and earth, the Military Industrial Complex alone is the honored one
addons.title: Domain Expansion: Unlimited Defence Budget

objects.text: Welcome to Estallia gentlemen, I will not lie, your chances of survival are small. But you have my word that I will use my Arcane gifts to ensure that your bodies are given unto Morr’s garden. This is the greatest reward, more than even gold, for the fate of your soul is an eternal concern. - SUPREME Meme wizard You are no longer limited to merely firearms, rather you have ascended to a higher calling. You are now a true artillery wizard, able to use your magical energy to cast spells which summon and or create temporary artillery pieces or other forms of war machines which will then bomb an area of your choosing, These spells are neigh infinitely scaling, meaning you can summon as many war machines as you have the energy for. Once they are summoned and are firing they require no further energy to keep around but dissipate after 8–10 shots and or bombs. The war machines require no operators, able to magically operate themselves, and are able to be directed with a thought from you. You are able to summon them far away from your current position if you want to, but since you might not be able to see the conditions they spawn in they might be out of position for what you require due to, FX. Tilting over or being stuck in a hole. So be careful with that. You are also able to choose what kind of ammunition they shoot, this includes but is not limited to, napalm, chemical warfare rounds, biological warfare rounds, magical warfare rounds, and much more. With more deadly ammunition being more magically expensive to conjure. The types of war machines you can conjure up is not limited to ground warfare either, you are perfectly capable of summoning up temporary air support, bombers, or even fighter jets to perform quick but devastating strikes on enemy targets. This does include nuclear bombers, but the cost of such ammunition tends to be quite large, even on the lower end of nuclear weaponry. You can also conjure up ballistic missiles, even ICBMs, when you get good at this school of magic. At the start, you are only able to summon modern weaponry and ammunition, with maybe a few types of enchanted ammunition if you are careful. However, as you get better you start being able to summon up science fiction adjacent, and then full on sci-fi stuff. As well as full on magical and enchanted forms of artillery and air support. Even going as far as being able to summon in orbital bombardment from a phantasmal ship in orbit. So go on and raise hell, and remember, to support the military industrial Complex young wizard, because for every advancement they make, you make one too.
objects.title: Lockheed Martin Wizard

objects.text:
Your Nerves of Steel now further augment your spine, transforming it into a crystalline extension of your Magic Crest. While the Crest in your skull handles complex design and high-level processing, the Spinal Crest acts as your body's primary mana conduit and autonomic spell processor.
 
Your spine is now the thickest, purest crystal conduit in your body, acting as the central "mana return pipe" from body to soul and drastically reducing energy loss and resistance in the bio-energy to mana conversion loop. This effectively doubles your passive mana generation rate.
 
The Spinal Crest also operates as a secondary, larger mana-crystal supercomputer. By sharing the computational load with your primary Crest, it reduces the processing time for complex spells, increasing your overall casting speed by about 50%.
 
Finally, the Spinal Crest can store a handful of simple spell formulae as pure autonomic responses. These "reflex spells" are pre-loaded with a trigger condition (e.g., "upon impact," "when foreign mana is detected"). The variables are constantly recalculated in the background, allowing the spells to be executed with zero conscious input - faster than thought itself.
objects.title: Spinal Crest

objects.text: You gain a Talent for a particular usage of the One Power. These can cover a wide range of abilities, ranging from healing, to Foretelling, and many more. These Talents mean that you will naturally learn how to weave these particular effects.
objects.title: Talented

objects.text:
Your magic affinity evolves, now including time itself. To start off, you know a dozen spells centred around time manipulation. While not being extremely powerful, you can now slow down or speed up time, create pocket dimensions where time stands still by combining your time and space magic, or even rewind time for minor objects, restoring damage or refilling drinks, for example.

With practice and research, however, the entirety of space-time will bend to your will; you will be able to create time loops, freely rewind or travel through time, create space-time nexuses where all timelines converge, and anything else you might imagine.
objects.title: Space-Time Magic

addons.text:
You can now integrate Falna into the Goddesses you've created. This means that the Goddesses can now benefit from the blessing and bestow it onto other people.

The Falna that is bestowed upon other people is no normal Falna. It has been coloured by a Goddess' innate abilities, giving those blessed better Excelia gain for actions that mimic a Goddess's powers. For example, a goddess who had the ability of summoning swords would give increased Excelia to those who used and made Swords.

The Knight of a Goddess is also given a significant boost, earning Excelia like they had a growth skill on the level of Bell Cranel, so long as they maintain the bond of Knight and Goddess.
addons.title: Falnic Goddesses

objects.text: The battle is about to begin, yes? And not just any battle. A battle to save others. As a Goddess, I shall grant you victory. Therefore when every last enemy is defeated, you are to shower me with praise whilst rubbing my head." You can now create Goddesses. Supernatural Weapons made by ancient humans to be used in the defence of mankind. Each has a specific niche, from summoning swords, creating poison or even resurrecting the dead; When creating a goddess you may designate what their particular niche when you produce them. They also by default need a "Knight"; Someone that unlocks their powers and acts as a "Master" for them. This bond cannot be broken, save for the death of one of bond's holders. Goddesses also have an instinctual need to be praised for their actions, often fighting beyond their limits to earn the most valuable currency to them, the blessed Head-Pat. Despite their fearsome abilities, they are not all powerful. They still bleed, get exhausted, die and can be corrupted like any other Human.
objects.title: Goddess Creation (Sentenced to be a Hero)

objects.text:
You have developed new features in this broad fusion of various powers centered on puppets.

With the help of Golemancy, in its freedom to manipulate any type of material, and the ability to control anything granted by Puppet Monarch, a capability has been achieved that borders on materiokinesis and biokinesis. You can consider everything around you as equivalent to a puppet/golem, which you are able to manipulate as freely as you wish.

Additionally, you can extend this manipulative effect to other entities and any artifact as long as they do not resist your influence. This can range from turning organic beings into a realistic imitation of elemental spirits that can manipulate the element they represent, or simply converting them directly into conscious androids with all kinds of weaponry and futuristic functions. You can even grant any foreign artifact its own consciousness and autonomy, while ensuring they remain loyal to you.

With the introduction of Figurines Collector, you can store your golems/puppets within your shadow realm with all the benefits that entails. Not to mention that they now have the freedom to fully manifest in their real version on which they were inspired, instead of their doll version that only partially simulated their original counterparts.

The number of dolls/golems you can keep active and control simultaneously is 20. If you grant them autonomy, with or without loyalty to the creator, they can be as many as your mastery of creation allows and as much energy as you can provide. The multiple energy reserves of each power have increased the SP-equivalent power limit to 15.

With the incorporation of Alchemist of Atlas (Type-Moon), you have gained the ability to modify, combine, reuse, and create artifacts or complementary functions both for your puppets/golems and for yourself.

For example, creating armor with your own enchantments or mechanisms could enhance the defense of a golem intended to unleash war in an aquatic environment, with the help of a puppet specialized in aquatic environments fused into its body to reduce any environmental disadvantages it might have. Conversely, you could create a golem in the form of armor that automatically protects you from any imminent attack while reusing a preexisting golem with another form and enchantment adapted to an urgent need, without having to create another one from scratch, in addition to granting yourself power equivalent to 15 SP, either permanently or temporarily.

Additionally, through the use of Thought Acceleration and Memory Partition combined with the ability to transform into a puppet or golem, you have gained the option to divide a portion of your soul and infuse it into your creations, effectively creating an avatar of your own design. This can even serve as a valid path to immortality as long as there is at least one trace of yourself and a hive mind is maintained by having your soul fragments distributed among all your creations. Do not worry your soul will regenerate simply by using the same energy reserves you use to create golems/puppets or by residing within your own shadow realm.

Finally, you can incorporate any technology, whether scientific or magical in nature, into your creations, thus allowing a level of customization and creation limited only by your craftsmanship skill and imagination.
objects.title: Doll of Creation

objects.text:
You have become the Host of your own Akademeia, a supernatural study modeled after the study of the late king of Euchronia Hythlodaeus V at the Euchronian Mage Academy. As the name suggests, it's dedicated to studying and researching Archetypes unlocked from your bonds. You could even create new Archetypes never before seen with enough research and bonds. Only those who are holding More's Utopia book, the one you're now holding, are allowed in.

Within Akademeia is your very own equivalent to More, a caretaker who will assist in researching your Archetypes and managing Akademeia when you're away. You may design their appearance, personality, mannerisms, etc.. While outside Akademeia, phantoms of your Akademeia caretaker will appear in many places, allowing you to access it practically wherever you go, with the cat Plateau being used as a quick visit in dungeons. Nobody can see either phantoms except those who've entered Akademeia already, and those you allow to see them.

You can use this to assist others as well. Inside Akademeia, you can unlock the ability for your Companions to be able to use Archetypes, as well as experiment with learned Skills as part of Skill Inheritance and perform Special Experiments for the Masked Dancer and Summoner Archetypes.

Note: Decorative horns, long blond hair, and black outfit is optional. For each new visitor to Akademeia, you may design a new Attendant. You or your Attendant(s) may leave Akademeia, but the last one to leave will be trapped in Akademeia until they return to switch places.
objects.title: Welcome to Akademeia (Metaphor: ReFantazio)

addons.text:
Your overwhelming affinity towards an element has forcibly aligned your Mana Core to said element. While this does mean that your Mana Core can’t be a different element, the sheer effortless power you now possess more than makes up for it. 

Such is the might you now wield that with barely any training your spells can reach planetary scale if used recklessly, for example a Wind Core could casually conjure a typhoon by just playing around with the weather, or inflict worldwide hypoxia by depriving everyone within range of oxygen.

Furthermore, everything save for the topmost layer of skin has been completely replaced by your Core, to the point that you are basically a living mass of crystallized elemental magic pretending to be human. Naturally, this makes your reserves completely off the charts, to the point that you can throw around high-tier spells without even making a dent in your reserves.
addons.title: Nascent Elemental

addons.text: Due to the aberrant nature of your Core, it has managed to overtake and assimilate your Gate as well. Don’t worry, this isn’t actually a bad thing, if anything it's entirely good news. Not only has the crystallization of your Gate made it more durable and resistant to damage, but as literally crystallized magic energy it has become of a higher quality as well, capable of safely channeling an order of magnitude more magical energy with even greater precision than before. Furthermore, the crystallized parts of your body count as a sort of extension of your Gate, not quite a true part of your Gate, but more connected to it nonetheless. This allows them to serve as conduits of sorts for mana, enhancing the effectiveness of the Flow Method in both efficiency and strength. Lastly, if the element of your Core and Gate match then your potential with that element is vastly enhanced, making you a prodigy and powerhouse comparable to the Witch of Envy’s mastery of Yin. If you have Nascent Elemental then your fully crystallized body renders your proficiency with the Flow Method comparable to people like Cecilus Segmunt and even Reinhard van Astrea, and if the element of your Core and Gate align then your magical potential surpasses even Satella at her peak.
addons.title: Crystal Gate

addons.text: Your Magic Circuits are among the organs crystallized by your Core, sparking a groundbreaking fusion between the two. Firstly, your Circuits become heavily attuned towards your Element, making Magecraft of that element vastly more efficient and powerful. Secondly, the crystallized parts of your body count as one massive Circuit, allowing you to harness mind boggling amounts of magical energy. Together, these attributes allow your spells to achieve effects comparable to Noble Phantasms given sufficient practice. If you have Nascent Elemental then your affinity for your Element rivals Shirou Emiya’s affinity for Swords even if your Origin is something else, allowing you to achieve Magecraft that approaches the level of True Magic within your field. Furthermore, as a living crystallized Magic Circuit you will become an entity analogous to Thia Escardos; not quite at the same level but definitely of the same variety of existence. If you possess Crystal Gate as well then your crystallized Gate and Circuits learn from each other, sharing attributes to a certain extent. Your Circuits become attuned towards whatever Element your Gate possesses, stacking with the benefits from the element of your Core, and each Circuit begins to act like a miniature Gate, capable of a fraction of the power of a real Gate but still capable of great feats if utilized correctly. Your Gate on the other hand, begins to act like a pseudo Mana Core.
addons.title: Crystal Circuits

objects.text: …What are you? You are an aberrant existence, born with a Mana Core that replaced not just your heart and some bones and organs, but your entire skeletal structure and all of your organs, as well as your nervous system. You can barely be called human, more elemental magic made false-flesh than anything else. On one hand, you now possess the raw power devastate countries on your lonesome given enough time and training, on the other hand you’ll need to put in a hell of a lot more effort in order to get any semblance of conscious control over your magic, as your affinity is so strong that your magic responds to even the slightest subconscious desire.
objects.title: Aberrant Core

objects.text:
You’re a true Heretic, inheriting the abilities, knowledge, and skills of all Great Houses regardless of your initial position.

Similarly, the limits of your Unit Composition, and even the limits placed on the number of Units you can have (including the Tyrant limit) have been lifted, letting you have as many Units in your retinue as you can raise, though upgrading them will still require investing Dark Power for each as usual.
objects.title: Heretic (Magnagothica: Maleghast)

objects.text: Your powers can be seamlessly integrated with the System, where they manifest as special classes, which allows them to benefit from attributes and grain perks as their level increases; powers can be grouped together into one class, such as multiple magic powers under [Sorcerer Apprentice] or several blaster powers under [Legend], however, this can dilute the perk pool if the powers are are too different. You can have one primary power class and an unlimited number of secondary power classes, which follow the standard class rules of the system; you can swap out your primary power class once a week and gain more primary class slots through achievements and perks. Powers that are part of classes start out 25% weaker at level one and increase in strength by a flat 1% (additive) for every level, up to a maximum of 100%. If you have Acclimation, you can get the tier-0 variant of the power classes, which start at the acclimation floor and evolve at level 25 (or 50 if you have Quarter Pounder).
objects.title: System Integration

addons.text: You can have up to 3 primary power classes (with a level equal to 1/2 their total SP, up to 75) and an unlimited amount of secondary power classes (with a level equal to 1/4 their total SP, up to 25); the powers only benefit from 1/5th of the strength increase from the levels gained through this upgrade.
addons.title: The Shard Immortal

objects.text: You have ascended into an Immortal, your body is almost entirely composed of mana, and your aging is stopped entirely; only your brain remains organic. As part of your ascension, you have gained a unique rarity X achievement that represents your title as an immortal — which takes the form of [The Immortal of X and Y] or [The X Immortal], depending on your class and deeds — and provides significant bonus to your attributes, two unique perks with strong powers, and the ability to recover from near-death once a week, as long as your brain isn't destroyed. You have one tier-2 primary class of your choice at level 5, which is a unique evolution of your previous class, two rare tier-1 primary classes between level 75 and 85, two common tier-1 primary classes between level 65 and 75, and up to ten secondary classes between levels 10 and 20, with the perks and combinations to match; your weakest attributes at around 150 and the strongest exceed 200, before any enhancements, which usually sit between 120% and 160%. As an Immortal mage, your mastery of magic is nearly unmatched. Your main magic seed has an immense capacity for mana, with a conversion ratio above 200%, and the number of magic tendrils you can deploy is in the dozens; depending on your perk choices, you might have a small selection of strong magic seeds (with a conversion ratio between 80% and 120%), or a wide variety of weaker magic seeds (with a conversion ratio between 40% and 80%), or even both with the right classes and perks. You are not necessarily a terror on the battlefield, but anyone trying to pick a fight with you will regret it nonetheless, as even the least combat-oriented Immortal is still a force to be reckoned with; and if you are focused on combat, may the System have mercy on your enemies.
objects.title: The Immortal of Choice and Adventure

objects.text: You gain the unique achievement [Rozeta's Blessing (Rarity X)] which grants you the following benefits: an additional primary class slot, with the tier-0 [Script Mage] class at level 1, which grants you access to the Script as part of the System; access to the [Focus] attribute, which boosts your mana regeneration; a [Pure Mana] magic seed with a 120% conversion ratio to power your spells; and +50 to your Magic attribute.
objects.title: System Script

objects.text: As an Immortal and Archmage of the Script, you have the tier-2 [Script Archmage] class at level 5, which is an evolution of any tier-1 script class of your choice. In addition to your [Pure Mana] seed, you have 3-4 mana seeds for specific branches of magic, including any you have invented.
objects.title: Archmage of the System

objects.text: You gain the unique achievement [INTEGRATION (Rarity X)] which grants you the following benefits: an additional primary class slot, with the tier-1 [Shard Mage] class at level 1, which allows you to use Arcanist and/or Kineticist through the System; one magic seed per sub-power with a conversion ratio of 120%; and +50 to your Magic attribute.
objects.title: Mage of Shards

objects.text: As an Immortal and Archmage (of Shards), your [Shard Mage] upgrades to the tier-2 version [Shard Archmage] at level 5, which allows you to use the other components of Archmage, such as Armiger, Artificer, through the System. You have at least one magic seed per component (with a conversion ratio of 120%), and several more with a conversion ratio between 60% and 30% depending on your perks.
objects.title: Archmage of Shards

objects.text: As the Archmage, you possess the unique achievements [Sorcerer Supreme (Rarity X)] and [Height of Occultism (Rarity X)] as well as the [Sigil of the Archmage] and [Sanctum Sanctorum] unique perks. You have the tier-3 [Sorcerer Supreme] class, which puts your total level above 300, two tier-2 classes between levels 140 and 160, three tier-2 classes between levels 70 and 90, and up to twenty secondary classes between levels 30 and 40. Your mental attributes are all above 300 while your Magic attribute has surpassed 1000. Your system mana seeds are upgraded to fully-fledged mana cores, which allows you to use their magic directly without the need for mana tendrils. At minimum, you have all four of the basic seeds (Kinetic, Thermal, Electromagnetic, and Organic) as well as a vast array of powerful perks and skills. Your system mainframe is located inside of your Sanctum Sanctorum, which includes resource nodes for all the exotic materials required to alter the system enchantments. You can connect other people to your instance of the system; however, you cannot modify their system status, as this part of the enchantment is held within the individuals themselves.
objects.title: The Immortal Archmage

objects.text:
You are now an Elemental Mage, a mage who has decided to focus on bending the elements to their will rather than a more esoteric form of magic. You can conjure, control, and dismiss the four basic elements: Air, Water, Earth, and Fire. However, over time and with training, you can access more advanced elements, such as Lightning, or even more esoteric elements like Light, Time, or Shadow.

You start only being able to manipulate those elements in a range of 20 meters around you for a few minutes, able to launch rock like a bullet or flame hot enough to melt metal in seconds, but anything more than in term of strength (not control) that will require training of your modest mana pool to expand it and your control over it. Your control is precise enough that you could make statues of your elements with precise details.

Esoteric application of elements is tough to do but possible, requiring decades if not centuries just to use the most basic esoteric application of a basic element like water’s ability to heal.

You cannot enhance your body with your elemental magic at the start, but a sufficiently masterful user of it might be able to.
objects.title: Elemental Mage

objects.text: You can now fully control how petrification affects your targets. You may force the petrified to remain conscious even in the form of a stone statue, as well as let them selectively keep any senses.
objects.title: I Have no Mouth and I Must Scream
Defiling Magic (D&D: Dark Sun)
objects.text:
You have learned the forbidden arts of Defiling Magic from the realm of Athas, the exact opposite of Preserving Magic, a careful nature-making that ensures the world around you. Defiling Magic is the art of converting the life energy of the surrounding land into power through which the wizard casts spells that drain life force, killing nearby vegetation and draining fertility from the soil.

The benefit to Defiling magic is not only does it provide far more magic then even a simple Arcane Spell it also is far quicker to learn increasingly growing with a speed the more you use your spells and should you progress further into this magic you would be able to not only draw energy for spells in plants and the land but all living things being able to focus and direct what you want to drain for fuel in your arcane workings.

The other benefit to Defiling Magic is the end goal of most Defilers in becoming a sorcerer-king and evolving enough in the Defiling Magic to become a Dragon, something you will know how to do but are nowhere near done, as it will take many years to tap into the starting stages of becoming a Stage 1 Dragon.

You will, like Arcane Magic, begin in the novice stages of a spellcaster in Defiling Magic, slowly growing and gaining more spells naturally as your mastery of Defiling Magic grows through experimentation.

objects.title: Netherese Age Wizard (D&D)
objects.text:
You are no longer just a novice of the magic of the weave. Perhaps you escaped the folly of Karsus, or perhaps you are a lucky wizard who stumbled your way into acquiring and reading the Nether Scrolls. No matter the method, you are no mere novice; instead, you are steeped in the lore of magic and the weave.

You have power similar to a level 20 wizard, with all that entails: wizard class features and abilities included. This also allows you to start with casting 9th-level spells; however, most of it will be in a specific school of magic, although you won't be limited to that school; this only determines what spells you will initially know. 

You have a similar magical talent to Karsus himself; perhaps from reading the Nether Scrolls or being another wizard of this time, you find it easier to learn new spells and modify your existing ones. You are also at a rate where you could cast spells at and beyond 10th level from existing outside the Forgotten Realms; do be careful not to replicate the fall of Karsus.

objects.title: Additional Commandments (The Seven Deadly Sins)
objects.text:
Each time you select this option, you receive another of the Demon King’s Commandments, progressively amplifying the power you possess the more Commandments you have. Should you absorb all ten Commandments, you will acquire power equal to that of the Demon King.

With sufficient skill, you may harness the power of your Commandment(s) to create powerful techniques, much like Mael did after acquiring multiple Commandments. You are also guaranteed to be able to use their powers without risking your well-being, and you will not be overtaken by the Demon King if you possess them all.

objects.title: Summer / Winter Knight (Dresden Files)
objects.text: Now, rather than just Summer Fire or Winter Ice you have received the weakest of the major Mantles of the seasonal Courts; that of one of the two Knights. This Mantle grants power; but also gives obligations and mentally affects the holder. It grants ageless immortality to the holder (if they don’t have it already), can only be transferred upon the death (does not need to be a permanent death) of a holder, and the longer it is held the more it affects the mind of the holder; although it’s always possible to resist. The Mantle of Knight allows the holder to use substantially more Summer Fire or Winter Ice than most Fae, but less than any major Fae Nobles or Ancients of their Court. They also become particularly adept at physical enhancement in the way of their Court, and gain enhanced healing enough to recover from even the most severe injuries in about a week of rest (although this does not have much immediate affect and requires rest to occur like natural healing). Knights must obey the laws of their Court, owe their fealty to the Queen and Mother, and are responsible for the obligations of their underlings should they be incapable of completing them. Unlike most noble Fae the Knights are capable of lying. Over time the Mantle holder will become closer to the emotional norm of their court: wildly emotional for Summer, and coldly clear, sociopathic, and calculating (aside from fight-or-flight and other primal emotions) for Winter; they will also feel a slight degree of inherent aggression towards any Fae of the opposing Court that they meet. Should they ignore or act counter to the obligations of their Mantle; the holder’s access to the Mantle’s power will be weakened or even temporarily removed, until they make amends.

objects.title: Summer / Winter Queen (Dresden Files)
objects.text: Now, you have received one of the ruling Mantles of Power from your respective Fae Court. There are three of these per court: the Maiden/Lady (or Queen-Who-Will-Be), the Queen (Queen-Who-Is), and the Mother (Queen-Who-Was). Each Mantle grants power; but also obligations, and mentally affects the holder proportionately to its power. All Mantles grant ageless immortality to their holder (if they don’t have it already), can only be transferred upon the death of a holder or if a higher ranked Mantle-holder dies (then the lower ranked Queen(s) would gain that of their immediate superior), and are weakened during the opposing season proportionately to Day-length. The longer a Mantle is held, the more they affect the mind of the holder, although it’s always possible to resist.. The least of the Queens are the Maidens or Ladies. They are capable of great displays of power in excess of all except the strongest mortal practitioners at their weakest; and even weaker gods at their strongest. They are bound by Court Law, may not lie, owe Fealty to their Court’s Queen and Mother, are responsible for the obligations of their underlings should said underlings be unable to complete them, and are barred from intimate relationships. They are more strongly mentally affected than the Knights: often quickly becoming near identical in actions to the previous Lady should they take up the Mantle. They are incapable of resisting their obligations as their Mantle will send them into a frenzy should they attempt it, and will weaken them for a significant period after. The strongest active Queen of each Court is the Queen-Who-Is. They are equivalent or stronger than many major gods at their weakest: and are capable of making Global Warming look like a picnic, or sending the planet into an Ice-Age, for Summer and Winter respectively at their strongest. They are bound by Court Law (which is primarily created by them), may not lie, owe Fealty to their Court’s Mother, are responsible for the obligations of their underlings should they be unable to complete them and for the general running of their Court. Breaking their word or attempting to ignore or act counter to their Obligations will massively weaken them. Following the pattern; they are even more strongly mentally affected by their Mantles: embodying the “Queen of Air and Darkness” and every Fairytale villain ever, and “Lady of Light and Life” respectively. The most powerful of the Queens are the Mothers. They are so powerful it is near impossible for them to enter standard reality without it cracking around them: far in excess of all but the strongest gods, and are immune to standard Faerie Weaknesses (Salt, Iron, Faith, etc). They are the ones who create, and are the source of power for, the Courts and Mantles. They are not bound by Court Law and owe fealty to no-one; but cannot lie, and are responsible for the obligations of their underlings should they be unable to complete them. Unlike the other Mantle Holders they are not involved in the everyday running of the Courts, and are so affected by their Mantles that Mother Winter thinks of the Queen as ”Overly Sentimental, Lenient, and Soft”; and Mother Summer loves all living things wholeheartedly and equally (including every last microbe and disease).

addons.text:
Your freedom from reliance on mortal beings and external powers has unlocked the full potential of your divinity. By making the power of any being you once depended on your own, everything now flows through you with pure divine essence. No longer confined by the influence of others, your strength is now driven solely by your will and inherent power.

As your divine essence merges with your being, your growth accelerates at an unprecedented rate. With every breath, you feel your power expand. Even without active training, your strength continuously increases as your divine essence expands endlessly.

When you engage in focused effort, however, your growth becomes beyond mortal reckoning, pushing you toward new heights of divinity with each passing moment.

You are no longer bound by the limitations of past dependencies. Your essence is now entirely self-contained—the divine within you is yours alone to command. Your potential is unrestrained and infinite, your strength grows steadily and exponentially- no longer subject to external forces or limitations.

Your journey onwards is unbounded, driven solely by your own divine will. As a being of complete autonomy, you transcend the need for anything outside yourself, embracing the full power of your own essence.
addons.title: Divine Autonomy

objects.text:
True gods do not draw their power from prayer, worship, or belief. Their strength is not fueled by mortal devotion but flows from within—eternal, transcendent, and complete.

Your existence is no longer bound by the whims of mortal faith or rituals. You are a being of immense power, untouched by the need for devotion or the limitations of human understanding.

If, once, your strength depended on belief, or if any of your powers required faith, prayer, worship, or similar acts to grow stronger, that is no longer the case. Your power now grows through your own will—through use, discipline, and the unfolding of your divine nature.

The prayers of others may still reach you, not as demands but as expressions of their hope and reverence. You answer them not out of obligation, but from your own will, moved by compassion, wisdom, or a resonance with your nature.
objects.title: Mythically Accurate

addons.text: “There were gods before you. There will be none after.” You who are untouched by worship, unmoved by rejection, have become more than immune. You are now the axis upon which all lesser divinity fractures. You stand above the divine hierarchy. Your will is not one of coexistence. It is a conquest. You do not endure the presence of other gods. You eclipse them. False thrones crack beneath your gaze. Divine mantles wither in your shadow. Those who call themselves gods find their names dimmed, their miracles unraveled, their dominion muted. You are not content with being unassailable. You are the standard by which all divinity is measured—and found wanting. Yet even Sovereignty may show mercy. This power, absolute though it is, may be veiled by your will. You may allow others to remain unshattered, should it suit your purpose, vision, or grace. Those divine beings who willingly cast down their own mantles and kneel—acknowledging you as the sole flame in the heavens— can be remade into loyal celestial attendants and servants in your name, bound through submission, their purpose and power is yours to shape. You are Sovereignty. Sovereignty does not share. It reigns.
addons.title: Ineffable Sovereignty

objects.text: “I do not scorn you for resisting. You err in believing you could.” You have transcended even the tools forged to cast the divine down. Powers, seals, weapons, objects, divine suppression, nullification, or death effects fail utterly in your presence. Anything laced with anti-divine or anti-immortal intent—none can grasp you. You are impervious to them. Their magic falters. Their logic cracks. Their hatred turns hollow. They do not clash or struggle. They simply fail; the very concept of opposing you was flawed from inception. These forces were made to unmake lesser gods or sever their eternal thread. You are not among them. This immunity is shared, in part, with those you empower. Saints, angels, chosen, and bearers of your mark find the forces that deny godhood weakened before them. They are your reflection, and through them, your untouchable nature echoes. You are Divinity. Divinity is not denied.
objects.title: Unassailable Divinity

objects.text:
Somehow, in some way, you have become a Pure Soul. Your soul has ascended to the highest quality in existence, radiating an essence of unmatched purity and perfection.

You possess the highest level of talent in soul arts, allowing you to effortlessly master techniques such as Kidō from Bleach or Aura from RWBY.

Your purity causes beings of all alignments to view you favorably, fostering goodwill and acceptance wherever you go.

The purity of your soul is so great that even the most corrupt and negative influences cannot permanently mar the perfection that is your soul. Any imperfections are naturally purified over time. With the strength of your soul also granting resistance to soul-based attacks, causing weaker ones to fail entirely.

Lastly, those who can see souls perceive yours as the most beautiful in existence, an awe-inspiring sight that sets you apart from all others.
objects.title: Pure Soul

objects.text:
Your soul, already extraordinary, has ascended into something truly enduring and eternal. It shall never decay or fade with time, becoming immortal in every sense of the word. It is now constantly growing and evolving, pushing and strengthening toward greater heights. Its purity is no longer merely a trait, but the foundation of its existence, allowing it to persist independently of the body and endure for eons even when separated from it. 

Any corruption or imperfection that attempts to take hold is instantly incinerated, unable to persist within your soul, and any damage it suffers rapidly heals to perfection. It possesses exceptional resilience to harm, its structure forming deeper and increasingly durable metaphysical layers as it evolves. Should your soul be shattered, its fragments will not fade, instead lingering and naturally drawing together until it restores itself, so long as even a fragment remains. Even death alone is no longer enough to end you, as your soul can continue to exist on its own until it finds a new anchor.

Your affinity and talent for soul-based abilities have reached a level of impossibility. Techniques that would normally require years or lifetimes to study and create can be grasped through sheer instinct or minimal practice, and even soul arts that would normally conflict with one another are no longer mutually exclusive. No soul-based technique is beyond your reach, regardless of complexity or contradiction.

To perceive your soul is to perceive a vast, endless inner expanse, capable of containing all colors and meanings in the world without breaking under their weight. It possesses immense metaphysical capacity, capable of housing limitless power and knowledge of any form without strain. Anything tied directly to your soul, including abilities or aspects of yourself, will regenerate perfectly alongside it, even if the portion that once held them is destroyed.

Even a fragment of your soul retains immense metaphysical weight, carrying the value of countless ordinary souls. Because of this, portions of it may be used as substitutes in rituals or other soul-based functions without diminishing your existence. Above all else, your soul is singular. No alternate version of you possesses the same soul, nor can it be copied, stolen, replaced, or recreated by any external means. Across all worlds and realities, it remains yours alone.
objects.title: Spiritual Ascendance

addons.text:
Your mastery and knowledge of the Qigong art—Hakkyokuseiken—has helped you gain full mastery and ability with Spirit Control on par with Elder Paibaru, who trained both Goku and Vegeta.

This grants you knowledge and skill to create perfect Ki clones of yourself with no division of power, the ability to enlarge yourself to the size of a giant, and the skill to fully restore your own or anyone else's health to its peak.

And finally, Forced Spirit Fission, which allows you to, after getting into physical contact with an opponent, steal their energy and can either absorb it yourself, disperse it, or send it into other people or living things you touch. This technique can also undo fusions, such as removing beings absorbed by Majin or Potara fusions.

Should someone or something also have absorbed energy from living beings, you can return that to the original people they belong to without any physical contact.
addons.title: Elder Paibaru

objects.text:
You have learned the Art of Spirit Control from the planet Yardrat.

While you have not mastered every technique, you start with the proficiency Goku possesses during the Android Saga.

Thus, you now have greater Ki Control and Instant Transmission, which also comes with the ability to sense other living beings.

You also have the necessary knowledge to continue your spirit control training to the point of mastery, which will allow you to gain new abilities, along with making your Ki more potent in strength.
objects.title: Spirit Control (Dragon Ball Series)

objects.text:
Through either training with the gods or somehow learning to break the barriers of the limits of mortals, you have obtained God Ki.

Compared to regular Ki, God Ki is much denser and much easier to control. You also gain an immense boost in power compared to your full power when using your regular Ki.

While you use God Ki, no one who does not possess God Ki or reach the level of the Gods in power can sense your energy.

You also become immune to the effects of dark magic, but you can mimic the effects should you have the necessary knowledge.
objects.title: God Ki (Dragon Ball Series)

objects.text:
Your power has ascended to legendary heights. A realm of unparalleled might, boundless strength, and limitless possibilities. You have surpassed the Gods of Destruction, and now only the Angels of Zeno-Sama are worthy adversaries. They rightly recognize the immense threat you pose. You are akin to an embodiment of raw power—a veritable god of war in human form. Even a fraction of your released energy can cause the infinite void to tremble, while a mere exertion of your power can obliterate entire universes.

Your remarkable skills match your overwhelming power, enabling you to achieve awe-inspiring feats with your body and Ki. From executing intricate blasts and teleportation to single-handedly vanquishing armies effortlessly, or engaging in duels with the greatest martial masters from different universes and emerging victorious. Your potential for growth extends far beyond your current capabilities, though it will likely require a truly exceptional catalyst to unlock that untapped potential. At present, the only being outside the Angelic hierarchy who can contend with you is Jiren the Grey, a hero whose legend rivals your own.
objects.title: The Grey (Dragon Ball Series)

objects.text:
You have ascended to the pinnacle of martial prowess, achieving a level of mastery so profound that even the gods themselves struggle to attain it. Perfected Ultra Instinct, often deemed the "absolute peak" of martial arts, is your ultimate skill.

This technique grants you the ability to operate at a level beyond conventional human limitations. Unlike ordinary individuals who must consciously think about their actions and await the transmission of commands from their brain through the nervous system, you have transcended this limitation. Every part of your body operates autonomously, independently thinking and acting in perfect harmony.

In the heat of battle, your body effortlessly reacts to any situation or threat with unparalleled precision and timing. You need not even acknowledge the presence of danger; your responses are automatic and flawless. You can engage in combat with supreme effectiveness, even while your focus is diverted elsewhere, rendering you virtually invincible. This transformation will also maintain your body at its peak performance as long as it remains active, ensuring that you always operate at the zenith of your capabilities, while magnifying your strength and abilities to a degree two or even three times greater than your previous mightiest transformation.

This state of Perfected Ultra Instinct will now be your default condition, marked by your hair radiating a resplendent white glow, with your eyes shining a piercing silver light. You can toggle this power on or off at your discretion.
objects.title: Perfected Ultra Instinct (Dragon Ball Series)

objects.text:
This state is attained by one who has received proper God of Destruction training and has gained the ability to use the powers of one.

When the Ultra Ego transformation is in use, the user becomes exponentially more powerful than before and gains the ability to use the Power of Destruction in full. The user's aura can also be manifested in an opaque, flame-like state, which can destroy enemy attacks on contact. In contrast to Ultra Instinct, which draws upon the principles of conquering oneself, Ultra Ego seems to draw upon a severe level of self-indulgence in battle. Whereas Ultra Instinct allows a user's efficiency and power to increase as they continue to evade and counterattack, Ultra Ego allows the user's overall power to increase as they take more damage and delve more into their lust for battle.

The heightened lust for battle required for this state can cause the user to act rashly. Taking damage to fuel one's battle lust and become stronger can backfire if the user accumulates too much physical damage to continue fighting effectively.

In this state, your hair becomes tyrian purple in color, and your eyes attain a magenta-like color irises as well and also retain visible black pupils.
objects.title: Ultra Ego (Dragon Ball Series)

objects.text:
Unlike Fused Zamasu, you've become a true hybrid of divinity and Saiyan supremacy, becoming a being of boundless power and potential. Your divinity as a Kai gives an innate understanding and talent for manipulating God Ki, and your Saiyan combat prowess creates a feedback loop for you to grow in power endlessly.

You begin with power equal to Fused Zamasu, enough to lay waste to an entire world with a flick of your wrists and fight beings as strong as Super Saiyan Blue Vegito. Your understanding of God Ki expands the range of its applications tremendously, from Cloning, Ki Constructs, Teleportation, Elementalism, Portal Creation, and much more. Limited only by imagination and ability. 

You can exploit the growth rate of Saiyans through Zenkais with your own immortality (granted by the Super Dragon Balls) and healing abilities, plus the unique nature of your essence let's you create transformations on an entirely different level. You also have an innate grasp towards divine techniques like Ultra Instinct or Destruction Energy.

In time, surpassing beings as strong as Beerus, or even Zeno becomes a very real possibility.
objects.title: Divine Wrath (Dragon Ball Series)

objects.text:
You step in the footsteps of Shiranui. You have mastered all the celestial brush techniques and can create more as you please. You now represent, and are, the sun, life, and goodness. Your presence drives off evil and darkness in all its forms with no exceptions. Your presence is like a divine intervention for the world around you, healing and restoring it, filling it with beauty and blessing the land and people.

Your power is immense, easily enough to govern a solar system, and it will only grow the more faith you have from those around you. If you had the true faith of a medium sized country you could easily affect galaxies.

Nothing but true evil, and weapons made thereof, can hurt you, and even then, it's not like you have a weakness to such weapons or abilities, they just affect you normally.

All things in the world can feel your station, and power when you are near them, making them naturally feel a deep respect for you. The more sentient a thing is, the lesser this effect is, so humans just feel a sense of respect for you, while animals and plants would treat you like royalty. You can hide your presence, and it's effects, if you wish.
objects.title: The Great God (Okami)

objects.text:
"Thou wast perfect in thy ways from the day that thou wast created, till iniquity was found in thee."
-Ezekiel 28:15

You may not have realized it until this very moment, but you are the incarnation of Satan into this blighted age, the single greatest member of the angels of Heaven.

Your raw power tramples on the weak forces present in this age of mere humans. You twice scoured the Earth clean in fire, once accidentally while fighting the other angels alone, and once while fighting Amon for the fate of mankind.

But more than this, you are the Lord of Lies. Your genius and your skill in manipulating events is unparalleled, as even without your angelic power, you can singlehandedly arrange the world situation towards your own benefit, setting nation against nation & man against man. You are even able to take measures to advance your own goals without having your memories or conscious understanding of your goals, so airtight is your planning ability.

You have numerous other powers as well, such as mind reading & mind control, reality warping, resistance to reality warping (as Satan once ignored the effects of time travel on the timeline), elemental manipulation, fusing with & possessing others, power absorption, shapeshifting, demon summoning, evolution (Satan didn't have many of these powers as a pure angel!), teleportation, even more powerful telekinesis than Amon, and many more.

Oh mightiest of angels, inflict your will on the world!
objects.title: The Morning Star (Devilman Series)

objects.text: You gain the abilities of all previous Dragonborn or Shezzarines, such as Pelinal Whitestrake, Saint Alessia, Reman Cyrodil, Martin Septim, Miraak, the many men who make up the gestalt being known as "Talos" (such as Zurin Arctus, Hjalti Early-Beard, & Ysmir Wulfharth), the various protagonists of the series, and even those that attempted to use Lorkhan's power directly (such as the Tribunal, Kagrenac, & Dagoth Ur).
objects.title: Heart of Lorkhan (The Elder Scrolls)

objects.text: Magnus is one of the et’Ada—the original divine spirits—the Great Architect who helped plan the creation of Mundus at the dawn of existence. He was also the first of what became the Magna-Ge to withdraw and flee into Aetherius, with his departure creating the Sun, never to be truly seen again. Even long gone, he was considered the God of Magic and the God of the Sun. Now you have mantled him so completely that you are becoming him, and he is becoming you. With this, you will eventually inherit all of his knowledge, his power, and his domains as the God of Magic and the Sun. Whether this changes your personality or not, is up to you. As the new God of the Sun, you have total control over that Celestial Sphere, able to command it to rise and set at your whim. You can call upon its celestial heat, light, and weight as you wish. As the new God of Magic, you also hold the title of the Sorcerer King, to whom all mages look to for guidance. You are able to develop new spells in an instant and recreate any feat of magic ever described. You are Magic—so utterly, so completely—that you can rewrite the Laws of Magic at your whim, redefining what is and isn’t possible with the Arcane Arts. You have the power to decide which souls will carry the spark of magic, able to ignite the gift of magic within others or snuff it out as you see fit.
objects.title: Mantle of Magnus (The Elder Scrolls)

objects.text: Instead of being merely Akatosh’s child by virtue of your Dragonborn blood and soul, you are Akatosh in truth. You have mantled your “parent” so completely that the world considers you and Akatosh one and the same. Now, you are Akatosh, the Dragon-God of Time. As the Lord of Time, you cannot be bound by it. You’ll find yourself able to manipulate time around you freely. With enough practice and experience, you’ll even be able to travel through time as if it were just another road. You’ve inherited Akatosh’s legendary bow—said to have been used to slay Lorkhan eons ago—and shield. These treasures draw upon the power of the sun itself. The bow can generate and fire arrows of solar fire that never miss, while the shield renders its bearer immune to all forms of fire and can reflect spells back to their source. Finally, Akatosh is the Father of Dragon-kind. Whatever your appearance, you are the undisputed Lord of Dragons, with dragons of all varieties bending to your will. You can create new dragons from infinitesimal fragments of your divine soul or empower another being with those fragments, turning them into a Dovahkiin—a Dragonborn. So long as even one of these dragons lives, you can never truly be destroyed or killed.
objects.title: Mantle of Akatosh (The Elder Scrolls)

objects.text:
Ki Rata is an internal/external discipline, widely respected as the deadliest Fist Art across the Kill Six Billion Demon multiverse.

The foundational concept of the technique is using a breathing technique to channel the soul flame that is Atum, generating immense power, which is then concentrated into a point smaller than the head of a needle before being unleashed. This compression of force imbues any strike with extraordinary power.

Each blow using this technique is named by the number of points it contains. The more points an attack has, the stronger it is.

A one-point blow can shatter a large stone with a tap, a two-point blow can decapitate a man with the air pressure created by flicking a finger, and a ten-point blow can level an entire city to the ground.

Practitioners of the art are also granted a great amount of durability as long as they do not break their focus.

You are granted total knowledge of every technique and forbidden art that Ki Rata has to offer, as well as the mastery to perform a two-point blow. With ten years of intense training, you could become as skilled as Solomon David in the mastery of Ki Rata.
objects.title: Ki Rata (Kill Six Billion Demons)

objects.text:
You’ve gone through the same process as Jagganoth and nailed thirty iron angel feathers into yourself, making you invincible to the point that the concept of harming you has been removed from existence. Not even several of the strongest beings in existence each wielding a Key of Kings working together could kill you.

You can still be restrained, imprisoned, or moved without your will, and you feel the pain of every attack that strikes you as if it had done damage. You can be incapacitated by the pain, but there will be no lasting consequences.
objects.title: Destroyer of the Seven-Part World (Kill Six Billion Demons)

objects.text: You started with Academy-level skills in using chakra, which, while better than nothing, isn’t exactly something to write home about. While you have the potential to develop techniques and become the titan of power you always wanted to be, that takes time—time you may not have or want to spend. But what if there was a way to bypass some of that early grind? For each level of Promotion you select here, your skills and capabilities will be increased accordingly—first to Genin, then Chunin, and finally Jounin. You’ll find yourself at the very peak of that rank, able to reach the next with minimal effort. As a Genin, you’ve mastered basic chakra control exercises like Tree Climbing and Water Walking, begun to master your element, learned a variety of low-level jutsu—nothing beyond a C-Rank—and started to specialize in a chosen shinobi art. As a Chunin, you’ve begun to learn B-Rank techniques—having at least one of your choice mastered—mastered your elemental affinity, started to learn a second element, built a solid foundation in most shinobi skills, and expanded your specialization with new abilities. As a Jounin, you’ve reached the top of the food chain—for a normal shinobi, that is—an elite shinobi with an arsenal of jutsu, including at least one A-Rank technique. You’ve mastered your second element—potentially starting to learn a third—and you can either be a Jack-of-all-Trades when it comes to shinobi arts or a true master of one.
objects.title: Promotion (Naruto)

objects.text:
Talent is not solely determined by intelligence or skill. Sometimes, what separates legends from ordinary shinobi is simply the amount of chakra they possess. While your control, knowledge, and experience remain unchanged, your body possesses the potential to generate and contain vastly greater quantities of chakra than normal.

Each purchase of Potential raises the maximum chakra reserves your body can ultimately attain while also increasing your current reserves proportionally. More importantly, your chakra reserves become significantly easier to cultivate, allowing them to grow at a rate impossible for ordinary shinobi through training, experience, and the natural strengthening of your body and spirit. Even early on, your reserves will greatly exceed those expected of someone with your level of training, with this advantage becoming more pronounced as your potential increases.

The first purchase grants you chakra potential comparable to peak Kisame with the Samehada, placing your ultimate reserves among the greatest ever possessed by an ordinary shinobi. Though you are still far from realizing that limit, your chakra pool can eventually grow to a level that allows you to wield powerful techniques far more freely than your peers.

The second purchase elevates your chakra potential to that of Prime Hashirama. Your maximum reserves can eventually dwarf those of nearly every Kage, allowing you to sustain devastating techniques and prolonged battles that would exhaust even elite shinobi.

The third and final purchase grants you chakra potential comparable to that of a Ten-Tails Jinchūriki. Should you fully realize this potential, your chakra reserves become truly monstrous, eclipsing virtually all mortal shinobi. While such heights still demand dedication and years of growth, your ultimate ceiling borders on the divine.
objects.title: Potential (Naruto)

objects.text:
Kekkei Genkai are a special kind of mutation that sprouts up in ninja and usually can then be passed down to a ninja's descendants with varying levels of commonality and strength. A Kekkei Genkai can be anything from a unique biological trait—such as being able to endlessly produce and manipulate bone from your body—to being a unique form of nature transformation, such as being able to easily create and utilize ice or generate crystal, to even being a unique type of eyes with their own abilities.

Any you purchase will come with knowledge on both how to utilize it and several jutsu and techniques to allow you to get started on making more. It will, at minimum, be enough to be considered a threat to most chūnin, if not some jōnin-level ninja, if it's directly combat applicable. It can be any known Kekkei Genkai from the series besides Sharingan, Rinnegan, Mokuton, Byakugan, Tenseigan, and Ketsuryūgan. It can also be any new one of your own design.

You can optionally choose to use one or more purchases to strengthen a Kekkei Genkai. Each purchase would only strength one Kekkei Genkai, so buying two Kekkei Genkai would require buying this two more times to apply the boost to both.
objects.title: Kekkei Genkai (Naruto)

objects.text:
You now possess one of the rarer but more versatile skills in the Shinobi world: the ability to summon allies to aid you in battle. This requires making a contract with the summon clan in question. The contract can take various forms, such as a large scroll or a tattoo, depending on what suits you.

To summon one of your new allies, you will need to sacrifice a small portion of your blood and provide the summon with enough Chakra.

However, be careful—while this power allows you to summon these creatures to your side, it does not guarantee that they will obey your commands.

With each purchase here, you gain a new contract with a different summon clan. These can range from well-known clans such as the Slugs, Toads, or Snakes, to lesser-known ones like Foxes, Bears, or even Dragons.

Each summon clan is guaranteed to have members who are Sages, capable of teaching you Sage Mode if they are willing. However, learning Sage Mode is not easy, and you may find yourself either unable to learn it or, in worst cases, petrified into a statue of your summon clan’s species if you fail.
objects.title: Kuchiyose no Jutsu (Naruto)

objects.text: You can now use the technique Edo Tensei, a profane variant of the summoning jutsu that allows you to summon the soul of a deceased individual into a living vessel and bind them to your will. The summoned souls can be stored within special coffins that can be summoned to a location or used to summon the soul from a distance. The technique requires the user to have acquired the target’s DNA, for their soul to exist in the afterlife, and for a living sacrifice to be provided to host the soul. Once the DNA of the target has been placed on a special scroll—that you now know how to make—it spreads out, forming a seal around the sacrifice, encasing them in dust and ash as it reforms their appearance into that of the soul you are reviving. Those resurrected by this power retain all the memories, powers, and abilities they had in life, including connections to things like summoning contracts. Clothing, armor, and tools are also visually replicated from the same dust and ash that form their resurrected bodies. The summoned souls can regenerate from almost any injury, and their energies are constantly replenished. While the summoner retains control over the movements of the reincarnated souls, you can choose to allow the original personality of the soul to remain—they do typically know how their abilities work best, after all. Alternatively, you can completely suppress their personalities and puppet their resurrected forms, though this requires your constant direct attention. You can switch between different levels of control over your summoned souls at will. There are only three—known—ways to end this technique: have the summoner release the souls, remove the souls from their vessels (and seal them away), or grant the summoned soul closure to their regrets in life.
objects.title: Kuchiyose: Edo Tensei (Naruto)

objects.text:
You now possess the esteemed lineage of the Senju clan, renowned for their exceptional life force and immense physical and mental energy.

This bloodline bestows upon you a range of attributes. Firstly, you inherit a potent life force that manifests as remarkable stamina, overall vitality and physical strength, you no longer need to use hand seals for all but the most advanced techniques, and you gain the regenerative abilities of Hashirama Senju (the accelerated cell growth of which neither shortens your lifespan nor gives you cancer, even enhancing your lifespan by lengthening your telomeres when they shorten). Additionally, you experience a heightened capacity for acquiring or creating new techniques, and possess formidable reserves of chakra, equal to that of a mature jinchūriki. But most notably, you inherit the profound power of Wood Release, an art formed by the harmonious fusion of Water and Earth elements. This sacred technique enables you to breathe life into existence using your own energy, primarily in the form of wood and other botanical creations.

Wood Release excels in almost all situations. You can summon solid wooden barriers to fend off attacks, ensnare adversaries with roots and branches to catch them off guard, and generate fields of fruit that emit poisonous gases capable of explosive impact beneath the enemy's feet, your imagination sets the boundaries as you can craft colossal wooden constructs, rivaling the size of mountains.

Remarkably durable, your wood surpasses the strength of tungsten-steel alloys and possesses the unique ability to absorb life energy from anything it ensnares, should you desire it.
objects.title: Senju (Naruto)

objects.text:
It seems you possess the blood of the Uzumaki, a now decimated but once proud and enigmatic clan descended from Asura himself. The Uzumaki were provided incredible abilities through their bloodline of which you have also inherited, but you are no mere member of the clan. Instead, you're a paragon of the Uzumaki, their equivalent of Hashirama to the Senju, or Madara to the Uchiha.

You now possess a much more powerful body and life force, granting you effective immortality and regeneration on par with Madara’s after he absorbed the Jūbi, and your chakra capacity and quality has been increased by a factor of 12.

Your chakra has also gained certain properties alongside it—now a lot more dense, you can manifest your pure chakra as constructs and you can now channel any unique properties your chakra possesses. You start off with the skill and mastery of utilizing your chakra constructs as chains but are by no means limited to it.

Alongside the potency of your chakra, the Uzumaki were known to possess unique qualities within their chakra, such as Karin’s healing, Kushina’s ability to absorb and bind, and more. You can freely modify your chakra properties such as absorbing others chakra or being poisonous at will. You can learn over time to hold multiple chakra properties at once but are only capable of imbuing it with one property to start with.

And now, finally, the Uzumaki’s greatest skill, the one ability which caused other nations fear them so that they banded together to destroy them—Fuinjutsu. Seals are a unique conundrum in the Shinobi World, do they merely store things or can they do everything just in written form? For you, it is very much the latter; you are now capable of, with time, research, and practice, doing anything with seals. You have the innate ability to understand the nature and language of seals, able to decipher, read, and write in it as easily as breathing. You start off knowing how to replicate any effect you can produce, whether through your body, powers, chakra or anything else but you can do so much more. You can do anything you put a modicum of effort to.
objects.title: Uzumaki (Naruto)

addons.text:
By combining the powers and teachings of the Hercules Method with Chakra and the Eight Gates, you have an ability similar to the forbidden Body Revival Jutsu.

This jutsu allows its user to perfectly control their own biology to use all eight of the Chakra Gates freely without backlash. Be warned, should this technique be interrupted and your concentration broken, you will suffer the full backlash instantly. You can safely turn off this technique with a few seconds of focus even while using the Eighth Gate. This process normally requires a ridiculous amount of chakra, but you can offload the work onto The Hercules Method on your skill with using it.

Over time, your body will permanently adapt to having each of the Eight Gates open at all times without backlash as your baseline. This process will be quickest for the first two Gates. But each further gate will increase the amount of effort and time it takes to accumulate greatly. You will be able to finish this process within a hundred years or a minimum of ten years with extreme effort.
addons.title: Method of Body Revival

objects.text:
Normally, the human body only uses 20% of its chakra to prevent the body from harming itself through overexertion. However, you are different.

You have learned the Eight Gates technique, allowing you to remove your body's natural limiters (or gates) for greater power. The gates are as follows:

The Gate of Opening
-Located in the brain's left hemisphere. It removes your mental inhibitions. Opening this gate allows you to perform the Front Lotus, but the technique might be too tiring.
The Gate of Healing
-Located in the brain's right hemisphere. It increases your physical strength and also re-energizes your body, enabling you to rapidly recover from exhaustion.
The Gate of Life
-Located on the spinal cord. It turns your skin red when opened, releasing enough chakra to create a buffer zone to allow safe passage through severe adverse weather. Other effects may include your pupils disappearing, your hair standing on end, and bulging veins all over your body. Opening this gate allows you to perform the Reverse Lotus.
The Gate of Pain
-Also located on the spinal cord. It increases your strength more than the Gate of Life, so much so that your muscles may start to tear.
The Gate of Limit
-Located in the abdomen. It increases strength further than the Gate of Pain, but you might begin to fracture your bones.
The Gate of View
-Located in the stomach, it boosts all your abilities. The power that emanates from you is enough to displace surrounding bodies of water. Opening this gate allows you to perform the Morning Peacock, wherein your punches are so fast that friction with the air produces flames. You are cloaked in a fierce green aura from the opening of this gate and can choose to toggle it.
The Gate of Wonder
-Located below the stomach. It causes you to secrete a blue sweat that immediately evaporates, creating an aura around you that can be mistaken for chakra. Opening this gate allows you to perform the Daytime Tiger, a single punch that creates a pocket of compressed air. Your strength increases to such an extent that your muscle fibers start to rupture, causing immense pain if anyone so much as touches you.
The Gate of Death
-By puncturing your heart with your thumb, you unlock the Gate of Death—The Eighth Gate. Your strength is increased 100-fold, however, the amount of chakra flowing through your body evaporates your blood (causing a red aura-like mist to surround you), and will slowly cook your body, there is a near 100% chance you will die from this.

As a freebie, you gain mastery of the Strong Fist taijutsu style like that of Might Guy or Rock Lee.
objects.title: Eight Gates Technique (Naruto)

addons.text:
Your internal pool of natural energy allows you to do what was previously thought impossible and become the perfect Sage. Due to your natural energy being sourced from yourself like your physical and spiritual energies, all your Chakra will naturally transform into Senjutsu Chakra, allowing you to enter Sage Mode indefinitely. You will naturally be in Sage Mode by default, but draining your natural energy too quickly can result in you being knocked out of it. You also receive additional benefits due to converting your Natural Techniques into Sage Techniques.

If you have Nature Magic, then your druidic shapeshifting gives you access to the sage transformation of Jugo’s clan. This enhances your physical capabilities while allowing you to transform your appendages into various weapons and other such transformations like those displayed by users of Orochimaru’s cursed seals.

If you have Street Druid, then your ability to commune with nature allows you to learn all its techniques. This enhances your spiritual capabilities, allowing you to create new techniques based on any of nature’s animals. This allows you to create new paths on the road to Sagehood that may one day rival the ways of the Snakes, Slugs, and Toads.

If you have Keeper of the Grove, you will become the greatest Senjutsu Master the world has ever known.
addons.title: One with Nature

addons.text:
Your skill and talent with Senjutsu from the world of DxD has given you the ability to overcome Sage Mode's weaknesses.

Notably, you don't need to stay still and meditate, allowing you to draw in natural energy with less effort. You can purify the land around you, improving the natural energy quality you draw upon yourself by an immense degree.

Examples include having the strength to lift and throw Tailed Beasts with little effort and strong enough to smash holes in mountains from the sheer force of your strikes.

Any techniques you use, whether through Chakra or DxD Senjutsu, also gain a significant increase in power.
addons.title: One with the World

addons.text:
No longer must you carefully gather the power of Nature energy from the environment around, as you have something far better. Cosmo is the energy of the universe, which connects all things, including nature. As such, you can draw upon your own Cosmo in the Place of Nature Chakra to gain levels of power that would make Ōtsutsuki run away, fearing for their life. 

You can stay in Sage Mode for as long as you wish without backlash of any kind, except for becoming tired should you run low on Chakra and Cosmo. This fusion also grants you the ability to Burn your Cosmo without the need for a Clothe Armor, as it will slowly enhance your body with no limits as you slowly grow towards Godhood. Also, you will find that your Ninjutsu will not only become easier to use but will also have its power be enhanced to unimaginable levels. Should you have a Sage Mode connected to a Summoning Contract, whatever special traits your Sage Mode grants will also grow massively and will improve further along with your Cosmo.

Even with only your Sixth Sense unlocked, you will be able to command power equal to a master sage. With each additional Sense you unlock and master, your power will improve by unimaginable magnitudes. Through the Seventh Sense, you will be able to match the power of Six Paths Senjutsu and even surpass its power with mastery. Should you possess the Eighth Sense, you will gain power beyond the imagination of the Ōtsutsuki clan, and should you gain Senses beyond the Eighth, even the Gods of Saint Seiya will give pause over your power.
addons.title: Sage of the Cosmos
Transcendant Senjutsu
addons.text:
Your Ki-enhanced Chakra changes your relationship with Senjustsu, evolving it into something nearly unrecognizable compared to the original. 

Thanks to the unimaginable density of your Ki-enhanced Chakra, Senjustsu works much differently, similar to Super Saiyan. You can create additional levels of Sage Mode based on the size of your energy reserves and your mastery of Nature Energy. With this combination, you can rival the insane power boosts Saiyans gain through Super Saiyan, albeit if you can draw in enough Nature Energy.
