This combination also allows you to safely pull in a much larger amount of Nature Energy both quicker and easier, as your Ki-enhanced Chakra will act as a powerful buffer which drastically lowers the chance of turning into stone should you fail to mix Nature Energy with your own.

Be aware that it may prove difficult to gather enough Nature Energy based on where you reside and your ability to draw in Nature Energy, such that you may need to draw energy from the entire universe to use a high level of Sage Mode, which takes a long amount of time.

objects.text:
You have acquired the ability to use Senjutsu, a specialized field of jutsu that involves harnessing the natural energy that exists in the world and merging it with your own chakra. While most people who attempt this risk turning to stone or transforming into an animal, you have complete control over your Nature Chakra, preventing these drawbacks.

Once you gather enough natural energy and merge it with your chakra, you enter Sage Mode. In this form, your physical strength, speed, stamina, reflexes, perception, and durability are greatly enhanced. For example, in Sage Mode, you could lift a house-sized rhino and hurl it over your head nearly a hundred feet into the air. Weapons made of iron or steel that would normally pierce your body like butter would shatter against your skin. Enemies who could once track your movements will now struggle as you effortlessly outmaneuver them.

Sage Mode also enhances your ninjutsu and genjutsu, while allowing you to amplify your taijutsu with nature energy, enabling unique and powerful attacks. Additionally, if you couldn't previously sense the life force of enemies, you now can, allowing you to detect attacks without needing to see them.

If you face an enemy capable of draining chakra, they are likely to die by turning to stone, as your control over Nature Chakra does not extend to them.

While most practitioners of Senjutsu need to remain still and meditate for minutes or even hours to gather chakra, you can simply clasp your hands together and gather enough natural energy to power your Sage Mode for an hour in just seconds.
objects.title: Sage Mode (Naruto)

objects.text:
On top of being a Sage, you're also the contract holder of either the Toads, Snakes or Slugs. Or if you're truly trying to become a master of the Sage Arts, you could become the contract holder of all of them.

Toads: You have signed the summoning contract with the toads, allowing you to summon them in battle. Through this, you can summon Shima and Fukasaku, who can sit on your shoulders and continuously gather natural energy for you, enabling uninterrupted Sage Mode. You can also perform combination attacks with them, such as spitting oil while they ignite it with fire to burn enemies, or launching high-pressure jets of water to slice foes in half. Additionally, you gain access to many Toad Sage techniques, including Frog Kata, a unique form of taijutsu. Frog Kata uses senjutsu chakra to create an aura around your body that extends the range and force of your attacks, even a punch that seems to miss will strike your foe with full power.

Snakes: You have the summoning contract with the snakes, granting you the ability to call them into battle. You gain access to various Snake techniques known by the snakes and their previous summoners. This includes the Snake Reconnection Technique, allowing you to heal from being bisected by reconnecting your body with snakes. You can also expend large amounts of chakra to "shed" your skin, healing all damage done to you. Additionally, you can use senjutsu to animate the environment, causing massive changes to unbalance or harm your enemies. You also gain the sword Kusanagi, capable of being hidden in your mouth and extending and retract from great distances.

Slugs: You have the summoning contract with the slugs, enabling you to summon them in battle. This grants you a high level of skill and affinity for Iryō Ninjutsu (healing techniques) and great proficiency in chakra control. Your slugs can act as vectors for your healing abilities, splitting into smaller versions of themselves to attach to and heal multiple people from a distance. You also gain access to most of the healing and unique chakra control techniques of your predecessors, such as Creation Rebirth, which forces rapid cell division to heal your body, bordering on immortality while the technique is active. However, it shortens your lifespan, as it doesn’t repair old cells, just hastens the creation of new ones. You also acquire combat-oriented jutsu like spewing poison mist, shaping chakra into a blade around your hand, overloading someone’s nervous system with a touch, and the Strength of a Hundred Seal.

If desired, you can physically manifest your Summoner Scroll(s) and wear them on your back, though the contract itself is metaphysical. Losing or destroying the scroll won't affect your summoning abilities. You also have the option to let others sign the contract, allowing them to summon the same animals as you. However, this does not grant them chakra or any of the bonuses you have acquired.

All summons are completely loyal to you.
objects.title: Successor to the Sannin (Naruto)

objects.text:
Innovator of the paper trails, you are a Paper Person. In fact, your very body can split apart into thousands of pieces of paper. This makes you effectively invincible, as any attack that'd deal damage only damages, at most, a very small part of you as long as you have chakra.

The technique is the lifework of Konan, who changed her very chakra into paper to create this technique.

Your body and clothing all become paper that you can control, change the color of, and shape. Nothing can stop your manipulation of paper and it surpasses other manipulators as this paper is made simply of your chakra.

You can sense through this paper and even scout out locations. You can even create clones of this paper, mixed with explosive tags or other sealwork.

Your paper is able to take intense amounts of heat, enough to melt steel, and withstand it effortlessly. You can even clash with steel with this paper. The sharpness of the paper is enough to tear into even metallic armors with little resistance.

Your paper can emulate surroundings perfectly, disguising itself as natural scenery. You are truly a Paper Person. 

Unlike Konan, your reproductive anatomy will not be rendered impotent by this technique, and you will generally be able to behave as if you had normal anatomy if you would ever find that more convenient.
objects.title: Dance of the Shikigami (Naruto)

addons.text:
Due to the consumption of the Chakra Fruit, you have now evolved and achieved a whole new level of power never seen before. Your chakra reserves are enhanced to a monstrous level, matching and surpassing an entire planet’s worth of chakra, blowing even Madara's chakra reserves when he became the Jūbi’s jinchūriki out of the water, meaning that you can wipe out countries and continents easily, and if pushed, can destroy a planet with your chakra techniques. You now have access to every Kekkei Genkai and Mora in the show or manga, and can create your own.

Your physical stats has risen to insane heights, such that your punches with no chakra enchantment could easily wipe out countries and subcontinents, while you can withstand planet destroying attacks and your movement speed/reaction speed is comparable to light.

You can choose to keep your normal appearance, maybe with horns or pure white skin if you want, or gain a similar demonic-like form gained by both Momoshiki and Urashiki.
addons.title: Chakra Ancestor

addons.text:
With the addition of the Rinnegan, you’ve unlocked and mastered three incredibly powerful Onmyōton techniques, one of which the very Sage of Six Paths used to create the bijū.

The first technique is Banbutsu Sōzō, Creation of All Things. Through this, you have the ability to turn fantasy into reality by utilizing Yin to shape and form your imagination into being and then utilizing your Yang chakra to bring it from fantasy into reality.

The second technique is Banbutsu Shōkyo, Eradication of All Things. Through this, you have the ability to turn reality to fantasy. By utilizing Yang to take control of an existing thing and then converting it into Yin, you can erase anything from existence that your chakra can get ahold of.

The third and final technique is Banbutsu Henkō, Modification of All Things. By applying both above techniques, you have the ability to modify any existing thing your chakra can get ahold of. By utilizing Yang to take control of an existing thing and then converting it into Yin to reshape and reform from your imagination then back into Yang to bring it back into physical form.
addons.title: Banbutsu

objects.text:
Your Sage Mode has been improved through fusing with Ōtsutsuki DNA, granting you access to Six Paths Senjutsu, Truth-Seeking Balls, Six Paths Chakra, all major Kekkei Genkai and Kekkei Mora of the Ōtsutsuki, and a mental encyclopedia of all ninshu (as well as its descendants—ninjutsu, taijutsu, and genjutsu) and shinjutsu, although you still have to learn how to use them.

You have also been granted a truly immense reserve of chakra, surpassing even EOS Naruto though not by that much; you gain enough strength to uproot an entire God Tree with a single physical attack, enough speed to appear as if you teleported a kilometer and a half away, the reaction speed to dodge light beams, and enough resilience/regeneration to survive being cut in half and regenerate from it.
objects.title: Six Paths Senjutsu (Naruto)

addons.text: You now no longer need invasive surgery to achieve your results, your Sage Mode (which now lasts as long as you wish thanks to Jugo's Kekkei Genkai) can absorb DNA and copy powers from it, perform the main power's effects using chakra instead of surgery, and perform biological self alteration at will.
addons.title: White Snake Sage

objects.text: You now have a supreme mastery of medical ninjutsu, allowing you to surgically alter yourself and others with biological and supernatural traits. You can create, implant, or alter things like Kekkei Genkai, jinchūrikis, curse marks, and even the chakra network itself with ease, curiously lacking the side effects such alterations usually have. Due to your encyclopedic knowledge of the subject, you can create any of these listed effects even with no reference material. You can surgically alter yourself and others in relatively mundane ways (increasing physical ability or chakra flow, changing physical appearance, restoring lost limbs, etc.) or in very esoteric ways (true resurrection of the dead, giving yourself superpowers from DNA samples, combining separate powers into a single stronger one, etc.)
objects.title: Paging Dr. Kabuto (Naruto)

objects.text:
You have ascended to the rank of Kage-level shinobi, joining the elite ranks of Hidden Village leaders. Equipped with your newfound strength and skill befitting of your station, this power has significantly elevated both your physical and mental capabilities, refining your chakra control to new heights, capable of knitting vast amounts of chakra, and in turn, granting you prodigious reserves—comparable even to those of a lesser, false/pseudo-jinchūriki.

As a shinobi of your caliber, you may choose a specialization, focusing your abilities as a master of either ninjutsu, genjutsu, or taijutsu. Alternatively, you could become a versatile force, a true jack-of-all trades, much like the Third Hokage, Hiruzen Sarutobi. Regardless of your chosen path, your extensive arsenal of techniques now rivals even that of the most renowned Kage in history.

With dedication and effort, your potential and talent could one day reach the heights of legends like Minato Namikaze.

Additionally, as a bonus, you'll gain all the knowledge and expertise needed to effectively govern a hidden village by yourself, mastering the intricacies of leadership and strategy required to stand as its unwavering pillar.
objects.title: Kage (Naruto)

addons.text: It’s no longer the title of Hokage that you’ve inherited; instead, your power has grown to include the scope of all Kage that has existed so far. You now possess everything from Ōnoki’s Dust Release to Ay’s incredible speed and strength. Your Hidden Village, if you chose to take it, will now at least rival the combined might of the Shinobi Alliance. You may also now choose any character shown in the series to be reincarnated as members of your village, with their history up to your discretion.
addons.title: Kage

objects.text: “When the tree leaves dance, One shall find flames. The fire’s shadow will illuminate the village, And once again, tree leaves shall bud anew.” The mantle of Hokage has always been one of the greatest honors that could be granted, and perhaps the greatest burden to bear. But with this, you should be able to shoulder the responsibility. You have inherited the combined physical ability, chakra, skill, wisdom, talent, jutsu, and knowledge of all your previous predecessors. From Hashirama to Naruto, all they had to offer at the very pinnacle of their power are now yours. You will also receive any of the Kekkei Genkai any of them wielded. In the case of Naruto, you will not receive Kurama. Instead, the chakra you inherit from Naruto will be of such quality and potency that it will be like you did, including the chakra of the other bijū as well, and you will be able to take a chakra form similar to that of his jinchūriki forms. If you possess an internal domain/world of your own, you may optionally choose to have a custom Hidden Village at least on par with that of the Hidden Leaf at the height of its power. All members of your village will be absolutely loyal. If you are reincarnated into the world of Naruto, you may optionally choose to have your reincarnation hold the title of Kage of whatever village you choose, and if you are reincarnated elsewhere, you may instead opt for your Hidden Village to be retroactively added to the setting instead of your inner domain/world, this also applies for reincarnations with no inner domain/world.
objects.title: Hokage (Naruto)

addons.text: Your Inner Beast takes on the role and power of your chakra monster, and can now freely manifest physically in the real world. Your synergy and control over its power is now perfect and the beast shares all your abilities as you do theirs.
addons.title: Perfect Jinchūriki

addons.text: Your beast is no mere bijū—it is an incarnation of the very Shinju itself. Your beast’s power has been dramatically increased by an order of magnitude from before. Your beast now possesses 10 unique abilities that it can share with you and much greater might and chakra capacity, at least on par with the original Jūbi if it has at least tenfold your own power, and tenfold your own if yours surpass it. It doesn’t have to take the form of the original Jūbi, it can still be its original form such as the fox Kurama or whatever form you chose for it. The factor your power now grows when combined is enhanced by a factor of 10.
addons.title: Jūbi Jinchūriki

addons.text:
Your beast, due to coming into contact with your Cursed Energy, has gained another ability besides the one you end up picking for it, granting it the same abilities as the Zero Tails or Reibi, which includes feeding on a living being's darker thoughts, allowing you to endlessly harness Dark Chakra as long there's enough enmity around you, along with reading the inner hearts of other beings while doing so.

It also makes you capable of performing jutsus without hand seals and manifest shadowy construct like hands for personal use, or for your beast to reattach its body parts or bits during a fight when it is manifested.
addons.title: Zero Tails

objects.text:
You’ve been blessed with one of the greatest powers capable of being granted to shinobi, but also one of the Shinobi World’s greatest curses. There had been a great being of power sealed within you—a beast made of incredibly powerful chakra has now found its home deep within your soul.

Yours is a bit of a unique case as the beast is no longer sealed within you; instead, it has taken a liking to you and stays with you out of its own free will. It has bestowed upon you all its awesome power, granting you everything—from its jinchūriki forms, Tailed Beast Ball, its full transformation, and all its unique abilities. The beast can also freely leave to fight alongside you without any detriment to you, and you can easily command its power as you would your own, freely mixing it with any other ability you possess.

The beast can be of any form you wish, whether a canon bijū or a unique one. Regardless of which beast you chose, they are perfectly loyal to you and can not be taken from you without your consent.

The beast's power will be on par with Kurama's if his overall power would be ninefold your own, and if you are more powerful, the beast’s power will increase until it’s at least ninefold more powerful than you. Your strength can grow to match your beast’s, and if you rise past that point, your beast’s power will rise alongside your own. Regardless of its strength in comparison to yours, combining your two powers will multiply your combined power by a factor of 9. If you chose a unique beast, you may design a unique technique or ability it has such as Shukaku’s sand or Son Gokū's lava.
objects.title: Jinchūriki (Naruto)

objects.text: You're not merely the amalgamation of every Hokage—no, you’re also the latest and most powerful incarnation of the Uchiha progenitor, Indra Ōtsutsuki himself. You’ve gained all the combined physical ability, chakra, skill, wisdom, talent, jutsu, and knowledge of every single incarnation of Indra that has existed. Indra was known for excelling at everything he tried, a genius of caliber almost unseen. You now possess this talent and can, with almost contemptuous ease, learn and develop anything you wish. As the creator of Ninjutsu himself, you’ve gained enormous talent and genius with jutsu in particular. Creating a new jutsu is now as simple for you as it is for a normal man to construct a sentence. Your chakra quality and potency is doubled and your chakra control is perfect. All of your dōjutsu are further amplified by an order of magnitude.
objects.title: Indra (Naruto)

objects.text: It seems there is a bit of irony here, as just like some of your predecessors were, you are an incarnation of the Sage’s second son—Asura Ōtsutsuki. But it seems even for an incarnation of Asura, you are special. You have not simply inherited his talent, chakra and will like the others—no, you have inherited everything from both Asura and every incarnation after him. Asura inherited his father’s incredibly powerful body and chakra. While his brother was a solitary man, Asura was known to gain followers and comrades by the droves. Likewise, his brother’s bloodline spawned only the ever powerful Uchiha clan, Asura's spread and created several. From his most powerful bloodlines the Uzumaki and Senju, to lesser known clans such as the Kaguya, or even Jūgo’s now near extinct clan, every chakra nature and body-based bloodline can eventually trace their lineage back to Asura. Aside from greatly amplifying your previous abilities, you now possess the ability to instinctively wield and mix all chakra natures and can freely modify your body as you wish. Weaponize your blood and bones, utilize lava and wood to alter the battlefield, or freely manipulate your chakra’s shape and inherent properties at will. You’ve also gained the ability to enter a powerful chakra form and can manifest a chakra avatar on par with Indra’s Susanoo. You can freely customize this chakra form and chakra avatar.
objects.title: Asura (Naruto)

addons.text: It seems the combined blood of Hagaromo and Hamura has given you the very chakra and abilities of Kaguya herself. Something else has happened alongside this—you’ve no longer inherited that of those that bare the name Ōtsutsuki and their incarnations, you seemed to have inherited the combined physical ability, chakra, skill, wisdom, talent, jutsu, and knowledge of every single descendant of Kaguya. You’ve also gained the ability to implant Kama’s into others to help avoid death, although yours are special as there will never be any incompatibility with any hosts you possess, and you can freely choose whether your hosts will obtain a White Kama or a true one. Your hosts cannot use the power gifted by the Kama against you, nor can they access unless you wish for them to be able to. When you reincarnate, your other hosts will not lose their respective Kamas.
addons.title: Ōtsutsuki

objects.text: The very man that started it all, it seems that Asura’s and Indra’s bloodline have converged once more and that has given rise to you. You are no longer simply Indra or Asura—you are both, and you are greater. Alongside what you’ve gained before, you've also now grown to the very Sage of Six Paths himself. Alongside a monstrous boost in chakra capacity, quality, and control, you’ve gained an ability that almost none knew of, one that gave the Sage his incredible wisdom. You’ve gained Banbutsu Rikai, Understanding of All Things. You’ve now attained instinctive and absolute comprehension of all things, from the physical laws of the universe, the complexities of human behavior, to even the mysteries of consciousness. You discern patterns, identify underlying causes, and see outcomes from the macro to micro scale. Every phenomenon, every aspect, every entity, you’ve gleamed into the very nature of existence itself. This grants you the ability to freely manipulate chakra as you wish, and are now capable of producing any effect you desire provided you have enough chakra to do so.
objects.title: Hagoromo (Naruto)

objects.text:
You’ve grown and grown, traveled thousands of worlds, cultivated and consumed countless Chakra Fruits until you’ve finally achieved what every Ōtsutsuki chases—Godhood. Your chakra is now on a scale none could dare have imagined, they are now divine miracles itself. You possess various remarkable abilities such as clairvoyance and automatic reflection of all harm to yourself. You no longer need a physical form and may freely discard your body and ascend to higher realms if you wish, as you exist as a chakra being for all intents and purposes and hold a body only when you desire. Alongside this, all your dōjutsu have merged into a single one, the Jōgan. This power, while supremely powerful, only grants three abilities. You may still freely access your lower level dōjustu, and all of their abilities carry over to the Jōgan.

Zengo—with this ability, the Jōgan grants absolute perception and complete comprehension of all things. From the barriers between dimensions, to the interactions of particles so small and so fast they could be said to have not happened at all, to even peering into the Pure Lands themselves.

Zenjiyuu—with this ability, the Jōgan grants its wielder true and absolute freedom. It removes all limitations and constraints. Your chakra no longer has to be mixed, controlled, altered or anything. It is not constrained by amount, potency, or type; it simply does what you wish for it to do. You are unbounded by any limits, whether they be physical or mental. You are free to move, think, and act as you please without fear of any kind of restriction or confinement. You can float effortlessly above the ground or race along at superhuman speed. Your mind is limitless, with capacity for analytical reasoning, imagination and creativity beyond human understanding. You can penetrate any mind or shield, gaining knowledge and insight that might otherwise be impossible for mere mortals. Your very form is free to change whenever you wish, capable of swapping its natures and properties whenever you wish. Even universal laws of physics, time and space hold no power over you, for you are truly free if you wish to escape those constraints.

Zennō—and with this final ability, the Jōgan grants you the ability to rewrite reality itself. You’ve now gained the ability to alter everything around you as you wish, capable of writing whole worlds into existence if you choose. With this power, fantasy is as real and permanent as reality, and reality is as imaginary and ephemeral as fantasy.
objects.title: Shibai Ōtsutsuki (Naruto)

objects.text:
You gain the ability to implant a variant of the Kama, the White Kama. This Kama is unable to serve as a receptacle for the soul, and thus cannot be used for the process of reincarnation. It also lacks the absorption and space-time capabilities of the original. In exchange for this tradeoff, anyone with a strong enough mind and body is guaranteed to survive the implantation process. Those who survive the implantation process can learn how to access a portion of the Ōtsutsuki’s power and abilities. Note that once the Kama is implanted, it begins to gradually overwrite the genetic profile of its host, eventually transforming them into a completely new Ōtsutsuki.

Those you implant manifest internal genetic locks; 18 interconnected seals that restrict the genetic transformation into an Ōtsutsuki. You are able to release these seals, allowing for the transformation to continue. When they reach 5% Ōtsutsuki, you can release the first, the second at 10%, the third at 15%, and so on until 18th lock at 90%. Once the final lock has been released, the transformation into an Ōtsutsuki can no longer be halted.

You are able to sense the transformation progress of those you have implanted.
objects.title: White Kama

objects.text: You have bathed in the River Styx, gaining this curse. Your body is invulnerable, unable to be harmed by anything but the mightiest of gods, all but for one spot on your body. This one spot is your greatest weakness, and should you be harmed there, you will die, even if you suffer a simple scratch. Along with your invulnerability, your strength, speed, agility, reflexes, endurance, and fighting skills have all been enhanced.
objects.title: Curse of Achilles (Percy Jackson)

objects.text:
Now, instead of simply being born a demigod, your heritage is a lot less... conventional, even accounting for the strangeness that is the life of your average demigod. Perhaps, like Heimdallr, you are born from multiple mothers; maybe your divine parents were incarnated as mortals; was your divinity stolen at birth; did another god claim you as their own; are you the child of multiple pantheons whose divine blood fails to recognize one another; or something else entirely?

Regardless of the exact details of your origin, you are now the recognized child of another god of your choice, while still possessing some level of mortality—somehow.

This grants you both all the benefits of your new parentage and the drawbacks. You gain access to your parent’s domains, will be able to speak the language, and utilize the magic associated with their pantheon. However, you also become the target of various monsters and enemies your divine parent may have. Demigods could charitably be called “chaos magnets,” and with you, that’s now dialed up to eleven... Good luck.
objects.title: Demigod² (Percy Jackson)

objects.text:
Instead of being a child of a god and a mortal, you are born from the union of a mortal and a titan. You are free to choose which titan you are descended from, whether someone as powerful as Kronos or as relatively powerless as Calypso.

As the child of a titan, the power of your divine parent flows through you, granting you immense speed, durability, and strength. You can outmatch speeding vehicles, survive impacts from them, and throw them without strain. You also have the ability to tap into your parent’s domain with enough power to more than match a child of the Big Three.
objects.title: Titanborn (Percy Jackson)

objects.text: Now, instead of the spawn of a mere god or titan, you exist as the child of something far more potent. Somehow, for reasons beyond understanding, you are the offspring of a mortal and a Protogenos—a primordial. The Protogenoi were the first immortals to emerge from the void of chaos, essentially sentient aspects of the world and universe itself, with total control over whatever they embody. They can manifest fully in the world, and with enough effort, be banished from it, but they can never truly be destroyed or killed. Even weapons as terrible as Kronos’ Scythe are only capable of dispersing their physical forms. You are free to select any of the Protogenoi other than Chaos as your parent, with the circumstances leading to your birth left entirely to your imagination. As the child of a primordial, you gain access to their domains, with your powers an order of magnitude greater than those of even the children of the Big Three, capable of matching lesser gods and challenging the Olympians. Additionally, you inherit a fraction of your parent’s ability to survive—if your physical body is destroyed, you can eventually reform from your parent’s domain.
objects.title: Protogenos Progeny (Percy Jackson)

objects.text:
You’re now something that even the Protogenoi take notice of—a child of the same abyssal void from which the first generation of Protogenoi, such as Gaea, the Earth itself, were born.

The Children of Chaos are a rare but immensely powerful lot. The personifications of Earth, Hell, Desire, Darkness, and Night are your siblings. You can freely choose an aspect of reality to embody—standing unmatched in whatever facet of existence you select. If you wish, you can also claim an aspect already controlled by one of your fellow Protogenoi, maybe they have retired—or perhaps even died—freeing their aspect for your use.

You are an existence far beyond the gods, just as they are beyond mortals. Even the famous Olympians tread carefully around you, unwilling to risk incurring your ire.
objects.title: Scion of the Void (Percy Jackson)

addons.text:
Your birth was prophesied by fate, your destiny providing potential and power so that you may carry out your role. Yet you were not satisfied, you refused to be the servant of anything, and so you have thrown off the chains that bound you and shattered the loom of fate, striding forth towards the future under your own power.

As one who has cast off the chains that bound them, you are fundamentally unable to be permanently restrained or sealed, your defiance of fate always providing an opportunity to escape, although there is no guarantee it will be easy. Similarly, your refusal to bow to the threads of fate unravels any form of prophecy you encounter, their carefully structured order of events collapsing in the face of your utter defiance.

Lastly, there is no limit on how strong your Demigod powers can grow, for you are not strong because of your destiny; you are strong because of your efforts alone, and no force can ever hope to stymie your strength. It may take decades, perhaps even centuries, but in time, you can grow your divine might such that even Primordial Gods cower before you.
addons.title: The Unbound

objects.text:
You are a child who has been prophesied by fate.

You are to demigods what demigods are to humans. You could, with great effort, be able to damage the gods and those who are immortal. The connection you have gained to your divine parent has been enhanced, similar to other prophesied children, such as Percy Jackson or Piper, to name the most notable examples.

Simply put, you have greater access to the domains of your godly parent, being able to access more than a normal demigod. For example, if you happen to be the child of Poseidon, you would be able to cause earthquakes and thunderstorms and, with great strain, even manipulate elements farther away from water, such as blood and poison that comes from divine sources. Or if perhaps your godly parent had been Hades, you would be able to call upon more skeletons, dredge up valuable materials from under the earth, place curses upon your foes, open a gateway to the underworld, and, at the highest level, kill someone with a touch.

Lastly, you have gained the potential to overthrow the Gods, and with time, your divine blood strengthens and becomes more potent, furthering your legend and bringing you closer to the divine.
objects.title: Child of Fate/Prophecy (Percy Jackson)

addons.text:
Your ability to grant the blessing of Artemis and your own divine heritage has been mixed. Your blessing now has the ability to grant others a fragment of your own demigod abilities. This will primarily focus on your more passive godly abilities, but your hunters can learn to harness your more active ones with time and effort. All of these abilities will be severely weakened compared to your own.

As your demigod abilities grow in strength, so does your hunter's ability to tap into them.
addons.title: Parents Blessing

objects.text:
You have gained a unique ability to enhance others with the blessing of Artemis. This blessing grants a multitude of things, but at its core, it grants agelessness, an affinity towards bows and hunting, an enhanced physiology moderately above peak human, and the ability to speak with wolves and communicate with animals. You may optionally choose for this blessing to come with an oath of some kind, which will cause them to lose the blessing if they break it.

Anyone who gains this blessing will be granted all the equipment that you yourself were granted as a Hunter of Artemis.
objects.title: The Hunter's Blessing (Percy Jackson)

addons.text: The powerful divinity flowing in your veins is enough to greatly increase the strength of your inheritance from your Divine Ancestor. Now your inheritance is closer to that of your average demigod in strength, or, in the case of a blessing, being something particularly powerful like the ability to shapeshift into any animal. This greatly increases the average benefits of being a demigod as well, being solidly superhuman in all aspects, even if your scent becomes much stronger due to the sheer divinity in your veins. If you have Blood of the Gods, then you can also use your Divine Ancestor as a point to branch out and tap into their family’s domains as well.
addons.title: Awakened Heritage

addons.text: There’s nothing average about the inheritance you have received, the sheer potency of the divinity flowing in your veins unlocking the full potential of your heritage. The manifestation of your heritage is now on par with your main Demigod abilities as well, as if you had multiple divine parents. Your physical characteristics are monstrous, capable of matching minor gods from the get-go.
addons.title: Ascendant Heritage

addons.text: The deity (or deities) you are a Legacy of can now be of the ancient Titans and beyond, potentially even of the ancient Primordial gods themselves. Your Heritage can potentially be of deities like Nyx or Gaea, or even a dead god like Ouranos.
addons.title: Primordial Blood

addons.text:
You have now inherited more than just the skills and knowledge of Rome; you have also inherited the accumulated divinity of all its people. This is enough to grant you a form of very weak godhood in a manner similar to the God-Emperors of the Triumvirate. This grants you immense physical strength, speed, and durability, enough to wrestle with gods and sometimes come out on top. 

More importantly, it grants you true immortality, regenerating whenever you would somehow be killed, and in your instance, as long as any memory and legend of Rome (or its nearest equivalent in the setting) remains, you will come back. You can even extend this regeneration to a select handful of minions, who will be considered extensions of yourself for the purposes of immortality.

Lastly, as you already have a great deal of divine energy, it would take only a mere nudge to ascend to the rank of true god. All that would be required is a new name, with a domain coming with the associated name, and the death or removal of an existing god to make room for your ascendancy.
addons.title: Lineage of Emperors

objects.text:
Your lineage is long and storied, carrying traces of other gods. In addition to your divine parentage, you are now descended from another God as well, albeit more distantly. While this may not provide the full portfolio of even a weak demigod of that deity, it's still enough to gain a decently powerful blessing or a minor affinity for a single aspect and increase the strength of the typical benefits to being a demigod.

You can choose how recently this other god became part of your lineage, which increases the strength of the benefits, possibly even enough to have an affinity for two aspects if they were your grandparent. However, the more closely related you are to this deity, the stronger your scent is, as the potency of the divinity in your veins increases.

If your Divine Ancestor’s domains line up with your Parents', then they can compound and synergize to unlock greater access to the relevant domains. This is even more pronounced if said Divine Ancestor is also your parent.

Each purchase of this adds another God to your lineage. You must leave at least one path of your ancestry as mortal, so no cheating and having four divine grandparents. The god you are a Legacy of doesn’t need to be from the same pantheon as your divine parent, so you can be a Son of Zeus while also being a Legacy of Thor.
objects.title: Legacy (Percy Jackson)

addons.text:
The Athena Parthenos is a majestic statue of the Olympian Goddess Athena, once standing proudly within the Parthenon of Athens. When Greece—and by extension, Athens—fell, the Romans seized the statue, seeking to undermine one of Greece’s most revered deities and diminish the threat of Grecian rebellion.

This act of theft ignited a millennia-long rift between the Grecian and Roman aspects of the Olympian gods, fueling numerous conflicts and wars throughout history.

But now? The statue has been returned to the last remaining stronghold of the Greek Demigods: Camp Half-Blood. Proudly displayed at the heart of the camp, it serves not only as a symbol of Greek heritage but also as a powerful guardian. The Athena Parthenos enhances the camp’s defenses, making it nearly impossible for intruders to breach its walls. Those who wish to challenge the protection of the Aegis must first confront the formidable power of the statue—and if they possess the Gorgoneion’s might, the statue can unleash deadly beams from its shield, petrifying would-be invaders in an instant.

Yet, the true significance of the statue’s return lies not solely in its overt displays of power, but in the more subtle effect it has on the spirit of the Greek camp, with its return mending the ancient rift among the Olympians. This reconciliation has allowed Camp Half-Blood to gain one of the greater benefits of its sister camp, Camp Jupiter.

Within the camp’s expanding borders, a new Grecian city is taking shape—New Athens. This metropolis will serve as a refuge for Greek demigods, legacies, nature spirits, and gods alike. A sanctuary of peace and safety, it allows its inhabitants to live and thrive without fear.
addons.title: Athena Parthenos

objects.text:
Now, instead of standing alone as a solitary demigod, you have the unwavering support and backing of your entire extended family—Camp Half-Blood—a legendary sanctuary and training ground for Greek demigods.

Nestled within a secluded pocket dimension, this Camp encompasses all the familiar facilities and inhabitants of the original sanctuary: from the Cabins—each as much a temple in its own right—to the Woods, the Big House, the Stables, the lake, and so much more. You can leave the Camp within its dimensional refuge, or to “install” it into the world at a location of your choosing, only to return it as you need.

The Camp is shielded by formidable magical barriers—almost impenetrable to enemies and intruders alike. These defenses also serve to regulate the weather and climate within, allowing you to maintain perpetual warmth and sunshine, or any desired atmospheric condition, ensuring comfort and security year-round.

Formerly, the Camp was under the leadership of Dionysus, but with his release from duty, the mantle now rests with you—should you choose to accept it. The day-to-day management is overseen by Chiron, the wise centaur, who trains the Campers and maintains order. A flock of Harpies tend to the kitchens and cleaning, while Nymphs lend their aid in various support roles, ensuring the camp functions smoothly.

The Camp’s ranks are open to any demigod who appears in the series—loyal, brave, and eager for adventure. New Campers are constantly recruited by Satyr searchers, who bring a steady influx of young heroes to replace those lost in battle, as well as to grow the camp’s numbers as Campers age out of their “prime”.
objects.title: Camp Half-Blood (Percy Jackson)

objects.text: You have an innate skill on the same level as Bell's own cheat skill. You may design your own cheat skill; this could be a replica of Bell's skill, only dependent on willpower instead of emotions, or a skill that allows you to be incredibly skilled with Miracles at Level 1—the possibilities are endless.
objects.title: Cheat Skill (DanMachi)

objects.text:
Instead of having a Falna (though you can keep yours if you'd like), you wield Arcanum, the divine powers of the Gods. You're a newly ascended deity, and your Arcanum can do things like healing fatal wounds, reviving the dead, teleporting, broadcasting an area on a magical screen for all to see, shapeshifting, creating items, or even destroying the world.

As a new god, however, you're not yet on the level of your elder counterparts. Your current strength is equivalent to a level 4 adventurer, and your abilities are more modest. You can heal grievous wounds and regenerate lost limbs, for instance. If you're somehow killed after descending to the mortal world, you'll simply reform and revive after three weeks.

You do have a way to grow your Arcanum: by forming a Familia. By granting a Falna to other beings, you claim them as your worshippers. Whenever they gain Excelia, you grow stronger in turn. You don’t have to worry about Familia members abandoning you after receiving their Falna, as they need you to regularly update it, and you can lock or strip it from them with just a thought. Additionally, all Familia members gain unlimited spell slots and the potential to gain one or more Spells, Developmental Abilities or Skills with each level-up. They also inherit any Cheat Skills you select for them. After all, what kind of God or Goddess would you be if you didn’t cheat when no other deity can punish you for it?

Over time, you will gain specific domains based on your Familia’s goals and overall skillset. For example, having a Familia full of blacksmiths would grant you the Domain of Smithing, while a Familia of spellcasters would give you Dominion over Magic. There is no limit to the number of domains you can acquire this way, but gaining new ones becomes increasingly difficult as it requires more members or higher levels within your Familia.

It would take 10 level 1 adventurers, who never level up, around 100 years of consistent adventuring for you to reach your full potential. This time decreases with stronger adventurers; for example, 10 level 2s would take about 50 years and 10 level 7s 14 years.
objects.title: Arcanum (DanMachi)

objects.text:
No longer are you a fledgling god who has barely touched on the aspects of divinity.

You are Hestia, the goddess of the Hearth and the guardian of the Sacred Flame. This gives you the abilities, skills, memories and appearance of the virginial goddess, allowing you to use your Arcanum in many more ways.

Flaring your Arcanum will automatically soothe spirits and cause all hostilities to cease as if they never had the will to fight in the first place. If you recreate your temple found in Heaven on Earth, by using a hearth inoculated with your blood, you may purify people found in the area of effect from wounds, hazardous mental effects and illnesses.

In addition to this, your abilities to complete household tasks now firmly rest in the divine. The healing of people's spirits and souls is almost automatic within your domain, and if you were to actively comfort them, then it would take the might of a deity to stop their restoration.

No matter what your actions, you will retain your status as a virgin goddess and are immune to the charms of beings on the level of the divine.
objects.title: Goddess of the Hearth (DanMachi)

objects.text:
Once you were just Hestia, Guardian of the Sacred Eternal Flame. Now, you are its incarnation, Vesta. This gives you control over the Sacred Flame that cannot be controlled, suppressed, stolen or copied without your will.

The Sacred Flame is a thing of immense power, likened to an Arcanum in itself, allowing you to light torches that banish corruption and create barriers that burn any who tries to move through it. If it's used to forge weapons, those weapons will be incredibly strong items, being “beyond” what can be created with magic in the Danmachi-verse.

In addition to this, you may bless those with your divine favor, allowing them to conjure flames on the level of a High-Ranked Adventurer's spells.

Whilst being the goddess of the hearth, you also are the goddess of festive flare, protector of justice and the expeller of evil. This gives you both an innate resistance and advantage against those with Evil alignment and corruptive effects.

You may freely swap between your original form of Hestia and your new form, Vesta. While this is not identity death or mind control, you will be more goal-oriented and serious. This can be likened to the person you are at home (Hestia), and the person you are at work (Vesta).
objects.title: Aedes Vesta (DanMachi)

objects.text:
You are an Immortal Phoenix, the ideal entity of Life and Death balanced as one. You are able to shift between your human and phoenix form in an instant. Immortality Through Rebirth allows you to return to life, at your peak condition and always stronger than before, you gain an innate resistance to the cause of death, no matter how esoteric it is. 

You are made of Fire on a conceptual level, giving you both an immunity to all forms of fire and heat as well as instinctual control over all fire you control, always burning everything you intend to without any mistakes. Your own Phoenix Fire is more than something physical, it is partially conceptual in nature, allowing you to perform feats like burning away old age, or burning away the space between two distances.

Your Phoenix Fire burns itself as a form of fuel, removing any possibility of a simple extinguishment. You are able to restore all entities to their top condition with a mere touch even if you have a bare speck of flesh, regardless of whether they are alive or dead. 

This healing touch cures them of any and all ailments, diseases, mental illnesses, curses, and anything that negatively affects their mind, body, and soul. This same level of healing is constantly being applied to you at all times, this can be turned down or even off at will. 

Just as you are able to gift life to others, you are able to rip it from them as well. You can cast any entity into the Wheel of Reincarnation upon death, with enough time and practice you will be able to extinguish souls, permanently removing them from the Wheel of Reincarnation. 

You passively grow in strength for simply living and with every kill you grow stronger, gaining increased strength for every soul you cast into the Wheel of Reincarnation.
objects.title: Phoenix

objects.text:
With a touch, you can bestow upon someone the same benefits Eternal Flame grants you, allowing the recipient to enjoy the same type of immortality you possess for as long as you do not rescind this gift. Additionally, you can share any immortality-related perks you have.

You can limit the strength of both the Eternal Flame and perks you share in any way you desire, whether simply making them weaker or restricting some functions entirely, as well as rescind any abilities you have given out at will.
objects.title: Prometheus
Eternal Stagnation
objects.text:
It seems the flame of your soul burns far too harshly, as even your own progress is healed back to where it began. Don't worry much, things such as memories or skill are unaffected, but progress such as muscle growth or the strengthening of your powers are now slowly degraded back to their baseline.

As Drawbacks trump powers, things such as Acclimation's growth period will still work, though once it finishes you'll be stuck at that strength until the end of time. Powers such as Dynamist Jr. will still function, though any growth you accomplish will fade with enough idle time, making it a constant chore to hope to upkeep your powers.

addons.title: Furnace
addons.text: It seems as though your flame, burning as fiercely as it is, has received benefits from your self-imposed limits. After all, a confined flame burns hotter, does it not? Whereas before it may have taken you a week or two to return from something like being erased from reality, now you would return in a day. Normal injuries would heal quicker than most mundane forms of damage could deal them, and damage to your powers recovers in a few hours at most. Damage to your soul recovers the quickest, as even a God of death unleashing their might upon it would be unable to outpace your recovery. Breaker of Chains was one of the few powers able to overcome Eternal Stagnation's limitations, and with that no longer an option you'll be stuck as you are for a very, very long time.

objects.text:
You may now bind effectively almost any number of objects, allowing you to amass a suitably impressive arsenal.

Even as just a baseline human, your soul can now support hundreds—if not thousands—of bound items. Not only can this capacity be increased through training your power, it can also be increased through training your body and mind. It can also grow gradually over time, though this approach is much slower.

Additionally, your bound items now also benefit from a fraction of all of your powers, not just your passive and power-boosting abilities.
objects.title: Multi-Bond

objects.text: No longer is your bound object merely attached to your soul; now, your soul flows throughout and infuses your chosen item, transforming it into a true part of yourself and granting it your full power. In addition, your bound item now has its qualities integrated into your soul while bound, spreading its benefits to yourself. If you have Multi-Bound, this expands to every other item you have. For example, binding a sword might grant your body the strength of the metal it was made from, and your teeth and nails the sharpness of its edge. This even extends to supernatural abilities as well: A sword enchanted to generate fire can now produce those same flames from a mundane (if bound) stick or even your own body, with no ill effects on either.
objects.title: Full Bond

objects.text: You now have the ability to connect objects with the souls of others as you can with yourself, and you possess an inherent intuition regarding the extent to which these individuals can form such bonds.
objects.title: Bind to Account

objects.text: You may now bind non-sentient plants. They don't count as normal objects allowing you to bind them without limit, but they will also not benefit from replenishment like other consumables. They will grow at normal speed and get all their requirements and nourishment provided automatically. Binding supernatural plants which require vast amounts or exotic resources to grow can strain your soul and drain your stamina, unless you also have Multi-Bond. To summon a bound plant, you have to have a suitable vessel with soil, or you may summon them partially, such as by only taking its produce. You will also receive an instinctual sense about your plants' current state, and if you have additional powers which can interact with plants, you may use them within your soul without any summoning required.
objects.title: Soul Greenhouse

objects.text:
Your ability to bind objects was extended to certain categories of living things by Soul Greenhouse, and you learned to bind things to others with Bind To Account. Now, that path is finally complete.

You can now bind all living creatures (even sapient ones), as long as you have their consent to do so, or have completely and totally overpowered them such that they have no further possibility of resisting you. This latter category applies even to the dead, meaning that you can use their conditional resurrection as "leverage" to acquire their services.

If you are in danger of dying, you may "burn" one of your bound souls, allowing them to take the hit instead of you (though you may also choose to accept your death to spare those bound to you). Just like an item, they can be outside your body (or even directly extended from your body) without losing their bond to you. Just as with Soul Greenhouse, more powerful beings drain your stamina (unless you have Multi-Bond).

With Multi-Bond, you may bind whole armies to your person, able to resurrect the slain with your spare energy for as long as you still live. With Full Bond, you can selectively take on any qualities of those bound to you, permit them to take on any of yours, and wholly integrate them (or later remove them) from your "self".
objects.title: Army Of The Soul

objects.text:
Sorcery and Necromancy, magical arts of great power with which Exalted of all stripes use to achieve miracles, going far beyond simple Charms. However, there is a catch to this; the two arts are incompatible with each other by default, advancement in one art inhibiting development in the other, and forcing Exalts to choose between mastering one, and mastering neither.

No longer. Now, your proficiency in both Sorcery and Necromancy are transcendental, allowing you not only to master both arts without limit, but also allowing you to develop your mystical skills up to the Third Circle regardless of the strength of your Exaltation, even if you are but a Terrestrial. Furthermore, you are not necessarily limited to the mystical arts of Creation, either: If you had the knowledge and resources, you could learn the arts of the Man-Machine and God-Machine Protocols of the Alchemicals, or even the Glamour Sorceries of the Raksha.
objects.title: Sorcery Unbound (Exalted)

objects.text:
The Primordials once sought to turn the Solar Exalted into their puppets by seducing them with their eldritch power. They forgot that everything in Heaven and Earth belonged to the Lawgivers by right.

You now have access to all the abilities and Charms of not only the Solars' shining glory, but also the Primordial's modified Exalted - the Abyssals and the Infernals - without the negative effects such cursed tools usually bring, such as Resonance or Urges and Torment.

This includes the Charms of the Broken Winged Crane, as the purity of the Solar's conviction turns the blasphemous, Luciferian act of overturning the Gods and Primordials to become a Devil-Tiger - a half-Primordial, half-Exalted being - into a heroic and noble theft of the Promethean Fire.

If, by chance, you already possess multiple of these Exaltations already, then this blessing enhances their new synergy even further, allowing you to 'purify' the entirety of the Abyssal and Infernal Charmsets into something more 'noble', while retaining their natures of death and Hellish power... or, alternatively, twist the Solars' Charms into tyrannical supremacy.
objects.title: Folly of the Primordials (Exalted)

objects.text: With each purchase, you may gain an additional Caste/Aspect from your chosen Exaltation(s), gaining the Abilities or Attributes they have an affinity for - translating into a small boost in initial power and a more noticeable boost to growth speed - as well as the Anima flares and powers tied to that caste, allowing them to use said powers individually or in any combination when expending Essence. This upgrade also has additional benefit for Terrestrials and Exigents specifically: For Terrestrials, they receive not only their Caste Abilities and Anima powers, but also additional elements to go with them, as well as a boon in the form of counting as multiple Exalts in one, allowing them to gain more power out of their Elemental and Cooperative Charms; Exigents, due to not strictly having Castes like other Exalts, may instead gain the nature and domains of an additional god of Creation to add to their capabilities, something which would normally require illicit ‘after-market’ modifications on behalf of their patron and would come with severe complications. (Note: Only Alchemicals (and technically Lunars) have six Castes, so purchasing this upgrade the full five times is unnecessary without the appropriate Exaltation. If you have the Machine-Dragon Symbiosis addon as well, then each purchase will grant you both an Autocthonian and Creation element, and taking all five allows you to pick a custom sixth Creation element to round out the set, such as ‘Ice’, for example)
objects.title: Many-Faced Chosen Hero (Exalted)

objects.text: Solar Exalted are losers. You’re a Cosmic Exalted, an entirely superior form of Exalted that was… tragically erased from existence. You start with the maximum amount of Essence, as many Merits as you can justify, and the only attribute you have is Flawlessness which starts with the maximum rating and can be used in the place of any other attribute. You also take precedence over even the perfect effects of Solar Exalted, able to contest perfect effects as though they were non-perfect and supersede them entirely with your own. Also, you can fly and live in space. Your Charms are a bit like those of the Solar Exalted, in that they dial up your abilities, but instead of stopping at 11 they go to 13 at least. They can be used to rewrite fate so any declaration they make comes true, make any course of action they take the objectively correct one, take away a person’s relevance to the story, fold Creation like paper by being too foolish to realize it’s impossible, summon literally anyone, cast sorcery of the Fourth Circle, use special martial arts to deal infinite damage with a punch, and erase anything that wasn’t in the original canon from existence (DON’T acknowledge that Cosmic Exalted aren’t canon while using that last one). Of course, that’s all what you can do on a planet. When you travel into space you become even more powerful, elevating the scale their Charms work on from countries and planets to star systems and galactic arms.
objects.title: Cosmic Exalted (Exalted: Cosmics… From Space!)

objects.text:
You have the power to perceive and manipulate the threads of destiny that weave the fabric of reality. You can see the infinite possibilities of the future, the hidden outcomes of other people’s choices, and the inevitable events that shape the world. You can also intervene in the flow of fate, altering its course, bending its direction, and influencing its chances. You can defy the laws of causality and logic, overriding absolute canon events, locked time events, and so on.

Your power allows you to both observe and interfere with the cosmic order without causing paradoxes or anomalies. You can save someone who was fated to die and preserve the balance of the universe. You can create branches in the timeline that allow for impossible scenarios and even block entire Timelines from collapsing. You can also remotely guide others to change their fate without disrupting the natural order. Additionally, you can also access your own fate and see what could have been if you had made different choices. You can also implant false fate into yourself or others, leading other fate readers astray.
objects.title: Reader of Stars

objects.text:
You've taken half a step into becoming a Higher Being, this elevates your abilities to unparalleled heights, granting an overall boost in all physical and mental aspects. Experience a transformative surge in strength, speed, agility, and intellect that surpasses mortal limitations. Harnessing this power, you gain a unique ability aligned with your specialty, whether it be elemental manipulation, telepathic communication, or time-bending prowess.

Embrace the remarkable resilience of Ascendant's Resurgence, allowing you to resurrect once per day if faced with defeat. Rise again, revitalized and ready to conquer any challenge. Unleash your full potential and ascend to extraordinary levels of power, dominating in the pursuit of your destiny.
objects.title: The Hollow Knight Once Felled (Hollow Knight)

objects.text:
Unlock the boundless potential of the Higher Being, transcending mortal limitations and embodying the essence of one or multiple concepts. As a divine entity, your power becomes intricately tied to the devotion and adoration of others. The strength of your abilities is magnified by the intensity of worship, granting you unimaginable power to shape the world within your own realm and through the embodiment of the concept(s) you represent.

While you reigns supreme within your realm, in the real world, your power is greatly diminished. You must rely on your concept as a conduit to manifest and enact your abilities, drawing upon the worship and devotion of your followers to fuel your actions. As long as at least one creature worships you, you shall remain immortal and possess the capacity to unleash extraordinary forces, create realms of your own, and transcend the boundaries of mortal comprehension.
objects.title: The First Step of a Higher Being (Hollow Knight)

objects.text:
Ascend to the apex of divinity as the Lord of Shades, merging your existing concept as a Higher Being with the ultimate embodiment of the Void. In your own realm, you reign supreme, possessing unrivaled power that transcends mortal limitations. Your authority over the Void empowers you to shape reality and dictate the cosmic tapestry, wielding unparalleled might as the harbinger of beginnings and endings.

Your newfound status as the God of Gods has turned you into the harbinger of beginnings and ending, making your very essence begins to intertwines and weaves the fabric of existence itself to make it yours. Within your domain, you are omnipotent, defying the constraints of time and entropy. However, outside of your realm, your potency diminishes, and you must channel your true might through your concept as a conduit. Even so, your eternal existence ensures that your reign endures, persisting even when the universe succumbs to oblivion.
objects.title: As Above, So Below, The Void Is All (Hollow Knight)
Bount (Bleach)
objects.text:
You are a Bount, an ageless being capable of sustaining and strengthening yourself by consuming souls. You no longer naturally age and possess an enhanced affinity for Reishi, allowing you to absorb ambient spiritual particles to replenish Reiryoku, heal injuries, and temporarily strengthen yourself. Spiritually dense environments make this considerably more effective.

You can safely feed upon the souls of the deceased, but consuming the souls or spiritual energy of the living provides a far greater and potentially permanent increase to your spiritual power. This comes at a price: doing so accelerates your physical aging and gradually degrades your body, with excessive consumption potentially leaving you extremely powerful but prematurely ancient.

Finally, you gain the knowledge required to create your own Doll, a unique spiritual familiar born from your power and personality. Its form and abilities are personal to you, it grows stronger alongside you, and it can be summoned through its own release command. With sufficient mastery, you may even discover ways of merging with your Doll, as certain exceptional Bounts have accomplished.

Note: You can choose to have one of the Dolls used by any Bounts in the Bleach anime.

addons.title: Beast Within the Doll
addons.text:
Your Inner Beast can manifest through your Doll, using its complete understanding of your powers to act as a second mind within it. While doing so, it can control the Doll alongside you, coordinate its abilities independently, and continue operating it even if you are unconscious or otherwise unable to command it.

More importantly, your Inner Beast can regulate the dangerous bond between you and your Doll. Damage or instability that would normally cause the Doll to turn against you or make its destruction fatal can instead be intercepted through your Inner Beast, allowing the Doll to be dismissed and eventually restored rather than taking you with it.

You have the knowledge of the various scientific wonders of the Soul Society. It includes the knowledge and ability to create tools to manipulate, expand or empower souls and spirit particles.

You are well versed in creating Gigai or artificial bodies meant to contain souls, creating the Tenshintai that allows to rapidly unlock Bankai even by rookie Shinigami, fusing souls and physical objects together, creating Reiatsu amplifiers and limiters, creating gateways connecting different dimensions and even weapons that focus and expel spiritual energy on their own.

However, the crux of your ability lies in the manipulation and creations of souls, making you a match for men like Urahara, Aizen, and Kurotsuchi. Provided you have the tools, it is entirely possible for you to craft new beings, like Mod-Souls and Bounts, from spirit particles, designed to your specifications. With sufficient time, you may very well recreate destroyed souls from its fragments and even surpass Urahara and Aizen by creating a perfect Hōgyoku.
addons.title: 12th Division

addons.text:
Your semblance and your Zanpakutō have fused together, creating a power stronger than either of them without any of its component's weakness. 

As your Zanpakutō has fused with your semblance, you don't have an inner spirit (or you may elect to keep your inner spirit for it may have fused with your semblance and grown to a higher level), and are able to use your Shikai without any requirement for release or name of your spirit. 

Your Bankai is in the form of a second form/power up that you have and can enter anytime, as long as you have sufficient spiritual power/aura. Your first and second release as an Arrancar also follows this pattern, with you being able to use your first release/true form's powers and abilities in your humanoid form. You will also be able to create swords akin to your Zanpakutō with your Spiritual Power and Aura.
addons.title: Kusanagi no Tsurugi

objects.text:
You may have died, or maybe someone threw your soul outside your body, severing your Soul Chain in the process. Whatever happened, you now possess the power of a Shinigami. You have bonded with an Asauchi, which will transform into your Zanpakutō when you gain the name of your inner spirit. You are also trained in the four core techniques of the Shinigami which are: Zanjutsu, the art of sword fighting; Hakuda, unarmed combat; Hohō, mobility techniques; Kidō, demon magic and the art of Konsō, the process by which a Shinigami sends wandering Pluses in the Human World to Soul Society if they are good in life, or to Hell if their life was full of evil acts. You are also extremely long lived, with some of the captains having lived for 1000 years.

You have knowledge equivalent to a freshly graduated Shinigami, and have the potential to reach the level of Captains and beyond.

(You can customize your Shikai and Bankai, as well as the general appearance and personality of your Zanpakutō.)
objects.title: Shinigami (Bleach)

objects.text: It’s long been considered an absolute rule that each Shinigami can have only one Zanpakutō. Now, however, you’ve proved that isn’t true. Somehow, you’ve done what was thought impossible and gained another Zanpakutō. Each purchase of this option grants you another Zanpakutō. It can be one you’ve designed yourself or one from the franchise that isn’t already specifically granted by another option. If you have the Captain upgrade, you will have mastered the Bankai of each Zanpakutō you purchase here.
objects.title: Sword Collector (Bleach)

objects.text:
As a Shinigami, you were infected by a Hollow, allowing you to gain some power from it. You are normally indistinguishable from ordinary Shinigami and can use all of the normal Shinigami abilities. To use your Hollow powers, you must don your Hollow mask. 

This augments your Shinigami abilities with Hollow powers, as well as giving you access to Hollow abilities like Cero. Your spiritual pressure likewise changes into a mix of Hollow and Shinigami. Donning your Hollow mask is a boost similar in strength to a Bankai release, if not more and is often compared to Resurrección.

Normally, you have to fight your inner Hollow to use your powers; however, your inner Hollow is quite cooperative, allowing you to use your Hollow abilities without any problems. As with your Shinigami Zanpakutō, you can also customise your Inner Hollow, including its general appearance and personality. You can also optionally fuse it with your Zanpakutō spirit, just as Ichigo's Hollow is his Zanpakutō.

With effort, you could also grow stronger in your Visored abilities, potentially unlocking something similar to a Resurrección, or even growing enough to gain a Vasto Lorde form similar to Ichigo's transformation.
objects.title: Visored (Bleach)

addons.text:
You inherit the power, wisdom, and skill of the Captain of the 4th Division, Unohana Retsu. This includes her spiritual power, her mastery of Kidō and especially Kaidō, the healing arts, being able to stabilize and save anyone so long as they have even a single spark of life left in them, as well as the knowledge and instinct to be able to tell something is off even while placed under a perfect illusion that fools every natural and supernatural sense.

You also inherit all skills of Unohana Yachiru, first bearer of the title Kenpachi and the original Captain of the 11th Division. This includes her immense combat-skills, be it Zanjutsu, Hakuda, or even underhanded tricks, being a fighter and killer with few peers.

You also inherit Minazuki as an alternative release, in both Shikai and Bankai forms.
addons.title: Unohana

addons.text:
You inherit the power of the most well-known Captains of the 2nd Division and Heads of the Onmitsukidō, Shihōin Yoruichi and Suì-Fēng/Soi Fon, in their prime. This includes their aptitude at stealth, infiltration, surveillance, and assassination, and the mastery of shunpo that made Yoruichi renowned as the Goddess of Flash. You also gain all of their experience and aptitude in combat, ranging from their expertise in Zanjutsu, Hakuda, Kidō, as well as the fusion of the latter two that is Shunkō. You will inherently be able to use Shunkō in conjunction with the elements of Lightning and Wind as well as have the potential to integrate it with other elements, such as Yūshirō's Fire.

You also inherit Suzumebachi as an alternative release, in both Shikai and Bankai forms, as well as Yoruichi's currently unknown Zanpakutō.

And yes, you can also turn into a cat if you want to.
addons.title: Head of the Onmitsukidō

addons.text:
You inherit the power of Urahara Kisuke in his prime. This includes his wide array of physical combat-skills and talent with Kidō, but most importantly his towering knowledge and intellect. The ingenuity and tactical and strategic brilliance that made him a Special War Factor, being able to come up with and implement a counter to pretty much anything so long as you know what you're up against and are given some time to prepare, as well as being able to improvise effective solutions on the fly. You're also constantly coming up with new ideas and gadgets, ranging from the extremely useful to the simply amusing.

You also inherit Benihime as an alternative release, in both Shikai and Bankai forms.

In addition you also get the business skill required to keep a small store running successfully, as well as a pair of amazingly comfortable and slip-resistant geta and a dazzlingly stylish striped bucket-hat.
addons.title: Hat-and-Clogs

objects.text: You have enough Spiritual Power to be considered among the top-most Captain-level Shinigami. You have learned the name of your Zanpakutō and have become proficient in both Shikai and Bankai. You have also become proficient in the four core techniques of Shinigami and even gained some Kaidō, healing arts. You have knowledge of all 100 Kidō as well as some forbidden Kidō and the ability to cast most of them. While you may not surpass the peak masters in their individual field, you are the most well-rounded Captain of Gotei 13.
objects.title: Captain (Bleach)

addons.text:
You have become a living poison. Poison, by definition, is something that is capable of causing illness or death when introduced to a living being. You are now able to further refine and redefine that concept by directly altering, manipulating, and creating poison at will. This means you are capable of killing non-living and divine entities now, rapidly changing the effects of your poisons on the fly, and even using your poisons to counteract and heal the harmful effects of injuries, illnesses, and more.

You are also completely immune to any harmful poisonous effect and are able to share that ability amongst who you chose. On top of that, your poisons completely bypass any immunity or resistance if they didn’t have that ability before.
addons.title: Lethal Dose

objects.text:
You now call the powers that the Captain of the 12th Division of the Gotei 13 possesses, your own. This means the genius-level intellect of Mayuri Kurotsuchi—the current head of the Shinigami Research Institute, which means his skill and knowledge in body modification, swordsmanship, chemistry, and much more.

You now call ‘The Leg-Cutting Guardian’ your own. This deformed, trident shaped blade gives you the ability to secrete a poisonous vapor from its hilt (that you are immune to), and damage caused by the blade paralyzes the victim where struck, but still allows pain to be felt in said area.

The second form or Bankai state of this Zanpakutō is the Konjiki Ashisogi Jizō, better known as the ‘Divine Leg-Cutting Jizō’. This second state transforms the Zanpakutō into a yellow baby-like giant creature, that follows your mental and verbal commands. This form allows your Zanpakutō to breathe a large cloud of spiritual poison roughly 200-meters around its location. Said poison immediately starts to break down enemies after making contact with them, and you are able to designate who it affects. The poison in this state is essentially always adapting to stimuli which prevents anything from ever developing an immunity or cure for it.
objects.title: Ashisogi Jizō (Bleach)

objects.text:
You inherit Head Captain Yamamoto’s power at his prime. Possessing immense reserves of Reiryoku and capable of bringing lieutenants to their knees with sheer pressure, Yamamoto’s lifetime of experience has granted him masterful control over every ounce of his spiritual power.

With millennia, to hone his skills, Yamamoto commands a mastery of the Shinigami arts that few can match. He is a master swordsman capable of slaying most foes with a single blow. His Hakuda techniques can obliterate even Espada-level enemies. His knowledge of Kido is so great that he can cast spells at full power without uttering a word. His Shunpo skills enable him to be able to overtake his opponent and arrive at their destination first. His body possesses immense strength, durability, and endurance.

Finally, you gain Yamamoto’s Zanpakutō, Ryūjin Jakka—the Flowing Blade-like Flame—with its Shikai and Bankai already unlocked.
objects.title: Genryusai (Bleach)

objects.text: Sōten ni zase, Hyōrinmaru! You gain the power of the Captain of the 10th Division of the Gotei 13, Hitsugaya Toshirou. A prodigy in the Shinigami arts, Captain Hitsugaya is the youngest Shinigami ever to achieve the feat of Bankai, and become a Captain of one of the the Gotei 13’s divisions. You receive his large reserves of ice-cold Reiastsu, his intellect, his talent with Zanjutsu, and skill with Kido, Shunpo and Hakuda. Finally, you have Toshirou’s Zanpakutō, Hyōrinmaru—Ice Ring—having fully mastered it’s Shikai and Bankai, either as an alternative release, or a separate Zanpakuto.
objects.title: Ice Cold Prodigy (Bleach)

objects.text:
You now possess all the powers and abilities of the Captain of the 8th Division, Shunsui Kyoraku. While one of the more relaxed and approachable Captains, Shunsui is also one of the most senior Captains, eventually succeeding his mentor as the Head Captain of the Gotei 13.

His Zanpakutō, Katen Kyōkotsu—the ‘Bones of Heavenly Blooming Madness’—answers to your call. This Daisho pair gives you the ability to manifest children’s games into reality and weaponize their rules and conditions. However, Katen Kyōkotsu affects all within its radius of effect—ally, opponent, and owner alike.

Its Bankai form, Katen Kyōkotsu: Karamatsu Shinjū—Heavenly Blooming Madness: Withering Pine Lovers’ Suicide—manifests and enforces the four acts of a tragic stage play, forcing the user and opponent to act out their roles, ultimately ending with the opponent’s death through the destruction of their head.
objects.title: Ken Asobi (Bleach)

objects.text:
You have all the powers, skills and abilities of Sōsuke Aizen in his prime. You are not only the perfect fusion of Hollow and Shinigami but also transcend both the races. Your mere presence is monstrously overwhelming, with your now immeasurable Spiritual Power. Your Spiritual Pressure is powerful enough to be vaporize living beings that come to close to you, though you retain enough control to not do so if you wish.

You inherit Aizen's genius intellect, planning capabilities and his mastery over various sciences. You are also master of the four core abilities of Shinigami—Zanjutsu, Hakuda, Hohō, and Kidō—such that even without using your Zanpakutō, you can defeat many of the captains. 

You also inherit Kyōka Suigetsu which you can use even without having your Zanpakutō, in a similar way Aizen used it on Yhwach. Also, as a bonus, you possess and can use the Bankai of Kyōka Suigetsu. You are immortal to such a degree that the Soul Society was unable to find a way to provide you true death, and even Yhwach would consider killing you to be a time-consuming task.
objects.title: Kyōka Suigetsu (Bleach)

objects.text:
Chire, Senbonzakura

Byakuya Kuchiki

You now possess all the powers, skill and abilities of Byakuya Kuchiki, Captain of the 6th Division of the Gotei 13, and 28th head of the Noble Kuchiki Family You inherit his immense spiritual power, skill with swordsmanship, Kido, Shunpo and Hakuda, his masterful strategic and tactical mind. His zanpakuto, Senbonzakura—the “Thousand Cherry Blossoms”—now answers to your command, freely allowing you to use their Shikai—where his blade scatters into countless microscopic blades reflecting the light to appear like Cherry Blossoms, and under his complete control—and Bankai Senbonzakura Kageyoshi—Vibrant Display of a Thousand Cherry Blossoms—where a nigh infinite amount of blade fragments are created under the users complete control.
objects.title: Yozakura (Bleach)

objects.text:
You inherit Kenpachi Zaraki's power at his prime. Your mere presence is monstrously overwhelming, you have immeasurable spiritual power, and you can even use your Reiatsu as armor.
