You inherit Zaraki's physical ability, fighting talent, supreme natural skill, and his hyper-adaptability, which were enough to make him a War Factor despite having only a single day of formal training.

You are talented enough to whup two Captains without even knowing how to do Shikai or Bankai, fast enough to dodge a captain's blade already touching your skin, and strong enough that someone with the power to make imagination into reality literally couldn't imagine something you couldn't cut.

You also inherit Nozarashi as an alternative release, in both Shikai and Bankai forms.
objects.title: Weather Beaten One (Bleach)

addons.title: The Blade is Me
addons.text:
The Hogyoku greatly accelerates your journey to transcendence.

Where before it would’ve taken you years to reach complete fusion, at the very fastest, you are now likely to do so in a matter of months, or less if truly pressed. 

Once you finally achieve complete fusion, the Hogyoku even aids you in maintaining the form, as it smooths any dissonance that might arise between you and your spirit, keeping you in harmony even under circumstances that would otherwise prompt conflicting emotions and opinions.

By incorporating the Hogyoku itself into your fusion, your combined will grants you much more granular control over the Hogyoku’s influence, all but removing the risk of it misinterpreting your desires or materializing fleeting wishes that are not in your best interests. Additionally, such a fusion grants you a powerful form of regenerative immortality and the capacity to evolve rapidly and grow stronger, just as it did Aizen.

objects.text:
Your connection to your Zanpakuto has become so deep that the boundary between the two of you has begun to blur, granting you power completely beyond your peers.

Initially, this change manifests as a simple increase in your Bankai’s power and efficiency, giving you a solid, if unexceptional, advantage over shinigami who would otherwise be your equal. However, with further training your fusion will become more complete and dramatic in effect. For example, in addition to greatly increasing the power of your spiritual pressure, it might fuse your Bankai to your body and allow you to fight the likes of Head Captain Yamamoto on relatively even grounds. 

Beyond even that is the true essence and endpoint of your journey, when the boundary between Zanpakuto and wielder does not simply blur, it dissolves entirely. This allows you to completely fuse with your Zanpakuto, a state Ichigo Kurosaki was only able to briefly touch while executing his Final Getsuga Tensho, at the expense of nearly all of his spiritual powers. In this transformation, your strength is such that you could swat down and inflict immense damage to the likes of Aizen in his most powerful Hogyoku-derived evolutionary state. 

All that said, actually reaching this state is likely to take years, if not decades, of dedicated training to refine your Bankai and deepen your connection with your Zanpakuto’s spirit, and even then it can only be maintained as long as you remain perfectly synchronized. 

You may, however, temporarily fuse with your Zanpakuto, briefly exhibiting transcendent strength at the expense of putting yourself under immense physical and spiritual stress. Even in the very best case, this backlash is likely to inflict critical damage to your physical body and deprive you of most of your spiritual powers, potentially reducing you all the way down to the level of an ordinary person. However, you are at least guaranteed to recover all of your spiritual strength, given enough time. Even if it may take months or even years.
objects.title: Beyond Bankai (Bleach: Brave Souls)

objects.text: With an ability to summon Heroic Spirits to fight for you, and the powers of a Shinigami Captains under your control, a new interaction is born. You gain the ability to summon the Captain’s powers that you share to serve you loyally, while this doesn’t have an energy cost to you, it does lock out the Zanpakuto and unique abilities of whichever Captain’s you summon while they’re around. Typically, Shinigami would be spiritual entities unable to properly interact with the world of the living. Each of your new subordinates is summoned into a spiritual vessel akin to a Heroic Servant, able to be bound by any Command Seals you might possess. Rounds of the Lionheart however is only capable of materializing the Captain’s in question, while Summoner on the other hand has enough power to summon their entire Division as well. Each Division of the Gotei Thirteen has about 200 Shinigami, and can come with any character connected to that Division.
objects.title: Sōtaichō (Bleach)

objects.text: You are a member of the mysterious Zero Squad. You not only have immeasurable Spiritual Power but have mastered all of the four core techniques of a Shinigami as well as the other auxiliary techniques. Your attainment is enough to defeat any Captain of the Gotei 13, without even using your Shikai. Moreover, there is an ability you possess that you have taken to extreme level. Maybe you have named everything like the "Monk Who Calls the Real Name", allowing you to manipulate Names—or maybe you are someone like the God of the Sword, unrivaled in Zanjutsu and the creator of Zanpakutōs. This ability synergizes well with your Shikai and Bankai, allowing you to expand the very limits of your ability—an example being Ichibe's Shikai which took the form of a large brush, granting him the ability to manipulate ink. With this power, he could suppress and erase others by enveloping them, along with their names, in black ink. As for his Bankai, it amplified this ability to an even greater extent. In his Bankai state, Ichibe could directly alter or bestow new names upon beings, causing the properties associated with those names to become reality. An additional benefit of your new position is the Ōken, which are the modified bones in your body, that allows you to create clothing with incredible defensive property and grants agelessness.
objects.title: Zero Squad (Bleach)

objects.text:
You gain all the powers and experience of Ichibe Hyōsube, the leader of the Soul King’s Royal Guard and living witness to the entire history of the Three Worlds, from the time before they were split all the way up to the present.

As such, your mastery of all the known Shinigami disciplines is beyond even the impressive standards of Squad Zero. Your strength is such that even someone as powerful as pre-Almighty Yhwach would seem little more than a petulant child standing before you.

In addition to the known Shinigami disciplines, you are a practitioner of a number of more unusual arts, ranging from Secret Kido to the manifestation of giant spiritual appendages capable of blasting your foes 4000 kilometers away.

Your most notable powers and arts are derived from your core contribution to the Soul Society, Names. As the Speaker of the True Name, you have innate knowledge of the true name of anything you set your sights on. Additionally, you may opt to strike at the names of things rather than their flesh, reducing their total strength in proportion to the damage you would’ve dealt. When armed with a writing instrument, you are even capable of bringing order to the black chaos of the world, allowing you to manifest supernatural effects via your written words, such as creating a powerful barrier with the word “Seal” or turning objects invisible using the word “Conceal”.

Ichibe’s own powers are not the only thing you’ve gained; you also gain his Zanpakuto, Ichimonji, the very first of its kind, as an alternate form for your own. In its sealed state, Ichimonji takes the form of a giant calligraphy brush, its tip ever wet with the spiritual power of chaos taking the form of black ink, which functions as a powerful focus and implement for your name-based abilities. 

Ichimonji’s Shikai enhances your power even further, changing the brush tip into a blade that scatters large amounts of ink with every swing. Anything that’s coated by this ink loses its name entirely, and all of its power along with it. Additionally, you may use your enhanced power from Ichimonji to call upon the “Black” of the world to further fuel and amplify your powers. 

Beyond Shikai, you also gain access to Shin’uchi: Shirafude Ichimonji, the very first Bankai, predating even the widely known name of the release. The core power of your Shin’uchi is the nigh-divine ability to bestow a new name, and all associated qualities, upon anything that has had its name removed by Ichimonji’s ink. In addition, your Shin’uchi also greatly enhances your name-based powers, allowing you to exercise terrible arts like Futen Taisatsuryō, which robs 100 nights from the world’s future to utterly annihilate whoever it’s used on, such they can never be revived or reincarnated.
objects.title: The Monk Who Calls the True Name (Bleach)

objects.text:
Your Zanpakuto Spirit is something that has only ever been seen once before, or perhaps will never be seen again. Zanpakuto are supposed to live inside your soul and be an extension of yourself to the point that most shinigami use the phrase “The blade is me.” However, yours is a special case, equal only to Kenpachi Zaraki and Yachiru in nature.

Your Zanpakuto spirit can manifest outside your inner world, similar to Nozarashi. It exists both as the blade you carry and as a separate entity in the physical realm. Only one of you can utilise its special abilities at a time; this limitation may diminish as your bond with your Zanpakuto grows. When outside your body, your spirit will be mistaken for another Shinigami and can summon a copy of its own blade.

This nature further empowers your Zanpakutou; consequently, many would assume your blade is permanently in Shikai. Even in its base form, your Zanpakutou is as strong as a Shikai, similar in nature to Kenpachi Zaraki. Each subsequent form is significantly stronger than it would ordinarily be.
objects.title: Wandering Zanpakuto Spirit (Bleach)

addons.text:
You inherit the power of the Novena Espada Aaroniero Arruruerie at his prime. This includes his ability to completely absorb the skills, appearance, muscle-memory, power, memories, and any unique traits of any being he devoured, his acting ability to perfectly mimic those he's eaten, as well as the powers of the 33,650 Hollows he has consumed.

You also gain Glotoneria as an alternate Resurrección, allowing you to use as many powers of those you've consumed simultaneously as you please. You can also choose to merge your sealed Zanpakuto with your hand to use it as an alternative method of feeding, as well as return it to its proper sword-form at will.
addons.title: Glotoneria

addons.text:
You inherit the power of the Octava Espada Szayelaporro Granz. This includes his intellect and scientific knowledge, skill at crafting devices and traps, his aptitude at analyzing and subsequently neutralizing the abilities of his enemies, as well as his ability to modify other beings, for example customizing his Fracción into effectively living consumable healing items.

You also gain Fornicarás as an alternate Resurrección, allowing you to make use of its numerous abilities such as releasing a spray of black liquid whose droplets turn into clones of anyone who comes into contact with them, the ability to liquefy if consumed and control the new host from the inside, Teatro de Titere which creates what can be best described as voodoo matryoshka dolls, as well as the self-resurrection ability Gabriel.
addons.title: Fornicarás

addons.text:
You are something which should not exist, the blasphemous fusion of a Quincy and Hollow, which should by all rights have imploded due to its very essence tearing itself apart. 

Besides losing your weakness to Hollow Reishi inherent to your existence as a Quincy, your abominable nature also grants you a single ability, one which is in fact but a perfected extension of a Hollow’s most basic ability; the ability to take a soul.

At will you can attempt to claim the soul of any living being within your range, devouring it and killing the being in question. This consumption is perfect with no loss of power, a perfect 1:1 of their spiritual power becoming yours, although as with normal Hollow consumption you don't get any unique powers they had. This perfection of consumption also applies to any souls you consume the normal way. If you possess some other ability which lets you acquire abilities from those you kill or consume, this counts for those abilities as well.

While beings stronger than or equal in strength to you can attempt to resist your claim, those weaker than you are fundamentally unable to deny you. Even then, those greater than you can be claimed if they're weakened or otherwise have their ability to fight back diminished.

Your range is determined by your own strength, your average Adjuchas may have only a few dozen meters of range, while an existence like Starrk may be able to devour the souls of entire countries with ease, to say nothing of what someone on the level of Aizen or Yhwach could achieve.
addons.title: Anathema

addons.text:
Some find the prospect of being composed of numerous devoured - and quite possibly tortured - souls, as well as being forced to consume more souls to grow to be a bit objectionable. With the addition of Soul Garden however, this is no longer an issue.

Your Soul Garden and the mass of Souls which make up your existence are now one and the same; any soul you consume as a Hollow comes to rest in peace within your Garden, and all Souls within your Garden contribute to your strength. Of course, this does mean that if you have some way to extract souls from your Garden and resurrect them you will lose the strength they contribute.
addons.title: Walking Afterlife

objects.text:
You lingered in the living world for too long without finding peace or moving on to the Soul Society after death, becoming susceptible to negative emotions, regrets, and despair. These negative emotions eventually consumed your soul, eroding your humanity and turning you into a Hollow. Hollows are powerful and malevolent spirits that have lost their hearts and transformed into monstrous creatures, driven by an insatiable hunger for souls. Hollows possess a wide range of grotesque and nightmarish forms, often combining animalistic features with a humanoid shape. Their distinct masks serve as both a defining characteristic and a source of power. These masks symbolize their shattered identities and human pasts.

As a Hollow, you possess formidable spiritual energy, granting you immense strength, speed, and regenerative abilities. You are a relentless predator, attacking with razor-sharp claws, powerful bites, and energy blasts known as "Cero" and are capable of opening gateways to other dimensions known as Garganta. Unlike other Hollows, you never lost your sapience and are directly born as an Adjuchas. 

Moreover, unlike normal Hollows, you do not need to continuously devour souls to prevent yourself from regressing back to a Gillian. However, you still need to consume a sufficient number of souls to evolve into a Vasto Lorde.

(You can customize your special ability that you receive as an Adjuchas.)
objects.title: Hollow (Bleach)

objects.text:
As a Hollow, you have removed your mask with or without the help of the Hōgyoku and survived the process, thereby becoming an Arrancar. 

Unlike normal Hollows, you possess a complete humanoid form, with the exception of a hole somewhere in your body as well as fragments of your mask. In your humanoid form, your physiology is also quite similar to a Shinigami and you have access to Hollow abilities like Cero, Bala, Descorrer and so on. 

As an Arrancar, you seal the major portion of your abilities within the form of a sword, which acts somewhat similar to Shinigami's Zanpakutō. When you release your sword's seal, you regain your true form and power as a Hollow. This increases your combat ability by several times. This release is known as Resurrección. 

You also have potential to achieve a second more stronger form known as Resurrección: Segunda Etapa. You start with power equal to that of someone like Yammy Llargo.
objects.title: Arrancar

addons.text:
You inherit the power of the Segunda Espada Baraggan Louisenbairn, the former King of Hueco Mundo. This includes his vast physical and spiritual power, his durability, the vast amount of experience Baraggan accumulated over his long life, as well as his power and skill in the use of Senescencia, being able to create Time Dilation Fields around yourself to slow attacks coming at you and age anything you come into contact with, as well as many other tricks you'll work out yourself.

You also gain Arrogante as an alternate Resurrección, increasing the power and range of your Senescencia to passively and rapidly age anything coming too close to the point of disintegration, as well as unleashing targeted bursts of entropy in the form of Respira, which takes the form of a smoke-like miasma eating away anything it makes even glancing contact with until it has been entirely consumed. You can also shift your sealed Zanpakuto into the form of a giant double-headed axe and back into a sword at will.
addons.title: Arrogante

objects.text: Congratulations! You have achieved the pinnacle of the natural evolution of Hollows. As a Vasto Lorde, you are born from devouring numerous souls and possess a monstrous appearance, adorned with intricate bone armor. You have immense strength, agility, and speed and are capable of wielding devastating spiritual energy. You have also mastered all the powers and abilities of your kind including Cero and its variations, Sonido, and others. Your inherent ability have also increased in both breadth and depth, becoming more powerful than before. You are a being that could hold your own against the Captains of the Gotei 13.
objects.title: Vasto Lorde (Bleach)

objects.text:
By fusing with the Hōgyoku, you have attained a new level of Resurrección that no Arrancar has ever reached.

The Hogyoku, aiding your evolution, has reabsorbed the Zanpakutō that contained your hollow power, harmonizing it with your Shinigami power. This grants you the true equivalent of a Bankai, rather than merely reclaiming Hollow power through a base Resurrección or achieving the Shikai equivalent of Resurrección: Segunda Etapa. In this state, all the powers and abilities you possess as an Arrancar are dramatically enhanced.

Your spiritual pressure has reached a transcendent level, comparable to Aizen's after his fusion with the Hōgyoku. This immense power is beyond the capacity of even Captain-level Shinigami to measure or detect. It's so overwhelming that beings with weaker Spiritual Power than yours could be erased upon contact.

The fusion with the Hōgyoku also bestows a godly form of regenerative immortality, making you nearly unkillable as you can regenerate rapidly and perfectly from any form of damage, as long as even the smallest fragment of your soul is not wiped from existence.

Additionally, you have gained the ability to adapt and evolve into increasingly powerful forms during combat, allowing you to surpass your opponents—similar to how Aizen continuously evolved after merging with the Hōgyoku.

The previous weakness of the Hōgyoku misinterpreting your desires has been eliminated, as it's now entirely a part of your being.
objects.title: Beyond Resurreccións (Bleach Brave Soul)

objects.text:
Through direct exposure to a Hollow while in utero, a fragment of its essence has become intertwined with your soul, transforming you into a Fullbringer. As a fully realized Fullbringer, you possess the ability to manipulate the souls residing within both inanimate matter and other living beings, albeit with greater effort for the latter. Recognizing that everything possesses a soul, you have acquired the power to manipulate and influence these spiritual energies.

This grants you capabilities such as walking on any surface, enhancing your speed through control over the ground, and even manipulating the soul within the air to enable flight—your imagination is the only ceiling here.

You also possess the capacity to imbue your essence into objects, allowing them to gradually develop into Fullbrings. The speed at which this connection is formed between you and an object is determined by your emotional bond and affection towards it. Once an object has become a Fullbring, you can activate it, potentially triggering transformations and granting you new powers and abilities that are unique to both the user and the particular object from which the fullbring originated. You are not restricted to possessing only one Fullbring, as you can create multiple ones, although the subsequent creations come at a greater cost compared to the initial one.
objects.title: Fullbringer (Bleach)

objects.text: You are the host of a large fragment of the Soul King, an example being a large portion of the Soul Chain possessed by Aura Michibane. This gives you an immense amount of Spiritual Power, enough to fight a Shinigami Captain to a stand-still. This also allows you to command the souls of the objects around you on a greater scale, allowing you to manipulate the world around you as you see fit as well as replicate the effects of Kidō with a wave of your hand. Your special ability as a Fullbringer also gets an immense boost in both breadth and depth, allowing you to compete with the Shikai and Bankai of the Captains of Gotei 13. You have also mastered the various Fullbringer-specific techniques like Bringer Light. As the second person reaching this level, there are many other powers and abilities left for you to discover with time.
objects.title: Michibane (Bleach)

objects.text:
You are not the host of some fragments of Soul King, but an entire body part of His. This has caused your Spiritual Power to grow to an immeasurable level, as well as boosting your physical ability to accommodate the immense Spiritual Power. Your control over the world around you as well as your mastery of your innate abilities and Fullbring(s) has grown to absurd amounts, letting you fight the members of Zero Division on equal ground. You also possess an ability from the Soul King's body part you are the host of. An example being the authority of stagnation and stillness governed by His right arm. This ability synergizes completely with your Fullbring(s), boosting it to unprecedented levels. Moreover, unlike the normal body parts of Soul King, the one you are the host of is not sapient or sentient and will not develop sentience in the future.

(You can design the ability as well as the body part you are the host of.)
objects.title: Aura of the Soul King (Bleach)

addons.text: Thanks to your increased capabilities as a Fullbringer, your Fullbring evolved, getting rid of its primary weakness. This allows your history altering to spread out from your target, granting you the capability of truly rewriting history on a grand scale. But using this will increase the cost of Spiritual Power with every extra affected person and/or object, making its cost scale with the scale of your history editing.
addons.title: Author of the Past

addons.text: With your ability to reincarnate, your Fullbring developed a new ability to forcefully rewrite your own past. By stabbing somebody, you can now rewrite the past in a way that you can actually become a biological relative of them, as if you were reincarnated into their family. You will always retain all of the powers and perks you obtained here, on top of whatever you gain from your new bloodline. This ability has an immense Spiritual Power cost, possibly even knocking out the user from exhaustion.
addons.title: Self-Insert of the Beginning

addons.text: Now, you can apply Alibi Block to the past of anyone you've cut, enabling you to physically travel back in time and appear in their past. You will leave behind an instinctual bookmark in the “present”, allowing you to instantly reappear whenever you want in the original timeline, which is now changed by whatever you did.
addons.title: Universal Bookmark

objects.text:
You gain access to the Fullbring of Shūkurō Tsukishima, which you can summon and dismiss freely in both its bookmark and sword forms. As a katana, it can be used as a high-quality weapon comparable to a Zanpakutō with incredible sharpness. But its real power lies in its ability to manipulate the past.

Whenever the user chooses to activate the sword's power, it will manipulate the targeted object’s or being’s past by inserting the user into its history, with the option to prevent the blade from actually harming your target in the traditional way. This would allow you to cut the ground and insert yourself into its history, laying a trap in the location; repair an object by changing its history in a way where you prevented it from breaking in the first place; make yourself the childhood friend of your enemy, making them hesitate, and more. You also gain a comprehensive knowledge of the altered history you insert into others', giving you the capability to obtain an immense amount of knowledge and skills in an instant.

This will also synergize with your other powers exceptionally well, as you will always have access to your full capabilities as you insert yourself into the past, which can be used creatively. For example, you could cut your homework to have it done by yesterday; cut a flask of water, changing its past to be an elixir you brewed via alchemy; change the history of somebody by making them have a magical contract, forcing them to be your familiar, etc.

The only real weakness of the Fullbring is the fact that its rewriting of history only affects your direct target(s), so if you are not careful, other people can recognize inconsistencies like you inserting yourself into your target’s history by hanging out with them but then others pointing out that you were at work that day.

Finally, your Fullbring is attached to your soul on a conceptual level, which allows it to grow in power just like any normal power you get here, and it can slowly recover in its unsummoned state if it gets damaged or broken.
objects.title: Book of the End (Bleach)

objects.text:
Your heart and love are far greater than those of a normal Fullbringer. You find it easier to form an emotional attachment to objects, so when you imbue your spiritual essence into any item, it becomes one of your Fullbrings faster than it would for anyone else. 

You have essentially unlocked a separate ability similar to the infamous Aura Michibane, a Fullbringer known for having no item she could emotionally connect to, which let her manipulate the souls of objects directly without ever forming a Fullbring of her own. You are her opposite; where she had no attachment to any item, you have an enormous emotional well to spare, letting you create new Fullbrings faster than any normal Fullbringer. 

You grow any Fullbring you own far faster than normal, finding new forms and unlocking new abilities at a pace a regular Fullbringer only sees early on; the key difference is that this growth does not slow down or hit a wall over time the way it would for them, meaning you keep progressing where others would stall. 

You also have a natural talent for knowing exactly what ability an object would gain as a Fullbring and which items are worth making into one. The rule is simple: the more history an object has, the more powerful its abilities become as you channel your emotional and spiritual energy into it to unlock its potential.
objects.title: Embraced Soul (Bleach)

addons.text:
You have inherited the power of Yhwach at his prime—the emperor of the Wandenreich and father of Quincy, the son of the Soul King. All your Quincy abilities are further enhanced as the father of all Quincy, and your power grows to match the title.

Not only do your Quincy powers grow, but you also experience growth in both Almighty and Soul Distribution, allowing you to consume other beings via physical contact, even those stronger than yourself, and the experience that Yhwach has had in using these abilities allows you to use them at the same level as he does. However, it takes longer for you to absorb the power they wield from stronger beings than the instantaneous power absorption from those weaker than you.

You have also regained all abilities that Yhwach has bestowed upon others, regaining the abilities that Yhwach has given away or collected in his long life of sharing his soul with others. This gives you the power of Ywatch at his highest, but before he has absorbed the Soul King.

This optionally comes with a mustache that grows more fabulous the more power you have.
addons.title: Yhwach

objects.text:
You are now an enhanced human, capable of discerning the presence of Hollows and other Souls. Through combining and manipulating the Reishi present in the atmosphere with your own Reiryoku, you can fashion a spiritual weapon of your choosing.

As a pure-blooded Quincy, you possess a distinct advantage in gathering and absorbing Reishi significantly faster compared to ordinary Quincy individuals. Over time, the line between Reishi and Reiryoku blurs for you, granting you unprecedented offensive, defensive, and supportive abilities, as both energies seamlessly intertwine.

Your primary spiritual weapon, typically a bow and arrow, is a versatile instrument that allows for sustained offense. As long as your stamina remains and your capacity to absorb Reishi persists, you would have an unlimited supply of arrows at your disposal. Your distinguished lineage also eliminates the need for an intermediary conduit to materialize your weapon; summoning and employing it becomes as natural as an extension of your own limb.

Furthermore, the process of continuously absorbing Reishi, coupled with your lineage, enhances your physical capabilities, including an extended lifespan spanning multiple orders of magnitude. This enables you to keep pace with any of your adversaries, eventually attaining mastery over them through dedicated practice and the passage of time. 

The Quincy also employ several techniques, each of them have be catalogued and outlined in your mind, enabling you to attain them and further master them, if you are willing to spend the required effort to do so.
objects.title: Quincy (Bleach)

objects.text:
You are among the most powerful Quincy created for the subjugation and destruction of Soul Society and the Shinigami who live there.

Your Reishi manipulation and physical capabilities have grown to give most Shinigami trouble, and you are able to match most Captains who have yet to release their Bankai. As a member of the Sternritter, you have access to a Schrift, a sacred letter that denotes a potent ability powered by the blood of Yhwach and inscribed on your soul. While powerful, yours still stands below the Schrift of the Schutzstaffel. However, you do have a unique protection against Ywhach's Auswählen.

As a Sternritter, you are also capable of using Vollständig, a potent evolution of Letzt Stil. It grants you an angelic visage composed of Reishi constructs and grants you additional abilities:

Reishi Dominance: your Reishi manipulation is put into overdrive, allowing you to absorb large amounts of Reishi into the tip of your Spirit Weapon, enabling a powerful attack. In places of notable spiritual composition, such as Hueco Mundo or Soul Society, your Reishi absorption is capable of even absorbing Reishi from the likes of trees, rocks, or even buildings.

Flight: by forming Reishi constructs in the form of wings, you are capable of high-speed flight.

Enhanced Spirit Weapon: your Spirit Weapon can now be formed entirely out of Reishi.

Enhanced Schrift: whichever ability was granted to you through your Schrift enters a greatly amplified state, enabling you greater power and range, and even access to techniques you normally couldn't use.

Enhanced Spirital Awareness: your ability to sense Reiatsu receives a similar enhancement, allowing you to overcome abilities that would otherwise hide someone's presence to you.

You also receive the special medallion of the Sternritter, allowing you to steal Bankai, and possibly other weapons that are parts of their owner's soul. Any stolen Bankai you use merely grants its form and power, you must still train to master it, and you are unable to use your Vollständig while wielding it.
objects.title: Sternritter (Bleach)

objects.text:
Rejoice, for the Emperor himself has recognized the extent of your power! Your power, on par with the Zero Division, has earned you an open invitation to serve in Yhwach's Royal Guard. The power you hold within yourself allows you to hold a much stronger Schrift from Yhwach's soul, or powers on par with such.

You have such immense spiritual pressure that you are capable of surpassing Captain-level Shinigami. Your Heilig Pfeil contains the potential to destroy the cities that surround the Soul King Palace. Your Reishi manipulation grants you an expertise over Hirenkyaku that gives you the potential to catch even the likes of Yoruichi Shihōin off guard. Similarly, your great Reishi manipulation sees your foundational Quincy abilities stand leagues above all others, save for Yhwach, himself.
objects.title: Royal Guard (Bleach)

objects.text:
Like Lillie Barro before you, Yhwach’s power has been allowed to grow excessively within your soul, mutating you into something more than human, something approaching divinity.

As a result of this evolution, your flesh itself has become a Reishi construct, not unlike your spiritual weapon.

This altered physical make-up grants you a number of foundational passive benefits, such as a subtle increase in your spiritual sensitivity and physical abilities, and a lack of physical weak points, like organs. However, when combined with the active use of your Quincy techniques, you can draw out much more dramatic effects, such as reconstructing your body to effectively regenerate or shapeshift, though the complexities of a “human” body mean you’re not able to do this very quickly in your base state.

Your survivability is such that even ripping you to pieces isn’t guaranteed to put you down for good, for any remaining piece of you that retains enough power to form a standard Heilig Bogen can be remolded into a new, appropriately weakened, body. There is no hard limit on the number of bodies you can control this way, meaning you could function as a literal one-man-army, assuming you have the required mental processing power and were bloated with enough Reishi before being ripped apart.

Additionally, any effect normally applied to your spiritual weapon or its attacks can be produced from your body, potentially with some slight reinterpretation, like how Lillie uses The X-Axis to become intangible.

When combined with your Quincy: Vollständig’s enhanced Reishi absorption and manipulation, you can near-instantly alter and reconstruct your form however you desire. You can even seemingly teleport by deconstructing and reassembling your body anywhere within the range of your Reishi Domination.
objects.title: Messenger of God (Bleach)

objects.text:
Like Yhwach, you have been born with the innate ability to distribute a piece of your soul to another by being touched by them (with no major loss to yourself), allowing you, like Yhwach, to acquire power by bestowing an ability. This enables those "gifted" to cultivate it and then taking it back. This ability can be broadly broken into a few sections, but it isn't all it can do—that's for you to discover, though.

In the distribution of your soul, you can heal wounds that one's soul could not heal alone. This includes the physical, mental, and spiritual ailments of those who have touched you. While the person's wound is healed, all of their knowledge, skills, and talents will be engraved inside the piece of soul they received from you. The price for this healing is a drastic reduction in the person's lifespan, and once the person has died, the augmented fragment will return to you with all of their knowledge, stats, skills, and talents. By having others drink your blood within a ritual, you may distribute your soul fragments in a much more powerful way by engraving a letter signifying an ability directly onto another's soul. You can forcibly retake these soul fragments at any time through "Auswählen," which allows you to absorb the energy from those you have gifted power to and send it to those who need it, or you can take their powers for yourself. Those taken from will perish, while those on the receiving end are revitalized with greater strength than they possessed before.

Upon activation of this ability, the targets are engulfed in massive columns of light. Dodging this light will not protect someone from having their power taken. The Auswählen can be used to revive those you have "gifted" power by stealing the powers and life of others. The greatest use of this ability is the Sankt Altar: you summon five orbs of energy in the air around a target that shoot out concentrated beams of energy at the target, forming the pattern of a large Quincy Zeichen. These beams rob the power of their target and transfer it to you.

However, beware that the use of this ability temporarily forms a piece of Still Silver within the hearts of those you have targeted with Auswählen. If this is extracted at the proper time and forced into contact with your blood, you will briefly lose access to your powers (seconds to a full minute).

The last ability is Reiatsu Infusion, which allows you to transfer your Reiatsu to others through contact with an object that you have infused with your Reiatsu. This temporarily forces an individual gifted with your power to act as you wish.

Remember, these are just the broad strokes of what this ability allows you to do. So, study and practice, and you may discover more.
objects.title: Soul Distribution (Bleach)

objects.text:
You have discovered a method to use the Soul Distribution as a side-grade, or perhaps created a ritual to generate Quincy without waiting for those carrying your soul fragments to reproduce. 

This ritual grants only the base traits of a pureblood Quincy, unlike the Schrift ritual. Both rely on using your blood to awaken an individual's powers; this process doesn't involve carving a letter into the recipient's soul; you can do both or just one. 

Whenever any Quincy you have created dies, their soul returns to you as their progenitor. You absorb all the Reiryoku, Reishi, and spiritual knowledge they accumulated during their lifetime. Furthermore, you may resurrect these Quincy as spirits to serve you. As long as one of your created Quincy survives, you cannot be permanently killed; you can be resurrected from any fragment of your soul you have bestowed upon them. 

Similar to Yhwach, the other person known for this power, you can now see the ideal letter to engrave on a soul just by looking at someone. You identify the Schrift that best suits an individual and the specific power it grants, ensuring the bestowed ability is perfectly aligned with their personality rather than providing an ill-fitting or suboptimal Schrift.
objects.title: Progenitor of Quincy (Bleach)

objects.text: You now possess the ultimate power of both the Soul King and Yhwach, known as The Almighty. However, this is not the fully completed version Yhwach attained after absorbing the Soul King; rather, it is the version he regained during his battle with Ichibei. This power grants the wielder a formidable form of clairvoyance, allowing you to see all possible futures and manifest the desired outcome in the present. It also enables you to undo events in the immediate present by selecting a future where the event in question does not occur. The Almighty provides a complete understanding of any power it can perceive, allowing you to not only nullify those powers but also to manipulate them as if they were your own. Despite its greatness, this power has limitations. Your version of the Almighty cannot create new possibilities or alter the future. If an action has a zero-percent chance of success with your current level of power, even the Almighty cannot make it happen. Furthermore, if your opponent uses an ability that can alter your perception or interfere with the past, it can disrupt the power of the Almighty. Only when your power grows to rival the Soul King will the Almighty evolve to its perfect form, enabling you to rewrite fate, create new possibilities, and truly alter the future.
objects.title: The Almighty (Bleach)

objects.text:
Shun Shun Rikka is composed of six spirits that you can instantly summon and dismiss, that resides within a six petal flower-shaped hairpins, each of which is two petals on the clip when inactive, and only spiritually aware beings can see them. Through various combinations of the six fairies, you have the power to reject phenomena by denying or undoing events in various forms. This power can be used for attack, defense, or healing (depending on the combination), and if used to its full capabilities, can rival gods.

The spirits are separate manifestations of your own soul, each with its own unique appearance and personality.

Two spirits (Ayame and Shun'ō) are in charge of healing. They surround something to return it to its former, complete state, by rejecting, reversing, and reconstructing phenomena that have occurred, even phenomena that you haven't witnessed. You can even fully resurrect the dead with this.

The other three spirits (Hinagiku, Baigon, and Lily) are in charge of defense, by placing a shield of any size between the enemy and target that can repel all forms of attacks. This shield is impenetrable because of its event rejection nature.

The last spirit, Tsubaki, is in charge of offense. It can cut through anything, by rejecting the fusion of something and repelling it, splitting it in two.

You can also combine the offensive and defensive spirits together, to create a shield that can disperse the incoming attack, and then reflect it back at full force towards the assailant. The full extent of this power can only be explored by you.

These spirits exhibit unwavering loyalty solely to you, dedicating themselves to serving you to the best of their abilities. When subjected to damage, the fairies can transform back into their hairpin form, undergoing passive regeneration with a maximum recovery time of 24 hours.

As long as your soul endures, the hairpins remains indestructible.
objects.title: Shun Shun Rikka (Bleach)

addons.text:
Your unique nature as the perfect hybrid of all five races already makes you the closest being to the Soul King, Adnyeus—even more so than his son, Yhwach. Moreover, hosting one of the Soul King’s complete body parts has triggered a profound evolution within you, gradually transforming your body into that of the Soul King himself.

Regardless of which body part you begin with, your corresponding body part will evolve, eventually acquiring the same abilities as the Soul King. For example, if you choose Mimihagi, the right arm that governs stagnation, your left arm will, over time, evolve to gain the abilities of Pernida, the left arm that governs progress. Similarly, your heart will develop the power of Gerad, who wields the ability of miracles, and so on.

This continuous evolution allows your power to grow with each passing day even without training or practice. Within approximately one year of passive growth, your strength will rival the Soul King in his prime, granting you all of his abilities. Even after reaching that level, your passive growth will not cease; though at a reduced rate, your body and soul will continue to evolve, becoming even stronger.
addons.title: Adnyeus

objects.text:
You're a human—a hybrid of a Shinigami, Hollow, Quincy and Fullbringer.

Within you is unlimited potential. You're able to become a War Factor, achieve what is seen as impossible and always come back up from the brink of defeat. You start with the power level of a 6th Seat Lieutenant Shinigami. You're capable of achieving the level of a Captain in a fraction of the time it would take for someone else and go much beyond when motivated enough. You also gain Zangetsu as an alternative release.

If you were motivated enough, you could come back even if you're at the brink of death, and strong enough to defeat whatever or whoever was able to defeat you.

You could even substitute the Soul King himself if the conditions were right.
objects.title: Ichigo Kurosaki (Bleach)

objects.text: The favor of Hell is a hard thing to gain, but yet, you seem to have managed what most would consider impossible. Hell has bestowed its power upon you. However it came to be, the sinful light of Hell has gathered around your body to form into an armor made to look like bones. Unlike Ichigo, you have the opportunity to choose how this armor forms around you, and how much of you it covers. It could be anything—from total coverage of your body, to something as small as a single ring. Either way, you still gain all the powers and abilities of this armor. This armor represents the invested might of Hell, and thus, your own authority within that realm. The most obvious result is an increase in Spiritual Power, as Hell pours spiritual energy usurped from its prisoners into you, allowing you to fight without fear of draining your reserves. More interesting are the abilities over Hell you now have access to. You can freely travel to and from Hell, summoning its infamous Gates to enter and then exit again anywhere this realm has reach. You can both create and command the chains of hell as well as summon the legendary guardians of Hell, the dreaded Kushanada. The chains are near unbreakable even to Captain-level opponents and can bind the spiritual energy of others, or curse them to be dragged down into Hell if the Gate is active. The Kushanada are gigantic gorilla-esque demon-like creatures who guard Hell and torment its prisoners, each one more than a match for any Vice-Captain Shinigami. The permanent of power you have received also gives you the same immortality as the Togabito, slowly reforming in Hell if you are ever killed. Unless your soul is completely destroyed, you will reappear in a few days in the depths of Hell. You’ll retain access to this version of Hell no matter which world you reside in, and can attempt to claim similar control over other Hells—If you can convince their guards to invest their power within you or conquer them yourself, at least. Note: You can use Hell to travel between Worlds, but only to worlds you’ve already travelled to.
objects.title: Skull Clad (Bleach)

objects.text:
Your Soul Energy is now able to replicate other supernatural energies through your Soul Arts. This replication requires both enough exposure and understanding of the energy you wish to imitate. 

In addition to this newfound replication capacity, your ability to manipulate your Soul Energy is prodigious. This instinctual level of manipulation allows you to create new Soul Arts with ease, and enables incredible control over the fine details of each individual Art. 

Soul Arts can individually develop further applications as you gain more experience and put more Soul Energy into them. 

All of your Soul Arts improve as you make history and break new ground with their use, additionally, all Soul Arts are now self-correcting, fixing imperfections in their foundations and removing inefficiencies even while not in use.
objects.title: Adaptive Spark

objects.text:
Your Soul can light a Spark inside of other individuals. This Spark grants them the potential to Ignite their Soul. Understand that just because you are able to grant an individual the potential to Ignite, they are not guaranteed to. 

If left to their own devices, most individuals will be unable to comprehend what it means to break down all that you are and Ignite your Soul from the remnants. Through your help, almost anyone will be able to go through the Ignition process. 

For every successful Ignition, you receive a Soul Trait, these Traits will give an active and passive ability that is individualized for every being that has been through a successful Ignition as a result of your Spark. 

Every time you help a Soul through a successful Ignition, you gain a new fount of Soul Energy that grows alongside the main production of your Soul.
objects.title: Soul Successor

objects.text:
No longer are you condensing your Soul into a mere weapon. You are able to partially manifest your Ignited Soul itself onto reality, taking on whatever appearance you wish. 

Your Manifestation is able to be separated from you for an indefinite duration, although you are able to recall it at will. 

This Manifestation holds the crystallized benefits of all of your accomplishments inside of it. Defeating challenging or unique beings, slaying numerous enemies of a type, repeating signature Soul Art, all of these are ways you can both unlock new abilities and increase the one you have.

 Your Manifestation has the same unlimited potential for growth that your Soul, additionally, your Manifestation will never lag behind your maximum power. 

With enough practice you will be able to manifest enough of your Soul to temporarily replace a small portion of reality with your Soul, allowing you to use your Soul Arts to affect reality at a much larger scale.
objects.title: Soul Manifestation

objects.text:
Your ability to infuse your body with your body will your Soul Energy has both increased by a magnitude and qualitatively improved. Soul Energy can now be condensed at-will into a set of Soul Armor that scales with you in all ways. 

This Armor has an innate adaptive defense, growing increasingly resistant to all forms of damage as it experiences them. 

This resistance will grow into an immunity once you achieve enough Soul Feats for surviving a specific form of damage. Soul Arts of the physical realm come to you naturally, taking dozens of steps at once, diverting rivers with the slice of a hand, molding magma with your bare hands, all of these Arts and many many more can be created with ease. 

Manipulating your own momentum, density, weight, and size can be done, allowing you to become either the immovable object, the unstoppable force, or even both at the same time, regardless of how much of a paradox it might be.
objects.title: Incarnation Armament

objects.text:
Your Immortal Soul has been ignited, making it absolutely and completely immortal. Nothing is able to damage, manipulate, drain, or copy your Soul, as it will always regenerate to its peak condition. 

Your body and mind are merely your Soul being physically projected onto reality, allowing you to change your appearance, age, race, and all other physical attributes at will. 

The amount of Soul Energy you produce every moment is astounding, at no point will you ever have to worry about truly running out of energy. 

The difficulty required for your feats to grant you abilities has been lowered tremendously, and every feat is now guaranteed to grant you both an active and passive ability.
objects.title: Immortal Ignition

objects.text:
Archangels are primordial angels that existed long before the creation of the Universe itself. They are the highest celestial beings, second only to the Primordials, and are regarded as Heaven's most fearsome wrath. The mere presence of an Archangel on Earth without a vessel can cause minor tremors, blackout the entire Eastern Seaboard, and generate strong winds and heavy rainstorms.

Being possessed by an Archangel is psychologically an Spiritually damaging to a human; some have been left in a drooling, catatonic state after possession or experienced complete breakdowns. While you don't have to worry about this since your body is your true vessel, if you choose to use someone else as a "Meatsuit," you should be aware of the consequences they may face if you don't fix them upon leaving.

All your abilities and powers, both physical and spiritual as a Seraphim, have been massively enhanced, granting you greater access to angelic abilities.

Archangels are said to possess lower-tier nigh-omnipotence. They have a tremendous and nearly unlimited power supply, known as Archangel's Grace (which is vastly more powerful and potent than an angel's grace), allowing them to accomplish almost anything they desire with a few exceptions. Examples of their power include killing lesser beings with a snap of their fingers, hand waves, or focusing their power through their eyes to cause the combustion of molecules (making them go up in flames from the inside out) or freezing them (turning them into a solid block of ice by stopping molecular movement). Gabriel can create objects out of thin air or create multiple universes based on TV shows to manipulate the Winchesters. Other abilities include Lucifer turning human souls into demons, Michael sending two humans back in time with a single touch, obliterating targets with holy energy (which can be controlled and concentrated), granting powers such as immunity to seraphic smiting or super strength, flawless resurrection and healing, near-omniscience and awareness of the universe, sensing events across time and space (including reality warping and timeline changes), energy blasts, flight, exorcism, thermokinesis, shapeshifting, clairsentience, limited precognition, power nullification, lie detection, the list goes on but it's for you to discover.

Archangels are mostly immune to the weaknesses of angels. Angel blades can only harm them, Holy Fire causes pain but is not fatal, and the Colt, which is said to kill anything, only inflicts pain. Enochian sigils have weakened effects on them.

The few remaining threats to Archangels include Archangel Blades when wielded by other Archangels, having their Grace taken (although it will regenerate over time if taken), a Ma'lak Box, and higher-level beings such as God and The Darkness.

Your angel blade and sword have been upgraded into personal Archangel Variants capable of killing an Archangel or Nephilim like Jack Kline, while keeping the vessel unharmed.

Note: As an Archangel, you can now dial back your senses to enjoy food and drink as humans do once again.
objects.title: Archangel (Supernatural)

addons.text:
Your Angel parent wasn't something as common as a Seraphim. No, they were an Archangel, one of "Heaven's Deadliest Playlist," making you potentially one of the most powerful beings in existence in time.

The mixture of Archangel Grace and your Human Soul has pushed all your abilities, powers, physical and spiritual, beyond any individual Archangel. As you grow older, you will surpass the power of all of them combined. As of right now, you are capable of feats such as awakening an Angel sleeping in the Empty (located outside of creation) from inside creation, creating your own angel with practice, casually granting someone the power to defeat a Prince of Hell, weakening or nullifying the power of those weaker than you.

You can also sense other universes and open portals to them, allowing you to travel the Multiverse. With time, practice, and power, you will be able to teleport to them without the need for portals. As you grow, the ability to traverse the whole Omniverse will open to you.

Being the Nephilim of an Archangel has also made you immune to almost all weaknesses of Angels, including most of the weaknesses of Archangels. As of right now, unlike Archangels, your power can no longer be contained by Lucifer's Cage or the Ma'lak box if you don't wish. However, an Archangel Blade can still harm and kill you, and Enochian Warding will still be able to trap or depower you. But as you grow in power, even these weaknesses will leave you.

Someday, you will be able to reach the level of Primordials such as God, The Darkness, Death, and The Empty (centuries on its own, and decades with perks).
addons.title: Spawn of an Archangel

objects.text:
Instead of just being an Angel, you are a Nephilim, a being that is half-angel and half-human. While most would think that this would make you weaker than your Seraphim parent, it is actually the opposite case. This is because as a Nephilim, you were born with both Angelic Grace and a Human Soul. The combination of these two sources is like adding nitrous and a supercharger to a car. The human soul supercharges the Angelic Grace, making a Nephilim eventually become more powerful than the angel that sired them. Since you are half-human, you do not need a vessel to interact with the physical world; you were already born into yours.

As a Nephilim, you have inherited all the powers of your Seraphim parent, and the soul you inherited from your human parent has enhanced all your abilities far beyond those of multiple Seraphim combined, though still below an Archangel. With time (10 years), your Grace will reach the potency and power of an Archangel's Grace. You also have a few new abilities, such as life force draining and the ability to change your age as you wish.

Note that losing your Grace as a Nephilim is more dangerous than as an Angel because your Grace is what keeps your Angelic and Human sides in balance. The loss of it will cause both sides to fight each other, resulting in immense pain, sickness, weakness, and so on, until your Grace regenerates.
objects.title: Nephilim (Supernatural)

addons.title: Above the Sequence Syncretism
addons.text:
Much like Great Old Ones can assimilate other Sefirah in order to expand their Authority and Symbolism, you have acquired the Sefirah and Uniquenesses (if there are any) of the Above the Sequence of your secondary Pathway. 

This means that once you finish your Ascension you will possess the Authority and Symbolism of both of your Above the Sequence groups, fused into a single whole which often sprouts new and more encompassing Authorities and Symbolism on par with a Pillar if they weren’t already one.

Additionally, your immunity to losing your sanity through advancement or losing control of yourself and your powers has made you exempt from the normal limitation of Pillars being unable to accommodate more Sefirah due to losing control of their Convergence instinct. This allows you to accommodate an additional Sefirah even if you are already a Pillar.

objects.text:
You may now select another Pathway to start at Sequence 9. This maybe from any of the twenty-two standard Pathways from Earth or non-standard Pathways from the Outer Deities. 

As you progress through the Sequences, your abilities may begin to fuse, creating new powers that neither Pathway possessed before. 

You may decide how your second Pathway advances. It will then adapt to function with either the Potion system or the Boon system, depending on your choice, even if it was not originally compatible with that system.
objects.title: Dual Pathway Beyonder (Lord of The Mysteries)

objects.text:
You now have your Pathway's Uniqueness accommodated in your body, even at Sequence 9. 

Your Uniqueness is the only one that exists in all of existence, as it is the Authority of your Pathway condensed into a single object, no matter how hard someone may try, there is no way to duplicate, steal, delete, or modify your Uniqueness without your permission. 

Having your Uniqueness accommodated, even at Sequence 9, qualitatively improves every single of your Sequence, from your pathway abilities, magic spells, mystic rituals, to even your growth rate due to the Partial Authority over your Pathway that you possess. 

Your growth will not have any soft-caps or barriers for you to experience, as you are now incredibly in tune with your Pathway, allowing you to advance much easier.
objects.title: Uniqueness (Lord of The Mysteries)

objects.text:
You have a Sefirot befitting of your Pathway’s own Above the Sequence, the nine Sefirot are: Sefirah Castle, Chaos Sea, River of Eternal Darkness, City of Calamity, Brood Hive, Nation of Disorder, Tenebrous World, Knowledge Moor, and Key of Light. 

This Sefirot grants you access to the other Pathways that make up your Above The Sequence combination. You are optionally able to meld your multiple Pathways into a single multi-faceted Pathway. 

The Mythical Creature forms you will eventually gain access to will not drive you insane, you will be able to shift into each individual form at-will or a form that is a combination of all Mythical Creatures. 

You have no need for anchors any more, regardless if you are at a Sequence when you need them or not, you will not be driven insane by the changes you will undergo as you raise your Sequence.
objects.title: Sefirot (Lord of The Mysteries)

objects.text:
You now have accommodated the other Uniquenesses of the Pathways that make up your Above The Sequence. These Uniquenesses grant you compounding benefits on top of the ones you received for accommodating a single Uniqueness. 

Holding all of the required Uniquenesses for your Pathways (or Pathway if you chose to condense them) grant you near-unlimited amount of Spirituality, allowing you to use your Beyonder abilities almost constantly, mystic spells and rituals with ease, and obtain a Mythical Creature form of your choice even at Sequence 9. 

Additionally, you have an innate resistance to mystic spells, rituals, and other beyonder abilities, reducing their effectiveness to near nothing as long as the source of the effect is not entirely outclassing you. 

Even a God would require more effort to effect you than ‘They’ would otherwise require.
objects.title: Additional Uniquenesses (Lord of The Mysteries)

objects.text: By taking advantage of the Interface’s ability to substitute for a God and combining the different Beyonder methods, you have gained the ability to become a version of a Dao Integrator, modified to take advantage of the characteristics of Boons. Boons and Daoism are two different but highly similar alternatives to Beyonder Characteristics, the standard method, for becoming a Beyonder. Boons are granted to the recipient from one of various Gods to ascend the sequences on their chosen Pathway. Boons can only ascend the user up to Sequence 1 on their selected Pathway due to the God in question. Boons are known to be dangerous due to the conflicting will of the God in within and how it modifies the user in the image of said God. They can, however, be made to synergize with Beyonder Characteristics for stability and can even be “stolen” using rituals from certain Pathways. Daoism is similar to Boons, but instead of praying to a God, the user instead prays directly to one of the Sefirot. While more stable than Boons, it has the unfortunate side effect of slowly fusing Dao Integrators with the Sefirot itself, leaving them functionally dead once they reach “The Unity of Heaven and Man” due to their mind being consumed by the Sefirot. This does come with some benefits, as it allows for high sequence Dao Integrators to potentially be stronger than a God if they fight without regards for their own well-being. Through the Interface, you can take the best parts of each of these methods. In exchange for spirituality, the Interface can now give you a “pre-stolen Boon” from one of the Sefirot. These Boons will not only have the stability and power from Daoism, but by using their modifying characteristic, you will be slowly transformed into a living version of your chosen Sefirot as you ascend the Sequence. These Boons will also synergize with Beyonder Characteristics, granting you more power than either would individually. Each subsequent Boon in a Pathway will require you to spend more spirituality than the last. When you finally have all Sequence 1 Beyonder Characteristics and Boons, you can then enact a ritual that will complete your transformation, skipping over Sequence 0 and transforming you into a Quasi Great Old One. The nine Sefirot you could transform yourself into are: Sefirah Castle, Chaos Sea, River of Eternal Darkness, City of Calamity, Brood Hive, Nation of Disorder, Tenebrous World, Knowledge Moor, and Key of Light. While stronger than a standard Sequence 0 and technically Above the Sequence, this transformation is incomplete due to your lack of Uniqueness. The Interface cannot manifest Uniqueness due to its nature, requiring you to buy Uniqueness from the CYOA or obtain one native to the world of LOTM. Surprisingly, the nature of the Interface allows you to follow through on this process with not just the nine Sefirot. You can also be transformed into one of the currently unnamed Sefirot for the 10 Non-Standard Pathways of the Outer Deities. The names of the Outer Deities are: Circle of Inevitability, Mother Goddess of Depravity, Mother Tree of Desire, Son of Chaos, Primordial Hunger, Supernova Dominator, Inextinguishable Ravings, Monarch of Decay, High-Dimensional Overseer, and Goddess of Fate. It is possible to follow in the footsteps of the Outer Deities and absorb more Sefirot to expand your power, but it must include a Pathway that is neighboring one of your own. Pathways are neighboring if they possess similar or complementary symbolisms and authorities. All nine Above the Sequence groups on Earth are considered not neighboring each other except for the Eternal Darkness group and Calamity of Destruction Group. The Interface’s ability to discover new paths has also been upgraded to allow you to become a brand new Sefirot for Pathways not native to the world of LOTM. This includes the 6 known Pathways of the world of Dorothy’s Forbidden Grimoire. How far you can develop said transformations will depend on the stability of their symbolisms and authorities. It could potentially require 5 or more Pathways to assemble like with Chaos Sea or be able to stand alone like Key of Light.
objects.title: Sefirot Integration Interface

objects.text: "To parasitize... to not parasitize..." Your informational connections and ability to create vessels have merged into something truly terrifying. Firstly, your informational awareness is far greater than previously. When others attempt to imitate you in any way, such as repeating an action you often perform or wearing an object that you enjoy, you can utilize the distortions in fate to detect the attempt, and, if you wish, seamlessly parasitize them. This only works for "signature" actions, so something like waving your hand or talking wouldn't work while something like putting on a monocle or mentioning a catchphrase would. This awareness also extends to objects with your likeness, such as statues or paintings. Secondly, your parasitizing has improved in both strength and scope. You can now parasitize non-human creatures, from elephants all the way to individual microbes. Furthermore, you can choose to partially parasitize individuals, which won't use up a vessel slot but still allow you to affect them. For example, someone lightly parasitized would subconsciously avoid matters relating to you. On the other hand, you could completely read the mind and even remove thoughts of someone heavily parasitized. Finally, you and your reflections also have a pool of power to bestow onto your vessels. This can give vessels weaker version of your powers. If you bestow your entire pool onto a single vessel, they will be of around equal strength to a reflection. However, your most fearsome ability is to transfer power across vessels and reflections completely at will. You can swap positions of any two vessels, strengthen one vessel while weakening another, or turn a vessel into the main body or reflection by transferring power, immediately making it gain your appearance. You can manifest a reflective crystal monocle on the right eye of any vessel.
objects.title: Monocle Man

objects.text:
Your reflections and pawns are now one and the same. Your pawns are converted into 3 starting reflections each having abilities in an area of your choice. When you create a new reflection, you can give them a specialty that they will develop toward. This doesn't have to be limited to combat, you can have an "Administrator" just as easily as an "Assassin." 

If a reflection dies and you gather enough souls, you bring back the old reflection instead of creating a new one. This essentially preserves their progress and specialty. Your main body gains all the specialties and powers of your reflections, but they do not share these with each other. This includes dead reflections. Every time a reflection grows, you do so as well. 

Despite the increased connection to your main body, damaging you through your vessels and reflections is still as futile as attacking the image of the moon on a lake.
objects.title: Mirror Demon

objects.text:
You are skilled in the forbidden art of creating marionettes. You can apply spiritual "threads" on a target, gradually turning them under your control. These are not actual threads, but represent your control over the souls of others. You can attempt to create a marionette out of anyone within your soul sight radius. You have direct control over your marionettes in a hivemind.

The process of enforcing your control on a soul gradually turns their thoughts sluggish and makes it difficult to move, until they cannot do so at all. The time it takes to create a marionette depends on the relative strength of your soul compared to theirs. You can easily usurp an ordinary civilian's soul with a thought, but an equal soul to yours is nearly impossible to control. You can still "attempt" to turn them into a marionette, which will lower their thinking speed. 

A marionette is an extension of yourself present at a different location and thus can transform between their original appearance and your own at will. They keep all of their old powers assuming they are not from an external source like a divine pact or eldritch contract. Marionettes also have weaker versions of your non-physical powers, the degree to which depends on their original strength. Your sensory and soul-based powers are always at full strength. Furthermore, they gain a minor physical boost in all areas and have no vital organs or physical needs since they are technically "dead." Marionettes are completely indistinguishable from their original even to others with soul sight.
objects.title: Spirit Body Threads

objects.text: The Grace of the Erdtree has converged within you, granting you mastery over ancient necromantic arts and the divine blessings of the Elden Ring. Through this power, you gain the unique ability to commune with the spirits of deceased who have yet to pass, harnessing their lingering essence in the form of Spirit Ashes, or inheriting their might through Ashes of War. Spirit Ashes allow you to summon spectral companions that heed your call, offering their aid and support as you traverse to your fate and destiny.
objects.title: Will of The Fallen (Elden Ring)

addons.text:
You have ascended to a power once held by Miquella the Kind at the zenith of his divinity. His grace now flows through you, imbuing you with a blend of strength and influence, though your might lies not in physical prowess, but in the realm of miracles and persuasion.

First, your affinity for Miracles is boundless. The radiance of Miquella shines within you, and invoking the divine is second nature. You can call forth blasts of blinding light with ease, unleashing waves of celestial power as if it were but a whisper on the wind. Your connection to the divine forces around you allows you to perform feats once thought impossible, making the miraculous a part of your very being. This also extends to the creation of powerful magical items and new forms of life like the Haligtree.

Second, you inherit Miquella’s ability to inspire unwavering affection and loyalty in those around you. With but a glance or a word, you can compel others to feel a deep, unconditional love for you. This power does not bend their wills into blind devotion, but instead, it fosters a bond of genuine connection—allowing you to sway hearts and minds with great subtlety. You are the architect of these affections, ensuring that those who follow you do so willingly, without descending into fanaticism.

Finally, you are gifted with the mysterious power of Saint Trina—the ability to weave eternal slumber. With this, you can send even the most powerful of beings into a peaceful, unending rest. Whether a foe too great to defeat in battle or a threat too elusive to confront, you can choose to still their existence, ensuring that they remain dormant for eternity. This ability is as much a mercy as it is a weapon, for those you put to sleep are beyond the reach of death but will never again awaken without your permission.

In all, you wield the power of Miquella the Kind—a being who sought to bring solace and growth to a broken world, and now, that power is yours to command.
addons.title: The Unalloyed

objects.text:
As you grow stronger, you have shown yourself worthy to walk the path of godhood, & the Grace Of the Erdtree serves as your key to unlocking this ultimate power.

You've become a Demigod & the blood of divinity courses through your veins, multiplying your innate potential beyond imagination & enhancing every aspect of your mind, body, & soul a hundredfold.

Within the mortal realms, Empyreans & mortal beings subject themselves to the basest indignities on their quests to attain godhood. However, you do not need to struggle to get where you already are. You are a mighty and versatile God who wields authority over concepts like 'Order,' 'Causality,' or 'Regression,' & you can manifest miracles that compel the reverence of believers.
objects.title: Rise of The Elden Lord (Elden Ring)

objects.text:
You have acquired the Primordial Rune of Night, a potent relic from an alternate version of the Lands Between. It grants dominion over the reality-warping phenomenon known as the Night.

Your power is great enough to single-handedly overthrow the Golden Lineage, with even legendary figures such as Radahn and Malenia falling before your might. The Night itself can corrupt the minds of others, binding them to your cause while greatly enhancing their strength. As it spreads, reality begins to erode, allowing locations, creatures, and even entire civilizations from distant eras—or entirely different universes—to manifest within your domain.

Combined with your overwhelming physical prowess, this power enables impossible feats, such as cleaving through dimensional space itself. You also possess extraordinary talent for sorcery, capable of passively casting spells rivaling the might of Founding Rain of Stars. In battle, you can imprison opponents within a pocket dimension where they must defeat you to escape, while the realm itself grants you physical and magical advantages tailored to your preferred fighting style.

Your greatest power, however, lies in your ability to create Lords of Night. Each Lord serves as both a champion and an extension of your will, accelerating the spread of the Night. What a single Lord could accomplish in a month, eight could achieve in a single day. You may also draw upon the strength of your Lords directly. From the moment you obtain this Rune, all of the game’s Lords of Night—excluding the Balancers—are bound to your service, granting you mastery over holy light, fire, ice, poison, lightning, sleep, Scarlet Rot, and Libra’s madness-inducing alchemy.
objects.title: Night Aspect (Elden Ring: Nightreign)

objects.text:
By taking this upgrade, you gain control over the Lands Between. The Lands Between consists of many regions, both above ground and underground. It will now exist within a pocket dimension that you can enter or exit at will simply by thinking about it.

You can materialize the Lands Between outside of its pocket dimension and into the world, causing the entire land to appear fully formed without causing any damage to the surrounding area. You can just as easily return the Lands Between to its pocket dimension whenever you desire. You will also be able to create Sites of Grace at whatever place you want.

The Lands Between you gain is not the war-torn land you remember, but the land as it existed before the Shattering. Both its surface and underground regions have been fully restored, including their castles, settlements, landscapes, and other structures. Curses such as Scarlet Rot and others have also been completely eradicated.

Its people have also been restored, and the Lands Between is once again inhabited by many different races, including Humans, Numens, Beastmen, Misbegotten, Ancient Dragons, Omens, Demi-Humans, Demigods, and more.

This also includes many of the NPCs and Demigods, such as Starscourge Radahn, Messmer the Impaler, Rennala Queen of the Full Moon, Ancient Dragon Lansseax, and more. However, any Shardbearers will be weakened from their previous states, as they will no longer have Great Runes. No Empyreans or Gods will be included among those restored or brought to your Lands Between.

As the god and ruler of these lands, their inhabitants will generally be loyal to you, though their loyalty can change depending on how you treat them. The inhebitants of your lands are no longer immortal.

Fortunately, no other Outer Gods will be aware of your Lands Between, nor will they have any influence on it. As the ruler of the Lands Between, you are able to grant the Grace of the Erdtree to anyone you wish or take it away, turning them into Tarnished.
objects.title: The Lands Between (Elden Ring)

objects.text:
"Oh mighty deity, show no mercy to the unrequited, and let your scarlet decay them all."

Wings of flowers and butterflies sprout from your back, rot and decay personified, the Scarlet Rot within you has bloomed.

Your control over Rot is now perfected, allowing you to unleash its full might in a metamorphic transformation. You can trigger this transformation at will, causing flower-like petals to bloom around you, resulting in an explosion of Rot that consumes everything in its vicinity.

In this deity form, your clothes decay, leaving only your sword (Only if it's made out of gold bathed in your blood) and flesh unharmed. But what you lose in fabric, you gain in unimaginable power capable of slaying the very gods themselves. Your physical prowess is amplified a hundredfold, and your life-siphoning abilities can fully heal you with but a scratch. Poisonous decay accompanies your every move, as you can conjure and manifest the Scarlet Rot with a mere thought, and if it lands, it will instantly consume everything. You can even shape the Rot into physical constructs impervious to all forms of damage. If you allow it to be, the radius of your Rot can easily and swiftly cover an entire continental landmass, mutating and decaying everything in its wake, you will find that even the very earth itself will be twisted in its image.

This form is extremely potent. Without caution, it will not discriminate between consuming friends or foes. You can revert to your normal form at any time, but overusing your deity form can lead to mental and physical fatigue. You can also extract Rot from within a living being if they have been infected, but only if the Rot hasn't reached their soul.
objects.title: Goddess Of Rot (Elden Ring)

objects.text:
You’ve unlocked a unique state—a heightened mode where you channel every ounce of your physical prowess into an explosive burst, amplifying your swordsmanship by hundreds of times.

This state lasts for only 10 seconds and can’t be activated again for another 60 seconds, but during those moments, your skills with the sword reach staggering new heights.
