For instance, if you could previously deliver a hundred sword strikes in a second, entering this state would allow you to unleash a thousand in the same span. 

This technique mainly works due to your divine talent with bladed weapons; as such, it can only function with blades/swords, and no other martial weapon would deliver the same effectiveness.

Additionally, your life force siphoning is drastically enhanced during this state. While a shallow cut might have only partially healed a deep wound before, in this state, even the most grievous injuries are restored completely with a single strike.
objects.title: Waterfowl Dance (Elden Ring)

addons.text: As the Ultimate Lifeform, the apex of all living beings, your mastery over your Stand has evolved to unprecedented heights, reaching a level no one has ever achieved. This newfound power, known as Heaven Ascension, grants you access to every single stand from JJBA, including "The World Over Heaven", "Made in Heaven", and even Stands from alternative universes like JORGE JOESTAR, alongside making all your Stands reach their Ultimate versions, significantly enhancing their abilities. As The Ultimate Lifeform, you can now effortlessly transform your Stand into its Requiem mode whenever you desire, and maintain this state for as long as you wish. Moreover, combining Stands has become much easier, allowing you to merge more Stands and their powers seamlessly. Not only that, you've gained the ability to create entirely new Stands over time, including new variations of stand types like Wounds, Bounds, and Beyonds. Even more astonishingly, you can now bestow Stands upon others simply by touching them. Your power of "Understanding" has been greatly enhanced, enabling you to instantly comprehend and master even the most foreign or esoteric concepts effortlessly. With a single glance, even the most unique or rare abilities can be comprehended by you now.
addons.title: Heaven Ascension
It Just Works
addons.text: Thanks to the impossible nature of To Stand Over Heaven, any inconsistencies in a Stand's abilities remain intact even after you acknowledge them. Additionally, you can create abilities that flat-out contradict established limits and mechanics of a Stand. For example, you can attack during King Crimson's time erasure, guide Soft & Wet's Go Beyond bubbles directly to targets, safely control uncontrollable stands like Cheap Trick or Milagro Man, and manifest evolved Stand’s abilities for Echo or Killer Queen.

addons.title: [ACT: Over Heaven]
addons.text:
Normally, Stands accessed through To Stand Over Heaven are limited by their baseline stats. Outside of Stand Combination and Requiem, the vast majority of your Stands remain static—unable to grow or unlock new abilities.

Until now.

Every single Stand within To Stand Over Heaven can now evolve, becoming something new—something even better. Their base power will be considered their ACT 1, with each subsequent ACT driving its stats and abilities to untold heights. And if you unlock an ACT with one Stand, every single Stand you have will also gain a similar ACT, with abilities tailored to that Stand’s power.

Through Stand Combination, you can now cross-fuse different Stand ACTs together, granting an unprecedented number of Stand combinations. However, you must keep control and focus to prevent the Stand Combination from consuming you as the more Stands and the higher their ACTs is used for a combination, the harder it is to control.

Furthermore, Requiem forms possess their own distinct ACT progression, completely separate from their base Stand form and extraordinarily potent. And who knows how powerful the ACT forms for Made in Heaven and The World Over Heaven will be once you unlock them?

addons.title: Requiem Over Heaven
addons.text:
With Stand Requiem, you bypass the time and training required to unlock your Stands' Requiem forms, gaining the ability to access them at will. Infused with Requiem energy, your Stands' base powers and abilities become vastly more potent and allows them to now also target/effect the soul, allowing these stands to bypass a target’s durability and defense.

Now that your Stand is fully sentient, it automatically protects you and fulfills your wishes. It can instantly shift into whatever Stand is needed, defending you from threats and fighting by your side without requiring any input. While it possesses its own autonomy, it remains fully loyal to you, relinquishing full control to you whenever you command or desire it.

Once you gain the ability to wield multiple Stands simultaneously, each one shares this sentience and can act independently. However, just as with any Stand, any damage they receive is reflected back to you. The key difference is that wielding multiple Stands divides this damage proportionally: if you are wielding three Stands and one is completely destroyed, you will only suffer 1/3 of the damage. However, a Stand can change itself into an automatic Stand—like Wonder of U transforming into Black Sabbath—so that no damage will be reflected back to you.

And when you finally master Stand Combination and unlock The One Above Heaven, you are able to further boost its power by assuming its Requiem form: The One Above Heaven Requiem. By fusing multiple Stands and having an intense desire to complete a task or objective, a Requiem ability will be formed based on the Stands used for its creation. Just by using two Stands for this ability, its power will completely dwarf any recorded Requiem Stand ability like Gold Experience Requiem and Silver Chariot Requiem—and the more Stands used, the more powerful the custom Requiem ability will be.

And with the Stand’s sentience, it is able to handle the mental load of you using The One Above Heaven, preventing it from consuming you. However, keep in mind that this Requiem ability will be temporary after you defuse your Stand combination, and the more Stands you combine for this ability, the more energy and stamina is needed for the fusion and to handle the ability. With time and training, the strain and cost will slowly lessen.

addons.title: A Holy Corpse’s Blessing
addons.text:
The presence of the Saint Corpse Parts has triggered a new evolution in To Stand Over Heaven. Alongside Stand Combination and Requiem, the blessing of the Saint Corpse Part now serves as a third distinct path to power.

Every Stand now possesses the potential to unlock a power comparable to D4C Love Train. While Requiem manipulate the soul, this power control luck and misfortune, building directly upon a Stand's core theme and ability. Furthermore, thanks to the unique nature of To Stand Over Heaven, you are able to actively control the flow of fortune and calamity at will resulting from these powers as long as it adhere to Equivalent Exchange. Initially, these evolved powers can only be used temporarily. Through time and effort, you can gradually increase their duration and usage until they become permanent.

Upon mastering Stand Combination and unlocking The One Above Heaven, you will have the potential to completely bypass and shatter the law of Equivalent Exchange. This grants the ability to freely generate or erase infinite fortune and calamity, along with a custom ability of the combined themes of your fused Stands through The One Above Heaven. However, due to the immense energy and focus required, this power can initially only be used temporarily. Experience and time will gradually decrease its cost and strain. 

Purchasing additional Saint Corpse Parts will further boost the duration and raw power of these and all other abilities within To Stand Over Heaven. Collecting all nine Corpse Parts will instantly make the evolution permanent, unlocking its true, unforeseen potential.

The Saint’s Corpse Parts will whisper and guide you toward attaining Heaven, and obtaining both Made in Heaven and The World Over Heaven. Each additional Corpse Part you acquire makes achieving Heaven simpler and faster. Gathering 6 Saint Corpse Parts allows you to immediately unlock both Stands—mirroring the six steps Pucci took to attain Heaven. And who knows how powerful To Stand Over Heaven will be if you have all 9 Saint Corpse Parts.

objects.text: After rigorous training and unlocking the full potential of your Stand, you have achieved the extraordinary ability known as To Stand Over Heaven. With this upgrade, you can access any canon Stand from the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure universe, with the exceptions of The World Over Heaven and Made in Heaven. Initially, you can switch to any canon Stand, but you are limited to using one Stand at a time. As you progress and grow in power, you will gain the capability to wield multiple Stands simultaneously. This newfound proficiency allows you to combine a diverse array of Stand abilities, making you a more formidable force on the battlefield. The fusion of different Stand powers grants you unparalleled versatility, enabling you to adapt to any situation and overcome challenges. However, the ultimate pinnacle of your power lies in mastering Requiem and Stand Combination. With time and experience, you will acquire the ability to access the Requiem form of any Stand you are using temporarily, significantly enhancing its power and capabilities; however, through training, you will be able to use the Requiem form of any Stand permanently. And through Stand Combination, you can merge multiple Stands into one, amplifying their power and creating an awe-inspiring Stand known as The One Above Heaven. Nonetheless, attaining such extraordinary heights comes with great risks. The power of Stand Combination is a double-edged sword, and you must tread carefully to prevent being overwhelmed by the sheer force of this amalgamation. While The One Above Heaven grants you unparalleled might, it also demands immense control and focus to prevent the power from consuming you. To access The World Over Heaven and Made in Heaven, you will need to undergo specific rituals or go through intense training to unlock their potential.
objects.title: To Stand Over Heaven (JoJo's Bizarre Adventure)

objects.text:
Your Stand has been pierced by a Stand Arrow and has successfully undergone evolution into a Stand Requiem. As a Requiem, your Stand’s abilities become vastly more potent, and it grants you the ability to fly alongside it. Your Stand can also manipulate the souls of living beings, as Requiem is an energy that dominates living souls.

Your stand also receives a powerful ability born from an intense desire to accomplish something, such as Polnareff’s wish to prevent Diavolo from ever obtaining the Stand Arrow, or Giorno’s desire to defeat Diavolo and his King Crimson. The power your Stand acquires can be virtually anything, though it will always be far more powerful than what an ordinary Stand could possess. An example is Gold Experience Requiem, which can revert any action to “zero,” effectively undoing an opponent’s actions and triumphing over time erasure.

Your Stand also appears to gain a life of its own, becoming a materialized entity that can be physically interacted with and granted a degree of autonomy. It is capable of independent thought and may even speak with you if it chooses. Despite this autonomy, your Stand retains an inherent desire to protect you and share your morals and beliefs.
objects.title: Stand Requiem (JoJo's Bizarre Adventure)

objects.text:
Your Stand is no ordinary Stand; yours is one of evolution, growing in power with time. Your Stand will go through various forms called ACTs, each with new powers that are related but stronger than your original Stand ability.

Pushing yourself to your limits will increase your ability as a Stand User: a Stand that can create bombs with a touch, you could evolve into various types of bombs or even find new ways of producing bombs like using bubbles to increase the distance of your ability. You can always use any version of your Stand, reverting to a previous ACT at will.

Your Stand ability can also take inspiration from other abilities similar to itself to form a new ACT, increasing its growing abilities. Perhaps with enough time, your Stand ability could hope to match the power of a Requiem Stand, but that is far from today.
objects.title: [ACT: Evolutionary Stand] (JoJo's Bizarre Adventure)

objects.text:
You are the Hierophant, the only one who is capable of serving as the facilitator of communion between heaven and earth. You are not just the chosen champion of any single god or pantheon, but rather the chosen champion of faith and worship itself to herald in a new age of god.

Your ability to work divine magic is second to none, but the gods themselves and even lesser deities find it hard to compete with you due to your ability to effortlessly tap into the various authority, domains, and symbology of different gods and pantheons to work your magic. Over time, your mastery of divine power could grow to rival that of the chief god of the Renown Pantheon.

As faith and worship of the gods increase, so does the strength of their influence on the world. The gods are somewhat obligated to grant you what you ask for, but the greater the act you wish the gods to perform, the greater the required faith, worship, or specific conditions must be met.

As the Hierophant, you are not the slave of the gods but rather the mediator and reconciler between the divine realms and the mortal plane; thus, you can cut the connection between specific gods or pantheons from influencing the world if you choose to do so.
objects.title: The Hierophant

objects.text:
Your Guardian's overall power has surged, bringing forth four additional abilities, thus totaling ten unique powers.

Protector's Wrath: A 20-minute buff, with a 24-hour cooldown, multiplying all its stats by a factor of 5.

Scope of Dogma: Their eyes undergo a transformative change, granting them the ability to see a person's complete profile—from physical characteristics, abilities, skills, powers, and even their intentions or ulterior motives.

Prime Directive: With their deep connection to the concept of protection, your guardian can establish three rules that the target(s) must adhere to. Violating these rules incurs stackable benefits for your angel:

Rule 1: Do not harm the host. Breaking it boosts the Guardian Angel's overall power by 30%.
Rule 2: Do not harbor harmful ulterior motives towards the host. Breaking it debuffs the target's overall power by 30%.
Rule 3: Do not attempt to obstruct the Guardian Angel in protecting their host. Breaking it enables the Guardian Angel to enhance the power of one of their abilities by 50%.

These rules will still take effect, whether or not the target(s) are aware of them.

Infinite Impermanence: Leveraging their Scope of Dogma, the Guardian Angel can seal and negate a skill, ability, or power. The Guardian may unseal it whenever they see fit or if you tell them to.

Any harm directed towards your Guardian Angel is interpreted as harm directed towards their host. Consequently, they benefit from any abilities that utilize this connection, such as Prime Directive and Sword of Absolution. In the event of the host's demise, for a duration of 24 hours, the Guardian Angel will undergo a remarkable buff of 200% in every conceivable aspect.
objects.title: Sacred Guardian

addons.text:
The infusion of Mannoroth the Destructor's blood into your Guardian Angel has given rise to an unparalleled protector. They now consistently surpass you in every conceivable way by a factor of 150, with a notable augmentation to their overall passive growth.

All of their unique abilities have also undergone substantial growth, both in potency and breadth, making them even more formidable, for instance:

Protector's Wrath will enhance the Guardian Angel's overall stats by a factor of 50, extending the duration to 60 minutes, with a cooldown of 12 hours.

In the event of their death, the resurrection time has been significantly reduced. They only require a mere 12 hours, instead of the previous 24, to fully revive at their maximum capacity. In the event of the host's demise, for a duration of 24 hours, the Guardian Angel will undergo a remarkable buff of 600% in every conceivable aspect.
addons.title: Invincible Guardian

objects.text:
Your Guardian Angel further gains five abilities, bringing the total to fifteen.

Sacrificial Pawn: When either the host or the Guardian faces imminent death, another designated life form will perish in their place, no matter where they are. For this ability to take effect, the Guardian Angel must establish a pre-arranged agreement with the sacrificial life form, with full consent from them. There is no limit to the number of backup life forms this ability can have. The Guardian Angel can also use this on themselves.

Lover's Boon: In conjunction with Sacrificial Pawn, each sacrificed Pawn provides a stackable temporary 5% buff to the Guardian's overall power. This enhancement ceases when the sacrificed Pawn is replaced by another lifeform, or if they are resurrected.

Domain of Vigilance: They are now able to conjure an undetectable sphere with a radius spanning 500 meters, enveloping all sides. Within this ethereal domain, they attain heightened perception, becoming acutely aware of their surroundings and capable of reacting to any potentially harmful intent within a mere thousandth of a second. Those who venture into this sanctuary will also experience a gradual sluggishness in their movements, continually decreasing until it reaches a reduction of approximately 25%.

Armor of Absolution: The Guardian Angel can now conjure a full-body armor with aesthetics of the host's choosing. This armor doesn't impede the Guardian's maneuverability in any way and increases in durability proportionally to the damage incurred, while also boasting swift regeneration capabilities. Additionally, the armor offers complete protection against any harmful psychic or esoteric influences directed at the Guardian Angel, like mind control and internal telekinesis.

Final Stand: When all else has failed, your Guardian Angel possesses the ability to merge with you, metamorphosing into an immensely more potent entity that amplifies all their stats by a factor of 1000X. You retain the freedom to determine the overall appearance and aesthetic of this newfound form. However, exercise caution, as this transformation is a last-resort measure, lasting only one hour before a mandatory separation, with a subsequent cooldown period of one week, leaving you, the host, irreversibly bedridden during that duration.
objects.title: Divine Guardian

objects.text:
You embody light, life, and goodness in all it’s forms. Exquisite flowers bloom where you step and your light chases away evil, depression and all things commonly thought of as bad. You can see the sins of every living thing you can gaze at. 

Your halo evolves and no innocent can be harmed or hurt as long as its light reaches them, you can heal just about anything other than death away in the blink of an eye, and looking at you is now akin to a religious experience. 

You gain massive control and power over holy sun fire, spawning it and controlling it at will, choosing what and who it can hurt. Your presence is a balm to the soul chasing away depression and other such mental or spiritual afflictions of all that surround you, you gain an infinite lifespan as while you are still a mortal you now have more in common with other celestials such as angels than a normal human. 

You can every week resurrect one person fully and completely, but be very careful doing so, you might just take a soul out of heaven and their eternal paradise, and that is a very, very cruel thing to do. 

You can feel people that are in harms way and appear near them in order to help them, this feeling extends to about the size of New York city in a circle around you. You also gain a pair of functional angel wings. 

All these powers can be turned on and off at will or be dialed up and down as you please.

Your comprehension of the Celestial language also increases. The Words of Creation were fragments of the precursor of the Celestial language. This precursor language, known as Supernal, was said to be the tongue of the gods themselves. Able to be understood by any sentient mind. And now you know a few of those words, able to learn more with time.
objects.title: Of All That is Good

addons.text: You can form bonds with three different Eidolons. Their initial strength remains unchanged but they each specialize into one of the three roles: defense, offense, and support. As you overcome challenges together, your Eidolons will grow in strength alongside you. In addition to acting as conduits for your spell, they are also able to learn magic or other mystic arts that fits their specialization.
addons.title: The Real Triumvirate

objects.text: You can magically beckon a powerful being called an eidolon to your side, serving as the mortal conduit that anchors it to the world. Whether your eidolon is a friend, a servant, or even a personal god, your connection to it marks you as extraordinary, shaping the course of your life dramatically You can freely chose the form of your Eidolon, from a simple wolf to a dragon, and its strength will be comparable to 10 SP with of physical power. Thanks to the bond, you can share the senses of your Eidolon and vice-verse. Your Eidolon can also serve as a conduit for spellcasting for any magical discipline you have access to. It takes a few seconds to manifest or dismiss your Eidolon. Even when dismissed, you can communicate with your companion.
objects.title: The Real Eidolon (D&D/Pathfinder)

objects.text:
Consuming the fragment of divinity has elevated you to the status of a demigod with a divine rank of 1. Additionally, you are granted a portfolio that best suits you.

As a god, you now possess a wide range of powers and resistances. You are immortal and have significant resistance to any non-divine sources of damage. Non-magical attacks cannot harm you in any way, and even if you are killed, you can come back to life as long as you still have followers. Furthermore, you are completely immune to any abilities that could transform you against your will, reduce your capabilities, instantly kill you, or affect your mind.

With the slightest act of will, you can cast any spell of any level from the priest and wizard classes without any special requirements. You can also alter the spells you cast thanks to your control over magic, and you can grant your followers spells that do not exceed your own ability to cast.

You can instantly teleport to any point in the same plane of existence, secretly communicate with any of your followers, communicate with any being, sense what is happening around your followers or where people have spoken your name or title, and you have a godly realm of your own.

You can increase your divine rank and grow more powerful by gathering followers, though you will not lose power if you lack them. Your divine rank will always remain at its highest attained level.

Followers whose souls you care for after death will still contribute to your total number of followers, but at a reduced rate: it takes ten deceased followers to equal one living follower.
objects.title: Divine Rank (D&D)

objects.text:
Your mastery of cursed energy and cursed techniques has grown to astonishing heights, rivaling the potential or even surpassing that of the greatest sorcerers in the Jujutsu world. Like Yuta Okkotsu and Satoru Gojo, you've become a prodigy, one able to go from an ordinary civilian blind to curses, into a formidable fighter within mere scant weeks of training—capable of besting some of the most skilled sorcerers alive.

Furthermore, you possess an innate talent and intuitive grasp of all things tied to sorcery and curses. Creating entirely new techniques for your innate cursed technique comes naturally, as does devising inventive ways to expand its use—easily pioneering new branches of application once thought impossible. The world of curses lies bare before your eyes like an open book.

To add to all this, your reserve of cursed energy now rivals that of Yuta Okkotsu, a person said to have "boundless" cursed energy.
objects.title: I Alone Am The Honored One! (Jujutsu Kaisen)

objects.text: The amount of cursed energy a sorcerer has is something determined at birth. By default, you have a rather good talent for jujutsu, granting you a respectable reserve of cursed energy which will replenish itself. This is more than enough to stand on the same level as the majority of sorcerers, though there are a fair few who still dwarf you in the size of their reserves. However, your reserves grow deeper—vaster—with each purchase. With each depth your cursed energy reaches, the more it grows "creepy" and ominous, but you're free to toggle this aura on and off or even dial it back. The first purchase grants you reserves similar to the likes of Satoru Gojo. With this, the amount of cursed energy you have utterly dwarfs that of almost any other sorcerer. While most sorcerers would completely exhaust themselves pulling off one powerful technique, you could perform the exact same feat a good several times over and still have energy to spare. The second purchase means your levels of cursed energy is on par with Yuta Okkotsu, someone whose reserves exceed even that of Gojo’s by a significant margin. Although you can still run out of energy, it’d take you well and truly pushing yourself to even come close to that. Your cursed energy is such that it feels almost bottomless to people who could sense it. With the third purchase, you are a monster only seen once before in history, one equal in reserves to Ryomen Sukuna, the King of Curses. Your reserves are immense, far surpassing Special Grade sorcerers and curses alike. You could use Domain Expansion three times in a row, yet have your reserves merely lowered to the same level as Yuta's—it's still enough for you to cast Domain Expansion two more times, and possibly countless more. However, the fourth and final purchase takes this even further beyond. The amount of cursed energy you possess is now double that of the prior option. You know what this means, don't you? You are an anomaly among anomalies. An aberration in regards to cursed energy. The amount of cursed energy you now have is absolutely unprecedented, transcendent even. You are the closest to having truly bottomless cursed energy, coming second to Kinji Hakari with Jackpot; however, unlike him, you're unbound by a time limit, a condition, or a Domain's effects—no, what you have comes entirely from you and you alone. Note: If you've selected I Alone Am The Honored One! (Jujutsu Kaisen), Disaster Curse (Jujutsu Kaisen), Shrine's add-on King of Curses, and/or Cursed Energy Manipulation's add-on Negativity Flood, then your reserves here would scale accordingly the more powerful you are, acting like a multiplier increase.
objects.title: Cursed Energy Reserves (Jujutsu Kaisen)

objects.text:
Each purchase gives you one cursed technique, like the Ten Shadows or the Ratio technique, either shown in the manga/anime or personally created (Limitless excluded).

These techniques can only start at the level of a new sorcerer.
objects.title: Cursed Techniques (Jujutsu Kaisen)

objects.text:
A specialized form of cursed energy manipulation that possesses the unique ability to convert negative cursed energy into positive energy. Through this technique, the transformation of destructive energy into constructive energy is achieved by combining two sources of cursed energy, resulting in a multiplication effect. Thus, the energy that destroys becomes energy that creates, and negative energy becomes positive. 

The utilization of reverse cursed energy spans a wide range of applications, with its most prominent use being in healing. By harnessing this energy, one can achieve a complete restoration of severed limbs, mend deep bone injuries, or even resurrection from the brink of death, all within a span of seconds. Moreover, the versatility of this technique enables continuous, uninterrupted operation, granting you the capacity to employ it incessantly without limitations, if you have the reserve for it.

However, as this technique originates from the brain, a devastating blow that eradicates the brain entirely would result in fatality.
objects.title: Reverse Cursed Technique (Jujutsu Kaisen)

addons.text:
You have unlocked the ability to use the hypothetical Domain Expansion of Mahoraga, as if it were capable of wielding the technique itself.

This Domain Expansion represents the ultimate execution technique.

The domain’s function is simple: once activated, it manifests the most effective possible attack or phenomenon to neutralize the target.

The lethality of the domain depends on the extent of your prior adaptations.

Against an unfamiliar opponent—one whose abilities you have not yet fully analyzed—the domain will manifest the most probable method of defeating them based on your current understanding.

However, against an opponent you have already analyzed and adapted to, the domain becomes an unavoidable judgment. The manifested phenomenon will perfectly exploit every discovered weakness, producing an attack specifically engineered to eliminate the target instantly.

When used correctly, even anti-domain techniques or other Domain Expansions would be powerless before your own, as they would already be analyzed and countered by your domain.
addons.title: Domain Expansion: Heaven Judged and Earth Annihilated

objects.text:
You now possess the adaptive power of the Eight-Handled Sword Divergent Sila Divine General Mahoraga as a cursed technique.

With the incantation “Furube Yura Yura,” you activate the technique and summon the Wheel of Cycle and Harmony behind your back.

When you experience a phenomenon for the first time, the wheel will turn, signifying that the process of analysis and adaptation has begun. Once the adaptation is complete, you gain resistance to that phenomenon and the ability to counter it. Repeated exposure to the same phenomenon will expedite the adaptation process. You retain all adaptations you have gained, even when the technique is deactivated.

This process of analysis and adaptation never fully ceases. Even when faced with phenomena, attacks, or defenses that your adaptation has already overcome, the wheel will continue turning—constantly analyzing and adapting in pursuit of ever more effective ways to overcome the challenges you face.

The wheel also grants you the ability to fully regenerate each time it turns. As a result, the only reliable way to defeat you is to kill you instantly before you can adapt to the attack.

As this is a cursed technique, you also have the option to master it further and unlock its hidden potential, such as its Maximum Technique, Cursed Technique Reversal, and Domain Expansion.
objects.title: Mahoraga (Jujutsu Kaisen)

addons.text:
You can now fully employ a Domain Expansion that brings you and your targets inside the Limitless itself, a vast void of infinite knowledge.

Boundless raw information floods into your target's mind, overwhelming them to the point where they're completely immobilized. The complete incapacitation of the target is caused by a phenomenon where the target will be able to see and feel everything while not being able to see or feel anything at the same time. All the actions one has taken in their life are forced upon them infinitely and they can't do anything but die slowly.

This effect does not affect the user or anyone they're touching with no intent to harm. You need your Six Eyes to be fully uninhibited to employ this domain, but when activated, it's an almost-guaranteed win once it ensnares your target.
addons.title: Domain Expansion: Unlimited Void

objects.text:
An inherited technique that brings the concept of "Infinity" into reality, allowing you to manipulate and distort space at will. You are granted ordinance over three specific techniques that represent different facets of such distortion.

Infinity — The fundamental state of Limitless, enabling the ability to halt motion. By infinitely dividing the finite space between two objects, approaching entities slow down and never reach the user.

Blue — Amplifies cursed energy output, generating an attractive force. By bringing the conceptually impossible negative distance into reality, the surrounding space is compelled to fill the gap, resulting in a magnetic-like effect.

Red — Reverses the strengthened technique, manifesting the divergence of infinity and generating a repulsive force. By channeling reverse cursed energy into Limitless, a repelling effect is created instead of a magnetic one.

Combining these techniques unlocks advanced applications, leading to entirely new and more potent distortions beyond their individual capabilities. This also allows teleportation if you have enough mastery over your infinity. But unless you have an ability that lets you process information down to the atomic level, these techniques would forever be out of your grasp.
objects.title: Limitless (Jujutsu Kaisen)

addons.text:
You are truly the Honored One, King of Curses. 

In the area of Jujutsu, you have no peers.

Your control and handling of cursed energy is truly perfect, even better than a user of the Six Eyes. You have mastered each and every jujutsu ability the world has to offer—Simple Domains, Barriers, Shikigamis, and even newer techniques such as Falling Blossom Emotion and the New Shadow Style. Your ability to utilize and direct cursed energy is without equal, and you can cook up new techniques and abilities using cursed energy as easily as merely conceptualizing them. Though mastering and utilizing them efficiently is another matter, but not one you need to concern yourself with for long, as your talent at mastering anything curse-related is truly insane.

Lastly, your already unreal amount of cursed energy has skyrocketed and more than doubled from its previous level.
addons.title: King of Curses

addons.text: The ability to cut anything—truly anything—is now yours. Your comprehension of the Sanctioned Action and your innate technique have formed a truly monstrous power. Concepts, time, space, laws of reality, you can cut it all. Your Cleave and Dismantle has assimilated into one technique, Cut. Cut allows you to cut anything you can perceive or conceptualize. It has no travel time or physical form; what you attack with it is simply instantly cut in whichever way you want it to. The efficiency of Cut is so great that even if you continually use it for days on end, you still wouldn't run out of cursed energy, and that is with an average reserve of cursed energy.
addons.title: Ultimate Cut

objects.text:
The innate cursed technique of the King of Curses himself.

It has 3 functions: Cleave, Dismantle, and Divine Flame.

Dismantle is a ranged attack that you send out; the speed, size, and cutting power it has depend on the amount of cursed energy you use and your control over it, with greater control allowing you to choose which areas of the technique your cursed energy enhances. It is most effective against objects and entities that do not have cursed energy, but can be used to great effect against sorcerers and cursed spirits anyhow.

The second, Cleave is a cut that adjusts itself towards the target's durability and cursed energy level to cut it while wasting the least amount of energy, but still cutting them down in one fell swoop. Unless used in a Domain Expansion, you have to make physical contact with what you want Cleave to attack, making it a close-range attack.

The third, Divine Flame, is the ability to form an arrow of fire; this arrow can be shot out as though from a bow, making it a long-ranged attack; the temperature of this arrow is enough to burn to death even a Special Grade cursed spirit made from the fear of volcanoes, and other fire-related disasters themselves.
objects.title: Shrine (Jujutsu Kaisen)

addons.text: By combining reverse cursed energy with your Solo Forbidden Area, you can truly bless those within it. Gathering Hallowed Belt dampens and even purifies all cursed energy within it, weakening users of cursed energy and even exorcizing any cursed spirits, literally ripping them apart at the seams as the very energy that makes up their bodies is purified and they dissolve, their souls released from this mortal plane.
addons.title: Gathering Hallowed Belt

addons.text: You’ve done it, you’ve achieved Enlightenment—and with it, the true power of your cursed technique. Within your range, you have free control over all cursed energy, even ambient cursed energy or that of sorcerers and cursed spirits. You can absorb cursed energy to increase your own strength, or even permanently increase or decrease the cursed energy of someone; although the closer you bring them to your level, the harder it is to increase their strength further. With this, you could permanently cripple and remove someone’s ability to use cursed energy, stripping away every last drop of cursed energy from them and leaving them a perfectly mundane human for the rest of their life. Of course, there are some limitations. To permanently affect someone’s cursed energy, you either need to be at least 2 Grades stronger than them or dominate and have physical contact with them. Still, within your range, it would not be inaccurate to call you the God of cursed energy.
addons.title: Divine Enlightenment

addons.text: You have unlocked the Domain Expansion of Solo Forbidden Area, known as Bestowing Kagura. A world of sea and sky, this Domain Expansion takes the form of an endless plane of still water with a mist-like sky. At the center of the domain lies a single Torii Gate, contrasting with the setting sun. Within the domain, the range of your Solo Forbidden Area expands to cover the entire domain, and as an extension of the sure-hit effect, it cannot be resisted. If you possess Gathering Hallowed Belt, then it can be used through the domain instead of the normal Solo Forbidden Area, capable of instantly halting all cursed energy and exorcizing entire legions of cursed spirits with ease. If Gathering Hallowed Belt is used, the time of day is instead sunrise, and the sky opens with beams of sunlight. If you possess Divine Enlightenment, then Bestowing Kagura becomes an Open Domain. This means it is no longer bound by the need for an outer shell, with the only way to destroy it being to damage you to the point you can no longer sustain it.
addons.title: Bestowing Kagura

objects.text: You possess the cursed technique known as Solo Forbidden Area, which blesses those within it with increased power, bolstering their cursed energy by upwards of 120%. At least, that is the common understanding of it. You know the truth, however. Cursed Energy is powered by negative emotions, so how would a blessing—something intrinsically good—increase the cursed energy of something? It doesn’t, or rather what you do isn’t a blessing, but a curse. In practice, this knowledge doesn’t help you much on its own, merely giving a good direction for potential improvement or new applications. However, should this be combined with a Cursed Technique Reversal, well…
objects.title: Solo Forbidden Area (Jujutsu Kaisen)

objects.text: You have gained the same body as Ryomen Sukuna—the King of Curses and the Strongest in History. An additional pair of arms and eyes manifests just below your usual ones, and a large mouth opens on your abdomen. In response, your body begins to evolve, transcending the limits of humanity. You grow taller, faster, stronger—more. You acquire monstrous strength, capable of sending someone like Yuji Itadori flying through several skyscrapers without any supernatural energy reinforcement, as well as inhuman speed and agility that allow you to move across the battlefield as nothing more than a blur. Your durability and endurance skyrocket—you can withstand an onslaught from multiple Grade 1 sorcerers attacking with enough force to shatter concrete, and emerge with barely a scratch. Even a blow from a Special Grade cursed tool, capable of obliterating a limb of a Special Grade curse, might only excise a chunk of flesh. Your additional eyes enhance your perception, and your extra arms and mouths enable simultaneous chanting and hand signs. Despite having four arms, four eyes, and a second mouth, your body functions flawlessly. No matter how much you speak or chant using both mouths, your lungs remain perpetually unburdened. No matter how much additional information your four eyes process, your brain handles it effortlessly. These attributes can be increased even further with time, training, and supernatural energy reinforcement. Eventually, you may be hailed as The Strongest. Optionally, you may also obtain Sukuna's tattoos or your own unique tattoos.
objects.title: A Body Perfect For Jujutsu (Jujutsu Kaisen)

objects.text:
You did it… You really did it…
You are the very embodiment of Curses.

Your Cursed Energy is endless; its potency is godly—a single drop of your blood would spawn a curse that could fight both Gojo and Sukuna at the same time and find them wanting.

You don’t just possess the ability to create cursed techniques—you possess every cursed technique that exists, every cursed technique that ever will exist... and every cursed technique that should've never existed.

I hope you’re happy, Abomination… for your very existence is a blight upon the multiverse. You are an Entity made of Endless Curses instead of Crystalline Shards.

Perhaps even the Entities are naught but ants to your accursed might.
objects.title: The Merger (Jujutsu Kaisen)

addons.text: Whether or not you came to be due to Kenjaku's machinations, not even he could have planned this. You, who already had a superhuman body, combined with your tricked Heavenly Restriction, have been given power almost unrivaled. As a baseline, without any supernatural energies, your speed and strength now allow you to stand comfortably above even Special Grade sorcerers; with nothing but brute force, you're capable of overwhelming Ryomen Sukuna at his peak, putting him on the ropes as Toji Fushiguro did to Suguru Geto. Your healing factor has improved to the point where you can regenerate your limbs and organs from amputation or lethal damage in just a few days, and your senses have sharpened to the point of giving you the ability to read the minuscule micro-movements of your opponents, granting you a pseudo-precognition akin to the Sharingan. Your brain ripples with power, enabling you to think faster and more clearly at all times. Lastly, devouring any cursed objects or their equivalent will harvest the supernatural energy from them, bolstering your reserves AND your bodily attributes. As your reserves' limits rise, so too does your body. Keep eating, and you shall overcome those who oppose you.
addons.title: Heavenly Blessing

addons.text:
Now if you consume a cursed object, the power is also added to your Inner Beast. If said object had a will, your Beast will crush it for a second time, and will be absolute in completely purging it. This means that if you were to eat all twenty of Sukuna's fingers at once, you'd feel no different. Save for a monstrous surge in power, knowledge of the new abilities added to your arsenal, and a deeper resonance with your Inner Beast.

You can manifest your Inner Beast as a Cursed Spirit similar to Yuta and Rika, and even transfer portions of its power into Cursed Tools and other similar objects to empower them, or as a conduit to use its abilities. You can also split its soul into multiple fragments, and anyone who consumes these fragments will have their bodies adapt to be just as capable a Cage as you, and can cultivate the partial power from it on their own. 

If you consume these fragments, you will regain the lost power you had from it.
addons.title: Perfect Vessel

objects.text: A monster in human form, capable of matching an experienced Grade 1 sorcerer like Kento Nanami in combat. You could shatter every Olympic record with little more than some minor exertion—and this is without even accounting for your use of jujutsu. Physically, you are unmatched by all but the most blessed or "blessed" in jujutsu society, and will only grow stronger as you train. But there's more to you than that. When you consume a cursed object, or anything infused with supernatural energy and/or a will, one of two things occurs: Most often than not, you'd crush its will instantly, adding its power to your reserves—much like the Death Paintings, whose meager strength would never withstand your sublime soul. However, should you devour something truly powerful, such as a Finger of Sukuna, it becomes your prisoner. While technically their vessel, you are in truth a cage—one they cannot escape or contest. Sharing space with a prisoner will also grant you awareness of your own soul, allowing you to strike at souls directly. And slowly, through the touching of your souls, their innate techniques, jujutsu, and abilities are engraved onto your body, letting you wield them as your own and even unlock latent potential, such as Reverse Cursed Technique if they possessed it. There is, however, one fatal flaw. Consume too many objects too quickly, and your cage will temporarily "break," freeing your prisoner to use your body as they please. Though you will eventually force them back into confinement... who knows what havoc they'll wreak until then?
objects.title: Cage (Jujutsu Kaisen)

objects.text:
Congratulations Sorcerer, you can now truly consider yourself a contender for the title of "The Strongest." Thanks to a combination of your physical attributes and certain cursed snacks, you have inherited all of Yuji Itadori's experience, strength, and techniques. You have become a human-curse hybrid with a lifespan exceeding 300 years and stand as one of the most powerful Jujutsu sorcerers in history. 

Your already perfect mastery of sorcery has reached a level attained only by the strongest. Your refinement in the use of Cursed Energy rivals, or even surpasses, that of a Six Eyes user, allowing you to perform feats such as masking your CE signature so completely that you are invisible to any tracking attempts; using Black Flash at will; and precisely controlling the power of your attacks to avoid killing your targets—even when landing a Black Flash. Furthermore, you have mastered the highest tiers of known techniques, to the point of being able to deploy an Open Domain. 

This perfection brings not only refinement but also immense firepower. Your Reinforcement allows you to go toe-to-toe with sorcerers like Ryomen Sukuna, Satoru Gojo, or Dabura Karaba and your inherited techniques enable feats such as reducing a large section of a city to rubble with a web of omnidirectional Dismantles requiring neither chants nor hand signs or using a single Dismantle with an single chant to kill so many curses simultaneously that the resulting explosion of dust creates a mushroom cloud so big that reaches the actual clouds

And with your Blood Manipulation CT now you can unleash a dozen Homing Piercing Blood capable of saturating a crowded building and stack Flowing Red Scale to the point where you can withstand attacks like Dabura's Sub-Light Speed Kick through sheer durability and RCT. 

Finally, your physiology as both a Vessel and a Death Painting Womb has been pushed to its limits, as evidenced by your profound understanding of your own soul—gained from having been a vessel, allowing you to use your Cursed Energy to shield your soul against attacks specifically targeting the soul, or to target your enemies' souls with your own attacks, as well as the ability to manipulate the toxicity level of your cursed blood to either merely incapacitate people or kill them upon mere contact, and the capacity to "digest" any being trapped within a Cursed Object (or similar item) that you consume; not even a soul as powerful as Ryomen Sukuna’s could avoid being crushed by your will, enabling you to adopt the strength and Cursed Technique, or similar power of anything you consume, without the need to undergo the process of becoming a vessel
objects.title: The Strongest of Tomorrow (Jujutsu Kaisen)

addons.text:
It appears that your cursed spirit has taken on numerous aspects of the Divine General, possibly even becoming it. In addition to its boundless cursed energy, it possesses two formidable abilities. The first is the Sword of Extermination, capable of instantly vanquishing any cursed spirit or spiritual entity comprised of negative or malevolent emotions.

The second is its capacity to adapt to any and all phenomena through its wheel of cycle and harmony. Working in tandem with your own adaptive abilities, you can double the rate of analysis and adaptation of a single phenomenon, or concurrently analyze and adapt to two separate phenomena at will. You can share all adaptations, counters, and even healing with your cursed spirit, and vice versa.

This bond guarantees mutual survival: as long as one of you lives, the other can regenerate from any damage, including death itself, as your wheels will still turn even after either of your bodies turns to ash. Both of you must die simultaneously to ensure a permanent end.
addons.title: Divine General

addons.text: The Darkness has replaced the cursed spirit bound to you and has given you Authority over all cursed energy. With your power over the Darkness, you can harness its power to not just give you access to an external endless well of cursed energy, but so much more. With its primordial connection, you can now create just about any kind of cursed technique you can imagine, as well as gain control of and override control of any similar powers that draw on cursed or negative energy. You can also create Binding Vows on the same level as Heavenly Restrictions, even on yourself; though, because of your absolute control over everything connected to The Darkness, you can undo any Vows you created along with those made by others without any repercussions. To say you have a talent with cursed energy is the understatement of the decade—your Authority over cursed energy makes it so you are a true God among Jujutsu Sorcerers as your ability to manipulate cursed energy is perfect, making it so there is no wasted energy or flaws with whatever technique you use.
addons.title: I am the Dark

objects.text:
Within your shadow now resides an incredibly powerful cursed spirit, comparable to Rika. This cursed spirit is bound to your very soul and is capable of generating an ungodly amount of cursed energy, some may even say infinite.

You can tap into this boundless source of cursed energy, greatly enhancing your own pool of cursed energy to awe-inspiring levels. The cursed spirit is absolutely loyal, never wavering in devotion, though their eagerness to serve you might be slightly overzealous.
objects.title: Queen of Curses (Jujutsu Kaisen)

objects.text:
The cursed technique held by the strongest Simurian, Dabura Karaba. It is a combination of two parts: control over light and a concept known to the Deskunte tribe that cannot be translated by humans, best approximated as "killing intent given mass".

You can fire beams of light that deal tremendous damage, easily capable of blasting through dozens of buildings or tearing apart Mahoraga, even after several spins of its adaptation wheel. These blasts can be solidified to stay in place as physical objects that you and others can interact with. There is no hard cap on the number of beams you can manifest at a time; if you have enough cursed energy, you can create a criss-crossing pile of hard light beams as tall as a building.

You could also apply the effects of your technique internally instead, which would allow you to accelerate to the speed of light on your own. This doesn’t give you any protection from the risks associated with travel at that speed, such as friction or the stresses such rapid acceleration puts on your body, but if you can hold it together, you are able to move and act at sub-light speeds, outputting truly absurd amounts of force to the point of creating nuclear explosions just from the air you displace.
objects.title: [-----] and Light (Jujutsu Kaisen)

objects.text:
Rather than making a deal with Kenjaku, you can freely incarnate into the world of the living on your own, and the best part, is that you can do it however many times you want. 

You can choose to incarnate into the world as a cursed object, like Sukuna's fingers, which will contain one or multiple fragments of your soul. While in this state, you can lay dormant for as long as you wish, and when your time for another life comes, you will attract a host that will inevitably consume you. Afterwards, you will incarnate into their body, taking their life as your own. Everything from memories, skills, powers, etc, all become yours to use, and the original consciousness is lost, replaced with yours. 

You can choose to not take over that poor soul by willingly turning them into a Cage for you, granting the benefits of that power. Unlike Yuji and Sukuna, you aren't actually in a cage, moreso a "lounge". Allowing you to easily take control of the body with or without changing appearances for however long you wish, and choose whether or not your host remembers any events that occured while you were in control. Your host can still fight for control if they have significant willpower.

Alternatively, you can reincarnate into a new body perfectly tailored and customized for you, and can be any physical form ranging from a teenager to an adult, instead of only a child. You also gain access to all of your powers at the same strength they last were in your previous life, and with your new body, a new well of potential to further improve them.  

Finally, you can choose to have a different Cursed Technique upon incarnation, either designed yourself or be random, or even take a Heavenly Restriction.
objects.title: Incarnated Sorcerer (Jujutsu Kaisen)

objects.text: "Stand Proud, Sukuna. You were strong!" AGGRESIVE DROWNING Throughout Heaven and Earth, you alone are the based one. Your Cursed Energy gains the quality of summoning seemingly random opponents for one person you consider an ally. Whether or not they choose to fight this individual, you choose to fight it, or they simply leave, they can only be there for about 3 minutes maximum. You gain a Domain Expansion known as "Swamp of Serenity." Indeed appearing like a serene swamp and lake, you gain a more absolute version of Comedian, allowing you to drown even someone like the king of curses Sukuna himself for the sake of humor. It can also overpower other Domain Expansions, given enough Cursed Energy put in, but a sufficiently funny lead in can assist as well.
objects.title: Domain Expansion: Swamp of Serenity (DevilArtemis)

objects.text:
You weren't born as a minor Curse Spirit, but as their apex predator, a Special Grade on par with the Disaster Curses; Jogo, Dagon, Hanami, and Mahito. Your abilities far surpass that of normal Special Grade Cursed Spirits. At bare minimum, you will have natural mastery in Cursed Energy equal to a Grade 1 Sorcerer or above, an Innate Technique perfectly tailored for you, and the potential to awaken a Domain Expansion overtime. 

Your mere presence is a living nightmare to humans, easily inducing severe levels of fear and causing incidents worthy of being documented as folkloric legend. With all but elite level sorcerers being able to oppose you, and even then, they will have a hard time.

Another major benefit is human level sentience and reasoning, making your natural instinct towards causing human suffering to nearly become mute. Although, it will always be somewhere in the background unless actively fought against until fully suppressed. It also has the benefit of making you much more tactical and focused in major conflicts, comparable to a peak human.

Optionally, you may design a new form for yourself. Whether you keep the inhuman traits linked to what you represent like Dagon and Kurourushi, or take a humanoid one like Mahito, Hanami, or Jogo is up to you. Even a completely different one entirely.
objects.title: Disaster Curse (Jujutsu Kaisen)

objects.text: Peace. Love. Mutual understanding. People wish for all these things with those around them, yet they seem oftentimes to be impossible. With your technique, though, perhaps anything is possible. You have the cursed technique of Maru and Cross, Chaos and Harmony. Chaos is an aspect of destruction, allowing you to manipulate and invert natural forces to hurt others. Objects can be made to defy gravity, water can suddenly boil and then freeze, gravity itself can be turned sideways for everyone but yourself nearby, and plants can rapidly grow and fight according to your will. Chaos can wield this and countless other destructive forces simultaneously, moving perfectly to your will. Harmony, however, is even more powerful. Harmony has the ability to bring things together, into harmony and balance. Two siblings are each other's perfect match, so it can make them become united. It could also guide an alien race that's constantly oppressed to a planet where they can live in peace and enable them to travel interstellar distances just to reach that destination. In truth, it can bring about virtually any scenario if the end result is "Harmony", with the path to reach that harmony being relatively irrelevant. Even if the technique itself can't bring about the desired scenario, such as creating a world where cursed spirits no longer exist, it can bring you all the people and tools required to achieve the scenario on your own. In reality, calling your technique "Chaos and Harmony" is a misnomer. The true nature of your technique is to grant people's wishes. If you or someone else desires an outcome deep enough from the bottom of their heart, that empowers your technique to make it a reality. If you don't want your friend to die of cancer, it can cure them. If someone wishes to be reunited with their lover, it can move them millions of light-years in minutes just to bring them back together. Perhaps the only true limitations of your ability are that those wishes must be heartfelt and legitimate, and the more impossible your desire, the more circuitous the route to make it a reality. Cursed Energy is also what's used to fuel these effects, so the higher the amount of CE, the stronger your technique becomes, to the point that calling you a "reality warper" would not be an exaggeration. By granting people's wishes, you can make everyone happy! Things outside of natural forces, like a technique capable of manipulating the soul, require that technique itself. However, you can easily use Chaos and Harmony to turn the wielder of that technique into a handheld plushie to use their technique as you see fit while you're holding them.
objects.title: Chaos and Harmony (Jujutsu Kaisen)

addons.title: Aspirant of GOLB
addons.text:
You were already the manifestation of Decay, yet through your metamorphosis into not only a true Herald of the End and a Monster from before time itself but also a living entity of evil energy, you have transcended to become something more. In the same breath, your possession of Chaos Magic has resonated with your studies and worship of GOLB, pushing your evolution to even greater heights.

You are no simple Cursed Spirit, for even the greatest of Cursed Spirits tremble before your malignant majesty. Instead, you have become something much more primordial: a microcosm of GOLB, a reflection of the cosmic embodiment of chaos, entropy, and disorder. 

Your Domain Expansion is the clearest expression of this, revealing its true nature as a return to the primordial state that existed before the universe itself. Within it, reality is temporarily reverted toward the chaos that preceded creation, with its cessation of knowledge stemming from the incompatibility of anything belonging to the ordered universe with this primordial state.

Your Cursed Energy has likewise evolved into a more potent and “pure” form, a primordial energy of chaotic malevolence capable of miraculous feats beyond the normal limits of Cursed Energy. The energy composing your body can also be shaped with practice, granting you a degree of shapeshifting as you learn to manipulate your own form. 

At the same time, your necrotic Cursed Energy has become vastly more potent, carrying traces of your Domain and eroding the very existence of anything not adapted to primordial chaos. Mere exposure can cause matter and energy to wither and crumble, while wounds inflicted by it may take years to heal, if they ever do.

While you are nowhere near GOLB's match yet, as you absorb Cursed Energy and grow in strength you ever so slowly get closer to that cosmic existence. Any upgrades or addons you may have taken compound with this to increase your starting point and bring you closer to GOLB.

objects.text:
"Before there was time, before there was anything, there was nothing, and before there was nothing, there were monsters." - Lich King.

As the being who opposes all life, you are like the embodiment of cursed energy with the sheer size of your reserves. Cursed Energy not contained within an individual is constantly absorbed when near your presence, adding to reserves. When something dies near you, all of its cursed energy will be absorbed and increase your reserves permanently. Your cursed energy is also necrotic in nature, for when you damage an enemy with your cursed energy, they find it much harder to heal. When a cut would have taken at most a week to heal, it will now take months.

As the Herald of the End, you also have Domain Expansion: Prior Existence. When this domain is deployed, all current knowledge ceases to flow. In other words, the enemy wouldn't be able to see, feel, touch, smell, or do anything that involves information. The poor soul you deployed it against will find it virtually impossible to do anything.
objects.title: DOMAIN EXPANSION: Prior Existence

objects.text:
"Ha ha ha ha ha! I'm rockin' your worldview!" - Ice King

Ice and snow, dancing with a glow! Madness isn't a sin; it's a wild, ecstatic win! Embrace the chaos, reject the status quo! Strengthen your inhumanity, let the frozen frenzy grow! When the frigid madness takes hold, it's not just radness; it's a carnival of joy, untamed and bold! In the realm of frozen lunacy, there's no harm in the insanity; it's the very essence of a reality!

Your cursed energy has a special trait, for when it comes in contact with the enemy, it lowers their body temperature.

You also have the Domain Expansion: Frozen Madness, and when it is deployed, everyone it encompasses will find their sanity slowly becoming more unstable as time passes by. As they lose their insanity, the environment also becomes cold. Very cold. A normal human would find themselves dead within 15 seconds.
objects.title: DOMAIN EXPANSION: Frozen Madness

objects.text:
"Homies help homies, always." - Finn Mertens.

When this domain is deployed, you can draw upon the power of your predecessors more. But that is not the primary ability of this domain.

This domain is not created to kill but to redeem. When it is deployed, the opponent will find the evil within them being actively suppressed. Even cursed energy will be actively suppressed. Your opponent will find it difficult to do anything with malicious intent.

If they actively try to keep the evil and malice in their hearts, the suppression of their cursed energy will slowly become permanent.
objects.title: DOMAIN EXPANSION: Golden Heart

addons.text:
Before you were like the Vongola Primo, a single flame with only those closest to you, but now, like Tsuna, you have a global-spanning organization backing you like an inferno.

On top of your already existing organization(s), you gain a Famiglia, the Vongola Famiglia, with you as the new boss. As this is your Famiglia, you can decide how it operates, whether as a vigilante group to protect the innocent, following the ideals of the first Vongola Boss (Vongola Primo), to tread the path of crime and violence following the second Vongola Boss (Vongola Secondo), or to form your own identity.

All members of your Famiglia, be they current or new recruits, are capable of wielding Dying Will Flames. However, under normal circumstances, only a few will awaken to them, and even then not all will have talent or creativity with their Flames.

Your Famiglia holds influence across the world, with several other Famiglie serving faithfully under you, but there are several organizations that act within your inner circle whose influence can be felt through these other Famiglie. These other organizations (which you can rename if you want) are:

CEDEF: Also known as Consulenza Esterna Della Famiglia, or External Advisors of the Family. A secret intelligence organization that is independent but ultimately under your Famiglia, whose main purpose is to aid with settling internal strife and times of crisis. However, while peaceful, they can gather information, acting as middlemen, detectives, and spies.

Varia: An independent and largely mobile squad of world-class assassins of the highest quality, whose skills and exploits are spoken of in hushed whispers of equal parts fear and praise. All members of Varia will have already awakened and trained their Dying Will Flames, with there being at minimum 7 members for each Flame Type.

Foundation: The research, development, and exploration branch of your Famiglia. Primarily staffed by scientists, researchers, inventors, and explorers, their duty is to research and develop tools relating to Dying Will Flames and related items such as Box Weapons. While focused on making the most of the Dying Will Flames, they can be assigned to research and develop other topics; just know you might get an alternative version that makes use of Dying Will Flames alongside it.

Cervello: An all-female organization that acts as the judges for Mafia battles. For when conflict between the Famiglie becomes an inevitability, they act as unbiased judges to ensure those in the conflict are aware of the rules, abide by them, and maintain them. Even if a judge has some connection or feelings for one of those involved in a conflict, they will abide by their role above all else. Given the nature of the organization, they have no interest in claiming power for themselves and instead choose to serve those of higher power, with you being the one they have sworn undying loyalty to. A trait of the Cervello is that all of its female members wear domino masks and appear similar, with only minor differences allowing someone to tell them apart, like hair length, and they wear the latest in fashion.

Guardians: These are your personal team, those closest to you who have sworn loyalty and are considered the strongest amongst your Famiglia, save for yourself. They are experts in their chosen fields and have mastered their Dying Will Flames. Normally, you would have six Guardians, with each representing the Flame Types save for Sky, but you can instead choose to have Seven Guardians, with each having one of the Flames of the Sky.

Each member possesses a full-power Vongola Ring that greatly enhances their user's control and power over their Dying Will Flames, along with similar types of powers should they have any, acting as both a soft and hard symbol of power. Paired with these rings are Box Weapons that contain animal companions who can aid in battle and transform into equipment, the details of which are up to you.

Should you choose to have Seven Guardians, you will possess a specially made eighth Box Weapon and ring that functions like the others.
addons.title: Familia of Flames

addons.text:
This is something never dreamt of before, a near impossibility that would have brought smiles to two old friends. Just as you can trace your ancestry to the first Vongola Boss, Giotto, you can also trace it to the first boss of the Simon Famiglia, Simon Cozzato, and through this newly unveiled aspect of your lineage, the Flames of the Earth awaken.

The Flames of the Earth are exceedingly rare Dying Will Flames, with only the Simon Famiglia using them. These Flame Types are rivals to those of the Flames of the Sky, and they are:

Earth Flame, characteristic: Gravity.

Mirroring the Sky Flame, the Earth Flame allows the user to manipulate gravity around them to enable flight, create gravity spheres that can turn into black holes, and for other applications, such as using it to keep broken bones together.

Swamp Flame, characteristic: Fermentation.

Mirroring the Storm Flame, the Swamp Flame is geared towards destruction through rot and decay. This destruction can create swamp-like areas that share this property and can be used to create bottomless swamps for area control and trapping foes, and it can be fired as a liquid.

Field Flame, characteristic: Movement.

Mirroring the Rain Flame, the Field Flame can swiftly strike opponents to end conflicts before they begin, using lacerations, or avoid dangers through dodges or speedy retreats, so long as you are aware of said danger.

Forest Flame, characteristic: Realization.

Mirroring the Sun Flame, the Forest Flame allows the user to manipulate plant life around them, turning leaves razor-sharp, reviving plants, and forming an area under your control through your plants.

Mountain Flame, characteristic: Tuning.

Mirroring the Lightning Flame, the Mountain Flame can tune with any Earth element for explosive power, extract solids from the ground, or compress the flame to create things such as rocks, magma, and crystals for armor.

Desert Flame, characteristic: Hallucination.

Mirroring the Mist Flame, the Desert Flame allows the user to create illusions that can trick the perception of both living beings and machines, enhance all forms of illusion such as desert mirages, and give a degree of substance to these illusions.

Glacier Flame, characteristic: Freezing.

Mirroring the Cloud Flame, the Glacier Flame uses its trait of Activity from Within to freeze water and vapor, creating ice constructs that can be shaped and controlled.

You can combine your Sky and Earth Flames together. While only the Oath Flame (a combination of Sky and Earth) is known, you can discover new Combination Flames.

Along with the Earth Flames, you also gain the Simon Famiglia and the Simon Rings, seven rings connected to the Flames of the Earth that boost their power comparably to the Vongola Rings. However, while they can boost power, it is unknown if they possess a Miracle comparable to the Vongola Rings.

Note: Out of the Earth Flames, one is unknown, with little information, this technically means the Field Flame is fan-made but built on what we know of the unknown Earth Flame and its user.
addons.title: Oath of Blood

addons.text:
You have been named the succeeding Guardian of that which balances and nurtures life, the Tri-ni-sette. Otherwise known as 73 or 7x7x7 these are 21 artefacts created eons ago by a humanoid species, only known as the original Earthlings, that existed before Humans came into being and who dedicated their whole species to protecting the Earth and the life on it. Originally seven gemstones that held incredible affinity to the Dying Will Flames they would be divided into 3 sets of 7, the Vongola Rings, the Mare Rings and the Rainbow Pacifiers, each set holding one of the Dying Will Flames and a unique miracle to each set based on the Space-Time Axis.

The Miracle of the Vongola Rings is to travel the vertical of the space-time axis; passing on knowledge, tradition and skill to the next generation of ring bearers and looking into one's own past to gain and quickly develop skills relating to their past whether through bonds or lineage.

The Miracle of the Mare Rings is to travel the horizontal of the space-time axis; access to view parallel worlds in order to gain knowledge, insight and communicate with parallel worlds to grow beyond what is possible within one timeline.

The Miracle of the Rainbow Pacifiers is to exist within moments and phases; they exist in a state of suspended animation effectively being immortal and are unaffected by large scale space time manipulation and reality warping with their Dying Will Flames and skills being massively increased. However; with this miracle comes a curse as those who wield the Rainbow Pacifiers are turned into babies being no more than 3 years old (or closest approximation) in appearance.

Originally; those chosen to carry the Rainbow Pacifiers were sacrificial guardians meant to protect the Tri-ni-sette and die so the next generation of can take their place. But; due to the Tri-ni-sette becoming connected to the Dresden Slate through you this sacrifice is no longer needed.

And through this new connection those who gain power from the Dresden Slate can also awaken Dying Will Flames of their own.

Should you have the Colored Kingship (K Project) addon Rex Tremende Majestatis; then you shall take your place as the undisputed Master of the Tri-ni-sette with their Miracles of the Space-Time Axis being natural to you with the power of your Dying Will Flames growing in power several times over to the point even a restrained manifestation of your flame can put pressure on even the most powerful of beings.

You are now able to designate 28 Kings into four sets of seven, three sets having access to the Miracles of the Vongola Rings, Mare Rings and Rainbow Pacifiers with the final seven having access to all three Miracles.

Optionally you can gain control of the Millefiore Famiglia and Giglio Nero Famiglia due to their connection with the Mare Rings and Pacifiers.
addons.title: 7x7x7

addons.text:
Thanks to your access to the Flames of the Night, you gain control over the Vindice and their prison. The Vindice are guards who uphold and enforce the laws of the Mafia world, these laws can now be set by you. Those who defy these laws are arrested and condemned to spend the rest of their lives in an inescapable facility known as the Vindice Prison, which now exists within your world. You may choose the prison’s location or allow it to be randomly determined.

By taking this power, all Vindice shown—except for Bermuda—become your subordinates and obey your commands. They can be dispatched to arrest anyone you choose and imprison them within the Vindice Prison, a facility capable of containing even the strongest Guardians.

All members of the Vindice are former Arcobaleno who survived the removal of their Arcobaleno Pacifiers. As a result, their bodies were once grotesquely damaged and concealed beneath bandages, though this has since changed, and they now appear no different from ordinary people. The Vindice do not wield the Dying Will Flames of the Sky or Earth; instead, they command the Flames of the Night.

Originally, they were unable to generate these flames on their own and had to rely on external sources. However, this limitation has been overcome and their ability to produce flames independently has been restored.

As former Arcobaleno, each Vindice member is an extremely powerful combatant with their own unique specialities. Even before healing, they possessed enough power to fight multiple Guardians, and their strength has only grown now that they can generate their own flames.
addons.title: The Vindice (Katekyo Hitman Reborn)

objects.text:
The blood of the Vongola flows through you, creating a connection to the bosses of the Vongola Famiglia, from the Vongola Primo (1st) Giotto (later renamed Ieyasu Sawada) to the Vongola Decimo (10th) Tsunayoshi Sawada, granting you all the skills, abilities, and equipment that any of the previous bosses possessed.

Through the Blood of Vongola, you gain the Sky Flame on top of the Flame Types you have purchased (should you have taken all 7 Flames of the Sky, then your ability to understand and combine them would vastly surpass all others, with their purity and density similarly increased), as well as the Vongola Hyper Intuition.

Hyper Intuition greatly increases your mind's perceptiveness and your instincts, allowing you to easily predict the actions of living beings and act accordingly, to others seemingly appearing as though you can see the future, and enabling you to bypass Stranger powers and illusions, with disguises failing outright.

But Hyper Intuition is not merely a weapon or a lie detector; it, along with your Sky Flame's trait of Harmony, allows you to better understand and lead others. Whether it's merely wishing to help your friends or forge an organization that will survive the passage of time, you have the makings of becoming one of the Great Leaders of the Mafia world, like the Vongola Primo before you.
objects.title: Inherited Flame and Clams (Katekyo Hitman Reborn)

addons.text:
Your ability as a Mythender to absorb the divinity of what you slay has merged with your ability as a Summoner to call forth a being of legend, allowing you to reach into yourself. You can now summon any divine being you have slain as a Subordinate God unconditionally loyal to you, though they retain their personalities and can tease or snark at you. You can decide how much of their original power you wish to give them access to, going from their full strength to barely qualifying as a Divine Beast, with the caveat that any power you allocate to your Subordinate Gods is inaccessible to you until you dismiss them.

If the Subordinate God you summon has multiple Domains or identities, you can decide which of them should be the dominant one. If you kill the Campione-God Perseus, you can also choose to summon him as Mithra or Helios, just as killing Ares would allow you to summon him as Mars. Should you slay multiple deities sharing an identity, such as killing the Lokis of the Riordanverse, Record of Ragnarok, and Danmachi, you can summon them separately or as a single Subordinate God with access to all their abilities, with you deciding which appearance and personality should be the core of the Subordinate God.

While using Command Seals to force compliance is unnecessary, you still gain three for each Subordinate God that you can use to empower them beyond their original limits, or the limits of the amount of power you were willing to part with when summoning them. Should you use up all three, the Subordinate God is dismissed and cannot be summoned again for 24 hours, with all power you invested in their summoning recovering over the same time span. This also applies if your Subordinate God is slain by an enemy, though if you voluntarily dismiss them, you instantly recover all power invested in them without delay. Any Command Spell not consumed at the moment the Subordinate God tied to it is dispelled, voluntarily or forcefully, will vanish.
addons.title: Subordinate Gods

objects.text:
You have ascended beyond the title of Campione, becoming the Mythender—the ultimate scourge of all supernatural beings. Your power reaches unprecedented heights, solidifying your position as the Apex Hunter of the divine realm. This upgrade enhances all your abilities and grants you an advantage in battles against supernatural and divine entities.

Every strike you unleash as the Mythender carries an overwhelming essence that pierces through the defenses of gods and mystical entities, inflicting devastating damage upon them, regardless of their divine power.
