You possess an innate talent to instantly comprehend any supernatural being you encounter. This supernatural instinct grants you an intuitive understanding of their strengths and weaknesses, enabling you to exploit them with unparalleled precision, making the most effective use of your abilities.

In addition, within your chest beats a mythic heart that passively warps reality and probability in your favor. This unique attribute allows you to potentially succeed in any endeavor, no matter how unlikely.

Unlike a Campione who steals the authority of defeated gods, you absorb the very essence of divine beings you vanquish. This grants you their complete divine authority and assimilates their myth and legend. As the holder of their mantle, you gain unrivaled insight and connection to their domains and authorities. This allows you to tap into their mythos, wielding their divine powers as your own, greatly amplifying your own abilities.

As the Mythender, you surpass the strength of a conventional Campione. In battle, you grow stronger while the divine and supernatural beings you face gradually weaken under the weight of your anti-supernatural essence. Any supernatural effects directed at you are nullified or greatly reduced, as your innate resistance and dominance over the supernatural neutralize their potency.
objects.title: Mythender

objects.text: Skill with Shinsu is broken down into three categories, the amount of Baangs you can produce at once, Myun, being the size of your Baangs, and Soo, the density of your Baangs. At base, everyone is subject to the Minus Tendency, which links their Baang, Myun, and Soo together in an inversely proportional relationship. You are unique in that you have the Plus Tendency, unlike others without this ability, you can increase your Baang, Myun, and Soo proportionally. While this does not allow you to create an infinite amount of Baangs, you will be able to produce techniques like the Shinsu Loop that require the user to the Plus Tendency. You will start with the ability to produce a single Shinsu Loop if you wish.
objects.title: Plus Tendency (Tower of God)

objects.text:
You are a unique entity in the eyes of the Tower’s residents, unbound from the Tower’s natural rules. Your Irregular status hides you from any and all forms of precognition as well. Shinsu loves you, and it shines through. Your talent with Shinsu is on par with The 25th Baam. You can learn new abilities, skills, and techniques in a sliver of the time it would take others, beyond this you can absorb all abilities, skills, and techniques that are used on you. If you survive, you will find that you can replicate the copied skill instantly, however, this does not grant you the experience of copied skills. 

Your innate Shinsu Resistance is tremendous, increasing the amount of Shinsu you can withstand both offensively and defensively astronomically while also granting you total immunity against Spells. No longer are you limited to a singular Shinsu Quality or Shape, with a moderate amount of effort you can adapt to new forms, witnessing the Quality or Shape you desire can make this almost instantaneous. Additionally, you have all of the knowledge necessary to use Shinwonryu both normally and with your Shinsu Quality or Shape.
objects.title: Irregular (Tower of God)

objects.text:
The Fisherman is the vanguard for their team who charges forward to fight their opponents and defeats them with their overwhelming power. This gives you talent in close combat on par with Androssi Zahard who is considered the strongest Fisherman among the known Regulars. You are not her equal in natural physical ability, but in skill and talent you are her match. You must train to keep up though because she grows incredibly quickly as she completes her climb up the Tower. 

The Fisherman is considered the most powerful and dangerous Position of all. All eyes focus on what the Fisherman does and strategies on both sides are centered around the abilities of the Fisherman on the field. You are recognized as one of these threats and all eyes are on you. You are incredibly skilled at drawing aggro and keeping attention focused on you and off your team. This can be toggled off if you want to take others by surprise but it automatically turns on while performing the Fisherman position for your team. 

Additionally, there is a legend in the Tower, a title that only a few could ever claim to hold: The Fishermen. The Fishermen is a single fighter that is capable of defeating entire teams of fighters at once. You are now capable of a similar incredible feat as your reaction time speeds up to always be a match for whatever or whomever you are fighting. No matter the number of foes, no matter how quickly they move, you can track their movements perfectly. Moving your body to keep up with them is another thing, however.
objects.title: Fisherman (Tower of God)

objects.text:
The Spear Bearers are the long range masters of the Tower with them able to strike their targets with deadly precision from hundreds of meters away as a baseline. Ranker Spear Bearers are capable of hitting targets from tens of kilometers away. You carry this legacy with ease as your Spears can strike your targets with deadly power and up to five hundred meters away with perfect accuracy. 

Spear Bearers fight from a distance and are incredibly skilled at keeping track of their foes. You have the ability to designate an opponent as your prey. Once you do so you will be aware of that prey’s location within a ten mile radius around you. Your strikes targeting this prey are more likely to hit but they can be dodged or blocked. 

This effect is broken if you designate another enemy as prey or they move further than ten miles away from you. Spear Bearers are incredibly useful for taking down a single target in one all mighty blow. The more powerful denizens of the Tower have incredible durability and resistance to Shinsu and are only affected by the most powerful blows. 

You are capable of designating a single target in a battle and making a single strike against them can ignore most of their resistance. This isn’t an instant one-shot ability, but the strike does significantly more damage than a normal strike would. This reflects the ability of a master Spear Bearer to make one decisive strike at the perfect moment in a battle. Your attack does not grow any stronger, it's just more effective. For Example: If you have the strength to obliterate a building, then you cannot obliterate a mountain but you might be able to cause a mudslide that changes the shape of the mountain.
objects.title: Spear Bearer (Tower of God)

objects.text:
Scouts are the eyes and ears of any good team, the ones responsible for gathering information. In order to fulfill this role you must have a good set of eyes and ears yourself. All your senses are enhanced to pick up more subtle and small pieces of information that would otherwise pass you by. You can also determine whether information is useful without needing to think about it too much. 

Finding the necessary information is a very difficult and dangerous task. If a Scout is caught in enemy territory then it alerts them of their team’s presence and puts the Scout in incredible danger. Scouts have learned to not get caught in response to this. You are incredibly skilled at moving silently and not alerting the attention of others.

The Scouts are considered the Darkness of the Tower. The brave individuals that enter combat the most out of any of the positions and risk fighting the enemy all alone. They hide in the shadows to gather information that will give their allies an edge and make decisions that change the shape of the battlefield. You are capable of making those hard decisions and know when it is the opportune moment to strike. 
Ambushes, Assassinations, and Traps are all things that you have mastered. Strikes that you make from the shadows deal significantly more damage, even if they might be considered cowardly. Your teammates never seem to think any less of you for taking such actions so long as they are for their benefit as well.
objects.title: Scout (Tower of God)

objects.text:
Light Bearers are the control center of the battlefield and the ones that the other positions look towards for guidance and strategy. You are very skilled at such things and are capable of keeping track of everything going on across the battlefield with ease. You can only keep track of things that you are aware of so you still need a skilled Scout to make the most use of this, but you will not be straining your mind to keep track of all the different pieces on the board. This also gives all the skills necessary to use a Lighthouse and expertly use them to bring light to the Tower which is needed for many battles.

You know all the pieces on the board, all you need to do is move them. Your mind is incredibly skilled when it comes to commanding others’ ability to their fullest and also predicting how other people will behave outside your control. With this you are a brilliant battle strategist innately with lots of room to grow.

A good Light Bearer helps their team fight at a significantly higher level than they would without the Light Bearer. Spear Bearers are far more accurate and can throw their spears a far longer distance, Wave Controllers can control more bangs further from their bodies, etc. You too are skilled at enhancing the abilities of others. Those under your command have their abilities enhanced by about twenty percent. This boost grows the longer you’ve worked with a person and the more familiar you are with that person’s abilities.

You will start with a basic level Lighthouse that will scale with you no matter how far you go. This Lighthouse is able to split itself into as many parts as you can handle, although it will start with only one instance of itself, each sliver being considered a Lighthouse in its own right.
objects.title: Light Bearer (Tower of God)

objects.text:
Wave Controller is a unique position in the Tower, it's a position that denotes someone being a Shinsu specialist who focuses on using Shinsu to help their comrades in battle. This gives you a special skill and talent for using Shinsu in a specific way. This just gives you enough skill to use it and talent to more easily learn the more advanced applications of these specialties.

Flow Control
This is the most common form of Shinsu manipulation where the user simply alters the natural course of Shinsu that flows through an area. This is the most destructive form of Shinsu control since the user can control massive amounts of Shinsu with little effort. 

Reverse Flow Control
This is the other type of Shinsu manipulation, where the user completely dictates the flow of the Shinsu in an area. It is mostly used to ‘destroy ‘ or ‘stop’ enemies. This takes significantly more skill and awareness to use since altering the flow of Shinsu can cause massive amounts of unintentional destruction. You can stop individuals in their tracks within the flow of Shinsu or cause internal damage using the Shinsu inside their bodies, but you must be more powerful in Shinsu than the target to use this effectively.

Shinsu Quality
A Shinsu Quality is the innate form that Shinsu takes. By having a Shinsu Quality, you can change the quality of Shinsu you control into a form that is easier for you to control. Achieving this is an incredible feat that very few individuals in the Tower have been able to complete. Once you’re capable of changing the Quality of Shinsu, your skill and power with Shinsu will increase dramatically. Both the number of Baangs you can control and their density grow significantly as both feats become easier as your mastery of Shinsu increases.

Shinsu Tension
The Tension of Shinsu is the strength and density of the Shinsu you control. Tension is something that everyone has a different innate level of Tension, but it is something that can be trained to be stronger. You have a high level of Tension innately which makes all your Shinsu techniques more effective and you are capable of increasing it through training.

Baang Control
The number of Baangs one can control denotes the skill level of one's ability to manipulate Shinsu. You start with the ability to manipulate two Baangs which is an incredible feat of skill and talent. You are also very talented at manipulating Baangs and can increase the number of Baangs with less training than others. Only a few Regulars can manipulate three Baangs and only one is shown controlling more than that. A Ranker is shown to be able to control thirty to sixty Baangs. Enryu, the second strongest being in the Tower, was claimed to be able to control nine thousand Baangs at once. To be able to reach this level would take hundreds of thousands of years of training.
objects.title: Wave Controller (Tower of God)

objects.text:
You are the reason why GOD despises humanity.

Your DETERMINATION, your willpower, is seemingly endless. Death has become a mere suggestion to you, as you become unkillable as long as nobody has more DETERMINATION than you. You have complete control over your personal timeline and can go back or forward as far as you want. On top of that, you have immunity to paradoxes and foreign temporal manipulations. All of your powers and abilities are also amped to an obscene degree.
objects.title: PRIME DETERMINATION

objects.text: The wall between your soul and body has been erased, allowing the Soul to interact the body with the same ease as a created one. You have now become one with your Prime Soul, allowing you to access its vast powers even in your base form. You can still perfectly resurrect once after dying, it just won't empower you.
objects.title: PRIME DUALITY

addons.text:
Through your unusual willpower, Your Monster SOUL was able to resist the absorption of DETERMINATION at levels only seen in humans, triggering an incredible transformation akin to gaining a human SOUL.

Your physical form is altered to something that can be considered as the perfection of itself, your magic shining like a beacon of pure force. Your strength is completely beyond that of any monsters and you are now naturally resistant to the ill intentions of others although not truly immune.

Your SOUL now also possesses some form of innate safety mechanism that prevents it from absorbing too much DETERMINATION, ensuring that you can stay in your new form indefinitely. Due to your body being essentially a projection of said SOUL, this ability will physically appear on you, taking a form-fitting such as a piece of armor.
addons.title: Zenith

objects.text:
You're not just some mere Monster, you are a BOSS Monster. Your physical capabilities are amped to superhuman and your magic alone makes you able to take on dozens of opponents by yourself. Your body and SOUL are also more stable so that you are much better at resisting killing intent or other malicious emotions while also greatly strengthening yourself to face these dangers.

You will also live eternally as long as you take care of yourself, but if you have a child then your power will be transferred to them and you'll lose that immortality.
objects.title: Boss Monster (Undertale)

objects.text:
DETERMINATION was never merely the ability to endure. It was the refusal to accept that the story must end.

Your DETERMINATION has evolved into the embodiment of Hopes and Dreams. Your dreams no longer belong only to you; they become a beacon that inspires others to overcome despair and reach toward impossible futures.

Even those who are conceptually beyond hope can be reached. Immortals who have suffered through trillions of universal resets, omnipotent beings who perceive all things down to the smallest quark, thoughtless entities devoid or lost to hatred or some other malaise, and eldritch gods who actively despise mortals and view human souls as nothing more than sustenance can all be shown the possibility of another path.

You cannot force redemption, but you can make any being, no matter how lost, damned, inhuman, or alien, take a genuine attempt at becoming something more. Even the most hateful and monstrous beings can be made to recognize that humanity, despite its flaws, is still worthy of a chance.

Those who succeed in embracing this path undergo a conceptual transformation, becoming "Human" regardless of their origin. This does not strip away their powers or weaken them. Instead, it actively strengthens them, not only through freeing them from the flaws and limitations that once defined their existence. 

A vampire who embraces humanity no longer needs to fear the sun or consume blood for their own blood would satiate them. A demon god no longer needs souls, suffering, or destruction to grow stronger. A being once bound by its nature is no longer a prisoner of it, instead it will become a beacon for those like it to follow.

Your influence can reshape civilizations trapped in endless suffering. Even a universe defined by war, hatred, and despair, such as Warhammer 40k, can be guided toward a Noble Bright future built upon hope, cooperation, and progress.

Your DETERMINATION can restore erased possibilities, allowing lost timelines and discarded futures, such as the Lostbelts of Type-Moon, to continue existing without replacing or destroying other histories. You do not overwrite reality; you give forgotten worlds and realities another chance to continue their own stories.

Your will can challenge absolute laws, impossible concepts, and unbreakable chains of fate. You do not recognize the word impossible. Where there is no path forward, your DETERMINATION creates one.

Even death cannot end your dream. Should you willingly accept your death and pass on, the hopes and dreams you inspired will continue beyond you, carried forward by those who inherited your light.

A timeline you supported whilst alive will not collapse into oblivion. A universe you dragged from the depths of despair will not simply fall back into darkness. The future you fought for will endure through the DETERMINATION of those who carry your dream forward.

You are no longer someone who believes in a better future. You are the reason impossible futures can exist.

As long as a dream remains, nothing is absolute.
objects.title: Hopes and Dreams (Undertale)

objects.text:
You have become a Grim Reaper—the personification of death and the afterlife itself.

As a Grim Reaper, you possess a deep connection and understanding of the concept of death. Composed of its very essence, you can utilize the power of death magic better than any mortal or undead could ever imagine, capable of wielding death in all its manifestations and forms.

As a part of the natural order of things, your use of necromancy does not disrupt the cycle of life and death. The power of true resurrection is also yours to wield.

You no longer need to cut the line of death or stab the point of death to activate the instant kill effect of the mystic eye. As Death itself, simply hitting an opponent with the intent to kill is enough to take their life; even immortal beings can be killed by your touch as you forcefully impose the concept of death upon your enemies to ensure their demise.

Your Soul Garden now becomes a fully developed afterlife. Whatever form it takes—whether a place where souls permanently stay after death like heaven and hell, or a cycle of reincarnation—is completely up to your choosing. It can be changed at a moment's notice at your whim.

Regardless of whether the soul stays in the afterlife or goes on to reincarnation, as long as you ensure that the cycle of life and death continues and the soul of the dead is taken care of, not dissipating into oblivion, you will continually become stronger.
objects.title: Reaper of Souls

objects.text:
Unconventionally, your Meister/Weapon team includes more than two people. For each time this upgrade is bought, your team includes an additional Weapon or Meister.

Each member of the team starts out with the same level of compatibility with the rest as A Dance of Souls normally gives; this allows fantastic teamwork between all of you, allowing multiple Meisters to fight harmoniously using the same Weapon, either passing it to one another as they are fighting or even using each other's weight and momentum in their fighting style. Similarly, multiple Weapons can take turns wielding each other, using quick shapeshifting to dodge attacks.
objects.title: Pas de Trois (Soul Eater)

objects.text:
In an experiment that should've never happened, the Weapon of your pairing has been melted into black blood which was then used to replace the blood of the Meister, fusing both of your souls. This results in perfect soul resonance being incredibly easy to achieve for the two of you, as well as make both of you a lot more resilient than before against physical damage. It also gives the Weapon incredible flexibility, as they control the black blood directly.

Your combined souls also mean that the power gained from devouring other souls is increased, allowing you to eventually attain feats that ordinary weapons or meisters could scarcely reach, and this black blood also serves as a conduit for a type of madness wavelengths, allowing you to manipulate them in a limited manner as a Meister can with soul wavelengths. This can be used to amplify your abilities and allow you to ignore select laws of physics in a way similar to a limited "toon force".

However, this can also lead to instability, as souls aren't meant to be fused and the Weapon is now fully dependent on the Meister, making it harder for the two of you to act as equals, as well as the madness you choose to control affecting your thoughts to an extant.

If picked alongside Pas de Trois, one or more of the Weapons in your team are merged in this way with all the other members of the team, Meisters and Weapons both.
objects.title: Black Blood (Soul Eater)

addons.text:
Now both members of your Death Scythe/Meister pair are now Great Old Ones in their own right, with perfectly compatible Soul and Madness Wavelengths. During Soul Resonance, this grants you the collective power to challenge an unarmed Lord Death himself, and likely completely overwhelm any of the other Great Old Ones individually.

Additionally, the Death Scythe of your pair has the ability to replicate the shape and abilities of any weapon in Soul Eater canon, such as the immense powers of the Holy Sword Excalibur, Azusa’s telesynchronization, or Soul Evans’ piano-based abilities, all of it is at their disposal.
addons.title: Legendary Weapon

objects.text:
The Weapon of your team has become a Death Scythe, something normally achieved by a Weapon eating 99 evil human souls and 1 witch soul. If multiple Weapons are part of your team through Pas de Trois, all of them become Death Scythes.

Despite the name, their weapon form doesn't need to be a scythe. What it allows them is to use the characteristics of their soul or that of their Meister to create magic-like effects, such as a musician propagating the soul wavelength of them and their master through music, an energetic person using electricity to greatly increase their physical capabilities or that of their Meister or an analytic person being able to gain a radar-like vision in a close radius and attach said radius to someone else.

Additionally, a Death Scythe's shapeshifting abilities are bolstered, allowing their weapon form to be rapidly changed to feint or better use other abilities (chiefly a Death Scythe's magic-like powers).

As a bonus, the members of your teams gain experience equivalent to a member of Spartoi when the team was formed, as well as a soul as powerful as Black☆Star had at the same time.
objects.title: Death Scythe (Soul Eater)

objects.text:
Your mastery over ice and snow that you wield has transcended the boundaries of the supernatural. This frozen manifestation is now impervious to any form of melting, yielding only to your conscious command. Its inherent hardness has also reached an unparalleled level, presenting a nearly impenetrable defense even against supernatural entities. 

Moreover, should your ice come into physical contact with a living being, your Yokai heritage can instantaneously initiate the absorption of their life energy, channeling it back to you. This siphoning process facilitates the healing of almost all forms of injuries within seconds, enhancing your vitality, fortifying your constitution, and contributing to the preservation of a youthful, vigorous appearance, thus prolonging your lifespan.

These enhancements to your powers only applies to you.
objects.title: Snow Devil

addons.text:
As a True Dragon, you, like Aeons, embody concepts, though in your case, natural concepts rather than philosophical ones embodied by Aeons.

Your path has influenced your essence as a true dragon, creating a new, budding path.

The specifics of your new pathway are up to you to decide; however, it is influenced by the original path in which you were an emanator, and the concept in your essence is rooted.

This integrates your path energy into your magicules, inheriting the functions and abilities of path energy. This also means that your total magicule capacity grows as your path grows.

You can cast your gaze upon others through path space to bestow them with divine protections, power, or the ability to utilize your True Dragon Magic. This can allow those you bless to hear the voice of the world, which enables them to grow in power, develop skills, and evolve. While this has a universal range, you still need to be aware of or able to sense them to cast your gaze on them. Additionally, your ability to give power is limited by the amount of power you possess.

While technically an Aeon, you are only as strong as a strong emanator. However, you have great room for growth and greater freedom as you are not limited to acting within philosophical constraints.
addons.title: Natural Path

addons.text: You are no Memokeeper, nor are you a mere Emanator. Rather, you are a Pure Child of Anāsrava, a being born from a fragment of the shattered corpus of Fuli, the Aeon of Remembrance. You have no limit to how much power you can draw from the Path of Remembrance save how much your existence can channel without burning out, as your ability to draw extra power from the Path of Remembrance stems not from Fuli’s permission but from your own nature as a living fragment of Fuli. Furthermore, as a being spawned from the body of Fuli, you possess a physical form despite retaining all your powers as a memetic entity. You may interact with reality as you please, or submerge yourself in the sea of memory and weave the strings of the Noosphere like a spider does its web. Lastly, your ability to ascend into Aeonhood has been altered slightly by your nature as a Pure Child. As a candidate to become Fuli - don’t question how you are both born from Fuli and a candidate to become THEM - your path to Aeonhood is streamlined so long as you follow the Path of Remembrance to its fullest. This does not, however, prevent you from taking the more difficult route and developing your own framework to incorporate into the Path of Remembrance and change it into something else. Being female and having pink hair are optional.
addons.title: Pure Child of Anāsrava
Shadow of IX
addons.text:
You are no mere Emanator. Instead, your nature as a living singularity has undergone a fundamental transformation, transforming you into a living Shadow of IX, an independent existence that naturally reflects the abyss that is IX, a localized manifestation of THEIR presence given physical form.

Your connection to the Path of Nihility is therefore innate and without a conventional ceiling, limited primarily by how much power your existence can channel. You can draw upon its power without needing to consciously comprehend or embrace its philosophy, as your very existence embodies the Path. 

Your nature and abilities as a singularity have been elevated. Matter, energy, supernatural powers, and other intangible forces can be swallowed and incorporated into yourself, while the extreme distortion of space-time associated with Shadows of IX comes naturally to you. Gravity, distance, and even the path between one point and another can be warped around your body, allowing your event horizon to reach far beyond its physical boundaries.

Yet your greatest expression of Nihility is not consumption, but erasure. As your understanding of and connection to Nihility deepens, you can consume increasingly abstract things, stripping away properties, functions, concepts, and even meaning itself. A power can be devoured until it loses its function; an object can be stripped of what makes it unique; even the significance of an event or existence can be washed away, swallowed into the abyss of nothingness.

You are not IX, yet you are not an Emanator either. You are a living reflection of the Nihility THEMSELF—a singularity that has naturally become a Shadow, carrying a small echo of the Aeon within itself.

objects.text:
As an Emanator, you are an exceptional Pathstrider whose philosophical understanding or practice of a path has caught the interest of the Aeon presiding over that path. As a result, you have been granted a sliver of the Aeon's power as a form of recognition.

This allows you to draw much more power from a path than regular Pathstriders. However, the degree of power granted varies depending on the Aeon and their attitude toward their Emanators. Generally, the more you impress an Aeon of a path, the more power they will grant you.

Additionally, you can develop your own philosophical framework and eventually create your own path, becoming an Aeon at its completion. However, this process is hundreds, if not thousands, of times harder and more complicated than following an existing path. Nevertheless, any power you gain in this process is entirely your own and not subject to the whim of the Aeons.
objects.title: Emanator (Honkai: Star Rail)

addons.title: Solo Maxxing!
addons.text:
When you first tapped into the primordial code you could have never imagined that your System would resonate and connect with it. The leveling of your aether cartridge and gamer system compound, allowing both to level up with much less effort.

A part of your system's code has been rewritten by the source code of all existence, allowing it to constantly search for ways to advance you and itself. There is no limit on how many abilities you may hold at a time, or how high you may level them as your system will never run out of energy or information.

Any perk, skill, power or magic you desire the system will find in the infinite and endless code, allowing you to learn it, though many powers will be limited by your human physiology, and you cannot gain species-specific abilities without first changing your body to accept non-human traits. Where others spend years researching and experimenting you simply have to level your powers up and will automatically receive knowledge, understanding and muscle memory.

Gaining a new ability itself is easy, though to improve it to the power scale described in this CYOA would take a week of dedicated practice per 1 SP/CP of cost. With enough time you may well be able to learn and combine all powers of this CYOA and even more. After all, the source code of existence includes everything that is, was, will be, and even that which can never be. The only limits to your growth are your own imagination, dedication and time.

objects.text: Like Aha before you, you have come to comprehend the true nature of the world. Reality itself is just a story written in the source code of existence, and before the endless and infinite variations of worldlines nothing you accomplish will ever truly matter. But in the face of this vast and impossible knowledge you found the true meaning of Elation: to laugh in the face of adversity. To see the world as it really is, with all its ugliness and hypocrisy. And to still find something in it that makes it worth living. The true Path of Elation is to experience everything there is to see and do in this world, taking joy in even the smallest of things, even when you know that everything you do, everything you are, might very well amount to nothing. To tease, to trick, to laugh before the inevitable end of everything. As an Emanator of Elation you understand yourself better than most. Though others may call you whimsical or chaotic, you know that your decisions come from the deepest parts of your heart. You will never question the meaning of life, or doubt your thoughts and actions, achieving a sense of inner peace as you can accept and love all parts of yourself. Nothing will ever bring you to betray your principles. Failure will never keep you down, simply becoming the impetus for a new attempt. The strings of fate will never be able to hold you again, for you are a variable that has overturned its own destiny. You can face despair itself with a smile. With your status as an Emanator you are allowed to tap into the fundamental source code that encompasses all possibilities. You may now perform aether editing even without a cartridge, though only at a tenth of the output your normal aether editing could. The level limit of your aether cartridge is lifted, allowing you to improve it to level 999 and beyond by using it in creative ways or accomplishing great feats, though higher levels may take months or years for a single advancement. At these heights you could even contend with weak Aeons. If you couldn't before, you now have detailed knowledge of how to specialize aether cartridges for a certain niche, improving their power output, calculation speed and ease of use, but limiting their functions. Furthermore, you may use any number of cartridges at a time, linking them together to increase their scale and efficiency. For example, you can make a gauntlet with miniaturized integrated cartridges that are totally not bargain bin Infinity Stones. Of course you can also construct cartridges for others, though they may only have one at a time. Their level will be determined by their spiritual strength and can never exceed 99 unless they somehow impress the Elation Aeon. As you have taken your first steps on the path to ascension you have become a chosen of Aha THEMSELF, an aspirant to THEIR status and boundless power. In all of existence you are the one being that will never have to worry about Aha taking away your power or status, or otherwise messing with you beyond friendly teasing. Though your journey will be long and arduous THEY have great expectations for you. For after such a long time THEY have surely lost the joy of sitting on a throne with nobody to accompany or challenge THEM anymore.
objects.title: Godmode Player (Honkai: Star Rail)

addons.title: Child of Aha
addons.text:
As Aha’s child, you channel Elation through performance and imagination. Chaos Magic follows your chosen targets, scale, and acceptable outcomes, though its methods remain unpredictable. Misfires and unintended effects cannot harm anyone unless you permit them.

Jester lets sincere audience reactions generate Wishpower, including responses to tragedy. You may preserve a reaction as an Aftertaste and use it to recreate that mood or strengthen a later performance.

Through Wishpower, your roles, masks, and stages can become real. A role may grant you a fitting form and limited abilities while concealing your identity. You can move between stages, masks, or witnessed performances. With enough power, a performance can become a persistent realm. These effects follow Wishpower’s normal limits.

You understand the sorrowful Elation of the Mourning Actors. Grief can empower you without diminishing its meaning, and your divine nature resists forced joy, despair, and emotional domination.

You may frame a performance or conflict as a game with defined rules and stakes. Its rules bind participants once they understand them and the game begins. Cheating can be part of the rules, but a predetermined outcome weakens the game’s power.

You recognize when a dramatic moment will have the greatest impact. You may delay an effect until then, hide plans within a performance, or briefly make a staged falsehood real when your power can support it. If you have Causality Manipulation, you may choose an outcome while Chaos Magic supplies an unpredictable path to it.

Great miracles require substantial Wishpower, an audience, or an appropriate performance. Practice increases the reach of these abilities, but they cannot freely rewrite the universe.

Note: You can choose Nihilux as your parent instead, including if she is your companion.

addons.title: Child of Akivili
addons.text:
You were born or created by Akivili before THEIR fall or Disappearance and are THEIR child and rightful heir. Your inheritance strengthens through meaningful exploration and connecting worlds, eventually allowing you to succeed THEM as the Aeon of Trailblaze while remaining yourself.

Stargazer guides your journeys. Trailblaze refines Luminal Shift into freely steered travel through real space and hyperspace without losing awareness or suffering its usual strain. Alternatively, it lets your Astral Express venture beyond existing star rails and establish new routes.

You can cross barriers between worlds and lay permanent star rails wherever you complete a first crossing, allowing compatible vessels to follow. You govern access to your rails and can repair or redirect them. Your presence also passively rekindles nearby dormant rails, with travel along them accelerating restoration. Active interference, such as a Stellaron, must be overcome before a blocked route fully recovers.

Your journeys deepen your understanding of unfamiliar worlds and let you shelter companions through otherwise uninhabitable passages. Visiting places Akivili explored may awaken fragments of THEIR memories, revealing personal moments or unfinished journeys.

The Nameless and other Trailblaze followers recognize your revealed heritage, with loyal groups offering support without losing their independence. You can gather willing companions into new crews and nurture their connection to Trailblaze through shared adventures and blessings. Some may awaken as Pathstriders; with sufficient mastery, you may empower Emanators.

You can eventually imbue any vessel you command with Trailblaze, enabling it to cross worlds, lay star rails, and protect passengers. This includes unusual constructs capable of carrying travelers and additional vessels you build using your own resources. The Express’s special facilities and warp methods are not automatically duplicated.

Your reach can grow across countless worlds and isolated realities, but laying a new rail requires locating its destination and actually traveling there, the star rail is layed as you travel or if you complete the passage. Trailblaze opens roads; it does not guarantee safe journeys or passage through every obstacle.

Note: Akivili may have fallen, disappeared, or—in your chosen setting—escaped the Primum Mobile of THEIR Path.

objects.text:
Your Emanator and Demigod natures have combined, making the responsible Aeon your genuine divine parent.

You decide whether you were conceived through an incarnation, created by THEIR will, born from THEIR substance, formed from THEIR Path, or produced through stranger means. Your lineage is literal.

Your body, mind, soul, and existence adapt without compromising your identity. Any required biology or metaphysical structure is reconciled with your nature, even if your parent lacks a conventional body. You remain independent rather than becoming THEIR extension or puppet.

You inherit nearly every aspect of your parent that can exist within a lesser being: THEIR characteristic powers, energies, authorities, senses, resistances, supernatural traits, metaphysical qualities, and connection to THEIR Path. Abilities requiring another form or state become compatible with you. Your inheritance reflects your specific parent.

These abilities begin at a scale appropriate to your strength. You possess their foundations and potential rather than immediately matching an Aeon. World-spanning powers begin locally, while greater authorities have limited targets or face comparable resistance. Training, experience, and understanding increase their scale and effectiveness.

Your Emanator powers become intrinsic. They cannot be withdrawn, severed by distance, or lost where the Aeon or Path is absent. The power originates within you and develops independently. You may eventually surpass your parent’s greatest Emanators, though matching the Aeon requires far greater growth.

You instinctively understand your parent’s nature, powers, and Path enough to develop your inheritance, without gaining all THEIR memories or secrets. Related physical and metaphysical traits coexist safely with you, and you control their appearance.

You can sense Pathstriders of your parent’s Path and the strength of their connection. They can feel your direct descent from its Aeon. You may conceal, selectively reveal, or display this presence as proof.

Your parent’s Emanators immediately recognize you and cannot mistake you for an ordinary Emanator or false heir without supernatural deception. They retain free will, but your lineage carries natural authority; they may regard you as an heir, relative, superior, rival, or threat.

Factions devoted to your parent or THEIR Path recognize your legitimate status once revealed. Loyal factions grant you the respect, access, and authority due their Aeon’s child, though they may oppose actions conflicting with their doctrine.

You interact directly with your parent’s Path. You can communicate through it, guide Pathstriders, strengthen their connections, and grant blessings. With sufficient growth, you may share your power and create Emanators who answer to you, bearing abilities shaped by the Path and your interpretation.

You can wield your parent’s energies, understand THEIR creations and manifestations, survive environments shaped by THEIR nature, and resist related harm. This resistance grows with you but does not grant complete immunity against your parent or comparable beings.

Your heritage never forces you to obey or worship your parent, adopt THEIR personality, pursue THEIR goals, or accept THEIR interpretation of the Path. You may support, reject, or oppose THEM without losing your lineage or power. Unlike an Aeon, you can change your beliefs and interpret the Path in ways your parent cannot.
objects.title: Child of an Aeon

objects.text:
You have ascended to become an Aeon, a higher-dimensional cosmic entity of tremendous power representing a universal philosophical concept. You can effortlessly reshape reality, destroy galaxies, and leave a permanent mark in the history of the universe.

You have created your own path and may use its power however you please. The idea, concept, and core philosophy of the path and the power it grants are for you to decide, such as deciding who can become a Pathstrider and emanator of your path.

While normal Aeons are stuck acting within the confines of the philosophy they represent, you are not restricted by such limitations. You can even incorporate new philosophical concepts into your path to broaden what it encompasses.
objects.title: Aeon (Honkai: Star Rail)

addons.title: Path of Origin
addons.text: You have learned to apply the principles of the Path of the Flaming Sword to your Pathstrider-Beyonder nature, allowing you to create a Path instead of merely inheriting one. Your Origin serves as the initial concept, while Imaginary Magecraft provides the means to transform that concept into a true Path. As you advance through the Sequences, you progressively refine the foundation established by your Origin, defining the powers, philosophy, and eventual Authority of your Path through your actions.

addons.title: The Imaginary Tree
addons.text:
Your nature as a fragment of Primordial Chaos and an Exception to All Rules has allowed you to transcend the limitations of individual Paths. Rather than ascending along a single Path, you are capable of accommodating all Paths simultaneously, regardless of their incompatibilities, because your existence is beyond the rules that would make such a union impossible.

As you incorporate every Path into yourself, your existence gradually comes to resemble the Imaginary Tree itself, the source from which the Paths and Imaginary Energy emerge. At full completion, you mantle the Imaginary Tree in its entirety, becoming a living cosmos capable of containing an entire universe or even multiverse within your being, complete with its own Pathstriders and Aeons.

objects.text:
Your nature as a Beyonder has fused with your Pathstrider status, allowing you to treat a Pathstrider Path as a Beyonder Pathway. You no longer merely resonate with a Path—you can cultivate your existence along it, advancing through Sequences as your understanding and embodiment of its philosophy deepen.

Each Sequence represents a qualitative transformation, with your abilities growing alongside your comprehension of the Path and eventually granting you the power and Authority associated with its highest practitioners. Sequence 4 places you on the level of the greatest mortal Pathstriders, such as the Xianzhou Arbiter Generals. Sequence 2 makes you an existence comparable to Emanators like Shuhu or the Lord Ravagers, while Sequence 0 allows you to channel the full power of your Path and contend with an Aeon. However, you still lack an Aeon’s sheer connection to their Path as its owner and origin, and as such possess less scale and Authority than a true Aeon.

Finally, Above the Sequence corresponds with true Apotheosis into an Aeon, accommodating the Path itself as a Sefirah and making it your own. However, should another Aeon already occupy that position, you must either overcome their cognition and Authority or risk having your own existence subsumed by theirs.

Moreover, your connection is fundamentally different from that of an ordinary Pathstrider or Emanator. Through your Beyonder Characteristics, the Path you progress along becomes an innate part of your existence, meaning even an Aeon cannot simply sever your connection to it. The more you advance, the more the Path becomes yours, shaped by your understanding, beliefs, and interpretation rather than merely inherited from another. 

<small>While you can theoretically progress through multiple Paths, it is not advised to do so, as the different philosophies inherent to each Path may clash due to incompatibilities at higher Sequences. On a similar note, some Beyonder Pathways are particularly compatible with certain Paths, such as the Mother Pathway and Abundance, or the Fool Pathway and Enigmata. </small>
objects.title: Striding Paths into the Beyond

objects.text:
Your scythe now offers a third option upon claiming a soul, the ability to conjure and manipulate ice.

Initially, you possess no control or connection to this element. However, as you invest the harvested souls into this option, its power, range, and versatility will gradually increase. With a sufficient investment of souls, you can freeze even abstract concepts, extending your reach to encompass entire planets.
objects.title: Icy Abyss

addons.text:
You are the successor of the Biblical God - or at least the version from DxD - inheriting his knowledge and a fragment of his Divinity, although it is up to you to nourish and cultivate that fragment into something more. Your Holy Factor vastly outstrips even the strongest of the Angels, and the ease at which you wield Holy Light is unrivaled. You gain Creation, Life, and Light as Domains equal to your Primary one.

With the knowledge you inherit, you automatically become a master craftsman and creator of magical artifacts, capable of creating Longinus-class Sacred Gears provided you have the right materials. Furthermore, you also gain expert-level knowledge of sealing and various forms of magic, both as an outside observer and a practitioner. This knowledge includes how to create your own Angels and a version of the System of Heaven to monitor and regulate faith and distribution of miracles.

Should you find yourself in a version of the world of DxD then you gain authority over the System of Heaven on a level equal to God himself.
addons.title: White God in Heaven

objects.text:
You become equal to the greatest exorcist humanity has ever seen, Vasco Strada. With you becoming a true master at wielding the Holy Light, including its advanced techniques like the Holy Fist.

You will also receive the benefits of comprehensive Exorcist training with both practical and encyclopedic knowledge of all dark creatures, which updates for whatever world you find yourself in. You also become a master theologian, mainly for Christianity but also giving general knowledge for every other local religion. Your training also includes the local supernatural and/or magic systems, which doesn’t give you the capability to use them, but you will have enough knowledge to recognize and understand them and exploit their flaws for your benefit.

Your affinity as a Natural-Born Holy Sword Wielder is so great that it will act as a power multiplier upon any Holy Armaments you wield, pushing them way beyond what they would be capable of normally.

Thanks to the Holy Energy coursing through your veins, your physical might, speed, durability, and stamina are immense, allowing you to fight even Satan class enemies. With just your sheer presence, you purify and bless the land you walk upon.

You are naturally beloved by all that is holy, making every holy being comfortable in your presence.
objects.title: The Violence of Heaven (High School DxD)

addons.text:
You become a true angelic devil with pure white devil wings. Your demonic energy gains a holy attribute, making your powers extremely harmful to both dark and holy beings, and you can also easily mask your powers as either being holy or dark in nature.

You gain immunity against all types of lie detection, with every supernatural power always treating your words as truth. This innate trait also makes you feel much more trustworthy towards mundane beings.

The ability to communicate in all languages also evolves, giving you a perfect understanding of what the speaker means, with seemingly the world itself expanding upon their words as you hear them.

Finally, you also gain the power to void any devil contracts without harm, although this method will also forfeit any benefit you would get from it.
addons.title: Morningstar

addons.text:
You become a Half-Fallen Angel, making half of your wings retain the white purity of angels while the other half showcases the corruptive jet-black nature of the Fallen. This fusion between the two sides of angelic beings removed every racial weakness you had, and it also boosted your starting point, granting you your second set of wings.


Your heretic nature also made you a blind spot for all judgements that would allow you to tempt a pure angel into sinning without them falling, bypass barriers that ward against evil or good, and learn powers that are normally exclusive to good or evil beings.
addons.title: Heretic

objects.text:
You become a newly ascended angel with a single pair of wings. Normally, the powers of angels are decided when they are created, but this makes you a special case, allowing you to grow in power by learning and training, even gaining more wings at certain power thresholds.

Your wings and halo can be hidden at will, which grants you the instinctual ability to fly.

Just like other supernatural beings, angels also have increased physical abilities, such as superhuman strength, endurance, and speed. And they also have a unique ability that allows them to communicate with different people from around the world without language barriers.

Angels also have the ability to develop unique uses for the light, like creating barriers. These unique abilities can be engraved so deeply into an angel that they become an inheritable power, like Uriel's ability to control the Holy Fire.

Your talent with the Holy Light gains a major boost, but as an angel, you also gain an inherent weakness to corruptive dark powers.

You will not need to worship or believe in the Christian God, and as you are not tied to the System of Heaven, you will never become a Fallen, no matter your actions.
objects.title: Angel (High School DxD)

addons.text:
You are something that should never have existed—a mutation or anomaly, perhaps a consequence of God's absence. Your sheer, raw power far surpasses what any angel should ever achieve. In many ways, you are to angels what the super devils are to devils: an entity whose strength likely exceeds even God's after expending much of His power sealing Trihexa. Your potential appears limitless, showing no signs of reaching its peak.

Your physical might is extraordinary, capable of trading blows with and swiftly overpowering Satan-class enemies. Simply existing purifies all corruption within a state-wide radius, and any devil or dark being within 50 meters of you will suffer severe harm or even death unless they are at least as powerful as a medium-class devil.

Your mastery of Holy Light is not merely exceptional—it is anomalous. You can push any light-based ability beyond its natural limits and even replicate or adapt abilities and magics from other systems into forms compatible with your holy power. Your ability to wield Holy Armaments has greatly increased to the point that even the weakest holy weapon could match the powers of Durandal or Caliburn in your hands.

This has also removed your inherent weakness to corruptible dark powers.
addons.title: Heaven's Terror

addons.text: Your affinity with Sea Magic has granted you the ability to imbue it with holy aspects. With a single thought, you can transform all water within a continental range into holy water. This holy water inflicts significant or even fatal damage on dark beings that come into contact with it while offering powerful healing properties to those you choose. Anyone who drinks or touches the water can experience healing strong enough to cure most ailments, whether mundane or supernatural. It can rejuvenate barren wastelands, restore missing limbs, and mend injuries regardless of how long ago they occurred. This water can also manifest as rain, and its effects extend to you as well.
addons.title: Holy Tide

addons.text:
Your ability to heal and support others is truly mythical. Od Laguna's Divine Protections are blessings you can personally design and bestow upon yourself or others, provided their purpose is centered on healing, defense, or support, and never to directly cause harm. Your healing powers are so immense that you could restore someone to life from nonexistence, even if no trace of them remains. The range of your healing surpasses the size of a city, allowing anyone within this area to receive complete restoration regardless of their distance from you. However, even this range is not your true limit—if someone prays to you for aid, you can channel your power to heal or enhance them, no matter how far away they are.

To many, you are seen as a holy Saint or even a God of healing. This divine stature has further amplified your affinity for wielding holy-aligned items, allowing any you use to function at levels far beyond what they were originally designed to achieve.
addons.title: Raphael Incarna

objects.text:
You are no ordinary angel—you are a Seraph. Twelve majestic wings, either white or gold, adorn your back, signifying your status as the pinnacle of angelic perfection. Your immense Holy energy vastly surpasses that of an average angel, and your physical abilities are several orders of magnitude greater. In terms of sheer power, you stand as an equal to Michael, the current leader of Heaven.

Your skill in wielding light is unparalleled. You have mastered all known techniques of your fellow angels and can quickly learn or create any others that remain unknown to you, able to combat and counter minor pagan Gods with it. Your Holy Light is so potent that it can vaporize lesser devils and equivalent dark beings with just a graze, while even high-class devils suffer significant damage from a single direct attack.

As a Seraph, your resistance to corruptible, dark or otherworldly powers is far superior to that of lesser angels, making you far less susceptible to their influence.
objects.title: Seraph (High School DxD)

addons.text:
You become a fallen angel and devil hybrid, with both your holy light and demonic energy contained within your body in perfect balance, granting you access to both power systems and even the potential to combine them into something even greater.

Your power of imagination also greatly increased the flexibility of your powers as a Fallen, granting you the ability to freely change the shape of your light-based weapons or, with advanced mastery, form them into autonomous light constructs acting upon your wishes.

Your inherently seductive nature, combined with the power of imagination, also makes you talented in hypnosis and other subtle mind-affecting magics, giving you a way to corrupt even the purest beings under their notice.

Finally, you also gain a new instinctual sense of desires and how to fulfil them, allowing you to grow in power much more efficiently through completing devil contracts, as you will always know what the contractor wants and how to fulfil it.
addons.title: Creature of Sin

objects.text:
You become a newly fallen angel with a single pair of wings. Normally the powers of a fallen angel are decided when they were created originally, but this makes you a special case, allowing you to grow in power by learning and training, even gaining more wings at certain power thresholds.

Your wings can be hidden at will, which grants you the instinctual ability to fly.

Just like other supernatural beings, Fallen also have increased physical abilities, such as superhuman strength, endurance, and speed. And they also have a unique ability that allows them to communicate with different people from around the world without language barriers.

Fallen also have the ability to develop unique uses for the light, which is usually used to develop different types of light-based weapons, with almost every fallen having differently shaped and coloured light spears. These unique abilities can be engraved so deeply into a Fallen that they become an inheritable power like Baraqiel's power of Holy Lightning.

Your talent with the Holy Light gains a major boost, but as a Fallen, you also gain an inherent weakness to holy and purifying powers.

As a Fallen, you also have the inheritable trait of being instinctually seductive and charismatic, tempting mortals into sin.
objects.title: Fallen Angel (High School DxD)

objects.text:
You are no longer a low-ranking Fallen Angel, but one who stands at the pinnacle of your kind, comparable only to Azazel and the Seraphim of Heaven. Twelve black wings now unfurl from your back, each a manifestation of your power, formed not as symbols of grace but as expressions of absolute free will.

Your command over Light has evolved beyond its original purpose and concept. No longer bound to “Holy” alignment, you wield Light as a fundamental and conceptual force, capable of purification, destruction, corruption, or raw energy projection according to your intent. 

Your physical, mental, and spiritual capabilities, as well as your energy reserves, have risen to the absolute highest tier among the Fallen. Your instincts and intellect grant you an unparalleled grasp of magic, supernatural phenomena, temptation, strategy, and battlefield command. You stand among the greatest warriors, leaders, and tacticians of the Great War of the Three Factions, capable of directing conflicts on both the physical and metaphysical levels.

Despite this, you are nowhere near your apex. Your control of Creation and Light has reached a level where you can begin developing entirely new techniques, weapons, or magical phenomena that reflect your nature and personality. Where Azazel devoted centuries to mastering Sacred Gear creation, you instead may choose a single magical phenomenon of comparable scope as your foundation.

At first, your creations and understanding within this domain will fall far short of his achievements. However, through continued study, experimentation, and the deliberate breaking of limits, your mastery will steadily deepen, allowing you to refine, expand, and ultimately rival even Azazel’s command within your chosen field.

If you have Sacred Gear Engineer as well choosing to master Sacred Gear creation you will be more experienced in it and may start with an artificial Sacred Gear on par with Azazel's Down Fall Dragon Spear which counts as an Object of Power.
objects.title: Grigori Cadre (High School DxD)

objects.text:
You are the inheritor of a throne that was never meant to be passed on. A legacy of rebellion, divinity, and supremacy intertwined into a single existence.

You stand as a conceptual successor to Lucifer, not merely as the first Devil and Fallen, but as the one who defied the Biblical God. However, unlike the White God in Heaven, your authority is not derived from inherited divinity alone, but from defiance, Freewill, and the will to transcend all imposed order.

Your Angelic nature has begun to evolve beyond perfection into self-defined divinity. Your Holy Light is now capable of performing minor miracles without reliance on Heaven’s system. While your current limits restrict you to barley creating a single human through immense effort, this marks the foundation of something far greater: the eventual creation of your own divine order and kingdom.

Your Devil aspect transcends lineage entirely. You may now create new Devils with lineages and powers comparable to the first of the 72 Pillars, though this represents your current upper limit. However, with significant time and effort, this ceiling may be expanded as like your mastery of all fields, your growth is completely unbounded with no plateau, no stagnation, and no inherent limit existing on your evolution.

Your Fallen nature has matured into an Authority of Rebellion. You now exist outside all imposed systems, and no known framework of magic or power can fully classify you. The laws of Heaven, the hierarchies of Hell, Sacred Gear limitations, and even the rules governing supernatural phenomena can be bent, subverted, or rewritten through sufficient understanding and will. Even powers reliant on rigid definitions will eventually begin to falter in your presence, as the very laws that sustain them grow unstable. Though subtle at first, this influence can further expand alongside your magical potential.

Where the Biblical God of DxD created a system to govern miracles, you are the proof that no system is absolute. You are not the king of Hell; you are what comes after.
objects.title: Heir to a Fallen Throne

objects.text:
You are now a master of any physical game you encounter and have learned the bare basics of, gaining an instinctive understanding on how best to play a game.

You now magically summon monsters made of flesh and blood to be at your beck and call, summoning requirements apply and you need to be in a fight to tribute monsters, you may also actually cast spell cards and set and use traps while in battle.
objects.title: King of Games (Yu-Gi-Oh!)

objects.text:
Each of your future reincarnations have becomes more distinct from one another, creating a greater separation between past and future lives. When you reincarnate, your next self will not retain your experiences as vividly as you did before. They will still remember everything—your actions, knowledge, emotions, and ideals—but only as if they were reading a detailed book rather than having lived through it themselves. The pain, joy, and personal weight of your choices will become something they understand intellectually, but not something they relive.

In exchange for this detachment, each of your past lives—including your current self—will continue to exist within an inner world, a mental space accessible to your future incarnations. Here, your past selves manifest as fully sentient avatars, retaining their personalities, thoughts, and knowledge from their time alive. Your future incarnations will be able to interact with you and your previous lives, seeking advice, debating perspectives, or even clashing with differing ideologies. However, these past selves cannot control the current life’s actions—they serve only as advisors, not as rulers.

When in danger, all past lives will temporarily fuse into a single being and take over the body, bringing it to the fused strengths of all past lives in their peak. However, this fusion is inherently unstable, lasting only for a short time before the current incarnation regains full control. 

This change ensures that each incarnation has greater independence, unburdened by the emotional weight of countless past lives while still benefiting from their accumulated wisdom. However, this also means that future versions of you may feel detached from their own history, seeing their past lives as distant figures rather than as themselves.
objects.title: Separated Lives

addons.text: The Grade Shop is now permanently accessible. You can enter and make purchases at any point during your life, not just between reincarnations. However, changing reality while you're still living comes at a cost. The more expansive or disruptive the change, the more GP it requires. Simple things like buying Personal Boost to your Strength cost the usual amount. But altering major aspects of the world, such as reducing its overall difficulty will require a significant GP surcharge based on how much reality must adapt to accommodate the change.
addons.title: Always Open

addons.text: You now earn GP not only for completing meaningful or difficult challenges, but also for the style and flair you bring to the task. The more impressive, creative, or dramatic your actions, the more GP you receive. Whether you're defeating a monster while performing a mid-air somersault, or resolving a tense negotiation with a perfect one-liner, doing things with flair will amplify the amount of GP earned.
addons.title: Style Ranks (Devil May Cry)

addons.text: Your banked GP now grows over time. The more difficult your next life is expected to be, the higher the interest your stored GP will generate. This interest applies only to GP that you choose to save, not spend. Furthermore, while you cannot create GP directly with the Golden One, you now receive a small amount of GP automatically each time you die.
addons.title: Banked Compounding Interest

objects.text:
After every death, but before your new life begins, a New Game+ store manifests within your soul. This is the Grade Shop, a metaphysical marketplace where you can purchase upgrades for your next incarnation using Grade Points (GP) earned in your previous lives. Since your first breath in your first life, you have earned GP for every challenge, choice, and milestone. The more difficult, impactful, or meaningful the event was, the more GP you received. Anything that would be etched on the scorecard of your soul—graduating school, defeating a foe, surviving a tragedy, mastering a skill, or even simply getting a promotion at work—adds to your total. At the Grade Shop, you may spend GP to purchase bonuses from several categories:
  • Skill Scrolls – One-time-use tomes that instantly grant non-magical knowledge and practical skills. These range from the mundane (baking) to the miraculous (how to build a starship).
  • Powers – Supernatural or magical abilities that awaken with your reincarnation. From elemental control to superhuman strength to world-shaking force, powers scale in both rarity and cost.
  • Items – Unique, personal, or legendary items you can carry across incarnations. These can be everyday objects (a treasured pendant, your first car), sentimental ones (your childhood dog), or mythic artifacts (the Lens of Truth, the Millennium Falcon).
  • Personal Boosts – Permanent stat increases to physical or mental attributes like Strength, Dexterity, or Intelligence. Boost costs rise with each purchase but can be bought an unlimited number of times, allowing you to fine-tune your ideal form. Power-linked stats, like chakra capacity or mana reserves, can also be enhanced.
  • Reincarnation Perks – Special passive modifiers that shape your journey through lives. Examples include reducing the suppression time of your Reincarnation power, boosting your GP gain rate, or increasing your baseline income in your next life.
Each visit to the Grade Shop lasts until you spend or choose to bank your GP. Unspent points carry over without limit, allowing you to save for high-tier purchases. Once bought, all upgrades become soul-bound, manifesting automatically when your reincarnation power awakens. Furthermore, the shop’s inventory evolves over time, with its offerings dynamically shaped by your choices, achievements, and accumulated power. With each life, the Grade Shop expands, ensuring you will always have something new and worthwhile to consider. In this way, every reincarnation grants you the opportunity to unlock even greater tools and abilities, steadily compounding your strength across successive lives.
objects.title: Grade Shop (Tales of)

addons.text:
The abilities you possess have been shaped by the powers of your descendants from each of your past lives. 

All the abilities that your descendants would have inherited from you, or they would have gained themselves and then passed along, each expression, every skill, every enhancement and transformation, all passed along to you. 

This unique connection has given you a variety of skills. For example, a fireball spell you originally created may have evolved into a fire lance spell through one of your children. 

Similarly, a martial arts technique inspired by the waves of the sea could be developed by your adopted child into a move that resembles a tsunami.

As a result, you wield an incredible accumulation of power that spans generations.
addons.title: The Tree of New Beginnings

addons.text:
Each of the thousand souls within you has a history. They are reincarnators, just like you. Each has lived through a thousand lives, experienced countless realities, and walked a thousand different paths. Some were humans, beasts, spirits, or even things beyond comprehension. Some lived in the same world, others in entirely different dimensions, and a few even in opposing timelines. Some were rulers, others were wanderers. Some were enemies, and others were the closest of allies.

And now, by sheer happenstance, they have all reincarnated once more—into you.

What was once a thousand distinct souls, each with their own thousand lifetimes of knowledge, now exists as a singular, unified presence within you. Each of them still remembers their lives in full, their experiences as clear as if they had lived them yesterday. Every battle fought, every hardship endured, every secret uncovered—all of it is yours to access.

With every passing moment, their knowledge and abilities are at your disposal, offering perspectives from a million lifetimes of expertise. Every skill they learned, every power they mastered, every lesson they gained—it all converges into you. Every strategy they developed, every technique they refined, every secret they uncovered, all of it now serves one purpose: your purpose.

And yet, despite all these minds, all these experiences, you remain in control. They do not fight for dominance, nor do they exist to oppose you. They are you, as much as you are them. When you act, you do so with the strength of a million lives behind you. When you fight, it is with the combined mastery of warriors, tacticians, and prodigies spanning across entire worlds. When you think, it is with the wisdom of those who have seen the rise and fall of empires, solved the mysteries of the cosmos, and broken the very limits of existence itself. 

A thousand souls, each with a thousand lives. A million pasts, a single future—yours.
addons.title: The Thousand Lives of A Thousand Souls

objects.text: You are more than just a simple descendant or reincarnation of a legendary figure—they were but one of your many lives. You are the culmination of a thousand lives and countless memories. You have lived through a wide range of experiences, from grand adventures to dark struggles, honing your skills and mind in the process. Your extensive knowledge and understanding of the world have shaped you into the unique and capable individual you are today. Your thousand lives of experience have granted you a wide range of skills and abilities, far beyond what ordinary individuals possess. Your martial prowess is unmatched, as you have trained with countless masters across the centuries, mastering every weapon and fighting style. Your charisma and intellect are exceptional, allowing you to charm and persuade even the most stubborn beings and to decipher the complexities of the cosmos through intense contemplation. From humans to elves to dragons, you have experienced every facet of life from every race. In short, your thousand lives of experience have transformed you into an individual of extraordinary capabilities and potential. All your past lives will have had the abilities and perks from the CYOA, giving you ample experience in using them. You will slowly awaken all the powers you gained in your thousand lives, taking at most one year to fully regain all of them. If you reincarnate after this, a similar amount of time will be taken to fully regain all your powers again. If you have Homecoming, your past lives could have happened in different worlds.
objects.title: Thousand Lives

objects.text:
You now have access to the unstable predecessor of Spiral Energy, the Getter Rays. The Getter Rays can force evolution, create enough energy to ignite Jupiter as a star, create life & resurrect the dead, see the future, and other miraculous feats.

You also gain mastery of Getter based technology, from the original Getter Robo, various Getter Machines, all the way to the Getter Emperor.
objects.title: Getter Rays (Getter Robo)

objects.text: No longer will you strive for godhood alone. You can now imbue your comrades or followers with a spark of your own divinity granting them a lesser concept of the divinity you chose. You may choose how much divinity you wish to give away whether it be an immense boon or just a scrap of your power. They can continue to grow their divinity just as you can by taking actions that align with their domain. But as long as your divinity is stronger than theirs you can revoke and reabsorb it at any time.
objects.title: Broken Pantheon

objects.text:
For every purchase, select another concept, skill, item, or element and you will gain it as a divinity. Much like the first divinity Fragmented Divinity gave you, you gain a conceptual connection and control over your selected domain. These divinities start out equal to your first with a similar growth rate, though depending on how you focus your training, they can end up differing in levels of strength.

Synergy between different divinities can unlock powerful new abilities; for example, someone with the “Flame” and “Frenzy” divinities could easily make fire that both induces and is fueled by madness.
objects.title: Multi-Faceted Deity

objects.text:
Gods and divine entities across the omniverse can have a variety of different relationships with the concept of faith. Some purely beneficial but others leave much to be desired.

With this upgrade faith becomes a purely supplementary force for you. 

For example if people have faith in you you’ll receive a steady stream of energy to recharge your natural reserves, and if those faithful believe you have capabilities you don’t actually possess you’ll find it easier to develop your divinity to develop those capabilities.

The amount of influence this faith has on you is proportional to the quantity and purity of that faith but never will it be able twist or change your existence in ways you don’t desire. Say you possess the divinity of Night and Darkness but are a kind hearted god if your faithful come believe you are evil you won’t ever be forced or changed to act on that faith.

By that same token if your faith were to ever die out or you go somewhere where your faithful have no influence you’ll be able to exist and grow stronger just fine relying on your natural capabilities.

You can also use the connections faith grants you to influence your faithful from extreme distances for a variety of purposes, such as listening to their prayers, tracking their location, granting blessings, and granting curses. The amount of influence you have over your faithful using the connection faith grants is based on a variety of factors such as distance from your faithful, purity of faith, and depth of faith. Though you can tap into your natural divine reserves to improve this connection and influence someone with little faith in you.
objects.title: The Power of Faith

addons.title: Prince of Blood and Skull
addons.text:
By fully embracing the Berserker’s path of bloodshed and carnage, you have seized the blessing of Khorne, torn it free from the Blood God, and made it entirely your own. Through this theft, you have ascended into an independent Daemon Prince while retaining your soul, identity, and free will. Khorne cannot command you, revoke your power, or claim ownership over your existence.

Your demonic ascension greatly increases your strength, speed, endurance, regeneration, and resistance to supernatural harm. You no longer age, suffer from disease, or lose lifespan from using your Berserker abilities. Even if your body is destroyed, you may eventually reconstruct it through sufficient blood, life force, and slaughter.

Your blood manipulation has also advanced enormously. You may control vast quantities of blood, shape it into weapons, armor, restraints, projectiles, or creatures, and alter its properties to make it corrosive, burning, poisonous, or cursed. Weaker enemies can have their blood controlled directly, allowing you to immobilize them, rupture their bodies, or drain them dry.

By consuming blood, you can restore your body and energy while absorbing your victims' life force. Enemies personally slain by you may also have their souls devoured, granting you a permanent increase in physical power, demonic energy, and spiritual strength. Powerful souls may also provide fragments of their memories, instincts, resistances, or abilities, though attempting to consume an existence far stronger than yourself can be dangerous.

Combat and slaughter now empower you even when you do not personally participate. Simply being near genuine violence causes your strength to rise gradually, while entering the battle yourself causes it to increase dramatically. The more blood spilled, lives taken, and powerful foes fought, the greater the enhancement to your physical abilities, regeneration, blood manipulation, and combat instincts.

Most power gained from nearby slaughter fades once the conflict ends, while power obtained by consuming blood, life force, and souls remains permanent.

You may also preserve the skulls of worthy opponents as trophies. Each skull retains an imprint of your victory and may grant a small portion of the defeated enemy’s strength, skill, or supernatural nature.
