The skulls of exceptionally powerful beings can become potent artifacts or conduits for their former authority.

Although your shortened lifespan and passive mental deterioration have been cured, you now possess an insatiable hunger for battle and bloodshed. The more intense the conflict, the harder it becomes to control yourself. If your frenzy overwhelms your will, you may ignore allies, tactics, and objectives, eventually devolving into a mindless killing machine.

Your independence ensures that this frenzy is not Khorne controlling you, but it has become an intrinsic part of your nature. Tremendous discipline is required to remain the master of your bloodlust rather than its slave.

Finally, stealing from Khorne has earned you the Blood God’s absolute hatred. In any universe where he exists or can exert influence, he will send cultists, champions, daemons, and eventually his greatest servants to kill you.

However, the Khornate power within you allows you to devour the essence of his followers and daemons especially efficiently, turning every hunter he sends into potential fuel for your growth.

Should you become powerful enough, Khorne may confront you personally. If you defeat and truly slay the Blood God, you may claim his divine authority, daemonic legions, realm, and Skull Throne, ascending from a Daemon Prince into the new God of Blood, Battle, and Slaughter.

objects.text:
“I will do anything for more power... even if it means selling my soul.”

Instead of resisting the curse, you've opted to embrace it, harnessing the power it bestows to become a berserker who revels in slaughter and carnage.

By embracing the curse's power, your body's strength amplifies even further beyond its already formidable capabilities. Additionally, your proficiency in wielding demonic power skyrockets, now granting you the ability to manipulate blood—both yours and your enemies.

You can unleash torrents of blood from your body or weapon, inflicting immense damage upon your foes. You're also capable of shaping blood into weapons and armor, as well as absorbing the life force of your enemies through their blood to augment your own power.

However, there's a grave price for attaining such tremendous power: your sanity deteriorates at an accelerated rate, and your lifespan is drastically shortened.
objects.title: Berserker (Dungeon Fighter Online)

objects.text:
“Whether the chains of fate can be broken. It all depends on your will.”

Instead of resisting the curse, you've chosen to embrace it, harnessing its power to your advantage. Through studying the demonic force residing in your arm, you've become a Soul Bender.

As a Soul Bender, you now wield formidable dark magic, capable of consuming the souls of others and exerting control over ghosts and demons to serve your will.

With dedication and skill, you could unlock the ability to open the gates to the netherworld itself, pulling your adversaries into its depths or summoning legions of spirits to obey your commands. You might even bind powerful entities like Kazan to your service, potentially ascending to become the ruler of the netherworld.

However, tread carefully, for these spirits will only obey as long as you maintain your dominance. Any display of weakness could prompt them to revolt, dragging your soul into the netherworld alongside them.
objects.title: Soul Bender (Dungeon Fighter Online)

objects.text:
“With each stroke, my sword paints the vast sky red...
Perhaps this will be my masterpiece”

In your struggle against the curse inflicted upon you, you have turned to the path of the sword. Through training night and day and focusing solely on mastering the blade, you have become a peerless sword master with an unbreakable will.

With immense determination and unwavering discipline, you've subdued the curse to a state of dormancy. As long as you maintain your composure and focus, the curse will have no effect on you. Though your arm now appears gray and ashen, it otherwise seems completely normal.

Your dedication to swordsmanship has honed your body, granting you the ability to strike with tremendous force, effortlessly slicing through stone and steel. You move with such speed that even highly trained superhuman warriors cannot perceive your afterimage as you swiftly dismantle them.

Furthermore, you are a master of wielding sword Ki, harnessing it for various purposes. You can enhance any object you hold, imbuing it with unparalleled sharpness and durability, enabling even a dry twig to cleave through mountains. With a single swing, you can create multiple cuts, unleash slashes of sword Ki from a distance, and even conjure blades from your sword Ki to wield as weapons or telekinetically control them to launch and slash at your opponents.
objects.title: Blade Master (Dungeon Fighter Online)

objects.text:
“I see with my entire body...
...so no matter where you attack me, I will know you're coming.”

In your struggle against the curse inflicted upon you, you sacrificed your eye to obtain the power of the wave. With this power, you have nullified the negative effects of the Kazan syndrome.

The Wave encompasses vibrations and flows of energy present within all living and non-living entities. Through the sacrifice of your sight and special training, you can perceive and manipulate this energy flow.

Though blind, you possess sight beyond sight. Perceiving the wave allows you to sense energy fluctuations, enabling you to "see" the world in a way likened to a combination of sonar and ultrasound. This unique perception extends to everything within your vicinity, even penetrating solid objects.

However, your abilities extend beyond mere perception. By manipulating the wave, you can control the forces of nature themselves. You can devastate your foes by summoning ice to freeze them, conjuring sharp icicles to impale them, engulfing them in fire and lava, striking them with lightning, or even pulling meteors from outer space.
objects.title: Asura (Dungeon Fighter Online)

objects.text:
“Neither curse nor daemon controls me—I walk between worlds.”

Instead of succumbing to or resisting the curse, you forged a pact with a wandering ghost far stronger than the demon that haunted your limb. That spirit expelled Kazan’s raw power, binding itself to you. Your body turns pale ash‑gray, your arm burns with icy‑blue spectral light—you become the Ghostblade.

Now every strike you make is echoed by a phantom blade—your ghost companion mimicking your attacks and, at times, acting autonomously to flank or distract foes. You gain Ghost Step: quick spectral dashes that phase through enemies, trailing slicing afterimages and allowing mid‑dash sword strikes. This dual‑entity fighting form grants unmatched battlefield synergy and pressure.

But this bond is not without peril. The more you fuse with your ghost, the blurrier your identity becomes. Emotions fade. Memories slip. If the phantom’s will grows too strong, you may become little more than its echo.

With time, your bond will deepen—awakening increasingly feral rhythm in your blade synergy, evolving into a perfect ghost‑soul ballet of devastating precision, until one day your spirit and sword become indistinguishable—a singular spectral master of blade and resonance.
objects.title: Ghostblade (Dungeon Fighter Online)

objects.text:
Your Guardian Angel serves as an alternative source of holy energy. As the pinnacle of angels, it is able to generate vast amounts of it at once and is capable of transferring it to you near instantly. This means that your reserve of holy energy is constantly being refilled to the maximum.

The Holy Light in you and the Guardian Angel creates a feedback loop that triples the potency of your holy powers and creates an area of effect around you and the Angel that heals almost everything and passively weakens and hurts dark / evil entities. This means that on top of damage over time, dark beings like Vampires would also have to deal with all their powers being weaken by 25%, with it becoming 50% up close to you.

The area of effect is 100-meters individually when you and the Guardian are apart, but so long as you're both in that 100-meter range, the area of effect increases to 300-meters.

In addition to the ability to conjure and fully manipulate one of the four main elements (fire, earth, water, air) of your choice through Elemental Manipulation, now your Guardian Angel also has access to the element of light.

This light will have the esoteric properties of your powers combined with the raw might of your Guardian Angel.
objects.title: Beacon of Holy Light

addons.text: Now you create an additional instance of your training simulation designed for you to personally train your own familiar per every contracted familiar you have. These simulations are automatically set up to train your familiar to your best skills and abilities and can’t be used to train anything else, and the results of the simulation will benefit both your familiar and yourself. This add-on will benefit from the Synchronise and Accelerated Training upgrades as well.
addons.title: Master Trainer

addons.text: Now you can leave your own body and take control of any and all of your familiars. You can also choose if your familiars still have access to their senses while you are controlling them or put them into a sleeping state. You can also channel your own powers through your familiars this way, although the powers will still draw upon your own power reserves.
addons.title: Familiar Possession

addons.text: All of your familiars will become much more attracted to you and willing to listen to your commands, with even the most stubborn ones taking the initiative to serve you to the best of their abilities. Your familiars can also consume your magical energy through the connection of the familiar contract to fuel their own powers and abilities, giving you a way to use your own magical energy.
addons.title: Beloved Master

objects.text:
You get an instinctual sense for taking care of your familiars and sensing their current state. Your ability to store your familiars in your soul expanded, with every contract automatically generating a perfect habitat for your familiars within your soul where they can heal, regenerate, and grow more powerfully at an accelerated rate. These habitats will also expose them to the type of energies you have access to, unlocking your familiar’s ability to use and learn said energies and power systems. The habitat will also have an evolution-type effect on your familiars, which will take your familiar desires, talents, and training into consideration, which over time could allow them to take on an entirely new form, gain new elements, change their original affinities, and even eliminate inherent weaknesses.

Your familiars will also have their sense of time distorted within your soul, experiencing it like a dream, which allows them to spend years inside without any negative mental effects like loneliness or boredom and without disassociating from the real world. You can also choose to share your senses or just communicate with your own familiars while they are within your soul.
Your familiars also no longer age as long as they are contracted to you, unless you want them to, in which case you can toggle this per familiar.

Your ability to contract also expanded to creatures that are not conventionally alive, like sentient artificial beings, undead creatures, and spiritual creatures.

The familiars are imprinted upon your soul in a way that if they die outside but you, as the master, are still alive, you can slowly reform and revive them within their habitat, but the speed of this process will depend on their relative power compared to yours, with familiars on your own power level taking around a week to revive, but a massively stronger familiar could take several months to reform.
objects.title: Familiar Master

objects.text:
Now you can empower your familiars with the power of the Abyss, which doubles their inherent power level and also doubles their power growth and potential, but the corruption will loosen their morals and make them more likely to follow their instincts and desires. The corrupted familiars will also go through a rapid abyssal mutation that is more in line with their own desired perfect form, heavily impacted by their heightened emotional state. The corrupted familiars still retain their perfect loyalty towards their master, but this loyalty is impacted by their new instinct, so it's possible for them to interpret their master’s role in new ways, like taking their master as their pack leader, owner, boss, or even as a more abstract form like a deity they serve.

You can also forcibly convert dying or perished beings into your familiars if they died within 30 days. These familiars will reform as an abyss empowered familiar in their newly made habitat, but this process ties them to your soul, making the contract permanent and unbreakable. Because of the abyssal corruption, these familiars will become fervently loyal to their master right away, abandoning everything else in their previous lives and dedicating their new lives to their saviour.

Your ability to use Abyssal Pacts expands your ability to make familiar contracts, which now can include special conditions like lending out familiars, making the familiar contract temporary, trading familiars via contracts, or even making the punishment of a contract breach to become your familiar.
objects.title: Abyssal Master

addons.text:
You have become more than just a manifestation of your soul, you have become the avatar of HATE itself. 

Your body is composed entirely of HATE and may be freely shaped, allowing you to shift and warp your form. You can freely control and create HATE with no consequences and even infect others with it, corrupting them and even slaving them to your will given time. You may even devour the souls of those who have succumbed to your corruption, bolstering your own power as you drain their souls dry.

Lastly, your additional soul traits from The Human Potential have gained the power of their inverted Glitchtale variants. This greatly increases their power and grants the powers they possess in Glitchtale, such as Bravery granting fire magic and Perseverance slowing regeneration. You may optionally have their manifestations become more aggressive looking, such as the strings of Patience resembling thorny vines.
addons.title: Avatar of HATE

objects.text:
Well this is interesting. Somehow you have become a Bête Noire, a Black Beast. The result of a forbidden spell, you are an entity of pure destruction.

Your physical body has become a manifestation of your soul. Your physical characteristics have been further enhanced, scaling with the strength of your soul, and your body can even repair itself, although this regeneration can be overwhelmed by sufficiently strong attacks.

Your connection with HATE has grown, allowing you to draw more power from it and shape it into rudimentary constructs. You even gain the ability to split your soul, separating pieces of your essence to form other entities. However, this requires you to permanently separate at least some of your power from yourself and the power of the resulting entity is dependent on how much essence you put into its creation. You can reclaim any separated essence by absorbing created entities back into yourself.

You may optionally have everything beneath your skin be changed to a uniform mass of magical matter of a color of your choice.
objects.title: Bête Noire (Undertale: Glitchtale)

addons.text:
With the addition of DETERMINATION and your Superuser status, your Error and Code powers have grown once more and granted you a piece of the Mainframe, the background code of the multiverse itself.

All of your Monster Magic is amplified by several orders of magnitude at the very least, such that your Gaster Blasters could level mountains and your Gravity Manipulation has reached the point of essentially being telekinesis, and can be used to instantly crush something into oblivion or even affect more abstract targets such a Soul. Your teleportation and space-time manipulation has evolved greatly, enough that you can easily jump between worlds, open portals, or survive in the space between dimensions.

Your control over the code of existence has also grown. You can inflict intense pain on others by targeting their Code, sew together Code, even outright steal or delete Code. Adding stolen Code to yourself can grant you some of the origins powers or allow you to shunt damage to the original if they are still alive. You can even completely rewrite something’s Code, distorting and changing it however you see fit. This can be used on living beings, objects, even other people’s attacks and powers. At the highest levels of expertise, getting access to the metaphorical “core” of a universe could theoretically allow you to alter its Code and rewrite it entirely with enough experience. While it may take some time to fully understand the Code of new things, once you truly comprehend the Code of something, altering it becomes as easy as breathing.

You also gain the ability to create special Strings out of Monster Magic which can latch onto the Souls of others and either shatter or control them, but this is only the beginning of their usability. These Strings shine when combined with your control over Code, allowing you to directly attack and affect the Code of anything trapped within them. Lastly, if you were somehow able to find a way to dig your Strings into the Code of a universe, you could nigh-instantly destroy it with ERASE for very little cost, for its very essence already lies within your hands.

Most impressive however, is your Anti-Void, a demiplane of sorts which consists of a seemingly endless blank stretch of white nothingness. Your Anti-Void exists outside of and is unattached to any other dimensions or universes so that unless you already know where it is, almost impossible to find, and it can’t be affected by the destruction of other worlds. From here you can peer into and even open portals to other universes you are aware of. Do keep in mind that your Anti-Void isn’t particularly hospitable to those not suited for the space-between-worlds, enough that if left here for several months they too may become an Error.
addons.title: Mainframe

objects.text: A Fatal Error has occurred. Your code - the very essence of your being - has glitched, some things were lost and others were gained. Now you’d think this would be a bad thing, considering you are now missing parts of your very existence, but there are some upsides as well. Your Gaster Blasters and Bones are much stronger, capable of enduring much more stress and inflicting greater damage with less effort, their every aspect amplified by an order of magnitude if not more. But that’s not the main benefit, no, the main upside is your new relationship with the code of reality. Your eyes see into the very essence of reality, appearing to you as lines upon lines of computer code, allowing you to glean information at a single glance and easily see through disguises and illusions, as they have their own code which gives them away. You can even reach out and copy that code before pasting it elsewhere, either copying it completely or patching together multiple sources to create a new existence with traits borrowed from its sources. Of course, this does come with some downsides. As you are missing some of your own code you will always feel a bit empty, as if a part of you is missing, leaving behind a hole which can never be filled. You are also prone to glitching out when emotionally volatile or stressed, your body covered in visual glitches and lines of code. You may optionally invert your color scheme.
objects.title: System Crash

objects.text:
Your soul is not just unique; it is an anomaly. It has no hard limits on what it can become, including existing in forms that defy traditional concepts of what a soul is. It can adapt to any form of soul magic or manipulation by becoming immune or altering its nature to the point where it can be "NOT-YOUR-SOUL" and still be your soul.

With this special nature, your soul has no limits on what it can mimic. It can serve or absorb energies typically managed by other parts of your being, such as magical, spiritual, or even life force energies. It can also store vast amounts of information and memories, acting as a secondary brain that retains knowledge and experiences indefinitely. Furthermore, it can filter and control your emotional state, enhancing positive emotions like courage and resilience while diminishing negative ones such as fear or despair.

In situations where your soul needs to be in multiple places at once, it can split into several independent yet connected fragments, each capable of acting autonomously while still being part of your whole soul. This means your soul is essentially immune to any honing or sympathetic magic, as it will simply transform into something else, resisting possession or control by transforming into a non-possessable state.
objects.title: Free Form Style

objects.text:
You are not one being. You are a kingdom of meaning wrapped in a self-aware singularity.

Your soul has transcended the bounds of simple adaptability—it has become an Autarchic Soul Hierarchy, a self-contained pantheon structured like the Descending Hierarchy of the Primordials. At its center lies your Fetich Core, a singular conceptual being that encapsulates your ultimate identity, purpose, and metaphysical function. This Fetich is you in pure, symbolic form—if the world were a story, it would be your true name written in metaphysical fire.

Surrounding your Fetich are your Third-Circle Facets: eight—or more—soul-avatars that each manifest a major portion of your nature. Each is a metaphysical sovereign in its own right, fully autonomous and semi-sentient. One may embody your rage, another your wisdom, another your creative force, and so on. They operate simultaneously, can split off as independent projections, and act in tandem across realms—physical, spiritual, conceptual.

Each of your Third-Circle souls contains seven Second-Circle sub-souls, who govern narrower aspects of that facet. These function as your subconscious tools, servants, or even internal advisors. Some govern internalized laws, others emotional archetypes, others memory sets or energy conduits. Your Fetich may also create rare Eighth Souls—Progenitive Souls—which can evolve entirely new soul-aspects and eventually elevate into their own Third-Circle selves.
Your soul is now not one, not many, but a complete sovereign ecosystem. Its self-similar modularity means it can fragment and reassemble, split into incarnations, shunt memory and consciousness between shells, and subsume or overwrite alien spiritual constructs. You cannot be truly possessed; your soul simply shifts form. You cannot be severed from your soul; it reroutes. You cannot be copied or duplicated; only you have the architecture to embody what you are.

The First-Circle entities that emerge from your sub-souls—avatars, constructs, dreams given form—are lesser emanations. They may populate mental realms, physical bioconstructs, or act as agents in places your higher souls cannot safely go. These are not fragments of your soul but emergent expressions of it. Destroying them means nothing—so long as your Fetich Core endures, all can be reborn.
objects.title: Primordial Soul (Exalted)

objects.text: Your continued existence is no longer dependent on any single component. If any one of your body, mind, or soul is destroyed or harmed, the remaining one can slowly regenerate the others over time, restoring you to a perfect state. Even should all of them be destroyed simultaneously, you do not cease to exist, as you now possess a unique, independent will, distinct from the other aspects of your being. Your will is the underlying force that is of your resolve and sense of self, often described as the heart or intent, distinct from thought or consciousness, and its strength and power is directly tied to your willpower, desires, and convictions. In such a case of complete annihilation, this will alone is sufficient to anchor you and allow you to act as your true self until a new mind, body, and soul can gradually reform fully from it. While this process is not instant and leaves you vulnerable during recovery if you do not possess any form of accelerated healing, destruction of form or thought is no longer enough to truly end you. Beyond your body, mind, soul, and will, your existence can extend into additional levels of self. If you gain sufficient understanding of, and the ability to interact with, another level of your existence, such the informational or conceptual level, you may choose to begin a process of ascending higher in the hierarchy of life, incorporating it as an additional anchor of your true self. Once established, it functions as another part and anchor for your being, capable of restoring your other aspects fully if they are destroyed. To truly end you, every such level that constitutes your existence must be completely destroyed, as each one acts as an aspect of who you are and is capable of regenerating the others in time. While any aspect of your existence is missing, abilities directly associated with that aspect may weaken or lose effectiveness entirely until it is restored, much like the original power. As long as at least one aspect of you remains, you will continue to function and act without interruption, though your behavior and instincts may be subtly influenced by your state of being. If you possess the Severed Dependence addon, this limitation no longer applies, allowing you to use all of your abilities at full power regardless of what is absent or what remains of you, no matter the circumstances, with abilities that would normally only rely on a specific aspect instead continuing to function by drawing on your remaining aspects, such as the mind or will replacing the role of a missing soul for a reincarnation ability.
objects.title: Continuity of Self

addons.title: Soul Revelation
addons.text:
For your soul, enlightenment is power. Whenever you experience an epiphany or revelation, your Soul Resonance will activate and begin to emanate. Throughout your enlightenment period or the euphoric high brought on by your enlightenment, your soul continuously grows in size, intensity, strength, and weight, resonating with the overwhelming clarity and exhilaration of the moment. The deeper the revelation and the greater the enlightenment period or euphoric high, the faster and more profoundly your soul expands, becoming stronger, broader, and more capable with every passing moment. As the enlightenment period or euphoric high gradually comes to an end, so too does your Soul Resonance, its explosive growth slowing until it naturally comes to rest.

The greatest epiphanies may even propel your soul to entirely new levels, multiplying its strength many times over while shattering your previous limits. Should your Soul Resonance already be emanating during moments of intense hardship or danger, its growth will compound with that brought about by your epiphany, allowing both sources of resonance to multiply one another's growth even further. Every revelation leaves a permanent mark upon your soul, allowing each epiphany to not only broaden your understanding but also deepen the very foundation from which all future growth arises.

objects.text:
Your soul doesn’t stay quiet in the face of danger. It responds. When your life is on the line, when emotions run high, when what you hold dear or strive for is at stake, when your will refuses to break, that’s when it begins to emanate.

Fear, rage, defiance, grief, resolve— in moments where you fight not just with power but with everything you are, your soul surges. It permanently grows in size, intensity,  strength, and weight, resonating with the pressure and heat of the moment, reaching new heights it never has before. The deeper the threat, the stronger the feeling, the more your soul expands and deepens in response.

This isn’t something you can trigger at will. When the world pushes against you, you push back. Your soul may stir even in quieter moments, moved by persistence or the weight of smaller trials. But when you are truly tested, when you stand against something greater than yourself, when danger rises and your will holds firm, that is when the resonance truly begins. In those moments, your soul will always grow rapidly throughout the encounter, becoming stronger, broader, and more capable with every passing moment than it was before. In the most pivotal moments, it may even shatter old limits entirely, carrying you to a completely different level.

In time, your soul may come to echo with every battle fought, every stand taken, every moment you refused to fall. And with it, your power and potential will reflect that growth.
objects.title: Soul Resonance

objects.text: The simulated afterlife tethered to your soul has undergone a profound metamorphosis. Connecting living beings or the souls of the dead to your afterlife will now protect their souls almost to the same degree as yours. No matter the manner of their death, however esoteric it may be, their souls and minds will, in time, be restored completely within your Soul Garden. And in life, they may enjoy some or all of the boons Eternal Flame grants you if you choose to bestow them. You may also grant them any immortality-related perks you have, in full capacity or limited to the level you wish. For example, you can make it so that Immortality Failsafe only protects them from being bored of one specific thing or set their age to a certain point with Who Wants to Live Forever?. Moreover, when the soul is completely restored, you will be able to revive the person completely. It will take about a month to gather enough energy to recreate the body from scratch, but this time may be greatly shortened if you possess some powers or technological means to create a suitable body for the soul to inhabit. You have some wiggle room in that the body does not have to be an exact one-to-one replica; it can be older or younger, have some other minor cosmetic alterations, or lack some undesirable deficiencies the original body may have had, but it still must be close enough for the soul to accept it. You now also possess almost unlimited control over your Soul Garden. You can create the afterlifes of your choice for each soul separately, with them all existing in separate 'layers', allow the afterlifes to be constructed for the maximum enjoyment of the individual automatically, or even merge various 'layers', allowing multiple souls to rest in one joint afterlife. You are able to enter any and all of those simulated phases in the form similar to astral projection, to communicate with others, or to partake in the comforting and healing aura of your garden yourself. Your physical body, meanwhile, will be in a state of deep slumber in the real world.
objects.title: Artificial Heaven

objects.text:
You have become a Constellation, a powerful being of stories and narratives, immortalized in myth and legend due to your great achievements and fame.

You now have the ability to use stories originating from notable events or occurrences. These stories are gained through significant accomplishments, such as winning a notable battle or performing an action countless times. They can also be acquired by killing another individual and stealing their stories.

The power of a story depends on how renowned it is and how impressive the achievement that earned it was. A story is "told" when its bearer summons its power, which can only be done in specific situations that match the setting where the original story was earned. Telling a story grants the user a boost to the abilities originally used in that story.

When a story is told and retold, later instances can influence, add to, and reinforce its power, allowing the user to wield it in new ways.

With your new status, you have gained five stories perfectly tailored to your personality and power set. These stories are of at least historical grade, but their grade can be much higher depending on your strength. The strength of your stories will not weaken due to a lack of fame; instead, they will always stay at the level of their peak popularity.

You can also form contracts with others, making them your incarnations and granting them the ability to use the power of your stories. When your incarnations use your abilities, they are retelling those stories. Anyone who witnesses their actions contributes to the fame of your stories, making them stronger.

Additionally, you now have the power to wield probability. By completing deeds, great or small, you can earn coins, which are raw probability concentrated into physical or virtual form. These coins can be used to raise your statistics, buy skills and items from the Dokkaebi Shop, or even change fate and the plausibility of events if you have enough coins. You can also give your coins to others for their personal use.
objects.title: Constellation Ascension (Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint)

addons.text: As the aggregate existence of all of humanity, your will naturally grows in strength too. When you exert your will upon the world you do so with the combined will and belief of an entire species, for you no longer harness just your own will, but the collective will of all humanity within your universe. In practice this means that reality struggles to resist any changes you put forth, for the faith of an entire species has a certain weight to it which shall not be denied. Furthermore, as your will is the combined will of humanity, the more humans there are in your universe, the greater the power you receive from this. Lastly, should you possess the addon The Multiversal Composite, then you wield not just the combined will of humanity in your universe, but the will of humanity in your multiverse cluster, elevating your effective influence to the point that your will cannot be denied and reality kind of just gives up and does what you want.
addons.title: Collective Will

objects.text:
Reminiscent of Haki, the Gods too exert their Will upon the world to enact change, albeit through the use of divine power. Yet a question arises, why are these monuments of power reliant on mortals, why do they begin to fade if no-one believes in them, what is it about those lesser beings which makes them so important? You now know the answer to this question, the Collective Human Abstract Opinion System - C.H.A.O.S. - the manifestation of all mortals’ collective thoughts and beliefs. 

The willpower and belief of a single average mortal isn’t much, especially when pitted against everyone else’s, but the collective faith of entire civilizations can bring forth miracles and give rise to the divine. It is this forbidden secret which is bestowed upon you, the reason for why they are so dependent on mortals, for it was not the gods who created mankind, but mankind who created the gods. And with this secret your Will has undergone a qualitative shift and become the truest manifestation of faith and belief.

In less flowery terms, your Haki has grown immensely and gained a more conceptual edge. For example, your Armament Haki doesn’t simply increase your strength and allow you to injure untouchable beings, it rejects the very notion that they are untouchable. So what if that sword is indestructible, so long as your will is stronger than the sword’s you may shatter it as if it was glass. Your Observation Haki doesn’t merely grant a kind of combat precognition, it allows you to see the very threads of Fate and reweave them if your will is great enough. Most impressive is Conqueror's Haki - for it is the right of a Conqueror to challenge and take, so long as they have the strength - and so with your will you may challenge to change reality itself and if your Will proves victorious, command reality itself to do as you say.

Of course reality won’t simply give up and take it. You are attempting to subvert the current order after all, and as such will experience pushback, scaling with how severe a change you wish to make. Of course you could always outsource the necessary willpower and belief, harnessing the faith of others to enact more wide reaching changes, just as the faith of entire civilizations once gave rise to gods.
objects.title: The Power of Human Will

addons.text: Your ability to use Type Energy allows you to benefit from Technical Machines, more often called TMs. TMs are small machines - which often look like compact or floppy discs - containing information on a Pokemon Move which when used on a Pokemon teaches them the Move stored within.
addons.title: Technical Machines

addons.text:
Your understanding of Type Energy has transcended simple kinetic damage, allowing you to now modulate your Aura to directly affect the target's internal "biome."

When performing a move, you may expend additional energy to imbue it with a Persistent Status Condition (such as Paralysis, Sleep, and others), provided the type of energy used is compatible with the intended effect.

Additionally, as in the games, many of these status conditions carry secondary effects. For example, a paralyzed target not only has a 25% chance to be unable to act, but also has its speed reduced to 50% of its original value; similarly, a burned target will have its Attack stat reduced by half.

Keep in mind that you may only inflict one status condition at a time on each target: a sleeping target cannot be poisoned, a paralyzed target cannot be burned, and so on. Paralysis, Burn, and Poison are considered persistent conditions and will remain in effect until the battle ends, a move such as Heal Bell or Aromatherapy is used, or an appropriate curative item (such as an Antidote or Paralyze Heal) is applied.
addons.title: Status Condition

addons.text:
Your ability to help others has resonated with your Aura and Type Energy, the result of which is giving you a personal revelation regarding your abilities and how the power inside can affect the world in positive ways.

The result is that your ability to heal and boost yourself or others with Pokémon moves has massively increased to an almost absurd degree; on a basic level, it empowers moves like Swords Dance so their boosts are five times greater and healing is ten times more potent.

But the true power of this revelation is your ability to heal the world around you, as you can use your various Type Energies and Moves to restore the environment around you, restoring habitats and making a destroyed wasteland suitable for life after an hour to a day's work (depending on the size of the area), effectively restoring the world to make it like new.

This insight goes beyond just your Aura and Type Energy, as it extends to your other powers as well, although to a lesser extent.
addons.title: Pokopia

addons.text:
Due to your innate connection with dragons, you develop a natural affinity for Dragon-type Energy, refining it above other forms of Type Energy.

As a result, you gain significantly greater ease in shaping it, making its techniques more stable, efficient, and easier to develop, refine, and control compared to other forms of Type Energy, while also granting you STAB (Same Type Attack Bonus), increasing the effectiveness of all Dragon-type attacks you perform.

Beyond combat, your connection with dragons deepens to an instinctual level, as you exude a presence that inspires trust and calm in dragonkind, fostering cooperation and mutual understanding without overriding their free will, while significantly strengthening bonds and improving training and coexistence with draconic creatures.
addons.title: Draconic Affinity

objects.text:
Your Aura has undergone a qualitative shift, unlocking the ability to alter itself and gain Type Energy. This allows you to use any Pokemon Move you understand and meet the criteria for - so no using Moves unique to certain Pokemon - as well as the ability to create new Moves yourself by experimenting with Type Energy.

You start with a basic understanding of all forms of Type Energy, as well as an understanding of one non-unique Move from each Type.
objects.title: Type Energy (Pokemon)

objects.text: You’ve seen the folly of vengeance, and how limiting and reductive it can be. Rather than Zarathos, the Angel of Vengeance bound to you, you possess Vox Ignis, the spirit of Variance. As a former spirit of vengeance, Vox Ignis possesses many of the same abilities. The ability to transform into a ‘ghost rider’, and the associated benefits stay within you. As does your hellfire manifestation. Your true separation comes from your penance stare, or rather the lack of it. As you reject vengeance, the stare no longer belongs to you, unable to inflict the suffering of retribution. Instead, you possess the stare of change. Having the target look you in the eyes can show them every change and alteration they’ve made during their lives, as well as every concurrent event that led to it. The ultimate demonstration of chaos theory. Vox Ignis is significantly more lenient to its hosts than Zanathos, but it still has drives, pushing to change and alter the surroundings, uplifting the hurt and reforming the villainous. After all, the only constant thing is change.
objects.title: Spirit of Variance (Marvel)

objects.text:
You have usurped Mephisto and now reign as the King of the 8th Circle of Hell, granting you absolute dominion over the realm and all its demonic inhabitants. You can freely travel between Hell and the mortal world, and even restore life to those who enter your domain. With the throne comes the total power of Hell itself, elevating you to one of the most formidable beings in creation.

As both Ghost Rider and Hell’s ruler, you wield the Damnation Stare—a devastating power that allows you to condemn sinners directly to Hell by forcing them to face the weight of their misdeeds. It is especially potent against demons, judging their worth and violently banishing their souls through the Purgatory Gates. While this power normally corrupts its wielder, you are immune to its effects.

Your authority also extends to the Spirits of Vengeance. You can grant the Ghost Rider’s power to others or strip it away at will, binding all Riders to your will as Hell’s monarch.
objects.title: King of Hell (Marvel)

objects.text:
You have been chosen to be the representative of an Abstract Entity. Despite their immense power, Abstract Entities require either a mediator or someone to act in their stead due to rivalry with their counterparts. Some employ intermediaries such as the Preordained, the Continuum, or the In-Betweener, while The-Powers-That-Be and The-Natural-Order-of-Things act through an Avatar and the 100 Centivars, respectively. In your case, much like Wyn, you have become the sole Avatar of a Universal Abstract.

As an Avatar, the abilities you receive depend entirely on which Abstract Entity serves as your patron. Serving as the Avatar of Eternity would grant you cosmic awareness, along with the ability to manipulate space and time and travel between universes. Becoming the Avatar of Death would allow you to sense when someone has died or is fated to die, kill anything "living" at will, or grant immortality that only Death herself could revoke, though it may still be bypassed by another Abstract. Acting as the Avatar of the Living Tribunal would grant you the authority to enforce the laws of the universe—and even alter them, should justice demand it.

You also cannot die from age or conventional means; even bathing in a star would not kill you, though it would leave you in constant agony. Regardless of which Universal Abstract you serve, you are unconditionally favored by your patron. This does not mean they will fulfill your every desire, but if you are ever in genuine need or grave danger, they will personally intervene to ensure your survival. However, it is important to note that once chosen, it is impossible to relinquish the role of Avatar.

Note: This upgrade merely adapts the concept and is not a plain copy of the comic version, which—aside from immortality—is nowhere near as powerful.
objects.title: Avatar of A Universal Abstract (Marvel)

objects.text:
Much like Jean Grey, you have become the closest thing the Phoenix has to a physical form. This connection makes you the Phoenix even when it is not present, and the Phoenix you even when you are not. Because of this unbreakable union, you can never remain dead—even if you are erased from existence—always being reborn within the White Hot Room.

Above all, this bond grants you the potential to achieve complete unification with the Phoenix Force. However, to do so, you must undergo a journey of self-discovery, coming to know who you truly are and to understand your nature as the Phoenix’s physical embodiment. Only by fully accepting your role as the Phoenix’s host can you ascend as the White Phoenix of the Crown and claim your place among the Abstract Entities.
objects.title: White Phoenix (Marvel)

objects.text:
Every purchase gives you an additional tail after your first one. After purchasing all 8 times you would have all nine tails. You also gain 100 years worth of experience with each tail you have, and can optionally choose if each tail also increases your age by 100 years or if you just gain the tails and experience. If you do increase in age, you can choose if this affects your appearance.

As a bonus, you tails are extremely well taken care off, being very fluffy and nice to touch.
objects.title: More Tails

objects.text:
You now stand as the newest member of the Inari Sanza—the three kami who collectively fulfill the role and responsibilities of Inari Ōkami. This role has been held by such illustrious kami as Izanagi-no-Mikoto, Izanami-no-Mikoto, Ninigi-no-Mikoto, Sarutahiko-Ōkami, and Ame-no-Uzume-no-Mikoto. Exactly how—and why—you’ve gained this role is up to you. Perhaps your predecessor wished to retire? Or even died?

As an Inari, you have the right to control the domains of rice, fertility, tea, sake, agriculture, industry, and prosperity. In these domains, you are rivaled only by your Inari counterparts, requiring the cooperation of two Inari to overpower the third.

Inari’s most famous domain is their association with Kitsune. Sly, cunning tricksters by nature, many follow the Inari as messengers and servants, with no Kitsune being able to deny an Inari’s command. While officially the Inari are not believed to be Kitsune themselves, their strong association with Kitsune leads many to believe otherwise. It makes sense, then, that you are also a Kitsune—a Kyuubi with nine fluffy fox tails and all the powers and abilities that come with them.

As the Lord of Kitsune, you have the ability to turn others into Kitsune. This can be a full species change or simply transforming the target into a partial Kitsune. By default, these new Kitsune start with only a single tail and must work their way up to nine. However, you are able to grant a Kitsune extra tails if you wish.
objects.title: Inari Ōkami

objects.text:
Like Set, you crave power beyond your original limits. Fortunately, as a unique god, your abilities defy normal boundaries. With each purchase, you gain an additional power source, each one unlocking a new ability associated with said power source. These new power sources are not stolen or borrowed—they are an intrinsic part of your being, fully attuned to your essence and desires.

Unlike Set, who struggles to control the power he seizes, your power sources are fully responsive and harmonize with your natural abilities. Each one is personalized to your strengths, seamlessly blending with your existing powers to enhance and expand them.
objects.title: Multiple Power Sources (Gods of Egypt)

objects.text:
The Dragon Warrior is a figure of legendary status, chosen to unlock the ancient secret hidden within the Dragon Scroll. This warrior is said to achieve the pinnacle of Kung Fu mastery, obtaining "limitless power" by unlocking the wisdom of the scroll. However, the true revelation of the Dragon Scroll is that the ultimate power lies not in techniques or external forces, but in believing in oneself. The true strength of the Dragon Warrior is drawn from within, that self-confidence is the key to greatness.

As the Dragon Warrior, your role is not just to master Kung Fu, but to revolutionize its very foundation, leading the martial art into a new and brighter era. Your Chi becomes incredibly refined, elevating you to a level of mastery where you can create new Kung Fu techniques with mere thought. You are not bound by the traditional forms, and your innovation in combat is limitless. With every technique you employ, you exceed the limits of normal mastery, executing each move with 110% efficiency and perfection, embodying the true essence of Kung Fu's evolution. In terms of talent and skill, you are equal to Oogway.
objects.title: Dragon Warrior (Kung Fu Panda)

objects.text:
Little is known of the most powerful of the Valkyries, but her name alone strikes fear into the hearts of those who dare to speak it—Sigrún, the Valkyrie Queen. 

Her pride outlasted the gods, her might so formidable that even whispers of her name cause terror. None but Odin himself had the courage to face her, and even he could not defeat her, choosing instead to imprison her with powerful magic. Yet, her shackles have now been shattered, and her soul is bound to yours.

You can summon her by uttering her name, and she will serve with unwavering loyalty, just as her sisters do. But Sigrún is not only their queen; she is their guide and their strength, her presence empowering them all the more.

When all nine Valkyries are summoned together, their collective power surges, each of their abilities amplified by 200%, emboldened by the presence of their sisters, so that no challenge or foes might stand before their might.

Sigrún, in her might, can also wield the full breadth of her sisters' abilities simultaneously.
objects.title: Queen Of The Valkyries (God Of War)

objects.text: With each purchase here you gain an additional Cloth, to either use yourself, bestow upon someone else, or simply keep safe.
objects.title: Additional Cloth (Saint Seiya)

objects.text: You have fully mastered your 6th Sense and your Cloth has been upgraded into a Silver Cloth. A Silver Cloth covers about 75% of its wearer’s body and boasts the durability and ability to enhance Cosmo at double the potency, in comparison to that of a Bronze Cloth. In addition, your control and skill with your Cosmo reaches the equivalent of a Silver Saint.
objects.title: Silver Saint (Saint Seiya)

objects.text: You have unlocked your 7th Sense and may choose a single canon Gold Cloth or custom-made of your design to obtain. A Gold Cloth covers nearly its wearer’s entire body and possesses a star system’s level of durability and power that grows further with the strength of its wearer’s Cosmo equal to that (tellingly) of a Solar System and can increase one's Cosmo far beyond a Silver Cloth. In addition, your control and skill with your Cosmo reaches the equivalent of a Gold Saint.
objects.title: Gold Saint (Saint Seiya)

objects.text: You have somehow Unlocked your 8th sense without going through the normally needed cost or effort to achieve this milestone. Your Cloth has undergone a startling transformation elevating it into a (false) God Cloth that covers your entire body. It can withstand galaxy-level forces at a minimum and is further strengthened with its wearers Cosmo. Which it can exponentially increase to unimaginable levels. This God Cloth even as strong as it is only pales to that of a true God Cloth worn by Gods. In addition, your control and skill with your Cosmo reaches a level beyond Gold Saints and touches into the realm of Gods.
objects.title: Ultimate Saint (Saint Seiya)

addons.text:
The incarnation of the Goddess Athena is foretold by the Great Master of her Saints, who reads the stars. But the stars never foretold your arrival, did they?

It may not make sense, but you possess Athena’s Kamui and her Aegis. Regardless of any other factors, you must be the mortal incarnation of the Goddess herself.

With this, you now have complete control of Sanctuary and the undying loyalty of all its inhabitants. You also possess the power to appoint and promote anyone you choose to the position of any Saint. This awakens their Cosmo to the appropriate level and skill, as if they’d trained their entire lives to wield it, and also grants them the Cloth to represent their new position… so choose wisely.

Finally, you also receive the final “piece” of Athena’s Kamui, Nike. Able to take the form of a small statuette of the Goddess of Victory, its true form is a golden staff that when infused with Athena’s Cosmo can pierce through defenses, and induce Victory.
addons.title: Athenian Incarnation

objects.text: Athena’s Sanctuary is the residence of the Goddess and the headquarters of her Saints. Originally located on the outskirts of Athens in ancient times, this vast stretch of mountainous Greek countryside now resides within a private pocket dimension. From here, you can choose to “install” Sanctuary anywhere in the world or return it to this pocket dimension at will. On the highest mountain within Sanctuary lies The Gold Zodiac, a series of twelve temples—each home to one of the twelve strongest Saints, known as the Golden Saints of the Zodiac. These temples, dedicated to Aries, Taurus, Gemini, Cancer, Leo, Virgo, Libra, Scorpio, Sagittarius, Capricorn, Aquarius, and Pisces, are situated along the only path up to the peak. This path serves as the final defense before reaching the Temple and the Colossus of Athena. While the supreme commander of the Saints of Athena is the mortal incarnation of the Deity herself, she only incarnates when her presence is truly needed. In her stead, a human representative known as the Great Master is chosen from among the strongest of the saints—the Golden Saints of the Zodiac. If you are interested, you have the opportunity to attain the esteemed position of the right hand of Athena as the newest Great Master of the Saints of Athena. Alternatively, you may choose to delegate this responsibility to one of your fellow Gold Saints.
objects.title: Sanctuary of Athena (Saint Seiya)

objects.text:
Now, should you desire, you can take over existing living beings, as long as they are weaker than yourself, hollowing out their minds and souls, and making them your sensories. Just as with normal sensory creation, this can be anyone in any universe you desire, and the target might even be completely unaware of the fact.

You can abandon such a sensory, taking back all the gifts you bestowed, and leaving behind a husk with a shattered mind and soul. But in this case, it is possible for someone with extraordinary abilities to revive them, and the connection will not be automatically re-established.

Lastly, restrictions on the amount of sensories you can create and what powers they may wield by themselves have been shattered. You are no longer limited to one sensory in a universe, and you may freely share your powers, perks, and even drawbacks, should you wish to, with your sensories, even if they have not yet awakened.
objects.title: Hijack

addons.text:
You can now spend your CP on your character creation. You can still create your character to the normal strength limit that you could before, but you can now spend CP on top to give more.

For instances that offer things as a free part of their character creation and/or story, but goes above your power limit, it’ll cost 25 CP to take them. 

You can “crossover” media, allowing you to use multiple sources to create a single sensory, albeit at the same strength level and restrictions as before. This can be used to use supplements, create unique crossovers, and other various forms.

This also allows you to simply buy things from other media sources and import them into the character creation. The same rules above apply for cost. You can buy whatever you wish, as many times as you wish, and run through them in whatever you wish, without worry about incompatibility or limits.

Limitations placed on the character, such as limits as to what settings they can visit if they would otherwise have the ability to do so, or locking particular abilities for events outside the scope of the media used, such as requiring sparking for some Jumpchain abilities to fully manifest, can be ignored unless wished for otherwise. 

For media that doesn’t have a 1:1 conversion ratio with your CP or uses multiple point sources or other similar methods, it’ll take the cheapest option that is not free, and it’ll cost 50 CP, everything above it is priced at a commensurate rate.
addons.title: Jumper

addons.text:
You no longer require any medium. You can freely pick any character, select any backstory, perks, powers, drawbacks, etc., as long as the strength of the resulting Sensory does not exceed your own.

There is no longer any limit on the number of such Sensories, but the ten-year timer can be active only for one of them at a time.
addons.title: Creative Mode

objects.text:
You can create a Sensory that will take the place of any character of your choice by accessing the medium within which said character is depicted. For example, by accessing a Harry Potter book, you can create a Sensory that will take the place of the titular protagonist himself at any point on the world's timeline or any other character mentioned in the book.

If the medium allows you to create your own character, like a CYOA or a Jumpdoc, you can freely decide the details within the constraints of the medium. And if the medium does not depict any world to place your Sensory in, you can freely pick your desired one.

This Sensory cannot exceed 1/10 of your strength or the strength of an average human, whichever is higher, and you are limited to only one such sensory at a time. After 10 years from the Sensory's perspective have passed, and if it is still alive, whether it was awakened or not, you can collect all its powers, skills, and knowledge. Afterwards, you are free to create another one.
objects.title: Mantled Avatar

objects.text: The Sensories no longer need to be born naturally. You can manifest them instantly with the appearance and personality of your choice, as well as let them possess any powers that could be gained naturally in the universe of destination. While such Sensories will not otherwise have any history or identity in the world, should you possess the Perk Altered History, this limitation is lifted, allowing you to create any backstory you desire. You are now also capable of taking temporary control over the Sensories, restoring their minds after the fact. You can allow them to remember the whole experience, make them forget it entirely, or even make them think that they acted completely on their own. Additionally, the mind and subconscious programming of the Sensory are now fully under your control; you can set new goals for them to strive towards at any moment, communicate with them telepathically—whether just as a voice in the head or appearing as a mirage only they can see—and even invade their dreams. Lastly, instead of creating a new Sensory, you now have the option to restore the existing one in case it has been heavily injured or even died, and at any time, you can destroy an existing Sensory should you need it.
objects.title: Presence Manifestation

addons.text:
Now your Home can also be used to summon others and interact with them here. You can now spend your CP on others in the same way you can for yourself. 

Here you can summon them and converse with them, allowing you to send them on missions, create deals with them, or otherwise interact with them as you wish. 

Isekai’s immediate speed becomes far more apparent here, now a journey can take as long as you wish, whether it’s immediate or stretched out as you wish. 

You can meet sensories in between jumps, able to send them on multiple successive journeys. You can also summon sensories here to interact with you, both your own and that of others. You no longer have a limit to how many sensories you can have.
addons.title: The Benefactor

addons.text: Your reaction room has been extended to your Home, now you can view any possible builds and their adventures, even if you never properly finalize it. You can also target anyone you summon for your power.
addons.title: The Observer

objects.text:
You notice a small nudge, a bond that is tied to your very nature as a Jumper. A place that calls to you for “its rightful owner” for being dramatic. With an effortless but unmistakable mental switch, you can instantaneously bring yourself there. 

The House is a convenient pocket plane where Jumpers lounge and use their System to a palpable level, shaping itself into a residence to help sort and use your abilities. 

The House is like any conventional house, its architecture and aesthetic are up to your preferences, and contains all the amenities of a well-stocked middle-high-class House starting out. The House has 5 main sections to help facilitate your powers. 

The first of which is a large main room where you can plan and build your builds and their story. This is spaced as a large room with an interactive interface to better parse the character creation, as well as letting you get an in depth representation of the build choice as you construct it. This can range from holographic representation to a full room reality warping to help you truly get an understanding about every choice. 

This can also be used to summon and interact with sensories, or possible sensories, prior to finalizing a build or to interact with them as they progress throughout their journey. 

The second section is a room that allows you to store representations of your various sensories, their various alternate forms, and allows you to integrate any elements of them into your own.

The third acts as a form of a warehouse and trophy room, where you can store various items, weapons, armors, vehicles, and other equipment. 

The fourth section acts as a form of residential space, where any and all companions can live. This section starts sparse but will grow to accommodate any companions you pick up over time, granting them amenities similar to your own. This will come filled with any companions you already have. 

The fifth section is a large space for you to interact with ongoing sensories affected by your character creation. You have the freedom to observe and interact with ongoing and active sensories, as well Insert at any point in its timeline throughout its possible lifetime. Your sensory limit for this is increased to 8, although this number can be increased over time and will rise up if you have other abilities and/or upgrades that increase this.

The House is pre-packaged with an infinite amount of possible character creation options, from Jumpchain Docs to other CYOAs, video game character creators, to a simple D&D character sheet, and much more, you can even create your own. They operate through the Home, becoming an interactive litany of “media” and “settings”, which you create your character and Build, limited by the CP you currently have in store and Jumper’s original restrictions.  As before you can allow your power to determine exactly what they are given, what world, what abilities, their entry, and every other facet or reign control over it as you wish. 

With enough points, the System can automatically pick the optimal options for you according to your needs and preferences lest you consciously select it.

Your home can incorporate any personal dimensions and other properties into it, including any features and abilities they grant, this also includes any future additions gained, either through this ability or otherwise. 
After ten years for this sensory have passed, whether it was awakened or not, you can retrieve all the powers, skills, and knowledge it acquired if it is still alive.

You can have only one such sensory at a time.
objects.title: The Jumper House

objects.text: You are now also the wielder of an Elemental Essence, either Creation, Destruction, or Energy. Creation gives the power to create anything, while Destruction gives the power to destroy anything. With Energy you can manipulate, generate, and project energy and life. All three of these Essences have near limitless potential and usages, but need a lot of training, discipline and research for feats like creating magical artifacts, destroying whole buildings, or blowing up a mountain with an energy beam. These also allow the usage of Elemental powers that fall into their categories, like Electricity or Fire falling under electrical and thermal energy.
objects.title: Elemental Essence (LEGO Ninjago)

addons.text:
You have become a hybrid of Oni and Dragon, much like the First Spinjitzu Master. This transformation has greatly enhanced your elemental abilities, as your body is now uniquely attuned to channel and withstand their power.

You now possess the might of the Source Dragons, granting you control over the primal forces of Balance, Energy, Life, Strength, Motion, Flow, and Focus—along with the elemental powers tied to each. In addition, by fusing the destructive essence of the Oni with dragon energy, you can wield the force of Chaos itself. This fusion gives you access to darker elements such as Brute Force, Fear, Misfortune, Swarm, and Decay.

Your deep understanding of Dragon Energy has also elevated your mastery of Spinjitzu. Advanced techniques like Airjitzu, Shatterspin, and Object Spinjitzu are now fully within your grasp. This insight even extends to other styles inspired by these concepts—such as the Rising Dragon, a technique born from the principle of motion.
addons.title: The Second Hybrid

objects.text: You become capable of wielding the Golden Power known as Light, or the malevolent power known as Darkness. Two forces that are capable of creating entire realms, rearranging the land and filling you with nigh-omnipotent power, enabling you to grant and remove Elemental Powers to and from those you deem worthy. It also makes you capable of wielding stronger versions of all Elemental Essences and Powers. You can create life, objects, and even entire worlds, or destroy them if you so please.
objects.title: Light/Darkness (LEGO Ninjago)

objects.text:
While you still have the Crest Stone, Crest, and Divine Pulse, you are no longer the host to Sothis. Instead, you are host to Arval, a vessel created by the Agarthan Epimenides for his resurrection. Rather than gaining Nabatean features, you have pale skin reminiscent of Agarthans and can optionally have Arval's white hair and red eyes. You will no longer inherit the legacy and divinity of Sothis, but instead the magical and scientific might of the Agarthan champion Epimenides. 

You are a scientific and sorcerous genius capable of revolutionizing an era. You can systematically experiment with magic system you possess, expanding your knowledge of the fundamentals. You are an expert at creating new sorceries, modifying or reverse-engineering the work of others, and coming up with powerful combat and utility applications. You have a particular affinity for learning soul-based magics or spells. You are also a genius of the biological sciences, capable of engineering Bonesaw-esque creations, healing others, and creating biological weapons. You can seamlessly blend your mastery of biology and magic together to create all manner of bizarre creatures. You gain a massive boost to your learning speed, making you a once-in-a-century prodigy at any skill you seriously try. 

Your advanced knowledge of sorcery lets you counter other mages and prevent your spells from being disrupted. You can find weakpoints in the defense spells of enemy mages, allowing you to deal extra damage. Furthermore, your own spellcasting is seamless and impossible to disrupt. Your casting can ignore anti-magic fields, spell silencing, or even an old-fashioned punch to the face. Any of your magical or melee attacks, including weapons, temporarily weaken the physical and magical stats of the enemy. Those stronger or equal to you are less effected.

You are still a master of tactics and strategy. Furthermore, you gain an understanding of both the aggressive and fast-paced tactics of Shez and the century-long plots of the Agarthans, making you a master in any strategic situation. Over time, you will merge with Arval, gradually strengthening your soul and talents until you can fully match Epimenides. Despite her snark and sarcastic attitude, Arval is extremely helpful for training, scouting, or serious conversation. Only you can perceive Arval when she is physically manifested. Unlike with Sothis, you will not inherit any Divinity or physical power, as Arval is a mortal and Epimenides is long dead. 

Optionally, you can choose to not have Arval and just keep the powers. Your powers will grow at a similar rate until you have a breakthrough, allowing you to reach the same level of strength as merging with Arval.
objects.title: Partner in Destiny (Fire Emblem)

objects.text:
You have been granted Lin Huang's Life Palace, essentially a dimension that allows you to store any monsters you possess and resurrect them, regardless of the state of their body or soul. There is no limit to how many times a monster can be revived. If you are killed, one of your monsters can die in your place, though this life-saving ability can only be used once every 24 hours per monster. Reviving your monsters requires no energy, though they can still be permanently killed by beings vastly more powerful than you, equivalent to 3-5 realms above.

As the owner of Monster Paradise, you can temporarily physically manifest your Life Palace in reality. It initially covers over 1 kilometer, but the range will expand as you grow stronger. Within Monster Paradise, you can freely borrow the powers of all your monsters and residents, bypassing any limitations such as energy cost or inherent restrictions. You can also lend your powers to others and drastically enhance your abilities.

In addition to your Life Palace, you inherit all of Lin Huang's monsters, though their strength is capped at one realm above yours. This includes creatures like Bai the Vampire King, Tyrant the Genie Combat God, Charcoal the Archaic Dragon, and many others, each with unique abilities. You also possess the Galactic Hive, a sentient spaceship capable of containing 100 billion bug monsters. While it currently only houses over 10 million bug monsters, including Hive Queens, it is an exception that allows you to summon both the hive and all its inhabitants simultaneously.

You also gain all of Lin Huang’s 10 combat souls, spiritual entities that are part of your own soul and are always two realms stronger than you. These combat souls include the Divine Sun Tree, Ninetails Lynx with space manipulation abilities, Destructive Divine Mammoth with overwhelming strength, the Nightmare Tapir capable of inducing and controlling dreams, the Undead Styx with the ability to turn and control the dead, Death Butterfly, capable of inducing death, and the Creation Clock, which manipulates time.
objects.title: Life Palace: Monster Paradise (Monster Paradise)

objects.text:
You are now the Anti-Spiral, the embodiment of opposition to all Spiral Lifeforms. As the living manifestation of the collective consciousness of the Anti-Spiral race, you exist as the ultimate force of stagnation and entropy. Your very essence is a force of negation, counteracting the unchecked growth and evolution of Spiral beings. You are not merely an entity but the culmination of an entire race's ideology, bound by the singular purpose of halting the rise of Spiral power at all costs.

Existing beyond the multiverse of Gurren Lagann, you stretch across dimensions, your influence dwarfing entire universes. Your presence is not limited to a single reality but reverberates through all planes of existence, casting a shadow that resists the flow of time and space. Every aspect of your being is an immense force, capable of undoing the very fabric of creation. The multiverse trembles in your wake, for you are the ultimate counterbalance, a cosmic anchor that holds back the tide of infinite growth.
objects.title: The Anti-Spiral

objects.text: ”Nan iChir Gelair!” You are the Bright Lord! And what is a lord without a kingdom to rule over. You now have your own personal army to rule over, made up of countless Humans, Uruk-Hai, Olog-Hai, and the various creatures they had under their command such as Caragors, Dragurs, etc. Alongside this, you’ve gained an internal dimension, roughly the size of the entire territory of Mordor and Nurn combined, where your followers call home. Your army will replenish over time, able to completely subsist itself upon the resources of your dimension, and replacing any lost soldiers quickly. Your army’s population can be made up of any of the creatures shown in the shadow of war series, from powerful Uruk-Hai, elves, normal humans, to even the immensely powerful Balrogs. It can also be made up of any species, races, or other physical forms you’ve bought in the CYOA. You can also choose to fill it with races/species from the world you’ll be entering, or from settings you have bought powers from as long as the races/species don’t exceed your own abilities.
objects.title: Bright Lord (Shadow of War)

addons.text:
The Overlord Gauntlet begins to seep deeper into your very essence, reshaping not only your soul but your flesh itself. Your Demon Form, once a strain on your body and psyche, is now stabilized and amplified by the Gauntlet’s dark resonance. No longer a mere transformation of necessity, it evolves into your true form, the embodiment of your will and dominion.

When you assume your Demon Form, the Gauntlet answers by forging a living Demonic Armor around your body. This armor does not weigh you down—it empowers you, reinforcing your strength, speed, and resilience while alleviating the immense burden that instant shapeshifting once placed on your muscles and mind. The fractures, pain, and exhaustion that once followed your forced adaptations begin to fade, replaced with stability and control.

The fusion between Gauntlet and Demon Form ensures that with time and mastery, you will reach the point where this form is no longer a temporary transformation, but a natural state. Your body will be able to maintain it indefinitely without cost or drawback, turning you into a permanent avatar of abyssal supremacy.

As the Gauntlet integrates further, your powers feed directly into one another. Every ability you possess influences your Demon Form, reshaping the armor, claws, carapace, and wings into new, adaptive configurations. Fire may crown you in flames, shadows may weave into a cloak of living darkness, or raw force may turn your strikes into cataclysmic blows. The Gauntlet evolves with you, ensuring that your true form is not static, but limitless.

With this addon, your Demon Form ceases to be a dangerous gamble and becomes the eternal manifestation of the Demon Overlord’s might—a flawless balance of power, control, and unending evolution.

The Gauntlet is no longer something you wear.
 It is the abyss made flesh, and you are its perfected vessel.
addons.title: Overlord’s True Form

objects.text:
Despite the name, Demon Lords don’t really need to be demons, simply the darkest and top of the food chain in the land of monsters. Now, however, you have become a demon. The dark power that once passively seeped into your subordinates now surges through you, reshaping your body and soul into something far beyond mortal or monster. Your form gradually changes over time, gaining new demonic traits as your power deepens. Your skin may toughen into an unbreakable carapace, your limbs may lengthen and sharpen into weapons of war, or your blood may turn into liquid fire that burns those who dare to wound you.

While these changes develop slowly, you have gained the ability to force them into existence when needed. In the heat of battle or under dire circumstances, you can instantly manifest specific traits to adapt to the situation. Need greater speed? Your legs reshape into those of a hunting predator, allowing you to move with terrifying agility. Facing an opponent immune to conventional weapons? Your hands twist into monstrous talons capable of rending through enchanted armor and divine blessings alike.

However, such forced changes come at a cost. While you can shift your body in an instant, doing so too frequently strains your physical form. The energy required to force these transformations places an immense burden on your muscles, bones, and nerves, causing aches and pains that linger long after the battle is won. Overuse can lead to growing fatigue, sharp stabs of pain, or even temporary loss of function in the altered limbs. 

The deeper you descend into demonhood, the more you drift from what you once were. Your mind remains sharp, your will unbreakable, but the instincts of the abyss grow stronger. Rage, hunger, and destruction simmer beneath your control, pushing you ever closer to becoming a true force of calamity. This can be controlled, as long as you do not overdo instantaneous changes and have sufficient downtime, you can outright remove the risk of personality drift from your powers.
objects.title: Demon Form

addons.text:
The Overlord Gauntlet reshapes the way your authority manifests, stabilizing and amplifying the power of your Marks of Dominion. No longer must you sacrifice a permanent portion of your strength to create a Demon General. Instead, the Gauntlet sustains these marks with its abyssal energy, allowing you to grant five permanent Marks at first. Once a Mark is used, it regenerates after a period of time, the duration depending on how much power was invested. With mastery and repeated use, the number of Marks you can wield simultaneously will grow, granting you the ability to command not just a handful of generals, but entire legions of them.

But the Gauntlet’s influence goes further still. From its fusion with your essence arises a new evolution: the ability to generate Overlord’s Generals, a unique type of minion forged to act as living pillars of your armies. Each one embodies the pinnacle of its minion type:

Brown General: The embodiment of brute force and warlust. Capable of rallying entire battalions of browns, their fury enhances the strength and durability of those under their command.

Red General: A master of fire and destruction, leading red minions into storms of inferno. Their presence amplifies the range and destructive force of flames, turning their warbands into walking sieges.

Green General: Silent hunters and assassins, leading their kin into perfectly coordinated ambushes. Under their command, green minions move as a single deadly organism, striking unseen and vanishing without a trace.

Blue General: The essence of resilience and sorcery. They command blue minions with uncanny precision, bolstering their restorative powers and unlocking defensive formations that repel even divine forces.

These Generals are not simply stronger minions—they are extensions of your will, shaped by the Gauntlet and bound by the Demon Lord’s authority. They bear fragments of your oppressive aura, enabling them to dominate lesser monsters and forge disciplined armies out of chaos.
