Their growth scales endlessly with yours, ensuring that as you ascend into greater power, so too do they rise as unyielding champions of your dominion.

Through the Gauntlet, even loss is no longer absolute. If one of your Generals falls, the Mark that empowered them will eventually regenerate, allowing you to forge a new leader when the time is right. The bond remains dangerous, but you are no longer crippled by permanent loss. Instead, every fallen General becomes a scar of experience, and their successors rise stronger than the last.

Your armies are no longer a swarm of creatures—they are an organized legion, led by generals who embody your darkness, commanded by your hand, and sustained by the Gauntlet itself.
The world will no longer face a Demon King’s army.

 They will face the Legion of the Overlord.
addons.title: Legion of the Overlord

objects.text:
You can forge Marks of Dominion, symbols of your authority that contain fragments of your own strength. These marks are created and stored within you, waiting to be bestowed upon a worthy subordinate. The process is slow and arduous, for each mark is a permanent sacrifice of strength. Once granted, a mark triggers an immediate transformation, causing the recipient’s body to shift. Their physical form changes drastically—horns may sprout from their head, their muscles strengthen, their skin hardens into something far more resilient, and their senses sharpen to supernatural levels. Their minds are instilled with unwavering loyalty and a heightened ability to command and strategize. In this moment, they cease to be mere followers and become something far greater: Demon Generals, the pillars of your rule.

Beyond the initial transformation, the Mark of Dominion continues to exert its influence. Much like the aura that passively strengthens those under your command, the mark accelerates this process to an extreme degree. Over time, a Demon General’s body and mind will continue to evolve, their demonic traits growing even stronger as their power matures. Their claws may become razor-sharp weapons, their bodies may develop resistances to physical and magical attacks, and their connection to dark magic will deepen, allowing them to wield it with greater ease. As you grow in power, so too will your Generals, their strength ever increasing in response to your own. The reverse is also true, as they grow stronger the stronger you become. 

A marked individual also gains a lesser version of your oppressive aura, allowing them to inspire and command with an authority that echoes your own. In their presence, lesser demons and monstrous beings are drawn to serve, instinctively recognizing their power as an extension of yours. 

The bond between you and your Generals is absolute. They do not merely serve you; they exist as an extension of your power. The stronger you become, the more their abilities grow in turn. However, this connection is also your greatest risk. If a Demon General dies or their mark is severed by powerful magic or divine intervention, the strength you sacrificed to create them is lost forever, weakening you in ways that cannot easily be undone. The more marks you bestow, the more powerful your forces become—but the more you stand to lose should they fall.
objects.title: Demon Generals

objects.text:
Was it betrayal? Greed? Trauma? Ambition? Whatever the reason, you are no longer a Hero symbolizing hope and virtue. 

Rather than gaining strength whenever you shield or save someone, you gain a permanent increase in power whenever you work towards your overarching goal. The magnitude of the boost scales with how difficult the task is for you: crushing weaklings would only grant a slight increase, while conquering a nation would massively increase your overall power. The exact manifestation of this power increase varies with each accomplishment. Defeating an archmage may allow you to learn some of the magic they used in their fight, while seizing the throne could grant you an aura of authority. You cannot control the exact manifestation, but they will always be aligned with your powerset.

While others can doubt your character or morals, they cannot question your strength. Your ability to learn is boosted to the point that, alone, your skills could rival those of an entire party. You can simultaneously learn and progress in dozens of disciplines at once, whether they are combat-focused like sorcery or swordsmanship, or utility skills like diplomacy. Furthermore, your talent in each subject is world-class. If you choose to learn sorcery, you can revolutionize magic. If you choose to learn holy magic, you can surpass the greatest of saints.

Despite whatever caused you to fall, your resolve has only grown stronger. You no longer need to "ignite" your resolve in dire situations, for it is a fundamental part of your existence. While you no longer gain massive temporary power-ups like a shounen protagonist, your willpower is used to further increase your base strength and growth rates. Furthermore, your hero's intuition has evolved to absurd levels. You have an instinctive sense of how, when, and if you should use someone to further your goals.
objects.title: Fallen Hero

objects.text: No hero stands alone. Your heroic spirit now reaches beyond you, resonating with others who share your ideals or possess exceptional potential. That same subtle sense that once guided you toward danger or those in need now helps you find allies. These allies may be paragons of courage, hidden talents waiting to shine, or simply good people drawn to your cause. Just as you’re guided toward them, they too feel an instinctive pull toward you. As bonds form and deepen, so too does your shared strength. When you fight alongside allies you trust, your connection fuels a passive surge of power for both of you. This bond-driven boost scales similarly to the surges you gain from heroic deeds: light when trust is new, powerful when bonds are forged through hardship, and legendary when your lives and goals are truly intertwined. This boost is permanent. When your allies stand by your side, they share in your heroic nature. They too begin to experience the strength that comes from courage and valor. When they protect others, heal, or take bold action, they receive a temporary, adaptive boosts that reflect the nature and difficulty of their deeds. In moments of true peril, when all seems lost, they can tap into a flicker of your resolve, gaining a sharpened focus and burst of strength that mirrors your own, allowing them to rise to the moment. This is less intense than your personal resolve and doesn’t carry the same life-threatening exhaustion, but it can still turn the tide of battle.
objects.title: Hero’s Party

addons.text: "Dreams save us. Dreams lift us up and transform us. And on my soul, I swear until my dream of a world where dignity, honor, and justice becomes the reality we all share—I'll never stop fighting. Ever." - Superman You've done it. You are the Perfect Hero. You are a living nightmare to evil and benevolent deity to good. By becoming the very concept of Hope and the purest definition of a Hero, you are the perfect being to achieve the impossible, manifest hopes and dreams into reality, and restore desolate, even completely destroyed worlds into a thriving utopia. Your presence alone can start the transformation of healing the broken, regrowing life, and recreating the very structures of a barren world. With every action towards saving it and the ambient Hope that rekindles throughout rapidly accelerating it. Eventually creating a brand new world unrecognizable from the history that once led to its ruin, achieving the ideals to create an even better world, or changing its very foundation entirely.
addons.title: True Hope

objects.text:
You embody the purity of a Hero. The raw, untainted desire to help and save others. To do the right thing because it’s the right thing to do, and from your actions, the world is one step closer to a brighter tomorrow.

Now even the sight or whisper of someone in danger fuels you as you act, scaling in proportion to the task at hand. Watching someone fall from a building will automatically enhance your speed, or make you develop flight to catch them as quickly as possible, or in a dire situation to save one or many, you will summon an extra surge of valor that allows you to do both. This compounds into permanent gains of strength overtime the more heroics you perform, generating more valor that is stored into a secondary pool you can draw from. 

The mark of a True Hero is in sacrifice, willing to truly put everything on the line for the world and those around you. From this, you can sacrifice any amount of valor for awe-inspiring surges of power. A small portion can give you the edge needed to put down a powerful villain, while using up all can elevate you to godlike status and beyond, further boosted by how dire and hopeless the adversity. Making you shine even brighter as the beacon of hope you are.

Even as you give up all of your valor, your base power remains unchanged. Also, the effect of your actions ignite the spark of a heroism within others. From inspiring the common man to volunteer at the local shelter, to causing another to follow in your footsteps. In the event you meet such a person, you will be the best teacher to bring out their full potential while keeping them on the righteous path.
objects.title: True Hero

objects.text:
You are not a Hero forged by light, but the darkness created by the evils of the world. You have witnessed its abyss firsthand and made it your mission to purge it by any means necessary.

Every evildoer you slay rewards you with a permanent addition to your abilities. The nature and potency of them scale with their importance and overall impact on the world. Killing a well-known serial killer might reward you with his expertise in stealth or a weapon based on his methods of death, while destroying a crime organization could give you a grab bag of powers like regeneration, super strength, invisibility, and a danger sense. And the truly irredeemable grant the greatest rewards if you manage to slay them. These additions are tailor-made to assist in your endless crusade against evil and can improve over time, overlap with each other, or combine with other powers to create more powerful ones. 

Your intuitive sense for evil is much sharper, to the point that you can smell its stench, observe its workings in real time, or even hear it whispering amongst a crowd. Your resolve is also enhanced, now giving a slight but significant edge against your opposition, and can be pushed further by willing so, at the cost of putting more strain on yourself. While you can still gain strength from saving others and being a traditional Hero, it pales in comparison to slitting the throat of evil. 

To be the Anti-Hero is to walk a fine line between light and darkness, with the constant risk of slipping too far into the latter, until it transforms you into the very evil you sought to destroy.
objects.title: Anti Hero

addons.text:
The ability to inscribe Runes onto objects has now extended to your glyphs. You can inscribe each glyph with multiple runes in unique combinations, creating powerful or varied effects whenever you deploy the glyph. This doesn’t need to be done on the fly; once a runic combination is inscribed on a glyph, it’s permanently memorized, allowing you to deploy it at any time.

These effects can range widely. For example, a single glyph could combine fire and wind elements to produce an inferno stronger than a standard fire glyph. You might create a healing glyph, one that absorbs energy from the atmosphere or anyone nearby to restore your own aura, or even one that can transform someone from a human into a dragon. The limits of your glyphs depend on the variety and uniqueness of each runic combination, the energy available to activate it, and your own creativity.

Over time, with the right runes, your glyphs could become self-sustaining, no longer needing your energy to activate and able to function continuously until you deactivate them or they are destroyed.
addons.title: Runic Glyphs

objects.text:
You have inherited the Schnee family Semblance of Glyphs, which allows you to create flat symbols that have various effects, such as moving, conjuring, or enhancing. However, your Glyphs are different from the rest, as you can manipulate elements without using Dust, the crystallized form of energy that powers most technology in Remnant. You can create and control fire, water, earth, air, and other natural forces with your Glyphs, giving you a versatile and powerful arsenal.

Moreover, you can summon constructs of anything you have defeated or sufficiently understood, including robots, animals, and even people. These constructs will obey your commands and fight for you, and you can also share their knowledge and abilities with them. You can also create constructs of items or objects that you have studied or analyzed, such as weapons, tools, or vehicles.

Unlike the rest of the Schnee family, you can create new Glyphs with their own unique functions over time. You can experiment with different combinations of elements, shapes, colors, and patterns to discover new effects and applications for your Glyphs. You can also learn to replicate the effects from other sources of magic or technology, such as the Maidens, the Relics, or the Silver-Eyed Warriors, and incorporate their aspects into your Glyphs.

Your Glyphs are a reflection of your creativity and curiosity, and they will grow and evolve with you as you explore the world. You are a natural-born master of Glyphs.
objects.title: The Bees Schnees (RWBY)
Aura Adept (RWBY: Lords Among the Ashes)
objects.text: Your Aura has taken on the nature of that found in another version of Remnant, granting you access to the ability to advance along a path few know of yet has shaped the very face of the world itself. Aura users are divided into several stages, each one having distinct differences between them. When a person's Aura is first kindled, they become an Initiate of [Title], their Title being whatever concept their soul is most closely aligned with. This grants them everything that the default Aura power grants. Through simple growth and training, one may become an Adept, possessing a strong grasp on their Semblance as well as vastly improved strength and agility. Most of the canon Beacon students would be considered low-tier Adepts, and the average graduate is a mid-tier Adept. With enough training and self reflection you can become a Lord, boosting your Aura and stats to rival a canon peak-Huntsman to start out and evolving your Semblance with an additional subpower or two. This also slows your aging by half, doubling your lifespan. At their peak, a Lord could defeat a Maiden or destroy a city if they were smart about it. Past this point Training will not allow further stage advancement, instead there exists a ritual that allows one to advance from the peak of Lord to the Paragon stage. Upon reaching this stage, you begin to physically embody your Title, with further Aura and stat boosts, another Semblance evolution, and your aging is halved again. In addition, you gain the ability to assume an Avatar Form, wherein for a short time you completely embody your Title thus greatly boosting your power, but it will take a couple years to master. At this stage you could defeat a Maiden in one on one combat, and when fully mastered could possibly destroy a Kingdom by yourself. On top of all of this, there exists one final ritual which shatters your limits entirely as you essentially become your Title, allowing a fully mastered Paragon to become a God. Once attained you become immortal, as your stats and Aura rise even further, and your Semblence evolves conceptual abilities able to crush anyone weaker than a Paragon outright. In your Avatar Form, it would be nearly impossible for anyone but a team of Paragons or a fellow God to kill you. A fully realized God could realistically conquer the world as seen by the Great War. By taking this upgrade you start at mid-tier Adept strength, gaining a solid grasp on your Semblance and being on par with the average Beacon Graduate in terms of Aura control and Huntsman combat prowess. On top of this, you are given knowledge on how to perform the rituals needed to reach the Paragon and God stages, adapted for whatever world you live in and the resources it has access to, and are guaranteed to be one of the few capable of reaching the peak. Anyone you give Aura to will follow the same path, but their overall maximum potential is dependent entirely on them, with most capping out at Adept while some rare few might be able to reach God (if you share the rituals, of course). At the absolute minimum it can take 10 years to go from Initiate to God, more realistically up to a century for those even capable of such. Note: All abilities from Addons on Aura or which require it will be at least somewhat improved by each stage you reach. For example, if you have Deific Aura you might unlock more abilities derived from your godly parent's domains with achieving God stage being a form of apotheosis, while Auric Enchant could allow for ever greater varieties of enchantments to be imbued.

addons.title: Remnants of an Age Burned to Ashes
addons.text: Your knowledge has expanded to include the technology of another version of Remnant, specifically anything shown or hinted at in the Lords Among the Ashes. This not only includes various minor improvements to canon RWBY tech including Dust-based superweapons such as that used to destroy the Titan Olympus, but also the technology from lost eras. Among the most important things this grants are Grimm-based biotechs such as Grimmtech armors (without the issues that led them to corrupting Gods unless you deliberately choose to do so) and artificial Grimm up to superweapons like the Titans, various near-magitech artifacts that interface with the soul, and even the technology that created the titular game, allowing for the creation of fully realistic simulated worlds where in you can train any powers derived from the mind or soul under variable time acceleration. Be warned that if the ratio of time inside vs outside is too large you might experience painful side effects, potentially lethal ones if you are kicked out because of a violent death in the simulation. Also be warned that the people simulated may be real enough to develop true souls and free will which can lead to moral issues with turning it off, though it could act as a source of fully human-like AI if you feel like transferring them into independent systems or Penny style Android bodies. Note: A notable percentage of this tech tree is reliant on having access to Grimm-matter. Much like Dust, you are granted the know-how to synthesize Grimm-matter from scratch, though without a native source of Grimm it will eventually fade away if not used (this CYOA is not responsible if you accidentally unleash the Grimm on the world).

addons.title: Blessing of the Jaune Dice
addons.text: Much like Jaune and his friends, you have an absolutely absurd growth rate, further boosted by Orion into something truly mythical. Not only does your mastery of your Semblance, Aura, combat and other Huntsman skills now apply to the versions found in Lords Among the Ashes, putting you at the peak of the Adept stage and mere months at most from reaching Lord, but your ability to advance further is enhanced as well. You can master any abilities granted by the following stages in only a fraction of the time and are able to push them even further than before, cutting the time needed to fully master them down to half of what it would otherwise be. Should you purchase Another Step to Godhood, this mastery applies to that stage too, making you a high-tier of your purchased stage. This also extends your mastery to all aspects of combat for that stage, making you just as skilled as you are strong. If you were to purchase the God stage, you would be among the most powerful God's to walk Remnant ever, able to fight a fully trained God wearing Grimmtech armor with a high chance of winning.

addons.title: To Walk in the Shadow of an Archangel
addons.text: The limits on your growth are now even further removed, as your ability to advance your Aura through stages further boosts your maximum power. With this, your version of 'mid-tier Adept' is now strong enough to rival a normal Lord in power, with your previous peak now considered the equivalent of a mid-tier Paragon. Should you master the Paragon stage, you could fight the likes of Cinder, otherwise known as Famine, and have at least even odds of winning. Upon reaching God, you would surpass her entirely, and full mastery would make you equal to a young Archangel in power. From there, you could continue to grow until you rival the likes of final battle Keter or Malkuth in power, but that would take a millenia of active growth, or a couple centuries if you have three purchases of Another Step to Godhood and Blessing of the Jaune Dice, and you could still stagnate if you ever stop being pressured to grow.

objects.title: Another Step to Godhood (RWBY: Lords Among the Ashes)
objects.text: Upon purchasing this upgrade, you immediately ascend as your mastery of Aura grows by another stage. This manifests as a much stronger Aura, a more powerful and versatile Semblance, and an innate knowledge and basic grasp of any techniques unique to that stage as if you had personally undergone the training and rituals needed to reach it, and a solid mastery of any from prior stages. As a side effect, this also raises your awareness of the true nature of your mind and soul, better allowing for self control and making it easier to work towards changing any aspects you don't like. The first purchase makes you a low-tier Lord, strong enough to rival any of the canonical inner circles of Ozpin or Salem in power. The second purchase makes you a low-tier Paragon, able to match a Maiden in combat at minimum. The third and final purchase makes you a low-tier God, an existence that even canon Salem and the four Maidens working together would be unable to overcome. From there, you can further train your power and skill to master the given stage and all it has to offer, taking a minimum of one, three, and ten years respectively without any other powers to supplement and / or boost your growth. Note: You can technically still grow stronger potentially forever upon fully mastering the God stage, especially if you have Negentropy or the equivalent from Shardless or Patron, but without other powers or outside assistance / tools (such as a native system of divinity / godhood ascension you can tap into) to push it along your growth will slow dramatically from that point, to the extent of taking most of a century just to become 10% more powerful. This is assuming that you train constantly and have something to give you a reason to seek further strength, otherwise you are likely to stagnate long before then.

objects.title: Angels and Huntsman (RWBY: The Games We Play)
objects.text:
Your Aura has taken on the nature of that found in another version of Remnant, removing the limits that previously existed on your growth. Your power is boosted to match the peaks of canon Huntsmen to start, but that is only the beginning. In this world the strongest Huntsman can reach power such that they could level cities by themselves with ease just through sheer physical force, and now so can you.

Not only that, but this also increases the versatility and power of your Aura, allowing you to perform a number of techniques that in canon would be restricted to specialized Semblances. This includes things like martial arts capable of going toe to toe with the most powerful Grimm when fully mastered, creating energy blasts and other constructs, astral projection, healing limbs, creating subdimensions through Naraka, and more. You start with a basic understanding of a few choice techniques, but it is up to you to master them and discover more.

The most important thing though is your soul. In this world souls are made of spiritual particles, unique elements named and structured after the Kabbalah Tree of Life. Through this, you pull matter and energy from a higher realm via Kether, shaping it as it passes down the Tree until it manifests in the world through Malkuth. Thanks to this, your Semblance is at least an order of magnitude stronger and can be trained even further still.

Should you train diligently and fight strong foes, your potential maximum strength will rival that of Raven, who once fought Gilgamesh while he was possessed and boosted by Malkuth to a standstill for a short time. However, without a cheat power like Jaune's Gamer Semblance, it will take at least a couple decades to reach that level of power.

addons.text: By transcending the boundaries of the physical world, you have unlocked the ability to wield your Metatron powers even when not in your Metatron form. These reality-warping abilities defy the laws of physics and bypass the powers of others, including the semblances of even archangels. Though costly to use, these abilities grant you unparalleled control over existence itself—you can halt the flow of time, exist beyond the grasp of death, and reshape reality to your will and whim.
addons.title: Metatron

objects.text:
You have inherited the knowledge and power of the “Archangel” Keter, the Crown. Forged as a super weapon from the combined essence and topmost Sefirot of billions of souls, Keter is a master of the spiritual realm, with only one true equal. This inheritance grants your Aura an unparalleled boost, elevating it to levels capable of withstanding attacks that could obliterate entire cities.

You have also gained Keter’s Semblance, the ability to bestow a role upon yourself or others. By declaring someone a “Teacher” or a “Scientist”, you elevate them to unmatched mastery in that role—a Teacher who rivals Socrates, a Scientist whose brilliance matches Einstein. Additionally, the person’s rate of improvement in their named role is exponentially accelerated.

Each individual can only be assigned one role, and the number of roles you can bestow is determined by your Aura. Assigning a role requires an amount of Aura equivalent to the difference between their current abilities and the mastery granted. However, once assigned, maintaining the role requires no further Aura from you or them.

As Keter’s inheritor, you also wield his unmatched mastery over magic, particularly spiritual magic. You can summon and command elementals of fire, water, air, earth, and other natural forces, bending them to your will. These entities obey your commands without question, making you an overwhelming force in both battle and mystic rites. Your deep connection to the spiritual realm allows you to manipulate mystical energies, perform intricate rituals, and even imprison souls in a state of purgatory, sealing them away beyond time and fate.

Beyond these powers, you possess the ability to see and understand the true essence and souls of those around you. Their nature, hidden intentions, and secret abilities are laid bare before your gaze.

You carry the wisdom of a scholar who led humanity into a thousand-year utopia. You wield the strength of a warrior who single-handedly halted entire demon armies in their tracks.
objects.title: Keter (RWBY: TGWP)

objects.text:
You have inherited the knowledge and power of the “Archangel” Malkuth, the Kingdom. Forged as a super weapon from the combined essence and bottommost Sefirot of billions of souls, Malkuth is the unrivaled master of the physical realm, with only one true equal. This inheritance grants your Aura an unparalleled boost, elevating it to levels capable of withstanding attacks that could obliterate entire cities. You have also gained Malkuth’s Semblance: the power to impose new laws upon reality itself within a vast radius around you. These laws seamlessly integrate into the natural order around you and can range from altering physical constants, such as changing the direction of gravity, to rewriting the very minds of an entire population. Malkuth’s most infamous use of this power was declaring his own existence anathema to life, instantly killing all beings within his domain. As the creator of the Grimm in his universe, Malkuth commanded them with unparalleled precision and might. The Grimm under his control were far more fearsome than the Grimm of RWBY canon, with his elder Grimm possessing the strength to level entire cities. Most terrifying of all were the Four Horsemen, unique Grimm capable of overwhelming entire civilizations through infection and destruction:
  • Conquest spreads like a bacterial plague, infecting the air and transforming those it touches into maddened Grimm-human hybrids, driven to slaughter all in their path.
  • War spreads through tainted blood, twisting nations into annihilating one another in brutal and unending conflict.
  • Famine chooses a single host, turning them into an endless devourer capable of consuming, refining, and generating limitless magical Dust, growing more powerful with each moment.
  • Death is a force of unmatched lethality, capable of killing even an Archangel.
You possess the skills of a being who nearly drove humanity to extinction. You wield the power of a warrior who slaughtered its mightiest defenders and reshaped reality to his will.
objects.title: Malkuth (RWBY: TGWP)

addons.text: Awakened within your soul is the entire lineage of the Rose bloodline, a family bestowed with the God of Light's Silver Eyes which includes Summer Rose, Ruby Rose and all the nameless Hunters and Huntresses that came before them. This has supercharged the Illusionary Floral Shift to form part of your Semblance, the Petal dimension. This dimension flows underneath reality, allowing you to, in its infancy, teleport through petals, make your weapons and projectiles phase through objects in a burst of petals or have those weapons stored in said dimension. Your Silver Eyes have also been improved. The emotions needed to activate your Silver Eyes have been drastically reduced and the precision you have with them is magnified.
addons.title: Red like Roses

objects.text:
When the masses think of the best Huntsman, your name immediately springs to mind. Not just faster and stronger than a seasoned Huntsman, but also with talent and mastery of Aura that’s unprecedented for your age group. Your control has reached the point where your shielding could be barely greater than the size of a bullet and still be strong enough to stop it in its tracks. Aura techniques which would usually be out of reach for others, are now within your grasp. Whatever your Semblance may be, you’ve had countless hours to perfect its functions and develop new techniques using it.

Any monster or creature that could be considered a natural foe for a Huntsman that comes within your line of sight is catalogued and analyzed by your mind. Weaknesses and tendencies unfurl like a spiderweb before your gaze, showing the optimal path to debilitate and eliminate said creatures. You also have a conceptual advantage against any chaos, evil, or darkness-aligned entity.

Any mechashift weapon in your hands feels like holding an old friend, as if you’ve been using it since early childhood. Shifting the weapon feels smooth and comes exactly at the right time. They also feel unnaturally durable and sharp in your care. Even in a fight against a Huntsman without your Aura, you could eventually defeat them due to sheer skill and experience.

You’ve also gained extensive training from all four of the Huntsman Academies and would have been on par with Pyrrha Nikos during it.
objects.title: Orion (RWBY)

addons.title: Sublime Ascendant
addons.text:
As you progress through the stages of Aura mastery, you increasingly embody your Sublime, gradually “rising” to meet and eventually become one with it. This culminates upon reaching the God stage, where you achieve a permanent state that is, for all intents and purposes, Terror without its downsides. Having completely merged with your Sublime, you have essentially become a physical manifestation of the concept it represents.

As a natural consequence of this transformation, your body may begin to change as you progress through the stages, taking on traits that reflect the nature of your Sublime as you more closely embody it.

addons.title: Mystic Armament
addons.text:
You find it intuitive to manifest spiritual constructs that reflect the nature of your Mystic, which serve as potent conduits for your Mystic’s power and are noticeably more refined than those you could otherwise create. A Mystic of Horus could create incredibly lifelike hawks to harass enemies and see through their eyes, while a Mystic of Amaterasu could manifest copies of the Three Sacred Treasures of Japan capable of replicating their associated abilities. 

Additionally, your enhanced perception of souls and superior handling of spiritual energy also makes wielding your Mystic more intuitive, giving you a deeper understanding of its spiritual aspects.

addons.title: Distributed Existence
addons.text:
As a primarily spiritual existence, your Form of Self and your physical body are equally “you.” In fact, with your physical body having essentially become a reflection of your soul and a vessel through which it interacts with the world, its nature has already become similar to that of a Form of Soul.

This addon takes that similarity a step further, making the two truly equivalent. Your physical body now counts as a Form of Soul, granting it all of the abilities and beneficial traits inherent to one, and your Form of Self likewise benefits from anything that applies to your physical body. As a reflection of this equivalence, your Halo manifests above both bodies. If you possess the means to create additional astral selves, those manifestations likewise benefit from this connection.

objects.text: The enhanced connection between your body and soul, combined with the malleable nature of your soul and your Halo’s nature as its reflection, has now come full circle. You have effectively become your Halo. You have become a kind of demi-spiritual lifeform, with your physical body now existing as a reflection of your soul and serving as a vessel through which it interacts with the world. Your Halo, meanwhile, has become the closest thing to your “real” body, an emanation of your soul manifested within physical reality. With your spirit now being the dominant force behind your existence, many of the limitations normally imposed by a physical body no longer properly apply to you. You no longer require things such as sleep or sustenance, as your soul has no need for them. This spiritual nature also makes it easier to wield the powers of your Mystic, allowing you to better synchronize with it without being as constrained by the limitations of flesh. You can disregard pain and physical harm, simply willing your vessel to continue functioning despite the damage it has sustained. Even if your physical body is damaged beyond functionality or destroyed altogether, it will eventually reform and rise again so long as your soul remains intact. You still require a physical body to directly interact with the world, but you can survive without one. Ultimately, the only way to truly kill you is to destroy your soul.
objects.title: Sublime Manifestation

addons.text:
Your Patron taking control of Od Laguna has given them a nigh-endless battery and a buff to their blessings.

Instead of Divine Protections, it's now Divine Blessings, which include traditional protections, powers, permanent body or soul enhancements, magical or divine artifacts, and even new Hero types such as Sword, Lance, Transformation, or Magical Girl. There is no miscommunication as it's your Patron making them.

Your Patron can endlessly grant these Divine Blessings whenever it is felt that you need them without having to wait to gather more power.
addons.title: GameShark

addons.text:
You're not just a hero for your Patron, but The Hero as a concept. What this means is that you can fill in for any universe's prophecy requiring a specific Hero or Chosen One to save the day. Foes that are fated to die at a specific time against a specific foe can be killed by you instead. Weapons, artifacts, and powers that were supposed to be unique to the heroic main character of that world can be used or learned by you and wielded just as effectively, if not more so.

This also has the added benefit that you no longer have to risk death when you ignite your resolve and can, in fact, do this over and over without risk. Your Patron can also further empower this boost to ensure you're always at least strong enough to defeat whatever foe you face while granting you new powers, skills, and items to help you win.
addons.title: The Chosen Hero

addons.text:
There's some kind of alleged danger that this world couldn't solve on its own. So they summoned you—either a group of individuals, a leader of a country, or even the majority of the world knew about you somehow and intentionally summoned you to fill the role of the hero who saves the day. Whether there is actually a danger only you can solve or if this is a case of political maneuvering is something you will need to find out.

Either way, expect a lot of people to at least have a general idea of what you can do—and either potential threats or a lot of hero worship from the natives.
addons.title: Save us Hero-Sama!!!

objects.text:
Your Patron is no deity merely humoring you, nor do they require you to start a religion to empower them.

Instead, your deity is the kind you would find in the most generic Isekai stories. They summoned you to be a Hero and continuously gift and empower you as you embark on your adventures solely for your enjoyment.

You can immediately choose a hero archetype, just as before—such as being the Sword or Lance Hero—without needing to travel to a simulated world to defeat a Demon Lord, whether that be one from the series or a new one is up to you. Your Patron also has the power to search for and identify real worlds that need a hero to save them (by their definition of "need" and "save") and can hijack an ongoing summoning or even drop you there themselves to help. However, this is not a requirement—you can simply remain in your current chosen world. Either way, whether through adventuring, saving the day, asking for more power, or simply over time, you will gain access to new powers, cheats, artifacts, and other things a hero would typically acquire to fulfill their role.

Over time, your Patron will gradually grow more powerful, and their blessings and the items they gift you will become increasingly potent. This process can be accelerated by regularly fighting and personally growing stronger. You can also still spread their religion to speed this up, but it is not something you have to do, as they care little beyond simply helping you.

Finally, unless you decide to rest, your Patron will not let you stay dead. If you ever die—no matter how—they will either revive you where you died or reform you in their domain before sending you where you need to go.
objects.title: Traditional Isekai Hero

objects.text:
It seems that your bond with your elemental spirits has deepened through understanding that the spirits also embody the harshness of their elements and embracing that fact to bring forth new properties to their symbolic abilities.

Through playing with the wind, you can now harness the shredding and eroding power of wind, making the very air around you difficult to breath and forming razor winds that tear down all that seek to inhibit your playing akin to a tornado smashing apart all that attempts to inhibit it.

Through breathing with the earth, you can now draw upon the shattering power of earth, making the very earth quiver beneath your feet and your strikes carrying great vibrations that shatter through even the hardest of defense like earthquakes reshaping the land.

Through flowing with the world, you can now exert the crushing pressure of water, making those that face you feel as though they are at the bottom of the sea and grant your strikes carry the pressure to carve through what lies before you like how a raging river erodes away what stands in its way.

Through cleansing through flame, you can now call forth fire’s ravenous nature, allowing your flames to burn the very vitality and life force of those who endure their bite, consuming more and more akin to a wildfire.
objects.title: Embracing Disasters

objects.text:
It seems your spirits wishing to further aid you have formed a connection to the world itself.

Through this newfound connection you have been granted quite a few benefits. Firstly, you can perceive the status of the world itself and any potential threats to it. Secondly, your elemental power will be amplified when in an environment that matches it, such as your fire becoming far stronger when on a volcano or water when at the beach. Next, you can now draw power from the world itself to either replenish your reserves or amplify your abilities, this potentially being more potent should the world you inhabit possess attributes like leylines. Finally, when facing a foe that seeks to or is endangering the world, the world itself empowers you to face said threat, filling you with as much power packed as densely as possible to be at minimum severalfold stronger. 

The sole cost of all these boons is that the world itself will seek to call upon you to defend it if needed.
objects.title: Elements of the World

objects.text: Wealth alone is not enough—true prosperity lies in the accumulation of treasures, those rare and unparalleled artifacts that define civilizations and shape history. You do not merely own valuable items; you attract them, as if the very concept of rarity bends in your favor. Whether by fate, fortune, or sheer inevitability, priceless relics, legendary artifacts, and masterworks of unparalleled craftsmanship find their way into your possession, drawn to you like moths to a flame. This is no simple knack for collection—it is a manifestation of dominion over the fruits of civilization itself. Throughout history, kings and conquerors have sought to gather the greatest creations of their eras, but where they struggled, you succeed effortlessly. Your “luck” does not simply bring wealth; it brings significance. If an object has value beyond mere currency—if it is a masterpiece, a relic, a treasure in the truest sense—it is only a matter of time before it falls into your hands. The laws of probability and chance warp around you, ensuring that no auction is lost, no deal slips away, and no priceless work remains outside your grasp for long. If you have Destiny’s Spoils, the treasures you attract will often be those most relevant to your current struggles, ensuring you always have the perfect tool or artifact to overcome any challenge. If you have Gilded One, you can create treasures outright rather than waiting for them to come to you. While these may lack the storied histories of naturally acquired artifacts, their craftsmanship and value remain unparalleled. If you seek a specific treasure, its arrival is an inevitability, guaranteed to come into your possession as soon as possible. If you have Monopoly Empire, you start attracting connections. Not only does wealth and opportunity flow toward you, but influential people take notice. Doors that were once closed begin to open, and you find yourself in conversations with those who hold power, knowledge, and access. These connections come fluidly, as if the right people always appear at the right time. They maintain effortlessly—relationships don’t feel like work, they simply exist, strong and reliable. No matter the situation, you always know exactly who to call, and when you do, they answer. Like the legendary kings of old, your true collection is not of individual items, but of ingenuity itself—the accumulated brilliance of humanity’s greatest minds. As time passes, your collection will only grow, reflecting the pinnacle of what the world has to offer. Few things exist beyond your reach, save for the unknowable wonders of civilizations yet to rise or those born beyond the stars. But for everything else—the finest creations of the past, present, and near future—you are not just a collector. You are the inevitable owner.
objects.title: Collector (Type-Moon)

objects.text: Amaranth of the Brave This is the gift of immortality bestowed upon Achilles by his mother, Thetis, immunizing him from all ill will and intent. This granted near-absolute protection against all harm to the hero, save for the singular weakness of his heel. This upgrades the “Curse of Achilles,” which relies on the powers of the River Styx, with this new blessing depending on the might of the “Flame of the West.” As long as ‘Western’ civilization exists, this powerful boon will always protect the bearer. This defense nullifies any attacks directed at the user and has only three weaknesses. The first is that those with Divine Blood at least equal to the bearer’s within their veins can pierce this protection. The second is that acts of ‘friendship’ do not trigger this defense; a vampire’s bite, for example, is meant to turn the victim into a ‘comrade.’ Finally, there is the “Achilles heel,” the vulnerability retained by the user to maintain their connection to humanity. This does not necessarily have to be the heel, but a singular point on the user’s body will remain vulnerable. Should this point be struck, the protections of Andreias Amarantos will fall for a time—12 hours, to be exact—allowing the user to be harmed like any regular human. Unlike the “Curse of Achilles,” the bearer of Andreias Amarantos will not require regular ‘naps’ to conserve their strength. Instead, being sustained by the “Flame of the West,” they retain enhanced physical capabilities, and many taxing uses of other powers will come easier to the bearer as well.
objects.title: Andreias Amarantos (Type-Moon)

objects.text: “Behold my deeds, my death, and my Spənta Ārmaiti which I must carry out. After I unleash this last arrow with all my strength, my iron body shall shatter and annihilate me where I stand!” Sometimes, a thousand arrows cannot do what a singular arrow fired with passion can. This Noble Phantasm is the crystallisation of Arash dividing the land between Persia and Turan using an arrow launched 2500 km at the cost of his life. Once, you may use your entire life force to supercharge a lone arrow beyond any conventional means. Whether this allows it to fly further than thought possible or pierce through defences thought impregnable, you may decide how this projectile is empowered. Also, the more powerful you are, the more lifeforce you may put into the arrow. Additionally, the shot you take gains an advantage in ending all kinds of strife. For example, if Stella ends the life of a famed enemy general during war, then it is more likely that the arrow would cause the entire conflict to come to its conclusion.
objects.title: Stella: Lone Meteor (Type-Moon)

objects.text: ”With my bow and arrows, I pray for the protection of the God Apollo and Goddess Artemis. I offer thee this Calamity —” The wrath of the gods is almost impossible for mortals to withstand. No one knows this more than the children of Niobe, who were slaughtered by Artemis and Apollo for Niobe’s Hubris. Gifted this divine protection by Artemis, you re-enact this myth by firing two arrows, a complaint to the gods, into the sky. What falls is not a blessing but the divine punishment of both Artemis and Apollo; arrows of light plummet from the sky by the thousands, killing everything beneath them. This Noble Phantasm can be used over a wide area enough to kill armies or focus on a singular person. The wide-area attack is best at killing opponents with high agility but low endurance, while the opposite is true for the concentrated attack. Eventually, with time and training, you may manifest the Noble Phantasm, The Seven Arrows of the Big Dipper. Seven meteor-like arrows that fall consecutively from Ursa Major. This may only target one person. However, if the original target dies, then the arrows will be distributed randomly across the battlefield.
objects.title: Phoebus Catastrophe: Complaint Message on the Arrow (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
Having received the blood of the Welsh Dragon, you have been transformed into something resembling a Demigod: a Half-Dragon. Unlike the Greek Demigods, you do not carry the curse that draws monsters to you by scent, though skilled hunters and monsters can still track your trail if they catch your scent. Each level of purchase here will enhance how much the Red Dragon’s blood has changed you.

With a single purchase, you possess the innate ability to extend razor-sharp claws from your fingers and toes—claws strong enough to rend through steel and never dull or break. You are immune to normal flames and intense heat, and can spit fireballs with remarkable speed and precision. These flames draw upon your internal draconic strength, granting you a power level comparable to a fledgling demigod still finding their way.

With a second purchase, your change deepens, with you now possessing strength similar to that of the average Demigod. Within your mouth, you can grow draconic fangs—powerful enough to bite through plate steel with ease. You can shift your skin into resilient scales stronger than Celestial Bronze—though if you lose focus, they’ll soon revert into skin. You can now unleash jets and plumes of fire, breathing smoke and flame with ease.

With the third purchase, your power continues to grow. You now possess strength comparable to the children of the Big Three. You can sprout draconic wings from your back, allowing you to fly unaided. Your fangs and claws have developed an anti-supernatural property similar to Celestial Bronze, making them effective against monsters and supernatural entities of all forms. Your skin can now shift back and forth into scales as permanently as you desire.

Finally, with the fourth purchase, you have reached the pinnacle of a demi-dragon, enabling you to challenge minor gods. You can transform into both a humanoid dragon and a full-fledged dragon form. While in your full draconic form, you’ll find all of your physical abilities enhanced by an order of magnitude. Finally, you have pyrokinesis—control over fire—comparable in scope to Percy Jackson’s control over water. You can conjure, manipulate, and unleash flames with devastating effect.
objects.title: Child of the Welsh Dragon (King Arthur CYOA)

objects.text:
Congratulations! You’ve officially overstayed your welcome. The deadline has passed, and the escape route should have closed. But for whatever reason—stubbornness, desperation, or sheer spite—you’re still climbing.

The rules have changed. No more time limits, no more ticking clocks. You are free to grind your bones against the Tower’s teeth for centuries, if that’s what it takes. But freedom in Hell is a poisoned gift.

Every extra moment you spend beyond the deadline stretches the time before you “wake up” in the outside world. A year in hell means a year missing from reality. Stay too long, and you may return to a world that barely remembers you.

And then, there’s the Tower.

It does not forgive. It does not forget. Every failure past the deadline feeds it, forces it to grow. The first death, a new floor. The second, two more. The third? Four. The longer you remain, the more the Tower grows, to the point where escaping may take decades of endless struggle.

And yet, as long as you can stand, as long as you can climb, the chance remains. You have chosen to fight against the inevitable, and the inevitable has chosen to fight back.

Hell does not let go of what it owns.

But neither do you.
objects.title: Till Hell Freezes Over (And Then Some)

addons.text:
You are no longer the vessel of just a single deity—your heart now houses the entire pantheon. Every god within your faith has taken root within you, their divine presence interwoven with your soul. Their voices, their power, and their essence no longer reside in distant realms but within the depths of your heart, making you a walking sanctuary of the divine.

With each heartbeat, their influence flows through you, allowing you to channel the authority of multiple gods at once. Their instincts, knowledge, and emotions subtly guide you, and in moments of need, they can manifest their will through you, empowering your actions with divine purpose.

The bond between you and the pantheon is absolute. Should a god falter, you can sustain them; should a god grow in power, you will feel it surge within you. Worship of your pantheon now strengthens both you and them. You have become their living vessel, the heart of the pantheon made flesh.
addons.title: Pantheon’s Living Vessel

addons.text:
You are no longer just a champion or a vessel of the divine—you are the central pillar of your pantheon’s existence. Their power, influence, and authority are now intrinsically tied to you, making you the primary conduit through which they act in the mortal world. You are not simply guided by the gods—you govern them, with control over the flow of faith and divine energy.

Your connection to worship has fundamentally changed. Faith does not just empower the gods—it empowers you directly, allowing you to wield divine energy on a scale that surpasses even the highest-ranking deities. You can redistribute belief among the gods, strengthening or weakening them as needed. If a deity in your pantheon begins to falter, you can restore their power by directing worship toward them. Conversely, you can strip a god of their influence, rendering them powerless if their faith is fully severed. Given enough worship, you can create entirely new gods, shaping divine authority itself.

At your peak, you surpass all divine entities in influence. Your connection to faith ensures that as long as mortals believe, you cannot be permanently destroyed. The gods cannot act unless you allow it. Should you fall, the pantheon risks fading into obscurity, but as long as faith in you remains, you stand as the unchallenged ruler of the divine, dictating the fate of gods and mortals alike.
addons.title: Godking of the Gods

addons.text:
With your god now residing within your metaphysical heart, and your blood no longer mortal but divine ichor, a new transformation begins—not just of body, but of divinity itself. Your patron is now rooted in the very life that flows through you. Every heartbeat, every surge of blood is a ritual of offering. You are their altar, their garden, and their growth.

Your divine ichor does more than empower you—it nourishes the god within. Just as deoxygenated blood flows into the heart and leaves renewed with oxygen, your divine blood enters your god and leaves more holy than before. This circulation is a loop of ascension: as your blood feeds your patron, they grow within you. In return, they refine you, lifting your mortal form toward something far more radiant.

Over time, your patron begins to change, evolving in tandem with you. Their power begins to reflect aspects of your nature and experiences, shaped by your victories, emotions, and beliefs. You are no longer just their vessel—you are their soil, their storm, their season of growth.

In turn, their growth feeds back into you. As they ascend through your living sacrifice, so too do your divine abilities bloom. Your magic becomes laced with celestial purity, your strength honed by mythic gravity, and your presence begins to radiate a low, unshakable sense of sacred authority. You and your god are now locked in a loop of mutual cultivation—divinity begetting divinity.

Should you both live long enough, even without believers your god may rise into something greater than they ever were—and you, into something more than godblood and borrowed might.

You may become the spark that forges a new pantheon.

And it will have begun in your veins.
addons.title: Divine Cultivation

objects.text:
They say God lives in one’s heart, for you this is pretty literal.

Your patron no longer exists in their celestial realm but now dwells within the very essence of your being, taking residence in a metaphysical manifestation of your heart. With every heartbeat, divine energy courses through your veins, infusing your body with power far beyond that of a mere mortal. Your strength, endurance, and resilience rise to match that of a demigod, making you a living extension of your deity’s will upon the earth.

This is more than just a source of power; it is a bond of true symbiosis. You are not simply their champion—you are their vessel, their anchor to the mortal plane. Your thoughts resonate with theirs, your emotions echo in their being, and your victories become their triumphs. Their presence within you allows them to act more freely in the world, subtly shaping reality in ways that were once beyond their grasp. Miracles become effortless, divine intervention more immediate, and your connection with them deeper than ever before.

However, such a bond comes at a cost. Should you fall, so too will your patron. If your heart ceases to beat, their essence will unravel, dissolving into nothingness. In a very real sense, their survival is now bound to yours, making your existence not just a matter of mortal consequence, but of divine preservation. Yet with this risk comes unparalleled power—you are no longer simply a champion of the divine. You are their heart, their vessel, and their living legacy.
objects.title: Godheart

objects.text: Idols are objects of devotion, admiration, and faith. In your case, that faith has become something far more literal. Your “pantheon” is no longer a distant collection of mythic gods, but the idols of Hololive themselves—each one elevated into a true divine being through the power of belief. Your Idols now grow stronger not only through EXP and HoloCoins, but also through worship. The admiration of fans, followers, and believers strengthens them, gradually refining them closer to their idealized divine selves. Even when their summoned bodies are destroyed, the power they have gained through faith remains. Their true forms reside within the divine realm you visit in your sleep, where they exist as fully realized divine entities rather than temporary summons. Because of this transformation, your Idols no longer need to be physically present for you to benefit from their power. You may call upon their authority as miracles, invoke blessings tied to their nature, or channel their strength directly—especially if you possess Godheart, allowing you to wield their divine power as your own. Your pantheon begins small, consisting only of the Idols you have acquired, but each new Idol you recruit becomes another god within your growing celestial court.
objects.title: Another Kind of Pantheon

objects.text:
The Guard Skills you currently have are a start. But you shouldn’t be satisfied with just a couple of skills, not when you have the capability to make more.

You can download The Angel Player onto any computer, phone, tablet, or similar electronic device with the necessary functionality to run the software.

With The Angel Player, you can code yourself additional Guard Skills and potentially even other abilities or modifications if you have the skill to do so.

The limits on what you can achieve with The Angel Player ultimately depend on your own coding expertise and the time it takes you to develop each new ability or skill.

Make sure to carefully consider what you want any new skill to do and the potential consequences that may come with it. Accidentally creating an evil clone or a technique with a painful drawback would not reflect well on your coding abilities.
objects.title: The Programmer (Angel Beats)

addons.text:
Your Angel Player has completely integrated into your afterlife. This allows you to program everyone and everything that is a part of it. From the NPCs to any dead souls you have, even some of the fundamental rules governing how your afterlife works can be changed.

This enables feats such as turning the NPCs into hostile shadow monsters if certain triggers occur, gifting others abilities from the Angel Player, and even turning someone into an NPC. The only real limitations are your coding skills, the time required, and the server capacity needed to run such powerful programs.
addons.title: God knows...

objects.text:
Your Soul Garden by default now takes the shape of a Japanese high school surrounded by forests. This shape is the original form of the afterlife you were supposed to go to.

Your afterlife is filled with "NPCs"—Non-Player Characters. These individuals appear and act human, but regular interaction with them reveals certain tells: they instantly recognize anyone who has recently arrived in your afterlife, they do not possess souls, and they consider anything strange they see as completely normal.

In addition, anyone you are connected to who dies can be brought into your afterlife if you choose to give them entrance. If you let it run passively, this will draw in children, teenagers and young adults who died tragic deaths across all periods of time in whatever world you're in. They will have the same type of immortality as you and will be capable of crafting items out of dirt if they know how to assemble each part individually. However, they do not have access to your Angel Player powers.

If you ever feel the need to let them pass on, you can choose to reincarnate them into any world(s) you have visited.
objects.title: Afterlife Battlefront (Angel Beats)

addons.title: Slayer Organization
addons.text:
As the First Slayer, you possess the ability to pass on the title and power, so it is only natural that you would grant those powers to those who follow you. Just as Buffy did, you have taken the once-solitary mantle and made it into something that connects many: an order of Slayers who share the burden and support one another.

Due to being the origin of their powers, your Slayers begin with a bit more power than Buffy, being more comparable to Buffy during her third year. Multiple of your Slayers could share the same prophetic dream of what is to come, allowing them to act together as a team or learn more minute details due to the shared nature of the vision. As they grow, they are able to share memories, allowing you and them to grow and perfect your skills as one.

And finally, as the symbol of your leadership of this new order of Slayers, you receive the mʔ – the Slayer's Scythe. Taking the form of a bardiche, this weapon was forged to slay the greatest of demons and contains the mythical essence of the Slayer's power; the power within it is the stuff of legends, allowing it to cut through anything, be they spiritual beings, magic, or even space itself.

Just as a Slayer can grow with time, so does the mʔ. The more Slayers there are, and the longer they remain active, the more powerful it becomes—a living proof of you and your Slayers.

objects.text:
You’ve become imbued with the powers of The First Slayer, thus giving you a direct connection to the shadow demon that first granted her powers. As a consequence of this, your superhuman powers become vastly superior, and you gain the ability to astral-project into the dreams and visions of other Slayers, as well as the precognitive ability to foretell impending dangers. Due to the primal nature of The First, your powers also become much more instinctive and intuitive to use.

As you’ve become the very first in line, you gain control over how the Slayer title is passed on and, as such, can awaken it in those with the potential for it.
objects.title: The First Slayer (Buffy the Vampire Slayer)

objects.text:
The flaws of your dark bloodline have been vanquished by Nagash's proper rites, and your old weaknesses are gone!

Your soul being properly moored to your body has had other benefits as well, as your might & abilities are now equal to all the Mortarchs of Nagash (and all other Undead Legendary Lords) put together, such as Vlad & Mannfred von Carstein, Luthor & Walach Harkon, Neferata herself, and even the non-Vampiric Mortarchs & Legendary Lords like Arkhan the Black & Krell.

Quite simply, you are the greatest Vampire of them all.
objects.title: Mortarch (Warhammer: Fantasy)

addons.text:
Something miraculous has occurred in your creation. Your body produces a protein known as Someinine, previously thought to be exclusive to the head of the Yozokura family. Unlike with the Yozokura family head your Someinine production has effects on you, enhancing your physiology to similar levels to the Yozokuras and granting you the ability to Bloom. 

This grants you the full power, knowledge, and skill of anyone with the power of Someinine, whether synthetic or natural, allowing you to replicate their powers and their skills. Your abilities can be activated at will and you have perfect control over them. You also have access to more advanced forms of Blooming like True Spring Blooming and the Profuse Blooming of 10,000 Flowers, and can use them without fear of health repercussions. The energy generated by Someinine can be used to fuel your Kishikai form along with your Tao, allowing you to use the form indefinitely. You can infuse Someinine into others which enhances their physiology and grants them a unique Blooming of their own. Finally, you gain an arsenal of the equipment used by the Yozokura family, as well as the knowledge to repair and recreate them.
addons.title: In Bloom (Mission: Yozokura Family)

objects.text:
You are a Tensen, a synthetic being created through a combination of Human and Flower Tao, namely Tao from the Banko and Waitanhua Flower Tao. Your physiology is enhanced to superhuman levels, being able to destroy stone pillars with a single blow and move fast enough to appear to be teleporting. You have immense powers of regeneration due to your Flower Tao, being able to regenerate lost limbs and even your head. Your regeneration is sourced from an ovule located around your navel. Due to your Flower Tao originating from the Waitanhua Flower, you are capable of sprouting vines that can be used as whips and formed into weapons and shields. You can also infect others with Flower Tao to cause them to go Arborification. 

You possess mastery of Tao, a form of energy present in all living and non-living things. Your mastery is on the level of Rien, granting you access to any Tao abilities displayed by the Tensen, and you possess all of the unique abilities and skills of your brethren. You can run out of Tao and weaken immensely, but due to having the combined properties of the Banko and the Waitanhua Flower, you can instantly convert organic beings into Tan or even the perfected Elixir of Life. You possess full knowledge and mastery of the Five Training Methods of Immortality used to train Sennin, and can teach the arts of Tao to others.

Your last resort is your Kishikai form, a monstrous hybrid of your Yin and Yang forms mixed with plant matter, which greatly boosts your power at the cost of using up a great deal of your Tao. You can maintain your full Kishikai form for 1 hour before you reduce yourself to a weakened state. Alternatively, you can partially assume your Kishikai form, giving you half of the power boost in exchange for double the time in this form.

However, you have one great weakness. If your ovule is destroyed by somebody with a large amount of Tao of the opposing element, you will die. You do not possess your brethren’s flaw of having your Tao weaken at night.
objects.title: Tensen of the Waitanhua Flower (Jigokuraku)

objects.text:
You're no longer a mere Hanyō, but you are now a full-blooded Yōkai. 

Your overall physical powers are greatly amplified, having at least the strength to fling trucks and collapse small buildings - regardless of the type of Yōkai you are. You also possess the speed to move at hundreds of miles per hour. In a single night, you could terrorize and wipe out a remote town of humans, even if they were armed with firearms such as shotguns and handguns.

Your lifespan spans thousands of years, and your Yoki is immense. You have two forms: a human form and your true form. In your true form, your powers are doubled, and potentially tripled with practice. On top of all that, you no longer have the weakness of losing your powers during the new moon.
objects.title: Yōkai (Inuyasha)

addons.text:
You're not just prayed to like a god. You're a God. The same kind of Gods that are part of the Takamagahara. This gives you up to four different domains of your choosing that will grant you both powers and an increase in power for any abilities your type of Yōkai had that connect with those domains.

It can be something as simple as harvest or rice, to something more broad like storms or the sun. But you cannot have more than two broad domains. Alongside this, you can choose a sacred Weapon, Object, Animal and Plant for each Domain. One of these must be connected to your Yōkai form.

As a divine being, your influence isn’t limited to a single form or place. You can manifest through natural phenomena, sacred objects, animals or followers aligned with your Domains.

You also have the other abilities of kami, such as dividing your essence into bunrei, each fully empowered, possessing mediums, creating and empowering miko and taking the souls of your faithful into a personal afterlife shaped by your domain. Finally, you may pass between realms—whether the living world, the spirit plane, heaven or the lands of the dead.

Your level of power allows you to dwarf a DaiYōkai and grow stronger through prayers and offerings made in your honor. You can turn beings weaker than you into lesser types of your own Yōkai race, or create new ones entirely—such as a Nine-Tailed Kitsune producing kitsune followers with any number of tails, so long as they remain beneath DaiYōkai level.

In time, with enough faith or centuries of growth, even the creation of beings equal to DaiYōkai may become possible.
addons.title: Kami

objects.text:
You reached a new level of power. To put it bluntly, you are to a Yōkai what a Yōkai is to a powerless human. 

Your power is so immense that you could kill hundreds of Yōkai with a single attack, and it would take armies upon armies of Yōkai to even have a slim chance of defeating you, only to end in a pyrrhic victory. Even then, such an event is unlikely to work—especially if you were to take on your true form. Your lifespan is endless, and even if slain, you could revive yourself given enough time.

Your ability to manipulate Yoki is so advanced that it wouldn't take much effort for you to develop new abilities on the fly. Creating barriers, teleporting, raising the dead, cutting space, and even forging personal dimensions are all within your reach—though such feats would require time and effort to perfect. Your body parts, such as fangs, could be used to craft extremely powerful weapons.

Humans would likely pray to you like a god. And would they be wrong, when you have the power to grant most—if not all—of their prayers?
objects.title: DaiYokai (Inuyasha)

addons.text: "Where Heaven’s gaze once faltered, yours now pierces. You do not ask the hidden to obey— you remind them they were always beneath your reign." The Celestial Bureaucracy, for all its might, does not reach everywhere. Beyond the light of the Jade Throne lie shadow realms and rogue domains—phantom courts, shattered heavens, veiled dimensions, and even alien or eldritch realms ruled by banished gods, ancient spirits, or unknowable forces. These are places where Heaven’s writ has faded, where chaos reigns unchecked. Yet even here, your divine blood resonates. The All-Reaching Mandate of Heaven is the ripple of the future made present. Though your formal coronation has yet to be realized, your authority spills through cracks in the world, granting you the right to act where even the Jade Emperor might hesitate. You may summon your divine influence into these forsaken planes, temporarily imposing the order of Heaven where once there was only madness. Your voice may call forth the unbound to parley—rogue immortals, eldritch rulers, ghosts, demons and others disguised as gods, all are compelled to answer, if not obey. In moments of judgment or turmoil, you can assert dominion, stilling conflicts, binding lawless beings to duty, or reasserting roles long abandoned. These exertions are not yet absolute. The Mandate’s reach is fleeting, resisted by realms that have tasted too much freedom. Yet with time, cultivation, and ascension, what begins as temporary arbitration will evolve into enduring control. Domains once foreign to Heaven’s eye— whether from the cosmos, ancient abysses, or beyond—will one day bend to your will, their native laws subsumed to the writ of Heaven. What flickers now like a beacon may soon blaze like a sun—unyielding, eternal, inescapable. You do not merely extend Heaven’s reach. You were born to reclaim what Heaven abandoned.
addons.title: All-Reaching Mandate

objects.text:
You are the successor of the Jade Emperor, the ruler of Heaven, you are destined to inherit his Throne. This marks the beginning of your ascent from a mortal to a celestial.

With the Mandate of Heaven now firmly rooted in your soul, you inherit not only the Jade Emperor's divine authority but also his divine cultivation arts. The cultivation techniques and spiritual practices that once elevated the Jade Emperor to his celestial station are now within your grasp. 

With time and effort, you can unlock greater mastery of these arts, cultivating your spirit and body until you can transcend mortal limitations. The more you cultivate, the more your power grows, drawing you closer to your ultimate goal: ascending to the Celestial Court.

Your divine authority extends beyond the mortal realm. The forces of Heaven itself begin to bend toward your will. Your decrees now have celestial backing, and you can call upon the favor of the gods themselves to enforce your rule. Be it summoning divine storms, calling upon celestial warriors, or invoking the elements to support your will, the Heavens now respond to your commands.

This power is a gateway to the divine. As you fulfill your duties on Earth and cultivate your celestial abilities, the path to Heaven becomes clearer. You are no longer simply a ruler of mortals—you are the Jade Emperor's Protégé, the next in line to ascend to the throne of the Celestial Court. 

One day, you will leave the mortal world behind and ascend to Heaven, where you will take your rightful place as the Jade Emperor, ruler of the Cosmos.
objects.title: Heavenly Scion of the Jade Throne

objects.text:
As the bearer of the Heavenly Mandate and the rightful emperor of a vast empire, you have awakened a divine ability, the power to perceive and manipulate the very fortune of your nation.

This national fortune is no mere superstition. It is a sacred, ethereal essence, a metaphysical gauge of your empire’s vitality and destiny. It pulses with the collective will, prosperity, and spirit of your people. So long as your empire flourishes and your subjects thrive under your righteous rule, this celestial energy will continue to accumulate, empowering you to reshape fate itself and guide the course of your empire’s history toward glory.

With this power, natural disasters can be averted. Gentle rains and bountiful harvests may be ensured. Rich veins of ore and other vital resources will emerge from the earth, ready to be discovered. The economy will prosper, and the population will surge, ushering in a golden age of innovation and abundance. Diplomats will triumph against all odds, wars will be avoided, and your nation will ascend to unmatched prominence, as if guided by destiny itself.

National Fortune does more than preserve domestic harmony; its influence extends far beyond your borders. Rival kingdoms may suffer blighted harvests, economic collapse, or the fires of rebellion. Sabotage and subterfuge will unravel under a chain of improbable failures. Hostile expeditions may miss your lands entirely, vanishing for generations. Your enemies will remain blind to the unseen hand orchestrating their ruin. Even gods and immortals who dare interfere may find their blessings undone, their curses broken, their prophecies voided, and their powers suppressed, overwhelmed by the sovereign might of your empire’s fate.

As emperor, you are the axis upon which this immense power turns. The nation’s fortune surrounds you like an invisible aegis, shielding you from supernatural harm, twisting fate itself to ensure your well-being and survival, elevating your luck beyond mortal limits, and marking you as one chosen by the heavens.

But heed this final truth: such power is not without limits. It is born from your kingdom’s prosperity, and to abuse it is to drain its lifeblood. Should your nation’s fortune be fully depleted, your dynasty will fall, and your empire will crumble into history.
objects.title: National Fortune

objects.text:
Among the Four Symbols, the Azure Dragon and the Vermilion Bird are most closely bound to the essence of Yang. Now, with possession of their thrones and powers, you stand as the Lord—or Lady—of Yang.

As the embodiment of Yang, you wield influence over some of the most potent domains: the Sun, Day, Light, Creation, Order, Life, and Peace. Command the Sun itself, and at your will, it will rise or set. With time, you could create a never-ending day. You possess the power to gather and shape all light, creating illusions or constructs as you see fit.

As a deity of life, you can breathe vitality into anything—restoring the fallen, granting true resurrection, or bestowing a statue with genuine life. Your very presence can bring harmony and order to the world: your radiant light banishes darkness.

All these powers—and more—are yours to command. Yet remember, there is no Yang without Yin. Without a complementary Lord—or Lady—of Yin to balance the scales, the full potential of these domains will remain beyond your reach.
objects.title: Lord of Yang

objects.text: As the Ruler of the East, South, West, and North, you stand as the most recent ascendant to the throne of the Golden Qilin of the Central Heavens—Lord of Tǔ, master of the Axis Mundi, and the Qilin themselves. In your divine authority as Lord of the Qilin, you possess the power to shift your form at will—from a humble human visage to your full, majestic divine Qilin form, or any blend in between. Lesser Qilin will instinctively heed your commands, recognizing your rule. The Wu Xing element of Tǔ—Earth—resides within you, granting access to a multitude of abilities and variants yet to be discovered. Dust, Gravity, Bones, Crystal, Sand, and more are at your command, each offering unique avenues to explore. At the core of your dominion lies the Axis Mundi—the very link between Heaven and Earth. This sacred connection bridges the mortal realm with the divine, and as its ruler, you hold the authority to regulate access to this celestial gateway. Should mortals be granted the ability to find and explore the divine realms? Or are they better left undisturbed by divine presence? Only you can decide. While one individual can wield all of this vast power, it becomes significantly easier—and wiser—to delegate.
