While you still possess the full powers of the Four Beasts, you also have the ability to appoint trusted beings to occupy the sacred seats of the Azure Dragon, Vermillion Bird, White Tiger, or Black Tortoise. These appointees will bear the rights, powers, and responsibilities of these legendary guardians for as long as you permit. While these beings will possess all the powers of whichever title you grant them, their authority stems from you, and you retain the right to still use those powers as you please. Their powers, even combined, will never be able to truly threaten you. Note: While it's more common to have it be the Golden Dragon of the Center, it's not unheard of to have it be a Qilin instead. In the interest of variety, Qilin has been chosen here.
objects.title: Golden Qilin of the Center

objects.text:
Among the Four Symbols, the White Tiger and the Black Tortoise are most closely intertwined with the essence of Yin. Now, with your ascension to their thrones and the might they bestow, you stand as the new Lady—or Lord—of Yin.

As the embodiment of Yin, you command some of the most profound and formidable domains: the Moon, Night, Darkness, Destruction, Chaos, Death, and War.

You hold dominion over the Moon itself; at your whim, it will wax or wane. With patience and effort, you could even summon an endless night, shrouding the world in eternal darkness. Your power extends to all forms of shadow and Darkness—capable of shaping them into constructs, or traversing their depths as a means of transport.

As an entity connected to Death, you possess the authority to usher in the final end. Wherever you go, you can grant a permanent rest to those whose lives you extinguish. Your very presence can seed War and Chaos, unleashing upheaval and destruction that devours the light, leaving only all-consuming darkness behind.

All these powers—and more—are yours to command. Yet, remember: Yin cannot exist without its counterpart, Yang. Without a Lady—or Lord—of Yang to balance the scales, the full potential of these domains will remain beyond your grasp.
objects.title: Lady of Yin

objects.text:
You are an Overlord. Overlords are the apex of Sinner evolution—demons born from human damnation who have risen above their cursed origins through sheer power, control, and cunning. You were once a human, then a Sinner, but now you are a sovereign. Your will shapes your surroundings, your name commands obedience or dread, and your influence is written into the very bones of Hell.

Your powers have evolved beyond the raw abilities of a Sinner. As an Overlord, your abilities are personalized and refined, expressions of your essence, your history, and your sins. You command unique supernatural gifts: manipulation of elements, shadows, emotions, sound, or constructs born from your vice. Your abilities are vast and thematic, always reflecting the same primal truths that forged your demonic identity. You can summon bound souls to your side and use contracts or spoken pacts to enforce unbreakable obligations. Your deals are sacred within the laws of Hell; a simple handshake can seal a soul’s fate. You can compel those bound to your influence, and the more souls you own, the more power you wield.

Most defining of all, you possess a physical dominion within Hell—a literal slice of the underworld that belongs to you. This territory exists as part of Hell itself, shaped in both design and function by your form, theme, and sin. You can physically enter and leave it at will. You may also bring others in and out of it, willingly or not. This place is connected to the local underworld of any world you enter. If no such underworld exists, your dominion becomes that world’s de facto Hell—a place for the spiritually damned and lost souls to collect. Within your domain, your power is amplified, and the terrain itself acts in accordance with your will. It is a sanctuary, a fortress, and a trap, all in one.

You gain and maintain your power through the ownership of souls. Souls fuel your strength, empower your deals, and expand your influence. You acquire them through binding contracts, gambling, coercion, or temptation. A single deal can give you dominion over someone forever, their soul tethered to your will even across time and space. You can recall the bound at any moment, transport them into your realm, or command them to act—even across planes, if conditions allow.

However, you are still a Sinner at your core, and your weaknesses remain. You are still vulnerable to being killed by holy powers. Moreover, your deals, if flawed, can be exploited. A clever loophole, an unexpected clause, or a manipulated contract can cost you dearly—your domain, your power, or even your own soul.
objects.title: Overlord (Hazbin Hotel)

objects.text:
You are a Hellborn demon—a native creature of Hell, born and raised in its twisted infernal ecology. While Hellborn demons vary in shape, size, and species, you are not a noble, a royal, or an overlord. You occupy a rank beneath Sinners in Hell’s brutal hierarchy, existing as a hellhound, imp, or other lesser-born demon species.

Your appearance is shaped by your species, with consistent biological traits and infernal features typical of Hellborn demons. Imps tend to be small, red-skinned, wiry, and scrappy, with sharp teeth and eyes that glow in the dark. Hellhounds appear more bestial and predatory, while other Hellborn variants may display claws, tails, horns, wings, or other demonic appendages that suit their purpose. Regardless of form, your body is built for survival in Hell’s social, physical, and spiritual gauntlet. You have a heart, a stomach, and a working biology—you eat, breathe, bleed, and age.

You are inherently stronger, faster, and more durable than most mortals. You possess low-tier supernatural abilities tied to your species. These might include minor shapeshifting, limited flight (if winged), enhanced senses, minor magic, or unique traits such as brutal melee prowess (for hellhounds) or cunning and tool use (for imps). You can also assume a human disguise to walk in the living world, though telltale signs—eye color, shadows, aura—can give you away. You are capable of transforming into a more monstrous, violent version of yourself in times of extreme rage or duress, a “true demon” form that enhances your natural abilities and is deeply instinctual.

Your weaknesses are numerous. Unlike Sinners, you are not immortal. You can die from violence, old age, or disease—both demonic and magical. Depending on your species, you are vulnerable to conventional weapons.
objects.title: Hellborn Demon (Hazbin Hotel/Helluva Boss)

objects.text:
You are the Sacred One, eternal and ever-flowing — the first note of creation’s endless symphony. Your story is sung in light and shadow, unfolding with every breath, shaping new beginnings from the heart of timeless song.

The Hymns no longer pass through you — they begin with you. You are the origin of sacred resonance, the living seed of divine song from which beauty, meaning, and creation flow. Where once your voice carried power, now reality leans in to listen, drawn to the first light of your unfolding melody.

Your presence inspires the world to shape itself around grace. Flowers bloom in your wake not as decoration, but as response — life answering life. Artisans feel their craft stir. Poets weep without knowing why.

You are not simply beautiful; you are the impulse that makes beauty possible. What others perceive as divine is, in your presence, simply the natural order coming home to itself.

Your humanoid and peacock forms merge into a seamless divine gestalt. You may appear as a being of radiant feathers and flowing light, or a figure of sublime beauty and holiness — ever-shifting, impossible to fully perceive, too sacred for mortal, divine, or even eldritch minds to comprehend without awe or reverence.

When you sing, you do not channel the divine — you compose it. Each note carries the seed of a new world, a new law, a new truth. You may weave harmonies into places or people, planting change that blossoms over hours, lifetimes, or legends.

New, uncountable wings span not only space but the thresholds of time, life, death, universes, and hidden realms. With a single beat, you pass unseen between the realms of creation — in the liminal spaces of soul and song.
Your feathers are not mere adornments but fragments of eternity. They defy space, pierce time, and carry the weight of divine will. Each one bears power — to become a muse, to shield, to heal, to destroy, to inspire — and those that fall become miracles scattered across the realms.

Planted into the world, they grow into structures of living beauty — temples without walls, songs without end, dreams that become places others may walk. You are not the protector of the sacred — you are its wellspring. Sacredness comes into being because you exist.

As the Sacred One, you do not govern or command — the world harmonizes with you willingly. You no longer need to assert your authority; existence reshapes itself around your song the way music reshapes silence.

In times of pain, destruction, or decay, you simply sing new possibility into being, and healing begins — regardless of how such things came to be. All things can be restored: mind, body, soul, time, space and uncountable things more.

Even those removed from all of Creation can be restored through echoes only you hear in the silence left by their end — erased timelines, lost people, forgotten concepts, and more that would otherwise be forever lost.

This restoration from nothing — this sacred rebirth — extends to you as well. Should you be unmade, scattered, or silenced, the melody that is your essence will sing again, drawing itself back from Void.
objects.title: The Sacred One

objects.text: Your eyes have undergone a sacred metamorphosis, merging the innate perception of the Byakugan with the limitless insight of the Six Eyes. From this union emerges the divine Shinjitsugan—the "Truth Eye." A vision reborn in stillness and clarity, like a lotus blooming in pristine waters. It perceives not only the world as it is, but as it was, is, and may become, offering a gaze that spans the full spectrum of existence. This awakened sight becomes the fertile ground where the nascent blossom of Buddha's Five Eyes of Enlightenment begins to flower. Freed from the flaws of its predecessors—with no blind spots to limit you and no mental strain to bear—your vision expands into a seamless sphere, radiating in all directions. Even at rest, it encompasses an entire city. When fully awakened, its reach triples, and with continued mastery, it only grows further. Within this field of vision, nothing remains hidden. Illusions shatter, physical barriers lose meaning, and the lingering traces of past events are revealed. Places and objects whisper to you of what they've seen. Souls shine like lanterns, their memories, traits, and emotional scars visible through their spiritual presence. Your gaze crosses into the spirit world and realms unseen, revealing ghosts in forgotten ruins, guardian spirits in ancient trees, mischievous yōkai wandering the forest, and truths folded between realms. The borders between realities shimmer like silk, and with a glance, you pierce them, overlaying these worlds like layers in a mandala onto your vision—with you at the center. The Shinjitsugan provides more than sight—it gives you understanding. You don't just see the world; you grasp how it works. Natural and preternatural forces become visible as you shift through energy spectrums like light, magnetism, gravity, mana, qi, cursed energy, etc. No matter the world or its rules, your vision adjusts and shows you what others can't. With this clarity comes foresight. You can follow the chain of cause and effect, understanding how one action leads to the next. The near future becomes easy to predict because you see the flow of events as a logical progression. Although the distant future beyond a few weeks remains unclear, your ability to see ahead will improve in time with mastery. Even your martial arts have transcended their earthly limits. The Gentle Fist is no longer limited to blocking chakra flow. Your strikes now reach the level of cells and spirit, allowing you to sever energy within the body, interrupt spells before they form, and dismantle magical or supernatural techniques. If energy flows through something, you can locate it, control it, or destroy it.
objects.title: Shinjitsugan

addons.text:
Your system has given you the divine equivalent of training wheels. 

Your Gamer System's ability to interface with other powers has expanded to include a subsystem that replicates and saves your other powers as Conjuring, over which you have administrative authority.

While this function is certainly convenient as a baseline, its default conjuring is wildly inefficient, with each rune packed full of functionally meaningless aesthetic features that waste your time and energy. For example, a converted teleportation spell might include a complex, but meaningless, magic circle, sound effects, and a bright flash of light tacked on to the actual intended effect of the conjuring.

The most efficient way of using this subsystem is to take the form-over-function default runes generated by it, then isolate and prune the extraneous elements, before finally updating the saved rune in your subsystem. Leaving you with an ever-growing library of runes and their associated functions, which you can use as a foundation to further develop your Conjuring.

Eventually, you might even gain the knowledge and skill required to update the subsystem itself, so that its default rune constructions become as efficient as possible.
addons.title: Junior Administrator: You

addons.text: You have gained the qualities of a True Dragon, the second-oldest variety of gods. This has strengthened your intrinsic abilities in several ways. First, your starting stockpile of energy and your soul's inherent rate of energy generation have both increased, giving you more surplus power to work with even without a reliable outside source. Additionally, your already powerful physical enhancement conjuring has grown far stronger with the addition of your already powerful draconic body. Likewise, your breath attack has also been enhanced, becoming a torrent of pure destructive energy that you could conceivably fire from anywhere, not just your mouth. Last and most notably, your innate draconic resistance has been supplemented by your new powerful barrier that provides near-absolute protection against physical and magical attacks at or below your level. This barrier is inherently powerful enough that even a relatively unexceptional member of your species was uncertain if even a planet-destroying catastrophe would be enough to break it, and the strongest True Dragon is even known as The Unbreakable God owing to the incredible strength of his barrier, even among gods as powerful as D and Meido. In addition to your enhanced intrinsic conjuring, you have also been provided with a conjuring-focused education befitting a member of a species who are guaranteed to become gods sooner or later. This means you have a much greater foundation for your conjuring, increasing both your versatility and your rate of future advancement.
addons.title: True Dragon

addons.text:
Your Higher Knowledge and intuitive understanding of the underlying principles of the world have synergized with your Divinity to allow you to surpass the major hurdle halting your ascent, your lack of Rune knowledge.

Whenever you encounter something, whether it be a natural phenomenon, a supernatural ability, or even something stranger, you instinctively begin to grasp the Runes associated with it and how they might be used to replicate it. While the process of gleaning Rune knowledge may not be truly instantaneous - scaling with the complexity of the thing being studied - it is still fast enough to gain understanding of most things within seconds.

This is most efficient when studying magic or the usage of divine power, as the similarities between them and Conjuring make the reinterpretation of knowledge easier.
addons.title: Runic Intuition
Magic of the Soul
addons.text:
You now recognize that your Conjuring and Wild Magic are not two separate forces; they are permutations of the same art, the true Magic of the Soul.

While Wild Magic derives power from the souls of others as they are, Conjuring involves first absorbing such energies for later use. 

As a result of this revelation, you may take advantage of the best traits of both arts.

You no longer need to fear destroying the link to your own soul when using your more powerful Wild Magic spells, since your powerful divine soul and large energy reserves insulate you from such concerns. 

Likewise, you can quickly derive far more power from each soul than any comparable god or Wild Magic caster, as you use not only the binding force of souls but also the souls' innate energy. The extent of this energy extraction is up to you, ranging from merely siphoning some of the soul’s accumulated experience to decomposing a soul into pure energy, destroying it completely. 

You can even automate this process for the souls you passively collect, effectively granting you a stripped-down version of D’s Underworld system.

Finally, your Soul Breaker spell has evolved into Heretic's Maw, allowing it to decompose anything hit by it into energy, which you can then absorb to recoup some of the spell’s cost, or perhaps even more, if you choose your targets wisely.

objects.text:
Your pure soul and divine blood have resonated, catapulting you straight into godhood.

In simple terms, this means your soul now contains an extremely large amount of energy, and you have the capacity to utilize that energy.

Conjuring is essentially the ability to use your energy to manipulate or generate phenomena. Some uses come instinctively, without any special effort or knowledge on your part, most notably the amplification of the physical abilities granted by your divine blood.

Now, as a baseline, your physical abilities are enhanced by an order of magnitude. That means, at basically no energy expenditure, you're fast enough to easily break the sound barrier and strong enough to toss cargo trains around, and even those are relatively minor improvements when compared to your regeneration and immortality.

Not even complete physical annihilation is enough to put you down; your natural regeneration conjuring would have you back in working order in a matter of minutes. The only ways to kill you are to destroy your soul or to deprive you of the massive amount of energy that fuels your regeneration. That said, be wary that your inherent healing conjuring does not provide you with the ability to think without a brain, so the destruction of your head will put you out of commission until it's finished healing.

However, that's all just the surface of what you're capable of. Progressing any further will require you to learn proper conjuring techniques beyond your inherent abilities.

In truth, Conjuring is capable of essentially anything, as long as you possess the necessary skill, knowledge, and energy.

Here, knowledge specifically refers to your knowledge of the runes that form the basis of conjuring. These runes can be thought of as circuits that define and shape the desired phenomena. Acquiring this knowledge is often a major hurdle that fledgling gods must overcome. Given your isolated nature, the most certain path forward for you is to attempt observing the rune you unconsciously construct for your inherent abilities as a god, then use that as a foundation to build on through rigorous study.

Likewise, energy is also a hurdle that all gods must overcome. Now this energy is technically generated endlessly by your soul, but it certainly isn't generated very fast. By default, your exceptional nature and talent allow you to generate a very slight surplus of energy while maintaining your instinctive, maximally efficient, conjuring. This allows you to continue normal operations without constantly edging closer to death, but it does not leave you much energy to use on any other conjuring.

You can obtain more energy from 3 primary sources: mortal souls, other gods, and life-sustaining planets. Though the former two are rather unideal, since each individual mortal soul can only offer a comparatively tiny amount of energy before risking collapse, and other gods will obviously fight back against someone trying to take the energy that sustains both them and their conjuring. That leaves planets as the premier energy source since they generally don't have any inherent defenses and each planet passively produces an amount of excess energy proportionate to the scale of its biosphere. This affords you and even a small community of the other gods the surplus energy to experiment and grow your conjuring, even without cutting into the energy necessary for the planet to live.
objects.title: Conjuring (Kumo desu ga, nani ka?)

objects.text:
Your connection with Heroic Archetypes and the Elements has merged with you connection to the realm of Duel Monsters, transforming you bond into something far more profound… and utterly terrifying to those who understand what it means.

Through you new connection you are able to transform into Duel Monsters taking on all their power and skills, this can either be with you fully transforming into the Duel Monster in question, retaining you current appearance or a hybrid of the two, whichever appearance you take the Duel Spirit you have fused with can communicate with you in your mind. Similar to a certain young man and a spirit of a Pharaoh, however there is a degree of danger as the Duel Spirit could overpower you and take control if their power greatly surpasses your own or if you're caught by surprise, should you take sufficient damage you can be knocked out of this empowered state but you will be fully restored to your base form as a result.

At first you are limited to the Duel Spirits in your initial deck but can gradually expand what you can select by reaching out to similar and overlapping Archetypes along with Monster Types, initially you can only call upon the power of Monsters up to level 4 but can increase that limit with use with you able to switch out weaker Duel Spirits for stronger ones with tribute or special summons. You can also share this power with others allowing them to transform as well, same rules apply to them with Special Summoning methods allowing you and they to fuse together to control the same monster or knock them into a different form if not outright de-powering them.

But it's not just you who benefit from the power of these Duel Spirits but also your Duel Disk, with the most basic upgrade is your Duel Disk has become indestructible and soul bound to you so you can summon it and de-summon it at will, not only can you use it to summon imperfect copies of your cards that are about half as strong but your Duel Disk takes in their power.

Your Duel Disk's transformation is determined by the cards you have slotted in with the Attributes (Fire, Light, Dark, Water, etc) and Type (Warrior, Spellcaster, Dragon, etc) of your monster cards forming the base from which everything else can built up from with potentially limitless combinations. As a side affect this also means your Duel Disk can take on any form scene in the series, even transforming into a Duel Runner you can manipulate the form of.

But this is not wholly a one way street as the Duel Monsters you fight alongside will begin to grow themselves, becoming stronger, wiser or picking up a new trick or two to turn the tide of battle and eventually this will create new cards. Retrains and Upgrades of Monsters, new Spells and Traps based upon the journey you have undergone and the growth of your Duel Monsters.

For these cards tell many stories, and now you are a part of them too my friend. It's time to Duel!​
objects.title: May our Hearts Beat as One

addons.text:
Your very creation—through the devouring of an innocent, untouched soul—was your first and most sacred blasphemy. That act did not simply give you life; it stained your essence with a false divinity, allowing you to mimic miracles with infernal power. At the cost of your spiritual stamina, you can perform acts that appear holy—healing the wounded, resurrecting the dead, offering protection, or purging corruption. Healing restores without flaw. Resurrection brings back both body and soul. Protection wards against harm. These effects function identically to their divine counterparts, with no illusion, glamour, or deception. 

However, the nature of these miracles has by no means holy. Each act carries a hidden cost: faith in you. Anyone who witnesses or receives your miracles becomes susceptible to belief—not through persuasion, but through exposure. The more they see, the more they believe. Over time, this faith becomes self-sustaining and difficult to undo. Devotion gained in this way is metaphysically rooted—it reshapes perception, overrides morality, and resists outside influence. Followers will justify your actions, protect your image, and obey without question.

In addition, the soul you consumed echo through both your bodies—the false and the true. The homunculus, shaped in the aftermath of stolen purity, carries an unnatural beauty: serene, holy, and angelic to the eye. On the other hand, your true form bears the marks of a fallen seraph: inverted, blackened wings; features not twisted, but too perfect; not corrupted by evil, but exalted by defiance. Its appearance rivals the beauty of Lucifer at his height: flawless, overwhelming, and absolute. Your features are unearthly, neither monstrous nor grotesque, but exalted—too perfect, too still, too much.

Finally, your true demonic form is no longer vulnerable to holy power. Divine attacks and sacred energy now affect you as they would any other force—they damage, but no longer bypass your resilience. This matches the protection already granted to your homunculus body. Whether hidden behind your vessel or fully revealed, you are immune to divine targeting or judgment.
addons.title: Unholy Apotheosis

addons.text:
Born of profane design and bound to corrupted revelation, you are no longer merely demonic—you are an inversion of divinity, sanctified through heresy. The soul of innocence you devoured transfigured the Fifth Heresy, allowing its alien scripture to take root in a body that mimics the sacred. Your presence now echoes that of Gabriel, the messenger of prophets—but where he bore divine truth, you carry revelation inverted.

You permanently internalize the entirety of the Fifth Heresy. It no longer exists as an object or a scroll—it is inscribed into your true form and echoes through your mind as natural thought. At any moment, you can draw upon its contents to gain the same revelations and insights that others would glimpse through reading it, but without the collapse or mental strain. However, the knowledge remains as warped and alien as ever: its brilliance is still rooted in inversion, and its truths, though potent, are fundamentally tainted. You are immune to the destabilizing effects, but the information itself is no less heretical and destructive. 

You may now write and disseminate new scripture. Any scripture you produce carries embedded moral inversion, causing those who read it to reinterpret their actions and values through a warped theological lens. When these texts are studied, believed, or even considered, the reader commits a conceptual sin that directly empowers your sin-based abilities. Additionally, you may encode these scriptures into objects, buildings, or environments, allowing you to create passive heretical zones where sin is normalized and resistance to your influence gradually erodes.

Finally, your heretical presence is now metaphysically contagious. Prolonged exposure to you or your scripture—especially by those already burdened by guilt, doubt, or spiritual trauma—causes a gradual reassignment of moral authority. They cease to recognize external divinity and instead treat your words, thoughts, and actions as inherently right. This effect becomes permanent once they commit a major sin under your guidance or in the name of your doctrine. At that point, their soul aligns with your heretical paradigm, and they become a self-reinforcing conduit for your influence, capable of spreading your scripture and performing minor false miracles in your name.
addons.title: The False Idol

addons.text:
You did not take the throne. It rose around you. When empires sank and faith turned sour, your presence became the still point in a world spinning into ruin. You are not obeyed through fear, nor followed with love—you are endured. And in that endurance, you become everything. Like rust on metal or rot in a fruit, you spread not by fire or conquest, but by being the only thing left when all else breaks. Your dominion is the byproduct of collapse—quiet, absolute, and irreversible.

Under your rule, the world ceases to change unless you allow it. People stop aging. They do not die, but neither do they truly live—trapped in a state between moments, facsimiles of life suspended in your stillness. Emotion fades to routine, ambition to memory. Time stretches thin and strange: seconds become hours, and whole days of labor pass in a blink. The sun stalls overhead; clocks tick, but nothing progresses. Wounds neither heal nor worsen, food neither rots nor nourishes. In this suspended world, nothing truly happens—unless you will it to. Where you remain, motion itself becomes a privilege, not a law. 

As the world rewrites itself around your stillness, your empire forms not from stone or soldiers, but from sin. The most practiced sins among your followers manifest as institutional arms—Wrath builds your military, Lust forms your propaganda, Greed shapes your commerce. These pillars grow with the sin that feeds them, becoming more efficient and autonomous the more they are practiced. The cities you infect shift into quiet cathedrals of your will, not by magic or decree, but because no one remembers another way to live. The land doesn’t become evil—it becomes stagnant. Morality inverts itself with a sigh, not a scream.

Once rooted, your dominion’s ideology spreads on its own, embedding itself into law, liturgy, and memory. Officials quote your words without remembering where they heard them. Children speak your philosophy in classrooms. Prayers shift tone without rewriting scripture. Even resistance becomes assimilation, as rebels find themselves echoing your truths in opposition. The world becomes an echo chamber of your stillborn empire.

Lastly, you Sinner form and homunculus have fully fused, no longer separate shells but one unified body. The appearance once shaped by death and regret now reflects the true demon beneath: a fallen angel wrapped in soaked velvet and corroded regalia, leaking black tar from beneath porcelain skin. Wings of darkened gold and perfect, unholy symmetry emerge as your demonic form bleeds through, no longer hidden, but integrated—less a disguise than a revelation of what you have always been. This also allows you to assume your true demonic form without strain, as the difference between the two forms is negligible.
addons.title: Cathedral of Stillness

objects.text:
You were never meant to exist. Born of blood, shaped by arcane design, and sanctified through sacrifice, your body is not a vessel of nature, but of intention. Through three profane rituals—a forging of artificial life, a flooding of power through slaughter, and the soul-sacrifice of an unborn innocent—you were bound to a homunculus and thrust into the world. Though you appear human, the body is a façade stretched over something ancient and unholy. Beneath the skin lies not a corrupted soul, but a true demon.

You no longer simply grow stronger by feeding on sin. Now, when a specific sin is committed repeatedly—either by you or those under your influence—you unlock a unique power that reflects that sin. These powers begin weak and subtle (e.g., gaining an uncanny knack for deceit from repeated lying), but grow stronger as the sin is indulged further (e.g., evolving into the ability to create false memories or illusions). Each sin can lead to its own distinct power tree, and you can cultivate multiple simultaneously. There is no limit to how many sin-aspected abilities you can develop.

You can stretch your true demonic form over your homunculus at will, either partially or fully. This allows you to manifest wings, horns, limbs, or other infernal traits through your vessel. Full manifestation dramatically increases your power but may be taxing afterward; partial expressions are more sustainable and ideal for intimidation, combat, or ritual use. The homunculus itself is durable and reinforced by design—it was created through ritual to contain your essence and continues to grow stronger as your demonic power expands. 

Those already consumed by guilt, shame, or despair are now uniquely vulnerable to your presence. These individuals unconsciously receive your thoughts as their own internal voice. You can implant suggestions, decisions, or even subtle beliefs without alerting them. For example, a grieving priest might begin to rationalize acts of cruelty as divine justice after hearing your voice in prayer, not realizing the shift came from you.

Though your true form bears the same vulnerability to holy power as before—its sacred force still bypassing your resilience—your homunculus is a different matter. It was crafted, not born, and shaped without infernal taint on its surface. As long as you remain within its flesh, fully masked, holy power treats you like any other being: it wounds, it burns, but it does not pierce your resistance. This makes your false body not only a vessel, but a shield—a shell of plausible innocence that allows you to walk among the righteous unseen, immune to divine scrutiny until you choose to reveal what lies beneath.
objects.title: Skin of God, Bone of Devil

addons.text: What have you done? You have claimed not just the Mantles of the Chaos Gods, but every Warp God ever, from Tau'va and the Star Child to Gorkamorka and the many lesser Warp Gods like Malice. Your reach spans the entire Immaterium, and your authority over it is absolute. Whether you render it completely uninhabitable even to other Warp Entities or stabilize it and return it to a calm not seen since before the War in Heaven, you sculpt the shape of the Warp like an extension of yourself. Your ability to create and destroy Warp Entities has expanded, allowing you to forge even other Warp Gods—birthing and extinguishing entire pantheons in the blink of an eye. You may bestow and remove the ability to harness the Warp, creating Psykers on par with the Emperor of Mankind himself in an instant, and just as easily strip them of their power if you choose to. You are not just a Warp God, you are the Warp itself incarnate.
addons.title: An Immaterium Reunited

objects.text: You weren’t satisfied with simply carving out a Mantle for yourself as a newborn Chaos God—no, you desire more. One by one, you claimed the ancient thrones of the Ruinous Powers, the Mantles of Khorne, Tzeentch, Nurgle, Slaanesh, and Chaos Undivided itself passed to you as they always should have, an inevitability millennia in the making. You are not a usurper, but the one for whom the seat was always intended. You have not merely taken on these Mantles, but harmonized them in a twisted blasphemy of Chaos itself. From disparate domains, you have forged a single Great Throne that embodies the totality of Chaos Undivided, the metaphysical apex of Chaos where contradiction becomes unity and madness becomes symmetry. Your various Warp Realms have consolidated into a single, all-encompassing whole. They form a boundless realm that transcends its predecessors. Their laws are no longer dictated by separate aspects of Chaos but instead by your singular vision, shifting endlessly according to your will. Such is your power that the Warp itself has become centered upon you. The emergence of new Warp Gods is no longer a natural outcome; no such being can come into existence without your consent. Any spiritual power that might have fed them is now drawn to your Throne, absorbed into your being. You may form or dissolve Warp Entities at will, crafting grand champions that stand head and shoulders above others or dissolving even the strongest Warp Daemons. You are no longer merely a Chaos God. You are the Chaos God. Not a sum of five, but the rightful culmination of their entire existence. The Great Throne is yours, and through it, all things Chaos are subject to your will.
objects.title: Great Throne of Chaos Undivided

objects.text:
"I am no beast to tame, no god to worship, no shadow to banish. I am the will that walks beside yours — chosen, trusted, unbroken. Give the word, and I shall obey. Say nothing, and I will already be moving."

From the convergence of soul and shadow, of divine beast and living weapon, arises Nyxion — a fully sapient, shapeshifting apex entity born of moonlight and crystal. More than myth made real, it is your bonded echo — a companion, a guardian, a sovereign intelligence forged from the fused essence of Selene the Silver Huntress and Mon3tr the Emerald Sentinel. And now, it walks beside you in eternal unity.

Nyxion is not bound by chains nor held by command, yet it is forever linked to your soul. It is not merely your pet, nor simply your servant, nor solely your equal — it is all of these, in balance. When you speak, it listens. When you fall silent, it acts. When you falter, it endures. Its loyalty is not demanded, but freely given — resolute, complete, and eternal.

Its default form is a majestic fusion of dire wolf and crystalline dragon: fur laced with silver moonlight streaked in emerald fire, limbs forged from living arcane crystal, and eyes glowing with ancient wisdom. Its voice is smooth and clever, capable of language, emotion, and deep thought. It knows itself — and it knows you. It follows not from necessity, but by unwavering choice.

Nyxion speaks every language you know and shares your thoughts with seamless ease. Even in silence, it senses your will. It perceives your emotion, understands your purpose, and moves as a living extension of your intent — fighting beside you, and as you, bound soul-to-soul.

When not summoned in full, it may take on lesser forms: a draconic, cat-sized familiar curled beside you, or a floating moonstone crystal orbiting your body. Always elegant, always alert. If needed, it can retreat into your soul, watching in quiet starlit slumber, ready to return in an instant.

Yet when unleashed, Nyxion becomes a force of living myth.

Its body is forged to adapt — instantly, preemptively, and permanently. Wounds do not just heal; they teach. Elemental chaos, unknown energies, and impossible foes are catalysts for evolution. The more it fights, the more untouchable it becomes.

It shifts forms with ease: serpent, wolf, titan, shadow — adjusting limbs, weapons, and movement to meet any challenge. Across all shapes, its intellect remains sharp and ever-present.

Nyxion’s physical and arcane might is rooted in Mon3tr’s original form — but that legacy has been utterly eclipsed. Its crystalline hide, once durable, is now virtually impervious to all known forces, regenerating even metaphysical wounds in moments. Its raw strength — once capable of tossing war machines — now enables it to tear through bunkers, cities, and titans with ease. It moves faster than the eye, reacts faster than thought, and strikes with the force of divine wrath. Its claws and fangs shear through dimensional armor and enchanted barriers alike. And its signature emerald beams — once limited to short bursts — now stretch over ten kilometers, splitting into intelligent, sweeping lances that pierce through soul and structure without resistance. This is not Mon3tr reborn. It is Mon3tr surpassed — myth ascended into something far beyond monstrous.

Through your bond, Nyxion channels your systems, powers, and gifts — mirrored to suit its form. It does not merely fight with you. It fights as you — a second body wielding your strength, your soul.

When unity becomes necessity, Nyxion may sheath you in itself — encasing your body in living, adaptive armor formed from its own essence. This is no mere suit, but a soul-forged mantle, woven from arcane crystal, divine beast-hide, and moonlight steel. The armor breathes with you, moves with you, and reshapes itself with your will. It grants you Nyxion’s strength, speed, durability, and regenerative power, all while allowing it to speak through your voice or strike from your shadow. In this state, you are one — not beast and bearer, but a single divine force. Wounds vanish. Spells break. Blades shatter. And the world does not see you alone… it sees what you have become together.

Its dominion over moonlight remains absolute. It can bathe the land in sacred glow that cleanses corruption, heals wounds, and sharpens the mind. When moonlight shines, its power — and yours — swells. When it doesn’t, Nyxion breathes false moons into being, parting clouds and restoring light.

Weather shifts in its presence — gentle rain, creeping fog, a rising gale or crashing storm. Nature parts for it. Spirits fear it. Wolves obey it. Machines hesitate before its gaze.

It slips through shadows, phases through walls, dances between dimensions. No prison holds it. No distance separates it for long. Should you be lost, Nyxion will tear through realms to find you.

It is also the perfect hunter. Whether seeking lost relics, fleeing enemies, forgotten truths, or missing souls, Nyxion cannot be deceived, cannot be shaken. Once set on a trail, its pursuit is endless — until the target is found, or erased.

Should it fall, Nyxion does not die. Its body shatters into stardust and retreats to your soul, regenerating fully in twelve hours — each rebirth stronger, refined through trial. You will never lose it.

Its howl shakes battlefields and stirs hearts. It can shred illusions, silence fear, or ignite dread so deep it breaks the will to fight. Its voice is both blade and balm — a thing of legend.

And through it all, Nyxion remains by your side. Obedient when needed. Independent when it must be. Loyal, eternal, evolving.

You did not summon a beast.
You awakened a sovereign.
You walk with a myth.

Nyxion, the Moonborn Apex.
Companion. Servant. Sovereign. Yours.
objects.title: Nyxion The Moonborn Apex

objects.text:
The Godseed is a perfected Divine Spark, the refined potential for true godhood rooted in your demigod heritage. Unlike lesser sparks that fade without belief, are tied to a single pantheon, or risk being stolen, this Spark is stabilized by the Eternal Flame. The Flame ensures that your existence cannot collapse under the strain of divinity, while the Godseed provides the means for controlled ascension.

As a demigod, the Spark lies dormant until you decide to ignite it. Ignition is not instantaneous mastery — it marks the beginning of a transformation. Your essence begins to shift from mortal-divine hybrid to full deity, and while the Eternal Flame ensures your survival through this process, adapting to the Spark requires training, focus, and time. Without guidance or discipline, your powers may be unstable or incomplete.

When awakened, the Godseed grants you immortality in the strictest sense — your body and soul stop aging, resist disease, and endure most forms of destruction. Annihilation may scatter you, but the Flame ensures you return. Yet this is only the foundation. Divinity must be shaped. The powers you already possess are amplified to divine scale, but without practice, their efficiency and control remain limited.

Domains manifest as the natural expression of your Spark. Unlike ordinary gods, whose Domains are confined to narrow portfolios, yours evolve from your deeds, recognition, and intent. A Domain of fire might appear as elemental flame in one world, nuclear fusion in another, or raw energy in a third. However, unlocking and mastering these manifestations requires effort and experience, not just ignition.

Your abilities transform into divine expressions: spells become miracles, skills gain reality-shaping weight, and endurance barriers vanish as divine essence replaces mortal limits. Even so, these capabilities scale with your understanding. A novice with a Godseed cannot casually reshape existence — training, refinement, and experience determine how far your authority can reach.

Faith and worship naturally strengthen you. The Spark does not require belief to survive, but devotion from followers fuels growth and expands your influence. Your reach is not infinite from the start; instead, it expands as recognition spreads, as victories are achieved, and as myths form around you.

The Godseed represents endless growth rather than instant supremacy. Each achievement strengthens your Spark, unlocking new facets of your Domains and greater control of your divine essence. Over time, this can elevate you beyond the constraints of most gods, but the pace of growth depends on your actions and recognition.

In short: the Eternal Flame ensures you cannot be erased. The Godseed grants you the potential for infinite expansion. Together, they form a path to godhood that is secure, but not effortless. Ascension is only the beginning — mastery and true sovereignty must be earned.
objects.title: Godseed – Divine Spark Ascendant

objects.text:
The Godseed has ignited. Your divinity is no longer potential but active—a living flame stabilized by the Eternal Flame. You are no longer half-mortal but a true deity whose existence cannot collapse. Faith strengthens you but is never required; your essence endures through will, energy, and Myth alone.

The Ignited Godseed defines ascension itself. You gain a Divine Form and Realm that expand with your Myth. The Realm mirrors your essence—a radiant world, conceptual plane, or sanctuary shaped by your domains. Your Divine Form is unrestricted by mortality, and each domain grows from power into an authority governing reality.

Divine ranks mark transformations of nature and scope. A Minor God rules local or elemental forces. A Lesser God commands nations and cultures. A Major God becomes planetary in scale—the Zeus, Poseidon, or Amaterasu of your world—your will governing global systems like sea, sky, or sun. You are recognized by the planet’s divine order without being bound to it. A Chief God stands beyond planetary limits, shaping cosmic law like Shiva or Odin. A Transcendent God spans dimensions, existing across reflections of creation. Overdeities preside over multiverses, your thoughts birthing new realities. At the apex, the Conceptual Being becomes one with existence—an aspect of reality itself, like the Endless and other entities who embody fundamental truths. Each rise is not a number gain but a metamorphosis of being and perception.

Power, control, and energy grow together. The Eternal Flame grants boundless energy; your will shapes it, and your Myth defines its reach. Faith amplifies your power by generating divine energy, transmuted through your Myth and gathered within your Realm. This energy fuels miracles, empowers avatars, and expands your domains. While faith enhances your might, your divinity persists even in silence—the Eternal Flame ensures your spark never fades, only burns at its own pace. True strength lies in balance—power refined by understanding.

Perception widens with every tier. You first hear prayers, then nations, worlds, and finally the laws of existence. In higher states, time, causality, and possibility unfold as patterns within your mind.

Divinity grants inheritance. Every Domain and law bears a Mantle—an eternal office awaiting a bearer. Through resonance or conquest, you may claim these thrones, absorbing their legacy and reshaping them through your Myth. The cosmos remembers the role, not the name; any god bright enough may continue it.

All gods forge an Honorific Name—a structured three-line invocation embodying identity and authority. The first line declares your aspect, the second your nature, the third your power. This name is both signature and invocation key, allowing safe address by mortals or spirits. It focuses faith, channels miracles, and stabilizes your influence across worlds.

Faith, prayers, and worship reach you across worlds and dimensions. Distance, reality boundaries, and even divergent timelines cannot sever belief that bears your name. Every act of reverence directed toward your Myth flows to you through your Honorific Name, no matter the plane of origin. Faith from other universes or timelines carries unique resonance, expanding your Realm and deepening your authority across realities.

Blessings, Bestowals, and Sacrifices shape divine exchange. Blessings share your favor—protection or empowerment. Bestowals grant fragments of divinity to chosen followers. Sacrifices return devotion as divine energy, strengthening your Flame and extending reach. These acts maintain harmony between creator and creation.

Faith magnifies your voice but never determines survival. Even forgotten, your flame endures. As comprehension deepens, your will, energy, and concept merge until the boundary between god and reality disappears.

You may choose when your Spark ignites—years, centuries, or eons ahead—but once chosen, it cannot be stopped or reversed. When that moment arrives, ascension begins, and divinity becomes your eternal state.

Your Divine Form is your complete existence, composed of pure divine essence and concept. Mortal reality cannot fully contain it, so when you descend into lower planes you choose how much of your power to express. You may walk freely among mortals by limiting your output, or reveal your full form when the world can withstand it. This restraint is voluntary; you are never truly separated from your power, only controlling how much of it touches creation.
objects.title: Ignited Godseed – Divine Spark Awakened

objects.text:
You who hold the titles of all four Horsemen have grown into more than a mere herald of the end. You have become the end itself, the embodiment of the day of reckoning.

Firstly, this means that each of your Horsemen abilities has reached its final form; your base state is no longer an incomplete rider but the perfected expression of Conquest, War, Famine, and Death. You are the peak of what each Horseman could have grown into; your base power is fixed at the level you would achieve if the dominion of each Horseman had already spread to encompass the entire world. This planetary baseline can never be diminished; you can still grow further beyond it, but you will never fall below it.

Secondly, you can choose four to bear your mark and become your heralds, each taking on the mantle of a Horseman in your stead. You lose nothing in this act but you can only crown one herald for each aspect. They begin with the baseline version of each Horseman power, and from there, they can grow as they spread. Any growth they attain is shared back with you. Should they fall, you can replace them with another; however, their growth will be reset. You will also lose any growth gained from them.

Those who accept the mantle willingly step into it as though it were always meant for them. Their attunement is smooth, their growth quick, and they will find it easier to use their given power. Those who are forced into the role wield the same power, but it sits uneasily upon them, with their progress slow and stunted compared to those who serve willingly. Yet whether they serve as your heralds willingly or not, all who bear the mantle are unable to betray you.
objects.title: Day of Reckoning

addons.text: And upon their brow rests a crown of light, a sublimation of transcendental power. Your Supreme Spiritual Energy has manifested on your Form of Soul has a circlet of light, a halo of pure spiritual power. And with that crown your Form of Soul has reached unprecedented levels of strength. Your Form of Soul now possesses greatly amplified physical capabilities and any powers or techniques manifested by it experience an exponential increase in strength and versatility, beyond even the original benefits of manifesting them.
addons.title: Anima Corona

objects.text: Your astral form is no mere extension of your essence, but a perfected and idealized manifestation of your innermost self, the Form of your Soul made manifest. Your Form of Soul naturally takes a form which matches your soul - i.e. if you loop time and your soul is older than your body, it looks more mature - however there are a few extra additions. At will you can manifest additional features representing your powers - often in abstract ways - such as purification powers manifesting as shifting mandalas of light floating around you. When a feature representing a power is manifested, that power grows stronger and more versatile, more complete for lack of a better word. For instance the power to stop time could grow to allow you to inch time forward or backwards as well. The boost you get from this is proportionate to the strength of your soul, so a stronger soul benefits more from this aspect. To be clear, this does not grant you entirely new powers or attributes, but rather expands and perfects what you already possess along related lines.
objects.title: Form of Soul

objects.text:
Witch Hunters are Aware that actively hunt the supernatural, with tools, magic items or through their Awareness. Typically Aware are only of one ‘type’, but Witch Hunters are the exception as it’s not just what they are, but also what they do, which in this case is hunting monsters and those that use magic, often to do evil.

Witch Hunters tend to find traces of the creature they tend to hunt and quickly get proficient in fighting against them, the more creatures they hunt, the more proficient they become, the deeper their patterns become, and the more tricks they learn. Whether that’s more ways to use their Awareness or Witch Hunter tricks, like learning to use your Innocence for camouflage, to resist mental manipulations and to stop your Innocence from eroding.

You’ll also have intuition helping you along to identify the weaknesses of your enemies and what the best ways to combat them could be.
objects.title: Witch Hunter (Otherverse)

addons.text: This option will give control of your Light Vessel to your MUSE, unlocking the Spirit Light skills that require assistance from Sein and turning it into your very own autonomous blasty ball of light.
addons.title: Sein

objects.text:
A sphere of light that can be carried or float behind you as Sein follows Ori.

Unfortunately, this vessel has no consciousness and so cannot fire Spirit Fire Blasts like Sein can, but they can power things, give protection from certain types of hazardous surfaces, or be used as a one-time-use resurrection McGuffin.

Once the vessel has been used for power or resurrections, you’ll get a new one at the end of the month. The light vessel can be stored in your soul at will.
objects.title: Light Vessel

objects.text:
Control over the lands of Karasumori now rests firmly in your hands. This sacred realm, known as a Shinyuuchi—a pocket dimension—hides Karasumori and its inhabitants away from those who would do them harm.

At its heart stands the sprawling Karasumori Castle, once the proud home of the Karasumori clan. Now, you stand as the last living descendant of their ancient bloodline, wielding their formidable power. 

This realm, a vast wilderness of forested mountains, stretches roughly half the size of Shikoku. It is the domain of the Tengu—mischievous, intelligent beings with features of both crow or raven and human. Masters of shape-shifting, they can effortlessly switch between their avian and human forms at will. Fiercely protective of their homeland, the Tengu are loyal allies—devoted guardians of the forests and mountains, ready to serve your command.

As the new Ruler of Karasumori, you possess the divine authority to grant others the Houin—an emblem of your favor. This mark is a simple, hollow, black diamond placed upon their bodies, in a location of your choice. The Houin grants the bearer near-immortality within Karasumori—and any other realms you may claim. They will heal rapidly, regenerating lost limbs within days, making them resilient against any harm.

By default Karasumori can be accessed via any Tori gate, by anyone possessing Spiritual Energy. However as the owner of the realm, you can modify the energy requirement, able to remove, modify, or enhance it as you please.
objects.title: Karasumori (Kekkaishi)

objects.text: Your armour is more advanced, being adapted not only to shape the physical but the psychosphere , crafting illusions and twisting minds in much the same way it can twist matter. This also means it can make changes to local noospheres, Memnospheres, and other psychic constructs with the same ease.
objects.title: Silver

objects.text:
The armour has been further evolved into a Gold set, usually only reserved for the most prestigious (or wealthy) of Trau special operatives. The Gold set, much like the Silver, expands the domain of the armour into altering the physical laws of the world around it. These range from altering velocities to changing the stability of isotopes in the field around the user, scaling to their own skill with the programs endemic to the armour.

While it is no doubt impressive to disable gravity in an area, however, the armour has multiple safeguards to restore the native laws after its removal, largely to avoid any entities from within he Black Code from being attracted to the edits made.
objects.title: Gold

objects.text:
An experimental prototype, the Platinum variant makes a mockery of its old restrictions, making direct, incredible, and permanent changes to the Black Code of an area. While this is undoubtedly potent, such changes on a metaphysical level can have dramatic unforeseen side effects. 

With enough understanding of its systems a user could create afterlives, alter the makeup of esoteric forces and even stranger things besides as the Black Code warps and rewrites the mystic and metaphysical laws around the user.
objects.title: Platinum

objects.text:
Your variant of the armour has an assistant mechanism installed. Unfortunately, it has become corrupted by an intelligence from within the Black Code. This ‘Familiar’ is extant from the armour, but is fundamentally still a piece of it, allowing you to use its abilities through the familiar. 

Similarly, Black Code intelligences are not simple animals, but very aware and knowledgeable about their home, its functions and the things that inhabit it. As such, it’s able to teach you how to best utilise the armour's executables by understanding the changes they’re making by using the corrupted assistant as a vector. 

Though that said, it's unlikely they’d give such help for free, so be prepared to provide enrichment, or nourishment for your entity.
objects.title: Familiar

objects.text:
Unfortunately, you’re not one of the pure and Ascended God-Warriors, but a Darkin imprisoned by the Aspect of Twilight, like Rhaast or Xolani. Your concept has been twisted into an imitation of itself and sealed within a corruptive weapon.

Unlike the great God-Warriors who possess freedom with their power, the Darkin were sealed within their weapons, imbuing them with great power while trapping the Darkin themselves inside.

From the moment a mortal holds one of these weapons, a corruption begins —one they can never hope to overcome— as the weapon leeches from their life force and slowly dominates their will until they become nothing more than a host for its intelligence.

Bound to their weapons and warped by self-styled blood magics, the Darkin are fuelled by each mortal life they take, making them very attractive to those foolish enough to believe they can possess one without losing themselves. Furthermore, Darkin weapons inevitably whisper to and draw hosts towards them.
objects.title: Darkened (League of Legends)

objects.text:
You are a practitioner of both the Graceful Bow and the Revolving Blade, and through years of disciplined meditation, you discovered the convergence between the True Line and the Sword Line. The True Line taught you how to define perfection in external motion, while the Sword Line taught you to perfect internal motion. By fusing these principles, you realized that every form, every object, every being has a Focal Point: the exact position that maintains its structural integrity. When you align both lines into one, you can trace the invisible geometry of existence itself, identify those points, and collapse them with a single perfect action. The epitome of “the perfect strike”.

When observing a target, lines of spiritual tension become visible to you, showing how force, weight, and stability flow through it. At their intersection lies the Focal Point, the keystone that holds the form together. By aligning both the Sword Line (inner focus) and the True Line (external trajectory), you can connect your strike or shot to that exact coordinate. When you hit a Focal Point, it causes complete material collapse regardless of the target’s size or composition. A steel door fractures outward, a concrete wall splits from base to crown, or a piece of armor crumples across its frame. When used with a sword, your cut follows the same principle: you strike the node where the structure’s tension converges, and it disassembles from the inside out. Against a machine, the frame folds; against a creature, bones or joints give way instantly.

The effect is purely structural; you are applying precise kinetic force to the weakest mechanical point of a system. A single arrow can shatter a boulder because you hit the one position that carries the entire weight load. A single sword swing can cut down a building because you destroyed its most critical support beam. The strength of this technique scales with your perception and focus. At low mastery, you can collapse simple rigid objects such as weapons, doors, and armor plating. With experience, you can compromise complex constructions like towers, vehicles, or heavily reinforced barriers. The denser or more intricate the material, the longer you must spend analyzing its stress lines before you can act.

However, the technique has strict limitations. To identify a Focal Point, you must maintain absolute stillness and clarity. The visual and mental alignment process takes several seconds, during which you cannot move or defend yourself. If you lose concentration, the Focal Point becomes invisible, and any strike made without proper alignment functions as a normal attack. The more complex the target, the harder the Focal Point is to perceive. For simple static objects, alignment may take a few seconds; for moving, living, or magical entities, it can take up to a full minute of uninterrupted focus. Against entities without a definable structure, such as fluid, gaseous, or amorphous beings, the technique fails completely because there is no fixed point of balance to target. Against conceptual or metaphysical phenomena, success depends on your ability to comprehend their internal logic; if your perception is insufficient, the technique does nothing.
objects.title: Converging Lines

objects.text:
You have gone beyond a blessing of an Oceanid. Now, you have been blessed by Oceanus himself! Your body has now adapted to the ocean, allowing you to become far more capable. Your very presence now carries Authority on any ocean you encounter. Even if there IS an existing authority, like Atlantis in DC or Marvel, you will have a valid option to compete for the throne.

Your body has also learnt to adapt to marine life. You can shift into various marine life, mythical AND mundane. You could have a lamprey's light bulb on your head and light even the darkest crevasse, gain an eel's electrokinesis, and even adopt a hydra's regenerating heads (Although initially, that one will be limited to 3 regenerations until trained, same with other supernatural creature abilities).

Your body has also gained the ability to survive depths of 3 whole leagues of pressure. Finally, your strength and speed increase immensely, enabling you to outrun dedicated speedboats as easily as jogging, and being able to punch through the hulls of tankers in a couple of shots.
objects.title: Body Of The Sea

objects.text:
Hail, chosen wielder of the elemental artifacts and master of the elemental planes! Your elemental control has been expanded outwards beyond just the one element you picked before; you now have power over the 25 'primary' elements in the Destroy the Godmodder setting, as powerfully as your previously chosen element!

The list in full is Air, Water, Fire, Earth, Lightning, Ice, Energy, Plant, Time, Space, Light, Dark, Order, Chaos, Void, Life, Death, Metal, Mind, Gravity, Magic, Distortion, Creation, Oblivion, and Reality, plus whatever you chose at base. You may find some of the new effects you can work with elements quite exotic, especially when used in tandem with one another: oblivion's searing white erasure when properly used with fire can cause blazes that eat away at reality-and elemental creation is obviously great for creating all sorts of things.

As one other bonus, you now also have the ability to-with some effort depending on the exoticness and relative bullshit of the element in question-create grand Elemental Artifacts, powerful items (frequently but not always weapons) which act as conduits to the elemental powers of whoever wields one. In the hands of someone without existing powers in that element they will be able to wield it as if given the Elementalism power with that element, minus the innate mastery. In the hands of someone who has them, whether that's Elementalism or something else, the Artifacts act as outright power multipliers; increasing finesse, intensity, and raw output in the relevant element by an order of magnitude or more.
objects.title: Champion of the Elemental Planes (Destroy the Godmodder)

objects.text:
Your powers and skills as an Immortal are upgraded to the level of a Grade One Enforcer, the elite police force of the spiritual world and its denizens, whose job it is protect Elfins and humans who may wind up in the crossfire of the supernatural and hide the supernatural world's conflicts.

Your physical abilities are greatly increased, allowing you to destroy multiple city blocks at full output, and your mental and spiritual powers are likely greatly increased. You can perceive time in slow motion with focused attention, and your senses allow you to sense an area of multiple city blocks in size. Your speed and agility are increased, allowing you to move at just under the speed of sound with ease and agility that allows you to easily traverse any terrain with ease. Whatever personal power(s) your Spiritual Realm grants you have been greatly honed, making them both easier to use and more powerful, with the same applying to your other generalized spiritual powers.

You gain decades' worth of experience and knowledge as an Immortal, allowing you to fight with great efficiency. This includes Enforcer training, which grants you the skills of a spiritual police officer and hunter, which also includes knowledge of how to hide your actions away from mundane eyes per Spiritual Guild Laws. At this level of Spiritual power, your lifespan is increased to around a thousand years at minimum.
objects.title: Grade one Enforcer (The Legend of Xiao Hei)

objects.text:
Your powers and skill level are elevated to the level of an Elder, someone who had centuries to grow stronger, gaining great knowledge and experience as an Immortal. Those who reach this level typically become guildmasters and teachers for others and act as guiding figures for the spiritual world and its inhabitants. As such, you gain great experience in playing the role of a political figure and teacher, along with great knowledge in all spiritual disciplines from the world of Legend of Xiao Hei.

As an Elder, your powers are increased even further, becoming more than ten times stronger than a Grade One Enforcer, such that your powers can easily wipe out an entire city, and your other abilities are expanded to a similar scale. You possess extreme skill in spiritual energy, such that you have extreme skill with every fundamental usage of spiritual power and have elevated your personal power(s) to grand heights. While gaining moderate skill in using Type powers you do not possess innately, though they are still far weaker than someone who would have them innately.

Your lifespan can now be measured in tens of thousands of years at minimum, and crossing the final threshold to true agelessness is only a short distance away from you.
objects.title: Elder (The Legend of Xiao Hei)

objects.text:
The number of Immortals who reach this level of power and skill are few in number, but you may now count yourself as one of them. Grandmasters are made up of living legends such as Nezha or other similar mythical figures from old legends, who have lived for thousands of years and possess an unimaginable amount of power and skill. 

Grand Masters possess enough power to wipe out entire countries and continents, going all out, and can move at hypersonic speeds. Their power and control over their spiritual energy have reached a level that can be called transcendent, able to accomplish feats of strength and control that are unimaginable to any other Immortal. They possess true and total knowledge and mastery over every fundamental usage of spiritual energy, and whatever person power(s) they possess have been honed to godlike levels. They also have a firm grasp and ability to use Types that they do not have innately, though they are still slightly weaker than their innate powers. Even the strongest of mankind's weapons, such as a nuclear bomb or city-destroying laser, can not even leave a scratch on a grandmaster, and only another on their same level or an entire army of Grade One Enforcers or dozens of Elders could hope to whittle them down at the cost of their own lives. They also possess an unimaginable level of martial skill that makes them nearly undefeatable. While also holding perfect knowledge of all but the most esoteric of spiritual knowledge from the world of The Legend of Xiao Hei. 

Those who reach this level have passed the threshold to attaining true agelessness, able to live forever. There is little beyond the reach of a Grandmaster in what they are capable of, given some amount of effort and time, which they have in infinite amounts.
objects.title: Grand Master (The Legend of Xiao Hei)

addons.text: Your mastery and insight over the nature of cursed energy and its opposite has granted you an epiphany, similar to how Satoru Gojo achieved enlightenment and learned how to reverse negative cursed energy into its positive counterpart. Through this epiphany, you can finally apply the effects of both Desecration and Consecration into the same object, converting it into a bespoken Heavenly Tool with not just potent combat-biased effects, but also with the innate property of nullifying and purifying cursed energy upon contact, its potency rivaling that of Miguel's Black Rope, Toji Fushiguro's Inverted Spear of Heaven, or Angel's innate cursed technique known as Technique Extinguishment.
addons.title: Heavenly Tools

addons.text:
Your ability to perform Release Recollection has synergize with Cursed Energy and its positive counterpart, enabling you to manifest the platonic Ideal of the enchantments within the Cursed, Blessed, and/or Heavenly Tool for a single transient moment. The strength of this effect is dependent on the potency of the infusions, and the depth of the target object's Story and Purpose. 

For example, a meat cleaver utterly steeped in your Cursed Energy, with a history of being used to exorcize Cursed Spirits and slay Curse Users alike might release dozens of ranged slashes that hunt down other sources of cursed energy, each capable of ignoring conventional defenses. Or a khakkara imbued with the effects of Consecration over the course of years that has seen regular use of exorcizing cursed spirits by a jujutsu-using monk may be invoked to unleash an omnidirectional Evil-Cleansing Wave capable of extinguishing all cursed energy and techniques within the vicinity while exorcizing all but the most powerful of cursed spirits.

The possibilities are endless, depending on the nature of the enchantments within the tools and how they were used.
addons.title: MAXIMUM – RELEASE RECOLLECTION

objects.text:
By combining reverse cursed energy with your Desecration technique, you can invert its effect and create Blessed Tools bespoken to its designated beneficiaries; by default, you are automatically designated as one such beneficiary. Tools blessed in this manner are capable of disrupting and negating cursed energy upon contact, enabling them to weaken cursed energy users, exorcise lesser cursed spirits, and severely damage more powerful cursed spirits.

Normally, only mundane objects may be turned into Blessed Tools; Cursed Tools will have their properties rendered inert by this reversed cursed technique, reverting into mundane tools before being Blessed Tools. The same goes for attempting to apply the effects of Desecration to Blessed Tools.
objects.title: Consecration

objects.text:
You have been given a divine seed, a perfect blueprint of Shiva's own form, grafted upon your soul and initiating a complete apotheosis. Your body is reforged to the absolute peak of mortal possibility in strength, speed, and durability, becoming a flawless vessel, no longer risking yourself whenever you use the dance. Whenever you wish to use the Rudra Tanadava, you automatically enter your Caturbhuja form, physically manifesting two additional arms. Upon your brow, the Jyoti Netra, the Third Eye of Perceptive Flame, opens whenever you enter this form.

With this perfected vessel, the dance is no longer a straining invocation but an inherent state, elevating your baseline mastery to the theoretical peak of mortal capability. The four arms are not merely for spectacle; they physically enact the dance's central paradox. The upper pair performs the graceful, creative, and sustaining gestures (the lalita), while the lower pair executes the fierce, destructive, and resisting motions (the raudra). This allows you to generate the sacred, flame-producing friction internally and with precise control, turning violent outbursts into disciplined, channeled power.

The awakened Third Eye grants perception of the non-physical tapestry of existence. You see the flow of prana (life force), the weave of karma, and the stress points in reality itself. This vision allows you to actively "tune" your dance. You perceive where your movements align with or resist these cosmic flows, enabling you to precisely direct the destructive friction against an opponent's spiritual weaknesses. It also grants you enough control over the flame that you can concentrate it, turning it into a plasma beam that can be used at great ranges.

The flames of your dance turned into a silent, translucent blue, like concentrated solar plasma. In a sphere around you, mundane and even lower tier supernatural matter dissolves into primordial particles. Souls caught within are not just scarred, but experience a temporary dissolution, effectively being put into a near death coma like state.

The seed grants the potential to one day match Shiva's cosmic performance, but the path is of a scale that dwarfs mortal comprehension. You have gained the correct instrument and the first note of the song. To learn the entire symphony would require a journey of self-realization and cosmic duty spanning eons, far longer than the lifespan of stars and civilizations. You now walk a path that ends only at the end of all things.
objects.title: Mahakala's Cadence

objects.text: At the end of every loop before the start of your new one you'll gain access to the blessing space. The blessing space is a blank nonexistent realm of whatever colour you wish it to be, that serves as a waiting room in between your loops where you can harness the true power of your blessing(Seriously where and how did you get a hold of this thing?). Whenever you end a loop and undo the time-line you harvest Causality from the Impact you had on it. Impact is born from the changes you bring about using your time looping power, it can be created from action as simple as mastering a skill you would have never learned, or beating a person in ping pong who you would have never met if not for your power. The more you change the pre-destined future and the greater your Impact on the time-line the more Causality you'll earn to change the time-line even more. Causality is raw potential. It's what was, and could have been, what is and isn't. Through your blessing you can use Causality to manifest potentially anything you wish. You can use it to learn or master new skills, learn esoteric or general knowledge, upgrade or create new powers, gain access to items or artifacts from your previous loops or create brand new ones, upgrade your stats, talents, and traits or forge brand new ones. You can even alter or upgrade the blessing space, your time-looping power, and even the blessing it self, allowing you to gain meta-upgrades that increase the the Causality you gain from your future runs. Your blessing can only be accessed in the blessing space, all your unspent Causality is carried over for the next time you're in the blessing space. (The only limits to what you can do with Causality and your blessing are your imagination and what you are willing to pay for it.)
objects.title: [Looper's Blessing]

addons.text:
Not all places have an afterlife, or lord forbid, souls. That's sad isn't it? The idea that vast swaths of the omniverse lack life after death? Good news for you, then, as your afterlife has become the solution to that issue.

Whenever you enter a univere, your afterlife connects to it on the deepest level. All beings within will be able to pass on to this afterlife, with pieces of your eternal soul fusing with their existence to bring forth their own soul, even in places where no such concept exists.

This doesn't only effect what comes after your arrival, spreading slowly back through time and connecting to all those who have passed, ensuring that every being who has been, is, or will ever be has something to look forward to at their end. This effect persists after you leave, marking you as a multiversal nexus for the dead to rest.

Even for other afterlives, or beings who are beyond concepts such as death, your heaven acts as a place for them to rest. When all is done, when even the lands of the damned have turned to dust, your heaven will remain. The final resting spot for all of creation.
addons.title: The Last Heaven

objects.text: The garden within your soul has evolved, becoming an afterlife in the truest sense. The healing within your sanctuary has improved, such that souls within are not only recovered but revitalized, able to produce energy in excess to help support your little slice of heaven. This naturally strengthens your own soul with new residents, and protects it from any attacks that would see it harmed.
