This also provides a canvas to be shaped, with both you and your residents being able to use some of that excess energy to 'decorate', so to speak, designing an overarching structure as well as individual, personal heavens for all within. Once they are ready, the souls within you can be cleansed of their karma and memories, leaving an impression in your soul and sending them off into the cycle of reincarnation. This process marks them, such that when they die in their new live(s) you may have them return to you, and should they wish they can reclaim the impressions they left they may do so. You can send a soul off without cleansing, but outside of your paradise the karmic burden of multiple lives is hard to bear. You too can read these impressions, though be wary that some may get grumpy if you do so without their permission. Any being you are close to, as well as any being you help to pass on, may be sent to this realm. You can also set an automatic 'filter', which grabs unclaimed souls around you that fit certain criteria. This also lets you connect to any other existing afterlife, for the purposes of communication, exchange and intermingling between them. If, for some reason, an entity you wish to house does not have a soul, you can instead imprint them upon your own, and send a piece of your paradise to act as one until they gain a soul proper. Finally, for souls that desire 'true death', you can absorb both their impressions and souls, having them become one with your afterlife and dissipating them into nothing. If a soul does not consent, this cannot be done.
objects.title: True Afterlife

addons.text:
You are now the strongest creature alive in One Piece World. Your strength, speed, stamina, and durability are on an entirely different level. With your strength alone, you can easily create shockwaves and flying slashes. You can form massive craters with nothing but your punches, and at full power, you could potentially level or even sink entire islands.

Your speed has increased to such an extent that anyone without supernatural senses—such as advanced Observation Haki, Future Sight, or similar abilities—wouldn’t even see you move, let alone keep up with you. Thanks to your incredible stamina, you can fight for days without stopping.

Your durability has reached a point where your body is nearly invulnerable. Most weapons—guns, swords, or even missiles—wouldn’t leave a scratch. You could fall from thousands of meters in the air, land on solid ground, and walk away as if nothing happened. It would take someone with advanced Armament Haki, Conqueror’s Haki, or a similar power just to begin to harm you.

Finally, your Haki has also increased both in size and strength. While before you were one of the most powerful Haki users, now you are the most powerful. You could intimidate opponents as powerful as Admirals with your Conqueror’s Haki.

You have also gained and mastered the ability, The Voice of All Things, which allows the user to communicate with people, creatures, and certain objects in the world around them without the need for a physical message, such as speech or writing.
addons.title: The Strongest Creature (One Piece)

objects.text:
You have completely mastered all the beginner and advanced techniques of Haki. Through this mastery, both your Haki pool and strength have increased to rival the strongest Haki users in the One Piece world, such as The Four Emperors or Admirals, though only the weaker ones. If you also have Will of D. Add-on, you are most likely one of the strongest Haki users in the world.

With Observation Haki, you have mastered all of its basic forms. You can sense the emotions, presence, strength, and intent of any being. Even if you are blinded, you can easily fight your opponents. Its advanced form allows you to see a few seconds into the future, with the duration increasing as your Haki grows stronger.

Through Armament Haki, you can imbue your Haki into any object you touch, allowing weapons to receive the same enhancements as your own body. You are also capable of allowing Haki to flow outward from parts of your body, emitting it over short distances without a medium. Additionally, you can force this Haki into a target’s body, destroying them from the inside and bypassing normal durability.

Thanks to your mastery of Conqueror’s Haki, you are now capable of knocking out people simply by looking intently at them, or even by just walking past them. You are also able to limit the effect of your Haki. When using it in a crowded area, you are capable of choosing who not to knock out. Whether a target is rendered unconscious or not depends on their strength and willpower relative to the user’s.

The advanced form of Conqueror’s Haki allows you to infuse yourself or your weapons in a manner similar to Armament Haki, greatly enhancing physical attacks for both offence and defence. Another advanced technique you have mastered is Observation Killing, which allows you to suppress and control your own presence, preventing opponents from seeing into the future with Observation Haki.

Finally, you gain the ability to tie a concentration of Conqueror’s Haki into a knot made of rope, storing it for an indefinite amount of time. When the knot is undone, the Haki is unleashed in a burst much like the standard use of Conqueror’s Haki.
objects.title: Haki Master (One Piece)

addons.text: Your Body and Spirit are uniquely intertwined, existing in unison and supporting each other, helped along by your soul’s malleability. With this unison comes the ability to effortlessly transition your body between physical and spiritual forms, shedding and reweaving your physical body as you see fit. One moment you may have a physical body, the next you exist as a soul alone. As you can exist as a soul alone, this also means you can survive having your body completely destroyed, and through your ability to recreate your body you can instantly “regenerate” any damage to your physical form, even that which would be fatal to a being of flesh alone. Lastly, your ability to mold your soul and body are greatly enhanced, allowing you to reshape your essence as you see fit. Taking Resonance amplifies this ability to even greater heights, and the addon Adjust would allow you to completely rewrite your existence in an instant.
addons.title: Spiritual Existence

addons.text: The awakening of your Sixth Eye and Crown Chakras has pushed your visual prowess to the point of effective local omniscience even at rest, providing near total awareness of your surroundings in a several mile radius on a physical and spiritual level, and can grow even larger with mastery and time. When active your range balloons outwards by an order of magnitude and deepens to a more metaphysical level, allowing you to observe the fundamental facets which underpin reality - such as divine law or the threads of fate - with continental range. This range can be further amplified via a radar-like pulse of spiritual energy which carries your awareness, capable of extending however far your spiritual energy does, meaning with practice and enough energy you could observe all of creation. As for your efficiency, it has reached the level of the divine. You can use ruinously expensive techniques for a fraction of a fraction of the original cost. Such is your efficiency that coupled with your reserves you effectively cannot run out of spiritual energy, simply regenerating it faster than you can use it, even when ceaselessly using your strongest techniques. Lastly, between your understanding of the physical and metaphysical and your unparalleled affinity for using spiritual power, you have reached a beyond savant-like ability to learn and create techniques. Merely thinking of a technique is enough for you to begin figuring out how to create it, even without any previous experience with anything like it, and with relevant experience you can create at least a rudimentary version within moments.
addons.title: Enlightened Clairvoyance

objects.text:
Your various spiritual and lifeforce energies have all combined, melded into a singular transcendent energy representing life, both spiritual and physical. This Supreme Spirit Energy is orders of magnitudes more potent than its individual components, with its usage empowering even minor techniques to be on par with the Trump Cards of wielders of lesser spirit energies, and your reserves are mind boggling vast.

You possess an unrivalled affinity for Supreme Spirit Energy, with the creation and learning of new techniques and applications being easy and intuitive for you to the point that you can create new techniques on the fly to suit your needs. Adding on to this, you intuitively understand the basics of techniques from all constituent power systems if you didn’t already possess this knowledge.

Additionally, your ability to draw upon and influence spiritual energy beyond your own has achieved a certain level of Authority. You can control both ambient spiritual energy and the spiritual energy of others, allowing you to use outside sources of spiritual energy to fuel your techniques and even hijack or disable the techniques of others should your control and power surpass their own.

Lastly, your Semblance has been subsumed and become a particularly potent and versatile technique you innately know, which can be used as a starting point for developing new techniques. For example, Ruby Rose’s Petal Burst could almost immediately be used to develop a Logia-esque intangibility transformation technique, and with but a bit of focus and practice could give birth to a petal blades technique akin to Senbonzakura.
objects.title: Spiritual Supremacy

addons.text:
Your Library of Babel has fully synergized with your authority as the Architect of Decline, coalescing your grand library into a singular, absolute record.

Due to its connection to you as the multiversal constant of entropy and the Ever After, your library automatically catalogs everything that has ever been, with this archive expanding continuously as new conclusions are reached throughout creation.

You may also write in the book as it's being written in a wide variety of ways, such as nudging a coincidence to end someone's tale on a more positive note, as long as it's something less powerful than you.

You may also deny finality itself, such as by allowing a collapsing timeline to avoid being purged from existence simply by taking it under your will, permitting it to continue peacefully inside The Ever After.

You may access this knowledge directly through your mind or manifest it physically as The Book of the End, a tome with obsidian-like covers and seemingly infinite pages, and browse it the old-fashioned way.

If you have The Counterpart, your twin will get an equivalent book called the Codex of Dawn, which holds the knowledge of everything that has ever begun.
addons.title: The Book of The End

objects.text:
The library inside your soul has flourished, expanding its reach to encompass not only life but history itself. 

Whenever you encounter a new individual, you gain an Appendix of Bloodlines. This allows you to trace a person’s lineage back through centuries up to their most ancient ancestors, viewing the lives, skills, and tribulations of their ancestors as "prequels" to their current story. You can see how their ancestors' history shaped their present self.

You gain the ability to access alternate drafts of any of your books. This lets you read the actions a person took in parallel timelines, seeing how their life would look today if they had made different choices in the past up to the present day.

Your library also generates books for objects and landscapes. By touching an item or standing in a location for an extended amount of time, you can read its entire history—from the forging of a blade and its schematics, the culture and construction of a city, to the geological shifts of a mountain range. You can uncover hidden secrets, forgotten owners, and the "memory" of the ground beneath you.

You are able to search for any information you might be interested in, despite the sheer quantity of information. Regardless, the library cannot predict the future; it merely records what has happened.
objects.title: Library of Babel

objects.text: "I can see him... His light... It's like staring at a god..." Your soul. Your radiance. It acts as a beacon for all those who travel under it's light. It is the ultimate reference point that provides eternal guidance to those that bask in it's glory. Forge an interstellar empire upon your soul's light, even if the travel between distant stars means braving an unforgiving warp. It also provides a conceptual benefit to all those who use it to traverse in that they will be less likely to encounter dangers whilst going much faster than would be usually allowed. Your soul can be also a teleport beacon allowing for the rapid exfiltration or infiltration of men, armour and equipment to your position. Those who follow your light, if they remain trapped in the harshest of prisons, blocked by ever shifting architecture, will still be able to find themselves escaping from such a place. When someone was to undergo a binding ritual with you, they will find themselves touched by the brilliance of your soul, causing their once meagre supernatural abilities to bloom like flowers under the sun. They won't become once in a generation prodigy but they'll have noticeable growth in their talent. Additionally, if the abilities they have include any drawbacks such Perils of the Warp or the chance of corruption, then they will be lessened or outright eliminated. You may choose to place a supernatural imprint of your soul somewhere and leave the beacon stationary, such as at the home world of humanity, so you can travel the stars. However, the further away you get from it, the harder it is to maintain.
objects.title: Astronomican

objects.text:
The ancient bindings placed upon you by the Charred Council are shattered, releasing the remainder of your sealed Nephilim power. You now stand as a fully realized Horseman-class entity, capable of contending directly with angels, demons, and other high-tier supernatural beings on equal footing.

Your body fully transcends mortal limitations with only high-order magic or divine weapons able to inflict injury at all. Your strength, speed, and reflexes reach catastrophic levels, allowing you to tear through fortified structures, cross entire battlefields in moments, and engage multiple elite supernatural opponents simultaneously without fatigue. Regeneration is constant and instinctive, rapidly restoring even severe damage so long as your essence remains intact. 

Your presence alone carries an aura of inevitability, causing lesser beings to instinctively recognize you as a harbinger of ruin. You also gain a fully unlocked form of Darksiders angel and demon magic with you gaining knowledge equivalent to decades of practice in these arts. You may also summon a bound war-steed: an immortal, magically sustained mount of apocalyptic origin, capable of extreme speed, endurance, and sustained combat support across vast distances.

With your chains broken, you may freely manifest your full might through a dedicated Apocalyptic Super Form, a transformation capable of leveling cities and surviving even the most destructive weapons mankind can deploy. This form may take inspiration from War’s Chaos Form, Death’s Reaper Form, Fury’s Havoc Form, Strife’s Anarchy Form, or a personalized combination of multiple forms.

This form represents the moment you cease to be a bound enforcer and instead become what the Horsemen were feared to be: a walking apocalypse, restrained only by your own will.
objects.title: Horseman of the Apocalypse (Darksiders)

objects.text:
The density and potency of the aetheric essence you produce each day has intensified more than twentyfold, turning your yield into a rich reservoir of divine power.

For comparison, this permits you to materialise a new minor god after only a few hours rather than days. If you chose to store your essence for a couple days, you could bring forth a divinity metaphysically akin to a fledgling thunderclap god, able to level a building in a single outburst although this act would still leave them exhausted.

The upper limits of your deities and divine spirits have similarly risen in tandem. Where once their greatest miracles only extended across a city, they could now influence events across a small country at their peak. Such heights demand patience, however, requiring months of consistent investment before they'd grow powerful enough to reach that scale.

For instance, a God of Short Circuiting could plunge whole regions into darkness with a cascading series of electrical faults. Otherwise, you might manifest the Four Horsemen of Irritating Injuries – Stubbed Toes, Splinters, Paper Cuts & Bitten Tongues – to spread their misery across cities and bring about the apocalypse of mundane bodily pain.
objects.title: Median Gods

objects.text:
Forget the idea of just “minor” gods — you’re playing in the big leagues now. The potential held within your aetheric essence has been multiplied by the same again.

With this upgrade, a baseline minor deity could be formed in under a dozen minutes, theoretically allowing you to field swarms of low-level divinities after just a few weeks. For example, an army of miniature Deaths could be fielded for every trivial entity, from the ‘ᴅᴇᴀᴛʜ ᴏꜰ ᴇᴀʀᴛʜᴡᴏʀᴍꜱ’ to that of the ‘ᴅᴇᴀᴛʜ ᴏꜰ ʙʀᴏᴋᴇɴ ꜱᴛʀᴇᴇᴛʟɪɢʜᴛꜱ’.

Should you conserve your essence, you would find yourself creating far greater divinities. After a week, you could formulate a deity linked to destruction that may shatter city-sections with ease, a God of Coffee able to produce literal caffeinated ambrosia or a sword's personified spirit that can boost the blade to rival Excalibur.

The ceiling on your gods’ potential has been removed, unshackling all prior limits. With sufficient time and investment, their domains can eventually encompass concepts as broad and esoteric as that of Fate, Love, Chaos or Time itself, eventually matching even the mightiest of established divinities, though this may take many years to achieve.
objects.title: Major Gods

objects.text:
You now gain the power to create Tsugumomo. Tsugumomo are objects or tools that have gained life through the influence of humans. After an object has been used for many years by multiple people, a portion of those users soul flows into the item, eventually allowing it to develop a soul of its own and acquire supernatural powers through the accumulation of these spiritual fragments.

You now gain a technique that allow you to safely take portions of your own soul, or the souls of others, which allows you to create Tsugumomo instantly. While taking portion of your soul weakens you somewhat, the missing portion will regenerate, though it may take days or months depending on how large of a portion is taken. This process can be further accelerated by engaging in activities you enjoy.

The strength of a Tsugumomo depends on the strength of the souls used, though even the weakest can grow stronger over time. When creating a Tsugumomo, you may either decide its basic personality yourself or allow it to develop naturally. Tsugumomo possess self-awareness, rational thought, and emotions, making them very similar to humans. They have humanoid bodies with organs and blood, and any wound inflicted upon such a body produces the same consequences it would for a normal person.

Typically, Tsugumomo develop appearances based on the objects they once were, featuring unique attire and sometimes abnormal traits such as unusual pupils or tattoos. However, you may now either leave their appearance to chance, as before, or choose what their living form looks like. Although some Tsugumomo may appear older than others, the passage of time has little effect on their physical appearance.

Tsugumomos primary requirement for survival is spiritual energy usually from humans, without spiritual energy, they revert back to being ordinary objects, this is usually equivalent to death. But now thanks to your powers, any Tsugumomo you crate can generate their own spiritual power, and don`t need to depend on others for it.

If a Tsugumomo receives fatal damage while in human form, it reverts to its object form in a destroyed state, and if it`s object form is damaged beyond repair, it will die permanently. Tsugumomo abilities are categorised into two broad types: fundamental abilities and personal abilities.

Fundamental abilities relate to the physical form of the Tsugumomo and require less spiritual power to use. These include changing between human and object forms, creating clone bodies, and altering size. Tsugumomo can also partially manifest their object bodies while in human form, such as projecting a weapon’s blade from an arm or fully manifesting a tool version of themselves for personal use. Over time, they may develop special techniques or discover new ways to manipulate their object form.

Personal abilities are more varied and stem from the Tsugumomo’s original nature, requiring greater power to perform. These abilities are unique to each individual and are often highly supernatural, differing greatly depending on the object. Examples include the ability to manipulate time due to originating from an hourglass, or a dice that controls fate

By having a powerful bond with your Tsugumomo you are able to reach Ascension, this technique can be initiated through mutual agreement, and it allows powerful transformation which unifies the minds of the user and the Tsugumomo, giving you massive increase in power. Each Tsugumomo, also possess a True Name, you know the true name of all Tsugumomo you create, and it is possible to forcibly trigger Ascension by having the owner call their true name.
objects.title: Tsugumomo Creator (Tsugumomo)

objects.text:
Beyond bestowing them with a soul, you can additionally give them a human form that they can swap into from their original one. 

While in this form they are as a normal human would be, with their appearance taking cues from their previous appearance but not entirely influenced by it. Similarly to before you are not in control of them while they are transformed, and they can swap back to their ‘original’ selves at will.
objects.title: Personification

objects.text:
Your ability to grant souls and human forms to the soulless has expanded, deepened by your connection to the very celestial bodies upon which life is born, grows, and thrives. No longer limited to individual beings, you may now bestow a soul, consciousness, and a physical avatar upon any celestial body, regardless of its nature or scale. Planets, moons, stars, and other such entities may all awaken beneath your touch, gaining true self-awareness and the capacity to act as independent, living beings.

The act of awakening a celestial body is transformative in more ways than one. Upon receiving a soul, the celestial body is immediately cleansed of any and all corruption, whether mundane or supernatural in origin. Pollution, environmental devastation, spiritual contamination, eldritch taint, demonic influence, parasitic energies, and countless other forms of corruption are purged completely. The world is restored to a state of purity, free from all forces that would diminish or corrupt its natural existence.

This restoration extends beyond mere cleansing. The awakened celestial body instinctively begins to heal itself, allowing life to rapidly recover and flourish. Ecosystems are restored, barren regions are revitalized, and lost biodiversity returns at an extraordinary pace. Species that once vanished from existence may re-emerge as though guided by the memory of the world itself. On Gaia, for example, every extinct species would gradually re-evolve and return in the same form it possessed at the time of its disappearance, restoring the planet's natural heritage across countless ages.

In awakening a celestial body, you also forge a profound bond with it. This connection is equal in strength and depth to the bond you gain through Obsession of the Celestial Spheres. Through it, you gain an intimate awareness of the celestial body's thoughts, feelings, and desires, while it gains a similar understanding of you. The celestial body gains an obsessive or all-consuming attachment to you, that is also equal to the one you gain through Obsession of the Celestial Spheres.

Each awakened world, moon, star, or celestial entity thus becomes both a living being and a steadfast companion, bound to you through a connection that transcends distance, time, and ordinary understanding.
objects.title: Awaken, Restore, Reinforce

addons.text:
Your mastery over the soul has reached its absolute peak. You now possess Supreme Grandmaster attainment in Soul Path, reaching the level once held by Spectral Soul Demon Venerable. Your understanding of the profundities of the soul has surpassed the limits of heaven and earth, allowing you to freely innovate entirely new soul path methods and abilities. Your own improvement would signify the improvement of heaven and earth, as every advancement you make deepens the understanding and development of Soul Path itself.

As a Soul Path Dao Lord, you are able to sense natural Soul Path Dao Marks within heaven and earth and refine them into your own. After refining these Dao Marks, you may manipulate them at will and effectively turn the surrounding world itself into your personal battlefield killer move, greatly amplifying all your soul path methods as if you personally possessed those Dao Marks. These Dao Marks may be manipulated directly through your will, allowing you to form soul path environments, formations, and killer moves even without relying on Gu worms.

Your soul possesses true Rank Nine Venerable power and now contains 1,000,000 Soul Path Dao Marks. Your soul’s power is great enough to destroy the sun of Immemorial White Heaven itself. Even a single arm of your soul possesses immense power, capable of battling Quasi-Venerables on equal grounds. Through your soul you may create a multitude of Rank Nine soul-based killer move methods and abilities, such as devastating soul attacks, soul suppression, soul enslavement, soul strengthening, and the creation of innumerable Soul Beasts, or even Immemorial Soul Beasts, by expending your soul foundation. Methods you create can even contain the profundities of other paths, such as incorporating Luck Path to create methods like Burning Soul Bursting Luck that expends your soul foundation to vastly increase your luck.

Your control over souls has reached an unparalleled level. Souls may be freely refined, fused, divided, devoured, or reshaped according to your will. You may create vast numbers of soul clones or servants, refine powerful soul beasts, or turn souls into resources and weapons. Almost all Soul-based methods are ineffective against you and may even backfire upon their users due to your understanding and the immensity of your soul.
addons.title: Soul Dao Lord

addons.text: You now become Spectral Soul Demon Venerable himself, inheriting all of his powers, abilities, willpower, knowledge, and attainments exactly as he possessed them while alive in the Late Antiquity Era. This includes his status as the number one Soul Path cultivator in history, his Soul Path Dao Lord status, and his Supreme Grandmaster attainment in Food Path. You may also choose to inherit his nature and disposition as well. You inherit his Rank Nine cultivation, along with his immortal aperture and the immense Dao Mark foundation he accumulated throughout his life. His Immortal Gu, mortal Gu, resources, and inheritances now belong to you as well, granting you the same cultivation base and capabilities he possessed at the height of his power before his death. All of Spectral Soul Demon Venerable’s experiences, killer moves, cultivation methods, and insights become yours. His mastery over soul manipulation, soul refinement, soul devouring, and the many methods he created throughout his life are now part of your own abilities, granting you the full power and legacy of Spectral Soul Demon Venerable at the peak of his life. If you possess Sovereign Immortal Fetus Gu, you now also inherit everything that has ever been accumulated by Spectral Soul, including after his death. This includes his Great Grandmaster attainment in atleast all paths, all of Shadow Sect’s resources, and all true inheritances gathered by Shadow Sect, including those belonging to multiple Venerables. You may also choose to possess all of Spectral Soul’s split souls throughout history as your own split souls, including those of Shadow Sect, with them retaining all of their cultivation, powers, Immortal Gu, mortal Gu, and accumulated resources as well.
addons.title: Spectral Soul Demon Venerable

addons.text:
Your Soul Garden evolves into the legendary Door of Life and Death, the Secluded Domain of Heaven and Earth where the souls of all lifeforms within the five regions and nine heavens pass after death. This secluded domain is now tethered to your soul and may be manifested at will, becoming a true cycle of life and death under your control.

Within the Door of Life and Death, the souls of the dead naturally gather and are preserved. Souls that enter this domain may be stored, nurtured, or released according to your will. This allows you to safeguard the souls of those you value while also granting you access to the countless souls that pass through the cycle of death.

As the master of this Secluded Domain of Heaven and Earth, you may freely control the flow of souls within it. Souls may be allowed to rest, used as resources for soul cultivation, refined into soul beasts, or returned to the world as you see fit. The Door of Life and Death greatly strengthens all Soul Path methods, acting as a supreme soul path environment that amplifies your abilities and provides you with a vast and constant supply of souls. This domain also contains and continuously produces countless Soul Path Dao Marks, as well as natural Gu worms related to life and death such as Life Gu and Death Gu. If you are a Soul Path Dao Lord, you may refine these Dao Marks to gain immense amplification to your Soul Path methods.

In worlds that possess their own afterlife or systems governing the souls of the dead, you may contest their authority over souls, attempting to seize control of that cycle of death. Should you gain authority, the souls of that world will naturally pass into your Door of Life and Death instead. Unless you will otherwise, the souls of that world will be drawn into your domain after death.
addons.title: Door of Life and Death

objects.text: Rather than a Hundred Million Man Soul you are naturally born with the horrifically powerful Hundred Million Desolate Soul, while becoming a Desolate Soul is a step in the wrong direction, this does however come with the ability to actually utilize the immense power contained within your Desolate Soul, this gives you the power of a Legendary Immemorial Desolate Soul Beast and allowing your soul to freely leave your body and act independently in the physical world without the need for a body. The appearance of your soul is no longer human; instead, it takes on a gigantic, monstrous humanoid thousands of meters tall, tall enough to tower over mountains and pierce through the cloud layers. Your soul has three heads and a thousand arms. Your soul no longer floats like human souls do; rather, it is so dense and heavy that it is affected by gravity with it naturally emitting overwhelming spiritual pressure, suppressing weaker souls and soul beasts. With this, your soul possesses quasi–Rank Nine Pseudo-Venerable power, durable enough to withstand six myriad tribulations at once. Your strength is sufficient to tear entire mountain ranges from the earth vein, allowing you to throw them at opponents, or crush most Rank Eight Immortal Gu Houses in the palms of your hands. Your soul contains 340,000 Soul Path Dao Marks. These Dao Marks greatly amplify all soul-based methods and abilities while interfering with other paths, providing significant resistance against effects from other paths. You may devour the souls of others to replenish or strengthen your own soul foundation, allowing you to gain the experiences, memories, and knowledge of those devoured, and even their attainment. Devouring souls also leads to the accumulation of Soul Path Dao Marks as your soul foundation grows stronger. You also possess the special ability to split your soul, dividing your soul foundation to create separate souls that can act independently and grow in power on their own, and may even use them to replace the souls of others if desired. Your Desolate Soul is unusually resilient to the erosion of Dream Realms, allowing you to pilfer the true meaning contained within without much worry for sinking into them. With most soul path attacks also struggling to damage your soul due to its immense density and foundation. The desolation of your soul does come with a cost, that being a major reduction of your ‘’Human’’ nature, replacing it with a bestial nature, dimming your positive emotions and impulses, while strengthening negative emotions and impulses. This makes committing acts of kindness, charity, honor, and justice feel like you are going against your very nature, while malicious acts come with natural ease. This does not make it impossible to be a good person, but it makes it much harder. With this, you are a genuine monster, down to your very soul.
objects.title: Spiritual Desolation (Reverend Insanity)

objects.text: Taurus grants you profound understanding of the earth, allowing Virgo's healing to extend beyond individuals into the land itself. You can now restore barren soil, purify contaminated water, and coax life from seemingly dead ground, healing ecosystems with the same touch that mends flesh and bone. Every acre you restore becomes receptive to your presence, the land itself remembering who brought it back to health. Capricorn works in the background of every restoration, making minute adjustments that cascade into exponential effects. A slight alteration to drainage here, a carefully placed microbe colony there, and entire regions transform over time. The healed land, in gratitude, offers its strength back to you. Within any territory you have restored, you can command the earth to rise up, trees to bend to your will, and nature itself to become an extension of your intent. The land that received life now gives power in return.
objects.title: Earth Triplicity, The Land Takes And Gives

objects.text: Your Gemini Twins gain the ability to multiply through negotiation. Using Libra's gift for finding common ground, you can parley with the local air itself, convincing it to manifest as new spirits. These air spirits carry the character of their origin, ice-cold breezes from northern peaks that leave frost in their wake, warm tropical winds that move with blinding speed, sea air thick with salt and mist. Each new spirit joins your growing collective, their numbers limited only by your ability to negotiate and the air's willingness to cooperate. Once gathered, these spirits share the Aquarian gift of synergistic growth. The more spirits work together, the faster each one improves and the more seamlessly they coordinate. A single spirit might scout a single street, but a thousand spirits working in harmony can map an entire city in moments, each sharing what they see through the perfect telepathic link. The intelligence you gather feeds back into your negotiations, as understanding a region's air more deeply makes convincing it to join that much easier. Your network grows itself, and the wind itself becomes your eyes.
objects.title: Air Triplicity, Breeze In The Winds

objects.text: Your Crab Totem now passively summons guardians shaped from your Scorpio transformation, tiny chimeric spirits the size of scorpions with wings of midnight blue and stingers that gleam in the dark. They grow more numerous as your totem strengthens with the love within your home, yet remain unseen unless a threat emerges. When intruders come with ill intent, the spirits reveal themselves, swarming with all the abilities of your full transformation, crushing pincers, paralytic venom, flight, and the ability to blend into shadow. Your home defends itself with an invisible army that scales with the bonds it protects. Pisces adds its dreaming nature to everything your totem touches. Not only the inhabitants, but the objects within and the very structure of your home begin to dream of perfection and drift slowly toward it. Your pipes flow more freely, your walls stand straighter, dust settles more slowly, relationships heal faster after conflict, and your sleep grows deeper with each passing night. The stronger your totem, the faster the drift, yet true perfection remains always just beyond reach, an infinite horizon of improvement. Your home becomes a living sanctuary that constantly, gently, becomes more itself.
objects.title: Water Triplicity, Ocean Depths Of Home

objects.text:
Your intent no longer just affects your physical actions. Now, any action you take, whether magical, spiritual, divine or esoteric, can be enhanced by your intent. 

Truly hating someone when cursing them will amplify the curse. Exerting a domain upon the world with wonder will amplify and warp the world to match the emotion. Fueling your spells with determination can make them nigh unstoppable.

This does not amplify the base power. Merely increasing its scope.
objects.title: Overflowing Intent

objects.text:
You can summon a soul stone as a tool, allowing you to break and flake pieces from the soul crystals you have. This allows you to sense and pull certain parts of their soul like specific memories, personality traits or anything else stored in the crystal to an edge and break it off similarly to how you would remove parts of a piece of obsidian by knapping.

This method is somewhat crude, only removing the majority of your targeted trait, leaving small pieces and torn up connections behind. But you can make use of these damaged parts, as the crystal will try to reform into a complete soul again, allowing you to graft on other flakes you have.

Thanks to your powers, the crystals with missing pieces will heal slowly, but if you break off more than half of a crystal, it will lack enough substance to heal, making it disintegrate.

You also gain some instinctual skill and a great talent in knapping.
objects.title: Soul Knapping

addons.text:
You are now able to become an Apostle of your created gods. This grants you many advantages-most importantly, you no longer need to fear losing your powers if you go against their core principles. Additionally, you can become an Apostle of any god you create, without limit.

Only the Major Gods, or the most powerful of Median Gods are capable of having an Apostle.
addons.title: Apostle of The Created God

objects.text:
You are now an Apostle of your chosen god. This grants you immunity to ageing, and a body capable of regenerating any wound it sustains. Even if your body is torn apart, the pieces will heal if they are brought back together, but you wont be able to regenerate entire limbs. You are also strong enough to lift a Humvee with your bare hands, fast enough to outrun a speeding vehicle, and capable of sensing the presence of others from a great distance.

Your ability to cast Lesser Miracles has also improved. You can cast them more easily, with less strain on your soul, and perform a greater number of miracles. Additionally, you can now wield more powerful miracles with far greater ease.
objects.title: Apostle (Gate — Thus the JSDF Fought There!)

objects.text:
Your soul has been irrevocably marked by the realm of… Heaven? Wait, it seems there has been a cosmic mistake. You are undeniably a condemned soul, a should be future inmate of the bad place. Yet somehow God themself has decided to give you access to the infinite power of Heaven in the here and now. You should be damned, but you are not.

This has given you a spiritual mark that functions as a permanent gate that connects you to the greater infinity of limitless cosmic energies of Heaven. Compared to the lesser infinity of Hell’s power, the energy of Heaven itself is pure righteous holiness and the fury of God manifest, without any craving or mental influences corrupting your being.

That being said, like Marked for Hell, this energy can be directly channeled to fuel and overwrite your own biology, spells, or any ability you have, empowering it at minimum twice as much as compared to Marked for Hell. When used to heal, it fills you with permanent angelic characteristics. In time you will sprout wings and form a halo. Be warned that the more severe the injuries you heal, the more the affected areas become more… biblically accurate. Though in time you can learn to take a more humanoid appearance. 

While this energy specializes in warding and protecting and is mainly used for pure creation or the protection of others and yourself, make no mistake, it can be used for pure destruction and annihilation so long as the target is deemed an enemy of God or a threat to humanity.

Also, the greater the act of selflessness, the stronger the energy will become permanently, unless used for unholy purposes antithetical to its Heavenly nature.

The sole cost of this power is the purification of the soul, a willing state of purity that is under normal circumstances incompatible with any being that has known the original sin. So this mark ensures that upon your final, permanent death, should you have the ability to resurrect, your soul will be claimed by the realm that fueled you. You will join the heavenly hosts. Depending on your personal power and the actions you took during your life, your rank within the heavenly host will range from being the lowest of angels, despised by all, to the new red right hand of YHWH themself.
objects.title: Marked for Heaven?

objects.text: For each purchase of this upgrade, you will start at the First Stage of the next Realm up. The first purchase makes you a Profound Realm Cultivator, while the sixth makes you Divine Realm. In addition, you gain the bare minimum training needed to be considered a competent fighter and Cultivator of that Realm, with knowledge of basic Techniques belonging to that Realm and further mastery achieved for those Techniques for each higher Realm purchased. This way, you won’t get completely bodied by someone a Realm below you who actually knows what they are doing, though this alone won’t guarantee a win if you battle a talented fighter of the same Stage as you.
objects.title: Realm Ascension (Beware of Chicken)

objects.text:
For each purchase of this upgrade, you gain basic mastery of a single Technique equal to your current Stage, along with enough talent for that Technique specifically that you can keep advancing it along with your Cultivation. A Technique is any single Qi fueled martial art, spell like ability, special crafting technique, unique Cultivation method, or any similar such thing found in Beware of Chicken (or any its official derivatives such as Soaring Heaven's Isle, Unbroken, or Elder but Younger Sister) that does not require a special bloodline or extremely specific circumstances, locations, or resources to perform.

In addition, you may make a Technique from scratch so long as it is not overpowered. Nothing a First Stage Initiate can do will kill an Imperial Realm Cultivator, though a Technique that can kill a Profound Realm Cultivator at immense cost and great risk is viable. Alternatively, additional purchases may be used to advance your mastery of a Technique, with a second pushing it to complete mastery for your Stage and a third pushing it to transcendent levels never seen before for your Stage.

If you purchase Techniques related to each other, you will gain a lesser talent for things related to both, such as two sword style Techniques giving you a minor affinity for sword Techniques in general. These stack, so buying ten crafting Techniques would give you a major talent at all things crafting in general, and would make you slightly better at each of said purchased Techniques. With double purchases of each pushing your talent to nearly transcendent levels, and a third pushing you to become a one man industrial revolution able to come up with designs that would make even the heads of major Sects weep in awe at your brilliance.
objects.title: Technique Mastery (Beware of Chicken)

objects.text:
Every purchase of this upgrade grants you one unique Trait that will help your Cultivation. A Trait in this context is anything one must be born with, can only acquire under unique circumstances, or must use specific resources or rituals that are unlikely to be acquired in worlds other than Xianada to attain. Essentially, anything not covered by Technique Mastery is covered here, and purchasing a Trait here expands your options for what you can master with Technique Mastery. For example purchasing a Fox Blood Trait would allow you to master the Fox Shadow Illusion Technique.

These Traits can be any that are found in Beware of Chicken (or any its official derivatives such as Soaring Heaven's Isle, Unbroken, or Elder but Younger Sister) as well as original creations in line with canonical Traits. These include things such as Spirit Beast Bloodlines (Dragon, Monkey, Fox, etc.), other unique Bloodlines such as any variation of the Celestial Constellation Soul Art Bloodline, various unique elemental affinities such as the Shrouded Mountain Sect’s Lightning and Light, the Fox Clan's Shadow and Illusion, or Meiling's Complete Medicinal Qi affinities, unique spirit roots perfectly suited for Cultivation, affinities for spirits and extrasensory perception, and any number of other possibilities.

Your Unique Trait’s strength correlates directly with your Cultivation Stage, but the main benefit is that it can, with proper training, allow you to more effectively fight above your weight class. A single Trait can allow you to easily develop Techniques that could fight someone a single Stage above you, maybe one whole Realm in exceptional circumstances if you train hard enough. Multiple Traits don’t necessarily stack in such a way that you could take on someone multiple realms above you, but instead they increase your versatility and innate growth potential when it comes to Cultivation. They are an increase in breadth instead of depth, adding to your toolkit in such a way that you are far less likely to be truly caught off guard and without a response to whatever you face in battle.
objects.title: Unique Trait Acquisition (Beware of Chicken)

objects.text:
You have begun the journey of mastering Talismans, which involves creating and utilising talismans which are inscribed paper tags that channel any form of energy you possess, even stamina, to create a variety of supernatural phenomena.

The talismans you create can be used to store magical abilities, cast offensive arrays, repel evil spirits, cast elemental attacks, heal wounds, enhance physical attributes when worn on the body, strengthen mental states, and much more.

Crafting a talisman requires imbuing a brush with energy and painting mystical symbols onto paper using specialised materials. The power and quality of a talisman depend entirely on the skill and knowledge of the artist, and the quality of the materials used. The rarer and more expensive the ingredients, the more powerful the resulting talisman will be.

Drawing talismans can be taxing on the spirit and consumes a practitioner’s energy. The amount of power that can be channelled is strictly limited by the creator’s current level of strength and the quality of the materials being used.

Creating a talisman is also a time-consuming process, but with practice and the aid of related skills such as artifact crafting, magical theory, and spiritual knowledge, the process will become significantly faster and more efficient. This ability also synchronises exceptionally well with Formation Mastery. In time, you will be able to imbue your formations into talismans, allowing them to be deployed instantly.

You possess a basic understanding of all forms of talisman arts, and possess enough artistic skills to create them. Through time, practice, and research, you can develop entirely new talismans.
objects.title: Talisman Master

addons.text:
Your mother has entrusted you with more than power—she has given you an instrument worthy of her child. Forged through the convergence of relics tied to finality, inevitability, and perfect resonance, this artifact has evolved into something far greater than the sum of its origins. It is no mere weapon, but a symbol of your inheritance, a conduit for your authority, and a growing manifestation of your connection to Death of the Endless herself.

The relic is soul-bound to you absolutely. It cannot be permanently lost, stolen, corrupted, or turned against you, always returning to your possession across dimensions, timelines, sealed realms, or conceptual separation. It recognizes no true wielder but you and instinctively reshapes itself into the form most suited to your intent. Scythe, sickles, blade, ring, staff, chain, lantern, or stranger manifestations still—the relic is fluid, symbolic, and alive with your authority.

The relic does not grant powers you do not already possess through Child of Death. Instead, it serves as a focus for your inheritance, refining and stabilizing your authority over Death, endings, souls, Life, and the Cycle itself. Complex manifestations that would normally require immense concentration become easier when channeled through the relic, while larger applications of your authority become smoother and more efficient.

The relic embodies the principle of finality through form. Anything possessing existence, structure, continuation, separation, or definable boundaries may potentially be cut by it, whether physical, spiritual, conceptual, temporal, spatial, or metaphysical in nature. Matter, souls, immortality, barriers, dimensions, causality, manifestations, memories, fate, and abstract continuations may all be severed through it. The greater the target, the greater the authority, understanding, and power required to impose an ending upon it.

Its wounds are extraordinarily difficult to heal or reverse, as the relic does not merely damage things—it forces them closer toward their conclusion. Regeneration, resurrection, immortality, and abilities meant to reject death or deny endings are especially vulnerable to its power. Fate manipulation, probability alteration, and many forms of metaphysical avoidance offer little protection against strikes delivered through the relic.

Though you are already capable of traversing the Cycle naturally, the relic greatly refines and amplifies such movement. Passage through worlds, afterlives, reincarnation systems, dying realities, conceptual spaces, and metaphysical boundaries becomes smoother and more instinctive when channeled through it. At higher mastery, the relic may externalize your authority over endings to sever separation itself, allowing you to collapse distance, cut pathways between realities, or carve through the boundaries dividing worlds, timelines, and dimensions.

The dead instinctively recognize the relic for what it is. Souls, reapers, psychopomps, undead, and beings tied to death or transition react to it with instinctive reverence, fear, or submission. The more absolute a being believes its immortality or invincibility to be, the more oppressive and inevitable the relic’s presence becomes against them.

Most importantly, the relic evolves alongside your inheritance. As your understanding of Death deepens, so too does the artifact. New forms, abilities, and expressions awaken naturally through the maturation of your nature as Death’s child. In time, it may grow into a true instrument of the Endless itself.

This is not merely a weapon. It is the manifested symbol of your inheritance.
addons.title: Endless Relic

objects.text:
You do not merely wield Death or Life—you were born from the very essence of Death herself. You are the child of Death of the Endless, not an avatar, mantle-holder, or replacement meant to inherit her station. Whether by blood, adoption, incarnation, or direct formation from her essence, the truth remains the same: you are undeniably her child.

This lineage transforms whatever connection to Death you already possess. If you command Death and Life directly, that dominion becomes instinctive rather than controlled. If you are a Thanatarch, your authority ceases to be an office and becomes part of your existence. If you are a Reaper of Souls, your nature deepens beyond that of a Grim Reaper into something far closer to Death’s own kin. Though the paths leading here differ—dominion, authority, or embodiment—the inheritance granted by this lineage ultimately draws them toward the same inevitable destination.

You share in your mother’s endless nature, elevating you toward a near-absolute state. You do not simply inherit power—you begin to embody the principles underlying Death, Life, endings, transition, continuation, and the Cycle itself. If you possess Eternal Flame, imposed limitations and restraints fall away entirely.

Anything that exists may be brought to its conclusion through your will. Flesh, souls, immortality, regeneration, curses, barriers, powers, memories, manifestations, concepts, and metaphysical states may all be ended if they possess an existence capable of reaching a conclusion. You do not merely destroy things—you impose finality upon them. Your touch, gaze, words, or intent may force death upon body, soul, power, fate, or even abstract existence itself. At the same time, you may preserve, restore, heal, and renew just as naturally as you destroy.

Your authority extends beyond living beings. You may end distance to arrive somewhere instantly, end transformations to restore an original state, end momentum to halt motion, end connections between souls, or end the continuation sustaining immortality and resurrection. The greater the target, the greater the power, understanding, and authority required to impose an ending upon it.

Your perception encompasses the deeper structure of existence. Souls appear as living narratives shaped by memory, karma, causality, lineage, destiny, and unrealized possibility. Past lives, alternate selves, abandoned timelines, and branching futures are visible as mutable paths that may be severed, restored, redirected, merged, or brought to an end. Love, hatred, worship, curses, vows, and destiny itself appear as tangible bonds you may manipulate directly.

You no longer traverse reality through ordinary movement. You move through the Cycle itself, appearing wherever death, endings, transition, reincarnation, or collapse are present. Distance, dimensional barriers, sealed realms, timelines, and many forms of conceptual separation become increasingly meaningless to you wherever Death’s influence can reach. Though not yet truly omnipresent, your existence may eventually manifest across multiple locations, worlds, or moments simultaneously as your inheritance deepens.

Your body bears Death’s mark. You no longer require food, sleep, breath, or aging to sustain yourself. Disease, decay, corruption, and spiritual erosion cannot meaningfully affect you. You instinctively sense approaching endings and may follow that certainty unerringly to its source.

Your Soul Garden evolves alongside your inheritance, deepening from a personal afterlife into a metaphysical domain tied directly to the greater Cycle itself. Though it does not replace the countless afterlives, underworlds, and reincarnation systems spread across existence, souls may naturally drift toward it from across realities. Lost souls, wandering dead, displaced spirits, and those lacking a proper end often find their way there instinctively, allowing the domain to gradually grow into a nexus of death, transition, refuge, and reincarnation across worlds.

Though your manifested power initially rests around a planetary to universal scale, your nature is rooted in something far greater. You are born from one of the fundamental principles underlying existence itself. Your growth possesses no fixed ceiling, and with sufficient time, understanding, and development, you may eventually ascend toward the same boundless state embodied by your mother. Few beings claiming dominion over death could ever truly stand beside you, for you are not merely a god of death—you are the child of Death itself.

You are The End of All Things.
objects.title: Child of Death

objects.text:
You have fused with the Supreme Being Bone, and like Shi Hao's third supreme bone, it is now born directly from your Supreme Blood, imprinting itself throughout your entire skeletal frame, organs, and nervous system, ensuring that you can never lose this power.

The Supreme Being Bone increases your overall energy, speed, and strength. It grants, innate survival mechanics, and highly specialised active abilities.

The bone continuously radiates life force, granting you a profound ability to rapidly repair internal injuries and regenerate damaged tissue. It naturally enhances the user's defensive properties, increasing their raw physical durability, muscle density, and resistance to hostile magical elements or toxic curses.

The Supreme Bone grants the owner access to three distinct, abilities. These abilities are:

Hand of God, when activated, this technique summons a massive, projection of a hand made of divine light from the heavens. The hand suppresses the surrounding energy, making it incredibly difficult for opponents to channel spells or deploy protective magical barriers. The hand descends with great mass and pressure, physically crushing the enemy's armor, weapons, and body into dust.

Reincarnation, grants control over the flow of time. You can release a wave of light that can instantly strip away years from anyone’s lifespan or reverse their age, and reduce them to a child. At its peak you can trap enemies within an endless cycle of birth, ageing, sickness, and death.

The third supreme art, when activated this technique acts as an engine that exponentially multiplies the raw power, physical force, speed, and energy of any other technique you are using simultaneously with this ability. At its absolute peak, it allows you to multiply your combat prowess dozens of times over.

You have complete control over these abilities and can activate or deactivate them at will. The bone is entirely free of drawbacks and carries no negative effects on your body, mind, or soul.

Its abilities can operate using any form of energy you possess, including stamina. The more powerful you become the stronger the abilities of the supreme being bones will be. They cause no strain or fatigue, even during prolonged, uninterrupted use.
objects.title: The Supreme Being Bones (Perfect World)

objects.text:
You are skilled in the art of creating Restrictions. While formations and restrictions may appear similar, they differ greatly in scaling, execution, and application. Restrictions are far more free-form, capable of adapting and changing according to the will of their user.

Restrictions can last indefinitely until they are broken, deactivated, or depleted of energy. The most advanced restrictions become self-sustaining, functioning like specialised nets that continuously absorb ambient energy or the energy of anyone who enters their range without further draining the creator.

To create a functional restriction, you use your energy to weave runes into geometric patterns and anchor the structure into space. Runes can be linked together at precise geometric intersections known as nodes. If even a single node is placed incorrectly, the entire restriction may collapse or backfire upon its creator. Their primary source of energy is the creator, drawing directly from whatever form of power they possess, including stamina.

Restrictions can be used offensively or defensively on the fly or to extensively trap an area, They can be created immediately with nothing but knowledge and your energy. A restriction master does not rely on a single restriction, instead, they can overlay multiple types.

Restrictions can also be inscribed onto objects, items, souls, or living bodies. While restrictions spells can be formed instantly from pure energy, permanent restrictions require physical anchors. The rarer and more precious the materials used to forge the anchor, the greater the power of the restriction it can hold.

You possess a basic understanding of all forms of Restriction Arts and how to create basic Restriction Flags. Through time, practice, experimentation, and research, you will be able to develop entirely new restrictions and refine existing ones.
objects.title: Restriction Master

objects.text:
Instead of receiving a personalized Angel, you instead start with the full authority and abilities of the Angels: Sandalphon, Gabriel, Raphael, Haniel, Michael, Camael, Zadkiel, Zafkiel, Rasiel and Metatron. You do not have an instinctual grasp of how to properly use them and will have to practice extensively before they can grow further. They may appear either in their original shape, as the ten swords wielded by Beast, or in a personalized design; you may also fuse their powers together into a singular weapon at any time, or separate them again. Furthermore, your Astral Dress reaches rank SS by fusing with all other dresses of the ten primary Spirits, adding their defense and properties onto your own. From the start, your natural strength, agility, endurance, intelligence and spiritual energy will be roughly equal to half of the ten Spirits' combined values.

Your ability to control spacequakes expands to include all distortions in spacetime, allowing you to regulate the size and intensity of any spacequake, and use them to control the local flow of gravity, space and time, as well as create pocket dimensions, different places, dimensions and universes. With enough study, even true time travel may become possible.

Different from any other Spirit, you do not have an Inverse form, as you embody both the positive and negative of your own existence and always exist as your 'true' self. You can now freely switch your Angels to their Demon King form and back. Each Demon King may now change aspects of their powers much more drastically than before, or offer an entirely new powerset.

If you weren't before, you have now become a true Spirit, a sentient magical construct manifested through your own spiritual energy into the physical world. Your true form is a higher-dimensional soul that functions as an endless generator of spiritual energy and persists even if you die, able to recreate your body with enough time. Only the severity of your death determines when you can return, but even if it takes years, you will one day manifest a new body. Your control and talent in manipulating spiritual power have greatly improved, allowing you to absorb the spiritual energy of others, copy their nature and abilities, and steal spiritual constructs like Angels, while making it impossible to do the same to you.
objects.title: Spirit of Revelation (Date A Live)

addons.text: Nahobino, I welcome you to a Velvet Room enhanced by the heretical power of the World of Shadows. While you retain the ability to create Attendants, Sophia will become the full time master and maintainer of the Velvet Room, allowing you and your Attendant(s) to focus your efforts elsewhere. You will unlock 5 new Miracles to purchase: Soulbound, allowing your demons to revive you should you fall in battle by either rifle through your pockets for reviving items or with (Sama)Recarm; Profound Experiences I - III, allowing all the Personas in your stock to gain experience as if they had the Growth series of passive skills; and Force of the Heart, allowing you to transform demons into Personas, and vice versa. What Arcana or demon race these transformed demons or Personas would have is up to you, so long as they're actual races and Arcana from the franchise. The Itemization service has been upgraded, allowing you to transform any of your demons into their Essences by combining them with a Black Paper Lantern. As always, new Personas also means more Itemization possibilities for armor, weapons, Skill Cards, or accessories pertaining to that specific Persona, with or without the Fusion Alarm sounding. You also are gifted the Ultramarine Talisman, which allow Persona Companions to use their Showtime (P5R/S), Highlight (P5X), Theurgy (P3R), and Series Finale (P4R) attacks as if they were character-specific Magatsuhi Skills.
addons.title: The Velvet Room of Shadows

addons.text: Nahobino, I welcome you to a Akademeia enhanced by the heretical power of the World of Shadows. While you retain the ability to create Attendants, Sophia will become the full time master and maintainer of Akademeia, allowing you and your Attendant(s) to focus your efforts elsewhere. You will unlock 3 new Miracles to purchase: Valourous Heart, allowing your demons to continue the battle even when you’re dead, resuscitating you once the battle's over if need be; Divine Punishment, allowing you to automatically kill weak demons without having to truly battle them; and Heroic Legacy, allowing you to treat your Archetypes as reusable Essences for Essence Fusion. The Essence Fusion service is upgraded, allowing you to not only pass down a demon's skills into the Skill Inheritance table of any Archetype lineage you have currently unlocked, but rewrite one of your Archetype's Affinity charts with a demon's native Affinity Chart. You also are gifted the Royal Talisman, which allow Metaphor Companions to use Synthesis Skill attacks as if they were character-specific Magatsuhi Skills.
addons.title: The Akademeia of Shadows

addons.text: Nahobino, I welcome you to this trifold hybrid, equal parts the World of Shadows, Velvet Room, and Akademeia. As such, you now have all the possible benefits, Talismans, Miracles, and service upgrades that can be provided.
addons.title: The Ultramarine Library of Shadows

objects.text:
Nahobino, you have gained access to the World of Shadows, a heretical sub dimension ruled by Sophia in lieu of Mido from previous SMT games.

Demon Fusion is made much easier for you with the addition of Reverse Compendium Fusion, allowing you to fuse demons from a combination of your stock and your newly acquired Demon Compendium, a grimoire that records the demons you have befriended or fused. Additionally, one can see Special Fusion recipes and which demons one needs to fuse for them.

While here, you can manage the Miracles you have accrued as well as purchase new ones you hadn't been aware were possible. Do note certain Miracles cannot be bought until you partake in adequate trials, though you can be guided into how to unlock the ability to purchase these hidden Miracles.

Managing your Demon Essences is also easier, allowing you to stockpile Essences, and now you can infuse your demons with Essences. Unlike you, who can take in a demon’s affinities and/or skills, demons can only take skills out of Essences.
objects.title: Welcome to the World of Shadows, Where Demons Gather (Shin Megami Tensei V)

addons.text:
Your soul no longer merely attracts the restless dead. It reshapes them.

Spirits drawn to you gradually lose the malice and corruption that bind them, becoming calmer and more lucid the longer they remain in your presence. Particularly ancient or hateful spirits may take months or years to change, while weaker ones may recover in days.

Once a spirit has been fully restored, it permanently gains its own version of Soul Anchor, the strength of which is determined by the power of its own soul. Particularly powerful spirits may even develop a stronger blessing than your own. At any point, a restored spirit may choose to peacefully pass on. Should it remain in the world, it can gradually spread its own version of Soul Anchor to other spirits and, eventually, the living through prolonged contact.

As your own soul grows stronger, the purification process accelerates, and the maximum strength of spirit you can restore increases accordingly.
addons.title: Beacon of Repose

objects.text:
Your soul has become a stabilizing force capable of strengthening others.

Those who remain in your presence for an extended period gradually develop a stronger connection between body and soul, gaining lasting resistance to possession, soul theft, forced reincarnation, soul damage, and similar forms of spiritual interference. With sufficient exposure, this protection becomes permanent.

Those who receive this passive blessing may, over prolonged periods of contact, gradually pass on a weaker version to others. The blessing diminishes with each generation and requires progressively longer periods of exposure to its current bearer before it can take root. It cannot compound, meaning no one inherits a stronger protection than the one you originally held.

The strength of your own soul determines both the potency of the blessing you grant and how many generations it can naturally spread before fading away.
objects.title: Soul Anchor

objects.text:
You have acquired the Nine Profound Exquisite Body. Within your body now exists a miniature world known as the Exquisite World. This allows you to store and unleash levels of energy far beyond what your physical body would normally be capable of.

Its existence can be concealed or revealed at will, remaining silent and leaving behind no traces of law aura or dimensional residue. The Exquisite World is divided into nine layers, each representing a deeper grade of mystery. As your power grows, you will gradually unlock the deeper layers of this inner world.

Because of this inner world, you can master any form of power without being restricted by your current energy level or the structural limitations of your physical body. You can also wield bloodline-specific, conflicting, or forbidden arts and energies simultaneously without suffering backlash, energy rejection, or any physical, mental, or spiritual drawbacks.

Unlike the original Nine Profound Exquisite Body, this version can be possessed by both men and women. Furthermore, no portion of its power can be transferred to another person through the exchange of Vital Yin or Yang.
objects.title: The Nine Profound Exquisite Body (Against The Gods)

objects.text:
Your potential has ascended past the mortal zenith of the Sword Saint to the divine realm of the Sword God. The gulf between a Sword God and a Saint is greater than the distance between a Saint and an infant.

You begin your journey already possessing supernatural mastery of the blade. Yet this is merely the baseline. Your capacity for growth is so vast that only a deity holding dominion over the blade could hope to match your potential.

A single glance at any sword technique reveals its core principles; a day of study grants you complete mastery. When learning from others or by observation, even the most impossible, esoteric, or conceptual applications will completely yield to your talent within a few months. Furthermore, your talent allows you to refine what you learn far beyond its original limits, transforming techniques so thoroughly that their original creators would no longer recognize or understand how to execute them.

Your body, soul and mind are uniquely suited to learning the blade. No sword technique will be able to corrupt or harm you nor will you be affected by negative side effects. You can also learn or create any sword technique you desire even if you lack the required inborn traits or unique requirements. Moreover, each time you draw your blade, your mastery expands and evolves. The mere act of combat and practice fuels your progression, allowing you to bypass the impossible.

You can also just as easily create your own sword techniques. Within a month of focused solo practice, you can take the first steps down the path to sever the intangible, striking down metaphysical concepts and cleaving through space, time or destiny itself. However, conceptual techniques of such nature might have equivalent backlash. While this power grants divine talent and skill, it does nothing to protect against such strain, which may cause harm or even death. Having a supernatural body can help prevent this.
objects.title: Nascent Sword God

objects.text:
Like all true dragons—and unique cases such as Ephyr—you possess a dragon core. This supernatural organ allows you to absorb the remaining life force of enemies you have slain and use it to permanently increase your own power.

This absorption is not automatic. After defeating an enemy, you must consciously draw their remaining life force into your dragon core before it dissipates. The stolen life force does not immediately become part of your strength. It must first be digested, refined, and assimilated by converting it into Prana, Mana, Aura, Force, or another form of supernatural energy you possess.

Your dragon core can store only a limited amount of unrefined life force. Once it reaches maximum capacity, you must process some of its contents before absorbing more. This capacity increases as you grow stronger and is further expanded by abilities that increase the amount of supernatural energy your body can contain.

The amount of power gained depends on the strength and remaining vitality of the defeated enemy. Weak opponents may provide only a negligible benefit, while exceptionally powerful beings can supply enormous amounts of energy. However, a greater amount of life force takes longer to digest and requires greater control to assimilate safely.

As your mastery of the dragon core grows, its capabilities will expand beyond consuming the life force of slain enemies. You may eventually learn to absorb nearly any form of energy, including incoming supernatural attacks. Absorbed energy can either be refined immediately into your own power or stored within the dragon core for later use.

You may also reverse this process, releasing the energy contained within your dragon core as a devastating blast. By expending enough energy, you can produce attacks far beyond your normal maximum output.

Unrefined or stored energy can be discharged without permanently weakening you. However, releasing energy that has already been fully assimilated into your power will temporarily reduce your overall strength, effectively causing you to lose levels in exchange for a much more powerful attack. These lost levels can be restored by absorbing and assimilating an equivalent amount of life force or energy.

At the highest levels of mastery, you may fight in a manner similar to Atisse after unlocking his full potential: absorbing incoming attacks to rapidly increase your level, then releasing that accumulated power back at the enemy with even greater force. Doing so returns you toward your normal baseline, allowing your level to rise and fall dynamically as you absorb and discharge energy throughout a battle.
objects.title: Dragon Core (Latna Saga)
Beyond Good and Evil
objects.text: At a simple glance, it’s said that a purely radiant soul, one full of warmth and resplendence, cannot coexist with a soul marred and mucked with corruption and sin. It’s impossible! Unconscionable to almost all beings with a soul as proof of their existence. Your very spiritual being challenges that notion. At first, this contradiction will tear you apart, mentally and spiritually. There’s a war in your spirit you can’t reconcile until you tackle the reason, so you do: the first ability you have is looking deep at your soul and seeing the “sides” of your spirit, one gleaming with innocence, one shimmering with an aura of deep-rotten sin. You experience the very struggle man faces day-to-day, just on a grand scale. Initially, these “sides” clash with one another while learning to understand one another, recognizing that, while they are far from the same, they are motivated and shaped by a single guiding factor within humanity: the collision between life and existence. The need to share the last crumb of bread with your fellow neighbor can be fueled by a genuine generosity, and the selfish expectation of paying it forward in the future. A series of ruthless manipulation and mass gaslighting of an entire country can be motivated by a pathological need for control and the wish to protect one’s people. These, among many other examples, cross your mind the more the “sides” of your soul slowly merge, giving a larger view of the world at large with the growing merger. At the pace with your life and accelerated by facing challenges of any kind that leave an impression on your soul, it’ll slowly coalesce into fully realized, with the final spark being the inevitable realization about your soul and what it personified: Good and Evil are part of a Greater Cycle, part of a Greater Structure; you aren’t one or the other, you merely Are. This epiphany will reinvent following this: the sacred and corrupt will acknowledge you as something more, one who left it all behind and became unfettered from morality while retaining their splendor, seeing you as Other, but an Other to be admired; every action—no matter how black or white it may be—will empower you, as every choice, even those you influenced, reinforce that you clearly made those choices, outgrown or bereft of any banal drive, good or ill; your connection with the dark, the cursed, the blessed, and the divine are inexplicably amplified by your Soul’s particular shape, being beyond such constructs; finally, this Soul will protect you from both divine punishments and demonic curses by its sheer strength of what it embodies, etc. You are beyond Good and evil; walk the path you set out for yourself.

addons.title: Worldly Soul
addons.text: You secure a reason for your existence as you succeed in reaching the peak of Sacred Transcendence and Black Sacrament, to become “where all things blessed and damned meet” in the World: every act, every choice you do is not merely revered, but viscerally etched into the mind and soul of anyone, no matter the shape and size, while leaving a solemn and unavoidable understanding they cannot resist, they cannot help but be grateful. They won’t sign praises or prostrate themselves at your presence, but they’ll be indebted to you, for a mark of your Soul is permanently embedded, their fate inalterably changed, leading to the same road as you did. Outside influences, daring to corrupt or purify, will pass through you; your words hold a weight that’ll be irresistible to pay attention to, their efforts backfiring, leading to the same outcome as above. Spirits, supernatural forces, and creatures, both of light and dark, will covet your favor and offer their powers, both sources resonating with your elevated nature in strength and connection. What’s more, forces and beings that tread the line or escape life’s dichotomy or the world’s framework, gods or cosmic beings alike, will view you as a kindred spirit. Lastly, when every reason you act is beyond the confines of morality, being strengthened by sin in body and spirit pivots to a boost for every action that reflects your nature.

addons.title: Angulimala’s Second Coming
addons.text:
The Sutra’s teachings and your being made of (and from) Sin harmonize well with your elevated soul, adding another layer to your spiritual existence.
