With your Soul already redefined by the eclipsing sin and virtue, your theoretical existence as profane is tempered and hammered into something new by how you mastered the Lotus Sutra and your “ideal” Soul, unshackling its capabilities.

From this, your presence and existence find strength in the World’s activities, both well- and ill-intentioned, a nourishing delicacy and a potential expression of power when done repeatedly (either by your hand and through others), which unlocks a fitting power, exhibiting its light and darkness under a cohesive ability that improves in potency and versatility the more this activity’s practice, similar to before.

Letting the Sutra’s wisdom pass through you, these teachings are unconsciously given—not a critique, but a reevaluation—offering a greater appreciation of Buddhist teachings, especially in Angulimala’s, partly redeeming the profane rituals that made up your body. 

While losing your demonic form from surpassing your existence as an inhuman entity, it’s turned around to reveal your unearthly Soul at will, fully or partially manifesting your splendor. 

From the get-go, your presence holds an odd sense of serenity grounded in arcane understanding that shares your temperament with others; those who are conflicted are particularly susceptible to your influence.

Heavenly and demonic spirits are enthralled by your presence, admiring at a distance unless you personally look after these beings, aside from being untouched or unaffected by these opposing forces; your body stopped being a vessel, but a temple yet again, protecting your Soul from asserting its full splendor.

addons.title: Karmic Singularity
addons.text: The nature of your Soul and surrounding deeds unbound of conventional morality has liberated you from the scales of Karma; instead, through the sheer Karma you’ve accrued by your revelation, it is bound to you. Your Karma acts as a planetary object with a gravitational pull, attracting more Karma, no matter how positive or negative it is; all are welcome. Thereby, effortlessly wielding holy magic would be no different than seamlessly using demonic magic, being the solace for righteous or sinful men holds the same weight to your Karma, helping to spread your revelation to anyone, and utilizing both benevolent and malevolent powers into something ambivalent yet greater, retaining their essence while seamlessly blending to the best of both worlds. Even your Karma brings a strange sort of fortune, as the world nudges itself toward a larger purpose. Occurrences that appear disastrous often hide a greater prosperity, and a fortuitous encounter can mask a surmountable challenge. While it may seem ill-fated at first glance, it’ll push your Soul and Karma to greater heights, enhancing the benefits of the add-on.

objects.title: Subtle Body
objects.text:
As a confluence of your supernatural energies within your body and your highly malleable spirit, it consolidated into controlling your existence’s metaphysical layers that act as a bridge between your body and soul, the subtle body.

The subtle body can be regarded as the catch-all term for all the supernatural structures or energies that work in tandem with your self’s physicality and mentality, the part where the soul, aura, Chakras, Dantians, Magic Circuits, Nen nodes, and what have you are involved, completing the map that is your being.

The growing mastery of your abilities made you realize how one’s existence relates to everything through one’s metaphysical layers; your subtle body functions as the threshold between Being and Reality, illustrating how one influences the other, heightening your awareness of your spiritual and/or esoteric facets and how they buffer your body and mind. Knowing your soul’s boundaries, your Chakra Points and Dantians, and intuitively understanding what they represent viscerally accelerates one’s self-mastery. 

To set a few examples, channeling spiritual or esoteric organs is now a seamless affair, feeling less like a “muscle” and more an intrinsic part of yourself with no need for rituals to activate your Magic Circuits (in turn, fully taking advantage of its full potential, greatly improving the efficiency and efficacy of your Circuits), you can conciliate every life-force power system you may have into a distilled life energy greater than the sum of its parts by slowly shaping your subtle body’s shape and culminating into a comprehensive framework capable of so much more depending of the systems you grasp or attained, helps with recoil or backlash from casting spells or techniques beyond your capability by your adaptable soul that incrementally strengthens your subtle body under duress or constant practice, makes it possible to willingly connect to ley lines, spiritual or existential planes by entangling yourself through your subtle body, and among many examples on what’s achievable with controlling one’s subtle body. 

Finally, managing your subtle body will offer fine control of one’s internal energies should, as a result of higher effectiveness and responsiveness of your self’s metaphysical aspects, additionally grant a growing mastery of the mind and body, as being aware of one’s immaterial aspects will develop into control of the material that improves subtle body’s abilities as a sort of feedback loop, i.e. with Cursed Energy within your purview will lead up to increasingly be aware, therefore control, one’s sections of the brain responsible for CE control, and so on.

But for all that, due to your subtle body’s supernatural nature, it won’t be relatively compatible with explicitly material power sources, like cybernetic implants or supernatural forces that are grounded in physical reality, unless you endeavor to reconcile this by naturalizing these sources and forces into your Self and being largely accepted by your subtle body.

addons.title: Etheric Body
addons.text: Harnessing your aura in several ways opened the path to controlling another layer of your subtle body, the Etheric body. Willingly harnessing one’s Aura through the entirety of your subtle body balloons your Aura’s potency and versatility, manifesting as a massive visage overlapping your physical form that represents the true extent of your soul made from your Aura. With Aura (RWBY), if you could withstand a small caliber barrage now you’ll take a brunt of high-yield missiles, if recovered from exhaustion and serious wounds at a accelerated rate now you’ll be an almost unyielding Huntsman with an endurance and healing told in legends, and where your Semblance could deal with a group of Grimm your soul’s truest expression reaches a height Salem will be wary of. With Aura Guardian (Pokémon) is your Soul and Aura already met in an unified whole, instead of improving the efficiency in your usage, continues your improvements at a massive scale, expanding your reserves caused by the energy surplus, breaking your Aura’s limits in their existent capabilities to the point of emulating other power systems, and becoming effectively immortal from all these factors nourishing your physical body. With Aura², your previous capabilities meet, your visage taking an active part of your growth, able to trounce creatures like the Grimm Wyvern or Legendary Pokémon by sheer spiritual power.

addons.title: Astral Body
addons.text:
The Form of your Soul can be seen as your subtle body fully manifested, and your subtle body is the boundary between oneself and the larger world; your Soul will reflect that truth.

Your Form of Soul will fully be aware and control how it relates to the World in several levels: tapping into your mind will let the stream of the Collective Unconscious or Astral Plane flow through you, reading the minds and psyches of everyone around you; tapping into your nature as a spirit will link you to spiritual planes, interact or manipulate the stray souls or spiritual energies from it; tapping into your magic will fully meld you into surrounding leylines and magical planes where drawing on their power is the least you’re capable of.

objects.title: Swordforce (Desolate Era)
objects.text:
By taking this power, you have achieved Silver Moon, the first stage of Swordforce, a unique energy manifestation that reflects a person's conceptual mastery and insight into the ultimate essence of the sword. By reaching this stage, you have also already mastered the two foundational realms that precede Swordforce.

The first is One with the Sword, where the swordsman and the weapon move as extensions of one another. It removes all delay between mental intent and physical execution, allowing the user to feel the air, wind, and enemy movements through the tip of their blade as clearly as if they were touching them with their fingertips.

The second is One with the World, where the user harmonizes with the natural energy of their surroundings. They become capable of reading the air currents caused by an enemy's attacks, allowing them to dodge or parry with minimal effort.

To advance in Swordforce, one must attain a higher understanding of the essence of the sword. Swordforce progresses through six distinct stages. These stages are:

Silver Moon, a layer of silvery-white light wraps around the weapon.

Dazzling Sun, the second stage of Swordforce, at this stage, a layer of white-gold light will appear atop the sword.

Imperial Ruler, at this stage, your sword intent strengthens further, granting you an oppressive, dominating aura in combat. Imperial Ruler forces external worldly energy to obey your command.

Sword Heart, the fourth stage of Swordforce, at this stage, the sword light is colored black. Swordforce gains sentience and life at this stage, albeit at a very low level.

Sword God, the fifth stage of Swordforce, at this stage, one doesn’t even have to attack; the invisible sword-intent radiating out from the user will be more than enough to force enemies to feel utter despair. At this level, the user can emit rainbow-colored sword light.

Sword World, the sixth stage of Swordforce, also known as "World of the Sword". Its level of mastery is the same as the Heavenly Dao of Primordial Chaos. This stage can be used as a base to advance to World God and Chaos Immortal levels.

Each successive stage of Swordforce is more difficult to master than the one before it, and attaining the higher stages with this power alone will be extremely difficult. One does not ascend through the stages of Swordforce through the accumulation of energy, but through meditation, mastery of diverse sword arts, moments of enlightenment forged in battle, and an ever-deepening comprehension of the sword.

objects.title: The Brightmoon Sword Art (Desolate Era)
objects.text:
You have acquired Ji Ning's signature, self-created technique, the Brightmoon Sword Art, designed to embody the ultimate essence of his Sword Dao. Fully mastering this art would allow you to gain comprehension of Ji Ning's Eternal Omega Sword Dao.

The deeper your understanding of the underlying Daos that comprise the Brightmoon Sword Art, as well as the essence of the sword itself, the more powerful its techniques will become. Fully mastering the Brightmoon Sword Art will be extremely difficult through this power alone.

The five stances that make up this sword art are as fallows:

The Soleheart Stance, represents the most profound insights of defensive sword arts. When the sword strikes, it is as though a black hole has formed, absorbing and trapping the enemy's attacks. At its peak, you can form a single black hole with yourself at its center, allowing the Soleheart Stance to truly evolve into a Supreme Dao of Defense. Its purpose is to absorb and ablate the power of incoming attacks.

The Blood Drop Stance is the fastest, most savage, and most penetrating of the five sword stances. A piercing thrust, that will transform into a Supreme Dao with a drill-like effect capable of completely penetrating space and time.

The Heavenbreaker Stance, a fast sword stance that also contains tremendous force. By channeling your energy into your sword, you increase its mass and power, allowing you to unleash a devastating strike capable of completely annihilating both your surroundings and your enemies. To unleash the full, terrifying power contained within the stance, the user must first accumulate force before releasing it in a single explosive burst. Equally important is the moment of release—it must be swift, fierce, and compressed into a short instant.

The Yin-Yang Stance, a defensive sword stance designed for situations where one faces multiple enemies. This stance can evolve into the Yin-Yang Sword Domain, allowing you to manifest a domain formed from multiple sources, including sword light, lightning, water, Heartworlds, and various other Daos, elements, or techniques.

The Shadowless Stance, the strangest of the five stances, as well as the second fastest. The essence of Shadowless lies in becoming one with all things. When windy, it can transform in to a gust of wind. When it is bright, it can transform into a streak of light. When it is in space, it can transform into a spatial ripple. Every single part of a universe, no matter where, is subject to the influence and power of the prime essences of that universe. If one's sword can fully merge with those forces, it will naturally become truly shadowless and invisible.

The Brightmoon Sword Art can be fueled by any form of energy you possess or acquire, including stamina. Although the original art required an extraordinarily high level of cultivation to learn and wield, this modified version has been adapted so that it can be practiced and used by anyone, regardless of their level of power, without causing any drawbacks to the body, mind, or soul.

objects.title: Supreme Magus (The Power Fantasy)
objects.text:
Your base personal magical reserve grants you the same level of power on your own as Jacky Magus with 250,000 disciples. Anything he could accomplish during the Second Summer of Love with the Pyramid at its strongest, you can accomplish entirely on your own, without any disciples. The Pyramid's collective reserve of magical power is equal to your own. Even without a single cultist under your command, you qualify as a Superpower.

For you, the equivalent of Magus burning a fraction of his disciples to fuel a ritual is burning the same fraction of your own magical reserve. This reserve constantly replenishes itself and, if completely depleted, will fully recover in about a month. Note that you can still increase your power further by teaching and recruiting disciples. Your minimum individual power level will simply be equal to that of Jacky Magus and the Pyramid at the height of their power.

objects.title: Numinous Genius (The Power Fantasy)
objects.text:
Your theoretical knowledge of magic is immense, allowing you to accomplish almost anything you can imagine. Almost.

Your miracles are rooted in White Magic, but some effects can normally be achieved only through Dark Magic. That is, Hell. For any other magician, acquiring such abilities would require selling their soul and condemning themselves to eternal torment of infinite magnitude after death, like Eliza Hellbound.

With this upgrade, however, you're something of a genius at gaming the magical system at your disposal, even more so than Jacky Magus. You now possess the theoretical knowledge needed to reproduce effects that would normally require hellish magic, but through safe, purely Numinous means, without selling your soul or compromising yourself in any way. This includes, but is not limited to, various forms of teleportation (of yourself, other people, or even entire landscapes) and spatial warping, dimensional gates opening, traveling back in time, generating energies that can corrode most Numinous defenses, etc.

objects.title: Additional Elements
objects.text:
You may choose an additional element for Elementalism, gaining the same complete control, mastery, and conceptual connection to it as your original choice. This may be purchased multiple times, granting another element with each purchase.

In addition, the conceptual distance between your chosen elements becomes substantially easier to bridge. 

Their concepts may expand toward one another much more readily, with greater overlap between them making this process easier still, allowing related or intermediary concepts to naturally fall within the growing scope of your Elementalism.

objects.title: Sui (Arknights)
objects.text:
No more are you merely a fragment of a great beast whose head once cleaved the clouds and whose size shattered the mountains. No, you are that beast, or at the very least it's first equal. Your true form is now that of a chinese dragon so large it could be mistaken for a mountain, though not a mountain range unlike some of the other feranmuts. But that is not where your strength lies, for that would be to forget you are divine.

You are a god, a feranmut capable of outright warping reality. The emanation of your power is capable of creating beings such as geists, objects such as knives or scripts turned into living, thinking beings by your will. But your true power is not limited in such way. It does not take you much of any effort to observe not just the planet you are on, but also the universe around you, enabling you to understand all that you see. You also bear every power that one of your fragments could base itself around at a much more powerful level, a painting that a fragment would use to create another reality would, via your hands, be able to outright redraw reality in an area. You also bear all power naturally already belonging to a feranmut at a much greater scale than any other could claim, excluding where their domains are. But it must be stated, that even with your immense power capable of leveling cities and annihilating mountains, your most powerful trait is just how hard it is to kill you in any way that actually matters. If you were to be slain, your corpse would not actually die. Rather, some of you would shatter into 12 proxies, 12 fragments of Sui. And even with your shattering, if your corpse was not drained of it's remnant might each year, you would simply revive.

You may opt whether taking this removes the fragments of sui from history, or whether they are not absorbed.

objects.title: Bootstrap Paradox
objects.text:
The “you” connected to your Black Book has taken the place of your Divine Patron, or at least that is how it appears at first glance. In truth they are your direct future self, reaching backward through time to guide you toward Apotheosis, to become the God they already are, not that you know this of course.

For the time being, your future self masquerades as your Patron, providing guidance, knowledge, and limited divine intervention. While you can bargain with them, and in moments of genuine crisis they can choose to lend you their own power, they prefer to let you develop under your own power. After all, their goal is not to simply hand you the power of a God, but to ensure that the God they are comes to be.

Therefore, the powers and miracles granted by your Patron are not truly coming from your future self. Rather, the seed of Divinity has already been planted with you, and when you pray for a miracle, you are unknowingly drawing upon that burgeoning power. Your future self merely helps you access and develop it, front-ending and obfuscating the process while your growing faith and following further nurture the Divinity that will eventually become them.

The paradox at play also strengthens your path to Divinity. The presence of your future self guarantees that you will eventually achieve Apotheosis, therefore fate naturally bends towards paths where you successfully progress towards Godhood and potential bottlenecks fail to take root.

And finally, the day will eventually come when your journey is complete, when your future self raises the curtains and reveals that the God whose faith you spread was you all along as you and your divine self become whole.

objects.title: Deicide (Campione!)
objects.text:
It seems as if you have slain yet another Heretic God, proving once again that you are worthy of being a Campione; through the death of the Heretic God(s), you have acquired another [Authority].

You may choose which Heretic God(s) you slew and which [Authority] you have acquired. This [Authority] can be any canon [Authority], or even an [Authority] not mentioned within the confines of the 'Campione!' novel.

You may also have the [Authority] you have acquired be the same expression of the [Authority] the Campione got in the novels, or have the version of the [Authority] altered to be compatible with your personality. 

With each purchase, you gain an additional [Authority].

objects.title: Pure Resurrection
objects.text:
Your resurrections no longer require a vessel.

When summoned, the deceased can manifest directly in a body created by your power. 

This applies to both impure and true resurrection, removing the need to transmute or sacrifice living matter.

You now possess a heavily exaggerated version of the Striker/Shaker effects all Shard Tinkers have. You are capable of modifying reality to make super tech with common materials. This includes the ability to cut glass with your fingernails, lead to a 95% yield in chemical solutions, using copper as a room temperature superconductor, making plastic from potatoes, and slotting modern components by hand into a board.

As a bonus, you can enter a fugue-like state for faster build speed and a deeper reality modification, leading to more throughput with the common materials, like making a 3-D printer extrude carbon nano-tubes.
objects.title: The Tinker Toolbox

addons.text:
You progress through the tech trees three times as quickly, but that’s not the important part.

What is important is that you gain Cave Johnson's ability to create something impossible out of something completely, incredibly different. You’ll be able to use the resulting piece of technology as an entry point to a new tech tree, several new tech trees if you’re lucky. This ability is heavily reliant on your resources, how difficult a problem the “completely, incredibly different” thing is, and pays out only in the long term, but it's worth it. 

I won’t explain the whole story, but the short of it is: In the 1940's the curtain company Aperture Fixtures tried to solve a problem that our Earth scientific community still has no definite answer for: the shower curtain effect. Half a century later, they ended up with the portal gun, which functions by harnessing and stabilizing a black hole in a device half the size of someone's arm. Ignoring the potential for free energy with careful use of portals, they built the black hole equivalent of a Dyson sphere and used it to create tunnels in the fabric of reality. Why? Because fifty years ago, they wanted to make a really useful shower curtain. 

It's never clear when the inspiration is going to hit, but it will happen once in a blue moon. On the upside, you won’t have to spend decades on R&D, given your prodigious Tinker powers and engineering prowess.
addons.title: They're Gonna Have To Invent A New Type of Nobel Prize to Give Us. (Portal)

objects.text:
An engineer has no bounds. Except for the bounds of knowledge, time, resources, physics… An engineer has a few bounds. BUT! Lacking what to build will never be a problem for you! As you build new tech, be it from the Space Engineers tech tree or others you possess, your knowledge of said trees will grow, either horizontally with tech with different functions, or vertically by improved versions.

Just like a tree, however, it must be nourished and cared for. Your tree will only expand by building new things, and only grow when you reach your limits. So you wouldn't know how to build a more advanced Jumpdrive before building a simple one first, and neither gain knowledge by building the same thing over and over again.
objects.title: Progression Tree

objects.text:
Constructing a device no longer automatically advances your tech tree — using it does. 

Progress scales with how much a field test genuinely challenges the tech: routine use under expected conditions yields only marginal gains, while varied or extreme conditions (such as combat) lead to major leaps.
objects.title: Field Testing Required

objects.text: Creating advanced technology in ancient times is an almost impossible feat—not because the knowledge is lacking, but because high-tech machinery usually requires an entire infrastructure of equally advanced tools to manufacture, refine, and assemble it. After all, you can’t build a spaceship using nothing but a hammer and an anvil. Except you can. Any technological powers you possess now come with a unique advantage: all blueprints, materials, and construction methods will be as cheap and low-tech as possible while still maintaining full functionality. Advanced spacecraft can be assembled with nothing more than a forge, a hammer, and a lot of elbow grease—though it might take a while due to sheer scale. Plasma weapons won’t melt themselves despite being made from budget steel, and high-end electronics can be cobbled together from the simplest of components. With this upgrade, you have a knack for bypassing technological bottlenecks, making cutting-edge inventions feasible with nothing but the most rudimentary tools and materials. Whether in a medieval setting or a post-apocalyptic wasteland, you can build wonders from scraps. Do be wary, since this is a change to the blueprints and crafting method that means anyone can make use of this cheaper and easier to build tech.
objects.title: Cheapskate

addons.text:
The protections around your creations no longer merely prevent reverse-engineering. Instead, they exploit a deeper limitation shared by all systems of knowledge.

Any sufficiently complex creation, technology, process, power expression, or body of information produced by you becomes fundamentally incomplete from the perspective of those attempting to understand it. No matter how intelligent, powerful, advanced, or transcendent the observer may be, any model they construct remains only a partial description of the whole.

Each apparent explanation inevitably relies upon assumptions that can only be justified from outside the framework used to derive them. Yet any larger framework capable of explaining those assumptions is itself incomplete and requires an even broader perspective. This process continues indefinitely.

As a result, understanding your work becomes an endless sequence of increasingly accurate approximations without ever reaching a final or complete answer. Additional dimensions, superior computation, precognition, omniscient observation, conceptual analysis, shard-assisted modeling, or other forms of information gathering merely reveal further layers rather than resolving the whole.

Observers may learn how to use your creations, replicate isolated functions, or understand limited aspects of their operation. What they cannot obtain is a complete description of why the system works, how every component relates to every other component, or the total set of principles governing it.

To any observer, there is always another box outside the box they are currently examining.

And no matter how far outward they look, they never reach the last one.
addons.title: Gödel Theorem

objects.text:
You have a very minor, passive reality-warping ability that can completely black-box any technology you create should you so desire. It can range from somehow unbreakable encryption to shunting some parts in pocket dimensions and so on.

You don't control how this black boxing will manifest, unless you have other powers for it, but it will never interfere with the object's design or intended function, merely preventing all other parties from reverse-engineering it. You are the sole exception to this black-boxing effect.
objects.title: Black Box

objects.text:
You gain exceptional skill in using items that you’ve helped create. Your effectiveness increases based on how much of a role you played in the item’s development. If you were involved in part of the process—such as assembly, tuning, or modification—you gain a noticeable edge in using the item. However, if the item was entirely made by you, from concept to construction to materials, you can use it with full efficiency, as if you had years of training specifically for it.

For example, if you forge a sword yourself—including designing the blade, choosing the metal, and doing the forging—you can wield it as if you were a trained swordsman, even if you lack formal swordsmanship experience. If you build a drone, you can fly it as if you were a seasoned pilot. If you construct a firearm, you can handle it with the precision and control of an expert marksman.

The effect does not grant general skill or transferable expertise. If you craft a sword and become proficient with it, that skill does not apply to other swords you didn’t make. You are not gaining knowledge of swordsmanship; you are gaining a deep, instinctive control over the item itself because you made it. Pick up another sword made by someone else, and you lose that mastery entirely.
objects.title: The Maker Knows Best

objects.text: Some say luck is merely a myth, that there isn't truly randomness in life. But, indeed, there is. And now, you have a way to knock lady luck on her ass with one scientific uppercut. And this is all due to your mastery of the Probability Theory. The Probability Theory is the scientific notion that luck can indeed be calculated and accounted for. You have the ability to make it so this theory always works in your favor when designing machinery or general inventions that require luck. Making Mind Awakening pills in Naruto that have a 90% death rate? Now you can change that so people will always get that 10% unless you want the person dead. Got a weapon slot machine that shoots out random guns? Well, work your magic, and now you can make it so it always gives the result you want. However, an important thing to remember is that this is useless on technology that has no luck elements. If the device or tool works one way, the Probability Theory has no hold on this object.
objects.title: Probability Theory

objects.text:
All technology becomes less reliable over time: gears grind down, wear and tear accumulate, and dust settles. But this is no longer a problem for you, as anything you create can now last nearly indefinitely without any need for maintenance. Whether the devices you made are constantly in use or lie abandoned underwater, they will still be as good as new even after millions of years.

Significant outside influence in a short period of time is required to cause lasting damage to the devices you made; otherwise, smaller damage never takes hold. Scratches do not form, water never erodes, rust never appears, and countless other small matters resolve themselves without your intervention.
objects.title: Built to Last

objects.text:
You don’t get the schematics. You don’t get the data archives, the alien databases, or the neatly labeled blueprints. Instead, you get the mind that could have made them.

The knowledge you receive from your technology-based powers is now intuitive rather than explicit. You understand the principles and concepts behind what you’re creating, but not the precise formulas or step-by-step instructions. You can look at a pile of parts and feel how they should fit together, or stare at a problem until inspiration strikes like lightning but you can’t simply sit down and replicate a Necron Gauss Flayer or an Atlas mech by rote memory.

You’ll need to experiment, prototype, and reverse-engineer your way forward. Progress will come faster than any normal scientist or engineer could ever hope for, but it will still take time, resources, and a fair share of trial and error. You’re a genius inventor, not a walking library of lost technology.
objects.title: Intuition, Not Blueprints

addons.text:
The construction and creation process now requires not only less time, but also fewer materials (or lower quality requirements).

In any case, this will inevitably lead to a 50% reduction in the original quality, as well as the need to use at least a small amount of materials.

You can use this effect at your discretion.
addons.title: Hold my Beer

objects.text:
You have been blessed with the power to accelerate your building process. Any technology power, Tinker ability, or even mundane building process has been accelerated.

If a project were to take you a whole year, it would be divided by 2 rounded down to 182 days. A month would, on average, be turned into 15 days, and so on. And this is divided further for each purchase.

This does not make the process take any less materials, it simply ensures via an unexplainable reality variable that you will finish building your device even faster!
objects.title: Accelerated Assemblage

addons.text:
When applying both approaches, the durability of your products will not be reduced. However... “Quality” is not included in the deal.

You are still free to apply The Business Approach of Elkoss Combine at your own discretion.
addons.title: Quickly. Cheaply. Functionally.

objects.text:
Now you have mastered a production approach similar to that used at Elkoss Combine. Between “cheap,” “fast,” and “high quality,” you are giving up “high quality” and focusing on cheapness and speed of production.

In other words, you are willing to sacrifice 50% of quality or service life in order to double production speed and cut costs in half.

Your products will remain functional, although their service life will be significantly reduced.

This approach does not force you to create exclusively low-quality products. You can apply it as needed.
objects.title: The Business Approach of Elkoss Combine

objects.text:
You possess absolute control over anything you create. You are able to teleport it to your position at will and manipulate it with your mind, both telekinetically controlling the position and speed of all of its parts and telepathically interfacing with it to use its functions with total precision.

In a fight you could summon hundreds of weapons built with your tech and attack with all of them at once, or summon a power plant and draw the energy it produces out into a laser to blast foes, or remotely pilot and overclock a vehicle to ram it into enemy lines at velocities well above its top speed.

You are always aware of the location and condition of anything you make. You do not need to be the one to build the device, as long as it uses your tech it’s yours to do anything you like with.
objects.title: Creator Privileges

addons.title: Biosphere Backup
addons.text:
Now your Genetic Database also includes the Biospheres that any of the civilizations your tech powers came from lived in, studied or were aware of.

Additional Biospheres can be added to this either by scanning at least 1% of the species within them, acquiring at least 1% of the surviving genetic data from them or by learning a sufficient amount of either the scientific, technological, cultural, artistic or historical knowledge of the civilizations that created, destroyed or studied them.

objects.text:
With this upgrade, every tech power selected now also provides the cultural, artistic and historical equivalent to the scientific and technological knowledge included.

With this knowledge you will be able to reconstruct the societies that contributed to your powers.
objects.title: Cultural Expansion

addons.text:
If you are not content with simply being the source of technological revolution, you can now monopolise almost any technological breakthrough. Should you wish to keep some process a secret, it will take a truly monumental efforts for other parties to reproduce it, and even then the results would most likely be of far lower quality than what you can provide.

With this, you can make entire societies completely dependent on the technology only you can provide.
addons.title: Monopolised Progress

objects.text:
You possess an unparalleled talent in proliferating any and all technical knowledge you possess across the world and naturally integrating it with society’s existing technological infrastructure.

Even should you travel to a Stone Age society—were you to have the necessary knowledge—it would take at most a couple of decades to raise it to the technological level roughly equal to that of the end of twentieth-century humanity. With technological progress snowballing exponentially, it might take only a few years to go from this point to an interstellar society.

In addition, you possess the ability to seamlessly integrate your supernatural powers into the society’s technological base, allowing you to make use of materials and effects otherwise inaccessible without anyone even suspecting you possess any abilities at all.
objects.title: Uplifting

objects.text:
You have an incredible knack for developing technology based on your own supernatural powers, whether to replicate a feat you are capable of, to support your powers, or even to negate similar ones.

If you possess some form of immortality, for example, you would be able to create an immortality-granting serum. If you have psionic powers, you will be able to create technology that interfaces with psychic abilities, psionic amplifiers and dampeners.

With enough research and effort, you will even be capable of such feats as modifying your own supernatural abilities, granting others similar powers through the internet, or building the devices for mass awakening of powers.
objects.title: Self-Referencing Meta Engineering

objects.text:
Science is not strictly linear. Given different circumstances, priorities or discoveries, civilizations can realise radically different technologies.

This general upgrade provides an alternate version for each known technology tree, drawn from any possible timeline, universe or sequence of events of your choice. Whether an ultra-militaristic variant of Star Trek's Federation or a Solarpunk themed Cyberpunk 2077, you can acquire their tech.

The resulting version of technology may differ drastically in its design philosophy, materials, energy sources, production methods, interfaces and more. You may choose to combine this version with your existing understanding or even fully replace it.

Note that this alternate version may excel in some areas while falling short in others, depending on its path of development. For example, equipment from an alternate early 21st-century Earth with a heavy focus on renewables and sustainability might lack the capacity for mass-production compared to other Earths.

Regardless of form, the alternate technology is equivalent in overall scope and capability to the original. It cannot exceed the maximum potential of the original technology tree nor can it go beyond it's fundamental limits; if a setting cannot facilitate FTL travel, no alternate version can achieve this, for instance.

This upgrade may be taken multiple times with each purchase granting an additional, distinct alternate version of all the technologies you’ve selected in this CYOA.
objects.title: Alternate History Technologies

addons.title: Moore's Gang of Outlaws
addons.text:
Any society you uplift is collectively granted access to Moore's Undead Law, allowing them to make quantitative improvements without you. If you possess Moore's Legislative Assembly then this allows them to do the same with qualitative improvements.

You may retract this access but not the improvements they have made, nor are you capable of limiting this to those you favor, unless you possess Monopolised Progress in which case you may do so.

objects.text:
You are no longer bound by the tragedy of technological progress being capped by physical law or diminishing returns. Research and development can always uncover deeper avenues for improvement, and low-hanging fruit can never truly be exhausted.

Where others eventually encounter barriers imposed by physics, you can always discover new methods of advancement. A microchip approaching the limits of miniaturization can be redesigned to become smaller, faster, and more capable yet again, a process that can be repeated ad infinitum. An engine that should be constrained by the speed of light can instead be refined into one that travels even faster, provided it was already capable of approaching that threshold. Code and information normally have limits to how elegant or compressed they can become, but yours can eventually be optimized to such an extent that a perfect simulation of the universe could run in real time on hardware from the 1980s.

As a result, you never run out of quantitative improvements that can be made to a technology, no matter how implausible further advancement might seem. Your limits are determined only by how quickly you can develop those improvements, not by how far they can ultimately go. This power removes physical barriers to continued quantitative progress, but while they can no longer slow your progress down, it does not reduce the work required to achieve it. You must still invest effort proportional to the advancement being made, though other powers may dramatically accelerate the process.

Others do not share your ability to make such improvements but they may replicate and build any that you have brought into existence, as well as use and bring them together in differing ways (though true qualitative innovations will not benefit from your improvements) such as a faster heat coil for a sci-fi weapon may be used to boil a kettle faster or the improved compression algorithm you used for AI memories can be used to compress normal files.

This power does not apply to qualitative breakthroughs. While quantitative advancement can continue indefinitely, entirely new principles, paradigms, or categories of technology remain bound by normal physical laws and must be discovered through conventional means or other abilities.
objects.title: Moore's Undead Law

objects.text:
You have finally broken free of physical law in its entirety when it comes to creating and advancing technology. Where others eventually exhaust the scientific principles and engineering paradigms available to them, the universe itself seems to reveal new avenues of innovation. Every experiment you conduct, every prototype you build, and every design you create uncovers further paths forward, whether entirely new ways of understanding a field or novel techniques that integrate seamlessly into existing ones. Each discovery naturally opens the door to further discoveries.

Instead of merely refining a conventional microchip, you could develop entirely new computational paradigms through quantum computing, which might in turn lead to quantum-entangled communications and eventually teleportation. A 3D printer could progress from fabricating simple objects to producing flesh and bone, then eventually converting energy into matter and matter back into energy. Code could tunnel into a new dimension, creating a baby universe whose physical laws are optimized for computation, or even copy and paste a simulation of our universe directly into that new reality.

This upgrade shares the same fundamental limitation as Moore's Undead Law: you must still perform the work required to achieve progress. The difference is that you are no longer restricted by either physical law or the technological paradigm in which you currently operate. Expanding the breadth of a field becomes as viable as refining its depth, though greater departures from existing knowledge require proportionally greater effort.

However, each breakthrough can serve as a foundation for future ones, making increasingly ambitious innovations easier to achieve over time. Existing expertise within relevant fields can further accelerate this process. Furthermore, quantitative improvements are retained across qualitative transitions, meaning that adopting a radically new technological framework does not require sacrificing existing capabilities in exchange for new ones.

If there is a particular technology you wish to create, all you need to do is work toward it. The necessary discoveries, principles, and innovations will emerge along the way, allowing you to assemble something greater than the sum of its parts, just as a cellphone is not a single invention but countless innovations working together.
objects.title: Moore's Legislative Assembly

objects.text:
What good is an inventor without any tools or materials? Especially when you're stranded in the middle of nowhere with no way to salvage anything resembling either? To solve this disastrous scenario, you've been given a bag of holding filled with such things. It also counts as an OoP.

It has an infinite hammerspace to hold all of it's contents, which will restock overtime (typically within a few hours), and automatiically adjusted to fit your current circumstances and needs. Nothing more, nothing less. Just always enough to give a moderate but significant headstart in your technological ambitions. 

For example, being stranded in the middle of a deserted island will give enough supplies to create a settlement and source of sustenance for yourself, plus all the resources you'd need to build some form of escape. While in modern civilization with all of your basic needs met, you'll only receive a standard set of resources to make something considered "average" for your capability.

This upgrade by itself will only give generic and mundane items, but with any Tech powers chosen, can add exotic ones and resources only native to the universe they originate from. Such as Vibranium with I Am Iron Man! (Marvel: MCU), blueprints and parts for Frieza Force spacecraft and scouters with Capsule Corp (Dragon Ball Series), or a random set of gems with Jeweler (Diablo). 

It can also grant you a stock of pre-made items for immediate usage (usually for emergencies) based on your Tech powers. Such as Hoi Poi Capsules, a small army of Egg Pawns, basic armaments and weaponry, or a lesser variant of Spartan Armor. These items will always scale to be above average at best, unless circumstances demand otherwise.

You cannot influence the contents within, but they will always be relevant and useful to you, with a hint into what you can use them for.
objects.title: Starter Pack

objects.text:
Congratulations on creating (or discovering) a new material that possesses unique properties and has the potential for wide-ranging applications.

When making your first purchase, you can combine the properties of several (for example, two or three) common materials. For example, you can create ‘metallised explosives’ that are 13 times more powerful than TNT, have the density and strength of tungsten (allowing them to be used without a metal casing as a projectile), and can be processed like ordinary plastic.

Your second purchase will allow you to add an exotic property to the material—one typically found in rare materials or manifested under specific conditions (superconductivity, superfluidity, etc.). For example, you can obtain an analogue of ‘metallised hydrogen’, which will be 20 times more efficient than rocket fuel with a density of 0.6–0.7 g/cm³. By adding the density of lead (11.34 g/cm³) to this, you will obtain a fuel that is 300 times more efficient than rocket fuel.

The third purchase will allow you to add metaphysical, mystical or anomalous properties, such as those of mithril, the zero element or kyber crystals.

You will receive a detailed production process for the material you have devised.
objects.title: "Your Name"-nium.

objects.text:
You can now make your technologies much safer at a minimal cost. You now have plenty of comprehensive guardrails to place on things like volatile power sources, hazardous machinery, and haywire prone AI. This does not make your technology necessarily more powerful, or easier to use, but it does eliminate danger to the users.

If you have a system or procedure that has a powerful effect, such as an unstable weapon or empowering serum, but a chance of catastrophically failing, then it will instead fizzle out safely if it fails. It will still break down and become unusable afterwords, and it will not become more likely to succeed, but the operator/recipient and surrounding area will be fine regardless.
objects.title: Safety Regulations

objects.text:
You are now not only master of the magitech of D&D and Pathfinder, but of all the futuristic technology available throughout both those settings, and perhaps more importantly, their conventionally technologically advanced spin-offs.

The technologies of Pathfinder & Starfinder (like those of Numeria, Androffa, & The Technic League, The Pact Worlds, Veskarium, Azlanti Star Empire, & The Unseen), D&D settings (The Barrier Peaks & Spelljammer), the worlds of d20 Future (Bughunters, Dimension X, Dark Heart Of Space, Genetech, Mecha Crusade, Star*Drive i.e. Star Frontiers, The Wasteland i.e. Gamma World, CyberRave, Alternity, & d20 Apocalypse), the alternate histories of d20 Past (Age Of Adventure, Shadow Stalkers, Pulp Heroes), the warped presents of d20 Modern (Shadow Chasers, Agents Of Psi, Urban Arcana, Dark Matter, Thunderball Rally), and many others, contain no secrets to your learned mind.

You also gain access to the magic, psionic, divine, physical, etc. abilities & their equivalents from these settings if you have the relevant powers.
objects.title: Progress Level (d20 Modern/Starfinder)

objects.text: You are now a C'tan Shard, a miniscule fraction of a being that once made the Old Ones quake with fear. You have an unparalleled ability to manipulate matter and energy, comparable to the T2 power Omni-Kinesis without range limits. Your body is made of an extremely durable Necrodermis shell, allowing you to shapeshift and granting you a powerful healing factor. This power will only grow in time, eventually leading to you becoming a full C'tan, a being comparable in many ways to a Negentropic Entity.
objects.title: Star God (Warhammer: 40k)

objects.text:
You can now synthesize and create the sentient xenos machine species known as the Necrons.

Utilizing a specialized living metal called Necrodermis, you can breath to life various types of Necrons, ranging from frontline troops like Warriors to even Overlords, Phaerons, and everything in between. This also encompasses Necron constructs like Canoptek Spyders, Destroyers, and even Wraiths. You have within you the power to breathe life into Necrons with such perfection that even the Silent King's body, crafted by the C'tan themselves, would pale in comparison.

Naturally, the larger and more powerful the creation, the greater the quantity of Necrodermis required, though you possess an inherent awareness of the necessary amounts for each creation.

To obtain Necrodermis, you can transmute regular metals into it when in proximity to that metal. Conductive metals will yield a superior ratio of transmuted Necrodermis. For instance, 1 kilo of silver will grant you 1 kilo of Necrodermis, whereas 1 kilo of stainless steel will only produce 500 grams of the living metal. You can transmute 1 kilo of Necrodermis if you have the equivalent ratio of the appropriate conductive metal within one-tenth of a second.

To the Necrons and your other creations, you are the unchallenged sovereign, your word a law they are bound to uphold. This allegiance is unwavering, transcending distinctions of intelligence, awareness, and inherent nature. Regardless of their complexity, each and every one of the entities you have brought into being, along with those subsequently born from your creations, is innately aware of your sovereign authority. They are instinctively and unfailingly devoted to fulfilling your commands, bound by an unbreakable, perfect loyalty that endures throughout their eternal existence.

You have the option to impart the full technology and knowledge of the Necron eternal empire to your Necrons, from their absolute peak at the War in Heaven to their current state, either partially or fully, according to your discretion.

Thanks to the properties of Necrodermis, Necrons are incredibly tough and possess powerful regenerative capabilities, but they can still be destroyed if they suffer enough damage. They can also gradually degrade over time.

When a Necron takes too much damage, its systems can trigger an emergency teleportation, returning it to a beacon of your design and placement. You can also back up their minds into specialized storage units and download them into new Necron bodies.

As their creator, you have the power to instantly terminate any of the Necons you create whenever you wish by simply reclaiming the life spark you granted them, reducing them to inert Necrodermis metal.
objects.title: Necrons (Warhammer: 40k)

objects.text:
The C'tan, once revered as gods, embodied the sheer might of the universe in the form of nearly omnipotent sentient beings. However, those days have long passed, and the gods have been vanquished, shattered into thousands of shards by their own servitors, the Necrons. These shards, each locked away and concealed, harbor the immeasurable power of the C'tan.

Even now in their reduced and wholly fettered state, C'tan Shards are beings of near-unlimited power. They can manifest energy blasts, control the minds of lesser beings, manipulate the flow of time, and banish foes to alternate dimensions. Indeed, a C'tan Shard's abilities are limited only by two things: its imagination — which is immense — and glimmering memories of the being from which it was severed. While no individual C'tan Shard has full recall of the omnipotent being it once was, each carries the personality and hubris of that vaster and more puissant being.

Now, you possess the keys to unleash and use every C'tan shard held by the Necrons, in an alternative dimension only you can access. The Necrons had only unleashed these godlike beings in the most dire circumstances, fearing that, despite the failsafes and precautions in place, there remained a small chance, however remote, for the shards to escape and attempt to overthrow their captors, reclaiming their position once again as the rulers of the universe. However, you share not this concern, as these shards like your Necron creations, will exhibit perfect loyalty to you, offering their overwhelming power in eternal servitude.
objects.title: C'tan Shards (Warhammer: 40k)

objects.text:
Created during the developmental apex of the Dark Age of Technology, the complete Standard Template Construct (STC) database was a complete AI-assisted technological encyclopedia, containing all the knowledge of the Men of Gold and their ancestors. You have become a living version of this ancient masterwork, able to perfectly calculate everything needed to create from locally available materials the means of manufacture and assemble every single advancement Mankind has ever made, from simple tinderboxes to the means of re-igniting cold stars.

At the height of understanding, Mankind built power generation modules that could harness the galactic background radiation to propel ships beyond light-speed, weapons that could crack open planets, aethermatic formulas to mold brane shields for shunting ships into different universes, specialized Gellar fields to seal or vivisect daemons, cure all possible or conceivable ailments or diseases with the Panacea, craft event horizon machines to digitize space-time or drag entire star systems into naked singularities, & even heal people by reversing time; the galaxy almost seems limited & quaint with the power of a full STC.
objects.title: STC (Warhammer: 40k)

addons.text:
In the radiant aftermath of the Omnissiah’s Benediction, you can invoke a deeper communion with the Machine Spirit through the Canticle of the Awakened Core. In critical moments—when the battle intensifies or a pivotal decision hangs in the balance—you channel a silent liturgy that echoes through circuits and servos alike, stirring the latent, archaic intelligence hidden within ancient cogitators and forsaken subroutines.

For a brief span, the machine transcends its mundane programming. Systems awaken with a clarity of purpose once reserved for the ancients: a battle drone might instinctively anticipate enemy maneuvers, a decrepit turret could tap into forgotten targeting algorithms, or a ship’s power core might momentarily unleash unprecedented output drawn from forgotten efficiency matrices.

Yet, this divine awakening is a double-edged hymn. An ancient cogitator may whisper data from an age it was never meant to recall. A servo-skull might speak in the voice of its original operator. And the more often you invoke the Canticle, the more unpredictable the awakenings become—fragments of identity, memory, or ambition may stir within the awakened systems, creating echoes of past Machine Spirits that don’t always fade cleanly.

Thus, while the Canticle of the Awakened Core bestows a potent surge of synergistic might, it is tempered by the ever-present possibility that what is awakened might never wholly yield to your intent. Use this sacred litany with measured faith and careful resolve, lest the chorus of ancient spirits defy the order you so earnestly invoke.
addons.title: Canticle of the Awakened Core

objects.text:
Your bond with the Machine Spirit grows stronger, letting you temporarily unlock its hidden potential. By performing special rites, you can encourage the Machine Spirit to reshape and adapt the machine it inhabits, creating temporary mutations to suit a specific need. These changes might include extra limbs for better functionality, new weaponised parts, or enhanced sensors for improved awareness. A simple electric car can instantly become a high-speed tank with a laser.

The transformations are short-lived, fading once the Machine Spirit settles or the task is complete. To make this happen, you’ll need to perform careful rituals—prayers, chants, and the use of sacred oils or tools.

Pushing the Machine Spirit too far can cause it to rebel or damage the machine.
objects.title: Mutagenic Invocation

objects.text:
The combined effort of the Imperium's smartest over ten thousand years has netted the genetic materials ready to ascend the Astartes into a new line of evolution, the Primaris Space Marine. You can now craft three more specialized organs and implant them into your Space Marines for a total of 22 organs. These organs will further enhance their transhuman status and ability, allowing them to outperform their Firstborn Space Marine brothers in almost every conceivable capacity. These additional implanted organs include:

Sinew Coils: The Primaris Space Marine's sinews are reinforced with durametallic coil-cables that can contract with incredible force, magnifying his strength as well as giving his body another layer of defence.

Magnificat: A small, thumbnail-sized lobe that is inserted into the brain's cortex. The Magnificat secretes hormones that increase the body's growth functions whilst also intensifying the function of the other gene-seed organs.

Belisarian Furnace: This is a dormant organ that connects to both the Astartes' hearts. In times of extreme stress, or should the warrior's body undergo violent, damaging trauma, it expels great bursts of self-synthesised chemicals — a hyper-cocktail that simulates the biological action of combat stims while also aiding in the rapid regrowth of tissue, bone and muscle. The gland then falls dormant again and takes some time to metabolically build itself up once more for the next usage.

You can expect the average Primaris marine to grow to be 9 feet tall.
objects.title: Primaris Gene-Seed (Warhammer: 40k)

addons.text:
You now possess the knowledge of how to create any form of technology that exists or has been shown within the Space King universe and is or was used by the Psycho-Warriors. This encompasses their starships, the mighty Psycho-Titans—massive combat walkers armed with devastating sonic weapons mounted in their heads, capable of leveling entire cities—as well as lost technologies such as the God Weapon and the AI Creatures which can evolve past any weaponry used against them.

You also gain the abilities of an Imaginator, an expert capable of designing new technologies, enhancing existing ones and understanding alien species with greater precision to ensure their efficient extermination.

Finally, you acquire access to forbidden and heretical knowledge used in the creation of female Psycho-Warriors. Your mastery of this technology even enables you to create female Space Marines.
addons.title: Space Kings Technology (Space King)

objects.text:
You have learned a new method of creating genetically enhanced supersoldiers on par with the Space King in his advancements in the creation of biologically superior lifeforms, Where as the average Space Marine would take on average 19 months to fully augment into an augmented soldier and receive training to become a competent Space Marine you now possess a method that instantly create the genetic monstrosities known as Psycho Warriors being 9-10 ft of pure muscle.

The average Psycho Warrior immediately is downloaded with the experiences of a deadly warrior able to fight in deadly galaxy-wide conflicts, immortal so long as Holy Globules remain intact, as a Medicae extracts them and inserts them into a new host, transferring the memories of the Psycho Warrior into a new body to begin the hate march once more. You may also create various variations of Psycho Warriors, such as the Imagniators or Medicae. The Imagniators create new, advanced technology with intelligence superior to the average Psycho Warrior, while the Medicae serve as medics, extracting the necessary components from fallen Psycho Warriors.

You do not need to make a Psycho Warrior and may instead use these new techniques to create Space Marines that are virtually immortal and boosted with the instantaneous creation of new Space Marines. You also gain access to the various technologies seen in Space King that are standard arrangements for the Psycho Warriors, such as the pink blasters, Psycho-Armour, teleporters and more.
objects.title: Praise Be To Space King! (Space King)

addons.text: “His Judgement and vengeance is ours to deliver!" The Sisters of Silence serve as the Emperor’s witch hunters and daemon slayers. Many fear them for their skill in arms in conjunction with their mighty equipment, such as their vranite armor or psyk-out weaponry. But the true threat comes from the secretive women behind those arms: each is a blank, capable of harming demons and rendering psykers helpless by their mere presence. You now possess the knowledge to create those mighty daemon slayers. Using special machines, you can alter the DNA of female candidates and grant them the pariah gene, turning them into blanks. This process will require two ingredients to succeed: first, a female candidate, and the blood of a human already possessing the pariah gene. It will take approximately a year and multiple surgeries for the pariah gene to fully take over a candidate's genetic makeup. While undergoing this process, candidates will also receive multiple other gene modifications to help them thrive on the battlefield, such as increased physical attributes, longer lifespan, increased height, removal of waste genes, etc. A candidate who has undergone the full process will stand at a minimum height of 6.6 feet and can easily best all but the most heavily augmented warriors in terms of pure raw attributes. Their augmentations allow them to keep up with a standard Astartes in terms of pure speed but leave them wanting in regards to all of their other attributes. It would take 2 or 3 regular sisters to match an Astartes in pure attributes. They can easily live up to a thousand years without any other external method of enhancing their lifespan. While coordinating with other augmented warriors of your creations, the Sisters of Silence receive a buff to all their attributes for each augmented force they're fighting beside. In addition, they can easily adapt and match any of their tactics, leaving them able to act as support without ever interfering with any other force. While undergoing the procedures needed to turn them into Sisters of Silence, candidates also undergo various rounds of hypno-indoctrination to teach them all that they need to know to excel in their role. They are also taught how to maintain, retrofit, and upgrade their equipment. They are unwaveringly loyal to you and are impervious to mind control or corruption.
addons.title: Sisters of Silence

objects.text:
The Custodes, the elite of the elite, the pinnacle of engineered perfection, towering even above the mighty Adeptus Astartes in both combat prowess and design. While they may bear a superficial resemblance to the Space Marines, their origins, construction, and battlefield supremacy stand worlds apart.

Now, you know how to create special incubation machines that would allow you to craft these transcendent warriors. The process requires two essential ingredients: the amount of biomass to form their physical vessels and precisely 550 milliliters, or a single pint of your blood, for each Custodian.

After a three-year incubation, a fully-formed Custodian emerges, averaging around 10 feet tall. Even without formal training, they surpass even the most seasoned Space Marine in every conceivable measure. A single Custodian could effortlessly dismantle an entire company of Astartes without even breaking a sweat.

If the Astartes represent a wolf pack, the Custodians would be the lions, the one-man army. These creations would be your ultimate weapon—unstoppable sentinels of raw power, each a fortress of flesh and steel, crafted with a singular purpose: to eliminate any threat with terrifying might and efficiency.

Unlike the Astartes, Custodes can also be female; each warrior born has an equal chance of being male or female.
objects.title: Adeptus Custodes (Warhammer: 40k)

addons.text:
You can now craft advanced machines that can forge specialized armor and weaponry for your Primarchs in mere months, instead of the millennia it traditionally takes in the lore.

These pieces of equipment will be gene-seed bound, meaning they will respond only to the specific genetic signature of each Primarch. Even the weakest of these armors will be durable enough to withstand orbital bombardments without so much as a scratch. They will amplify their every ability by a factor of five, and provide such immense resilience that your Primarchs will thrive comfortably even in the most inhospitable environments known to life, etc.

Their weapons will wield devastating firepower, shredding the most durable alloys as though they were paper and cutting through the mightiest of daemons as if they were made of melted cheese. Your Primarchs will know not only complete physical and mental superiority, but also the might of their arms.
addons.title: Primarch Artifacts

objects.text:
The knowledge of creating the Primarchs was a secret held solely by the Emperor himself, his magnum opus. For thousands of years, no human, xenos, or even the foul forces of Chaos could replicate their splendor—until now. You have unlocked the full secret of their creation and possess the tools to bring them to life. Like the Custodes, you can craft incubation pods, where, after a ten-year gestation, a fully grown Primarch will emerge. The smallest will tower at twelve feet, while the largest will stand a colossal fifteen to sixteen feet tall.

To ensure the success of this incubation process, three essential ingredients are required: a constant supply of fresh biomass for the full ten years, one liter of your blood every month, and fragments of your soul. The machine will extract a portion of your soul at the beginning and another at the end to fuel the formation of the Primarch.

If you possess a standard human soul, you can sustain the creation of only three Primarchs over the decade; any more, and you will surely expire. Fear not, for your soul will regenerate slowly over time.

The power of a Primarch can not be understated—they are truly demigods in every sense of the word. Each Primarch, to some degree, is a psyker or holds the potential to become one. Even the weakest, untrained Primarch, fresh from incubation, could obliterate a squad (8) of Custodes without breaking a sweat. As they grow, they will develop unique powers and abilities, setting them apart from one another. Every Primarch will also naturally exude an aura of regal authority, commanding awe and reverence from any lesser beings around them. Only you remain immune to this effect.

Your primarchs will be utterly loyal, with no chance of corruption or betrayal. To them, you are their most precious parent. But beware—if left unchecked, their devotion may drive them to lengths even you cannot foresee, all in their quest to honor your will.
objects.title: Immortis Primarchs (Warhammer: 40k)

objects.text:
Now, instead of fully grown Primarchs emerging from their incubation pods, they will crawl out as newborn infants. Whether due to a calibration error or some twist of divine fate, all of your Primarchs will take the form of babies. Though still infused with the power and potential of Primarchs, they will embody infancy in every other sense—tiny, vulnerable, and in need of guidance.

It’s now your task, as their parent, to shepherd them through childhood, from changing diapers to feeding, playtime, and all the nine yards in between. These still aren’t ordinary human babies; they are still bioengineered perfection. As such, your Primarchs will experience rapid, extraordinary growth every year, transforming in body, mind, and spirit until they reach adulthood, much like their 40k counterparts.

Nurturing them with gentle care and love during this crucial period will profoundly influence their potential, granting up to a 300% boost in power when they reach maturity. Neglect and indifference won’t have negative consequences, but they also won’t receive this buff.
objects.title: Are they supposed to be that small? (Warhammer: 40k)

objects.text:
By taking this power, your blood now carries the essence of divinity, a divine gift that you can pass on to your children.

The power of the Space Marines is undeniable, the supremacy of the Custodes beyond question, and the authority of the Primarchs absolute. Yet with the infusion of your blood, these figures would be elevated to new heights that would make their former selves look like bumbling children in comparison.

By merging your blood with the creation of Space Marines, Custodes, and Primarchs, their physical capabilities increase exponentially, up to a fivefold enhancement. Where a Space Marine could once lift three tons, now, without power armor, he can effortlessly lift fifteen.

Moreover, they gain the unique defensive properties of your blood, providing them with an extraordinary resistance to harmful psychic and magical influences, fortifying their minds and bodies against unnatural powers that would otherwise overwhelm them.

The tools of war forged by your machines can also be enhanced by using your blood. For example, by anointing a drop of your blood onto Power Armor or a Bolt Gun, their performance can be amplified by 200%. This buff persists as long as your blood remains on the equipment.
objects.title: Imperishable Dynasty (Warhammer: 40k)

addons.text:
You gain the genius-level intellect, learning, comprehension, strategic brilliance and understanding of machinery, technology, siegecraft, and architecture possessed by Perturabo, The Primarch of The Iron Warriors. You are a master of siege warfare, capable of designing and executing assaults that can shatter even the most impregnable defenses.

You can effortlessly reverse-engineer, miniaturize, refine, and enhance any technology you encounter. You can seamlessly integrate any technological knowledge you have or acquire.

Your strategic mind allows you to deconstruct complex problems into their fundamental components, uncovering the most efficient and devastatingly effective solutions. On the battlefield, you perceive engagements like a real-time strategy game, analyzing and commanding across even the most chaotic or non-Euclidean terrains with unerring precision.
addons.title: The Lord of Iron (Warhammer 40K)

objects.text:
Your skill in architecture and fortification rivals that of Rogal Dorn, the Praetorian of Terra. You can raise monumental structures and entire cities in a fraction of the time it would take others; achievements that would require centuries of labour are completed under your guidance in mere years. A world you dedicate yourself to defending becomes, for all practical purposes, unassailable.

Your fortification networks would render even Cadia seem exposed and undefended by comparison. You can surround a planet with immense orbital bastions, forming a steel shell of impregnable defences. On the ground, your fortresses achieve mathematical perfection: no cover, no weakness, no mercy for any attacker.

Any foe that grants you the time to fortify your position signs their own doom. You possess the knowledge necessary to construct colossal orbital plates and vast habitats that rival Hive Cities in size, which can orbit their patron worlds. Though these orbital plates are more difficult to defend than true fortresses, under your command, they too become formidable bulwarks of your dominion.f

You can easily integrate any technological knowledge you have or acquire into your buildings and fortifications.
objects.title: Praetorian of Terra (Warhammer: 40k)

objects.text: You are the Last Time Lord. Time bends to your will; you no longer need to follow the rules of time; there are no fixed points for you, and no one can go back and change time to remove you by changing it so that you never existed. You also become more charismatic, to the point that you could lead cults and gain massive followings. This also makes the number of regenerations you can have infinite, as you no longer hold the genetic defect that Rassilon introduced to the virus that he created to allow for regenerations. You become supernaturally lucky as danger seems to flow around you rather than face you as guns seem to jam and lasers somehow bend out of the way, You also appear to have an effect on supernatural events around you as they seem to work at a lessened power, if you will. As a final bonus, you gain all the memories of a single Time Lord of you choosing.
objects.title: Time Lord Victorious (Doctor Who)

objects.text: You become The lonely God, The Predator, The Great Exterminator, the Destroyer of Worlds, gaining the body and memories of the doctor; you gain an unfathomable intellect, charisma, and skills; and you are lucky enough that you could charm an entire army of Daleks, Cybermen, Sauntaurons, and many more to back down at the very mention of your name. You are unpredictable to the Possibility Engine, which reads the infinite possible timelines in infinite universes, selects the very best scenarios, and forces them to happen. It seems to just forget about you and breaks at adding you to its variables. You also gain the doctor's unwavering willpower, able to power through four and a half billion years of torture and still come out on top with your sanity in tact. For some reason, you have also become good at running and making improvised plans.
objects.title: The Doctor (Doctor Who)

addons.text: Your nature as one of the Champions of the Great Maker has further expanded your capabilities, granting you almost all the technological knowledge of the denizens of Autocthonia, be they mortal, Exalted or spirit; from simple artifacts like Photo-Resonant Gel and Courier Drones, to the vats complexes and many magitech Charms used by the Alchemicals, to even the technical and sorcerous knowledge possessed by the craftsman of the Sodalities, required to perform the rituals to make new Alchemical Exalted. This also includes the knowledge of how to create and use the disturbing and highly corruptive Voidtech of all shapes and sizes, for better or for worse.
addons.title: Autocthonian Architect

addons.text:
The works of the living and of the Great Maker are not the only innovations out there- nor are they the only great and terrible powers: Not only are you a master in the many technological marvels of Creation and its own Solars, you are just as proficient in the darker arts of the Underworld innovated by the Deathlords' over the centuries.

Such innovation not only includes Necrotech, combining medicine and craftsmanship with necromancy to make risen dead servants and warmachines - up to even great horrors like the Bonestriders or the Thousand-Corpse War Frame - but also the more outright occult workings of the Underworld; Essence-Containing Gems and Attunement Spikes, Loathsome Osseous Shells and the Unmelting Hearts, even potentially recreating the Monstrances of Celestial Portion, that which twisted the Solar Exaltations into their dark counterparts.
addons.title: Artifice of Death

objects.text:
You gain the technological knowledge from the Exalted franchise, specializing in the advanced technology of Heavens Reach and the First Age Solar civilization. This encompasses a deep understanding of celestial machinery, essence-based technology, and the ancient artifacts of a lost era. With this knowledge, you become a master of harnessing the power of essence, crafting intricate artifacts, and manipulating cosmic forces.

Armed with this expertise, you wield mighty artifacts and artifacts, tap into the raw essence of creation, and command awe-inspiring celestial machines. Your mastery of technology from Heavens Reach and the First Age Solar civilization allows you to reshape reality, unleash devastating powers, and leave an indelible mark on the world.
objects.title: Shards of Lost Knowledge (Exalted)

objects.text: You gain the technological knowledge from the Nasuverse franchise, specializing in the advanced magical technology of Chaldea and the insights from the alternate future of Notes. This encompasses a deep understanding of genetic engineering through Ether Liner, the creation of powerful conceptual weapons like Black Barrel and Knight Arms, and the secrets of far-future Magecraft. With this knowledge, you become a master of manipulating the fabric of reality, forging devastating weapons, and pushing the boundaries of genetic enhancement. Furthermore, your mastery of Magecraft from the distant future grants you unparalleled access to ancient spells, arcane rituals, and mystical techniques. With this combined technological and mystical knowledge, you transcend the limitations of ordinary Magecraft.
objects.title: Singularity; Notes (Type-Moon)

objects.text: You now have access to the technological knowledge of various alien civilisations within the Nasuverse franchise, going beyond the mere scraps of technological data that humans have invented on the backwater planet known as Earth. This new knowledge includes technological achievements such as recreating something on the level of the Moon Cell; creating space probes on a similar level to Velber, an observational device created by the same race as the one species that made the Moon Cell; and the creation of Dyson sphere spaceships that can match, if not surpass, the level of the Chaos, or Machine Gods, meant to terraform other planets to mimic your home planet.
