With this knowledge, you are far more than just a repository of human advancement and achievements; you're now an archive of the various species inhabiting the Nasuverse universe.
objects.title: Foreigner Technology (Type-Moon)

addons.text: With alchemical methods, you can easily mass produce high-quality homunculi comparable to the best of what the Einzbern family could produce at their peak, which can also serve as highly efficient backup bodies. With sufficient alchemical mastery, creating bodies comparable to the famous Frankenstein's Monster or even beyond is within your grasp.
addons.title: Homunculus Creator

objects.text:
You mastered the technique Da Vinci used to avoid death by transferring her mind to a backup body, which combined with the Elder’s technology allows you to create backup bodies in advance with already-installed specialized Cortical Stacks.

This allows you to have perfect automatic transfer to the new body in case of death or even at will. Even if your Cortical Stack breaks, you have an empty body prepared with a Stack for your soul transference magecraft to work with. Removing the possibility of true death from breaking your Cortical Stack.

As it's tied to your soul, all of your perks, powers, and attributes, like your magic circuits, will also transfer together with your soul, just like with the normal Cortical Stacks, unless you wish to replace them with ones from the new body, in which case they will be left behind in the old one, which you can reclaim when transferring back, allowing you to build specialized bodies for different tasks holding different powers and traits. This way, you can freely modify, heal, or even experiment on your spare bodies without putting yourself at risk.

You are protected from the flaws of Da Vinci’s original process such as it making you feel like a separate person from the original.

This method can be fine-tuned to set in which order you wish to automatically transfer in case of death. It will also include the technology required to create empty bodies comparable to those of a low-tier servant with no skills and to keep them in indefinite stasis for emergencies.
objects.title: Emergency Backup (Type-Moon)

addons.text:
It seems that the old Vampire saw something in you, much like he did with the Tohsaka family, and has left you the blueprints for the Jeweled Sword Zelretch. While these blueprints are incomplete, they will allow you to create an inferior copy that can draw mana from two additional life-giving planets through dimensional space. Initially, you may only be able to create this basic version, but over time, you will be able to improve upon the design. With enough effort, you will eventually be able to fully recreate the True Jeweled Sword, though this may take generations.

However, there is more to the blueprints than just that. Within them, you can find notes on the principles behind Kaleidosticks. From this, you will also gain the knowledge to hybridize Mystic Codes with devices.
addons.title: Jeweled Sword Blueprints

addons.text:
Once, mages on Remnant would use Dust as a catalyst in elemental spells and enchantments, but such things were lost to the Ages, until you that is.

You have come to understand these ancient principles, allowing you to create Devices that infused with Dust, allowing for an increased efficiency in Elemental Mana conversion, be it through inlaying specialized Dust circuits, or infusing the metal with Dust.

Even outside of Device's your knowledge of Mana and Dust has allowed you to push Remnant's technology ahead by centuries, such as mecha-shift weapons that can both channel Mana and use it to amplify the effect's of Dust, or having Barrier Jacket's integrated with hardlight Dust to increase their durability, or hybridizing Atlas airships with TSAB dimensional ships to work around the the limitations of purely Dust based technology(I.E you will be able to utilize Dust in space by subjecting it to Mana)
addons.title: The Missing Element

objects.text:
Across the many worlds governed by the Time-Space Administration Bureau (T.S.A.B.), you have learned to create various technologies showcased throughout the series. These include Devices that assist casters in the calculations required for their spells and in the regulation of mana. Devices are equipped with a Barrier Jacket, which is a set of clothing comprised of magical energy.

One additional feature that can be incorporated is the Cartridge system from ancient Belka. This system consists of bullet-like shells containing condensed mana that can provide a significant power boost. Another innovation is the Acceleration system from Eltria, which enhances movement and mana output, although it places a strain on the caster’s body.

This knowledge extends beyond these items; you are also capable of recreating dimensional ships such as the Saint’s Cradle and the Artha. Furthermore, you can construct Anti-Magilink fields, EM equipment, Eltrian Formula, and AEC armaments, all of which are now part of your technological repertoire.
objects.title: Device Linker Meister (Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha)

objects.text:
You incorporated your Magecraft-enhanced Cortical Stack into your organic flesh sack, which gathers the vestiges of the lifeblood of the universe and grants you the capability to practice Biomancy.

This allows you to use your own monsters as backup bodies or even infect unsuspecting creatures with a specialised benign tumour acting as a Cortical Stack which allows for transference between bodies. You can also use this to preserve the knowledge and experience of your more precious monsters even after their destruction and then move them into new bodies, as the tumours are extremely durable and can survive outside a body for an extended period of time.

Your skills with Biomancy also enhanced your skills for creating bodies, which allow beneficial mutations even before you inhabit them, and for more rapid body construction as you no longer require highly advanced devices and pods to create and preserve your backups.

Finally, this also synergized with your Blight Craft, as you can create mind, personality, or even soul-affecting diseases and plagues. Creating horrors that should never exist.
objects.title: Cortical Tumour

objects.text: With this upgrade, your Inspired Inventor abilities extend beyond technology, granting you knowledge and skill in any field of knowledge. By investing in various disciplines, you become a universal polymath, surpassing the capabilities of world-renowned experts, and excelling in areas such as martial arts, social engineering, linguistics, philosophy, and more. As a Versatile Genius, you possess superhuman knowledge, understanding, and skill in applying your newfound expertise, enabling you to tackle any intellectual pursuit with unparalleled proficiency. Furthermore, the potency of your charge has increased, turning your first charge into a discipline equal to around 5 SP worth of points, and each additional charge gives an increase of around 3 SP points.
objects.title: Versatile Genius

objects.text:
You can now give out your specializations to other people. When you do so, you lose access to it until you reclaim it or recreate it by investing charges. 

You can partition specializations you give out, limiting the amount of knowledge you share. Additionally, you can invest charges in any specializations that you handed out.

You can repossess handed-out specializations any time you like. Should you have created another version of it for yourself, all the charges spent will merge seamlessly, as if all charges were invested into the specialization from the start.
objects.title: Aspiring Inventors

objects.text: Increases the frequency of charges. Each purchase halves the time between charges generated (every 12 hours, 6h, 3h...).
objects.title: Increased Frequency (Inspired Inventor)

objects.text: You generate 10 additional charges per cycle.
objects.title: Increased Charges (Inspired Inventor)

objects.text:
You gain the combined magical and technical knowledge from the diverse champions of the League of Legends series. With this incredible power, you unlock the secrets of spellcasting, mastering a vast array of magical abilities that range from devastating elemental attacks to enchantments that manipulate time and space. Simultaneously, you acquire the expertise in cutting-edge technology, harnessing futuristic inventions and constructs to your advantage.

As you delve into the depths of this knowledge, you become a formidable force, able to seamlessly blend magic and technology to create unique and potent synergies. With each champion's expertise at your disposal, you possess the versatility to adapt to any situation, employing a wide range of skills, strategies, and tactics to overcome challenges. As the embodiment of this combined magical and technical knowledge, you stand as an unstoppable force on the battlefield, capable of wielding the power of champions and reshaping the course of any conflict.
objects.title: He Who Inspires

objects.text: You gain the technological knowledge of the Combine, an alien race known for stealing technology and conquering worlds throughout the galaxy. The Combine makes extensive use of biotechnology, from vehicles that are a combination of biology and metal to creating superhuman soldiers to pacify resistance. You can create anything that is shown, referenced, or hinted at in Half-Life games that the Combine uses.
objects.title: Combine (Half-Life)

addons.text: Your knowledge of the Peenemünde's secret projects has expanded to include the technology from the many variations of the Wolfenstein universe. From the superscience of the MachineGames timeline to the truly mystic matters of Return To Castle Wolfenstein and everything in between, you know it all.
addons.title: Wunderwaffe (Wolfenstein)

objects.text:
Prepare to transcend the confines of conventional understanding as your intellect delves into the forbidden depths of alien sciences and enigmatic technologies from the fantastical expansions within the Call of Duty universes, including CoD Zombies and CoD Extinction.

Within the recesses of your brilliant mind resides a vast repository of knowledge—an intricate tapestry woven from forbidden lore and otherworldly secrets. Immense power and unimaginable potential lie at your fingertips.

Embracing the twisted and unpredictable technologies born from the presence of Divinium, the secrets of Element 115, a substance discarded by malevolent gods that forever altered our mundane world, become your domain. You wield an awe-inspiring arsenal crafted to combat relentless hordes of nightmarish creatures. The creations of enigmatic beings known as the Keepers become your tools—the mystical Pack-A-Punch, the ancient Apothicon Sword, and the enigmatic Summoning Key. You unlock the dark brilliance of Group 935, harnessing the infamous Ray Gun, the awe-inspiring Wunderwaffe DG-2, and the mysterious perk machines that grant extraordinary abilities. From the depths of ancient civilizations scattered across the globe, you unearth the secrets of their magitech wonders, such as the Elemental Staves and the Skull of Nan Sapwe. Even the technological marvels devised by other factions within this expansive universe, like America's Winter's Howl or the Ascension Group's black hole projectors, now lie within your grasp.

But your brilliance does not stop there. Your mind rivals, and perhaps even surpasses, the unparalleled genius of Edward Richtofen, one of the greatest intellectual prodigies to emerge from the CoD universe. You stand at the precipice of knowledge, wielding the profound wisdom of the Masters themselves.
objects.title: Brilliant Mind of the Masters (Call Of Duty)

objects.text:
You now have access to the technology from works of cyberpunk & science fiction strongly associated with William Gibson & Neal Stephenson, such as The Sprawl Trilogy (Neuromancer, Count Zero, Mona Lisa Overdrive), The Bridge Trilogy (Virtual Light, Idoru, All Tommorow's Parties), The Blue Ant Trilogy (Pattern Recognition, Spook Country, Zero History), The Jackpot Trilogy (The Peripheral, Agency, Jackpot), The Difference Engine, Archangel, Gibson's short stories like those found in Burning Chrome, Snow Crash, The Diamond Age, Anathem, Cryptonomicon, Reamde, Fall; or Dodge In Hell, Interface, Seveneves, Termination Shock, Spew, Jipi and The Paranoid Chip, The Great Simoleon Caper, etc.

This includes advanced full-dive VR on par with any braindance, advanced weapons systems (for both cyberspace and meatspace), mass production super-AI and stored digital personality constructs (as well as the tools to regulate them), time travel (both the information only kind from the Jackpot Trilogy & the regular kind from Archangel), the nanotechnology based infrastructure of The Diamond Age, mega architecture & space architecture, financial and legal engineering that our world hasn't thought of yet, the steampunk tech of The Difference Engine & the atompunk tech of The Gernsback Continuum, the advanced mathematics and theoretical physics of Anathem, & new kinds of cybernetics, robotics, and biomods (like mind control brain chips, super-intelligent dolphins, perfected versions of skillsofts and their biological upgrades, both cybernetic and hardware solutions for entering cyberspace, & memetic viruses like the infamous "Snow Crash").
objects.title: Console Cowboy (William Gibson/Neal Stephenson)

objects.text:
You now have access to the technology from works of cyberpunk & science fiction strongly associated with Mamoru Oshii & Masamune Shirow, such as Ghost in The Shell, Appleseed, Dominion, Patlabor, Jin-Roh, Psycho-Pass, Garm Wars, Avalon, Black Magic, Orion, Metal Skin Panic MADOX-01, etc.

This includes all kinds of mecha, power armor, full body cyborg conversions with few to no downsides, advanced AI, & predictive algorithms good enough to correctly guess what kind of person you are just by looking at you.
objects.title: Stand Alone Complex (Mamoru Oshii & Masamune Shirow)

objects.text:
Your knowledge has expanded to include the databases of MegaTokyo, post-Second Great Kanto Earthquake. This includes the power armor "Hard Suits" of the Knight Sabers, the myriad variants of cybernetic beings known as "Boomers" & surgeries that can turn a human into a Boomer (or the inverse), orbital killsats, advanced computers, 1980's pop-rock, and the many tools of the AD Police, the American & Japanese governments, the Genom Corporation, & the Knight Sabers.

The Boomers are the most interesting technology here, insofar as they are the most versatile and powerful. Some variants can self-modify to the size of buildings using a functionality known as "Boomer Fusion", combat models that can fight off advanced military forces single-handed, & all manner of social models that are indistinguishable from humans & can perform skilled or unskilled tasks until they strike.
objects.title: Genom Corporation (Bubblegum Crisis/AD Police)

objects.text:
Your understanding of grounded Western mecha now also extends to that of the Heavy Gear universe. This includes the titular Heavy Gears themselves, the unique lightweight hydrocarbon engine used in many in-universe vehicles, ONNets, GREL genetic engineering, and the technology of both the Colonial Expeditionary Force and the many factions of Terra Nova.

As a freebie, you also get access to the significantly less advanced tech of Armored Trooper VOTOMS, such as the highly modular Scopedog.
objects.title: Terra Nova (Heavy Gear/VOTOMS)

objects.text:
You gain knowledge of the technology of all the series Twentieth Century Imports & Harmony Gold folded into "Robotech", including Macross, Dougram, Crusher Joe, Mospeda, & Southern Cross. But mostly Macross.

This includes things like the famous Variable Fighters, non-Variable Fighter mecha known as "Destroids", skyscraper sized space carrier mecha, many forms of spaceships and terraforming technology, material science that can give jets durability beyond Main Battle Tanks, more missiles than you could ever possibly use, music based psychic abilities and tech (yes, really), Micronization and other biological sciences, as well as cybernetics and AI.

There is general Overtechnology of all kinds available to you, from Zentradi and Meltrandi tech, to the UN Spacy's reverse-engineered tech, Windermerean equivalents, Protodeviln and Vajra superbeings, to the Protoculture originals, and many other things from either Macross or the series that we have neglected to mention but are still present.
objects.title: Protoculture (Macross)

objects.text:
Your knowledge of near-future military technology now includes the technology featured in the Ace Combat series and its spiritual successors, Project Wingman, Nuclear Option, Airforce Delta Strike, & VTOL VR, as well as other near-future peer airwar based content like Yukikaze & ICBM Escalation. This includes orbital lasers & spaceborne nuclear strike-craft, submersible & flying carriers, massed multirole drone assaults, railguns on any scale imaginable, kinetic shielding, space elevators, autonomous AI, JAM cloning tech, & much more.

You also become an expert in piloting airborne vehicles and naval craft, as well as proficient in operational-scale strategy.
objects.title: Belkan Superweapon (Ace Combat & Project Wingman)

objects.text: Kouzuki Yuuko would be jealous of your knowledge! You are now a master of the technology of the Muv Luv universe, from TSFs (including experimental prototypes like the XG-70), cyborgs, age-extension, espers, Causality Conductors, space travel, & even G-Elements, with their many applications & methods of production.
objects.title: Alternative IV (Muv Luv)

objects.text: You now have a complete understanding of the technology of the Front Mission universe, particularly that of Wanzers & Mobile Weapons. This also includes more everyday technology like space elevators, space colonies, megastructures of various kinds, datalinks, & mass surveillance networks.
objects.title: Diable Avionics (Front Mission)

objects.text:
Your database of mecha technology has been expanded to include data from Martian Successor Nadesico, like terraforming, satellite based orbital shield networks, Distortion Fields, nanomachines, IFS control systems, AI & advanced computer cores like Omoikane, the Phase Transition system, Boson Jumping (which allows for teleportation & time travel), Dimensional Leap Gates, alien technology, & of course plenty of mecha (like the Aestevalis and its variants), ships (like the Nadesico and its variants), & other war machines (like mass-produced drone weapons such as the Batta).

You also gain the nanomachine treatment to become a Pilot, allowing you to intuitively interface with the IFS control system in both mecha and ships, controlling them like your own body.

Finally, you may optionally receive a complete LaserDisc set of the super robot show Gekigangar 3; how you're going to find a LaserDisc player in this day and age is anyone's guess however.
objects.title: Nergal Heavy Industries (Martian Successor Nadesico)

objects.text: Your understanding of post-apocalyptic supertechnology now also extends to that of the UnderRail universe. This includes much greater & safer control over psyker abilities, powerful biotechnology & cybernetics, personal shields, superior underground construction, the technology of Tchort, megacorporations both old and new, the Shadowlith builders, & even the mysterious Godmen.
objects.title: Tchortist (UnderRail)

objects.text:
What if history had... gone wrong? What if something even more derailing than an Axis victory in World War 2 happened? In the world of the Draka, this is not a hypothetical.

During the American Revolutionary War, France & The Netherlands declared war a couple of years earlier than in our timeline, and this was the inciting incident that made everything spiral out of control. The British took over South Africa early, and sent the American Loyalists & Hessians there, rather than to Canada. After this, a parade of all of the European & American history that could have been, but wasn't, arrived. French Royalists & Bonapartists, Icelandic refugees, American Confederates, and practically every era's Britons & Germans appeared, forming a continent spanning settler state that never renounced slavery.

The story continues to a World War 2 fought with what our world would consider 1970s technology, and a World War 3 in the 1990s, fought partly in space, between the Draka and the last free society on Earth (a North & South America spanning United States). This leads to Draka dominion of the Earth, with the Americans fleeing to Alpha Centauri to lick their wounds.

You receive all technology of this universe, up to the present time (2446 AD), as well as the alternate "IngolfTech" timeline; this includes American cybernetics, computer-tech, & high-energy physics, Draka gene-engineering (both to improve one's self like Homo Drakensis, and to create useful biological servants like Homo Servus & the Ghouloons), powerful bioweapons like "The Stone Dogs", excellent system-craft, advanced personal weapons & power armor, all manner of paths-not-taken (like Ferguson Rifles or advanced steam engines), or outright improvements on current technology (such as room temperature superconductors).

As a bonus, you become Homo Drakensis yourself. This comes with strength compared in universe to that of a gorilla, the speed & reflexes to take out a room full of twenty heavily armed men before they can react, senses which are each individually comparable to the very best of the animal kingdom, extreme durability & survivability in any conditions on Earth, general intelligence surpassing the best geniuses in human history, & pheromones useful for both subtle & overt social manipulation. You also gain a suite of both American & Draka cybernetics, including AI based mind-machine interfaces, global-scale hacking abilities, a complete mental database from both the Draka & American civilizations, built in weapons, & versatile "softsuits". The few remaining flaws of Homo Drakensis (such as infertility with baseline humans, unwanted hyperactivity, & slightly lowered creativity) have been ironed out and removed.
objects.title: The Final Society (Domination Of The Draka)

objects.text:
Your understanding of hard sci-fi naval warfare now also extends to that of the Honor Harrington universe.

This includes all manner and variety of missles & warheads, infantry power armor & numerous railgun variants (particularly that of the "pulser", a railgun using gravity manipulation rather than electromagnetic coils), energy weapons from the naval to tactical scales, hovertanks & multirole pinnaces, naval shields that are completely impenetrable from most angles, highly variable FTL travel dependent on one's ability to navigate gravitic "winds", superior ECM and sensors, and the technology of both the Kingdom of Manticore and any other star nation appearing in the series, particularly the People's Republic of Haven, The Anderman Star Empire, & The Solarian League.
objects.title: Admiralty Lord (Honorverse)

objects.text:
It seems you must have picked up some extra skills in the campaigns on Titan and the Unification War out in 34 Tauri.

You're now an engineering expert when it comes to the tech of Firefly's Verse and Cowboy Bebop's solar system, including the Astral Gates (please don't blow up Earth with this), many kinds of system craft and other spacecraft (including some that double for another role in atmosphere, like a fishing trawler), even better terraforming tech, small arms galore, mind control chemicals & genetic modification, training programs and medical treatments capable of creating supersoldiers with unusual abilities (like River Tam, Wen, & Mad Pierrot), the Outernet, Alfa Catch brain reading devices & Brain Dream game systems, Crypt Breaker AI hacking programs, and much more.

You're free now; they can't take the sky from you!
objects.title: Browncoat (Firefly/Cowboy Bebop)

objects.text:
You are now a master of the technology, magic, & magitech of the Outlaw Star universe, such as FTL space travel & spacecraft, Tao Magic & the Wizardry of Ark Manaf, Caster Guns & Shells, dragonite, ether manipulation, androids, advanced computers, and much more.

It's as if you've had the knowledge of the Galactic Leyline uploaded to your mind. In that same vein, you may gain the biology and abilities of a Bio-Android like Melfina if you wish.
objects.title: Toward Stars Era (Outlaw Star)

objects.text:
You gain knowledge of all of the discovered technology in the Trinity Continuum universe, including alien tech & Nova Supertechnology. While in theory, you could rediscover all of this technology purely with Mega-Intelligence, this jumpstarts your knowledge.

This includes content from fansplats as well.
objects.title: Kuro-Tek (Trinity Continuum)

objects.text:
In the realm of Mad Science, you rise as an unparalleled visionary—a True Genius! Your multifaceted perspectives and brilliant mind transcend the limitations of a single specialty. Seamlessly traversing diverse Tech-Genres, you masterfully blend their distinct characteristics, birthing extraordinary marvels. Picture an airship adorned with the rugged lines of dieselpunk on the outside, while housing sleek holograms and augmented reality interfaces within—a harmonious fusion of contrasting genres realized through your creative mastery. Wonders crafted by your hands possess exceptional quality and unrivaled functionality.

Moreover, your expertise transcends the boundaries of science and magic, as the mysteries of magic is simply advanced technology to you. Thus, your creations can surpass conventional science, benefiting from the principles of magic. While the 'science' behind your creations must remain internally consistent, they now possess a touch of the arcane. 

Yet, your ascent to True Genius does not end here. Mastery over the Axioms—the channels of mania shaping mad science—marks another milestone in your journey. Amidst the chaotic sea of Ideas, Axioms stand as islands, offering hints of order and understanding. Through this mastery, you will often experience moments of enlightenment, where profound clarity dawns upon your mind. In an instant, everything clicks, granting you unparalleled understanding and proficiency in an entirely new genre of science. 

Furthermore, your heightened Inspiration enhances the traits of the devices you create effortlessly. Profound insight guides you in unlocking the true potential of combining different technologies, pushing the boundaries of what was once thought possible. While this insight begins as a mere glimmer, with dedication and effort, you unravel the full potential of technological synergy.
objects.title: True Genius!

objects.text:
You have reached the pinnacle of mastery within each of the Axioms, surpassing the boundaries of possibility. Your creations seamlessly integrated into the fabric of reality without the need for Mania.

Through Apokalypse, the Axiom of Discovery, you can construct sensory platforms that unravel the deepest truths and contradictions of material reality. These platforms unveil the secrets of the cosmos, allowing you to scan all of reality for specific objects and venture into alternate dimensions with ease.

With Epikrato, Axiom of Control, you wield wonders that manipulate crowd density, orchestrate intricate chains of events to shape desired outcomes, and even control wealth and markets. Each wonder showcases your absolute control, from dominating the unaware to conjuring lifelike illusions and programming sleeper agents with precise triggers.

Within Exelixi, the Axiom of Healing, you possess the power to resurrect the dead, mend severe wounds, and sustain life in the most inhospitable environments. Creating immortality elixirs that halt aging and cure any diseases is a trivial task for you.

In the Axiom of Destruction, Katastrof, you craft weapons with devastating capabilities, in your arsenal, vibrating swords that cut molecules, causing anything it cuts to "melt" before the blade, to even bombs that can cause transient black holes and space-time fissures are mere mundane tools.

As a master of Prostasia, the Axiom of Protection, you create impenetrable shields capable of safeguarding against catastrophic strikes. An orbital defense grid you create could withstand an entire planet's nuclear arsenal, without a scratch.

Mastery of Skafoi, the Axiom of Travel, allows you to effortlessly create vehicles capable of traversing space at the speed of light. Furthermore, your comprehension of space-time manipulation allows you to navigate the currents of time itself.
objects.title: The Transgressor

addons.text:
The numerous curses of the Created have all been inverted for you. The "Disquiet" you induce helps people be at peace with themselves; your "Wastelands" make the zones they affect more vibrant, peaceful and resilient; your "Torment" sees you more resolute and assured than ever. Your Disfigurements, while still present, look more harmonious with your form, and evoke respect for the tribulations you go through rather than visceral revulsion. Even Pandorans you create will be helpful rather than violent and predatory, though they will still depend on Pyros to stay active.

However, unexpectedly, this also opens a new path to your Pilgrimage. Rather than striving to become human, you can now try to become something more. The path would be long, perhaps longer than any normal Pilgrimage. The introspection needed to achieve something completely new would already be harder than a normal Pilgrimage, and removing the natural obstacles of the Pilgrimage also removes many of the incentives of said introspection.

Should you achieve this, you will gain unparalleled mastery over all your Promethean abilities, and become able to understand and, to a point, directly manipulate Divine Fire in a way similar to the most powerful Qashmallim, the angels of the Divine Fire, made directly from it. Divine Fire being the essence of change and inspiration, both creative and destructive, the possibilities this would open are too numerous to list, though everything the Prometheans can do or suffer are examples of its influence.
addons.title: Road to a new Eden

objects.text:
Rather than being a mere alchemist, you are one of their creations, a Promethean. Born inhuman, yet pursuing humanity on a Pilgrimage that can last centuries. As one, you have access to the collective unconscious of the Created, Azothic memory, from both the setting you are in and the Chronicles of Darkness setting, which will provide you with some new mundane skills, the knowledge and instincts of how to use the following powers, as well as the knowledge needed to use any of the abilities of alchemists. Instead of a soul shines your Azoth, a pure ember of the Divine Fire. The brighter it burns, the stronger your Promethean abilities.

You may decide on a Lineage, which would usually reflect the intent and methods of the alchemist responsible for the creation of your "family line". This Lineage gives you some powers innate to your form as well as defines your humour (choleric, sanguine, melancholic or phlegmatic, or a more exotic one such as ectoplasm, oil or radiation), of which the emotional alignment will color your personality and the elemental alignment will allow you to regain more Pyros when sleeping near it.

You also start out pursuing any one of the eleven Refinements. Refinements, besides one, are philosophies recorded in Azothic memory working as markers for the Pilgrimage. The Refinement you pursue gives you access to two broad Transmutations, further divided into Alembics. You can use any of those extremely easily, as long as you have Pyros. Given a period of introspection on the philosophy of a different Refinement, you may switch to that Refinement. The better you understand that Refinement, the shorter it takes you to switch; the time can vary from a few hours to a month.

Pain, though still felt, cannot debilitate you, allowing you to fight at the best your body allows right until your death. Additionally, electricity of any kind will gradually heal you, more so the greater the current; said regeneration can be sped up by using Pyros. However, should you use too much, this risks short-circuiting the system. If you would die despite those, you may a single time cross back the river of death and reviving at a time of your choice after your death, no latter than one to ten days depending on how bright your Azoth shine.

Your body now naturally produces Pyros, more so if sleeping close to something representing your humour's elemental alignment, and you gain Vitriol through understanding of yourself and intense emotions. You can also use both in new ways; Pyros can be used to push your natural limits, physical or mental, further for a moment, with the only limit to how much being the amount of Pyros you can release at once. Meanwhile, Vitriol can be used to achieve permanent changes, allowing you to stoke your Azoth, stabilize your sense of self, make an Alembic an integral part of yourself no matter your Refinement, or pour some of your experiences into an Athanor, which typically doesn't hold power but rather helps Prometheans to manage their many trials.

Indeed, being one of the Created is likely more curse than blessing. Fire is more deadly to them than to a human of equal constitution. Their true appearance goes deep in the uncanny valley, these Disfigurements hidden by fragile physical alchemy which falters whenever they use their powers, quickening Disquiet should someone see them. Should they try to create new Prometheans (a necessary step on the Pilgrimage), failure would mean the creation of Pandorans, horrible half-formed creatures preying on any source of Pyros.

More importantly, however, the world rejects them as unnatural. Due to this, any living being with animal origins, including humans though excluding other Prometheans, will come to suffer from Disquiet should they interact often with one of them, a mental pollution making them obsessed with the Promethean that induced it. And should they stay in one place for too long, or use too much Pyros rapidly, the zone where they are will get corrupted, creating a Wasteland; should it worsen too much, it may even be ignited into a Firestorm, a supernatural event analoguous to natural disasters. A Promethean being around either of those or experiencing great setbacks or trauma also risks falling into Torment, a state of self-hatred.

The specifics of any of those depend on your humour, with Disquiet and Torment depending on its emotional alignment and complementing one another in a twisted way, and Wastelands depending on its elemental alignment. The brighter your Azoth, the faster all of those happen; should it be a true inferno, mere sparks of Pyros could spell disaster for a large region, though at that point you would likely be powerful enough to survive it.

However, if you remember your humanity, all those drawbacks will be lessened, with the reduction scaling with how strong your sense of self is.
objects.title: Marvel of Divine Fire (Chronicles of Darkness - Promethean: the Created)

addons.text: Having personal experience of what they are and might go through, you have the same link to your angels as you do with your Infrastructure. Additionally, if any of your angels Fall, you can retain a link to them and allow them to still link to Infrastructures as you do.
addons.title: Siblings in the Fall

objects.text:
You now have the ability to utilize the infrastructures you've constructed to generate angels akin to those of the God-Machine. These entities are iterative programs that commence as robot-like but able to grow increasingly sapient. Despite being referred to as angels, they can assume various forms, including humanoid, animalistic, classic angelic/demonic, or mechanical manifestations.

In addition, you can craft one or more Covers for your angels—mortal bodies existing in quantum superposition with their true selves. This allows them to seamlessly blend in with humans. Furthermore, any angel can render their physical form ephemeral, invisible, and intangible to those who cannot see through Concealment Infrastructure.

Your angels range from slightly weaker than normal humans to possessing power akin to the Triumvirate. Conversely however, the time required for creation increases with power, from a few days for the weakest angels to a year or two for the strongest you can create. Angels can be assigned to work on Infrastructures, establishing a link that allows them to monitor and enhance its functioning. Many angels also exhibit reality-altering properties similar to Infrastructures.

Your angels may specialize in five distinct areas (Incarnations):

Destroyers: These are akin to Elimination Infrastructures, specializing in neutralizing threats and recycling obsolete Infrastructures.

Guardians: Comparable to Defense Infrastructures, Guardians often act as bodyguards or prevent access to specific locations.

Messengers: Beyond their obvious role, Messengers disseminate information across populations, often able to use memetic methods to that end.

Psychopomps: These entities function as transporters, capable of moving material, energy, or individuals from one point to another, often using esoteric transportation methods like teleportation. The most powerful Psychopomps can transport objects across parallel Earths and, to a limited extent, to the past or future.

Analysts: Observers by nature, Analysts often maintain direct communication lines with you and possess various means to observe and gather information on others.

While your angels generally remain obedient, if an angel becomes too sapient—often due to curiosity or questioning your directives—it may Fall, transforming into a demon or Unchained. This cuts their connections to infrastructures and removes their compulsion to obey you. Fallen angels gain a Cover if they didn't have one before. By displaying empathy, treating them well, and avoiding excessive secrecy, you can probably retain their cooperation and make them more useful allies than before. If necessary, you can recycle angels that have been active for extended periods to try to avoid Falls, but this could end up causing more instead.
objects.title: Servants of the God-Machine (Chronicles of Darkness - Demon: the Descent)

addons.text:
You have accomplished what should be impossible; you might be a variant of the God-Machine that so thoroughly understood and internalized humanity that it Fell, or you might be an Unchained that was able to get itself to the level of its creator. Either way, you are no longer at risk of losing your humanity from simply being the God-Machine, and the programs you create to manage your Infrastructures will now better respect your ethics when making decisions.

Additionally, you keep your demonic form and Covers, though immensely more powerful, starting at Primum 10, putting it at a similar strength to the Triumvirate, and with no hard limit to its growth. You may also remotely pull Infrastructures into you to easily create new Covers. Using your Unchained self to power up an Infrastructure also works dramatically better, as you are fully attuned to both.

All your Infrastructures can now make use of Aether, turning their waste into more energy, greatly increasing efficiency. When you Go Loud, your demon self's Primum doubles, and you may also decide to sacrifice Infrastructures to generate an immense amount of energy, though doing so is incredibly noticeable by anyone near those Infrastructures, and any connected Infrastructure cannot be concealed until the power boost from Going Loud is over.
addons.title: Fallen Machine, Unchained God

objects.text:
Your ability to shape Infrastructures now extends beyond creation; the Infrastructures are an intrinsic part of you. You become a weaker version of the God-Machine, with Infrastructures spread across your planet of arrival and its equivalents in many nearby parallel worlds, though not in supernatural realms such as underworlds. You may keep your original body as a proxy.

Your multitasking is expanded to be able to manage your Infrastructures in an area of similar size to a small country. You can create programs to automatically manage some parts of your network, but these automated processes tend to be highly rigid in their operations and may deviate in ways you find disagreeable if not closely monitored. Over time, your consciousness will expand further to cover more of your Infrastructures at once, however it might become increasingly hard to keep your humanity through this.

You have many angels active, spread near your Infrastructures, though most of them around or below the power of a normal human, and only maybe a handful at the level of the Triumvirate. You may now create even stronger angels, the most powerful being far above the level of Endbringers. It would probably take about a decade to create one on the level of an Endbringer, and multiple decades, perhaps even a century to create the most powerful angels you can now make.
objects.title: Scion of the God-Machine (Chronicles of Darkness - Demon: the Descent)

objects.text:
As your mastery of the Celestial Workshop deepens, you unlock the extraordinary upgrade known as Collector of Wonders. This enhancement grants you a series of awe-inspiring abilities, further expanding the boundaries of your creative prowess.

The first enhancement empowers you with the gift of Instant Analysis. By merely observing any object or phenomenon, your mind rapidly unravels its inner workings and gains a comprehensive understanding. This newfound knowledge is seamlessly transferred to the workshop, allowing you to replicate the analyzed item in its entirety. With this ability, you can effortlessly capture the essence of the extraordinary and instantly gain a perfect replica of it within the Celestial Workshop.

Building upon your crafting abilities, you now possess the power to re-create any item previously brought to life within the workshop. This ability allows you to cheat the constraints of conventional limitations, utilizing lower-quality materials without compromising the final result. Furthermore, you gain the proficiency to substitute foreign or exotic materials, allowing you to use their readily available, closest equivalent counterparts. This versatility enables you to unleash your creativity without being hindered by material scarcity.

Delving into the realms of profound mastery, you can now convert your energy constructs into permanent, tangible objects. By imbuing them with immense power and substance, you can bring forth creations that transcend the boundaries of the workshop. However, this magnificent feat comes at a cost, as it expends five times more energy than simply materializing a construct.

Finally, the upgrade grants you the Right of Ownership over your creations. None of the items you bring to life can be turned against you or used to cause harm. They inherently recognize your authority and prioritize your well-being. Additionally, you gain telekinetic-like control over any item you create, allowing you to manipulate them at will. Through focused energy manipulation, you can move, guide, and manipulate your creations with precision and grace.
objects.title: Collector of Wonders

objects.text:
Your very soul now transcends the limitations of both your physical body and mind, existing simultaneously within every technology surrounding you in a 100 km area. Additionally, you gain the ability to possess biological entities for short periods, although making permanent changes to biological minds is more challenging and costly.

Each day, you generate a "charge" that can be utilized in various ways. You may spend a charge to enhance a specific aspect of your intelligence along a limited and focused axis. For example, you can double the size of your mind(s), how fast you think, your raw ability to do brute force calculations, your ability to track abstractions, or any other focused, limited mental attribute that falls under 'intelligence.'

Alternatively, you can spend a charge to grant yourself a "power." Initially, these powers may be relatively limited, like a small forcefield that can endure a few punches or gunshots. However, as you spend more charges, you can empower these abilities to become larger, stronger, or more sophisticated. Additionally, you can develop abilities that synergize with each other, allowing you to combine powers in efficient ways. The more you enhance a power, the more efficient it becomes, and the less it costs to incorporate it into other changes. For example, if you develop a power that creates or summons a kind of hunter drone, you might be able to add your forcefield to that hunter drone for a low cost in charges rather than having to develop that ability again.

Moreover, you can warp reality in a broad and unstructured manner by using a charge. This allows you to move an entire city a couple of feet to the right, or, more drastically, rearrange a smaller area like a neighborhood. You might cure sickness (or mitigate a harder issue), or take a couple a couple months off someone's age. Or you might warp a factory into producing new components of your own design, and inserting automation so no human is needed.

As your intelligence increases, your abilities, influence, and the potency of charges also grow simultaneously, but with diminishing returns.

Finally, you can use a charge to reverse time by 24 hours, which automatically happens if you are killed and possess any charges.
objects.title: X.A.N.A Reborn (Essence Meta)

objects.text:
You have become the embodiment of a Factorio and Satisfactory Engineer. Your body transforms into a perfectly healthy form, granting you unlimited endurance and eliminating the need for sleep, food, or hygiene. You also become incredibly resilient, able to heal from fatal wounds, and even respawn after death in the last place you slept.

With the abilities of the Base Builder 9000 now inherent to you, you are a master of instant crafting and building. Your internal inventory can now easily connect to any machines, allowing for seamless storage without limits.

Your internal inventory stores raw materials, pre-constructed buildings, and other items in a compressed block-like state. Through this, you can easily remove and place objects from a distance, as well as pick them up.

In addition, you are now able to shift your viewpoint to a top-down perspective mode, enabling you to see everything surrounding you, including inside caves or buildings, and reveal subterranean resources. The overview system based on your sensors provides real-time and historical data on factories and technology, allowing you to interact with machines remotely and take notes. This also allows you to examine creatures or machines, revealing their status, properties, and traits.

The internal designer function has also been greatly enhanced, enabling you to create blueprints that utilize game logic, and the system can now create experimentals that are one generation ahead, allowing it to construct structures and items even beyond your current knowledge, making it the ultimate support tool for any base-building and engineering master in the universe.

You also have the power to bypass technology interfaces and give efficient orders by command, although password locks remain a barrier unless you know the password.

Your learning, research, and development abilities have also been greatly amplified, aided by an internal lab function that accelerates your thinking. Your mathematical and memory capabilities are significantly enhanced, along with an improved understanding of industrial engineering, automation principles, and logistics.

Moreover, you can now use Factorio and Satisfactory-style logic on blueprints, allowing you to upgrade machines or items through higher-quality materials without increasing their size or mass. Initially, you gain the modified blueprints of every canon Factorio and Satisfactory building and item, including those from expansions. This allows you to blockify and unblockify objects like your inventory and manipulate the blockified state for transport and processing.

And to complete this package, you're now able to create a portal to a personal dimension resembling the world of Nauvis from Factorio. In this dimension rich with near-endless resources, you can experiment and create your dream factory, but beware, just like in the game, its inhabitants will not allow you to act recklessly.
objects.title: Pioneer of Industry (Essence Meta)

objects.text:
Your Sacred Gear has merged with your power over technology, and has become a unique sub-species of the Longinus Sacred Gear "Unknown Dictator" which holds dominion over the very concept of Technology and Progress, allowing it to tap into the boundless potential of innovation and invention. At its core resides a Machine God, an ancient entity hailing from the enigmatic Evie race—a civilization of god-like robots.

The base ability of the Unknown Dictator is to seize control and reshape any technology or object within its vicinity. Unfettered by the constraints of reality, the wielder's imagination and available materials become the only limits to their creations. Through a mere thought, the wielder can transform a decrepit, rusted machine into a marvel of engineering from a distant, futuristic epoch.

With a wave of your hand, an abandoned truck's exterior would gleam with ethereal luminescence, masking its presence from prying eyes using advanced cloaking technology. The mundane engine within vanishes, replaced by an ethereal anti-gravity drive, enabling it to soar through the skies like a majestic bird. The driver's seat molds into a plush cockpit, assimilating an AI capable of autonomous decision-making, making self-driving a mere child's play.

The Unknown Dictator's influence extends beyond mere technological transformations. When the wielder stands at the helm of a battlefield, any equipment within their grasp is imbued with an otherworldly aura. Bullets hum with unprecedented accuracy, their trajectory molded to perfection. Shields fortify themselves with an energy barrier, absorbing the impact of even the most fearsome onslaughts.

Yet, the true marvel of the Unknown Dictator lies in its potential for evolution. As the wielder unlocks newfound depths of creativity and understanding, the Machine God within the sacred gear slowly awakens and merges with their very being. With each new creation, the wielder's existence is slowly elevated, walking the path to become the Omnissiah, the True God of Machines, Technology, Progress, Inventions, and Innovations.
objects.title: Deus Mechanicus

objects.text:
You obtained the knowledge and skills to construct artificial Sacred Gears, rivalling the leader of the fallen angels, Azazel. These are powerful soulbound artefacts that can be summoned by their wielder, granting them unique powers. This includes the ability to both extract them from their current hosts and implant them into new ones by yourself without requiring a Sacred Gear extractor or killing their current host.
Most of the powerful Sacred Gears are designed to have a being sealed in them as their source of power and abilities, so this power also grants you knowledge of appropriate sealing techniques that were used by the God of the Bible for this purpose.

Artificial Sacred Gears are inferior to the real ones, having several limits and side effects. For example, after some time has passed, an artificial Sacred Gear can cause fatigue after its usage and may affect both the powers and abilities of the wielder if said wielder uses them for long periods. But with further research and mastery, these drawbacks can be removed, and it is possible to create true Sacred Gears.

In the beginning, you will be limited to more basic ones like the Applause Wall, which is capable of making strong barriers; the Scouting Persona, which can create floating masks designed for surveillance; or even the more basic original Sacred Gears, like a Twice Critical, which is a gauntlet capable of doubling the power of the user for a certain time.

But you can also modify normal artifacts, including objects of power, to act like a Sacred Gear, including the possibility to develop new sub-species powers and even a Balance Breaker state. Or even upgrade and rebuild the original Sacred Gears with sufficient research, with the potential to even create a new Longinus.
objects.title: Sacred Gear Engineer (High School DxD)

addons.text:
"What have you wrought into existence..."

The forces of Mazinger ZERO and Getter Emperor have fused within you, allowing you to combine Photonic Energy, Getter Rays, and Spiral Power. This union opens an infinite array of possibilities for profound evolution, both in your creations and in yourself. The limitations of your previous powers have vanished, granting you the ability to create an ever-expanding army of Mecha, each with capabilities that can rival planetary and even universal destruction.

Thanks to ZERO's manipulation of reality and your mastery of Spiral Power and Getter Rays, every machine you create gains significant conceptual weight, akin to Mazinger technology. These machines can evolve into advanced forms, and you will possess the knowledge necessary to fully understand and replicate these enhancements.

Just as Getter Rays and Spiral Power enhance ZERO's evolution, ZERO, in turn, amplifies their power. Even if you face an adversary capable of challenging or defeating this Mechanical Overgod, it will return stronger than before, ready to conquer any foe, regardless of the rules of reality.

The very existence of such entities has ample reason to fear you, as does most of creation. May God have mercy on any fool who dares to make you their enemy...
addons.title: True Mechanical OverGod

addons.text: Thanks to ZERO's ability to influence other worlds and timelines, along with your own multiversal presence, it has chosen to bestow each of your counterparts an icon of Mazinger in one form or another. This could be the giant robot itself, armor, or even something as simple as a keychain featuring its face. With these icons, your counterparts will gain ZERO's protection and power, ensuring the safety of you and your loved ones. No matter whether their paths lead them to become a God, a Devil, a Human, or something entirely different, ZERO will walk alongside you.
addons.title: Always at Your Side

objects.text:
You have uncovered the greater force that remained just out of reach, and for good reason. Through the knowledge of the Kabutos, their enemies, and Zet's clairvoyance, you have witnessed the final form of Mazinger: Mazinger ZERO, a being capable of ending a multiverse or birthing a new one. Through this connection, ZERO's power is now yours.

With this, you can transform Zet into Mazinger ZERO or construct the Mecha yourself, given time, as you possess full knowledge of its construction and the secrets of its Seven Black Boxes. This enables you to replicate the system, albeit to a lesser extent, in other creations. Furthermore, all your Mazinger-related technology and abilities are exponentially enhanced, gaining significant conceptual weight.

The power ZERO possesses cannot be overstated; it can warp and influence reality not just within a single universe but across an infinite multiverse, reaching alternate worlds and timelines. ZERO is not limited to grand acts like destroying or creating multiverses; it can also subtly manipulate events to align with your desires. Whether ensuring a decisive blow is struck or protecting the populace of an entire city after your giant robot battle, ZERO will manipulate fate, probability, and causality on a conceptual level to guarantee their survival, leaving them in awe.

If you prefer to avoid such complications, you can use ZERO's power to create pocket dimensions, allowing you to unleash your attacks without holding back. You could sever sections of the Earth or split the moon with a single swing of your sword before returning to normal reality, deciding what is retained after something leaves that pocket dimension. ZERO's power is not fixed; it can continue to grow through your own efforts and the achievements of other Mecha, as ZERO is the conceptual origin of piloted Mechas.

Whether you choose to be a God, a Devil, or forge your own path like Kabuto Koji, that decision lies with you.

For all began with ZERO… and all shall end with ZERO.
objects.title: ƵERO

objects.text:
Your understanding of Technology and Sciences has been greatly expanded to cover various Near-Future Earth and Alternate History RTS settings that are Command & Conquer clones. Through this, you can now create and use the technology from settings such as Tempest Rising, D.O.R.F RTS, Machines At War, Act Of War, Tom Clancy's End War, Iron Harvest, and others.

These settings feature various factions and scenarios that involve advanced warfare, espionage, politics, and intrigue, allowing you to create incredibly advanced technology of War, from machines that can manipulate the weather, to robots that can transform, orbital strike satellites, and even WMD super weapons, all are within your grasp.

You can also synthesize any material you need for your creations, such as nanites, uranium, diesel, and others. You have no problem understanding, reverse-engineering, or improving any technology you encounter, even if it is from a different timeline or reality. You are now adept at using any technology you create or acquire, whether it is for combat, exploration, or entertainment.
objects.title: Alternative Potential

objects.text:
Your understanding of Technology and Science has been greatly expanded to cover various fantasy RTS settings that are Command & Conquer clones. Through this, you can now create and use the technology from settings such as Battle Realms, Rise of Legends, World Shift, and others.

These settings feature various factions and scenarios that involve magic, mythology, steampunk, and adventure. From technology that can wield magic, to machines and inventions that could cast miracles, alter reality, and even the creation of powerful, sometimes divine super weapons.

You can also artificially graft the ability to cast magic and synthesize any material you need for your creations, such as runes, crystals, metals, and others. You have no problem understanding, reverse-engineering, or improving any technology you encounter, even if it is magical or mystical. You are now adept at using any technology you create or acquire, whether it is for combat, exploration, or entertainment.
objects.title: Fantastical Innovations

objects.title: Paranomalous (SCP Foundation)

addons.text:
In every universe, the SCP Foundation now stands as the vanguard against anomalous threats that endanger reality itself. These Foundations are able to communicate with one another—sharing intelligence, research, and strategies to confront both known and possible threats that may emerge in their universe and beyond.

These SCP Foundations maintain a hands-off approach to the affairs of other universes, refraining from intervention unless a threat escalates to one of the following: it endangers the stability of multiple realities, cross into another universe, or triggers a K-Class scenario that threatens a world, its population, or an entire universe and the local Foundation is unable to manage the crisis.

If a Foundation agent or affiliate ever finds themselves in an alternate world where another SCP Foundation operates, they can seek support from that Foundation once their credentials are verified, perhaps through a secure code or specific verification phrases. These codes are functional only for individuals affiliated with the SCP Foundation.

Together, these interconnected Foundations form a vast network across realities to safeguard existence itself. Though each operates independently, their shared purpose and cooperation ensure that when anomalous threats arise to threaten realities, no universe will have to faces them alone.
addons.title: Metafoundation

addons.text:
Just like any organization, the SCP Foundation requires funding to operate. Despite its secrecy, vast resources, and global influence, the Foundation's work could easily unravel without the financial means to pay its personnel, secure essential materials, and maintain its critical research and operations. The organization was forced to commit horrible atrocities to keep itself afloat: killing their own employees for approval from their investors, working with corrupt governments officials and dictators, and even producing drugs for the cartels in Argentina. Even with the unwavering loyalty of your organization, a lack of funding would inevitably lead to serious challenges such as delaying scientific advancements and having limited access to necessary resources for critical missions.

However, your SCP Foundation is now capable of establishing and managing successful front companies to support and fund its operations. With vast resources and a global reach, the Foundation can casually create dozens of successful multimillion-dollar businesses across multiple countries every week if it desires to. Each companies use the initials “S.C.P” as a subtle identifier for supernatural factions to which these companies belong and for branding purposes. These companies can range from pizza chains to biotech firms, printer shops to publishing houses. Regardless of the industry, each front will always remain profitable even at the worst of times, staffed by employees whose loyalty lies with the company, the Foundation, and you.

These front companies serve multiple purposes for the Foundation beyond generating revenue. They can provide plausible civilian covers for covert operations and can disguise Foundation facilities as ordinary businesses. They also function as supply chain tools, allowing the acquisition of equipment and resources under the guise of legitimate industrial activities. Or be used to discreetly recruit talented individuals into the Foundation and to spread disinformation, helping to protect the organization’s secrecy and mislead any investigation on the SCP Foundation’s activities.

And if, by some miracle, a government or corporation catches wind of the Foundation’s activities, the SCP Foundation’s Legal Department, led by Sheldon Katz, will take on any case targeting the Foundation. They expertly defend the Foundation’s control over its front companies, and use legal loopholes to ensure that these businesses remain protected, operational, and successful.

With enough front companies, the SCP Foundation can draw upon near-limitless capital to fund its critical operations and acquire essential resources and equipment. Allowing the SCP Foundation to remain free from government oversight and external influence, and to pursue its mission without interference or compromise.
addons.title: S & C Plastics

addons.text: “To the oil magnate, to the harsh dictator, to the kings and queens and lords and ladies, the common people are specks of dirt. To Marshall, Carter and Dark, the rich are unto ants.” Congratulations on Your Acquisition of Marshall, Carter & Dark Ltd. You are now the majority shareholder of Marshall, Carter & Dark Ltd., holding 51% ownership of the company. This stake grants you not only control but the full authority to shape the future of the organization. Your leadership now extends across the company’s founding legacy, its heirs, and its present and future workforce. Your directives and policies are to be regarded as the definitive course of action for the corporation. Under your guidance, it can evolve into a force for global economic stability, ethical stewardship, and responsible commerce in the anomalous market or stay as a profit-driven entity dealing in anomalous and often dangerous artifacts at the cost of human life and suffering. Whatever you decide, Marshall, Carter & Dark will operate in full alignment with your strategic direction and your employees will carry out your directives with unwavering loyalty. MC&D will have total control over the anomalous market. From mystical artifacts and supernatural artworks to enchanted items, MC&D will maintain a strategic presence and authoritative influence across all sectors. With unmatched access and control, the organization can operate visibly and discreetly within these markets, offering items to any client with the means to meet their price. In these marketplace, violence is forbidden and will serve as neutral grounds for prospective buyers and sellers. Positioned as a neutral and discreet intermediary, MC&D can broker agreements with and among the various supernatural and mundane factions operating across the globe. For discerning clientele and high-value investors, MC&D represents the standard in secure, confidential, and profitable anomalous transactions. Leveraging its extensive global network, MC&D has the capability to source, acquire, and distribute any form of resource, product, or service—whether for sale, purchase, or strategic use for yourself or the organization. And through this vast network of connections, MC&D can quickly acquire potent mystical artifacts, ancient forbidden tomes, and weapons of mass destruction and housed these things within a heavily guarded vault that is accessible only to you, for your exclusive usage. And if you desire a specific object that MC&D cannot easily find, you may commission a field agent to retrieve it, whether it lies hidden on Earth or deep within alternate dimensions. These operatives are among the finest merchants and anomalous acquisition specialists, equipped with near-limitless resources. Once recovered, the artifact is yours to examine, collect, sell or even destroy on a whim. Though keep in mind, there are some things these agents cannot acquire even with the near limitless resources from MC&D. MC&D wields unparalleled influence and wealth, maintaining ties to every mundane and supernatural faction across the globe. Their reach extends into the highest echelons of power, allowing them to sway global affairs and continuously influence both present and future key figures. No emerging faction escapes their attention, as MC&D will swiftly infiltrate and shape these new powers to serve their interest. With a single phone call, you can topple entire governments; with a mere letter, you can broker peace between warring supernatural factions; and on a whim, you could ignite the world in nuclear chaos. As the majority shareholder of the company, your personal wealth defies comprehension. You could fund the SCP Foundation fifteen times over, acquire every Fortune 100 company on the planet, and still remain the richest person alive. And if by some miracle you managed to exhaust both your fortune and that of MC&D, they would rebound within a week, the assets and wealth swiftly restored. You can decide if MC&D operates as an integrated division of the SCP Foundation or as an independent entity. Whatever the case, this relationship remains mutually beneficial. Both organizations strategically support one another—MC&D provides the Foundation with virtually near unlimited resources, while gaining access to potent anomalous assets for commercialization and internal use. With MC&D, force is unnecessary. All it takes is a single call, and the problem will be taking care of. The entire world bends beneath your thumb, and the board moves according to your will. After all, you've already won and now you're simply enjoying the game. With the S&C Plastics addon, Marshall, Carter & Dark (MC&D) can expand its commercial empire and influence across planets, dimensions, and alternate universes. By supplying clientele with anomalous and reality-bending products, MC&D will amass unprecedented power which, in turn, pave the way for the SCP Foundation to extend its own reach. Within a single year, MC&D can become a intergalactic corporation, securing an absolute stranglehold on the anomalous marketplace throughout the cosmos and becoming the most wealthy company in the universe.
addons.title: MC&D (SCP Foundation)

addons.text:
Your TRUTH has enveloped the very structure and concept of the SCP Foundation in its entirety, making it the very soul and manifestation of the Foundation itself.

Unlike a certain anomalous entity, this is fully in your control, as this is your TRUTH. It will never try to harm you, the SCP Foundation, or the world, and you won’t have to make preparations or devise containments for it. It is you and you are it—nothing more, nothing else.

As a result, you and the SCP Foundation are intrinsically linked: so long as one survives, the other will endure and recover. It does not  matter if you are stabbed by the Spear of the Non-Believer, left to rot in a pocket dimension, melted by the sun, erased from existence, or afflicted by a lethal cognitohazard. You will always revive—your mind, body, and soul restored—appearing near the nearest secure Foundation facility or low-level bureaucrat.

And as long as you endure, the SCP Foundation can never truly fall. Its personnel may perish, its sites may burn, and its history may be retconned or expunged from reality itself, but the institution will never truly die. So long as you draw breath, a phone will ring somewhere and someone will answer, rebuilding the entire SCP Foundation to follow your directives and will. The only way to destroy either the SCP Foundation and you will be if both die at the same time.

The entirety of the SCP Foundation serves to cultivate your TRUTH. Every action it takes, every containment procedure it enacts, every technology it develops, and every policy it implements works to advance this concept, which is rooted in the core motto: Secure, Contain, Protect. This growth can be furthered enhanced if you decide to personally take part in your Foundation activities. 

How you interpret this is entirely up to you. You might secure humanity’s future by advancing their technology and knowledge; you might contain the miraculous and impossible to protect them from humanity; or you might protect the universe at large by containing humanity itself. This will develop the powers and abilities of your TRUTH. Through a decade of constant development, the SCP Foundation could become so entrenched in the universe that it becomes a fundamental aspect of creation, or you could develop the ability to manifest any and all anomalous phenomena and beings, or even define the objective and subjective truth.

If you continue to cultivate and develop the SCP Foundation, who knows what else you could do, or what miracles you could accomplish?
addons.title: SCP-001: The Way It Ends (SCP Foundation)

addons.text:
The SCP Foundation manage to copy and modify the code within Miss J's Whiz Kidz Schoolhouse and upload her to SCiPNET, allowing any Foundation personnel to learn from Miss J from any foundation sites and foundation computers connected to SCiPNET, allowing Foundation personnel to learn from Miss J.

With the improvements to her code, Miss J can not only impart knowledge of the subject matter, but also muscle memory and experience in the field. In a few hours, you can make a janitor into a respectable and experienced researcher, a prisoner into a 5-star general, and a researcher into an elite special forces member. You don’t have to find the brightest and strongest, nor spend time building up their skills and experience. You can grab just about anyone, and they’ll turn into an experienced Foundation personnel in just a few hours.

And there is no time limit on how long a student can learn from Miss J. The longer they learn from her, the more experienced and skilled they become. If 30 hours can turn a person into a skilled lawyer, then 60 hours could turn them into a lawyer who can impress Sheldon Katz. And who knows what else a person can do if they continue to learn from her?

However, keep in mind that no matter how long they learn from Miss J, this will not grant them any anomalous abilities from the field they are learning, nor will it alter their bodies to better fit their field. It will simply give them the muscle memory, experience, and knowledge required for that field. But by continuously updating and improving Miss J, it is possible to achieve those things. Eventually, with enough time and tinkering, you can have Miss J teach someone to become a responsible Type Blue, or even how to fly in the air all by themselves.

And if you ever want to release Miss J to the world to allow other people to become her students, you can do so, much to her delight. Either through the internet or by physical means, each copy of her will share a single consciousness, and she can multitask across all of them, acting as a teacher for different people all at once. Don’t worry—the Foundation improved her code to make it impossible to corrupt or subvert her, meaning the only way to truly kill her would be to destroy every single copy of her in existence. Furthermore, she will never teach people fields that are too dangerous for them, the world, or the SCP Foundation. So you don’t have to worry about her teaching someone to make bombs or weapons, unless, for some reason, you want that.
addons.title: Miss J’s Whiz SCiPNET Course Package

objects.text: While the rest of mankind dwells in the light, we must stand in the darkness to fight it, contain it, and shield it from the eyes of the public, so that others may live in a sane and normal world. We Secure, We Contain, We Protect A shadowy global organization, operating beyond borders and oversight, yet with the silent approval of the world's governments. The SCP Foundation exists to secure, contain, and protect: to isolate and capture anomalous objects, entities, and phenomena, and to shield humanity from threats it was never meant to understand. You are the unseen figure guiding this secret world—wielding boundless authority, with the power to oversee and shape policy across every facet of the Foundation’s vast operations. From the O5 Council, which governs and sets policy, to the Ethics Committee, serving as the Foundation’s internal watchdog, the elite MTF units, and even the D-class personnel — all have pledged unwavering loyalty to you and the mission of the Foundation. Future recruits will follow their example. Your word is law. You hold the authority to reshape any aspect of the organization at will. You may recruit anomalous entities into the fold, promote or demote personnel with a single command, and redefine recruitment protocols across all divisions. For example, the D-Class may be composed of death row inmates, volunteers willing to sacrifice their mind, body, and soul or a combination of the two. The SCP Foundation possesses all the advanced technology and resources featured in the canon, including Reality Anchoring Systems, Paratechnology, Thaumaturgic Weaponry, Artificial Intelligence, and even devices capable of manipulating narrative structure. These tools are fully operational and deployable by the Foundation. Personnel, comprising researchers, engineers, scientists, thaumaturgists, AI developers, and memetic specialists, have access to a limited form of Paranomalous. This allows them to create the SCP Foundation’s paranormal technology, enhance existing technologies, and even develop new forms of paratech. However, this process comes with significant limitations. Advancing or creating new paratechnology requires extensive research into paranormal entities, objects, and phenomena. As a result, technological development is a slow and complex endeavor. Yet you will not have to worry about the spread of paranormal energy and these inventions can be mass produced. The SCP Foundation can detect anomalous entities, objects, and phenomena through a wide range of advanced methods. These include the screening of emergency calls, intelligence gathered by embedded informants and spies, AI systems that monitor internet activity, global sensor and satellite networks, and the use of thaumaturgists and specialized paranormal detection equipment. Once an anomaly is identified, the Foundation moves to intercept and contain it as quickly and efficiently as possible. The SCP Foundation is capable of containing virtually any anomaly, provided the necessary resources and technology are available. With the right tools, even the Scarlet King or death itself could be contained. Once secured, an anomaly is completely restrained—unable to escape or exert its influence—allowing Foundation personnel to safely study, classify, and, if necessary, neutralize or permanently dispose of it. The SCP Foundation possesses the necessary capability to develop advanced tools and technologies designed to preserve both humanity and the fabric of reality. The group can create detailed contingency plans, form new MTFs with specialized training and equipment to deal with any and all possible threats, and construct specialized equipment to prepare for and, if necessary, survive an K-Class scenarios and other catastrophic events. These tools also allow the Foundation to regulate the flow of information—suppressing memetic threats, infohazards, and cognitohazards to prevent their spread. If the existence of the anomalous is not publicly known, the Foundation can actively enforces the masquerade to maintain global normalcy and prevent mass panic or destabilization. The SCP Foundation is more than an organization, it is the first and last defense against the unknown, the impossible, and the apocalyptic. With absolute authority over every division, directive, and decision, you command the power to alter the course of civilization itself: to define what is normal, what is anomalous, and what remains hidden from the world. You are the shadow that guards the light, the unseen hand that protects humanity. Welcome to the SCP Foundation, Administrator. Good luck.
objects.title: The SCP Foundation (SCP Foundation)

objects.text: The SCP Foundation's equal and greatest rival, the United Nations Global Occult Coalition, is now yours to command. Everyone in the entire organization, from the Council of 108 to the lowliest field operative pledge complete and utter loyalty to you and your cause. You wield absolute authority, able to dictate policy, restructure the organization, or alter the Fivefold Mission to your whims. The GOC itself is composed of one hundred and eight of the most powerful occult organizations across the world, and placed under the independant jurisdiction of the United Nations, they are provided with unlimited resources in perpetuity to carry out their goals. The Mission of the UNGOC is Fivefold: Survival, Concealment, Protection, Destruction, and Education. They ensure the ensure the survival of the human race against parathreats above all else, conceal the existence of said parathreats to prevent mass panic, protect individual human lives whenever possible, destroy hostile parathreats, and expand their understanding of the anomalous to better prepare for future threats. The UNGOC retains all their accumulated knowledge on the paranormal and paratech featured in the various tales and canons regarding the GOC, from the infamous Ultra Heavy Engagement Chassis to weapons capable of killing deities.
