Given sufficient preparation and resources, the militant PHYSICS Division of the UNGOC has the capacity to liquidate virtually all parathreats it encounters. And once a threat is neutralized, it stays dead. The R&D teams in the UNGOC's PTOLEMY Division have access to a limited variant of Paranomalous, allowing them to reproduce the existing technologies of the UNGOC and even slowly develop new forms of paratech to help combat both present and future threats. However, they will not be able to reproduce any technology wholly created and used by the SCP Foundation such as their Eigenweapons. Although they may eventually be able to with your guidance. The ambitions of the Coalition do not end at militant pursuits. As a political entity, the UNGOC is well versed in diplomatic matters regarding the anomalous. With the PSYCHE Division being tasked to maintain diplomatic contact with non-hostile occult powers to maintain peace between them and humanity as well as observation for emerging parathreats. Furthermore, the International Court For the Paranormal manages all major international cases related to the paranormal community. As for its other Divisions, the Coalition's PNEUMA Division is tasked with threat detection, planting hidden operatives in both mundane governments and rival organizations, gathering vital information for the operations of the GOC. Furthermore, they make use of technologies such as Kant Counters to proactively identify potential parathreats across the globe. The CAULATICA Division spearheads Concealment operations, performing cover-ups and disinformation campaigns to keep the anomalous a secret from the world at large. Finally, there is the PANGAEA Division. It is the last resort of the UNGOC, only to be used in the most dire circumstances such as eschatological events. The Division consists of the UNGOC's most powerful assets, such as former parathreats who have pledged allegiance to the GOC, and an army of reanimated super soldiers under the ZED Division. The PANGAEA Division is the Coalition's last line of defense, only deployed when the world itself is at stake. In short, the UNGOC is the single highest authority in identifying, neutralizing, and containing parathreats. Superseding all national, international, and otherwise corporeal interests. Make humanity proud, Undersecretary-General.
objects.title: The Global Occult Coalition (SCP Foundation)

addons.text:
In a world where order and civilization are nothing but mere facades over the endless abyss of unimaginable possibilities of the Anomalous…

The answer is to fight fire with fire.

The answer is Valravn.

The Valravn Corporation is an Anomalous Private Military Company, in other words, mercenaries. As a private army-for-hire at the behest of the highest bidder, it commands a highly trained force recruited from ex-operatives of the best anomalous and non-anomalous armies of this world… and others.

You are now one of its best assets, connected to the Retroactive Unified Neural Network Escathological System (RUNNES), a powerful predictive system powered by ancient runic magic and artificial intelligence, containing technological and thaumaturgical base of the Company and its sub-divisions, your body is enhanced with cutting-edge paratech and mystical runes, merging modern warfare with arcane power. As a premier mercenary for Valravn, you embody a fully integrated skill set honed through rigorous training that combines tactical precision with esoteric rituals. 

Enhanced reflexes, acute situational awareness, and augmented strength, equal to that of 5 trained men, enable you to dominate chaotic battlefields, while runically inscribed weaponry and armor allow you to channel anomalous energies for both offensive and defensive advantages—turning each conflict into an opportunity to bend situation to your will. Embrace your destiny, Contractor; in the relentless world where ancient magic meets modern technology, you are the ultimate weapon, and with Valravn, you never lose when war is your trade.
addons.title: Valravn Contractor (SCP Foundation)

objects.text:
You’ve been enhanced with next-generation Anderson Robotics technology, becoming a field-grade cyborg equipped for operations far beyond baseline human limits. While not invincible, you are faster, smarter, and more capable—engineered to survive in a world of anomalies.

Your mind is augmented by a neural interface built on Anderson’s Cortex Mesh architecture. This upgrade enhances memory, cognition, and multitasking, letting you process data like a human supercomputer. You instinctively understand and operate Anderson Robotics technology—ranging from utility drones and prosthetics to mid-tier androids. Reverse engineering or improvising AR devices is second nature; with time and materials, you can replicate basic systems like scout drones, turrets, or synthetic limbs—even under duress.

A retinal implant projects a heads-up display across your vision, offering real-time diagnostics, environmental data, and structural, as well as spatial analysis. It also enables short-range wireless interface with nearby systems. While not immune to digital threats, you’re highly resistant to hacking, surveillance, and data corruption. You also carry a failsafe: a localized EMP burst that disables tech in your vicinity — including your own implants, temporary.

Your body is reinforced. Synthetic fiber bundles enhance your musculature, granting roughly triple the strength of a trained human and brief bursts of heightened reflexes or speed. A lightweight alloy scaffold bolsters your bones against blunt trauma. While your skin remains organic, it’s interwoven with semi-material polymer underlayers that begin to exist during impact, offering protection from small arms fire and reducing damage from blades and shrapnel.
You heal faster than average — recovering in days rather than weeks — and can enter a low-metabolism stasis to survive potentially fatal injuries. Biomechanical implant is integrated into your upper digestive tract and sternum, allowing you to safely consume & dissolve ferrous and non-ferrous metals into suitable for use raw material usable by your internal systems for repair and maintenance. 

Most notably, you have partial access to the Anderson Network: a semi-anomalous datacloud containing encrypted research, schematics, and AI intelligence. Occasionally, you receive bursts of insight—blueprints, fragments of machine thought, or behavioral data from other anomalous systems. The information is unpredictable, overwhelming at times, but with training, you can learn to harness it—and perhaps one day unlock full access to the network.

You are not immortal. But you are enhanced, upgraded, and connected to a world of synthetic innovation. You are no longer merely human — you are something better, more adapted. And in a world ruled by the anomalous, this may be all you need.
objects.title: Anderson Affiliate (SCP Foundation)

objects.text:
You are now a fully fledged L.E.A.F Leader, capable of creating plants that can grow to the size of humans, talk, and even move. This grants an unparalleled amount of versatility, as each plant has its own unique abilities that allow it to effortlessly defeat most powered individuals, especially in numbers.

Each "Heroic" plant takes at least three times as long to grow as a normal plant, and all plants operate on their in-game logic.
objects.title: Garden Warfare (PVZ)

objects.text:
Delving into the realm of mysticism and the cutting edge, you have unlocked the knowledge to translate magical spells into digital code, allowing them to be uploaded and cast through technological devices. By harnessing the device's inherent power, these spells come to life in extraordinary ways. But the true marvel lies in your ability to manipulate and reshape the very fabric of these spells, for they exist as lines of code waiting to be altered.

While you are not bestowed with limitless freedom in modifying these spells, you hold the power to shape their mechanics and rules to your advantage. Imagine a shield spell that automatically activates under specific conditions, creating an impenetrable barrier just when you need it most. Picture transforming an elemental spell, shifting its control from the fiery embrace of flames to a gentle inferno, or even changing its color to pink.
objects.title: Code Caster

objects.text: Your skill is no longer limited to the works of Men and Dwarves; you now stand with the Smiths of the Elves. You know how to make great works of art and war, such as Orcist and Glamdring. Your skill is great enough to match that of Celebrimbor, who forged the three Rings of Power for the Elves. Your skill is not that of Fëanor, however, and as such, crafting something on the level of the Silmarils is still out of your reach.
objects.title: Elven Smith (Lord of the Rings)

objects.text:
One ring to rule them all, one ring to bind them. You are no longer limited to a mere three rings. You know how to make the works of Sauron, of Mairon. You have learned great “scientific” knowledge from Aulë, allowing you to create great and terrible things such as the Rings and the Fortress of Barad-Dûr. The Rings will no longer corrupt you, as you are their master.

You have also learned the ways to twist man and elf, turning your enemies into faithful servants, such as orcs and Nazgûl. Lastly, you are proficient in the Black Speech, the official language of Mordor.
objects.title: Annatar (Lord of the Rings)

objects.text:
Your skill in Elven smithing has been elevated to the level of Fëanor himself. You can create works on the level of the Silmarils and the Palantíri, and have even learned the secret art of making Silma.

You have even mastered many languages similar to Fëanor, such as Quenya, Sindarin, and Adûnaic, even Rohrric, Khuzdul and Entish.
objects.title: Greatest Smith of the Elves (Lord of the Rings)

objects.text: Aberrations are weaker variations of Abnormalities, and the E.G.O. Equipment from them is also weaker. You can reproduce your unique E.G.Os to create weaker versions of them, with weaker requirements as well.
objects.title: Aberrations (Wonderlab)

objects.text:
Through the extraordinary power of Abnormal Innovation, you gain unparalleled expertise in both scientific and anomalous knowledge from the vast universe of Project Moon. This encompasses a deep understanding of various technologies, entities, anomalies, and their peculiarities across different works such as Lobotomy Corp, Library of Ruina, Limbus Company, and more.

Armed with this combined knowledge, you become a master of management, wielding the ability to create, harness, and control Abnormalities and Distortions with unparalleled skill. You possess the rare ability to study the properties of these enigmatic beings and utilize their unique abilities for a multitude of purposes.

With your comprehensive understanding of the anomalous, you gain the power to manipulate the behaviors of Abnormalities, ensuring your safety while efficiently extracting valuable energy. As a skilled handler, you navigate the intricate and unpredictable nature of these anomalies, unlocking the secrets they hold and utilizing them to your advantage.
objects.title: Abnormal Innovation (Project Moon)

objects.text:
You gain the combined knowledge of the races that have held the Mantle in the Halo universe at their peak.

This includes the profound wisdom and understanding of Humanity, the Forerunners, and the Precursors. This knowledge encompasses a deep comprehension of the fundamental principles governing the universe, including advanced mastery of slipspace and the lost science of Neural Physics, which grants the Precursors absolute mastery over the material world.

This mastery over the fabric of reality goes beyond conventional means, allowing for the creation and manipulation of intricate, nigh-indestructible structures and reality-warping phenomena.
objects.title: Mantle of the Ancients (Halo)

objects.text:
Your knowledge has expanded to include all known technologies of the villainous factions throughout the entire Kamen Rider multiverse. From the time manipulating technology of the Worm’s Zectors to how the original Kamen Rider was made, all of it is in your grasp.

Additionally, you gain knowledge of the different monsters’ biologizes as well. You can raise the dead as Orphnocks, invade reflections with Mirror Monsters, or just make good old-fashioned Cyborg Soldiers. You can’t, however, replicate any magical biologizes. No cloning God for you.

Of course, this all goes without saying, that you gain the technology of Shocker and all its iterations. The most powerful of which is the History Modifying Machine. This machine makes it so that you can not only travel through time and realize different possibilities of what could have happened, but also that any changes to the timeline are applied to your original timeline instead of splitting into a new one. The changes will be reverted if it gets destroyed, but that is rather hard to do, as it also transforms into a giant robot.

You also become a master at planning and a cunning manipulator. You need to get volunteers for these projects somewhere.
objects.title: Shocker (Kamen Rider)

objects.text:
Even the magical knowledge of the Kamen Rider’s foes is not safe from your grasp. Your previous limits on magical biology have been broken as well.

You now gain the knowledge of how to create magic rings to cast spells, Eyecons to bind the souls of the living and deceased, the creation of demons, monsters from stories known as Megids, the manifestation of human malice with Malgams, and more. You additionally gain the magic power necessary to use these items and can even extend your reverse engineering to magic. This does, however, require you to have a physical object related to said magic to be able to study, and it will take twice as long as it would take for normal technology.

Your previous limits on cloning have been broken as well. This also means that you can clone the various godlike beings fought by Kamen Rider throughout history. Controlling them is another matter, though, as they have a large tendency to rebel due to having very large, and not completely unfounded, God complexes.

The greatest knowledge you receive from this would be the knowledge of how to become a god yourself. You don’t automatically become a god, nor does becoming one make you omnipotent. One of the most famous gods in the world of Kamen Rider was beaten by a random space alien after all.
objects.title: Dai-Shocker (Kamen Rider)

addons.text: “The desire to create is one of the deepest yearnings of the human soul.” It’s not just the concept of Perfection that you know how to work with, but of Soul as well. Over time, this will also grow to include other concepts. You’re now capable of reaching into the very souls of others, capable of utilizing a piece of something’s soul in the creation of things. The piece of their souls will immediately regenerate itself to the one it's taken from, unless you will it; otherwise, however, this grants an immense array of possibilities. The first is the ability to imbue objects you’ve created with properties of their original soul source. From powers to knowledge, anything can be imbued with anything. The second ability, and perhaps most important, is that you can now forge items intended for someone, greatly improving and increasing the power it would give them. Almost as if made exactly for them, bound in a way nothing else could. The third and final ability is that you’ve also now gained the ability to forge Inner Beasts yourself, capable of directly forging them out of the souls of others or yourself.
addons.title: Forged in the Soul

objects.text: “Pleasure in the job puts perfection in the work.” Very few have put in the dedication to the craft as you, your very heart and soul going into each creation, regardless of what you make. You’ve gained the incredible ability to imbue objects you create with the concept of Perfection, allowing you to create things such as the Perfect Vehicle, a vehicle that can travel to any destination in an hour, from wherever regardless of distance, space, or even time. Or perhaps a Perfect Meal, a meal so nutritious that when eaten will keep a person full for 100 days without any negative side effects, enhance a person’s natural abilities 10 fold, not to mention so splendid that people would find themselves crying tears of joy upon tasting it. You can choose to imbue the concept into anything and everything you craft. All your abilities related to crafting, technology, or creation in general get a significant boost. You also now find great joy in the process of creation, and are much more creative in general.
objects.title: Perfect Series

objects.text:
Your understanding of the MCU’s technology has expanded dramatically. Now, rather than simply settling for the grounded, you’ve gained the technological prowess of all earthbound inventors across the Marvel Multiverse! The collective works of The Right and the post-human creations of Orchis stand as mere examples in your path of creation, as do singular inventors, such as Stark and Richards.

But this is merely the start. Humanity has become a canvas on which to design your magnum opus! A pathway to the greatest throne and the highest of heavens. If you wish to drag mankind kicking and screaming into a new age, do so. If you would see them as mere resources? Make it so. Your potential is unlimited, but it is up to you to seize it.
objects.title: Doctor Stasis (Marvel)

objects.text:
Your understanding of the MCU’s technology has expanded exponentially. Now, rather than limiting yourself to the backwards world of Earth, you’ve gained knowledge of all the stellar powers of the Marvel Multiverse! The technology of the mighty Shi’ar empire, the xenobiological knowledge of the Skrull, and the superscience of the Taa-ans stand as mere examples on your path of knowledge.

But this is merely the start. The stars are your muse to inspire you to ever greater heights. Dyson spheres in the palm of your hand, empires as vast as your imagination, adaptations that would make earthbound minds weep. Your potential is unlimited, but it is up to you to seize it.
objects.title: Orbis Stellaris (Marvel)

objects.text:
You’ve inherited the full legacy of Earth-616's Victor Von Doom, the ruler of Latveria, without any unwanted changes to your mind and soul.

Your body is in peak human condition, giving you strength and durability on par with Daredevil. But your greatest asset is your mind. Your intellect is on par with Doom’s, processing information as quickly as a sophisticated computer and capable of absorbing vast amounts of data. Combined with immense charisma and an unbreakable will, you can withstand powerful psionics and even the tortures of hell.

You are a polymath of extraordinary ability, with expertise across nearly every scientific field. You can create advanced robots to serve as decoys and perform feats like separating the Hulk from Bruce Banner through neurosurgery. As a warrior and strategist, you can skillfully wield nearly any weapon and possess martial arts skills that let you defeat opponents like Black Panther and Taskmaster in hand-to-hand combat.

Inheriting Doom’s mystical powers, you may not be on the level of the Sorcerer Supreme, but you have the skill and strength in magic to be considered a worthy successor. You can cast mystic blasts, summon demons, travel through dimensions, manipulate elements, and nullify others’ powers. Your true brilliance lies in merging magic and science, creating marvels like the Time Platform, a device capable of altering history itself.

You also have access to Doom’s technology, including his signature armor that enhances your strength above Spider-Man’s level, can withstand blasts from the Infinity Gauntlet, and houses various weapon systems.
objects.title: I, Doom (Marvel)

objects.text:
The scope of your ability to create therianthropes expands significantly, allowing you to not only add insects and arthropods to the pool of your potential splicing-material, but straying from the animal kingdom entirely and using plants for therianthropes with large-scale poison-generation, fungi to give control over certain targets, and even bacteria to create a walking biological WMD if you so choose.

You can also modify a therianthrope's hybrid form to increase its combat viability by, for example, moving a bombardier beetle therianthrope's gas valves or a spider therianthrope's spinnerets from their backside to their hands, or granting therianthropes minor abilities that their corresponding animals don't possess, such as letting a wasp therianthrope fire their stingers as projectiles.

Beyond simply turning humans into therianthropes, your knowledge of genetics also allows you to uplift humans to the same biological pinnacle of human ability that Joseph G. Newton possessed. This procedure does not make them incompatible with the Theriomorphosis Surgery.

Finally, if you wish to keep a bit more control over the therianthropes you create, you can alter the operation so that, instead of being able to transform at will, the user requires a liquid catalyst that they must imbue in some form, either by injecting, ingesting, or inhaling it.

Beyond the field of genetics, you can design and build support equipment for therianthropes that strengthens them and synergizes with their innate abilities, such as equipping a bird-therianthrope with wing-blades that allow them to cleave targets in half simply by flying through them.

This technological prowess extends beyond supporting therianthropes, allowing you to build technology of the 26th century, which is less impressive than it may initially sound. You can produce devices and weapons that are superior to current technology, but much of it by a margin so narrow that it can be reproduced by studying your work. The most impressive thing unrelated to therianthropes you can build is spaceships with artificial gravity; however, as you cannot build an FTL-drive, as they would realistically only be suitable for intra-Solar System travels.
objects.title: Mosaic Organ Operation (Terra Formars)

objects.text:
You gain comprehensive knowledge of both technology and the Virus from Punishing Gray Raven and its extended universe, fully adhering to canon lore. This expertise allows you to understand and create anything that humanity has developed, referenced, or hinted at within the Punishing Gray Raven world. Your mastery spans Constructs, cybernetics, A.I.s, advanced weaponry, CUBs, zero-point energy reactors and mind-transfer technologies. Additionally, you possess deep knowledge of systems like the Ascnet, M.I.N.D. network, control frameworks, and the intricate mechanics of both mechanical and biological combat units.

Moreover, you acquire the specialized knowledge of prominent figures such as Nikola, Lee, and Asimov, giving you unparalleled expertise in Punishing Virus technology, biomechanical engineering, and Grey Raven’s advanced weapons. This includes a detailed understanding of the virus’s structure, its propagation, and effects, along with personal immunity to the Punishing Virus (though this protection does not extend to your allies). Finally, your expertise in Omniframe and Uniframe/Compositers technology enables you to enhance or construct new combat frames and systems not seen in the lore.
objects.title: Punishing Virus (Punishing Gray Raven)

objects.text:
Your knowledge has touched every civilization the Chozo have helped or resembled, on top of the Chozo themselves, both the Thoha and Mawkin Tribes. Thoha focused their wisdom on science, which includes their Metroid and X-Parasite findings, Aeion energy research and harnessing, and their following technological projects across time. Mawkin focused their wisdom on military might, aside from inheriting their martial prowess, you obtain their focus of research on weakpoints or instrumentalizing their enemies' abilities, among the development of Chozo armaments.

As declared beforehand, this includes Bryyonian, Luminoth/Ing, and the Alimbic civilizations’ technological know-how, among others.
objects.title: The Chozo’s Parting Gift (Metroid)

objects.text:
You're as good of a scientist as Andross ever was, and as good an engineer as Slippy Toad; all technological knowledge that might be found in the Lylat system or it's neighbors is available to you.

These include weapons of war like the multirole Arwing fighter (and its opposite, the Wolfen), the Landmaster battle tank, the Blue-Marine submarine, the Great Fox command carrier, the equipment of Space Dynamics & the Cornerian military more generally, the bespoke tools of the Andross Empire (and its successors like the Anglars & Andrew Oikonny's rebel forces) like mechs, armor, aerospace craft, & superweapons (such as the Attack Carrier, Granga's Mech, the Umbra-class station, the Salvadora, and so on), the technological and biological assimilation of the Aparoids, & of course, whatever technology turns you into a giant psychic floating head with the power of a battle-fleet.
objects.title: Maniacal Scientist (Star Fox)

addons.text:
Of course, there was another way that the legend of Mega Man and the two doctors could have gone. Instead of advancing robotics, perhaps they built a more advanced internet, one that could one day interact directly with the real world?

Your mastery of the digital world grants you the knowledge of the Battle Network timeline, such as the advanced network and internet infrastructure, PETS & NetNavis, Battle Chips, the software of Battle Network, & the EM Wave & alien technology from Star Force.
addons.title: Battle Network (Mega Man)

objects.text:
You've already gained the genius of Doctor Light & Doctor Wily. However, their legend would not end with their deaths, with the Reploid technology they created becoming the foundation of a new society.

You gain access to all technology from the rest of the primary Mega Man timelines (diverging when X either did or did not seal himself away), including the full original timeline (such as the rest of X, Zero, ZX, Legends).

This includes, but is not limited to, the means to turn human beings into cyborgs with the capabilities of Robots and Reploids (or vice versa, Robots and Reploids with majority human characteristics) like the Humanoids seen in Mega Man ZX, as well as Biometal (also from Mega Man ZX), the Cyber-Elves, Energy Crystals, & the CIEL System of Mega Man Zero, the technology of the Bonne Family and other Diggers (including Servbots, mecha like the Gustaff series, & airships like the Drache & the Gesellschaft) & the Elysium civilization's technology from Legends.
objects.title: Cyber Elf (Mega Man)

objects.text:
Your Mastery of Corru has grown indeed. You now have the ability to easily and seamlessly connect Corru to technology from the Bright Cousins, humanity. Allowing for use of their boxed lightning and the rapid evolution of technology working in tandem. This applies to just about any other technology, as well. 

Furthermore, your body body is transformed into a proper Qou body made of Corru, with a Mind Core included. Though optionally it can form as a second body. 

You are able to shape it at will like any Qou, including into sharp shapes for combat purposes. However, this comes with an added benefit. 

You, specifically, can reshape the Corru that makes this body up into damn near any technology, so long as you know the schematics and fundamentals of how it works. Allowing you to carry entire arsenals in your mind, ready to be drawn out at any time with a simple though to reshape part of you.
objects.title: Corru Mastery (Corru.Observer)

addons.title: Craftsmanship (Kingdom Come: Deliverance II)
addons.text: You have now reached the maximum level in the art of Craftsmanship from the world of Kingdom Come: Deliverance. You know how to create every iten featured in both games and your skills allow you to easily create tier four quality items. You have also gained all Craftsmanship Perks available in both games.

objects.text:
You have reached the maximum level in the art of alchemy from the world of Kingdom Come: Deliverance. You know how to create every potion, poison or perfume featured in both games, you also know the name of every herb used for alchemy in the games, what they look like, and their known effects.

The potions in this world are varied and produce different effects, ranging from potions that quickly heal wounds to those that increase strength, durability, or stamina. Some allow you to see better in the dark, while others cure poison, increase Craftsmanship or Thievery, or eliminate drunkenness and hangovers.

Your skill allows you to easily create potions of exceptional quality. You have also gained all Alchemy Perks available in both games. With enough time and research, you may even be able to create entirely new potions.

Finally, you are able to summon an Alchemy Bench, an object from Kingdom Come: Deliverance that you can use to perform alchemy. You can summon it anywhere there is sufficient space and return it to a pocket dimension when it is no longer needed. The bench has an endless supply of water, wine, oil, spirits, firewood, and phials for sole purpose of brewing and storing the potions you make.
objects.title: Alchemy (Kingdom Come: Deliverance II)

objects.text: Alright, alright. You can substitute the ingredients you normally can't get with the closest mundane equivalent. For example, redstone could be fine copper. Or blaze powder can be magnesium.
objects.title: Substitution Brewery (Minecraft)

objects.text: It seems you don't need an enchanting table anymore, as you have effectively become the enchanting table. No longer must you meticulously craft one; you can simply will any compatible enchantment on an item. You will still need bookcases to reach the higher levels of enchanting, but you won't have to worry about things like Lapiz, or someone else using your enchanting table.
objects.title: Touch-Based Enchantment (Minecraft)

addons.text: Through the ability to spawn villagers and your ability to enchant objects using Minecraft magic, you have gained access to villagers special version of enchantment magic. This magic does not require any bookshelves or an enchantment table, with it instead requiring emeralds. The strength of the enchantment depends on the amount/quality of the emeralds used.
addons.title: Village Magic

objects.text:
You are now able to spawn Villagers. To spawn a Villager, you must simply take an egg, any egg, and break it with the intent of a Villager to spawn. These Villagers are loyal to you and not as weak as their game counterparts. As they have the abilities of their cousins, the Illagers, they are able to use weapons and tools, craft things such as totems of undying, use the magic of the Evokers and Illusionists, and create things such as the Ravagers. 

Villagers are willing and able to learn any trade they can, from alchemy to carpentry to the priesthood, and will quickly create their own workplaces, which will connect to other workplaces, as well as homes, creating a village. They also are able to craft Iron Golems as well and are very mercantile, more than willing to trade their goods for emeralds, and of course as their creator you are given a permanent discount (equivalent to being Hero of the Village).
objects.title: Hero of the Village (Minecraft)

objects.text: Your golem-making abilities expand to cover all golems created by Illagers in Minecraft Dungeons, including Redstone Golems, Redstone Monstrosities, and Redstone Cubes. Generally, Redstone Golems will be the shape of the mold you fill with liquid redstone. They aren't bright and need to be given commands, which they will execute perpetually until given another command. They are way stronger than Iron Golems, with joints appearing where intended in the mold. Redstone can be fabricated for purposes of golemmaking trough mixing 1/2 uranium with 1/2 copper and your touch.
objects.title: Designs of Archillager (Minecraft Dungeons)

objects.text:
Your expertise has expanded through the imaginary tree to contain all technological disciplines and knowledge shown in every Hoyoverse game.

From the technology of Zenless Zone Zero that allows the final city of the world to fight hollows and use them as a resource to the curios, interstellar civilizations and planet-destroying weapons of Honkai: Star Rail, you know how to make and use any technology shown or referenced in-game. 

You also gain access to Madame Herta’s Simulated Universe, which has been updated to have a copy of all known Aeons and all enemies from every game in it to allow you to study them and reproduce their powers and abilities with time and effort.

Your intellect also increases to be equal to members of the Genius Society, such as Madame Herta and Ruan Mei. It is much easier for you to solve problems and come up with theories that shape galaxies, and you have a perfect memory.

You also generate Imaginary Energy from the Imaginary tree and can turn it into any energy type available in the games to power anything you build.
objects.title: Across The Hoyoverse (MiHoYo)

objects.text: With your ability to understand any crafted object's function and how to replicate any crafting technique, you naturally learn how to craft any object you have analyzed. While this still doesn't explain the science behind the process, you will automatically understand the basic concepts behind it and will have an easier time discovering its details.
objects.title: Reverse Engineering

objects.text:
The informational plane has been saturated with an endless amount of energy, allowing you to create devices that not only can store and retrieve information from it but also create engines that would syphon the energy directly from the Datumplane.

You can harness any type of energy, from electromagnetic to mana or psionic energy, with the only requirement being calibrating the syphons to channel the correct type. There is no theoretical limit as to how much energy can be extracted at once. The only limiting factor is the throughput of the harnessing engines you build.
objects.title: Wireless Charging

objects.text:
In addition to information, Datumplane can now transmit both matter and energy instantly and across any distance.

There are numerous ways to accomplish this. You can build gates that provide fixed teleportation entry and exit points, master gates that can transmit to any point in space—even across entire universes or dimensions—without the presence of a receiving gate, teleporters that work without any visible portal, personal transportation devices, wireless energy transmitters, and much more. To this end, Datumplane can be used as a shortcut dimension without needing to break down matter and reconstruct it at the other end.

You can also build machines that digitize physical matter and energy, replicator devices capable of creating any object as long as a blueprint and a sufficient amount of matter and/or energy is supplied, and much more.

While this technology can be reproduced, you can still lock others out of some or all functions of Datumplane through the use of an administrative device, for example, limiting their teleportation distance or energy throughput.
objects.title: Per Aspera Ad Astra

addons.text:
You can now build technology that directly modifies information in the Eidos, which, subsequently, alters the real world. This allows you to achieve almost any effect, such as healing someone by replacing information related to their physical body with a healthy version from the past, teleporting objects by editing information about their position, creating or dampening energy fields, and anything else you can imagine.

However, the processing power required for each change is immense and scales exponentially with the complexity of the change. Moreover, changing information about past events, while theoretically possible, will require you to calculate changes in the Eidos for every single moment in time from the point of change onwards, thus raising the calculation requirements beyond what is feasible even for some advanced space-faring civilisations.
addons.title: Editor Permissions

objects.text:
You can now access an additional layer in the Datumplane, Eidos. This layer represents the complete collection of information about any and all objects and phenomena, past or present.

This allows you to gather any information you might need, from the map of a building or files from someone's computer to the position of every single atom in the universe, or even observe past events. You know how to decode this raw information into a useable format, but the more complex and extensive it is, the more advanced computational hardware you will need.
objects.title: Eidos

addons.text:
The divide between the real and the digital has been erased. You can now build matter-digitization devices that would fully convert anything, from inanimate objects to living beings, complete with mind, body, and soul, into an existence adapted to exist within the Datumplane.

Similarly, you can now transfer anything from the Datumplane into the real world, albeit it will take an external source of energy to manifest physical objects that weren't previously digitized into the real world.
addons.title: Digitization

objects.text:
Datumplane has been transformed into a fully realised digital realm. Even without relying on any devices, you can freely enter this realm in a virtual body.

Inside this realm, you are the highest authority, free to shape it however you wish: control the topology of its virtual space-time, materialise structures, manifest data flows as rivers, and anything else you can envision. You can even design fully sentient digital entities that can potentially interact with the outside world if provided with the necessary technological interface.

The Datumplane now possesses limitless processing power, allowing any and all software—from computer games to hyper-advanced AIs—to run inside it without reliance on any external hardware, requiring it only for connection to the outside world.

Lastly, even should all devices sustaining it be destroyed, the Datumplene will persist for as long as your mind does.
objects.title: The Grid

objects.text: "Soon, everything will be perfected. No more illness. No more hunger. And best of all? No more free will!" You've truly taken after the Doctor in more ways than simple admiration, for you are his legacy and future realized. Your technological expertise comes not only from the games but from any and all other pieces of Sonic media—comics, TV shows, movies—you name it! From the Roboticizer to turn living beings into your robot slaves, the formula to create the Metal Virus, the robot designs and minions of Sonic X, to the Death Egg from the movies and then some. But that's just the beginning—in time, you can also replicate the technology created by Doctor Starline, the Metarex, Nine, the Nocturnus Clan, the Chaos Council and many more across the Sonic Multiverse. Surely with all this extra IQ, no one shall ever stand in your way—not even a constant, blue nuisance!
objects.title: Eggman Land (Sonic the Hedgehog)

objects.text: With this upgrade, you're now given access to any technology seen and/or used in the Five Nights at Freddy's books and novels, along with technology seen in the various series that are a part of the Fazbear Fanverse Initiative, like Popgoes, Five Nights at Candy's, The Joy of Creation, etc.. This includes inventions such as the infamous Faz-Goo, Sea Bonnies, Bobbiedots, Fetch, and more. While 'Fantasy and Fun’ was more of a catchphrase or slogan, the infusion of actual magic into your inventions can make it out to be so much, much more. With the right programming and some practice manipulating Remnant on their part, your creations can perform magic of their own. Infuse enough magic into something, and you can even give it life. Sentience, if you wish it to be. Despite the implications (and perhaps dangers) of free will, they will be loyal to you to a fault, growing to see you more as a parental figure in their lives.
objects.title: Another Five Nights

addons.text:
Your knack for engineering, already fueled by an over-the-top approach, is now tempered and honed by your dwarven heritage. The chaotic stacking of redundant systems is replaced by a seamless integration of impossibly dense components and compact functionality. Your creations pack the full power, redundancy, and complex functionality of Overkill into half the bulk and weight. Components are seamlessly integrated, not bolted on, achieving an impossible density where armor, power systems, and redundancy become intrinsic to the core structure.

This refined approach to engineering also embodies extreme longevity. Maintenance intervals stretch from months to decades, even centuries. Every system is forged to endure time and conflict with dwarven resilience. Your creations to operate flawlessly for generations with minimal upkeep.

Finally, nobody's sure how or why, but everything you build seems just a bit more. More durable, more efficient, more precise. Call it a 10-20% difference across the board?
addons.title: Dwarven Engineering

objects.text:
Your gift for turning trash into triumph has taken a wild turn. Efficiency takes a backseat as you lean fully into excess, overengineering your creations with reckless brilliance. You can now indulge in wild overbuilding—stacking redundant systems, slapping on oversized components, layering armor until it's absurd, and pumping far more power into your tech than any sane engineer would consider safe or practical.

And yet, it works. Somehow, it always works. Your instincts as a maker twist this chaos into raw effectiveness. Add another generator, another barrel, another antenna, another layer of shielding—it doesn't matter. The more you add, the better it performs. Overbuilt weapons hit harder, fire faster, and shrug off wear. Vehicles turn into mobile fortresses. Drones become miniature death machines with overlapping failsafes and adaptive AI clusters jury-rigged from leftover smart devices.

This isn’t just about durability or firepower, though. The sheer scale of your constructions opens up new functions and systems entirely: complex sensory suites, integrated fabrication modules, redundant self-repair arrays, internal storage bays, absurd energy capacity. If you can imagine it, and you can bolt enough metal to hold it, you can probably build it—and your mind will instinctively find the path to make it all function together, no matter how over-the-top the design.

Of course, with this level of extravagance comes weight, bulk, and a complete disregard for elegance—but when your machines walk through gunfire, crush opposition, make your morning coffee and keep running long after anything else would’ve fallen apart, style becomes irrelevant. Overkill is your new normal, and it’s glorious.
objects.title: Overkill

objects.text:
You aren't limited in the scope of technology or abilities you can create or use, such as not being able to make technology by species that would be considered god-like in Star Trek. However, you are not a total master of this technology; while you do have the technical know-how to create the technology of the precursor species in Star Trek properly, using it is another matter.

This includes, but is not limited to, the power hinted at by the Q, the technology possessed by the being known as Trelane, and many other precursor species seen throughout the Star Trek series, including the Bajoran Prophets, the Nacene, Espers like Gary Mitchell or the Thasians, V'Ger, Badgey, the Cytherians, The Guardian Of Forever, the "Greek Gods", the Travellers, the Douwd, the Organians, the Excalbians, and the Metrons, to name a few.

Keep in mind that even the Q eventually met people who could fight against them, so try not to get too cocky.
objects.title: Precursor Species (Star Trek)

objects.text:
You are no longer limited to just 25th-century Star Trek technology. You have gained access to 26th-century Star Trek technology and beyond, even up until the 31st century of Star Trek. This also includes psychic technology as long as it's not from any of the "god-aliens" of Star Trek.

You still do not have access to technology created by Star Trek's many "god-aliens" unless you have taken Precursor Species (Star Trek); however, this still allows for technologically advanced civilizations that have gone beyond the reach of 25th-century Star Trek technology.
objects.title: Section 31 (Star Trek)

objects.text:
You may now, with an exertion of focus commensurate with the amount of information you've already consolidated in this fashion, shift any unit of your declarative memory into or out of a special mental archive. It never consumes any amount of your time or attention to reference or cross-check archived information, and you may review all such memories simultaneously, allowing you to discern correlations and patterns that would otherwise be impossible to see.

This consolidated register is axiomatically proof against tampering and decay, and it likewise suppresses the harmful effects of any information encoded therein.

Additionally, when engaged in any sort of creative, intellectual, or technical labor, you may directly substitute internal consideration for real experimentation, at a rate limited only by your intelligence and relevant true knowledge, with no loss of effectiveness.

You are also no longer dependent upon productive interaction with the outside world for purposes of intellectual stimulation and development, and your ability to compensate for detrimental interaction is unbounded.
objects.title: Crystallized Law Special Booster (Chain of Isekai)

objects.text:
With this upgrade, you may, with an amount of research, development, and industrial investment commensurate with the utility and divergence of your intended subject from the world as it already exists, discover and then actualize arbitrary new physical phenomena.

All such phenomena, despite the apparent and inherent contrivance of their existence, still extend logically from the physical and mathematical nature of Crystallized Law: they take the form of quantified and reducible objects with reducible effects and reducible properties.

Additionally, when cooperating with others—or facilitating cooperation—the absolute effectiveness of the working group so formed is increased for all creative, intellectual, and technical purposes, scaling with the total number of participants, the diversity of their perspectives, their ability to check one another, and their actual organizational efficacy.

This compounds with, but is distinct from, the principle that the benefits of teamwork and collaboration are never inapplicable to the creative, intellectual, and technical pursuits of such a working group, even in realms of otherwise individual achievement, and that the replicability of any individual achievement is enhanced within such a working group to an incredible degree.
objects.title: Crystallized Law Limit Breaking Capstone (Chain of Isekai)

objects.text:
You now have access to not only the genetics of Pokémon and the advanced technology found within the Pokémon universe, but you also possess the DNA of Fakémon, as well as cutting-edge technologies derived from various Pokémon-inspired games, including numerous fan-made projects that expand on the lore and gameplay of the Pokémon franchise.

This information grants you the knowledge to explore new technologies, create unique Pokémon, and develop technological advancements that integrate Pokémon technology with Pokémon-inspired video games or fan-made projects.

You can also create entirely new Pokémon with much greater ease than what Pokétech allows for creating new Legendaries, Mythics, or even regular Pokémon. The creation of brand new fossil-type Pokémon, or any other type, even creating Pokémon Types that have never existed before. When creating God-Level Pokémon, it will take longer to produce the genetic code than a regular Pokémon.
objects.title: Fakémon

addons.text:
On top of what Stellaris, Empyrion and Space Engineers already give you, your knowledge now branches into the tech of the X-Series, Elite Dangerous, Star Citizen, and EVE. This means you can build massive shipyards, orbital stations, and modular infrastructure on a scale far beyond anything a single colony could manage before.

You understand gravitic and antimatter drives, warp gates and jump systems, and the kind of fleet-scale logistics that keep hundreds of ships supplied and coordinated. Weapons tech expands into plasma cannons, point-defense networks, and full planetary siege systems, while your industrial side gains orbital refineries, automated resource distribution, and long-range trade networks.

Lore-friendly mods expand your toolbox further, adding more ship modules, station components, and industrial tricks.
addons.title: Void Citizen of New Eden

objects.text:
Your knowledge now extends to the technology of Empyrion: Galactic Survival. This includes scalable warp drive navigation, modular shield systems from ships to planetary grids, CPU-optimized vessel design, advanced constructors and fabricators for large-scale automation, and planetary logistics networks capable of sustaining interstellar empires.

All official lore-friendly content is included, granting access to advanced tiered construction, starbase-scale power generation and defenses, and limited terraforming.

As a bonus, you also gain more technologies in the form of Astroneer, Stationeers, and Osiris: New Dawn, such as compact power systems, environmental chemistry for resource conversion, and modular life-support infrastructure.
objects.title: Empyrion Overseer (Empyrion: Galactic Survival)

objects.text:
You possess knowledge of the Dominion Code, which is the fundamental information or data that makes up the fabric of reality. With this knowledge, you can not only create the Meta-Nanites but also gain an immense understanding of the building blocks of existence.

This knowledge doesn't automatically grant you an understanding of how everything in existence works, especially on alternate Earths that aren't the world of Generator Rex. However, you will have a great and comprehensive understanding of how to create technology that can allow you to comprehend and manipulate the fabric of existence, no matter where you are. This will enable you to understand any phenomenon, including those of supernatural origin.
objects.title: The Dominion Code (Generator Rex)

objects.text:
Your ability to mix tech & esoterica elevates your biological modification & cybernetics skills to the point that you can perform surgery nearing Bonesaw in skill, even on yourself.

There's also direct effects on things you can make - especially SMILEs, Green Blood, & the various Mutagen strains - have fused into a compound vastly superior to its components:

Blood of The Emerald Empyrean Demon (B.E.E.D.).

This is an alternative to blood, & you understand how to alter your bone marrow to produce it, or integrate a 2nd circulatory system into your body - dealer's choice.

B.E.E.D. is in a subconsciously regulated flux state. You can activate it via a mental switch & include a controlled mutation, or set it to retrograde to return to base form. This control stems from the innate ability of Zoan Lineage Factors to shift biological structures and the mental/neural modifications of theriomorphisis that allow for the same.

B.E.E.D. allows you to convert a mutation into a new Zoan Lineage Factor & add it to your DNA. It is also mystically resistant, meaning you take less damage from mana and soul-based abilities.

Touching two targets allows you to either:
• Fuse them into one

• Apply a mutation to them based on each other, plus their most recent exposure to foreign DNA

• Combine any bloodlines or racial abilities they have within you as an alchemical focus

Cybernetics are replicated in the form of biotech and added to the genome.

It can also rapidly accelerate & evolve existing mutations or cause the development of unique powers based on the DNA used (eg: giving a spider mutant Spider Totem powers like Venom Blasts).

Note: This doesn't apply to unique abilities based on magic or spiritual forms of power like chi & aura - unless they are derived from a genetic component (Silver Eyes from RWBY are viable, but specific semblances & even Aura in general are not).

It allows you to recreate these powers as Paramecia-like abilities. It is even more advantageous if they are the same base species as you, because it will be added to your base form, and you can access them without activating B.E.E.D. The further divorced the target is from your base species, the harder it is to replicate, and the more DNA you need to extract.

Note: This doesn't work on abilities that are planetary or higher in power/scale.

Finally, if none of these cases apply, B.E.E.D. will simply give them elevated physical abilities based on genetic potential.

You can reverse these granted mutations by establishing physical contact again.
objects.title: Sanguis Daemonicus Smaragdi Empyrei

objects.text:
You have shattered the tyranny of coal by mastering the atom itself. You've pioneered radical new physics, allowing you to process uranium ore with industrial-era tools and construct compact, hyper-efficient fission reactors. These atomic furnaces can power your greatest creations for years on mere ounces of fuel, freeing you from the chains of your coal dependency forever.

This liberation, however, comes at a terrible price: the insidious, invisible threat of radiation. 

Your genius is now laced with peril, forcing you to swathe your reactors in meters of lead shielding and handle your power source with a dread respect for its deadly emissions. Every refueling or repair of your advanced power cores exposes you to a genuine, persistent threat of acute radiation poisoning, requiring stringent safety protocols to survive your own creations.
objects.title: The Atomic Furnace

objects.text: What was once unmanned fighting among men of steel is now.... manned fighting among men of steel! Previously, all of your robots would be unable to be manned. Limited to remote control devices or vocal commands, or the like. Now, as long as you can fit in the machine, you can physically act inside of it. You can also dictate "street matches", able to build make-shift rings and set up said street matches in less than an hour! Of course, you will most likely be approached if held on an important street, but otherwise, you will be able to build technology to protect the environment and the crowd from collateral damage. The durability of your buildings and rings also becomes quite a bit stronger, able to withstand natural disasters, like a hurricane being merely a "decent wind", or a 7.5 Magnitude Earthquake being a good vibration for your fans. Finally, your robots can now be much bigger and stronger to boot. Before, they could break a truck. Now at their strongest, they could make punches that go as hard as 232.2 Billion newtons, or the force of a volcano eruption, and take those hits for at least a little while on average. When it comes to speed, ironically, this is their worst stat, as even the fastest will only move around the ring at about 100-110 mph.
objects.title: Realest Steel

objects.text:
"I saved the best inventions for myself."
-Syndrome

Your knowledge of the Super-Fashion of the Incredibles has broadened to include all of the technology therein, including that of Syndrome, The Underminer, Screenslaver, Baron Von Ruthless, Bomb Voyage, Xerek, and other masters of technology.

You can create adaptive combat robots known as Omnidroids, advanced weapons and armor (with features like flight, zero point energy, & even multipurpose gauntlets that can do everything from scanning, shooting homing missiles or recon drones, to even operating the aforementioned Omnidroids), mind control devices, your own off-brand containment foam, numerous super-vehicles, specialized explosives, computer systems well ahead of their time, biological immortality, and so on.
objects.title: Hero Syndrome (The Incredibles)

objects.text:
It seems that your knowledge base has expanded to include technology that is based around housing, caring for, aiding, and fighting Kaiju.

With this you could make artificial islands with individualized environments, hyper-dense food, stasis prisons, specialized medical vehicles, kaiju-sized armor and equipment, and even giant anti-kaiju robots.
objects.title: Kaiju Housing, Care, and Combat

objects.text:
Your ability to create, support, and battle kaiju now encompasses the world ending tactical free-for-all beatdown of the Monsterpocalypse wargame.

You gain the ability to create any of the Monsters and Units of all the different factions. You can bioengineer natural titans such as the Terrasaurs, Vegetyrants and Planet Eaters. You can construct the massive machines of GUARD, the Martian Menace, or Ubercorp International. Different types of cyber-bioscience such as the Shadowsun Syndicate, the Legion of Mutates, or the Subterran Uprising are also available. Even magical monstrosities such as those of the Elemental Guardians, Lords of Cthul or Drakken Armada are possible.

Really though, you can use any powers, technologies or creatures you have access to create entire species or “factions” of kaiju. Anything sufficiently large and physically powerful counts as a kaiju for this power, including mechs, summons, size-shifting warriors and even flying saucers.

You can create minion creatures and machines which, while not full-sized kaiju, are the size of a house. However, any actual kaiju could easily crush them underfoot without a thought. Endless waves of these minions can swarm a monstrous battlefield en masse, providing tactical support and securing territory for their kaiju commander. These minions can have tactical abilities like indirect fire support, disrupting the energy of an enemy kaiju, entrenching other minions or boosting energy gained from territory.

Your kaiju also gain energy by claiming territory of the area they are fighting over, either by destroying buildings or other features, or having their minions secure them. You also know how to get advantages in battle by destroying or securing different types of locations. You can also build installations, structures such as fortresses, nests or temples that allow you to control and gain advantages on a battlefield before fighting even begins, though this makes them prime targets for enemy kaiju to smash.

You can further enhance and fine tune what kind of abilities, powers and fighting styles you kaiju have. Despite all this talk of abilities, tactics and support, your kaiju also become even better at pure physical wrasslin’ style power attacks such as slams, charges and tosses. Your kaiju also gain the ability to go into a Hyper Form, either by charging the energy built up over battle, or when on the brink of death. Hyper forms provide a minor power boost, but also have their own abilities and fighting styles. For example, a hit-and-run zoner in its base form could go into a power attack bruiser or minion coordinator in its Hyper Form.

A kaiju starts with an Ultra Form unlocked, and can eventually unlock a second Mega Form. Through extensive research or power-ups, you can discover rarer esoteric forms such as Quantum Forms, Metal Forms, or Cosmic Forms. These Hyper Forms should be considered sidegrades of eachother with different powers, rather than straight upgrades, and a kaiju can only use one of its Hyper Forms per battle. If you have a kaiju-sized form or physiology, then you may also use Hyper Forms.
objects.title: Reach Out and Crush Someone (Monsterpocalypse)

objects.text:
Instead of just being another Techie/Netrunner who can make the various technologies of the cyberpunk universe, you are a cold-blooded Corpo, the actual winner of the Corporate War.  While every megacorporation was too busy fighting over buying each other out and gaining their resources, you somehow managed to outmanoeuvre all of them and have managed the impossible: merging all of them into one singular entity. 

What would be the point of winning the war if you didn't bring your achievement with you? As the sole winner of the corporate war, you are now the proud CEO of a corporation with a name of your choosing, with various subsidiaries of the varied corporations within the Cyberpunk universe. While you could list the myriad corporations you do have, it would be easier to name those that you don't have, which is none. This corporation will not be subject to antitrust laws or any other laws, as being a substantial player in the world's economy comes with the benefit of being immune to such foolish, frivolous laws. 

You are also in possession of Night City, a metropolis so ingrained with corporate corruption that it registers as part of the new corporation that you now own. The raving city of vices, crime, and gang violence. The place where dreams go to die. You could be the stabilising presence this place needs, or rule over it with an iron fist; either way, it doesn't matter, the people will love and be absolutely loyal to you anyway.
objects.title: Corpo War Winner (Cyberpunk)

objects.text:
You have gained knowledge of the technology from a number of worlds, worlds which darkly reflect the race and class struggles of South Africa. These worlds are the worlds of Neill Blomkamp, and their technology is now an open book to you, including Elysium, CHAPPiE, District 9, Demonic, & his short films.

This includes advanced AI, robotics, drones, & cybernetics, whole-brain emulation & full-dive VR, Prawn technology and weaponry, cheap and ubiquitous system-craft, medical tech that can cure or heal anything short of death, stop aging, or make any change to your body within human (or Prawn) limits, bleeding-edge weapons systems like those developed by Armadyne & Tetravaal (including explosive smart rounds, full-auto railguns, & orbital range MANPADs), & even whole paradise-like space stations.
objects.title: Elysium (Neill Blomkamp)

objects.text:
Just like Vorsiber Atomic or the Space Nations before you, you have the seed of artificial consciousness in your hands, a power you can release either to the universe's peril or great advantage...

The technological advancements that human and artificial minds can bring about in concert are truly staggering. FTL travel, non-linear means of experiencing time (including universe & timeline hopping, memories from alternate futures, & direct time travel), novel drone forms (including humanoid forms like the Raven, mecha like LAKE, aircraft like the Cutter, or even full spaceships like the Guardians), genetic engineering and cybernetics (which can bring humans closer to artificial perfection, uplift lower species like domestic cats to sapience, or create monsters like the Terror-raptors), the infastructure to fight wars in multiple galaxies at the same time, and the alien technology that can be found in those distant systems.

With all that's found in Heart Of The Machine, AI War: Fleet Command 1 & 2, A Valley Without Wind 1 & 2, Bionic Dues, The Last Federation, Starward Rogue, & In Case Of Emergency Release Raptor, you have an enormous number of tools at your disposal.
objects.title: Heart Of The Machine (Arcen Games)

objects.text:
The Zohar, an enormous monument deeply connected to other dimensions (both the Lower & Upper Domains), is the source of many supernatural phenomena of great interest to researchers. It (and its copies) seem to be a link to existences that approximate something like "God", though that may merely be a sign of how little we know of its workings. Perhaps one day, you will create the means of knowing or becoming such a being?

To set you on that path, you have been granted the knowledge of the worlds the Zohar has revealed itself in. This includes both Xenogears & Xenosaga (or perhaps they're the same world after all?), with knowledge of the technology of The Galaxy Federation (or was it The Milky Way Federation?) & related organizations (like Vector Industries, The Kukai Foundation, Scientia, Robot Academy, Ziggurat, & The Salvator Faction), The Immigrant Fleet (or was it The Pilgrimage Fleet?) & related organizations (like Ormus, U-TIC, Hyams Group, & The Yuriev Institute), as well as the civilizations of the "Eldridge planet", like Solaris, Nisan, Nimrod, Zeboim, Kislev, Aveh, & Shevat.

Also, as you have in a sense been touched by the Zohar & the higher dimensions, this gives you the ability to use the Phenomenon Phase Shift (granting you the incredible luck of a protagonist), as well as to use many new & powerful kinds of Ether abilities.
objects.title: Secrets Of The Zohar (Xenogears & Xenosaga)

objects.text:
You have acquired a new section in your ability to customize the roles you assign to your minions. It is now possible to reach and surpass the superhuman level. From granting cybernetic enhancements to fulfill the role of a super soldier, to granting magical powers to faithfully fulfill the role of a true mage.

Due to the wide variety of extraordinary roles you can assign, all of them are limited to only 10 SP. Any supernatural ability you assign can never exceed this threshold. For example, a minion with the role of a mage will never surpass a true mage who has studied and trained their entire life while also improving and perfecting their abilities.

If you possess a magical, spiritual, or psychic power whose origin is naturally something common or frequent, such as Nen or Magical Power, you can grant such supernatural power to your minions along with an equivalent role. For example, possessing Chakra and then granting the same power to your subordinates, who will automatically gain the profession that best reflects it, in this case Shinobi around Chunin level. However, they will usually only operate at above average for the powers.

In the case of technological powers, they will simply adopt the profession necessary to create, maintain, or operate something specific. For example, A few workers you make could be given Peter Parker's knowledge to ensure your Spider-Man-related technology will never falter. Or if you needed to make some T-800's, they will have machine-like precision and the knowledge how to upkeep/build them.
objects.title: Fantastic Manpower

objects.text:
Far away, on the very rim of the multiverse, there is The Edge, a toroidal universe where the universe is more akin to our own, where Sun-worshiping knight orders fight against monks who worship entropy and black holes, where magic and science allow for interstellar travel, and you, well, you learned all you could.

 From the manipulation of gravitational waves and miniature singularities as shown by the Monoist, to the manipulation of light and incaglass used by The Sunstar Free Company, such as in the construction of lightblades and free electron lasers, bladiators.

Even the secrets of Illvoi Cloudsculpting technology is with in your reach allowing the knowledge to recreate their psychokinetic technology. you have also learned the bio-engineering secret's of the Eumidians be it plant or animal based biotech they have showcased.

Then there is the industius scappers of the Kavaronic Federal Empire, from whom you have learned how to mine not just asteroid but also deep within planet's. 

Laatly there is the secret's of the Drix, more specifically you have learned how to construct their eternity collums and eternity drive that allow for interstellar travel through weftwalking. escentially an artificial form of planes walking.

With all this one thing must be remembered, and that is this tech is extremly resceptive to mana and aether, as show with the Thaumaton Bomb, which can recreate the mana aether reactions inside of star's.
objects.title: From the Edge of Eternity (Magic: The Gathering)

objects.text:
In all their billions of years of warfare, there was one opponent Xeelee could never overcome: the creatures of dark matter, Photino Birds.

You now possess the full breadth of technological knowledge of every dark matter species, allowing you to accomplish such grandiose feats of engineering as terraforming on a universal scale and arranging galaxies in a particular structure to attack with resulting gravitic waves.

But the full scope of this technology could not be utilised by creatures of baryonic matter. As such, you also gain knowledge of how to transfer your consciousness into a body of dark matter. This would allow you to achieve many feats previously only possible by application of technology, such as time travel, at will, using only your new form's natural capabilities.
objects.title: Photino Victory (Xeelee Sequence)

objects.text:
You have become far more capable and knowledgeable. No longer limited to the knowledge and experience of one man, you now have dozens of scientists and geniuses' worth of knowledge from all over the world of One Punch Man. From Kuseno to Child Emperor to Metal Knight, you have gained the knowledge of all technology in the setting.

This includes, but is not limited to: battle suits, AI, strength readers, remote-piloting robots, Kaiju creation via serum, structures capable of withstanding spaceship bombardments, and whole robot armies. Your learning speed has also been enhanced, by roughly 3x its original capability.

One of your most impressive feats is that of the creation of artificial monster cells. While they were originally theorized to come from a specific monstrous being, you have been able to recreate them in labs with sufficient materials. Compared to the original, however, they start off rather weak. At best, you can only create definitive Tiger Level monsters at first. But with a couple years of research and refinement, you could eventually create Dragon Level monsters semi-consistently depending on the being who consumes the cell.

Finally, organizations like the Monster Association, Hero Association, etc. are well within your skill to create. From dealing with the logistics and finding the perfect people to hire, to the ethical money cuts you might need to keep this place up and running, you can become a titan of a faction in the world you inhabit.
objects.title: Hero Association (One Punch Man)

objects.text:
You now inherit the knowledge of the Atlantean civilisation from the Visions of Escaflowne series. This primarily includes the creation of Melefs and Guymelefs, powerful mechanised suits of armour. You know how to build every Melef and Guymelef shown in the series and, with time and research, you will be able to create even more powerful ones.

You also possess knowledge of Zaibach Empires technologies such as Liquid Metal, Floating Fortresses, Stealth Cloaking, and more. In addition, you know how to synthesise Energist, a gem-like crystal with many properties, ranging from powering Guymelefs and ships to granting seemingly supernatural abilities such as divination. The colour indicates the potency of the Energist: red is the most powerful, followed by purple, then green.

You can also understand, and synthesise Levistone, a unique rock that naturally floats in midair and is used for large-scale transportation.

Finally, you gain a basic understanding of Atlantean science, including Destiny Particles. With time and research, you will be able to create advanced devices such as dimensional portals, the Fate Alteration Machine, a Zone of Absolute Fortune in which everyone's wishes are granted, the Destiny Prognostication Engine, and much more.
objects.title: Knowledge of Atlantis (Visions of Escaflowne)

objects.text:
From Makuhero City to the technorganic jungles of Quatros, you have learned to recreate the unique technologies and organisms found throughout the Hero Factory universe.

You have acquired the skills to build, modify, and equip the Heroes created at the Hero Factory. This includes crafting various equipment such as Sonic Blasters, Fire Shooters, Energy Shields, and a range of vehicles like the 'Ultra Mach Speed Cycle' and the renowned Hero Pod, allowing you to ensure your heroes are ready for any situation.

However, your technical knowledge extends beyond just equipment. You not only know how to construct Hero Cores but have also learned to synthesize Quaza Stone, the key element in their construction, which is one of the rarest substances in the known universe.

Your understanding also encompasses the technology of villains, from Von Nebula's staff to the Witch Doctor's theories on Quaza. You are knowledgeable about the various weapons, vehicles, and armor seen throughout the setting. Additionally, you possess expertise in the biological aspects of the universe, enabling you to clone Brain Slugs and the creatures they have mutated, as well as the technorganic creatures of Quatros.

Do not worry too much about the need for infrastructure; you also have the knowledge to build and construct the necessary framework for forming an intergalactic hero organization. Furthermore, you understand how to construct the various robots depicted throughout the series.

While you may not be a hero yourself, you are the one who ensures the universe is never without them.
objects.title: They aren't born, they're built (Hero Factory)

objects.text:
While humanity has greatly advanced in mere five hundred years, its accumulated knowledge is a pittance compared to the countless civilizations that spawned in the billions of years before them.

Weapons that can remove matter from reality in the volume of light seconds, projectors that can alter inertia in many magnitudes, force-free bubbles to use as a shield, FTL in galactic range, a star made of computronion, self-contained space bubbles, and even a machine that can breach the brane between realities, allowing in theory for you to travel across dimensions or even in time.

You could also recreate the Patter Junglers - immense algae network that can store and give information from both organics and synthetics, and even absorb or create said beings; or The Greenfly - von Neumann terraforming swarm with the ability to learn and incorporate other technology into itself. Even the feared Inhibitors, machines made of pure force and impervious to most of what the universe can throw at them, can be made to serve you.
objects.title: Fermi Revelation (Revelation Space)

objects.text:
[Key] recognized, authentication verified. You have obtained all the necessary parts to succeed, Bong Myeong's legacy, inheriting a talent for creation that surpasses the Supreme Deity himself.

A pseudo-Absolute Law, one that guarantees the advancement of civilization and technology, always pointing towards the road of Liberation. With it, you can fashion wonders far surpassing what your current abilities would suggest—on the level of immortals—becoming "the greatest artisan alive."

What this ultimately means is that impossibility is nothing more than a polite suggestion that you can realize with very little effort, for no doors are barred to freedom, nor would they require anything more than simple desire to pursue it. Such that even [Fate]'s machinations may naught suppress its march.
objects.title: Liberation Law Talent (Regressor's Tale of Cultivation)

objects.text:
You become one of the Seraphs, inheriting the resilience, ingenuity, and practical knowledge that allowed humanity to survive the world's collapse. Your expertise expands from primitive survival into the complete technological progression of an early civilization, from chipped stone and bloomery steel to windmills, mechanical power transmission, advanced metallurgy, glassmaking, ceramics, agriculture, animal husbandry, architecture, and civil engineering. In any world, this knowledge instinctively adapts to its local resources and natural laws.

Your body reflects the hardiness of a Seraph. You possess exceptional stamina, heightened resistance to disease, hunger, exhaustion, and harsh climates, and recover rapidly from hardship. Years of labor and survival leave little lasting wear, while your instincts for exploration, craftsmanship, and resource gathering are extraordinarily refined. Anything you create is easier to produce and consistently exceeds what its materials and methods should normally allow.

Like every Seraph, you exist slightly outside the normal flow of time. Death is not the end; instead, you remanifest roughly five kilometers from where you last entered the world, exactly as you were upon arrival. Your clothing, equipment, injuries, and overall condition are preserved, making each return feel less like resurrection and more like stepping back into reality after a brief absence. This temporal anomaly cannot be prevented by conventional means, ensuring that so long as the world itself endures, another chance always awaits.
objects.title: Last Seraph (Vintage Story)

objects.text:
Seeing as you've largely expedited the process of experimentation and design, the biggest issues you will face with your inventions are a lack of raw materials, advanced components, and the specialized tools necessary to create more advanced technology. Such are the issues that will plague any would-be tinkerer. Now, this problem is alleviated twofold.

The first enhancement is that increasing your knowledge of a scientific field exponentially increases the efficiency of your inventions in that field, far more than your prowess within it would suggest. This expresses itself as inventions that can be made with the absolute bare minimum of resources, or clever workarounds that let you get away with using what would normally be substandard or unsuitable materials. This also means your inventions will require far fewer or less specialized resources to fuel, maintain or achieve the same effect as you could before. You could, for example, with enough time and effort, take an existing rechargeable battery and, from that technological base, create a power pack that could be fuelled by anything from solar power to throwing it into an open fire.

The second is an exponential rise in ease of creation, which also scales with your understanding of differing fields. This essentially amplifies your already powerful instinctual ability to create tech, and lets you act with practically perfect precision, meaning you will never stumble or make a mistake even under extreme circumstances. Even when dealing with highly sensitive components in less-than-ideal conditions, you'll somehow be able to casually pull off adjustments and fine-tuning that could outperform a modern machining tool. While tools will still make your life easier, your bare hands are more than enough for most tech.

All of this combined lets you perform feats of seemingly reality-bending tinkering straight from the playbook of a fictional super scientist: you could, with a little practice, put together highly advanced technology blindfolded at speeds exceeding industrial production lines. You might take a laser cannon that would normally need to be fitted onto a tank, and downsize it so that you can fire an equivalent shot from a comfortably sized pistol. Or, you could perform adjustments to your tech in minutes at most, even if you're in a cave with nothing but a box of scraps.
