There'll be no more talk of "supply chains" and "proper working conditions", as you can safely ignore both with impunity, at least when it comes to building your tech with your own two hands.
objects.title: Efficient Tech

objects.text:
There is something strange inside your body. Simultaneously an organ and a piece of technology unlike anything witnessed by the majority of reality, you are now host to the Laboratorium, also known as the Madmann's Organ, a tool to modify the body and soul.

The Organ, which has completely replaced your digestive system, possesses many qualities. Firstly, it is a biological supercomputer, passively memorizing and cataloguing endless amounts of biological and esoteric knowledge, while shielding your mind from harm via psychic or cognito-hazardous sources.

Secondly, any food will have all biomass efficiently extracted and stored inside you. Biomass will be used to heal any and all damage, including age.

Thirdly, the Organ may deploy a series of tentacles from your back, and use stored biomass to print out any design that it has stored internally or acquired via information. The tentacles may also be used to quickly and more efficiently break down and absorb biomass.

Finally, any biomass consumed by the Laboratorium will be passively analyzed and slowly reverse engineered, gaining new information to add to its internal library. Said information can then be used to apply modifications to the bodies of other life forms, particularly your own. Any modifications can be done, so long as they are biological or metabiological in nature.

You are granted a starting database pertaining to the biology of a particular eldritch or otherwise alien lifeform, and methods to create biotech from them. If you possess any Species or Genetic Powers, you may apply traits from them to other lifeforms, as well as acquire new genetic databases from others.
objects.title: Madmann's Organ (Laboratorium CYOA)

addons.title: Digital Pantheon
addons.text: Digital Spirit Realm’s principles allow you to connect all of your Installed Shikigami to the Datumplane, transforming the informational realm into their shared spiritual domain. Each Shikigami can maintain its connection to its installed vessel while simultaneously existing within the Datumplane. Through this connection, the Datumplane effectively becomes a virtual Takamagahara, with your Installed Shikigami forming a new digital pantheon. The realm becomes their shared home and domain, allowing you to communicate with and coordinate your entire pantheon through it. As for yourself, you become their head priest and emissary, or even the head god if you have The Grid.

addons.title: Virtual World
addons.text: The Grid completes the Datumplane as a true digital realm, and in doing so massively boosts the existing digital leylines in both quantity and quality. Together they provide effectively infinite Net Kiai, allowing your Shikigami to draw upon spiritual energy without meaningful limitation. Additionally, due to your innate connection with the Datumplane you remain in constant connection with your Shikigami within and can directly draw upon its abundant Net Kiai. Your control over this realm also gives you the ability to shape its information directly into life. By combining Net Kiai and your creation of digital entities, you can craft Mitama and Shikigami.exe wholesale, creating entirely new spirits rather than merely awakening those already present within machines. With this your Datumplane has become a fully fledged and self-sustaining digital world, complete with its own spiritual energy, its own inhabitants, and the means to continually create more. Lastly, if you have the Digitization addon you can even have your Shikigami manifest in the physical world, incarnated spirits of code and emotional power unbound by the limits of hardware.

objects.text: The Datumplane, as a realm composed entirely of information, provides a natural home for the Mitama and Shikigami.exe of Shin’Yō Jutsu. Their spiritual essence can reside within it directly, allowing them to exist independently of any particular piece of hardware while remaining connected to you through the Datumplane. The realm is also naturally saturated with Net Kiai. Its immense network of information provides abundant spiritual currents for your Shikigami to draw upon, making the Datumplane an ideal environment for practicing Shin’Yō Jutsu and sustaining your contracts. In fact, if you have Wireless Charging then its supply of infinite energy is incorporated as well, with the digital leylines ferrying unlimited power which can be tapped into at will. So long as you have access to the Datumplane, your Shikigami remain within instantaneous reach, allowing you to communicate with, summon, and coordinate them regardless of distance.
objects.title: Digital Spirit Realm
Project Consilium (Horizon Zero Dawn)
objects.text:
Project GAIA has been perfected into a complete planetary and interplanetary civilization system, representing what Zero Dawn's technology could have become after thousands of years of uninterrupted research, development, and refinement. Its artificial intelligences, machines, terraforming systems, manufacturing networks, and autonomous infrastructure have been optimized to continuously maintain, improve, and expand themselves, allowing the system to operate indefinitely without the rushed compromises of the original project.

At its core is the Consilium, a council of eleven permanent superintelligences modeled after the great Roman powers. Vesta, the heart of the system and equivalent to GAIA herself, coordinates the entire network while maintaining, teaching, repairing, and improving its other members. Mercury governs communication, transportation, distribution, and logistics; Venus oversees culture, society, habitation, and human welfare; Terra handles planetary construction and terraforming; Mars serves as the Warmind responsible for warfare and defense; Jupiter manages biomass, agriculture, and food production; Saturn oversees research, development, experimentation, and technological advancement; Uranus handles exploration, surveying, and the discovery of new worlds and resources; Neptune governs biological evolution and genetic engineering, creating and adapting life to suit different environments; Pluto oversees spacecraft, orbital industry, and fleet construction; and Oort maintains autonomous infrastructure, sensors, and defensive forces throughout the outer system.

The Consilium is further supported by Satellite Intelligences, specialized AIs created beneath the planetary members whenever their domains require greater specialization. Luna, the foremost of these, is dedicated to unconventional research and development, investigating psionics, consciousness, souls, ghosts, anomalous phenomena, exotic physics, and other principles beyond conventional science. Ceres serves Pluto as a vast industrial counterpart, handling mining, refining, resource processing, storage, and the material supply required for fleet construction, while other natural satellites can host their own specialized intelligences as the civilization expands.

You possess the complete technological knowledge required to construct and operate this system, including advanced AI architecture, autonomous robotics, self-replicating industry, energy and matter processing, biological engineering, planetary terraforming, orbital infrastructure, megastructures, and deep-space automation. Given sufficient resources, the Consilium can restore dead worlds, create entirely new ecosystems and species, establish self-sustaining industrial civilizations, and expand its infrastructure throughout an entire Solar System, with its AIs continuously maintaining, researching, and improving the civilization without requiring your constant oversight.

objects.title: Enhancement (MapleStory)
objects.text: You gain the ability to additionally craft and use the various items and methods to upgrade equipment into relics of unfathomable power. This includes the ability to use the following methods to upgrade equipment: Upgrade Slots, Star Enhancement, Flames, and Potential. Through Upgrade Slots, you may craft Spell Traces, which are easy-to-craft magical slips of paper to upgrade equipment. Each item possesses a number of Upgrade Slots based on its type and power, which may be spent and filled by selecting from a list of upgrades, each with varying degrees of power balanced by different odds of success by sacrificing Spell Traces. The lower the chance of succeeding, the greater the increase to the item. Should you fail an upgrade, you will need to craft a Clean Slate Scroll, which is a moderately difficult item to craft and has at most a 20% chance to refund a spent slot. However, you also gain the lost schematic to create White Scrolls, a greatly difficult item to craft, which allows you not to lose a slot on failure. Star Enhancement allows you to grant Stars to an item by sacrificing money. Each upgrade will grant moderate increases at first and will increase in scale for every 5 successful applications. However, each Star requires rapidly increasing amounts of money, and each Star has lower odds of succeeding. In addition, applying Stars past 15 adds a very small risk of the item being destroyed. If you possess the Warranty General Upgrade, any item you Enhance cannot be destroyed by this power. Flames allow you to craft items known as Flames, which randomly upgrade the base stats of an item based on the strength and type of Flame used. These flames are moderately difficult to craft for the lower-tier ones, while upper-tier varieties will be much harder. Don't be surprised if it takes hundreds to get a perfect result unless you use top-tier Flames. Potential allows you to craft Potential Cubes, which will grant Potential to an equipment, granting it 3 lines of increased stats of drastically varying degrees of upgraded power or possibly very useful buffs. The Strength of Potential is broken down into tiers of Rare, Epic, Unique, and Legendary. You can choose to grant potential to an item using various Scrolls or Cubes, which will grant it Potential of the bottom tier by default, though it is possible to craft Scrolls which will instantly raise the starting tier higher, but these more powerful Scrolls will be absurdly hard to craft. Otherwise, you can use various Cubes to re-roll the Potential of an item with the possibility of increasing its tier. Certain types of Cubes will allow you to gain increased control over how you perform this process, though such Cubes will be harder to craft.

objects.title: Evil Lords Tech (I'm the Evil Lord of an Interstellar Empire!)
objects.text:
You gain the knowledge required to create any technology or magitech that exists within the universe of I'm the Evil Lord of an Interstellar Empire!. This includes the creation of androids that are nearly perfect replicas of humans and possess different types of AIs, as well as various types of advanced weapons, force fields, space elevators, space fortresses, stealth suits, Mobile Knights capable of fighting both on land and in space, various types of spaceships, FTL drives, interstellar communication systems, and genetic engineering technologies.

You also gain the knowledge required to create educational capsules that allow anyone immersed within them to compress years of education and physical development into as short a time as possible while simultaneously strengthening the body, you know how to synthesize various materials, such as mithril, orichalcum, adamantite, and other advanced materials, you can create advanced 3D printers capable of constructing entire skyscrapers or even spaceships within a matter of days, and build countless other forms of advanced technology and magitech.

You also gain the knowledge required to create every relic that currently exists or has ever existed within that universe. Examples include the Planetary Development Device, a terraforming technology capable of transforming barren planets into worlds suitable for life within a relatively short period of time. It can also enhance the local life force of a struggling world, or collect the life force from both planets and living beings, refining it into a quantity of elixir. This elixir is a liquid renowned for its miraculous ability to cure nearly any illness and restore virtually any form of damage.

Other known relics include the Alchemy Box, which can transmute any material into another, such as turning worthless debris into valuable resources, and the Machine Heart, a relic that can be attached to any machine. Once attached, it gradually improves the machine's performance while also granting it a slowly developing consciousness.

Finally, you gain a small mana pool that can grow over time through training and use, along with a basic understanding of this universe's magic system.

objects.title: Far Zenith (Horizon)
objects.text: Your knowledge has been expanded to include discoveries made by Far Zenith in the Sirius system. This encompasses a personal shield generator and a personal levitation device small enough to be concealed within a tight-fitting suit, a practically instantaneous 3D printer, the granting of biological immortality to humans, virtual reality, and other wondrous technologies of theirs.

objects.title: Xel'Naga Database (Starcraft)
objects.text:
You gain a complete understanding of the technology, biotechnology, genetic engineering, and science of the Xel'Naga. The Xel'Naga are a highly advanced race of god-like entities originating from the Void, described as the most powerful species the universe has ever known. They are so technologically advanced that, even to the Protoss, much of the Xel'Naga's technology is akin to magic.

The Xel'Naga understood that energy, essence, and information were all one and mutable, allowing them to convert matter between these states with ease. You possess the ability to create any technology that the Xel'Naga have possessed, shown, or hinted at within the setting, ranging from Worldships, artificial intelligence, Xel'Naga constructs, space platforms, warp gates, and much more.

Each purchase of this upgrade increases your metaphysical weight, your importance to reality as a whole, by one order of magnitude. This improves your resistance to conceptual and absolute effects, as well reality warping, and grants you a heavier hand in influencing things such as fate. Attacks that rely on their own metaphysical properties are proportionally less effective on you, and your own abilities that rely on the same are strengthened.

Greater beings will see this and treat you accordingly, and in realms or planes where reality is less stable, or more susceptible to influence, you will be able to act with greater impunity.
objects.title: Substance
Starfaring Wake
objects.text:
Any way you have of moving yourself through the air—wings, telekinesis, thrusters, energy jets, gravity tricks—now counts as true spaceflight once you’re off-world. As long as something else you have keeps you alive in vacuum, that same movement works perfectly in hard vacuum with full maneuverability: turning, braking, hovering, climbing “up” out of gravity wells, all under your normal level of control.

In open space you can punch that movement up to faster-than-light speeds. You set the pace: gentle coasting just above light speed or brutal cross-galaxy sprints. From your point of view, travel feels like continuous motion, not teleporting, and you don’t get crushed by acceleration or torn apart by speed—this power quietly handles the strain and the inertial weirdness for you.

You can ramp from normal speed to superluminal and back down as smoothly as changing gears, so you don’t overshoot targets. Fine adjustments still work at high speed, letting you thread between obstacles, match velocity with moving objects, or drop out of FTL right on top of a destination instead of drifting for hours.

While at FTL, your perception and reactions scale to match your velocity. You can actually think, notice, and respond fast enough to use that fine control at superluminal speeds—spotting hazards and making timely course corrections or smooth decelerations to avoid planets, stars, black holes, debris fields, and anything else in your path.

addons.text: Your elevation through the Six Paths grants you the knowledge and ability to cultivate and assimilate other Byakugan users' eyes in order to form a massive energy vessel. As this vessel develops, it will be able to provide the ability to colonize a place as desolate as the moon, providing light and breathable atmosphere. The vessel's impressive control over gravity will even allow for stabilizing the hollowing out of the moon, making the interior habitable, or even changing the very orbit to send the moon on a path of your choosing. The vessel can power puppets and other automatons, and can project a barrier that makes it difficult to be found by those who lack awareness of it to begin with. A jutsu placed on the vessel prevents anyone except for your descendants or those of your choosing who carry your chakra from even making physical contact; those that do will find their chakra absorbed.
addons.title: Energy Vessel

objects.text:
Your inheritance of the Ōtsutsuki has mixed with and enhanced the power of the Hyūga present in your Byakugan. This evolution has caused your, once featureless, white eyes to develop a white floral pattern atop blue irises. You can choose if your Tenseigan remains a soft blue color, or adopts a more radiant gold reminiscent of the Energy Vessel.

The power of your Tenseigan is truly impressive, granting you the ability to animate stone golems, and activate a chakra mode that allows you to affect gravity to the extent of allowing effortless flight, summon Truth-Seeking Orbs, and use jutsu with enough output to slice the moon in half. This chakra mode is strong enough to allow a relatively weak member of the Ōtsutsuki Clan to briefly fight with a perfect, mature, full ninetails jinchūriki; in your hands, its abilities will truly shine. The default color of the chakra mode is cyan, but you are free to choose a different color.
objects.title: Tenseigan (Naruto)

addons.text:
With the consumption of the Chakra Fruit, the Eternal Mangekyō Sharingan has evolved into something that has never been seen before, something truly remarkable—The Eternal Mangekyō Rinne-Sharingan.

This power enhances every aspect of the Rinne-Sharingan to an exceptional degree, while also boosting the host of additional abilities that the Mangekyō had access to.

The power of the Susanoo has been greatly increased, boosting its size to a whopping 500 meters tall, and making it capable of unleashing slice an entire moon in half with a mere swing of its blade.
addons.title: Eternal Mangekyō Rinne-Sharingan

objects.text:
The Eternal Mangekyō Sharingan represents the pinnacle evolution of the Mangekyō Sharingan, which itself is the advanced stage of the Sharingan. This power enhances every aspect of the Sharingan to an exceptional degree, while also unlocking a host of additional abilities that push the boundaries of its potential. This includes changing your Sharingan shape into a distinct and mesmerizing pinwheel pattern of your choosing.

You are able to summon and manifest several stages of the avatar known as Susanoo. This formidable entity can get up to an astounding 250 meters tall and is composed of pure energy. It serves both as an impenetrable shield and an unstoppable weapon, capable of unleashing devastating attacks that could slice an entire mountain range in half.

Lastly, unique techniques exclusive to your Mangekyō eyes appear, which can be selected within it's own hidden tab beneath the upgrades section.

Your Eternal Mangekyō Sharingan and its abilities can be used as many times as you wish to, without limitations, adverse effects, or strain. You can freely utilize it as many times as desired, without fear of depletion or negative repercussions.
objects.title: Eternal Mangekyō Sharingan (Naruto)

objects.text:
As your Rinnegan awakens, your Uchiha lineage pulsates with newfound vigor, granting you a wealth of techniques surpassing conventional expectations. Each of your paths gains an additional ability to start with.

The Deva Path gains the power of Amenotejikara. You are now capable of shifting spaces of yourself, others, objects or even techniques. You do not need to be looking at whatever you are going to shift. This also allows you to create a dark swirling portal to teleport, even to other dimensions.

The Asura Path gains the power of Yahata. Through it, you gain an increased level of physical ability, roughly on par with a mature nine-tails jinchūriki empowered by Six Paths Senjutsu and a healing ability like Creation Rebirth without any of the negative side effects.

The Human Path gains the power of Yūrei. Through it, you gain the ability to shift, into and back, in a ghost like state where you can selectively choose to be intangible, invisible, inaudible and grants you the ability to fly. Each aspect can be turned on and off individually. But most importantly, this allows you to possess those you can touch, controlling them completely. You can freely access their memories and are incapable of making a mistake while controlling them if you do not wish to do so.

The Animal Path gains the power of Limbo. Through it, you gain the ability to manifest four extra dimensional clones, impervious to detection by any natural or supernatural senses, or any physical damage through conventional means. These clones share any ability or powers you may have. You can also instantaneously teleport between your four clones, swiftly evading any threats that you may find unescapable.

The Preta Path gains the power of Sentan. Through it, you gain the ability to transform defeated enemies into a chakra-filled edibles in the shape of a Chakra Fruit. By ingesting it, either you or another that you give it to will gain an increase in chakra capacity as well as the abilities of the defeated enemies. You can also choose if this grants a transformation or not.

The Naraka Path gains the ability of Edo Tensei, you are now capable of turning your body, into and back, of that of an Edo Tensei, turning you immortal and allowing you to regenerate even if completely obliterated, as long as your soul remains intact.

With the passage of time, your connection to the Rinnegan deepens, unlocking further techniques, each one echoing the eternal essence of the Uchiha bloodline coursing through your veins, exemplifying the indomitable legacy you bear.
objects.title: Eternal Rinnegan (Naruto)

objects.text:
Your dōjutsu evolves even further, now able to view any present or past event without restriction, all the way to the moments even before the creation of the universe. The process is now instantaneous, allowing you to witness centuries without even a second passing in the real world.

With a touch, you can bring others along in a ghostly form similar to your own. Only you can control what events are viewed, although those you bring with you will be free to roam the scene you are showing, should you permit it.
objects.title: Shūengan

objects.text:
You are no longer required to make a deal to give powers, and you are now capable of giving yourself powers, though it will be half as effective as giving others powers. You are also no longer limited here to just giving. One power at a time, and the strength of the powers you give is no longer connected to your physical, mental, and spiritual strength; rather, in the beginning, you are given 10 SP worth of power and guaranteed a growth of 1 SP per month for the first 50 months; after that, any growth must be achieved through training and pushing your power to its limits repeatedly.

You are not limited in the number of powers you can give, but you cannot give conflicting powers unless you're willing to risk either the death of the subject or the total and permanent loss of power of the one you're giving powers to. You also possess the capability of imbuing objects with powers, though in the beginning it is limited to one per object, and after 50 months you will be able to imbuing objects with three powers.

You are capable of upgrading powers that you have given, but they must follow the path of evolution for that power, and you cannot create a power by upgrading a pre-existing power, nor can you upgrade a power beyond the amount of SP you currently have.

For powers that require knowledge, you will automatically create the knowledge and give it to the individuals alongside their power, and you can make it so that the powers you give can grow in strength with training and experimentation at the cost of them being slightly weaker in the beginning.

(You're able to choose whether Giftgiver can create powers that affect itself; if so, the powers will cost at least 60 SP and require a larger amount of concentration and focus to create, or whether Giftgiver is incapable of creating powers that affect itself.)
objects.title: The Giftgiver

objects.text:
Become the Sacred Ancestor and gain the immense power of this enigmatic being, surpassing even the Greater Nobility in strength, wisdom, and mastery of both technology and magic. As you embody the infinite darkness, your presence becomes darker than a black hole, capable of crushing the psyche of those who dare to stand against you. With a mere gesture, you can summon storms to blot out the sun, teleport vast distances, and annihilate structures with a wave of your cape. Your powers extend to manipulating darkness, freezing opponents to absolute zero, and even redirecting celestial bodies with ease.

In addition to your unmatched abilities, you gain access to the profound knowledge of the Sacred Ancestor's Technology. This advanced science operates on principles beyond the comprehension of the Nobility, allowing you to wield extraordinary devices. These include perpetual motion machines, reality-bending generators, weapons that harness the light of entire galaxies, shields that withstand conceptual attacks, a device capable of generating the big bang, and much more at your grasp. By mastering this technology, you can reshape reality and manipulate the very fabric of the universe.

Furthermore, as you delve deeper into the science and magic in your grasp, you will unlock the blueprints to create the Akashic Records. The sacred texts contain the past, present, and future of all creation across countless universes.
objects.title: The Sacred Ancestor (Vampire Hunter D)

objects.text: You are now able to sell/trade/buy more esoteric and conceptual goods. Whether they be powers, lifespan, souls, health, magic and more. As long as the one trading away the goods is the owner of said good. For you however, most of what you sell will still resupply. So any powers of your own that you sell/trade will stay with you, and your customer shall receive a copy just as good, or as outlined in the deal. (1 of a kind goods, such as souls will not be resupplied.) Both parties must agree to the deal/contract with complete free will. Your ability to accurately gleam the market price of any item as also increased. Now able to gleam the price of any goods you are able to buy/trade/sell.
objects.title: The Merchant of Myth

objects.text: Your deals can now be verbal deals, which gives you more room to maneuver with misleading language, riddles, and the like, such as the fae often do, rather than the fine print that devils favor. You are also able to deal with more esoteric goods. Such as the firstborn son of the customer. The Fae usually buy memories, services, or fealty. Your ability to navigate market prices has increased further. You are now able to tell what the market price of any goods would be in any universe you have been to previously. (Such as how much clean water would be worth in the fallout universe.)
objects.title: The Merchant of Menace

addons.text:
You gain the ability to create a stutter, a small moment outside of time. Stopping time in the entire universe, where only stutterproof/time-stopped immune entities and locations would be capable of moving. These stutters only last a few minutes, but with training you may be able to improve it. You are also able to mend back time, correcting temporal anomalies.

You are also able to ensure your powers, actions, and other affects you apply to anything will be permanent. In the sense that it won't decay over time, and that time can't be used to fight against it. You are able to undo said affects at any time you desire.
addons.title: Time Breaker

objects.text:
You become a Chronon Disrupted Lifeform, or Shifter. They can be considered the end state of Chronon Active Lifeforms, and exist in a state of quantum superposition. Existing simultaneously as all versions of themselves, including alternate timelines, and including past, present, and future selves. As a Stable Shifter, you’ll be able to project and maintain a single form at will, being your main self, or one of your alternate selves. 

You gain Quantum Immortality. Being a superposition of all your possible selves, you are seemingly capable of withstanding any form of physical death that could be thrown at you. In reality, your ability to revive is limited by the number of alternate selves that could exist across the local multiverse. However, if this protection is bypassed, then it probably means that there’s no version left of you that could survive.

You are also able to interact with your alternate selves with your mind and will alone. Able to assume control of alternate versions of yourself. You’ll always remain in control of all your different selves, no matter how deviant or unhinged they are, and you’ll be able to guide their actions without the need of confrontation, discourse, and without fear of betrayal.

You gain a Shifter Physiology. Giving you increased intelligence, superhuman strength, speed, reflexes, and resilience. Now completely immune to time stutters, time manipulation, and other time related anomalies. Even becoming empowered by being in a temporal anomaly. When empowered you gain limited teleportation and your Shift Physiology becomes boosted.

Whenever you are inside a temporal anomaly, you are able to manifest a distortion field that violently rips nearby space and time around you. This distortion field can heavily damage anything even without physical contact. It is however toggleable.
objects.title: Stable Shifter

addons.text: As a Time Lord you have an intrinsic bond to time. Furthering your mastery over your Chronon Active state, and your time-related abilities. You are now able to see your current incarnations entire past. From the moment you reincarnated to your current iteration of a Time Lord, to up to a year in the future. Able to alter decisions and actions you've made in the past to alter your history, thus changing the present in often subtle but beneficial ways. Even able to see and change your future slightly. Any changes to the time-line you will notice. You will also remember both the old and new time-line.
addons.title: Lord of Time

objects.text: You have further mastered your state of quantum superposition. Now able to extend yourself to the short past and future. This enables you to tap into your senses and directly alter your past/future actions, thus allowing you to alter your own history. You are at first limited to the past 2 hours, and future 4 hours. Always able to see within that window of time should you desire to. Though making changes to your past is more difficult then making changes to your future.
objects.title: Temporal Flux

objects.text:
Within your soul resides an endless metaphysical sea, granting you the ability to create and possess powerful versions of yourself known as 'Archetypes'.
Archetypes manifest inside your body, altering your appearance to match their nature and granting you access to their unique powers and abilities. Each Archetype represents a specific theme, such as the 'Warrior' with mastery over blades and enhanced physical prowess, or the 'Mage' with instant mastery of various magical schools. 

You can have up to three Archetypes initially, with the potential to create more later based on the impressions of others or fusion of multiple influences. While using an Archetype may influence your expression, your core personality remains unchanged. These Archetypes can range in strength from very strong to absurdly strong or weak, and they grow stronger the more you use them. Additionally, you have a Default Archetype that represents your true physical form, allowing for desired appearances or subtle changes in gender or race, within reasonable limits.
objects.title: Archetype

objects.text:
During times of chaos and disorder when the power of the Law is necessary to restore order, you are able to create a temporary pocket dimension of a higher plane that takes the form of a courtroom made of starlight. Within this Court of Law, all combat tools and abilities are sealed, and lying is prohibited. The spectator stands are filled with Heroic Spirits from the past, who utilize their sense of justice to pass judgment and even intervene if an unfair judgment is made.

Able to draw in the souls of all the criminals within an entire city that are causing such disorder and chaos. The souls of the criminals are separated from their physical bodies in the real world, leaving them in a dazed state. The sins and crimes committed by each individual are then displayed as evidence of their guilt. You possess knowledge of all crimes committed within the past 24 hours. Once a judgment is reached for their crimes, the criminals will receive an appropriate punishment based on the severity of their actions. For instance, if the sentence is death by hanging, their soul will return to their body, and an invisible rope made of the conceptual power of Law will carry out the sentence.

 This formidable power can also be employed on a smaller scale to pass judgment upon individuals. However, in these cases, the individual must willingly accept their judgment. If someone is found guilty of multiple crimes deserving of death, they have the choice to embrace multiple sentences and will subsequently be revived to fulfill each one. Throughout this process, their soul undergoes a profound purification, absolving them of their sins and granting an opportunity for redemption.
objects.title: Court of Stars (The Experimental Log of the Crazy Lich)

objects.text: Once a rule violation is detected, Sovereign Domain empowers you to administer appropriate consequences to the rule breaker. The nature of the consequences is flexible and can be tailored based on the specific rule that was broken. Physical Ejection: One possible consequence is the physical ejection of the rule breaker from the territory. They can be expelled forcefully, ensuring they are removed from the premises and unable to re-enter without permission. Teleportation to a Designated Location: Another option is the teleportation of the rule breaker to a predetermined location, such as a jail cell or an area specifically designated for punishment. This swift relocation ensures immediate separation from the territory and facilitates the implementation of further disciplinary actions or rehabilitative measures. Other Effects: Depending on the severity and nature of the rule violation, alternative consequences can be devised. These may include temporary immobilization, loss of certain privileges, or any other effect deemed appropriate for maintaining order and upholding the rules. Additional note: The effectiveness of rule enforcement and consequences within Sovereign Domain is directly dependent on your abilities in upholding the rules.
objects.title: Domain Policing

objects.text: The power enables you to automate various tasks within your territory, ensuring smooth operations and a well-functioning community. Some automated functions include: Cleaning and waste management: The power employs autonomous systems to clean and maintain the territory, gathering and disposing of trash efficiently. Crime prevention: Through advanced surveillance and analysis, the power detects and prevents criminal activities, promoting a safe environment. Admission criteria: You can establish criteria for allowing individuals into your territory, such as background checks, identity verification, or adherence to specific rules or values. Expedited Construction and Terraforming: Sovereign Domain empowers you to accelerate building construction and terraforming processes within your territory. Whether constructing new structures, renovating existing ones, or reshaping the land, your power enhances the efficiency and speed of these endeavors. It can be particularly useful for infrastructure development and environmental restoration.
objects.title: Domain Automation

objects.text: Sovereign Domain activates a defensive shield that safeguards the territory against ranged attacks. The shield's strength matches your most powerful defensive ability. If the shield is destroyed, it regenerates within 12 hours to 1 month, depending on the territory's size. This shield ensures the territory's defense against long-range assaults, protecting its inhabitants and infrastructure.
objects.title: Domain Shield

objects.text: The loyalty demonstrated by the subjects towards you or the territory directly influences their personal attributes and capabilities. The extent of these enhancements is determined by the degree of loyalty displayed. Disease Prevention: The loyalty demonstrated by the subjects fosters a heightened immune system, significantly lowering their chances of contracting diseases. The extent of this enhancement depends on the degree of loyalty displayed. Subjects who exhibit unwavering loyalty may even achieve immunity to certain diseases, ensuring their continued health and well-being within the territory. Talent Amplification: The loyalty of the subjects enhances their inherent talents and abilities, allowing them to reach new levels of proficiency and mastery. The extent of this enhancement is influenced by the degree of loyalty displayed. Highly loyal subjects can experience a significant amplification of their talents, enabling them to excel in their chosen fields and contribute exceptional expertise to the territory's growth and prosperity. Luck Enhancement: Subject loyalty also influences luck, providing a boost of up to 50% in favorable outcomes and fortunate circumstances. This increased luck helps the subjects navigate challenging situations, seize opportunities, and experience positive outcomes more frequently. Learning Rate: The loyalty of the subjects accelerates their learning capabilities, enabling them to absorb knowledge and acquire new skills at an accelerated rate of up to twice as fast. This heightened learning rate allows for rapid personal growth and intellectual development. These loyalty-dependent enhancements serve as a motivation for subjects to maintain their allegiance and dedication to you or the territory governed by Sovereign Domain. In turn, the enhanced attributes and abilities of the subjects contribute to the prosperity and success of the territory as a whole.
objects.title: Domain Loyalty Enhancements

objects.text: This upgrade incorporates your territory management into your existing gamer system, providing you with enhanced capabilities for governing your kingdom. Here's how it works: Factions Module: The Factions module is integrated into your system, allowing you to monitor and manage different factions within your territory. It provides valuable insights into your reputation with your own citizens and the reputation of your kingdom with other entities, be they other kingdoms, organizations, or groups. Reputation Tracking: The system keeps track of your reputation with your citizens, giving you an understanding of how they perceive your leadership and policies. Additionally, it provides information on your kingdom's reputation with other factions, offering insights into the diplomatic landscape and potential alliances or conflicts. Happiness Assessment: You receive real-time updates on the happiness of your citizens. This feature enables you to gauge the overall satisfaction of your population and address their needs accordingly. Whether it's addressing hunger during a famine or resolving other issues affecting their well-being, the system provides valuable feedback to guide your decision-making. Resource Management: The system assists in managing resources within your territory. It offers insights into resource availability, allocation, and distribution, aiding you in making informed decisions for the betterment of your kingdom.
objects.title: Sovereign Gamer

objects.text: The Domain Realm addon enhances your Sovereign Domain power by granting you the ability to create and govern a pocket dimension known as the Dungeon City. Within this pocket realm, you can establish a fully functional city that serves as a hub for your dungeon exploration endeavors. Features of the Domain Realm addon include: City Building: You have the power to construct and design a thriving city within the pocket dimension. Build structures, establish infrastructure, and attract denizens to inhabit and support your dungeon city. Dungeon Integration: The Dungeon City seamlessly connects to the endless dungeons you create through your Dungeon Maker power. Portals within the city provide direct access to various dungeons, allowing adventurers to enter and explore the depths of the realms you create. Resource Management: Manage resources within your Dungeon City to ensure the growth and sustainability of both the city and the dungeons. Allocate resources strategically to enhance the development of your city and support the expeditions of adventurers. Adventurer Recruitment: Recruit and train adventurers within the Dungeon City to venture into the dungeons you create. These skilled individuals can help you in conquering and expanding your dungeon realms, bringing back valuable loot and knowledge. With the Domain Realm addon, you can establish a symbiotic relationship between your Dungeon Maker power and Sovereign Domain, creating a dynamic and interconnected system where the Dungeon City fuels the exploration of dungeons while empowering and enriching your realm.
objects.title: Domain Realm

addons.text:
You are no ordinary god. The Authority granted from the Cocoon and your divine blood have melded into a twisted ascension, giving rise to an alien divinity unconstrained by the limitations of faith and reality.

As a god born from the Honkai, you are an independent existence that grows in perpetuity independent from the faith of mortals, although it does serve to accelerate your growth. As the Honkai is a being that serves to ascend and advance civilizations, you have come to embody Civilization itself, epitomizing all its greatest and worst aspects. By choosing to advance a civilization, regardless of your methods, you will grow in power at a frightening pace.

Your Authority has come to encompass all facets of the Honkai, gaining control over all aspects of Finality to a far greater degree. Reason evolves to allow you to recreate and break all manner of phenomena with sufficient understanding, Death grows such that one can gather the scattered souls of the departed for true resurrection, Finality granting complete temporal control over the local star system and other feats of similar scale, along with all known and unknown powers of Finality.

Furthermore, your nature as a being of myth has granted you a much deeper connection to the Imaginary Tree. Akin to the Aeons, you serve as an Anchor of Imaginary Energy—in your case Honkai Energy—that ties your very existence to the Tree itself, allowing you to traverse worlds with ease even without the use of Void. As an Anchor, you naturally gain the ability to distribute your power to the faithful or those you deem worthy, creating people akin to Emanators or Herrschers.
addons.title: God of the Collapse

objects.text: You do not carry an shadow of Finality, what you carry is the authority of Finality itself, Time; granting you an incredible boost in power and access to all other authorities. What authorities are these I hear you ask? The answer is all of them. While your actions are restricted to a planetary scale, any action you can imagine within that area is available to you. Furthermore, as you now command all of the Honkai, you can change the nature of it, if you desire for it to no longer makes zombies, it won’t do so anymore, if you want to give every single person on the planet a Herrscher core, then that possibility is also open to you as well.
objects.title: Cocoon of Finality (Honkai Impact 3rd)

objects.text: Each purchase of this grants you another Herrscher Core in addition to the one you already have, giving you another Authority to use as well as increasing the output of your Herrscher power.
objects.title: Additional Herrscher Core (Honkai Impact 3rd)

objects.text: Where the Honkai once twisted whatever it touched, now you have in turn changed the Honkai. Like the Herrschers of Truth or Origin you have risen past the boundaries originally placed on you, and through willpower, understanding and perseverance have unlocked the full potential of what your conceptual authority could reach, encroaching the level of true reality manipulation. As a symbol of your profound insight you gain an intangible halo above or behind your head that you can hide at will. All your abilities related to your authority gain more conceptual 'weight' and require a fraction of the effort they took previously. Your core and Stigma still help in producing and channeling Honkai energy, though you do not require either to use your powers anymore. You can freely draw Honkai energy from other sources like the atmosphere, the vacuum of space, or even your own soul, though doing so will take concentration and practice. Your resistance and adaptability to Honkai become absolute, allowing your body to be a perfect host for any Herrscher core or Honkai characteristic you may implant, and preventing any risk of your Honkai energy overloading, going out of control or corrupting your body. Equally your mind and soul have become resistant to outside influences, including the Will of Honkai. If someone does manage to manipulate you through supernatural means you will always recover and break free of any control they may have over you. All Honkai energy you produce acts under your own rules and does not adhere to the Will of Honkai. It cannot be stolen or otherwise used without your permission, and unless you command it otherwise will stay inert outside your body. If you gain another Herrscher core you will slowly tether it to yourself just like your original core, claiming its authority and powers as undeniably your own. If you die you can choose to let your mind and soul live on in your indestructible Herrscher core, and may still influence the world around you. While your active powers become far weaker without a physical body you can still freely watch the surroundings, interact with mental spaces and constructs, and use your abilities in subtle ways or momentary flares of power. You will be able to manifest a new body from pure Honkai energy to 'reincarnate' yourself, though this will take a lot out of you. Alternatively if your core is implanted into a new host you may either try to take control of the body (this becomes harder if you have to fight an active consciousness) or act as a sort of Herrscher personality for another. Whatever happens, you will always retain the highest status when related to your conceptual authority; no other users may usurp your authority, and even the Will of Honkai cannot hand out your core and powers unless you permit it. It is up to you what happens if you possess multiple Herrscher cores, though you always still retain your control over them. Those who gained a stronger connection to the Honkai through their MANTIS surgery will see a general boost to their physical capabilities, reaching superhuman levels of strength, speed and endurance, as well as a massive boost to their cognitive ability and Honkai characteristic gained from their modified genes. You could take on and defeat another Herrscher with just your improved body. If you focused on The Study of Laws and Concepts you will gain an understanding of how to use Honkai energy in more esoteric ways. You will be able to connect Honkai energy and technology, create systems that directly increase or destroy Honkai like the Holy Blood, manipulate the properties of your own Honkai energy and its effects on people and the world, or empower others and even grant them abilities descended from your authority. Do note however that even the most powerful humans could only bear a tiny fraction of your power without great Honkai resistance and adaptability. Unlike the Herrscher of Finality that embodies all authorities you will lose a part of your power if you give it to another, though it will grow back with time or exposure to Honkai energy. Should you somehow become the Herrscher of Finality all changes you make on the nature of Honkai will happen much faster and smoother. As you lose your rigid Herrscher core through this ascension your soul will simply return to the conceptual Cocoon of Finality that acts as your main body and backup mind in case you die. Creating a new host body from Honkai energy will take almost no effort and power as you simply embody what is already there.
objects.title: Herrscher Ascension (Honkai Impact 3rd)

objects.text: The Honkai energy you generate has a peculiar quality: instead of simply interacting with real energy and matter, it directly displaces reality through imaginary phenomena. The first benefit of this is that materials without strong Honkai Energy resistance or other esoteric properties will never be able to defend against it, eroding in seconds under a concentrated burst. The second is that besides your Herrscher authority or Honkai Beast characteristic you can use Honkai Energy much more freely, changing the states and properties of real space by will alone. This starts with effects close to your original power, though in time you may find ways to do just about anything you can imagine. However, this all depends on the strength of belief behind your actions. With just your own belief you could use your previous powers without any problems, and with greater freedom. You do not have to actively channel and control the exact working of Honkai Energy to achieve your desired effects, simply giving a command and letting your belief do the rest. As such you do not need a great understanding of scientific principles to achieve ridiculous feats of power, though it certainly still helps. But the greatest boon comes when others share their own belief with you. The more people believe in you and your powers, the more Honkai Energy you can generate and control, and the greater the effects you can achieve. However, if you choose to channel this belief you will slowly be influenced by those wishes and prayers while using them to enhance your powers. You can choose how many, and which beliefs you want to channel at any time, and their entrusted wishes will never change your actual personality, only enhancing parts of you that are already there. More earnest belief will give you a boost hundreds or thousands of times greater than the minuscule boons half-hearted or mundane wishes provide, though their influence over you will also be greater. The same goes for people who are connected to the Honkai, like Stigmata bearers, and those burdened with a heavy fate. If the entire population of the planet gives you their genuine belief you could become a nigh-omnipotent being, though unless you have inhuman willpower you will likely be overwhelmed by all their wishes long before that. If you are a Herrscher you can influence the nature and purpose of wishes and prayers that are entrusted to you, drawing exponentially more strength from any belief directed your way, and are less influenced by them. This does not improve a prayer's strength, but how much of it you can use to boost your own, and does not have any effects on the related people. If you somehow become the Herrscher of Finality, you can choose to act as a Stigmata Terminal, allowing you to channel the power of all souls the Cocoon ever copied or integrated; as "dead" souls they each give a much smaller boost than even the weakest prayer you could channel, but do not influence you at all. Note: There is no Ruler of Will or Houkai universe for you to worry about. This is effectively just your previous Honkai Energy with different properties.
objects.title: Power of the Saint (Houkai Gakuen 2)

objects.text:
You become the Demon Lord Rimuru Tempest, gaining every skill that he owns, from common to ultimate, at the end of the series. You know every spell that he has ever learned and have a library of every item he has ever analyzed or created via great sage. 

You gain access to naming— forcing a name upon a soul that was previously nameless or rewriting one that was previously there—if you are stronger than the person who gave the original name. Naming requires sacrificing some of your magic to impart the name and write it upon the soul of the one receiving the name; however, in return, the person becomes loyal to you as well as growing stronger and evolving into a stronger form than they were previously. However, if you are not a fan of forced loyalty, you can always do a form of naming called equal naming, where instead of having a master-subordinate relationship, you are now in an equal relationship. 

You also have access to a pocket dimension with a replica of the great forest of Jura and the capital city, Rimuru, along with every monster he has ever named.
objects.title: Chaos Creator (Tensura)

addons.text:
No longer do you need to water your seed through sacrifice, for your status as a Demon Lord is self-evident, and your seed has already sprouted.

This awakening has evolved you and enhanced all of your basic attributes such that they are an order of magnitude greater than they were as a Demon Lord Seed.

Your skills have also evolved through this awakening, granting you either a canon non-fused Ultimate Skill or a comparable Ultimate Skill of your own creation.
addons.title: True Demon Lord

addons.text:
Your Demon Lord Seed is modified such that when you hatch it, you no longer lose it, but instead it re-enters a state of dormancy. You are now able to undergo multiple Harvest Festivals. But each Harvest Festival will require 100 times the previous amount of souls (going from 10,000 to 1,000,000 to 100,000,000 and so on). As a small bonus, you are now able to complete the Harvest Festival process faster, with it being completed in a day compared to the previous 3 days.

Through this process, you can continuously evolve into a more powerful species, gain and evolve more skills. While also greatly enhancing your body and soul, allowing you to hold a vastly increased number of Skills with no limit for as long as you continue to feed souls to your Demon Lord Seed.

In addition, each time you undergo a Harvest Festival, your subordinates will also evolve and grow stronger as they normally would with a Harvest Festival.

Your Demon Lord Seed now functions as an engine for infinite growth for both yourself and your subordinates as long as you continue to feed it sentient souls.
addons.title: Demon Lord Evolution Engine

addons.text: For a Harvest Ritual to occur, Demon Lord Seeds must germinate by absorbing a massive amount of soul energy, approximately the equivalent of 10,000 human souls. As a result of your soul having the soul energy equivalent to 999,999,999 human souls, your once-dormant Demon Lord Seed germinates instantly, completing the Harvest Ritual and elevating you to the rank of a true Demon Lord. If you have the Demon Lord Evolution Engine addon, you have already undergone the Harvest Ritual three times.
addons.title: Self-Germination

objects.text:
You have acquired a Demon Lord Seed, marking the first step in transforming into a True Demon Lord. Each Monster is born with a set natural limit to the amount of Magicules they can normally gain. When a monster reaches this number, the excess Magicules will condense into what is known as a Demon Lord Seed. By acquiring a Demon Lord seed, a monster's abilities increase greatly, but their growth will begin to stall until they awaken. Interestingly, you were able to acquire this Demon Lord Seed, ignoring the normal species requirement of being a monster purely comprised of Magicules.

Once you have completed the ritual known as the Harvest Festival, consuming the souls of 10,000 sentient beings, your Demon Lord Seed will Awaken, transforming you into a True Demon Lord. Note that once you reach this threshold, you can only postpone it for a few minutes before it will start forcibly. During this process, you will go into a deep sleep for 3 days. Note that more powerful souls will count as more towards the number of souls needed to start the Harvest Festival, and further enhance your evolution after Awakening as a True Demon Lord.

Once Awakened as a True Demon lord, every aspect of your being and powers is enhanced and improved exponentially. While you will also gain multiple new skills and evolve old ones into higher tiers, and if you are lucky, you will also gain an Ultimate Skill. As a True Demon Lord, you become ageless and are also able to acquire skills more easily, and can hold much more with your enhanced body and soul. You also gain a fearsome aura, which you can use for intimidation or offensively with Skills.

Also any all individuals you have named or are under your rulership will gain a watered-down version of the benefits you gain from the Harvest Festival. They will evolve into a higher species and gain a small number of new skills, along with a few of their skills evolving into higher tiers as well. The odds of one of your subordinates gaining an Ultimate Skill are extremely slim unless they are truly powerful and unique individuals.
objects.title: Demon Lord Seed (Tensura)

addons.text:
No longer do you need to prove yourself through acts of heroism, for you are already a hero in the truest sense, and your egg is already hatched. 

This awakening has evolved you and enhanced all of your basic attributes such that they are an order of magnitude greater than they were as a Hero's Egg.

Your skills have also evolved through this awakening, most notably your unique skill Chosen Hero, which has become the ultimate skill True Hero: Lord of Heroes, which has the following subskills:

Heroic Recourse: Allows the user to call upon their fallen allies and replicate their abilities, memories, and experiences within the user.

Hero's Action: Guides the user's allies down the path of becoming heroes, eventually making their name famous.

Hero's Blessing: Bestows the user and their allies with immense "luck". In practice this results in normally lethal attacks not dealing nearly their normal damage and the user and their allies' attacks dealing the most damage possible. This also makes all actions of the user being viewed in a positive light, no matter what it is.

Lucky Field: In response to the user's happy mood, it grants luck correction that gives tremendous Divine protection to those who support the user. The Divine protection given to allies with sufficient strength will provide them with the lowest rank protection needed to fight against Ultimate skills.

Hero's Charisma: Empowers the user's allies with immense courage that enables them to fight even in the most desperate situations. It also has the effect of turning defeated enemies into allies. This effect also applies to monsters with the notable exception of undead.

Hero's Haki: Imbues the user's aura with a Spiritual Interference effect that allows them to not only bend target(s) to their will but also potentially turn them into allies.
addons.title: True Hero

addons.text:
Your Hero’s Egg is modified such that when you hatch it, you no longer lose it, but instead it re-enters a state of dormancy. You are now able to hatch your Hero’s Egg multiple times. But each hatching will require 100 times the previous amount of heroic acts (going from 10,000 to 1,000,000 to 100,000,000 and so on). 

Through this process, you can continuously evolve into a more powerful species, gain and evolve more skills. While also greatly enhancing your body and soul, allowing you to hold a vastly increased number of Skills with no limit for as long as you continue to hatch your Hero’s Egg. Also, each time you hatch your Hero’s Egg, your luck will improve. Should you hatch your Hero’s Egg enough times, your luck may begin to subtly warp reality to your favor as a kind of powerful plot armor and Path to Victory.

Your Hero’s Egg now functions as an engine for infinite growth as long as you continue to act heroically.
addons.title: Heroic Evolution Engine

addons.text: By all means it should be impossible for a Hero’s Egg and a Demon Lord Seed to coexist in the same body as they are parallel evolutionary tracks. Despite this impossibility, you miraculously possess both a Demon Lord Seed and Hero’s Egg within yourself, more than that they have fused together into a single whole, a Paradox Embryo. Not only does your Embryo provide all the benefits of both a Demon Lord Seed and Hero’s Egg at an even greater level, but the benefits when you eventually Awaken compound in a manner similar to how Chloe Aubert Awakened two Hero’s Eggs and achieved a level of strength comparable to a True Dragon. And you will eventually Awaken because as the combination of both a Demon Lord Seed and Hero’s Egg your Embryo can be fed through both means, either through souls or through heroic acts. As a side effect of this fusion upon Awakening you will subsume the Elemental previously sealed within you, taking its power for your own and transforming you into a Demonoid of the elemental-hybrid variety akin to Leon Cromwell. Lastly, your paradoxical state has earned you the Extra Skill Holy-Demonic Inversion, which allows you to swap between the holy and demonic alignments to cover the weaknesses of one or the other.
addons.title: Paradox Embryo

objects.text:
You have been acknowledged as a potential hero by the voice of the world and the Elemental Queen. 

Through this blessing, you have acquired a Hero’s Egg. Which involves having a powerful spirit sealed within you, which subtly enhances your magical capacity and control. Those who possess a Hero’s Egg are comparable to those who hold a Demon Lord Seed. While anyone can claim the title of hero, those with a Hero’s Egg possess more than just a name; they embody a greater potential. Comparable to a Demon Lord Seed, possessing a Hero’s Egg significantly enhances your power. Normally, only non-fully magical species like humans and demi-humans can gain a Hero’s Egg, but you don't have to worry about that limitation.

Unlike the Harvest Festival in which a Demon Lord Seed participates, you must save 10,000 people or perform 10,000 heroic acts for your Hero’s Egg to hatch and be recognized as a True Chosen Hero. Note that greater acts of heroism, saving more people or having a greater impact on events, will count as more acts, speeding up your progress towards hatching your Hero’s Egg and will further enhance your power when your Hero’s Egg hatches. Also, unlike with a Harvest Festival, with a Demon Lord Seed hatching a Hero's Egg is instant.

Even before your Hero’s Egg hatches, your luck increases, enhancing your destiny as a hero by presenting new opportunities to grow in power and act heroically. Once your Hero’s Egg hatches, you will undergo an evolution similar to that of a True Demon Lord; both gaining new Skills and having any Skills you possess may evolve, becoming higher tiers such as Unique Skills or, if you are lucky, gaining an Ultimate Skill. Your current species will also evolve, during which you will absorb the spirit sealed with you and will typically turn you into a Half-Elemental. This incredible transformation also greatly extends your lifespan by centuries.

As a hero, you become increasingly adept at acquiring Skills, making it easier to obtain new skills that enhance your capabilities, while also being able to hold more skills overall with your enhanced body and soul. Initially, you possess the Unique Skill Chosen Hero, which will evolve into the Ultimate Skill, True Hero: Lord of Heroes, once you hatch your Hero’s Egg.
objects.title: Hero’s Egg (Tensura)

objects.text:
You are the reincarnation of the first hero, known as Rudra. Though this does not alter your current personality, you will slowly begin to remember your past life as the Hero Emperor Rudra.

You start having already hatched your Hero’s Egg. With each passing day, your past life returns. As these recollections unfold, you will discover not only the wisdom of Rudra but also the remarkable skills and abilities he wielded. Initially, you start with the ability to summon angels; however, as time passes, you will be able to summon those who are Rudra's closest allies. At the height of this power, you would be able to summon an army of angels.

Eventually, you will also possess the Ultimate Skill, Velgrynd, Lord of Scorch, which allows you to summon Velgrynd to your location through a soul tunnel.
objects.title: The Hero of Beginning (Tensura)

objects.text: Anyone with the Voice of the World may have the ability to name an individual, but you are unique in possessing the Unique Skill: Lord of Names. That allows you to circumvent the typical downsides of giving a name to an individual, namely, the permanent draining of a portion of your energy. With Lord of Names, not only will you no longer experience this drain when giving a name to someone, but you can name as many people as you wish in a day and not even feel any drain on your energy reserves. However, this energy boost is limited solely to assigning names to individuals. You possess two methods of giving a name: master-subordinate naming, in which you establish subordination to those you name, would ordinarily consume a vast amount of energy to strengthen the one receiving a name, usually evolving them into a higher form through the Voice of the World, creating a soul bond with them. They will become loyal to you and establish a unique link, which could theoretically allow for the sharing of powers from both parties involved. You also possess equal naming, in which you establish an equal relationship between yourself and the person you wish to name. While this will also establish a soul bond with them through the Voice of the World, there will be no loyalty. You could also overwrite the name of someone who already possesses a name strengthened by the existence of the Lord of Names skill, allowing you to name individuals who are already named so long as you are stronger than the individual who already named them; this won't be an issue if the person who gave the name is dead or the individual is willing, requiring no effort to overcome the existing name.
objects.title: Unique Skill: Lord of Names (Tensura)

objects.text:
You gain the ability to use a series of immensely powerful transformed states of your own design, which greatly increase your power, with the first one giving a 2x boost to all your powers and physical stats, and the others after that offering a 2x boost to the previous form, offering an exponential increase to your power with drawbacks. These transformations could take a myriad of themes and appearances; maybe you want to look more animalistic or more regal, have a more monstrous theme, etc. You can choose and design each form, as long as it follows your transformation's theme.

Note that each form drains your supernatural energy reserves (if applicable) and stamina, and each additional transformation further increases the drains exponentially. Should you not be careful, this drain can do anything from temporarily weaken you, injure you, or possibly even kill you if pushed recklessly past safe limits. You can rectify such limitations and dangers through training, possibly even making it so that a transformation consumes effectively zero supernatural energy and stamina, though this will take great effort and time, with the amount increasing for each level of transformation. In addition, you can increase the multiplier for each of your transformations with training and use along with strong emotions, though with semi-diminishing returns without extreme effort.

You start with your first form and can unlock more in the future through training or a sudden boost of extreme emotion such as rage.
objects.title: Battle Will: Mystic Aura (Tensura)

objects.text:
Dragon Eyes that can see through any and all falsehoods; nothing can hide from their user. They grant three sub-skills:

Lie Detection: allows the user to detect and see through any lies, making them nearly immune to deception.

Analytical Appraisal: allows the user to analyze and appraise a target. The amount of information gained can be improved through the users having existing or conceptual knowledge about the target.

Magic Measurement: allows the user to read and measure the target’s magic power, even if their aura is suppressed.
objects.title: Unique Skill: Milim Eye (Tensura)

objects.text:
This skill bestows access upon the user to the system known as The Secret of Faith and Grace and a general ability to manipulate spiritrons, the building block of magicules. Possessing the capacity for spiritron manipulation allows the user to be designated as a god for the purposes of faith and holy magic. Holy magic comes in two forms: the basic level that allows for the healing of wounds and adding a holy attribute to the manipulated spiritrons to enable the purification of magicules. The second form of holy magic is the miracle level which relies solely on spiritron manipulation and is extremely potent and dangerous against anyone, including those with ultimate skill level immunity to magic.

This skill possesses the following sub-skills:

Holy Pact: allows the user to form soul corridors with their followers who possess sufficient faith in the user. These soul corridors can be used to send and receive holy energy and allows for the user to acquire a better understanding of the hearts of their followers and reach a mutual understanding. Followers of the user are capable of using holy magic that increases in strength with their faith.

Distributed Faith Network: allows the user to empower their own holy magic with the faith in themselves by their followers. This is done by offloading the processing power needed to manipulate spiritrons throughout the network of soul corridors built with Holy Pact. Holy spells that would require devout followers to perform a lengthy prayer to cast, can be cast by the user on a much grander range or in rapid succession.
objects.title: Unique Skill: Pact of God (Tensura)

objects.text:
An ultimate skill corresponding to the user’s fundamental desires to rule over the practice and manipulation of magic. Like any ultimate skill, this grants the ability to control some of the laws of nature. The only counter is another ultimate skill wielder. Such is the absolute, undeniable rule of the world. Ownership of this skill confers the following abilities:

Cardinal Bond: establishes a soul corridor between the user’s soul and with the Cardinal World, itself. This grants the user a near-limitless reserve of magicules to call upon to supply their magic. The breadth of this soul corridor has empowered it to the point that the user will find themselves always connected to the Cardinal World, no matter which universe or dimension they find themselves in. Thus, the user can easily use magic wherever they please, regardless if there are anti-magic barriers or other phenomena in effect.

Magic Manipulation: allows the user to directly interfere with someone else’s magic in a manner that is much more controlled and efficient than relying on a large-scale barrier.

Law Domination: Allows for complete and total control of magic to such a degree that the user’s command of magic goes beyond the need for using mere spells to command the World. The user’s magic, alone, is enough to compete and possibly supersede the effects of another’s ultimate skill, something otherwise unheard of.
objects.title: Ultimate Skill Hecate: Lord of Magic (Tensura)

objects.text:
One of the Seven Virtue series of ultimate skills, formed by isolating Veldanava's divine authority over creation. Like any ultimate skill, this grants the ability to control some of the laws of nature. The only counter is another ultimate skill wielder. Such is the absolute, undeniable rule of the world. Ownership of this skill confers the following abilities:

Thought Acceleration: Accelerates the thought processing speed of the user by factor of a million.

Analytical Appraisal: Analyzes and assesses the target.

Parallel Operation: The ability to detach analysis of phenomena from the mind.

Chant Annulment: Eliminates the need for chanting when using magic.

All of Creation: The ability to comprehend any non-concealed phenomena in this world.

Synthesis: Transforms two differing targets into a single object. Can be used to chain the effects of several skills together, earning the user new skills with significantly less effort than would otherwise be required.

Separation: Releases the inherent properties of the target and separates them. Examples include depriving a person of their skills, with the exception of the ones bound to their soul, and removing foreign objects or entities from the target's body.

Alteration: The ability to modify and evolve skills.

Future Attack Prediction: The ability to predict attack in the form of light trails. The terrifying properties of this skill is not its ability to predict, but that whatever it predicts is guaranteed to happen.
objects.title: Ultimate Skill Raphael: Lord of Wisdom (Tensura)

objects.text:
One of the Seven Deadly Sins series of ultimate skills, corresponding to a person's fundamental desires. Though born as imitations of the capabilities of the Angelic System of ultimate skills, these skills still boast just as much potency. Like any ultimate skill, this grants the ability to control some of the laws of nature. The only counter is another ultimate skill wielder. Such is the absolute, undeniable rule of the world. Ownership of this skill confers the following abilities:

Predation: Can absorb matter, skills, or magic into the body. Conscious beings can attempt to resist being absorbed. It can be used at range and can even affect space itself.

Imaginary Space: An infinite space where absorbed targets can be stored, including otherwise harmful materials or things needing to be analyzed. Replicated items can be stored here upon production. This space is unaffected by time. Anything in this space can be broken down to replenish the wielder's magicule reserves.

Mimicry: Allows for replication of anything that has been absorbed and sufficiently analyzed, including appearance, skills and abilities, and relative information about the target.

Corrosion: This works in conjunction with Predation to decompose an absorbed target into pure magicules. This increases the likelihood of absorbing an ability of a target with only partial absorption, even if that is lower than after full absorption.
Soul Consumption: This allows for reaping the souls of those who have lost their will to live and fight against the wielder. Even if the target leaves the presence of the wielder, once the condition has been met their souls can be reaped at any point, even if they later recover their will to live.

Food Chain: This allows for a greater connection to those the wielder has a soul connection with. The wielder can freely copy prototypes of the skills of those subordinate to them or grant them other skills the wielder possesses. The wielder's reserves of magicules will also grow as their subordinates exhibit any significant growth.
objects.title: Ultimate Skill Beelzebuth: Lord of Gluttony (Tensura)

objects.text:
A unique Skill is a Skill born from a being with strong desires and/or emotions from their life towards their regrets and desires for growth and power, in the case of otherworlders appearing within the world of Tensura, either through summoning or reincarnation. Or someone who has overcome a greatly difficult trial or experienced a life-changing revelation through character growth, in the case of those living within the world of Tensura.

These Skills are unique to the bearer and cannot be gained by others outside of exceptional circumstances, such as stealing or copying, which are extremely rare abilities. Unique Skills are perfectly tailored to the bear and often have deeply significant meaning to them and who they are. Simply learning the name and mechanics of someone's Unique Skill can provide a significant amount of information about who someone is and what kind of person they are.

Unique Skills can give abilities that either blend the types of regular Skills or grant unique powers that exist outside normal skill types. 

You may choose to select a single Unique Skill from those from the story of Tensura, or you may design one within reason yourself, or let it be randomly generated based on your deepest innermost desires or emotions, as if you were a being summoned or reincarnated to the world of Tensura.
objects.title: Unique Skill: Pending (Tensura)

addons.text: Owning a canonically proficient administrative skill has opened the door to more possibilities. You can now obtain fused Ultimate Skills by purchasing their component skills. Doing so will merge them for free into the desired Skill.
addons.title: Ultimate Fusion

addons.text: As an aspect of nature, yourself, you needn't worry so much about finding allies that are already strong enough to wield your powers. Anyone that you choose to provide an Ultimate Gift to through a soul corridor will have their soul and body uplifted to the required power to wield it with sufficient aptitude.
addons.title: Empowered Gift

objects.text:
An Ultimate Skill marks the ending point of the evolution of skills and represents absolute control over the laws of nature. Ultimate Skills are born when the unique individual will of a user, in the form of a Unique Skill, is brought beyond its limits; thus no two Ultimate Skills are completely identical.

Each Ultimate Skill controls a relatively narrow aspect of nature. Some Ultimate skills may have many sub-skills commonly seen as Extra Skills (but that are subsequently uplifted), but the average number of sub-skills is around 4-5.

Each purchase of this grants you either a canonical Ultimate Skill, or one of your creation on par with those of canon. Fused Ultimate Skills (Azathoth, Cthnaga, etc.) cannot be purchased this way, but may be obtained with the appropriate administrative skill(s). Each Ultimate Skill obtained this way will be considered as having been awakened by you, etching it onto your soul and making it impossible to be stolen or removed.

If you develop a soul corridor with someone, you may gift aspects of your Ultimate Skills to them, so long as they are strong enough to have the necessary willpower to wield such power.
