These Ultimate Gifts lack the same protection as your Skills and will change in subtle ways to better match their recipient.
objects.title: Ultimate Skill: Pending (Tensura)

objects.text:
You have somehow acquired the unique skill Magicule Breeder Reactor, the same ability possessed by Milim Nava. This powerful skill acts like a Magic Power Furnace, continuously generating magicules by harnessing and multiplying surrounding energy. The skill creates an endless loop: energy generated is fed back into the process to produce even more energy, allowing you to maintain your power level indefinitely. Your energy reserves never diminish, even if they stop increasing.

An intriguing byproduct of this skill is Stardust, a super-compressed form of magicules essential for performing Star-type True Dragon Magic. However, controlling Stardust requires highly specialized knowledge, as its properties make it nearly impossible to analyze. Even Guy Crimson, who copied the skill, couldn’t utilize Stardust without this expertise.

With this skill, you now possess the ability to use Star-type True Dragon Magic, effectively enabling you to wield the same powers as Milim Nava. Your endless reserves mean you will never run out of energy or magic, allowing you to cast spells continuously, without limitation.
objects.title: Magicule Breeder Reactor (Tensura)

addons.text:
Your power over Turn null has changed, allowing you to gain a chaos world, which is a seperate prison like world, that also acts as storage for The Destructive Energies of Imaginary Collapse, meaning you now have a way to store all that energy. You May Also Supply the energy you have stored to your followers and subjects or anyone you have named allowing them to use Turn Null. 

As a chaos world, it's a prison with unlimited size where those who need to be quarantined are locked up. The skill version allowed the user to acquire and manipulates their own chaos world, as the higher version of Stomach and Isolation, everything inside is not affected by the passage of time and capable of isolating harmful targets from the rest and convert them into energy. Because it's essentially infinity, it can store an unlimited amount of things inside and is even strong enough to store the ultimate destructive energy from Imaginary Collapse.

It can be used to directly eat the targets, even indestructible object like Snow Crystal into Imaginary Space.  It can also be used as a defense that can isolate and absorb attacks, surpassing the performance of Uriel's Absolute Guard or to isolate an area with it, trapping targets from escaping. When used on top of another Imaginary Space like Infinity Prison, the user can cut off the flow of information completely even from Parallel Existence and the likes.
addons.title: Imaginary Space

addons.text:
Your power of creation has reached perfect synergy with Turn Null, allowing you to create anything by substituting it as an energy or resource source when needed. With this limitless potential, you can shape entire worlds, dimensions, realms, stars, life forms, advanced technology, powerful artifacts, abilities for others, and even complex systems akin to the Voice of the World.  Eventually you will be able to create laws and concepts.  However, using Turn Null as a shortcut is intensely draining, often bringing you to the edge of collapse.

As the Maker of Worlds and Creator of Life, you possess immense potential, yet mastery demands significant time, energy, and resources. You must first develop proficiency with simpler forms of creation before advancing to higher levels.

Currently, without a safe way to store Turn Null’s destructive energy, your ability remains effectively dormant. Channeling this energy requires complete immersion, making it difficult to wield. Yet, when fused with Turn Null, your creative powers are profoundly amplified, reaching far beyond their original scope.

All that you create bears a spark of life, a soul, and a deep bond with you. Any sentient life you craft remains eternally loyal, endowed with a soul capable of growth, skill, and evolution. Even worlds you form may develop consciousness, transcending mere existence to evolve in their own right.   

As long as your creations exist, you will be unkillable. Over time, your existence will solidify into an unshakable constant, with your creations—whether life forms, worlds, or systems—serving as the foundation of your immortality. Eventually, you will transcend your creations, and they will no longer bind you to life. At this point, you will become a true omniversal constant, able to recover from even the most extreme fates, such as true death or reality erasure, reforming at a safe location. You will be immune to imprisonment or timeline alterations, and both you and your creations will share these protections and benefits.
addons.title: The Imaginary Creator

addons.text:
Due to your mastery of Elementalism, you have become an entity made of Turn Null Energy—an essence that embodies both creation and destruction. You can assume a human form at will, or transform into a state of pure Null Energy, which is indestructible and nearly invulnerable. Anything that attempts to harm you is annihilated by your very existence.

The things you create through Imaginary Collapse are now enhanced by your status as a Null Elemental. Your destructive abilities are vast, and you will eventually gain the power to erase even abstract concepts—like wounds, diseases, aging, or the distance between locations. The possibilities are limitless. With time and practice, you will be able to create and destroy virtually anything, reaching the highest levels of power, where you can create entire worlds and systems, similar to the legendary Veldanava.

However, be warned: advancing too quickly in strength may have unintended consequences. Your mere presence could unravel the very fabric of reality itself. Null Energy is inherently resistant to control, and in most cases, it will require a fierce struggle to master it.
addons.title: Null Elemental

objects.text:
Imaginary Collapse, also known as Nihility Collapse or Turn Null, is a destructive energy capable of annihilating gods and worlds alike. Not only does it wield immense destructive potential, but it also allows for the creation of realms and systems, such as the "Voice of the World." This energy was originally used by Veldanava to create the cardinal world, though he later lost access to it due to lacking a means to store it. Until now, there were only two known wielders of this energy: Veldanava and Rimuru Tempest. You have now become the third known user of this unparalleled power.  As Long as any trace of this energy remains you cannot truly die.  

Imaginary Collapse is the source of both the Magicule Breeder Reactor skill and Stardust Energy, intensifying all benefits derived from the Reactor. Your energy can shift between stardust and imaginary forms, adaptable for both creation and destruction, while continuously increasing in quantity and quality. As the origin of Stardust Energy, this skill also grants the ability to replicate any energy source—such as Ki, Chakra, Reiryoku, Mana, or even the magical forces of other True Dragons—making your energy adaptable to a wide array of mystical and combat scenarios.

This power also provides three intrinsic abilities. The first, Destruction, allows Turn Null to completely, and eventually conceptually, annihilate anything it touches. At your current level, this skill doesn’t yet achieve full conceptual destruction, but as it develops, it will enable you to obliterate even the truly immortal and erase magical or energetic constructs with ease. The second, Creation, empowers you to form household items, weapons, armor, and other basic necessities. If you possess other creation abilities, this skill will synergize with them, reducing resource and energy costs. Eventually, you may even be able to create entire worlds, demiplanes, or a personalized system similar to the "Voice of the World." The third ability, Energy Replication, allows Turn Null to mimic any other energy type, assuming all its beneficial properties without any drawbacks.

Finally, until you develop resistance or immunity to Imaginary Collapse, this power may affect you as well, and its immense potential will be difficult to control without extensive training or until you acquire a Manas. Use caution and practice, as mastery over this skill will require time, discipline, and resilience.
objects.title: Imaginary Collapse (Tensura)

objects.text:
Embrace the pinnacle of terror and ascend as the Archon of Dread, an entity that transcends the boundaries of individual Dread Gods. With this potent upgrade, you gain the ability to tap into the collective essence of all Dread Gods, becoming an avatar of their combined power. 

However, at the start you can only wield the authority of two Dread Gods at a time, but can effortlessly switch to another in an instant.

As the Archon of Dread, your connection to each Dread God deepens, forging a bond that grants you access to unique and almost divine-like powers known as Authorities. Each dread god's Authority is distinct and perfectly tailored to your being, amplifying your abilities to unimaginable heights. Whether it is The Spiral's mastery of manipulation and distortion, The Eye's omniscient perception and foresight, or The Corruption's unstoppable decay and rot, you wield their Authorities with unparalleled proficiency.

Unlike before, as an Archon, your mind remains unclouded and immune to the encroaching madness that typically accompanies the embrace of dread gods. You have gained mastery over their influence, and the boundaries between your humanity and their divine essence blur seamlessly. 

Furthermore, as an Archon, you passively absorb the negative emotions of those around you, perpetually fueling your power. Your insatiable hunger for dread is sated, and you will never starve for the sustenance of despair and fear. In fact, absorbing a substantial amount of negative emotions grants you a temporary surge of power, enhancing your abilities to unprecedented levels.
Will you embody The Web's intricate manipulation, The Lonely's crushing isolation, or The Hunt's relentless pursuit? The choice is yours, and as the Archon of Dread, you stand as the embodiment of all fears, wielding their terrifying might in the pursuit of your chosen Authority.
objects.title: Archon of Dread

addons.text:
When recreating elements from outside your multiverse, their behavior and properties depend on your understanding, which may result in significant differences from the original. 
If you introduce your creations into realms outside your multiverse, they must conform to the specific rules and dynamics of those worlds. Their capabilities and functionality rely on your comprehension of the workings of the particular realm where they are deployed.

When recreating elements from outside your multiverse, their behavior and properties depend on your understanding, which may result in significant differences from the original. 
If you introduce your creations into realms outside of your multiverse, they carry within themselves an echo of their origins, allowing them to perform feats beyond what the rules of the world they are in should permit. This echo, although powerful, cannot completely override the established dynamics of a true world. As a result, any abilities and functionality are somewhat constrained by your understanding of the workings of the particular world they are deployed in.

objects.text:
Your soul has been transformed into a cosmic nexus that serves as a gateway to a vast array of dimensions within your personal multiverse. Your authority over this multiverse is absolute, granting you the ability to shape and govern each realm as you desire, forging new realities and populating them with life. You can even recreate yourself within this multiverse, guaranteeing you will exist for as long as it does.

There are two methods to establish connections between the outside world and your own. Firstly, within your line of sight, you can create portals leading to a location within your multiverse. Secondly, you can treat a small radius around you as an extension of your multiverse, allowing your influence to reach into the surrounding area. The maximum size of the created portals and your radius of influence improve as your soul grows stronger. 

Within your realms, your creative abilities are boundless, and the people and objects that inhabit them are as real as those in the external world. However, they may operate under entirely different rules and principles. While this divergence poses no challenges within your multiverse, where your authority governs the outcomes of interactions, it becomes a factor to consider when your creations venture beyond its boundaries.
objects.title: The Heart of the World

objects.text:
You possess the ability to utilize stored materials from your Inventory to efficiently construct structures of your choosing. With a simple designation of the area and desired structure using your HUD, it will seamlessly materialize as if it had always existed. Furthermore, you have the freedom to customize the appearance of your constructs, allowing them to blend harmoniously with the surrounding architecture if desired.

You will also gain access to an extensive database of pre-designed blueprints, including civilian and military structures like energy turrets, force field generators, and surveillance systems. As you progress, the construction of specialized research facilities becomes available, enhancing the technological capabilities of your blueprint database.
objects.title: Creator

addons.text: Your Blood is extraordinarily potent. As it is, you can never go below 5. On the upside this renders you quite natively powerful, even upon awakening from Torpor. Unfortunately, this is also the weakest your blood can be before you have to start draining other vampires in order to survive.
addons.title: Extraordinary Potency

addons.text:
I deeply hope you have a feeding strategy… 

Your blood is immensely potent and cannot decrease beyond the theoretical maximum of Kindred. Fortunately this has also rendered you a kind of vampire demigod when applying yourself fully. Unfortunately your hunger has also increased in kind, and staying fed will have to be your main priority.
addons.title: A Danger to Yourself and Others

objects.text:
Your embrace has entered you into the great requiem. The vampires of the second world.

While you carry many of the same weaknesses of vampirism, there is one central benefit that the Requiem gives you. 

Generation does not matter, there is no great hierarchy of blood, merely your age. As you age the potency of your blood increases, only decreasing when you enter Torpor, falling asleep and allowing it to decrease. Over this time however, your memories of the ages become foggy and unclear.

Blood Potency is much the same, practically as Generation, as you can increase it by diablerising more powerful vampires, but easier to acquire.
objects.title: Scion of the Requiem (Chronicles of Darkness - Vampire: The Requiem)

objects.text:
You’re no longer Kindred, you’re now a different sort of Vampire, maybe you’re an Energy Vampire who sustains themselves from the energy of others or an Emotional Vampire who sustains themself on pity. Capable of "feeding" on mental energy psychically, typically by eliciting conversation that wastes people's time, causes boredom, pity or irritation, this works online as well though on lesser efficiency. Should you absorb a large amount of energy in a short time you’ll enter a temporary enhanced state where your abilities are upgraded and new abilities become usable.

You could also be something more specific, like an ‘artist vampire who happens to currently be working as a barista’. This gives you massive talent in your skill of choice, though it will have to be something mundane in nature, while getting the job of your choice would become like a walk in the park. That doesn’t mean that your Vampiric talents are left unimproved, your physical characteristics improve as do your abilities and you’ll become capable of flight, hypnosis, shapeshifting into a bat, crawling on walls and triple jumping. In addition you can choose one of your abilities with which you become uniquely talented with, or one which you gain. Examples include enhanced speed, teleportation, invisibility, pyrokinesis, sonic scream or telekinesis.

Despite your improvements your weaknesses remain in place, though your abilities no longer consume your blood, instead just tiring you out and you can consume normal food, although it won’t nourish you.
objects.title: A different kind of Vampire (What We Do in the Shadows)

objects.text:
You are not considered a true Kindred of Cainite society, but something… lesser. Not wholly vampire, nor wholly human. A Thin-Blood. Duskborn. Mercurian. Or, if spoken of less flatteringly, Run-off. A vampire of the fourteenth generation or higher, marked by diluted Vitae—too thin to bestow the full gifts of your eternal damnation, leaving you with only the barest scraps of power compared to your kin. Yet in return, you've escaped much of the burden that plagues them, being less affected by the curses of your lineage.

You, however, are a touch more unusual than the rest of your kind. Marginally stronger, a tad bit faster, slightly more resilient—but never enough to be considered anything more than a rounding error. Still, you are granted the choice of a free Merit or the option to empower one you already possess, though only to a modest degree.

For example, Day Drinker may no longer halve your health under sunlight, even if you're unable to call upon vampiric abilities. Lifelike may allow you to pass even more convincingly as a mortal, with warmth in your flesh and a steady pulse in your veins, alongside more regular signs of true life. Or Discipline Affinity granting one dot in another discipline of your choice, etc.
objects.title: Thin-Bloods (World of Darkness - Vampire: The Masquerade)

addons.title: Prince Of Wallachia (World Of Darkness - Vampire: The Masquerade)
addons.text:
Your mastery of Biomancy has given you the power, experience, & dark mien of the canniest of the Tzimisce, Vlad III Tepes, Voivoide of Wallachia, the Son of the Dragon, Dracula!

This includes a bare minimum of 4 in every core stat (though they're usually higher, with some going all the way up to 6), numerous Skills & Talents (the highest levels of skill being in Subterfuge, Leadership, Interrogation, Intimidation, Etiquette, Animal Ken, Alertness, & Melee), vast Knowledge (including multiple languages, the Occult, Politics, History, & many Academic subjects), a complete mastery of Vicissitude derived from your skill in Biomancy, many other Disciplines (including Animalism, Auspex, Celerity, Dominate, Fortitude, Potence, Protean, & Obfuscate), a mastery of many paths of Sorcery (including Koldunic Sorcery, Tremere Thaumaturgy, & Countermagic), an enormously strong will, & the innate shrewdness to outwit & defeat multiple Tzimisce elders while still only a mortal.

objects.text:
You are no longer an eighth-generation vampire: you are now a fifth-generation vampire. Every vampiric ability that you have is now massively buffed, and no kindred above your generation should be able to harm you. You have enough strength to destroy a small island and have gained speed to the point that you can move faster than the speed of sound and mundane humans can no longer keep track of you without help from technology. You are durable enough that it would take something equal to your strength even to begin harming you. This lets you start with all your clan's disciplines at 5-6 dots, a level only vampires of a higher generation can achieve, as well as let you hold more vitae for a maximum of 40 blood points.

As an Elder Kindred, you now possess the ability to form and create new disciplines. At the start, you will have the equivalent of one dot in your created discipline, and with training and exploration, you could increase that further. However, you do have some limits to this ability, as you would be unable to create clan-specific disciplines requiring another Kindred to teach you the discipline, such as Dementation or Vicissitude. Another limitation on this ability to create new powers would be that, as you are not Cain, they will take longer to develop, requiring vast amounts of time to formulate properly.
objects.title: Methuselah (World of Darkness - Vampire: The Masquerade)

objects.text:
You are no longer a Fifth-Generation vampire; you have ascended to become a Third-Generation vampire. As one of the thirteen (or fourteen) who survived the Great Flood, every vampiric ability you possess has been vastly enhanced—so much so that even a horde of Methuselahs could not hope to match you.

Your strength is great enough to destroy a planet, and your speed surpasses anything a Methuselah could ever achieve through the innate swiftness of a Kindred. Your durability is such that it would take a nuke to the face to even begin to harm you.

As an Antediluvian, you have the power to create your own disciplines with ten dots or you can choose from the existing ones. These disciplines are inherited by all members of your clan. You may also design a unique clan curse or select one from the existing bloodlines. Additionally, your capacity for vitae is greatly expanded, allowing you to hold a maximum of 60 blood points.
objects.title: Antediluvian (World of Darkness - Vampire: The Masquerade)

objects.text: You are no longer a Third-generation vampire. There is only one vampire of equal status to you: the Dark Father Caine. You start as his equal, no longer limited to the disciplines of any clan; instead, you can make new disciplines via blood magic. You have had your magic potential unlocked just as Lilith did for Cain. However, this awakening was not quite an "Awakening" proper, like that of the mages; instead, you are able to recreate the powers of those you see or create new powers all together. You are surrounded by a darkness that only those who can see beyond the veil can see, marking you as being able to kill anything, even the gods, should you feel like it. Your strength is further enhanced so that you could destroy the earth with little difficulty and move on destroying all the planets nearby, and your speed has increased so that at your base you are massively faster than light. Your durability is of similar proportions, as any attack made against you is reflected on the attacker at seven times greater strength. You are also no longer affected by any weakness of the vampires before you, as you were the originator of all of their being able to step into the sun freely or even eat normal food. You are no longer limited by the amount of vitae you can absorb or use at any given time.
objects.title: Original Vampire (World of Darkness - Vampire: The Masquerade)

objects.text:
Within you stirs the unfathomable essence of Yog-Sothoth. Transforming you into a nascent being, an Archetype titled "The Fractal Throne of Infinite Colors" Through this, your very presence command dominion over the fabric of time and space, unraveling the limitations that bind mortal perception.

With a mere utterance, you can summon weapons of unparalleled might, capable of cleaving through any defense, leaving wounds that defy healing or closure. However, their true potency lies not only in their destructive force but also in their ability to unravel the manipulations of time and space. Through them, you can bring an end to any manipulation of reality, rendering those who seek to wield such powers powerless against you. No matter the strength of their abilities, the forces that warp existence crumble before you.

As you become a Fragment of the Key and the Gate, you gain absolute control over the time and space of the universe. You can warp time, extending moments into infinity, create endless spaces between spaces, and tear asunder those unfortunate enough to find themselves trapped within your spatial distortions. No detention can hold you captive against your will.

Furthermore, your Iridescent Sight expands beyond the confines of your eyes, encompassing a range of 1000 meters around you. Within this vast expanse, you wield the power to manipulate reality itself. All of Creation bends to your will, their properties altered, and even creation from nothingness can be done with a mere thought. The boundaries of creation are at your command.

No longer bound by previous limitations, your influence over reality remains potent even as it extends beyond your immediate vicinity. The alterations you impose on the fabric of existence no longer weaken or dissipate with distance but hold steadfast.
objects.title: The Man Who Walks Through Time And Space!

objects.text: You may freely manipulate how many slots a given skill takes up, with its power increasing as its size does. A skill which took up all 108 slots would be a full-strength copy, one which takes up 54 slots a half-strength copy, etc.
objects.title: 108 Sizes

objects.text: You gain access to a Skill Archive, which stores any skills you discard from your 108 slots. You may freely pull skills from the Archive into one of your slots as though there was a person in range with that skill, and there is no limit to the number of skills the Archive can contain.
objects.title: 108 Authors

objects.text:
You may sacrifice a skill you have slotted or which is in your Archive in order to form a Bead, which is a permanent copy of the skill in question, still at 1/108th strength, a reduction which applies to secondary characteristics like growth speed as well. You may undo Beads and return them to a slot or the Archive at will.

Additionally, you may add more skills of a related type to the Bead (fire skills for pyromancy, for instance), changing its expression and increasing its power. A Bead composed of 9 skills would be expressed at 1/12th power. As long as a Bead exists the person its components are copied from cannot have the connected skills copied again.

When a Bead is used in conjunction with a skill in the 108, or another Bead, its power increases as though all used skills and Bead components formed a single, larger Bead. For instance, using a 9-component pyromancy Bead with 9 slotted skills and an 18-component barrier Bead together to form a fire shield would be treated as a 36-component Bead, or a skill at 1/3 strength. With enough components a Bead is able to go beyond 108/108 strength. For the purpose of effects, a Bead counts as a skill within your 108 slots.
objects.title: 108 Connections

objects.text:
While your copy is still 1/108 of the strength of a Skill and your range is still 10,8 meters, for every slot you occupy the range and strength will be increased by 1, of course the reverse happens if you empty those slots. Copy a single skill and your next copy is going to be 2/108 the strength and your range 11,8 and if you copy again, your next copy is going to be 3/108 the strength and your range 12,8.

When you fill all of your 108 slots, you will gain a new set of 108 slots, and the same will happen again if you fill the entirety of your new slots. While your range will no longer increase, the strength of your copies will keep increasing, starting with 108/108 from the previous set + 1/108 from the new set. Those new sets are permanent and thus you won't lose then if you empty the slots of the sets that spawned them.
objects.title: 108/108 Skills

objects.text: If your opponent is stronger than you, you gain a boost in your capabilities. Your physical capabilities would be boosted to just bare minimum of what is necessary to possibly achieve victory. Your mental capabilities on the other hand are boosted greatly, you can accurately find the weaknesses of your opponent and utilize your skills at the necessary level to take advantage of these weaknesses.
objects.title: Pick on someone your own size!

objects.text: The Velber, also known as the Wandering Star of Predation, the Umbral Star, or the Harvest Star. It has a comet-like structure that rsembles a crying eye. It's an observation device created by the same race that created the Moon Cell. However, it’s far less benign. Rather than observing and occasionally teaching a single civilization, it destroys and consumes civilizations in the process of recording their information and is responsible for the destruction of numerous ancient civilizations from every world it has visited. It can be considered both a single spaceship and an entire species, of sorts. Surrounding it is an armada of Arks of the Stars, each containing a Void Cell, an organic life forms that was developed from the data of destroyed civilizations in a similar manner as how the Moon Cell used information from human civilization to create "high level information life forms" like Servants. Each Anti-Cell has inherited the characteristics of a different civilization, so each is a completely distinct organism right down to their manner of existence. In your case, you’d start off with ten and can grow with time as more data from civilizations are harvested. These Void Cells and their Ark of the Stars are under the absolute control of the Velber. While they do have their own independent thoughts and can, under unusual circumstances, desire freedom, they can never escape the absolute control the Velber has over their actions. Due to your astronomical size, you can optionally choose to and it is heavily advised that your starting location be outer space or its equivalent in your chosen world if you do not wish to crush the world upon your arrival.
objects.title: The Umbral Star (Type-Moon)

objects.text: Your soul is unique; instead of only having access to a singular Reality Marble, you now have multiple Reality Marbles. You have been bestowed with the ability to choose an additional Reality Marble, including a specific Reality Marble from the Type-Moon universe. All Reality Marbles you have do not conflict with each other in what would usually happen to someone with multiple Reality Marbles.
objects.title: Additional Reality Marble (Type-Moon)

addons.title: Unified Foundation
addons.text: The Philosophy Foundation’s history of being fused with the planet has resonated with your personal world, causing it to fuse with your World at a fundamental level, becoming one of its underlying foundations. The knowledge contained within it is no longer merely stored information, but has been integrated into the laws and natural order of your World. Its original collection has consequently expanded beyond Eastern Magecraft to encompass the various supernatural traditions of Gaia. Atlas Alchemy, Astromancy, Sacraments, and other systems are incorporated into a single unified framework, allowing you to freely combine their principles rather than treating them as isolated Magecraft Foundations. The same applies to the Mysteries of Gaia itself. Your World has enough understanding of its laws to recreate not merely the principles behind Phantasmal Beasts, but the actual phenomena associated with them. The inhabitants and phenomena of ancient Textures can therefore be reproduced as genuine parts of your World, from Oni and Sirens to Pegasi and beyond. Additionally, if you have the Trichiliocosm’s Knowledge addon then the collection of knowledge expands even further to encompass not just Magecraft but also the psychic powers and technology of Gaia such as Pure Eyes or Chaldea’s Rayshifting, and even the Eldritch Power displayed by those touched by the Outer Gods.

addons.title: World of the Flaming Sword
addons.text:
Through your Path of the Flaming Sword, your World has incorporated the metaphysical structure of Lord of the Mysteries and become a miniature reflection of the cosmology of the Lord of the Mysteries universe. 

It now possesses its own Beyonder Characteristics, advancement materials both organic and inorganic, and supernatural lifeforms aligned with Pathways, alongside nascent Spirit and Astral Realms that develop alongside its World Soul. Unlike those of the original setting, however, its Beyonder Characteristics belong to your World rather than the Original Creator, making them inherently compatible with its Mystery and Magecraft. 

Your World has further taken on the role of a Sefirah corresponding to your Pathway. This grants you partial accommodation of its power and allows you to progress toward Above the Sequence without requiring an external Sefirah. If your Pathway possesses a canonical Sefirah, a corresponding manifestation will gradually form within your World.

At higher Sequences, your Divine Kingdom takes shape within the Inner Sea of your World. This Kingdom is intrinsically linked to your Reality Marble, allowing you to project it into reality at will, overwriting the surrounding Texture with your Divine Kingdom and forcing its Laws upon the world around you.

Lastly, the Pathways of your World are not static. Existing Pathways can grow and change as your World integrates new conceptual frameworks and Laws, in fact entirely new Pathways and even Sefirah can form if sufficiently alien concepts and symbolism is introduced.

objects.text: Through the World bound to your soul, you have become something akin to an Archetype or Ultimate One—a False Archetype, if you will. Your World now serves as your personal Magecraft Foundation. You can create thaumaturgical systems based upon its laws, environments, inhabitants, and phenomena, allowing you to reproduce anything it possesses through Magecraft. These spells may also draw upon the conceptual weight of your World, giving them an authority far beyond what ordinary Magecraft could achieve. Additionally, because their Foundation exists within a self-sustaining supernatural World, they are unaffected by the decline of Mystery. Your World has also assimilated the fundamental principles of Gaia. Phantasmal Beasts, Textures, natural spirits, and other supernatural phenomena can exist within it as naturally as mundane life. As you encounter and assimilate foreign laws, Mysteries, and phenomena, your World can incorporate them, becoming increasingly complex and powerful. Furthermore, because of these integrated laws your world has also developed into a nascent celestial body in the Type-Moon sense, complete with its own infant World Soul. Your connection to this World makes you something akin to its Archetype, allowing you to draw upon its developing authority and, in turn, guide its growth. As its World Soul matures, so too does the power invested into you, gradually transforming from something that merely resembles an Archetype into the real thing with all the power that entails.
objects.title: Archetype: False

objects.text: "O' saint and knight who showed me a different madness, neither of you were mistaken! I make an offering! To all humanity, permitted by this broken world, I offer the sacrifice that is me!" The greatest illusion that either Prelati can make. An illusion so powerful that it tricks the very world about what it should be. Using this Noble Phantasm, you can seemingly turn back time, reversing whatever damage that you've caused or make people believe that they been summoned into a Reality Marble. This is indistinguishable from reality, with people being able to do things like working and living within these places. However, it is still an illusion. After five days, the world realizes that is has been deceived and returns to how it originally was. With time and training, this duration can be extended.
objects.title: Grand Illusion (Type-Moon)

objects.text: You are no longer just a tinker; instead, your Tinker of Fiction power has synergized with your Real-Time Strategy power. You now have the ability to produce unique units, structures, and more from the tech trees you have currently unlocked with Tinker of Fiction. The rate at which you can research new technology has significantly increased, roughly doubling the speed at which you can build units, structures, or develop new technologies from existing tech trees provided by Tinker of Fiction. With RTS of Fiction, you also experience less difficulty in combining different specializations, although researching tech combinations will take longer than researching them individually.
objects.title: RTS of Fiction

objects.text: You no longer need to expend energy to upgrade your units; instead, they will now gain combat experience through successful engagements in battles or through killing others. As they accumulate combat experience, they will gradually begin the process of self-upgrading, promoting to a higher-ranked unit requiring around 100 kills/battles to be promoted the first time and doubling the requirement with each rank they achieve. As your units promote, you will find that they are significantly stronger than standard units, climbing through the ranks so long as they remain alive. Each time a unit is promoted, it becomes approximately twice as strong as a regular unit or twice as strong as it was during the previous promotion.
objects.title: Unit Veterancy

objects.text:
No longer are you limited to just mirrors, now you can use any reflective surface: water puddles, windows, the frame of a car and much more.

Not only that, but you can become one with anything reflected in your world, allowing you to for example access the memories of a person. The more reflections you are, the harder it is to stay as them.
objects.title: Man of Glass

addons.text:
You have inherited the power of the Tower Master, giving you a complete record of every human, object, and event you've ever experienced. If you so choose to, you can replay these stored memories at will, allowing you to experience any event from not only your perspective, but from anyone’s perspective.

You uniquely understand how the past's time and space is constructed through various causalities. The more intricately you come to understand them, the more you can accurately construct "What If" scenarios.

With this, you can use The Earth Bone Dragon’s Skull (SSS Class Suicide Hunter) on the memories of these "What If" scenarios, thus allowing you to summon them into the real world.
addons.title: Mansaeng

objects.text: This allows you to archive memories of the living, or those whom you revived with Hundred Ghosts Reincarnation. These memories will be placed within a metaphysical ‘box’, which can only be destroyed by you. Unless the box is destroyed, you can endlessly recreate their body with their strength/abilities. The body can travel around the world, create new memories, and ‘update’ those experiences back to the box. Even if the body is completely destroyed, the box will not suffer any damage, however the memories of a destroyed body cannot ‘update’ those experiences back to the box.
objects.title: The Earth Bone Dragon’s Skull (SSS Class Suicide Hunter)

objects.text: Music affects everyone differently, but it affects nobody like it does you. Now when listening to certain genres of music, the minor buffs you usually receive have graduated into major buffs, massively increasing the strength and duration of said buffs. On top of receiving your usual buffs, you now gain a choice of temporary powers that are thematically aligned with the genre of music you’re listening to. These powers can range from super speed to telekinesis, as long as they resonate with whatever music you’re currently enjoying. The more powers you receive, the less potent all of them become, decreasing in effectiveness by half each time.
objects.title: Musicis Deus

objects.text: Your musical affinity is expanded to a level where you can now produce music in an area of effect around yourself, gaining inspiration and sampling from previous music you listened to and enjoyed. You can create either sets or mixes intermingling their melodies into a power set or an array of buffs, both depending of the breadth of music genres it contains. The potency is understandably lessened the more sample size it contains, but it makes up in versatility. Aside from playlists, you can take “samples” from your aforementioned music to create personalized productions, practically customizing what type of buffs or temporary powers you’d get. All this isn’t worthwhile without a crowd, you know? As a result, you can’t help but share it with others through the area of effect where your musical creations are heard, and within said area, you can choose which individuals are touched by your vibes, joining in the symphony.
objects.title: Dancing with the DJ

objects.text:
Your patron’s bestowed piece of power, the planets' favor, and your musical attunement causes you to finally hear the Sound… the Sound of it All, the Music of the Spheres. The Music of the Spheres indicates a metaphysical principle that regards proportions of celestial bodies —the Sun, Moon, and planets— as a form of music. That’s to say, everything constituting the universe can be heard as a melody for you to listen to... and comprehend. 

This confers the view of perceiving a planetary sphere's “melody”, understanding it, and thus controlling it. First, you grasp planetary frequencies, which is the unique vibrational frequency a planet carries. You can then attune yourself to a planetary frequency of a specific celestial sphere by simply being within a planet or any celestial phenomenon in your proximity, using Earth as an example, allows you to control the Earth’s “cymatics”, “rhythm” and/or “tempo” of anything surrounding you. When comes to "cymatics" in terms of this power, it is the sound that shapes matter and energy, and "rhythm" and "tempo" are parts of the sound dictating space-time. This means, locally manipulating elements of reality within Earth (or any celestial sphere) the more you submerge yourself in the Sound. Best to be careful, then, as surrendering to the melody has the risks of losing oneself, which is with any case of dealing with eldritch truths.

Other applications can be orienting the “tempo” or "rhythm" of events and possibilities, safely communicating with eldritch or celestial entities by “dueting”, and vocally (by singing is most effective) warping reality, which are among the few capabilities.
objects.title: Musica Universalis

objects.text: You’ve acquired the peak of all alchemic knowledge and skill. The ability to perform the four stages required to compose a Great Work. Nigredo - The blackening or melanosis, is an art that is associated with the concepts of decay and entropy, being able degrade anything that it comes in contact with. Using Nigredo you are able to selectively reduce matter to nothing, dissolve supernatural effects, etc. Albedo - The whitening or leucosis, is an art associated with the concepts of analytical observation and purity. This bestows upon you the power to ‘see which cannot be seen’ and ‘hear what cannot be heard’ alongside other similar abilities. The information you gather during this esoteric process is stored in a sort of magical repository for easy access later. Citrinitas - The yellowing or xanthosis, is the refining art associated with the concept of transformation, able to reshape, alter, or change any material in some manner. This ranges from returning a blade to pristine condition, to changing one’s own face. You can also use it to augment qualities within an object or individual. For example, bringing out or hiding physical features, speeding up or slowing down certain conditions, and proportionally increasing or decreasing abstract effects. Rubedo - The reddening, purpling, or iosis is an art associated with concepts of unity and harmony. This stage grants the ability to attune and harmonize various concepts, energies, and traits. Letting you form unimaginable effects by utilizing opposing or contradictory forces, abilities, and traits. An example would be treating the spiritual or incorporeal as physical in nature. This art also allows for the combining of various things such as but not limited to: objects, forces, and even complete magic systems- creating something more powerful than the sum of its parts. While these four stages are powerful on their own, together they allow for the birth of something that truly describes the pinnacle of alchemy. What that something is depends on your initial goal, and will always end up being something that exceeds your expectations. Additionally due to your newfound expertise, Prima Materia is now able to substitute for exceptionally rare ingredients when used in alchemic creations.
objects.title: Magnum Opus

objects.text: Having mantled the Thrice-Great God, you’ve become an archetype that represents knowledge and progression in all that surrounds the domain of Hermeticism, its major points being Alchemy, Astrology, Medicine, Wisdom, and Theurgy. Your newly realized Godhood provides many immense benefits for all that falls under your domain. You’re now able to debate and overturn even the most esteemed of philosophers, whilst conveying your topic with divine aptitude. Your pursuits in Medicine are able to cure even which cannot be remedied by the highest of divine physicians. Your insight into Astrology provides information and experiences in which many would gladly give their lives in order to uncover. Lastly your Alchemic skill, talent, and knowledge exceed even the most accomplished in its art- becoming nearly unrecognizable from its fundamentals yet still improving them. In addition to his other feats, you are now a psychopomp, an entity capable of traveling to and guiding souls to the realms of the deceased. “As above, so below” - Hermes Trismegistus
objects.title: Hermes Trismegistus

objects.text:
You have inherited the combined legacies of Xiao Yan and Yao Chen, including everything they acquired throughout their long and storied lives.

This inheritance includes a vast library of knowledge on alchemy, cultivation, and battle techniques, with the most significant being the Flame Mantra, a cultivation technique that grows stronger in direct proportion to the power of the heavenly flames you possess.

Moreover, you possess a sixth sense for alchemy, allowing you to instantly identify the properties of any alchemical reagents or magical herbs you encounter, even if you’ve never seen them before. This ability not only helps you understand what can be created with the ingredients at hand but also provides a general idea of how to craft the finished product.

This unique talent ensures that you can utilize each ingredient to its fullest potential, rapidly advancing your skills as an alchemist.
objects.title: Alchemy Saint Legacy (Battle Through The Heavens)

addons.text: Your sacred gear gains the capability to produce blessed firearms and ammunition harnessing the Holy Light similarly to the sacred gear Blade Blacksmith, also known as Holy Sword Creation.
addons.title: Holy Firearms

addons.text: Your sacred gear gains the capability to produce demonic firearms and ammunition, harnessing your demonic power similarly to the sacred gear Sword Birth, also known as Demonic Sword Creation.
addons.title: Demonic Firearms

addons.text:
You can opt-in to have an improved version of the Buki Buki no Mi (Arms-Arms Fruit) as your Devil Fruit. This will turn it into a special Paramecia, which, similarly to a Logai type, allows you to transform your entire body into firearms and even split apart into a dozen of them via your telekinetic control, with every firearm benefiting from your own sacred gear.
Even in complete firearm form, you still retain all your senses separately for every weapon you control, giving you the ability to have several fields of vision and process all the information that comes with it.
Your biggest firearm will act as your main body, and the speed and precision of your telekinetic control will depend on the distance between your main body and other summoned ones.
Just like with the original devil fruit, if you use explosives or are damaged by your own weapons, your body will reform even if there is only shrapnel left behind.
addons.title: Firearm Human

addons.text: Your inner world contains a manifestation of the Great Gunsmith, including every firearm and bullet ever produced, including every single prototype and experiment. When your inner world is materialised, your telekinetic control over firearms will know no bounds, encompassing your entire inner world and even affecting your ammunition, giving you unprecedented control and power.
addons.title: Unlimited Gun Works

addons.text:
The spirit in your sacred gear (Or just you) are now able to turn any modern firearm in your gears forge into a magic foci equivalent. 

Not only that the forge in your sacred gear also gains the ability to analyze magic you see and encounter and make magic bullets or gun foci.

Your gear can make magical bullet equivalent or gun foci based on any mystical relic or artifacts ability you find or witness in action even divine relics given enough time analyzing them by your gear.

Lastly should you obtain balance breaker you can transform any other modern weaponry into a foci.
addons.title: Magic bullets and rockets OH MY

objects.text:
Thanks to your affinity for firearms, your Sacred Gear mutated, forming a new Longinus. It acts as an automatic forge within your soul, constantly prototyping and experimenting with the creation of new firearms and ammunition based on your own desires, powers, and capabilities.

This will allow you to incorporate other powers into your bullets so your shots can deliver effects even when limited to touch range, partially removing the range restrictions of your powers.

You can also summon your firearms in a floating state around your body, which you can telekinetically control with dexterity and precision equal to your own hands. In the beginning, you will be limited by your multitasking and accuracy, but as your expertise grows with the sacred gear, you will slowly develop a new instinctive sense, allowing you to aim and handle a great number of firearms at once.

As firearms are one of the most recent weapons of humanity, they grant you both anti-human and anti-divine attributes, which gives you disgustingly powerful super-effectiveness against both. This power comes from the divine having no legends or history standing against modern firearms, which makes your weapons a blind spot for the divine while also being one of the most feared weapons made by humanity against their own race. This has no effect on beings that are neither humanoid nor divine in nature.

At the core of your sacred gear resides a sadistic pink-haired fox girl with a Russian accent. She regards all human activity as filthy, but that doesn't mean she dislikes any of it. She has complete knowledge about every weapon created by modern humanity and is a skilled assassin.
You can also choose this sacred gear with a sealed being of your choice, or a version that has no personality and only acts as a normal power, giving you access to the knowledge its core contains as you practice and learn.

As your mastery grows, you can also unlock other modern weapons of war dreamt and designed by humanity with your Balance Breaker, allowing you to become the embodiment of Death, the Destroyer of Worlds.
objects.title: Great Gunsmith

objects.text:
Your medical brilliance expanded within the field of surgery. Now, your sheer skill and the assistance of Healing Point allow you to do miracle surgeries, close to the realm of impossibility. You could sew on extra arms and attach them to your nerves seamlessly, transplant the head of a human onto an animal, or even restructure an entire being into a walking, living organ container. With practice and expertise, your neurosurgical skills would allow you to straight-up reconstruct the brain of a person.

Meanwhile, you still operate within the restrictions of reality; your healing energy allows you to suppress immune reactions and bypass incompatibilities between species or even entirely different biological lifeforms. With research, your surgeries can even expand into the supernatural, allowing you to do feats like transplanting the ability to do magic from one person to another or surgically altering the soul.
objects.title: Frankenstein M.D.

objects.text:
Things are worse than you thought. It’s not just one person or even several people that require your expertise; it’s potentially hundreds or thousands. Whether that is because of natural disasters, warzones, or CBRN incidents, your talent has now expanded to manage, mitigate and resolve these crises.

From advanced triage techniques to ramshackle battlefield medicine and cutting-edge extraction procedures. You have the capability to treat the most injured of victims found in the worst of Hot zones.

It’s one thing to have all the talent and knowledge, but if you cannot apply it, then the knowledge is useless. In the heat of battle or surrounded by flames, you always keep a cool and collected demeanour, allowing for the rational observation of the quandary that you are in.

The battlefield usually isn’t the place where you’d find a doctor, but you thrive in it. Bullets often miss by a hair's breadth; stray artillery shells are unlikely to explode on your position, and patients under your care won’t get shot out from under you by marksmen. If you were treating a soldier, then you would not be killed by an enemy combatant so long as you don’t take up arms yourself.

A crisis cannot be managed alone; it takes professionals such as Doctors, Paramedics, Firefighters and many more.  Therefore, if they are under your command, then your subordinates work faster, tire less and have a better chance of saving their patients. Also, miscommunication of instructions is almost impossible, save for the direst of circumstances.
objects.title: Angel of the Battlefield

objects.text:
Looking beyond oneself to others is a sign of a thriving society, and as a doctor, you embody this even more than most.

The people around you can instinctively tell that you are a doctor and that you can help heal them. Additionally, you project an aura of comfort and peace, enabling you to deal with the most rowdy of patients.

You can readily navigate people's faith, traditions and culture, avoiding potential landmines when it comes to treatment, meaning you can give them a similar level of care to someone who has no beliefs at all.

Your Healing Point has also been transformed, allowing it to be used in an area of effect. This reduces both its potency and its precision, only allowing for the treatment of very minor wounds and bruising. You may choose whether it is the touch-based version or the area of effect version.

Having compassion for a patient is critical to treating them. Therefore, the more you treat patients, the more your emotional intelligence and moral fibre are enhanced. You are kinder, more compassionate and better at dealing with a wide range of emotions. This will not have any adverse effects upon you and will not make you into anything you would not wish to be.

You are also talented in finding the root cause of certain diseases, such as the abundance of readily available high-fat, high-sugar and high salt foods in obesity, and then taking actions to make the right societal changes for these diseases to be limited.

Humanitarian aid comes to you quickly. This isn’t reality warping; you won't find medical supplies completely isolated in the desert, but a greasing of the wheels. From Dictators to Government bodies, if they were already considering providing aid, then you are likely to find your proposals approved.

Innovative medical infrastructure, such as hospitals, clinics and pharmacies, can be conceptualized and built with your oversight at record speed, which is more durable and can treat people with much greater effectiveness.
 
The people most in need are usually in the most difficult of environments. Hence, the more you spend in a biome, the more resistant you are to the weather. At a certain point, you will no longer sweat in the sun or freeze in the snow, but even at the peak of resistance, you’ll still die if you try to take a bath in flames.
objects.title: Humanitarian

objects.text:
Cancer. Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease. Genetically engineered Superviruses. Normal Doctors and Scientists struggle to understand and create cures for these things, but not you.

Far away from the rigors of applied medicine, you work in research laboratories creating medical devices, drugs, and techniques that defy modern comprehension, such as hyper-targeted genetic therapies, 3D-printed organs and effective broad-spectrum antibiotics.

In the movies, a hapless researcher inadvertently releases a contagion into the wild, ultimately leading to the end of the world. You have no such worries. You are immune to any disease you are currently working on, and no accident or enemy action will cause an outbreak.

A researcher’s worst nightmare is for their hard work to be poured down the drain as a drug they had hoped to work, kills the research specimen. To avoid this, you may simulate a drug within your mind, using your genius and knowledge to essentially perform parts of the research process without physically doing it.

At the last and most crucial part of a drug’s testing cycle, human trials are performed. In the early days of medicine, they were plagued by death and inconclusive data. Your clinical trials are extremely effective, with data that is conclusive and beneficial to you. Additionally, patients are less likely to face the lethal side effects of your drugs.

Eventually, you will have to publish your findings. You will find that your Research Papers will have more weight in academia than they would usually allow, meaning your rise to becoming a recognised worldwide expert in your field is all but guaranteed.
objects.title: Biomedical Researcher

objects.text:
Congratulations! You've entered into a contract with the Omniversal Mail Office. You now have a job. 

While you can use the service like normal, you can choose to take a commission and send packages yourself. The more commissions you take, the better the benefits.

Firstly, like any mail courier you can summon, you are completely unkillable and can travel anywhere extremely quickly, although you can only benefit from the former while you are working. Secondly, you'll earn compensation for each delivery you make. Lastly, your everyday life is backed by insurance provided by the office. Note that if you don’t work enough, the office may start cutting into your benefits.

You also have a complementary mail van that you can summon. It has the same invulnerability and quick travel you have. Your powers also become more effective while inside it. You also instinctively know how to drive said van.
objects.title: Sending Mail

objects.text:
Thanks to your understanding of the transformative properties of the Warrior’s Bond, and the summoning of nonhuman entities, you’ve gained access to the art of Sealing.

The Process of Sealing an entity is relatively simple; the results, however, rarely are. When Sealing, one requires a silver piece, inscribed with a rune representative of the corresponding being that is to be bound. Following this, the object must be ceremonially ‘sealed’ to imprint it with the it’s aspect. Unlike the Bond, however, these are not limited to tools and weapons.

Much like the Warrior’s Bond, sealing produces varying results along a theme. A sword sealing a Deamon of fire may be flaming, or it may be ephemeral, or drain air from the surroundings to fuel itself, drawing from different attunements of the same aspect. Likewise, a tome of knowledge may be of endless pages, or only one, containing what is needed at the exact moment opened. In many ways it acts as a weak Bonding might.

Finally, the quality of Sealing confers benefits in the way the aspect is expressed, but also in a more tangible way. With exquisitely made sealings,  one can talk with the entity sealed.
objects.title: Sealing

objects.text:
This is quite the fortunate circumstance you find yourself in, as it looks like an Admin accidentally put you in creative mode.

You can make any terrain disappear with a mere punch, destroying/inventorying 1 square meter of whatever you punched.

Your storage size hasn't changed, but now you can spawn any quantity of items from Minecraft or from any other universe you have been in. There are some stringy limitations though. Firstly, you can not create one-of-a-kind items unless you come into contact with said item first. The second, is that spawned items have a size limit of 1 cubic meter.

You also have a form of unlimited Experience. More accurately, you completely eliminate the need for Experience to use the Minecraft enchantment method.

Additionally, you are virtually immortal and inviolable. Nothing can hurt you, with the exception of incredibly potent multi-dimensional attacks or conceptually empowered erasure attacks that render the local space-time void. Regardless, if you are hurt you will still have your 'hearts’ for potential damage mitigation. You still don't respawn if you die.

Finally, you are also capable of flying at speeds topping out at 200mph.
objects.title: Creative Mode (Minecraft)

objects.text:
You’ve gone beyond just playing the game — now you mod it.

With the creative freedom of Minecraft, the unlimited access of Creative Mode, and the conceptual control of Symbolic Scripting, you’ve become a modder in the truest sense. Not just a player who crafts and builds, but one who edits the very framework of reality.

You can now design and apply mods — personalized systems, tweaks, and overhauls that rewrite how things function around you. These mods can be temporary or permanent, public or private, and modular, stacking and interacting with each other in layered complexity. One might alter gravity, another how magic works, and yet another could give swords new properties based on emotion or memory.

Mods aren’t limited to physical or magical rules — they can affect narrative causality, game logic, or metaphysical laws. Want fall damage to apply only on Wednesdays? Done. Want your enemies to render in low resolution while you stay crisp? Sure. Want a concept like “death” to reload like a script instead of being permanent? Script it.

Through symbolic structure and creative coding, you can patch reality, create compatibility layers between unrelated abilities, or even implement entire modpacks — self-contained thematic rule-sets that overhaul entire settings.

You aren’t exploiting the system.
You are the system administrator
objects.title: The Modder (Minecraft)

objects.text:
Your Minecraft abilites expand even further, allowing you to install an entire progression-based Minecraft modpack of your choice. Said modpacks being modpacks that contain a plethora of mods that are interlinked with one another and bound into one big progression tree. With one overarching goal, to achieve technological supremacy, and sometimes even grasping infinity with the palm of your hands. Examples include: 'Gregtech: New Horizons', 'SevTech: Ages', 'Enigmatica 2 Expert: Mode', etc.

Depending on the modpack, you may start out in possession of some items, although most of the time it could be nothing. Unlike with modpacks similar to SevTech: Ages, where you start out having to pick up rocks and grass, you retain your ability to begin your adventure by punching trees. And due to the uniqueness of many raw materials, you are able to substitute any raw material with something similar/equivalent that exists within your local reality.

Most of these modpacks will have you go through lengthy and difficult labors to even see signs of progress, but eventually it will all be worth it, for the potential they contain is immense, infinite even. And that is the ability to eventually craft Creative Items, items that allow you to harness the power of infinity. The first of which you can create are usually niche in its use but an endless source nonetheless. The next would then be items like a Creative Energy Cell, infinite electricity in a single cubic meter. Perhaps it could be a Creative Tank, letting you siphon endless amounts of any liquid that you put into it.

Regardless, you have a long road ahead of you. Progressing through the tree of hundreds of mods, eventually culminating into having an infinite amount of whatever item may come into your possession.
objects.title: Progression-based Modpack (Minecraft)

objects.text: The chains that bound together all the mods in your modpack have broken, shattered by the full weight of a 'kitchen sink' modpack. The modpack is still cohesive like before, but now each individual mod can operate on their own untouched original logic, unbound by the fragile concept of balance. You can now install modpacks like 'All the Mods', 'MC Eternal', 'Skyfactory', or other 'kitchen sink' modpacks. Modpacks wherein total balance held between every mod is held with little to no regard. Creative Items are still a possibility, even moreso than before. As now you have the freedom to choose how you would go about crafting such items. If you were so inclined, you could craft them exponentially faster in comparison to Progression-based Modpack.
objects.title: All the Mods (Minecraft)

objects.text:
"You are strong, child, but I am beyond strength." - The Lich

You are a primordial monster, an existence that came before time. You are the one who extinguishes the light, you are the scholar of GOLB, the one that shall stand after all life has been extinguished.

As a being that existed before time, nobody is safe from you, as you exist in every timeline. Not as separate beings, but as pieces of a whole. All previous abilities mentioned of the lich are amped to extraordinary levels, allowing you to do things like wipe off life on an entire continent with your mere presence, and if you stay long enough, eventually "kill" the planet.

You can not truly die, only be put down for a length of time. Possibly months at a time, but a Herald of the End can not be stopped. Even in the minuscule chance you do die, you will still live on in other timelines.
objects.title: Herald of the End (Adventure Time)

objects.text: You now inherit the complete power of Zakranaid. All the matter, energy, knowledge, and lifeforms consumed by the Dimensional Devourer are now at your disposal. At its peak, this dimensional monster could devour planets and now its formidable powers are yours to command.
objects.title: Predator of the Universe

objects.text: You lose the ability to 'shift' to alternate or parallel worlds. Although no alternate versions of yourself exist, your absence can no longer be used as a gateway into other realities. Instead, you become fully disconnected from the omniverse, existing as a truly independent singularity. All other effects or benefits of your singular nature not directly related to shifting remain unchanged. As such, attempts to alter your past, perceive your future, or interact with alternate versions of yourself remain impossible. Likewise, your unique singular existence ensures that tracking or locating you through your other methods of multiversal traversal remains completely impossible.
objects.title: Anchored Singularity

addons.text: The control of the time is no longer limited to you alone. With a touch, you can send someone or something forward or backwards in time, trap them as a time-frozen statue, or, alternatively, allow them freedom when you stop or slow down time. The possibilities are nearly endless.
addons.title: Timeskip

addons.text: You can now shift the state of anyone and anything just as you can your own. With a touch, you can make someone older or younger, completely stop their ageing process, heal wounds and damage by restoring the body to a previous state, or kill someone by ageing them to dust or restoring wounds inflicted and healed long ago.
addons.title: Temporal Mould

objects.text:
Your unique nature now anchors the timeline of any universe you are in. Unless you explicitly allow it, such concepts as time travel become a thing of the past, and even beings that exist outside of time itself will be powerless to change the timeline. The past is an immutable monolith, and the future is a raging ocean, with tidal waves of the choices made in the present by you and other beings washing away any outside meddling.

You can decide to lock the timeline completely without any possibility for alteration, allow select few to traverse through it, or make it so any such attempt will result in a branched timeline, where unfortunate time-travellers will be caught without a way to return to the main universe you inhabit.

Lastly, unless you explicitly allow it, you are now immune to any and all outside interference in your personal flow of time, such as time stops or time loops to name a few.
objects.title: Time Anchor

addons.text:
You have become truly timeless. You can freely shift your physical state along your personal timeline, whether truly ageing yourself up or down or limiting it to only appearance, without having to suffer any age-related drawbacks.

This power cannot ever be lost, even if you revert to the point before you had it, as it is a fundamental part of your nature. Your mind is also protected, granting you a perfect and infinite eidetic memory, as well as ensuring that you can never be left unable to command your personal flow of time. Even should you be injured or dead, you can effortlessly rewind your physical state to an unharmed version.
addons.title: Temporal Mimicry

objects.text:
Your personal timeline is completely untangled from that of the rest of existence, allowing you to effortlessly shift through time. By controlling your interaction with the regular timeline, you can effectively pause, stop, speed up, slow down, rewind, and freely travel through time as much as you wish.

Due to your existence as a singularity, you will never encounter your time clones or be subject to any form of time paradoxes, and—similarly to your undetectable dimensional shifting—other methods of time manipulation cannot detect or affect you. The exact nature of your relationship with time is yours alone to decide.
objects.title: Temporal Axis Shift

addons.text:
You are no longer limited to having only one reflection per universe. Now, you can create multiple ones within the confines of one world, complete with unique histories and abilities.

Creating multiple reflections in a single universe becomes exponentially more difficult as the number of active reflections increases. Should you shift a reflection to a universe already inhabited by another one, you can choose whether to merge them or keep them separate.
addons.title: Fractured Mirror

objects.text:
While your existence is unique, there is no limit to what you could have become in various universes—a beggar, a king, a mortal, a god, or anything else you can imagine.

Now, when you shift to an alternate universe, you can optionally assume the identity of your potential alternate universe self, inheriting all its memories, skills, powers, blessings, curses, family, and other interpersonal relationships. None of this will influence your personality and sense of self but will allow you to act just as this universe's 'you' might have acted without drawing unwanted suspicion.

All the setting-specific abilities you obtain this way are tied to the world they originated in and will be lost should you shift to a universe with a completely different metaphysical structure. The only constants are your inherent abilities and your own knowledge, persisting across all realities you might visit.

As the multiverse is infinite, there is no limit on what version of you might exist in whatever world there might be. But the greater the difference in power between your original self and the potential version of you whose place you would like to assume, the more effort it will take to shift. If you are an ordinary human, assuming the place of your version that is a god in their universe might very well take decades of concentration, while shifting and assuming the place of your much weaker counterpart will be nearly effortless.
objects.title: Evershifting Lens

addons.text: If you have more than one reflection, you can selectively 'pause' any of the universes your reflections inhabit as if you left them. You are always passively aware of all your frozen reflections, and should all your 'active' ones perish, a random frozen reflection will activate.
addons.title: Frozen Reflection

addons.text: You can now freely customise the history and identity of each of your reflections. They can even gain new powers that align with their backstory, although those will remain native to each reflection's world of origin and will be discarded should it shift to another universe. You can also disguise the reflection's innate abilities as another type of power naturally present in this new universe, allowing it to appear as a perfectly 'normal' member of the supernatural community.
addons.title: Faces in the Mirror

objects.text: For you, the entirety of existence is now akin to an endless hall of mirrors, each mirror a universe and you a reflection in one of them. Instead of just shifting into a new universe, you may now optionally create a new reflection in your world of choice, complete with all your powers and perks. Even one-time perks like Wealthy apply anew for each reflection. In addition, you can customise each reflection, altering its appearance or even limiting some of the powers, although these changes can be reversed during a new shift or when creating a new reflection. All reflections are equally you, connected in a hivemind-like fashion yet still separated so that nothing that affects or even destroys one of them, no matter how esoteric, will ever affect the other ones. Lastly, no two reflections can coexist within the same universe. If you shift to or create a reflection in the world inhabited—currently or previously—by another reflection, you can choose for them to merge or for one to completely replace another.
objects.title: Hall of Mirrors

addons.text: Lastly, there is now no distinction between a reflection and a sensory. You can create a reflection and have it live its life until such time as it is awakened and becomes your true vessel. Likewise, you can create a sensory that will have all or some of your powers and perks from the very beginning of its existence, without the need to wait for it to grow up and mature, as you can speed up its timeline until it reaches a desired age, as well as generally direct the course of its life, creating the perfect backstory for you when it is awakened.

You have descended completely into the Abyss, cutting yourself off from the laws of the wider omniverse.

While you can still allow the worlds your reflections appear in to influence them as usual, you can now selectively choose for your reflections to be unaffected by any and all concepts and laws that either the world itself, or others try to enforce upon them, be it something relatively simple like gravity, or something highly esoteric like death itself.
addons.title: Lord of the Abyss

addons.text:
The souls you claimed into your Soul Garden now reside safely 'in orbit' of a singularity that is yourself.

For each and every such soul, you can now construct a reflection of their own, either a replica of a body they had in life or one of your own design, as well as share with them some or all of your perks, either with limited or full strength at your discretion.

Each soul can operate only one reflection and, unless you explicitly allow it, cannot travel through the multiverse on its own.

Lastly, you can always communicate with each and every reflection, summon them to your location, or even forcibly discorporate them.

At all times, the souls are safely stored in the Garden, and similar to you, no damage to the reflection can harm the soul itself.
addons.title: Void Garden

objects.text:
You have reached apotheosis, becoming a true singularity beyond the omniverse, out of the reach of anyone or anything in existence. Even if all of your reflections were to be destroyed, it will not hinder you in the slightest, as attacking them is akin to trying to destroy the moon by striking its reflection on the surface of the lake; no harm that befalls your reflections can ever truly reach you, and you can create a new or restore an old one whenever you desire.

The limit on how often you can create a reflection, or how long it takes to travel to a new universe yourself, has also been lifted. You can create a reflection in any universe you desire with but a moment of concentration, or move through the multiverse as easily as one would walk down the street, silent and undetectable as always.

All your powers and perks belong to the singularity that is your true self, as such you can create reflections with any combinations of those, and when one reflection gains new powers or perks, the singularity obtains it as well, and you can then share it with any and all other reflections you possess.
objects.title: Infinity Mirror

objects.text:
Your ability to create near-flawless illusions has combined with your ability to challenge reality and convince it that you are correct and produced the ultimate scammer’s tool, the ability to lie to reality itself.

You may, with concentration, convince reality that your illusions are in fact the truth and that that is how things work. Whether it be phasing through matter, flying on swords, or replicating the effects of other powers, so long as you can make an illusion of it, you can make it real. Of course, since it is still a lie, the moment you lose concentration and the truth is revealed, reality corrects itself, at least to an extent. 

See while the direct manifestation of the illusion may be corrected, the aftereffects won’t be. For example, if you create a website containing top-secret information and people learn information from it before it’s dismissed, they won’t suddenly unlearn that information. Other, more combat focused examples would be swinging a sword once and causing a myriad of invisible slashes or creating a bunch of clones of yourself. Anything cut by those slashes won’t suddenly be uncut, as the action is already over, and anyone beat up by your clones stays beat up, even when the clones disappear. Therefore, the best way to use this power is to find the right illusions which will produce the outcomes you desire in a way which can’t be corrected.
objects.title: A Liar’s Guide to Scamming Reality

addons.text: Your chosen elemental tie has boosted your ability to imbue, harness, and harvest it for use in your alchemical processes and creations. This lessens the burden of using large quantities of your metaphysical element, using said element in new ways, as well as increasing the potency and control of it by two-fold.
addons.title: Conceptual Attunement

addons.text: The fear you embody as a Devil now extends towards your prowess in Conceptual Alchemy. This enables you to use your concept of fear in various alchemic means to strengthen humanity's fear of it. Which in turn allows you gain further power from the concept you embody. Additionally alchemical processes involving your concept experience an increase in potency in relation to the fear humanity holds of it.
addons.title: Conceptual Fear

objects.text: You’ve gained the ability to imbue, harness, and harvest concepts themselves to use as ingredients or additional boosts, in your alchemy.
