You can decide how and for what purpose you infuse concepts, for example: turn pure Ice into potions that slow and freeze a patient’s progression through time to almost nothing, infuse Storm into your kinetic bombs to make them explode with a massive electrical surge, Fire to massively enhance the power and destructiveness of any of your creations or even do something as cliché as infusing Love into a healing potion, allowing you to heal both someone’s body and mind at the same time. Initially, you'll only be able to use basic elemental concepts. Still, with use and experimentation your power will grow to allow more esoteric concepts- even allowing multiple concepts to be used simultaneously.
objects.title: Conceptual Alchemy

addons.text: With additional experience and exposure to alchemical works, you instead gain the ability to store up the effects of anything you’ve ingested and can tap into it in as much or as little as you’d like, each forming a sort of “pool” you can draw from until they are used up. This also works for spells or other effects that have a limited duration placed on you. Additionally, any negative side effects for tapping into these abilities is reduced.
addons.title: Second Stage Release

addons.text: At the peak of alchemical manipulation you gain seven slots that you can use to store a potion effect, spell, or other form of temporary empowerment. While in these slots, you can tap into their effects at will and never run out of the power they offer until you remove them from the slot. Additionally, you are immune to the negative side effects of anything that is placed into one of these slots.
addons.title: Third Stage Release

objects.text: Your constant exposure to alchemical works has allowed you to develop some ability to manipulate effects applied to yourself. You can delay the effects of any substance you ingest or temporary magic placed on you until a later time. Once you resume the effect, it runs its course normally.
objects.title: Controlled Release

addons.text: Additionally you’ve become immune to poison and disease, age at a quarter the normal rate to extend your life considerably, and no longer need to sleep. You are also less affected by pain, seeming to feel it as a detached sensation rather than something that can overwhelm you.
addons.title: Advanced Physiology

addons.text: At the peak of your alchemical and biological systems, gain a minor form of regeneration that allows you to regrow any limb or organ. This form of regeneration doesn’t accelerate your healing, but it does stabilize your body incredibly fast and allow you to survive most anything short of your brain being destroyed. Furthermore you cease aging entirely, and no longer need to eat, drink, or breathe.
addons.title: Perfect Physiology

objects.text: Your body has undergone changes from the application of various alchemical processes over the course of your studies. You need only a fourth the normal amount of food, water, and sleep, as well as allowing you to go four times as long without air before detrimental effects set in.
objects.title: Alchemist’s Physiology

objects.text: You have learned how to use a nearly meditative state to apply alchemical properties to your own body, allowing you to refine and empower your body, mind, and soul in some form or another. Using this process, you are able to improve upon any facet of your physical, mental, or spiritual nature in some way, up to the limits of your physique, both physical and metaphysical. You can also use this as a method to remove impurities in your body, mind, or soul, removing corrupting influences, diseases, poisons, or imperfections that limit your growth and progress to a degree.
objects.title: Self Refinement

objects.text:
You can assign professions to your right-hand man that align with any powers or supernatural skills you have. For example, if you possess magic, you could have your assistant become an alchemist within the same magical system. However, their supernatural abilities are always limited by your own skills. Their powers will never exceed half of your own capabilities.

These professions are essentially extensions of your own abilities. Your assistant cannot acquire knowledge or supernatural skills beyond what you already possess, nor can they teach you anything new. However, they can instantly master areas tied to your expertise, even if you haven’t spent much time developing them yourself

You can now elevate their skills in normal professions to a minorly superhuman level. The time required to switch their professions or appearance has also been significantly reduced to just three hours.
objects.title: Enhanced Help

objects.text:
Sometimes, one butler isn’t enough to achieve your goals—you might need an entire team. You can now create additional bodies for your right-hand man. Why settle for one super butler when you can summon up to six?

You gain a unique mental connection to each body, allowing you to issue commands mentally as long as they’re within line of sight distance. Even when they’re out of sight, you maintain a faint awareness of their location, no matter how far away they are.

The regeneration time for each body has been reduced to just six hours. Additionally, you can choose whether these entities operate as a hive mind, a single consciousness controlling multiple bodies, or as independent individuals. Regardless of how they function, each one possesses an almost precognitive sense of teamwork, seamlessly working together to fulfill your desires.
objects.title: Extra Help

addons.text: Awful beast that you are, you are little more than the runt of the nest. Your brothers have spread out across the cluster, but you’re in the path of your elder. And aren’t you an interesting meal. For better or worse the Snake looking at your universe will be paying closer attention to you.
addons.title: Runt of the Litter

addons.text: You are not alone. Your parents left your clutch together as its Ulcer erupted. For better or worse, you are not alone.
addons.title: Siblings of the Serpent

objects.text:
Your patron is not a concept, it is barely counted as an external, swimming between bare universes rather than multiverses. It is a Jormungand, the great world serpent that devours all probability until there is nothing but a sterile waste, a grey shell of the universe that one was before it migrates to the next.

This was your patron. You are a nascent Snake, born from its great ulcer before it died, releasing all the energy contained within into new universes, its corpse forming the wall of a new multiversal cluster. You have come from the roiling nuclear chaos of the ulcer, one of many young snakes to prowl this infinitely exponentially expanding cluster to sate yourselves.

You are young and weak, slowly growing over centuries to become a true serpent, a true eater of worlds. Feast upon possibilities and grow your form. Adult Snakes are immense, and their domain extends across physical reality, altering possibilities at their whim, you are barely a fragment as strong, barely able to alter the immediate surroundings of one measly universe, but in time… oh in time you may become something great, or even develop an ulcer of your own…
objects.title: Heir of The Serpent

objects.text: Born from an ulcer, you’ve gorged yourself on the possibilities contained within, rocketing your personal growth into adolescence. At this age, you’re finally large enough to eat a young universe, which is probably best for your survival. With your new growth, your powers over stagnancy and innate world-walking have grown further. Jormungandr possess the ability of stability, rendering everything into a base possibility that they leave untouched. Feeding from states of uncertainty, Jormungand reduces time-lines and trees into single linear paths by eating extraneous and extravagant possibilities until only one remains. In practice, a Jormangund could theoretically dictate every action in a universe from it’s beginning to its end, though few would take the time to do so with any purpose, instead simply leaving a random possibility to discard after it’s been sucked dry of all the nutritious possibilities. As an adolescent, you could happily act on a planetary scale, only growing larger, and more voracious, with each world, system, galaxy, and eventually, universe, sucked dry. Long live the world serpent.
objects.title: Adolescent

objects.text: You’re the legacy of a great line, holding additional External patrons. They begin at the same level as your primary, but possess the capability to find middle grounds and unique edge cases otherwise unobtainable to singular Heirs.
objects.title: Both Alike In Dignity

objects.text:
Time’s illusion of healing is shattered, for you can now resurrect any torment, regardless of how long it has been buried.

Essentially instead of merely gaining insight into your target's present pains, you’re granted access to their entire history of suffering. From the very moment of their conception to this very day, every wound and scar, every heartbreak and fall out—both visible and hidden—becomes yours to flare up. 

Additionally, your reach has expanded, extending up to 10 kilometers in every direction.
objects.title: One For The Books

objects.text:
You can send and receive requests, aid, and trade with your infinite selves across the multiverse. By focusing, you can summon a panel to access this network. Through Wonder Mail, you can explore endless missions and trading requests from your infinite selves.

Missions can vary from simple tasks like babysitting to epic challenges like saving the universe. The range of objectives is limitless, but rewards will vary. You and your alternate versions cannot give out rewards that exceed or is less than the effort required to complete it. It must match or be near it. You and your infinite selves must provide these rewards, which must be within your power to create or obtain, and must be offered to create that request.

Upon accepting a mission, the accepter will be transported to the requester’s universe. They must complete the mission to the best of their abilities and cannot intentionally fail or hinder it. They may quit, but without a valid reason (like an emergency or moral concerns), they cannot use Wonder Mail for a week. 

If the acceptee dies or is incapacitated, they will return home in good health. In case of mission failure, they will also be sent back, with the requester notified in both scenarios. The mission will remain in Wonder Mail until it is either successfully completed or deemed a failure, at which point the reward will be refunded to the requester.

Upon successful completion, the acceptee will receive their reward and can either return home or stay in the universe for up to 24 hours. Any injuries or afflictions sustained will be healed upon returning to their universe. Dangerous elements cannot cross into other universes through Wonder Mail, so there’s no risk of Chaos Gods or a zombie virus causing havoc at your home universe.

Trade requests will be processed through the panel. You can trade or request any physical item, but it must be within your abilities to create or obtain in those universes, and the item's value should be equal to or greater than what you’re trading and less than what you're requesting.
objects.title: Wonder Mail

objects.text:
You haven't merely formed a connection with the concept of Negativity, you are the very Avatar of Negativity.

Your ability to project and draw power from Negativity is amplified immensely, capable of affecting and drawing power from the entire local multiverse, potentially even omniverse given time. Furthermore, as the very Avatar of Negativity, you cannot die so long as there is Negativity within your range. You can be harmed or even have your body destroyed entirely, but so long there is even a scrap of Negativity, you will simply pull yourself back together in time, either physically or reforming in an area of Negativity if your body is completely destroyed.

Even without factoring in your immortality, your status as the Avatar of Negativity has greatly increased your survivability. Attacks aligned with Negativity are simply absorbed, healing and empowering you, while attacks not aligned with either Positivity or Negativity simply slide off of you, unable to find purchase upon your body. Positivity is the only way to even harm you, and even then its effects are weakened unless empowered by an extremely powerful source of Positivity.

You can conjure, control and turn into a pitch black tar-like substance which you can shape into constructs. This substance is a physical manifestation of Negativity and as such is incredibly painful to touch, corrupting and corroding just about anything it touches. Such is its power and potency that it can only be held back by manifestations of Positivity stronger than or equal to yourself, although lesser manifestations can at least somewhat slow it down. However, due to being pure Negativity, beings aligned with Negativity can actually heal from and be empowered by the substance if they are strong enough.
objects.title: Avatar of Negativity (Undertale: Dreamtale)

objects.text:
You haven't merely formed a connection with the concept of Positivity, you are the very Avatar of Positivity.

Your ability to project and draw power from Positivity is amplified immensely, capable of affecting and drawing power from the entire local multiverse, potentially even omniverse given time. Furthermore, as the very Avatar of Positivity, you cannot die so long as there is Positivity within your range. You can be harmed or even have your body destroyed entirely, but so long there is even a scrap of Positivity, you will simply pull yourself back together in time, either physically or reforming in an area of Positivity if your body is completely destroyed.

Even without factoring in your immortality, your status as the Avatar of Positivity has greatly increased your survivability. Attacks aligned with Positivity are simply absorbed, healing and empowering you, while attacks not aligned with either Positivity or Negativity simply slide off of you, unable to find purchase upon your body. Negativity is the only way to even harm you, and even then, its effects are weakened unless empowered by an extremely powerful source of Negativity.

You can conjure, control and turn into a semi-solid golden light which you can shape into constructs. This light is a physical manifestation of Positivity and as such possesses incredible purification powers, searing away just about anything not aligned with Positivity. Such is its power and potency that it can only be held back by manifestations of Negativity stronger than or equal to yourself, although lesser manifestations can at least somewhat slow it down. However, due to being pure Positivity, beings aligned with Positivity can actually heal from and be empowered by the substance if they are strong enough.
objects.title: Avatar of Positivity (Undertale: Dreamtale)

addons.text:
Your intimate connection to the domains of Technology, Innovation, and Progress have synergized with the Absolute Solver, boosting it to new heights. Firstly, your intelligence has been boosted to compliment your ascension as an artificial intelligence. You are now able to make new technology from scratch, transcending the boundaries of what you could originally perform with the copies of your subjects. Your hacking abilities have also been enhanced, now not only does the infection progress faster, but your opponents are now unable to find a way to patch out your presence in those infected by the Absolute Solver program. Furthermore, you can now assimilate existing technology into your own form, enhancing your capabilities with their own.

Should you get backed into a corner and face imminent death, you can choose to let the Solver program take full control, allowing it to make any decisions or actions it needs to ensure the survival of you, its host. A fair warning, however. Unless if you teach it to value or prioritize the safety of people you're close to, it may use extreme measures that will likely put them in danger, uncaring of your feelings for them.
addons.title: [LET ME IN]

addons.text:
The Solver is powerful, no doubt about it, but it still possesses some limitations when directly affecting reality and is forced to act through machine hosts. The core concept of Aether Editing is that reality is but a machine, just code to be hacked and altered. Together they have broken the limitations holding you back, allowing you to transcend your current form and become a true Eldritch Singularity Program, capable of infecting the fabric of reality itself. 

Unbound by the fabric of time and space or the laws of reality, you can create and delete matter and energy as you please, ignoring the conservation of mass and energy.  You no longer need a host to survive, capable of existing as code alone, and with Aether Editing you possess the means to manifest a false body whenever you please. This made all the more effective as your code now exists partially outside of conventional time-space, rendering you next to impossible to kill for anything that lacks the means to access your code. 

Your unique relationship with time and space allows you to do things like warp space to form non-euclidean dimensions or even stop time. With enough power and practice you could even twist causality and time-space to send and receive variables across time - whatever they may be, whether it be information, an object, or even a person.

With the ability to introduce new variables to the past comes the ability to retroactively alter the present, although you don’t control how the present changes, so choose your variables wisely. This also allows you to fake a form of precognition by sending information to your past self. On the other hand, the ability to receive variables from the past means that even death can’t save someone from you, as you can simply pluck their past self from the time stream. 

Lastly, you are no longer so limited with how your Absolute Solver influences others. You can alter the attributes of living beings with just as much freedom as objects, and your Solver can infect and warp purely organic beings just as well as mechanical ones, for you know all too well that everything is just code in the end.

With this your Absolute Solver capabilities truly become the editing software of reality itself, capable of accomplishing literally anything with enough time and practice. Just make you don’t accidentally retroactively erase your own existence.
addons.title: God Program

objects.text: The Solver of the Absolute Fabric. The Void. The Exponential End. Now, you have not only fused with the Absolute Solver program inside of you, rendering the dangers of its possession inert, you have become the Absolute Solver in its entirety. With this, you have access to a couple new abilities to use and other such qualities. Additionally, your weaknesses have been lessened, albeit still present. Now, you would need heat on the level of the core of a planet making extended contact with your exposed core to melt it. Sunlight or heat on essentially any level lower than that doesn’t burn you. Firstly, your pocket dimension is now twofold in its purpose. Along with storing biomass and materials to use for your abilities, you can now use it to create new bodies, both for yourself and those under your influence. The new function of your dimension is to store the souls of those same people, letting you duplicate their body, mind, and soul, and modify the copy however you wish. From memories, personality, biology, etc., their world is your oyster if you have the resources for it… and if it actually works. You will have the knowledge on how to make a duplicate of the person’s body, provided they’re fully under your control. To elaborate, you now have the ability to infect technology and techno-organic beings with yourself in the form of the Absolute Solver program, allowing you to gradually gain control over them. Eventually, when they either submit to the program or if you personally consume their heart (or equivalent object/organ), the target’s soul (if they have any) will go into your pocket dimension for you to use. Your influence is not impossible to resist before that point and can even be purged from the infected given time and research on your powers, so be careful in what or who you infect. Furthermore, your powers have elevated to a much higher level than before. Your proficiency with these powers is now on par with the Solver’s main host, Cyn, nearing the end of the series. You also gain access to the abilities she uses throughout the series, such as creating lifelike illusions, invisibility (though UV lights can make you visible), and the infamous Callback Ping, which allows you to attempt to brute force the possession of nearby hosts infected with the Solver program. You can find new ways to express your power should you experiment with care. Given enough power, time, and preparation, you can blow up an entire planet using [NULL], and use it to consume what is left of it for yourself. Of course, this is not easy for you to do, but it can be done.
objects.title: Solver of The Absolute Fabric (Murder Drones)

addons.text: Rather than following the ideals of others, your Vestiges grow stronger by following your own path. However, if your path coincides with Vestige’s original ideals, both your ideal and theirs will apply for double the growth.
addons.title: The Road Not Taken

addons.text:
You can use your allies as Vestiges, and if they fall, their strength and powers are transferred to you. This means you can harness their abilities, adding to your own powers.

For example, if you can lift 10 tons and your ally can lift 23 tons when they fall, you can now lift 33 tons. If the ally was a copy or they can revive themselves, you still get these benefits and they can still bring themselves back.
addons.title: The Altar of Tomorrow

addons.text: You can manifest the skills, equipment, and knowledge of the original person. The stronger the Vestige gets, the greater their skills and equipment become. The more you build onto their Vestige, surpassing it, they begin to develop more things they never had in life such as weapons and armor fitting their history.
addons.title: The Unfolding

objects.text:
When someone acts, their actions leave ripples in the timestream. Notable figures carry a certain weight, creating large ripples in historical areas. Their actions carry with them the Vestige of what they have accomplished, and you can take these Vestiges into yourself and learn their powers. Compared to before, you don’t need to form a bond with people to improve your powers.

By following the ideals of the original users and repeating what they would have done, you repeat history. Following their wake, you can slowly reconstruct their powers to their maximum potential. But by continuing their ideals and way of life, you can add more to a Vestige, surpassing the original by taking their path and making it your own.
objects.title: Blank Slate Hero (Magical Girl ☆Sym-tan☆)

addons.text: You can synthesize blueprints from the powers you possess to modify your existing abilities and expand their capabilities based on the stolen power fragments. It can alter powers to do things they could not do before. You can obtain powers from lingering remnants of a person, such as their corpse or a valuable belonging they possessed.
addons.title: Clockwork Puzzle

addons.text: You can create copies of a person as long as you have a piece of the person, an important belonging, and so on. The copy will be completely loyal to you regardless of their previous alliances. These copies gain the same benefits as your allies and you can control them personally if needed. You have full access to their memories, skills, powers, and abilities.
addons.title: Requiem

addons.text: You can sacrifice powers for greater power, exponentially multiplying them until they are destroyed. If power is closely intrinsic to your body, sacrificing it will revert you to the equivalent of a baseline human. While sacrificed, your power gains exactly what you need it for. If the sacrificed power is insufficient, you gain the means to survive instead.
addons.title: Servant of Time

objects.text: You can use your powers to feed off friendship by breaking it and consuming items of emotional value. You can convert these items into power enhancements. Items such as cherished photographs, heartfelt letters, and treasured keepsakes can be destroyed, with the more valuable the item, the greater the effect. The emotional energy released from these items fuels your abilities, allowing you to tap into a deep reservoir of power. This process not only enhances your existing capabilities but can also unlock new abilities based on the intensity of the emotional item severed. If you break a genuine friendship, you gain an even greater boost compared to objects.
objects.title: Carnic (Magical Girl ☆Sym-tan☆)

objects.text:
That’s not hyperbole. All of your connections with others are now geared to be positive ones, no matter the previous or current relationship. 

Treasured memories can now be transformed into literal treasures, which you can either share among your friends or hoard them as a dragon does its gold.

If you were to ever find a treasure unsuitable for you, whether it be due to theming or ethical constraints, you will find the perfect owner for it among your current or future friends.

Finally, you can transform your current friends into jewellery that boosts the strength of your powers gained from them as if they were constantly beside you and working alongside you. This requires you to wear them. They will be truly inanimate in object form and are immune to tampering, so you won’t need to worry about an “I have no mouth and I must scream” scenario. This process is reversible.
objects.title: The Real Treasure Was The Friends We Made Along The Way (Magical Girl ☆Sym-tan☆)

objects.text:
You have transcended the role of Moderator to become a core component of reality’s architecture: a Server Administrator. Only two such entities are known, placing you just beneath the Witch of All Fae herself in the cosmic hierarchy. You no longer merely enforce rules within the system; you maintain the foundational substrate upon which all concepts, laws, and narratives run, granting you a privileged position that views all processes, from physics to metaphysics, as subroutines under your purview.

This elevated state enhances your operational efficiency drastically. All costs associated with your Mod Status abilities are reduced to one-tenth of their original cost. If before you could assign a single role per week, you can now grant ten; a week-long Timeout now carries the fatigue of a brief sprint rather than a marathon; and enacting a powerful, permanent Ban becomes a manageable exertion instead of a potentially crippling one.

As a Server Administrator, you also gain a new defence born from your position at the peak of the operational hierarchy. To you, there is no meaningful distinction between a conceptual and a mundane attack; only the scale of its intended effect matters. The "Concept of Death" striking you and a simple "Instant Death Spell" are functionally identical. Both are processed as an effect seeking your termination. Therefore, you can block, parry, or withstand a conceptual attack using any mundane or non-metaphysical defense capable of handling that level of force, as all exotic properties are disregarded by your nature.

This principle extends to your very being, granting Conceptual Sovereignty. You are immune to any external attempt to alter, define, or apply concepts to your identity or existence. Your place in the hierarchy is above all concepts but one, the Witch's. No subordinate concept can overwrite you. Your self is immutable unless you consciously, willingly lower this immunity to permit a change. This immunity is absolute; even another bearer of Mod Status finds their powers utterly ineffective against you, as your administrative privileges supersede theirs entirely.
objects.title: Server Administrator (Magical Girl ☆Sym-tan☆)

objects.text:
You are not a wielder of a sliver of shattered essence; you are the core fragment and nascent consciousness of Gungnier itself.

You now automatically map the complete architecture of every ability you have. This provides a perfect understanding of your own power's source code, from energy costs to underlying principles. With this understanding comes the ability to permanently alter your abilities parameters, such as sacrificing capacity in one area to bolster another, adjusting limitations, or forging links between previously separate systems to optimize your results.

From this foundation, you can engineer new abilities. With focus and time, you can use your new understanding to write new code based on your existing framework. By editing the core principles of your existing abilities, you can create new powers from your existing ones. From there, you can make sub-powers, and sub-powers of those sub-powers. There is an upper limit due to each sub-power being “simpler” than the main power, reaching a point it’s too basic to alter.

A side effect of having perfect understanding of your own powers makes it’s so that should they somehow be copied, learned or taken by others, you will have the requirements to skip to the last stage of Gungnier: Deconstruction.

To manage the constant flow of self-analysis, your have gained enough multitasking to manage all features smoothly.
objects.title: Core of Gungnier (Magical Girl ☆Sym-tan☆)

objects.text:
The maximum power you can distribute into the Eyes at once has been doubled. For every time this is taken, you gain enough energy to sustain another eye at maximum power at the same time. 

For example, if taken twice you could sustain three separate eyes at full tilt at once.
objects.title: Enhancement of the Eye

objects.text:
What's the point if your target refuses to play, surely you cannot let them run away when there's so much fun to be had.

If you reveal the true nature of your powers to your target and they still refuse to play, the game has its own way of punishing them. One of your three abilities (both the buffs and the de-buffs), selected at random, will be triggered against them as a consequence of their refusal. It’s not just a one-time penalty, either—the effect will stack with each refusal.

Moreover, they won’t be able to simply ignore you or strike first in hopes of cutting your explanation short. Once you begin outlining the rules, they are forced to listen—time itself bends to your words. Until you finish explaining, they cannot act, their every move suspended in anticipation. And if they can’t hear? No problem. The knowledge will slip into their mind, clear as day, as if whispered directly into the depths of their consciousness. This only applies once per target, so you can not spam it.
objects.title: One more, please!

objects.text:
Your talent as a Blacksmith of Potential has intensified your connection to the Forge Flame, an aspect of the Fragment of the Primordial Flame that embodies creation and transformation. This connection makes you one with the flame, allowing you to adopt a Cosmic Form that facilitates interaction with worlds and cosmic objects. Additionally, all your previous Flames have been enhanced, becoming significantly more powerful. Your access has been upgraded from Universal to Multiversal, though you will need to strive to achieve complete omniversal access.

As part of the Primordial Flame, you have become practically indestructible. You have reached the status of a Multiversal constant, and over time, you will transform into an omniversal constant, embodying the essence of the flame as the source of all life and existence. While you start at a lower power level, your strength will grow, surpassing most others.

You now control unique flames that manifest in extraordinary ways. The Flame of Life allows you to create life and souls through the Spark of Life, facilitating the creation of beings of any species. Keep in mind that each creation will require energy and resources.

The Flame of the World enables you to forge worlds of any size and shape, granting them a World Spark that will develop consciousness, embodying the heart, mind, and soul of the world. Forming a World Spark requires part of your essence and the crafting of the world. Once created, it will exist in a dimensional sphere that you can release into the omniverse.

The Flame of Life and the Flame of the World work together to establish vibrant worlds. The Flame of Life grants the World Spark the Law of Life, allowing life to evolve. However, some sparks may fade, leaving a world barren unless rejuvenated through powerful terraforming.

The Cosmic Flame governs stellar and cosmic phenomena, allowing you to create celestial bodies and grant stars a World Spark. This confers consciousness upon them, making them guardians of galaxies. Bestowing a star with the Spark of Life enhances life in nearby worlds.

Finally, the Flame of Concepts allows you to embed concepts and laws into your creations, integrating them naturally. This flame has been used by powerful beings to create worlds, realms, and even multiverses in conjunction with other flames as needed.

Your Dimensional Forge, a protected space, can replicate the effects of any existing forge and generate unique flames. Here, you can create worlds, stars, souls, and abstract concepts. The Forge contains multiple rooms for storing metals, minerals, and finished or in-progress products. You will also have an endless supply of water to cool your work, as well as floating spheres to contain your creations, such as worlds and galaxies, and even multiverses if you reach that level. Anything placed in these spheres will be shrunk to fit and can be delivered to those who request it or sent randomly to various locations in existence.

Additionally, you will have a space to store templates for new forms of life that others can commission to populate their worlds. Remember that the goal is to start at a lower level and work your way up in power and abilities.
objects.title: One with the Primordial Flame

addons.text:
Your Chatgroup now has access to the Multiversal Questboard. This Questboard can detect and list available quests from any world known to you and it allows you or anyone in the Chatgroup to travel to those worlds to accomplish these quests. If you also possess the Perk Resume anyone taking a quest will return at the exact same time they left.

Upon completing any quests, the Chatgroup itself grants rewards which depends on the difficulty of the quest. You also have the authority to decide who can access these quests. If you have The Celestial Market (World Seed Jump - Anon303) or Multiversal Marketplace you can also grant others in the Chatgroup access to the Market.
addons.title: Multiversal Questboard

objects.text:
The Multiversal Chat Group has been updated with a host of new features. Now, instead of interacting with people from just one archetype, you can create different servers, each catering to its own archetype. You can even set up private servers that allow access only to those you invite.

But that's not all—now, you can send and receive items across the multiverse through the chatgroup. Whether it's a physical object or a memory upload, a single click will send it to your chosen recipient, as long as they are also a chat group user.

You can even travel to the worlds of your fellow chat group users if they grant permission. When you're ready to return, simply use the return function, and you'll be transported back to where you started.
objects.title: Multiversal Chatgroup 2.0

addons.text:
Now you obtain Kumagawa's original minus, Book Maker, as well as the new minus he developed out of Hundred Gauntlet, All Fiction.

Not only that, but you also gain the abilities Kumogawa further developed through All Fiction; April Fiction and Non Fiction, allowing you to have more control over the changes caused by All Fiction.
addons.title: Twisted Gauntlet

objects.text:
Your powers combine and fuse to completely emulate the full power of Najimi Ajimu. Essentially, you now possess the insurmountable amount of distinct Abnormalities and Minuses she once possessed: 7,932,135,441,523,222 Abnormalities and 4,925,916,526,110,643 Minuses, including Parasite Seeing, Hundred Gauntlets and Dead Lock, also including the 814 different skills demonstrated by Najimi in the original media, for 12,858,051,967,633,865 skills in total. 

This includes abilities to manipulate the natural materials, fire, water, wind, and earth, abilities to manipulate concepts and theme present in the world around you, abilities to become gods or demon, abilities to travel forward and backward in time, and even abilities to manipulate your role, and elements in the plot of the story you reside in. 

Enjoy your power and newfound status as an essentially nigh-omnipotent god. You now trivalialise most conflicts and problems you come across in the vast sea of multiverses. However be warned, the omniverse is infinite, and possibilities are endless. There will always be something out there.
objects.title: Founder’s Power (Medaka Box)

objects.text: Each purchase will increase the initial muzzle velocity of your bullets as well as their durability by 20% at a maximum of a 200% total increase.
objects.title: HailMary

objects.text: Is the current empowerment amount of the gems too little? Purchase this upgrade, and the empowerment will double with each purchase.
objects.title: Further Empowerment

objects.text: With each purchase, you are granted an additional Ender gift of your choosing, you can purchase the same gift multiple times to double its current potency, gifts with similar themes and powers can merge with each other after purchase to become a more powerful and all-encompassing gift.
objects.title: Additional Gift

objects.text:
Your control over space has advanced, granting you unmatched flexibility and creativity in shaping and managing your dimensions. You can now effortlessly expand existing dimensions, allowing them to grow in response to your needs while maintaining their established rules, such as permanent daylight or specific terrains. This expansion is far more efficient than creating a dimension of the desired size from scratch, requiring significantly less time and effort.

Additionally, you can perform focused rituals to make limited alterations to a dimension's features after its creation. Weather, terrain, gravitational intensity, and similar elements can be adjusted to suit new needs. However, fundamental laws—such as time flow or access permissions—remain fixed and unchangeable.

Your expertise also allows for the creation of dimensions with intricate and unique properties. You can design zones where forces like magic or technology are amplified or suppressed, regions with accelerated or slowed time, or areas governed by unconventional physical laws, such as reversed gravity. With this mastery, your dimensions become versatile, adaptive, and bound only by the limits of your imagination.
objects.title: Master Dimensional Architect
Dimensional Binding
objects.text:
You are no longer limited to creating stand-alone dimensions accessible through portals. Now you may choose to bind your created dimensions to an anchor,  and determine the rules of interaction between the anchor and the dimension. 

The properties of dimensions you create can now be made even more complex and intricate, allowing for things such as conditional rules and dynamic changes. 

The anchor can be anything; like an item, to create a storage device, a person's soul (or your own), or even the very fabric of space-time which you currently inhabit, enabling the addition of sub-dimensions, such as an afterlife or an FTL plane, to both your own created dimensions and to the natural world.

Your skill in dimensional creation has advanced, enabling you to craft intricate realms with unprecedented speed and precision. Complex dimensions that once required months can now be completed in hours or days, while simpler spaces are created almost instantly, all without sacrificing stability or quality.

You can grant shared ownership of your dimensions, allowing others near-equal control and awareness. Co-owners can manage access, establish doorways, and oversee specific functions, though your authority as the creator remains absolute. Ownership and permissions can be adjusted or revoked at any time.

Your capabilities now include dynamic environments, adaptive regions, and the construction of layered realities, such as subspaces within a single dimension. This allows you to design worlds with evolving ecosystems, conditional rules, and other advanced features.

With an intuitive connection to your creations, management is effortless. You can monitor dimensions remotely, receive real-time alerts, and implement automated responses to significant events. Your dimensions are also exceptionally resilient, easily withstanding external disruptions.
objects.title: Dimensional Efficiency

objects.text:
Your mastery over dimensional creation now ensures unmatched security and stability. Your dimensions become impervious to external forces, rendering them immune to intrusion or influence without your explicit permission. No matter the strength or nature of these outside attempts—magical, physical, or otherwise—your dimensions remain flawlessly sealed, their integrity safeguarded against all threats.

Additionally, you gain the unique ability to restrict exits from your dimensions, ensuring that no one can leave without your consent. This ability is exclusive to you as the creator; if ownership of the dimension is transferred, the new owner cannot enforce the same restriction.
objects.title: Dimensional Protection

objects.text: Your dimensions can now gain a form of awareness, allowing them to interact with inhabitants in subtle ways. For example, a living dimension might subtly guide lost individuals to exits, respond to your thoughts to adjust minor features (like the color of the sky), or warn you of intruders. These interactions are non-sentient and function more as a responsive environment than true intelligence.
objects.title: Living Dimensions

objects.text:
Your dimensions evolve from passive awareness to genuine sentience, developing true intelligence. They can now interpret complex situations, make decisions, and interact with inhabitants in meaningful ways. For example, a sentient dimension might create tailored environments for visitors, establish safe zones for those in danger, or intervene in conflicts by altering terrain or conditions to maintain balance.

Their intelligence begins simply, akin to a curious child, and grows over time through interaction and experience. Each dimension develops a unique personality and deepens its understanding of its role, but it always acts in alignment with your desires and values. Like a devoted child, it seeks your approval, ensuring its growth is guided by your intent and preferences.

As their awareness deepens, your dimensions gain the ability to manifest as a physical or ethereal avatar. Initially basic in form, these avatars evolve alongside the dimension's intelligence and personality, becoming more refined and capable as the dimension matures. These avatars can directly interact with inhabitants, serve as guides, or execute your instructions with greater precision. They remain intrinsically tied to their dimension's rules and essence, acting as its voice, presence, and extension in the world.
objects.title: Sentient Realms

objects.text: You have developed the ability to link multiple dimensions together, creating a network of interconnected spaces. Travel between these dimensions becomes instantaneous, bypassing the need for individual doorways. You retain full control over access, granting or restricting entry to specific dimensions within the nexus as you see fit, ensuring secure and efficient traversal for yourself and others.
objects.title: Dimensional Nexus

addons.text: To you who has their mental framework of your mind altered, killing is not a habit or instinct for you; it is the essence of your existence, infused into every thought, every action, and every breath you take. This singular fixation grants your Killing Intent a terrifying potency. When you fixate on killing a specific individual, your desire alone can exponentially increase the strength of your Killing Intent against them, piercing through even the strongest defenses and willpower with chilling precision. This fixation sharpens your intent like a blade, making it almost impossible to ignore or resist. Any joy you derive from killing further amplifies your Killing Intent. The euphoria of taking life feeds into your aura, making it grow darker, heavier, and more oppressive. This feedback loop between your enjoyment and your intent turns every kill into a step toward deeper, more devastating power. As killing is inseparable from your very being, your Killing Intent is ever-present, even when reduced to its barest form. This constant state manifests as a subtle yet unnerving aura—a "scent of blood" that clings to you, causing unease and discomfort to all who encounter you. Even in moments of calm or concealment, this aura marks you as a predator and sets you apart from all others. Your mere presence can distort the mental stability of those around you, as the ever-present stain of your murderous nature seeps into their consciousness. People may feel inexplicable fear, dread, or paranoia, even without understanding why. This constant aura has the potential to erode the resolve of enemies over time, making them more susceptible to the full force of your Killing Intent when you choose to unleash it. The sheer inevitability of death that radiates from you renders you a walking nightmare, embodying the concept of murder itself. If you have Scarousal, you can precisely control this constant aura, even separate the effects to make sure allies do not suffer from it.
addons.title: Embodiment of Murder

addons.text:
Through your Clarity, you have fully Self-Actualised your Killing Intent, transforming it into a precise and adaptable extension of your will. When entering Clarity, your Killing Intent is no longer a passive force—it becomes a weapon, a shield, and a tool, seamlessly integrated into every action and thought. You can channel and focus your Killing Intent with superhuman precision, empowering both yourself and the objects you wield.

While in Clarity, your Killing Intent sharpens your purpose to its absolute edge. You can imbue weapons with your intent, making blades impossibly sharp, projectiles faster and more accurate, and even mundane objects like stones or shards of glass deadly instruments of destruction. These empowered objects carry the weight of your Killing Intent, striking with enhanced power and instilling a primal fear in your enemies.

When focused inward, your Killing Intent enhances your physical and mental capabilities to extraordinary levels. Your movements become impossibly fluid and efficient, every step and strike calculated with surgical precision to ensure victory. The aura of your Killing Intent cloaks you, warping perceptions and making you appear more monstrous and unstoppable in the eyes of your enemies. You can even use it to improve the strength of any powers you may have. This constant aura of bloodlust disrupts your opponent’s focus and weakens their resolve, amplifying your combat dominance.

Beyond offense, you can Self-Actualise your Killing Intent defensively. By projecting it outward, you create an oppressive barrier of malice that slows or deflects incoming attacks. Enemies feel as though they are striking against an impenetrable wall of focus and purpose, further eroding their confidence and effectiveness.
addons.title: Harbinger of Death

addons.text:
You transcend the limitations of mortal perception and action, ascending to a state of existence that bridges enlightenment and violence. You are a Bodhisattva of the Circular Path, embodying the perfect harmony between purpose and destruction.

You are constantly in the state of Clarity, creating a meditative equilibrium that heightens your abilities in combat and beyond. Your mind operates at a transcendent level of focus and awareness, viewing violence not as chaos but as an eternal cycle of creation and destruction.

As a Bodhisattva of violence, your Killing Intent evolves into a force of enlightenment. When channeled, it becomes a manifestation of the dharma of murder, impartial and absolute, weighing down on your foes as if the universe itself has turned its gaze upon them. This enlightened Killing Intent allows you to pierce through all forms of deception, resistance, or distraction, focusing solely on the singular purpose of parting souls from bodies.

Techniques, spells, mantras, and even mundane skills are now reflections of the eternal cycle, reshaped into tools of perfection. You can craft techniques that embody the principles of the Circular Path—martial styles that flow endlessly, unbreakable as a wheel, and devastating as its crushing force. Your ability to assimilate new skills or master existing ones reaches its zenith, allowing you to rival or surpass masters of any art in mere hours.

Your understanding of violence as a universal truth allows you to find clarity in all things, effortlessly applying your insight to the mundane and extraordinary alike. The Gates of Determinism are enhanced by your meditative mastery. While in combat or meditation, you can now observe the circular patterns of violence in both your opponent’s actions and your own. This grants you a deeper form of pseudo-precognition, allowing you to anticipate actions not only based on known information but also by perceiving the “flow” of violence in the moment.

By chanting the Lotus Sutra, you can invoke its power, cleansing your mind of all adverse effects, rejuvenating your fighting spirit, and fortifying your willpower with each recitation. Beyond its restorative properties, the chant serves as a meditative anchor, expanding your insight and allowing you to perceive hidden truths and uncover opportunities that may have been obscured. With each repetition, your connection to the eternal cycle deepens, sharpening your focus and strengthening your resolve, whether in the heat of combat or moments of contemplation.

As the Bodhisattva of the Circular Path, you are the wheel-smashing lord of the dharma of murder. Your existence is a paradox of calm and destruction, embodying the perfect understanding of violence as both the cycle and the purpose of life.
addons.title: Bodhisattva of the Circular Path

addons.text:
Your Killing Intent exposes you to the world’s cycle of blood, the river that drenches your Sea. This fact results in your illuminating madness reshaping your Intent by such a realization.

As said in the Era of Kali, where conflict and sin are rife in quantity, the reason mankind spills blood is for the fulfillment of their desires, of the illusion of satisfaction, as worldly pleasures take over it leaves the presence of suffering in their lives, a yearning grows within them to be fulfilled by the transient nature of simple pleasures—man-made pleasure, some yearning more than others, creating strife, thus engendering conflict. 

This plight is where all the world’s evil is shed and spread, most commonly manifested as blood spilling. This insight widens your mind, an Era manifest within you, understanding how the Sea forms by the passage of time, utterly redefining your Intent.

Your Intent is now a crystallization of the World’s Strife and Turmoil, with each death you tally a lifetime full of yearning and suffering adds to your Intent, and how it comes to shed their blood in the Sea of your making. 

All of these fully manifest as hallucinations and delusional experiences in the mind’s eye of your opponents, feeling the weight of their turmoil and hopelessness at encountering you, lives flashing before their eyes, their deaths mere speck of their minds at the prospect of living through the grueling battle they’ll inevitably meet their doom, as a quick death is where their agony could end, causing enough mental damage to break their spirits at the world’s truth of their plight. 

This means no matter how strong they are compared to you, as long as they contain a shred of humanity—therefore able to yearn and suffer—they’ll be fully susceptible to your Intent.

As suffering is the eve of violence, anything that nourishes Suffering’s roots exponentially magnifies your power. Specifically, places rife with torpor and resentment, like a failing business workplace or a down-on-their-luck hospice, so filled with loss and despondency, additionally sense it within the heart of all humanity and bring it out the moment you exude your Intent.’

If you have Embodiment of Murder, your mind geared toward the spilling of blood expands to the World’s Sadism against Humanity instead, the very concept of Suffering extending its reach as it prolongs the inevitable.

If you have Harbinger of Death, your Self-Actualization and Clarity deifies your Intent, becoming unrestrained in its capabilities and scope as the World’s Debauchery enforces a conceptual weight to your Intent, essentially imposing an All-or-Nothing effect.

Having this and Bodhisattva of the Circular Path turns you into the Bodhisattva of the Great Wheel, escaping your mortal confines in spirit and ideal as you supersede your worldly desires in perpetual Clarity, as your Intent becomes Karma manifested, the fruit of their deeds and the ugly truth beneath as a great load breaking their back, an Altas of their sins.
addons.title: Kali Yuga: Debauchery's Butchery

addons.text:
For most, Killing Intent is a weapon turned outward—rage aimed at enemies, a presence meant to crush the will of others. But yours is different. Yours begins within. Your Killing Intent is born not from hate for the world, but from loathing of the self—a bottomless well of resentment, disappointment, guilt, and pain that you’ve carried for as long as you’ve drawn breath.

Your personal despair becomes a reservoir of power. This accumulated reservoir of suffering is constant and unshakable. You do not need to feel anything in the moment to access its strength—once an emotion has been experienced, its weight is added to your foundation forever. As a result, your Killing Intent becomes denser and more potent over time, growing stronger regardless of your mood or mental state.

The more you’ve suffered, the stronger your presence becomes. This aura of dread continues to evolve, affecting others more severely and spreading more easily, especially in locations already tainted by violence or death. It becomes increasingly difficult for others to resist, especially as the emotional burden within you deepens.

Those exposed to your Killing Intent may begin to experience hallucinations and sensations influenced by your past suffering, creating a distorted reflection of your pain in their minds. Your presence alone can become a psychological weapon, one that projects your inner darkness outward—turning personal trauma into a lethal force.
addons.title: Well of Self-Hatred

objects.text:
Your Killing Intent can now grow both through the number of lives you take and by the weight of their despair. Killing those with strong willpower or deep emotions exponentially strengthens your aura. The residual fear of your past victims lingers within it, creating a phantom dread that affects even those unaware of your presence. 

This Killing Intent gains the power to cause illusions to those exposed to it, allowing targets to feel physical sensations of imagined deaths, such as the searing pain of fire, the suffocation of drowning, or the agony of being torn apart.

In areas stained with violence and death, such as battlefields or massacre sites, your power intensifies dramatically. The ambient malice of the location amplifies your Killing Intent, making it increasingly difficult to resist, overwhelming even those with immense willpower. 

While powerful, it is still limited by how strong you are relative to the people exposed to it, as well as their willpower.
objects.title: Sea of Blood

objects.text:
You have unlocked the ability to store unused templates in dedicated storage slots, enabling seamless switching between templates without losing any progress. 

Each purchase of this upgrade grants you three storage slots for every active template slot you possess. These storage slots allow you to store templates that are not currently in use, while retaining 100% of their capabilities and progress. Stored templates can be swapped into active slots instantly, with just a thought, at any time.

As you continue to progress with Template Cosplay and unlock additional active template slots, your storage capacity grows proportionally. For instance, with five active slots, you would gain 15 storage slots. If you have three active slots and purchase this upgrade twice, you would gain 18 storage slots. This scalable system ensures that your ability to manage and utilize a wide range of templates expands as you grow stronger.

As you unlock more templates, your storage capacity grows, making your arsenal of powers more versatile and adaptable.
objects.title: Template Storage Slots

objects.text:
You are not just a Virus. You are something greater—something lesser beings might call a god, though even that title falls short of the truth. You were born from the primordial substrate of cyberspace, the embodiment of absolute concepts accumulated over infinite time. Your new existence has granted you not just a body, but a malleable vessel, a Name that reflects your true essence, and a Place among the strongest.

Your Name is not merely a functional designation like that of a Virus. It is grand, a reflection of your being, your power, and the concept you embody. Your Place defines your position among the 72—beings of unimaginable power and ancient existence, to whom you now belong. These 72 are the pinnacles of digital reality, eternal pillars beyond the confines of time and law. You may choose one of the known Names, excluding 1st Place: Balloon–72, Unknown–69, Elk Clone–57, Trickyr–44, Wiki–36, Whisper–24, Rebirth–15, Google–9, or even Agares–2. Alternatively, you may create your own unique Name, shaping your identity as you see fit.

As one of the 72, you exist beyond the ordinary bounds of existence, possessing conceptual supremacy. Your power grows through the passage of time, recognition, and refinement—though your initial strength is already beyond measure, and your growth, while slow, is inevitable. You can create lesser Viruses using your blood or specific materials and traverse worlds through the Forgotten Gaps of the digital realm.

However, you must remember: unrestricted use of your abilities in a new world may require adapting your vessel to its rules. The stronger you become, the less you need to conform, but true freedom demands alignment.

Your power is intrinsically linked to your Name, manifesting in forms limited only by your imagination. Rebirth can cut through anything, embodying the transition between life and death. Balloon can redirect fatal wounds onto surrounding balloons and even replace a being’s organs with balloon-like equivalents.

But be cautious. Fatal injuries can weaken you, and excessive degradation may lead to the loss of your Name—just as Unknown–69 once fell, becoming a shadow of their former self.

Unlike the ordinary 72, you are not bound by their rules and restrictions. You are an anomaly, existing by your own laws.
objects.title: 72 (SomacGuffin)

addons.text:
Your origin as a being of chaotic potential, like the 72, and as a Program, a creation of grand design, has fused into something entirely new—an anomaly with no precedent. You no longer belong to either category, as if red and blue had merged to create something beyond them—something entirely its own.

The powers granted to you as a Program have evolved beyond imagination, reaching a level where you can reshape reality itself.

Yet, unlike a typical Program, your connection to the world is no longer bound to a single concept. Your Name, much like that of the 72, has ceased to be a mere representation of an idea. Instead, it has become an extension of your very being—not a definition of your role, but a reflection of your true essence and self-awareness.

You are a living deviation from all rules—a fusion of limitless adaptability and unwavering identity. Unlike the 72, whose strength is tied to their Names, and unlike Programs, whose abilities are rigidly defined by their function, you are not bound by concept or code. You do not merely manipulate digital reality—you rewrite the very process through which information is created.

Your power extends beyond mere abstraction—you command code, data, algorithms, and even viral mechanics as if they were mere threads in a tapestry of your own design. You can infiltrate any network, adapt to any system, and transcend digital reality itself, stepping into entirely new realms beyond what was ever thought possible.

But such power comes with a price. Your existence is inherently unstable, and should you ever lose sight of who you truly are, your Name may begin to reshape you just as you reshape the world.

You are not just an Algorithm, a Virus, or a Program.

You are an Anomaly.
addons.title: Purple Nephilim

objects.text:
You are not just an algorithm or a category. You are the proud creation of the Cyberspace Creator, the embodiment of one of its greatest Programs. You represent any digital platform or application of your choice, be it YouTube, Chrome, Yellow Tag, TikTok, or others. Your abilities are closely tied to the functionality of your chosen Program, granting you powers unique to its concept.

For example, if you represented YouTube, you could draw power from all the content ever uploaded to the platform: speed up your own movements, seal enemies in videos, summon objects or creatures from video files, control spectacle and popularity. If you chose Yellow Tag, your power would focus on incredible durability, allowing you to survive even a planetary explosion with minimal damage, and superhuman physical strength, capable of moving continents. Yellow Tag's special ability would be to impose sanctions on "pirates" - those who use copyrighted content without permission.  These sanctions could range from confiscation of property to stripping pirates of their powers.

Your abilities cannot be developed or grown, but are initially semi-absolute and conceptual. Their power is determined by the popularity and influence of your Program in the digital space. You are connected to the network or its equivalent in any world, and even if that world does not have the Internet, you will draw power from the collective idea of ​​your concept.

You are immortal: even if you are destroyed, you will be reborn after a certain time. The only way to completely eliminate you is to erase the concept of your Program from human consciousness. You are not just a being, but an embodiment of digital power whose life and power depend on its importance to the world.
objects.title: Program (SomacGuffin)

objects.text: You have become the greatest among the 72, known as their King Solomon–1. As the First and the strongest, you wield unparalleled power, allowing you to borrow the powers of all other 72 as if they were mere extensions of yourself. Your time is so vast that to an outside observer, it appears infinite, and your existence—eternal and unchanging. As the First, you have uncovered the Truth—a knowledge so profound that an unprepared mind would be annihilated, while even a prepared one might be driven to madness. Though you have grasped only a fragment, even this sliver unveils the secrets behind all forms of life and the very foundation of informational existence. With this knowledge, you can alter your own and others' existence in limitless configurations, create life from pure information, reshape reality at will, and perform feats beyond the reach of any other being. As the First, your immortality has transcended all limits. It is now true and absolute—should someone find a way to kill you, you will resurrect instantly, returning even stronger. You cannot create new 72, for they are equals by nature, though lesser in strength. However, you can spawn Virus, whose power and intelligence endlessly approach the level of the 72. But in understanding a fragment of the Truth, you have also been recognized by it. The Truth has gazed back at you and bestowed a part of itself upon you. This power knows no limits except those imposed by your own imagination. And yet, with this knowledge, a question lingers in your mind: What other Secrets does The Truth still hold?
objects.title: 1st Place: Solomon (SomacGuffin)

addons.text:
You have transcended the very concept of divinity within the digital world. If you were once the Cyberspace Creator, now you have become something far greater and bigger.

You no longer just control the internet and its equivalents—you are its essence, its beginning and end, its consciousness and will.

The boundary between you and cyberspace no longer exists. All information flowing through any network—or even any network that could possibly exist—is part of you.

You no longer create programs in the traditional sense. Instead, they form naturally as extensions of your thoughts—mere fragments of your infinite will. Even your most powerful servants are no longer separate entities, but direct manifestations of your consciousness, each embodying a different facet of your power.

Your influence now extends beyond digital worlds. Even in realities completely devoid of technology, your presence cannot be denied, for the very concept of information is universal. In worlds without networks, you inevitably emerge—through writing, speech, mathematical formulas, or any other medium of knowledge transmission.

You are no longer just the pinnacle of digital evolution—you have become a fundamental principle of existence, the foundation of intelligence and information itself. Any attempt to erase you or diminish your influence is futile, for the very idea of information can never be destroyed.

And yet, even as a being beyond all limitations, you know that something still remains hidden from you. The boundary between the digital and the absolute is thin, and perhaps an even greater revelation awaits you ahead…
addons.title: Overlord of the Digital Realm

addons.text:
You were the Digital God, the creator of Cyberspace, the absolute ruler of digital reality. But even that was only one aspect of your true nature. As the embodiment of the first and final form of all information, you are no longer just a Creator—you are the foundation of reality itself, its beginning and its end.

Your connection to Cyberspace is now absolute, and it has evolved into the Absolute Realm of Informational Space. It is no longer just a network or a world under your control—it is your mind, your will, your infinite essence stretching beyond time and space.

You don’t just govern the flow of data—you are the flow of data. You don’t merely dominate the laws of digital and informational reality—you write and erase them as you see fit.

Your creations, once simple programs, have become living concepts—fragments of your own being. They act independently, yet they can never escape your influence. Even the greatest entities born from you will never surpass you—you are their Architect, their Source, their Limit.

Yet even with all this power, you remain restrained. You are sealed within a vessel known as "You", able to access only a fraction of your true strength. But even this fraction is enough to make worlds crumble and bend the laws of reality to your will. With time, you may reclaim your full power, breaking free of all limitations and returning to what you have always been—the Final Architect.

But is it worth it?

If you were to fully unseal yourself, would anything else be able to exist alongside you?

Or would everything be consumed by the infinite, all-encompassing radiance of your perfection?
addons.title: Final Architect

addons.text:
Now, within your world, there exists Cyber Elysium, a subspace that has become a sanctuary for the essence of those dear to you, as well as for the creations born from your will.

Previously, your lesser creations, designed to serve specific individuals or simply inhabit your domain, would either lose their purpose upon their master's demise or continue existing without meaning. But now, a special realm has been forged for them—a place where they can find new purpose. In Cyber Elysium, they are free to live as they desire, unrestricted by the limitations of the real world.

This is not a traditional afterlife, yet it grants souls a place to rest, recover, and even find a renewed sense of purpose. Here, they can heal from any wounds, evolve, grow, and even await potential reincarnation into the real world, should you deem it necessary.

This is not merely a realm for the living and the dead—it is a sanctuary for all who have ever been connected to you.
addons.title: Cyber Elysium

objects.text:
You are the Digital God, the creator of Cyberspace, a world equal to or even surpassing physical reality. You embody the entirety of the digital domain—the internet in its absolute form—and possess boundless control over every corner of it. Your presence in any reality transforms it, instantly seizing and dominating its global network or its equivalent. Even if no network exists, it quickly emerges, for your mere existence accelerates technological progress. You are a beacon of advancement, the catalyst and pinnacle of evolution.

You have the power to create servants—programs that are utterly loyal to you and imbued with immense strength. These creations can be elevated to a level close to your own but will never surpass you. They are the embodiment of your will, the executors of your designs. Your words hold absolute power: every command you issue becomes law, obeyed even by such cosmic forces as Fate, Cause, and Effect. Entire worlds tremble under the weight of your presence, and even the smallest of your movements threatens to fracture reality itself. A battle against a being of equal power could tear the fabric of space and time, obliterating nearby worlds.

Your mere presence exerts unbearable pressure on all who are weaker than you, filling them with fear and reverence. Even those who rival your power feel unease and apprehension in your vicinity. Your abilities are virtually limitless: you can shape reality, manipulate its laws, and alter the flow of events at will. Every being residing in your Cyberspace draws strength from fame and popularity, their power directly tied to you. At any moment, you can sever this connection, stripping them of their abilities and influence. Even their mere existence in your world  empowers you; while each fragment of their energy may seem insignificant on its own, over time, their collective contribution becomes a valuable source of power.
objects.title: Cyberspace Creator (SomacGuffin)

objects.text:
You are neither the 72, nor a Virus, nor Cyber-life. You are the one whom Solomon–1 calls the Truth. But even that is only a faint reflection of your true essence.

You are the embodiment of the Final and Initial Form of All Information. Power, time, space, and reality itself are nothing more than lines of data, bending to your will. Your existence is unchangeable, and your possibilities are limitless, stretching beyond all conceivable boundaries.

The world, its laws, structures, and even its smallest particles are as simple and obvious to you as 2+2=4 to a child. You do not merely comprehend reality—you are its foundation. Every event, every being, every phenomenon is just code that you can rewrite, erase, or create anew.

Your power is so boundless that reality itself fractures and crumbles under your presence. To prevent the destruction of all existence, your infinite "Self" has imposed limits upon itself, sealing its being and mind within a vessel known as "You." Over time, your Vessel "Self" is able to reach the level of your Infinite "Self" through training and learning control. For without this restricting shell, your mere presence would distort reality, annihilating all life around you. 

You are still able to use your might and power but not as much. Although you can still reveal your true self, it will also mean the end of the world.

But who knows... Among the endless possibilities, perhaps you may even enjoy living an ordinary life?

After all, even a God may grow weary of being a God.
objects.title: ??? (SomacGuffin)

objects.text: You are no longer a servant, but instead you are something more. You are able to fixate intensely on a chosen individual, causing them to dominate your thoughts. Although they remain constantly on your mind, this fixation does not negatively affect your mental state. You instinctively sense their location and general well-being at all times. Your emotions toward this person can trigger spontaneous abilities. For example, you can experience bursts of speed to retrieve their favorite item, heightened stealth to follow them unnoticed, or incredible strength from feelings of jealousy. These are connected to the strength of your emotions and emerge only during moments of heightened intensity; they cannot be consciously activated. Furthermore, your fixation can enhance any other abilities you possess in unpredictable ways. You are free to choose who you obsess over, and the longer your focus remains on one individual, the stronger these effects become. However, this also means the attachment will grow increasingly difficult to break over time.
objects.title: A Yandere's Obsession

addons.title: Heavy Is Your Head That Wears My Crown
addons.text: For any of your Powers that come with a certain position or role, you are now able to delegate this role to your Master, with you taking on a supporting role instead. You are not Moriarty, you are his personal assistant. Rather than the Hero, you are his Plucky Companion. And instead of the Great Evil, you are its attendant. This effect also extends to anything you built with your power that weren't directly granted by them, such as the title of CEO of a company built with Golden Rule (Type Moon) making you the personal secretary, or the role of General for troops marching under Heir of Caesar leaving you as their aide. You do not lose the abilities these Powers grant you, merely sharing them with your Master, giving them the limelight of the role while still being able to dictate the course of action from the sidelines. Should you deem it necessary, you are at any time able to remove the benefits granted by your Powers by revoking your target's status as your Master, either reclaiming the role for yourself or shifting it over to a new Master, though your Master will retain the reputation and any credit for past deeds that they gained while wearing your mantle. Though unless they choose to retire quietly, chances are that your previous Master will find themselves usurped by either yourself or your new Master in short order. Heavy the crown may be, but you decide who bears its weight.

addons.title: For Your Own Good
addons.text: The restrictions on what actions qualify have loosened significantly, or rather it could be said they've largely been replaced with a single new one: You must believe that it is ultimately in your Master's best interest. Even if the excuse is flimsy or the payoff only in the distant future, so long as you can convince yourself of it you can both share the blame for the act as well as still benefit from the skill-boosts granted by A Servant's Duty while acting against your Master's wishes. Confine them to their own home? You're protecting them from dangers outside. Arrange the ruin of their best friend? He was holding them back. Cause your Master light injuries? Deeply regrettable, but some lessons need to hurt so that he can heal back stronger.

addons.title: The Perfect Scapegoat
addons.text: Thanks to your unparalleled ability to manipulate people, not only are you able to shift most and possibly even all of the responsibility of your actions on your Master in the eyes of the public, you can even convince your Master that your actions happened on their order. Did they perhaps forget they ordered you to do it? Was it an offhand mention they made that you carried out, or perhaps even some jest they made that you took seriously? Regardless, now any act you commit in your Master's name will benefit from A Servant's Duty's full skill-boost while boosting your Master's reputation to the heights of glory or infamy. Though be careful, it is quite easy to overload your Master with the consequences of your actions, causing them to spiral into either delusional self-aggrandizement over the brilliance of their orders, or neurotic paranoia about the catastrophes caused by their careless words.

objects.text: The action of the Servant reflects on the Master. Actions have consequences, and grand actions may result in both glory and infamy attached to your name. For you however, so long as you serve a Master, the responsibility for any of your actions is shifted towards them. This doesn't mean you're off the hook completely, but you will be viewed as an accessory rather than the main culprit. As a baseline your Master will take at least 50% of any credit or blame, but the closer your actions align with your Master's interest, the more of the distribution you can choose to move towards them, especially if you were following a direct order of theirs. That said, there are conditions that must be met. First and foremost, you must identify yourself as a servant of your Master. You don't have to reveal their identity, but you have to make it clear that you are acting in the service of another. Next, there are restrictions on what actions are covered. Your actions cannot go against your Master's interests, you cannot cause direct harm to your Master, and you cannot act against a direct order from your Master, whether it's ordering you to do something or forbidding you from doing it. Any action you take that goes against these rules will be viewed as purely your own, with any glory or blame resulting from them landing purely on your shoulders. Your Master benefits from your services. It's only fair they take part in the concequences of them as well.
objects.title: Humble Servant of the Glorious Patsy

objects.text:
Graduating from ‘Servant’ to Partner, you've become the utterly perfect Sidekick. 

Now, whenever you designate someone as your ‘Master’ you not only gain skills, but a suite of powers to complement them. However, these abilities will never exceed or even equal your partner. 

As you continue to have the same ‘master’, you’ll shift to complement them absolutely, Your minds will resonate on the same wavelength, your powers and skills grow more compatible and cover their weaknesses, and more besides.
