However, this also has an effect on your own mentality. As you’re never purely your own individual, but a social chameleon, the skills and role that would make this perfect partner fundamentally inform your outlook as long as you embody it. 

Additionally, should you designate a group or team as your master in the same way, your abilities will be notably weaker and more general in order to best fit a role that would help each member as opposed to focusing on a single one.
objects.title: (Side)Kickin’ it

objects.text: Your rebirth as a Voidwalker has opened your eyes to the truth of reality; it is artificial, fake, wrong. And with this knowledge comes two abilities. Firstly, you have gained the ability to see everything that makes up the fabric of existence, every variable which shackles the primordial Void into the twisted shape of reality. When you gaze upon something you see everything about it, from its spiritual essence to the number of atoms which make up its body. Secondly, with this knowledge comes the ability to alter said variables, to bend and reshape those shackles, changing the very foundation of reality. With time you can even learn to destroy the shackles altogether, unmaking something on a fundamental level and returning its essence to that which was there before and will be there after. You can even use this on yourself to alter your own physical form, instituting new bindings into the fabric of your body. A side effect of this ability is that you gain a great resistance to most forms of harm, especially supernatural and esoteric ones, as you subconsciously reinforce your own existence against outside attempts to alter or harm it. This power isn’t without downsides though. Your awareness of the inherent wrongness of reality means that it disgusts you, inspiring a longing for the Void and a deep urge to unmake reality, spurred by your disdain for its twisted shape. You can resist this urge with some effort, but in the beginning doing so will require most of your power and focus. Resisting the urge becomes easier with time, but this does not change the fact that it will always exist.
objects.title: Void Revelation

objects.text:
Your ability mutated to work in reverse, allowing you to convert living beings into objects. You can choose what they transform into, and can shift this at will. 

Moreover, they’ll be indistinguishable from Living Objects themselves, as you and they become capable of shifting their living forms as well as their object form at will. Those you affect get the innate loyalty to you as normal living objects do.

This effect can be applied to anyone that consents, at any distance or through any medium, even through mediums such as video call. If they don’t consent, you merely need to touch them in order to affect them. 

If they have abilities, their abilities can be reflected in their object form, and their wielders will be able to utilize it as you wish. The power’s manifestation and expression can alter depending on what form they’re using.
objects.title: Transmutation of Life

addons.text:
Your Shard or Inner Beast mutated into a fledging monster of Eldritch proportions, inheriting the traits of The Thing from The Stars, fully deviating their usual abilities to something inconceivable: temporal paradoxes materializing creatures from times past and futures, labyrinthian dimensional landscapes, and distortions across reality, capabilities far beyond a Shard, barely an Entity, finds it possible. 

That’s not all, as your Shard or Inner Beast remade, not a cell of a Worm or a facet of yourself, but an Egg. A Cosmic Horror in gestation, with the Heart as the parentage, once maturing it will compare to its progenitor in power. So instead of hosting the Heart of Darkness, your Shard or Inner Beast takes over the role of the Eldritch resident, retaining all the powers with a higher potential for exotic and higher-dimensional capabilities. Particularly for your Inner Beast, a part of you is touched by this enigmatic nature that obviously extends to your other powers entailing a change in nature to abilities that weren’t either unworldly or abstract to being with, essentially developing budding conceptual traits within them i.e. Imagination Power now has to chance to evolve into a fully manifestation of one’s desires, thoughts, and emotions given that you imagine it.
addons.title: The Sleeping Comet (Darkest Dungeon)

objects.text: Nyarlathotep’s fragment, The God of the Depths’ rotting remains and your knack for magic from the beyond has attracted something from Beyond… Under the bowels of the World, there exists a beating Heart, palpitating just as it did millions of years ago during Humanity’s creation. It writhes and spasms underneath the Earth and it’s calling for you: The Heart of Darkness, with a flash of unearthly vision, has sunk its claws into your soul. You unwittingly become a Host for the Heart of Darkness, now capable of mighty and terrible deeds of cosmic proportions. This manifests in visions, forbidden knowledge that is nearly unfathomable if not for your “backer’s” favor shielding you from much of the insight’s mental ravages. The insights deform the mind through the Heart's own Bed of Procrustes, expanding its paltry limitations to show the true reality of existence. This knowledge is demonstrated as a talent in the Dark and Eldritch arts, fueled by the Heart’s ungodly power. It can additionally be used to turn people insane, breaking their minds by hearing things they aren’t meant to know. The corruption you could spread through The God of Depths' traces, now may spread true Darkness through the lands and skies, bringing forth abominations in all possible forms of life or unlife, themselves further propagating your Darkness in the manner that you wish, and inviting dark gods and monstrous things from beyond the veil to do your bidding. The population in areas affected by your Darkness worships and is corrupted by you. These cults revere and sacrifice offerings to their Lord, steadily calling for their Lord’s presence; the more your Darkness spreads, and the more that is sacrificed in the Heart’s name, the more the realm of the Heart, the Darkest Dungeon, comes closer to your world. This is both an empowering and dehumanizing experience, as it strengthens your powers over the Eldritch and Unholy. However, there is a chance of succumbing to the Flesh if you aren’t careful to safeguard your soul. The Darkness inflicts constant Stress onto any unfortunate souls in your domain that you choose, a constant mental strain over everything and everyone that can have fatal consequences.
objects.title: A Change of Heart (Darkest Dungeon)

objects.text:
Your connection to the Heart is carved upon your brow as a symbol, a symbol representing the alien logic of The Heart; The Iron Crown. The Iron Crown is a mysterious symbol present in the mythos of every ancient civilization across the globe. It is a pattern, a formula, a mark, all in one. It signifies the very equation the world & existence builds upon as a bedrock. Its existence is a permanent scar on the human mind, our inheritance from those foolish civilizations who grasped for things that mankind was not meant to know. It is a mocking reflection, telling our whole species exactly how far we were meant to venture from our dark island of ignorance. 

But you are no longer so limited, your connection to The Heart surpassing those long-dead sorcerers. Using your thoughts and feelings, you can shape reality to your whims and deepest desires, imprinting your mind upon reality itself. This also affects your original powers as well: your understanding of the natural and unnatural world & your connection to The Heart is deepened, corrupting reality itself. You are the origin of myriad dark beings, made from every all-too-human weakness you've since moved beyond, the bile of human decrepitude congealing into worthy servants for your new might.
objects.title: The Darkened Coronal (Darkest Dungeon)

objects.text: You are not just any being—you are the chosen Architect. As the Architect, your mastery of both science and magic is unparalleled. You are a multiversal savant of unmatched skill, having attained the Fifth Degree in all twelve disciplines of Magic and Science. With this mastery, you are capable of creating wonders beyond imagination. You can recreate anything and everything within the Ouroboros CYOA, including even the most extraordinary concepts such as Natural Potentials, the Demiurges—without being limited to a single one—and the greatest achievement of all: the Ouroboros Loop, through which eternal paradise can be realized. In addition to this mastery, you have gained all personal alterations available in the CYOA at their highest levels. Among these are: The Philosopher’s Stone, which removes all physical needs, grants immunity to toxins, diseases, and genetic disorders, bestows infinite life, and provides minor godhood. The Nonmercurial Mind, which protects you from insanity, time alterations, boredom, forgetfulness, stress, mental scarring, and any form of direct or indirect mental manipulation. Alchemical Metamorphosis, allowing you to alter your body into any shape, form, or function without limit—provided it is not of cosmic or otherwise egregious size. Seraphic Pulchritude, which bestows upon you a beauty so profound that even gods are captivated by your presence. This divine beauty extends to all aspects of your being—your body, mind, and soul. Furthermore, you have the ability to share lesser aspects of these personal alterations with others. You can grant them immortality, immunity to mental effects, the ability to reshape their forms, or enhanced beauty. If you wish, you may also tone down any of these effects to a lesser degree or their most basic form. Architect, the universe itself is your canvas and your marble. Shape it according to your desire!
objects.title: The Architect (Ouroboros CYOA)

objects.text: You are an aberration—an anomaly, possessing not one, but two Origins. Choose another Origin to be awakened. If your Origins share a connection in some way, then the resulting powers are likely to mesh and combine in unexpected ways.
objects.title: Dual Origin

objects.text:
It's not enough to be cool, you must assert your position as the coolest! 

Now on top of an upgraded ability to wield Rule of Cool much more effectively and spot more opportunities for it, you know how to make others bend the knee because of it. This manifests in a variety of ways but all of them lead to the same result, provoking some form of intense reaction, or stripping the morale of your victims through sheer embarrassment and degradation. 

For example, showing visible signs of not taking your opponent seriously can send them into a blind rage at such brazen arrogance, giving you the opportunity to land a decisive blow. Another is baiting someone into a sense of superiority over you, only to crush that worth with a single display of raw, unnatural talent at whatever sport or game you're competing in. It can even be used to make someone fall for a ruse that they otherwise wouldn't have.

You can also use this the inverse way to inspire allies with newfound courage or for more neutral endeavours like public speaking. Overall, you've learned to weaponize your coolness for various psychological, practical, and social benefits.
objects.title: Taunt Button!

objects.text:
You don’t just look cool—you thrive on it. Your power is now directly tied to your aura, the intangible force that makes badasses look effortlessly dominant. The stronger your aura, the stronger you become. Every cold stance, every dramatic one-liner, every moment you exude overwhelming presence feeds into your power, enhancing all your abilities and physical parameters. When your aura is immaculate, you operate on an entirely different level—speed, strength, reflexes, and skill all scale up with how much of an absolute menace you appear to be.

However, this power is fickle. If you start losing your cool—fumbling an attack, getting caught off guard in an uncool way, or, god forbid, looking awkward—your aura dwindles, taking your buffs down with it. Though you will never drop below your base strength, maintaining your power requires an unbroken streak of sheer presence.

Whether you radiate untouchable elegance, overwhelming intimidation, or ruthless efficiency, your every move will command attention. The battlefield is your stage, and as long as you keep the audience enthralled, your strength will only continue to rise.
objects.title: Aura Farmer

objects.text:
It’s all well and good to consider yourself cool, but if no one else is impressed by you then all of your showing off is just embarrassing. Now you can get external feedback to make sure you really are cool, and get a bigger power boost in the process.

Your aura now treats the attention of others in-universe as a power source in addition to that of the intangible audience you were playing to before. By impressing an individual into acknowledging you as someone to be respected or feared you add a fraction of their power to your own, which can be further boosted by the multiplier your aura farming gives you. Not only do you get an overall power increase proportional to the power of your “fans,” you can also gain new abilities based on the abilities they have, adapted to fit your power source and aesthetic. You won’t be directly copying the powers of others, but as long as they acknowledge your power you will be able to pull off similar stunts to them, starting at a fraction of their ability but potentially surpassing them with enough aura.

If you ever achieve a 100% approval rating, becoming someone universally seen as a force to be reckoned with by people in-universe and out, the combined boosts from every being would be enough to make you the objective strongest being in the setting without exceptions. Of course, if they start to doubt you again you will weaken, potentially losing this status.
objects.title: Approval Rating

objects.text:
You aren’t just doing things in a way that is cool anymore, you have tapped into Grandeur - The Law of the Epic.

The bigger and more flashy your actions are, the greater the enhancement to their intended effect. Throw a giant fireball? It might burn like the fires of hell.

Make a wide, flashy swing with a cheap iron blade? That swing will have enough strength to fell an oak tree.

But this extends to more than just direct actions. Build a massive mega-factory? The products it produces will be peerless.

Organize a war that spans an entire continent? It will be less costly and more effective than if you had just prepared a series of campaigns to take that same territory.

Build a giant wall to protect your city? Not only will it be nigh-unbreakable, it will protect all it covers from outside harm!

Your Time, your Effort, your Resources, all that you poured into your works, shall make them rise to ever greater heights. Go big or go home, for Grandeur will accept nothing less…
objects.title: Grandeur (Into The Cardboard Realm)

objects.text:
Have you ever seen your favorite characters do things completely divorced from their character, logic, physics or just common sense, just to goof and since it got a laugh out of you, thought nothing of it? This power is the embodiment of this license, being capable of doing anything, no matter how nonsensical, irrational or absurd, as long as you’re funny enough to pull off said stunt.

Your cartoonish abilities grow in context, further from the touted slapstick, instead of personally applying to your physiology turning you in a cartoon personification, your powers aren’t weakened outside of your cartoon form, what’s more, your power affects anything exploitable for fun and games, even the very “scene” isn’t unscathed from your power’s zaniness and drive to make fun of everything, including itself.

Pesky and inane nuisances like logic, physics, or the very story or universe itself are mere guidelines to just shrug off injuries to ridiculous degrees short of nonexistence, perform deeds so absurd others might question the reality they live in for such things to occur, incite worldwide changes and warping the world’s tone to a world gone mad from either chaos or outlandishness at the drop of a hat, and control narrative conventions from breaking the 4th Wall as well as interacting with it, are among the things you might imagine or think of using this power (or do a cursory glance on TV Tropes or any of those sites putting their time and money on this topic).

The only limitation is that it only works if something you do is funny or you find it funny; how sharp your wit and sense of humor are keenly determines how strong this is.
objects.title: Rule of Funny

addons.text:
You are not from some upstart boss on some newbie planet, no, you are the boss of a more advanced planet comparable to one of the main planets under the Godoran Civilization. As a boss of a planet under a star system grade civilization, you have a higher initial power and a deeper understanding of your super system.

You are now a grade B super with B-grade energy reserves. You also gained another seven advanced knowledge on your super knowledge tree, which, like your other knowledge, is fully mastered.

More importantly, you gain the potential to develop molding talents naturally. This type of ability is reserved only for NPCs within the world of The Legendary Mechanic, but your boss template allows you to possess it.

You begin with the molding talent [Basic Strengthened Life] which is the source of your abnormally high HP, you possess 150% higher HP than you otherwise would.
addons.title: Galactic Backbone

objects.text:
You aren't some tutorial boss for the hero to play around with; you're an actual threat now. Your health bar is also something to brag about now as it's now an impressive size. Get good at using it, and most people will be a mess after you're done with them.

You are a cut above the rest now. You couldn't be classified as normal anymore, as all of your stats are comfortably above what the average could achieve. Your health is even greater as well, making you have twice as much health.

Your second phase can also be accessed now at 50% HP, instead of 40%. It amps you by 30% instead of what it originally did. Accessing your second phase will also give you a new passive ability, depending on your theme. Being a brute for example, could have you gain the ability to regenerate.
objects.title: First Real Boss

addons.text:
You are the boss of a planet under a star cluster-level civilization, not some backwater star system-level civilization. This once again boosts your power and understanding of your super system even further.

You are now a grade B+ super with B+ grade energy reserves. You are oh so very close to the Calamity grade, also known as A grade, only two thousand Ona away. You also gain the remaining seven advanced knowledge and a single high-end knowledge from your super knowledge tree. This knowledge, like the rest, is fully mastered.

Your [Basic Strengthen Life] has evolved into [Intermediate Strengthen Life], which enhances your maximum health by 7.5x or 750% amplifying your cockroach-like vitality even further.
addons.title: Nearly there

objects.text:
Nobody is fucking with you anymore; you're the one fucking them over. Your health bar is so big now that you could use it as a weapon itself. You would be equivalent to a general of the Demon King of a generic fantasy.

Your stats are truly incredible, not even an army could reasonably contest your strength now. You could fight on equal grounds against a sandbagging Endbringer in pure stats. Your HP is 5x what it normally would be, truly making you one tough cookie to crack. You gain a high resistance to one kind of effect on top of your natural resistances, like slashing damage or poison. Whatever it is, it's your choice. You can't change your decision afterwards.

Your second stage is now at 60%, but still the same as the previous upgrade. You have now obtained a third stage as well, which you access at 30% of your health. You will experience an additional 45% gain in stats and an additional active ability, that again will complement you. This ability will be a powerful one, equivalent to 10 SP.
objects.title: Mid Game Boss

addons.text:
Rejoice, for you are the boss responsible for a planet under a super star cluster-level civilization. This once again boosts your initial power and understanding of your super system.

You are an early-stage Grade A super with early-stage A-grade energy reserves. You are now capable of wiping out all life on the surface of most planets in a handful of days, depending on your ability, without outside interference from someone as strong or stronger than yourself. You are a calamity given flesh, a world-ending threat most civilizations would hesitate to face.

You obtain another seven high-end knowledge from your super knowledge tree, like the rest of your knowledge this is fully mastered as well.

Your [Intermediate Strengthen Life] has evolved into [Advanced Strengthen Life], which enhances your maximum health by 15x or a whole 1500% this leaves you proactively unkillable by conventional means even someone like Black Star would seem fragile compared to you.

You can choose a broader immunity, such as [True Damage Immunity].
addons.title: Calamity of The A

objects.text:
Oh yeah, that's a big health bar. It's so big, you could use it like a helicopter. Your HP is now 10x that of what it was previously, giving you a real edge against other big health bars. You would be the right-hand man of the Demon King himself.

Your stats are now off the charts. No mundane weapon could even give you any lasting damage. In pure stats, you can start matching against an Endbringer at full power. You obtain moderate resistance to everything, and you become immune to your choice of resistance. It must be at least somewhat specific, like slashing damage or poison.

You don't have a fourth stage, but you do gain a new feature: you only reach your next stage by reaching 0% of your HP. When this happens, you will do a total recovery with a dramatic effect around you. Any stat gains from your stages will be increased by 10% for each on top of your previous ones. You also obtain secondary abilities that, while minor, will have to force your enemy to alter their strategy. For example, you can gain extra range on your attacks, making you hit your enemies when your attack was nowhere close to hitting them. Or perhaps you can occasionally obtain a burst of speed.

You go back to your first stage with your current HP when you are out of combat.
objects.title: Late Game Boss

addons.text:
You are strong enough to be the ruler of star clusters on your own, with only beyond A grades and the universal civilizations capable of matching you.

You have reached the endpoint of grade A, with energy reserves barely scratching the roof of grade A. You are now someone even the current universal civilizations would keep track of.

You obtain the last seven high-end knowledge in addition to a single cutting-edge knowledge from your super knowledge tree; like the rest of your knowledge, this knowledge is fully mastered.

Your [Advanced Strengthen Life] has evolved into [High Strengthen Life], which enhances your maximum health by 25x or a whole 2500%. At this point, you are indestructible in all but name; even a Beyond A Grade would struggle to injure you in any noticeable way.

With your last phase, you are capable of temporarily breaching into the Beyond A Grade, amplifying your power by horrifying levels. Even if this is temporary, it enhances you to the point of being one of the strongest individuals in the known universe.
addons.title: Beyond A Grade Seed

objects.text: You are no longer just an obstacle in the hero’s journey—you are the final test, the one they’ve been preparing for all along. You have ascended beyond a mere boss and become something else entirely. You are the endgame. Your health pool is now 15x what it normally would be. It's so big, you could comfortably wipe a football field clean in it's entirety. Your body is a battlefield, your health bar a fortress. No matter what they throw at you, you will still be standing. Your stats have reached the peak of what’s considered possible. Your power is a force of nature; your speed is beyond perception; your durability is something even legends would struggle to match. Your resistances have also evolved. You go from a moderate resistance to high resistance. You obtain three immunities; while you can choose it initially, your immunities can change to what is actively being used against you after a few minutes. Your transformations have reached their final peak. It now grants you a 50% boost to all your stats and abilities for the second stage. The passive ability you received from First Real Boss also grows stronger. If it was regeneration, it’s now twice as fast; if it was an elemental boost, its potency has doubled. Whatever it was, it is now something even greater. When you reach your third phase, your stats are amplified by 75%, and your active ability from Mid Game Boss evolves into something even stronger, now equivalent to a 15 SP power. You also gain a new passive ability that fits your theme, something that further cements your role as the final challenge. Maybe weaker enemies lose their ability to fight in your presence, maybe every step you take warps the battlefield, or maybe reality itself bends to accommodate your strength. And finally, you have one last phase. If your enemies manage to push you this far, every single one of your stats and abilities will double, making you an unstoppable force of destruction. On top of that, you gain one final ability, something worth 20 SP—something that defines you as the final boss. Perhaps you become unkillable, unable to be slain unless incredibly specific conditions are met. Or perhaps you gain an attack so devastating, it can erase entire cities, leaving nothing but ruin in its wake. This wouldn’t be complete without a lair worthy of your status. Whether it’s a floating fortress, a ruined wasteland, or a palace bathed in darkness, you now have a domain that strengthens you. This is your realm—the place where you make your final stand, the stage where your legend will be written. You are no longer just a boss. You are The Final Boss.
objects.title: The Final Boss

addons.text:
You are capable of ruling over vast segments of galaxies on your own, no longer subordinate to others. Your power allows you to act as you see fit in the universe. If you want to rule, then nobody can stop you, or if sleeping in some cave is the depths of your ambitions, then no one can meaningfully object.

You have broken through the last barrier to reach the Beyond A Grade. You are now a grade S super with S-grade energy reserves. Your Ona is a little above 33000, leaving you in the bottom bracket of S-grade. Even so, you are one of the most powerful individuals in the known universe.

You obtain the eight cutting-edge knowledge you lack and three ultimate skills from your super knowledge tree. This knowledge, like the rest of your knowledge, is fully mastered.

You gain another molding talent [Advanced Lucky Glow]. This increases the probability of beneficial or lucky things happening to you by a large amount, enough so that your abnormally high luck is noticeable to others.
addons.title: Beyond A Grade

objects.text: You were never meant to be found. Long after the hero has bled their way to the end, long after they’ve climbed the mountain and slain the Final Boss, they think the journey is over. That they’ve won. That the world is safe. But they never saw you—because you didn’t let them. You are the Hidden Boss, the silent end, the architect of despair that watches from the void beyond endings. Your base strength is no longer what it once was. Everything the Final Boss had to build up to, you now possess by default. Your base stats equal the Final Boss’s final phase and you have access to all the powers you would have in that phase at base. Your second stage now boosts your stats and abilities by 75%, and you gain two additional adaptive immunities—five in total now. Your third stage doubles your power and you gain yet another passive ability, based off your theme and highly synergistic with your first passive ability. Your fourth stage boosts your stats by 150%, with your powers from before now each gaining five unique sub-powers. These offshoots function at a fifth of the strength of the original, but each one grants a new form and function. A firestorm may gain flame clones, burning terrain, heat-based lasers, fire bombs, and armor-melting strikes. But what is power without subjects? Your leadership has become something beyond mortal comprehension. Those who serve you do not remain weak for long. Your goons begin at the level of a Tutorial Boss and only grow stronger the longer they serve your will. Time spent in your shadow elevates them—they will progress toward higher-tier Boss templates, with diminishing speed as they reach high levels. Those around you long enough can be promoted into lieutenants and be designated roles, giving your inner circle theme-based buffs, like regenerating near you or sharing resistances. And of course, no one sees you coming. You can hide every aspect of your strength—your stats, your phases, your immunities, your aura. Only the most potent divinations will see your true power. You can appear as a common man, a fading memory, or nothing at all. You are not the final challenge. You are the one no one knew was playing the game. You are the Hidden Boss.
objects.title: The Hidden Boss

addons.text:
The effects of Copy Palette now extend to your Helpers, allowing you to fuse and and split them apart in real time, resulting in a perfect fusion and/or upgraded version of their represented abilities. You can't absorb these fusions for yourself, only one aspect of them. (The other gets reformed as a Helper). Cinematics and dramatic flair is optional.

Additionally, you can also bestow your Inhale or Copy Abilities to others besides your Helpers. You are fully aware of everyone with them, their location, current abilities and can take them back at will.
addons.title: Star Aliies

objects.text:
Upon storing or gaining a copy ability, you can sacrifice it to create a Helper. These cutesy companions gain all of the power of your chosen ability and are unwaveringly loyal to you. So much so, that they’d take a bullet for you with no hesitation. Don't worry, it's painless and they'll be in stasis until you summon them again. 

By default they are silent and emotive, but speech and fully realized personalities can be added. Whether they develop on their own, or you skew them to your liking is your choice. While their expertise lies in their powers and basic common sense, other skills can be learned as well. 

You can absorb a Helper to regain the copy ability they represent, and can redesign them for various purposes. Wheelie could be a car instead of a motorcycle, Burning Leo could be a lion, Sir Kebble as a knight on horseback, or Knuckle Joe as a walking Bruce Lee reference.
objects.title: Helpers (Kirby)

addons.text:
Your copy abilities aren't just one note gimmicks, but ever evolving seeds of power, growing and improving alongside you every step of the way. Simply using a copy ability, finding creative applications for it, or even a highly compatible fusion can cause breakthroughs that evolve them into more powerful forms. 

Your normal “Bomb” ability can improve to produce explosives that home in on targets, or cause a chain reaction of explosions, “Sword” can grant you a shield on top of a stronger and larger sword, “Ice” can allow you to make living constructs of snowmen, “Fire” can let you produce flames that rival that of a dragon and fly, even “Sleep” gains a use by restoring you to full health and granting a buff in less than a few seconds.

This is merely a fraction of what your powers can become, as they can continuously evolve beyond that. You can also “Downgrade” and “Upgrade” throughout the different Tiers of your abilities if you wish, can't go wrong with the classics after all.
addons.title: Evolved Abilities

objects.text:
Your copy abilities gain an astronomical increase in potential, being accessed either by successfully inhaling a “Super” version of an enemy, or by sacrificing at least 2 of your other abilities into one, resulting in the creation of a Super Ability. 

Such as the iconic “Ultra Sword” to slice and obliterate almost any obstacle in your way with ease, the “Monster Flame” to summon a giant dragon, the “Flare Beam” to shoot massive balls of destructive energy, the “Snow Bowl” to become a one man avalanche of doom, and the Grand Hammer that has the potential to cause gargantuan shockwaves and craters that threaten the very earth. 

You’re not limited to just these, every ability you own can reach these heights. With the catch of only being usable for a limited time, with a reasonable cooldown afterwards before you can do this again. 

You can extend the timer by sacrificing more abilities and/or Starspit. Helpers also count as sacrifices.
objects.title: Super Abilites (Kirby)

objects.text:
You find yourself perched upon the zenith of power, having inherited a legacy that resonates through the ages—the indomitable forces of the first and second Shadow Monarchs. Even those that they have since parted with, such as the likes of Min Byung-Gyu, Kamish, or Iron. Within the depths of your shadows lies an unyielding army, an ethereal cadre of countless shades that never wane in their dedication or strength. An undead legion made up of every Shadow that Sung Jinwoo and the Ashborn have resurrected.

Each member of this spectral battalion is a living testament to the enduring strength and unbreakable spirit of warriors forged in the fires of history. They materialize from the very fabric of the past, meticulously extracted and awakened by the first and second Shadow Monarchs. These shadows are far more than mere phantoms; they are the haunting echoes of fierce warriors who displayed unmatched courage on the battlegrounds of old, lying in wait, steadfast and resolute for the summons of their rightful leader.

With such colossal power at your command, you stand ready to sculpt the destiny of realms, wielding a legion that knows no fatigue, no slumber and is eternally bound to your will alone. As you prepare to invoke their strength, the air around you crackles with promise, and the weight of your heritage settles upon your shoulders like a mantle, affirming your role as the ultimate Inheritor of the title Shadow Monarch.
objects.title: Legion of Shadows (Solo Leveling)

objects.text:
The connection to the Heroverse through the H-Dial has resonated with Drawing Creation allowing for another means of drawing upon the power of Heroes, Comic Books.

By drawing and writing comic books you can summon heroes to fight alongside you; both those from the H-Dial allowing you to summon previous transformations and your own original creation Heroes.

The requirements to make these Hero Comics is pretty straightforward, they must be a minimal of 32 pages of story content explaining the Hero's Origin, their personality, feats, powers and a sense of the world they live in and other things you would expect in a First Issue or One Shot introducing a new Hero. Once created whoever wields the Hero Comic, known as a Reader, can summon the Hero who will follow their Reader's orders. The Reader supplies the summoned Hero with power, whether through some internal energy reserves or through their physical and mental stamina.

Hero Comics are indestructible when you use them but can be destroyed when used by others, they can survive being used in the middle of a chaotic battle through a mixture of self repairing and high durability but focused effort can lead to their destruction. Once a Hero Comic is destroyed the Hero is lost until you can remake the book by remembering said Hero, even if it's from just a feeling you can recreate a destroyed Hero Comic to restore the Hero, with H-Dial Heroes a Hero Comic's destruction is merely a lost of connection to the Heroverse but for your Original Heroes it's like being lost to Limbo.

There are a few restrictions to these Hero Comics, the first is the reliance on their Reader as should they be rendered unconscious or fall too weak and or ill to maintain the Hero they will return to their book and that the more powerful a Hero is the more it's needed to both summon and maintain them. Regarding said books they have to have a consistency to them in art and story, especially regarding the H-Dial Heroes as if your writing strays too far from what they are then all the work done on the comic will be undone as you left with a blank book. Meanwhile your original Heroes will start off weaker than H-Dial Heroes possessing no more than 10 SP of powers.

You are also limited to creating Heroverse Heroes you have transformed into previously so you can't make a Hero Comic for Superman unless you have transformed into Superman previously, and it would be limited to that version.

Even with these restrictions this is a power that cannot be underestimated as you can even empower these Heroes, imagining new feats for them or expanding upon powers to widen their arsenal by creating supplementary pages that can be absorbed into the books or through repeated use. These powers and feats must be reasonable and make sense in the Hero's own world, a Hero able to absorb any attack directed at them being able to use the gathered energy for a super attack is believable but randomly giving someone the power of an unrelated god is most certainly not, effectively expanding their powers and skills vertically and horizontally by 5 SP at most for each individual upgrade that requires a period of rest between each upgrade.

However this restriction is much lighter regarding your own Created Heroes as you have more freedom in their upgrades so long as it makes sense in universe and fits with their character.

Once you've sufficiently mastered the creation of Hero Comics you can even create a special type of Hero, Amalgam Heroes. Like the name implies it's a fusion of different Heroes containing the powers and skills of both with them building off one another that can possibly make the Amalgam Hero greater than their parts, however this is a more tricky technique as the Heroes in question must be complimentary, share some theme or possess a strong synergy as you are not just combining their powers your combining their stories. You can't just give Crying Man Super Scott's powers without combining their origin stories. Amalgam Heroes can either be a powerful transformation for your summoned Heroes or become their own entity given time.

These upgrades are not solely yours alone either as they can empower the original Hero through the Heroverse as moments of inspiration or appearing in times of great need, and your own created Heroes can be imprinted upon the Heroverse through their use allowing them and their worlds to become fully real beyond the comic you created them in and thus accessible through the H-Dial.
objects.title: Comicalize! ComicalCreate! (Hero Inside)

addons.text:
It seems that not even the death of the dreamer can end your dream anymore.

Should you die, you can slip into the Collective Unconscious or Non-Existence entirely.

While in such a state, you are still aware of what’s happening in the world you left behind, ready to pop up at an opportune moment if possible. You may also choose to be undetectable in such a state, as if you did not have a mind or soul to be found.

Or if there’s too much attention, maybe you’ll drift over to another world entirely only to later return bigger and better than before.
addons.title: Eternal Dream

objects.text:
You are a creature of Dreams, capable of limitlessly changing yourself.

You can even usurp what already exists, like a flowing river, someone’s words caught on the wind, or the haze of sleep that fog’s a person's brain. Being a flowing river could mean you could appear wherever it reaches when you stop, or make the current much stronger or weaker while someone's trying to cross it. 

Someone’s words could let you change the perception of what they said, altering how others interpret their meaning. And the haze of sleep could let you amplify someone’s exhaustion, turning mild tiredness into bone-deep weariness, ready for a nap or even causing them to pass out entirely.

But that is merely a taste of what you can do…

Belief is your weapon, but that cuts both ways. To draw anything beyond the limitless freedom of form, you must draw from the realm of the plausible, for reality itself has a level of belief - of how things should be, but on it’s own it is weak, only able to counter the most over the top expressions. For example you can become a tree, or even a forest all at once but trying to be everything, everywhere, all at once, or becoming a God will fail.

Of course there are ways around that, using doubt to weaken belief. If you went on a journey, who’s to say you couldn’t have learned how to do that? If your past is obscured, then revealing a ‘fact’ about you may change the present if they can’t completely deny it.

Or perhaps you subverted something that already was, for it is much harder to deny it if you have proof that it existed.

(With enough time and study, you may well be able to do anything. If you can spin the right tale…)
objects.title: Dreambreed (Into the Cardboard Realm)

objects.text:
Unfortunately your bond isn’t as complete as you’d like. Rather than acting as an infinite and internal emotional battery, the Avatar operates somewhat externally, more akin to a familiar occupying the same space. Similarly, the power it brings to bear is operated through the both of you, meaning that you may have to make a determined case as to why, for instance, a being of rage like The Butcher should intervene with a robbery.

Eventually, you should be able to reach the same level as a true emotional avatar, but this would require greater time acclimating to the strain they’d put on your body, as now they’re external the effect on your psyche and body from their presence would be otherwise lessened.
objects.title: Emotional Familiar

objects.text: Your power has grown beyond just talents and affinities. You now have the ability to measure someone's skill, mastery, and knowledge in a particular subject, along with how much each factor influences the overall measurement. Just like before, you can focus on their highest mastered skills, assess generalized abilities, or search for a specific skill.
objects.title: Skill Check

objects.text:
It seems you've gotten an expanded repertoire of abilities. First among this suite is the dual-layered force field, specifically designed to shield you as you soar through the skies at blistering speeds and dizzying altitudes.

The inner layer will act like a second skin, forming a protective cocoon that insulates you from extreme temperatures, maintaining a stable, comfortable, and breathable environment. While negating wind pressure, friction, and inertia, relieving your body from the intense G-forces of high-speed flight. Moreover, it'll store large amounts of air and oxygen within itself, allowing you to ascend into the upper troposphere and stratosphere without the need for any special equipment for extended periods.

That said, it's still wise to avoid climbing too high—as this won't guard you against radiation. As a bonus, however, it does keep your clothes and gear intact, preventing them from being torn apart during flight.

The outer layer forms a dynamic, directional barrier that constantly aligns itself with your trajectory. Extending roughly a meter ahead of you at the tip in a conical shape, this layer adapts to your speed and flight style, automatically shifting itself to suit subsonic, supersonic, or even hypersonic velocities—although you won't be reaching the latter speeds anytime soon, being limited to at most supersonic until you're skilled and tough enough to handle more, which may take you a few years.

Additionally, with time and consistent training, this barrier can be reinforced, increasing its durability and performance.

Furthermore, this outermost layer can even be weaponized—by ramming into targets at high velocity, you can slice or pierce through obstacles. However, colliding with exceptionally dense or solid objects is ill-advised, as excessive force may compromise or shatter the barrier.

Complimenting and rounding all of this out is your new, rudimentary control over the wind—which you can use to grant quick bursts of speed or fine-tune your movements in the air. With it, you're able to maneuver with far greater precision and agility, cutting through the skies with far less resistance.
objects.title: Soar

addons.text:
You're now capable of entering a deep state of suspended animation, enabling you to cross vast stretches of space with minimal effort or awareness. Once you've mentally charted a destination and set a course, your body and powers take over—automatically guiding you through space as you remain in hibernation. This self-piloting function maintains your trajectory and momentum without requiring conscious input.

Although mostly autonomous, you may occasionally need to wake briefly to review your route and make minor course corrections.

During this dormant state, your energy consumption drops significantly, and even the aging process effectively is put on pause. Needing to only wake every few months for basic sustenance before returning to stasis. In essence, your body functions like an internal autopilot system, letting you rest while still making steady progress across the stars.

Perfect for long-range travel, deep space exploration, or surviving interstellar voyages with minimal wear and tear.
addons.title: Deep Space Travel – Suspended Animation Auto-Pilot

addons.text:
Through the interplay of your powers, you've instinctively learned to manipulate gravity wells to aid your movement—less a skill you developed, more an ability that awakened within you. By subtly warping spacetime, you mimic the principles of an Alcubierre drive, using gravitational fields to propel yourself forward.

While initially weak, this form of propulsion strengthens with practice, eventually allowing you to push past the light-speed barrier in real space by riding the very curvature of spacetime itself.

In addition, the synergy between your abilities has awakened an intrinsic sense of gravitational flow. You now instinctively perceive how gravity bends, warps, and interacts with the environment—not just on you but on everything around you. An awareness that extends to even sensing the elusive, theoretical graviton particles, enhancing both your navigation through space and the advancement of your gravity-based abilities.

You've also learned to project a personal gravity field around yourself—serving as both a secondary defense layer and a way to simulate planetary gravity. Shielding your body from the long-term effects of zero-g, allowing your physiology to function as if still grounded, and making you perfectly attuned for deep space traversal.
addons.title: Newton's Defiance

addons.text:
You've unlocked the ability to absorb energy from cosmic rays and stellar winds, greatly enhancing your existing powers. This upgrade also transforms your once-rudimentary wind control to allow you to "ride" upon cosmic winds even in deep space.

By harnessing the flow of stellar and cosmic particles, you can produce a continuous amount of passive auxiliary propulsion—as your outer force field unfurls into a massive, concave disc, catching and deflecting incoming energy to generate passive thrust, whilst your inner field absorbs and repurposes that same energy into concentrated jets of high-energy radiation. Together, they effectively turn you into a hybrid solar sail-ion engine.

The denser the surrounding stellar wind, the more velocity and momentum you can build. In regions like a star's corona, this effect becomes especially potent, allowing for bursts of speed far exceeding your previous capabilities.

Moreover, the more stellar wind energy you gather or ride upon, the more powerful, resilient, optimized, and efficient your force fields become. Resulting in a continuous feedback loop that, at full tilt, turns you into a blazing, energy-surfing juggernaut drifting on the tides of the cosmos.
addons.title: Cosmic Wind Surfer

addons.text:
You've gained the ability to access an alternate hyperdimensional space—a sort of shortcut through the cosmos. By identifying and entering specific routes or entry points, you can momentarily slip into this hyperspace, allowing you to cross vast distances in a fraction of the time it would take in real space. What once took days, months, years can now take only moments.

However, these hyperspace lanes aren't always straightforward. The routes can be unpredictable, nonlinear, and difficult to map. Taking the wrong path could cause you to exit in the wrong location—overshooting, undershooting, or even ending up somewhere entirely unintended. Navigating it safely requires a great deal of caution, awareness, knowledge, and mastery—which you'll gain in time.
addons.title: Slipping Into The Unknown

objects.text:
Your power has evolved again, shattering the last chains that once held it back, transforming you into a true voyager of the stars. As a result, all of your previous abilities have gotten an upgrade—making it so your inner force field is no longer just used for storing air or shielding you from gravity, wind pressure, friction, and inertia.

It now allows you to survive without needing air at all while fully protecting you from all forms of radiation, effectively making you immune. You're also unaffected by sudden pressure changes, meaning you can move from Earth to the vacuum of space—or worse—and remain perfectly fine.

Your speed and acceleration have also reached new levels. You can now go from zero to hypersonic in an instant, reaching speeds around Mach 5 to 10. Note that this is fast enough to ignite the air around you through friction, turning it into plasma that'll wrap around your form and generate powerful shockwaves to shake buildings as you fly past.

Despite the intensity, this speed puts no strain on your body, thanks to the enhanced strength of both your inner and outer force fields. Your outer layer, in particular, is now strong enough to allow you to crash through multiple skyscrapers in a row at these speeds without injury.

With enough unimpeded momentum, you can go even faster. Capable of consistently reaching and maintaining high hypersonic speeds—upwards of Mach 33, roughly close to the maximum speed achieved by the Saturn V rocket in the Apollo 11 mission. Unfortunately, this is your current soft limit, but with training and refinement, you'll be able to push that boundary even further.
objects.title: Breach

addons.text:
You're no longer limited to forcefully tearing your way into hyperspace. Now, you can sense and access natural faults, routes, and entry points scattered throughout the cosmos along the fabric of space.

Due to some strange circumstances, hyperspace now welcomes you with open arms, creating a connection between you and it.

This newfound connection grants you an intrinsic awareness of hyperspace itself—an almost instinctual ability to feel its flow, navigate its currents, and chart its ever-shifting terrain. With this heightened sensitivity, you're able to traverse hyperspace with far greater accuracy and confidence, rarely losing your way as you map and master this strange dimension.
addons.title: Threading the Unknown

objects.text:
By one way or another, you've awakened a new ability—one that lets you disassemble your body into a stream of particles and light, propelling yourself at sub-light to near-light speeds. In this form, you become a blur—intangible and untouchable—capable of moving at velocities far beyond your previous limits. However, using this places a tremendous strain on both your body and mind.

Once activated, you lose all maneuverability, locked into a straight-line trajectory with no way to steer or course-correct. Higher cognitive functions will also begin to fade, leaving only your most basic awareness until you reach a point where you'll naturally exit the form. Thus, sustaining this state for more than a few seconds requires intense training and discipline. Thankfully, the strain is proportional to your speed, allowing you to build up from sub-light gradually to near-light as you adapt.

While in this state, you'll harmlessly phase through matter, leaving your surroundings undisturbed. Upon returning to your physical form, all momentum is instantly canceled without any adverse effects on you or the environment—making it appear to onlookers as if you had teleported.

And if you manage to sustain near-light speeds for ten consecutive seconds, you'll forcefully breach into hyperspace—an alternate dimension layered atop real space. Within this realm, your body reforms, and your full consciousness returns. Still traveling at incredible speed, you can now navigate hyperspace lanes—natural currents and pathways that let you bypass the typical constraints of real-space travel.

By using these routes, you can traverse distances that would have otherwise taken light-years in just a few moments. But hyperspace is unpredictable. Its paths twist and turn, non-linear in nature, and spiral in ways that don't always make sense, and exiting without recklessly could leave you reappearing stranded in deep space, inside a star, or worse.

Fortunately, the "shadows" of massive celestial bodies are visible in hyperspace, giving you some guidance—but mastery over these currents will take time, skill, and caution.
objects.title: Luminal Shift

objects.text: You now have access to three pairs of abilities: Shield and Slowness; Heal and Cure; and finally Randomizer and Bomb. From each pair you can only have one slotted and can freely change which ones, though during battle you temporarily lose the capacity to change which one you will use, so choose carefully. Each ability has a cooldown with the exception of Shield. Shield creates a circular forcefield at a direction of your choice that can stop all damage and will even flip the attempt at damage into healing instead, though the healing is only 1/3 of what the damage would've done—unfortunately it can only be used continuously for 10 seconds and only regenerates when spent, so it must be used in bursts, fortunately when spent it will explode with the force of a grenade so it still can drive away a enemy; 1 second is recovered every 5 seconds. Slowness slows time to a point you could dodge a bullet due to it barely moving from its position; cooldown is 10 seconds. Heal will undo damage done to you—be it to your soul, mind or body—, the more damaged you are the more effective it will be—being at death's door would completely heal you while a paper cut would become slightly smaller. Cure will get rid of all ailments—poisons, diseases, parasites and etc—and even kill sources of ailments within range—and influences—like magics that force you to feel a emotion—, it also heals you a bit everytime its used. Randomizer causes all shapes within your range to be changed to the same very simple random shape, though they keep their durability; the cooldown is 10 seconds, though it's reduced to 7 if you have more than 3 opponents in your range. Bomb acts as all possible drawings and instantly kills the opponents regardless of whether its drawings where hidden or how much durability it had; the cooldown is 30 seconds, though it's reduced to 25 if you have more than 5 opponents in your range.
objects.title: Abilities (Divineko)

addons.text:
Your cosmetics now come with small to medium benefits when equipped—those benefits may or may not fit with the cosmetic they are from. Things like red hair slightly increasing your resistance to fire, or black gloves with skulls allowing you to affect more enemies with the same shape simultaneously, or even wings capable of flight.

You also no longer need to chose one ability within each of the three pairs of Abilities, being capable to use all of them simultaneously.
addons.title: Superpowered Cosmetics

objects.text:
As you go through battles you will gain cosmetics. Cosmetics are changes to your body or new clothing/accessories that don't actually give you much of a benefit—they may give small ones, a school uniform certainly would help with quickly getting dressed for example. Those cosmetics can even change things like the aesthetics of any powers you have, including the energy you use to draw.

Certain cosmetics will be a case of "one or the other"—like say red or green eye color—while others can simple fit into different places, like rings.
objects.title: Cosmetics (Divineko)

objects.text:
Your power has evolved, allowing you to grant even stronger abilities through your CYOAs, but at a much greater cost. Instead of the usual requirement of one hundred participants per charge, you can now create special “High Stakes” CYOAs, where individual options can be significantly stronger. However, for every 3 SP added beyond the usual power cap, the number of required participants increases five fold.

High Stakes charges function exactly like normal charges, allowing you to instantly mentally review all completed builds and choose one to make real. However, standard charges cannot be used for High Stakes builds, and High Stakes charges cannot be used for normal builds. Your storage capacity also remains unchanged, with a maximum of one hundred charges at any time, whether they are from High Stakes or normal builds.
objects.title: Going Viral

addons.text: Loyalty Insurance allows you to skip the first stage of the taming process with any creature you create. And Loyalty Insurance will also apply to any offspring of your domesticated creatures.
addons.title: Instinctual Loyalty

addons.text: Synergy with Seedbearer elevated the second stage of your taming process as now your presence passively increases the talents and capabilities of any tamed creatures you have. This effect has become so potent, it allows them to break into the territory of supernatural skills and elevate their pre-existing capabilities. A dog could track scents through an entire city, a cat could climb onto clouds and something inherently supernatural, like a dragon, could train its fire breath to the level its practically breathing anti-matter.
addons.title: Genius Menagerie

addons.text: Your ability as an esoteric farmer gives you the technical skills and knowledge to harvest and process any produce you can harvest from your creatures. You also gain the ability to train your creatures to produce exotic materials and resources with the chance for them to even gain a power for this purpose. A sheep could be trained to produce wool on par with Kevlar, or cows to produce milk which absorbs and cleanses radiation. And through several generations of training and selective breeding, you could turn a simple chicken into a small phoenix, laying eggs which revive the recently dead.
addons.title: Wondrous Livestock

addons.text:
Your tinker specialization allows you to automate the first two stages of taming. The efficiency and speed of the processes depend on how sophisticated the tools you made. This could range from simple tools like electric punishment collars to life-pods keeping them in a simulated training scenario.

This also heavily synergizes with other tinker specializations, like making symbiotes to tame your creatures or even making ball-shaped capture devices containing a folded space with time-accelerated taming facilities.
addons.title: Auto-Tamer

addons.text:
Upon reaching the second stage, you unlock the ability to transform your tamed creatures into formidable and majestic mounts. In this enhanced state, your creature temporarily shifts form, becoming ideally suited for riding. Whether through an increase in size, a change in shape, or both, their physical transformation aligns perfectly with your needs as a rider, ensuring both comfort and stability in motion.

This mount form grants a surge in power to the creature. The creature’s strength in this state is at minimum equal to their usual capabilities—with it usually it surpasses those base capabilities. The extent of this boost scales with the strength of your bond, meaning the closer your connection, the more potent the mount becomes. 

This transformation is not permanent. It is triggered solely while you are mounted, and the moment you dismount, the creature reverts to its natural form.
addons.title: Legendary Mount

objects.text:
Now you are no longer limited to animals, allowing you to tame any living creatures. Albeit the more intelligent creature, the more difficult it becomes to tame them. Your taming process can be broken down into a three-step procedure.

First is the taming procedure where you gain an instinctual knowledge of how to approach and gain the trust of said creature. Your power heavily assists in this step, as beyond the creatures you target finding you tolerable, you also heighten their ability to learn and develop mentally as long as it involves details about you and your actions. From the creature’s viewpoint, this feels like you are stuck in their mind, making them always think about you, with any memories involving you being much more vivid compared to anything else. For creatures of high intelligence, your power also brings out their more instinctual and animalistic side, allowing you to tame any creature. This stage can be sped up massively by synergizing master powers.

After you tamed a creature, you enter the training stage where you strengthen your bond and potentially awaken powers in them. You have some control over what powers they gain by training them in a specialized manner. At this stage, your effectiveness is heavily affected by your skills in teaching.

The final stage is domestication, in which your power imprints the results of the previous stages onto the creature’s genetics. This not only preserves the results of your taming and training but also makes them inheritable by the next generation. This also introduces genetic compatibility between all successfully domesticated creatures you have, allowing you to crossbreed them into chimaera-like creatures, or eventually entirely new species.
objects.title: Legendary Tamer

objects.text:
Keep tuning. Your connection to the Transmission has strengthened to the heights of its intermediary, the Thin Man.

All of your abilities have elevated to new heights. You can teleport without need for a screen at the range you formerly could, or between two screens anywhere in the world. Your control over space is at the level you could pull a skyscraper to your location from across a large city, and it now extends to minor manipulation of time as well. Reversing or travelling through time is beyond your power for now, but you can speed it up or slow it down in the area around you. Your capacity to control technology is no longer limited to using one device at a time, instead dominating any screened device in your area through thought.

Of course, such a close connection to the Transmission comes at a price; its hold on you is so great that you spread its influence merely by being present, exponentially more so when actively using it.
objects.title: The Thin Man (Little Nightmares)

objects.text: Tune in, viewers! You aren’t just an agent of the Transmission, you are the Transmission. You are present in any place there’s a screen, corrupting the world around you in accordance with your designs. Your control over the world around you has reached the point of practical reality-warping, capable of distorting countrysides into hellish landscapes, creating pocket dimensions of Escher-like architecture, mutating those who watch your broadcasts into monsters while enslaving their minds, and even creating worldwide stable time loops. Your influence will only grow stronger and spread as you continue to infect screens and consume those you’ve enthralled in your signal.
objects.title: The Signal Tower (Little Nightmares)

objects.text:
Your ability to make yourself intangible has developed into a purely conceptual power, no longer solely reliant on manipulating your molecular structure.

Now, you can control the degree to which anything interacts with you, whether matter, energy or fundamental forces such as gravity. With time and experience, this influence could grow further in scope to encompass even more abstract concepts such as memory, time or death itself.

Through this ability, you can be both intangible and tangible at once, selectively choosing what affects you and what does not. For example, you could remain untouchable to a foe while simultaneously reaching into their chest and gripping their heart in your hand. Alternatively, you could walk on air while ignoring gravity, moving freely through the sky.

This control is not limited to your body; you can project this influence outward. Initially this effect only extends to a radius of one metre around you, but it can expand substantially with practice and effort. Within this space, you have an innate awareness of all interactions and can determine which are permitted to engage.
objects.title: I Decide What Touches!

addons.text:
Just like your father, you have taken a portion of yourself and put it in the Perfect Weapon, creating your own Nullifier. When activated, this weapon can erase anything from existence: matter, energy, and even abstract concepts. Furthermore, thanks to the Perfect Weapon’s ability, you can alter the Nullifier’s shape and form, transforming it into any type of weapon while still channeling its devastating power.

With your power and mind, you can wield the Nullifier’s abilities to their fullest potential. You can selectively target and erase specific entities or elements from existence, obliterate entire areas without affecting anything outside your chosen parameters, and even generate a protective sphere around yourself that erases anything it touches as well as anything that dares to target you.
 
A unique aspect of your Nullifier, due to the influence of the Perfect Weapon, is that anyone can wield it, regardless of their intellect or will, so long as they have your permission. You can allow your friends, family, allies, or servants use the Nullfier, and they would wield the weapon perfectly, just as you would.

The Nullifier scales with your power. Unlike the Ultimate Nullifier wielded by your father, capable of erasing or altering the infinite multiverse, and killing the strongest cosmic beings in the Marvel universe, your Nullifier could, at most, obliterate a single universe or timeline, or erase an unsuspecting Celestial. However, as your power grows, so too will the Nullifier’s potential—until it may one day rival, or even surpass, that of your father’s.
addons.title: Your Nullfier

objects.text:
You are now the second child of Galactus, a younger, less powerful echo of your father’s vast might. Where he could destroy an entire multiverse with his full power, you can, at best, destroy a couple of galaxies in one shot. Still, with time, effort, and consumption of countless worlds you can match his power one day.

Your body has transformed. You are no longer merely a being—you are a force of nature, an intrinsic aspect of the universe itself. Your appearance is fluid, ever-shifting, and subjective. To one civilization, you might appear as towering giant; to another, a swarm of devouring locusts. A million species could look upon you and each would see something different, their perceptions shaped by their culture, belief, and fear.

You possess unimaginable strength—you can toss the Hulk around like a ragdoll and overpower Odin using sheer physical power alone. You can regenerate from nearly any form of damage—because you an intrinsic part of the universe itself, not even the destruction of your mind, body, or soul is enough to keep you down. Only forces capable of permanently harming a cosmic entity, or beings vastly more powerful than you can stand a chance of ending you.

Your intellect rivals the greatest minds in existence. Among mortals, only Valeria Richards comes close to matching your brilliance. You can create technology that baffles Reed Richards and Doctor Doom, grasp the workings of the most complex machinery at a mere glance, and remain unfazed by the most dangerous and incomprehensible cognitohazards the cosmos has to offer.

Your command over the Power Cosmic surpasses that of all Galactus’s Heralds combined. Anything they can do, you can do better in every conceivable way. You even possess the power to create your own Heralds. However, doing so requires you to permanently surrender a portion of the immense reservoir of Power Cosmic you have. The only way to reclaim this lost power is either by consuming enough energy to regenerate it or by reclaiming it from the Herald you bestowed it upon, which you can do at will. Be warned: Heralds are not inherently loyal, unless you choose to tamper with their minds and souls—so be careful.

Unlike your father and sibling, you are not dependent on devouring planets and civilizations daily to survive. Your reservoir of the Power Cosmic naturally replenishes over time, sustaining your existence without constant consumption. However, to grow stronger, you must feed—converting matter, and energy into raw cosmic power that you can devour. Technically, anything with energy can fuel your growth, but planets remain the most efficient and fulfilling source. The older and more populous a world is, the greater the growth you will have.
objects.title: Child of the World Eater (Marvel)

addons.text:
You gain the combined Hand Powers from Superstar Saga, with all the Bros Moves and Bros Attacks possible with them. You're free to come up with your own. 

If on your own, you can dual wield both elements no problem, which deals great damage on their own. If you have a partner, you can transfer one of the two powers to them.
addons.title: Firebrand & Thunderhand

objects.text:
You can perform a special attack similar in strength to Bros Moves on your own, it won't always be that strong, but good backup if you're low on BP/FP/SP. This attack can be a more elaborate version of your “Attack”, “Weapon”, or another technique or power from this CYOA.

For example, if you suck at landing the Black Flash, assigning it to this makes that way easier due to the QTE, and autopilot of the Action Command. You're not limited to just that either, as variations of how you execute these attacks can be added to an infinite list. Such as a 3 piece combo move with the Black Flash. 

The difficulty of QTE sequences will increase the more complex the attack is, alongside its variants.
objects.title: Super Attack (Super Mario)

addons.text:
If a fourth and final member is present, this evolves into the Quadruple Attack, putting everything achievable in Trio Attacks to shame. Even gods will fear being on the receiving end of the cruel, unusual, oddly funny, mischievous, and terrifying punishments you dish out with but a whim. 

The earth, heavens, stars, underworld, cosmos, and everything beyond screams in fear and begs for your mercy when you unleash your divine wrath… Well more accurately, try out that stupid idea of yours that ends up being the coolest thing ever conceived.
addons.title: Quadruple Attack

objects.text:
If a third person is in your party, you gain a new block called, the Trio Attack. It follows the same rules as Bros Attacks, with a greater emphasis on pushing the boundaries of toon force to create team attacks so impossible, so wacky, yet so cool, that it doesn’t matter. 

When using a Trio Attack, your team and opponent can enter another dimension where logic and physics are forsaken, weapons of freakish proportions are treated like toys, shapeshifting into and conjuring nearly anything is commonplace, and humor becomes a deadly weapon. Your opponent is just a victim here.

These attacks are more expensive than Bros Attacks, and with slightly harder and more elaborate QTE sequences. 

Only one party member can have the Trio Attack, and their turn is the only window to use it. It's permanent until said person leaves, or is swapped out, also, the same member cannot be assigned the block again until the next day.
objects.title: Trio Attack (Super Mario)

objects.text:
You or one of your party members has access to the Luigi Logic block, but remains dormant until an Innovation, stroke of genius, or elaborate idea is conjured in their mind. What it is and how it manifests depends on the context of your situation, both in and outside of battle. 

This takes into account every aspect of the context, environment, current goal, and other factors to reach a plan of action that in theory, seems silly, nonsensical, or just common sense. 

But in practice, is ten times more effective than all other options combined, aided with toon force of course. In battle, this results in an team attack that leaves your opponent so damaged and embarrassed that they're stunned for a few turns. Being free for you to wail on until they get their act together.

Outside of battle, it's more mundane but equally effective. Like skipping the dungeon puzzle you're struggling with, discovering a new passage that wasn't there or even hinted at before, or as simple as squeezing through a tight passage easier.
objects.title: Luigi Logic (Super Mario)

objects.text:
You and/or one of your party members can perform the feats of Dreamy Luigi from Dream Team. If on your own, or you choose otherwise, you can use Spirits as a substitute.

In the Dream World, you can perform Luiginary Moves by fusing your Dreamy Partner into a “prompt”, gaining full control over them and their abilities. Such as a clock to control time, a propeller to control wind, trees for slingshot, or the sun and moon for temperature. These prompts are always highlighted by a specific effect that alerts you to it. 

In battle, you can absorb your Dreamy Partner for a massive boost to your stats and overall abilities, alongside a new block called, “Luiginary Attacks”. Where you summon your absorbed partner, who can clone themselves indefinitely, for even more team attack possibilities. Since you're in the Dream World, there's no limits to hold back your creativity, aside from BP cost. 

You can also utilize these outside of battle for transportation or overcoming obstacles. 

Outside of the Dream World, you can use Spirits to perform lesser versions of these abilities, due to the constraints of the real world.
objects.title: Luiginary Works (Super Mario)

objects.text:
Each purchase of this power causes one of your options within the following blocks — Super Attack, Bros Attack, Trio Attack, etc — to develop an Advanced variation of itself. An alternate version of the same attack that provides new applications and possibilities for it. 

For example, if one of your Bros Attacks is specifically designed to deal massive damage to one target, the variation allows you to damage multiple targets with the same firepower. 

You can decide how it works or let it be random. You can already develop this mid battle with creativity.
objects.title: Advance!! (Super Mario)

objects.text:
You gain a new block of your own design in your Action Command, unlike others however, this one doesn't have options inside. Selecting it instead activates whatever ability it possesses, with its own QTE sequence. Like the Vacuum block from Bowser’s Inside Story.

These blocks can activate many abilities for offense, defense, gimmicks, and support, but is only as strong as a 5 SP power. Having one alone will generate a block that depicts its ability, that you can use as a turn. Having multiple will fuse them together into the first, so they can be displayed in a list after selecting the Unique Block.
objects.title: Unique Block (Super Mario)

objects.text:
You or one of your party members can gain the forms and powers of any and all bosses throughout all Mario RPG Games. This scales with your chosen tier of Boss and the characters available within them. 

If a character has been two different tiers of Boss, you gain their level of strength during that specific time and tier. Tutorial Boss Bowser is a fly compared to The Final Boss Bowser, same for Mid Game Boss and Final Boss Cackletta, Ecks-Ten-Shun Corps brothers, Antasma, Fawful, Shroobs, etc. 

Regardless of the tier you settle on, you can only “cosplay” as one boss at the start, and gain more as you level up, or acclimate to your new role, even fuse them and gain new powers upon doing so. Unlike Mario RPG Bosses, you also enjoy all the benefits of the Action Command, plus its add-ons and upgrades. 

Even if you settle for Mid Game Boss for example, you can ascend to the Late Game Boss, and The Final Boss status with effort.
objects.title: The Grand Finale (Super Mario)

objects.text:
The web of connections around you no longer expands only through your own encounters. Now, the people you know begin to encounter others—new faces, distant links—who, without knowing it, are being gently pulled into orbit around you. These extended connections don’t meet you directly at first, and may not even be aware of your name, but through mutual ties and layered relationships, they become part of a growing, invisible support structure woven through your life.

Your presence echoes through this network. Friends meet friends, coworkers introduce acquaintances, someone’s cousin happens to be exactly the person you’ll one day need. These links are looser, more diffuse, and lack the immediate intimacy of your direct relationships, but the chain holds. When the time comes, you’ll find that the help you need is there—not at your fingertips, but within reach, so long as you’re willing to put in the effort to trace the line and make the ask.

Lastly, your closest contacts now move with a subtle sense of purpose. When a problem stirs on the horizon, they may act without waiting for you to ask, seeking out people who can help—not because they’re told to, but because something in them nudges them toward it. The net you cast has grown wider and more dynamic, and while the thread may stretch, it never breaks. You’re never truly stranded. Even when things are at their most tangled or distant, someone will know someone who knows someone… and that someone can help you.
objects.title: I Know A Guy Who Knows A Guy Who Knows Me

objects.text:
Your social gravity intensifies. It’s not just that you know someone who can help—it’s that the people you come to know often ascend into roles where their influence expands dramatically. Sometimes, they’re already high up when you meet; other times, you know them during quieter years, only to watch them rise like smoke on the wind. CEOs, judges, senior bureaucrats, obscure experts who later become indispensable—your network isn’t merely vast; it’s strategically elevated.

This doesn’t solve problems outright, but it reframes the world in your favor. Bureaucratic red tape becomes a friendly chat. Doors marked “Authorized Personnel Only” open with a casual nod.
