Someone who once owed you a drink now controls funding for an entire sector. Your presence in their life becomes as meaningful to them as theirs is to you. The power dynamic may tilt, but the respect never does.

In practical terms, this means that when you need something complex, large-scale, or highly specific—permits expedited, systems accessed, protections extended—you almost never start from zero. There’s always a hand you can shake, a call you can make, or a friend who knows a friend already working behind the scenes.

You don’t just have allies. You have friends in high places.
objects.title: Friends in High Places

objects.text:
You’ve taken your street art to the next level—not just expression, but identity. You can now create a personal symbol: a logo that’s unmistakably yours. This isn’t just a signature; it’s a statement of presence, a mark of power. Wherever it appears, it carries a charge that resonates with you and the people or causes you care about.

When you spray this logo onto an object, place, or even a person, it becomes linked to you. That bond gives the tagged thing a boost—but only when it’s aligned with you, your crew, or your intent. Weapons hit harder, vehicles run smoother, allies act sharper, spaces feel safer or stronger. It’s like giving something your blessing, but with pressure valves and pigment.

But your mark isn’t for everyone. If someone else tries to use what you’ve tagged against you—if they steal your gear, occupy your turf, or hijack your work—the effect flips. What once boosted now burns, backfires, jams, or just… doesn’t feel right. The logo turns hostile in subtle or spectacular ways, depending on how far the betrayal goes.
objects.title: Tagger

objects.text:
You inherit The Dark Lord’s legacy, gaining his assets, knowledge to create Virabots, his Wristbands of Power, and his natural powers. Whether your stick figures also gain them is up to you. If you weren’t superhuman before, now you are, matching the physical abilities and prowess showcased by The Dark Lord, Chosen One, and The Second Coming. 

Furthermore, you gain powerful pyrokinesis that can wreak havoc on an equivalent scale to the destruction of Newgrounds—which would be a city in real life terms, can create spheres of destructive energy capable of seemingly destroying anything if charged for long enough, and can attract objects. With the Wristbands of Power, you gain the powers of flight, laser vision, and control over Corrosive Energy to dissolve anything it touches into nothing. It can also be shaped into constructs like spikes and energy blades.

Virabots possess similar strength to you, with the same Corrosive Energy woven into their physiology. They take the form of spiders with all their natural abilities, and unlike normal computer viruses, they cannot be deleted.
objects.title: The Dark Lord (Animator vs Animation)

objects.text:
You inherit all the powers showcased by the first stick figure created by Alan Becker; named The Chosen One. Whether your stick figures also gain them is up to you. If you weren’t superhuman before, now you are, matching the physical abilities and prowess showcased by The Dark Lord, Chosen One, and The Second Coming. 

You gain elemental powers that range from manipulating fire, ice, air, and electricity, to summoning aspects of the weather like storm clouds and lightning bolts. As well as the powers of flight, laser vision, and a form of energy manipulation to augment your physical abilities, create implosive energy spheres, and emit golden shockwaves that can counter Corrosive Energy.
objects.title: The Chosen One (Animator vs Animation)

objects.text:
You inherit the legacy of Victim/H4CK3R, gaining their assets, technological prowess, and the powers they gained from the name of H4CK3R. Whether your stick figures also gain them is up to you. If you weren’t superhuman before, now you are, matching the physical abilities and prowess showcased by The Dark Lord, Chosen One, H4CK3R, and The Second Coming.

You possess a holographic visor that grants you the ability to perceive the data of anything you can see, allowing you to see its structure, purpose, history, abilities, and more. You are also able to alter it. This control over data gives you a vast array of abilities, such as telekinesis, flight, duplication, reading and possibly controlling minds, forcibly activating or deactivating the powers of others, creating constructs, and more. Some of the more high-level feats of data manipulation seem to require close range to perform. Extremely strenuous use of your abilities can cause your power to briefly “short out.”
objects.title: H4CK3R (Animator Vs Animation)

objects.text:
Somehow, your console power has manifested physically thanks to your Minecraft powers. Taking the form of an orange block with metal panels, this Command Block provides a way to repeatedly execute input commands, allowing you to spawn various blocks into your inventory, teleport objects and entities, and generally mess with reality in much the same way as your Debugger Console.

However, it's when you throw Virga Arcana into the mix that things get crazy. You can now summon a staff with a slot that will perfectly fit any Minecraft block, granting it unique properties. When the Command Block is slotted in, you will gain the abilities to instantly code and execute any and all commands you wish, just by thinking about it. Sculpt grand sculptures in a second, spawn any kinds of creatures and entities, set the game mode to Creative, teleport multiple people on command! Knowledge of the console's code will come more naturally, allowing you to perform more elaborate, precise and esoteric commands over time.
objects.title: Command Block Staff (Animator Vs Animation)

objects.text: Each purchase of this upgrade will allow you to select another resistance concept of your choice. Resistances will naturally synergize if their categories overlap.
objects.title: Layered Resistance

addons.text: Well now, this is interesting… looks like the Velvet Room has subsumed Akademeia into its foundations, transforming it into an enormous personal library. With both facilities in one place, you can now both research Archetypes and fuse your Personas nigh-simultaneously. Not only that, but you and your Persona-awakened Companions can now transform into your totem Persona(s) as if they were an Archetype. Not only that, but Personas can receive Skills from learned Archetypes via Skill Inheritance. The Sacrificial Fusion service is upgraded, allowing you to rewrite an Archetype's Affinity chart with a Persona's native Affinity Chart, at the cost of that Persona.
addons.title: The Blue Velvet Akademeia

objects.text:
You have become the Host of your own Velvet Room, a crossroads that lies between dream and reality, mind and matter, consciousness and subconsciousness. Only those who are bound by a “Contract” may enter this place. It allows for your status as a Wildcard to truly shine, being able to manage and fuse the various Personas you have gathered thus far, repurposing them into newer, more powerful ones. The appearance your Velvet Room takes depends upon the nature of your personal struggles and journey, and is known to change to fit each person who visits it.

Within the Velvet Room is your very own Attendant, someone who will assist in fusing your Personas and managing the Velvet Room when you're away. You may design their appearance, personality, mannerisms, etc.. While outside the Velvet Room, doors to it will appear in many places, allowing you to access it practically wherever you go. Nobody can see these doors except those who've entered the Velvet Room already, and those you allow to see them.

You can use this to assist others as well. Inside the Velvet Room, you can vaguely feel the potential of others around the world, allowing you to sense the very rare few who can become proper Wildcards. Their very nature is a contract, one that lets you pull them into the Velvet Room in their sleep. If you find them worthy, you may materialize a key for them to use to enter the Velvet Room and make use of its services.

Note: Comically long nose, pointed ears, balding head, and/or bulging bloodshot eyes is optional. For each new visitor to the Velvet Room, you may design a new Attendant. You and/or your Attendant(s) may leave the Velvet Room, but if left without anyone to stabilize it for too long, it will become unstable and remain unavailable for 1 week.
objects.title: Welcome to The Velvet Room (Shin Megami Tensei: Persona)

objects.text: For each purchase, you generate 1 additional charge per cycle.
objects.title: The End Crowns All (Charges)

objects.text: Increases the frequency of charges. Each purchase halves the time between charges generated (every 12h, 6h, 3h).
objects.title: The End Crowns All (Frequency)

objects.text:
Your dominion over deals has grown. You may now empower contracts or objects with Spirit of the Deal. If all parties consent and sign willingly, the agreement binds them with the same force. These contracts remain valid even if you reside in another universe or have long since passed away.

Anything an individual rightfully owns may now be offered in a deal. Whether tangible, conceptual, or metaphysical, anything they personally possess can be placed into a deal. Souls, lifespans, knowledge, magic, or any other possession may be bargained or exchanged. 

While you may deal in nearly anything, this does not grant the capacity to use or endure all you acquire. Absorbing eldritch knowledge may drive you mad, implanting superpowers might mutate you into a monster, and consuming divinity as a mortal may kill you. This power grants no protection or knowledge to safely wield what you claim.

You may store anything bargained for within a metaphysical vault accessible only to you. This vault holds all things safely locked in time until you choose to withdraw, absorb, or trade them again. Anything placed within remains yours to use in future deals.
objects.title: Soul of the Contract

objects.text:
You have acquired the powers of the Supreme Primarch, and now, as the new Supreme Primarch, you have a plethora of new abilities on top of your previous primal abilities being enhanced to match your new station. First off, you can teleport between different dimensions at will and harness all six elements. You can seal off someone's powers and create seals imprisoning beings in other dimensions. You can also create pocket dimensions with unique physical laws, separate from regular space-time. Additionally, you can manifest three pairs of wings in any color of your choice, allowing you to fly and hover.

Also, it should be mentioned that you now have your primal core(s) within these wings. You can command all angels weaker than yourself and calm down rampaging beasts, including fellow Primals. As the Supreme Primarch, you can access an even more powerful state by manifesting twelve wings in colors of your choice. In this state, your physical and magical abilities are massively increased, making you capable of beating any Astral or Primal. You gain passive regenerative powers, allowing you to heal fatal wounds within seconds. You can also fly and hover with these wings. Additionally, your abilities in this state bypass the enemies' durability, letting you pierce through their defenses. You can remain in this twelve-winged state indefinitely.
objects.title: Supreme Primarch (Granblue Fantasy)

addons.text:
Through your sheer willpower and your mastery over all your collected power, you have further evolved along your path of being a primal/astral chimera. You now also gain the knowledge and abilities of the Dusk Speaker astral clone Beelzebub. Besides giving you metal wings made of chaos matter but you gain further magical and chaos based powers and mastery over them. 

Furthermore, not only are you the singularity of the sky realm but now also the crimson horizon. You find now that because you represent and back two realms your singularity powers have even more presence and powers against others. This for example can be showcased by escaping a prison designed to contain unruly archangel level primal beasts or by harming and killing the first supreme primarch easily.
addons.title: King of Flies

objects.text:
"What is a god? Omnipotence given form." — Zero Lucuilius

You can now enter a transformation state that allows you to destroy everything that exists similar to the Dawn Speaker clone astral Lucuilius.

In this state, you become a being made entirely of pure energy in the next dimension. To you, existence is just a tool to interact with the world. Your body is made of Chaos Matter, which lets you ignore reality, logic, cause and effect, and the laws of physics. As a being of chaos, your attacks can destroy the very foundation of reality, including ideas, history, and information.

 This means you can destroy anything, even beings that are immortal, and no amount of power, not even the Omnipotent, can bring back what you have destroyed. Your abilities become much stronger in this state, and only the Supreme Primarch working with the Singularity could possibly be as strong as you.

Also, any attempt to predict or understand you will fail, because the chaos matter messes up and corrupts these efforts, making machines break and causing people to go mad. You can stay in the chaos transformation state forever. 

It should be furthermore stated that you are a chimeric hybrid of supreme primarch level primal and the strongest tier of astral making you the best of both their worlds.

You may optionally gain the knowledge and exact powers of Lucilius and Lucificer (the first primarch followed by the second one Sandalphon) besides evolving in your own way.

Among that there is also the option to bring along the companion Belial archangel of cunning (the literal manifestation of cunning and one of the first primal beasts ever made only ever loyal to his creator).
objects.title: Chaos Form (Granblue Fantasy)

objects.text: You've broken past the threshold into the realm of high-tier. Now, you've honed multiple techniques from your ability that makes it versatile, powerful, or both. For example, having Barrier would now allow you to deflect physical damage and allow only certain people to enter or exit your Barrier, on top of having incredible durability that scales as you get stronger. A testament to your increased mastery. Your mastery of your ability has also caused it to manifest passively, but you'll never be negatively affected or debilitated by this. An example of a passive ability would be Lightning's electrical current detection, Barrier's invulnerability, Aura Manipulation's aura detection, Energy Discharge's accelerated healing, and Time Manipulation's quick reflexes. Your passive is guaranteed to complement your ability to boost your combat prowess even further. High-tiers also gain a body enhancement package equal to a low-tier Brute, akin to the perk Frankenstein or higher, but it varies from person to person depending on their ability. You're no different. You're guaranteed to gain enhanced speed and strength that allows you to outrun a motorcycle and lift a tall teenaged boy as a waif of a girl, even without activating your ability. You also obtain an enormous supply of aura, befitting of a high-tier, allowing you to use your ability effectively in combat without exhausting yourself.
objects.title: High-Tier (UnOrdinary)

objects.text:
Feared and revered by all, you've joined the ranks of the nigh-invincible god-tiers. A subcategory of high-tier, you're not only born with extraordinary power, but have discovered and mastered each and every intricacy of your ability.

The power disparity between god-tiers and lower tiers is incredibly vast, with a god-tier easily curbstomping a high-tier. To challenge a god-tier as anything other than another god-tier is akin to challenging... well, a god. With all that entails.

Upon taking this upgrade, your ability has been boosted to the point that you can take on an entire school of low-mid-tiers, beating them all to the ground within an inch of their lives and remain standing, albeit with some injuries.

However, your body enhancement will either remain the same or be proportionally boosted, depending on your ability. A god-tier with Time Manipulation may be fearsome, but their defense will still remain the same as they were before they activated their ability.
objects.title: God-Tier (UnOrdinary)

objects.text: You can now shape the orbs into whatever shape you wish. The only limitation is that they must remain as a single whole and cannot be split.
objects.title: Shaper

objects.text: Each purchase of this upgrade doubles the amount of orbs you have access to. The first purchase grants a total of sixteen, the second a total of 32, then 64, 128, all the way up to 8,192.
objects.title: More Orbs

objects.text:
You are your Shroud, and your Shroud is you. If you couldn't already do so you can now channel your powers through your Shroud as it counts as an extension of your body.

Your Shroud can also be split and sectioned, effectively granting you multiple independent Shrouds. These divisions can only be created from yourself or from existing manifestations of your Shroud. 

You retain control over each fragment, maintaining tactile feedback and an innate awareness of their positions at all times, so long as you remain in the same universe as the fragment. Separated pieces may also carry an echo of your will, allowing them to follow standing orders and act autonomously until recalled.
objects.title: Deep Weave

addons.text:
As your Shroud is no longer merely an extension of your will but a part of your very being, you gain the ability to transform portions of yourself into your chosen element. You may heal or recharge by absorbing manifestations of that element not created by you. If you were not already capable of flight through your Shroud, you now are.

Absorbing an elemental manifestation with a will of its own—or a being strongly aligned with your element—requires overpowering the target’s will. Successfully doing so allows you to copy their skills into your true form, as well as any traits or abilities connected to elements or affinities you already possess.

Your Shroud has also evolved into a gaseous aura, granting you subtlety where once there was only spectacle. Manifestations need not be dramatic or obvious: a Fire Shroud may express itself as a shift in temperature rather than open flame, a Life Shroud may manipulate bacteria and viruses, and a Technology Shroud may reach into digital code. By learning how your element manifests in less visible forms—humidity, brightness, distortions in space—you can produce far more dramatic effects seemingly from thin air.

You also gain an elemental sense, attuned to the nature of your Shroud. For instance, a Technology Shroud may let you perceive wireless networks and signals, while a Spatial Shroud may let you feel distortions in the dimensional fabric. With practice, this sense can be refined into a powerful tool.

By infusing yourself directly with your element, you can significantly enhance your strength, speed, and durability. Additionally, you may now separate portions of your elemental manifestations without fear of them dissolving, granting you greater permanence and control over your creations.
addons.title: Elemental Loom

objects.text: Your Shroud is not merely raw energy—it can be aspected toward an element of your choice. Select an element such as Fire, Ice, Storm, or something more esoteric like Technology, Cosmic, or Life. At will, you may shift your Shroud from its solid energy form into a manifestation of that element. This choice impacts the appearance of both yourself and your Shroud, your constructs, form, and aura reflecting the chosen element. When aspected, the Shroud grants you a significant increase in affinity with your element, enabling you to generate, control, and wield it directly. For example, a Technology Shroud might let you create or interface with machines. Furthermore, you have a certain level of flexibility and breadth to your elemental manifestations, such as a Fire Shroud allowing for the manipulation of magma or even inflaming passion with enough practice. Your Shroud can only be damaged by things which could feasibly harm the element itself, such as water affecting a fire Shroud while physical strikes cannot, or gravitational effects damaging a space-time Shroud. Even non-physical elements such as light and shadow are capable of becoming tangible, such as by becoming the physical cloak once more, though by doing so they can be damaged by physical forces. Manifestations of your Shroud are always dramatic and unmistakable: a Fire Shroud may blaze with flames or molten rock, a Darkness Shroud may cloak you in void-black mist, while a Cosmic Shroud may shimmer like a star-strewn cosmos. Despite their intensity, these elemental forms only harm what you will them to harm. All manifestations must remain contiguous with you; any portion severed from your Shroud will dissipate within ten to thirty seconds. You may also impose your will upon natural manifestations of your chosen element by merging part of your Shroud with them. The process takes time proportional to the difference in strength between you and the target, but willing manifestations—such as repairing a cooperative robot with a Technology Shroud—allow for faster and smoother control. Each purchase of Elemental Shroud grants you an additional elemental affinity, however your Shroud can only aspect itself towards one element at a time. True mergers of multiple elements are not possible, but practice will let you rapidly switch between them and keep the previous element’s manifestations active for longer afterwards. Doing so with directly-conflicting elements (such as fire and ice, or life and death) requires much more practice to be done effectively.
objects.title: Elemental Shroud

objects.text: You have access to the Master Classes of Lord (+) and Muse (-). These are the respective active and passive classes of Interference. As allegedly the most active and passive classes respectively, they utilise and impact their aspect on a cosmic scale, acting as ‘master copies’ or the examples that define how active and passive classes operate. The Lord seeks to subjugate or subvert their aspect or to subjugate through their aspect. They seek to shape reality to their ego and desires above all else. The most beneficent Lord is still an overbearing and righteous force, while at their worst they become the worst of tyrants that view anything from without them as theirs by right. The Muse inspires through their aspect or inspires their aspect. They don’t respond as much as the choices they make naturally invite responses that align to them. They make no actions and still progress, but they’re equally unable to actually take any meaningful action themselves, trading the excessive power of their active counterpart for an incredible range to perform minuscule actions within, so that they can cascade downwards, with the Muse themselves becoming more of a symbol than a participant.
objects.title: Master Classes

objects.text:
Classpects are, by their nature, loose in definition. Now, you can construct your own Class, Aspect or both as long as it follows their fundamental rules. 

An Aspect is always a fundamental building block of Paradox Space’s reality, with a physical, metaphorical and metaphysical trait associated with it.

A Class is usually an archaic role or trade that serves the ‘King’ (the desires or wants of the player), with their inspiration informing the way their aspect is expressed.
objects.title: Fan Classpect

objects.text: Usually attained by dying on your Quest-bed,God-Tiers are the ultimate expression of a Classpect, and the pinnacle of a Player’s power. Having ascended, your power over your aspect is dramatically enhanced. For example, The Knight of Time could summon and experience alternate selves at will, while the Heir of Breath could control the winds of entire worlds at a time. After ascension, your powers continue to grow as you ascend the ‘God Tiers’ with mythologically and narratively relevant activities and actions. Finally, God-Tiers have a form of conditional immortality, being biologically immortal and can, unlessed judged ‘HEROIC’ or ‘JUST’ revive from any death that meets them, ensuring their deaths are always relevant. A God Tier additionally usually changes the body in small ways to resemble an ‘ideal’ of the species (Trolls for instance being insectoid viewed ‘fairies’ as an ideal, and so their god-Tiers all had wings). You also receive hooded pajamas robes that all Gods get to accompany their ascension (customised to your Aspect and Class, of course).
objects.title: God-Tier

objects.text: Rather than becoming the second coming of Primus as the God of Machines, you have used the AllSpark as an impromptu Beyonder’s Visage to immediately propel yourself toward the Transcendental (X) grade, becoming a Legendary Mechanic of a branch of your choosing, whether you pick the armed, energy, or virtual branch you are a true god of all machines on your own. As a Legendary Mechanic, your class skills are max leveled, and you have mastered all Mechanic class knowledge to the peak. However, you lack blueprints beyond those given directly through mechanic knowledge or class advancement. With your raw mechanical prowess, the lack of blueprints is not a huge issue. Your capacity for R&D rivals that of a Type III civilization on the Kardashev scale all on your own. Your nature as a Transcendental being causes you to obtain a uniqueness within your Information form. This allows you to self-resurrect upon death as long as there remains any carrier for any information about you in the universe. This automatically causes an Information form disturbance, bringing about your resurrection somewhere in the universe with no power or memory loss. Even if you are at the final stage of the Mechanic class, there are no limits to the power you can obtain, though there is no stage above you. As an X grade, you are of a unique Divine Species; you can create three unique racial talents and choose which lineage your second God's Trait Transformation tree originates from.
objects.title: The Legendary Mechanic (Legendary Mechanic)

objects.text:
With each purchase, you get one molding talent of your choice.

Molding talents are what separates boss characters from normal characters. An example of a molding talent is immunity to true damage, which is any form of damage that bypasses resistances.
objects.title: Molding Talent (Legendary Mechanic)

objects.text: Your genetic chain has taken on a truly inconceivable structure: with each purchase of this, your genetics vastly increase in complexity and stability, allowing you to naturally awaken additional Esper abilities. These additional Esper abilities share growth with your original Esper ability. Even if their potential is poor, such as [Esper Silence], as you possess other Esper powers, your overall potential isn't held back because of it.
objects.title: Unique Gene Chain Variance

objects.text:
You have awakened an Esper ability far beyond even those described in the Super High Risk Esper Ability Treaty, that is, the ability to induce the creation of new Esper abilities within the gene chain of oneself or others.

There are a few stages in the process of creating new Esper abilities: Nucleation,  Implantation, and Nucleus Growth. 

You begin by nucleating the idea behind the Esper ability you want to create. You can be as specific as you want, from clearly defining each parameter and variable, to being as vague as nucleating the idea of a "Flight" Esper ability. This creates an Esper Ability Nucleus, which is implanted into a gene chain to develop into a complete Esper ability.

You then implant the Esper Ability Nucleus into the genetic chain of a living being, either your own or that of someone else. While your genetic structure can withstand and support multiple Esper abilities at once, other people can only have one, and you are unable to implant Esper Ability Nuclei in those already supers.

To grow a nucleus into a complete Esper ability, you must feed it vast amounts of energy. Esper abilities with an F grade potential cost 100 energy to develop, and each Potential Grade higher increases this energy cost by five.

Your genetic chain can initially support around a hundred Esper abilities; holding more than that risks destabilising your genes. Increasing in Grade doubles the amount of Esper abilities your genes can support without collapsing. You can also increase the number of Esper abilities you can hold through reinforcing your genetic structure.

The power of each Esper ability you create depends on your personal power as an Esper, with each benefiting from Esper class advancement knowledge, and you can use as many as you want to at once without risks.

You still start as a grade F Esper with F-grade energy reserves.
objects.title: True God of Espers

objects.text:
You’re gonna be the very best, like no one ever was.

You become a master trainer of all sorts of exotic creatures and supernatural monsters. Any creatures you tame become loyal companions that fight to the best of their abilities. You know the optimal ways to train and spur the growth of your creatures, allowing them to reach their greatest potential and learn new abilities. You gain an excellent tactical sense of how to best utilize your creatures’ latent abilities, as well as synergizing them with each other. You also have an instinctive knowledge of which kind of elemental abilities work best against others.

You gain up to six Pokeballs that can comfortably contain a single creature that is loyal to you, and can be called forward at any time. You can only have six pokeballs at a time, and no power upgrade or improvement can increase this number. You also gain a special realm full of many different spacious environments where creatures not currently on your team can comfortably stay, and when not in battle, you can access this realm and call forth or send in creatures as you see fit and swap out which creatures are in your Pokeballs. You cannot enter this realm, but you can view inside of it and communicate with your creatures.

You also become much better at capturing wild creatures, especially with the help of your own creatures. Tricks, abilities and devices you use to capture and control creatures are more effective and rarely fail. In your quest to find more creatures, you become a talented explorer who can venture and survive in any wild environment. You know where to look for any kind of creature you wish to capture, and have excellent luck encountering rare and elusive creatures. You know how to find legendary creatures that most people think don’t even exist. Should you prove yourself worthy, even mythical beasts that serve as gods and guardians will be willing to follow you.

You’re on the road to catching ‘em all and becoming a true master.
objects.title: To Be a Master (Pokemon)

objects.text:
Now with One Mind Among Many, whatever happens to a clone, or to you, will never affect the rest. Attacks on the mind and soul, phenomena that are designed to disrupt a hive mind, handcuffs that would strip or neutralize powers, or even extreme pain, will no longer impact the others. You will be aware of a clone’s pain or death, but will be unaffected by their suffering, and only retain the knowledge of what has occurred.

Your control over your clones has evolved. You can now upgrade, downgrade, or dismantle any of your clones from any distance. You may elevate a Purpose-Built into a Core Clone, downgrade a Core Clone into a lower-tier clone, or dismantle them entirely. Each of these actions will consume or restore energy equal to the amount required for the respective process.

If your main body is ever killed, destroyed, permanently incapacitated, or erased, the nearest clone, regardless of tier, will be elevated to become your new primary body and become you, inheriting all your original powers and abilities. You cannot choose which clone will receive this transfer, only that it must be the one nearest to you. Should your former body still exist in any form, it will be immediately dismantled.
objects.title: One Body Among Many

objects.text:
You have become a true Mythical Creature, at the level of Sequence 2, often known as an Angel. Your body, spirit, and existence have all been elevated to a whole new level, granting immense power and presence.

Your Mythical Creature Form is now your natural state, no longer a transformation but your true existence. You can freely manifest or withdraw your form without strain, and your powers now operate at their full potential as extensions of your being. Your appearance no longer ages, and you no longer require sustenance, for your essence sustains itself. You can determine what your form affects or spares, allowing you to precisely choose how its presence interacts with the world. Its effect is now far more potent, able to potentially harm even beings far greater than yourself, and its presence is capable of greatly influencing and altering the world itself. Though death remains possible through the principles of decay and time, your nature allows you to endure far beyond the limits of mortality.

As a Mythical Creature, you can shatter Beyonder characteristics to free them from sealed artifacts and purge any corruption within them. You possess a will strong enough to endure through ages and have a high natural resistance to corruptive knowledge and higher existences, your presence shielding you from influences that would distort your nature. Several of your powers have been elevated to the level of Sequence 2 authority, carrying the power and influence befitting an Angel.

You can traverse the spirit world freely when given positioning, bestow blessings or boons upon others, and create an honorific name, a five-line invocation symbolizing your authority and essence, allowing others to call upon you anywhere through rituals. You can hear and respond to prayers from across the world, perceiving those who call upon your honorific name, and you can cast your gaze into the Astral World. Revealing your true form grants an immense surge in power, its manifestation amplifying all your abilities to their highest expression, and you can use the status and strength of a complete Mythical Creature to influence the world around you.
objects.title: True Mythical Creature (Lord of the Mysteries)

objects.text:
The Abyss of Da’at is the void that binds all Sefirot and connects all meanings. It exists everywhere and nowhere, a boundless emptiness bearing the absence of all symbols and authority. It is a silent gulf that underlies existence, where all things lose their shape before taking form again. An empty vessel of pure potential, waiting to be filled and shaped by your will.

You gain access to this emptiness and can shape it through your own actions, for the Abyss is part of your true self. It serves as your personal Sefirot, where anything you offer is broken down and remade into symbolism. By offering physical materials, abilities, or manifestations, you can destructively deconstruct them into the symbols that they are constructed from. Each symbol represents the true nature of what was given—the concept behind its existence rather than its form. Abstract ideas cannot be sacrificed directly; they must be represented through something that embodies them.

When something is sacrificed, it is absorbed into the Abyss and transformed into symbols. These symbols become the foundation of its internal structure. Each symbol reshapes the Abyss, expanding its depth and complexity, turning it from a hollow void into a functioning source of authority and origin of power.

Symbols that are adjacent in nature can interact to create new expressions. Each connection between them gives rise to additional symbols born from their relationship. A symbol like light may form links to others such as heat or hope, drawing on both physical and abstract associations. These interactions do not merge the symbols themselves but generate new layers of symbolism built upon their foundation.

Symbols that are incompatible or meaningless separate automatically or can be expelled entirely. You may remove any symbol that serves no purpose, keeping the structure stable and coherent. The Abyss naturally maintains equilibrium between what it accepts and what it rejects.

A single symbol can form a complete pathway within the Abyss, though its scope will be limited. Multiple symbols with adjacent or compatible symbols can produce broader, more versatile pathways with a greater number of authorities. Each pathway develops its own expressions, powers, and authorities through the symbols that compose it. From these pathways, you can even produce characteristics that embody their nature. The Abyss allows you to freely organize these pathways—you can merge, divide, or restructure the abilities derived from your symbolism. As long as you remain within the scope of your symbols, there is no limit to what ability you can create. This acts as a lesser version of the Great Old Ones’ pathway reorganization ability.

As you refine and expand the Abyss with higher-order symbols, its internal structure and potency grow. A fully balanced and complete Abyss of Da’at allows you to truly reach the state of a Pillar. When complete, the Abyss manifests as your own controlled layer of reality, an existence-scale domain equal in scope to the Spirit World, the Astral World, and the Physical World. Its form depends on what you build within it, such as a unified world of fate or a vast dimensional realm filled with endless sub-realities bound under one order.

The Abyss also grants perception of the symbolic layer of existence. You can tap into this to see the symbols that define all things, understand their connections, and determine how they fit within your high sequence group. When performing a sacrifice, you can choose which symbols to extract, limited to those naturally aligned with what was offered.

You can acquire the symbols of other Sefirot, Uniquenesses, or Great Old Ones by sacrificing them into the Abyss. Doing so integrates their symbolism into your own structure for the Abyss, permanently binding their source matter to your Sefirot making you gain all their authorities and symbolism for your Abyss.

Your powers and existence combine with the nature of the Abyss. Each created pathway within it can allow you to manifest its own corresponding Mythical Creature Form, embodying the nature and symbolism of that path, with your core Mythical Creature Form being the reflection of the Abyss itself, the totality of all your symbols and pathways. Together, these forms exist as facets of a greater whole, reflections of the Abyss that binds them.

Anything sacrificed ceases to exist in its original form but continues as symbolism within you. Each symbol remains active and connected to the whole, expanding and strengthening the foundation that defines your being.
objects.title: Abyss of Da’at

addons.text:
Due to every shop now carrying every common item imaginable, the Multiversal Marketplace has compensated you by refining its selections with surgical precision.

Now, whenever your Pause Shop ability activates, you no longer appear in generic vendors or broad-stock markets. Instead, you are drawn to hyper-specialized establishments that exist solely to prepare you for the exact event, adversary, or circumstance you are about to encounter.
addons.title: Hyper-Specialized Shops

addons.text:
Your bond with the Multiversal Marketplace has evolved, allowing you to become part of its eternal trade network. Now, when allies, companions, or key figures in your world stand on the brink of pivotal events, you may assume the role of Pause Shop’s wandering merchant yourself.

At these moments, you may teleport directly to their location, appearing as the perfect merchant for their needs. Whether they face an impending battle, a perilous journey, or a crucial decision, you can offer them any item in your store’s inventory.

You may choose to participate in the event personally or remain an observer, vanishing once your wares have changed hands. Regardless, to those you aid, your timing always seems impossibly perfect; A mysterious benefactor appearing just when they need you most.
addons.title: Your Helpful Neighborhood Merchant

addons.text:
Now, when you take on the role of the wandering merchant and teleport to assist others, you gain full access to the Marketplace’s entire catalog of common goods across every known (and unknown) universe.

During these visits, you may conjure and sell virtually any standard item imaginable, from potions and rations to basic weapons, tools, or trinkets. Though the Marketplace enforces its eternal greed, preventing you from giving items away freely, you may instead sell them at only a slight profit, ensuring your assistance remains accessible while still respecting the balance of trade.

Now, even items that were never part of your personal shop inventory may be summoned and sold, expanding your role from opportunistic buyer to a true merchant of the multiverse.
addons.title: All That and a Healing Potion Too

objects.text:
Your connection to the Multiversal Marketplace deepens, granting you more than simple access to products from other universes. You now also possess the ability to pause time at the precipice of any major event and project yourself into a seemingly random store of the Multiversal Marketplace.

Though random in appearance, the merchant you will encounter during this passed time is never arbitrary; rather, their inventory is always mysteriously curated to suit the challenges you are about to face. Whether you require armor for an imminent battle, healing elixirs for an injured ally, intelligence boosting potions for a coming trial, or simply gear for an ambush you never saw coming, their wares will always prove relevant.

However, this ability will only trigger before important events or combat situations and thus cannot be manually triggered. Furthermore, each visit must be brief, forcing you to rush while you browse, barter, and purchase whatever resources you believe will most aid you in the events to come.

Then once your transaction is complete, you return instantly to the exact moment and place you departed from, with no time having passed in your reality.
objects.title: Pause Shop

objects.text:
A sustained, weaker alternative to Release Recollection. Instead of awakening an object’s full conceptual might, you reinforce it by amplifying a fraction of its nature.

A wooden sword becomes tougher than steel. A kitchen knife grows sharper and more precise. Armor forged for protection gains heightened resilience. A cherished keepsake becomes lighter, sturdier, or more responsive.

This enhancement lasts as long as you maintain it. It strengthens the item, but never transforms it into its true legend. It is reinforcement, not revelation.
objects.title: Enhance Armament

objects.text:
With each purchase, you both an additional pair of spectral arms to utilize in addition to your original set, up to a maximum of (eight/ten/twelve) pairs total; with each set, you gain an additional pair of Domains as well with all that entails, though no boost in power.

These additional Domains may either be grouped in their own related/opposing pairings independent from your other hands, or combined with pre-existing Domain groups as seems fitting - for example, adding hands containing Earth and Air to those containing Water and Fire, or Expansion and Propagation/Replication to Growth and Evolution.
objects.title: Plentiful Armaments

objects.text: Your Legion has expanded to include those you personally kill. Any individual slain by your hand may be claimed as a legionnaire, becoming bound to you in the same manner as those accepted through personal connection or loyalty. Those claimed in this way become enslaved to your will, their loyalty absolute and unquestioning, unless you choose to grant them autonomy or free will, or even release them entirely, with or without restrictions you decide to impose. This effect can also extend to those killed by your legionnaires, allowing your Legion to expand endlessly through conquest.
objects.title: Conquest (Shinza Bansho)

objects.text:
The Imagine Breaker evolves even further, transforming into Malignant Tumour Apoptosis, an idea of self-destruction given form.

When activated, any and all supernatural powers and effects around you are instantly dispelled and suppressed, and any opponent is reverted to the level of a regular human. The effect can propagate for kilometers around you, and with time, you will be able to extend it even further, until there is nowhere you cannot reach. As Malignant Tumour Apoptosis lowers everyone around you to a level of a baseline human, with the exception of yourself, it will affect even those for whom their powers are a natural part of their biology, come from cybernetic enhancement, or are otherwise something that will not usually be considered 'supernatural'.

The most powerful application of this ability, however, is that you can impose upon anyone a status of Apoptosis, causing their own supernatural abilities to eat them alive from the inside out, essentially making your target self-destruct. This cannot be defended against or resisted; unless the target is already a powerless human, all manner of supernatural powers and associated concepts will immediately collapse, causing, by the chain reaction, the complete destruction of the target on all levels of existence. Even the likes of all-powerful Hadou Gods and transcendental Gudou Gods will be stripped of all their powers and immediately self-destruct.
objects.title: Malignant Tumor Apoptosis (Shinza Bansho)

addons.text:
With the support of Engine of Escalation, every power you steal becomes four times stronger than the original. Additionally, every day, the Engine generates a copy of each ability Harirankyu holds in its arsenal.

You are not restricted to only giving out those copies to others, as you can merge them together, resulting in an ability with increased power, removed limitations, or improved versatility.

Similarly, the number of the replicas you can produce now also doubles every day for each consumed person, allowing you—in short order—to amass an endless army of loyal followers.
addons.title: Engine of Usurpation

addons.text: Your sensories—similar to replicas—are inherently connected to Harirankyu from the moment of their creation. At any time, you can selectively take anything from any of your sensories, as well as fully absorb and recreate them at will, and even restore their minds after awakening.
addons.title: Sakasa Haritsuke

addons.text:
You have become Harirankyu itself; your true body is no longer flesh and blood but an abstract idea. Using Presence Manifestation as a vector, you can now create and recreate mind, body, and soul for yourself whenever you desire, as well as instantly restore them in case of damage, no matter how severe or esoteric.

Your physical presence causes the growing sense of unease and dread in everyone nearby, especially in those particularly sensitive to supernatural presence, drawing out their darkest thoughts and emotions and making it all the more easy to target them, although you can suppress this aura should you wish to or make someone selectively exempt from its effect.
addons.title: Waste God

objects.text:
Much like the original wielder of this power, you are now eternally envious of everything and everyone, effectively fulfilling the first condition of forced cooperation. The effect is entirely subconscious and will not influence your personality.

Additionally, you are almost supernaturally skilled in causing others to dislike you. You are an unparalleled master of insults and trash talk, to a point where even a brief conversation with the most patient and benevolent person can cause them to go into a blind rage.

Lastly, you now can give out anything you stole to others. Everything you give out is still ultimately sourced from Harirankyu and can be recalled at will. You can even choose to put the souls you stole inside the recreated bodies, resurrecting those you have fully consumed. Unlike with a full recreation, however, there is no guarantee that those you resurrect will be loyal to you.
objects.title: Tatari

objects.text:
Your Truths are half mended from the shattering that caused the current state of the Dao. While still hungry, they are appreciative of novel use as much as they are of use in battle. This allows for both less risky growth so long as one can innovate, and truly rapid gains of progress from experimenting in the middle of a fight.

Even your buds gain this benefit, gaining better rounded powers and being far less demeaning in the attachments they spread.
objects.title: Conflicted Dao Special Upgrade "Thinker" (Ruins of Isekai cyoa)

objects.text:
There is a battlefield at the core of the Dao, the idea of where it was first developed. This place is as much metaphor as it is material, but you have the ability to reach it with minimal effort. Throughout this area will be scattered terrible and unearthly beasts reflecting all of the Truths that have come to be. Your own will happily work with you, or challenge you if desired. While those of others may be subjugated, made to kneel and bound to your will, or usurped from their masters if beaten thoroughly enough. Be careful, for the truth beasts lack the limitations and weaknesses of the flesh that their bearers have, and may come in packs.

With time and conquest, you may be able to use this land to reach its shard based twin, assemble a network of Seekers far more tightly bound than otherwise possible, find ways to weaken the boundaries to call your truth beasts into reality, or simply accelerate your way through the Dao.
objects.title: Conflicted Dao Limit Breaker Upgrade "Networking" (Ruins of Isekai cyoa)

objects.text: You have been granted a second Truth, grand and esoteric, torn from the remains of the god who was turned against itself to make the Dao. Something to the tune of "I Am Always Met With the Ideal Foe" at its core, this power helps manage your encounters, bending space around you in subtle but meaningful ways so that those who can easily beat you must put in far more effort to find you, while those who would be an engaging and profitable battle can be found by you at a moment's notice. It can even aid passage across nearby realms or parallel earths for you or your targets should it deem such necessary. While not perfect, it will refine itself as would any other Truth.
objects.title: Conflicted Dao Booster Upgrade "Worthy Opponents" (Ruins of Isekai cyoa)

objects.text:
You have been granted the Truth of "I Always Perform at My Best", currently its expression is focused on your mind. Movements are executed flawlessly without any concentration needed, and not a single piece of information within your senses slips by your unconscious. Such information is then used by the Truth to further inform future actions. While it currently doesn't surpass your physical limits, it can help in most fields, be they academic, spiritual, or more esoteric, and is always tilted towards the outcomes you personally desire.

While already significantly developed into its current interpretation, it is a Truth and will continue to grow and bud as you develop it. Likely gaining further ways to gather and collate information to allow you to further reach towards perfection.
objects.title: Conflicted Dao Capstone Upgrade "Destination" (Ruins of Isekai cyoa)

objects.text:
Your authority over the concept of Entropy has expanded to apply to metaphysical avenues. You can apply this authority to destroy souls, decay people's beliefs in their gods, snuff out esoteric phenomena, and even erode conceptual laws locally. This can also be applied in reverse, restoring anything under your influence.

You can also call upon all those who are long gone, as they become part of your ever-growing domain. These beings will be only superficial remembrances containing a fraction of their abilities.

If you have personally played a part in their demise, you can summon them with their full memory and a personality loyal to you. Those who met their end by you cannot be resurrected or claimed by outside forces unless you purposely release them, allowing their soul to pass to the afterlife or straight up bringing them back to life if you prefer. 

The range of your system has been increased to a planetary level and will naturally increase as the march of time progresses towards the inevitable end of all things. You have complete awareness of all entropic processes present within your range.
objects.title: Principle Erosion

objects.text:
This software upgrade grants access to the Anima Interface, a subsystem for scanning sentient and biological entities allowing you to treat consciousness and physiology as editable systems. Upon visual focus, you perceive a target’s holographic character panel displaying aggregated core attributes (Strength, Intellect, etc.), a vitality bar for health and stamina, major skills with proficiency levels, and visible status effects. This scan also functions on yourself, providing quantified self-diagnostics.

The initial functionality follows the Engine's core rule of conservation. You can edit the displayed macro-attributes such as Strength or Insight by increasing one and decreasing another of equivalent value within the same subject. You can also adjust skill proficiency levels by transferring points from one skill to another internally. The process is stable but strictly limited by what is visible; you cannot add attributes or skills the target does not already possess in some form, and physical contact is initially required.

As your mastery grows, you perceive deeper data: sub-attributes, latent potentials, and memory structures. By directly accessing these micro-properties, you gain the ability to define and add entirely new attributes or skills to the target. You precisely pay the required cost by draining value from specified, less-critical underlying properties you can now see and control, creating stable, permanent additions such as new innate talents or expert-level skills that were not previously present.
objects.title: Administrator Account

objects.text:
With your overall mastery over Binding Vows, you have become a Binding Vow Merchant.

You gain an intuitive talent in regards to Binding Vows—accurately creating, modifying, and destroying your self-imposed Binding Vows in response to the flow of combat. You could create a Vow to give up on offense in exchange for a stronger, defensive counter-attack, then outright destroy it for a Vow to trade your techniques for a huge increase in physical strength, all in the span of several moments.

The usual drawbacks associated with self-imposed Binding Vows are lessened, if not negated entirely thanks to Binding Vow Merchant's facilitation. However, Binding Vows with other beings remain the same as usual.
objects.title: Tithe

objects.text: Your recharge now completely refills your Charges. At noon and midnight, your Charges are restored to your current maximum instantly, regardless of how many you have left. This does not affect the permanent increases to your maximum pool; it only affects the recharge of your existing Charges.
objects.title: Full Recharge

addons.text:
Apart from Harirankyu, you also inherited the full breadth of Seijuuro's abilities, including his proficiency in Kantan; Harirankyu and its Forced Cooperation take the place of Hadan you would've received by yourself.

You are an unparalleled genius, excelling in any intellectual pursuit, to the point where you can invent an entire supernatural system from scratch before hitting your twenties. You fully mastered all types of dreams, allowing you to achieve practically anything you desire and take your powers to the real world unimpeded.

But the most defining aspect you inherited is your willpower. You can withstand the collective will of all mankind trying to break your spirit or live decades as barely a lump of flesh suffering from a myriad of diseases so agonising that experiencing a single one for but a moment is enough to drive a regular man insane without ever losing hope or desire to live. This, naturally, enhances the powers of your dreams to an unparalleled level, where no regular user of Kantan can hope to challenge you.
addons.title: Anathema of Malady

addons.text:
You have unlocked a modified version of Sera Mizuki's Hadan, with the condition for Forced Activation being that both you and your target have the desire to return to some point in the past.

Once activated, the time around you starts flowing backwards to the moment of your choosing. You can control who and what is or is not affected by this reversal and to what degree, even letting someone keep their memory while you reverse their physical state, and with being strengthened by Forced Cooperation, the effect of this Hadan becomes absolute, rewinding even those that possess time manipulation powers of their own or even those unbound by this concept entirely.

While your Hadan is active, you become absolutely impossible to harm, as opponents' attacks cannot form, and any and all previous injuries or effects rewind immediately; even conceptual effects that are otherwise impossible to heal get erased. At its most powerful, you can completely rewind the entire timeline to a moment of your choosing, as if all the events afterwards had never happened.
addons.title: Inukai Gempachi Nobumichi

objects.text: Within you lies the potential to reach Innate Dream, otherwise known as Hadan, an extremely potent ability born from the crystallisation of your dreams and desires. It can range from reversing time to the ability to steal anything from the target, including its Hadan. Simultaneously, conditions for Forced Cooperation will coalesce. This is a phenomena that, once its conditions are satisfied, makes your Hadan unavoidable and inescapable, as the target counts as having agreed to fall under its effect of their own volition. The details of both are unique to each Kantan practitioner and are dependent on the practitioner's personality and experiences. The conditions for Forced Cooperation can, sometimes, be very broad and easy to fulfil or near-impossible and extremely convoluted. But the harder it is to activate Forced Cooperation, the more it boosts the power of your Hadan.
objects.title: Kyūdan (Soushuu Senshinkan Gakuen Hachimyoujin)

addons.title: Tyrant of Light (Soushuu Senshinkan Gakuen Hachimyoujin)
addons.text:
You are no longer simply one of the Rosei. Now, you stand as an equal in all aspects to Amakasu Masahiko, the first and strongest of them all. While all Rosei are incredibly talented in all types of dreams, you are especially predisposed towards the creation-type.

Even your simplest creations appear as breaches in the laws of reality, rejecting common sense, logic, and limitations. Moreover, as you advance your mastery of Kantan and achieve the necessary strength, you will obtain all the techniques that Masahiko created, such as the creation of future battleship Ibuki, Rods From God, Little Boy and Tsar Bomba, summoning of Beelzebub and Nakiri Kuubo, and much more.

objects.text: You have become one of the Rosei—the living bridge to Araya, the origin of all things. Your unique existence grants you extended control over dreams and Dreamworld itself, unachievable to other Kantan users, and your proficiency with all types of dreams grows exponentially faster than it otherwise would've been with no upper limit. As a living conduit and representative of humanity before Araya, you can now bring others into the Dreamworld and even open its gates to the entire world, as well as freely limit or enhance the abilities of other Kantan users. Moreover, the power of the Rosei rises with the number of their followers, those close to them mentally, physically, spiritually, and ideologically, with each new follower enhancing their leader relative to the strength of their bond. Those followers draw their strength directly from you, allowing you to enhance their abilities beyond what is achievable by other Kantan practitioners, share with them your perks, and even resurrect them should they perish. After you master all the regular stages of Kantan and reach the final layer, one last stage will become available to you. Unique to the Rosei, surpassing even Innate Dreams, Tsuidan is the ultimate expression of the dreams of humanity. Everything was created by human dreams: gods, demons, other universes and dimensions, and any idea formed and unformed, be it in the past, present, or future. You now can summon those dreams and legends into reality: gods, monsters, legendary figures or artefacts; not mere replicas, but true originals, ultimately loyal to you. Tsuidan also grants you free control over reality, allowing you to create any effect or concept, physical or metaphysical, control and rewrite the history and events, create universes; any and all of your fantasies and dreams can be manifested into reality. Upon reaching the final layer, you will completely transcend both the real world and Dreamworld. No longer a man of flesh and blood but an abstract idea given human form, unbound by concepts, rules, duality, or information. Even interacting with you becomes impossible without your permission, as it would be like trying to harm a fictional character through a page in a book.
objects.title: Rosei (Soushuu Senshinkan Gakuen Hachimyoujin)

objects.text: Your failsafe now extends to sustained or rapid multi-hit attacks. Now a rapid sequence of attacks such as a burst of machine gun fire, chain of explosions, or a continuous laser beam is instead treated as a single lethal event, triggering your “critical state” failsafe. Ongoing damaging effects, such as a death aura, are likewise also treated as a single event for the purpose of triggering your "critical state" failsafe.
objects.title: Once More (Kingdom Hearts)

objects.text: Your failsafe now has a recovery method of its own, after entering the "critical state", you will be able to gain a Second Wind that will heal up any critical and immediately lethal damage bringing you back into the fight at "low health" but only if you defeat an Enemy. What counts as an Enemy is up to you, it doesn't have to be the being that brought you to that critical condition, it could be a nearby slug, a robot, a bystander or even an ally, as long as it can be defeated in some way it can be designated as an Enemy. But don't worry about shedding blood just to get back to the fight, only Defeat is necessary, so that could mean anything from taking the will to fight out of them, knocking them out, making them run away or just killing them.
objects.title: Fight For Your Life

addons.text:
The unique, malleable, ever-changing, and constantly evolving nature of your soul extends to both your mind and body. There are no longer any limits to what either can mimic. For example, you could absorb unique biomass, allowing your body to adopt new traits that enhance its abilities. With enough study, you could become a psychic of the same type by learning from unique psychics or their effects. Even energies exclusive to certain beings are not beyond your reach, as your body would develop the necessary organs or channels to harness them.

This adaptability also makes you resistant to mental and physical manipulation, rendering you immune to forced transformations or unwanted changes in thought. Your ability to adapt means such attempts would be nearly impossible to succeed.

There are no real limits on what your body and mind can become, whether you choose to remain human or gradually morph into an unrecognizable, alien being with an incomprehensible mind and form. Regardless of the changes, your mind and body, like your soul, would still remain you.
addons.title: Adjust

objects.text:
The Equilibrium between your mind, body & soul has strengthened even further and has now completely resonated. What was before merely a defensive balance between the three has evolved into complete sharing of all abilities and powers as your whole being has begun to connect nearly to the point of being considered one thing not three.

If you for example had Telekinetic abilities allowing you lift objects with your mind. Your body would now gain a tactile telekinesis field allowing for the mimicking of super strength, durability and flight on the level of what you could have physically lifted or blocked with your mind.

If your body could generate and circulate mana, your soul would now also produce mana, effectively doubling the amount of magical energy at your disposal.

A power that previously enhanced only your body—such as growth mutation—would now strengthen your soul and mind at the same rate, within the same limits that once applied only to your physical form.

Your mind, body, & soul will strive to balance all powers and abilities across the three aspects as effectively as possible.

While this state of resonance doesn’t grant you new powers on its own, it ensures that any powers you possess or acquire will be shared and synchronized between all three aspects of your being.
objects.title: Resonance

objects.text:
You take working out your brain to the next level. Now, it's not just defensive qualities that are equal between mind, body, and soul, but your actual strength too.

Having a strong mind, such as being very smart, clever, or just having strong strength of will, also raises the strength of your body and soul. Being above-average intelligence will make you above average in physical capabilities and give you an above-average strong soul. Being a big meathead gym jock will also make you either one of the smartest people around or make any psychic abilities you have extra strong while increasing the power of your soul and supercharging any soul-based powers you may have. This also works for any powers you have that originate from or work with one of the three.

This also means you can train one, and it will train the others. So, if you want to be smarter to telekinetically move bigger objects or ace that upcoming test, then you better go hit the gym.
objects.title: Conditioning

objects.text: You only have one wolf in you now, because in a rather gruesome turn of events, the All Bite wolf ate the All Bark wolf, taking its traits into itself. The wolf is now roughly the size of a horse, and thus, the sound of its bark and the force of its bite have grown to match.
objects.title: Dog Eat Dog

objects.text: If you thought the wolf ate the horse, you guessed wrong. Cause when it tried, the horse ate it. The horse-sized wolf in you was wolfed down by the Wise Horse; this caused it to undergo a transformation into a chimeric being. Neither a horse nor a wolf, this creature has taken up residence inside you where the wolf once dwelled. This beast is the size of a draft horse; it has the front legs of a wolf and the back legs of a horse. Its body is like that of a long-furred horse, and its face is a strange fusion of both. The knowledge of the horse has altered the wolves' powers, granting more control and depth over them. The power that was once limited to biting has spread through this creature, its claws projecting phantasmal slashes, and its hooves hitting like meteors. While the power of the bark's ability to create portals now allows the sound to shatter and twist space itself.
objects.title: I'm So Hungry I Could Eat a-

objects.text: Wisdom cannot be contained within one head; somehow the chimeric beast inside of you has grown two additional heads. The three heads are positioned like that of Cerberus, the new heads rising from the left and right of the original head. Alongside that, the chimeric beast grows even larger and more monstrous with this new transformation, the new heads also being more canine in comparison to its previous form. The new being calls themselves the Council, each of the heads possessing separate consciousness and personality, yet the heads share processing power, making their previous wise decisions even wiser, if that is somehow possible. The Council will deliberate on any topic you present to it and bless you with their wisdom. This can range from simple questions, such as asking what you should wear, to seemingly impossible tasks, such as how to defeat an otherworldly force; the difficulty of the task determines how long it will take for them to come to a conclusion, but no matter the task, they will have an answer for you eventually, as the Council's wisdom is boundless... As long as you are capable of dealing with their chatter, because for some reason, they like to talk nonstop among themselves out loud, even though they share a telepathic link with one another. Alongside their cognitive capabilities, the transformation has empowered their other abilities as well, such as their ethereal claws and jaws now combined with their bark, which are capable of shearing through space, carving paths into other dimensions, or decimating opponents. Their bark has been empowered by the three heads capable of simultaneous casting, causing most things in their path to break apart at the subatomic level due to the frequency generated from the synchronicity. Three heads truly are better than one, but maybe consider getting a pair of noise-canceling headphones for the sake of your sanity.
objects.title: Three Heads Are Better Than One

objects.text: Be honest. Did you think that was really how this worked? That a “rulebreaker” is something that can be neatly sorted into one category, assigned one powerset with its own hard limitations? That was an invention, a ruse concocted to limit the damage you could deal if you realized what you really are. You are delusional; that is to say, someone who fundamentally possesses the capacity and the will to decide the rules don’t apply to you. Your consciousness exists independently of your physical form, reality, and your own mind, and it can change any of them with nothing but will. You don’t have to pick one rule to break. You don’t even have to pick two, or six, or a thousand. You are A Rulebreaker, and you are the only thing keeping you from stepping over the boundaries that define possible and impossible. What this means for you is, to start with, you can choose two of the rulebreaker archetypes, and in time you will be able to gain more. Further, you will be able to break smaller rules, including the ones which define the limitations of your rulebreaker powers (even the ones that seem to be pure logistics), with a bit of effort. Over time you will gradually free yourself from any constraints as you adapt to the knowledge that logic and rules are only artificial boundaries you aren’t required to acknowledge. At the distant endpoint of your journey you will find yourself free from any limitations whatsoever, a being of pure will capable of anything. Of course, the issue of unravelling reality remains very real. In fact, now that you’ve rejected even the safety net designed to minimize the damage dealt by people like you the danger is an order of magnitude more severe. If you don’t handle things delicately you could see Reality start to break down within a human lifetime or less. Perhaps you’ll find a way to use your power to maintain it. Perhaps you’ll simply adapt to the new world as it comes.
objects.title: Rulebreaker (RULEBREAKERS, a Reasonable CYOA)

objects.text:
When summoning an Aeon, you can intentionally "misinterpret" your knowledge of the original, creating an altered version. These changes can range from cosmetic ones, like a different hair colour, different clothes, being younger or older than their original, or a different gender, to personality modifications, including making the Aeons unwaveringly loyal to you, and even changing their powers and abilities to better suit your needs.

While you cannot make the Aeon significantly stronger than you already could, you can summon a version more suited for a specific task. For example, if the original was an incredibly peaceful individual, you can summon the Aeon with a more battle-oriented mindset if you are in the middle of a fight.
objects.title: Aeon Alter

objects.text:
When summoning an Aeon of someone who has died, you can instead summon a real mind and soul into the recreated body, allowing for true resurrection. This will work even if the person has been erased from existence by a cosmic law, restoring their mind and soul no matter the damage sustained.

Additionally, the limit for what counts as 'witnessing' has been broadened significantly, allowing you to summon Aeons after seeing a video, a photo, or even an accurate enough drawing or detailed enough description of a person. The only limit still is that the person whose description or photo you see must be real.
objects.title: Incarnation

objects.text:
You can now create aeons of anything you ever witnessed, including animals, inanimate objects like buildings, artefacts, or technology, and even metaphysical structures and phenomena.

For aeons that do not possess an intelligence of their own, like technology and artefacts, you maintain mental control over all of them, capable of accessing any functions the aeons possess, with your multitasking capabilities rising with the number of aeons you summon.

You can summon any number of aeons that lack a soul or consciousness, allowing you to amass an entire fleet after only seeing one ship, for example.
objects.title: Projection

objects.text:
The limitation preventing you from enforcing your own lies has been relaxed.

Your ability may now act upon falsehoods that you personally introduce, provided the statement enters the awareness of another person and remains uncontested long enough for you to enforce it.

For a lie you speak to become eligible for your power, at least one other individual must hear, witness, or otherwise become aware of the statement. The lie must exist within another mind as a potential truth.

If no one challenges the claim before you activate your ability, you may treat the statement as if it originated from someone else and enforce it into reality.

If someone explicitly calls the statement false, the claim becomes temporarily invalid for enforcement.

However, this restriction is not absolute. If the individual who challenged the claim can be convinced that the statement may be true, the contradiction collapses and your power may once again act upon it.

Similarly, the lie does not need universal acceptance. As long as at least one person is aware of the claim and does not directly denounce it as false, even if others do, your ability may still enforce it.

In effect, your lies now exist in a fragile state of social possibility. Once another mind accepts them without opposition, they become viable truths waiting to be realized.

As with Truth, once a falsehood has been enforced into reality it cannot simply be reversed without creating and enforcing another lie to replace it.

Your words now operate on a dangerous principle: If someone believes it, or no one dares deny it, reality may follow.
objects.title: Axiom

addons.text: When you awaken your Authority, it rises from the completeness you already embody—Crown, Body and Soul working as one. Your Authority carries the echo of your Blue Blood's eternal nature, manifesting within you an Eternal Heart that beats with adamant endurance. This heart does not simply sustain your life—it declares that your life was never meant to end. Your Authority, when channeled through this heart, makes your existence harder to extinguish, your flesh harder to destroy, your tenure in the world something that must be permitted rather than taken. You endure where others would perish, not because you are stronger, but because your heart simply refuses to stop. Your Soul unfolds into a Treasure Basin of endless wealth, producing coin that spends anywhere—on physical things like cars and castles, on ephemeral things like favors and secrets, on intangible things like luck and opportunity. This wealth, when bestowed upon people or businesses, carries with it a blessing of Fortune that clings to them like morning light. They find opportunities appearing, deals turning their way, chance favoring their steps. You do not lose what you spend, for the Basin refills as you draw from it, its depths recognizing that infinite wealth is a royal's right to hold and share. Your Crown rises as the sign of your rule, elevating your existence such that you stand above all things. It does not merely mark you as sovereign—it makes you the sovereign, the eternal ruler to come, the one that existence has been waiting for. When you act, you act from above. When you speak, you speak from the throne. When you command reality, you do so as the one reality always intended to sit at its head. Your Authority, complete and crowned, simply is what it was always meant to be.
addons.title: Royal Completion

objects.text: When Crown, Body, and Soul align within you, royalty becomes not what you have—but what you are. From the moment they unite, you feel the shift. Your body and spirit begin to reinforce each other, physical trials strengthen your will where they would break another's, and spiritual trials temper your flesh until you walk away from what should have left you crawling. You are harder to surprise, harder to deceive, harder to harm. The World simply has more difficulty reaching you. As time passes, the resonance deepens. Your Crown learns from your Body and Soul—what tests you, what breaks others, what you overcome again and again. It adapts with you, for you. Talents you lack manifest from nothing and limits you carry dissolve sooner than they would have alone. The three aspects cease to be separate gifts and begin to function as one system, one self, one complete sovereign. When your body endures a curse meant to break it, your Crown bends future curses away before they land. When your soul spends wealth to command what should not be commanded, your Body remembers and becomes harder to exhaust in turn. They teach each other. They become each other. At the peak of this union, you are something complete. Your Blue Blood answers to no force in existence—no possession, no curse, no transformation you do not permit. Grab gravity and suplex it such that it reverses until you desire otherwise, drag time itself to slow it down or step onto it and move faster. Your Golden Soul cannot be claimed by anything without your will and it’s repslendence has become radiant enough to endure non-existence without harm. It’s raw wealth and weight ensures fortune itself is something you create and renew. Where before you bought demons for a continuous cost, you can now do a one time payment for permanent service, the angel not only creates a castle but becomes it’s permanent steward to change or improve it and rituals complete themself instantly. This Weight of your Wealth is truly crushing. Your Crown bends reality so that all of this is simply true, undeniable, the natural order of things. The world inclines toward your will evermore such that you create and demand without denial.
