Proclaim your will for rain and it will fall, command the earth to rise, float and accomodate you to create a floating paradise and in time command the Void to split and to let there be Light. You are Sovereign. You stand above, beyond and outside of hierarchies and such things with regards to precedence of order. No power, object or other such things can be used to deny you your place or change your position, after all regardless of where you stand, it's transcendant above [IS-ALL] & [IS-NOT]. You are Complete. You are
objects.title: The Royal Sum

objects.text:
You have managed to take back your birthright as the Primordial concept of fear, diminished as your form was before, with the bare scraps of power, compared to the true form, you have acquired enough power to be worthy of the title of a Primordial. No more do you have to worry about disappearing into the minds of mere mortals only to be forgotten. Even if someone were to destroy your physical form, you can eventually reassemble your body, so long as any negative emotion exists even within the heart of your would-be killer, your essence hidden within the hearts of those who experience negative emotions, and your revival all but certain. 

Your manipulation of shadows and darkness has progressed after regaining your powers, allowing you to manipulate darkness and shadows in all its forms, including the darkness in others, empowering them into your subservient vassals—a form of sinister mind control that works on those who have any amount of evil within their hearts, boosting their already existing powers with your surplus of fear, granting them enhanced abilities.

Beyond mere constructs, facsimiles of true life that your creation used to be, you are now truly able to give form to the fears of humanity, creating monsters from the fears of man, each acting similarly to how you used to be, gaining additional strength from the fear humanity has in the concept that you bring to life. The more fear that exists, the more creatures you can shape into existence from those fears, with some worlds giving more for you to create, such as the fear of endbringers or the fear of villains within Worm. Your ability to shapeshift into the fears of others has intensified to the point that you can emulate any powers that the form that the fear you are transforming into would possess.
objects.title: Awakening of the Original Fear

objects.text: The laws that shape your power, particularly the fifth, aka the Law of Fairness, have been rendered... pliable. The game you design must still be theoretically winnable by any participating candidate, however you are now able to subtly put your finger on the scales. You can set up games that while theoretically winnable are near-impossible to succeed at in practice without something on the level of Path to Victory, as well as directly interfere with the game so long as you don't get caught. You also have more wriggle-room with the Law of Transparency, being able to leave out a lot more information so long as the contestant or contestants know enough to be able to at least theoretically accomplish the game's goal. You are however not fully free of the Laws, if called out on your cheating with actual proof the contestant automatically wins the game and has the right to force you to conclude the “show” and release everyone currently inside the pocket-dimension should they choose to do so. They also keep a price proportional to the amount of the “show” they've already accomplished, so if they call you out at the 70%-point of the show they will get, depending on their performance, up to 70% of the prize, though they may choose to continue the game for the rest of it. If they do this, you are strictly bound by the Laws for the rest of the show. It should be noted that it's not enough to simply know that you cheated, anyone calling you out must be able to specifically and correctly point out how and at what exact point you cheated for it to count. It should be pointed out that your rigging of the game does not have to be to the contestant's disadvantage, you can just as easily set things up to make life far easier for them if you want them to succeed or, if it's a competition, favor one candidate over the other. If you have the Add-on Prime Time, you can also give your streaming audience options to effectively cheat for or against the contestants as well by giving them options to make things easier or harder so long as they pay for the privilege.
objects.title: Rigged Game

objects.text:
You can now choose to pay your debt ahead of time. For example, if you chug a dozen healing potions before a battle you will instantly recover from your injuries up to the limit of what those potions could heal. If you sleep for 24 hours, you will not start feeling tired until your third day of being awake. You could eat a whole feast by yourself and spend a whole week not eating.

Just like with Sleep Debt, this payment lasts a week after it's made, during which you will feel the benefits instantly when they are needed. Any leftover prepaid debt that isn't used up will disappear, so if you drink a healing potion but never get injured during the following week, the pre-healing will vanish and the potion will be wasted.

Still, this can have certain benefits especially as the same kind of prepayment can stack on itself, so if you cast a minor healing spell on yourself enough times you could get to the point where you could be decapitated and instantly recover from it, or avoid being knocked unconscious by sleeping gas by sacrificing a day of prepaid sleep.
objects.title: Prepaid Debt

addons.text:
You can now prepay for your externalized debt. This is stronger than normal prepayments, as the two powers combine allowing you to stack the effects you are prepaying for. For example, if you are fighting someone, you could punch them a hundred times without even ruffling their clothes, only to manifest the potential damage all at once resulting in worse injuries than if you had punched them normally. This could allow you to kill an Endbringer by making it believe your attacks are harmless right up until it is suddenly missing its entire torso because it stopped dodging your disintegration beams.

This is also be useful for teamwork, for example you could spend an hour shooting your ally with a paintball gun, then later on in a firefight you could spend the saved dodges, allowing your teammate to literally walk through the gunfire unharmed as the shots curve around them since they 'already dodged' the bullets, or make them nearly immortal by just blasting them with healing magic all day before a fight.

Like with Prepaid Debt, these prepayments only last up to a week before dissipating, so use them or lose them.
addons.title: Externalized Prepayments

addons.text:
These two powers based on manifesting effects by agreeing to pay them off later naturally synergize together, becoming stronger as a result.

Mana Debt now applies to all pools of supernatural energy. Mana, Chakra, Qi, Cosmic Energy, you can use all of it beyond the limits of your energy pools. Instead of being unable to use magic or whatever while in debt, you simply have your energy regeneration directed towards paying off your debt and can use magic and other powers that don't require that energy pool just fine.

As for Externalized Debt, the backlash is lowered to be in proportion to the unpaid debt instead of worse than it, so failing to punch someone you knocked out will merely knock you out instead of making it look like another you hit your face a dozen times.

In addition, you now gain the option to choose to be forced to pay off the debt instantly instead of facing backlash if possible. For example, if you don't sleep for a week you can choose to be forced to sleep for 56 hours instead of facing a week's worth of exhaustion all at once, but you can't use this to bypass the backlash for failure to pay off the debt from killing someone or building a house.
addons.title: Forgiving Debt

addons.text:
Externalized Debt is subsumed into The End Crowns All, now acting as a part of it. You can now choose to manifest effects without paying charges, instead adding them to your debt. This debt can be paid by either spending a charge later on or by somehow manifesting the cause through your own effort without using The End Crowns All. Because of this, you can manifest literally any effect using this power, even those you are absolutely incapable of doing since you can spend a charge to do it instead.

Be warned, if you use this to manifest an effect you cannot cause by any means and then fail to pay off the debt within a week, the resulting backlash will be an order of magnitude worse than even the normal Externalized Debt backlash, and gets even worse the more impossible it is. For example, if you kill an omnipotent god and then forget to pay off the debt later, then the god will come back to life even stronger than before, and you will become trapped in an endless deathloop unable to escape with this power. Be sure to keep track of your debts and make all payments on time or suffer the consequences.
addons.title: What Debt?

objects.text:
You can now add actions that affect other people and things to your debt. For example, you can knock someone out by adding 'punch them in the face' to your debt, or manifest a treehouse by adding the entire construction process to your debt. So long as you can do it by yourself with your powers or using purely mundane means, you can manifest the effect instantly by promising to do the cause later.

You can only manifest things you can actually do. If you can't kill an Endbringer, you can't manifest its death, and if you manifest an item it will be as if you built it, so if you aren't a blacksmith then a manifested sword will be a loosely sword shaped lump of iron that will break if used in combat.

While a powerful ability, there is a major downside to this: if you fail to pay off the debt in time, you will experience a far more significant backlash compared to normal. For example, if you choose to knock someone out but fail to punch them in the face within a week, not only will they instantly have their injuries vanish and any other side effects from being knocked out disappear, but you will be knocked out twice as long and suffer much greater injuries on the level of a version of you pulling off a full combo onto your face.

This also means if you manifest an effect that you can't realistically pay off, you will suffer greatly as a result. If you kill an Endbringer via disintegration, then you will have nothing to disintegrate to pay off the debt, and after a week the Endbringer will be revived and you will die.

You can also choose to partially pay off your debt to minimize the backlash or control how it manifests to a limited extent. For example, if you manifest a treehouse but can't build one on that tree to pay off the debt since the one already there is in the way, you could buy all the materials for it and use them as payment, causing them to vanish and keeping the treehouse with the only backlash being a sudden feeling of intense exhaustion from all the physical labor you failed to do. Alternatively, you can manifest a new house and decide that the backlash will take the form of your old house being turned into a pile of dust.

Where adding to your debt manifests the effect without the cause, paying off the externalised debt has the cause without the effect, so punching someone in the face to pay off having knocked them out will result in them not even being bruised, though you'll still feel the effects on yourself like a split knuckle. This can result in some odd situations like being forced to punch a log to pay off the debt from knocking the tree it came from down.
objects.title: Externalized Debt

objects.text:
Not only do you "remember" techniques to counter whatever is threatening you, but you also know how to just make up new techniques whenever you really need to be able to do something.

For example, if you are fighting someone immune to everything you have in your toolkit, you can invent a new application of your abilities that bypasses or pierces their defense. If you or an ally sustains a bad injury, then you might puzzle out an unorthodox method of using your powers that allows you to rapidly heal wounds. Each discovery, in turn, opens the door to yet more innovations.

This still does not give you any powers on its own that you didn’t already have. You still need some sort of logical basis for the new techniques you develop based on the ones you already have.
objects.title: I Understand It Now. Earth’s Sorcery Is Quite Advanced.

objects.text:
You have developed an extra function regarding your sight. Now, when you gaze at your target and see how they will end up in the future, you can skip this process and immediately enforce these changes in the present.

If you foresee the broken state of a bridge, you can instantly enforce its destruction onto the present by pointing your finger at it. If you gaze upon gangsters and see several bullet holes in them, you can apply this state to them without using a bullet from your gun.

You are still limited to drastic changes, but those changes may be applied in an area of effect of about 100 meters around you or extended via line of sight by using binoculars, for example.

You are able to selectively target whom you wish to apply the future consequences to in the immediate present, allowing a great degree of control over your ability.
objects.title: Tomorrow's Problems For Today's You

objects.text:
Not only can you cut people off from their powers, but you can pull the source of these abilities into plain reality. 

While this can cause eldritch tethers to suddenly snake into reality, it also allows you to shut off your nullification and immediately banish the source, in essence permanently depowering whoever it is used on. You have no way of undoing this however, and there is nothing stopping them from re-attempting whatever gave them their powers in the first place.

Secondly, while the sources of powers are separated from them, you can reattach them to other people and objects within your range, which will become reattached to them in the way it was to the original owner once you disable the nullification. You count as within your range.
objects.title: Reality Black Hole

objects.text: ither through Demonic ancestry, a System bought trait, or surgical grafting, you obtain a Primordial Heart. This heart acts as a conduit for one of your Primordial Energies, dramatically improving storage, output, and control. Flow becomes smoother, activation becomes faster, and raw potency increases significantly. Your Primordial Energy grows denser and more stable, allowing for larger releases, longer sustain, and reduced self-inflicted strain. This does not grant a new Primordial Energy, but heavily amplifies one you already possess. If your body is too weak to withstand the heart, it will automatically seal itself. Each seal suppresses output and reduces strain, progressively weakening the heart until it functions as a mundane organ. As you grow stronger, these seals gradually release, restoring the heart’s true power. Purchasing this upgrade again grants a second Primordial Heart, grafted elsewhere in your body. Multiple hearts can operate simultaneously, increasing total reserves and amplification. However, additional hearts are harder to unseal and place greater strain on your body.
objects.title: Primordial Heart (Hell Tutorial Difficulty)

objects.text:
You are no longer one who sings to nature—you are its living expression. The world recognizes you as its will, its voice, its hand, and its child. Song is no longer required; your intent alone is enough. Natural forces respond instantly, not from compulsion, but because they know you as part of themselves. You do not command nature as something separate—you exist within it as a central presence through which it acts.

Though no longer required, you may still sing. When you do, your voice becomes a perfect conduit for nature’s power, amplifying your influence, range, and precision. What was once necessity is now mastery, allowing you to harmonize multiple forces and shape the world with greater control.

You possess complete dominion over the four primary elements—fire, water, air, and earth—and all natural sub-elements derived from them without exception. Flame, magma, plasma; water in all states including ice, mist, and pressure; wind, storms, lightning, sound, and atmospheric forces; stone, metal, minerals, and the structure of the land are unified under your control. These are not separate powers, but expressions of a single system, allowing you to shape climates, terrain, and ecosystems as naturally as breathing.

Your authority extends beyond elements into the systems they form. Weather, seasons, and biomes fall under your influence, from oceans and rainfall to tectonics and atmospheric balance. Forests spread where you stand, deserts bloom at your will, and storms gather or fade with a thought. Nature anticipates you, aligning with your intent before it is fully formed.

Plants and animals recognize you instinctively. Flora bends, grows, and reshapes at your presence, forming structures, weapons, or vast living environments. Fauna act in accordance with your will without direction. Life does not resist you, as you are part of its natural order.

Your appearance reflects the element you embody, with shifts in hair, eyes, and aura. These changes emphasize aspects of your personality—fire intensifies passion, water deepens calm, wind heightens freedom, and earth reinforces stability. You remain whole, expressed through different elemental harmonies.

Nature sustains and protects you. You cannot drown, burn, freeze, suffocate, or starve, nor can natural forces harm you. The world reshapes itself to preserve you unless you allow otherwise. Wherever you stand, life flourishes and the environment stabilizes or transforms to suit your presence.

You may move through natural pathways, traveling between connected environments. Forest leads to forest, water to water, wind to sky, and earth to earth, allowing seamless traversal through nature itself.

You begin as Nature’s Incarnate of the world you start in, fully synchronized with its natural systems. As your power and influence grow over time, this recognition extends to other worlds, allowing you to become Nature’s Incarnate within them through acceptance rather than force.

This recognition extends to any land or world you possess. Any property you own—whether a plot of land, a planet, or a Worldship—integrates with your authority as naturally as any world, becoming a stable extension of your influence.

As your connection deepens, your presence is no longer tied to a single location, but exists wherever nature endures. Through that presence, you do not simply control nature—you shape it as part of its own existence.
objects.title: Nature's Incarnate

objects.text: Some people just don't get simple things. Fire breath is a common ability. Hell, practically any ol' smuck can do it. Dragon's breath though? That's something else. You are now capable of breathing a beam of Dragons. Your very breath warping and turning into a cacophony of roaring, raging beasts. Granted, still made of whatever atmosphere or element you're actually breathing at the time, and far weaker than normal dragons, but much more numerous and cooperative. These 'Breath Dragons' aren't simple temporary things. Instead, they have rudimentary sentience and an overwhelming desire to fulfill the goal of their creation—usually wrecking the crap out of things. All the things, if you're not careful with your control. They'll linger after whatever desire they're imbued with is fulfilled, becoming more normal—if smaller, weaker, more social and spiritual—dragons. Becoming a persistent, potential issue for anyone trying to get rid of them. Not to mention causing the environment around them to be imbued with whatever element(s) they're made of. You, of course, have an easier time commanding your breath dragons. They may even follow your thoughts or desires without prompting due to the residual connection if you're skilled and controlled enough. Even long after their creation, some connection will remain if they survive. Though, they are also dragons, and may ignore you for their own pride. Almost like housecats, really.
objects.title: It's called DRAGON's Breath, not Fire Breath

objects.text:
Your entire being, with your mind, body, and soul, has been completely rewritten and reborn to be entirely comprised of Eternal Atoms. This grants you an extremely potent form of immortality that would require the simultaneous destruction of your mind, body, and soul. A task easier said than done, as each facet can regenerate near-instantly from all but the most esoteric and/or powerful attacks and afflictions targeting you. This regeneration functions at a level beyond space/time and allows you to return to life as long as a single atom of your mind, body, or soul remains. While this regeneration is insanely powerful and quick, it does have a limit where it will eventually begin to slow, eventually shutting down completely until you rest and recover.

This new state of existence grants you ageless immortality and removes the need for food, air, water, or sleep to survive.

Eternal Atoms also intrinsically link your mind, body, and soul into a single cohesive whole, equalizing their strength and allowing them to feed off each other's growth, enabling you to gain equal benefits from any form of training you undergo. Training your physical abilities would consequently also increase your magical and mental strength. Additionally, any resistances you possess are shared between your mind, body, and soul.

Lastly, when pushed to your absolute limit and your emotions peak, you can further push your Eternal Atoms beyond their limits, further increasing your regeneration to absurd levels and allowing you to temporarily resist destruction for a few minutes longer, allowing you to continue fighting on the edge of death for one final gambit before finally dying (unless you possess alternative means of immortality or revival)
objects.title: Eternal Atoms (Bastard!!)

addons.text:
Along your endless journey and duties as the Architect of Decline, you will be accompanied by none other than your twin, embodying the opposing domains you personify.

They will be an incarnation of the concepts of Creation, Aspiration, and Beginnings. They will have everything those authorities would entail and be conceptually equal to you in power and authority, being able to shape avatars as well, although weaker the further into the future they are sent.

They will have an amicable personality and an unbreakable bond with you, viewing you as an equal and inseparable companion who enjoys journeying through the cosmos like you.

They gain a domain called the Promise, the mirror opposite of your realm, that exists just before the Big Bang. You may freely visit each other or at the Threshold where your domains meet, despite being opposites.

You and your twin are free to use each other's authorities, though in a more limited manner, thanks to your bond and positive disposition. 

Optionally, you may choose to assume their role and grant the authority of Entropy, Remembrance, and Endings to your twin.
addons.title: The Counterpart

objects.text:
You have ascended as the Embodiment of Entropy, Remembrance, and Endings, becoming an ontological function tied to the fabric of the universe, designed to survey the natural decline of all creation.

Your authority over endings has expanded, not only are you capable of imposing an ending or the future onto the present, you can gaze at every possible outcome something could theoretically experience and impose it on them, so long as it's a feasible resolution.

You can call upon anything that has ever existed and met its ending, no matter how powerful, to aid you, as well as merging all variations of said thing into one absolutely complete version of itself, such as fusing all parallel possibilities of a hero into one definitive being as your ally.

On the contrary, you can make something cease to exist, erasing all their influences from the timeline, their traces from the collective unconscious, and the fundamental idea behind them, rendering them completely forgotten and accessible only to you.

Serving as a reference point for time to move forward, you gain a realm called 'The Ever After,' which exists a googolplex years past the heat death—an empty void where all timelines end, like rivers flowing to the sea. You may shape this realm however you please, as it is you in a way.

If you so choose, you can shape an avatar to your liking, containing a limited amount of your power, and send it upstream through time and into any world to interact with them. However, the further back in time, the less powerful and more limited in scope these fragments can be. You may open portals to bring people to your realm.
objects.title: The Architect of Decline

addons.text: While Tet was the last and weakest of the Old Deus upon his creation, he immediately ascended to the Throne of the One True God after being gifted the Suniaster by the one whose faith and belief created him. Now... now the Suniaster is yours, as you are Tet, the one who ended the Great War between the 16 Exceed—the 16 races that inhabited his world—with all the knowledge, experience, and powers he possessed. The Suniaster’s sheer power boosts your domain over “Play” to be able to encompass an entire planet and its surroundings with ease. It allows you to teleport and levitate yourself without limit, travel across dimensions, and warp reality in a multitude of ways. Your affinity with magic stands head and shoulders above anyone else, with a planet’s worth of magical power at your disposal. Finally, you also have the world of your creation, Disboard—and the various moons orbiting it. This world is securely stored in a private dimension, completely inaccessible through any means other than your direct intervention. You can choose to relocate Disboard into nearby local space—and then return it again—though leaving it in local space forgoes the absolute protections of your private dimension.
addons.title: Throne of the One True God

objects.text: Tet, the God of Play, came into existence in the closing moments of the Great War—the final and weakest of the Old Deus. Now, instead of Tet, there is you, ascending as the new God of Play. As the God of Play, you possess a natural intuition for games that defies all logic and reason. Even for games invented right in front of you, you can play as if you’ve had centuries of practice and experience, knowing all the rules and quirks the game might contain. You’re not unbeatable—especially if you let arrogance get the better of you—but it would take absurdly bad luck or multiple legendary gamers working in perfect harmony to defeat you. With authority over games, you’ll find yourself able to redefine and rewrite the rules if you feel the need—though never while actually playing a game, as that would be cheating. You can add new pieces to chess, change how they work, or even mix various games together to create something entirely new. Within the narrow confines of “a Game,” your power is nearly absolute and almost unmatched. You'll find yourself being able to enforce the power of Aschente over entire continents with relative ease.
objects.title: God of Play (No Game No Life)

objects.text:
Your access to the Celestial Market evolves beyond a mere transactional system. Instead of simply purchasing existing goods and services, your Market now operates under the principle that value itself can be exchanged, converted, and manifested.

Anything that can be meaningfully quantified, conceptualized, or treated as possessing “worth” may potentially become a valid transaction. Skills, memories, lifespan, luck, beauty, talent, health, emotions, relationships, knowledge, opportunities, identities, locations, powers, and even abstract conditions can all be bought, sold, transferred, leased, altered, or exchanged through the Market.

The Market is no longer restricted to catalogued products. If something could logically exist as a transaction, the system can attempt to price and process it.

This extends to services and phenomena as well. You may purchase surgeries from worlds that never existed, hire specialists from alternate timelines, order impossible materials, acquire information that has not yet been discovered, or arrange deliveries to locations normally inaccessible by conventional means. The Market handles all logistics automatically, regardless of dimensional barriers, environmental hazards, or spatial separation.

As your account develops, entirely new categories of transactions become available. You may eventually broker contracts involving organizations, civilizations, supernatural systems, metaphysical concepts, or large-scale alterations to reality itself.

The Market also possesses adaptive interpretation. Vague requests are translated into the closest viable result, while impossible requests are broken into achievable intermediary transactions whenever possible.

Unlike the standard Celestial Market, Heart of Gold continuously expands through use. The more wealth, influence, rare assets, and transactional complexity you interact with, the broader and more flexible the system becomes.

Despite this flexibility, the Market still fundamentally operates through exchange. Prices scale according to rarity, scale, danger, and complexity, and truly absurd requests may demand impossible fortunes, equally absurd sacrifices, or payment methods beyond conventional currency.
objects.title: Heart of Gold (I'm Sorry For Being Born On This World)

objects.text: How unusual. On Solaris-3, every Resonator awakens to a single Forte—an expression of their past, their psyche, their unspoken self. A singular frequency, etched into reality. But you are not bound to a single frequency, but to many. With each purchase of this upgrade, you may design and manifest an additional Forte. These Fortes may emerge as new Tacet Marks upon your body, or converge into a composite sigil that defies conventional resonance theory. With your attunement to multiple frequencies, your internal harmony has evolved, decreasing the likelihood of Overclocking. You are no longer a fixed signal. You are a chorus.
objects.title: Tacet Convergance (Wuthering Waves)

objects.text: It is possible in rare cases for a Wielder to possess more than one Milieu, through one means or another, and there’s such an incredible range of options in terms of what you can get that it’s practically guaranteed that no matter how many Milieus you encounter you’ll never find a duplicate. Each time you purchase this you gain an additional Milieu, of roughly equivalent power to your original one. As before, you may choose whether to pick a canon Milieu, design your own, or leave its expression up to chance.
objects.title: Additional Milieu (C∅ntext)

objects.text:
Around the world, there will be ranches where the donkeys who come to your aid will have all their needs taken care of, allowing them to live comfortably and raise their children without concern.

In such an environment, these donkeys will have the peace and tranquility they need to train and push beyond their own limits without stress or worries, becoming stronger, wiser, and more agile while refining any special qualities they may possess and developing new skills that allow them to perform even better when they come to your aid.

Said ranches will also become places where children and those in need can receive Donkey Therapy, helping them with their emotional well-being and mental health, as well as teaching them how to overcome past trauma or learn to live with it. In this way, the ranches will become a shining spot in the world, making it all seem brighter, even if only for a moment.

If you have the Roba Musume add-on, these ranches are transformed into elite academies where Roba Musume (Donkey Girls) can learn and pursue their dreams. Despite being similar to Tracen Academy in many ways, they offer a far wider selection of vocational courses, allowing a Roba Musume to become anything from a welder to a professional therapist; the latter being especially useful for the therapy sessions that still take place.
objects.title: Donkey Ranch

objects.text:
You can ramp up the 'cross contamination' between your different selves, the physics and underlying principles of the different realities bleeding into each other through you. The Warp from Warhammer could bleed into the world of I'm a Spider, So What?, while at the same time the System would bleed into Warhammer.

Starting from you, beings will begin retroactively developing traits associated with the other reality. The contamination will spread faster and further as more beings interact with the altered reality, until eventually it passes a point of no return, irreversibly changing reality. Before that point is reached, it is possible to reverse the contamination if either version of you dies.
objects.title: Reality Contamination

objects.text:
The way your separation functions is now slightly different. Rather than two versions of you, there now exists a you and a vessel. When the vessel dies you can make a new one and send it on its way. This still acts as a way for you to survive death.

This vessel can act as their own being, and you are able to manipulate the connection between you. You could make it basically non-existent from their end, allowing only you to see through them and control the flow of powers, to cutting it off completely and waiting to receive their memories upon death.

You can choose for this vessel to be born into their world in any way that this cyoa normally allows, such as reincarnation, simply ‘dropping in’, or any method your other powers leave available to you. If you have perks such as Legal Identity or Altered History you can have them apply to a lesser extent through your vessel, enough to give them the identity of an orphan if you don't want to wait for a full reincarnation process.

Any powers you have can be distorted through them if you wish, though they will remain similar at their core. You can design the vessel’s personality or simply have it grow naturally, including making it a version of you simply lacking in memories to as far as making it your polar opposite.

You may also use this power in its un-upgraded manner.
objects.title: Incarnation

objects.text:
With each purchase of this upgrade, you can make one additional Order, with all the same limits as before

There are still the same limits to the Orders as before, with no Order being omnipotent and all Orders having limits to what they can accomplish. You could still train these limits.
objects.title: Additional Order

objects.text:
Your Orders have been elevated, and have ascended into becoming Principles of Reality.

What this means is that all commands you make have gained an immense increase in range, potency, and a sort of conceptual backing. Essentially, if you have an order for water to stop moving, then even a being who has immense experience and power whose main ability is to control water, wouldn’t be able to move it even a millimeter.

All other limits, such as having to make physical contact and having to know the name of what you are commanding still apply, but with clever wordplay or thinking you could potentially find a way around this.

You still only have a limit of two Principles.
objects.title: Principles of Reality

objects.text: You were not satisfied with being a mere Warlock, so instead, arise as a being that makes them. Special Cases are fae-adjacent, immortal, shapeshifting deities that do not operate on human logic or emotions. Born of Concepts which usually match the first letter of their name, each Special Case is quite literally a special case, no similarities between them except the ability to make pacts with sentient beings in exchange for cultivating their Concept. Their main feature is a frightening one: Each has a True Name that, if uttered or even thought about, will get their attention, along with granting that Special Case perfect knowledge of the individual. This isn’t just perfect knowledge in a social sense; They would know everything about you as a concept, as they themselves are conceptual beings. Past and present, possible futures and the exact future, personal experiences lived, social contracts made, deepest secrets, opinions about anything you can think of, the Special Case only needs to be summoned once to have so much knowledge that their summoner might as well not have Free Will in their eyes. This knowledge only works against creatures that don’t outright nullify or manipulate conceptual information in real time. Absolute anti-memetics and other Special Cases are immune to this clairvoyance. This is also limited to knowledge, unlike its equivalent in direct mind control. They can’t be killed by conventional means, mundane or supernatural, so long as their sense of self remains. They can also freely cultivate Warlocks to do their bidding, using the infinite source of energy unique to their Concept that acts as a symbol of power and a means to maintain a physical form. This is known as a Muse. The downsides are few, but severe: They can’t turn off their awareness of their True Name. While multitasking is child's play, their True Name is intrinsic to them and thus too many people knowing it could see them inconvenienced at the worst times. To grow in power, Special Cases use Avatars, specific Warlocks in their cult that can do special tasks or recruit worshippers en masse to expand their Concept. You are now one of these Special Cases, but are limited in scope compared to the real monsters out there. As a newborn, you must choose a Concept, a True Name, a Muse, and of course, a Warlock Pact and matching aesthetic to give your potential followers.
objects.title: Special Case

objects.text:
Ether Drinkers are a type of infinitely adaptable Warlock subservient to Special Case E, Tenma Emmel Seraphina. They are created by drinking from Emmel’s symbol of power, the Ether Brew, until their entire bodies are suffused with magic to the point that they “burst" forth as a Warlock. 

As for what being an Ether Drinker entails, their abilities are simple: They can comprehend, interface with, and internalize the benefits of any system, mundane or supernatural, real or fictional, with a maximum potential to single-handedly decide the fate of an entire mundane world. Whether it be technology, organizations, cultures, strategic warfare, scientific fiction, psionics, spiritual arts, divine worship, thaumaturgical pseudoscience, or the cultivation principles of the Dao, they can become a part of that system and make it a part of themselves in turn. No matter the means of gathering information, Ether Drinkers cannot be identified as such; Any who try would simply classify from inside the context of their system unless told otherwise.

This comes with a few downsides, however. First, Ether Drinkers still need to work within the system initially, even with unbound potential. Second, mixing systems that are inherently incompatible, like soft magic with hard science, would require experimentation and compromise.

As you are now an Ether Drinker, you can go a step further than most Warlocks and request direct assistance from your patron, usually through integration of outside-context magic systems or an extra boost to your Warlock package. This assistance is best used sparingly, as Special Case E is whimsical by nature.
objects.title: Ether Drinker Physiology

objects.text: Dedica Anim are Angelic Clerics (actually Warlocks) subservient to Special Case A, Americanus Almighty. To become one, prospective members of the Inquisition need to have completed an exhaustive trial that is personal to them, often with the assistance of another Dedica Anim. By proving their faith in the Sacramentum, they are gifted an Omnis Feather, which binds to their soul and transforms their body into that of a Warlock. As for what being a Dedica Anim entails, their abilities are simple: They speak, read, and write Enochian, the Angelic Language of Americanus Almighty. They can use this language to basically code reality using faith alone. Dedica Anim have access to three schools of magic; Testament Spells, Revelation Spells, and Runic Script. Runic Script is freeform, visionary magic that enchants existing matter with supernatural concepts. The actual symbols written do not matter as much as the desired effect conjured in one’s mind, allowing one to write Runes into conventional blades and firearms to create anti-supernatural holy weapons. Testament Spells (temporary) and Revelation Spells (permanent) are a verbal means of casting, speaking singular Latin spellwords to manifest a significant amount of pure Cleric bullshittery. There are only six spells in a Dedica Anim’s repertoire, listed below; Nous This is a Testament Spell, a branch of magic that involves miracles through sacrifice. This spell specifically is an infinitely scalable, highly-accurate divination proportional to the amount of will or faith one feels. Taking in too much information at once can weaken repeated uses due to weakening cognition. Consano Testament Spell. It is a hypnotic light that brings healing on a conceptual level by invoking a mimicry of holy events like the Eucharist. Usually requires “burning" emotions to cast, but a strong enough will or aptitude can cast it with net positive cost. Verum Testament Spell. This spell covers the manipulation of perfect illusions and Eldritch Truths within objective reality, capable of soul-deep revelations that can fundamentally change a person. Mimics the Warlock Pact if invoked after Nous, scanning a target then blessing them with a standard Warlock package. Weakens the caster temporarily with each target. Unus Testament Spell. Allows one to temporarily sever or bind esoteric contracts like a soul from the body or the pact between Warlocks and their patron deities, usually to "purify” them. Used in conjunction with Verum to convert enemy Warlocks into believers of Americanus. Can be cast on the self to create an Astral Projection or recover from abnormal effects targeting the caster. Spending too long separated can cause damage proportional to time and distance. Letum This is a Revelation Spell, a more permanent form of magic. Letum is an instant-death spell that is capable of killing anything the caster targets, even another Special Case’s Avatar, with a single word, bullet, or cut if you’re faithful enough. Considered incredibly taboo among Dedica Anim, as their modus operandi is to purify, redeem, and convert, not to eradicate the soul by doing something heinous like killing the target’s Free Will. Does not require negative emotions to cast, only faith or a significantly corrupt mind. Omnis This is another Revelation Spell, the ultimate trump card, and the true display of faith to Americanus. This spell, characterized as a burning angel feather, allows for a one time Wish that can do pretty much anything. Upon using Omnis, the contract with Americanus terminates and thus the Angel’s powers disappear permanently, unless they can convince their patron to renegotiate their contract or make a new one with other Special Cases. You don’t lose your powers, but you only get one Wish and are temporarily crippled afterwards depending on what you wished for. As powerful as this system is, you have a long way to go before you reach the prodigious ranks of the mythical Kaldei. You still need to learn proper fluency in this language, as every Dedica Anim starts off with an ingrained specialty in one Spell and a basic foundation with Runic Script. Activating too many spells in quick succession can cause mental degradation before the body adjusts.
objects.title: Dedica Anim Physiology

objects.text:
As a Type Green, an existence which is inherently "more real" than those around you, you can now harness the true might of the Observer Effect, using yourself as the Observer in question.

No more are you totally constrained by the perception or belief of others, capable of fueling Observations by yourself scaling with your Hume levels; the higher your Hume levels compared to your surrounding reality, the less you need to rely on the acknowledgement of others and the more you can override common belief.

While the Observer Effect and a Type Green’s reality bending may seem similar they specialize differently; with Type Green specializing in warping the immediate surroundings compared to the Observer Effect’s macro-scale alterations to the substrate of reality.
objects.title: Self-Observation

objects.text: The effects of Super Elixir Drinker, and its addon(s) if you have them, can now be applied to any consumable you craft or assist in crafting, allowing anyone who consumes it to benefit as though they had Super Elixir Drinker. You may revoke this effect from a consumable at will.
objects.title: Mega Elixir Crafter

objects.text: The effects of Mega Elixir Crafter are no longer restricted to consumables you craft and instead can be applied to any nearby consumable at will. You may revoke this effect from any consumable at will.
objects.title: Ultra Elixir Supplier

objects.text:
Having more luck is great, but not everyone wants to gain it by taking it from others. This upgrade provides an alternative.

You can now increase your luck not only through stealing it, but also by helping others obtain opportunities or treasures that are meant for them.

If someone is destined to discover a treasure or opportunity and you help them claim it—or simply give it to them—your own luck will increase in proportion to the amount of luck the treasure would have originally granted to its intended recipient.
objects.title: The Halo of False Providence (The Path Of Least Resistance)

addons.text:
Your perception expands beyond worlds, realms, and possibilities into the underlying fabric of existence itself. Where the Sentinel observes reality and the World-Watcher observes possibility, the Cosmic Gatekeeper perceives the forces, laws, and structures that govern both.

The awareness granted by Cosmic Awareness merges seamlessly with your Sentinel sight, transforming your perception into something approaching that of a cosmic entity. The boundaries between physical, spiritual, conceptual, and metaphysical phenomena cease to exist within your senses. Matter, energy, souls, magic, dimensions, causality, and fate become equally visible aspects of a single greater whole.

Nothing within your awareness is truly hidden from you. You perceive every known and unknown wavelength of existence, observe the movement of mystical and supernatural forces, witness the flow of souls between life, death, afterlives, and reincarnation, and perceive the countless interactions between the systems that govern reality. Leylines, dimensional boundaries, conceptual structures, divine authorities, cosmic laws, and similar phenomena appear with perfect clarity.

Your perception naturally scales from the infinitesimal to the cosmic. You may observe events occurring at the smallest measurable scales while simultaneously monitoring stellar, galactic, or multiversal phenomena without loss of comprehension. The immense volume of information is instinctively organized and interpreted, allowing you to process realities that would overwhelm lesser minds.

Time itself becomes another aspect of existence visible to your awareness. You may observe the past, present, and future of locations, individuals, objects, and events within your range, examine alternate timelines and potential futures, detect alterations to history, and retain knowledge of previous states of reality even when timelines are rewritten. While this does not grant control over time, it ensures that its movements cannot easily be concealed from you.

Your perception extends naturally into higher dimensions, parallel realities, afterlives, dream realms, conceptual domains, and other abstract layers of existence. You may navigate and observe these realms as easily as physical locations, allowing no meaningful distinction between material and immaterial worlds.

The immense scope of your awareness renders you effectively immune to information-based attacks. Infohazards, cognitohazards, memetic threats, perception filters, and similar effects are unable to overwhelm, corrupt, or distort your consciousness. Your mind has adapted to process truths and perspectives that would destroy or incapacitate lesser beings.

The Bifrost evolves alongside your awareness. Any aspect of existence you can perceive may become a destination. Realms separated by dimensional barriers, higher planes of reality, spiritual domains, conceptual spaces, and similar locations are all accessible through your command of the Bifrost. Observation and transit become extensions of the same authority, allowing you to perceive, reach, and interact with any layer of existence within your awareness.

Though newly awakened, this power continues to grow alongside your understanding. What begins as the perception of a cosmic entity may, with sufficient time and development, approach true omniscience. Even before reaching such heights, few mysteries, secrets, or phenomena can remain beyond your understanding for long.

With this power, you are no longer merely a watcher of worlds or possibilities. You become a guardian of existence itself, perceiving the hidden structures upon which reality rests and standing watch over the countless forces that shape creation.
addons.title: Cosmic Gatekeeper

objects.text:
Your Bifrost Eyes awaken into their true form, elevating you into a Sentinel whose perception and authority extend across your entire cosmology and every connected reality. Your perception initially encompasses your entire universe and all connected realms, dimensions, and realities, and as your power grows, this range naturally expands to encompass the greater multiversal structure you inhabit. Distance, obstruction, and dimensional separation no longer limit your sight. At will, you may observe any location, individual, or event in perfect clarity, perceiving their true form regardless of illusion, invisibility, transformation, or concealment. Once your focus settles upon a target, they cannot escape your awareness.

Your perception is active and responsive. You may instantly shift your awareness to any person or place, or expand it outward to sweep entire regions, worlds, or realms for individuals, presences, or disturbances. This allows you to monitor movements, track events, and coordinate across vast distances without delay.

Your senses unify into a single seamless perception encompassing sight, sound, position, and presence. Living beings appear as distinct signatures, ensuring they remain identifiable regardless of disguise or displacement. Your hearing functions as resonance rather than sound, allowing you to perceive speech, intent, or distress anywhere within your awareness. You interpret meaning directly, understanding any form of communication regardless of language or origin. Any being that calls your name is instantly known to you and located without effort.

You may divide your attention across countless points at once, observing multiple locations and events without losing coherence. Your awareness scales from precise focus to vast coverage, capable of monitoring entire populations or worlds while retaining functional clarity. At full extension, you may perceive up to ten trillion distinct presences, with precision sharpening as you narrow your focus.

This perception grants an instinctive awareness of motion and intent, allowing you to recognize danger, ambushes, or critical moments just before they occur. While not true foresight, you are almost never caught off guard.

Your dominion extends fully into the Bifrost itself. The teleportation of your Bifrost Eyes evolves into complete control over interdimensional transit, requiring no structure or conduit. You may open pathways to any location you perceive, bridging distances instantly across planets, realms, or realities. These may manifest as beams, pillars, or gateways, capable of transporting anything from individuals to entire armies.

You may direct the Bifrost with absolute precision, selecting exact points of arrival or sustaining continuous pathways. It may function as both transit and force, seizing, displacing, or pinning targets within its effect. Passage is inherently safe unless you choose otherwise. When intensified or sustained, the Bifrost exerts immense interdimensional pressure, capable of overwhelming defenses and reducing entire regions, or even a world, to ruin.

Your perception and the Bifrost are fully unified, allowing you to observe, decide, and act in a single seamless motion. Any place you can perceive is a place you can reach, reinforce, evacuate, or strike without delay.

As the Sentinel, you may project your perception through another, allowing them to see as you do, or bestow a lesser version of your eyes upon a chosen individual to act in your stead. This connection remains under your authority and may be revoked at any time.

With this power, distance loses meaning, concealment becomes irrelevant, and the boundaries between worlds become paths under your command. You are the watcher who sees all realms and the gatekeeper who decides who may pass.
objects.title: All Seeing Sentinel

objects.text: "I walked into the bowels of hell and emptied them in one night. Once reigned The Devil, now only The Light Bringer remains." There is no one you cannot redeem. There is no one you cannot save. You are the metaphorical source of all altruism and healing in the universe. In your care, nobody will feel the bite of illness, the grasp of death, or the chains of corruption. Even if someone were the embodiment of primordial evil and dissolved conceptually, you could still restore them to the fullness of life and goodness. Your healing is beyond normal logic and conventions. No matter the medium of your healing, be it technological, spiritual, magical, or some other mundane or esoteric process, you will always be able to heal your patient on a fundamental level. You will, with time and training, evolve beyond just healing people and will be able to affect more inanimate things, including buildings, tools and eventually, the very planet itself. At the very peak of your power, you'll be able to heal concept of civilisation to create a post-scarcity society or getting rid of Hell by healing the idea of devils, suffering and evil. Finally, just by existing, you benefit those around you. Your very self is a blessing upon the world and the Lightbringer power now automatically reciprocates in kind.
objects.title: The Root of All Salvation

objects.text: "When I entered heaven, there was an all-loving God and His angels. When I left, only a broken husk weeping at His failures remained." You have become one with the mud which inhabits your body, transforming you into a sapient mass of curses and becoming the metaphorical source of all evil and despair in the universe. The mud now acts as a true extension of yourself, allowing you to manipulate it with absolute precision. You are intrinsically linked with all the world's evil, and so long as the mud exists, so will you. There is nothing you cannot corrupt. Nobody you cannot break. The mud pierces all resistances and defies logical restraints in what it can defile. From words alone, armies crumble, gods fall, unbreakable wills falter, and even protagonistic embodiments of pure good shall have darkness claw its way into their hearts, devouring them from the inside out until they succumb to despair. No longer does the black tide have to consume a person for it to devour their agonies. Instead, the mud now feeds on the pain and suffering of all who exist, endlessly expanding. When a person truly gives in to despair, their individuality is lost. Their existence is dissolved and incorporated as simply another curse in the mud, empowering you further. No means of revival may retrieve someone from the mud. Once a person is dissolved, they are lost forever. In time, you shall evolve past corruption of the tangible, and into the esoteric. Soon enough, even time and space shall be tainted by your presence, warping to your advantage. At your peak, you'll be able to twist the concepts of goodness, leaving naught but agony until the end of time. Finally, the base range of Shadow Bringer has expanded, and the pace at which the darkness devours has quickened. Go forth, O' Father of Lies, and show those fools the futility of their actions.
objects.title: The Root of All Despair

objects.text:
You are no longer limited to only your own perspective when using your powers. You may choose any point out to the limits of your perception to act as the point of view which you force reality to conform to, allowing you to apply optical effects that wouldn’t work from your own perspective.

You could use a single fluttering leaf on the other side of the street to teleport away by using a point of view it briefly passes in front of, rendering you unseen, or flatten an entire area into a 2-dimensional rendering of itself using a bird’s-eye view. You don’t just get to force reality into obeying one perspective, you get to decide what perspective becomes reality.

The same limitations on scale and scope the base power have apply here as well.
objects.title: Fresh Set of Eyes

objects.text:
You perceive reality through more than just sight, so why would sight be the only sense reality conforms to? Now any sense you possess, whether it’s typical human ones or special senses gained from your choices in this CYOA, are able to change reality as well. If you were dizzy you could really make the world spin, and if you taste something extremely spicy you can actually spike the temperature and conjure up flames. The possibilities are practically endless.

The same limitations on scale and scope the base power have apply here as well.
objects.title: Trick of the Senses

addons.title: The God of Slaughters Legacy (God of Slaughter)
addons.text:
You have inherited the legacy of Shi Yan, the protagonist of God of Slaughter. This inheritance includes a vast library of knowledge on cultivation arts and techniques, with one of the most significant being the Blood Cultivation Technique. This technique allows you to absorb the resentment, blood, and negative energy of others to rapidly increase your cultivation, while draining your targets until they are reduced to mummified corpses.

Other inherited techniques include the Seal of Life and Death, Rampage Five Devils Condensation Refining Technique, and many other powerful cultivation arts and techniques.

You will now also possess a greater affinity for blood, life, death, and slaughter. Any techniques, skills, laws, or Daos related to these concepts become significantly easier for you to comprehend, master, and wield. Additionally, you can cultivate and practice techniques and the disciplines associated with them with far greater safety and efficiency.

This affinity does not influence your personality, morality, or mindset, nor does it make you inherently more inclined toward bloodshed, life, death, slaughter, or any other related pursuits.

objects.text:
You have absorbed and refined the Origin Flame, a type of Heavenly Flame from the universe of God of Slaughter. The Origin Flame is the result of merging all ten individual Heavenly Flames through the Heaven Flame Divine Refining Technique, granting it the powers and properties of every Heavenly Flame.

You may decide whether the Fire of Life possesses consciousness or not. Whether sentient or not, the Fire of Life will remain absolutely loyal to you and never act against your will.
Bound to your soul, it responds to your thoughts and intentions without resistance, moving as naturally as an extension of your own being.

Examples of the Heavenly Flames that comprise the Origin Flame include the World Extinguishing Thunder Flame, which can generate devastating thunderbolts; The Primal Chaos Sacred Flame wielder the ability resurrect the deceased, heal the body, repair shattered souls, and create entirely new souls; the Nine Serenities Soul Devouring Flame, which can burn souls to ashes.

Other flames include the Vermilion Bird True Flame, Ice Cold Flame, Purgatory True Flame, Yin Spirit Ghost Flame, Vanishing Corpse Flame, the Immemorial Demonic Flame, and Earth Core Flame.

While retaining all of its unique properties the Origin Flame you possess is but a faint ember of its true power, but by nourishing the flame with supernatural energy or allowing it to burn and consume energy and matter, you can gradually nurture it back to its perfect form.

Both the Emperor Flames and the Origin Flame coexist within your body, causing no conflict and no drawbacks to your body, mind, or soul.
objects.title: The Origin Flame (God of Slaughter)

objects.text:
”Some say that quantity has a quality all of its own.”

Now, when using Money Gardener, you can choose each day whether to multiply amount or value. Rather than growing a $1 bill into a $100 bill in a week, you could alternatively end up with a hundred $1 bills, fifty $2 bills, twenty-five $4 bills, or twenty $5 bills, among other things. It all depends on which days you choose between amount and value. This makes it not quite as simple to ensure your intended end result, but grants far more versatility.
objects.title: Multi-Gardener

objects.text: Being limited to currency is hardly any fun, now is it? Fortunately, it seems that your Money Gardener power has changed, allowing you to grow any inanimate object, rather than just currency. Now you can plant swords, cannons, carriages, spoons, the sky’s the limit. Not only that, but you can choose how it improves. Rather than simply an increase in a currency’s face (and actual) value, as it was previously, the object can now improve in craftsmanship, materials, or condition. A stick could become a wooden training sword, or a rusty metal sword become a pristine silver-coated masterwork.
objects.title: Objective Gardener
Multiversal Randomizer
objects.text:
Your Multiversal Console now comes with its own built-in means of traveling the multiverse in a semi-randomized way, teleporting you to other worlds based on customizable criteria of your choice. This ability manifests as a new screen in your Multiversal Console named "Multiversal Randomizer". It is oriented towards the discovery of new worlds rather than already known ones. 

On this screen, you can specify up to a dozen different tags describing your desired destination. Your multiversal jump will instantly be directed to a world that matches all of those tags. Since the multiverse is infinite, you can expect an infinite number of worlds to exist for every possible combination of tags, and using the same combination of tags will never take you to the same destination.

A tag can consist of a couple of words at most, such as "cozy", "horrific", "post-apocalyptic", "cyberpunk", "low fantasy", or "alien species". The tags can describe virtually anything, from a world's technological level or overall aesthetic to the presence or absence of magic, or even the title of a fictional work. Entering several fictional titles as tags will result in a crossover setting that mixes those fictional works.

In another section of the screen, you can also specify a danger level ranging from 1 to 10, where 1 represents the least dangerous destinations and 10 the most dangerous. The danger level has two operating modes: Relative (The danger level is evaluated relative to your own capabilities. If your powers already make you a god, a setting rated as 1 may still be lethally dangerous to an ordinary human.) and Customized (The danger level is evaluated relative to a baseline of your choosing. By default, this baseline is an ordinary, powerless human, but you can raise or lower it as you see fit.)

For an ordinary human, 1 would be a comfortable world almost entirely devoid of danger or meaningful challenges, such as an Animal Crossing village. 5 would be a moderately dangerous world where threats exist but can usually be avoided without much difficulty if you don't actively seek them out, although danger can still unexpectedly come knocking at your door. Examples include a typical JRPG fantasy setting or Brockton Bay in Worm. 10 would be a nightmarish world where day-to-day survival is an extreme challenge, such as the world of Crossed at the height of the outbreak or the jungles of Catachan in Warhammer 40K.

When all these criteria have been chosen, a press of a button will teleport you to a generic and viable landing spot for this location.

addons.title: Custom Worlds
addons.text:
Have you ever wanted to go to a world you know and love, but change a few things about it? Well, now you can. Your Multiversal Console gains another screen that lists all the worlds you have personally been to or know of from any source, whether they are books, movies, games, TV shows, or any other source.

Whenever you select a setting from this screen, you can add or remove tags and search for all the worlds that match those tags, then you can travel to any of them with the press of a button. For example, have you ever wanted to go to your favorite sitcom, but wanted it to be set in a cyberpunk world? Or perhaps you wanted to visit a Game of Thrones world, but wanted it to be a space opera or a cultivation world? Now you can.

As with the Multiversal Randomizer, you can specify a danger level ranging from 1 to 10 when searching for worlds to visit.

Even without adding any tags, you can use the Multiversal Randomizer's teleportation power to travel to any world you know of.

objects.title: Multiversal Quality of Life
objects.text:
Your multiversal console has been upgraded even further with several quality-of-life oriented extensions.

The first extension is Caravan™. It adds an option for group travel whenever you jump to another verse, whether it's one in your Database that you've already visited or a new one you'll be visiting for the first time through your Randomizer. You can choose to teleport nearby people along with you or directly open a gate to your destination. The gate remains open for a few minutes unless you close it manually, allowing anyone to simply walk through.

The second extension, LinguaScan, adds a new floating icon to the side of your screens. Clicking it activates your Console's new omnilingual translator. It instantly translates the speech of locals into your preferred language while doing the same in reverse, allowing them to hear your words in their own language. Its visual filter also automatically translates written text for you and applies a similar effect to anything you write, making it appear to locals as though it were written in their own language. It even goes so far as to apply a lip-sync filter to people's faces, making translated conversations appear completely natural. (Note that the translator remains active even if you close your screens. To turn it off, you have to click the LinguaScan icon again).

The third extension, SpawnPoint+, adds a new option when using your Randomizer or jumping to a verse from your Database that you've already visited. You can enter a short description of your desired landing point. It can be something generic, like "a forest clearing, far away from all human civilization" or "the middle of a giant battle", or something more specific, like the name of a city or country, but it cannot be something as precise as geographic coordinates. Your destination will then be calibrated to fit that description as closely as possible.

The fourth extension is CultureShock Pro, which generates a superficial primer of roughly ten pages on the lore and cultures of the world you're currently in. This is particularly useful when you've left most aspects of your destination up to chance. Especially critical knowledge, such as major cultural taboos or customs whose violation could have serious consequences, will always be included.

The fifth and final extension is Nope™, which ensures that any destination generated by your Randomizer will, at the very least, not be an inherently lethal trap for you. For example, it won't send you to a world where the atmosphere is toxic to you regardless of your arrival coordinates, or one ruled by a pantheon of evil gods who prey on visitors and prevent them from ever leaving. This safety feature can be deactivated entirely or manually adjusted to determine how strict it is when filtering potential destinations.

You’re not a fumbling beginner, but you’re not just a seasoned veteran either. No, you’re something much, much older. You are an existence that has existed since the beginning of the world, and it shows. While the exact length of time this entails depends on the universe you first arrive in and the nature of its history and creation, at the very least you can be guaranteed to have been there since the very dawn of the world. If you arrived in Middle-earth, you were there when Eru Ilúvatar and the Ainur sang Creation into existence, while on a more ordinary planet like Earth, you emerged when it was still a lifeless ball of molten rock. The benefits of this are self-evident. Your knowledge is vast, and you have forgotten more than even the greatest mortal geniuses have learned in their entire lifetimes. Hidden lore of the world lost to the passage of time? Obviously you know it. An important event in history? You were there for it and remember it as though it were just yesterday. Your presence is etched into the history of the world if one knows how to look, for the history of the world is your history. As a side benefit, if you were not already ageless, you are now, unchanging in the face of the passing eons, although this by itself only protects you from the ravages of time, not from someone killing you. Your age provides a certain level of game-breaking potential, as you’ve been around long enough to figure out a few tricks and exploits that push the local power system beyond its intended limits. While you’re still not on par with the truly world-breaking anomalies, you’re nonetheless an anomaly in your own right, no matter how minor. As with Late-Game Character you can instead choose to apply this to the setting of one of the abilities you obtained from the CYOA.
objects.title: Time Abyss

objects.text: You have gained authority over the Azure, the omnipotent force that brings all things into being. Instead of your previously careful record manipulation the Azure by its nature creates and influences reality through the enforcement of will and fulfillment of wishes. With time you will learn to rewrite Logic and Magic, and alter the fundamental structure of reality and the Azure itself. Your Drive, the manifestation of your soul, is called Eye of the Azure, and denotes you as a newborn God. As a natural Observer you are able to view the past, present and possible futures, and use Phenomenon Intervention to alter the events you see into other possibilities. You can freely influence the world and history, though be warned that all changes you make will only remain while you or another Observer actively enforce their existence. At the start you will only be able to enforce a handful of major changes at a time, though lesser changes will take almost no effort, and with time and practice your limits will increase. You can still make permanent changes by copying the new states into the Akashic Records, though these rewrites will take a lot more energy and effort compared to Phenomenon Intervention. You yourself are a Chrono Phantasm, immune to observation or reality manipulation except your own. The Eye will also allow you to freely enter and exit the Boundary, a dimension outside of reality where the Azure lies and all worldlines intersect, using it to travel through time, space, and different dimensions. It will also help you locate the three Sankishin, conceptual terminals of the Azure hidden in the Boundary. While they will never acknowledge another besides you as their wielder, you will likely have to prove yourself worthy of their power and allegiance first. The Tsukuyomi Unit guards time; it can create impenetrable conceptual protections by preventing the resolution of events, or placing its target out of sync from the world so that an attack will never hit. When summoned it appears as a golden light field, hanging behind your back in the form of angelic wings and a halo. Tsukuyomi can also summon itself, guarding its wielder at all times by projecting its defense backwards through time before you took damage. The Susano'o Unit cuts time; by destroying pieces of history it can make possible results impossible. A target is attacked from all possible timeframes, spaces and dimensions at once, and if there is even a single instance at any point in past, present or future throughout the multiverse where the target was hit this result is enforced to always occur. When summoned Susano'o appears as a set of silver and white armor that greatly increases its wearer's strength. The Amaterasu Unit is the most powerful, governing time on a universal scale. It is the source of Phenomenon Intervention; wielding it allows you to enforce a limitless amount of Observations without upkeep, freely creating and changing worlds as you desire, and overrule any other reality manipulator. You can also make other people into Observers, though they will only be as strong as you were before gaining the Sankishin, and cannot make permanent changes. Amaterasu is the only Sankishin that will place a constant anchor on you, appearing as a black tattoo-like crest somewhere on your body that glows blue when active. You can also summon it in the form of a giant mechanical angel. If you have Prajña you will already have the Sankishin under your command, and also gain their vast powers as your own.
objects.title: Successor of the Azure (BlazBlue)

addons.title: Little Guys, Big Responsibilities
addons.text: With so many Little Guys, even a Tall One would have difficulty keeping track of all those goobers. So some of your Little Guys decided to step up! For each selection of More Little Guys, another of your Little Guys will also turn into a Tall One.

objects.text: One of your little guys now rests above the others. He is no longer a mere Little Guy, but instead a Tall One! (Relative to them at least). The Tall One is more powerful than a regular Little Guy, having 10SP total in power. They are also stronger and more resilient, a little above what a peak human could achieve. Furthermore, they are as smart as a regular human. With this overall boost, your Tall One can act as a middle man for you, able to order your Little Guys while you are away.
objects.title: The Tall One

objects.text: Get more Little Guys! The first purchase increases the number of Little Guys by 1, with each purchase doubling the additional Little Guys (1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256, 512).
objects.title: More Little Guys

objects.text: Each purchase increase the total SP available for each Little Guys by one.
objects.title: Buffed Guys

objects.text:
You have ascended from a fragmented Ghost into that of the Ghost Messenger.

Your primary ability is the absolute suppression of other supernatural entities based on the number of Ghosts available. So long as the number of Ghosts or supernatural powers you currently possess is greater than the number of Ghosts currently presence or supernatural powers possessed by your target, your power will trigger an unsolvable, absolute shutdown upon them. Upon targeting a victim, whether a Ghost Controller, or a pure Ghost, who fulfills this condition, all of their supernatural powers and Ghost Domains are instantly rendered "dead" and suppressed. Under this effect, supernatural entities become completely inert, while Ghost Controllers are reduced to ordinary, fragile mortals, allowing you to harvest the Ghost within them or execute them without any possibility of resistance.

Your growth is no longer limited by traditional compatibility or the tedious search for specific "missing puzzle pieces." Instead, your supernatural law dictates the infinite accumulation of Terror level through theft. Every time you suppress and "consume" a Ghost or any entity possessing supernatural traits, you will permanently assimilate their power into your own existence. This increases your suppression slots by one or more, directly expanding your margin of suppression. What you consume does not dilute your sense of self; rather, your consciousness effortlessly commands these stolen traits as subservient cogs within your greater system.

Your Ghost Domain has also increased in potency, starting at a level equivalent to the Fifth Layer of Yang Jian's Ghost Eyes. It now manifests as a chilling, absolute darkness that completely swallows all forms of electromagnetic signals, light, heat, and conventional space. The domain can also create objects, structures, and even "people" with their own thoughts and behavior, allowing you to recreate entire environments such as a village and its inhabitants. However, these creations remain Ghost Slave under your control rather than truly independent sentient beings. 

Unlike most Ghosts, you are an abstract existence. Due to this, you have also achieved a state of conceptual immortality as you are no longer bound to a physical form but have instead become one with your Ghost Domain itself. Should your current manifestation be overwhelmed, sealed, or suppressed, your core consciousness will simply detach and reset into something else. You can instantly "Restart" by shifting your identity into object, Ghost Slave, or anything else within your Ghost Domain. You will re-manifest perfectly intact and completely cleansed of all damage or negative status effects, and can do so infinitely as long as your Ghost Domain isn't suppressed.

Note: Your supernatural nature has already been fully incubated, and you do not need to lie within the Ghost Coffin to mature like the original Ghost Messenger. You also start out with 1 suppression slots.
objects.title: Ghost Messenger (Mysterious Revival)
[Hero of the Turn-Based World]
objects.text:
Your mania for turn based tactical gameplay has paid off, as you now possess the ability to impose a set of rules similar to a tabletop RPG or CRPG on the world around you. Anyone within a radius of roughly 100 feet from you (including yourself) is locked into a small region that is “their space”. The order in which beings act is determined by initiative, a complex calculation based on one’s agility, thought speed, and any special powers they possess, though the power will load the scales in favor of you getting to act first. You and anyone affected by the Turn-Based World can only perform activities like movement, casting spells, utilizing items, etc if it is your turn (other than talking, which is of course a free action). You possess a pool of “Action Points” which are depleted by moving and acting over the course of six seconds.

You possess several supplementary abilities that allow you to take advantage of these altered rules of reality.
