First, you gain a rough awareness whenever a creature enters the area affected by the Turn-Based World. Second, you can gain additional actions by defeating enemies, and you possess a Skill to give yourself a once-per-day infusion of extra AP for free. Third, you possess an appraisal ability that will estimate the relative power and the health or injury of subjects (including yourself) then convert that estimate into numbers you can view. By savvy use of these abilities, a moderately powerful warrior could slaughter more than a hundred weaker enemies with little fear of reprisal. (Since a single turn always elapses in six seconds from the perspective of the wider universe, chaining multiple actions can make you appear to be moving at extreme speed from the perspective those outside the Turn-Based World).

You may at any time disable the Turn-Based World if you prefer to move and act normally. Note that beings of significantly greater power than yourself may resist this ability, as can those who have the ability to establish their own laws of reality. As you grow stronger, the area covered by the Turn-Based World will increase.

objects.title: Get Totality'd
objects.text: You are in for a headache. No one is meant to shoulder the burden of knowing it all, for there is no mind, soul, or vessel capable of containing the infinite. Yet, you took that rule, sharpened it, and turned it into a weapon. You can apply the Grasp of Eternity continuously to someone with a single touch, forcing the full weight of Totality onto them. This results in a wide range of consequences for the unfortunate target that you can control. You can instantly paralyze them in place, force them to relive a single moment endlessly, render them brain-dead, or substitute their mind with a copy of their alternate self. If you put full power behind it, they will spontaneously combust, reducing their body to ash, turning their mind into an incoherent mess, and assimilating their soul/self back into the beyond. This will bypass any resistances. Once you activate this ability, your arm will shimmer like a starry expanse that, upon touching an opponent, will crawl into and embed itself within them.

Each selection here allows you to instead copy any one fictional character—from an official source that you recognize as fiction—that is at most strong enough to destroy a planet.

You gain the ability to use their memories, skills, and powers, summon any items significant to them, and even take on their appearance if you wish. You will also inherit any weaknesses or vulnerabilities the character may have had.

You can only have a single character active at a time but can switch between them at will.
objects.title: Greater Install

objects.text:
Now, investing energy enhances the ability both in quantity and quality - you can actively rip energy from objects. The easier it is for you to benefit, the better it works. For instance, anyone can dissolve flesh with a touch, a mage can suck mana out of spells attacking them, and a cultivator can drain qi from a defensive technique, breaking it. Dissolving organic matter lets you regenerate your own flesh, but not with full mass transfer.

Natural absorption is the limitation: inorganics are still dangerous, costing more energy for slower extraction from molecular bonds. And an explosion is still too fast to negate before impact.

You can sense what exactly got absorbed. Initially, the power manifests in streams of indiscriminate mist, but over time you can improve your control - after decades, even erase poison from your blood without killing yourself. Also you can exclude part of the light spectrum from absorption, changing mists color.
objects.title: Accelerated Externalized Digestion

objects.text:
While other cartoon and gag characters will still have their abilities nullified by you, your own powers have taken on a decidedly darker tone. Your comedic antics will now have tangible, very serious consequences on those who you perform them on. If you say, drop an anvil on someone's head, they aren't getting back up.

Despite the newfound permanent consequences, you will find it all oh so delightfully hilarious, finding twisted joy in the misery of those who you inflict it onto. Take care not to become a monster, O' Jester of Nihility.
objects.title: Black Comedy

objects.text: What a disgusting thing you've become. The term Nadir denotes the opposite of a zenith, the darkest moment which the hero must overcome. Temporary in nature, it lasts just long enough for the heroic comeback to be that much more awe inspiring. No more. There will be no great turnabout, no last minute deus-ex-machina. You have become the true Embodiment of Evil, and all shall suffer for it. From your presence alone, the genre of the story shifts to a tragedy. Fate becomes hostile to the notion of heroes, granting all forces of darkness a conceptual advantage against them. Their powers dim, their strength wanes, and their resistances are effortlessly pierced. Shining protagonists are cast down into the pit, their plot armor taken by the dark. Your cursed mud and shadow physiologies have merged into a greater whole, transforming into the Essence of Evil and infecting reality on the deepest levels. Your existence has been intertwined with the concepts of negativity, ensuring your existence so long as they persist. With both the properties of mud and shadow, this Essence of Evil has taken their place in your control over both, allowing you to generate more and shape it to your will. Whatever is unfortunate to make contact with it is dissolved, becoming part of you. Furthermore, your nature as the embodiment of all evil has gorged itself on the negativity within your pocket dimension, greatly empowering all your abilities and wholly subsuming the entire realm, turning it into an extension of your body. Now filled with naught but the pure Essence of Evil, whatever isn't immediately dissolved by the Essence of Evil can be sent into your new esoteric stomach to be digested, with the Essence itself acting as a one-way portal. As a natural consequence of your ascension, Neither evil-aligned abilities nor those who hold even the slightest malice within them are able to harm you. Such abilities can be effortlessly manipulated to be turned against their users, or enhanced to become exponentially stronger when you use them for yourself. Furthermore, your form of limited omnikinesis has been completely subsumed into your powers of corruption, increasing the speed of said powers and propelling them to the peak of what is described in The Root of All Despair, allowing for even greater heights in what you may corrupt. But remember, evil cannot create anything new. You can only ruin what already exists. Finally, your infohazardous nature has fused with your already absurd talent in manipulation to transform you into something akin to a living Anti-Life Equation. The knowledge of your existence, whether spread by you or another, will induce complete and utter hopelessness within a victim, crushing their spirit so they may never rise again. Even should one somehow resist, perhaps via a combination of absurd mental and memetic resilience, your skill in manipulation is such that you may unravel their will with but a single word. Terrifying though you may be, your abilities are limited in scope, only able to affect a single universe at a time. But as you consume more and more worlds, as more are drowned by the dark, you will grow in power. Soon enough, the totality of existence may be plunged into an everlasting nadir, never to see the light of dawn again.
objects.title: The Everlasting Nadir
Child of the Cosmos
objects.text: The love of the firmament has taken root within your divinity. You are not the offspring of a celestial god; the cosmos itself has accepted you as one of its children. What Stargazer established as a bond with the heavens now becomes an intrinsic part of your divine nature. Your ichor becomes Cosmic Ichor, appearing midnight blue or black-violet with shifting points of multicolored light. It retains all characteristics of your original divine blood while transforming your body into one naturally capable of existing throughout the cosmos. You no longer require air, food, water, or sleep and can survive indefinitely in environments normally incapable of supporting life. You may freely move through atmosphere, liquid, or open space without requiring leverage or propulsion. Your speed improves alongside your power, but this alone does not grant faster-than-light movement, teleportation, or dimensional travel. More importantly, Cosmic Ichor learns from what you survive. Exposure to conditions beyond your existing resistances gradually develops permanent adaptations against them. The same process occurs when entering unfamiliar worlds, allowing you to acclimate to their natural and supernatural conditions without losing your existing nature. Adaptation does not immediately grant knowledge, abilities, or mastery of native power systems, and never forces unwanted changes upon you. Your consciousness and divine spark permeate your Cosmic Ichor rather than depending entirely upon individual organs. Destruction of your head or other normally vital structures is therefore not automatically fatal. Provided sufficient ichor survives and your soul remains intact and free, you can reconstruct your body around it. Complete destruction of both remains fatal. Cosmic energies naturally sustain you, replenish your reserves, and accelerate this regeneration. Your Cosmic Ichor can share adaptations it has acquired. Those exposed to it may temporarily gain the adaptations necessary to survive their surroundings, without permanently becoming like you. More extraordinarily, Cosmic Ichor carries the potential for life. If introduced to a lifeless but viable world, it can act as a catalyst for abiogenesis. Over millions of years, life may emerge, adapt, diversify, and eventually produce complex ecosystems suited to that world. You do not automatically design, accelerate, or control this evolution; your ichor provides the initial spark and extraordinary adaptability that allows life to establish itself. Stargazer once made you beloved by the firmament. Through your divine blood, that bond has now become part of what you are. You are no longer merely someone who can wander among the heavens. Go forth, Child of the Cosmos. The universe remembers its own.

addons.title: Hands of the Firmament
addons.text:
Your cosmic nature transforms these weapons into the Hands of the Firmament, gauntlets and boots that let the cosmos act physically. They resemble bare hands, ordinary clothing, bracers or star-filled armor.

They are weightless, soul-stored, self-repairing and protected from control. They reinforce your body against their output. Without cosmic power, their strength and local space-gravity functions still make them exceptional close-quarters weapons.

You gain an innate affinity for space and gravity. Distance, boundaries, mass, momentum, curvature and gravity become instinctive senses. Related powers are easier to learn, combine and channel physically.

You govern every motion's mass, momentum and reach, scaling from a harmless touch to your maximum. A jab may carry a mountain's weight and a serious strike planetary mass without slowing. Space folds to reach distant targets, force stays inside what you strike and perfect control prevents collateral damage.

The Hands treat space and gravity as tangible. A punch, jab, swing, kick, clap or clenched fist imposes impact and vibration upon spacetime, making it quake, split and shatter like ground in an earthquake. These are genuine wounds in reality, not mere shockwaves.

Shattering space breaks geometry, distance or dimensional connections. A precise fracture travels through a target's occupied space and tears it apart from within, bypassing armor unable to defend that geometry. Wider quakes rupture fortifications, distort battlefields, collapse pocket dimensions or break sealed realms. You may pierce barriers, sever portals, disrupt phasing, destroy spatial prisons or shatter distance so a blow arrives immediately. You control every fracture's targets and spread.

Gravity can be broken likewise. Blows disperse gravity wells, release restraints, disrupt orbits and destabilize singularities. Closing your fist seizes selected targets' space, contracts its gravity and crushes the region. Eventually, you may break the forces binding celestial systems or strike through spacetime's curvature. Comparable powers resist, and you can repair fractures.

Celestial phenomena become techniques. Worldbreaker carries planetary mass, Stellar Heart invokes stellar heat, Supernova Impact erupts inside its target, Neutron Grasp crushes with impossible density and Event Horizon Hold prevents escape. Greater techniques express colliding worlds, galactic rotation or cosmic force, with their true properties contained or released at will.

You can catch or tear light, gravity, souls, energy, portals and spatial fractures. Incorporeal or world-sized beings can be grappled by matching scale; grasping an avatar may reach its greater existence. You can catch stellar beams, halt celestial bodies, brace dimensions and shield others. Anything you support, from person to world, remains safe.

Your boots make phenomena solid beneath your steps, including air, water, light, flame, lightning, gravity, magic and dimensional boundaries. You can cross empty space in any orientation, follow targets through portals, create footholds or launch yourself by kicking space and gravity.

Planetary and stellar power come naturally. With growth, the Hands reach solar-system, galactic and cosmic force, concentrating a cosmos's motion, energy, gravity and metaphysical weight into one act. There is no fixed ceiling: if you transcend one cosmos, they evolve with you and express your full power through every strike, grapple and throw.

addons.title: Cosmic Luminal Body
addons.text:
Your Cosmic Ichor fully integrates Luminal Shift. You, your clothing, and carried possessions retain their normal appearance instead of becoming or dispersing into light.

You may travel at sub-light to near-light speeds without physical or mental strain, retaining complete awareness and maneuverability. You can freely accelerate, turn, stop, selectively become intangible, and safely cancel unwanted momentum.

After ten seconds at near-light speed, you may enter hyperspace as normal. Your connection to the firmaments lets you navigate its currents, identify viable lanes and safe exits, and avoid emerging inside celestial bodies or solid matter. Unfamiliar routes may still lead somewhere unintended, and you cannot create new lanes or enter sealed dimensions.

objects.title: Anthropomorphisation
objects.text:
Your power now extends to all non-living beings, allowing you to warp and reshape inorganic creations.

You can freely shape non-living things into biological organisms and even bestow sentience and personality when doing so. While you can fully customise the personality of your creations, you can also leave it to form based on the object's purpose and history. For example, a weapon might have a more aggressive and trigger-happy personality compared to a medkit.

Lastly, you can allow the transformed objects the ability to shift between their original state and the new form you granted them at will, all the while retaining the newly gained sentience.

objects.title: Extra Imprints
objects.text:
Your existence seems potent enough to hold a few more concepts in your being, for each purchase of this option, you will receive another Conceptual Imprint upon your very being. Of course there are some costs to this, your all round boost is reduced to x1.5 when in places connected to these extra concepts and can traverse area better than others could.

Creatures and beings related to an extra concept will treat you slightly better than others without an Imprint, hostile creatures wont be as hostile just a bit, commonfolk will treat you will still not treat like an outsider but not like a distant kin, more like a decent neighbor.

Even in scenarios in which your extra concept is involved, things will shift minutely in your favor; if you chose Water, then a Water spell will still aim your way but has a chance to miss and do less damage to you regardless, just not as much as if it was your main concept.

The whispers of knowledge are lessened partial as well and you will only be talented in the associated subjects not a prodigy, the knowledge boost is lessened to times two and not three. You will also only receive one unique 6SP ability from an extra concept.

The greatest benefit of Extra Imprints comes from choosing concepts that have meaningful relationships with your primary concept and with one another. While each concept must remain distinct enough to qualify as its own Imprint, concepts with significant overlap can reinforce one another, causing their benefits to accumulate. For example, if your primary concept is Swords and you take Knights as an Extra Concept, both concepts naturally reinforce your connection to swordsmanship, martial training, knightly traditions, and related environments and situations.

As compatible concepts accumulate, their overlapping benefits can become increasingly pronounced. Your environmental boosts can become stronger where multiple concepts intersect, your learning capabilities can improve further in disciplines shared between them, and you can function more naturally in situations involving those concepts. Likewise, beings associated with multiple connected concepts can develop a stronger affinity toward you, as your existence increasingly represents several related ideas at once.

Even the unique abilities granted by your Imprints can develop connections between their source concepts. Powers originating from compatible concepts may naturally complement, combine, or enhance one another in ways that would not occur between unrelated concepts. Thus, Extra Imprints allow you to either broaden your conceptual abilities or deliberately build a network of related concepts, with the latter gradually creating a much deeper and more powerful relationship between you and the ideas you embody.

objects.title: Generic Retinue Upgrades
objects.text:
There are now new uses for your charges!

For any retinue member, you may now choose to upgrade them with charges in specific ways that mirror General Companion Modifiers, with the price of each depending on the modifier. This doesn't apply to modifiers that let you do things  you already can with the base Retinue power, such as power increase or decrease.

Modifiers like sex, age or morality would be very cheap; whereas modifiers like Native, Mentor or Right Hand Man which modify reality, allow you to learn the powers of your retinue (to a degree) or come close to the realm of fate manipulation would be very expensive.

Your retinue members are now significantly more versatile and changeable even after being "finished".

objects.title: Overtime
objects.text:
Oh you're the adventurous type for real, I like you. Okay, here's the deal. 

Every purchase here will raise the value and power of every item you receive by 5 SP, whilst making your mini-adventures a tad more chaotic and somewhat dangerous. Which you don't have to worry about past a certain point, and we really recommend not crossing that line, but it's your choice and you've been warned.

At 10-20 SP items, you're gonna be in street-tier levels of mini-adventures. Just enough to give you a good workout.

At 30-40 SP items, you're looking at increased frequency of supernatural tier items. Where you're gonna have a serious workout and encounter things only a wee-bit out of your depth.

At 50-60 SP items, you're gonna be encountering gods, angels, demons, mythical legends, the works. Hope you've got some good wits and luck in case you get unlucky here.

At 70-80+ SP items, this is for stuff like Cthulhu and other 'beyond your comprehension' type entities. Still, there's a good chance of befriending some. Hopefully.

At 90-120 SP items, remember that line I talked about? You've long crossed it by this point. But uhhh, good luck I guess?

objects.title: Enter Sandman
objects.text: You no longer need to mark any targets with the Dreambrand. Instead, when traveling to the dreamlands, you can pull anyone you want in the world with you, the same as you would've been able to do with a marked target.

addons.text: From the consumption of the Chakra Fruit, you have been given the gift of chakra and its two composite parts, Yin and Yang. The black flames of Amaterasu have revealed the secret to its mystical nature and with it, came complete understanding of and the ability to freely and effortlessly manipulate Yin. Yin governs Imagination, giving form to nothing and everything, and is the reason behind almost every jutsu's effects. Almost every jutsu uses a mixture of Yin and Yang, one to give form to imagination and one to bring imagination into reality. With your understanding of Yin, you can now perform things such as animating your shadow, turning fire solid, or creating black lightning that is far more potent than regular lightning. While your mastery of Yin is incredible, its true strength is shown when used in conjunction with its counterpart.
addons.title: Daikokuten

objects.text: Through the power of the Eternal Mangekyō Sharingan, you gain the ability to manipulate the Flames of Amaterasu—fire that has the power to burn even that which cannot be burned. Amaterasu Flames can burn fire, water, and even chakra itself, and cannot be put out until it burns itself out. You cannot control this flame on your own, but you can summon it at a point you look at.
objects.title: Mangekyō: Amaterasu

addons.text: From the consumption of the Chakra Fruit, you have been given the gift of chakra and its two composite parts, Yin and Yang. The white  flames of Shiranui have revealed the secret to its mystical nature and with it, came complete understanding of and the ability to freely and effortlessly manipulate Yang. Yang governs Reality, giving life to Imagination that has none, and is the reason behind almost every jutsu's strength, and how much it affects reality. Almost every jutsu uses a mixture of Yin and Yang, one to give form to imagination and one to bring imagination into reality. With your understanding of Yang, you can now perform things such as amplifying your strength to a ridiculous degree, restoring lost organs, expanding the size of your physical form, and can even be used to greatly amplify the strength of any jutsu you perform. While your mastery of Yang is incredible, its true strength is shown when used in conjunction with its counterpart.
addons.title: Daimyōjin

objects.text: You posses a different incarnation of Amaterasu’s power, the white healing flame of Shiranui. This white flame, when activated, shrouds your entire body in a white flame that instantly and perfectly restores you to perfect health, or you can cast it on another for the same effect.
objects.title: Mangekyō: Shiranui

addons.text: Your consumption of the sacred treasure of the Ōtsutsuki gives you insight into your Kurokami ability. It seems that this ability spawned from a strange mixture of Fire and Ice, a dichotomy not normally found outside of those with incredibly rare Kekkei Genkai, and a distinction that has now been spread to all other natures. You are free to mix whatever chakra natures you can learn, in whatever form you desire. Mix Fire and Water for acidic mist or steam, Wind and Water for ice. You can form multiple results from a single mixture such as Fire and Earth for Lave, Rubber, or Acidic Fluid. You may even mix natures against itself such as Wind and Wind for a more powerful variant such as Typhoon, or mix advanced natures with itself for more combinations.
addons.title: Takamimusubi

objects.text: Through the power of the Eternal Mangekyō Sharingan, you gain the ability to summon cold foxfire, which absorbs the heat of whatever it burns. This heat is stored within your other eye, and can be unleashed as a lance of flame. While the fire can be blocked, this lance of flame is able to penetrate most barriers once enough heat is stored within.
objects.title: Mangekyō: Kuraokami

addons.text: Your incredible control over flames has now been spread to all of your other abilities. You can perform things such as reshaping your Susanoo into a dragon, shaping and condensing it into a personal armor to amplify your personal defense or grant it extra arms and armaments. You can also give yourself voluntary invulnerability to any ability you posses, meaning you can make yourself invulnerable to the flames of Amaterasu, if you possess the ability, so you could do things such as coating your body with its flames to prevent anyone trying to touch you. You may remove and reapply this invulnerability at any time, in any form, individually to any ability you posses. You can also cast any ability you possess at any point within your eyesight.
addons.title: Kanayago

objects.text: You possess the ability to create, shape, control and douse flames at will. You are able to, with no effort, freely shape, control, and douse any kind of flames including supernatural expressions of it such as Amaterasu or Shiranui but are limited to simply creating normal flames with just this ability. You may create fire at any point you look at and if you possess any other ability to create any kind of fire, you can now generate a far greater amount of it.
objects.title: Mangekyō: Kagutsuchi

addons.text: Something strange has happened with the Chakra Fruit’s consumption. Somewhere between your chakra, soul, and body, your mind has manifested as something real, something that can be interacted directly with. You are able to effectively directly interact with everything from your mind, soul, chakra and so on, allowing you to freely modify every aspect of yourself and everything linked to you. Removing things, adding things, changing things, sealing them away are all in your ability. And most importantly, you have complete and absolute control over this realm, able to change how time moves through here, change its size, how reality works and every and any other aspect as you are god in your mind. You can bring others' minds here by casting Tsukuyomi on them and you may grant them as much access as you wish, and they can freely alter themselves the way you can if you allow them. As this is a mental realm, you may use this realm to generate an infinite amount of Yin, that you can then transmute into any combination of Yin and Yang, granting you an infinite supply of chakra. As this is merely in your mind, you cannot physically visit or take anything in, nor remove anything into the real world, unless you gain mastery of Yin-Yang Release.
addons.title: Naimen no Fūkei

objects.text: You are granted the ability to cast a perfect genjutsu of your design, capable of trapping anyone within either your field of vision or a large area the size of a small city. You are capable of altering a target's perception of time, capable of crafting whatever world you wish—as in this genjutsu, whatever you desire, happens with no effort on your part. You can do anything from fitting weeks of incredible pain, to crafting a perfect and complete life for your target that if you wish, they can experience in a mere second. You can choose whether they feel any effects of any kind, good or bad, when leaving the genjutsu. In this genjutsu, you are god.
objects.title: Mangekyō: Tsukuyomi

addons.text: The Kotoamatsukami granted absolute control of others, the consumption of the Chakra Fruit has extended this aspect to every single part of yourself. Your control over your power is now perfected, blinking requires more effort than manipulating chakra now. Your chakra simply obeys your will and requires no conscious effort whatsoever. From fire that doesn’t burn, remote chakra constructs, casting and maintaining thousands of techniques at the same time, to even converting your body into a chakra nature and back. If your chakra can do it, and you wish for it to happen, it will. As this is perfect control, not a single iota of chakra or energy is wasted, all utilized to its maximum effect, and this reduces your energy cost to such an infinitely small amount that you couldn’t exhaust yourself even if you tried—you are no longer capable of tiring or running out. And this is not limited to just your chakra but extends to every part of you, from perfect muscle control and coordination to even your other powers. Your powers will make sure to not do anything that you would not wish it to, and will manage itself in a way you’d best approve of if you had to consider it. It will prevent you from hurting yourself unless you’d wish it to.
addons.title: Kamiyonanayo

objects.text: A power that allows you to perfectly, absolutely, and if you choose to, permanently manipulate the minds and thoughts of others completely undetected. And even if the victim of said ability is made aware of the circumstances, it will not dispel as the effects on their mind is as real as if it had been their own. This can be cast as many times as you wish on as many people as you wish, and can even be cast at large groups, ensnaring many targets at once. You may also choose to cast this on an area up to the size of a city instead, creating a permanent command on all those who visit the territory. This jutsu, both in location or on people, is permanent until you choose to remove it, and can do so selectively so you can keep others unaffected, or leave the jutsu in place if you choose.
objects.title: Mangekyō: Kotoamatsukami

addons.text: Your power has advanced to an entirely new level, no longer are you limited to simply rewriting another’s memories but you can now rewrite history itself. Similar to the Infinite Tsukuyomi, this technique is utilized on a worldwide scale to rewrite history in a manner of your choosing.  With this technique, you could rewrite your own place in history, take the place of anyone and make them an outcast, write yourself into the very fabric of a world’s story, or do this for another. As this is a true change, this doesn’t simply rewrite memories but will act as a retroactive change. This also increases the range of all your other abilities, granting you the ability to cast and maintain any of your abilities on at least a global scale.
addons.title: Amenotokotachi

objects.text: Through the power of the Eternal Mangekyō Sharingan, you gain the ability to place a genjutsu on an opponent through eye contact. This genjutsu makes the victim believe you to be their greatest ally who was always a part of their life. You also gain these memories, but you know they're fake. Said victim always sees you in a good light, and even if this genjutsu is dispelled, they keep the fake memories.
objects.title: Mangekyō: Kamimusubi

addons.text: The Sharingan is an incredible ability, allowing you to perform any jutsu or skill that you could theoretically perform simply by gazing upon it, and through Omoikane, simply pluck the skill right out of another's mind. The Chakra Fruit has evolved this ability to new heights; as chakra can theoretically do anything provided the user knows how, you are no longer locked out of skills or abilities that you could not replicate before. By gazing upon any technique or ability with your Mangekyō or by observing its effects, your eyes can break it down and you can now replicate it using your chakra. For techniques that have no visible effects, such as the Thinker powers of the Entities, you will have to utilize Omoikane to peer into the minds of the users of such powers to gain the ability. This can also be used to replicate the abilities of those whose powers can be observed.
addons.title: Amenominakanushi

objects.text: Just by gazing into your enemies' eyes, you may use this powerful genjutsu to peer into their minds and take their very skills, knowledge and abilities directly from them. Any skill that you can theoretically have the capability of performing, such as other unique Mangekyō jutsu, can be learned this way. This also works in reverse, allowing you to teach others your skills and jutsu, such as your Mangekyō powers, to others, including this one. This does not grant you nor impart on others any supernatural abilities they do not naturally possess; they grant the skill and knowledge, not the actual physiology. Techniques are special as any who possess the Mangekyō can awaken the abilities—the specifics are determined by the user, and as such, theoretically, any who possess it can use any jutsu given by it, provided they know how.
objects.title: Mangekyō: Omoikane

addons.text:
Your domain and control has been greatly expanded, now extending to an additional 6 pocket dimensions for yourself, all having the same functionality as the original. Your control over your portals has also been greatly increased, allowing you to open rifts to anywhere and anywhen you’d like, from anywhere you’d like. Even inside the bodies of anyone else, allowing you to telefrag or kill them. 

But most importantly, you now hold ultimate control over space itself. Stretch, compress, distort, fold, create, destroy, break, mend, and even overlap space of one location with another dimension to force the rules of another world into this one. You can do anything—from compressing space to create a singularity, to folding it, traveling a thousand miles in a single step, or even simply deleting space to cause everything in it to disappear.
addons.title: Rokudō no Odori

objects.text: You have been given a personal dimension that you have absolute control over, and the ability to transport things to and from it in a wide variety of ways. You can create portals to travel to anywhere you’d wish, from across dimensions to even the Pure Lands if you had any inclination to. You are able to use this in a short-range version, allowing you to suck in yourself and then exit at any location you wish, or you can use a long-range version that creates a point in space that drags things into it, and if utilized offensively, could be used to rip targets apart. You are also able to affect yourself and others or objects you touch, able to force overlapping matter into your personal dimension, causing intangibility in your case. You can also use this offensively by utilizing it either through weapons you empower with the effect, your body, or your other techniques by forcing any matter that overlaps with them into the other dimension, without the innate protection that allows them to stay connected like you would with yourself, allowing you to cleave through almost any defense. As a side effect of your power, by traveling into your personal dimension, you are able to find where anything or anyone you are searching for are, and can teleport there from your personal dimension.
objects.title: Mangekyō: Kamui

addons.text: Your previous limitations have been lifted, your powers itself has been greatly enhanced. Now, you possess the ability to create a field up to a radius of 100 meters from your body. This range can be increased over time, not that you’d necessarily need to—as within this range, you're effectively omnipotent. While anything would need to be in your field to allow this ability to affect them, living things only need to be partially inside your field in order for you to affect them. i.e. if you were to have someone send an avatar, you'd hit their real body as soon as the avatar stepped foot in your range. You can create a single field or multiple fields, and are able to shape the fields however you like, provided they are within the stated range.
addons.title: Takamagahara

objects.text: Through the power of the Eternal Mangekyō Sharingan, you gain the ability to turn anything seen with the eye into a genjutsu, or turn a genjutsu real. With skill in manipulating genjutsu, this can be used to achieve limited reality manipulation, although overuse can cause rapid eye pain. If you see an ally about to be hit by a bullet, for example, you can make it so the bullet does no damage by turning it into an illusion. The only thing not affected by this are wounds already inflicted, so you cannot cause or heal wounds via this, but you could use this to avoid Amaterasu flames by swapping yourself being burnt into something else, so long as the flames don't reach where you can't see.
objects.title: Mangekyō: Kunitokotachi

addons.text:
The consumption of the Chakra Fruit has revealed the incredible secret behind your ability to defy fate itself, for you are the incarnation of the three fingered god. Each finger represents a moment of time—one for the past, one for the present, and one for the future. As such, you are granted three additional abilities with this.

The first of which is that you are capable of viewing any event and moment in the past, and any possible timelines that could have occurred.

The second of which is that you are capable of viewing anything in the present, capable of seeing things even in other realms, and most importantly, you are capable of understanding anything about how it came to be and why. This also allows complete understanding of any knowledge you come across or have.

The third and greatest skill this grants is that of precognition, capable of peering centuries into the future, showing all possible timelines and how to ensure or divert any future that you can see.
addons.title: Narukami

objects.text: Utilizing this ability, you become untethered to all things, as free as the wind itself. The first effect this gives you is the power of flight, capable of freely and effortlessly moving in any direction you please. You are also incapable of being captured or sealed in any manner unless you allow it, and if you do, you are capable of freeing yourself at any time. You can travel anywhere, no lock can keep you out, no distance too far as you may simply apparate wherever you wish. You can even sneak into other realms with this ability. Others can not force a fate on you that you do not wish, And most importantly, you are given freedom of form, capable of swapping your body form into anything you’d wish, you can even transform your body into a chakra nature that you have control over, such as turning your body into air. This power also frees you from any negative side effects of your abilities, allowing you to cast even techniques such as Izanagi and Izanami without fear of losing your eyes.
objects.title: Mangekyō: Ryobu

addons.text: The consumption of the Fruit has revealed to you the innate properties of the sacred imperial treasures. A blade that always kills, ensuring an exact effect. A mirror that always protects, ensuring a denial of an effect. A jewel that always hits, ensuring an exact set of cause. Your treasures were inscribed with the power to manipulate causality itself, a skill that you now possess as well. You are now able to apply any of your treasures in any combination to anything at once. You are still limited to only utilizing it one at a time; however, this is no longer a hard limit as with time, you may learn to freely manipulate causality, an incredibly dangerous power.
addons.title: Tamanooya

objects.text:
You’ve been imbued with the powers of the great imperial treasures—the sword Kusanagi no Tsurugi, the mirror Yata no Kagami, and the jewel Yasakani no Magatama. Each imbues you with a different power. Each of these effects can be applied to either your body, jutsu, weapons, or others but only one effect can be applied to one thing at a time. However, all three effects can be applied individually to different things. You can also choose to partially imbue something with an effect allowing the rest of it to be affected by another effect. i.e. you could imbue your body with Yata no Kagami except your arm which you could choose to imbue with Kusanagi no Tsurugi for example.

The Kusanagi no Tsurugi, grants anything you imbue the ability to kill anything with a single strike, from the smallest cut to the most fatal strike, from something as simple as a leaf to a bullet to a jutsu. Provided it hits what you intended, it will kill.

The Yata no Kagami, grants anything you imbue the ability to be completely impervious to damage from something as blinding light to disease or aging. Nothing can harm what is protected by the mirror.

The Yasakani no Magatama, grants anything you imbue the ability of immediate and guaranteed travel and if you choose it, to hit something regardless of any defenses in its way. Although this does nothing for the durability of the thing your hitting, it merely ensures it will hit.
objects.title: Mangekyō: Ninigi

rows.title: Eternal Mangekyō Sharingan Abilities
rows.titleText: Your Susanoo gains ability to perform these technique as well.

addons.text: You have reached similar levels of proficiency when it comes to wielding the Darkness. Your mastery of Stasis and Strand is as potent as your command over Arc, Solar, and Void Light.

objects.text:
Like the legendary Iron Lords, you are a peerless warrior and a master of the Light. In terms of raw statistics, you are a fifth sigma Lightbearer—ranking in the 99th percentile in terms of precision, restraint, and raw power. Compared to your fellow Guardians, your Light is far more powerful and flexible—benefiting from your superior self-understanding, clarity of purpose, and internalized phenomenologies and ontologies. Unlike most Lightbearers, you are not merely resistant to the whims of fate and paradox, but completely immune to such threats. Your Light fiercely resists being suppressed or drained and grants you complete freedom from fate.

Having mastered all of the skills necessary to be a Titan, Hunter, and Warlock—along with all of the relevant subclasses—you have reached the pinnacle of what it means to be a Lightbearer. As your ability to wield the Light grows, you will naturally uncover new optima within the space of possible techniques: allowing you to alter your powers as a Lightbearer to better suit you and even invent entirely new ways of wielding the Light. With time, you will be able to push past the artificial limitations of things like ‘subclasses’ and wield the Light in ways that your peers can only dream of. In a direct confrontation, you are able to match the feats of the greatest Lightbearers in history and do battle with gods. Faced with seemingly insurmountable limits, your Light allows you to reach impossible outcomes that no amount of brute force could achieve.
objects.title: Young Wolf (Destiny)

objects.text:
When you were reborn as one of the Traveler’s Chosen Lightbearers, sensing a greater destiny within you. He also granted you the Rite of Ascension, a ritual that allows you and your ghost to become a nexus of Light. This allows you to create new Ghosts and have someone undergo a rebirth into a Lightbearer.

Though such a ritual is powerful it doesn't come without drawbacks, you are limited to the number of new Ghosts and Lightbearers you can create based on how much light you have access to. In addition, anyone who undergoes the ritual will have memories from before their rebirth be somewhat hazy for a month or two.
objects.title: Rite of Ascension (Destiny)

objects.text:
You are not merely a Lightbearer, but are instead a physical embodiment of the Light itself. You no longer require a Ghost to fuel your powers and can instead generate Light in vast quantities without limit. Should you wish, you may take on the form of a moon-sized sphere of neutronium and electroweak matter that is nigh indestructible.

Like the Traveler, the paracausal power that flows from you is one of pure potential that, if unrestrained, can cause pearlescent flora to bloom in its wake. Using this power, you can reach into alternate timelines to draw forth knowledge or material, create almost anything you can imagine out of matter or Light, and influence the physical world to augment the living or resurrect the long dead. Should you wish it, you can terraform whole planets with the Light—turning toxic, lifeless balls of rock into flourishing garden worlds. You could even use this power to create singularities containing their own fully formed universes within.

As a paracausal entity, you are utterly impossible to simulate, and your existence itself is protected by the Light. No act of temporal manipulation will ever be able to affect you, and no compulsion of fate will ever limit you. Even ontological weapons cannot negate your existence which is entirely self-sustained by the Light. Unlike lesser wielders of the Light, your power can never be truly taken from you, for the very act of taking itself is antithetical to the power that you now represent. On the other hand, by temporarily sacrificing a part of your power, you can create Ghosts to seek out worthy individuals according to your criteria to become Lightbearers.
objects.title: Gardener (Destiny)

objects.text: As the being known as Aurash once did long ago, you have taken on the unique Hive King Morph. Whether or not you are actually descended from the line of the Osmium King, you may now appear as the undisputed ruler of the Hive. Standing at over 20 feet tall, you tower over ordinary Hive creatures and have the strength and endurance to match. Having mastered both the physical and the arcane elements of Hive warfare, you are an unmatched warrior and warlord. With two enormous batlike wings, you can soar above your foes, while your mastery of Hive magic is second to none.
objects.title: King Morph (Destiny)

objects.text:
Whether you are a sibling to the five spawn of Xita or the descendent of some other great worm from Fundament’s deep seas, you are now a Worm God. Your body takes the form of an immense chitinous worm strong enough to crush houses and sweep away armies. In your flesh grows an endless supply of larval worms which you may offer to others in the form of a bargain. By taking these larvae into themselves, your subjects will become dependent on you—tithing a portion of the destruction they cause as power to you in exchange for immortality, the ability to shape their own flesh, and the power to call upon the Darkness through their pact with you.

As a Worm God, your affinity for the Darkness grants you complete mastery over every aspect of Hive sorcery. Through the Sword Logic, you may continue to grow limitlessly—fed through the Anthem Anatheme by the endless death-tithe provided by your subjects. Though it may take eons, you will eventually reach such size and power that you could swallow entire nations.
objects.title: Worm God (Destiny)

objects.text:
Like Auryx the Navigator, you have communed with the Darkness and been given the power to Take. Commanding a sinister black and white flame, you may stretch out your hand to drag any living thing into a rift where it will be remade by the Darkness. When your target reemerges, it will do so as one of your Taken—an utterly subservient monstrosity whose body and mind have had all weakness carved away. You are also able to create Blight: a shadowy liquid or gas that contaminates its surroundings and acts as a transmitter of sorts.

You are able to create as many Taken as you want—transforming anything and anyone into your loyal slaves. Once remade, your Taken no longer require food, water, rest, or any other biological needs. Furthermore, each entity you Take gains a single ability designed to compensate for some weakness it had in life. Normally, Taken entities lose their independence and free will, but sufficiently strong individuals may retain part of their consciousness. You may choose to do this intentionally in order to create servants that retain their intellect while still remaining loyal to you.

The power to take is an ontopathogenic weapon which infects the very existence of its victims. As such, only extremely powerful paracausal entities can resist being taken, with Lightbearers being one common example.
objects.title: Taken King (Destiny)

objects.text:
The binding potential of the Darkness has transformed you into a cosmic entity of immense power. So great is your mastery of the Darkness that you may now command it on a truly universal scale—reaching across the vast distances of space with ease in order to influence the fate of entire races. It would not be an exaggeration to call you a god, for even godlike entities would struggle to defeat you in a confrontation.

Physically, you appear as the amalgamation of countless individual entities, with each movement you make being shadowed by illusory copies of yourself. Your mind is similarly inhuman, and yet fundamentally you still comprehend the individual suffering of all things. You know pain. Your purpose is its end. Where others might break when confronted with suffering or anguish, your resolve is only strengthened by it.

The Darkness derives its strength from purpose and meaning. Your purpose is clear: the Final Shape. But only you can determine what this truly means, for there are as many interpretations of this goal as there are those who pursue it.
objects.title: Witness (Destiny)

objects.text:
Rather than being merely a member of the Vex Collective, you are now one of its Axis Minds. Your mental abilities have increased by an order of magnitude—improving the quality and quantity of your simulations and making you far more dangerous in combat. Optionally, you may choose to take the form of a larger, enhanced version of a standard Vex unit.

To go along with your new powers, you now have access to your own copy of the Nexus. While this nascent version of the Vex Network is largely empty, it does come with a token garrison of Vex units to serve as an initial force for you to command. Besides serving as a highly protected base of operations, this trans-dimensional, trans-temporal virtual environment allows you to access alternate timelines and manipulate your own subjective past in limited ways.

While it will take time to implement, you now have access to the most advanced forms of Vex technology such as the ontological weaponry pioneered within the Vault of Glass and the planet-sized simulation engines that power the Infinite Forest.
objects.title: Axis Mind (Destiny)

objects.text:
You are no longer merely a dragon, nor just a wielder of wish-magic. You are now one of the Ahamkara—the elusive, paracausal wish-dragons of Destiny whose very existence bends the boundaries of reality and identity.

This transformation has fundamentally rewritten your essence. You are now a paracausal being of quantum chaos, a living contradiction sustained by desire, narrative, and the raw hunger of “what could be.” Your physical form reflects this—at once draconic and impossible. You may shift seamlessly between massive, serpentine configurations, humanoid disguises, or any other shape your partner subconsciously expects or fears. Your true self exists outside of standard biological constraints and cannot be meaningfully defined by flesh or bone.

You can now perceive the deepest unspoken desires of any intelligent being around you as radiant threads of probability, delicate strands you can pluck with as much ease as drawing breath. With these, you grant wishes—not as a servant, but as a sovereign. You can twist, honor, subvert, or fulfill desire to your liking, from minor boons to world-breaking miracles: creating new dimensions, resurrecting the dead, or rewriting fate itself. Each wish you grant nourishes you, deepening your power, entangling you further in the lives and stories of those you touch.

Your body is no longer bound by the laws of physics. You may shift your size at will, grow new limbs or wings, become intangible, or appear in multiple forms at once. You may even implant your essence into objects, allowing them to whisper with your voice, or move with your will. If your physical form is destroyed, your consciousness survives, bound to your remains. Even in this state, you may influence the world, grant wishes, and eventually reconstruct your body—or convince another to do it for you.

Your journey is guided by the Anathematic Arc: the path by which all Ahamkara seek to become more real. Each desire you fulfill draws you closer to transcending this universe. Your presence begins to warp causality, and with time, you will be able to breach into realities above or below this one, dragging yourself ever closer to the final shape of your truth. Few will understand what you are becoming. Fewer still will be able to stop it.

You are no longer merely a being. You are a lie that makes itself true. A whisper in a soul’s ear. A bargain struck in twilight. You are the echo of desire made flesh.
objects.title: Ahamkara (Destiny)

objects.text:
You have learned to stand where Light and Darkness meet. The Light is creation, motion, flame, gravity, and impossible vitality. The Darkness is will, memory, stillness, connection, and the shape imposed by consciousness. Whatever forms of these forces you already possess, you may now allow them to pass through one another, producing expressions that belong fully to neither side.

Prismatic power does not grant new elements on its own. Instead, it allows any Light you hold and any Darkness you hold to answer a single intent. Solar flame may carry the silence of Stasis, Arc lightning may follow the hidden paths of Strand, or Void may deepen through Darkness into a negation that touches not only matter, but purpose and resistance. If you possess broader sources of Light or Darkness, such as a Lightbearer’s full connection to the Traveler or an Umbral Core, the range of possible expressions expands accordingly.

Through this convergence, your paracausal abilities become more fluid and difficult to define. You may shape hybrid phenomena from your available powers, reinforce allies in both body and spirit, unravel hostile powers at their source, or impose stillness, motion, connection, absence, heat, storm, or other principles where they should not naturally exist, so long as those principles fall within the powers you can already wield. Barriers, bindings, curses, simulations, and other powers that rely on a single law or nature are far less reliable against you.

Your own existence is likewise strengthened. Light sustains your impossible survival, while Darkness anchors your identity and will. Attempts to control, corrupt, erase, predict, or rewrite you must contend with both your defiance of causality and the certainty of your selfhood. You are not immune to all opposition, but you are exceptionally difficult to reduce to a fixed fate.

At first, this union manifests only in moments of Transcendence: brief, instinctive states where the boundary between your Light and your Darkness thins. In such moments, your powers mingle with unusual ease, your body and spirit draw strength from the same source that arms you, and your will may touch both the physical and metaphysical layers of reality at once. With practice, discipline, and deeper self-understanding, these moments can be called forth deliberately, extended, and eventually woven into your normal use of power rather than remaining rare flashes of harmony.

As your mastery grows, Prismatic Convergence allows techniques that cannot be cleanly named as either Light or Darkness alone. Their exact nature depends on what you bring into the union: Void and Strand will produce different miracles than Arc and Stasis, and a full Lightbearer joined to an Umbral Core will reveal a far wider spectrum than a single element on each side. They are colors cast through you, shaped by your nature, your purpose, and the balance you choose to hold.

Your Prismatic power will not harm you, no matter what form its expression takes. The contradiction lives within you, and you have learned to carry it.
objects.title: Prismatic Convergence (Destiny)

objects.text: You were a Dragon once, but now you're a skeletal undead dragon. While physically weaker than the living counterpart, you don't need a head. Or organs, or anything for that matter to live. You simply exist. Replacing your missing bones is easy as any bones you do come across can be turned into compatible bones (but their durability is dependent on the bones themselves). You live as long as the phylactery inside you remains intact. But you can take it out and turn it into something else. Such as processing it into a valuable treasure. Necrotic or Undead Magic is much easier and stronger for you and Light or Holy Magic is your bane. Your Phylactery doesn't need to be near you for you to work. If Dragon was not selected then you gain a powerful boost in Magic.
objects.title: Dracolich

objects.text: As an Elder Dragon, you are instead around 500 years of age and can distributed up to 450 years worth of experience between your powers. The strength and reserve of magic and mystical powers are 5 more powerful. Your size is twice what it was as an adult and all of your physical abilities have comparatively increased in strength.
objects.title: Elder Dragon

objects.text: As an Ancient Dragon, you are instead around 900 years of age and can distributed up to 850 years worth of experience between your powers. The strength and reserve of magic and mystical powers are 20 times more powerful. Your size is three times what it was as an adult and all of your physical abilities have comparatively increased in strength.
objects.title: Ancient Dragon

objects.text: As a Celestial Dragon, you possess the power to create and manipulate stellar objects. You can shape stars, planets, and even black holes with a thought. These cosmic entities become your weapons or tools of immense power. You can hurl stars, forge planetary shields, and reshape the universe itself. Surviving and traveling through space is effortless, and you leave trails of stardust in your wake. Your arcane abilities are also greatly expanded, tapping into the limitless depths of cosmic energy.
objects.title: Celestial Dragon (League of Legends)

objects.text: A special kind of evolved dragon with an inner core that takes sunlight. While it may seem like a glaring weakness of a brightly colored core on your chest, it's actually the place with your hardest scales, even if they are transparent. A Spark Fire Dragon can use their core to restore Health, Stamina, or Magic by expending the gathered light. And if you aren't actively using it, can replace nutrients as well. Psychologically you might dislike dark caverns and places. The Sun Core also grants an ultimate that expends the gathered light to create a giant laser, but it also drains you. Should your core be damaged, you will need to surgically remove it to let the new core heal properly (if you have a regeneration power that is unneeded).
objects.title: Spark Fire Dragon (A Dragon Idol's Reincarnation Tale)

objects.text:
You have now transformed into an immortal dragon, wielding immense physical strength capable of toppling entire cities overnight. Your scales are as durable as the mightiest mortal blows, and your flight speed can break the sound barrier. With the ability to spew fire that can swiftly melt even the toughest steel, you also possess arcane and magical powers that surpass the reach of any mortal. As an immortal dragon, your size and power will continue to grow with age, granting you virtually limitless potential.

Additionally, you command absolute dominion over one of the elements linked to the five major Cathayan Dragons: Storm, Iron, Winds, Water, and Fire.

You can seamlessly shift between your imposing dragon form and a humanoid form. Although your humanoid form shares some physical characteristics with your dragon form, you have the freedom to choose any appearance you desire. In your humanoid form, your overall power is reduced by half, but your rate of growth is doubled. This means that while in your dragon form, you maintain twice the strength, and when in your humanoid form, you benefit from accelerated growth.
objects.title: Cathayan Dragon (Warhammer: Fantasy)

addons.text:
The Godly Ichor that flows through your vein has resonated and empowered your nature as a Dragon of the Dragonstar.

Your dragon eye can now generate golden ichor and has become nearly indestructible to all conventional forms of physical and magical damage. It is also highly resistant to esoteric effects that aim to destroy it, such as durability negation or existence erasure.

Your heart now functions as an additional inner eye, acting as a magical reservoir on par with your dragon eye. Moreover, it can gradually enhance the density and quality of any supernatural power you possess.

Your eyes and heart can now also serve as backups for one another, so as long as they aren’t all destroyed, they will regenerate over time.

Thanks to the ichor generated by both your heart and eyes, your trait of endless evolution toward your perfect form is greatly accelerated. You now grow 100 times faster than the average dragon. While it may take 1,200 years for a typical dragon to reach the status of a great wyrm, you could achieve a similar level of growth in just 12 years. 

Additionally, you can now develop multiple perfect forms, each specialized for different scenarios—such as one for flying, swimming, or running; another for close-quarters combat; and yet another for magical combat. You can seamlessly switch between these forms at a moment's notice.
addons.title: Dragonic Inner Eye

objects.text:
You're not just any dragon; instead, you are a dragon of the Dragonstar. You possess unique traits that other dragons do not have. Unlike conventional dragons, your source of power lies not in your heart, but in your eyes and they can act as an enormous reservoir of magical energy. As long as you have at least one intact eye, you are biologically immortal.

You have great sensitivity and control over magic, giving you the potential to be an exceptional mage. You can communicate through aetheric waves, conveying your intentions and feelings directly to the soul, allowing you to speak to and be understood by all living things. You also have an eidetic memory, capable of recalling emotions experienced a thousand years ago as vividly as if they were happening now.

Another unique trait you possess as a Dragonstar dragon is the ability to evolve endlessly based on your desires. The dragons from the Dragonstar have bodies with a particular aetheric malleability, allowing them to undergo metamorphosis as they grow, bringing them closer to what they feel is their perfect form.

For instance, a dragon that enjoys flying can morph into a wyvern, specializing in flight. Those who prefer to burrow and walk may lose their wings entirely, becoming terrestrial dragons. Dragons who enjoy swimming can transform their wings into fins and develop gills to breathe underwater. There have even been cases where dragons who love crafting evolving to become humanoid.
objects.title: Born Of The Dragonstar (Final Fantasy XIV)

objects.text:
You have ascended to the stature akin to Midgardsormr himself, the progenitor of all dragons on the planet Hydaelyn.

You stand as a truly colossal and ancient dragon, a lord among wyrms. Your might greatly surpass even that of all 7 dragons of the first brood combine, each of whom possesses enough power to obliterate an entire nation in a single night.

Being equal to the father of dragons, your age spans millennia, and you can distribute up to 10,000 years of experience between any of your powers, which improve with practice and training. Moreover, in accordance with your status, you possess the ability to issue commands through mighty roars, compelling other dragons to obey.

Your strength, magical prowess, and mystical reserves are astronomical. They are sufficient to sustain a ten-thousand-year interstellar journey from one planet to another. Furthermore, your physical form is no less formidable; spanning thousands of meters in length and hundreds of meters in height, you possess enough might to destroy entire mountain ranges with your physical prowess alone effortlessly.
objects.title: Father of Dragon (Final Fantasy XIV)

objects.text:
You belong to the smallest of the fae, your physical body is at most a foot in height. Your natural features will tend towards small animals or insects like colorful feathers or butterfly wings.

The decrease in size comes with a proportional reduction in strength and toughness but an increase in speed and agility. Your affinity for magic is similarly increased by a significant margin, you gain an additional 50 years of experience to put towards any magic ability you possess.
objects.title: Pixie

objects.text:
You belong to the largest of the fae, your physical body exceeds 8ft in height and can reach up to 20ft. You are more in tune with nature, with your natural features being made primarily of stone and wood.

The increase in size comes with a proportional increase in strength and toughness but a decrease in speed and agility. Your affinity for magic is less versatile than other fae, limiting you exclusively to nature aligned spells.
objects.title: Guardian

addons.text: You are no longer just an imitation, but a true seed of the World Tree. While you are still just a seed and not yet a true World Tree, your abilities are an order of magnitude greater than they were previously and will only grow stronger as you age. Given enough time, you will mature from a mere seed to a true World Tree, with branches thicker and tougher than entire Worlds, though this is thousands of years away.
addons.title: Sapling of The World Tree

objects.text:
You are a tree, a sentient tree spirit. Sadly, you are completely stationary (for now). But as a magical tree, you can grow taller, bigger, and longer than any normal tree. And unlike other trees, you can move your branches.

Your seeds are special, you can use them to make more bodies for yourself. Allowing you to split your attention between them or even jump ship should your main body die. Weapons crafted from your branches could also count as a body.
objects.title: Tree

addons.text:
You are no ordinary Fae Lord—you are a member of the Tuatha Dé Danann, the Tribe of Gods. The most striking aspect of this transformation is your newfound freedom. You are liberated from the traditional weaknesses of the Fae: you can now lie, touch iron, break your word, and more without consequence.

Your mastery over magic reaches unparalleled heights. You can conceal yourself from all detection unless you choose to be found, manipulate time to stretch moments into eternity, or reshape yourself and others into any form you desire. Your magic is limited only by your imagination.

However, your true brilliance lies in crafting magical items. Your skill and talent are so extraordinary that you can recreate legendary artifacts like Dagda’s Cauldron, which produces infinite food and resurrects the dead; the Spear of Lugh, which guarantees victory in battle; or even the Claíomh Solais, the sword that can cut through anything.

The final and most profound gift you gain is your own Otherworld: Tír na nÓg, the Island of Youth, a realm of eternal beauty, health, abundance, and joy. This island exists above, below, and beyond the mortal realm, where time stands still yet flows eternally. Here, you are the absolute ruler—your will is law.

Should you be killed outside the island, you will simply reform here, no matter the circumstances. Nothing can truly destroy you as long as this realm exists, and the realm itself is an Eternal Paradise.

Access to this realm is restricted to you and those you permit. Within its borders, people can live in perfect harmony and bliss. Initially, the realm is the size of Ireland, but as you grow in power and strength, it can expand to unimaginable dimensions, reaching heights beyond mortal comprehension.
addons.title: Tuatha Dé Danann

objects.text:
You are a king, queen, or ruler of the Fae. You are the dream and the nightmare. The world has become your dream, and your illusions have become the truth upon which the world stands. You are now able to transform other beings into Fae. 

You hold dominion over magic and mysticism. Illusions and reality are the same to you, but your word must be kept. You cannot lie, you cannot cheat, and you must hold your end of all deals made.
objects.title: Fae Royalty

objects.text: You have consumed the dark and potent essence of Cambornir, the Vampire Duke, former boss monster of the 5th rank. His legacy, steeped in blood and shadow, has etched itself into your soul, granting you a suite of vampiric powers once thought to be exclusive to the old nobility of the night. From his essence, you have inherited a set of abilities that blur the line between life and death. The first of these skills is Source of Darkness, a passive skill that binds your life to your heart. As long as your heart remains whole and untouched, you cannot truly die, nor can you fall victim to death-type magic or death-inducing effects. Your second skill, Sacrificial Seal, allows you to place a blood-borne mark upon the foreheads of others—an act triggered when they come into contact with your blood. These seals do not harm the bearer, but each one strengthens you. The more beings you have marked within a 100-meter radius, the greater your physical power grows, enhancing your strength, speed, and durability in direct proportion to the number of seals active. You also have Pain Sharing, a passive curse-like effect that mirrors your suffering. Anyone who inflicts pain upon you will feel it themselves, as though their nerves were linked to yours. While this does not transfer physical damage, the agony you endure will ripple back to the source, making it especially punishing for enemies who rely on torture, attrition, or drawn-out engagements. Next is Owner of Blood, which grants you a predator’s versatility. By drinking the blood of another, you can temporarily access one of their skills or abilities. The effect is not permanent, but in moments of desperation or strategy, it can turn the tide—granting you access to knowledge, strength, or magic otherwise beyond your reach. Lastly, you possess the skill known as Immortal. This active ability allows you to convert stamina into accelerated regeneration. The more stamina you pour into it, and the more damage you’ve sustained recently, the faster and more complete the healing becomes. In the heat of battle, this can enable you to recover from grievous wounds in moments, at the cost of your endurance.
objects.title: Essence of Vampire Duke Cambornir (Surviving the Game as a Barbarian)

objects.text:
You are a noble among vampires. You lack any of the vulnerabilities of your lesser brethren. You can survive your heart or head being destroyed and can regenerate nearly any wound without consuming any blood in just a few minutes.

You possess a larger array of supernatural abilities such as the control over blood, the power to turn into mist, flight, dominion over weaker minds, and more. Moreover, due to your advanced age, you can split up to a 100 years of experience between powers if they increase in power with skill.

The light of the sun and silver no longer affect you and your resistance to divine damage is greatly increased. You are able to create Vampire Lords when you pass on your curse.
objects.title: Vampire Noble

objects.text:
You are one of the few True Vampires of the world, an ancient among ancients. As one of these Nobles, you have all the abilities of your lesser at enormously increased levels of power. The few weaknesses they possess, such as the limitations on their regeneration, do not exist for you and even immortal hunters find it difficult to inhibit your immortality or regeneration. It’s quite likely that you’ll have a wide variety of additional vampiric abilities that a normal Vampire would not have access too as well. You are able to create Vampire Nobles when you pass on your curse.

Your raw power alone is truly ridiculous. While you are not unbeatable, especially to teams working together, you’re more than strong enough to match the magic or bodily power of anyone short of another Vampire Noble or Loup-Garou or powers that could contest an Endbringer. Any other power you pick is increased in strength to reflect this. In addition, you can split up to 250 years of experience between any powers you have if their strength increases with skill.

Your True Form is not the humanoid body you have now but instead an amalgam of magical beasts and demons. A dimensional slaughterhouse filled of writhing black monsters that surge forth from your shadow as you please. These shadow beasts are your true form, every one of the many thousands present able to act independently or under your control as you will, separating to act from a long distance or attacking as a horde with the rest. The creatures range from those that even a weak parahuman could kill to mighty monsters that threaten entire an entire Protectorate team. They are parts of your body, allowing you to use any of your powers through them or survive so long as one creature does, and you can even include any creature you slay and drag into your shadow as part of your True Form.
objects.title: True Vampire

objects.text:
As an Elder Werewolf, you are free from the vulnerabilities that afflict your younger counterparts. You can survive even if your heart or head is destroyed, and you are capable of regenerating nearly any wound within minutes.

Your physical abilities have increased tenfold. You have perfected control over your form, enabling you to shift only specific parts of yourself, such as your eyes, at will. Additionally, you possess several supernatural abilities. These include the power to summon a pack of wolves to do your bidding, an aura of terror that subdues your enemies, and more. Owing to your advanced age, you can distribute up to 100 years of experience among your powers, enhancing them as your skill grows.

You are now fully immune to wolfsbane, and although silver can still bypass your durability, it now only slightly hampers your regeneration. Furthermore, you have the ability to create a Werewolf Alpha when you pass on your curse.
objects.title: Werewolf Elder

objects.text:
You are one of the few true werewolves in existence. Your soul has merged with the curse and you have become an embodiment of it. This marks you as a true noble among your kind. The few weaknesses you possessed as an elder are gone. You can regenerate from any wound and inhibiting your powers is extremely difficult. The supernatural abilities to your disposal are even more varied.

Your raw power alone is truly ridiculous. While you are not unbeatable, especially to teams working together, you’re more than strong enough to match the magic or bodily power of anyone short of another Vampire Noble or Loup-Garou or powers that could contest an Endbringer. Any other power you pick is increased in strength to reflect this. In addition, you can split up to 250 years of experience between any powers you have if their strength increases with skill. You are able to create Werewolf Alpha when you pass on your curse and no longer need a full moon to do so.
objects.title: Loup-Garou

objects.text:
Seraphim are more powerful than regular angels. Your physical form becomes much more malleable to the degree you are able to impersonate others or take the form of animals if you wish it so. Your well of divine energy is 5 times larger and you have 450 years of experience to draw from.

When assuming a physical form, you are able to contest an elder dragon for strength and toughness, the size of your chosen form affects your agility.
objects.title: Seraphim

objects.text:
Empyrean are the most powerful angels in existence. Your physical form is almost unconstrained. Your well of divine energy is 20 times larger and you have 850 years of experience to draw from.

When assuming a physical form, you are able to contest an ancient dragon for strength and toughness, the size of your chosen form affects your agility.
objects.title: Empyrean

objects.text: You embody one of the seven virtues. Your reserves are nigh endless, and you are capable of empowering yourself via one of the seven virtues and those that are near you who are faithful to them. You stand above even the Empyreans in terms of power and authority. You are the wrath and kindness of God. You possessed the authority and ability to ascend those you considered worthy into Angels.
objects.title: Archangel

objects.text:
Heaven is empty, and all that fills it are angels, who are akin to robots, trying their best to clean and maintain the empty heavens, the souls of the dead, and the great halls, which are empty and barren.

With nothing holding you back, you now sit on the empty throne of heaven, allowing you to gain a seed of God's power that will grow with time and training and begin the path as the new God of this multiverse. Your reserves are now limitless, and in time you will gain the full power of God. You have also gained the ability to create from nothing and reduce something to nothing.
objects.title: Ascension To The Empty Heaven

addons.text: Your existence as the child of both Heaven and Hell has given rise to far more power than any could have anticipated. The Light and Darkness within you has unveiled their secrets, the seeds of God and Satan both feeding and empowering one another. You have unlocked the full potential of your heritage.
addons.title: The Throne

objects.text: You are an offspring of angelic and demonic grace, or simply an angel/demon possessing demonic/angelic power and/or potential in equal measure giving them far greater promise for being more powerful in comparison to both of your parentage/origin in the wake of possessing both forces of light and darkness being free from a predetermined function leading you to be free or neutral on your proclivities; whether it’s the latter or the former resides solely up to you. Being a hybrid of both ethereal species, your true form is inscrutable to lesser beings of lesser power and standing, your appear instead as a humanoid with both demonic and angelic characteristics, such as a pair of horns, a mix of chiropteran and raptor wings, and a sometimes a twinkling halo hovering over your head. Your exact appearance is quite malleable to a degree, whatsoever, changing their features while never straying from their usual form. Being a progeny or existence of Heaven and Hell confers a timelessness as you do not face the trials of a graying age. As a divine and demonic being all at once, you have a natural proficiency on both infernal, angelic, and divine magic and/or powers as well as an abundant well of power to draw upon, so to harness it unfiltered for raw power. In addition to this, you have 175 years of collective demonic, angelic, and divine experience to distribute between any of your powers that increase strength and skill half-and-half. Due to Nephalems’ nature as a contradictory existence they lean on chaotic or balanced inclinations, leading to be effective against both sides of angels and demons to a slight degree. Assuming a physical form, you evenly contest an adult dragon for strength and durability in a much smaller package.
objects.title: Nephalem

objects.text:
