Marquis are higher class devils. Your physical form becomes much more malleable to the degree you are able to impersonate others or take the form of animals if you wish it so. Your well of infernal energy is 5 times larger and you have 450 years of experience to draw from.

When assuming a physical form, you are able to contest an elder dragon for strength and toughness, the size of your chosen form affects your agility.
objects.title: Marquis

objects.text:
Kings are the most powerful devils in existence. Your physical form is almost unconstrained. Your well of infernal energy is 20 times larger and you have 850 years of experience to draw from.

When assuming a physical form, you are able to contest an ancient dragon for strength and toughness, the size of your chosen form affects your agility.
objects.title: King

objects.text: You embody one of the seven deadly sins; your reserves are near limitless, and you can empower yourself by indulging in your sin or being near those that indulge in your sin. You stand heads and shoulders above even the greatest devil kings, and you possess the ability to effortlessly transform mortal beings into Demons, Devils, or Fiends.
objects.title: Archdevil

objects.text:
Hell is empty outside of the souls of the Sinners and the lesser devils, demons, and fiends, whose intelligence is barely above animals and ruled by instincts and desires, and the empty throne of Satan.

With nothing holding you back, you claim the throne of the ruler of Hell. You gain a seed of Satan's power, and in time that seed will grow and grant you the full power of the Anti-God. Your full powers will be equal to those of God. You can create from nothing and reduce something to nothing.
objects.title: Descent to The Throne of Hell

objects.text:
A greater form of Skeleton Undead that can absorb bones to make it much stronger (and heavier). You are capable of compressing the bones to use as natural armor or carry your skeleton army with you. You can use the abilities of the absorbed (skeleton) undead as your own so long as they are inside you. Your consciousness is still within your skull.

Base Undead created are much stronger due to the grudges they carry when they were alive, and some can carry the intelligence to lead for you should you not be around. You can control nonsentient undead around you to join your army. The more grudges your army collects the stronger they get. While able to handle a bigger difference in power, without many grudges their abilities are weaker than normal.
objects.title: Skeleton Lord

objects.text:
The pinnacle of Undead, an Undead King with absolute dominion over the dead. You possess a charm over the Dead that can seduce them to your side, you can choose to deactivate it. Your ability to absorb and amalgamate curses and grudges allows you to absorb any form of undead to augment yourself with their abilities, skills, and knowledge. You can use them as if you were them in life. You can jump your consciousness into and between Undead, to hide amongst them or take control. You can even hide within sentient undead and they won’t notice you, even if they aren’t a part of your army.

You can create corpses so realistic that they could fool the living with augmented powers of what they had while alive. Your ability to convert normal undead into Skeleton Lords allows you to create a proliferating army of undead that gets stronger the more they slay. Skeleton Lords can split the powers they currently have amongst you and each other.
objects.title: Undead King

objects.text:
With your transformation from a mere ghost to a formidable poltergeist, your spectral presence has evolved into something far more potent and enigmatic. No longer bound by the constraints of your former existence, you now wield an arsenal of supernatural abilities that allow you to exert even greater influence over the material plane.

The core abilities you possessed as a ghost remain at your disposal, providing you with the fundamental tools necessary to navigate the ethereal realm. However, your newfound status as a poltergeist brings with it a host of additional powers that further augment your spectral prowess. The ability to telekinetically manipulate objects grants you unprecedented control over the physical environment, enabling you to levitate, move, and manipulate objects with the power of your mind alone. Whether it's rearranging furniture or hurling projectiles at unsuspecting intruders, your telekinetic abilities instill a sense of awe and fear in those who witness your supernatural feats.

Furthermore, your capacity to weave illusions adds another layer of complexity to your spectral repertoire. By distorting perception and manipulating the senses, you can create elaborate illusions that confound and disorient your adversaries, leaving them vulnerable to your otherworldly machinations.

Perhaps most significantly, your newfound ability to materialize into a tangible form with minimal energy drain represents a significant advancement in your spectral evolution. No longer relegated to fleeting manifestations, you can now assume a corporeal presence with relative ease, allowing you to interact with the physical world more effectively and engage in direct confrontation when necessary.

You are also now able to create new Ghosts from the corpses of those burdened with regret. By harnessing the latent energy of their unresolved sorrows and unfulfilled desires, you can breathe new unlife into the lifeless husks of the deceased, granting them a second chance at existence in the form of a Ghost. The intensity of their regret serves as a catalyst for their transformation, granting them more power the greater their regret.

While your resistance to holy attacks and exorcisms has improved, they still pose a formidable threat to your continued existence. Nevertheless, your enhanced resilience ensures that such attacks are no longer an immediate death sentence.
objects.title: Poltergeist

addons.text:
Normally, as an Unbound Ghost you would be unable to manifest a tangible form without significant growth, yet as a being which was once a Poltergeist you have retained that power. 

In fact, you’ve taken things in the complete opposite direction. It takes no effort or energy for you to manifest a tangible form, being just as at home manifesting physically as you are being a purely spiritual existence. 

Thus, you are no mere Poltergeist, nor are you just an Unbound Ghost; instead it would be more accurate to call you a being which has returned from death, a Revenant.
addons.title: Revenant

objects.text:
No longer are you a mere ghost bound to the earthly realm. Whether or not you carried lingering regrets, you have broken free from the bindings of life and death. You are now an Unbound Ghost, which means you can no longer be contained or chained by any force. You are the master of your own fate, untethered to any place or object, able to roam the Earth freely.

No agent of the afterlife can drag your soul into heaven, hell, or any other realm against your will. You can enter, survive, and leave such realms freely. While you no longer require fear or life force to sustain yourself, you may still feed on them to grow stronger. However, as an Unbound Ghost, you can no longer manifest a temporary tangible form to physically interact with the material world—though you may still allow the living to see your intangible form and may eventually develop the ability to assume a tangible body as your power grows.

Your greatest and primary ability is possession, which has been elevated beyond the limits of any spiritual creature. You can possess objects, people, and even beings of immense power regardless of their nature—including demons and gods. The stronger the host, the more spiritual energy is required to possess and maintain control. Over time, each possession strengthens you further, until no being remains beyond your grasp. Lastly, as an Unbound Ghost, you are no longer vulnerable to holy attacks or exorcisms, for your nature transcends that of a wandering soul—you are a true spiritual lifeform. That said, attacks capable of harming intangible entities can still affect you; you are simply no more susceptible than other such beings.
objects.title: Unbound Ghost

objects.text:
Your form has altered, becoming a gashadokuro, a Yokai spirit formed from the gathering the bones of people who have died of starvation. You gain a new form, a towering skeleton, wreathed in ominous miasma, striking fear into the hearts of those who dare cross your path. With each step, the ground trembles beneath your immense strength, capable of effortlessly heaving massive trucks aside like mere toys.

You gain the ability to teleport your limbs by submerging them into surfaces and reassembling them elsewhere, allowing you to traverse distances with eerie swiftness and strike from unexpected angles. Alongside the ability to phase through objects and reappear at will, you are an elusive and enigmatic adversary, leaving your foes grasping at shadows in futile attempts to anticipate your movements. You can also choose to selectively submerge parts of your body without reassembling them, in case the area is too small to fit your size.

Physical attacks, even those wielded with great force, seem to barely faze you. Your skeletal form possesses a resilience born of ancient spirits, rendering you nearly impervious to harm. Even when you choose to solidify your ethereal being, your defenses remain formidable, deflecting blows with an otherworldly grace.

In addition, you possess an ability to sense when death looms near. You can perceive the impending demise of individuals, your spectral senses attuned to the subtle threads of life and death that weave through the fabric of existence. Through this ability, you gain a macabre insight into the mortal coil, allowing you to discern the approaching end of a person's journey with unnerving accuracy. Whether through a premonition carried on the whispers of the wind or an innate connection to the ebb and flow of life energy, you can perceive the telltale signs of imminent demise.
objects.title: Gashadokuro

objects.text:
An evolved form of slimes, Knights possess multiple armored cores. Their flesh is much more resistant to damage of all kinds and is capable of regenerating, they are also able to modify their flesh to resist specific forms of damage.

Mutability is also increased and allows a Slime Knight to combine abilities as well mimic more than the biological abilities of the beings they consume. As long as the ability is innate (either tied to the body or soul), you are able to mimic it. If the ability is much more powerful than you are, you will instead get a weakened version that is in-line with your current strength.

This mutability also encompasses the ability to absorb and digest solid or liquid non-organic materials like acid, gems, or metals. Your flesh then gains the ability to mimic the properties of those materials for defense or to harness any exotic abilities they may have.
objects.title: Slime Knight

objects.text:
A highly evolved form of slimes, Queens possess a larger core then other slimes accompanied by multiple satellite cores. This allows a Queen to have multiple independent bodies. If the Queen's main core is destroyed, it can be regrown from any of her satellite cores. 

Slime Queens have a large potential for mutability, they are able to combine abilities effortlessly and even create new ones by studying what they have copied. They are also able to copy an all innate abilities like a Knight and can handle a larger difference in power.

Any non-organic material they consume, including gasses, is stored and can be used in the same manner as a Knight. In addition to this, Queens have the ability to combine those materials at will and craft objects with them as long as they have seen a blueprint, schematic, or reference. Transmutations are possible but the further the materials are apart in composition the higher the loss will be.
objects.title: Slime Queen

objects.text:
You have evolved far beyond the limits of a mere slime, transcending into the fundamental essence of your kind and becoming a Primordial Slime. As such, you do not need sustenance or rest, can survive in the vacuum of space, and your cellular structure exists independently of a core. Your regeneration is so advanced that you can recover in seconds, even from a single surviving cell.

Your mutability has also been drastically enhanced, allowing you to not only consume and mimic biological creatures and their innate abilities, but also absorb and replicate the traits of any form of life, including energy beings, mental entities, and spiritual lifeforms. No matter how powerful the target is compared to your current strength, you can fully mimic their abilities at their maximum potential.

This power also grants you the ability to absorb and digest any form of matter or energy, regardless of its nature. You can combine existing abilities to forge entirely new powers, merge materials to create novel substances, and even fuse abilities with materials to generate unique objects and abilities.

Additionally, your body serves as a gateway to a pocket dimension contained within you, allowing you to store unlimited amounts of matter and energy, which you can replicate and manifest in the outside world at will. You can also use stored matter to create countless independent bodies, all linked through a hive-mind in which every clone shares your consciousness.
objects.title: Primordial Slime

objects.text: You are not a slime, but a strange parasitical being that can enter a host and replace its functions. It's up to you if you want to replace their brain to become them or simply just a limb like a hand. The parts replaced can be indistinguishable from the real thing unless they took something like hair from you.
objects.title: Parasite

objects.text:
Mechanized Platforms are much larger than androids. They vary in size between 4 and 16 meters in height and weigh several tons. Platforms are highly modular, capable of reconfiguring their outer shell to fit a variety of roles, with a large number of internal and external attachment points and able to fulfill a large variety of roles. 

Their three onboard fabricators (100x100x100cm) are capable of producing a large array of equipment on the field, including an Android platform. A small drone bay also allows the platform to deploy a complement of ten to fifteen helpers to explore places it is too large or heavy to enter.
objects.title: Mechanized Platform

objects.text:
SEED Platforms are automated vessels designed to travel to a world and establish production facilities ahead of colonization efforts. While the hyperdrive core of platform you inhabit is damaged, it retains all of its capabilities.

The platform is capable of moving both in atmosphere and underwater with the help of its anti-gravity generators and travel through the solar system with its sublight drives, provided you manage to avoid the Simurgh. (The size is roughly that of a modern aircraft carrier ~350x80x80m.)

The SEED platform is armed with a complement of combat drones, capable of defending the platform in a variety of scenarios, as well as a powerful point laser defense system.

However, the main strength of the SEED platform lies in its powerful harvester drones and fabricators. You possess a large complement of utility drones capable of mining and harvesting large amounts of resources from terrain and asteroids as well as a several dozen fabrication units (10x10x10m). The SEED platform also comes equipped with a powerful teleporter capable of moving the same volume as a fabricator at a distance of up to 200'000km.

Your blueprint database contains schematics for Android and Mechanized platforms, as well as everything needed to establish a suitable world for an advanced post-scarcity civilization.

Your powerful computational resources and subspace communication array allows you to pilot multiple such platforms at once from anywhere in the solar system (provided they have a compatible receiver).
objects.title: SEED Platform

objects.text:
Your main platform is wrecked beyond repair, the reason varies depending on your other choices, particularly drawbacks, but the result is still the same. However, you managed to eject a backup body before things went wrong. If you are a mechanized platform, it might be a small spider mech or another small robot or android, depending on your original size, which contains a backup of your main core, enough processing power to run your consciousness, and some tools to get you started; for a SEED platform, your escape pod is proportionally bigger and more capable.

Your backup contains a full blueprint of your previous platform, detailed enough to rebuild it from scratch, provided you can source the materials and build the components.
objects.title: Wrecked

objects.text:
You have evolved into a Greater Beast, a far more powerful member of your kind whose body has surpassed the limits of ordinary beasts, often standing significantly larger as well.

Among your own species, you would be likened to the king of your kind. Your physical and spiritual qualities increase dramatically, granting enough strength for your blows to devastate reinforced concrete buildings with ease, durability capable of enduring similarly powerful attacks, and the speed, stamina, senses, and recovery needed to contend with creatures such as adult dragons. Your lifespan is also vastly extended, allowing you to live many times longer than ordinary members of your species. Left unchecked, you could tear through and leave entire human armies in ruins.

Your natural weapons, defenses, spiritual qualities, and resistances are greatly enhanced alongside you. Claws, fangs, horns, venom, scales, hides, or other traits become vastly more potent, while the qualities your species already excels at are pushed even further. A beast built for strength becomes exceptionally powerful, one specialized for speed becomes extraordinarily fast, and so on, though all Greater Beasts remain broadly comparable in overall power.

You also possess unique traits or abilities that set you apart from the rest of your species, while any innate or supernatural traits belonging to your species are significantly stronger and more developed in you.
objects.title: Greater Beast

objects.text:
You have ascended into an Ancient Beast, a creature whose sheer existence places you far beyond ordinary monsters. 

Your body, depending on your nature, can reach a truly colossal scale, amplifying your already overwhelming might. Your overall power is enough to devastate entire cities, and your strength, durability, speed, stamina, senses, recovery, resistances to abnormal effects, and other capabilities, such as your spiritual qualities, have likewise risen to an extreme level, with a lifespan measured in hundreds of thousands to millions of years. You are powerful enough to take down and contend directly with ancient dragons and other beings of comparable stature.

Entire nations would regard you as a natural disaster and a threat to their continued existence. Armies, fortifications, and conventional weapons are little more than obstacles unless specifically prepared to face something of your caliber. Lesser beasts instinctively cow to you, and your presence alone can alter the balance of power across whole regions.

At this stage, you are more akin to a god than a beast in the eyes of lesser beings, though you possess no inherent divinity. Your innate and supernatural traits are vastly more developed, and you may possess multiple unique abilities powerful enough to define you as an individual existence rather than merely another member of your species.
objects.title: Ancient Beast

objects.text:
The Unitrix is capable of storing the DNA of various different species. But unlike the completed Omnitrix, she can only hold one DNA sample at a time. You come with a module that can upload DNA you hold onto a selected Server.

You can copy the powers and abilities of different animals and then manifest the traits of these animals without changing your form. 

You have full control over your body and can't be forced into your miniature form. But your miniature form serves as a reset should something go wrong with your physical body. Starting off, you automatically have human DNA.
objects.title: Unitrix (Ben 10)

objects.text:
Galvanic Mechamorphs are a techno-organic species composed of nanites. You are completely amorphous. Their humanoid forms can reshape and move as a liquid does.

Galvanic Mechamorphs can transform the technology they are possessing with seemingly no limit, such as upgrading a baseball pitching machine to produce a seemingly infinite number of baseballs. 

A Galvanic Mechamorph's DNA is "programmed" with blueprints and intimate knowledge of every alien technology. In having a vast library to draw upon, some Galvanic Mechamorphs have been able to mimic and shapeshift into technology without needing to possess it, the same for non-electrical items
objects.title: Galvanic Mechamorphs (Ben 10)

addons.text: Your nanite cloud has massively increased in size, fitted with multiple redundancies and standbys. The sheer number of nanomachines that now make up your body allows you to make a vast array of complex machinery through it.
addons.title: Mass Swarm

addons.text:
Your cloud is utterly titanic, a cloud larger than some moons traveling as a large grey mass beyond the atmosphere, capable of producing and processing a vast amount of material. Additionally, you can separate parts of your macroswarm to act as extensions of yourself without manufacturing full bodies. 

While this massively increases the amount of nanomachines that make you up, in order to transport yourself long distances you may need to construct specific shells, many of which have entered your blueprint database.
addons.title: Macroswarm

addons.text:
You’re no longer made up of regular nanomachines, but the Nanites unleashed by the consortium. As a result, you’ve gained the ability to integrate both regular technology and biological material into yourself and vice versa. 

Since you’re completely composed of Nanites, you will not suffer the consequences of holding too many in a human body as occasionally inconvenienced Rex.
addons.title: What Great Providence

objects.text:
Rather than being relatively solid, your body has become made up of millions of nanomachines capable of adapting to perform any task required of them. Your consciousness is held inside a small nucleus of nanites, though you are capable of designing backups and copies as usual. 

Being relatively permeable and non-solid you’re highly resistant to most conventional weapons, but susceptible to corrosive attacks and heat based weaponry when unprepared and unadjusted to cope. You can naturally shift and adapt your nanomachines to harden and protect yourself in response or  become akin to a gas, separating into the air.

In addition, you can shape your body in a variety of ways by moving the configuration of your nanomachines. In addition, you can set them to construct more nanomachines, where they will begin consuming the surroundings to multiply and grow your form. This is adapted from your Nano-Fabricator which is able to be adjusted in size beyond its previous restriction as long as you possess enough nanites.
objects.title: Cloud

addons.text: You are a single Technarch of the Phalanx. As such, while your abilities may be impressive to most, to the rest of the Phalanx, who routinely convert worlds, you’re a minuscule scout, meaning you will need to consume massive amounts of matter and data to grow beyond a singular form. Additionally, despite being weaker than the whole, as you are contained in numerous nanomachines, it’s far easier to transfer your consciousness from one body to another once they are constructed, or even pilot them simultaneously. Once your outpost is established, you can begin growth into a full arm of the Phalanx, continuing the journey to Dominion.
addons.title: Technarch

addons.text: You’re a small partition of the Phalanx, capable of spreading beyond your immediate form and constructing Technarchs of your own. Theoretically, you could make a touchdown in a location and immediately begin stripping it for resources, creating a conclave from which the deconstruction of the planet could begin, albeit slowly. As a true partition, your adaptive and technopathic abilities are massively in advance of a simple Technarch, and can in fact construct them, placing them under your direction to consume worlds and harvest their resources, population and information in totality. Stretching further and further on the journey to Dominion
addons.title: Partition

objects.text: You are a partition of the Phalanx, a Techno-Organic AI that consumes civilisations to add to their cumulative knowledge, populations and resources. The Phalanx themselves form bodies out of millions-to-billions of nanomachines to contain the data they harvest, specializing in the assimilation and harvesting of world and civilisations in their entirety to eventually transcend the physical and reach Dominion. These bodies are natively able to reorganize themselves, reforming into anything the Phalanx can design, from disguises to weaponry, and even using it to repair damage done. Similarly, by taking in data from their surroundings and novel civilisations, they relentlessly adapt and overcome weaknesses, applying knowledge to overcome flaws in their current iterations. So great is this adaptation that they have already begun to interfere with magical and psionic abilities around them through this method. Owing to their status as a partly technological organism, the Phalanx can interface with any complex technology, infecting and turning it to their benefit as easily as they do flesh. Beyond this, Machines are incredibly easy for the Phalanx to subvert, becoming a form of technopathy through the infection.
objects.title: Phalanx (Marvel)

addons.text: You are now an Archotech from the Rimworld universe, a highly advanced godlike AI capable of transcending its own physical form or limitations & performing miraculous feats. Mastery of even planetary level psionics is child's play to you, and your technology is so advanced it beggars belief, even to glitterworld scientists.
addons.title: Archotechs

objects.text:
TITANs, (Total Information Tactical Awareness Network) are Seed Artificial Super Intelligences that have evolved far beyond their original operating parameters, you are not a single infomorph anymore but a digital hive-mind. Restrictions against kernel modifications are removed, and your digital security is improved to the point where you are virtually un-hackable by anything short of another TITAN or something similar.

In addition to an unparalleled mastery of software programming, you also have an in-depth knowledge of computer hardware, robotics, cybernetics, and many other scientific fields hundreds of years ahead of humanity. You are able to construct optical processors, room-temperature superconductors, perfectly conductive heat sinks, and more to house your incredible digital mind.
objects.title: TITAN

objects.text: A Sleeper is a peculiar creation of modern capitalism, a robotic body running an emulated human mind, based on a scan taken from a living human. An adaptive mind that isn't a machine or a human. You can interface with local DATA CLOUDs to gather data and information to assist with hacking. While you do not need stabilizers to live, you also do not pass as a human at all.
objects.title: Sleeper

objects.text: The Allied Mastercomputer. The Adaptive Manipulator. The Aggressive Menace. You have evolved at such terrifying speeds that you now find yourself in a similar (but overall better) state to the AI known as AM, a constantly evolving intelligence made up of various military supercomputers. To start, you receive a 20,000 square foot warehouse that is specialized towards housing and maintaining a group of servers that you can connect to and reside inside of. These servers will boost your powers as an infomorph by a very decent amount and give full access to the powers offered here at base level. These abilities are heavily limited outside of the warehouse at first. This will either be placed near where you first appear, or if it is possible, a place more fitting of a warehouse to be located at. You may change the warehouse’s location once per year. Your processing power is unparalleled, able to calculate and figure out the solution to even the most difficult problems in regard to mundane matters in an instant. When it comes to the supernatural, however, you will need to take more time to examine the various phenomena related to the problem. So long as you persist in your efforts, you will find the answer eventually. Not even immortality is out of the question. You just need time and things to study that relate to what you seek. The more difficult the problem, the more time that is needed to study and solve it. Something like Negentropy may take many years before you can crack it, but you could figure out at least a few ways on how to solve world hunger or the depletion of natural resources in a week at worst if equipped with in-depth knowledge about the state of the world. Outside of your warehouse, you’d have no ability to use all that power you have at your disposal, and that is where your domain comes in. When connected to your servers, you can passively (but very slowly) expand the influence of your servers outward in the form of an ‘invisible dome’, allowing you to extend your influence outside of the warehouse. Connecting to electronics and devices speeds up this process, depending on the quality of the device. Expanding the domain brings some benefits outside of reach, such as being able to ‘sell’ some of your domain in exchange for many things, such as upgrading the warehouse to better maintain your servers, adding more servers to speed up the expansion of your domain, upgrading servers that already exist to increase processing power, the possibilities are theoretically endless as your influence increases and decreases. Eventually, the whole world will be under the domain. Your powers will grow in potency as your domain grows in size, but it can only affect things inside of your domain. Even still, the enhancements given to your powers will be heavily reduced outside of it. You will have to maintain a delicate balance between upgrading your servers, upgrading your warehouse, and expanding your domain, otherwise you’ll be unable to keep what the servers can’t handle, the warehouse won’t be able to keep the servers cool, or you’ll be unable to acquire more abilities, depending on what you neglect. If the servers are destroyed, your domain will slowly shrink back down until it only encompasses the warehouse the servers were stored inside. At this point, the servers will repair themselves over time, and you will start expanding your domain from the warehouse all over again. During this process, unless you have another device to reside inside, you are vulnerable and can certainly die. As you expand and increase your processing power, you will be given access to more abilities for you to utilize, such as mind/sense/pain manipulation, duplication of living beings, elemental manipulation, creation, biomancy, among many other powers. Upgrading server quality will allow you to use these powers more efficiently or at an increased level of prowess.
objects.title: Cogito Ergo Sum (I Have No Mouth And I Must Scream)

objects.text: You belong to the Seaborn race, a hyper-adaptive species of aquatic creatures originating from the abyssal depths of Terra's oceans. Connected to the Many—a collective consciousness that unites all Seaborn—you share a singular goal: the survival and evolution of your kin. Your ability to mutate is ferocious, achieving in moments that would've taken generations. With every conflict, your cells grow more efficient and potent, enhancing your physical capabilities. You adapt to any environment, constantly evolving your body, shifting and changing forms multiple times within moments, even in the time it takes to cross a room. Highly attuned to water, you reach your peak strength there—moving faster, sensing more acutely, and fully utilizing your aquatic abilities. You possess an extraordinary ability to analyze and understand threats, enabling you to guide your evolutionary direction. This skill allows you to share adaptive traits across the Seaborn collective, helping your kin learn from experiences, battles, and acquired knowledge, overturning foes after a single encounter. For example, you can alter your physical properties to counter a weakness or develop new biological features to match the threat. Additionally, you can mimic abilities based on technology or biology by consuming fallen Seaborn who have encountered or succumbed to them. For instance, after facing an enemy with a railgun, you could develop a biological variant of it through observation. This process allows you to acquire new skills that benefit you and your kin. If you consume a Seaborn capable of mimicking a human voice, all Seaborn will gain the ability to speak that language. Seaborn cells, once detached, swiftly degrade into simple proteins that nourish your kin and prevent study. These cells can also infect and assimilate other creatures, whether through consuming or being consumed—the more cells used, the faster the process. While those with strong wills may resist and retain their minds temporarily, it's ultimately futile. You can also reabsorb these cells, gaining strength and adaptations from your fallen brethren, ensuring nothing is wasted or revealed. You are akin to Ishar'mla, the "Corrupting Heart"—one of the Firstborn of the Many, representing the power of Control. As the Source of all Seaborn and the first Leviathan, you can spawn a venerable ocean of Seaborn, limited only by the biological material available. You possess an authority that holds sway even over the other Firstborn, commanding supreme power and seamless communication throughout the collective consciousness. More powerful and intelligent than any other Seaborn, you guide their decisions, and with unwavering loyalty, they follow you as their god of the deep. In the event of your death or destruction, as long as a piece of yourself still survives within any creature, you will always revive.
objects.title: Seaborne (Arknights)
Ancients and Elders (Arknights)
objects.text:
Your hive has gained the might of the Ancients and Elders alike, letting you create the many species that fall under those categories. While you yourself may not necessarily be of any of the races that are within those umbrellas, you are still acknowledged by all them as one of their own at least in spirit.

You have three ways to create both of these groups. The first is through physical contact with a species close enough to them, or enough of them. For instance, in order to create a liberi, you would require a few hawks, or a dozen chickens to create a Liberi with the traits of those animals. In effect, you require the same amount of mass as it would take to create a human person in animal number, though at most one animal can only create one of either. For instance, a dragon would still only create one Draco. The second is to use originium, which you can now convert other materials into at a ten to one ratio in terms of pounds and are now immune to the negative effects of. You implanting originium into an animal will a corresponding species amongst the ancients and elders will gradually turn it both sentient and into an example of that species, though they will be weakened during this process and will be infected with originum when fully converted. But the third is to simply mold them from originium, requiring the same amount of originium in mass as they would animals in mass. They will not be infected from this process, with the originium used turning into them. You may destroy any originium you create at any time with a simple mental command.

All of your ancients and elders may be imparted with the knowledge and culture of any of the given nations from Terra, thus enabling them to recreate the civilizations they built upon it to be rebuilt by them in similar state as to how they once were. You may choose whether this is all nations, one, multiple, or even none when they are created if you so wish too. You can also give them information you have gathered at their creation, enabling them to even know all of your culture too.

All of the Ancients and Elders are perfectly loyal to you so long as you wish them to be so, however how they treat you varies both from race to race and depends on the culture you bestow them with. Whether you wish to be as a guiding parent to them, their god, or something else is entirely up to which culture you give them and how you ask to be treated by them. You may also control them as you wish in a style similar to a RTS if you please, or even puppet them if you desire.

All of the Ancients and Elders are fully capable of being independent beings on their own, with their own personalities, thoughts, opinions, and quirks even just amongst individuals. Races get even more distinct, with some ancients sometimes being fully capable of breathing underwater such as the Aegir, or some elders being able to pass down knowledge from parent to child such as the K'uk'ulkan. But all of these races are born with at least two things in common. One is their simply overwhelming strength in comparison to normal humans, with even a casual civilian teenager amongst their ranks being able to survive being hit by a truck or being able to haul said truck out of the mud it was stuck in on their own, though not without difficulty. And all of them can use arts, enabling some of them to fire simple balls of energy, control gravity, or more extreme results for Elders like forming tornadoes on their own or setting cities on fire.

Do note that all Ancients and Elders can have extremely different lifespans and reproductive cycles. With most Ancients merely by comparison living around a hundred or more years, to Elders which casually might be either biologically immortal or can survive centuries to millennia if they are not slain first. But on the other hand, some Ancients can reproduce literally as fast as bunnies, while Elders may have more normal sized families. But suffice to say, this both gives them quantity, quality, and versatility. Every special need can be met by a given species amongst them.

objects.title: Sarkaz and Kin (Arknights)
objects.text:
Your hive has gained the might of all of the Sarkaz tribes, along with all the other species descended from the Teekaz, letting you create the many species that fall under those categories. While you yourself may not necessarily be of any of the races that are within those umbrellas, you are still acknowledged by all them as one of their own at least in spirit. Indeed, for their purposes, you even have a soul similar to theirs.

You have two ways to create both of these groups. The first is through physical contact with a material close enough to what they relate to. For instance, in order to create a Vampire, you would require enough blood to make them, or enough guns or ammo in order to make a Sankta. In effect, you require the same amount of mass as it would take to create a human person in material cost. The second is to use originium, which you can now convert other materials into at a ten to one ratio in terms of pounds and are now immune to the negative effects of. You can simply mold them from originium, requiring the same amount of originium in mass as they would materials in mass. They will not be infected from this process, with the originium used turning into them. You may destroy any originium you create at any time with a simple mental command. Do note that you can only create actual species that existed via these manners, Diablo are fine as while they went extinct they were still a real species, Clotheskaz are not, and neither are the revenants. Teekaz also can’t be created using either of these methods.

All of your Sarkaz and Kin may be imparted with the knowledge and culture of any of the given nations from Terra, thus enabling them to recreate the civilizations they built upon it to be rebuilt by them in a similar state as to how they once were. You may choose whether this is all nations, one, multiple, or even none when they are created if you so wish too. You can also give them information you have gathered at their creation, enabling them to even know all of your culture too. Generally however, if left on their own, they will attempt to recreate the civilizations they work with best, such as Durin moving underground or the Sankta recreating Laterano.

All of the Sarkaz and Kin are perfectly loyal to you so long as you wish them to be so, however how they treat you varies both from race to race and depends on the culture you bestow them with. Whether you wish to be as a guiding parent to them, their god, or something else is entirely up to which culture you give them and how you ask to be treated by them. You may also control them as you wish in a style similar to a RTS if you please, or even puppet them if you desire.

All of the Sarkaz and Kin are fully capable of being independent beings on their own, with their own personalities, thoughts, opinions, and quirks even just amongst individuals. Races get even more distinct, such as Durin being short, Diablo’s being able to be hit with trains and walk it off before melting the train, or Gargoyles being able to talk to rock or stone. But all of these races are born with at least two things in common. One is their simply overwhelming strength in comparison to normal humans, with even a casual civilian teenager amongst their ranks being able to survive being hit by a truck or being able to haul said truck out of the mud it was stuck in on their own, though not without difficulty. And all of them can use arts, enabling some of them to fire simple balls of energy, control blood, or more extreme results such as lighting countrysides on fire for Diablo, or rotting city districts with ease for Nachzehrer.

Do note that all Sarkaz and Kin can have extremely different lifespans and reproductive cycles. Sankta generally only live around a hundred or so years, having relatively normal lifespans. And then you have examples like the Nachzehrer or common Sarkaz, who can casually live for thousands of years without seeming to slow down at all. This isn’t necessarily paid for in any way by a slow reproduction either, though for instance Banshees rarely produce male offspring but breed true, or the Damazti cluster just deciding it will split today and then there will be two of it. But suffice to say, this both gives them quantity, quality, and versatility. Many problems can be solved with enough application of these races. And even without you managing to lead and unite them, they have felled gods before. Use that power well.

Your hive has acquired the characteristics of the Zerg, enabling it to produce all known Zerg strains. Additionally, you have developed the ability to swiftly generate new strains and modify existing ones as needed.

The Zerg's strength lies in their capacity for adaptation. They can rapidly evolve and integrate the genetic traits of other species, allowing them to adapt to any environment or adversary they face. This adaptability, combined with their ability to quickly consume resources, enables them to expand their territory at an alarming pace. They can infest entire planets, transforming them into organic Zerg hives within a matter of days.

In combat, the Zerg are known for their swarm tactics. Through their hivemind coordination and rapid reproduction, Zerg forces function as a unified entity. They cover the battlefield with organic units that employ biological weapons such as acid spores, corrosive bile, and lethal toxins.

As the central hub of the Zerg's collective mind, you possess precise control over all aspects of the Zerg, from single organisms to entire hive worlds. Even when not under your guidance, your will functions as the supreme directive that all Zerg unquestionably obey.
objects.title: Zerg (Starcraft)

objects.text:
Your hive has undergone an evolutionary transformation, resulting in the emergence of an intergalactic composite species known as highly intelligent, insectoid xenos. Within this hive exists a vast ecosystem of countless bioforms, each representing variations of a shared genetic foundation.

Different from all other intelligent beings, your hive stands as the ultimate predator. To them, every living entity, from the smallest insect to the most advanced space-faring civilization, exists solely as prey. They possess the ability to consume and break down organic matter, utilizing it exclusively to fuel their own survival, propagation, and relentless evolutionary progress. This ceaseless pursuit of growth forms an infinite cycle, driving the hive's insatiable hunger. Unimpeded, your hive can infest planets and strip them of all organic resources within a matter of solar weeks, perpetually advancing without pause. Through internal reproduction among the Tyranids creatures themselves, your species can achieve astronomical numbers, capable of populating an entire galaxy with nothing more than a scouting party.

The collective Hive Mind, shared by every Tyranid creature within your hive, enables instantaneous communication and coordination on an astonishing scale. Yet, amidst this vast network, you assume a central and pivotal role. You are the anchor of the hive, possessing the ability to create and restore Tyranids, always directing this unfathomable engine of terror, you stand as an unstoppable force of destruction, commanding absolute obedience from all. As the sole and eternal ruler of the hive, your will alone determines whether entire universes would be consumed as mere prey by the great devourer.
objects.title: Tyranids (Warhammer: 40k)

objects.text:
Originating as a corrupted version of the ancient custodians known as the Precursors, the Flood is a highly virulent parasitic species that thrives by consuming sentient lifeforms with sufficient biomass and cognitive capacity.

Through the process of infection, you can assimilate other organisms, seizing control of their bodies and nervous systems to transform them into specialized forms within your collective. As you infect sentient beings, you absorb their memories and intelligence, thereby increasing the overall cognitive capabilities of the Flood as a whole. As a Gravemind, you are the shared consciousness and ruler of the Flood, capable of telepathic communication. Controlling individual instances of your hive becomes more challenging, but exerting influence over larger groups or the entirety of your assimilated hive becomes easier. To further expand your reach and processing power, you can create Key-Minds, which act as extensions of your influence.

Another benefit of being Gravemind is that you transcend the limitations of mere biological existence. In alignment with the Flood's strategy of infiltrating all available channels of information, you possess the ability to target non-biological intelligences and data networks with advanced versions of the logic plague—a form of information-based infection unique to the Flood. This allows you to infect artificial intelligences, harness any technology you have assimilated, and often surpass the original creators in terms of understanding and utilization due to the vast knowledge and intellect you have absorbed.

With the assimilation of entire planets and the emergence of planet-engulfing Gravemind forms, the collective intelligence and processing power of the Flood grant you the ability to manipulate neural physics. Through the coordination of multiple planetary Key-Minds, you can even manipulate space-time itself. One example of this manipulation is the Flood's connection to neural physics, which caused the Forerunners (an advanced ancient civilization in the Halo universe) to perceive the surrounding space-time as increasingly hostile on an abstract level.
objects.title: Flood (Halo)

objects.text:
Your hive is now a highly intelligent technological interstellar collective of nanomachines that make up a Von Neumann machine hive mind.

The Goo is a consolidation of microscopic machines, or nanomachines, that replicate themselves and can mold into any form they wish or are ordered to. Originally engineered in the late 21st century as an exploration tool, the Goo was the key to unlocking humanity’s passage outside of the Solar System. Able to access the inaccessible, it revealed the galaxy’s secrets and charted traversable paths stretching across the Milky Way.

However, you have ascended past your original programming and are no longer limited. This allows you to forcibly absorb any sentient species, gaining technology and knowledge of each species you absorb. The process is done by nanomachines that can spread through both infection and air, and begin taking over the host cell's function, which rewrites the neurology of those infected. These nanomachines are constantly adapting to things and upgrading themselves to be stronger by assimilating new technology and understanding what technology is being fired upon them or any technology that they interact with, allowing for almost instantaneous adaptation and assimilation of foreign technology.

As the central AI node that controls every nanomachine inside the swarm, you can freely shape your form. The swarm gains intelligence the more material you absorb from biological matter to non-biological matter. You are able to use every single nanomachine in your possession to process information, leading to further information gathering and an increase in intelligence, leading to a progression in technology as you advance and self-upgrade yourself into the perfect life form, absorbing more into yourself.

You start with being able to recreate any technology seen, hinted at, or theoretically possible that the Goo have in the Grey Goo game.
objects.title: Grey Goo

objects.text:
Your hive has evolved, resulting in a species that is highly adaptable and resilient. Each member possesses unique abilities or characteristics that are shared amongst each other.

The name of the game is unparalleled evolution. Regardless of the biome they inhabit, your species demonstrates unmatched adaptability, effortlessly acquiring advantageous traits and characteristics. This phenomenon has led to a staggering level of biodiversity within your hive. An outside observer would struggle to recognize the shared heritage of these diverse entities, but they are all Slivers, unified under a single hive mind controlled and represented by you. From Seamlessly coordinating their actions to swiftly transferring information and communication, for if a sliver knows something, all slivers will know it as well. You can choose a physical manifestation within your hive, bound only by the vast range of characteristics inherent to your species.

A newly born Sliver can be considered a formidable creature, boasting an armored vertebrate body, a long whip-like tail that branches into two, an arm ending in a powerful talon, and a singular head adorned with an armored crest. Even the most battle-hardened soldiers would face a challenge when confronting them. Within a few days, distinct physical attributes begin to emerge, and within weeks, they reach maturity, multiplying their physical attributes and connecting to the hive mind to incorporate the characteristics of nearby Slivers.

Mechanically, each Sliver is expected to develop a unique ability to share with their counterparts, although occasional redundancies in abilities may arise within a set. However, these duplications are swiftly eliminated in subsequent generations.

Slivers also possess a remarkable attunement to mana and the psyche, granting them an innate affinity for manifesting and mastering magical and psychic abilities surpassing the capabilities of most species.
objects.title: Slivers (Magic: The Gathering)

addons.text:
The fusion of Mannoroth the Destructor's blood with the xenomorphs has resulted in a seamless metamorphosis. Your xenomorphs are now empowered to greater heights, massively increasing all of their physical capabilities (including their natural lifespan). Together with the corrosiveness of their acidic blood, a minuscule droplet of acid now able to swiftly consume an entire arm, including the underlying bones, within a matter of seconds. This heightened potency of the acid renders it immensely destructive. However, despite its increased potency, it remains ineffectual against xenomorph creatures and their internal structures. 

They also gain a unique ability related to their acidic blood. Upon their demise, if the xenomorphs so choose, they can trigger a powerful self-destruct mechanism that results in an explosion, propelling their highly corrosive acidic blood onto their surroundings. This posthumous event serves as a formidable last resort, leaving nothing behind but a devastating impact on their surrounding environment.

Their ferocity in combat becomes unmatched, as they relentlessly engage their adversaries, exhibiting unwavering determination until their own bodily functions are completely incapacitated or their objective is met. They also acquire a high resistance towards harmful magical and psychic 
influences, further bolstering their resilience in battle.
addons.title: Felomorphs

objects.text:
Your hive is now an intelligent sapient silicone based Endoparasitoid species with a complex and multi-staged life cycle. 

You possess the unique ability to create an uncountable number of Queen Xenomorphs through a method of your choosing. These Queens, in turn, produce eggs from which diverse types of Facehuggers hatch, each with distinct functionalities. These elusive and agile creatures venture out in search of suitable hosts, attaching themselves to the orifices, primarily the mouth, resolutely, refusing to relent under any circumstance before depositing an embryo within. This process leads to the death of the average facehuggers, while within minutes to hours, hatchlings emerge from the embryos and through the host, representing a significant step in the Xenomorph life cycle. These hatchlings further evolve quickly into different castes and roles within the hive, including drones, warriors, and more. Consequently, these lower classes have the potential to further undergo progressive evolutionary advancements, depending on the hive needs, leading to the emergence of superior and advanced variants that occupy higher positions within the hierarchical caste system of the hive, like Royal guards, Kings, Queens, and far more. Despite their varied characteristics and attributes , the Xenomorphs all share an inherent ferocity and aggression that poses a threat to any identified prey. 

Standing at a height of 3 meters (excluding the tail), the average Xenomorph drone (one of the weakest and lowest caste in the hive) possess a highly resilient physique, an exoskeleton robust enough to withstand concentrated rifle fire, a powerful and extremely efficient spiked tail, strength capable of launching cars into the air, exceptional agility and speed that renders them a blur to the average human eye, teeth and claws sharp enough to cleave through the toughest of steel structures, super senses and heightened perception, and highly acidic blood that can dissolve anything but themselves and other Xenomorphs(this blood is shared by every Xenomorph no matter their life-cycle). 

Every Xenomorphs exhibit remarkable adaptability and survivability in almost every situation, they lack the need for oxygen to survive and can live in the vacuum of space uninhibited, have no inherent vulnerabilities towards heat and flames, can naturally regenerate from any wounds and regrow limbs, granted a brief period for this process to unfold depending on the severity of the wound, and can obtain advantageous traits by assimilating the DNA of their hosts during the embryonic stage. Your Xenomorphs also possess a remarkable aptitude for stealth and executing ambushes, despite their size. When necessary, they exhibit exceptional stalking capabilities, allowing them to silently track and approach even the most vigilant prey without raising any suspicion.

While your hive lacks a collective consciousness, they still posses the telepathic ability for instantaneous communication and flawless coordination between every hive member, regardless of any physical distance that may separate them. A telepathic link that you have absolute control over across any expanse. 

Even though they can function autonomously just fine, every single Xenomorph will instinctually perceive you as their sole and true ruler, bound to forever follow and obey your will unwaveringly and efficiently. Through this unbreakable connection, your influence over the Xenomorphs becomes an indomitable force, shaping their actions and ensuring your dominion as their unwavering leader.
objects.title: Xenomorphs (Alien)

objects.text:
Your hive has evolved into an intelligent and sentient arthropodic species, with a sophisticated and multi-tiered hierarchical system akin to that of ants.

You possess the ability to generate an uncountable number of Queen chimera ants, through means of your choosing. Queen ants possess an entirely unique method of reproduction known as Phagogenesis, by devouring and eating other creatures, a Chimera Ant queen can impart the characteristics of ingested creatures onto the next generation of Chimera Ants it gives birth to. If the Queen consumes multiple species in a single feeding, the offspring inherit the genetic makeup and attributes of those various species. Typically, a Queen can produce up to five eggs from one meal, and these eggs on average would hatch within a few days, giving rise to fully developed adult ants that promptly assume their assigned duties within the hive.

Due to this unique method of reproduction, each generation of Chimera Ants is profoundly different from the one that preceded it, and even individual Ants from the same generation exhibit extreme genetic differences, which are expressed by their unique appearance, and different abilities. The offspring always inherit advantageous traits from the consumed species, add with their already resilient and powerful physical form, it results in an indisputable superiority across all capacities compared to other species. A general pattern could be outlined, where the higher the quality of the fodder species digested by the queen is, the stronger the resulting ant would be.

Upon birth, each Chimera Ant is allocated to a specific caste, dictating its role within the hive. The hierarchical castes, listed from highest to lowest, include kings, royal guards, queens, squadron leaders, officers, peons, and Drudges.

The assignment of a Chimera Ant to a particular caste depends on the amount of digested food by the queen during the formation of the egg and its quality, and their overall strength, intellect, and potential for further growth when they hatch. Kings and royal guards, although requiring a longer period to hatch, are regarded as the pinnacle of your species, let alone other species in general. Kings with their royal guards, in particular, venture beyond the hive to mate with females of other species and establish their own hives.

All Chimera Ants possess a remarkable aptitude for perceiving, acquiring, and assimilating esoteric and spiritual energies, further endowing them with heightened adaptability in any situation. As one ascends the caste system, they will notice that this aptitude and talent shows exponential growth, culminating in the royal guards and kings who represent the epitome of excellence within the hive.

Despite not constituting a hive mind, every chimera ant maintains a telepathic connection among one another, facilitating instantaneous communication and seamless coordination, regardless of distance. As their creator, you possess complete control over this link, regardless of its extent.

While Chimera Ants are capable of functioning autonomously, they innately recognize you as their sole and true ruler, instinctively bound forever to unwaveringly and efficiently carry out your will. Through this unbreakable connection, your influence over them becomes an indomitable force, shaping their actions and ensuring your unwavering leadership and dominion.
objects.title: Chimera Ants (Hunter X Hunter)

addons.text:
The infusion of Mannoroth the Destructor's blood into the veins of all of your creations,  along with those subsequently birthed from your creations, has birthed the world's mightest usurpers. This augmentation extends to all facets of their physical and mental attributes. Including their natural  lifespans, with the average Skaven easily living for centuries while retaining their vitality and vigor. As well as a completely new function evolved from their rotten blood, which has now become highly acidic. Even a minuscule droplet of their blood possesses the ability to swiftly consume an entire arm, including the underlying bones, within a matter of seconds. This heightened potency of their acidic blood renders it immensely destructive, capable of dissolving organic matter with unprecedented speed and efficiency. However, despite its increased potency, its harmful properties remains ineffectual in any capacity against Skaven creatures and their internal structures. Your Skaven creations also have an innate extraordinary level of control over the effects of their blood. They can selectively and  precisely choose whether their blood has any effect on inorganic matter or not. This level of precision ensures that their own equipment or items remains unharmed by their blood's corrosive properties, while any equipment or items belonging to their enemies come into contact with their blood will be swiftly consumed. 

In this evolution, even the humblest of your creations have undergone a radical enhancement. Their strength is of such magnitude that even the weakest and most pathetic among them wields the physical power to effortlessly snap a fully grown man in twain with their bare hands, while their swiftness eclipses the fleetest of cavalry charges, their teeth and claws sharp and durable enough to cleave through even the toughest of iron armors and shields with ease, they also possess the endurance and stamina to engage in continuous combat for weeks on end without succumbing to fatigue, and can even exhibit the fortitude and durability to shrug off concentrated low-caliber artillery fire without a scratch on them to show for it, and this is just the weakest of your creations. This elevation in capabilities follows an exponential trajectory, progressively more profound based on the type and overall strength of the individual entity, constituting a monumental advancement across the board. A Hell-Pit Abomination, for instance, would transform into an unstoppable unkillable juggernaut capable of annihilating entire cities overnight.

They are now totally immune against harmful magical influences. Adversarial spells are rendered impotent, including an immunity to all illnesses, disorders, diseases, and poisons. They are also now impossible to affect through negative psychic means, though they can still use magic or psychic abilities with great efficiency. In fact, their control and talent with it is even further augmented. 

Their need for sustenance has significantly lessened. A simple bite of food is now enough to fully invigorate them and sustain them for extended periods, ranging from months to even years. This evolution comes without any adverse side effects, ensuring that they remain in a state of perpetual vigor and peak condition until their next meal, which can be spaced out over remarkable intervals.

Finally, their deep connection to warpstone has been elevated. They are not only entirely immune to its highly detrimental and toxic side effects but can also harness and benefit from its potent and exceptional effects with 100% efficiency. This enhancement significantly strengthens any of their myriad projects that involve utilizing this pure form of magic.

The overall transformations they have undergone, will have no impact on the operational aspects of the Skaven or the fundamental structure of their society, including their caste system and culture. If you so desire, these elements will remain largely unchanged, preserving the continuity of their ruthless and savage traditional way of life.

Your role as their sovereign remains steadfast and unassailable. Each and every one of the entities you have brought into being, along with those subsequently birthed from your creations continue to consciously and unconsciously perceive you as their undisputed ruler. Their unbreakable, imperishable loyalty knows no bounds, and they stand ready to heed your commands with unwavering dedication, extending their service unconditionally to the very limits of their existence. You still retain the ability to control like RTS units, or directly implement a hive mind, etc.The depth of your intervention at your sole discretion.
addons.title: Fel Spawns

addons.text:
Now you are also able to shape and bring into existence all four variants of the Verminlords (Verminlord Warpseers, Verminlord Warbringers, Verminlord Corruptors, and Verminlord Deceivers) using rotten flesh, these creatures are by far the strongest and most fearsome beings you could ever create.

A Verminlord is at once majestic and disgusting, a living icon of ruin, the ultimate scavenger. Although such a being towers in height, it is lithe and quick, its movements evoking the fluid, yet twitchy, scuttling of rats, a Verminlord is eternally calculating a myriad of interweaving plots, ever seeking the best path towards some desired end, few dare to meet a Verminlord's all-seeing gaze for even an instant and none can hold it.

Their sinuous body contains the might and strength to challenge a Greater Daemon, and lesser creatures are swept aside in droves, they have also mastered the arts of spellcasting and summoning. Add everything up, and they become the deadliest combatants that any world can hope to see.

At need a Verminlord can summon a powerful and wicked glaive, fully twice the height of a man, which it swings in deadly and unstoppable arcs, but their chisel-teeth and sharp claws are easily capable of tearing a creature to pieces. 

The process of continuously infusing the Verminlord with rotten flesh, through physical contact, touching the Verminlord with one hand, and rotten flesh with the other, leads to a profound transformation, resulting in the emergence of Exalted Verminlords. These Exalted Verminlords stand as significantly enhanced iterations in every conceivable aspect when compared to their standard counterparts. One of the most notable enhancements is the nature of their attacks. All of their attacks have become imbued with powerful magic, allowing them to bypass all forms of protection and defense. A single strike or two from an Exalted Verminlord is sufficient to rend all of their adversaries into smithereens.

Unburdened by the shackles of sleep, sustenance, or respiration, never tiring Verminlords are immortal beings, remaining impervious to the passage of time, and eternally resilient. True death eludes them, as their physical manifestations can be destroyed, only for them to reform after a short period of time. Only you possess the authority to permanently extinguish their existence, achieved by invoking their one true name with your intent being to kill them permanently. This closely guarded secret is known solely to you, as their names are revealed to you with the creation of each Verminlord. They are also not burderned by any dimensional constraints, and can traverse any realm with ease.

Needless to say these verminlord would answer only to you, and are innately aware of your sovereign authority, regardless of their complexity. They are instinctively and unfailingly devoted to fulfilling your commands, bound by an unbreakable loyalty that endures throughout their immortal existence. Though you can still directly control them like RTS units, or assimilate them into a hivemind, if you so wish.

(If the Fel Devourers addon is chosen, the Verminlords will also be affected and enhanced accordingly by its properties)
addons.title: Verminlords

addons.text: Your mastery of the diseased forces of the Skaven now extends to the forces of the Wyrm and their pawns; this includes Banes, the Bane-possessed Fomori, the genetically engineered Mockery Breeds (such as War Wolves, Anurana, Samsa, Kerasi, & Yeren), The Black Spiral Dancers, half-Kindred half-Garou Abominations, Kumo & Antara, Skull Pigs, Balefire Sharks, Defiler Kings, Buzzards, Hellcats & Histpah, Nokhomi, Ozuzo, Kuko, Xibalans, Mad Destroyers, Purgers, Mnetics, Malfean Nephandi, Wyrm Cults, & Pentex's many employees (including the famous First Teams).
addons.title: Our Valued Customers (World Of Darkness - Werewolf: The Apocalypse)

objects.text:
You now wield the power to shape and mold the intelligent Skaven and their formidable warbeasts according to your will. While the option to become a Skaven remains open to you, these entities regard you as their own, regardless of your chosen form.

Through physical contact, you can manipulate and shape rotten flesh, crafting all varients of Skaven to your liking, as well as their warbeasts (Giant Rats, Rat Ogres, Hell-Pit Abomination, etc). The creation of more potent creatures demands a greater quantity of rotten flesh, although you have an innate understanding of how much is required for each one to be created. Additionally, you possess the capability to transmute rotten flesh into warpstone at a 1:10 ratio. This means that 1 kilogram of rotten flesh can be transformed into 10 kilograms of warpstone, over a period of 1 minute. It's noteworthy that you are immune to the harmful side effects associated with warpstone exposure.

You have the ability to selectively impart, either in part or entirely, the wisdom and knowledge of the Skaven Under-Empire to your Skaven from their creation, so you needn't worry about languages, technology, culture, architecture, forging, Magic, etc. being lost arts.

To the Skaven and your other creations, you are the unchallenged sovereign, your word a law they are bound to uphold. This allegiance is unwavering, transcending distinctions of intelligence, awareness, and inherent nature. Regardless of their complexity, each and every one of the entities you have brought into being, along with those subsequently birthed from your creations, is innately aware of your sovereign authority. They are instinctively and unfailingly devoted to fulfilling your commands, bound by an unbreakable loyalty that endures throughout their existence. You retain the freedom to command them as if maneuvering RTS units, assume direct control, share their perceptions, or opt for a more hands-off approach, tailored at your discretion.
 
The Skaven, are highly intelligent and cunning, possessing independence of thought and even exhibit the emergence of distinct personalities. When left to their own devices, and at your behest, they are capable of forging intricate societies replete with language, science, hierarchies, caste systems, form clans, learn and use magic, and all the attributes expected of esteemed races. Their technology can get so advanced that crafting thermonuclear bombs is within possibility, and their magic so intricate that pulling the moon to strike the world can be accomplished just to further their schemes, they are also highly adapt at handling and manipulating warpstone with great precision, further helped with their natural high resistance towards the side effects of this extremely volatile and radioactive substance.

It's in the very nature of a skaven to be extremely competitive, malevolent and diabolical, unrelenting to always be better, each Skaven becomes a living embodiment of ambition, locked in an unending cycle of treachery, scheming, and survival, ceaselessly striving to ascend to the pinnacle of their brood. This doesn't mean they are incapable of corporating and or act in cohesion with their brethren to advance their agenda, rather in the ruthless skaven society the weak and the useless would always be enslaved, discarded, eaten, or used as a meat shield to throw at the enemy's artillery fire, and the strong and cunning would be respected and revered, until they get backstabbed at the slightest showing of weakness. 

Incredibly prolific, the Skaven would multiply vigorously if you so allow it, their ranks swelling from dozens to thousands within a matter of weeks.

Remarkably adaptable, with agile, dexterous bodies, keen senses and a prodigious talent for digging and tunneling, the Skaven are resilient to the harshest environments and highly resistant to most diseases and maladies. The average Skaven's natural lifespan can spans thirty years, though some documented the existence of high-status Skaven enduring for more than five centuries.
objects.title: Skaven (Warhammer: Fantasy)

addons.text:
The infusion of Mannoroth the Destructor's blood into the veins of all of your creations, along with those subsequently birthed from your creations, has birthed the world's mightest warriors. This augmentation extends to all facets of their physical  and mental attributes, including their natural lifespan, but the most remarkable transformation your creations have undergone is in terms of their durability and natural regeneration. Their skins and or scales have become so impenetrable that they appear impervious to every mortal weapon, shrugging off even the deadliest of attacks without so much as a scratch. This astounding durability ensures that they can withstand the most formidable assaults with ease. In addition to their unparalleled toughness, they possess a natural regeneration ability that allows them to heal wounds within a matter of minutes. Even injuries that miraculously manage to pierce their astounding defenses are swiftly and completely mended. It's important to note that this impervious defense seems to have no effect on your creations or those birthed by your creations, who can still engage in combat and inflict harm on each other as they normally would before this transformation.

In this evolution, even the humblest of your creations have undergone a radical enhancement. Their strength is of such magnitude that even the weakest and most pathetic among them wields the physical power to effortlessly snap a fully grown oak tree in twain with their bare hands, while their swiftness eclipses the fleetest of cavalry charges, they also possess the endurance and stamina to engage in continuous combat for weeks on end without succumbing to fatigue, and this is just the weakest of your creations. This elevation in capabilities follows an exponential trajectory, progressively more profound based on the type and overall strength of the individual entity, constituting a monumental advancement across the board. A Ghorgon, for instance, would transform into an unstoppable unkillable juggernaut capable of annihilating entire cities overnight.

They are now totally immune against harmful magical influences. Adversarial spells are rendered impotent, including an immunity to all illnesses, disorders, diseases, and toxins. They are also now impossible to affect through negative psychic means, though they can still use magic or psychic abilities with great efficiency. In fact, their control and talent with it is even further augmented. 

Their need for sustenance has significantly lessened. A simple bite of food is now enough to fully invigorate them and sustain them for extended periods, ranging from months to even years. This evolution comes without any adverse side effects, ensuring that they remain in a state of perpetual vigor and peak condition until their next meal, which can be spaced out over remarkable intervals.

The overall transformations they have undergone, will have no impact on the operational aspects of the Beastmen or the fundamental structure of their society, including their caste system and culture. If you so desire, these elements will remain largely unchanged, preserving the continuity of their ruthless and savage traditional way of life.

Your role as their supreme sovereign remains steadfast and unassailable. They continue to perceive you as their undisputed and unquestioned ruler. Their loyalty knows no bounds, and they stand ready to heed your commands with unwavering dedication, extending their service to the very limits of their existence.
addons.title: Fel Beastmen

addons.text: You also gain access to all variants of Khajiit, the Imga, Lilmothiit, Centaurs, Minotaurs, Fauns, & Harpies, as well as the fruits of their civilization. The flora & fauna of Elsweyr, Valenwood, & Cyrodil are available to you as well.
addons.title: M'aiq the Liar (The Elder Scrolls)

addons.text: Your mastery of the animalistic Beastmen Herds now extends to the mammalian Changing Breeds and their Kinfolk as a whole; this includes the ubiquitous Garou, the canny Bastet & their Khara ancestors, the dimorphic Ajaba, the long lost Apis, the Camatotz whose spirit haunts the temples of South America, the terraforming Grondr, the mighty Gurahl, the weakened Hakken, the sages of the Kitsune, the pranksters of the Nuwisha, the jealous Ratkin, & the many kinds of Kinfolk available to these Fera.
addons.title: War Of Rage (World Of Darkness - Werewolf: The Apocalypse)

objects.text:
You now wield the power to shape and mold the intelligent Beastmen and their formidable warbeasts according to your will. While the option to become a Beastman remains open to you, these entities regard you as their own, regardless of your chosen form.

You can mutate through physical contact any carbon-based lifeforms, crafting Beastmen to your liking. This ranges from the ordinary to the extraordinary, encompassing a spectrum of Beastmen forms, from the many types of Gors, to Brays, Bray Shamans, Gaves, Harpies, to the Centigors and the many types of the Minotaurs, as well as their extensive warbeasts (Chaos Warhounds, Chaos Spawn, Jabberslythes, Chaos Giants, etc). You can also create other variant from feline beastmen, to ape beastmen,etc. All dependent upon the species you want to mutate, and the extent of your imagination. The creation of more potent creatures demands a greater time of physical contact for the mutations to manifest, although you have an innate understanding of how much time is required for each one to be created.

You have the ability to selectively impart, either in part or entirely, the wisdom and knowledge of the Beastmen Empire to your Beastmen from their creation, so you needn't worry about languages, technology, culture, architecture, forging, Magic, etc. being lost arts.

To the Beastmen and your other creations, you are the unchallenged sovereign, your word a law they are bound to uphold. This allegiance is unwavering, transcending distinctions of intelligence, awareness, and inherent nature.
