Regardless of their complexity, each and every one of the entities you have brought into being, along with those subsequently birthed from your creations, is innately aware of your sovereign authority. They are instinctively and unfailingly devoted to fulfilling your commands, bound by an unbreakable loyalty that endures throughout their existence. You retain the freedom to command them as if maneuvering RTS units, assume direct control, share their perceptions, or opt for a more hands-off approach, tailored at your discretion.


The Beastmen, while can be considered intelligent, possessing independence of thought and even exhibit the emergence of distinct personalities, its in their very nature to loathe order and the very concept of civilization in all its forms, usually preferring to live deep within the twisted woodlands and forests. Their lack of civilization is substituted by their unmatched ferociousness and prowess in combat. Few can match the strength and savagery displayed by the Beastmen, and even fewer their variety in the amount of battle hungry soldiers they can field. While you can command them as their supreme ruler to build and maintain a functioning civilization, they wont excel at it like they would in fighting and destroying everything in their way.

The Beastmen would follow a violent and ruthless hierarchy, if left to their devices, without your intervention, based upon the overall prowess of a Beastmen as well as what kind of breed the particular Beastmen is. Those that possess exceptional strength and bear the greatest blessings of their bestial heritage, such as magnificent curling horns, occupy the higher tiers of their tribes. Those Beastmen that possess small horns or none at all, such as the lowly breeds of Ungors and Brays, are always below those that do such as the Gors and Minotaurs. Hence, each warherd is led by the strongest and most bestial amongst their numbers. A cycle of death and brutal duels for a beastmen to further his position and status is ever-present within the herd.

Highly prolific, the Beastmen would multiply vigorously if you so allow it, their ranks swelling from dozens to thousands within a matter of years.

A powerful race, seizing whatever they desire through sheer might, leaving destruction in their wake for all that opposes them, they are also especially resistant to negative and harmful magical and psychic influences, and can whistand and even shrug off most diseases and illnesses. The average lifespan of the beastmen depends on the variant and type, but the Gors usually live to around 200 years.
objects.title: Beastmen (Warhammer: Fantasy)

addons.text:
The infusion of Mannoroth the Destructor's blood with every Daemon you create has birthed a transformation of unparalleled might. A surge of power courses through their very being, propelling them into a realm of prowess never before witnessed. This augmentation extends to all facets of their physical attributes, this also includes their innate magical and or esoteric capabilities, like their chaos aura, now even able to affect immortal creatures harboring the strongest of wills.

In this evolution, even the humblest of the Daemon have undergone a radical enhancement. Their strength is of such magnitude that even the weakest most pathetic among them wields the power to effortlessly uproot a fully grown oak tree from the very earth that nurtured it, while their swiftness eclipses the fleetest of cavalry charges, they can even exhibit the fortitude to shrug off concentrated medium-caliber artillery fire without a scratch on their skin to show for it. This elevation in capabilities follows an exponential trajectory, progressively more profound based on the type and variant of the individual Daemon, constituting a monumental advancement across the board.

They are also now totally immune against harmful magical influences, poison, and diseases. Adversarial spells are rendered impotent, and they are now nigh impossible to affect through psychic means. They can still use magic or psychic abilities with great efficiency, where their control and talent with it, got even further augmented.

Your role as their sovereign remains steadfast and unassailable. They continue to consciously and unconsciously perceive you as their undisputed ruler. Their loyalty knows no bounds, and they stand ready to heed your commands with unwavering dedication, extending their service unconditionally to the very limits of their eternal existence.
addons.title: Fel Daemons

addons.text:
You are now able to infuse mortal creatures with a chosen core emotion, out of the four paramount ones you have control over, enabling them the potential to undergo various transformations. Depending on your intention and the emotional reservoir available to you, mortals can be shaped into Chaos Spawns, half-daemons or fully-fledged Daemon Princes.

As a mortal transforms into a Daemon Prince, shared physical characteristics might emerge, yet their individuality shines through, influenced by their former lives' personalities, traits, and acquired mutations. This kaleidoscope of variations encompasses a myriad of shapes, hues, and even unique powerful gifts that manifest sporadically, ensuring each Daemon Prince stands distinct from others. You can even go further, through continuously infusing Daemon princes with the core emotion that initiated their transformation, they can ascend to become Daemon Primarchs, one of the highest of Daemonic beings.

 Exalted variants is still possible for the once mortal Daemons, although the elevation of a Daemon Primarch into their exalted form, would take at least 5 years of infusing the accumulated core emotion that transformed them.

While Daemon Princes generally rank below the standard variant of the Greater Daemons and above the standard variant of the Lesser Daemons in terms of overall power, Daemon Primarchs almost invariably surpass even the standard Greater Daemons, often prevailing against multiple of them simultaneously. 

Having undergone this metamorphosis, these once-mortal Daemons hold you in the same highest regard as any other Daemon you've created naturally, consciously and unconsciously perceiving you as their undisputed ruler. Pledging unwavering and unbounded loyalty and extending their service unconditionally throughout their eternal existence.
addons.title: Daemonhood

addons.text:
You may now use the selfsame methods with which you create Daemons to create Daedra.

You may use Tzeentch energy to create Daedra associated with Hermaeus Mora, Sheogorath (or Jyggalag), Ithelia, Boethiah, & Nocturnal, Khorne energy to create Daedra associated with Hircine, Mehrunes Dagon, & Molag Bal, Nurgle energy to create Daedra associated with Malacath, Peryite, Vaermina, & Namira, & Slaanesh energy to create Daedra associated with Azura, Mephala, Clavicus Vile, Meridia, & Sanguine. For those of unclear, unknown, or nonexistent affiliation, any energy may be used.
addons.title: The House of Troubles (The Elder Scrolls)

addons.text:
Your emotional energy can now be converted into Magnetite, a substance that can be used to summon Demons from the Shin Megami Tensei series. The more powerful the Demon, the more Magnetite is required. This is before even mentioning the Law Of Subjugation, which does not permit a Demon to be summoned by a master weaker than it.

You also extend your ability to fuse Demons to create more powerful ones to Daemons created with your powers; for example, if you have a bunch of Bloodletters sitting around collecting dust, you could try fusing them to create a Bloodthirster.
addons.title: Heretic Manor (Shin Megami Tensei)

objects.text:
Your hive has evolved into an malevolent, otherwordly, intelligent entities, born and corrupted by the deepest and darkest emotions of all mortal creatures. While becoming a Daemon remains a choice for you, these beings regard you as their own, irrespective of your form. 

You wield the power to supernaturally sense, shape and manipulate four pivotal emotions: Anger, Pleasure, Despair, and Change. These emotions can be naturally siphoned and extracted without any limits or adverse effects on yourself, drawing them from all mortal and even immortal creatures. You can accomplish this through physical contact for a swifter extraction, or by merely having them within your field of view, albeit at a slightly slower rate than the former method. Through this power, you can craft Daemons according to your preferences. Although Daemons might share many characteristics, no two Daemons are entirely alike. This diversity spans across three broad categories of Daemons: Daemonic beasts, Lesser Daemons, and the most formidable of all, the Greater Daemons.

The quantity and variety of Daemons at your disposal are directly linked to the reservoir of Emotions you've accumulated. In a single day, you could manifest an entire battalion of approximately 500 Lesser Daemons like the fearsome Bloodletters by harnessing anger, while a month's accumulation of that same emotion could yield the creation of a mighty greater Daemon like the Bloodthirster. Daemons possess an innate capacity for growth, their overall power and might increasing proportionally with the passage of time. You also have the option to deliberately and voluntarily through physical contact infuse a Daemon with the core emotion that birthed them, progressively augmenting their power until they attain their Exalted forms. These Exalted Daemons stand as significantly enhanced iterations in every conceivable aspect compared to their standard counterparts. A solitary Exalted Daemon has the prowess to subdue an entire battalion of their regular counterparts with ease. You can toggle on and off an ethereal gauge, visible only to you, that provides a visual representation of your accumulated emotional resources, serving as a guide for your creations.

To the Daemons, you are the unchallenged sovereign, your word a law they are bound to uphold. This devotion knows no bounds, extending to Daemons of all intelligences, awareness, and inherent natures. Regardless of their complexity, every Daemon consciously and unconsciously recognizes you as their supreme leader, driven to unconditionally fulfill your commands until the very limits of their eternal existence. You can still command them like RTS units, assume direct control, see everything they see, or otherwise act like a true hive mind if you wish, but you don't need to hold their hand about every little thing if you don't want to. The depth of your intervention at your sole discretion. 

Daemons, posses both intelligence and independence of thoughts, and can even exhibit the emergence of distinct personalities, especially with the lesser Daemons and higher. Each Daemon is dangerous and formidable, that a rare few mortals can even hope to meet in combat and not die or get mind enslaved instantly, each one is fueled by a different core emotion that let them posses distinct strengths and capabilities over each other. Those borne from anger flourish in the midst of warfare, harnessing unparalleled combat prowess that escalates with each battle and every life they claim. On the other hand, those empowered by pleasure specialize in the intricate arts of beguiling seduction, wielding the uncanny ability to bend wills and dominate minds through their enchanting presence alone. Able to transform mortals into mind-numbed slaves with a mere gaze upon them.

Conversely, Daemons rooted in despair emanate a virulent influence, propagating their malevolent plagues and diseases throughout the land. Their very poisonous essence becomes a conduit for abominable and deadly afflictions that sow decay and suffering. While the Daemons of change embody an unparalleled mastery over magic and knowledge that transcends conventional understanding, while also excelling in trickry and scheming to further their devious agendas.

Unburdened by the shackles of sleep, sustenance, or respiration, never tiring Daemons are immortal beings, remaining impervious to the passage of time, and eternally resilient. True death eludes them, as their physical manifestations can be destroyed, only for them to reform after a short period of time. Only you possess the authority to permanently extinguish their existence, achieved by invoking their one true name with the intent to kill. This closely guarded secret is known solely to you, as their names are revealed to you with the creation of each Daemon. Every Daemon you bring into existence shares a unique bond with you that transcends the boundaries of dimensions. Unrestricted by the limitations of mortal planes, they are perpetually anchored to your presence, enabling them to traverse any realm with seamless ease. This bond serves as a conduit that defies the confines of space, granting your creations the ability to move unhindered across the vast tapestry of existence.

 A Daemon, regardless of its type, can voluntarily radiates an aura of chaos that consumes the minds of mortals, driving them to madness. This influence intensifies the more powerful the Daemon is, to the point where a mere gaze upon a Greater Daemon would fracture a mortal's psyche, plunging them into instant madness. As their creator, you remain immune to the chaos aura and any other innate magical or esoteric influences that they possess, unaffected by their effects in any capacity.
objects.title: The Daemons of Chaos (Warhammer: Fantasy)

addons.text:
The infusion of Mannoroth the Destructor's blood into the veins of all of your creations, along with those subsequently birthed from your creations, has birthed the world's mightest guardians. This augmentation extends to all facets of their physical and mental attributes, including their regenerative powers, now nothing short of miraculous. They can mend bone-deep wounds within mere seconds, fully restore detached limbs in a matter of minutes, and recover from vital injuries such as the complete destruction of organs within hours. This astounding regenerative capability renders them virtually invulnerable to all but the most extreme forms of destruction. Short of being fully pulverized, it is nigh impossible to permanently incapacitate them. Only you as their creator, possess the authority to instantly and permanently extinguish their existence, achieved through physical contact, with your intent being to kill them permanently.

In this evolution, even the humblest of your creations have undergone a radical enhancement. Their strength is of such magnitude that even the weakest and most pathetic among them wields the physical power to effortlessly snap a fully grown oak tree in twain with their bare hands, while their swiftness eclipses the fleetest of cavalry charges, and can even exhibit the fortitude and durability to shrug off concentrated high-caliber artillery fire without a scratch on them to show for it, and this is just the weakest of your creations. This elevation in capabilities follows an exponential trajectory, progressively more profound based on the type and overall strength of the individual entity, constituting a monumental advancement across the board. A Carnosaur, for instance, would transform into an unstoppable unkillable juggernaut capable of annihilating entire cities overnight.

They are now totally immune against harmful magical influences. Adversarial spells are rendered impotent, including an immunity to all illnesses, disorders, diseases, and toxins. They are also now impossible to affect through negative psychic means, though they can still use magic or psychic abilities with great efficiency. In fact, their control and talent with it is even further augmented. 

Your creations, those subsequently birthed from your creations have also transcended the need for sustenance. The very essence of their being, the flowing water that courses within them, now serves as an eternal wellspring of nourishment. Hunger and thirst are now distant memories to them, replaced by an unending source of vitality drawn from their inner waters. This evolution comes without any adverse side effects, ensuring that they remain in a state of perpetual vigor and peak condition throughout their eternal existence.

The overall transformations they have undergone, will have no impact on the operational aspects of the Lizardmen or the fundamental structure of their society, including their caste system and culture. If you so desire, these elements will remain largely unchanged, preserving the continuity of their traditional way of life.

Your role as their sovereign remains steadfast and unassailable. Each and every one of the entities you have brought into being, along with those subsequently birthed from your creations continue to consciously and unconsciously perceive you as their undisputed ruler. Their unbreakable, imperishable loyalty knows no bounds, and they stand ready to heed your commands with unwavering dedication, extending their service unconditionally to the very limits of their eternal existence. You still retain the ability to control like RTS units, or directly implement a hive mind, etc.The depth of your intervention at your sole discretion.
addons.title: Fel Guardians

addons.text: You also gain access to the Argonians, the Sload, Lamia, & the Tsaesci, as well as the fruits of their civilization. The flora & fauna of Black Marsh & Akavir are available to you as well.
addons.title: The Hist (The Elder Scrolls)

addons.text: Your mastery of the Lizardmen and their imperial greatness now extends to the non-mammalian Changing Breeds and their Kinfolk as a whole; this includes the pseudo-vampiric Ananasi & the Insect Races they destroyed, the scouts of the Corax, the assassins of the Nagah, the amphibious Rokea, the long-lived Ao, the nostalgic Mokolé, the ancient power of the Lizard Kings, the versatility of their Drachid subjects, & the many kinds of Kinfolk available to these Fera.
addons.title: The Lizard Kings (World Of Darkness - Werewolf: The Apocalypse)

objects.text:
You now wield the power to shape and mold the highly intelligent Lizardmen and their formidable warbeasts according to your will. While the option to become a Lizardman or any variant of The Lustrian fauna remains open to you, these entities regard you as their own, regardless of your chosen form.

Through physical contact, you can utilize water, allowing you to create all variants of Lizardmen (Slann, Skinks, Saurus, Kroxigors) and other forms of the extensive Lustrian feral species (Dread Saurian, Thunder Lizard, Salamanders, Carnosaurs, Cold Ones, Ripperdactyls, Bastiladons, Wyrms, Stegadons, Coatls, Troglodons, Razordons, Terradons, etc). The creation of more potent creatures demands a greater quantity of Water, although you have an innate understanding of how much is required for each one to be created. You can also keep imbuing your creations with water, alevating them to a blessed transformation. These blessed Lizardmen and or Lustrian fauna stand as significantly enhanced iterations in every conceivable aspect compared to their standard counterparts, they also gain special powers and abilities that further sets them apart.

You have the ability to selectively impart, either in part or entirely, all of the wisdom and knowledge of the Lizardmen Empire to your Lizardmen from their creation, so you needn't worry about languages, technology, culture, architecture, forging, Magic, etc. being lost arts.

To the Lizardmen and your other creations, you are the unchallenged sovereign, your word a law they are bound to uphold. This allegiance is unwavering, transcending distinctions of intelligence, awareness, and inherent nature. Regardless of their complexity, each and every one of the entities you have brought into being, along with those subsequently birthed from your creations, is innately aware of your sovereign authority. They are instinctively and unfailingly devoted to fulfilling your commands, bound by an unbreakable loyalty that endures throughout their immortal existence. You retain the freedom to command them as if maneuvering RTS units, assume direct control, share their perceptions, or opt for a more hands-off approach, tailored at your discretion.
 
Capable of independent thoughts, and even gaining their distinct personalities, Lizardmen can be split into Three core castes within their society, the ruling caste being the magical Slann, the warrior caste being the powerful Saurus, the working caste being the mighty Kroxigors, and their closely related cousins the Skinks, the ones who can pretty much do everything to a certain degree, due to their agile and dexterous physique, and their high intelligence, second only to the Slann. When left to their own devices, they will create one of the strongest civilizations, suffering no worthy enemies, while working in perfect harmony.

If you so allow it, your Slann and Skinks will start to construct and maintain their own spawning pools, from which the Lizardmen will hatch fully grown and ready for their tasks. They can even create blessed spawning pools where the stronger variants will spawn.

Unburdened by the shackles of sleep, fatigue, and exhaustion, all of your creations gain immortality, ensuring that they will never wither with age. Instead, as they continue to exist, they only grow stronger and more capable, their power and abilities expanding with the passage of time. In addition to a natural talent with magic for the Skinks and especially for the Slann, where they can reach a mastery of magic so great, that no other species can ever hope to match them.
objects.title: Lizardmen (Warhammer: Fantasy)

addons.text:
Now you are also able to shape and bring into existence the denizens of the depths in the form of the Undead of the Vampire Coast, as well as their ranged and artillery arsenal, ranging from the humble Gunnery Mob armed with pistols and an array of gunpowder firearms and barnacle-crusted cannons over the mobile bomb that is the Bloated Corpse, the massive crustacean Rotting Leviathan and the stealthy crawling horror that is the Mournghoul all the way to the animated ship-hulk that is the Necrofex Colossus and the pinnacle of undead artillery that is Queen Bess.

Additionally the sea itself has given you a new way to shape these undead in addition to ex nihilo or by converting corpses, as these undead and their arsenal can be shaped from flotsam, sunken or partially sunken wrecks, and beach litter of all sorts, the bounty of the sea in all its forms serving as the raw clay from which you shape your armies.

Just like with the regular undead, the forces of the Vampire Coast are mere extensions of your will, even the seeming independence of the likes of the Depth Guard and Syreens but a facade of your Hivemind.
addons.title: Vampire Coast (Warhammer: Fantasy)

addons.text:
Your Fel Blood has mixed with the Dhar composing your Undead servants' bindings, enhancing it with the most powerful and nourishing blood around. Even your thirstiest Vampires will feel perfect eternal satiation when this ingredient is added to their bindings.

The strength of even your zombies is enough to effortlessly shred through oak, while their swiftness equals that of cavalry charges. They have the endurance and stamina to fight for days without tiring, even without proper necromantic binding, and even have the fortitude to endure concentrated fire from Imperial artillery.

They are now totally immune against harmful magical influences, disease, poison, or the decay of the dead. Adversarial spells are rendered impotent, and they are now almost impossible to affect through psychic means, though they obviously can still use magic or psychic abilities themselves. In cases like that of Vampirism, where there are highly specific weaknesses, your Fel Blood removes them.
addons.title: Fel Vitae

addons.text:
Your Dhar has mixed with Blood Magic and Koldunic Sorcery, and now the numbers of your Undead can include Kindred of any clan, up to the generation beneath yours (so that for example, if you were the default 8th Generation, you could create Vampires of the 9th Generation or weaker). You can also create related beings like Ghouls, Gargoyles, Revenants, Szlachta, and Vozhd.

Just as it is suspected that the Antediluvians control the actions of their clan even in their dreamless sleep, so too do you retain the dominance of will you have over your Undead creations with your created Kindred as well.
addons.title: Prince (World Of Darkness - Vampire: The Masquerade)

objects.text:
Your hive is no hive at all, but rather the souls and bodies of the damned bound to your service with dark magic. Within this hive exists a variety of forms of undead, with purpose made horrors like the Vargheists, Bone Giants, & Necrofex Colossi, coexisting with more independent minded Vampires, strange beings like Wraiths, & cannon fodder like Skeletons.

While you can create many things ex nihilo purely from necromantic rites and manipulation of Dhar, the true strength of your army is to turn the dead into your servants. This takes far less time, effort, and energy than meticulously creating your army from scratch. This allows you to snowball, with victories in battle leading to more corpses, which gives you a larger army, which leads to more victories. The more powerful your opponents, the more powerful your potential servants.

The dark magic animating even the seemingly independent minded Liches & Vampires is your own, meaning that their will is actually your will, no matter what. The Hive Mind is simply more obvious with your "simpler" minions, as they can do nothing without your command.
objects.title: Undead (Warhammer: Fantasy)

addons.text:
Now you are also able to shape and bring into existence the Chaos Dwarfs and their warbeasts. A dark-souled and merciless race of Daemonsmiths, dark sorcerers, slavers, and brutal killers, Chaos Dwarfs are the worst traits--the greed, violent hatreds, and evil obsessions--of the Dwarfs given physical form as exposure to the power of Chaos slowly mutates even the notoriously resilient Dwarfen physiology, inflicting twisted terrors on their minds and souls so that they have become a spite-filled and calculatingly cruel reflection of what they once were.

Unlike other the other Dwarfs you command, you are capable of teaching the Chaos Dwarfs the sorcerous arts, and they will become obsessed with the control of hellish forces and the fires of the deep earth, combining the dark lore they have learned with an artisanship and skill for metalwork and industry undimmed by the twisting of their lineage.

The Chaos Dwarfs can build the greatest and most infernal warmachines the mortal world will ever know, hulking cannons bigger than houses and shrieking rockets that can obliterate entire villages into smoking ruins.

You may still command these creatures as you could their unblighted kin, for in addition to the compulsions you can inprint upon them they also fear and respect you as their absolute sovereign.
addons.title: Sons of Hashut

addons.text: You also gain access to the Dwemer & The Sixth House, as well as the fruits of their civilization. The automatons of the Dwarves & those of Sotha Sil are available to you as well, as well as Corprus creatures such as Ash Vampires & Ascended Sleepers.
addons.title: The Tribe Unmourned (The Elder Scrolls)

addons.text:
The phrase "to draw blood from a stone" is often used to represent an impossible task, but seeing as the Dwarfs were born from stone, and you have infused them with mighty new blood, perhaps it is not as difficult as has been suggested. The fusion of Mannoroth's blood with Dwarf flesh, has pleased Armok, the Dwarf God of Blood from another universe, and your Dwarfs now radiate with his favour.

The strength of even their beardless is enough to effortlessly shred through boulders, while their swiftness equals that of Elves (there's only so much Fel Blood can do about having stubby little legs). They have the endurance and stamina to fight for days without tiring, and even have the fortitude to endure concentrated fire from artillery forged in Zharr-Naggrund.

They are now totally immune against harmful magical influences, disease, or poison. Adversarial spells are rendered impotent, and they are now almost impossible to affect through psychic means, though they obviously can still use magic or psychic abilities themselves. As famously already magic resistant Dwarfs, they have been further enhanced, now being able to act as an equivalent to 40k Blanks and shut down hostile magic in a radius around them entirely.
addons.title: Fel Grudges

objects.text:
You are the ancestor god of a new Dawi clan, though actually becoming a Dwarf is optional. The Old Ones once hewed the Dawi from stone, and this power is granted to you as well, allowing you to forge Dwarfs just as Dwarfs forge steel. All the wisdom and knowledge of the Dwarfs is known to your clan from the beginning, so you needn't worry about artillery & Rune Magic being lost arts.

While your Dwarfs are capable of building and maintaining a complex civilization autonomously from your commands, you still have control over your Dwarfs with a power to cause irresistible compulsions, similar to the Dwarfs' pathological need to keep grudges. Your control over them is similar to the control one has in Dwarf Fortress, except that things that would take them out of your control like tantrum spirals or irrational noble behavior are not possible. They're capable of independent thought, and will even gain their own personalities, again in the style of Dwarf Fortress.

You and all your Dwarfs gain a resistance to magic & a long lifespan, with one famous Dwarf canonically living to his 1620th year.
objects.title: Dwarfs (Warhammer: Fantasy)

addons.text:
The infusion of Mannoroth the Destructor's blood into the veins of the Asrai, and into the roots of the treemen & dryads, has created Nature's mightiest protectors. They are augmented in all facets of their physical attributes, including their strength & speed, and it gives them an immunity to illness and plague.

Their strength is such that mere Elves become able to effortlessly shred through Oak, while their swiftness eclipses the fleetest of cavalry charges. They have the endurance and stamina to fight for days without tiring, and even have the fortitude to endure concentrated fire from a Tilean culverin battery.

They are now totally immune against harmful magical influences. Adversarial spells are rendered impotent, and they are now almost impossible to affect through psychic means, though they can still use magic or psychic abilities. In fact, their control and talent with it is even further augmented.
addons.title: Fel Sap

addons.text: You also gain access to the Bosmer, Falmer, & Maormer, as well as the fruits of their civilization. The flora & fauna of Valenwood, Skyrim, & Pyandonea are available to you as well.
addons.title: Fargoth (The Elder Scrolls)

objects.text:
You like Durthu, have become the acknowledged master of nature & all forests, though actually becoming a Nature Spirit or Wood Elf is optional. The Nature Spirits and even some Wood Elves (like Orion), are said to be shaped rather than born, and this power is granted to you as well, allowing you to form Wood Elves & Nature Spirits just as Ariel sculpts Orion. All the wisdom and knowledge of Athel Loren is known to your tribe from the beginning, so you needn't worry about Worldroots manipulation & the Lores of Life & Beasts being lost arts.

While your Asrai are capable of building and maintaining a complex civilization autonomously from your commands, you still have complete control over them, with a power to control their minds similar to Drycha's manipulations. Your control over them is similar to the control one has in any other Hive Mind found here, though they're capable of independent thought, and will even gain their own personalities.

You and all your Asrai/Nature Spirits gain immortality & a powerful connection to nature, no matter what world you're on.
objects.title: Athel Loren (Warhammer: Fantasy)

addons.text:
It is often said that fire purifies, something you have proven. Rather than infuse Mannoroth the Destructor's blood directly, Asuryan has purified it alchemically, turning it into the blood of Aenarion when fused with Elf or Man blood, or into the blood of his faithful dragon companion Indraugnir when fused with the blood of other creatures. The users become true children of Aenarion, and are augmented in all facets of their attributes, physical or not, as they become more of whatever they are. Warriors gain the talent & strength of Tyrion, hewing through formations as if through grass, while wizards become as skillful & wise as Teclis, seemingly knowing every art, and so on.

Their strength is such that mere Elves become able to effortlessly shred through Oak, while their swiftness eclipses the fleetest of cavalry charges. They have the endurance and stamina to fight for days without tiring, and even have the fortitude to endure concentrated fire from a Tilean culverin battery.

They are now totally immune against harmful magical influences, disease, or poison. Adversarial spells are rendered impotent, and they are now almost impossible to affect through psychic means, though they obviously can still use magic or psychic abilities.
addons.title: Heirs of Aenarion

addons.text: You also gain access to the Altmer, Direnni, & Bretons, as well as the fruits of their civilization. The flora & fauna of the Sumerset Isles & High Rock are available to you as well.
addons.title: The Cultured Folk (The Elder Scrolls)

addons.text:
Your power over the creations of Asuryan now carries over to their spaceborne counterparts, for your High Elves can now become proper Craftworld Eldar.

Just as your Elves did not forget their arts or abilities, neither have your Eldar forgotten theirs; Wraithbone, Craftworlds, Infinity Circuits, the Webway, the techniques of the many ascetic paths, & the weapons that fought the War In Heaven to a stalemate are no mystery to your creations.
addons.title: Craftworlders (Warhammer: 40k)

objects.text:
You have been blessed by Asuryan with the power to make Ulthuan anew, though actually becoming a High Elf or any kind of Ulthuan fauna is optional. Asuryan has granted you a power to revive the glory of Ulthuan like a Phoenix, allowing you to create Asur or other forms of Ulthuani wildlife (Dragons, Phoenixes, Great Eagles, etc.) from fire, with more powerful creatures requiring greater blazes. All the wisdom and knowledge of Ulthuan is known to your kingdom from the beginning, so you needn't worry about grand architecture, ithilmar forging, Lothern seamanship, & High Magic being lost arts.

While your Asur are capable of building and maintaining a complex civilization autonomously from your commands, you still have complete control over them through Asuryan's blessing, making you the most legitimate Phoenix King to ever live. Your control over them is similar to the control one has in any other Hive Mind found here, though they're capable of independent thought, and will even gain their own personalities.

You and all your residents of Ulthuan gain immortality & a natural talent with magic, no matter what world you're on.
objects.title: Children of Ulthuan (Warhammer: Fantasy)

addons.text:
The infusion of Mannoroth the Destructor's blood into the veins of all of your creations,  along with those subsequently birthed from your creations, has birthed the world's mightest tyrants. This augmentation extends to all facets of their physical and mental attributes, including their  innate talents in warfare, being masters in martial arts and all aspects related to combat, the minute they are brought into existence. This proficiency is deeply ingrained in their essence, and they continuously improve as they age, evolving into even more formidable warriors over time.

In this evolution, even the humblest of your creations have undergone a radical enhancement. Their strength is of such magnitude that even the weakest and most pathetic among them wields the physical power to effortlessly snap a fully grown oak tree in twain with their bare hands, while their swiftness eclipses the fleetest of Elven Steeds, they also possess the endurance and stamina to engage in continuous combat for weeks on end without succumbing to fatigue, and can even exhibit the fortitude and durability to shrug off concentrated medium-caliber artillery fire without a scratch on their skin to show for it, and this is just the weakest of your creations. This elevation in capabilities follows an exponential trajectory, progressively more profound based on the type and overall strength of the individual entity, constituting a monumental advancement across the board. A Hydra, for instance, would transform into an unstoppable unkillable juggernaut capable of annihilating entire cities overnight.

They are now totally immune against harmful magical influences. Adversarial spells are rendered impotent, including an immunity to all illnesses, plagues, and poisons. They are also now impossible to affect through psychic means, though they can still use magic or psychic abilities with great efficiency. In fact, their control and talent with it is even further augmented. Your creations have also transcended the need for sustenance. The very essence of their being, the fire that burns within them, provides all the sustenance they require for eternity. Hunger and thirst are now distant memories to them, as they can forever draw nourishment from their inner flame.

The overall transformations they have undergone, will have no impact on the operational aspects of the Dark Elves or the fundamental structure of their society. If you so desire, these elements will remain largely unchanged, preserving the continuity of their ruthless and evil way of life.

Your role as their sovereign remains steadfast and unassailable. Each and every one of the entities you have brought into being, along with those subsequently birthed from your creations continue to consciously and unconsciously perceive you as their undisputed ruler. Their unbreakable, imperishable loyalty knows no bounds, and they stand ready to heed your commands with unwavering dedication, extending their service unconditionally to the very limits of their eternal existence. You still retain the ability to control like RTS units, or directly implement a hive mind, or otherwise do as you wish. The depth of your intervention at your sole discretion.
addons.title: Fel Inheritors

addons.text: You also gain access to the Dunmer, Chimer, & Ayleids, as well as the fruits of their civilization. The flora & fauna of Morrowind & Cyrodil are available to you as well.
addons.title: Children of Veloth (The Elder Scrolls)

addons.text:
Your power over the malicious pilots of the Black Arks now carries over to the residents of Commorragh, for your Dark Elves can now become proper Drukhari.

Just as your Elves did not forget their arts or abilities, neither have your Eldar forgotten theirs; Their dark genetic and spiritual sciences, the shrewdness of the Archons, the combat arts that allow a half-nude Lillith Hesperax to kill squads of Astartes with nothing but a cheap shiv, the mad architecture of the Dark City, & the most refined implements and instruments of pain are no mystery to your creations.
addons.title: Drukhari (Warhammer: 40k)

objects.text:
You now wield the power to shape and mold the Druchii and their formidable warbeasts according to your will. While the option to become a Dark Elf or any variant of Naggarothi fauna remains open to you, these entities regard you as their own, regardless of your chosen form.

Through physical contact, you can utilize blood from any creature, allowing you to create Druchii and other forms of Naggarothi wildlife (Dragons, Hydras, Manticores, Medusae, Spiders, Cold Ones, Giants, Elven steeds, etc). The creation of more potent creatures demands a greater volume of blood, although you have an innate understanding how much blood is required for each one to be created. Additionally, you possess the capability to transmute blood into Ithilmar at a 1:10 ratio. This means that 1 liter of blood can be transformed into 10 kilograms of Ithilmar, over a period of 1 minute. 

You have the ability to selectively impart, either in part or entirely, the wisdom and knowledge of the Ulthuan and Naggarothi to your Dark Elves from their creation, so you needn't worry about languages, technology, culture, architecture, forging, Magic, etc. being lost arts.


To the Dark Elves and your other creations, you are the unchallenged sovereign, your word a law they are bound to uphold. This allegiance is unwavering, transcending distinctions of intelligence, awareness, and inherent nature. Regardless of their complexity, each and every one of the entities you have brought into being, along with those subsequently birthed from your creations, is innately aware of your sovereign authority. They are instinctively and unfailingly devoted to fulfilling your commands, bound by an unbreakable loyalty that endures throughout their immortal existence. You retain the freedom to command them as if maneuvering RTS units, assume direct control, share their perceptions, or opt for a more hands-off approach, tailored at your discretion.

Capable of independent thoughts, and will even gain their own distinct personalities, the Dark Elves possess a remarkable level of intelligence, characterized by their astute and cunning minds that set them apart, all of your Dark Elves possess a cold like beauty, being said to take a mortal's breath away, both figuratively and literally. The Dark Elves are a warrior race, innately attuned to the art of warfare, thus all Dark Elves possess a certain degree of martial skill, complemented by their supernatural physical attributes, remarkable speed, and uncanny agility, rare and few can anyone hope to match them in comabt and not perish instantly. Yet, the defining trait of the Dark Elves lies in their inherent nature of malice, sense of superiority, and unparalleled sadism. Left to their own devices and without your intervention, their supreme arrogance and ruthless ambitions would gravitate towards domination and subjugation of the entire world. Their ideology is rooted in a stark dichotomy where strength and power dictates rule and the weak are fated to serve or perish beneath the whims of the powerful. For the Druchii respect counts for nothing unless it is backed by fear.

The creations you have brought into existence possess the ability to reproduce among themselves, contingent upon your allowance. When such unions occur, the resulting offspring will mirror the traits and attributes of those you initially crafted, essentially akin to if you had created them yourself anew.

All of your creations gain immortality, remaining eternally resilient and if they so choose with a youthful appearance, only growing stronger the older they get, with a prodigious natural talent with magic, no matter what world they're on. Your immortal servants represent a formidable force that a rare and few adversaries can encounter without facing swift defeat or becoming enslaved to their will.
objects.title: Naggarothi (Warhammer: Fantasy)

objects.text:
You forged your children in blood, for blood. It is more than their origin—it is their essence. Blood speaks to them louder than any race or creed, flooding their thoughts until they, in turn, learned to command it.

Your dark elves have transcended their former selves, evolving into a new kind of being—one that draws even more strength, speed, and lethality from consuming blood itself. They can even heal and fully regenerate from even grievous wounds through the consumption of blood. The severity of the injury dictates the amount required—shallow cuts need little, while mortal damage demands far more. Yet not all blood is equal. The rarer and more potent the blood, the greater the boon it grants. 

But they are no vampires. They do not require blood to live, nor do they fear sunlight or a wooden stake to the heart. Blood is not their curse—it is their legacy. It shaped them, empowered them, and now, they wield it as a weapon, a birthright.

In addition to drawing strength and vitality from consuming blood, each of your Dark Elves possesses an innate affinity for blood magic. This arcane gift allows them to manipulate blood as a physical medium—whether their own or that of others.

Their proficiency with this magic varies according to individual potential, but even the weakest among them can conjure weapons and armor forged from their own blood. With effort, they can even influence the blood within other living beings, though the ease of control depends greatly on the target’s strength and will.
objects.title: Bloodforged

addons.text:
The infusion of Mannoroth the Destructor's blood with your creations, along with those subsequently birthed from your creations, has birthed a transformation of unparalleled might. A surge of power courses through their very being, propelling them into a realm of prowess never before witnessed. This augmentation extends to all facets of their physical attributes, this also includes their innate potential for overall growth.

In this evolution, even the humblest of your creations have undergone a radical enhancement. Their strength is of such magnitude that even the weakest most pathetic among them wields the power to effortlessly uproot a fully grown oak tree from the very earth that nurtured it, while their swiftness eclipses the fleetest of cavalry charges, they can even exhibit the fortitude and durability to shrug off concentrated high-caliber artillery fire without a scratch on them to show for it. The degree of advancement experienced by each individual Undead and Construct is directly proportional to their type, variant, and initial power, constituting a monumental advancement across the board.

They are also now totally immune against harmful magical influences, poison, and diseases. Adversarial spells are rendered impotent, and they are also now impossible to affect through psychic means. They can still use magic or psychic abilities with great efficiency, where their control and talent with it, got even further augmented.

Your role as their sovereign remains steadfast and unassailable. They continue to consciously and unconsciously perceive you as their undisputed ruler. Their loyalty knows no bounds, and they stand ready to heed your commands with unwavering dedication, extending their service unconditionally to the very limits of their eternal existence. You still retain the ability to control like RTS units, or directly implement a hive mind, etc.The depth of your intervention at your sole discretion.
addons.title: Fel Kings

objects.text:
You now wield the power to shape and mold the Tomb Kings and their formidable Constructs according to your will. While the option to become an Undead or any variant of Nehekhara Constructs remains open to you, these entities regard you as their own, regardless of your chosen form.

Through manipulating and shaping bones in your general vincinity, you can create the undead Tomb Kings (Kings & Queens, Princes, Liche Priests, Tomb Heralds, etc) and other forms of Nehekhara Warbeasts and Constructs (Hierotitan, Khemrian Warsphinxes, Tomb Scorpions, Necrolith Colossus, Necrosphinx, Ushabti, Sepulchral Stalkers, Khemric Titans, etc). The creation of more potent and powerful entities demands a greater quantity of bones, although you have an innate understanding how much bone is required for each one to be created. 

You have the ability to selectively impart, either in part or entirely, the wisdom and knowledge of the Nehekhara to your Undead from their creation, so you needn't worry about languages, technology, culture, architecture, forging, Magic, etc. being lost arts.

To the Tomb kings and your other creations, you are the unchallenged sovereign, your word a law they are bound to uphold. This devotion knows no bounds, extending to your created Undead and constructs of all intelligences, awareness, and inherent natures. Regardless of their complexity, each and every one of the entities you have brought into being, along with those subsequently birthed from your creations, is innately aware of your sovereign authority. They are instinctively and unfailingly devoted to fulfilling your commands, bound by an unbreakable loyalty that endures throughout their immortal existence. You retain the freedom to command them as if maneuvering RTS units, assume direct control, share their perceptions, or opt for a more hands-off approach, tailored at your discretion.

If you choose so, the undead entities you bring into existence are granted the restoration of their former intelligence, memories, personalities, skills, and abilities prior to their demise. Their resilience and durability is extraordinary, allowing them to endure the most ferocious of weapon swings without exhibiting any discernible harm.

Living eternally, these tireless, unbreathing beings require no sustenance and do not succumb to weariness. All of your creations, and those birthed from your creations are perpetually immune to true death, as their physical forms, if destroyed, promptly regenerate and reform within a matter of seconds. However, only you hold the exclusive power to permanently extinguish their existence. By making physical contact with the intent to permanently kill them, you can cast their souls back to the realm of the afterlife, ensuring their definitive departure.

Endowed with an innate aptitude for mastering magic, your immortal servants represent a formidable force that a rare and few adversaries can encounter without facing swift defeat or becoming enslaved to their will.
objects.title: Tomb Kings (Warhammer: Fantasy)

addons.text:
The infusion of Mannoroth the Destructor's blood with your creations, along with those subsequently birthed from them, has given rise to a transformation of unparalleled might. A surge of power courses through their very being, propelling them into a realm of prowess never before witnessed. This augmentation extends to all facets of their physical attributes, including their intellectual capacities that now rivals those of the average humans and their natural lifespan, your Ogres now possessing a longevity that lets them reach into the thousands of years, only growing stronger the older they get.

In this evolution, even the humblest of your creations have undergone a radical enhancement. Their strength is of such magnitude that even the weakest, most pathetic among them wields the physical power to effortlessly uproot dozens of fully grown oak trees with a single tug and hurl them across a field, while their swiftness eclipses the fleetest of cavalry charges. They also possess the endurance and stamina to engage in continuous combat for months on end without succumbing to fatigue, and  exhibit the fortitude and durability to shrug off concentrated high-caliber artillery fire without a scratch on them to show for it And this is just the weakest of your creations. The degree of advancement experienced by each individual Ogre, Dragon Ogre and Warbeast is directly proportional to their type, variant, and initial power, constituting a monumental increase of power across the board. A Stonehorn for instance would transform into an unstoppable, unkillable juggernaut capable of annihilating entire cities overnight.

They are now totally immune against harmful magical influences, adversarial spells rendered impotent. Their enhancement also includes an immunity to all illnesses, plagues, and poisons. Additionally they are also now impossible to affect through psychic means, though they themselves can still use magic or psychic abilities with great efficiency. In fact, their own control and talent with in these areas is augmented. 

Your creations have also broken free from the insatiable hunger that once plagued them. Their appetite has now become more manageable, able to derive massive amounts of sustenance from a single bite of meat, as if they had just feasted on the grandest banquet of their existence. Although their overwhelming love for food will always stay with them, their reliance on it is gone. 

Their jaws and teeth, as well as the acidity of their stomachs, have undergone enhancements of unparalleled magnitude as your creations are now able to crush, devour, and digest any organic or inorganic material that exists or could ever exist with ease.

The overall transformations they have undergone will have no impact on the operational aspects of the Ogres or the fundamental structure of their society, including their caste system and culture. If you so desire, these elements will remain largely unchanged, preserving the continuity of their ruthless traditional way of life.

Your role as their sovereign remains steadfast and unassailable. They continue to consciously and unconsciously perceive you as their undisputed ruler. Their loyalty knows no bounds, and they stand ready to heed your commands with unwavering dedication, extending their service unconditionally to the very limits of their near-eternal existence. You still retain the ability to control them like RTS units, or directly implement a hive mind. The depth of your intervention at your sole discretion.
addons.title: Fel Devourers

addons.text:
Now you are also able to shape and bring into existence Dragon Ogres using raw meat, beings that embody a fusion of the upper body of an Ogre with the formidable lower body of a dragon. These creatures are virtually unparalleled in their might, while boosting a remarkable speed from their powerful lower body, able to match even elven steeds, rendering them impervious to most adversaries. They stand as immortal entities, their strength and size expanding as they age, knowing no bounds to the power they can amass over time.

Among their kind, the oldest and most revered are the Shaggoths. These beings are distinguished by their exceptional size towering over mammoths, advanced age, profound wisdom, and martial prowess that borders on the legendary. They are living incarnations of destruction and devastation, a force of nature unto themselves.

All Dragon Ogres possess a remarkable natural affinity for lightning. They have the innate capability to generate and harness lightning, infusing it into their every action if they want to. This electrifying power becomes an integral part of their existence, enhancing their already formidable abilities.

Moreover, they can consume lightning to further empower themselves. This consumption serves as a source of rejuvenation and augmentation, enabling them to tap into the raw energy of thunderstorms and electrical phenomena to elevate their already awe-inspiring might to even greater heights.

In your hands lies the choice of allowing Dragon Ogres to age naturally, granting them the potential to evolve into Shaggoths after how many countless centuries, or directly creating them using a substantial quantity of raw meat, that could probably feed an entire small-sized village for a month. 

You possess the authority to permanently extinguish their existence, achieved by invoking their one true name with the intent to kill. This closely guarded secret is known solely to you, as their names are revealed to you with the creation of each Dragon Ogre. 

These immortal creatures hold you in the same highest regard as any other Ogre you've created, consciously and unconsciously perceiving you as their undisputed ruler. Pledging unwavering and unbounded loyalty and extending their service unconditionally throughout their eternal existence.

(If the Fel Devourers addon is chosen, the Dragon Ogres will also be affected and enhanced accordingly by its properties)
addons.title: Dragon Ogres

objects.text:
You now wield the power to shape and mold the Ogres and their formidable warbeasts according to your will. While the option to become an Ogre or any variant of The Mountains of Mourn fauna remains open to you, these entities regard you as their own, regardless of your chosen form.

Through physical contact, you can utilize raw meat from any creature, allowing you to create all variants of Ogres, and other forms of The Mountains of Mourn wildlife (Sabretusks, Thundertusk, Giants, Stonehorns, Rhinoxen, Blood Vulture etc). The creation of more potent creatures demands a greater quantity of meat, although you have an innate understanding how much meat is required for each one to be created.

All of the wisdom and knowledge of the Ogre Kingdoms is known to your Ogres from their creation, so you needn't worry about languages, technology, culture, architecture, forging, Magic, etc being lost arts.

To your Ogres and your other creations, you are the unchallenged sovereign, your word a law they are bound to uphold. This allegiance is unwavering, transcending distinctions of intelligence, awareness, and inherent nature. Regardless of their complexity, each and every one of the entities you have brought into being, along with those subsequently birthed from your creations, is innately aware of your sovereign authority. They are instinctively and unfailingly devoted to fulfilling your commands, bound by an unbreakable loyalty that endures throughout their immortal existence. You retain the freedom to command them as if maneuvering RTS units, assume direct control, share their perceptions, or opt for a more hands-off approach, tailored at your discretion.

Capable of independent thoughts, and will even gain their own distinct personalities, the Ogres can be considred a rather simple minded race, but what they lack in intellect, they hugely compesante it with their physical capabilities. Standing at a towering height of 10 feet, the average Ogre possess immense physical strength, able to effortlessly snap a fully grown horse in half with a casual swipe of their massive hands, their skin, remarkably durable, serves as an impervious front line shield against even the most formidable of weapon strikes, while having a surprising swiftness that defies the expectations of their colossal frame, allowing them to overtake the swiftest of mortal humans with startling ease. The most distinctive trait of the Ogres lies in their instantiable hunger, an all-consuming force driven by a set of teeth and jaws capable of crushing even the toughest of rocks and metals. Accompanying this formidable maw is a stomach that possesses the uncanny ability to digest nearly anything that crosses their path. Add everything up, and they beomce a biological marvel that transforms them into a relentless force of nature, a nightmare no sane individual would willingly confront in combat, and this is just the average Ogre, for an Ogre will grow both in power and might the older he gets. An Ogre Tyrant, the leaders of their Ogre tribes, ranking third in terms of status only after the Overtyrants and yourself, are second only in strength and prowess to the Overtyrants within the hierarchy of Ogre society, standing at an awe-inspiring height of 15 feet, and capable of single-handedly overpowering and soundly defeating a dozen Ogre Bulls on his own.

Within the complex tapestry of Ogre society, strength and martial combat reigns supreme, embodying not only status but also the very essence of law itself. Yet, the most pivotal role that might plays in their world is that of sustenance. The Ogres view power as a means to secure their next meal, and they brook no opposition when it comes to satisfying their ravenous appetites. In a society that thrives on ruthlessness and pragmatism, where the weak inevitably meet their demise, the strong and powerful reign supreme, both in terms of authority and access to nourishment. Left to their own devices and without your intervention, an Ogre society paints a stark tableau of survival, where the pecking order is unyielding and the ultimate goal is the continued existence of the mightiest.

The creations you have brought into existence possess the ability to reproduce among themselves, contingent upon your allowance. When such unions occur, the resulting offspring will mirror the traits and attributes of those you initially crafted, essentially akin to if you had created them yourself anew.

Able to live up to 500 years, Ogres are a highly resilient and adapatble species, mighty beyond compare, highly resistant against harmful psychic influences, and with the ability to use magic to a certain degree.
objects.title: The Hungering Maw (Warhammer: Fantasy)

addons.text:
Now you are also able to shape and bring into existence the Warriors of Chaos and their fearsome warbeasts. These evil Men have chosen to forsake their former lives and give themselves wholly to the service of Chaos to become instruments of destruction. 

Within the tribal societies that worship the Chaos Gods, the most favored warriors are often gifted with a suit of hell-forged armor as a reward for their service to their cheiftains. In the hierarchy of the Northmen armies, such armor is often used as a clear sign of status or rank. Only the most gifted and powerful warriors are allowed to wear such armor, with the majority of Champions often donning armor of their own. Such gifted Men are said to tread the path of the gods, and head in search of glory, power and, ultimately immortality.

Chaos Warriors are fighters of great prowess, raised from strong Northmen stock, with skills honed by a lifetime of constant battle amongst themselves and against other races. Their strength is infernal and their bodies as tough as the Iron Mountains. Imbued with the power of Chaos and gifted with suits of Daemon-plate, a Chaos Warrior is equal in combat power to an entire squad or more of normal Men.

Now these fearsome warriors answer to you for you are their unchallenged Champion and master.
addons.title: Slaves of Darkness

addons.text:
There are tales from the days of Sigmar, that say that in the olden times, the tribes that would one day settle and become the human kingdoms of today were so primitive that they wore little but pelts, and carried only flint, or those few steel weapons the Dwarfs granted them. With only this, they were able to stand against vast legions of Orcs, though the Orcs themselves had iron weapons & armor. This suggests a great might which has been lost to the Men of today.

With an infusion of Mannoroth the Destructor's Blood, your humans (and their beasts) have rediscovered that strength; indeed, they have even surpassed it. The average human now has the singular tide turning ability of a minor Elector-Count, Warrior-Priest, Grail Knight, or Wizard.

The strength of even their weaklings is enough to effortlessly shred through Oak, while their swiftness eclipses the fleetest of cavalry charges. They have the endurance and stamina to fight for days without tiring, and even have the fortitude to endure concentrated fire from fine Nuln artillery.

They are now totally immune against harmful magical influences, disease, or poison. Adversarial spells are rendered impotent, and they are now almost impossible to effect through psychic means, though they obviously can still use magic or psychic abilities themselves.
addons.title: Fel Tribes

addons.text:
Your power over mankind and those bound to them now carries over to the humans of the Imperium Of Man. Those who were made alike to the servants of Sigmar, The Lady, Ursun, The Celestial Dragons, or so on, can now become like those who serve the Master of Mankind and the Omnissiah.

Just as your humans of Mallus did not forget their arts or abilities, neither have your Terran humans forgotten theirs; the methods of communing with the machine spirits and the wonders of the machine cult, the psychic arts, the holy powers of the Living Saints, the killing techniques of the Assassinorum & Death Cults, & the geneforged might of the Astartes are no mystery to your creations.
addons.title: Great Crusade (Warhammer: 40k)

objects.text:
You now wield the power to shape and mold the Humans and their formidable warbeasts according to your will. While the option to become a human or any variant of The fauna humans were able to tame remains open to you, these entities regard you as their own, regardless of your chosen form.

Through physical contact, you can utilize mud and clay, allowing you to create all variants of humans, and other forms of the extensive wildlife humans were able to domesticate (Kislev, The Empire, Cathay, Bretonnia, etc). The creation of more potent creatures demands a greater quantity of mud and clay, although you have an innate understanding how much is required for each one to be created.

You have the ability to selectively impart, either in part or entirely, all of the wisdom and knowledge of the Human Empires/Kingdoms to your humans from their creation, so you needn't worry about languages, technology, culture, architecture, forging, Magic, etc. being lost arts.

To the Humans and your other creations, you are the unchallenged sovereign, your word a law they are bound to uphold. Bound by an unbreakable loyalty that endures throughout their existence. You retain the freedom to command them as if maneuvering RTS units, assume direct control, share their perceptions, or opt for a more hands-off approach, tailored at your discretion.

Capable of independent thoughts, and will even gain their own distinct personalities, within the tapestry of diverse races and species, humans stand as a unique testament to adaptability and the potential to stand unyielding against adversity. While they may not always be regarded as the strongest, most skilled, or the smartest, their unparalleled ability to adapt is their defining characteristic. Indeed left to their own devices, they may either build the greatest of civilizations, or cause their downfall in their relentless pursuit of progress and change. 

Able to live up to 100 years, Humans are a highly resilient and adaptable species, and with the ability to use magic to a certain degree.
objects.title: Humankind (Warhammer: Fantasy)

objects.text:
Your hive is now a massive interconnected species of psychic parasitic fungus similar to Ophiocordyceps Unilateralis. 

You, as the central intelligence of this hivemind can produce an unlimited amount of spores which can infect both flora and fauna. These spores are a potent psychedelic neurotoxin, instantly paralyzing and killing anyone who comes in contact with them in minutes. These spores are also produced en mass as a self defense mechanism when your fungus is harmed. 

Once a creature succumbs to the neurotoxin, their central nervous system is hijacked by the fungus, allowing you to completely control their corpse and drain them of the knowledge in their brains. Furthermore, you can force the usage of any powers the victim might have. The bodies of these infected eventually become overgrown with fungus, producing more spores and continuing the cycle.

The collective psionic might of the hive is enough to allow you to project thoughts across an entire city and use telekinesis to crush buildings to rubble. And with every intelligent creature infected, the psionic might of your hive grows. Infected creatures act as living psionic pylons, spreading your range to wherever they are present. With enough infected, you may even fuse together those you have infected with fungal roots, creating hulking monstrosities with greater strength and abilities than the of the sum of its parts. 

When infecting the landscape itself, your fungus can create mycelium networks miles deep and towering pilei, blotting out the sky with suffocating amounts of spores and bolstering your psychic power.
objects.title: Mentalismycosis

objects.text:
Out of every creation you bring into existence, there is a 1 in 10,000 chance, or 0.01%, that one will possess a seedling of divinity.

This occurrence is random and beyond your control, but when it happens, the results are nothing short of miraculous. Even though it’s just a seedling, the creation's potential for growth will be amplified dozens of times. Their size will often grow to be larger than their contemporaries. Their eyes, if they have them, will shine with a piercing color depending on their personality, and they will naturally exude an aura of nobility and grandeur, striking awe and reverence in all who behold them. This aura will not affect their creator, beings with a similar power level, or those with divine seedlings. If their species isn't already immortal, the divine seed will increase their original lifespan by 3000%.

These beings will become the main characters, the extraordinary figures who exceed any expectations you might have for them. They will be born with unique powers and abilities previously unseen in their species, and they will acquire more along their journey. Given enough time, they will undoubtedly become the strongest of your creations, the elites among elites.

If allowed to flourish, the seedling will infinitely fuel their potential, and they might even attain demi-godhood after enough near-death experiences and decades of practice.

This divine seedling does not affect the inherent loyalty your creations have towards you as their creator. However, the influence of the seedling may cause their temperament and personality to lean towards the extreme and eccentric. If you desire, you may remove the power of the seedling through physical contact, but doing so will almost certainly kill its host. While you cannot use the seedling for yourself, you may transfer it to another target, provided it is one of your creations.
objects.title: The Making Of Gods

objects.text:
You now have a HUD display system that can be effortlessly accessed at a subconscious level. This HUD provides precise and comprehensive information about your hive, including population, growth rate, contentment, as well as individual statistics such as age, potential, and physical condition, and much more.

Furthermore, your hive gains attributes and traits similar to an RPG game, allowing them to level up as they successfully complete tasks and challenges set up by you. You have the ability to allocate the experience points earned to enhance their specific attributes manually or allow the system to automate the allocation process. 

The user interface (UI) of the HUD can be tailored to your personal preferences, enabling you to design it to align with your specific needs and aesthetics. Importantly, the HUD remains entirely visible only to you, ensuring the privacy and exclusivity of the information it provides.

This integrated HUD system grants you unparalleled insight and control over your hive's progress and potential, allowing for efficient management and optimization of its resources and capabilities.
objects.title: Hive System

objects.text:
The Ex- Machina possesses advanced technological capabilities and unique characteristics that make them a formidable opponent in combat and strategy. Your hive is comprised of them, and their mental link allows for swift and accurate communication among all units, giving them a significant advantage in any conflict.

The Ex-Machina have a total of 5 types of units, which can be organized into specific roles depending on the task at hand. They are designed for specific tasks, but all units are linked together through a hierarchical structure with varying roles:

The Seher are responsible for information gathering and oversight of the hive.

The Prüfer are analytical units that can analyze and interpret information. 

The Zeichen are units dedicated to designing and manufacturing new technologies.

The Kämpfer are the combat units designed to engage with enemies in direct combat. 

The Befehler are commanding units that issue orders and coordinate the actions of other units in the hive.

In addition to these unique characteristics, the Ex-Machina possess incredible adaptability and replication abilities. They can learn from any attacks used against them and quickly develop defenses against those attacks. These abilities make fighting against the Ex-Machina a challenging and strategic endeavor. By harnessing the power of this new race, you can gain an incredible advantage on the battlefield, especially when paired with their advanced technology and adaptability.
objects.title: Ex-Machina (No Game No Life)

objects.text: How unfortunate joyous an occasion! Our Prince of Darkness True Savior is with us once again! You now wield the full might of the Alternate threat, being the Unspeakable, inciting their birth (either directly spawning them or manipulating others to birth them as Tulpas) and molding them to your devilish whims. The Alternates are in reality a collective of demonic beings acting the will of their creator to topple God's order with theirs. A distinguishable ability of Alternates of how they diverge from common devilry, their more artful and insidious tactics range from supplanting others from their own, able to shapeshift or even assimilate their victims gaining their visage while also emulating their voice to further deceive everyone around them, this creating ambiance of paranoia and/or distrust of their environment and society furthers eases the victims to be susceptible to the Alternates' psychological warfare, isolating and wearing down at the victim's psyche inflicting them with a particular illness, called M.A.D (Metaphysical Awareness Disorder), consisting of "giving information not desired to be known", put simply an infohazard that ravages the target's mind maddening them to put an end to it themselves. Another thing to note is how they're not fully tangible beings, showcasing other abilities such as flight/levitation, camouflaging in the shadows, and teleporting, among other unseen capabilities. Alternates are shown to be extremely difficult to harm or kill, and common methods of defense such as firearms aren't enough to deter them. Good thing they know and exploit this fact to mock their helplessness. Being the sole creator, their fate solely resides with you, whether you use it to its rightful use is up to you.
objects.title: Alternates (The Mandela Catalogue)

addons.text:
The infusion of Mannoroth the Destructor's blood greatly strengthens your Wobblers and has birthed a new colour of incredible might, Crimson Wobblers

In this new form, even the weakest and least competent wobbler is now able to obliterate buildings, and outsmart even an average human, 

They can now consistently use magic or psychic abilities with great efficiency, and their control over these abilities has been doubled.
addons.title: Fel Simulation

objects.text:
Congratulations, You now wield a insignificant part of BIG MÖRTs power, this allows you to mould clay into "Wobblers." Who will serve you competently? Sufficiently? Uhhh, decently?, well... uhhhhhh they'll try their best...

Wobblers are all physically superior to humans in exchange for their lowered intelligence and wit, its not a good trade off... additionally, all wobblers are attuned to magic and can be at least somewhat competent at it, unlike anything else the poor things do...

Wobblers are the primary inhabitants of the TABS world. They have wandered it for Aeons Past. From the Age of Tribal to the Dark Awakening, their civilizations have risen and fallen. despite that they will always thrive and survive....

Wobblers are capable of building and maintaining a surprisingly complex civilization autonomously from your commands, with a massive amount of variety, additionally you have complete control over them, with the power to control their minds, bodies, and souls with mere thoughts. However, they're capable of independent thought and in time may be able to resist your will, especially the more magically powerful wobblers; they may even gain their own personalities, religions, and cultures if left alone.
objects.title: Totally Accurate Overmind Simulator (T.A.B.S)

objects.text:
"We are the Borg. Lower your shields and surrender your ships. We will add your biological and technological distinctiveness to our own. Your culture will adapt to service us. Resistance is futile."

You are the master of the Borg, a "Borg Queen" in your own right. You can assimilate others into the collective, or create drones from scratch. As the Borg is a true hive mind, your drones are pure extensions of yourself with no free will of their own. You can create "free" or "free-er" drones like Seven of Nine or Hugh, but these are the exception rather than the rule.

As part of this, a complete database of Borg technology (even from known alternate timelines) is granted to your gestalt mind. This prevents you from having to reinvent the wheel (or the cube, as the case may be).
objects.title: The Borg (Star Trek)

objects.text: "We are eternal. The pinnacle of evolution and existence. Before us, you are nothing. Your extinction is inevitable. We are the end of everything." The Reapers are a highly advanced race of sentient synthetic-organic starships, spanning colossal lengths ranging from 160 meters to over 3 kilometers. While they exhibit variations in outward appearance across subtypes, a common resemblance to cuttlefish or squid is evident. In the presence of Reapers or any of their associated artifacts, sentient life—whether synthetic or organic—succumbs to an overwhelming sense of indoctrination that forcefully realigns their mentality to serve the Reapers in any capacity needed. Proximity to an actual Reaper grants them the much more direct ability to manipulate the minds of sentient beings, compelling unwavering servitude. This indoctrination is irrevocable and almost impossible to subvert—except under truly exceptional circumstances—ensnaring even the most formidable individuals as long as they remain nearby. Furthermore, Reapers possess the capability to assimilate lifeforms into husks—hybrids of Reaper technology and harvested organisms. These mindless entities serve solely as foot soldiers to advance the Reapers' objectives. Few races truly understand the sheer horror of this tactic, as every soldier that falls has the potential to become another enemy asset for the Reapers. Beyond this twisted psychological influence, the Reapers wield immense destructive power physically. A single ‘Sovereign-class’ Reaper is nearly impervious to damage while being capable of decimating fleets and annihilating cities. They are equipped with an intelligence so advanced that it allows for the disassembly and assimilation of technology, no matter how complex, given enough time. Their armaments are “Magnetohydrodynamic” weapons that shoot streams of molten metal at a fraction of the speed of light. The ‘secondary’ weapons mounted on their ‘arms’ can pierce through the most resilient cruisers' shields with ease, while their main, spinal-mounted version is capable of obliterating dreadnought-class ships effortlessly. A Reaper is capable of reaching much higher FTL velocities than standard ships, thanks to their enlarged Element Zero Drive Cores. This allows them to generate a sufficiently powerful Mass Effect field to land on planetary bodies or change direction in space in ways that would normally be considered impossible for ships of their size. This Drive Core is also responsible for the Reaper’s powerful kinetic barriers, capable of holding back the full force of entire fleets using ‘conventional’ Element Zero weaponry. Perhaps the greatest ‘weapon’ of the Reapers is their sheer numbers—a fleet of high-powered starships whose numbers are almost beyond count.
