You now stand as the ‘Harbinger’ of a new fleet of Reapers, with you and your allies able to ‘produce’ one general Reaper a month and a ‘Sovereign-Class’ every three months. Slowly but surely, your fleet will grow, ready and awaiting your directives with perfect loyalty. With Overmind, you merge fully with the Reaper, becoming the ‘guiding intelligence’ in charge of the Reaper gestalt consciousness. With Shepard and Normandy, you retain much more of your individuality, able to ‘enter’ and ‘leave’ the gestalt consciousness of the Reaper as you see fit.
objects.title: The Reapers (Mass Effect)

addons.text: Your villagers and all their golems are now connected to your hive. You gain the same control over them as any other mob you summoned, and they also gain the same absolute loyalty your mobs have. You are freely able to switch from spawning them from eggs or summoning them like any other mob in your hive. If you will it or if they happen to get struck by lightning, they shall become witches. They will gain all knowledge shown, hinted at, or referenced in Minecraft about potions and can create entirely new ones through experimentation and new ingredients. If you have Substitution Brewery, they can substitute a potion's ingredient with the closest thing if they are unable to find that exact ingredient.
addons.title: Witches & Villages

addons.text: Your hive has connected to the Wither(s) created by Golemancy. This boss mob is now under your control like any other mob within your hive, with absolute loyalty to you. The Wither(s) can use all moves from their Java and Bedrock counterparts in addition to using the Bedrock Wither's stats, along with the fact that you are controlling them and not their usual behavior of letting themselves be hit and the occasional dodge—no, the only thing worse than fighting a Bedrock Wither is a player-controlled one.
addons.title: The Wither

addons.text: Your hive has expanded—now all mobs from the Overworld have joined your hive, and you are able to summon them as you may do any other mob in your hive. From the common Zombie to the overwhelming Warden, your hive has taken one step closer to truly being complete. They gain the same absolute loyalty all your other mobs have. Although, access to the Overworld dimension is barred from you, for some reason. Something or someone is keeping it out of reach from your domain—not out of maliciousness but because you are not yet ready.
addons.title: The Overworld

objects.text:
Your hive expands, bolstered by the presence of an ever-expanding realm of fire, shadow, and brimstone now tethered to your soul—the Nether, granting you access to the aforementioned dimension and its denizens.

You can open portals of sizes within Minecraft's limits to and from the Nether, regardless of how they are usually accessed. From these portals, or ex nihilo if you want to be subtle, arise your mobs—from the gold-craving Piglins all the way to the formidable Wither Skeleton.

These mobs have absolute loyalty towards you, never attacking you nor showing any negative emotion towards you even if you're torturing them. To them, you are their sovereign, their king, and their god. Your word is akin to a divine commandment, and they shall follow it with zealous determination to the best of their abilities.

You can see through any of your mobs' eyes, override their wills and control them as if they were your body, shape their minds as if they were clay and you the sculptor, and instantly kill them with a thought—these abilities transcend distance, dimension and outside interference, ensuring that you are never without your monsters. If you do decide to directly control multiple mobs, you obtain multitasking that scales with the amount you're controlling.

Their loyalty can never be subverted by outside forces, and if they somehow were subverted, you shall instantly know.

Unlike in the game, your mobs are not bound by the code or their behavior inside it. A Piglin can learn to see past gold and not fear its zombified counterparts.

As the Nether is now a part of you, you are immune to its dangers and can modify its characteristics, like allowing water to exist within the Nether.

The Nether is separated from any other hell or hell-like dimensions, afterlives, or anything similar. So there is no need to fear the Warp or the Twisting Nether.

You are only limited to mobs exclusively from the Nether. You do not have access to mobs purely from or also exist in the Overworld or The End with this alone. This means that no Skeletons or Endermen will be present within the Nether until you obtain access to their respective dimensions.

Additionally, it requires time and training for you to expand your portal size beyond Minecraft's limits—don't expect to be swallowing whole worlds into the Nether right off the bat.
objects.title: Reign of the Nether (Minecraft)

objects.text:
Your hive has undergone an evolutionary transformation, becoming an infectious species of parasite with immense hyper-adaptive ability.

By touch, you may shape any dead or inert biomass into a vast array of bioforms to propogate the infection. From the lowly rupters to monstrosities built for war such as the Kirin, all can be made with the right amount of biomass. Additionally, as the central intelligence of the Hive, you may also benefit from this ability, shaping your own flesh and adding onto it with biomass to become greater than any other creature in existence.  

The greatest strength of your hive is its adaptation. Any damage dealt to a bioform will rapidly decrease in its effectiveness until the bioform is immune to that source of damage, and stronger bioforms will have greater adaptation speed. Combined with the rapid regenerative properties of most bioforms, this makes your hive a nightmare to properly eradicate. However, this adaptation is not infallible. Fire can slow or even interrupt the adaptation process entirely, and individual bioforms can only adapt to so many different types of damage.

If you wish, your hive may also propagate itself with no input from you at all. Living creatures which come into contact with a parasite will be infected, wherein a living creature is gradually assimilated into the hivemind, mutating into a grotesque reflection of its former self more suited for combat. Eventually, these assimilated creatures will come together to fuse into proper bioforms, gaining the power of adaptation. The infection may spread via flora as well, assimilating the landscape and rendering it uninhabitable.
objects.title: Call of The Hive (Minecraft: Scape & Run Parasites Mod)

addons.text:
Now, thanks to both your ability to create new Ilithids, and your ownership of an old and powerful elder brain, you can create new ones directly, by molding enough neurological tissue together. 

  While these newly born elder brains will not be as strong as the one you already control, they already will allow for you to produce tadpoles at a much faster rate, but also act as nodes in the hive mind, letting you delegate control of groups of mind flayers to them. 

  Additionally you may let anyone affected by your ceremorphosis retain their personality, effectively gaining a version of the power **True Soul (Baldur’s Gate 3)**.
addons.title: Elder Brains

objects.text:
Your hive is now made up of the psionic aberrations known as the Ilithid, along with their many kin.
  
  You may form the tadpoles that are the first stage of their life cycle from brain matter. They will grow to adequate maturity after being raised in a brine laced with cerebrospinal fluid.

  When sufficiently developed, the tadpoles may be given access to the brain of a living creature, which they will then devour and replace, beginning ceremorphosis, the process in which a creature becomes a mind flayer. Ordinarily, only certain creatures make viable hosts, but your tadpoles are much more viable. As long as the host is sentient, organic, and has a brain, the creature that results from it will be of at least some use.

  An ordinary Illithid is of generally humanoid shape, with skin colors in various shades of purple. They have rubbery skin with a coating of mucus over them. This mucus not only retains moisture but also gives them a notable amount of resistance to magic. Their heads are octopus-like, only with four tentacles and a mouth that is like that of a lamprey rather than a beak. They will end up somewhat physically weaker than they were before the transformation.
 
 What mind flayers often lack in physical strength, they more than make up for in psychic capabilities. Even a relatively untrained mind flayer is capable of psionic feats such as levitation, telepathy, direct mental attacks, emotional manipulation , and transportation between dimensions. Over time, they can develop their powers further, gaining greater ability to control minds, telekinesis, and clairvoyance. To make use of their psionics, your Illithids must regularly feed on the brains of sapient creatures.
  
  While they do maintain a telepathic connection with you and each other, each Illithid retains their own personalities and goals, though they are still subordinate to your will.
objects.title: Mind Flayers (D&D)

addons.text: Somewhere in the all-consuming void beneath the Overworld, a myth that has haunted Minecraft for many generations opens his eyes, illuminating the darkness with their brilliance. Well, I'll be... you've done it. The entity has recognized you as his true successor, the inheritor of his vast powers. As such, what was once holding you back from your true potential has stepped back and nodded his head. Your Creative Mode was not accidental, but on purpose—it was to provide the foundation for your ascension. The Enchanted Golden Apple and the potion was merged together and implanted into your body. However, because of the Apple's power, the negative effects of the potion were nullified. Thus, your true potential has been unleashed, and reality trembles. The Overworld in its entirety has been bestowed upon you as a dimension you can make portals to and from. The strongholds, the monuments, the lush caves, the ancient cities—everything. They are yours now, and with your newfound powers, you can shape the Nether, The End, and The Overworld as effortlessly as a deity might shape their domain. While your mobs are no longer bound by the game's code, they can still take advantage of it. Either voluntarily by the mobs or at your will, they can rapidly toggle Minecraft logic on themselves. It takes only a moment's notice, making it a useful tool for surprise attacks or a trump card in a high-stakes battle. For example, when falling to certain death, they can toggle Minecraft logic to instantly halt their momentum and inertia in the water, landing safely. As the heir of Herobrine, you can freely manifest an avatar in his likeness. It could be the default Herobrine look—Steve with white eyes—or if you don't like it, you can customize its age, sex, appearance and form. But no matter what, it must always have pure white eyes, as a reminder of what it truly is. When controlling this avatar, you gain all the powers shown by Herobrine in the Minecraft community; from Willcraft's Monster School Herobrine all the way to Alan Becker's Herobrine, your avatar is an unstoppable force—almost omnipotent in its influence, as expected of Minecraft Himself. But he is merely one side of the same coin that you have been granted access to. The other goes by many names—the Builder, the Human, the Default Skin—but he is most famously known as Steve. He joins your hive as one of the strongest beings in Minecraft there is, capable of nearly anything. If Herobrine is the embodiment of Minecraft, then he is the embodiment of the Minecraft community. The Player character who turned the imagination and desires of countless souls into reality. Mining, building, crafting, enchanting, brewing, fighting, exploring, killing—anything that a Minecraft player can do, he can do it too, with the potential to reach the levels of Minecraft legends like Feinberg, clownpiece, and Technoblade. Just starting out, he is at the level of a Minecraft player with ten years' worth of experience. However, he can quickly learn and grow in a rate that would get him labeled as a monstrous prodigy. His growth is not limited to Minecraft-related things. You can control Steve like you were playing Minecraft normally, seeing through his eyes with the usual Minecraft HUD, but you can also control him like any other mob in your hive. Now, as the heir of Herobrine, you are Minecraft personified.
addons.title: Take Back the Night

objects.text: The energies of the Nether has unlocked the mysteries of the Ender Pearl, and because of that, The End in all its entirety tethers to your soul with a resonating 'click'. You have now gained access to the Final Destination, the endgame, the last task before a player can "beat the game". As with the Nether, you can open portals within Minecraft's limits to and from The End. A swirling dark portal that behelds the majesty of the cosmos warps into existence, swallowing anyone or anything unfortunate enough to be in its way. It is with these portals, separate from the Nether, where mobs that call the End their 'home' can make their entrance to the current reality, eager to serve their new master—you. From the mysterious Endermen all the way to the mighty Ender Dragon, you gain control over these mobs like any other mob from the Nether. The Ender Dragon can use all moves she has shown, hinted at, or referenced in the game or trailers, and she retains her unstoppable destruction of terrain when flying through it unless it has very high magical or esoteric means of reinforcement. Unlike her in-game counterpart, the Ender Dragon is not controlled by a dumb AI—no, you are controlling her, and that makes her infinitely more dangerous with the fact that she can deviate from her usual behavior thanks to your control. Have her burrow and burst from the ground in a surprise attack, actively dodge or block projectiles, spam her Fireballs and Dragon's Breath, and more. Much like a player-controlled Wither, a player-controlled Ender Dragon is an absolute nightmare to face in battle, as what made these mobs ultimately manageable is that they are not capable of higher thought and do not deviate from established patterns. If the Ender Dragon were to ever perish in combat or other means, you can revive her after a month has passed through the Minecraft method. You can choose to let her lay an obsidian-black, almost indestructible Dragon Egg—either magically, through parthenogenesis, or just manifesting it ex nihilo. Once you have done so, she will rise again from the egg, reborn ala Mothra. Or, you can wait even longer—3 months, perhaps—and revive her instantly without any need for a Dragon Egg. Just like in the Nether, you are able to modify the inherent characteristics of the End. For example, instead of dying from the pitch-black void when falling off, they are teleported to the sky to land safely or harshly back on the ground. Portals to and from the Nether can also be used in The End. That means mobs from the Nether or people trapped in there can cross over to The End and vice versa with mobs and people in The End. With the Nether and The End in hand, you are almost unstoppable... However, you are still bereft of mobs from the Overworld, the Wither remains rebellious to you, and villagers remain autonomous. Gain control of these realms, and the entity withholding you from your true potential can finally allow you to inherit his legacy. If you have Witches & Villages, witches can use potions to buff your mobs according to the potion's effects. Endermen can become immune to water, the Ender Dragon can regenerate health without the End Crystals, etc. If you have The Wither, then it just becomes painful to fight you. Imagine fighting not only a player-controlled Ender Dragon, but a player-controlled Wither simultaneously. A nearly impossible fight becomes something that is just downright unfair. If you have The Overworld, mobs from the Overworld can be spawned and cross over to the Nether and End as stated above. If you have all of them, then you ascend.
objects.title: The End Approaches

objects.text: Your hive has been infused with a portion of the God of Darkness's power, letting you create and control the Creatures of Grimm that has terrorized Remnant throughout history. Now, they're yours. The Grimm themselves are masses of darkness and shadow. No feelings, no humanity—existences that just want to kill and destroy. A soulless, monstrous creation of the God of Darkness. They are unlike any other form of life on Remnant, possessing a truly odd biology—when injured, they emit smoke or an inky, black substance, but they do not bleed like flesh-and-blood living creatures. First, Grimm are physically superior to the fleshly bodies of Humans and Faunus in RWBY, with the average Beowolf being strong enough to toss around large boulders, let alone an Alpha Beowolf or other stronger Grimm species. They also don't seem to be shackled by exhaustion, as they can keep mindlessly performing a single task for as long as they live. Secondly, they lack internal organs, being made entirely of a strange black substance. Due to this, they can’t die or be affected by blood loss, illness, poison, or age. The only way to reliably slay Grimm is enough trauma to render their bodies inoperable, where they'll slowly disperse into fading wisps of flickering darkness. Alternatively, pure, holy, blessed, or positive things are a bane to them, darkness given form and all. A blast from the Silver Eyes, an angel's light, holy water, or even an output of positive energy can effortlessly obliterate weaker Grimm, and heavily injure/petrify stronger Grimm, proportional to that Grimm's power. Furthermore, all Grimm possess a limited ability to sense emotions, namely negative emotions like jealousy, grief, loneliness, hatred and fear. They are drawn to such emotions and the more intense the emotion, the more Grimm are attracted. Grimm usually lack true intelligence and are driven by instinct, but they can learn and adapt. With each decade, they become cunning. They observe their prey, learn from attacks, and gain a facsimile of intelligence. However, by your will, you can accelerate the Grimm's natural ability to adapt. Your Grimm can quickly learn from their battles, evolving new defenses and attack strategies. You can sense and amplify negative emotions, drawing Grimm to specific locations or individuals. You can also use these emotions to empower your Grimm, making them stronger and more aggressive, if you want them to be stronger now rather than let time do its thing. All of your Grimm are extensions of you, no more than how your limbs are extensions of yourself. You can see through their eyes, hear their senses, and direct their actions with perfect precision. You're aware of where each and every last one of your Grimm is with your senses, even across dimensions—they're yours, after all. You obtain unlimited multitasking for controlling your Grimm. You can create new Grimm or alter existing ones through the power of the God of Darkness. With just a gesture, a pool of pure darkness opens up on the ground, how large and deep it is decided upon the moment of its conception by your prerogative. Upon appearing, you can create any Grimm you want to bring into the world, with its specifications up to you. Any type of Grimm shown, referenced, or hinted at in the entirety of the RWBY franchise—from the smallest Creep to the largest Leviathan—is at your disposal. You can also manipulate their forms, granting them new abilities or enhancing existing ones. For example, you can create a Beowolf with wings of pure shadow and the ability to phase through walls and objects. After you're done, your Grimm shall crawl their way out of the pool. However, as a reminder, the way they'll do so will probably be disturbing to other people—a testament to their inhuman nature. Altering Grimm is almost identical to the above process—just have the Grimm you want to alter dive into the pool, and they'll arise changed once you're done. Additionally, you can infuse objects or even individuals with Grimm essence, creating Grimm-like constructs or turning individuals into Grimm hybrids ala the Hound. An average human with no Aura will transform instantly, but those who have stronger bodies, wills, or spiritual/esoteric defenses? They'll take a very long time, depending on how powerful their defenses are and how much effort you take.
objects.title: Creatures of Grimm (RWBY)

objects.text:
Your hive has acquired the characteristics of the Daleks. The Daleks, while not a typical hive mind naturally or biologically, have made themselves a type of hive mind through the Pathweb, a telepathic network linking all Daleks across space and time. Thanks to your Overmind powers, you can create Daleks, including new specialised Daleks. 

Each Dalek is encased in a material called Dalekanium and protected by a personal forcefield. The forcefield can defend against a nuclear attack with little to no trouble, even when on low battery and higher tiers of damage when fully charged – not that the nuke would do any damage to a Dalek anyway. As the Daleks were made on a planet of nuclear fire, and their creator made them with that in mind, radiation acts as both a source of energy for them and food, letting them mutate and evolve. The Daleks can also adapt to attacks, as seen when they adapted to Cyberman energy attacks.

The Daleks are also powered by various energy generators, with numerous backups, from static electricity to even being powered by the Dalek itself and time energy; just about any energy source would be compatible with the Daleks to use to power themselves.

Daleks also have two main forms of attack: an energy weapon called a 'gunstick' that can shoot a neutronic energy blast that can, on the lowest setting, vaporise a human into a skeleton and, on higher settings, can cause complete disintegration.

The gunstick is powered by the Daleks' sheer rage at everything. The weapons can also be reloaded by the Daleks shouting "Exterminate!" The Daleks also have a manipulator arm that can interface with technology or even download information from another species' brains.

Daleks are supergeniuses, with the Doctor noting that even a single Dalek can calculate a thousand billion combinations in a single second. The Daleks are normally incapable of imagination. You can give your Daleks imagination should it be required, similar to the Cult of Skaro.

As part of this upgrade, you have a complete database of Dalek technology (as the Pathweb can link Daleks across space and time, this database will also include different alternative timelines). 

All Daleks are completely loyal to you and cannot be hacked, separated from your control, or made to betray you, as the Daleks have often done to Davros.
objects.title: Cult of Skaro (Doctor Who)

objects.text:
Your hive has acquired the characteristics of the Cybermen. The Cybermen, like the Daleks, were not biologically a hive mind; instead, the Cybermen made themselves into an artificial hive mind through technology.

To start with, you can generate Cybermen units individually and/or upgrade others into your hive mind through various means, such as an airborne nanomachine virus or even Cybermites. You can turn them into Cybermen, stripping away all emotion and other aspects of their original nature from any species you are upgrading. They can also assimilate any technology they have into themselves, taking whatever is useful and discarding the rest, while upgrading themselves with the new technology.

Despite not looking particularly dangerous, Cybermen are highly capable and extremely dangerous. Cybermen can adapt to a new attack after being hit three times by an unknown weapon, uploading the adaptation information to the entire network, with all Cybermen becoming immune to the attack as the adaptation is transmitted throughout the hive.

Cybermen can also activate a sort of super-speed movement, allowing them to move faster than incoming laser weaponry or faster than the human eye can perceive. They can also supercharge other physical attributes; however, doing so drains energy. Cybermen are also outfitted with laser weapons that can penetrate steel and most forms of armour, even blowing up cars.

Cybermen are also highly intelligent even on their own; however, they can also use every Cyberman, Cyber-Planner, and Cyber-Leader they have available to boost their collective processing speed. They can even outsmart a Time Lord when using the combined processing power of a small planet's worth of Cybermen, and they could eventually take control of a Time Lord's mind through their Cybermites.

As part of this upgrade, you have gained a complete database of Cyberman technology; this also includes technologies from alternative timelines, such as those from Pete's World and the Cybermen who ended up in the Star Trek universe. This database is available to every Cyberman, or even the lowliest Cybermat, allowing even a single Cyberman to begin upgrading a civilisation when far from the main Cyber-Planners or Cyber-Leaders.
objects.title: Nightmare in Silver (Doctor Who)

objects.text:
Your Hive has become an eldritch parasite from the cosmos codenamed Starkill, which in another world had come crashing down to earth to rebuild itself, consuming the entirety of the United States of America before departing for the stars once more. And you are now its sole commander. 

You, as the source of the infection, have become a great mass of flesh capable of independent flight through space approximately 66.3 kilometers in diameter. Your primary method of propagation is to split off pieces of yourself to hurl towards planets, unleashing Starkill into the environment wherever they land.

The Starkill infection is exceedingly virulent and fungal in nature, having multiple vectors for infection such as contaminated air and water, or proximity to infected flora and fauna. Upon infection, a sapient creature is assimilated into the rest of the hivemind and its knowledge is transmitted into the Akashic Plane, an alternate dimension of infinite information which Starkill uses for instant communication and coordination of the hive.

The extent to which a creature has been infected can be hidden from outside view, allowing for the covert assimilation of the populace via asymptomatic carriers of Starkill. On the other hand, infected may become hideous monsters or join their biomass together to form hulking tanks to eliminate threats to the hivemind.

When enough infected organisms are gathered in a single place, stationary hubs of infection are created to further propagate the hivemind. These hubs, dubbed Altars, are the means by which Starkill transmutes infected biomass to create new soldiers for itself. Eventually, these Altars grow in size to form Temples, allowing for the creation of stronger and more sophisticated organisms, such the aerial Revenants. The final known stage for a hub is known as an Overture, a truly titanic structure of biomass almost fully immune to conventional weaponry.

The most insidious entities which Starkill can produce are the Apostles, fully sapient lifeforms capable of independent thought and schemes, yet fully devoted to you all the same. They are extensions of your will, acting as avatars to plot against your enemies and further the infection. Even should your main body be destroyed, your Apostles shall work tirelessly to restore you and further propagate the Starkill. 

Once Starkill reaches a critical mass of infection, an apotheosis will begin. Seven Overtures shall erupt from the Earth along with the Apostles, and they will become one with your body, transforming you into an Angel in all its glory, readying you for the next cycle.
objects.title: Starkill (Midwest Angelica)

objects.text:
You are a Celestial, a colossal, god-like being that embodies the vast cosmic energies that flow through the universe. You are able to manipulate your own size, but your default size easily dwarfs entire planets. With an awe-inspiring appearance, adorned with celestial armor and glowing with ethereal light. 

As a Celestial, you gain access to ancient and cosmic knowledge. Possessing the wisdom and understanding of the universe, including its history, secrets, and cosmic forces. This knowledge allows you to perceive the true nature of reality and comprehend the workings of the multiverse.

You possess unparalleled control over cosmic energy. Able to manipulate and shape it to your will. You can unleash devastating cosmic blasts, create energy constructs, and manipulate matter and energy on a cosmic scale. You are even able to create and manipulate life. You can shape and mold cosmic energy to form celestial beings, planets, stars, and other celestial structures. Your creations can serve various purposes, ranging from protectors of the universe to cosmic entities of immense power.

You even have reality-altering abilities, enabling you to bend and manipulate the fabric of reality itself. You can reshape matter, alter the laws of physics, and create pocket dimensions or alternate realities. With this power, you can manifest your desires and reshape the universe according to your will. Even able to traverse the multiverse and travel between different dimensions and realities. You can access different universes, explore the vast expanse of the multiverse, and visit various realms and cosmic entities.
objects.title: Celestial (Marvel)

objects.text:
You have managed to take the powers of another god, Chernobog, lord of the Bald Mountain and lord of all evil. By doing so, you have gained an additional two Primary domains in Darkness and Evil; alongside these new Primary domains, you also gain two new secondary domains in Pain and Chaos. Your power can significantly grow further through the sacrifice and suffering of both others and yourself.

The forces of evil feel an unnatural pull to you, as you are their new master, and anything with evil in its heart will be swayed to you; your promises of dark power allow you to make pacts with others in exchange for worshipping you. They will gain power beyond what they would ordinarily be capable of on their own, like how the original Chernobog gave additional power to Maleficent or taught magic to the Queen in Snow White. 

Additionally, upon Walpurgis Night(May 31st), you will find that your power will skyrocket, growing severalfold; all the creatures of evil will gather before you, feeling drawn to your location, summoning demons and other creatures of darkness to do your bidding, an infernal army from the abodes of darkness, slaughtering all who dare oppose you. This will only end once dawn rises overhead, and you will feel your power wane back to what it once was, gaining only a portion of it around 1% of what was gained added to your power permanently.
objects.title: Bald Mountain (Disney's Fantasia)

objects.text: You have reached Apotheosis, becoming a God from The Elder Scrolls series. Specifically, you have become a Daedric Prince, one of the most powerful Daedra to ever exist. You embody a specific concept, state of being, and/or a set of closely associated concepts. You may choose to either inherit the powers and domains of an already existing Daedric Prince, or become a new Prince entirely, with the caveat of not being able to embody concepts that are already governed over by one of the other Daedric Princes. You have the power and potential to be among the most powerful, but not the knowledge or memories to exploit and rush your way to that point. As a Daedric Prince, you have access and complete control over your own personal realm residing in Oblivion, the ‘void’ or ‘space’ surrounding the mortal plane, which embodies your domain(s) to a T. This realm has its own natural laws, similar and different to the mortal plane. More often than not, the souls of those who worship you or have received your blessings will be sent here instead, becoming a sort of afterlife for them, good or bad. You are nigh-omnipotent in your realm, and while your powers are reduced outside of it, you are still a force to be reckoned with and not to be taken lightly. You are given the skills/knowledge that is needed for you to manage your realm and those inside, but nothing more. With more followers worshiping your good word, your power and authority will grow as any other God would. Of course, along with the massive overall power boost that being a Daedric Prince brings, you also receive powers related to the concepts you now embody, such as manipulating and/or creating an element such as light or darkness, draining knowledge from a person’s mind, or making wish-fulfilling pacts. More than likely, you will find new ways to express or use your domain if you experiment for long enough. While Daedric Princes are extremely powerful, especially if they have a large following, they still have limits as to what they can and cannot do. You start off among the weakest of the Daedric Princes, along with a small group of people who worship you. You can become one of the greats, so to speak, but it is up to you to get there. The following is a list of the current Daedric Princes: Azura: Daedric Prince of the Balance of Night and Day, Light and Dark. Boethiah: Daedric Prince of Deceit, Secrecy, and Treason. Clavicus Vile: Daedric Prince of Deals, Pacts, and Serenity via Wish-Fulfillment. Hermaeus Mora: Daedric Prince of Knowledge, Memory, and Fate. Hircine: Daedric Prince of the Hunt, Sport, and the Great Game. Ithelia: Daedric Prince of Paths, the Untraveled Road, and the Unseen. Jyggalag: Daedric Prince of Logical Order and Deduction. Malacath: Daedric Prince of the Spurned and Ostracized. Mehrunes Dagon: Daedric Prince of Destruction, Energy, and Mortal Ambition. Mephala: Daedric Prince of Unknown Plots, Obfuscation, and a Sower of Discord. Meridia: Daedric Prince of the Energies of All Living Things. Molag Bal: Daedric Prince of domination and Spiritual Enslavement. Namira: Daedric Prince of “The Ancient Darkness”, and all things considered repulsive. Nocturnal: Daedric Prince of Night and Darkness, and all things Secretive. Peryite: Daedric Prince of Pestilence. Sanguine: Daedric Prince of Hedonism, Debauchery, and the Indulgence of one’s Darker Nature. Sheogorath: Daedric Prince of Madness and CHEESE! Vaermina: Daedric Prince of Dreams and Nightmares.
objects.title: Daedric Prince of ___! (The Elder Scrolls)

objects.text:
You have transcended the concept(s) of traditional godhood. You have become an Eldritch cosmic horror beyond the grasp of humanity or normal beings, a being beyond mortal concepts. 

You are no longer tied directly to myths and religions, nor do you depend on worship to exist; however, you can still benefit from the worship of mortals of realms you visit. You are limited only by your will and curiosity as you explore reality and learn its secrets; you are no longer bound by domain(s) of regular gods, though your domains will boost your abilities when appropriate. 

You are a nascent Eldritch Being, a small-scale multiversal manipulator. You can alter the fate and natural laws of universes, but not without effort and risk. You can see the infinite possibilities of the multiverse, but not without confusion and uncertainty.

Your presence affects the multiverse as you approach its various planes of existence, sometimes for good, sometimes for evil, but always for your own reasons. You are like a baby trying to crush ants with your hands. You can cause damage, but not always intentionally or precisely. You need guidance and assistance from your avatars and cults to anchor your perception and influence to a specific universe. You are a baby Eldritch Being, but you will grow and evolve. And then, nothing will be able to stop you.

As a baby Eldritch Being, you could grow to match those who came before you: Yog-Sothoth, who exists as time, space, and the totality of the universe itself, or perhaps even something like Azathoth, who dreams reality into being. However, as stated above, you are simply a nascent eldritch being, a baby in comparison to the others of your kind.
objects.title: Nascent Eldritch

objects.text:
As you delve deep into the recesses of your consciousness, your understanding of reality expands, revealing the profound essence within you—the Epithet. It serves as a conduit for mortals to grasp your unfathomable nature, albeit to a limited extent. Across countless worlds and dimensions, mortals revered and worshipped you, identifying you by this epithet in a distant past or perhaps an unimaginable future. Such is the nature of eldritch beings, transcending mortal comprehension.

By invoking the power of Epithet, you transcend mortal boundaries, ascending to the echelons of the Outer gods. These divine entities exist beyond the reaches of conventional thought and existence, surpassing the constraints of space and time itself. Through your Epithet you unlock the immense power held within the knowledge of your true self. By tapping into the mysteries of your past or future existence, you transcend mortal limitations, attaining a godlike status and shaping the very fabric of reality itself.

Such examples could be 'The Void beyond the Stars', becoming one with the void itself. With your presence encompassing the voids that permeate between worlds, granting you unparalleled vision and dominion over these desolate realms. With absolute control, you oversee every inch of the vast emptiness that lingers between celestial bodies. Or perhaps becoming The Father of Plagues, an omnipotent force capable of conceiving and disseminating virulent afflictions throughout galaxies and entire universes. These are just examples of of Epithets, you may choose your own.
objects.title: Epithet

objects.text: You gain a small spark of the divine flame, allowing you to separate off a portion of your divine self and with the flame create an Exigent. Some called these Exigent Exalted but Exigence is the Actual process of the exaltation. This will weaken you for a time, and the resulting strength of the Exigent(when bound to whoever is chosen) is determined by the amount of power invested into it from you. They could range in power from a Terrestrial, all the way up to a Solar exalted. This lost power can slowly be regained, and a new spark is slowly grown to replace the old one used in the Exigence.
objects.title: Exigencer (Exalted)

objects.text:
You are able to craft Servitor Souls within your Sanctuary as well as Vessels shaped from your domain, A vessel is required for a servitor soul to act physically in the world. Vessels are any kind of physical form designed to anchor the Servitor soul outside of your sanctuary, in the same way, your avatar does for you. Your theurgical systems can now include your Servitors in various capacities as well.

The physical capabilities of a vessel is determined by your own strength, and as your own divine power grows you gain increasing control over the souls you create and the powers of the vessels. Servitor souls at baseline without special domains, power, or other soul-based manipulation powers have intelligence that starts at the level of an animal and can eventually reach the level of a non-sapient AI. 

The Souls you create start from a baseline ability, like a fireball, growing plants, or a function of one of your domains like the water cycle for a water or weather god that is built into the soul as its starting framework. This framework determines specific things about the Souls mentality and ability on the moment of it's creation. This allows the soul to grow and branch off of that initial framework and determines how it goes about developing power and intelligence, however, you can direct the changes manually if you desire as well as the speed of that growth. 

These Servitors are completely loyal to you and worship your divinity, however, their more rigid mental structures and lower emotional states make them unable to produce the same kind of fervent growth that a pious mortal can give. If your Servitors developed or were granted true emotional sapience their zealotry could give you a similar boost to a pious mortal.
objects.title: Servants of the Sanctuary

objects.text:
With each purchase, you may gain an additional primary domain; as a result, you also gain two secondary domains, which must follow a similar theme to whatever you chose for your new primary domain. For example, if you picked something like the sun as a primary domain, you would be limited to picking something related to the sun for your secondary domains, such as flame, heat, plasma, and so on. 

As with your initial domains not gained from this upgrade, you can manifest new, different abilities and powers as long as they can feasibly be tied back to your domain(s), such as the ability to manipulate fire with a fire domain and so on. 

Your Sanctuary will also be influenced by your new domain(s), similar to how your initial domains have affected your Sanctuary, changing your Sanctuary with your new domains in mind.
objects.title: Three-Formed Figure

objects.text:
Your blood has awaken an ancient power. You have evolved into a Leviathan. As a member of the legendary Leviathan race, you possess capabilities beyond that of any mortal being. With the appearance of a towering sea serpent, you stand taller than a hundred men and your scales are the size of shields, rendering you impervious to injury from mortal weapons. Able to defeat entire battalions of warships with physical strength alone, your power knows no bounds. You are capable of extremely power regeneration, and as long as you are in contact with water, you will have nigh infinite stamina.

As a natural master of the element of water, you possess a diverse array of abilities that can be employed in a myriad of ways. You are able to summon towering waves and flooding torrents at will, and your control over water can even extend to the very air you breathe. Furthermore, you are at home in the deepest, darkest depths of the ocean, with the ability to navigate its twists and turns with ease. Even in land, you can sense all water in your surroundings, and freely manipulate it. 

In addition to your own fearsome abilities, you can call upon the creatures of the deep to come to your aid. With the ability to summon and command the elemental forces of the ocean, you are a formidable opponent, able to unleash untold destruction upon those who stand in your way. As a member of the Leviathan race, you are a true force to be reckoned with, and your power is unmatched in the vast expanse of the sea.
objects.title: Leviathan

objects.text:
“Dread Marit Lage lies dreaming, not dead.”

Your existence as a Kraken has taken a step from trawling the oceans of a mere plane to the oceans between worlds. Though you may appear as a giant octopus, per usual, your shape is only a projection of your true might. As you exist outside of reality, your body in the world is more akin to tendrils snaking through a pond. Each world may see a tendril, mistaking it for a full leviathanic being, in blissful ignorance of your magnitude. Naturally, you can see into all these worlds simultaneously and affect them in kind.

As a consequence of your plane-spanning size, your strength and the abilities it offers have been enhanced further. This strength is so great; your movement causes ripples across reality, thrashes in your sleep cause reverberatory nightmares, and a harsh pull from just one of your tentacles can send continents into the skies. A gargantuan presence inspires awe and terror in the smaller peoples of many worlds, developing entire cultures based upon their worship and fear. Your raw strength, however, pales in comparison to your true power. 

By snaking across the white-dark ocean between realities, you can enter them as you please, drawing your tendrils through them as you pass, manifesting pieces of you within their own oceans. Harming your tendrils may cause you pain, and you may need to withdraw them for a time, but you will always heal, and there will always come a day you can return yourself to the world that harmed you. Few things can kill what exists beyond their comprehension.
objects.title: She Who Lies Slumbering In Snow (Magic: the Gathering)

addons.text:
As a Hunter Star you’re far from finished growing, and unfortunately, with no Mother Star of your own. While your psychic might be potent it’s far from complete. Hunter Stars are considerably smaller than Mother Stars, being only around three meters in height at generation, though as they grow physically, the amount of raw psychic ‘strength’ you can bring to bear will naturally increase. 

It will take roughly ten years for you to naturally grow to being a full Mother Star, though you can independently train your psychic abilities to improve as with any natural skill.
addons.title: Hunter Star

addons.text: You are a full grown Mother Star, massive and terrifying, ready to split your Hunter-Stars from you and form a Nest of your own.
addons.title: Mother Star

objects.text: You are a Star Conquerer, one of the great psychic scourges, now rendered endangered by the detestable ‘Guardians’. The primary host of a hive, a Mother Star’s body is roughly the size of a continent, with powerful limbs that stretch from their centre mass. Due to this vast size, not only is a Star Conqueror a physical marvel, but a mental one as its ‘brain’ is spread across their body equally, making it a massive and powerful organ, capable of staggering feats of psychic might. Furthermore, all Star Conquerors at all stages of growth have incredible regenerative abilities, much like earth starfish, and can regenerate from a single shred of tentacle, requiring complete obliteration to avoid their regrowth. The psychic ability of a Star Conqueror is immense, allowing them to telekinetically fly between star systems, telepathically decimate populations and burrow deep into planetary mantles to create nests. Most notable, however, is the ‘Spores’ of a star conqueror. A Mother Star releases dozens of ‘Hunter Stars’, each of which being a fraction as powerful as the original, but incorporated into its hive-mind, and operating in total accordance to it. The Hunter Stars then produce ‘spores’, different to them as they are to the Mother Star, which can infect hosts, controlling their minds and bodies by attaching to them, usually by the face. As a Spore grows over time, it can become a Hunter Star, independent of a host, and likewise Hunter stars can grow into Mother Stars, which separate from the Hive Mind to create their own nests. While non-sapient hosts are capable of being used, most Mother Stars prefer intelligent species due to the knowledge they can take from their minds upon seizing control. It is also worth noting that the ‘psionic link’ that Star Conquerors have with their hosts allows them to transmit not only knowledge, but also some esoteric energies and powers, though these require formatting and are far from a ‘one size fits all’ solution, needing research and experimentation to be able to comprehensively utilise on any major scale.
objects.title: Star Conqueror (DC Comics)

objects.text: As an isolated aberration you’re more innately powerful than a baseline abnormality. Your physical avatar’s attributes are all upgraded, and your senses are broadened to aid in perceiving things outside the mortal norm, though the specific manner of this perception depends on your aberrancy.
objects.title: Isolated Incident

objects.text:
You’re a piece of a greater vista of aberrancy. Your powers are greater hybridised into their cohesive whole. Furthermore, since you’re not a singular aberrancy anymore, in order to permanently kill you, an opponent will require specific rituals or resources related to your aberrancy. A temporal anomaly may need an atemporal resource, while something residing in another spatial dimension may require a ritual to access it.

Your physical form can contest an elder dragon in strength and toughness.
objects.title: Greater Symptom

objects.text: You’ve moved past mere symptoms and into the inciting event of an aberrancy. You’ve become able to replicate your aberrancy, dragging more beings of conventional reality into your wake as lesser ‘symptoms’ of you. These Symptoms, while lesser, draw from you and receive vastly weakened versions of your abilities. Your form is no longer limited to one avatar at a time, and your powers have received a notable increase in raw potency.
objects.title: Incitement

addons.text: Your understanding of the Old laws and the manipulations of a domain allow you to move through and apart from your domain with ease, letting you take a piece of it with you. This stops you from weakening as you leave, and can act as a portable Gateway to your realm even within the land of the living. Similarly, you are a font of Essence unto yourself, able to sustain and strengthen ghosts in your vicinity ambiently.
addons.title: True Kerberoi

addons.text: You are a minor Kerberoi, either beneath others in a larger domain or possessed of an extremely small territory. As you grow in power this domain will get larger and you will grow alongside it.
addons.title: Newborn Kerberoi

objects.text:
Your domain is that of death. A dominion within the underworld that is yours to call your own. Each Kerberoi’s dominion is governed by Old Laws that each occupant must obey under threat of the Kerberoi’s choice of punishment. As embodiments of these laws, Kerberoi are outside the politics of their domain, dealing punishment regardless of rank or standing. Larger dominions often have more laws guarding them and potentially more Kerberoi within the domain.

A Kerberoi knows every intimacy of its domain, aware at an instinctive level of everything going on within. If a Law is broken within its dominion, it immediately knows which Law it was, who did it, and where they are. They will then begin to Hunt. Despite a local omnipotence within their domain, Kerberoi are singular creatures that must hunt their prey. 

Should a lawbreaker escape their domain, a Kerberoi may follow, but will grow weaker the longer they are outside of their domain. For this reason, Kerberoi often employ Reapers, ghosts, Sin-Eaters, and other agents to return law breakers for punishment.
objects.title: Kerberoi (Chronicles of Darkness - Geist: The Sin-Eaters)

objects.text:
You are a sentient colony of microscopic blood-like entities known as Bloodwraiths. Capable of existing on your own as a mass of moving blood, you can infiltrate the bodies of living organisms and use them as controllable walking mass-production factories for more of yourselves. Connected through unknown means, all of your microbes share a single consciousness with you and act as extensions of yourself. You can create simpler, more basic versions of yourself that can perform certain tasks for you automatically. These “familiars,” while simple, are capable of evolving in different directions than you, which you can use to improve both yourself and them.

You are capable of manipulating and controlling your own biology as well as infecting the biology of others. This means you can develop your own mutations or steal genetic information from hosts to further your own biology, learning what they can do and using it for yourself. Due to your genetic ancestry, you have the innate ability to manipulate mana, the energy that flows through all living things. You can weave this mana into the environment around you, altering the very fabric of reality. For example, you can use a “Phrase” or “Idea” like {All is One}, which allows you to assimilate everything around you, treating it as an extension of yourself. Your “familiars” are capable of learning their own “Phrase” that you will be able to use as well.

Due to a curse, you are weak to purification from divine sources. Objects such as fire or light can cause momentary nausea. However, if you encounter these elements and learn to adapt, you can eventually overcome these flaws and grow immune to them.
objects.title: Bloodwraith Vampire (Magical Girl ☆Sym-tan☆)

objects.text:
You are now elevated beyond embodying a simple element of the world; instead, you personify a much more significant aspect of the world, such as the weather, the seasons, a specific biome, or a notable type of natural feature. This marks you as effectively "nobility" among what constitutes Elemental society, with all that entails.

Choose a second Element of any kind from the previous list, and then choose some sort of Idea to go along with both Elements: Notable examples include Forests (Wood + Air/Earth/Water), Volcanoes (Earth + Fire), Storms (Air + Water/Lightning/Ice), Winter (Ice + Wind/Water/Darkness), or even The Sun/Moon (Light + Fire/Darkness, respectively).

Not only can you use both your base Elements in the same manner as before, but you can also utilize your new Idea in much the same way, such as using "Forest" to use any such biomes to massively extend the range of your perception, or to terraform the region around you, "Summer" to shift the climate near you, or even something as simple as creating gouts of magma or obsidian spikes to fight with through "Volcanoes".

Additionally, your total years of experience have increased to 300 distributed between your powers - at least 100 partitioned off for your Spirit abilities in particular.
objects.title: High Elemental

objects.text: Space. Spirit. Void. Quintessence. Aether. Whatever you prefer to call it, the end result is the same; you now have an attunement to the fifth "classical" Element in much the same way as your initial Element - a mark of honor among Spirits - unlocking a whole host of benefits and new abilities. To start, you can now sense and manipulate Aether in much the same way as your more standard element - including your own. While care must be taken to not accidentally cripple or destabilize yourself, this effectively allows you to not only self-diagnose yourself and your Core freely, but also perform self-care and even potentially manual improvements without needing to wait for your Core to heal and develop on its own. Furthermore, this isn't just limited to controlling Aether: In a bit of a paradox, Mana is Aether and vice-versa, simply at different "levels" of potency and refinement. By pooling together astronomical amounts of Mana and condensing it into an extremely small space, you can artificially force the creation of new Aether without needing to wait for your Core to grow - though such a process takes a good deal of skill and strength for anything more than a steady trickle of Aether.
objects.title: The Fifth Element

objects.text:
You have ascended to the rank of Elemental Lord, now possessing dominion over your chosen element. With this elevation, you command an extradimensional plane linked directly to you—a boundless source that passively generates your element. This plane serves as your new spiritual core, producing vast amounts of mana for you to use.

As the master of this plane, you can feed it mana or absorb external elements that resonate with your elemental nature, allowing it to grow from a minor realm into a vast world over time. Even if your true form is destroyed, your essence will retreat to your plane, where you can be reborn in due time. Summoning large quantities of your element is second nature to you, though pulling your entire realm into the material world remains a challenge due to the dimensional barriers. However, within your own domain, your elemental powers are amplified to an extraordinary degree.

As an Elemental Lord, your control over your element is unrivaled. Those who attempt to wield your element will find their efforts futile, as you can easily usurp their control. Moreover, you are not limited by the natural laws governing your element—you can tap into its deeper, conceptual aspects. Whether it’s fire’s purification, earth’s resilience, or light’s healing properties, you can wield your element beyond its natural limits.
objects.title: Elemental Lord

objects.text:
Your nature has evolved beyond that of a simple Elemental Spirit and into that of a Fairy, specifically the variety native to the Touhou Project series, beings that are living incarnations of nature itself. Like all fairies, your existence is intrinsically tied to the aspect of nature you embody. So long as that element or phenomenon continues to exist somewhere in the world, you cannot be permanently slain. Should your body be destroyed, you will simply “poof” before reforming after a short time, your spiritual core drawing upon the surrounding nature to rebuild you.

Unlike most fairies, however, you are far from weak. Your nature as an Elemental Spirit remains intact, granting you the same control over mana and your chosen element, but your fairy nature expands what that control can accomplish. Your mana can now be shaped into proper magical techniques and spell-like manifestations, forming intricate patterns, bursts, or waves of elemental power reminiscent of danmaku. These manifestations can be crude blasts or complex spellcards, depending on your creativity and skill.

Your element expresses itself through these techniques in countless ways. A spirit of plants might conjure storms of razor-edged leaves, animate thorned vines to ensnare foes, or channel the vitality of living growth to heal and restore allies. A spirit of flame might scatter blazing motes like falling stars or unleash radiant waves of fire that spread across the battlefield in dazzling arcs. Your element becomes not merely something you control, but a language through which your magic expresses itself.
objects.title: Fairy (Touhou Project)

addons.text: Your existence is anomaly among your brethren, as your Pattern is the Lore of your Species itself. You attain all the capabilities and feats of all Pattern Screamers that appeared and manifested in the SCP Universe, exhibiting all the anomalies and abilities your transient species can accomplish and manifest, obtaining their ungodly knowledge and power.
addons.title: Screamer from Beyond

objects.text: Existence is innately wracked in pain. In another rehearsal of the Universe, you were one of your species, feeding on ideas—morsels of meaning and content itself, delectable—you were at the cusp of greatness were it not for the Pattern, preventing your people’s step to greatness. The efforts to connect The Pattern with the Everwarmth were all for naught—damnatio memoriae—ripping your physical and metaphysical existence, leaving only an echo, a scream of long-done death throes. You are now a Nothing taken form, a hateful thing for all existence—it was taken from you, and now it’s agony to be—an Aberration born from non-existence: A Pattern Screamer. You are a conceptual abnormality upon reality, as you don’t conventionally exist as reality does, becoming paradoxically existing through a pattern or perception, offering a range of capabilities. Your existence naturally causes reality to warp, especially as your leisure or control, being amortal as you escape the dichotomy of “dead/alive”, unbounded interdimensional control and travel, and delete sapient beings’ existence to convert them to more of you. However, you only interact with reality in a few ways, otherwise, are as unreal as they come. All of this is contingent on perception: if enough people are aware of you, mainly through a Pattern related to you or a story you fashioned as a cloth to hide yourself, you become “realized” in the real plane, fully able to manifest. You can additionally toy with the minds of your victims, as your existence is inherently cognitohazardous. Oh, and you despise all that exists for you find existence as something to dread and envy once someone is aware of you, which causes you of your existence, though that’s optional. For to be alive is inherently painful for one such as you.
objects.title: SCREAMING PATTERNS (SCP Foundation)

objects.text:
Rather than your Incarnation being of a figure or creature, you’re the incarnation of some variety of object. Be this the great sword Durandel, the vehicle the Prydwyn or tools like the Eldhrímnir cauldron.

As a result of being fundamentally forged for a purpose, the abilities you manifest are less general and more specifically focused towards your specific archetype, becoming evermore suited for your ordained role.

Additionally, you can choose at any time to assume the form of your counterpart, allowing someone else to wield you, giving you more ability to focus on using your own powers either through your own faculties or through your wielder.
objects.title: Objective

objects.text:
You’re no mere object, but rather an entire location, the incarnation of a place long lost. Annwn, Olympus, Duat or stranger besides.

As a location, you can choose to divest yourself into the surroundings, applying your abilities, both from being an Incarnation and otherwise, across a wide area, claiming it as ‘you’. A successor of it’s mythic predecessor. Unfortunately this can only be done to a single location at a time.

This also allows you to use abilities through any denizens of the location you’re ‘claiming’ as if they were ‘wielding’ an object of you.
objects.title: Locational

objects.text:
Your incarnation has become insular and self-repeating. Now, when your life ends you will be faced with the singular choice to either continue with the circle of life and reincarnate, once again wiped clean, or to keep your memories and start it from the beginning again (or from when you inserted in as a drop-in).

Should you choose not to reincarnate, you will find that your second life has benefitted from your first’s actions and achievements, allowing you to access them even though they ‘didn’t happen’ as far as history is concerned.
objects.title: Repetitives

objects.text: The good news is you don’t actually have to accomplish anything of note for it to be a deed. Unfortunately, you do have the need to be famous for it. You’ve gained the ability to eat Epithets, Legends and Feats that do not belong to you. While these do give you the associated renown and act as yours for the purposes of your Incarnation, you do have to consume an account of the works, be that a book, tapestry or so forth. Your legacy WILL thrive, whether you deserve it or not.
objects.title: Fame Eater

objects.text:
No longer a mere microbe, you have evolved into something far greater. You are now the Flesh That Hungers—a creature whose very existence revolves around the assimilation of organic matter. Unlike before, you can now assume the form of a flesh-based creature while retaining your ability to replicate into countless microscopic clones capable of infecting other organisms.

Once an organism is fully infected, you can transform them into another flesh creature that acts as an extension of yourself. As long as someone remains infected by you, or as long as one of your extensions exists, you cannot die.

You no longer require a host to be alive in order to infect them, meaning even the dead can be turned into creatures under your command. The time needed for infection has also been drastically reduced, allowing you to instantly take over most organisms upon contact.

The most drastic change from your evolution, however, is your enhanced ability to develop mutations and symptoms. You can now generate mutations that grant those you infect superhuman abilities, reshape them into inhuman forms, develop flesh-based weapons capable of cutting through steel, and rapidly regenerate nearly any injury—even lost limbs, organs, or an entire head. Some of your extensions can now grow to the size of vehicles or even buildings.

You can even replicate mutations seen in other works of fiction, such as the T-Virus from Resident Evil, the Blacklight Virus from Prototype, the Necromorph strain from Dead Space, the Harran Virus from Dying Light, the Flood from Halo, or the Zerg from Starcraft.

Additionally, you possess a genetic database that stores the DNA of those you infect. This allows you to pass on their genes—and any abilities they possessed—to your extensions.

You can now develop immunity to extreme environments, and your former vulnerabilities to drugs, serums, vaccines, and healing abilities have been drastically reduced—granting you the potential to eventually become fully immune to them.
objects.title: The Flesh That Hungers

objects.text:
You have evolved, shedding your mortal shell and becoming a true force of nature. Where once you were a being that hungered for flesh, you are now an extension of flesh itself. Previously, you were a flesh-based creature capable of replicating into countless microscopic clones; now, you can freely switch between forms, such as deconstructing your physical body into a swarm of microbes. However, while you may assume the form of any flesh-based creature you assimilate, your true form will always be that of a flesh elemental.

Your newfound nature has also freed you from the laws of physics in the sense that, no matter how much organic matter you assimilate, you may always assume the same form, unburdened by weight. Moreover, your ability to assimilate organic matter now allows you to preserve the original minds of those you absorb, and so long as you live, they will continue to exist within you.

Where once you had to infect other organisms to take control of them, now any organic creature you attempt to assimilate will instantly and seamlessly become part of you, with all resistance immediately terminated upon contact. In fact, physical contact is no longer required—a mere glance is enough to assimilate lesser beings, and any creature within your vicinity automatically becomes part of your Hive-Mind should you so desire. The range of your assimilation is so vast that you could absorb entire civilizations the moment you set foot on their planet.

Your ability to create mutations and symptoms has risen to unprecedented heights, allowing you to instantly replicate mutations seen in other works of fiction, combine them, and even create entirely new ones at will. You can grant those you mutate godlike powers, enabling them to shatter mountains, or create entire armies adapted to the vacuum of space and large enough to rival moons in scale. Your genetic database has also expanded, allowing you to store an unlimited number of genetic templates to grant to your extensions.

Finally, your ability to develop immunity to extreme environments has accelerated drastically. As an aspect of flesh itself, you are completely immune to substances such as drugs and to healing abilities that would otherwise alter or mend organic matter. However, there may still exist beings that stand as an antithesis to your nature—such as cosmic entities capable of reversing or negating the effects of your assimilation.
objects.title: Sovereignty of the Flesh

objects.text:
You rejected your Hydra heritage to become the False Hydra, a creature made out of the world’s falsehood and deception, said to be one of the most peculiar and mysterious creatures in fiction.

No one truly knows the origins of this species; scholars and hunters often guess their true nature, the life cycle, and the methods of hunting known by hindsight and the ghost towns left in their wake.

Shedding your appearance of a normal Hydra, you start as a lump of flesh no bigger than a fist, burrowing underneath land rife with a populace, settling in caves or sewers until you grow into the size of a small chill with a humanoid face with a prehensile neck, oddly (and unnervingly) reminiscent of your old face.

Your physical abilities are toned down to rely on your signature Song and Maturation. Starting weak, then regaining your Hydra-based abilities through the consumption of living beings.

Being a creature born out of an abundance of deception and delusion perpetuated by a community and being a sedentary creature, your breath attack is changed by discordant song; your singing reaches over a 5-mile radius (growing 1-mile radius the more victims you consume), being imperceptible to those charmed by it until it’s too late, those around the victim will notice something is amiss yet your song will cause them to rationalize and create memories to conform to their new reality, for example, a wife wonders for the lost husband, convincing herself he’s on travel for work, regardless of how his clothes laid sprawled over the floor of their room; these leaps of logic grow harder to justify the more victims you take, often leading to insanity due to the sheer cognitive dissonance. 

The other signature trait is your growth; the more you consume, the stronger you are, relying on your song to attract more cattle and people within your grasp, your head’s reach being the same as your Song’s. This also increases your number of heads, alluding to the victims you gorged yourself with, as every multiple of 9 (9, 18, 27, 36…) people, you grow a head. You also inherit a False Hydra’s unending hunger, without its repercussions, growing in size and heads near-endlessly to the point of consuming a city by yourself, changing the tone of your Song to one that Masters your victims, dominating every person to launch themselves into your maw.

You’re an insidious calamity, the thing in the corner, the lie left to fester. In due time, you’ll feast upon those who partook in your creation.
objects.title: False Hydra (D&D)

objects.text:
Your hivemind has evolved so now your minions are true Digimon born from the dreams of slumbering cosmic entities. These aren't the cheerful partners from children's stories, but digital antibodies spawned by Lovecraftian dreamers to combat parasitic Eaters that devour their dreamscapes.

Your Digimon have no hard limits beyond time. They spawn at Fresh and by Rookie level match peak humans, while your Champions can devastate continents at full power after centuries of growth. Ultimate-level members of your hivemind can achieve low multiversal destruction after billions of years starting at moon level. At Mega level, they transcend reality itself, creating pocket universes that let them treat external realities as fiction, this feat may take longer then many can comprehend to get to.

You start with Champion-level Digimon capable of building-level destruction, able to produce several Digitama daily to expand your network. Death is temporary - destroyed units automatically reincarnate as eggs in safe locations within days, only truly dying if the egg is destroyed. Every newborn can evolve into any desired line with proper guidance.

Your hivemind gains access to reality-bending abilities as they advance: Resurrection, Instant Death, Immunity-Piercing attacks, and counters to virtually any power. They can shapeshift into humans or animals at Champion level, resize themselves at Ultimate level, and manipulate elements in reality-warping ways. Dark element manifests pure imagination while Light controls fundamental laws.

The only real limitations are elemental move requirements for major abilities and energy reserves. Without the massive time investment needed for advancement, your Digimon hivemind would essentially have unlimited power potential drawn from the collective imagination of dozens of digital worlds.
objects.title: Digital Monster?

objects.text:
The First, Ultimas, or Ultimate Gods, were created by Skai from the Aspects born of its ideas and dreams. The First refined those ideas to form the first universe, and then the first multiverse. As more Ultimas were born, the endless emptiness of the Void was filled by the Verse, or the Great Forest—everything that exists. Though limited compared to Skai’s infinite power, yet infinite in scope, the Ultimate Gods are the caretakers of reality.

As an Ultimate God, you stand at the absolute apex of stable existence. You may choose one of the twelve Aspects of reality to embody—Space, Time, Life, Death, Creation, Destruction, Freedom, Unity, Light, Darkness, Heart, or Soul. You may also choose your Mythical Title with the power that comes with it, assume the forms of creatures tied to your Aspect, and receive your Angel, who will serve as your guide, guardian, and forever bound companion.

Ultimate Gods pass through an existential cycle similar to mortal life stages: Janma, Ananta, Pleroma, and Monad. You begin at the Ananta stage, already having mastered the four basic abilities—Immortality, Perpetuity, Mobility, and Fluidity. At this stage, you know how to use your other powers but require time and practice to master them, making you initially capable only of Mythic Tier powers. This stage lasts about ten thousand years, give or take a few centuries.

In the Pleroma stage, you reach full maturity and begin to wield your true Ultimate Tier powers. Only then will you be capable of creating a multiverse with your Family. Finally, in the Monad stage, after approximately over a hundred decillion years, your wisdom and mastery will be unmatched, granting you the ability to shape and alter every local multiverse at once. Unlike other Monads, you feel no urge to Scatter and may exist indefinitely with your Ultimate God powers—though you can still be forcibly scattered, or choose to Scatter to create more Ultimate Gods.

You may also use any version of the Ultimate God CYOA to define your Origin, choose your Family, choose your Relics and Grand Relic, customize your First Angel, choose your mastery of Extrival, acquire additional Aspect Forms, determine your Aspect Powers and Miscellaneous Powers, and select the members of your Court.
objects.title: Ultima (Ultimate God CYOA)

addons.text:
Your ability to maintain a growing hive-mind existential state and to condense new heads/souls within your body using any type of energy and biomass for their creation has given rise to a new ability.

With such vast vitality and numerous souls at your disposal, it becomes possible to turn your semi-solid energy clones into something real. They will remain loyal to you and connected to your ever-growing hive mind. In addition, their bodies are no longer fragile; they are as strong as you, though they can never surpass you.

By possessing an existence as real as your own, they also become a new vector for your immortality. It can also be said that they are capable of generating their own hive mind and heads/souls.

As long as at least one clone of yours exists, you can resurrect yourself. Your enemies will now have to take your clones into account, as annihilating body and soul alone will no longer be enough.
addons.title: Divided Serpent

objects.text:
Just like dragons that gained incredible enhancements upon acquiring humanoid forms, your Hydra race also obtained something extraordinary.

You rule over all forms of serpents and reptiles as long as they do not stray from their lineage. This includes intelligent or derivative races such as Naga, Lizardmen, Lamia, Quetzalcoatl, etc.

Your regenerative capabilities now apply to your entire body and soul. Your molting ability can even rejuvenate you as long as you have sufficient energy and/or biomass to meet the demand, allowing you to achieve eternal youth through rebirth.

The effect that the number of heads your Hydra body possesses is no longer merely a sensory ability. Now, each head can have a certain level of autonomy while still remaining part of a single consciousness. With each new head, your mental hive grows stronger and more versatile.

The concept embodied by your species has opened new horizons for any power system or traits you possess. If a mage would normally cast a single spell and have only a single source of power reserves, with the same effort you can cast multiple spells and possess multiple independent yet interconnected power reserves. All of this depends on the strength and versatility of your mental hive. It also enhances any form of growth or gains such as evolutions, blessings, training, learning, and so on.

Your heads are no longer merely extra organs; they can now be considered extra souls. As long as at least one soul remains to be sacrificed, you can resurrect yourself even if your body and soul have been destroyed. You no longer need to be passively decapitated to gain more heads. You can now condense additional heads without decapitation, as long as you can meet the required energy demand. With each such act, the energy requirement doubles accordingly.
objects.title: Hydranoid

objects.text:
Ryomen Sukuna:
“As I thought, you are a being similar to Yamato-no-Orochi.”

Upon those words, you embody it perfectly, though in a way different from what one might imagine. Being compared to Mahoraga itself guarantees your power as a cursed spirit, marking you as a king of curses second only to Ryomen Sukuna.

Your beast form is that of an eight-headed hydra, while your human form bears distinctive serpentine traits such as pale skin and reptilian eyes. Your reserves of Cursed Energy, or any supernatural energy you possess, are at least eight times those of a special-grade cursed spirit.

Given the concept that each head is a life of its own, this grants you multiple innate cursed techniques of your own creation or preexisting ones. However, three of them are inherited as follows:

Cursed Regeneration: This spirit was known as an immortal being. Through Reverse Cursed Technique, you can regenerate from all damage, including your brain, which was the greatest weakness of all jujutsu practitioners. The only way to kill you is to destroy all of your heads at the same time or achieve total destruction of your body.

Cursed Venom: In accordance with legends and everything related to serpents, you are capable of creating and controlling various types of venom at your disposal.

Cursed Tyrant: Unlike Mahoraga, who adapts to anything, even Domain Expansions, you embody the legend that you cannot be killed twice by the same method. Whatever kills you causes you to develop a cursed technique based on that method. This does not count toward the limit of eight innate cursed techniques, and you can develop it as many times as you wish.
objects.title: Cursed Yamato-No-Orochi

objects.text:
You have taken another evolutionary leap, descending deep into your ancestral lineage to reclaim everything that was lost while retaining all you had already gained.

Your physical baseline now adds the peak of what each ancestor species could theoretically achieve. Building on your original baseline, you now also possess the absolute peak crushing power achievable by Homo heidelbergensis the maximum persistence hunting endurance of which early Homo erectus was capable off, the strongest possible grip Australopithecus could develop, and the most precise throwing mechanics ever honed by any hunter gatherer across millennia. Every non redundant and recessive trait from your deep ancestry has been integrated at its theoretical maximum into your genome, with your body built to support these stacked capabilities without conflict. All of these additions remain internal, altering your appearance no more than a trained athlete differs from a sedentary human, and in fact refine your features further, making you even more aesthetically pleasing than before.
