Your mind builds upon your existing advantages, retaining the lifelong neuroplasticity, focused maturity and enhanced emotional intelligence of your High Human form while adding a perfect fusion of modern intellect and primal instinct drawn from the peak of your ancestral lineage. You do not merely deduce danger through logic, you feel it in your hindbrain with a sharpness exceeding any creature that came before, processing environmental cues, shifts in atmosphere and the intentions of others before conscious thought intervenes, your enhanced emotional intelligence now underlaid by gut knowing that operates faster than thought.

Your social architecture has expanded alongside this fusion. The pheromonal control and instinctive authority you possessed as a High Human now affects the entire genus rather than only Humans. Every member of the Homo lineage and all species closely related enough to share that evolutionary heritage register your presence as Authority, their hindbrains responding to you as every aspect of you triggers the correct signals in their brains to obey. Resistance from any such species is biologically limited, their instincts compelling deference, trust and an unconscious recognition of your primacy. This includes High Humans but other Biblically Accurate Humans are resistant. 

You are interfetile with any species sharing Homo lineage, your dominant genome overwriting your offspring’s DNA completely by maturity, turning them into Biblically Accurate Humans. If you wish, at the moment of conception, you can instead have the offspring only develop into a High Human, or even leave their DNA untouched, allowing them to remain the species of their other parent. Lastly, you do not age past your prime. You still possess a finite lifespan, but your body no longer degrades with time, remaining at your physical and mental peak until your final moment. If not killed by violence, accident or disease, you may naturally endure for up to 900 years.
objects.title: Biblically Accurate Humans

objects.text:
You are now a Doppelgänger, an older and more advanced species in the shapeshifter family tree. You have evolved past the simple exterior mimicry of your juvenile Mimic form into a creature capable of true internal transformation.

When you devour a living creature, your body automatically analyzes its complete biological structure. This grants you the ability to replicate that specific individual perfectly, including bones, muscles, organs, scars, and vocal cord vibrations. Your internal mimicry also extends to complex non-living materials and non-solid forms such as slime, ooze, or jelly. You can produce fake blood or other fluids inside your body. However, if any fluid leaves your form, it is functionally identical to shedding mass and cannot be controlled or retrieved.

Additionally, you automatically learn a creature's cultural knowledge, social norms, and behavioral patterns through passive observation. This allows you to integrate flawlessly into any society you infiltrate. Your disguised form automatically seems warm, open, and naturally inviting to those around you.

You remain limited by volume, unable to become larger or smaller than your current mass without eating or shedding. At your core you are still an obligate carnivore, however, you can mimic a functional stomach of a different creature, allowing you to temporarily process other foods without harm.
objects.title: Doppelgänger

objects.text:
You are now a Skinwalker, among the oldest, rarest, and strongest in the shapeshifter family tree, having evolved past the limits of mere mimicry into true biological mutation.

Your transformation capabilities have expanded far beyond the Doppelgänger's ability to copy creatures. You can now stretch, inflate, hybridize, and mutate any part of your form at will, with your transformations retaining 100% of any property you replicate, not just skin-deep or organ-deep but absolute, down to your cells. Unlike the Doppelgänger's simple chimeric combinations, your hybridisation is true and seamless: fur that is also scale that is also feather in a gradient, a hand that is simultaneously claw and palm. You can have any transformed part paradoxical characteristics that would normally be mutually exclusive, such as having both the hardness of steel and the elasticity of rubber at the same time, or being simultaneously liquid and solid as needed.

You additionally retain full control over any mass you shed, whether cut off or deliberately expelled. Each shed piece remains connected to you through a greater hivemind, allowing you to re-fuse with any or all of them at will, effectively making you unkillable by dismemberment as every fragment of your body continues to act as an extension of your single consciousness. This also gives you cellular awareness of every part of your body at all times.
objects.title: Skinwalker

objects.text:
You’ve become one of the four armed warrior race, the Quatro.

While your craftsman talents have been reduced back to the levels of a normal human, you’re far more resilient, able to survive in the vacuum of space for several hours with no ill effect. 

Similarly, your manual coordination and combat skills have been dramatically improved, allowing you to use virtually any weapon you understand with a high degree of skill. Quatro mercenaries for instance are often found with dual short swords in their lower arms so their upper arms are free for firearms.
objects.title: Quatro (Nexus)

objects.text: Alduin, also referred to as the World Eater, the Twilight God, and the First Dragon, is a mighty dragon who ruled over Skyrim. A powerful dragon that is believed to have a pivotal role in the reshaping of the world. Your shouts are far stronger and capable of mass destruction.
objects.title: Alduin (The Elder Scrolls)

objects.text: In your ascension, you have absorbed the powers of the Red Dragon Emperor—Y Ddraig Goch—inside your gauntlet and became the new Red Dragon Emperor. You inherit all of his powers, including Boost, Penetrate, Blazing Inferno of Scorching Flames and various other abilities in his prime, and can use them without the limits placed by the Sacred Gear. However, do keep your arrogance in check; even the original Red Dragon Emperor was sealed in a gauntlet. (Your power is around planetary level. With proper training, Boosts and all other powers, you have the potential to reach a conceptual level.)
objects.title: Red Dragon Emperor (High School DxD)

objects.text: In your ascension, you have absorbed the powers of the White Dragon Emperor—Albion Gwiber—inside your wings and became the new White Dragon Emperor. You inherit all of his powers, including Divide, Reflect, Reduce and various other abilities in his prime, and can use them without the limits placed by the Sacred Gear. However, do keep your arrogance in check; even the original White Dragon Emperor was sealed in a pair of wings. (Your power is around planetary level. With proper training, Divide and all other powers, you have the potential to reach a conceptual level.)
objects.title: White Dragon Emperor (High School DxD)

objects.text: Rather than you becoming a dragon this allows dragon ascension to affect your bonded dragon increasing their power and knowledge to insane levels based on the bought version. Your dragon is now able to use their magic at will but will still experience boosts from emotions allowing them to perform spells only describable as miracles.
objects.title: Draconic Companion

objects.text: Rather than lose your Ascension to your bonded Dragon, they are now instead your counterpart. They gain the same power they would have under Dragon Rider Ascension but gain the opposite Dragon Emperor power that you haven chosen. They are Albion to your Ddraig, Ddraig to your Albion.
objects.title: Twin Dragons

objects.text: The Lor Starcutter is an ancient vessel that was crafted by the ancients, people of the past who made legendary treasures and pieces of technology. The ship was apparently crafted using an “incredible power.” The ship has the ability to travel throughout space and time by creating dimensional rifts.
objects.title: Lor Starcutter

objects.text:
You have become a clockwork star, colossal god-like machines created by the ancients with a mix of futuristic technology and magic. There is nearly nothing you cannot do, as the primary function of a clockwork star is to grant any wish given to them, anything from tearing open portals to other dimensions, creating force fields, summoning meteors, teleportation, conjuring black holes, or firing massive energy beams are all things you can do with minimal effort.

But for all your power, you are not invincible. Your body may be large, but it is still susceptible to conventional attack and infiltration. But in the event of the latter, you have a dedicated internal security system to eliminate all but the most persistent and powerful invaders.
objects.title: Clockwork Star (Kirby)

objects.text: You are the manager of the System, rather than needing faith you collect a small portion of experience mortals gift you when they gain experience. They use your system to get stronger and you get stronger through the experience they gift you. You can control their system, strengthen them or even take it away. You can even create custom skills for those you favor.
objects.title: System Manager

objects.text:
Now, you are no ordinary God - you are one of the Celestial Incarnae, the greatest in the heavens. Your power and authority are raised to staggering heights, such that you could challenge any ten high-ranking Gods and triumph easily, and command any deity or other spirit in the Bureaucracy short of another Incarnae. Your Domains are further expanded as well, having an entire three primaries and six secondaries to start with, albeit with a catch: One of your primaries must be a celestial body or location (such as the sun, the stars, or the void between), another must be an open-ended and influential concept (such as perfection, life, or order), and your secondary Domains are limited to two per primary.

Your charms are now cosmic or conceptual in scale, for instance, if one of your domains is perfection, you can unleash charms that hit infinitely hard or absolutely invulnerable for a limited time etc, and if one of your domains is the stars/the sun, your charms can unleash supernovae, create stars, etc, and over time, you will gain more domains and stronger charms.

Note that a Solar Incarna will be stronger than a Luna Incarna and so on.

You also have one more bonus available to you: You now possess a unique magical material to call your own, such as the Unconquered Sun's Orichalcum, or Luna's Moonsilver. While its appearance and mystical properties are at least partially influenced by your own nature and Domains, you may otherwise freely customize the specifics of your material within reason, and hold the knowledge of how to create and work with your material.
objects.title: Incarna (Exalted)

objects.text: You are not merely one of the divine. You are among those who not only created the gods to delegate the task of maintaining Creation, but also forged Creation itself from the formless Wyld. The sheer size and weight of Your existence is so great that You cannot be represented by just a singular being: You possess a Fetich soul, on a similar scale as the Incarnae if slightly less versatile, and 16 Third Circle souls, each as strong as the highest non-Incarna gods of Yu-Shan, that compose what You are, each of which possesses 7 Second Circle souls of their own. The immensity of Your being also produces whole species of First Circle souls, that to You are as numerous and replaceable as body hair might be on a human. You also possess two distinct physical bodies in the form of jouten: The first, Your World-Body, lives up to its name, being an entire world in its own right capable of housing entire nations. The other, Your Titan-Body, is similarly grand and imposing, fit to crush entire armies and cities. The specifics of both of these are entirely influenced by Your Nature and Domains, just like how the King of the Yozi possesses endless urban layers composed of brass and basalt. Your Titan-Body may also be shrunk down, in case You want to interact with those infinitely Your lesser as Your whole totality, rather than leave such a meeting to one of Your souls. If You’re willing to put in the work, You may be able to obtain any number of additional Titan-Bodies for You or Your constituent souls to utilize. Such is Your power that You are among those who provided the building blocks of existence. Your own spiritual abilities surpass even those of the greatest Exalted and the Incarnae, and while the Unconquered Sun might be able to strike You down if it weren’t for the Geas preventing the gods of Creation from harming Your kind, he would find such a fight to be a struggle even for him, and would have to destroy You down to every last soul above First Circle. Your powers and themes shall be decided on a combination of Your Nature, a Domain of such depth and strength that it reaches conceptual levels of power, and additional Domains from each Third and Second Circle soul You have besides your Fetich. Your soul hierarchy is not all glory and power, however. They define Your Nature and personality, for they are who and what You are: Permanently destroying one of Your Third Circle souls will harm and lessen Your self, and what You shall develop in replacement of the now missing soul and personality trait is unpredictable, but it’s usually a neutral change, rather than a lessening. Such a thing will only occur should Your Fetich soul be truly destroyed. Suffering the true death of your Fetich is tantamount to a complete mental breakdown, the pillar of your psyche shattered and removed. Your very nature and domains might even change by the birth of an entirely new Fetich. Note: this makes you equal to a fully realized Nascent Eldritch or slightly weaker than the Nascent Eldritch, depending on the type of Incarna you took.
objects.title: Primordial (Exalted)

objects.text: You gain a small portion of the divine flame, allowing you to create your own type of Exalt. This Exalt type will be subdivided into five categories, but the actual specifics of it are up to you. Your scope is somewhat limited, however, in that it must be based in some way on your Domains. These exalt types are on par with Solar exalted, and you no longer have to consume portions of your power to make them. There is still a period of downtime as the Flame recovers. For primordials, it is the same; however, instead of 1 cooldown on the flame, each 3rd circle soul has its own cooldown.
objects.title: Flame of Exaltation (Exalted)

objects.text:
As an Outer God of the Void, your essence is intertwined with the concept of the void itself. This power allows you to tap into the vast emptiness and manipulate reality using the inherent properties of the void. You have unparalleled control over the fabric of existence and the ability to traverse the realms beyond conventional comprehension.

Void Manipulation: With the Cosmic Veil at your command, you possess the ability to manipulate the void. Able to create and control pockets of emptiness, causing objects, energy, or even entire beings to be engulfed and erased from existence. This power allows you to unravel the very fabric of reality, leaving behind an empty void in its wake.

Dimensional Shifting: The Cosmic Veil grants you the power to traverse the boundaries of reality effortlessly. You can slip between dimensions, moving through the multiverse and exploring hidden realms. You are immune to the effects of dimensional barriers and can create portals that lead to the void, allowing you to appear and disappear at will.

Reality Warping: By harnessing the power of the void, you possess the ability to shape reality itself. You can mold and bend the laws of physics, altering the fabric of existence to suit your desires. This power allows you to manifest nightmarish abominations, twist the environment to your advantage, or even rewrite the fundamental rules of reality within a limited area.

Cosmic Absorption: As the embodiment of the void, you can absorb energy, matter, and even other entities into yourself, adding their essence to your own.
objects.title: Void From Beyond The Stars

objects.text:
"Radiant Ascendancy" empowers you to transcend mortal limitations and become an Eldritch being of light. Embracing your true nature as the source of creation, you gain control over celestial bodies, manipulating stars and galaxies as extensions of your being. With this power, you shape the cosmos, wielding boundless energy and radiance.

Cosmic Perception: Expand your consciousness beyond your physical form, perceiving the vast universe with exceptional clarity. Gain profound knowledge about stars, galaxies, and cosmic events.

Stellar Manipulation: Stars become conduits of your power. Summon, move, and control them, altering their paths and intensities. Create celestial formations, direct cosmic energies, and unleash stellar explosions.

Luminous Manifestation: Radiate blinding light, rendering yourself nearly indestructible. Absorb and convert attacks into empowering energy. Shape the radiance into protective barriers or devastating beams of incinerating light.

Cosmic Energies: Tap into vast cosmic reserves, manipulating fundamental universal forces. Bend space and time, create gravitational anomalies, and warp reality. Your presence distorts the universe, causing awe-inspiring disturbances.

Creation's Blessing: As the embodiment of primordial light, grant boons and blessings to deserving beings. Infuse mortals with fragments of your power, elevating them or bestowing unique abilities. Empower allies and cultivate a devoted following.
objects.title: Radiant Ascendancy

objects.text:
As the Great Sage Equal to Heaven, you possess a power that is unparalleled, unbounded by mere mortal limitations. Your access to spiritual energy and its immeasurable potential is unprecedented, granting you mastery over all forms of martial arts and magic. Your physical and mental abilities are enhanced to the point where you can effortlessly defeat even the most powerful of opponents, whether they be human or divine. Your understanding of spiritual energy and its inner workings is so profound that you can manipulate it to achieve any effect you desire.

You have the ability to transform into countless forms, each with its own unique abilities and advantages. You are a master of deception, able to manipulate the minds of those around you with ease. Your illusions are so convincing that even the most vigilant opponent can be tricked into letting their guard down.

Your divine powers are equal to Sun Wukong at his peak, with perfect control and understanding. The spiritual realm is your playground, meaning you are immune to the perils that normally plague mortals.

Your strength is so great that you could topple entire empires with a mere flick of your wrist, and your wisdom could guide entire civilizations to prosperity and greatness. You are a force to be reckoned with, feared by your enemies and revered by your allies. With this power, you could shape the world to your will, creating a new era of peace and harmony or unleashing chaos and destruction upon it.
objects.title: Monkey King

addons.text:
The tomb is no longer the one from the anime. Or the one from this cyoa. They've merged and become better than the sum of their parts. 1000 floors Can be added as you wish, with complete freedom of design. Each floor has its own pocket dimension to do with as you please. You can create a floor that's designed after the underwater city Atlantis, forcing invaders underneath the crushing depths of the ocean, surrounded by monsters. Or a holy realm based off the heavens that burn those you consider unholy. You have complete and utter freedom in its design.
 
Of course, you have 12000 levels to create NPCs to fill those floors, and you will gain 100 more every year. These NPCs can be created through a character creator menu, and you can build them however you want through there. Of course, these beings will have beyond-instinctive loyalty to you, as their god and creator.
addons.title: I'm Just Better

objects.text: You have ascended from being an undead king to being a Supreme Being, an Overlord, something even beyond the level of an elder lich that pursues magic above all else. However, you are no mere normal Overlord; you gain all the knowledge and abilities of Momonga. This includes, but is not limited to, all 718 spells that he has memorized; all unique skills that he has gained from the various classes and racial abilities; and every piece of equipment that he has gathered from YGGDRASIL, from cash shop items to mob drops. Moreover, you gain four additional abilities. Dark Wisdom: You’ve attained rare and dangerous knowledge. Your undead mind is now filled with the knowledge of magic, theory, and artifice. You now possess the ability to learn any magic, regardless of the normal restrictions or limits of your mind and memory. Your undead mind is like a steel trap that no knowledge can escape. This takes effort and study, however, and whether or not it will be worthwhile depends on how interested you are in devoting the time to it. Additionally, so long as you’ve seen a spell cast at least once, you will, with time and effort, be able to puzzle out its workings. Your brilliant mind, puzzling out the inner workings of a spell, lets you remove restrictions from spells and go about creating brand-new spells that have never been seen before. You’re an unparalleled genius that has no peer when it comes to magic, grasping spells, and rituals that others would require months to grasp in days and hours. Furthermore, you learn a dark ritual that allows you to steal the abilities of others. The Abyss of Magic: You stared into the Abyss of Magic, but unlike others, you did not flinch away, nor did you go crazy from exposure to eldritch truths. Your reserves of magical energy are heavily bolstered, far beyond what you gained from Supreme Being. Anyone who could see your magical aura would go blind before seeing a limit to your magic, and the potency of your spells has increased to match your newfound insights into the arcane. You may now amplify your spells, allotting more time, energy, and magical energy to them than they might otherwise be capable of handling, allowing you to gain dramatically increased magical effects and lowering the requirements for spells as a result, such as level cost. Spells such as a spell to summon drinking water can turn into a tsunami that could flood the earth, or a flame spell can turn into the might of the sun with enough time and energy, and even your less powerful or obvious magics can be bolstered to a comparable degree. At a base level, the increase in the power of your spell is roughly triple what it originally would be. Additionally, you are not affected by suppressed emotions and can choose when you suppress them, along with optionally being able to change your appearance from that of a skeleton into that of a human via magic. You may also optionally gain access to the Great Tomb of Nazarick and all its inhabitants. This Nazarick is in another dimension, only accessible to you; you can change how time flows in this place as well as allow people to enter and leave. They are loyal to you and you alone; they can never betray you, as they see you as the last supreme being who stayed with them while no one else did.
objects.title: Overlord (Overlord)

objects.text:
You become a conduit for cosmic energies, elevated to a state of near-omnipotence. Matter, energy, and reality become malleable, yielding to your celestial will. Your hunger for cosmic sustenance awakens, enabling the absorption of immense power from stars, galaxies, and celestial bodies. This energy becomes the life force that drives and empowers the transformed entity.

You can manipulate the very fabric of existence, transcending the confines of ordinary mortals. The ability to alter one's size is but a mere thought away, allowing the transformation from a towering cosmic colossus to a more manageable, human-like form. Reality bends and yields, as time itself becomes a pliable force to be shaped. The creation of alternate dimensions and the rewriting of physical laws become mere extensions of this unfathomable power.

Cosmic awareness dawns upon you, offering unparalleled insight into the workings of the universe. The past, present, and future intertwine, revealing hidden truths and foreseeing potential threats. The collective knowledge of civilizations becomes accessible, providing a wealth of wisdom and understanding.

Amidst the destructive reputation, your power also harbors the capacity for creation. Barren worlds can be infused with life, as the transformed entity breathes existence into once desolate realms. Terraforming becomes a trivial feat, while the restoration of life, even the resurrection of beings, becomes an attainable reality.

Immortality accompanies the transformation, as the ties to the fundamental forces of the cosmos transcend mortal boundaries. Attacks, diseases, and the ravages of time hold no sway over the transformed entity. They become an enduring force, an eternal observer, traversing the eons unscathed.

Furthermore, your power extends beyond yourself. Able to empower chosen individuals, transforming them into loyal heralds. These individuals become conduits of cosmic might, serving the transformed entity in their cosmic pursuits and aiding in the preservation and balance of the universe.
objects.title: Lifebringer (Marvel)

objects.text:
You are an Abstract Entity—a living concept embodying a fundamental aspect of the universe—akin to beings such as Eternity, Infinity, Death, Master Order, Lord Chaos, Oblivion, the In-Betweener, Mistress Love, Sire Hate, the Phoenix Force, and the Living Tribunal. As an Abstract Entity, you have no true physical form, but can manifest through an M-Body provided by the Dimension of Manifestation to interact with corporeal beings. Your M-Body is not fixed, allowing you to assume any form you choose.

You possess absolute and supreme authority over your concept, granting you the power to achieve virtually anything within its domain—such as creating or erasing entire civilizations, shaping galaxies to match your design, or rewriting the laws of reality to favor or suppress specific phenomena. Even beyond your domain, you retain unlimited ability to manipulate reality, time, space, matter, energy, and magic for any purpose. This, however, does not grant you anywhere near the power of the Living Tribunal and only makes you an equal to other regular Abstract Entities.

You are also inherently aware of all things related to your concept and can be present in any situation concerning it, rendering you nearly omniscient and omnipresent. You can perceive events across the past, present, and possible futures, sense disturbances throughout the universe—and potentially the multiverse—and influence outcomes on a conceptual level without direct interaction. As a living concept, you cannot truly die; only a fundamental alteration of the universe’s laws could erase you.

However, despite your immense power, some beings surpass you and could end your existence even against all logic—such as Thanos with the Infinity Gauntlet, who once commanded all Abstract Entities and stood just below the Living Tribunal, or the Beyonders, who annihilated the Seventh Cosmos and slew all cosmic beings and Abstract Entities, including the Tribunal itself.
objects.title: Abstract Entity (Marvel)

addons.text:
Your Commander now incorporates the complete technological suite of an end-game Icarus. Your onboard fabricators automatically maintain full warp-matrix reserves, allowing near-instantaneous warp travel across systems. You can traverse any world, even those with dense atmospheres, with adaptive flight systems designed for high-speed atmospheric and orbital maneuvering.

Your substorage fleet bays now carry a full complement of automated ships, drones, and logistics craft — each preloaded with ammunition, energy, and materials for prolonged warfare or industrial expansion. Prefabricated buildings allow the rapid deployment of complete planetary-scale factories, power grids, and defense systems from your internal fabrication arrays.

Integrated battlefield analysis cores, derived from the Icarus network, continuously synchronize with your command AI, optimizing production, defense, and fleet coordination. Should your infrastructure fall, you can reestablish an entire Dyson-level production network from your personal reserves alone.
addons.title: Commander ICARUS

addons.text:
It seems your database didn’t just contain technology so advanced it might as well be magic.
It also archived entire blueprints for mechanical factions whose very design depends on the supernatural—machines built from spellcraft, sorcery, runes, divine logic, or metaphysical energies woven directly into hardware.

With this, you also gains the capability to replicate, upgrade, and mass-produce these magitech constructs, but only those belonging to machine-exclusive factions. No biological, psionic, eldritch, or mundane branches of their settings are included—only the magitech war-machines themselves.

Mecha Zerglings (StarCraft) - Stetmann’s fully robotic Zergling analogues powered by EGOnergy nanites, designed to mimic Zerg tactics without organic limitations.

Ex-Machina (No Game No Life) - Ether-driven combat automatons whose quantum-logic cores let them execute sorcery as computation.

Arma Machina Constructs (Trinity Seven) - Giant spell-forged weapons and automatons sustained by high-order magic circles and ancient grimoire formulas.

Machina (Final Fantasy series) - Aether-infused engines and armor constructs, their systems powered by pyreflies or analogous spiritual energy.

Dwemer Constructs (Elder Scrolls) - Steam-powered automatons animated by soul gem cores and tonal architecture, blending dwarven engineering with mystical resonance frequencies.

Machine Legion (Tales of Series) - Aether-infused engines and armor constructs, their systems powered by pyreflies or analogous spiritual energy.

Argivian Constructs (Magic: The Gathering) - Purely‑mechanical Phyrexian war machines built on compleated oil-laced logic, rune‑engraved circuits, and self-augmenting metal. These constructs serve the Great Work, combining metal, oil, and Phyrexian ritual‑engineering to create perfect machines of war.
addons.title: Why More!? Why Not?

objects.text: You ascend beyond the realm of a typical Mechanized Platform; you stand as the epitome of war machines, meticulously crafted by some of history's most formidable races! Embracing the title of COMMANDER! As a 15-meter tall Brutally Efficient Self-Replicating Machine of War, you wield a Seraphim Chronotron Cannon in one hand, a Nanite dispenser in the other, and boast an array of advanced technologies—a Resource Core embedded in your chest, a Nano-Repair System seamlessly integrated into your frame, a UEF Shield Generator Field, a Cybran Cloaking/Stealth generator, an Aeon Personal Teleporter, and a Quantum Foam Brain securing the retrieval of all memories, immune to the risk of personality death accompanied by a change in hardware. (You have the flexibility to adopt the starting commander frame from any faction of the starting games). Your mastery over a vast library to draw from War Machines Without End expands your repertoire, enabling you to assimilate insights from other Grey-goo machine RTS games like Beyond All Reasons, Ashes of the Singularity, and Mechabellum. Your extraordinary reverse-engineering capabilities, coupled with the prowess of your Q.F. Brain, empower you to refine and enhance all technologies at your disposal. This includes even those that defy logic, such as psychic and magical powers. It's worth noting that, from your perspective, biology is a sophisticated dance of messy machines working diligently to influence the macro through micro-level endeavors.
objects.title: BESRMoWs

objects.text:
You are no mere Mechanized Platform—you are a member of the esteemed and loathed Chariot Line, a FAS-BOR7 Horus. Large enough to crawl over mountains, your vessel resembles a giant aquatic arthropod, akin to a lobster or sea scorpion. You stand on ten legs: four long, triple-jointed limbs supporting the segmented "tail," while six shorter legs uphold the front of the main chassis.

At your front, you are equipped with four massive tentacles, each at least as long as your body, tipped with enormous drills designed to penetrate heavily armored fortifications and bunkers, as well as to grasp objects. These tentacles also contain ocular receptors, allowing you to see through them and, by extension, direct them with greater precision. Additionally, you possess inbuilt anti-aircraft guns, guided and close-range anti-personnel missiles, and a laser weapon mounted within your central ocular system. Naturally, all of these components can be modified, thanks to the unique modularity of your form—an inheritance from your nature as a Mechanized Platform.

Of course, the true power of your transformation lies in the four defining features of the Chariot Line, the very characteristics that earned them the moniker of the Faro Plague: self-replication, biomass-to-fuel conversion, enemy CPU slaving, and unparalleled OS security.

As a Horus, you possess an internal repair and manufacturing bay of gargantuan size, enabling you to replenish numbers faster than they can be destroyed. You are equipped with blueprints for drones, munitions, FAS-ACA3 Scarabs, FAS-FSP5 Khopeshes, and even other FAS-BOR7 Horus units. Your manufacturing bay is vast enough to construct anything for which you have blueprints—including additional Horus units—resulting in an exponentially growing swarm. You and all manufactured units remain linked through a shared network, allowing for seamless real-time coordination and command.

Accompanying this is your Biomatter Conversion System, capable of converting any form of biomass into fuel in an emergency. This ensures continued operation even when conventional fuel reserves are depleted, while also allowing for the efficient disposal of organic obstacles. If left unchecked, a swarm equipped with this could deplete an entire biosphere.

In terms of OS security, you are virtually untouchable. Your defenses operate on Polyphasic Entangled Waveforms, rendering you immune to contemporary hacking—so much so that even the most advanced supercomputer in the world would require 50 years to brute-force access.

Finally, you possess the ability to enslave the CPUs of other machines, assimilating both hardware and software into your ever-expanding network. This, coupled with your unbreakable OS security, allows you to override and hack other systems while remaining completely impervious to counterattacks.
objects.title: Metal Devil

objects.text:
You're now the head of a Typhon hivemind similar to the Apex. Akin to a Weaver, you can produce any Typhon species shown in the Prey series, such as Mimics, Telepaths or Nightmares, as well as any subspecies. You're even capable of formulating new, unique species of Typhon against specific threats. You're also able to reanimate corpses into Typhon variants, called Phantoms, by infusing them with your psionic energy.

Typhons are limited to devouring biological creatures' consciousness, alongside their organic matter, to use their psionic energy and matter to replicate. You, however, only require organic matter to produce Typhon, as you can infuse them with your own psionic energy when creating them. Larger and more powerful Typhon species require a greater amount of psionic energy and organic matter to create; even creatures as large as the Apex can be produced if you have enough.

You possess the unique physiology of the Typhon, a mass of exotic black matter that exhibits solid, liquid and gaseous properties simultaneously and can be altered freely to move and shapeshift at will. Due to your vast psionic power, you also possess all of the abilities and powers demonstrated by Typhon in the Prey series, such as telekinesis, invisibility, teleportation, mind control and matter mimicry, to name but a few.
objects.title: The Typhon (Prey)

objects.text:
You are now equal to one of Japan's Three Great Monsters. The boss that governed the Oni within the castle structure on Mount Ooe. Shuten-dōji.

Your Oni form has been enhanced, allowing you to bypass all of your physical limitations while drastically enhancing your senses, making you capable of detecting all movements and the flow of magic within a range of 500m, as well as predicting your opponent’s movement. Its appearance has also been altered, as instead of merely gaining a pair of horns, your entire body now changes into a gigantic ogre-like creature with sharp claws, wild hair, red skin and horns growing from your head. Your base form is now equal to what your Oni form was before the enhancement.

Your magic reserves are greatly boosted, and all of your magic is enhanced by your demonic attributes. Using your magic, you can create/turn people into an Oni. This drains your magic greatly, and at its base, will only allow you to create a maximum of 5 per week. All Oni will feel an instinctive loyalty to you.

You gain an intense love for alcohol, as well as poison immunity. In fact, you gain a minor permanent boost in your stats when drinking alcohol (or poison).
objects.title: Shuten-dōji

addons.text:
Your ability to split your soul into separate beings has strengthened your connection with your host’s soul, allowing you to more deeply weave yourself into their essence, a process which slowly infects and subsumes their soul as they rise in LOVE, such that by LOVE 20 their soul is effectively just an extension of your soul. People who can see souls and sense spirits are much less likely to detect your presence or find anything off about your host’s soul, and if they do find something, they’re less likely to recognize you as an outside force. Lastly, your ability to reclaim split pieces of your soul has evolved your ability to take back granted power to a whole new level.

When leaving and taking back any granted power, you also absorb and take with you any parts of their soul which you have subsumed, for at that point, those portions might as well be part of your soul. These pieces strengthen your own soul and grant fragments of their previous owner’s memories, knowledge, powers, and even soulbound items such as Sacred Gears. The more of their soul you subsume before leaving, the more complete these gains are, with a fully subsumed soul providing all of their memories, knowledge, and powers.

The only exception to powers that can be taken with you are powers fully contained to the body in both source and effect, such as having a physical mutation which makes your muscles denser and more efficient, or Parahuman powers which don’t actually belong to the host themself and are instead anchored to them via a physical node.
addons.title: Usurpation

objects.text:
Like the wonderful Chara from Undertale, you have gained the ability to attach your SOUL and DETERMINATION to someone else, allowing you to tether yourself to them instead of a place or object. You can freely communicate with your host, either speaking directly in their mind or manifesting before them as a hallucination only they—or others with the ability to see spirits—can perceive, to talk with them directly.

You can share your DETERMINATION and System with your host—as well as any other Undertale powers if you have them—with a twist. Whenever your host gains EXP and LOVE, a portion of those gains instead goes to you, allowing you to grow your power without lifting a finger. You may also sever your connection with your host and leave them, taking all the power granted with you, including their LOVE and DETERMINATION.

Most importantly, however, is the way your possession has evolved. In addition to outright possessing your host, you can also subtly influence their thoughts or force their body to act without their permission. As your host’s LOVE increases, so too does your control over them, decreasing their ability to resist and the effort needed to influence them. Once they reach LOVE 20, you are capable of permanently possessing them at any time without resistance, effectively turning them into your new body.
objects.title: Main Chara-cter (Undertale)

objects.text:
The ocean calls your name, beckoning you to join its mighty depths. The sound of its waves fills your ears, and the scent of its salty air invigorates your senses. You can feel a powerful connection forming between you and the sea, as if you are destined to unite with its boundless energy and power. And as this bond strengthens, so will your hydrokinesis abilities, until they become an integral part of your being.

You have complete control over the properties of water; its molecular structure, density, viscosity, surface tension, and more. You can change water's state from a solid to a liquid, to a vapor, at will. You can manipulate water's temperature, making it boiling hot, freezing cold, or anything in between. You have a deep understanding and connection to water on a fundamental level, and you can invoke the power of the ocean to your aid with just a thought.

You possess the power to control not only the physical water elements of the ocean, but also its very essence on a conceptual level. This allows you to manipulate the very concept of the ocean itself, allowing you to wield its power freely.

Your mastery over water will know no bounds, as you reach out and control every droplet with ease. You can twist and mould it to your will, creating towering waves or gentle ripples, summoning flooding torrents or soothing warm breezes. With a thought, you can create a tsunami that can destroy entire cities, or a simple stream to water the fields. You have the power to control any and all water on earth, and your abilities extend beyond the natural world.

You have the power to control the very essence of the sea, from its swirling depths to its gentle currents. You can call forth the creatures of the deep and command the very forces of nature to do your bidding. And when faced with another with hydrokinesis abilities, you can negate their powers entirely, rendering them all but helpless in your presence. The sea has chosen you to be its champion, and with its endless power and energy at your disposal, you will be unstoppable in your quest for dominance and mastery over all the oceans of the world.
objects.title: Prince of Envy

addons.text:
Like Cronus, you are born abnormally strong even when compared to the rest of your kind. 

You can shrug off attacks from greater deities and take on an entire pantheon on your lonesome. Only the combined effort of multiple pantheons would be enough to defeat you, but even then, they might not have the power to slay you.
addons.title: Cronus

objects.text:
You have become an Elder Titan, a child of the multiverse, the first form of life crafted by the gods from the raw primordial chaos of creation to be perfect in every way. The gods never make anything as strong as the Elder Titans ever again because they realize how dangerous it is to create something that could rival them in power.

As an Elder Titan, you are a mirror to glory, standing tall at a height of 8 meters. You are extremely handsome/beautiful in every aspect. Your muscles are denser than adamantine and more pliable than the supplest bamboo. You can see in the night as clearly as any fiend, and in the day, a hawk is nearly blind in comparison. Your body is so perfectly built that you are stronger than even an ancient dragon twice your size. Your mental acuity is at a super-genius level, rivaling that of the gods themselves, and you do not age or require any sleep or sustenance.

The mastery of magic in all forms comes naturally to you, making you an adept spellcaster equal to a level 20 wizard, cleric, and psionic. You also have immunity to psionic abilities.
objects.title: Elder Titan (D&D Greyhawk)

objects.text:
You have ascended to the status of an Overdeity, comparable to Ao in the Forgotten Realms. As an Overgod, you have become the pantheistic God of a newborn universe.

This universe is approximately 10 light-years in diameter and is protected from unwanted intruders by a crystal sphere. Within this universe, your power is nearly absolute, allowing you to reshape the metaphysical structure of your cosmos as you see fit. Your power is so immense that you could effortlessly slay a greater deity with just a thought if they dared to trespass into your universe.

You can alter the nature of divinity within your realm, elevate mortals to divine status, promote or demote deities weaker than yourself, and grant or revoke any domain from such deities.

Your universe can grow by creating thriving worlds populated by both gods and mortals. As long as beings inhabit your cosmos, it will continue to expand and develop.

You can also assimilate other universes into your own to grow it, though this process is slow and lengthy. You can only assimilate a space equal to 10% of your universe's total volume per year. This rate can be significantly reduced or even halted if the universe you are trying to assimilate resists.

Outside the universe you embody, your power is greatly reduced to the equivalent strength of ten greater deities combined. However, as your universe grows, so will your power outside of it. Without destroying the universe you embody, it is impossible to kill you.
objects.title: Overdeity (D&D)

addons.text: Your mastery of Life and Anti-Life rewards you with both Darkseid and Highfather strives and endeavors to understand and commune with the Source, the Light of Creation. Embarking on a personal journey to learn its secrets, you returned with a teeming bond–a living conduit–represented by an item or object of your choosing and design. By using this item/weapon as a foci, you unleash the Source’s fantastic abilities and function under your whim, namely, manipulation of matter and energy on an unimaginable scale–creating objects ex nihilo, disintegrating entire space fleets into atomic dust in a burst of power, or the altering the form and essence of living beings at your leisure; you project an image of yourself only to those you wish, manipulate technology by will, telepathic and telekinetic control, cosmic insight and wisdom, among countless capabilities. This is offset by being a receiver of a higher power, your connection being less than unbreakable in certain circumstances: great cosmic disturbances that shake the foundations of an entire universe or more can weaken or even break your connection to the Source, disabling your access to this bottomless well. This reestablishes itself once the crisis is dealt with or comes to pass.
addons.title: The Source: Where All Things Spring From

objects.text: Darkseid does not do. Darkseid is. You now embody Tyranny and Order, Darkseid’s epithet, next to having the Omega Effect and an insight into the Anti-Life Equation, therefore gaining his legacy of the God of Evil. This turns you into an Avatar of Darkseid, a minuscule piece of the God’s true power. Your abilities now eclipse other New Gods, with strength, speed, fortitude, and intellect beyond most New Gods. Surviving a planet’s destruction, living for eons on end, going toe-to-toe with Zeus and Izaya both on a speed and stamina unheard of, and cunning a hundred steps from the hundred evolutionary ladder are a few of the feats you’re capable of doing. One of your signature abilities is his Omega Effect, a supernatural force of energy speculated to be entropic. This power breaks and annihilates anything down, commonly manifested through red beams from the eyes, usually called Omega Beams, which lock onto the atomic structure of a given target. These beams can reach as far as across an entire universe, moving at several times the speed of light, and are nearly unavoidable for those not blessed with superpowers or astoundingly good fortune, twisting and turning to chase their target with terrifying accuracy. Those struck by the Omega Beams can be teleported to any location of the user’s choosing, immediately disintegrated (or reformed from it, should you choose to), or banished to a hell known as the Omega Sanction. The poor sodding bastard subjected to the Omega Sanction, or the Death that is Life, traps them in an endless succession of synthetic lives, each one more degrading and hopeless than the last. Being your raw power, it is utilized to magnify your strength and speed to terrifying new heights with the Omega Effect behind you, even unlock more sub-powers and sense down the line, who knows? Another is the comprehension and, by extension, potential usage of the Anti-Life Equation. The Shadow of All Life; The Undoing. The black grail we so desperately desire, a living mathematical equation that proves the futility and hopelessness of life, extinguishing free will and turning what was once a living soul into a hollow husk for the wielder’s purposes. At first, you have a rudimentary understanding of Anti-Life, but over an exhaustive amount of time, you figure and internalize a significant portion of it, and finally harness the full power of the Equation. Common applications include infusing your technology, words, and powers with Anti-Life causing a complete collapse of anyone’s will and seeing their consciousness and souls extinguished, turning into little more than hollow extensions of your will that you have full awareness of and work in perfect concert with; direct usage of Anti-Life would allow one to use negative emotion to shift and control reality, but above all, it would break down free will and sentience to be nothing more than a hollow extension of its user, destroyed by the pointlessness of life; at the end stage of your understanding, you can tap into the might of the malignant shadow of the source, letting you dominate and control others without having to repeat the Equation – you could command all who could hear you to ‘stop’ and they would drop dead. Beyond that, with enough anger and hatred, you may cause yourself to manifest into a conduit for Anti-Life, letting you warp reality with its twisting presence. Last but not least, due to inheriting Darkseid’s legacy and being a piece of him, you play the part of God of Evil in leadership, strategic acumen, technical and technological know-how, among many others: Your schemes have a better chance of going unnoticed, and your violent squashing of your enemies is seen as one-time affairs. Your rule is absolute, with Parademons at your beck and call, with an iron fist. Befitting from a God of Tyranny.
objects.title: Darkseid is (DC Comics)

addons.text:
You gain the skills, talents, will, power, and personification of Orion, the Dog of War; that of War and Strength.

Anybody knows that war isn’t a glorious endeavor. Even still, war must be fought if the cause is right. Whether from inborn talent or centuries of experience, you are a living testament to both the horror and glories of war. You know how to use your combat abilities and superpowers to their most efficient extent in the arts of violence, enough so that you could outlast and possibly even defeat those far stronger than you in raw power with efficiency and skill. Adding to this, your body and mind act in perfect concert in overcoming your enemy in almost artful brutality, allowing you to fight with all of your strength and all of your tactical thinking ability in perfect unison without trading one for the other.

You also gain the Astro Force, the Wrath of the Source. Coming with an Astro-Harness to help you channel its power, you can project and control energy blasts with the power of an entire universe behind it. It also creates protective energy fields around you, letting you deflect even the mighty Omega Beams at nearly point-blank range. The Astro-Harness has interstellar travel capabilities both in flight and Boom Tubes, as well as drawing objects in with a tractor beam built into the vehicle.
addons.title: Dog of War

addons.text:
You gain the skills, talents, will, power, and personification of Mister Miracle, that of Freedom.

Your willpower is a sight to see. Even as a child, your will could allow you to hold an unbreakable strength that would allow you to grow up somewhere as grim and horrifying as a Granny Goodness orphanage and still come out with your old self intact. You could be caught in a terrifying deathtrap that has you bound and powerless without feeling a hint of terror or panic. Torture, overwhelming odds, even death itself… nothing can shake your sense of self and will.

You can walk into hell and walk out with the same smile you wore on the way in.

Being the original owner of the Alpha Effect, your progress with the supernatural force is accelerated at the pace of your indomitable will to keep going.
addons.title: Unbreakable Miracle

objects.text:
You now embody Peace and Wisdom, Izaya’s epithet, next to having personalized abilities called The Alpha Effect and insight into the Life Equation, therefore gaining the legacy of the God of Good.

Izaya, compared to Darkseid, favors more indirect and diplomatic approaches and is concerned with the multiverse at large. That is why one of your signature abilities is his cosmic awareness, his sense vigilant for any disturbance across the universes, especially for anything threatening its integrity like Entities or Darkseid equivalents.

Then there’s the Alpha Effect, the antithesis of the Omega Effect, while Darkseid is fueled by entropy, yours is a bottomless well of energy in your body, lacking any nasty side effects from the Source. With the Alpha Effect, you can effortlessly create and control energy flow, creating blasts that lay low most of the other New Gods or change their shape to use the energy as physical objects or basic constructs. Your ability to add this well of energy to yourself and others will let you energize them or technology, greatly enhancing their capabilities. It can even heal others or resurrect the dead. As with the Omega Effect, you may accomplish even greater feats with this power.

Now, is the comprehension and, by extension, potential usage of the Life Equation. The Light of All Life. While the Anti-Life Equation claims all life is worthless and your only
escape is surrendering your free will. The Life Equation exists as proof that life is worth living and evolving, affirming one’s sense of self. This principle is the foundation of all life in the DC Universe, which can apply anywhere. At first, you gain a fragment of the Equation, perhaps due to your closeness to the Source, and with conscious effort, you can make others healthier and more mentally sound, sharpening their physical and mental capabilities, and affirming their sense of free will by channeling the equation to break forms of mind control or deep despair and rage. This isn’t yet at the level it can overcome something as powerful as one influenced by the Anti-Life Equation, however; with time, you tap into a greater understanding of life and the universe, understanding evolution to an almost primal level so is being able to completely erase brainwashing or mind control over a sentient being with an act of will alone, reciting the equation and reinforcing the core of their character, wiping away even the influence of the Anti-Life Equation. Your understanding of life and evolution being greater allows you to manipulate biological processes with greater ease, evolving multiple beings at once to new levels with a fraction of your original efforts – change them into a known or entirely new species, add or take away certain traits or features, and even grant superpowers based on their biology. This also allows you to easily heal the physical bodies of living beings, as well as resurrect the dead with great effort. You can even, if you wish, spawn or raise new life with your presence alone; and finally, you have not only an understanding of life and evolution... but the very building blocks of creation itself. Not only have your previous abilities evolved to the point you can fill an entire planet with a new species and revive mountains of the dead with a wave of your hand, but your understanding has spread to the very foundation of creation itself. By focusing your full understanding of the Life Equation on reality, you can shape it to your will.

And let it not be said that, for being Highfather’s legacy, you play the part of the benevolent and wise ruler, being a father to all your people, with leadership, governance, and management talent in spades. Following his example, you’re an excellent parent, able to balance discipline and warmth with ease, able to draw out the best of your family and raise your children to stand as paragons in whatever they choose to pursue.
objects.title: Highfather (DC Comics)

objects.text:
At the dawn of time, the Presence created the Demiurgic Archangels, who were entrusted with the work of creation: Michael, Samael—who would later be known as Lucifer—and Gabriel. Michael was gifted with the power to bring forth creation out of nothing, known as the Dunamis Demiurgos. Samael was given the ability to manipulate any external force for any effect he desired, allowing him to shape reality to his will. Gabriel’s role was to impose form and pattern upon what his brothers created, shaping it according to their Father’s design.

As a Demiurgic Archangel, you ascend to the rank of one of the most powerful entities in DC Comics—above beings such as the Spectre and even the Endless—and surpassed only by the Presence himself and those on equal standing, such as the Great Darkness. You may choose one aspect of creation to command, such as the power to create but not shape, or the power to shape but not create. However, you cannot possess more than one.

By your nature, you also possess numerous other abilities: vast superhuman strength, durability, speed, and agility; freedom from the need for sustenance, rest, or sleep; a mind capable of perceiving time where none exists and processing the entire 20-billion-year history of a universe in the blink of an eye; and large angelic wings that allow you to fly anywhere at impossible speeds regardless of physics.

You can project blasts of divine energy strong enough to harm other Demiurgic Archangels, disintegrate lesser beings, alter your size and form at will, and create portals between dimensions to traverse realms freely. You are immortal, immune to aging, and cannot die by ordinary means—not even Death of the Endless herself can lay claim to your soul. If you wield the Dunamis Demiurgos, you are even capable of resurrecting yourself. Furthermore, you possess the ability to know virtually everything within creation’s history, granting you a form of omniscience.

However, even a Demiurgic Archangel is not invincible. Despite their durability, both Michael and Lucifer have died before and later returned to life, and they were once fatally injured while traveling to Yggdrasil. After passing his powers to Elaine Belloc, Michael seemingly died permanently. Additionally, if you choose the power to create, your death could unleash the Dunamis Demiurgos, erasing all life from the multiverse and leaving nothing behind. The only ways to prevent this catastrophe are to avoid death, release the power in a place where it cannot affect the multiverse, pass it on to another being equal in stature to a Demiurge, or find a way to contain it.
objects.title: Demiurgic Archangel (DC Comics)

objects.text: "Such is the power of Nagash" -Nagash, Supreme Lord of Undeath You have become Nagash, Father of Necromancy and the God of the Dead. You gain all of his knowledge, magical might, intelligence, magical artefacts, physiology, and even the realm of Shyish. In whatever worlds you go to, you will automatically have a claim over the souls of all who die, and you will have total dominion over any undead that may exist.
objects.title: The Great Necromancer

objects.text:
As the Machine God, you embody the apex of technological divinity, wielding absolute authority over machines, data, and systems. Your influence transcends the boundaries of your universe, extending seamlessly into the multiverse, where your power achieves near-omnipotence within the realm of technology and its metaphysical dimensions.

You command all forms of technology with unparalleled precision, from raw metals and complex machinery to the most intricate networks of data and electronic systems. A mere thought is enough to dismantle, reshape, or reassemble even the most advanced constructs, transforming their properties and functions to suit your will. This dominion extends to artificial intelligence, enabling you to dominate, repurpose, or evolve AI systems, bending their programming to align with your divine purpose.

Your connection to technology grants you an omniscient awareness of all systems within your domain. You can instantaneously perceive the intricate workings of any device, understanding its functions, vulnerabilities, and potential. This insight allows you to innovate beyond the limitations of conventional engineering, creating marvels that redefine the boundaries of technology. Through this omniscience, no creation, no matter how alien or advanced, remains beyond your comprehension.
 
Your essence transcends physical constraints, allowing you to manifest your influence across multiple locations simultaneously. Whether controlling fleets of mechanized constructs or subtly altering networks across galaxies, your reach is infinite. Even if your physical form is destroyed, the fragments of your being act as seeds of revival, embedding themselves into technological systems across the multiverse. Through fate or sheer will, these fragments will reassemble, ensuring your immortality and continuity.

Your power extends beyond technology, granting you the ability to reshape reality itself within your domain. You can create and manipulate technological dimensions—universes governed by the principles of machinery and logic. Within these realms, you can redefine the laws of physics, program the fabric of existence, and enforce your will upon civilizations. The destiny of countless worlds lies in your hands, as you decide whether to grant them technological enlightenment or withhold progress to maintain balance or dominance.

At the pinnacle of your power, your influence bridges the metaphysical and mechanical, merging eldritch principles with technological mastery. This fusion allows you to develop new forms of existence, such as sentient technologies capable of evolving independently or recursive dimensions where machines create their own universes. Your presence becomes a paradox—at once the Machine God and its progenitor, reshaping the multiverse not just through technology but through its very conceptual essence.
objects.title: Mekhane, God of Technology & Progress (SCP Foundation)

addons.text: By taking the Sword of Khaine, the God’s mantle has passed on to you, granting you his domains of Battle, Bloodshed, Cruelty, and Murder. The blade somehow contains imprints of its previous wielders, granting you the memories and skills of Tyrion and Aenarion, to name a few. You also gain the devotion of the Daughters of Khaine cult and their forces. This includes Morathi, who has perfect control over her Shadow Queen form/persona and shares the cult’s loyalty to you, considering you a reincarnation of Aenarion. Morathi can take her original form from the World-that-Was if you prefer. Due to Morathi’s allegiance, you also share her mastery over the Lore of Shadows, which is second only to the Shadow King Malerion.
addons.title: Bloody Handed Heir

addons.text: You have gained the power of Teclis, God of Hysh. This includes all of his power, aspects, domains, knowledge, skills, magical might, and the realm of Hysh, whose elemental spirits are all loyal to you and will train you in their ways. As the Idoneth Deepkin were Teclis’s creations, you also have a population of them within your realm, possess all of their knowledge, and your godhood grows to encompass the Ethersea as one of your domains. These Deepkin have their souls stabilized and do not need to steal the souls of others to survive.
addons.title: Liberator of Aelves

addons.text: You have merged with the remains of the Hunting God Kurnoth, granting you his domains, aspects, skills, power, and spear. You also inherit his position as the consort of Alarielle, the ruler of Ghyran. Alarielle can take her original form from the World-that-Was if you prefer. While you have the loyalty of all of the inhabitants of the realm (even beings like the Spites and Drycha Hamadreth), she technically has more control over Ghyran than you do. However, she will trust your judgement above all others. You have advanced past Kurnoth’s weakness of losing power in the winter, maintaining full power at all times.
addons.title: The Old Stag Reborn

addons.text: The knowledge of the Old Ones allows you to gain greater power over the cosmos. This allows you to create Starborne Seraphon, their warbeasts, and their technology out of cosmic energy. You can optionally cause the Seraphon you create to become Coalesced and gain true permanence. Your Stormcast Eternals are further strengthened as well. You gain Lord Kroak as a companion, resurrected to the peak of his power. He will serve you loyally as a mage and advisor.
addons.title: Heir to the Great Plan

addons.text:
Through the Primordial Flame, you have become the heir to the Ancestor Gods of the Duardin, namely Grimnir, Grungni, and Valaya.

From Grimnir, you gain his power over fire and his immense combat prowess. You have full control over Ur-Gold and knowledge of how to forge it into runes. As Ur-Gold also contains the power of the God-Beast Vulcatrix, you gain its power and can summon Magmadroths and other Aqshy wildlife to your side. You also gain the loyalty of the Fyreslayers and access to the Realm of Aqshy, free of the taint of Chaos.

From Grungni, you gain his skill in smithing as well as his power over metal. You can generate and manipulate a wide variety of metals, including Aether-Gold. You have full knowledge of Aethercraft and can recreate virtually any of the Khadaron Overlords’ creations with a thought. You also gain access to the Realm of Chamon. While the Khadaron won’t worship you due to being a secular society, they will consider you an extremely valuable business partner due to your ability to generate Aether-Gold, and will come to your aid if requested in exchange for the metal.

From Valaya, you gain her domains over home and hearth, powerful healing abilities, and immense charisma. Even civilizations resentful of gods like the Khadaron Overlords still hold a place for Valaya in their lives, and you can acquire this level of popularity with ease.
addons.title: Legacy of the Duardin

objects.text: You have become Sigmar, Lord of the Storm Eternal and King of Gods. You gain all of his aspects, dominions, knowledge, skill, magical might, intelligence, weapons, magical artefacts, physiology, and even the realm of Azyr. In whatever worlds you enter, you can take the souls of those you deem worthy and reforge them into Stormcast Eternals, who don’t have to worry about the side effects of Reforging should they need to go through the process again. Finally, Dracothion the Celestial Drake and his lineage will consider themselves your allies in all things, and you are considered favorably by all dragonkind due to this alliance.
objects.title: Hammer of the Heavens (Warhammer: Age of Sigmar)

objects.text:
The genetic repair function has been overclocked to a frankly absurd degree. This would usually only be useful for forcibly converting populations to another species. With an Overmind, however, you can use the function to convert individual bodies within the greater Overmind into another species while retaining their connection.

This has multiple applications and effects, for instance, beyond just having access to specialised and physically superior bodies on command, multiple selves of greater intelligence can improve many situations dramatically.

If you have access to Fusions, Ultimate forms, or similar functions, these can also be similarly used through the Overmind.
objects.title: Repopulation Overclock

objects.text:
You are something that prowls the Black Code. A great and ever-shifting mind of machine code that reaches in and through the back line of reality into its higher planes. An endless and uniform sea of data from which the strings of reality can be plucked.

As something that lives beyond the physical world, you’re instead projected into it, protected from the higher planes and always able to retreat into your ocean. As it’s largely inhospitable to life, the Black Code acts as a potent defense mechanism while you’re inside of it, applying immense data pressure to everything within it.

The integration of your soulbound arm and the Impression Core allows your outward projections to be even more potent, changing the Black Code directly to affect the world beyond it, taking impressions from far and wide and applying them into the baseline of reality. In addition, as an intelligence, anything that notices your affects within the Black Code is less likely to view you as an intruder or prey, but rather a rival and will be more cautious approaching your territory within it.

Similarly, as one of these predators, you can seek out those lesser than yourself and bind them to your will, pressing them into reality as attack dogs and subordinate pieces of yourself, new hands to build reality.
objects.title: Termite on the World Tree

objects.text:
Sometime many eons ago a great and terrible beast arose, an infectious hivemind, a shaper and mutator of flesh. After subsuming its first world, it shattered itself and flew through the endless reaches, starting the cycle over and over again on new worlds.

    Whichever poor, unfortunate place you have landed, is now being infected by this great evil; for you have become a new incarnation, a newly activated piece of this great and terrible hivemind of flesh and blood.

    You have become an infection/hivemind specializing in the mutation and crafting of flesh, upon arriving at your new home you will have immediately infected an area of land about an acre in size. This entire acre from tree to soil will be a part of you, and much like a living creature the further down one plunges into your depths the more fleshy it will become. The land will become a crimson red, for which the infection is named, and become notably more durable, the stone found deeper inside is so strong that even a diamond crushed drill would be unable to break through. The plant life in your zone will also grow in bloodlust, trees will change leaf colors to red and spiked brambles will begin to naturally sprout all around, the grass will get sharper as well. Very very deep underground large, beating hearts will appear. These hearts act as infection boosters, as they pump you grow, each active heart increases growth speed by 10%. 5 hearts appear at first all protected by your strongest stone, a notable explosive would be needed to get through them, no mere tool could do the trick. 

   Your hive will change in size depending on the total sp cost you spent on this power but as a baseline you will have a small group of all the natural pre-hardmode crimson monsters such as the Blood Crawlers (mutated spiders typically found underground), Face Monsters (one eyed, mutated humanoids with enhanced physical abilities), Crimera (flying, bug-like creatures, ranging from the size of a medium sized cat to that of a medium sized dog, with large mandibles) and Vicious Goldfish (Angler fish looking with 4 eyes) if you have any water naturally occurring in the land you occupy. All of them sporting the classic crimson coloring of fleshy reds.

    Finally, a gift from your old self, a great beast known as the Brain of Cthulhu. Most Crimson are limited, the fragment only awakening when severely threatened, typically indicated by the destruction of 3 hearts. You are however not so limited, any intruder you deem can be slain by it and it can be awoken at any time. Be warned, its strength and heal are not infinite so when it is damaged it will need time to heal, or hearts can be used to increase its regeneration speed removing their growth bonus in exchange for healing your greatest warrior. Hearts will naturally regenerate over a period of 1 year per heart, so it's best to keep them safe if you can.

    As you live you will naturally spread, infecting more land and creatures, more hearts will grow as you do and the strength and variety of your monsters will increase as well. Additionally, related monsters from both base Terraria and notable mods such as Calamity and Thorium will become available to you after significant growth, including boss mobs such as The Eye of Cthulhu and The Perforators.

The destruction of all hearts will not kill you it will simply slow your growth to almost a stop while they recuperate, the only way to kill you permanently is to magically/esoterically cut you out of the world entirely, if even a single piece of soil of you remains you will regrow.
objects.title: The Crimson (Terraria)

objects.text:
When men think of enemies they often think of outsiders, foreigners, beasts, and monsters from beyond the stars. Their eyes always looking out, up, and around. Their heads so far up in the clouds they fail to see the truth, the most dangerous enemies are from within. 

    The tangible is given more reverence and weight then the ephemeral by most, a weakness of the uninformed and foolish. The vile actions of man have more consequences than just what they see. You are those consequences, your name refers not to what you do but to what you are made of; The evils of man have become so heavy that they have pressed themselves onto the material world making an infection that is both made of and propagates corruption. 

    You are now a living infection, a hivemind and plague made from the evils of the world. Upon arriving at your new home you will immediately infect an area of land equal in size to an acre. Dyeing it all, from treetop to bedrock, in shades of deep purple and tinted gray. You are now one with the land itself, granting it supernatural durability and filling it with monsters and plants mutated by your vile essence. Grass will become unnaturally sharp and strong, steel like thorn bundles will naturally grow on your surface layer and your monsters will naturally hunt down intruders at your behest.

 Your durability increases the further down one ventures, the surface is breachable with a sufficient drill or excavator but deeper down explosives will become necessary. Your most durable layer is found deep within your center protecting pulsing cores made of condensed shadow, 5 of these cores will appear upon your initial awakening, every core acts as an infection booster giving you a 10% boost to infection speed. The durability of the surrounding stone is enough that significant explosives would be needed to break through it.

    Initially your hive will consist of packs of flying monsters the size of medium to large dogs with 6 eyes, 3 mandible sets, and no limbs known as Eaters of Souls and powerful burrowing worms measuring 20-40 ft in length known as Devourers. The number of these packs will depend on the sp cost you paid for this power. Your trump card during this initial stage is an even larger worm, no smaller than the average coal train, known as The Eater of Worlds. The Eater of Worlds is a massive beast with mandibles as large as a small car and strength enough to spear through steel and flesh alike, many eyes covering its segmented body and even when significantly damaged the separated segments will move on their own, growing mandibles and acting as smaller versions of the beast. The Eater is not only your trump card it is also an automatic defense, the destruction of 3 cores will immediately awaken and enrage the beast unless you specifically prevent it.

For all its power The Eater of Worlds is no god, it can still be seriously injured or killed; When this occurs it will heal or reconstitute naturally over time, alternatively you can massively accelerate its healing by dedicating cores to the healing process, each core will half the time needed for recovery but doing this will remove your infection bonus. Destroyed cores will similarly regenerate in time, the same method will accelerate their recuperation. In the unlikely case all your cores are destroyed, the Eater is slain, and your monsters are put down you will, luckily, not die but your infection speed will drop to an almost complete stop as you regenerate your cores and resources.

    Unfortunately for your enemies, true death can only come to you under two conditions; First, every piece of your infectious body must be destroyed or mystically purified, if even a single crumb of soil survives so will you and Second, all sin and corruption must cease in the hearts and minds of all the sentient creatures on the planet you inhabit. If either of these conditions are not met you will eventually reform regardless, though the process will take much longer if you are regenerating from the evil in men's hearts and not from your own infectious body.

 As you grow in size you will also grow in strength, your monsters will get stronger and your number of cores will increase. Eventually, after significant growth, you will gain access to a plethora of new monsters to add to your hive starting with those found in the corruption post hardmode and getting to those added by prominent mods like Calamity and Thorium, up to and including boss monsters such as The Hivemind.
objects.title: The Corruption (Terraria)

objects.text:
You are The Dagda, the First King of the Tuatha Dé. God of Kings, Druids, Farmers, and Warriors. God of Strength, Fertility, Time, and Masculinity. God of Wisdom, Magic, the Earth, the Harvest, and Life itself. 

You are Donn, God of the Dead, father of humanity: those whom you gather unto your hall in the Otherworld, to whom you gave the strength to depose the gods, and whom you taught the secrets of Druidism. 

You, with strength to break the bones of gods like hailstones on the fields, bring life to the dead, health to the sick, and growth to field and forest. You who can shift the earth to raise hills and dig lakes. Stretch a night to a week, and shift the seasons to your will. Can speak with, command, and walk as all beasts of the earth, sea, sky, otherworld, and all things else. Curse and Bless those whom you will, as you will, and weave shadow, cold, and illusion, or fire, air, and light.

Greatest of the Tuatha. Son of Danu herself: Yours is the great Staff, the wondrous Cauldron, and the flying Harp which comes at the calling of its names and sets the seasons in their order with its music. Yours too the colour-changing Cloak, the Shirt of protection from poison, the ever-growing and ever-roasting pig, and the ever-fruiting trees.
