You keep all your dwellings: misty Tech Duinn in the sea where the souls of the dead gather, Uisneach centre of Ériu and abode of Druids where the sacred Beltane fire is lit, and Brú na Bóinne where the light of the new year shines in the heart of Winter, and all the halls of the Otherworld they lead to.

You are the Striker. The Great Horned One. First of the Tuatha. God worshipped by gods and men alike. Hail Eochaid! Mighty One! Father of gods and men!​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​
objects.title: The Good God

objects.text: Increases the frequency of charges. Each purchase halves the time between charges generated (every 3.5 days, 1.75 days, 21h).
objects.title: Increased Frequency (Tinker of Fiction)

objects.text: You generate 1 additional charge per cycle.
objects.title: Increased Charges (Tinker of Fiction)

objects.text: You can now choose tech trees. You can still optionally select for random tech trees but if you have a specific tree in mind it won't be up to RNG.
objects.title: Multiple Choice (Tinker of Fiction)

objects.text: You're now no longer restricted to using one tech tree at a time, allowing you to mix and match tech. You can integrate the Crysis Nanosuit into your MJOLNIR power armor, mount Alpha Centauri Singularity Weapons on the Normandy, install Star Wars holoprojectors in your Pipboy, and generally ignore the boundaries between tech trees.
objects.title: Multidisciplinary (Tinker of Fiction)

objects.text:
Each Node, as you purchase or upgrade a technology tree, you gain not only the technology but also the corresponding expertise tied to that tree. This expertise can range from intellectual, tactical, and strategic knowledge to cultural insights and practical skills, all integrated seamlessly into your mind and body. This power grants you a comprehensive understanding of the systems, philosophies, and techniques from the fictional universe where the technology originates, transforming you into both a creator and practitioner.

For example, unlocking a tier in Mass Effect's Human Tech tree might grant you Cerberus spy training or Alliance military tactics. Gaining access to Warhammer 40k’s Adeptus Mechanicus tech would not only give you intricate knowledge of machine crafting but also a deep understanding of their Rites, Canticles, and Prayers, even those outside of pure technological worship. Similarly, unlocking the Endless Space Horatio faction’s tech would provide insights into cloning and eugenics-based societal planning.
objects.title: Thinker of Fiction (Tinker of Fiction)

objects.text:
The Gamer System has undergone significant evolution through its integration with Tinker of Fiction, resulting in transformative changes. A key addition is the Technology Tab, a comprehensive archive of knowledge that spans every conceivable world. This feature encompasses super-science, speculative advancements, and potential future human technologies. It goes beyond fictional universes, offering access to a near-limitless repository of innovation and possibility.

The system operates using two types of currency: Catalog Points (CP) and Tech Tree Points (TTP). Catalog Points allow you to unlock technologies specific to individual factions, species, or civilizations. For example, you could acquire the full scope of human technology from Mass Effect, covering all past, present, and future innovations within that universe. Meanwhile, Tech Tree Points enable access to entire tech trees, granting you the collective advancements of all factions and species within a given setting. These tech trees are broader and more comprehensive, but their costs reflect their increased scope and value.

The cost of accessing catalogs or tech trees varies based on their complexity, rarity, and potential impact. For instance, in the Mass Effect universe, a Human Technology Catalog costs 10 points, while species-specific catalogs for the Asari or Turians are priced according to the sophistication of their contributions. Catalogs for ancient or extinct civilizations, such as the Reapers or Protheans, are the most expensive due to their advanced and enigmatic nature.
 
Unlocking the entire Mass Effect Tech Tree, which consolidates all species and factions, requires approximately 100 points. Specialized catalogs, such as those focusing on Material Science for creating advanced materials or FTL Technology for faster-than-light travel, are also available. These targeted options allow you to tailor your acquisitions to meet specific needs or goals.

Points are earned through gameplay achievements, such as completing quests, exploring dungeons, overcoming significant challenges, and altering the destinies of worlds. The more difficult the task, the greater the rewards. Additionally, the system provides a daily allowance of 1 point for each currency type, ensuring consistent progress.

Every week, you’ll receive a curated selection of ten settings from which you can unlock tech trees and catalogs. You can purchase as many as your points allow, with all acquisitions becoming permanent additions to your archive. The selection refreshes monthly, offering new opportunities to expand your repository. If you have high system intelligence, you may request specific settings to unlock; however, this comes at an increased cost.

Once technologies are unlocked, they become a permanent part of your system. This grants you the ability to combine innovations from different worlds and create entirely new advancements that transcend the limitations of individual universes. For example, you could integrate FTL propulsion with Typhon-derived materials or merge Asari biotics with Cyberpunk neural interfaces. The Tech System is more than an archive; it’s a tool for creativity and unprecedented technological progress.
objects.title: The Tinker System

addons.text: Your expertise in handling the system’s source code reaches the kernel, your modification now can range to a complete overhaul of the system’s mechanics, and you can code just about any feature by programming it within the system. This results in the jailbreaking of the system itself.
addons.title: Superuser

addons.text: Your Toolbar has granted you access to the Editor Subsystem, which takes the form of any 3D editor of your choice and can be customized to suit your preferences. This subsystem gives you complete control over your Powers and Skills, allowing you to reshape their mechanics and forms like clay. It even enables you to create entirely new powers and skills, though with certain limitations. For instance, you must design any new power from scratch, and unfortunately, you cannot grant these powers to yourself instantly. While the Gamer System can create things from nothing, it doesn’t allow you to gain everything without effort. The stronger the power you design, the more challenging the conditions for acquiring it will be.
addons.title: Editor UI

objects.text:
You can access the inner workings of your system(s?) through the Debugger Console. This special window grants you access to the source code and assets that run the Gamer System. The language used is unknown to you unless you have code-related powers or skills. Modifications you do through the console happen in real-time and your system will glitch out if your code has bugs. Thankfully, there is a version control system built in so you can save your modifications and revert to an earlier state if you wish.

While you can modify the inner workings of the system and are able to change the rules, you cannot modify your player data directly and are still limited by some rules. The level of freedom you have with your modifications depends on how strong you are.
objects.title: Debugger Console

addons.text:
Your Guild has resonated with your Eternal Flame, greatly empowering its aspects. Now, once someone becomes a member of your Guild, they are granted the true immortality of the Eternal Flame, allowing them to live for all eternity and never truly remain dead. However, as the Guild Master, if you expel someone from your Guild, you may also choose to remove their blessing of the Eternal Flame.

Your Guild’s dimension now has two new functions. First, a “Respawn Point,” which acts as an anchor that allows a Guild member to resurrect at this location within your pocket dimension, either by choice or if they die in a dangerous location. Second, your Guild members now have access to a place called the “Arena,” where they can challenge one another to battle, whether to the death or not, as they can simply resurrect afterward.

As your Guild has been enhanced by the power of the Eternal Flame, its size has expanded significantly. For example, what could once be compared to a village is now akin to a city. Your members’ connection to the Guild has also been strengthened, making the links between them unbreakable and untraceable by anyone or anything. Lastly, access to your personal dimension has been sealed against all outside entities that are not members of your Guild, rendering it essentially impenetrable.
addons.title: Halls of Valhalla

objects.text:
You now possess a Guild connected to your system, with a Guildhall located within a pocket dimension for your and your Guild members’ personal use. You can use it to invite people you know to join you, and the Guild also grants a system to each person you invite, allowing them to possess unlimited potential and eventually surpass any limits they previously had.

Your Guild is anchored to you and your system, and thus can be brought with you to any place you have been. Within the pocket dimension, you can adjust the flow of time from 10% to 1000%, individually for each room. It also contains a wide array of other functions and conveniences for your day-to-day needs, as well as entertainment of any non-supernatural variety you might desire.

Your Guild also has levels of its own, which can be increased either by members pooling their resources into it or through their collective efforts and hard work. As your Guild increases in level, it will not only grow in size and complexity, but will also gain new abilities and refine existing ones.
objects.title: Guild Master

objects.text:
In order to help you get used to your great and phenomenal cosmic power, your game system has locked the majority of your powers behind unlocks and progression through the system. You now start out as a Real lvl 1 player, and can only select for your starting powers up to 10sp worth of power from your purchased powers, you can use this to buy into more expensive powers but are completely limited in what you have access to within that chosen power to the level of 10sp, and can choose a starting quest that unlocks another power at 10sp.

You will gain statistics or attributes that quantify your your current self and your powers, but your system must be progressed through just as much as your other powers. 

All powers are locked behind quests which must be completed, these quests are generated via some reaction to something in the real world these quests will attempt to challenge your current power level but should align somehow with the power it unlocks, or they can be forcefully generated through focused meditation. Forcefully generated quests are more likely  to be unfair or harder to complete, but no quest will be generated as impossible. If you fail a power quest, that power goes on an unlock cooldown and will take time before you can quest for it again.

To progress your powers and earn more sp worth of their power you have to train or use the powers in ways that push their limits in order to unlock and level them.
objects.title: Systematic Progression Systems

addons.text: Your Companion Quests are now streamlined into a questline consisting of 10 steadily harder Quests per Companion. Each Quest rewards you with 1 SL, with the last granting SL 10 and solidifying their status as your Companion. In addition, the Quests slightly alter the rewards for every other SL, allowing you to choose between a pair of Traits, Powers, or Items instead of simply granting one. For non-Companions, the Questlines still exist but typically consist of more Quests with only one Trait granted every other SL as usual.
addons.title: Social Link Quests

objects.text: Instead of fate doing all the work in getting you and your companions to meet and connect, you will have to progress along a questline and raise your reputation up with your companions during  these quests. These quests do not control the people becoming your compaions, and if you fail them or do poorly you will lose reputation just as you would normally. You need at least one companion for this drawback to take effect.
objects.title: Companion Quests

addons.text:
The Debugger Console grants you direct access to the underpinnings of the game world, enabling you to alter game mechanics and assets in real-time. With the Debugger Console, you are no longer just a player—you become a system manipulator. Through this console, you can interact with and edit the game’s source code, game logic, NPC behaviors, and world assets.

The modifications you make using the Debugger Console are live, meaning the world reacts immediately to changes, but be careful—any errors or bugs in your code can cause system glitches or even destabilize the game world temporarily. Fortunately, a built-in version control system helps mitigate this risk. You can save versions of your work and revert to a previous state if necessary.

While your ability to modify the system is powerful, the extent of what you can do depends on your strength and proficiency. The stronger your character, the more you can bend the rules and manipulate the system.

You cannot directly manipulate the game’s core “player data” (i.e., health, experience, etc.), but you can still exert influence over the environment, enemy NPCs, and game progression. If you reach certain milestones in the system, you may discover hidden functions or exploit weaknesses in the world, giving you further leverage.
addons.title: Hacker’s Interface

addons.text:
You can use Dungeon Maker within your Game World, allowing you to create, explore, and conquer dungeons within the game dimension. Any loot obtained inside these dungeons, or elsewhere in the Game World, can be transferred to the real world, where it will appear in your inventory.

As the Game World follows a respawn system: whenever you die within the dungeon, you will reappear outside at the entrance fully healed and restored. You may re-enter the dungeon at any time, but all loot and experience gained during that run will be lost.

To mitigate this, dungeons contain designated resting areas between specific floors. Resting at one of these areas allows you to save your progress. If you die after resting, you will respawn at the last resting floor you reached, rather than at the dungeon entrance. However, any loot and experience gained on floors above that resting point will still be lost. And if you leave the dungeon, the floors will reset, forcing you to go through the dungeon again.
addons.title: The Deep Dungeons

objects.text: When you sleep, you gain access to an entirely new dimension—a hyper-realistic game realm directly connected to your Gamer System. You can choose the layout of this realm. It can be modeled after the world of an existing game, such as Dark Souls, or it can be an entirely unique creation shaped by your imagination. Within this realm, you’ll encounter NPCs, monsters, and an array of game mechanics, such as respawn, quick time events and more. The realm also offers opportunities for your Class Change. For example, you can locate specialised trainers who align with your chosen class. These mentors can accelerate your development, enabling you to level up rapidly and even granting access to rare or hidden class-specific abilities. Exploration and interaction play a key role, as building relationships with NPCs can lead to benefits, ranging from hidden items, quests or even more. Progress made within this realm directly affects your real-world self. Skills, experience, and abilities gained transfer seamlessly between both realities. Additionally, relationships formed with NPCs may reach a level where they can be brought into the real world. Time in the Game World is faster that the real world, with 3 hours in the game world being 1 hour in the real world. If you took Accelerated Training upgrade then the time in the Game World can be accelerated further.
objects.title: Game World

objects.text:
Instead of automatically mutating, Dynamist jr. will build an ever-growing upgrade tree for your powers.

Each power has its own upgrade tree, how it works depends on the power itself but will usually follow either a fully diverging tree or a simple web of interconnected nodes.

The number of nodes you can select depends on the form of the skill tree. For webs, the number of choices is proportional to the size.

Choices are not permanent, you can change your selection whenever you want. It takes around 5 minutes of meditation for the power to reconfigure itself, during this it cannot be used actively. Interrupting the meditation will result in a failed reconfiguration and other consequences.
objects.title: Skill Tree Jr.

objects.text: With each purchase of this upgrade, Dynamist Jr.'s rate of growth both vertically and horizontally is doubled: Power mutations that would normally take four days to manifest would now take two days, then one, then twelve hours, and so on. This upgrade also divides the time needed for Skill Tree Jr. to reconfigure itself by 1.5 with each purchase.
objects.title: Growth Boost (Dynamist Jr.)

addons.text:
With the influence of Engine of Escalation, the rate at which you can develop desired mutations has skyrocketed. While significant deviations still take a long time to achieve, small improvements in line with how the power already functions can be manifested in mere minutes.

This also has nullified any need for maintenance, as any manifestation of mutations will already be precisely engineered to integrate with your existing powers.

Lastly, you can now exclude some powers from developing chaotic mutations at all if you do not wish so, with them only growing in strength, not at all, or only manifesting precisely the mutations you desire.
addons.title: Precision Power Engineering

objects.text:
You can now much more accurately influence the direction that your powers’ growth takes, allowing you to guide your mutations through specific and niche pathways rather than general themes and shapes - though, the prioritization of more imminently-useful adaptations when you are challenged or in need still remain.

As a secondary bonus, you can now “plan” your powers’ growth and set them on a sort of autopilot, allowing them to continue on a specific, predetermined course you've visualized without continued influence, assuming no such moments of immediate need arise.
objects.title: Fine-Tuned Growth

addons.text: Your mutation engine seamlessly integrates its two branches of evolution. All powers selected through Dynamist are now treated as core powers for the purposes of Lesser Dynamist. They receive the full benefit of accelerated growth—both in speed and strength—and are prioritized by the engine for mutations, optimizations, and sub-power development.
addons.title: Unified Evolution

addons.text: Your mutation engine now has dynamic control over its evolutionary priorities. You can now manually retask the enhanced growth effect of Dynamist Jr. (and Dynamist, if applicable) onto any powers of your choosing.
addons.title: Retasked Focused

addons.text:
All of your powers, regardless of core status, now benefit from the enhanced speed and strength of core power growth. Horizontal mutations, vertical reinforcements, and synergistic refinements occur across your entire build without distinction.

With no need for selective focus, the engine operates at peak efficiency at all time for all powers allowing your entire power suite to evolve in tandem.
addons.title: Dynamist Released

objects.text:
Your mutation engine gains a deeper core of intelligence and autonomy. It is now capable of a more concentrated evolution, applying its strength with far greater focus. 

You gain three Major Powers that each cost up to 30 SP and five Minor Powers that each cost up to 15 SP. You can choose powers from the Shard list only if you have Essence of Shard. These powers are integrated directly into the core of your mutation engine and serve as the foundation of its focused evolution.

Dynamist Jr. evolves these core powers at close to twice its normal speed and strength, enhancing them both horizontally with new sub-abilities and vertically by reinforcing key traits. However, all other non-core powers will still mutate at the the normal rate of Dynamist Jr. 

Once selected, these core powers are fixed. They cannot be swapped, replaced, or reassigned by any abilities tied to Dynamist jr. Your mutation engine treats them as permanent fixtures and uses them as its preferred ground for experimentation and refinement.
objects.title: Lesser Dynamist

objects.text: Your Character Sheet now has a constantly updating list of Quests that you can take on. Each Quest has a variety of rewards, from minor amounts of XP, free feats, to even unique Special Characteristics. Quests can possible have bonus options that you are able to complete for extra rewards, or even hidden requirements that can grant you incredible rewards.
objects.title: Quests

objects.text: You are now able to change your from Human (or whatever Physical Race Changes you had) to a new race or even a hybrid between various races. This selection of races is initially limited to the options available in both D&D and Pathfinder. You are able to change your race beyond this initial switch as well, to do so you must both have enough XP and meet the qualifications for the new race. You will never be unsatisfied with the results of your new race or hybrid.
objects.title: Race Change

objects.text: Your Character Sheet is now somehow connected to a omniverse wide store. While D&D and Pathfinder items will population a sizable portion of this store, everything you could ever wish for can be found here. You shouldn’t be surprised at the prices when you go looking for one of a kind and other wise unique items. Anything can be used as a currency, not just gold, experience, memories, emotions, rare metals, and even magical energy can be used if the seller is willing to accept it. Anything bought through this store cannot be tracked, nobody will be able to discover your identity unless you wholeheartedly wish to share it without any manipulation.
objects.title: Store

objects.text: You have no level limit of 20 with this Character Sheet, and have no restrictions on your Multi-Classing capabilities. You are capable reaching Epic Level Spells and so much more.
objects.title: Epic Leveling

objects.text: You have no restrictions on the spell levels you are able to cast, allowing you to go beyond the 9th level of spells. Clerics are able to select a god to worship, and beware the connection between you and you god, for not all gods are benevolent. Warriors are able to slaughter entire planets and fight the Divine in poor conditions and win with ease. Artificers can create artifacts that can make even the Divine jealous.
objects.title: Beyond Heroic

objects.text:
You are no longer limited to choosing from options from first-party content for your Character Sheet. You may select options created by third-party publishers such as Spheres of Power, Wayfinder books, and various others. 

You can also instead create custom content yourself, such as new Classes, Spells, Traits, Feats, and even items if you can craft magical items, though be aware you can only twist the rules so far. 

Either of these options will incur an experience penalty based on the strength of content you are pulling from or have created, which will slow the advancement of your Character Sheet and how quickly you can level up.

Also, this upgrade will affect other Character Sheet upgrades, such as the Shop upgrade and Race Change, should you have it, with the price of created items or races being raised based on their strength compared to normal first-party items.
objects.title: Third-Party and Homebrew Content

addons.text:
Your Character slots can now each have a sheet of their own, from a different tabletop system or the same should you so desire. You can divide any experience you gain across characters as you please, but the pool is shared. 

If one of your sheets’ systems deals in experience in the tens of thousands and another in singular digits, the ratio will be weighted to retain a level of consistency in terms of growth. (ie a sheet from Exalted won't be reaching its maximum capability from missing two levels as a Pathfinder Wizard.
addons.title: Indecisive

addons.text:
Rather than making simple singular Skill cards, you can instead choose to create full Character Sheets of any system you have access to, These sheets act much like your own, but are linked to the physical object. When creating the sheet it can either be created by transferring an amount of experience from your own sheet(s) as long as it has not been spent, or instead create them as you would a Skill Card, channelling the powers and abilities of others where applicable. 

Anyone with possession of the sheet gains the specific build specified upon it, but can use any experience or milestone advancement gained after to alter it as you can your own.
addons.title: Sheet Cards
Gestalt²
addons.text:
Your indecisive nature has proven to be a huge benefit thanks to the merging of various specialized powers; you are now able to merge your various Characters from your different Character sheets into a single Gestalt wherein you have your various powers from different systems to create something better then the sum of their parts such as mixing a wizard class from several different systems and being able to use the magic of the various systems or combining a caster class from one setting with a melee build and being able to do both.

This would also let you combine various spells from systems that would otherwise be incompatible, such as allowing you to be a vampire and a mage at the same time despite it being otherwise impossible while doing a Gestalt, combining your Mage: The Ascension character with a VtM Kindred. You can also combine spells, for example, casting two spells with similar effects from two settings to get a better effect; however,  keep in mind that spell slots and other energies are separate from one another.

Despite your classes now being able to combine into a single build, the experience is still weighted towards consistency. (i.e. a sheet from Exalted won't reach its maximum capability by gaining two levels as a Pathfinder Wizard in a theoretical Gestalt combining a Pathfinder Wizard with a Solar Exalt.

addons.title: Kindred Character Sheet
addons.text:
With your ability to use non-D&D-related properties via "god I fucking hate D&D", you can port your existing Kindred status into a character sheet. You will have gained a separate character sheet that tracks your progress as a Kindred.

One of the biggest benefits to this is that you are now able to have a boost in learning your vampiric disciplines and grow them much faster than normal, as you can use your experience to level your disciplines, putting more dots into them, as Vampire: The Masquerade does not have traditional levels, and even picking up new disciplines from other clans. However, they will be full price, unlike the discount you would get with disciplines from your clan.

Should you have the other upgrades to the character sheet, your kindred nature can add to the utility; for example, with store you will find that items from the World of Darkness universe are slightly cheaper than normal, or you can use homebrew clans, disciplines and other homebrew content should you have Third-Party and Homebrew Content.

addons.title: Exalted Character Sheet
addons.text:
Due to your ability to have a character sheet for non D&D related properties and you being an exalted you are now able to port your already existing essence level 1 as your current exalt power into your character sheet and have gained a separate character sheet that tracks your progress as an exalted letting you level faster then if you just had the modified character sheet for exalted given by God I Fucking Hate Dungeons And Dragons.

One of the biggest benefits of this is not needing to gain that first level in being an exalted; however, the benefit after is being able to use your character sheet as a boost for learning how to use your abilities as an exalted and furthering your growth than if you were to learn them naturally gaining a discount in your character sheet for any abilities that are from your specific Caste. 

If you have other character sheet upgrades, your exalted nature can add utility, such as finding items from the exalted universe slightly cheaper than normal, or using homebrew charms if you have Third-Party and Homebrew Content.

objects.text:
Your Character Sheet is no longer limited to Dungeons and Dragons, and now extends to any tabletop game of your choice. The system must be chosen from the point you take this upgrade.

Your growth in these sheets will naturally also fall under the domain of the system chosen. (Ie, a Vampire: the Requiem sheet will have a far lower ‘exp’ gain but since it requires less XP to grow it will equal the same rough level of power)

Note: As different TTRPGS vary in internal strength vastly, the stronger the initial power of a system chosen the more effort will be required to grow. A Nobilis character, for instance, would essentially be locked into its starting position while a more grounded system would grow incredibly quickly.
objects.title: God I Fucking Hate Dungeons And Dragons

objects.text: You now have one level in every class considered official from the edition your character sheet comes from—each selection grants one more level—and while these levels don't count towards your level cap each individual class still can't go over level 20.
objects.title: Abserd (D&D/Pathfinder)

objects.text:
Your power's scope has been increased. You now have the ability to summon up to seven other versions of yourself to fight alongside you. Your coordination with one another is perfect and they are absolutely loyal to you. The other versions can be as powerful as whatever your strongest form has been, but as you get stronger so do the scope of your possible versions you can summon. 

If one of them dies you may resummon them to revive them, and if they survive past your death, one of them will receive your memories and soul and perfectly merge with you to resurrect you. This will not cause you any changes, it'll just cause them to be desummoned and you summoning yourself back to life in their place, and they can be recalled back as soon as you’re alive again. 

This power can now also be extended unto others and objects, allowing you to alter them into different versions of themselves and/or summon up to seven copies of them, however you choose whether their copies are loyal to you or the one you copied from, and you choose whether they can revive through their copies or not. You can over time increase the amount of copies you can summon.
objects.title: Into the You-niverse

objects.text: Your skill as an teacher has been greatly improved. You may designate up to a dozen students  that will learn at a highly accelerated rate in comparison to others, if you had every single power listed here, an average student plucked off the street would be able to learn everything you are willing to offer over the course of 10 years. Your own skill and rate of learning as a student is also increased by an equal margin if you were to learn on your own, and ten times that if your were to find a teacher.
objects.title: Accelerated Course

objects.text: You may designate up to one person as your apprentice allowing them to learn at an incredibly accelerated rate. If you had every single power listed here, and they were no more than an average student that you could pluck off the street then they could learn everything you have to offer in no more than 3 years. You own rate of learning and skill is also improved my the same margin, and 10 times that if you were to find a teacher.
objects.title: Apprentice

addons.text:
You can now imbue skill cards with information, powers, skills, and perks written down, recorded, or otherwise held in some kind of medium.

From ancient scrolls detailing the secrets of waterbending, the Scroll of Seals from Konohagakure, to Jedi Holocrons, to even the knowledge stored away in your archive. 

Anything can be imbued into a skill card, which can be used to instantly learn and comprehend anything on them by their users. You do not have to understand the info to imbue it into a skill card. 

This can also be used it imbue properties and other traits into skill cards, such as imbuing regular objects or object of power into a skill card. 

What this does is it allows the one who gains an Object of Power through this a charge that they can expend on an object, which will in turn grow/turn into the object of power.

Alternatively the skill card can be used to learn the abilities and properties of the Object of Power directly, forgoing the need for the object entirely.
addons.title: Encyclopedic Skill Cards

addons.text:
You can create skill cards from the skills, powers, and perks of anyone you defeat or other wise win against in a wager. This also allows you to forgo actually taking them from your opponent. 

This also expands your ability to create skill cards from any creature(s) and/or item(s), allowing you to imbue abilities, skills, perks, properties, and qualities otherwise not easily obtained. 

Your skill cards also are improved upon to be able to be imbued with far more than before, allowing you to touch upon more esoteric and conceptual aspects.
addons.title: Winner’s Spoils
Limited Use Cards
addons.text:
You can now impose certain restrictions on your Skill Cards, such as limiting who may receive the powers, skills, and perks imbued in them, implementing specific requirements the holders have to fulfill before gaining them, or defining a limited time period before they lose them again.

Alternatively you can produce Limited Use Cards that allow their holder a number of instances in which they may use the imbued powers before automatically breaking. For example, blocking one instance of a Thinker power using Blank, performing a risky jump with the Parkour skill, and conjuring a wind blade with Elementalism may each take a point off the maximum use count. Importantly, the holders of these cards do not gain the powers, skills and perks as their own compared to normal Skill Cards.

objects.text:
You’ve gained the ability to create Skill Cards. Anyone who comes into possession of a skill card can use it to instantly gain what is imbued into the card. 

You can imbue Powers, Skills, and Perks in any combination into the card, including the ability to make skill cards itself. You can also imbue the powers, skills and perks of others into a card with their consent. It typically takes a minute to make a card and as many as you wish can be made.

The cards can be made sturdy enough to be as durable as steel, and will last forever and can be used as many times as you wish, or at the time of creation you can establish whether the card will disintegrate and disappear after a set number of usages.
objects.title: Skill Cards

objects.text:
You were born a blue blood, a nobility of the highest order. Your Authority reflects this, self-actualizing your own power to a higher level, tremendously increasing the fluidity and strength of your Authority. Your Aspects grow as if they received the full amount of your Authority’s growth, understand that you do not actually lose any Authority for this new method of development. Temporarily and permanently allocating Authority is now qualitatively more effective. Even temporarily allocating your Authority will permanently increase your base level by a small fraction of what the original boost was if utilized effectively

There are no limits to what you can achieve through your self actualizing capabilities, although that does not mean that everything will be easy. You will now receive even greater benefits from performing outstanding feats.
objects.title: Aristocrat

objects.text:
You are capable of creating physical representations of your Authority. There are two different forms that can be created inside your Authority: Frameworks and Armaments. Frameworks are formed through the careful condensation of your Authority. Armaments are created once you have attuned an Aspect to a specific Framework. For some Frameworks, this process is almost instantaneous, while others can take up to years. 

Frameworks and Armaments grow with their creator through use and experience, as your legend grows, you will find that both your Frameworks and Armaments adapt to always be in line with your capabilities. Even after attuning your first Aspect, your Armaments will be attunable to more Aspects over time. You are capable of storing both Frameworks and Armaments inside your Authority, taking merely a moment to deconstruct and reconstruct them as needed. Attuned Aspects receive incredible boosts in growth as you use each Armament more.
objects.title: Artisan

objects.text:
Your Authority is attuned to combat in all its forms, granting you an instinctual understanding of how to manipulate your body and Authority for proper combat. Martial techniques will come to you as if you were born to use them. Through a small concentrated effort you can create Methods, powerful techniques that harness your Authority and its Aspects to dramatically enhance your capabilities. 

Mundane techniques can be blended together to form an art that could let even a mortal fight against those that are supernatural. You can create both mundane techniques in addition to Methods. While Methods can be easily created, it takes true dedication and insight to elevate and evolve a Method to new heights. Methods can be utilized in conjunction with one another or merged for greater effect. 

You start off knowing 4 Methods as a starting bonus, one devoted to the offense, one for defense, another for utility, and a final one for movement. While these four starting Methods are nothing incredible, they can be taken to untold heights with the proper attention.
objects.title: Warrior

objects.text:
You are a mentor, a teacher, a guide. It is not enough for you to walk the path of enlightenment, forever walking and realizing your true self, no you guide others along the same path. You are able to carve out a small portion of your own Weight to awaken Authority in another, making them capable of self-actualization like you. While their powers are minor and insignificant in comparison to yours, the Weight of their Authority derived from their own accomplishments, they possess the incredible ability to grow ever more powerful alongside you. 

They will need to draw from your own Authority to aid them at first for greater feats, but as they become more and more powerful the Authority they generate will evolve into Aspects of their own, after which they will in turn become capable of awakening and mentoring others in turn.  Any Authority and Aspects they evolve, and grow is in turn reflected in your power granting you greater strength the stronger your students and their own growth. 

You may choose to instead carve out a more significant portion of your Authority to help speed along the process of empowering your students. You have exceptional skill in teaching anyone.
objects.title: Mentor

objects.text:
You are born to overcome, a true Conqueror of the ages. Overcoming adversity now grants you both an Aspect that is related to the source of adversity, and an increase in Weight proportional to the difficulty of the challenge. In addition, every being you overcome allows you to replicate powers, abilities, stats, and even traits from them, even the weakest of the beings have something for you to add to your own legend. The target of your Conquest is not entirely up to your choice, as you are only able to influence what you receive in the beginning, although you will never be dissatisfied or harmed by what you subjugate. In time you will be able to control what you receive with great precision.

As you overcome adversity you'll find that your current capabilities will excel in situations you have previously prevailed over, skills you already possess will expand in scope, scale, and potency. Defeat the world’s greatest swordsman and you’ll find yourself with skill capable of carving mountains, out muscle a feared warrior and your blows could split the earth, wander the world and you’ll find yourself crossing into new realms.
objects.title: Conqueror

objects.text:
Creates an AI equivalent representation of your power that resides within the Tower of Power. The beings created will manifest their body and personality based on your tastes and the power they represent. 

The power representatives can help you manage your power, complete challenges in the rooms, help you, or complete challenges while you are away. The room challenges they can complete without your help start out as just generic simple increases in your powers, but with a positive relationship and more room and tower progress, their ability to complete challenges grows.

 These representations are not sentient and are more like complex video game characters, if you decide that you don’t like the current representative you can choose to generate a new version, with your progress saved between representatives.
objects.title: Organization of Power

addons.text: Your representatives will start at a baseline neutral relationship with you and requires development of that relationship in order to get their help to progress, as well as each representation acting as a test or obstacle of your power mastery that you have to progress past to reach deeper rooms or higher floors. You can choose how this relationship manifests whether it is like a dating sim, real-life interactions or even boss monsters for each floor that have to be defeated in whatever way
addons.title: Dynamic Relationship Systems

objects.text:
Your access to the powers that connect through it has been changed, all of your powers now start at their most basic and level of power, taking into account any power structures that exist within your powers already (Levels, tier systems, cultivation levels). The Tower will now structure its powers in different floors so that you can only gain access to all your power by unlocking each floor. Any power that is meant mostly to save your life such as immortality powers will work however the form they take can differ depending on how many floors of power you have unlocked. An instant revive might not take months, or revives you in a safe place far away from the action you were hoping to stay in.
Each floor you go up will let you ascend into more and aspects of your power, but you have to master each floor before you can progress, and in doing so master your powers at that level.
objects.title: Started at The Bottom with Nowhere But Up

addons.text:
When you forsook your fate and the fleeting divinity that once guided you, your connection to the divine nearly extinguished. But your will and nature refused to let it fade. 

It took hold of that fragile spark, and though it became smaller, it solidified within you, stronger than before, yet still far from its true potential.

This Seed, nurtured not by external offerings but by the pure, intrinsic power of your own existence, now grows steadily within you. It is not a gift earned through worship, but a force that takes root within your very being—waiting to bloom into true divinity.

The essence flows quietly, steadily, from the depths of your spirit. With every trial, every step forward, this divine power pulses within you, slowly but inevitably pushing you toward your destiny. 

It is your strength of will, your unwavering heart, and the divine essence inside you that now drives your ascent.

The world may test you, but the Seed of Divinity, once planted, will continue to feed your soul, propelling you closer to becoming the true god you are meant to be.
addons.title: Seed of Divinity

objects.text:
The Shrine, the worship, the blessings. Useless, all useless. Your path to ascension shall not be marked with needing gimmicks or tools.

You are you, and you will accomplish it with what you have on your hands, nothing more and nothing less! 

Your path to divinity is still in the horizon, an ever distant accomplishment for you and you alone. The world may be cruel, it may be cold. You may starve, you may wither, but you will go to that path all the same.

Your heart beats, and so you will strive to become a god from an ordinary mortal. You have the potential to ascend, but how many trials? How many years? You will find out, without any assistance of any kind.
objects.title: A Path Walked Fearlessly

objects.text: You no longer need to drop the simulation to gain the benefit of the simulation training. The benefit you receive from the simulation is provided to you in real time.
objects.title: Synchronize

objects.text:
Instead of just being able to create 1 simulation you can now create up to five in total. Each simulation can be directed to train and study different things or have an additive effect when directed to train in one specific thing. For example, if you have 2 simulations dedicated to sword training then you would reap double the benefit.

As you continue to use this power you will gradually gain the ability to create additional simulations over time
objects.title: Additional Trainer

objects.text: The Flow of time in the simulated realm is increased. Each purchase of this upgrade increases the flow speed by five times over, starting at 3x to 15x, then 75x, then 375x, and then finally 1875x.
objects.title: Accelerated Training

objects.text:
Copy-Fusion-Evolve has gained a new ability called the Soul Archive which diligently records every acquired power and skill, ensuring a comprehensive registry. When these abilities undergo fusion or evolution, the archive seamlessly reinstates any skills utilized in the fusion process to their pre-fusion or pre-evolution levels. 

To illustrate, fusing two level-fifty powers results in their loss, replaced by the fused outcome. However, the Archive provides the option to selectively relearn these powers at level fifty or automatically regain all lost abilities. This dynamic extends to the evolution of any power or skill, offering users a flexible and personalized approach to skill management.
objects.title: Soul Archive

objects.text:
Instead of ‘copying’ a single attribute you can take an ‘impression’ of a person. This distills all of their abilities, skills and powers down to a fundamental core in your backlog. This impression is the ‘Core’ of a powerset, capable of reproducing them, though not without fault. 

The set given by the impression core is rallied around the singular concept at its core. In essence acting as a kind of ‘reimagining’ of its central facet. For example, if a hero has a bloodline ability that gives them superstrength and flight, an impression would instead focus on their thematic core, be that a defender or someone that stalks the night and give you a powerset that is relevant to that core rather than the original powers they possessed.

These cores act as single abilities in Copy-Fusion-Evolve, and need to be trained to reach their full potential. They can also be fused and evolved with singular powers or other impressions as usual.
objects.title: Reimagining

objects.text:
"Individually mighty, collectively indomitable."

The concept of unity has become an intrinsic part of the core connection binding you four entities under the mantle of pawns and master.

Collaboration among your three musketeers yields substantial benefits based on the undertaken activity. For example, when the trio coordinates offensively to bring down an enemy, they experience a 50% buff to all their combat capabilities and abilities. Similarly, when they unite in defense of a target, their defensive abilities receive a 50% boost. Essentially, the assembly of the three musketeers always ensures a consistent advantage  and buffs across the aspects they represent—DPS, tank, and support—depending on the circumstances they encounter. This wouldn't negatively affect their capabilities in any way should they act alone.

The concept of unity has also extended to their master. Now, the only way to inflict harm of any nature on you, is for all three musketeers to be vanquished.
objects.title: Three For One

objects.text:
The imbalance is gone. Half measures are no longer necessary. No longer do your talents merely approach one another; they stand as equals. Whatever your greatest talent, aptitude, or potential may be, it becomes the standard for every other current and future field. There is no longer a strongest and weakest talent. Instead, every talent, aptitude, and potential possesses the highest aspects of every other talent, aptitude, and potential, regardless of what those aspects may be, across everything you are capable of learning or developing. This applies not only to your natural abilities, but also to any effects or powers that affect what qualifies as talent, aptitude, or potential.

If one of your talents reaches a miraculous or heaven-defying level, every other talent immediately rises to match it in full. For example, if you possess a divine talent for swordsmanship capable of reaching metaphysical heights, you will possess that same level of talent for magic, music, painting, science, or any other field as well. Whatever is considered talent, aptitude, or potential in one subject or field will have an equivalent in every other, regardless of whether it manifests as instinct, comprehension, creativity, affinity, intuition, or any other form of natural aptitude. Your gifts will always be expressed in whatever manner is most appropriate to each discipline. 

Likewise, any future increase to a single field is reflected across the rest, ensuring that your growth is always universal rather than isolated. This does not grant you knowledge or experience; it simply ensures that your capacity to learn and master every discipline is always equal to the greatest talent you possess.
objects.title: Ascendant Talent

objects.text: The road to even greater progress usually gets steeper as you ascend and your strength and powers reach previously unheard-of levels. Not for you, though. You don't follow the rules about bottlenecks, soft caps, or decreasing returns. Rather, your advancement travels along a distinct path, unrestricted by traditional boundaries. Whenever you train, you experience a situation where every step you take forward causes your progress to accelerate exponentially. Essentially, the more you advance in power, the faster you will advance, experiencing an incredible adventure filled with limitless possibility and unwavering growth.
objects.title: Broken Limiter
Chain Breaker
objects.text: Your potential is no longer unlimited, as this power's sole function is now to allow you to break free of any form of restraint. If something, or someone, places a seal or restriction upon you, you'd be able to free yourself of it, but this power won't give you any potential that isn't already there.

addons.text: No longer do you need to wait months for the adaptation to kick in. Now, the moment you encounter any new type of supernatural energy, be it magic, psionic, or anything else, your source will instantly adapt to emulate the newly encountered energy. You will also gain the basic understanding on how to manipulate these new energies, but will still have to wait around a week for more deep understanding, although this time can be drastically cut down with practice.
addons.title: Instant Adaptation

objects.text: Inside you, there is a malleable source of energy. When you visit a new universe, if there is a power system reliant on some specific type of supernatural energy, your internal source will evolve to allow you to emulate it. This also speeds up the process of acquiring new aptitudes, now requiring only a month to do so.
objects.title: Universal Power Plant

objects.text:
You embody the phrase "What doesn't kill you makes you stronger." Your power grows exponentially with each combat encounter.

You possess a godly battle IQ, allowing you to instantly analyze the entire battlefield, identifying points of interest, useful items, and the strengths and weaknesses of your opponent. This advanced analytical ability enables you to devise effective tactics and strategies, no matter how unconventional they may be.

The trials of battle also enhance your own powers and skills. With each use, your abilities develop beyond their original conception. You can adapt or create new techniques on the fly, making them as familiar to you as if you had practiced them your entire life. Additionally, the same technique will rarely work against you twice.

Given the means, you can also copy your opponent's powers or techniques by creating your own version that is functionally identical.

Even outside of combat, your creativity regarding all things related to battle is massively increased, allowing you to find new uses for your powers and combine them into lethal mixtures.

Sparring is now more effective for you than months of training, and life-or-death struggles, where one wrong move could lead to death, enhance your power equivalent to years or even decades of training depending on how long the battle lasted.
objects.title: Perfected In The Fires of War

objects.text: Every time this choice is selected, you gain an additional, randomly selected Evil Eye to which you are fully attuned.
objects.title: Evil Eye

objects.text:
You may choose additional Essences to sense, draw in, and consume instead of being limited to one. Each Essence functions the same way as your original choice and will enhance you the same way. You can feed on both of your Essences at the same time, with both likely compounding on each other. The more closely related and synchronized your chosen Essences are, the greater the boost gained when consuming them together.

Each Essence keeps its own nature, and more specific or unusual Essences remain more effective. As a bonus, the effects of Chaos are greatly reduced the more additional Essences are chosen, allowing for much greater constant consumption without negative consequences.
objects.title: Multi-Essence Vampire

objects.text:
The abyss of your craving runs deeper than even you imagined. Now, with each additional selection, you awaken a new core desire alongside your original one. These desires fuel your growth just as the first, adding new paths for your power to develop. 

When you indulge multiple desires at once, your growth doesn’t merely stack. It multiplies exponentially. The more desires you satisfy in a single act, the greater the surge in your strength. For example, robbing a bank to fulfill your desire for greed while broadcasting it live to feed your hunger for attention would trigger a far greater spike in power than either indulgence alone. The deeper and more tangled your indulgence becomes, the more monstrous the reward.
objects.title: Fountain of Desires

objects.text:
Your ability to create original classes is vastly improved. To design a new class, you can open the “Class Designer” interface by saying it, which allows you to create new classes that will show up in your selection menu. You can design any class you could dream of, but it will automatically have its progression balanced, so an incredibly powerful class could take years of practice before you hit its cap, while a simplistic class way under your power level could be evolved in a matter of days.

This will grant you incredible flexibility, as with some creativity you could create a class for every problem you encounter. Or you could just obtain incredible power by throwing all utility out of the window and creating specialised classes like a caster class solely devoted to explosions.
objects.title: Hyperspecialization

objects.text:
Your Character Slots and Classes have been heavily altered and fused. Instead of being limited to a fixed number of Character Slots, you can now, in theory, get an unlimited amount. However, each Character Slot, including your Default Character, can only hold one class, meaning you can no longer combine abilities from multiple classes.

Whenever a class reaches the point where it can evolve into a stronger version, you will automatically gain an additional Character Slot in addition to the class evolution. This new slot lets you start with a different class while keeping the evolved class in its dedicated slot. Over time, this process allows you to build a roster of specialised characters, each excelling in a specific area.
objects.title: Separate Character Classes

objects.text:
You can incorporate new Roots of an associated concept into an existing Root, allowing you to exaggerate and accentuate certain aspects before repeating the process. Wood, for instance, can branch into paper, into Story and ever onwards.

Similarly, you can graft Roots you’ve either developed together to create hybrids such as Kintsugi from Gold and Pottery, emphasising repair in its fusion as well as the individual parts of both.

Finally, you can develop Roots at a faster rate if you see them in others. While the vast majority of humans are rooted in Flesh, more abstract being can harbour great cuttings to add to yourself.
objects.title: Graft & Branch

objects.text:
By your ability to appraise others and your Skill Tree System combining, your power is improved in three major areas.

First, you will gain a starting amount of Research Points (RP) based on your lifespan before you gained this power, calculated as if you have earned points passively through your life.

Secondly, you can see and open the skill trees of other beings, allowing you to allocate their points as you wish. Every being will also have starting points in the same way as you do. Also, after you first opened the Skill Tree of somebody, they will also start to gain points from active learning, and you can further boost their rate of earning RP by actively teaching and training them, but only you can spend their points.

Finally, any skill nodes you discover from appraising others will also appear in your own skill tree, allowing you to invest in them without having any connected nodes, giving you the ability to skip prerequisites for certain skills.
objects.title: Skill Allocation

objects.text:
You gain the ability to create projections of creatures you sealed as summoned minions. These projections are essentially ethereal clones of the sealed creature that can use any of the original’s abilities but only has as much energy as you invest into its creation. Creating these projections does nothing to the original creature besides temporarily draining it of energy. These projections last as long as they have energy dissipating into nothing when they run out.

These projections have a range of ten miles around you and the further they go from that range the more rapidly they’ll drain of energy and dissipate.

These projections are mindless making them only capable of simple tasks, and they are only as skilled at using their abilities as you are.

You can optionally have the sealed creature remotely control a projection that is based on them which gives the benefit of their mind and skill to any task you require of them while also giving that projection a more solid appearance. Of course this does nothing to the personality of the sealed creature so if it isn’t your friend it might not be a good idea to give it control of a projection.
objects.title: Sealed Delegation

objects.text: With each purchase one of the 7 seals is released without you needing to face a personal challenge or sacrifice anything. If required, it can retroactively give you whatever qualities you would have gained should you have opened the seal naturally.
objects.title: Released Seal

objects.text:
The metaphysical 'worth' of yourself, encompassing all aspects of your being, has now been significantly elevated. Consequently, the value of your sacrifices are much more proportionally favourable, providing you with far greater returns than before, regardless of the sacrifice made.

The initial purchase of this upgrade will multiply your metaphysical worth by a factor of 4. With each subsequent purchase, your original metaphysical value will be further multiplied, following that of the cubic number sequence (e.g. ×4, ×8, ×27, ×64, ×125, etc). Where formerly sacrificing a day's memories could temporarily empower an ordinary civilian to be able to destroy buildings with a punch, now, with a single purchase, they could instead demolish a city block or have the boost last four times longer.

This upgrade has the side effect of similarly affecting other mechanisms involving the metaphysical like magic, spiritual forces or other esoteric powers. As a result of your augmented personal worth, you will attain more potent returns from metaphysical sacrifices, sales and negotiations so long as you use yourself as currency.
objects.title: Tributary of the Heavens

objects.text:
Your power of sacrifice has transcended past your original limit of being restricted to mere personal empowerment. Instead of only affecting yourself, you can now bend reality and the universe itself to your desires through sacrificing aspects of your being.

For instance, by sacrificing a day’s worth of memories, you could temporarily stop time in a small area around you for a minute or cause a specific person to suffer a heart attack half a continent away. At the extreme end, sacrificing your entire existence could potentially allow you to rewrite fundamental concepts or even strike down the very Gods themselves.

Keep in mind that you still adhere to the core principles of Heavenly Sacrifice. As such, the better articulated, more restricted and precise your desired alteration to reality is, the lesser a personal sacrifice required. Conversely, attempting to enact vague, sweeping changes to existence will likely escalate to a cost that you are either unwilling or unable to pay.
objects.title: Celestial Sacrifice

objects.text:
So long as you have access to something with a genuine supernatural connection to something else you want to seal your sealing chains will be able to drag that target to you through that connection. Which can optionally with enough skill, leave the thing with the connection unharmed. Which is useful if you say want to seal a Tailed Beast from Naruto or The Radiance from Hollow Knight without having to go through the trouble or moral dilemma of also sealing their current container.

The sealing target will still be able to fight back and resist while you try to seal them through that connection.
objects.title: Sealed Transfer Program

objects.text:
Instead of gaining items and power that increase in strength each time you log in after a certain threshold, the new system rewards you with items of increasing power only at specific login milestones. These milestones include one week, one month, a quarter-year, half a year, one year, 2.5 years, and 5 years, among others.

For example, on a regular day, you would receive items worth 1 to 5 SP. At the one-week milestone, you receive an item or power worth 10 SP. After that, daily rewards return to the usual range until the next week's milestone, where you again receive an item or power worth 10 SP. At the one-month milestone, you receive an item or power worth 15 SP, in addition to the weekly milestone reward, and so on.

While the requirements are stricter, this new system allows you to gain items and powers that are worth more than 50 SP. Additionally, you will have access to a shop where you can sell unwanted items and powers for one-third of their SP value, giving you the option to purchase the items or powers you desire.
objects.title: Milestone Reward

objects.text: Want more awards? No worries! This upgrade will give you additional awards for the Daily Login System. Each purchase will grant 1 additional award.
objects.title: Multi-Reward

addons.text:
As a demigod, your unique nature grants you partial mastery over the concept of divinity. This ability allows you to perceive and identify the fundamental laws and concepts of existence surrounding you. Moreover, you passively absorb and internalize these principles over time, gradually mastering them without conscious effort.

Your powers and abilities have now become conceptual in essence. This transformation makes you resistant to harm or destruction from anything that is not of equal conceptual magnitude. Additionally, your status enables you to study and comprehend Higher Concepts—such as Finality, True Death, Life, Creation, Destruction, Infinity, and the Kabbalistic Tree of Life—at an accelerated rate compared to before.

While your demigod nature amplifies your ability to interact with laws and concepts, it also imposes certain limitations. You cannot fully realize the ultimate truths of these principles until you ascend to godhood. Upon reaching complete mastery (100%) of any law or concept, further progress will freeze until ascension. Upon becoming a god, these truths will be fully realized, granting you dominion over each mastered principle.

As a demigod, mastered laws and concepts are potent yet lack the divine power required for performing feats of godhood. However, upon ascension, you will transform into a being akin to the Aeons—or possibly even a primordial entity—depending on the depth and scope of the laws and concepts you've mastered.

Choosing to focus on Higher Concepts such as Finality, True Death, Creation, or Destruction will elevate you to an omniversal level of influence over those domains. However, this path is arduous and requires immense dedication and endurance.

Interestingly, if you dedicate all your effort to mastering a single law or concept, whether it is a regular or higher concept, you can bypass the traditional requirement for godhood. Mastering the truth of a single higher concept will directly elevate you to godhood, offering an alternative route to ultimate ascension.

As a demigod, you are more susceptible to the corrupting influence of Forbidden Knowledge. However, upon ascension to godhood, you will gradually develop resistance to this influence. This newfound resilience opens the possibility of evolving into an Outer-Versal Being or Eldritch Entity, should you choose to embrace such a transformation.

Your journey as a demigod is both a privilege and a trial. While your nature provides unparalleled access to the fabric of existence, it demands patience and focus to overcome its inherent limitations. Whether you pursue mastery of laws, ascension through higher concepts, or transformation into a cosmic force, your path is yours to shape.
addons.title: Divine Lord of Laws and Concepts

addons.text:
You have dedicated yourself to studying and mastering a singular concept and its related laws: The Authority of Finality. This concept has elevated you to the status of the Lord of Finality, a being akin to Terminus, the Aeon of Finality, or gods like Chronus and the Bad Wolf—entities tied to the fabric of time. The various concepts that fall under the umbrella of Finality are inherently mastered as well, though each one must be individually realized. Once fully mastered, these concepts will not only strengthen your authority but can also be used to create a new, more powerful type of Herrscher Core.

As the Lord of Finality, Time is your core law and concept, with all others secondary in comparison. With this power, you have gained unparalleled control over the flow of time and existence, granting you supreme influence over the fabric of reality itself. Time, one of the fundamental aspects of existence, becomes a tool in your hands, allowing you to manipulate events, sequences, and outcomes across all planes of reality. This power transcends mere chronological adjustment—your influence extends to the very essence of existence, giving you the ability to reshape, preserve, or erase any form of being.

Your control over Finality enables you to halt, accelerate, or reverse the passage of time, whether universally or in localized areas. You can rewind events to undo catastrophic outcomes, accelerate growth to expedite development, or freeze entire realities, preserving them indefinitely. You also have the ability to split timelines, creating alternate realities, or to merge fractured streams of time into a unified continuum.

With control over existence, you can end or redefine the purpose and state of any entity, from individuals to entire worlds. For example, you could erase an immortal being that defies destruction by severing its connection to existence. You could also rewrite a species’ fundamental traits, ensuring its survival or guiding its evolution toward a desired outcome. Even abstract concepts, like war or despair, could be purged or transformed, shifting the emotional or ideological landscape of civilizations. This mastery over Finality allows you to reshape reality on both a macro and micro scale. On a grand level, you could dismantle and rebuild entire universes, dictating their laws of physics, time, and space. On a smaller scale, you can alter the fate of individuals, shifting their roles in the greater design of the omniverse. This vast control enables you to craft reality according to your vision, whether by creating utopias, constructing realms of endless challenges, or preserving key elements of history.

Your dominion over time and existence also synergizes with other powers, such as Void manipulation and Honkai energy. By combining time control with the creation of Void spaces, you can craft self-contained realities where time flows differently. This could create accelerated training grounds, timeless sanctuaries, or isolated dimensions for experimentation. Merging existence control with Honkai energy would allow you to imbue individuals with temporal or existential resilience, making them immune to the shifts in the fabric of reality, or granting them the ability to transcend mortality.

Ultimately, your mastery of Finality makes you a shaper of both destiny and fate, enabling you to mold the omniverse. You are not only a destroyer but also a creator, protector, and innovator. This connection to the Imaginary Tree and the greater omniverse on a conceptual level means that as long as the concept of Finality endures, so too shall you.  Due to being The Lord of Finality, you can now travel to other worlds by traveling the branches of the Imaginary Tree, if you choose to leave the imaginary tree you may become an outerversal being. Please note that due to being The Lord of Finality, you are an omniversal Constant.
addons.title: Lord of Finality

addons.text:
You have devoted your existence to mastering and embodying the polarised concepts of Life and Death, becoming a paradox that defies the natural laws of existence. With equal dedication to these fundamental forces, you have unlocked immense power, granting you unparalleled dominion over both realms.

Your understanding of the concept of Death transcends the physical and spiritual. You wield the power to bring an end to anything on a conceptual or abstract level. Be it a person, object, idea, or even a divine entity—nothing escapes your power. Whether physical, spiritual, emotional, or purely symbolic, all things succumb to you, the harbinger of finality.

This power grows in proportion to your knowledge of Death’s laws and forms. With the manipulation of Death, you can obliterate thousands, including divine beings. However, Death itself has forsaken you—you cannot die. This immortality is both a gift and a curse, a burden that the wise fear and the foolish desire. You are one of the few beings who can truly call themselves absolute. Your presence instills unease in those who fear death; they instinctively shrink away, sensing your role as the inevitable end.

Conversely, your presence breathes vitality into even the most barren of worlds. Nature flourishes in your wake, and those teetering on the brink of death find salvation. With your power, you can resurrect the dead—bringing them back from the afterlife without consequence—and heal multitudes with the correct manipulation of Life.

Those attuned to the essence of life are drawn to you, compelled by your role as its ultimate bringer. Your influence scales with your understanding of Life’s principles, allowing you to restore what was lost and nurture what yet remains.

As both the Lord of Death and the Bringer of Life, you stand as the enforcer of balance across the omniverse. You pursue those who defy the natural order, ending the lives of those who unnaturally extend their existence at the expense of others. You alone possess the power to travel freely across all forms and layers of reality, ensuring harmony among worlds.

In time, even multiversal and omniversal constants will succumb to your power, for all things must end when the final reckoning arrives. Beyond destruction and creation, your mastery will expand to manipulating, shaping, and redefining the very essence of souls.  Those who are immortal due to Eternal Flame are an exception, and can not be killed, not even by you. 

Your unique nature ensures that those aligned with Life or Death across the omniverse will take notice. Some will fear you; others will love you. Many will seek to control you, drawn to your embodiment of their domain. You are a force of duality—a being who commands both reverence and dread, destined to shape the eternal cycle of existence.
addons.title: The Lord of Death, Bringer of Life

addons.text:
You have chosen a single concept to preside over as a Herrscher. This concept is also one of your chosen subjects to master. While you gain this concept as a primary subject, you also receive Honkai as a bonus subject. This means you can study, master, and realize the concept of Honkai. Such mastery will have profound effects on both you and your Herrscher core.

Herrscher cores can be custom-created and are uniquely soul-bound to you. Any concept you study and master can be transformed into a Herrscher core. A progress bar will indicate the condensation of a new core, and upon reaching 100%, you will fully embody the Herrscher of that law or concept.

Each additional Herrscher core strengthens the previous ones. For example, if one core grants the power to annihilate a country, two cores will allow you to destroy two countries simultaneously, and so on. This accumulation of cores also enhances your connection to Honkai and Imaginary related powers. These powers will become compatible with all forms of energy you have access to, and you will be immune to any drawbacks associated with them. Furthermore, new Herrscher cores will unlock abilities and powers akin to those wielded by previous Herrschers, but at an even greater scale.

By mastering the concept of Honkai, you gain immunity to all Honkai-related phenomena, and a slight immunity to Imaginary-related phenomena. Even if you undergo the MANTIS transformation, you will be unaffected by its negative side effects. Additionally, you can absorb the genes of one type of Honkai Beast, even those you create. This limit increases with each new Herrscher core you condense. Any adverse effects from using Honkai-powered martial arts, such as brain damage, are also mitigated, though not entirely negated.

As a Herrscher, you are intrinsically linked to the higher concepts of Finality and Imaginary. Your ability to study Herrscher and Honkai concepts accelerates your understanding and mastery of these higher concepts. It also reduces the time required to study, master, and realize any related concepts.

Upon achieving a significant number of Herrscher cores, you will evolve into the Herrscher (Cocoon) of Finality. This evolution grants you the ability to create stronger Herrschers based on your enhanced Herrscher cores. However, this transformation requires a substantial number of cores and considerable time. As the Herrscher of Finality, you will inherit the outfits, powers, and weapons of all previous Herrschers of Finality, further cementing your dominance.  You now have the potential to become a being similar to the Will of Honkai.
addons.title: Lord of Honkai

objects.text:
You are no longer a mere student of laws and concepts—you have ascended to the level of mastery. This advancement allows you to study and realize laws and concepts at an accelerated pace. Furthermore, you are no longer bound by limits on how many you can study simultaneously. Even highly abstract ideas, such as Racial Concepts—the fusion of multiple species or races—are now within your grasp, granting you the power to reshape the very essence of anyone you encounter.

Higher-level concepts, such as Finality, True Death, Life, Creation, Destruction, Infinity, and even Kabbalah’s Tree of Life will progress at a much faster learning rate compared to before. However, their complexity means progress in these areas will still take a while. Your mastery rivals that of major gods like the Olympians or Asgardians, making you one of the most powerful beings in terms of mastered laws and concepts. However, you do not yet embody these laws and concepts; instead, you wield them with precision and strength.

As a Master, you possess the ability to fuse multiple concepts to achieve extraordinary effects, enabling you to alter reality on a low to medium scale. You can imbue objects and powers with these concepts, greatly enhancing their capabilities. For example, you could create a sword capable of traversing dimensions or a door that opens to any location while being compact enough to carry. Your mastery also allows you to create entirely new powers, limited only by your understanding and realization of the associated concepts.

Through your deep comprehension of various laws and concepts, you have passively attained immortality or eternity, depending on the nature of the concepts you have mastered. However, it will take centuries to study and master the Concept of divinity.

Be cautious—any forbidden knowledge you acquire will interact with any Concepts and Laws you have learned. This interaction has the potential to turn you into an eldritch being or change your personality depending on the Concepts and Laws you have studied and mastered.
objects.title: Master of Laws and Concepts

objects.text:
You can now summon powers, entities, and phenomena not only from standard Wikipedia but also from wikis focused on fictional works. Your first die roll determines the source: 1–11 refers to standard Wikipedia, 12–19 to a fictional wiki, and 20 directly ties to the Wiki Warrior power itself.

Every roll of 20 upgraded or modifies your power in a unique way. For example, you could gain a +2 modifier to your next three rolls, the ability to reroll once every 10 rolls, or other unique upgrades that make your power more versatile. This expands the potential of Wiki Warrior, adding new layers of unpredictability and chaos, where every roll could lead to something truly  crazy extraordinary.
