objects.title: Fiction Warrior

objects.text:
Rather than resetting your growth, you now have the ability to halt it and have that growth stockpile. This causes your powers to stagnate, while your stockpile compounds any gains they would have made in a near exponential manner.

You can retrieve this stockpile at any time, but the boosted growth rate will be reset each time you do. For powers who's main function is growth, such Dynamist Jr. or Breaker of Chains, you can instead have them express themselves in the form of temporary power ups or mutations in your powers, though this will lower the overall gains you make compared to stockpiling their entirety.
objects.title: Investment

objects.text: Your Rings are now no longer required to be ‘rings’ in the physical sense. They do have to be easily unequipped or removed from the subject, but they can now take a myriad of forms. Tunics, belts, even swords or partial pieces of greater projects. One notable Inleyer built a sword where each element, pommel, guard and blade, were made from rings, only enhancing their effectiveness for example.
objects.title: Inley

addons.text: In the Land of Mordor, where the Shadows lie. Sauron, in his cooperation with Celebrimbor and the smiths of Gwaith-i-Mírdain, possessed a limiting factor to his plans. More specifically, his own Master Ring, The One Ring, had to work on the same ‘system’ that the other 19 Rings of Power would be created from. This link to each other made it so that The One could have dominion over the system, but to do so entirely, his ring had to prove itself more powerful than the collective might of the 19 combined. To make more would likely have Sauron spread his power too thin, weakening his influence over them all. It was one of the reasons why he ultimately stopped their production, and why he poured much of his remaining power into The One Ring anyways. Thankfully, you seem to have found a way around that particular ceiling. As the Ringmaker, each summoned Servitor Ring is fundamentally equal in its power compared to their siblings, regardless of their eventual wearer. Your Master Ring, even if it were solely relying on the SP enhancements from the rings you give to others, would only need 4 rings worth to be equal to them, and 5 to be superior. This means that if you can be superior to one of them, you're superior to them all, regardless of the quantity. The rings you forge, however, are a slightly different case. All Rings of Power crafted by you gain the benefits of a Servitor Ring, with all that implies. Since they were likely empowered or enchanted to begin with prior to their ‘promotion’, they are fundamentally higher in potency than a summoned Servitor Ring. This means that if you create a powerful enough ring, that ring specifically (and by extension, its wielder) may be able to resist your control over it. Those that do so will not boost the strength of your Master Ring. However, that only means you need to create more ‘lesser’ rings and find those who would bear the burden of wearing them. Eventually, even those mighty rings who once resisted your power will fall under your influence. As your Master Ring empowers you, and by extension your ability as a craftsman and smith, you will be able to create even more powerful rings to bring yourself ever higher. Your Master Ring will pave your way to attaining true power, a slope that will never stop going upwards so long as you never stop walking it. All that came before have fallen to you, in eternal service to your grand design. All that is here and now are enjoying their freedom, feeble and fleeting as it is. All that is to come, more powerful than the rest, will surely join them in time.
addons.title: And In The Darkness Bind Them

objects.text:
Your Rings now come in two varieties, a Master Ring, which is connected to your soul, and Servitor Rings which are the other rings you produce. You can only have a single Master ring at a time, but otherwise it follows the same rules as your Servitor rings. 

The main benefit of a Master Ring is that for every Servitor ring you give to another, its own strength rises equivalently by 5sp. While functionally this gives you half as much raw power as you are giving away, your singular ring becomes more powerful with each conduit.
objects.title: To Rule Them All

addons.text: Your ability to transfer your mind and soul into another has fused with your ability to store souls in your rings. Now when you die, you can choose to take over the body of anyone who is wearing a Ringbearer ring. You can choose exactly who you become among your list of Ringbearers.
addons.title: Soul Transference

addons.text:
Ringbearer’s esoteric knowledge of the soul and Faerie Queen’s ability to copy physical data and powers have fused together. Now you can create exact complete copies of people you have fully claimed in the past using either Faerie Queen or Ringbearer’s resurrection. 

This gives your shades the appearance, skill, knowledge, and memories of those you have claimed. Your shades are still totally loyal to you.
addons.title: A True Shade

addons.text: You can now permanently sacrifice one of your shades to come back from the dead as if you were taking over the living body of that shade.
addons.title: A Worthy Sacrifice

addons.text: You can now copy the abilities of everyone you have ever brought back from the dead just as if you had resurrected them as a Ringbearer.
addons.title: A Resurrected Sum

objects.text:
Those who bear your rings cannot be released even in death. 

Should one of your ringbearers die while wearing one of your rings, you may choose for them to instead lose 5sp worth of the power gained from the Ring, and rise as a Shade. 

These Shades are like the original, but off slightly. While they’re immune to death they’re also distant, more obedient and by all means dead. A corpse being puppeted by the ring containing their essence. 

As a Shade, the Ring now contains their soul, and is the only part of their body that cannot be regrown or repaired if harmed. If they have multiple rings, all must be destroyed before they cannot recover.
objects.title: Mine, Now and Forever

objects.text: How about an even better deal? Now, upon each purchase of this upgrade, the amount you can retain or acquire per 'loss' or 'gain' increases by 5%. For example, with a single selection of this upgrade, you would instead lose 15% less and gain 15% more. But this upgrade's true potential lies in stacking these benefits, as your prospects only grow with each purchase! With four purchases, you could recover from injuries at a 30% better rate than before while using up equally less stamina for the duration. Alternatively, you could retain 30% more information after studying, all while expending nearly a third less mental effort. The more you invest, the more you get for less! All Terms and Conditions apply. Under no circumstances shall the company or its affiliates, partners, suppliers or licensors be liable for any indirect, incidental, consequential, special or exemplary damages arising from or in connection with your access or use of this product. Potential side effects may include but are not limited to: hallucinations, memory loss, the bubonic plague, lycanthropy and death. All sales are final and non-refundable.
objects.title: Get 5% More Off Now!

objects.text:
Your parasites have evolved. Specifically, they can now harvest more than half of their host’s power, burrowing into them and hijacking their bodily processes until they’re a symbiosis. The host is warped irreconcilably, their powers now modulated by the parasite, leeching up to ninety percent to send to you.

Alternately, they can instead enhance their host, giving back up to halfover what they took, effectively giving them 150% of their original strength, at the parasite’s discretion, deferring to you. 

As the parasite continues to embed itself into the host, they begin to feel an attachment to the parasite. The shape of this attachment depends on the personality of the host, ranging from ‘too useful a tool to give up’ to ‘my beloved child’.
objects.title: Riddled Host

objects.text: Pick another power, you get a guaranteed path to developing that power through Knowledge is Power as if you were learning from someone who possessed it.
objects.title: Template

objects.text:
Every major action you take now forces the magical D20 to appear, binding your fate to the roll. No longer limited to three uses per day, this power now applies to every Major Action to do. Whether you fight, persuade, or attempt a daring escape, the dice will decide the outcome. Major Actions include anything with meaningful consequences such as attacking an enemy, casting a spell, sneaking past a guard, or making a high-stakes decision. Minor Actions such as walking, recalling information, or opening an unlocked door remain unaffected.

A low roll can spell disaster, turning a well-planned attack into a clumsy miss or a crucial leap into a near-fatal fall. Even the most carefully crafted deception can fall apart if luck turns against you, your voice cracking at the worst possible moment. But just as failure lurks in every roll, so too does the potential for greatness. A high roll can elevate the mundane to the extraordinary—a strike landing with perfect precision, an escape executed with impossible grace, or a simple argument shifting the course of fate itself. Every action now carries risk and reward, making each choice a true gamble.

While the dice hold immense power, skill still plays a role. Just as in a game, your natural abilities add modifiers to your roll, tipping the odds in your favor. A trained warrior won’t be as easily undone by a bad roll, their expertise making failure less likely. A gifted speaker can still sway hearts, even when luck falters. Strength, agility, intelligence—every aspect of your being influences the dice, giving those with talent and experience a better chance at success. Luck is a powerful force, but it does not stand alone; preparation and ability still shape the final outcome. 

No amount of training can fully erase the element of chance. The strongest fighter can still stumble, the sharpest mind can still be caught off guard, and even the most persuasive voice can find itself unheard. At the same time, the weakest of individuals might defy all expectations, achieving the impossible through sheer fortune. Every action is a roll of the dice, a test of fate that can tip the scales in either direction.
objects.title: Life V2

objects.text:
Patience is a virtue, but sometimes you can’t afford to wait a full year to reap the rewards of your training seals. Now you have the ability to break your seals early, instantly regaining your full power without losing the boost gained from your seals—though at the cost of a reduced effect based on how much time has passed.

For example, if you use Jakuka Kyōka to seal your power by a factor of 5 but release it after 182 days instead of the full 364, you will only receive half of the intended power boost. Similarly, if you release Kōsoku Kajio or Sōhō Zōkyō early, the removed weakness or added function will be only partially realized, proportional to the time invested.

However, just as you can shorten the duration, you can also extend it beyond the original 364-day term for even greater rewards. The longer you maintain the seal past the required time, the stronger the bonus multiplier becomes. For example, keeping Jakuka Kyōka active at full power for twice the normal duration (728 days) will grant a 5² × 1.1 boost instead of just 5², while keeping it for three times the duration (1,092 days) will increase it to 5³ × 1.2 instead of just 5³. You can even choose not to set a specific time, keeping your powers sealed indefinitely until you decide the moment is right to unleash them.

This scaling applies to all seals, allowing you to gain more power, refine your abilities further, or remove even deeper limitations—if you have the patience.
objects.title: Appear Weak When Strong

objects.text:
You aren’t just a wielder of Phase Force you are a Dimensional Monster! As a Dimensional Monster you possess at least some inhuman traits though that can be as small as some unusual pupils, sharp teeth, and pointed ears.

This further improves the general enhancements of possessing Phase Force, but normally there are some downsides too.

The stronger you are the more Dimensional Pressure affects you, limiting your abilities until you adapt to it or even preventing your entry all together without sufficient Phase Build up first. Phase Build up is the process of saturating an area with Phase Force to alleviate Dimensional Pressure.

But since you were born in the Inner Dimension, you are already adapted to it and can use your full power right away.
objects.title: Inner Born Dimensional Monster

objects.text:
It seems you aren’t just any Dimensional Monster, you are a Great King!

Your Phase Force enhancements have soared in power and a new ability has been unlocked, allowing you to create your own dimension and populate it with Dimensional Monsters, where your will shall become law.

But this is not without risks, as the inhabitants of your new dimension aren’t inherently loyal to you and instead respect you for your strength and power.

Over time, if you prove to be a good ruler however, you may end up much like The Beast King whose subjects respect them for their strength, but follow them for their kindness and wisdom.
objects.title: Great King

addons.text:
It seems you haven’t just attracted Solomon’s Gaze, you are strong enough to carry Lucifer’s Will too!

You have been granted a portion of Lucifer’s Light unlocking a more powerful form of ‘Phase Awakening’ called ‘Supreme Awakening’.

In this state your abilities skyrocket such that you could face even a Lord in single combat and survive.

But there are limits to this power… Because it is not your own, it takes time to gather, granting you 1 charge a week with no upper limit.

Your body is also put under massive strain during ‘Supreme Awakening’, meaning you can normally only safely use it for 30 seconds at a time before it begins to cause you harm.
addons.title: Supreme Awakening

addons.text:
Your power as a Great King has mixed with Solomon’s work, and a powerful Desire for the world, to create something greater than the sum of its parts.

Awaken now, young master! For you have ascended to the seat of a Lord, a god in truth.

You now stand as the youngest of the Lords, the ranks of which contain The Nameless Will and Count D - The Lord of Fantasy.

The power of a Lord is thus, your Phase Force enhancements have further improved and you have gained a domain over a single concept, such as Fantasy or Death. But such power isn’t unbeatable… if one of your strongest minions or someone of similar strength were to turn against you, they would be able to lock you out of the world they reside in, possibly forever.

In addition, the Dimensional Monsters you can create are now able to become Great Kings themselves.
addons.title: Lord of [Blank]

objects.text:
As you slept, you dreamt… Again and again, you approached a figure - a Librarian in black, and walked through a gate, from there the details grew fuzzy.

What you do know is that once the dream had stopped, you saw the figure again, this time in the waking world.

You have paid their fee and passed the trial, making you a Prime/Shadow Agent.

Your Phase Force deepens its utility and enhances some of your old abilities, and you unlock a few powerful new abilities including one that will send your Phase Force into overdrive for one truly powerful attack, with the lingering effects leaving you stronger until you get some rest.
objects.title: Solomon’s Gaze

objects.text:
Amarok and Mon3tr have fused into a terrifying creature—an unstoppable predator that follows your commands or your intentions without hesitation. Merely speaking one or a combination of its names is enough for it to understand your intent. It is an entity similar to Fenrir, Jörmungandr, and the Narwhal that Devours Everything from Teyvat, with an unwavering loyalty to you and a shared soul connection. This creature possesses consciousness, intelligence, and no matter the distance or obstacles, it can teleport to your side instantly.  Much like a familiar, you can see through the eyes of the beast, speak through its voice, and hear through its ears. Due to the shared soul connection, it can use your powers and skills. 

The beast has the ability to change its form at will. It can take the appearance of a wolf, a crystalline dragon, a hybrid abomination, or any other animal or creature it chooses. This flexibility allows it to adapt to any situation or enemy. Its resilience is equally astonishing, combining the metallic durability of Mon3tr with the nearly indestructible defenses of Amarok. It can throw entire buildings as if they were mere stones, and its defenses adjust dynamically to any kind of attack, making it nearly impossible to destroy. Only an opponent with strength equal to or greater than yours could stop it, and even then, they would have no chance unless they wield a catastrophic force. Additionally, its defenses can manifest as a spectral armor, automatically shielding you before an attack even reaches you—an instinctive, absolute defense.

Its devouring power is its most terrifying ability. It no longer only consumes matter; it devours gods, spirits, emotions, and even abstract concepts. It consumes everything from its prey, stripping away reserves, techniques, memories, skills, powers, and emotions until nothing remains. Everything it touches is destroyed and absorbed by its jaws, allowing it to gain new skills, powers, and energy with each new prey. It can also transfer whatever it has devoured to you. Its most devastating attack is a green-black ray imbued with its devouring power, capable of piercing nearly any defense and erasing existence itself. Additionally, it can track prey across infinite worlds, devouring not just matter but space itself, tearing through dimensions and feeding on any energy or abstract force without end. There are no limits to its hunger.

When not in use, the creature resides within your soul, waiting to be summoned. It can also take a smaller form, similar to a pet. If the creature is injured or killed, you will feel its pain through direct feedback, affecting both it and you due to the shared connection. This will trigger animalistic changes in you, such as the urge to hunt or heightened sensory abilities, effects that will subside over time.

This creature is a nightmare to everyone except you. Even gods fear its power, for it can consume divinity itself. In essence, you now control your own Beast: an unstoppable force of destruction and endless hunger, akin to Primate Murder.
objects.title: The All-Devouring Mon3tr

objects.text:
Your growth is no longer additive but compounding. Each year, your strength, intellect, endurance, and abilities increase by 10% of your current power rather than your base, ensuring that every boost is greater than the last. In the second year, this means a minimum of an 11% total increase, the third year 12.1%, and so on—causing your growth to accelerate exponentially over time.

This also makes you effectively immortal from the effects of aging.
objects.title: With Age Comes Wisdom

objects.text: Your hoard may now encompass more exotic or ethereal things beyond just material goods, such as knowledge or people. Whether it be kidnapping maidens or learning the secrets of the universe, so long you feed your endless greed you will continue to grow into infinity. Keep in mind however, that the strength you gain is based on the value of what you possess, including rarity, so the greatest gains always come at the cost of others.
objects.title: Exotic Hoard

objects.text:
The amount of SP you gain each day is increased by 2 SP for each selection.

For instance, 3 selections means you would gain 11 SP worth of charges per day.
objects.title: Increased Charge

objects.text: Rather than getting the energy of 5sp each day, you gain 5sp per day. this means that like regular SP it scales exponentially, allowing you to gain items that would normally cost 20sp in four days rather than weeks.
objects.title: Ascendant Inventory

objects.text: You now possess a lesser Summoner’s Sanctuary as well. You are no longer limited to summoning only objects and the inanimate and can instead summon people, animals and other animate beings, adding them to your mental search targets. These are summoned similarly to objects, with more powerful individuals requiring more energy to summon (Using the Companions section as a guide). Sapient beings summoned in this way can be sent to your pocket like objects, but will experience no time having passed while within it. Similarly, outside of effects akin to Loyalty insurance they are not guaranteed to be loyal to you.
objects.title: Sanctuary Jr

addons.text:
Attacks that work purely based on concepts fail against you. Elementals wielding the concept of Fire burning your soul? Lol, fire can’t do that dummy. The Literal Embodiment of Death trying to use its concept powers? Lmao, try magic next time.

A Fire Concept user just doing regular burning would still hurt you though, because that’s what fire can normally do. Sure, Death may not be able to one-shot you, but you can still die in other ways. Especially magic. Magic is still scary.

This doesn’t negate all parts of a conceptual attack, only the parts that work off of the concept. A stick imbued with the concept of death wouldn’t kill you, but a knife could still kill you the normal way without the concept.

This inherent protection only works until you learn how to use those powers. If you know how to use the Concept of Fire, expect other Fire Concept users to be able to burn your soul like normal.
addons.title: Eh? What’s a concept?

addons.text:
Apparently, since you already can’t feel pain, when you adjust the connection between your Soul Gem and body to lower it further, your emotional responses lower instead.

What this means is that if the connection between Soul Gem and body is weak enough, your negative emotions will never darken your Soul Gem nor will your Soul Gem affect your mental state.

This could be seen as a bad thing though, since you would very much fit the metaphorical definition of a soulless person. As in, even if you can’t feel negative emotions, you can’t feel any other kinds of emotions either. Please don’t accidentally lock yourself in this state?
addons.title: Eh? EMOTIONAL DAMAGE!?

addons.text:
Damn you’re hungry.

Apparently, whenever you activate your Doppel form, you can eat any attacks powered by negative energies aimed at you and use it to sustain your form. Eating too much will transform you into a witch though, so try not to bite off more than you can chew?

Your limbs will slowly transform into your Witch Form as a measuring tool for you to know just how much more negative energies you can eat before you transform into a Witch. Eating neutral or positive attacks will crack your Soul Gem a little as well, so be careful of what you decide to put in your mouth.
addons.title: Eh? It’s made out of curses isn’t it?

objects.text:
If you don’t know it exists, it can’t hurt you. This is especially true for you, as unless you’re aware of an attack, you can’t be harmed by it. 

Poisons? Well, unless you knew that what you were eating even had poison in the first place, nothing would happen. Sneak attacks? What sneak attacks? You only know front facing combat!

Of course, this power isn’t infallible. While the damage is negated, the actual attacks still aren’t. The poison coursing through your veins would still be there, it just wouldn’t hurt you unless you knew it was in your body. Not to mention, if you knew the barest gist that the attack actually existed and what it would probably entail (like hearing a battle cry before a backstab, ominous statements that their poison would start activating in a few moments, etc.) the attack would work like normal and still harm you like it should.

Dramatic, flashy moves are most effective against you, due to them being very hard to ignore. Same goes for environmental attacks, as it’s very hard to ignore that you’re on fire or drowning. As a bonus, you don’t actually have pain receptors anymore. Yay?
objects.title: Eh? Could you repeat that? (Magical Girl ☆Sym-tan☆)

objects.text:
No magical girl is without a story, and you are no exception. Every legend, every feat, is immortalized within yourself, glorified with you as the star.

Whenever you accomplish something remarkable, something of renown, it's legend will become a part of you. These legends alter you, ensuring that no matter what, you'll be able to at least call upon a fraction of the power that shaped them. If you were empowered by a godess to fell a dark champion, you'll forever be able to call upon her blessing, even if she rescinds it, and you'll always have an advantage against the forces of darkness you once fought.

These effects will always glorify you, even if the real deal didn't work out quite as smoothly. If it took you years to accomplish a feat, you'd be able to replicate a fraction of it instantly, and attempting to do the same would only take you a few days time. Your ultimate attacks, the ones that take sacrifice and tears, will become something you can call upon at a whim.

These legends compound, shaping a greater whole as they are told. Enough stories of you fighting the forces of evil will form a greater legend of heroism, granting you improved strength when protecting others. Enough stories of your treachery will have you perform it all the better, not that a magical girl would ever do anything like that~.
objects.title: Add It To The Lore (Magical Girl ☆Sym-tan☆)

objects.text:
The rate at which you gain ‘selves’ is vastly increased. While not entirely predictable, as with the nature of the clones themselves, you are guaranteed to receive three selves a year at least. 

Additionally, these selves are vastly more likely to receive additional attributes, skills, and even powers, than they previously were. These, as with all of your relevant abilities can be transferred across the link, though if this is endemic to the self’s survival then the body may require some of that ability to stay with it to remain functional, or alive.
objects.title: You will Be Cloned And Be Happy

objects.text:
As your skills evolve, your body and mind begin to awaken latent talents—innate traits people are unable to train to get, the genetic difference between a genius and others. These are not magical abilities or supernatural gifts, but physical, mental, and instinctual developments that perfectly align with the demands of your craft.

For example, if you train in boxing, your body will subtly reshaping itself over time: your neck muscles growing thicker and more resilient to support impact resistance, your nervous system sharpening to process split-second decisions, your muscles adapting to favor lightning-fast twitch responses, and an instinctive awareness developing—a natural, almost subconscious ability to track patterns, read opponents, and exploit the finest openings in a fight. These talents emerge on their own, without your conscious choice, the result of your body and mind instinctively adapting to optimize your performance.

This process unfolds across all skills you improve, whether actively or passively. Even casual, everyday practice in a skill will steadily awaken corresponding talents, and this extends to every skill you touch. All these talents will coexist, even if they seem contradictory. Should you master both the raw, bulky strength of a grappler and the fluid, agile grace of a dancer, your body will accommodate both extremes simultaneously, weaving together seemingly opposing traits into a unified whole.

Even a single week of dedicated training is enough to awaken at least half a dozen complementary talents that directly bolster the skill you are honing. These talents scale in quantity far more than quality. As your skills grow to astonishing levels, your body continues to accumulate an increasing number of supporting talents, each one tailored precisely to the ever-elevating demands of your abilities.
objects.title: A Foundational Framework

objects.text: You gain an additional basic slot for powers.
objects.title: Extra Basic Slot

objects.text: You gain a medium slot that can host any one power with a cost of 15 SP or higher, weakened to the equivalent of 6 SP. Powers in this slot grow 20% slower than your other powers and can only be swapped out once a day.
objects.title: Medium Slot

objects.text: You gain a large slot that can host any one power with a cost of 30 SP or higher, weakened to the equivalent of 9 SP. Powers in this slot grow 40% slower than your other powers and can only be swapped out once every three days.
objects.title: Large Slot

objects.text: You gain a special paragon slot that can host any one power with a cost of 60 SP or higher, weakened to the equivalent of 12 SP. Powers in this slot grow 60% slower than your other powers and can only be swapped out once every six days.
objects.title: Bargain Bin Paragon Slot

objects.text: You have now added an equalizer module that will equalize the speed of any of your bigger slots to that of your basic slots. Your slots are no longer slowed down but they are still restrained by the minimum SP requirements for the powers they can host.
objects.title: Equalizer Module

objects.text: You gain 3 slots that allow you to pull Objects of Powers from … somewhere. These objects are weakened in a similar manner as the powers in your slots, including the ability to grow, and benefit from the Essential and Trinket upgrades at no cost. However, you can only summon small, portable objects (ex: a sword, book, clothes and armor at the most, but an exosuit, a vehicle, or property are not), and lose powers derived from summoned objects when they are discarded; for consumables, they do not replenish by themselves, even if specified, but can be refilled by funneling 60% of their SP cost from your energy pool.
objects.title: Celestial Backyard Sale

objects.text: LET'S GO GAMBLING! DANG IT! You gain 3 gacha slots that, as the name implies, are filled with completely random powers. Each power has a finite amount of energy it can draw from and, when their energy is exhausted or after a week, a new power takes its place. You can burn an hour worth of energy to re-roll a slot. Growth applies to the slots rather than the powers themselves and is slowed down by 50%.
objects.title: Gacha Slots

objects.text: You can turn one or more of the powers you chose in the CYOA into static slots managed by Polybius Remastered, weakened to the equivalent of 5 SP. Each selection allows you to convert one power that costs more than 5 SP and recoup part of the cost. Static slots follow the same rules as locked slots, including the increased growth rate.
objects.title: Static Slot

objects.text: The slots of Lesser Dynamist are integrated into Polybius Remastered as static slots. Major Slots are reduced in strength to 10 SP, and the Minor Slots are reduced to 5 SP. Both types of slots have the increased growth rate of static slots while retaining their mutation potential and do not suffer from the growth penalty until the slots reach their original size (15 SP for Minor Slots, 30 SP for Major Slots). You can divert some energy from the Polybius Remastered pool to increase the mutation speed or trigger specific mutations.
objects.title: Dynamist Slots

objects.text: You are now capable of temporarily boosting powers beyond the original maximum of 20% for 5 minutes. Each additional hour of energy used will either boost a power by another 20% or an additional 5 minutes, or any variation in-between. This puts the maximum boost you can give a single power for 5 minutes at 480% of it's original strength. (Note: This could, theoretically, allow you to maintain a constant 1.7% boost on a single power. That, however, would be wasteful)
objects.title: Supercharged

objects.text:
When changing a power in a slot, you can now also replace that slot with any other Polybius Remastered slot type. When swapped, non-basic slots inherit all unique properties of the new slot type, including elevated starting SP values, minimum SP requirements, slowed growth rates, and increased cooldown times between swaps. In addition, any slot you have swapped in this way becomes immune to Equalizer Module, if you possess it.

Furthermore, if you possess Celestial Backyard Sale, you may freely convert Objects of Power slots into basic slots, and basic slots into Objects of Power slots.
objects.title: Slot Synchronization

objects.text: Rather than having 3 distinct powers worth 3sp, you have a pool of 9sp which can be split and combined to form powers, so long as they follow the original guidelines of Polybius Jr. This pool grows as fast as a normal slot, however the powers it forms have lost the ability to grow independently.
objects.title: Pool (Polybius Remastered)

objects.text: I Rule Me. You’ve begun to set up the pinnacle of yourself, a Gestalt Personality. You can now fuse personas into each other. In addition to possessing an alloyed personality of the components, each fused persona has access to both the individual powers of the original components and any amalgamations the two powers could reasonably create. It is worth noting that you yourself, also technically being a Persona, can fuse personas with yourself. Ultimately this means you could simply fuse personas as soon as they generate, but this can have unintended impacts on your personality (especially for the more belligerent personas) even if it is a simple and sometimes elegant solution.
objects.title: Gestalt

objects.text:
At a certain point, you stop just surpassing weapons. You begin to understand them. Not just their steel, shape, or function but their intent, their essence, their meaning. A sword that burns is more than a sharp thing with fire. It is rage, or judgment, or wild hunger made manifest. And you, now, are capable of internalizing that essence. 

You can now internalize magical or supernatural traits from weapons. Once you have surpassed a weapon’s physical trait, you can begin to absorb its magical effect through a slower, deeper process. To absorb its trait, you must use it in a way that reflects understanding of what the effect is meant to achieve. This process cannot be triggered by passive exposure.

The magical effect, once absorbed, is expressed biologically. A fire enchantment may manifest as body heat that ignites on contact. A weapon that slows time may lead to accelerated perception or momentum control. While the version you gain is diminished in scope compared to the weapon’s original enchantment, you are not locked into a single function or form. Because you understand the effect, you can adapt its expression through movement, touch, presence, or other physical means.

For example, the frost of an ice weapon could be expressed not only through chilling strikes, but by freezing surfaces you walk on, leaving trails of ice, or slowing enemies that make contact with your skin. A thunder-infused axe may lead to concussive force in your footsteps, voice, or breath. The effect must be physically expressible. If the magic cannot be reinterpreted through the body, it cannot be inherited.

You may internalize and stack multiple magical traits over time. Each becomes a permanent part of your body, layered and redefined through your own experience and application. Once a magical trait is fully absorbed, the weapon becomes obsolete and offers no further growth.
objects.title: Beyond the Craft

objects.text:
There is a path beyond dominance. A discipline forged not in conquering new arms, but in choosing to remain with those you have already surpassed. Where others discard their tools the moment they become obsolete, you persist, not out of sentiment, but out of devotion to refinement. You temper yourself by restraint, holding your strength in check, using your mastery as a whetstone to sharpen what raw power alone cannot touch.

When you wield an obsolete weapon, you automatically enter a tempered state, restricting your physical capabilities to the exact point they were when you first outgrew that weapon. This state remains active as long as the weapon is held, and can be manually deactivated if you wish to regain access to your full strength. If you take up a weapon you never used to grow, but which is still obsolete to you, your stats are limited to what they would have been had you used that weapon long enough to surpass it. While in this state, your skill with the weapon increases at an accelerated, exponential rate, driven by the focused repetition and adaptation required to fight under constraint.

Despite the restraint, your true physical stats continue to grow in the background. In fact, the more you refine your skill while using the weapon under limitation, the faster your suppressed strength, speed, and durability accumulate. Once you release the weapon or exit the tempered state, you immediately regain access to your full capabilities, which is now heightened by the growth stored during restraint. 

Over time, prolonged mastery with an obsolete weapon will also imprint elements of its technique into your broader combat style, granting subtle but lasting refinements even when the weapon is no longer in hand. For example, training extensively with an outgrown sword may leave you with perfect control over attack angles and momentum regardless of what you're using. Mastery of an obsolete shield might grant a permanent sense of spatial awareness and optimal body positioning. Continued discipline with an outdated bow could imprint predictive timing, letting you read trajectories and enemy movement patterns with uncanny ease.
objects.title: Tempered Mastery

objects.text:
You gain the ability to perform the logical conclusion to both your original powers, able to transform your entire form from flesh to machine, becoming an Artificial Intelligence, or to change your cybernetics into biological enhancements. You can also easily shift parts or your entire body into any combination of flesh or metal at will.

Your body now gains the best of both worlds in that it is now always treated as though it were a machine with increased durability equal to common metallic alloys and a mind that is comparable to a top-of-the-line computer. Additionally, you gain a powerful anti-virus capable of defending against all but the most powerful and esoteric sources of hacking. Along with the ability to communicate through a built-in wi-fi system and a basic hacking suite able to hack most common machines.

This allows you to far more easily graft new powers into yourself that are either biological or mechanical, and even edit them through mechanical engineering.
objects.title: Metalsync

objects.text:
Your power now extends beyond yourself, now able grant quests to others. 

Acceptance is always voluntary, you cannot force anyone to take a quest, but you may shape and give quests on their behalf, either from your own intent or from a request they bring to you.

When granting a quest, you decide its themes, style, and difficulty. You can tilt it toward combat, investigation, endurance, social maneuvering, or other broad approaches.

You can raise or lower the difficulty to adjust the scale of the reward, just as you can with your own quests.

The final shape of the quest still rests with the power. You provide direction—difficulty, themes, style, and scope—but Covenant determines the exact form and balance. Rewards remain as flexible as ever, whether concrete, abstract, or mixed, vague or specific. The power interprets intent, refines requests, and ensures the result is always fitting, often better than originally imagined.

Unlike your own quests, where you only see the next steps, any quest you give to another is fully visible to you. You know its name, its themes, the entire quest line, and every objective along the way. The recipient sees the normal limited view: summaries, updates, and the next few steps, but never the entire path.

Through the quest itself, you can also communicate directly—sharing advice, warnings, or encouragement that appear within the recipient’s awareness as part of their ongoing updates.

Quests can also be anchored to a medium. If the recipient chooses, their quest can manifest as a book, a phone interface, a scroll, or another form, letting them track progress, view objectives, and review summaries more tangibly.

This medium cannot be hacked, tampered with, or tracked externally. This can be merged directly with their own existing mediums, and if they lose or destroy it, or even simply wish to, they can swap mediums at will.

If they prefer, they may rely entirely on instinct instead, with no device or written record at all.
objects.title: Patron

objects.text:
You may now force others into quest lines. Unlike Patron, acceptance is no longer required; once chosen, the target is bound to the quest and cannot refuse or abandon it. All other mechanics remain the same.

This enforces a subtle but inviolable unconscious Geas to continue the quest. You can still allow it as fully optional whenever you wish.
objects.title: Mandate

objects.text: For every purchase of this upgrade, you may gain one additional trait per summoning slot.
objects.title: Additional Traits

objects.text: For every purchase of this upgrade, you may gain another summoning slot.
objects.title: Additional Summoning Slots

objects.text:
You can now channel your Multiversal Summoning energy into another person through physical contact. 

Doing so amplifies your summoning potential, perfects your summoning accuracy, and fuses that individual with a known chosen Multiversal variant of themselves. The resulting fusion grants them said variant’s knowledge, skills, and abilities but restricts you solely to known variants of the person you are touching. The greater this restriction is, the greater the boost to your summoning potential.

For example, using this on Batman would allow him to inherit the powers and experience of any other Batman you know from across fiction and the fewer batman you know the easier it will be to summon the stronger variants.

This power can be used once per week for each slot you have and increases as you gain more slots through mastery of this power.
objects.title: Multiversal Remix

objects.text:
You can now fuse traits into bespoke fusions. While this obviously can be used to produce new appearances, it also gives you a mental ‘prediction’ system, allowing you to see the consequences of your fused traits, and angle them towards what you desire.. 

For instance, copying a Kryptonian’s strength and fusing it with some form of magical ability might result in a trait for sunlight-recharging magic or Magic-fueled superstrength or many other things in between.

Once traits are fused, you can un-fuse them into their components again. You still count as ‘possessing’ both traits as far as copying others from the same source are concerned, and will need to deconstruct the fused result in order to exchange one of its components.
objects.title: Fusion Falling

objects.text: Increases the frequency of charges. Each purchase halves the time between charges generated (every 4h, 2h, 1h)
objects.title: Increased Frequency (Architect Jr.)

objects.text: You generate an additional charge per cycle.
objects.title: Increased Charges (Architect Jr.)

objects.text: Architect Jr. is no longer limited to only modifying the powers it has created. Modifying or enhancing powers still takes the same number of charges it would have taken had they been made with Architect Jr., with the exception of Architect Jr. itself, which takes double the number of charges to strengthen or modify.
objects.title: Self Modification

objects.text:
You can now channel your charges into granting or enhancing powers for anyone you are physically touching, at the same rate you would create abilities for yourself.

Initially, each recipient begins with one empty power slot, regardless of whether they possess preexisting abilities. However, you may sacrifice one of your own slots to grant that individual an additional slot.

Additionally, you may sacrifice another person’s power — whether innate or granted — to contribute to your own growth. For every 84 charges’ worth of power you sacrifice in this way, you can either gain a new power slot or increase your charge generation rate by one charge every eight hours.
objects.title: Power Transference Engine

objects.text:
It seems you've instead received the demo version of what was already a lesser copy of a greater power. It isn't all bad though.

The powers you can make now have a maximum strength they can reach, capping out at 5sp. The powers you make also grow much slower passively, taking around a month to grow by a single sp.

The upsides of this are the fact that the cost of making new slots and increasing charges is now fixed at sacrificing a 5sp power, and the amount of charges it takes to increase the strength of a power is equal to the sp cost the power will reach (2 charges to go from 1sp to 2sp, 3 charges to go from 2sp to 3sp, ect...)
objects.title: The Littlest Architect

objects.text:
You can now imperfectly recycle powers back into the charges used to create them. For every 2 charges used to create or upgrade a power over the course of its life, you gain 1 charge back. 

This effect occurs instantly upon sacrificing a power, cannot be triggered with temporary or sub-powers, and can temporarily exceed your maximum charge capacity. However, if you exceed your maximum charge capacity then you will no longer produce charges until you drop below your maximum charge capacity.
objects.title: Residual Recycling

objects.text:
Your body’s absorption ability has expanded into a new method of power growth. Now, you can choose to break down an individual you have absorbed, instead of merging with them.

Breaking down has the absorbed target be completely converted into energy that is used to enhance your capabilities to even greater degrees than merging, at the cost of not gaining their skills, memories, and power systems. Further, the amount of power gained depends on how strong they were. For example, a Ki user would provide several times the energy that a regular human would.

Finally, the process for breaking down is always faster than merging. Such as, a target that would take an hour to merge, would only require a minute or two to break down instead.
objects.title: Break Down Refinement

objects.text:
Your body's absorption ability has expanded your merging capabilities. Now, you can choose to merge with items, including corpses, to gain any abilities or properties they have. 

There are three things to take note of, however.

Firstly, with items, in most cases the merger is near instant, but should said item have a will of its own, then the length of the process will depend on the power difference between you and it, in the same way it would for an individual.

Secondly, like with individuals, items can cause some alternations to your appearance, such as your hair turning into metal.

Third and finally, when it comes to merging with corpses, the effectiveness is affected by both the condition of the corpse and how long it has been a corpse. As an ancient or highly damaged corpse will give mere fragments, whilst either a fresh or near-perfectly preserved corpse would grant nearly the same as if you had done so with the individual whilst they were alive.

As a final detail, should you have Break Down Refinement, you will be able to break down items & corpses as you would an individual.
objects.title: Expanded Targets

objects.text: Your absorption ability has evolved to trigger upon death. Now, whenever you kill a target, if you so desire, you can absorb them instantly without requiring physical contact and bypass the normal merging time entirely. The absorption grants you the same benefits as a standard merge, including their skills, memories, strength, and power systems, as if the process had fully completed. This does not alter the nature of merging itself, only removing the delay when the target is slain by your hand. If you possess the Break Down Refinement upgrade, you may instead choose to break down the target upon killing them, following the normal effects of that upgrade. If you possess other upgrades to Absorb to Grow, their effects can also apply normally to targets absorbed in this manner.
objects.title: Kill to Absorb

objects.text: Instead of merely breaking down to turn them into energy to enhance your powers or boost yourself, you will imbue any powers, skills, power systems and so on into yourself exactly the same as you having those yourself without altering your personality or your appearance. In addition, you will be able to break down and absorb 5 times faster than before. Optionally, you may take the changes to appearance and personality from absorbing your targets if you desire.
objects.title: Full Breakdown

objects.text:
Your abstract powers have fused into a greater whole. You can now create new powers in one of three ways, placing them into one of your 7 active slots or storing them in one of your 21 storage slots.

First, you may copy the power of anyone within direct line of sight without spending charges. If the copied power exceeds 20SP, it is reduced to that level. Each individual (person, creature, or monster) can only be copied once. If you have Shifter Jr. instead of Limited Ability Works, you may also copy that target’s skills, appearance, and objects, provided the combined total of all copied traits does not exceed 20SP.

Second, you may summon the 5SP base version any power from the library of Polybius Remastered or you may craft a completely new power by spending up to your maximum of 50 stored charges. This method grants full customization over the result, and charges spent this way are 3 times stronger than those Architect Jr. would normally produce. In addition, the number of charges you generate per day is 5 times greater than Architect Jr. would normally allow.

No matter how a power is created, it can be refined and strengthened through continued use or by investing charges. Powers grow 3 times faster through use than they normally would under Polybius Remastered alone, and charges spent this way are still 3 times more efficient relative to Architect Jr. alone. However, no power may exceed 120SP.

Finally, you may expand your storage and capacity by sacrificing powers. Creating a new storage slot requires the sacrifice of a power worth 50 charges. Converting a storage slot into an active slot costs 50 charges for the first upgrade, with the cost doubling each time thereafter. Doubling your maximum charge storage requires sacrificing a power worth 100 charges.
objects.title: Prototype Early-Access

addons.text: The effects of any and all objects of power upgrades you purchased that do not have any OoP as a requirement now apply to all objects you have created via Unlimited Remastered Works.
addons.title: Inventory Benefits

addons.text: Each growth booster doubles the charges produced, in addition to boosting the power growth rate of Polybius Remastered.
addons.title: Omni-Boost

addons.text:
Lesser Dynamist is fully integrated into Unlimited Remastered Works. All of your active power slots now benefit from Lesser Dynamist’s accelerated growth rate.

In addition, all of Lesser Dynamist’s slots merge into a shared SP pool, which you may freely draw from to create new power engrams. No single engram created from this pool may exceed 30 SP when stored normally. The also means if that power engram is expressed through Summoner’s Sanctuary Remastered or Terrestrial Inventory then the limit is increases to 45 SP and 75 SP respectively.

Finally, any engram created from this pool remains reversible: you may dismantle or reduce its capability at any time, returning its gifted SP value to the pool to fuel future creations.
addons.title: Expanded Pool

addons.text:
Prototype Engineering merges into Unlimited Remastered Works, further expanding its reach. Your Prototype slots are now treated as power slots, increasing your total to 18 active slots and 70 storage slots.

Any engram placed within Prototype Engineering generates auxiliary engrams—secondary fragments of abilities that grow alongside the core. These auxiliary engrams are random but always synergize with the parent engram. Using Prototype Engineering, you can nurture them until they reach 20 SP, at which point they mature and a new auxiliary engram begins forming. Each power engram may host one auxiliary engram for every 15 SP of its own value.

You can also control the randomness and growth rate of these auxiliary engrams by the mode you put auxiliary engram in when growing them. 

For example, a chrono-kinesis engram might generate auxiliary engrams such as a thinker ability that reveals potential outcomes of your power’s use, or a sticker ability that lets you affect the recent past states of touched objects.

When applied to summons, auxiliary engrams become even more versatile. They can manifest either as additional abilities the summon possesses, or as entirely separate summons spun off to support the main summon, whichever you prefer at time of summoning.
addons.title: Unlimited Engineering Works

addons.text:
Now any trait, skill, appearance you have copied, also has an endless number of duplicates storied inside a library within Unlimited Remastered Works.This library allows you to fuse any power engram with one or more stored duplicates, so long as each individual trait is only used once per engram and the total SP value of added traits does not exceed that engram’s cost.

In practice, this means any trait you have ever copied can be woven into future powers you create or duplicate, provided the combined traits remain within the power’s SP limit. You no longer need to deconstruct fused powers to exchange or retrieve their components.
addons.title: Component Library

addons.text: Your Lesser Dynamist is interconnected with the Polybius Remastered section of Unlimited Remastered Works, allowing your Expanded pool to grow from the unrestricted speed Polybius Remastered does with its powers. By default, without any upgrades, your expanded pool will gain one SP into its pool every 1.2 days, but Unlimited Remastered Works has wired a very tiny portion of its energy to increase the speed so that it expands your pool by 1 SP every day. Unfortunately, you are still restricted to the engram limitations of the Expanded pool, meaning you will not be able to craft exponentially stronger engrams despite your growing pool.
addons.title: Growing Pool

addons.text: Your expertise as a grandmaster architect in power crafting has allowed you to grow your powers beyond its 120 SP cap, but only for Unlimited Remastered Works itself. Due to the exponential difficulty of upgrading powers past 60 SP, this will not be an easy task. Additionally, unlike URW's younger sister, you no longer need to spend an exponentially increasing amount of charges to increase your active slots, now only requiring 100 charges regardless of how many you have created.
addons.title: Grandmaster Architect Works

addons.text: You can now grow your powers within Unlimited Remastered Works above the 120SP cap; unfortunately, you are still bound by the exponential difficulty of upgrading powers past 60 SP. As a small bonus, you start with 16 active slots instead of 15.
addons.title: Bargaining for Paragons

objects.text:
Your minor powers have fused into a form of limitless power crafting. You now wield 15 active slots and 50 storage slots with each slot now holding a power engram, a crystallized imprint of powers, abilities, skills, and traits.

If you channel that power engram through Prototype Early-Access then you gain the powers, skills, and traits stored in that engram. If you channel that engram through Summoner’s Sanctuary Remastered then it strength increases by 1.5x and it manifests as a person embodying that engram. If you channel that engram through Terrestrial Inventory then it strength increases by 2.5x and it manifests as a object embodying only that engram’s powers.

Any engram placed in an active slot is still bound to the upper limit of 120 SP regardless of the channel it is expressed through, though additional active and storage slots may still be created by Prototype Early-Access.

In addition, both Polybius Remastered and Dynamist Jr. now effect all power engram placed in an active slot, thus allowing them to improve even when not in direct use. These improvements occur at ten times the normal rate of Polybius Remastered, meaning you can cultivate entire libraries of high-level powers with time and dedication, raising a least a dozen separate powers to 60 SP with a single year of training alone. Summons created from engrams persist in this growth as well, carrying all progress they achieve forward even if dismissed and their engram used for other purposes.

Furthermore, your charges have also ascended as well, becoming five times as strong as those produced by Architect Jr., Summoner’s Sanctuary Remastered, or Terrestrial Inventory. You also now generate 25 charges per day. In addition by spending a single charge, you may boost the copying ability of Prototype Early-Access, allowing it to replicate powers, traits, and objects up to 45 SP.

Finally, you gain a single Paragon Slot, a sixteenth active slot with no upper limit on the strength of abilities placed within it. Unlike normal slots, the Paragon Slot does not merely grow but instead absorbs, remixes, and defines laws for all your other engrams. Whatever you place within it reshapes the character of your entire arsenal. A fire ability in the Paragon Slot causes every other power to manifest fiery aspects, while technological powers aligns your abilities with the physical sciences until your entire arsenal functions like a living machine. 

The Paragon Slot is not simply a vessel but an axis of reality, a central law around which all other slots orbit. It stands alone, unduplicable and irreplaceable, the true source of your ascended power.
objects.title: Unlimited Remastered Works

addons.text:
By using the Reverse Cursed Technique, you can now use your own body as a base for your shikigami, allowing them to partially manifest through you. You could harness Escape Rabbit’s cloning ability to create duplicates of yourself, unleash powerful torrents of water from your arms like Max Elephant, or summon the Dharma Chakra of Maharoga, taking on the burden of adaptation yourself to protect the Entity from destruction.

At first, you can only partially manifest a single Entity at a time; however, with time and practice, this number will gradually increase.
addons.title: Partial Manifestation

addons.text:
You are now able to unleash the completed form of Chimera Shadow Garden, dragging your targets into your shadow, an expanse of pure darkness.

Within this domain, you have command over the shadows. You can summon shadow-clones as decoys, shields, or distractions, allowing you to instantly switch places with them or letting them absorb attacks for you. You can merge with the darkness, vanish, or teleport through it—slipping into one shadow and emerging from another, and bend the terrain like liquid night to confuse your foes. The shadows themselves can become weapons to strike or impale, or as mediums to summon the clones of your entities.

Every Entity you have mastered will affect your Domain Expansion. Some may bolster your offense with guaranteed attacks that will relentlessly attack your targets like Nue’s lightning that continuously electrocutes your targets, or Piercing Ox’s brutal strikes that batter every part of their body. Others provide vital support, such as Round Deer’s Reverse Cursed Technique steadily restores your health and stamina, while Mahoraga may constantly analyze your opponent’s abilities and develop countermeasures to them.

You can combine these powers to create devastating effects, such as lightning attacks that grow stronger the longer they’re charged, or you can temporarily sacrifice certain abilities to amplify another while Chimera Shadow Garden is active. For instance, you can enhance Round Deer’s Reverse Cursed Technique to instantly regenerate lost limbs and heal fatal injuries, at the cost of other powers for the remainder of the Domain Expansion. For every Entity you master beyond the first, you gain a 4% increase to both your own and your Entities’ overall power and potential within the domain.

The shadowy liquid will constantly drag targets downward unless they reinforce their footing with cursed or supernatural energy, or manage to float above it. Those who fail are pulled into the shadowy abyss below. Within it, there is no buoyancy, resistance, or oxygen—just falling endlessly into the abyss, until the target perishes or the Chimera Shadow Garden is dismissed or broken.

After your Domain Expansion ends, any entities you have already summoned—whether hidden within your shadow, inside the domain, or outside—will remain active even if you experience Cursed Technique burnout. However, you won’t be able to use the 100 Shadows Technique, such as summoning Entities or merging existing ones, until you recover from the burnout.
addons.title: Domain Expansion: Chimera Shadow Garden (Jujutsu Kaisen)

objects.text:
Your Cursed Energy has merged with the Entities within the 100 Sacred Treasures, making them resemble Shikigami of the Ten Shadows Technique. Through this fusion, these Entities can now only be destroyed through supernatural means. Furthermore, Entities 2 through 10 have taken on the forms and powers of the 9 other Shikigami of the Ten Shadows Technique, with Entity 10 manifesting as Mahoraga itself.

Your shadow, as well as nearby shadows, can now serve as an alternative medium for summoning your familiars. You can instantly summon and desummon them, hide them within your own or nearby shadows to launch surprise attacks, or even summon them in partial, unstable forms. These unstable forms are less vulnerable to damage and can be re-summoned if destroyed, though they deal reduced damage and must remain close to your shadow.

You can also utilize the shadows yourself, such as hiding within them to evade detection or using them as storage for weapons and tools. However, anything stored within your shadow still carries its physical weight, which you must bear.

Through their shadows, you gain the ability to merge two or more Entities into a single, unique being that inherits traits from each of its “parents.” The resulting Entity’s strength depends on the power of the originals, the number of Entities fused, and the amount of Cursed Energy used in the process. With sufficient energy and enough Entities combined, the creation may evolve into something entirely new—possessing abilities distinct from any of its components. A fused Entity’s death never results in the death of its source Entities, and each component can still be summoned independently without consequence.

However, if an Entity is killed or destroyed, then its power and strength will be inherited by another Entity, dramatically increasing the inheritor’s own might, expanding their abilities, and removing previous limitations. There is no limit to how many inheritances an Entity can possess.

For example, if Entities 1 through 9 were to perish, the tenth Entity’s ability to adapt would strengthen to the point of granting instant adaptation to any phenomenon simply by seeing it, or if Entities 1 through 99 were to fall, then Entity 100 may ascend to a level capable of rivaling a Paragon power. This effect will last until the Entities are restored after 24 hours have passed since their destruction.

The ritual for taming the Entities remains largely the same, but now you can compel anyone nearby to partake, forcing them into combat with your Entity. While the Entities will never kill you, they will fight with lethal intent against anyone dragged into the ritual. The ritual will only stop when one side is defeated. Defeating an Entity this way will void the reward, and you must start over again after 24 hours have passed.
objects.title: 100 Shadows Technique

objects.text: Time to add some extra gambling to your gambling! Now, when using the charge, you can gamble with the improvement, granting it a 50% chance of having double the effect, and a 50% chance of having no effect at all, simply giving the base increase.
objects.title: Upping the Ante

objects.text: You likely have many powers, so choosing which one gets upgraded is likely going to get difficult. Now, you can simply upgrade all of your powers other than Let's Go Gambling in the same random, measurable aspect. Any chances to upgrade the result will apply on a per-power basis.
objects.title: Improving the Arsenal

objects.text: There are two fundamental changes to your creations. The first is that growth after they reach 5 SP of power is linear instead of slowing down. The second is that when gaining a power from it, if it’s already reached the level of 5 SP, that version of the power will be obtained instead of the 1 SP version.
objects.title: Objects of Medium Power

objects.text:
Evolution requires logic. It requires a cause for an effect, a problem to be solved, a history to be cited. That is the most basic logic upon which all living beings follow.

You take that logic, beat it up and take it out back to shoot it. Your evolutions no longer occur automatically after accruing enough energy, instead being a pool from which you can draw to make your changes. If you have sufficient energy, you could go from a normal man to a Samsung fridge with mounted artillery and angel wings. You can use you energy to amplify and alter your powers, your body, your mind, or just abount anything else you could think of. In times of the most dire need this energy will help you in the simplest, cheapest way it can. A lethal wound would bring great regeneration while an incoming blow would see you grow durable chitin.

A days worth of passive energy gain is enough to reform your body within the limits of your mass, and the more you explore or experience causes this energy to accrue rapidly.
objects.title: Digivolution

objects.text: “Well, looks like you have either completed their adventure in Hyrule already or are a dirty hacker.” Instead of starting with 3 of each type of Container you begin with a full set of 30.
objects.title: Endgame Container Set (Legend of Zelda)

objects.text: Well, would you at that? It looks like someone found a rather interesting cheat code. The previous limit of 30 of each Container type no longer applies to you. This allows you to gain a godlike amount of durability, stamina, and magical power that only grows stronger as you continue your adventures and accomplish grand feats, and defeat powerful foes. However, each additional set of 30 you gain will drastically increase the amount of effort it will take to gain more.
objects.title: Jailbroken Containers (Legend of Zelda)

objects.text:
Rather than be restricted to exclusively technological pursuits, your remarkable Tinker savantism has expanded to encompass any and all feasible fields of knowledge.

This breadth ranges from the conventional, such as the humanities, marksmanship, strategy, linguistics and espionage, to the more esoteric, including magic, spiritualism or even entirely inhuman eldritch concepts. 

This follows the same underlying mechanics and scaling as before. By investing Charges into a given field, you acquire progressively greater knowledge, comprehension and practical proficiency within it. This can grow from top-tier human expertise to outright superhuman levels of capability and skill, depending on the investment.

Additionally, instead of starting with just three Charges, you now begin with six. Your first Charge invested into any new discipline also carries more potency, equivalent to 2 SP worth. However, this extra bonus doesn’t extend to any further additional Charges placed into the same specialty.
objects.title: Gifted Generalist

objects.text:
Upon selecting this upgrade, the frequency of your Charge generation doubles, halving the time between Charges from 6 days to 3 days.

Each additional purchase of this upgrade doubles the frequency rate again, further reducing it to every 1.5 days, 18 hours, 9 hours etc.
objects.title: Increased Frequency (Inferior Inventor)

objects.text:
Upon selecting this upgrade, the number of Charges you generate doubles, increasing the amount gained from 1 to 2 Charges.

Each additional purchase of this upgrade doubles the number of Charges again, further increasing it to 4, 8, 16 Charges and so on.
objects.title: Increased Charges (Inferior Inventor)

objects.text: By leaving a member of a Set unassigned, and with no intent to fill it, it will instead fill itself over time, extrapolating from other parts to fit. For example, placing fire magic in a Set of cardinal directions would have the others develop into the three other standard fantasy elements, completing the Set. If you have a power from this Cyoa that is already part of it's own Set, such as Red Horseman or Black Tortoise Of The North, you can forgo choosing your own Set to instead choose theirs.
objects.title: Completionist

objects.text:
You’re no longer limited to a single Set, being able to design multiple different sets with different abilities contained within. These sets behave much like your original one, and can even follow the same ‘theme’ with the exception that they cannot contain anything that is already contained in one of your sets.

Unfortunately, you can only design a new set when your previous set is filled.
objects.title: Additional Sets

objects.text:
You can now create a Set consisting of other people.

After joining the Set, changes occur to ease teamwork and boost power synergy. Due to the complete dedication of a person to a single slot, the enhancement will be even greater than from one slot among many in the original version.

As in the base power, no member can leave the Set by normal means - the slot can only be freed upon death.
objects.title: Order of Set

objects.text:
The time between re-rolls is reduced by half for each purchase. 
(1 month -> 15 days, 7.5 days etc)
objects.title: Lower Timer

objects.text:
You have a mental archive of every build you have ever gained through Roulette. Whenever you would gain a new random allotment of abilities from Roulette, you can instead substitute a previously rolled build onto it.

These ‘saved’ builds do not increase in power if your total energy has increased since it was rolled initially.
objects.title: Save Station

objects.text:
Gu cultivation primarily develops the aperture and Gu rather than the cultivator’s own body. This limitation no longer applies to you, as you have become something akin to a Human Path beast. As your cultivation advances, your physique grows alongside it, matching the natural level of beasts equivalent to your rank: from ordinary beasts, Beast Kings, and Beast Emperors throughout the mortal ranks to Desolate Beasts at Rank Six, Ancient Desolate Beasts at Rank Seven, Immemorial Desolate Beasts at Rank Eight, and beyond as your cultivation continues to rise.

Among mortal ranks, each minor cultivation stage further develops your physique, with low stage placing you near the lower end of beasts at that level and peak stage bringing you near the upper end. After becoming a Gu Immortal, this progression continues through the accumulation of Dao Marks, with each calamity and tribulation further strengthening you within the same rank.

As a Human Path beast, you are naturally well-rounded, placing your strength, durability, vitality, stamina, speed, regeneration, recovery, lifespan, senses, soul strength, spiritual resilience, Dao Mark resistances, and other physical and spiritual qualities around the average for beasts of your level, including the ability to withstand attacks of that level. The paths you cultivate can shift this balance toward their corresponding qualities, much like beasts and their associated paths. Strength Path, for example, grants exceptional physical strength, while other paths similarly enhance the qualities most closely associated with them.

These improvements are inherent to you and require neither Gu nor killer moves to maintain.
objects.title: Human Beast Physique (Reverend Insanity)

objects.text:
With each purchase, you may choose any Gu to become a Vital Gu, whether one that already exists in canon or an entirely new Gu of your own design, so long as it follows the normal limitation of possessing only a single ability. 

Your chosen Vital Gu resides within your aperture, and begins at the same rank as your cultivation. It will grow alongside you by self-refining itself whenever you advance to a higher rank. This process requires no materials, recipes, or outside assistance, though it is not instantaneous: mortal Gu may take several days to complete the refinement, while Immortal Gu can take months or even years depending on their rank and complexity, with higher cultivation allowing the process to proceed faster.

You also possess a natural intuition for how to raise the rank of your Vital Gu through normal refinement, making the process vastly easier and less costly than usual. This allows you to deliberately refine your Vital Gu beyond your own cultivation rank, and with sufficient preparation, even raise it to Immortal Gu rank while you are still a mortal. You can also use normal refinement methods and additional resources to speed up its self-refinement without risk.

You may possess multiple Vital Gu, and each retains the normal qualities and advantages of a Vital Gu, including being safely used as a core component in refinement without risk of being lost from refinement failure. If a Vital Gu is actually destroyed, however, you still suffer the backlash and injury normally associated with losing one, though your connection to it makes refining a replacement of the same Gu significantly easier and allows the replacement to become your Vital Gu again.

If you possess Extreme Physique (Reverend Insanity), Vital Gu aligned with the paths of your Extreme Physiques self-refine far more quickly, reducing the time required to only a fraction of normal. They are also far easier to refine to Immortal Gu rank while you are still a mortal, making it much easier to fulfill the Immortal Gu requirement for immortal ascension.
objects.title: Vital Gu (Reverend Insanity)

addons.title: Mutated Human Beast
addons.text:
Your Extreme Physiques further mutate your Human Beast Physique, elevating you beyond an ordinary beast of your level. At the mortal ranks, the qualities associated with each of your Extreme Physiques can reach roughly one rank above your cultivation, while at the immortal ranks they instead reach the upper end of your current rank even from its earliest stages. 

The qualities associated with your paths are also massively enhanced within your physique, and your talent in those paths is pushed even further, placing you among the once-in-a-lifetime geniuses capable of producing exceptional insights, techniques, and innovations.

Wild Gu of your Extreme Physiques' paths can now naturally form within or upon your body and enter a symbiotic relationship with you, much like the Gu naturally associated with powerful beasts. These Gu feed from your body, essence, or other suitable resources you naturally provide, can somewhat commune with you, and normally act in harmony with you rather than as parasites. They may even instinctively assist and defend you when you are threatened. You may refine them at any time if you wish, but they can remain wild and still coexist with you.

The rank and frequency of these Gu depend heavily on your cultivation. Gu below your rank form far more commonly, while Gu equal to your current rank are much rarer. As your cultivation rises, lower-rank Gu become increasingly easy to produce while higher-rank Gu remain comparatively uncommon. After becoming a Gu Immortal, there is even a chance for Immortal Gu of your associated paths to form naturally, though this is exceedingly rare compared to mortal Gu. Wild Gu formation is ultimately based on chance, and you may suppress it partially or entirely whenever you wish.

The environment and other surrounding factors can also influence what Gu form and how often. Areas rich in the Dao Marks, materials, or natural phenomena of your associated paths can greatly increase the likelihood of corresponding Gu appearing. Such environments also resonate with you, temporarily enhancing the qualities associated with your paths along with your physical and overall qualities.

Gu, beasts, materials, and other beings associated with the paths of your Extreme Physiques also become naturally favorable toward you. Wild Gu are especially attracted to you and are more willing to approach, remain nearby, form symbiotic relationships, assist you, or accept refinement, while other entities of those paths instinctively regard you with greater affinity.

objects.text:
Rather than an ordinary A-Grade talent, you possess one of the Ten Extreme Physiques of your choice. Your aperture possesses 100% primeval essence capacity, alongside the unique aptitude and characteristics associated with your chosen physique. 

Your primeval essence recovers at an extraordinary rate, and from Rank Three onward it automatically nourishes your aperture walls, allowing your cultivation to progress even without active cultivation. Your cultivation speed greatly surpasses ordinary Gu Masters and you possess greater human qi, while mortal Gu aligned with your physique can display power equivalent to those one rank above. Gu and other things associated with your physique’s path are also naturally more favorable and attracted toward you.

Your Extreme Physique also naturally enhances the qualities associated with its path. A Strength Path physique grants greater physical strength, for example, while a Wisdom Path physique enhances your intelligence and mental capabilities. You are also a genius in the path associated with your Extreme Physique, able to innovate and increase your attainment roughly ten times faster than others.

Unlike ordinary holders of the Ten Extreme Physiques, however, your extreme talent will never become a danger to you. Your aperture remains perfectly stable regardless of your cultivation or how much power accumulates within it, preventing the usual risk of your aperture becoming unable to contain its own growth and exploding. This allows you to cultivate and exploit the full potential of an Extreme Physique without suffering from its greatest weakness.

Upon ascending to Gu Immortal, your Extreme Physique grants you a super-grade blessed land, giving you an exceptional foundation. The advantages of your Extreme Physique allow you to easily overpower ordinary Gu Immortals of the same rank and fight those of higher rank when using its path.

You may choose one of the original Extreme Physiques from the setting or create an original Extreme Physique based on a path of your choice.
