You may purchase this option multiple times, gaining an additional Extreme Physique each time. Each additional one further improves the foundation and quality of your future immortal aperture. The Dao Marks associated with your different physiques do not conflict with one another, allowing you to cultivate their respective paths simultaneously without suffering the usual drawbacks of conflicting Dao Marks. You still retain the resistance provided by Dao Mark conflict against external enemy effects.
objects.title: Extreme Physique (Reverend Insanity)

objects.text:
You may now raise your attainment in a chosen path by one realm. Each purchase can be applied to any existing path or even an entirely new one; choosing a new path begins at Master attainment, while choosing a path you already possess advances it by one realm. The stages are Master, Grandmaster, Great Grandmaster, and finally the height of Quasi-Supreme Grandmaster.

Higher attainment greatly improves your ability to understand, innovate, optimize, and create new applications within that path. While you possess the understanding and intuition of that attainment realm, you do not automatically gain the practical experience, techniques, or knowledge that would normally come from cultivating the path for years.

This option cannot directly grant Supreme Grandmaster attainment, which must still be reached through genuinely surpassing the existing development of that path.
objects.title: Path Attainment (Reverend Insanity)

objects.text:
The growth and mutation of your powers has been integrated into your body's unstoppable evolution and adaptation. Now, both the horizontal and vertical mutations of all your powers have become accelerated at least five-fold, with the occurrence of detrimental mutations greatly reduced in probability. The process of pruning and merging redundant mutations is likewise much faster.

Your body's mutations continually take your powers into account, constantly adapting to make their use entirely effortless, no matter how many new additions you generate. Where a change to your powers might help you overcome an obstacle, your adaptive mutation might choose to prioritize that power's change over warping your body. However, no matter what, your body will always benefit from these changes in some way, whether it be increased strength, resistance to environmental factors, enhanced or new senses, etc.
objects.title: Ever-Growing Arsenal

objects.text:
You have skipped the steps normally required to rise in Rank, becoming a Transcendent—also known as a Saint. Rather than enduring your First Nightmare, you are automatically elevated to the Transcendent Rank as though you had already undergone your Third Nightmare. You begin with a formed Soul Core, the ability to access your Soul Sea at will, and full possession of your Aspect, Aspect Ability, Innate Ability, Attributes, Flaw, and True Name. How the Spell evaluated you is also up to you, allowing you to claim a Divine Aspect if you so desire.

A Transcendent, or Saint, is a being who has undergone a profound transformation in which a mortal acquires the first qualities of the divine, essentially becoming a demigod. This process refines the soul essence into a far more potent state, while the Soul Core expands tremendously. The soul grows beyond the confines of the body and forms a connection with one or more aspects of the world, allowing Saints to be acknowledged by the world itself and even bend it to their will.

For this reason, Saints possess an otherworldly presence that seems to influence the environment around them. They develop a supernatural intuition attuned to the world, enabling them to sense subtle shifts in the flow of spirit essence, movements in underlying laws, and disturbances in the fabric of reality. Saints can also replenish their reserves of soul essence by drawing upon the power of the world while within their element—for example, one attuned to shadows restoring essence by remaining within darkness.

As a Transcendent, your control over soul essence has advanced to extraordinary levels, allowing you to manipulate it with remarkable precision. You can selectively enhance individual muscle fibers, nerve clusters, or tendons within your body. The scope and refinement of these enhancements far surpass those of an Ascended and can be consciously adjusted. With proper training and instinctive mastery, you can explosively increase your strength, speed, agility, and resilience.

Your Transcendent nature enables you to perform a wide array of superhuman feats, such as lifting immense weights, moving at supersonic speeds, and becoming nearly invulnerable to mundane harm—even surviving unscathed from a nuclear explosion by exerting your will upon the world. You could effortlessly defeat Nightmare Creatures of the Dreamer, Awakened, and Ascended Ranks, and with sufficient skill and experience, contend with Corrupted Nightmare Creatures equivalent to Saints. If truly exceptional, you might even challenge Great Nightmare Creatures, which stand a Rank above.

Those who walk the Path of Ascension experience enhancement in every aspect of their being as they rise in Rank, both physically and spiritually. As a result, their beauty also increases. As a Transcendent, your appearance would surpass even that of supermodels, and this enhancement would be even greater if you were already attractive. Your longevity is similarly extended, allowing you to live far beyond normal human lifespans. While you still require sustenance, you can endure without food or water for extended periods.

Because you have skipped directly to the Transcendent Rank, you gain two additional Aspect Abilities tied to your Aspect, the nature of which you may determine. All who reach the Transcendent Rank also acquire a Transformation Ability, enabling them to literally become something else—such as a giant eagle, a killer whale, mist, a being with multiple bodies, a dragon, a hundred-meter-tall giant, or even a creature composed of fire.

Finally, your body and soul have fused into one unified existence. If you were to enter a realm like the Dream Realm—where ordinarily only the soul may pass—you would now be able to enter with your physical body. You can also establish an anchor in the Waking World and pull upon the tether connected to your soul, allowing you to travel to and from the Dream Realm at will and even transport others with you, one at a time.
objects.title: Transcendent Rank (Shadow Slave)

objects.text: Now the butterfly effect is taken into account by your power. The pool of energy you gain from another includes not only what they could have done personally, but also what they could have caused to happen as a result of their actions. Killing the leader of a country would give you much more energy than an average person because they would have caused much more change by giving commands; killing a brilliant inventor before they unveil a shocking new invention that would change the world gives you enough energy to change the world the way you want to.
objects.title: No Man is an Island

objects.text:
Now, instead of being offered a random opponent in the Arena, you may instead choose your target and challenge them on your home turf!

At any time, you may designate a fictional character from any established IP as a Target, and will be teleported to that character's world, no more than 20 meters away from them. You may choose any point in that character's timeline to Target them, except for any time that they are currently already in a fight, or in a helpless state (unconscious, asleep, paralyzed, etc.). You may take items with you.

Once you arrive, there is no time limit, and you are not obligated to do anything to the Target. At any time, you may choose to 'give up' and return to your original world, with only a few seconds passing at most.

However, if you choose to directly challenge your Target and manage to defeat them, you will be granted any and all of their powers, abilities, learned skills, innate traits, experience and knowledge. You may also be selective about which things you do or do not copy, or may toggle acquired rewards off and on. Don't want you bursting into flames in the sun after going to all that trouble to kill Dio, for instance.

When directly challenging the Target, you may summon an impartial being in order to judge the contest. It may take any form you wish, but will never interfere; its only role is to declare the victor, and if the win is legitimate or not. You may lose a challenge as many times as it takes until you win, though you'd better hope that your Target is the patient or merciful type.

Note: The challenge you issue does NOT need to be a fight. You can challenge the Target to a game of poker, or armwrestling, or even a footrace. As long as it's something that they could reasonably participate in, it will be ruled as legitimate.
objects.title: The Challenger

objects.text:
Instead of merely restarting your life, you may now choose, at will, to completely restart your build, returning to the moment you first made your choices. You retain all of your memories, but not your perks, powers, or skills, as you have yet to choose them again after restarting.

Upon returning, you may redesign your entire build from scratch, including your powers, companions, and setting. However, if you change the Meta target, your choices will instead affect the new target, and if you do not select this power again once your build is complete, you will no longer be able to restart.

Should you decide to select any of the same choices as before, you may optionally have fate and circumstance ensure that everything you previously achieved in your life occurs again with little to no effort on your part. Unlike before, however, restarting your build will not affect only the universe you most recently visited, but every universe you have visited, as you are not merely restarting your new life, but returning to the point before it even began.
objects.title: Try Again

objects.text: The Level 100 limit was one of the fundamental restrictions placed upon YGGDRASIL Players. You, however, are no longer bound by it. Your Character System has been modified to allow you to endlessly gain experience and levels beyond the normal maximum, giving you the opportunity to reach heights that no ordinary Player could ever attain.
objects.title: Aspirant of the World

objects.text:
You don't have to begin your journey as a Level 1 Player. Each purchase of Starting Levels grants you 20 Generic Levels, giving you a head start on your progression.

These levels can later be converted into racial or job levels through your Character System's respecialization mechanics, allowing you to invest them into classes as you unlock those suited to your desired build. Until then, they remain Generic Levels and provide only their basic statistical benefits.

You may purchase Starting Levels up to five times, granting a maximum of 100 Generic Levels. These levels are granted immediately and do not need to be earned through experience, though they do not bypass the requirements for unlocking or qualifying for any particular class, and unlike the standard generic levels, it doesn't cost any exp to convert them.
objects.title: Starting levels

objects.text:
You gain access to a Cash Shop modeled after the one available to Players of YGGDRASIL. Through your Character System, you may spend accumulated XP to purchase Items, equipment (Weapons and gear up to Divine class), consumables, cosmetics, and even World items that were available in and/or custom ones based on YGGDRASIL and the new world.

The price of an individual purchase is determined by the value and rarity of the item, but no single purchase can ever cost more XP than you would need to gain 30 levels.
objects.title: Cash Shop (Overlord)
Universes Beyond
objects.text:
You have gone beyond standard cards for universes without a card game; instead, for each new universe you arrive in, you now gain cards from that universe in whatever card game you have chosen; they will be ported to the rules of the game you currently have selected via the original power.

For example, if you have Magic: The Gathering as your selected card game for the base power, you will be able to get additional booster packs that have cards that are not in Magic: The Gathering but have instead been ported to be Magic: The Gathering cards based on creatures, spells, locations, and artefacts from whatever universe that you are currently in.

You gain one Booster Pack every time you arrive in a new universe; the Booster Pack has [14] cards. To gain new Booster Pack(s), you will need to explore more of the world added to your Booster Pack card collection or complete noteworthy actions.

The main benefit of this evolution is gaining cards that would otherwise be unavailable if a setting doesn't have a card game and thus can not be picked via the original power.

objects.title: Card Game Store
objects.text:
You now have access to a pocket-like dimension that has a store that sells [Booster Packs], [Booster Boxes], and [Singles]. Their stock matches your current game of choice and will update to include any new games you have started collecting cards for. Should you have Universes Beyond, the store will also now include cards from any universe you have visited.

Should you want the [Booster Packs], [Booster Boxes], and [Singles] available in the store, it would require you to buy them; what you pay will be able to change from a large variety of currencies, as the shop will accept any currency from whatever universe you are in currently. [Singles] will be the most expensive, since you are essentially paying to get the exact card you want instead of leaving it to chance. [Booster Boxes] will be the second most expensive, as each [Booster Box] has 36 [Booster Packs].

What the store has available will change each time you enter, as certain packs will be more expensive while others will be less expensive. As time goes on, you may also sell cards back to the store, but you will only receive 60% of what the card would be 'worth,' while the remaining 40% will be in store credit.

objects.title: Store+
objects.text:
The store has been significantly upgraded. Instead of needing to finish one deck from the base power, the store now has cards from various games; which ones are available at any given time is random. Including cards from the Universes Beyond upgrade, the store will sometimes have deals from universes you haven't visited yet for a steep price; these will be limited-time deals, as the universe cards in the store will change every once in a while. 

The store also now has a new thing to sell: fully built decks, although a deck that you buy in the store won't count toward getting a new game unless you buy them from [Booster Packs], [Booster Boxes], or [Singles]. The shop will also now have sales that go on at random, selling things of a certain type of card game available for cheaper or even introducing new Booster Packs and Booster Boxes with specific themes from whatever card game you have, such as if it's Yu-Gi-Oh! Cards from a certain era will be sold in the Booster Packs and Booster Boxes. 

New events will also happen in tournaments held in the store, and if you win, you gain additional booster packs for the base power game you picked and items from the store. A tournament will happen once a month.

objects.title: Unique Cards
objects.text:
You have a rare chance, upon opening any card packs, to get a unique version of a card with different art, foil, limited edition, or whatever you want to call it, and foil cards are far better than regular cards.

The odds of getting a foil are about 1 foil per 6 packs; depending on your luck, you can get additional foil cards. Should you have the Card Game Store upgrade, you can buy these special cards; they will cost twice as much as a regular card.

Even a basic card as a foil would practically be double the value of a regular card. For example, if you select Magic: The Gathering cards for the base power, a basic land card would give more mana when manifested, a summon would be stronger and cost less mana, a spell would have a bigger effect, etc.

objects.title: Dynamic Allowance (Stray Cat Strut)
objects.text:
With this upgrade your daily allowance changes from a static 10 points to a percentage of your highest earning day to date.
This percentage starts at 1% with each additional purchase adding 1% up to a 5% cap.

Only points earned as outlined in the original power count for the calculation of this allowance.

objects.title: Many-Strands System
objects.text: The three methods of growth you possess have fused. The varying rulesets and the myriad of classes and abilities within Character Sheet, Grand Design, and Player have been harmonized into a whole greater than the sum of its parts – the Many-Strands System. From the Grand Design, you gain Dynamism. Every class can now be gainfully advanced from Level 1 to Level 100 and beyond, evolving or consolidating with other classes as it does so. Rather than a single road, this represents a vast tree of options for personalization. A Maid could branch out to become a Battle Maid, or alternatively by focusing on her class’s core ideals might gain the ability to “clean” things as esoteric as sin from a person’s soul at higher levels. With enough investment, she may do both. From Player, you gain MightEvery class level added to your sheet boots your base statistics (which include physical and mental attributes, mana capacity, and overall strength of soul). While a given class will skew its improvements more towards some areas than others, a max level player whose entire build revolves around cloistered academic wizardry will still be strong enough to fight a kaiju in melee combat. From Character Sheet, you gain Guidance. At any time you may access a mental resource presented in the form of a “game manual”. This manual contains a compendium of every single class, feat, skill, spell, and special trait that has been recorded within the Many-Strands System. If you query a particular entry (say for an elite class or a rare spell), you will receive information on the requirements to unlock that class or spell and even advice on potential methods to do so. (Note that the advice given is very general – the system might recommend you save a princess from a tower in order to qualify as a [Knight of Romance], but it wouldn’t give you a floor map for the lair of Garmagor the Abducting Demon). The manual will update to account for any novel skills, classes, etc that are created due to your actions. You have a total of 250 levels to work with. Given that all three of these systems can yield exponential increases in power, a moderately focused Level 250 build could easily sunder planets, perhaps even snuff out a sun, and their abilities stray from the purely physical into the conceptual. Upgrades and addons for any of the three component powers will naturally enhance the composite. For instance, if you have Race Change, you may pay XP to change your race to any non-deific creature from Dungeon & Dragons, Pathfinder, The Wandering Inn, or Overlord, from a lowly dretch to a quagoa to a half-gazer. Doing so will generate a racial class based on that creature, which can be levelled up and can evolve or merge with other classes as normal. Selecting a very powerful base creature like a True Dragon or a greater Seamwalker requires exorbitant amounts of XP to gain even the first level of its racial class, however. You can spend XP to hybridize with additional races, becoming an utterly unique being.

objects.title: Dormant Transformation
objects.text:
You no longer begin with your first transformation unlocked and instead must gain it the old-fashioned way through extreme training or a strong emotional trigger, or a great need when pushed to your limits in a fight.

As a small boon, however, when you do unlock your first transformation, its multiplier will be 5x instead of 2x and consume much less supernatural energy and stamina than normal.

objects.title: Even Further Beyond
objects.text: You immediately unlock your next transformation without any need of additional training or undergoing the triggers necessarily to do so. Your new transformation will possess a minimum multiplier of 2x, which stacks with the multiplier from previous transformations.

objects.title: Mastered Transformation
objects.text: You retroactively gain the benefits of long training, with your transformation(s) increasing their multipliers by +4X and lowering the drain they inflict upon by 25% for each purchase. However, each additional transformation will only gain half of this increase for each level. For example, your second transformation will only gain +2.5x increased multiplier and 12.5% less drain.

addons.text:
Unlimited Ability Works becomes your central hub for your powers. You can store any of your abilities inside Unlimited Ability Works, allowing you to alter it as you would copied abilities. You grow to be able to steal/copy the abilities of others either through touch or through sight within a radius of 100 meters, and also hand out the same to within your line of sight or through touch. 

Unlimited Ability Works now extends to items and objects that grant or possess abilities such as Cauldron Vials, although you’ll get a random expression when copying those powers. When using powers you can choose to host the power yourself or summon an item to use it through, including a copy of whatever item you originally copied it from if it was obtained through an item. When handing out a power you can choose to imbue an item with the ability. 

Each power stored inside Unlimited Ability Works grows to be able to express 5 different expressions at the same time. You can fuse as many powers as you wish greatly increasing synergy and without losing functionality or worrying about compatibility, including any fused abilities you may already have. Unlimited Ability Works can also incorporate the properties of whatever power you store inside of it, and you can discard unwanted abilities.
addons.title: Unlimited Management Works

addons.text: You gain the ability to make an unlimited amount of copies of powers stored inside Unlimited Ability Works, allowing you to field an incredible amount of variety of expressions of the same power. You gain a full copy of the abilities of whatever person, item, or entity you see or touch or otherwise encounter.
addons.title: Unlimited Copy Works

addons.text: You gain the ability to make an unlimited amount of copies of powers stored inside Unlimited Ability Works, allowing you to field an incredible amount of variety of expressions of the same power. You gain a full copy of the abilities of whatever person, item, or entity you see or touch or otherwise encounter. You start with a second copy of every power you purchase.
addons.title: Unlimited Copy Works

addons.text: You gain the ability to break down every ability stored inside Unlimited Ability Works into its component parts and reconstruct it in any manner. You gain a secondary thinker power that grants you perfect understanding and subconscious awareness of all possible combinations and allows you to immediately construct and deconstruct as you desire.
addons.title: Unlimited Component Works

addons.text: You can alter any and all copies or phantoms of living beings or objects you summon, the same as you could with powers. You can alter appearance, personality, memories, and powers and even add other powers you possess on top of the phantom's original ones.
addons.title: Unlimited Alter Works

objects.text:
You can alter the powers in your possession by cycling through different expressions of the same power or modifying it by boosting one aspect at the expense of another or changing its restrictions. You can do this to others in your line of sight as well. 

You have a secondary thinker power that subconsciously makes you aware of possible variations, and allows you to effortlessly alter them accordingly.
objects.title: Unlimited Variety Works (Unlimited Ability Works)

objects.text:
You are now capable of copying any and all powers from any existing source you encounter, regardless of the source's strength or number of powers.

Even barely glimpsing an avatar of an Entity is enough to have a full collection of the Entity's powers at full strength. This copying can even extend through such things as body parts, allowing you, for example, to get the full power of an Endbringer by finding a part severed in a fight.

Lastly, your copying has become absolute, with no defence being able to resist or circumvent it.
objects.title: Unlimited Copy Works (Unlimited Ability Works)

objects.text: You are no longer limited to copying the abilities of those you personally encounter. Now, you can copy powers based on photos of a person, a video recording, or even a story or a fantasy, allowing you to copy the abilities of imaginary and non-existent beings.
objects.title: Unlimited Imagination Works (Unlimited Ability Works)

addons.text:
You can now summon perfectly loyal copies of anyone you have ever witnessed. At your discretion they may appear as ghostly phantoms or one-to-one replicas of what they were when the copy took place. The copied phantoms keep their memories between summons and can grow in power just like individual copied powers could.

You can also copy any objects you encounter. You will automatically gain all the knowledge and ability needed to perfectly utilise the copied object.

Should any of your phantoms be damaged or destroyed, you can easily restore them by desummoning and summoning them again.
addons.title: Unlimited Phantom Works

objects.text:
Your copying ability now extends to any and all knowledge any entity may possess. This allows you to copy skills, technical knowledge, memories, and even entire personalities.

Active copied skills seamlessly integrate and adapt, allowing you, for example, to utilise copied martial arts without regard for any physical differences between you and the source of the skill.

Should you activate a copied personality, you can use it as a mask and even temporarily allow it to act in your stead, albeit you can always regain full control whenever you desire.
objects.title: Unlimited Skills Works (Unlimited Ability Works)

addons.text:
Every power in your arsenal is raised to be equal in strength to the strongest ability you possess. This process is continuous, updating every ability automatically whenever you acquire a new one or an existing power grows stronger.

Additionally, you can now perfectly control and regulate the strength of any and all powers you possess.
addons.title: Unlimited Upscale Works

objects.text:
Every power you copy is fully perfected, stripped of all the flaws and inherent downsides it may have previously had.

The power that would've caused you to feel pain or dealt internal damage when using it, for example, no longer does so, and abilities that produce unwanted side effects when utilised have those side effects entirely removed, or, alternatively, you may simply choose to be able to suppress them whenever you desire.
objects.title: Unlimited Improvement Works (Unlimited Ability Works)

objects.text:
You can manifest any of your copied powers as a separate entity or an Object of Power. In the case of a living being, you can fully customise their appearance and personality, as well as allow them to retain their memories between summons. For objects, you can similarly control the appearance, as well as set conditions on who, if anyone, will be able to use them aside from you.

Since all of your summons are merely independent representations of powers, even should any of them be damaged, wounded, or killed, you can instantly resummon them no worse for wear.
objects.title: Unlimited Manifestation Works (Unlimited Ability Works)

objects.text: You can have up to 3 templates active at once and merge their features.
objects.title: Hybrid Form (Shifter)

addons.text: Thanks to your understanding of merging forms, and altering them, you’ve now been given the ability to  incorporate the elements of any of your templates into your base form. You can only incorporate the elements of three forms at once.
addons.title: Mastery of Form

objects.text: You can now Alter the templates you have copied, allowing you to tweak the expression, appearance, gear or other aspects of the template. These can be saved as another unique template if you so wish.
objects.title: Editing (Shifter)

objects.text: You’ve reached a level of understanding where you can take pieces from your templates and combine them together into a new creation. The body of one, the mana reserves of another, all are just tools in the practice of form creation.
objects.title: Piecemeal (Shifter)

addons.text: By observing a partial description, you can now treat it as a template of its own and apply it like any other, be that Editing or as constituent parts for another constructed form.
addons.title: Bits & Bobs

objects.text: Your ability to copy anything you see has been amended slightly. Specifically, it dramatically broadened the definition of ‘see’. Now, any figure you concentrate on copying can be stored as a template, as long as you’re looking at a representation of them, be that News, a written description, or even Fictional characters. Any abilities these depictions have are translated into the template, but these do not include non-diegetic elements, such as theme music.
objects.title: Observational (Shifter)

objects.text:
You are no longer bound by what you could have seen or learnt from outside sources. Every imaginable form or combination thereof is less than a thought away, with no limits or restrictions.

Be a simple human one moment, the next—a living star; a moment later—a void. Should you so desire, you can even superimpose forms atop each other, for example, become a black hole in the shape of a human, only selectively freeing your destructive capabilities when you so desire.

Even should you not consciously direct it, your body will change or create new forms for every single need you might have and every challenge you encounter, such as instantly adapting to survive a particularly dangerous situation, for example.
objects.title: Free Form (Shifter)

addons.text: Aspects from forms seen later can be applied retroactively, be they skills or highly specific interactions between different powers.
addons.title: Interactivity

addons.text: With the higher specificity given from Free Form, you can modulate your retroactive shifting to a greater extent, allowing you to experiment and mastermind various outcomes. You can see the shape of these alternate presents and make your choices.. If not fully aware, at least informed.
addons.title: I Am That I Am

objects.text:
Your forms can now be applied retroactively. Meaning should you be hit by a bullet, then later shift into a bulletproof form, you can selectively choose to have shifted back before being shot, removing the wound.

Be aware, this can have unpredictable effects if done beyond a few moments later.
objects.title: Retroactive (Shifter)

objects.text: You generate 5 additional charges per 24h.
objects.title: Increased Charges (Architect)

objects.text: Increases the frequency of charges. Each purchase halves the time between charges are generated (every 12h, 6h, 3h).
objects.title: Increased Frequency (Architect)

objects.text: Each charge is worth 2 extra SP per purchase, up to 20 SP per charge.
objects.title: Increased Potency (Architect)

objects.text: You can destroy copied or stolen powers to generate charges. Each distinct power can only be refunded this way once; once a copied or stolen power has been destroyed, it cannot be copied again, only re-created from the blueprint.
objects.title: Refund Fraud  (Architect)

addons.text:
The effects of any and all Objects of Power Upgrades you purchased that do not have any specific OOP as a requirement now apply to all Objects of Power and Items that are created by the Architect. Additionally, you may treat all your purchased Objects of Power and Items as if they were created by the Architect in the first place.

If you come into possession of any item or Object of Power, you may connect it to the Architect, after which it will count as if created by you. Although, should the object be protected in some way, such as being soulbound, for example, you will need to expend a charge to claim it.
addons.title: Extended Benefits

objects.text: You can now create Objects of Power with your charges, summoning them somewhere in your vicinity, such as in your hand or somewhere in your line of sight. You can manipulate and interact with them as you would powers.
objects.title: Treasure Vault (Architect)

addons.text: You can now use lesser charges to create items similar to those from the Items section, in the same manner as Treasure Vault creates Objects of Power.
addons.title: Wholesaler

objects.text:
Your charges now extend to all personal traits and options, not just powers. Perks, skills, appearance changes, drawbacks, and similar effects are all within your control, and may be created, altered, or interacted with exactly as you would with powers.

You may split a Normal Charge into eight Lesser Charges. 

Lesser Charges are not a new type of resource, but simply smaller divisions of the same power, allowing for more precise and granular allocation and control. 

They may be freely combined, divided, or stacked alongside Normal Charges without restriction.

1 Lesser Charge = the value of 1 CP = the value of 0.5 SP
2 Lesser Charges = the value of 2 CP = the value of 1 SP 
8 Lesser Charges = the value of 8 CP = the value of 4 SP = 1 Normal Charge and so on. 

Each purchase of Increased Potency (Architect) also applies here. As potency grows, the divisibility of charges increases proportionally, preserving the same equivalency values. 

You may create Drawbacks and impose them on others or yourself, if you so wish. However, you cannot "buy off" the Drawbacks you originally selected in this CYOA.
objects.title: Side Benefits (Architect)

addons.text:
Your power expands beyond simply creating, able to manipulate and tweak any living being, be it of your making or not, in the same manner as you would powers. Although, if those you did not create personally have any protection, you will need to expend a charge for those alterations to stick. You can also imbue your creations with any skills and equipment you desire.

Additionally, you can create a replica of any character, real or fictional, complete with their personality, skills, powers, equipment, and even memories. For this, you only need a surface-level knowledge of the character, as Architect will fill in any missing details. Every single detail can be further tweaked and modified to suit your tastes, and you can install the same loyalty towards you that your other creations possess.

Every new creation requires only lesser charges now, with the cost being a single lesser charge, plus the square root of the total cost of the character’s powers, skills, perks, etc., rounded up to the nearest whole number in charges. Further alterations beyond the initial creation cost the normal amount of points.

Should any of your creations perish, they can be revived after 24 hours have passed at no cost, or immediately by expending a charge as normal.
addons.title: Expy

addons.text:
Instead of creating characters wholesale, you can choose to store created characters as your Personas. 

You can create your regular stored Personas as normal inside your slots, but you can also create as many additional Personas not beholden to a slot, although they don’t get the benefit of a normal Persona budget, instead their cost is entirely dependent on Architect paying the cost, being equivalent to the cost of the character normally being made. 

You can separate a Persona from you at will and turn them into a normal creation. Architect made Personas are not subject to the normal time requirements of creating a Persona.

Architect improves your ability to create and manipulate Personas, matching your control over own creations. This allows you to freely tweak your Personas without restrictions. You may also pour Architect Charges into Personas to further enhance your Personas.
addons.title: Persona

objects.text:
You can create beings, with their charge cost being 1, for their creation, plus the sum total cost of their powers.

You have complete control over their appearance and personality and can imbue them with any knowledge and skills you yourself possess. Their loyalty to you is unbreakable, to the point of being immune to any attempts at mind control, unless you purposefully create them otherwise.

You are always aware of the exact location of your creations, can communicate with them regardless of distance, or summon them to your side. Should they be destroyed, their existence stays inseparably bound to the Architect itself, needing only a single charge for their resurrection.
objects.title: Retinue (Architect)

addons.text:
Anything and anyone made or changed by the Architect can now be retroactively inserted into the world. An OOP you create may be a legendary ancient artefact, and a companion you create may have a family, be the CEO of a galaxy-spanning corporation, or be a world-famous artist.

As with the system, it takes ten charges to make your creation added retroactively, on top of the cost required for the creation or the change themselves.
addons.title: Retroactive Continuity

objects.text:
In addition to singular abilities, you can now create entire supernatural systems and embed them into the world. Be it a magical system, psionic abilities, chakra pathways, or anything else, you can design a system that will allow anyone to practice and advance in it. 

You may decide the effective range in which this system will be accessible, make a room where everyone becomes psychic, a multiverse-spanning magic system, or remove any kind of range limit entirely, as well as choose whether someone has to remain inside the range to utilise the system or can retain access even outside of it.

As with everything else you create, every single detail about the newly developed system is completely under your control, from who has the potential to learn it to how far one can advance in it. As the creator and origin, you have instant mastery over the system you create, as well as complete and total immunity to everything originating from it, as nothing you create can ever be turned against you without your express permission.

But the price of such fundamental change to reality is steep. To create a power system, you must spend a hundred times the amount of charges that is required for the creation of a singular ability of a similar magnitude, with additional ten charges if you want to make the embedding retroactive.

Lastly, just as you could alter and modify powers, you can now directly interfere with other supernatural systems already present in the world. If the system is without a manager or protection of any kind, you can freely insert yourself into the role of a creator, claiming all the benefits as if you created it in the first place; otherwise, you will have to spend a charge to do so.
objects.title: Distributed Systems Engineering (Architect)

objects.text:
Now, all the leftover charges produced by the architect empower all your abilities until you spend them.

Each charge enhances every one of your powers by one percent of its total strength. As such, a hundred charges will double the strength of every power you possess.

This boost includes the Architect itself as well, albeit to a lesser extent. With every leftover charge the generation of new ones speeds up. Every thirty charges, the speed at which you generate new charges effectively doubles.
objects.title: Interest Rates (Architect)

objects.text: You have one more slot.
objects.title: More Slots (Polybius)

objects.text: You have one less slot per selection.
objects.title: Less Slots (Polybius)

addons.text: Polybius generates an additional 5 SP per day into your pool for you to allocate. You also generate an additional 1 SP for every additional Polybius slot. The SP generated is doubled for every Growth Booster bought.
addons.title: Ever Filling Pool

addons.text: Polybius doesn't have just a vast catalog of abilities to choose from that expands and grows over time. Polybius has every power and every single variation in its infinite catalog. The infinite engine that powers it has also mutated it, allowing it to summon powers in a variety of new ways, as well as summoning more than just powers. Now Perks, OoPs, Skills, Items, and other facets can be utilized as well, their variety as infinite as your powers. In the case of options requiring CP, your SP pool will convert at a ratio of 1SP:2CP and back as needed. OoPs and Items summoned are all still representations of your pool, so if destroyed or lost their cost gets added right back to your pool. You can now summon any power you wish, although it’ll still choose for you if you do not direct them. Instead your ability to call upon a power is merely restricted by your SP.
addons.title: Never Ending Well

addons.text:
Once you manifest something using the Polybius, you can permanently separate the portion of the pool that sustains it, 'solidifying' your creation.

Everything you have 'solidified' is still connected to Polybius. For example, you can grant the power to someone else and recall it at will, and living beings can be resurrected in case of death. But you can never reassign this portion of the pool to anything else.

The separated portion of the pool is capable of growth, as the power it is assigned to develops, or a living being gets stronger, and your primary pool will never completely dry out. Once you have separated a portion of it, your pool will start refilling itself at a rate of one SP per week. While slowly, you will accumulate an endless array of abilities in your arsenal.

You are capable of storing anything you have solidified into a sort of 'archive', effectively removing it from your arsenal if it no longer suits your taste, but you can always recall it into your active roster.

Lastly, you can now subsume other powers, objects, and living beings into Polybius by dedicating a part of the pool equal to the sum total of powers and abilities they hold. Everything subsumed will count as if it was created by the Polybius and solidified.
addons.title: Permanent Manifestation

objects.text: Your slots and their combined SP limits are converted into a pool of SP for you to choose your powers. Any improvements on a power will also raise the amount of SP you have available in your pool by a comparative amount.
objects.title: Pool (Polybius)

addons.text:
Instead of giving full power slots, you now grant people temporary access to a portion of your SP pool, creating complex powersets within the allotted amount of points. When someone trains and improves the powers gifted by you, the corresponding part of the pool they are connected to will also grow.

There are no longer any limits to the design of your constructs. Their physical capabilities can range from below a normal human to the level of Endbringers and beyond, with no definable upper limit. The number of points needed to create a construct is half of the sum total of the point cost of their powerset.

Lastly, you no longer require any body, mind, and soul to exist. Your existence is now tied to the Polybius itself, allowing you to freely manifest any desired form and restore or replace it as needed—same as you could create other beings—only limited by the available points.
addons.title: Entourage

addons.text: Now every being you create with Polybius or grant power to will regularly generate SP for your pool at a rate of 1 SP per day. They will also generate an additional 1 SP per day for every extra slot you possess, and the generation rate doubles for every Growth Booster you purchase.
addons.title: Crowdsourcing

addons.text: Now, by expending CP, you can create copies of any character, real or fictional. You can further customise their physical attributes, powerset, memories, and personality. They will be as loyal to you as your other creations unless you purposefully create them otherwise.
addons.title: Replica

objects.text:
You can now share access to your power slots, allowing others to wield powers granted by the Polybius in your stead. When you do so, you lose access to the slot, although you can regain control at any time, with nothing and no one being able to keep the power from returning to you if you so desire.

Alternatively, when separating a slot, you can materialise it as a conscious construct with physical capabilities roughly equal to that of an Endbringer on top of the power you chose to be placed in the slot. You can choose the exact appearance and personality of the constructs, and no matter what, your personal Endbringers will be completely loyal to you. You can dematerialise existing ones and create new constructs at any time you wish, with the minds of previous constructs being safely stored in the vast library of Polybius to be summoned again when needed. You can swap what power each construct has on the fly or allow them to do it themselves. Lastly, you can create constructs without personality or mind of their own to serve as your remote-controlled bodies.

When you regain a slot, the powers retain all the growth that occurred while they were separated.
objects.title: Rogue Synapse (Polybius)

objects.text:
You can integrate the first tier of an ascension into Dynamist. This ascension will grow alongside your other powers and you will be able to reach higher tiers or even forge your own ascension path.

This precludes you from picking an ascension outside of Dynamist.
objects.title: Dynamic Ascension (Dynamist)

objects.text: You have an additional Paragon Power Slot which can contain a power that can cost up to 120 SP for Dynamist.
objects.title: Paragon Power (Dynamist)

objects.text: You have additional Superior Power Slot which can contain powers costs up to 90 SP for Dynamist per purchase.
objects.title: Superior Powers (Dynamist)

objects.text: You have space for an additional Major Power for Dynamist per purchase.
objects.title: Additional Major Power (Dynamist)

objects.text: You have space for an additional Minor Power for Dynamist per purchase.
objects.title: Additional Minor Power (Dynamist)

objects.text: You have space for one fewer Minor Power for Dynamist per purchase.
objects.title: Remove Minor Power (Dynamist)

objects.text: You have space for one fewer Major Power for Dynamist per purchase.
objects.title: Remove Major Power (Dynamist)

objects.text:
Instead of automatically mutating, Dynamist will build an ever growing upgrade tree for your powers.

Each power has its own upgrade tree, how it works depends on the power itself but will usually follow either a fully diverging tree or a complex web of interconnected nodes.

The number of nodes you can select depends on the form of the skill tree. For diverging trees you can always select one of the branches fully. For webs, the number of choices is proportional to the size.

Choices are not permanent, you can change your selection whenever you want. It takes a around 10 seconds for the power to reconfigure itself, during this it cannot be used actively.
objects.title: Upgrade Tree (Dynamist)

objects.text: With each purchase of this upgrade, Dynamist's rate of growth both vertically and horizontally is doubled: Power mutations that would normally take four minutes to manifest would now take two minutes, then one, then 30 seconds, and so on. This upgrade also divides the time needed for Upgrade Tree to reconfigure itself by 1.5 with each purchase.
objects.title: Growth Boost (Dynamist)

objects.text: The reach of Dynamist has now been extended, and now any power that is not part of the powers in Dynamist power slot can now be affected by it although, while it is much slower when compared to the ones in Dynamist power slots, it is faster than Dynamist jr
objects.title: Dynamist Unbound

addons.text: No longer are your other powers secondary to those hosted by Dynamist, now every power you possess falls under Dynamist’s scope and can benefit from Dynamist’s full power.
addons.title: All In One

addons.text:
Dynamist and Dynamist Jr fuse, binding themselves to one another in a way that makes them far more powerful than its component parts. Redundant and similar upgrades such as Growth Boost (Dynamist Jr.) will each count as an additional Growth Boost (Dynamist), and purchasing the Tree upgrade for both will grow it to allow it to automatically mutate while still allowing you to reconfigure it later. 

Rather than remaining a separate ability, they fuse with one another gaining and expanding upon each of their advantages and giving Dynamist the ability to mutate and enhance itself like it does other powers.
addons.title: Ouroboros
Combined Pool
addons.text: The power slots from Lesser Dynamist are also converted and added into the pool of SP, combined with those from Dynamist. There is no distinction between points that come from Dynamist and those from Lesser Dynamist.

objects.text:
Your slots are converted into a pool of SP for you to choose your powers. You now have your slots combined SP limits as a budget to choose your powers.

You can freely allocate your points as you wish, including giving more points to a power than its actual cost. You can grab any power and its upgrades provided you have enough SP for it.

Instead of losing SP points powers given extra points rise in potency to match its given SP.
objects.title: Pool (Dynamist)

objects.text: You can integrate Objects of Power into Dynamist as though they were normal powers. this can either manifest as a summon-able item or an ability endemic to yourself depending on what fits the individual OoP most and personal preference. Naturally this allows these 'objects' to be affected and adjusted by Dynamist
objects.title: Sectioning (Dynamist)

objects.text:
All of Dynamist's slots fuse into one singular slot that can contain a minor power which costs up to 30 SP. The speed at which this power evolves five times as fast, the quality of the mutations, both horizontal and vertical, is similarly improved, and sub-powers manifest and evolve at a higher rate. 

You can freely shape the direction of those changes and no longer need to be facing a challenge for Dynamist to improve, it will use simulations and precognition to remove gaps in your ability ahead of time; maintenance and optimizations happen in the background, removing the issue of mutation debt entirely.
objects.title: Singular Focus (Dynamist)

objects.text: Instead of being able to choose the power, Dynamist creates a 10 SP power seed designed specifically for you; the evolution and mutation potential of this power is almost infinite, it grows two times faster than the singular slot, new aspects, abilities, and sub-powers manifest much more frequently and are often stronger and more versatile.
objects.title: Personal Focus (Dynamist)

objects.text:
You can now freely alter the expression of your Dynamist power. What this allows you to do in effect is alter the powers inside Dynamist at will, from something as simple as exchanging potency for range to a complete paradigm shift from Changer to Master. 

Most importantly however this allows you to freely alter Dynamist at will as well, from swapping what powers Dynamist is emulating at will, reallocating your pool of power, to focusing on vertical or horizontal growth and much more. Dynamist will alter without any conscious efforts to meet your needs and desires.
objects.title: Flux (Dynamist)

objects.text: Your power has grown to encompass its sister ability. If you possess Celestial Inventory you now also possess Summoner’s Sanctuary, if you possess Summoner’s Sanctuary you now possess Celestial Inventory. The two powers meld together seamlessly.
objects.title: Celestial Sanctuary (Celestial Inventory/Summoner's Sanctuary)

objects.text:
The Celestial Inventory comes with a dimensional pocket, where you can store and retrieve objects, liquids, gases, or any other tangible thing. This pocket space has unlimited capacity, and contained entities neither come into contact with each other nor degrade over time.

Any object smaller in size than a hundred cubic meters can be moved to and from the pocket dimension instantly, and with each second, the effective volume which you can move doubles, allowing you to store and summon much larger objects. While solid objects can only be moved as a whole, you can move an arbitrary volume of gases, liquids, etc. Any objects summoned from Celestial Inventory can be recalled into the pocket dimension and moved back from it instantly from any distance.

The pocket dimension has its own search and favourites system.
objects.title: Dimensional Pocket (Celestial Inventory)

objects.text:
Your Mental search bar to help locate items from the Celestial Inventory has seen a massive buff depending on how you look at it, now instead of being limited to only being able to search for something if you know the items name you can instead search for the universe the item comes from such as being able to search for an item in the "Marvel" category and being given a mental list of items from the marvel universe to vastly limit the amount of items you need to look through to get the specific item you are looking for without knowing the name of the item. 

The search bar can now also limit an item you are looking for by searching for a specific property of item in the search bar such as typing in "sword" and then being given a list of swords this vastly helps when looking for an item that you don't know the name of allowing you to look through a specific genre of item to get the specific item that you want instead of needing to look through a vast list of items unrelated to what you currently need.
objects.title: Advanced UI (Celestial Inventory)

objects.text: The Summoner's Sanctuary has coalesced into an infinitely sized pocket dimension. Its interior space can be customised and modified however you wish, from a small two-room apartment floating in the void to a skyscraper with infinite floors. Moreover, you can manifest parts of this dimension in any universe you visit, with their external appearance also under your complete control, and internal space connected to the rest of the Sanctuary. When you unsummon someone, you can choose for them to remain within this dimension and even have a space customised for their maximum comfort, from a cosy room to a giant castle. You may even selectively warp time so that for those inside your sanctuary only moments pass before you summon them again. Should anyone you summoned perish, they will resurrect inside the Sanctuary with all wounds perfectly healed. You can also extend the same benefits to other people, allowing even those you did not summon to resurrect inside your dimension. You will also gain a space of your own, perfectly tailored to your taste, and will resurrect inside the Sanctuary should you ever meet your untimely demise. Nothing can stop or interfere with the resurrection process, as well as enter the dimension against your will. You can freely teleport to and from this dimension, as well as bring anything and anyone inside, but you cannot take outside anything that was created as part of the dimension.
objects.title: Throne of Heroes (Summoner's Sanctuary)

objects.text: For something to threaten you, they do not need to be real. Theoretical or otherwise, you can grow to surpass the figures in your head. The people who you believe could do something. The story characters in a book, a creature from legend, or even imaginary threats of a rumor.
objects.title: Inner Demons (Conquest)

addons.text:
All members of your Pantheon are tied to you forevermore, immortal and unageing. With but a thought, you can rewind their age, resurrect them even from complete annihilation, or let them regenerate near-instantly from any and all injuries.

Furthermore, you can, at will, raise or limit the strength of the members of your pantheon to any level not exceeding your own, as well as share any powers and perks you possess with them.
addons.title: Legion (Conquest)

objects.text:
You can share your ability to overcome any challenge with others, allowing them to grow in power just like you do.

With this, your companions can become your generals, aiding you in your endeavours, or the best sparring partners, always rising to provide you the most fulfilling challenge.

You can grant and recall this blessing at any time, and the strength of those you granted power to will never outmatch your own.
objects.title: Pantheon (Conquest)

objects.text: You are no longer empowered just enough to overcome a challenge. Now, you completely transcend any and all obstacles, dangers, and challenges you encounter. Your opponents will not even be able to scratch you; your blows will shatter their defences like wet paper; your intellectual pursuit may see your mental capabilities rise to near-omniscience. The power to solve any and all of your problems is less than a thought away.
objects.title: Transcendence (Conquest)

objects.text:
Now, you can travel to and control even metaphysical planes, dimensions, and worlds. This includes mindscapes, dreams, personal worlds, and everything else that otherwise would have been inaccessible to you. You can fold the boundaries between thought and reality, collapsing the distance between conceptual realms and material dimensions. Locations that exist only as ideas or possibilities are as reachable as any point in physical space. Even the most abstract forms of existence—those without shape, boundary, or form—can be traversed, altered, or brought into alignment with your design. 

Your mastery over time also grows, as you are now capable of controlling it even in places where such a concept does not exist at all. You can loop time inside someone's dream to plunge them into a never-ending nightmare or stop time and trap someone inside their own inner world.
objects.title: Imaginary Axis (Mobius)

objects.text:
You have transcended the limitations of conventional creation. Thus, you are now capable of creating matter and energy that are not simply undiscovered, but most definitely do not and can not exist.

The matter and energy you make can now break the most fundamental laws of the universe, and there is no limit on what properties they can have. From indestructible materials to fire that burns at absolute zero, poisonous light, wind that turns organic matter into sand, and anything else your mind can imagine.
objects.title: Ptah (Amun)

objects.text:
Even without any prerequisite knowledge, you can create anything you can imagine. You need only a general idea, and any missing details will be filled in by Amun itself.

This includes things such as Items, Objects of Power, and even Companions. You can create any artefact, for any conceivable purpose and of any complexity, or living being with powers, personalities, and memories of their own, with any details polished by Amun to perfectly follow your intent. You can also use any kind of medium, such as a story, a film, or a photo, to create perfect replicas of any item or character even should you lack any knowledge about them beyond the general concept, as well as modify these creations in whatever way you desire.
objects.title: Sokar (Amun)

objects.text:
You can raise each and every attack or effect you produce to the level of the Universal Law. The fire you conjure becomes the concept of burning solidified, incinerating matter, energy, and even abstract ideas, and the black hole you create is a universal attractor that traps everything in its event horizon—from souls to luck and fate.

Any limits on what you can shape and control have been shattered. Even in metaphysical and imaginary spaces, where concepts of matter and energy do not exist at all and your surroundings are merely abstract representations, your control remains absolute, allowing you to reshape the architecture of dreams and fantasies.
objects.title: Ma'at (Amun)

objects.text:
At its most basic level, the entirety of existence is an infinite collection of configurations of matter and energy held together by various physical and metaphysical laws, with the passage of time being merely the change from one configuration to the next.

You now have access to this most fundamental basis of existence. Each configuration that has been, could have been, is, could be, or could never be is laid out before you like grains of sand on an endless beach. You can pluck any grain and install it as the current configuration, setting the world to any state you desire, past or future, possible or impossible. You can also sweep aside unwanted configurations, thus suppressing undesirable effects and outcomes; reproduce any phenomena—natural or supernatural—by picking a configuration where it has taken place; or even change the current operating laws of reality entirely.
objects.title: Atum (Amun)

addons.text:
You have obtained one of the most powerful top-secret experimental weapons of the United States of America’s Military from the world of Fallout, named ARCHIMEDES II. 

Project Poseidon is an orbital laser canon that gathers the sun's rays to create an extremely powerful artillery blast towards a targeted area below it. This weapon is now built into your selected satellite property, which is modified such that it gains modifications that allow it to gather energy from the sun and redirect it towards an area. Unlike the original, which requires an array of mirrors set on the ground to collect sunlight and beam it back up to ARCHIMEDES II, your satellite can do everything on its own. 

You are given the C-Finder, a strange gun-shaped device that allows you to activate ARCHIMEDES and set coordinates to where you wish it to fire.

Note that you may only use the ARCHIMEDES II once every 24 hours.
addons.title: Project ARCHIMEDES II

objects.text:
You may now choose a single additional heavy weapon from any of the Fallout games. 

If you have purchased one selection of Wasteland Arms, you may select weapons that may be easily obtained from any of the Fallout Games that don't require special effort to be obtained.

If you have purchased Wasteland Arms twice, however, you may select unique or named weapons that may come from quests, or are of limited availability, or are one of a kind from any of the Fallout games.

Should you have purchased Wasteland Arms three times, you may also further upgrade your selected weapon to gain FIVE appropriate lines of Legendary Attributes. 

Such weapons include Super Sledge, Deathclaw Gauntlet, Power Fist, Shishkebab, Grognak's Axe. Various heavy Ballistic, laser, plasma, or explosive weapons, including: the Laser Gatling gun, Plasma Caster, Plasma Gatling gun, Tesla Cannon, and of course, the infamous Fat Man Nuclear Missile Launcher.
objects.title: The Big Guns (Fallout)

objects.text:
You're a natural bearer of multiple crests. You can choose to have your hair become silver and your eyes purple if you wish, unlike Edelgard and Lysithea you do not have a reduce lifespan.

Each purchase will let you choose to have a Major Crest of one you don't have and it's associated Heroes' Relics and Sacred Weapons.
objects.title: Full Armory (Fire Emblem)

objects.text:
During your time as a Keyblade wielder you will have a dream that takes you to your own 'Station of awakening'. There you will have to pass your own Mark of Master exam. Once passed you will become a true Keyblade Master.

You will be able to enter a mental world like the 'Station of Awakening'. When focusing for a few minutes about a person, situation, place or a problem you are faced with you can enter this mental void with stained glass platforms. Each stained glass representing the object of your focus. You will then hear a an unidentifiable voice that may help you realize something about what you were focusing on, but only just enough to help you out.

All Keyblade Masters share the ability to extract the hearts of themselves or others. This can be in full or only parts of the heart, such as extracting the darkness from someone's heart. They are also able to lock the world away, completely cutting it off from the outside. Another ability is to perform the Keyblade Inheritance Ceremony, a trial in which a person is chosen to inherit the power of the Keyblade. You will also gain Keyblade armor and the ability to turn your Keyblade into a Keyblade Glider. 

You gain the Power of Waking much like Sora. Allowing you to awaken Sleeping Worlds and Sleeping Hearts, bringing them back to their original state. This grants you the ability to dive into the heart of a person to reach their Station of Awakening in order to wake them up.

You could give emotions to an eldritch monstrosity or an unfeeling robot, a soulless clone or a full blown AI. With enough time and effort even granting them their own Heart, which is almost synonymous with a ‘soul'. The closer the being is to ‘human’ the less time this will take, with someone who is functionally human may take only a few years, while a eldritch horror may take several centuries of close interaction.
objects.title: Keyblade Master

addons.text:
You gain access to Limit Form. Limit Form will increase your physical and magical ability slightly but will grant and teach you powerful martial and magical attacks. You will gain a Limit Attack for each of these attacks. Through usage and mastery of this form, you gain the ability to heal yourself of damage done by your Limit attacks and increase your maximum number of Limit Breaker Charges quicker than normal.

Also, you may now use your Limit Breaker pool as a Drive Gauge gaining the ability to enter Drive Forms by spending three or more Limit Charges. This transformation will last half of your normal time limit but you can spend extra charges to add extra time. Should you enter a Drive form by using a charge you will gain a powerful burst of self-healing and recover a large amount of mana.
addons.title: Limit Form

addons.text:
Each of your Drive Forms gets its powers greatly boosted. With the diminishing returns of your Drive Forms being removed and your ability to stay in them getting massively increased. In time you may now gain entirely new Drive Forms by meeting and bonding with new allies and through personal growth and accomplishments.

You also gain Ultimate Form which acts as a vastly improved version of Final Form and grants the ability to summon countless spectral Keyblades you may control telekinetically. Usage of this form will demand an insane amount of allies granting you their power or taxing your stamina and magic reserves to the limits.
addons.title: Form Mastery

objects.text:
You gain a set of fashionable magical garments that possess special powers. To start they are magically reinforced acting as decent armor able to protect your entire body even uncovered parts. Also, they can self-repair over time or instantly if you feed them magic. But their greatest ability they grant is Drive Forms. 

These special transformations will both modify your abilities and empower you greatly while also granting a single potent ability once mastered that you may use outside of them. These abilities include High Jump, Magic Dash, Double Jump, and Glide/Flight. To enter a Drive form you will need to either borrow the power of an ally or power it yourself through magic and stamina. Drive forms will increase your power and can be improved with training but with diminishing returns past a point. At first, you will be hard-pressed to hold a Drive Form for longer than a few minutes but can improve your time limit by training to a soft limit of an hour. 

To start you get access to Valor or Wisdom. But with further growth and training, you will also unlock Master Form and Final Form

Valor Form will grant you the ability to wield a second Keyblade and greatly increase your physical abilities. But will greatly hamper your ability to use magic until you master the form. 

Wisdom Form will greatly increase your magical strength at the cost of your physical strength, while also granting you the ability to shoot magical bolts with your Keyblade. This form allows you to float across the ground gliding with magic while greatly increasing your speed.

Master Form will also let you wield a second Keyblade telekinetically with one hand while also increasing both your physical and magical ability. This form acts as a combination of both Valor and Wisdom Form's best strengths.

Final Form grants you the ability to wield a second Keyblade and your original both telekinetically granting insane combat ability. This form massively increases both your physical and magical abilities as if Valor, Wisdom, and Master forms were combined. While in this form you will also gain the ability to float and glide with mastery becoming total flight.
objects.title: Drive Form Clothing

objects.text: How curious; it seems that you have not only obtained a second Keyblade, but also the ability to wield two at once, something normally only possible by holding two Hearts in the same body. You also now have the Keychains for the Kingdom Key D and the Starlight. While this doesn't actually boost your power beyond benefitting from two Keychains, the value of simply having two magical skeleton keys shouldn't be understated.
objects.title: Synch Blade (Kingdom Hearts)

objects.text: Dawn of Destruction This is the sword of the hero of the Völsunga saga Sigurd. Originally it was a Sword of Selection, thrust into the Barnstokkr tree by Odin and drawn forth by Sigurd’s father Sigmund, before it was shattered by Odin’s divine spear Gungnir, and was reforged anew into a cursed and demonic blade capable of killing even Dragon kind. Gram is thought to be the strongest demonic sword capable of matching the strongest holy sword Excalibur, and unleashing waves of demonic fire to obliterate one’s foes. As a sword that has been broken and reforged, Gram now has a piece of the original broken blade connected to it’s pommel, turning it into a double bladed weapon, along with this you gain four smaller shards of the blade reforged into daggers as well. Gram’s most powerful use is the technique Bölverk Gram, instead of unleashing the blade’s power as a wave of destruction, instead the blade is charged with magical energy, and then thrown at the target in blast of searing demonic flame. Each of the smaller daggers can be used to perform this technique as well, though at a much reduced power level. Note: Gram somehow picks up an emerald colour when it is reforged, no-one currently knows why, so you may freely select the colour of your Gram.
objects.title: Gram (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
Alongside your weapon, you have now gained a suit of armor and a shield. Both of these have the enchantment to make it mobile and compact. When activated, it perfectly overlays any clothing or equipment you have while also leaving your equipment accessible. By default, this takes the form of an accessory of your choice and activates by having physical contact with it and being willing to expand. You may choose if you want to access the armor, shield, or both.

Due to being made out of celestial bronze, your armor and shield are nigh-indestructible, far lighter, and offer more protection than they naturally should. Unlike celestial bronze weapons though, the shield and armor affect supernatural and mortal effects alike, but they are far more effective towards the supernatural. This resistance is strong enough to block blows from all but the most powerful of Greek monsters.

Alongside this, your armor has three forms: Light, Medium, and Heavy, which you can easily change while out of combat. Light armor offers a great level of overall protection while keeping you lightweight and easily moveable. Medium armor is the perfect middle ground and offers more protection than light armor at the cost of removing some of your mobility. The heavy armor version makes it slightly heavier and removes even more of your mobility, but in return, it majorly boosts the protection it offers.

Alternatively, you can have it made out of Imperial Gold, which has the same properties.

Note: For every additional weapon you buy you may gain another suit of armor.
objects.title: Celestial Bronze Armor (Percy Jackson)

objects.text:
Your weapon has been upgraded from celestial bronze to the most powerful and dangerous material in the Percy Jackson universe, Stygian Iron. Stygian Iron is typically only usable by demi-gods whose parents are connected to the underworld, but you have found a way to bypass that effect entirely. Contrary to normal divine metals, it has the ability to harm normal mortals and supernaturals alike, with you gaining the ability to control this feature at will.

Its most powerful, and main, ability is that it can absorb the essence of any supernatural it kills, making itself stronger in the process and permanently killing any immortals unless they are significantly stronger than what the metal can handle, in which case it will take them longer to regenerate or reform. Alongside this ability, it also slows down the target's natural and supernatural regeneration factors. Lastly, as a result of being forged in the underworld, it now also enhances abilities related to death or darkness when channeled through it.
objects.title: Stygian Iron (Percy Jackson)

objects.text:
Your weapon has gained a unique variation of a property found in Bone Steel, the Norse Pantheons divine metal. Unlike other divine metals, bone steel is forged through iron smelted with bones and then quenched in blood, and if forged correctly, it becomes a divine metal. The unique property Bone Steel has specifically is the ability to be far more effective on creatures whose blood it was quenched with.

Unlike normal bone steel, your weapon also now has the property to be supernaturally attuned to another type of creature or supernatural through some of their blood. You may change this attunement whenever through dropping blood onto it while willing it to change, but it can only have one attunement. To return to a past attunement, you must drop that creature's blood on it again. Alongside this attunement, your weapon was quenched through your own blood when forged and is now also supernaturally effective on any creatures who share your heritage or a variation of your heritage. These attunements can not be used against you in any way.
objects.title: Bone Steel (Percy Jackson)

addons.title: Throne of the Sea God
addons.text:
As <U>Lord of Olympus</U>, you lead the Olympian Council, a group comprising some of the most powerful, influential, and important gods around. As the leader, you possess great influence and power within this council, but it’s far from absolute.

With the seat you now inherit from Poseidon as the god of the seas, you hold two seats on the Council. You can choose to retain both seats yourself or appoint someone of your choosing to hold one, creating a grateful ally inclined to follow your lead. Without extreme provocation—or neglect—from you, they will be highly unlikely to betray you.

addons.title: Throne of the Chthonic God
addons.text:
As <U>Lord of Olympus</U>, you lead the Olympian Council, a group comprising some of the most powerful, influential, and important gods around. As the leader, you possess great influence and power within this council, but it’s far from absolute.

Mortals feared the God of the Dead, refusing to acknowledge his presence upon the Olympian Council—whether as an extra member or replacing a god is up to you—but mortal wishes have little hold over the gods. Now, with the seat you inherit from Hades as the god of the dead, you hold two seats on the Council. You can choose to retain both seats yourself or appoint someone of your choosing to hold one, creating a loyal ally inclined to follow your lead. Without extreme provocation—or neglect—from you, they will be highly unlikely to betray you.

addons.title: Triune Deus
addons.text:
After the famous sons of Kronos overthrew their father, they divided his dominion over the world between them. Zeus became God of the Heavens and King of Olympus. Poseidon became God of the Oceans and King of Atlantis. Hades became God of the Afterlife and King of the Underworld. Yet, none of the brothers could truly claim the Earth as their own—each having influence over it and needing to answer to the others.

As you control the Heavens, the Seas, and the Underworld, unopposed you can now gain equivalent control and authority over the Earth. The gods and spirits of nature now answer to you as the God of the Earth, accepting your new position as their leader. They will be initially loyal, though they may ultimately attempt to overthrow you if you give them cause.

This can optionally come with another seat upon the Olympian Council—as an extra member or replacement is up to you—if you wish. You can, as always, choose to retain all of your seats or appoint someone of your choosing to hold one, creating a loyal ally inclined to follow your lead. Without extreme provocation—or neglect—from you, they will be highly unlikely to betray you.

objects.text: You hold the symbol of the King of the Gods, the Master Bolt. You bear the divine ichor of the gods within your veins. Now you take your throne as the new Lord—or Lady—of Olympus. Perhaps Zeus was somehow slain or faded. Maybe you mantled him so completely that you now are him, as far as the world can tell. Regardless of the reasoning, you are the inheritor of Zeus’s position and powers—Skyfather and King of Olympus. With your ascension, you’ve gained Mount Olympus, the home of the gods and the seat of their power. A mountain floating high in the sky—hidden by the mist—and covered in various Grecian temples that serve as the homes of the gods. Olympus comes with every god and monster that resides upon it—and those that don’t have their own kingdom to rule. These gods will all respect your new position as their leader and be initially loyal, though they may ultimately attempt to overthrow you if you give them cause.
objects.title: Lord of Olympus (Percy Jackson)

objects.text: You bear the symbol of the King of Atlantis, the Trident. You carry the divine ichor of the gods within your veins. Now, take your place upon the throne of Atlantis as its new King—or Queen. Perhaps Poseidon has retired. Perhaps he has faded or been slain. Or perhaps you have mantled him so completely that, as far as the world can tell, you are him. Regardless of the reason, you are the inheritor of all the powers and positions of the God of the Ocean and King of Atlantis. With your ascent to the throne, you gain, of course, Atlantis, the former home of Poseidon and his court, and a seat of his power. An entire Grecian city-state deep beneath the ocean, home to gods, monsters, and beings of the sea who now owe their allegiance to you. These gods will accept your new position as their leader and will be initially loyal, though they may ultimately attempt to overthrow you if you give them cause.
objects.title: Lord of Atlantis (Percy Jackson)

objects.text:
All of your enchanted Objects of Power have received further enchantments, pushing them to the limit of mortal enchanting.
