Your sword has several new enchantments to better serve you in and outside of combat. First, it slowly repairs itself to mint condition, removing the need for maintenance. This process takes days to finish if the sword is broken, but is otherwise always in effect. Second, any wound inflicted using this weapon will take longer and more effort to heal. Finally, all previous enchantments are moderately increased in strength, enough that you can cut through enchanted metal with the same ease you could plate armor previously.

Your warhammer has several new enchantments to better serve you in and outside of combat. First, it slowly repairs itself to peak condition, removing the need for maintenance. This process takes days to finish if the warhammer is broken, but is otherwise always in effect. Second, the shockwaves now reverberate through the target, dealing additional damage over time. Finally, all previous enchantments are moderately boosted, enough that its shockwaves can bypass enchanted armor as easily as normal armor.

Your armor gains several new enchantments to better protect and enhance you in and out of combat. First, it slowly repairs itself to pristine condition over time, removing the need for maintenance. If heavily damaged, this process takes days but is always active. Second, the armour now passively reduces the impact of all incoming attacks, dispersing force across its surface to significantly minimise damage, even from powerful blows. Finally, all previous enchantments are moderately enhanced, increasing the armor’s durability and resistance to damage, such that even enchanted weapons will struggle to penetrate it.

Your clothes’ enchantments have increased in strength. They repair almost instantly and are about as resistant as leather armor. All dirt and grime will instantly be cleaned.

(This doesn't give you additional Objects, only upgrades what you already have.)
objects.title: Heavily Enchanted

objects.text:
Ammunition management remains the greatest limitation of the Helios platform. Due to the weapon’s intense power requirements and unique plasma-rail hybrid operation, energy cells must be swapped frequently under sustained combat conditions.

With each subsequent purchase of this, the total number of modular energy cells you receive will instead be increased per the cubic number sequence: 1, 8, 27, 64, 125 cells and so on. Each modular energy cell holds enough power for either 100 rapid shots or 10 long-range sniper discharges. Each cell takes 4 hours of solar charging to fully refill itself, although they can use other sources of energy.
objects.title: Auxiliary Ammunition Supply – Helios

objects.text:
Goliath’s power lies in its ability to overwhelm, but that power comes at a steep logistical cost. With each subsequent purchase of this, the total number of ammunition bricks you receive will instead be increased per the cubic number sequence: 1, 8, 27, 64, 125 bricks and so on. Each brick contains 500 incendiary-explosive slugs.

For every 10 bricks obtained through this, you also receive an extra ammunition fabrication box. These portable storage units can fabricate new ammo bricks from scavenged metal and fuel stock in roughly 90 minutes per brick, assuming stable environmental conditions and a consistent material feed.
objects.title: Auxiliary Ammunition Supply – Goliath

objects.text:
The Vindicator was built for frontline reliability, but its sustained fire and heavy-caliber slugs demand constant resupply in prolonged engagements. With each subsequent purchase of this, the total number of ammunition bricks you receive will instead be increased per the cubic number sequence: 1, 8, 27, 64, 125 bricks and so on. Each brick is pre-packed with 200 smart-slugs, compatible with the Vindicator’s rapid-feed system. These bricks are designed for speed and field efficiency, weather-sealed and self-cooling, and can be swapped out in under two seconds even under pressure.

For every 10 bricks obtained through this, you also receive an additional portable storage box — a fabrication-grade ammo replicator that rebuilds empty bricks using scrap metal, polymer shards, or powdered alloys. With sufficient raw material and standard planetary conditions, each unit produces a new ammunition brick approximately every 45 minutes. These fabrication boxes are rugged, field-sealed, and automatically link to inventory HUDs to display remaining resources and progress.
objects.title: Auxiliary Ammunition Supply – Vindicator

objects.text:
Though designed as a dependable secondary weapon, the Evoker’s heavy smart-slugs and low magazine capacity demand consistent resupply in extended operations. Each purchase of this upgrade increases your stockpile of pre-filled magazines exponentially, following the cubic number sequence: 1, 8, 27, 64, 125 magazines and so on. Each magazine is pre-loaded with 6 high-density smart-slugs, engineered specifically for the Evoker’s wide-bore electromagnetic chamber.

These magazines are magnetically sealed, weatherproof, and designed for field handling, capable of being swapped in under two seconds even under adverse conditions. Smart integration with most standard HUDs allows real-time tracking of remaining ammunition and magazine condition.

For every 10 magazines acquired through this option, you also receive an additional portable storage box. When fed with sufficient raw material such as scrap metal, polymers, or alloy powder, each box can fabricate one full Evoker magazine (6 rounds) every 4 minutes under standard planetary conditions. The replicator is self-sealing, vacuum-rated, and ruggedized for extreme field conditions, automatically syncing with your HUD to monitor resource levels and build progress.
objects.title: Auxiliary Ammunition Supply – Evoker

objects.text:
The Hellstorm is a weapon of controlled, catastrophic violence, but its devastating Scatter-Cells are expended rapidly in sustained breaches and defensive holds. With each subsequent purchase of this, the total number of ammunition canisters you receive will instead be increased per the square-cube sequence: 1, 4, 9, 16, 25 canisters and so on. Each cylindrical canister is pre-loaded with 10 Scatter-Cells, ready for immediate rotary-feed into the Hellstorm’s receiver. These canisters are reinforced, environmentally sealed, and designed for the three-second combat-swap under punishing conditions.

For every 6 canisters obtained through this upgrade, you also receive an additional portable ammunition storage box — a dedicated, medium-yield field fabricator for Hellstorm ordinance. This ruggedized unit recycles spent canisters and forges new Scatter-Cells from compatible feedstock: scrap metal, conductive polymers, and oxidizer compounds. With sufficient raw material, each fabricator can produce one full 10-cell canister in approximately 22 minutes under standard conditions. The units feature linked status indicators that sync with armor HUDs, displaying feedstock levels, fabrication queue, and thermal integrity of the Hellstorm's barrels.
objects.title: Auxiliary Ammunition Supply – Hellstorm

objects.text:
An advanced iteration of the standard-issue Drexil-AXVII, the VX model was engineered for heavy breaching troops operating in extreme combat zones. The VX was deployed where Coalition entrenchments required more than kinetic force to be dislodged.

The VX module introduces a secondary fire mode powered by a micro-singularity compression emitter built directly into the gravitic core. When activated, the cannon opens a stable micro singularity just forward of the emitter assembly, approximately 10–20 centimeters in diameter. This singularity persists for a short window, typically no more than two seconds, and exerts controlled gravitational pull on the surrounding environment. Any loose debris, enemy fire, or local material within a five-meter radius is drawn inward, rapidly compacted into a high-density state. Within the field’s controlled boundary, the captured mass is compressed and heated through intense gravitational shearing, reaching plasma conditions similar to those found in accretion disks.

Once sufficient mass-energy has been accumulated and ionized, the cannon executes a polarity inversion in the emitter array, transforming the singularity into a white hole-style ejection point. Plasma is expelled at extreme velocity, shaped and directed by gravitic lensing fields into a coherent, high-temperature discharge. This discharge, typically in the range of 5–15 megajoules, is capable of vaporizing armored fortifications, cutting through energy shielding, and destabilizing vehicle-class targets in a single blast. Depending on configuration, the plasma can be focused as a lance, dispersed in a cone, or detonated in a localized area-of-effect burst.

Each plasma discharge generates significant thermal waste, upwards of 3 MJ, which is managed by extended radiator fins and a priority-cooling cycle that temporarily locks out secondary functions. Overuse can lead to internal overheating, forcing a temporary shutdown of the plasma system for 30 to 60 seconds. The system draws an additional 0.1–0.2 liters of water per blast for deuterium harvesting and thermal cycling, a non-trivial load on long-duration missions, though survivable via the built-in biosiphon system in emergency conditions.
objects.title: Drexil-AXVII/VX

addons.text: Your great armory of relics is now further blessed with lunar power thanks to your collection - every treasure of yours within the Gates now has properties like those of your Moonlight blades, filtered through a lens of each item's origin and properties: Arms and armor now similarly act as conduits for magic and can be augmented with arcane power, divine artifacts may now channel the power and aspects of moon gods regardless of divine source, tools and resources can now impart similar qualities on anything made using them, and so on.
addons.title: Treasury of Lua

addons.text: Your collection of blades has evolved from just mystical artifacts into an assortment of even greater weapons; each and every greatsword has been reforged into pure Moonsilver - the magical material associated with Luna and her chosen Stewards - while still retaining their original abilities. This enhancement not only gives your armory a sizable enhancement all-around, and makes them just as good a conduit for Essence and Charms, but also grants them the Lunars' and moon goddess' protean nature - manifesting as in the form of preternatural accuracy, range and speed as the blades warp and shift like living, fluid metal.
addons.title: Glorious Argent Panoply

addons.text: The power contained in your collection comes easier to you than other supernatural arts, allowing you to infuse similar traits into your works with only knowledge of the sword(s) in question as a reference, and a share of your own energy. While the lunar magic and capacity for channeling magic are the most obvious, outliers like the Golden Order Greatsword's holy magic is an equally viable option; and with more technical - or magi-technical - knowledge, recreating or improving upon the laser blades could be achieved, as well.
addons.title: Lunar Artisan

objects.text:
You now have in your possession a copy of every variant of the Moonlight Sword shown in a Fromsoft game, from the original sword of King’s Field, to the Holy Moonlight Sword of Bloodborne, to even the Dark Moon Greatsword of Elden Ring - this even extends to the MOONLIGHT series of laser blades from Armored Core, retrofitted and scaled down (or up, if you happen to be colossal) for personal use.

This collection not only includes all "classical" iterations of the eponymous blade, but also variants and derivations of the aforementioned blades, such as Ludwig’s Holy Blade, the Golden Order Greatsword, and the IA-C01W7: ML-REDSHIFT. In the case of the MOONLIGHT laser blades, they're outfitted with (relatively, for their size) portable generators that enable their use in the absence of an Armored Core or other mech, but their output can be overwhelmed with excessive use of their blade wave techniques.
objects.title: Moonlight Collection (Fromsoft)

objects.text:
This is no longer just a starter’s tool—it’s the weapon you’ve made your own. Your weapon may be reforged with higher-grade metal, etched with personal symbols, or infused with a quiet glow that reflects your rising strength. It no longer looks like a beginner’s gear—it looks like the weapon of someone who’s survived their first real fights and is ready for more.

While wielded, the weapon now grants a 80% increase to the stat you originally chose during the Tutorial Weapon stage. In addition it also gives a flat 10% boost to all other stats. Now, whenever you land a critical hit, the weapon gains a temporary charge of momentum. It can store up to three charges and you can expend one to boost your next attack by 100%.

Lastly, your attacks with this weapon do 30% more damage, and 10% of their total damage bypasses defenses and immunities.

This isn’t just a dependable tool anymore—it’s a weapon you can trust in a real fight.
objects.title: First Real Weapon

objects.text:
This is the kind of weapon that gets noticed. Its form has matured: polished steel, crackling energy, or humming resonance that marks it as something forged by battle, not bought from a merchant’s stall. It isn’t just a weapon anymore—it’s yours, unmistakably shaped by your victories and survival.

The weapon now grants a flat 20% boost to all stats while wielded, with a 100% boost to your originally chosen stat. In addition, the weapon now possesses an active ability equivalent to a 5 SP power, themed to your fighting style or stat choice. It may be a brutal finishing strike, a short-range time-slowing effect, a wave of elemental force, or something else fitting your build. This ability can only be activated using charges from critical hits, and you can expend 2 charges at once to use and boost the ability by 100%. You can also now store up to 5 charges.

Additionally, the weapon gains a type advantage against a creature, enemy type, or class of foe. You choose this when the weapon upgrades. The more specific the type, the stronger the effect: choosing “undead” gives a moderate bonus, while something like “elder dragons” grants a significant damage increase. This bonus is always active when fighting a qualifying target. Finally, the weapon deals an additional 40% damage to all enemies and 15% of its total damage bypasses defenses and immunities.
objects.title: Mid Game Weapon

objects.text:
This is a weapon that inspires silence when drawn. Its presence is undeniable—every line, glow, and edge speaks of mastery and violence refined over countless battles. It no longer feels made—it feels forged by fate. It doesn’t just suit you—it completes you.

While wielded, the weapon now grants a flat 30% boost to all stats, with a 120% boost to your originally chosen stat. In addition, you can now choose two more stats, each receiving a 60% boost, turning your combat profile into a finely tuned engine of destruction. Your first passive trait—originally tied to your main stat—grows stronger, evolving into something far more impactful. If it once staggered foes, now it might throw them. If it once shortened recovery, now it may allow seamless chaining of movement and attacks. Your two new chosen stats also grant their own passive traits, each equivalent to what your original passive was at base.

Your active ability has also grown, becoming a 10 SP equivalent power. Charges are still gained through critical hits, but now you can also generate them by executing combos—the longer and more fluid your combo, the more charges you gain. You can now store up to 10 charges, allowing for greater tactical flexibility and devastating burst windows.

The weapon’s type advantage also deepens—it still grants bonus damage against your chosen enemy type, but now applies a thematic debuff based on the weapon’s nature. A flame-themed weapon may sear nerves and cause ongoing burn damage; a spectral blade might instill fear, lower resolve, or disrupt enemy abilities. The stronger and more specific the type you chose, the more devastating the debuff becomes. Finally, the weapon deals 50% more damage to all enemies, and 20% of its total damage bypasses defenses and immunities.
objects.title: Late Game Weapon

objects.text:
There are weapons made to be wielded. This one was made to be feared. Its form is unmistakable: otherworldly, elegant, brutal—sometimes all three. Even legends pause when it’s drawn. It no longer feels like a tool or a symbol. It feels like a force. And when you take hold of it, you don’t hesitate. Somehow, it fits perfectly, and so do you.

While wielded, this weapon grants a flat 40% boost to all stats. Your first chosen stat now receives a 150% boost, while the other two chosen stats are increased to 100% each.

You expand your type advantage repertoire, choosing two additional enemy types to deal extra damage against. These new advantages do not apply a debuff like the first, but the original debuff becomes significantly more dangerous—harder to resist and far more persistent. Enemies of your original type now begin each encounter slightly demoralized, momentarily slowed, less focused, or more vulnerable. The weapon now deals 60% more damage to all enemies, and 25% of its total damage bypasses defenses and immunities.

Your main active ability evolves into a 15 SP-level power, reaching its peak potential. Alongside it, the weapon grants you two additional active abilities, each equivalent to a 5 SP power, focused on secondary aspects of your fighting style or stat profile. These might open the battlefield, close gaps, punish reckless foes, or help maintain momentum. All three abilities draw from your shared charge pool, which now stores up to 15 charges.

You may now also hold up to 5 bonus charges that linger temporarily after reaching max capacity. These slowly decay over time. Additionally, if you successfully parry an incoming attack, the strike is negated entirely, and the surge of momentum immediately grants you one charge.

Now, by changing between distinct stances mid-combat, your weapon will subtly alter how your stats and passive traits express themselves. One stance might focus on raw impact and disruption, another on speed and fluidity, and a third on control and counterplay. Certain actives or combo abilities may react differently depending on your current stance.

Finally, once per combat, you may enter Overdrive Mode by expending five charges. In this state, your stat boosts are doubled, your abilities no longer consume charges, and every strike you make deals additional true damage. Overdrive lasts for three minutes and ends early only if you fall or disengage.
objects.title: End Game Weapon

objects.text:
This weapon was never meant to exist in the hands of a player. It’s the kind of artifact hidden behind obscure choices, near-impossible encounters, or long-forgotten corners of the world. It doesn’t hum with power—it roars with potential. To wield it is to cheat the rules, not by breaking them, but by being written above them.

While equipped, this weapon grants a flat 60% boost to all stats. Your two secondary chosen stats are enhanced to 150%, and your original stat a staggering 200% boost. All three passives now operate in their perfected forms—your primary passive triggers automatically, and each secondary passive activates at full strength with a 50% guaranteed chance.

Your type advantage system is fully realized. All three of your chosen enemy types now suffer bonus damage and thematic debuffs on every hit. The debuffs stack, escalate, and layer together when multiple types overlap. Your original type advantage becomes a triple-stacked curse, applying three independent effects fitting your weapon’s theme—shredding defenses, draining energy, disrupting abilities, or crushing will. The weapon deals 80% more damage to all foes, and 30% of that damage bypasses defenses and immunities.

Your three active abilities have been strengthened, your primary is now a 20 SP-level power, with the other two elevated to 10 SP-level powers. Your charge pool stores up to 20 charges, with an additional 10 temporary overcharges gained through critical hits, extended combos, and well-timed parries. 

Overdrive Mode can now be activated as many times as you like during combat, costing 5 charges per activation. While active, your stat boosts are tripled, and all abilities cost no charges. Overdrive can now be layered—each additional activation stacks linearly on top of this baseline, increasing both stat multipliers and true damage with each use. For example, one activation grants 3× stat boosts, two activations grant 4×, three grant 5×, and so on.

This is no longer just a hidden weapon. It’s the breaking point of the system, forged from everything the world was never supposed to give you—and everything you dared to take anyway.
objects.title: Easter Egg Weapon

addons.text:
Now fully fused with the myth of Jack the Ripper, your demonic form has become both the wielder and the sheath of your blades.

You can now freely transform your grafted hand back into the original knife, swap which hand it’s grafted to or even duplicate it to be on both hands. If you choose, you can even summon up to ten of them in its knife form, each a fully-formed projection of the original, identical in function, aura, and lethality. Even in its normal knife form it retains the abilities it gained as your grafted arm.

You can additionally manipulate the summoned knives telekinetically within a ten-meter radius around you. They respond with the same speed and precision as your own hands, moving through the air with fluid, ghostlike motion. You can wield them in combat as freely as if they were gripped in your fingers, send them spinning through the air like guided razors, or let them hover in readiness, waiting for a thought to strike. 

However, your demonic form has drawn you closer to the knife’s spiritual residue; closer to the voices. It becomes slightly harder to think clearly when engaging in violence, harder still to tell where your thoughts end and theirs begin if you ever indulge in excessive violence. Returning your mind to its prior state is possible, but becomes more difficult each time you slip.
addons.title: Sheath of the Ripper

objects.text:
For some inane reason, you decided to graft the Knife of Jack the Ripper into your dominant hand. Your fingertips have been replaced with ten-centimeter blades, sharp and unnervingly flexible. From your fingers up to halfway past your elbow, your arm takes on a metallic sheen with the durability to match. It no longer feels pain, and at times, it no longer feels like it’s yours at all.

The knife’s abilities they’ve grown. Wounds you inflict heal wrong, if they heal at all. The malice that was the knife’s edge lingers in the cut. Damage festers over time, worsening the longer it’s left untouched. You can also change how you cut now, causing the aura to behave like a shredder, the edge rapidly tearing through the same space multiple times in succession.

But now the malice runs deeper. The knife whispers into your subconscious constantly. You hear the dying thoughts of its victims, and the voices of those who once used it. At first, it’s a background murmur. It will stay this way as long as your mentality is strong, but if it falters the voices will get louder. Eventually it will start directly talking into your head, interrupting your thoughts. Nonetheless, it will never progress beyond this, so as long as your mentality state regains its stability it will reduce back to what it originally was.
objects.title: Scissorhand of the Ripper

objects.text:
Crafted by Loki, used in the death of Baldur, wielded by Hrómundr in his saga under the name Mystletainn, known also as Hævateinn—the weapon fated to slay Víðópnir, the cosmic rooster perched atop Mímameiðr—and believed by some to be the flaming sword of Surtr, this blade is the culmination of all its names, myths, and legends.

It is all of these, and more—a Divine Construct with the weight to wound gods and tear down divinity itself. In your hands, it now takes the form of a long, thin green blade that glows with a vibrant yellow light that at times flickers like the tongue of a flame, as though the branch of mistletoe itself had caught fire.

Not only does it retain its original ability to bypass and become the exception to any one law, it can now also function as a wand for spellcasting—channeling magic with uncanny precision. Each step of invocation is seamlessly refined, smoothing over all the processes of its activation, requiring only your intent; the blade handles the rest. For it to work, you must, however, still be capable of casting the spell yourself.

In combat, Lævateinn is capable of slicing through metal and stone as if they were cloth, its edge and point never dulling. Every strike made with it shall land true, guaranteeing injury, no matter how slight. The greater the disparity of power between you and your foe, the lighter the wound—but a wound all the same. For it is a weapon that cannot miss. Additionally, every cut dealt shall bear the searing flames of Múspell, burning even as they bite—its sunlike glow scorching the undead with particular cruelty. Though this is the extent of the true Lævateinn's fire it carries, it is nonetheless fearsome.

Having once been wielded by Hrómundr, the blade still bears the bane of the undead in its make. And having tasted the blood of kings, it now carries a conceptual advantage toward all sovereigns, divine beings, and the undying alike.

And at its heart, it remains what it has always been: the dart, the arrow, the spear, the missile, the blade that felled Baldur. When its True Name is invoked and hurled, loosed, or launched toward a target, its path becomes inevitable—as if guided by Loki's hand. The blow will bypass all barriers, become the sole exception to every protection, and ignore all defenses. And if its mark bears the crown of godhood or kingship, then they shall know no escape from death.

Furthermore, you may switch it back and forth between its blade and arrow forms if you so wish.
objects.title: Lævateinn: The Sure-Striking Wounding Wand of Exceptions

objects.text:
Your Graviton Beam Emitter is no longer limited to projectile output alone. It can now unfold and reconfigure its internal architecture, allowing it to manifest a solidified graviton edge: a Graviton Sword. When activated, the weapon projects a long, razor-thin blade of condensed unknown energy, extending anywhere from a short dagger length to several meters long. The blade appears as a deep red-black line in space, distorting the air around it and subtly warping light, giving the impression that reality itself is being cut rather than merely matter.

Unlike conventional energy weapons, the Graviton Sword does not burn or slice through force. It displaces matter at a fundamental level, pushing atoms apart along the blade’s path with the same principle as the GBE’s beam, but focused into a continuous edge. Armor, barriers, forcefields, and even spatial distortions offer little resistance; anything with structure can be severed cleanly. Even targets that regenerate rapidly or exist partially outside normal physics find their cohesion disrupted by the blade, making it especially lethal against exotic entities.

The sword can be used safely without catastrophic recoil, as the force is stabilized along the length of the blade rather than expelled outward like a beam. However, attacks made with it still carry extreme physical feedback. Swinging the blade with full intent generates tremendous inertial resistance, as though cutting against the weight of the world itself. Those without enhanced strength, reinforced bodies, or superhuman durability risk shattering bones, tearing muscles, or being violently wrenched off balance when striking with full power.

At will, you may shift between handgun and sword configuration instantly. The two modes share the same underlying system, meaning the blade can also be overcharged. Doing so briefly extends its length dramatically and intensifies its destructive effect, allowing single swings to cleave through massive structures, battlefield-scale entities, or entire city blocks if unchecked. Such use is possible, but never subtle, and never without consequence to the environment.
objects.title: Graviton Blade Mode (Blame!)

objects.text: Before, you could obtain any Enchanted Blade besides the Shinuchi- the most dangerous one of them all. Now, even that one lies within your grasp. Magatsumi's construction is largely the same as the other blades created by Rokuhira Kunishige. However, its abilities are structured differently. Instead of three key abilities that revolve around a central theme, the Shinuchi has a singular power, which can be expressed in any number of ways: the power to consume the life force of others and freely manipulate it. The user's spiritual power and vitality are amplified to the point it cannot be contained in the body, manifesting as spectral insects such as butterflies, and also causes fields of flowers to spread from the user. The fields will cause plants to grow from anyone else who touches them, with lethal results, sapping their life force to give to the user. By default, the user's strength and recovery will be greatly enhanced. Active usage of abilities include Centipede (a cutting shockwave that radiates out in all directions from the user, Spider (immobilizes targets by creating a web-shaped shadow beneath them), Dragonfly (a narrow blast that emits from the tip), Butterfly (a slash that cuts through space), and Bee (A massive, concentrated, piercing blast). With sufficient creativity/imagination, you may of course create other manifestations of its power, though they will inevitably tend towards an insect name theming. Magatsumi's most powerful ability, Malediction, is potent enough to wipe out the entire population of an island, and requires full mastery of the blade. While you alone can wield the blade's maximum power, you may allow others to utilize the first three abilities of Magatsumi.
objects.title: Magatsumi (Kagurabachi)

objects.text: The bow now possesses no physical form, and can thus be summoned in any shape you wish, as long as it's a projectile weapon, from a bow, to a crossbow, to a bunch of knives. Any and all of the Cosmic Bow's different firing modes and arrow types may now be called on and used freely, combining where applicable. The projectiles' piercing ability has increased exponentially (and will continue to do so), enabling them to shoot through all obstacles, and will endlessly pursue whatever you set your sights on.
objects.title: Void Bow

objects.text: Penance was not the only one of its kind. Ozriel created several other arrowheads, these ones slightly less effective, as prototypes. In this case, however, you now possess multiple Penance arrows, each one equal to the original. When you expend them, the four week timer will count for all of them, but starts from the one that was used first.
objects.title: Additional Arrowheads (Cradle)

objects.text: The 'True Realm' of an Enchanted Blade occurs when the user's understanding of the blade's power deepens. The blade's abilities will grow and expand, evolving new variants based on the user's needs and creativity. Kuregumo, also known as Cloud Gouger, is one of the more straightforward Enchanted Blades, calling on weather-based abilities. And due to your mastery of magics related to these, your understanding of Kuregumo has deepened immensely. Perhaps you are at its peak, or perhaps there's still higher to climb, but you are certainly on the level of its first user, at a time when it helped turn the tide of a war, a nuclear-level threat in your hands. Kuregumo's three primary abilities are as follows: Mei: The user may generate and charge up a blast of pure lightning. At maximum charge, the destructive force may destroy a building (at least for a beginner), but there will be a ten second cooldown. True Realm applications may include more freeform manipulation of electricity and elimination of the cooldown. Yui: The user may instantly freeze and create ice in a large area. The affected area, precision of the freezing and shape of the ice may be fine tuned, leading to full ice manipulation or 'freezing' other, more esoteric things. Kou: The user conjures water in various forms, whether it be rain, a waterfall-like torrent, or clouds of mist and fog. Manipulation may be possible, but primarily this ability is meant as support for the other two. That does not mean other applications cannot be possible, especially if one is a master of Sea Magic and its erosive properties...
objects.title: True Realm Kuregumo

objects.text: The Flaming Sword is something truly terrifying—capable of cutting through and killing anything. It is a weapon of such power that it should never have fallen into mortal hands... and now it never has. You are now an Archangel, one of the strongest creatures in existence—an entity that, in the right circumstances, might even succeed in replacing God. Your physical, mental, and angelic abilities are comparable to your newly acquired Archangelic brethren. You are immortal, eternal, unageing, invulnerable—unable to be killed or harmed by anything but your own sword or weapons forged in Hell itself. As the Archangel of the Flaming Sword, you are fire incarnate—able to create it, control it, become it—in all its variants: from Holy Fire to Hellfire—and its many aspects. The hearth fire is yours. The fires of the forge are yours. The campfires and funeral pyres are also yours. The Flames of the sun, and the fires of the Earth, yours. But what’s an Archangel without other Angels to lead? You will find yourself able to empower others with the barest spark of your divine flame—igniting the potential within them and transforming them into Angels. They possess the power Of all That is Good: powerful and strong in their own right, but incapable of ever truly challenging you. They’ll be inclined to follow your commands, though not out of blind devotion.
objects.title: Archangel (DC Comics: Lucifer)

objects.text:
You are now the Heir to God himself. With his retirement, you now take his place as his successor and as the Ruler of Heaven.

As God’s child and heir, your powers are enhanced to be greater than those of any of the Archangels, though you have not yet reached God’s immense power. With around a century of time and practice, you might one day be able to replicate God’s most mighty feat—the creation of the Earth.

You now rule the Silver City, floating high above the realm of Heaven, and the home of countless angels loyal to you. Heaven is a dimension you will always find accessible with a single thought, a realm of peace, tranquility and light, a paradise.

But even God did not always stand alone. With his wife, Goddess, he forged Heaven and created the angels—their children. If you find such a partner, you can grant them power roughly equal to your own and the ability to rule by your side.

Finally, you have the ability to create more angels. It would take a year to create a new angel from nothing, or a week to bestow this power upon a soul you deem worthy of becoming one of your angels.
objects.title: Heir of Heaven (DC Comics: Lucifer)

objects.text:
Instead of a standard lightsaber, you have the ancient Jedi super-weapon, the Kyber Saber. 

The Kyber Saber itself, was a lightsaber made by Jedi Baird Kantoo, that, rather than generating a plasma blade, instead had several pure kyber crystals fused into a solid blade, that consequently granted it two abilities.

The first ability, is that when swung, the Kyber Saber unleashes destructive waves of energy capable of casually slicing apart moons and wiping out entire star-fleets.

The second and perhaps more terrifying ability, is that the Kyber Saber multiplies its wielder’s power and connection with the Force a thousandfold.
objects.title: Kyber Saber (LEGO Star Wars)

objects.text:
The sheath of Arayashiki, formed from another's ego and desire to protect the wielder, gives a form of protection from the memory erasing effect of the unstoppable blade.

Whereas before Arayashiki would tend to target the user's most precious memories as consequence for its usage, the sheath can pick through the user's memories to prioritize erasing certain memories over others, allowing for greater usage of the blade while not falling into a state of non-self.

However, the user is not the one making the choice on which memories to erase. The sheath itself is sapient and makes the judgment call. Regardless, the spirit of the sheath is deeply loyal to its wielder and will attempt to make the best possible decision at all times. Alternatively, you may choose to embed one of your companions as the consciousness within the sheath.
objects.title: Renketsuen (Project Moon)

objects.text: All Wearable Objects of Power now gain a transformative aspect. If you possess the ability to transform your body to where it wouldn't be able to wear the object properly, the object will instead shape to your body to keep it to a comfortable fix. Rings will stay perfectly to your new fingers, or the closest thing to fingers you have. Armors, Uniforms, and hats will mold their shapes to fit your new body type even if it's not humanoid. This will also apply to those you share these with.
objects.title: All Sizes Fit One

objects.text:
The ultimate weapon—perfected and brought to a whole new level. All of the advanced and perfected features from every version of the Omnitrix, brought to one device. From the Master Control, to Nanotech, Ultimate Aliens, Omni-Enhanced Aliens, Omni-Kix/Omni-Naut Aliens, Fusion Aliens and even Mutant Aliens—the Cosmictrix has it all. This watch has no flaws or bugs that would impair the user from using it whenever they want. An impenetrable firewall is also installed, which would make it completely unhackable, no matter how much effort or how smart the individual attempting to do so is. Its durability is almost inviolable, and it could survive a whole universe exploding without a scratch to account for it. The user also gains a complete understanding of how to fully operate it.

A dataset comes with the watch that includes a perfected and enhanced version of 1,000,912 aliens that the user can access and change into, including Alien X, without any restrictions, cooldowns or time limits.
objects.title: The Cosmictrix (Ben 10)

addons.text:
Before, the Omnitrix required some form of DNA in order to scan a new alien species, but there are species that have been lost to time, and no DNA remains to bring them back.

However, now there is something that could be the answer.

If you encounter the residue of a ghost/psychic, spiritual entity, or whatever term you prefer to describe it, from an alien species, the Omnitrix can use your connection of Body, Mind, and Spirit to retrieve a sample and restore it, unlocking new transformations.

As long as some aspect of a species exists—whether physical, mental, or spiritual—you can scan it into the Omnitrix; thanks to this, the repair function has evolved to the point where you can save those condemned to horrible fates, as you can restore not just the body, but also the minds and souls of species, becoming a bringer of salvation to them.
addons.title: Resurrection from Extinction

objects.text:
The scanning function of the Omnitrix has been improved, allowing it to scan aliens and other life forms that it would not have been able to acquire before. This includes those without DNA analogous information, such as energy beings or beings that require magic, like dragons or even beings that would be considered too unintelligent for the Omnitrix—like the Xenomorph, for example—without corrupting the user to below human intellect. 

The scanning function can now scan from a greater distance and penetrate defenses that would have previously prevented it from scanning something. The safeguards around scanning mutant DNA samples have been removed, allowing the Omnitrix to scan mutant genetic samples without harming the user.

Additionally, the scanning function no longer interferes with the Omnitrix's other functions while acquiring a new sample.
objects.title: Improved Scanning (Ben 10)

objects.text:
Primus, one of the things that Azmuth created to help with the creation of the Omnitrix, before Azmuth could store all the millions of DNA samples into the watch, he needed to have a planet that could house all of the genetic information he gathered, so he created the planet of Primus, a place that houses the Codon Stream, a green liquid that is present throughout the artificial planet of Primus that served as the database for the prototype Omnitrix until Azmuth finished the completed Omnitrix, and the Codon Stream was relegated to being a backup drive that acts as a backup if any of the DNA inside the completed Omnitrix were ever to get corrupted. 

Your Omnitrix also now has access to its own version of Primus (optionally) hidden away in a pocket-like dimension or somewhere in whatever galaxy you now find yourself in; with it, you will also find that you also have the main way that Azmuth gained new genetic samples for the Codon Stream after he realized that sending Myaxx to gather each strand of DNA was too inefficient, so he created the beings known as Volaticus Biopsis, blue robotic/biological mosquito or wasp-like creatures with two pairs of wings and four legs. They have eyes with black sclera and green pupils. They also go through the universe into the vacuum of space and collect new genetic samples from all over the galaxy.

The Codon Stream is also connected to the Omnitrix's artificial intelligence; it also houses a backup of the artificial intelligence that watches over the planet to make sure nothing happens to it. This also further boosts the processing speed of the artificial intelligence of the Omnitrix, as it now has access to the Primus backup servers, allowing it to make upgrades to the Omnitrix over time, similar to how the Omnitrix recalibrated after Ben wore it after a long time, updating itself with new features, or how the Omnitrix grew along with Ben 10K to suit him better.
objects.title: Primus (Ben 10)

addons.text: You can now transform into aliens that are currently summoned. This also means that you can transform multiple people into the same sample and summon multiple. Unfortunately, this is still limited but has been increased to ten concurrent identical summons.
addons.title: Doubling Up

objects.text:
Your Omnitrix has been edited to be able to bring transformations you’re not using into the world, in addition to transforming into them. You cannot be in the transformation you are attempting to ‘summon’. Additionally, you cannot summon any alien that you have yet to ‘unlock’ within your Omnitrix playlist.

When you are summoning, they can either be separate or transform a person nearby into one of your alien forms. When transforming people around you, they are not compelled to obey you. Should they die, be destroyed or take any other kind of critical damage, the alien sample they were using will be unavailable inside the Omnitrix for 24 hours.

When taking this power, you can decide whether aliens that are summoned without transforming others are mindless automata or have personalities of their own. Should they have personalities, you can also decide whether they are edits of your own or informed by the ‘donor’ of the DNA sample.
objects.title: Summoning

objects.text:
The Omnitrix is a delicate piece of machinery; thankfully, it comes packaged with self-repair matrices, but sometimes it’s better to know where things went wrong.

Occasionally, your Omnitrix will contaminate the DNA samples stored within your playlist. Cross-contamination, random mutation, internal errors, etc. While on their own, they may be slightly annoying—only occurring occasionally—but they also tend to possess unique attributes. Thus, the Omnitrix will store these mutations in its log. After having seen one, you can select them while transformed into the base transformation to transform into the mutant.

Furthermore, these mutations can grow over the top of each other, becoming stranger and more complex as time passes, essentially invoking an entirely simulated speciation.

Though these must be scanned, this also allows you to duplicate mutations seen outside of internal errors, such as other alien mutations, mutated humans, etc.
objects.title: Mutatrix

objects.text:
Your Omnitrix is advanced to the point of ten full years of development, coming with some much needed refinements.

Firstly, its main improvement is the function suite, including the Master Control (allowing the user to transform freely and without waiting for recharge), Lifeform Lock (allowing the user to stay in a form as long as desired), and a suite of ‘Quality of life’ functions—such as aesthetic suites, menus and voice commands.

Secondly, all 1,000,912+ transformations in the Omnitrix are sorted into playlists of ten for easy sorting like the regular Omnitrix, but these also include a few ‘specialty playlists’ that are sorted for specific functions. Examples include:

The Powerhouse Playlist — This includes transformations saved for the ‘Worst Case Scenario’, remaining usually locked outside of this playlist because of their capability of extensive collateral damage if used incorrectly, such as the Dark-Matter generating alien ‘The Void’ and Atomix.

The Parasite Playlist — This includes parasitic species capable of enhancing or altering the abilities of their ‘host’. The playlist has a dual-selection between parasite and host, with the ‘host’ playlist specifically curated to avoid detrimental combinations, such as ‘Overkill’s weakness to Fire or Sound being given a Pyronite host.

The Monster Playlist — This is an example of System-playlists—playlists designed specifically to map to a local system or location. The Monster Playlist specifically consists of species native or common to the Anur system, such as Transylians and Opticoids.

If taken with another 'Omnitrix' variety (ie, the Ultimatrix), these are applied over the top, still giving you the functions of your selected Omnitrix.
objects.title: (Un)Official Omnitrix (5YL)

objects.text:
The Omnitrix is a device that has had many reasons for its creation, from being an act of repentance to being a tool to help understanding and prejudice against aliens by allowing someone to walk a mile in each other's shoes, as it were, and finally as a digital Noah's Ark, a way for the millions of species held inside to be able to live on and eventually be resurrected; however, it is a bit odd that, despite doing that, the only cultural information the Omnitrix has on various species is the language they speak.

With this upgrade, not only do you acquire the new species when scanning a new alien or unique species into the Omnitrix, but you also get their cultural history. The Omnitrix has expanded to include more than just the genetic material. Azmuth has expanded the information matrix of the Omnitrix to allow the Omnitrix to contain the history, language, and more of any scanned species. The Omnitrix now also has cultural information available for any existing aliens; however, cultural information for new species will be added when you scan them.

As an aside, this does much more than give you information on the species culture, as it also boosts the basic instincts that an alien you transform into has, allowing for you to get the experience of having used the abilities like a normal member of the species, with the information on the history, culture, and biology allowing you to have a much clearer understanding of your abilities when transformed and naturally speak the language of whatever alien you are without needing to use the translator. Some aliens will benefit from this more than others, such as Grey Matter now having the experience of a typical Galvan school and various Galvan technologies; however, all aliens will benefit from this in some way, not just intelligence aliens.
objects.title: Cultural Download

objects.text:
The Omnitrix often grants a uniform of sorts to the alien, usually clothing similar to the outfit worn by the person who initially transforms using the Omnitrix, such as how Four Arms was often wearing white T-shirts because of Ben's usual attire when he was 10 years old, and some aliens often also got additional equipment such as NRG and his containment suit, Goop and his UFO projector, Brainstorm and his breathing brace, or how Juryrig had goggles and a scarf. 

Now your Omnitrix no longer discriminates when giving clothing to your aliens; it gives equipment based on what the alien would typically have in its culture, rather than just clothing that matches what you are wearing. This can be more beneficial for some aliens than others, as some don't typically have equipment their species is known for, such as Nanomech. 

To give an example of something that would be given to you should you have the transformation, it would be having a set of tools sized for a Galvan (think of a small utility belt with wrenches and other supplies) when in that transformation and also having typical Galvan clothing; another example would be if you somehow got your hands on a genetic sample of Yautja DNA, you would have a suit of armor from that species' culture equal to what your age would be as a Yautja (Young Blood/Elite/Elder); the equipment would get better with age and status, as the entire culture of the Yautja is built around their weapons and equipment, therfore you would get them.
objects.title: Equipment Mode

objects.text:
A.N.N.I.E, or the Adaptive Neural Network Interface Executive, is a newly added AI assistant to the Omnitrix. However, compared to modern day AI, A.N.N.I.E is quite an improvement by lightyears. A.N.N.I.E's memory is down to the hundreds of attoseconds and can recall much better than any human, or alien minds. Annie is capable of assessing a situation and, while it may seem like she causes a mistransformation compared to what you picked, this is actually due to her choosing a much better transformation for the situation. After all, why pick Stinkfly to stick a runaway car to the ground and risk injuring the driver, when A.N.N.I.E can instead choose Upgrade for you and you can make the car slow to a stop more naturally?

Optionally, you can choose to mold her appearance, personality, and gender. At a base level, A.N.N.I.E is a full color hologram of a girl with green and black hair, with mechamorph textures on her shirt. She's a very humble and kind individual fit to the user and given full knowledge about them. Upgrades and addons can affect her if you wish, like Cultural Download allowing you to access the information outside of a transformation, or Additional function allowing A.N.N.I.E to possibly turn you into an Ultimate version of your current transformation as needed.

She can also serve as a software repair program, notifications, and more.
objects.title: A.N.N.I.E

objects.text:
You can now integrate additional functions into your selected variety of Omnitrix in addition to what you selected.

This ranges from adding the ability to use ‘Ultimate’ forms, the lack of errors and bugs of the ‘Official Omnitrix’, Fusion Aliens from the Biomatrix, Omni-Kix, etc.
objects.title: Additional Function

objects.text:
Not only are you limited to ten forms in your playlist, but once every month your playlist of ten randomises, opening new forms but also removing access to many of those you had before reconfiguration. 

You can set this reconfiguration off earlier up to a minimum of a week per reconfiguration, but the playlist will always be randomised.
objects.title: Reboot Syndrome

objects.text:
You really did get this in a state didn’t you?

Your Omnitrix now includes your human form in its list to be randomised. This means that after your first randomisation you’re highly likely to lose it completely. This means you’ll be forced to use whatever forms you’re given 100% of the time with no guarantee you’ll be able to access a ‘normal’ body. 

Thankfully, the body you’re actively in will not be randomised with the rest when Reboot Syndrome goes into effect, allowing you to keep a single form guaranteed between them. This does mean that you may be able to find your human form again… if you beat the odds.

This does however mean that regardless of your ‘model of Omnitrix you will not have to worry about timing out. Silver linings.
objects.title: Life-Form-Lock-Lock

objects.text:
It appears that a critical factor is missing from your Omnitrix: the DNA samples. So you'll have to scan them, fill your watch's playlist in, to transform.

Still, your watch is far from useless, it is a level 20 DNA Alterer. A repulsive blast can protect you from threats attempting to remove or tamper with it. Additional features include a in-built communicator, GPS, hologram projector and even a rudimentary AI. Furthermore, it can also be used for storage or contain both people and objects. As a last resort, the watch can act as self-destructive bomb, just don't let it collect energy for too long unless you want to blow the Universe.
objects.title: Empty Playlist (Ben 10)

addons.text: In addition to gaining access to playlists from settings you enter, you’ll slowly accrue transformations from any setting you have a connection to through your powers. Ie, if you possessed Homeworld Technology (Steven Universe), alien species from this setting would be available in the Omnitrix to unlock. Unfortunately, these will be acquired over time. The more you use the specific power that gives this connection, the more transformations from this source will become accessible.

With the improved scanning functions of the Omnitrix, the Updated Playlist that you get from the universe you pick via Playlist Update will now include aliens that are considered energy beings or have nonstandard DNA similar to the Anodites spark. This will also include aliens that are considered too unintelligent for the Omnitrix without corrupting the user's intelligence below human standards. Additionally, when you enter a new universe, you gain your entry galaxy’s species playlist, though if you want anything further afield, you’ll need to scan it yourself. This will also be affected by the aforementioned improved scanning function of your Omnitrix.
addons.title: Improved Playlist

objects.text:
In addition to your default playlist, for each purchase of this upgrade, you get a playlist from a separate universe added to your plate. Ie, in addition to the default Ben 10 playlist, you could have DC or Mass Effect species available to you as well to an equal degree of specificity.

Additionally, when you enter a new universe, you gain your entry galaxy’s species playlist, though if you want anything further afield, you’ll need to scan it yourself.
objects.title: Playlist Update

addons.title: G.L.I.T.C.H
addons.text:
For a decidedly strange value of ‘good’ news, A.N.N.I.E is always on the bridge with you allowing you to have far greater control over it’s functions when you’re inside the Omnitrix. 

Not only can you manually override the timeout without relying on the donor ‘outside’ to return, but you can also administrate the exact manner of function for some of your specific Omnitrix’s abilities. For instance, you could decide which donor gets control of a fused form, or forcibly activate an Ultimate form etc.

objects.text:
Your various donors gave more than their DNA. Instead, much like Zs'Skayr each of them is completely sapient within the watch. Now whenever you transform into one of them, they will be in control instead, with you taking up a space inside the watch. 

The interior is not uncomfortable, being akin to a large city of ‘donors’ separated into distinct neighborhoods for each ‘playlist’. Within this you have a kind of ‘bridge’ from which you can observe the outside, and are in the privileged position of being able to communicate with the persona in the real world, as can anyone inside the bridge when you’re outside.

While they’re not guaranteed to be friendly, it’s impossible to do serious harm inside of the Omnitrix. 

Thankfully, the timeout function is also now endemic to the device, giving a cap of three hours any one sample from the playlist can be outside besides yourself.
objects.title: Sealed

objects.text: Each of these devices being variations on a theme of transformation into another speculative self allows them to take a similar approach to things, just different in the details. This allows you to select most of the upgrades for any of these devices as though they were upgrades for the one you possess, and they will be adjusted to fit. For instance, the Y-Dial (DC Comics) upgrade with the Omnitrix would produce two separate alien ‘you’s’, the Summoning upgrade with the Forma Dominae would let you summon forms rather than becoming them, and the H-Dial with an Additional Function could give the heroes supplied ‘Ultimate’ forms. Any upgrade selected will be adapted to work in the same way as your particular item, Adding additional playlists to the H-Dial would not give it access to aliens for instance, and likewise the C-Dial would likely turn an omnitrix user into an iconic alien that embodies what they want to be rather than a hero, and the Forma Dominae with improved Scan would gain a scan to copy potential forms it sees since it does not already have one.
objects.title: Variations on a Theme

objects.text:
The Forma Dominae’s development has been kickstarted.

Each purchase of this upgrade hastens the Forma Dominae’s development twofold, including evolving the forms it has access to, the effects it can apply to magic passed through it, the growth of the intelligence within the Dominae, and even the functions it has available.
objects.title: Acceleration

objects.text:
The Forma Dominae’s effect has been extended slightly beyond your body. Normally, any equipment or clothing you have on you would be stored in a small pocket until you return to normal. This effect, however, allows the Forma Dominae to adapt your clothing and equipment to fit any new form you find yourself in.

Additionally, the Forma Dominae will begin using its form-changing to alter and create temporary ‘items’ in the same manner it creates forms. These new items range from weapons to tools to clothing, adapting much like its forms. As they’re created with the same method, they’re able to be affected by any function the Forma Dominae has developed.
objects.title: Integration

objects.text:
You’ve skipped quite a bit of development focused directly on the Forma Dominae’s intelligence. It’s now fully grown into an on-board advisory with a few inbuilt functions.

Firstly, the Dominae can connect with you while you sleep through the advisor, allowing the two of you to form a ‘workshop’ of sorts with which you can construct and plan new forms and functions.

Secondly, intelligence can overlay a kind of real-time analysis and display system over your senses, showing the best functions for a scenario and suggested options, truly acting as an ever-present advisory.

Finally, the intelligence itself has been drastically advanced to the point that it has developed a form of personality coupled with the embers of a soul as it inches towards a true self-awareness.
objects.title: Advisory

objects.text: This allows you take more lantern rings of different colors than the base one you have selected previously.
objects.title: Additional Lantern Rings (DC Comics)

objects.text:
The Ring of Volthoom is by all accounts a conventional power ring, able to create constructs, collect data, and will have all the amenities expected of a usual power ring, with three glaring exceptions.

Firstly, it is powered exclusively by the cowardice of its wielder, growing in strength the more fearful and terrified they are. It does not extend beyond the host either, drawing exclusively from their own terror. 

Secondly, it has no lantern battery, drawing its power from the host, slowly leeching all the energy of their body. Excessive use has caused users to die of malnutrition as all of their energy is taken and converted for the use of the Ring. 

Thirdly, and of seemingly least import, the AI attached to the ring is purposely degrading, vicious and domineering, designed to corral and browbeat the user into following the commands and directives of the Overlords of Oa in their ‘protection’ of the universe they believe they rightfully own.
objects.title: Ring of Volthoom (DC Comics)

objects.text: Your Ring and Lantern gain a program to shift to the color of Life, White, but hold your horses - you'll need to master the Emotional Spectrum first. To do this, once your ring ascertains you've mastered your first choice of color, you can tell it to move onto another color of the Emotional Spectrum of your choice. You'll need to resist the temptation of the parasitic light of Greed, Orange, and the influence of the light of Rage, Red, but once you've successfully mastered the Emotional Spectrum, your Ring will be ready to shift to the White Light with your assistance, drawing on your expertise with the entire emotional spectrum, you'll need to balance this perfectly. Once you've done so, you'll be able to make use of all of the Emotional Spectrum on a level of potency and efficiency a league above the impure lights through the Light of Life. Your personal Lantern and Central Power Battery will shift through the emotional spectrum in sync with your ring if you so choose.
objects.title: White Lantern Ring (DC Comics)

objects.text:
Good news! You’ll be able to access the entirety of the emotional spectrum immediately! 

The bad news is that you won't be able to control it. The Phantom Ring is an unstable machine, changing its emotional power source whenever the user changes their emotional state, in turn also causing the user to feel that emotion with incredible intensity as a consequence of connecting you directly to the emotional spectrum, which can have disastrous effects on your psyche.

Furthermore, lacking a personal lantern, it recharges over time through this direct exposure. Should this charge exceed safe levels, reaching maximum capacity at 200%, it can enter meltdown and explode with dramatic force. Though the ring and wielder will be unharmed, it can utterly devastated their surroundings.
objects.title: Phantom Ring (DC Comics)

objects.text:
Rather than a Ring you’ve been given the brand of the Ultraviolet corps, drawing from the ‘unseen light’ of buried emotion. 

This brand functions largely in the same manner that a Ring does with the notable benefit that you can’t be disarmed without physically removing the finger it’s attached to. Similarly, the ring is fueled by the entity Umbrax directly, allowing its users not to require personal lanterns, at the cost of having a constant connection to their entity and its influence pressing on their psyche.

The Unseen light is drawn from the uglier parts of a mentality, Shame, self-hatred, the cruel and self-destructive feelings that most bury. Similarly, it’s wielders can bring the same emotions out in others, drawing them into the forefront.
objects.title: Ultraviolet Brand (DC Comics)

objects.text: You now have access to the Central Power Battery for the Lantern Ring you chose, or one for every type of Lantern Ring you have if you have multiple. In addition to providing an unlimited central reservoir of emotional energy to work with, having access to the Central Power Battery also allows you to create more Lantern Rings of the same color—and the required smaller lanterns to charge them—this, in turn allows you to set up a Lantern Corps of your own. As the 'Owner' of the Central Power Battery, you stand as the head of your new corps, and though this will NOT force other members to follow you blindly, it will inspire a certain level of loyalty in it's members. You also gain the ability to limit the Lantern Rings of your corps, perhaps you have a desire to not allow a member to kill? perhaps you simply want to institute a time-limit before the ring must be 'recharged' or 'reconnected' to the Central Power Battery? Anything—within reason—is possible.
objects.title: Central Power Battery (DC Comics)

objects.text:
You have a Lantern Ring—or more—and the Central Power Battery that goes with it, and now you have the Lantern Corps to match. While each Lantern Corps will have its own unique nuances in its structure, any Corps gained from here will have a similar size and power level.

Your Corps comes with a headquarters the size of a small city, capable of housing your entire Corps in relative comfort and equipped with all the necessary facilities for it to function. You can choose a specific location for this headquarters or allow your Corps to select one for itself. Your Corps will automatically maintain itself, recruiting new members with the particular emotional outlook your Corps requires.

You have the option to take an active leadership role within your Corps, let it run autonomously without your input, or choose a mixture of both. Should you ever change your mind, your Corps will be happy to accommodate you. While your Corps is not mindlessly loyal to you, it would take concerted effort on your part to make them willingly betray you.
objects.title: Lantern Corps (DC Comics)

objects.text:
You possess a unique and innate connection to the Emotional Electromagnetic Spectrum, attuning you more strongly to a specific emotion such as compassion, fear, hope, or rage. This heightened inclination grants you an exceptional degree of resonance with that emotion, comparable to figures like Saint Walker’s boundless hope or Atrocitus’s overwhelming rage. While this attunement increases your emotional capacity, it does not strip you of self-control.

Regardless of which emotion you are most closely aligned with, your capacity for that emotion has no upper limit and can continue to grow through experience and emotional stimulation. This benefit applies to every Lantern Ring you acquire through selecting Additional Lantern Rings.
objects.title: Emotional Attunement

objects.text:
The Hellbat Suit was created through the combined skills and resources of the Justice League. Made from a shifting nanokinetic metallic composition forged in the heart of the Sun, it is controlled by an onboard AI and further enhanced with powerful magical enchantments.

The suit can absorb energy and release it as devastating blasts, turn invisible, and enable flight.

The Hellbat Suit enhances the user to such an extent that it allows an unaugmented human to run a gauntlet against multiple New Gods and their armies of Parademons — even facing the leader of the New God Pantheon, Darkseid, himself.

This power comes at a cost: it rapidly drains the user’s metabolism, ultimately killing them.
objects.title: Hellbat Suit (DC Comics)

objects.text: ’What Happens In Your Head Also Happens’ You can see into all things. Where once the M-Vest acted as at least a barrier between you and the madness now you’re intimately aware of how you connect to it. The nonsense of the mind, and of reality blur together as you gain the abilities of the ‘Martians’, a series of processes that exist only to spread their own devices. While these ‘Martians’ are able to do much they’re bound by the rules of the mind, metaphor and perception twisting to form reality. The White Martian, for instance, replaced the sun with its own light in the mind of a small town, stoking paranoia and suspicions of everyone and everything inside them. ‘Despair-0’ meanwhile created symbiotic links to isolate others from psychic effects and affairs. While it can be hard to understand and piece together the world as it exists, seeing thoughts as smoke and pasts in fogged glass, you can do much with it. Driving a car into the subconscious perception of Alcatraz to infiltrate the real thing, sniping ‘bad ideas’, duelling manias between a person’s pupils. Mind-HUNT-SAVE-KILL-HEAL-REDEEM-er
objects.title: The Mind ****er (DC Comics: Absolute)

objects.text:
Rather than the equipment of Diana of Themyscira, you’re receiving the equipment of Diana of the Wild Isle. 

While still receiving the Bracelets of Submission and her tiara, the rest of the equipment is substituted for;

Έμπιστος Φίλος (“Trusted Friend”) - a Satchel that is larger on the inside containing many mystical ingredients and artifacts. By calling its name it brings the ingredient or artifact appropriate for the situation. Though it starts with a moderate collection (like many well crafted weapons remain within, such as the Athena Blade), many more esoteric things must be actively collected and added to it in order to be called.

The Nemesis Lasso - Made from the remains of the last basilisk, the Nemesis Lasso burns whoever it touches in proportion to their own sins.

Θυσία (“Thysía”) - The second Lasso, transforms the body and mind of whoever it touches, with the shape determined by what it was used on to rarely predictable results. It can be used on yourself, with a limited amount of control by focusing on what to become, but your personality will be suppressed and overtaken by that which you’re transforming into.

Troika - The third lasso, brings both the wielder and the bound into a ‘crossroads’, showing a representation of where their choices have taken them and where they can take them next. On the outside, both are rendered catatonic as they traverse the crossroads.

Pegasus - The undead flying steed, a firebreathing skeletal horse that rallies to its riders' call. It is clearly capable of understanding speech and can fly fast enough to comfortably catch up with fighter jets.
objects.title: Equipment of the Wild Isle (DC Comics: Absolute)

objects.text: Each purchase of this grants you an additional Vision of a different element, allowing you much greater versatility, in addition to allowing you to utilize Elemental Reactions unassisted to bolster your elemental abilities even more.
objects.title: Visionary (Genshin Impact)

objects.text:
Rather than a human with a Vision, you are some form of elementally aligned lifeform such as a Vishap, Enlightened Beast, or Elemental Spirit. This means that your ability to use an element stems not from a Vision but from an innate capability, a core part of your nature which cannot be removed.

As an elemental lifeform you grow in power as you age, a process helped by your greatly extended lifespan. Additionally, while your physical form has visibly diverged from humanity, with enough power and control you could likely assume a human guise should you so desire.
objects.title: Elemental Lifeform (Genshin Impact)

addons.text:
You are no mere god or an ordinary dragon, you are something greater and older still, you are an elemental dragon sovereign reborn—the original ruler of the world of Teyvat before the coming of the primordial one.

As an elemental dragon sovereign, you can transform effortlessly between your humanoid form and your dragon form, your command over elemental power is nigh-absolute and far surpasses that of even the Seven Archons. Furthermore, you now have access to dragon authority which are powerful esoteric utilization of elemental energies belonging exclusively to the elemental dragon sovereign.

For example, the Dendro dragon can house an entire world within itself and give birth to elemental creatures within said world while the Hydro dragon has control over the primordial sea from which all life in Teyvat originates and complete command over Pneumaousia.

For each element you control, you gain an additional dragon authority corresponding to that element.
addons.title: Dragon Sovereign

addons.text:
The Eikon that was hosted inside of you has been subsumed and absorbed into your being, bolstering your already considerable power over the element to massively new heights.

A feat that would have been strenuous to accomplish before can now be performed casually. In your semi-priming state, you are at least ten times more powerful than before and When you are fully transformed into your Eikon state, you can wield the power of the element to destroy and reshape an entire continent.

Any additional element that your Eikon possesses is now yours to command on the same scale, and it is treated as if you have a Vision of that element.
addons.title: Lord of the Elements

addons.text: A common misconception is that Archons are responsible for the bestowal of Visions, when it is in truth the machinations of the divine laws set in place by Celestia. And yet, through your ability to awaken in others the power you possess you have gained the ability to fulfill this myth, even in worlds beyond Celestia’s reach. To assist with this you can sense the ambition of others to gauge who would be suitable for a Vision, and can automate the distribution of Visions by setting a criteria which automatically grants a Vision when met. The requirements set by Celestia are available as the default criteria, but can be changed if you so desire it. You can bestow Visions aligned with whatever elements you yourself possess, even ones which don’t have a canonical counterpart should you have Lord of the Elements.
addons.title: Let There Be Sight

addons.text: Having Ascended through Kuuvahki, the very framework of your existence as a God and Elemental Lifeform has been altered. Your body is made not from Elemental Energy but from Kuuvahki itself, granting an unprecedentedly pure connection to the Light Realm and a level of power far surpassing the norm, such that with time and sufficient devotion, you could exist on par with an Elemental Sovereign. You also possess a stronger connection to the Moon (or Moons if whatever world you are on has more than one), becoming stronger with its presence among other things. Should you be a Dragon Sovereign then you will reach immense levels of power surpassing even the Shades of the Heavenly Principles. If one such as you had existed when the Heavenly Principles first descended, the world of Teyvat would be much different than it is today.
addons.title: Moonborn

objects.text:
You have ascended to godhood with your elemental prowess and gained power comparable to that of the illustrious Seven Archons. As a god, you are an ageless elemental lifeform capable of wielding great elemental abilities at a level of power and control that eclipses that of any ordinary element wielder, and you can also grow even stronger with devotion and worship. Since you are composed entirely of elemental energy, you can shapeshift your physical form to be however you like.

You are capable of performing truly awe-inspiring feats that can forever alter the world, such as shearing off entire mountain ranges with razor wind to reshape the land and tossing said mountains far away into the sea, creating and throwing numerous stone spears the size of an island, cutting a country in half with a single sword strike, or creating and maintaining thunderstorms and blizzards over an entire country for years or even decades on end—such is the awesome might you wield as a god.

Should you also have Visionary, your enhanced elemental abilities will extend to all of the Elements you wield, not just your first.
objects.title: Archon (Genshin Impact)

objects.text:
Besides being granted a Vision, you have also been given something much more valuable—a Gnosis. They are tools created by the Heavenly Principles using the remains of the Third Descender, a being whose will can rival that of an entire world.

While a Gnosis functionally does the same as a Vision (the manipulation of elemental energy), it operates on a much larger scale compared to its more primitive counterpart.

The elemental power that a Gnosis can allow its wielder to channel is tremendous, having the potential to reshape the entire world. Mortals who know how to wield them can have the power to rival the god, while gods who own a Gnosis are elevated to a level of power that makes them tower over their fellow gods. It also allows for the esoteric utilization of elemental power that is typically impossible for gods or dragon sovereigns, as their origin is from beyond the world of Teyvat.

You begin with a basic mastery of the Gnosis, which allows you to wield and master elemental power on a scale similar to a Vision holder with hundreds of years of experience. As your mastery over the Gnosis grows the more power you draw from it.

You gain one additional Gnosis for each purchase of visionary; if you have all 7 Gnosis and enough mastery over their power, you could absorb them to become a descender.
objects.title: Gnosis (Genshin Impact)

objects.text: What you have in your possession is not a Vision, but a Moon Wheel—a Vision-like object whose origins lie in Nod-Krai and which predates Visions entirely. Moon Wheels were originally created by the Heavenly Principles and the Three Moons, bestowed upon the Moon Goddesses’ human followers as tools for ritual communication. They are widely believed to be the original framework upon which the modern Vision system was later based. Regardless of their true origin or precise relationship to Visions, what is known is that Moon Wheels, like Visions, allow their bearers to manipulate the Elements. Unlike Visions, however, Moon Wheels draw upon Kuuvahki—the unfiltered power of the Light Realm, and the most ancient, primordial form of elemental energy. While this distinction does not radically alter the fundamentals of elemental manipulation, the shift from conventional Elemental Energy to Kuuvahki carries notable benefits. Your strength fluctuates with the Moon’s position, reaching its peak when the Moon is closest, a reflection of the Moon Wheel’s lunar origins. Manifestations of elemental power exhibit greater harmony with the natural world due to Kuuvahki’s purity, and the Moon Wheel itself possesses an enhanced affinity for esoteric rites and ritualistic applications. If taken with Elemental Lifeform your essence will incorporate Kuuvahki into itself with all the benefits that entails, transforming you into something akin to the Radiant Beasts or Kuuhenki
objects.title: Moon Wheel (Genshin Impact)

objects.text:
Each purchase of this grants you an additional Delusion of a different element, allowing for even greater versatility, in addition to allowing you to utilize Elemental Reactions unassisted.

You may also use this to purchase Delusions separate from your own to give to your allies.
objects.title: Delusional (Genshin Impact)

addons.text:
As being of pure elemental energy, being infused with this much abyssal energy should kill you, and it kind of has. See, when a god dies, they leave a curse upon the land, one which contaminates the land, poisons the people, and corrupt beasts into monsters. Just like the abyss. Your ability to control corruptive energies has prevented you from properly dying, instead turning you into a combination of divine curse and abyssal power.

Naturally, your ability to corrupt is enhanced far beyond what you could have done previously. Being a living curse, you can defuse your essence directly into the land, allowing you to hijack its natural energies to fuel yourself and your powers. You can even use the land itself as your weapon, striking disaster after disaster in an area until your foes are dead and gone.
