You can even possess people and objects directly, turning them into your monstrous slaves. 

This enhanced corruptive power means that your abyssal energy has achieved a new level. You now possess a higher authority over the abyss and the creatures therein. This new authority grants the ability to command even Abyss Lectors and Abyss Heralds. With this power you gain a proper title, you are now the Abyss Archon.
addons.title: Curse God

addons.text: You are not some random abyss creature or corrupted dragon, you are something much worse. Through a combination of forbidden knowledge and draconic power, you have become a replica of one of Rhinedottir’s “Miraculous Creations”. You are now kin to the evil dragon Durin, with all the power that it entails. Thankfully, you don’t have the problem of being in a dream-like state. Your abyssal energies have increased to the point where you could easily kill an Archon or a modern Sovereign. You would still struggle against a Sovereign with its full authority or an Archon teaming up with its Sovereign counterpart. Seeing as how full power Sovereigns don’t currently exist, you are by default, one of the strongest beings alive. In an interesting turn, your abyssal power has twisted, becoming somewhat “corrupted” by your draconic phlogiston. This means that the energy of the world is surprisingly more receptive to your corruption. If you are not enforcing your will, it is entirely possible for the land to use your power to cleanse itself of other energies it deems corruptive, restoring it to its natural state, like the world's biggest phlogiston aphid. This effectively means that you find yourself in a position where you can actively fight against reality warping powers such as those of the celestial nails and other such powers of Celestia.
addons.title: Shadow Dragon

addons.text:
In the history of Teyvat, the world has been shaped by three descenders. Each with the power and knowledge to rewrite the laws of the world, whether in life or death. You have become their rival. Through your ability to both become one with the land and total command your element, your word is now law. You are the bringer of earthly principles, the ultimate enemy of Celestia.

Your command over both your elemental and abyssal energies has reached their zenith. You have harmonized the power of the abyss and the raw phlogiston of the world, allowing you to infuse the world with the power of the abyss at no cost to the land itself. The land shall grow verdant, the people grow healthily, and the beast of the land unconsumed by madness. Disaster will not strike your land unless you command it so. Your harmonization and defiance of Celestia means that you possess the power to overturn any of their decrees. This even includes their vicious curse against the people of Khaenri'ah, transforming them from Hilichurls back to their human forms. Your authority over phlogiston is such that you could even manipulate elements that are not your own, though to a lesser degree than if you had either a Gnosis or Delusion. 

If you were to possess both a Gnosis and Delusion of the same element, you will be able to permanently fuse all elemental energy of that type with the power of the abyss, down to the raw phlogiston, ensuring that Celestia could never manipulate it from on high ever again. If you have them all, then you are truly the one who shall topple the so-called heavens.
addons.title: Bringer of The Earthly Principles

addons.text: As an existence of Primordial Light and Abyssal Darkness intertwined, your authority over your Element and Phlogiston has expanded to encompass Kuuvhaki as well, granting you absolute control over the unfiltered power of the Light Realm, which in turn bestows total control over all derived forms of Elemental Energy. While this does provide control over the other elements without purchasing them through Visionary, doing so greatly increases your power as you become more complete. You are the Heir to Nibelung, the one to succeed where he failed, and you will tear the Gods from their Thrones.
addons.title: Heir of Nibelung

objects.text: Your corruption has consumed you, transforming you into an Abyss Creature. The power of the Delusion now courses through you, letting you manipulate intense abyssal energy surpassing even Abyss Lectors and Abyss Heralds. Your Delusion’s weakness of feeding on your lifespan has been removed, now feeding on your abyssal energies. Like other high level Abyss Creatures, you have a seemingly endless lifespan, meaning you will not die of natural causes like old age. Your physical form is also composed of abyssal energies, allowing you to shapeshift however you wish. Due to wielding the power of the Abyss, you possess an advantage over beings of the natural world. Any being made of or fueled by elemental energies will be damaged significantly by your corruptive power. This extends to similar beings who are fueled by the energy of their natural world. Though this, it is even possible for you to kill the likes of an Archon should they cross your path. Your corruptive influence allows you to terraform the world around you to a facsimile of the abyss. Your intense control of abyssal energy then allows you to manipulate your environment as you see fit. From creating a storm in a desert to making plants grow in a wasteland, all are done according to your whims. You do require the corresponding element to make such changes, however. Your control also means that this corruption is done according to your will. No randomly leaking energy will taint the land without you knowing. Having Delusional will increase the variety of ways you can use abyssal energy and elemental energy together. Any Delusions you give others can either be made to draw power from the abyss or the user's life force. You may change which one at your discretion.
objects.title: Creature of The Abyss (Genshin Impact)

objects.text:
Much like Skirk, you have studied under the Sinner known as the Foul, learning how to harness the power of the Abyss for your own ends.

First and foremost, you have shed the need for a Delusion, as Surtalogi has taught you the Seven Shifting Serpent technique, allowing you to mimic the seven elements using abyssal energy. While you are most proficient in mimicking the element associated with your previous Delusion, you can still utilize a mimicry of all seven elements.

Under the Foul you have also learned how to directly manipulate abyssal energy, true mastery of all forms of tangible weaponry, and have even begun to master the second step of Surtalogi’s teachings. To assist in safely using these teachings, you have also gained a lesser version of the ability of Skirk’s people, allowing you to safely adapt to Abyssal Energy and use it without harming yourself.

While you are not yet at Surtalogi’s level, with time you will be able to match and even surpass him, allowing you to turn “heaven and earth into your blades” and “bend all of creation to your will.”
objects.title: Seven Shifting Serpent (Genshin Impact)

objects.text: This is no mere crown, it is the emblem of a king, a symbol of power and authority. When adorned with this regal headpiece, the wearer is transformed into a towering presence, exuding an aura of command and respect. It is as if they are imbued with the qualities and characteristics of a monarch: wise, just, and revered. Their appearance alters too, taking on the visage of a Saber Face; a figure of grace and elegance, a sight to behold. Truly, the wearer of this crown is a king among kings.
objects.title: Crown of Kings (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
You have received one of the true masterworks of Dwarven armour-craft in Middle-earth: a mail coat made of Mithril; “silver-steel,”  rings so fine that it may even be worn beneath standard clothing without any bulkiness or restriction of movement, and causes no more pinching or chafing than an equivalent cloth shirt.

Mithril mail is significantly lighter than even standard Dwarven mail, comparable in weight to “a feather,” requires no maintenance whatsoever, and surpasses standard Dwarven mail in its capacity to absorb force. Its component rings are, furthermore, nigh-indestructible. The rings are so fine that the slight risk of a blade finding the gaps between them; a vulnerability present in standard Dwarven mail, is effectively eliminated. 

Combined with the improved force absorption and the near-invulnerability of the rings themselves, this renders wearers essentially immune to any physical attack on covered body parts, though not elsewhere, as Frodo discovered when set upon by Shelob.

Alternatively, your mail may be fashioned from Galvorn: a black metal wrought from meteoric iron by the Dark Elf Eöl, and equivalent to Mithril in strength but heavier.
objects.title: Mithril Shirt (Lord of the Rings)

objects.text:
You have received one of the Sixteen Great Rings forged by the Smiths of Eregion with the direct aid of Sauron, later seized by him and bestowed upon Nine Kings of Men and Seven Dwarf-lords. These Rings are far greater in power than the lesser rings and are all of a kind.

They greatly enhance all the wearer’s natural abilities and qualities; strength, persuasiveness of speech, quickness of mind, and force of spirit for a non-exclusive list. Further innate magic is strengthened; for example the seven Dwarf-lords multiplied their hoarded gold many times over and always perceived the richest places to mine when they wore their rings. The Rings also grant the ability to walk in the Unseen World and to harness the Morgoth-element inherent in all creation (for Morgoth poured his power and corruption into the world at its making, and from it all evil springs) thereby enabling the use of dark sorcery by the wearers.

Finally, the Ring will greatly extend a mortal lifespan; however, the wearer's body and mind will continue to degrade beyond their natural span, in form if not in strength, until they ultimately become a wraith bound to the One (should it exist in your world). Even those of exceptional resilience of body, mind, and spirit; who might endure for centuries without fully relenting; will in time fade and fall under the dominion of the One. Those few who are not able to be wholly corrupted will nonetheless be driven toward darker impulses and destructive desires.
objects.title: Ring of the Sixteen (Lord of the Rings)

objects.text:
You have acquired one of the Three Elven Rings forged by Celebrimbor without the direct aid of Sauron. These Rings are far more powerful than the lesser Rings and even the Sixteen given to Dwarves and Men, greatly enhancing the spirit and abilities of their bearers. Yet they are chiefly suited to healing and the preservation of the world rather than to warfare. They cannot be used to control the Morgoth-element, nor do they inherently draw mortals into the Unseen World or grant sight into it, as it was assumed their wielders (being Elves) could already perceive such things. The Rings may still render themselves unseen upon their bearers’ hands.

Of the Three:
1) Nenya, the “Ring of Adamant” or “Ring of Water,” was given to Galadriel. It is fashioned of mithril and set with a diamond. Known as the chief of the Three, it possessed the greatest power of healing and preservation.
2) Vilya, the “Ring of Sapphire,” “Blue Ring,” or “Ring of Air,” was first given to the High King Gil-galad and, before his death, passed to his herald and heir, Elrond Peredhel. It is a band of gold set with a sapphire. Of the Three, it is the mightiest in enhancing the bearer’s inherent power over the physical world, enabling Elrond (although a comparatively young elf and probably not a Calaquendi) to command the River Bruinen and wield it as a weapon against invaders.
3) Narya, the “Red Ring” or “Ring of Fire,” was first entrusted to Gil-galad, then to Círdan the Shipwright, and at last to Gandalf upon his arrival in Middle-earth. It is a band of unknown metal set with a brilliant ruby. Unlike the others, it also grants its bearer a gift: the power to strengthen the hearts and minds of others and to kindle hope through the mere presence of its wielder. 

Though the wielder of the One (should it exist in your world) cannot directly dominate a barer of the Three (unless their will is significantly weaker) they may nonetheless perceive the depths of their hearts, minds, and spirits with great clarity for however long as the Three are worn; and have great power over anything made or maintained by the power of one of the Three.
objects.title: Ring of the Three (Lord of the Rings)

objects.text:
You have acquired the Dragon helm of Dor-Lomin, a mastercraft dwarven mask made by the great smith Telchar. It is finely inlaid with gold in runes and with a terrible crest in the form of the dragon Glaurang as a taunt to the servants of Morgoth. 

The helm is so heavy that besides dwarves, only the strongest among men (such as Hurin and Turin of their doomed house) are capable of wearing it in combat, but for those who can it is well worth it’s reputation:

The helm has all the capabilities of a standard dwarven mask but is also enchanted to ward all other wounds and harm from the wearer (this isn’t perfect but no barer has received more than light wounds while wearing the helm) by causing damage to the weapons meant to harm them. It also inspires enchanted terror in the wearer’s foes, to the extent where most orcs and evil creatures would turn and run rather than attempt battle with the man wearing the Dragon of the North.

Finally, the Helm is one of the great heirlooms of the House of Hador, of the Edain (men loyal to the High King of the Noldor-elves in Middle Earth), and the sight of its wearer inspires both hope and courage among those who see the Hadorians or their Númenorian descendants as allies.
objects.title: Dragon Helm of Dor-Lomin (Lord of the Rings)

addons.text:
You’re not just a Symbiote, you’re one of Knull’s personal breed. Your shapeshifting has been improved dramatically, barely caring about biomass while forming your body. You can become the size of large buildings and skyscrapers with enough time. Similarly, using this sheer might your regular abilities have been improved dramatically, making you able to keep pace with beings like the Silver Surfer. 

Symbiotes you generate are part of your corner of the hive-mind, looking to you for guidance in the same way other Warriors would be directed by the King in Black. This also makes you able to disseminate Genetic Codexes gathered by your offspring.
addons.title: Warrior of the Abyss

objects.text:
Instead of possessing a symbiote, you are a half-symbiote creature. You retain all the powers of a symbiote, including the ability to bond with a host and enhance their abilities, though you don't require the bond to survive. Unlike regular symbiotes, you maintain your species' original form rather than becoming formless when not bonded.

As a half-symbiote, you can sense nearby symbiotes, command them, and sever their connection to the Symbiote Hive. Additionally, you can evolve them to become stronger and more efficient. However, you are susceptible to Knull's influence.

Any upgrades you choose are now applied directly to you, rather than to the symbiote you would have previously bonded with.
objects.title: Symbiote Hybrid (Marvel)

objects.text:
Rather than a single symbiote, you can receive multiple symbiotes. While this would allow you to give them to others, it would also allow you to hybridise them, creating a greater Symbiote than it’s constituent parts, inheriting any specialised evolutions or genetic codecies either had acquired up to that point. 

If you so choose, you can divide any Klyntar upgrades you possess amongst these different Symbiotes.
objects.title: Hybrid Madness

addons.text: As both the embodiment of the Symbiote Hivemind and the singular Uni-force, you’ve gained the power to fundamentally alter the symbiotes under your control. What this means practically, is that you can exchange the endemic traits of the symbiotes to mimic those of the Uni-Force, albeit on a far lesser scale. Be this connecting your Symbiotes to the Uni-Force rather than the Abyss and thus altering their anti-divine qualities, or exchanging the Shapeshifting of a usual symbiote for the external Matter manipulation of Captain Universe. Very few things are outside the capabilities of this combination, so with time and creativity you could create any number of subspecies and trains as diverse as they are powerful.
addons.title: ...And White
The Void Crafter
addons.text:
You are the finest craftsman when it comes to the Living Abyss. No longer do you need to spend a decade mastering your craft, for you are already a master.

This allows you to create all of Knull's creations, as well as things he could never have imagined, even in his wildest dreams. You understand every aspect of the Living Abyss, and whenever you decide to create something, you know exactly what you want to make and how to make it, leaving no room for mistakes.

Additionally, your mastery of the Living Abyss grants you an uncanny ability to harness other forms of the Abyss. When dealing with any other manifestation of nothingness, you instinctively know how to wield it in a manner similar to your control over the Living Abyss.

addons.title: Symbiote Throneworld
addons.text:
You now have in your possession the artificial planet Klyntar, also known as the Symbiote Throneworld, stored in a pocket dimension that remains with you wherever you are,, whose inhabitants—including Symbiote Dragons, Grendel, and Grendel's Mother—are utterly loyal to you. This grants you the power to perform feats such as merging entire legions of Symbiote Dragons into a dome of darkness capable of engulfing entire planets and blocking out all light.

This also grants you and your symbiotes access to the Symbiote Hive-Mind, a psychic realm connecting all symbiotes and their hosts across space and time, which also serves as an afterlife for both. Through it, you can sense and telepathically communicate with symbiotes, their hosts, and manifested codices. You can also remotely pilot symbiotes, seeing through their eyes, speaking through them, manipulating their forms even without direct contact, and bringing deceased symbiotes and their hosts back to life.

With enough mastery, the Symbiote Hive-Mind allows you to project your consciousness through time, possessing any symbiote that has ever existed. Unlike the Kings in White, the King in Black exists as a non-linear being, "unstuck in time," with the potential to influence and exist in all moments simultaneously.

objects.text:
The King in Black, also known as the Onyx King, is a counterpart to the Beyonders, tasked by the Celestials with maintaining the Multiverse from within. While the Beyonders—also called the Kings in White or Ivory Kings—operate from the Beyond using the Concordance Engines, the King in Black rules from the Un-Beyond, wielding the power of the Living Abyss. This dark force serves as both a tool and weapon, enabling the manipulation of darkness in countless forms.

As the King in Black, you hold dominion over the Living Abyss, granting immense power to create and command life from darkness. This includes the creation of symbiotes—parasitic and corruptive creatures born from the Abyss—and the ability to shape any construct or being from this substance. Your very body is composed of the Living Abyss, granting you the same powers as the symbiotes and a physiology rivaling Thor and the Silver Surfer. Through experimentation, you can refine the Abyss to enhance and modify your own capabilities.

Creatures born of the Living Abyss are capable of slaying gods and consuming their divine essence. The Abyss is not limited to the living—it can infect inorganic matter, entire planets, and even the fabric of the universe itself. Mastery of this dominion allows you to create beings such as Symbiote Dragons, a Symbiote Hive-Mind, the Void Knight (a proto-symbiote forged to enslave the Silver Surfer), and even legendary artifacts like All-Black, the Necrosword. Unlike Knull, who spent billions of years experimenting to master the Abyss, you can achieve comparable control within a decade.
objects.title: King in Black (Marvel)

objects.text:
Your symbiote is the 1000th of its breed, much like Toxin. It is strong enough to overpower both Venom and Carnage alone. However, unlike Toxin, this symbiote is vastly stronger than all other existing symbiotes, second only to All-Black.

Your symbiote grants you the strength of a Class 100 heavy hitter, like the Hulk, Juggernaut, or Thor. You could rip out a steel door effortlessly, bench press diamonds with your bare hands, lift a plane, withstand the full weight of a building, or even throw objects into orbit. You can also jump incredibly high, similar to the Hulk, capable of leaping several stories. That's not all; your symbiote is also strong enough to overpower other Class 100 heavy hitters.

But physical strength isn't all your symbiote has. Your symbiote's durability, precision, and reaction speed are also equally enhanced. Your durability is such that you could fall from terminal velocity without suffering any damage or even survive a nuclear explosion at ground zero, with your symbiote taking only a few seconds to recover from the latter. Your symbiote also possesses resistance to fire and sound, making it far less affected than its predecessors, to the point where most fires and sounds are merely a nuisance.

Your symbiote has bonded to you down to the genetic level, making you both inseparable unless your symbiote decides to separate from you or someone has the means to separate the symbiote from your genetics. This consequently gives you better shapeshifting abilities, such as growing wings. Your symbiote also possesses a massive pain tolerance and healing factor, allowing you to feel almost no pain and heal from almost any wounds and diseases, such as cancer.

Injuries like broken bones, missing limbs, missing organs, decapitation, or even being blown into pieces can be healed in mere moments. Your symbiote can heal anyone as long as they haven't died. While your symbiote's speed isn't near breaking the sound barrier, you can run faster than 100 miles per hour and catch up to cars. Meanwhile, your symbiote's reaction speed is such that it could even catch multiple point-blank shots with its tendrils or hands.
objects.title: The 1000th Symbiote (Marvel)

objects.text:
Your symbiote is no ordinary breed, but instead a Symbiote Dragon. As such, it is vastly more powerful than other symbiotes, capable of overpowering and easily slaying gods, and is far more resistant to the traditional weaknesses of fire and sonic attacks. Some Symbiote Dragons can also breathe fire or other forms of energy, spawn individual symbiotes from the Living Abyss that composes their bodies to raise armies of minions, and even reanimate corpses.

Symbiote Dragons are also capable of interstellar travel, flying at speeds fast enough to match the Silver Surfer. However, while resilient, they are not indestructible. Unlike the Grendel symbiote, yours won't be incapacitated by sonic grenades or destroyed by a steel-smelting blast furnace. Nevertheless, it wouldn't survive being inside a star and remains vulnerable to high-voltage electricity.
objects.title: Symbiote Dragon (Marvel)

objects.text:
Your symbiote has evolved, reaching the scale of All-Black, the first and most powerful symbiote created by Knull from the living abyss. All-Black is metaphysically tethered to the undead corpse of the Celestial used to refine it, which supplies it with power in exchange for assimilating the souls of those slain by the Necrosword. This connection grants All-Black's hosts powers akin to Knull's own. However, this version of All-Black, which you are acquiring, can absorb souls directly to augment its power without needing the Celestial's connection. With All-Black, a mortal like Gorr could slaughter countless gods and essentially become a dark god himself, wielding the power to defeat Young Thor, present-day Thor, and All-Father Thor simultaneously. The Necrosword also grants the ability to kill immortal beings as powerful as Celestials, Galactus, and Ego.

All-Black grants its host a superhuman physique, including a strong healing factor, virtual immortality to live for three thousand years while still appearing in their prime, and the ability to fly at faster-than-light speeds. Its host's strength is augmented to such an extent that a mortal like Gorr could throw chunks of a moon at Thor and single-handedly defeat millions of gods in open combat, including one that could "wrestle with black holes for fun." However, All-Black is meant to be wielded by a god and is stronger when wielded by one, such as Knull, who decapitated a Celestial with one strike. While wielding All-Black, Gorr could withstand the Godblast of an Odin-Force-powered All-Father Thor, survive immersion in a star, and being thrown into a black hole, which failed to harm All-Black.

All-Black's preferred form is a sword, but it can shapeshift into clothes, armor, wings, weapons, and tendrils, creating semi- or fully sentient minions known as Black Berserkers. Additionally, All-Black can discharge purple energy blasts and augment the abilities of its hosts. Notably, All-Black has a psychosomatic fear of intense heat and sound, although it cannot be harmed by either.

Note: While All-Black corrupts the hosts it possesses, you don't have to fear this, as it won't corrupt you.
objects.title: All-Black (Marvel)

addons.text: Much like a certain symbiote from Earth-23203 that bonded with every living being that had ever existed in order to obtain a complete codex catalogue of all life in the universe, your access to the Akashic Records has allowed your symbiote to assimilate all codices from the Marvel Universe into its Codex Database. As a result, it possesses every power derived from biology, as well as the entirety of the collective knowledge held by organic life.
addons.title: Team Biolife (Marvel)

objects.text:
Your symbiote has unlocked the full potential of its genetic codex database, granting it access to the powers, abilities, and knowledge of any being it bonds with or has been bonded with. As it assimilates more life forms, it grows increasingly powerful, gaining the knowledge and strengths of every creature it encounters.

This database is capable of storing an infinite amount of information, allowing your symbiote to assimilate a vast catalogue of knowledge and powers from all life in the universe. This grants it access to the collective might and wisdom of countless worlds. With the right powers, your symbiote could terraform planets, create new life, form living planets, and even make weapons capable of shredding entire worlds by harnessing antimatter.

Similar to Venom from Earth-23203, your symbiote has the potential to evolve beyond mere survival, engaging in wars spanning billions of years for the preservation of organic life. In such a conflict, even beings like Galactus and the Celestials would be minor obstacles. With the right powers, your symbiote could eventually create entire universes, without the need for self-sacrifice.
objects.title: Venom The End (Marvel)

objects.text:
Your symbiote’s natural abilities as a creature of the Living Abyss have been greatly enhanced. Much like Carnage, who sought to become a God Butcher, your symbiote now possesses the ability to absorb both living and nonliving matter into itself—most notably other symbiotes—using their essence to grow stronger and expand its arsenal of powers.

Through this power, your symbiote holds the potential for limitless assimilation. Carnage once slew Alejandra Jones to claim the Spirit of Vengeance, merged with Tony Stark’s Extrembiote armor, assimilated countless Venom and Carnage variants across the multiverse, and acquired abilities such as size alteration from a Venomized Ant-Man, the Hell-Mark of Andi Benton, and even the Power Cosmic from the Silver Surfer. In the same way, your symbiote can consume and inherit powers and abilities without limit. Such assimilation allows it to wield these abilities simultaneously—culminating in the possibility of rising to a level where it could slay and absorb an alternate Knull, ascending as a new King in Black.

Like Carnage, your symbiote may even forge its own god-slaying weapon by consuming unique materials. Just as Carnage devoured Uru and birthed All-Blood the Necrospear, your symbiote could fashion a weapon of its own—an apex creation born of the Abyss, capable of striking down deities.
objects.title: God Butcher (Marvel)

objects.text:
Your Symbiote has gained a unique adaptation. Usually this takes the form of a specific and unusual skill, such as Sleeper’s Chemokinesis or Scorn’s Technokinesis. 

These abilities grow in power depending on your Symbiote’s own strength, the more they grow and develop the greater these skills become.
objects.title: Unique Evolutions

objects.text:
Your Klyntar is capable of ‘overclocking’ the powers and abilities possessed by its host. Similar to the physical enhancement it usually gives, the Klyntar not only makes these stronger, but can alter them in thematically cohesive ways. 

For instance, if you possessed the ability to fire beams of concussive force from your eyes, while wearing the klyntar it could alter this to instead make you travel through the force blast akin to teleportation.

If you have Symbiote Hybrid, this does not apply to any powers you possess, but can apply if you choose to take a host.
objects.title: Adaptive
Anti-Venom (Marvel)
objects.text:
This option changes your Klyntar into a composite version of the Anti-Venom organism, possessing the best traits demonstrated by every Earth-616 incarnation. It retains the normal abilities of your symbiote, but loses its connection to the Living Abyss and abilities dependent upon it, such as corrupting gods.

In exchange, it gains Anti-Venom's enhanced restorative abilities, resistance to traditional symbiote weaknesses, and the ability to sense and purge diseases, toxins, parasites, radiation, and similar foreign influences. This cleansing can also remove mutations or powers sustained by such sources, such as the radioactive basis of Spider-Man's abilities.

Your symbiote is not a Klyntar, but an artificial entity created by humans. It is a picotech suit that possesses nearly the same abilities as a Klyntar symbiote, along with an artificial intelligence whose personality you may choose. The suit is not especially vulnerable to fire or sound; however, unlike Klyntars, it cannot generate matter. As a result, there is a limit to how extensively it can shapeshift, and it is vulnerable to attacks that compromise the entire suit at once, leaving nothing from which it can regenerate.

Unlike Klyntar symbiotes, your symbiote is not composed of Living Abyss and therefore cannot be manipulated by Knull or any King in Black. However, this also means it lacks several abilities common to traditional Klyntars, such as infusing symbiote codices into those they bond with and passing those powers on to subsequent hosts, bonding with inorganic materials, or killing gods and stealing their divinity.

On the other hand, as a product of science, the symbiote can be upgraded and improved through technological means—provided you have the intelligence or resources to do so.
objects.title: Artificial Symbiote (Marvel)

objects.text:
Your symbiote has become more attuned to their abyssal nature, unlocking the ability to spread the Living Abyss beyond their own body. By extending their tendrils, they can gradually assimilate their surroundings, transforming everything from the ground and buildings to animal and plant life into extensions of the Living Abyss. As their influence spreads, so too does their awareness, allowing them to sense more of their surroundings. The longer they remain in a location, the more thoroughly it is consumed by the Abyss.

As the Living Abyss expands, your symbiote will grow larger and stronger, evolving into an increasingly powerful creature suited to ruling as the apex of this growing domain. In addition, their reproductive abilities are also enhanced, allowing them to establish nests that produce new symbiotes, which will seek out hosts of their own and spread the Living Abyss even further. Should their expansion continue unchecked, the entire world will eventually be assimilated, becoming akin to a second planet Klyntar.
objects.title: Aspect of the Living Abyss (Marvel)

objects.text:
This helmet was built as an unshackled failsafe — containing a fully unleashed Nova Core that bypasses all safety and command protocols. A direct fusion of user and reactor, the Supernova Helmet grants power equivalent to high-tier cosmic entities.

Enables gravitational destruction on a planetary scale, from collapsing starships to shifting tectonic plates.

Grants flight beyond light, cross-dimensional traversal, and instant reaction combat speeds.

The AI is stripped down to minimize interference — leaving you with raw, unfiltered control over the gravimetric field.

Risk of mental and physical degradation is significant. Sustained use can warp space, destabilize planetary ecosystems, or collapse dimensional anchors.

This helmet is not designed for leadership — but obliteration.
objects.title: Supernova Helmet (Marvel)

objects.text:
This variant was crafted to act as the command system of a Nova Corps-style organization. As the wearer of the Nova Prime Helmet, you become the architect and arbiter of a new corps.

Contains an expanded Nova Core, far more powerful than the Centurion version, and a Master AI Kernel capable of issuing or revoking rank-based access to other Nova Helmets.

You may manufacture additional Nova Corps Helmets at any of the four base ranks and bestow them to others, though doing so comes with an energy cost and sync delay.

You can remotely set restrictions: time-limited use, lethal force toggles, emergency override protocols, or battlefield boundaries.

While others retain free will, they will instinctively view you as their field commander. It’s a symbol of authority, leadership, and absolute combat dominance.
objects.title: Nova Prime Helmet (Marvel)

objects.text:
You are the sole host of the entire Nova Force, a cosmic power once distributed among every member of the Nova Corps across the universe. This grants you immense physical augmentation and vast reserves of energy, placing you on par with beings such as the Silver Surfer and Thor. By channeling the Nova Force, you can elevate your strength to extraordinary levels—capable of trading blows with entities like Gladiator or Annihilus—and of moving and flying at faster-than-light speeds.

The Nova Force allows you to rapidly heal from injuries, though it cannot restore lost limbs, and provides you with near-inexhaustible stamina. You can endure extreme temperatures, crushing pressures, and devastating attacks, including assaults from beings such as Annihilus or even a massive blast from an enraged Galactus. Your control over energy is similarly enhanced, enabling you to unleash destructive power sufficient to harm entities like Quasar or Ego the Living Planet.

In addition, you become the bearer of the Xandarian Worldmind, a sentient collective intelligence created to govern, preserve, and advance Xandarian civilization. The Worldmind contains the totality of Xandarian knowledge, encompassing art, science, history, philosophy, and advanced technology, all of which you may access through verbal or mental communication. It continuously provides guidance, tactical analysis, insights, recommendations, and even criticism, while also helping stabilize your mind and preserve your sanity under the strain of wielding the full Nova Force.

The Worldmind can assume control of your body while you sleep to protect you from threats, translate nearly any language or analyze unfamiliar ones, shield you from psychic intrusion, provide precise targeting assistance for energy attacks, and hack or interface with highly advanced alien systems. It can instantly access entire databases from alien worlds and is even capable of containing the Phalanx Transmode Virus—though doing so requires significant effort.
objects.title: The Last Nova (Marvel)

objects.text:
Rather than the android taking your place, you can call pieces of it out of Null-Space  independently of others. 

This can be done in two major ways, either replacing parts of you for the android (like an arm or wings, attached to your body through a Null-Space tether), or projected separate from you, able to act at a distance. Unfortunately it will rely on your own multitasking ability to be reliably used as such.
objects.title: Partial Transition

addons.text: You’re no longer limited to pulling them out of Null-Space when calling your android, able to call them into reality at any time, even while you yourself are untransformed. Additionally, you can instead manifest the amulets each of the androids are connected to through your own, allowing others to take control of them the same way you take over your own.
addons.title: Armchair General

addons.text: Your entire flight has been augmented with your Nanites, making them a horrifyingly effective force, adapting and assimilating as they pass. Beyond this, all five of your androids’ nanites are linked, sharing designs and adaptations between each other, giving all access to each other's databases for enhancement.
addons.title: Theta of War

objects.text: Once your amulet swapped you with a singular Raptor Android, now you can call an entire flight at will. Whenever you use your Amulet, rather than swapping places with your single android you can choose to pull four additional Raptors out of Null-Space. While these Androids view you akin to a squad leader, they are a completely sapient group of highly trained fanatics, and should be treated with care. You may choose whether These Androids benefit from any other Upgrades or Addons to Raptor Amulet you’ve taken.
objects.title: The Fraternity (Marvel)

objects.text: The Raptor Android is an adaptive machine, iterating on what works and storing configurations for later use and refinement. Yours has gone further beyond this into a fully adaptive machine. Its passive scanners have become weapons of their own, seeking novel phenomena, energies, abilities and more, and registering them, searching for ways to integrate them into its ever growing suite of modes. While it may take time to integrate and replicate more esoteric or powerful effects, it will eventually do so. Furthermore, if the source is actively attached to the android when returned to Null-Space it will be sent to the same pocket-dimension most of its iterations remain so it can be adapted fully, vastly reducing its time to completion.
objects.title: Assimilation Agenda

objects.text: For each purchase of this, you can either get an additional rank 0 warframe of your choice or upgrade an already taken one to one if it's variants (Prime, Umbra, e.t.c).
objects.title: Platinum (Warframe)

objects.text:
You have acquired a full suit of Gromril plate armour, such as that worn by the Dawi elite known as the Ironbreakers of Warhammer Fantasy. The suit is all-encompassing, comprising a great helm, chestplate, pauldrons, greaves, gauntlets, sabatons, and every other piece necessary for a complete set of plate.

The armour renders its wearer essentially invincible to standard physical attacks, owing to the immense durability of Gromril; although, sufficient force may still break bones beneath the armour (Dwarven Ringmail underlay would help to mitigate this) and a few necessary gaps remain where thin blades could find purchase, such as at the eye-slits. 

Further, weapons of exceptional strength and sharpness, could still penetrate the armour if wielded by the immensely strong, though only weapons forged from Gromril itself have ever been recorded doing so.

Gromril requires no significant maintenance and will not weaken with age; even should a suit endure for ten thousand years, and is the perfect material for Dawi Runes to be engraved upon. It is, however, extremely heavy, and only the strongest Dawi, or those of equivalent strength relative to their mass, could even attempt to wear and fight in Gromril plate.
objects.title: Gromril Plate (Warhammer Fantasy)

addons.text:
You’ve long since conquered the trials of the previous Khan and have proven yourself more than worthy of wielding the full power of the Makulan Rings. You have all ten rings and their full power at your disposal. 

This also allows you to retroactively have successfully completed other similar obstacles and/or challenges required for any of your other OoPs and/or powers to gain their full power.
addons.title: The Mandarin

objects.text: There was another ring among the other set of ten, a yellow band with a purple fire shaped gem sitting inside it. Axonn-Karr was not the first Makulan to step foot on this planet, that distinction belongs to another. The Makulan race was more than explorers and scientists; they were conquerors, led by a powerful overlord who would dominate countless civilizations. Forged in the heart of the first star, the Makulan race created the Makluan Rings for their overlord to help in his conquest. For thousands of years, he would utilize them to conquer other worlds and planets. During a feast to celebrate the conquest of half of the cosmos, the son of the overlord stole the rings and fled, managing to escape and successfully hide on Earth after spending years on the run. Finding a man named Khan who he deemed worthy to wear the rings, the Makulan would bestow upon them the ten rings and the Dragonseed. The Dragonseed altered the DNA of Khan, making him part Makulan and granting him full access to the ring's powers. He would grow his empire, conquering all he wished. However, as he grew older, Khan saw his children as unworthy, spoiled, and selfish; he understood that they would not use the rings wisely. Rather than choosing a successor, he decided to allow the rings to decide for themselves by scattering them across the globe, erecting elegant stone temples that would house them, and creating powerful and deadly creatures to serve as dormant guardians, representing tests that would serve to measure the virtue and worthiness of those seeking to claim the rings. Near his deathbed, Khan would seal each of his rings in their temples, before taking his first ring to the remains of the Makluan ship of Axonn-Karr, and leaving instructions to his descendants on how to find it to start their journey. Perhaps you are a descendant of the Khan, inheriting his first ring and about to set off on your journey to gather the rest after having been directed there; perhaps you just got lucky and happenstance led you to acquire the Dragonseed on Axonn-Karr’s ship. Either way, you’ve come into possession of Khan’s first ring, allowing you to start collecting the remaining set. Each of the rings allows the wielder to manifest a suit of armor that the user can make, and segments of it disappear and reappear around them at will. The armor provides enhanced strength and durability, with each additional ring increasing the armor’s enhancements. Any of the rings may be used to generate a holographic map of where the remaining rings are and help unveil hidden areas created by the rings. Each of the rings grants its own set of abilities and will get more powerful the more of them you collect. The rings respond to mental commands. The Purple Ring provides teleportation and manipulation of electromagnetic energies. The Green Ring provides powerful impact beams, typically used to amplify the effects of the other rings. The Blue Ring allows the user to generate and manipulate water and sound. The Red Ring allows the generation and manipulation of fire, The Orange Ring has the ability to freely alter matter. The Crimson Ring grants powerful psionic abilities, allowing one to manipulate the minds and memories of others and even uncover hidden information through clairvoyance. The White Ring allows the manipulation of Air, allowing the user to create powerful blasts of wind and vortexes, and will enhance the speed of the user. The Black Ring allows the manipulation of darkforce, allowing the user to create powerful barriers and waves of devastation. This can also be used to open up portals to other dimensions. The Pink Ring grants control over life. Each of the rings, barring the first one, will have its own test of virtue that must be passed before you can use them. The tests will be scaled to give you some difficulty regardless of your own power; nothing is impossible and perfectly within the realm of reason, but nothing you can steam roll. While each ring can be used individually, each Makluan Ring enhances the powers of the others. If all 10 are successfully collected, the wielder of the Makluan Rings will possess the power of a god.
objects.title: Descendant of Khan (Iron Man: Armored Adventures)

objects.text:
You gain the ability to create new Masks of Termina, further expanding and enhancing your collection of powers. Each mask you create reflects the bonds you forge, the foes you overcome, and the trials you endure, making your collection a living testament to your journey.

Magical Masks can be created after completing a significant task for another person, such as saving their life, reuniting them with a lost loved one, or helping them achieve a deeply personal goal. The abilities of each Magical Mask are tied to the person or task you assisted. The greater the difficulty or significance of the task, the more powerful the mask’s abilities will be.

Transformative Masks are forged through profound encounters with death and power. You can create these masks either by defeating a powerful foe and capturing the essence of their spirit or by helping someone who is dying—or has already passed on—find peace with their end. These masks grant you the abilities of the being they represent, as well as a connection to their story.

Locked Masks represent the pinnacle of this power, allowing you to shape masks tied to beings of extraordinary might. You can attempt to create a Locked Mask at any time, but the strength of the mask determines the scale of the task you must complete to prove yourself worthy of wielding it. For example, a mask based on a legendary Hero may require you to save a city, while a mask imbued with the power of an Endbringer could demand that you save the world itself before you can claim its strength.

In addition to creating new masks, you can enhance the masks you already wield by completing specific challenges tied to the spirits or entities they are based on. These challenges deepen your connection to the mask’s essence, unlocking new powers or refining its existing abilities. As you grow in strength, this process allows you to unleash the full potential of your masks, forging an unbreakable bond with the spirits they embody.

Through this Echo of a lost land, your masks transcend being mere tools; they become living testaments to your journey, infused with the essence of the lives you’ve touched, the foes you’ve overcome, and the spirits you’ve laid to rest.
objects.title: Termina’s Echo (Legend of Zelda)

objects.text:
Instead of relying on XP, you can fuel [Wish Upon A Star] with various resources like Mana, Lifeforce, or other forms of energy. Even stamina can be used, though with an average person’s stamina, you can only cast wishes equivalent to Tier 2 spells or lower-tier Tier 3 spells.

This also removes the monthly cast limit, allowing you to cast [Wish Upon A Star] as many times as you wish as long as you have enough energy.
objects.title: Wishing Well

objects.text:
Your uniqueness remains intact, as you are still one of a kind across all the infinite worlds of the Wheel. However, any semblance of royalty has long faded. This crown, once a mark of greatness, has degraded into a pitiful shadow of its former glory. It no longer enhances your presence, nor does it inspire loyalty or draw skilled followers to your side.

Gone, too, is the crown’s ability to bolster your courage. Instead, its worn and dilapidated appearance only serves to highlight its fall from grace. No matter how you reshape it—be it a tiara, helmet, or hat—it will always look noticeably degraded, old, and unrefined, always drawing attention to its broken form.
objects.title: Crown of Loss

objects.text:
Instead of the 100,000th backup bag, you’ve somehow stumbled upon his 1,000th backup bag (which, by Rendall’s standards, makes it almost respectable). Still a backup, yes, but a far greater one—holding not just alchemical oddities but everything that once captured his erratic yet brilliant mind. It is an archive of abandoned experiments, prototype enchantments, forgotten relics, misplaced heirlooms, and even the occasional functional artifact.

The bag is no longer just a storage space—it is a labyrinth. A mess of enchanted shelves, shifting compartments, and collapsing dimensional pockets, most of which are only semi-stable. While technically organized into alchemy, armaments, textiles, provisions, and more, the deeper you go, the less sense it makes. A neatly folded cloak may sit beside a cursed dagger; an unfinished love potion might rest next to an enchanted frying pan that screams when overheated. Some sections have labels, but most are scribbled nonsense in Rendall’s near-indecipherable shorthand.

Unlocking its deeper sections still requires effort. You will find riddles, alchemical puzzles, or unfinished enchantments that must be deciphered or completed to access more. With every section you unlock, the more and more you will find, from ancient spells to god-touched materials or artifacts of questionable legality—and perhaps even an early draft of Rendall’s Magnum Opus.

While not truly infinite, the bag is bottomless in spirit. Many a scholar could dedicate lifetimes to its secrets—and still leave wondering if they had only scratched the surface.
objects.title: Arcane Whimsy

objects.text:
Each purchase grants you one additional Yo-kai Companion from the entire Yo-kai Watch franchise. You’re allowed to pick any from the standard 8 tribes. (Brave, Charming, Mysterious, Tough, Slippery, Eerie, Heartful and Shady).

Their medal is automatically catalogued into the Yo-kai Medallium. 

Additionally, your Yo-kai can follow you at any time. Completely invisible to mortal eyes, unless you explicitly allow so. You can swap and dismiss them at will.
objects.title: Extra Yo-kai (Yo-kai Watch)

objects.text:
Realizing you’re once in a lifetime opportunity, you’ve taken destiny into your own hands and swore to never be called “average” again. Earning you not just an upgrade to your Yo-kai Watch, but the features of every known variant of it that has and ever will exist.

Your Yo-kai have the potential to evolve into various forms, gain new abilities, and overall become stronger through the evolution of themselves and/or their Medals. The watch is omni-compatible with all of them, and can cycle through their variations as if it was cosmetic. From Z Medals all the way to Y Medals and beyond. You can also find these powerful versions of them in the Yo-kai World, which you can freely travel to and from at anytime from anywhere. 

These range from unlocking the hidden power of, but not limited to; the Legendary Tribe, transforming into Shadowside Yo-kai, Boss Yo-kai, Treasure Yo-kai, Yo-kai Heroes, Sword Bearer Yo-kai, Celestial Yo-kai, and all their variants.

The watch itself gains a vast array of features to further enable your exciting life. Such as shielding you from certain death, memory erasure, fusing Yo-kai and/or humans together, gaining the abilities of special Yo-kai, summon multiple Yo-kai simultaneously, easily swap them out in real time, and so much more. 

As a bonus, the watch can freely change form at your command or by its own will. Whether to be a physical reflection of your very soul, or simply because you think it looks cool.
objects.title: Yo-kai Watch: Model Ultimate (Yo-kai Watch)

objects.text:
Upon first use of The Golden Tiger Claws, you’ll notice a small but unmistakable pull, one that if followed will have the Claws opening a tear through reality into a space between spaces, a realm that borders all, reflects all, but remains untouched, as peaceful and serene as it is beautiful.

This small dimension houses a world mostly untouched by sapient species, all that lies here is a temple, kept in perfect condition despite its lack of occupants.

This temple houses a veritable trove of treasures, the full catalogue of Shen Gong Wu from Grand Master Dashi, manuscripts of powerful ancient Xiaolin knowledge and trainings, insights into the wisdom of Dashi and all Grandmasters after and before him, even the teachings of the Heylin are stored here.

Alongside all this, you’ll also find a wealth of information and items that seems to derive from the settings and influences of any of the powers you may have purchased here, or gain in the future, seemingly incorporating their properties whenever you encounter them.

The great dragon Dojo also resides here, ready to serve as a guide and teacher for you. He’s also a remarkable housekeeper and teacher, able to greatly advance anyone in the teachings of the Xiaolin monks and anything’s else stored in this dimension, should you need a teacher for yourself or for any pupils you may take in.

He also possess the Scroll of Dashi, a powerful tool that not only carries information about the Shen Gong Wu, but now also reveals important items whenever they come into play, Dojo gaining insight into what it shows and able to pinpoint where anything it shows is located.  

You may choose to freely open up methods of travel to your hidden realm to any worlds, or simply keep it hidden. You also seem to have the curious ability to attract potential students to this world, subtly guiding them to the correct entrance while hiding it from all others, even if you have no idea who these students are. 

All those that study inside this dimension will develop incredible talent and potential in whatever they study, even if they had none otherwise, which only enhances further the longer they stay there and the further along they progress. This realm can incorporate or be merged with any other items or abilities that grant a personal world, dimension, or space of some kind.
objects.title: Xiaolin Temple (Xiaolin Showdown)

objects.text:
Your arsenal expands beyond a single impeccable outfit into a full wardrobe of high-end attire, each piece carefully crafted and outfitted with the same advanced technology found in your original ensemble. Your personal collection spans every style and occasion—casual streetwear, tailored business suits, resort wear, loungewear, cocktail dresses, bathing suits, winter coats, and even sleepwear.

Every garment is as protective and functional as the original: bullet- and slash-resistant, temperature-regulating, and designed for maximum mobility. A seemingly simple hoodie may conceal impact-dampening armor and integrated comms, while a beach-ready outfit may include polarized lenses with thermal imaging and swimwear that adjusts buoyancy or filters toxins from water. Even sleepwear allows for rapid response, subtly wired to monitor health and alert you to nearby threats.

Comes with a manual on how to wash them without triggering or damaging any of their tech.
objects.title: Closet of Distinction

objects.text:
Your gear finally looks like something finally worth equipping. The armor now fits properly, with smooth, reinforced plating over vital areas, clean seams, and a consistent finish across the set. Whether it’s a steel breastplate, a set of toughened robes, or well-stitched leathers, everything about it suggests standard-issue gear for a capable adventurer. It’s not legendary, ornate, or custom—but it’s clearly functional, balanced, and well-maintained, like something freshly issued from a kingdom’s armory. It has that “mint but mass-produced” feel: clean, reliable, and ready for the real fight.

The gear still performs its most crucial function—absorbing all damage in your place until its durability is spent—but now with far greater endurance and comfort. Its total durability is ten times its base, allowing it to withstand drawn-out battles with ease. It’s also been refined in weight and design, adjusting naturally to the wearer’s frame and combat style. The result is a set that feels lighter and more responsive, no longer just shielding you, but actively supporting your movement and abilities. If the durability reaches zero, it still ceases to function rather than breaks entirely, and can be repaired using materials or time and care.

Alongside this, your gear now grants a flat 30% boost to all of your stats, subtly enhancing everything from your physical strength and speed to your mental focus and reaction time. It also provides 5% damage nullification, reducing incoming damage before it even touches the gear’s durability, making it significantly more efficient in prolonged fights.
objects.title: First Real Gear

objects.text:
Your gear now looks like equipment worn by someone who’s survived a dozen battles too many to still be called a rookie. It’s well-crafted and battle-ready, with subtle flourishes of style that suggest personal history—engraved plating, a reinforced cloak, a faint magical shimmer. Still, it doesn’t scream legendary; it’s not forged by gods or bound in dragonhide. But it looks real. Solid. Professional. The kind of gear a competent warrior puts on because it works, not because it glows.

The armor’s durability is now immense, being twenty times more durable that its base. 10% of all incoming damage is nullified, easing the load on the gear. Additionally, the wearer can select one damage type—such as slashing, fire, lightning, or psychic—and gain 50% resistance to it, halving its effects before nullification or durability takes place.

When worn the gear enhances all of the wearer’s stats with a flat 60% boost, and allows you to choose one stat to receive an additional 30% boost, totalling at 90%—with this stat being locked afterwards. Finally, the gear grants the wearer an active ability worth 10 SP. It must be non-offensive in nature, and can take the form of a mobility, defensive, retaliatory, or regenerative power. Whether it’s a short-range blink, a burst of adaptive armor, a delayed counterstrike, or a healing surge—it becomes a signature move tied directly to the wearer’s bond with the gear.
objects.title: Mid Game Gear

objects.text:
Your gear has the look of something forged for champions—not ornate, not overly embellished, but unmistakably powerful. The lines are cleaner, the material denser, the finish near-pristine no matter how much it’s been through. Whether robes, armor, or hybrid, its form is crisp and unmistakably elite—just wearing it sets you apart. It’s not flashy, but there’s a tension in the design, like it’s holding back something vast. The kind of gear that looks like it has its own reputation, whispered about by anyone who’s ever fought someone wearing it.

Functionally, the gear is now a fortress. Its durability is colossal, being a whole forty times more durable that at base. 50% of all incoming damage is nullified before it ever touches the armor’s durability. Your previously chosen damage resistance becomes a full immunity, rendering that type of harm completely ineffective against you.

When worn all your base stats receive a flat 80% increase and you may also select two additional stats to receive 100% boosts. Your first chosen stat is now amplified to 120%. Finally, the active ability granted by the gear has evolved to be the equivalent of a 15 SP ability.
objects.title: Late Game Gear

objects.text:
Your gear now exudes silent menace. There’s no flash, no glow, no trailing magical sparks—it doesn’t need them. Every edge is precise, every line purposeful. It might be full plate etched with ancient runes, or a seamless bodysuit of adaptive weave, or a battle-worn greatcoat over layered sigil-plates—whatever the form, it radiates mastery. Not crafted for beauty, but refined through necessity. This is gear made for those who survive not because of luck, but because they’ve mastered everything else. It looks like the final step before stepping off the edge of mortality.

With durability now multiplied by eighty times its base, this armor is practically untouchable. Just like before, 50% of all incoming damage is nullified. Your immunity too is just the same however you also gain two additional resistances, each offering 25% mitigation against other types of harm—be it piercing, frost, psychic, or any other defined form. Furthermore, the gear grants resistance to instant debuffs—you shrug off things like staggers, knockbacks, sudden slows or silences, though continuous effects like poison or burns still take hold.

All your stats receive a 100% increase by default when worn. The two secondary stats are boosted to 120%, and your original chosen stat now receives a full 175% increase. The gear’s active ability is now equivalent to a 20 SP power. In addition, the gear now grants two additional active abilities, each worth 5 SP, following the same rules as before. These can complement your main ability or branch into utility, survivability, or strategic manipulation.
objects.title: End Game Gear

objects.text: Your gear is a travesty of design brilliance—a walking paradox of power and poor taste. Whether it’s a suit of bubblegum-pink armor plastered with fake stickers and anime eyes, a shimmering bathrobe with the words “World’s Okayest Hero” stitched on the back in gold thread, or a literal cardboard box held together with divine tape, Joke Gear looks like someone rolled a nat-1 on fashion and a nat-20 on cosmic nonsense. It jingles. It squeaks. It glows in places that shouldn’t glow. And yet… for some cursed reason, it works better than anything else ever has. Despite looking like a bad joke told by the gods, your gear is utterly absurd in performance. Its durability is a ridiculous 100 times the base value—you could tank artillery fire, dragonfire, and eldritch screams without the duct tape peeling. It still absorbs all damage in your place until depleted, and 80% of all incoming damage is nullified before that. All debuffs—every single one—simply fail to apply. Your main immunity now reverses the damage, boosting your stats temporarily when you’re hit by the thing you’re supposedly immune to. Your two additional resistances has been boosted to nullify 50% of their damage types. Stat-wise, your gear is an unapologetic, unoptimized mess. All stats are given a flat 150% boost. Your two chosen stats get a 175% boosts, and your originally favored stat gets a staggering 200% increase. Your main ability is now equivalent to a 25 SP active, and your two secondary actives each clock in at 10 SP, all based on your previous designs. If you use any two of these abilities in succession, they trigger a combo effect, additional effects from synergized abilities. Joke Gear wasn’t supposed to exist. It’s the result of someone asking “what if we didn’t care about balance?” and the universe answering “bet.” Optionally, you can choose to instead have your gear look like how it did in End Game Gear.
objects.title: Joke Gear

objects.text:
A ring obtained from a more dangerous world, but radiates with greater warmth that can be felt through not just your body, but mind and soul as well. Even in the  greatest pain of them all, the warmth of the ring will soothe you.

The ring can now also heal you from mental and spiritual damage. In the event you are dying, unable to rocover with the ring's aid, it will become stronger, until it can outpace your coming death. It will only be able to just barely outpace it, only able to heal you 0.01% while it staves off death.

Although the ring is a miracle worker, it won't be able to help you if your body has completely has given up. But so long as your body functions slightly, you will eventually recover.
objects.title: Sun Queen Ring

objects.text: Your shield received a major upgrade. All its functions are doubled in efficacy: double the durability, and halved recovery and recharge time. It also has a smart system that can interpret your intentions, allowing a small opening in your shield that allows for you to shoot inside of it.
objects.title: Archotech Shield Belt

objects.text:
Your path was never meant to be walked alone. Now, every companion you have receives their own transformation device—whether it be a Morpher, a Rider Belt, or another thematically appropriate gear—perfectly attuned to their personality, fighting style, and spirit. Each device grants them a full heroic (or villainous) transformation, complete with a personalized suit, abilities, and a signature weapon or tool. 

As with your original transformation device, your companions may also call upon advanced forms, special finishers, and (should you already possess them) Zords or equivalent vehicles unique to them through their own gear.

Furthermore, new allies who join your side after your journey has begun will not left out. Once every 3 months, you can use a deep connection with someone to forge a new transformation device for them to use. However, this act of crafting a transformation device requires a deep bond, preventing mass-producing these gifts for strangers or shallow acquaintances.
objects.title: United Front

objects.text:
Your expanded holding item now comes fully stocked with both tools and low-level magical (or technologically advanced) materials chosen to match the powers, abilities, items, and skills you have at the start of your adventure. The emphasis is on utility rather than treasure: functional craft tools, repair kits, tuning instruments, and small caches of specialist raw materials intended to let you build, adapt, and maintain gear at low levels rather than hand you finished legendary components.

Examples of what you might find inside include a compact soldering torch, a tiny holoscale and field calibrator, a portable drone/armor diagnostic scanner, a magic vial and mortar set for alchemical prep, small sheets of Ceramite, ingots of plasteel, rune-etched thread, Ether-charged wiring, or a canister of Starkium for emergency tinkering. 

The total amount of tools and materials you start with is limited by the physical capacity of your chosen expanded holding item. Additionally, no single tool, part, or material provided may be worth more than 5 CP on its own or be a power granting item. Otherwise your expanded holding item may contain practically any low-level items that fit its size constraint.
objects.title: Exotic Tools and Resources

objects.text:
Your expanded holding item has awakened into more than simple storage. It has become a Artifact Reliquary, a storage chest containing a metaphysical vault that binds itself to the resonance of specific Objects of Power.

You may choose three Minor Objects of Power (worth up to 15 SP each) that are imprinted into the dimensional lattice of your Artifact Reliquary. Once your Objects of Power are select and imprinted they are fixed and cannot be changed without magically recreating the Reliquary. 

If an imprinted object is lost or destroyed (but not consumed), the Reliquary can call it back or reforge a functional copy from its lattice. The Reliquary may only produce or hold one instance of any particular imprinted object at a time; if the imprinted object currently exists elsewhere in the world, the Reliquary cannot create a second copy. Objects that are designed to be consumed (for example Chakra Fruit or Compound V) cannot be permanently recreated after consumption; if consumed then they are gone forever, but if they are destroyed or lost before being consumed then the Reliquary can still recreate them.

Furthermore, Your ability to restore, reforge, and call back imprinted Objects of Power is anchored to the Reliquary itself meaning that if it is destroyed, lost, or irreparably corrupted so too is your ability to reforge, restore, and call back your objects of power through it. Additionally, any extra properties granted by the underlying expanded holding Item (for example Treasury’s great wealth or Storage Ring’s extended capacity) continue to apply to the Reliquary.
objects.title: Lesser Artifact Reliquary

objects.text:
Your Artifact Reliquary gains a special compartment that resonates with shifting strands of fate and probability. When you place any magical or technologically advanced object inside and close the lid, the Reliquary absorbs that object into its lattice and cycles its imprint through countless potential variants across every world. After this short process the Reliquary replaces the absorbed object with an alternate Object of equal SP value that is better aligned to the intention foremost in your mind when you shut the container.

However, this replacement process is not instantaneous or omnipotent. While the Arsenal cycles, the Reliquary’s lid remains sealed for several minutes and you cannot access any contents inside. After a cycle completes the Reliquary will also require a noticeable cool-down before it can cycle another object.

Furthermore, the returned object is determined pseudo-randomly, with your intent strongly guides the lattice, but never guaranteeing a perfect fit. The rotated artifact may grant an artifact that directly addresses your situation, or it may present an unexpected alternative that requires creative use. The Reliquary will strongly bias results toward the concept you were thinking of when you closed the lid, but will allow for any better permutations possible.

Additionally, the system will be kinder on your imprinted objects with them not destroyed, but stored as potential within the arsenal. They can be easily returned back to their original form by repeating the process with intent to reverse it. Non-imprinted objects may be cycled but cannot be guaranteed to return to a recognizable much less original form.
objects.title: Rotating Arsenal

objects.text:
Your Artifact Reliquary potential has deepened into something far greater. You may now choose three Major Objects of Power (worth up to 30 SP each) and five Minor Objects of Power (worth up to 15 SP each) to be permanently imprinted on your Artifact Reliquary.

With functions beyond mere preservation and restoration, your Greater Reliquary can now also refine imprinted relics. By sealing a single imprinted object inside the Reliquary for a noticeable period of time, you can channel the lattice’s attunement into that object, improving it in many subtle ways. However, doing so renders that object unusable for the duration of the process and locks it from the Reliquary’s outward catalogue until refinement completes. 

You may perform this refinement on only one imprinted object at a time with each successful refinement granting a small, permanent, cumulative improvement to that object’s capabilities or versatility. These improvements will be somewhat random and tied to the concept and use of the object since its last refinement. For example, if you use a water totem to hold back a flood, you might find it better at controlling vast quantities of water. If you were to use the same item to put out a large forest fire, then you might fight it gaining an auxiliary ability to control small fires. While you cannot choose the exact improvement, the Reliquary will inform you of any changes significant changes when the object is unsealed.
objects.title: Greater Artifact Reliquary

objects.text:
Your Reliquary has learned to obey not just pattern, but purpose. Where refinements once produced thematically-linked but effectively random improvements, you can now direct the lattice toward a particular kind of enhancement. This gives you far greater control over they kind of improvements you will see in you relics, so much so that you can pretty much workout an evolutionary plan for your objects dozens of refinements in advance. 

Furthermore, you can now leave your relics sealed after their core refinement is done, allowing you to not only continue improving them but also improve the rate at which they are improving. As a result, the longer you leave a relic sealed inside your Artifact Reliquary the faster it will improve. However, this rate of improvement resets if you remove the object from the Artifact Reliquary.
objects.title: Guided Trajectory

objects.text:
Your set of T-60 Power Armor has been upgraded to the Mark III Advanced Power Armor, aka the Hellfire Armor. This set of Armor comes equipped with quite a few upgrades:
An auto-gyro able to lock the user in position, for storage while upright or sleeping in the suit.
An air conditioning system
Radio Headset
And a urine recycling system allowing the user to live weeks without external water supply.
Alongside these upgrades the frame and plating has received an upgrade. Being generally 1.5 times better than the standard. It is also lighter, being made of a lightweight ceramic composites, allowing for improved speed and agility. The visor has been redesigned to allow for greater field of view, and a hump that encloses the operator's head. Added to protect said head. The main draw of the Hellfire Armor is it's heat and flame resistance, being made for operations with flame-based weapons, which also gives it a boost in defense against energy projectiles.
objects.title: Hellfire Power Armor (Fallout)

objects.text:
The potion Harness is upgraded into the infamous Mageblood of Wreaclast. A belt that has had an endless number of Exiles in Wraeclast seek for the vast power it grants its wearers. The Mageblood allows its bearer to benefit from the effects of four potions permanently without consuming them for as long as it is worn. You can freely swap your selection of four permanent potions between any of the 16 vials of the Potion Harness with a moment of focus.

With the Mageblood, you become the ultimate alchemical warrior, able to benefit from various potions at will. You can also use this belt to abuse the power of potions that would normally have short effects and extend them into powerful, permanent buffs.
objects.title: Mageblood (Path of Exile)

objects.text:
The Rook began as a thirteen-year labor of love, a mechanical exosuit built to give a dying prince the strength to stand and ride to war. As the kingdom grew and technology advanced, that original framework evolved. Where once cables and pulleys amplified the movements of a frail body, now hydraulics and servos move six meters of forged plate. The knight’s harness became a cockpit. The armor became a machine. But the principle remains unchanged: strength through craft, not flesh. It is a walking tower, a direct descendant of the suit that carried a boy to war, and it bears his title still.

You sit reclined within a gyroscopic pod suspended inside the rounded torso. Haptic sleeves read the movement of your arms and translate it to the mech’s limbs with scaled force and fidelity. Buttons and toggles at your fingertips govern the remaining systems: joint locks, weapon activation, heat venting.

The Tower moves at the speed of a charging horse, its hydraulic stride carrying it across broken ground at sixty kilometers per hour. A full swing of its gauntlet delivers impact equivalent to a head-on automobile collision, and when its mass is put behind a shoulder or a charge, that force doubles. Its plate is forged to withstand repeated impacts from light autocannon and heavy rifle fire; medium arms score the silver finish but do not penetrate. You are not invincible, but you are not easily felled.

Sheathed vertically across its back are two broadswords, each measuring five meters from pommel to point. Their edges are electrified and vibrate at resonant frequency, generating a subsonic hum that deepens under load. They can cut straight through meter thick steel. A meter of armor grade steel yields in a single, clean stroke. You can optionally replace these two weapons with a single double-headed polearm that has similar features.
objects.title: Rook Tower

objects.text:
Your Power Suit is upgraded to be a match for Raven Beak’s. It boosts your strength far more than before, enough to easily tear apart robots which a genetically modified supersoldier in an average Chozo Power Suit couldn’t damage, and is also far more durable, capable of tanking the entire arsenal of a normal Chozo Power Suit and only being scratched by a Super Missile fired point-blank into your face.

Your own suit’s arsenal is expanded. Your arm cannon can fire a powerful laser beam, a machine-gun barrage of missiles, slowly expanding black orbs which home in on their targets, a laser sweep which covers everything except you and the space immediately around you, and even miniature suns which release waves of damaging energy.

Your suit also has several Aeion-based abilities, including a super-speed dash attack, an energy aura which absorbs damage and releases a massive shockwave upon breaking, and a second energy aura formed after the first breaks which blocks all damage and requires a carefully-timed melee attack to break.

As a bonus, you can gain all of Raven Beak’s knowledge and physical conditioning, including a mastery of combat sufficient to beat Samus Aran at her strongest in a fair fight and enough skill with technology to hack highly advanced computers and robots and reprogram them to do your will in a matter of minutes.
objects.title: Hadar Sen Olmen (Metroid)

objects.text:
You are not just a simple Kamen Rider; you are an extraordinary embodiment of what it means to wield the power of a Rider, far more than just a typical Rider. You have mastered the very essence of being a Rider, that of adaptability and growth. Your mastery over your Kamen Rider form is unparalleled; you are easily able to understand any new abilities on the go that you receive from newfound forms and gimmicks that you will eventually get in your journey as a Kamen Rider. 

Additionally, you seem to have a knack for unlocking additional Kamen Rider forms than you would have before, as if destiny is on your side, granting you additional abilities and forms that are exactly what you need at any given moment. These additional forms that you receive usually come in the way of fighting an enemy that you can't defeat and gaining a sudden boost in the form of a new transformation that usually has a way of defeating and countering whatever insurmountable foe you are facing. If you are facing a foe with the ability to stop time, your new form will possess the ability to move while in stopped time.

It seems as if you are a rising star who is growing faster to reach your full potential. Your evolution occurs at an astonishing pace, often outstripping that of a conventional Rider. You could achieve the full might as a Kamen Rider faster than you could ever dream of before being able to get to a final form within a year or so, depending on what enemies you face.
objects.title: Prodigal Rider (Kamen Rider)

objects.text:
Rather than having to wait and practice to reach full power upon obtaining your Rider Gear, you will instead receive the highest level form that a Rider has possessed. If you are using a Canon Gear, this can be its Final Form. Even if you don't possess a Canon Gear, this upgrade will still be useful, as you will be comparable to other similar Riders.
