You will be capable of using your unique abilities to the level of fighting an enemy on the likes of an Endbringer with little trouble. You have achieved a god-like strength beyond that of mortals.

As the expression of reaching your peak potential, you will have mastery over the powers and items that the Rider Gear gives you, possessing the experience needed to use your abilities beyond just having a vague idea of what your own special abilities as a Rider entail. Additionally, your Final Form will grant you new, unique powers that are extrapolations from the base abilities the Rider Gear gives, such as if you possessed often considered to be the top of the Kamen Rider universe these abilities are often ones that break a power system on its head or are a fusion of all existing forms that you possess, like Muteki and his invincibility or being able to use your abilities without transforming using the Rider Gear.

While your growth potential may still allow you to grow beyond the realms of a canon Final Form, your growth speed will be hampered by having such a high starting point and not being able to find a fight that can challenge you in a meaningful way to evolve beyond your current realm of power.
objects.title: Final Form (Kamen Rider)

objects.text: "Rejoice! The one to inherit all Rider powers, the Demon king who will rule over the past and the future! His name is Kamen Rider Zi-O!” -Woz You have ascended to the throne, taking what is rightfully yours, whether as the rightful ruler or a usurper who took the power. You are now the king who rules the past, present, and future, someone who befits the title of a true Demon King. Your Riderbelt is now that of the Ohma Zi-O Driver, the evolved version of Sougo's Ziku-Driver that transforms him into Ohma Zi-O. As with Ohma Zi-O, you have the powers of every past, present, and future Kamen Rider, including Secondary Riders and Dark Riders. In addition to the base tokusatsu series Riders, you also possess the power of various novels, spin-offs, and movie forms. You can selectively choose singular powers you wish to use at any given time from past, present, and future Kamen Riders or even use all of them passively. You may also summon duplicates of any Kamen Rider or person you have gained a Ridewatch of, creating an army of completely loyal Kamen Riders to fight for you instead of getting your own hands dirty on someone beneath your attention as a Demon King. The Rider Armour is also nothing to sneeze at, made out of dark matter that can negate most physical damage done against the user and enhance your time-related abilities through technological, supernatural, and magical means, allowing the user to sense alterations to the time stream or view different timelines. The suit can also defend against your timeline shenanigans. The helmet can also shoot lasers from the eyes. You may also make temporal clones of yourself. You also possess the ability to make blank Ridewatches that can absorb the potential that someone has once near them, or if you manage to defeat someone, turn them into a Ridewatch without waiting for the time it would take for a blank Ridewatch to absorb the potential of the individual. A Ridewatch is the crystallisation of the potential they held as an individual, gaining whatever powers they are destined to possess or already have, adding to their already immense power.
objects.title: Ohma Zi-O: Ascended Throne (Kamen Rider)

objects.text:
Your Bag of Holding(s) gains a number of additional enchantments, turning it a far more versatile and dangerous while retaining all normal properties of the Bag of Holding.

The bag can reshape itself into any number of different carrying bags, from a simple wearable pouch to a simple silk bag. As long as the form is something designed to carry contents and can reasonably be carried with two hands, the bag can take that shape.

The bag’s contents are entirely weightless, no matter what is placed inside. Whenever the user places their hand inside, no matter how many contents are stored within, the item they intend to retrieve will immediately and smoothly find its way into their hand, removing any fumbling or blind searching. 

The user is also subconsciously aware of everything currently kept inside the bag, removing the issue of losing track of its contents.

The user may also choose for anything placed inside the bag to cease progressing through time, allowing stored items to remain frozen in time for as long as they stay within.

Most importantly, the bag can endlessly reproduce selected contents. Whatever the user places inside the bag may be designated for duplication, provided it can fit through the mouth of the bag. Once designated, the bag may produce endless copies of that item when the user reaches inside to retrieve it.

A rare potion may become an endless supply. A handful of gold coins may become effectively bottomless funds. A cheap iron dagger may become as replaceable as dirt. If it fits through the opening, it qualifies.

The user may designate up to 10 items, or up to 10 sets of things with each set counting as a single item, for this duplication effect at one time. These designated items do not take up any of the bag’s normal storage space. Anything not designated for duplication is simply stored within the bag as normal, using its usual capacity.

The bag will detect the user’s intent when adding an item to or removing an item from this duplication list. When an item is removed from the list, the bag produces one final “copy,” which is in truth the original item. That original must be withdrawn before another item can take its place.
objects.title: Bag of Endless

objects.text:
In addition to your own ring, you, like every Sentai Red before you, have the capacity to find/create a team for yourself. With every purchase, you get an additional Sentai ring, following your own chosen theme, though each with a unique color of your choice. 

The rings you obtain will grant variants of your abilities, such as members of a team with a video game theme being tied to different genres, or a team with a Greek mythology theme each being tied to a different god. The powers of the additional rings are noticeably weaker than your own, but not by enough to make you better than any other 2-4 members of your team put together.
objects.title: Additional Sentai Rings

objects.text:
Your suit is now fully upgraded. Your life support could withstand aggressive ambients for days before needing to recharge, all while keeping you confortable and in pristine health. Your Shield is five times better, able to take greater damage and coming online again in five seconds after being taken down. Your Jetpack now can truly fly, reaching a respectable 100km per hour in an Earth like environment.

Your Storage now is the size of a small warehouse, and you can store anything as big as a car. Finally, your Fabricator is overall all better: it can fabricate things in high fidelity, complexity, and in larger size, the same as you can store in your Storage. It also contains a smart program that comes up with simple designs you may require, ranging from pre-fab shelters to tools.
objects.title: Upgraded Exosuit (No Man's Sky)

objects.text: Your Master Robes have been upgraded to the Archmage equivalent. Instead of the previous bonuses, these robes now apply a 25% decrease to all spells, a 200% increase in magical energy regeneration, and increase the wearers natural mana pool by half.
objects.title: Archmage Robe(s)

objects.text: Your Archmage Robes now retain the 22% mana cost reduction for a specialized school of magic from the Master Robes, effectively reducing the cost of spells from that school by 47%.
objects.title: Specialized Archmage
Perfected Key of Blankness (Honkai Impact 3rd)
objects.text:
This is not just a Valkyrie Battlesuit anymore.
This is the most ambitious project of the Previous Era that was never completed.
This is humanity's attempt to create an artificial perfect Herrscher.

Made from Soulium, an advanced nanomaterial, the Perfected Key of Blankness is less a Battlesuit and more an extension of your own body. Parts of your body are replaced by this wondrous material, acting as a physical anchor from which the armor can unfold to protect you.

But this connection goes deeper than flesh. Anchored to your soul is the core of the Battlesuit, an artificial Imaginary Singularity that acts like a pseudo-Herrscher Core. The Singularity produces an infinite amount of Honkai Energy, though the output is limited by your chosen weapons, and how much you are infused with Soulium. While the Soulium in your body is limited this connection to Imaginary Space can produce an endless amount of nanomaterial from pure Honkai Energy and shunt it into real space if needed.

Because of its unique nature you can configure this connection to the Singularity in any way you wish, allowing you to emulate known Herrscher powers, but programming new conceptual abilities takes time and extensive knowledge. The Battlesuit comes installed with twelve presets related to the Divine Keys and their abilities, though you can only hold one conceptual authority at a time, and switching between presets takes a short time. At the beginning your powers will be much weaker than actual Divine Keys, though they will be far less rigid in their use, and you will have better fine control.

Soulium heals any of your wounds and physical defects by replacing your body parts with its own nanomaterial. This material is naturally highly resistant to Honkai Energy erosion and all failings of common technology, such as temperature, electric shocks or physical force. It automatically adapts to anything that damages it, reducing the next damage of the same kind until it becomes completely immune, meaning you only grow stronger with every time you get hurt.

Even without unfolding your Battlesuit the Soulium infusion improves all your physical capabilities to superhuman levels. If you were already powerful before, this would increase your strength to such a level that you could battle a Herrscher with your bare hands. However, if you do unfold the physical armor it will protect you from any environment and passive effect, no matter how harmful, and deflect most attacks, even deeply esoteric and conceptual ones.

Additionally, as your Soulium is linked to your soul, you have full control over all nanomaterial produced, and it can never be hacked or hijacked. However, the Soulium you produce cannot leave the immediate vicinity of your body or soul, or it reverts to the Imaginary Energy it is made from.

You bear the symbol of the King of the Underworld, the Helm of Darkness. You carry the divine ichor of the gods within your veins. Now, take your place upon the throne of the Underworld as its new King—or Queen. Perhaps Hades has retired. Perhaps he has faded or been slain. Or perhaps you have mantled him so completely that, as far as the world can tell, you are him. Regardless of the reason, you are the inheritor of all the powers and positions of the God of the Dead and King of the Underworld. With your ascent to the throne, you gain, of course, the Underworld, the former domain of Hades and his court, and the seat of his power. The Underworld is home to the Chthonic gods, various monsters, and the place where the souls of mortals reside after their deaths. The Chthonic gods will accept your new position as their leader and will be initially loyal, though they may ultimately attempt to overthrow you if you give them cause. As King of the Underworld, you have the right to sit in judgment of the mortal souls that enter your kingdom, deciding whether they suffer punishment, enjoy paradise, or endure limbo for all eternity. You can also appoint proxies to serve as judges in your place if you wish.
objects.title: Lord of the Underworld (Percy Jackson)

objects.text:
By consuming a Virus Core, you can create equipment, consumables, or materials whose properties derive from the Virus Core’s contents. The available effects, their strength, and the quantity of material produced depend on the nature and amount of data actually inside the Virus Cores consumed.

For example, data extracted from an enemy with regeneration might produce healing potions or an accessory that gradually repairs injuries. Data extracted from a fire-based ability might produce a flaming weapon, protective clothing, or a consumable that releases a burst of flame. 

A single core may support several possible alternative creations, allowing you to decide which application would be most useful. Before consuming a core, your Twilight Bracelet displays the proposed result, including its properties, common usages, and limitations.
objects.title: Virus Core Items

objects.text:
You can now use Virus Cores to create persistent Chaos Gates, allowing you to transport yourself, other travelers, and their belongings between connected locations. 

Once a Chaos Gate is created, you can either teleport to already established Chaos Gates for free, or you can connect to new locations using additional Virus Cores. 

When a destination is protected, Gate Hacking allows you to hack around these restrictions by consuming high-quality Virus Cores to rewrite the restrictions preventing access. This can bypass a portal’s authorization requirements, penetrate spatial barriers, reopen sealed passages, or establish entry into an otherwise isolated realm. 

You can also apply this Gate Hacking Ability to gates and transportation systems created by others. Successfully opened routes can be recorded and reused, although repaired or altered defenses may require another hack.
objects.title: Gate Hacking

objects.text:
If you're not satisfied with the capacity of your vehicle, this upgrade can solve that problem! Each purchase adds a fixed amount of capacity equal to your vehicle’s original capacity. For example, it works like this: 1 purchase = ×2 capacity, 2 purchases = ×3, and so on (linear increase, no exponential multiplication). For example, it would take just 2–3 purchases to turn a DeLorean into a limousine. 

At the same time, the vehicle’s dimensions increase by ~35% in length (for cars and elongated hulls) or 15% across all axes (for ships and aircraft). The vehicle’s design will be adjusted accordingly to accommodate the new parameters and will not affect its speed, power, or combat characteristics.

This feature applies to many objects in the “Vehicle Objects of Power” categories.

It is important to remember that this change affects only capacity, not power or productivity, and it will not provide additional cargo or crew if they are part of the original OoP.
objects.title: Oversize Model

objects.text:
If your vehicle isn’t armed (or, in your opinion, isn’t armed enough), this upgrade will help remedy that!

Take a car, for example. The first purchase will allow you to install a large-caliber machine gun as an integral part of your OoP. The second purchase will give you an automatic cannon, and the third—an artillery piece (a heavy automatic cannon, a cannon, or a rocket launcher). The only requirement is that your vehicle must be able to withstand movement while carrying this weapon and not be destroyed when it is activated.

The situation is a little different with ships. Find a military ship in your setting that roughly matches the size of your ship. On your first purchase, you’ll receive an equivalent amount of light armament (e.g., air defense); on your second, medium-caliber armament (e.g., anti-mine caliber); and your third purchase will give you main-caliber armament. If your ship is already a warship, for each purchase you can choose to either double all of its armament or increase the caliber and power by 50%. This will work as long as it makes sense.

All weapons will be equipped with ammunition storage slots, reloading systems, and targeting systems.
objects.title: Militarism. Happiness. Fucking Great

objects.text: If you think you're safe at Warp, you're wrong. You can now equip any of your starships with advanced FTL interception capabilities. No matter the mechanics behind it, your ship can remain fully operational, even capable of attacking other vessels, at FTL speeds. You can also install an advanced sensor array that allows you to track objects travelling at superluminal speeds, ensuring that your enemies can never escape you.
objects.title: Interceptor Engine Array

objects.text:
Now, your spaceship (or any other sufficiently large and suitable vehicle) can be equipped with its own Adjutant—a synthetic assistant with advanced AI that connects to all of the ship’s systems and can be thought of simply as a “computer,” but with far more impressive capabilities.

Your Adjutant can provide substantial assistance with a wide range of tasks, such as navigation, ship control, administration, encryption and decryption, providing historical and analytical information, serving as an advisor on various matters (including command), and storing and processing data.

Your Adjutant will differ significantly from the start, as it will possess a variety of additional modules that depend on the type and purpose of the vehicle to which it is connected, allowing it to integrate optimally and effectively to fulfill its role. If the vehicle already has its own AI on board, the Adjutant can replace it, supplement it with its own databases and capabilities, or work in parallel by dividing tasks and responsibilities.
objects.title: Adjutant (StarCraft)

objects.text:
You have come into possession of a powerful spaceship which, unfortunately, has found itself trapped amidst a vast cluster of space debris, ice, asteroids, ancient wrecked starships and space stations. This giant mass of debris, known throughout the Warhammer universe as the Space Hulk, is so vast that your ship occupies just 5–10 per cent of its volume. The remaining space is filled with: 50–60 per cent old, wrecked ships and stations with their satellites, and 30 per cent asteroid-like space debris. Most of these old ships and stations are inoperable: around 75 per cent of their systems are completely out of action, whilst the remainder are functioning with significant glitches or require major repairs. Nevertheless, they can maintain conditions that are just about suitable for survival. All the man-made debris surrounding your ship also belongs to the same universe as your ship.

You could try to retrieve your ship, dismantle the chunk into parts and repair your old ships. This would require significant resources and a proper shipyard. However, just like the Space Orks from Warhammer, you could choose not to repair anything at all, but simply fly around in this space junk. To do this, you’ll need to route control systems to the external ships so you can activate their engines and work out which end of your flying scrap heap is the front and which is the back.

After a few purchases, you’ll end up with a batch of undocumented passengers in the form of aggressive wildlife or former ship occupants. After two purchases, these will be loners, groups or small communities, and after three purchases, almost every scrap ship will contain the remnants of degenerate crews or automated defence systems fighting for their survival. Whether to get rid of them or leave them on board is up to you. They are unlikely to try to leave the Space Hulk, but they may carry out raids inside it. On the other hand, you certainly won’t get bored.

If you have two or more spaceships as OoP, you can apply this ‘upgrade’ to both of them at once, and your Space Hulk will consist of two or more smaller, collided ‘flying dumps’.
objects.title: Space Hulk (Warhammer: 40k)

objects.text:
While Leviathans develop, they are usually incapable of carrying weapons. Deemed unacceptable by their slavers, they began Hybridisation experiments to produce a ‘Warrior’ breed. This is the Leviathan you have. 

Hybrids are much like regular Leviathans with two notable exceptions. Firstly they’re predisposed to taking orders as well as any properly bred Peacekeeper, and secondly, they are absolutely covered in weapons. 

Even juvenile hybrids have a large ‘Sonic Ascendancy Canon’ capable of extreme damage, only growing more devastating as the leviathan itself grows. Coupled with numerous smaller external arms and even a powerful network of internal defences, even a young Hybrid is a force to be reckoned with.
objects.title: Leviathan Hybrid (Farscape)

objects.text: It seems that your database and facilities that came alongside with Kiryu have undergone quite the upgrade. Now your database includes the knowledge of various human technology found in the Godzilla franchise, including subjects like A.M.F.’s blackhole gun, Future America’s genetic engineering and time-machine, G.D.F.’s various mechs and Gotengo, and even Dr. Serizawa’s Oxygen Destroyer. Furthermore, now your housing facility has expanded to include areas to construct and hold the various new technology you may wish to create.
objects.title: Human Engineering (Godzilla Franchise)

objects.text: It seems that your database and facilities have gained even further upgrades. Now your database includes the knowledge of the various aliens that have encountered earth within the Godzilla Franchise, such as the Xilien’s interstellar ships, atomic barriers, and genetic control implants, the Black Hole 3 Alien’s disguises, and the Bilusaludo’s cybernetics, AI, and nanometal. Furthermore, your facility is now akin to Mechagodzilla City and its constructive capabilities, as with proper resources it could even mass produce Mechagodzilla 1s on such a scale that you could make a fleet of them.
objects.title: Alien Engineering (Godzilla Franchise)

addons.text: Now you have the beginning’s of your own Fleet of Fog each of your Helicarrier’s now is equipped with it’s own Mental Model, and upgraded with Fleet of Fog technology While the Project Insight Dry-docks gain the ability to craft more Mental Models, and gather more nanomaterials to create more Fog ships. Any such creations will be absolutely loyal to you, happy to aid in your endeavors.
addons.title: Fleet of Fog

objects.text: Once we get them in the air, they never need to come down. Nick Fury Instead of only a singular Helicarrier, you now also gain the entirety of Project Insight including the three Project Insight Helicarriers, along with the dry-dock facilities that they, and many more Helicarriers could be constructed in, this Dry-dock can either be in a location of your choosing, or attached to another property type OoP. These Helicarriers have all the armaments and air wings of the originals, but lack’s the properly equipped satellite in orbit, needed to make full use of the targeting Algorithm.
objects.title: Project Insight (Marvel: MCU)

objects.text: Your Constitution Class vessel has been mothballed, and in return you receive a vessel of your choice from the 24th Century Starfleet flotilla. This includes models such as the Galaxy Class, the Sovereign Class, the Intrepid Class, the Defiant Class, or even the refitted Excelsior Class. These are just examples, and if you can think of a Federation ship from the era that you'd like, feel free to take it.
objects.title: Make It So (Star Trek)

objects.text: You have acquired an upgrade to your starfleet vessel, retrofitted with upgrades from the 29th-century Starfleet. Now, you can not only receive any craft from the 24th century, but your options have expanded to be any ship that was fielded around or before the 29th century, or you can receive a retrofit to your current vessel instead of picking a different vessel from the 29th century. Your ship can explore a new method of transportation invented in the 29th century; it can now traverse time, and those inside are not affected by changes to the timeline, nor is the vessel.
objects.title: Timefleet Retrofit (Star Trek)

objects.text:
In addition to your Knight, for each purchase you’ll be given a lesser Knight Armigers (Or War Dog). This knight is up to four meters in height and specialised for harrying foes and butchering small squads.

While they are intended to be support for a larger Knight. To that end they are fitted with a Helm Mechanicus, which is both far inferior to the Throne Mechanics of a Knight, but also less intensive. Additionally, it allows the Armiger to keep communication with both their squad and their bonded greater Knight.
objects.title: Armiger Retinue (Warhammer: 40k)

objects.text:
A standard Battlefleet consists of 50 to 75 ships of various sizes, with the largest—Battlefleet Solar—housing thousands of planet-killing vessels.

Yours, while not as large as Battlefleet Solar, is on the larger side, composed of 100 ships, including your own Gloriana-Class Battleship, an Ark Mechanicus, three Emperor-Class Battleships, three Retribution-Class Battleships, and numerous other battleships and frigates.

Your Gloriana-Class Battleship, while not the largest vessel the Imperium possesses, is among the most powerful. Each one is built to meet the exacting standards of a Primarch, the transhuman demigod sons of the Emperor… and now, you.

Gloriana-Class Battleships range from 20 to 30 kilometers in length and are protected by overlapping void shields. They are so durable that even if one were to crash into the surface of a planet at full speed, it could—given sufficient repairs—be restored to full operation shortly afterward, minus most of its mortal crew.

Your Gloriana houses an entire Legion of Astartes, over a million mortal auxiliaries, and countless servitors. It carries the supplies, infrastructure, and equipment needed to train, maintain, and replenish all forces aboard.

Your Ark Mechanicus could be considered a sibling to the Gloriana, measuring 25–30 kilometers in length and containing technologies from the Dark Age of Technology—including a weapon capable of sending an enemy ship a moment back in time, causing it to collide with a temporal clone of itself. It also houses a Nova Cannon that fires a 50-meter-wide shell at a significant fraction of the speed of light before detonation. Also Hidden aboard the Ark Mechanicus is a STC.

 Your Emperor-Class and Retribution-Class Battleships are equipped with lance batteries capable—individually—of destroying a void-shielded hive city.
These vessels are both fortresses and cities, housing millions of capable soldiers. 

Your Gloriana-Class Battleship or your Ark Mechanicus is capable of taking on entire navies single-handedly, besieging—or outright destroying—a planet alone, while the Emperor and Retribution classes can take on “lesser” navies.

Each of your ships carries weaponry sufficient to obliterate lesser vessels, and each houses multiple Exterminatus-class armaments.
Every ship is crewed by the best-trained personnel the Imperium can offer, mortal and Astartes alike, and equipped with the finest technologies of Mars. They traverse the Warp with exceptional stability, their only true difficulties arising from the direct intervention of the Chaos Gods.

Your frigates, though smaller, are made to equal quality as the rest of your fleet, both in construction and in crew.

Your total crew numbers over one hundred million, all holding absolute loyalty to you and the Emperor—for to them, your word is the Emperor’s own.

With this fleet, conquering multiple sectors would be trivial, and taking an entire Segmentum, while difficult, would not be impossible.
objects.title: Battlefleet (Warhammer: 40k)

addons.text:
You now have the option to replace your Citadel with the Mega Star Destroyer, Supremacy, a monumental upgrade that significantly enhances your Citadel’s firepower, mobility, and strategic reach. This does not remove the production capability or knowledge of your Citadel. 

As a Mega-class Star Dreadnought, the Supremacy spans an astonishing 60 kilometers in width and towers at 13 kilometers tall, dwarfing even the largest Star Destroyers of the Galactic Empire. Its sheer size allows it to function not only as a command ship but as a fully self-sufficient mobile base, housing factories, shipyards, and repair facilities capable of constructing and servicing fleets of TIE fighters and Star Destroyers.

Equipped with near-impenetrable deflector shields and an arsenal of turbolasers, ion cannons, and tractor beams, the Supremacy has immense offensive and defensive capabilities. It can carry and construct 2 Star Destroyers internally, and transport an additional 6 Star Destroyers externally along with hundreds of thousands of troops, vehicles, and supplies, making it a one-ship planetary invasion fleet capable of overwhelming any opposition.

Furthermore, regardless of choice of Citadel, your number of Star Destroyers are increased by a further 8. Your number of support craft are also increased by a similar ratio and all ships are brought up to First Order standards.
addons.title: Supremacy

addons.text:
You now command the full Sector Fleet that once protected the Second Death Star, expanding your military power exponentially. This fleet includes a formidable collection of warships, capital ships, and support craft that provided the backbone of the Empire’s defense around the Death Star.

This powerful addition significantly enhances your offensive and defensive capabilities, giving you a fleet that is more than capable of holding its ground against any enemy. With multiple Star Destroyers, TIE fighter squadrons, and support craft at your disposal, the Sector Fleet ensures that your dominance is maintained in both the offensive and defensive theaters of war.
addons.title: It's A Trap!

addons.text:
You can now replace any number of troops in your fleet with Jedi/Sith trained by and loyal to you. The effectiveness of these Force-sensitive units depends on the number of soldiers you choose to replace. 

If you replace only one or two soldiers per Star Destroyer, each Force user can be as powerful as a Jedi Master or Sith Lord, wielding incredible power and influence in battle. However, if you replace the majority of your troops, the Midichlorian count of each Force user will decrease, meaning they will be much less potent—becoming no more than average Force apprentices or even the equivalent of younglings in their abilities.

The greater the ratio of soldiers replaced, the less powerful each individual Force user will be, so careful management of your fleet’s composition is key to maintaining balance. Additionally, if you possess any Force upgrades, your allocatable Midichlorians increases by an order of magnitude, allowing you to create a vast number of potent Force-sensitive soldiers.
addons.title: The Mobile Jedi Temple - Chu'unthor

objects.text:
Once the personal armada of Darth Vader, the Death Squadron Fleet is now yours to command, ready to strike fear into the hearts of your enemies.

This formidable fleet consists of over a dozen warships, including a core of five Star Destroyers forming the backbone of its terrifying strength. Alone that would present a near insurmountable challenge to any adversary, however, the true strength of this fleet is its flagship, the Executor.

This 19 kilometer Super Star Destroyer stands as the ultimate symbol of overwhelming power. The Executor is equipped with over 700 heavy turbolasers and 1000 more light turbo-laster batteries, more than enough firepower to decimating entire fleets. It is defended by 12 full squadrons of TIE fighters, bombers, and interceptors, ensuring superiority in space combat. Furthermore, the ship houses 3 prefabricated garrison bases with a total of 38,000 stormtroopers, ready to deploy at a moment's notice.

Additionally, your flagship can be crewed by the elite 501st Legion, led by a Darth Vader loyal to you and you alone. Your crew is loyal, ready, and eager for your conquest of the stars.
objects.title: Death Squadron Fleet (Star Wars)

objects.text:
After the Battle of Endor and the deaths of Emperor Palpatine and Vader, Grand Admiral Thrawn, along with many other Moff, Admirals, and generals, became warlords, carving out sizable portions of the galaxy and creating mini-empires with the disbandment of the Imperial war machine. You have gained command of the 7th Fleet that Thrawn used to take control over a portion of the galaxy, ready to instil order into a new galaxy. 

Thrawn’s Fleet of Star Destroyers was no ordinary fleet, composed of six Imperial-class Star Destroyers outfitted with personal enhancements made by Thrawn himself, further enhancing the power that the Star Destroyers already possessed. Each Star Destroyer is outfitted with several squadrons of TIE fighters, including TIE defenders, bombers, experimental interceptors, Avengers, Nissis-class Clawcraft, and many other advanced TIE fighters equipped with hyperdrives, prototype weapon systems, and shields—a culmination of the Thrawn doctrine. 

Additionally, your new fleet is crewed by a legion of elite stormtroopers who have been personally trained and vetted by Thrawn himself, loyal to you and you alone, along with a version of Grand Admiral Thrawn who can come up with brilliant strategies that could conquer a galaxy with the fleet now under your control.
objects.title: Thrawn’s 7th Fleet (Star Wars)

addons.text:
Now, instead of just the 200 Star Destroyers promised by the Katana Fleet, you gain the full power and strength of the Allied Fleets at the final Battle of Earth at your disposal as well. Each ship is retrofitted with the same Slave Circuits and has the self-replenishing and repair capabilities of your Katana Fleet.

Each ship can alternatively be manned by a loyal, competent crew stationed onboard, ready and able to fulfill your orders. As the Fleet Commander, you can take control of the fleet at any point, directing them from your Command Chair.
addons.title: The Eezo Fleets
Ancient Upgrade
addons.text:
Now, your entire fleet of ships is upgraded with the latest cutting-edge Ancient technology: Zero Point Modules to augment the power systems, intergalactic hyperdrives able to travel transgalactic distances in mere hours, and the infamous Drone Weapons, capable of bypassing all but the most powerful shields and burrowing through all conventional matter with ease.

With this technology at your disposal, you can spread your influence across multiple galaxies with little effort.

objects.text:
Now, instead of your lone Star Destroyer, you sit at the helm of the legendary Katana Fleet—or at least a fleet of ships similar to it.

The original Katana Fleet comprised a series of 200 Dreadnaught-class Heavy Cruisers specially outfitted to be operated with the bare minimum number of crew, requiring about 2,200 personnel per ship.

Your fleet consists of 200 ships of whichever Star Destroyer class you selected, each retrofitted with enough slave circuits to be commanded and controlled by a single individual—man or woman—in the Command Chair. For those vessels with Starfighter complements, this includes those as well. You can optionally choose to have a well-trained and loyal crew to operate your fleet while retaining the ability to take command and direct the fleet at will from your Command Chair.

You can ‘portion off’ sections of this fleet into smaller sub-commands under other trusted individuals; however, as the overall Commander, you still retain ultimate authority.

Oddly, this fleet seems to slowly self-replenish and repair itself, with replacement munitions and even ships appearing over time—whenever you’re not paying direct attention to it, at least.
objects.title: Katana Fleet (Star Wars)

objects.text: With each purchase here you gain another Star Destroyer for your use. This can either be another of the same class as your original ship, or any other vessel considered a "Star Destroyer".
objects.title: Another Destroyer (Star Wars)

objects.text:
Nearing a whole kilometer long, the SSV Kilimanjaro belong to the newest class of Dreadnoughts of the System Alliance. 

Running a cannon that covers two fifths of the ship length, this broadside cannon can accelerate a 20kg slug at up to 1,3% of light speed, delivering 38 kilotons of TNT. Spread on both sides, 156 mass accelerators cannons protect the ship from foes, obliterating them. Its massive eezo core can project a mighty shield, and even should it fail, its thick armor guarantees that only overwhelming force can penetrate its defenses.

This ship also receives the benefits from the Normandy SR-2, and includes an onboard VI and a couple dozen droids to run the ships autonomously for you.
objects.title: SSV Kilimanjaro (Mass Effect)

objects.text:
Rather than just a tool to take colonists from one place to another, your Cryosleeper Ship now becomes a true Colony Ship. In addition to the capabilities of the Cryosleeper, the Colony Ship is able to set up all the infrastructure a proper self-reliable colony could need. 

The ship now spot a couple hundred drone berths, which send mining drones to collect resources in space to be brought to the ship, where refineries will process the ores into the material needed by the auto-forges, which in turn will pump the goods, components, structures and machinery run and establish the colony, such as pre-fab buildings, industrial machines, vehicles and equipment, etc. While you can add new tech (such as those given by your powers), the technological database is very barebones. Centuries ahead of what we have today, but still pale on what you would get from The Domain of Man (Starsector).

To put all of this to use, the ship also spots a bigger livable space for up to a hundred thousand personnel, who will run all the extra facilities, and the auxiliary spaces needed to keep them, such as hydroponics and growing vats, living quarters, recreational spaces, schools, etc. You can have the total capacity filled during the trip or left just a skeleton crew, it's up to you. A Simple AI helps automate most of the simple and repetitive work, but human hands and supervision is still required.

The ship also has enough resources to keep its crew for a hundred years, the same time a person can safely stay in cryosleep before problems start to arise.
objects.title: Colony Ship

addons.text: Your docks are improved. Besides being able to repair and upgrade your ships, you can now make new ones. It can fabricate a new frigate every day, a destroyer every 3, a cruiser every 5 and a carrier in a week. You can also fabricate a Onslaught or similar sized ship in a month, or two weeks with the Nanoforge on board. It can also fabricate other structures, thought anything you want to produce will require blueprints for the machinery to fabricate.
addons.title: Onslaught Mobile Shipyard

addons.text: Your escort ships receive each a Beta core. While not as powerful as it Alpha siblings, they are still capable of incredible computational output, and are coherent enough to pass as sentient beings. They are loyal to you, will reduce supply demand and improve energy capacity considerable, and only require a fraction of their skeleton crew to operate their ships (you can still have your crew if you want).
addons.title: Complimentary Beta Cores AI

objects.text:
While a fearsome beast on its own, an Onslaught may fall prey to a swarm of smaller ships if they manage to overwhelm its defense.

Now, you gain a small escort of ships to avoid this. Composed of six frigates, four destroyers, three cruisers and two carriers, those ships are designed with both wolf-pack tactics and supporting the Onslaught as an anchor in mind. 

They all receive the same benefits from the Onslaught: fully supplied, crew, and experimental generator. Additionally, to maintain your fleet, the Onslaught now spots a drydock where you can fix and modify your ships.
objects.title: Escort Fleet (Starsector)

objects.text:
Your Ha'tak undergoes a modernization and is transformed into Apophis' mothership — a new type of carrier ship designed and built by System Lord Sokar. However, this ship was later captured and used by System Lord Apophis.

The upgraded ship significantly exceeds the standard Ha'tak in size, reaching a length of 1,500 meters. Its design remains similar, except that the traditional pyramid is now placed on a large platform with movable elements at the corners.

Apophis' mothership is equipped with 120 high-powered weapons capable of destroying a standard Ha'tak with just six shots. Its defense systems are also significantly superior to those installed on a standard Goa'uld carrier ship, allowing it to withstand fire from at least 5-8 Ha'tak or a massive mine attack and the frontal impact of a dying star.

The ship's hyperdrive is significantly faster than that of a standard Ha'tak, but still lacks the speed necessary for intergalactic travel.

Apophis' mothership can accommodate 48 air wings of Death Gliders and twelve air wings of Al'kesh aircraft, as well as dozens of Teltak transport ships. There is room for more than 8,000 Jaffa troops. The minimum crew for the ship can range from 2 to 30 people, but it requires significantly more personnel to operate at full capacity. There are also 15 transport rings installed on board.

Overall, Apophis' mothership includes all the same ship systems as a standard Ha'Tak, but each of them is more powerful and advanced, significantly exceeding the capabilities of standard systems.
objects.title: Apophis' Mothership (Stargate)

objects.text:
Your Ha’Tak has undergone an upgrade with a unique power source the Eyes of the Goa’uld. This power source fuels the ship’s superweapon, but when the superweapon is not in use, the energy can be redirected to massively enhance other systems, vastly augmenting their power and tripling their effectiveness.

Your upgraded ship significantly exceeds standard Ha’Tak vessels in size, measuring 2,000 meters in length. Your Mothership is equipped with the typical complement of 60 staff cannons, though these have been vastly upgraded beyond the normal lethality of a standard Ha’Tak. They are capable of penetrating and devastating the shields of a regular Ha’Tak. The Mothership also possesses a singular, unique superweapon that, when fully powered, can devastate a planet or destroy an entire fleet of spacecraft in a single strike.

The mothership also boasts a powerful energy shield capable of protecting the vessel from even the intense bombardment of an entire Goa’uld fleet. Weapons fire striking the shield produces an orange energy field that extends across the craft, protecting it from damage.

The ship’s hyperdrive is significantly faster than that of a standard Ha’Tak. With the addition of Ancient and Asgard improvements, the hyperdrive easily allows for intergalactic travel, though it remains slightly slower than those used by the Asgard or the Ancients.

The Mothership can accommodate 50 Death Gliders and 50 Al’kesh aircraft, as well as dozens of Teltak transport ships and Goa’uld troop transport vessels. There is also room for more than 8,000 Jaffa troops. The minimum crew required to operate the ship ranges from 2 to 30 people, though significantly more personnel are needed to run it at full capacity.

There are also 20 transport rings installed aboard the vessel. In addition, the Mothership contains a cloning bay that produces genetically augmented Kull Warriors loyal only to you. Production is rapid enough that you begin with around 12 personal Kull Warriors who are completely loyal to you, and you receive at least two new warriors each month. This also includes the specialised weapons and armour they typically wear.
objects.title: Anubis Mothership (Stargate)

addons.title: Recovered Aurora (Stargate)
addons.text:
Thanks to your Lantean heritage, you have been granted the Aurora herself alongside your Aurora-Class Battleship, the Aurora being recovered before her self-destruct.

An important thing to keep in mind is that the Aurora experienced significant damage and is currently barely operating and requiring significant repairs in order to be functional again. The most notable is that the front quarter of the ship is mostly missing and the Bridge is completely destroyed. If you can repair the ship then you will have one of the most formidable warships shown in Stargate at your disposal. 

Additionally, her crew has been returned to their prime and are awaiting in stasis for you to wake them. This means that if you can get the life support systems operational then you can safely revive them without worrying them dying due to their advanced age. This grants you around 350 Lanteans loyal to you who are very knowledgeable about all the systems of the Aurora and can significantly speed up repairs and any potential upgrades to her systems.

As a final bonus the Aurora’s Database has been completely recovered which includes all mission reports, technical specifications, star charts, and if you so choose, the “fatal flaw” they discovered in Wraith technology, which can be used as you wish. This knowledge can aid you massively in the repairs of the Aurora.

objects.text:
You now have at your disposal an Aurora-class battleship, designed by the Lanteans for space combat. This powerful warship is equipped with cutting-edge technology that no one has yet been able to surpass—or even come close to matching. Despite its age, the Aurora remains one of the most advanced vessels in the Milky Way and Pegasus galaxies, rivaled only by the finest warships of Asgard and the Ori.

The battleship’s hull is 3.5 kilometers long, 1 kilometer wide, and 500 meters high, making it one of the largest ships in both galaxies. It is protected by a powerful energy shield that adheres to the hull and is significantly more effective than the shields of other races. This shield is capable of withstanding prolonged fire from several heavy Writhe Hive ships.

The ship’s armor and hull possess incredible durability and can withstand massive fire for 5 minutes, remaining combat-ready even when partially destroyed. The ship’s primary armament consists of powerful Lantean Drone Weapons capable of destroying Writhe Hive ships with a single volley. A single drone can easily handle a fighter or small ship; three drones are sufficient to destroy a Ha’Tak; and a volley of hundreds or thousands of drones can wipe out entire fleets.

Secondary armament includes 16 pulse cannons, which, although weaker than the drones, are capable of effectively destroying ships of lesser races or inflicting serious damage on stronger opponents.

The ship's power system includes a reactor and auxiliary systems, but its combat capabilities are significantly enhanced when using a Zero Point Module (ZPM). With a ZPM, the ship can reach speeds close to the speed of light using its conventional engines.

Unlike conventional ships, your battleship is equipped with an intergalactic Hyperdrive, allowing you to travel between galaxies in 20 days. With the ZPM, this time is reduced to a few hours.

In addition to the main systems, the ship is equipped with numerous auxiliary and secondary devices. Among them are a subspace communications system capable of projecting holograms even onto another ship, and several hundred Stasis pods. The ship also has space to accommodate up to 30 Puddle Jumpers in three hangars.
objects.title: Aurora (Stargate)

objects.text:
Instead of a basic hoverboard, you have gained a 74-Z speeder bike, an open-air repulsor lift vehicle built for speed and maneuverability that was primarily used by the military during the Clone Wars. A 74-Z speeder can reach a maximum altitude of 25 meters (82 feet), can quickly accelerate to a maximum speed of 500 km/h, and carry 4 kilograms of cargo.

While slightly slower than its predecessor (the BARC Speeder), it comes equipped with a multitude of other functions, which include a power generator with self-charging fuel cells, a forward multi-scanner array, forward-mounted Ax-20 blaster cannon, on-board com-links, simple optical sensors, and a close-range com link jammer.

Note: You can choose the basic look of your speeder.
objects.title: Speeder (Star Wars)

objects.text:
What is more terrifying than a single Mobile suit coming at you with malicious intent? A Squadron of them coming at you with malicious intent. 

You gain an additional dozen grunt mobile suits. You can decide them to either be Zakus, RGM, or other mass produced suits from the earlier Universal Century.
objects.title: Mobile Suit Squadron (Gundam)

addons.text:
With the ascension of Elder God Demonbane, you now stand at the precipice of all existence, gazing beyond the veil of reality itself. In this transcendence, you have been deemed worthy by the Architect, the All-is-One, the One-is-All, the Key and the Gate—Yog-Sothoth. As a result, you are entrusted with the Silver Key, not a mere artifact, but a conceptual passage, a gateway to the infinite layers of existence and the fundamental truths that lie beyond mortal comprehension.

Unlike conventional tools, the Silver Key is not an object but a conceptual gateway, a means of unlocking the true nature of reality and traversing the infinite layers of existence. With it, you gain access to the Gate, piercing the veils of time, space, and causality at will. This key grants knowledge and power beyond comprehension, allowing you to step outside the limitations of linear time, perceive the underlying structure of the cosmos, and even traverse the unknowable domains beyond creation.

The power of the Silver Key extends far beyond simple movement. It grants a limited omniscience, allowing you to glimpse possible destinies, unravel the illusions of causality, and observe the knots of fate known as Canon Events everywhere before you even focus on them. To you, all timelines, divergences, and outcomes are merely possibilities, ephemeral what-ifs, not fixed absolutes. True causality, after all, is nothing more than a construct—one invented by the Architect to organize the chaotic symphony produced by flute's clutched in a monstrous paw, where an unceasing cacophony holds that which should never wake, in restless slumber.

However, such knowledge comes at a cost. The further you push beyond the threshold, the more your existence begins to unravel, as the human mind is not meant to wield absolute understanding.
addons.title: The Silver Key

objects.text:
By fully awakening the Deus Machina, you ascend to its ultimate form—Elder God Demonbane, a transcendent war construct, no longer a mere machine but an existential force standing against cosmic horrors and the unraveling of reality itself. No longer constrained by physical form, Demonbane transcends into a paradox, an entity whose very presence denies annihilation, whose existence is a contradiction so vast that even the Old Gods cannot erase it.

Its arsenal warps the concept of weaponry itself, shaping reality to suit its divine will. The Scimitar of Barzai, a blade that severs time, space, and fate, allows Demonbane to strike across infinite realities, collapsing the distance between thought and execution. The Lemniscate Catastrophe unfolds endless iterations of Demonbane, ensuring that no enemy can escape annihilation across all timelines and dimensions.

At its peak, Demonbane wields the Shining Trapezohedron, an artifact existing in multiple states simultaneously—a blade of infinite cutting potential, a polyhedral construct embodying boundless cosmic knowledge, and the fusion of both, shifting between forms as needed. In its blade form, it cleaves through physical and conceptual existence alike, severing bodies, fate, and the fundamental laws of reality. In its polyhedron form, it becomes an incomprehensible wellspring of infinite energy to be used freely. When both forms merge, the Shining Trapezohedron Overdrive allows absolute reality rewriting, imposing the wielder’s will upon creation itself.

Yet, such divine supremacy is not wielded without cost. The strain upon the pilot’s mind, soul, and existence grows exponentially beyond measure. Those unable to endure its presence risk losing all identity, ceasing to exist within mortal comprehension, becoming an extension of Elder God Demonbane’s infinite, unrelenting will.
objects.title: Elder God Demonbane (Demonbane)

addons.text:
No longer a mere replica—in your possession is now the original Spear of Longinus, produced by the First Ancestral Race as a safeguard for their plans. Unlike the other spears, however, you are its ultimate and only master. Linked to you on a spiritual level it can follow your commands even across galaxies, attack your foes while not harming your allies, and even protect you from enemies on its own due to its advanced intelligence.

No barrier, AT-Field, or similar spiritual-based defence can resist the spear for longer than a moment. Like the Dark Moon itself, it can grow without limit to any size—although growing enough to completely encircle a planet the size of Earth will take around a year—and even propel itself at FTL speeds if needed to strike the targets at intergalactic distances. Additionally, whatever being it strikes can now be put into indefinite stasis, never withering or decaying for as long as the Longinus remains in contact with it.

No longer limited to brute force, the Spear now also has access to an arsenal of various esoteric abilities. The light it emits can instantly turn any organic matter into a salt-like compound on a continental scale at least; it can emit a barrier, otherwise known as Longinus Curtain, that would take an AT-field of a being comparable to a Seed of Life to even damage and that can cover an entire planet, as well as render a false image on both sides; has access to a Spatial Lens that can be used to open wormholes and transfer matter and energy at interplanetary distances; and much more.
addons.title: Despair Made Manifest (Neon Genesis Evangelion)

addons.text:
It seems the Black Moon is not as empty as it first appeared. It has one more occupant—the progenitor entity of the human race, Lilith. You can freely decide the details, whether it is Rei with full powers of Lilith, if they are separate entities, or anything in-between.

While monstrously powerful—just as any other Seed of Life—combat is not Lilith's true purpose. That being the creation of a new race, one endowed with gifts of reason, logic, and scientific curiosity, allowing her progeny to learn, collectively evolve, and build grand civilisations.

The Chamber of Guf has been filled to the brim with new unborn souls, allowing Lilith to release primordial ooze into the world. From which, in time, a new ecosystem will arise, with one race eventually emerging as the culmination of millions of years of evolution. While usually humanoid, if left unsupervised, the form of these creatures will be heavily dependent on the circumstances of their evolution. Additionally, you can allow Lilith to use your own biology as a template—which may be useful if you possess some abilities that could be inherited that way—and guide the evolution down a much more predictable path.

The expended souls will slowly replenish, although it would take centuries to gather enough for a new civilisation to be born. Lastly, Lilith can initiate an Instrumentality—a process during which she will forcibly retake every expended soul and collect it inside the Black Moon. From there, the souls can either be recycled, reborn into a new race of beings, or combined and brought together in a form of a gestalt being, nearly on par with Lilith herself.
addons.title: Lilith (Neon Genesis Evangelion)

objects.text:
No longer a man-made imitation, now in your possession is a vessel fit for a god. Black Moon is one of the transport vessels originally made by the First Ancestral Race to send the Seeds of Life to various planets across the universe, where they would later become the progenitors of a new race in the Seed's own image.

True to its nature as a space vessel, it can easily enter and exit the atmosphere and even cross intergalactic distances in mere moments. As it was originally a vessel for a single passenger, the Moon requires no crew to operate. Linked to your very soul it follows your mental commands without fail across any distance. Although, you can temporarily allow someone else to pilot it.

To survive its journey, Black Moon is made out of incredibly durable exotic material. It can exist for billions of years without any sign of wear and tear, even buried underneath Earth's crust, and it was able to survive a collision with the prehistoric Earth that buried it in the first place—the resulting debris from which has formed our own Moon—without so much as a scratch. Should the need arise, Black Moon can employ numerous esoteric defences, such as manipulating matter and space in its vicinity to render most attacks against it useless, as well as create zones of nearly-stopped time around it in extreme circumstances. Should it, by some miracle, still be damaged, it possesses an extraordinary healing capacity, able to reconstruct itself from the tiniest pieces if given enough time.

Normally, the Moon takes the form of a black sphere 13.75 kilometers in diameter, but it can change size and shape into nearly anything, from taking the form resembling that of a Grail to shapeshifting into a form resembling that of a Spear of Longinus and even phase through conventional matter and energy, making parts of it or even the whole Moon intangible and/or invisible at will. While there is no limit on how large it can grow, the generation of mass is not instantaneous, and it will take some time before it can expand to the size of a planet.

Inside the moon there exists a Chamber of Guf—a reservoir of souls. While currently empty, it can be used to construct an internal virtual environment of any complexity, allowing you to accommodate billions of living beings, souls, spirits, and much more, all able to interact with each other within the Moon's semi-real internal space, never needing food, water, or any nourishment while inside, but still capable of experiencing the simulated nourishment should they so desire. This interior is completely independent of the Black Moon's outside appearance, allowing, for example, the equivalent of a city to be housed within the shape that can be perceived as having the size of a single-room apartment.
objects.title: Black Moon (Neon Genesis Evangelion)

objects.text:
Your Evangelion has broken the logic of the world, and not only became Armaros, but fully usurped its power and mantle, all without being enslaved by the control mechanisms that affected its previous vessels. As a result, your Evangelion now fully integrates Armaros' power and has assumed it's role.

Firstly, your Eva gains a new power source in the form of the same dark energy composing Armaros' true form. This darkness liberates it from the need for external energy, and its power output is comparable to an S2 Engine but without the downsides.

Secondly, your unit acquires a second armor layer above its regular armor, comprised of thousands of QR Signums resembling black scales. This additional armor is exceptionally resilient, even by Evangelion standards. Each QR Signum employs your unit's darkness to generate layers of Artificial Fields, significantly enhancing its defensive capabilities. Some QR Signums can also be detached for transmitting your Evangelion's power, akin to how Armaros' power was utilized. If a living being is connected to one of your QR Signums, you can manipulate or control their movements through your unit.

Thirdly, your Evangelion can utilize its inner darkness to transform into an artificial Seed of Life and enter an Awakened State. This state involves releasing its inner darkness and creating an external avatar, referred to as a Darkness Giant. This avatar is several times taller than an Evangelion, comparable in size to NHG airships. In this state, your Evangelion gains the status of an artificial Seed of Life. However, lacking the light present in other seeds, it can't induce an Impact.
objects.title: Mantle of Darkness (Neon Genesis Evangelion: Anima Jump)

objects.text:
The core of your Eva has underwent a transformation, evolving it's power source into a new form, the Center Trigonus. This evolution fundamentally alter its nature, while granting it the S2 Engine's ability to draw energy from higher planes of existence, this new form vastly surpasses its previous energy production capacity. Importantly, you now have the ability to regulate the energy output, preventing overheating and explosions from exceeding limits. The immense power generated empowers your Eva to achieve even greater feats through its AT Field.

This increased power leads to a change in your Evangelion. By temporarily pushing it to generate more energy, your Eva can enter a temporary Awakened State, transforming into a godlike entity akin to a light-based energy condensate, similar to Radiant Giants. Unlike the canonical version, this state doesn't threaten your individuality through consumption by light. It can initiate an Impact, but it lacks metaphysical features and won't open the Doors of Guf like true Seeds of Life. Instead, it triggers an explosion of pure power causing destruction.

Furthermore, due to your Eva now dimensional breach nature, conventional methods can't damage or destroy it. Even if it were to be destroyed, you can choose to merely fade in a benign manner rather than explode. However, even if your Eva is damaged or destroyed, the Center Trigonus remains secure, allowing you to resurrect after a few years 

Your Eva mechanical components has been upgraded to manage the heat generated by the Center Trigonus.
objects.title: New Genesis Core (Neon Genesis Evangelion: Anima Jump)

objects.text:
Signature Control Package 08 “Eclipse” was developed in direct response to escalating losses suffered during the early raids into Xeno Alliance-held sectors. Coalition drop ships, including Judgement-class craft, were being intercepted and destroyed long before atmospheric breach, due to the Alliance’s predictive sensor grids and wide-spectrum orbital surveillance systems. In an effort to preserve orbital superiority and reintroduce the element of surprise, Eclipse was commissioned to suppress emissions, distort telemetry, and delay enemy target acquisition during approach vectors.

The Eclipse package is a structural and software retrofit designed to reduce the Judgement’s EM, thermal, and gravitic profiles during non-combat approach phases. The hull receives a layer of thermo-reactive baffle mesh bonded over the existing anti-radiation plating. This mesh passively redirects excess heat into directional venting manifolds located along the ship’s shadow-side panels, effectively reducing radiative output across observable spectrums. Simultaneously, power regulation subroutines reallocate energy flow away from weapon capacitors, external emitters, and active thrust systems during approach, minimizing detectable energy spikes without interfering with flight stability. 

To counteract long-range scanning and targeting systems, Eclipse integrates a microburst sensor ghost array into the dorsal and lateral hull compartments. This system intermittently generates low-resolution decoy signatures and synchronized false telemetry pings, intended to mislead early warning arrays and orbital tracking networks. These signals are emitted through modified QuantaTrace beacons that temporarily broadcast divergent positioning data while maintaining internal navigational accuracy.

In addition, Eclipse deploys a localized Ghost Imaging Array, which projects a high-fidelity false signature of the Judgement at a displaced vector. This decoy mimics the ship’s electromagnetic and thermal profile, causing most automated targeting systems to lock onto the ghost instead of the real vessel. When timed correctly with orbital clutter or debris fields, this layered misdirection causes tracking AI to assign Judgement’s signature to a non-priority object, misproject its trajectory entirely, or waste initial strike attempts on phantom contacts.

The Eclipse module also installs a low-emission cruise mode into the ship’s core control systems. When activated, LECM reroutes propulsion to a gravitic drift subroutine, allowing the vessel to coast along precomputed vectors with minimal thrust or emissions. This approach window typically lasts 20 to 60 minutes depending on vector length, after which full systems can re-engage for final insertion or deployment. During this phase, all weapon systems are locked to passive standby, and AI routines prioritize emissions masking and inertial balancing over combat readiness.

If you have Carrier Packages such as Ironspear or Falconstorm, Eclipse extends its signature suppression envelope to all docked assets. The Dominator and Valkyrie-class interceptors benefit from hull-based EM shielding and internal power dampening while in cradle, effectively rendering them invisible to passive sensors until deployment.
objects.title: Signature Control Package 08 “Eclipse”

objects.text:
With the knowledge given by the Hades Matrix, your lighthugger got some major upgrades.

The Conjoiner Drives are upgraded to emit nothing on the detectable spectrum, which when paired with camouflage screens and a cryo-arithmetic engine - a quantum computer that gets colder rather than hotter when making their calculations - allow for an essentially untraceable and undetectable ship.

An inertia suppression machine allows for extremely fast acceleration and deceleration, and its free-force bubbles can absorb most conventional attacks. It also includes exoteric weapons such as bladder-mines and hypermetric weapons, that essentially can remove a section of space where they hit from existence. The mines can remove 20km wide around then when triggered, and the hypometric weapons can hit a target with the same effect over a AU away.
objects.title: Hades Matrix Upgrades (Revelation Space)

objects.text:
Once, the Ark was a ponderous lifeboat, a lumbering fortress of timber and pitch meant only to endure the seven months of flood and preserve life until the waters receded. It was never built for swiftness or battle, but for survival, for patience, for rebirth. That era is gone. The vessel has been reforged into something greater, no longer a passive cradle for the remnant of creation but a sovereign power upon the waters, a warship the size of a floating kingdom.

Measuring one thousand meters from bow to stern and eight hundred meters across, it rises more than two hundred meters above the waterline, with a further seventy meters buried below the surface as ballast, storage, and foundation. Where once it was made of timber reinforced by divine blessing, now its hull and frame are constructed entirely of dark, tempered steel, layered and sealed with alloys that resist rust, fire, and every earthly weapon. The ship is capable of healing itself, plates bending back into place, seams knitting shut, and splintered towers rising anew after crashing.

Every level of the Warship bristles with armament. Lined along its flanks are batteries of cannons. From every deck, in every direction, weapons protrude, muzzles of steel and bronze, their barrels forged with divine craft. The ship carries siege mortars that can hurl shells for leagues, swivel guns for fending off swift attackers, and ballistae and catapults retrofitted with explosive payloads. The rudder-oars have been reforged into towering steel fins, giving the ship an agility no vessel of its size should possess. Despite its monstrous weight, it can turn, accelerate, and stop with uncanny swiftness, answering the will of its captain as though it were a living creature. 

Within its vast interior, the Warship is no longer only a vault for life but a living civilization. Thirteen original decks remain but seven more decks have been added, each devoted to immense gardens and farms that stretch from one end of the ship to the other. These farms make the ship self-sustaining beyond measure. The surplus are automatically dried, pressed, and preserved in the lower decks, where the divine aura of the vessel ensures nothing ever rots or perishes.
objects.title: Noah’s Warship

addons.text:
Your True Mobile Home expanded size, combined with your Empowered Village, has combined to have your whole village inside of your Vehicle. Your home now has access to self-replenishing resources spots where your villagers can gather materials necessary (or even non-necessary but in lower quantity) for life in a village, but that is not all, it also grants your vehicle, spots inside of it where materials from your power’s settings can appear, though the more powerful the material the less your True Mobile Home can generate (So no tons of Ebony if you have Clever Craft but your villagers might find a few pounds a month of it).

The True Mobile Village also has an upgraded capability to let you mark 5 locations where you or your villagers can teleport to and from in the outside world, no matter where the True Mobile Village is, though you have to manually place those marks at the location you visit. You are not completely limited to 5 locations, as the more your True Mobile Village gets upgraded, the more locations you will be able to mark.
addons.title: True Mobile Village

objects.text:
Previously, your internal home was limited to the size of.... well, a home. Now, you can carry not just a house full of people, but a whole VILLAGE inside of your vehicle!

The inside of your vehicle is now 10 Kilometers of moldable, influenceable land that can be built inside of. You could make a tropical island village, a nice urban land based on verticality, etc. Externally, your vehicle will now appear slightly bigger than before regardless of the shape it forms by about 2-3 meters.
objects.title: Mobile Village

objects.text: Your mobile vehicle has now reached its pinnacle in internal size. Before, you had 10 kilometers to work with, giving you the size of a small island to make a village. Now... you have 5000 square kilometers inside to play with! While you can indeed mold this like previously, you will also find a few extra benefits on the external vehicle. For one, the renewability stretches into practical negentropy, meaning you could start pouring waterfalls of water and city-wide feasts and it wouldn't dent the supply. As well, your speed now goes from a few machs, all the way to a quarter light speed! And that is before any modifications. This vehicle is also FAR more durable, able to survive a nuclear bomb from long range, if only barely and needing immediate repairs.
objects.title: Mobile City

addons.text: The Angel Combustion, having merged with your Inner Spirit, has now been able to manifest in a ghostly spirit! Optionally, it can visually resemble a mechanic of some kind, whether that be an Angelic fantasy-style engineer, or a modern-day beauty in car shop clothes, etc. She will bless her home with the ability to teleport you to it no matter where you are in the world with a "Holy Flare" gun that'll never run out of ammo. The Angel Combustion is also able to either bless vehicles or curse "Blasphemers" in a way related to your powers. If you had Pyrokinesis of some kind, she could bless the Magnum Opus and other vehicles with Fire immunity, or she could curse blasphemer's engines to overheat the moment they intend to attack you.
addons.title: Angel Made Manifest

objects.text: "Come and see, come and see, O Saint. The dream, the hallucination become truth! The Angel, made steel!" Your V-8 Interceptor has evolved into something greater. Now... It has become the Angel Combustion's earthly form, the Magnum Opus! This vehicle is capable of going beyond the speed of sound, Able to take horrible and unnatural weather, turret fire, and much more, AND able to pull things many times its own weight. As well, you gain access to many tools of the wasteland, blessed by the Angel Combustion. A Thunderpoon capable of destroying vehicles and small structures with a single fire like a heat seeking missile. A Harpoon capable of penetrating and pulling down steel walls and gates. And a Sniper Rifle capable of hitting from multiple miles out as if right next to the target. Optional Chumbucket to maintain and operate the vehicle, will never betray you even if you put the angel in danger.
objects.title: Magnum Opus (Mad Max)

objects.text:
“A new urban system developed to cope with Catastrophes. Usually it only takes 2-8 weeks to completely evacuate from a Catastrophe area.”

Now you are the sole ruler of your nomadic city, one of many that roam the dangerous lands of Terra.

Nomadic cities are modular transport systems that function as cities made up of platforms. Each platform is about 3 km long and 1.5 km wide and includes residential buildings, industry, and infrastructure. The city consists of 20 platforms that can reach speeds of up to 40 km/h.

There are three levels inside the platforms: The upper level is “The Living Deck” with residential buildings and parks; The middle level is “The Support Deck” with infrastructure and warehouses; The lower level is “The Power Deck” with engineering systems.

The platforms are connected by docking nodes, bridges, cable cars, or aviation. They are adapted for different functions: industry, housing, and others.

The city is managed from the Control Tower. The platforms are protected by armor and weapons. Nomadic cities are designed for 2 million people with comfortable living conditions. Movement is possible on a tracked chassis, by water, on an air cushion, or by air.

You can keep Rhodes Island as one of the mobile platforms or replace it. It's your choice.
objects.title: Nomadic City (Arknights)

addons.text:
Your forces and resources, which previously belonged to the RDA, are now being integrated with the SDF Navy’s assets.

This significantly expands your fleet’s capabilities: you receive four additional Olympus Mons-class ships, which, according to the original storyline, were never completed. Each of these ships will be accompanied by a fleet equivalent to the original one.

Additionally, you gain access to resource extraction, colonization, and interstellar logistics, previously available only to the RDA. Your interstellar transport ships will be upgraded to SDF standards. You can consider every Venture Star-class ship to now be based on the Olympus Mons hull, but with significantly limited armament.

Finally, the Hell's Gate base will be converted into orbital shipyards and an orbital elevator, similar to those located above Mars by the SDF. These shipyards will be able to simultaneously build up to four Olympus Mons-class ships and up to a dozen smaller vessels.
addons.title: SDF Security Operations

objects.text:
You now have at your disposal the entire Settlement Defense Front fleet, consisting of dozens of warships capable of faster-than-light travel and representing a formidable force capable of capturing and holding an entire star system.

Your fleet includes up to 8 smaller squadrons, each consisting of at least 2 aircraft carriers, 6 destroyers, and 4 escort ships (A-Jak). All ships are equipped with crews, aircraft, and ground forces sufficient to conduct large-scale operations on any planet or space object.

The backbone of the fighter fleet is the R-7 Skelter aerospace fighter. However, you can upgrade your flagship vessels by equipping them with the more advanced R-16 Skelter, which, among other things, utilizes stealth technology and energy weapons.

Your fleet is equipped with a large supply of resources for prolonged military campaigns, and the crew is highly trained and fanatically loyal to you.
objects.title: SDF Navy (Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare)

objects.text:
You are now in command of an Asuran Cruiser, which is virtually an exact replica of an Alteran Cruiser, given that the Asurans sought to perfectly replicate Alteran technology.

The ship is approximately 350 meters long and is equipped with a powerful energy shield and a sturdy hull. Its primary armament includes Ancient Drone Weapons and ~12 Lantean impulse weapons, each of which is capable of destroying a Ha'Tak-class ship with 6–12 hits. The ship is also equipped with an advanced Cloaking Device that renders it invisible to both sensors and the optical spectrum.

A single person is sufficient to operate the ship effectively, but a crew of 10 is required for optimal performance. The ship can accommodate a full crew of 30–40 people and up to 50 passengers. A small hangar houses 2 Puddle Jumpers.

The ship’s hyperdrive is incredibly fast and efficient, but is intended only for intragalactic travel. The ship is highly maneuverable and capable of catching up to a Puddle Jumper.

Despite its power and technological sophistication, the Asuran Cruiser may face serious difficulties when encountering ships of the Older Races, such as the Asgard, Ori, and Alterans. Nevertheless, it is one of the most powerful ships in its weight class in both galaxies, but it will be difficult to use it for anything other than military service.

To keep things simple, you’ll have 1200 Ancient Drones, which is more than enough to destroy a small squadron of lesser races. What’s more, any unused drones will be able to return. As a bonus, you'll receive a module that slowly replenishes your ammunition supply when resources and materials are available.
objects.title: Asuran Cruiser (Stargate)

objects.text:
The Mother In Being extends 180 meters from bow to stern, its hull a shell mimicking that of a WWII Carrier housing thousands of maturing young at various stages of development. Eight massive jointed legs extend from the keel, each of her limbs thick enough to support the entire structure and tipped with broad, rubberized pads that distribute weight across any surface. The vessel walks across any terrain with equal ease, its legs churning through shallow harbors or stepping over buildings without concern for draft or obstacles. Those legs can extend or retract up to 300 meters, allowing the Mother to elevate herself above incoming fire or step over defensive barriers that would stop conventional ships. The Mother serves as a mobile fortress and factory, her flight deck constantly elevating, launching, and recovering young while those legs carry it toward whatever operational zone you designate.

The young swarm from the flight deck with all the capabilities Dead Ahead possesses, but Dead Ahead is only one of many young. What changes with the numbers present is strategic complexity; pack tactics and group hunting. The young coordinate through a distributed intelligence, with each individual benefiting from the pack's collective experience. They execute complex maneuvers impossible for lone fighters, ranging from pincer formations to layered suppression fire to synchronized diving attacks. Some provide ranged harassment while others close for blade work, adapting their approaches based on enemy response. Those that expend their web reserves or sustain damage return to feed and regenerate, replaced immediately by fresh spawn from the interior hatcheries.

The Mother In Being's primary armament focuses on conversion than anything else. Biological launchers positioned along her hull fire egg clusters that burst on impact, embedding larvae into whatever inorganic vessels they strike, such that vehicles and vessels seeded with eggs begin growing chitinous plating and turning into variants of young, or if they're large enough, producing their own broods. A cargo ship implanted with sufficient larvae will, over weeks, metamorphose into a lesser Mother capable of spawning its own fighters.
