The infection spreads through contact with transformed hosts, creating cascades of infection that can turn entire fleets into allied minions with adequate saturation and maturation.

Damage to the Mother repairs through accelerated breeding, her interior layered with young in every stage of development packed between structural supports. When her hull is breached, young immediately swarm the gap and secrete hardening resins while others interlock their bodies to form patches. Minor damage seals within minutes while major breaches require an hour as successive generations mature rapidly, their bodies calcifying into permanent repairs stronger than the original chitin. The Mother can sustain catastrophic damage and remain operational as long as her core deep in the keel survives to spawn replacements. 

The Mother treats you as both captain and cherished offspring, restructuring her interior constantly to suit your needs. Young form themselves into furniture, walls, flooring, living quarters, kitchens and more, though they cannot replicate technological objects like computers or smaller items like pencils and toiletries. She learns your preferences through observation, extends her legs to help you board, softens floors to cushion steps, etcetera. She will sacrifice vast numbers of her spawn to ensure your survival, treating you as the only thing more precious than the continuation of the bloodline.
objects.title: Multi-Domain Carrier Ship: Mother In Being

objects.text:
It seems that you have done the impossible. The Timelords have been trying for ages to retrofit previous models with little to no success, as the two times they attempted to replicate the upgrade to a previous TARDIS model to have a humanoid form similar to Compassion, they failed. The TARDIS went insane, so they stopped attempting to upgrade previous models with the humanoid retrofit and instead created a new line of TARDIS models labelled type-103 to make new humanoid TARDIS units. 

You, on the other hand, have managed to upgrade a standard model of TARDIS, allowing for your TARDIS to possess a humanoid form that it can take while still inside its own standard form or even just taking on the outward appearance of a humanoid. 

The first and foremost benefit to this new upgrade is that you no longer need to know how to fly the TARDIS, as it can instead fly itself. The humanoid form of the TARDIS can take form and use the console to fly itself to any location you ask, or even operate itself while not taking a humanoid form. The TARDIS can also use its chameleon circuit to change its form to just about any humanoid form, even other aliens, to better blend in if needed. Changing its humanoid form, however, takes time.

The second benefit to this is your TARDIS, depending on what model it is, gets an upgrade in its technology, such as if you take any model number before the 102 or 103, it would be upgraded with technology from the 102 model that is superior to the 103 model, as the Time Lords purposefully handicapped the 103, afraid that the humanoid TARDIS models would end up like Compassion, the first and only Type-102.

This new TARDIS will be optionally completely loyal to you and similarly view you as the Doctor's TARDIS views the Doctor, and will have a personality that matches your own.
objects.title: Humanoid Tardis Retrofit (Doctor Who)

objects.text: With every purchase here you gain another Ancient City-Ship.
objects.title: Another City-Ship (Stargate)

addons.title: Atlantus Ascendant
addons.text: Now, instead of the city almost being destroyed one of its three depleted Zero Point Module’s is replaced by one that is fully charged. And with a full ZPM, so many functions and features of Atlantus become available to you from the outset. Advanced laboratories, and manufacturing facilities. Food generation from energy-mass conversion, advanced scanners. Medical technology capable of fixing almost any ailment, and advanced communications systems. But perhaps most important of all? A search function, enhanced by a custom artificial intelligence able to sift through the millions of years of data sitting in the Atlantus databanks, and actually allowing you to find anything within them.

objects.text: Instead of just a generic Ancient City-Ship, you get the capital of the Lantean civilization: the City-Ship Atlantus, whose sinking beneath the waves inspired the ancient tales of Atlantis. Atlantus has weathered ten thousand years beneath the crushing weight of the Lantean ocean, with its shields on the brink of collapse when the Atlantis Expedition arrives. On one hand, you’re now receiving a City-Ship all but depleted of power; on the other hand, you’re gaining access to every Ancient project stored within the city—the Atlantis Expedition itself (which can include anyone who was ever part of the expedition), as well as any of the various characters who called Atlantus “home” throughout the series. You’ll also gain access to the Atlantus database, filled with all the knowledge of the Ancients as of their departure from the Pegasus Galaxy, along with any of the various bits of technology they might have required. Finally, you hold a position of real power on Atlantus—whether that is as head of the Atlantis Expedition, leader of the Atlantean Council, or something else of your own design. It grants you the ability to lead everyone who considers Atlantus home, with all of its people being loyal to you. As long as you give them no real cause, they will never willingly betray you.
objects.title: Atlantus (Stargate)

addons.title: Rao Reborn
addons.text: Rao is the chief god of Krypton, the god of the sun and light upon whom the Kryptonians depended for so long. Now, with Krypton’s destruction, Rao is no more. Dead, retired, or simply missing—Rao is gone... and now you stand as the successor to his position, and power. With time and effort, perhaps you might one day even be able to restore his dead world. With your status as the second coming of Rao, you may optionally have bright red hair, long considered a sign of Rao’s divine influence. You also enjoy the absolute loyalty and obedience of all Kryptonians, who revel in the presence of their beloved deity. As Rao Reborn, you possess all the powers of the Immortal Sun, with divine authority over solar energy that allows you to perpetually fuel the powers of your Kryptonian body. Kryptonians gain great power under the light of younger, brighter stars, as their bodies metabolize energy and grant a variety of abilities. In truth, these powers are the blessing of Rao upon his children who travel out from under his watchful gaze. Now, you can bestow this blessing upon those you deem worthy, granting them the full set of Kryptonian powers under the light of any sun.

objects.text:
Instead of a City-Ship, you gain Argo—one of the major cities of the now-destroyed planet Krypton—as your own. Protected by a powerful force field, it was ejected during Krypton’s destruction, resting on a chunk of the planetary crust. As a cosmopolitan melting pot of the various guilds of Krypton, the city contains copies of most of the technology, science, art, and religious centers that Kryptonian society has created.

Krypton was traditionally led by its Council, consisting of representatives from the five guilds: the Artists, the Scientists, the Military, the Religion, and the Labor guilds. Argo has recreated this Council in the wake of Krypton’s destruction. You will have a seat on this Council, not merely as a guild leader but as Head of the Council.

As Head of the Council, your responsibilities are few; the remaining Council members rule wisely and effectively, much as if you were actively participating. While the loyalty of Argo and its people to you is not absolute, it would take concerted effort on your part—working against the city’s interests—to cause your newfound people to turn against you.

While much of the land beneath the city has become contaminated with highly dangerous Kryptonite and its radiation, this material provides the benefit of a nearly limitless energy source to power the city, its shield, the propulsion engines, and the myriad devices that ensure enough food and water for the 40 million inhabitants of Argo City.

At the force field dome, an artificial red sun provides heat and light to the city but also locks away the incredible potential power of every Kryptonian. However, with your leadership, the Kryptonian Council could swiftly change this to the light of a yellow sun if you wish.

Argo will be located somewhere within the Solar System wherever you enter. If for some reason you have no ability to get to the city yourself, they’ll send a shuttle to retrieve you within a day.
objects.title: Argo City (DC Comics)

objects.text:
You are now in possession of an omnicannon weapons system, ready to be installed on any space-faring vessel you possess.

This is an incredibly advanced piece of weaponry, originally created for the Gravestone frigate to take on Eternal Fleet. When fired, it launches a green energy beam at a target, which then forks and chains to the surrounding enemy vessels. Even heavily damaged and nearly out of power, one shot was enough to take out more than two dozen ships of the Eternal Fleet, each of which is an incredibly advanced and heavily shielded more than a kilometer-long behemoth.

At full power, this cannon can allow one ship to take on and win against an entire fleet consisting of thousands of vessels.
objects.title: Omnicannon (Star Wars)

objects.text:
You are now the owner and CEO of the entire Spacing Guild, complete with the fleet of hundreds of thousands of heighliners and millions of employees. All guild property rests in a dedicated pocket dimension, but you can import it into any world you want as well as send it back for safekeeping.

You can retroactively insert the Guild into any world as a force with almost complete monopoly in space travel and shipping.
objects.title: Spacing Guild (Dune)
A Larger Property
objects.text: Each time you select this, you can double the size of one of your properties.

objects.title: Unique Address
objects.text: Your Properties now can be placed in a pocket dimension, accessible to you however you choose; a door in the air, drawing a hole in a wall, putting a key in a door, etc. The pocket dimension will be inaccessible to anyone who does not go in with you and you don't allow. The only way to brute force your way in is to know where the dimension is in the universe and have a way of traveling through dimensions as well. When it comes to those that are generally "Groundless" like space stations and orbital properties, optionally they will gain a "Ground" below them and a general gravity that makes it so you don't fall on your face and just float up and down to the actual properties. Otherwise, you will immediately access the properties.

objects.title: I Swear That Building Wasn't There Yesterday
objects.text:
Any property object of power you possess can be manifested physically in a location of your choosing in any world you visit. If you place it in an occupied location, the local area warps to fit it.

This takes the path of least resistance. For example, if you wanted to place a building in between two other buildings with almost zero space but there was more space nearby, this upgrade would simply move the surrounding buildings to the side and possibly shrink them slightly.

Any buildings you place are your fully legal property with airtight paperwork and waived property tax. Despite the name, no one will notice anything off unless you wish them to. Additionally, you can choose to have the building modified cosmetically to fit the setting.

If your property exists in a pocket dimension of some sort, you can choose to have it remain in the pocket dimension and add a physical building that acts as a portal to it. With the aid of pocket dimensions, the property can manifest in multiple worlds at once. Otherwise, it is transported to the new location, and space returns to its natural state.

objects.title: MCV (Red Alert)
objects.text:
«Where do you want setup?“

Your Property OoP will undergo a comprehensive upgrade, similar to that of the Mobile Construction Vehicle (MCV). This innovation will enable it to transform into a modular vehicle which, after being moved, will be able to return to its original state whilst retaining all its functional capabilities.

The dimensions of the MCV will depend directly on the dimensions of your Property OoP. However, when folded, it will always be considerably more compact, as all its components and structures will be optimised to minimise the space it occupies. It is important to note that, due to this compactness, the MCV will not be able to transport large volumes of resources from your Property OoP’s warehouses and storage facilities.

In its basic configuration, the MCV will be capable of travelling both on land and on water. It will not be equipped with weapons (even if your Property OoP originally had such systems), but will retain its defensive capabilities. If your Property OoP is too large, you may wish to consider using several MCVs, which will be combined into a single structure, much like a modular construction kit.

This approach is particularly effective for technological facilities, such as buildings, building complexes or industrial facilities. However, applying it to other types of facilities may present difficulties.

This does not make your Property OoP as convenient as Vehicle OoP; every movement procedure is a complex and time-consuming operation, during which your OoP will be unable to perform most of its original functions and capabilities.

addons.title: A Nomad's Dream
addons.text:
You can improve the mobile mode of your MCV by installing the “Oversize Model and Militarism. Happiness. Fucking Great” mods, which will be applied to the MCV as a Vehicle OoP. 

These upgrades will not increase your Property OoP in stationary mode, but will allow you to transport more passengers, supplies and resources, which are stored in warehouses and storage facilities.

The “Militarism. Happiness. Fucking Great” modification will allow your MCV to use weapons that remain in stationary mode in the form of permanent turrets and firing points.

addons.title: New Opportunities. New Ways.
addons.text:
The MCV’s mobility will be enhanced in terms of movement and long-distance travel. This enhancement will depend either on the conditions of your current world or on your abilities related to Technology and Artifice Powers.

For example, in a space setting, your MCV will become a spaceship – albeit a slow and unwieldy one – but capable of interstellar flight. As an example of working with Technology and Artifice Powers: if you have the Koprulu Sector Database (StarCraft), you will be able to teleport your MCV, just as the Protoss teleport their bases. All of the MCV’s previous capabilities will remain intact.

objects.text: Instead of a comparatively small 45 km long space station, you now have access to the planet-sized Greater Ark. This massive structure resembles a colossal spoked wheel, complete with six curved arms extending from its core. It stands as one of the crowning achievements of Forerunner civilization, serving as a safe haven from the strategic pulse of the Halo Array while also functioning as a construction yard for those legendary weapons. This colossal structure is manned and maintained by a series of loyal AI that are not susceptible to rampancy. The station normally has no organic inhabitants, however if you should desire it can be populated with several billion loyal members of any race or species you have purchased, Their population is completely loyal to you and will see you as their ruler. They are capable of self governing as well and will do so should you wish, or they can do some mixture of administration duties for you, and will alter it as you wish. This population can be made up of any races shown in the Halo Universe, such as the Humans, Forerunners, Huragok, Sangheili, Unggoy, Jiralhanae, San’Shyuum and more. It can also be made up of any species, races, or other physical forms you’ve bought in the CYOA. You can also choose to fill it with races/species from the world you’ll be entering, or from settings you have bought powers from as long as the races/species don’t exceed your own abilities. If you were to buy an option that somehow grants companions, followers, locations and/or territories of some sort, you can merge them with this allowing you to extend each other’s benefits to one another without overtaking the other. Traditionally, the Greater Ark is located beyond the galactic rim; however, you have the option to position it in a relatively closer location within galactic space if you so choose. The surface of the Ark features a variety of carefully maintained environments, including oceans, forests, ice caps, and deserts. It possesses a breathable atmosphere, and with the aid of advanced technology, it allows all species to thrive within its bounds. The Ark serves three primary purposes. First, it acts as a remote activation point for the Halo Array to which it is linked, well beyond the Array’s operational range. Second, it functions as a fully automated construction facility capable of producing new Halo installations or their replacements, which do not require the super-weapon capabilities of the originals. Finally, it serves as a genetic library, intended to reseed the galaxy with life in the event that the Halo Array is used for its intended purpose. At the core of the Greater Ark lies the Foundry, which is designed to construct Halo installations ranging from the diminutive 10,000 km size to the colossal 30,000 km size, utilizing resources from the material-rich planetoid contained within its core. While this core planetoid will need to be replaced over time, possessing Negentropy or Shardless will imbue it with the ability to provide infinite resources. Additionally, the station maintains numerous smaller foundries suited for producing lesser space stations like the Citadel or Mass Relays, as well as ships of various designs and sizes. Lastly, the Greater Ark is capable of generating Slip-Space portals large enough to transport mega-structures, such as a Halo Installation, to their final destinations.
objects.title: The Greater Ark (Halo)

addons.text: "There is but one city in the Imperial Province, but one city in Tamriel, but one city in the World; that, my brothers, is the city of the Cyrodiils." You have been given the Imperial City, also known as Cyrodiil City, as well as the isle it is located on and the surrounding minor isles. The institutions of the city, such as the Elder Council, the Imperial Cult, the Blades (or Penitus Oculatus if you so prefer), and the Imperial Legion act as well oiled machines. The city houses many guilds: the Mages Guild Housed in the Arcane University is one such institution, the Fighter's Guild is another such institution, and there are many other more mundane guilds dedicated to the more mercantile goings on of a city. The city is also home to the Thieves Guild and the Dark Brotherhood are also located within the city. The city is home to around a million inhabitants, Men, Mer, and Beastfolk alike, of all races and creeds. But they are all unified in one thing: their loyalty to you as their Emperor. The guilds would be more than willing to do things for you at a reduced rate, or for free in some cases, even the Thieves guild will hesitate on stealing items from you, and the Dark Brotherhood will outright refuse to take contracts against you or your immediate family. You also receive the badge of office of the Emperor: the Amulet of Kings, an Artifact created by the Dragon-God Akatosh that was given to the Slave-Queen Alessia. It consists of a large red soul gem diamond, named the Chim-el Adabal, held in a golden clasp surrounded by eight smaller gems that represented the then Eight Divines. The Amulet's abilities are thus: the previous lighters of the Dragonfires, from Alessia to Reman to Tiber up to and including Martin all form an oversoul that can give you counsel in any matter, and the second ability of the Amulet is to light the previously mentioned Dragonfires, a mystical fire that powered barrier between the material world and other dimensions, requiring your permission to pass through.
addons.title: The Imperial City

addons.text:
Your Personal World has fused with the Imperial City, letting all citizens of it breathe life into your Personal World which has now transformed a small part of it into Cyrodiil proper. All of your citizens will always be loyal to you, even if they venture out of the city into the untamed wilderness of your Personal World. Beware though, with the transformation of your Personal World, Flora and Fauna of the world of Nirn have started springing up but they do not have the same loyalty to you that your citizen have.

While your Imperial City only gets Cyrodiil at the start, with the passage of time and the betterment of your people, more locations from the world of Nirn will start to appear. such as Skyrim or Morrowind, the order of which depends on what you focus on for your people; a magically focused ruler will get Morrowind or The Summerset Isles sooner while a warrior focused ruler will get Skyrim or Hammerfell sooner.

While normally particularly talented people of the Clever Craft would be able to escape your Personal World, The Dragonfire prevents that as long as you do not want to let other visit other worlds without your permission.

Worry not, your Clockwork City isn’t left behind either; now acting like the reverse side of the world, every advancement that your world gets, the Clockwork Dimension gets a Dwemer/Steampunk equivalent.

As a bonus, since the world of Nirn is so linked with Aetherius and Oblivion in Lore, your Personal World now generates its own Magicka and Daedra in the form of an Aetherius & Oblivion equivalent. Worry not for the gods that exist in the proper world of Nirn, while they still exist here, they are powerless and more akin to automatic robots than proper gods, only existing so that you can modify the rules of magicka to your liking. The normal Daedra of Oblivion are also unlike those of the world they are based from, happy to serve mortals but requiring more magicka to summon in comparison.

You should be conscious, however, that changing how a fundamental part of the world works is no easy task even with those lifeless gods at your side, requiring months for just the simplest change but once mastered could let you become akin to a dreamer, someone that understands the dream.
addons.title: The World of Nirn (The Elder Scrolls)

objects.text: Sotha Sil, known as the Clockwork God among other titles, designed a city-state built on the Dwemer philosophy of steam and machinery, creating a self-contained world made of brass and gears. The Clockwork City is a magical and mechanical marvel, crafted by Sotha Sil to perfect what he perceived as the flawed creation of the Aedra. This city is contained within a Celestiodrome—a Clockwork Globe—that, despite its immense complexity, is miniaturized to the size of a Dwemer Storage Cube when viewed from the outside. The Clockwork City is divided into three major areas. The Radius forms the outskirts of the city, while the Brass Fortress serves as the central hub, the Proper City within the Clockwork City. Beneath it lies the Mechanical Fundament, a network of maintenance tunnels that house the Cogitum Centralis, the city's control center, also known as the Throne Aligned. Other parts of the Clockwork City consist of domes and metal tunnels, including the Outer and Inner Flooded Halls, the Halls of Delirium, the Central Gearworks, the Chamber of Sohleh, the Imperfect, and The Halls of Regulation that manage the treatment of the city's breathable air and drinkable water, precisely controlling humidity, temperature, and wind currents. The Mnemonic Planisphere, a building within the city, serves as an extension of Sotha Sil's consciousness where his memories are stored in the form of stars. This "A.I." guides you through the Clockwork City, providing insights, suggesting improvements, and even teaching you advanced Dwemer or Clockwork magic and technology. As you progress, you will unlock more of Sotha Sil’s forgotten blueprints and knowledge. The Halls of Fabrication, an enormous processing facility within the city, refactors materials and iterates designs for the city's machines. At one point, it dismantled Dwemer machinery to repurpose its materials for Sotha Sil's creations and continues to fabricate any and all mass-produced items, constructs, or even structures. By inputting raw materials, you can create anything from simple tools to complex Fabricants. The city is powered by a mechanical replication of the Heart of Lorkhan, which acts as a new source of divinity for the Clockwork City. To prevent the Heart from destroying the city, variants of Kagrenac's Tools were created to control, shape, or even dismantle the Heart if necessary. Sotha Sil went to great lengths to keep the Heart from those who would misuse it, storing it under heavy security in the Chamber of Lorkhan, located deep in the Clockwork City's Cogitum Centralis. Sotha Sil's realm is entirely synthetic and inhospitable to most forms of organic life. Although devoid of sentient beings, the city is populated by various mechanomagical life forms of metallic and organic origin, created to thrive in this artificial environment. Among these life forms are the Fabricants, creatures that are part organic and part inorganic, designed to emulate the form and behavior of their Tamrielic counterparts. These beings are constructed from a blend of grown flesh and metallic grafts, powered by soul gems, and can resemble creatures of the land, air, and sea from Nirn. The Factotums, entirely synthetic constructs that often appear humanoid, perform a wide range of functions, from maintenance and security to acting as bards. While refabricated Dwemer constructs can also be found in the Clockwork City, they are rare.
objects.title: The Incomplete Sotha Sil - Clockwork City (The Elder Scrolls)

objects.text:
Instead of a 'merely' 45 kilometer long space station, you now possess a completely enclosed, habitable Dyson sphere with the radius of approximately one astronomical unit.

This dyson sphere, called Iokath, was constructed by an ancient race, the name of which was long forgotten. This race was composed mostly of scientists and engineers, whose primary research was focused on creating weapons of mass destruction.

While not a weapon of destruction by itself, its outer surface is all but impenetrable, with innumerable defense installations making sure that there are almost no known forces in the universe that can threaten this technological marvel. The interior surface of the sphere houses various biomes that serve different needs, from living habitats to research facilities, and the whole structure could be altered and expanded as needed.

This entire enclosed ecosystem is completely self-sufficient, relying on the star around which it is built for energy and matter, with countless construction and repair droids working tirelessly on repairing any sustained damage, maintaining all the machinery inside, as well as constructing new sections of the sphere if the need arises.

But the most valuable thing inside the Iokath is knowledge. The entire sphere doubles as an immense information storage and processing unit, with every bit of scientific data acquired by the builders of Iokath, as well as every schematic to their every superweapon stored safely inside, ready to be accessed by you. This dyson sphere has countless production facilities that are capable of producing any technology schematics for which are stored in the Iokath, from the imposing warships of the Eternal Fleet, piloted by a hivemind of the most sophisticated droid captains, to godlike wardroids capable of wiping out all life on entire planets on their own.

Additionally, Iokath will now contain the entire technological knowledge required to construct and operate both stations like the Citadel, as well as Mass Relays, with every technology power or technological object of power expanding the database of the Iokath. In case of the former, the entire database will be stored inside the sphere, and in case of the latter, the Iokath will gain comprehensive schematics and related scientific knowledge to reproduce and understand the workings of the object. 

Incredibly advanced simulation computers as well as molecular forges and construction droids will help you easily integrate any technology you come across or prototype new ones based on the information Iokath possesses, for example designing new ship engines on the mass effect, with the speed and range of the mass relay, or making intergalactic mass-driver weapons as defence emplacements on the outer shell of the sphere.

Now, in addition to any mass effect race, you can choose to have a population comprised, in part or fully, of any species native to the Star Wars universe, even the enigmatic creators of Iokath themselves. You can also choose to fill it with races/species from the world you’ll be entering, or from settings you have bought powers from as long as the races/species don’t exceed your own abilities. At the start, the population is now capped at one quintillion, but this limit can be expanded without much effort by constructing additional living habitats.

Lastly, the star around which Iokath is built now has a negentropic property; thus, it could be used endlessly for matter and energy without the fear of it ever going supernova or imploding into a black hole, sustaining Iokath indefinitely.
objects.title: Iokath (Star Wars)

objects.text:
The Second Death Star was the ultimate weapon and symbol of the Empire's might. A massive space station and superweapon, the Second Death Star measured 200 kilometers in diameter, making it significantly larger than its predecessor. Unlike the second Death Star, which was incomplete when destroyed, this iteration is fully operational. Its design features a colossal central trench surrounded by an array of weaponry, shield generators, and docking bays, making it an indomitable force in the galaxy.

Armed with a Superlaser more powerful and controllable than its predecessor, the Second Death Star is capable of destroying entire planets with ease. Unlike the first Death Star, which required extended charging time between firings, this version has improved power regulation, allowing for faster consecutive shots at full strength or even more rapid controlled bursts for strategic anti-capital ship strikes. Its defenses include numerous turbolaser and ion cannon batteries, ensuring it is well-protected against enemy attacks.

Beyond its destructive capabilities, the Second Death Star serves as a mobile base for the Empire’s fleet, allowing it to carry out both planetary invasion and planet wide destruction. Although it was destroyed during the Battle of Endor, the Death Star’s legacy as one of the most formidable weapons in galactic history endures.
objects.title: Death Star II (Star Wars)

objects.text:
Your Droid Factory has received an upgrade, and it now not only has production facilities for the various battle droids implemented by the Confederacy of Independent Systems, but it also has access to the various spaceships that the Confederacy of Independent Systems implemented during the war with the Republic. 

This includes but is not limited to the various capital ships and starfighters of the Confederacy of Independent Systems,  Lucrehulk-class Battleships, Munificent-class star frigates,  Subjugator-class heavy cruisers, and many other spaceships that the Confederacy of Independent Systems was capable of fielding, including several prototype superweapons that never got finished.

The Shipyard can produce anywhere from 5-10 ships a month, depending on how many materials you have at hand to put into production. The facility comes with enough supplies to produce spaceships for a year before needing a resupply. The shipyard also has several Vulture and Hyena fighters ready for orbital defence if needed.
objects.title: Confederacy of Independent Systems Shipyard (Star Wars)

addons.text:
Your Demiplane has become something truly unique—an impossibility made real. What should only be achievable by Nature Spirits or True Ancestors has been defied, as you have accomplished the extraordinary feat of manifesting a Marble Phantasm. 

Unlike a Reality Marble, which is foreign and subject to erosion by the world's will, your Demiplane is a natural phenomenon. When manifested, it not only endures but also grants you unparalleled control, allowing you to summon vast armies, wield devastating weapons, or even unleash orbital bombardments. More than that, it imposes the fundamental laws of your domain upon the surroundings, reshaping reality itself to fit your desires.

Everything that occurs within this manifested space affects only the outside world, leaving your Demiplane untouched. You can choose which aspects of your realm to bring forth—whether it be the cataclysmic impact of a crashing moon, a relentless meteor shower, a barrage of cannon fire, or the crushing abyss of the ocean depths. If your Demiplane contains subdimensions, you can manifest them as well, extending your influence even further. 

Because your Demiplane exists as a Marble Phantasm, it strengthens your connection to it, allowing you to erode supernatural and paranormal forces upon manifestation. Even divine beings from not connected to your demiplane will find their power diminished within your domain.

Beyond merely summoning portions of your world, you can design entirely separate dimensions to act as the manifested space—a prison realm, an endless hunting ground, a nightmarish hellscape. You have the power to define new laws, forge unique effects, create never-before-seen creatures and weapons, and even store spells within this realm, ensuring it is always battle-ready upon manifestation.

When the Marble Phantasm is activated, all who reside within your Demiplane remain unharmed. Instead of altering the original space, it creates a copied projection, one still tethered to the source. This allows soldiers and resources to be stored and deployed instantly, ready at a moment’s notice.

Unlike a Reality Marble, which the world resists, your Marble Phantasm is a natural extension of existence itself. Unless you provoke the world's wrath, there are no limits—you may manifest it whenever and for as long as you wish.

Note if you have a throne world or something similar the two will not cancel each other, they will just merge into something truly unique.
addons.title: Marble Phantasm: A World Manifested

addons.text:
Planting Irminsul within your Demiplane has fundamentally transformed it, bringing a cascade of effects. The first and most immediate change is that all benefits provided by Irminsul now extend to the Demiplane. Due to the Demiplane's nature and its connection to multiple worlds, which you can designate as home worlds, Irminsul’s influence will spread to any world linked in this way.

As Irminsul takes root, it will extend throughout your entire Demiplane, weaving leylines until it reaches the boundaries. Once it has grown to a sufficient size, it will shift into a subdimension beneath the Demiplane, ensuring its protection. 

These leylines will channel energy across your domain, facilitating the sharing of powers, techniques, and knowledge, fostering an environment of innovation and boundless creativity. When connected to designated home worlds, Irminsul will slowly extend its reach into them, absorbing memory, energy, and information. 

This feedback loop will accelerate the growth of both Irminsul and your Demiplane, expanding their size and benefits. If it encounters worlds with unique energy systems, their energies will merge with your domain, giving rise to new powers. The same principle applies to any energy systems or abilities you possess. 

Irminsul will also spread any knowledge or memories from assimilated worlds to your demiplane, granting access to all the citizens, you can also restrict this knowledge to different levels of access.

As the one connected to both the Demiplane and Irminsul, you hold the authority to regulate the flow of leylines and energy, adjusting their intensity and even creating nexus points of various sizes.  Due to this connection you can draw energy and power from all the leylines of your Demiplane, and even from Irminsul itself allowing you to reach greater levels of power for a short time.  Enough to Challenge Cosmic Forces for a short while. 

Over time, Irminsul will evolve further, tapping into subdimensions brimming with energy, allowing for limitless growth and expansion. Eventually, this new tree will reach a point where it becomes a self-sustaining cosmos, akin to the original Yggdrasil. Any world assimilated by Irminsul will become part of your cosmos, existing as separate realms much like the multiple dimensions of Yggdrasil. In this way, the New Yggdrasil will mirror and eventually surpass its predecessor.

However, certain energies remain anathema to Irminsul. Harmful and forbidden forces—such as eldritch or corruptive influences—pose a direct threat. If such forces infiltrate an assimilated world, they can bypass your Demiplane’s natural barriers, leading to corruptive effects. Additionally, any power or object that interacts with Irminsul will now also influence this emerging Yggdrasil.  It is possible to resist or puriy the corruptive energies in certain ways.  If you are naturally resistant to corruptive influences then irminsul will also be resistant but not immune. 

No longer is it merely Irminsul—it has become something greater. A new tree, one with the potential to rival and ultimately surpass Yggdrasil itself.  No longer is your demiplane a small world, or even a false world, it has been elevated into a True and Self Sustaining World.
addons.title: A New World Tree

addons.text:
Your ability to devour or absorb the essence of those you defeat has transformed your Demiplane into a unique world, combining aspects of a Marble Phantasm and a Reality Marble, granting you something akin to a Throne World, but much larger and more powerful. This Ascendant World reflects your desires, personality, and abilities, potentially unlocking a unique power based on its concept. It mirrors the domains of powerful beings like The Endless, Mara Sov, Oryx, and the Millennium Castle of Brunestud.

The Ascendant World consists of multiple layers. The original Demiplane remains a sanctuary, protected by a misty barrier. Surrounding it are the Outer Spaces, subdimensions that act as defensive zones, forcing intruders to navigate through them before reaching the core of your world.

You have complete control over these Outer Spaces, which you can shape into paradises, deserts, war zones, or voids devoid of reality. The laws of these spaces affect everything within them, and the influence of your Throne World ensures that anyone who enters must obey these rules.  You can freely edit the effects and laws of the outer spaces, changing them as often as you want.

At the heart of your world lies your Throne World or Sanctuary, a separate but equally vast counterpart to your original Demiplane. Its entrance, located at the center of the main plane, is guarded by forces of your choosing. Inside this sanctuary, your authority is absolute. You can alter landscapes, change the laws of physics, summon forces, or weaponize the terrain itself. The laws governing this place extend across all layers, allowing you to control and project parts of your world into the outside world like a reality marble or marble phantasm.

As the ruler, you cannot be overthrown. You can allow certain individuals to enter directly into any layer without needing to pass through the others. Intruders will be sent to the Outer Spaces, while those you trust can enter the Throne World or the main plane. You can also create new life to populate any of the layers.

If you possess D.A.G. or Sword Logic, any being defeated or devoured within the layers becomes yours, adding their skills, memories, and attributes to your own.

While you can be defeated in the outside world, true death can only occur within your Throne World. Enemies must pass through the Outer Spaces, breach the Demiplane, and enter your Sanctuary to destroy you. However, exceptionally powerful beings may bypass some defenses. If you possess Eternal Flame, you cannot die within your Throne World and can return to the outside world regardless of the circumstances.
addons.title: Ascendant World Made Real

addons.text:
Displacement Containers allow you to transport entire worlds, nations, kingdoms, and cities to new locations. For example, you could relocate all seven nations of Teyvat. Originally, there was no true domain under your control where you could place them. Instead, you had to deposit the containers and their contents in random locations, hoping for the best. Now, your Demiplane serves as a proper home for everything retrieved using Displacement Containers. As long as there is sufficient space, you can seamlessly transfer the contents into the Demiplane.

Anything or anyone placed within the Demiplane through this method becomes naturally loyal to you. Once settled, they cannot be removed; they are there permanently. Despite initial challenges in adapting, they will naturally integrate into the culture and community already present. Over time, they will blend in, and any inherent powers accessible to the original inhabitants will also be available to the newcomers.

If you have sealed something evil, demonic, or eldritch inside a Displacement Container, you can choose to feed it to the Demiplane. Doing so strengthens the Demiplane, expanding its boundaries, enriching its vitality, and unlocking new powers. Whatever is consumed by the Demiplane is erased entirely, ensuring its absolute destruction—even gods can be sealed and devoured in this way.

This feature provides a true sanctuary for those without a home—refugees, survivors of destroyed worlds, and the lost. In their gratitude, they will see you as their savior
addons.title: A True Home for Displacement

addons.text:
Your demiplane and sanctuary have fully merged into a unified dimension—an autonomous realm entirely under your dominion. Like the feywilds, the endless realms, or the dominions of hive gods, this new world serves as your domain, a realm located outside of existence itself. Comparable to DC’s Fourth World, where the New Gods reside, your true form now lies beyond the bounds of normal reality, accessible only through rare means.

This dimension is now a natural yet sovereign part of existence, fortified with intrinsic defenses and governed by mutable laws shaped solely by your will. It supports its own afterlife for your followers and fosters a unique civilization with its own evolving culture. You are the central force of this world—the Heart of your own multiverse. Anyone born or residing within it can carry their powers into the outside world. Over time, the realm continues to expand, welcoming more inhabitants.   

At its core resides your True Self, the origin point of your divine presence. From here, you manifest avatars to engage with other realms. The dimension operates as a feedback loop: the more belief and worship you receive, the stronger your legend becomes. As your mythos grows, so too does your realm—enhancing both your power and the domain itself.

For Nascent Eldritch beings, the realm becomes anathema to outsiders. Unauthorized entrants are subject to your rules and are entirely stripped of their powers. However, you can grant immunity to those you choose. You can also summon your divine realm directly from your shadow, overtaking the surrounding world and imposing your laws upon it.

This realm is inextricably tied to your essence, granting you unbroken access to your domains and powers regardless of location—even across multiverses or beyond the Omniverse. Through the Theurgy System you’ve established, power flows to your followers proportionate to their offerings—be it prayer, sacrifice, or other acts of devotion. Worship fuels your realm across all worlds where your faith is practiced, continuously amplifying your divine presence. If you are an Eldritch being, worship is not essential to your existence, yet it remains a formidable source of power should you choose to draw from it.

You possess absolute authority over this realm. You may summon it whole or in part like a marble phantasm, layer it atop the outside world like a reality marble, or divide the realm itself into tiers or sub-realities. Its laws and appearance are entirely yours to define. You can turn the realm into a galaxy of planets, or perhaps into something like Yggdrasil and its nine worlds, the shape and structure, its laws and effects, everything about this world is yours to control and shape. This dimension exists both within and beyond conventional reality—a natural, yet unnatural realm. Here, divine or eldritch power reigns supreme, shaped by your nature. It is incorruptible, untouchable by outside forces. All objects and powers that enter it serve only to strengthen its essence.

If you decide to create more gods whether they be regular divine beings or eldritch gods, you will be the king of a new pantheon, with the new gods being fully loyal to you, allowing them to take their own parts of this realm for themselves.
addons.title: True Divine Realm

addons.text:
Your True Form in your Divine Realm rivals that of Darkseid or Izaya—not just their fragments, but their full, divine essence. Your avatars are as strong as either the avatars of Darkseid or Izaya, capable of saving or damning a universe. Your reach can extend throughout the entire multiverse, and your mere presence could destroy universes.

The Omega Effect, Alpha Effect, and the twin cosmic equations—the Anti-Life and Life Equations—are elevated beyond comprehension in your hands. Your Omega Effect is potent enough to annihilate the entire Quintessence, the group of the most powerful beings in the DC Universe. With the Alpha Effect, you can empower normal mortals to confront and even defeat an avatar of Darkseid. Through the Anti-Life Equation, you could bend the will of the entire multiverse to your command. And with the Life Equation, you possess the power to restore all of creation, even if it were utterly obliterated.

The most profound transformation comes from your mastery of the Source itself. By fully wielding both the Anti-Life and Life Equations in addition to your access to the Source, you can channel the full, unbridled power of the primordial Force of Creation for a brief moment. With time, discipline, and deep contemplation, you can gradually extend this connection until you can command the limitless essence of the Source without restriction.

You have become something greater. A force of nature that bends creation and destruction, who embodies both good and evil. And when you fully master the Source, there will be no higher truth, no greater force—only you.
addons.title: Godhead

addons.text:
Your Demiplane evolves into a vast, living Sanctuary where nature exists in perfect balance. It is no longer empty, but a fully realized world of interconnected ecosystems containing every biome and seasonal state—forests, oceans, deserts, tundras, mountains, and more—each transitioning seamlessly. All elements and their sub-elements are present as stable, self-sustaining systems integrated into the environment rather than isolated forces.

At its center lies a perfect convergence of all biomes, elements, and seasons in complete harmony. This core serves as your home and throne, a stable nexus where opposing forces coexist without imbalance. Your authority here is absolute. Nothing may enter this central domain without your permission, and any who attempt to do so are redirected to the outermost layers.

The Sanctuary is populated by natural and supernatural life tied to nature. Plants, animals, spirits, and elemental beings exist as a unified ecosystem, recognizing you instinctively and acting in alignment with your presence. They are not bound servants, but extensions of the Sanctuary’s natural order, maintaining balance without hostility toward you.

All natural and nature-aligned resources are produced in effectively limitless supply, sustained by perfectly balanced systems. Mana, life force, and elemental energy flow endlessly without depletion. This creates an ideal environment for recovery and growth, accelerating healing and allowing safe training under any natural condition.

The Sanctuary acts as a living extension of your power, amplifying your abilities, stabilizing large-scale effects, and allowing you to channel its energy and environments as though they were part of yourself.

You may project portions of the Sanctuary into reality, causing environments to align with it. Forests may spread, oceans surge, storms form, and terrain shift as its influence manifests outward, temporarily transforming the battlefield in your favor.

In battle, the Sanctuary serves as both weapon and domain. You may reshape battlefields, summon entire ecosystems, and attack from multiple directions through natural gateways. Opponents may be drawn into the Sanctuary or forced to fight at its edges, where terrain, life, and elemental systems act in coordination under your will. Within the Sanctuary, your power is greatly amplified.

The center of the Sanctuary may be anchored to any location or domain you control, aligning it with a physical or conceptual core such as a base, territory, or mobile construct. Anchored locations act as stable extensions of your domain, allowing you to operate from them while maintaining full connection to the Sanctuary.

Worlds connected to your Sanctuary benefit from its influence, gradually stabilizing ecosystems, restoring balance, and allowing nature to flourish in healthier, more resilient forms.

The Sanctuary grows alongside you. As your power and influence expand, so too does its size, complexity, and reach, incorporating new biomes, lifeforms, and connections to other worlds. It remains a stable, self-sustaining domain that reflects your role as Nature’s Incarnate.
addons.title: Primordial Sanctuary

addons.text:
Your Reality Marble, Demiplane, and monster creations have fused into the Hyakki Yagyō: a supernatural world intrinsically bound to your existence, power, and creations. It exists as a persistent parallel world alongside reality, evolving with you across all worlds and dimensions.

The Hyakki Yagyō contains oceans, mountains, forests, graveyards, ruins, cities, shrines, roads, rivers, districts, spirit realms, wandering processions, and civilizations inhabited by your creations. Endless lantern-lit streets, abandoned stations, hidden villages, marketplaces, temples, and sealed regions form within it over time. The world is shaped by your nature, power, creations, and the Parade itself.

All creatures created through Originator of Monsters instinctively belong to the Hyakki Yagyō. Rather than existing as isolated summons or temporary creations, they become permanent inhabitants of the Parade, forming territories, factions, hierarchies, settlements, and supernatural communities. Powerful entities may rule districts while weaker entities gather into packs or wandering processions. Your creations continuously evolve and adapt to the environments of the Parade over time.

As the owner of the Hyakki Yagyō, you possess complete awareness and authority over the realm and everything within it. You may freely reshape terrain, alter environments, establish laws, construct structures, create or remove districts, designate rulers, seal regions, or reorganize entire sections of the world. No being may usurp your ownership or sever your connection to the realm.

The Hyakki Yagyō exists as a supernatural layer parallel to reality and may partially overlap with the physical world. Roads may appear where none existed, fog may spread across districts, shrines may emerge temporarily, and supernatural phenomena tied to the Parade may manifest directly into reality. You may selectively overlay districts, environments, structures, or inhabitants onto reality while leaving the remainder of the Parade separate.

The Parade connects to reality through corresponding landmarks and liminal spaces. Roads connect to roads, shrines connect to shrines, torii connect to torii, rivers connect to rivers, and graveyards connect to graveyards. By entering these connected locations, you and your creations may travel between reality and the Parade or move between connected locations through its internal pathways. You may establish permanent anchors within reality to strengthen these connections.

You may freely summon inhabitants of the Hyakki Yagyō into reality. These entities are not projections or constructs, but true residents physically crossing over from the Parade into the outside world. Lesser entities may manifest freely, while stronger rulers or massive beings require greater overlap or stabilized landmarks to fully emerge. You may also release your creations into reality either temporarily or permanently.

Anything stored within the Hyakki Yagyō physically exists somewhere inside the world itself. Creatures, artifacts, cursed objects, structures, entities, resources, and supernatural phenomena may all be contained within the Parade through districts, vaults, shrines, ruins, archives, prisons, or regions.

If you possess Lord of Fear, fear, rumors, nightmares, belief, and supernatural stories strengthen both the Hyakki Yagyō and its inhabitants.

If you possess Originator of Legends, urban legends, paranormal phenomena, cursed locations, and conceptual horrors may naturally emerge within the Parade over time, while monsters residing within it may gradually evolve into true Legends through accumulated fear, mythology, and supernatural influence.
addons.title: Hyakki Yagyō

objects.text:
Your plot of land has been transformed into a fully self-sustaining demiplane—a secluded world detached from all existence. Though small, it remains a complete and independent realm. This demiplane is a flat world, enclosed by an impenetrable barrier of mist that prevents any and all beings from entering unless you explicitly grant them access. While most demiplanes start as empty voids, yours is a breathtaking utopia, featuring crystal-clear oceans, pollution-free air, and a vast night sky illuminated by countless stars. The weather cycle is fully under your control, and the landscape, filled with lush fields, towering mountains, and deep valleys, can be reshaped at will.  Everything in this world is controlled by your thoughts and will.

Currently, your demiplane is the size of Germany, but it has the potential to expand. As you travel, experience new things, and channel your energy into the land, its boundaries will grow, doubling in size over time.

You hold absolute authority over the laws governing your demiplane. Any being that enters is subject to its rules, which you can modify at will. However, changes take effect after 24 hours, and all residents are notified beforehand. The mist barrier serves as both protection and concealment, ensuring that your realm remains hidden from those who are uninvited. If you choose, you can establish doors or gateways, allowing authorized individuals to enter or even just those seeking refuge. The barrier also occasionally draws in the forsaken, abandoned, or lost, guiding them into your domain through spontaneous openings in the mist.  Only those stronger than you, or cosmic beings, can even hope to find your demiplane and enter. 

Your connection to the demiplane is constant, regardless of your location. Even if you find yourself in another world, you can always return. Additionally, your demiplane can link itself to any world you have previously visited or marked with a beacon, allowing seamless travel. This ability extends to all residents, granting them the freedom to move between worlds while maintaining their bond with the demiplane. Moreover, the realm possesses a natural ability to pull in those lost in the fog, granting them sanctuary.

As the rightful owner, your control over the demiplane is absolute. Every aspect—weather, day and night cycles, seasons, laws, landscapes, and structures—bends to your will. You can enhance the land’s fertility, ensure abundant and nourishing food, and shape civilization itself. There are no limits to what you can create or alter. Additionally, your rule is unquestionable; no one can usurp or challenge you. You possess an innate awareness of everything within your domain, allowing you to sense disturbances or threats the moment they arise.  You could even mix and match different building styles and cultures together to form something new. This includes, for example, the Nation of Fontaine if your plot of land was Fontaine, along with something of your own design, creating something truly unique.

You cannot grant ownership or change ownership of the demiplane to anyone else. However, you can grant ownership to sub-dimensions and even plots of land, allowing for individual kingdoms; either way, you still retain full control and ownership while those granted ownership become secondary owners.

Everything that once influenced your original plot of land now applies to the demiplane. You have the power to claim new locations and integrate them into your expanding realm, extending your dominion and shaping it to your vision. Your demiplane is more than just a refuge—it is a world of boundless potential, forged entirely by your will.
objects.title: The Demiplane

objects.text:
You have gained the power to claim additional Plots of Land—whether adjacent to your current territory or entirely separate, even across different worlds. No matter how distant, each new acquisition grants you a separate Plot, with a maximum size equal to that of Germany or smaller, depending on your preference. These Plots may remain distinct or be fused into a single, larger domain at your discretion. You could make some Land and its civilization be focused on magic, one focused on technology, really the choices are yours.  

All powers and items that influence your land—whether directly or indirectly—extend their effects to your additional Plots as well. Through your bond with these lands, you can teleport freely between any of them, including any location within their bounds. Trusted individuals may also be granted access to this teleportation network, allowing seamless travel between Plots—even across worlds or dimensions.

If you possess abilities like Dimensional Farms or Dimensional Dominion, you may house your additional Plots within pocket dimensions, expanding your domain into vast, self-contained realms. Likewise, if you hold dominion over civilization, your influence applies uniformly across all your territories.

Because you can maintain multiple Plots, you have the flexibility to diversify their purposes. One may remain a conventional territory; another could become your personal planet; a third might evolve into a Demiplane. If you create a Demiplane, it becomes subtly linked to your other Plots, enabling shared infrastructure, rapid troop transport, and other cross-territorial abilities.  This allows you to have a Plot of Land, a Planet, and a Demiplane all at the same time.
objects.title: Additional Plots

objects.text:
Your territory expands far beyond its original borders, transforming from a single nation-sized domain into a full continent. The maximum size of your land now matches that of a true continental mass, large enough to hold countless cultures, regions, and environments without ever exceeding the scope of a full continent. Whether it manifests as one continuous landmass, a fractured plate of islands and archipelagos, or a sweeping stretch of diverse terrain, the shape and structure of your continent are fully yours to define.

Just like before, your land grows alongside its people. As your population increases and your civilization advances, your continent subtly expands, gaining new regions and landscapes. This growth feels natural within the world, unfolding in ways that reflect the progress of your society without disrupting the world around it. Your continent can appear in any world you choose, whether it is your birthplace or a world you have discovered and claimed as home. If that world hides the supernatural, you may choose whether your continent remains concealed or embraces all beings openly.

Your entire continent can still be transported in the form of a marble-sized sphere. When you decide where it will take form, the sphere dissolves and the full landmass emerges completely shaped. Oceans, mountains, forests, cities, and coastlines are all in place, ready to be settled and ruled. As with your earlier land, the continent is fully self-sufficient, abundant in resources, fertile soil, and stable climates.

Once established, history shifts to weave your continent into the world’s past. It becomes a recognized and accepted part of the planet’s geography and story, with a place in maps, records, and myths. Your continent adapts to the world’s changing eras, yet always remains firmly under your control. Should natural disasters strike the surrounding world—storms, droughts, quakes, or worse—your territory stays untouched. Even as the outside environment shifts, your continent endures as a stable, protected, and thriving realm.

Your Continent is everything your Plot of Land was—only greater, broader, richer, and vast enough to shape the future of any world it touches.

Note: You can populate your Continent with species and characters from settings or powers you have chosen. All addons, upgrades, and features for Plot of Land affects Continent. You can also merge any of your additional plots, or any of the various upgrades into your Continent, so you can have it all in one location and merged Seamlessly.
objects.title: Continent

addons.text:
You’ve gained the ability to store your planet inside your Inventory or in a special object known as a Displacement Container . This includes not only the planet itself, but also its sun, moon, structures, and all life upon it. Everything enters a state of living stasis—time continues normally for those on the planet, allowing them to move, breathe, and go about their lives as if nothing has changed. You can summon individuals from the planet at will or unpack the entire world whenever you choose.

If stored in your Inventory, the Planet, and all things connected to it is pulled into dedicated slots equipped with a management and communication interface. This lets you monitor and even speak with those inside, if you wish. If you use a Displacement Container instead, you can store multiple planets or stellar objects within a single container, or house a very large one with ease. While it is stored inside, the container itself becomes indestructible.

When unpacked, the planet can appear in one of two places: either nearby, within your immediate vicinity, or in a distant, uninhabited region of space—undiscovered, vast, and perfectly suited for your planet and its celestial companions. Wherever it's placed, the system integrates seamlessly with the local stellar structure, avoiding disruption to orbits or cosmic balance. You can teleport freely to and from this location.

If you possess the ability Planetary Annexation, this power extends further. Any world, land, or domain you've claimed can also be packed into your Inventory. This enables you to transport entire planets, solar systems, galaxies—even constellations—at will. Should the scenery grow stale, you can rearrange your cosmic holdings with the ease of a god.
addons.title: Pack it Up!

addons.text:
Your deep understanding—and eventual mastery—of the Laws and Concepts that shape existence has begun to resonate with your Planet. Once you’ve studied a specific Law or Concept to at least 50–75% proficiency, it can become a permanent feature of your world. Elemental Laws—such as those governing fire, water, air, and earth—as well as the cycles of the seasons, already exist as natural components. So too do minor aspects of Life, Death, and Time.

More complex or supernatural Laws, like those related to Magic, Ki, Chakra, or Aura, can be integrated into your world once sufficiently understood. These energies then permeate your entire Planet, becoming part of its fundamental makeup. This applies not only to worlds you create but also to those you annex through Planetary Claim.

If you possess the power to bestow godhood, you can refine and solidify these Laws into Domains—such as Thunder or Magic—granting deities full authority over them within your planetary sphere.

The Laws you choose to incorporate will shape the evolution of civilizations. A world infused with the Law of Magic may prioritize sorcery over science, while one centered on technological principles may progress rapidly in innovation. Blend both, and your civilization may transcend conventional limits. Should you attain mastery over the Concept of Void or Null, you can enforce your planetary laws upon any outsider, weakening or neutralizing threats entirely.

Some Laws carry deeper implications. The Laws of Punishment and Frost, for instance, could be used to forge constructs similar to the Nails of Punishment from Teyvat—relics of control and divine authority.  Any law or Concept can be studied, mastered and applied to your world.  

With the right Laws at the right moment, everything can change. As the owner and ruler of the Planet, you wield complete authority to shape its reality. Unique items, divine powers, sacred beasts, or elemental artifacts—such as Visions, Gnosis, trees, or animals—can all be used to create and anchor new Laws and Concepts. Whether forging new gods or new realities, their potential is yours to command. Minor Laws and Concepts can be upgraded to Major ones, bringing vast and powerful changes to the worlds they are applied to.

You are the Heavenly Principle of your world—a world now inseparable from the fabric of existence itself.
addons.title: Planetary Laws and Concepts

addons.text:
Your planet is no longer an empty utopia or a scattering of settlements. It is now home to a true planetary civilization—one that spans continents, oceans, and skies, unified under your rule.

The population expands naturally from your original village into cities, megacities, and planetary networks, growing into the tens of millions, hundreds of millions, or even billions, as you desire. Settlement density, cultural diversity, architectural styles, and systems of governance are entirely up to you. The world may be unified under a single planetary authority, divided into nations loyal to you, or structured through any social or political framework you deem appropriate.

Every citizen of this civilization receives the same benefits granted by Empowered Village. All of your powers gained through the CYOA are shared with them at ten percent of your current strength, with the potential to grow up to fifty percent of your maximum. As before, you may selectively withhold specific abilities, trading breadth for significantly greater mastery, refinement, and stability among the powers that remain. This empowerment scales cleanly across the entire population without dilution, instability, or loss of control.

Any inherent qualities you possess—whether derived from your race, biology, metaphysical nature, powers, technologies, energy systems, or other defining properties—are reflected throughout your civilization. If you wield Chakra, Ki, Reiryoku, Haki, mana, psionics, divine power, or any comparable system, then your civilization is likewise capable of accessing, cultivating, and integrating that same energy framework. These systems become foundational to culture, training, industry, warfare, and daily life, shaped according to your intent and limitations.

Species and racial traits follow the same rules as your village. If your people share your race or form, they possess those traits at either half of your strength or the full baseline of the species, whichever is greater. You may also choose to populate your planet with additional races or species drawn from the setting you are entering or from any worlds, settings, or sources tied to powers you have acquired. These species may coexist freely within your civilization, forming unified societies or distinct cultures as you wish. However, no race or species introduced may inherently exceed your own abilities, potential, or existential standing. You remain the absolute apex around which the civilization is structured.

The civilization’s level of technological, magical, or hybrid development is chosen by you. It may range from ancient or medieval societies to modern industrial worlds or advanced post-scarcity civilizations. If you possess any Technology and Artifice powers, the entire planet benefits from them, including infrastructure, manufacturing, research, automation, logistics, and large-scale construction. This may naturally extend into orbital industry, planetary defense systems, and spaceflight if desired.

Your planet’s idealized environment ensures that civilization does not scar the world unless you wish it to. Pollution, resource depletion, ecological collapse, and systemic decay are nonissues. Cities, farmlands, arcologies, floating settlements, underground realms, and megastructures coexist seamlessly with the planet’s perfected nature.

This civilization is utterly loyal to you—not through crude mind control, but through deep-rooted cultural, social, and existential alignment. You are their founder, protector, and axis of history. Over generations, myths, traditions, institutions, and identities arise with you at their center.

If you possess Shaper of Civilization, your influence becomes even more direct. You may guide planetary development from a strategic, godlike perspective, shaping terrain, city layouts, population distribution, cultural priorities, and world-scale projects as if managing a living planetary simulation.

Your Planetary Civilization is stable, self-sustaining, and scalable. It will not collapse due to internal strain, ideological fracture, or resource pressure unless you will it to. As you grow in power, so too does the scope, capability, and influence of the world you rule.
addons.title: Planetary Civilization

addons.text:
On a mundane, non-supernatural world with no established ruler, if no one rises to challenge you or assume rulership within a minimum time of 48 hours, the world becomes yours.

Should you choose, you can extend your dominion beyond a single planet—entire solar systems can be brought under your control. When claiming a solar system, your authority encompasses everything down to the last atom.

Whatever you claim—whether a single world, multiple worlds, or an entire solar system—falls completely under your sovereignty. Every creature, citizen, and even the soul of the world itself is bound to your rule. If the claimed world contains additional dimensions, such as a setting like High School DxD, then those dimensions are included as well. Claiming such a complex world will, however, require the use of dimensional powers. There is no limit to the amount of territories you can have active at once, provided each territory is a world or planet.

Given the scale of what can be claimed, all functions of Sovereign Domain and its related upgrades are significantly enhanced. These improvements enable the governance and control of galaxies, should your power grow that far. Challenges to your rule can still occur—whether through battle, competition, or even democratic voting—and the consequences of losing a challenge remain in place.

If your home planet is capable of travel between worlds or dimensions, or even through the omniverse, all claimed territories—planets, solar systems, and dimensions—will travel with it. Alternatively, you may choose to fuse all claimed worlds into your home planet, increasing its size, power, and potential. In this process, the land, structures, inhabitants, wildlife, and even vegetation from the claimed worlds are safely merged into your world, fully preserved. All Benefits, powers, and features that applied or will apply to your Planet in the future will also apply to the claimed worlds.
addons.title: Planetary Annexation

objects.text:
You no longer own just a continent. Instead, your domain has been elevated to that of an entire planet—a true utopia among the mythical Garden Worlds. You may choose between two sizes: one equal to Earth, or a larger Super-Earth, twice its size.

This planet offers perfection in every aspect. Its soil is endlessly fertile, the weather beautiful and balanced, and the skies host their own unique constellations. You may populate it with fauna and creatures from any world of your choosing, even blending in the landscapes of other fictional realms—perhaps the golden fields of a distant fantasy, the flowered meadows of Avalon, or the burnt-orange skies of Gallifrey. Pollution does not exist here. This is nature at its most idealized.

The planet is threaded with abundant and superior Leylines—more potent and numerous than those found on most magical worlds. If you possess access to other energy sources, they too will manifest here seamlessly. The planet is entirely yours. You are its undisputed ruler. Any being who chooses to settle here will, over time, come to serve you with complete loyalty.

Every essential resource is present: from bronze and titanium to rare cosmic metals and ores. Vast, seemingly endless veins lie beneath the surface, waiting to be tapped. The planet is concealed within an uncharted, hidden region of space, accessible only by you. You can travel to and from it at will.

Should you have access to advanced technology trees, the planet will generate all corresponding resources automatically, including specialized fauna, flora, and materials needed for any development. All resources are self-replenishing and effectively infinite. The same applies to any future technologies you acquire.

If you possess Dimensional Farms, this amplifies the effect—granting you truly endless farming capabilities: animal farms, plant farms, tree farms, and countless other resource-generating systems, all self-sustaining and without limit.

And if you wield the power of the Shaper of Civilization, your control expands further. As you once shaped your land, now you can reshape the entire planet. From a godlike, strategic perspective—as if commanding a world-building game—you can edit terrain, place structures, design cities, and mold civilizations across your planetary canvas.

Note it does come with its own Sun and Moon, both of which will never be destroyed or fade with time. Also if you have a Demiplane, then one of the entrances will lie at the very center, deep within the land of your planet. You can even pull the Planet, and its sun and moon into the Demiplane if you desire. Your Planet is naturally tied to your Demiplane if you have one, this may cause some changes in both planet and demiplane. Irminsul and other similar objects or powers will also apply to your Planet just as they apply to Demiplane or other places. 

If you have purchased Additional Plots, then one or more of those plots can be transformed into This Planet. Alternatively you can choose to transform any worlds or land claimed into a Demiplane or into this Planet.
objects.title: Your Very Own Planet

addons.text:
Now your moon transforms into Morrslieb, also known as the Dark Moon, Chaos Moon, and Green Moon. Essentially, it turns into a giant chunk of rich green warpstone filled with sinister warp magic.

Under the light of Morrslieb, your dark magical abilities are enhanced, easier to manipulate, and have more predictable effects. The forces that oppose you, on the other hand, are weakened and may feel the onset of madness.

But most importantly, on the night before New Year's Eve (Witching Night or Hexensnacht) and on the day of the full moon at the end of autumn (Day of Mystery, Floating Holiday, or Geheimnistag, which can be considered Halloween), Morrslieb will reach its full power and become the brightest moon in the sky. The boundary between reality and the warp will become almost imperceptible. For you, this means that on these two nights, you will feel a surge of strength, as if you were on the surface of your moon, and your power will increase a hundredfold.
addons.title: Morrslieb (Warhammer: Fantasy)

addons.text:
Possessing your own moon grants you all of Princess Luna's abilities related to controlling this astronomical object, regardless of which aspect of talent you have chosen.

Now you can control the cycle of your moon, from the ability to organize a full moon every night to summoning solar eclipses at will (unless prevented by serious circumstances).

You can use your moon as a portal to enter dreams or travel to the Dream Realm (as an image, reflection, or moon path). In addition, if someone tries to kill you, you will most likely be accidentally banished to your moon... Even if the blow would have completely destroyed you. However, you will be able to return on the next full moon (even a normal one), without waiting for 1,000 years to pass.
addons.title: Princess Moon

objects.text:
Now you have your own moon—a unique astronomical object that will become part of your world's night sky. It will not replace existing satellites, cause cataclysms, or disrupt the magical balance, if there is one. Just one day, a new moon will appear on the horizon.

It will be comparable in size to Earth's Moon and will have similar natural conditions, but otherwise, you can choose its appearance yourself. This will not be a problem for you, as you will be able to feel as comfortable on it as on a quiet summer day or night.

Your moon will be rich in various natural resources, which will largely depend on your abilities. In addition, it can acquire powerful magical or mystical energy if you have the appropriate capabilities.

The moon will fuel you with strength or inspiration, especially if you have magical abilities. They can increase tenfold when the your moon is shining in the sky. And if you find yourself on its surface, your powers can increase a hundredfold, and the moon itself will become a source of tremendous energy for you.

Your moon will have its own cycle, and its influence will depend on its phase. You will be able to move it across the sky simply by wishing it. One day it may set in one place and rise in another.

With tremendous willpower, you can fix the moon in the sky for as long as you can control it. You can even eclipse other celestial bodies with it, causing eclipses, but this will require incredible effort on your part.
objects.title: Personal Moon
Your Very Own Star System
objects.text:
Your dominion now extends not just to a single planet, but to an entire star system comprising 10 planets of your choice, each with the benefits of ‘Your Very Own Planet’, whilst their moons will enjoy all the benefits of ‘Personal Moon’.

If you find having 10 garden worlds a bit dull, you can choose ‘uninhabited worlds’ with a vast amount of rare resources from the Powers available to you or your current universe.
