A gas giant can also become part of your system, and its moons can be used as Your Very Own Planet and Personal Moon, given their size, comparable to that of Titan or Europa.

In addition to planets and moons, your system will contain asteroids, comets and planetoids, rich in resources and minerals.

All planets, moons and large astronomical objects will be connected by portals situated in convenient locations, facilitating both personal travel and mass transport. Although spaceships will make travel easier, the portals will be through-type, and travelling from one planet to another will require passing through all the intermediate planets.

With your second purchase, you will receive a system comprising four stars orbiting a common centre of mass, each of which will have 10 planets with the same benefits as before. You can choose the type of star, but some options, such as a black hole, neutron star, pulsar or magnetar, may reduce the habitability of the planets. However, they offer more valuable resources or an aesthetically pleasing appearance.

You can place your star system anywhere in the universe and restrict faster-than-light travel to within your star’s heliopause, which will make it more difficult for others to invade your territory.

Your demiplane has ascended into a fully autonomous Dimension—a vast, self-sustaining cosmic realm with its own metaphysical laws, layered architecture, and expanding influence across the multiverse. No longer confined to a fog-enshrouded pocket, it now operates as a living, independent system of reality. Beginning at a planetary scale, its growth has no upper limit, evolving in size, depth, and conceptual complexity according to your will, experiences, and interactions with other worlds.

The Dimension consists of multiple interwoven layers: a material layer of physical matter and ecosystems; an ethereal layer for souls and spiritual forces; a conceptual layer shaped by symbols, beliefs, and narrative logic; and a dream layer responsive to the subconscious minds of its inhabitants. You may freely create, reshape, merge, or remove layers, dictating their interactions, physical laws, and causal relationships. Time is entirely under your control—you can slow, accelerate, or pause it independently across regions, allowing civilizations to rise and fall in moments from an external perspective.

Your authority governs the realm’s fundamental laws: gravity, energy, matter, magic, death, and rebirth. Changes to these laws can be enacted instantly or set on a timed schedule, with unique rule sets for specific regions, groups, or layers. The land itself adapts to your design, generating lifeforms, magic, and even sentient structures as extensions of your will.

Every inhabitant carries fragments of your Dimension’s metaphysical structure. When they travel beyond its borders, they act as subtle carriers of your reality. Foreign universes may bend or shift around the embedded logic they bring, and over time, your cosmology spreads through contact, belief, and narrative resonance. Myths, rituals, and magical systems from your realm may manifest in distant worlds, while prolonged exposure to your people or artifacts can cause outsiders to dream of your Dimension or form involuntary bonds with it.

The original mist barrier has evolved into advanced dimensional phasing and cloaking. You may render the Dimension invisible to beings below your tier or open selective gateways into other worlds and timelines. Portals can be overt or subtle, manifesting through dreams, myths, or subconscious calling. Wanderers, refugees, and lost souls may be drawn into your realm without realizing it, guided by its internal logic and narrative pull.

Within your realm, you possess omnipresent awareness of every change in matter, energy, and concept. You can project avatars or aspects of yourself into any location or layer, each acting with your full authority. These projections may speak through wind, water, stone, flame, or dream, carrying your voice across any medium without limitation.

Your bond with the Dimension is absolute. It serves as an inexhaustible source of energy, regeneration, and metaphysical resilience. Even if your body is destroyed outside, your true essence remains anchored here, granting recovery, resurrection, and continuity through otherwise fatal events. If you possess Eternal Flame or an equivalent power, you are truly unkillable, and your Dimension becomes permanent and immune to destruction or overwriting.

The Dimension’s structure is infinitely customizable. You may craft galaxies of civilizations, stacked planes of reality, or entirely separate cosmologies with distinct divine orders and rules. It can follow a recursive fractal model, where worlds hide within villages, forests, or even objects, each fully functional and bound by your laws. You choose whether this pattern applies universally, regionally, or not at all.

At its heart lies the metaphysical core—your sovereign anchor. It holds your will, identity, and authority, ensuring the Dimension cannot be erased, absorbed, or rewritten as long as it endures. You may delegate localized control while retaining ultimate dominion. Within your world, entire mythologies and hierarchies may arise, potentially becoming multiversal archetypes that extend your influence through shared symbols and belief.

This is no longer a hidden refuge—it is a living, evolving cosmic force. Its laws spread, its mythos takes root, and its presence reshapes the realities it touches. Anything that affects a demiplane still applies here. You may teleport in and out from anywhere, populate it with beings from any setting, or phase it into a higher state to prevent interaction with other realms. Alternatively, you may anchor entrances wherever you choose. If you possess a Planet, Personal Sky Island, or similar construct, you may merge it with the Dimension and even manifest it externally.

If you have multiple Dimensions, they may merge into a unified whole or coexist as distinct realities under your control.
objects.title: Dimension

objects.text:
Remember how before, you were given a fresh vault, free of experiments? Well... now, your vault is changed so that indeed, you CAN do Experiments.

From the franchise itself, you can choose any experiment vault hinted at or stated. However, thankfully for you, success is closer in your grasp. The more on the level or at least altruistic the goal of your experiment is, the more likely your goal is to succeed. While this means Vaults like 92, 31-33, and 87 will not get this success buffs, experiments like 81, 111 or even Vault 94, will receive further chances of success. The same will be true on either side of your own custom experiment.

Finally, your Vault will receive a few miscellaneous buffs: a 50% size increase, defense increases like the Vault door being able to take 3 nukes instead of 1 and stuff like paralyzing lasers and concussive turrets.
objects.title: Experiment Enterprise (Fallout)

objects.text: Revolutionising safety for an uncertain future You are no simple Overseer of a singular Vault. Vault-Tec Industries was not as benevolent as everyone thought. As one of the Pre-War companies, possibly responsible for the destruction of civilisation, they were more prepared for the coming apocalypse than most in America, excluding the government faction known as the Enclave with whom Vault-Tec possess an ongoing relationship. Your Vault is no ordinary Vault; in fact, it is quite similar to Vaults 31, 32, and 33. Your Vault houses the best and brightest minds in Vault-Tec Industries in a bid to regain control of society after its destruction. As the new Overseer of this Vault, you are not simply in charge of the Vault; instead, you are the new CEO of Vault-Tec Industries as a whole. A corporation with a vast, diverse array of revenue streams and unparalleled market control, able to manipulate governments into doing whatever it wants. Your profit margin could rival that of small countries, and the might to subsidise other companies into your own. Vault-Tec Industries has many different divisions each with its own focus on what services it provides such as Future-Tec which works on top-secret and alien technologies developing cutting edge technology for Vaults and the loyal customers of Vault-Tec, Vault-Tec Game Studios which focuses on creating video games, and many other sub divisions for practically every branch of the corporate world holding a stranglehold on innovations a monopoly so big not even the government would be capable of separating Vault-Tec Industries or enforcing laws against your machinations. Vault-Tec Industries will now follow you across various universes, establishing branches in each universe you enter.
objects.title: Vault-Tec Industries (Fallout)

objects.text:
When House made his calculations for the end of the world, he was off by a few days, as before the war was to begin, he planned to upgrade not only his securitron army but also the various computer systems within the Lucky 38 using proprietary high-density data storage RobCo technology; however, due to his calculations being slightly off, the Platinum Chip never made it to the Lucky 38 before the bombs dropped.

With access to the Platinum Chip, all the computers within the Lucky 38 massively boosted beyond the capabilities of any other supercomputers within the Fallout Universe, allowing for the defensive systems in the Lucky 38 to receive a massive boost regarding the prevention of missiles, something House surely would have appreciated when the Great War started.

Additionally, the Platinum Chip boosts the computers within the Lucky 38 with the Mark II operating system and the Securitron software updates that House desperately wanted. This update allows the Securitrons to auto-repair from damage that would otherwise cripple a normal Mark 1 Securitron and require House to prepare more Securitrons. It also allows the Securitrons to access the grenade and missile launcher weapons they have been equipped with, but cannot use due to software limitations.

Furthermore, this also enhances your already impressive legions of Securitons already present within the Lucky 38 with access to Securitons housed in the top-secret bunker under Fortification Hill, which has thousands of Securitons to bolster your army, as well as fabrication systems that, when fed materials, can produce more Securitons. However, current material stocks are low and can only provide an additional supplement equal to half the Securitons already in the top-secret bunker.
objects.title: Platinum Chip Upgrade (Fallout)

addons.text: Your business has expanded once more... Now, your building has basically become an indoor Amusement park at a whopping 1,950,000 Square Meters, or 3 times the size of Disneyland! Besides your obvious advantages from the size, Your 600 villagers are now all skilled in Fazbear-type jobs: Engineering, marketing, cooking, etc. But, the true benefit... comes in the Animatronics themselves. No longer limited to "normal" animatronics, each of the animatronics now have your capabilities. If you had Pyrokinesis, now any of your Chicas can do a good phoenix impression. Got Photokinesis? Ballora can manipulate light and its properties to benefit her eyes. The Animatronics also come with the same loyalty benefits as your villagers, your village elders now capable of acting as chairmen of the board if you wanted. As well, all of your original village inhabitants will be given very comfortable living quarters around the park for the sake of their job, on top of the hotels for park customers.
addons.title: Fazbear Amusement Park!

objects.text: Your Pizzeria has now ballooned. Rather than being 2000 square meters before, you now have a whopping 40,000 square meters! Once more, the layout is up to you, but to compare, your building is now as big as Freddy Fazbear's Mega Pizzaplex, if not a couple hundred square meters bigger! You can dictate the theming of this building, so it could be an 80's callback, a winter wonderland, a cowboy western, etc! Now, you can start with up to 16 animatronics to roam the halls. Along with this, you can choose whether you get organic workers for the building, or legitimately useful staff bots. Similar to another supernatural food place, you can dictate what people have to pay to eat here, and they will indeed pay it if able. This building also has incredible defense systems for "non-paying customers" in the form of the animatronics themselves, sensors, and a nightguard that is peak human in every singular regard, physically AND mentally.
objects.title: Fazbear Hyperplex (Five Nights At Freddy's)

objects.text:
In theory, the EX-EYE is defenceless, in practice however it’s the heart of a fortified stellar fortress. The EX-EYE is the ultimate strategic carrier, having a guardian fleet that operates on the principle of a carrier battle group. Every ship in its fleet is single-purpose, logistically minimal, and completely expendable, all of which are drones with the EX-EYE’s continued operation being their only objective.

The innermost defense is provided by 700 Bulwark-class Point Defense Bastions. Each Bulwark is a brutalist octahedral block of layered composite armor covered in thousands of angular weapon ports, resembling a geometric fortress. The armament consists entirely of rotary mass drivers, banks of rapid-fire railguns that vomit hypersonic tungsten slugs. Supplementing these are wide-angle electromagnetic catapults that fire canister rounds packed with monomolecular flechettes, turning entire sectors of space into shredding zones that obliterate strike craft squadrons on approach. Bulwarks rely exclusively on armor thickness and structural redundancy, with low-power omnidirectional thrusters that allow slow rotation to present fresh armor facings. They are gun platforms that establish killing fields.

Long-range engagement is the domain of 100 Javelin-class Artillery Platforms. Each Javelin is a single enormous railgun with minimal superstructure, a needle-like spine kilometers long where the entire vessel serves as the magnetic acceleration channel. Their heavy rail cannon fires a single hundred-ton projectile of aerodynamic Depleted Uranium-Tungsten alloy accelerated to a significant fraction of lightspeed, delivering kinetic energy sufficient to vaporize capital ships on direct impact. The firing process generates recoil forces that require the vessel to spend additional time re-stabilizing before it can fire again. Javelins carry minimal armor with angled deflection plating, relying on their extreme engagement range and the protective screen of the inner fleet to survive, and their massive primary thrusters are designed for slow positioning to line up firing solutions.

The fleet's mobile battle line and electronic warfare core is composed of 300 Reaver-class Interceptor Carriers. Each Reaver is a geometric, angular hull covered in launch bays and studded with massive fork-like emission arrays, carrying internal hangar space for thousands of Viper-class dogfighters. The emission arrays are the Reaver’s primary anti-capital weapon, generating contained spheres of magnetized plasma that rupture on impact into cascading electromagnetic pulses and arcing electrical discharges, designed to fry unshielded electronics, overload and collapse enemy shields, flash-vaporize hull plating through thermal shock, and temporarily disable sensors and weapons across wide areas of the target. Reavers carry moderate armor and powerful capacitor shielding, with powerful thrusters for sudden positional shifts to maintain optimal range. 

The Viper-class autonomous dogfighters form the most numerous component of the fleet with approximately 900,000 units distributed across the Reaver carrier fleet. Each Viper is a sleek dagger-shaped craft with a reinforced ram nose and armored prow, designed around twin Ripper coilguns mounted in the wings that fire streams of tungsten-carbide penetrators for high-speed strafing runs against armor and subsystems. Vipers carry a limited payload of Spark capacitor darts, single-shot projectiles that discharge localized Thunder Strikes on impact to specifically disable individual subsystems like engine nacelles or weapon batteries on larger targets. They carry no shields and rely entirely on extreme maneuverability from overpowered thrusters capable of G-forces that would pulverize biological pilots, combined with angled hulls that deflect glancing kinetic hits.

The entire defensive operation runs on perfect information, using the EX-EYE's localized scrying capability. Unlike a full-power galactic scan that consumes a white dwarf's energy and screams its location across the cosmos, this focused mode observes only the immediate battlefield and approaching enemy fleets. It provides the same perfect, real-time clarity without the massive energy draw or catastrophic spacetime distortions. This allows the EX-EYE to act as a perpetual, undetectable battlefield command and control center.
objects.title: “EYE OF GOD”

objects.text:
This is a direct derivative of the Receptacle System architecture, its core Scrap-Net protocol and decentralized automation logic minimally modified and ruggedized for the vacuum and low-gravity environment of asteroidal operations.

The continental-scale junkyard is replaced by a captured metallic asteroid, a celestial body matching the scale of Ceres at approximately 940 kilometers in diameter, comprised of 78% ferrous and platinum-group metals, 15% rare earth elements and crystalline carbon structures, and 7% residual silicates and volatiles.

The internal facilities are functionally identical but recalibrated; the perimeter offload zone becomes the primary smelting and processing belt, and the central compacting pit is reconfigured as a zero-g refinement crucible. The system's final output is no longer compacted scrap blocks, but precisely alloyed ingots and pre-fabricated material stocks.

The original automaton castes remain with adapted mission parameters: the Inbound 'Carriage' Fleet now operates as an Export Fleet, hauling finished product to orbit; the 'Gulper'-Class units transport raw ore between mining sites and processors; and the 'Corvid'-Class observers now perform spectral assay and purity verification.

A new 'Mole'-Class automaton is added to the workforce. These heavy mining units are tasked with primary excavation, using drill arrays and cutting beams to break down the asteroid's matrix and feed raw material into the system.

Your administrative authority is exercised through the same Scrap-Net, now locally designated the Ore-Net. You begin with direct claim over the entire asteroid, an estimated 1 quintillion ton of raw, high-concentration ore, and 100 trillion tons of refined ingots and material stock.
objects.title: Legacy Mining System 455 "The Dig"

objects.text:
You now head the RDA Security Operations division, also known as SecOps. This is a specialized security service responsible for protecting your assets related to the Unobtanium Mine and related industries.

The division has about 1,000 fighters. It also commands several squadrons of aircraft, including approximately 8 SA-2 Samsons and 4 AT-99 Scorpions in each squadron. The flagship is the formidable C-21 Dragon. The division's arsenal also includes approximately 50 AMP combat exoskeletons and several dozen armored vehicles.

SecOps personnel are well trained and have considerable combat experience. They are equipped with body armor, breathing masks, and a variety of small arms, including large-caliber rifles. They also have grenade launchers and flamethrowers at their disposal to support the infantry.

However, the technology currently available to SecOps is not cutting-edge for the 22nd century. The unit is not designed for full-scale combat operations. Its main task is to provide enhanced security and protection for personnel and facilities in hostile environments populated by dangerous creatures.
objects.title: RDA Security Operations (Avatar)

objects.text:
With each purchase, you receive an additional mine that can be used to expand production or increase your initial Unobtanium Mine. The choice is yours.

In any case, you are also provided with the Hell's Gate industrial complex. This center combines industrial, logistical, and administrative functions, simplifying the management of extraction, transportation, and security of materials. You will have at your disposal light industry for the manufacture of parts and small equipment, a chemical metallurgical plant, storage warehouses, logistics routes, and a fleet of various equipment. In addition, you will receive automated security systems, including high fences and automatic turrets.
objects.title: New Mines

objects.text: Rather than being an unobtanium mine, you have come into possession of a mine excavating a different science fiction super material, such as Vibranium or Beskar. The value of the mine remains approximately the same, and the equipment is adjusted to allow the harvesting of these different materials. If you have New Mines, you can choose what material each mine excavates separately.
objects.title: Different Mine

objects.text: Instead of receiving a mine containing vast amounts of unprocessed Unobtanium ore, you instead obtain a warehouse containing 350,000 ingots of refined Unobtanium, each 1 kg in weight. These are stored in several hundred Pandoran native wood crates, with each crate containing half a ton of Unobtanium ingots. If you have New Mines, these additional mines will also come in the form of already processed, refined Unobtanium ingots. You still gain the Hell’s Gate light industrial complex, with the warehouse becoming a part of it. And with Different Mine, the alternative material will come in a refined form ready for use. This does not add any value to your materials; it only saves you the effort of extracting and refining them yourself. Your warehouse is fully restocked on the first day of each year, regardless of whether you only used one ingot or all of them.
objects.title: Finished Extraction

objects.text:
Your Starbase receives a major upgrade on its defense potential. That is, offense.

Your starbase now comes installed with many armaments: from point defense to take down missiles, missile silos to rain down on enemy ships, and even multiple rail guns to take down the bigger threats. Your energy shield also receives an upgrade, able to tank many more heavy blows before falling, fueled by a more powerful generator. The hull is also improved, being made of sturdier material and with a special coat that partly negates energy attacks.

This militarization of your base will come with the appropriate facilities to repair and maintain its upgrades, from the machines to build more ammo and armor, to the barracks and command center for the soldiers that operate and maintain them.
objects.title: Starbase? More like Starfortress

objects.text: For each purchase, your initial available space is multiplied by 10 (400km³, 4.000km³, 40.000km³, etc…).
objects.title: A Bigger Starbase

objects.text: For each purchase, you gain an additional Starbase. If you selected A Bigger Starbase, you may divide the extra space between the multiple Starbases rather than a single one.
objects.title: Another Starbase

addons.text:
Your Factory Suburb and the entire complex of ten Factories will gain a constant and inexhaustible source of resources for production, equal in quantity and value to the output of your Unobtanium Mine, while retaining the full range of resources previously available.

With this upgrade, your Factories will be able to conserve energy and produce goods quickly and on a large scale. For convenience, you can immediately calculate resources by accounting for them in terms of any value or nominal units (for example, in monetary terms).
addons.title: Expanded Resource Base

addons.text:
Your Factory Suburb system cannot create full-fledged High-Level Safeguards, such as Sanakan and those equipped with GBE. However, it is capable of supporting up to 1,000 Provisional Safeguards for performing local security tasks and neutralizing intruders. An example of such an agent is Dhomochevsky.

Provisional Safeguards fall into the mid-range protection category. Their capabilities are comparable to those of Killy and are surpassed only by Sanakan and similar models. However, they are not armed with a GBE, but with a four-barreled pistol capable of firing various types of ammunition: metal bullets, homing missiles, and a laser. This weapon is sufficient to destroy Exterminators and inflict serious damage on High-Level Safeguards.

In addition, each temporary Safeguard can be issued a Buckshot Shotgun with immense power comparable to the GBE. However, it lacks the GBE’s penetrating capability and can only breach certain walls of the megastructure. This shotgun has a small ammunition capacity, but its shot covers a large area at a range of up to 200 meters.
addons.title: Provisional Safeguard (Blame!)

objects.text:
Along with the Factory, you’ll find an extensive complex of structures adjacent to it. These were likely built by the factory itself, perhaps without any specific purpose.

In fact, it is a separate section about 200 kilometers long and wide and approximately 10 kilometers high. The main outer walls, internal partitions, and load-bearing structures are made of the same nearly indestructible material as the megastructure. However, smaller parts and individual structures are made of more conventional materials. The center of the entire "Factory Suburb" is a complex of 10 Factories located in the center.

The internal layout of the section is chaotic, but you will easily find huge rooms comparable in size to the Factory itself (up to 10 km in length and width, with a height of up to 1–2 km). There are also numerous transport and communication systems, airlocks, passageways, elevators, and much more. Keep in mind that the orientation of individual rooms may be distorted, and the floor may be a wall or a ceiling.

Factory Suburb will be powered directly by the Factory and several gravitational generators located in isolated, sealed-off rooms. It is best not to enter these rooms, as they create temporal and spatial anomalies. At best, you will find yourself in the future or the past, or perhaps in another reality where the Section does not exist, and you will be trapped deep within the rock. More likely, you will simply be erased from existence due to a disruption in the chain of causality.

The outer walls and airlocks, made of megastructure material, will provide reliable protection against external threats, and numerous Structure Conversion Towers will defend against invasion by producing large numbers of Exterminators upon detection of intruders. There will be two types of towers: “main” towers, up to 40 meters tall and protected by a shield made of megastructure material, which are incredibly difficult to destroy; and “small” towers, two stories tall and much less protected, but also capable of producing large numbers of Exterminators. 

You will be able to manage the Factory Suburb from any available terminal and grant access to anyone while retaining the rights of the chief administrator. In addition to you, Builders—autonomous machines responsible for construction and repairs—will move around the Section’s territory. You can issue orders to them.

In fact, it is a stunningly huge and no less stunningly protected "metropolis", but at the same time depressingly empty. And you can safely count on almost completely free 10 isolated levels, each of which has an area of almost 40,000 square kilometers and a ceiling height of up to 1 km.
objects.title: Factory Suburb

objects.text:
Your laboratory has received several groundbreaking innovations and improvements made by Dr Hedo, the grandson of the late Dr Gero. Building upon and improving the designs of the Androids based on the already impressive work of Gero. Hedo managed to create Androids significantly stronger than Gero ever created during the Cell Saga. Any android you make in this improved facility will be far more powerful than anything Gero could produce during his own time.

The facility has now undergone an expansion of the materials available and quantity enabling for the production of around 10 regular Androids on par with Android 18 and 19 during the Cell Saga with improvements on the usage of the infinite energy model from Dr. Hedo's research or a singular Special Android on the level of Gamma 1 and 2 a new generation of Android that far exceeds anything that Android 18 and 19 would be capable of and on par with a Super Saiyan Blue Saiyan.

Moreover, Not only does your Supercomputer now hold an improved archive of the various Ki techniques from the Z Fighters beyond the point of the Cell Sage, additionally its genetic database has also been upgraded with the extensive DNA catalogue of every alien or unknown lifeform that has come to earth beyond the point of the Cell Saga including the likes of Majin Buu and other aliens that have visited earth past the Cell Saga.
objects.title: Dr. Hedo Improvements (Dragon Ball Series)

objects.text:
Instead of a standard Lazarus Pit, you possess a small lake filled with pure Dionesium.

Named after Dionysus, the Greek god of rebirth, Dionesium is the primordial substance from which Lazarus Pits are derived. The Lazarus chemicals found in ordinary pits are merely diluted and corrupted imitations of this far purer medium.

The restorative capabilities of Dionesium far surpass those of even the finest Lazarus Pit. It can heal virtually any injury, disease, poison, curse, or physical corruption, restore youth and vitality, and resurrect the dead with far greater reliability, greatly extending the window in which resurrection remains possible.

Unlike a Lazarus Pit, immersion in pure Dionesium carries none of the usual drawbacks. Users do not suffer from Lazarus Fever, temporary insanity, soul degradation, or violent madness upon revival.
objects.title: Dionesium Lake (DC Comics)

objects.text: Now, instead of the relatively small asteroid space station of Omega, you gain the mobile planetoid city of High Charity. Nearly 350 kilometers wide and over 500 kilometers long, this densely populated space station is home to nearly 8 billion sentients. The population of High Charity can be made up of any races known in the Mass Effect or Halo universes. You can also include any species or races of physical forms you’ve purchased in the CYOA. This can also include any species existing in the world you’ll be entering, or from the worlds your powers originate from—so long as the race or species you choose doesn’t exceed your own abilities. The mobile planetoid uses various Forerunner artifacts to power itself—such as using a decommissioned Forerunner Dreadnought’s engines—to provide powerful energy shielding, and features maneuvering and slipspace drives to transport itself throughout the galaxy. While you can disconnect the various Forerunner artifacts to use them elsewhere, doing so will leave the station woefully underpowered, unshielded, and almost unable to move. High Charity is protected by its own defense fleets, consisting of thousands of battleships, carriers, and cruisers. Built from the best technologies of the Mass Effect and Halo universes and crewed by those loyal to High Charity's leadership, this fleet is a formidable weapon in the right hands. As for the leadership of High Charity? Typically, it lies with the High Council, led by the triarchy of San’Shyuum Hierarchs. You can choose to leave this in place... or, you can replace it with leadership of your own design—perhaps with you ultimately sitting upon the “throne.” The major criminal organizations of Omega continue to exist, only increased in size and scale, with members numbering in the tens of millions each—though, ultimately, they still represent only a tiny fraction of the population of High Charity. The Omega mines still exist, producing endless quantities of resources for High Charity to use. The station will exist somewhere in the galaxy, in a system of your choosing. If you don’t have a method of easy space travel, a starship will arrive in a few days to pick you up and transport you to High Charity.
objects.title: High Charity (Halo)

addons.text:
Your galaxy is now inhabited by several thriving and diverse civilizations. You can decide which forms these civilizations take, such as a united multicultural federation, several competing empires, or young planets taking their first steps to the stars. You can set different standard tech levels, cultures and sizes for different civilizations at your leisure. If your powers or technologies do not provide you and your races with sufficient FTL capabilities, then they will invent rudimentary technologies or techniques matching the low-tier of vanilla Stellaris hyperdrives.

Your entire galaxy is empowered, with its civilizations having access to any powers, technologies, races and resources you do. You may also populate your galaxy with any civilizations, races, resources or wonders from any of the universes of your powers and technologies. You may also populate the galaxy with alien races of your own design who possess their own versions of your powers. As with Empowered Village, the capabilities of all beings in your galaxy cap out at 50% of your own power level.

Your galaxy subtly expands to accommodate the civilizations within. There will always be more planets for them to explore and colonize and wonders for them to discover.
addons.title: Galactic Civilizations

objects.text:
Your L-Gates now lead to an entire galaxy of your own, rather than a relatively small cluster. This Galaxy belongs entirely to you and is separated from your starting world's galaxy or cosmos. The galaxy is uninhabited by extant complex intelligent life

Your galaxy contains billions of systems, with at at least a million habitable planets across several sectors. You can structure the systems, sectors and planets as you wish, including what kinds of planets there are. There are also many abandoned megastructures, habitats and ruins to discover and rebuild, including ones of original design.

The planets are rich in minerals, energy, food and strategic resources and luxuries, including resources from your powers. There are also other types of stellar wonders and phenomena in your galaxy, both from Stellaris, originating from your powers, and others undiscovered.

The Galaxy has abundant hyperlane arteries and networks, as well as wormholes, and interconnected L-Gates between different sectors. These hyperlanes are fast and streamlined for any type of FTL drive, but are also strategically defensible.

You also have corridors between your own galaxy and your starting world’s galaxy or cosmos, which allow travel between them as fast as an FTL capable ship would be able to travel between nearby stars. You gain an additional hundred L-Gates that provide access to your galaxy that can be placed in your starting world. You can shut off the corridor and L-Gates at will.

Optionally, you may start with an inhabited planet somewhere in this galaxy, with a decent population, infrastructure, and resources, as well as a small fleet of FTL capable starships.
objects.title: Vast and Full of Wonders (Stellaris)

objects.text: Now instead of gaining just Konoha, you gain the Shinobi Union—or at least the factions that would eventually be founding members within it. From Sunagakure, Kirigakure, Iwagakure, Kumogakure, and the samurai of the Land of Iron, all of them will be subject to your authority as Daimyō. Each Village—or equivalent—resides within it’s own pocket dimension, and has all the same mechanics as Konoha albeit adapted to suit the specifics of the village in question.
objects.title: The Shinobi Union (Naruto)

objects.text: With each purchase here, you can choose another Shinobi Village—or an equivalent—from the series to add as a member of your Shinobi Union. Any such village will be subject to all the same mechanics as Konoha and the Shinobi Union, but will have less strength and population than the original members of the Union.
objects.title: Another Member

objects.text:
The quality of your security personnel has now been raised to a level of exceptionally trained operatives. Your forces can now perform operations that would make all the world's top military and spy agencies weep with envy, and each soldier is now a consummate professional in killing everything that breathes, infiltration, sabotage, terrorism, assassination, corporate espionage, and everything else you might require of them.

A squad of your security forces can enter a warzone between two superpowers, achieve their objectives under the nose of all intelligence agencies combined, and walk away without a loss, and if there is anything one of them cannot take down, a few of them will almost always do the job.
objects.title: Human Unit Never Killed

objects.text:
No longer merely a corporation, you are now the owner and leader of an entire corporate state. Comparable in size and population to the largest countries in any universe your corporation gets imported into, your state is completely self-reliant, with your corporation producing everything from toilet paper to military technology, and schools and universities ready to fast-track citizens to become productive and qualified employees.

When importing your corporation, you can, instead of creating an entirely new landmass, choose to take over any existing country as your state.

As the state grew from a privately owned company, you are the only one who decides the policy and laws, with the absolute majority of the population supporting you to their dying breath, and the rest never opposing you so long as the quality of life is at least tolerable.

As an added bonus, you can now share any of the self-targeting perks with the entire population of your state.
objects.title: One Nation Under Copyright

objects.text: I went to blow the fire a-flame, But something rustled on the floor, And someone called me by my name: It had become a glimmering girl With apple blossom in her hair Who called me by my name and ran And faded through the brightening air… You have received the region of the Otherworld known as Tír Na nÓg, Emain Ablach, Ynys Affallach, Insula Avalonis, Glæsisvellir, The Land of Silver Apples, or simply Avalon. This comprises of a hilly island covered in apple-trees and nature of all colours that is an absolute wellspring of magic like few other places on earth. This Island can potentially be reached in many ways: by sailing away from land at sea or on a lake during dawn or twilight while intending to find it, or opening a faerie mound or circle that is linked with the island (most notably Glastonbury Tor) using magic. Like most other Fae domains, time, space, and the seasons within the realm are malleable to the owner’s will. Faerie Food will always be available at the owner’s wish, and a vast variety of magical materials and animals can be found or grown within. Spells cast within will always last until the caster (or owner of the realm) decides otherwise; although they will not remain permanent if what they are cast upon leaves the realm, and the owner may suspend the aging of any mortal creature within the realm. Finally, should the owner or any other Fae creature they have a connection with die within the island or outside (baring soul destruction, similar complete erasure, or death by Iron) they may reincarnate within the island although the process takes several centuries in the outside world. Be warned: while it is possible to restrict most access to the island there will always be at least one way in and out that you forget about or will not be able to close. Though I am old with wandering Through hollow lands and hilly lands, I will find out where she has gone, And kiss her lips and take her hands; And walk among long dappled grass, And pluck till time and times are done, The silver apples of the moon, The golden apples of the sun.
objects.title: Ynys Affallach

objects.text: Your Journal is now a magical artifact of the highest degree, capable of storing infinite quantities of Magic. Your Journal now allows you to create your own magic spells and cast them from it. You have incredible lee-way as to the variety of your spells. By self-referencing the mundane knowledge in itself, your Journal will create new spells or techniques.
objects.title: Preternatural Artifact

addons.title: Philosophy Key
addons.text: Thanks to the Cultivation Manual, your Journal’s evolution into a magical artifact has resulted in benefits for cultivation as well. Not only can your Journal now store infinite amounts of Qi the same way it can store magic, but just as it can create new spells it can also create new techniques for using Qi. In simpler terms, anything it could do for magic it can now do for Qi as well. More than that though, it can also derive new cultivation methods and techniques from your knowledge and the information stored within, allowing you to expand and refine the ways in which you cultivate; for example if you learn how to use a sword then your Journal can create and refine a method of sword cultivation, if you know tai chi it can refine that knowledge into a moving meditation cultivation art which reinforces and invigorates the body, and so on. If you have Akashic Records then not only does the speed at which your Journal derive and refine cultivation techniques greatly increase, but the threshold of information needed to develop a new technique is drastically lowered; you just need to feed the Journal a rough idea and understanding of what you desire and it will put together at least a basic technique which fits your criteria, with the quality of the output depending on what information the Journal already has.

objects.text: Your Journal is now able to collect information on the vast and abundant number of magic systems you will experience. As you continue on your journey you will find the basic magic system of each universe now fills the pages of your Journal. This archive of mystical knowledge will continue to fill its own pages with magical research, the speed of this research is the same as if you wholeheartedly dedicated yourself to magical research.
objects.title: Unfinished Athenaeum

objects.text: Your Journal is now innately connected to a pool of magic within you, allowing you to pre-cast spells and store them within your Journal. Once stored, these spells will become a fixture of your Journal, recharging themselves after use at no cost. The quality and speed of the magical research done by your Journal is outstanding, allowing new elemental variations of spells to be made almost constantly. At a greater scale, your Journal can delve into entire branches of magic and break them down with ease. Additionally, your Journal now improves your own magical generation, the more magical knowledge your journal collects, and the more spells you have stored affects this growth.
objects.title: Akashic Records

objects.text:
Your manual has been upgraded, granting you access to additional cultivation techniques tailored to your journey. With each purchase, you can either choose one specialised technique to complement the foundational practice or increase the strength and potential of a technique you already have. These techniques open the door to focused paths of growth, such as Beast Energy Cultivation, which channels primal beast essence for strength and instinct, Physique Cultivation, designed to fortify the body into an unbreakable force, Elemental Cultivation, focusing on a specific element like fire or ice, harnessing its raw power, Dual Cultivation, which emphasises mutual growth between partners through shared energy, blending yin and yang energies or even a Cultivation technique made specifically to empower and grow a specific power you already have.

If the chosen technique has certain requirements, such as specific alignments or mentalities, the manual will include methods to cultivate them from scratch. Do be warned that these methods will likely affect your way of thinking to better fit the cultivation technique.

In addition to the specialised cultivation techniques, the manual also provides advanced combat techniques tailored to your chosen path. Whether it’s feral, instinct-driven combat styles for Beast Energy Cultivation, elemental weapon techniques for Elemental Cultivation, or physically powered based combat forms for Physique Cultivation, each technique is designed to enhance your mastery of both energy manipulation and combat, ensuring a seamless blend of power and martial prowess.
objects.title: Unique Cultivation Techniques

objects.text: ”Hello! Fwiendy-Wend~” Your Black Book has always been a mystery, but now the rabbit hole goes ever deeper. You have made use of a ritual that ended with you establishing a contract with a Pantheon of 5 eldritch entities known as the Lords in Black. These cosmic horrors reside in a dangerous place existing outside of dimensions known as the Black and White. They're all siblings, all being ancient agents of chaos who are more than willing to do whatever they can to get their way. Your contract forbids them from dragging you into the Black and White outright without valid reason, but do not take that as an absolute defense. Serve them well and treat them as you would any other Patron, and you will be rewarded. With this Upgrade, your Black Book is updated with numerous spells and rituals pertaining to each of the 5 Lords in Black, along with rituals involving all of them. You may optionally replace your original Patron with the Lords in Black or keep the Patron as is. To top off your signing-on bonus, each of the Lords in Black have bestowed upon you a boon of their own. Wiggog Y'rath, or Wiggly, The King In Black is the most clever of the Lords in Black and is their leader. He offers His ability to subtly manipulate other people’s minds, making your suggestions and offers more likely to stick in their thoughts, placing them under your thumb (and His). Bliklotep, or Blinky, The Watcher with a Thousand Eyes is the most sadistic of the Lords in Black. He offers His sight, allowing you to see anywhere you wish within 100 meters of yourself. Nothing will hide from your gaze (unless it would be more entertaining to Him if something did). T'noy Karaxis, or Tinky, The Bastard of Time and Space is the most tricky of the Lords in Black. He offers you the ability to travel through time, able to go back and forth through tears in spacetime up to days at a time (so long as He allows it). Nibblenephim, or Nibbly, The One Who Feasts in the Dark is the hungriest of the Lords in Black. He offers the ability to consume the most notable traits of those who fall by your hands, allowing you to enhance yourself greatly (if you don't appear tasty to Him). Finally, Pokotho, or Pokey, The Singular Voice is the most uncompromising of the Lords in Black. He offers you the privilege to create a branch of His collective hive mind, the Hive, that you can infect others into being a part of using your blood (so long as He never hears a voice from you that isn't His own). “Out of the depths of Hell and back, us spawn of the Black and White! Cover our souls with robes of black, and take up the arms of night! You summon us once, you summon us twice, you gamble it all on a roll of the dice! The devil has won, it can't be undone, the book has all but closed on your life!”
objects.title: The Lords In Black (Hatchetfield)

objects.text: You can select another beginner book. Try not to overdo it!
objects.title: Extra Volumes for Overachieving Dummies

objects.text:
Congrats, you finished Magical Middle School, now it's time for Magical College! And you won't even have to go broke for it.

Instead of only giving the basic knowledge of a magical system, the book now holds knowledge of the most advanced techniques from its respective system. From Elminster’s wizard spell book, to a Divine Chosen prayer book, or a tome of forbidden knowledge from an ancient demon, the knowledge to how to achieve the apex of its powers is here. You still have to hit the books for access to said phenomenal cosmic powers, though.
objects.title: Magic for Academics

objects.text: You gain another book with advanced knowledge from your chosen system. You can only choose said books if you have access to their “for Dummies” version. So taking two different books from Arcane Magic from D&D is fine if you took the basic version, but taking an Advanced Prayer book wont if you didn't take the “for dummies” version.
objects.title: Extra Volumes for Exceptional Academics

objects.text: The Death Note is no longer limited to recording how someone dies. It can now be used to write the course of their life. Once you write the name of someone whose face you know, everything written beneath their name becomes part of their personal story. You can determine their actions, decisions, thoughts, emotions, relationships, successes, failures, discoveries, and the events that occur around them. You may influence luck and probability, arrange coincidences, and control how other people interact with the target. You can write with as much or as little detail as you wish. A precise entry can dictate exact words, times, actions, and outcomes, while a broader entry such as “She becomes extraordinarily wealthy over the next year without attracting unwanted attention” will allow the Death Note to arrange the necessary events itself. Any details you leave unwritten will be resolved in whatever manner best fulfills your intended result. The Note may affect people whose names and faces you do not know, provided they are only involved through the story of someone you have properly identified. Writing that your target is hired by a particular company, befriended by a specific stranger, attacked by a certain criminal, or chosen by a government official will control those people as necessary, even if you do not know their names. The identified target acts as the protagonist through whom the rest of the entry is enforced. You may establish exact dates and deadlines, or allow events to unfold naturally over any length of time. There is no longer a time limit for completing an entry. The story and chapter begins by drawing a special open symbol (〄) after a character’s name, remains open until you draw a special closing symbol beneath it (〆), marking the end of that chapter. Until both symbols are drawn the events in the chapter do not begin. You no longer have a time limit to write your entries. Closing a chapter releases the target from that particular entry, but does not prevent you from writing their name again. You may begin new chapters for the same person as often as you wish, allowing you to continually revise, extend, or redirect their life. The Note can compel results that would normally be extraordinarily unlikely, provided they remain possible. It can cause someone to make a historic scientific breakthrough, solve a mystery no one else could unravel, survive a chain of disasters, or correctly write down information they had no reasonable means of knowing. The target does not need to understand how they reached the answer. Circumstance, intuition, coincidence, overlooked evidence, or an improbable flash of insight will carry them to the written result. Writing a person’s name no longer causes them to die automatically. Death must now be included as part of their story. You may describe it in exact detail, simply write that they die under broad conditions, or end their chapter with nothing more elaborate than ”He dies peacefully that evening.” Unless death is explicitly written, the Notebook will not kill them. The Note will always interpret your writing according to your genuine intent rather than exploiting careless wording. So long as the desired outcome is possible, the world will reorganize events, behavior, and probability until the written story becomes true.
objects.title: The Book of Life

objects.text: The Death Note no longer requires both a person’s true name and face. Any sufficiently specific identity will work. Knowing someone’s name is enough to target them even if you have never seen their face. Likewise, knowing their face is enough even if you do not know their name. Aliases, titles, usernames, codenames, and monikers also function provided they genuinely identify the intended person. You could therefore target L simply by writing L, provided you actually mean the individual known by that designation. The Note understands your intent, so two people sharing the same name will not cause ambiguity. You are targeting the person you intend to write about, not merely matching text against a legal identity.
objects.title: By Any Other Name

objects.text:
Your collection of Skill Books now includes combat manuals and memoirs by the greatest warriors, soldiers, and commanders of your world’s history. This includes knights, generals, and even wrestlers.

This includes guides for many types of weapons, from axes, to guns, fighting vehicles, and even odd objects. This includes many specific styles and techniques. It also covers tactics, strategy, intelligence, formation fighting and combined arms.

Learning these techniques requires actual training and conditioning in addition to studying, however, you still learn just as quickly. Actual or simulated combat in between studying and training also greatly improves your growth.

This does not include fighting using esoteric energies or techniques unless you have Applied Theories. In this case, the collection will contain a small amount of secret memoirs of battlemages, psy-soldiers, superheroes and the like.
objects.title: Combat Manuals

objects.text: You can now draw up to five cards and are no longer limited to drawing from only a single set at once, you can instead choose how many cards you draw from which set. Additionally, you are able to draw again after five seconds but the number of cards you can draw reduces by one every time you do so until you wait for the full cooldown.
objects.title: Celestial Oracle

objects.text: You can draw special cards from a side deck. When played, these cards will summon an ethereal envoy for two minutes. The envoys are divided into three types, offensive, defensive, and support, each with their own abilities roughly equivalent to 5 SP. You can only have one envoy summoned and can extend the duration by thirty seconds by sacrificing a card from your regular draw.
objects.title: Celestial Envoy

objects.text: When you defeat an opponent or make a pact with an ally, you can add a card which contains a spell that matches the theme of their powers (equivalent to 8 SP or less) to a side deck. You can draw and play one card from this side deck once every two minutes.
objects.title: Celestial Sect

objects.text: Your original Sacred Gear has done odd things to your soul. You don't just have one Sacred Gear but multiple Sacred Gears. All creatures inside the Sacred Gears have either set aside their differences or learned to play nice as to not impede you in anyway.
objects.title: More Sacred Gears (High School DxD)

addons.text: Although this sword is typically wielded only by Kami, you have drawn it with surprising ease. This sword, a Kami in its own right, has inexplicably chosen to allow you to wield it effortlessly. It was once the weapon of the Shinto creator god Izanagi-no-Mikoto, who used it to slay the newborn Fire Kami, Kagutsuchi-no-Mikoto. Through this act, Ame-no-Ohabari gained a powerful Godslaying attribute and usurped control over fire from Kagutsuchi, enabling it to generate and manipulate black flames. This sword's most dreadful power is its ability to usurp the Domain or Authority of a god, as it did to Kagu-tsuchi. However, this is not without its weaknesses, Kagu-tsuchi’s power has been consumed long enough for the blade to contain it without risk, but each new Authority you might try to add will need time to settle within the sword, least you risk damaging or even destroying the blade. The sword also has a finite capacity for Authorities, as a sword of "ten Hand-breadths" it is limited to ten, including Kagu-tsuchi's 'preloaded' one.
addons.title: Ame-no-Ohabari

objects.text: You've now unlocked the full power of the Sacred Gear Canis Lykaon, which summons an independent avatar in the form of a large black wolf with crimson eyes. This avatar can create blades that are often described as capable of "cutting through anything," including divine entities. The Sacred Gear also allows the user to generate black blades from the shadows within their field of vision. These blades typically take the shape of swords, but other bladed weapons are also possible. Its Balance Breaker, Night Celestial Slash Dogs, enables the user to envelop themselves in darkness, transforming into a humanoid black wolf with six tails. This transformation enhances the user's strength and extends the range of their shadows to the limits of their line of sight. The shadows can cut through both tangible objects and more intangible entities, such as magical abilities. Additionally, the user can manifest their blades imbued with powerful curses to weaken their targets. The final form of Canis Lykaon, known as Perfectus Tenebrae Lykaon et Fortis Densus Laelaps, is attained upon mastering the Balance Breaker. In this form, the user is shrouded in darkness, taking on the appearance of a dog-like beast equipped with an immensely sharp scythe. All abilities from Night Celestial Slash Dogs are amplified, and new powers are unlocked. The user can slice through the very fabric of space with the scythe and can produce numerous 'clones' of the Sacred Gear's independent avatar, each capable of wielding its powers.
objects.title: Canis Lykaon (High School DxD)

objects.text: Since the end of the Great War of the three factions, Ddraig, the Red Dragon Emperor, has remained trapped within the Boosted Gear, forced to lend his might and power to whoever has the fortune—or misfortune—of being his latest wielder. But with the Red Dragon’s blood within your veins—and God's Death in the Great War—a new possibility has emerged within the gauntleted form of the Boosted Gear. The Boosted Gear was never designed to account for someone who bears the Dragon’s blood, and it struggles to distinguish you from Ddraig. This flaw grants you a few abilities that no other wielder of the Boosted Gear has possessed before. Instead of the Boosts the Sacred Gear would normally grant, you can summon Ddraig Y Goch, the Red Dragon Emperor himself, temporarily releasing him from his prison. Ddraig is no fool; he will serve you gladly and loyally to alleviate his suffering, knowing full well that your death would cost him this small freedom—the ability to feel the sun on his scales and the wind beneath his wings. You can summon Ddraig to a size about that of a parrot, at effectively no cost. However, to enable Ddraig to utilize his full size and power will put a strain on both you and the Boosted Gear. Each level of Child of the Welsh Dragon that you bear will grant you about three hours of Ddraig’s full power before he must return to the Boosted Gear for at least twelve hours.
objects.title: Boosted Gear: Galw'r Ddraig Goch

objects.text:
Your number of Evil Pieces has increased by 8. 7 of these additional pieces can be considered “minor pieces” and thus boost a specific ability/power similar to Bishops, Knights, and Rooks but not like Queens. 

The last additional piece is a “major piece” and thus gives a universal boost to people they are used on, similar to Queen pieces. This major piece can alternatively be specialized in order to give a massive singular boost to a single ability you have and this ability is also passed along with your demon heritage. 

For Brave Saints and Fallen Saints the additional pieces are as cards and are only a boost of 6 cards. However these 6 additional cards can reincarnate more powerful beings and can all be treated as minor pieces. Thus they can be specialized to specific abilities and powers similar to Evil Pieces. You can also choice the value of the additional cards when you use them. 

If you have the Global King System this upgrade gets spread to all peerages created through the Global King System.
objects.title: Fairy Chess

objects.text:
The greatest work of Ajuka Beelzebub, the Global King System was a monument to the 4 Great Satans and the Devil race as a whole. When a being of significant strength earned the approval of the 4 Great Satans they were allowed to touch the monument and be turned into a King, which gifted them an Evil Piece set and the ability to recruit others into their peerage.

This monument, now in your control, can create an unlimited number of Peerage sets from the selection of your own Peerage Pieces. As a result, if you have a standard Evil Pieces set, you can covert others into devil Kings, but if you have a Brave Saints set, then you can covert others into angel Kings.

However, for this monument to work the individual touching it must be of strength (although not always physical strength) comparable to a High-Class Devil and must have your approval in order to be reincarnated into a King.
objects.title: Global King System (High School DxD)

objects.text:
Now, you have the final piece to complete your set of Evil Pieces: a King Piece. King Pieces are rare; they were originally created during the early stages of the Evil Pieces development. They were deemed dangerous, and ultimately, only nine of these items were ever made.

The trait of the King Piece is power enhancement, capable of increasing the strength of its bearer by anywhere from 10 to 100 times their base strength. However, the King Piece in your possession is different—a “mutation piece” of sorts. It only increases your own strength to a maximum of 10 times your base strength, but in exchange, those who bear your Evil Pieces will also gain this tenfold increase to their base strength.
objects.title: King Piece (High School DxD)

objects.text:
You are in luck. One of your Evil Pieces has become a Mutation Piece. Mutation Pieces grant an increased level of power in comparison to a normal Evil Piece and reincarnating a person with one will only ever require a single Piece.
 Should you purchase the maximum amount, then all your Evil Pieces will undergo mutation, no matter how many you have.
objects.title: Mutation Piece (High School DxD)

objects.text:
Grand Servants are powerful Heroic Spirits summoned directly by the World itself, specifically to save humanity from the threat posed by the Beasts. Unlike the Holy Grail War—an artificial ritual created by humans to make Servants fight one another—the Grand Servant system exists solely to unite seven champions against a singular, overwhelming enemy.

Each Grand Servant is granted a Saint Graph of a rank far superior to that of ordinary Servants, placing them on an entirely different level. In comparison, regular Servants are considered convenient, multi-purpose familiars—versatile, but ultimately limited. If ordinary Servants are weapons designed to fight individuals, a Grand Servant is a weapon forged to confront the world itself.

While the Holy Grail War is a degraded imitation of the original Grand Servant system, the key difference between a standard Servant and a Grand Servant lies not in their comparative spiritual ranks alone, but in the rank and authority of the vessel they inhabit.

The title of Grand is granted to the "seven strongest of that era," each one standing at the absolute pinnacle of their respective Class. Candidates must possess unparalleled ability and heroic feats of extraordinary renown. Each Class—except for Grand Assassin—has multiple potential candidates, with the final choice determined by the specific threat facing humanity. As this is a role intended for humanity's champions, Divine Spirits are considered ineligible for Grand Servant status.

By selecting this option, you may obtain one Grand Servant Class Card. Due to the nature of Extra Classes, you cannot choose an Extra Class Servant as a Grand Servant. You may acquire another Grand Servant Class Card through the “More Cards” upgrade.
objects.title: Grand Servant Card (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
Divine Spirits are gods who have deteriorated since the end of the Age of Gods. They represent the highest classification of Nature Spirits—beings originally formed from human thought and born into the world independent of humanity’s collective will. Although they grow stronger through worship, they have since been diminished to the status of standard Divine Spirits.

Gods typically fall into two categories: those that were always present in the world and later became gods through worship—such as personified natural phenomena—and those who were reborn or elevated into divinity. Among Divine Spirits, there also exist Chief Gods—the supreme deities of their respective mythologies. Because some gods were so deeply tied to nature that they were considered sapient natural phenomena, Chief Gods are often seen as the closest thing to rulers of the planet.

All Divine Spirits possess a Divine Core within their Saint Graphs, which far surpasses the “Divinity” skill found in standard Heroic Spirits. The Divine Core functions like a heart, acting as the essential source of their divine identity and power.

Divine Spirits also wield Authorities—a unique category of ability exclusive to gods and agents of the World. While standard skills produce effects through logic or causality, Authorities manifest their effects simply because the user possesses the divine right to do so. A god’s Authority is tied to their domain—for example, Quetzalcoatl possesses Authority over both the sun and dragons, among others.

By choosing this option, you may obtain up to three Divine Spirit Class Cards. However, you cannot have more than one of the same class unless you take the “More Cards” upgrade. The Divine Spirits granted through these cards are Divided Spirits—fragments of their divinity rather than the full deities themselves.
objects.title: Divine Spirit Cards (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
The Beast Class is an Extra Class embodying calamities that threaten humanity. Unlike standard Servant Classes, Beasts exist on a scale far beyond that of conventional Saint Graphs.

Beasts are known as the Evils of Humanity, born from the karma generated by humanity’s advancement. They are divided into two categories: those who have been persecuted or oppressed by humanity, and those whom humanity has used to persecute or oppress others.

Despite their destructive nature, one qualification to become a Beast is a twisted “love for humanity.” These entities often aim to protect or uplift humanity in their own way, but their methods inevitably lead to devastation. Their vision of a "better future" threatens the stability of the current world.

Beasts are numbered from I to VII, with each seat open to be filled with an Evil of Humanity. While the Logos of a seat may differ between individuals, each seat maintains fundamental similarities.

Beasts possess the ability to erode and overwrite space itself, forcibly transforming their surroundings into manifestations of their nature. This spatial corruption is so potent that it can even affect Reality Marbles.

The Beast Class has three Class Skills: Independent Manifestation allows a Beast to project and materialize itself across time and space at will. As their souls exist beyond the boundaries of life, death, and the Human Order, they can appear freely across timelines as immortal avatars controlled by their consciousness.

Authority of the Beast is an Anti-Human Order Skill that grants the Beast's power to harm or destroy beings classified as “human.”

Nega Skills are conceptual negations that nullify specific concepts. For example, Nega-Summon disables the use of Noble Phantasms by Servants.

By selecting this option, you may obtain a single Beast Class Card. You may acquire another by selecting the “More Cards” upgrade.
objects.title: Beast Card (Type-Moon)

objects.text: You receive an additional Class Card each time you select this option, up to a maximum of 7 cards for a total of 14 Class Cards. You may only take one Class Card per class, so while you can obtain a second Saber card, you cannot acquire a third one after doing so.
objects.title: More Cards (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
Extra Classes are considered normally impossible classes that are abnormal by the standards of Proper Human History—unorthodox and often forbidden roles that fall outside the traditional framework of the seven standard Servant classes. These Classes are generally regarded as weapons that should not be wielded by humanity. Known Extra Classes include Avenger, Saver, Ruler, Alter Ego, MoonCancer, Shielder, Faker, Foreigner, and Pretender.

By choosing this option, you may select Extra Class Servants for your Class Cards instead of being limited to the standard seven. For example, you could build a set with six standard Servants and one Extra Class, or even construct a deck composed entirely of Extra Class Servants. However, this decision is permanent—you cannot change your chosen cards later. As with standard Classes, you may only have one card per Extra Class unless you obtain additional cards through the “More Cards” upgrade.

The Beast Class cannot be selected through this option, and excessively use of Extra Class Cards will not cause you to be seen as foreign to the Human Order.
objects.title: Extra Class Cards (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
Now, you have command over not only Magnus’s Staff but also his Eye. This floating, crystal-like sphere is inscribed with mysterious unknown script and radiates potent magic.

The Eye of Magnus is arguably one of the most powerful—and dangerous—artifacts in existence. Its true potential is unlocked only through the Staff, for it is Magnus’s crowning achievement: a sophisticated framework that created and interacts with the ley lines upon which Tamriel is built.

Ley lines are potent currents of magical energy that course beneath the land, enriching the areas they pass through. Their intersections are among the most coveted locations for magical defenses and settlements. Under your control, the Eye grants the power to forge new ley lines and manipulate existing ones.

Additionally, the Eye can adapt to any supernatural energies you possess, allowing you to propagate and channel these energies through both pre-existing and newly created ley lines.
objects.title: The Eye of Magnus (The Elder Scrolls)

objects.text: The Suniaster is an artifact said to contain the concept of “absolute supremacy.” According to legend, it grants the Throne of the One True God to whoever possesses it, bestowing near-absolute power upon them. While many of the stories are just legends, the relic in question does hold great power—if you can get your hands on it. The quest for this device led the Old Deus to war, as they attempted to claim its power for themselves. It wasn’t until a member of Immanity discovered that the term “Suniaster” referred to the core of the planet’s Spirit Circuit network—a network that provides magic to all races but Immanity—that its true nature was understood. Taking the form of a comparatively small crystal, the Suniaster contains the entire reserves of magical power the planet possesses. This amounts to hundreds, if not thousands, of times the magical energy held by even the oldest and greatest of the Old Deus. The Suniaster effectively bestows upon its bearer a level of sheer power that all other gods can only dream to one-day obtain. With the heart of the planet’s power in your hands, you are free to recreate the 16 Exceed at your leisure—simply willing them into existence, forged in an instant with the Suniaster’s immense power.
objects.title: Suniaster (No Game No Life)

objects.text:
Instead of merely gaining a single Coffin of Eternal Sleep, you gain dominion over an entire graveyard, one saturated with necrotic energy and teeming with undead that rise to serve you. The graveyard is the nexus of necrotic energy, causing corpses buried within the grounds to rise as loyal low-tier undead. Any corpse in the graveyard or its surroundings will be immediately animated by this unholy energy, transforming into mindless but obedient servants bound to you.

In a few days, the undead that dwell within the graveyard are slowly transformed by the constant influx of necrotic energy. Low-tier undead that remain in the graveyard will gradually grow in power, ascending to mid-tier status, with the potential for even greater growth if left for long enough. These more powerful undead develop the ability to manipulate the necrotic energies of the graveyard, granting them control over lesser undead, establishing a hierarchy of necromantic power. The longer they remain in the graveyard, the deeper their connection to it becomes, making them formidable protectors of your domain.

The graveyard is not just a source of undead soldiers, but also a formidable defensive stronghold. The land itself becomes hostile to the living, sapping the vitality of intruders and weakening their resolve. Healing and divine magic struggle to function within the cursed grounds, and intruders will find themselves constantly besieged by the oppressive presence of death.
objects.title: Graveyard of Eternal Dominion

addons.text:
In the heart of your undead city, a grand cathedral suddenly emerges, a divine structure that radiates both holy and necrotic energy. The moment it appears, the undead populace of the city flocks to it, drawn by an overwhelming sense of reverence and awe. Once mindless soldiers, they now become pious believers, either venerating the god you serve or exalting you as their divine ruler. Vampires bathe in holy water, finding new vitality within it, while skeletons carve holy scriptures into their bones, carrying the weight of their faith etched upon their very forms. Even the most sinister of undead find themselves compelled to worship, imbuing the city with an eerie, yet profound, sense of holiness amidst death.

The necropolis is now a sanctified domain, where the low-tier undead become holy sentinels, patrolling with renewed fervor. The mid-tier undead nobles act as high priests and clerics, managing the city’s divine logistics and spreading faith. The high-tier undead, including liches and vampiric lords, serve as your holy generals, commanding armies with both necrotic and divine might.

Through the Cathedral’s power, all undead in the city are now immune to holy energy, turning what was once their greatest weakness into a strength. Not only can they resist divine magic, but they can also wield holy power themselves, channeling it through their undead forms. Your necropolis is now a shining beacon of necromantic and holy synergy, an unassailable fortress where death and divinity coexist in perfect harmony.
addons.title: Land of Holy Death

addons.text:
The necropolis is built upon the massive Corpse of an Entity, an incomprehensibly powerful being whose death has transformed the land. The Entity’s enormous form stretches across the center of the city, its colossal body acting as the foundation for your dark empire.

The Entity’s shards—some still intact, others damaged—are embedded throughout the city. These shards can be activated and harvested to enhance your undead army. The low-tier undead now unconsciously draw power from the dormant shards, granting them enhanced capabilities tied to the Entity’s power. Mid-tier undead can tap into the more potent shards, allowing them to specialize in specific fields, such as increased strategic acumen or improved combat prowess.

The most powerful high-tier undead, such as liches and vampiric lords, can directly bond with specific shards, unlocking a portion of the Entity’s original might, essentially becoming something akin to Titans. These undead become immensely powerful, capable of wielding abilities unique to the Entity. Their connection with the shards also grants them access to the Entity’s stored knowledge, giving your necropolis a record of all its past Cycles.

Though the safeguards on the Entity’s shards prevent them from randomly connecting to the living or acting uncontrollably, you, as the ruler of the necropolis, have the authority to selectively activate and bond shards to key individuals or constructs. The power of the Entity becomes a vital part of your empire, fueling both your undead and the city itself. As the necropolis continues to thrive on the body of the Entity, your dominion becomes more than just a realm of undeath—it becomes an extension of a cosmic force, elevating your power and the city’s influence to unimaginable heights.
addons.title: Death of the Deathless

addons.text:
You are no longer just a ruler of the undead—you become an immortal, high-tier undead, bonded to the necropolis. An unending flow of necrotic energy courses through you, continuously rejuvenating your strength and amplifying your powers. As long as the city stands, neither you nor your undead can die. Even if your physical body is destroyed, you will reform, drawing power from the vast reservoir of undeath within the city’s core.

Your transformation into a high-tier undead grants you immense physical and magical abilities. You no longer age, tire, or weaken. Your body is now impervious to decay, regenerating from any injury with terrifying speed. This endless supply of energy allows you to summon vast armies of undead at will, effortlessly reanimating fallen foes or strengthening your minions.

All undead within the necropolis are now linked to your essence, sharing the city’s immortality. They, too, can regenerate from death, reforming over time as long as the necropolis remains intact. This connection allows you to command them with absolute authority, controlling their actions and siphoning their energy when needed.

The city itself becomes a beacon of undeath, radiating energy that spreads throughout the surrounding lands. This necrotic energy empowers both you and your undead, making you nearly invincible within its confines. You can draw upon the city’s energy to fuel devastating abilities, channeling the raw power of the undead to obliterate your enemies or empower your own form. The city acts as your phylactery—so long as it stands, you and your army cannot be permanently destroyed.
addons.title: I am Death, Destroyer of Worlds

objects.text:
You gain dominion over a vast, dark city—a Necropolis steeped in necrotic power and teeming with a ready-made society of undead that serve you without question. This ancient city, long forgotten by the living, is now your seat of power, its streets lined with shadowy buildings and its skyline dominated by towering spires of bone and obsidian. The moment you assume control, the city’s undead inhabitants—an army of low-tier to high-tier undead—pledge their undying loyalty to you, awaiting your command.

The undead army is immediately at your disposal, an organized and disciplined force. The low-tier undead, consisting of skeletal soldiers, ghouls, and zombies, form the bulk of your forces, patrolling the streets and protecting the necropolis. These tireless soldiers require no rest or sustenance, ensuring that the city is always ready for battle.
