Mid-tier undead, including undead knights, wraiths, and lich attendants, serve as captains and strategists, leading the lesser undead into combat and maintaining order within the city. At the top of this hierarchy are the high-tier undead, powerful beings such as death knights, vampiric lords, and liches, who act as your generals and personal advisors, ensuring that your dominion remains unchallenged. These high-tier undead are not only powerful combatants but also masters of necromantic magic, capable of summoning even more undead to swell your ranks.
objects.title: Necropolis of Eternal Sovereignty

objects.text:
From the moment you acquire the Spirit Calling Bell, it comes pre-attuned with the Mimic Tear Ashes, granting you the ability to summon a perfect spectral copy of yourself. Unlike other spirits bound to the bell, the Mimic Tear does not rely on external entities—it mirrors you, wielding your weapons, wearing your armor, and utilizing your abilities with an uncanny level of skill.

The Mimic Tear’s potential is directly tied to your own growth. As you gain strength, so too does your duplicate, ensuring that it remains a formidable force regardless of your chosen path. Whether you are a master of sorcery, a brutal melee combatant, or a nimble assassin, your Mimic will replicate your tactics, bringing the full force of your power to the battlefield.

Though bound by the spectral nature of the Spirit Calling Bell, the Mimic Tear possesses significant durability, especially when upgraded. As you deepen your attunement with it, its resilience, damage, and effectiveness will scale alongside your mastery of the bell.
objects.title: Mimic Tear (Elden Ring)

addons.text:
You did not inherit the Grail’s corruption—you are the one who tainted it. Rather than being warped or controlled by its will, you crushed it, sinking your curse into its core and forcing it to bow. The Grail’s power is no longer a thing you possess—it is a part of you, and its once-sacred mechanisms now operate under your absolute authority.

The Corrupted Grail has been absorbed into your soul like a second heart, granting you its near limitless energy. Your body has become a living conduit of cursed energy, able to conjure and command the black mud of All the World’s Evil with terrifying freedom. The Grail manifests your desires directly, reshaping magical laws around you. You can unleash the mud in waves, shape it into weapons, or flood entire landscapes with cursed mana that warps leylines, silences sacred spaces, and overrides divine protections. The spread of this corruption feeds your inner Grail, letting it generate power from suffering, death, or despair—all of which you now passively absorb from the world around you.

Any Servant you summon is automatically Blackened, their will overwritten or fused with your own. These Servants draw mana from your internalized Grail and act as extensions of your will. Even without summoning, you can create phantasmal constructs or pseudo-Servants from raw curse-stuff, shaped by intent and hatred.
addons.title: Soul of All the World’s Evil

objects.text:
The Grail you possess has been irreparably tainted. Whether through exposure to the evils of humanity, a failed wish, or deliberate invocation of cursed forces, it now reflects the abyss more than Akasha. Its form remains unchanged, but its function—and its hunger—are no longer yours to control.

Wishes made through the Corrupted Grail are stronger and less limited than before. It can do things the normal Grail can’t. Its corruption also lets you summon beings that shouldn’t be possible, like Avenger-class Servants, monsters, or even entities from beyond the world—including those who wouldn’t normally qualify for summoning at all.

Using the Grail, you can manipulate souls directly: extracting them, binding them, consuming them to empower spells or binding them within the Grail for storage or ritual purposes. You can also accelerate the Grail’s recharge through the suffering and sacrifice of others, using deaths, disasters, and anguish to fuel it instantly. When desperate, you can even offer fragments of your own soul to instantly recharge it or gain a temporary surge in power.

However, the Grail is no longer a neutral artifact. It's corrupted and will infect everything it touches. All spells, rituals, and even passive magical effects conducted through the Grail become twisted, ironic, or cruel in outcome—granting the letter of your intention, but often perverting its spirit. Even mundane uses risk triggering malicious side effects as the Grail interprets all action through the logic of “All the World’s Evil.”

With every use, the Grail erodes your mind, morals, and identity. Its influence seeps into your thoughts, guiding you toward further dependence and increasingly extreme acts. Over time, you will begin to hear voices, experience intrusive desires, and lose the ability to distinguish your own will from that of the Grail. When this corruption reaches a certain threshold, you become unable to part with the Grail—soul-bound to it.

At this stage, your soul becomes its final offering. If you die while bound to the Grail, your soul is devoured utterly—either becoming raw fuel for its future use or incarnating as a dark echo of your former self: a puppet vessel that grants wishes not for you, but for the Grail itself.

That said, the corruption is not entirely without limits. If you exercise extreme discipline—using the Grail only in moments of absolute necessity, resisting its temptations, and avoiding gratuitous sacrifice—you can mitigate its influence. With careful restraint and clarity of purpose, the Grail’s power can be wielded with minimal consequence, and over time, its hold on you may even weaken, allowing fragments of your soul and sanity to recover. But the line is razor-thin, and the Grail never forgets the taste of a willing master.
objects.title: Corrupted Grail

objects.text: You can improve the power of your wands. For each selection, you can increase a single wand spell level by one, up to level nine. While the recharge rate remains the same, for each level above four, the maximum number of charges will decrease by half, rounded down (so 5th is 25, 6th is 12, 7th is 6, 8th is 3 and 9th is 1). Those wands are also more complex to recharge manually, but not impossible.
objects.title: Greater Wand (D&D)

objects.text:
You are no longer just the average wielder of the Talismans; you have taken in the essence of the creator of the Talismans himself Shendu absorbing his power for yourself as he did with the Noble Animals that represented the Chinese Zodiacs, his mastery of Demon Sorcerery and his nature as a dragon are now yours to command you can take the form of Shendu The Apocalypse of which Legend speaks becoming an ancient dragon with enhanced physical capabilities able to leap over buildings and lift mountains effortlessly.

Similar to Shendu you now know how to turn your own abilities into Talismans to grant a fraction of your powers to another; these Talismans can not be used against you in any form and can corrupt those who wield them into being your pawns, you can also turn those you have defeated into Talismans granting you further abilities similar to how The Ultimate Evil Shendu turned the Noble Animals into artifacts for his own gain. You also know the location of your Talismans, no matter how far they are from you, nor what barriers would block your detection of them.

You also have become the King of the Shadowkhan; having replaced Shendu as the master of shadows, you can summon legions of Shadowkhan at your beck and call from the Shadow Realm from any location that has any amount of darkness. The shadows are no longer safe for your enemies, a legion of shadow ninja now in your grasp. The Shadowkhan possesses amongst their ranks Ninja Khan; however, they can also recruit new members into the Shadowkhan.
objects.title: Shendu Reborn (Jackie Chan Adventures)

objects.text: Your Replication Box has recived a new capability. Where before, it would always leave dead copies, now... it can copy organic life as well! Each companion or individual you put inside are temporarily put unconscious until the cloning is done, and follows the same rule as before: The stronger the person is, the longer it takes. Thankfully, the person is fed through the box's own energy, so they won't die while the copying takes place. In this case, an average mundane human or one only slightly above peak would take a day to copy. However, a companion that has a power level worth 15 CP would take a month, and a companion whose power is equivalent to 60 CP could take 2 whole years to clone. But, despite all of these, the clone does come with benefits, which thankfully include an inherent loyalty to you, and the embedded knowledge they're a clone, meaning thankfully no existential crisis's. They also have a natural charisma and ability to get along with their original, though never to your detriment.
objects.title: Biological Copy

objects.text:
Your Replication box now has evolved in a rather interesting and helpful way. Beyond now being able to decide the relative appearance of your box to disguise it if needed, the speed of its copy ability has skyrocketed. Previously, a normal or weakly supernatural item (around 1 SP) took a day and 15 SP worthy items being a month to copy, even if perfectly.

With each purchase, you can halve the time needed for each object to be copied. 

1 day becoming 12 hours, 12 hours becoming 6 hours, 6 hours becoming 3 hours and so on.
objects.title: Caffeine Copier

objects.text:
The power of the Heart of Tengu has been enhanced, now allowing you to bind and control the Foot Mystics at their full power. The Mystics can manipulate greater amounts of their element and to a finer extent, this extends to their shapeshifting, allowing them to specifically shape their bodies.

Their black magic has returned to full power, allowing them to utilize additional abilities. This includes, but is not limited to; projecting lightning bolts, teleporting, opening portals, disguising themselves, levitating objects, creating shields, and commanding demonic minions.
objects.title: Dark Heart of Tengu

objects.text:
Your grimoire awakens a Demon Lord Factor within you, transforming your relationship with magic from structured study into instinctive authority.

Your Thema deepens into a core expression of one of the Seven Sins, no longer just a framework for understanding magic but a driving force that shapes how your power manifests. This alignment enhances every spell you create, reinforcing it with overwhelming presence, efficiency, and scale. Magic that once required careful construction now flows naturally, forming complete and stable formulas with far less effort.

You gain the ability to directly interfere with and overwrite external magical structures. Spells, barriers, and constructs can be unraveled, reinterpreted, or forcibly brought under your control by asserting your own magical logic over them. This allows you to dominate magical exchanges, turning opposing techniques into resources or dismantling them outright.

Your mana capacity expands dramatically, accompanied by a continuous, self-sustaining flow of energy. This allows sustained high-output casting, rapid formula iteration in combat, and the ability to maintain multiple complex spells simultaneously without loss of stability.

The grimoire evolves alongside this awakening, becoming a true extension of your will. Its interface sharpens into a more independent and forceful presence, capable of rapid analysis, predictive modeling, and aggressive optimization of your magic in real time.

You also gain access to Demon Lord–class spell frameworks. These are large-scale, high-impact techniques built around domination, erasure, reconstruction, or absolute control within the scope of your Thema. Such spells are instinctively understood, though mastering their full potential requires continued use and refinement.

Your presence alone begins to exert pressure on the magical environment. Weaker spells destabilize in your vicinity, ambient mana bends toward your influence, and other magi can feel the weight of your power even before you act.

The more you embrace your Thema and its associated Sin, the more naturally your power expands. Your magic becomes faster, heavier, and more absolute, evolving from structured casting into direct imposition of your will upon reality through the logic of your magic.
objects.title: Demon Lord Factor (Trinity Seven)

objects.text:
Enchanted by a Fae smith, blessed by some wild god, or by some other unknown means: your horn has received another deeply perilous ability. Should you so choose when you sound it you may summon one of the many Wild Hunts to your location. This does not give any means to control the hunt, beyond calling them.

A Wild Hunt is a form of flying spiritual procession accompanied by severe stormy weather. It may be lead and composed of many dangerous beings: from the god Odin and his host of Valkyrie and Einherjar (or possibly one of said Valkyrie) upon many-legged horses, to Gwynn ap Nudd or Arawn and the hosts of the Fae accompanied by the Cwn Annwn hunting dogs, or great hosts of ghosts lead by figures such as Herne the Hunter or King Arthur, or many others. These beings are not effected by any normal weaknesses they would otherwise have during the hunt.

Barring those of exceptional power, only a fool would attempt to challenge such a host in battle: any who try would be swiftly killed and their ghosts brought into the hunt, or captured and forced to join. They will pursue whatever they decide is a suitable quarry until at least the next Sunrise, destroying nearly everything else in their path; and few can evade them for long.

However the Hunt is bound by a few rules: they may not take or harm an individual standing in the exact centre of an ancient road, nor may they take someone who has entered a holy place (except if it belongs to a member of the Hunt), and they may not enter a dwelling uninvited except if it is built blocking an ancient road or their quarry has fled inside. Further, any who aid the hunt (the classic examples being shoeing the horse of its leader or giving them directions to suitable prey) will receive payment in gold, silver, magical blessings, or part of their magical prey.

For more mundane methods of avoiding the attention of a hunt: falling flat on the ground before they spot you has a decent chance to work, providing there is something else nearby they might decide would be good sport.
objects.title: Call the Hunt

objects.text:
Through the Base Builder 9000, you can summon non-sentient, video game AI-like workers to assist you. Summoning workers will cost materials, usually the same materials used to create whichever structure they are deployed in. The number of workers that can be summoned is based on the size of the structure they are deployed in; the bigger the structure, the more workers. The skillset of these workers is based on the type of structure they are deployed in. Workers summoned to a guard garrison will be Guards, each trained for combat. Workers summoned to a farm would be Farmers, and the farms themselves would be able to summon farm animals such as chickens or cows. You also gain access to a database that holds data on all of your workers, including their status. If a worker dies, you will be able to re-summon them as long as the structure they were deployed in is not destroyed. You can move a worker to another structure, and they will gain the appropriate skills at the cost of losing their past skills. Any skill naturally learned will be retained, however. 

Do note that while they can follow orders and make limited independent decisions, with your having the option to change their parameters and scripting to have them do different things under different circumstances, they are unable to truly think for themselves.
objects.title: Base Workers

objects.text:
You now have pocket dimension of dry docks that can reproduce and conduct maintenance on any ships you have. 

These dry docks can restock and preform maintenance on any ship or vehicle you want in a single day, regardless of whether or not that ship or vehicle is an Object of Power. 

However, for production, these dry docks will take longer to produce more powerful ships. You gain one slot for each vehicle or ship you have purchased from Item or Object of Power. Each one of these dry dock slots then produce vehicles and ships at a rate of 1sp (or 2cp) worth of Items or Objects of Power per day. Each slot can only work on a single ship or vehicle at a time and each ship or vehicle being produced can only be worked on by a single slot. 

Additionally, you can upload the blueprints of any ships (Object of Power or not) and have your Base Builder 9000 construct them instantly but at the cost of materials from your inventory. However, this upgrade does not include any knowledge about how to plan or design ships but does automatically include any ships or vehicles you start with. 

Furthermore, if you have the Base Workers upgrade then the workers you generate will also crew your newly produced ships and vehicles as well.
objects.title: Dry Docks

objects.text:
The Frolis Maneuver is an advanced technique of Morphing. It involves acquiring multiple genetic samples of the same species and combining them to create a customized, unique Morph—a hybrid form that retains the core biological traits of the original species but can be tailored to specific needs or desires.

You have mastered this technique to a degree unmatched by others, pushing its boundaries far beyond its original limits. Through your experimentation and ingenuity, you have developed the ability not only to merge multiple samples of a single species but also to blend the morphs of different species altogether, forging Chimeras—biological hybrids that fuse traits from various creatures into a single, cohesive form. 

This process comes at a cost: each Morph used in the combination is effectively consumed, requiring you to re-acquire your desired morphs again.

The resulting hybrid must be biologically plausible—it cannot violate fundamental principles of biology. For example, you might scale an eagle to the height of a lion and blend the features into a griffin. The griffin-like form would require appropriate wing structure, musculature, and skeletal support to sustain flight.
objects.title: Frolis Chimera (Animorphs)

objects.text:
The nanites swarm in your body has been upgraded with the capabilities of the Beta Nanites, which was the second attempt at controlling nanites before the creation of the Omega Nanite. Unlike the rogue Alpha nanite, your sentient nanite swarm are incredibly stable, and does not require a constant supply of materials to maintain stability. With this, you gain the unique ability to fuse with machines and living beings, gaining all their positive traits and abilities. However, you can also drain the energy from living beings to strengthen yourself and repair any damage you sustained rapidly. 

Additionally, your initial technopathy has been greatly boosted, allowing you to easily take control most unprotected machines near you.
objects.title: Beta-2 Nanites (Generator Rex)

objects.text:
Within you now resides a colony of Omicron Nanites, the core nanotechnology featured in M. Rex, which remarkably differs from its Generator Rex counterparts. These nanites possess full self-awareness, each with its thoughts, emotions, memories, and distinct personalities. Their primary mission is to protect you, their host, from harm, excelling at regenerating your body, purging toxins, and granting extraordinary powers.

As the Omicron Nanites' host, you gain remarkable abilities akin to Omega-1 Nanites, but surpassing them vastly. You can manifest colossal machines, designing and creating any device you possess the technical knowledge to craft. While the nanites don't contain pre-existing designs, they greatly boost your creativity, the potential technology your mind conjures knows no bounds. Moreover, you can manipulate the environment at will, forming openings, spikes, walls, and even weapons from raw matter. The nanites themselves also use these abilities to defend you independently.

Additionally, the Omicron Nanites possess an impressive resistance to technopathy, making controlling them a daunting task for any entity. Only an entity wielding power akin to a Meta-Nanite could hope to exert control over them.
objects.title: Omicron Nanites (Generator Rex: Machina Rex)

objects.text:
Your once-broken Ancient Belkan device is now revealed to be a part of the Tome series, whether it be the Night, Orange, Azure, Purple, or other you can choose.

Despite most of its memory being corrupted and lost, the Tome of ##### Sky emerges as a formidable Ancient Belkan device. It possesses the unique capability to compile spells within its pages, granting users the ability to cast them at will. The tome features a Guardian Knights system and a Unison Device, adapting to different roles as it can function as a Weapon-type, Wearable-type, and/or Auxiliary control-type, changing forms at your command.

Its Master Program is an AI so advanced that it possesses both sapience and sentience, but it remains in low power mode until the energy concerns are resolved, designed to assist you, it's Lord, in utilizing the tome effectively. An intriguing aspect of the Tome's database is its knowledge of the foundational magic systems across all Nanoha media, spanning Midchilda, Ancient Belka, and Modern Belka. 

As an additional choice, the first time you use and the core is formed, you can opt to become a descendant of a Saint King, endowing your magical energy with an iridescent (rainbow-colored) glow and manifesting heterochromia.
objects.title: Tome of ***** Sky (Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha)

objects.text:
The Demonica, short for "DEMOuntable Next Integrated Capability Armor," is an adaptive suit of armor (and attached gun) with the abilities of a COMP, with the added benefit that it uses magic to become more powerful (by extension making the user more powerful) the more combat data it's fed. This has no logical upper limit; the ones used in the Schwarzwelt Incident eventually adapted to be able to fight Shekinah, that universes' avatar of God and the creator of that universe.

It also includes an improved scanner suite that can detect hidden doors, traps, and invisible beings.

This starts at the level of the game's opening, a run of the mill fictional power armor. You can choose for it to appear as the default Demonica, the black and red version used by Jack's squad, or the futuristic variant used by Alex.
objects.title: Demonica (Shin Megami Tensei)

objects.text:
Your Demonica now comes with one of the aircraft carrier sized vehicles used during the Schwarzwelt Expedition, like the Red Sprite, the Elve, the Blue Jet, the Gigantic, or the Lightning.

This craft includes multiple methods of movement (both wheeled and VTOL Flight), scientific laboratories and industrial production facilities, an armory full of spare Demonica suits, an advanced AI system named after the sci-fi author of your choice (which is capable of piloting the craft and operating it's systems in the absence of a crew), energy shields, high-energy physics equipment to perform dimensional shifting, and so much more. Above all, it has the adaptive capabilities of the Demonica itself, allowing a craft type that perished to the Schwarzwelt's weakest demons to eventually keep up with God's Heralds, both in resisting their attacks and in keeping up with their speed, which was enough to cross entire universes in less than a second. Almost any capability can be reverse engineered, created from whole cloth, or jury rigged by the ship's AI, with the example of Arthur even devising successful plans to make use of the prima materia of the universe, the Cosmic Eggs.
objects.title: Red Sprite (Shin Megami Tensei)

addons.text: As a Primarch yourself, the Sangprimus Portum naturally contains your own Gene Seed as well. Thus, you may optionally have your Space Marine Chapter be composed partially or totally by your own Sons. Space Marines of your own Gene Seed will possess an exceptionally fanatical loyalty to you akin to the other Legions’ loyalty to their Primarchs.
addons.title: Sons of Your Own

addons.text:
You have gained an additional full Chapter of Adeptus Astartes—this one composed of the Blood Angels. However, these Blood Angels are… different. Their name has become literal. Their nature reflects the duality of their Primarch: the Noble and Righteous Aspect, embodying his compassion, grace, heroism, and protective will; and the Anguished and Dark Aspect, from which the Red Thirst and the Black Rage originate. Of your new Chapter, 945 are low-class Angel Vampire / Dead Apostle hybrids, 55 are mid-class hybrids, each one a near-mythic apex of their fused lineage. All of them revere you with the same devotion they hold for the Emperor and Sanguinius himself, recognizing you as a guiding figure their altered souls resonate with.

Their hybrid nature has profoundly transformed both the Red Thirst and the Black Rage. The Red Thirst now grants tangible benefits and is vastly easier to control. By consuming a single gallon of blood from any being, a Blood Angel gains a minor but cumulative affinity toward that being’s abilities—subtle at first, but capable of stacking with startling speed. The Black Rage retains its usual combat potency and ferocity, but no longer permanently destroys the mind of a fallen Blood Angel. Instead, entering the Rage grants a form of short-term death resistance, functioning like a temporary pseudo-perpetual state—they cannot die unless completely atomized, though they do not regenerate mid-battle. When the Rage subsides, they experience a burst of temporary regeneration strong enough to stabilize them in a critical-but-survivable condition; if they receive medical attention within two hours, they will make a full recovery rather than being lost to death.

all of them possess full Wargear, in peak condition.
addons.title: Blood Angels… literally

objects.text: "Rise up, Humanity! Rise from the ashes! Claim your birthright! SPACE!” A galaxy at war; the Emperor needed Angels of Death to be his hands to unify and conquer the galaxy in his name. He is not alone in having armies of Space Marines; you have used the Sangprimus Portum and have created a Chapter of Space Marines(roughly around 1,000 Space Marines) to help you conquer the world or perhaps to bring order to chaos. These Space Marines can be of any legion using the various Gene-Seed that the Sangprimus Portum has available from both the loyalist legions and non-loyalist legions. As the Sangprimus Portum has the purest form of Gene-Seed, the Space Marines created to found your Space Marine Chapter will not possess the flaws that are typical of a standard Space Marine legion associated with any specific Primarch you have chosen to host your Legion of Space Marines. The Space Marines are issued standard Space Marine gear; however, it will not be modern Space Marine gear. Instead, it will be gear that they had access to during the Great Crusade. This gear can be anywhere from the start to near the tail end of the Great Crusade; however, anything further will not be available for your Space Marines Chapter. You are blessed; you now possess a book within the Sangprimus Portum that details all the notes the Emperor ever had when creating his genetically enhanced supersoldiers both the Space Marines and the Primarchs this will also include notes from Malcador, the Emperor, and his many collaborators in experiments into creating Female Versions of the Primarchs that the Emperor scraped due to not wanting humanity to be ruled by the genetically enhanced.
objects.title: Crusade of Man (Warhammer: 40K)

objects.text: "Our principle is that what the enemy can see, he will soon learn to fear" It seems that you have deciphered more of the Emperors notes; now instead of outfitting your Space Marines with substandard wargear from the Great Crusade you can issue your Chapter with Wargear from modern Warhammer including several instances of Terminator Armor; while you won't be able to issue your entire Chapter with Tactical Dreadnought Armour, you will be able to outfit at least a singular company's worth of Space Marines(100) in Terminator Armor. This Upgrade in equipment is not solely focused on just the Armour of the Space Marines, as they are now outfitted with better weapons then just as simple bolter or chainsword for both melee and ranged; created from the best forge worlds your Chapter has access to Plasma Weapons and various other armaments that would ordinarily reserved for the best of the best such as Force Weapons. Including both land and air armoured assault vehicles, such as the Predator and Land Raider, to name a few land vehicles your Space Marines possess, it does not include any vehicle that could be considered a spacecraft. To help in keeping your new upgraded equipment up to standard, a portion of your Space Marine Chapter, around 100 trained to become Techmarines under the tutelage of the Cult Mechanicum, will understand the intricacies of the technology they repair. You also gain a small contingent of Space Marine Librarians added to your Chapter, around a singular company's worth of Space Marines. As they are separate from the warp dangers, should you wish, your Librarians can be shielded from the harmful nature of the warp.
objects.title: Beware the Terminator (Warhammer: 40K)

objects.text: "They shall be my sons, and in them will live the hopes of a unified Humanity. Theirs will be the strength to prevail, not only when victory lies within easy reach, but even when it seems unattainable, when doom settles like a shroud all about. In those times of darkness, my noble sons will shine the brightest of all." You have accomplished the impossible and deciphered the notes from the Emperor on the creation of his crowning achievement and greatest mistake: the Primarchs. You have achieved what only two other people have managed to accomplish. Your legions of Space Marines now have a Single Primarch born from your own genius to help you conquer the world or perhaps to bring order to chaos. This Primarch can be a clone of any existing Primarch, or it can be a wholly original being created in your image of perfection incarnate and possessing loyalty beyond what the Emperor himself instilled into his own creations. Your Primarch possesses wargear on par with the armour and weapons that the Emperor himself created for his own Primarchs' artefacts that further boost the power of your Primarch to levels beyond ordinary. As your creation was not hurled into Chaos the second of its creation, you will not have to worry about Chaos-born mutations infecting the Gene-Seed that the Primarch houses within itself. Your Space Marine Chapter has now extended into that of a full legion with the added help of having a Warmaster to lead your forces, as well as adding additional gene-seed to the forces, allowing for quirk replacements to be made to your troops from your new Warmaster.
objects.title: Warmaster (Warhammer: 40k)

objects.text:
The Emperor needed tools to reshape the galaxy in his image and bring about his vision of the future, and in doing so, he created the Primarch as little more than a tool. You are now his only true equal in creating primarchs, while a small selection of others have managed to create a single primarch in their attempts to imitate the Emperor. You have gone above and beyond the impossible, beyond just creating a single primarch; you have created multiple in your need for a proper army to conquer and unify much more than just a single world.

You have now created an equal amount of Primarchs to that of the Emperor, equaling to around 20 genetically-engineered transhuman children. As with Warmaster, this can be a clone of any existing Primarch, a wholly original being in your own image of perfection, or a modified clone of any canon Primarch. For each option, you can optionally make each Primarch possess a loyalty beyond what the Emperor ever instilled into his own creations.

Each of your Primarchs now possesses wargear on par with the armour and weapons the Emperor himself created for his own Primarchs, further boosting their power considerably, beyond what they already possess, to levels exceeding those of an ordinary Primarch. As your creations were not taken directly into Chaos across the universe seconds after their creation, you will not have to worry about Chaos-born mutations infecting the gene-seeds the Primarchs possess, nor your creations suddenly deciding to worship Chaos Gods.

As with the original Primarchs, each Primarch now has its own Space Marine Chapter that has received the gene-seed from their perspective. A new Primarch possesses loyalty in equal measure to both you and the Primarch from which the Space Marine Chapter has received its gene-seed.
objects.title: Primarch Project: Primarchs of Man (Warhammer: 40k)

objects.text:
You now command your own contingent of Custodians—fifty in total—along with a single exemplar on the level of Constantin Valdor himself, on top of your chapter(s) of Astartes. Their loyalty to you eclipses even the loyalty they once held for the Emperor of Mankind, remaining absolute under any circumstance. Each Custodian possesses staggering physical ability: on the low end capable of hoisting a large elevator packed with two hundred-pound men up its shaft one-handed in a single motion; on the high end effortlessly lifting heavy tankers; and at their peak delivering a single strike with the destructive force of roughly 170 megatons of TNT. 

Their speed renders them invisible to ordinary humans and nothing more than golden blurs even to Adeptus Astartes. Every Custodian has perfect recall, effortlessly mastering and retaining all information they encounter, including the complete array of known languages. 

Their breadth of expertise spans xenos cultures, Imperial politics, military doctrine, technology, and philosophy. They are innate tacticians capable of coordinated, near-precognitive action through sheer analytical processing, operating independently as hyper-competent lords of the Imperium shaped by centuries of training and a bespoke creation process. 

Their intelligence surpasses even the greatest baseline human genius, and in certain domains rivals or exceeds that of the Primarchs themselves, making each Custodian a companion intellectually fit for the Emperor, and maybe, you.

Your Valdor-level Custodian stands as a paragon among them, possessing the skill and physical might to contend with the weakest Primarchs, such as Fulgrim. All Custodians radiate an overwhelming presence that induces a form of Transhuman Dread even in Astartes.

all of them possess full Wargear, in peak condition.
objects.title: Your Custodes Reborn (Warhammer: 40K)

objects.text:
Your Core now becomes the latest and final prototype of the series, The DH-13. The DH-13 combines all the powers from the DH-Series, all 12 of them, and amplifies them by about 20% in all areas. The DH-13 incorporates all these abilities: 

DH-01 - Aries
Origin: United States
Role: Oversees and maintains the DH series.

DH-02 - Taurus
Origin: United States
Concept: Unstoppable Force
Description: Uses enhancement spells for extreme firepower, capable of obliterating obstacles.

DH-03 - Gemini
Origin: China
Concept: Super Speed
Description: Accelerates beyond human perception, converting speed into destructive force.

DH-04 - Cancer
Origin: Russia
Concept: Super Heavy Armor
Description: Features impenetrable armor and defense spells, ideal for frontline protection.

DH-05 - Leo
Origin: Japan
Concept: Overgrowth
Description: Mimics and masters techniques, growing infinitely stronger over time.

DH-06 - Virgo
Origin: India
Concept: Super Regeneration
Description: Uses instant, automated healing spells for rapid recovery.

DH-07 - Libra
Origin: US-EU
Concept: Quantity Strategy
Description: Controls multiple unmanned units to overwhelm opponents with sheer numbers.

DH-08 - Scorpio
Origin: Italy
Concept: Espionage and Support
Description: Excels in indirect combat with support spells but is vulnerable in direct fights.

DH-09 - Sagittarius
Origin: Germany
Concept: Ultra-Long-Range Bombing
Description: Conducts wide-area surveillance and precise long-range bombardments.

DH-10 - Capricorn
Origin: European Union
Concept: Metamorphosis
Description: Transforms into mythical beasts to adapt to different combat scenarios.

DH-11 - Aquarius
Origin: England
Concept: Fully Automatic Counterattack
Description: Uses ice spells to create freezing fields, turning enemies into ice statues.

DH-12 - Pisces
Origin: Israel-Egypt-Saudi Arabia Union
Concept: Super Poison
Description: Utilizes powerful poison spells effective in extreme environments.
objects.title: Akashic Engine - 13 (Yuusha, Yamemasu)
Guyver Gigantic (Guyver)

objects.text: Each purchase of this allows you to select another Divine Key.
objects.title: Another Divine Key (Honkai Impact 3rd)

objects.text:
It seems your nanomachines aren't actually all that bad, being better than what the lower quality advertised. Its regeneration is superior, allowing the reattachment of limbs, and being able to regrow limbs within a year given the resources, and can purge any mundane virus/poison/lead. 

It can also understand you now, and listen to your commands instead of just doing its thing, allowing it to prioritize your wants, although it will never try to actively be a detriment to your survival on its own. It is also capable of communicating with you.

It can also well put you comfortably above peak human with the active usage of nanomachines, as it basically "reinforces" your body in any way you need it. Do note though this will significantly decrease the amount of nanomachines available for other tasks, depending on how much you are using.

Its firewall is much stronger, and no computer in the modern era is capable of hacking it. Its ability to recover is also much better, allowing it to go from almost gone, to a full recovery within a month, instead of the snail pace the low-tier nanomachines go.
objects.title: Medium-Quality Nanomachines

objects.text:
Now this is the real deal. These are the nanomachines you get when you wanna start edging physics. It's capable of regenerating an entirely new arm in minutes for you, and expunging harmful elements from your body if it can't destroy it. It can keep you alive within the vacuum of space for hours as it allows effective usage of all resources within your body.

Your physical might is incredible, allowing you to lift the weight of cars with your enhanced body with only moderate difficulty, and that's without being actively reinforced. Being reinforced would allow you to lift 5000 kg; run so fast you run on water; and jump so high, you can jump over houses—all that, you get the picture, right?

Its firewall is also incredible, as even a supercomputer made by humans in a century couldn't reasonably hack it within a human lifetime. It can also make a complete recovery within 5 minutes from just 1 nanomachine.

It can also leave your body on command, and hack electronics if you allow it to come into contact with them. Improve them too somewhat, if you so wish.
objects.title: High-Quality Nanomachines

objects.text:
You have undergone quite the evolution, as your Akrid like properties and Harmonizer have fused within you, in turn changing you into a member of the insectoid reptilian species native to E.D.N. III Akrid. 

As an Akrid your ability to produce purified T-ENG follows this process. Firstly, your body absorbs the ambient thermal energy into your blood causing a reaction that pools together into an impure T-ENG. Then the impure T-ENG pools in your body will then be processed and refilled with purified T-ENG. Notably, the amount of thermal energy your body can absorb depends upon your size.

You start out as an S-Class Akrid due to only initially being human-sized. Despite this you are already strong enough to tear apart humans effortlessly, regrow limbs so long as you still have T-ENG, be unharmed by low caliber bullets, and survive in extreme hostile environments from polar winters to volcanic heats. As you continue to live and absorb T-ENG to survive you will grow through the various classifications of Akrid: M-Class, L-Class, and G-Class. Each becoming an exponentially greater threat than the last, with M-Class being a threat to a squad of armed soldiers, L-Class being a threat to V.S. pilots, and G-Class being a threat to entire cities.

Notably, your form as an Akrid is highly malleable, utilizing T-ENG to grow in a manner befitting your environment and opposition, such as going from a Sand-worm like form in the desert into that of a six-limbed salamander in a jungle. Furthermore, once you reach the G-Class stage you will begin to develop unique abilities to aid in your survival, such as Green Eyes ice breath that covered city blocks, or Akrid X’s malleability and near immortality due to evolving to have a body made mostly to T-ENG.

Beyond the standard growth you have the potential to match and even succeed the Over-G, an Akrid who was the size of a mountain range in it immature state, able to freely shift its form due to being made of T-ENG, required orbital bombardment to be harmed, could create, modify, and control other Akrid, and could even start a world-ending Ice Age due to the sheer amount of thermal energy it could absorb conversely also creating a literal sea of T-ENG.
objects.title: Akrid (Lost Planet)

objects.text:
While the Stargate was the answer to the Ancients for exploration, colonization and trade on planets, the Supergate was made for war: to deploy a massive number of starships over vast distances in seconds.

Composed of multiple ship-like segments that are just the right size to pass a regular Stargate, they can link together to make a temporary Supergate that range from four-hundred meters to a kilometer in diameter, depending on how many segments are deployed. This version runs in an infinite power source, allowing for indefinite operation time, and has an infinite range: so long there is another Supergate to dial, they can establish a wormhole between them no matter the distance. 

You can use the same dial from regular gates to operate the Supergates, and will also receive a file on how to dial with other machines and how to operate the segments. You can have one of your Supergates already in position in your local Solar System, but must deploy any other you want to dial them with.

The first purchase grants you enough segments to form a pair of one kilometer Supergates, and each subsequent purchase multiplies that number per ten (2, 20, 200, 2.000, and 20.000).
objects.title: Supergate (Stargate)

objects.text:
Doranda Outpost, built by the Lanteans as part of the Arcturus Project, is an outstanding example of a fortified structure. Its design provides protection against orbital strikes and is capable of withstanding harsh climatic conditions for 10,000 years without losing functionality.

The outpost’s primary weapon is a “ground-to-space” energy cannon mounted on the roof and known as the Dorandan firing unit. This weapon boasts a high rate of fire, speed, and targeting accuracy, allowing it to effectively destroy both large ships and small aircraft in space and in the atmosphere, as well as engage surface targets within line of sight.

In addition, the weapon serves as a safety mechanism for Project Arcturus, dissipating excess energy during overload.

The Doranda Outpost and Project Arcturus can be easily integrated with any of your other OoPs capable of accommodating a small skyscraper and a large energy weapon.
objects.title: Doranda Outpost (Stargate)

objects.text:
The Cloning Vat is enhanced with a breakthrough age modulation system, allowing you full control over the physical age of any clone at the moment of creation. Instead of beginning life as an embryo, clones can now emerge at any age you choose—infant, adolescent, adult, or even elderly—depending on your specific needs.

The previous default of accelerated aging is no longer a fixed limitation. You can now disable it entirely, letting clones age at a natural rate, or reverse the effect by slowing their aging down drastically.

Additionally, you can program conditional aging behavior. For example, a clone could age rapidly when young until they hit their peak, at which point its aging can cease entirely.
objects.title: Age Modulation

objects.text:
The Cloning Vat evolves beyond simple replication, unlocking the ability to synthesize entirely new lifeforms by blending multiple genetic templates stored within its reserves. No longer confined to duplicating a single subject, the vat can now splice and fuse DNA from any combination of sources it has previously collected—human, alien, monstrous, or otherwise—allowing you to craft custom beings tailored to specific purposes or ideals.

This advanced gene-weaving function enables the creation of hybrid entities with mixed traits, such as the physical prowess of one source, the psychic aptitude of another, and perhaps even the resilience of a third. You may design these hybrids to appear as offspring—biologically plausible children created from two or more genetic lineages—or push them into entirely inhuman forms that defy natural categories. Physical characteristics, gender, and even reproductive capacity can all be assigned or altered at will, giving you total authorship over the clone’s identity and potential.

This bypasses the original vat’s 50% power limitation. This means you can create hybrids whose abilities surpass what the vat could previously support—though such creations may be more volatile, unstable, or unpredictable, depending on the complexity of their genetic design.

Besides that, all other core limitations of the Cloning Vat remain intact: clones still lack memories, they must be created one at a time within the three-clone limit, they suffer accelerated aging and they require at least one source of viable DNA for each contributing strain.
objects.title: Chimera

objects.text:
Your bio-nanochips have now undergone a evolution, fully integrating a cutting-edge gene-chip. This living system functions as a tripartite data core for health data, as it maintains a constant diagnostic overview of your physical, cognitive, and spiritual states.

This gene-chip, embedded directly into your DNA, is the latest model, able to self-repair, adapt, and virtually indestructible. If damaged, it regenerates like an organ. However, while its database is fully stocked with Earth-origin knowledge, it is limited to its home reality upon activation. To fully unlock its potential in alien or divergent environments, it must accumulate new data points through direct experience, observation, or input.

Its breakthrough feature lies in its ability to interface with the soul. In any setting where soul-energy or spiritual essence is detectable or manipulable, the chip can likewise perceive, harness, and process it.

The chip retains all prior functions, now enhanced by neural-link integration, giving you a clear H.U.D. for augmented reality. You may synchronize thoughts with the chip, allowing it to download knowledge directly into your mind or guide your body like an autopilot. It can also subtly influence cognition or probe deeper into your soul, such as psychosurgery, assisting in mental fortification, memory refinement, or emotional stabilization.
objects.title: Deep Blue (Six Ring Wizard)
Matrix (A Wizard's Secret)
objects.text:
Your existing computational system has been upgraded with Matrix, a quantum computer capable of performing enormous numbers of calculations and simulations simultaneously. Rather than simply analyzing information, Matrix can use that information to explore countless possible solutions and determine which are most effective.

Matrix can break down spells, techniques, machines, biological processes, energy systems, and other phenomena into their underlying principles. It can then modify individual variables, simulate the resulting changes, compare the results, and repeat the process until it finds increasingly effective configurations.

This allows you to develop and optimize almost anything that can be sufficiently understood. A spell can be redesigned into more efficient forms, a martial technique can be adjusted to reduce wasted movement, a machine can be optimized for greater efficiency, or a biological modification can be tested before being applied. Matrix can also analyze several possible approaches to the same problem and determine which is most likely to produce the desired result.

The more complex or unfamiliar the subject, the more information Matrix requires to produce reliable results. It cannot simply calculate the answer to something it has no basis for understanding, and completely unknown phenomena may still require observation and experimentation before they can be properly modeled.
You gain one additional orbment and accessories per purchase.
objects.title: Extra Orbments

objects.text: With this you can upgrade your installations to an experimental prototype, an installation equipped with four guns at once (although the ammunition remains at the previous level).
objects.title: Quadruple Installation (Halo)

objects.text: You can add two M95 Lance launchers to your M71 Scythe battery. This is a six-round rocket launcher that fires 85mm M4510 ASGM-7 surface-to-air rockets. It is fully automatic and networkable with the M71, and features accuracy, range, and over-the-horizon capability. Four full ammo racks are included.
objects.title: M95 Lance (Halo)

objects.text:
In addition to your COMP, you've received a fragment of the King of Bel, the one said to have once been the ruler of the demon world. With this, you have a legitimate claim to the throne, and the demons you encounter will know that.

As the potential King of Bel, your COMP records and internalizes both the abilities and the supernatural essence of every Demon you control. Once a Demon has fought alongside you long enough, you’ll unlock the Demon Whisper ability. 

Through Demon Whisper, you don’t just learn one of that Demon’s skills, you partially inherit their power, granting you heightened physical, magical, and/or spiritual capabilities tied to their nature. This can mean sharper senses from an otherworldly scout, increased resilience from an undead warrior, or even partial elemental affinity from a spectral mage.

In addition, demons will instinctively recognize your authority, making contracts smoother and tribute demands lighter. Over time, the combination of inherited powers and learned skills will grant you the powers of the legion of demons you amass, allowing you to truly earn the title of Demon Lord.
objects.title: King of Bel (Shin Megami Tensei)

objects.text:
Previously, you were limited to neuralyzing only a small room at a time, due to both the restricted range of the light and the possibility of people avoiding it by hiding behind obstacles. Now, however, you possess a Neuralyzer capable of overcoming both limitations—on a monumental scale.

Across your world, landmarks and monuments have been outfitted with integrated Neuralyzer technology, seamlessly adapted to each structure. For example, at Mount Rushmore, all eight presidential eyes can emit the flash, affecting anyone in the vicinity—or anyone facing the monument at the time. This technology exists in every landmark and monument worldwide, regardless of the setting.

Finally, you also have access to a refillable supply of protective glasses, allowing you to spare those you don’t wish to be neuralyzed when the monuments activate.
objects.title: Look At The Birdie! (Men In Black)

objects.text:
Alongside the Gravity Gun you also gain the Physics Gun, commonly referred to as the Physgun, a precision tool that lets you grab, move, and manipulate objects and entities as if the laws of physics were your plaything. A beam of blue energy links the device to any target you choose, letting you lift and freeze your target in midair regardless of their weight.

You can rotate and reposition anything with fine control, locking it in place as if it were welded to reality itself. Your grip ignores gravity, inertia, and momentum, allowing you to casually rearrange the world like a sandbox.
objects.title: Physics Gun (Garry’s Mod)

addons.text:
Your android receives an Energy Core module based on Remolding Pattern device technology. This module significantly improves the energy situation, allowing most abilities to be used without cooldown restrictions. However, the most powerful attacks that require a large amount of energy will still be subject to restrictions. But now your android will be able to fly freely and use normal attacks continuously.

All the benefits provided by the Remolding Pattern (Girls Frontline) feature remain unchanged.
addons.title: Energy Core

addons.text:
Every android in the HOC squad can receive an upgraded version of the Omega Blaster. This will significantly increase its power and ammunition capacity. In addition, it will be able to fire automatically, allowing it to effectively destroy particularly stubborn enemies and clear the area.

From the perspective of “Inherited Case” (Experimental Weapons (Girls Frontline)), the power of each shot from the “Hyper Energy Cannon” of the “Omega Blaster” will increase to the equivalent of a 305 mm high-explosive shell, and the ammunition capacity will be 50 shots.

However, you can also choose the “Beam weapon Andoris” upgrade. This option is suitable for any number of androids in the HOC. In this case, the beam cannon will have an ammunition capacity of 10 shots and 1.5 times the power. A shot from such a cannon will pierce reinforced concrete with a diameter of 7-8 meters and a length of 12-15 meters and kill “soft” unprotected fir trees within a radius of 50 meters.
addons.title: The Magic of Artillery Superiority

addons.text:
Your android will be upgraded to MK.2, an early version created by the Android Association in Floating Castle. Compared to MK.99, which is considered a “second-tier” android, MK.2 has higher specifications.

The main upgrade will double the effectiveness of all systems. In addition, a protective shield will be installed, reducing incoming damage by 40% of defense (significantly weakening the impact of 50-caliber equivalents and almost completely negating the effectiveness of rifle caliber), allowing for more freedom in long-range and close-range combat.

Unlike MK.99, which acts as fire support, MK.2 is equally comfortable in long-range combat and close-quarters combat.
addons.title: MK.2

objects.text:
Your T-Doll is upgraded to the MK.99 model—a combat support android from the Android Association, developed for Floating Castle. During the upgrade, new systems are installed, with a particular focus on energy weapons and flight systems.

Notable weapons include:
- The “Photon Beam,” integrated into the head, fires a powerful energy beam from the eyes. There are two modes: “Beam Magnum” fires multiple energy beams, and “Beam Cannon” fires a single powerful beam capable of penetrating obstacles and heavy defenses.
- The Beam Saber is an energy blade designed to cut through large, heavy, and well-protected targets, although it can also be used to chop up clusters of smaller targets.
- “Omega Blaster” — an energy rifle with the same attack modes as the “Photon Beam,” but significantly more powerful. It has an energy-consuming special mode called “Hyper Energy Cannon,” which releases an energy bomb that deals enormous damage and scatters enemies (similar to “Inherited Case” from Experimental Weapons).

The flight system allows you to move freely in the atmosphere and maneuver actively. However, using this system requires a lot of energy, so it should only be used in extreme cases.

The Android is equipped with an autonomous recharging device that cannot instantly satisfy all energy needs, but is capable of recharging batteries in a calm state.

Tactical programs allow you to effectively fight any opponents, including mages, wizards, monsters, demons, and other creatures typical of fantasy worlds.

All upgrades and add-ons for the T-Dolls branch are available, except for Dummy Dolls, as this model cannot use them. With each purchase in Upgrade of Dummy Dolls, you receive an additional android.

P.S. “Mechanical parts” refer to the costume.
objects.title: MK.99 (Guardian Tales)

objects.text:
You have upgraded your Utility Sticker to a Universal Utility Sticker, removing the previous limitation of being restricted to household utilities. Now, your archive contains every conceivable utility interface in the world, from industrial gas pipelines, water mains, high-voltage power connectors, and network ports, to specialized laboratory connections.

Examples:
• High-voltage transmission line sticker.
• Industrial steam valve sticker.
• Hospital oxygen feed sticker.
• Fiber-optic backbone port sticker.

The sticker catalog is comprehensive for all human-made utility systems and remains updated with newly invented interfaces. Stickers applied to objects or systems function up to 7 days or 168 hours while attached. Stickers applied to living systems (e.g., medical or life-support utilities) have a temporary effect of up to 6 hours.
objects.title: Universal Pack

objects.text:
Through a groundbreaking upgrade to your assimilated Nanosuit, the nano machines within your body have been supercharged, transforming you into a rapidly evolving swarm of advance Ceph nano machines. With this transformation, you gain access to the vast array of abilities and technologies exhibited by the Ceph throughout the Crysis series.

As a living swarm of nano machines, you possess incredible adaptability and versatility. You can seamlessly reconfigure your form, allowing you to manipulate your physical structure, change shape, and even mimic the appearance of other objects or individuals. 

In addition to shape-shifting, you inherit the Ceph's advanced weaponry and destructive capabilities. You can generate and manipulate devastating energy-based projectiles, unleash powerful shockwaves, and deploy self-replicating robot army. With minor preparation your attacks can devastate entire cities, and even countries with ease.

Furthermore, the assimilation of Ceph technology grants you access to their vast knowledge and ability to invent hyper-advanced technologies million of years more advanced than modern earth. You can analyze and replicate Ceph technology, allowing you to create and modify cutting-edge weaponry, advanced energy systems, and other highly advanced devices.

The integration with Ceph technology also enhances your sensory perception, granting you even more enhanced vision modes, the ability to detect energy signatures, and an expanded range of senses that extend far beyond the capabilities of normal humans. You can analyze and understand complex systems, decipher alien languages, and navigate intricate technological networks.
objects.title: Invasion Of The Roomba From Outer Space (Crysis)

objects.text:
Your Adaptive Utility Fog has undergone a fundamental upgrade: it is now true programmable matter. The nanites can reconfigure at a molecular level, allowing them to simulate the properties of different substances—metals, plastics, glass, or advanced composites.

Think of it this way: if the base fog was the ultimate 3D printer that could only use one type of plastic filament, this upgrade gives it every possible filament and the ability to print the internal machinery as well. It can now form objects with functional, internal complexity. This means creating circuitry that conducts electricity, lenses that bend light, airtight seals, or blades with a hardened edge and a shock-absorbing core.

The fog is matter awaiting instruction. With understanding, you can will it into being. Its limits are now defined only by your knowledge of an object's design, the available mass, and the laws of physics.
objects.title: Advanced Programmable Matter

objects.text:
Your Adaptive Utility Fog gains the ability to actively disassemble and reassemble existing matter on a macro scale. This is not molecular transmutation, but a process of incredibly precise physical deconstruction, transport, and reformation, allowing for rapid construction, deconstruction, and alteration of the physical environment.

In practice, this grants you basic, powerful matter manipulation. The fog can swarm over a boulder, disassemble it into gravel, and reassemble that mass into a stone wall. It can take a heap of scrap metal and weave it into a set of ultra-sharp blades or a set of armor. It can smooth a rough surface, carve intricate patterns, open tunnels, or erect simple fortifications almost as fast as you can visualize them. While the fog cannot change the fundamental material (stone remains stone, metal remains metal), its ability to reshape the world around you in real-time has too many practical and tactical applications to fully list.
objects.title: Assembly/Disassembly Protocol

objects.text:
A full-body mobility system designed for controlled, multi-directional movement.

You receive a second grapple gun and a reinforced body harness with hip-mounted docking points on both sides. When holstered, the grapple guns can be operated remotely without needing to hold them.

Control is handled through wrist-mounted interfaces built into the harness. You aim and shoot with wrist movement and finger flexing, and switch the barrel position from front facing to side and back facing with button press, allowing precise firing, retraction, and release while keeping your hands free for other tasks.

While mounted, each grapple gun has a restricted firing arc (120°) for stability and safety. However, both units can still fire forward, sideways, or backward, enabling fluid movement and repositioning in any direction.

The harness distributes load across the body, improving balance and reducing strain during rapid swings, lifts, or directional changes.

It also includes storage mounts for quickswap attachments and other small gear, keeping tools accessible without interfering with movement.
objects.title: Omnidirectional Manoeuvring Harness

objects.text:
Your purchase now includes a set of quickswappable moduels for your Grapple Gun.

The attachments are mounted via a quick-lock system, enabling fast changes with minimal effort, even in active situations.

Available attachments include smoke pellet launcher for visual cover, a net launcher for restraint, and fire-retardant foam grenade launcher for suppression and containment. 

Each module comes with limited ammunition but the purchase includes a DIY guide on how to produce more.
objects.title: Quickswappable Attachments

objects.text:
You deepen your connection to the Sacred Scrolls, gaining access to complete Scrolls aligned with the Fivefold Paths. Each selection grants one fully realized domain of control that works immediately.

Your Metal Scroll updates to a complete one. It governs machinery, fabrication, and structured systems through the Mech Designer interface.

Each additional Scroll gives control over a specific domain.

The Water Scroll governs flesh and blood. You can reshape, heal, enhance, or redesign living bodies in real time. Disease, inefficiency, and natural limitations can be removed or replaced.

The Earth Scroll governs matter and terrain. You can reshape the environment, move large volumes of material, and construct stable structures directly from what is available.

The Wood Scroll governs life and growth. You can create and direct living systems, from small organisms to full ecosystems, controlling how they grow and adapt.

The Fire Scroll governs energy, including Qi. You can generate, store, convert, and direct energy to power systems, reinforce structures, or release it as force.

All Scrolls function at scale and do not require detailed design unless you want finer control.

They also work together without issue. Energy can power machines or living systems, biology can be integrated with technology, and environments can be shaped to support both.

If all five Scrolls are obtained, the system is complete. All domains function together, allowing simultaneous control over matter, life, energy, and machinery.
objects.title: Sacred Scrolls (The Mech Touch)

objects.text:
The nano-gel's reach has been expanded from the face and throat to a full-body sheath, allowing the mask to secrete the transformative substance down your neck and across your entire skin surface until it encases you from scalp to sole. 

The onboard database is supplemented with fully digitised body templates capturing complete anatomical scans, so when you select a stored identity the gel now sculpts your entire physique to match, altering your apparent build, limb proportions, shoulder width, and overall silhouette to replicate the target. 

The system excels at adding mass, broadening your frame, or lengthening proportions by layering the nano-gel outward with structural integrity that holds under touch and scrutiny. However, it struggles considerably when attempting to make you smaller, as it cannot physically compress your skeleton or reduce your core volume; at best it can project a clever optical illusion using controlled shadowing, contouring, and refractive tricks to give observers the impression of a slighter frame, an effect that collapses immediately upon physical contact.
objects.title: Ten Thousand Avatar Systems

objects.text:
A near-invisible micro-camera array has been added along the upper edge of the mask, giving the system the ability to record everything you see with full visual fidelity, storing the footage in the mask's internal memory for later playback or upload to external devices. 

Beyond simple recording utility, the system's true power lies in its automatic cataloguing function: whenever you observe a person's face with sufficient clarity and directness, the camera feeds the visual data to an onboard reconstruction engine that analyses the three-dimensional structure, texture mapping, and characteristic micro-movements of the subject's features. From this captured data, the mask autonomously generates a ready-to-use digital template, adding the new face to your library without any conscious effort on your part, so that by the time you have finished a conversation, the face of the person you were speaking to is already stored and available for you to wear.
objects.title: Face Stealer System

addons.text:
The GX-9 Tecton was a catastrophic failure of design philosophy, built not as a weapon but as a monument to its creator's obsession with raw, performative masculinity. It resulted in a machine so grotesquely over-armored that it could barely lift its own mass and struggled to justify its own existence on any battlefield that required something other than a stationary target.

Your Tectons have been stripped of their original monolithic armor and re-clad in a lighter composite that matches the original's durability while shedding the excess mass that crippled the machine. This weight reduction transforms it from a sluggish, self-destroying hulk into a genuinely mobile siege platform. The strain on every joint drops to within safe limits for the first time, the frame no longer accumulates damage just from moving, and the machine can actually use its strength without fighting its own bulk.

The recharge cycle for the Tectonic Drivers and ballistic pounce drops from fifteen seconds to seven and a half. The original machine wasted most of its power just overcoming its own weight, but the lighter frame means more energy goes to the weapons and movement systems where it belongs. You can seismic strike, pounce, and seismic strike again in the time it previously took for a single cycle.

You receive five Tectons in total, a direct consequence of the new armor alloy requiring a room-temperature superconducting crystalline matrix so rare that its entire planetary extraction yield across a decade was enough to clad only a single hand of machines. A comprehensive team-fighting manual is included, teaching synchronized fault line resonance strikes where multiple Tectons hammer the same subsurface node from calculated angles to generate a targeted super-quake between them without accidentally collapsing the ground under each other.
addons.title: Tecton Base

addons.text:
The MK. II Hunter was a failure born from a design committee that demanded a machine to replace infantry but refused to fund it like a war machine, forcing engineers to pour their entire pittance of a budget into the one system that might keep a pilot alive long enough to maybe accomplish something.

Each Hunter is now equipped with retractable forearm blades whose edges maintain a near-plasma state, giving the machine a one-hit-kill melee option against any target it has successfully outflanked. The mouth-mounted gatling cannon fires smart-slugs that have been completely re-engineered with micro-thrusters for terminal course correction, allowing each projectile to actively steer into shield breaches or weak points during its final flight milliseconds. Upon impact, each slug's penetrator tip breaches the first layer of armor before a tiny shaped charge detonates internally, forming a molten metal jet that destroys critical components from the inside out, bypassing external protection entirely.

The Distributed Hex-Net's recharge time is now permanently locked at three seconds regardless of how many generators remain operational, removing the original system's cascading failure spiral entirely. The system only fails completely when the last generator is destroyed, allowing for full-tilt aggression right up to the moment of total shield collapse.

You receive a full platoon of fifty Hunters, a number made possible only because the design's infamously tight budget forced the use of stamped composite plating, off-the-shelf actuators, and civilian-grade structural spars cheap enough to stamp out in bulk. A comprehensive team-fighting manual is included, detailing decentralized pack tactics, terrain exploitation for maximum shield cycling, and bait-and-ambush patterns designed to cripple enemy logistics with minimal losses.
addons.title: Hunter Base

addons.text:
The Type-F Revenant was a failure born from a brilliant scientist who solved an impossible physics problem to create a perfect sniper and then had absolutely no idea how to build an aircraft around it.

Your Revenants now carry a secondary ammunition type for the forearm gatling cannons, designed specifically for close-range high-speed aerial combat. These rounds are engineered to tear rather than pierce, deploying into expanding clouds of razor-edged submunitions upon firing that shred aerodynamic control surfaces, sensor clusters, and fragile external systems.

The wing array has been completely rebuilt with an integrated inertial dampening field projected through the pilot's reactive gel pod, granting near-zero G-force feedback regardless of the machine's maneuvers. Combined with thruster upgrades delivering higher maximum speeds, brutal acceleration, and instant deceleration, the Revenant now outperforms any conventional jet in a turning fight while its pilot remains clear-headed and unpunished by the physics that should be liquifying them. The wings retain their full range of deployment from the thirty-meter stable hover configuration to the five-meter folded sprint profile, but the structure has been reinforced to survive the stresses of maneuvers the original frame would have torn itself apart attempting.

You receive a full squadron of twenty Revenants, due to the demands of each airframe’s moderately expensive systems that together make mass production a slow bleed on even a well-funded logistics chain. A comprehensive team-fighting manual is included, covering fluid swarm formations, high-low altitude kill zones, and synchronized time-on-target attacks where twenty sniper rounds from twenty different vectors all converge on a single bunker at the exact same instant.
addons.title: Revenant Base

objects.text:
You receive a fully automated complex housing three specialized workshops, each purpose-built to maintain, repair, and rearm your respective mech types. The facility includes diagnostic gantries with full-spectrum sensor suites, automated parts fabricators, weapons harmonisation ranges, and immersive simulation pods for pilot training. The complex also contains the original creator's classified engineering archives, allowing for the application of post-design flaw corrections that the initial production runs desperately needed.

You are granted a finite ten-year stockpile of all specialized consumables, exotic alloys, replacement components, ammunition feedstock, neural gel nutrients, and fusion core tritium reserves necessary to keep your full complement of mechs operational for a decade of sustained combat operations.
objects.title: Refit Complex

addons.text:
Your polymorphic body and ability to create various materials have amalgamated allowing you to not only change your material, but to completely overhaul your properties. 

This extends not just to turning yourself into other materials fully, but partial transformations so fine you could replicate intricate machinery, complex chemicals and even computational engines with relative ease only from your own body. 

This alteration even extends to esoteric substances as needed, including the mystical otherworldly materials as long as you have ever come into contact with a sample. These range from alien elements to substances strange and specific as an angel’s blood.
addons.title: Polymorphae

objects.text:
Integrating the Responsometer into yourself, you’re akin to the Metal Men created by Doctor Magnus himself! 

Much like the robots you could once use the Responsometer to create, you’re constructed out of a pure material. This metal however is completely malleable, able to be polymorphed into many different shapes. 

While you technically retain the same base form as your material (being mercury would make you liquid at room temperature for instance), your ability to shapeshift lets you become impossible sizes, flatten yourself, or turn your limbs into devices and great shapes with a thought. This would also naturally let you retain a humanoid form by simply shaping yourself into one. Additionally, you can use the metal of your base form for many creative applications, for instance, being made of Magnesium might allow you to burn a bright light as a distraction.

However, you retain the relative weaknesses of the material you’re constructed from, such as the high conductivity of Gold, the relative weakness of Tin, or the radioactivity of plutonium. While these properties are not always positive or negative they can be inconvenient. Mitigating this however is that your body is fully able to be damaged and destroyed as long as the Responsometer inside you remains intact, allowing you to repair yourself near instantly by merely acquiring enough of your material to replace what you lost.

You can choose for your body to be made of any material you have access to from this CYOA or the setting you’re entering rather than a traditional metal, such as Netherite, Vibranium, or even Naquadah.
objects.title: Magnus’ Magnum Opus (DC Comics)

objects.text:
You can now completely alter your chemical makeup to mimic materials you have access to. While you’d need to understand the material you’re becoming, you could truly become an Nth Metal man, inheriting the material’s psychic qualities, or Neodymium perhaps.

This is not limited to metals, being able to mimic Gasses like Neon, Oxygen and more, truly embodying the greatest successes of Doctor Will Magnus.
objects.title: The Nth Metal Man!

objects.text: You gain an additional Alpha Core. You may, instead of giving it a personality, leave it blank so your original Alpha Core can either make copies of itself or use it for additional processing power.
objects.title: More Alpha Cores

objects.text:
The Light didn't just miraculously figure out how to clone Superman; they stole a piece of Kryptonian technology, specifically a portion of a Genesis Chamber. Your Genesis Chamber has now been upgraded similarly, incorporating the facility that The Light created for unethical experiments using the cloning technology gained from Kryptonian technology. The facility you own is a state-of-the-art institution filled with equipment that is a few hundred years more advanced than modern equipment. 

These facilities contain the data that Lex Luthor and the Light have collected on various heroes. You will find genetic samples from most of the heroes stored here, along with research on cloning them and the beginnings of research into meta-humans. However, the facility has only been successful in creating clones of Superman and genetically engineered lifeforms called Genomorphs that possess telepathic abilities. 

With enough research into the field of genetic engineering and cloning, you can finish the ongoing experiments that Cadmus has started, perhaps even figuring out how to clone other heroes from the DNA gathered, such as Wonder Woman or Martian Manhunter, to name a few heroes that have recorded DNA samples. The facility already has several clone vats ready for production.
objects.title: Cadmus (DC Comics: Young Justice)

objects.text:
Your Mother Box has been used to enhance you with new God technology, transforming you into a great and mighty figure. That can see and hear pins drop from across the world.

Your strength, speed and resilience are incredible, able to not only survive but match and surpass Kryptonians, placing holes in moons with ease and causing global climate disaster in the wake of larger fights.

You can natively command storms and lighting, able to generate storms with ease and manipulate the lightning into constructs to aid you. Your storms also generate massive amounts of sand and dust in the process, spewing from your back not unlike a cape that can be commanded telekinetically down to singular grains.
objects.title: “And he will carry the dust of his people on his back” (DC Comics: Absolute)

objects.text: Your Multi-Tool is vastly improved. The Scanning function now has planetary range, able to search everything on it, even if in low resolution. Analyzing is also improved. Regardless of the distance, so long as you point it to your target, it will be able to analyze it after a minute. Your matter storage now has no limit. You could in theory hold a whole planet mass inside of it, given enough time. Finally, the energy production of your Multi-Tool is perfected, allowing you to fire it forever, without fearing overheating.
objects.title: Enhanced Multi-Tool (No Man's Sky)
A Full-fledged Planetary Shield
objects.text:
Your Planetary Shield Generator has evolved into a network of 200 powerful shield generators, each with significantly increased output. This system includes all the necessary infrastructure and generating capacity.

Although the overall strength of the shield remains the same, the increase in the number of generators allows for the flexible reallocation of defensive resources.
