You can reinforce specific areas by concentrating the power of certain generators on them, whilst simultaneously reducing defences in lower-priority sectors. This makes it possible to increase defensive capabilities locally by several times.

After the second purchase, your shield receives a number of additional enhancements. Firstly, an ‘energy converter’ is added, which redirects part of the incoming energy towards strengthening the shield. This makes attacks by standard capital ships extremely ineffective, although superweapons and ultra-powerful systems can still penetrate the defences. However, even in this case, a single shot will be significantly weakened, and breaching the shield will be a difficult task due to the number of generators. Secondly, a ‘frequency modulator’ is integrated, allowing you to gradually adjust the planetary shield’s parameters to increase its effectiveness (by up to 50% against certain types of attacks and weapon types).

The result is a shield capable of withstanding a planetary bombardment from hundreds of capital ships, several shots from an Eclipse-class SSD superlaser, or the impact of an asteroid the size of Chicxulub (approximately 10 km in diameter). However, it would not be able to withstand a strike from the Death Star or the impact of the Moon.

objects.title: Miracle Machine (DC Comics)
objects.text:
In the image of New God technology, and the advancement in the Guardian of the Universe’s willpower technology (read Green Lanterns), your Motherbox can rearrange itself into a Miracle Machine, a wish machine capable of turning thoughts into reality. A stray thought could warp reality nearby, a cage of inertron enveloping the machine until you actively wish to use it.

Retaining your Mother Box’s AI that’s better understood as living consciousness, much like a Genie’s counsel, it’ll decide whether your wish benefits the Source’s larger will and fulfill your wish; is it a delicate exercise in visualizing and understanding your wish as long it’s in line to the Source Wall’s will, with the unintended consequences if the Machine takes the wrong idea.

For any Consumable Objects of Power, you now have an additional use of it, even if it is a multi-select. Schrödinger's Stein now gets up to 10 additional refillable containers, Armstrong Serum gets additional needles, each with 3 uses, etc.

For those with multi-select, it will stack with however many you pick.
objects.title: Additional Consumables

objects.text:
You have been granted a Panther Habit, specifically the upgraded Habit from the MCU. This is a suit comprised of vibranium nanobots that are stored in the necklace, which can be mentally commanded at will. These nanobots can repair the suit through stored vibranium nanobots, and while not infinite, they will regenerate after time. 

As a result of being made of vibranium, it has perfectly soundproofed shoes, and the suit has the ability to absorb and store kinetic energy, allowing you to enhance attacks or send out a kinetic blast. But also due to being composed of vibranium, the suit can be disrupted through specific sonic frequencies. Lastly, due to advanced Wakandan technology, this suit also has a highly advanced built-in communication system.
objects.title: Panther Habit (Marvel: MCU)

objects.text:
As well as your initial doses, you’ve been given a small handheld device capable of synthesising MGH directly from the bloodstream. 

By pressing the end into a subject with a genetic or biological component to their powers such as a mutant, mutate, or inhuman, you can take a sample that immediately fills the chamber on the back. This chamber can then be removed while over the course of a minute it synthesises the blood into Mutant Growth Hormone.

The Auto-Synthesiser comes with three such chambers, auto-sterilising after each use. These chambers can either be re-injected raw or have their contents transferred into more permanent casing. 

If you possess some form of cyberware, you may choose to have the Auto-Synthesiser incorporated into your body.
objects.title: MGH Auto-Synthesiser (Marvel)
Better Venom (Marvel)
objects.text: The first purchase brings you up to the full strength standard Spider-man package, still webless. The second gives you organic webbing, as swingable ropes and as a wide spray area attack. Third adds the additional powers of any varient Spider-(wo)man. Buy all four to be a composite of any and all Spider-(wo)men.

Somehow, you lack the greatest weakness of a Devil Fruit user—you are no longer weak to water. You can be submerged in liquid without losing your strength, and even sea prism stone does not negate your powers, with your only weakness being that of Haki.
objects.title: Beloved by the Sea (One Piece)

objects.text: There is something strange about you—something unnatural. Somehow, you possess the ability to host powers that should not, that cannot exist within one person. You can hold, mix, and, if you have a method for doing so, pick up powers that are contradictory, unsafe or otherwise impossible to wield at once. Choose two more Devil Fruits to wield.
objects.title: Kurohige (One Piece)

objects.text: You have somehow done the impossible—your mind and body have caught up with the power of your Devil Fruit and thus have achieved Awakening. You have already mastered your Awakening and the full breadth and scope of your Devil Fruit is available to you. You gain a similar upgrade to all of your abilities.
objects.title: Warrior of Liberation (One Piece)

objects.text:
You have gained the booster shot created by Eddie Morra and his team of scientists to give the user of the booster shot immunity to the side effects of NZT-48. The booster shot allows those who take it to take as much NZT as they want without undergoing any of the negative side effects of NZT that would ordinarily come about from regular use of NZT. 

However, the booster shot is required to be taken every few months to continue seeing no side effects from NZT. With this, you gain enough to last you a year, which will be replenished when you run out. With some effort and NZT, you could find a way to make this immunity permanent, as well as the effects of NZT.

Along with the booster shots, you have gained a shipment of 15 more NZT per week, giving a total of twenty pills that will be replenished every week.
objects.title: NZT Booster Shot (Limitless)

addons.text:
Your body is a perfect synthesis of divine ichor and Orichalcum-based technology. You are both immortal and ageless, benefiting from the regenerative power of a demigod and the self-repair systems of a Machine God. Additionally, you are no longer burdened by the curse of technology that plagued demigods in the mortal world. Devices and electronics no longer act as beacons to monsters. You can freely use modern technology without fear of alerting supernatural threats, as well as imbue Greek based magic into advanced technology.

Your existence embodies a purified form of godhood while retaining your mortal essence. This paradox grants you divine authority that is both ancient and advanced, yet not constrained by the rigid hierarchies or weaknesses of other gods. Although you are no more resistant to divine powers than any other deity, the purity of your godhood as both human and terminal grants you a unique resilience against divine manipulation or corruption.

If your divine parent is the same in both, you become the perfect union of myth and mechanism, embodying their divine authority in its most complete form. Not only do you inherit their Olympian powers as a demigod, but you also serve as their most advanced terminal, seamlessly integrating their divine will with the Divine Corpus Network. Your powers are not merely stronger; they are more refined, allowing you to wield them with absolute precision and control. Your firepower is significantly amplified, as you can access both the mythic might of an Olympian and the advanced functionalities of a Machine God. Additionally, your connection to the Divine Corpus Network enables you to calculate optimal strategies and trajectories instantaneously, giving it a level of adaptability and scalability that other divine beings lack.
addons.title: Pseudo Machine God

objects.text:
You are a demigod, or more accurately, the theoretical counterpart to the Demigods of the Greek Divine Spirits if they were created from the Machine Gods. In addition to the enhancement of the 12 Klironomia within you, they have also bonded at a deeper level, rewriting your very DNA into a pseudo techno-organic mesh that merges mortal biology with divine mechanism. Your exact designation is [Pseudo-Organic Type Autonomous Terminal], a living extension of one of the Twelve Olympian Machine Gods. Through this bond, your connection to your chosen deity has intensified, granting you access to the Divine Corpus Network—the communication and power system that links all gods of Olympus.

Divine Patterns based on the sequences of your chosen Olympian have been engraved into your body, functioning as circuits that allow you to replicate aspects of their power. These patterns grant you abilities echoing the miracles and dominion they once wielded. To sustain this transformation, your body has been infused with Orichalcum-based materials that reinforce your form while maintaining flexibility and resilience. Your body now generates and runs on True Ether, the primordial energy of the Age of Gods, enhancing your magical capabilities to a level far beyond modern Magecraft. 

Your frame now contains the Lineage Factor of your chosen Machine God. These are metaphysical organs that mimic the vital functions of a Machine God’s true body, optimized for an organic host. You also have some general Linage factors included. Your brain now has enhanced cognitive processing and grants advanced linguistic abilities, including cross-species communication. Your lungs allow you to survive in extreme environments, from the ocean’s crushing depths to the vacuum of space. Your gut efficiently processes ambient mana, enabling you to sustain yourself purely on magical energy, even in hostile or foreign domains. Additional your physiology has been fundamentally altered, granting you strength, speed, and durability that far exceed human limitations, rivaling high-ranking Servants. Your lifespan is now measured in centuries, and your enhanced form is functionally ageless as long as your divine systems remain intact.

As a terminal of an Olympian Machine God, you can also emulate the basic functions their Authority and Divinity, enabling you to manifest miracles and divine phenomena associated with your “parent”. A bond with Zeus allows you to summon divine lightning and storms. A connection to Poseidon grants control over water and seismic forces. Alignment with Athena provides unmatched strategic foresight and the ability to manifest divine weapons of war. These powers are channeled through the Divine Corpus Network, allowing you to wield the divinity of your patron while maintaining your autonomy.

With every purchase, you can increase the number of connections you have, allowing you to be the paradoxical terminal of multiple Machine Gods. By merging the Authorities and Lineage Factors of different Olympians within your frame, you expand your divine capabilities, embodying the unique paradox of serving as a conduit for multiple deities.
objects.title: Machine Demi-God

objects.text: “I’m not 'just like the rest of you'. I’m stronger, I’m smarter, I’m better. I am better!” Instead of a standard vial of Compound V, you have received a unique, highly experimental version of this chemical serum. Thanks to this vial's modified composition and exceptional purity, the effects of its usage have become vastly more formidable. The powers and level of enhancement granted by this vial are now so potent that an individual could go toe-to-toe on equal standing with the famous Homelander himself. Forget being a typical supe; with this serum, you now have the potential to be truly worthy of the title “The World’s Greatest Superhero”. This upgrade applies equally to every vial of Compound V that you purchase via this CYOA.
objects.title: Compound V+ (The Boys)

objects.text:
In the years following the deployment of Grimjaw during the Xeno Conflict, select blacksite programs under the Coalition’s Strategic Bioforge Initiative began pushing for something more than just muscle and mutation. The result was Grimjaw: Primecurrent, a volatile fusion of bio-mutation and nano-reactive augmentation.

Once injected, Primecurrent retains the core mutation cycle of its predecessor—instantaneous activation, brutal transformation, and a 25-minute window of peak adaptive strength—but now introduces a second evolutionary layer. Trace nanite colonies flood the bloodstream alongside mutagenic agents, interlinking with nerve tissue and muscle fibers to create a biomechanical feedback loop. These nanites enhance internal bioelectric output, allowing the user to generate and discharge controlled bursts of energy during the transformation window. Arcs of electricity can lash out from hands or strike targets through direct contact. Joints emit crackling radiation on impact. 

This energy output is chaotic but metabolically driven, meaning your body becomes more efficient with each cycle. Just like the original serum, repeated stabilized uses result in lasting biological improvement—but Primecurrent introduces a second growth curve. Each completed cycle improves not just muscle and bone, but also your internal energy yield. Over time, this allows you to generate more frequent electrical surges, withstand greater heat, and even disrupt enemy tech in close quarters. These changes stack, and although will be subtle in baseline form.

However, this integration carries greater danger if abused. If you inject Primecurrent before your body fully resynchronizes, the results are exponentially more devastating than with the base serum. Nanites lose their instruction sets and begin rewiring tissues at random—rewriting pain centers, triggering muscle seizures, and burning out nerve clusters through uncontrolled energy surges. Bone-laced conduits rupture. Internal arcs of plasma detonate beneath the skin. The more you’ve evolved, the more chaotic the breakdown.
objects.title: Experimental Fusion Strain 13-A “Grimjaw: Primecurrent”

addons.text:
Your DrakeRig has been adapted to be able to use the Primecurrent variant of Grimjaw, a more advanced united call Wrym. The capsule housing and aerosolization systems have been recalibrated to handle the more unstable fusion strain, allowing the nanite-infused compound to be vaporized and delivered in a constant, breathable form.

The lower-level effect from the aerosolized Primecurrent causes the nanites to integrate into the user’s physiology gradually rather than explosively. The nanites work slowly, embedding themselves into tissues and interfacing with nerves, muscle fibers, and even bone marrow. Over time, this rebuilds the body at the cellular level using hybridized biological and technological structures. Muscle fibers begin fusing with conductive lattice, nerves become more efficient through nano-filament support, and skeletal structure is reinforced with internal plating.

This rebuilt body continues to benefit from stacking gains, but now those gains occur along both physical and energy-reactive lines. Structural integrity increases. Sensory reaction time sharpens. Electrical resistance improves. Bioelectric signaling becomes stronger and faster, subtly enhancing everything from reaction time to pain tolerance. Over multiple weeks of uninterrupted use, even baseline strength and resilience begin to move far beyond what pure biology could support, due to the scaffolding provided by embedded nanites and microstructures. 

This deeper integration introduces a more severe form of dependency. As your body becomes increasingly technological, it also becomes increasingly energy-hungry. Traditional food and metabolic fuel are no longer sufficient. While the aerosolized Primecurrent continues to provide metabolic support, the underlying energy demand, especially from the tech-integrated systems, grows faster than biological systems can naturally support. Without Primecurrent active in your system, internal systems begin to fail, leading to exhaustion, nervous misfires, and cellular degradation. In short, once adapted to Primecurrent through the Wrym, your body is no longer capable of sustaining itself through normal means. You require the compound not just to enhance performance, but to function at all.
addons.title: Capsule Inhalation System 02 “Wrym”

objects.text:
The DrakeRig was created for long-term deployment over temporary suicide squads. The result was a stripped-back delivery rig that provided constant, low-dose exposure to Grimjaw in aerosol form. Originally used by tunnel fighters and deep-range infiltrators, the DrakeRig spread quickly among elite irregulars for its reliability and self-sufficiency.

The DrakeRig system consists of a respirator unit and a hardened capsule module mounted at the back of the neck, slightly below the mask’s connection point. This capsule functions as a reservoir, holding multiple doses of Grimjaw at once. Doses acquired weekly can be gained either as syringes or be loaded directly into the chamber. Once installed, Grimjaw is converted to aerosol form and fed directly into the respirator through a pressure-sealed channel. The gas is inhaled continuously, maintaining a constant low-level saturation in the user’s bloodstream. A single dose provides exactly one week of constant output; stored doses are drawn from sequentially, requiring no manual switching or refilling mid-cycle.

The system delivers long-term physical enhancement that mimics the effects of synthetic steroids, but with higher efficiency and reduced long-term damage. Strength, speed, reflexes, and endurance all increase steadily with continuous exposure. Unlike the violent, time-limited mutation of a full injection, aerosolized Grimjaw remains stable in the system and avoids triggering destructive transformation events. These effects stack with time, with permanent physiological gains accruing gradually. Users experience long-term performance improvement without the catastrophic risks tied to overuse of injected doses. 

However, constant use builds dependency. The body adapts to Grimjaw as a baseline metabolic requirement, leading to both psychological craving and physiological need. Without continued exposure, users suffer immediate withdrawal symptoms: fatigue, tremors, cognitive decline, and intense caloric debt. Grimjaw gas also replaces the need for food under normal conditions, as the compound is metabolized as a high-efficiency energy source. Removal of the rig or depletion of the capsule leads to rapid metabolic collapse unless caloric intake is massively increased.

The capsule also contains an internal injector for full-dose emergency activation. At any time, the user can trigger a complete release of one full dose directly into the spinal entry point at the base of the capsule. This bypasses the gas system and initiates the standard 25-minute mutation cycle. The transformation remains identical to the standard syringe-based injection.
objects.title: Capsule Inhalation System 01 “DrakeRig”

objects.text:
After the ban on the original Wendigo protocol, blacksite labs in the Saturn-Titan Exclusion Zone began producing unsanctioned offshoots. Wendigo Black was the most extreme, an unstable, tactically overwhelming apex state. Designed purely for slaughter through radical biochemical recursion.

Wendigo Black grafts weaponized biofunctions directly into the host’s anatomy. Claws and fangs, formed from keratin-carbon composites, deploy faster than the human eye can track. They retract when not in use, but can shear modern armor and puncture ballistic-grade plating. Each delivers a dual-stage neurotoxin, with paralysis seting in almost instantly, followed by muscular degradation and cardiac failure. Blood, when exposed to air, turns into a lethal airborne mist that contaminates a wide radius that causes a fatal protein breakdown within minutes. Should the subject's flesh be consumed, said breakdown occurs instantly.

Regeneration is exponentially accelerated. A fully amputated limb can regrow before the blood finishes pooling. Regrown organs repair faster than standard synthetic grafts, with neural reconnection complete in less than half a minute. Unlike the original Wendigo, Wendigo Black uses recursive damage as fuel. Muscles are permitted to rupture under stress and rebuilt stronger with every microfailure. Each regeneration cycle adds a marginal increase in local muscle capacity, but also raises the metabolic load of the body permanently. After a single battle, caloric demand may spike by the equivalent of multiple days’ worth of nutrition.

Because of this, food debt now has harsher penalties. After only short-term deprivation, cannibalization also eats away neural substrates, causing memory degradation, aggression spikes, and increasing susceptibility to psychosis. Additionally, due to the chaotic nature of cellular overproduction, subjects develop aggressive but non-lethal cancers. The regenerative system suppresses metastasis but cannot remove malformed tissues entirely. Tumor growth is constant and painful, and while not terminal, it interferes with organ performance and chronic inflammation, further elevating metabolic demands.

The subject's brain has been partitioned into six independently modulated hemispheric clusters, each taking turns in short cycles to enter a pseudo-dormant state where cerebrospinal acid is flushed and restimulant hormones are recycled. This in turns means they are incapable of sleep. The result is enhanced total recall with flawless data retention, every sight, sound, and sensation can be replayed with perfect clarity.

However, with no cognitive silence, the subject suffers constant mental degradation: sensory hallucinations, inability to differentiate memory from present experience, emotional desensitization, and eventual identity erosion. Furthermore, hormonal systems are also unintentionally destabilized. Each violent act, use of strength, or successful regeneration floods the brain with neural reward chemicals. Without combat, the subject experiences intense withdrawal, cold sweats, tremors, psychotic ideation.

Lastly, heat retention in Wendigo Black is extreme. The near-total lack of energy radiation means invisibility from any thermal reader, but it also means thermal buildup occurs rapidly. Internal temperatures rise past the threshold for fatal heatstroke within minutes of continuous engagement. Because the body cannot shut down or faint, the subject suffers from nausea, internal bleeding, and neurological disruption unless rapidly cooled.
objects.title: Genetic Reformat Serum 07-X “Wendigo Black”

objects.text:
In addition to your fruit, you gain the ancient, world-shaping tree that bore it—the Shinju, or God Tree. Towering far beyond mountains and rooted in the very life force of the Earth, the God Tree is not merely a plant but a sentient force of nature, once worshipped as divine and feared as apocalyptic. It is the original source of chakra, a cosmic parasite planted by the Ōtsutsuki clan to drain the energy of entire worlds. Its presence warps the land around it, turning entire regions into bleak, chakra-drained wastelands.

The God Tree is inexorably bound to the fabric of the planet it feeds on, drawing in the life force from the planet itself, steadily maturing until it produces a new Chakra Fruit once every thousand years. This cycle can be accelerated if the tree is fertilized with immense energy or the life-force of powerful beings. In this way, you can hasten its growth through sacrificial offerings, converting captured or defeated foes into rich fodder for its roots.

Beyond its fruit-bearing power, the God Tree may be weaponized. You can command its tendrils and roots to lash out at enemies, leech chakra, or bind them in place. With enough time and energy, you may even merge with it as Kaguya once did.
objects.title: God Tree (Naruto)

objects.text:
Instead of just a bag full of snacks, you now have access to an entire supermarket filled with a wide variety of grocery products. These range from cheap candy to high-end, luxurious gourmet ingredients like beluga caviar and wagyu beef, each with its own unique beneficial effects when consumed.

As with the snack bag, all items in the supermarket remain fresh as long as they stay within the store. You're given a weekly allowance of store credit to stock up on whatever you choose. For example, if you prefer more soda and less fish, you can adjust how your credit is allocated. If you stick with the default setting, the credit will always be enough to fully restock the store. Any additional purchases beyond that will require you to pay out of pocket.

The more luxurious and expensive an item is, the greater the benefits it provides when consumed. All these ingredients can be eaten raw without risk of food poisoning, but cooking them well allows you to mix and even amplify their effects based on how delicious the final dish is. On the other hand, if you're not very skilled at cooking, you might want to stick to frozen dinners, pre-packaged, or reheated options.
objects.title: Epic Battle Mart™

objects.text:
You got the Philosopher's Cocaine, but it turns out, there was something even more potent out there, and this is it.

By some miracle, your Philosopher's Cocaine was transmuted into Celestial Cocaine, the drug of the very gods themselves.

After snorting up this CELESTIAL cocaine, you unlock the current world's power system. If you already have it, you gain a massive boost to it instead. However, the benefits don't end there as you'll achieve actual enlightenment and gain a dot worth of strength to your Dexterity, Stamina, and Intelligence (For reference, if you could knock out someone in a punch before then you could destroy a large hill after taking this equivalent of strength). As an added benefit, it'll scale with your baseline attributes.

Its replenishing properties unfortunately took a hit (pun intended), and you'll only gain another hit after a year after it was originally taken. Not to mention the ounce you got has been condensed into a single hit's worth.

But if for some reason you're high enough to instead mix it with something else, it'll boost its properties a bare minimum of 1,000% scaling higher than the weaker it was. So a simple healing potion made by a bumbling apprentice could be turned into a supreme potion of healing. A supreme potion of healing, however… could be amped up to break the threshold to being a potion of true resurrection, which will heal everything from missing limbs, terminal diseases, and even mental illness.
objects.title: Celestial Cocaine (Exalted)

objects.text: You have received a Sefirot of your choice, these can take on a multitude of different forms, some purely material, some exist purely as illusionary constructs, and a rare few existing as both a real tangible object and an illusionary presence. Regardless, these are sealed in a 1x1x1 meter wooden crate, preventing their existence from leaking out and interfering with the outer world. This crate also prevents the sefirot from developing its own consciousness, leaving it unable to prevent a Sequence Zero from merging with it to open the door for transcending the sequence system and becoming a Great Old One. These crates also come with a pamphlet containing details on the sefirot, including an honorific name you can use to astral project into it. This allows you to gradually connect with it, leaving a merging intuitive process. You can choose where these are initially located, and if you have means of storing them, like an inventory or a pocket dimension, they are stored there.  If you have Great Old Dominator Diet Supplement, and purchase all potions for a high sequence group and the corresponding sefirot, they are combined into a Great Old Dominator Potion, which, when drunk, elevates you to a Great Old One with all the abilities, authorities, and symbols expected of a Great Old One of your High Sequence Group, just at an initial power around Sequence Zero, though with time and effort you digest the divine essence of the original Great Old One, leaving you with their full power.
objects.title: Legacy of the Oldest One (Lord of the Mysteries)

objects.text:
Now, you own all plasmids AND Vigors in the Bioshock franchise. After injecting yourself with one of ALL of them, your form is reshaped into that of a 9 feet tall, golden "Ideal" form of either man or woman. Not only have all of your abilities from this source become available to you, you have become quite a bit physically stronger as well. If before you were only an average human in strength, you can throw people clean across a warehouse sized room while putting them through the wall! And that's not all...

You can now naturally regenerate EVE in your body, internalizing it and allowing you to use your plasmids at a longer rate. Finally, your powers have each become far stronger than the average plasmid user. Fire fireballs around 7,000 degrees Celsius, levitate around 40,000 tons, Hack security systems and make them think without a doubt that ANYONE you dictate as an enemy is in fact an enemy, and finally: summon an army of 10 big sisters to fight at your side.

Each of these Big Sisters see you as a master/mistress worth following, albeit having a far more weakened version of this upgrade for themselves.
objects.title: Genesis (Bioshock Franchise)

objects.text: Your life has become a little like a video game. Now whenever you explore new realms, defeat notable foes, or accomplish significant objectives, there is now a chance that an Extra Life Coin manifests nearby. These coins appear the same way that rare bonus lives would in a video game with them tucked behind secret areas, gifted after close call boss fights, or discovered as shimmering loot. The coin snap into your inventory once picked up, phasing into your essence like any other Extra Life Coin.
objects.title: Extra Life Loot

objects.text:
Instead of the initial ten fruits, you gain access to a hidden grove capable of cultivating Fruits of Evolution.

The orchard produces new fruits each year at a steady but limited rate, usually several depending on the care given to the trees. You instinctively understand how to tend the grove and harvest the fruit safely, allowing the plants to mature with greater stability than their wild counterparts.

Fruits grown here are more predictable and far less volatile than naturally occurring ones.

The orchard is concealed from casual discovery and resists ordinary destruction. If damaged or neglected, it will slowly recover and regrow unless completely annihilated by extreme forces.

Anyone who eats their first fruit grown in the Orchard is guaranteed to survive the transformation.
objects.title: Origin Orchard (Shinka no Mi)

objects.text:
You have undergone the same process with Venom as Absolute Bane, granting you complete control over your own musculature. Your cells now bend to your will, allowing you to enhance both body and mind far beyond normal human limits. Your mind has been freed from its natural constraints on learning and memory, granting you an immense capacity to absorb, process, and retain knowledge—ranging from entire books and libraries to fighting styles, weapon mastery, battlefield tactics, ancient strategies of warrior kings, and even modern algorithmic doctrines. This heightened control also provides you with an extraordinary tolerance for pain, to the point where it can even be entirely negated.

In addition to the usual physical augmentation provided by Venom, your durability increases to the point that you can endure an entire building collapsing on you and simply walk away. You also possess a vastly accelerated healing factor capable of restoring otherwise fatal injuries almost instantly, including being run over by the Batmobile or having your spine and limbs severed. Lost organs can regenerate within seconds, even something as delicate as an eyeball.

Your tolerance for Venom infusion is also significantly expanded, allowing you to process quantities once believed to be far beyond what the human body could endure. At higher concentrations, your body can grow to gargantuan proportions, with every cell mutating into a state similar to embryonic cells. However, this power is not without limits. Exceeding your maximum threshold risks causing your body to collapse into a mass of gore and ruined tissue.
objects.title: Venom Enhancement (DC Comics)

objects.text:
Rather than a briefcase containing a handful of Elixirs, you gain ownership of an ancient alien Ark identical in purpose and capability to the vessel discovered beneath Antarctica by Eva Fabre.

This colossal starship is the origin of the Chromatic Elixirs and much of the technology derived from them. Hidden, buried, cloaked, or otherwise secured when not in use, it serves as a vast repository of alien knowledge and resources.

Within its depths are immense reserves of Red, Orange, Yellow, Green, Blue, Violet, and White slimes, alongside the machinery required to analyze, refine, preserve, replicate, and manufacture Elixirs from them. Should you possess the necessary knowledge and resources, the Ark is capable of much more.

The vessel contains laboratories, fabrication systems, databanks, medical facilities, industrial infrastructure, and countless artifacts left behind by a long-extinct interstellar civilization. Much of this technology operates on principles beyond modern science and may require extensive study before its full capabilities can be understood.

The Ark recognizes you as its rightful owner and primary administrator. Its systems respond to your authority, granting you access to its facilities and archives. While not all functions are necessarily active or immediately understood, the vessel itself is intact and possesses everything the Antarctic Ark provided in the source material.
objects.title: Antarctic Ark (The Perfect Run)

objects.text: Developed in a time of soft war, these candies are considered an all-around upgrade to the original Rare Candies. In this instance, the drawback of taking into account any possibilities of enhancement. If you have a book of magical spells? It could make it so like if you read the book back to front as many times as possible in the span of a year. With something like Dr. Gero's Laboratory (Dragon Ball Series), It'd give you a year's worth of mental usage and research in your head. This is said to be due to the essence extracted from a Meowth and Clefairy, but no one knows. Another upgrade to it is that rather than 6 months, it's increased twofold to one year worth of training. It also includes what the previous candy did not, enchanting items. However, this has a strict requirement of you needing to have OWNED said equipment, and to be focusing all your thoughts on it while you eat the candy. Optionally, you can have the Rare Candy turn into the Epic Candy, or have the Epic alongside the Rare.
objects.title: Epic Candy
Ichor Vein
objects.text:
It seems you have access to an Ichor Vein, a wellspring of corrupted God’s Blood.

In addition, you also have the necessary tools and facilities to harvest and process the hardened Ichor into Ichor Steel.

This one will spring to life once every 3 months with enough Ichor to make half the amount of Ichor Steel you previously received.

But raw Ichor is dangerous to those without a very strong will, as it tries to drive them insane so they will open the wellspring wider and dive into it, with its effects growing stronger the more of it there is in one place.

objects.title: Dreamstone (Chrono Trigger)
objects.text:
By combining the Sun Stone and Rainbow Shell, you have artificially recreated Dreamstone, the legendary ore that formed the foundation of Zeal's magical civilization. This version combines the Sun Stone's Infinite energy capacity with the Rainbow Shell's supernatural receptivity and durability.

Dreamstone can absorb, store, and channel effectively infinite amounts of magical and elemental energy without loss, retaining it for millennia without degradation. Its exceptional conductivity provides a 1:3 energy conversion ratio, allowing energy to be repeatedly cycled to generate additional magic and potentially create a near-infinite energy source.

However, repeated cycling causes diminishing returns. After a few hundred cycles, the ratio gradually falls to 1:1, after which Dreamstone requires time to recover before its 1:3 ratio can be restored.

Dreamstone is exceptionally suited for creating or enhancing magical weapons, armor, tools, machinery, other artifacts, and creating Magitech. it can even house spiritual beings without harming their spiritual essence.

It can be considered the ultimate resource for any magic based society and their technology, when used to make something such as a time machine or something as simple as a knife or gun, Dreamstone's only limitations come from the schematics and craftsmanship rather then any material failings. 

With enough knowledge anything is possible to be made with this material.

You are no longer merely the keeper of the Heart of Kandrakar—you are its Light, the very fulcrum through which its magic flows. This is not just a title but a birthright, one that binds you to the core of Kandrakar and makes you a conduit for its immense power.

The elements are no longer separate forces to master—Fire, Water, Earth, Air, and Quintessence are yours to command as one, shifting effortlessly at your will. But your dominion extends far beyond them. As the Light of Kandrakar, your magic is a force of creation and control, allowing you to shape reality itself. 

What is imagined can be made real, as thoughts, drawings, and even stories take form at your command. You can warp existence in an instant, altering the world around you and even affecting living beings, stripping them of senses, speech, or movement as easily as turning a page in a book.

Your mastery of magic is unparalleled, extending into spellcraft that can bind, shield, or undo even the strongest enchantments. You can trap beings within objects, imprison them within paintings, or weave spells strong enough to resist even the mightiest of magical forces. 

The barriers between realms mean nothing, and with but a thought you can traverse them, allowing you to travel freely between worlds, traverse dimensions and open portals with ease.

You are no longer just a wielder of the Heart of Kandrakar—you are its Light given form, the essence of its magic, a force of balance and power with no equal.
objects.title: Heart of Light (W.I.T.C.H)

addons.text: The servers are the seven chaos. Chaos is power. Power enriched by the heart. The controller is the one that unifies the chaos. This ancient chant gave you the enlightenment needed to master the Power of Chaos. And it has been etched into your subconscious ever since. This understanding lets you amplify your Chaos Powers, both in-and-out of your Super Form, allowing you to steer them towards the direction of Positive and Negative Energy as you wish. With enough of either, you can ascend the already amazing power of your Super Form to ludicrously absurd levels, to the point that you can warp reality as you see fit. Enough Negative Energy lets you achieve a form similar to “Dark Sonic”, while the opposite grants a form similar to “Starfall Super Sonic”. Both will have their own merits and unique abilities. You will always have complete control over yourself in these states. By creating a perfect balance between the Positive and Negative Energies, you become akin to “Hyper Sonic”, earning not just complete mastery over chaos, but becoming an embodiment of it—it's to the point that you become linked with the Chaos Emeralds in a similar vein to the Master Emerald, allowing you to neutralize their power and sense their exact location, even if you’ve scattered them across the galaxy. You may design the appearance of these upgraded forms as you wish.
addons.title: Undefeatable

addons.text: "Cowards run. I win." The Chaos Emeralds are said to hold unlimited power, and since you are one of the few experts of this power, it's only fitting that it belongs to you and you alone. Your connection to the Chaos Force runs so deep that you’ve gained abilities unheard of. From Ultra Sonic, you can manipulate non-living matter by changing the anatomical structures around you, like turning the air into a wall of water, the stone floor into ice, or a rock into a large spike. You are adaptable to any environment, to the point that you’re not only immune to the hazards they bring but can actively use them to your advantage. From Enerjak, your control over Chaos Energy grants you nigh-omnipotence and omni-presence, as well as the ability to create Prelates. By extracting the soul of a living being, you can then reconstruct it as a metallic, mindless slave with the same physical likeness as the original. Their powers and skills (if any) remain intact, and other enhancements are yours to bestow. When a Prelate is defeated, the soul returns to the original body or can be remade anew to fight again. From Chaos Knuckles, you gain cosmic awareness, and can travel through time and alter it at will on top of warping reality. With each passing moment, you continuously evolve beyond your current level in all aspects, surpassing your enemies just by existing. Finally, you gain access to your own pocket dimension known as the Special Zone, or whatever you want to name it. There is no limit to what you can do with it—a perfect playground to test your godly power.
addons.title: The Ultimate Power

objects.text:
Your Super Form has been upgraded, bestowing you powers that make you a god! 

For as long as you remain in this state, you are nigh-invulnerable. Not even the universe collapsing on itself will leave a scratch on your shining form, and nothing your opponents throw at you can harm you. The only chance they have is to wait for you to revert to normal, have access to a Super Form themselves, or an equivalent power to it. Even then, you can power through such attempts with little issue.

Downloaded into your brain is an archive of every Chaos Power ever used throughout the entire Sonic the Hedgehog franchise, in excruciating detail. From all the techniques used by Super Sonic, Super Shadow, Super Silver, to those of similar forms and powers such as; Burning Blaze, Darkspine Sonic, Excalibur Sonic, Perfect Chaos, Ultimate Gemerl, etc.

You can even create your own Chaos Powers, using nothing more than your own imagination and infinite reserves of Chaos Energy.
objects.title: Chaos Force (Sonic the Hedgehog)

objects.text: Your aptitude for chaos energy has unlocked several techniques you can use with just one chaos emerald. Eventually, you can perform them without their assistance, as if they were innate abilities. Avatar: Lets you create multiple clones of yourself made of pure energy. While you can potentially create hundreds or even thousands of them, they are only temporary. The more you create the less time they stay active until fading away and vice versa. Aside from the hue of energy that surrounds them, they are virtually identical to you. Bullet: Transforms you into a fireball that launches yourself at high speeds in any direction, ending with an explosion. You may utilize this ability for other means such as creating explosive shockwaves, propulsion or a form of fire manipulation. Vision: Reveals secrets and points the way to hidden treasures or your next destination. This has the potential to expand into more applications such as divination and reading minds. Water: Liquifies you into a blob that can freely traverse through any bodies of water, allowing you to swim at astonishing speeds, climb waterfalls or even hide within small puddles. Ivy: Sprouts a large vine from the earth that lifts you into the air. You have full control over the trajectory, speed that it moves, and how it manifests. Whether that be a grind rail, a hangar, launchpad, etc. Slow: A lesser version of Chaos Control that simply slows down time to a crawl for a few moments until it resumes again. You are unaffected by this, unlike those around you. Extra: This bestows you a technique or ability unique to you. This can take many forms depending on several factors like your species, personality, weaknesses, etc. It can be as simple as improving an already potent aspect of yourself to as complex as learning a new attack. It will always scale to match your current capabilities. All of these techniques are vastly improved in your Super Form.
objects.title: Chaos Superstar (Sonic the Hedgehog)

objects.text:
In addition to the Chaos Emeralds, or as a replacement for them, you may select any set of gems or Objects of Power from the Sonic Universe to add to your collection. Like the World Rings, Scabbard, Chaos Rings, Phantom Ruby, Warp Topaz, Jeweled Scepter, or Sol Emeralds. 

This also includes things like Warp Rings from the Archie Comics or Movies, the Miles Electric, an Extreme Gear, a Wispon, and Chip's Bracelet. As well as Level Up Items like the Light Speed Shoes, Flame Ring, Bounce Bracelet, or the Gems from Sonic 06.

Each item can be adjusted to fit your needs, but will still retain its original functions.
objects.title: Additional Gems (Sonic the Hedgehog)

objects.text: "Where's that damn fourth Chaos Emerald?!" Instead of all seven, you only gain one emerald, but we can compensate for that. Upon first purchase, the other six emeralds will be scattered across the world you reside in random locations, but you can use the one in your possession as a radar to sense and find them. With the second purchase, the other six emeralds will simply not exist, leaving you with only one. A single emerald still possesses unlimited power and Chaos Energy reserves, which will still allow you to perform most feats with them, but Super Forms and reality bending feats are impossible. You can choose the color of the emerald.
objects.title: Lost Emeralds (Sonic the Hedgehog)

addons.text:
Whether as the result of your understanding of chi, or as a result of an abnormally strong bond between you and the Stone, you have attained the power and knowledge of Van Hohenheim himself.

This includes the ability to perform Alchemy at a distance, without a circle, and without visible effort (indeed, in some cases it does not even require conscious effort or thought). With the Soul in your stone becoming cooperative towards you, or even fusing with your own soul, you can perform feats far beyond what a regular Alchemist with the exact same stone would, no-selling point blank atomic blasts, seemingly ignoring Equivalent Exchange (even by the high standards of Philosopher's Stones), & performing biological & Human Transmutations without consequence.
addons.title: The Philosopher Of The West

addons.text:
Truth has lifted the scales from your eyes, for you now know the nature of the being contained within your unique Philosopher's Stone. The tortured soul being punished is none other than Father himself!

You are now partly a being with an essence that originates from inside The Gate, giving you knowledge of Alchemy without compare. With your knowledge & the Stone's power, you become a being as powerful as Father after he absorbed the souls of Amestris & The Eye Of God, though with a level of control that won't tear your body apart if you use it.
addons.title: Dwarf In The Flask

objects.text:
You don't just possess a Philosopher's Stone; you are one. While this is arguably true of all humans, given that they have a soul and thus could use their soul for Transmutation, this is an extraordinarily bad idea, an excellent way to shorten your life, & not at all what we're talking about.

Rather, the essence of the Stone has become part of your being in a fundamental way, permitting far more powerful feats of alchemy than even a normal Philosopher's Stone could produce on its own. In particular, the self-focused Human Transmutation of a Homunculus can grant super strength, super speed & reflexes, superior senses & instincts, superior intelligence & charisma, super durability & stamina, eternal youth & regeneration, immunity to contaminants, many types of shapeshifting (such as into other people, animals, & chimeras, turning one's skin to graphene or other materials, extending one's body as a weapon, becoming a hollow shell without organs, etc.), being able to take over the bodies of others, being able to consume others to take their abilities, being able to consume almost any object, use of a shadow based form purely made from soul energy, an internal facsimile of a Gate of Truth connected to a pocket dimension, and eyes which allow for perfect understanding and execution comparable to a visual range limited Path To Victory.
objects.title: Homunculus (Fullmetal Alchemist)

objects.text:
Your Exsphere has evolved into its near perfect form, becoming an Angelus Project Cruxis Crystal. A core of condensed magical and spiritual energy fused with a near-divine essence, a Cruxis Crystal represents the pinnacle of power amplification. It enhances the users physical, mental, magical, and spiritual capabilities to godlike extremes.

Furthermore, unlike standard Exspheres, Cruxis Crystals also halt aging, remove the need to eat, sleep, or breathe, and with sufficient mastery, be used to revive the dead. A user also gains flight, passive regeneration akin to immortality, and effortless control over complex and high-level magic.

A Cruxis Crystal user can survive lethal injuries, move faster than perception, and wield magic with such precision that it rivals divine will. With mastery, the Crystal can even serve as a vessel for the soul, preserving life and form long after the total destruction of the user’s physical body.

The magical energy produced by a Cruxis Crystal is so vast that it becomes visible even to those without magic or magical sight, manifesting as luminous, wing-like constructs radiating from the user’s back. Even lesser Cruxis users are often mistaken for divine beings by entire civilizations, including advanced magical races such as elves.

Yet the cost of such power is immense. Where an Exsphere feeds on negative emotions and life force, a Cruxis Crystal demands far more. Its creation must begin at birth and often spans decades. During its final stages, it devours memory, strips away identity, and consumes every shred of humanity. In the end, what remains is the purest form of potential, paid for with the entire life of another.

The Angelus Project Cruxis Crystal, developed and designed for the “God-King” Mithos Yggdrasill, represents the perfected form of this process. It surpasses all others in raw power, control, and divine resonance.

If you are willing to wield an artifact born from the complete annihilation of another’s soul, humanity, and life, then the Cruxis Crystal will grant you nothing less than the power of a god.
objects.title: Cruxis Crystal (Tales of: Symphonia)

objects.text:
You are the ideal host, the missing vessel the Shaper Shard has always sought. You are not simply compatible—you are essential. Upon finding you, the Shard fuses to your body, embedding itself deep into your upper spine near the nape of your neck, permanently replacing bone and nerve with its own crystalline lattice. From this point on, you are no longer a random subject of mutation—you are the Shard’s chosen vector, its primary conduit, and its one true target.

The bond between you and the Shard is not one of control but of fusion. You are now able to influence the Shard’s vision of the perfect lifeform. Its crude, chaotic designs now shape themselves around your ideals and your aesthetic. You can dictate the forms you take. Wings, horns, armored skin, serpentine limbs—what you envision, the Shard will manifest. 

But the influence is not one-sided. As it listens, it also quietly presses itself into you. The fusion allows the Shard to begin subtly altering your instincts, your neurochemistry, your reflexes, and your fundamental urges. This is not born of malice. The Shard is genuinely trying to help. When you sprout wings, the Shard pushes flying instincts into your mind—how to flap, how to glide, how to balance midair. When you grow claws, it teaches you to slash and grip. It adapts you to your new body, feeding you instincts that should have taken generations to evolve. 

But the Shard is clumsy. It does not fully understand the intricacies of organic life, nor does it perfectly separate useful instincts from those that should remain dormant. The result is that side effects bleed in. You may develop predatory impulses when you never intended to be a predator. You may feel a creeping territorial aggression, or compulsions that were never part of your original self.

Further more, through your fusion, the Shard also gains a vector to channel its immense biological energy. You can now store this energy within yourself, holding it like a living battery. You can release this stored energy at will, using it as a direct fuel source for your rapid transformations. Through this energy, you can freely and instantly change your form—whether to revert to old forms you’ve held before or to create entirely new configurations on the spot. Each transformation costs stored energy, and while the supply replenishes over time, rapid consecutive changes will quickly drain you.

Even when you direct the form you take, the Shard’s influence lingers in the details. You may grow angelic wings, but beneath the feathers, pale blue veins bulge unnervingly, the blood webbing under translucent skin that should not be there. You may craft sleek, perfect horns, but their texture may pulse faintly, as if alive. Every feature, every choice, carries this subtle warping, an edge that feels just slightly wrong. 

You can also release this energy outward to alter other living creatures. With a directed pulse or physical contact, you can force mutation into the bodies of others, reshaping them with DNA the Shard has gathered or invented. These changes work just as they did when the Shard operated alone: Rapid mutations that likely will cause the target’s physiology to collapse and cause death. 

However, as the bonded host, you now have a say in what is changed or added. You can direct the Shard’s energy to impose specific alterations—gifting wings, scales, claws, or twisted hybrids of DNA the Shard has gathered or created. You can guide the form, but the Shard’s clumsiness still remains. The mutations remain unstable, the process still rough, and the Shard’s alien logic continues to slip in strange, unintended results.
objects.title: Panacea

objects.text: Spiegel retained memories of the second stage of the First-Class Mage Exam, which allows him to create up to three copies of any mages who passed this test, including Frieren, and maintain their existence permanently. You must select three mages in advance, and after that, it will be impossible to change your selection.
objects.title: Clones (Sousou no Frieren)

objects.text: With each purchase of this, you can have an additional lacrima implanted inside you, granting access to another magic for another chosen element, a resistance to that element, and innate talent for combining the elements of your multiple lacrima.
objects.title: Additional Lacrima

objects.text: You gain a tattoo-like marking on the back of your hand, as you merge one of the Dragon Balls with your very being. This prevents the chosen Dragon Ball from turning to stone and being “lost” when the Dragon Balls scatter to recharge after wishes have been made. The Dragon Balls can be “fed” power from any sources of internal energies you possess, accelerating the process of recharging the Balls. However, the Dragon Balls can only accept power so fast. A single Dragon Ball being recharged with infinite reserves could only shorten the recharge cycle by about 7.5 weeks. Finally, thanks to hosting a Dragon Ball within your person, you can now sense the rough direction of any remaining Dragon Balls, and detect their presence when close. Note: You will need the Generic Objects of Power Upgrade: Fission to be able to separate any Dragon Balls from your being, if you should desire to do so.
objects.title: A Fist Full of Stars

objects.text: Instead of the merely fist-sized Dragon Balls you had previously, you now have access to these, the colossal Super Dragon Balls capable of summoning the Dragon of the Gods, Super Shenron an immensely huge and powerful golden dragon. The Super Dragon Balls adjust themselves to a size appropriate to your setting and story. In a space-fairing epic, they might be the size of planets nearing that of Neptune. In a more planet-bound setting they might be the size of mountains. Regardless, it will be a herculean task to assemble them all, though always possible just not easy. Once summoned Super Shenron is capable of controlling his size, ranging from the size of galaxies, to being able to fit within an arena as appropriate. The Dragon also only responds to the “Language of the Gods”, which you are now fluent in. But the pay off for assembling these colossal crystals? Super Shenron suffers from only two restraints, he only grants a single ultimate wish per summoning, and he does not allow wishes that affect the mechanics of this Object of Power. Beyond that however? Super Shenron is capable of almost anything, and would be capable of driving off an entity, significantly hurting, or even potentially “killing”—one. Killing in this context is more accurately rendering brain-dead. The Shards and the potential problems from their existence will continue to exist, just without the Entity’s guiding consciousness around. Note: This upgrades one wish to the level of Super Shenron. However if you choose to have more than one selection of the base Object of Power, the Dragon will grant you those wishes at the base Object of Power's level before leaving.
objects.title: Super Dragon Balls (Dragon Ball Series)

addons.title: The Power To Overcome
addons.text:
Much like a certain Saiyan raised on Earth, the purity of your being has allowed you to cleanse the Dark Energy from the Demon Realm Crystal, eliminating its adverse effects and giving rise to the "Ultra SuperVillain Quelled" transformation (or "Ultra SuperHero", the name is up to you). 

This is exemplified by the physical changes seen in the two phases of the standard Ultra SuperVillain Mode: the aura shifts to a sky blue, the irises take on a crystallized blue-green hue, and in the second phase, the energy enveloping parts of your body, along with the chest crystal, turns a distinct blue shade. Yet, this is no mere physical alteration; thanks to the purification of the crystal's power and the removal of the heightened aggression, your ability to share the power of the crystal with others has evolved. You can now grant them the power of the transformation's second phase, though doing so means you can no longer mentally control those to whom you bestow this power. 

Surpass your limits, new Time Patroller, and wield this new power to prevent gods, demons, or anyone else who stands in your way from destroying the future.

addons.title: Time Breaker's Legacy
addons.text:
Your affinity for the fusion of technology and magic, combined with your possession of a Demon Realm Crystal, has granted you the genius and skills of the demon known as Fu, along with the blueprints to recreate all his experiments.

From every type of Demon Realm Crystal to the Time Breaker masks, which allowed Towa to control Bardock and grant him unparalleled power, and the bioengineering and magical prowess that enabled her to create a being like Mira, or even the ability to travel between timelines and alter them to harvest energy from powerful warriors for your experiments: all this and more is within your grasp. You could even perfect the prototype Demon Realm Crystal design, eliminating its original flaws. 

Just be careful with your experiments, alright? Doing something like gathering all the malice from every evil being in the timeline could end up creating a black hole that devours every timeline, and let's just say there’s no Time Patrol here to save your ass.

objects.text:
How curious; it seems that the crystal you were given isn't just one of the many Demon Realm crystals that Fu used during his exploits. This specific crystal is actually one of the final prototypes created by Fu, making it far superior to its predecessors. Its function remains similar, empowering the user and unlocking their, or others', potential by infusing the crystal's Dark Energy, but the results are vastly improved. Infusing this Dark Energy into yourself or others triggers the "Ultra Supervillain" transformation, an evolution of the standard Supervillain mode that comes in two phases. 

The first phase, which unlocks the user's potential and boosts their power tenfold, is characterized by a dark pink aura with floating crystal shards, as well as the user's irises taking on the same pink crystalline texture as the crystal itself. The second phase increases the user's power twentyfold; additionally, one arm and parts of the torso and leg become enveloped in a thin layer of Dark Energy that stains the skin and clothing black, while crystallized power from the crystal begins to protrude from the user's torso. It doesn't stop there, however; the second phase allows the user to transfer some of the Dark Energy to others to control their minds and grant them the first phase of the form, whether to gain more minions to command or simply to have extra minions while you harness the crystal's power yourself

Be careful, though; after all, this is still an unrefined prototype. Beyond the crystal's usual weaknesses, you must now contend with two inherent flaws. First, Ultra Supervillain Mode alters the user's mind, making them far more aggressive and sadistic, an effect that can persist even after exiting the form if it is used excessively. This In the long run wouldn't be an issue if you were merely controlling someone else; however, if you are personally wielding the crystal's power, you must be careful not to lose control. You risk attacking an ally or falling into an enemy trap because your heightened aggression clouds your judgment. Secondly, you can easily lose the form's power due to the crystal protruding from your chest; a well-placed strike against it could deactivate the transformation, leaving you vulnerable if you are facing a superior opponent

In the end, only you can harness the true potential of this crystal, young Time Breaker; so do not fear using it to achieve your goals, just try to keep those pesky do-gooders from the Time Patrol from thwarting your plans
objects.title: Ultra SuperVillain Mode (Dragon Ball Series)

objects.text: For each lacrima you have implanted in you, you have a corresponding elemental magic and resistance, but now they bestow something even greater. Now, you are fully immune to the relevant element, such as a fire dragonslayer becoming immune to fire and heat, or a lightning dragonslayer becoming immune to electricity. This does not boost your dragonslayer magics.
objects.title: Draconic Immunity

objects.text:
Now, your box of Kryptonite has access to a rare new variant: Platinum Kryptonite. Typically, Platinum Kryptonite bestows the full range of Kryptonian powers to non-powered humanoids, as long as it’s in close contact with them.

This variant of Platinum Kryptonite, however, is limited to only bestowing such powers upon those you personally grant a fragment to. If they happen to lose it or have it stolen, it will be completely useless to anyone else who gains it.

Due to being a much rarer and more powerful resource, your box of Kryptonite will only be able to produce at most five pieces of Platinum Kryptonite per purchase here.

Use it wisely.

<Small>Note: Any fragments lost or stolen, can be freely replaced up to the maximum amount of Platinum Kryptonite you have purchased.</small>
objects.title: Platinum Kryptonite (DC Comics)

objects.text:
You have been gifted a miracle. Your allies have seemingly been cloned, or replicated in some fashion. You gain an exact copy of them in every way: power, intelligence, appearance, personality, etc. This means with individuals, you could have up to 5, or in the case of armies and organizations? You get the same number over. So for Greek Army for example; one purchase gives you 13,400 soldiers, two would give you 20,100, three would give you 26,800, and finally four would give you 33,500.

However, this doesn't become exponential, only a linear increase.
objects.title: Further Assistance

objects.text:
Your allies undergo intensive training and enhancement, enabling them to become elite units by every measure: combat skills, physical and mental fitness, and weaponry and equipment.

Put simply, every purchase enhances your subordinates’ combat capabilities. For each purchase, your subordinates will gain ~50–100% of their initial capabilities (that is, the increase is linear rather than exponential). You can focus improvements on a single Ally OoP or distribute purchases across several to enhance their combat performance as well.

This system is highly flexible and depends on the conditions of your current setting, the Technology and Artifice Powers available to you, as well as your personal vision of how it should work.

For example, upgrading mundane soldiers, 1 purchase = elite veterans; 2 purchases = a significant upgrade to equipment or a transition to the level of low-tier super-soldiers, 3 purchases = obtaining advanced equipment or advancing to the high-tier super-soldier level, and so on. The upgrades are relative to each Ally, so while 1 purchase for A Certified Good Boi (or Girl) would only make it a more trained and physically capable pet, Empowered Village would make the whole village very capable of defending themselves without you.
objects.title: Training & Enhancement

objects.text: Your presence has inspired a progression in your Allies previously unheard of. Your Allies now have gained a 200% increase in all areas: numbers, strength, resources, etc. But of particular note is their newfound horizontal growth, allowing them to gain new traits while working with you. Aquilla of the Ninth might gain the ability to utilize their dark magic taint like restraining their opponents and faster travel via darkness. Plush Pal! could gain the ability to make offspring perfectly suited to a particular customers' taste. Or even Pokémon could have their move limits removed and gain powers based on their typing and more.
objects.title: Performance Powerup

addons.text:
Your gargoyle can now repair itself using any solid material it absorbs, converting it into whatever substance its body is composed of regardless of origin. This removes the previous restriction on matching materials, allowing it to regenerate in virtually any environment while maintaining the superior properties of its chosen composition. It can also alter the material of its body entirely, provided it has previously absorbed and assimilated that material, enabling you to shift its composition between known substances as needed. This includes supernatural materials.

The conversion process is not instantaneous, and both regeneration and full-body material changes take time to complete. More complex or higher-grade materials require longer to properly convert, meaning newly restored sections will temporarily retain the properties of the lower-grade material used. Until the process finishes, those areas remain weaker than the intended final composition.
addons.title: Material Gargoyle

objects.text:
Your golem has been turned into a gargoyle. Any additional features you design into its form are fully functional rather than cosmetic as before. Wings grant true flight, claws become sharp and capable of rending, and extra limbs function with full coordination and strength. It retains its loyalty, intelligence, and regenerative abilities while benefiting fully from these enhancements.

You can shape it into forms suited for combat or utility, such as granting it wings for sustained aerial movement, multiple arms for grappling and multitasking, or specialised appendages for climbing and precision work. Its dexterity is no longer a limitation, allowing it to perform fine manipulation and fluid, controlled motion. Given enough time and sufficient carving skill, you can freely redesign and refine its body into new configurations to suit different needs.

Its body is now composed of denser, rarer stone, making it more durable than before. It can still absorb common rock to repair itself, but any restored sections will initially be weaker. These sections gradually convert into its superior material over time, restoring full strength once the process is complete. By default, it resembles a stone gargoyle with sharp teeth, claws, and wings capable of flight.
objects.title: Gargoyle

objects.text:
Your golem is no longer made of common earth-based materials, instead you can choose any non-supernatural solid substance such as processed steel, ice, crystal, or similarly stable materials for it to be made off. These materials fully define its physical properties, granting the durability, weight, and other characteristics appropriate to their nature.

Depending on the material chosen, it can gain different properties, such as a steel body having increased toughness and structural integrity, or ice having a lighter form with unique environmental interactions. It will function as effectively as its composition allows without losing cohesion or stability. Its capabilities remain consistent with its form, and while its performance may vary based on material properties, it retains the same level of control, intelligence, and obedience as before.

Due to its different material body, it can no longer repair itself using any common rock, and instead must absorb material identical or highly similar to its current composition to heal.
objects.title: Material Variant

objects.text: Your village has shed at least a form of its chains. Before, it was the size of a small-ish village and stayed that way. Now, it can grow via natural expansion and welcoming others while keeping all of its benefits in the new areas. Anyone who becomes an inhabitant will gain the powers you give to the village, and while not as heavily, they will be inclined to the same loyalty as the others, depending on the individual and if they choose to keep that loyalty. But the biggest buff of the village is that they are no longer limited to 50% of your cap. Now, if they truly train and put themselves to the test, it's possible they could even surpass you. If you don't train at all and little Jimmy down the street who has Haki is into developing himself, it's possible his Armament Haki could be even better than yours. But no one will ever dream of replacing you as the village leader, still.
objects.title: Unchained Village

objects.text:
With each purchase, you receive an additional egg containing a random, Level 1, non-legendary Pokemon that will hatch within a week of obtaining the egg. With time, the Pokemon can learn any move it would normally be capable of and can evolve without needing a specific location or item.

As a bonus, you may freely choose a type of Poke Ball, except Master Ball, to obtain which can house your future partner. If your world lacks Pokemon Centers, Pokemon Doctors, or close equivalents, your partner's Poke Ball slowly heal them from the equivalent of 0 HP to Max HP.
objects.title: Additional Random Pokémon Eggs (Pokemon)

objects.text:
Do you want a Pokemon companion (or a few), but don’t feel like gambling? Well now you can simply choose what non-legendary Pokemon you want your eggs to contain! 

This will work on the initially purchased egg, as well as any additional ones if you have any. In addition to choosing the species, you can also determine gender, guarantee at least one egg move, and whether the Pokemon will be shiny or not is entirely up to you.
objects.title: Guaranteed Pokemon Eggs (Pokemon)

objects.text: Mahalo, customer! You have unlocked a permanent Gold Membership for your Ride Pager, adding new Pokémon into your playlist for an expanded number of options for your travels across not just Alola but the world beyond. Additionally, Lapras Paddle & Sharpedo Jet are now able to Dive underwater, meaning your Sea Style Riding Suit now includes a diving helmet with an infinite oxygen respirator mask with a underwater mic & a full body insulating wetsuit with deployable feet flippers. Sharpedo Jet can also now cross through whirlpools, while Charizard Glide can now defog an area. Ampharos Flash: For exploring dark areas at a jaunt speed. Sneasler Climb: For climbing up ledges or general mountaineering related treks. Basculegion Ascend: For going up and over waterfalls or whirlpools with either surfing or ghostly energized jumps. You can throw Poké Balls or fish comfortably while on this Surf Ride Mon. Sceptile Slash: For cutting down that pesky fast growing shrubbery. Cyclizar Dash: For those wanting just the wind on their face. Can also leap into the air.
objects.title: Gold Membership Ride Pager (Pokemon)

objects.text: You’ve guaranteed what Pokemon are hatching from these eggs, but what if the pool of existing Pokemon isn’t quite good enough for you? With this, you can get fanmade variants of the chosen Pokemon such as Delta Variants (Pokemon Insurgence), regional forms for fanmade regions, or anything else of a similar nature, so long as it is not meaningfully stronger than the Pokemon you’d be obtaining.
objects.title: Fanmade Variants
Paldean Care Package (Pokemon Scarlet / Violet)
objects.text:
You didn't want a bunch of options, huh? Well, now instead of multiple Pokémon in your Ride Pager, you have one, and only one: either Koraidon or Miraidon, loaned from Professors Sada and Turo in Area Zero. No take backs: once you chosen your Raidon, you’re stuck with it. You can request the nature you want your Raidon to have, though all will have a fondness for sandwiches of all flavors.

Both Raidon models are capable of flying, swimming and running at high speeds, can smash or shove aside boulders, leap at least two stories tall, can rip plants out by the root, and can scale sheer surfaces, all while comfortably able to carry at least several humans around on their natural saddle-like backs, with easy to reach handlebars.

Unlike Alola's Ride Mons, your Raidon is combat capable, meaning your Raidon could serve as an emergency party member to your team. Just in the absolute worst case scenario of you running into someone capable of messing with Poké Balls, your Raidon’s ball is immune to lockout overrides.

Now you claim the entirety of the Adeptus Astra Telepathica—its forces, its fleets, its strongholds, and every institution under its command. This includes the Sanctioned Psykers, the Navigators, the League of Black Ships, the Scholastia Psykana, and even the Obsidian Keep itself. Every soul within the organization regard you with Zeal, worship and devotion beyond what even the Black Templars could ever show the Emperor himself, and nothing can change this, even if The Ruinous Powers themselves used all their might to try to corrupt them, all of this is inheritable for any and all descendants of any and all members, their devotion absolute, unbreakable, and beyond all doubt.

More astonishing still, you inherit every Sister of Silence who has ever existed throughout the Imperium’s long and blood-soaked history. Nearly one million Sisters now stand under your banner—each restored to flawless condition and bound to you with the same unwavering zeal described in the Vigil of the Sisters of Silence. Your presence grants them perfect command over their nature as Nulls and Pariahs: they may sharpen their anti-psychic aura into a suffocating void, or silence it completely with a thought.

Their most legendary figures return as well. At their head stands Jenetia Krole, the Soulless Queen, the greatest Knight-Commander of the Sisterhood during the Horus Heresy—reborn with all her mastery, leadership, and iron resolve intact.

All who serve within the Adeptus Astra Telepathica are wholly loyal, but your psykers possess a unique miracle: perfect incorruptibility. Whether by their metaphysical bond to you or the sheer absence of Chaos in your presence, they stand immune to daemonic whispers, warp-taint, and every form of corruption known to the Imperium.

You do not merely command the Adeptus Astra Telepathica—you refine it into perfection. Beneath your authority, it becomes a war engine without fear, doubt, or the faintest possibility of corruption.

Finally, you are granted a perfect personal dimension to contain all of this power. It provides limitless resources to feed, house, arm, entertain, and maintain every force you command, complete with the infrastructure required to support them. Any pocket realm, or Forces you possess—whether granted through OoP’s, items, powers, companions, or upgrades such as Shadow Garden (Eminence in Shadow), Personal World, or The YOU Foundation—can be seamlessly merged into this domain. With each fusion, the dimension expands, and its resources multiply, ensuring your followers remain forever sustained, equipped, and unwaveringly loyal.

Under your rule, the Imperium’s greatest psychic order becomes not merely a weapon, but an empire within an empire—thriving in a realm shaped entirely by your will.
objects.title: Adeptus Astra Telepathica (Warhammer: 40K)

objects.text:
Before, this plush pal was made strictly for the public center, to only serve as a friend to those in need. But now... It seems your Plush Pall has come from a further version of its future, where the government has bought out the corporation that designed and built these animal bots.

On top of what it could do, it has gained a few improvements in the battle arena. Specifically, it now has spatial folding technology in its limbs, like a bee with laser stingers, a panda with claws capable of cutting down to the cellular level, and more if you are able to make it for them to absorb into it. Another benefit is that it can let out 10 "drones" of itself like a cub for a bear, looking like cartoonish child versions of the animal, to perform reconnaissance and small group attacks. It has also gained two new benefits for its interior space for its owner. One is that the space has increased from the size of an average bedroom to a whole 2 story house worth of space. And further more, your pal can now equip you with a same-animal onesie, from your toes to your head while also covering your face. 

This allows you to control your Pal from the inside down to the tiniest twitch while your pal can also, if you desire, adjust your movements to be less wasteful. Finally, your Pal has now been given a separate battle AI it can swap into, where it gets a new level of intelligence in the art of combat and aggression, though the original AI is still available.

If taken with Phobia Plush Pal!, this will allow the dolls ability to grow to the level of its upgrade (Horror Hidden Beneath), but still at a contained level.
