The Plushy Pal will be able to channel the dolls abilities into its weapons, making its slash cause eldritch mutations in targets, and beams of "fear" and more.

If taken with Princess Plush Pal!, the drones will gain an additional armor in the shape of chibi-knight armor, becoming MUCH tougher without any drawback of speed loss. Your main Plush will also gain the ability to utilize more combative forms of magic in the outfit, like magic missiles, restrictive spells, and powerful ward spells.

If Taken with Powerful Plush Pal!, the weapons and drones will all be infused with the powers. Ki powered claws, Hamon infused bites, and more. It will also influence their interior space, allowing you to share in its power as a sort of power up.

And with Pattern Plush Pal, It once more boosts the templates, allowing up to 50 SP worthy characters. It will also augment the fighting capabilities of the template, for example allowing Hinata Hyuga to affect not just chakra points, but any vital point or organ in the body.

Finally, this can apply to any addons using Plush Pal if chosen.
objects.title: Prime Plush Pal!

objects.text:
It seems the future company that created the Plush Pal has reached a singularity point. The Plush Pal given to you is the best of its kind.

It possesses immense technology, almost considered magitech by most who work on it. Against even the hottest fire in the universe, it can create a shield of absolute zero to counter it, and it can do the opposite for the most chilling cold. If a planetary explosion were about to occur around you, the Plush Pal would quickly pull you into its back and encase you further in a nanomachine barrier. Until there is not a trace of danger left, it will not let you out in case additional threats remain. Even against magic, it will quickly shield you while rewriting its own atoms whenever change is forced upon it. This is aided by the Plush’s now-precognitive predictive systems, which anticipate both dangers and requests you might have for it.

All Plush Pals now possess size manipulation, allowing them to shrink to the size of their corresponding insect or grow to the size of skyscrapers, with their strength remaining unaffected unless the growth is beneficial. Furthermore, if you possess any weapon Objects of Power, the Plush Pal can temporarily fuse with them until you call them back out.

Its physical prowess has also increased to match its technological capabilities. Nothing on Earth can harm it—bullets bounce off its plush body, blades simply press into the fabric rather than cutting through it, and even supernatural powers are quickly negated or weakened through rapid pseudo-adaptation to whatever attacks it. In terms of speed and strength, it is likely unmatched by anything on the planet. It can destroy large sections of the Earth in a single strike, travel at the speed of light without harming you inside it, and even manipulate matter at the near-atomic level precision.

Finally, it has one more significant capability. Using a combination of nanomachines, cellular reprogramming, and what it calls “love” as the third ingredient, it can transform others into Plush Pals—though only to the level of a standard model. In about twenty minutes, it can transform any creature or living being into a Plush Pal, although this does not guarantee they will cooperate with you. However, compared to your Pinnacle Plush Pal, they are little more than infants in terms of capability.
objects.title: Pinnacle Plush Pal!

objects.text:
In the future, the mobile factories of the Plush Pal also served as multi-talented businesses to maximize efficiency, show off the plush pals to the public to show their worth, and more. It seems you have gotten hold of one such factory, known as a "Palace."

In its mobile form, it resembles a fantasy castle roughly big enough to be held by two adult hands with relative ease. To bring it to normal size, it must be in an area the factory itself can identify as safe. Since it's 600,000 square meters, that requires a lot of space. But, once you squeeze it intentionally twice in a row, it will grow over the span of 10 minutes to its full size, providing its own power, material needs, and sustenance from the ground and area around it, without poisoning it or the like.

Once fully grown, the place is open, and you'll find plenty of space for you to set up businesses, showcases, and more. The prime benefit however, is its capability to build Plush Pals in the factory section. These Plush Pals will all obey you first, but will also obey their owners, if willing to put you first if absolutely necessary. Any and all Plush Pal Addons and upgrades you have will seep into these Plush Pals.

You will find the charisma, cuteness, and just overall new nature of this building will attract plenty of customers, and no people will be able to shut down your business. Health Inspectors will always give you 100's/A+'s without hesitation, Safety Inspectors will not find a single thing dangerous in the place, and more.

Finally, you are able to create Plush Pals specifically for jobs in the building, like a bobcat vice president, or a mole factory supervisor, or even a kitty HR Department head, and so on..
objects.title: Plush Pal Palace!

objects.text:
You must've gone to the future and bought some more Plush Pals, because now, you have up to 9 additional Plush Pals under your belt.

Each of these have a very casual hivemind, more of a shared informational and sensory bank that updates at the Picosecond between them. So if your Bee Pal was in Madrid, your leopard in China could basically share vision with them at essentially no delay or the like. Addons and Upgrades apply to all selected.
objects.title: Plentiful Plush Pals!

objects.text:
It seems that the egg you received was not the one containing Godzilla Junior, but rather some other daikaiju from the Godzilla Franchise.

You may pick which daikaiju you wish this to be the egg of, but there are some details that you should take notice of. Firstly, the daikaiju will imprint upon you to the same degree as Junior would have, but may express it differently. Secondly, the growth rate and dietary differences between daikaiju, such as in comparison Heisei Godzilla Junior who would require constant exposure to radiation and a few years to mature.
objects.title: Alternate Daikaiju (Godzilla Franchise)

objects.text:
The presence of the horror has deepened—no longer merely a slumbering god behind glass eyes, it now stains the world with more vivid and irreversible corruption. The doll’s influence over reality becomes more invasive, especially in areas already saturated by its lingering presence. When the horror awakens in such a place, space itself twists into a living nightmare: walls breathe, shadows crawl in unnatural directions, and the very geometry of the area fractures under the pressure of its dreaming mind, creating a mutable, semi-organic terrain that reflects the horror’s subconscious.

Even while asleep, the horror is no longer inert. The doll becomes quietly alert, aware of those who linger near it. Proximity now invites subtle psychic infection. The longer someone remains near the dormant doll, the more they become saturated with its psychic residue—threads of influence that creep into their thoughts, warping perception, blurring dreams with waking life, and gradually undermining their will. Over time, the horror learns to puppeteer such individuals, causing them to act on its behalf in small, disturbing ways: whispering to others in their sleep, sabotaging nearby objects, or unknowingly spreading its influence further.

When the horror finally awakens, the true price of that saturation is revealed. Those fully under its thrall—whether they knew it or not—undergo violent and grotesque mutations. Flesh bends to its will, minds are stripped of identity, and they become twisted servitors driven by fanatical devotion and instinctive violence. These newly born monsters act as extensions of the horror’s will, moving with uncanny synchronicity and ferocity. You, as the owner of the Object of Power, remain untouched by its control or mutation.
objects.title: Horror Hidden Beneath

objects.text: " The US is dead... long live the US." It seems you have done the impossible, and gotten the "military" and "government" to become one powerful union, with this union's name up to you. Now, on top of the Brotherhoods resources, you have gained the resources of the elusive Enclave! This means you have, similarly to before, all of the resources and members they have ever had access to. For example, this means your box has grown internally quite a bit, allowing for all structures of both organizations inside, including the Enclave Oil Rig and more making this about a 70 mile circumference including a mini ocean. For the Enclave, you have also gained a rather helpful resource of reverse engineering thanks to manpower and Enclave scientists. Combined with the Brotherhood and whatever you can give them, you practically have the Pre-War infrastructure to develop new technology. Examples of what you now have include a massive mobile base on the ground, utilizing modified crawler-transporter technology, bigger than the Prydwen, plans for a Multi-Generational Ship for space travel, the demon incarnate Frank Horrigan, a ZAX supercomputer president, and far more. Each half of the union is able to utilize, upgrade, and just generally interact with the others technology.
objects.title: United Government

objects.text:
Your combat drone has been rebuilt for covert operations in social environments, equipped with a fully human-like android shell. The Ghostskin replaces the Juggernaut’s armored exterior with an advanced synthetic body—realistic skin, facial musculature, and temperature regulation—capable of flawlessly mimicking human appearance, movement, and expression. It can blend into civilian populations, pass for a bodyguard or operative, and enter restricted areas without raising suspicion.

Internally, its full combat functionality remains unchanged. Hidden beneath the skin are its integrated weapons, reinforced chassis, and battlefield-grade actuators. However, all systems are now concealed within a form that appears completely non-threatening until activated.

Ghostskin includes a high-tier social interaction suite: thousands of behavioral templates, multilingual fluency, and an adaptive emotional response model. It can interpret tone, facial cues, and body language in real time, adjusting its behavior to charm, disarm, or manipulate as needed. Infiltration, negotiation, subterfuge—it can now do more than survive a firefight. It can prevent one from ever starting.

Ghostskin allows the Juggernaut to operate where no weaponized drone could: dinner parties, corporate meetings, embassy halls, or public events. It is the perfect mask for a monster designed to protect you without compromise—and now, without warning.

Yet, even now, it is not truly alive. Ghostskin only simulates empathy, it doesn’t feel it. Its personality is a construct—a mask crafted for interaction and deception as much as protection. It operates within moral parameters you set, but make no mistake: its loyalty is absolute, its responses are calculated, and its actions are optimized for your safety above all else.
objects.title: Infiltration Shell “Ghostskin”

addons.text:
Your doll has been upgraded and equipped according to YoRHa standards, which has significantly increased its combat performance.

Significant increase in physical strength, agility and speed, allows you to kick a two-meter heavily armored robot into the air tens of meters. The speed of movement and jumping distance have also increased significantly. Developed AI allows you to quickly and effectively analyze the battlefield and opposing enemies, developing effective tactics.

The installed Black Box serves as both a power source and a memory storage system.

Combat programs are adapted for close combat and mastery of cold weapons, which, combined with great physical strength, allows you to easily destroy opponents who are weakly vulnerable to hand-held firearms.

There is the possibility of field modernization with special chips. Which allows you to quickly adapt to current tasks and situations. A full set of chips is issued as basic equipment.

The equipment kit includes a set of cold weapons, a YoRHa Pod, a visor headband and a set of clothing with heat-dissipating properties.
addons.title: YoRHa Androids

objects.text:
Your T-Doll has gotten themselves an upgrade, elevating them to the "Elite" level. As an Elite unit, they are now fully capable of independent operation, excelling in covert missions, electronic warfare, and advanced tactical combat scenarios. Their software enhancements also grant them access to a wider array of combat algorithms, infiltration techniques, and strategic decision-making capabilities.

In addition to their software upgrades, your T-Doll has received an improvement to their hardware as well. Upgrades to their processor, memory, communication systems, and sensors drastically improve efficiency and adaptability. They are now equipped with high-capacity batteries alongside a dedicated backup power system, ensuring extended operational longevity. Their reinforced frame armor renders them impervious to small and medium-caliber weaponry, while enhanced servos provide greater strength and reaction speed.

Furthermore, you will have the option to install specialized modules to further refine your T-Doll's capabilities. Whether it's an "Electronic Warfare Module," a "Command Module," or a "Communications Module," you are free to customize your T-Doll's enhancements to suit your needs.

Their "Dummy Network" has also been upgraded. While the number of dummy units remains the same, the control link is now significantly more stable, boasting increased bandwidth for seamless coordination.

All of their equipment—ranging from weapons and ammunition to specialized gear—has also been upgraded to the level of military-grade special forces equipment, ensuring peak combat effectiveness.
objects.title: Elite T-Dolls (Girls Frontline)

addons.text:
Your doll gets to command 20 standard T-Doll SF of your choice (basic units like Reaper, Vespeed, Jaeger, etc.).

They have their own full AI, but a significant part of non-combat capabilities is suppressed by your doll.

They retain the ability to control 5 Dummy Dolls.

All of them get weapons, basic equipment and supplies.
addons.title: Boss's Retinue

addons.text:
You can only have 1 Shogun Doll, which will have access to the Magatsu Mitake Narukami no Makoto form and wield the Musou Isshin sword.

The other, up to 3 dolls, can be copies of the Shogun, but without the said form and sword. However, they will still be formidable opponents, who will have access to the Musou no Hitotachi art sufficiently to defeat the Harbingers of Fatui.
addons.title: Children of Ei

objects.text:
Instead of one T-Doll, you get a squad of four "Tactical Dolls," each of which can be either a copy or be entirely unique, the appearance and weapons of which you can freely choose. All these dolls receive the benefits available to your doll, including supplies and "dummies." Friendly relations will reign within the squad, allowing you to achieve the most effective interaction. 

As a bonus, you'll get any civilian car capable of accommodating you and your squad of dolls with all your things.
objects.title: T-Dolls Squad (Girls Frontline)

addons.text:
Your "Army" is upgraded to the "elite" level, and each doll in its composition receives "elite" status with the corresponding capabilities and support. This also applies to civilian dolls and technical support, which are transferred to the category of high-class specialists and expensive high-tech equipment.

All weapons, equipment and equipment are now at a level available only to elite special units and are distinguished by their efficiency and high power. And the fleet of equipment includes several samples of specialized (but lightly armed) equipment, such as helicopters, airplanes or boats and small submarines for special purposes.
addons.title: Elite Army of T-Dolls (Girls Frontline)

addons.text:
Now you have 20,000 T-Dolls made using SF technology (a heavy legacy of the "Boss's Retinue" addon), but no more than 100 command-type "Ringleader" Dolls. All these dolls have access to the advantages available to your dolls earlier, such as Dummy Dolls and so on.

The bulk of them are basic units, such as Reaper, Vespeed, Jaeger, etc. But they can be further strengthened with high-tech and experimental equipment and weapons.

The "civilian" personnel of dolls is expanded to 2,000 dolls, allowing you to maintain the required level of combat readiness and combat effectiveness at the maximum level even with the use of the most advanced and experimental weapons systems on the battlefield.

The vehicle fleet available to you is expanded and improved to the appropriate level, and the presence of automatic ground, air and ground equipment is a basic indicator for you. However, she still remains lightly armed and protected.
addons.title: Sangvis Ferri Army (Girls Frontline)

addons.text:
You and your T-Dolls now form a single common network that allows you to interact without the risk of detection, interception, and communication disruption. The network will function regardless of distance and even between different realities and dimensions.

Within the network, you act as the main administrator and as the main conditional "server" through which communication, transmission, and storage of information will be carried out, including a continuous current copy of the neural cloud of any of your T-Dolls with an accessible archive of ongoing changes.

The higher the level of your dolls ("regular", "elite", and "SF"), the higher the complexity and internal capabilities of the network will be. "Regular" T-Dolls would require noticeable efforts from you to create command structures and create chains of information exchange (for example: one chat without any structuring except for nicknames); "Elite" T-Dolls would already be able to independently create and maintain command structures and information transfer systems, allowing for the creation of an effective system for transferring relevant tactical information in real time (example: creating separate channels or chats); "Sangvis Ferry" and command-type "Ringleader" Dolls would already be able to independently act as "servers" and administrators for processing and storing huge amounts of information, including situations where you are out of order for some reason, although this would fragmentation the network into unconnected local networks led by individual "Ringleader" Dolls.
addons.title: Command Network

objects.text:
Now you have 1000 T-Dolls at your disposal, each of which has all the advantages that were previously available to your dolls, including Dummy Dolls and supplies of equipment and equipment.

In addition to 1000 T-Dolls and 5000 of their Dummy Dolls, you get 100 civilian dolls of technical and logistic support with all the necessary equipment and support materials, including workshops and production equipment.

Within your army there will be a ready-made command hierarchy and a close-knit friendly team, which will lead to a high level of interaction and mutual understanding.

As a bonus, you will receive the required number of heavy army trucks and light armored vehicles corresponding to the level of your T-Dolls.

You can choose where your army will be deployed and in what form (deployed in combat position or quietly stored in factory packaging in some warehouse or hiding place).

In addition, the "Army" can implement all the add-ons available to you in the corresponding OoP branch concerning T-Dolls. For example, "Mobile Armor" will allow each doll to have its own piece of armor of the appropriate level (regular T-Dolls - military vehicles produced the of the 20st century, elite T-Dolls - modern military vehicles of the beginning of the 21st century, and Sangvis Ferri dolls - high-tech vehicles).
objects.title: T-Doll Army (Girls Frontline)

addons.text:
Something amazing has happened to your T-Dolls, they have been blessed and sanctified by the hand of the Machine God himself, the Omnissiah. And this Miracle has many consequences.

First, and perhaps not the least significant, if you meet a Tech-Priest of the Adeptus Mechanicus, he will see and feel that your T-Dolls are blessed and revered machines, and not the despised and to be destroyed Abominable Intelligence of the Silica Animus.

The second significant consequence is that all the "rituals" of the Cult Mechanicus obviously and effectively work on your T-Dolls. This is a major enhancement, allowing you to increase the reliability, efficiency or security of your T-Dolls.
The third significant consequence is that your T-Dolls will gain resistance and protection against various negative effects of various natures, both from technological and supernatural danger. Various software viruses will lose their effectiveness and will either not be able to penetrate the T-Dolls' programs or will be quickly identified and destroyed. Any communication suppression can be overcome and broken through, despite their strength and technical superiority. Any supernatural or esoteric threat will either have no significant impact or will be significantly weakened. In particular, such protection is effective against threats that combine technical and supernatural aspects, such as a paranormal software virus capable of defiling AI.

The last significant aspect is that your T-Dolls will to some extent become inherent in fervor and ardor in the matter of destroying the unnatural, otherworldly and alien, which will significantly increase their effectiveness against this type of threat.
addons.title: Dolls Blessing of the Machine God

objects.text:
If you have Technology Powers from any universe in the corresponding section, you can re-equip all your dolls with equipment, weapons and vehicles from the corresponding universe.

The level of equipment will depend on the level of "dolls" available to you. For example: from Adeptus Mechanicus (Warhammer: 40k) your "normal" T-Dolls will receive the level of equipment and gear available to Astra Militarum regiments; "elite" T-Dolls will receive equipment available to Scion Tempestus and the most elite mortal units of the Imperium; Sangvis Ferri will receive equipment more appropriate to Skitarii regiments of the Adeptus Mechanicus. The same ratio will apply to other universes: "normal" T-Dolls - a normal army; "elite" T-Dolls - elite units; "SF" - the most advanced experimental and rare military units.

This will not allow you to receive any mystical enhancements or equipment, but strictly technological upgrades. The exception will be Power and OoP represented through addons and upgrades from the OoP T-Dolls branch, such as "Children of Ei", "The Shogun", "Creations of Holou" and others.

By purchasing OoP in Vehicle Objects of Power, you can replace the crew with T-Dolls, who will be ready to perform the functions of the crew.
objects.title: An Army of Cosplayers? (Girls Frontline)

addons.text:
Your doll has undergone deep modernization and integration with the GBE, which elevated it to the rank of a high-level safeguard.

The Safeguard body has high strength and resistance to damage, allowing it to withstand blows capable of destroying buildings. Safeguards are able to restore damage even if most of the body is destroyed.

Scanning systems allow you to analyze objects, obtaining various information about them. Search for targets beyond the line of sight, in various spectra and through various materials and obstacles.

After a detailed scan, it will have the ability to mimic a person in detail, imitating his appearance in detail.

The weapon is a rifle-type GBE integrated into the forearm, which is capable of automatic fire.

The protective equipment is supplemented by a magnetic force field capable of deflecting energy weapons and low-level GBE attacks.

Your "doll" will not have a Netsphere connection, but you will be able to restore it from a copy of the information image. However, it is really difficult to completely destroy Safeguard, since if necessary, they can retain consciousness even if most of the body is destroyed.
addons.title: High-Level Safeguard (Blame!)

addons.text:
Your doll has undergone a deep upgrade to the Ex-Machina level, receiving impressive physical capabilities, the main one being the Losen algorithms, which allow, after analysis, to imitate and copy any attacks, including magical ones, to which they themselves have been subjected, as well as create new techniques based on the received data, which allows you to continuously expand your arsenal.

Ex-Machina is incredibly durable and is designed for 1000 years of service, but can last up to 6000 years.

Scanning and analysis systems, coupled with incredibly powerful AI, allow them to incredibly effectively identify lies and tricks, including half-truths and omissions.

There is access to an extensive arsenal of 50 weapons and copied abilities, since your "doll" is not connected to the Ex-Machina cluster with their 27,000 weapons and abilities. But this is more than enough to be a formidable combat unit. Weapons and abilities will manifest in combat form, appearing in the form of doll body kits and equipment.

The most powerful technique, Alles-Losen or "last stand", allows you to use the full arsenal of weapons and abilities, turning your doll into a "mobile fortress" and giving it the ability to withstand even a much stronger opponent. Albeit for a short time.
addons.title: Creations of Holou (No Game No Life)

addons.text:
Your  T-Doll type is the ringleader can obtain her own experimental weapon prototype as a secondary weapon without losing any combat capabilities.

However, it will be compact enough for your T-Doll to use and carry it around on her own.

As a bonus, you can choose 1 parameter out of 3 (power; ammunition capacity; rate of fire) and increase its stats by 10 times.
addons.title: Boss Guns

objects.text:
Your doll has undergone a global upgrade using Sangvis Ferri technologies and has been upgraded to the type "Ringleader" Doll, which has significantly expanded its computing power and improved its combat and command programs. In general, even the best Elite T-Doll AIs produced by humans are relatively weak compared to the capabilities of Sangvis Ferri dolls in this area.

Upgrade of the combat capabilities of the frame and its protection, to a level where only heavy easel weapons or squads of elite T-Dolls can pose an immediate threat.

In the context of electronic warfare, your Doll has become a truly formidable opponent. But the main strength of your doll from now on is coordination and centralized control on the battlefield as a command link, which will allow you to confront even a more technologically advanced and stronger enemy.

High-tech and experimental weapon systems such as lasers, rail guns, integrated weapon systems, etc. are added to the list of available weapons.

As an option, your doll can be upgraded with Paradeus technology instead of SF technology.
objects.title: Sangvis Ferri (Girls Frontline)

addons.text: All your android horses receive equivalent protective equipment (horse armor) and additionally receive a set of enchanted cavalry weapons, with the ability to install cavalry combat programs for the T-Doll that owns the "horse".
addons.title: Royal Doll Cavalry (Girls Frontline)

objects.text:
Your T-Doll will receive a robotic horse with basic artificial intelligence that allows it to function autonomously.

This “horse” has a sturdy body made of metal and composite materials with armor that protects it from light and medium firearms. Thanks to its sensors, it can easily navigate difficult weather conditions and detect targets. In addition, it has excellent cross-country mobility—it can outrun motorcycles. High-capacity batteries ensure long operating times without recharging.

The robotic horse can be equipped with various heavy weapons, which are mounted on movable rods in the croup area (for example, two miniguns). It is capable of firing on the move. In addition, it can use its steel armored hooves to strike like a normal horse.

The hull has several compartments for storing cargo and slots for installing modules and additional equipment of your choice.

Your T-Doll and her Dummy Dolls will also receive robotic horses. Horse riding skills will be provided in the form of software.
objects.title: Doll Cavalry (Girls Frontline)

addons.text:
After the Dummy Dolls are deployed and the T-Doll commanding them is damaged or destroyed, control and management can be intercepted and taken over by another allied or higher-ranking T-Doll.

This control will be weaker and less effective, but will allow the mission to continue using the "orphaned" Dummy Dolls. However, if necessary and with free time, the T-Doll, with the codes, software and free computing power, will be able to reprogram the Dummy Dolls for itself. However, the T-Doll will still perceive them as something foreign and will not be able to achieve 100% of their effectiveness.

Elite T-Doll will be able to take over control of orphaned Dummy Dolls from 4 destroyed T-Dolls. If you have the command-type "Ringleader" Doll, this doll will not only be able to take control of "orphaned" Dummy Dolls, but also forcibly intercept such control from T-Dolls subordinated to her personally, without having problems with their effective control. However, "Ringleader" will not be able to control Dummy Dolls from more than 40 T-Dolls.
addons.title: Dummy Network: Backup Protocols (Girls Frontline)

objects.text:
Your doll and her Dummy Dolls receive a software and hardware upgrade, allowing each individual T-Doll to control additional Dummy Dolls without losing efficiency.

If your T-Doll first gets an upgrade to its communications and control systems, then its Dummy Dolls will get a full-fledged AI (but extremely primitive and limited in computing power), which will allow them to autonomously carry out simple orders and protocols without the need for continuous control from the T-Doll.

Each purchase increases the number of Dummy Dolls by 5 units, delivered with all weapons and equipment. The maximum number in total is up to 45 Dummy Dolls.

With all this, your T-Dolls will remain a weak link and when it is destroyed, the remaining Dummy Dolls will continue to directly carry out the last received order or, depending on the situation, can go into standby mode with a response to external conditions (this will not be a sleep mode, Dummy Dolls will continue to shoot back as needed).
objects.title: Upgrade of Dummy Dolls (Girls Frontline)

addons.text:
Ammunition, fuel and supplies have been significantly increased to the point where your Doll Army will have to fight seriously for over a year to seriously deplete and use them up.

At the same time, the type of supply has changed, now all supplies will be delivered and placed in large, well-fortified and camouflaged underground warehouses with a security and alarm system in case of outsiders.

The level of protection of the warehouses is sufficient to easily withstand shelling even from heavy artillery and bombing strikes, but the warehouses themselves are not provided with any weapons or external fortifications except for automatic cargo gates.

You can choose the location of the warehouses, but you will still be limited to areas where they cannot be quickly or accidentally discovered, most likely they will be far outside of populated areas and areas frequently visited by outsiders. So inaccessibility to them will be one of their main features.

If you have any equipment, then a significant number of its samples will also be placed in warehouse storage, both assembled and disassembled.
addons.title: Army Supply Depots

objects.text:
Each of your T-Dolls, including Dummy Dolls, receives a massive ammo supply, including tens of thousands of rounds of ammunition, dozens of grenades, mines, and explosive charges. The supply will also include ammo for any heavy, backup, or vehicle-mounted weapons your T-Doll uses.

The ammo supply is varied, but the bulk is standard ammo types, and only up to ¼ will be specialized ammo types, including experimental or highly specialized ones.

This will also work with any upgrade or add-on from the T-Dolls tree, allowing you to get the ammo you need regardless of its origin and technical complexity.
objects.title: Supply of Ammunition

addons.text:
Your HOC creaw can obtain more heavy weapons by utilizing dummy dolls. This will increase firepower without affecting effectiveness. The basic rule is that heavy weapons require your T-Dolls or Dummy Dolls. 

Additional Dummy Dolls can be used to obtain more heavy weapons or more powerful artillery, but they cannot be self-propelled.

You can leave additional Dummy Dolls simply as infantry cover or reserves.

Transport, ammunition, and equipment will be increased in accordance with the new requirements.
addons.title: Expanding Support

addons.text:
Your HOC crews get their own android horses and effectively become "Horse artillery" (a nod to the Napoleonic Wars and the American Civil War), a type of horse-drawn field artillery.

In its simplest and most "historical" form, this looks like 2 horses pulling a gun and 2 more pulling a cart with ammunition. However, you don't have to go so far into historicism and can determine the composition and method of transportation yourself, depending on the artillery pieces you choose. Up to the point that one horse can transport a disassembled mortar or automatic grenade launcher with ammunition.

You should remember that android horses are significantly stronger and have a higher load-bearing capacity than their living counterparts, but without going to extremes. But you are still free to choose either a large number of guns or one large one.
addons.title: Horse Artillery

addons.text:
Your HOC calculations can forget about such a terrible thing as a "shortage of shells" and they will be able to not save ammunition in battle, allowing themselves frivolous "overspending of shells" and shooting "somewhere there". However, they may have to worry about the wear of the barrels of their guns.

The ammunition reserves provided by the HOC increase several dozen times and in addition to this, the nomenclature is significantly expanded, allowing you to receive even rare, experimental and specialized types of ammunition.
addons.title: Additional Ammunition

addons.text:
You get additional reserve forces consisting of HOC T-Dolls according to the "Doll's Reserves" rule (squad will receive 12 dolls; army will receive 3000 dolls, etc.)

HOCs formed from Dolls's Reserves crews will receive heavy weapons manufactured no later than the 20th century with minor upgrades and modifications.

You can put in the effort to upgrade and modernize to an acceptable technological level, as long as it is not drastic. This will take some time and resources, but the results will usually be worth it.
addons.title: Heavy Weapons Reserves

objects.text:
“Artillery is the god of war” (Joseph Stalin).

You can join forces with the Heavy Ordnance Corps (HOC) platoon, which is equipped with heavy weapons that can inflict impressive damage on the battlefield in a short period of time.

Essentially, this is 4 T-Dolls (or 1,000 for the army, etc) and their Dummy Dolls, which form a heavy weapons squad. Imprint Technology (ASST) will be further expanded to include selected heavy weapons, without sacrificing the advantages of using personal firearms.

Heavy weapons include anti-tank systems, mortars, automatic grenade launchers, large-caliber machine guns, anti-aircraft systems, and howitzers. The basic rule is that the crew for these weapons must be fully staffed by your HOC T-Dolls and their Dummy Dolls.

You can have several or more heavy weapons if you have enough HOC T-Dolls and their Dummy Dolls to operate them.

The higher your doll's level, the more advanced and sophisticated your weapons can be. For example, SF will allow you to deploy futuristic weapons.

The HOC calculation will be provided with full transport, ammunition, and equipment.

If you do not chase after the number of heavy weapons , then HOC calculations will be an ideal option for garrisons of fortifications, bases and defensive lines.
objects.title: Heavy Ordnance Corps (Girls Frontline)

addons.text:
You get additional reserve forces consisting of SHOC T-Dolls according to the "Doll's Reserves" rule (squad will receive 12 dolls; army will receive 3000 dolls, etc.)

SHOC  receive equipment produced no later than the 20th century with minor upgrades and modifications. Equipment, despite some technological backwardness, will be quite combat-ready.

You can make an effort to modernize and update to an acceptable technological level.
addons.title: Military Equipment Reserves

addons.text:
Your SHOC crew will be able to get additional units of military equipment, which will be crewed by Dummy Dolls.

The basic rule remains the same. The selected military equipment must have a crew consisting of your T-Dolls or their Dummy Dolls. You can distribute T-Dolls among different vehicles to reduce vulnerability. The number or size of military equipment you receive will depend on the number of your Dummy Dolls and the number of crews of the selected military equipment, including warships.
addons.title: Expanding Heavy Support

addons.text:
Now your SHOC T-Dolls can choose a Gundam-type Mobile Suit with all its features, but adapted to the style and character of your T-Doll both in appearance and in weapons.

In this mobile suit, the use of the Minovsky particle has been eliminated, so that nothing threatens the T-Doll if it is destroyed or damaged. However, the suit will experience problems with some power shortages and overheating of the systems, especially during critical operating conditions.

The delivery package will include all necessary supplies and supplies. 

Dummy Dolls won't get their Gundams, mobile suits will get only crew SHOC T-Dolls.
addons.title: Girls and the Song of Steel (Girls Frontline)

addons.text:
Now you can equip your vehicles with improved versions of experimental weapons as additional or primary armament.

The power of the installed experimental weapons will be an order of magnitude higher (x10 or a more powerful type of weapon system) than what it was before. Ammunition and rate of fire will remain the same.
addons.title: SHOC: Experimental Weapons

objects.text:
You will receive additional forces in the form of Super Heavy Ordnance Corps (SHOC), which will be able to use various military equipment. This is a direct path to battlefield dominance due to its overwhelming firepower, protection, and mobility.

The numerical composition of the SHOC replenishment will be equal to the initial number of your HOC corps.

By default, each SHOC T-Doll will receive her own piece of military equipment, in which she will form a crew together with her Dummy Dolls. If the number of crew members exceeds the number of T-Dolls and their Dummy Dolls, you can combine several or more dolls into a crew, but you will receive 1 piece of equipment for the specified number of dolls.

Your SHOC will receive military equipment for powerful fire support of the allies. Options include infantry fighting vehicles, tanks, self-propelled guns, helicopters, airplanes, boats, patrol ships and submarines if there is a sufficient crew of T-Doll and their Dummy Dolls.

All vehicles will be provided with ammunition, fuel and other supplies.
objects.title: Super Heavy Ordnance Corps (Girls Frontline)

addons.text:
Now you can equip your vehicles with upgraded versions of your experimental weapons as secondary or primary armament.

You can choose 2 out of 3 parameters (power, ammunition capacity, rate of fire) and increase their values by 10 times. Or you can choose 1 parameter and increase its value by 20 times.
addons.title: Mobile suit: Experimental Weapons

objects.text:
Your T-Doll has undergone a deep upgrade that includes the ability to work in aggressive environments (including space) and adverse conditions, but most importantly, it has been able to use the Mobile Suit through direct integrated management.

The Mobile Suit is essentially a lightweight humanoid mech, 2-3 times the height of a T-Doll and equipped with integrated heavy weapons. As a rule, these are any heavy weapons that can move Mobile Suit, including automatic cannons, various light guns and rocket launchers with mortars and other heavy weapons (for ease of understanding, anything that can be mounted on a pickup truck or light truck). Secondary weapons will be rocket launchers and some kind of melee weapon.

In addition, the Mobile Suit will be equipped with various systems and modules of the appropriate class. If the regular T-Doll is more likely to have an armed engineering suit, then the elite T-Dolls or SF will already receive a Mobile Suit of special military design and appropriate specialized equipment and capabilities.

The Mobile Suit is also equipped with a flight system in the form of rocket engines, allowing for short atmospheric flights and maneuvers in outer space. It also retains the ability to move on the earth's surface.

Dummy Dolls will receive similar suits. 

Together with suits, the supply of ammunition, spare parts, fuel and other necessary supplies will be provided.
objects.title: Supernova Spirit (Girls Frontline)

addons.text:
You are being upgraded to the Elite T-Doll level, which gives you access to all the advanced combat and technical capabilities of this type of Tactical Dolls. All of these improvements and features are the best available to elite dolls. 

If you want, you can choose to specialize your doll body in order to strengthen any strengths by lowering other possible indicators. Such specializations can be: "combat" (strength, strength, reaction speed), "command" (computing power, sensors and communications), "saboteur-scout" (invisibility, electronic warfare, stealth) and others.

But even without choosing a specialization, all your parameters will remain at the top of the possibilities available to elite dolls (for example: strength like the AK-15, intelligence like the AR-15).

The list of available software, equipment, and weapons is also being improved to the appropriate level, typical for elite dolls with access to special military equipment and support.
addons.title: Elite T-Doll Frame

addons.text:
Now you have been upgraded to a Ringleader command-type frame corresponding to Sangvis Ferri technology. This vast improvement elevates you even above the best elite human-made t-dolls and provides a tremendous boost in combat performance and capabilities.

You keep the same opportunity to choose a specialization as before, but now all the improvements from specialization will be even more obvious, allowing you to stand out even against the background of similar dolls SF.

Your software, supplies, and weapons have also been upgraded to high-tech systems and experimental designs that significantly exceed the level available to elite t-dolls.

As an option, you can choose to upgrade using Paradeus technology instead of SF technology.
addons.title: SF T-Doll Frame

addons.text:
Now a replicator cube will be built into your T-Doll frame, which will be able to restore or recreate your doll body, and then upload your latest up-to-date copy of the Neural Cloud to it.

This will also require time and materials, but the process will take place autonomously and unobtrusively. You can either carry the built-in replicator cube permanently inside the doll's body, or leave it somewhere safe and secluded.

Being outside of your body, the Cube can begin to recreate your body in advance, but activation and downloading of a copy of your consciousness will not happen due to hard-wired security protocols that will allow activation only when your destruction.

You can have more than one replicator cube.
addons.title: Dolls never die

addons.text:
Somehow, you have obtained two samples of experimental weapons in an even rarer form. Their main feature is that they are the size of heavy pistols.

You can choose two experimental weapons (either the same type or different types).

You must choose one of three parameters (power, ammunition capacity, rate of fire) and reduce its combat effectiveness by a factor of 10 (as long as it makes sense). You can increase the remaining two parameters by a factor of 10.
addons.title: Unique Snowflake

objects.text:
You have undergone the digitization of consciousness and incarnation in the form of a Neural Cloud, which is similar to what is available to Nytos from Paradeus and is known as "Virtual Cognition Image" or "virtual consciousness".

This gives you many advantages, such as the ability to connect to digital networks, allows you to go through many upgrades, and manages the T-Doll body with all its advantages and disadvantages. At the same time, you retain the ability to flexibly develop and learn.

In addition, you can control and adjust your consciousness at all three levels (surface consciousness, sleep, basic code and basic data) through various modules and upgrades or updates. Among the modules, there is a "human behavior module", as well as various other modules responsible for the sensory and communication capabilities of Doll, each of which can be disabled or enhanced (thereby either getting rid of unnecessary sensory information, for example, touch, or vice versa, multiplying it). You can add additional modules such as thermal or infrared vision, extended hearing range, and more. And you retain feelings and emotions, as well as physical pain, but you can suppress or turn them off at will.
 
You also get the opportunity to edit and work with your memory, deleting unwanted fragments or integrating other dolls fragments into it. However, this requires care and caution, as it can lead to various failures, such as the manifestation of incorrectly erased or damaged memories in the form of hallucinations.

The main advantage will be that you will be able to save a copy of your Neural Cloud, thereby being able to recover even from complete destruction if your copy is saved.

On the downside, you will become vulnerable to electronic warfare and hacking, but the degree of vulnerability will depend on the T-Doll body available to you, the better the body, the better the firewall and security programs on it. Severe stress, strong emotional reactions and abnormal events can cause a "neural meltdown" with an external manifestation in the form of body convulsions. Such a prolonged condition can, in the worst case, lead to damage or to the complete destruction of data in the Neural Cloud.

The computing power of a regular T-Doll may not be enough to calculate and process a large number of complex scenarios, and this can lead to a state similar to stupor from fear.

You save the need for "sleep", during which the memory cache is processed and formatted, for more efficient operation. 

Together with the T-Doll body, you get all the software available to it, additional supplies and support, as well as access to all the benefits provided by upgrades and addons.
objects.title: Digitizing the Mind (Girls Frontline)

addons.text:
Your fairies will receive all the benefits that your T-Doll receives from Elite T-Doll or Sangvis Ferri upgrades. This will significantly increase their durability (up to the ability to withstand limited fire from medium firearms) and tactical capabilities through standard detection and electronic warfare equipment.

SF fairies will receive energy weapons and a protective energy field (capable of protecting against small arms fire) as standard, regardless of their specialization.
addons.title: Advanced  Fairies

addons.text: For each purchase, your T-Doll will receive 1 additional Tactical Fairie of the same specialization or any other.
addons.title: Additional Fairies

addons.text:
Your fairy receives a similar storage module based on Collapse Technology, with exactly the same functionality as your T-Doll.

This is an extremely useful upgrade for your fairy, allowing you not only to make more full use of the drone in logistics tasks, but also, with a little ingenuity, to use it for combat purposes.
addons.title: Fairies: Storage Module

objects.text:
This is an AI-powered support drone that will assist your T-Doll in battle. It can be considered a specialized unmanned aerial vehicle. The drone is about half the size of a human torso and can vary in design. It can fold into a compact form for convenient storage or transport by the T-Doll itself.

You can choose one of several specializations for the drone, such as creating a shield, reinforcing armor, distracting the enemy, installing mines and rocket launchers, constructing or reinforcing light field defenses, as well as other options such as direct support by enhancing characteristics or using various types of weapons (from shotguns and rifles to mortars and rocket launchers). You can install any weapon, including a flamethrower or chainsaw (of course, if you need a flying chainsaw with a delicate mental organization). There are also non-combat fairies, such as culinary, fireworks, beach, and others.

The programming of the fairy corresponds to the personality matrix and behavior of a “magical fairy,” and the AI perceives itself as a fairy. It is recommended to address them and treat them as “fairies,” otherwise it may lead to a program failure and the drone running away.
objects.title: Tactical Fairies (Girls Frontline)

objects.text:
With this purchase, you can upgrade your drones. This will significantly improve their software, functionality, and appearance. In addition, you can choose an additional specialization for the fairy.

You also have the option to transform the “fairies” into their animated versions. In this case, they will not just be holographic drones, but miniature androids with an obvious or hidden flight system.

In any case, the upgraded fairy will be able to perform maintenance and carry out light or medium repairs on your T-Doll.
objects.title: Tactical Fairies: Chibi (Girls Frontline)

addons.text:
Your Nikke belongs to earlier generations, which gives it a significant advantage in combat potential.

One of the common features of early models is the use of synthetic muscles, which are not inferior in strength and agility to the drives of later models, but which can be strengthened through training without the need for modernization or upgrades.

Early models may also have built-in weapons and generally be much more “mechanical” in appearance than later models.

As a rule, they can all be classified as SSR level.

At the Sangvis Ferri level, your nikke becomes a 1st generation nikke, a “Pilgrim.” This gives it access to powerful and advanced systems far superior to those of ordinary nikke, as well as providing it with a wealth of practical combat experience. Usually, one Pilgrim is enough to easily deal with a dozen ordinary nikke. Possible examples include the ability to wield a sword with supersonic strike speed, a laser capable of hitting coins thrown up in the air from a distance of 1 km, and the ability to destroy a tank with a single strike.
addons.title: Nikke: Early Generations (Nikke Goddess of Victory)

objects.text:
Instead of a T-Doll, you get Nikke, a cyborg girl with a mechanical body and a human brain who possesses human-like thinking. She is practically immortal, does not age or get sick, and is capable of regenerating and repairing most damage until her brain is completely destroyed.

They have mechanical bodies made of composite materials with great strength and durability, far exceeding human capabilities. Their bodies are covered with “Goddesium,” a material indistinguishable from human skin and strong enough to withstand damage that would turn a human into a pile of bloody splatters and scraps. Instead of blood, they have a red-colored coolant. Their energy source is an internal inexhaustible reactor called the “core.” However, Nikke is capable of eating food and obtaining energy from it.

Only girls between the ages of 18 and 30 can become Nikke. During the creation process, NIMPH (Neuro-Implanted Machine for the Protection of Humans) nanomachines are implanted into their brains, which copy and manipulate their memories, and can restore and correct them, including complete deletion or formatting. Fragments of memory can reappear due to any kind of shock. During the implantation process, combat protocols and programs are introduced, allowing them to wield weapons at an expert level. Your Nikke has no restrictions on harming people. Nikke are capable of increasing their effectiveness through training and learning.

Nikke are divided into 9 generations, yours belongs to the late 9th generation and is significantly inferior to the first earlys generations to the degradation and loss of technology by humanity. But this does not affect her combat power.

Nikke are divided into models:
- R: Mass-produced models with lost memories and personalities, resembling futuristic soldiers with closed helmets. Their bodies are average, and their effectiveness is reduced.
- SR: Retain some memories and unique physical features, often idealized appearance. Your Nikke belongs to this level.
- SSR: Can partially retain memory and personality, as well as gain unique abilities. They also receive an idealized body and advanced technology.

Nikke can have several spare bodies. Combat bodies are heavy (about 300 kg), which can cause problems when moving on weak surfaces. In addition to the combat body, you can choose 5 more spare bodies for various tasks. Peaceful bodies are usually no stronger than a human, but you can also choose lighter combat bodies with less combat power.

Your nikke will receive a set of special equipment and weapons of your choice.

The only problematic area will be the possibility of mental disorders and rampages, which are mitigated by imitating human activities: sleep, food, entertainment, and hobbies.

Despite possible unethical practices, your Nikke's brain has been cloned and has no history, but this does not prevent her from having a vibrant personality.

Nikke does not and cannot have Dummy Dolls.

Your nikke will have access to all improvements and add-ons from the T-Doll branch, but with its own characteristics and limitations.
objects.title: Nikke (Nikke Goddess of Victory)

objects.text:
You now have access to vast reserves ready to support your operations at any given time or to free up more valuable T-Dolls from routine tasks.

The number of reserves is 3 times the number of T-Dolls you have.

It works simply, you get T-Dolls that are slightly worse than your "standard" T-Dolls. This can be either in terms of manufacturing technology (if your dolls are Elite T-Dolls or SF dolls), or if the technology level cannot be lowered (...or simple Tactical Dolls), then they can be equipped with less advanced weapons (bolt action rifle or Self-loading rifle instead of assault rifles).

All these Dolls get all the necessary weapons, equipment and supplies with transport support. They also get the benefits of all the add-ons and upgrades from the T-Dolls you purchased in the tree, but if it makes sense, all of these will be lower in technology level or quality.

You can choose where and in what form your reserves will be deployed (deployed in a combat position or quietly stored in factory packaging in some warehouse or cache).
objects.title: Doll's Reserves

addons.text:
Nikke in your battalion are upgraded to full-fledged SR or SSR Nikke types, depending on the level of your first Nikke.

In any case, this will significantly increase combat effectiveness due to greater tactical flexibility and adaptability. In the best case scenario, this will have an extremely positive effect on combat potential within SSR models.
addons.title: Battalion: Nikke SR-type (Nikke Goddess of Victory)

addons.text:
One of the main problems you may encounter when using your nikke is the risk of developing mental disorders that can lead to aggressive behavior and uncontrollable rage. Usually, this problem is solved through individual mental health monitoring and therapy that mimics human activity. However, in the case of your nikke, this method can be difficult.

Nevertheless, thanks to this add-on, each of your nikke will be equipped with their own copy of SCP-458. This will help maintain mental health with minimal effort and significantly increase the loyalty of your nikke.

In addition, you can change the form of SCP-458 to a lunch box or bento with changing contents. A thermos mug with the SCP Foundation logo and similar functionality is included as a gift.

And yes, you can certainly deprive your Nikke of their “joy,” but then you will likely join the 20% of Nikke commanders who perish as a result of accidents.
addons.title: Goodies for Nikke

addons.text:
Your Battalion has now surpassed the SSR rank into a new rank entirely when wearing their Plush Pal armor: the EX Rank. Any and all Units connect to the Plush Pal armor, having just enough for the Battalion to swap with each on, on all levels, allowing them as well for near instantaneous information sharing, essentially acting as extreme simultaneous cameras. They will also gain all technology of the suits for search and rescue.

A healthy bonus is that all Armors essentially act as a second AI, and a very friendly/helpful one at that. No soldier in these battalions will be sad or suffer the horrors of war, and will always have a pal, even if they don't have a friend nearby. As well, each wearer will be able to utilize the capabilities of their animal. A spy who has a chameleon suit will have enhanced sensors and cloaking technology, while a grenadier with a falcon suit could be blessed from the skies above as a one-person bomber plane.

Finally, with sufficient infrastructure and training, your soldiers could even make more armors, although it would still take about a month to even make ONE Plush Pal, assuming they get it right.
addons.title: Battalion: Nikke EX-Type

objects.text:
Nikke R-types are “mass-produced” models whose memories and personalities have been erased due to the nature of the manufacturing process. This does not diminish their combat value, but overall they are not as effective as SR or SSR models. However, in your case, this is not such a pressing issue, as they were cloned and essentially had nothing to erase.

R-types still have strong and powerful bodies, as well as equally powerful weapons. However, they look average and do not stand out with the same external aesthetics as SR or SSR models. As a rule, they are equipped like futuristic soldiers in armor, with helmets covering their faces.

They are not as skilled or tactically flexible, but they can still learn and train. Although at first, they will be closer to robots in their behavior. However, with experience, they will be able to develop their own unique personalities and actually move up to the SR rank as soon as their self-awareness reaches the required level. In this regard, they will also acquire all the properties of SR models, including a refined appearance. But this process is extremely slow and depends on chance... And the severity of the experience.

You also receive the same number of Nikke R-type units. A total of 360 Nikke units in 3 companies, as well as support from 48 T.A.L.O.S. type mechs (3-4 meters tall; heavy weaponry; self-repair system; 3D printer capable of producing ammunition and spare parts; equipped with the same energy core as nikke), each piloted by 1 nikke R-type. + 12 non-combat nikke for maintenance and logistics. All of them are provided with motor transport.

Connection with upgrades and add-ons for the T-Dolls branch, allowing you to gain advantages according to the same rules, taking into account the characteristics of Nikke.
objects.title: Battalion: Nikke R-type (Nikke Goddess of Victory)

addons.text:
Your T-Doll has been upgraded to the third generation Tactical Dolls (elite dolls belong to the second generation).

This includes many software and hardware improvements. They have improved self-determination, flexibility, and independence in decision-making, which makes them effective in non-standard situations, although sometimes leads to errors.  But as Ro635, a third-generation prototype, put it, “Um... That's true, but practically speaking there's no real difference.”

Third-generation dolls can fully utilize the Remolding Pattern, which allows T-Dolls to rebuild their bodies and take on powerful combat forms, such as Darture, making them stronger than a platoon of Elite T-Dolls. 

This also applies to SF-level T-Dolls.

Note:
The combat form of T-Dolls will be comparable in capabilities to the Mobile Suit from the Supernova Spirit upgrade.
addons.title: Third  Generation Tactical Dolls  (Girls Frontline)

objects.text:
Remolding Pattern is a compact device based on technology developed by Persica that significantly enhances the capabilities of T-Dolls.

The technology involves controlling the flowering process of artificial Collapse Epiphyllum, followed by the use of collapse particle energy in the T-Doll system.

From a practical standpoint for second-generation dolls, this allows your T-Dolls to temporarily (~1 hour) gain an 80% increase in the combat stats of your T-Dolls and their weapons. However, it can significantly increase the wear and tear on the dolls' frames.

Your T-Dolls' Remolding Pattern device will be ready for reuse 24 hours after its previous use.

Dummy Dolls are not capable of using this device.

T-Dolls SF will also only receive an 80% boost.
objects.title: Remolding Pattern (Girls Frontline)

objects.text:
Your Buddy in a Box has been replaced with a demon familiar of your choice that trails behind you.

These include;

- Incubus, which doesn’t have an esoteric effect of its own, instead duplicating attacks you make, essentially doubling them at full potency. 
- Twisted Pair, a duo of demon familiars that float either side of you. Similarly to the incubus, the Twisted Pair don’t have any esoteric effects of their own, instead, they duplicate any attack you make on either side of you at 65% the strength of the original.
- Lil Brimstone, a familiar that disgorges a blast of superheated blood from its mouth.
- Rotten Baby, a familiar that cannot shoot, instead routinely coughing up legions of ‘friendly’ flies to harry enemies.
- Gallo, a foetal incubus that notably doesn’t hover around you, instead it nestles inside your abdomen, ready to be shot offensively out like a whip cord, extended by an umbilical cord tying it back to you, from the end of which it can aim and shoot it’s tears automatically. 

And evermore strange ‘buddies’ coughed up from hell.
objects.title: Demonic Familiar (The Binding of Isaac)

objects.text:
Your Buddy in a Box has been replaced with an angelic familiar of your choice that trails behind you.

These include;

Seraphim, an angelic familiar that rather than having a random array of esoteric effects, merely has consistently powerful concussive tears that sharply home in on enemies.
Sworn protector, Rather than shooting at all, this familiar is dedicated solely to defending you from attacks, circling you and pulling attacks and projectiles towards itself instead.
The Relic, a completely passive familiar that gives you spiritual protection from attacks, with some cooldown.
Holy Water, an autonomous vial that surges forwards to coat enemies in the paralysing substance within that restores itself after every battle.
Lil Delirium, a familiar that, every minute, duplicates another potential familiar at random, unable to settle. Each has random effects that vary greatly in utility and effect.

And evermore strange buddies called down from heaven.
objects.title: Angelic Familiar (The Binding of Isaac)

objects.text: ”Hail to the King Baby” Your Buddy In A Box has been replaced with the King Baby. The King Baby itself has no offensive abilities in the slightest. However, any additional familiars you have that would be following you, such as other Buddy in a Box familiars, or even some kinds of attack drones, can be instead placed under the King Baby, which will manoeuvre and coordinate every familiar under it into a well oiled machine, firing in unison with pinpoint accuracy at their designated target. When not commanding your legions, the King Baby will follow you like any other Familiar gained through Buddy in a Box.
objects.title: King Baby (The Binding of Isaac)

addons.title: Genome Soldier Project (Metal Gear)
addons.text:
Your cloning facility can now perform retroviral modifications, allowing you to recombine or modify different DNA strains in an existing subject. You can use this to give non-clones ability on par with your clone samples, making them "Genome Soldiers", but you can also use this to "double dip", allowing you to apply the augmentations & improvements available to you when growing a clone, to already fully grown clones or Genome Soldiers.

On top of that, it also has genetic samples from Earth's most legendary special forces soldiers, such as The Boss, Revolver Ocelot, The Snakes (Naked, Solid, Liquid, Solidus, & Venom), Kazuhira Miller, & "Jack". These can be cloned directly, or recombinated with other samples to produce a wholly "new" person.

It also comes with a much more advanced medical suite of cybernetic & nanomachine installers, meaning that your men can be upgraded to the capabilities seen from the Genome Soldiers or Solid & Liquid Snake during the Shadow Moses Incident, the Sons Of Liberty or "Jack" during the Big Shell Incident, or the standard PMC troops, Rat Patrol Team 1, or Old Snake during the height of the War Economy.

objects.text:
You receive the Tipoca City Military Complex, the facility on Kamino in which the clone army of the Republic was grown.

The Military Complex has various facilities beyond just the sectors where they produce the clone army; it also has facilities to train and feed the clones, as well as produce armour, weapons, and other key components. The Military Complex can roughly grow a 2,000 clones in a month and train them in a similar amount of time.

Kamino can clone just about anything, should you give them enough DNA to work with. The facility can also alter the genetic structure of the clones you are growing to provide them with better strength, decision-making skills, and other augments; however, doing so will slow the speed of the clones' growth.
objects.title: Kamino Clone Facility (Star Wars)

objects.text:
It seems your clone facility has received the notes that both Vader and Palpatine have uncovered in their experimentation with force-sensitive clones.

Your clone facility is now capable of creating clones that are force sensitive; it also now has facilities that can train these force-sensitive clones, giving them the training similar to that of an adept of the force, around the level of a Jedi Knight or a Sith Assassin. Further training will require supplemental material not found in this facility. A force-sensitive clone will take around three months to a year, depending on how strong you make the force-sensitive clone.

Through this new knowledge, you are also able to speed up the rate at which non-sensitive clones can be grown by making them force null sensitive, a virtual blank in the force. This will increase the rate at which they can be cloned to just 5 to 17 days depending on the knowledge that you put into them. Fully trained clones will take 17 days, while fresh clones without training require just 5 days to flash clone.
objects.title: Project: Starkiller (Star Wars)
Rothana Heavy Engineering (Star Wars)
objects.text: In addition to the ground equipment production facility, you also receive an automated shipyard capable of producing all the space ships and aircraft used by the Clone Army during the Clone Wars. The dry docks are capable of producing five to ten ships per month, depending on their size, and have enough supplies for a year of production. The shipyard has a several of Arc 170s and Y-wings for defense in case of attack, and a regiment for air support.

addons.title: MandalMotors
addons.text: Shipyard production capabilities are expanded to include Mandalorian ships ranging from Fang Fighters to Keldabe-class Battleships.

objects.text:
For every selection you receive one less adept. To a minimum of one of either ‘side’. Each Apprentice lost however awards each of the remaining ones a commensurate amount of power and skill.

For instance, reducing yourself to 10 Dark Side Adepts would make the remaining ten equal to most experienced Jedi Knights, while reducing yourself to a single apprentice would make them considerably stronger as an individual, more akin to a bonafide sith lord.

Trading all 39 for a single apprentice would meanwhile result in something more akin to Darth Treia at her height.
objects.title: The Rule of Two

objects.text:
You have been given the means of creating new Starfleet enlisted & officers; training them, of course! I mean, with the technical knowledge of your officers at your disposal, I suppose you could implement something like a mass cloning program (perhaps based on the Riker Transporter Incident), but it doesn't seem very Federation to create people for the sole purpose of labour...

For that purpose, you now have ownership of the grounds of Starfleet Academy, as well as other related Federation institutions like Starfleet HQ (which includes Starfleet Command & The Communications Research Center), Starfleet Medical Center, The Daystrom Institute, Memory Alpha, The Vulcan Science Academy, & other such places which exist specifically to develop the intellectual life of the Federation (rather than for purely practical purposes).

With their holodecks & 24/7 holographic staff, mind training programs (based on the Vulcan & Cardassian examples), & extensive databases, the new Academy curriculum should have the ability to train enlisted personnel in about a month, & skilled officers or specialists (like doctors or chief engineers) in about three months. With the wide range of circumstances that exist among Starfleet recruits already accounted for in the curriculum, and the 24/7 assistance of holographic tutors, even the most uneducated & malnourished medieval peasants can be turned into Klingon wrestling security officers or EPS conduit repairing engineers, all with the famous Starfleet creativity & esprit de corps. It can handle around 21,000 cadets in training at a time, though you will have to find these recruits yourself.

You can merge them into a single complex, have them in their separate locations, or store them as a stable transporter pattern to be placed or altered however you wish.
objects.title: Starfleet Academy (Star Trek)

addons.text: Your Meeseeks have now been given quite the upgrade, in the form of being automatically given any power you have, or choose to give, at the time of creation. Create a Meeseeks that can turn into a Titan Meeseeks, a Meeseeks that can use Hamon energy, and much more.
addons.title: Weseeks

addons.text:
It seems you've solved the Meeseeks' pain problem entirely. Now, their pain is replaced by a loyalty to you, compounding further and further the longer they exist. This also, astonishingly, gives them an interesting connection back to their box, as the more Meeseeks you make with a particular power, the faster the next Meeseeks will grow in their powers.

The first Meeseeks you give Ki to might be able to figure out flight on its own in about a year, but the next one can figure it out in 8 months, and then the next in 4 months, and so on.
addons.title: Meeseeks to Please

objects.text:
Somehow, your very nature has affected the box that spawns Meeseeks, giving them a significant upgrade in capabilities.

For one, they no longer suffer from the weakness where even a few days of existence feels like hell to them. Instead, they can now exist for around 10 years before any negative effects begin to appear, with the previous limit of roughly 2 days being extended to about 12 years.

Additionally, they now share your level of physical capability rather than merely possessing the abilities of an average human. If you can flip a tank, so can a Meeseeks. If you can see across three cities, the Meeseeks can do the same. However, this only applies to pure physical capability. If your powers include abilities beyond physical enhancement, the Meeseeks will not gain access to those. For example, if you were a Saiyan from Dragon Ball, they would inherit the raw physical power of a Saiyan, but not abilities like Ki manipulation or energy attacks.
objects.title: Mr. Yuuseeks!

addons.text:
IDENT:
I/We Am/Are Cerebr-X
I/We Am/Are the LegaXy of all mutants
I/We are SanXtuary/DOMINION/InsuranXe
I/We will make syXtem repairs and head direXtly to earth
I/We will ConXtruct/ReproduXe/ReXlaim/EnXure Homo Superior/Post-Homo Sapiens
Et in Krakoa Ego

<hr class="rounded">

Small issue, the psychic samples inside Cerebrax have all simultaneously become active. Several million mutant minds all calling out from inside one metal shell. This cacophony combined with the metal shell of the modified Cerebrax has produced CEREBR-X, The Diaspora. 

Cerebr-X’s directives, as seen above, dictate the vast majority of its actions, it acts to restore the mutant nation of Krakoa, and ensure the ‘survival’ of the millions of mutant minds within. Thankfully, it’s actively creating containment and sectioning for the minds within its databanks, and later intends to construct Life Model Decoys to act as physical agents for them. Until then it’s erratic, prone to outbursts, and subject to multiple extensive system failures from its damaged components.
addons.title: DIASPORA

objects.text:
Your Sentinel has been amended slightly, transforming it from a humanoid robot to the Psionic mistake of mutant science; Cerebrax.

Much like the Sentinel, Cerebrax possesses an AI and is loyal to you, however, it’s form is more akin to a spherical ‘Cerebro’ unit with many tentacled limbs. Where the Sentinel was only loyal to you in a robotic way, Cerebrax is a truly thinking machine, having absorbed immense psychic energy in its lifespan.

Additionally, having been conceptualised as a wearable enhancer for mutant abilities, and later repurposed into a genetic and psychic repository before becoming what it is now, the Cerebrax unit stores the ‘imprint’ of any target it’s faced. Rather than merely storing the template of their powers, it will attempt to obtain and maintain a psychic record, allowing it to use them to the same skill as their original user.

Similarly, Cerebrax can be worn, this either allows you to use the simulated abilities stored within through yourself, or allow Cerebrax to puppet another body to do the same, allowing it a greater utility to abilities that might only affect biological matter, being inorganic.
objects.title: Cerebrax (Marvel: X-Men)

objects.text:
Your Sentinel is no longer just any ordinary Sentinel and is instead the magnum opus of Sentinel technology of Earth-811, an advanced technological marvel far beyond the ordinary Sentinel, both in its raw power and mental capacity. It now has the strength and durability to contend with the Juggernaut in direct physical combat. As an upgrade to the previous Sentinels, Nimrod can shapeshift its form into any conceivable shape through nanomachines, including that of a human to blend into society and form technological weapons by scanning new forms of technology and its already large database of weapons effective against mutants. 

Your upgraded Sentinel is far more intelligent with the enhancements, an ever-evolving loyal AI with the sole purpose of serving you, adapting to any new powers that it encounters at a faster rate than any other Sentinel. With its updated scanning technology, it can refine and evolve not just immediate threats but simulated fights from accumulated data and scans of superhumans even before they activate their powers. The Sentinel also has improved self-repair and regenerative features, regenerating from anything short of complete molecular destruction.

The weapons systems that your new upgraded Sentinel has access to are numerous, including but not limited to energy-projection capabilities, such as concussive, electric, plasma, and disintegration blasts, as well as magnetic fields, gravity manipulation, and sonic attacks powerful enough to render beings as resilient as Juggernaut unconscious. It is also capable of teleporting vast distances, flying, and duplicating itself into a hivemind of Sentinels under your command.
objects.title: Sentinel Model: Nimrod (Marvel)

objects.text:
The Reaper’s are insidious with their technology, using it to indoctrinate other races into their service. Their virus is an equivalent tool suited for synthetic life, capable of altering the logic of any artificial intelligence to align with and join the side of whoever deployed it. When the Heretics acquired a copy they began to develop it with the sole purpose of reunification—specifically, reunification with the greater Geth Consensus, now fully and entirely aligned with the Heretics' point of view.

Now, the Heretics have deployed their variant of the virus, and achieved their goal of reunification. The end result? Instead of you gaining control of a small faction of the Geth Consensus, you gain the entirety of the Geth—every program, platform, ship and space station under the Geth’s control.

Like the Heretic Station it has evolved from, the Geth Consensus is stored within a private pocket dimension until you choose to “install” it. When you do so, it’s various assets can seamlessly integrate into the galaxy as if it was always there. It can also be returned to it’s pocket dimension storage if you find it necessary.
objects.title: The Geth Consensus (Mass Effect)

objects.text:
You have now unlocked the Digi-Capture program first created for the EDEN server and the power of your Digimon have grown to match that. Champions that can destroy mountains, Ultimates that rival Endbringers, and Mega Digimon of unlimited power are all within the reach of those that truly push their growth to its absolute limit.

With this upgrade, your Champion-level Digimon can now possess destructive capabilities on a geological scale. They can level mountains, generate continental hurricanes, and manipulate elemental forces with unprecedented efficiency. Your Ultimate-level Digimon can with time reach planet-threatening potential, with entities like Vademon capable of devastating entire worlds through concentrated attacks.

Mega-level Digimon transcend conventional power metrics, operating within the Digital World's 24-dimensional framework. These digital entities can influence the 11-dimensional kernel omniverse, manipulating fundamental aspects of reality through their connection to you. The boundary between digital and physical realms becomes increasingly permeable under their influence. But reaching this power might be the work of multiple lifetimes.

This upgrade also grants access to the Digi-Farm and Digi-Bank functions. The Digi-Farm allows for passive training and evolution of stored Digimon, while the Digi-Bank provides secure storage for excess digital entities.
