You may now maintain up to three active Digimon partners simultaneously, each capable of independent action while maintaining their connection to your enhanced Digivice.
objects.title: The Great Work

addons.text:
Your ability to draw strength from Positive Emotions has resonated with your Pendant and Digi-Egg granting them access to two new all inspiring forms, the Golden Power of Destiny and Miracles. These Crests and Armours are massively more powerful than the others, so much so that a Digimon with the Golden Armour of Miracles could be counted amongst the upper echelons of power in the Digital World.

Your Pendant's ability to enhance the ability of your Will and Emotions for the use of powers has greatly increased with fine control, any acts of healing or support is greatly enhanced by focusing it through your pendant as well.
addons.title: Shining Light

addons.text:
From a Dark Ocean known as the Quantum Sea your Negative Emotion Drive is able to draw upon Eight Inverted Powers from it's depths known as Great Sins. Lust, Wrath, Greed, Gluttony, Envy, Sloth and Pride with the Opposite of Light the Crest of Darkness. With these Sinful Codes it's possible for your Digimon to attain the power of one of the Seven Demon Lords of the Digital World… or perhaps create a new Eight Throne of Darkness.

Your Pendant's ability to enhance the ability of your Will and Emotions for the use of powers has greatly increased with fine control, any act to cause harm or control others is greatly enhance when used through your pendant.
addons.title: Abyssal Darkness

objects.text:
Your Digivice didn't just come with your Partner it also came with a gold pendant and a white egg that feels completely solid, these are a Blank Crest and Digi-Egg. These Blanks are special in that they can transform to match whatever noble trait best suits you or shift between them, while you begin with only one Crest and Digi-Egg in the beginning (Or however much you buy) you can earn the other ones given time to train and develop the right mindset.

These noble traits are Courage, Friendship, Love, Sincerity, Knowledge, Reliability, Hope and Light. However while these 8 are the most prominent variants of them can appear, such as Kindness for Love or Determination for Courage.

The Blank Pendant acts as a Focus for your Will and Emotions, an aid to help support your Digimon to achieve Ultimate and Mega Digivolutions easier and safer due to the sheer escalations of power in the Evolution Stages. And with your Crests you can grant them additional powers matching the theme of the Crest currently in use, such as Fire for Courage and Electricity for Friendship. The Blank Pendant isn't strictly limited to aiding you Digimon Partner as it can double as a focus and training wheels for any of your abilities that use Will or Emotions.
The Digi-Egg is more direct in it's use as it grants your Partner Digimon Armour Digivolution, a special form of Digivolution that allows a Digimon to Digivolve up a Stage with power greater than average. These Armour Digivolutions are more closely connected to the noble trait connected to them with a greater focus on those abilities rather then those of the Digimon, building up the Digimon's ability but narrowing the expression of their powers. Due to your connection with the Blank Digi-Egg you are able to use on yourselves to gain Digi-Armour should the situation call for it and spread it's power among any one or thing under the effect of your Master Powers.

Due to the special nature of the Blank Pendant and Blank Digi-Egg they are able to transform into any Noble Trait you possess even switching them, and essentially performing a Side-Evolution with your Digimon, in an instant. Give enough time it's possible you could layer these Noble Traits on top of each other with training but the more you add on the greater the challenge to master it becomes.
objects.title: Chosen's Blessings

objects.text:
You have gained the ability to use techniques that give humans Digimon abilities such as Spirt Digivolution, Biomerge Digivolution, and Bio-Hybrid Digivolution.

While each has its differences they have some similarities. Each allows you to become a Digimon for a max of an hour temporarily, draws from stamina instead of a time limit, and reverts to an uninjured human form if you take a fatal level of damage.

For Spirit Digivolution, you can use Spirits to become Digimon. When you defeat a powerful foe you will gain another spirit of the element closest to that foe in randomly either Hybrid Spirits or Beast Spirits. If you defeat a powerful foe but already possess the Hybrid and Beast Spirits of that element, you gain that element’s Fusion Spirits.

If you have Chosen's Blessings, you can also gain Unified Spirits. They can be unlocked if you defeat a massively powerful foe and have all the spirits of either Flame, Ice, Wind, Earth, and Wood or Light, Darkness, Thunder, Water, and Steel. If you possess all the spirits above then you can gain the spirit of Susanoomon.

For Biomerge Digivolution, you gain the ability to fuse with any Digimon if you have a very deep mutual bond with that Digimon. If you have Chosen's Blessings, you can fuse with your Digimon past the champion level and can include a warp aspect into your Digivolution.

For Bio-Hybrid Digivolution, you can inject Digimon DNA into humans allowing that human to take on the traits of the Digimon the DNA was taken from. Every time you defeat an individual, you gain a vial that contains the DNA of the Digimon that most represent them. You can also pull DNA vials from Digimon in your team. These vials can only be used once and only allow you to Digivolve once.
objects.title: Human-Digimon Interface (Digimon)

objects.text:
You can now scan items with your digivice to create Digimon item cards. These cards can then be used with your digivice to upgrade and improve your Digimon mid battle. Each item can only be scanned once a day. 

The type of item gained is closest to the item scanned and strength of the item generated are determined by the quality of the item scanned. Multiple item cards can be used at the same time but any used items only lasts as long as the battle itself.
objects.title: Digi-Modify (Digimon)

addons.text: Your knowledge of Pokémon technology has combined with Bestiarie's protocol in a very interesting and powerful way. Now, your Bestiarie can copy any Pokémon, even Legendaries besides Arceus himself, and improve upon them. If it copied Machamp, it would be able to throw 500,000 punches per second and be able to lift entire continents with one hand rather than just a mountain. If it copied Dialga, it could manipulate time down to a nanosecond if you so desired. Finally, Bestiarie is not limited to knowing four moves and could, in fact, learn all 920 moves besides Shadow and G-Max moves. Any Pokémon can be improved, and your Bestiarie knows it. On the more utilitarian side of things, your Bestiarie can now, with given materials and the like, act as what Ditto was meant to do as a new experiment: A Pokémon generator. However, these will not be enhanced in any way, although you can dictate to Bestiarie whether they're shiny or not, and other, more cosmetic details. Finally, Bestiarie can speak Pokémon and any animal language perfectly, even acting as a direct translator to a creature speaking, letting the voice of the creature come out of Bestiarie's muzzle. Note: If taken outside of Pokémon without any way to replicate the Legendaries or Mythicals, Bestiarie will still come complete with about 1000+ Pokémon in her/its database.
addons.title: Mechanical Ditto

objects.text:
Bestiarie has been upgraded with a supernatural CPU. Now, its Apto protocol has advanced to cover its weakness before. It can copy fantastical creatures perfectly, with boosts included. If it were to meet a Sea King in the world of One Piece, two Sea Kings would soon occupy the same area, albeit one unable to be controlled by a certain princess. In Hunter x Hunter, it could copy any fauna and even Chimera Ants due to their biology, ex, an (optionally now) mechanical clone of Neferpitou, but even stronger.

That is another weakness removed: Looking like a truly mechanical version of what it copies is removed, meaning that, unless scans are done, Bestiarie will perfectly pass for an organic creature. Although you can still ask for a particular mixture of machine and organic for visuals.
objects.title: Fantastica Metalica

objects.text:
The "Big Boy" is the final evolution of the Red-Shirt concept, fielded exclusively by high-tier pirate lords and veteran mercenary commands. Each are painstakingly assembled by illegal armorers in off the grid factories.

Physically, the Big Boy discards the patchwork scrap for forged, multi-layered composite plating, offering uniform high-grade protection. Its frame is a purpose-built alloy skeleton, supporting reinforced servo clusters at its major joints. This provides genuine strength and stability, allowing it to move with a deliberate, powerful stride rather than a simple lurch, and to wield oversized crew-served weapons or heavy industrial tools as direct melee instruments. Its superior structural integrity and actuator power are primarily devoted to carrying its additional mass: layered slabs of appliqué armor, reinforced bracing, and thicker frontal plating, transforming it into a veritable walking fortress.

Its cognition is its most radical upgrade. It hosts a heavily-shielded, restricted heuristic processor loaded with distilled combat data from countless underworld engagements. This allows for adaptive, if brutal, tactical behavior: it can identify and prioritize high-value targets, execute simple flanking maneuvers, use cover with purpose, and even perform rudimentary squad coordination with other drones. It possesses persistent operational memory, allowing it to learn from and adapt its behavior based on prior encounters, though the architecture prohibits any form of true consciousness.
objects.title: Heavy Duty Elite “Big Boy”

addons.text:
For high-tier pirate flotilla or a mercenary legion, a single elite drone, no matter its formidable armor and sharpened cognition, is a meaningless asset. Warfare on the fringe is a contest of mass, terror, and overwhelming tactical pressure; one walking fortress, isolated and alone, can be circumvented, outmaneuvered, or simply drowned in the same disposable hordes it was meant to surpass. Since they can afford one Big Boy, they don’t stop there. They commission a Frat House.

Your original twenty Red-Shirts are all replaced with Big Boys instead. Additionally, each drone’s combat processor is networked together into a single, shared intelligence. Their link has improve, remaining connected so long as they stay within a 10 kilometre radius of each other, automatically reconnecting should they return into the area. This link allows them to think and fight as one creature. What one drone sees, they all know instantly. They set up kill zones without a word, covering each other's movements and focusing fire with terrifying coordination. They learn from every fight, and that learned experience is saved and shared across every drone in the Frat House, making the entire swarm smarter after every battle. Their communication is a hardened, encrypted signal that’s almost impossible to detect or jam.

However, every drone lost isn't just one less gun, it's lost processing power. The network's intelligence dims and slows with each casualty and disconnection from the link, its coordination decaying into simpler, dumber patterns until nothing of the hive mind remains. At their weakest, their skill and intelligence drops to that of a baseline Big Boy.
addons.title: Frat House

objects.text:
The name "Death Marchers" does not come from their lethality, but from their standard tactical deployment: a full squad marching in a grim, predictable column directly into enemy fire, programmed to advance until they are destroyed.

This provides you a full squadron of twenty distinct Red-Shirt drones instead of one. Each unit retains the same low-quality, jury-rigged construction, slow speed, and complete lack of refinement. Their intelligence remains non-existent, operating on the same crude, sequential logic, making each individual just as predictable and vulnerable as a solo unit.

The squadron is linked by a short-range, analog wireless mesh network. This allows them to broadcast basic status signals such as “TARGET ACQUIRED” or “UNDER FIRE” to nearby units. Their core IF/ELSE programs have been expanded with a few crude swarm protocols. Upon receiving a specific signal, drones can execute pre-programmed, simple maneuvers like “FLANK LEFT” or “KITE BACKWARD.” This creates the illusion of coordinated tactics like surrounding a target or suppressive advance-and-retreat patterns. However, this coordination is extremely literal and brittle. Each drone remains just as stupid, environmentally blind, and oblivious; they cannot interpret complex situations, adapt to true obstacles, or recognize deception, making the entire network vulnerable to jamming, spoofing, or being led into traps.
objects.title: Death Marchers

objects.text: Each purchase increases your army by a factor of ten (2.000, 20.000, 200.000).
objects.title: A [B]igger Army

objects.text: This upgrade can be taken up to 9 times, and with each purchase of this upgrade, the Minion population cap will increase by 10,000. Upon reaching the 10th upgrade, the population cap is completely removed. At that point, Minions will continue to appear as needed with no upper limit, requiring only that you maintain sufficient access to basic food, shelter, and entertainment to support them. At any time, you may also impose a voluntary population cap via a method of your choice, limiting the number of active Minions to whatever amount you can comfortably manage.
objects.title: More Minions (Minions)

objects.text:
You've received not one, but a small pack of four non-sapient market model LQ-84i in addition. 

As these are merely remote drones, you’re capable of directing them with signals transmitted from your own mind-processor. These can be as simple as ‘attack’ or complex decision trees and chains. If left without orders, they fall back on default ‘sentry’ programming and attack unfamiliar entities that approach.
objects.title: Born Into a Pack
Tomb World: Solemnace (Warhammer: 40k)
objects.text:
How?

Just how?

You have gotten your hands on a tomb world, except it's not just any tomb world; it's the personal tomb world of one of the craziest Necrons, who would be absolutely livid if he ever found out that you somehow stole his tomb world from him. You now have in your possession the Tomb World of Trazyn the Infinite.

The thing about this tomb world is that it's not like any other tomb world, as it doesn't just have the typical fixtures of a tomb world in various machines of war and courts full of lesser nobles, Crypteks, and various Necron Warriors; this tomb world also has the pride and joy of Trazyn the Infinite in his museum, in which he has curated a list of items, artifacts, and people in temporal stasis too long to count that it would just be easier to say what he doesn't have.

This entire tomb world is kept in a pocket dimension space that you can teleport to at any time, as the Necrons are masters of spatial folding and have found a way to keep this tomb world hidden from the rest of the galaxy or wherever you now find yourself.

Every single Necron under your command is completely loyal to you, and you may optionally, at a single time right now or later, decide the personalities and other things regarding the Necron under your command; however, once you decide their traits, you can no longer change them.

objects.title: Battleclade Servitor (Warhammer: 40k)
objects.text:
Each Battleclade Legio Cybernetica unit under your command will be supported by a Battleclade Servitor consisting of 30 combat servitors designed to engage in combat and provide heavy fire support in hostile environments.

Your servitors are created from cloned genetic material rather than living humans, and possess impressive durability and survivability in both their mechanical and biological components, allowing them to operate even in the harshest conditions.

You can choose from various specialized combat servitors, such as the gun servitor (essentially a platform equipped with heavy mounted weapons), the battle servitor (with implanted small arms), or technical support servitors (equipped with light weapons but capable of performing field repairs or transmitting signals and providing target acquisition). But in reality, you can design your own model to suit your specific conditions and capabilities.

In any case, your servitors are masterfully crafted, superbly programmed, and equipped with a multitude of auxiliary systems, including advanced sensors, communication systems, subdermal armor, and reliable power systems.

Alternatively, you can choose to receive 3 Kataphron-class servitors, which replace a dozen standard servitors. If you have multiple Legio Cybernetica units, you can choose any type of servitor for each individual unit.

If you have powers from the “Species and Genetics Powers” section, your servitors can also gain access to them—meaning they will effectively be constructed from your genetic and biological materials.

objects.title: Legiones Skitarii (Warhammer: 40k)
objects.text:
Now, under your command is not just a single cohort, but a full-fledged Legiones Skitarii—which is usually sufficient to defend a single Forge World (albeit perhaps not the largest one).

Typically, a legion consists of 4 Macroclades, each of which, in turn, consists of 4 Cohorts. Thus, you’ll have ~6,000–7,000 Skitarii under your command, along with a variety of vehicles and support and reinforcement units.

Despite their relatively small numbers, the armies of the Machine God easily outclass most enemies thanks to their technological equipment, implants, and fanatical devotion, which allow them to fight for many months and years if the situation—or their ruthless masters—demands it.

addons.title: Taghmata Omnissiah (Warhammer: 40k)
addons.text:
The Taghmata Omnissiah is an army belonging to a specific Forge World, assembled at the call of its Fabricator-Archmage and operating as a feudal militia, comprising legions of Skitarii, as well as troops and contingents from individual Magos and outposts or vassal worlds associated with the Forge World.

Your Skitarii legion is joined by forces from the Legio Cybernetica and detachments of combat servitors.

For every 1 purchase from the Legio Cybernetica, you will receive additional Skitarii forces (their numbers will increase tenfold, to 60–70 thousand), as well as a full Legio Cybernetica cohort comprising 1,000 battle-automata; purchasing the Battleclade Servitor upgrade will provide you with full combat servitor support for this cohort.

With the Adeptus Mechanicus Technology and Artifice Powers and a second purchase from Legio Cybernetica, you can obtain up to three different support units of your choice. For simplicity’s sake, if you wish to select something else, you may assume you have 9,000 points to spend on units for three support units at their tabletop game prices; This will allow you to showcase the full diversity inherent in Mechanicus armies (you can take any mass-produced Imperial machinery and man it with Skitarian units, or choose units associated with the Adeptus Mechanicus: Imperial Knights and Titans).

If you purchase ‘Technology and Artifice Powers’ for the Adeptus Mechanicus and make two purchases from the Legio Cybernetica, your points pool will be increased to 100,000, allowing you to also purchase allied contingents from other Imperial factions.

objects.title: Additional Nemean Lion Cub
objects.text:
Each purchase grants you an additional Nemean Lion Cub. You may choose whether the cub is male or female. The cub starts at the size and strength of a normal lion but already possesses its legendary invulnerability, making it immune to iron, bronze, stone, and other mundane weapons.

Over the next 3 years, the cub will grow into a massive Nemean Lion the size of a small house, with enough strength to wrestle a demigod and the speed to match. Each lion is completely loyal to you, obeying your commands and defending you with unwavering devotion.

objects.title: Another Cub (Avatar: The Last Airbender)
objects.text: You gain another Lion-Turtle egg. The cub that will emerge from within will have an affinity to your choice of a different element.

objects.title: Assembler Vat (Halo)
objects.text:
Rather than being merely a structure for storing designs and constructing replacement Monitor bodies, your Design Seed now develops into a highly adaptable Assembler Vat. Through advanced nanofabrication and the manipulation of Smart Matter, it is capable of constructing, assembling, even growing technology and structures at the molecular and atomic level.

The Assembler Vat remains as a compact Design Seed, allowing it to be transported and deployed much as it was before. However, once you have selected a suitable location and "planted" the Seed, both you and your Monitor may determine how the Vat develops. Its architecture, aesthetic, internal layout, and overall scale can be customized throughout its growth.

The Vat is also capable of adapting itself to the surrounding terrain rather than simply building over it. It may seamlessly integrate into a cliffside, spread through natural caverns, grow upward into towers, descend deep underground, or reshape the surrounding area to accommodate whatever facilities are required. It can even create specialized construction zones, including enormous fabrication pits, subterranean foundries, hangars, assembly chambers, or other structures necessary for larger projects.

Alongside these improvements, your Monitor has undergone a substantial upgrade of its own. While remaining completely loyal to you, it is now capable of learning, developing, and expanding its capabilities over time.

Your Monitor may create additional Forerunner Ancilla, including lesser administrative intelligences, specialized support Ancilla, and even additional Monitors. With sufficient infrastructure and resources, extraordinarily sophisticated constructs such as the Ancilla required to operate Guardian-class constructs are no longer beyond its eventual capabilities.

As the Assembler Vat increases in size and complexity, your Monitor may also create Sub-Monitors to divide responsibilities and manage its growing infrastructure. These Ancilla form an interconnected hierarchy resembling a distributed Contender-Class Ancilla, with your original Monitor serving as the primary, authoritative node. Sub-Monitors may independently oversee construction, defense, logistics, research, maintenance, exploration, or any other responsibilities assigned to them, while remaining subordinate to the original Monitor and, ultimately, to you.

Once the Assembler Vat begins establishing itself, it automatically produces an initial complement of 60 Sentinels 20 Aggressor Sentinels and 40 Constructor Sentinels.

As the Vat grows, it may create additional Sentinels and other appropriate automated constructs as necessary, allowing its workforce and defensive capabilities to grow alongside the facility itself.

If you possess any Technological or Artifice-based powers, the Vat gains the ability to reproduce and manufacture technology derived from them. Any designs, principles, materials, or technologies that your abilities allow you to create may be incorporated into the Vat's fabrication systems, ensuring that it can continually adapt to your growing capabilities and remain one of the most versatile tools available to you.

Optionally, any Objects of Power you possess can be converted into a single-use Design Seed. Rather than carrying or immediately deploying the Object, you may store it in this compact form until it is needed. Once planted, the Design Seed reconstructs the Object of Power in its proper form.

Objects of Power that provide a Base, Structure, or Property may instead be incorporated directly into your Assembler Vat. Rather than merely placing the two structures beside one another, the Vat seamlessly integrates the new addition into itself, adapting architecture, infrastructure, power systems, control systems, communications, fabrication technology, and other necessary components to ensure complete compatibility.

objects.title: Bijuu Unbound (Naruto)
objects.text:
Now, instead of being so drastically weakened, your Bijuu companion(s) have the ability to draw upon their full, titanic power, capable of devastating cities with little effort.

They are also able to reclaim their full, immense size if they wish, while still being able to revert to their smaller size or any range in between.

Even with their power restored, the Tailed Beast(s) will choose to stay, grateful for your support while they were still so weakened. As you protected them, they now want to protect you, as they accompany you through whatever adventures lie ahead. However, they can still choose to leave if you give them enough reason to.

objects.title: Grand Army of the Republic (Star Wars)
objects.text:
«As my first act with this new authority, I will create a Grand Army of the Republic to counter the increasing threats of the Separatists» ―Supreme Chancellor Palpatine

You are now in command of the entire Grand Army of the Republic at the start of the Clone Wars. You have 3,000,000 soldiers at your disposal, organised into 10 system armies. They are fully equipped with everything they need: gear, weapons, vehicles and warships, including Venator-class Star Destroyers .

Your clone troopers have received the Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic and strictly follow your commands. Order 65, which poses a problem for you as it provides for your arrest—since you are effectively acting as Chancellor—has been secretly amended to ‘arrest those who issue Order 65’ (as, in fact, have all the other orders that are personally problematic for you).

The army also includes a Special Operations Brigade, consisting of 10,000 clone commandos. These are the finest soldiers in your army, although they can sometimes be wayward and troublesome.

Once every five years, you can replenish your army’s losses with new clones. These soldiers will arrive with all the necessary equipment, weapons, gear and ships, and will also undergo training based on new programmes developed from your army’s experience.

If you require urgent reinforcements, you can use Spaarti clones instead of Kaminoan ones. These soldiers, known as ‘meat droids’, allow you to replenish your losses not once every 5 years, but once a year.

Although your army may lack combat experience, its training is of a high standard, given its size.

You can also choose a Clone Army from the late Clone Wars era; however, 2/3 of it will consist of Spaarti clones, whilst the remaining Kaminoan clones will have gained impressive combat experience (in addition to better weaponry, new technology and ships).

objects.title: Separatist Droid Army (Star Wars)
objects.text:
"With these new battle droids we've built for you, you'll have the finest army in the galaxy."
―Wat Tambor, to Dooku

At your disposal is the largest droid army in the history of the Galaxy, numbering at least 10 million units. The bulk of the force consists of B1 battle droids, though other models are also present.

Your droid army is organised into 20 army, each comprising up to half a million combat units. Furthermore, it is equipped with all the necessary machinery, equipment and a naval fleet, including three Lucrehulk-class battleships with their escort and support vessels. These forces enable you to carry out large-scale operations within a sector or conduct major military campaigns within a single star system.

Your strategy is based on using large numbers of cheap combat droids to achieve numerical superiority. These droids are supplemented by a small number of highly effective specialised combat units. The army is commanded by tactical and super-tactical droids.

Once a year, you can replenish your losses by receiving new units complete with all the necessary weapons, equipment and vehicles. The new droids may feature minor modifications based on combat experience.

What’s more… You can easily make up for your losses right in the middle of battles by assembling one fully functional droid from the parts of 3–4 destroyed ones.

addons.title: Support for Separatist Factions
addons.text:
You can now count on the support of various separatist factions, whose private armies form the backbone of the Separatist Droid Army. Each faction will offer you a unique boost in line with its ideology and tactics.

The Techno Union will provide you with technical expertise and upgrades for your droid army. This will ensure that every new recruit receives not only significantly improved models adapted to current conditions, but also entirely new specialised combat droids tailored to the circumstances you face. The Commerce Guild will double the frequency of reinforcements, allowing you to receive additional troops not once, but twice a year. The InterGalactic Banking Clan will increase your droid army tenfold. And the Corporate Alliance will add ‘mortal soldiers’ to your ranks – mercenaries ranging from ordinary gangsters to professional assassins and spies – who will make up approximately 1 per cent of your total army strength.

If you acquire the Confederacy of Independent Systems Shipyard, you will receive all the benefits of support from every CIS faction without having to choose.

objects.title: Red Ribbon Empire
objects.text:
No longer are you limited to the shackles of a relatively mundane army... now, you have ascended to the realm of the gods.

Previously, you were missing the good doctors. Now, you have the entire Gero lineage in the army, and all of their creations. From the Trucker Hat himself, to the Perfect Lifeform, even to the superheroes Gamma 1 and Gamma 2 themselves. Gero and Vomi are 20 and 21, but retain all of their human memories and personality. They are very much lovebirds, and thankfully without the death of their son Gevo and Son Goku destroying their livelihood, very controlled mentally. Gero focuses more on the mechanical side of things, while Vomi is more biology focused.

Your empire has also naturally expanded, having a base in every major city and location in the setting if applicable. In space-settings, they can easily create spaceships that rival the faster ships of the setting to get to and from different bases with speed and efficiency. Even in purely fantasy based settings without technology, It's possible the Gero family could create Magitech based Androids, or modify existing ones to work as needed.

Your magnum opus, however, has yet to be created... Cell Max. This requires immense research, reverse engineering of your original Cell, and sufficient DNA sources to give him the power he needs to function. There is also the danger, like in canon, of Cell Max turning against you if mishandled or activated prematurely.

The loyalty of your army is also enhanced with this upgrade. After all, you're the man/woman who brought them to such a big position of power. In fact, if you wish to seal the deal, maybe you could find a way to help Staff Officer Red in particular with his hearts' desire.

The Heart now comes housed within the full cadaver of the Thinker from which it was taken. Preserved in some grotesque mockery of life, the body is pallid, the eyes glassy, following movement and staring. The corpse is filled with metal, oil and splints that preserves its form, but like the Heart before it, an S.E.P. field renders it unremarkable to all others, seen but ignored, dismissed as refuse or a mannequin no matter how out of place it lies. Only you are spared this dismissal, forced to see it for what it truly is.

The Corpse makes use of its own array of senses such as sight, hearing, touch, and others less human to scan its surroundings and subjects. Its eyes can pierce through façades, tracking details that should not be visible; its ears pick up threads of meaning hidden between words; its skin remembers the brush of contact long after it has passed. From these perceptions, the Corpse's analytic ability far outstrips its lone heart. This manifests as a limited form of post-cognition, capable of simulating the past with the available information.

Unlike the Heart, the Corpse remembers. All data it has picked up, stored, layered and woven into a sprawling web of knowledge. At will, you can command it to assemble these fragments into a clearer picture, mapping relationships between truths, conjectures, and buried facts. Unlike the Heart, the Corpse speaks and explains. It addresses you directly in words, its tone unhurried and deliberate, often pausing as though savoring the act of revelation with a subtle smugness.

The Corpse can be called upon for up to two hours of use each day, and as it runs out of time its speech grows less focused, its insights more erratic, drifting into riddles or compulsive muttering as it strains to hold too many truths at once. It can replenish its time faster by resting.
objects.title: Corpse of a Tattletale

objects.text: Your H-Dial has been upgraded with the capabilities of the spectacular Y-Dial! The Y-Dial’s main use is to split the user into two heroes similar in nature to the C-Dial, each embodying different traits of the original user. Similarly, it can be used repeatedly to further divide these heroes into more. However, it is worth noting that the split heroes are fully independent, and can only recombine into the original if both desire to do so.
objects.title: Y-Dial (DC Comics)

objects.text:
Your H-dial has been upgraded with the capabilities of The fantastical C-Dial. The C-Dial is similar to the H-Dial, but it does not randomize transformations, instead giving you one, transforming you into your inner Hero. It transforms you into the heroic embodiment of everything you want to be in an instant, albeit with the same restrictions of the normal H-Dial. 

As an example, Miguel Montez, once the guardian of the H-Dial, once used this to teach an entire city the value of heroism through only his will, and an early encounter with said heroism in his own life.
objects.title: C-Dial (DC Comics)

objects.text: Your H-Dial has been updated with the capabilities of the incredible K-Dial. The K-Dial is a simple creation that creates a gateway to the extra dimensional void called the K-Hole. It’s a place utterly without hope. The vast majority disappear into the void to be unmade, but with cast iron will, it can be used as a (rather weak) H-Dial in extremis for those trapped.
objects.title: K-Dial (DC Comics)

objects.text: “Well, would you look at that?” Your Rainbow Chest now carries a tenth item, that being the INFAMOUS Gun That Kills the Past. This strangely shaped gun allows you to shoot yourself, which will send you to any point in your past to attempt to correct a single mistake before returning to the present. You will keep your full current powers and abilities Take extreme care with how you use this gun, as changing the past can create a FAR reaching butterfly effect, changing the present in unpredictable ways. This gun uses extremely special ammo, with which you begin with only a single bullet for the gun. You will receive an additional bullet every year that will rest within the chest's ammo storage.
objects.title: The Gun that Kills the Past (Enter the Gungeon)

objects.text:
Your Rainbow Chest also now contains “Blanks”, a special bullet casing that holds a powerful defensive effect. When used, they emit a large blast of mostly harmless energy that will destroy any physical, energy, or supernatural attack that approaches you. These Blanks have a maximum effective range of one mile, though you can selectively decrease this size at will.

You receive 3 Blanks every day, and any unused Blanks will be stored within the Rainbow Chest's pocket dimension.

Additionally, you receive a modified version of the Full Metal Jacket item, which will allow you to have your Blanks automatically activate should you be about to take a mortal blow. You can selectively toggle this effect so you can use your Blanks either passively or strategically yourself.

Lastly, you will gain your choice of any 3 Ammolets, items which modify the effect of Blanks from the base game or mods (any stronger than Ammolets stronger than ones from the base game will be nerfed to the level of ones from the base game).
objects.title: Blanks (Enter the Gungeon)

objects.text:
You have been given a second gravity stone, enhancing your gravity control to incredible levels. Its most vulgar uses allows you to change the density of anything around you, and potentially allows you to create miniature black holes with a little effort.

Additionally, Experience with the stones can allow you to use them to alter spacetime, creating rifts and portals through it. Baron Helmut Zemo once used them to transport a group into the Microverse by fiddling with their relative densities, or retrieve items from the past with relative ease. 

Mastering a single Moonstone would take effort, but the destructive potential of two means you must be very careful bringing your full force to bear.
objects.title: Second Stone (Marvel)

objects.text:
You gain the technological knowledge of the civilization that created the Evolution Cube as well as any other technology that utilises Evolutionary energy. Among the technology is the Evolutionary Totem, the Ovitan Badge and the Gene Collapse Missile. 

The Evolutionary Totem is a totem filled with the energy of the Evolution Cube and its effects can cover an entire planet. Unlike the one-time improvement of the Evolution Cube, the effect of the totem device was gentler, similar to a buff. If maintained for a long period of time, it would slowly increase the talent and potential of a planet’s inhabitants. Because the totem device slowly altered one’s genes, the advantage was that the effect was not restricted by one’s strength level. Totem will slowly run out of energy, requiring the Evolution Cube to recharge it.

The Ovitan Badge worn on the body and uses Evolutionary energy as fuel. It could carry out an ultimate evolution of the wearer when activated turning a normal person into a biological aberration. However, when the effect ended, the user would collapse and die. There was also a chance to break through the genetic locks and become a perfect evolutionary being, but the chance was so miniscule that it was not considered at all. 

Gene Collapse Missile is a special missile that carried the evolutionary energy similar to that of the Ovitan Badge. After hitting the surface, the energy would spread and contaminate all living beings within the range, and they would all turn into aberrations and experience genetic collapse, until they eventually died.

All this technology is reliant on the energy of the Evolution Cube, and since the cube has a limited energy output you will not be able to power an infinite amount of tech.
objects.title: Evolutionary Technology

addons.text:
Your fusion of the Behelit & the Berserker Armor grants you the power, skill, & equipment of Skull Knight, the Hammer of the Inhumans.

This includes the skill to slaughter Apostles in their multitudes, the speed and power to defeat Zodd in single combat, knowledge of Causality which allows you to divine future events, your phantom steed which can move at supernatural speed and defy physics (by running up a 90 degree wall, for example), and the Sword of the Behelits, an enormously powerful blade capable of killing Ganishka's Shiva form in a single strike, and altering reality, as it did with the Great Roar of The Astral World. It can also create portals between the worlds or between different points within a world, as the user chooses.
addons.title: Sword of The Behelits

objects.text:
Your Behelit has been enhanced by the powerful Kushan sorcerer, Daiba.

Your power is now equivalent to an extremely powerful Apostle like Ganishka, Rakshas, or Nosferatu Zodd.
objects.title: Man-Made Behelit (Berserk)

objects.text:
Your Behelit is now as powerful as those possessed by the members of the God Hand.

This, among other expressions of cosmic power (including but not limited to flight, spatial manipulation, powerful magic, intangibility & imperviousness to all purely physical damage, speaking with the dead, The Invocation of Doom, biomancy, shapeshifting, summoning, & physical abilities vastly exceeding even other Apostles), gives you extreme power over "Causality", allowing you to perfectly see the future or manipulate the world as if the universe was a story and you were it's writer. That said, there are some things outside "Causality" which this cannot effect so easily.
objects.title: The Egg of The King (Berserk)

objects.text:
You acquire a Reality Stabilizer Seed, similar in design to the Dimensional Cage. When placed in contact with a star, the seed draws on the star’s matter-energy and begins constructing the stabilizer. This process takes at least six months to complete. Once finished, the stabilizer integrates into the outermost layer of the star’s surface, making it nearly invisible from the outside, feeding off the star’s plasma. In the case of binary or tertiary star systems, only one star needs to be seeded initially. Once the stabilizer is complete, a new seed is automatically launched to the next star, repeating the process until all stars in the system are seeded. Each additional star increases the stabilizer's power by an order of magnitude.

If the chosen star is the Sun, the Reality Stabilizer will extend its coverage over the entire heliosphere, encompassing the Post-Trans-Neptunian Zone. The Reality Cage's functions are enhanced to a degree where the stabilizer’s power is magnified by an order of magnitude. Should the universe beyond its protective sphere collapse into the Void/Quantum/Emptiness/Nothingness/The Between, the Solar System will continue to exist as long as the Sun provides energy. Once the Sun is depleted, the system will eventually fail.

If you purchase this upgrade a second time, you skip the construction phase, with you being able to choose between it always being there active or just awaking/booting up. If placed on a planet instead of a star, the shield becomes stronger due to it's focused, localized protection, and the second purchase adds stabilizers to additional planets, fortifying an entire system.

In case of having Eldritch Drive Module Add-On, the Stabilizer will create Engels to combat, fix, collect and other menial task that need a physical presence.
In case of having Leyline Eldritch Resonance Add-On, the Tree will now have the Star range of the Stabilizer or on every planet, a Local Tree will bloom and be connected to the Star Tree.
objects.title: Reality Stabilizer

objects.text:
You are the inheritor of Able, gaining his powers.

Firstly, you gain Able’s superhuman strength and speed, capable of swatting bullets out of the air with a length of steel rebar, dashing over 64 meters in under three seconds, and although you’re not invulnerable, you have a remarkable ability to ignore pain and shock, pressing on despite what would be debilitating wounds in normal humans. 

Secondly, you have the ability to summon bladed weapons out of nowhere. The blades are made out of a completely non-reflective black material appearing as a "black void in space" and will rapidly vanish after leaving your hands unless you will them not to.
objects.title: Able (SCP Foundation)

objects.text: With every purchase, you gain an additional Embryo. You are also able to customize the direction of your Embryos. For example, you can choose to have an Embryo become a Type Castle or Apostle with Arms.
objects.title: Additional Embryos (Infinite Dendrogram)

objects.text:
Your Embryo is War God Ship, Baldr. Form VII Guardian/Fortress/Gear/Weapon Embryo, notable for being 4 High-End versions of the Basic Type. It possesses 7 alternative modes. It also has a machine-like personality that will activate self-destruct on some shenanigans (But if something is serious, then it would dedicate itself to the task).

Baldr has some significant drawbacks in terms of functionality due to the lack of resources and loses out to more specialized Superior Embryos in terms of performance. The material cost of producing ammunition is extremely high. Also, there is a lag between switching forms, which renders you unable to move for a time. Finally, as a Superior Embryo, its ultimate skill is comparatively weak and depends greatly on the status of the user.

Baldr can change between an arm-mounted canon, a Gatling gun, a fixed turret (with Cameras and remote control), a tank (capable of independent action and communication), an all-terrain land-battleship, a hovercraft heavy cruiser, and a Battleship. It can produce its own ammo with enough materials with a variety of effects such as DD Shells (Direct Damage) that can ignore a target’s defense.

It possesses the Ultimate Skill [Unmatched God of War — Baldr]. It transforms into its Full Offense Mode, which is a giant mobile suit more than 100 meters in length. You control the robot and can reproduce all of your movements perfectly. Your HP increases to 100 times your original STR stat, STR is doubled, END increases to match your original STR stat and AGI increases to half of the original STR stat. This skill requires a power cell to be used, which only lasts 30 minutes. It takes 24 hours for Baldr to activate and charge 1 power cell.
objects.title: War God Ship, Baldr (Infinite Dendrogram)

objects.text:
Your Embryo is Queen of Monsters, Leviathan. Form VII Type Maiden with Guardian Embryo. All of Leviathan's resources and functionality are geared towards increasing her status. However, Leviathan can only exhibit a tenth of her stats when in her Maiden Form. Leviathan also exhibits an extremely strong instinct that allows her to intuit attacks that would prove dangerous to herself. As a Type Maiden, Leviathan possesses a humanoid form. In her Guardian form, she becomes an enormous monster reminiscent of a Godzilla more than 100 meters in length.

While in her Guardian form, she possesses over 200,000 STR, AGI, and END with an HP of 24,000,000. However, she has nearly 0 stats in everything else. In other words, Leviathan moves and thinks at Mach 200 and has the strength to move even under the pressure of 2,000,000 times that of Earth’s gravity.

Leviathan possesses the Ultimate Skill [We are the Queen of Monsters - Leviathan]. An active skill that fuses Leviathan with you and combines both of your statuses for 10 minutes with a 24-hour cooldown. Should you have a power that can share stats independently of this Ultimate, both effects will be added.
objects.title: Queen of Monsters, Leviathan (Infinite Dendrogram)

objects.text:
Your Embryo hatches as a guaranteed Maiden-type. Instead of leaving it to chance, the bond fixes itself as a “Maiden with” variation attached to one of the five basic Types. At hatching you choose the attached base Type (Arms, Guardner, Chariot, Castle, or Territory); hybrids remain possible as the Embryo evolves. The Maiden retains the hallmark focus on overcoming foes or concepts “stronger than itself” under limited, pre-set conditions, and she shares the usual temperament of Maidens—grounded, willful, and inclined to treat the world as real rather than a game.

Each Maiden expresses a core “theme” (motif, archetype, or concept) that shapes aesthetics, skill flavor, and conditional advantages. By default, the theme is inferred from the Master’s personality, drives, and ideals. Alternatively, you may explicitly choose the theme at creation. Once set, the theme persists and refines at each evolution, narrowing to greater focus or branching into sub-motifs.

This upgrade preserves everything an Embryo normally gains: the crest, the seven ranks of evolution, Status Correction appropriate to the chosen base Type, resource absorption for upgrades, and High-End/Superior growth paths. The Maiden’s emergency evolution trigger is also present: in a true crisis she can leap to the next form instantly, after which the time to reach the subsequent evolution is significantly longer.

The Maiden will support your goals and will oppose actions that would seriously harm you, as is standard for Maidens. All other Embryo rules remain unchanged.
objects.title: Maiden’s Vow (Infinite Dendrogram)

objects.text:
The ten reusable Displacement Containers, once used to store and relocate entire worlds, dimensions, subspaces, people, and structures, have now been fused and upgraded into a single, extraordinary artifact: The Crystal Ark. This fist-sized, indestructible crystal resides within your soul, inaccessible to anyone without your explicit permission—even the most powerful beings cannot breach it. You can freely enter and exit the Crystal Ark at will.

Retaining all the previous abilities of the Displacement Containers, the Crystal Ark introduces unprecedented enhancements. Within it lies an infinite subspace, organized into archives dedicated to entire species, worlds, and cultures. These archives preserve and restore lost or extinct civilizations by recreating their data as tangible, physical entities. Structures, lands, and ecosystems are stored in shrunken stasis containers, while the DNA and essence of species are preserved. From this data, 1,000 new members of each species are born, equipped with basic survival skills and the knowledge necessary to adapt, evolve, and thrive in a new world.

The Crystal Ark mirrors the purpose of Noah's Ark from the Bible: a vessel to preserve and rebuild lost civilizations, species, and cultures. Its capabilities extend to any race or civilization, whether it be the Time Lords of Gallifrey, the Kryptonians of Krypton, or the Martians of Mars. No land, species, or culture is beyond its reach.

When rebuilding a civilization, you control the process entirely. You can choose to guide and nurture the new beings as their teacher and parent or let them begin as independent young adults or children, already equipped with the knowledge to sustain themselves. Hidden within the new civilization is an invisible database containing the history, culture, technology, and lessons of their predecessors. As the civilization progresses through milestones—such as the Bronze, Iron, or Industrial Ages—relevant knowledge is gradually revealed to aid their evolution.

The Crystal Ark also includes a powerful interface that allows you to customize every aspect of the rebuilding process. From structures and ecosystems to knowledge archives and societal rules, you can tailor the design to your vision. Once finalized, the entire civilization is compressed into an indestructible seed-like capsule. This capsule can be deployed into a random timeline or a carefully chosen location. Upon activation, it initiates a miniature creation process, using stored materials, heat, and energy to form planets, moons, or even entire solar systems. Resources such as dust, rocks, heat, and energy can be mined and stored within the Crystal Ark to fuel this creation process.

Beyond rebuilding, the Crystal Ark serves as a repository of knowledge, blueprints, culture, and technology from all civilizations it records. You retain access to the original DNA and data, ensuring you can replicate or modify civilizations as needed. Unlike the destructive tendencies of entities like Brainiac, your role is that of a guide and creator, fostering growth and renewal.

As with the original Displacement Containers, the Crystal Ark allows you to transport and deploy anything stored within its subspace, enabling you to reshape worlds and civilizations with unparalleled precision and care.
objects.title: The Crystal Ark

objects.text:
Each purchase you make permanently increases the power of all your stickers by 5%, up to a maximum boost of 210%.

Your stickers now have the durability of an immovable object, they cannot be washed away by rain, blown off by wind, or removed by anyone without your permission.

Additionally, sticker effects can now stack on top of each other. However, each additional sticker increases the strain on the object or person it is applied to. After a certain number of stacked stickers, the target stops receiving new effects, making further applications useless.

The effects of stickers on people are still temporary.
Each purchase gave you additional new 50 stickers in you booklet or gave you new booklet with 50 stickers.
objects.title: + 50 Stickers

objects.text: This thing is so unspeakably shitty… Unfortunately, your Capchalogue is not the seemingly unlimited Wallet, but rather one of the multitudes of baroque ‘fetch modems’ that predate it. There are many bespoke kinds of these, ranging from ‘stack’ which merely ejects the oldest item (at great speed) when it’s queue is full, or ‘Bogo’ which ejects a random item, to bespoke and strange systems like the ‘Tech-Hop’ modem which forces you to rhyme and rap to retrieve desired items and keep an inventory stable.
objects.title: Unhelpful Sylladex (Homestuck)

objects.text:
This is no ordinary arrow. It appears you have obtained another arrow alongside the Stand Arrow—the legendary Requiem Arrow. This is the very arrow that played a pivotal role in the downfall of Diavolo.

When pierced by someone who already possesses a Stand, the Requiem Arrow elevates that Stand to entirely new heights, granting abilities that surpass the limits of an ordinary Stand. It shatters the previously established rules of what a Stand can achieve.
objects.title: Requiem Arrow (JoJo's Bizarre Adventure)

objects.text: Your Golden Chest has undergone an evolution gaining two new features. First, the max amount of money you can spend to increase the rarity of the item from the chest has been removed. Now the chest simply gives any random item from .001x to 1000x the value of the money inserted into it. Second, any item from any universe can now be drawn from the loot box. One day you might find harmless trinkets such as keychains, toys, or snacks, Or the next you may witness the existence of an enchanted relic, a cursed blade, a magical grimoire, a Devil Fruit, a functioning alien starship, or some impossible artifact that defies the laws of physics. The rarer the prize, the slimmer the odds. The loot box is only bound by three iron rules: Authenticity — Whatever you receive is real, functional, and immediately usable in your hands. A loot box containing a spaceship means you truly own a spaceship and all the technological knowledge needed to use it. Power — As you spend more, the higher the likelihood the item inside will be more powerful and more immediately useful. Randomness — No amount of pleading, rigging, or brute force can influence what emerges. Not even gods can predict the loot box's next result. However, ownership of such a device is both a blessing and a curse. One draw may result in a novelty eraser. The next, you might find yourself responsible for a nuclear warhead, a soul-corrupting warp artifact, or a screaming egg of an Elder Dragon.
objects.title: Universal Golden Loot Box

objects.text:
The Gameforge Console has expanded its reach beyond video games, allowing you to enter dungeons based on any popular fictional story, regardless of medium. Once a narrative is presented to the console, it deconstructs its world, systems, and power dynamics into a coherent dungeon shaped by the story’s logic and power allowing for opportunities to bypass the maximum Impossible++ threshold.

Now completing a Normal-difficulty Naruto dungeon might leave you with a fully functional genin-level chakra network and the capacity to learn real jutsu. Finishing a Hard-difficulty One Piece dungeon could grant you a genuine Devil Fruit or a manual detailing the fundamentals of all 3 Haki, while more ambitious worlds such as cultivation epics, cosmic superhero settings, or eldritch mythologies may result in their rewards further scaling beyond the normal maximum possible before.
objects.title: Universal Access

objects.text: Your console now comes with the ability to create dungeons that are geared towards challenges not based in combat. When inserting a game into it, you are given the option to either form a normal dungeon full of enemies and dangers, or to instead choose an alternative challenge. Choosing the alternative setting will give you a list of possible challenges, generally shaped by the game in question and the selected difficulty. For example, a Casual Minecraft challenge could be to speedrun getting a diamond tool in peaceful mode or to create a specific music track using noteblocks in a certain amount of time. Meanwhile an Impossible Cooking Mama challenge would be having to beat her in a baking competition. And an Impossible++ Persona 5 challenge could be anything from having to win a very obscure Persona and Megami Tensei franchise trivia contest without missing a single question to having to convince all of Joker's love interests to not beat him up on valentine's day and instead share him with any of your Human Master or Social Thinker powers disabled. Winning these challenges still gives rewards, though they will typically be related to the type of challenge in question. So a casual baking or building challenge would grant you mundane skill in those activities, while an Impossible challenge based on Guitar Hero might make your musical skills supernaturally good with some minor support abilities tied to it, and an Impossible++ challenge to convince Batman: Arkham Asylum's Joker to change his ways would give you supertherapy powers akin to I Do Not Judge, I Merely Accept or its upgrades. Finally, you can, instead of picking predesigned challenges, enter a custom challenge into a prompt, allowing for practically anything to be simulated. The Console will immediately rate the prompt's difficulty and assign a suitable award to it, though you may choose to up the difficulty to get better rewards in exchange for having to complete a tougher version of the challenge. Such as a basic prompt of 'run 10 kilometers in Minecraft' becoming 'reach The End's World Border without flying powers' if upped to Impossible++. The only true limit is that prompts that completely go against the source material will be rejected, so you can't challenge the Hollow Knight to a cosplay contest or something like that.
objects.title: Freeform Challenges

objects.text: Your console now has an additional menu feature: a prompt in which you can enter specific rewards. Upon inserting a game, you may choose to specify any reward you can think of related to that game, from specific items, to powers found within it, to even specific characters you wish to bring out of it as companions. Upon doing so, the console will generate a custom challenge run that, upon completing, grants that reward. Before it pulls you in, the console will give a warning of the required difficulty to receive that reward, and will give you the options of either starting the challenge as is, lowering the difficulty in exchange for lessening the reward such as getting a lower rarity variant of the item or a version of the companion who lacks certain powers, or upping the difficulty to get a better version of the reward, like a gun with an infinite ammo upgrade and a blueprint to make more of them or the power coming with a maxed out upgrade tree. If the reward is invalid for whatever reason, the prompt will reject it while giving suggestions for the closest equivalent found in the game if possible. Such as requesting a Gravity Gun in Portal resulting in suggestions for a Portal Gun, asking for the power to fire Hadokens in Control could have the console suggest the Floppy Disk’s Launch ability as a reward, or offering a BSAA squad as companions in place of a HECU squad if you inserted Resident Evil 6 instead of Half-Life. This can be useful if you don’t remember the name or specifics of something you want from a game as you can enter generic or vague requests and have it suggest rewards until you find what you are looking for. If you have Freeform Challenges, you gain nearly full control to shape the entire challenge run, its nature, victory condition, and rewards, so long as you obey the difficulty to reward ratio and the result isn’t completely incompatible with the game in question.
objects.title: Reward Selection

objects.text: Whenever you insert a game in the Gameforge Console, you’ll find another menu option has appeared. Selecting this option will open a submenu containing a list of modifications that can be applied to the game, from generic mods like graphics upgrades or reskins of characters to more specific mods such as ones that add original characters or new mechanics or bosses. In addition to those, the list also includes every mod ever created for the game both in your homeworld and in every setting you’ve ever been to, as well as DLC or other official bonus content not included in the base game across all platforms. You may apply any combination of such modifications to your game before entering the dungeon, with them all being seamlessly integrated into your run. The main benefit of this, other than tweaking your run to be more to your liking, is that your potential rewards can now be based on whatever mods you have installed. For example, installing Magic Storage before starting your Terraria run would allow for a Tinker power based on it to become a potential reward, though it wouldn’t be guaranteed without the Reward Selection upgrade. There are some things to note though. Your run will be exactly as challenging as the difficulty requires, so if you install a ton of over powered ‘quality of life’ mods that would trivialize your Impossible++ challenge, expect the enemies to get their own boosts that are just as over powered to maintain their threat. Also, if you install mutually incompatible mods, the console may unilaterally alter them in an attempt to get them to fit together somehow, and if that’s not possible, it will refuse to load the dungeon until you uninstall them. If you have Universal Access, then for non-games the Workshop will instead contain a list of modifications for the setting based on a combination of other media in the franchise, popular fanfiction plots or fan theories, and some generic tropes like ‘roleswap au’ to swap the good guys and bad guys roles or ‘alternate genre’ that could result in an Action Adventure series instead becoming a Horror Black Comedy.
objects.title: Gameforge Workshop

objects.text: You now have the ability to insert multiple games into the Console at once, allowing you to do a challenge run in a crossover of the games in question. For physical media specifically, your console will save a downloaded copy of any games inserted onto itself that you can then select from a menu for when you wish to create a crossover. This can result in some interesting dungeons, such as a crossover of Cooking Mama and Beat Saber where you run through a dungeon fighting food-based monsters using duel lightsabers where you have to attack to each monster’s beat in order to defeat them, collect their ingredients, and then bake Mama a full course meal to her standards. Other possibilities include teaming up with Master Chief, Gordon Freeman, and the Ghost to take on the Radiance who was enhanced with Combine implants before being infected by the Flood, or competing with the nations of Metal Gear’s USA, Zelda’s Hyrule, and KanColle’s Japan to see who can get a Domination Victory in Civilization while fighting off terrorists, moblins, and Abyssals on top of normal bandits and city states. If you have Universal Access, the potential crossovers can get even crazier, and you may also select one property to take precedence. This could allow for a comedic crossover of the Cthulhu Mythos and The Office where eldritch horrors wear suits, crack jokes, and the necronomicon is Cthulhu’s work laptop. Alternatively, it could result in a much more serious one where the Dunder Mifflin Paper Company is a cult and the cast are either insane murderers trying to summon horrors from beyond the veil or soon to be insane victims who will be sacrificed for said summoning. Your rewards will also be influenced by the crossover. For example, you could play a crossover of a Gundam fighting game and Code Geass: Lost Colors and be rewarded with a Gundam powered by a Sakuradite reactor and whose primary melee weapon is a fusion of a Radiation Wave Unit and the legendary Shining Finger. Finally, as a bonus, you now have the option to use the console to actually play the games (or consume other media as intended if you have Universal Access) instead of entering a dungeon, acting as a normal if extremely high end console (controller or keyboard sold separately). Alternatively, you can enter a dungeon that consists of nothing but a high-end gaming / entertainment room to play the game in plus an EXIT door that ends the ‘run’. This means you can now experience the craziness of Hollow Knight x Minecraft x Beat Saber x Cooking Mama x Farming Simulator or whatever other combinations you come up with as their hypothetical developers intended.
objects.title: Crossover Generator

objects.text:
On top of receiving products from Zonko’s Joke Shop, you also receive products from its spiritual successor, Weasley Wizard Wheezes. On top of new items to prank people with, many are improved versions of Zonko’s products.

This includes the fireworks used in the battle of Hogwarts, fever fudge, boxing telescopes, reusable hangmans, and extendable ears.

If you have Witchcraft and Wizardry (Harry Potter), you will also gain the knowledge to create more, as well as the creative talent that allowed the Weasley twins to be such successful pranksters.
objects.title: Weasley’s box of Magic Prank Items (Harry Potter)

objects.text:
You have now also bonded with The Grimoire Extraordinaire, a skill crystal which grants the ability to detect flaws in any skill, technique, item, structure, entity, and more. The Grimoire now resides within your soul, functioning through your eyesight and any visual abilities you possess, manifesting as a holographic or mental interface that only you can perceive.

The Grimoire breaks down its targets into literal blueprints of their operational and structural components. It visualises hidden systems, exposing exact stress points, mechanical inefficiencies, and energy anomalies. When observing an enemy, the Grimoire generates a visual overlay that highlights high-priority structural flaws. It pinpoints fragile filaments, exposed joints, unstable energy channels, or poorly anchored cores, creating opportunities for precise and potentially lethal strikes.

When combined with sensory abilities, it can map the stability of the surrounding environment. You can detect looming cave-ins, weak flooring, or hidden trap triggers long before stepping into danger. The Grimoire can also identify flaws within magical barriers, puzzles, arrays, or locking mechanisms, allowing traps to be dismantled safely without triggering catastrophic reactions.

One of the Grimoire’s greatest strengths is its capacity for optimisation and improvement. By analysing even the most basic movements—such as swinging a sword, casting a spell, or executing a fighting technique—it can instantly identify flaws, wasted motion, and inefficiencies in the user’s execution, then explain exactly how to refine and improve the technique or skill for maximum power, efficiency and performance. With the Grimoire’s guidance, even ordinary skills can be elevated to elite levels within days.

The Grimoire can also map energy pathways. It reveals structural defects in the flow of energy through your or another person’s body, or even within a spell itself. By correcting these flaws, you can drastically reduce power consumption, increase casting speed, amplify destructive output, and more.

Because it inherently exposes imperfections, the Grimoire also functions as a flawless appraisal tool. You can inspect any item or tool, to identify hidden impurities, structural weaknesses, or manufacturing defects.

During battle, if an opponent relies on enchanted equipment, the Grimoire reveals exactly where the enchantment is unstable or flawed, allowing you to deliberately shatter it with a precise strike. Likewise, you can guide craftsmen by identifying exactly where a piece of gear should be reinforced to prevent failure in combat.
objects.title: The Grimoire Extraordinaire (Paragon of Skills)

objects.text:
Each purchase increases your herd tenfold (x10). You can also exchange any number of animals for another species in any quantity, without restrictions. However, the herd must be large enough to sustain natural reproduction. This applies to all species, including extinct, solitary, or predatory ones. 
 
A new animal can be purchased for its equivalent weight in cows. For example, one mammoth is roughly equal to ten cows, and vice versa if the animal is smaller. Predators will cost twice as much.

This may seem strange and suspicious, but the blessing will help conceal certain details. Unless, of course, you set a herd of war mammoths on someone... In that case, the blessing’s protection won’t be enough for something so obvious.

Additionally, you’ll receive facilities for processing animal products, whatever they may be. However, you should consider what products and in what quantities each animal species can provide.
objects.title: An Extinct Zoo.

objects.text: You have a special connection to the Objects of Power (OoP) that you have claimed. If your OoP are somehow destroyed or lost, than you can instantly summon it back, or materialize new one. You can only do this once a week.
objects.title: Warranty

addons.text: You can now actively refuse to be used by anyone of your choosing. As before, you can choose specific people or set criteria.
addons.title: Choosing the Chosen One

objects.text:
Your Objects of Power can only able to be used by you and those you permit. In the hands of others, the objects are inert. You can choose what properties to turn off with this ability. For example, you could make ordinary rock retain its durability but not its size-changing properties.

If you wish, you can choose any number of criteria to be used instead, such as only being able to be used by people with "good alignment". Finally, you can choose which objects of power to apply this to.
objects.title: ID Lock

addons.text: Soulbound items are linked to your soul, but did not gain the benefits of being an Object of Power. Now, over the course of three months, any soulbound object will slowly become an Object of Power and gain any benefits from being one, with the inverse happening to Objects of Power.
addons.title: True Bound Object

objects.text: Your Objects of Power (OoP) are now linked with your soul. With a thought, you can summon or store them instantly. You've also now got an instinctive grasp of how to wield or use each item—be it a sword, gun, or ship. Plus, your mind can direct and control OoP remotely. That ship needing a crew? Now a one-person show, commanded by your thoughts.
objects.title: Essential

objects.text: Your powers have been infused into your Objects of Power (OoP), granting them multiple new features. All your perks naturally apply to your Objects of Power; you may choose to exempt some perks or objects from this, but without Natural, Personal Touch or Holding Back, you may not change your decision. You also can now channel any of your other active abilities through your Objects of Power nigh perfectly. This typically requires physical contact with your Object of Power, but depending on the object or if you have Essential, it could be applied at range. Some abilities may not apply as well depending on what they entail.
objects.title: Infusion

objects.text: Harnessing your unique bond with the Objects of Power (OoP), you've attained the ability to combine multiple OoP's into a singular, enhanced OoP. The resulting fused OoP inherits the combined attributes, strengths, and abilities of its constituent OoP's.
objects.title: Fusion

objects.text: Well you’ve combined all your Objects of Power into a single glorious mess... now what? Split them back up of course! Where as before you could only fuse Objects of Power, turning many into few, you can now do the opposite and turn the few into many. This allows you to break your single Mega-Object of Power back into it’s individual parts... and go even further, allowing you to separate out the individual functions of your Objects of Power into separate Mini-Objects of Power themselves, each of these Mini-Objects will have the same form of the Object, but only a portion of it’s functions.
objects.title: Fission

objects.text:
Instead of receiving your Objects of Power (OoP), you’ve been turned into your OoP. While you could theoretically 'use' yourself, you'll find you’ve become symbiotic, becoming threefold more efficient, if being 'used' by someone else. 

In this manner, you can now attach yourself to another being, in whatever form your OoP would designate, and can utilize it through them. 

However, you still retain the innate flaws of many OoPs, such as an inability to actively refuse to be 'used' in the manner of the OoP you've been turned into unless it has some form of innate requirement. You’re still conscious and intelligent.

If you’re reincarnated as an Ally OoP you’ll similarly find yourself operating best under another’s command. Additionally you would only be one of the allies if it contains multiple, such as clone Regiment (Star Wars) (though you may choose which).

If you possess multiple OoP you may select which this applies to, or all if taken with Fusion.
objects.title: Reincarnated as a [REDACTED] but my [REDACTED] is [REDACTED] and the prom is tomorrow!

addons.text:
Your Objects of Power (OoP) are now bonded to you on every level—physical, mental, and spiritual. They are permanently grafted, embedded not just into your body but also into your very essence.

Because of this, you can no longer summon or store your OoP as before. They are always present, fixed in place as an inseparable part of you. However, their influence no longer holds power over you beyond what you allow. Any thoughts, emotions, or compulsions they once imposed are now fully within your control.

Additionally, your OoP now regenerate and heal as you do. Damage done to them will recover over time, just as wounds on your body would.
addons.title: Essentially One

addons.text:
The bond between you and your Objects of Power is more than physical—it lingers in the spaces between thought and form, in the currents of energy running through your body. Even when torn away, your OoP are never truly lost.

If your grafted Object of Power (OoP) is destroyed or removed, a weaker, ghost-like version remains, allowing you to continue using its abilities at reduced strength. Over time, your body and nervous system work to reconstruct the OoP from this imprint, gradually restoring it to full power. However, the process is not instant—until it fully regenerates, you may experience physical strain, nerve pain, or momentary lapses in control as your body struggles to reintegrate the missing piece.
addons.title: Phantom Grafts

addons.text:
You now permanently fuse with anyone who wields you. The moment you are picked up, you automatically graft yourself onto their body, integrating into their flesh, bones, or nervous system. This process is irreversible under normal circumstances and can be painful or disorienting for the wielder.

Once attached, you function as an extension of their body. Your abilities activate through them, and you experience everything they do, including pain and physical sensations. You cannot refuse being used, but your effectiveness is highest when your intent synchronises with your wielder. Over time, your presence subtly influences their physiology, altering their reflexes, senses, or even minor aspects of their personality.

Removal is almost always lethal, as your presence becomes too deeply intertwined with their body and mind. Even in rare cases where separation occurs, you do not emerge unchanged. Traces of your wielder remain within you—memories, instincts, or imprints of their personality subtly shaping your nature over time.
addons.title: Fleshbound

addons.text: Instead of your integrated Tinkertech modifying your power, your integrated Tinkertech is the source of your power. This gives a much greater versatility on how you can modify its expression, since you can rebuild potentially every part of it to facilitate any desired changes. While still hard to do since anything beyond superficial, surface level changes still requires surgery, the Tinkertech has been designed to make this process easier, vastly reducing the dangers associated with the process. They can still potentially influence your thoughts, emotions, or physiology due to how integrated they are, but given enough time and resources, you can potentially remove this drawback through upgrading the Tinkertech, though that would be a megaproject in itself. If you have a Tinker or other kind of power that could facilitate it, you can make the Tinkertech your own, allowing for even greater control over the resulting power(s).
addons.title: Tinkertech Power Source
Check Out My Fit
addons.text: You have full control over how you and your Objects of Power (OoP) are connected, able to freely adjust their appearance and degree of functionality at any time. They do not need an outside anchor, directly imbuing your flesh and blood with their nature and abilities. You could imbue a sword OoP into your hand, so a hand chop would have the same destructive power as a real sword. However, creating a physical representation of your OoP will increase how much of their strength you can release drastically. A spaceship transformed into mechanical wings will allow you to fly much faster than simply imbuing its nature into your shoulder blades. You can also create conditions for your OoP to transform, such as immediately manifesting a set of armor when you are attacked. However, do remember that your connection to your OoP will always have a physical element. So transforming your skin into armor, or your nails into a sword, will be extremely painful for a normal human. With a physical form your OoP will be susceptible to targeted destruction, and all damage they take will reflect on your body unless you can repair or otherwise limit the damage. If you have Essentially One you can now summon and store your OoP again, though you can only manifest them in or on your body. This makes transforming them much easier; simply storing the concept of the OoP imbued in your body and resummoning it in an already changed state will skip the painful transformation.

objects.text:
You and your Objects of Power (OoP) are now one with each other. They are now physically grafted onto your body, fusing with your flesh, bone, or even nervous system in a way that is both permanent and deeply personal. They could be embedded into your limbs, woven into your skeletal structure, or integrated into your neural pathways.

This grants you enhanced control over your OoP, allowing for near-instantaneous activation and heightened control.
