However, removing or altering these OoP may be excruciating, impossible, or even fatal. Additionally, their influence over you may grow stronger, subtly shaping your thoughts, emotions, or even physiology over time.
objects.title: Grafted Hardware

objects.text:
Your Objects of Power (OoP) can now be converted into inherent abilities, making the item's powers become part of you. These powers are absorbed into your being, granting you all their abilities and strengths permanently. For every time this is taken, you can choose one OoP to convert. For OoPs that are impossible to convert directly into powers, they will become the closest approximation of what the OoP’s expression as a power would be, while maintaining the same strength as the original item. 

This transformation allows the powers to benefit from power-boosting abilities and grow like any other power from the CYOA. However, the powers will still have the same restrictions as their item counterparts, and any drawbacks that restrict powers will now also affect these abilities, as they function exactly like powers from this CYOA. Additionally, OoPs with abilities that out scale their cost will have their power counterpart scale to their cost, with the potential to grow to their full power. Ultimately, you need to rely on nothing but yourself.
objects.title: Conversion (One Object)

objects.text:
Your Objects of Powers (OoP) can now be converted into inherent abilities, making the respective item's powers become part of you. These powers are absorbed into your being, granting you all their abilities and strengths permanently. You may choose which of your OoPs are absorbed and which are not. If you possess Fission, you may undo and redo this with any of your OoPs as you see fit. You could even convert your regular powers into OoPs if you also had Infusion. For OoPs that are impossible to convert directly into powers, they will become the closest approximation of what the OoP’s expression as a power would be, while maintaining the same strength as the original item. 

This transformation allows the powers to benefit from power-boosting abilities and grow like any other power from the CYOA. However, the powers will still have the same restrictions as their item counterparts, and any drawbacks that restrict powers will now also affect these abilities, as they function exactly like powers from this CYOA. Additionally, OoPs with abilities that out scale their cost will have their power counterpart scale to their cost, with the potential to grow to their full power. Ultimately, you need to rely on nothing but yourself.
objects.title: Conversion (All Objects)

objects.text: You gain the full strength and power of any Objects of Powers converted into powers, not diminishing in any capacity if it would have during the conversion.
objects.title: Full Conversion

objects.text: Unfortunately, one of your powers isn't going to you. Not directly. Instead, one power per selection is being filtered through an Object of Power of some description, whether it be a focus for magics or technological suit to simulate a physical power.
objects.title: Detract

objects.text: You are unable to use your chosen Objects of Power yourself. Instead it is your job to safeguard them until a worthy wielder comes along. Luckily you at least get to decide who is worthy, besides yourself. You gain a minor sense of any person who might be considered “worthy” by any criteria you choose. You can choose different criteria for different objects. You will also have the ability to retract and take back the OoPs at any time.
objects.title: Keeper (One Object)

objects.text: You are unable to use your chosen Objects of Power yourself. Instead it is your job to safeguard them until a worthy wielder comes along. Luckily you at least get to decide who is worthy, besides yourself. You gain a minor sense of any person who might be considered “worthy” by any criteria you choose. You can choose different criteria for different objects. You will also have the ability to retract and take back the OoPs at any time.
objects.title: Keeper (All Objects)

addons.text: Welp, we really should have seen this coming. Instead of being merely an OoP, you now are the familiar that activates it as well. You get to choose your 'owner' and at any point can revoke ownership or reassign ownership.
addons.title: Usagi! Get in the damn robot!

objects.text:
Your OoP isn’t an unfeeling object, but is instead some variety of living creature. The Familiar operates the OoP’s effects. Whether these effects take place on you or centred on the Familiar depends on the Object of Power.

While it is not under your direct control, it is likely to be aligned with you and is optionally sapient. Both you and the creature know the direction of each other, and roughly how far from each other you are.

If taken with Detract, the Familiar can instead operate a non-OoP power.
objects.title: Familiar (One Object)

addons.text: Welp, we really should have seen this coming. Instead of being merely an OoP, you now are the familiar that activates it as well. You get to choose your 'owner' and at any point can revoke ownership or reassign ownership.
addons.title: Usagi! Get in the damn robot!

objects.text:
Your OoPs aren’t all unfeeling objects, some are instead a variety of living creatures. These Familiars operate the OoPs’ effects. Whether these effects take place on you or centred on the individual Familiar depends on the Object of Power. You may decide if this only applies to some of your OoPs or all of them.

While they are not under your direct control, they are likely to be aligned with you and are optionally sapient. Both you and all the creatures know the direction of each other, and roughly how far from each other you are.

If taken with Detract, the Familiars can instead operate a non-OoP power.
objects.title: Familiars (All Objects)

objects.text: One or more of your objects of power has been cursed. For each selection one curse you have selected is instead carried by Object of Power of your choosing. As a result the curse only applies while using the item you are considered under the effects of that curse.
objects.title: Cursed Item

objects.text:
Tired of having to throw away your epic weapons and armor when finding a pool noodle with better stats? Well, no more. With each purchase of this upgrade, you can turn one of your OoPs into an indestructible, self-repairing growth item.

The more you use a growth item, the better it gets at its intended purpose. A sword will become sharper and more durable, a ship will move faster, and a grimoire will continuously add new spells. The growth rate is always fast enough to ensure that whatever items you choose will remain extremely viable for you to use as your primary equipment at your current power level. This growth includes any supernatural abilities/properties of the OoP.

Furthermore, growth items can develop new and unique abilities upon being exposed to various phenomena. If you use a sword to judge criminals, it may gain a holy attribute and deal more damage to demons. If you travel through a magical blizzard, your grimoire could gain the ability to cast basic ice magic for you.

Finally, if you truly encounter a powerful item of the same type as your preferred OoP, you can begin a process that will slowly merge them together. Initially, your chosen Growth OoP will gain moderately weaker versions of the abilities contained within the other item. However, these abilities will develop as if they were constantly experiencing use. This lasts until your chosen OoP matches the merged object in power level. This can only work on objects of the same type: swords can only merge with swords, and spears can only merge with spears.
objects.title: Growth Item (One Object)

objects.text:
Tired of having to throw away your epic weapons and armor when finding a pool noodle with better stats? Well, no more. With the purchase of this upgrade, you can turn each one of your OoPs into indestructible, self-repairing growth items. You are also free to exempt some OoPs from this change.

The more you use a growth item, the better it gets at its intended purpose. A sword will become sharper and more durable, a ship will move faster, and a grimoire will continuously add new spells. The growth rate is always fast enough to ensure that whatever items you choose will remain extremely viable for you to use as your primary equipment at your current power level. This growth includes any supernatural abilities/properties of the chosen OoP.

Furthermore, growth items can develop new and unique abilities upon being exposed to various phenomena. If you use a sword to judge criminals, it may gain a holy attribute and deal more damage to demons. If you travel through a magical blizzard, your grimoire could gain the ability to cast basic ice magic for you.

Finally, if you truly encounter a powerful item of the same type as one of your preferred OoPs, you can begin a process that will slowly merge them together. Initially, your chosen Growth OoP will gain moderately weaker versions of the abilities contained within the other item. However, these abilities will develop as if they were constantly experiencing use. This lasts until your chosen OoP matches the merged object in power level. This can only work on objects of the same type: swords can only merge with swords, and spears can only merge with spears.
objects.title: Growth Items (All Objects)

objects.text: Now your Objects of Power gain a unique additional feature, the ability at will to shrink down to the size and shape of a pin or charm for easy transport and storage, generating any temporary hardware needed, such as necklaces, bracelets, or the like. Their miniature form’s will always still be able to be visually identified as the object in question. Multiple trinkets can be joined on the same hardware as appropriate–such as charms on a bracelet. This does lock out all other abilities of your Objects of Power, but the sheer convenience of transport must surely be worth it? The return to normal size can either be a simple shift in size or an elaborate sequence, changing as needed by you. Note: The hardware generated by this upgrade will only disappear when all trinkets connected are returned to their full size. Note: the examples given here are a small subset of the possibilities, as long as it’s small, decorative, and for display on your person it works.
objects.title: Trinket

objects.text: With all the various Objects of Power you can gain, it can be a little difficult to find objects that both function well together and don’t look like you cobbled together something from random things you found. Or it was. Now, all of your Objects of Power have the ability Transmogrify. This handy little power allows you—while out of combat, and not using the OoP in question—to change any aesthetic aspect of your OoP—the shape, size, color, materials, etc.—to anything that suits your needs and desires, enabling you to adjust your OoP to fit the world you find yourself in. The only restrictions are that the OoP must remain capable of performing every function it previously could, and that it must be recognizable as that item—broadly speaking, at least. This means a sword will always need to look—and act—like a sword. But instead of a straight-edged European steel longsword, it might look like a bronze Greek Xiphos. Ultimately, a spade will always be a spade, a shield a shield, and a sword a sword.
objects.title: Transmogrify

objects.text:
This upgrade is primarily intended for spacecraft, but can also be applied to other types of equipment if it makes sense.

You can adapt the ship to the setting by improving its capabilities to the minimum standards for a ship of the appropriate size and class. If the ship already had such a function, it will be brought up to the “average” for the setting (for example, if it could perform slow superluminal flight, in Star Wars it will have a class 3-4 hyperdrive). 

If the ship did not have a certain system, it will receive it, but at a “low level” for a ship of the corresponding size and class.

If you have the appropriate power from Technology and Artifice Powers for a specific setting, you can get the best systems available in it.

For simplicity, we can divide ship systems into the following main groups:
- Propulsion systems.
- Defense systems.
- Weapon systems.
- Auxiliary systems.

This will not diminish the uniqueness of your ship if you so desire, and you may choose not to replace certain systems or change their local equivalents.
objects.title: Local Standardization

objects.text:
Your OoP will receive a self-destruction system that prevents it from falling into the wrong hands.

You can configure the parameters: activation time, trigger, self-destruction method, and possible damage.

Access can be disabled or transferred to authorized persons.

Unauthorized access is impossible.
objects.title: Self Destruct System

objects.text:
You receive a Blueprint for an Object of Power, which allows you to create the object. This does not provide the materials or skills necessary to follow the blueprint, but does provide the knowledge of how to create those materials if you have another power capable of doing so. 

You do not have to purchase the Object of Power in order to gain its blueprint.
objects.title: Blueprint (Any)

objects.text: You receive Blueprints for all of your Objects of Power, which allows you to create more of them. This does not provide the materials or skills necessary to follow the blueprint, but does provide the knowledge of how to create those materials if you have another power capable of doing so.
objects.title: Blueprints (Owned)

objects.text:
You built your Objects of Power with your own hands before you arrived in your new world.  They gain any bonuses that would have applied to your own creations, and you gain any bonuses and experience you’d gain from the act of creating them. You can also make minor personal touches to their appearance and function. You know every part and feature of your OoPs, having designed them yourself. 

If you do not posess any Tinker, Technology and Artifice, other Powers, or otherwise the skills and intelligence that would have allowed you to create your Objects or something similar to them in function and scale, then their creation happened in a one time Tinker-trance. You will have no recollection of how you constructed the objects, though you will know what you constructed, and will have to figure out how to follow the Blueprints again from the ground up.
objects.title: Made It Myself

objects.text: Instead of gaining your Objects of Power in fully working condition, you’ll receive them in a much less... capable state, with many features and abilities they might have had being non-functional. On the bright side, this damage is guaranteed to be fixable—though it doesn’t necessarily guarantee you have the ability to do so. Each purchase here damages an OoP of your choice, reducing it’s features and functionality by 5 SP until it’s repaired to working order. You can apply multiple selections of Restoration Project to an OoP—or it’s Upgrades & Fusions—as long as it doesn’t go over the total cost of the OoP in question. As you repair your various OoP, they will regain any functionality lost.
objects.title: Restoration Project

objects.text:
Within your Object of Power now stirs a burgeoning soul—a small and fragile thing at first, one shaped by the nature of the equipment itself. Over time, through weeks, months, and eventually years, this soul will grow by learning from you. As it develops, it will form its own thoughts, feelings, and personality, yet remain deeply connected to you and unwavering in loyalty.

You won't have to wait until it fully matures to benefit from its presence, however—as once the soul gains basic awareness, typically within a few weeks, it will begin assisting you. A mental link forms between you and the equipment, deepening your connection to it and allowing for more intuitive usage. The soul will learn from your habits and preferences, adjusting itself to support your fighting style.

If your equipment is a sword, the soul will guide your movements, accelerating your growth and helping you master techniques more quickly. If you use it to channel magic, the soul will harmonize with your energy, enhancing how spells are cast through the item and improving its efficiency as a magical conduit.

As the soul continues to grow, it may begin to help you develop new techniques or refined ways to wield your equipment. Its evolution brings strength, though always in line with the nature of the object it inhabits. Any new powers will be natural extensions of what the equipment already does, rather than simply creating wholly new abilities.
objects.title: Equipment Soul

addons.text:
As you are the OoP, the nanites would normally attempt to recreate your consciousness when making a copy of you. Thankfully, they’re smart enough to understand how many problems this could cause, and instead have supplied an uplink, in essence ‘dividing’ you amongst each copy of the OoP.

While there’s a ‘You’ that’s the combined total of each of the OoPs, there’s also a ‘fork’ of you that’s solely inside one, with the ‘greater’ you essentially acting as a buffer so each of you can act independently and also completely in sync with each other. 

Naturally, this means that should this connection somehow be cut, you’ll still be functional in any body, and once connection resumes your memories will be uploaded and made available to the rest of ‘you’ as you’re made complete again.
addons.title: Endless Expansion

addons.text:
Thanks to your ability to fuse OoPs, you can fuse multiple copies of the same OoP together to improve various aspects of the original, be that power, charge, durability, or by some other metric.

These improvements are always linear with each new copy integrated into the original.
addons.title: Additive Ascension

addons.text: When you duplicate an OoP, you may choose whether the object gains a newly born Familiar of its own or whether it’s linked to the familiar of the original object.
addons.title: The Reproductive Process

objects.text:
One of your OoPs has been given an additional slot 5mm³ in volume, containing a solid block of highly refined replicatory nanites. By touching the small block, you can designate a mass of materials and it will begin using them to recreate the OoP they’re integrated into.

Notably, these nanites require a mass of materials to produce a copy of the relevant OoP, but can transmute mundane materials as needed for the conversion. The more mystical or obscure the requisite material they need is, the less efficient the transmutation is, requiring entire quarries of stone to create a fist sized amount of a purely mystical element. This works similarly for replicating enchantments, which would also need material to compensate for their creation.

As the nanites of the cube are so highly specialised, they don’t truly have the capacity to do anything but replicate the OoP they’re integrated into.
objects.title: The Replicator Cube(s)!

As you are the OoP, the nanites would normally attempt to recreate your consciousness when making a copy of you. Thankfully, they’re smart enough to understand how many problems this could cause, and instead have supplied an uplink, in essence ‘dividing’ you amongst each copy of the OoP.

All of your OoPs has been given an additional slot 5mm³ in volume, containing a solid block of highly refined replicatory nanites. By touching the small block, you can designate a mass of materials, and it will begin using them to recreate the OoP they’re integrated into.

objects.title: The Replicator Cube(s)! (All)

addons.text:
Your crew are no longer baseline humans. Instead, every individual crewmember becomes partially infused with your own power. All perks that naturally apply to you through Infusion now extend to every member of the crew associated with your Objects of Power. As with Infusion, you may choose to exclude certain perks if their effects would prove disruptive or unnecessary, but once excluded the decision remains fixed unless you possess Holding Back.

In addition to perks, your crew develops minor manifestations of your abilities, tied to how those abilities are normally expressed when channeled through the associated Object of Power. These manifestations are weaker, but they are independently usable by the crew. For example, if you can channel destructive lightning through your OoP, your crew may be able to spark lightning between their hands or imbue the same OoP with electrical discharges. They could also have physiological changes, from being different races to having cybernetics depending on your powers. The expression is always contextually limited, reflecting the crew’s role and the function of the Object of Power they are assigned to.

Further, each crew member may be issued a weaker version of your personal Object of Power. These lesser copies are weaker and cannot replicate the full scope of your personal gear, but they scale appropriately to the crew’s roles.
addons.title: Empowered Cohort

objects.text:
Some Objects of Power (OoPs) are simply too vast, complex, or dangerous to be handled by a single person, no matter how powerful or skilled they may be. Some were never designed for individual use in the first place — they require teams, hierarchies, and entire support systems to function properly. This choice addresses that limitation by providing you with a fully equipped and appropriately scaled crew to operate your Objects of Power with maximum efficiency.

Upon selecting this option, you may choose any number of your Objects of Power, each of which will now come with a dedicated crew tailored to its operational requirements. You will receive exactly the personnel needed to run the OoP as it was originally intended, down to the last technician, pilot, engineer, or support staff. These individuals are entirely baseline humans (or their setting-appropriate equivalents) with no supernatural or enhanced abilities beyond their training and expertise, but they are fully competent and capable in their assigned roles.

For instance, if your OoP is something as monumental as the DS-1 Orbital Battle Station "Death Star" (Star Wars), your granted crew would include over a million operators to manage the station’s various functions, alongside hundreds of thousands of Stormtroopers and Imperial Army personnel for security, maintenance, and combat operations. Similarly, a starship, ancient fortress, or arcane war machine would come with the exact complement of crew required to operate it — no more, no less.

These crew members are counted as Companions
objects.title: Hired Help

objects.text:
Some Objects of Power demand more than simple possession; they require skill, focus, and control. A magic sword is useless in the hands of someone who doesn’t know how to wield a blade. A spellbook full of complex runes means little to a reader who cannot channel energy safely. Even when one has the right body or mind, without the training to use the OoP properly, its true power remains out of reach.

With this, you gain exactly what you need to use the Object of Power effectively, nothing more, nothing less. If the OoP requires strength, then you get the physical conditioning, muscle memory, or experience needed to handle it correctly. If the OoP requires knowledge and understanding to follow its instructions and interpret its subjects, then that knowledge will be given to you, limited strictly to what is required to operate that specific OoP.

This only ever grants what you could realistically gain through physical experience or practiced skill, not magical power, energy, or supernatural talent. You become capable of using the Object of Power properly, but you will be no stronger, faster, or wiser than that minimal threshold requires.
objects.title: Trained

objects.text: You may, per purchase, select one Object of Power and one thematically similar item from the Equipment and Items section that you have already purchased. The Object and Item are now considered one and the same, having the benefits of both. For example, you may fuse your Tutorial Gear with your Tinkertech Armor, granting it better protective properties, additional functions like generating a shield or strength enhancement, and the benefits of whatever Tinker or Technology and Artifice powers you have, all while still being better at absorbing damage, granting minor access to the local power system, and being self repairing if you hate doing maintenence. Or maybe you instead fused an Object upgraded with Made It Myself with a purchase of Mega Project, boosting the power of your chosen Object far beyond the casual level of your Tinker Powers. Instead, it would be at the theoretical peak of what you can make, thus resulting in even a basic Enchanted Sword at minimum being able to challenge an Endbringer. Note: The Object and Item chosen are permanently fused together, being retroactively considered one and the same. If you possess Fission, you may undo this fusion at any time, with the benefit of your Item still being considered an Object of Power as far as any Powers or OoP Upgrades are concerned.
objects.title: Items of Power

objects.text: You may choose for any of your Objects to be 'Adapted' into a version of itself made in another setting. They will function largely the same or at least as close to it as the new setting could make something like it, but the underlying mechanics behind how it works will be changed to suit the new setting's tech tree and metaphysics / supernatural systems. Great for if you want to streamline your potential power systems, or if you wish to get an Object but don't want to deal with the implications of using something from a particular setting like Warhammer: 40k or the SCP Foundation. For example, you could make a D&D Magical Object manifest its effects via Ethernano Magic instead of Weave Magic via Adapting it to Fairy Tail. You could make DxD Excalibur a Mystic Code or Noble Phantasm by Adapting it to a version of itself forged in the Nasuverse, though it wouldn't suddenly become the True Excalibur, the Last Phantasm. You could make the Golden Elixir and its granted power of Cultivation instead a nanomachine slurry that uses hypertech to slowly refine your body and awaken psychic powers with no theoretical upper limit by Adapting from 'Generic Xianxia' to 'Generic Space Opera'. Or maybe your Citadel doesn't run on eezo tech, but instead runs on magitech, and any biotics on the station are instead magic adepts. The possibilities are limitless. Note: No matter what, the overall base power level of your Objects will remain roughly the same post Adaptation. However, this can change the potential ceiling on growth possible with certain Objects if they are switched to a higher scale setting. Of course, this can do the opposite too, so pick your Adaptations carefully.
objects.title: Alternate Setting Adaptation

addons.text: Now your knowledge, skill, focus, and control also expand and evolve with the bond and understanding you have with your OoPs. For example, this will allow you to learn how to perform high level maneuvers on your starship or even create a new sword-fighting art perfectly suited for your cold weapon.
addons.title: The Perfect Wielder

objects.text:
“Hey, you! Yes, you, Mister or Missus Average. Do you want to be special? Then come and become a vessel of a greater power!”

Instead of merely gaining your Objects of Power (OoPs) and worrying about whether you can use them, your body, mind, and soul will be transformed into a suitable vessel for them. If your magic staff requires you to be able to use magic, then you gain the ability to use either the magic system of the world you are in or a generic magic system if magic does not exist in the world you are in. If a weapon is too heavy to be properly used by your body, then the body would be changed so that you can wield it.

This has some limitations, of course. How strong these “Vessel”-ness traits you get depends on how strong a bond and understanding you have with your OoPs. Initially, you are at the lowest level, gaining only the baseline required to ensure you can use the OoPs. After that, the more you use the OoPs, understand how they work, and become more skilled with them, the better your body is moulded to be able to use them. For example, the more you use a sword, the better your body's muscles fit to use it, or the more you use the magic staff, the more magically powerful you become. These traits are also highly specialized for these OoPs and may not work as well with others, if at all.
objects.title: I Am Worthy!

objects.text: Anything you create now counts as an Object of Power, benefiting from any and all upgrades that would've affected it should you have purchased the item in the CYOA.
objects.title: Creations of Power

objects.text: Now, all the generic OOP Upgrades apply to any Item bought in the CYOA, anything obtained through your powers, like summoning, and all your legal possessions.
objects.title: Possessions of Power

objects.text:
Consumable Objects of Power you purchase will now restock themselves when used after a period of time (in days) equal to the square of their SP cost.

This does not affect objects which already include a method of replenishment.
objects.title: Restock

objects.text: Each purchase reduces the wait for Restock by 5 days, but cannot reduce it below 7 days.
objects.title: Faster Delivery

objects.text:
Your OoPs have been covered in a thin electro-magnetic protective layer that defends them from EMP pulses and other general deactivation strikes. 

This does not protect from Technopaths or make the item any more durable.
objects.title: EMP Protective Coating

objects.text: You can now instantly teleport to anywhere inside any of your Property or Vehicle Objects of Powers. While this works over any distance there will be a cooldown that scales with distance. Minimum cooldown is five minutes and maximum is 24 hours.
objects.title: Fast Travel

objects.text: Magik is fully linked with your Magitek Planisphere. The range of spells you can cast expands greatly and their power increases as well though they will still be limited compared to more fleshed out magic systems. The greatest boon comes in the ability to create more powerful spells that can only be used through cards. Your reserve increases by half and can be trained but no longer combines with other magic traditions.
objects.title: Celestial Opposition

objects.text: Kanai's Cube and the Evolution Cube have fused together, forming something greater than its constituents, longer having a set form or shape, you are able to pull the Alchemist's Tesseract into yourself, binding it to you using it's own power of transmutation. All diminishing returns cease to exist, as there is always something to improve. You may insert items into the Tesseract's spatial pocket, allowing them to passively grow into legendary items at no cost. Non-Legendary items can now be broken down for their powers. Legendary items now grant you an added bonus on top of its base power, these bonuses could be anything, with multiplicative damage multipliers and flat damage resistances being easy possibilities. All powers granted from breaking down artifacts evolve over time, growing stronger in both strength and versatility over time. These growths can be increased with practice and experience
objects.title: Alchemist's Tesseract

addons.text:
Your Omnitrix has evolved, the Alien Order has taken in and fused with traits from the Human Order and become something entirely new, pushing its power to unimaginable and unprecedented heights.

With the ascended power of the Alien Order, only the strongest forces and attacks can hope to affect you, as anything less is effortlessly nullified. Beyond defense, you can extend your Order across a vast distance, reshaping the area and influencing every aspect within it. Only the most powerful beings may resist your dominion, and even they will not escape its influence unscathed. 

And even if an attack were to connect, your true death remains impossible unless the Human Order, the Alien Order, and the millions of species and forms encoded within your Omnitrix are all destroyed simultaneously. Only then can Death claim you. So long as even a single fragment endures—no matter how small—you will instantly regenerate, fully restored from all harm and damage, along with the Human and Alien Orders, and every species housed within your Omnitrix.

The millions of species within your Omnitrix have ascended into True Archetypes, entities that embody the will of their homeworlds and yet remain independent from it thanks to the Omnitrix. This transformation increases each alien's powers, elevating even the weakest among them to a level capable of threatening, and even devastating, a world. Every alien now possesses a distinct, specific ability, deeply rooted in their culture, species traits, and planetary essence. This power stands on par with Arcueid’s Event Storage and Kukulkan’s Kinich Ahau Impact.

Your ability to influence species and civilizations has reached unprecedented heights. Within a single human lifetime, you can guide a primitive, tribal society, one that has only just discovered fire, into becoming a spacefaring civilization equipped with faster-than-light travel and advanced technologies. If you choose to remain, your influence can exponentially push their development even further.

Even if you leave the planet, your presence leaves an indelible mark. The species you touch instinctively gain the knowledge to grow, evolve, and live in harmony on their own. In time, they will rise, reach beyond their world, and journey towards the stars, becoming beacons of hope, guiding other civilizations to reach for the cosmos and coexist.

Finally, you can push your aliens to their ultimate potential by using the Omnitrix’s Evolutionary Function. This allows them to ascend into their final form, a TYPE, the strongest life form of their homeworld. In this evolved state, every ability and attribute is amplified to unimaginable levels. Even the weakest alien can effortlessly obliterate entire planets, reshape and permanently alter their environment to mirror their native worlds, become immune to concepts such as death and damage, and bend the very laws of reality to their advantage. Linked directly with the Evolutionary Function, these beings can constantly adapt, evolving on the fly to overcome any threat or situation. This should not be used lightly, as while you can control these forms, the sheer devastation and damage that even the weakest alien can cause could permanently alter a planet’s landscape, or worse.

Your Omnitrix is no longer just a tool—it is a catalyst for growth, evolution, and unity across the cosmos. Through your efforts, countless species can rise, civilizations could flourish, and the spark of life could spread far beyond its origins. Even when you depart, your influence endures, inspiring harmony and advancement among those you’ve touched and beyond. You have become an eternal beacon guiding the universe and its people toward its next great evolution.
addons.title: We Shall Forever Exist, Cousin

objects.text:
The Omnitrix, in its most basic form, is an archive, an Ark, of DNA from millions of alien species that allows the wearer to transform into them. Both a means to foster understanding and proof that these beings existed even after they've been wiped from the universe.

And this aspect of the Omnitrix has melded with your own nature as the Composite Human and Mystery Slayer, and through them, your connection with Human Order, to allow for something greater to take form.

Through the collective knowledge, experience and being the apex of these species, your Alien Transformations become Pseudo Archetypes. Pseudo Archetypes can be considered as Incomplete or False Archetypes, contenders for the position of Archetype if they were on their native home (which includes beings such as Gods), but for one reason or another would not be made into the Celestial Body's Ultimate One.

Carrying the weight of not just the history of a species but one who have left their cradle worlds to journey across the stars, even if a particular species recorded in the Omnitrix has yet to achieve this feat, they will be considered as such in regards to your transformation.

In simple terms, your transformations are now hundreds of times stronger than they were before, with new exoteric abilities that complement them and represent moments of their history and achievements as they have gained a connection to the respective species' own version of Human Order, collectively referred to as Alien Order.

With Alien Order and Human Order, you can resist aspects of reality around you and bypass the local laws of the reality you find yourself in. Forced conversion and any sort of alteration are nullified, with you being able to counter such directed attacks back upon the source, weakening and allowing your own Order to take root around you.

But it's not just power and knowledge that comes with this but Understanding and Compromise as through this new vast archive of reference material you instinctually understand to help other species reach the level needed to be ready to travel the stars under their own power; from giving them an encouraging pep talk to identifying a possible unknown factors you understand how to show the way and clearing the path forward for them, however they must be the ones to reach the stars under their own power.

Along with this, you know how to foster peace between different groups to at minimal reach a peaceful coexistence; however, such outcomes are not always possible or ideal if one group can't or won't act in good faith.

Finally; any DNA sample you come across or possess will be made into the most ideal version of itself even if the DNA is corrupted or damaged through whatever means and through this you can heal species who have been mutated or degraded by knowing what they were before as you have the full history of the DNA itself along with pre-evolve version of the pre-evolved version of the species.

Given a few hours of prep to build up the charge needed, you can bring back any species from total extinction so long as their DNA is in the Omnitrix (which includes whatever species you are). These new beings will be members of said species resurrected with the knowledge and culture of their people(s) within their minds for easy access, allowing them to start again and once more sail across the stars.

Through this, you have become more than a hero or a peacemaker; you are a living Testament to countless lives and of Life itself. A living promise and message, for even if they shall never have met, a message can be shared: "We Exist(ed)"
objects.title: We Exist(ed), Cousin.

addons.text:
The Fleet of Fog, despite its technological advantage and invincibility, requires a massive supply of huge volumes of high-tech materials, spare parts, consumables and ammunition.

This provides the Fleet of Fog with naval bases that not only allow ships to be based, but also provide production of everything necessary for the supply, repair and construction of Fleet of Fog ships. 

A full production cycle. Starting from resource extraction and ending with the construction of ships, guarantees the independence and combat readiness of the fleet in the future.

The base itself usually looks like a giant floating city with high panels in the center, where there is also a high multi-kilometer spire (optionally, it can be an orbital elevator). There are basic defense and protection systems, but the main defense functions should be assigned to the ships of the Fleet of Fog.

Each of the 13 fleets receives one such base and 2 more small supply bases, capable of repairing and restoring individual squadrons.

With the support of such a base, each individual fleet will be able to quickly replenish losses and fight with the entire world.
addons.title: Fleet of Fog Bases

addons.text: The upgraded Fog Battleship acquired through Flight of Fog or Eternal Fleet of Fog has provided a template for your Fog Fleet to enhance itself. This overhauls your Fleet of Fog to be more in line with your own ship, albeit scaled towards their purpose, with lighter ships possessing lesser capabilities. Additionally, if you possess Iokath and Fleet of Fog Bases then Iokath’s capabilities expand to become a sort of super Fog naval base, possessing all the capabilities of a Fog Base and more, scaled up to suit the power of Iokath’s other capabilities.
addons.title: Fleet of Fog 2.0

addons.text:
Your Fog Fleet has undergone a major upgrade and has been significantly improved. Now, each flagship of the 13 fleets is a Geiersburg-Class Fog Space Fortress.

In addition, the size of each fleet has increased to 12,000 ships, maintaining the previous class proportions (approximately 900 battleships, about 2,700 heavy cruisers, 8,400 light Fog ships, and 600 Assault and Suppression ships, which are again separated). In addition to increasing the number of ships, you can adapt them to the appearance characteristic of Legend of The Galactic Heroes, or increase their displacement by 200-400 times without changing their appearance.
addons.title: Armada of Fog Fortresses

objects.text:
The entire might of the Fleet of Fog is at your disposal, with your Yamato-class ship becoming the supreme flagship.

Initially, the arriving fleet will consist of 13 fleets, each of which can be divided into several additional fleets, which in turn consist of 1-3 battleships, 3-9 heavy cruisers, 9-27 light cruisers, as well as supply, support and reconnaissance ships.

A separate line includes the "Assault and Suppression vessel" ships, which are equipped with the most destructive weapons and the strongest armor, which serve as heavy artillery platforms. However, they were previously aircraft carriers and presumably 2 such ships will be allocated to each fleet.

Each ship will be an external copy of a ship that existed during World War II, but armed with high-tech weapons and armor.

All ships are connected and have access to the Joint Tactical Network, which allows them to exchange and stores large amounts of information and experience. The Joint Tactical Network is built on quantum communication protocols and communication will not be affected by factors such as distance and some interference. Only an extraordinary event in multidimensional space can cause a communication failure, but even in this case, ships with sufficient computing power will be able to receive and send messages. If necessary, ships can be excluded from the network.

Parallel fleet services form supply ships and repair ships, which are also subordinate to the fleet flagships.
objects.title: Fleet of Fog (Arpeggio of Blue Steel)

objects.text:
You have followed in the Chosen of the Dead Three’s footsteps.
 
You have gained control over an elder brain—no easy feat. With your control, you can force the brain to spawn more tadpoles. Through the Netherestones, the Elder Brain has evolved past its previous limitations, holding a vast psychic might that puts it above normal Elder Brains. Furthermore, the elder brain no longer has a limit to the range in which it can control those affected by ceremorphosis.

Perhaps through this evolution, the Netherbrain has regained the knowledge that the Ilithid Empire once had, as within it holds a lost understanding of technology that the Ilithid Empire once used to conquer the galaxy.

By magically examining the crown, you have removed the weakness of the Netherstones and instead turned it into an advantage. So long as the crow retains the Netherestones, you have gained a fraction of the divine power the Dead Three lent to their chosen.

Through the stone that Kethric once wielded, you have gained insight into the domain of death and, in time, become capable of seizing the domain, in addition to the ability to be invulnerable to damage for as long as the elder brain still lives.

Through the stone that Orin wields, you gain insight into the domain of murder as well as the ability to kill that which cannot be killed.

Through the Netherstone that Gortash once employed, you have gained insight into the domain of tyranny and the ability to control the minds of others to a greater degree, even those with immunity.
objects.title: The Absolute (Baldur's Gate 3)

objects.text:
Using concentrated Omni-Energy collected over a 24hr period, the Omnitrix applies its enhanced scanner & database to project an energy field with a radius ranging from 1m - 5km.

In this dome, you can target any sentient being for transformation into a hybrid by forcing their base Lifeform Template into a hyper-malleable state & shooting a directed burst of Omni-Energy to incorporate the chosen DNA sample.

By default, this combines all targets with a single selected DNA sample, however it is possible to set an individual alien per target - manually or by using the onboard V.I. to assign the most compatible species to each mark in range.

This can also be extended to mutant, hybrid, or contaminated forms logged within the improved database.

Know that they aren't full aliens & retain most of their base DNA - their alien powers are somewhat weaker while experiencing fewer/reduced racial drawbacks.

Any innate powers a target may have remain mostly intact, though ones dependent on bloodlines/biomass/adaptations may suffer.

The field also lets the wielder mix up to 11 different forms temporarily into their own DNA, imitating Kevin Levin's amalgam forms, only maintainable thanks to the Omnitrix regulating the user's genetic stability - therefore preserving their sanity.

However, the more samples used, the shorter the timer for the sake of the user's health.

Finally, any transformations are semi-permanent, meaning they can become permanent after 72hrs, but they can be restored via the DNA repair feature.
objects.title: Omni-Enhancer Field

objects.text:
The Kelvin Stone, the Centripetal Accelerator, the Alpha Rune, and the Perplexahedron’s Crown—each a formidable artifact in its own right. Yet, scattered across the fabric of reality, these four objects are more than meets the eye; they are the pieces of the Map of Infinity.

When brought together, these fragments form the shape of an infinity symbol split in four, retaining all the immense powers of each individual piece—and with the ability to separate them again at will.

The is a complete map of space and time itself, spanning every galaxy, era, dimension, and plane of existence. As long as you possess it, the artifact serves as your “All Access Pass,” granting you the knowledge and power to travel anywhere and anywhen—beyond protections, restrictions, and defences—without limitation.
objects.title: The Map of Infinity (Ben 10)

objects.text: The Map of Infinity is an enigmatic artifact whose true origins are unknown—until now, that is. Formed by The Architect at the dawn of creation, the Map reveals one last form—becoming a simple green book that can change its size at will and contains a near-infinite number of pages—and one last secret. The newly revealed Compleat Atlas of the House and Immediate Environs, while still retaining all the powers of its Map form, is a complete guide to the House and the Secondary Realms. Without the powers of one of the Keys to the Kingdom, the Atlas will refuse to open. With a Key in hand, it can provide answers to almost any question the user might ask about the House and the Secondary Realms, as it forms a complete record of the entirety of existence—a kind of backup—within its slim form. This book can never be forcefully taken from you; it will always reappear nearby unless you freely give it away.
objects.title: The Compleat Atlas of the House (The Keys to the Kingdom)

objects.text: With the four cardinal Dials reunited, H, C, Y, K. You can access the greatest Dial of them all. The impossible M-Dial!. The M-Dial, or Multiverse Dial cannot be combined with your other dials. The fact you have reunited the others merely allows you to visit it’s resting place. The M-Dial is capable of warping entire universes around the axes of itself. For instance, Robbie ‘Mr Thunderbolt’ Reed attempted to stop all tragedy from befalling the universe by dialing H, and giving every being in prime-earth a connection to the Heroverse. Like all Dials, it’s sensitive to intent, but it is still a massive force that you have little control over, and can have disastrous consequences. With custodianship of the Dial, a great responsibility now rests on your shoulders…
objects.title: M-Dial (DC Comics)

objects.text:
You have been given the Mask of Mantau! Developed by a past holder of the H-Dial, it is a blank mask and cowl that when worn obliterates the mental component of the H-Dial, allowing you to be fully cognisant and in control while it’s in use. However, this comes with a rather esoteric flaw.

When using the Mask in conjunction with the H-Dial, instead of creating connections to the Heroverse from nowhere, it hijacks the connections randomly. Somewhere, across the multiverse, the connection someone has to the Heroverse will be connected to you instead for the duration of the dial. This could cause untold chaos depending on what connection was grabbed within their world. but hey, out of sight...
objects.title: Mask of Manteau (DC Comics)

objects.text:
‘Legacy is more powerful than Gravity. Legacy can let you fly.'

The H-Dial has always been able to affect multiple people at a time as long as they’re actually touching the Dial. Now, you can recreate the transmissions of Mister Thunderbolt, and let the world join the dance. 

Functionally, this means you can broadcast the function of any H-Dial or H-Dial adjacent device you have access to to a thematically relevant device. The recipient only has to treat it in kind, for instance Dialing H(4) for Hero onto a mobile phone in order to activate it.

This grants you no control over the individual or their transformation, but it can be done over an entire city at once. That said, all of these transformations only last for a single hour at a time. Just be careful, you never know what someone will do either for, or with, a taste power…
objects.title: We The People (DC Comics)

objects.text:
“It started with just one of them. Each had their own manmade gimmick, but they were all blue-collar criminals. Salt-of-the-earth kinda guys. Alone they would commit a daring robbery in Central City... and I'd catch them every time. Then one day they had the idea to attack me all at once and call themselves... The Rogues!”

You gain all the costumes, equipment, and abilities—excluding their powers—of the Rogues, along with the knowledge necessary to understand, use, and replicate their technology.

Among the weapons and equipment you gain are Mirror Master's Gun, which allows you to travel through mirrors and other reflective surfaces and trap others within them; Weather Wizard's Weather Wand, which grants you control over the weather and the ability to create lightning, tornadoes, snowstorms, and other phenomena; and Trickster's gadgets, which include itching powder, potato-head-shaped bombs, explosive rubber chickens, sharp yo-yos, hard candies, and other prank-themed weapons, as well as a pair of shoes that allow you to fly for up to 10 hours.

Additionally, you can absorb the power of one of these weapons, allowing you to gain the metahuman abilities of its original owner. For example, if you choose Captain Cold's Cold Gun, you will gain the same ice powers he possessed at the time, allowing you to slow down people or high-speed objects through molecular deceleration caused by absolute zero.

Finally, you are free to transfer the weapons, costumes, and gadgets to others in order to form your own team of Rogues. Upon obtaining them, they gain the skills and identity of their former owners—becoming “legacy” villains, so to speak—and, if you allow it, they can also absorb the powers of the respective weapons they inherit. 

However, just like the original Rogues, this new group must follow the original Rogues' moral code:

- No killing: Civilians and police officers should not be killed unnecessarily. They would rather face robbery charges than spend the rest of their lives in prison for murder.

- No killing superheroes: You do not take a hero's life. If you cross that line, the reaction from the superhero community will be merciless, putting the entire group at risk.

- Do not harm women or children: This is an unforgivable offense, and breaking this rule results in exile or even execution by the group itself.

- Zero drugs: The use or trafficking of drugs is strictly prohibited. Captain Cold believed that vices cloud judgment, weaken discipline, and cause criminals to make fatal mistakes.

- Family does not betray or fight family: You must watch each other's backs, stay united, and never fight among yourselves.

- Unity of identity: No criminal may inherit the name or identity of another member of the Rogues while the original is still alive.

If they fail to follow these strict rules, they will lose their place in the group, along with all the weapons, equipment, items, and abilities you granted them—all of which will return to you.
objects.title: The Legacy of the Rogues (DC Comics)

objects.text:
Upon claiming The Witchblade and taking your place as ruler of Themyscira, the ancient bond between the weapon and its previous wielders awakens a forgotten covenant. Hidden by time and divine secrecy, all former bearers of the Witchblade—dating back centuries and across countless civilizations—have been granted refuge on Themyscira by the will of the gods and the artifact itself.

These women, each a powerful and battle-hardened warrior in their own right, were preserved in stasis or spirited away by the Witchblade upon their deaths or retirements. Now, under your reign, they live once more on Paradise Island. Each has been gifted her own personal Witchblade that is a lesser fragment drawn from the original, yet still immensely powerful. These Sister-Blades are sentient, fiercely loyal to their wielders, and bound to your command as their source.

The former hosts serve as elite champions, advisors, and protectors of Themyscira, creating a new order known as the Sisters of the Blade. Their knowledge of ancient wars, mystic threats, and supernatural realms now strengthens your rule, while their loyalty to the Witchblade ensures unwavering fealty to you.

Themyscira is no longer just home to the Amazons, it is now the stronghold of Witchblade’s legacy. With you at the center, the island thrives as a beacon of feminine might, mystical power, and eternal vigilance against the dark forces that seek to disrupt the balance of the world.
objects.title: Sisters of the Blade

addons.text:
Your T-Dolls have not only received enchanted weapons and armor, they have received weapons and armor at the limit of mortal enchantment, which significantly increases their capabilities and effectiveness.

In addition, your T-Dolls receive master skills in wielding the received weapons and equipment. If before a T-Doll could tear apart an armored person only by brute physical force, now the same can be achieved with quick, precise strikes to weakly protected places without serious physical pressure... And this does not take into account the enchantment of the blade, both before and now, which has become even better and will allow you to do the same with an opponent already in enchanted armor.

In addition to this, the T-Doll will receive an extensive base on palace etiquette and cultural behavior.
addons.title: The Valiant Doll Knight (Girls Frontline)

objects.text:
Somehow, your T-Dolls were armed and equipped with enchanted weapons and armor. Someone's joke or a lucky coincidence, but now your T-Dolls can focus on using the received weapons and armor in the same way as firearms, without losing the ability to handle modern weapons.

In accordance with the selected type of weapon and type of armor, the T-Doll will receive the corresponding skills in handling them. These will not be salon or court "dances" with weapons, but rather "soldier's" practical and pragmatic ways to cut / hack / stab your opponent in the simplest and most effective way.

Dummy Dolls will receive similar weapons and equipment.

As a bonus, T-Doll can get an adapted version of medieval or fantasy clothing, and also gets the opportunity to get a new profession of the corresponding era. It is permissible to use the style and equipment of the 15-16 centuries.
objects.title: T-Doll Knight (Girls Frontline)

addons.text:
Due to possessing a Pure Soul, you not only have an easier time manipulating and creating souls, but you also possess the ability to gain the personal and class skills of different Heroic Spirits. Initially, you will be limited to 3 class skills and 3 personal skills if they are A-rank.

If they are B-rank or lower, you can have access to six personal skills and four class skills.

Alternatively, due to the sheer quality of your Soul, you can also instead harness the power of a Heroic Spirit, granting you the ability to become a demi-servant. However, at the beginning, you are limited to one class the Heroic Spirit is qualified for at a time, but you can easily change classes should you wish.

If you have purchased Spiritual Ascendance, you will be able to have six A-rank personal and class skills, or be able to use the full power of a Heroic Spirit without the limits of any class.
addons.title: Heroic Soul

objects.text:
Your Sacred Gear has merged with your Holy Grail and became a unique sub-species of the Longinus Sacred Gear “Sephiroth Graal” which holds domain over the concepts of souls and life. The knowledge gained by tapping into the Holy Grail allowed the Sephiroth Graal to advance to further heights by gaining access to The Root and, by extension, the Throne of Heroes, splitting it into three different sacred gears similar to the subspecies possessed by Valerie Tepes, each grail controlling separate abilities and improving in power when used in unison.

The base ability of the Sephiroth Graal is manipulating and generating souls. Through this ability, the user can create or alter life, such as using the soul of a dragon to modify the species of another being into a dragon or remove the weakness of the race in question, such as a vampire's weakness to sunlight or running water. Additionally, the Grail is adept at bringing back the dead, no matter how long they have been deceased.

The user can summon the spirits of the long-dead by tapping into the Throne of Heroes, and the user can also summon Heroic Spirits from various classes and incarnate them fully, allowing them to access the power they possessed in their life, along with the boost provided by myths and legends. The summoned Servants are loyal to the user and serve to protect them from danger. The user can modify the Servants by manipulating the Saint Graph, granting them access to multiple classes simultaneously or replicating the grail mud used by Angra Mainyu, the Shadow.

The Holy Grail has enhanced its capacity to uncover knowledge by establishing a connection with The Root. This bond between the Sacred Gear and the Holy Grail has amplified the knowledge of The Root, enabling it to access the knowledge of the present world and update the information stored within The Root and the Throne of Heroes. This transfer of knowledge takes time to update, requiring you to stay in the universe for some time before fully updating.

Using the Sephiroth Graal does come with some drawbacks. If you are not careful, you can corrupt your soul. If you use its functions consistently, spamming the knowledge it grants on soul manipulation can corrupt. So long as it is used periodically between breaks, soul corruption can subside.
objects.title: Sephiroth Graal

objects.text: Your Sacred Gear has merged with the Summoner’s Staff and became a subspecies of the Longinus Sacred Gear “Annihilation Maker”, which holds dominion over Imagination and Productivity. Inside of this Sacred Gear resides the original Oneiroi, Morpheus, Phobetor, and Phantasos, who hold dominion over the Dream, the Nightmare, and the Fantasy respectively. The sons of Hypnos, Sleep Incarnate. Like the Valkyries of the Norse Faction, new blood has taken up the role in their stead. The base ability of Annihilation Maker is the creation and control of numerous creatures using the shadows that spread out from its user based on their imagination. As the factor determining the strength of these monsters, the more honed or otherwise potent the user’s imagination and productivity is, the more powerful the creations that arise from the user can be, even having abilities or powers of their own. At its mastered state, the user of this Sacred Gear could destroy a small country in a matter of hours, and potentially the world given enough time and effort. Your subspecies has this same ability, but due to the Summoner’s Staff considering more than just creatures and monsters to be ‘summons’, the limitations of Annihilation Maker have loosened. Any of your creations (if they weren’t already) now count as summons, receiving the boost the staff normally gives. You can manifest anything that could reasonably be a ‘summon’, from familiars, projections, or even beings that need contracts or a source of energy to manifest and/or stay in the material plane, such as Heroic Spirits. You can also use your own shadow (not the ones you generate via Annihilation Maker) to store any creations you’ve summoned, provided that they can fit inside it. However, these creations, while intelligent, are not sapient, even if they seem to exhibit that trait. Summoning too many creations at once or attempting to create a summon that is too powerful for you to handle will put strain on you, causing a fair amount of pain, eventually knocking you out and dismissing whatever was being created in the process. At the base form of this Sacred Gear, creating sapient life is impossible, even with full mastery over the basic ability. The highlight of this fusion, however, is Annihilation Maker’s new Balance Breaker. Originally, this allowed for the creation of ‘Anti-Monsters’, creatures that are created for the sole purpose of defeating certain species or races, such as Devils, Dragons, Gods, or Angels. These Anti-Monsters are highly resistant to the abilities of the race they specialize in, and are able to regenerate wounds incurred upon them after a short time. You have access to this Balance Breaker, along with the new Balance Breaker that your subspecies has developed. The Balance Breaker of this subspecies, ‘Genesis Immaterium’, allows for the once-per-usage creation and realization of true sapient life, at the cost of intense exhaustion—both magical and physical—for varying degrees of time, depending on how powerful the result was, and being unable to access either Balance Breaker until you fully recover from it. These creations, still under your authority as your summons, harbor ironclad loyalty to you. With this ability, you could theoretically create a God, provided that you have the sufficient magical energy and mastery over your Balance Breaker to do so. Even then, this will be extremely difficult. The design process requires intense focus and a most experienced sense of imagination to pull off successfully. Any incorrections or flaws made during the process will be carried over. This process can be cancelled before completion, but will exhaust you far more than what you would normally be if you succeeded. Dismissing a sapient being created by you is impossible, you must either absorb them into your own shadow or kill them.
objects.title: Annihilation Maker

objects.text:
The Dragon Pieces are an evolved and mutated form of the standard Evil Pieces, altered by the immense draconic power of their wielder. Instead of reincarnating a being into a devil, these pieces reincarnate the target into a half-dragon. This transformation grants the target the formidable traits and abilities of dragons while bypassing the traditional weaknesses of devils.

When used, these pieces reincarnate a being into a half-dragon instead of a devil. The reincarnated individual gains draconic traits, including heightened strength, durability, magical potential, and longevity. Their physiology adapts with dragon-like features—scales, claws, enhanced senses, and potential for a breath weapon. Traditional devil weaknesses are replaced by draconic traits. However, they retain the dragon's reversed scale weakness and hoarding instincts, which can be honed or controlled with experience. Additionally, the reincarnated gain weaker versions of the core draconic abilities, including Outrage, Immortality, and Dragon Gate. These abilities function at a diminished capacity compared to true dragons but can be trained and refined over time.

Each piece grants unique draconic traits in addition to their base powers. The Queen grants mastery over all draconic abilities, including advanced magic, superior physical prowess, and devastating breath weapons. It also enhances leadership instincts, tactical thinking, and provides an aura of command that bolsters nearby allies. The Rooks bestow immense draconic durability and strength, along with reinforced scales that are nearly impervious to physical and magical damage. They can generate localized energy shields and possess earth-shattering power in close combat. The Bishops amplify magical abilities to their peak, granting mastery over multiple elements, enhanced magical regeneration, and the ability to manipulate draconic energies for unique spellcraft. The Knights grant unparalleled speed, agility, and reflexes, as well as enhanced predatory instincts, aerial superiority, and the ability to perform devastating ambush attacks. The Pawns possess exceptional adaptability, with the ability to rapidly evolve in combat, enhancing their traits based on enemy weaknesses. When in enemy territory, they can permanently promote into other piece types, gaining all associated abilities.

The reincarnated individuals develop an instinctive attachment to the wielder's hoard, valuing and protecting it as if it were their own. Loyalty and bond strength can influence power boosts during battle, especially when defending their hoard or king. The strength of the potential recruit must still be evaluated, and particularly powerful beings may require multiple or mutated pieces. Recently deceased beings can be reincarnated as long as their soul is intact and willing. Exposure to draconic energy allows pieces to mutate further, potentially reducing the number of pieces required to reincarnate a powerful being or granting unique hybrid abilities, such as mixing elemental affinities. Reincarnated half-dragons can choose their growth path, focusing on physical prowess, magical mastery, or refining a unique draconic ability. Encouraging the honing of innate draconic instincts can lead to the evolution of stronger, more specialized traits.

The Dragon Pieces are a reflection of the wielder's power, and as such, they can evolve further based on the wielder's growth and hoard. Their influence is potent, making their bearer a formidable leader of a loyal and powerful draconic peerage.
objects.title: Dragon Pieces

objects.text: Typically the Omnitrix tends to not handle magic well, now however? It can transform the user into magical beings, using their nearest DNA equivalent. It’s interaction with your Grimoire has also unlocked a special hidden playlist of 10 Elemental Warriors from deep within it. First is Pummel Weed, a living plant resembling a Venus flytrap is skilled in an art resembling boxing, and capable of burrowing through the ground at high speed. The leaves on his body have spikey thorns to deter attackers, and deal more damage. Second is Rubble an Elemental Warrior who’s body is made up of a pile of spiked rocks. Rubble can shoot these at targets in a variety of ways. Third is Ash who takes the form of a relatively small red dragon with wings that allow him to glide but not fly. Ash fights with his firey breath, in blasts and streams of various sizes Fourth is Major Ruin an armadillo-like creature with a spikey shell, Major Ruin curls into a ball, and travels at high speeds to impact his target Fifth is Deep Blue an aquatic looking creature with tentacles for a lower body, and cannons for arms. Deep Blue can fire an endless stream of water from his cannons, to damage enemies, and propel himself. Generation of mobile whirlpools, and slicks of ink are also among this Warrior’s capabilities. Sixth is Chilla a big, bulky Yeti-like creature with spikes of ice emerging from his back. This Warrior generates ice in many forms, particularly to slings spikes of ice with high accuracy, and is capable of climbing nearly any surface Seventh is Flex is thin blue creature with four elastic tendril arms, and two eye stalks atop a mouth that is the largest part of their body. Flex specializes in grappling, able to grab targets from far away and drag them—or himself—closer, this also allows flex to rapidly travel around. Eighth is 40 Below appearing as a large snow golem creature with a snowball instead of legs. This creature has a powerful Ice Breath, and generates ice in it’s wake. Ninth is Snare is a plant creature with vicious jaws able to bite through even steel. Snare’s saliva is toxic, acidic and poisonous, and Snare can spit with extreme accuracy. Lastly Snare can send his roots through the ground to hinder and harm his targets further. Tenth is Thermite a small, red, ant-like creature carrying a rocky cauldron full of lava. Thermite can emit this lava in a variety of strengths and techniques to annihilate his targets.
objects.title: The Wotnot (Kameo: Elements of Power)

addons.text: Due to your knowledge of the two systems of magic that lay the foundation of Kingdom Hearts, you are able to create an improved form of the Medals used during the Age of Fairytales. Instead of merely allowing your apprentices to borrow power, these Medals can help them learn and master that power, acting as training wheels to further hone their skills. As you and they go on adventures and live your lives, new Medals will manifest, representing these moments— with the bonds made along the way ensuring that both they and you continue to grow stronger, their hearts glowing brighter each day as the time your apprentices become fully realized Keyblade Wielders seems to grow ever closer.
addons.title: New and Improved

addons.text:
Due to your Dream Mastery, you have been able to bring back the Chirithy of your apprentices. Chirithy is the name of a species of Dream Eaters to which they all respond—creatures who were charged with overseeing the progress of the Keyblade Wielders and offering guidance. Should their Keyblade Wielder cease to be, their Chirithy would soon follow.

Optionally, you can give your apprentices an additional Dream Eater to act as a personal pet and companion in battle. The appearance of these Dream Eater pets would be up to each individual apprentice.
addons.title: Old Snugly Friend

addons.text:
Daybreak Town undergoes a massive expansion as Scala Ad Caelum is added to the Pocket Dimension. Whether it merges with Daybreak Town or stands as a separate city is up to you to decide.

As a result of this, the upper limits on the number of apprentices have doubled, along with the number of Kingsguard you can have at once.
addons.title: Scala Ad Caelum

objects.text:
You have gained your own Keyblade-wielding Apprentices; however, they all share the same tragic fairytale. Your new apprentices come from a previous age known as the Age of Fairytales, where they were among the countless young Hearts who joined one of the Five Unions of the Foretellers in order to protect the world from Darkness and gather Lux (Light). However, it all came crashing down as mistrust and greed caused friends to turn their weapons upon each other, as their former Masters led them into what would become known as the Keyblade War. They joined to be heroes, but in the end were little more than pawns and child soldiers in another's plan that ended their reality— with only the Light in the hearts of the few survivors being able to create a new one.

Your apprentices recognize you as their new Master and their saviour from grim fates (the details of which are up to you). All past grudges between them are gone, as well as any loyalty they would have had to the Foretellers, as they now recognize you as their true Keyblade Master. While they have plenty of battle experience, they actually know very few techniques beyond the absolute basics. The reason is that they used items known as Medals that allowed them to perform more advanced techniques without actually being taught by the Foretellers. So you will need to teach them properly, as the use of Medals became a crutch for them.

To help with that, you gain a Pocket Dimension containing an exact copy of Daybreak Town, where you and your new apprentices can live and train, with all you need for comfortable living and no shortage of customs to mix and match. This Pocket Dimension is totally secure, with the only way in being with a Keyblade.

You also gain all the outfits that were available to your apprentices, including armours and a Black Coat able to protect you from Darkness, and you can give out copies of these outfits to others with a mere thought—handy if you want to surprise people with new clothes or give someone armour in a pinch.

Optionally, you can choose to double the number of employees that work for you and have these new employees work exclusively with your new apprentices to help them recover from being child soldiers.

As for how many apprentices you can gain, the upper limit depends on the size of your organization. The upper limits are:

- Small = 50 Keyblade Apprentices
- Medium = 350 Keyblade Apprentices
- Big = 1,000 Keyblade Apprentices
- Foundation = 2,000,000 Keyblade Apprentices

Note: Should you have any other organizations under your control, you can have these Keyblade wielders already be a part of them and gain whatever benefits from it.
objects.title: Re:Union X

addons.text:
Drive forms use the power of allies to power its transformations and you have the greatest ally of all, Kingdom Hearts. 

As such, you have gained access to the Universal Drive Form. This form represents the collective skills of every soul that has ever passed through Kingdom Hearts. Because of this, Universal Form boosts not just you physical and magical abilities but every aspect of your powers, including your skills and knowledge of other powers selected here.
addons.title: Universal Form

addons.text:
Your connection to a massive repository of souls has mutated. Kingdom Hearts now is not just a collection of souls but an afterlife of an entire multiverse. 

As such, you have become the personification of the afterlife with every soul dying in the entire local multiverse going to your Kingdom Hearts. Furthermore, using your shades you can borrow the skills, knowledge, and power of any being that ever died and went to Kingdom Hearts. Now the only limit to your power is that your Kingdom Hearts is limited to the local multiverse.
addons.title: God Of The Afterlife

addons.text:
Your ability to use Kingdom Hearts has spread to every Keyblade master in your team. Now every Keyblade master has a X-Blade of their own. Each X-Blade is stylized to most represent the core aspects and character of the person who wields it. 

In addition each user of the Keyblade can separate themselves into pieces, each an identical full body copy of the original. 13 pieces of darkness if they are a villain or 7 pieces of light if they are a hero. All of these pieces can be controlled with perfect coordination as they are the same Heart, just spread across different bodies.
addons.title: All For One And One For All

objects.text: The X-Blade (“Chi-Blade”) is an ultimate weapon personifying light and darkness. While an ordinary Keyblade is said to be made from the heart of a single being and all those they connect with, the X-blade is forged from the might of Kingdom Hearts, the collective soul of an entire Multiverse. This immense power made the X-Blade a coveted artifact, so much so that a prophecy that it would be forged started the Keyblade War, which both forged and shattered the blade. Reforged using seven pieces of light and thirteen pieces of darkness, the X-Blade stands as a weapon without equal in its home multiverse. While very little is known about the X-Blade, legend says it wields the might of entire worlds and is capable of restarting the entirety of its home multiverse, although whether this is true—or whether such power would function outside its own reality—remains a mystery. The X-Blade’s name is said to reflects the meanings of “X” (Chi): “death” and “spelling endings”. It is believed to fully embody these concepts according to one of the rare beings who has held its might in their hands. Wield with Absolute Caution The X-Blade’s true reach and limitations are unknown.
objects.title: X-Blade (Kingdom Hearts)

addons.text:
All the pieces come together. Raiden Ei, her puppet Shogun, and the sword Musou Isshin.

Raiden Ei is not only a god, but is a formidable warrior and leader who won the Archon War and defeated many other deities and comparable beings. Shogun, a puppet with its own consciousness and will, designed to resist erosion and capable of confronting Raiden Ei in battle. The Musou Isshin sword, created by the divine power of Ei's deceased sister, Makoto, and which carries a piece of her will.

Combined together, they achieve the full comprehensive power and strength they have ever possessed, fully corresponding to all titles and will allow them to lead the nation to a great goal. Her Eternal Excellency. Shogun of Inazuma. God of Eternity.
addons.title: Great and Excellent Ogosho, the Almighty Shogun (Genshin Impact)

objects.text:
Your doll ascends to "Shogun", a puppet created by Raiden Ei to resist erosion.

Shogun has her own consciousness and wields the Musou Isshin sword, thus inheriting the power of Raiden Shogun Ei. She will never doubt, never fear, and will always try her best to achieve her goals without being distracted by worries or idle thoughts.

"Mine is the most supreme and noble form. Power over the realm has been vested within me, and I am the essence of all that is the Raiden Shogun."

Magatsu Mitake Narukami no Makoto is a form that Shogun can take, which allows her to continuously absorb supernatural energy, produce various deadly attacks, and allows her to have a shield that blocks all damage in close combat and gain greater resistance to damage.

The most powerful attack "Eye of Stormy Judgement" can temporarily freeze targets and lead to instant death regardless of defense and any characteristics.
objects.title: The Shogun (Genshin Impact)

objects.text:
Your Ancient Name has evolved beyond merely recording your deeds, knowledge, powers, and legacy. The weight of everything you accomplish can now crystallize into Ancient Titles: metaphysical epithets representing what you have proven yourself to be. Where an Ancient Name records who you are, an Ancient Title declares what you have become.
