Ancient Titles cannot simply be chosen or claimed. They are earned through genuine deeds, achievements, reputation, experiences, and the meaning others attribute to you. Slaying a vampire might earn Vampire Slayer, while hunting countless creatures across worlds could eventually produce something far greater. The more extraordinary, consistent, and meaningful your accomplishments become, the more powerful and profound the resulting Title may be.

Every Title grants abilities corresponding to its meaning. These are no longer limited to simple increases in strength or affinity. Vampire Slayer might reveal vampiric weaknesses, strengthen attacks against vampires, resist their supernatural abilities, and make tracking them instinctive. The Eternal Hunter could grant supernatural tracking, heightened predatory instincts, mastery of hunting techniques, resistance to attempts by prey to escape or hide, and other abilities naturally encompassed by the Title. More specific or prestigious Titles possess greater authority within what they represent.

There is no limit to how many Titles you may possess or have active simultaneously. Their abilities freely function alongside one another, and Titles whose meanings overlap can stack, compound, and reinforce their effects. Dragon Slayer, Wyrm Hunter, and Dragonbane, for example, would each provide their own benefits against dragons while their shared aspects compound together, making you considerably more effective than any individual Title would allow. There is no diminishing return simply because several Titles affect the same thing; legitimately earned legends strengthen one another.

Titles can also grow alongside your legend. Related Titles, accomplishments, and meanings may evolve or combine into greater Ancient Titles when your deeds justify it without erasing what came before. Previous abilities, accomplishments, and meanings remain yours, allowing their effects to continue stacking with the greater Title wherever they overlap. There is no predetermined endpoint to this process, allowing your collection of Ancient Titles to continuously expand and evolve alongside your legend.

Your Ancient Name serves as the foundation of this system. Everything preserved within its archive—including the deeds, knowledge, experiences, powers, skills, and legends of its bearers—may contribute toward the creation and evolution of Ancient Titles. In return, every accomplishment performed beneath an Ancient Title becomes part of the Ancient Name's growing legacy. Name and Title therefore continuously strengthen one another, with the Name preserving your history while the Title gives that history meaning.

Your legends can also follow you between worlds. When entering somewhere unfamiliar with you, you may allow appropriate traces of your established Titles and accomplishments to appear naturally within its history and culture. Myths, stories, songs, statues, paintings, records, folklore, and similar remnants may exist as though your legend had always found some way to reach that world. These changes remain subtle and cannot grant possessions, political authority, relationships, or accomplishments you never actually earned.

A legitimately earned Title can never truly be lost. Lesser epithets may remain independent, evolve, combine with others, or become incorporated into greater Ancient Titles while retaining their accumulated benefits. You may freely activate or suppress any number of Titles individually, allowing you to embody as many or as few aspects of your legend as you desire.

At their greatest heights, Ancient Titles may become so profound that their bearer is regarded as virtually synonymous with what they represent. The Living Concept of War, for example, could grant extraordinary affinity, power, knowledge, and authority concerning warfare after a sufficiently legendary history of battle and conflict. However, an Ancient Title remains an expression of your accumulated legend rather than true divinity or conceptual embodiment. There remains one final boundary between being recognized as the embodiment of something and truly becoming that which your Name represents.
objects.title: Ancient Title

addons.text: Now you possess the infamous achievement of Professor Ivo—his specialized Absorption Cell technology used to create the notorious AMAZO. Encapsulated into a nanite form, this grants you access to the newest addition to the Meta-Nanites: the Red Nanite. The Red Nanite manages Powers At 20% it allows you to replicate the powers and skills of anyone within your vicinity, you lose access to these powers once the original owner leaves your vicinity, and can only use one at a time. At 100% you can permanently replicate the powers of anyone who enters your vicinity, and use multiple powers at the same time. At this level you can also nullify the powers of those who enter your range.
addons.title: Red Nanite

addons.text: Your ability to merge magic with technology has allowed you to emulate and control the magical and spiritual through it like the other nanites do natural phenomena. This has crystallised into nanite-form as The Black nanite. The Black nanite manages magic. At 20% it allows you to perceive magical effects and replicate them, incorporate magic into any of your creations, and warp magical effects in your vecinity. At 100% you can cast the greatest spells of a generation repeatedly and at will, create sources of infinite mana, nullify all magic in an area and even destroy souls with ease.
addons.title: Black Nanite

addons.text: Your understanding of your fleshy form and your ability to manipulate the flesh has transcended to becoming a Nanite of its own, the Pink nanite. The Pink nanite. Commands Flesh and living material. At 20%, you can warp the biomass of things around you, creating bespoke organs, healing wounds, and grafting limbs. At 100%, you can command the flesh of planets, transmute inert matter to meat and create life ex-nihilo.
addons.title: The Pink Nanite
The Cyan Nanite
addons.text: Your ability to merge psionics with technology has allowed you to manipulate and incorporate psionics and psychic tech as the other Nanites do other phenomena. This has solidified into The Cyan nanite. The Cyan nanite governs psionics. At 20% it allows you to perceive psionic effects and replicate them, incorporate mental constructs into any of your creations, perform basic telepathy, and warp psychic effects in your vicinity. At 100% you can mind control planets at will, create permanent psychic constructs of any size and strength, nullify all psionic effects and erase the entire psychic potential of species with ease.

addons.title: The Silver Nanite
addons.text: Your awareness of the hidden planes all around you has merged with your nanites, allowing you to manipulate these dimensions as they do other phenomena. This has culminated in the Silver nanite. The Silver nanite administrates dimensions. At 20% it allows you to innately sense dimensional irregularities, create small pocket dimensions, summon small extra-dimensional entities and pests into your reality, and create gateways to well known locations. At 100% you can travel across and between universes at a whim, summon armies, and create custom and expansive pocket dimensions at your leisure.

addons.title: The Gold Nanite
addons.text:
Your understanding of your own soul and its ability to adapt has allowed you to merge the metaphysical nature of souls with your nanotechnology. This combination has materialized into nanite form as the Gold nanite.

The Gold nanite governs souls.

At 20%, it allows you to perceive and analyze souls, manipulate spiritual energy, incorporate souls and spiritual constructs into your creations, reinforce and repair your own soul, and warp the souls of those in your vicinity. Your soul can also instinctively adapt to better withstand spiritual attacks and optimize your spiritual abilities.

At 100%, you can freely create, destroy, reshape and restore souls, manufacture entirely new souls, separate souls from their bodies without harming either, and reconstruct souls that have been damaged or fragmented. You can create self-sustaining sources of spiritual energy, engineer souls with specific traits, and manipulate the fundamental spiritual essence of entire planets or species with ease.

objects.text: You have merged with all five Meta-Nanites, the pinnacle of Nanite technology. Initially, you harness only 20% of their combined power. Over time, you will unlock an additional 5% each year until reaching their full potential. The Purple Nanite Commands Technology. At 20%, you can master advanced technologies from centuries ahead and create complex machines effortlessly. At 100%, you can forge unimaginable devices like the Omnitrix or the Mother Box, and wield unparalleled technopathy over entire planets. The Blue Nanite Controls Elements. At 20%, you can manipulate and generate elements such as fire, wind, earth and water—conjuring tornadoes, incinerating armies, and freezing cities. At 100%, you can drown countries, and crack continents with ease, you would even be capable of shattering planets if you wished. The White Nanite Masters Gravity. At 20%, you can generate shields, soar through the air, and amplify gravity to bring enemies to their knees. At 100%, you can collapse continents, redirect celestial bodies, and create miniature black holes safely. The Green Nanite Rules Space-Time. At 20%, you can manipulate time around you and bend space like clay—warping and twisting it to turn entire cities into mazes. At 100%, you can control time itself, and traverse cosmic distances instantly. The Orange Nanite Governs Matter and Energy. At 20%, you can absorb nuclear energy, summon lightning storms, and manipulate matter within a 1,000-meter radius. At 100%, you can project energy akin to a gamma-ray explosion, create matter and energy ex nihilo, and manipulate entire planets.
objects.title: Meta-Nanites (Generator Rex)

objects.text: I'm strong to the finish 'cause I eats my Spinach You gain access to one of the most frightening items in all of existence. Spinach But not just any spinach, Popeyes Spinach You now gain access to a special snack you can summon, that being Popeye’s legendary can of Spinach. Once per day, you can summon a can of spinach from thin air. Either when you are critically injured or at will. You can comedically instantly consume the can's entire contents of spinach. After which, you will instantly recover from any and all wounds you possess and have your strength increase by 100 fold (or more accurately 500 fold with Super Elixir Drinker factored in) for the entirety of the fight you are in or an hour (whichever is longer). Also, from now on, every food item from Snack Supply now increases your stats by 2%, with Steroid Snacks now increasing your stats by 5% each when consumed. Unfortunately, however, your Snack Supply will now only provide the healthiest and surprisingly tasty foods for you to consume. The Magic Potion becomes massively empowered, gaining its full canonical might amplified! With the drinker now gaining 30 times (150x with Super Elixir Drinker factored in) their normal strength. Along with their minimum speed becoming 10% of the speed of light. Also, The Magic Potion’s effects now fully count towards your durability, increasing it by the same amount as your enhanced physical strength. Should you continue to eat healthy with Snack Supply and consume your special spinach daily. Your power will steadily grow, matching Popeye’s reality-bending might with a century of careful eating. However, even still, you will slowly be able ot ignore physics through insane strength. Being able to slowly perform feats such as picking up incredibly large objects, perfectly throwing all kinds of things with perfect precision, and defying logic, or surviving physical damage that should kill you. Also, note that the boost from spinach and The Magic Potion will not stack. Should you consume both The Magic Potion’s effects will resume after the effects of spinach end. Consuming both will not pose any danger to the inhibitor. Now go forth and ascend to godhood through healthy eating.
objects.title: Sailor’s Diet (Popeye the Sailor)

addons.text:
With the combination of not one, but two different iterations of Excalibur fused into your Sacred Gear, the Round Table’s capabilities have been enhanced even further: Not only can you now copy allies at a distance, such as across a battlefield, but if said allies are genuinely loyal to you, they can now be copied by the Round Table even if they no longer live, allowing you to retain fallen friends’ powers.

As one more added benefit, your Sacred Gear now comes with the original twelve Knights of the Round Table already copied, and can even re-add them at any time as if through its second new function, though otherwise they still share the same limitations.
addons.title: Knights of the Round

addons.text:
With the completion of the legendary king of Britain’s armaments, the Round Table has reached a breakthrough and been elevated even further, becoming a true Longinus-class Sacred Gear and awakening its Balance Breaker ability: Simply put, you can now copy non-innate abilities from allies as well, up to and including things such as their own Sacred Gears, combination abilities like merging holy or demonic power with the elements, or even rare/exclusive techniques such as Senjutsu or Youjutsu.

Furthermore, any growth earned in an ally’s copied powers will now persist even when removed from the Round Table’s roster, even in cases such as said ally leaving you or dying, allowing you to pick up where you left off should circumstances allow you to reunite with your comrades.
addons.title: Once and Future King

objects.text:
Your Sacred Gear has merged with the sword(s) once wielded by the ancient king of Britain, awakening the abilities of a new type of Gear known as the Round Table, a “could-have-been” power that Arthur had the potential to awaken but somehow never achieved during life. Using this power, you can copy the innate abilities - such as the 72 Pillars' bloodline abilities, or the angels’ innate talent with holy light - of up to twelve allies by touch, and store them within the Sacred Gear for later use.

Switching between copied powers only takes a split-second, and the growth of each copy is retained when not in use, but you can only use one ally’s abilities at a time, and they start at a novice’s level when copied, requiring you to train them back up to their original strength the normal way. Furthermore, you also gain any innate weaknesses or flaws of said ally when in use, and removing an ally from the Round Table’s collection (which can happen automatically, if they stop being one) also removes all growth you achieved in their powers, forcing you to start over should they be re-added later.

Finally, the core of your Sacred Gear now contains the essence of the original Arthur Pendragon himself, either in the form of his actual spirit being preserved within the Round Table, acting as an advisor and ally to you, or just as an archive of his knowledge and experience for you to draw on to further bolster yourself.
objects.title: Round Table (King Arthur CYOA)

addons.text:
For each Excalibur fragment you possess, you gain an entire corps of Enforcement Knights imbued with the corresponding fragment’s abilities. For example, the Destruction Corps consists of knights capable of unleashing devastating energy blasts and amplifying their attacks for overwhelming impact. Each corps mirrors the unique power of its Excalibur fragment, from the adaptability of Mimic Corps to the mind-bending tactics of Nightmare Corps.

You can invest energy to increase their numbers.
addons.title: Excalibur Corps

addons.text:
You can now summon the Heroic Spirits of the Round Table, legendary knights who embody the ideals of Camelot. These champions retain the Gifts they wielded during the Camelot Singularity, such as Lancelot’s “Ferocity”, Gawain’s “Nightless” or Mordred’s “Rampage” and possess the potential to awaken even more gifts as their bonds with you deepen or as they resonate with the sacred land of Camelot. They require specific resources or energy to be summoned and improved, with the stronger ones, such as Lancelot or Gawain, demanding greater costs.

Within the Holy City of Camelot, these Heroic Spirits are exponentially stronger, their abilities enhanced by the spiritual power of Rhongomyniad and the divine essence of Excalibur. When summoned, they fight with unwavering loyalty, serving as steadfast guardians of justice and righteousness.

Together with the Enforcement Knights and the divine constructs forged from Rhongomyniad’s energy, these Heroic Spirits ensure that Camelot remains an indomitable fortress, its brilliance unyielding in the face of even the most formidable adversaries.
addons.title: Calling of the Knights of the Round

addons.text:
As the Living Incarnation of Artoria and Arthur Pendragon, your connection to Camelot grants you unparalleled authority over the legends of the Round Table. Through this bond, you can summon the Living Incarnations of all the knights of the Round Table simultaneously, bypassing the need for gradual summoning through resources or rituals. 

Each knight is summoned at their peak strength, having every version of their abilities, and retains their memories, skills, and personalities, while also being loyal to you in every way.
addons.title: Round Table, Living Again

objects.text:
Created from the outer shell of Rhongomyniad, anchored by the Mystic Code of the Round Table, and powered by Excalibur.

The Holy City of Camelot’s walls are incredibly durable, and they repel without taking a scratch any malicious attack due to the Camelot castle only granting access to those with righteous hearts, one can further protect the castle by activating walls made out of the same light as Excalibur and allowing Camelot to withstand up to 10 attacks on par with a divine punishment just to break through them. 

While inside the walls of Camelot, one can summon Enforcement Knights, who are knights who possess souls of high rank, but fall short of reaching the level of Heroic Spirit like the Knights of the Round Table, and also create knights out of Rhongomyniad's Energy who are more akin to a divine construct than humans.

(The Knights of the Round are also able to create Enforcement Knights which are catered to their abilities.)
objects.title: Holy City of Camelot (Type-Moon)

addons.text:
You're not just a Mash expy. You've become the Mash of the situation. You have your Senpai, your Fou, and all the abilities, instincts, and skills of the original Mash Kyrielight. If you choose, you may also inherit her full set of memories and her appearance.

If Ritsuka, your Senpai, dies, you can bring them back once per day with a full day's cooldown. All the staff and known characters you’ve added to Chaldea are completely loyal to your Senpai and loyal to you as their second-in-command. That’s perfectly fine, because your Senpai is completely loyal to you in turn, so deeply bound that not even mind control, soul corruption, or memory erasure could break that connection.

If you die, your Senpai can summon you back faster than a normal Servant, restoring you to action. And if your Senpai falls as well, you’re not gone forever. As long as your soul isn’t completely destroyed, you will eventually return, and when you do, you can bring your Senpai and the rest of Chaldea’s crew back with you.
addons.title: Grand Camelot

addons.text:
You don't just have Lord Camelot. You also have Mash, Fou, and all the abilities, instincts, and skills of the original Ritsuka Fujimaru, the final summoner of Chaldea. If you choose, you may also inherit their full set of memories and appearance. In this role, however, your capabilities go beyond the original. Your connection to Chaldea’s summoning systems is deeper, granting you greater precision and control over who you summon through its magical generators and summoning chamber.

Mash still retains her own Lord Camelot, but if you choose to give her yours, her overall power will doubles across all areas. If Mash dies, you can bring her back once per day, with a full day's cooldown.
addons.title: Grand Order

addons.text:
While you retain the ability to come back to life after a period of time unless your soul is destroyed, this ability is also shared with all your servants. Additionally, you have the option to, instead of combining the forms of multiple versions of a servant with yourself, to instead apply this to the Servant associated with the corresponding power if you have the required items or powers. If you do not already possess that servant, they will be immediately summoned. For example, Mash would become "Super Mash," gaining all the memories, items, and skills of Tachie, Galahad, and Galahad Alter. Similarly, Artoria would acquire the powers and items of all her alternate versions.

To ensure this process does not go awry, all servants benefiting from this enhancement become absolutely loyal to you, a state that cannot be undone by mind or reality manipulation.
addons.title: Waifu 4 Laifu

objects.text:
You now occupy a high-ranking position within Chaldea’s command structure, potentially even that of Director. Though you may not bear the title of Final Master, your authority grants you full control over all territories, facilities, and personnel associated with Chaldea. These assets, whether housed in a Pocket Dimension or relocated to a site of your choosing, are entirely under your command. 

Each location is conceptually shielded from time and reality manipulation through the power of your Lord Camelot. Additionally, with access to the coffins and your Storm/Shadow Border, you possess the capability to travel through both time and dimensions. This allows you to revisit specific pivotal moments in your world’s past or journey outward into parallel timelines and entirely new universes.

Unlike the original Chaldea, even if the buildings, summoned servants, and the rest of the staff were destroyed or killed, you can bring them back once a day, with a day-long cooldown. Everyone is completely loyal to you, to the point that not even mind control or memory erasure will stop this. 

This also gives you the option to include known characters associated with Chaldea, such as both Da Vincis, Holmes, Goredolf, the Crypters, Captain Nemo, Romani and more. You can decide who accompanies you.

Additionally, with Chaldea's magical generators and its ability to store and manipulate Saint Graphs, you can more easily summon multiple Servants and enhance them using materials gathered during your journeys. 

None of the summoned Servants are inherently loyal to you, but the summoning chamber prevents them from harming you, making it to easier to either command them or eliminate them.
objects.title: Chaldea Security Organization (Type-Moon)

addons.text:
Rather than the Shielder Paladin Class Mash Kyrielight forged for herself during the Reckoning Singularity, you have created your own variant of the paladin class, that being the Saber Paladin class.

As the class of the Holy Knight, Saber Paladins are akin to a perfect fusion of the offensive power of the Saber class and the defensive capability of the Shielder class.

As a Holy Knight, your Mana Burst becomes Mana Burst (Light), which imbues your magical energy with holy light. This gives you an incredible advantage against unholy, undead, and evil-aligned beings. 

In addition, as Succeed Phantasm (Mana Defence) is the same type of skill as Mana Burst, it too is imbued with Holy Light, which provides a near absolute resistance towards unholy, undead, and evil-aligned powers.

This also gives you two new personal skills:

Human Order Affirmation A: This skill temporarily raises your output and life scale when facing threats to humanity. This skill scales to the level the opponent(s) threaten humanity. Facing an endbringer could enhance you to the point you could crack a continent.

Independent Manifestation A (Spacetime Anomaly): This skill allows the user to travel through time and space, provided there are distortions in spacetime that can ripple out and alter history. This comes with the ability to detect these anomalies with some degree of clarity, allowing you to sense the human foundation value of singularities or the lost depth of lost belts.
addons.title: Saber Paladin

objects.text:
You, your armor, and your shield have evolved. No more are you just a mere imposter utilizing the Noble Phantasm of another. Now, it has truly become your own Noble Phantasm, with your own powers.

Your overall physical capabilities have increased dramatically. You have the physical capabilities to exceed that of Mash Kyrielight even if you're not a Servant. Your attacks, through the usage of your ability to absorb and convert energy, allow you to release beams and rays of holy energy.

Your Succeed Phantasm has evolved through your armor constantly gathering energy for you, such that it is always active at a base level, making you durable enough to shrug off most high-caliber firearm levels of force. Further usage of energy will increase this even more. You've also gained a new passive skill called Territory Defense C, which makes it so any nearby allies who are attacked can only take as much damage as the equivalent of a strong punch to the chest. Each ally has up to 5 charges of this, and each attack consumes a charge. This skill’s charges will refresh for allies a few minutes after battle ends.

Beyond this, your three active skills have evolved into new forms:

Venerated Shield of Snowflakes B: On top of its previous defensive boosts, it now also increases your energy stores by a fifth and your overall power by a third for a short amount of time.

Obscurant Wall of Chalk A: It now grants one target a truly absolute invincibility to everything for a short amount of time, while granting everyone else the previous temporary invincibility. It also charges your energy stores by a fifth. When using your Noble Phantasm, it evolves into Timeworn Bullet Kindling of Amethyst B, constantly restoring your energy by a small amount over time and increasing the damage of your second Noble Phantasm use by 100%.

Shield of Rousing Resolution A: Massively increases the rate at which your energy comes back.

Your Noble Phantasm has evolved. Its default, Lord Chaldeas Hope-Forging Shield of Human Order, on top of its previous capabilities, further increases you and your allies' defense massively, increases your strength by a third temporarily, allows you to immediately reuse all your skills, and grants you a passive buff known as Holy Sword Charging, which allows for your second form to be used.

Rayproof Kyrielight: Hope-Bearing Sword of Human Order allows you to create a long rifle-like gun that, through a combination of the Black Barrel and your power as a paladin capable of sealing space, allows you to fire a beam that ignores invincibility, strips all buffs from the targets, and does a scaling level of damage based on the target’s threat to humanity and how much they diverge from the world’s proper timeline. Such scaling can potentially grow to the point of retconning the target from existence in the proper situation.
objects.title: Paladin (Type-Moon)

addons.text: Instinct is the ability to instantly identify the best personal course of action in combat. This includes sensing where an attack is coming from and determining the optimal way to avoid or block it, even against projectiles like bullets. Your Instinct, however, is at an A rank, placing it on a level akin to predicting the future. With this enhancement, it becomes possible to overcome limitations such as not being able to see or hear an incoming attack, as well as to assess the potential danger of an attack before it happens. While it only allows you to see a few seconds into the future, it is incredibly powerful.
addons.title: Instinct A

addons.text:
While it's called luck, it's more accurately described as good fortune that allows you to negate your "fate." Attacks that are usually guaranteed to hit—whether through manipulation of causality, reality warping, time travel, or simply being ordained by fate to land—have a very high chance of failing if you attempt to avoid them.

Your ability to circumvent fate could even allow you to alter events that were supposed to happen in the world or free yourself from things like imprisonment or things like time loops.
addons.title: Luck A+

addons.text:
Your connection with Rhongomyniad has granted you a boost. Even if you do not meet the prerequisites to break a seal, you are able to break one seal on Rhongomyniad every month. Additionally, you temporarily gain a significant increase to your magical production and power, as well as your luck (if applicable) during battle.

On top of this, you gain Dun Stallion, which is constructed from your mana. This means that even if it dies, you can resummon it. Its speed is always twice your own, and it possesses the strength to jump high enough to reach the clouds, as well as the durability to survive reentry and impact with the ground.

The appearances of Dun Stallion, Rhongomyniad, your armor, and Excalibur can all be altered at will, but these changes do not affect their power.
addons.title: Protection of the Ends of the World EX

objects.text:
You've got the appearance, the charisma, the weapon, the armor, and the presence of one of the versions of Seiba. Practically the "Plan B Seiba" people summon when the other is off doing more important things. Your Mana Burst is so potent that it enables you to move and fight at hypersonic speeds right from the start, and demolish large houses with sheer strength. This grants you more than enough power to take on and defeat the average Servant while withstanding all but the most top-tier magic.

Your armor, instead of being physical, is made of your mana and can be recreated by exerting mana if it's destroyed. Its durability now increases to always be double your own. You've also picked up some nifty magic tricks such as being able to walk on water and also knowing how to shroud Excalibur in wind to both make it invisible and to release strong blasts of wind when you uncloak it.

Your personal appearance no longer needs the Crown of Kings; you have the ability to shift between all the different Seiba appearances at will, including changing your armor and Excalibur to match those versions. This doesn’t actually result in any decrease or increase in your or your weapon’s power, it only alters the special effects and aesthetics.

You're pretty much a Saberface at this point. As a bonus, you can choose for the vial of Dragon's Blood to be completely consumed by you the moment you receive it.
objects.title: Saberface (Type-Moon)

addons.title: Voice of Heaven
addons.text:
Through your connection to Heaven’s System, the System has encountered and learned from the piece of the Voice of the World you copied.

Heaven’s System becomes a localized instance of the Voice of the World, allowing you to bestow the benefits of the Voice of the World to anyone within the influence of the Heaven’s System.

Furthermore, due to possessing administrative authority over Heaven’s System you automatically possess administrative authority over the localized instance of the Voice of the World as well. This elevates your “aligned” status to a whole new level, possessing a level of control and favor on par with Veldanava himself.

You can also offload the burden of Skills being inscribed into your body/soul onto the System, allowing you to possess any number of Skills without strain. Similarly, you can draw upon Heaven’s reserves of energy when bestowing Names or having children, allowing you to do so without permanently losing power.

objects.text: Your Sacred Gear has merged with the Throne of Metatron, awakening a new Longinus Sacred Gear Lesser Throne of Heaven. The Lesser Throne of Heaven has a direct connection and administrative authority over the Heaven System. The Throne Computer comes pre-loaded with a complete manual on how to operate the Heaven System, in whatever format you want it to be in, from a written manual to a series of YouTube videos where God explains how to use the Heaven System. Upon learning the functions of the Heaven System, you can control the distribution of Sacred Gears and Spirit Inheritances, leaving the distribution of the divine artifacts created by the Lord to no longer depend on chance. This also allows you to remove Sacred Gears from the system directly, and if you have Sacred Gear Engineer (High School DxD), you can add the Sacred Gears you make into the system. As the light and holy weaknesses of devils are artificially imposed on them by the Heaven System, you can use your Sacred Gear to impose said weaknesses on individuals, groups, or species. You can also alter the requirements for an angel to “fall” that the Heaven System imposes on angels; you can also redeem fallen angels, turning them back into pure angels. You can use the Heaven System as a magical foci for your own spell casting needs. This allows you to amplify your spells to a potency roughly equivalent to a Super Devil’s all-out attack, but also project your spells to anywhere under the Heaven System’s clairvoyance. The Heaven System’s clairvoyance can passively observe the entire world, even peering into alternate dimensions such as the underworld and the dimensional gap. You can access this as a video feed through the Throne Computer, or project it directly into your mind.
objects.title: Lesser Throne of Heaven

objects.text:
Ownership of two Krakoan habitats has expanded to the full island of Krakoa. Of this there are two halves, Pacific Krakoa and Atlantic Krakoa, connected by a network of portals. Krakoa is at its core an entire nation that if taken as a continuous landmass, would be slightly smaller than France.

Within Krakoa however, are a series of structural and infrastructure pieces that make it an absolute national powerhouse. In addition, you also gain a relatively small population of mutants that, while only Beta-level or lower, will be able to operate the vast majority of Krakoan infrastructure. 

On top of the infrastructure already present in the Greymalkin and Bar Sinister habitats, the actual island also contains both mundane infrastructure such as housing and farming, educational infrastructure localised to the Akademos Habitat, and civil infrastructure like the Healing Gardens and Hellfire Bay.

On top of this, it possesses an incredible amount of more fantastical infrastructure. The Armoury, where Krakoan defense technologies are developed, the Arena, The Healing Gardens, The Grove where mutant law is made and the No-Space, held outside of time in the depths of the island, and far more.

And of course, the Boneyard and Arbor Magna, where the Resurrection Protocols are performed, ensure that mutants are an immortal species, being restored to their full prime, though the current system, lacking the original five, is vastly less efficient, resulting at at most one person a day being restored.
objects.title: Krakoa (Marvel: X-Men)

addons.text: Your strange nature and ability to wield contradictory powers has resulted in the sea being willing to tolerate the presence of a Devil Fruit’s power within you. Instead of replacing your Devil Fruit, you instead gain the power of the Flood-Flood fruit as a fourth Devil Fruit.
addons.title: Toleration

addons.text: You are not merely the champion of the sea—no, you are the sea, or at least a fragment of it. A physical manifestation of a part of the sea. The energy and strength sapping abilities of your water grows exponentially in both strength and speed, enough to suck all but the strongest of beings dry in mere moments, rendering almost anything helpless once caught and making most attacks completely useless. You can freely create and control water at no cost, even on the largest of scales—directing entire oceans worth of water to crush and drown all who oppose you, all while maintaining fine control over it. Additionally, your connection to the sea has grown strong enough that it would take conceptual or divine authority to even begin to contest your control over the waves. Lastly, the increase in strength and regeneration you experience when touching water you control has grown as well. Now, the mere presence of any water at all is enough to significantly empower you, and actually being in contact with water saturated with your power is enough to render you borderline immortal.
addons.title: One with the Sea

addons.text:
Your aquatic nature meshes well with your role as the Sea’s Champion, elevating your physical form to rival that of the greatest Fish-Men of the One Piece world in strength. Additionally, you can no longer experience any form of dehydration, as you carry the essence of the Sea wherever you go.

That isn’t all, however. The true strength of this power is that your marine telepathy grows in strength and range, enough to resemble the power displayed by the Ancient Weapon Poseidon. As the Champion of the Sea, you hold dominion over all creatures which dwell within it, able to communicate with and command them with absolute authority. From the smallest plankton and fish to the mightiest Sea King and kraken, all things which call the sea home instinctively kneel before you.
addons.title: Poseidon

objects.text: You are not merely loved by the sea—you are its champion in the crusade against the abominations who have rejected the benevolence of the sea and turned to the unnatural powers of Devil Fruits. Your Devil Fruit has been claimed by the sea—an unfortunately necessary evil—and fundamentally altered into something new. A conduit for the sea's grace, hence known as the Flood-Flood Fruit. This allows the user to become, create, and control water, turning them into the ultimate counter to Devil Fruits and an enactor of the sea's will. In more common terms, you gain the powers of a Water Logia. Additionally, as a conduit for the sea’s power, your waters can subject even those without Devil Fruits to the same weakness Devil Fruit users possess, bypassing their defenses and sapping their strength. This is because the weakness to water is not something inherent to Devil Fruits, but rather the sea explicitly targeting those who consume Devil Fruits.
objects.title: Champion of the Sea

addons.title: The Sea's Bounty
addons.text:
Your connection to the sea allows you to draw upon Devil Fruits that have never existed before, all born from the sea itself. 

New Fruits based on marine creatures, Sea Kings, oceanic phenomena, and mythical beings of the deep become available, expanding your arsenal beyond the canon. 

These sea-born Fruits function identically to any other Devil Fruit within your Singularity, capable of being mastered, fused, and eventually bestowed upon others. 

However, unless you possess the sea's tolerance for multiple Devil Fruits, these sea-born Fruits are the only Devil Fruit powers that may coexist with the Flood-Flood Fruit.

objects.text:
Your Devil Fruit has evolved; it no longer grants you a single ability. With this upgrade, you now have access to any Devil Fruit abilities shown or referenced within the world of One Piece.

Initially, you will only be able to call forth a single Fruit's powers at a time. As you progress in familiarizing yourself with the powers you now have hidden away within yourself, you will gain the ability to control multiple Devil Fruit abilities at the same time. You could even learn to merge multiple Devil Fruit powers at the same time, creating new, unique Devil Fruit powers.

With time, you could learn to create new powers based on Devil Fruits that don’t exist yet or are considered non-canonical, such as Devil Fruits created for the movies or even brand-new fruit abilities. However, you are currently not at the level required to produce new Devil Fruit abilities. You could even learn to bestow Devil Fruit abilities on others.

However, like all Devil Fruits, you still possess the weakness they all share, being unable to swim or be submerged under water, as your strength will be sapped.
objects.title: Devil Fruit Singularity

objects.text: Your Chakra Fruit has merged with the essence of the Devil Fruit tree, transforming it into the Demon Emperor Fruit. This grants you the ability to use all Devil Fruit powers and have complete control over which fruit's power manifests, along with which ones you desire to use singularly or together and even combine certain Fruit powers to make all new abilities. You still possess the weakness of sea water and related things like sea stone unless you buy Beloved of the Sea (One Piece).
objects.title: Demon Emperor Fruit

objects.text:
The five Mother Dark Brings have fused back into their original form, the Dimension-Destroying Dark Bring: Endless. Normally taking the form of a small orb of dark slime roughly the size of a golf ball, this seemingly unremarkable object holds unfathomable power. To begin with you can freely use the powers of all five Mother Dark Brings at will. The rate of Dark Bring generation increases to five per day, with the odds being 45% for a Regular-Level, 35% for a High-Level, and 20% for a Supreme Dark Bring.
Aside from this, Endless can also fuse with you, boosting your physical might to a point where you can overpower an Endbringer. Your Dark Bring's most prominent power however is that it lets you summon, command, and even fuse with the monstrous form of Endless known as the King of Oblivion.

In this form it, and by extension you, have a number of additional abilities. Aside from raw physical power and the ability to release energy blasts that can casually wipe cities and mountains off the map, as a being intended to destroy dimensions it naturally counteracts temporal or dimension-based abilities such as Phir Se's, Myrrdin's, or Labyrinth's, weakening and even destroying them with little effort. In the same vein it can breach and travel into other dimensions and generate a continuously expanding fog of Star Memory. Anyone who enters this fog unprotected will rapidly start to lose memories, starting at their most recent ones, until all memories are wiped away and they dissolve into nothing. Should they manage to either leave the fog or force it away from them, the lost memories will fully return within minutes. Finally, Endless can continuously charge energy even mid-combat, and release it in the form of an Overdrive, a massive explosion that can at full power purge all dimensions on a planetary range and collapse them into a singular lifeless timeline, though this would be a self-sacrificial move that would also erase both Endless and you as its wielder.
objects.title: Endless (Rave Master)

addons.text:
The holy Omnissiah has blessed the Forge World. 

Even the defences have been blessed by the Omnissiah, they detect enemies twice as far and no longer require active assistance when targeting them for the machine spirits will actively help with eliminating any intruders who would harm a location touched by the Omnissiah.

Anything created in the Forge World is automatically blessed, transcending the quality of technology that the Omnissiah has not blessed. Plasma guns from this Forge World are designed to be highly efficient, as they don't overheat and rarely, if ever, need reloading. Additionally, Power Armour from this Forge World is twice as durable.
addons.title: Blessed Forge World

addons.text:
Your Tactical Doll has undergone a significant upgrade, integrating advanced innovations from the Dark Age of Technology. This enhancement bestows it with capabilities akin to those of humanity's strongest creation and tragic downfall: the Men of Iron. With these newfound abilities, your Tactical Doll stands as a powerful force on the battlefield, blending the advanced technology from the Dark Age with itself.

In addition, your Tactical Doll and any made on the Forge World also possess what would be considered to be a machine spirit and will not be considered an abominable Intelligence.

Furthermore, the Forge World now boasts access to a Standard Template Construct (STC), a blueprint of immense value, allowing for the mass production of Tactical Dolls that mirror the specifications and enhancements found in your upgraded version. With this STC at its disposal, the Forge World can ramp up production, creating a formidable array of Tactical Dolls ready to support any military endeavour, each equipped with the cutting-edge upgrades from the Dark Age of Technology.
addons.title: (Wo)men of Iron

addons.text:
Your Forge World harbours an ancient secret. Beneath the endless seas of dark red sands lies a buried relic, a fractured shard of the C’Tan known among the Necron as the Mag'ladroth, or the Void Dragon to all others in the galaxy. Though this shard is far too damaged to ever fully regain its power, it remains the most intact piece of its kind in existence, second only to the shard hidden deep beneath the Martian surface.

This shard possesses a unique ability that influences your Forge World. It acts as a catalyst for innovation, subtly altering and enhancing the designs produced by the servitors and machines. The creations that emerge from the Forge World are not merely machines; they are infused with an ancient knowledge of the Void Dragon, making them advanced, even a mass-produced lasgun turns into a work of art that far exceeds anything else that would be made by any other Forge World technologically.

Every being in the forge world sees you as the Omnissiah made flesh, a living testament to the machine god. The very spirits of the machines resonate with your presence, singing your name in tunes of reverence and loyalty. Servitors labour with renewed vigour and zeal whenever you are near, driven by an almost palpable enthusiasm, as they believe that they serve not just a leader but the very manifestation of their faith. The Forge World thrums with life, inspired by your guiding essence, perpetually striving to reach new heights of technological achievement.
addons.title: Cult of the Machine

objects.text:
The Angel Forge has undergone an evolution into a sprawling Forge World. This new Forge World boasts a level of technological complexity unmatched by modern Forge Worlds, built utilising lost knowledge from the Dark Age of Technology. The sheer production capacity of your Forge World is rivalled only by the Holy Planet of Mars.

Within the depths of this Forge World, the Adeptus Mechanicus have meticulously hoarded technology, preserving the secrets of the Dark Age of Technology. Here, long-forgotten technology can be recovered, enabling the creation of advanced machinery. However, deciphering and uncovering all that the Adeptus Mechanicus know about the Dark Age of Technology will require time. 

Currently, the forge is limited to technology available at the present Adeptus Mechanicus level. The air vibrates with the reverberations of machine spirits, as a vast army of servitors toils endlessly to manufacture complex machines and cutting-edge technology.

To safeguard this technological treasure from those who would seek to obliterate it, the Forge World is fortified with Orbital Defence Cannons, strategically positioned around the planet, ready to defend against hostile spacecraft with devastating firepower. 

On the ground, dormant Imperial Titans lie in wait, prepared to awaken and unleash their formidable might should ground forces be needed to repel invaders. Furthermore, a highly trained garrison of Skitarii, equipped with the most advanced gear and weaponry that the Adeptus Mechanicus can provide, patrols the Forge World, ensuring its safety and the continued production of humanity’s most vital technologies.
objects.title: Forge World (Warhammer: 40K)

objects.text:
Your God reached out to the Gates, the Gates touched back, merging and elevating them into something far greater. Your Machine God now mirrors, or perhaps even is, the Universal Machine—an incorruptible construct crafted by humanity in a distant far future.

Your Machine, imbued with the power of the Gates of Babylon, now possesses the extraordinary capability to mimic, replicate, perceive, record, and embody all tools humanity has ever created, used, discovered, and knows of. It is the earliest stone calculators, the sacred relics of ancient deities, and the groundbreaking innovations of posthuman science. It encompasses not only physical things but also abstract concepts such as martial arts, language, philosophy, and culture. It is humanity's ultimate testament—a fusion of flesh and, ultimately, the Word.

It also possesses the ability to manipulate any tool, transcending machinery. It can control everything from stick swords, fire from a fireplace, and even ideas. Furthermore, it can project a control radius from any tools associated with humanity.

Within the Gates of Babylon, your god will oversee the vault with unparalleled precision. It will repair any damaged items and replicate those that are destroyed, while restocking consumables such as medicine, potions, and scrolls. The vault's contents will be preserved intact, safeguarded from temporal paradoxes and any threat of erasure which will extend to you as you are connected to the Gates of Babylon. Moreover, it will autonomously protect you from all potential dangers.

Your vault and Machine will continuously expand as you journey through new timelines and universes. The Machine will seek out and integrate any tools and concepts that humanity has created, used, discovered, or known within those timelines, causing your vault to perpetually grow.
objects.title: The Universal Machine (Doctor Who)

objects.text:
Your Book of Prophecy has fused with your Perfect Omnitool, and your Witch Factor has begun to course through this newly merged form, transforming your Book into a Tome of Wisdom. With these upgrades, your book now starts with a 4x4 grid for codes, allowing infinite expansion as you continue to scan. Your scanning function no longer requires physical contact and can now scan everything within a 10-mile radius. The restrictions on what you can recreate from this ascended form of the book have been removed. The limitation on affecting the minds, souls, or personalities of others is also gone. Any remaining limits on the book are either lifted or fading away as the Tome of Wisdom grows infinitely. Every new scan and every piece of technology or magic incorporated increases its functionality or grants new, unique abilities that may never have existed before.

But that’s not all your tome can do. Your Future Vision has vastly expanded— the more people and things you scan, the more detailed your visions of the future become. If you manage to scan most of your current world, you will gain incredibly accurate, if not near-perfect, omniscience over the past, present, and future spanning hundreds of years. Additionally, your ability to revive yourself has extended to others, allowing the tome to bring anyone back to life, as long as you’ve previously scanned them and still retain their code.

You no longer need to physically read the book to access its information. Now, all data—whether it’s memories of people, visions of the future, or knowledge of skills and abilities—will be directly transmitted into your mind. You’ve also gained your own sub-dimension called the Castle of Dreams, where you can simulate the past, present, future, or even hypothetical realities for yourself or others.

Moreover, you can now scan and edit your own code, adding new codes that you desire or removing those that are detrimental to you.
objects.title: Tome of Wisdom (Re:Zero)

objects.text:
You are no longer merely a wielder of the Triforce; you have ascended to a state akin to the goddess Hylia herself, a true inheritor of the Three Golden Goddesses. The individual Triforce pieces melt together into a single, divine golden essence that fuses with your very being, elevating you to a higher plane of existence. 

This transformation grants you eternal life and true immortality, enabling you to endure even the Void of Nonexistence itself. Death does not exist for you in any way shape or form nor can it be imposed upon you. 

You transcend and are beyond Death to such a degree that those who control or embody it can’t even perceive or register your existence. If you stand before one who embodies the end of all things, you can reveal yourself as to have them face True Eternity and self-annihilate in Paradox.

Your shapeshifting abilities now extend to encompass any form, creature, or entity shown within the Zelda Universe. The powers of the Triforce are no longer external artifacts—they are innate to you, inseparable and immune to theft, sealing, or replication. Moreover, you gain the ability to wield the powers of Hylia, Demise, and the Fierce Deity and other gods such as the Horse God, unlocking a level of mastery that encompasses the domains of the Zelda pantheon. 

In time, you may even claim dominion over the realms of the Three Golden Goddesses, approaching their divine magnitude and perhaps one day achieving the power to create an entire universe on your own.

Your divinity is entirely self-sufficient. Unlike lesser deities, your existence and strength do not depend on the faith or belief of mortals. Your power flows endlessly from within, needing no external sustenance or validation. You are an independent god, free of the constraints and vulnerabilities that tether other divine beings. This carries over to any other Divine powers you have that depend on Faith.

As a god, you gain dominion over your own Sacred Realm, a divine domain that exists beyond time and space, nestled within the Void itself. This realm is completely impervious to intrusion unless you grant access. Within your Sacred Realm, you wield omnipotent power, capable of altering and reshaping anything as you see fit. 

While this unparalleled power does not extend to visitors within your realm or to the mortal world, you can use this space to observe the world, scrying across dimensions and timelines. From here, you can send dreams, omens, and signs to guide others, bless them with divine gifts, and shepherd your chosen ones toward a brighter destiny.

One of your divine affinities is a profound connection to music, a talent that transcends mortal understanding. Your mastery of melodies and harmonies resonates on a cosmic level, capable of inspiring mortals, calming storms, or even influencing the flow of time and reality itself.

You are the Threefold God, an eternal and self-sufficient deity whose existence stands as a testament to the unification of courage, wisdom, and power. The cosmos itself may one day bow to your will.
objects.title: Threefold God (Legend of Zelda)

addons.text: Outside of the embryo provided by the OoP, Arcadia now becomes an embryo as well. She begins as a Type Maiden with Weapon embryo of the first form with EX rank status correction for all stats while keeping all of her previous powers.
addons.title: Master of the Silver Bat

addons.text:
You obtain the superior job of Sacred Princess or King of Sacred (depending on your gender). It’s a special lineage-based Superior Job that gets passed down to the royal family. This job’s abilities are tied to the use of the Primeval holy Sword, Altar. By having this job, you can choose to change your hair color to blue which shares the marks of the first bearer of the job. Sacred Princess/King of Sacred grants four skills, [The Inheritor of The Sacred Blade], [Release], [Border One], and [■■].

[The Inheritor of the Sacred Blade] is a passive skill that multiplies all the user’s stats by a factor of 10 when wielding the Primeval Sword, Altar.

[Release] is an active skill that unlocks the first seal on the Primeval Sword, Altar. On use, it activates the first ability [The Inheritor of the Sacred Blade].

[Border One] is the ultimate skill of the Sacred Princess/King of Sacred that releases the second seal of the Primeval Sword, Altar. With [Border One], the user gains the ability to sever intangible entities, such as energy and even space itself, by simply existing within the affected area. However, using it drains the user's MP, SP, HP, and even their lifespan at an alarming pace.

[■■] is the final blow of the Sacred Princess/King of Sacred, capable of dealing catastrophic damage to both the physical and metaphysical planes. This ultimate attack ensures that nothing can survive its strike, leaving nothing but destruction in its wake.
addons.title: Sacred Princess/King of Sacred

addons.text:
You obtain the Superior Job King of Destruction from the Crasher Grouping. A Job that, when leveled up, increases only Strength which makes it highly unbalanced in terms of stat spread. However, despite that, it also grants high resistance to debuffs like Extreme Poison. King of Destruction grants the user two skills, [Right of Destruction] and [World Breaker].

[Right of Destruction] is the ultimate skill of the King of Destruction and allows them to destroy the indestructible. The user’s attacks are capable of destroying gases or even non-physical entities. Skills, items, laws, or even concepts that negate destruction can be negated with this skill. It also has the effect of negating damage the user receives when they attack an opposing force whose END is lower than their attack power.

[World Breaker] is the King of Destruction’s Final Blow. It’s only available to users whose Strength surpasses 70,000 and by increasing their physical strength to their limits they can unleash a move that can “destroy the world”. Combined with [Right of Destruction], even space itself is destroyed erasing everything within a wide area including the user. As the destroyed space is being restored, it will cause damage to anyone inside. Using this guarantees that the surrounding landscape will be completely altered.
addons.title: King of Destruction

addons.text:
You obtain the Superior Job King of Beast from the Jaguarman Grouping. Unlike other taming Jobs, this job barely increases Minion Capacity and does not increase stats much. However, it makes up for it with its skills. Normally this Job would be terrible because strong minions have a high Minion Capacity, but Embryos do not cost Minion Capacity. King of Beast grants two skills [Beastheart Possession Level EX] and [Beastheart, As One].

[Beastheart Possession Level EX] is a passive skill that adds 100% of the subordinate monster’s status to the user’s status. Due to Leviathan, you’ll gain stats equal to her and any other minions or Type Guardian Embryos you possess.

[Beastheart, As One] is an active skill that synchronizes the thoughts of the user with any minions they used [Beastheart Possession Level EX] on regardless of any obstacles and distance between them.
addons.title: King of Beast

addons.text:
You are now able to create zeroth stage embryo yourself. These embryos can be used and implanted into yourself, or given to other people. 

If these embryo develop into Type Maiden, Type Apostle, or other embryos involving living creatures, these embryo will always be loyal to you and maintain a telepathic connection with you, even if they were developed by other people. 

You now also receive The Maker superior job, that grants access to skills which can help in the development and strengthening of embryos. This job fits under all production job groupings, including but not limited to alchemist, mechanic, engraver etc
addons.title: The Maker

addons.text:
You can now, if you wish so, convert the Primeval Sword, Altar into a first form type weapon embryo while retaining all of it's previous abilities.

You now also obtain the infinite job The Smith, which was owned by the original creator of both the Primeval Sword, and the Nameless Axe.
addons.title: The Smith

objects.text:
The Gamer System is enhanced by integrating and utilizing the functionalities and traits of the Archetype System from Infinite Dendrogram, without compromising the unique structure and abilities of the original Gamer System. This integration allows the Gamer System to adapt to the features of the Archetype System, amplifying your capabilities without fully transforming the Gamer System into the Archetype System itself. The result is a more dynamic, flexible system that supports your growth through the notarization of stats, status effects, and further interaction with your Embryo’s evolving abilities.

With the integration of the Archetype System, stats take on more multifaceted roles. For example, AGI now not only impacts movement speed but reflects the speed at which you think, and henceforth boosts the speed of experience gain for abilities through Gamer System, allowing you to adapt more quickly in both battle and training. Similarly, STR improves physical attacks and overall power, while END increases durability and resistance to physical and magical threats. DEX fine-tunes precision, allowing for sharper control over attacks or magic, while LUC improves the chance of critical hits, rare item drops, and the overall outcome of uncertain events. Alongside these attributes, Soul Power plays a crucial role in powering specialized abilities, supporting your core skills and other combat or magical functions, in conjunction with HP and MP. MP serves as your reserve for magic-based actions, fueling spells and abilities that rely on your magical affinity, and HP serves as a notarization of vital energies.

While the Embryo benefits less obviously from the new abilities, its integration with the Gamer System provides powerful advantages by enhancing its evolving functionality and interaction with your system. The Embryo keeps all of it’s previous traits, and now forms a connection to the Gamer System allowing you to track and manage its progression through an intuitive interface. The relationship between the Embryo and the Gamer System amplifies your potential in multiple areas. For instance, you can now view the Embryo’s detailed status, manage resource consumption, and strategize its evolutionary path based on the resources and stats at your disposal, providing a deeper and more integrated connection with your embryo.

One of the key features of this upgrade is the utilization of resources. In the world of Infinite Dendrogram, progress is driven not by experience, but by resources acquired from killing other masters, tians and monsters. Resources, which replace traditional experience points, can be utilized to strengthen abilities, evolve your Embryo, and enhance your stats. Resources are also beneficial for summoning monsters, crafting, and acquiring new abilities or items. This shift to a resource-based system adds more flexibility to your growth, as resources can be allocated strategically, depending on your priorities and goals. Resources are a type of energy omnipresent in Infinite Dendrogram, and now, you can absorb and transform resources from the body, soul, concept and the very being of enemies that you kill, preventing them from ressurecting, as well as food that you consume. 

In addition to the core features of stat growth and resource management, you are now also provided with the acquisition of summoned monsters. Summoned monsters are creatures with spiritual forms that can be made physical through certain job skills. These monsters can either require a medium for summoning or exist without one. Monsters summoned with a medium can be empowered and grow stronger over time, increasing their potential and abilities. If these monsters are defeated, they can be re-summoned as long as their medium is intact, but their level is reset if the medium is destroyed. Monsters summoned without a medium are more temporary, appearing only for a limited period, and are usually summoned using MP or SP. These creatures, though not able to grow in power on their own, offer immediate utility in combat. The minion capacity system allows you to manage multiple summoned entities, whether they are empowered or not, enabling a more strategic approach to resource management and combat tactics. Monsters summoned through the Gamer System can also benefit from the Embryo’s evolution if aligned correctly, allowing them to become even more powerful through synergies and adaptations. They can be summoned through other abilities or powers.

The Gamer System now also adopts the quest mechanism of the Archetype System providing an additional avenue for acquiring resources. Completing quests or defeating bosses rewards you with resources, which can be used to upgrade your stats, abilities, or the Embryo. This system mirrors the progression mechanics found in Infinite Dendrogram, where gaining resources through various challenges is vital for overall growth. Resources earned through quests or special objectives are automatically added to your Gamer System, and can be allocated based on your immediate needs. This allows you to target specific areas of growth, enhancing stats or acquiring jobs.

Unique Boss Monsters or UBMs adds another avenue of recourse gathering to your gamer system. Powerful enemies or foes are automatically categorised and attached with UBM attributes, ranging from Epic to Superior rankings. Upon defeat, they offer rare rewards, generated by the Gamer System, customized to your needs. These rewards can range from powerful equipment to UBM-based items, which often carry extraordinary abilities and can be enhanced through specific skills. The special rewards are typically bound to you, however they can also be used by your Embryo, further boosting its strength. UBM material item drops can provide enhancements to the final product, sometimes offering up 100 times the normal output. Or you can opt for more resources, forgoing the reward.

Outside of direct upgrades to the Gamer System, you now also gain access to all the magic attributes of Infinite Dendrogram. These attributes include, but are not limited to: The sky that attribute governs the generation of energy, such as, heat, light, sound, etc, that also covers the manipulation of gases, due to this characteristic, the sky attribute covers many varied types of magic attributes and excels in the use of attack magic. The earth attribute which governs the alteration and reinforcement of minerals and the manipulation of solids. It possesses a good mix of attack and defense magic, but these are mostly limited to spells manipulating solid matter. This attribute also makes use of spells which reinforce attack and defense power. This attribute can only deal physical damage. The sea attribute that governs the absorption and decay of energy, and the manipulation of liquids, specializing in defensive magic. And the dark attribute that possesses anti-life properties. It deals nearly no damage to objects and isn’t effective against a wide-range of possible targets that other attributes work on, but in exchange it can ignore most physical defenses when used against living creatures. However, it can be defended using magical barriers of its natural opposing attribute — light. This attribute does not possess any actual mass.

Also, when you are near death, your embryo sends you to a pocket dimension that cannot be accessed and does not exist for other people, and after three days, you are able to return to where you were formerly injured, treating it as a temporary “save point”.

You also gain access and compatability for all jobs in the archetype system. For jobs, your gamer system acts as a job crystal.

Your MP and SP regenerate at 1.39% of max per hour
objects.title: Master (Infinite Dendrogram)

addons.text:
Now, even while you remain outside the castle, you can synchronise your personal timeline with it, essentially cutting yourself off from the rest of existence. In this state, you can walk through time as easily as one would walk down the street, slowing down, accelerating, pausing, or even rewinding it.

As this is achieved by cutting yourself off from the natural flow of time and not imposing your will on the outside world, this manipulation is undetectable and cannot be interfered with even by other beings proficient in time manipulation.

At will, you may synchronise others with your personal timeline, allowing them to follow you into the past or future, although they will not be capable of travelling by themselves.
addons.title: Norn

objects.text:
The castle is now eternally and inseparably bound to your soul. Feeding on the endless energy inside you, it has lost the need to consume the souls of others to function and grow, now constantly operating at peak capacity.

Due to the influence of your inviolable soul, the castle is now impervious to any and all damage, no matter how esoteric, and will continue to exist even should you perish or if the whole of reality shatters around it. In the event you die, you can now safely resurrect inside the castle's walls, where no one can disturb your recovery process. Likewise, any soul claimed by the Gladsheimr can now share in your absolute immortality, both eternally safe and inescapably bound to your golden universe forevermore.

Thanks to the infinite energies that now fuel your castle, it can now expand without limit, as well as consume other structures, pocket dimensions, and even whole worlds, seamlessly integrating them into this hellish realm. Although the larger something you wish to consume is, the longer it will take.

The castle's true form now forever exists outside of all of creation, unbound by any laws and unreachable by any entities. But you can still manifest portions of the castle at any point in space and time you desire or even just summon the effects of its offensive or defensive weaponry to wield them akin to spells. This allows you to, for example, manifest Castle structures, any objects bound to the Gladsheimr, or create portals through time and space by materialising interconnected entrances and much more.

Lastly, you can now cloak yourself in a small part of the castle, manifested as a suit of armour, simple clothing, or even just as an invisible presence, thus making yourself as invulnerable as the castle's walls, impervious in mind, body, and soul to any and all attacks and influences.
objects.title: Gylfaginning

objects.text:
Your Mana Cube and Doran's Ring have fused into something far greater and more powerful, the Operational Support Ring, a masterwork crafted by Ahkasha itself. This ring offers a suite of fundamental enhancements, including a minor increase to your constitution, 100% increase in spell power, an 80% reduction in supernatural energy cost, a 200% boost in casting speed, and an impressive 600% improvement in supernatural energy recovery.

In addition to these core enhancements, the ring grants the powerful ability to cast any spells up to two additional times without any extra casting time or supernatural energy cost. Furthermore, it has the ability to eliminate casting time entirely for any spells you have mastered to a high degree. Additionally, you can precast and store up to five spells per day within the ring, ready to be unleashed at your convenience. Much like the Mana Cube, this ring is compatible with any type of supernatural energy—whether it's Qi, Ether, Spirit, or any others.

While this ring is still most likely beyond your ability to accurately replicate, your mastery in magical artifact creation can improve by leaps and bounds through studying it.
objects.title: Operational Support Ring

objects.text:
Instead of a galaxy-wide network of Stargates, you receive a fleet of 10 Seed Ships, each crafted in your choice of Stargate design—be it from Atlantis, SG-1, or Universe. All ships remain the same size as those from Stargate Universe. Their architecture will adapt to match the selected style, reflecting "Ancient Architecture" of that era, while maintaining the same power levels as the Lantean technology.

Additionally, you gain a large portable Drydock/Station capable of repairing and maintaining these ships, as well as constructing new Seed Ships or other vessels from the Stargate universe. This facility is fully equipped with automated manufacturing systems and the necessary materials—resources supplied externally—to build Stargates and ships efficiently.

The Drydock can accommodate the Destiny, along with five other Seed Ships simultaneously. If you possess other ships from Stargate or other series, its size will adjust to ensure seamless connection and operation without compromising its core capabilities.

All vessels are linked to the Drydock’s central control system, featuring a master Neural Interface Chair similar to those on Atlantis. From this station, you can oversee all ships, monitor their locations and status, access intelligence gathered, and manage Stargate addresses across vast distances.

Built with Lantean-era Ancient technology, the Drydock is armed with drone launchers, pulse weapons, formidable shields, an intergalactic Hyperdrive, and its own Stargate. It is fully self-sustaining, capable of supporting a crew of around 1,000.
objects.title: Ancient Drydock (Stargate)

addons.text:
It seems I was wrong about the book lacking its original counterparts complete ability to create new Sacred Gears , thanks to your mastery of understanding the laws and concepts of reality you can now create entirely new Sacred Gears based on your understanding of a concept, this also comes with the ability to form contracts with abstract being to serve as power sources for your own Longinus class Sacred Gears. 

To give an example, if you have a novice understand of the concept of speed you could make a pair of boots that increase your speed by 10× with a Balance Breaker potentially being rocket boots that increase your speed by 20× while mastery allows for a Sacred Gear with a connection to the Speedforce, effectively turning the wielder into a pseudo-speedster with a potential Balance Breaker being an armor akin to Savitars that allows one to enter the Speedforce itself.

On another note you can also study the concepts that Sacred Gears are based on like domination with the Boosted Gear or life with the Sephiroth Graal potentially allowing you to evolve them into a higher stage.

The sky's the limit now, use responsibly please.
addons.title: Conceptual Creator

addons.text:
It seems that your Sacred Gear has absorbed your Imperial Arm causing it to now include all the canonical Teigus in its disposal. Just like with Sacred Gears you don't unlock them all right of the start and need to train in order to gain access to more Teigus.

Thought this does allow for you to slowly remove the drawbacks to your Teigus like Lionel losing its regeneration if you've fused with it and your Teigus no longer can be permenantly destroyed as you can just desummon and resummon them.

Just like with Sacred Gears the book also keeps track of the trumpcards of the Teigus as well as being able to grant your Teigus the ability to use Purge Mode which could be considered akin to Juggernaut Drive/Breakdown of the Beast but without the lifeforce draining effects.

Also the Book of Conceptual Records contains the knowledge of how the original Imperial Arms where made allowing for the creation of new Teigu by using corpses of magic beasts that might exist in your world (Endbringers do count but good luck taking one out).

Also you hold blueprint on things like the Shingu and Meihou shown throughout the series with instructions on how to make them how to remove their flaws
addons.title: Imperial Armoury

objects.text: Thanks to your understanding of Sacred Gear creation and possessing a Sacred Gear (alongside a lot of points), you now hold the strongest Sacred Gear in your possession—the Book of Conceptual Record. With this, you now hold all canon Sacred Gears and can make modifications to them to remove their limitations, make new Balance Breakers and even fuse existing ones. Though, due to the nature of the CYOA, it has been made slightly weaker than its original self; firstly, you lack the complete ability to create any kind of Sacred Gear, being limited to basic ones like Twice Critical; although, as you grow in power, (both your own and with the Sacred Gears you wield), your ability to create new Sacred Gears will grow until you can create those on the level of Longinus. Secondly, most canon Sacred Gears are locked as of the moment, with only the initial Sacred Gear you picked along with three more that are not Longinus (though if you purchase either the More Sacred Gears upgrade or any of the other Sacred Gear upgrades/fusions, they will be integrated into the book). As of this moment, you can only use up to three Sacred Gears equal in power to a Longinus, but in time, you could potentially use more. You also have an archive detailing the abilities of each Sacred Gear you have unlocked as well as any Balance Breakers that previous users have unlocked, as long as you meet both power and physiological requirements (for example, with the Boosted Gear, you could use the Promotion Forms as they are simply based on the Evil Pieces' promotion system, while Diabolos Dragon God would require a connection to the concepts of Dream and Infinity). Note: The Book contains notes on the holy relics and how to remove their drawbacks, thus eliminating the need to go to the Heaven of DxD, as well as the blueprint for the seal used on Trihexa, though if used by anyone below the level of an Ultimate-class being (which can wipe out places like Japan with relative ease), it will cause instant death unless an alternative power source other than the user is used. It also contains notes for making other holy relics, as long as the world believed they did, even if they never truly existed.
objects.title: Book of Conceptual Records (Sekiryuutei: Book of Conceptual Records)

objects.text:
Your Evangelion has undergone a significant transformation, now utilizing a true Seed of Life, granting it power comparable to Lilith and Adam. This enhanced form, known as the Pseudo-Evolution State, consists of two phases. The Initial Phase, which triggers luminescent armor, eyes, and a mouth to radiate light, greatly amplifying your Eva strength, surpassing even the Angel of Might or Unit-01's initial phase. During this state, your Eva gains a halo, and wings made of light, and can utilize it's AT-Field to warp the physical reality surrounding it. 

The second phase, termed the Awakened State, allows your Eva to fully ascend to its true form, metamorphosing into a godlike entity similar to an energy condensate or Radiant Giant. It possesses the capability to initiate a True Third Impact, an immensely powerful catastrophic event capable of reshaping the planet, and allowing you subsume the entire world in your AT-Field. 

To assess the potency of even a fraction of a composite Seed of Life, an Awakened Eva-13 withstood an onslaught by the AAA Wunder, sustaining minimal damage. Your Eva, fashioned with the complete power of a progenitor entity, would undoubtedly be even more formidable. In this heightened state, your Eva gains access to its Chamber of Guf, also known as the Anti-Universe or Minus Space. This realm serves as an infinite repository for souls and various items. Governed by distinct laws, the LCL within this space constructs a virtual environment from individuals' memories.
