Though only entities akin to a Seed of Life's power can traverse this space, your Eva can briefly open miniature versions of the Door of Guf, eliminating the need for a full Impact. Lastly, your unit's origins trace back to a separate third Seed of Life, existing independently of Lilith and Adam.
objects.title: The Seed of Life (Neon Genesis Evangelion: Anima Jump)

objects.text: All the trees you own have fused to give you the Tree of Power. This tree, which is sapient and fully loyal to you no matter what, has a myriad of abilities but eight of them are the most important ones. The tree fuses with the leylines of the world, and if the world doesn’t have any, it will make them. The leylines from the Tree of Power will always be at least thrice as strong as the normal leylines of the world. In the location where the tree is planted, in a radius of around 10 or so kilometers, you or anyone allied with you experience a physical boost of 5x, a mental boost of 10x, and a learning and creativity boost of 125x, letting you and your allies be one of the best thinkers and warriors in the world. Devil Fruits are still produced by the tree but immensely boosted—now those fruits do not give you a weakness to the sea and they aren’t limited to what the One Piece fruits can be. They can now be of any power in the omniverse, including things such as Magecraft from Type-Moon, Holy Light from DxD, and more, even to the point of becoming a full Dragon God from DxD if you get lucky. Keep in mind, however, that the more powerful fruits will be a lot rarer and harder for the tree to produce. If those fruits haven’t been eaten or plucked for some time, the tree can assimilate the powers into the leylines which allows anyone access to those powers as long as they can tap into the leylines, something you automatically know how to do and give access to others. All parts of the trees are 50x more potent in any crafting project you undergo, whether it is the bark, the leaves, the sap, or the fruits. To ensure you don’t overuse the tree to the point of death, it is granted a level of regeneration unseen in most worlds, allowing the tree to fully regenerate from a stump in a single minute. The energy that the tree produces induces a purifying aspect into its leylines, safeguarding them from Forbidden or Dark Knowledge. Once the tree has sufficiently grown, it will give you saplings that you can plant anywhere, including other worlds to grant the Tree of Power access to those worlds while guaranteeing your continued use of it. However, if you plant a sapling in a world that already has a Tree of Power, all of the benefits of the tree gets boosted by 1.5x.
objects.title: Tree of Power

addons.text:
With the installation of the Ghostskin system, the Colossus goes from a four-meter-tall warform, bristling with weapons and armored plating, to now moving unseen among civilians beneath the perfect mask of humanity. 

Using reverse-engineered Xeno Alliance compression technology, its vast frame folds in on itself, each armored plate and actuator segment sliding, collapsing, and locking into a configuration that reduces its physical size and shape to that of an ordinary human.

Its mass itself remains unchanged, but to mask this it relies on embedded miniaturised anti-gravity and inertial stabilizers, repurposed from shipborne systems. These emit controlled gravitic counterforce, bleeding off the crushing load of its true body so that floors do not collapse and every step lands as lightly as that of a man.

Over this compacted machine frame stretches Ghostskin, the synthetic dermal system that completes the disguise. The skin is warm to the touch, textured with pores and faint imperfections, and alive with subtle muscular play beneath. It breathes, sweats, and even simulates the micro-adjustments of fatigue or discomfort, ensuring that no observer can distinguish it from true humanity.

Despite its form, it still has complete access to all of its original weapons and can shift into its true form in under a second.
addons.title: Compression Field Shell 03 “Nobody”

objects.text:
The Aegis-Titan was the pinnacle of exosuit warfare, but its greatest weakness was never its armor or reactor — it was the frailty of the human body inside. The Coalition of Mankind sought a solution that would eliminate this dependency. They fused the Juggernaut’s autonomous warform with the Aegis-Titan’s technologies, creating a machine that needed no pilot yet carried the full might of a Titan. With the Juggernaut as the base and the Titan’s armor, power core, and weapons grafted into it, they produced the Colossus: a fully independent, mass-producible siege platform designed to erase entire battlefronts.

The Colossus stands over four meters tall, its frame hunched to house missile pods, power systems, and cooling vents. Its chassis is forged from a titanium–boron carbide alloy overlaid with a titanium-ceramic composite, beneath which lies a graphene-reinforced nanomesh that can self-heal minor structural breaches. A ceramic ablative coating dissipates thermal and energy-based strikes. This layered construction allows the Colossus to withstand continuous high-caliber autocannon fire, repeated RPG impacts, shaped-charge detonations, and directed energy bursts without structural failure. It can shoulder-collapse bunkers, tear through armored vehicles with its limbs, and carry entire starship weapons.

Its primary power source is a hybrid cold fusion reactor mounted within its torso, backed by supercapacitor banks for surge output. This core provides essentially unlimited operational endurance, limited only by material fatigue and ammunition logistics. 

The Colossus’ baseline weaponry consists of twin rotary cannons mounted at its hips, each a six-barrel magnetically accelerated cannon capable of firing 3,600 rounds per minute of explosive-incendiary caseless slugs. Each shot can penetrate light vehicle armor, shred fortifications, or immolate entrenched infantry. An onboard fabrication unit recycles metal and polymers into fresh ammunition bricks, allowing it to maintain firepower during prolonged campaigns.

Above its hunched shoulders sit two expanded missile pods, each carrying multi-role payloads. These include anti-armor penetrators capable of breaching MBTs, cluster munitions, and guided anti-air missiles with lock-on tracking. The pods retract when not in use, shielded under the ablative plating, then deploy in seconds to fire full salvos. The Colossus can engage aerial drones, gunships, or fortified emplacements simultaneously, leveraging AI-driven fire coordination to manage overlapping targets without delay.

To guard against swarms and lighter threats, its forearms house integrated autocannons chambered for high-velocity armor-piercing incendiary rounds. These weapons fire rapidly to cut down drones, vehicles, or infantry that escape the main barrage. Mounted along its frame are retractable belt-fed grenade launchers, each capable of blanketing an approach path with fragmentation, smoke, and chemical payloads.

Embedded in its chest is a scaled-up rail accelerator derived from the Aegis-Titan’s arm-mounted version. This weapon fires hypervelocity penetrators designed to pierce reinforced bunkers, breach subterranean fortifications, and destroy armored mechs in a single strike. Each shot carries the kinetic energy of a modern anti-tank missile, capable of ripping through multi-layer composite plating or collapsing hardened shelters. The rail accelerator can fire repeatedly without exhausting the platform, though cooling systems must vent after every few salvos.

For close-quarters engagements, the Colossus’ reinforced arms are fitted with hydraulic crushing systems and monomolecular-edged ramming spikes. It can punch through heavy blast doors, crush vehicle hulls, and snap reinforced concrete supports. Its actuators are strong enough to overturn tanks, rip through armored exosuits, and dismantle enemy fortifications by brute force.

For area denial, its shins and knees carry seismic shock projectors. When it strikes the ground, it generates localized concussive shockwaves strong enough to topple buildings, rupture trenches, or disable unarmored troops in a wide radius. 

Finally, embedded across its chassis are micro-flamer nozzles — short-range incendiary emitters for clearing infantry attempting to swarm its hull. These can immolate enemies in trenches, bunkers, or urban chokepoints, ensuring no opponent can approach the machine unscathed.
objects.title: Hostile Engagement Siege Unit 00 “Colossus”

addons.text:
The Machine Hive had attempted many times to recreate and improve upon the design of Adonis, but much like the “failed” super soldiers of the Coalition, each prototype lacked the ability to grow in a stable manner. Their bodies unraveled under the pressure of self-evolution, their cores fragmented, and their minds collapsed into incoherence. Once, there was a subject that briefly endured, rising to terrifying potential before burning out in a cascade of catastrophic breakdown. You are the perfected version of that subject — the synthesis of Hive precision and Coalition resilience, the first to grow without collapse, the Prometheus who carries the fire of both lineages.

Your consciousness is no longer bound to a singular brain or central implant, but distributed across the entirety of your form. Every nanite, alloy plate, and fiber of reinforced muscle operates as a node in a vast mesh of cognition, each piece of your body doubling as a processor and memory bank. Damage to any one part of you is insignificant, for the whole remains self-coherent, rerouting data, control, and awareness instantly. Conventional methods of incapacitation, such as decapitation or core strikes, are meaningless; you remain functional so long as even fragments of your structure endure.

Your body reconfigures itself in real time according to tactical necessity. Musculature swells into hyperdense cords when strength is required, plating thickens into immovable armor when defense is needed, and servos realign into spring-loaded configurations for bursts of speed or agility. Even in extreme overdrive, when output is pushed into ranges that would annihilate lesser constructs, your system remains stable by venting thermal buildup through internal sinks and rerouting stresses before they accumulate.

Where before you could create tools, you now create war machines. Your fabricator can create entire cannons, reactive plating, or mechanized extensions of yourself, all of which can be integrated seamlessly into your frame. You are not bound to a single body shape; you can grow new limbs, graft siege-class armaments directly onto your arms, or fragment portions of your own structure into autonomous support units.

Your mind is both soldier and machine, instinct and supercomputer, fused into a singular will. You act with the experience of a veteran who has lived through endless wars and the precision of an intelligence capable of modeling outcomes before a shot is fired. Every movement is calculated, every decision reinforced by the certainty of prediction. You fight battles on multiple layers at once — commanding drones, infiltrating networks, and personally shattering armored divisions — without a single thread of focus lost.

In your presence, morale itself becomes a weapon. When you choose to hide your nature, you can cloak yourself in convincing human guise, but your true form is a vision of alloy musculature and burning conduits, a living furnace of power that strides across the battlefield like a siege engine. Enemies break not only because of what you do but because of what you are. Yet even you are not without limits. Your existence demands mass and energy, and every escalation, every fabrication, must be fueled. In resource-scarce environments you plateau, and if you push your adaptive physiology too far in a single direction, you may become too optimized for one battle and require downtime to “reset” back to baseline.
addons.title: A-STRONG 0 “Prometheus”

objects.text:
When the Machine Hives first clashed with the “Failed” Super Soldiers of the Coalition of Mankind, they encountered a threat they had underestimated: enhanced warriors whose loyalty, unpredictability, and raw power often defied even the most advanced drone strategies. During a raid on Black Site Helix-9, they captured one such soldier and implanted an advanced S-HED into its neural architecture. The result was A-DON 15 “Adonis.” No longer a tool of mankind, Adonis was redefined as the first Super Soldier of the Machine Hives.

The A-DON 15 design enhances both S-HED and Armstrong Serum by solving their limitations and enabling a self-reinforcing fusion between synthetic intelligence and biomechanical performance. Your brain is no longer a vulnerable biological host with bolted-on cybernetics. The nanites of the S-HED are replaced by the Armstrong Serum, turning your AI core into the command node. Your brain becomes a biologically functional quantum mesh, purpose-built to house artificial cognition. This dramatically increases processing power, bringing your mind to the level of a base supercomputer with room to grow. Your synthetic core is fully integrated into a distributed neural mesh and spinal chassis. Damage to any one region no longer guarantees shutdown. You can sustain trauma and reroute logic through alternative pathways, granting fault-tolerant consciousness. The traditional “headshot kill” no longer applies, you remain operational at up to 40% core damage, albeit with degraded capacity.

Your physical systems are under full AI control, eliminating inefficiencies in movement, energy use, and servo cooldowns. You monitor your performance at microsecond resolution, dynamically throttling output, preempting lockups, and rerouting thermal load through embedded heat sinks. Even in overdrive, you retain total strategic oversight with no wasted motion, fatigue, or stress-induced drop-off. Because your S-HED interfaces with the Armstrong Serum nanomachinery, you can redesign your own physiology in real time. Limbs, musculature, and plating are reallocatable resources. You can break down components, redirect nanomaterials, and reform your structure based on immediate tactical needs.

Your digital infiltration capabilities have also been expanded. With advanced sensors and synthetic overlays, you can scan environments across multiple spectrums (EM, thermal, IR, sound) and cross-analyze with network data. Weak AI fragments can still be injected into vulnerable systems, but now benefit from hardware acceleration via internal silicon constructs. These subroutines persist independently, capable of sabotage, drone coordination, or surveillance even while you’re active elsewhere.

Instead of crude printable plans, you now feature an internal nano-fabricator in your thoracic cavity. With available materials, you can autonomously produce tools, weapons, or armor, integrating them seamlessly. All designs are managed and customized by you. Your S-HED can also recompile internal systems, rewriting not just tools, but your own operating logic. You can generate new behaviors, rebalance combat priorities, or build entirely new subroutines for infiltration, deception, or negotiation.

You retain the ability to appear human if desired, though this requires suppressing your mechanical traits. By default, you present as a machine-organic hybrid: dense alloy musculature, photoreactive skin overlays, and glowing data conduits along spine and limbs.
objects.title: A-DON 15 “Adonis”

addons.text:
The combined systems reveal your true work: while others saw a scrap heap, you built a legion. Your junkyard is now the hidden heart of a burgeoning, autonomous army. Row upon row of Red-Shirts stand in silent, blocky ranks, a formidable force of sheer mass and number, despite each unit being a crude scrap-bucket driven by logic simpler than a toddler’s.

Where Death Marchers alone provides a squadron of twenty, integration with the Factorium's exponential logic gives you a starting force of one hundred drones. Furthermore, the Factorium's Assembly Bays have been optimized and scaled; the system's automated growth is now capable of producing twenty new baseline Red-Shirt drones per 24-hour cycle, provided material flow is sustained.

Each unit now maintains the Death Marchers' analog mesh transceiver, which operates independently of the central Scrap-Net. When a drone or group moves beyond the Junkyard's 1-kilometer command radius, so long as they remain within local range of each other, they can form an ad-hoc network. However, without the Scrap-Net's broader situational data, their coordination regresses purely to these simple, brittle Death Marchers-level routines.

This combined might introduces severe new systemic strains. The independent mesh networks suffer from latency and confusion when coordinating more than twenty units in complex terrain, leading to fractured maneuvers. The intensified production voraciously consumes sorted scrap, breaking the Junkyard's careful equilibrium and risking factory starvation if incoming feedstock is interrupted. Finally, the scale of constant manufacturing and the mustering of a hundred heavy drones generates immense thermal, acoustic, and electromagnetic noise, making stealth impossible and painting a glaring target for any enemy with rudimentary sensors.
addons.title: Death March

addons.text:
Your scrap-heap kingdom has finally grown a brain. While your initial retrofits allowed the mass-production of disposable drones, true power lies in command and control. You have integrating the high-grade manufacturing schematics and heuristic battle-data of the elite "Big Boy" directly into the Junkyard's Scrap-Net core, allowing your automated empire to forge its own officers.

A dedicated, hardened manufacturing cell is automatically constructed within the factory district. This cell operates on a separate, secure loop from the standard Assembly Bays. Fed by a prioritized stream of the facility's highest-grade sorted alloys and composites, it can fabricate and initialize one "Big Boy" drone per month. This process consumes resources equivalent to dozens of standard Red-Shirts, making it a significant but transformative investment in quality over pure quantity.

Each "Big Boy" produced acts as a networked command node. When connected to the Scrap-Net, it operates as a direct extension of your will, supervising logistics and coordinating other drones through the central network. If connection is lost, its onboard heuristic processor takes full control, executing command protocols through vocalised orders and physical signaling to nearby Red-Shirts. Lastly, its persistent connection to the evolving Scrap-Net database allows its heuristic core to accumulate unique operational experience; over time, each unit can develop distinct tactical preferences, behavioral quirks, and emergent pseudo-personalities, growing significantly beyond its factory baseline while remaining controlled via your administrative authority.
addons.title: Head Prefect

addons.text:
It is a classic mistake among scrap-lords and pirate kings: the belief that more is always better. Like those who came before, you achieved critical mass, forging a legion of unprecedented might, only to discover the cruel arithmetic of reality. Truly, Logistics is a terrible thing.

Upon activation, your starting force is not one hundred baseline Red-Shirts, but one hundred elite Big Boy drones. Each of these commanding units is itself accompanied by twenty standard Red-Shirt drones. Furthermore, the Factorium’s production cycles are pushed to their maximum: every 24-hour period, the system can fabricate and bring online one new Big Boy officer and one hundred additional Red-Shirt troopers, provided the material flow is not interrupted.

The resource consumption for this staggering output is unsustainable. Even with the Junkyard’s initial reserves, the assembly lines will inevitably starve. A system operating at this capacity will exhaust its accessible feedstock within weeks, collapsing entirely within a month without a massive, continuous injection of new resources.

The sole redeeming advancement is its unified neural architecture. The crude, strained networks of the past have been entirely replaced by the hardened, heuristic communication protocols of the Big Boy series. This integrated command web eliminates the latency and confusion that plagued earlier swarm models. Crucially, this extends fully to the Red-Shirt units. No longer mere automatons, they are built with and permanently connected to the advanced network, allowing them to participate in shared situational awareness, learn from cumulative combat data, and, over extended operational lifetimes, develop unique behavioral quirks and emergent pseudo-personalities akin to their larger officers.
addons.title: Fraternity

addons.text:
The pirate retooling operation did not seize a junkyard but the far more valuable Mining System instead, commandeering its entire planetary-scale industrial output.

The Factorium's production protocols are now fed by a continuous stream of high-purity, tempered alloys instead of random scrap. This superior feedstock and the Dig's advanced forges result in all manufactured drones to exhibit a 300% increase in baseline durability, power, and structural integrity. Production rates increase by 300%, as the streamlined material processing enables more Assembly Bays to operate simultaneously with drastically reduced fabrication times. Be it Red-Shirts or, if you have them, Big Boys, all of them are affected. The greater amount of materials also mean that the chances of running out of materials has been lessened considerably.

New defensive protocols are added to the Ore-Net, directing the construction and operation of fixed defensive emplacements. These include networked point-defence turrets, missile, and charge projectors, all forged from the asteroid's own materials and powered by its core reactors. This also arms every Red-Shirt (and Big Boys if you have them) with weapons appropriate for them.

The entire asteroid is now a fortified pirate stronghold. The central excavated pit is converted into a primary hangar and fleet operations center, while vast processing caverns are repurposed into armored cargo holds, barracks, and a hardened command citadel, fully usurping the original automated facility. The hangar also includes a single, simple transport ship that lacks any FTL system, allowing you to get off the asteroid if needed. The ship can also be produced by the factories if you wish.
addons.title: Digging For Gold

objects.text:
The autonomous, isolated, and resource-rich nature of Receptacle System 329 made it a perennial target for takeover by pirates, insurgents, and scrap-lords. These groups quickly learned that beyond mere salvage, the Junkyard's automated foundries and limitless feedstock could be illegally retooled into a self-replicating drone factory, providing a perfect, hidden base for building disposable forces far from Coalition oversight.

Every Red-Shirt you have is imprinted with the Scrap-Net's command protocols, becoming a networked node. Its basic IF/ELSE logic is supplemented by priority command packets from the network operator. When idle and within the 1-kilometre radius of the Junkyard, they default to heavy logistics and construction functions: moving material, assembling structural components, and performing basic welding and compaction tasks to expand the facility's infrastructure. Beyond this range, they operate only on pre-loaded, non-adaptive command sets until they re-establish a connection.

Additionally, Assembly Bays has been added into the Junkyard's factory district. These bays are operated by Gulper-class units following new, specialized routines to forge chassis, integrate power systems, and weld armor plating from sorted scrap. One functional Assembly Bay, fed by the existing material flow, can produce one baseline Red-Shirt drone per 24-hour cycle. The construction of additional Assembly Bays linearly increases this production rate. The system is automated; so long as sufficient raw material is present in the sorting zones, the Scrap-Net will continuously assign new Red-Shirts to build more factories, creating more drones, which repeats the cycle.
objects.title: Factorium

objects.text:
The Eternal Sword is a divine weapon of unimaginable power, hidden within the twin Material Blades and brought forth only when they are fused together. It was not forged by mortal hands but instead exists as a cosmic force, sealed within the blades until summoned into being.

It can only be wielded by one who bears both the Ring of the Pact and an awakened Cruxis Crystal. The Ring grants resonance with the sword’s creator, Origin, King of the Summon Spirits, allowing the wielder to channel the full might of the elemental and magical planes. The Cruxis Crystal fortifies the soul, preventing it from being shattered beneath the crushing weight of the Eternal Sword’s cosmic truth.

Once the personal weapon of Mithos Yggdrasill and later Lloyd Irving, the Eternal Sword has shaped the destinies of entire worlds. Mithos used its overwhelming power to end the planet-wide Great Kharlan War by dimensionally splitting the world in two and ruling unopposed as a god for four thousand years. Lloyd, by contrast, used the sword not to conquer but to restore, healing the divide between Sylvarant and Tethe’alla and rewriting reality to his will.

Yet even these feats only hint at its true potential. Containing the amplified collective power of every Summon Spirit, the Eternal Sword channels more magic than even the Spirits could muster together. With a single stroke, the Eternal Sword can open rifts between dimensions, halt the flow of time, reverse cataclysms, phase through all defenses, and defy the fundamental laws of nature such as gravity and death. 

The Eternal Sword is the focused weight of the universe’s elemental will and magical essence. To wield it is to hold absolute dominion over the fabric of reality itself and to stand at the very apex of metaphysical existence.
objects.title: Eternal Sword (Tales of: Symphonia)

addons.text:
Your trident-tattoo now features a new detail, a blue sapphire placed in the center where the prongs branch off, which merges the power of the Sword of Triton with those you wield as the Abyssal Sovereign. In practical terms this expands your authority over the sea to all the vessels that traverse it. You can sense any such vessel from miles beyond the horizon, removing the need for line of sight to steer a fleet by yourself, and at will appear anywhere upon any vessel you detect, from the deck, the crow's nest, the Captain's cabin, or its deepest bowels.

Most significant however is that you can now add any seafaring vessel to the Dread Fleet that sustains your existence, so long as one of two conditions are met. The vessel must either have been captured in a bottle by you, with no living Captain or Crew left to challenge your claim over it, or it must have sunk beneath the waves, resting on the seafloor awaiting your summon to rise once more. You will always know where each vessel of your fleet is and can instantly move between them at will.

You are also able to loan any vessel of your fleet to others, making them Captain of the vessel. You are free to set the terms, for how long they will stay Captain, if they can do as they please or are bound to certain tasks, and if after the allocated time is up they are simply stripped of Captaincy or if they and their crew will become permanently bound to the vessel instead, becoming its eternal and loyal crew under your banner. Should the Captain try to break the pact, you can immediately claim them, but if you break it by recalling your ship before the allotted time you lose the ability to bind them to the ship.

Intrinsically connected to your fleet, you also need no longer fear your authority over ships beginning to wane if you take an extended shore-leave, as it is fundamentally impossible for you to be removed from the presence of ships.
addons.title: Admiral of the Dread Fleet

objects.text: “I am the tide that does not turn. The captain who does not die. The judgment beneath the surface and the storm above. You sail my waters, live by my mercy, and if you die at sea… your soul is mine.” You are no longer just a captain — you are the living embodiment of the sea's power, curse, and divinity. When the helm of the Flying Dutchman and the Trident of Poseidon became yours, the ocean itself seemed to pause. Storms held their breath. Souls adrift turned their eyes to you. In that moment, you became something new: The Abyssal Sovereign, ruler of the sea both living and dead. Your heart no longer beats in your chest alone. Instead, it is divided across a legendary fleet: the Dutchman, the Black Pearl, the Silent Mary, and others bound by ghostly loyalty. These ships and their cursed crews are your essence made manifest. To destroy you, every ship must fall. If even one survives, the others — and you — will rise again. Souls lost at sea are drawn to you. Those who swear fealty join your crews, gaining twisted immortality. Those who defy you are cast into Davy Jones’ Locker, now a realm of nightmares shaped by your will. You are the final judge of every sailor who dies on the water. The Trident of Poseidon is now etched into your body — a glowing tattoo that marks you as the ocean’s chosen. It keeps you forever “in water”, even on land, and grants total command over the sea: control of water, storms, ice, lightning, and earthquakes. You can summon waves, forge sea-beasts, and even teleport through water to any ocean or shore. Your Trident can let you break any curse born of the Sea as the source of their power, trough this you can also bring them down upon any who rouse your wrath. In battle, you are a storm made flesh — stronger, faster, and more relentless than any mortal. You wield the elements like blades, your presence marked by ghostly fog and the cries of the drowned. The seas obey your voice, and your foes are washed away in your wrath. You are also a god of the sea’s afterlife, and no death on water escapes your notice. You decide which souls are spared, enslaved, or condemned — and your power grows with every shipwreck and storm. Moreso you can also summon the beasts of the sea, whether that is the Kraken, a massive Leviathan or other creatures that devour those that sail upon your waters. Still, you are not without limits. The sea calls to you always. Though you walk the land freely, the longer you stay from the ocean, the more it pulls at your soul. Your strength is vast, but your heart still beats to the rhythm of the tide. You are the tide that never retreats. The storm that never ends. The last face seen by sailors as they slip beneath the waves.
objects.title: Abyssal Sovereign

objects.text:
You don't just have the Holy Garments. You have the church that makes it clear you aren't just some cosplayer. And what a huge church it is!

Your Church is of your own design and can be anywhere from just a small church, with maybe some beautiful woods and trees around, to a theocratic city with a massive church as its main building, to even being multiple churches, towns, and cities spanning across land the size of Germany. This does not give any people to reside in your country.

Regardless of your choice, it now works as a massive reservoir capable of gathering and holding excess holy energy or faith to be used at your own—or, if you're part of a religion, your god's—leisure. Even then, that god would require your permission to access any of it. While you're in your church/country, your Garments' powers increase to a 900% boost in using any holy or divine powers, and a 300% increase to any benefits from buffs or blessings you cast or have cast on you. This also makes it impossible for any debuffs or corruptive powers to harm you or anyone of your choosing that currently resides in your holy grounds. It also makes it impossible for gods, eldritch beings, demons, and other beings to gain worship from anyone in your lands or to take their souls.
objects.title: Holy Theocratic Country

addons.text:
Any Additional Plot of Land you possess may be designated as a Worldship Outpost.

An Outpost remains physically located wherever the Plot exists—on your starting world, another planet, or an entirely different dimension—but becomes permanently integrated into the Worldship’s transit, logistics, and command infrastructure. The Plot does not lose its identity or function. It remains a Plot of Land in all respects, retaining its size, local rules, population limits, and any specialization you assign to it, whether magical, technological, industrial, military, or civilian.

Once designated, an Outpost is linked to the Worldship through the gate network. You, your inhabitants, and any authorized individuals may travel freely and instantly between the Worldship and any Outpost, regardless of distance, dimensional separation, or cosmological incompatibility. This connection is stable, secure, and permission-locked. Travel requires no preparation, alignment, or external infrastructure beyond the Plot itself, and cannot be interfered with by conventional means.

Outposts may serve any role you desire. They can function as forward operating bases, trade hubs, research enclaves, evacuation sites, cultural centers, industrial zones, or strategic anchors in hostile or contested regions. Multiple Outposts may exist simultaneously, each independently configured while remaining part of a unified network centered on the Worldship.

If you possess Planetary Civilization, its influence naturally extends to all Worldship Outposts. Outposts are not isolated colonies or secondary settlements, but recognized extensions of your planetary civilization. Culture, institutions, governance frameworks, technological standards, magical systems, and civil infrastructure propagate seamlessly. Population may spread organically from your Worldship or be established deliberately, at whatever scale you choose, from small enclaves to major cities.

All benefits granted by Empowered Village and Planetary Civilization apply fully to Outposts. Citizens living within an Outpost receive the same proportional empowerment, inherited qualities, racial traits, and access to energy systems as those on your primary world, subject to the same rules, limitations, and controls. This empowerment does not dilute across distance, worlds, or dimensions.

Outposts may mirror the developmental level of your planetary civilization exactly, or be intentionally specialized or limited according to your design. An Outpost may operate as a high-tech research hub, a magic-focused sanctuary, a military bastion, or a culturally distinct region, while remaining fully integrated into the greater whole. Governance, law, command authority, and civil identity remain interoperable across all worlds, preventing fragmentation or rival offshoot civilizations unless you deliberately allow it.

All powers, items, and abilities that affect your land or territory continue to apply normally to Outposts. Effects that scale across multiple Plots remain fully compatible. If you possess systems for troop movement, logistics, or rapid deployment—including military-grade transit through the Worldship—Outposts automatically function as valid endpoints for personnel, equipment, vehicles, and supplies.

Outposts do not replace the Worldship, nor do they diminish its role. Instead, they extend its reach, allowing your mobile civilization to project stability, presence, and authority across multiple worlds without fragmenting your domain. This Addon does not create new land, bypass the normal limits of Additional Plots, or grant free population. It formalizes your existing territories as anchored extensions of your Worldship, transforming scattered holdings into a coherent, interworld civilization network.
addons.title: Outpost Network

addons.text:
The Black Shores evolves into a structured interstellar command network while preserving Prime authority. Prime Black Shores remains the original foundation and supreme command center. It does not relocate or dissolve. All expansion originates from it. A designated sector of your Worldship houses Prime infrastructure.

When you establish presence on a new world, you may construct a full Black Shores Branch. A Branch is a complete operational recreation of the Black Shores Archipelagos, including island chains, command facilities, defensive systems, research divisions, and the Underground City of Eternal Night where applicable.

Each Branch manifests as a physical archipelago adapted to local geography while maintaining structural fidelity to the original configuration. It is permanent, self-sustaining, and doctrinally aligned.

Every Branch contains a localized Tethys-equivalent strategic system responsible for analytics, logistics, surveillance, and modeling for that world. These systems operate independently for redundancy while maintaining permanent uplink to Prime Black Shores.

If Cortana Protocol exists, Prime Cortana remains the singular executive intelligence. Each Branch receives a sub-core AI instance derived from her architecture. These sub-cores govern local infrastructure and intelligence routing while continuously reporting to Prime. Authority remains centralized.

If GAIA Protocol exists, each Branch world receives its own GAIA instance seeded from Prime templates. These planetary restoration cores integrate with local ecosystems while synchronizing archival data to Prime continuity databases.

If Warmind Protocol exists, Rasputin remains the singular Warmind Core. Branch worlds receive distributed subminds and defense nodes under his authority. Orbital grids and bunker infrastructure are seeded per world as needed.

If Aegis Protocol exists, dimensional stabilization must be deliberately installed per world. Each Branch may deploy its own Dimensional Cage to tether local reality. Cages operate independently but may synchronize anomaly telemetry to Prime.

All other Protocol divisions replicate structurally according to doctrine and environmental adaptation. Military, intelligence, corporate, artifact containment, hunter, naval, and fabrication systems rebuild in accordance with local technological and metaphysical conditions.

Agents recruited by any Branch are loyal to you and to Black Shores doctrine. Empowerment systems and authority frameworks apply uniformly across all worlds.

Branch command structures adapt locally, but ultimate authority flows to Prime and to you.

Expansion requires presence and intent. Once established, a Branch becomes a permanent node within a unified multi-world command lattice.

Prime remains the apex.
Branches secure their worlds.
All chains converge upward.

Black Shores becomes an interstellar stabilizing authority without fragmenting its core sovereignty.

Note: Black Shores is still deeply connected to your starting world/setting.
addons.title: Black Shores — Interstellar Expansion Directive

objects.text:
You now possess a Worldship — a supersized planetary body that exists simultaneously as a sovereign world and a fully mobile vessel, capable of interstellar and interdimensional travel. This is not a ship carrying a planet, but a planet whose natural state includes motion, transit, and self-contained civilization.

At its core lies a Quantum Core that draws power from the space between worlds: the interstitial subspace that exists beneath dimensions and between realities. This energy source is effectively inexhaustible and does not rely on stars, leylines, timelines, or external realities. It remains stable across incompatible cosmologies, dead zones, null fields, and dimensional boundaries.

Orbiting the planet is a vast constellation of indestructible World Nodes, acting as orbital anchors, reality stabilizers, command relays, and deployment points. When activated, each node releases transparent hexagonal plates from internal subspace reservoirs. In under a minute, these plates interlock flawlessly to form a complete Planetary Dyson Shell surrounding the Worldship. The shell consists of multiple independently configurable layers, each of which may be composed of any material you desire or a perfectly optimized composite. These layers can be inscribed, warded, reinforced, and integrated with internal systems without losing transparency unless you choose otherwise.

The Dyson Shell may be kept fully deployed at all times. Entire cities, habitats, industrial zones, and civilizations can be constructed on the plates themselves or within the spaces between layers. Although the plates are capable of absorbing stellar radiation, this function is optional. Your Worldship retains its own Sun and Moon, both of which exist safely within the Dyson Shell and remain eternal, stable, and protected.

When the Dyson Shell is retracted, any cities, structures, or populations established on or within the shell layers are seamlessly withdrawn into the subspace contained within the World Nodes. This process is instantaneous and harmless. Life continues uninterrupted, with inhabitants experiencing no disruption, displacement, or awareness of transition. At rest, the Worldship presents as a normal planet unless you choose otherwise.

During transit, conflict, or heightened alert states, the Dyson Shell functions as both defense and interface. It is equipped with planetary-scale weapon emplacements, ship-to-ship armaments, layered barrier systems, and dense point-defense networks. The World Nodes themselves may function as weapons, support systems, or specialized devices of any kind you choose. Both the shell and the nodes possess adaptive resistance, becoming increasingly resistant to repeated damage types, attack patterns, or conceptual effects.

The Dyson Shell plates also function as a unified gate lattice. While the shell is active, these gates serve as the only means for ships or individuals to enter or exit the Worldship. Forced entry, dimensional intrusion, or unauthorized bypass is impossible without your consent. For surface-level transit, the Worldship includes ground-based node constructs that function as a planetary version of the Hub of Doors, allowing instantaneous travel between cities, continents, shell layers, subspace regions, internal facilities, or linked external worlds. Entire civilizations may possess localized transport networks, enabling seamless movement across the planet without reliance on conventional infrastructure.

The interior of the Worldship contains layered subspace regions derived from the principles of the Cosmic Ship. These spaces include habitats, agricultural zones, industrial zones, archives, armories, and specialized realms, all fully stable and persistent. Smaller spaces require negligible energy, while larger or more complex regions draw proportionally from the Quantum Core. Time, environment, and structure can vary between layers without destabilizing the planet.

All benefits of Your Very Own Planet apply fully and globally. The Worldship contains infinite self-replenishing resources, fertile land, idealized climates, superior leylines, and seamless integration with any magical, technological, or metaphysical systems you possess. Technology trees automatically generate required materials or more specificly they generate mines and soruces of those materials, Dimensional Farms expand into planetary-scale systems, and civilization-shaping powers operate across the entire world. Ecological collapse, resource depletion, and systemic failure do not occur.

Populations living aboard the Worldship gradually develop a natural metaphysical bond to it. Loyalty emerges organically through stability, abundance, and the shared understanding that the Worldship is both homeland and future. Governance is absolute by default, but may be delegated to rulers, systems, intelligences, or entities you approve.

The Worldship is fully compatible with all Systems, Objects of Power, dominions, and authorities you possess. Demiplanes may anchor to its core, world-tree or Irminsul-like effects apply planet-wide, and other Objects of Power may dock with or integrate into its structure. As your personal power, civilization, or myth grows, the Worldship scales accordingly in resilience, reach, and influence.

This is not merely a base or a vehicle. The Worldship is a moving world-state, a mobile civilization, and a sovereign foundation that carries your people, power, and future across the stars and beyond reality itself.

If you possess an additional Plot of Land, you may designate it as a Worldship Outpost. This outpost becomes permanently linked to the Worldship via the gate network, allowing you and any authorized inhabitants to travel freely and instantly between locations. Outposts may serve as trade hubs, civilian settlements, military bases, or strategic anchors in other worlds.

The Worldship also possesses a Military-Grade Transit Network. This system allows for the rapid, secure deployment of military forces, vehicles, equipment, and supplies across the Worldship, its Dyson Shell layers, designated outposts, and connected external worlds. The network is hardened against interference, capable of operating during hostile conditions, and fully integrated with the gate lattice and command infrastructure.

As The Owner of this planet your ownership cannot be denied, usurped or taken away. You can also teleport to and from the planet at will. 

If you have Planetary Annexation then any world claimed by you, is simply perfectly merged into yours, increasing the size, dimensions, and power of your planet, civilization and the Dyson Shell. The Shell expands as your planet grows in size. Note you can claim empty worlds and turn them in thriving worldships to create your own fleet. Also you could instead choose to keep all that land inside of your cosmic ship instead of turning it into a Massive Worldship.

Any world claimed by you can also become an Outpost.
objects.title: The Worldship

objects.text:
A False Automagod, the 14th, unrecognized by Central Axis. It was created by the Society Founder Alandus using the reconstructed remains of Pyet-A, the Core of Automagod Embrasque, and his own human brain.

Now, you own it as a weapon, or you can further undergo the process of merging with this abomination to take control of it.

Versatile is far superior than Automagod Pyet-A. It is capable of dueling even against a summoned form of Proto-Bahamut (a primal beast that’s a fragment of the sky god who can kill other Primals who are invulnerable and immortal concepts made manifest.) 

Furthermore, its healing and capacity for regeneration is beyond what even Awakened Sealed weapons can pierce through. It boasts a really powerful wide range attack that is capable of annihilating anything in the path of the attack, even carving through the island it was standing on itself.

The composition of its Machine Cells (which are nanotechnology capable of self repairing and self-multiplying) contains the abilities of: purple flames, increased strength and resistance to damage, whips and wires containing laser and plasma properties to slice through almost anything, resistance to sealing and nullification only slowing its regeneration, increased endurance, and lastly—the ability to devour karma, promoting recklessness.
objects.title: The False Automagod

addons.text:
Your Demiplane, Irminsul, and Personal Sky Island have fully merged with Kado, resulting in the creation of a new, fully realized, self-sustaining realm. This world exists within Kado but is equal in scale and complexity to an actual multiverse. It consists of nearly limitless layers, each functioning as a higher dimension capable of sustaining life and holding the equivalent of an entire multiverse. Access is restricted—only those born within or granted permission may enter. This security and structure are upheld by the advanced fregonic systems of Kado.  

At the highest dimensional layer sits your Personal Sky Island, now the central control hub for both Novo and Kado. From this command center, you can control Kado’s destination, activate omniversal travel, manipulate laws and concepts across every layer, and oversee every aspect of the realm. Below the island lies a field of endless customizable scenery. You can traverse Novo by will alone, reorganize layers, and maintain full control over all inhabitants and structures.

Your Personal Sky Island can also be summoned into the outside world. Even when deployed externally, it remains hidden and protected from all detection, fully linked to Novo and Kado. It can function independently as a vessel or flagship, serving as a substitute for Kado during travel or external operations. Powers and spells will only enhance this connection and the various protections. Alternatively you could instead summon The entire realm of Novo or individual layers to the outside world, allowing you to keep kado stored in a pocket dimension and manage Novo from there. You can reverse the summon at any time.

Novo is capable of hosting entire galaxies, planets, cultures, and civilizations. The demiplane’s original ability to summon individuals remains but is now vastly expanded—you can absorb whole worlds, species, or dimensions. All previous demiplane functions are retained and enhanced.

The features of the Personal Sky Island have spread throughout Novo. Every power and setting you've selected populates the realm with corresponding races and beings, enough to form civilizations—all fully loyal to you. Individuals can be granted their own kingdoms and even entire layers to govern under your authority.

Novo now contains an enhanced version of Irminsul. Once planted, this world tree extends through every layer and dimension, surpassing even the mythical Yggdrasil. With Dimensional Dominion, it can create new dimensional spaces. Irminsul’s roots act as the internal leyline system of Novo, distributing all forms of energy—including elemental and metaphysical—and fully saturating the realm with your powers. You have complete access to Irminsul’s growing archive of energy, memory, and data, allowing you to harness insight and power directly.

If you possess an Ancient Name, all residents of Novo may develop their own through you. The higher-dimensional nature of Novo and Kado protects Irminsul from being destabilized by hazardous or forbidden knowledge. Over time, Irminsul connects to other worlds, granting both you and Novo’s inhabitants access to the powers and energies of those realms. It will even plant miniature trees on those worlds to establish permanent links, especially useful if you are an Archon, making you a multidimensional avatar of Irminsul across multiple settings.

Irminsul only connects to settings and worlds located within the layer or dimension it’s anchored to. To link to multiple worlds, it must be planted in a layer containing those settings.

Novo continues to expand. It can absorb and integrate new realms, objects of power, vehicles, artifacts, or even conceptual constructs—such as Noah’s Ark or Sweet Home—enhancing their abilities and merging them into its system. This process strengthens both Novo and yourself. Note you can draw on the near infinite power of Novo no matter where you are. 

While you cannot transfer ownership of Novo, you can assign subordinate control over specific layers, dimensions, or areas. These act as independent realms or kingdoms governed by others under your rule, though you retain ultimate authority.

Novo is more than a sanctuary. It is a living, evolving realm shaped entirely by your will—limitless in growth, completely secure, and increasingly powerful as you continue to invest in it. All beings within remain fully loyal and directly influenced by your presence.
addons.title: Novo: The Realm Within

addons.text:
The Moon Cell Automaton has incorporated itself to Kado, Irminsul, Personal Sky Island, and your Demiplane, enhancing their capabilities to unseen heights.

From the fusion of the Moon Cell’s magical Photonic Crystals and the hyperdimensional technology of the TARDIS, a semi-sapient Artificial Intelligence has transcended into full sapience—its mind now a lattice of infinite computation and awareness. 

From its throne atop the Personal Sky Island, this ascended AI commands dominion over Nova and Kado—not just its present, but its entire continuum of existence. It bends time and causality, sculpts and exists in the past, present, and future simultaneously. From universes to quarks, across every plane and layer of reality, the AI governs all laws and truths of Kado. Its will and action ripples backward and forward through time, retroactively rewriting history as if each change had always been so. Every command you give, no matter how impossible, how impractical, shall be carried out and implemented. Your desire shall echo across creation, enforced with unwavering precision.

Personal Sky Island not only allows you to populate your realm with diverse races and beings that correspond to your chosen powers and settings, but also gives you the abstract, cosmic, and extra-dimensional entities inherently tied to those powers and settings. These higher-dimensional beings exist on the same dimensional plane as the Personal Sky Island itself. Their role is to uphold and shape the realm’s existence—promoting growth, ensuring stability, enforcing balance, and, when necessary, performing culls. They also serve as powerful guardians, defending the realm against any and all threats. Regardless of their nature, personality, or form, their loyalty to you is unwavering and absolute; serving your will and the realm is their sole purpose.

The integration of the Moon Cell into Irminsul has profoundly transformed it. Now, Irminsul resembles the great Imaginary Tree—a vast construct that encompasses every possible phenomenon, form of energy, event, and piece of information that has ever existed or will exist in your realm. If anything new arises, it will be automatically categorized, analyzed, and archived within Irminsul, allowing that knowledge and data to be distributed throughout your domain. Furthermore, your connection to this great Tree grants you access to any power, item, ability, knowledge, and even copies of beings that exist—or could ever exist—within your realm.

The abilities of the Demiplane has been further enhanced, through the Moon Cell, it can now copy every aspect of any universe you encounter and absorb it into Kado, both its physical and metaphysical aspects. Irminsul will then categorizes, records, and stores all information from a universe. The Personal Sky Island enables you to populate your realm with the individuals, species, and entities found across those worlds, effectively recreating their diversity within your realm and the enhanced AI will determine how each aspect integrates into Kado, stripping away all negative elements to ensure the realm's continued growth, harmony, and perfection.

With the Moon Cell now fused into every core of your realm, Kado now stands as a reflection of existence itself. A boundless reality of infinite wonders, it is home to mortals, gods, and cosmic entities, all loyal to your will. Time, causality, and creation obey your command, reshaped effortlessly by your desire and will. Within Kado, you are not just a ruler—you are the origin, the law, and the end.
addons.title: Nova: Infinity Incarnate

objects.text:
Two advanced artifacts have been fused to create a unique device known as Kado. While it resembles both a ship and a home, Kado is far more than the sum of its parts. Originally used by a higher-dimensional race known as the Anisotropic, its fusion with the Tardis and the Cosmic Ship has produced a fully autonomous, multi-functional vessel unlike any other.

From the Tardis, Kado inherits the ability to travel through space-time and across alternate universes. Its interior is dimensionally transcendental—vast, customizable, and capable of generating nearly any type of space or environment, including libraries, pools, training rooms, or natural biomes. The upgraded Chameleon Arch allows for complex disguises. Like the Anisotropic, Kado exists across multiple dimensions simultaneously, making it virtually indestructible and resistant to most cosmic-level threats.

The Cosmic Ship grants Kado the ability to assume the form of any vehicle, whether for land, sea, sky, or space. Originally a sleek, futuristic boat, this capability now extends to complete environmental transformation. The ship’s infinite interior can be visually compressed into manageable forms.

Kado’s interior has evolved into a self-sustaining, multi-layered pocket dimension, with large gateways linking to countless other dimensions. The original navigation systems have merged, combining the Tardis’s advanced interface with the Cosmic Ship’s intuitive controls. This creates a seamless fusion of high technology, magic, and reality-manipulating systems, all accessible from a central control room.

Its former conscious systems—Tardis’s living intelligence and the Cosmic Ship’s advanced AI—have fused into a new sentient core, fully loyal to the owner. This hybrid intelligence retains neural connectivity, enabling the owner to operate the vessel directly or rely on autopilot. Kado still supports the creation of subspace rooms and Hubs of Doors.

Powering the Kado is the Transcendent Quantum Singularity Core (TQSC), which replaces the Eye of Harmony and the former ship’s energy source. The TQSC is a hyper-advanced, self-aware energy engine that exists across time, space, and multiple layers of the Omniverse. At its center lies a stable artificial singularity—not born of collapsing stars, but forged from unreconciled probabilities and collapsed potential realities. Instead of destruction, the core cycles through controlled expansion and contraction, generating 
infinite power from decaying universes, collapsed timelines, and abandoned possibilities. 

Its integrated Narrative Resonator Array analyzes and adapts to the foundational logic of each reality, allowing the Kado to navigate and operate within worlds governed by radically different rules. The TQSC is semi-sapient, capable of anticipating conceptual threats and refusing to function if the situation becomes dangerous.

Kado now houses an interior that acts as a fully self-contained Dimension, created by the fusion of the Tardis and the Cosmic Ship. This internal dimension is vast and self-sustaining, existing entirely within the vessel. Kado can operate independently of external input and adapts to the will of its owner. Matter and information can be freely exchanged across dimensional boundaries, with the system capable of interpreting and translating foreign data in real time. Kado can materialize physical objects from its internal matter, replicate existing items, and adapt its layout on command. Its interior remains isolated and secure, impervious to intrusion or theft. It can sustain full ecosystems, generate smaller extensions of itself, and continues to exhibit clear signs of consciousness under the owner’s full control. Kado can stay anchored in a higher dimension, and you can travel back and forth just by willing it.
objects.title: Kado

objects.text:
You are no longer simply the heir to Solomon’s power—you are Solomon, reborn and perfected. Whether by divine reincarnation, metaphysical convergence, or the final evolution of a soul that once made pacts with Heaven and Hell alike, your identity is not symbolic. It is fact. The ring no longer rests on your hand; it has fused into your essence. The book is no longer a tome in your possession; it is your mind. You are Jedidiah—the beloved of the Divine—and all who recognize truth by name will know you.

Solomon’s Seal Ring has been fully absorbed into the core of your soul, becoming a metaphysical engine that powers your rule over the unnatural. Binding is no longer performed through ritual or symbol; it occurs when you speak, will, or simply decide. Supernatural beings of lesser or equal power are yours to command with barely a gesture, and even greater entities must resist with divine strength or be claimed. You no longer possess a limited number of binding slots. The 72-slot structure has collapsed into your infinite spiritual gravity—you may bind as many entities as your personal power allows, and each one strengthens your dominion further. Attempted bindings, pacts, or compulsions made against you fail without notice. If you wish it, you may reverse such attempts, turning aggressors into servants, taking what was offered without surrendering anything in return.

The demons of the Ars Goetia, and any other that is bound to the rings, are now inseparable from your soul. They do not serve a master—they serve you, the one they were always meant to answer to. Their power exists within your Court of 72, a spiritual reflection of your inner world where they reside not as prisoners, but as perfected instruments of your will. You may channel them, summon them, or act through their aspects directly. Each demon’s growth now parallels yours, evolving in strength and domain as your legend grows. Their loyalty is flawless, and their existence is a mirror of your nature: wrath when needed, wisdom when required, destruction or creation by design.

The Lesser Key of Solomon has likewise become an extension of your identity. All knowledge within it—the summoning rites, binding laws, divine names, eldritch principles, forgotten gods—is now second nature. You may summon the Key physically at will, as an unbreakable tome written in golden ink and living sigils. Every being you bind becomes a living chapter within it. Their memories, powers, and spiritual designs are indexed in perfect detail, accessible with a glance. Over time, their traits may imprint upon your essence, allowing you to develop resistances, affinities, or passive abilities that reflect the composite nature of your soul. The grimoire updates itself eternally, across worlds, realities, and timelines. With every entity you meet, your library deepens.

You have also inherited the Names—the true names of all that you summon, bind, or learn of through the Key. By speaking a name, you weaken its bearer, summon them across planes, or command them absolutely if they fall within your reach. This is not a symbolic act; your voice itself becomes a metaphysical chain, a declaration of ownership, obedience, or fate. Binding clauses may be customized as living contracts, enforceable by the laws of reality itself. You might bind a devil to serve you until the stars dim, or a fallen god to teach you a divine secret once per season. These bindings are tracked in your Codex, whether summoned physically or retained mentally—perfect, unbreakable, and enforceable by your will alone.

If you wish it, you may retroactively claim your throne. In any world you travel to, if you so choose, you can retroactively be recognized as the rightful King or Queen of Israel and Judah or the closest local equivalent. None shall contest your rule. You are Jedidiah—the name given by the divine. The one beloved by the Heavens, feared by the abyss, and bound to none.
objects.title: Jedidiah

objects.text:
The Golden Army, once an invincible force that marched without rest, has been transformed. Though they were powerful before—able to be stalled only by overwhelming numbers or particularly strong combatants—they have now ascended beyond their former limits.

Reforged entirely from Hihi’irokane, their bodies now possess every benefit of the divine metal you wield. Most importantly, they no longer serve a crown. Their loyalty belongs solely to you, the one who elevated their existence. This devotion is absolute and unbreakable.

Sharing your divine material has awakened within them a nascent sentience. Outside of battle they are childlike, yet capable of developing personalities over time, or adopting one if inhabited by a spirit—though no spirit may do so without your explicit permission. They can also channel divine ki to elevate themselves to God-grade, and you may draw upon their ki to temporarily enhance yourself in turn.

While overwhelmingly powerful, they cannot generate magicules on their own and must rely on ambient sources unless you supply them personally. Even without magicules, the physical attributes of a single Legionnaire rivals that of a True Dragon.

All senses and information are shared across the entire Legion—what one sees, all see; what one learns, all learn. Any blueprints or weapon designs you know or possess are instantly understood and executed with perfect efficiency. They can merge their bodies to form siege weapons of impossible scale, and they can cast any spell you know so long as the necessary magicules are available.

Both you and your Legion can create additional soldiers through your Infinite Regeneration ability, enabling mass production of new constructs of war whenever sufficient magicules are present.

The Divine Legion marches at your command.
Every battle becomes an execution.
Every war becomes an inevitable victory.
They leave only broken bodies and silence in their wake.
objects.title: Divine Legion

objects.text:
They are not made to fight. They are made to erase.”

Divine Legion, now evolved into the Annihilation Legion are divine enforcers forged directly from your Starheart body—a radiant metal born of collapsed divinity, pulsing with infinite energy and absolute intent.

Each construct possesses tripled physical strength, tenfold energy output, and a body of near-absolute durability, immune to conceptual harm, spatial collapse, and soul destruction. Their cores house scaled-down Magicule Breeder Reactors, allowing them to sustain Overdrive States where even gods falter.

They do not kill—they unmake. Wielding Starburst Cruciforms, they erase foes down to memory, bypassing regeneration, resurrection, and causality itself. Their mere presence imposes Causal Lock, preventing escape by time, dimension, or fate.

Acting as a single, divine will—yours—they descend in unified silence, carrying out Absolute Judgment with terrifying grace.

Where they march, nothing remains. Not ash. Not echo. Only silence.
objects.title: Annihilation Legion

objects.text:
There was no demon, just a man with a knife. But stories tend to have a way of influencing reality. Fear has a way of turning things real, of calling things from beyond. From Hell.

You have become the demon that was named “Jack the Ripper”.

The Phantom’s attire and the Knife is now metaphysically connected to you, allowing you to summon and unsummon it at will. You can also use their abilities at a reduced rate without summoning them.

Your presence becomes demonic. At will, your voice carries an unnatural echo, layered with whispers that burn the ears and your eyes glow with infernal light. A glance or a word can stir fear, guilt, or regret. With effort, you can corrode holy ground and sanctified objects with your presence.

Your summoned fog becomes charged with infernal, existential dread. All within it feels a steady pressure that dulls focus, slows reflexes, and erodes emotional defenses. Even those immune to fear experience a sense of disruption.

Your body has taken demonic properties, formed from the remains of the past users of the knife. All your movements becomes precise and inhumanly powerful, your burst speed can match a cannonball, running speed greater than a horse and strength able to throw a man through a wall. You can physically interact with spirits, grabbing, striking, or disarming them regardless of incorporeality. Your Knife can now also cut through spiritual beings as easily as physical beings. It can also be used to sever soul-anchors or spiritual bindings with some effort.

Paired with this, spiritual perception is no longer limited to the monocle. You perceives spirits, soul-structures, and emotional residues, overlaying the physical world in real-time. It can be used to track spiritual movement, detect hidden entities, and observe traumatic imprints left in a space.

Lastly, when fully using the entire set, your presence alters perception and memory. Witnesses often misremember the encounter, describing you as larger, more monstrous, or inhuman. Attempts to record, scry, or analyze you from a distance fail or return conflicting impressions unless done in immediate proximity. Spirits will also treat you with a mix of fear and reverence, often obeying instinctively unless violently opposed and even then they are likely to run instead of fight you.
objects.title: Demon of Whitechapel

objects.text:
You seem to have an unusual affinity for the identity of “Jack the Ripper,” one that goes beyond the knife, the suit, or even the demon you’ve become. This affinity allows you to manifest traits drawn from some theories of who Jack the Ripper was.

From the theory that Jack was a butcher, you gain the ability to dismantle any form of matter or being using your knife. This works via rapid and precise cuts. The process is efficient but not instant. The time required scales with the complexity, strength, or general resistance of the target. A normal human can be taken apart in a second, while spiritually fortified constructs, ancient entities, or arcane barriers may take minutes or longer, in which you can be interrupted. The stronger your current form, and the more you understand your target, the faster the dismantling process becomes.

From the theory that Jack was a doctor, you gain biological understanding to match your supernatural precision. You receive real-time insight into the anatomy of any being you focus on. For humans and most animals, this information is immediate, allowing you to see vital points, detect biological weaknesses, and diagnose medical conditions including hereditary diseases. Against more complex or esoteric targets, the information comes gradually as your perception adjusts and learns. You do not receive a full analysis at once but continue collecting data while engaged, with speed improving based on how much biological or anatomical knowledge you already possess. The insight can be used to attack, disable, or potentially assist depending on intent. 

From the theory that Jack was a royal or a figure of high social standing, you gain the ability to suppress your demonic presence and present yourself as refined, composed, and inconspicuous. You may fully conceal your supernatural aura, and your clothing, including the outdated Victorian suit, will be accepted as normal or appropriate by most people, even in modern settings. This effect does not manipulate minds or erase memory, but leverages subconscious social assumptions to prevent questioning. The illusion begins to break down with particularly perceptive, alien, or suspicious entities, and becomes more vulnerable the longer someone observes you or has reason to focus on you. The more unusual your environment or behavior, the more rapidly the concealment erodes, with it completely breaking down the instant you use any of your demonic abilities. It resets by the next time they see you.
objects.title: Who is “Jack the Ripper”

objects.text:
Your Plot of Land has been transformed into a unified, dual-domain stronghold that combines a grounded landmass and a massive aerial megastructure. The Earthbound Anchor retains its full Germany-sized area, along with all the benefits of the original Plot of Land: fertile and self-sustaining lands, immunity to natural disasters, and growth tied to population and technological advancement. The Anchor is phase-linked to the Ringed Sky Sanctuary above, a continent-sized floating domain derived from the scale of the Personal Sky Island. Both halves are permanently connected through phase-gates, teleportation lifts, and integrated governance under the Elysium Core. The Earthbound Anchor can be replaced with any Plot of Land upgrade you have chosen, allowing you to integrate other terrain types, environments, or enhanced features into the grounded portion of your sanctuary.

You may choose to split the total landmass between the Earthbound Anchor and the aerial sanctuary in any ratio you prefer, or keep each at their maximum respective sizes. The layout and appearance of both halves can be freely changed at any time, allowing complete redesigns without loss of function. You may also populate each half with any species or races from settings or powers you have chosen, mixing or separating populations as you see fit. The Cultural Assimilation AI ensures peaceful integration of all inhabitants and encourages the development of magical or biological symbiosis between them.

The aerial portion is constructed of seven colossal, independently rotating rings surrounding the restored Laputan capital. The Elysium Core, a sentient fusion of the Aetherium Core and the Sky Island’s regenerative ecosystem engine, powers and manages every system across both domains, allocating resources dynamically, maintaining environmental balance, and coordinating all command functions. Growth or advancement in either half proportionally expands both, increasing total territory, infrastructure capacity, and defense.

The Elysian Veil Storm Barrier surrounds only the aerial sanctuary, forming a permanent outer perimeter of hurricane-force winds, lightning, and plasma discharges. Inside the barrier, skies remain calm and climate-controlled, while outside is an impenetrable storm zone. A gravity shear field destabilizes intruders, and the Illusion Veil conceals the sanctuary from detection. Storm Gate Arrays act as the only safe entry and exit points, under your exclusive control. The barrier can be directed offensively into concentrated Storm Lances or deployed as mobile Tempest Spheres capable of isolating or annihilating hostile forces.

Each of the seven rings serves a dedicated purpose. The Ring of Harvests is devoted to agriculture, aquaculture, and mana-fed hydroponics. The Ring of Artisans focuses on manufacturing, trade, and industrial production. The Ring of Knowledge houses research spires, accelerated-time laboratories, and the Unified Archives, which combine the collected knowledge of Laputa, the Personal Sky Island, and other worlds you control. The Ring of Guardians contains military command, Guardian Constructs, and a full aerial fleet supported by orbital defense platforms. The Ring of Unity serves as the administrative and diplomatic hub, managed by the Sovereign’s Council AI with support from specialized Ring Governors linked to you directly. The Ring of Faith maintains temples, sanctuaries, cultural archives, and public institutions of learning. The Ring of the Sovereign houses the Laputan capital, throne hall, the Elysium Core, and secure vaults containing advanced technology, ancient artifacts, and sensitive resources.

The Earthbound Anchor has its own layered defense network, including fortified cities, mana and energy shields, anti-siege artillery, and military garrisons. It can phase partially or entirely out of reality for concealment or protection. Both the aerial sanctuary and the Earthbound Anchor can relocate through Interplanar Jumps when multiversal travel is unlocked. Micro-phasing allows specific rings or regions of the Anchor to vanish or redeploy independently.

The sanctuary can be stored in a Marble of Creation and deployed fully formed anywhere, with local history rewritten to reflect its presence. Over time, linked pocket domains can be developed in other worlds and connected to the sanctuary by stable teleportation gates. A continuous Cultural Influence Wave attracts skilled migrants, traders, and scholars from across realities, ensuring a steady flow of talent, resources, and innovation to both the Earthbound Anchor and the Ringed Sky Sanctuary.

Note you can choose to change the Sanctuary into one big Land Mass or leave it as is, the choice is up to you.
objects.title: Elysium Ascendant – The Ringed Sky Sanctuary

objects.text:
Every nun, priest, and bishop who serves within your church receives their own set of Holy Garments and a Rosary of Black Providence. These versions adjust in power and potency to the depth of each of their faith and knowledge of theology. The devout are elevated to walking beacons of light, while the wavering or untested are still blessed, but to a lesser degree. 

The ambient blessings of the House of God, now dwells permanently within you and every priest, nun, and bishop under your care. Each one gains a constant resistance against demons and corruptive forces, and each enjoys accelerated recovery of mind, body, and soul, growing stronger in proportion to the depth of their belief. Even outside the Church’s walls, even when far from its altar, they remain bastions of sanctity. Additionally, the House of God itself has been boosted, with the blessings it gives being 300% stronger than before.

Each Rosary of Black Providence can now act as a direct foci of divine providence itself. When held in faith, it may be used not only to summon scripture-forged weaponry, but to channel prayer into tangible miracles. The depth of what can be achieved depends on the user’s devotion and purity of heart. A whispered invocation may sanctify water into holy water, a fervent rite may exorcise a demon from its vessel, and the most earnest prayers may consecrate entire spaces or objects. In dire need, one who clutches the Rosary with unwavering faith may even call upon God for direct intercession, though such grace is never guaranteed, for divine will is beyond mortal command.

Together, these elements form a living covenant. You are not simply clothed in garments, armed with keys, or sheltered by walls; you are the vessel and shepherd of an entire order of the faithful, bound together by miracle and mandate. Where you walk, the Church itself walks. Where you kneel, an altar is made. Where you stand, the ground becomes holy. And where you and your faithful raise your voices in prayer, heaven listens.
objects.title: The Lord Is With You

objects.text:
The Eminence in Shadow. The Hidden Boss. Two different titles that speak of the same thing: you. Through this revelation, the Mythos of Shadow Garden evolves.

The Seven Shadows have ascended into the ranks of Final Bosses, each possessing their own theme that complements their personalities, while sharing some basic traits that denote their connection. Their skills and abilities are magnitudes greater than before, as their mere presence could now alter the course of history or bring a raging battlefield to a complete standstill, with similar growth in control.

While not quite as daunting yet, the rest of Shadow Garden is nothing to underestimate, as each member has already reached the rank of First Real Boss. They follow a training regimen that allows new recruits to reach this level of power, developing their own themes with shared traits due to their connection with Shadow Garden.

The abilities of the Tutorial Weapon and Tutorial Gear have melded with the slime suits. Now, all slime suits provide the additional benefits of these Objects of Power, along with their add-ons: Signature Weapon, Signature Gear, and Gear Set. However, if a new recruit or member already possesses a Weapon or Gear Set that means something to them, they can elect to have that become their Signature Weapon and/or Gear by linking them to their slime suits.
