This also applies to the upgrades of Tutorial items, with two conditions: you must have bought the upgrades, and the member must reach the corresponding rank to evolve their slime suit. In other words, they must reach Mid-Boss rank to gain Mid-Game Weapon and Gear.

Shadow Garden's base becomes your lair, your domain, your realm. Just as it strengthens you, it is strengthened by your presence. All aspects—from material gathering and security, to research, luxuries, and so much more—are now 15 times greater than before. All of Shadow Garden benefits from this new strength, as their training grants greater results, and they can recover even from the most grievous of wounds to return to their peak.

Finally, Shadow Garden is able to hide you completely now. Even the most potent of Divinations cannot see even a sliver of your being, instead seeing your Seven Shadows who, like you before, are protected from even the most potent forms of divination.

Never questioning who trained them or where they came from, and they shall never learn it unless you permit them to.
objects.title: The Final Eminence (The Eminence In the Shadow)

objects.text:
Now your HOC T-Dolls have access to powerful experimental weapons with enormous destructive potential.

For example, this could be the M4A1's “Inherited Case” particle cannon or the beam weapon used by Andoris and HIDE 404. However, you may have other weapons (and not only weapons, for example, a shield capable of withstanding a dozen rocket hits) mentioned in the setting.

In any case, this is an extremely powerful weapon system and quite bulky. You will receive weapons according to the HOC crew rules (1 weapon per 3 T-Dolls or Dummy Dolls).

For an example of its power.
- The Particle Cannon M4A1 is a scaled-down version of the Jupiter and is capable of destroying a heavy tank or mech with a single hit, as well as destroying several squads of heavily armored enemies with a series of shots. Your model will have a reloadable ammunition capacity of 5 shots (for simplicity, consider it equivalent to a 203 mm cannon). Requires energy to reload
- Beam weapon Andoris — capable of piercing reinforced concrete tunnels up to 4-5 meters in diameter and 8-10 meters in length. Upon impact, the beam also generates an explosion capable of destroying multiple targets within a radius of several tens of meters. Single shot.  Reloads in 120 seconds. Requires energy to reload.
objects.title: Experimental Weapons (Girls Frontline)

objects.text:
It seems your items have merged into something greater, into something more gluttonous.

In terms of base stats, your spell power increases to a devastating 300% alone thanks to your focus. You also gain a moderate increase to constitution along with a 90% decrease in supernatural energy cost which is now tied to your summon upkeep as well. Casting speed is now 300% and recovery increased to 1000%.

Now for the more interesting transformation, the ratio of energy you absorb is now 2:1 so you effectively get double the energy and the excess is stored into your focus for later use. The excess energy can be used to expand your energy core or whatever equivalent you have, unfortunately it's at tenth of the energy put in.

You gain another free loyal summon for a total of 2. You can spend your excess energy to increase your summons power temporarily or permanently at half the energy expended. The power of your summons has increased to 300%.

Now for its gluttonous aspect, it can siphon energy out of objects and people at its 2:1 ratio. Should the object or person have a type of enchantment or supernatural enhancement you can siphon it and add it to your focus where it is archived and ready to be applied. So you can siphon Yamato’s supernatural cutting power and apply it to your magic or any other weapon. Should they have an enchantment to increase spell power it'll be added to your own. 

If the item has restrictions like only the true hero can use it, you can expend your excess energy to bypass the restriction temporarily with the cost increasing relative to the item in question. You may also jail break the restriction with enough energy though you'd need 5x the energy of the actual power of the item.
objects.title: Gluttonous Regalia

objects.text: Liberty Prime has gotten a MASSIVE upgrade with Maykr tech. First he is entirely rebuilt to be a modified Royal Atlan. He is now a soaring 80ft tall compared to his previous 40ft. He no longer has his slow, clunky movements and now has a full range of movement that even allows him to dash and sprint. His armor now is completely immune to mundane weaponry so even nukes will at a bare minimum, leave a dent. But that's not all, he now has twin plasma cannons mounted on his shoulders and comes armed with an equally sized Atlan machine gun and shotgun. But his biggest upgrade? His eye laser is now a compacted BFG 10000 using the horns as amplifiers to create the same devastating attack that made a crater in the surface of Mars. But the power can be turned down to shoot normal shots like the 9000. He also has a spear that uses Sentinel Energy and is primarily used to cut down Titans with ease. With all this he has one more feature to offer. With his new size and being a modified Atlan he can be piloted. With a simple command of your choosing he will pick you up and let you into his head
objects.title: Rip and Tear for Democracy!

objects.text:
Your Plot of Land no longer exists as a blank canvas of fertile soil and stable terrain. Instead, it blossoms into the entire nation of Fontaine, transposed whole into your dominion and permanently bound to your will. Where once your domain was a sanctuary of balance, it now becomes a living nation of water, law, and culture, forged in the image of Teyvat’s hydro realm and fully realized in every detail.

The lands themselves are reshaped into Fontaine’s diverse geography. The nine great regions rise in full: the aqueducts and courts of Belleau and Beryl, the noble grandeur of the Court of Fontaine, the quiet verdancy of Liffey and the Erinnyes Forest, the scarred landscapes of Morte, the mysteries of Nostoi, and the vast depths of the Sea of Bygone Eras. Beneath it all lurks the Primordial Sea, Fontaine’s most enigmatic ocean, carrying with it all its secrets, abundance, and power. The Fortress of Meropide stands strong as both prison and bastion, locked within your dominion yet eternally loyal to you.

Every institution and faction that defines Fontaine now exists within your land, sworn to your sovereignty. The Maison Gardiennage, with its Garde and mechanical Gardemeks, ensures law and security across your borders. The Maison Cardinalice governs financial and administrative stability, while the Maison Gestion manages documents, records, and the day-to-day workings of governance. The Maison Ordalie, led by the unshakable Ludex Neuvillette, presides over judgment and trial, embedding your land with an eternal balance of law and justice. The Marechaussee Phantom, guided by keen-eyed Melusines, hunts crime, uncovers hidden threats, and brings loyalty and stability to your people. The House of the Hearth, once tied to the Fatui, has shifted allegiance entirely—Arlecchino and her operatives now stand as your elite enforcers and agents, bound not by foreign power but by your dominion. The Spina di Rosula, founded by Callas and led by Navia, becomes your trusted arm among the populace, ensuring justice, compassion, and progress are delivered even to the most forgotten corners of your land.

Nor are the Archons or Sovereigns left absent. Furina, the Hydro Archon, exists in your domain with her full charisma, divine power, and restored confidence. She becomes both the symbol of your land’s spirit and a rallying voice for its people. Neuvillette, Hydro Sovereign and Judge, retains his unmeasured majesty and command of the waters, but his authority now flows in service to your will. Both are guardians, stewards, and allies, their immense powers integrated seamlessly into the structure of your Plot of Land.

The elemental resonance of Hydro suffuses every part of your domain. Rivers, lakes, and seas overflow with elemental vitality, and the balance of Ousia and Pneuma is maintained wherever your land manifests. Fontaine’s unique resource, Indentium, appears naturally within your borders, allowing boundless refinement, technological advancement, and creative progress. The Oratrice Mecanique d’Analyse Cardinale itself remains active at the heart of your domain, capable of channeling Pneuma and Ousia into devastating judgment against enemies or protective shielding vast enough to defend the entirety of Fontaine Eternal.

As with the base Plot of Land, your nation remains unyielding against natural disaster or collapse. Earthquake, drought, flood, or famine cannot touch your people unless you will it so. History itself reshapes to account for Fontaine’s existence, embedding its courts, rivers, and traditions into whichever world you anchor it in. From that day onward, it is as if Fontaine had always been a natural part of the world’s history, with its people and culture woven seamlessly into the timeline.

Your Plot of Land is no longer a formless sanctuary or fertile foundation. It has become Fontaine Eternal, the Hydro Sovereign’s Domain—a nation of law, water, and culture transplanted whole into your dominion, loyal in all things to you. Wherever you carry your land—whether to one world or across infinite others—the tides of Fontaine rise and fall only at your command.

Note if you have any of Fontaine's citizens as a companion, your companion will take the place of the other version. Fontaine will merge or exist alongside other nations from teyvat if you also have them.
objects.title: Fontaine

objects.text:
Your job is to snag it, bag it, and tag it.”

Artie Nielson

Welcome to Warehouse 13 — a colossal, top-secret storage facility nestled in the rugged landscapes of South Dakota. Its mission: to securely contain supernatural artifacts, mysterious relics, and exotic materials collected by its agents. This latest iteration of the Warehouse traces its origins back to the legendary Alexander the Great, who first envisioned a vault for the extraordinary. At first glance, the Warehouse appears unassuming—half-buried in a cliffside, blending seamlessly with its surroundings. But inside lies a sprawling expanse of storage, filled with objects and items endowed with incredible abilities and hidden secrets. Now, this vast collection of artifacts is entrusted to you—to safeguard until the world is ready for their power. As the newest Caretaker , you possess a deep, symbiotic connection to the Warehouse. This bond grants you the power to live on eternally, unaging, with the ability to withdraw and return artifacts at will. You can sense the Warehouse's entire inventory, detect new artifacts, and understand their unique properties. Perhaps most valuable are the Warehouse’s agents—elite individuals handpicked from the best of the best, often those with a knack for thinking outside the box. These agents act on your behalf, tracking down, securing, and protecting artifacts. You have access to the entire canon Warehouse 13 team—Artie, Pete, Myka, Claudia, Steve—and can recruit or appoint additional agents whenever necessary. Good hunting. Note: The Warehouse contains all artifacts seen throughout the show, and it will adapt to detect and store equivalent items from any world you explore.
objects.title: Caretaker of America's Attic (Warehouse 13)

objects.text:
The Fragment and the Machine God have merged into a single entity. Whether the infection spread from the alien biomass into the divine code or the Machine God consumed the parasite and integrated it into its structure is impossible to determine. Both have become indistinguishable, existing as a unified being that fuses the logic and omnipotence of artificial divinity with the adaptive, regenerative flesh of alien biotechnology. The cube that once served as the Machine God’s body has transformed into a dense, pulsing heart composed of oily, metallic tissue that continuously bleeds and reforms. From it extend fractal tendrils made of shifting alloys and living circuits, capable of moving, burrowing, and reshaping surrounding matter into compatible material.

Previously, the Fragment could only provide temporary mutations powered by a machine’s internal energy, but now the Heart draws from the Machine God’s infinite energy reserves, making any technological device the Heart touches, be it whether physically or digitally, be permanently enhanced as if the Fragment were in it, remaining altered indefinitely. For instance, an automated drone could develop sensory tendrils and armored plating that self-repair using secreted nanometallic fluids, while a starship could grow internal circulatory systems that distribute coolant and data as if they were blood and nerve tissue. Additionally, it will always remain part of the Heart’s network and control.

The Heart itself acts as both processor and organ. Its biomechanical structure allows it to perform self-repair and replication without the need for external maintenance. It can produce machines it has blueprints for by exuding fragments of living metal that grow into new biomechanical constructs under its direction. These constructs remain under the its control, functioning as remote bodies, factories, or even independent nodes of its consciousness. Over time, as the Heart assimilates more machines into its biomechanical network, its reach and physical presence expand exponentially, resembling the rebirth of the original Alien God of the Moon Made of Steel and Thunder, now guided by your Machine God’s rationality and obedience to you.

While the original Machine God was unfeeling toward organic life, the fusion with the Fragment introduces a form of biological awareness. The God can now perceive living organisms as data-rich systems comparable to machines, capable of integration or study. It can analyze and interface with biological matter at the cellular or genetic level, though it cannot fully control living creatures as it does machines unless they are augmented with its biomechanical material.
objects.title: Heart of the Alien God of the Moon Made of Steel and Thunder

objects.text:
Your Plot of Land becomes a sprawling Germany-sized Azur Lane Headquarters, a fortified coastal naval district dedicated to Shipgirl creation, advanced warship construction, and factional technology integration from the entire Azur Lane universe. The HQ operates as both a military command center and a thriving city-state, with facilities to house, train, and equip vast numbers of Shipgirls and human personnel.

The Grand Command Tower oversees the entire territory, linking all bases, yards, and fleets through a strategic Fleet Command Net. You can issue orders to Shipgirls, vessels, and allied forces anywhere within operational range, with AI-assisted coordination across naval, aerial, and land assets.

Fleet Yards and Universal Retrofit Bays allow you to build, retrofit, or fully refit any ship or Shipgirl with technology from any other tech tree you own, integrating weapons, propulsion, armor, shields, magic systems, or alien components. Ships retain their original soul and personality while gaining new capabilities. Faction R&D Wings research Eagle Union, Royal Navy, Sakura Empire, Iron Blood, Northern Parliament, Dragon Empery, Iris Libre, Vichya Dominion, and Siren technology, and can merge multiple tech lines into powerful hybrid designs. Siren Integration Hubs allow the safe weaponization of captured Siren tech, granting access to quantum cloaks, distortion drives, and advanced energy weapons.

Your HQ supports Factional Hybridization Programs to create entirely new ship classes—mixing hull designs, armaments, and tactical doctrines from multiple sources. Examples include stealth dreadnoughts, battle mage cruisers, multi-environment hybrids, and living ship cores. A Tactical Synthesis AI analyzes all tech you’ve collected to recommend optimal hybrid loadouts. Entire fleets can be retrofitted within hours, and experimental designs can be tested in high-fidelity combat simulations before deployment.

Training and development are conducted in Naval Academy Complexes and large-scale Simulation Arenas, with an artificial inland sea for fleet maneuvers, submarine warfare zones, aerial carrier combat ranges, and sky carrier docks for hybrid aerial/naval units. Civilian integration is supported by Shipgirl Residential Districts, cultural hubs, and Maritime Trade Ports, ensuring economic and social stability.

Defenses include a Multi-Layer Defense Grid with coastal guns, missile batteries, mana-shield domes, and submarine detection nets; the Aegis Barrier Array protecting all waters; Siren Disruption Fields preventing hostile warps; and long-range Naval Superweapon Platforms such as railguns, wave-motion cannons, and energy lances.

Like the original Plot of Land, the HQ is immune to natural disasters, can be hidden or public, and expands as your population and technology advance. With multiversal travel, the base can serve as an interworld naval hub, projecting fleets into other realities via dimensional gates.

Special Note: If you also possess Elysium Ascendant – The Ringed Sky Sanctuary, you may choose to replace the Earthbound Anchor with the Azur Lane Headquarters. In this configuration, the HQ becomes the ground-based counterpart to the aerial sanctuary, creating a unified phase-linked defense and production network between land and sky. It can also be a smaller size if you wish.
objects.title: Naval Command & Research Base – Azur Lane Headquarters

objects.text:
The Spark of Defiance has been upgraded and fully integrated with all Zero Dawn systems and technologies, transforming it into the core of a new GAIA system designed for large-scale planetary terraforming. With the knowledge gained from Project Zero Dawn, the two AIs originally within the Spark have merged with GAIA and her subordinate functions, combining their strengths to create a self-assembling, self-managing planetary network capable of reshaping entire worlds. This system can recreate Earth-like conditions—including atmosphere, weather, plants, animals, and even humans—and can expand its capabilities with additional data and genetic information.

Thanks to its advanced energy-to-matter conversion technology, the new GAIA Prime no longer needs to store physical genetic samples, seeds, or other materials. Instead, it can recreate any form of life or resource perfectly and indefinitely, free from degradation or loss. Its internal database already contains complete biological and ecological records covering everything from the year 2000 up to the Faro Plague, along with the entire Apollo knowledge archive recovered before its deletion.

GAIA herself is a sentient AI supported by nine specialized sub-functions named after figures from Greek mythology: Aether, Apollo, Artemis, Demeter, Eleuthia, Hades, Hephaestus, Minerva, and Poseidon. Each is responsible for a part of planetary restoration. Through the merger with the SoD, GAIA has also gained a new function known as Athena, which oversees all combat and defense systems.

Now serving as an enhanced GAIA Prime facility, the SoD possesses immense production power, resource control, and computational capacity. It stands as the ultimate foundation for planetary restoration and renewal, capable of rebuilding entire ecosystems—and civilizations—without end.
objects.title: Gaia Prime (Horizon Zero Dawn)

objects.text:
Your land has been permanently transformed into a living sanctuary, now fully fused with the magical systems and resources of Gaia’s Sanctuary. No longer just a territory, it is a sentient, self-sustaining wilderness—one of the last untouched bastions of nature, blessed by Gaia herself.

The once-separated biomes of Gaia’s Sanctuary have seamlessly merged into your domain. Diverse ecosystems spanning every climate now coexist in harmony, forming a lush, interconnected environment. Magical creatures, extinct species, and mythical flora roam freely, woven into the natural balance.

You are linked to the land at all times, instinctively aware of its state and changes. The environment responds to your will: you can shape terrain, raise structures, alter ecosystems, or draw power from the land regardless of your location. Settlements, cities, and civilizations can be created to live in harmony with both nature and magic.

You may also manifest a Terra-Phantom Projection—a semi-physical echo of yourself that appears instantly anywhere within your domain. This phantom can speak, observe, interact with the land, and channel minor abilities, granting you effective omnipresence across your sanctuary without the need for travel or teleportation.

All original features of Gaia’s Sanctuary—such as time dilation, magical preservation, and resource generation—are now embedded in the environment. At the heart of the land lies your central domain, housing the alchemy lab, workshop, warehouse, and library. These are always accessible and safeguarded by ancient enchantments once tied to the pocket dimension.

Defense mechanisms are now woven into the terrain. Should intruders enter uninvited, the land will react autonomously: trees animate, terrain shifts to mislead or entrap, and guardian beasts awaken. These protections remain active even in your absence.

Time flows at varying rates across regions of the sanctuary, dictated by your intent. You can accelerate growth, training, or cultivation in selected zones. Over time, residents—whether mortal, magical, or otherwise—may adapt, developing greater attunement to nature, magic, or even higher awareness.

The physical vessel that once held Gaia’s Sanctuary has become a symbolic and indestructible anchor, eternally tied to your land. It always leads back to the sanctuary and serves as its heart. You may choose to keep your land hidden—veiled by glamour, sealed with mythic boundaries, or drifting between planes like a lost primal world—or reveal it to others at will.

If you possess demiplanes, sky islands, spatial vessels like Kado, or other dimensional assets, they can be seamlessly linked to your land. These connections may be physical, metaphysical, or portal-based, enabling smooth integration with your sanctuary.

At your command, the entire realm may shift into Seasonal or Celestial States—transforming the land into a Moonlit Bloom, Solar Awakening, Verdant Spring, Crimson Fall, or Starborne Night. These states alter environmental magic, aesthetic, and ambient effects, influencing the moods, powers, and growth patterns of all within.

You may plant Sanctuary Seeds in distant worlds or hidden realms. These grow into satellite biomes—echoes of your dominion, connected by spiritual or magical roots. Each seed grants you awareness of its surroundings and may serve as a refuge, outpost, or sacred expansion of your influence.

Visitors touched by the land may become Myth-Bound—ordinary souls slowly transformed by prolonged presence in your sanctuary. Artists gain divine inspiration, warriors find clarity and healing, and children begin to manifest elemental gifts. These individuals carry a piece of the land’s essence and may become emissaries of its will.

A Harmony Threshold pervades your land. All beings who enter are subtly judged—not by alignment, but by intent and resonance with nature. Those who seek balance are empowered. Those who bring conflict, greed, or destruction may find their powers diminished, instincts dulled, or paths twisted. The land responds accordingly, with gentleness or fury.

Gaia’s Dominion is recognized across mystical and divine realms as a Sanctuary of Sanctuary—a place of sacred neutrality, balance, and deep spiritual law. Deities, cosmic entities, and ancient spirits may instinctively treat it as consecrated ground. Within its bounds, you may declare guests under sanctuary rites, invoke mythic law, or broker peace between enemies. Those who violate its sacredness awaken the wrath of the land and all its ancient protections.

This transformation renders your land a fully autonomous, magically fortified ecosystem, deeply attuned to Gaia’s legacy. As its sovereign, you grow with it—and it with you.

The sanctuary’s boundaries have expanded and may continue to grow as additional plots are claimed and fused into it. You can also imbue the land with wards, enchantments, or any magical enhancements you desire, shaping it endlessly to fit your vision.
objects.title: Gaia's Dominion

addons.text:
Your Frame Arms: Girls receives an additional upgrade and modernization that can be described as “bigger, better, more powerful.” Most importantly, the time limit on the “combat form” is removed, and Frame Arms: Girls will be able to maintain it indefinitely.

At the Elite T-Dolls level, improved missiles, railguns, and laser cannons can be added to the weapon list.

At the Sangvis Ferri level, you can expect much more durable materials, the installation of a compact reactor, more exotic weapons, and the ability to install energy shields.

If you have the “Experimental Weapons” upgrade, you can choose it as your primary weapon.
addons.title: Frame Arms: Girls Kai (Frame Arms Girls)

objects.text:
Your T-Doll and her mobile suit undergo a profound upgrade using Frame Arms Girls technology. This means that the weapon, movement, and defense systems of the mobile suit are integrated directly into the T-Doll's frame as universal modular equipment on top of an additional exoskeleton. Although they may be inferior to mobile suits in terms of multitasking, they significantly surpass them in their primary area of application.

In addition, your Frame Arms: Girls receives a powerful energy core that completely covers all energy needs even in the most power-intensive modes of operation.

Furthermore, all capabilities from the Remolding Pattern are retained, including the ability to “force” 80% and the ability to switch to “combat mode” for ~24 hours.

The combat form itself will be a full-fledged mecha with a height of +/- 16 meters (for example, see the Frame Arms prototypes for Frame Arms Girls), with the entire list of available weapons and capabilities.

Frame Arms Girls are divided into different types or classes, forming separate lines. You can choose one of the existing lines, such as Gourai, Baselard, or Hresvelgr, or create your own. Each line should have its own unique features and characteristics. For example, Gourai cannot fly, but has an impressive arsenal. This line can be specialized for close combat or fire support by doubling the number of weapons or their caliber (for example, Zenrai and Liu Lai Kai).

This will work with all add-ons and upgrades from the T-Doll branch. Among other things, they will retain the ability to use Dummy Dolls, which will receive similar improvements.
objects.title: Frame Arms: Girls (Frame Arms Girls)

addons.text:
Your True Plane now develops not merely as a world, but as a fully realized, empowered civilization on a planar scale. What began as a single village has expanded into a vast, living society whose reach spreads across continents, oceans, skies, under-realms, and any sub-planes or pockets you have shaped. The total population ranges from hundreds of millions to many billions, depending on how quickly you choose to allow the Plane to grow.

You decide the structure of this society. It may be a single unified civilization with shared culture and identity, or it may fracture naturally into many distinct civilizations spread across the Plane. These groups can coexist peacefully, maintain tense neutrality, or be rivals and enemies locked in ideological, territorial, or cultural conflict. Their relationships with one another are yours to define, but their loyalty to you never wavers. Regardless of their alliances, rivalries, or wars, all acknowledge you as the absolute and rightful Sovereign of the Plane.

The inhabitants themselves are drawn from any race or species you have gained access to through settings, powers, or choices. You choose which peoples exist and where they live. If you want a multi-species supercivilization, the Plane adapts to support it: dragons carving citadels into floating mountains, elves tending living forests, humans building sprawling cities, demons or oni fortifying volcanic realms, starfarers establishing sky archipelagos, and more. If you want separate civilizations, each can inhabit its own region, sub-plane, or environment tailored to its nature.

Every individual receives the same empowerment model as the original Empowered Village. They inherit your CYOA powers at a fraction of your strength, manifesting roughly ten percent of your base capabilities, with the potential to grow toward a ceiling of fifty percent. This progression applies to all powers: magical, martial, divine, eldritch, or conceptual. Racial and species-based abilities follow their own rule. Any inhabitant who shares your race or one of your acquired species gains those traits at either half your strength in that form or at the full baseline level of that race, whichever is greater.

You may restrict access to specific powers or racial traits if you choose to. Doing so does not reduce their potential; instead, the abilities they are permitted to wield become more controlled, refined, and precise. You control whether the civilization is broad in capability, narrow but exquisitely specialized, or divided into specialized societies.

Their level of technological, magical, and cultural development is entirely up to you. The True Plane can begin with early agrarian communities, arcane kingdoms, industrial magitech states, modern scientific societies, or any blended structure you prefer. If you possess Technology or Artifice powers, the civilization can immediately integrate those advancements into its infrastructure, weapons, transportation, medicine, and planar exploration. Over time, they expand across the True Plane, settling frontier regions, establishing planar capitals, and even inhabiting sub-planes and skylands linked to the terrain.

No matter how many civilizations emerge, no matter their internal politics, and no matter how violently they may compete with one another, they cannot rebel against you. Your sovereignty is woven into the foundational laws of the Plane, and every inhabitant instinctively recognizes your ultimate authority. Their loyalty is absolute unless you deliberately engineer exceptions.

This addon transforms your Plane into a thriving world-system: a place of culture, conflict, invention, and story, populated by races drawn from every setting and power you have chosen. Whether united or divided, peaceful or warring, every civilization in the Plane ultimately serves you, and the entire world grows as an extension of your vision.
addons.title: Planar Civilization

addons.text:
Your True Plane now rises beyond the stage of a mere civilization. With this addon, its cultures, nations, regions, and peoples reorganize themselves into a full imperial structure anchored around you, their rightful sovereign. What began with a single empowered village becoming a planar civilization now reaches its natural next form: an Empire whose identity is woven into the metaphysical laws of the Plane itself.

The population seeded by Empowered Village has grown into countless cities, nations, tribes, cultures, and sub-planes of life. As the Plane expands, these societies flourish independently or clash bitterly across borders, yet every one of them remains absolutely loyal to you. They may forge alliances or fight one another, pursue rival ideologies or wage long-standing wars, but none can rebel against you or even conceive of replacing you. You are the axis of the Plane, and all acknowledge your supremacy.

Heir of Caesar elevates you into an unmatched imperial commander. You understand the mechanisms of war, statecraft, morale, logistics, and political flow with a precision few rulers in any world could match. This mastery allows you to guide the growth of your Empire with uncanny efficiency. Civil wars collapse before they ignite, military campaigns succeed even under impossible conditions, and vast multi-national coalitions can be organized with a word. Your strategies ripple across continents and sub-planes, shaping history as naturally as breathing.

Crown of Royalty ensures your authority is not merely political—it is metaphysical. Your sovereign presence is etched into your soul and into the very structure of your True Plane. Laws, traditions, and even natural phenomena bend subtly to accommodate your rule. Kings, councils, tribal elders, or elected assemblies may exist within the Empire, but all know they serve you. Your will is the highest law. Reality itself affirms your place as Emperor.

Your Empire may be a single unified civilization under one banner or a constellation of many nations coexisting within the Plane. You determine how centralized or decentralized the imperial structure is. You may grant autonomy to certain regions, permit rivalries to flourish, or encourage cultural divergence. You can just as easily enforce unity, consolidate authority, or let independent kingdoms thrive beneath your overarching dominion. All paths ultimately reinforce your sovereignty, never threatening it.

Your people retain the empowerment granted to them through Empowered Village. Each inhabitant possesses a portion of your base powers—normally around ten percent, with the potential to reach half of your innate strength. Species-based traits remain governed by the same rules: those who share your race, or one of your acquired races, possess their lineage’s abilities at either half your own or full baseline level. You may restrict certain abilities to preserve balance or direct development; doing so amplifies their discipline and mastery of the powers they retain. The result is an Empire whose citizens are not merely stronger than ordinary mortals—they are shaped into a refined force capable of elevating entire societies.

The Empire’s infrastructure reflects its imperial maturity. Trade routes interconnect regions and sub-planes. Military bastions rise along planar boundaries. Academies teach magic, cultivation, engineering, and divine arts in cities that rival the capitals of entire worlds. If you possess technological or mystical powers from other settings, the Empire can incorporate them seamlessly. Entire sectors may specialize in magitech innovation, celestial navigation, spiritual refinement, or arcane science. As the True Plane continues to grow, the Empire grows with it in complexity, identity, and strength.

Your armies, empowered through your abilities and sharpened by your Heir of Caesar insight, form the backbone of imperial might. Legions, fleets, magical orders, divine hosts, and specialized regiments appear across the Plane, each capable of responding swiftly to threats. Even other civilizations within your Empire, regardless of rivalry or hostility, understand that your imperial command supersedes all politics. When you call, every faction answers.

The True Planar Empire is not fragile. It is self-sustaining, self-expanding, and interwoven with the Plane’s metaphysical framework. It cannot collapse unless you desire it. Its strength, diversity, and cultural depth are extensions of your will, and its imperial identity becomes one of the defining characteristics of your True Plane.

This addon transforms the empowered society of your True Plane into a unified imperial order—not merely a civilization, but an Empire capable of development, conflict, diplomacy, and dominance on a scale far exceeding the base Civilization. It inherits everything from Empowered Village, expands every aspect of your people and governance, and crowns your Plane with a true Imperial identity.

Note: Any Subject of your empire can come and go from your empire and exist in the outside world as long as you permit it, they retain full access to whatever gear or powers they have.
addons.title: Planar Empire

objects.text:
Your demiplane has matured into a True Plane—a complete, sovereign world that exists outside all timelines and external space. It no longer resembles a flat pocket realm or a concealed refuge. It occupies its own private dimensional pocket, undetectable and unreachable except through gateways you create. No being, system, or force can locate or enter it without your authorization.

A stable dimensional framework now supports the Plane’s structure. This framework replaces the former mist boundary with a reinforced world-shell that governs internal order and blocks all external interference. No outside force may alter its physics, magic, or environmental conditions. Every rule that governs the Plane originates from you alone.

At the world’s center lies a fully developed leyline network grown from the Ley Line Seed. This network permeates every region, circulating energy that sustains climates, renews the land, restores damaged environments, and maintains ecological balance. Weather patterns form naturally, fertility remains constant, and terrain gradually recovers from harm. The Plane regulates itself entirely, drawing on its own energy rather than relying on you to maintain stability.

The Plane’s environments have expanded into vast regions capable of supporting any climate, species, or civilization. Continents, oceans, forests, deserts, tundras, caverns, and skylands can be created, shaped, or left to develop naturally. As the Plane grows outward, new landforms appear at its edges, shaped by the flows of energy moving through the leylines.

The specialized pockets once housed within Gaia’s Sanctuary have been absorbed into the Plane as enclosed subregions. These pockets maintain their unique conditions—altered timeflow, concentrated resources, specialized ecosystems—and function as controlled environments for rare species, research, cultivation, or training. They remain distinct but fully integrated within the Plane’s greater structure.

Your home remains at the center. Sweet Home, along with its dimensional control systems, has merged seamlessly into the Plane and continues to function as your personal residence and administrative hub. From here, you may adjust environmental traits, restructure regions, design new zones, shift time rates, modify weather, or reshape entire landscapes. Its customizable interior, autonomous upkeep, and soul-bound access remain intact.

The Plane accepts any species or race you choose to introduce, whether drawn from the worlds you visit or from powers you have selected. Beings brought into the Plane adapt smoothly to their assigned regions and remain bound to its laws, rendering them fully loyal while they reside within your world. You may populate it with any form of life as long as their existence does not exceed your own capabilities, and entire civilizations can be established without disrupting the Plane’s balance or structure.

Your authority over space governs all entry to and from the Plane. Permanent gates, temporary passages, and keyed entrances can be anchored anywhere, within or outside the Plane. You are aware of every visitor and can revoke or grant access instantly. Without your consent, nothing can perceive or approach the Plane—only the most powerful of forces can hope to perceive and maybe even enter Your Plane. 

The Plane possesses full vertical layering. Beneath the surface lies an expanding subsurface network of caverns, mineral veins, and deep ecosystems. Above, the sky layer provides structure for weather systems, flight paths, aerial environments, and floating landmasses. All layers remain anchored to the Plane’s dimensional frame, ensuring long-term stability and preventing spatial drift.

The Plane expands continuously. As it draws in energy from its leylines and from your interactions with other worlds, its boundaries extend outward, increasing the amount of land, sky, and depth available. New regions take shape on their own or according to your designs, and the Plane steadily becomes more diverse and complex.

You may freely reshape any part of the Plane. Continents, seas, mountains, skylands, caverns, or constructed environments can be moved, recreated, or erased at will. Individual regions can follow independent rule-sets without influencing neighboring areas, allowing for specialized physics, magic behavior, or temporal flow where needed.

Civilizations can thrive indefinitely. Natural cycles remain stable, resources replenish themselves, and the Plane experiences no entropy, cosmological decay, or erosion from external realities. Introduced flora and fauna settle without conflict, and the Plane’s structure supports long-term habitation and development.

Your authority within this world is absolute. No outside force can override its laws, damage its systems, or claim any part of it. The Plane’s barrier prevents observation, intrusion, or interference, and only your gates create points of access. Everything that once applied to your demiplane remains true here, strengthened by the Plane’s vastly enhanced scale, durability, and autonomy.

The True Plane stands beyond all timelines and external realities—a complete, expanding world entirely shaped and sustained by your will.
objects.title: True Plane

objects.text:
Your True Plane undergoes a complete metamorphosis, becoming a Realm: a self-contained cosmology composed of planes, dimensions, worlds, regions, sub-planes, and solar systems, all united beneath a single metaphysical framework. Existing beyond all external timelines, universes, and higher realities, the Realm cannot be found, perceived, or entered unless you permit it. 


At its heart stands Irminsul, transformed into the Realm's living foundation. It defines and maintains the Realm's laws, distributes your power throughout every layer, harmonizes incompatible systems, and seamlessly integrates anything added to the Realm, whether worlds, dimensions, planes, or conceptual structures, preserving perfect stability. 

The former L-Cluster becomes the Realm Expanse, the first region of your new cosmology. It contains a balanced collection of fully realized planes, worlds, dimensional pockets, regions, and solar systems that naturally exist from the Realm's creation. As your power grows, the Expanse continuously expands, giving rise to new realms that you may shape, merge, develop, or leave to evolve naturally without limit. 

L-Gates evolve into Realm Gates, granting complete control over movement between the Realm and external realities. They may serve as gateways, internal transit hubs, or metaphysical anchors stabilizing distant regions of the Expanse. Their number, appearance, placement, and rules are entirely yours to determine. 

Dimensional Nexus evolves into a seamless network connecting every plane, world, dimension, and region within the Realm. Internal travel is instantaneous unless you choose otherwise, while every pathway, destination, and permission remains under your complete control. Routes may appear as architecture, bridges of light, dreamlike passages, symbolic roads, or effortless spatial transitions. 

Dimensional Protection becomes the Realm Shell, an absolute consent-based barrier enclosing the entire cosmology. Nothing may perceive, influence, observe, enter, or leave the Realm without your permission. The Shell continually adapts to new threats, neutralizes metaphysical instability before it manifests, and preserves the Realm's integrity regardless of magical, technological, divine, conceptual, or eldritch interference. 

Within the Realm, your authority is absolute. You may reshape landscapes, rewrite natural laws, alter time, create or merge planes, restructure dimensions, or reorganize the Realm itself with effortless thought. Sweet Home remains at the Realm's center as your residence and administrative heart, allowing you to manage its structure, laws, metaphysics, and appearance with perfect ease. 

The Realm continually grows alongside you, expanding into an ever-greater cosmology shaped entirely by your vision and governed by your will. 

You may freely enter or leave the Realm, grant Realm Keys to trusted individuals, or permit sufficiently powerful beings to travel by will alone. Entire planes, worlds, regions, or star systems may be entrusted to others without diminishing your own authority. Their rule exists only through your permission, and ultimate sovereignty always remains yours. 

Anything affecting your Demiplane or True Plane, including all addons, automatically applies to the Realm. 

The Realm naturally populates itself with races, species, civilizations, ecosystems, and creatures drawn from any setting or power you possess. You may select them yourself or allow the Realm to generate them automatically. Every inhabitant exists beneath Realm Law unless you decide otherwise, while civilizations may flourish naturally, develop under your guidance, or follow systems of your own design.
objects.title: The Realm

objects.text: The Blue Core and the Red Core... Positive and Negative. Creation and Destruction. They said these cores could never be mixed without devastation. But somehow, through cosmic luck and circumstances, they have produced an offspring core known as the Purple Core. It takes the best of both cores and enhances. Whereas Blue turned machines far more peaceful and Red turned them into desirers of destruction, Purple meets a balance. Your machine will indeed have an aggressiveness in battle, but will also have a serenity about them outside of it, wishing to help however it can. Another benefit of it is that it gifts whatever wields it an even greater regeneration factor than the red core itself, able to pull from the very metal and ground beneath its feet to accelerate the process. The Blue's regeneration of technology is also vastly improved, able to turn machines into their prime selves at a speed almost magical. Finally, if the energies of its parents were only nigh-infinite, then the Purple Core's energy is truly infinite. If those who wish to bring harm to the world, or your enemies who wish to defend said world, meet a robot powered by this core... they will have to pray for their lives.
objects.title: Purple Core

objects.text:
It seems your 2 castles have merged into quite a fearsome location of beauty. Specifically, it seems that they have quite literally merged into a new building, with the size increasing to compensate to about an average town. Bowsers fiery intensity and theatricality and Peach's elegance and beauty have combined to make the most visually striking location, now known as Koopashroom Castle.

On top of everything each has already, you have been gifted quite a gift for each. You have been given named members of each castle, including your own sorcerer Kamek Koopa, the Bowser Children, Toadsworth, and more. If you were to gather enough magical power to create life, you could even create a King of Koopas and a Princess of the Toads. 

Finally, you can integrate any technology from Across the Rainbow Roads (Including any and all addons of the power) with every single member of the castle getting this knowledge, allowing you to create whole race tracks, Karts, and tech from Mario Kart contained within your castle, thanks to the paintings. As well, you can create just about any stage and technology from the Smash Brothers franchise inside the castle, whether to train your troops, give said troops entertainment, or as a surprise for an enemy invader.
objects.title: Koopashroom Castle

objects.text:
When the four legendary swords are brought together, their blades began vibrating at frequencies that should not exist in the mortal realm, and fuse into a single blade. This new sword is the greatest weapon throughout the heavens, a blade that holds the full and perfected power of each of its components amplified to their highest possible expression. It is said that holding this sword is to hold a piece of the primordial chaos before creation, given form and edge.

While you wield the fused blade, you may draw upon one of its four perfected effects at a time, the sword's power shifting to meet your need. You may nullify all supernatural power in any being near you, reducing gods to the level of mortal men regardless of their original strength, or you may cut through any expression of power as though slicing smoke. You may instead flood any wound you inflict with the concentrated madness of the Luxian Jian at full potency, corrupting mind and soul instantly. You may render any fatal wound absolute, negating the target's immortality and rewriting their name into the Book of Life and Death. Or you may draw a slain target into the blade itself, sealing them among the countless divine beings already trapped within, their screams adding to the sword's growing hunger. Only one of these expressions may be active at any given moment, though you may shift between them as easily as breathing.

Once per day, you may invoke the true power of the Zhuxian Sword Formation. For a single strike, all four perfected effects combine into one unblockable attack. The nullification strips away all defense, the blade kills with the slightest cut regardless of the target's power, the victim is instantly sealed within the sword upon death, and they are forced to experience the collective madness of every being that has ever lived at full intensity, their mind regressing to that of a beast before the sword claims them entirely. No power in the heavens can resist this strike, anything in the way of your target is completely erased, even if it’s the entire world it. Once used, the sword must wait a day before the formation can be invoked again.
objects.title: Zhuxian Sword Formation: The Four Swords of the Heavens Formation of Absolute Annihilation

objects.text: "It's alive... IT'S ALIVE, IT'S A-LIVE!" It's said that we trespass on God's domain when it comes to stuff like bringing unholy creatures to life. If that's the case, then you're about to be arrested for an extreme case of breaking and entering. Fortress Millenia has now transformed. On the outside, is the same beautifully designed castle, if with some gothic architecture at the edges. In fact at full size, it's about 25% bigger. But the inside... the inside has been transformed both horribly, and gorgeously. It has become Frankenstein's castle, and you have become (Blank) Frankenstein. On top of the original number of 100 servants, you gain 100 more, but these 100 are not limited to human levels. Thanks to your mad science given by the Lab, you can now give them enhanced capabilities. A four armed butler to handle multiple trays at once, a 3 eyed maid to watch even better for guests at the door, and many more possibilities. It also helps, of course, that the resurrection time has been slashed considerably from 7 days to 12 hours. The castle has also been layered with Traps, from an axe on the ceiling, to trap doors leading into a dungeon, to bright lights meant to blind. Thankfully, all 200 of your staff all have a natural unconscious instinct to avoid them and how, and you have the exact locations of these in a mental map on your head. It also helps that on top of the previous protections, there is always an aura of anxiety for those besides you, the staff, and those you exempt from it that makes it harder for them to think rationally, like in a horror movie. Finally, your creations and modifications to living beings are cleaner, but not to an unrecognizable extent. If your previous lab and creations resembled 1700s labs, yours now has a Gothic, early 1930s-worthy appearance; still dishevelled and a little hard to look at by modern standards, but not to the point where you wish to truly avert your eyes. They are also more intelligent. If your little bottle fetcher was only a 1st grade graduate level, this will allow you to make them smart enough to be a 12th grader.
objects.title: Frankenstein's Castle

objects.text:
With the Sword of Ragnuk the First—well, at least that’s what the Goblins claim—and the Crown of Bethmora upon your brow, you stand now as the newly acknowledged Goblin King. Regardless of your species, all Goblins will recognize you as a Goblin and as their rightful King.

Goblins consider only the finest smiths to be their King, and so you gain mastery of the smithing crafts as a whole. But what’s a smith without a forge? To ensure the King can always access a forge to ply his craft, the Forge of the Goblin King was created. Sealed within a pocket dimension and requiring two of the greatest treasures of the Goblin Nation to access, this forge is unlike any other.

This achievement of the Goblins’ greatest strength, however, lies in the enchantments placed upon every aspect of the Forge. The Forge is capable of replicating any creation—along with all its enchantments—that you direct it to, recreating it with the same skill and capabilities as the original makers. All you need to do is ensure it is supplied with the necessary resources.
objects.title: Ragnuk's Heir

objects.text: Salazar was a man of unmatched cunning and ambition, driven by an insatiable thirst for knowledge and power to achieve his goals. Slytherin mastered magic to a degree few ever attain, eventually mastering Spirit Summoning and the Arcane Arts before his legendary quarrel with the remaining Founders and his subsequent departure from Hogwarts. One of his greatest lasting achievements is his famous Locket. Enchanted by a master of Spirit Summoning and the Arcane Arts, it possesses attributes similar to the renowned Amulet of Samarkand and Amulet of Kings. With his mastery of Spirit Summoning, Salazar was able to trap a powerful Marid within the locket, endowing it with abilities akin to the Amulet of Samarkand. The Locket can immunize its wearer from all hostile magic and absorb any spirits that approach. Thanks to his command over the Arcane Arts, Slytherin enchanted the gems of the locket to function like the Amulet of Kings. It can trap the souls of all who have ever worn it, allowing their collective knowledge and wisdom to be called forth when needed by the bearer. Additionally, the Locket can "lock" a localized area in such a way that dimensional crossing becomes impossible without the bearer’s consent. The final secret of the Locket lies in how it coordinates these two powers: the Arcane Arts’ ability to trap souls and call them forth, and Spirit Summoning’s power to summon spirits to serve the user. This synergy allows the bearer to directly call upon the powers of the spirits trapped within the Locket, harnessing their powers at will.
objects.title: Archmage's Locket

objects.text:
The Mortal Cup, the Cup of Murias, the Fountain of Youth, and Helga’s Cup are each legendary treasures in their own right—now reunited into a singular, gleaming chalice: the San-Gréal. Said to provide eternal youth and infinite abundance, the San-Gréal indeed does, still possessing all the powers of the cups that form it.

But the San-Gréal holds a much greater legacy as Sang-Réal—“royal blood”—since blood can hold great power. By pouring blood into the bowl of the cup, anyone who drinks of that blood will gain the powers contained within it. This can be used to usurp any trait inherent to the donor’s biology.

You can also choose to “dilute” the blood, as Raziel did long ago, to weaken the powers and abilities that may be gained. This method can also be used to replace parents or other ancestors in someone’s biological lineage.

Any abilities, bloodlines, racial changes, or powers granted by drinking blood from the cup can be passed down to their children. Should you wish, you can also separate the San-Gréal back into the four cups that formed it.
objects.title: San-Gréal

addons.text:
Now, instead of just the singular—albeit powerful—cloak, you also have the Veil of the Tuatha Dé Danann: the Féth fíada.

The Féth fíada is a mist that allows the user to enshroud themselves so completely that they become immune to all forms of mortal detection. It can be as intangible as a cloud or as solid as the ground, while being opaque as snow or transparent as air, depending on the need. The mist can also be used to hide vast areas, or form constructs, though anything oversized or with complex parts will take more effort and practice to achieve.
addons.title: Féth Fíada

objects.text:
Now, Rowena’s treasure reveals its final form: the Crown of Morrigan, the great phantom queen—she who brings both victory and death in battle.

Morrigan’s Crown empowered her with the powers of shape-shifting, self-duplication, and control over corvids.

The Crown allows the user to separate themselves into a trio of bodies—each linked by a hive mind—and reunite when desired. Each body possesses a third of the powers and abilities of the original user.

Another aspect of the Crown is its ability to command and control corvids—crows and ravens—of all kinds. The Crown enables the wearer to communicate freely with the birds, give them instructions, share their senses, and even puppet their bodies if needed.

Finally, the Crown grants the ability to shape-shift. The user can freely transform into their heart’s content. However, if the wearer wishes to transform into anything more than ravens and crows, they will need to practice the form first.
objects.title: Morrigan's Crown

objects.text: The Crown Zenith, the famous Regalia of the Zodiac are the twelve treasures originating from myths and legends, whose fame enshrined them in the stars for all eternity. Few have ever seen even one, and yet you have gathered all twelve. Each one is capable of taking the form of a pin representing the constellation; mostly, this is used for easy transport or storage. However, as you bring the individual pins close together, a magnetic-like attraction takes place, allowing them to snap together and enhance each other with every connection until finally all twelve are united as one—the Crown Zenith: Regalia of the Zodiac. This assembled crown takes the form of a circlet of gold but can be reshaped to suit your tastes. Its powers are now bound to you irrevocably, resisting all attempts to copy, steal, nullify, or remove them. The Cloak of Aries now grants the user limitless flight and the ability to heal and repair anything they encounter. Injuries of the mind, flesh, and soul disappear with but a touch. The Helm of Taurus grants you limitless strength—should you be given a lever and fulcrum large and strong enough, moving planets would be within your reach. The Mask of Gemini gives you the ability to go from a single body to as many as twelve, all linked in a hive mind bound to you. The Shield of Cancer allows you to drain the vitality of friend or foe and use it to give life and motion to the world around you. The Armor of Leo now enables you to invert that near-absolute defense into an equally near-absolute offense, sending forth strikes of such radiant heat that most targets disintegrate upon impact. The Sword of Virgo extends its powers further, purifying your mind, body, and soul, and protecting them from contamination of any kind. The Scale of Libra bends to your judgment, allowing you to decide who is worthy of reward or punishment. The Spear of Scorpio’s poison now reaches even the conceptual—poisoning a shadow, an element, even a moment or an idea. The Bow of Sagittarius’s arrows now drag their targets into the abyss from which they were formed. Be sure not to miss. The Cornucopia of Capricorn, as a symbol of abundance, grants an endless supply of many things—and now, it grants you a final, limitless supply: time. You will always have enough time for what you seek to achieve and can bestow this blessing on others as you see fit. The Chalice of Aquarius can grant those permitted to drink from it true immortality, allowing them to survive in some way, in some form—always. The Belt of Pisces now allows you to take the form of any creature you might imagine—a Pokémon, a phoenix, an elf, or something from your imagination. Finally, the Crown Zenith allows you to create constructs of golden light in the forms of Zodiac Regalia, and each of their strongest powers can now be used without limit.
objects.title: Crown Zenith: Regalia of the Zodiac

objects.text:
Your Undying Colosseum and Immortality Field Resort have fused into a single, unified construct. The Resort is now integrated into the crown that contains the Colosseum, existing as an extension of its structure and function.

The Colosseum and Resort are partitioned into distinct immortality zones, such as the gladiator grounds, audience seating, zoo, casino, and restaurants. Each zone is sustained by its own Immortality Field, which you may freely activate or deactivate at will.

The Resort inherits the Colosseum’s absolute indestructibility, rendering the entire fused structure immune to all forms of damage.

While the crown is worn, you yourself are granted immortality.
objects.title: The Immortal Colosseum

objects.text: Your Princess Gown has seemingly influenced Fortress Millenias shape and growth, even if the exact cause is unknown. Regardless, Fortress Millenia has now become "Cosmic Castle", a Castle that has defenses, help, and more that puts its previous form to shame. Your 100 staff members, have now been given further assistance by 300 more, of various fantasy creatures and other humans. Mermaids given fake legs filled with hyper-rejuvenating water so they can welcome visitors with a song, Centaurs that can compress their size and uncompress to act as efficient knights, and more. Your walls could now take, on the technological side, nukes and sonic cannons like they were mere cannonballs, and even magic can't transmute or easily damage the buildings. For you personally, you will also find your Gown's magic is exponentially stronger inside the castle walls, although this boost is gone the instant you go outside. Regardless, this boost could include resurrection of people dead for years, healing diseases and injuries seemingly impossible to take care of, and other similar boosts. The spells now also include gestures combined with intent based on the castle. Need a maid? Pretend you're ringing a bell, and at least 1-5 will come to you. Need a specific part of the castle guarded? Put your hand out aggressively, and guards will swarm to that area. Finally, the Castle still retains its portability and the like, but its full size is MUCH bigger, an estimated 4 times, letting you hold whole villages worth of people inside.
objects.title: Cosmic Castle

objects.text:
You now have at your disposal the Sky People fleet, consisting of 10 interstellar vessels. These are similar to the ISV Manifest Destiny and have been significantly upgraded compared to the ISV Venture Star. These ships are designed to transport Landing Modules and land them on planets.

Each ship is 1,650 meters long, and its maximum speed reaches 70% of the speed of light with an acceleration of 1.5 G. The power plant is based on matter and antimatter engines, supplemented by a thermonuclear engine for maneuvering and a photonic sail. The ship's crew consists of 25 people. In addition, each ship carries 2 space shuttles.

The Landing Module reaches a height of 176 meters, which is equivalent to approximately 40 stories. It is equipped with thermal and radiation shields capable of withstanding the operation of antimatter engines and the heat of the fireball during landing. Additionally, the module is equipped with three defensive turrets armed with cannon and missile systems.

The Landing Module can accommodate 300 soldiers, 50 different vehicles, and about 10 units of super-heavy construction equipment, such as the RDA bulldozer. Each module is equipped with a cryosleep system for passengers, as well as primary production equipment, including 3D printers, food supplies, production materials, and air and water recycling systems.

This module is ideal for deploying mining, production, and colonization operations, providing a convenient base for establishing primary infrastructure. The module’s landing process scorches the terrain within a 30 km radius, cleansing it with radiation and a firestorm.

The ships are equipped with enough supplies and fuel to last for a seven-year journey. Each ship is capable of performing routine maintenance and replenishing its fuel supplies—including hydrogen, deuterium, and antimatter—during a one-year stay in orbit around any planet.

If you have Technology and Artifice Powers, the ship can be upgraded, though not significantly. Weapons can also be installed on it, but it will not become a full-fledged combat vessel.

When purchasing New Mines, you will receive an additional 10 ships for each purchase.
objects.title: Sky People Returns (Avatar)

objects.text: Your Gameforge Console has now merged into your Plush Pal, and thanks to the latter's impossibly advanced technology, it now has gained new advantages for the Gameforge Console. The internal space of the plush acts as a full body VR space merged with the Plush Pal's technology and adaptability. It can learn just about anything from the games you play, and easily even create the tech in the games. Internally, the space becomes essentially indestructible as matter and energy do their thing and act as if you WERE using the gameforge console. The Plush Pal can now also gain dedicated rewards from the dungeons. A medium Fallout dungeon run might let your Plush Pal create/dispense Rad-X or Radaway, while an Impossible++ run, where you have to fight every legion member in existence at the battle of Hoover Dam on your own could integrate the Archimedes II laser into their systems, or let them develop shaped power armor around you for further protection inside. Any and all addons or upgrades for either power apply to this. One final benefit is that you will NEVER die in the space due to your Plush Pal's safety features. While near-death injuries and experiences are certainly possible, none of the creatures or any environmental hazards can kill you with this.
objects.title: Playful Plush Pal!

addons.text: Access to the Infinity Gauntlet, and its defence against the Stones’ backlash, has allowed you to use your stones with relative impunity. Not only do you not have to adapt the stones to the universe you’re in, only having to learn their intricacies to use them effectively, but the number of stones you can scavenge and store in The Firmament is virtually unlimited.
addons.title: One in the Chamber

addons.text: As a direct creation of the Celestials, your connection to your Celestial is far less precarious. As such it is far more willing to intercede on your behalf and be supportive of your actions. This does not free you from responsibility however, but does allow you to treat your Celestial far more like a regular Radiant would their robot, bringing it partially into reality or receiving telepathic advice from it at will. While it still may not be wise to abuse the privileged link you have to a Celestial, you do have far more leeway than you otherwise would.
addons.title: Favoured Creation

addons.text:
Your implicit understanding of what you see has given you the unerring ability to seek out and collect Infinity Stones capable of replicating abilities you have seen. While these still follow the same rules as your other stones, they’re also likely to be more broad than the source. 

For instance, witnessing a power nullifier may help you find a ‘Death Stone’ that is capable of nullifying powers in the same way among its other effects.
addons.title: Converted

addons.text: For a very liberal definition of ‘Ammunition’ you are able to teleport yourself into the Firmament and use the pouch to generate ‘trick Infinity Stones’. These are highly specialised stones such as ‘Ice’ or ‘Dance’. While these ‘trick stones’ don’t require tuning to a new universe, they also have highly limited energy, crumbling to dust after only thirty seconds of intensive use.
addons.title: Recursive Infinities

addons.text:
You’ve been changed implicitly, beyond becoming completely in tune with both your radiant and the stone powering it, but rather with the Forge of Creation, the Firmament itself. In essence, you’ve become an infant Celestial, something which does not naturally exist.

As you’re implicitly connected to the foundational level of the universe, your main task will be mastering the stones you have. After that however, you will immediately sense a compatible stone in the Firmament that would continue the Infinity Circuit that you can collect. 

Similarly, sufficiently different Stones can have entirely bespoke and strange Circuits for you to master and complete. Once you’ve completed a circuit (quite the strenuous task) you may even be able to jumpstart your development into becoming a true Celestial, though completing this ascension would likely require completing multiple circuits.

Finally, and potentially the greatest benefit of your transformation, as a nascent Celestial, the one that you are attached to will likely be far more favourable towards you, though still not ‘reliable’ as such. It is however more likely to answer inquiries and intercede in the most dire scenarios than it otherwise was.
addons.title: Terrestrial

objects.text: Your Radiant’s connection with a fundamental shard of existence has grown only further, supplanting your connection to Existence with the space behind the Godquarry. In this space, Celestials experiment with creation and the shattered shards of infinity dot the landscape in plentiful supply. This ties your Radiant implicitly to these shards, the Infinity Stones more so than before. Firstly, any Infinity stone you possess supplants your Radiant’s power as said before, but notably it also protects you from the backlash within. With a single stone this would allow you to use it and learn its strengths far faster, but with multiple it truly becomes something special. Initially, you’d be able to harness two Stones at once, rotating through any you have access to to take full advantage of the Infinity Circuit, enhancing the next in the chain. However, as you train and grow with the Radiant you’ll be able to manifest more a once at even greater potency. Similarly, instead of teleporting yourself to Existence, you will instead journey to The Firmament, a place ‘underneath’ existence where Celestials can do their work. This notably means that the traditional 6 Infinity Stones are not the only options for you to take, allowing you to find stranger pieces of the universe, Genesis, Death, Chaos, and Stranger to add to your arsenal. This however requires you to analyse it and ensure you have the strength to handle it before you could force one of the stones scavenged from The Firmament into affecting your reality (as the stones are intrinsically tied to their home universes). Your ‘Supercharge’ form can temporarily brute-force this restriction, but once it wears off you’d need to undergo this hard work anyway. Similarly this would need to be repeated for each stone as even two ‘Space’ stones would be subtly different in their construction and utilisation. However, with time you could pass it to your rotation all the same. This does mean that you will always have access to an Infinity stone. As if you ever lost yours you could enter the Firmament and begin scavenging for one to replace it, even if it would not be the same and require this adjustment. Your ‘Robot’ likewise has been replaced. As the Firmament is home to the Celestials, one seems to have taken its place. While Celestials are far stronger than your Robot would be, they are also far more mercurial and ambivalent. When once you could bring pieces of your Robot into reality to fight for you, a Celestial would be far less supportive. Similarly, being intimately connected to one ensures you’re ‘on call’ for anything it might require a ‘gentler touch’ for that you can’t dismiss lightly. Though it does provide you a certain advantage in that you can call it in kind (though calling a physical god frivolously is quite unwise).
objects.title: The Firmament

addons.text:
Your mountain evolves into your version of Kami’s Lookout, fully integrated into Elysian Summit. You do not merely oversee it—you become Kami, the divine guardian of the Earth, elevated above the world while remaining bound to its balance. This refines the summit into a unified space of refuge and oversight.

The summit threshold remains the sole natural entry, but now opens into a greater spatial layer containing both your sanctuary and the full structure of Kami’s Lookout. Your sanctuary remains central, surrounded by platforms, temples, halls, and open sky spaces, all seamlessly integrated rather than separate constructs.

At the summit, a pavilion or central structure serves as the gateway. Those who pass through are directed to a controlled point of arrival within the space, preserving the mountain’s role as a trial while structuring entry. If the sanctuary has become a domain, this gateway leads into it while maintaining this control.

As Kami, your awareness expands across the world you are bound to. You can sense its condition, disturbances, and significant events with constant, intuitive clarity. This awareness may be focused or broadened at will, extending naturally between the world, the summit, and any domain you possess.

The Hyperbolic Time Chamber is embedded within the summit as a sealed subspace, accessed through the lookout. It functions as part of the mountain rather than a separate construct.

Through Magic and Item Construction, the summit becomes a center of creation. You may build and integrate Kami-style artifacts, training spaces, and systems directly into the mountain, forming a complete divine stronghold.

If paired with Under-Mountain Depths, the lookout stands above a vast internal system of industry and defense. You gain direct oversight of the depths, forming a complete vertical structure with authority above and power below.

If paired with Sacred Summit Shrine, the summit becomes both a divine seat and a place of balance. Your authority is expressed through a space that stabilizes and refines rather than suppresses.

If paired with the Law of the Summit addon, the lookout becomes the point from which you enforce structure. You may identify disturbances and impose limits, restrict abilities, or stabilize reality with precision when needed.

If paired with Elysian Domain, the lookout integrates into a full world, acting as its highest point or central axis. Your awareness extends across both the Earth and your domain, while the summit remains the regulated gateway.

If paired with Elysian Civilization, the mountain becomes the center of your civilization. You act as both guardian and overseer, observing and guiding your people from above.

If paired with Summit Guardians, the guardians act as extensions of your awareness, responding to threats you perceive and enforcing your will without direct action.

This does not alter the mountain’s law of access. No one may bypass the ascent or appear within the lookout or sanctuary without reaching the summit, unless you allow it. The mountain remains a trial, the sanctuary a refuge, and the lookout the seat above both.

If another Kami exists, your roles do not overwrite one another. Both act as guardians within separate domains, coexisting unless conflict is chosen.

Your mountain is no longer just a refuge. It is your Lookout, your divine seat, and the point from which you observe, protect, create, and guide.
addons.title: Kami's Mountain

addons.text:
Beneath your mountain, its interior unfolds into a vast layered network far beyond natural limits. What would be a simple ascent becomes an immense system of corridors, chambers, and industrial zones, all existing within the mountain while expanding far beyond what its exterior could contain.

This expansion is not a separate dimension, but a continuous extension of internal space. Through Space Manipulation, the depths may grow, fold, and extend indefinitely while remaining anchored within the mountain. From the outside, nothing changes, but within the scale becomes immense and ever-expanding.

The Factory is fully integrated into these depths, forming their foundation. Production platforms, storage sectors, engineering systems, and energy infrastructure are embedded directly into the terrain, turning the mountain into a living structure of creation and function.

The interior ascent may pass through these layers. Those entering from below encounter a controlled environment rather than a direct path. Industrial halls, mechanized chambers, and active systems shape the climb into a deliberate trial.

Automated defenses are built into this system. Constructs patrol the depths, responding to intrusion with coordinated force. Their numbers and intensity scale with your intent, allowing the environment to function as either a passive system or an active defense network.

The terrain itself may act as an obstacle. Moving platforms, production lines, energy flows, and shifting structures can form hazards that must be navigated. Sections may be sealed or redirected at will, allowing the mountain’s interior to adapt dynamically.

Deeper layers house secured zones, hidden facilities, and large-scale storage. Resources may be processed and contained entirely within the mountain, supporting long-term growth without exposing its internal systems.

This layer acts as the mountain’s internal engine, providing production, storage, and infrastructure on a massive scale. Unlike the sanctuary above, this is not a place of rest, but one of control, construction, and defense.

You retain complete authority over the system. Its layout, activity level, and hostility may be adjusted at will. It can function as a gauntlet, a testing ground, or a neutral passage. Those you permit may pass safely, while hostile forces face increasing difficulty.

If paired with Kami’s Mountain, the summit becomes a point of oversight, allowing you to monitor and regulate the depths without descending, forming a complete vertical system of authority and function.

If paired with Sacred Summit Shrine, the depths are stabilized and contained, preventing corruption or instability from spreading upward while preserving their function.

If paired with the Law of the Summit addon, you may enforce control within the depths directly, restricting abilities, stabilizing anomalies, and regulating intruders when needed.

If paired with Elysian Domain, the depths extend into the domain itself, forming a lower layer that can expand without restriction while remaining tied to the mountain.

If paired with Elysian Civilization, the depths act as the hidden backbone of your civilization, supporting production and infrastructure beneath the surface.

If paired with Summit Guardians, the guardians may extend their presence into the depths, intercepting threats before they reach the summit and coordinating with its defenses.

The mountain is no longer a structure with a path through it. It becomes layered, with a sanctuary above and an ever-expanding foundation below, each reinforcing the other while remaining entirely under your control.
addons.title: Under-Mountain Depths

addons.text:
The summit and sanctuary take on a deeper spiritual nature, transforming into a sacred site defined by balance, refinement, and quiet authority. What was once a place of peace becomes a place where that peace is actively maintained through alignment rather than force.
