The threshold at the summit becomes a consecrated boundary. Crossing it is not merely entering a hidden space, but stepping into a domain shaped by spiritual order. The environment responds to presence and intent, subtly reinforcing stability while resisting disruption.

Within the summit and sanctuary, harmful intent, corruption, and instability lose cohesion the deeper one moves inward. This is not direct suppression, but a loss of alignment. Actions driven by hostility become harder to sustain and less effective, as if the space itself refuses to support them.

Through your nature as a Miko, the shrine continuously purifies. Curses, corruption, and spiritual contamination are gradually weakened and cleansed from individuals, objects, and the environment. This process is constant, though it may be focused and intensified at will.

Your knowledge as an Onmyōji expands this into an active system. You may establish wards, seals, and controlled boundaries throughout the summit and sanctuary, shaping movement, defining restricted areas, or reinforcing key locations. Spiritual entities may be bound as attendants or guardians, maintaining the shrine without constant oversight.

Ward Magic reinforces this structure with stable, long-term defenses. Barriers may be layered into the environment, protecting against physical, magical, and supernatural intrusion. These defenses can be passive or condition-based, forming a persistent protective network.

This does not strip power or prevent interaction. Instead, the space aligns itself so that imbalance cannot easily persist. Those acting in harmony experience no resistance, while those imposing disorder find their actions weakened by the environment.

At its center, the shrine forms a focal point of your authority. Whether as a temple, altar, or extension of your pavilion, it allows you to perceive, regulate, and shape the spiritual state of the summit and sanctuary. You may adjust its influence from a gentle presence to a reinforced system when needed.

If paired with Kami’s Mountain, the shrine and lookout reinforce one another, turning the summit into both a divine seat and a place of balance, expressing authority through guidance rather than suppression.

If paired with Under-Mountain Depths, the shrine stabilizes the mountain as a whole, preventing corruption or instability from spreading upward while preserving the function of the depths.

If paired with the Law of the Summit addon, the shrine works alongside enforced structure, allowing you to both refine and regulate, combining alignment with defined limits.

If paired with Elysian Domain, the shrine extends into the domain, maintaining stability and resistance to corruption across its entire structure.

If paired with Elysian Civilization, the shrine acts as the spiritual core of your civilization, reducing unrest and maintaining cohesion among your people.

If paired with Summit Guardians, the guardians operate within a refined environment, becoming more effective against corruption and instability while unaffected by the shrine’s influence.

The shrine does not impose peace. It creates a space where peace sustains itself, and imbalance must adapt or fade in its presence.
addons.title: Sacred Summit Shrine

addons.text:
Your mountain gains the ability to enforce order directly, not as a passive effect, but as a deliberate extension of your will. Where other aspects refine or stabilize, this grants you the authority to define and impose structure when necessary.

At a base level, the mountain becomes resistant to distortion. Unstable abilities, reality-warping effects, and phenomena that violate coherent rules are forced into a more stable state simply by existing within your domain. This effect remains subtle, ensuring that nothing operates completely outside of structure without your consent.

Beyond this, you may actively enforce limitations. Within the mountain, sanctuary, and any connected space, you can selectively restrict abilities, weaken their effectiveness, or prevent their use entirely. This is not a constant suppression, but a precise tool, applied to individuals, areas, or specific types of power.

Reality Anchor manifests through the structure of the mountain itself. Entities and effects that exist outside normal rules are forced to conform when you direct it. Invulnerability may fail, regeneration may slow, and distortions collapse into stable forms. The stronger or more alien the target, the more focus is required, though your control improves with familiarity.

Power Nullification functions as a direct extension of this authority. You may sever individuals from their abilities within your influence, either partially or completely. This effect can be sustained through the structure of your domain, allowing you to maintain control without constant focus.

This system is not always active at full strength. The mountain remains permissive until you choose to intervene. When you act, enforcement is immediate and precise, allowing you to regulate threats or restore order without altering the nature of the sanctuary as a place of refuge.

The summit and central structures act as focal points for this authority. From them, you may extend enforcement across your domain or concentrate it within specific areas, maintaining normal interaction while retaining complete control when required.

If paired with Kami’s Mountain, your awareness allows you to identify disturbances instantly, while this authority allows you to act on them with precision, turning observation into direct enforcement without delay.

If paired with Under-Mountain Depths, the internal structure becomes a controlled environment where abilities may be restricted and anomalies contained, turning the depths into a regulated zone when needed.

If paired with Sacred Summit Shrine, the two systems complement one another. The shrine refines and aligns, while the law defines limits, creating a balance between guidance and control.

If paired with Elysian Domain, this authority extends across the entire domain. You may enforce rules throughout your world, restrict movement or abilities, and maintain complete control over access and exit when required.

If paired with Elysian Civilization, your authority extends into governance. You may regulate your civilization directly, ensuring stability and preventing internal collapse under extreme conditions.

If paired with Summit Guardians, the guardians operate within defined rules, allowing them to fight under conditions where enemies are restricted and stability favors their actions.

This does not make your domain oppressive. It ensures that when order must be enforced, it can be done with certainty. Power is not removed by default, but nothing within your mountain or domain exists beyond your ability to define its limits.
addons.title: Law of the Summit

addons.text:
The hidden sanctuary within your mountain becomes a true, self-contained dimension, bound to the mountain yet no longer constrained by its physical structure. The summit threshold becomes a gateway, linking the ascent to a complete and independent world beyond it.

At the summit, a pavilion or central structure serves as the domain’s primary entrance. Those who pass through arrive at a controlled point within the domain, whether at its boundary or a designated location. The mountain still governs access, ensuring entry must be earned through ascent unless you allow otherwise.

The domain preserves the Avalon-like nature of your sanctuary, but now exists as a stable reality rather than a folded space. Its scale is no longer tied to the mountain and may expand over time as your mastery deepens. Terrain, atmosphere, gravity, and environmental conditions are defined at creation, forming a cohesive world that can be refined or extended through deliberate effort.

The sky and horizon are fully under your control. They may reflect the outside world, remain fixed, or shift at your will. You may observe distant locations in real time, focusing your view across vast distances without leaving the domain. This perspective may be adjusted freely, allowing awareness while remaining within your world.

Your connection to the domain is constant. You are aware of all within it and their general location, and may monitor its state without direct presence. Systems may respond automatically, allowing the domain to function as a stable and self-regulating environment.

The domain may be layered into distinct regions, allowing multiple environments, subspaces, or internal structures to exist within a single world. These regions may differ in terrain or function, forming a cohesive and evolving system.

The domain is highly resilient. It cannot be entered, altered, or exited without your permission. External forces cannot interfere with its structure, and those within cannot leave unless you allow it.

If paired with Kami’s Mountain, the lookout becomes the highest point or central axis of the domain, with your awareness extending across both the outside world and your domain seamlessly.

If paired with Under-Mountain Depths, the domain gains a lower layer tied to the mountain’s interior, allowing expansion without restriction while maintaining structural continuity.

If paired with Sacred Summit Shrine, the domain gains a stable spiritual foundation, reducing corruption and maintaining balance across its entirety.

If paired with the Law of the Summit addon, you may enforce rules across the domain directly, restricting abilities, stabilizing anomalies, and controlling access when required.

If paired with Elysian Civilization, your civilization may extend into the domain as a controlled expansion. You determine who may enter, reside, or travel within it, with the mountain remaining the primary gateway.

If paired with Summit Guardians, the guardians may operate throughout the domain, responding to disturbances across its regions while remaining anchored to the summit.

The mountain remains the anchor. The ascent remains the trial, the summit the threshold, and the domain the world beyond it. Entry cannot be bypassed without your consent.

This elevates your sanctuary into a complete world of your own, no longer bound by physical limits, yet always tied to the mountain that guards it.
addons.title: Elysian Domain

addons.text:
Your mountain recognizes you not only as its master, but as its apex being. Your draconic nature integrates fully with Elysian Summit, transforming the entire mountain into your true den—your territory, your resting place, and the center of your presence.

This is not limited to the summit. The entire mountain becomes your domain in the most instinctive sense. Its exterior, interior, depths, and sanctuary all reflect a unified truth: this is your territory. The summit serves as the heart of this den, where your presence is most concentrated, while the rest of the mountain carries your influence outward through every layer.

Your connection to the mountain becomes instinctive. You are always aware of its structure, pathways, and disturbances within it. Movement through the mountain becomes effortless, whether across its exterior, through its interior, or within its sanctuary. Where others must climb or traverse, you move as though the mountain itself accommodates you.

Your physical capabilities are reinforced within your den. Strength, speed, endurance, and reaction operate at their peak without resistance. You do not struggle against your environment—your environment supports you. In contrast, others feel the mountain more heavily the further they ascend, especially when acting with hostility.

Your presence establishes a natural hierarchy. All who enter—creatures, constructs, guardians, or inhabitants—instinctively recognize you as the apex. This does not force obedience, but places you at the absolute peak of the mountain’s internal order.

The mountain reinforces this identity. Those who climb feel your presence the higher they ascend. The pressure becomes instinctual as well as environmental, as if approaching something greater the closer they come to the summit.

Within your sanctuary, this den becomes more refined. The space remains peaceful and stable, but it is unmistakably yours. It acts as the innermost chamber of your domain, where your presence is calm rather than overwhelming.

If paired with Kami’s Mountain, your role as Kami gains a physical embodiment. You are both divine overseer and apex entity, combining awareness and dominance into a single presence.

If paired with Under-Mountain Depths, your awareness extends through every layer. From summit to foundation, nothing exists outside your perception, and movement between layers becomes seamless.

If paired with Sacred Summit Shrine, your nature is refined rather than suppressed. You remain the apex, but your presence is balanced, allowing you to act as both stabilizing force and dominant entity.

If paired with the Law of the Summit addon, your authority gains a direct edge. You enforce limits while overwhelming physically, making resistance significantly more difficult.

If paired with Elysian Domain, your den expands beyond the mountain. The domain becomes an extension of your presence, and you are recognized as the apex within both, your influence carrying seamlessly between them.

If paired with Elysian Civilization, your people recognize you as both ruler and apex protector. Your presence reinforces loyalty and security as a constant, undeniable force.

If paired with Summit Guardians, the guardians recognize you as their absolute superior. Their coordination with you becomes more precise, acting in alignment with your intent.

Your mountain is no longer simply a place you inhabit. It is your den in the truest sense—layered, expansive, and alive with your presence.
addons.title: Apex Den

addons.text:
Your land expands into a fully realized civilization centered around your mountain. What was once a village grows into a network of cities, towns, and communities, unified under your authority and sustained through stable, self-sufficient systems.

Your population scales with your land, spreading naturally across its regions. Each settlement develops with purpose, supporting others while maintaining its own role. Infrastructure, culture, and industry emerge together, forming a civilization capable of long-term growth without instability.

Your people inherit a portion of your power. Their abilities refine and strengthen over time, creating a population that is not only numerous, but increasingly capable of supporting, defending, and expanding your domain.

The mountain serves as the center of this civilization. It is more than a landmark—it is the point around which everything is structured. It acts as a capital, a symbol of unity, and a place of authority, regardless of how far your civilization expands.

You do not need to manage every detail. The civilization functions independently, maintaining stability and growth on its own. Your influence remains absolute, allowing you to guide, reshape, or intervene when necessary without disrupting its natural flow.

If paired with Under-Mountain Depths, the civilization gains a hidden foundation. Production, storage, and infrastructure operate within the mountain, supporting the surface without exposing the systems behind it.

If paired with Sacred Summit Shrine, the civilization gains a stable spiritual core. Balance, purification, and cohesion are reinforced, reducing internal conflict and maintaining long-term stability.

If paired with the Law of the Summit addon, your authority extends into governance. You may regulate behavior, restrict abilities, and enforce order when necessary, ensuring stability without constant control.

If paired with Elysian Domain, your civilization may extend into the domain as a controlled expansion. Settlements may exist within your inner world while others remain outside, with movement governed through the mountain as the primary gateway.

If paired with Kami’s Mountain, you become both ruler and guardian. The mountain serves as your seat of authority, allowing you to observe and guide your civilization from above.

If paired with Summit Guardians, the guardians act as elite protectors tied to the summit, responding to threats that reach the mountain or extending their influence outward when required.

If paired with Apex Den, your people recognize you not only as ruler, but as the apex presence of their world. Your authority becomes instinctive to them, reinforcing unity and loyalty.

This is not merely a collection of settlements. It is a living system built around your mountain, your authority, and your presence, growing and adapting while remaining entirely your own.
addons.title: Elysian Civilization

addons.text:
The summit of your mountain gains a permanent defensive presence in the form of three bound guardians, each embodying a distinct role within your domain. These are not mere companions, but extensions of your authority, anchored to the summit and tied to the function of the mountain, sanctuary, and any space beyond it.

Each guardian fulfills a core role. One stands as the shield, holding ground and maintaining stability. One acts as the spear, engaging threats directly and adapting through combat. One acts as the support, reinforcing allies and sustaining both the guardians and the summit itself. Together, they operate with seamless coordination, aligning naturally without constant direction.

They are anchored to the summit but not confined to it. They may move through the upper mountain, sanctuary, and connected spaces, responding to intrusion, imbalance, or your command. Their awareness is strongest near the summit and threshold, allowing immediate response to those who reach it.

They do not tire, require no sustenance, and cannot be permanently destroyed. If defeated, they return after a period of time, retaining all growth and experience. Over time, they evolve beyond their initial roles, developing into an adaptive and specialized defensive force shaped by what they face.

Their behavior is fully under your control. They may remain passive or act autonomously, responding instantly to threats. Those you permit may pass without resistance, while hostile forces face coordinated and escalating opposition.

If paired with the Three For One upgrade, their unity deepens. Acting together grants them significant increases in effectiveness based on their roles, turning their coordination into a reinforced system where their combined actions exceed their individual capabilities. This bond extends to you, tying your safety to their survival. As long as one remains, you cannot be harmed.

If paired with Under-Mountain Depths, the wardens extend their reach downward, intercepting intruders before they reach the summit and coordinating with internal defenses while remaining anchored above.

If paired with Sacred Summit Shrine, they operate within a refined environment, becoming more effective against corruption and instability while unaffected by its influence.

If paired with the Law of the Summit addon, they act within enforced structure, fighting under conditions where enemies are restricted and stability favors their actions.

If paired with Elysian Civilization, they extend into the domain itself, operating across its regions and responding to disturbances over time while remaining tied to the summit.

If paired with Kami’s Mountain, they act as extensions of your awareness, responding to what you perceive and enforcing your will without direct intervention.

If paired with Apex Den, they recognize you as their absolute superior, aligning more precisely with your presence and acting in direct synchronization with your intent.

The wardens are not simply defenders. They are the living extension of your summit’s will, ensuring that anything which reaches the peak is met with a force that adapts, endures, and answers directly to you.
addons.title: Summit Guardians

addons.text:
Your domain gains a fully integrated production system, transforming your mountain and all connected territory into a continuous cycle of growth, refinement, and creation. This is not a single location, but a unified system operating across your land, sanctuary, and civilization.

Agriculture within your domain evolves beyond conventional limits. Crops grow in abundance regardless of conditions, carrying properties aligned to your abilities. They do not decay, spoil, or degrade, and may develop enhanced or supernatural traits over time. Livestock and creatures remain in perfect health, incapable of disease or deterioration, while producing materials influenced by your powers.

Your control over both plants and animals allows for directed growth. Crops may be cultivated toward specific traits, while animals may be guided to produce desired materials or effects. Growth, reproduction, and yield increase without placing strain on the environment, allowing the system to remain stable at any scale.

This production feeds directly into your alchemical capability. Materials produced within your domain are naturally suited for refinement, reducing inefficiencies and allowing for consistent creation of potions, constructs, and transmuted resources. Over time, this enables increasingly complex outputs, including the distillation of abilities into usable forms.

Transmutation further expands this system. Raw materials may be reshaped, combined, or elevated into new forms, allowing you to convert production output into specialized resources, biological constructs, or refined ingredients without reliance on external supply.

The system operates as a continuous cycle. Growth produces resources, resources feed alchemy, and alchemy enhances further growth. This loop stabilizes itself over time, forming a self-sustaining and expanding production network.

If paired with Elysian Black Shores, this system becomes the resource backbone of your civilization. Production, refinement, and distribution operate at scale, supplying your population and supporting long-term development.

If paired with Under-Mountain Depths, large-scale production and refinement may be centralized beneath the mountain, forming a hidden industrial foundation that supports your entire domain.

If paired with Sacred Summit Shrine, all production is stabilized and purified, preventing corruption or instability in materials and ensuring consistent output.

If paired with Elysian Domain, this system may extend across your entire world, forming large-scale agricultural, ecological, and alchemical networks.

If paired with Summit Wardens, your guardians may be supplied, restored, and enhanced through this system, allowing them to operate without resource limitation.
addons.title: Elysian Cycle

addons.text:
Your domain expands into a vast maritime civilization and fleet command system centered around your mountain. The Azur Lane Headquarters merges directly into your territory, transforming the surrounding regions into a network of naval cities, hidden ports, fleet yards, research hubs, and fortified maritime infrastructure.

The seas surrounding your territory become integrated into the structure of your domain. Coastlines expand into harbor cities, inland seas, carrier docks, and fleet anchorages capable of housing entire armadas. Through the spatial architecture woven into Elysian Summit, these waters and facilities possess far greater internal scale than their exterior appearance suggests.

Your mountain remains the center of this system. Fleet Command Towers, naval academies, coordination centers, and research facilities are integrated into both the summit and the internal layers of the mountain itself. Beneath the surface lie hidden drydocks, submarine bays, manufacturing sectors, and protected development zones connected through internal transit systems.

Shipgirl creation, naval construction, and retrofit capability scale alongside your civilization. Fleet Yards and Retrofit Bays may integrate compatible technologies, powers, or systems you possess into ships, Shipgirls, and naval infrastructure while preserving the identity of the original vessel or individual. Entire fleets may be modernized, redesigned, or hybridized within your territory.

Faction technologies from across Azur Lane are integrated into your research structure. Eagle Union, Royal Navy, Sakura Empire, Iron Blood, Northern Parliament, Dragon Empery, Iris Libre, Vichya Dominion, and Siren technologies may all be researched, combined, and developed simultaneously. Hybrid ship classes, dimensional fleets, advanced carriers, living warships, and experimental maritime constructs may all be developed within your territory.

Your territory functions as both a civilization and a naval superpower. Maritime trade routes, civilian districts, naval academies, and fleet infrastructure operate continuously alongside military operations.

Defensive systems spread across the islands and coastlines, including naval artillery, anti-air grids, shield systems, submarine detection networks, distortion barriers, and advanced maritime superweapons.

If paired with Elysian Black Shores, your naval civilization integrates directly into the Black Shores operational network. The Tethys System may coordinate fleets, simulate naval engagements, predict maritime threats, and manage large-scale deployment across planetary and interdimensional operations.

If paired with Under-Mountain Depths, enormous subterranean shipyards, hidden drydocks, manufacturing complexes, and protected naval infrastructure may be constructed beneath the mountain.

If paired with Elysian Domain, the waters of your domain become connected to external seas, oceans, rivers, and compatible waterways. Fleets and naval forces may travel through the Domain itself before emerging into outside waters at locations of your choosing.

If paired with Summit Wardens, the guardians may operate as elite fleet defenders, commanders, or rapid-response units tasked with protecting your mountain and surrounding seas.

If paired with Worldship and Black Shores Interstellar Directive, your fleets evolve into spacefaring variants capable of interstellar deployment. Ships and Shipgirls retain their identity while adapting into advanced aerospace and void-capable forms. Ports, shipyards, and fleet systems extend across both your territory and your Worldship.

Your domain is now the center of a vast maritime civilization and naval command system capable of projecting power across impossible seas and distant stars.
addons.title: Elysian Naval Command

addons.text:
Your civilization undergoes a complete transformation. The Black Shores no longer exists as a separate hidden archipelago, but merges seamlessly with your domain, forming a unified civilization and operational system centered around your mountain.

The archipelago integrates into your territory, reshaping it into a vast and interconnected network of islands, coastlines, and developed regions. These act as hubs for habitation, research, logistics, and deployment, while your mountain remains at the absolute center, serving as the core of authority and coordination.

Black Shores infrastructure expands both outward and inward. Cities and facilities spread across the islands, while deeper systems embed directly into the mountain. Beneath it lies the City of Eternal Night, housing the Tethys System within a concealed data-realm that serves as the central intelligence of your civilization.

The Tethys System evolves alongside your domain. It models global threats, internal development, and long-term growth, processing information across your territory and simulating future outcomes, allowing your civilization to act with foresight.

Your population expands across this structure, forming a true civilization rather than isolated settlements. Cities and operational zones develop throughout your domain, unified under your rule. Every citizen retains the empowerment granted by your system, creating a population that is both numerous and capable.

The Black Shores organization becomes the operational backbone of this civilization. Consultants, Gardeners, KU-series units, and all systems scale to match your population, forming a layered network of governance, research, logistics, and response that operates continuously without direct oversight.

The distortion field extends across your entire territory. Your civilization remains hidden or selectively accessible according to your will. External forces cannot locate or interfere without permission, while internal systems remain fully connected and stable.

Your authority evolves with this system. You are not simply its ruler, but the central point through which it operates. All systems, personnel, and networks ultimately resolve to your command.

Your domain is no longer simply a nation or an organization. It is a unified civilization and operational system, centered around your mountain and defined entirely by your authority.
addons.title: Elysian Black Shores

objects.text:
Your land manifests a singular feature: a vast mountain whose upper reaches are perpetually veiled in cloud and distance. It stands as a natural part of your territory, yet dominates the landscape while resisting easy approach.

The mountain is encircled by a natural expanse shaped to your will. This region may take any biome, or a seamless blend of many, from forests and valleys to more fantastical environments. These landscapes transition naturally, forming a cohesive whole. While still part of the world, they carry a subtle harmony influenced by what lies above, creating a gradual shift toward something more serene.

No one may reach the summit through shortcuts. Teleportation, spatial movement, flight, and similar methods cannot place an individual at or beyond the upper reaches. To ascend, one must climb the exterior or enter from the base and traverse its interior. The ascent is governed by pressure rather than suppression. The mountain resists forceful intrusion. The more one relies on overwhelming power, the more inefficient and exhausting movement becomes. Those who proceed with control, patience, or purpose encounter far less resistance. Intent shapes the climb; aggression makes progress heavier, while calm or focused approaches move more naturally. The mountain does not deny entry, but demands proper approach.

Within, you may shape internal routes at will. These paths may be natural caverns, constructed passageways, or layered environments, and can contain obstacles, guardians, hazards, or remain open as you choose. All paths ultimately lead to a single point near the peak.

At that point, a threshold exists. This threshold, whether a gate, pavilion, shrine, or simple passage, serves as the sole entry into the summit beyond. Passing through it does not lead to the visible peak, but into a spatially expanded interior anchored within the mountain.

This space is not a separate dimension, but a folded interior far greater than the exterior could contain. Beyond it lies your sanctuary. This inner realm mirrors Avalon, existing in perfect stability and isolation, untouched by decay, interference, or deterioration. Time, atmosphere, and environment remain harmonized, preserving an unchanging sense of peace. Nothing within it degrades or collapses unless you allow it.

The sanctuary takes any form you desire. It may center on a pavilion, pagoda, or open caldera surrounded by fields, forests, and life. The land is a complete paradise, with endless greenery, gentle terrain, and living systems without conflict. Animals roam freely, and the environment sustains itself effortlessly.

The sanctuary incorporates the full function of Sweet Home, acting as a living, self-configuring environment that adapts to your needs. Its structure may shift, expand, and refine through your will and available energy, while maintaining automated comfort, maintenance, and internal systems that allow it to function as a true home rather than a static refuge.

Despite its isolation, it remains connected. From within, you may observe the sky beyond the mountain, including sunrise, sunset, and the passage of the outside world, preserving awareness without exposure.

Access is entirely under your control. Others may only enter by reaching the summit threshold through the mountain itself, unless you permit otherwise. Once inside, they exist within the sanctuary’s stability unless you decide otherwise.

This is not merely land, but a refuge made absolute, hidden, enduring, and entirely your own.
objects.title: Elysian Summit

objects.text:
Your ticket has been upgraded to VIP status, which significantly expands its capabilities and features.

Among the improvements: you can now use the story-based abilities of the film’s main characters of your choice, or combinations thereof. When transitioning between the movie and reality, you retain all your abilities and the properties of the items you bring with you. If other people are with you, you can allow them to retain their abilities.

Finally, your ticket no longer expires and now functions as a subscription, allowing you to repeat your journeys once a week to any film.
objects.title: VIP Ticket

objects.text: Now, instead of “Evil Pieces,” you have the crystalline “Race Pieces” associated with the 16 Exceed. The Race Pieces infused with the Suniaster’s power have the ability to grant the bearer a fragment of the power the Suniaster held, and can convert them into an “Old Deus” by binding themselves to the bearer’s soul. Each piece is tied to one of the sixteen Exceed, the sixteen races of Disboard, and grants the bearer complete control over that race as its “New" Old Deus, able to generate new members of that race and command them with absolute authority. The greatest portion of the Suniaster’s might is infused into the King Piece, now linked to the Old Deus and amplifying all other powers you may have tenfold. Binding with this piece transforms you into a powerful Old Deus, marking you as King over all other Old Deus and, therefore, King of your new peerage. The bestowing of a Race Piece upon someone you deem worthy is almost absolute. Once it binds itself to its bearer’s soul, it cannot be suppressed, negated, or removed in any way other than by you removing the piece of your own free will. Note: With the King Piece now representing the “Old Deus”, “Immanity” is now represented by a Pawn Piece.
objects.title: Race Pieces (No Game No Life)

objects.text:
With each purchase here, you gain an additional 8 Race Pieces, each bearing a small fragment of the Suniaster's power. These Race Pieces can be any piece other than another King Piece.

Each Piece can be tied to one of the Exceed—other than the Old Deus—or, if you have powers that make you another Race, you can instead tie a Race Piece to them.

What would an Old Deus of Kryptonians look like? Or an Old Deus of Kaijuu, maybe? There is a very generous definition of "Race" here. Shinigami (Bleach), Mutants (Marvel), Wizards (Harry Potter), and other similar options can be selected if you have the appropriate power—even if they could be considered parts of another Race.
objects.title: Additional Pieces

objects.text:
Your Bell and the Box have fused. Now, with a simple tap of the button, you'll hear an elegant ring before a Meeseeks appears, typically dressed in butler attire. Beneath the surface, the handbell has infected the box itself, infusing the creation process with Mr. Deeds.

On top of everything both could already do, these creations, which prefer to be called “Deedseeks,” are now able to maintain their composure for far longer. They can persist at about half a normal human lifespan, Averaging 35-40 years in total.

Their production rate has also increased dramatically. This is thanks to you not being limited to simply one Mr. Deeds, but possibly a few hundred Deedseeks instead.

Finally, even if a Deedseeks fulfills its initial task, it will not disappear unless you directly command it to do so. If one dies, there is no longer a need to wait three minutes — simply press the box again.
objects.title: Mr. Deedseek

objects.text: The AllSpark is a cube containing the totality of Cybertronian knowledge and the power to restore that race to life by creating new Cybertronians from various technology. The Escafil Device is a cube granting those who interact with it the ability to change their shape into any animals whose DNA you can acquire a sample of. Or at least they were. Now, they snap together, merging in an instant to form something greater than the sum of their parts. Instead of the Escafil Device only allowing the ability to Morph into living, breathing animals—after acquiring their DNA—and with the archives of the AllSpark, you can now Morph into mechanical variants—based on Cybertronian biology—of any animal whose DNA you acquire. The AllSpark, synchronizing with the Escafil Device’s Morph granting, can give Transformers the ability to acquire new alternate modes by scanning various animals. Even gaining a human-sized and shaped alternate mode is possible, making the much more capable of interacting with the significantly smaller humans.
objects.title: Tesseract

objects.text:
Your Gameforge Console has received yet another upgrade. Before, you had nearly complete freedom in how you used it, but now ‘nearly’ has been removed from the equation. You are now the proud owner of the Worldforge Console, and with it a whole new world of possibility opens before you.

In the main menu a new option has appeared, the World Hub. At first, the World Hub is merely an endless white plane, but as you complete Dungeons you unlock the ability to add things from the media the Dungeon was based on using a customization menu, with better options becoming available based on the hardest difficulty Challenge you completed. For example, completing a Casual Hollow Knight Challenge would allow you to add basic structures and NPCs from Dirtmouth, while an beating Impossible++ Challenge would fully unlock all of Hollow Knight, from areas to Charms to main characters like the Knight or Hornet. You can mix and match from any completed media to create your ideal virtual world.

Just because it's a virtual world does not mean the Hub is lifeless though. Every NPC is simultaneously a simulation and a real being with thoughts, feelings, and even a soul, all loyal to you. In addition, you can create custom assets based on unlocked content, with additional modifications possible by beating a Challenge with Workshop content enabled. In time, you could create a Spartan II who is also a Super Saiyan, Magical Girl, and Witcher who fights with a team of Digital Pokemon and wields a Keyblade-based Symphogear Mjolnir Suit, or whatever other crazy combination you can come up with. Mix and match power systems, cultures, character models, and more to your hearts content in an ever expanding world of your own creation, and any unwanted changes can be undone at the push of a button.

In addition, you can also bring others into the world with you using the Console, though they are treated as Guest users with limited access permissions you can customize. This allows you to do multiplayer Dungeon Runs, growing your allies strength along with your own. Alternatively, you can bring anyone in a ten foot radius into the World Hub, either to explore your world, live in it full time, or be transported to a prepared arena to fight against along with a small army of NPCs.

Finally, you gain the ability to acquire Meta-Rewards, Challenge rewards that alter the function of the Worldforge Console itself. This can do anything from adding even more customization options, add new difficulties or unique Challenge types for various media, allow you to stream Dungeon runs on the internet, let people do their own runs from other consoles or devices, improve your ability to drag people into the Hub, let you bring parts of the Hub or NPCs into the real world on a semi-permanent basis, the possibilities are endless.

The only limit is that Meta-Rewards are locked behind Challenges of immense difficulty that get harder the better the Reward is, with even a basic one locked behind an Impossible++ Challenge. But if you get good enough, get strong enough, then the only limits to what you can do are what you decide on for yourself.
objects.title: Worldforge Console

objects.text:
Your Personal World and Worldship have fully merged. All features of both powers are retained and enhanced. The Worldship becomes your Personal World, while its sovereign dimension becomes the foundation of the Worldship itself.

The Sovereign Worldship exists within its own dimension when not deployed. This dimension expands alongside the Worldship and supports its civilizations, infrastructure, territories, and internal realms. When summoned, the complete Worldship manifests as a celestial body within the chosen reality. When dismissed, it returns to its sovereign dimension without disrupting life aboard. You may always travel to and from it regardless of distance, dimension, timeline, or cosmology. It cannot be permanently stolen, usurped, denied, or separated from you.

All capabilities of The Worldship remain fully operational. The Quantum Core, Dyson Shell, World Nodes, gate lattice, transit networks, deployment systems, orbital infrastructure, defensive systems, planetary weapons, outpost links, annexation functions, internal dimensions, and all other Worldship systems gain the adaptive and evolutionary properties of the Personal World. They may grow, improve, and incorporate new powers, technologies, resources, energies, and discoveries as the Worldship develops.

The Worldship continuously evolves to support your powers, discoveries, technologies, magical systems, energies, and authorities. As you grow stronger, the Sovereign Worldship grows alongside you.

The sovereign dimension now serves as the foundation for all internal domains, subspace sectors, shipyards, archives, industries, habitats, research facilities, agricultural regions, training grounds, and specialized realms. These regions may continue expanding alongside the Worldship without conventional spatial limitations. The Worldship may become larger through natural growth, dimensional expansion, Planetary Annexation, or any other means available to either parent power.

Existing populations remain while the Worldship supports the growth of its civilizations. Cities, industries, institutions, military forces, academies, and cultures flourish indefinitely without stagnation. New peoples, species, technologies, traditions, and discoveries may be integrated seamlessly into the greater whole.

The Worldship learns from every reality it encounters, gradually incorporating useful resources, technologies, lifeforms, environmental traits, magical phenomena, and other beneficial developments into itself. Over time, it becomes a living archive of your journeys, discoveries, alliances, conquests, and achievements.

Claimed worlds are integrated into both the Worldship and its sovereign dimension, automatically expanding its territory, civilizations, infrastructure, internal domains, and systems. The Dyson Shell, World Nodes, transit networks, and dimensional framework expand alongside this growth.

If critically damaged, the Worldship automatically retreats into its sovereign dimension where accelerated restoration preserves its populations, civilizations, infrastructure, and ecosystems while repairing damage and strengthening resistance to recurring threats, hazards, environments, and attacks.

The caretaker intelligence evolves alongside the Worldship itself, becoming more capable as the world expands. It remains loyal and assists with administration, navigation, logistics, maintenance, development, defense, and the responsibilities required to govern a civilization-world.

This is more than a world. It is a sovereign dimensional worldship: a living homeland, an evolving civilization, and a wandering nation among the stars, bound to your soul and destined to grow alongside you without limit.
objects.title: Sovereign Worldship

objects.text: Countless Wazamono/Grade Blades... Fifty Ryōwazamono/Skillful Grade Blades... Twenty-Eight Ōwazamono/Great Grade Blades... And Twelve Saijō Ōwazamono/Supreme Grade Blades... .Wield Them Well. Your Samurai Will has awoken the living spirit forged into your chosen blades by their makers, the Craftsman Clans of Wano. Moved by your spirit, they have deemed you worthy, causing a resonance within your Sacred Gear and Meito. Now combined, your version of Sword Birth is capable of creating Black Blades, greatly expanding the scope of effects you can imbue into your demonic blades. But the true power lies in your ability to summon a conceptual copy of any Meito in the existence of the Sea Ring World. Being conceptual, and upgraded to Black Blades, each of these blades can imbue you with a portion of their powers, as well as the powers of their wielders, depending on how intricately bound the blade is to its most powerful wielder, as well as your own symbiosis with the named blade. Yoru or Murakumogiri may grant you at most a 10th of their Mihawk or Whitebeard's skills & powers to start. But mastering these weapons can get you to the point of not just borrowing the full power of a wielder, but also inheriting their teachings, a portion of their will, and even a bit of their strength or powers... permanently. Should you achieve Balance Breaker, you will most likely develop the avility to summon previous wielders to aid you in combat; however, you can forgo this, design something else, or let fate choose.
objects.title: Sword Birth Subspecies: Lord of the Famed Blades

objects.text: I, Arthur Penhaligon, Second Architect of the House, being of sound mind, not acting under duress or undue influence, and fully understanding the nature and extent of all my property and of this disposition thereof, do hereby make, publish and declare this document to be my Last Will and Testament, and hereby revoke any and all other Wills and codicils heretofore made by me. With the retirement, and dissolution of Arthur Penhaligon as Architect of the House, the Keystone of Creation, you now rise to take his place as the Third Architect, and inherit the Keys to the Kingdom. The First Key, which governs Time, the Second Key which governs matter, the Third Key which governs Space, the Fourth Key which governs the Mind, the Fifth Key which governs the Soul, the Sixth Key which governs Magic, and the Seventh Key which governs Energy. Each Keys full potential and power has been unlocked and bound irrevocably to you. Nothing short of your own free will can suppress or remove the Keys from you. You will have the ability to freely use them across the House and Secondary Realms, regardless of the day. With these seven Keys—and the Compleat Atlas—in hand, you gain the ability to flawlessly recreate existence and take complete control of the House, and its seven demesnes, The Lower House, The Far Reaches, The Border Sea, The Great Maze, The Middle House, The Upper House, and The Incomparable Gardens, along with the countless myriad worlds known only as The Secondary Realms. From there though? What you do is up to you. You could appoint Trustee’s to govern the seven demesnes, and bear a Key—albeit a limited version of one—and try to return to live a normal life. Maybe you could simply take control of the House, and attempt to remake it in your own image? Or maybe you’ll decide to do something else entirely? The choice is yours... All hail the Third Architect, Rightful Heir to the House, the Keys of the Kingdom, Master of the Lower House, Lord of the Far Reaches, Duke of the Border Sea, Overlord of the Great Maze, Commander-in-Chief of the Glorious Army of the Architect, Master of the Middle House, Ruler of the Upper House, Lord of the Incomparable Gardens, and the Secondary Realms.
objects.title: Tertius Architectus (The Keys to the Kingdom)

addons.text:
At the press of a button, the Mystery Shack can unfold into Shacktron, a colossal humanoid mech designed by Fiddleford McGucket.

Shacktron possesses immense physical strength, capable of wrestling creatures many times its own size, demolishing buildings with ease, and serving as a powerful defensive platform for the Shack and its occupants. True to its original design, one arm ends in the mounted head of a Tyrannosaurus rex, providing a devastating close-range weapon alongside the mech's tremendous raw power.

Despite its transformation, the interior remains largely intact and habitable, with occupants kept secure throughout the process. The transformation is fully reversible, allowing the Mystery Shack to return to its ordinary appearance without damage or loss of functionality. Any upgrades, protections, or properties possessed by the Shack continue to function while it is in Shacktron form unless doing so would be physically impossible.
addons.title: Shacktron

objects.text:
Once a research lab dedicated to solving the mysteries of Gravity Falls and later tourist trap, the Mystery Shack is now yours.

Above ground, the Shack appears much as it always has. The ground floor contains the Mystery Museum, gift shop, kitchen, living quarters, and the rest of the familiar attractions. The upper floor houses two bedrooms and the attic.

Entering the correct passcode into the museum's vending machine reveals the hidden elevator leading to the underground complex. Here you'll find Ford's laboratory and study, as well as the fully functional Interdimensional Portal. Any maintenance, power requirements, or specialized knowledge needed to safely operate the facility are conveniently provided in copies of the journals.

Scattered throughout the Shack is a collection of supernatural curiosities. These include items such as cursed wax figures, the Infinity-Sided Dice, an infinite pizza slice, a size-altering crystal flashlight, the President's Key, the Memory Gun, Truth-Telling Teeth, and a cursed pinball machine.

The property is naturally protected against supernatural intrusion. Attempts to scry upon, remotely observe, or otherwise gather information about the Shack through any means simply fail. Likewise, reality-warping, spatial manipulation, and similar powers cannot touch the Shack, ensuring it remains a stable sanctuary even in worlds where the laws of reality are less than reliable.
objects.title: Mystery Shack (Gravity Falls)

objects.text: Now, instead of solely the mobile planetoid station of High Charity, it has gained a companion—a moon approximately 120 kilometers in diameter. With its own natural atmosphere, the moonlet appears white from a distance, hinting at shallow oceans and lush, verdant growth upon closer inspection. Ashla is largely hollow, featuring an expansive cityscape that covers its inner surface. At its core lies an “artificial star”—a construct housing a Forerunner Lifeworker vessel—that provides light, and powers the moon, provides formidable shields and enables the moon to travel independently through the galaxy if desired. Ashla is an immensely powerful Force nexus, oriented towards the light side of the Force. Once a Force user has experienced its sheer power, they will often be able to detect it across the entire galaxy. At the heart of the nexus lies the Pool of Knowledge, a dark pool situated in the center of a dank grotto. Bathing in this pool offers visions of the past and future, while granting a powerful connection to the light side of the Force. Normally, this would be a very dangerous thing to do; however, this version of the Pool lacks the usual risks. As a nexus of the light side, Ashla is now home to the Jedi Order—whether that is the traditional Jedi Order or a new one founded by you is up to you—with millions of members skilled in the Force. The Jedi serve as the Shield of High Charity—and any other property or territories you might own—guardians of peace and justice, and counterparts to the Sith Order—if it should exist. Ashla has a population of around a billion, each with a connection to the Force. You can choose to determine this randomly or specify the demographics using the same rules as for High Charity.
objects.title: Ashla (Star Wars)

objects.text: Now, instead of solely the mobile planetoid station of High Charity, it has gained a companion—a moon approximately 120 kilometers in diameter. With its own natural atmosphere, the moonlet appears red from a distance, revealing deserts, and a harsh jagged landscape upon closer inspection. Bogan is largely hollow, featuring an expansive cityscape that covers its inner surface. At its core lies an “artificial star”—a construct housing a Forerunner Lifeworker vessel—that provides light, and powers the moon, provides formidable shields and enables the moon to travel independently through the galaxy if desired. Bogan is an immensely powerful Force nexus, oriented towards the dark side of the Force. Once a Force user has experienced its sheer power, they will often be able to detect it across the entire galaxy. At the heart of the nexus lies the Font of Power, appearing as a fountain in an overgrown courtyard. Drinking from this fountain offers immense power, while granting a powerful connection to the dark side of the Force. Normally, this would be a very dangerous thing to do; however, this version of the Font lacks the usual risks. As a nexus of the dark side, Bogan is now home to the Sith Order—whether that is one of the Sith Orders of old, or a new one founded by you is up to you—with millions of members skilled in the Force. The Sith serve as the Sword of High Charity—and any other property or territories you might own—the vanguards of fury and destruction. Bogan has a population of around a billion, each with a connection to the Force. You can choose to determine this randomly or specify the demographics using the same rules as for High Charity.
objects.title: Bogan (Star Wars)

objects.text: Now, instead of just the planetoid High Charity and its twin moons, Ashla and Bogan, you have the world of Tython—roughly the size of our own—considered the legendary origin of all those who wield the mystic Force. Tython is still capable of moving itself through both slipspace and realspace, and it is still guarded by its formidable defense fleet—now also able to use technology from the Star Wars universe. High Charity—now simply a city on the surface of Tython or an orbiting station—remains the seat of government—and, to an extent, religion. Other settlements exist across Tython, spreading the population out across its surface. Ashla and Bogan have also increased in size—becoming the size of our moon—while still maintaining all their previous features. However, the Orders that called them home have reunited, reforging themselves into a new Je’daii Order, which values balance in the Force. Those who stray too close to the light side of the Force are sent to Ashla to meditate on the darkness of Bogan in the sky. Conversely, those who stray too far into the dark side are sent to Bogan to meditate on the light of Ashla. The Je’daii serve as both the sword and shield of Tython and its people, ready to serve in whatever role is needed.
objects.title: Tython (Star Wars)

objects.text: Now Tython and its twin moons awaken, becoming similar to Mogo the Living World, as the power of the Emotional Electromagnetic Spectrum becomes accessible to them. They’ll be able to manipulate their own weather, plant life, gravity, waters and soil, while being able to independently travel through the stars, and communicate telepathically. All three will look favourably upon you, with it taking considerable effort to make them willingly betray you. Each of these celestial bodies awakens a single aspect of the Emotional Spectrum, with a natural inclination toward certain colors. You can choose any color you like for this however, and over time, they’ll be able to learn to utilize all seven aspects. Bogan’s nature as a nexus for the dark side of the Force gives it a natural aptitude for Rage, Avarice, and Fear, while Ashla’s nature as a Light Side nexus draws it toward Hope, Compassion, and Love. As the balance between the two, Tython has a natural inclination toward the emerald light of Will. The Force-wielding order that calls these worlds home gains the ability to draw upon the light of emotion, integrating the technology of the Lantern Rings into the Lightsabers they prize so highly. The Je’daii path, instead of simply focusing on balancing the Force, includes mastering and balancing the seven aspects of emotion, whereby the blade of their lightsaber will turn white as they gain a greater connection to the White Light of Creation— the origin of the Force, the origin of Life. The three worlds are each rich with emotion-attuned Kyber crystal, which can be used to make more "Power Sabre's", these crystals slowly replenish any that are taken. These crystals are part of what makes the worlds so alive in the Force—in the Emotional Spectrum—and allow them to project the power they gain over incredible distances with precision.
objects.title: The Living Worlds (DC Comics)

objects.text: Now, Tython is integrated with the technology and knowledge of the Ancients, as well as their creations—the Asuran. Tython, Ashla, Bogan, and their fleets gain shields backed by Zero Point Modules, hyperdrives capable of crossing the galaxy in under an hour, and an endless supply of the infamous drone weapons. The various settlements across Tython and its moons are converted into the enormous mobile city-ships of the Ancients, patterned after their crown jewel, Atlantis. The population doubles to 16 billion, with the 8 billion new inhabitants being Asuran—like yourself—a sentient mass of nanomachines, each somehow capable of manipulating the Force. These Asuran are bound by their base code to obey you, though this has its limits, they will not willingly betray you without you giving them a very good reason. Tython and its satellite’s gain powerful industrial capabilities. With an effectively unlimited number of Zero Point Modules, you’ll be able to create most materials via energy-mass conversion, and even “print” ships wholesale with a bit of effort.
objects.title: Asuras (Stargate)

objects.text:
Your set of Federation facilities has expanded to include those of Starfleet more generally, particularly starbases, stations, shipyards, & the ships they service.

This includes San Francisco Fleet Yards, Utopia Planitia Fleet Yards, McKinley Station (including the Advanced Starship Design Bureau), Antares Ship Yards, Jupiter Station, The Fleet Museum, Starbase series stations (like 1, 6, K-7, 134, 173, 257, 375, & Yorktown), Armagosa Observatory, Epsilon IX, Regula I, Cold Station 12, The MIDAS Array, The Argus Array, Deep Space 9, & Spacedock-class stations (like SB74, Douglas Station, & of course the iconic Earth Spacedock One).

The level of technology available (and to a degree, which facilities you get access to) is determined by the level of technology of your core ship. For example, the "Constitution-Class Starship (Star Trek)" with no upgrades can get you everything up to the TOS movie era, but if you want 24th century equipment you need to take "Make It So (Star Trek)", and if you want anything beyond that, you will need "Timefleet Retrofit (Star Trek)". This is especially relevant as it effects the tech of the ships you receive alongside their berths, as well as the ships you can create using the drydocks.
objects.title: Spacedock One (Star Trek)

objects.text:
The Paradox Alchemic Sylladex allows you access to a variant of Paradox Space Alchemy. Through this Sylladex you can not only Captchalogue things, but also Alchimize them. Alchimizing things normally requires the use of Grist, but by using the principles of The Phantom Magus Combine Deck it is possible to directly combine component items. This can be done through either AND or OR type operation, allowing the same two component cards to create two different results.

While direct Alchemization is possible, you can also perform more standard Alchemization through Grist, this is possible through two features. The first is a "Capcha Database", it contains the "code" of everything you've Captchalogued or Alchimized, allowing you to Alchemize things directly from Grist. The second is a "Grist Grinder", this allows you to grind Captchalogued items into various types of Grist, though you will only receive a fraction of the Grist needed to Alchemize the grinded item.

The Paradox Alchemic Sylladex is bound to your soul like the The Phantom Magus Combino Deck, preventing anyone from taking it. If you have Unhelpful Sylladex, the storage feature of The Paradox Alchemic Sylladex will function like your chosen Sylladex, otherwise it will work like the wallet Sylladex.
objects.title: The Paradox Alchemic Sylladex

addons.title: Sovereign World
addons.text:
Your Personal World becomes Star Sovereign’s Habitat World. Spatial compression unfolds its full surface beneath the Sky Shell without shrinking it. Star Sovereign can remain approximately 1,000 km across outside while its interior holds an Earth-sized world, ringworld, Alderson Disk, or larger realm at its actual scale.

Everything already in your Personal World comes with it: land, oceans, ecosystems, resources, buildings, inhabitants, and civilizations. Its geography adjusts enough to form one connected world, but nothing is erased or reduced. Existing nations may keep their territories, governments, and identities within Star Sovereign.

The Sky Shell incorporates your Personal World’s sun, moon, stars, atmosphere, weather, seasons, and other celestial features. They retain their natural or supernatural functions. All Personal World addons, upgrades, and modifications also carry over, including those acquired after this fusion.

Star Sovereign’s capital, Grand Sovereign Ring, defenses, and infrastructure adapt to the expanded interior. Its four Grand Continental Corridors become major routes between the capital and Ring. Roads, transit networks, and portals branch from them to connect distant regions, using shortened routes where ordinary travel would be impractical.

Your Personal World’s ownership and protections cover the entire union. You retain its recovery, access control, teleportation, portals, and ability to alter its environment. As your Personal World gains territory or features, new space unfolds beneath the Sky Shell; Star Sovereign expands its infrastructure to support them. Wherever Star Sovereign travels, your entire world travels with it.

addons.title: Sovereign Resource Network
addons.text:
Gaia’s Expanse remains a separate living world, permanently connected to Star Sovereign by a large, controlled gateway in the Grand Sovereign Ring. Smaller Resource Gates can connect authorized mines, farms, warehouses, refineries, factories, laboratories, shipyards, and other facilities directly to the Expanse.

The network tracks requests for materials and coordinates their delivery. Workers, machinery, and automated systems can gather resources in the Expanse and send them through the nearest Gate to the facility that needs them. Ore reaches refineries, processed materials reach factories, and food reaches population centers. Storage facilities on both sides operate as one distribution system.

You can establish mines, farms, processing plants, roads, railways, drones, and settlements in the Expanse. Compatible technologies and magical improvements available to either structure can be applied to this infrastructure. As Star Sovereign’s population and industry grow, the network adds Gates, storage, extraction, and transport capacity to meet demand. Gaia’s Expanse adjusts its resource abundance as described by its own powers.

You decide who and what may use each Gate and can close, move, or restrict them. A compromised Gate seals automatically, preventing the network from becoming an entry through Star Sovereign’s defenses. Extraction is coordinated with the Expanse’s self-restoring ecosystems so its wilderness remains intact even as it supplies a growing civilization.

objects.text:
Star Sovereign is the sovereign capital and mobile homeland of an interstellar civilization. Equal parts artificial world, industrial powerhouse, and naval fortress, it is a self-contained nation carried among the stars. Initially measuring approximately 1,000 km in diameter, it is designed to expand alongside its civilization, forever growing to accommodate new territories, industries, and populations.

Encircling the world is the Grand Sovereign Ring, a colossal 250 km-thick hollow megastructure forming its outer boundary and structural backbone. Rather than being solid, nearly its entire interior is usable space, housing a vast military-industrial metropolis containing continuous Fleet Corridors, colossal shipyards, manufacturing centers, logistics networks, research facilities, civilian and military spaceports, reactors, utilities, transportation systems, and planetary support infrastructure.

Protected beneath immense armor and planetary shield grids, the Ring is entered through four colossal Fleet Gates positioned at the cardinal directions, allowing entire fleets to deploy or return simultaneously. Smaller Transit Gates serve civilian, industrial, and military traffic. Every gate connects directly into the protected Fleet Corridor network, allowing spacecraft to travel anywhere within the Ring without exposing the Habitat World to space.

Anchored to the Ring is the immense Sky Shell, spanning the entire interior like the heavens of an artificial planet. Hidden above the landscape, it maintains the atmosphere while controlling weather, lighting, seasons, and astronomical projections. Citizens experience blue skies, clouds, rain, stars, and natural day-night cycles without ever seeing the engineering concealed overhead.

Beneath the Sky Shell stretches the Habitat World, a true continental homeland filled with cities, forests, mountains, rivers, plains, deserts, coastlines, and inland seas. Advanced spatial engineering allows new provinces, settlements, and environments to be integrated seamlessly as Star Sovereign expands.

At the world's center lies a great inland sea surrounding the Capital City, from which rises the colossal Sovereign Tower, extending upward until it meets the Sky Shell. Visible from nearly every horizon, it serves as both the symbol of your rule and the heart of the civilization.

The Sovereign Tower is your Palace-Fortress, housing your private palace, Grand Throne Hall, audience chambers, diplomatic halls, strategic command, administrative ministries, Beacon systems, communications, observatories, and direct access to the Sky Shell. From here you rule the civilization while your administrators, commanders, engineers, and advisors carry out your will.

Buried deep beneath the Tower lies the heavily fortified Core Citadel, housing the Sovereign AI, central command nexus, master archives, Beacon Core, Launch Star coordination, strategic communications, dimensional control systems, and continuity infrastructure. While the Ring operates the civilization's distributed industries and infrastructure, the Core Citadel coordinates every major system as the hidden heart of Star Sovereign.

Four monumental Grand Continental Corridors radiate from the Capital City to the Ring, forming landscaped transportation valleys roughly 3–5 km wide. Their upper levels contain parks, waterways, roads, and public transit, while lower levels house maglev lines, freight, military logistics, utilities, and maintenance systems. Countless bridges, tunnels, and wildlife crossings preserve the surrounding landscape.

Where each Corridor enters the Ring, transparent Atmospheric Containment Veils separate the Habitat World from the Ring while allowing people, vehicles, cargo, and spacecraft to move freely without conventional airlocks. Branch corridors connect every province, city, and industrial district to these four great arteries.

Protected by layered shields, colossal armor, heavy defenses, and deeply redundant infrastructure, Star Sovereign ranks among the greatest fortresses your civilization possesses. As your civilization grows, so too does Star Sovereign. The Habitat World expands with new territories and cities, the Ring grows with additional shipyards and industries, the Sky Shell extends to cover every new horizon, and the Core Citadel seamlessly integrates every addition into a single unified civilization. Wherever your people journey, Star Sovereign remains their eternal homeland beneath its own heavens.

You may choose to populate Star Sovereign with races or species from the world you enter, or from any setting whose powers you have purchased, provided no individual exceeds your own abilities. They become loyal citizens of Star Sovereign, seamlessly integrating into its civilization, culture, and continued development.
objects.title: Star Sovereign

addons.title: Ancient Dragons
addons.text:
Your Status as a True Dragon has altered the makeup of the pocket dimension containing your Labyrinth and its population.

Like Güliedistodiez before you, you enjoy the complete loyalty and servitude of all 8 Ancient Dragon Chiefs present within the series, along with their subordinates. Everyone from Hyvan and his band of Wind Dragons to the mysterious and solitary Light and Dark Dragon Chiefs, Byaku and Reise.

To match this increase in draconic population, the space containing your Great Elroe Labyrinth has expanded accordingly and gained fitting environments for them to live in, such as great snowy peaks for Nia and her Ice Dragons and great lakes or an ocean for Iena and her host of Water Dragons, the specifics of which are up to you.

addons.title: Lineage of the Eldest Divine Beast
addons.text:
You have not only inherited Shiraori’s powers and scythe, but also her connections to the Taratect Species, which has altered the makeup of the pocket dimension containing your Labyrinth and its population.

Through this connection, your pocket dimension is now home to a loyal reconstruction of the Origin Taratect Ariel herself, having had her soul’s lifespan extended, along with all of her forces at their peak, including her dozen or so Puppet Taratects and all 6 Queen Taratects (including the one already present), who each have Taratect hoards comparable to those already present in the in the Great Elroe Labyrinth. 

In addition to the standard Taratects, your labyrinth is now also home to the Shiraori’s own kin, the Horo Neia, or better known as the Nightmare’s Vestiges. These monsters vary wildly in strength, depending on their stage of development, but are highly intelligent and revere you as their progenitor.

Finally, the size of your labyrinth has been expanded accordingly to allow for this increase in population without changing the average population density.

addons.title: System Integration
addons.text:
Your Great Tomb of Nazarick and Great Elroe Labyrinth have fused. The specifics of this are up to you, whether the strata of the labyrinth are integrated as new floors of Nazarick, the entrance of Nazarick appears somewhere in the space containing your Great Elroe Labyrinth, or something else entirely.

No matter the shape, the conjuring running your labyrinth has combined with Nazarick’s guild system, giving the monsters of Elroe Yggdrasil levels and features and the denizens of Nazarick access to your modified W System, enhancing the power and potential of both groups. 

The specific treatment of Elroe’s monsters varies depending on their strength. At the very top, the Legendary Monsters like the Queen Taratect receive 100 suitable Yggdrasil levels and function as special boss-class NPC’s for your guild. Below them, any monsters ranked B-S receive between 50 and 90 Yggdrasil levels and are treated as mercenary monsters under the guild system. At the bottom of the hierarchy, any monster ranked C or below is treated as a POP monster by the guild system, receiving up to 30 Yggdrasil levels.

The denizens of Nazarick, on the other hand, receive much more equal treatment. Every being in Nazarick starts at level 1 in your W System, and gains x1000 their Yggdrasil level in starting skill points. Additionally, Yggdrasil’s Heteromorphic races are treated as monsters by the W System, granting them access to various evolutions as they level up.

Additionally, your System gains a function to convert stored MA energy into NPC levels, which you can use as you please, be it for designing new NPC’s from the ground up or converting existing monsters into NPCs. You begin with 1000 of these levels.

Finally, you can now access your W System from your Guild Menu, and vice versa.

objects.text:
You have ownership over a pocket dimension containing the entirety of the Great Elroe Labyrinth, including the Upper, Middle, Lower, and Bottom Stratums, along with a core room in a magically sealed space at the very heart of the labyrinth containing the core of a modified version of the W System, which keeps the properties of the structure itself and the monsters inhabiting it functional.

The Upper Stratum consists of a huge country-sized network of interconnected caverns of various sizes, inhabited by large numbers of relatively weak monsters, many of which are poisonous. On very rare occasions, a monster in this stratum will gain strength equal to a dragon, most often as a result of a native Earth Wyrm evolving into an Earth Dragon before eventually migrating to a lower stratum.

The Middle Stratum is a vast, fiery hellscape, consisting mostly of large magma-filled caverns with small rocky islands and paths stretching across. The average monsters that inhabit this environment are not noticeably different from their peers in the Upper Stratum in terms of raw strength; however, they all possess powerful resistances to heat and fire, allowing them to freely traverse the stratum’s hostile environs.

The Lower Stratum’s environment is much like the Upper Stratum, only with far fewer small passages and caverns. Its inhabitants diverge in much the same way, with the stratum’s monsters being much stronger and larger, on average, ranging from those that a party of powerful adventurers might be able to handle to those that an entire army would struggle to put down.

The Bottom Stratum consists of one ginormous cavern, inhabited by two separate hierarchies, headed by the legendary monsters: a Queen Taratect and the Ancient Chief of the Earth Dragons, Gakia. The Queen Taratect is a fortress-sized spider monster who controls dozens of Arch Taratects and uncountable hoards of her lesser children. Gakia’s total forces are fewer in number than those of the Queen, but their average quality is much higher, largely consisting of Earth Dragons and powerful Earth Wyrms on the cusp of evolution, with a small handful of additional Ancient Earth Dragons that are only a bit weaker than the Queen and Gakia himself.

From the very depths of the Bottom Stratum, you may access the conjuring system governing the structure and its inhabitants, which you have administrative authority over. Here you will find all of the data present within D’s W System, and pre-compiled functions that allow you limited control over the system’s features, such as the energy extraction rate and instinctual monster behavior, independent of your own Conjuring skills. One special feature of note allows you to use Spatial Conjuring to open and close entrances to your Labyrinth at coordinates of your choice, letting you effectively insert it wherever you please.

<small>Note: The intelligent monsters of the labyrinth respect your status and presence as the administrator of their home; however, their loyalty will need to be earned, as they are not as easily influenced by their instincts as their lesser kin.</small>
objects.title: Great Elroe Labyrinth (Kumo Desu)

objects.text:
With the unification of the Geth Consensus and the Quarian Migrant Fleet under your leadership, a 300-year-old conflict comes to a close. Instead of merely controlling the Migrant Fleet and the technological assets of the Geth Consensus, you gain the entire Perseus Veil, within which lies the homeworld of the Quarians and their Geth creations.

The Quarians will undergo a rapid population boom, as the Geth assist in restoring their immune systems and help grow millions of new Quarian children within artificial wombs. Overjoyed by the return of their creators, the Geth will turn away from their previous policy of isolation, embracing the perspective gained through interaction with organic life.

The Perseus Veil is stored within a private pocket dimension until you choose to “install” it. When you do so, it’s various assets can seamlessly integrate into the galaxy as if it was always there. It can also be returned to it’s pocket dimension storage if you find it necessary.
objects.title: The Perseus Veil (Mass Effect)
Child of an Archon
objects.text:
Your nature as an Elemental Lifeform is no accident of birth or circumstance. Choose one of the Seven Archons of Teyvat, past or present, to be your divine parent. You are their true child by blood and divinity, born as a divine elemental lifeform whose nature descends directly from one of Teyvat's great gods. Former Archons such as Greater Lord Rukkhadevata and Raiden Makoto may be chosen just as readily as their successors.

Your parent's Element becomes the foundation of your elemental existence. Your affinity, reserves, control, and potential with it vastly exceed those of an ordinary Elemental Lifeform, allowing you to instinctively manipulate enormous quantities of elemental energy and develop increasingly powerful applications of it. You possess exceptional resistance to your inherited Element and can partially or completely transform your body into elemental energy. Your divine nature also grants you agelessness, tremendous resilience, and the ability to recover from otherwise devastating injuries so long as your elemental essence survives.

Beyond their Element, you inherit a portion of your parent's unique divine nature and potential. A child of Barbatos may possess exceptional affinity for wind and freedom; a child of Morax could inherit his tremendous durability and authority over stone; a child of Beelzebul could display extraordinary mastery of lightning and combat; while a child of Buer or Greater Lord Rukkhadevata could develop profound connections to Dendro, dreams, wisdom, and life. The exact manifestation reflects your chosen parent and develops alongside you rather than simply granting you an identical copy of their abilities.

You are not born with the full might of your parent. Instead, their divine lineage grants you tremendous potential for growth. Through training, experience, age, worship, and the development of your elemental and divine nature, you can steadily approach their level. Given sufficient growth, your inherited divinity can fully mature, allowing you to ascend into a true elemental god in your own right and potentially equal or eventually surpass your parent.

This ascension does not require a Gnosis; your divinity is intrinsic to your existence rather than derived from an external artifact. Should you acquire Archon, however, your developing godhood immediately matures to an Archon-class level, greatly enhancing your elemental abilities and everything inherited from your parent. A Gnosis remains an optional divine amplifier and will naturally synergize with your inherited divinity should you possess one.
