Subsequently, humanity will face assimilation, consumption, and harvesting without warning. The entities will perceive you as a threat equivalent to or potentially surpassing their individual powers. Moreover, your perks will prove useless against them.

If you manage to succeed, you will become something equivalent to a human entity. You will gain access to all the knowledge and scientific understanding and all of the powers and abilities of humanity, and will revere you as its salvation; its light as its God Emperor or Empress. When humanity looks for a leader, a guiding light, they will look toward you first, but if you have no desire to rule, they will follow others. But if you wish to rule over humanity later, even the most power-hungry and arrogant leaders will willingly step down and assist you in any way they can.
objects.title: The Catalyst

rows.title: Worm Missions
rows.titleText: These are missions related to the Worm universe. They may sometimes be taken in other settings, such as Crossover or Alternate Earth, but it is up to you to decide how they fit into the narrative.

objects.text:
You must be recognised by the majority of the inhabitants, both highborn and lowborn, of Westeros as being the King/Queen of the Andals, the Rhoynar, and the First Men, Lord/Lady of the Seven Kingdoms, and Protector of the Realm (or the nearest equivalent). 

The entirety of the Seven Kingdoms and all its traditional constituent kingdoms must be primarily under your control; any kingdom or other similarly significant power in open revolt against you will prevent this mission from succeeding. You do not necessarily have to maintain the monarchy of Westeros or even be considered its rightful, legitimate ruler but you must be the sole leading authority within the realm.

If you succeed in this grand task, you will thereafter be recognised as the true, legitimate ruler of all the Seven Kingdoms. Over time, all of the citizens of the Seven Kingdoms will become fervently loyal to you and your causes, as though you had inspired them directly. Both the lords, ladies and smallfolk of Westeros will be completely united behind supporting you and you will be seen as being akin to the greatest rulers in Westeros' history. If you choose, you may also obtain the power of the House of the Dragon (A Song of Ice and Fire), including all of its boons and items. Furthermore, the realm will be blessed with bountiful harvests, peace and prosperity for as long as you rule.

If you do not manage to obtain this status before the end of the year 300 A.C., the constituent realms of the Seven Kingdoms will promptly fall apart into massive all-out conflict between each other, devasting the local lands and their people far beyond any civil strife ever seen before. Westeros will be nigh impossible to unify, with the realm also being hit with incredibly severe famines, numerous natural disasters and large plagues akin to that of the Great Spring Sickness.
objects.title: The Iron Throne (A Song of Ice and Fire)

objects.text:
You must either stop the sentinels from ever arising or render them unable to be produced. Whether this takes the form of ensuring the fundamental forces never see their creation, or a concerted seek-and-destroy does not matter. Given that humanity did not create the sentinel’s AI, but discovered it, this could be a more pressing task than expected. 

If you fail, and the sentinels become either official policy or produced in any serious number, the AI within will make rapid advancements. Within a year of development, it will be able to mass produce Nimrod-esque sentinels capable of rapid adaptation and dedicated to the destruction of not only mutant-kind but humanity. After all, ‘Mutants Are Human’.

If you succeed in rendering Sentinels unable to be widely produced, and maintain this state of affairs for at least ten years, A mutant with the ability to spontaneously create and direct Artificial Intelligences will activate somewhere within your country of origin. They are guaranteed to be aligned with you, at least at first, and with time could learn to produce mutant aligned intelligences on a mass scale.
objects.title: Falling Sentinels (Marvel)

objects.text:
Your mission is simple: you must collect all three Hallows and become the Master of Death.

For this mission to be successful, you must collect the Resurrection Stone, the Elder Wand, and the Invisibility Cloak within five years of entering the world. The wand must have given you its allegiance, and the stone must be separated from the ring.

If you succeed, you will become the Master of Death, which comes with several benefits: biological immortality, the ability to summon the spirits of deceased individuals with full loyalty to you and without causing them pain, and the ability to cast spells wandlessly with the same power as if you were using a wand.

If you fail, the Hallows will permanently radiate a special aura that will cause everyone near them to seek them with fervor. This aura does not discriminate; it affects wizards, Muggles, magical creatures, and others alike.

(Note: The Hallows from the Objects of Power do not count towards the completion of this mission.)
objects.title: Master of Death (Harry Potter)

objects.text:
Your mission is to bridge the centuries-old divide between the Wizarding World and the Muggle World, uniting them into a single, cohesive society. This will require an unprecedented level of diplomacy, strategic planning, and the careful orchestration of events to reveal the existence of magic to the Muggle population in a way that minimizes fear, chaos, and hostility. You must navigate the complex political landscape of both worlds, earning the trust of Muggle leaders while persuading key figures in the Wizarding community to support this radical change. Alongside these efforts, you will need to foster mutual understanding and respect between the two communities, creating educational programs, joint ventures, and cultural exchanges that allow both Muggles and wizards to learn about each other’s worlds. You will face resistance from extremists on both sides—Muggles who fear and resent the power of magic, and wizards who believe in the superiority of their kind and wish to keep their world separate and hidden. 

If you fail, the two worlds will still become aware of one another, in a more negative and chaotic fashion. Fear, misunderstanding, and violence will erupt on a global scale, leading to widespread conflict between Muggles and wizards. The Wizarding World will be forced back into hiding, more isolated and mistrustful than ever before, and the hope of unity could be lost for generations, plunging both worlds into an era of darkness and distrust. In addition to this, both societies will regress multiple generations in term of technology and progress, dooming many.

Should you succeed, you will create a world where magic is known, accepted, and integrated into everyday life, allowing both societies to work together to face future challenges, whether they be magical or mundane. This new world could lead to unprecedented advancements, as wizards and Muggles combine their strengths and knowledge to push the boundaries of what is possible. You will be heralded as a beginner of a new age, basically treated as something similar to a king of the world.
objects.title: Bridge of Two Worlds (Harry Potter)

objects.text:
You must unite the Sector into a single political entity. The previous governments can still exist in some form, but they must be under the jurisdiction of a central entity, like a federation or an empire, is up to you.

If any of the major factions collapse into decivilization, or if over 10% of the total population die due to violence before you complete the mission, the Sector as a whole will turn on you. They will manage to activate the gates, discover ancient technologies and weapons caches, and make their collective mission to hunt you down.

But if you succeed, the riches of the Dominion will be available to all. You will find a datapad with the knowledge of The Domain of Man (Starsector) from the technological and Artifice section, allowing you to replicate any technology from the Domain era, and make infinite duplicates of it. Additionally, a fleet of terraforming ships will be found, allowing to turn all worlds in the Sector into garden worlds under a generation.
objects.title: One Sector, One People (Starsector)

objects.text:
You have been sent back to the era of the Great Crusade with one simple objective: stop the Horus Heresy from happening.

Your victory condition is simple, as you only have to prevent Horus from falling to Chaos, as well as at least two other Traitor Primarchs (personally I would recommend Magnus & Fulgrim, & would recommend against pursuing obvious lost causes like Kurze or Angron).

If successful, humanity enters a golden age surpassing the greatest heights of the Dark Age of Technology. If Horus falls or you're not able to sway two other canon Traitor Primarchs, the resulting civil war is even worse than in canon, with three canon Loyalist Primarchs turning Traitor, leaving humanity too weak to fight off the predations of daemons & xenos.
objects.title: Magnus Did Nothing Wrong (Warhammer: 30k)

objects.text:
Warhammer 40k and 30k generally lacks one thing, one element which is so rare as to not be believed, and yet so integral to the success of the human race. Any decent fucking parents.

Your mission should you choose to accept it, is to remedy this, at least a little. By inserting yourself into the 30k timeline in a world where a primarch finds themselves after being involuntarily put up for adoption by the 4 immaterial child abductors and their mother going through a moral trial and emotional episode.

If you take this mission, you are guaranteed to appear just a bit before the primarch does, adjusting for the start date you picked, assume canon start here would be the moment your chosen primarch appears on the planet. You are also guaranteed to find this primarch before anyone else does and before they get out of their pod.
Your job from here is simple in theory, yet difficult in execution. Be a good parent.

Now this might sound simple, but anyone who has ever had kids will tell you that it is most assuredly not. And this is made far more difficult by the fact that primarchs by their nature are superhuman to a grand degree. It is extremely difficult to instill respect, and morals, and life lessons, to a being which dwarfs your level of intelligence by magnitudes. They will grow up fast, and be extremely talented and intelligent. They will also be somewhat warlike, and be prone to wanting to rule or help humans around them, by their very nature as they were crafted to be generals, and governors, in a massive galaxy spanning crusade.

You need to make your chosen primarch a stable, decent, and well rounded person. Without any glaring developmental issues or psychological complexes.

This is going to be a long term and difficult assignment. But the rewards are great.
Should you succeed, your chosen primarch will be certain to influence the imperium and the galaxy for the better, to make life better for the people under their eventual rule, and to help both their brothers and the emperor along on a better path. Maybe even averting the heresy all together and making the imperium change paths into truly bringing mankind into a golden age if you did incredibly well raising them. They will also be incredibly resistant to the influences of chaos, downright immune if raised very well.

However, should you have failed in raising a stable and mentally healthy child, then you will find that the primarch is especially vulnerable to chaotic influence, assuredly falling to the dark gods given time and relative isolation. Furthermore they will also be a mediocre to bad ruler, and make things worse for nearly all the worlds they take control over.
objects.title: The One Thing Which Could Truly Turn Things Around for the Better (Warhammer: 30k)

objects.text:
The galaxy is full of petty empires squabbling over resources and territory. Now, you must play the game yourself, and survive where most do not.

The nature of your empire is entirely up to you, so long as you control at least more than one star system. You might be the Warboss of an Ork Empire, a Chaos Lord carving out a domain in the Eye of Terror, a Rogue Trader managing their holdings, a renegade T'au ruling over your own version of the Farsight Enclaves, an Aeldari Corsair establishing a home base, or a Necron Phaeron presiding over the inferior races of the galaxy. You must, however, be independent of any other direct authority figure. You can nominally be a part of an overarching faction, such as following one of the four Chaos Gods or serving the Imperium at large, but your territories must be loyal to you first and foremost to be valid. 

If your territories can persist and remain independent for at least a century, you will succeed, securing the loyalty of your subjects forevermore. Your holdings will also be surrounded by permanent and violent warp storms that spill into realspace, threatening everything that draws near. Despite this, it will never affect you or your forces, or hinder your attempts at Warp travel. The price for failure will simply be the consequences of your inability to protect your territories, as your people may fall into bloody infighting or wither away as so many did during the Age of Strife, if they haven't already been conquered by one of your countless enemies. Whoever survives will unanimously blame you for not doing enough, even if it is an unfair accusation, and most likely attempt to assassinate you if they can.
objects.title: Galactic Warlord (Warhammer 40k)

objects.text: Being born under a glimmer of love between her coward of a father and her mother amongst the morbidly dreary existence she lives, Eto Yoshimura has come to despise the world and saw no hope for it aside from the solace of its destruction. An avid reader and auteur, she fashions the idol of the One-Eye King: a title encapsulating her hopes and dreams of a society where ghouls prosper and enjoy a life devoid of persecution, beyond looking behind their backs to a world calling their heads. This belongs to a One-Eyed Ghoul like her or a Half-Human strong enough to lead a revolution deposing V (and the Washuu Clan’s establishment) and becoming a symbol of hope for ghouls, freeing the ghouls from humanity’s long-standing oppression, then uniting both species; seeing both sides of the coin, belonging to both yet neither, they are the bridge to which both sides see and understand each other, reflecting beyond the role of hunter and hunted, predator and prey, being one and all, at last. Being born in a sunlit garden sterile and bereft of the gentleness and soul of a garden, Kishou Arima has come to despise his life (and himself) for what they created him for, a killer, an exterminator, the Greatest Ghoul Investigator in History, a man so sadistic and massive nobody sees him eye-to-eye, anyone tearing their eyes away for his far-away gaze, so far beyond his peers he’s closer to an ideal than a man. All lies. His days are numbered, his end ever closer once he reaches his 40s, left-eye glaucoma on the wayside, and every day a piece of his soul dies with him. That is until he “meets” Eto Yoshimura. It was a custom of his, during his incursion into the 24th Ward, found a hideout with a peculiar ghoul. Quite of a fight, he managed. This was different, this ghoul was different, too unlike other ghouls he’d been called to ‘clean up’, to that end, he couldn’t help asking for a reason. The answer? It pleased him, enough to take the Mantle of the One-Eyed King, joining her in a shared malcontent of the world they live in, and wish to change it. The King in the Belly of the Beast, a double agent, still playing the role assigned to him by V and now willingly taking a role upon himself, at the same time. Seeing Arima’s aging at a rapid pace for his half-human nature, and the growing chance a ghoul will gain over him in due time, this very Ghoul will be exalted as the ghouls’ true hope, one they needed to “raise” and “teach”, a One-Eyed Ghoul to be rightful Heir to the “throne”. The most likely Heir? Ken Kaneki. Chirin Incarnate. Tragedy Manifest. Your mission is to train and prepare Ken Kaneki for his impending role. Probably barring the unneeded yet unavoidable trauma and agony, just a bit at least. Of course, you can’t shield him from the inevitable save to help him build enough resilience and EQ to curb his worst traits and habits. There are many routes and paths you can undergo and proceed depending on the time of arrival: Collaborating with Arima and Yoshimura to streamline and diversify their intended Plan and bolster their forces; directly aiding Kaneki and serving as a guide or parental figure to mentor the Future King accelerating his development; simply ensuring events pivotal to Kaneki’s development as a person, ghoul, and human altogether come to pass deterring or control at least some of the suffering’s brunt borne from them; or a mix of them all. It rests solely on you to find the right set of circumstances and endeavors to procure the best outcome. Accomplishing this up to his “Crowning” and Arima’s sacrifice or death, Kaneki (and the Goat Organization) will be indebted to you, swearing personal loyalty to you and your goals, with Kaneki gaining all Ghoul Specialties and the potential to develop into a Transcendent Specimen, and Goat members winning a chance to grow into Apex Specimen, their strides for revolution and upheaval more impactful, resonant to the populace (both ghoul and human alike), without the need for Kaneki to fall out into Furuta’s plans of chaos and iconoclastic use of the CCG up to avoiding the Dragon Incident. Any event or happenstance straying or stifling his potential growth and development to be at Arima’s level, resolute on the path set out before him, without a good enough base to support him, and leaving them to come to pass, results in failing this mission and the death of Kaneki Ken, will Arima and Yoshimura feeling betrayed by your meddling, all Kaneki’s loved ones holding a grudge the size of Hiroshima against you, and the Washuu, CCG, and V recognizing your role at your disruptive attempt to foster a revolution, all the line-up have a want for your head, stopping at nothing to see it true.
objects.title: The Goat’s Crowning (Tokyo Ghoul)

objects.text: You must guide Anakin in mastering the dark side of the Force while preserving his training in the light. Your goal is to teach him balance—show him the Force in all its splendor, uniting both sides within him. If Anakin succumbs entirely to either the light or dark side—whether by fully embracing the Jedi path or aligning with Darth Sidious—you will have failed. In that event, Anakin will gain intimate knowledge of your abilities and strategies, and he will use this information to relentlessly hunt you down, leveraging his newfound allegiance. However, if Anakin achieves perfect balance within the Force, you will be rewarded. If you do not already possess the Force, it will awaken within you. Anakin will become loyal to you and gain access to all Force abilities, even rarer ones such as Shatterpoint. Moreover, he will establish his own sect of Force users who will also be loyal to you.
objects.title: Balance in the Force (Star Wars)

objects.text:
You must create a nation free from the influence of any Archon, a nation built and governed entirely by mortals. In doing so, you must ensure that this new nation does not suffer the same catastrophic fate that befell Khaenri'ah. The survival of your nation, free from divine intervention, is the ultimate goal.

Failure to achieve this will result in you and everyone who joins your cause being cursed, much like the Hilichurls and other survivors from Khaenri'ah. The curse will transform all who sought refuge in your nation into twisted forms, doomed to wander in suffering, just as those from Khaenri'ah once did. The very ambition to live free from the Archons will become the reason for your downfall.

If you succeed, however, you will be rewarded with a unique piece of anti-elemental technology, capable of nullifying all elemental reactions. Additionally, everyone who joined your nation, and you as well if you don’t already possess it, will gain the Olympic perk. Finally, you will gain the power to control the elements without needing a Vision, giving you unparalleled strength and freedom from the influence of the Archons.
objects.title: A New Khaenri'ah (Genshin Impact)

objects.text:
You must help raise the Human Systems Alliance to the level of achieving their desired seat on the Citadel Council, with you as the Councilor, and keep the position until the Reaper War is over.

If you succeed, instead of the usual possible endings you gain a new more positive one, a galaxy united via diplomacy and the common good, all Races surviving, and contributing to the rebuild of the galaxy, and a new, greater Council. With this, you are personally rewarded with a Normandy SR-2 Class Cruiser the SSV-Sword, seized from Cerberus during the war, upgraded and crewed by members of every Race or their representatives.

If you should fail, you gain possibly the bleakest possible ending. Though the Reaper’s are no more, multiple races are  extinct, among them the Quarian, the Geth, the Rachni, & the Krogan. Earth is rendered uninhabitable, and the Council races descend into infighting and petty squabbles. Should you fail, the SSV-Sword's mission will be to hunt you down, (or at least be as big a hinderance as they can) and it's crew of Cerberus fanatics will upgrade it with Reaper technology to do so.
objects.title: Councilor for Humanity (Mass Effect)

objects.text:
By selecting this mission, you will start in the setting of Gundam 00, a month before Celestial Being reveals itself to the world and their mission.

Your mission is to achieve world peace. This can't be done through violence or mental control. You must somehow convince the three major political powers, the Innovaders, and Celestial Being that there has to be some way for everyone to live together without relying in violence. You have five years to do so.

If you don't manage to do it, humanity will fall. The A-Laws or some version of them will form, even more brutal than before. Celestial Being, if still existing, will be corrupted and commit terrorist acts against the innocent. The people will lose empathy, slowly dividing society further until they are back to the stone age. By the time the ELS arrive, they will come in much larger numbers, humanity not standing a chance.

But if you achieve this, you will become an Innovator: a being able to control quantum waves, which can be used to communicate with other beings akin to telepathy, share intentions and memories, possess enhanced mental capacity, reflexes and life span, and even sense danger. With time, every other human will turn into Innovators as well, and will usher humanity to a golden age that will last for millenia, if not more. When the ESL arrives, rather than conflict, humanity will be able to communicate with then from the start, ensuring cooperation between the two species without bloodshed. Humanity will become a galactic power, and they will forever remember you as the person responsible for this.
objects.title: Anno Domini (Gundam)

objects.text:
You must achieve global peace across all the Elemental Nations and be recognized as the undisputed ruler of the entire world. This monumental task requires uniting the warring factions, earning the respect and loyalty of every village, and establishing a lasting harmony that transcends the deep-seated rivalries and conflicts that have plagued the lands for centuries.

Failure to accomplish this will have dire consequences. You will be branded as the most wanted criminal in history, hunted relentlessly by Hunter-Nin, Bounty Hunters, and elite shinobi from every corner of the world. No organization, village, or individual will dare to associate with you, leaving you isolated and constantly on the run, with no place to hide or seek refuge. Your name will become synonymous with betrayal and chaos, marking you as a pariah to all.

However, if you succeed in this nearly impossible mission, the rewards will be unparalleled. If you do not already possess chakra, you will be granted it, with reserves that rival or even surpass the legendary power of the Ten-Tails. This immense chakra will give you the strength and endurance to face any threat and maintain your position of power. Additionally, you will unlock the knowledge of how to wield Kekkei Genkai—the unique, powerful bloodline abilities—without needing to be born into the corresponding lineage. This means you could potentially master techniques like the Lava Release, Dust Release, or Wood Release, regardless of your ancestry, making you a truly unstoppable force.
objects.title: United Them All, Believe It!!! (Naruto)

objects.text:
Academy City, a shining beacon of progress and technological development, as well as a pioneer in the development of Esper powers. For all its glamorous façade, underneath lies a hidden, much uglier truth. ‘Dark Side’ is mainly used as an umbrella term to describe anything illegal going on inside Academy City, from some genuinely positive things that ensure the safety of the city against outside threats, something more neutral like smuggling and black market trade, to horrific experiments on children in an attempt to push the development of abilities no matter the cost and use of espers like assassins and child soldiers.

Your mission is to, during the next 10 years, purge this Dark Side from the City so it may become what it advertises itself to be. A heaven for scientists and espers alike, where every man, woman, and child is free to pursue their dreams without trampling over the dreams and desires of others, where espers are not subjected to torturous projects all in the pursuit of the 'System' or just to satisfy some scientist's sadistic curiosity.

Do note that while the most depraved parts of the Dark Side undoubtedly must be dealt with, some parts of it are so deeply engraved into the structure of Academy City that simply eliminating the culprits without any contingencies will bring severe consequences for the City itself. In your quest to bring a brighter future for this temple of science, you must ensure that it is not weakened in the face of external threats and is able to maintain its autonomy, as well as the position of leading authority on the subject of the development of supernatural powers. You do not need to vanquish the Dark Side completely, merely deal with the worst offenders, such as human trafficking and experimentation, etc.

If you manage to do so, then it is only fair that your efforts are recognised by the City, with the seat, or even several, on the Academy City's Board of Directors all but guaranteed, which will grant you much more legitimate power, with the only one above you being the Board Chairman himself, although he rarely is directly involved in the actual governing of the City. Moreover, throughout the Academy City, an invisible and undetectable aura will now spread, facilitating much more rapid technological innovation and the progression of the development of esper abilities. So much so that it is quite reasonable to expect the emergence of full-on interstellar travel within the decade even without your interference, as well as espers finding it much easier to reach higher levels of ability, although reaching level 4 or 5 will still take a great deal of effort.

If you fail to do so, the Academy City will fall even further into lawlessness, with various research institutes and corporations turning it into a true hellish dystopia, with the outside world mostly powerless to put a stop to it due to the advanced technologies and braiwashed espers the corrupt board of directors have control over.
objects.title: Operation Handcuffs (Raildex)

objects.text: The Level 6 Shift Project was developed to help Accelerator, Academy City's strongest Level 5 esper, reach the fabled Level 6. For this purpose, 20'000 clones of third-ranked Level 5, Misaka Mikoto, were created, to then be killed by Accelerator, with each terminated clone pushing him ever so slightly towards the prophesized breakthrough. Your mission is to stop this inhumane experiment. To do this, you will need both to defeat Accelerator himself or otherwise convince him to stop his participation, as well as prevent the scientists behind the project from ever continuing it or launching a similar one by whatever means necessary. But this is not the end of your troubles. As Misaka clones created with little purpose beyond engaging and, subsequently, being killed by Accelerator, the information that has been downloaded into their brains upon creation is mostly combat-related; as such, it falls upon you to socialise them not to mention help them learn how to properly recognise and express their emotions. This task is somewhat helped by the mental network all clones are a part of, with them being able to share thoughts, feelings, experiences, and memories between them. The second issue is that their bodies were not designed to last anywhere near a normal human lifespan. If you do not have the capabilities to rectify this flaw yourself, maybe a certain frog-faced doctor can help you. Lastly, you will also need to find and protect Last Order, a 20,001st clone, who serves as a control mechanism for the clones' mental network, as she may become a central figure in various plans of Board Chairman Crowley, as well as some scientists likely to be disgruntled by the abrupt ending of the project. If you manage this task and help the clones live a semi-normal life, not only will you have the almost unbreakable loyalty and love of 20,001 decently strong electromaster-type espers, who now will be able to further develop their abilities in time, the Will of Misaka Network, a thought entity created from the gathering and consciousness and egos of 20'001 Sisters, itself will now strive to help you in almost all of your endeavors. If you wish so, she may forge an unbreakable connection with you, which will persist even if you travel between universes. Through this connection, you will gain a sort of Guest Account in the network, allowing you to communicate and share thoughts and memories with the Misakas just like they can. Additionally, now you and all Misakas can share mental calculation capability, which can boost any mental powers immensely, as well as allow the usage of each other's esper powers. For example, if every single Misaka shared with you their esper capabilities, this would be enough to catapult you to the level of electromaster ability greater than that of Misaka Mikoto, the original and current strongest electromaster, as the combined processing power of all 20'001 Misaka clones is just a little less than that of Accelerator himself. Note that in this timeline, the one who would've originally defeated Accelerator and stopped the experiment will be either unwilling or incapable of stopping the project; as such, it will only come to an end when the board chairman himself deems it necessary. By then, it is highly unlikely that more than a quarter of clones will be left alive. It is also quite possible that he will allow the experiment to be completed; in that case, you will have to deal with a godlike vector controller, who will undoubtedly be quite mad from the experience. While the mission will not be considered failed until half of the clones are terminated, their emotional stability, as well as possible reward in the form of their computational capability, will exponentially decline, incentivising you to save as many as you can. That is if your conscience did not motivate you enough already.
objects.title: Level 6 Shift Project (Raildex)

objects.text:
The Bridge-Builders Cabal is a gathering of Transcendants, exceptionally powerful magicians, each of which is capable of rivalling the entire magic side of the world—apart from Magic Gods—on their own. While they all gathered with the purpose of making the world a better place, their different views on how that can be achieved, as well as side effects enforced by their magic, make coming to a unilateral decision nearly impossible. And the strength they wield means they require a consensus so as not to undermine the efforts of each other or even destroy the world in its entirety if any infighting broke out.

Due to this impasse, they decided to come to you for aid in resolving their various differences and incompatibilities in views. Your mission would be considered fulfilled if you manage to convince them on a compromise that would account for every Transcendant's particular brand of saving the world. Should you fail to do so, they still have a backup plan: to resurrect the legendary magician and holy man, Christian Rosencreutz, with the intent of him providing the guidance they seek.

What they would manage to resurrect, however, would be the furthest from the legendary healer and wise man. Johann Valentin Andreae, the man who created the myth about Rosencreutz, while indeed one of the most powerful magicians to ever live, capable of defeating almost the entire Cabal with a single attack, is a malicious and sadistic persona, hell-bent on tarnishing the legacy of Christian Rosencreutz, jealous of his creation leaving his control and eclipsing him. And he will be gunning for you first thing, as the one someone dared to assume would be compared to Rosencreutz in wisdom and ability to save the world. Defeating him will not be easy, as not only is he an extremely powerful magician, but he even set up a 'false hell', a special phase that will intercept his soul on its way to true hell and allow him to resurrect should you defeat him. You will need to either find a way to subvert this ability or follow him into this false hell and escape it before he manages to do so, as it allows only one soul to leave at a time, with the rest being finally cast into true hell.

Should you succeed in any way, not only will you gain the loyalty of the Transcendants, who will resolve to adhere to your vision for the future of the world and the entirety of the magical ability, knowledge, and equipment that Andreae possessed, but you also will attain a profound ability to better the world around you. Whenever you go, you find ways in which you can influence people or events to reduce suffering, foster goodwill and understanding between people, and even your mere presence will inspire most people to try and be better versions of themselves. Your legend will also spread; depending on your actions, it may be the legend of the Healer and a Wise Man or a King among Kings who can lift a nation from the depths of poverty to the heights of prosperity. This is so potent that even inherently grimdark worlds, where suffering seems to be ingrained within the very rules of the universe, may be transformed into near-utopias, although it will require your active participation.

Should you fail, not only are you very likely to die at the hands of the false Rosencreutz, but any surviving Transcendants as well will decide that the time for diplomacy has passed and will try to resolve conflicts between themselves in an all-out fight, possibly resulting in the end of the world.
objects.title: Hell Tour (Raildex)

objects.text: The world as you know it is not pure. It is tainted by the influences of various religions, belief systems, mythologies, or even folklore and fairy tales, obscuring the pure world of physical laws that lies underneath all of it. All this taint forms what is known as phases, which serve as sort of 'filters' through which the world, like a picture, is altered. From these phases, various otherworldly energies and alien laws originate, allowing the use of magic. Between the phases there exists a distance, which regularly changes, causing sparks to appear as a result of these collisions. These sparks have limited but widespread influence on the world, subtly altering such things as fate, fortune, misfortune, etc. The results of the sparks are varied, from something trivial and overlooked, like stubbing your toe, which people easily blame on bad luck, to predestined deaths and natural disasters. The propagation of the sparks is amplified by the use of magic, especially in the case of magic based on unifying theories, which include gathering multiple phases together, leading to increased collision and production of much more sparks. From the moment you appear in the world, the influence of the sparks will slowly, but surely, begin to increase. The increase will be negligible in the first couple of decades, but after centuries, the world will undoubtedly become more hostile, with a noticeably increased rate of inexplicable diseases, natural catastrophes, etc. If nothing is done, then in the end the calamities will enter the realm of supernatural effects by themselves, with water droplets being akin to bullets and fallen leaves akin to the sharpest blades. Your mission is to negate the effect the sparks have on the world, to return complete control over their destiny in the hands of humans. There are various ways to do it, like introducing special mythologies to act as 'cushioning', to prevent phases from colliding, creating and spreading over the world an existence similar to an imaginary number district, restricting the use of magic, or a more extreme solution, like eliminating all the phases entirely, leaving behind only the pure world of physics, unaffected by human beliefs, and therefore a completely magicless world. Or, maybe, you will devise your own plan. Should you accomplish this monumental task, the reward will be equally grandiose. If you were able to change the world on such a fundamental level, it only makes sense for the hidden truths to reveal themselves to you. From now on, whether in this world or any other, you will be able to instinctively grasp at its metaphysical structure, gaining an intuitive understanding of the laws governing both the natural and supernatural sides of the world. It will manifest as an intuitive understanding of both various scientific fields as well as supernatural practices, be it psionics, magic, or something else. This understanding is so potent that, should you have zero prior experience with the world's magic system, a week worth of study will allow you to rise to the level of understanding others would have to painstakingly crawl towards for ages. A month, and you will be able to create complete new systems within the frameworks of the world that others haven't even theorised about. You also get a sense of when the world is 'wrong' in some way, similar to the production of sparks, as well as a basic understanding of how this 'wrongness' may be fixed. You will still need to work towards that goal, but compared to everybody else, you will be able to do this in very little time, should you actually put in some effort.
objects.title: Phase Shift (Raildex)

objects.text:
Most Espers in Academy City go through the Power Curriculum Program with hopes of one day becoming a Level 5, or even higher. They believe that hard work and perseverance will, eventually, let them rise through the ranks and become one of the strongest. But this is far from the actual truth that is carefully concealed by the board of directors: only a small portion of Espers can ever hope to achieve achieve even Level 4, much less advance beyond it. The capability to reach a higher level is decided at birth by a number of factors—one of those being genetics—and those who do not possess innate talent will find it either extremely hard or downright impossible to rise to the top.

This is where your mission comes in. You must fix this unfair system and come up with a way that would allow even the most hopeless Level 0 to rise through the ranks and become at least a Level 4 Esper, without requiring an extensive investment of resources by the City. How you do this is completely up to you, whether by inventing a more efficient Power Curriculum or using one of your abilities.

One such experiment, called Level Upper—which may not have been attempted yet, depending on when you arrive in this world—consisting of linking Espers into a brainwave network. This allowed for a temporary increase in the calculational capabilities of connected individuals, as well as unconscious sharing of experience between users of similar powers, leading to a drastic increase in power. However, this came with severe and potentially lethal side effects. You may try to perfect this experiment or go down a completely different path; the choice is is yours. Nonetheless, the end result must be a method that can be safely distributed throughout all of Academy City.

Should you fail to do so before the truth leaks out and leaves all the lower-level Espers disillusioned, then Academy City will suffer a rapid decline in the number of new students. It may eventually wither away and cease to exist, with many Espers being claimed by their countries of origin, where they may very well be subjected to various experiments in an attempt to recreate the Power Curriculum Program. Although this downfall will take at least a couple of decades, the exact timeline depends on Academy City's own advancements and the actions of the Board of Directors.

Should you succeed, however, every Esper will eventually gain the potential to reach high levels of power. You yourself will also gain a profound ability to create new and manipulate existing power systems. This will manifest as an instinctual understanding of how to manipulate the physics and metaphysics of any world to enable the emergence of supernatural abilities in one form or another. Although it may be incredibly difficult to achieve, with time and resources, nothing will be beyond your reach.

Lastly, you will gain a perfected ability reminiscent of the aforementioned Level Upper. You will be able to connect others into a joint brainwave network, with yourself as the sole administrator. You may choose to share or revoke this authority at will. The extent to which this network affects those connected to it will depend entirely on you. You could allow everyone to freely share thoughts and powers through it, or limit it to unconscious sharing of experience and calculational capability, as it was with the original. You may also create segregated groups within the network, each with different permissions. In any case, you will have access to all the powers connected to the network and may share your own (if you possess any) with anyone you choose.
objects.title: Level Upper (Raildex)

objects.text: When God died during the war between the factions of Heaven and Hell, the System that he put into place has gradually been falling apart. System is a complex metaphysical structure put into the world of DxD that governs both the distribution of Sacred Gears, as well as various blessings. The current leader of Heaven, archangel Michael, can barely keep it functional, which led to the development of various 'bugs', such as Balance Breakers, as well as the possibility of reincarnated and half-blood devils possessing a Sacred Gear of their own, something that was originally created as tools for humanity to defend against various supernatural races. Your mission is to gain access to and, eventually, repair the systems, as well as place proper restrictions and repair various bugs. Chief among them is making sure that only true humans can wield Sacred Gears, as originally intended. This will allow both humanity and the forces of Heaven to more effectively maintain the balance between the factions, as well as allow humanity to become something more than a source of servants for the devils. If you manage to complete this great task, the reward will be equally as great. With the throne of Heaven being vacant for so long and given the monumental task you've performed, there is little doubt as to who shall occupy it. And the army of angels will become your loyal followers and allies in the protection of humanity, as it should have been from the start. If you fail, then in the next 20 years the System will break completely, stopping the cycle of sacred gear distributions as well as nullifying any benefits from the prayers. While this will make the majority of humanity less desireable to demons due to them no longer possessing the sacred gears, it will also make them that much more defenseless.
objects.title: Ascension to the Throne of Heaven (High School DxD)

objects.text:
Trihexa, the Emperor Beast of Apocalypse, is a gigantic black-furred chimaera with seven heads, seven tails, and ten horns, appearing as a mix of a lion, tiger, bear, dragon, and various other animals. It is a being on par with Dragon Gods Ophis and Great Red, with strength enough to shatter dimensional barriers and destroy worlds, and a healing factor so potent that it can regenerate from ashes in mere moments.

Long ago, the God of the Bible risked his life to seal it away using thousands of forbidden seals, which are now slowly becoming undone. In the next few years, the seals will erode completely, and Trihexa will break free. While normally mindless, possessing only instinctual desire to destroy everything around it, your otherworldly nature piqued its interest, and it will be gunning for you first as its main prey, and should you fall, it will feast on your remains, becoming powerful enough to obliterate the rest of the world and potentially even travel to other universes to endlessly continue its path of destruction.

Your mission, should you accept it, will be to defeat this beast, which is no easy feat, as even the top strongest beings in the universe were forced to seal themselves inside the dimensional barrier for thousands of years to continuously battle this threat, all in an effort to contain it. You must accomplish this all on your own, as otherwise Trihexa won't recognise you as its master. For this purpose, you have gained access to the secret seal, the apparent last failsafe of the God of the Bible from this universe. This seal will isolate both you and Trihexa in a time-dilation barrier, where you can battle for all eternity until one of you perishes or submits, with not even a second passing for the rest of the world.

Should you accomplish this monumental task, the beast will be resurrected as your loyal pet and familiar, its life now bound to you, with both of you now regenerating from any and all injuries as long as the other remains alive. You will be able to use its senses, give it orders telepathically, or summon it to you regardless of distance. Its immortal nature also serves as an almost endless pool of magical energy which you can tap into to fuel and further enhance your spells and powers. Should you wish so, Trihexa will gain access to seven humanoid forms of your liking, one for each head, with personalities tailored to your liking but always unwaveringly loyal to you. It will be able to shift into any of them or separate itself into seven bodies connected in a hive mind-like fashion, as well as change its size at will, in case you find a several hundred meters tall beast accompanying you a little impractical.
objects.title: Pet of Revelation (High School DxD)

objects.text:
From a young age, Rias Gremory was arranged to be wed to Riser Phenex, a fate she struggled most of her life to avoid. It seems all her attempts will be in vain, and now it falls on you to help her escape this arrangement. Whether you have a prior history together, recently met, or are about to cross paths, you become the Gremory heiress's last hope for a happy future.

Your mission is to prevent the arranged marriage Rias is forced into. How you achieve this is entirely up to you. You could convince or force Rias's and Riser's parents to annul the engagement, join Rias's peerage to win the Rating Game, pressure Riser into a duel for Rias's hand, or devise another solution altogether.

If you fail, the marriage will go through with anyone being powerless to stop it, whether due to potential political fallout or due to simply not being strong enough. As you were Rias's last hope of getting out of this predicament, you will earn both her eternal contempt and the ire of her brother, one of the strongest beings in the world.

If you succeed, however, well, there is only one possible reward for saving a princess: you will become the prime candidate for Rias's hand in marriage and earn her eternal love, as well as the loyalty of her peerage, second only to their loyalty to Rias herself.
objects.title: Wedding Crash (High School DxD)

objects.text:
Your mission is to remove any knowledge of the true nature of Players in the New World, specifically their origins as beings from other worlds. This includes entities like Ainz Ooal Gown, the Six Great Gods, and the Eight Greed Kings. Your task is not to kill or erase them entirely but to ensure that no one in the New World knows or understands their true nature as Players. This could involve altering memories, rewriting histories, or concealing evidence that reveals their origins.

If you fail to obscure this knowledge, a new wave of Players will arrive in the New World, each armed with their otherworldly power and understanding. These new Players will instinctively dislike and oppose you, viewing you as a threat to their ambitions. Their presence could disrupt the balance of power and place you in constant conflict as they seek to undermine you.

If you succeed in obscuring the true nature of the Players in the New World, those Players whose origins you have concealed will become your allies, sharing their resources and knowledge with you. Their NPCs will maintain their loyalty to their original masters but will also recognize you as a trusted ally, extending their services to you as well. This alliance grants you access to the Players' riches, bases, and any other resources they control, creating a powerful network of support. In cases where a Player has already died, your reward shifts. You will gain detailed knowledge of the locations of all their hidden gear, wealth, and bases. The now-masterless NPCs, once loyal to the deceased Player, will transfer their allegiance to you alone, providing you with both their skills and the full benefit of their previous master's holdings.
objects.title: Alien Conspiracy (Overlord)

objects.text:
You awaken as an NPC within the Great Tomb of Nazarick. Your existence has been carefully crafted by one of the 41 Supreme Beings, complete with a backstory, personality, and abilities suited to your role. Depending on your strength, you may find yourself as a low-ranking servant, a mid-tier Area Guardian, a Floor Guardian overseeing an entire level, or even a hidden trump card like Rubedo, kept in reserve for Nazarick’s greatest challenges.

Your mission has two primary objectives. First, you must fully embody the NPC role assigned to you, adhering strictly to the lore and personality written for your character. You are forbidden from revealing your true nature or any knowledge that your NPC would not plausibly possess.

Your second objective is to earn the favor and trust of the Supreme Being currently in command of Nazarick, Momonga. This may involve direct assistance in battles, offering unique insights or strategies that align with Nazarick’s and more importantly, Momonga’s goals, flawlessly managing your assigned responsibilities, or even subtly influencing events to protect or enhance Nazarick’s standing in the New World.

Failure to complete these objectives will lead to consequences. If you are exposed as not being the true NPC you appear to be, Nazarick will turn its full might against you. You will be hunted down, and if captured, you will face one of two fates: execution or eternal torment in one of Nazarick’s infamous torture chambers. Similarly, failing to gain the approval of the Supreme Being will result in your marginalisation, with you being treated as expendables. 

Should you succeed in your mission, you will reap tremendous rewards. First, you will retain the full power level of your NPC design, including access to Yggdrasil-tier abilities, magic, and skills. Your equipment, which is tailored to your role, will remain yours to wield. Gaining the favor of the Supreme Being will elevate your standing within Nazarick, granting you access to restricted areas, greater influence over its strategy, and potentially command over other NPCs or resources. Additionally, you will be rewarded with a unique World Item specifically suited to your abilities and role. This item will further enhance your power and solidify your position as an invaluable asset to Nazarick.
objects.title: The Hidden Pawn (Overlord)

objects.text:
“My fortune is yours for the taking, but you have to find it first!

I left everything I own in One Piece". 

The Golden Age of Pirates, an age of romance and adventure kicked off by the words of a dying man.

His words would inspire an entire generation of anarchy and chaos, of freedom and adventure in equal measure. 

Thousands flocked to the sea in search of his famous treasure, you among them.

Your goal is simple, either you or someone you help are to become the Pirate King, by any means necessary. 

Your goal is accomplished by either you or your crew finding the One Piece before anyone else. 

This means you cannot simply hang back and have someone else find it and then steal off them.

The rewards for this is simple, you gain a Devil Fruit power of your choice, Kurohige, Beloved by the Sea if you don’t already have it, absolute authority over the Grand Line, as well as being forever known and respected as the King of Pirates

If you fail however, either by failing to find the One Piece within 10 years or if someone finds it first, you’ll be captured by the Marines and sent to Impel Down, which seems to be inexplicably impossible for you to break out of, regardless of what abilities you have, your only hope of getting out is if someone breaks you out from the outside.
objects.title: Pirate King (One Piece)

objects.text: Humanity is in danger! You will have 20 years after the events of the 5th Holy Grail War before ORT awakens, a threat that humanity is not ready to face, a being that constantly adapts, evolves, and devours all that comes its way, a being believed to even dwarf all other TYPES. And unfortunately, it seems you now have the displeasure to defeat or kill this being. ORT's awakening is guaranteed to happen in the amount of time given, so there is no escaping this battle against the Ultimate One of the Oort Cloud. This will be a fight that will decide the fate of the Earth and Humanity, so you better be ready to give it your all. Failure upon your mission will mean not only the destruction of the Earth and all of humanity in this reality. But in every reality, for ORT has found a way to infect every timeline that humanity exists in through means incomprehensible to you. If you were to succeed with the task set before you, then REJOICE! For you are now the newly crowned Ultimate One of the Oort Cloud, subsuming/inheriting all the power of your former foe and predecessor!
objects.title: WARNING! AWAKENING IN PROCESS...! (Type-Moon)

objects.text:
Have you ever heard of a Living Dex? It is when you have one of each pokemon, including all their evolutions and forms. So you wouldn't have just a Gastrodon, you would need an East and West form each, the 32 forms of Alcremie, and four Deoxys in total for each form, PLUS their shinies.

Sounds tough? Unnecessarily complex? Good. Welcome to the Pokemon World.

Your mission is to complete the living dex. One of each pokemon that exist in this world, plus their alternate forms AND shiny. Obviously we wouldn't expect EVERY one of the 4 billions and some form of Spinda, but all the others, including legendaries, must be captured. Good news is, Pokemons that were once regarded as unique are actually just really, really, REALLY rare, so it is possible to complete your task. There is also a guarantee there is at least one shiny of each form out there, but there is also nothing stopping other trainers to catch them first.

You have one year per 100 forms to complete the challenge, so 30 years with the currently released games, with more or less time depending on any AU changes.

Should you fail, you will be cursed by Arceus for a hundred years. He wont torture you or anything, but he will make you be his servant, helping him with his tasks and whatever errand he need done. You will have very little free time, much less a personal life. You won't age while working for him, but you won't grow in strength either.

If you succeed, Arceus instead will grant you a blessing. Having one of their every creature, including themself, Arceus will grant you a single, all-mighty wish. This wish has the potential to affect a single universe in strength, but it can grant you practically anything you wish. A new Universe where you are god isn't beyond its scope.
objects.title: Gotta Catch em All! (Pokemon)

objects.text: It seems you have been chosen to follow in the path of the one known as Ash Ketchum. You are challenged with the task of completing ALL Pokémon leagues. From Kanto to Paldea, You have to defeat all 74 gyms (Gym leaders in other "realities" also count, but will simply swap temporarily with the other without consequences), 32 Elite Four Members, and 12 Champions through ALL regions. However, there are requirements for the mission. One: You cannot fight with any Pokémon given otherworldly buffs. So for example, you cannot fight Brock with a Hamon Charmander, or Clement with a Gomu Gomu no Mi Froakie. Two: You must use a new team for each region with the exception of Champions, and always having your very first Pokémon. And Three: You cannot use Legendaries or Mythicals on anything but the Champions. If you fail by breaking the rules or taking more than 8 years to complete the challenge, you will find being a Pokémon trainer a lot harder. Pokémon will be harder for you to catch, and your own Pokémon will start disobeying more, no matter what you do. You will also find Pokémon attacks even more common against you, and only you. If you succeed, you will be given, If you do not have it already, Aura Guardian, Type-Energy, and Psychic (Pokémon) from Shardless. However, you will be given an even greater challenge for your own enjoyment, entirely optional. Every gym leader through Champion will be given powers related to their Pokémon to give you a personal challenge in hand-to-hand or other competitions. If you were to succeed in these, whether with your own Pokémon once again or your own power, you will be considered the strongest in the world, Pokémon you desire actively following you to be caught.
objects.title: A Trainer's Journey (Pokémon)

objects.text:
You must reunite the two quirks, All for One and One for All. You don’t necessarily need to be the person who has both, you just need them reunited.

If either of the quirks is lost before you reunite them, both the villains and heroes will treat you as an enemy. They will unite in their shared desire to hunt you down. 

If you succeed, the rewards you gain is based on if you have the two quirks personally or have them reunited in another. If you have them personally, both will awaken and give you both Symbol of Peace (My Hero Academia) and Demon Lord (My Hero Academia) with the Addon between the two.

If you didn’t have the two quirks and another person did instead, their quirks will awaken and gain the same powers. They will also be loyal to you.
objects.title: United Together Once More (My Hero Academia)

objects.text:
Cards of Blasphemy are a set of 22 cards created by Emperor Rosella, each corresponding to the 22 paths. Each card contains a potion formula and a sequence description for each sequence. They have anti-divination and anti-prophecy abilities and are considered a high-level item. 

Your mission upon arriving in this world is quite simple, you just need to collect all the Cards of Blasphemy no matter how within 10 years of arriving in the world. Despite the simplicity of the missions, as already stated, the cards have protection and it is so strong that even your powers will be not very effective, but also some can be sealed with a special seal that will only open after saying the correct password. And remember that most of them are in the hands of extremely powerful forces. And for the record, some cards can be death traps, so be careful.

If you succeed, not only will you gain the power of the Beyonder (Lord of The Mysteries) and all of its upgrades, but you can now also take ALL paths at once while fully preserving your identity.

If you fail, not only will your actions attract the attention of ALL deities in the world, but also the attention of a VERY large number of Outer Gods, you will also be hunted by every existing church with their beyonders.
objects.title: Full Deck (Lord of the Mysteries)

objects.text: You have been summoned by Angela Roth to be a guardian and teacher to the just-born Rachel Roth aka. Raven, Pride, the Unkindness, the Dark-Winged Queen. Your mission is to protect young Rachel from her Father, siblings, and their bevy of enemies until the day after her 18th birthday as well teaching her how to control her great potential so that she may Rise as the White Raven. This will require you to raise her in the event of Angela Roth's passing, but also either find some way to sever her metaphysical connection to her Father Trigon that he will use on her coming of age to invade the Universe or train her in her gifts such that she can cast down her Father herself. Her siblings will hunt her to the ends of Creation looking to take her power for their own, looking to impress their Father with the fact that they have bested his Heir & Pride, either finding a way to permanently banish them to Hell or find a way to kill them. The enemies that Scath and his bloodline have made are vast and formidable, from the Lords of Hell, the Gods of Olympus, Eclipso, the Lords of Order and Chaos, the Silver City and its Legions, etc.... and they have all been looking for a way to harm his plans. Rachel's birth allowed them to find out about the Prophecy, and so did the peril it entails. Many contenders seek to end her so that Trigon may not add another Realm to his Hell as well as lose his Heir, "The Dark-Winged Queen". How you accomplish this is up from hiding her from them until the given date, or simply kill/incapacitate them all as they come. The reward is plain and simple: Raven finds in you a surrogate parental figure she counts on, earning loyalty and faith in you as any parent could. An ally, a daughter you can count on. As a side effect of raising Rachel correctly she was able to rebel against her Father and win usurping all that is his. Good Luck, may the Presence bless you for you will need it, Wandering Hero.
objects.title: White Raven (DC Comics)

objects.text: "Look, Charlie, you've had a busy day! All this running around, all this excitement with BATMAN!! Stop! You're crazy!" The Joker has escaped Arkham once again, leaving a trail of chaos in his wake and turning Gotham into a stage of terror. Your mission is to eliminate the Joker once and for all, regardless of when or by what means you accomplish it; you can confront him directly, set a trap, turn one of his own weapons against him, or devise any other method that results in his death. That said, imprisonment, dimensional exile, memory wipes, or centuries-long containment are not acceptable, as the Joker must disappear for good and you must be the one to make it happen. However, eliminating him is only part of the mission, as you must also ensure that he cannot return to life for at least one full year, which will be especially difficult considering that the DC Universe has countless ways of bringing someone back from the dead, including Lazarus Pits, magic, and advanced technology, so you'll need to find a way to ensure that the Joker stays dead for the entire year. If you succeed, several rewards will manifest. First, Jason Todd will owe you a debt he could never repay and will see you as someone he can place his complete trust in; furthermore, he will not hesitate to offer you his help whenever you need it and will stand by your side when the time comes. Second, Harley Quinn will finally be free from the Joker's influence and, with him out of her life, she will finally have the freedom to heal, reclaim her identity, and choose the path she truly wants to follow, whether that means returning to psychiatry, forging her own path as an independent hero, or perhaps, in time, finding a place among the Bat-Family. Third, the Joker's victims will finally have a chance to heal and, although some wounds may never completely disappear, they will gradually be able to rebuild their lives without living in fear of ever falling into the hands of the Clown Prince of Crime again. Finally, Arkham will no longer be the site of constant escapes and disasters and, without the Joker inspiring, manipulating, and creating new criminals, Gotham's rising crime rate will finally stop escalating, allowing the city to slowly begin regaining its stability. On the other hand, if you fail and the Joker survives or manages to return from the dead, he will know that someone tried to kill him, and to him, that won't simply be an attempt on his life but the beginning of a new game. He won't merely try to kill you, but will become obsessed with you. And if someone else manages to kill him, the Joker will make sure that even death isn't the end by using his own toxin to transform whoever killed him into a new version of the Joker.​
objects.title: The End of the Joke (DC Comics)

objects.text:
Look, someone needs to say it: Nabu is a lich. He's a disembodied soul inhabiting a vessel to sustain his existence, and he forcibly possesses innocent people to act in the world. The only reason the Justice League tolerates this is because he's useful against Klarion and the Lords of Chaos, and they'd rather look away than start a fight with an "ally." But usefulness isn't morality, and convenience isn't justice. It's time for that to end.

You must make Nabu completely and utterly unnecessary. This can be achieved in a few ways. You could permanently eliminate the threat of the Lords of Chaos and their agents, removing the very reason the Lords of Order require a mortal anchor in the first place. You could prove yourself a better, more worthy Lord of Order than Nabu himself, demonstrating such mastery over order magic and such genuine heroism that his continued existence as a parasitic helmet becomes redundant. So long as you meet the goal, any method counts as a success.

If you succeed, Nabu will be reborn as he was in life, a mortal soul no longer bound to the helmet, and every host he ever possessed will be released instantly. He will be tried for any and all crimes and wrongs he did against his Hosts. As compensation for their stolen years, each former host will receive a portion of Nabu's accumulated magical knowledge. All of them, including a now-mortal Nabu, will be grateful to you in one form or another. Additionally, if you proved yourself the better Lord of Order, you may claim Nabu's title, his powers, and his position among the Lords of Order for yourself.

If you fail in this mission, you will gain the very unhealthy interest of both the Lords of Order and the Lords of Chaos. Neither side will be willing to share you, and both will attempt to deny you to the enemy.
objects.title: Nah-bro (DC Young Justice)

objects.text:
Mama Kent ain't raise no absentee dad. Jonathan and Martha Kent taught their son that you don't abandon family just because they arrived unexpected or remind you of your own mistakes. Clark Kent can fly, punch through walls, and hear a whisper across the city, but he's been stone cold deaf to the one person who needs him most. A boy was created in a tube, denied a childhood, denied a father, and the so-called Man of Tomorrow can't find five minutes to be a parent.

You must get Superman to not only accept Superboy as his son, but to fully embrace the role of father. This means legally adopting Connor Kent, raising him in Smallville or Metropolis, giving him the childhood every kid deserves: complete with birthday parties, homework help, embarrassing family photos, and the kind of love that no cloning tube can manufacture. Superman must be present, active, and committed to being a real parent.

If you succeed, two rewards manifest. First, Superboy will become fully Kryptonian under Earth's yellow sun, gaining the complete suite of powers without any cloning defects or limitations. Second, Superman will achieve a permanent way to lock Kryptonian DNA against any future cloning attempts, a biological key that makes it impossible for any Kryptonian he meets to be replicated without his direct intervention, rendering Cadmus and the Light's cloning projects permanently obsolete.

If you fail, Superboy will defect entirely. He will join Lex Luthor and the Light, embracing the role of the abandoned son who found purpose elsewhere. He will similarly gain full Kryptonian powers, but now as an enemy of Superman and the Team, armed with a personal vendetta and the resources to make everyone pay in Luthor’s name.
objects.title: Dad Of Steel (DC Young Justice)

objects.text:
Match really got the bad end of the stick. He was supposed to be the perfect clone: full Kryptonian DNA, no human weakness, no missing pieces. Instead, Cadmus cooked him wrong. A full Kryptonian body trapped behind a berserk, broken mind, screaming and raging with an expiration date. They locked him away like a failed experiment, and everyone forgot he existed. But he's still in there. Somewhere.

You must heal Match completely. This means stabilizing his mind, repairing the genetic and psychological damage Cadmus inflicted, and treating him as a person rather than a weapon. Once healed, you must successfully integrate him into society as a fully independent individual, someone capable of making his own choices, building his own life, and finding his own place in the world, whether that's with the Team, with the Kents, or somewhere entirely his own.

If you succeed, you gain two rewards. First, Match will owe you his very existence and will be fiercely loyal to you for the rest of his life. Second, you will gain full Kryptonian powers without the weakness to Kryptonite. Additionally, Match himself will manifest a new ability: Adaptation and Immortality identical to Doomsday. However, unlike the original, Match can temporarily suppress his monstrous adaptations, allowing him to appear normal and remain integrated within society while retaining the power to become something far worse if truly threatened.

If you fail, Match will still gain that same Doomsday ability, but he will be captured by the Light before he can control it. They will subject him to over one thousand ways to die, each death more painful and devastating than the last, forging him into a truly mindless, unkillable weapon. The result will be a genuine Doomsday, unleashed upon the world with nothing left of the person you tried to save.
objects.title: Light a Match (DC Young Justice)

addons.text:
You like to suffer don’t you? Now, rather than quests being used to unlock your SP back, you have to face Shrines just like Link did. Each shrine gives the equivalent of 1SP of power back. You also don’t start with any item or Object of power, instead finding them as treasures over the world, quest, or even in temples like the other games.

There will always be enough temples for you to recover your full power, and you are fated to eventually find everything you lost. If you fail your mission, Systematic Progression Systems will return to normal.

As a freebie, you start with a Sheika Slate, and a weakened master sword that turns into the real deal if you finish your mission. And by managing to finish the mission on Master mode, you will also receive the location of the other two Triforces.
addons.title: Master Mode

objects.text:
Millennia ago, Calamity threatened the land of Hyrule. Through the effort of its people, he was sealed, and preparations were done for his eventual return. Unfortunately, Calamity did not stay idle. He slowly took control over its defenses by spreading its Malice, and turned its weapons against them. Now a hundred years have passed, and while Princess Zelda holds Calamity so far, her powers are weakening, and his release is imminent. 

That's the kind of mess you are being thrown into. You appear on the day Link is supposed to awaken from his nap. While in the game you have all the time in the world before facing Ganon, you have a limit here: you have exactly one year to face Calamity before Zelda powers fails, and he makes a full resurrection.

As for defeating Calamity, you can do so by any means you want. Take down the Calamity Beasts to weaken it, or go right away to face him in the castle. Keep in mind this world is an actual world rather than a videogame open map, so travel time can take days or even weeks rather than fifteen minutes.

If you do nothing and Link is the one who defeat him, you wont get any reward, and will fell bad about it.

If Calamity break free and isnt defeated soon after, then the gods will have to intervine. They will drown the land as they once did in ancient past, and trap Calamity under the sea. Unfortunaly this mean all of Hyrule will suffer the same fate, with only those in high elevation surviving. Dont worry thougth, eventually a new hero and princess will come to save the day... in a thousand years or so.

If you do manage to defeat him, you will free Hyrule from Ganon… at least for ten thousand years or so. All automatons will be free from his influence, and obey you now as its new master. You will also discover deep in the royal castle a Sheikah Tablet filled with ancient knowledge and technology, effectively giving you the power of Korok War Crimes (TLoZ). With this, and with the help of Zelda and the Sheika village, you could return Hyrule to a golden age in less than a decade. And finally, you will receive the Triforce of Power. Initially you will be able to only draw a fraction of its power, but with time and practice you will be able to use it to its full potential. Who know, maybe you can also use it to find the other two?
objects.title: Age of Calamity (Legend of Zelda)

objects.text:
Your task is to convince Tanya Degurechaff, Being X’s most defiant adversary, to genuinely embrace faith in them. Tanya views Being X as a manipulative deity who interferes in human free will, making her conversion an incredibly difficult feat. To achieve this, you will need to demonstrate undeniable proof of Being X’s benevolence in a way that aligns with Tanya’s pragmatic and skeptical mindset. Manipulation or coercion will not work—Tanya’s belief must be entirely sincere.

If Tanya refuses to embrace faith by the end of the Great War, she will consider you a sworn enemy and will actively work against you. Furthermore, all religious individuals will find your presence revolting, and those blessed by Being X will experience uncontrollable urges to kill you on sight. Your existence will be a pariah in any religiously-inclined society, and Being X’s interference in your life will become relentless and punitive.

If you succeed, Being X will reward you by guaranteeing you, your family, and your friends a place in a peaceful, blissful afterlife of your choosing. You will also receive divine blessings throughout your mortal life, including miraculous interventions and unparalleled fortune. As an additional reward, Being X will grant you the opportunity to reincarnate into another world of your choosing after death, retaining your memories and abilities.
objects.title: Faith of the Fallen (Youjo Senki)

objects.text:
Your mission is to bring an end to the Great War while avoiding mass genocide and ensuring minimal casualties. This is no easy feat in a world defined by imperialism, total war, and divine manipulation. To succeed, you must navigate the delicate balance of diplomacy, military strategy, and political intrigue. Key to your efforts will be building alliances with figures of influence, particularly Tanya Degurechaff, whose strategic brilliance and growing influence within the Empire could turn the tide of negotiations.

The peace talks must address the grievances of all major factions, providing a resolution that satisfies their political, military, and economic needs. Achieving peace will require earning a reputation for fairness and honor, ensuring all sides trust your mediation.

Should you fail to stop the war, Being X will take a more direct approach and manifest within the mortal world. This will escalate the war to catastrophic proportions, with divine powers actively influencing events. Entire nations may be destroyed, and humanity’s autonomy will be replaced with Being X’s oppressive rule. Your failure will not only bring devastation but also mark you as a primary target of Being X’s wrath.

If you succeed, the war will come to an end, and divine intervention will be completely removed from the world. This will spark a golden age of innovation in both science and magic, unhampered by divine interference. Your reputation as the architect of peace will make you a globally respected figure, and Tanya herself will become a trusted ally, recognizing your intellect and resolve as equal to her own.
objects.title: The Path to Peace (Youjo Senki)

objects.text:
You have taken the narrative place of one Subaru Natsuki. For the express purpose of this mission you have inherited the power of Return by Death and an incredible affinity for Yin and Spirit magic. While you do not control how much time is rewound in the event of your death unless you possess some other means of time-travel, it will always be enough for you to reach a satisfactory ending should you persevere.

Your ultimate goal is to heal this broken land teetering on the edge of destruction. For this you must end the destructive influence of the last two witches, Satella and Pandora, whether by eliminating them or recruiting them to your side, as well as assist Emilia in ascending to the throne of Lugunica and becoming a wise ruler in of herself.

Failure will have catastrophic consequences. The Witch's Cult, already a formidable force, will expand into a nation-spanning organization, spreading chaos and despair. Satella will break free from her seal, but the Witch of Envy will seize control, plunging Lugunica into an abyss of madness, and isolating you from all should you lack the strength to fight back. Emilia, consumed by the Witch's influence, will become a mirror of the very evil she resembles, and join hands with The Witch of Envy.

But victory holds its own rewards. Should you succeed, you will earn the respect and loyalty of those you save, becoming a true beacon of hope, and everyone who stood with you on this journey will pledge their unbreakable loyalty, their faith in you unwavering. You initial gift will blossom into control of all canonical witch factors, and your role in saving this world will grant you the eternal love of Od Laguna, bestowing upon you the ability to receive, create, and gift any divine protection you desire.
