objects.title: The Great Sages Journey (Re:Zero)

objects.text:
You must establish yourself as the sole, undisputed leader of Night City, uniting its fractured factions and inhabitants under your banner. This requires creating a gang so influential and ideologically powerful that it transcends the petty turf wars of the streets and the soul-crushing grip of the megacorporations. Your mission is to lead a rebellion that challenges the status quo, inspire loyalty across all social strata—from corpo elites to street-level rebels—and build a movement capable of reshaping the city forever.

The entirety of Night City must recognize your authority, either through respect, fear, or awe. Any significant faction—be it corporate, gang, or nomadic—actively opposing you will prevent your mission from succeeding. It is not necessary to destroy these factions outright, but they must acknowledge your dominance or be absorbed into your vision. Your gang must not only survive but rise as the ultimate force in the city, capable of global influence.

If you succeed, you will uncover and distribute a cure for cyberpsychosis, liberating countless people from the edge of madness and becoming a symbol of hope for all with cyberware. Those who bear augments will look to you with unmatched respect. Night City itself will transform into a beacon of freedom and prosperity under your rule, and your legend will ripple across the world for all of time.

If you fail, your rebellion will collapse, leaving you and your allies branded as the most wanted criminal in Night City. The corporations and rival factions will paint you as a cautionary tale, your name synonymous with failure and hubris. Your reputation will be reduced to that of a joke—a leader who overreached and fell spectacularly. The city will remain locked in its brutal cycle of chaos, and you will spend the rest of your days hunted, hated, and remembered for all the wrong things.
objects.title: The Rise of the Legend (Cyberpunk 2077)

objects.text:
Your mission is to reach a minimum of fifty percent cybernetic integration within six months, utilizing any chrome available in the verse (modified or otherwise, so long as it’s locally sourced) without succumbing to cyberpsychosis. Cybernetics that do not have the risk of cyberpsychosis does not count to the total cybernetic integration.

If you succeed in reaching at least fifty percent integration without your psyche shattering, you will undergo a proprietary neural-imprinting process that rewires your brain to accept your cyberware load as your natural baseline. Your existing chrome, and only the chrome you have installed at this moment (at the end of the mission), will feel as natural as the flesh you were born with. This does not apply to any future cyberware after this change. New installations will still carry their normal costs and risks. However, because your baseline has shifted, you are now psychologically capable of handling more total chrome before reaching critical mass. You will, quite literally, be “built different.”

If you fail to reach the required percentage within the timeframe, every piece of chrome you ever install will cost double the humanity, pushing you twice as fast toward the edge of cyberpsychosis with each new augmentation. If you instead fail by going cyberpsycho during the mission itself, you will become just another monster for Max-Tac to put down. The city will grind on without you, and you will be forgotten, just another soul who burned too bright and too fast in the neon-drenched darkness.
objects.title: About Time I Chrome The Fuck Up! (Cyberpunk 2077)

objects.text:
You must redeem Adam Smasher before his death. This does not mean transforming Night City's most feared boogeyman into a peace-loving humanitarian or convincing him to abandon violence as a solution to life's problems. It means severing the invisible leash that Arasaka has wrapped around his consciousness for decades, turning the ultimate corporate weapon against the corporation that built him. You must free Adam Smasher from every form of Arasaka's control, be it contractual, psychological, technological, or financial, and ensure that when he walks away, he does so with the intent to make war on his former masters rather than die defending them.

Success requires that Adam Smasher leaves Arasaka entirely, free from any and all corporate control. More importantly, he must depart with the clear intention of opposing Arasaka's interests, becoming a rogue force of nature that the corporation can no longer aim at its enemies.

If you succeed in freeing Adam Smasher from Arasaka's grip, you will accomplish what the corporation spent decades trying and failing to achieve. He will regard you with genuine loyalty and respect, the first being in decades to earn such a distinction. While he will never be a gentle soul, he will treat you as a true ally, protecting your interests as his own and standing with you when the chrome counts. Additionally, he will retain everything he owned, from his modified IEC Dragoon body, his DaiOni heavy assault frame, several spare Gemini-series bioforms, and a warehouse full of weapons collected throughout his centuries of service. He will also keep his existing logistics network, including a personal R&D department, Ripperdocs, and weapons manufacturers. All of which he lets you use without condition or expectation. Lastly, you gain the same chrome tolerance he has added to your own tolerance, allowing you to actually use his chrome.

If you fail in this mission by allowing Adam Smasher to die before his redemption, Arasaka will learn the full extent of your attempt to steal their greatest weapon. They will take everything that remained of their greatest weapon and they will feed it through Soulkiller. From that digital ghost, they will construct one perfect replica, an Adam Smasher made of one hundred percent chrome, immortal and able to be rebuilt should he somehow die. As an Engram, he will also have no upper limit on chrome tolerance, allowing for Arasaka to truly go all out. Adam will then hunt you anywhere Arasaka's reach extends, which is to say everywhere that matters. From the glittering towers of Tokyo to the corporate enclaves of London, from the orbital platforms above to the subterranean vaults below, from the crowded markets of Santo Domingo to the empty stretches of the badlands. He will actively hunt you for a solid decade before leaving you alone, only being dispatched if you ever enter his radar again.
objects.title: Dogs of War (Cyberpunk 2077)

objects.text:
You must accomplish two simultaneous, world-altering objectives that together represent the single most ambitious technological intervention attempted since the Data Krash itself. First, you must fix the Old Net, restoring that shattered digital landscape to something resembling functional order, purging the worst of its corrupted data, repairing its broken architecture, and making it habitable for human consciousness once more. Second, you must destroy the Blackwall's barrier between the general net and the Old Net for good, not merely lowering it temporarily or punching holes through it, but dismantling it so completely that the two networks become one unified whole, accessible to any netrunner with the skill to navigate them.

If you succeed in both objectives, the results will reshape human existence itself. Global cases of cyberpsychosis will drop by fifty percent as the rogue AIs find new purpose and new homes in a restored digital ecosystem. Those same AIs will begin using their incomprehensible processing power to actually help the common man, optimizing supply chains, curing diseases, predicting natural disasters, performing countless small miracles that make life slightly less unbearable. General existence across the planet will become measurably less dystopian. Do note that true utopia remains impossibly distant without enormous outside help.

If you break the Blackwall without fixing the Old Net, you will unleash every rogue AI trapped behind it directly into the general net with nothing to stop them and nowhere for them to go. They will not simply crash systems or corrupt data; they will go full Skynet. They will begin body hijacking anyone with sufficient cyberware, and they will face no limitation from cyberpsychosis because they were never human to begin with.

If you fix the Old Net without breaking down the Blackwall, you will have performed monumentally expensive repairs on a house you cannot enter. The moment the Old Net becomes functional again while still sealed behind NetWatch’s barrier, they will move in with overwhelming force and claim it entirely for themselves. Every restored server, every recovered data fortress, every dormant AI that might have been befriended will fall under NetWatch control. They will use the old data and the captive AIs to push their technological capabilities beyond any corporation on earth, becoming the single most powerful organization in the world overnight. And they will rule tyrannically as control over the net means absolute control over information, and absolute control over information means absolute control over everything else.

If you fail to do either objective completely, then NetWatch will be overrun and taken over by the AIs. The Blackwall will be hijacked by rogue intelligences and turned into a weapon to limit and control every netrunner, monitoring their thoughts, restricting their access, feeding them false data while the AIs use the entire restored Old Net as their impregnable home ground and infinite processing farm. They will, again, go Skynet, but this time with unlimited digital territory to retreat into, unlimited computational power to grow stronger, and the Blackwall itself turned into a cage for humanity rather than for them.
objects.title: Skynet Wannabe (Cyberpunk 2077)

objects.text:
You must become a parental figure and stabilising influence for David Martinez, guiding him through the crucible of Night City without losing him to the forces that claimed everyone else in his life. This means being present when he needs someone to turn to, offering wisdom when he faces impossible choices, modeling restraint when his impulse is to push harder, and loving him enough to say no when no one else will. Should she still be alive, saving Gloria Martinez will also greatly help in this mission.

Success requires two things. First, you must keep him alive and sane, preventing his death and his descent into cyberpsychosis. Second, you must earn his genuine recognition as a parental figure. He does not need to admit this aloud, nor call you father or mother or anything specific. He simply needs to think of you that way.

If you succeed in this mission, you will receive two rewards. First, you will gain the same level of tolerance for chrome that David Martinez possesses naturally, added directly onto your existing capacity for augmentation. Second, David will somehow, through means you need not question, acquire a slimmer, more refined version of the Cyberskeleton, no strings attached. He will be able to jack into it with zero strain whatsoever as it was made perfectly for him.

If you fail in this mission by not being there when he needs you, pushing him away or failed to reach him, then his canon fate will claim him absolutely. He will die the same death and go cyberpsycho the same way. But it will be worse than canon. Arasaka will recover what remains of David Martinez and rebuild him. They will turn him into their Adam Smasher 2.0, a perfect weapon forged from a broken boy. You will also be fated to meet again, although the outcome of such a meeting is not guaranteed.
objects.title: Home With The Milk (Cyberpunk 2077)

objects.text:
You must ensure that V not only survives the impossible circumstances of their existence, but achieves an ending where they are fully happy, surrounded by loved ones, and able to live out their natural death when their time finally comes. This means navigating every trap the Relic laid for them, every betrayal the city planned, every impossible choice that canonically offered only degrees of tragedy. You must be the factor that changes the equation, the presence that allows V to have everything rather than sacrificing one precious thing for another.

If you succeed in this mission, V will see you as close a choom as Jackie ever was, and that is not a title given lightly. Beyond this, V will gain the same level of power they can achieve in the game at their absolute peak: a fully maxed-out build with every skill, every piece of legendary chrome, every advantage the city can provide with no strain or damage.

If you fail this mission, the consequences depend entirely on how V's story ends. If V survives but receives a bad ending, they will blame everything on you. They will hunt you down, continuously chroming up until they can match a fully maxed-out V, and they will make you pay for being the one who made them believe things could be different. If V dies, then everyone who knew them becomes interested in you for one reason or another. Their loved ones will want revenge, certain that you could have saved them if you had tried harder. Their enemies will want to study you, forcefully hire you, or even kill you themselves to clean up loose ends. You will be pulled apart by competing forces, each one certain that you hold the key to something valuable, and none of them caring whether you survive the extraction.
objects.title: V is for Victory (Cyberpunk 2077)

objects.text:
You must complete a threefold mission for Johnny Silverhand. First, you must either extract his engram from V before the Relic does irreversible damage, or acquire a fresh copy of his construct before V ever slots the damn thing. Second, you must secure or construct a body specifically tailored to Johnny Silverhand, one that lets him be fully himself without the limitations of flesh he never wanted or chrome he never chose. Third, you must help him nuke Arasaka Tower again, but this time it must be done right: no civilian casualties, no innocent blood on his hands, and Johnny himself must survive to see the flames and walk away.

If you succeed, you gain the technology to create engrams yourself. You will be able to scan the brains of the long dead and effectively revive anyone, no matter how long ago they died, as long as you have at least fifty percent of their original brain matter intact. Additionally, Alt's survival is guaranteed, and she receives a body of her own, freeing her from the digital purgatory she endured for so long. Both she and Johnny will consider you their closest allies, and will be willing to help you if you even show a hint of needing their help.

If you fail this mission, Alt will be corrupted by the rogue AIs of the Old Net. They will turn her into a sock puppet and she will become the second coming of the Data Crash. The net will burn again, worse than before. She will at some point end up hunting you, and Johnny if he is still alive, down personally. She will not stop hunting you two until you are erased from existence entirely.
objects.title: Secondhand Silver (Cyberpunk 2077)

objects.text:
Night City is an awful place to live for those at the bottom. So just don’t be there. You have to command a controlling stake in at least one of the parties at the top of Night City. Be that complete command of the Mayor’s office and its official channels, a hostile takeover of a megacorporation, financial control of city assets, a subtle subversion of some of the city's gangs, or some other means of attaining power. You have to hold this position for at least three consecutive years. 

If you manage to hold your position for three consecutive years you will gain access to a controlling stake in a AAA Corp (or an additional one if you took that method to power) operating within night city that you are free to use as you will. 

If you fail to keep your position stable, or even attain it in the first place by your fifteenth year, you will be framed for multiple crimes and corporate indiscretions and added to their respective blacklists. Arasaka killsquads, the NUS’s Most Wanted list, even Netwatch’s tracking. You’ll never be able to live or work in Night City society again, and even the criminal elements will be weary of dealing with you in fear of calling the largest guns down on all of them as well.
objects.title: Power Company (Cyberpunk)

objects.text:
You must guide Ozpin and Salem to set aside their ancient hatred and work together once more. Their tragic history spans countless lifetimes, shaped by divine curses, betrayal, and endless conflict. Your goal is to help them confront the pain of their past, rebuild trust, and rekindle the unity they once shared. While rekindled love is possible, it is not require for success. Simply making them forgive each other and see the value in cooperation, redemption, and shared purpose is enough. However, you may not reveal to anyone about the stakes, benefits, or consequences of this mission. You only have a year or until the Fall of Beacon to possibly succeed, whichever comes first.

If you succeed, both Ozpin and Salem will be freed from their immortality and their divine punishments lifted. They will gain even greater magical power than they had before and, most miraculous of all, their dead children will be returned to life. A family shattered by gods and time will have a chance to heal. They will also become powerful allies, lending their vast knowledge and resources to your cause.

If you fail, both will take your failure as a personal betrayal. Salem will ceaselessly redirect massive formations of Grimm to hunt you and your allies down. Ozpin, having regained the full extent of his magic, will lead teams of elite Huntsmen to track and destroy you. Both will possess intimate knowledge your strategies, your methods, and your weaknesses and they will use this knowledge with lethal precision.
objects.title: Marriage Counselor (RWBY)

objects.text:
Being the goddess of Magic throughout the Forgotten Realms is a thankless job. Tasked with keeping The Weave, the magic fabric of reality that allows for all magic, Mystra the Third has to deal with all sorts of things. Being responsible to keep the Weave isn't easy, and many powerful beings aim to replace her, take the Weave for themselves, or worse.

The actual Mystra has been a goddess for a few centuries now, and unfortunately for her, she has competition. Shar, the Mistress of the Night, has created the Shadow Weave, an edgier source of magic that operates in the empty spaces of the Weave. Where the Weave is a tool for everyone, the Shadow Weave is accessible to only those Shar approves - and pays her tithe. It is also corruptive, and it takes a toll on the mind of those who don't have Shar blessing.

Shar recently managed to kidnap Mystra. Learning from her predecessors and being once killed herself, she set safeguards that allow for The Weave to function in her absence, at least for a little while. Elminster, her Chosen, can maintain the patterns of the Weave, though that puts him out of commission. However, he can maintain it only for so long before its threads start to fray, and Dead and Wild Zones start to appear, making magic unusable and causing many disasters to happen. 

The only good news of this mess is that while Shar is making divine Mystra location impossible, she is sure to be in Faerûn. Moreover, both Shar and her followers were spent in this attempt. There is a window in which you can exploit this to rescue Mystra before it is too late.

That's your task: to find where Shar hid Mystra, and rescue her. You have a year before Elminstrel starts to fail to maintain the Weave, and one more before Shar manages to slay Mystra and try to absorb her powers.

If you fail, Mystra will sacrifice herself, and Elminster will be forced to become the next god of Magic. While he will be able to do its job diligently, he will be unable to interfere in Faerûn anymore, making the realm lose one of its biggest guardians. Shar will also be able to absorb a sizable portion of Mystra's godly essence, making her stronger. Chaos is sure to follow, and the rules of magic may change due to Mystra's passing and Shar's strengthening, making magic unreliable for some time.

If you manage to rescue Mystra, she will turn you into one of her Chosen. Magic will attune to you, making you resistant to it. It will also be faster to learn, stronger, and easier to cast. With some effort, and his assistance (which he will be happy to give freely), you could reach the level of Elminster in a decade.
objects.title: Rescuing Private Mystra

objects.text:
Expose the truth about the ongoing war beyond the walls of Ba Sing Se. Your goals are to reveal the reality of the conflict to the Earth King and to dismantle the secret facilities beneath Lake Laogai, ensuring that no one can ever be captured or brainwashed there again. Bring light to the hidden struggle and restore freedom to those oppressed by secrecy and manipulation. You have a month to complete the mission.

If you succeed, you will find yourself as the new Grand Secretariat of Ba Sing Se and able to Earthbend, if you couldn't before, talented enough to hold your own against masters such as Toph Beifong and Bumi.

If you fail, the Dai Li will declare you their most wanted criminal. With a high bounty you would be hunted throughout the four nations and if captured, would be then brainwashed to be an asset to the Earth Kingdom.
objects.title: There IS War in Ba Sing Se (Avatar: The Last Airbender)

objects.text: You must reform the ex-galvan Albedo. This can be done by peaceful or coercive means, but Albedo must be otherwise reformed within ten years. Various ‘relapses’ are acceptable as long as this limit is met. Giving him outlets (he did seem to enjoy theatre), or recognition might work, as could paying him to stay out of trouble while conducting his experiments. (though creating a paper trail between the two of you could cause some unforeseen half-cocked hero ruining carefully laid plans. Should you fail to rehabilitate Albedo, he will add you in with Tennyson on his list of vendettas, escalating plans and schemes. Additionally, he will endeavour to at least implicate you in as many as possible, if only to keep enemies divided as opposed to rallied against him. Should you manage to reform Albedo into, if not a hero, then at least ‘higher-than-neutral’, you gain access to a powerful ally that’s not only familiar with some of the most advanced technology in the galaxy, but capable of iterating and building upon it. With resources and focus just the two of you could become a notable power quite on your own.
objects.title: The Miraculous Rehabilitation of Albedo (Ben 10)

objects.text: You are charged with acting as an agent of Redemption for the living Devil known as Lord Frieza. How this can be accomplished is up to you, although there are a few particular ways. A certain boon of the challenge is that rewriting his personality is a possibility, but it has to be permanent. The issue with this method is that it also has to be monumentally strong, since Frieza is such an iron-willed monster that his psychotic and sadistic nature can overpower the rewrite if it is not powerful enough. But, depending on if you succeed or fail at reforming this genocide lover, you will get one of 2 results. Should you fail to reform Frieza, or if he dies before this redemption could be accomplished, he will hate you to a similar extent as he hates the Saiyan Goku, willing to devote his entire army and even HIMSELF to killing you. Similar to when he resurrected himself, he will even "stoop" to the level of training himself for 12 months, bringing hell and near extinction to the universe in his search for you, making it crystal clear to the gods themselves YOU are the source of his rage. Should you manage to get Frieza to see the wrongness of his actions, he will reform the Frieza Force into the Frieza Defense Force, who will work alongside the Galactic Patrol. He will even take action against his father and, if he exists in this universe, his brother Cooler to reform them both into a force for good. Frieza will also give you the resources of the armada, and finally, even willingly train with you to keep himself from ever going back to evil, guaranteed to unlock Spirit Control due to his knowledge of Yardrat from the Ginyu Force.
objects.title: HFIL On Earth (Dragon Ball)

objects.text: You have aligned yourself with the man known as Dio Brando after his resurgence in 1984. For this mission, the task is deceptively simple. You must help him kill all 6 Crusaders that stand in his way, and get him the blood of the Joestar family. Whether you do this when all 6 are traveling together, on Dio's doorstep, or even before they get together, all that matters is you must eliminate all 6 before the final battle against Dio outside of his mansion. Failure by failing to kill them before Dio has to sneak attack them will result in the Crusaders not only surviving... but treating you as a bigger threat than Dio ever was. All 6 will actively do their damndest to kill you, possibly even awakening new abilities. Or in Jotaro's case, awakening time stop to kill you. Success in killing them all will have Dio considering you his new most trusted confidant. He will awaken The World Over Heaven and ascend to new frontiers. However, he will never forget, dismiss, or otherwise treat you negatively despite his ascension, and will reward you however you like without hesitation.
objects.title: Ascendant to Heaven (JoJo's Bizarre Adventure)

objects.text: You have been tasked with a very difficult goal. You must defy fate itself, and save the dead Stardust Crusaders. So this means you must: keep Muhammad Avdol, Noriaki Kakyoin, and Iggy the Dog alive in Part 3, Jean Pierre Polnareff alive in Part 5, and Jotaro Kujo in Part 6. Thankfully, if you know the series, you will be able to capitalize on the information. The only roadblock in this sense is that if Fate doesn't kill them the first time, something else will happen. Maybe Avdol survives Cream's first attack, but then Dio tries to decapitate him in Time Stop. Polnareff could survive Diavolo's attack, but then Silver Chariot Requiem, in pursuit of its mission, kills its own user to keep the arrow safe. In general, Fate will try to correct the events at least one time. But luckily for you, Fate will accept it if your will to go against it is truly strong enough. Failure by letting even ONE Crusader die will result in events being a lot worse. If Avdol dies, Iggy and Polnareff will be even more disheartened and practically let Vanilla Ice kill them. If Kakyoin dies, he will not even have the energy to alert Joseph about the nature of The World, and so on. Events revolving around the deaths will be magnified and lead to even more. Success in saving ALL 5 Crusaders will result in a domino effect of rewards. Save Iggy, Avdol, and Kakyoin, and they will be with Polnareff and Jotaro throughout their travels, making it easier on the 2 overall. Save Polnareff from his fate in Part 5, and Diavolo will be defeated even quicker, with even Narancia Ghirga being allowed to survive his fated death. Finally... if you are to stop Jotaro's death, it will have turned out Kakyoin, Polnareff, AND Avdol were close enough to lend assistance, assuring the death of Enrico Pucci without him being able to accelerate the universe to a new world.
objects.title: Savior of the Crusade (JoJo's Bizarre Adventure)

objects.text: "Tatakae...Tatakae...Tatakae!" You have been given the task of saving the 80% of life, or around that at least, from the Rumbling. How you do this is up to you, though the general requirements are to either: Stop the rumbling once it happens and before any major damage occurs to the world, or even stop it altogether by keeping Zeke from trying to use the Founding Titan's power to sterilize the subjects of Ymir. Fail at doing either goal, and not just 80% of the world will be destroyed. The Titans and Eren will receive a power boost and actually kill ALL life on earth: from humanity to the very bacteria on the ground, unstoppable in this method. After this, Eren will dedicate every Titan under his command to kill YOU, if you haven't died by then. Success in stopping the Rumbling post-start will result in the world being thankful for your actions and willing to put aside most of their differences for whatever you might ask them to do. However, Eren will be very angry at you at the very thought of betraying him and stopping his will, with the Yeagerist group serving as a cult for the man, assuming you don't kill him. Success in preventing the Rumbling period will have Eren see you as a man worth pledging his loyalty to. His titan form will even mutate slightly, making him 2 meters bigger, and even more powerful overall, while you will be given a titan shifter form of your own, whether it be a copy of an existing one or a custom one.
objects.title: Fumbling the Rumbling (Attack on Titan)

objects.text: “Michael, the big brother, loyal to an absent father. And Lucifer? The little brother. Rebellious of daddy's plan. You were born to this, boys! It’s your destiny!” Your mission is to ensure that Sam and Dean Winchester fully and willingly embrace their ordained roles as the true vessels for the archangels Lucifer and Michael. They must open themselves completely, without reservation, deception, or external compulsion, and invite their respective angel to take permanent residence within them. The specific version of the archangel is not important, whether it is your world's Lucifer, the Apocalypse World's Michael, or another compatible iteration, the principle remains the same. If you are not in the canonical Supernatural world, this mission will create a metaphysical "line" that tethers the appropriate archangelic essences to the brothers across realities, making the convergence possible regardless of your current setting. Should both brothers ultimately deny their destiny, Michael and Lucifer abandon all pretense of cosmic decorum. They descend with overwhelming force, tearing their way into the brothers, shattering their will through sheer, agonizing power. Once forcibly installed in their vessels, the archangels are no longer interested in a mere earthly Armageddon. Their war will expands exponentially, scorching the surface of Earth in hours before their dueling graces tear into the fabric of the solar system itself, extinguishing the sun, shattering planets, and ending all life from Mercury to the Oort Cloud in a silent, expanding wave of divine annihilation. If Dean accepts Michael but Sam refuses Lucifer, you create a kingdom of perfect, sterile order without its necessary counterbalance. Michael, now anchored in his perfect vessel and unimpeded by his brother's rival, executes the original divine plan with cold, logical purity. Free will is identified as a cosmic defect and systematically excised. Humanity is perfected into a silent, harmonious, and emotionless collective. There is no pain, no conflict, and no choice. The world becomes a beautiful, gleaming, and utterly silent prison. If Sam accepts Lucifer but Dean refuses Michael, you unleash the unchained spirit of rebellion with no one to stand as its equal. Lucifer, ecstatic in his perfect victory and free from his brother's opposing force, does not seek to rule or destroy in a traditional sense. Instead, he transforms all of creation into his personal canvas of torment and perversion. Hell and Earth merge into a single, endless carnival of suffering where hope is meticulously crafted only to be cruelly shattered, where love is twisted into obsession, and where every soul is both torturer and victim in an ever-escalating theater of pain. Should you succeed, however, a transformative fusion occurs. A perfect merging where Dean remains Dean, but now with Michael's power, perspective, and grace seamlessly woven into his being while Sam remains Sam, with Lucifer's might and knowledge as a fundamental part of his self. They ascend as themselves, only infinitely more. They claim their thrones as rightful heirs, bringing a lasting peace between Hell and Heaven, as well as protection for Earth. For you, success grants the ability to perceive, pluck, and gently guide the "strings" of fate attached to individuals, making them more receptive to their necessary destinies, and a revered place as the architect of this new age. You will also be free to walk through any supernatural realm (Heaven, Hell, Purgatory) without harm.
objects.title: The True Vessels

objects.text: "The same thing always happens. Everyone wants to save the world, they just… they disagree on how." The destruction of Shady Sands brought a fresh new hell to the West Coast. Without the government of the NCR, the wasteland devolved back into a more hectic place, to say the least. The Brotherhood became more openly monstrous on their pursuit of technology and treatment of human beings, and just overall things went to hell. But now with this mission you have a chance to fix all that. Now, what does that mean? You have the very difficult task of disarming this nuclear bomb with explicit failsafe's, or if you are sufficiently powerful enough via some means, taking this bomb OUT of Shady Sands before its detonation 3 minutes after arming. You are unable to prematurely stop the bomb from even arriving in Shady Sands. Only upon discovery by the citizens can it be interacted with. If you fail to disarm it and somehow survive the blast, you will be branded the devil that brought upon the destruction of civilization by the wastelanders. No one will sell to you, and even the most evil out there will wish to kill you for fear of you possibly targeting them next. The Brotherhood of Steel in all of its chapters will also think you are harboring more advanced technology and do everything in their power to capture you and make your life hell. However... If you succeed in disarming or getting the explosion sufficiently away from Shady Sands, you will be considered a hero greater than any and all protagonists in the series. Statues in your honor will be built, and you will be given the shardless power "You're S.P.E.C.I.A.L". However, if you already have it, you will instead find anything that normally weighs 100 pounds or more is 1/20th of its weight. Finally, the NCR will give you any and all resources you may request as a reward for saving them.
objects.title: Atom Bomb Baby (Fallout)

objects.text: "What is this feeling? This wild throbbing in my heart?! This rush, this tension! It's been so long I forgot... the exhilaration of a real fight!" They say humanity's true goal is to reach the peak of its potential. To always strive for perfection. But... what if that doesn't truly bring you happiness? After all, without that need to strive for more, or to better yourself any further, what left is there to do? This is what one lone man has experienced. A man who lives in City Z, and while he hasn't been cursed with true lack of emotions... They have been deadened to him, and he truly worries that there will be nothing to truly challenge him anymore. To make him feel alive. Your mission is to give the man known as Saitama a true fight. To make him bleed and truly force him to go all out. Saitama must also experience real joy and excitement at this fight at least at some point, making him use multiple serious series attacks and mean them. Of course, you can also attempt to revive his general passion through some other means, whether powers or just sincere humanity, although in some ways this could be considered even harder. Failure in this task will result in Saitama becoming more emotionless than ever, wanting to leave the hero business and truly go into a downward spiral. He will shun Genos away, close himself off, and turn to self-destructive tendencies. He will never fight again, becoming the pinnacle of nihilism and apathy. Succeeding in this task (even if you "lose") will bring Saitama's emotions back full force. He will truly become the best version of himself in all regards. Saitama will gladly train Genos to become a titan of a hero; Saitama will actively search out crimes to stop and raise his rank within the hero association and truly become the Caped Baldy the public loves on the same level as Amai Mask, maybe even greater to the working class.
objects.title: Reignition of Passion (One Punch Man)

objects.text: An alien has been living on this earth for over nearly 2 decades. To the world, this man was known as Omni-Man. He was the greatest Superhero on the planet, and the loved one of Debbie and Mark Greyson. But, beneath the kind helpful hands, were fists that could flatten cities and states in mere minutes. This monster became known to the world after murdering the Guardians of the Globe, and a hero known as The Immortal on live TV. You have the difficult task of reforming this underside of Nolan earlier than 1 year+ after this situation, and specifically before his attack against Immortal AND the fight with his son, or even before his murder of the Guardians of the Globe. A rule of this challenge is you cannot "Master" him, with any powers. Charisma enhancing powers or something similar will indeed work, but mind control will not. So while something like Heartbreaker would not be allowed, Believe In The Me That Believes In You! would indeed be valid. You cannot mentally or spiritually modify Nolan in any way either, so truely getting through to him, whether under your own, with assistance, or at most supernatural charisma, is the only way to succeed in this. Failure will result in his massacre during the Mark fight being much greater. Nolan will not hesitate for even a fraction of a second to use his full power to kill Mark for refusing the Viltrumite ideals, and will kill a LOT of humans to let the Viltrumite Empire come in, who will brand you as a criminal for attempted corruption of one of their greatest soldiers. Success however, especially if you accomplish this before the murder of the Guardians, will lead to a much better timeline for the show. Nolan will, indeed, help take care of smaller level crime since prepping for world conquering is no longer his goal. He will also have more time to properly train Mark, including telling him properly of Viltrumite weaknesses and other important empire information. You (or Nolan) will also receive the powers of a full-blooded Viltrumite or, if you choose Nolan to receive this, his base state will increase to three times their original capabilities in all areas.
objects.title: Think, Nolan, Think! (Invincible)

objects.text:
"You who picked this mission, this shall be our contract. I am TegaSword. I shall grant the wish of those who collect all of the Sentai Rings. That is the Ring Contract. Now, state to me your wish."

It seems you have been chosen by the wish-granting god mecha TegaSword from No.1 Sentai Gozyuger, and he granted you one of five Gold TegaSwords and the Gozyu Wolf & TegaSword Red Rings. The remaining four Gold TegaSwords for GozyuLeon, GozyuTyranno, GozyuEagle, and GozyuUnicorn will be given to either random people or up to four of your Companions.

Your task: participate in a single elimination battle royal and collect the scattered Sentai Rings, all for TegaSword to grant the wish of the last Ringed Warrior standing, with all rings in hand. 

First things first: collect the 49 Universe Rings, who will choose 49 people they vibe with the most as their wielder. These Universe Warriors, who use Silver TegaSwords to transform into the Main Protagonist of their respective Sentai Ring, will also be gunning for that wish, so they will be both fighting each other and/or you, depending on the circumstances. Depending on the Drawbacks you have selected, you can have it so that all Universe Warriors will passively zero in on you and the Gozyugers. Defeat them to get their ring, though they can also willingly surrender their ring to anyone.

Once you and the Gozyugers get all 49 Universe Sentai Rings, you must fight it out amongst each other to decide who shall truly be No.1. Winning it all will have TegaSword grant you exactly one wish. A permanent loss will see that your morpher dissolved and you waiting for the next Battle of the Rings the following year.

While participating in a Battle of the Rings, you cannot travel into another world until a Final Winner is decided.
objects.title: Now Seize It! Number O~ne! (Power Rangers/Super Sentai)

objects.text: S.E.E.S. had failed to truly defeat Nyx Avatar that fateful January night. There was just no way to destroy the cognitive god of death without causing massive psionic backlash. And yet, the Redeemer of Man, Minato Arisato/Kotone Shiomi, would not give up. Channeling the power of the Universe Arcana, the Redeemer of Man would defeat and seal away Nyx, dying in Aigis's lap the following March. But what if they didn’t have to die? You must somehow, some way, stop Nyx in such a way so that Minato/Kotone will not have to cast Great Seal upon obtaining the Universe Arcana and kill themselves to stop it while also not destroying humanity from the collapse of the collective unconscious by killing the eldritch cognitive god of death serving as the backbone of the modern Persona series. If you managed to save the Redeemer of Man on January 31st, you will gain the eternal gratitude of Elizabeth & the Velvet Room, as well as full time employment at the Kirijo Group & a lifetime’s supply of Incense. Should you fail, Minato/Kotone will suffer through their Canon Event, and S.E.E.S. will unconsciously feel that you’re at fault their Leader is gone, and be distant or cold with you. You will have a second chance, but you will now need to have a way to permanently kill Erebus and remove the Redeemer’s soul from the Great Seal without unraveling it. Fail that and S.E.E.S. will all but exile you from their lives.
objects.title: Save the Redeemer of Man (Shin Megami Tensei: Persona)

rows.title: Alternate Earth Missions
rows.titleText: These missions are exclusive to settings outside of the Worm universe but can also be taken if you choose the appropriate setting in the Crossover option.

objects.text: You are master of one Martial Art of your choosing, ranging from unarmed forms or styles of Martial Art with centuries of years of development, modern Martial Arts geared for military CQC, to armed forms over myriad armaments or weaponry throughout history, from common swordsmanship or spearmanship to specialties like the Kanabo or Kamas.
objects.title: Martial Art

objects.text: You are a master of a specialized martial tradition composed of dozens interrelated martial arts, all unified by a single cohesive combat theme such as a ronin, hoplite, ninja, samurai, knight, or many more similar archetype. With this, you command unarmed combat, weapon use, stance work, battlefield tactics, and situational techniques appropriate to your theme, allowing you to transition fluidly between methods without hesitation or loss of effectiveness. Each martial art is distinct yet harmonized, giving you depth, adaptability, and lethal competence within your specialization
objects.title: Specialized Master

addons.text:
You are now a genius among geniuses.

With your ability to read body language helping you understand how your opponents move, along with your hand-eye coordination and ambidextrous nature helping you execute those moves to perfection, you've gone from learning martial arts quickly to learning them almost instantly.

You're able to execute moves you've only just seen once, combine them into your arsenal, and improve upon them as well.
addons.title: Fist Eye

objects.text:
You possess a prodigious talent for martial arts in both learning them and creating new ones. Techniques that would normally take years or decades to master come to you in a fraction of the time. Under your insane talent, understanding, memorizing, and refining martial techniques that include striking, grappling, weapons, or internal movement styles is dramatically accelerated.

When you train in a martial art, you progress ten times faster than you would normally progress. You not only learn individual techniques and forms with ease, but you also intuitively grasp the ideas behind them, enabling you to combine methods from different styles into coherent hybrid approaches without confusion or conflict. Your body and mind form muscle memory quickly, allowing you to absorb and integrate diverse martial systems efficiently.
objects.title: Talented Artist

addons.text: You have already adapted your martial arts to align with your powers and any unusual biology.
addons.title: Adapted Martial Arts

objects.text: You find it easy to adapt your knowledge of martial arts to align with any and all powers you possess, even if they dramatically change your body. Additionally, you excel at integrating different martial arts styles, allowing you to use them simultaneously with the various techniques you already know.
objects.title: Adaptable Martial Arts

addons.text:
Your ability to improvise weapons and armour from all sorts of items has melded with your free-form style of fighting, letting you make full use of your environment and items in ways both beginners and masters would never have thought of: clothes being used to blind and bind, tables going from shields to weapons to platforms within moments, and whatever you can get your hands on is used with the effectiveness and skill of a master with decades under their belt. Even the most random fights can come off as masterfully choreographed fight scenes, with you in the middle being equal parts entertaining and impressive.

This also extends into your improvised weapons and armours, as you are more capable of wielding them for longer and knowing how to use any breakage to your advantage, such as an armour of books and tape being used as a whip, or having a morningstar of sticks break apart at just the right time for maximum effect.
addons.title: Martial Improvisation Art

objects.text: You are a master of free-form Martial Arts, seamlessly flowing between styles and forms like water—from the surety of your fists to easily dominating with a staff or pair of sticks when the opportunity arises, with no loss of momentum and advantage. Your entire body moves like a well-cared weapon, deftly aware of all tactics and moves it can carry out from the multitude of Martial Arts you’re intimately skilled at.
objects.title: Thousand Styles Master

addons.text:
In the field of law enforcement, you have the markings of a living legend. You have mastered all the skills needed to serve within the police force, from the newest recruit all the way up to the chief of police and even director of agencies such as the FBI and CIA. These skills include police procedures and codes, de-escalation of situations (such as hostage negotiation or talking someone down from making a horrible mistake), undercover operations, heightened instincts for pinpointing threats, and finding non-violent means to resolve situations, to name a few.

But it's not only in serving the law where you shine; you also protect it. You have all the skills needed to serve in the highest position a judge can attain, being innately better at reading the law in both its word and spirit. You can pick up on when someone is tilting the scales in one direction or another. While it may not be to the same level as your starting country, you have decent knowledge of the laws of other countries—enough so that you won't be stumbling around blind.

Optionally, you can choose to have a connection with the law, either being direct (formerly worked with the police or in a court) or indirect (family member or friend with the connection, etc.), and you will have at least one mundane weapon for self-defense.

If there are no modern police forces, this can be applied to the closest equivalent, such as city guards. This also applies to your optional weapon.​
addons.title: Law & Order

objects.text:
You are a skilled marksman.

You are also proficient with the most common ranged weapons and can figure out more exotic weapons with ease.
objects.title: Marksman

addons.text: Your skills have fused into the perfect expertise for assassination and being a gun-for-hire. Your talent and skill for hand-to-hand combat become flexible and versatile to create quick and lethal techniques and strategies, device plans for any hit to either divert any attention by making it look like an accident or set someone up to take the fall, and being unnoticed or leave no evidence of what you did, for example.
addons.title: Assassination

objects.text: You are a master of the fictional martial art called Gun Fu, adapted to actually work.
objects.title: Gun Fu

objects.text:
You possess the complete, hard-won skill set of an elite combat specialist. This represents the education, relentless training, reflexes, and ingrained experience of a true professional from a specific combat profession of your choice—be it modern special forces, the art of a knight, the precision of a pilot, or the cunning of a guerrilla.

Your body and mind react not as a civilian's, but with the automatic, proven protocols of your chosen profession. You possess instinctive command of its core tools: weapons, tactics, field medicine, survival, and the fortitude to operate under extreme pressure. Dropped into a hostile scenario, you immediately apply correct procedures, read the terrain with an expert's eye, and act with decisive competence.

This skill makes you an exemplar of trained, human capability within your chosen field, providing the foundational, practical excellence to handle yourself effectively in hazardous situations.
objects.title: Veteran's Training

addons.text:
Your various physical skills have sublimed together, making you potentially one of the best mundane sports(wo)men in our world; what this entails is that you have a natural talent for all forms of sports that, with skill, dedication, and training, will see you counted amongst the 0.01% of all-time greatest players. But even without effort, you could play professional matches on the side with decent reliability. Your ability to learn new sports has also increased greatly, requiring you to only see a game once to get a general sense of the rules—if no one explained them to you—if you encounter a new sport or forgot about one you knew once.

By default, before any drawbacks or perks, your body will be more athletic, with the exact details being influenced by your preferred sport, with you having a 50% easier time developing muscles and training your body for specific sports or other activities like spear fishing.
addons.title: Professional Athlete

objects.text: You know how to fall, how to land, how to jump, and how to maneuver. You're a master of parkour.
objects.title: Parkour

addons.text: You have learned the general skills of a hunter, which include basic-level crafting using primitive materials, trap making, archery, butchering, tracking, camouflage, how to care for equipment, and basic herbal knowledge.
addons.title: Hunter

addons.text:
You have learned the skills and habits of an avid explorer. As an explorer, you cover a litany of skills others might specialize in: diggers and cave divers, climbers, hikers, and mountaineers, so is the strenuous and longstanding habit of trekking through long terrains and ecosystems. 

Whether you traverse through caves, mountains, or treacherous lands, you know and understand both the methods and techniques to get ahead while mindful of the risks tied to your expertise. 

Doesn’t matter the tools, whether by hand, equipment, or machinery, your knowledge of the terrain, its composition, environment, and dangers helps to create the best plan for the most effective traversal in a short amount of time. This includes an expert level of climbing, camping, digging, cave diving, etc.
addons.title: Explorer

objects.text: You know how to survive without money, whether that's in the wilderness or in a city.
objects.title: Survival

objects.text: You know how to be stealthy. This includes both the crowd blending and the sneaking/hiding approach.
objects.title: Stealth

objects.text: You know how to move any limb as if it were the dominant one, from fingers and toes to hands and feet, as well as your eyes and ears. If you can move one side in a certain way, you can move its mirror image with the same dexterity. This grants you stronger vestibular and proprioceptive senses. This is particularly beneficial when you have a non-human body, allowing you to intuitively understand and control movements that may differ from the normal human body, enhancing your overall coordination and fluidity in unfamiliar forms.
objects.title: Ambidextrous

objects.text: You possess excellent hand-eye coordination, making you generally skilled at activities that require it, even if you wouldn't be classified as a top-class athlete. While this coordination enhances your abilities, it doesn't elevate you to the level of a Gun Fu master or a talented fighter.
objects.title: Hand-Eye Coordination

objects.text: You know your surroundings, and always have a sense of the direction you are facing.
objects.title: Spatial Awareness

objects.text: A blind person can 'see' to some extent using echolocation. It isn't perfect, or as clear as a not-blind person's sight, but it helps. You can use this version of echolocation.
objects.title: Echolocation

addons.text: Your tactical understanding expands beyond just combat and onto the field of sports, including a clear understanding of all its rules. Not only for yourself, but especially when instructing others. Regardless if it's for a competitive solo-sport like triathlon or boxing or a team-sport like soccer or basketball, you know exactly how to train each person under you to achieve their best possible results, individualizing their training to maximize their strengths while working at offsetting and removing their weaknesses. If it's a team-sport, you can turn practically any group into a well-oiled machine that flawlessly works together and covers each other. You also know how to ignite and fan the sparks of their passion and determination, encouraging them to not give up and keep reaching for the stars.
addons.title: Coach
Human Endurance
addons.text: You've gained what some would call superhuman endurance, but the truth is you're just a clear example of what it meant for humans to evolve as persistence hunters. This is a result of your physical and mental discipline, combined with near perfect breathing.

objects.text:
You now know how to properly exercise and take care of your body. This includes how to stretch, proper lifting forms, and breathing techniques. You also know how many nutrients your body will need to sustain yourself and how to adjust your intake to achieve different workout goals. 

You can also help other people exercise, judging which exercises would be best for them and how to help make them a proper meal plan.
objects.title: Exercise

addons.text:
Your body maintains a perfectly stable sleep-wake cycle regardless of environmental conditions, ensuring that the absence of sunrises, sunsets, or other natural indicators of the passage of time never affects your rest, alertness, or overall performance.

You may consciously adjust your biological schedule to match new work shifts, artificial day-night cycles, or even planets with different day lengths in a fraction of the time it would normally take, suffering little to no fatigue, jet lag, or circadian disruption in the process.

Now you can maintain a functional biological clock even when your environment no longer provides natural indicators of the passage of time!
addons.title: Perfect Circadian Rhythm

objects.text:
You have undergone professional training and conditioning, enabling you to withstand significantly higher G-forces and physical stress than the average person.

In addition, you are well-versed in the techniques required to maneuver, live, and function effectively in a zero-gravity/microgravity environment, much like an astronaut aboard the International Space Station.

This will also include the knowledge necessary to maintain your physical health in microgravity, ensuring you know what to do so that your body won't simply deteriorate.
objects.title: Astronaut Training

objects.text: You have mastered the skill of not thinking, completely emptying your mind of unwanted distractions. Whether it is a power feedback or your own mind generating ideas and running a million thoughts per second, you can tune out any and all of your mental processes, allowing you to hyper-focus on specific tasks, or simply enjoy a moment of peace and quiet even from your own thoughts.
objects.title: Head Empty

objects.text:
You possess extensive training in breathing disciplines and respiratory conditioning. This includes techniques used for relaxation, meditation, sleep regulation, pain management, endurance training, freediving, cold exposure, stress resistance, and environmental adaptation.

You instinctively regulate your breathing for optimal performance under physical or mental strain, allowing you to remain calmer, recover faster from exertion, improve oxygen efficiency, and tolerate harsh conditions more effectively. You are on the limits of mundane human respiratory conditioning and environmental adaptation.

You can also identify inefficient breathing habits and teach proper techniques to others.
objects.title: Breathwork

addons.text:
Your education in technology has pushed you to being one of the top experts in the world, with you being able to figure out how a mundane piece of technology works and why it does within hours before quickly coming up with means to improve the function and design. You could disassemble an 1800s automaton before quickly coming up with a prototype design to create an automaton more lifelike than any seen before.

Whether it's a mass-produced piece of tech or the vanity project of a billionaire who is losing touch with reality, you can, with research, figure out how it works or how it's meant to, before streamlining and improving it.
addons.title: Innovating Imagineer

objects.text: You have the equivalent of a degree with a major in mechanical engineering. While you can't understand Tinkertech, you are educated enough to spot such devices and poke at them without blowing yourself up.
objects.title: Mechanical Engineer

objects.text: You have the equivalent of a degree with a major in electronics engineering. While you can't understand Tinkertech, you are educated enough to spot such devices and poke at them without blowing yourself up.
objects.title: Electronics Engineer

addons.text:
Your triple major in software engineering, information security, and advanced mathematics provide you with incredible mastery over their respective fields, you are a true jack of all trades, master of all, with the equivalent of 20 years of experience in each field.

In the realm of security, you can harden individual systems or even entire networks against all but the most dedicated of — or dumbest of users; you can breach even the most secure systems and remain undetected — provided you can find a way in, of course, either through social engineering or searching for vulnerabilities.

Your experience in software engineering and education in mathematics gives you the insights you need to design and implement complex programs — or even entire platforms. Your architecture and code are clean, elegant, and optimized; even if bugs find their way into your code, you can easily identify and fix them.

Outside of programming, you are also an expert in network and  have the expertise to deploy and manage large fleets of servers or machines, and can automate most routine tasks that do not involve physical intervention.

All of this expertise still cannot fix Layer 8 errors, however.
addons.title: Savior of the IT department

objects.text: You have the equivalent of a degree with a major in software engineering. This includes several programming languages popular on Earth Bet and the ability to learn more as you go easily.
objects.title: Software Engineering

objects.text: You have the equivalent of a degree with a major in information security. This includes modern techniques of social engineering and hacking. Keep in mind that hacking usually isn't like how it's portrayed in the movies. You're not good enough to break into a Tinker or government's database, but most other things you can break into pretty easily.
objects.title: Information Security

addons.title: Living Canvas
addons.text:
Your artistic talent has combined with your medical knowledge, expanding it to the human body. This primarily takes the form of making you an incredible tattoo artist, being able to create detailed and beautiful imagery on skin as well as mix colors that are vivid and safe for the wearer. You are skilled in all methods of tattooing, ranging from modern machines to various traditional methods all the way to the improvised methods used in prisons.

Beyond tattooing, you're also skilled in the safe application all other forms of aesthetic body modification such as piercings, scarification, branding, dermal and subdermal implants, as well as, where possible, the undoing of such modifications.

objects.text: You have the equivalent of a degree with a major in Visual Arts. That is, all fields, such as painting, drawing, printmaking, sculpting, photography, filmmaking, architecture, and more contemporary fields like industrial design, graphic design, fashion design, interior design, and decorative art apply to this skill. It includes both the technical and artistic skills of all of them, including the sensibilities needed for them, color theory, art composition, and artistic symmetry, among others.
objects.title: Visual Arts

objects.text: You have the equivalent of a degree with a major in Literary Arts. This degree covers all known fields of literature in all its forms and mediums you can put your words in, including both the technical and artistic skills needed to write across all of said forms and mediums, such as an evocative and enriching handle of your native language, a good grip on how sentences and texts are eloquent enough to get a message across, good mental visualization and association, etc.
objects.title: Literary Arts

addons.text:
Your skills in visual, written, and performing arts have not only expanded but also built upon one another to create a final product of much higher quality. If you were creating a comic, your knowledge of how the human body moves would aid in drawing characters during a climactic battle. A single picture can effectively convey a chapter's developments, and even directing others to achieve the best possible scene despite setbacks from weather and actors, as you adjust cameras and perform minor edits to the script to better fit the actors.

This doesn't mean you will always have the greatest ideas, but whatever art form you choose to work on will be executed in one of the best ways possible. Even subpar ideas can be transformed into something that captures the public's attention for a year or years to come, given your great effort.
addons.title: Auteur

addons.text:
On stage, your personality radiates. You understand every detail of concert halls and stage setups, ensuring a flawless performance every time. More than that, you know how to create an unforgettable experience for your audience; every show feels like an event. Tickets to your performances will sell out within hours.

Even outside the concert hall, when you take the floor, all eyes and ears are on you. Your presence commands attention, no matter the setting.
addons.title: The Big Show

addons.text: You have a true gift for writing music for any genre. Writer’s Block is a thing of the past for you, as you can get inspired whenever you want to. Your talent for conveying messages through lyrics is unmatched, effortlessly capturing the perfect words and subtle nuances to express your vision with clarity and emotion.
addons.title: Lyricist

objects.text:
You have the equivalent of a degree with a major in Performing Arts. This includes all fields, such as music, dance, theater, and other related fields. 

This encompasses both the technical and artistic skills needed to perform for an audience (either on stage or a screen), such as a trained and captivating singing voice, a mastery of the dramatic arts able to seamlessly embody an array of characters with great depth and authenticity, and a professional grace and elegance in expressing them through every move you make, let you turn a dance floor into your show stage.
objects.title: Performing Arts

objects.text: You have the equivalent of a degree with a major in psychology and its branches. This won’t give you a talent for being a psychoanalyzing guru, stripping a person of their barest psychological essentials. Still, it’ll give you the tools, techniques, and practices for wrapping your head around people’s psychological profile, their neuroses, and what have you and utilizing this for either therapeutically guiding them to a healthier state or vice versa. This pairs well with other social sciences, especially Sociology.
objects.title: Psychology

objects.text: You have the equivalent of a degree with a major in sociology. While this doesn’t give you the talent for societal control or simply a near-unnatural insight into the “soul” of a society, you gain the tools, research methods, and, hence, the understanding for getting the picture of societal dynamics, tendencies, and the projective patterns influencing the past, present and future of communities (microsociology) and social structures (macrosociology) at large. This pairs well with other social sciences, especially Psychology and Law.
objects.title: Sociology

objects.text: You have the equivalent of a degree with a major in economics. This won’t offer you the talent to manipulate markets on the lines of Number Man, you get a handle on the tools, practices, and elements of an economy ascertaining their processes and health, allowing for opportunities in terms of market tapping, investing, or endeavoring in commerce of businesses. This pairs well with other social sciences, especially Psychology, Sociology, or Law.
objects.title: Economics

objects.text: You have the equivalent of a degree with a major in political science. To clarify, having this doesn’t turn you on a hellion of a politician with the savviness to win the hearts and minds of the populace, more so, it is having a comprehensive set of understandings, tools, and techniques to grasp the political landscape of communities or nations. This pairs well with the majority of social sciences.
objects.title: Political Science

objects.text: You have the equivalent of a degree with a major in anthropology.
objects.title: Anthropology

addons.text:
Due to your extensive study of humans and history, your archaeology has been pushed to be among the leading experts in your field. This allows you to gain more information from your findings, being able to come up with deductions and theories that are at minimum 95% accurate (accounting for false positives and whatever random things could have gotten mixed in). While not perfect, it will allow you to correct any misconceptions later on as you can reach deeper into the past to understand the cultures and lives of people long gone, not just humans, as this can be applied to any civilization you come across, no matter how alien or removed from humanity it is.

And with this insight, you can even grasp how ancient tools and mechanisms were created, along with their purpose and use. Handy if you want to escape a death trap in a tomb or research a demographic by looking into its past, as all the little threads that build up the present become clearer and clearer to you.
addons.title: Doctorate of the Study of Peoples

objects.text: You have the equivalent of a degree with a major in archaeology.
objects.title: Archaeology

objects.text: You have the equivalent of a degree with a major in history.
objects.title: History

addons.text: You’re an expert on criminal law, but this doesn’t solely focus on the lawyer side of things, as you also know all the ways to commit crimes and get away with doing them from a legal standpoint, allowing you to abuse the local laws to your benefit. This can range from using technicalities to reduce sentences down to nothing, various sleazebag lawyer tricks that are somewhat illegal, and other unorthodox methods using the laws to block the police and judges from getting to you or your clients.
addons.title: Criminal Law

objects.text: You have the equivalent of a degree from a reputable law school. While you have never practiced you have every law in the country you start in, as of your starting date, completely memorized. You're also better at memorizing laws, so it's somewhat useful if you chose a country you don't plan on staying in.
objects.title: Lawyer

addons.text:
Your knowledge of Biology and Chemistry has enhanced your medical skills, pushing them far beyond what was once thought possible. Your expertise in all aspects of medicine is so advanced that it would make others believe you are a Parahuman.

In record time, you can not only diagnose a patient's condition but also develop treatment methods that maximize the benefits of those treatments. Even if it means creating new medications from scratch, at the very least, you're able to make significant progress in any medical field.

Finding a universal cure for cancer will take some time, but cures for specific types can be developed much faster, along with cures for conditions like arthritis. This level of mastery extends to surgeries as well. You could perform an open-heart surgery and handle any complications with ease to save the patient's life. Even if an alien creature were found inside the heart, you'd simply remove it for later study while finishing the procedure. Performing surgeries on yourself would feel almost second nature, though you'd need a mirror to see what you're doing in some cases.

However, as much as this knowledge can heal, it can also harm. You know how to break a body—whether by targeting specific areas or poisoning it. Hospital bed or coffin, you decide where they rest.
addons.title: MD in the HOUSE!

objects.text: You have the equivalent of a M.D. from a reputable medical school. You have the skills to handle just about any medical situation.
objects.title: Doctor

addons.text:
As a consequence of having a hyper-acute sense of taste, you have been able to detect even the slightest flaw in your cooking, allowing you to account for and correct it; as a result, the quality of your food has seen an exponential increase, with even dishes made from poor ingredients turning into creations that would knock the socks off anyone.

And if you had ideal cooking conditions, ingredients, equipment, and space, you could knock off more than just socks (metaphorically speaking), as world leaders and the most powerful people in the world would give almost anything to have you as their personal chef.
addons.title: Food Warfare

addons.text: You gain advanced knowledge and an intuitive understanding of handling food, including preserving, refining, and preparing it safely; you instinctively know how to treat ingredients to boost their nutritional value while removing anything that could be harmful. You also develop a sixth sense that instantly warns you when food, ingredients, or water are contaminated, spoiled, poisoned, cursed, or otherwise unsafe to eat; this sense is immediate and doesn't require any testing or tasting. On top of that, World Clean now extends to the food and ingredients you touch; with just a brief moment of focus, you can purify raw ingredients, prepared meals, and raw materials—removing dirt, toxins, parasites, diseases, and common contaminants—without changing their flavor, texture, or nutritional value.​
addons.title: Food Inspector

addons.text:
Your good fortune seems to have extended into the world of ingredients and cooking, greatly increasing your chances of finding rare or high-quality ingredients, surviving the dangers of nature while searching for them, and succeeding in food-related activities such as cooking competitions, culinary festivals, negotiations, or other gastronomic events.

In addition, certain ingredients seem almost drawn to you, making them far easier to obtain or capture, whether it's an incredibly rare fish willingly swimming toward your hook, a hard-to-find truffle appearing directly along your path, or even a dangerous creature prized as an ingredient becoming unusually calm in your presence.​
addons.title: Gourmet Luck

objects.text:
You possess an extraordinary talent for transforming ordinary ingredients into extraordinary culinary creations. Through your mastery of culinary techniques and knowledge of flavor profiles, you can transmute the simplest of ingredients into gastronomic marvels.

Your cooking is an art form—where you blend science and creativity to push the boundaries of taste and texture. Your ability to combine flavors, textures, and presentation is nothing short of magical. You understand the alchemy of cooking, knowing the precise ratios and techniques to create dishes that captivate the senses. Your culinary skills go beyond taste alone.

You have a deep understanding of the nutritional properties of ingredients, allowing you to create dishes that not only delight the palate but also nourish the body. Your skill can still improve with practice, time, and effort, earning you even greater heights of culinary success and delights.
objects.title: Culinary

objects.text: You have the equivalent of a degree with a major in Philosophy, specialized in a school of thought of your choice. It could be Stoicism, Materialism, Idealism, or any other philosophy that you can think of. You know how to apply these teachings and principles in life. Your knowledge of all schools of thought is excellent, and you're able to deliver it in a concise and digestible manner, making it easy to understand for people from all walks of life. You live by your philosophy, and with the ability to debate and meditate on your school of thought, you are rewarded with clear, structured thinking.
objects.title: Philosophy

addons.text:
Your vast Occult knowledge has expanded even further through your studies in Theology granting you a similar wide and deep understanding of all major religions in your original world and the world you find yourself in. Through this knowledge, you have a better chance of negotiating peace between religious groups whose reason for conflict is primarily one of faith and even cool the tempers of the worst zealots.

In theory, you could use this against those who weaponize faith to talk down those who have been brainwashed, with the chance for them to join you or use it to create your own cult, but that is up for you to decide.
addons.title: Doctorate of Religious Studies

objects.text: You have the equivalent of a degree with a major in theology.
objects.title: Theology

objects.text: You have the equivalent of a degree with a major in Chemistry, giving you a thorough understanding of the properties, composition, and behavior of matter. This expertise enables you to conduct chemical analyses, design experiments, and contribute to fields like pharmaceuticals, materials science, and environmental science.
objects.title: Chemistry

addons.text:
You are now an expert field botanist, possessing not only a deep academic understanding of plant biology and genetics, but also the practical knowledge to apply your expertise directly in the field. You know how to avoid common pitfalls in crossbreeding and hybridization, ensuring the creation of new, healthy, and stable strains without the need for controlled lab environments.

Whether navigating complex ecosystems or dealing with unpredictable weather patterns, your instincts and precision allow you to adapt your methods for optimal results. Capable of developing new strains of plants that thrive in a variety of natural environments of your choice—resilient, adaptable, and suited for broader ecological integration.

Your skill in cultivating, modifying, and enhancing plant life is on par with, if not surpassing, experts who have spent decades in the field. You understand how to optimize plant traits for medicinal use, ecological restoration, or sustainable agriculture. While this doesn't make you superhuman, your intuitive grasp of field conditions, genetic viability, and environmental impact places you among the foremost authorities in botanical science.
addons.title: Expert Breeder (Flora)

addons.text:
You are now an expert in the genetic engineering of animals, possessing not only a deep academic understanding of animal biology and genetics, but also the practical knowledge to apply your expertise in the field. Be it cloning, crossbreeding, genetic modification, or something else. You know how to accomplish it even without a controlled lab environment and how to avoid the common pitfalls that come with these practices. 

With this knowledge, you can even create entirely new species of animals, perfectly adapted to thrive in whatever ecosystem you place them in. Be it forests, oceans, deserts, mountains, or even in households as pets. 

Your skill in breeding, modifying, and enhancing animal life is on par with, if not surpassing, experts who have spent decades in the field. You understand how to optimize animal traits for economic use, ecological restoration, or sustainable agriculture.
addons.title: Master Breeder (Fauna)

objects.text: You have the equivalent of a degree with a major in Biology, providing a deep understanding of various life forms, ecosystems, and biological processes. This knowledge allows you to analyze and interpret biological data, conduct experiments, and contribute to fields such as medicine, ecology, and genetics.
objects.title: Biology

objects.text: You have the equivalent of a degree with a major in Physics, granting an understanding of most mundane physical phenomena and the capacity to theorize about esoteric physical phenomena.
objects.title: Physics

objects.text: You have the equivalent of a degree in mathematics, gaining a comprehensive understanding of math and enhancing your skill with mental math. This can help with practically any kind of hard science and even some parts of soft sciences, particularly in the form of the use of statistics.
objects.title: Mathematics

addons.text:
You're a truly brilliant and creative mind when it comes to the physical sciences, with a knowledge base that would make you a world-class expert in at least a dozen specialties and the capacity to expand this count with a minimum of effort. You're prodigious at finding novel and elegant theories to explain unknown phenomena, communicating those theories to other scientists, and designing practical means of testing your conclusions, with a clarity and insightfulness that could exceed the greatest minds in history, at least in the fields you choose to focus on.

A few years of your influence could open up a new era in your chosen disciplines, and a decade or two could spark a genuine paradigm shift in how we understand the world, though it would take the collaboration of the entire scientific community to make that a reality.
