You won't be reverse-engineering tinkertech anytime soon (or even particularly intricate mundane tech), but powers and tinkertech do provide an excellent source of data for pushing the limits of human understanding. And so, if you set your mind to it, you could be the best in the world at modelling and reasoning about the exotic phenomena that accompany parahuman powers, and if that means revolutionizing physics along the way, so be it.
addons.title: Copernican Revolution

objects.text:
Your knowledge of the Natural Sciences is wide, albeit not as deep as the knowledge gained from skills such as Chemistry, Biology, Physics, Ect.

While the knowledge gained would make you a savant in those skills, the real benefit is in skills such as Geography, Ecology, Astronomy, Oceanography, Meteorology.
objects.title: Natural Sciences

addons.text:
Given your generalized knowledge base, with survival and construction training, you are now one of the handful of people able to restart society from scratch. Even if you were dropped in the middle of nowhere, you could set up a decent settlement within a week that could support others, laying the foundation for the tiny settlement to grow into a major city and effectively speedrunning civilization development, to a point—reaching a level comparable to cities of the 19th and early 20th centuries.

With more specialized (Skill)s, you will be able to do more, as they will be enhanced to a degree thanks to your foundational knowledge. With the right skills, you could even recreate a modern city in under a decade and launch a rocket into space.
addons.title: Rebuild Civilization

objects.text: You possess the equivalent of a high school diploma or GED in your chosen setting.
objects.title: A GED

objects.text: You have acquired in-depth knowledge of Master/Stranger Protocols, including how to recognize the influence of Masters on your colleagues and identify Stranger infiltration. Additionally, you'll gain knowledge of how to develop effective M/S Protocols tailored for your organization, ensuring the safety of your subordinates from the filthy manipulations of Masters and the threats posed by lurking Strangers. You also know how to resist the influence of the Masters, if you train a lot in them, depending on the nature of the power you will be able to get out from under the Master influence.
objects.title: M/S Protocols

objects.text:
You have the equivalent of a degree with a major in Parahuman Sciences. Even though the findings of this field aren’t close to the truth in the grander scheme of things (you know why, in the first place), research and leading theories such as Trigger and Agent Theory help frame parahumanity’s mechanics and origins for further study and insight into their culture. Other natural sciences you pick like Physics, Doctor, and Biology support this field’s effectiveness in accuracy, from helping develop an encompassing view of parahumanity to a scientific model of what we all understand as the [Cycle]. Any social sciences like Psychology or Sociology branch this skill out to their respective field of study, namely Parahuman Psychology or Sociology.

Considering what you know, you have quite a bit of headway in advancing this field of science.
objects.title: Parahuman Science

addons.text:
You possess an unparalleled talent for writing screenplays and scripts that captivate audiences and command the attention of studios, directors, and actors. You can effortlessly map out an entire series of movies, cartoons and TV shows, knowing every scene, character, and plot beat in advance.

You have an instinctive grasp of how to balance dialogue, action, and exposition, hitting every emotional note with flawless timing. You can write for any genre, adapt to any tone, and produce clean, production-ready drafts faster than most teams of writers while ensuring they resonate with a wide audience.

Your skill is so refined that nearly every screenplay or script you create has an exceptionally high chance of being picked up for production, often with little to no rewriting required. You can pitch your ideas with clarity, verbally summarizing a script so compellingly that executives will be eager to greenlight it.
addons.title: Master Screenwriter

addons.text: Making movies is one thing, but getting people to go out and see them is another. You’re a master of marketing—you know how to get people to watch your movies. You know how to create the best trailers that spark interest, which ads to run and when, and where to place them. You have an instinctive sense of how much marketing is enough without overexposing the audience. This extends to any media you work on.
addons.title: Marketing

addons.text: The most critical part for an excellent director, no matter if it is on camera or a stage, is that the actors can faithfully bring their vision to life. Your gift for working with your actors increases greatly, helping you coordinate them and effectively arrange training to ensure they'll be able to pull off even the most complicated series of moves, even stunts if they're willing, perfectly and safely. You also have a knack for working with large groups for coordinated performances, helping your cast create awe-inspiring displays for the crowd, whether that be elegant or even seemingly chaotic dances for musical movies or action-scenes that leave audiences breathless as they happen and then gushing for weeks after the show is over.
addons.title: Choreographer

objects.text:
You are a master Director and Producer, possessing the skills and talent to craft truly masterful films, where every shot is nothing short of exquisite. Your films are rich with clues, psychological depth, and layered character development that can captivate audiences worldwide.

You have mastered the art of setting a scene with exceptional attention to detail. Your sense of framing, lighting, and timing is impeccable, allowing you to bring your vision to life exactly as intended.

Budgets, schedules, and crew coordination are second nature; even under tight deadlines and unexpected setbacks, you keep production running smoothly. Your leadership ensures every cast and crew member performs their role perfectly.

In post-production, your editing instinct is unmatched; you can determine the perfect pacing, shot order, and transitions. You know exactly when to trim, when to linger, and when to let silence do the talking; you can keep viewers engaged from the opening frame to the final credit.

Your color grading skills bring mood and tone to life, ensuring that the visual atmosphere perfectly matches the narrative. Sound design becomes magic in your hands. You seamlessly integrate VFX, CGI, and practical effects as if they were part of the original shot.
objects.title: Light, Camera, Action

addons.text:
Rather than finding a USB drive, you remember and have knowledge from watching, reading, or otherwise consuming all the details of whatever media you end up in. 

If you so choose, you can still have the USB as well.
addons.title: A Glimpse of Meta

objects.text:
You have been educated in many of the hidden truths, secrets, and forgotten knowledge of your world. Whether that be about the dawn of cultivation, knowledge of a still-relevant but forgotten age, or even the origins of superpowers; you've heard and memorized them.

The knowledge you have attained is wide in scope. Only forgotten or hidden truths that affect large swaths of a world's history are included. Things that affect entire bloodlines, populaces, or geographies. The most person-specific knowledge is equivalent to that of spoken but yet-fulfilled prophecies, if they are still in play.

<small>If there is a particular secret that you do not wish your Meta-Target to know, you can exclude it.</small>
objects.title: A Glimpse of Secrets

objects.text:
You now have equivalent of a degree with a major in cartography, letting you draw accurate maps of any enviroment you can observe. 

This includes enviroments that can only be observed with powers.
objects.title: Cartography

objects.text: You can select up to 5 additional educations not listed here, such as an equivalent of a degree with a major in astronomy, aviation, education, etc. If your destination is an Alternate Earth, you can choose a formal education specific to that world with limitations. If you go to RWBY or Naruto, you can have the formal education of attending a Huntsman academy or Ninja academy, but it won't unlock your Aura/Semblance or give you more chakra than the average civilian if you didn't already have it.
objects.title: Further Education

addons.text:
You know how to teach. You know how to fight. Now you know how to teach others to fight. Not only on a technical level, how to operate a weapon and how to hammer combat reflexes into their heads, but also how to mold a civilian into a warrior, a soldier, who is actually likely to survive his first engagement, and his tenth. You know how to break others down and how to build them back up better, and have an instinctive understanding how far you can push someone before they break and when it is best to give space or, rarely, even a word of comfort.

Your training is spartan, pushing your recruits to the breaking point and a few careful steps beyond, but the results are undeniable. The men and women you train may not love you, in fact they may come to despise you during the time spent under your care, however once they've tasted combat out in the field they will know that it was thanks to you that they were ready, it was thanks to you that they came back home.
addons.title: Drill Instructor

objects.text: You know how to teach people. Could be useful if you want to start a school of superpowered martial arts because frankly, martial arts won't work the same with superpowers added to them, even if it's just a weak Brute power.
objects.title: Teaching

objects.text: You find it easier to take notes, pay attention, and follow along with speeches, seminars, lectures, discussions, and anything written. Also helps you learn physically and makes studying easier. Really helps if you have ADD or ADHD.
objects.title: Learning

objects.text:
The Mind Palace is a memory technique; you plot a map with locations and deposit memories there. Theoretically, you can never forget anything. You have trained this skill to its theoretical extreme.

By concentrating, you can enter your mind and choose how it looks and the general aesthetic of it, as well as which memories are at which locations by manually sorting them. It might take a while for you to get to the locations and thus the memories you seek, yet with time spent getting familiar with the relevant locations, you’ll get faster at finding them. Concentrating on a memory will lead you to its location in your mind; the more vivid the memory and the better you remember it, the less time you’ll need to find it. After getting used to the process of organizing your memories and doing so with a majority of your old memories, your new ones will start to automatically sort themselves according to your sorting scheme in the map of your mind.
objects.title: Mind Palace

addons.text:
Your planning skills, both on a small and large scale, have synergized masterfully, enabling you to strategize effectively on both micro and macro levels simultaneously without issue. This ability extends beyond conflict; you possess a skillset that allows you to plan battles on a galactic scale without overlooking a single planet, direct emergency aid to the areas in most dire need, and even orchestrate subtle actions with massive consequences—such as causing one person to miss their taxi in order to destabilize an entire region.

You may not be a Thinker, but your skillset would be invaluable to any nation, serving as both their greatest hope and ultimate weapon.
addons.title: Grand Master General

objects.text: You have the Art of War installed and have a tactical mindset. You also find yourself with the ability to make a mental map of an area. That said, you likely won't be able to make the best use of this until you have some experience.
objects.title: Tactics

addons.text:
You’re adept at the art of the revolution. Beyond an understanding of how to incite and inspire rebellions from discontent, you understand the minutiae of how to wage a revolutionary or insurgent movement. 

From subversive communications to guerrilla warfare, while the exact skills you gain will be tailored to the skills that unlocked this addon, they will always be a useful part of your rebellion toolkit.
addons.title: Summer of Fire and Blood

objects.text: You know how to make long-term plans. You find it easy to grasp geography, troop locations, and the best move for your enemy to make.
objects.title: Strategy

addons.text:
Your investigative talents now operate in perfect synergy with your mastery of espionage. Information isn't just uncovered—it’s extracted, traded, and weaponized.

You instinctively blend critical thinking with covert influence, deciphering coded exchanges, manipulating pressure points, and constructing networks of informants with surgical precision. You instinctively understand how to follow a lead without leaving a trail, how to convert evidence into influence, and how to destabilize or protect entire systems with precise, hidden moves.

Secrets come to light not only through physical clues but also through the social fabric itself—rumors, relationships, silences, and shifting allegiances. Gossip becomes evidence. Omissions speak volumes. You’re not just solving mysteries—you’re controlling the flow of information, one secret at a time.
addons.title: Web of Truth

objects.text: You have all the skills necessary to be a detective... except for the legal knowledge. This doesn't make you more perceptive, but it does make it so you know what and where to look and inspect, and so is the frame of mind with the necessary critical thinking.
objects.title: Investigation

objects.text: You are good with all that is related to business and money: accounting management, project and business management, dealmaking, bartering, etc. Picking this up with Economy turns this into a talent bordering on a savant.
objects.title: Business

objects.text: You know how to play and win a crowd or group, gaining your resolve and loyalty for either a cause or goal through oratory and force of character alone. Picking this up with Political Science turns this into a talent, granting political charisma moving droves of people.
objects.title: Politics

objects.text:
You have the ability to inspire people, whether it is helping an artist reignite their creativity, helping a crestfallen leader see the light of better days, or rallying a group to unite and work for a common cause.

You know how to act and speak properly to deliver your message, which, as a side effect, makes you good at TED talks or press conferences where you need to address many people.
objects.title: Inspiration

objects.text: Espionage in all its forms is as easy as breathing for you—with gaining contacts, expanding networks, planting spies, and more being trivial. You could have your thumb on the pulse of the city within days, its deepest secrets unable to stay hidden from you.
objects.title: Cloak and Dagger

addons.text: Your gift of the gab has grown to the point where you can get people to laugh, whether it's a chuckle or full-body laughter that leaves them doubled over in tears. You can come up with jokes or skits that brighten people's day or serve as a distraction. This skill can also work with other skills to create more niche jokes that are technical in nature.
addons.title: The Comedian

objects.text: You're good at banter and distraction. A bonus for this is that you gain a sense of humor, if you didn't already have one.
objects.title: Banter

objects.text: You’re good at lying. Not just good, but it’s more like you are an artist of the lie. You know just what emotions to fake and how to say things that will convince others of your professed sincerity, and can spin almost endless bullshit while knowing just how to keep it believable.
objects.title: Bullshit Spinning

objects.text: You have a sense of exactly what time it is at all times, even if you can't see the sky or have been underground for long periods of time.
objects.title: Internal Clock

objects.text: You have all the skills and knowledge needed to be a magician, specifically one who deals with using tricks to create an illusion of magic. You know how to do actions that seem impossible or inexplicable to even observant viewers with your sleight of hand and misdirection. Your mastery of the art of diversion allows you to conceal your actions without others realizing what you are doing or how you are doing it.
objects.title: Magician

addons.text:
Your deep knowledge of performance and understanding of how to present yourself to an audience have granted you a unique ability to influence how others perceive you. With carefully chosen words and purposeful movements, you can project an image of unparalleled authority, earning respect and admiration. Conversely, by slightly slouching, wearing unremarkable clothing, and adopting a more subdued manner of movement, you can make yourself appear insignificant, causing others to subconsciously overlook you.

This newfound mastery allows you to skillfully manipulate public perception, shaping how others see you to suit any situation.
addons.title: Self-Show

objects.text: You know various ways to create a lasting impression on people. With your skills in creating spectacles that use various verbal and non-verbal cues to capture the attention of the audience. You are talented in striking poses and can create catchy phrases that can leave lasting impressions on people. As a result of your dramatics, you also know how to create impressive entrances and exits that can dazzle onlookers.
objects.title: Dramatics

objects.text: You are an expert in causing pain. Not simply physical pain, but psychological, emotional or financial. Through either accident or design, the tools at your disposal can lead to trauma, misfortune or even mental breakdown of the victim. In many cases, it is better for those who would oppose you to simply run away. While you may take no joy in the acts of violence you do perform, you understand it to be a tool like any other to obtain what you want.
objects.title: Harmful

addons.text:
You are now unparalleled at helping others with any and all mental problems. From effortlessly curing depression after only a brief talk to even helping those possessing completely alien mindsets deal with traumas incomprehensible to the human mind or helping murderous psychopaths regain their humanity and conscience.

While you may not be able to completely change someone's personality, you will effortlessly be able to temper their worst tendencies. Do be careful when utilising your gifts: if a depraved criminal suddenly gains a conscience, it can have disastrous effects on their psyche, although you will be able to mitigate most of the negative effects with time and effort.
addons.title: I Can Fix Them

addons.text:
You become a supernaturally good masseur. In addition to your massages being far more pleasurable and relaxing, you can now affect someone on a much deeper level.

Due to your supernatural level of precision, you can affect the body on the level of individual blood vessels, which lets you, for example, fix any internal organ malfunctions, essentially turning a massage session into a non-invasive surgery if needed.

Lastly, with some practice, you can even apply this skill offensively, rupturing blood vessels and internal organs with a single strike, causing heart attacks with a touch, and much more.
addons.title: Hands-On

objects.text: You have a natural talent to heal others physically, mentally, and spiritually. Without knowing any elaborate medical procedures, you can often diagnose and treat others with spot diagnosis that even professionals will take days to confirm. For patients with more esoteric conditions, you gain insight into what they need to recover and can act upon this intuitive knowledge to affect cures that belie your training.
objects.title: Healer

addons.text:
Your diplomatic skills have greatly improved, especially regarding mediations between different groups, including those with wildly different ideologies or deep-rooted grudges. Your logistical abilities and your capacity to stay calm under any circumstances make you a master of conflict resolution, getting to the heart of the issues and finding compromises and deals that tend to leave everyone satisfied, while preventing or significantly reducing future conflicts.

Your plans are usually so well-crafted that those who go against either the letter or the spirit of the deal end up looking much worse than they would have otherwise, earning the ire of everyone, including their staunchest allies, and they will be forced to make concessions or face consequences in order to resolve the situation.
addons.title: Peace Maker

objects.text: Your abilities to communicate and negotiate are astounding. You have an ability to untangle complex disputes and come to solutions that leave everyone satisfied. Political negotiations, business deals, snarled conflicts between groups or nations - none of them stand a chance against your unique style of diplomacy. You have an ability to empathize with others and understand their motivations that makes them trust you implicitly.
objects.title: Diplomat

objects.text: When negotiation fails, it's time for force. And that's where you excel. You know how to wage a war and win it. Both physically and in every other context. Your aggression is calculated, focused, and never aimless; the best way to get what you want is with a well-placed show of force. You know when to hold back and wait—and when to strike. While others may cower or falter under pressure, your natural instincts kick in to let you win, no matter the odds.
objects.title: Aggression

addons.text:
No longer will you run out of new and creative ideas. When faced with a problem, you will get a comprehensive understanding of various ways to approach it; no longer will you have to experience the thought 'Why haven't I thought of it before?'.

Moreover, when you need a specific new idea, such as an inspiration for a story if you are a writer, or where to go on a date, you will always have a neverending stream of new and creative ones, as closely tailored to your tastes as possible.
addons.title: Wellspring of Ideas

objects.text: You have an endless supply of creative ideas and plans that allow you to overcome any obstacle. You can think on your feet and adapt to any situation, no matter how unexpected. You are able to turn even the most hopeless of situations into opportunities for success. No matter what challenges come your way, you always have a clever and cunning solution.
objects.title: Resourcefulness

addons.text:
Your talent as a recruiter, knowing the best points of leverage and positions to fill has given you a near preternatural skill when constructing and managing teams. 

Beyond this, your ease of connection lets you strangle issues as they develop, and become a true powerhouse of a leader.
addons.title: Team Leader

objects.text:
Your talent for building and maintaining connections with people is unmatched. You effortlessly make friends and allies of unlikely candidates, and you can always find the perfect foot in the door to establish a new relationship. 

You have an intangible knack for knowing what a person needs to hear to form a connection, and your network of allies spans almost every possible walk of life. 

You have the ability to make even the hardest hearted enemies into devoted allies. 

Through a combination of charm, wit, and force of character, you are able to win over the most adverse of adversaries to work with you willingly.
objects.title: Connection

objects.text: You find it easy to look at plans and ideas from multiple angles, allowing you to notice small but important details that otherwise would have gone overlooked. This does not help you in solving these problems, just helps you identify that they exist.
objects.title: Idiot Proofing

objects.text: You gain knowledge on all things related to the criminal underworld, ranging from being able to tell criminal fronts, knowing how criminal gangs work, how people launder money or even just knowing how to get contacts for “business”. In addition to this, you also have a natural talent for committing crimes, finding it easier to learn certain skills such as lock picking.
objects.title: Criminal Underworld

objects.text: You gain the knowledge of information verification and dissemination, able to assess the credibility of news and sources, as well as spread information both factual and false, while also knowing how to hide information. You also have knowledge in crafting believable fake information and creating multiple fake sources and leads for it, thus making it far harder to prove it is fake. With your deep knowledge of information verification and dissemination, you are also well-versed in how to effectively use information to your advantage. Whether it is to blackmail someone or create false narratives, you know how to leverage information to achieve your goals.
objects.title: Information Control

objects.text: You possess an understanding of all occult practices across the world, both ancient and modern. Your expertise extends to the origins, purposes, and meanings behind every ritual, symbol, and practice. You are familiar with the cultural, spiritual, and historical contexts that shape these esoteric traditions, as well as their symbolic significance and intended outcomes. This includes deep insights into the philosophies, tools, and spiritual systems that underpin them, allowing you to explain not only how these rituals are performed but also why they are structured in specific ways and the principles they aim to honor or invoke. This doesn’t necessarily make these occult rituals work.
objects.title: Occultism

objects.text:
You have a natural talent—a knack for nurturing and guiding children, whether they are your own or not. An innate sense that grants you an intuitive understanding of how to support and care for them, helping them grow into their best selves. This instinct allows you to strike a thoughtful balance between firmness and leniency, encouraging their development while ensuring their happiness. While not infallible, it does provide you with the insight to navigate each given moment and situation to the best of your abilities.

While your newfound talent won't make you the perfect parent, it'll make you a damn good one. To your ward, you'll be an unparalleled figure—their favorite person and a steadfast source of comfort, guidance, and love.
objects.title: Caregiver

objects.text:
You possess an almost unnatural skill of deducing what will bring others the most enjoyment. From picking the perfect present to planning an ideal date.

Even if you know nothing about the person and are only going to meet for the first time, you always have an instinctual understanding of what they will enjoy the most, as well as an ability to quickly adjust your actions on the fly the more you learn about them.
objects.title: Present Perfect

objects.text: You have a tendency to simplify complex problems. When faced with a challenge, you instinctively go to the most straightforward solution, avoiding unnecessary complications. You can go through layers of complexity to find the simplest, most practical approach, often fixing issues with minimal effort. Your mind quickly eliminates unnecessary possibilities, allowing you to focus on the most effective and efficient course of action.
objects.title: Occam’s Razor

objects.text: You have the uncanny ability to separate your ego, and biases from decision making, so you can think calmly. In any situation, you can quickly analyze the core factors at play, dismiss distractions, and focus solely on practical solutions. So you can assess risks, benefits, and outcomes with a clear perspective, ensuring you consistently make decisions that are grounded in reason and logic. By relying on clarity over impulse, you avoid overthinking or reacting impulsively, always acting with purpose and efficiency.
objects.title: Logical

addons.text:
You are a master of the hustle, a relentless opportunist with an almost supernatural knack for turning situations into profit. You excel at identifying lucrative opportunities, exploiting inefficiencies, and navigating complex financial landscapes with ease. Whether it’s recognizing an emerging market trend, negotiating a deal that leaves you leagues ahead, or transforming a struggling enterprise into a thriving success, you operate like a shark in the waters of commerce—calculating, decisive, and always hungry.

Your understanding of economic systems allows you to assess the health and processes of markets, spotting gaps ripe for exploitation. Paired with your business acumen, you can launch ventures, manage enterprises, and broker agreements with a savant-like talent. You operate in the big leagues, excelling in the mega-sized arenas of finance and commerce, where deals are measured in millions and success is built on strategic foresight and calculated risks. No resource, asset, or opportunity escapes your notice, and your relentless pursuit of profit makes you a formidable force in any financial arena.
addons.title: Money Shark

addons.text:
You thrive in the chaotic ebb and flow of the underground, mastering the art of the hustle in the shadowy corners of society. With your knowledge of the criminal underworld, you’re a natural at navigating its unspoken rules and shifting currents. Whether it’s spotting a criminal front, brokering deals with shady contacts, or leveraging illicit networks for personal gain, you know how to keep your finger on the pulse of the streets.

Your talent lies in small-time hustles and quick-turn schemes—flipping stolen goods, running cons, or securing black-market resources. You understand how to read people and situations, adapting quickly to avoid suspicion or capitalize on vulnerability. You’re adept at spotting opportunities others would miss, turning what seems like chaos into calculated profit.

You are a master in the small-time, thriving on casual street smarts and hustles, where quick thinking and adaptability make the difference between getting by and getting ahead.
addons.title: Street Shark

addons.text:
You are a master of the art that has no rules: dirty fighting. While traditional martial artists might focus on form and discipline, you thrive in chaos, exploiting every cheap shot, distraction, and unconventional tactic to gain the upper hand. Whether it’s gouging eyes, sweeping legs, throwing sand, or weaponizing the environment, you know how to fight smart, not fair.

This skill complements any martial expertise, allowing you to turn even the most structured style into a ruthless, unpredictable tool in close-quarters combat. Your reflexes and ingenuity make you dangerous in any fight, whether you’re in a formal duel, a back-alley brawl, or a life-or-death struggle. You understand that the only thing that matters is winning, and you’ll do whatever it takes to come out on top.
addons.title: Dirty Fighting

objects.text: You smell opportunity like sharks smell blood, honing in on even the faintest hint of advantage with a precision that others envy or fear. Your sharp instincts allow you to identify opportunities where others see none, and you never hesitate to exploit them to their fullest potential. This skill shines brightest in domestic situations, where your ability to read people, navigate social dynamics, and leverage secrets, alliances, or rivalries ensures outcomes in your favor. While you can still recognize and take advantage of openings in combat—such as exploiting an enemy’s mistake or using the environment to your advantage—this doesn’t grant you an inherent sense for battle or combat strategy.
objects.title: Opportunist

objects.text:
You have a great understanding of how to erase every trace of your presence. Physical evidence, digital footprints, or even psychological tells—you know how to cover your tracks perfectly.

From wiping fingerprints off surfaces and masking your scent to avoiding surveillance cameras or crafting untraceable fake identities, you can remove any sign that you were ever there. You know how to manipulate environments, anticipate detection methods, and blend seamlessly into the background.
objects.title: Concealment

objects.text:
You’re a pro at getting away with things—regardless if it’s sneaking something past someone, pulling off a shady deal, or slipping out of a mess without consequences. If there’s trouble, you know how to avoid it. If you’re caught, you know how to talk your way out. Either way, you don’t stick around to face the fallout.

You cover your tracks so well that no one even realizes you were there. Security cameras? Witnesses? Doesn’t matter—you know how to twist the story, plant doubt, or make the evidence point somewhere else. If you need to disappear, you can be gone before anyone knows to look. If you need to bluff, people believe whatever you’re selling, even if it’s total bullshit.

This isn’t just about petty tricks. You can skim off the top of a business and make the numbers look clean. You can sell people on a scam, disappear with their money, and leave them blaming themselves. Maybe you’re running a fake charity, setting up a Ponzi scheme, or siphoning funds while keeping a spotless reputation. Even if someone starts putting the pieces together, you’ve already got an airtight alibi and someone else to take the fall.

Whether it’s dodging an argument, faking innocence, or bailing on a bad deal, you know exactly when to stay quiet, when to talk, and when to leave. You don’t get caught often, and even when you do, it never sticks. You know every trick in the book, and if there’s a way out, you’ll find it.
objects.title: Master of Escape

addons.text:
Your ability to communicate with animals has been greatly refined; while you cannot have full-on conversations with words, you can now better command and understand animals. 

For example, you know the tone and posture needed to ease a wild wolf and direct it toward a threat, and this understanding can influence the animals themselves, being at least neutral toward you, with even aggressive animals leaving you be if you leave them alone.

Coupled with this, you gain a proficient skill in domesticating animals; while results will vary from species to species, you will be able to live in harmony with them, and they with you, with you as the pillar of their new family, pack, or any plural for a group of animals you can think of.
addons.title: The Ventura Effect
Dr. Dolittle Jr.
addons.text:
Your natural understanding of animals combines with your healing talent, extending your medical abilities into the animal kingdom.

Beyond diagnosis and treatment, you are also capable of understanding and interpreting animal behavior, distinguishing when a behavioral problem is caused by pain, illness, fear, or trauma, while also knowing how to calm them and earn their trust —even when dealing with frightened, injured, or aggressive animals— making it possible to examine and treat them without the need for force or sedation.

Likewise, you intuitively understand what each species needs to maintain good health and well-being, from nutrition, exercise, and hygiene to proper living conditions and preventive care; you can apply this knowledge to pets, livestock, exotic animals, and even species you have never treated before, quickly understanding their medical and behavioral needs.

If you have the Ventura Effect add-on, your abilities extend especially to the comprehensive rehabilitation of wildlife, allowing you to rescue and treat animals, contribute to the recovery and conservation of species, and restore their habitats, helping them regain a healthy life and thrive once again in their natural environment.

objects.text: Sit, stay, and rollover. You are good at handling and training animals. In return, they love you or don't attack first. For some reason, you're just as good with kids and politicians.
objects.title: Taming

objects.text:
You are a master of substitution, whether it’s swapping one thing for another or filling in gaps with precision and ease. You can look at any situation, system, or object and identify what can be replaced, adjusted, or exchanged to improve it. 

This skill doesn’t just apply to physical objects you're good at recognizing what can be swapped in any context. Whether it's a broken part in a machine, a missing link in a plan, or a shift in strategy, you know how to fill the void with something that works just as well, or even better.

You’re able to make these substitutions on the fly, seamlessly integrating new elements into the existing structure. This could mean replacing a damaged component in a device without needing a full repair, finding a new tactic mid battle, or even swapping out a character in a team to improve performance. Whatever it is, you’ve got the knack for seeing the gaps and filling them perfectly with the right alternatives.
objects.title: Substitution

objects.text:
You have a natural talent for improving systems, processes, and tasks to their most efficient form. Whether it’s fine-tuning your daily routines, refining a business model, or streamlining a complex project, you know how to make things run smoother and faster with fewer resources.

With this, you can quickly identify inefficiencies and weaknesses in any system, be it mechanical, organizational, or even magical, and apply the best methods to make them more effective. You’re great at finding shortcuts, cutting down on waste, and enhancing performance. From adjusting workflows to designing better systems, your knack for optimization ensures that things get done in the most effective way possible, saving time, effort, and resources.
objects.title: Optimization

objects.text: You know how to find the right people for the job—and how to get them on board. Whether you're assembling a team from scratch or filling in gaps in an existing one, you can identify who has the right mindset, skills, or potential for what needs to be done. You can quickly figure out how to appeal to their motivations, address their doubts, and make your offer sound tempting.
objects.title: Recruitment

objects.text: You’re a savant at creating and using self-made weapons, this doesn’t apply to ‘normal’ stuff like guns, katanas or high-quality materials, instead it applies to all kinds of Improvised Weaponry, from a sharpened rock, a morningstar made of sharp sticks, a baseball with needles, to a slingshot put together with parts you found in the trash. As long as you’ve made it yourself and it doesn’t involve any whole weapons in itself, it qualifies. You’ll be proficient with them as if you’d trained with each one for years and can modify them on the fly, a few minutes in a trash dump and you could be walking out of it with a weapon better than any melee weapon you could buy, or a decent ranged alternative.
objects.title: Weapon Improvisation

objects.text:
You’re a savant at creating and using self-made armor. This doesn’t apply to ‘normal’ stuff like steel cuirasses, leather armor, high-quality materials; instead, it applies to all kinds of Improvised Armor, from a wooden shield with needles, an armor made of books held together by tape, or sharp boots made of metal scraps. 

As long as you’ve made it yourself and it doesn’t involve any whole weapons in itself, it qualifies. You’ll be proficient with them as if you’d trained with each one for years and can modify them on the fly. A few minutes in a trash dump and you could be walking out of it with an entirely different armor than what you went in with or one that you modified to have different options. 

You’re good enough to build small contraptions into them, like a gauntlet that throws out a metal plate or armor you can take off and use as a car jack.
objects.title: Armor Improvisation

objects.text:
You know how to work with little space. Whether it's fitting gear into a backpack, loading supplies into a vehicle, or organizing tools on a shelf, you instinctively know how to arrange things for maximum capacity without sacrificing accessibility.

You’re skilled at folding, stacking, compressing, and aligning in ways others wouldn’t consider. What looks like a tight fit to most is roomy in your hands.
objects.title: Compact

objects.text: You have a good eye for inspecting places and spotting vulnerabilities — weak points in walls, doors, windows, fences, equipment, or layouts that others might overlook. You know how to reinforce, fortify, and set up layered defenses around physical locations, from barriers and locks to patrol routes and structural reinforcements. You understand how intruders think and operate, so you can anticipate break-in methods, sabotage tactics, or bypass tricks before they happen.
objects.title: Security Expertise

addons.title: The Procrastination Monster
addons.text:
Oh no… this is not good.

It seems your Curse of Worldly Distractions has interacted with your Tulpamancy skill in a rather unusual way. As a result, you have accidentally created a “special” tulpa: an entity whose sole purpose in existence is to distract you.

The Procrastination Monster is persistent, creative, and dangerously persuasive. It does not seek to harm you physically or sabotage you directly. Instead, it specializes in irresistible suggestions, brilliant ideas at the worst possible moments, and perfectly timed opportunities that arise exactly when you need to focus the most.

Unlike your other tulpas, you cannot dismiss it at will while your Curse of Worldly Distractions is active. It will manifest whenever you attempt to engage in tasks that require prolonged concentration, using any means available to divert you from your goal.

It possesses its own personality and retains memories of your preferences, insecurities, ambitions, and weaknesses—and it will not hesitate to use them against you. The more important the task, the more persuasive it becomes.

Naturally, it follows the same three exemptions as the Curse of Worldly Distractions: it will not manifest during combat, while you are sleeping, or during intimate relations.

Good luck.

You are going to need it.

objects.text:
Ever wanted an imaginary friend?

You are now skilled in the creation of tulpas, more conventionally known as imaginary friends. You could create them to support or comfort you when you're down, or to help remind you of convictions you've made in the past, among other purposes you might use them for.
objects.title: Tulpamancy

addons.text:
Your social skills have melded together and sublimed into something almost otherworldly, a once-in-a-generational talent for social interactions, able to talk your way into and out of almost any situation. From talking a veteran guard into letting you into the break room of the facility they’re guarding to getting the wealthiest people in the world to give you money for whatever you want with only words and nothing else.

A large part of this comes from your own Self-Awareness, which has allowed you to better understand others; the time it takes per person can differ wildly, but you can come to understand a person so well it would almost seem like you are able to read their minds, predicting their next actions with frightening accuracy, even if it’s only broad strokes, and being able to manipulate them like puppets on strings or work with them in a seamless manner.

Despite whatever appearances, this is a skill and not a power, meaning your effectiveness is affected greatly by the time spent observing someone. The more time you spend with someone, the more you are able to understand them, and by that same metric, the more time away or changes the person goes through, the longer you will need to spend rebuilding your understanding.
addons.title: Awareness of Others

objects.text:
You have an exceptional capacity for self-awareness and introspection. You recognise all your thoughts, feelings, biases and behaviours, intrinsically understand what motivates them and can mindfully reflect on how they shape your personality and actions. 

Due to being so deeply attuned to your desires and character flaws, this insight is notably beneficial in guiding your personal growth, decision making and future interactions. Despite your acute awareness, this will never slip into unhealthy levels of self-consciousness.

This skill also extends to your social self-awareness, helping you comprehend how you are perceived and come across to others. You can adeptly adjust to follow social norms and others’ expectations, letting you navigate interpersonal situations while still being authentically you.
objects.title: Self-Awareness

objects.text:
You have learned a personalized method such as a repetitive sound, a specific breathing pattern, or a physical focal point, to gradually quiet your conscious mind and enter a trance state. In this state, you gain limited access to your own subconscious, allowing you to plant suggestions or create trigger words for yourself. A trigger word established this way might be used to suppress a surge of pain, temporarily block a traumatic memory from conscious thought, or instruct your body to flood itself with adrenaline on command. This doesn’t allow you to do anything you cannot physically do, although you can program yourself to do things you cannot consciously do.

Entering the trance state requires dedicated time and freedom from distraction, and the suggestions you implant are not instantly effective. A single session might produce a faint, barely noticeable result, and for a suggestion to take hold with any reliability, you must repeat the process consistently over days or weeks. Making a change permanent, such as rewiring a habitual reaction or fully compartmentalizing a memory, demands sustained, long-term effort, and even then, the mind's natural resilience means such alterations require periodic reinforcement to remain effective.
objects.title: Self-Hypnosis

objects.text: You find it easy to adapt your knowledge and skills to align with any and all abilities you possess and vice versa, even if they dramatically change your body. Such as using sonic powers to enhance your singing capabilities or using your knowledge of chemistry to help in alchemy.
objects.title: Adaptable Skillset

objects.text:
You lack preconceived notions. You do not rule out anything as being ridiculous or impossible and can easily absorb ideas that others would dismiss out of hand, always keeping an open mind and accepting strange situations or others’ personal idiosyncrasies without judgement or mental stress.

This also means that you pick up on details that others would take for granted, allowing you to consider angles that someone else would have built a resistance to seeing, as well as helping you to see the beauty of the world in little things most people ignore.

This does not impair your ability to apply logic or understand social norms in any way, merely allows you to keep yourself open to alternatives.
objects.title: Tabula Rasa

objects.text:
Your skills, knowledge, and experiences never remain isolated.

Each new discipline you learn naturally integrates with everything you already know, allowing abilities developed in one field to influence and enhance those from entirely different fields.

You do not need to consciously recognize these connections, as your mind and body instinctively absorb the most relevant aspects of each experience and incorporate them into your other abilities. For example, your knowledge of chemistry allows you to cook better by understanding how ingredients interact; your knowledge of botany helps you understand how to care for and cultivate plants, potentially even allowing you to develop a green thumb; and your knowledge of anatomy allows you to draw and sculpt more accurate figures, potentially even creating photorealistic works of art.

Even the most mundane activities can have something to offer, as a skill that seems to have little use on its own can become an important piece when combined with others, allowing small improvements to accumulate and eventually produce capabilities that none of the original skills possessed on their own.

The more experiences you accumulate, the deeper the synergy between them becomes, as learning not merely provide you with new skills—it also transforms, refines, and enhances the abilities you already possess.​
objects.title: Skill Synergy

objects.text:
You know a variety of physical crafting skills at a professional level, such as carpentry, smithing, sewing, electrical engineering, and more. 
You don't know any esoteric crafting skills, but you find it easy to learn new ones.
objects.title: Master Craftsman

addons.text:
Your talents have seamlessly converged, shaping you into the ultimate homemaker—a guardian of heart, family, and home. With the ability to provide guidance and support to all the wayward souls you hold dear, offering them the sanctuary they seek. Your home becomes a haven of comfort—where loved ones can rest their weary heads and find the encouragement they need to rise again.

The meals that you prepare transcend nourishment; they soothe the mind and heart, offering a quieting balm for life's troubles. Within your hearth, you foster healing—not just of the body but of the spirit, gently mending the wounds of those you cherish over time. With a steady hand, you can mediate conflicts, bringing harmony to any discord within your family.

You are more than a provider or caretaker; you are the heart of your hearth, the unwavering center of warmth and strength that binds your family together.
addons.title: Hearth Maker

addons.text:
Home management is the art of efficiently managing all available resources—time, money, space, and effort—to meet the needs of the household’s inhabitants.

Thanks to your Home Management skills, you know how to use the minimum amount of supplies and effort to get what you need, making what you already have last longer; as well as identifying which aspects of the home can be improved and how to do so without compromising other aspects of it.

On top of this, this add-on also allows you to instinctively notice when something is out of place or missing in your home and clearly discern whether it’s a simple oversight, an accidental loss, or even intentional theft.

As a result of all this, your skills in cleaning and home maintenance are now on par with those of a Master Housekeeper with a lifetime of experience and innate talent—and with growth potential that could even surpass them!
addons.title: Home Management

addons.text:
Your skills no longer operate in isolation; you have learned to integrate household maintenance with animal care and gardening.

You now have a natural talent for organizing your home in a way that allows you to maintain a small garden or home-grown plot; whether on a balcony, by a window, or in any small, well-used corner, you can always find a space for your plants. 

This also comes with a degree of knowledge and experience in indoor agriculture, allowing you to help your plants grow using methods such as vertical structures, urban farming, or hydroponics, as well as small home remedies that make plant care easier: from using crushed eggshells to provide calcium to certain species, reusing coffee grounds as an effective fertilizer, to preparing natural infusions that help control insect pests.

On the animal side, you are now capable of giving them the best possible life as pets: you not only know how to train them with patience and consistency, but also how to fully integrate them into household life, help them overcome experiences of abuse or past abandonment, and guide them to adapt calmly and safely to their domestic environment.

And thanks to this good relationship with them, you no longer need to worry about them damaging your plants; in fact, far from causing problems, your pets can even help protect them within the limits of their natural behavior: domestic birds can help scare away flying insects, cats can keep rodents that might harm your crops under control, and dogs can deter birds that try to take from your plants to build their nests.

Finally, in the same way as with plants, you have acquired practical knowledge of home remedies and basic care for your animals, whether to relieve common discomforts, such as preparing gentle chamomile infusions for mild digestive issues, or to make them more comfortable, like oatmeal baths for irritated skin.
addons.title: Home Remedies & Little Joys
Pillar of the Community
addons.text:
You have extended the concept of home beyond its walls, your instinct for caring, organizing, and protecting now applies to entire communities, allowing you to transform groups of people into a united family.

You gain an intuitive understanding of a community's needs, from resource distribution and space organization to the physical and emotional well-being of its members, allowing you to recognize what is missing for a place to truly become a home and find practical ways to address those needs.

Your presence helps create an environment of trust and cooperation, allowing people who live or work alongside you to feel that they belong to something greater and making it easier for them to support one another and build strong relationships.

You can establish community care systems, such as neighborhood support networks, efficient supply distribution, shared spaces, and methods to maintain a safe, clean, and welcoming environment.

Additionally, your talent for maintaining homes extends to larger spaces: shelters, villages, neighborhoods, and settlements can all benefit from your ability to transform ordinary places into environments where people can live, rest, and thrive.

You are no longer simply someone who maintains a house; you are someone who helps create a home for everyone.

objects.text:
You have mastered a range of housekeeping skills that enable you to keep your home spotless and comfortable, such as washing clothes, scrubbing dishes, wiping furniture, organizing, and more. You are not familiar with any esoteric cleaning skills, but you have a knack for picking up new skills and knowledge about anything related to maintenance or sanitation.

Even if you have this, you can still be lazy. But with this, you will clean much faster and more organized than you could before.
objects.title: Master Housekeeper

addons.text:
You now possess extensive knowledge in foraging, cultivating, and utilizing a wide variety of herbs, plants, mushrooms, and other natural flora—as well as select types of fauna—commonly used in traditional medicine.

Among your newfound repertoire is the refined knowledge and skill to accurately identify and prepare natural ingredients for treating wounds, illnesses, and a wide variety of other ailments. You're also well-versed in crafting herbal blends, traditional remedies, natural medicines, and dyes—and even in ways to safely employ certain typically toxic or poisonous substances to create rare or specialized treatments for more complex conditions.
addons.title: Natural Remedies

objects.text: You know how to do basic first-aid. You know stuff like mouth-to-mouth, how to stop bleeding, and how to stop someone from biting their tongue off from pain. You have a college 101 course-level knowledge of both biology and anatomy. You find learning further about these subjects to be easy.
objects.title: First-Aid

objects.text: You are capable of operating any land vehicle, sea vessel, or aircraft with the exception of especially exotic Tinkertech vehicles.
objects.title: Driving

objects.text: You know how to pickpocket. This gives you moderate skill at stealth and sleight of hand.
objects.title: Pickpocketing

objects.text: You know how to lipread. Now even if you're deafened, you can get a grasp on what people are saying.
objects.title: Lipreading

objects.text: You can type at an impressive speed of approximately 500 characters per minute. Additionally, you have an intuitive understanding of the layout of every key on a standard QWERTY keyboard, as well as various other keyboard types, both common and setting specific, on your choice.
objects.title: Typing

objects.text: You know all the common slang to your chosen setting. This is mostly useless if you chose Reincarnate or Character-Insert, though a loner or sufficiently young or old person might not know the slang.
objects.title: Setting Specific Slang

objects.text: You are now a certified gamer with the skills and knowledge to rival the best e-sports professionals and speedrunners in any video game you've played. Even in games you've just picked up, your skill will already be above average, and you'll quickly improve to match the top players.
objects.title: Pro Gamer

addons.text: Whenever you enter a new world, you gain a basic understanding of its common sense—allowing you to blend in as an average citizen, no matter how strange or alien the setting. You also develop a weak intuition for interacting with unfamiliar common day-to-day tools and conveniences. While you won’t gain deep knowledge or technical expertise, you’ll at least know how to send a message through a holophone or swipe a magical bus card for a flying bus without fumbling. However, this only covers the essentials—more complex systems or obscure tools can still trip you up.
addons.title: A Traveler’s Guide

objects.text: You gain the common sense of this world, encompassing social norms, taboos, customs, and unspoken rules that govern daily interactions and societal behavior. This knowledge is redundant if you reincarnated, but may be useful for younger people or drop-ins. It ensures you can navigate social situations smoothly, avoid faux pas, and integrate more seamlessly into your new environment. This gives you understanding over etiquette, recognizing appropriate behavior in various contexts, or being aware of sensitive topics to avoid.
objects.title: Common Sense

addons.text: Your skills in Dramatics and Presentation have soared to elevate your arts to heights rarely, if ever, seen before. Your visual skills evolve to create photorealistic paintings that spark debates over whether someone is smiling or not, buildings that are pleasing to look at and comfortable to live in, designs that will be referenced for decades to come, and truly eldritch landscapes that appear real to those who see them. Your literary skills advance as you create characters and stories that entice people into the worlds you write about. Short poems that resonate with aspects of the human soul or entire series that make readers wish they were a part of those worlds are mere examples of what you can craft. Your performing skills become mesmerizing—whether playing a role so convincingly that others believe it is real, even those who know you're acting can’t help but feel that you’ve been subsumed by the role, or your dances, which become almost hypnotic, drawing the gaze of all around you, even those who are not human. All of these are just examples of the wonders and horrors you can bring to the world as one of the greatest artists—if not of all time, then at least in recent generations. If you have the Auteur addon, then all your artistic skills will feed into one another, making you possibly the greatest artist the world has ever seen, with your name known far and wide.
addons.title: Greatest Content Creator

objects.text:
You have a way with your words and actions. Regardless of what you do, you can make it look and sound good.

If you're a Hero, Villain, or public figure, you're likely to be one of the more popular ones.
objects.title: Presentation

addons.title: Open Book
addons.text:
Every detail you examine about a person, no matter how small or great, become pieces of a puzzle that quickly form an unnervingly accurate picture of the subject. Whether you've exchanged a few simple words or passively observe their actions, you know exactly what to look for to determine how a person ticks, and if that's not enough, they can just as easily reveal their inner world to you without even realizing. 

This works best when you have actual evidence or reference to work with, as you are not a mind-reader.

objects.text: Without prior knowledge, you can quickly obtain a great deal of information by analyzing the person's body language, age, clothing or fashion, hairstyle...
objects.title: Cold Reading

addons.text:
It is always best to handle things cleanly and peacefully, but unfortunately, people sometimes have information that you absolutely need, but are completely unwilling to share it or even speak to you.

However, you know how to make people talk when words alone fail, and it is time to break out the...enhanced interrogation tools. From medieval racks and thumb screws to more modern methods like electricity and waterboarding, and even unconventional and less directly damaging methods like sleep deprivation, you are skilled in their implementation and a master in the field of breaking people down, knowing exactly how to maximize effectiveness while ensuring your target doesn't escape into the Great Beyond. This aptitude also means that you'd also be the one called when a message must be hammered in or a truly memorable example made of someone.

And while normally the veracity of the information acquired with such methods is...hit and miss at best, you have a near-supernatural gift to know when someone's telling you the truth, when they're intentionally trying to mislead you, and when they're just desperately telling you whatever it is they think you want to hear.

It's a dirty job, but unfortunately, there are times when someone has to do it.
addons.title: Enhanced Interrogation

objects.text: You can extract any information you want from anyone without them realizing they've given it up. Your subtle manipulation and charm make others willingly divulge their deepest secrets and desires to you.
objects.title: Information Extraction

addons.title: Humanitarian Relief
addons.text:
Your talents have come together with a singular purpose: preserving lives and restoring stability in times of crisis.

You can rapidly assess the needs of the affected population, identify those requiring immediate attention, and determine the best way to distribute limited resources such as food, water, medicine, shelter, and personnel; even under immense pressure, you remain calm and make clear decisions, allowing those around you to cooperate instead of falling into panic or disorder.

Your communication and leadership skills inspire trust among volunteers, professionals, and survivors alike, facilitating cooperation between them, while your talent for mediation helps resolve conflicts and keeps relief efforts focused on their objectives, and your ability to treat the injured and sick, combined with your management skills, allows you to attend to their needs without neglecting those of the rest of the affected population.

You are also capable of establishing distribution systems, coordinating teams, and improvising solutions with the resources at hand, turning improvised shelters into organized and safe spaces, keeping supply chains operating efficiently even under adverse conditions, and making the most of the resources available.

Whether facing natural disasters, epidemics, armed conflicts, or any other humanitarian emergency, you possess an intuitive understanding of how to organize and coordinate relief efforts quickly and effectively, and although you cannot solve every problem or save everyone, your presence will undoubtedly increase the chances that the affected population can endure hardship, regain stability, and begin rebuilding their lives.

objects.text: You’re a master, or talented at least, at managing. You can coach and manage teams, businesses, organizations, or individual schedules. Bearing an astute mastery of associated management skills, techniques, speech, and body language, your range goes from logistics and plans to resources in the most optimal manner. You can additionally put your talents at your disposal, using them to administer your time, workload, and other qualities relating to yourself to raise your efficacy and be an effective go-getter.
objects.title: Management

objects.text: You’re a master at any and all forms of tax evasion, from hiding your income to knowing how much you can push the envelope before you look suspicious, and exactly what tax forms you should be using to throw off your local revenue agency, you’re a master at it all.
objects.title: Tax Evasion

addons.text:
Thanks to both your knowledge of biology and mechanics, you are able to minimize the effects your constructions can have on the environment around you, maximizing the eco-friendliness of your creations as you gain a greater insight into how the natural world around you can help improve your construction.

And just as you gain greater insight into using the natural environment to improve and fortify your constructions, you also gain greater insight into what you can build to aid in the growth and balance of nature, such as creating dams to help sustain a part of a forest or preserve a local animal species.
addons.title: Nature Friendly

objects.text:
You’re a skilled builder, whether it’s a house, bridge, or city infrastructure. You understand the best practices and methods for constructing anything, ensuring projects are efficient, stable, and practical. From selecting the right materials to determining the proper techniques, you can design and build with confidence.

Your expertise allows you to plan out projects thoroughly, visualizing the entire process before lifting a tool. You know how to optimize every step, whether it's creating a solid foundation or ensuring a structure’s durability over time. This extends to all types of construction, including large-scale infrastructure, and ensures everything you build will stand strong and serve its purpose.
objects.title: Construction

objects.text:
Paperwork, regulations, and endless procedures— where most people see a nightmare, you see a well-oiled machine just waiting to be used right. You know how to navigate bureaucracy like a pro, cutting through red tape, filing the right forms, and getting approvals with barely a hassle. Permits, contracts, legal loopholes—you understand them all, and can make them work in your favor.

You don’t get stuck in the system, you ARE the system. You know who to talk to, what to file, and how to make things move faster when they need to. If there’s a way to push something through without raising alarms, you’ll find it. If someone tries to drown you in rules and policies, you’ll turn it right back on them. Whether you're running an empire, avoiding fines, or just making sure things get done your way, you always know the right steps to take.
objects.title: Red Tape Wizard

objects.text:
You have a keen understanding of how to manage and optimize the flow of goods, resources, and people, whether it’s for a small-scale project or large-scale operation. You know how to plan, coordinate, and move things efficiently, ensuring that everything gets to where it needs to be on time and without unnecessary waste.

This skill helps you manage supply chains, organize transportation, and handle inventory with ease. You can track resources, predict shortages or bottlenecks, and come up with quick solutions to keep everything running smoothly. Whether it’s moving goods across a city, planning military deployments, or organizing a complex event, you can maximize efficiency, minimize waste, and ensure that everything is in the right place at the right time.
objects.title: Logistics

addons.text:
You are on the level of a dedicated financial planner, possessing the foresight to navigate personal and business finances with confidence. 

You gain an intuitive grasp of long-term financial strategy, allowing you to plan beyond simple budgeting. Retirement funds, tax optimisation, and wealth-building techniques become second nature, ensuring your money works for you efficiently. You can assess debt structures, investment opportunities, and risk management strategies with a keen eye, minimising financial pitfalls and maximising stability.
addons.title: Financial Planning

addons.text: You have a natural talent for finding value where others see none. Discounts, deals, and lucrative side hustles practically fall into your lap, allowing you to stretch every dollar and turn overlooked opportunities into steady profit. Whether it’s haggling for the best price, spotting trends before they take off, or repurposing discarded items into something useful, you always make the most of what’s available.
addons.title: Hustler

addons.text: You have an innate ability to keep your home organised, efficient, and low-maintenance while staying within budget. Clutter naturally disappears under your care, as you instinctively know what to keep, repurpose, or discard. Storage is optimised, and wasted space is a thing of the past. Additionally, you possess a knack for minor home repairs, allowing you to fix small issues like squeaky doors, leaky faucets, or loose furniture without outside help. Your spending habits align with a clean and functional lifestyle, preventing impulse buys and unnecessary accumulation of household items.
addons.title: Practical Minimalist

objects.text: You gain an intuitive understanding of managing money wisely, covering everything from grocery shopping to long-term financial planning. This ensures you can budget effectively, compare prices, and make cost-efficient choices without falling for marketing tricks or impulse buys. You’ll naturally track expenses, avoid unnecessary debt, and maximise savings. Whether it’s stretching a paycheck, recognising the best time to buy essentials, or planning for future financial stability, this skill keeps you financially grounded.
objects.title: Financial Savvy

objects.text:
You can swim like a professional.

You expertly synchronize your breathing with your movements, allowing you to swim long distances without fatigue. You know how to hold your breath for extended periods and maintain buoyancy, controlling your body in the water with the same confidence as on land.

You are well-versed in aquatic environments, knowing where it is safe to swim, what hidden dangers may lie beneath the depths, and how to properly explore the underwater world.
objects.title: Swimming

objects.text:
You've got yourself a natural talent for nurturing plants and gardening. A knack that lets you—at a glance, tell you if something is amiss with the flora under your care, picking up on the subtle clues that reveal what may be wrong with, or negatively impacting the growth of plants under your care.

You can then use these clues to determine what steps are needed to ensure their well-being—whether it's adjusting the nutrient composition of the soil, finding the ideal balance of sunlight and shade, or simply fine-tuning the moisture level, etc.

Alongside this, you gain the added skills of a seasoned gardener and landscaper, capable of tending to a vast array of plants—and should you encounter a plant you are unfamiliar with, you can make an educated guess on how to take care of the plant, based on other plants that grow within the same biome. With that foundation, you can quickly work out how to nurture these new plants.
objects.title: Green Thumb/Gardener

objects.text:
You are a professional sound imitator. 
Your control over breath, rhythm, and articulation allows you to create complex sound compositions using only your voice.

With a little effort, you can precisely reproduce any sound you've heard, as long as it is within your biological capabilities. 
Your sharp hearing allows you to flawlessly mimic rhythms, bass, percussion, and vocal effects, turning your voice into a full-fledged musical instrument.

This also makes you a master of beatboxing.
objects.title: Sound Imitator

objects.text: You have an advanced understanding of balance—socially, strategically, and emotionally. You know how to keep things from tipping too far in any direction, whether it's calming a heated argument, keeping a group on task without burnout, or managing power and responsibility within a team. You can recognize when things are escalating too quickly, or stagnating, and you know how to step in at just the right time to nudge everything back on track.
objects.title: Moderator

objects.text: You have a great understanding of how media works—its rhythms, language, and influence. Whether it’s traditional news, digital platforms, or social media, you understand how to craft a message that lands, spreads, and shapes perception. You know what content draws eyes, what headlines stick, and how to control the narrative. From managing PR crises to launching viral campaigns, you can leverage media tools to your advantage and steer public sentiment smoothly.
objects.title: Media

objects.text:
You are now extremely talented in all aspects of the agricultural branch that concerns animals, including day-to-day care, selective breeding, management, nutrition, and livestock raising. 

With but a glance, you can tell if anything is amiss with your animals and will instinctively know the proper steps to help them. 

This talent extends to not just herbivores, but also carnivores and omnivores.
objects.title: Animal Husbandry

objects.text:
You can now more accurately perceive and interpret your surroundings—observing people, assessing potential hazards or threats, and understanding the situation you're in. This heightened awareness allows you to better evaluate your environment, anticipate hidden dangers, and respond effectively.

This applies equally in high-stakes combat zones and subtle social settings, enabling you to "read the room" and respond appropriately. By picking up on cues, recognizing patterns, and anticipating outcomes, you can make faster, more informed decisions in any dynamic situation that you've found yourself in.
objects.title: Situational Awareness

addons.title: Wayfinder
addons.text: You know how to move, whether it's climbing up a wall, swimming across a lake or running through a city. This knowledge of physical movement augments your navigating abilities, allowing you to find and traverse paths that would be absurd to regular people.

objects.text:
You know how to find your way, no matter where you are. Dense forest, unfamiliar city, open ocean, or winding dungeon—it doesn’t matter. You can chart a path, read the terrain, and adjust on the fly with minimal delay or confusion.

You know how to make sense of terrain, landmarks, and patterns. If there’s a shortcut, you’ll find it. If the main route is blocked, you’ll know how to reroute without wasting time or getting lost. Even in unfamiliar territory, you'll rarely second-guess where you’re going.
objects.title: Navigator

objects.text: You are good at brewing, whether it’s potions, alcohol, medicine, or anything that needs to be mixed, steeped, and perfected. You understand how ingredients interact over time, how heat, pressure, or fermentation can change a result, and how to tweak a process for a stronger effect, smoother taste, or longer shelf life. You can improvise recipes when resources are limited, and you will rarely waste a batch. You know how to make your brews consistent, potent, and tailored exactly for the purpose at hand.
objects.title: Brewer

objects.text: You know how to analyze a subject in depth and determine its merits and faults objectively, without any interference from biases. As well as how to articulate these findings in a way that's understood and beneficial for all parties involved.
objects.title: Critic

addons.text:
Your awareness of both your Internal Self and the External World has compounded with your discipline, as you not only know what you want but have a greater idea of how to go about it, this combination of skills giving a profound improvement to your quality of life as you find numerous things being a touch easier in your day-to-day life with overall improvements.

Training and study become easier as your understanding of yourself lets you find areas where you may be falling short or having trouble grasping, and taking the steps to correct or circumvent the issue, and when the issue is external, such as a bad teacher, you will be able to pick up on the issue and have an idea of where to get the guidance and mentorship you need. Along with being able to find a style that suits you best after learning the fundamentals.

You don't gain more opportunities; rather, you become more acutely aware of those that already exist, whether they are plain to see or require just a bit of effort on your part to create through interacting with others, with your own self-awareness giving you some deeper idea of others. You become more aware of manipulation, being better able to tell who and how someone is trying to manipulate you personally, and how to manipulate others in turn, while hypnosis, subliminal messaging, and mental powers have a harder time trying to grasp you.

But the greatest benefit is the strengthening of your other skills, giving you a seeming talent that equates to years of practical experience with your other Skills, not due to empowering the skills themselves but putting you in a better place to make use of this knowledge.
addons.title: Betterment Foundation

objects.text:
You reap what you sow. You understand this better than anyone, making you stay focused on your goals and block out distractions no matter what external or internal factors befall you. Save for anything truly debilitating. 

This doesn't grant you the willpower to strive for said goals, simply the mindset to be consistent.
objects.title: Discipline

objects.text:
You are a master musician—a true virtuoso. You possess an innate and perfected understanding of music in all its forms. You can pick up and expertly play any musical instrument as if you’ve practiced it for a lifetime. Whether it’s strings, percussion, wind, brass, or digital instruments, your muscle memory and intuitive musical sense let you adapt instantly.

Your grasp of melody, rhythm, harmony, and improvisation is flawless, allowing you to compose, perform, and innovate across any musical genre or style with ease. You can play by ear, transcribe anything you hear, and turn even chaotic noise into coherent, beautiful music. Your performances resonate deeply, stirring emotion in anyone who listens.
objects.title: Virtuoso

objects.text:
Your visualisation skills have been enhanced to the point that you can now visualize with great detail, even if you were completely incapable of it before.

For example, you can visualize an apple with as much clarity as if you were physically seeing it.
objects.title: Visualisation

addons.title: Joestar Secret Technique
addons.text:
You have learned the secret technique of the Joestar family, one passed down for generations. It is their last resort, an all or nothing gambit, the final move they pull out when a fight seems unwinnable. Now, run for your life!

You know exactly when you should run away instead of staying to fight, the perfect moment to flee. After executing this technique, things will go slightly in your favor in order to preserve your life.

objects.text:
You can run like a professional.
