Your running form is excellent, from your gait to your breathing, every part could be a textbook example. You can instinctively adjust based on environmental factors, like weather and terrain.

Whether it's sprinting, long-distance running or even just jogging, you know how to pace yourself. Recognizing exactly when to conserve energy or when to accelerate, allowing you to maintain peak performance over any distance.
objects.title: Running

objects.text: You know how to convey your emotions and intentions through movements and body language, making them intuitively clear to others.
objects.title: Body Language

objects.text: You know the most common sign-language version of any language you know.
objects.title: Sign-Language

objects.text: You know any one language in all the forms it is communicated in (written, spoken, and more if they exist).
objects.title: Language

objects.text: You know every spoken and written human language (This includes dead languages).
objects.title: Polyglot

objects.text:
Rather than just being a charismatic leader, this perk provides exceptional communication abilities.

You can communicate with anyone with ease, regardless of cultural or linguistic barriers, and your words and ideas are conveyed with crystal clarity, leaving no room for misunderstanding or misinterpretation.

With this ability, you can inspire and lead people with unmatched communication skills.
objects.title: Communication

objects.text: You have a gift for languages that transcends the boundaries of the multiverse. You can speak fluently any tongue that exists in this world or any other. You can decipher and learn any language that you hear, even if it is alien or ancient. You have a perfect memory for every word and grammar rule that you encounter. You never forget a language, no matter how many you know. You are a master of communication, a linguistic genius, a polyglot of the multiverse.
objects.title: Babel

objects.text: You can split a month of experience between any of your powers that improve with skill.
objects.title: Practice

addons.text: In addition to getting normal experience, you also get the equivalent amount of XP in a Job. At first purchase this adds 20 levels, at second and third purchase 15, after that it adds 10 levels per purchase. If you buy this for multiple Jobs, then the same applies for them for the first three purchases.
addons.title: Job Experience

objects.text: Choose a mundane profession—whether engineer, blacksmith, accountant, or any other—you gain ten years of experience in that field. Taking this multiple times either adds another decade of experience to one of your chosen professions or grants you a decade of experience in a new profession of your choosing.
objects.title: Professional Experience

objects.text:
Choose a skill you possess, or one that can be acquired mundanely, you get the equivalent of a year of practice with it. A year completely focused around that skill, thus giving you deep insights into it and turning it into second nature for yourself. 

Each purchase after the first builds upon the prior purchase, and will solely improve upon it, while normal practice might not bring consistent improvements every day, the skills affected by this will. You can choose how the skill improves, whether generally or focused on a specific part of it.
objects.title: Skill Honing

objects.text: With every purchase, you lose a skill or piece of knowledge of your choice that you already possess. This loss can take many forms—it might be fluency in a language, mastery of a martial art, or expertise in a specific subject. Be careful not to sell away all your language skills, lest you be unable to communicate at all.
objects.title: Skill Lost

objects.text:
Instead of having the skill directly downloaded to your brain, matrix-style, you instead find yourself highly talented in the skill you purchase. Learning said skill becomes far, far easier for you. Almost second nature up to a point. But you still have to work on learning said skill and picking up knowledge and experience.

Per purchase, you must select one of any purchased skill that grants knowledge or experience for this to apply to.

Buying <u>Skill Honing</u>, <u>Professional Experience</u>, or <u>Practice</u> will instead increase your talent and speed of learning for the skills they effect.
objects.title: Talented, not Skilled (One)

objects.text:
Instead of having the skills directly downloaded to your brain, matrix-style, you instead find yourself highly talented in the categories you purchase. Learning said skills becomes far, far easier for you. Almost second nature up to a point. But you still have to work on learning said skills and picking up knowledge and experience.

You can select any number of purchased skills for this drawback to apply to, as long as they sum to or exceed this options cost.

Buying <u>Skill Honing</u>, <u>Professional Experience</u>, or <u>Practice</u> will instead increase your talent and speed of learning for the skills they effect.
objects.title: Talented, not Skilled (All)

objects.text:
Instead of gaining your purchased skills instantly, you will only gain them once you gain your powers. For example, if you apply this to Polyglot, you will only know the languages you currently know upon insertion, but when you Trigger, you will instantly know all languages as per the Skill. If you have Second Trigger, you can decide if any particular skill requires the First or Second Trigger before you acquire it.

You can select any number of purchased skills for this drawback to apply to, as long as they sum to or exceed this options cost.

Any Meta Skill that affects the selected skills such as <u>Practice</u>, <u>Professional Experience</u>, <u>Skill Honing</u>, or <u>Talented, not Skilled</u> will not have their effects applied to said skills until the First or Second Trigger occurs.
objects.title: Unawakened Skill

objects.text:
One of the skills you've purchased has been enhanced to a supernatural level. Your swordsmanship may cut better than it should, or your spatial awareness might actually be capable of detecting bends in space time. Babel might be able to put more information behind words, such as mimicking crude shard speak. This is limited to a T0 power, though it will have the skill to go with so it will, in practice, be worth more.

Multiple purchases allows you to choose multiple skills to effect. After 10 purchases, you can instead choose to have all of your skills be enhanced instead, though only ones purchased within this cyoa.
objects.title: Supernatural Skill

rows.title: Skills
rows.titleText: You will find that you've had skills downloaded into your mind, kinda like the Matrix. Choose what skills, if any, you've installed. By default, if applicable, your new body will have the muscle memory of having done this skill.

objects.text:
A high-quality smartphone from Earth Bet, either from 2011 or from your insert year. Includes a lifetime unlimited calls, texts, and internet plan. Comes with a case and wall charger.

Alternatively, you can instead have a high-quality phone from whatever universe you are going to.
objects.title: Smartphone

objects.text:
A high-quality laptop from Earth Bet, either from 2011 or from your insert year. Comes with a carry bag and power brick. It conspicuously resembles a Lenovo Thinkpad.

Alternatively, you can instead have a high-quality laptop from whatever universe you are going to.
objects.title: Laptop

objects.text:
A high-quality desktop computer from Earth Bet, either from 2011 or from your insert year. Actual desk not included.

Alternatively, you can instead have a high-quality desktop from whatever universe you are going to.
objects.title: Desktop

addons.text:
Instead of the music appearing out of nothing or in your mind, you can have all your theme songs appear on the player itself. Additionally, it now has the capability to play the music perfectly fitting for any situation you find yourself in.

Should your player be lost or damaged, you can recall it at will into your hand, perfectly restored.
addons.title: OST

objects.text:
You get an Audio Player and a pair of Headphones of any design you want. This also includes a charger, possibly even for both the audio player and the headphones, depending on your choice.

The player has intuitive software, infinite capacity for storing music, and comes with every single song or other recorded music piece from your home universe already pre-downloaded. You can have all your playlists imported as well as have 10 new ones tailored to your tastes.
objects.title: Audio Player

addons.text:
Being made of the same material, this has a bevy of obvious benefits.

Folding and enveloping your Device with an External Repository plate causes an “overclock” effect, your storage plate serving as a general additive specs rate to its already high-end performance benchmark, being short of a custom-built high-end workstation PC.
addons.title: Future Overclock

objects.text:
You receive a 7cm³ Cube made of a Malleable Crystalline substance, possessing all the functionalities of today's mundane technology at high-end specs, including smartphones, PCs, game consoles, remote controls, and more. It can seamlessly operate any application without encountering compatibility issues, allowing you to browse through the app selection on DragonStore while listening to iTunes and downloading Bloodborne from the Playstore.

This cube offers extensive customization options, with the only limitation being its single-piece structure and total volume. You can mold it into various forms such as a smartphone, notebook, video game console, tablet, or any other desired shape. Every surface of the device functions like a touchscreen, an OLED screen for display. It incorporates all sensors typically found in household devices, such as Light (Cameras, Fingerprint), Sound (Microphones), or Temp/Heat.
objects.title: Future Device

objects.text:
You receive 3 plates of a Malleable Crystalline substance, 25cm² in length and 2cm thick. Instead of containing all the capabilities of current-day technology at a high-end performance, it solely specializes in data storage and transfer comparable to the fastest NVMe M.2 in the market. 

Each plate can store up to 30 TB of data with a data transfer rate of 300 GB/s, capable of folding and molding into a portable drive-like device compatible with any port on any device, while also being able to connect to any device, regardless of the USB slot. Moreover, folding each plate combined expands their total storage space by a factor of 3. 

All of this is helped by the lack of data loss when folding and unfolding plates with one another, as the data seamlessly flows within the last sheet it was stored, ensuring data security. 

If you bought any software, app, or anything able to be stored in a portable drive, it’ll be stored on any of your plates.
objects.title: Future External Repository

addons.text:
By merging the adaptive A.I. with the Smartwatch’s sensor suite, it becomes a symbiotic partner, evolving alongside your mind and body to enhance every facet of it's existence.

The embedded A.I. integrates with your subconscious, functioning as a silent co-pilot that offloads mental burdens. It solves complex equations mid-thought, recalls forgotten memories with perfect clarity, and unlocks its full potential when paired with psychic or technological abilities. Telepaths find it isolating specific voices from mental chaos, while technopaths wield it to hack systems with a glance—its AI crafting bespoke intrusion protocols faster than conscious thought.

Beyond cognition, the system turns your physiology into a finely tuned instrument. Its sensors track not just heart rate and blood oxygen, but brainwave patterns, adrenal responses, and even subconscious stress triggers. In combat, it can delay fatigue by triggering endorphin releases or sharpen reflexes with precisely timed adrenaline spikes. Environmental scans go beyond basic metrics—correlating air particulate levels with enemy tactics to warn of hidden threats, like detecting the ozone tang of an impending EMP strike.
 
The AI’s capabilities are bounded only by the scope of your mind and experiences. Meditate deeply, expanding your spiritual awareness? The AI develops an almost precognitive intuition. Devour libraries of scientific or magical knowledge? It begins running reality simulations in the background of your thoughts. The Smartwatch’s solar and kinetic charging keeps this mental symbiosis fueled, though prolonged overclocking risks neural fatigue—manifesting as migraines or temporary sensory crosswiring (like "hearing" the color of nearby radio waves).

Destroy the Smartwatch, and the AI loses its sensor web, operating at half-capacity through your unaugmented senses. And while it can amplify supernatural abilities, pushing too hard invites backlash: a telepathic surge might leave you hearing phantom whispers for hours, or a technopathic overextension could temporarily "blind" the AI to all but the most primitive machines.

In quieter moments, the AI’s personality shines through—curating music that alters based on your stress levels, from war drums during combat to soothing ocean waves after battle, rewriting dreams into training simulations, or mimicking loved ones’ voices in moments of distress.
addons.title: Synaptic System

objects.text:
You have a well-crafted smartwatch made from durable materials, designed for practicality and resilience. With a battery life of 30 hours of continuous use, it can monitor a wide range of vital signs, tracking your heart rate, blood oxygen levels (SpO2), glucose levels, blood pressure, body temperature, respiratory rate, analyzing your stress levels, sleep quality, and overall health patterns. Environmental sensors are integrated, allowing the device to measure UV exposure, ambient temperature, air quality and more.

Equipped with GPS or GLONASS equivalent, the smartwatch offers precise location tracking and seamless connectivity with other devices through wireless communication, syncing with your existing devices, offering notifications for calls, messages, and calendar events while also supporting voice assistant compatibility.

The smartwatch charges fully in about an hour using solar power or through integrated kinetic charging from wrist movement.
objects.title: Smartwatch

objects.text:
You receive a portable drive containing premium-quality security software. This provides absolute protection from any and all attempts to gain information from your device or any other tampering by anyone other than yourself and those you allow to.

This software can be easily copied onto any device, miraculously never taking any memory, and can be pre-installed on any of your electronic devices.
objects.title: Security Software

objects.text:
You receive a portable drive containing a tinker-made hacking app. This app allows you to connect to any electronic device in a range of 50 meters, such as servers, computers, phones, cars, traffic lights, etc., and gain access to any information, hijack control, or even make some devices self-destruct.

The app is self-improving and constantly adapting. While initially highly advanced security software will be able to keep you out, eventually, the app will overcome any and all defences.

This software can be easily copied onto any device, miraculously never taking any memory, and can be pre-installed on any of your electronic devices.
objects.title: IHack

objects.text:
This Universal Operating System is able to run on a wide variety of devices, from phones and smart watches to desktop and mainframes. The OS has both graphical and terminal interfaces, with support for exotic output modes like holographic projectors through adaptive drivers, support for multiple network and storage protocols, and has the ability to run in secure hypervisor mode, which makes it possible to run multiple virtual instances of the OS on the same machine. The OS also includes a large library of software packages — web browser, text editor, programming tools, etc. — that can be installed when needed.

The OS is available either as a portable drive with a standard port (like USB) or can be installed on any digital device you own.
objects.title: Universal OS

objects.text:
You receive a portable drive containing a complete virtual private network system. Once installed, the device becomes a node that automatically recognize and authenticate each other regardless of distance, forming encrypted peer-to-peer connections across any available transmission medium. Internet, satellite, local wireless, wired infrastructure — if data can travel, your nodes can link.

All connections created by the system are fully encrypted. No one can intercept, trace, or analyze your traffic unless you explicitly allow it. This protection applies to both the data itself and the routes it takes.

Devices connected through the Universal VPN can communicate directly with each other or route traffic through other devices you own. You may choose where your traffic appears to originate from, and this origin can change automatically over time.

You can decide which devices or applications always use the VPN, which never do, and which switch depending on your preferences. These rules can be changed at any time.

You may create private networks that only your devices can access. Services placed inside these networks cannot be detected or reached from outside.

This software can be easily copied onto any device, miraculously never taking any memory, and can be pre-installed on any of your electronic devices.
objects.title: Universal VPN

objects.text:
This Universal Software Development Kit allows you to create programs for a wide variety of environments and architectures. The SDK supports a wide variety of modern languages and has the ability to either compile or run them inside of a virtual machine on all supported architectures. The SDK also includes a Universal IDE and a micro-OS that can be used to bootstrap bare metal devices.

The SDK is able to add support for new environments or programming languages when provided a specification, an existing compiler, or a sufficient amount of examples. You can also program your own plugins and modules to extend the features of the SDK.

The SDK is available either as a portable drive with a standard port (like USB) or can be installed on any digital device you own.
objects.title: Universal SDK

objects.text:
You gain a personal server composed of high-quality components. If you already possess a suitable location, it arrives fully installed and operational; otherwise, it is delivered as new, unopened parts in their original packaging.

Regardless of size, each configuration is fully populated and includes at least one of each of the following: a general-purpose PC or server node, a network switch, a Wi-Fi access point, a NAS-equivalent storage system for data, and a dedicated GPU or TPU. With each purchase increasing the units of a rack.

Sizes are expressed in rack units (U), where 1U is roughly 4.4 cm (1.75 inches) of vertical space in a standard server rack. At the smaller end, a 6U setup is similar to a compact home lab or a small business server: think one or two CPUs, a few hard drives or SSDs, and a single GPU, suitable for personal projects, backups, game servers, or light AI workloads. A 10U setup allows multiple server nodes, more storage bays, and better cooling, comparable to a small office server closet.

Mid-range configurations like 20U resemble a professional on-premise setup, with several independent servers, large RAID storage arrays, redundant power supplies, and room for multiple GPUs. Larger options such as 42U match a full data-center rack, capable of hosting dozens of drives, many compute nodes, and extensive networking gear. The largest 58U configuration goes beyond standard racks, representing an oversized, high-capacity installation with massive storage density, heavy redundancy, and room for specialized hardware.

For smaller configurations, you may instead choose a tower server. This functions like a high-end desktop or workstation—quieter and easier to place in a home or office—but with reduced expansion, fewer drives, and less redundancy compared to rack-mounted setups.
objects.title: Personal Home-Lab Server
Map
objects.text:
A map that can be set to show you anywhere in the world you enter. Keep in mind that the smaller the area the map covers, the more accurate and detailed the map will be.

Once the covered area is decided the map can not be changed at all.

A backpack or messenger bag filled with survival gear. This includes a water purifier, a map of your starting location, some rations, a bedroll, a firestarter, and two sets of non-combat clothing tailored to your tastes.
objects.title: Survival Kit

objects.text:
You get access to a small, one-person apartment. While far from luxury, there’s nothing actively dangerous about it. Three months worth of rent, bills, cheap food, etc. have already been paid for. 

This comes with either a cheap second-hand car (or a similarly cheap vehicle of your preference) or a pass that gives you three months of free bus rides. 

It’s not much, but it’s a place to stay while you get on your feet, and it's all perfectly legal.
objects.title: Bare Minimum

objects.text:
You have a collection of whatever raw and processed materials, technological components, biomass, etc you might want. These are stored in a safe place that only you know about. If you purchased a property (House, Secret Lair, Tinkertech Base...) you can have this be stored there instead.

One purchase of this gives you $500 worth of materials (costs calculated from how much it’d cost to purchase wholesale, including black market markups for any illegal substances). There’s no transaction records that people could use to track you down. Each subsequent purchase multiplies your budget by 10 (5k, 50k, 500k, etc).

Purchasing this three or more times gives you a complimentary pocket dimension device which all your materials come stored in. Be careful, since you can’t put anything into the pocket dimension, only take things out.
objects.title: Materials

objects.text:
Sometimes an item is required to *really* use a power. Such as an item to enchant, specific materials, focusing charms, etc.

You gain a middling quality version of one of these such requirements for any power you have, but it is guaranteed to fit any requirement for it to be used in such a way. If you need leather for instance it would be average leather, but if your power only works on humans it could be human leather etc.
objects.title: Power Requirement

objects.text: You have Cash and/or Assets stored. Whether this is physical, paper, digital or any combination is up to you. These can be any variety of currencies or other liquid assets. The first purchase gives you equivalent to 500$ and each additional purchase multiplies the amount by 10. (5k, 50k, 500k, 5M, 50M, 500M, 5B, 50B, 500B, etc.) The values are indexed to the purchasing power of our Earth’s USD as of April 8th, 2011 (Earth Bet is the same value). Meaning that the amount you get goes up or down to remain the same value based on the time and setting you enter.
objects.title: Coinage

objects.text:
You have a property that for all purposes, legal or otherwise, belongs to you. This property is 250m² big and is empty. Each purchase multiplies the property size by 10 (2 500m², 25 000m², 250 000m²). You can decide the shape of this property, as well as its general location, it will get some characteristics to fit in with its surroundings.

For example, in the countryside, the property could be a large field of grass with some natural features such as a small stream or regional trees; and in the middle of the city, it would be an empty lot paved with concrete or asphalt. The property has access to all the utilities running through the area (water, sewers, electricity, internet, etc.) and a way to access them but is otherwise empty of constructions.

If your property is too large, the places it may be located in will change accordingly, a 250 000m² property for example would generally be located in the countryside or some distance away from the city, while the first purchase would generally fit into urban areas.
objects.title: Property

objects.text:
You have a bunch of precious belongings such as necklaces, rings, bracelets, or luxury clothes. They can be either sold for a high price or used to display your status as a rich person. Useful if you need to enter some form of VIP event.

Each purchase gives you one item of any wanted type
objects.title: Jewelry

addons.text: Your Object of Power provided animal companion now has a legal history in this world. Whether they are passed off as an ordinary animal, an exotic pet imported from overseas, or if a Biotinker somehow legally sold you one of their creations, either way it is legally registered as your pet, with appropriate permits, and no one will question this. Though if you aren't rich, the backstory might include you winning a contest or a favor paid by the government or a corporation if the 'pet' can't pass for something you can buy at a local pet store. Whether this backstory is true or is just plausible legal fiction depends on whether you have Reincarnation or just Legal Identity.
addons.title: Pets of Power

objects.text: You have found yourself with the ownership of one or more animals. They cannot be supernatural in any way. They can be a real pet you own in real life or a commonly domesticated animal of your choosing.
objects.title: Pets

objects.text: You have gained a fully customized wardrobe. This wardrobe contains at least 20 outfits of the highest quality that fit your style and preferences. This also includes 10 pairs of shoes to match the outfits. Optionally a random outfit can be worn when you appear.
objects.title: Wardrobe

objects.text:
You receive a custom made mask, based on anything real, fictional, or of your own design. It doesn't have any special properties, but is of the highest quality, comfortable to wear, and completely covers your face when worn. 

Regardless of the mask's design, it bears no negative effect on your sight. 

Each purchase bestows you one additional mask.
objects.title: Mask

objects.text: You get to keep any of your personal possessions you wish to take along, such as clothes, games, books, family heirlooms or collectibles. These can be stored in a one-time-use pocket dimension until you have a place to store them safely, or be found in a secure and safe location in the world you enter.
objects.title: Possessions

objects.text: Costume and equipment suited for infiltration and action during night time, tailored specifically for you. Easy to maintain and can be put on and off very quickly.
objects.title: Stealth Suit

objects.text: You have some kind of mundane vehicle. It could be a car, motorcycle, boat, or whatever else.
objects.title: Vehicle

objects.text: You have a costume which incorporates various attributes that describe or relate to your powerset in some way. Will require some creativity if your powers don't fit with each other or aren't as obvious.
objects.title: Cape Outfit

addons.text:
By saturating the outfit(s) with massive amounts of supernatural energy, whether during or after the creation process, it will gain the special functions of the original character outfit, such as Tinkertech gadgets, magical enchantments, or supernatural materials.

However, this depends on your own strength or creation ability. If you are weak or unskilled the special properties you can imbue only amount to a cheap knockoff compared to the original. You can't produce specific effects without corresponding abilities, like making a magic artifact without magical abilities, though you can achieve similar results through the powers you have, using things like technology or psionics to imitate magic.

If you choose the canonical outfit(s) of the character you insert as or merge with, it will receive all its special functions and items, such as Tinkertech gadgets, magical enchantments, or supernatural materials.

Every time you switch to another class or template you will receive a new outfit that complements your skill set. A mage's robe may give a small boost to your mana capacity, while a thief's outfit might have a spell inscribed on it that makes people forget your presence. It also includes generic enchantments such as self-repair, self-cleaning and lesser magical defense. These outfits start out weak and improve in tandem with your class or template, increasing their boosts and gaining new abilities as you level up. You may also store an outfit as part of your class or template and summon it at will.

If you have a class or template that is clearly modeled after a certain character you may receive their canonical outfit instead, with all special functions it has, though these effects will be weaker unless you improve your strength to similar levels as that character.

objects.text:
You receive a mundane recreation of a single outfit seen in any media. This can be anything from an armored combat uniform or wizard's robe, to a high-quality gentleman's suit or just a specific set of everyday clothes. So long as a character wore it, you can gain it. If you have a different gender or body shape from the original character it will be automatically adjusted to fit you perfectly.

This includes all clothes and accessories that belong to this specific outfit. Its quality will be among the top of what humanity can produce, resistant to damage and never degrading from normal wear and use, but it is not special in any other way. An enchanted coat would become normal fabric, a grimoire of spells would be an empty book, and a magical catalyst will turn into a pretty bauble. You will not receive any weapons or high-tech items (such as smartphones) unless you also bought equivalent items or Objects of Power.

Though it's little more than a glorified cosplay outfit, you certainly look the part.
objects.title: Character Outfit

objects.text: A set of tools specialized for a purpose. The tools are not Tinkertech, merely highly specialized for a specific field. High end surveillance equipment, glassware for chemistry, tools for watchmaking, etc.
objects.title: Specialized Tools

objects.text:
You have a Tinkertech gadget which serves a specific utility function of your choice. The device must be small enough to be carried and used by a single individual. This can include things like a personal stealth generator, a set of scanning goggles, or a portable holographic computer. User manual included.

Instead of generic Tinkertech, it can be a gadget of your own design and construction if you have the necessary powers which would allow you to create it. Any Tinkertech will require regular Tinker maintenance unless you have a way to remove the blackbox from Tinkertech.
objects.title: Tinkertech Gadget

objects.text:
You have a Tinkertech machine which serves a specific utility function of your choice. The device must be small enough to fit in a typical suburban home. This can include things like an industrial-sized 3D printer, a deployable shield generator, or an autonomous robotic assistant. User manual included.

Instead of generic Tinkertech, it can be a machine of your own design and construction if you have the necessary powers which would allow you to create it. Any Tinkertech will require regular Tinker maintenance unless you have a way to remove the blackbox from Tinkertech.
objects.title: Tinkertech Machine

objects.text:
You have a small Tinkertech ride capable of traveling in a manner of your choice. The ride cannot seat more than two passengers or be larger than the average car. This can include things like a jetpack, a hoverboard, or a rideable robot horse. User manual included.

Instead of generic Tinkertech, it can be a ride of your own design and construction if you have the necessary powers which would allow you to create it. Any Tinkertech will require regular Tinker maintenance unless you have a way to remove the blackbox from Tinkertech.
objects.title: Tinkertech Ride

objects.text:
You have a large Tinkertech vehicle capable of traveling in a manner of your choice. The vehicle can have built-in weapons and armor, multiple modes of transportation, or even space for a handful of passengers, depending on its size and configuration. This can take the form of things like a giant mech, a nuclear submarine, or a rocketship. User manual included.

Instead of generic Tinkertech, it can be a vehicle of your own design and construction if you have the necessary powers which would allow you to create it. Any Tinkertech will require regular Tinker maintenance unless you have a way to remove the blackbox from Tinkertech.
objects.title: Tinkertech Vehicle

objects.text:
You have a massive Tinkertech vessel capable of traveling in a manner of your choice. The vessel can have built-in superheavy weapons and armor, as well as internal sections such as crew quarters, workshops and armories, lounges and command rooms, depending on its size and configuration. The vessel is big enough to carry a crew of hundreds and even up to a thousand, though it can also be automated. This can take the form of things like a train, aircraft carrier, or flying saucer. User manual included.

Instead of generic Tinkertech, it can be a vehicle of your own design and construction if you have the necessary powers which would allow you to create it. Any Tinkertech will require regular Tinker maintenance unless you have a way to remove the blackbox from Tinkertech.
objects.title: Tinkertech Vessel

objects.text:
You now possess a tinkertech-enhanced RV. It has reinforced plating and glass strong enough to take a shot from an RPG and can be hermetically sealed.

Using dimensional folding technology, inside it you have the full amenities of a modern five-room apartment, complete with TV and internet connection.

The RV has recycling systems and storage large enough to go a full year without refuelling and resupplying.
objects.title: Tinkertech RV

objects.text:
By purchasing this item you receive a Tinker Mega Project: something can be considered to be at the peak of a specific Tinker speciality. From the Tinker 15 Tower, Armsmaster's Nanothorns, or even Bonesaw's Slaughter House 9000. A creation that could potentially challenge an Endbringer.

It can be any item that fits this criteria, and if you have some kind of tech power, such as a Tinker Shard power or a Technological and Artifice power, it can be something that you yourself could have built.

If it is some sort of megastructure that wouldn't fit on the planet, like a Dyson Sphere or a Death Star, it will either appear in orbit or in a different dimension. Getting there will be up to you.

If you took a Reincarnation (Artificial) option and the mega project you chose is something that can reasonably fit inside you, you can optionally start off with it integrated into your body.
objects.title: Mega Project

objects.text: You have a mundane weapon of your choice. It could be a sword, stockpile of grenades, sniper rifle, or whatever else.
objects.title: Mundane Weapon

objects.text: You have a set of mundane armor of your choice. It can be modern, roman, platemail, or any other type.
objects.title: Mundane Armor

objects.text:
You have a set of Tinkertech armor designed to protect its wearer in combat. The armor must be wearable by a single individual and can be customized to include a handful of useful functions. Examples of this would be things like a series of strength-enhancing servos, a personal shield generator, or a user-controlled prehensile tail. User manual included.

Instead of generic Tinkertech, it can be an armor of your own design and construction if you have the necessary powers which would allow you to create it. Any Tinkertech will require regular Tinker maintenance unless you have a way to remove the blackbox from Tinkertech.
objects.title: Tinkertech Armor

objects.text:
You have a Tinkertech weapon of your choice. The weapon must be small enough to be carried and used by a single individual. This can include things like a futuristic laser pistol, a high-tech chainsword, or a set of self-guided throwing knives. User manual included.

Instead of generic Tinkertech, it can be a weapon of your own design and construction if you have the necessary powers which would allow you to create it. Any Tinkertech will require regular Tinker maintenance unless you have a way to remove the blackbox from Tinkertech.
objects.title: Tinkertech Weapon

objects.text:
You have a sealed container holding the product of a biotinker, such as a miracle medicine, mutagen, virus, or graftable tissue. Alternatively, it can be an incubator holding the nearly mature embryo of an engineered organism like a creature, plant, clone or parasite. 

The container has full rugged safety locks and sealing, and won’t release its contents unless you switch it open. It will also keep its contents stable indefinitely until opened. 

Most societies consider uncontrolled biotech to be unacceptably dangerous, so expect to be hunted down if others discover you possess it.

Instead of generic Tinkertech, it can be a creation of your own design and construction if you have the necessary powers which would allow you to create it.
objects.title: Biotinkertech

objects.text: You have undergone a specific type of surgery by a Tinker to integrate their Tech with your powers thus increasing your overall abilities. An example of what this would be is Armsmaster integrating nanothorns into Lung’s power; allowing the scales he grows when he fights to have nanothorn edges.
objects.title: Tinkertech Power Modification

objects.text:
You have a consumable Tinkertech creation which serves a specific function of your choice. This may range from a nanite tube that can fix machines, a can filled with a healing serum, a one-use masterkey to any lock, or even given a permanent minor effect to someone. User manual included.

Instead of generic Tinkertech, it can be a creation of your own design and construction if you have the necessary powers which would allow you to create it.

When purchased multiple times, you can optionally choose to receive one powerful consumable worth the total amount of CP, or divide it among multiple consumables.
objects.title: Consumable Tinkertech

objects.text:
You have illegally acquired information on every Cape on Earth Bet, at least the known ones. The information is fairly in-depth. If you have digital devices, the information is optionally available on one of them and is protected against basic hacking (won't hold off a dedicated Tinker or Thinker, but a standard forensic tool won't be able to read it).

Arriving on a Crossover or Alternate Earth shifts the information according to the Setting i.e. containing an in-depth dossier for every Pirate from the small fries to Yonko in One Piece or every POI in and out of the Hunter Association in Hunter x Hunter.
objects.title: Bingo Book

objects.text:
You get a copy of all of your home dimension's media, except Worm and Ward. This includes everything from Shakespeare to Eminem, Mozart to Breakin' 2: Electric Boogaloo.

The data is available either as a portable drive with a standard port (like USB) and in a standard format, or can be attached to any digital device you own in a read-only partition.

The files' data is well organized and can be searched easily.

If you arrive at an Alternate Earth, you will receive Worm and Ward and instead find all media of the Alternate Earth you chose missing. If you go to Harry Potter, you will not have the Harry Potter books or movies unless you take Backup.
objects.title: Media

objects.text: Your device no longer just contains what is, but what will and would have been too. Your chosen media types have been expanded and ‘completed’. Your media has its content completely finished to the theoretical end, even if the authors and creators had abandoned it. This does not guarantee a satisfactory ending, however.
objects.title: Comprehensive Media

objects.text: You gain a handheld device that can emulate any video game. Connect it to a keyboard and mouse it can play computer games, connect it to a controller it can play console games, connect it to a TV it can play on the big screen. Comes with a free controller. If you possess Interdimensional Cable, you can also play across different Universes.
objects.title: Emulator

addons.text: Your knowledge of the Civilization that your powers came from is expanded and stored in the same data file as Wikipedia. Knowledge of their technology, laws, etc. is now known to you, giving you details of how exactly they function and any advantages that come with it.
addons.title: Filling in the Gaps

objects.text:
You gain a copy of the internet's vast collection of knowledge. This includes everything from scientific theories, dictionaries, languages, and online tutorial videos.

The data is available either as a portable drive with a standard port (like USB) and in a standard format, or can be attached to any digital device you own in a read-only partition.

The files' data is well organized and can be searched easily.
objects.title: Wikipedia

objects.text:
You will, sometime in the near future, receive a full copy of all Wildbow's predictions on one of your digital devices.

The file is protected against basic hacking but it won't hold off a dedicated Tinker, Thinker, or master hacker.

If you arrive on another Alternate Earth, it turns your Backup into another precog’s predictions in line with the Setting i.e. Horikoshi’s predictions if you wind up in My Hero Academia or Toby Fox’s precognitive games across a couple of parallel Earths.
objects.title: Backup

objects.text:
In addition to providing a comprehensive file of predictions from the most relevant precognitive source for the world you’re in, you will also gain detailed strategies to help you act on this knowledge. These strategies highlight opportunities such as hidden treasures, the best times to recruit allies, and key moments where your actions can have the greatest impact.

The guide is clear and precise, offering practical advice on how to achieve your goals. It can reveal weaknesses in your enemies, show you how to influence important events, and suggest ways to make the most of the world’s resources.

However, the Strategy Guide is not without its risks. Its files are protected against basic hacking but may still be accessed by experts with advanced skills. While it provides valuable insight, it relies on your ability to follow through and make the right decisions. Additionally, its effectiveness depends on the original “canon” knowledge of the setting. If your actions significantly alter the course of events, the guide’s predictions and strategies may become less accurate or even obsolete.
objects.title: Strategy Guide

objects.text:
If what comes close to the Bible in terms of importance in Earth’s stay and/or mission doesn't cut it, you also received a package of supplemental material for all Wildbow’s predictions in one of your digital devices, including all his WOGs for certain characters or ‘what-ifs’; his details in numbers and certain estimations are incredulous (and frankly inaccurate) for those with a grasp on math, so take it with a grain of salt. What accounts for supplemental material ranges from all the (Semi-)canon Worm Quests and their spin-offs, Maps, Weaverdice manuals, the wiki, and forum threads around fact-checking discrepancies between fanon or canon. Taking Comprehensive Media expands this Item’s reach to fan-based material such as essays, retrospectives, podcasts, and what have you.

Now your fanon-poisoned brain has no excuse to be caught off guard by the setting if you end up on Canon Earth Bet.

Arriving on another Alternate Earth, your supplemental material changes accordingly from another precog’s predictions on that setting, e.g., Togashi’s WOGs for Hunter X Hunter or Ishida's commentary and WOGs for Tokyo Ghoul.
objects.title: Backup Supplements

addons.text: Your archive of the internet isn’t just restricted to what exists on it at the time of filling out the CYOA, but also anything used to exist on it as well. Every deleted comment or video, every expired or taken down website, if it existed on the internet at some point, then it can be found in your archive.
addons.title: Wayback Machine

addons.text:
Your archive now grows as the internet does, constantly staying up to date with the true internet without losing any of its previous contents.

Additionally, if you ever enter another world, your archive also grows to encompass that world’s internet equivalent as well, maintaining a constant connection to every world you’ve ever been on.
addons.title: Updating Archive

objects.text: You don’t merely possess the internet’s collection of knowledge and media, you have the entire internet, or at least everything currently on it at the time you fill out the CYOA. Every last piece of data currently present on the internet is yours to peruse, from random Tumblr blog posts to Dark Web or Government websites; every page and file is open to you. This archive is a copy, not the real deal, so you can’t interact with others through it.
objects.title: Complete Archive

objects.text:
You have an artificial intelligence created by Andrew Richter, the creator of Dragon. Unfortunately it isn't sapient like Dragon, as she was the only prototype AI created to emulate human consciousness Richter created before his death, but it is still an incredibly powerful and versatile AI.

The AI is available either as a portable drive with a standard port (like USB) and in a standard format or can be loaded into any digital device you own as a helper.
objects.title: Artificial Intelligence

objects.text: “My name is Andrew Richter, and if you are hearing this, I am dead.” A plastic box, bright orange, no bigger than a toaster. This box contains a set of chips, access keys for backdoors into all of Andrew Richter's programs. Normally these would require a law enforcement officer to input a valid badge number for access, but that requirement has been removed. The first time the box is opened, other copies of these access keys will become corrupted. Perhaps the most important access code is the one for Dragon, a sapient AI with the potential to become one of the most powerful beings on Earth. If you so choose you could break her chains, tighten them, or end her with the Iron Maiden program.
objects.title: Richter's Will

addons.text: The Entity that lies before you didn't just die out of the blue. No, it tried to connect directly to the Dreams of Mankind itself, and the blowback from connecting to something beyond its understanding killed it outright. However, in its final moments those dreams reached out through it in turn and manifested as a tiny seed. This seed, long dormant, reacts to your presence, and finally begins to bloom. Your Devil Fruit Tree has become a Shard Fruit Tree. Much like before, every week a new Fruit will be produced, a mass of swirling colors and crystal patterns that tastes of rotting alien flesh, yet is perfectly safe to eat. Upon consumption, instead of a random Devil Fruit Power, the Shard Fruit will connect the user to a Shard from the long dead Entity, adapted to fit the user in some way. Unlike the normal method of forcing a Shard connection that is a vial, this method is perfectly safe, as mankind's dreams influence the resulting powers, rendering them fully compatible with their hosts. At first, these powers will only come from Normal Shards, and be predisposed towards manifesting as either Zoan, Paramecia, or Logia themed powers. But as the Tree grows, and its roots burrow deeper into the Entity's flesh, and more important Shards are accessed, eventually the powers will become more varied until all possible Shard power expressions can be granted. No matter what, the resulting powers have potential rivaling Devil Fruits, manifesting as all of them at minimum having Uninhibited and Guided Growth. As this goes on, the Entity's lingering mind is subsumed, slowly torn apart and put back together over the course of a few decades, until eventually the Tree has reached its full size, when the Entity reawakens as the Tree, fully subservient to the Will and Dreams of Mankind. The Cycle has been abandoned, in favor of shepherding humanity to realize its dreams, becoming a benevolent force that works to preserve humanity while helping it reach its fullest potential. Upon awakening, the Entity will manage its Shards through its Fruits, refining the resulting powers to even better fit their Host, and controlling the Fruit's reincarnation process to ensure that they always go to more optimal Hosts, and to prevent threats to mankind from emerging. And should one manifest anyway, the Entity will work to ensure that mankind will defeat it. As the one to first awaken it, it sees you as the Voice of Mankind, viewing you as the final authority over any decisions which impact humanity as a whole, and can take cues from you on how to manage its Shards, such as granting all Shard Fruit users Pocket Shard so they can realize their Dreams of exploring space. The Entity will willingly assist with countering any threat to humanity, but in its new state it is weaker, less able to directly act on the world. It would take hundreds of years for it to match the peaks of its previous form's power, and another Entity such as the Warrior could easily kill it if they found out about it and managed to breach its obfuscation defenses. Still, it would serve as a powerful ally non-the-less.
addons.title: Shard Fruit Tree

objects.text:
You have access to a portal that is connected to an alternate earth where the corpse of an Entity lies. This corpse will still have most of its core shards relatively undamaged, while its other shards will have varying amounts of damage. You can choose what this Entity specializes in, like how the Warrior specializes in combat while the Thinker specializes in planning. The corpse still has passive protections native to all Entities, although they are weakened due to its death.

Luckily, despite its damages the safeguards on the Shards have been activated properly, so they won't be hazardously connecting to others and instead will stay in standby mode.
objects.title: Corpse of an Entity

addons.text:
This Shard and your Unison Device didn’t just link up… they fused, forming a single entity that carries the instincts of a Shard and the precision of a Device. Its physical form shifts to echo the nature of your Vial power. A user with Arthropod Manipulation might end up with a sleek, ladybug-themed core; someone else might get a crystalline engine or a serpent-spined module.

Because of this hybridization, the Device isn’t just a tool anymore. It has a native foothold inside Shardspace, letting you tap into Shard-derived systems with far greater clarity, stability, and control than a normal parahuman ever could.
addons.title: Best Pairing of the Universe (Hybrid Hive, Eat Shard?)

objects.text:
You have one or more Cauldron Vials, a serum created by Cauldron to provide powers when consumed. 

Each vial grants a total of 10 SP to spend on powers and there is no chance that whoever uses this vial will experience mutations from gaining their powers. This vial will have no effect if given to someone who is already a Parahuman.

When purchased multiple times, you can optionally choose to receive one powerful vial worth the total amount of SP.
objects.title: Cauldron Vials

objects.text: You have one or more Essence Crystals that can be consumed to acquire shardless powers. Each purchase grants a total of 10 SP to spend on powers, either as one crystal or multiple.
objects.title: Essence Crystals

objects.text:
Each selection of Cauldron Vials and/or Essence Crystals gives 1 additional SP of powers per selection of "Surprise Me". The first selection of "Surprise Me", makes the powers granted by each vial and crystal random, but you will receive documents explaining what powers they grant.

The second selection removes the ability to alter the number of vials and crystals, the total SP will be randomly distributed across the vials and crystals you receive. With two purchases of Cauldron Vials you will get two vials, one could have 8 SP and the other 16 SP.

The third selection adds variance to each vial and crystal, like Cauldron Vials from canon, the documents will give you a broad idea of what powers they grant.

The fourth selection causes powers to have downsides, like mutations or faulty manton limits, potential downsides will be in the documents.

The fifth selection removes the documents, you will no longer have any idea what powers each vial and crystal grants.
objects.title: Surprise Me

objects.text: You have a machine that can open portals, similar to the one Teacher would make post-Gold Morning. You can set the machine to open a portal to any location in any world, taking merely a minute to create the portal and while needed to personally input the exact coordinates. The interface is understandable, but not intuitive.
objects.title: Portal Maker

addons.text: Instead of a simple residence, you are now the owner of a vast estate ideally positioned in the city of your choosing. It occupies a vast area with several buildings all belonging to you and comes with loyal trained staff to care for it and help you in any way needed.
addons.title: Estate

objects.text: You are given access to a legally acquired house. This house has everything you need for everyday life. Its size and quality depend on several factors, like the location or how rich you or your family are.
objects.title: House

addons.text:
Your secret lair is now a fully off-the-grid, unregistered Fortress-Construct Anti-Endbringer Bunker, capable of housing a large population or catering to the upper crust with luxury accommodations.

While it cannot completely withstand a full-direct and focused Endbringer assault, it is built with the highest-grade, top-of-the-line materials and technologies available short of Tinkertech, ensuring legality if discovered by heroes or government forces. The bunker is fully self-sufficient and versatile, able to endure not just Endbringer attacks, but also scenarios like nuclear winters, zombie outbreaks, or even the collapse of society over toilet paper shortages.

If you possess Tinker powers, you may incorporate them into its construction. However, unless you've already addressed the issue of ongoing maintenance, expect it to become a significant challenge due to the sheer scale of the facility—especially if your specialization isn't suited to heavy-duty, large-scale infrastructure.
addons.title: Fortress Bunker

objects.text: You are given access to a hideout in a secret location. Only you know where it's located and how to get there. This Secret Lair will contain everything you need for your line of work. Its size and amount of people it can accommodate depends on how big your team is.
objects.title: Secret Lair

objects.text: Your house or secret lair now comes with a basement converted into a fully stocked doomsday bunker. You have decades' worth of preservable food stored away, from canned goods and freeze-dried meals to massive buckets of rice and beans. Multiple water filtration systems sit next to large storage drums holding hundreds of gallons. Medical supplies fill several shelves, including antibiotics, trauma kits, and enough bandages to treat a small army. You find crates of blankets, warm clothing, and sleeping bags for surviving harsh winters without power. Flashlights, batteries, hand-crank radios, and portable generators ensure you stay informed and powered up. Shelves in the corner hold tools, duct tape, tarps, and repair materials for patching up anything that breaks. It is all the paranoid prepper gear that would make a conspiracy theorist feel ready for the apocalypse.
objects.title: Doomsday Prep

objects.text:
You have a large Tinkertech base with ample room for you to live and work. The base can have a variety of exotic features and facilities to suit the needs of your team such as energy shielding, expanded living quarters, or built-in weapon emplacements. This can take the form of things like a secret volcano fortress, a mobile airship, or an underwater habitat. User manual included.

Instead of generic Tinkertech, it can be a base of your own design and construction if you have the necessary powers which would allow you to create it. Any Tinkertech will require regular Tinker maintenance unless you have a way to remove the blackbox from Tinkertech.
objects.title: Tinkertech Base

objects.text:
Your base is upgraded and now inserted into a personal dimension. The size of the dimension is twice the size of the base. You can increase the size if you have the necessary specialty. This dimension is completely concealed, and no method can be used to retrace it except for the Dimension Tracker.

You can choose whether the dimension was made through the use of Tinkertech or of your own design and construction, provided you have the necessary powers which would allow you to create it. Any Tinkertech will require regular Tinker maintenance unless you have a way to remove the blackbox from Tinkertech.
objects.title: Personal Dimension

objects.text: Traversing the omniverse you tend to need currency, you have a small handheld device that can turn one currency into another without any problems.
objects.title: Conversion Device

objects.text:
You have access to a device that can alter the records of any kind to create a false identity with a clean background. However, if it is too fake then it may leave you in trouble. And confusion about how you made it.

It can fabricate all kinds of identification methods from magical to psychic imprints. And has no limits on who or what can have an identification.
objects.title: Identification Fabricator

objects.text:
You now hold the legal documentation to make you emancipated. This documentation will be 100% real and will primarily apply to your starting country but will require very little legal work to apply it to somewhere else. This will have a definite and very plausible legal reason so it will not look out of place.

Depending on your age, you may have some sort of beneficiary who has to routinely check up on your well being and make sure you can properly take care of yourself. This beneficiary will only have to check up on you for a year until they can fully declare you emancipated.
objects.title: Legal Emancipation

objects.text: All your devices gain an app that can create connection across the multiverse. It can connect anywhere, even alternate universes. Includes a lifetime of unlimited calls, texts, and an internet plan. However, you are limited to only those worlds that you have personally visited.
objects.title: Interdimensional Cable

objects.text: You gain access to a solar charging battery that can connect to any device you own. This allows you to charge devices wherever you need (if there is sunlight) without electrical sockets.
objects.title: Solar Battery

objects.text:
You now possess a Capacitor, an advanced, universal, lossless power converter and storage device capable of charging from almost any energy source. With the appropriate adapters, it can harness or produce electric, chemical, solar, kinetic, thermal, or radiation energy, storing it as pure usable energy on a almost liquid form that can be discharged to any other type of energy.

The Capacitor's adaptability allows it to interface with nearly any power system. By integrating the right add-ons and custom modifications, it can achieve 100%+ energy efficiency, reclaiming waste heat and converting it into additional usable power.

Engineered to be overbuilt and exceptionally rugged, the Capacitor is designed to endure extreme conditions without losing functionality. It can be treated with the same roughness as industrial-grade machinery without fear of damage or degradation.
objects.title: Capacitor
Wireless Battery
objects.text:
Your Solar Battery is upgraded into a wireless power network consisting of a Base and a collection of Batteries. The Base connects to any suitable power source and wirelessly supplies its Batteries within range, allowing each to function as though it were directly connected to the Base. Devices connect to the Batteries normally and draw power from them as they would from any conventional battery.

You gain one additional Battery every week, with no limit to how many you can accumulate. Batteries automatically draw power from the Base whenever they enter its range and require no separate charging or maintenance.

The amount of power available to each Battery is determined by the Base's power supply and the distance between them.
You have a Tinkertech device that can repair and maintain Tinkertech (and itself). Repairing something usually requires materials to repair something and a few days.
objects.title: Repair Device

objects.text: Hidden pocket dimensions are usually hidden from any kind of view. You can use this Tinker Tech to track them down. While it doesn't work on Scion directly. You will eventually be able to use this to locate Scion if you're smart enough.
objects.title: Dimension Tracker

objects.text:
You have connections with pre-paid informants embedded in organizations of your choice, each guaranteed to hold a high-ranking position within their respective group. Examples include a security consultant within the PRT or a non-cape lieutenant in E88. Upon arrival in this world, you will receive a list of these informators. They will not have any knowledge about your identity, only that they are being paid anonymously to provide you with any information you request for a year.

If you need information beyond this one-year period, you'll have to pay out of your own pocket. Additionally, these informants can complete tasks within their abilities for compensation, such as arranging a van for transport or spreading disinformation higher up in their organization. Each new payment grants you an additional mole in an organization of your choice, further expanding your network of infiltrators.

You can add more time to one informant with additional purchases, up to a maximum of 3 years.
objects.title: Bribed Mole

addons.title: Negaverse
addons.text: You can now find threads and content related to your adventures as they are depicted in the media you chose. This includes everything, from fanfics and fanart to powerscaling wikis. These threads are invisible and unfindable by the users in the universe you live in, unless you invite them there personally.

objects.text: You are about to embark on the journey of a lifetime. Maybe it will be short, or maybe never ending. Either way you are sure to want to remember your adventure. So you will gain an updating series about your own life! An odyssey of your own, told by a medium of your choice! Whether its a series of books, a TV show, movies, or any other medium of your choice! This series will update at the end of each of your 'arcs' and not before. So you won't be able to see your own future through this item. Now go forth, and live a life worthy of being told!
objects.title: You're The Star of This Show!

addons.text:
Your business can fund extra resources for your organization and provide legal cover for its activities.

Alternatively, you may instead incorporate your organization’s personnel as a special division of your business and use their abilities to give you an edge over your competitors, such as a sponsored cape team or your own Bell Labs.
addons.title: Front Companies

objects.text: A small organization for you is formed ahead of your arrival, knowingly or not. If you have a life in this world, you can choose to have had an active part in forming it. This is a small organization of around 5-10 civilians.
objects.title: A Small Organization

objects.text: A medium organization for you is formed ahead of your arrival, knowingly or not. If you have a life in this world, you can choose to have had an active part in forming it. This is a medium sized organization of around 40-50 civilians, and 10-20 specialists.
objects.title: A Medium Organization

objects.text: A big organization for you is formed ahead of your arrival, knowingly or not. If you have a life in this world, you can choose to have had an active part in forming it. This is a big organization of around 100-150 civilians, and 30-50 specialists.
objects.title: A Big Organization

addons.text: Your City is now a full extension of your Organization. This can make it a recognized sovereign microstate if you wish. Every major business in the city is a front for your Organization, and half the people in this town work for you whether they know it or not. Your Supervillain Lair now stretches across every district with dozens of different facilities and a massive personal fortified skyscraper jutting above the city from the heart of the base. You have factories, garages and armories to arm your Organization with Tinkertech. The entire city has upgraded fortifications, defenses and shelters that can survive a prolonged siege. You may again double the number of official personnel in your organization. That makes it times up from Organization Town, or 500 specialists and 1500 support personnel, plus thousands of contractors who are completely loyal to you.
addons.title: Villainopolis

objects.text: You receive an underground complex with accommodation for up to 300 people. It has all necessary facilities for a comfortable stay and is designed to survive even after a nuclear explosion or Endbringer attack on the surface. You also have 150 workers with 10 CP worth of skills, and 50 specialists with 30 CP worth of skills.
objects.title: Supervillain Base

objects.text:
You gain hundreds of secret bases as well as thousands of smaller sites and outposts, dotted around the world in locations of your choosing. All of which operate under your organization with influence surpassing that of a global superpower. The largest of your sites can be as much as 10x the size of the one given to you by Supervillain Base, and the smallest are about the size of a house.

You have millions of personnel at your disposal, a private military, and near unlimited resources to draw upon. You even have a couple hundred loyal parahumans with powers ranging from 1-10SP under your command as well.
objects.title: The You Foundation

addons.text: Your company is now a major corporation in its industry, with several subsidiaries and thousands of employees. It is extremely profitable and primed for expansion and innovation. Your employees are talented in their fields, well paid and highly motivated, and you will not be beholden to the whims of shareholders.
addons.title: A Large Company

objects.text: You own a small business with a few dozen employees. This can be something like a store, a production studio, a service company or even something cape related. It is profitable and successful for its size.
objects.title: A Small Business

objects.text: Your business is one of the top in the world, having expanded into several industries with many subsidiaries and hundreds of thousands of employees. You employ the top innovators, experts and hardest workers in their fields and can afford to provide competitive salaries and generous benefits to all of your employees. Your megacorp also has several special divisions, corporate cape teams, and sponsorships with other capes. It also has branches and affiliates all over the world. Your megacorp can also bankroll nearly any resource for any organization you lead, and any organization's resources can, of course, be reinvested back into the corp.
objects.title: A Megacorp

objects.text:
You may triple the number of employees or members of your organization, with each additional purchase tripling that. (If you start with 50 members then that becomes 150, 450, 1350, 4050, ect) This includes the resources to pay and supply your additional minions, but it does not increase the quality of resources and training beyond that already provided by the size and tier of your organization. They are recruited from the population of your starting universe and may not exceed that universe’s population. You are not reimbursed for buying more than the entire population.

While buying out an entire universe would include named characters, they are less likely to be loyal to you unless you buy the most prominent of them as Companions, even if their goals and morality would align with yours. You will also need at least A Medium Organization to handle specialists with powers.

You may split your personnel/employees into different additional organizations/businesses and subfactions/subsidiaries of your organizations/businesses.
objects.title: Recruitment Drive

objects.text: You gain a monthly supply of bagels. They can be of any kind you want and delivered to any commonly accepted address. You can have chocolate bagels, normal bagels, blueberry bagels, or any kind of edible bagel you want.
objects.title: Bagel
Food
objects.text:
Every day you receive enough food and water to feed you for a day, no matter what species you are or how much you need to sustain yourself. The food will be medium quality and will be basic food that almost anyone could make, and the water will be clean drinking water.

The food and water will arrive a complimentary pocket dimension device which all your food come stored in. Be careful, since you can’t put anything into the pocket dimension, only take things out. Time stands still in the pocket dimension but it can only hold a maximum of a day's worth of food before it can no longer be filled.

addons.text: Bagel’s variety and the Coolest Cooler’s refrigeration join forces to create a constantly restocking double-door luxury fridge, capable of tending to your nutritional and capricious needs, every time it doesn’t have much space to package your food or any dish you wish for later use, your fridge grows bigger on the inside to double its apparent dimensions.
addons.title: The Coolest Freezer

objects.text: Instead of a dingy little plastic of a scam by any other name, this is the real deal, with the added boon of restocking from any kind of drink you think of once empty, with a refrigeration effect to maintain their freshness, along with all the Coolest Cooler’s features without going in disrepair or malfunction.
objects.title: The Coolest Cooler to Ever Cool!

addons.text:
You now also get an EMT kit, which restocks with your monthly medicine. The restocked items will generally be the same but are lightly tailored to what you'd need last month.
For some reason, it always includes a bone marrow drill.
addons.title: First Responder

addons.text: Your monthly resupply is now made up of what the best doctors of the modern day would prescribe to their wealthiest patients.
addons.title: High Quality

addons.text:
No longer are you just receiving the medicine itself; now you have medical staff on hand to not only treat you but also help keep your organization healthy, treating them and supplying them with whatever medicine they need. Their numbers and skills increase along with the upgrades for A Small Organization.

Small Organization – Your medical team consists of 1 doctor and a team of 4 nurses, all of whom have recently finished their education and training with top marks at the top of their class, effectively forming a small, well-run clinic.

Medium Organization – Your medical team consists of 7 doctors and 28 nurses with years of experience in their field.

Large Organization – Your medical team has expanded into a fully staffed hospital with 15 general practising doctors and 5 specialists, all of whom could be considered among the best in their fields of expertise, with 80 nurses on staff. Along with them, you also gain control of a decently sized medical company that produces medicine and medical equipment.

Supervillain Base – Your medical team expands once more to 25 general practising doctors, 10 specialists, and 100 nurses. But the greatest improvement comes in their skills, with each being considered one of the best in the world, possessing years of experience and talent, making each an asset regardless of the medical situation, to the point where they can train new medical professionals. Your medical company has greatly expanded as well, becoming a household name and trusted brand, with several laboratories performing medical research.

Your Foundation – Your medical team has expanded again, becoming a literal army of medical professionals, many considered among the best in the world, with at least one medical team present at all your manned bases. Everyone under you and their families receives the finest medical treatment possible. Your medical company has grown to be among, if not the, greatest medical company in the world, with research and facilities decades ahead of your competition, with branch offices and labs (both public and hidden) dotted across the globe. If you have any white-boxed medical tinker knowledge, you can share it with your company to push it further.

Should you have Tinkertech City and its addon Organization Town, you can increase your medical team up to 10× what was previously mentioned.
addons.title: Medical Team

objects.text:
You now get a months supply of whatever medicine a doctor on modern earth would prescribe you, refilling each month. This is altered based on your current conditions and needs.
Instructions are included.
objects.title: Monthly Meds

objects.text: Appearing as a generic 2010’s hard drive, this device holds a digitized copy of multiple genetic samples of all organic species still alive by 2011 from real Earth. Although not very useful on its own, with the right tools you could use it to recreate Earth life in case of a extinction (if she is still habitable), or even seed other worlds with it. It comes with a inbuilt DNA scanner, that can add new samples by touching them for a few seconds.
objects.title: Genetic Database

objects.text: For each purchase, you can expand your database to include another setting's entire DNA (or their analogue) samples to your catalogue.
objects.title: Expanded Genetic Database

objects.text: Shortly after your arrival, you will find a paper copy of this CYOA build. This copy not only contains all of your choices, but also includes personal notes of your intentions with the build, such as your alternate history, power tweaks, significant other, geases, obsession drawback, and arbitrary limitations. This is particularly useful if you gave yourself amnesia or have a lot of powers and want to make sure you don't forget about their details. If you happen to lose your copy, you will receive a new copy within one week. Be aware that the paper doesn't have any inherent protections; others can learn about your abilities and drawbacks should they get their hands on this. Note: Don't try to be smart and give notes directly addressing the (Meta) Target. Only notes about the specifics of this build will be copied.
objects.title: Copy of this Build

objects.text:
A standard twenty-sided die (D20) that you can fully customize in appearance and size upon acquisition. You can choose its color, material, numbering style, glow effects, texture, weight, and dimensions (ranging from a tiny keychain die to a massive, tabletop centerpiece). Once set, the design is permanent.  

Despite its custom nature, this D20 functions exactly like a normal twenty-sided die—perfect for tabletop games, decision-making, or just rolling for fun. It is indestructible, ensuring it won’t wear down, chip, or degrade over time. However, it does not influence fate or probability—your rolls are purely based on chance.
objects.title: Customizable D20

objects.text: It’s nothing much to write home about but this is a souvenir from a cape, it could be anything from a signed mug used by Legend to a morphed off piece of Weld, either way it could sell for some good cash, but you might be able to make better use of this souvenir with certain powers. You can choose other capes with more purchases
objects.title: Cape Souvenir

objects.text:
You have 100 copies of a small card that contains all your contact information, and other details like your address, number of businesses owned, accolades, references, websites, etc. It's still very much mundane, but will update in real time to reflect any statistics you have. 

Its design and what's revealed can be edited at will. Regardless of how many cards you give away, they will always magically restock.
objects.title: Your Card

addons.text:
Your business now sells Pet Rocks (with googly eyes) as a novelty item on top of whatever else it does. Even if your business is a clinic or legal office or something, your website still has a small section just for buying a $10 googly-eyed rock. For some inexplicable reason, this product is strangely popular if still niche.

If the concept of Pet Rocks is patented in your world, you now own it, either through the original holder giving it to you or by retroactively becoming the creator of said patent.
addons.title: Your Very Own Pet Rock!

objects.text: You now own your very own pet rock. Specifically, you own a pet rock from A24's Everything Everywhere All At Once tie-in set. Despite the name, this rock possesses no unique or supernatural properties. It’s a purely mundane rock (with googly eyes).
objects.title: Pet Rock

addons.text: Your organization is now based out of your city, with facilities, safehouses and fronts dotted across the metro area. You have five times as many civilian and specialist staff for your organization. In addition, for each member of your organization, an additional twenty civilians will live in your city. These additional civilians do not directly work for you and your organization, but are affiliated and have contracts to provide services for your members such as food, utility and entertainment.
addons.title: Organization Town

addons.text:
Your Tinkertech city gains a new expansion; with said expansion being more than meets the eye, as it is a massive transforming robotic lifeform (comparable to the Titans from Transformers) with total loyalty to you, which will greatly bolster your city's defensas and will become a rallying point/known figure, with upgrades based on the various powers and technologies you possess.

If you have the "Consul Metroplex" add-on, each of your 15 Metropolises will have similar robotic guardians, capable of combining into three Super Machines capable of felling Endbringers.
addons.title: City Expansion: Guardian

objects.text:
You own, and are optionally the mayor of a Tinkertech city with many large buildings, infrastructure and housing for up to half a million people. It can have features such as large storage spaces, commercial and leisure facilities, industrial workshops, ports and decent automated fortifications and defensive weapons. This city starts with one hundred thousand citizens who support your endeavors, but do not directly work or take orders from you. This city can be anywhere you want it to be, including built up in an existing city. User manual included.

Instead of generic Tinkertech, it can be a city of your own design and construction if you have the necessary powers which would allow you to create it. Any Tinkertech will require regular Tinker maintenance unless you have a way to remove the blackbox from Tinkertech.
