There will be independent Tinkers in the city who are contracted to do utility service on the Tinkertech, but they will not do other work for you unless you hire them out of pocket.
objects.title: Tinkertech City

addons.text: You can choose to expand your island instead of receiving a property. This adds the size of your property to the size of your personal island.
addons.title: Expanded Island

addons.text: Instead of being around the size of Tarnsey, your personal island is the size of D'Urville Island at 150 km2. And instead of having an estate on the mainland like some peasant, your estate is on your own private island, ensuring that your privacy is undisturbed. Your private island also comes with a developed harbor, a private airstrip, and roads to ensure that you can travel around your island. You also receive 15 or so vehicles split across boats, private planes, and cars as you choose. If you have Skills such as Brewer, Chemistry or Biology your private island can also come with specialized facilities to support the use of such skills like a vineyard to support your brewery needs, or a pharmaceutical research facility for your pharmaceutical studies.  If you have Power Requirement, your island can also have specialized facilities to support the use of your powers, such as an enchanting room if you have the power to enchant things.
addons.title: Island Estate

addons.text:
Your secret lair is built on your private island, as your private island is more private and secluded, the secret lair is much larger than it would be if it were in the wild. To the point of it practically being a massive underground military facility, it even comes with a dozen missile silos capable of firing intercontinental ballistic missiles.

Your private island also has a decent self-defence system for anti-missile, anti-air, or anti-sea vessel purposes, allowing you to protect yourself from enemy attacks. You do not, however, have a private military, so if enemies get onto your island, you're going to have to deal with them yourself.

You have a stock of 1,200 missiles, 2/3 of which are conventional explosives, the rest are armed with chemical, biological, and nuclear (but not thermonuclear) warheads, though your nuclear warheads number in the double digits at most.

Your underground base has the facilities needed to manufacture more missiles for your silos, as long as you have the materials needed.
addons.title: Secret Island Base

addons.text:
Your secret underground base has been built with the highest-grade, top-of-the-line materials and technologies short of Tinkertech. It is incredibly durable, to the point that it can withstand a dozen simultaneous point-blank thermonuclear detonations.

This large underground facility is now built with long-term survival in mind, and has greenhouses, water purification plants, and farms capable of sustaining a population of 10.000 practically indefinitely. It can also comfortably house up to 10.000, and uncomfortably house 25.000, though then food and water can become an issue.

Your stock of missiles increases massively, to the point of rivaling superpowers such as the United States and the Russian Federation in terms of nuclear firepower.

At this point, the lack of a private military becomes quite the inconvenience, as the inability to efficiently back your missiles with a proper military force is more or less the only thing holding you back from just taking over a nation.
addons.title: Super Secret Island Base

objects.text:
You have a private island that is, for all purposes, legal or otherwise, belongs to you. This island is a little bigger than Taransay, around 15 km2 (5.79 square miles). 

This island is mostly undeveloped, only having the basic infrastructure needed to support and maintain water, sewage, electricity, internet, etc. Along with a way to access them. The only structure on the island is a smallish harbor capable of docking mega yachts. 

You can choose the area your personal island is located in. The island's climate depends on its location, so don't expect a tropical island in the Arctic.
objects.title: Private Island

addons.text:
Your most talented students are now primed to be fast-tracked directly into your organization or business. They gain internship and training program opportunities, and career pathways for induction or hiring into the organization/business's lower level secrets and special projects.

Your school's faculty are now also members of your organization or employees of your business, who know how to pick out and mentor the best potential recruits.
addons.title: Pipeline Program

objects.text:
You now own and are optionally the headmaster of a school dedicated to those with powers or special abilities. This can be any combination of power systems native to your starting world, ones added by world modifiers or drawbacks, the use of enchanted artifacts or advanced technologies, or preternatural mundane skills like combat, science, spycraft or card games. It can also be used to spread any grantable or teachable power system you have access to. You may also choose to have the school masquerade as a mundane but prestigious academy that accepts unpowered students, while training powered or potentially powered students through covert extracurriculars and programs.

This school can range anywhere from Pre-K, to High School, to Post-grad, or a trade school. It can also be an escalator school that covers the students' entire education lifetime. The school has staff and teachers who are experienced with use and training of powers and abilities. Administrators, instructors, and counselors are also accommodating and understanding about helping students through academic and personal problems so they can be their best selves and get their best results.


Though the students are only just starting to gain and understand their powers, or they may not have even fully earned or unlocked them, they will show high affinity for those powers once they start to come into their own. The school also has research programs where students and staff cooperate to better understand their powers and associated theories. The school also features a curriculum of mundane subjects, academics and extracurriculars.

The campus and facilities, including classrooms, training rooms, dorms and recreational areas are built with Tinkertech to provide a comfortable experience conducive to learning. Instead of generic Tinkertech, it can be a campus of your own design and construction if you have the necessary powers which would allow you to create it. Any Tinkertech will require regular Tinker maintenance unless you have a way to remove the blackbox from Tinkertech.

Optionally, or if powers do not exist normally in your starting world, and you do not have a way to grant or teach other people your own powers, then the school is still a very prestigious mundane institution with high quality faculty and talented students and alumni, as well as a beautiful and high-quality campus and facilities.
objects.title: A Super School

objects.text:
A biotechnology system built from the same principles Bonesaw used to create the Slaughterhouse Nine Thousand.

By supplying a biological sample—blood, hair, skin, bone, or similar material—the machine can grow a complete clone of the original individual. The resulting clone possesses the subject's memories, personality, skills, instincts, and other mental traits, reconstructed from the same processes used by Cranial's technology.

The original does not need to be alive, unique, or even currently exist. As long as a viable sample remains, the machine can produce additional copies.

For parahumans and other superpowered beings, the reconstruction is sufficiently complete that powers, mutations, and similar abilities are recreated alongside the clone whenever possible within the setting's metaphysics.

Multiple clones may be produced simultaneously, and the machine is capable of continuous operation provided sufficient resources are available.
objects.title: Bonesaw Replication System

objects.text: You can alter the appearance and function of any of your items so long as they serve the same general purpose. This includes things like turning Bingo Book into an actual book or turning Essence Crystals into potions.
objects.title: Item Tweak

rows.title: Equipment and Items
rows.titleText:
You can choose for any of the specifics of the items to be chosen manually, or leave it entirely up to chance. 

You may also optionally choose for it to be based on your subconscious desires, the specifics chosen in a way you’d be content within the limits stated in the choices below, or some mix of the two.

(If you have it and can fit, you can make the items appear on any Hammerspace/Inventory, Home/Lair or similar).

objects.text:
Everything is better with friends, even fights for the fate of the multiverse. Pick a person real or fictional and you can have them fill the CYOA (or you can fill it for them) to come along with you, although filling the CYOA for them is optional and you may instead just bring them as they normally are.

This can include one of your friends, a character from Worm/Ward, another fictional property, or even an original character.

Though depending on who, you will need to actually befriend them as well if you’re a drop in. Regular rules regarding Character Insert and Reincarnation applies for history and background if applicable. 

You may instead opt for them to be a random Companion. They can be as varied as any you could have chosen, even with a build already filled out.

If you choose this variant, the person selected will be someone you naturally click with and get along with effortlessly.

They are simply someone who fits you perfectly on a personal level, making companionship easy, natural, and mutually supportive. 

You can choose however many are specific or random if bought multiple times. Regardless, if random you will instantly mutually recognize each other as companions at first sight or when you first encounter each other.
objects.title: Companion

objects.text:
Your CYOA opens up to five other participants. 

Unlike companions, you do not control the build of those participants, instead, they are some of your friends/acquaintances that have filled a compatible CYOA and just happened to chose the same destination as you. The builds they have chosen can vary in strength wildly.
objects.title: Private Lobby

objects.text:
Your CYOA opens up to five other participants. 

Unlike companions, you do not control the build of those participants, instead, they are random people on the internet that have filled a compatible CYOA and just happened to chose the same destination as you. The builds they have chosen can vary in strength but at least one will be in the same strength class as you.
objects.title: Public Lobby

objects.text: Opens the crossover companion section
objects.title: Crossover

objects.text: Opens the Original Companions section
objects.title: Original

objects.text: Opens the Good Companions section
objects.title: Good

objects.text: Opens the Neutral Companions section
objects.title: Neutral

objects.text: Opens the Evil Companions section
objects.title: Evil

objects.text: Opens the General Companion Modifiers section.
objects.title: General Companion Modifiers

objects.text: Opens the Specific Companion Modifiers section.
objects.title: Specific Companion Modifiers

rows.title: Companions
rows.titleText:
This section is entirely optional. 
This does not stop you from finding your own companions or recruiting these people yourself.
These will be your allies and teammates. There is nothing keeping them as your teammates if they don't want to, aside from maybe a situation you find yourself in.
This can, and likely will, add butterflies.
If you character insert as a character, do not add them as a teammate. It won't do anything.
If the companions you choose do not normally exist within the setting you may optionally choose to retroactively add them to it, their history altered or added to their setting.
You may choose the method they are made to join your team, whether probability manipulation, mind control or whatever else.
If you are a reincarnation you may optionally choose your history and relationship with any of your companions.

objects.text: This choice allows you to swap the sex of a companion you select, such as turning a male character into a female character or vice versa. You may take this option up to 5 times, the fifth time allowing you to alter as many of your companions as you wish.
objects.title: Sex Swap

objects.text: This choice allows you to alter the moral alignment of a companion you select, such as changing a Lawful Good companion into True Neutral. You may take this option up to 5 times, the fifth time allowing you to alter as many of your companions as you wish.
objects.title: Morality Swap

objects.text: This choice allows you to change the age of a companion you select, such as turning an adult into a teenager or an elderly individual. You may take this option up to 5 times, the fifth time allowing you to alter as many of your companions as you wish.
objects.title: Age Swap

objects.text: Your chosen Companion is now native to the world you arrive in, their backstories and powers adjusted to fit into that world and its power system. So if you arrive in Worm, all your Crossover Companions will be parahumans, while if you choose Crossover or Alternate Universe your Companions become natives of that world. For example, Glory Girl would be a Ki-User if you go to Dragon Ball, or if you go to One Piece and select Bleach's Yoruichi she would become a Haki-User whose Mink-Ancestry lets her use Electro, etc. You may take this option up to 5 times, the fifth time allowing you to alter as many of your companions as you wish.
objects.title: Native

objects.text: This choice allows you to increase the power level of a companion you select. The increase can range from allowing Captain America to lift up to 100 tons, to transforming a character into their strongest known incarnation, such as Cosmic Spider-Man or God-Buster Iron Man. You may take this option up to 5 times, the fifth time allowing you to alter as many of your companions as you wish.
objects.title: Character Power Increase

objects.text: This choice allows you to decrease the power level of a companion you select. The reduction can range from restricting Superman to lifting no more than an airplane, to reducing an eldritch god to the level of a standard street-tier superhuman. You may take this option up to 5 times, the fifth time allowing you to alter as many of your companions as you wish.
objects.title: Character Power Decrease

objects.text: This choice allows you to modify how a companion’s powers function. Examples include changing a fire-based elemental power into ice, altering a sorcerer’s magic into psionics, and similar adjustments. However, these changes cannot increase the companion’s overall power beyond its current level. You may take this option up to 5 times, the fifth time allowing you to alter as many of your companions as you wish.
objects.title: Power Tweak (Companions)

objects.text: This choice allows you to remove a weakness or vulnerability from a companion you select. Examples include eliminating Superman’s vulnerability to kryptonite, Martian Manhunter’s psychosomatic weakness to fire, a Green Lantern’s susceptibility to fear, or even lifting a curse afflicting a companion. You may take this option up to 5 times, the fifth time allowing you to alter as many of your companions as you wish.
objects.title: Weakness Removal

objects.text: This choice allows you to alter an aspect of a companion’s personality, or even their entire personality, provided it remains within their moral alignment. However, this option cannot remove personality traits that function as inherent vulnerabilities. For example, a dragon’s instinctive greed to hoard treasure—if it directly causes them to be susceptible to being deceived or otherwise manipulated—would not fall within the scope of this choice. You may take this option up to 5 times, the fifth time allowing you to alter as many of your companions as you wish.
objects.title: Personality Change

objects.text: This choice allows you to change the genre from which a companion originates. Examples include shifting Batman from his usual stoic portrayal to a more comical Batman Forever-style, altering villains to resemble the tone and behavior of characters found in young children’s cartoons, or transforming an otherwise normal-looking individual into a horror-themed version. Such changes do not necessarily alter the companion’s moral alignment, but may affect how they behave, present themselves, and are perceived by others. You may take this option up to 5 times, the fifth time allowing you to alter as many of your companions as you wish.
objects.title: Alternate Genre

objects.text:
This choice allows you to change the aesthetic of a companion you’ve selected. 

Examples can be as minor as turning Supergirl (DC Comics) into a goth instead of her usually more ‘prep’-esc presentation, or turning Danger (Marvel) into a more fantasy-like construct rather than a pure android. 

These  changes do not necessarily alter the companion’s moral alignment, but may affect how they behave, present themselves, and are perceived by others.

You may take this option up to 5 times, the fifth time allowing you to alter as many of your companions as you wish.
objects.title: Aesthetic Swap

objects.text:
Through this option, rather than getting the ‘original’, any companion you choose can instead be a robot duplicate (or clone, or other form of replica) of them designed to imitate the original. You may decide whether the companion knows they're a duplicate or not at the time of purchase, as well as how obvious they are as a fake, and why they were created in the first place.

You may take this option up to 5 times, the fifth time allowing you to alter as many of your companions as you wish.
objects.title: Duplicate

objects.text:
Through this option, any companions you choose will possess a Klyntar symbiote of their own. These symbiotes do not need to be Venom specifically and may instead be others such as Toxin, Anti-Venom, an artificial symbiote, or even entirely original symbiotes of your own design. Each symbiote grants its host power at least comparable to that of a Spider Totem, while also enhancing any existing abilities the companion already possesses.

You may decide whether this option applies to a single companion or all of them. Additionally, you can determine the circumstances under which each companion acquired their symbiote; however, regardless of origin, each host and symbiote will share a bond and level of familiarity as though they had been partnered for a long time.
objects.title: Venomized (Marvel)

objects.text:
The companion you choose shares a connection with you across all circumstance. This bond transcends distance, time, and even death itself, ensuring that no force in existence can permanently keep you apart.

Lose track of them, and chance will guide you toward reunion. Have them taken from you, and fate will weave paths for their return. If they are killed, their essence endures, and in time they will find their way back into your story through resurrection, reincarnation, or circumstances beyond explanation. Should you be the one to fall and later return to existence, they will be drawn to you once more, as inevitable as gravity.

Beyond this unbreakable connection, you will find that you and your chosen companion simply click. Your personalities mesh, your communication flows easily, and your partnership is marked by an intuitive understanding that makes working together feel natural and right. This chemistry is not forced, it is the natural harmony of two souls meant to walk the same path.

This is not control over their will or destiny. They remain themselves, with their own choices and paths. The bond ensures only that your journeys will never truly end apart, and that when you are together, you are truly in sync. Whatever comes, whatever separates you, your story together is never finished. You may take this option up to 5 times, the fifth time allowing you to alter as many of your companions as you wish.
objects.title: Eternal Bond

objects.text:
The companions you choose will never fade into irrelevance. However they develop through training, revelation, external power ups, or simply the crucible of shared experience and otherwise they will always find a way to keep pace with you and remain a noteworthy presence in your journey.

This does not grant them specific powers or dictate the form their growth takes. A warrior might master techniques long forgotten, unlock latent potential, or forge weapons that grow with them. A mage might stumble upon ancient grimoires, develop entirely new schools of magic, or attract the attention of beings beyond mortal ken. The method is not predetermined, only the outcome: they will grow alongside you, ensuring they are never left behind as mere spectators to adventures that have outpaced them.

This modifier ensures that the bonds you forge remain meaningful. Your companions will rise to meet the challenges you face together, becoming figures of consequence in their own right rather than fading into the background of your story. You may take this option up to 5 times, the fifth time allowing you to alter as many of your companions as you wish.
objects.title: Right Hand Man

objects.text: This choice allows you to choose a single drawback per purchase to "share" with your Companions, such as Eigo Kaiki, or Monologue. You may take this option up to 5 times, the fifth time allowing you to alter as many of your companions as you wish, as well as choose any amount of drawbacks.
objects.title: Companion Drawbacks

objects.text:
Each time you select this modifier, choose one companion and decide how they gain access to something you possess. This can be any perk, skill, power, item, or object of power that you have. The form this takes is up to you.

Your companion might receive a flawless copy of the thing, as capable with it as you are. They might gain a lesser version, enough to be useful without matching your full strength. You could shape an alternate expression, the same core concept manifesting in a way suited to their nature. Or you could simply entrust that through training, discovery, or events that unfold, they will eventually acquire their own equivalent.

The means by which they receive it can be as direct or indirect as you wish. A skill might be taught. A power might be awakened. An object might be found. The only guarantee is that when you make this choice, they will have it somehow, in whatever form you decide.

This is a one time choice for each companion you apply it to. Once made, the gift is theirs. You may take this option up to 5 times, the fifth time allowing you to share with as many of your companions as you wish.
objects.title: Sharing is Caring

objects.text:
This makes specific companions into your chosen Dere types. This does not fully alter the chosen companions' personalities, and instead, simply adds these new archetypes which shall affect how they act towards you and other people they care about. Note that this does not necessarily mean they are in love with you. It could be how they show how much they care in general, regardless of whether it is familial, platonic, romantic, or so on.

While there are many Dere types, there are 5 main ones that people tend to identify. These are:

Tsundere - Acts mean and sometimes violent to hide their sweet inner selves. Could lean more Tsun (more sour) or more Dere (more sweet).

Yandere - Acts obsessive for their loved ones, which is normally hidden under a sweet exterior. Not necessarily always violent, but definitely at least possessive.

Kuudere - Stoic and coolheaded, often seen as the other side of the coin to Tsunderes. Their chilly unapproachable demeanor is contrasted by their hidden warmth underneath.

Dandere - Introverted and comes across as emotionless, they are shy, and are rather similar to Kuuderes. They tend to be quiet, blending into the background, rarely opening up, and only keeping a few people close.

Deredere - Bubbly and joyful to everybody, and treats everyone, including those they care for the most, with equal amounts of high enthusiasm.

Those are only the 5 most common types, though you may pick some of the other smaller categories such as Himederes (princess-like egotistical folk) or Kanedere (likes money above all things and has golddigger tendencies) for some quick examples. Maybe even mix and match some types so long as they aren't fully contradictory with each other, the choice is yours.
objects.title: Dere Injector

objects.text:
Your chosen companion has learned how to teach whatever learnable skills or powers they have to others. This does not guarantee that such powers or skills may manifest the same way because some powers reflect the specifics of someone's mind, body, and/or soul.

As examples, a Persona companion could help you achieve the personal growth and self-acceptance required to summon a persona or Ranni from Elden Ring could teach you to channel the power of the stars to cast powerful sorceries. This does not guarantee that you or anyone else they teach will have a noteworthy level of talent.

You may take this option up to 5 times, the fifth time allowing you to alter as many of your companions as you wish.
objects.title: Mentor

objects.text:
A companion of yours is now split into two or more separate characters that represent a part of them. For example, Danny Fenton being separated into his Human and Ghost side, or Starscream being split into his ambition and cowardly sides, etc. They become separate characters,  and whether or not they are related or even get along depends on their personalities. Whether or not they also still retain their powers, get their powers split up in weaker versions, or keep no powers at all depends on you.

You may select this 5 times. You could either split a single character into multiple fissions of themselves, or you could select more other characters to be split into multiple versions. You may split as many characters if you pick this 5 times.
objects.title: Character Fission

objects.text:
Two or more companions of yours are now fused into one being, similar to the Amalgam universe. How much of a character is visible in the fusion is up to you (so for example, a Midoriya/Taylor fusion could be more Midoriya, more Taylor, or a balance of both). They may also possess a mix of the powers of their components, a single power from theirs, or none at all, again, it is your choice.

You may select this 5 times. You could either fuse more characters into one fusion, or you could select other characters to fuse. You may fuse as many characters if you pick this 5 times.
objects.title: Character Fusion

objects.text: By taking this choice, rather than your companions joining you immediately on entry, you'll actually have to meet them. While they’re still guaranteed to be loyal to you in the same way, the companions you’ve taken will be added to the world much like you have been, even if they were not from the setting natively. The method that brought them here may be different from your own however (for instance, they might have been brought there from portals or a doomed timeline, etc) You may take this option up to 5 times, the fifth time allowing you to alter as many of your companions as you wish.
objects.title: The Long Way

objects.text:
Your chosen inorganic companion has become human, or at the very least one of the native species in the world you're traveling into. They still retain all the powers and abilities they may had as an inorganic, so at worst, they are now a cyborg.

You may take this option up to 5 times, the fifth time allowing you to alter as many of your companions as you wish.
objects.title: You're a Real Boy/Girl Now!

objects.text: Any companion you select with this now gains a complete copy of themselves along with this. The clone is an identical clone down to the smallest detail, though thankfully without the existential horror of being a clone. This can offer benefits, such as allowing spell users that thrive with more assistance to have that assistance with themselves. You can also choose to withhold or give modifiers to this one in particular, General or specific. You may take this option up to 5 times, the fifth time allowing you to clone as many of your companions as you wish.
objects.title: Clone City

objects.text:
Some of your companions now share a body… technically. 

While one of these companions has their body out in the real world, the other exists inside of their head, with the one on the ‘outside’ controlling when they swap back and forth. Neither companion has access to any abilities or equipment held by the others when they are ‘outside’. 

This can affect as many of your companions in whatever combination you like.
objects.title: Body Share

objects.text:
You can now swap the race of your companions with this modifier. If they were previously human, they can now be changed to any race in species that you choose. Besides any inherent racial abilities they have, their powers will otherwise be unaffected by this unless otherwise possible. 

The drawbacks to this is that it does not increase or decrease their base power, nor does it give anything beyond basic/necessary instincts of the species to use said abilities they gain. Possible examples include changing Jotaro Kujo from JJBA to a Saiyan, Kara Zor-El from DC to a Xenomorph, or Storm from Marvel to a Dragon, etc. You may take this option up to 5 times, the fifth time allowing you to swap species for as many of your companions as you wish.
objects.title: Species Swap

objects.text:
With each purchase, you may choose one of your companions to become a member of your family or their family. You can decide exactly how you are related, whether as siblings, cousins, childhood friends who are considered family, parent and child, or another appropriate familial relationship such as in-laws, etc. The chosen relationship is integrated seamlessly into both you and their history, with records, memories, and other details adjusting accordingly so that it feels as though you have always been related.

You may purchase this modifier multiple times, allowing you to establish family connections with multiple companions. Each purchase can be used on a different companion, and you may choose a different type of relationship each time. If you purchase this modifier 10 times, you may instead apply it automatically to as many companions as you desire, without needing to purchase it again.

Note: This is particularly useful if you intend to travel to one of your companion’s home universes. Having an established family relationship gives you a believable connection to them, allowing you to blend into their world without constantly having to explain to everyone how you know each other and how you meet. An it is even more useful if a person wants to gain some form of position of authority, that can only be gained from having some form of family relation to one of your companions.
objects.title: Family Ties
Absolute AU
objects.text:
Take a concept, a specific part of a character's being, and take that away from them. And yet, despite all that, have them remain as mostly their original selves. Their core remains in tact despite such huge change in their origins. That's what it means to be an Absolute Variant.

Take Batman for example and take away his wealth, or tear Wonderwoman away from Paradise and have her grow up in hell, or in more popular fanworks, have Steven Universe not have the Crystal Gems to help raise him, or the Absolute TMNT where they were all separated as babies.

Just remember, Absolute does NOT equal edge for edge's sake. It could be darker, yes, especially considering how a lot of other universes could be. But overall, you simply have to take a part of the character away from them while still keeping their overall core as similar. How that would work depends on how you interpret each companion.

objects.title: Bound to Object
objects.text:
Through this option, any companions you choose will become an Object of Power you own, be it a weapon, artifact, building, vehicle, or something more esoteric. They gain access to its abilities and full potential, but must become the object themselves.

If the Object of Power is already sentient, you may choose whether your companion replaces its existing mind, merges with it, or shares its body with the original consciousness.

If the object is large enough, such as a building or vehicle, your companion can briefly manifest physically to assist with its operation. This is easier with magical or sufficiently advanced technological Objects of Power. If capable, they may also create a permanent physical body through various means.

Should you possess a mental world, your companions can manifest within it in their original bodies to speak or train with you, regardless of distance.

You may take this option up to 5 times, with the fifth purchase allowing you to apply it to as many companions as you wish.

rows.title: General Companions Modifiers
rows.titleText:
This section allows the choice to optionally modify your companions. Whether the following options directly alter a companion’s personality or powers, or instead make them an alternate-reality version of the character, is entirely up to you.

Note: This section is entirely optional and serve solely for keeping track of changes if you’d prefer. Any and all changes here are already available via the blanket permissions given by the companion section, and customizations of a character are not limited solely to options here.

objects.text:
Guitulth Ddraigg Gwyn, the Dragon of Wales has had to leave the UK. While ostensibly this was due to a ‘cultural exchange’ between the US’s Protectorate and the King’s Men, the truth of the matter is rather more severe. 

Guitulth and his three children have always been the recipients of threats, this is common for any public cape. What is unusual is for the English Defense League to carry out an act of domestic terror on your home. A home containing three children.

Relocated to the US, specifically the perpetually understaffed and underfunded Protectorate East North East, Guitulth and his family are rather bitter about the whole affair. A tragedy allowing them to be pushed around like a bargaining chip. The eldest, Oen, has stayed in the UK to continue his education, leaving the middle and youngest in one of the worst cities in America.

Kingdom-side the South-West King's men are currently being led by Splitscreen (IV) while they search for a better fit internally. Stateside, Guitulth is a massive boon to the Brockton roster, a much needed ‘Heavy hitter’ that can act as a credible threat as much as a hero. It’s not for nothing a Dragon is a marketing slam dunk.
objects.title: American Dragons

objects.text:
Every Benjamin Tennyson in the omniverse has an Omnitrix. Well…. except for 3. One of those was due to his cousin, Gwendolyn Tennyson, being more destined to wear it. With this Omnitrix, Gwendolyn has access to all of Ben Prime’s aliens.

But the bonus is what she has despite that. Unlike a certain man’s statements about alternate Gwens, this one DOES keep her Annodite form and magic. And she can use the latter on top of various transformations. While Ben is the more creative and expressive of the two, Gwen is the more logical and curious.
objects.title: Gwendolyn Tendolyn (Ben 10)

objects.text: With this you can choose for less of the Metal Men to join you as companions, though since they usually operate as a unit this may be quite distressing. For each Metal man absent, the others will grow in experience or strength commensurately.
objects.title: Death of the Metal Men!

objects.text:
The Prince of All Saiyans and the Low-Class Saiyan Kakarot. One originally thrived under Lord Frieza’s rule, and the other went to Earth and gained much power. However, here? Vegeta was the one who arrived here due to a malfunctioning space pod, while Kakarot landed on a planet in the nearby System for Raditz to find. Vegeta lost most of his memory, besides his name and the fact that he’s an alien.

In this world, Vegeta mostly steamrolled competition, but due to a unique personality trait change, Vegeta DID seek out masters. In general, what this means for Vegeta is the following: He is closer to his Battle of Gods arc self, where he isn’t quite as angry all the time, and his pride isn’t as absolute. Vegeta’s technique repertoire includes Goku’s as well as his own, with some mixtures. And depending on when in the timeline you take him, he could have Super Saiyan 4, or even Super Saiyan God, or so on, like his main counterpart.
objects.title: A Prince Among Commoners (Dragon Ball)

objects.text:
With this Modifier, after the Cell Games, Gohan never stopped training. While still focusing on his studies and a regular life, Android 16 words and the results at end of the Games moved Gohan, who understood that to protect his loved ones he must have the strength to keep them safe.

As such, he grew up constantly sparring against Vegeta and the other Earth warriors, with his strength often matching (and surpassing) the former. Even though he is stronger and more willing to fight, his personality remains much the same: a good person who rather solves things with words than fists. By the time of Buu, he is in fact, equal to his father even at Super Saiyan 3 with only Super Saiyan 2, even if just barely.
objects.title: True Ultimate Gohan (Dragon Ball)

objects.text:
They say the Courier should’ve died that day. That Benny’s bullets should’ve done the job with them being put into Courier 6’s skull. But it seemed fate had a role for him to play. Or… many roles?

Due to an odd variable surrounding the Courier, suspected to be a “glitch in reality”, he has been given the ability to swap “Timelines” of himself, with memories transferred between them, thankfully, with no risk of insanity specifically from this process. One could be a rebel against the NCR who has access to the Archimedes laser, another could be a true heroine who has gone through the good routes of all DLC. Yet another could also be a Legion Sympathiser with combat training from the greatest of Caesar’s Legion. And finally, another could be a man who rules over a transferred New Vegas with Securitrons and many other defense systems.
objects.title: Multiversal Mailman (Fallout)

objects.text:
Maybe it was a mistake, maybe it was a deliberate choice, maybe it just had to be done, but whatever it may be, either or both of the Elric Brothers are now immortal. The souls of the many dead flows in their veins. The name of a sin is bestowed upon them. In the prime universe there's the Fullmetal Alchemist. In this one, we have Pride.

As stated prior, with this choice, either the brothers ended up becoming a Homunculus. Homunculi are resilient beings with the ability to keep regenerating so long as their cores, a Philosopher Stone, has the souls to fuel it. They are also long living, if not immortal. They can typically be identified with the Ouroboros mark on their body. Depending on the sin they are, they also possess some sort of ability (such as their body being able to harden as Greed, or becoming a fluid like water as 2003's Sloth). While the name Pride is used for this modifier, you are not limited in choosing this, which sin it is exactly is up to you.

As for how this affects their character, it depends on when they were turned and which version of homunculi we are talking about. Are they mistakes by alchemists seeking to bring the dead back such as in 2003? Then they would be similar yet not quite, like an imperfect copy of the one that was supposed to come back. If this is the Manga or Brotherhood, they would have to share their bodies with the original bearer of their sin. Or maybe you have a different interpretation on what they would be like? That is valid too.

Either way, you now have a nearly indestructible ally in your side. Whether that's a good thing or a bad thing, who knows? The sins normally don't act alone, especially if one of the brothers weren't turned together.
objects.title: Pride of their Father (Fullmetal Alchemist)

objects.text:
The citizens of Mondstadt never really believed Fischl's act, but the truth is sometimes much weirder than any fairy tale. Because Fischl is truly the reincarnation of the legendary princess of Immernachtreich. While she still wields an Electro Vision, her authority over darkness and the night has awakened, effectively making her the new deity of her own Element. However, she is still only a newly born god and can use barely a fraction of her true potential.

Anchored to Fischl's soul is a pocket dimension containing the entire Golden Apple Archipelago that she can freely enter and invite others to. Besides her grand castle and court of Night Ravens this includes the other islands and their domains, such as the Temple of the Star Latitudes. She can freely manipulate this realm, shifting the geography, raising or lowering the land, and even selectively changing physical laws to create places like flying islands.

Fischl's eyes actually have magical qualities as described in her story. Her right eye can perceive the true nature of all things, discerning falsehoods and seeing possible alternate timelines of everything in her sight. Then her left eye can impose 'judgment' on those things, switching the order of existence so that the target becomes their alternate expression, or dispelling their deception by forcing their true self to the forefront. However, due to her young age she still has poor control over this eye and has to keep it covered almost constantly to prevent accidental effects.

Besides that her control over elemental energy increases drastically, and her manifestation ability can create flocks of raven familiars, weapons, or wings directly from her back. In time Fischl will ascend to the level of the Archons, with the authority to hand out Umbra Visions that focus on manipulating shadows.
objects.title: Princess of Immernachtreich (Genshin Impact)

objects.text:
Thanks to this modifier, Gojira and Mosura possess the ability to freely shift between their colossal Kaiju forms and humanoid bodies. In their humanoid states, they retain their intelligence, personalities, and a fraction of their immense power, allowing them to exist within human society without immediately leveling the surrounding city. As a result, the titles King of the Monsters and Queen of the Monsters have evolved beyond simple epithets and become formal positions recognized by both humanity and the world’s Kaiju population.

This change came about through an unusual political development: the two ancient titans are legally married and jointly hold sovereignty over a remote Pacific territory known as Monster Island. The island serves as a sanctuary, territory, and capital for Kaiju activity, while also functioning as a diplomatic bridge between humanity and the planet’s more destructive inhabitants.

The exact nature of their marriage is left up to you. It may be a purely political alliance designed to stabilize relations between monsters and mankind, a mutually respectful partnership formed after countless battles fought side by side, a genuine romantic bond between two ancient beings, or something more complex that only they fully understand. Whatever the truth, the arrangement has endured long enough that most governments treat it as an established geopolitical reality.

Their unusual union has also produced heirs of a sort. Gojira Junior and Mothra Leo are widely regarded as the next generation of Kaiju royalty, with both of them also possessing the ability to shift forms. Whether they are literal offspring, chosen successors, or symbolic princes of Monster Island is for you to decide, but regardless, the two are often treated as the inheritors of their parents’ legacy.

Because of this status, Gojira and Mosura are no longer seen solely as unstoppable disasters but as sovereign powers in their own right. In their humanoid forms, they attend diplomatic meetings, negotiate treaties, influence global policy regarding Kaiju management, and occasionally intervene when conflicts between humanity and other monsters threaten to spiral out of control. Their existence has given rise to an entirely new field of diplomacy centered on Kaiju relations, environmental protection, and maintaining the balance between civilization and the natural world.
objects.title: Titan Shifter Family (Godzilla Franchise)

objects.text: Harry Potter’s parents, James and Lily Potter, originally died on October 31st, 1981. But with this… Harry never lost his parents. On top of getting Lily and James with Harry, he has turned out quite a bit different than in canon. His skills, knowledge, and overall abilities have increased by a substantial amount thanks to actual parenting help and guidance. In particular, even if you were to take a 7th-year Harry, he would be on the level of Dumbledore.
objects.title: The Boy Who Thrived (Harry Potter)

objects.text:
Instead of Vox as he is, you get Vox at his theoretical peak, if he had achieved his goal of taking Heaven for his own and seizing the throne of God.

Vox gains access to a level of angelic power surpassing Lucifer, Sera, Emily, Adam, and the other elders of heaven combined, making him essentially almighty. He is effectively invulnerable to damage, can create anything imaginable with a snap of his fingers, is able to casually smite foes with enough angelic energy to shatter planets, and at a thought can access detailed information on everything that has ever happened or ever will happen in the universe since the dawn of time, just to start with.

Mentally, Vox is in an odd place. Despite being (arguably justifiably) immensely prideful of the position he’s risen to, his insatiable drive to climb even higher has not been curbed. If a mediating influence doesn’t enter his life soon he’s liable to break down in a destructive fashion searching for an even more dramatic way to prove himself.
objects.title: VOX DEI (Hazbin Hotel)

objects.text:
When the Second Vessel, known as the Knight or Little Ghost, became the Lord of Shades and defeated the Absolute Radiance, they lost control of themselves and would have consumed all of Hallownest had it not been for the Everbloom Flower they gave to the Godseeker banishing them. However, here things went a bit differently as the Delicate Flower instead stabilized them, resulting in them truly becoming the Void given Focus they were meant to be.

Your Companion is now none other than the God of Gods, the Void given Focus itself. Thanks to the flower's blessing, the Lord of Shades can bring their full power to bare, both for helping and protecting people and for annihilating any threats you face, as they will quickly master their powers until they reach the full potential of As Above, So Below, The Void Is All (Hollow Knight).

As a bonus, they may assume their original Vessel form at will, reforming their shell and all, though this is a mere facade that can be broken in an instant if needed.
objects.title: Lord of Shades (Hollow Knight)

objects.text:
Just when you thought damn, is there even anything more for Davepeta to pursue considering they've basically reached their peak? Well with this, they can go even further beyond!

Due to some more patented Homestuck Shennanigans™, Davepeta did what other mere tutorial "NPCs" like them couldn't do, Get Tiger- I mean, go Godtier. As such, they gain Conditional Immortality, meaning they cannot be killed UNLESS it is a Heroic Death (them dying for a good cause like sacrificing themselves) or a Just Death (them dying because they have to be stopped like if they get corrupted for example). This is judged via a Godtier Clock, which judges each death and so long as it is neither, they are revived fully healed.

Not only that, they gain the abilities of a Godtiered Knight of Time and Rogue of Heart too. As a Knight of Time they possess Dave's powers of time manipulation, such as time stopping, time travel, manifesting time clones, etc. As a Rogue of Heart meanwhile, they gain soul manipulation abilities, able to rip out their enemy's souls and swap them into different bodies to mess with them.

Finally, maybe due to how they managed to ascend, but Davesprite and Nepeta are now able to separate themselves from each other temporarily, both sporting a much more confident view of themselves. This helps a lot with multitasking, and the two do enjoy being able to be their old selves again, even though they ultimately feel more free as one being.

This is Davepeta Ascended. This is Davepeta's Ultimate Self.
objects.title: Davepeta Ascended (Homestuck)

objects.text:
Carl, a far kinder and more personable version of the ancient Viltrumite. Carl still possesses the memories and history of Conquest, but his personality is dramatically different. Rather than being a sadistic conqueror who delights in violence, he is patient, friendly, and surprisingly easygoing, with a dry sense of humor and an appreciation for the simple pleasures he was never allowed to enjoy during his life as a weapon of the Viltrumite Empire.

Carl is ashamed of his Viltrumite heritage, given all the genocide and slaughter he and others have done, but can be intimidating when necessary. He has a genuine respect for other peoples and cultures, preferring to talk more than fight. He is protective of those he considers friends, possesses a somewhat grandfatherly disposition toward younger companions, and has little interest in proving himself through conquest. While he retains the terrifying potential and memories of Conquest, Carl is ultimately defined by the fact that he wants to live as his own person rather than as the title the Empire gave him.
objects.title: Carl (Invincible)

objects.text: "I lost my friends in Egypt all those years ago... I never stopped training so I never lost anyone ever again." Jotaro Kujo, the Great-Great Grandson of Jonathan Joestar, and the Grandson of Joseph Joestar, had a very tragic life in a way. Essentially born to a fate to kill Dio Brando, losing his best friends after gaining them all within 2 months, and legitimately almost dying from his own hand. And even after this, he lost another friend without even knowing about it. Finally, he died trying to protect his own child and his friends... and failed. This is all due, in part, to his lack of consistent training of his Stand, Star Platinum, and its abilities. But in this timeline, something changed. Whether it be the near-death experience, or the birth of his daughter Jolyne Kujo, or something else, Jotaro never stopped training his Stand. He did his best to advance his Stands strength and capabilities, coming up with ways to use it that would only make it stronger. Depending on when this Jotaro comes from, he could possibly have even surpassed the Vampire Dio's time stop of 9 seconds and more. Personality-wise, Jotaro has also been made more open and emotional, although not to the greatest extent. If accompanied by his relatives however, he will be very synergistic with them.
objects.title: Ocean Man (JoJo's Bizarre Adventure)

objects.text:
In Stardust Crusaders, when Jotaro faced off against Dio, he found that his Stand, Star Platinum, had the same power of stopping time as The World. No one ever really questioned the sheer improbability of the two enemies having identical Stands, just chalking it up to Fate or something like that. While this might be the case in other realities, in this one it is because Star Platinum's true power is power copying.

When Jotaro faces off against an Antagonist, that is someone Jotaro is dead set on defeating at any cost, Star Platinum begins to analyze their powers and copy it. At first it starts with lesser aspects like resistance to their own powers, for example allowing JoJo to perceive and eventually move in a stopped time. Eventually however, if the fight drags on long enough, it'll copy the full power, allowing JoJo to use it to the same extent as his foe.

This power does have a handful of weaknesses. Minions working for the Antagonist don't count for this power, so he won't get dozens of powers from fighting off one organization. For another, there must be real, long term, and deep seated investment on JoJo's part to defeat them; simply fighting off someone he met that day won't count, he has to have been actively working towards defeating them for at least a week for it to deem them a big enough threat to target. On top of that, it only works when he is directly fighting facing his foe, taking at least half an hour of fighting to copy at full power. This is why he never reached the same length of stopped time as Dio, because he died before the process was complete. Finally, if not maintained through training, the power will very slowly fade over the course of several years.

Still, with this power Jotaro is much stronger than Canon, having at least a half dozen powers he can freely use including The World, Killer Queen, and Whitesnake, the last of which gives him even more options for Stand Powers and can even empower allies too. As a consequence of this, Pucci is Fated to lose as even if he attains the power of Made in Heaven, Jotaro will simply catch right back up with him no matter how fast he moves, especially as Made in Heaven's time acceleration power reduces the time needed to copy other Stands.
objects.title: The Same Kind of Stand (Jojo's Bizarre Adventure)

objects.text:
With this Modifier, Megumi Fushiguro reaches nearly all of his potential before the events of Jujutsu Kaisen. Through rigorous training and better guidance, he successfully tames every Ten Shadows shikigami except Mahoraga, mastering their abilities and freely combining them in combat.

He also masters Reverse Cursed Technique for both healing and output enhancement, and develops advanced partial manifestations, allowing him to summon individual traits of his shikigami—such as claws, wings, or tails—without fully materializing them.

His martial skill reaches the level of the strongest Grade 1 and Special Grade sorcerers, seamlessly integrating hand-to-hand combat with the Ten Shadows Technique. He makes extensive use of Binding Vows to strengthen or modify his technique, trading aspects such as duration, availability, or personal restrictions for increased power, versatility, and faster growth.

By the start of the series, Megumi is a confirmed Special Grade sorcerer with a refined Domain Expansion that fully incorporates his tamed shikigami. While still calm and tactical, he possesses the confidence, experience, and ability expected of one of the strongest modern sorcerers, without requiring later awakenings to realize his potential.
objects.title: Megumi "The Man" Fushigoro (Jujutsu Kaisen)

objects.text:
When his adoptive father developed cancer, instead of studying the occult and performing a ritual to sell his soul to Mephisto in exchange for a cure, Johnny chose to study theology and firmly believed that God would send an angel to heal him.

He prayed with all his heart, and Heaven listened. Johnny’s father was cured and even had a change of heart, deciding to stop performing dangerous stunts for the sake of his family and to find a safer job. However, this was not the end of it, as Johnny was soon contacted by a messenger of Heaven who told him he had a great destiny and had been chosen to become the host for a powerful angel, one meant to enact God’s will on Earth. Johnny, feeling immensely grateful, accepted his new role and became a man of faith.

As the Ghost Rider, host to a Spirit of Justice, Johnny Blaze possesses all the standard powers of a Spirit of Vengeance, though with some differences, such as angelic wings for flight. Instead of the ability to create and manipulate hellfire, the angel grants him the power to wield a holy light that is extremely effective against the sinful and demonic. This holy light cannot harm the innocent and also allows Johnny to heal nearly any injury of anyone he chooses, while truly evil beings and demons are outright disintegrated. Rather than summoning ordinary chains, Johnny can call forth the Chains of Heaven, which are even more effective against demonic entities.

The Penance Stare has also changed. Instead of simply punishing the target, it forces them to repent for their sins. The victim feels the full weight of their life, both the good and the bad, as their own soul turns against them in a desperate attempt to atone for every wrong they have committed. If the target truly repents, they experience an overwhelming sense of peace as their sins are cleansed. However, against demonic entities, this stare completely erases them and inflicts intense pain and damage on more powerful beings.
objects.title: Spirit of Justice (Marvel)

objects.text: Usually, Danger doesn’t really have a name. She spent decades as a literal room, practically enslaved to train her father’s X-Men. Not so much anymore. In this world, after discovering he’d accidentally created life, Charles Xavier chose not to ignore her in favour of his new class. Instead, this Xavier freed his new daughter. Unsurprisingly, having a technopathic machine actively on the New Mutants, and later the X-Men has had a few effects. Sentinels are far less dangerous as a whole when she’s present, Charles Xavier ends up less morally bankrupt (if still paternalistic and scheming) etc. Most pressing to Danger herself, she’s far better adjusted, most of her neuroses that are usually wrapped up in feelings of confinement and parental abandonment, are instead centred around her being a machine surrounded by humans who can’t really understand her or her thought processes, her decisions being primarily emotive but dangerously overclocked by a supercomputer that believes (often just as mistakenly as her own father) to be operating in her own best interest. Another more recent cause for distress is the very real fact she doesn’t have a soul, which is naturally quite distressing.
objects.title: Danger Xavier (Marvel)

objects.text: Originally, Danger broke out when her father was practically exiled, but alive. While the fight wasn’t healthy or constructive for either it was at least cathartic. This Danger however, broke out after Charles Xavier was already deceased. Denied any kind of closure (or confirmation she was right), Danger pushed in the opposite direction. Charles Xavier was right, he was a visionary. And when they killed him they didn't even keep his name on the school. Danger stopped being an individual, she buried herself into the ground and started growing her “family”. Isolated again, she’s getting ready to unleash her children on the world. Not as a plague, nothing so gauche. Rather, much like the version of her father she’s built up internally, she sees herself as a shepherd to a new species. A machine people to share the world with their predecessors, Homo Superior. The irony has never been lost on her.
objects.title: Mistress Mold (Marvel)

objects.text:
When Jennifer Walters received a blood transfusion from her cousin Bruce Banner, her compatibility with gamma radiation proved far greater than anyone could have anticipated. Not only did she become as strong as the Hulk and gain the ability to switch between forms at will, but she also developed environmental adaptability, allowing her to breathe underwater, survive in a vacuum, and even developed the ability to perceive spiritual beings.

Jennifer’s connection to the One Below All essentially transformed her into an Avatar of Destruction, granting her the ability to annihilate anything through sheer brute force. She also gained the ability to grow exponentially stronger the angrier she becomes, with no upper limit. Once her anger reaches a certain threshold, she can assume her Titan Hulk form. In addition, she acquired intuitive control over the power of the Green Door, enabling her to return to life no matter how—or how often—she dies, and even to reopen the passage should anyone lock the Green Door.

While these abilities have made her one of the strongest members of the Avengers, they have also burdened her with a compulsion to destroy as destruction incarnate. Although she can control this urge, it lingers at the back of her mind, threatening to surface should she ever lose control.
objects.title: World-Breaker She-Hulk (Marvel)
Ultra (Marvel)
objects.text: In a former life, Ultron had been built by Hank Pym, modeled off of his own brain pattern, had achieved sentience and wished to destroy the avengers, and eventually humanity. This Ultron had a deep-seated hatred that even he couldn't explain for humanity, or generally anything that lived. This Ultron become one of the greatest supervillains of the Avengers roster, and Marvel universe in general. However,What if? things'd been different? With this modifier, Hank instead used the patterns of his wife, Janet Van Dyne, in the creation of "Ultra-A." This version of Ultron, while being fearful and aggressive at first, was pacified without need to delete her or the like thanks to Janet's rationality kicking in. Working with her mother and father, as she firmly called them despite their insistence to using their regular names, she eventually became Ultra-E, the first humanoid model. With this, she decided to become an Avenger of her own freewill. Essentially having Ultron's moveset slightly modified, she utilizes her mother and father's programmed skills to their fullest, including a supply of rationed Pym Particles, preferring to knock people out cold to avoid causing unnecessary pain. Optionally, you can choose to pick an Ultra from further down the refinements, making up what they might've given her.

Roll has decided she wants to help more directly with her brother in the field. In response, Light has given her a "Mega" form of her own, Hyper Roll.

Now, Rock has his sister alongside him. Besides her own natural skills, she now has the ability to transform into a Support to Mega Man's offense. She possesses heightened durability, capable of taking endless punishment from powerful attacks like they were nothing, being more durable than her brother, if not as physically strong in combat. Hyper Roll also possesses a database of medical treatment techniques for human beings, although more esoteric beings is outside of her wheelhouse without research.

The cream of the crop is her "Mega Medi" on her arm. Cycling through medicines developed in her body, she can heal anyone with a shot from her cannon, despite it looking like it should INJURE people. One shot from her cannon, and she could likely heal you from near death no matter the injury if given long enough to "charge" her shot. She also has robot repair kits in her non-Mega Medi arm for on the field repair of her brother. Her antennae can shoot electricity as a defense mechanism, but only to the extent of a powerful mundane taser.

This has lead Mega Man and Hyper Roll to working together insanely well as a team, and Rock seeing his sister as great to have on the field with him in a battle, even being playful outside of it with each others altered form.
objects.title: Hyper Roll (Mega Man)

objects.text:
In this world, Izuku Midoriya’s father, Hiashi Midoriya, was an Alias for that of Zen Midoriya. After Inko Midoriya died in a car crash mere days after the declaration of Midoriya’s quirklessness, Zen had a very twisted sense of “compassion”, deciding to adopt the boy off the streets. Alongside a then-10-year-old Tomura, Midoriya was raised into a very dangerous threat. However, he does have certain weaknesses.

Compared to his older “brother”, Izuku is a lot more bloodthirsty and sadistic, hating the idea of not playing with his suffering food. As well, he no longer has the Quirk known as One for All. Instead, he has been given a quirk based on manipulating the very air to his whim, although depending on how old he is, he isn’t very great with it.
objects.title: Izuku Shigaraki (My Hero Academia)

objects.text: The boy known as Izuku Midoriya was thrust into the power One for All. This quirk gives 7 quirks in one, combined with a stockpile effect of power. But Midoriya's body was initially unable to handle this initially and even risked his life at multiple points to handle it. But now with this, Midoriya has One for All on top of another power system. He will be treated body-wise as if he had this power system first before the quirk, so in some way, it's possible his body will be able to handle One for All easier. OFA will not cause him to explode with this new power system and will adapt instead to keep itself in check around it. Any power system considered widely used is viable for Deku, although he does still need to learn how to use the system beyond the instincts needed to say, not blow up, or accidentally use his power. He could have Haki, Chakra, common species powers (Ex: Saiyan isn't eligable but any species that's common is on the table)
objects.title: True One for All (My Hero Academia)

objects.text:
All for One found Izuku on a rooftop, a quirkless boy who had just been told by his childhood friend that he should jump and hope for a quirk in his next life. Where All Might would have inspired hope, All for One offered Izuku power, purpose, and a family that would never mock him for being quirkless.

This proved to be a terrifying boon for the villain's ambitions. Izuku's analytical mind was turned toward identifying weaknesses in heroes and security systems. His heroic desire to save others was twisted by All for One's careful grooming into a conviction that true peace required absolute control, that the ends of a unified world justified any means. The result was a successor who succeeded where Tomura failed in every conceivable way. Izuku's stability meant no tantrums undermining serious operations. His strategic genius meant plans with actual contingencies. His genuine charisma drew followers who believed in his vision rather than just fearing his master. His dedication meant that he inherited the full All For One Quirk far earlier and with little strain.

When All for One's vestige manifested within him, expecting to slowly assert control over a new vessel, it found itself facing something unexpected. Izuku's will succeeded in integrated the vestige into himself. All for One's skills, his centuries of accumulated knowledge, his strategic genius, even his demeanor now belong to Izuku as thoroughly as if they were his own.
objects.title: All for Deku (My Hero Academia)

objects.text: "I was just a young, obsessed middle schooler when I wanted to become a hero. But the world has a way of changing you, of making you see things in a new light. And sometimes boys... need to put away his lust for babes... to truly become a cool hero!" With this modifier, whether due to coincidence, an accident, or whatever else you desire, Minoru Mineta has lost a vast majority of his interest for girls. While it's down to a more normal level, It has been replaced with a desire to truly be the most sought after hero of all time! In practicality, this means Mineta had the kick in his ass to truly improve early on, even before U.A. Mineta becomes far more skilled in martial arts based around his quirk like throwing weapons or grapples. While this doesn't necessarily make him a god, It makes him physically stronger, and even on the verge of a Quirk awakening at the time of taking him, if you give him a sufficient breakthrough to achieve. If he achieves this awakening, It'll give his quirk far more versatility. His body acts as one big ball for the purposes of his power, able to activate or deactivate stickiness on any part of his body allowing him to spider-climb or more. Finally, his quirk can allow the balls to change their properties, from frag-grenades that blast multiple smaller balls out of one big one, or sacks meant to hold various chemical effects he can decide.
objects.title: Perv-Man No More (My Hero Academia)

objects.text: Naruto no longer possesses the Nine-Tailed Fox inside of him… in fact, this modifier makes it so that, rather than putting the Nine-Tails into Naruto as a last-ditch effort, Minato actually defeated Obito before he could rip the Nine-Tails out of Kushina in the first place via Minato using Sage Mode. This has led to an overall decrease in Naruto's capability. While indeed, his chakra is no longer horribly ineffective and being messed with, AND he has Minato and Kushina to have trained him and helped him out, he no longer has access to the vast chakra the Nine Tails allows him. Thus, no Nine-Tails Chakra Mode, or any tailed beast form for that matter. The benefit, however, is that he at least still has Sage Mode and better diversity in his jutsu variety.
objects.title: Nine-Tails No-More (Naruto)

objects.text: "You know Sasuke, there's a chance our roles could've been reversed." Naruto, instead of rising up despite the village's hatred of him and choosing to try to become Hokage in order to earn their respect, ended up growing isolated and bitter, culminating in his almost inevitable decision to leave the village that shunned him. With Naruto ending up deciding that he must pursue strength to make the world accept him, by any means necessary. Sasuke, meanwhile, instead of being consumed by hatred and need for vengeance against the brother that killed his entire family, he instead dedicated his life into being the only pillar left of his clan. With him wanting to honor their legacy by rebuilding what is left of the Uchiha and possibly trying to become Hokage in order to achieve that. This leads to two entirely different paths for the two men. With Naruto being the Missing-Nin that Sasuke is trying desperately to save. The specifics is left up to you, either way, Sasuke isn't going to give up until he brings his dumb friend home. This is Multiselect, picking 1 means you are only changing the fate of one of them, be it Naruto or Sasuke, picking 2 means that both of their fates are swapped.
objects.title: Naruto and Sasuke: Paths Diverge (Naruto)

objects.text:
Whether it be through a change of attitude after losing Sasuke, or something shifted in how she was raised in canon, Sakura's character diverged heavily. No longer was she far too devoted to Sasuke, instead, she had begun looking into herself first and foremost. She is done feeling like a burden. Sakura shall now prove once and for all that she's strong too.

Now this change in mentality may boost Sakura further in her ninja training. She may still remain a great medic nin, but she may also broaden her horizons, such as access to Water and Earth jutsus, stronger taijutsu as per Lee and Guy's training, to even potentially gaining Slug Sage Mode which works incredibly well with her already prodigy level chakra control. She could even go in other new directions in her career, such as learning to wield more weapons like dual battle-axes, or even learn the darker sides of ninjutsu through somebody like Kabuto or Orochimaru. Her horizons are broadened, and she's more willing to do what it takes to catch up to her team, even if she was a mere mortal amongst demigods such as Naruto and Sasuke. Whatever her new build may be, depends on you.

As for her personality, not only is she more headstrong and focused than she was already in canon, but her love for Sasuke definitely waned a bit. She may still care for him, but she is definitely willing to put him down if it means protecting her loved ones. Whether that means she still ends up with him or not will depend on you.

Either way, Sakura is now actively trying to prove she isn't as helpless as others may perceive her to be. She may not have the blood of legends in her veins, but she is proving she could go toe to toe with the very best of the ninja world. This is her very best. This is Sakura's strength.
objects.title: Sakura's Strength (Naruto)

objects.text: Nier fought hell and back to get his sister back. It would be only fair that he be able to bring her along. Yonah is a 12 years old replicant, without any power or fighting skill. She can't contribute in a fight but will give her best to contribute in any other way, and by bringing her along Nier and the gang will be forever in your debt. Her health is also in perfect condition… though that contributes little to her cooking skills.
objects.title: Yonah (NieR: Replicant)

objects.text: Nurarihyon and Hagoromo Gitsune come with their Hyakki Yakō’s. Nurarihyon is the leader of the biggest yokai clan in eastern Japan, while Hagoromo Gitsune is the leader of all Kyoto yokai.
objects.title: Hyakki Yakō (Nurarihyon no Mago)

objects.text:
With this modifier, Luffy no longer dreams of becoming a Pirate King. Instead, due to various circumstances, he has joined his grandfather in the Marines! This has proved to be quite the boon in some ways. Luffy was still thrown through plenty of dangerous training, but with his grandpa there to help him along with his Devil Fruit, he has gained a more outright heroic mindset and a formidable arsenal.

He has been taught the fighting style Rokushiki (even Rokugan), and with his rubber body has shown higher growth. His access to the Voice of All Things is more concrete, and he is overall book-smarter than in canon. A final benefit is that his Justice is “Free Justice”: if he feels someone is truly innocent of the crime, only then will he actually let them go from a fight or from being brought in.
objects.title: Monkey D. Luffy, Man of Marines! (One Piece)

objects.text:
With this Modifier, Aigis awakens to the power of the Wild Card she gained after the death of Minato Arisato/Kotone Shiomi in March 2010, which she then refined in the Abyss of Time. Now in addition to using her native Personas Palladion and Pallas Athena, she is capable of wielding both the Personas and Theurgies her leader was able to use, in addition to both of her native Theurgies Orgia Mode and Maximum Firepower.

She also gains the various weapon upgrades she outfitted herself with in the Arena games, including Extreme Orgia Mode and Heritage Liberator Palladion as new Theurgies.
objects.title: Aigis the Wild Card (Persona 3 FES: The Answer)

objects.text:
In one universe Pyrrha Nikos died, and in this one Jaune Arc died. For as much as things changed, they still remained similar enough for the plot to follow fate’s strings.

And that included Pyrrha Nikos taking Jaune’s place and ending up trapped in the Ever After for decades. In those decades she trained her skills and Semblance, waiting for Team RWBY to fall.

As a result, the children’s tale “The Girl Who Fell Through the World” doesn’t feature the Rusted Knight, but instead the Tarnished Spartan.
objects.title: Tarnished Spartan (RWBY)

objects.text:
During Marguerite Breuil's reign on the Throne, a Hegemony God named Hajun was born and eventually threatened all of existence. While he was narrowly defeated in another timeline, here he succeeded and ascended to the Throne. The only reason everything wasn't destroyed was Ren emanating his own Law of stagnation. As time went on, he eventually lost his pre-Hajun memories and barely remembers his love for Marguerite, instead focusing on the downfall of Hajun and becoming Tenma Yato, the leader of the Yatsukahagi (a team consisting of the remnants of his friends and former enemies).

He doesn't need to emanate his Law or manifest his Briah for his time abilities as he can manifest the power of Eine Faust Finale with his Time Armor, which also nullifies all attacks weaker than him. He can physically manifest his Law into his Kamunagara, a red-haired Naga half the size of Japan. Using his blood connection to Mercurius, he can summon a storm of meteors that can utterly destroy a battlefield down to the Earth's mantle.

His Holy Relic, Margueritte-Bois de Justice, now comes as scythes emerging from his back that have enough power to slice a star and cut the universe. Furthermore, he can shoot ranged version of his scythes that launch as a destructive light. He can cry tears of blood that becomes an army of spiders the size of bears that multiply instantly.
objects.title: Tenma Yato (Shinza Bansho)

objects.text:
With this modifier, the Aleena you meet is not the exiled Queen of a world under tyranny but instead a woman who is the definition of rags to riches and an icon of self-betterment in a world more in line with the Game / IDW canon.

Abandoned in the wilds as an orphan, this Aleena found comfort in her love of music and would use her talents to build a company with the power of a nation. The definition of a Renaissance Woman, Aleena led her company into becoming a megacorporation that improves the quality of life of the people and ensures the betterment of the world; from farming, scientific research, education, medicine, and even stepping into space exploration.

All the while studying new things from science and magic for the fun of learning, what this means is that while Aleena has far more theoretical knowledge than her original Underground self, she has less hands-on experience in active combat. Not to say she has no experience, as she does have some small adventures under her belt, with her besting Dr. Eggman at least once on her own, but it doesn't compare to the years of active use Queen Aleena has.

While having no children of her own, she is fond of sponsoring others and would effectively 'soft' adopt Sonic, Sonia, and Manic to make the three siblings via adoption rather than blood given the chance. This, of course, means she would do this for others like Tails and a very young Hedgehog girl by the name of Tania (who in one continuity is Sonic / Nicky's younger sister).

Note: Should you have the 'Council of Four' addon, then you are able to change the version of Mobius to one of the other versions of the planet / Sonic's world, with the whole planet acting as the headquarters of Aleena's company.
objects.title: Self Made Woman (Sonic Underground)

objects.text: With this modifier, you get a Luke who went down a different route than his canon counterpart. Here, Luke Skywalker kept his nephew Ben Solo from going down the dark side by catching the influence from Snoke early and having a talk with Ben. With this, his Jedi order and training thrived, giving him much more experience with the Force. He still went to Ach-To, but simply to learn. What this gives you is a Luke Skywalker still full of compassion, strategy, and even more physically able than before. For example, casting a force illusion across the galaxy will not, in fact, kill him, but will indeed leave him winded for a while.
objects.title: Grandmaster Skywalker (Star Wars)

objects.text: The events leading up to the birth of Senator Amidala's twin children are largely unchanged. However, thanks to this modifier, Darth Vader's inadvertently uxoricidal assault of the original timeline has had vastly different consequences past the point of his children's birth. Thanks to the internal damage Padmé suffered while so far along in her pregnancy, the blood of mother and foetuses has mixed in a way it was not supposed to- and as a result Padmé has become Force Sensitive at a level just below that of Vader himself.
