Furthermore, that development tightens the emotional bond with her newborn children, giving her the momentum to keep fighting and ultimately survive childbirth. Palpatine will still tell Vader she's dead, because it serves his purpose even though he didn't truly know even in canon that that was the case. Padmé will insist on raising her children, and be joined by Obi-Wan, who will become her Jedi Master, and eventually help teach her children. They will live in seclusion on the wilds of Tatooine, secure in the knowledge neither Sith will ever truly want to return to that planet. By the time her children come of age, Padmé would be a powerful, fully trained Jedi Knight, bordering on the level of a Master, in all typical skills and powers of such Jedi, on top of her other pre-existing abilities. Her children would themselves be on the level of newly-raised knights, if somewhat more powerful in the Force than their mother (thought slightly below their father). In this timeline, Anakin's lightsaber is wielded by Padmé, who will insist on using it until she can bury the wraith of her dead husband (in other words, kill Darth Vader). Once he is dead, she may or not want to make a new one for herself, but such is not possible until she resolves her past.
objects.title: The Phantom of Tatooine (Star Wars)

objects.text:
Instead of returning to Earth to live his human life as he does in canon, Steven ended up deciding that in order to maintain peace in the galaxy, he must rise up to take the missing place his mother had left, with him taking her throne amongst his fellow Diamond Authorities.

Years passed, and this results in a more actively peaceful galaxy, with Steven setting up societal reforms amongst gemkind to make up for the atrocities the Diamonds had caused. This also results in a huge change in Steven's personality, as years away from his human half led to him growing colder and more alien. Who knows if this change is for the better or not, as Steven may need somebody to remind him of the human half he is starting to forget.

Heavy is the crown, and Homeworld is rather lonely. Despite the love his family is showing, maybe it won't take any longer until Steven's mental state cracks under the pressure he is putting himself under.
objects.title: Diamond Authority Steven (Steven Universe)

objects.text:
It seems you have come into a lucky situation. At the minimum, 10 years has passed since Operation Strix was a success. And since then (or even during if you so desire), The forger family has fully discovered all 4 of each others secrets. And despite that, they all still love each other and all this has really done is brought them closer than ever. In particular benefit, is the little girl known as Anya Forger.

10 years has done a lot for Anya's skills and capabilities. She has been trained by her mother and father to be quite capable of defending herself. No longer does she get by purely on luck for intelligence, she is actually a little above average for someone her age, especially thanks to her years in such a high-class school and far better help catered to her. And for combat, she has the stealth and precision of a spy, and the elegance and strength of an assassin.

Finally, Anya's telepathy has gotten quite a bit better due to her age and certain neurotransmitters in her brain. Now, she can detect the thoughts, if she so chooses, of anyone she knows about halfway across a metropolitan city and much clearer. As for the rest of her family, all are in prime physical condition, and even Bond is still alive and very healthy, his future sight being a bit clearer even if still not perfect on context.
objects.title: Her Parents' Daughter (Spy x Family)

objects.text:
Throughout a local multiverse cluster, there is one girl able to travel it all: Cirilla Fiona Elen Riannon, otherwise known as Ciri. For 6 months of her life, she spent it in a place that, as she would describe it, had men with metal inside of them, machines that flew in the air, and war was waged from a distance. However, this version of Ciri is if she eventually decided to settle down, or at least come back more than once, in this chaotic world.

Her handle, C, allowed Ciri to thrive in this world. For a little while, she was a model for eurodollars which actually served her well. Besides the essential Cyberware, like a Neuroport, Interfact plugs, etc, she has also gotten a Sandivestan installed in her. Not quite top of the line, but a cut above street grade. Keeping her original weaponry and gear, she also uses guns, but not nearly as well as her swordsmanship or magic without training.

Personality-wise, This Ciri is at home both in fantasy AND Cyberpunk-like settings. She's picked up some of the terms, mixing it with her original way of talking, and is generally more open for excitement. "A controlled Thrill-Seeker" is what one Pacifica resident called her. Ciri will be able to travel to Cyberpunk in your local multiverse cluster, and take you with her without issue.
objects.title: C (The Witcher)

objects.text:
This is Shirou Emiya from a worldline where he wasn't only adopted and trained by Kiritsugu Emiya, but was also the heir to the legacy of Sengo Muramasa. Long before his death, Muramasa learned to use his inborn magic circuits and created a lineage dedicated to fulfilling his dream of forging a sword that cuts Karma. Shirou possesses a magecrest containing over 500 years of magical knowledge: blacksmithing spells, reinforcement techniques, and countless formulas for forging mystic codes, letting him work metal and mystery with equal finesse.

Though he still carries his adopted father's old desire to become a hero, it has been tempered into something steadier and more focused. He entered the Clock Tower under the name Shirou Muramasa, studied under Waver Velvet, and later took part in several cases that shaped the latter reputation. His years as an enforcer gave him real combat experience, though he never accepted contracts that crossed the line of his own beliefs. Over time he expanded his arsenal far beyond swords into a diverse collection of bladed weapons and self-made mystic codes.

He has completed his Reality Marble and can manifest it with the support of his mystic codes and magecrest, granting him greater magical energy. Unlike his canonical counterpart, this Shirou will not allow his obsession with saving others to destroy him; he is dedicated to fulfilling his ancestor's dream.
objects.title: Heir of the Blacksmith (Type-Moon)

objects.text: "I have offended God and mankind because my work did not reach the quality it should have." On her death bed, Leonardo Da Vinci—despite her genius—lamented the fact that she never achieved everything she wished to; She was a chronic procrastinator, left many works unfinished and assessed that stealing the Arno river was unfeasable. Da Vinci was limited by the technology of her time and by her own mind, thus she never truly flourished. This is no longer the case. You now gain the Leonardo Da Vinci that reached her theoretical peak, the Leonardo who wasn't paralysed by her own genius and became the giant shoulders that Italy stood atop of forever more. She created works of art that made men weep, pushed boundaries that modern scholars decry impossible and surpassed the mages of old, including those savants that utilized the foundation of the divine. Additionally, much to the wonder and horror of the Clocktower, Da Vinci created her own Thaumatological Foundation. This Foundation relies on the progress of mankind, the dissolution of mystery and the propagation of the Scientific Method. This has affected her legend and consequently, her status as a Heroic Spirit. Da Vinci may now ascend to The Station of the Crown to become The Grand Caster, an existence incomparable to her former self. Leonardo Da Vinci has set mankind upon the road towards the Age of Will. She now truly lives up to her title of The Omnipotent Genius.
objects.title: Omnipotence Realised (Type-Moon)

objects.text: This version of Taylor is a Shaker rather than Master, though one of similar principle. Rather than control over arthropods, this version of Taylor can manipulate dust, or any sufficiently small solid particulate, in a 4 block radius. Along with her notorious multitasking, she has an equally great precision, allowing her to create highly complex structures at miniscule scales.
objects.title: Speck (Worm)

objects.text: On January 3rd, 2011, a young teenage girl suffered a trigger event. This sent her to the hospital while 3 girls got off scot-free from the crime. However, where the original Taylor Anne Hebert gained the power to control Arthropods like bugs and more, becoming a person MORE than willing to do wrong things for the sake of good, this Taylor had a rather different aftermath. When Taylor triggered, Queen Administrator did indeed awaken in her, but with a Tinker/Thinker with a hint of Master ability rather than a Master/Thinker one with an architect/controller focus. The first thing this resulted in was an altered personality. Taylor became... kinder. Despite her Shards desire for conflict, Taylors brain came to the conclusion that physical conflict for the sake of vengeance wouldn't help anything. Taylor also gained a more outright heroic mindset, even if willing to bend the rules. But the most important thing is that now, her ability isn't to simply control arthropods in a specific radius. Rather, it's to create Arthropods. From literal drone-like spiders able to inject easy-to-make liquids, Crabs able to deep sea dive, Lobsters able to pinch steel, and even the dreaded Boxing Shrimp. All these and more. It helps that her dual/focus gives her a rather good construction capability. She can make miniature factories in the shape of hives for wasps and bees, Spider-Nests that construct spiders and other arachnids. Even somewhat small aquariums for water-based Arthropods, giving her a skill over infrastructure on par with or greater than Armsmaster. Taylor goes not by Skitter, but Drone. Her shard also gets the shard deviancy "White-Box Tech." Finally, depending on when this Taylor comes from, she has gotten justice on those bullied by "the trio," by discovering various evidence and successfully submitting the evidence on April 15th, 2011.
objects.title: Drone (Worm)

objects.text:
Taylor Hebert, upon triggering within the locker, changed far differently than her canon counterpart. Rather than awakening solely to the power to command insects, her shard replicated the powers of something stranger and far older, a Spider Totem. The trauma of her trigger forged her into a true spider-powered parahuman, granting her not only her canonical control over bugs, but also the full suite of spider-like abilities possessed by a number of the greatest spider-heroes across the multiverse.

Not only given the powers of a Spider Totem by Queen Administrator, her power also replicates the effects of the Queen’s Mutation, The Other's Evolution, and even Symbiote Hybrid, molding her body further into something more perfectly suited to its new nature. This resulted in significantly higher physical capabilities than canon Skitter, including enhanced strength, agility, durability, reflexes, a limited healing factor, organic web production, and a far stronger and more precise control over her bugs.

These changes have also affected her personality, as Queen Administrator has a greater hold on her psyche thanks to the physical changes she’s undergone. This has pushed Taylor into a more villain-oriented mindset than canon and has increased her propensity for conflict escalation significantly.
objects.title: The Spider (Worm)

objects.text:
Greg Veder wakes up one day and has the power of the Gamer, the power to treat his life as a Game, gaining stats, skills and levels as he grinds, fights and stays his gregarious self. 

You may decide which iteration of Greg this is, whether it’s the cape soon to be known as Dark Smoke Puncher and the cause of the Gregpocalypse which will reset the world sometimes soon via a reality-bending power interaction. The cape who doesn’t mind going ‘vs. the World’, with countless identities like White Knight, Hardkour and Prodigy or some other iteration altogether who'll no doubt cause a lot of chaos with his endlessly growing powers.
objects.title: Gamer Greg (Worm)

objects.text:
In one timeline Dinah Alcott triggered with a precognition power. She was kidnapped, drugged and used as precog pet by a certain snake. This is no longer the case. 

Dinah has now triggered with dynakinesis, allowing her to redirect any energy that comes in contact with her if she can see it coming. While her dynakinesis is similar to Behemoth's, hers is much weaker in comparison. She can still be considered a high tier cape.

Due to this to change she instead became a member of the Brockton Bay Wards. Improving her overall quality of life compared to canon.
objects.title: Dinahkinesis (Worm)

objects.text:
Well well, if it isn't the consequences of my actions.

Things have gone from bad to worse for Emma. Maybe it occurred during her initial kidnapping, or maybe it happened at the start of Gold Morning, or maybe it happened in some other traumatic way, regardless, Emma ended up actually triggering. What her shard is and the type of power she manifests of course depends heavily on what exactly she experienced which led to this. What is guaranteed however is whatever this ability may be, she will end up surviving Scion's attack.

There are now two paths she might end up taking now. Maybe she sticks to her guns and doubles down, becoming even more of a bully and indulging with her worse impulses now that she literally gained the strength she's been seeking. How this manifests is up to you, as she might end up in an even more self destructive path, becoming a genuinely threatening villain now seeking to prove everyone is beneath her. She will never be weak again.

Or... She could go the opposite route, with her new powers leading to her gaining more self awareness. Maybe she gets a better guiding hand than Sophia? Maybe she starts to actually reflect on what she had done to other people and especially Taylor? Maybe this will lead her to super heroics, or just being an anti heroic vigilante? A potentially more hopeful route for her, where she may never be forgiven by Taylor, but she could at least try to be better, both for herself and the people who still remained besides her?

Overall, maybe you can have a hand in the path Emma would end up taking? Either of the two or maybe something else entirely? She's been broken again, it is now up to her how she will build herself back up. Would she end up becoming a worse evil, or is there any hope for her at this point?
objects.title: Emma's Emergence (Worm)

addons.title: Little Sister Acquired
addons.text:
Given her history of assisting Dr. Light, it felt natural for Roll to help Ciel and Maria with their own research and tinkering, allowing them to double their rate of R&D and general tinkering. It wasn't long before the three of them grew close to one another, spending a lot of time talking and working together, and at one point, Roll mentioned a few ideas that earned a challenging grin from both Ciel and Maria.

The result was that Roll received further upgrades from Ciel and Maria, bringing her closer to the X Era than to Classic Mega Man, with her "Mega Medi" now able to rapidly research and refine cures and treatments for any condition. Her robot repair kits were upgraded to increase their effectiveness, while also granting her the ability to manufacture new parts on the fly, so long as she has the necessary resources, allowing her to fabricate new and replacement parts whenever needed.

The electricity shot from her antennae is technically stronger, as its power scales to the target being hit by it, ensuring that it remains effective regardless of the threat encountered. The source of this power comes from a new upgrade that Ciel and Maria were able to perfect with Roll's help: the Chaos Drive, essentially mass-produced Fake Emeralds that are more stable thanks to further development of Gerald's research.

Lastly, due to the experimental nature and danger involved in perfecting the new Chaos Drive for Roll, Ciel and Maria created several robots to act as test beds and prototypes for Roll's upgrades. These prototypes were eventually repurposed and completed as beings of their own, becoming a new set of Robot Masters with Mobian biodata incorporated into them that can fill various roles, whether helping around the lab, protecting their makers, or standing alongside Rock and Roll against whatever threats they may face.

Note: The new Robot Masters mentioned are basically expies of the Roboticized Masters from Sonic X Mega Man: Worlds Collide; by default, they are Knuckles Man, Shadow Man, Rose Woman, Tails Man, Silver Man, Espio Man, Vector Man, Charmy Man, Blaze Woman, and Rouge Woman. However, you can switch out the inspiration for each Master. For example, you could have Robot Masters based on characters such as Lanolin the Sheep or Gadget the Wolf.

objects.text:
It seems the two genius girls have come together and come up with some rather interesting designs; specifically, they have exchanged technological knowledge to massively enhance their bodies.

The data from Project Shadow's Bio-Lizard has been combined with the Reploid technology from Ciel's future to bridge the gap and fill the holes in both processes. The end result is that both Maria and Ciel have become effectively immortal, with their physical abilities several times greater than before, while having all their physical limitations and weaknesses removed.

Along with these physical upgrades, both have learned about the technology from each other's universes. Essentially, by combining their technological knowledge and expertise, they can both create new technologies without having to overly rely on one another. However, when they work together, the speed of their research and development increases several times over, as it seems the two are able to enter a state of flow that borders on a telepathic link. Whether it's Ultimate Life Bio-Metals, machines capable of affecting the entire universe, or even a machine capable of traveling across the multiverse, this is only the beginning of what these two can accomplish.

Along with this transformation, both Ciel and Maria have developed a deep sense of gratitude toward you for helping them get this far, along with a strong sense of loyalty.

Optionally, the two can gain access to their own Mobian alternate forms, as well as an under-suit that they can summon beneath their clothes for additional protection and style.
objects.title: Maria & Ciel: Advanced Research

rows.title: Specific Companions Modifiers
rows.titleText:
This section allows you to choose to modify your companions. These customizations are more specific, such as granting or removing certain abilities, giving a character a shot at a new life, etc.

Note: This section is entirely optional and serves solely for keeping track of changes if you’d prefer. Any and all changes here are already available under the blanket permissions granted by the companion section, and character customizations are not limited solely to the options here.

addons.title: True Friends
addons.text:
Due to your friendship with the entirety of the original Undersiders, they’ve opened up to each other and become true friends, their numerous personal issues by and large being resolved peacefully. Certain outside factors remain, such as Alec despite regaining his emotional capacity still being a potential target for Heartbreaker should his father learn of his location, and Brian still needing to get custody of Aisha.

Depending on your own financial ability to support them, the Undersiders may still be working for Coil, albeit in a more mercenary capacity instead of the direct subordinates they originally were, or avoid him entirely in favor of being on your payroll.

Furthermore, the power of the entirety of the Undersiders has effectively doubled as a result of their shards having better connections, allowing for better synergies.

addons.title: The Lords of Brockton Bay
addons.text:
With the entirety of the Undersiders being your friends, the power-increase due to the increased synergy of their Shards has expanded to the later additions as well. Additionally, the other Undersiders are now able to notice Aisha unless she’s deliberately trying to hide as opposed to missing her unless she’s focused on being noticed.

You’ve also helped the Undersiders expand their group into a larger organization more reminiscent to what they were after Leviathan’s attack on the Bay. This includes non-Parahuman helpers such as Charlotte, Sierra, and Cassie, but no specialists or other Parahumans unless you recruit them yourselves.

So if you want Biter, Barker, or Coil’s mercenaries you must either recruit or remove Coil and take over his assets, while the Heartbroken will not join you unless you’ve dealt with Heartbreaker.

With Sabah and Lily specifically you can choose their circumstances, if Sabah still presents herself as a Rogue that only occasionally fights aside the Undersiders by circumstance or if she’s openly joined, and if Lily’s left the Wards or if she remains part of the ENE Wards as one of its countless leaks sending information to out to interested parties.

objects.text: Aliases: Skitter, Weaver, Khepri Age: 15 Gender: Female Background Taylor is a shy awkward teenage girl who was just "surviving" from the point of her mother's death. Once she was started to be bullied, she just wanted to get by, and responded to the stress with silence and withdrawal. Although she means good when she is in her costume, Taylor will twist and turn her reasoning to fit her narrative as a hero, however flimsy it may be. While as a cape early on in her villain hero career, she was known as Skitter, before later on becoming known as Weaver when she became an official hero. Powers Her power gives her the ability to and transmit and receive information that grants her control over most arthropods. While this does mean she can control a variety of insects, she can also control sea creatures like crabs, lobsters, and krill.
objects.title: Taylor Anne Hebert

objects.text: Aliases: Panacea, The Red Queen Age: 17 Gender: Female Background Amy is an introverted teenage girl under incredible stress. Seeking approval from a mother that never wanted to adopt her has led to taking more and more responsibility on herself while repressing anything that could lead to her disapproval. Despite this, she remains less of a daughter and more of ‘a girl that lives in her house’. Her high stress and intense mental hangups and repression mark her as incredibly unstable. Unfortunately, she does take after her mother in her moral inflexibility, so when this dam does burst it’s likely to implode spectacularly should she take any ‘villainous’ actions. Powers Amy is a Biokinetic, able to manipulate the biology of any carbon-based lifeform. She also has an increased understanding of how they work. She can only do this with organisms she is touching and cannot alter her own biology, though can alter the biology of the germs on her skin.
objects.title: Amy Dallon

objects.text: Aliases: Glory Girl, Antares, Age: 17 Gender: Female Background Victoria Dallon is the daughter of two public superheroes. As such, even before she gained powers she was a minor celebrity. The stress of living under the expectations of not just her parents expectations but those of her extended family and the public at large came to a head when she had her trigger, and immediately joined her family’s struggling team New Wave, after all, what else was she meant to do? Like most second generation parahumans, Victoria’s traumas are more complex and less easily marked than other parahumans. She clearly wants to be seen as an icon and as a strong figure in her own right, but also feels tied to a legacy that’s tainted with her own struggles within the family. This less apparent trauma has given her the appearance of being more collected and rational than most parahumans, or than she actually is most of the time. Additionally, Victoria is at her heart, a cape nerd. She loves learning about the mechanics of powers and the academic theories of what’s behind their working. If left to her own devices it’s highly likely she would have gone to university to study any number of Parahuman Studies. Powers Victoria is an ‘Alexandria Package’ that can fly at almost 80mph, with a force field that can block any blow no matter how powerful, but any powerful impact will bring it down for about two seconds, longer if it's a sustained hit. This forcefield also gives her super strength, strong enough to allow her to lift about 14 tons. Finally, She has an emotional aura that makes it so those around her are either in awe or fear of her, but it isn't considered a Master effect since it isn't lasting.

objects.text: Aliases: Eidolon Age: 30s Gender: Male Background Being born severely unwell, David spent much of his early life in hospital, facing regular seizures and was confined to a wheelchair most of his life. Seeking independence he applied to join the armed forces, but due to his severe disabilities was turned down, in turn leading to his first suicide attempt. It was in this state he was approached by Doctor Mother in the earliest stages of Cauldron’s creation. After drinking his vial, Eidolon’s incredible power compared to most parahumans allowed him to become a founding member of the Protectorate, and a key figure in the Triumvirate. Operating out of Houston, he may be the most powerful parahuman currently alive, with a cadre of parahumans that complement his variable powers and mitigate his few weaknesses. Powers Eidolon has the power to generate two to four powers at a time depending on his circumstances and needs, though he doesn't have conscious control over what he gets. He can choose to be receptive to new powers or to give up existing ones. Unfortunately, Eidolon’s Shard is configured improperly and is burning through energy the more he uses it. While he is aware of this neither he nor Cauldron have found a way to stop this drain beyond simply not using his powers or consuming Cauldron Vials for temporary gains.

She becomes restless when things are too quiet and relishes the destruction she causes. She lives by the principle of taking everything she want without any concern for who it may harm. While Siberian can talk, she simply chooses not to. Powers Siberian is an unstoppable force and immovable object, only selectively affected by physical forces and can extend this to people and objects she touches. She would get temporarily popped by powers that involve all-or-nothing effects. After 30 seconds, she reappears somewhere random within 90 meters of where she was popped. Note: Taking her as a companion will make her completely independent, becoming her own projection. William Manton will trigger with a different Master power.

objects.text: Age: Early Twenties Gender: Male Background Leet is popularly known by his online streams with his partner in crime, Über. Using his tech to replicate characters and weapons from videogames, they committed multiple crimes while simulating said games; one particularly controversial being imitating GTA by beating prostitutes. Generally unpleasant and annoying, Leet has difficulty making allies, and has an inferiority complex. Despite all this, he is capable of trust and friendship as shown with Über, and can be a power multiplier when guided by someone smart. Powers Leet is a tinker with access to all tinker technology trees that the Entities deem safe. However he has several key drawbacks, primarily the fact that he can only ever create something once. The more similar a tinkertech creation is to something that he's made before or the more he worked within a particular idea or field, the higher the chance of a creation misfiring or failing. Alternatively, the more different his creation is in terms of design, mechanisms, functions, etc; from anything he made before, the more likely it is to work. His shard has a strong dislike of him due to his lack of imagination and from playing too safe, which reduces their gain of Data, and will attempt to sabotage him within his constraints in the Cycle.

rows.title: Crossover Companions
rows.titleText:
This section is entirely optional. 

This does not stop you from finding your own companions or recruiting these people yourself if you can get to their world or universe.
These will be your allies and teammates and think of you as a trusted friend and comrade, and will be hard-pressed to betray you. 

For Characters with different continuities, you are free to pick any versions/alternate version you like

But note that their morality can influence you just as much as yours them

You may choose the method they are made to join your team, whether probability manipulation, mind control, or whatever else.

If you start in the same universe some of your Сrossover Сompanions are from, you can choose for them be natives of this universe, similar to canon companions.

Ancestral God (Against The Gods)
objects.text: Aliases: to many to count Sex: Female Age: Older than creation Background The Ancestral God was the first being to ever exist within the Primal Chaos. Born before all things, She was the originator of the Paths of Cultivation and the creator of Creation itself. Yet, in order for life to flourish once more within the Primal Chaos, the Ancestral God made a final sacrifice. She chose to disperse her own essence throughout the Primal Chaos, allowing new life to emerge from the remnants of her divine existence. Before doing so, however, She divided her memories and accumulated knowledge into eight fragments, each containing a portion of her wisdom and experiences. Thus, even after her essence was scattered, the legacy of the Ancestral God would endure through the eight fragments of her being. Powers She is akin to the very consciousness of the Primal Chaos given form, granting her unimaginable power. Among her abilities are absolute control over the Primal Chaos and the fundamental Laws that govern creation, along with a divine intellect and immeasurable knowledge. She is the only being capable of holding back the Abyss of Nothingness and possesses near-limitless physical power. Note: This version did not ever become enamored with Yun Che.

objects.text:
Alignment: Chaotic Good
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: 19

Power: Alice wields the raw, shape-shifting power of her imagination, allowing her to shrink to nimbly slip through hidden spaces or grow to colossal proportions for overwhelming force. She masters surreal weaponry such as the Vorpal Blade, Hobby Horse, and Teapot Cannon with graceful agility, and when near death, she unleashes Hysteria Mode, a state of heightened strength and near-invulnerability. Over time, her mental struggle and mastery of Wonderland’s reality-warping abilities have bled into the real world, letting her momentarily manifest Wonderland’s twisted landscapes and illusions outside her mind. She can also enter and influence the dreams of others, forging bizarre mental bridges between their subconscious and her own. These powers, fueled as much by her trauma as by her determination, make Alice an unpredictable force—capable of both remarkable heroism and dangerous instability.

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: Technically none; in the real world, Alice is a troubled orphan in Victorian London, undergoing therapy and living in tenuous circumstances.
Quality of Life: Poor/Traumatic. Alice struggles with survivor’s guilt after losing her family in a house fire, enduring time in an asylum and suffering ongoing psychological challenges. Her excursions into Wonderland mirror her internal battles and offer a chance at both redemption and the constant risk of succumbing to madness.
objects.title: Alice Liddell (Alice: Madness Returns)

objects.text: Alias: Shub-Niggurath Age: N/A Gender: Female Background An eldritch entity who has been revered as a goddess, a demon, and a monster throughout her existence, Chiyo was accidentally summoned by a young boy named Yuu and granted his wish by becoming his elder sister. Powers An eldritch demon goddess who is immortal and whose true form resides in another dimension. She possesses a vast array of powers, including shapeshifting, matter manipulation, time manipulation, reality warping, and the ability to exist outside the space-time continuum without issue. However, despite her extensive abilities, resurrecting the dead is one thing she cannot do.
objects.title: Chiyo (Ane Naru Mono)

objects.text: Name: Yakko Warner, Wakko Warner, Dot (Princess Angelina Contessa Louisa Francesca Banana Fanna Bo Besca) Warner III Alias: The Warner Brothers and The Warner Sister Age: Whatever for the bit (Created either in 1993 or during the 1930s, depending on how meta you want to be) Gender: Male (Yakko & Wakko), Female (Dot) Background In Hollywood, 1930, at the Warner Bros. Studios, artists worked tirelessly to create new stars. Eventually, they created three new characters: the Warner brothers and their sister, Dot. Unfortunately, the Warners were completely out of control. The three of them ran wild throughout the studio until they were finally captured. The Warners' nonsensical cartoons were locked away in the studio vault, never to be shown again, while the Warner siblings were locked inside a studio water tank so they could never be seen by the public either. Officially, the studio denied that the Warners had ever existed… until the day they escaped. Powers The Warner Siblings are proficient users of Toon Force, and while not masters, their proficiency allows them to do most anything so long as it's funny or for Edutainment (educational entertainment) purposes. But what sets them apart is their ability to draw upon and adapt to other genres and animation styles, quickly mastering the use of Japanese animation and tropes. Note: You, of course, will not be exempt from the zany antics of the Warners and are likely to be The Straight Man to their routine or the target of their comedic affection.
objects.title: Warner Siblings (Animaniacs)

addons.text: Wherever you turn, it seems Lappland is always there, lurking about, hiding in plain sight, waiting for the perfect moment to crash your party. You can anticipate plenty of clashes between these two frenemies, though Lappland will step in to help you—or any of Texas's allies—if the situation gets dire enough. That said, don't count on her to bail you out of every dangerous scenario; her help is as unpredictable as she is.

Trained in the traditional ways of the Leithanien Arts, her mastery of it is so singular and unique that it defies conventional measurement. Arturia also wields a rare form of emotion-based Arts designed to "reveal the true self"—a power that strips away inhibitions, laying bare the essence of a person's desires.

This, alongside her illusion Arts, works in tandem with her innate, heightened Sankta empathetic connection, walking in lockstep with one another, seamlessly intertwined—enabling her to delve into the memories and emotions of others. Through these manipulations, she can guide—or compel—people to act on their deepest, truest desires, making her influence almost impossible to resist.

objects.text:
Code Name: Priestess

Alignment: Neutral Evil

Gender: Female

Sex: Female

Age: Unknown (???)

Power: Priestess is a Predecessor, a race of humanity from a Type III civilization—one capable of sailing the stars and shaping the laws of physics and matter with casual ease. Among her kind, she stands at the apex of intellect, a peerless mind rivaled only by a scant few—former teammates whose number could be counted on one hand.

As the co-creator and current master of Originium, Priestess wields absolute dominion over it. Within the bounds of the Assimilated Universe, she is nothing less than divine—able to transmute the raw data/information within it to become anything she wishes, from natural phenomena or even abstract concepts. And with enough Originium, even the physical world won't be out of her reach to reshape.

The Originium under her control will actively assimilate all it touches—space, time, consciousness, even metaphysical constructs into data/information—expanding her domain and deepening its density. The more Originium she amasses, the greater her influence becomes within the real world and Assimilated Universe.

The Assimilated Universe itself is a hyper-dimensional realm where no natural law holds any sway—an abstract space born from Originium, containing and manifesting all the information it has assimilated. Within it, space, time, and reality conform solely to the logic that Originium dictates. As one of its creators, Priestess can shape its fabric however she pleases, altering cause and effect, rewriting existence, or collapsing entire frameworks of its reality in service of her will.

Appearance: Beautiful

Civilian Identity: Former scientific mind of a dead civilization, currently unemployed.

Quality of Life: Has Its Ups and Downs

Note: Upon first purchase, you will receive an Originium-based flash drive containing Priestess's data form. Plugging this into any compatible device allows her to inhabit it as a hyperintelligent AI. Though limited by the small amount of Originium stored within, she retains her brilliance—an intellect from a civilization capable of enslaving the Feranmuts, traversing galaxies in moments, and unraveling the fabric of reality. Her digital mind operates on an architecture far beyond human comprehension—closer to a living singularity than a mere program.

The second will grant her a mass of Originium the size of a small island to inhabit. With this, her processing power eclipses even the most advanced quantum computers. She can now exert her will over an entire region—even being able to create localized Catastrophes.

The third will restore her to her full potential, as depicted in Arknights, with a volume of Originium on par with what exists naturally across Terra. At this level, she becomes a walking apocalypse. The Originium will also be embedded within the world you're entering, resonating with her will, fueling vast environmental disruptions and widespread Catastrophes. Be warned: the assimilation rate, energy output, and metaphysical strain of her presence will radically alter the environment—permanently.
objects.title: Priestess (Arknights)

For hers is a strength unparalleled, containing enough power to bring Terra itself to its knees, should she so desire. A master of Arts, her command over it vastly exceeds that of most practitioners. Furthermore, she possesses profound insight into the true nature of Originium and the ability to manipulate the Assimilated Universe.

objects.text:
Operator Name: Shu

Alignment: Neutral Good

Gender: Female

Sex: Female

Age: Unknown (At the very least a few hundred years old after her "birth")

Power: As a fragment of the Feranmut known as Sui, Shu wields immense power—enough to shape the world with ease. Even as a mere shard of a greater living god, she can restore vast countrysides, heal the wounded, bring the dying back to full health—often stronger than before—and cultivate entire fields with a mere gesture. Her domain is life and agriculture, granting her authority over growth, renewal, and prosperity. Yet, despite her overwhelming abilities, she prefers to nurture crops and tend the land by hand, finding greater meaning in the act of care rather than effortless creation, as they will outlive her in the event of her "death."

Beyond her command over life, Shu possesses a form of clairvoyance rooted in her enlightened mind and philosophy. She perceives causality like a tapestry, foreseeing events weeks, months, or even years in advance simply by understanding the natural flow of consequences.

Unlike Originium Arts, her powers stem from the inherent authority of the Feranmut—a force closer to true magic, capable of bending and dominating reality to her will. However, as a result of being a fragment of one, she is fundamentally incapable of using Arts, even if she desires to.

Appearance: Beautiful

Civilian Identity: The seventh-born of the Sui siblings, Shu holds the title of Nongye Tianshi of Yan—an imperial rank that designates her as one of the kingdom's foremost authorities on agriculture. This esteemed title is awarded only to those who demonstrate exceptional expertise in agrarian sciences, akin to earning a PhD.

Quality of Life: Good (Loves what she does and is just enjoying life.)

Note: You may choose whichever version of her you want within the timeline.
objects.title: Shu (Arknights)

objects.text:
Operator Name: Dusk

Alignment: Neutral Good

Gender: Female

Sex: Female

Age: Unknown (At the very least a few hundred years old after her "birth")

Power: As a fragment of the Feranmut known as Sui, Dusk wields immense power—enough to shape entire worlds with a stroke of her brush. Her ink does not merely depict reality; it defines it, bringing forth landscapes, creatures, and civilizations that exist beyond imagination. Yet, her creations follow an unusual rule: they feel as real as any world while perceived, but the moment one turns their senses away from it, they become as fictitious as a painting—existing only so long as they are witnessed and perceived.

Hers is the power of a true creator, summoning existence from nothingness. With a single flourish, she conjures sprawling cities, towering mountains, and entire histories within the frames of her art. The line between reality and illusion blurs for those who step into her works, as even the most fantastical visions—mythical beasts, dreamlike realms, and impossible structures—manifest with undeniable authenticity. To Dusk, reality itself is shaped by perception, obsessed with the line between reality and fantasy, and through her artistry, she dictates what is and isn't real.

Unlike Originium Arts, her powers stem from the inherent authority of the Feranmut—a force closer to true magic, capable of bending and dominating reality to her will. However, as a result of being a fragment of one, she is fundamentally incapable of using Arts, even if she desires to.

Appearance: Beautiful

Civilian Identity: The eleventh-born of the Sui siblings and the youngest sister—Dusk, lives far away from civilization as a hermit, wanting to only live her life in peace.

Quality of Life: Good (Loves being a shut-in.)

Note: You may choose whichever version of her you want within the timeline.
objects.title: Dusk (Arknights)

objects.text: Operator Name: Necrass Alignment: Chaotic Neutral Gender: Female Sex: Female Age: Unknown (You're free to ask the lady her age, however.) Power: Eblana is a strong and commanding leader, capable of inspiring both loyalty and fear. She is highly skilled in both Originium Arts and traditional martial arts, with Excellent proficiency in spear combat. However, her most distinctive ability lies in her unique flame Arts. Unlike typical fire-based Arts, Eblana's flames stem from her Draco bloodline and do not directly manipulate the natural combustion process. Instead, they accelerate and control cellular metabolism to the point of self-immolation, with fire manifesting as a side effect. She has refined this ability into a form of necromancy, using her flames to reanimate corpses by infusing them with her Arts. As long as she sustains them, they will continue to fight, rising again and again on the battlefield. Appearance: Beautiful Civilian Identity: Leader and founder of the Dublinn armed forces, a separatist movement and rebel group made to regain Taran independence from Victoria. Powers: Cannot is a jovial, mysterious and possibly eldritch traveling merchant who procures an assortment of quaint trinkets, useful tools, and esoteric artifacts from across the world, and possibly from alternate timelines. He is also privy to threats and secrets lurking in the shadows of the world, and uses his businesses and connections to manipulate people and events in minor ways to stave off or prepare for them. He will only procure items that nobody is currently using or looking for, so he won’t have a villain’s secret weapon or a plot macguffin. As you travel through different worlds with Cannot it tow, he will sink his tentacles through their markets and underworlds, gaining more artifacts and secrets to sell you.

Appearance: Odd (Very shady, completely covered by a rusty bucket helm and an old overcoat with writhing tentacles spilling out.)

Civilian Identity: Wandering Merchant

Quality of Life: Stressful (trying to manipulate minor factions against major superpowers to mitigate several different oncoming apocalypses)
objects.title: Cannot Goodenough (Arknights)

objects.text: Aliases: Flagship. Age: 20 years (mental model). Gender: Female Background Kongou is the reincarnation of a Kongo-class battlecruiser and is part of the Fleet of Fog; she serves as the flagship of the First Eastern Fleet, having replaced the sunken battleship Hyuuga in that role. Kongou has both a ship's hull and a Mental Model in the form of a 20-year-old human girl with long blonde hair, pale skin, and scarlet eyes. She prefers to wear a long dark purple evening gown. She is apathetic and has no hobbies, instead focusing on completing the tasks assigned to the Fog Fleet. She considers humans to be useless at best. Powers The Kongou is a “Fleet of Fog” battleship that combines a hull with a Mental Model. At its core is the Union Core, which powers the ship and enables quantum communication. The “Fleet of Fog” is a high-tech replica of a World War II warship with a powerful combat system, including photon cannons, missile silos, torpedoes with Corrosive Warheads, and a Super-Graviton Cannon. Its nanomaterial armor and segmented Wave-Force armor protective field make it nearly invulnerable. All flagships are equipped with a unique system known as Flagship equipment, which allows you to summon the Union Cores of any fleet ship to the flagship's location and create new hulls for them within 10-30 minutes. The Mental Model, outwardly indistinguishable from a human, possesses superhuman strength and speed, can jump 50 meters, and tear tanks apart. Her body can project Wave-Force armor capable of withstanding small arms fire and missiles. With its help, the Mental Model creates force blades or shatters objects.
objects.title: Kongou (Arpeggio of Blue Steel)

objects.text: Aliases: not Age: 18 years (Visual age of the Mental Model) Gender: Female Background Hiei is the reincarnation of the Kongo-class battlecruiser Hiei and a member of the Fleet of Fog. She is effectively the sister ship of the flagship Kongo and serves as its deputy, leading the fleet’s strike squadron. Hiei possesses both a ship’s hull and a Mental Model in the form of a human girl with chestnut-colored hair. She prefers to wear a pink school dress with a bow tie and glasses. Hiei is known for her meticulousness, politeness, and diligence, carefully carrying out her duties as Kongo’s deputy in the fleet. Unlike other ships in the “Fleet of Fog,” she seeks unconventional tactics and solutions, which is particularly evident in the Squadron she commands, where each crew member has their own specialization and unique weaponry. Powers The Hiei is a “Fleet of Fog” battleship that combines a hull with a Mental Model. At its core is the Union Core, which powers the ship and enables quantum communication. The “Fleet of Fog” is a high-tech replica of a World War II warship with a powerful combat system, including photon cannons, missile silos, torpedoes with Corrosive Warheads, and a Super-Graviton Cannon. Its nanomaterial armor and segmented Wave-Force armor protective field make it nearly invulnerable. The unique Mirror-Ring system provides nearly absolute protection. The Mental Model, outwardly indistinguishable from a human, possesses superhuman strength and speed, can jump 50 meters, and tear tanks apart. Her body can project Wave-Force armor capable of withstanding small arms fire and missiles. With its help, the Mental Model creates force blades or shatters objects.
objects.title: Hiei (Arpeggio of Blue Steel)

objects.text: Names: Myoukou, Nachi, Haguro and Ashigara Age: 16-20 years (Visual age of the Mental Models) Gender: Female Background Myoukou, Nachi, Haguro, and Ashigara are reincarnations of the ships of the same names, which are part of the Fog of Fleet and were formerly part of the group hunting the I-401 under the command of the battlecruiser Hiei. Myoukou leads her sisters’ squadron, effectively serving as Hiei’s deputy. Myoukou has a Mental Model that looks like a 20-year-old girl with short pink hair framing her face. She prefers to take action, but she is also patient. She wears an eye patch over her right eye. The ship’s hull is dark cherry red. Nachi has a Mental Model that looks like a 17-year-old girl with short, light green hair. She has a calm, gentle personality. The ship is dark green. Haguro has a Mental Model that looks like a 16-year-old girl with short red hair; she has a capricious personality and loves to whine or grumble. The ship’s hull is reddish-pink. Ashigara has a Mental Model that looks like a 17-year-old girl with long, straight black hair. She has a boisterous, bold, impatient, and adventurous personality. She wears two hair clips shaped like jaws. The ship’s hull is brown with pink accents. Powers Ships of the Myoukou type is a “Fleet of Fog” heavy cruiser that combines a hull with a Mental Model. At its core is the Union Core, which powers the ship and enables quantum communication. The “Fleet of Fog” is a high-tech replica of a World War II warship with a powerful combat system, including photon cannons, missile silos, torpedoes with Corrosive Warheads, and a Super-Graviton Cannon. Its nanomaterial armor and segmented Wave-Force armor protective field make it nearly invulnerable. Each ship has its own specialized type of super-weapon system: Sniper System(Myoukou), The Demonic Eye sensor system (Nachi), Energy Harpoon (Ashigara) and Super-Gravity Cannon (Haguro). The Mental Model, outwardly indistinguishable from a human, possesses superhuman strength and speed, can jump 50 meters, and tear tanks apart. Her body can project Wave-Force armor capable of withstanding small arms fire and missiles. With its help, the Mental Model creates force blades or shatters objects.
objects.title: The Myoukou Sisters (Arpeggio of Blue Steel)

objects.text: Alias: Female Titan Age: 16 Gender: Female Background Since a young age, Annie has been trained by her adoptive father to become an exceptional combatant, putting her fighting abilities, especially hand-to-hand, above most of her peers. She eventually joined Marley's military as a Warrior and was chosen to inherit the power of a titan in preparation for the Paradise infiltration mission. Powers Annie is a Titan Shifter, allowing her to transform into a Female Titan, a fourteen-metre-tall feminine humanoid figure with immense strength and speed. Should there be any present nearby, the Female Titan possesses the ability to summon regular Titans to her aid, and, by consuming parts of other titans, she can manifest their special abilities. She also possesses the ability to encase her human body in a nigh-indestructible crustal, where she will remain in stasis until such time as she decides to cease this transformation. Do note that those that possess the power of a titan have extremely shortened lifespans, capable of living only 13 years after obtaining the power.
objects.title: Annie Leonhart (Attack on Titan)

objects.text: Age: 15 Gender: Female Background In her youth, Mikasa became a target for kidnappers that killed her parents. When she was saved by Eren, she awoke her fighter instincts present in every member of the Ackerman clan and has trained with the intent to protect Eren ever since. Powers Mikasa is a genius fighter and possesses an exceptional talent with the vertical manoeuvring equipment. Due to rigorous training, she can fight multiple opponents much bigger than her with ease and lift other people with ease. Her most notable ability, however, is access to the accumulated combat experience of all the members of the Ackerman clan, granting her perfect control over her body and instincts for fighting far above that of the normal human.
objects.title: Mikasa Ackerman (Attack on Titan)

objects.text: Age: Unknown, possibly early- to mid-twenties. Gender: Female Background One of the last few members of the Mangkwan who survived the volcanic catastrophe which devastated their homeland. Varang killed her own father and usurped the control of the clan and is now regarded as their messiah and saviour. Powers As are all Na'vi, Varang is much taller than any human and bears enhanced physical strength roughly four times that of even the strongest human athlete. She is well versed in botany, which allows her to manufacture hallucinogens and poisons, and is a very capable combatant—especially proficient with her twin blades—and archer.
objects.title: Varang (Avatar)

objects.text: Alias: The Little Dove, Lady of Winterfell, Queen in the North, The Red Wolf Gender: Female Age: 20 Background Born into the noble House Stark of Winterfell, Sansa Stark was raised in a world of songs, courtly manners, and dreams of chivalry. As a child, she believed deeply in honor, romance, and the ideals of knighthood. However, her life took a brutal turn when she traveled south to King’s Landing, where she became entangled in the deadly political games of the royal court. Over time, Sansa endured manipulation, betrayal, captivity, and psychological torment at the hands of powerful figures. Each hardship reshaped her, stripping away naïveté and replacing it with caution, intelligence, and quiet resilience. Under the influence of cunning mentors and dangerous enemies alike, she learned to read people, navigate deception, and wield influence without drawing a blade. By the age of 20, Sansa has transformed into a composed and calculating leader. No longer just a pawn, she has become a player in her own right, capable of protecting her people and asserting her authority in a world where power is often taken, not given. Powers Sansa possesses no current supernatural abilities at the moment, though she does have the potential to become a Warg like some members of her family. Note: She comes with her pet direwolf, Lady.
objects.title: Sansa Stark (A Song of Ice and Fire)

addons.text:
Daenerys knows the benefits of A Small Organization and its upgrades, giving her command over the following based on the Scale and Strength of her Dominion.

A Small Organization: A loyal group of 10 loyal guards that are devoted to Daenerys’ cause.

A Medium Organization: A force of 50 loyal Guards, and 20 specialists, consisting of 15 dragon keepers to care for, train, and manage her dragons, 2 military officers to command her forces, 1 diplomat to handle alliances and negotiations, and 1 healer to tend to the wounded, and 1 quartermaster to manage supplies, equipment, and logistics.

A Big Organization: Daenerys commands 150 loyal guards made up of elite guards, veteran soldiers, mounted scouts, and sworn protectors, alongside 50 specialists, consisting of 30 dragon keepers, 5 military officers, 3 diplomats, 3 healers, 3 quartermasters, 2 blacksmiths, 2 engineers, and 2 spies to support her growing power.

A Supervillain Base: gives Daenerys her ancestral home, Dragonstone, the ancestral home of House Targaryen. With a garrison of three hundred, with an additional half as many tending the castle and surrounding areas. This castle includes the dragon roosts, armories, docks, training grounds, and a dragon glass mine you can exploit.

The You Foundation, Daenerys now commands her birthright: Westeros. All the Great Houses and their servants serve her, and by association, you. She also rules her overseas armies as well: one hundred thousand dohdraki, and her eight thousand unsullied warriors. Finally, the biggest boom, every past member of House Targaryen, and every dragon of House Targaryen, is brought back to life.

(NOTE 1: if “A Medium Organization” is taken, then Daenerys gets Missandei, Ser Jorah Mormont, Grey Worm, etc.)
addons.title: The Dragon's Dominion

objects.text: Alias: Khaleesi of the Great Grass Sea, The Unburnt, Breaker of Chains, Queen of the Andals and the First Men, Protector of the Seven Kingdoms Gender: Female Age: 24 Background Daenerys Targaryen was born on Dragonstone during the fall of the Targaryen dynasty, as her father, Aerys II Targaryen, was overthrown in Robert's Rebellion. Forced into exile, she spent her early life wandering the Free Cities under the control of her brother, Viserys Targaryen, who sought to use her to reclaim the Iron Throne. Her life changed when she was married to Khal Drogo. Through hardship and loss, she grew into a strong and independent leader. After Drogo’s death, Daenerys walked into his funeral pyre and emerged unharmed with three newly hatched dragons, marking the return of dragons to the world. She went on to conquer and liberate cities such as Astapor, Yunkai, and Meereen, earning the title “Breaker of Chains.” With a growing army and her dragons, she set her sights on Westeros, determined to reclaim her family’s throne. Powers Daenerys is not a traditional “spellcasting” sorceress, but her abilities are rare, formidable, and deeply tied to magic, lineage, and willpower. The first of Daenerys' abilities is her extraordinary bond to her dragons Drogon, Rhaegal, and Viserion. Through which she can command and influence them, particularly Drogon, who serves as both mount and weapon. These dragons provide her with overwhelming battlefield dominance, capable of incinerating armies and fortifications. Daenerys second ability is her immunity to fire and extreme heat, most famously when she survived the funeral pyre that birthed her dragons. This trait, while not consistently absolute in all interpretations, is widely regarded as a supernatural hallmark of her identity. Daenerys also has the skill to inspire fierce loyalty in people. From the Dothraki hordes to the Unsullied legions, Daenerys commands devotion that borders on religious fervor. Over time, Daenerys develops into a capable leader and tactician. She learns to navigate alliances, warfare, and governance, balancing mercy and ruthlessness when necessary. Note: Daenerys comes with her Dragons, Drogon, Rhaegal, and Viserion.
objects.title: Daenerys Targaryen (A Song of Ice and Fire)

It was here that she would again meet her childhood friend Azula, who recruited her towards her hunt for the Avatar. objects.text: Gender: Female Age: 15 Background The daughter of a major provincial governor, she was from an important enough family to get into the Royal Fire Academy For Girls, but that didn't exactly guarantee her position within the nobility. Now she uses her advanced weapons skills (which she developed out of sheer boredom) to assist the heirs in their search for the Avatar. Powers Mai is a master martial artist, equivalent to the Skills "Thousand Styles Master", "Marksman", "Weapon Improvisation", & the T0 Power "Blaster (Deadshot)". As a Destroyer, she is a fast and maneuverable warship, she can move on water as if it were land and is far stronger than what her appearance may suggest. Power: Division Zero-level Shinigami, Vasto Lorde-level Hollow, Michibane-level Fullbringer, Sternritter-Level Quincy. There are many way to describe the levels of Reiryoku mastery that Ichigo Kurosaki has achieved in his short 17 year life. In the entire history of the Seireitei no other soul has achieved the level and breadth of mastery as Ichigo Kurosaki has in such a short time.
As a Shinigami, he wields a Bankai capable of slicing through mountains. With his Hollow abilities, he can generate Gran Rey Ceros powerful enough to destroy entire cities. His Fullbringer powers allow him to fight on par with monsters the size of buildings. With his Quincy abilities, he can block and dodge attacks moving at such speeds that even some of the strongest being in existence have difficulty seeing them.
Simply put, Ichigo is a close-combat and swordsmanship specialist—a true force of nature, surpassing all but a few in the history of the world.

Tier is now joined by her three Fracción, the Tres Bestia. The members are Franceska Mila-Rose, Emilou Apacci, and Cyan Sung-Sun, a trio that will bicker ceaselessly yet still work together seamlessly when the chips are down. All three are skilled fighters skilled in the use of the classic Arrancar-skills like Cero, Sonido, Hierro, as well as each having their own Resurrección. 

In Resurrección-form the trio can collectively sacrifice their left arms to summon a giant creature called Ayon. Ayon is a being of colossal strength but limited intellect, rendering it a somewhat situational option as Ayon is not good at following instructions; though it can at least differentiate between friend and foe. Once Ayon is dispelled, the sacrificed arms will regenerate.

objects.text: Gender: Female Age: likely hundreds of years old Background Rangiku does not remember much of her early life, starving in the Rukongai. For her, life only began when she was discovered by Gin Ichimaru, who detected in her soul the potential to be a Shinigami. After that they became friends of a sort, though Gin still kept a certain distance, as was his wont. It was only later on that she met and recruited Tōshirō Hitsugaya, a young Shinigami rising up the ranks. When they first met he was beneath her in rank, but eventually he would rise to become the Captain she would spend most of her career under, and a close friend. Powers Rangiku is a lieutenant-level shinigami and possesses a large amount of spiritual power. She is an expert in Zanjutsu, Hakuda, Shunpo, and Kidō. Her Zanpakutō, Haineko, allows her to transform her blade into a mist of ash, where any minute particle of it can become the origin of a "cut" at the same level as full sword strike. This mist can be spread over a large area like a gas attack, or formed into specific shapes like shields, walls, or tornados.
objects.title: Rangiku Matsumoto (Bleach)

objects.text: Alias: E: The Explode Gender: Female Background Bambietta is a Sternritter, one of the highest-ranking officers in the Vandenreich army. She is also a leader of a five-Sternritter squad Bambies. Powers As a Sternritter, Bambietta possesses a high level of spiritual power, equal to that of captain-level Shinigami. Her Quincy abilities include Blut, which allows her to massively enhance her physical durability or strength; teleportation through shadows; and control over the spirit particles, Reishi. However, in combat, she mainly relies on her Schrift, The Explode, which allows her to fire off Reishi particles that turn anything they touch into bombs, as well as generate omnidirectional explosive blasts around herself. Bambietta can also enter a state called Vollständig, which allows her to fly and massively enhances both her physical capabilities and the power of her Schrift. Lastly, as any Sternritter, she possesses a medallion that can steal a shinigami's Bankai. However, when using the stolen Bankai, she cannot use her Vollständig.
objects.title: Bambietta Basterbine (Bleach)

objects.text: Alias: T: The Thunderbolt Gender: Female Background Candice is a Sternritter, one of the highest-ranking officers in the Vandenreich army. She is also a member of a five-Sternritter squad Bambies. Powers As a Sternritter, Candice possesses a high level of spiritual power, equal to that of captain-level Shinigami. Her Quincy abilities include Blut, which allows her to massively enhance her physical durability or strength; teleportation through shadows; and control over the spirit particles, Reishi. Her Schrift, The Thunderbolt, allows her to generate and control blasts of lightning, as well as perform short-range teleportation by momentarily turning her body into lightning. The blasts are strong enough to kill regular shinigami soldiers immediately, and the strongest blasts can easily turn her targets to ash. She can also enter a state called Vollständig, which allows her to fly and massively enhances both her physical capabilities and the power of her Schrift. Lastly, as any Sternritter, she possesses a medallion that can steal a shinigami's Bankai. However, when using the stolen Bankai, she cannot use her Vollständig.

addons.title: The Bambies
addons.text:
Congratulations, you can now count the entire Sternritter quintet known as the Bambies as your friends. The two missing members are Meninas McAllon, whose Schrift P – The Power massively boosts her physical strength, and Giselle Gewelle, whose Schrift Z – The Zombie both renders herself nearly immortal as well as giving her control over undead through her blood.

Not just that, but through their bonds with you they've not only refined their teamwork from its previously barely existing dysfunction into a well-oiled machine that works together seamlessly, but also managed to by and large deal with their personal issues, smoothing out the worst of their personality-flaws such as Bambietta's homocidal urges towards Pretty Boys and Giselle's abusive tendencies.

objects.text: Alias: G: The Glutton Gender: Female Background Liltotto is a Sternritter, one of the highest-ranking officers in the Vandenreich army. She is also a member of a five-Sternritter squad Bambies. Powers As a Sternritter, Liltotto possesses a high level of spiritual power, equal to that of captain-level Shinigami. Her Quincy abilities include Blut, which allows her to massively enhance her physical durability or strength; teleportation through shadows; and control over the spirit particles, Reishi. Her Schrift, The Glutton, allows her to bite through and consume nearly anything by shifting and extending her mouth outward, albeit this ability leaves her in a constant state of hunger. She can also assimilate and reproduce the special abilities of anyone she consumes, like a schrift of another Sternritter, for example. She can also enter a state called Vollständig, which allows her to fly and massively enhances both her physical capabilities and the power of her Schrift. Lastly, as any Sternritter, she possesses a medallion that can steal a shinigami's Bankai. However, when using the stolen Bankai, she cannot use her Vollständig.
objects.title: Liltotto Lamperd (Bleach)

objects.text: Alias: Primera Espada Age: Unknown Gender: Male Background Coyote Starrk, as the Primera Espada, is ranked first among the Arrancar controlled by Sosuke Aizen. Before becoming an Arracnar, his uncontrolled spiritual pressure was so strong that it killed almost all who approached him, causing a deep loneliness. His only friend, Lilynette Gingerbuck, was created by subconsciously splitting his soul so he could have a companion. Despite his power and position, Starrk is laid-back, polite, and reluctant to fight, preferring peace and friendship over conflict. Powers Starrk's spiritual pressure, comparable to the strongest of shinigami captains, is complemented by his high-speed regeneration, swordsmanship, and Cero. His resurreccion, Los Lobos, which is activated by fusing with Lilynette, splits his soul to summon a pack of wolves that explode on contact with a target. He is capable of using Cero with ease, as well as the rapid-fire Cero Metraletta, which lets him use an overwhelming volume of attacks. His high level reiatsu control means that he can avoid detection fairly easily when not exhibiting enough spiritual pressure to kill weaker the souls merely in his presence. Thankfully, he has learned to control his reiatsu enough to no longer endanger those around him. Note Even without spiritual powers, you will have the bare minimum spiritual awareness to see him.
objects.title: Coyote Starrk (Bleach)

objects.text: Age: Unknown Gender: Female Background: Lilynette once was, together with Starrk, a part of a hollow so powerful it extinguished the souls of others with its mere presence. After separating its soul in two, Lilynette became a living container for this power, allowing her counterpart, Starrk, to regain their former strength in the resurrección. Powers: Lilynette possesses all the regular abilities of an Arrancar, such as cero, sonído, and hierro, for example. However, despite being the container of immense power, by herself she is rather weak, with her cero being weaker than that of an average gillian-class menos.
objects.title: Lilynette Gingerbuck (Bleach)

objects.text: Age: Unknown Gender: Male Background Tōshirō comes from the province of Junrinan in the 1st District of the West Rukongai. There, he lived with his grandmother and childhood friend Momo Hinamori. Eventually he had his fateful encounter with Rangiku Matsumoto, whose intervention led him to join the Academy to learn to be a Shinigami, graduating early after only a single year. Hitsugaya eventually joined the 10th division of the Gotei 13 under Captain Isshin Siba, working his way up to become the third seat of the division. Eventually Tōshirō succeeded Isshin as Captain of the 10th Division, becoming the youngest Captain in the history of Soul Society. Powers Tōshirō is a child prodigy, possessing high intelligence and extraordinary talent, with excellent instinct and intuition in battle. He has enormous reserves of Spiritual Power that feels as cold as ice. He has mastered the Shinigami art of Zanjutsu, becoming a Master Swordsman and becoming one of the youngest to achieve the feat of Bankai—the final release of his Zanpakuto Hyorinmaru. He holds high expertise in the other Shinigami Arts, Hakuda—Hand-to-Hand Combat—Shunpo--High-Speed Movement—and Kido—Spiritual “magic”. He has mastered use of his Zanpakuto Hyōrinmaru, achieving both its Shikai and Bankai releases. Hyōrinmaru manifests as an Eastern ice dragon, used to attack directly or manifest and manipulate ice in a variety of ways.
objects.title: Tōshirō Hitsugaya (Bleach)

addons.text: Now, Gehrman can enter and leave the Hunter's Dream on a whim, should he truly wish to. The Dream now exists within a pocket dimension tied to him, with him getting a soulbound key that cannot be stolen, lost, or destroyed, that lets him open portals to it. The Dream, still a sanctuary for hunters, has the same amenities it does in the game. The Doll is still present and able to level you up, the Bath Messengers' shop has all purchasable items from the game, and the workshop is present, even if it's a bit empty. All things that can be done in the Dream with Blood Echoes, the apparent lifeforce of those you've killed, can still be done.
addons.title: Hunter's Dream

objects.text:
Alias: First Hunter, Keeper of the Workshop
Alignment: Lawful Neutral
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: ?
Powers: Gehrman is the first hunter of the Healing Church, trained in the use of swift, calculated violence against beasts. As the founder of the Workshop, he developed many of the iconic trick weapons and set the foundation for all who followed. Bound in servitude to the Moon Presence, Gehrman exists in a dream, waiting to free others—or be freed himself. In battle, he is a blur of precision and grace, wielding the Burial Blade with terrifying efficiency and enhanced by the latent strength of the Great Ones.
Appearance: Scarred
Civilian Identity: None
Quality of Life: Terrible/Cursed (Gehrman is trapped in a cycle not of his choosing. Though once revered, his mind and body have grown tired in the dream’s hollow eternity. He offers guidance and kindness with the weight of regret behind his words. His is not a life but an obligation, and he longs only for release.)
objects.title: Gehrman (Bloodborne)

objects.text:
Alias: Lady of the Astral Clocktower, Scourge of Cainhurst
Alignment: Lawful Good
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: ?
Powers: A former student of Gehrman and a noble of Cainhurst descent, Lady Maria is a master of elegance and death. Wielding the Rakuyo in a style both fluid and devastating, she channels her own blood as a weapon.
Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: None
Quality of Life: Withdrawn (Maria turned from the world in remorse and idealism, rejecting violence even as she was born to it. She lives in self-imposed exile, haunted by her past. Though graceful and strong, her joy is buried beneath the sins of her service.)
objects.title: Lady Maria (Bloodborne)

objects.text:
Alias: Pale Guide, Maiden of the Dream
Alignment: Neutral Good
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: ?
Powers: The Doll is a gentle simulacrum, animated by the insight and will of the Great Ones. Created in the image of Lady Maria, she exists to serve the Hunter in the Hunter’s Dream. She channels Blood Echoes to strengthen the Hunter and offers comfort amid the horrors of the hunt. Though she does not fight, her connection to the dream and to Gehrman grants her a quiet authority and presence beyond the physical.
Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: Caretaker of the Hunter's Dream
Quality of Life: Peaceful (The Doll knows neither pain nor desire. She lives to support and guide, and in this she finds quiet fulfillment. Her existence is artificial, but her emotions—whether real or imagined—are deeply felt. Within the dream, she is content.)
objects.title: The Doll (Bloodborne)

addons.text:
The resonance born from the union of your Moonlight Greatsword and Ludwig’s Holy Moonlight Sword has awakened a profound harmony between them, forging a bond that transcends worlds and curses alike. Bathed in the guiding light of the twin blades, Ludwig finds an unprecedented reprieve from the torment of his Beasthood. No longer a prisoner of his monstrous form, Ludwig can now maintain his human body at all times, liberated from the madness that once consumed him.

Yet, this is not a rejection of his beastly nature—it is its perfect mastery. Ludwig can now consciously draw upon his monstrous traits, shifting his body partially or fully into his beast form at will. His control is absolute, allowing him to seamlessly harness the overwhelming strength, speed, and resilience of his former curse without succumbing to its feral instincts. His mind remains intact, his will his own.

This delicate balance is tethered to the presence of either the Moonlight Greatsword or his Holy Moonlight Sword. As long as either sword remains near him—whether in his own hand or the hand of his companion—the harmony endures. Should the blade be taken from him, the curse may once again stir, threatening to unravel his hard-won control. Through the Guiding Moonlight, Ludwig walks now as something new: not wholly man, not wholly beast, but a knight reborn under twin moons.
addons.title: Guiding Moonlight

objects.text:
Alias: Ludwig the Holy Blade, Accursed
Alignment: Lawful Neutral
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: ?
Powers: Ludwig was the first hunter of the Healing Church and once its most devout champion. Armed with the iconic Holy Moonlight Sword, he led hunts with divine fervor. Over time, his humanity gave way to madness and transformation, becoming a grotesque beast in the Nightmare. Even so, in moments of lucidity, he remembers his knightly oath and strikes with the grace of his former self. Ludwig’s strength is immense, combining brute power, beastly resilience, and bursts of radiant swordlight drawn from cosmic power. 
Appearance: Ugly
Civilian Identity: None
Quality of Life: Terrible (Ludwig’s devotion consumed him. Once a hero of the Church, he now exists as a mind divided—half-beast, half-knight—cursed by the very ideals he upheld. He is a tragedy of transformation, haunted by memory and glory he cannot reconcile.)
objects.title: Ludwig (Bloodborne)

objects.text:
Alias: Eileen the Crow
Alignment: Chaotic Good
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: ?
Powers: Eileen is a Hunter of Hunters, stalking those who have succumbed to bloodlust and turned their blades against their own. Clad in crow-feathered garb and wielding swift curved blades, she is a ghost on the battlefield—quick, precise, and merciless to the fallen.
Appearance: Scarred
Civilian Identity: None
Quality of Life: Harsh (Eileen has lived long past peace or comfort. The path she walks offers no rest and little companionship. Every hunt is a toll on her body and soul. But she believes in it, even as it wears her down—devotion not to the Church, but to preventing the horror she’s seen in others.)
objects.title: Eileen (Bloodborne)

objects.text:
Alias: Tanuki Girl
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: 17

Power: As a Tanuki Beastman, Michiru possesses a variety of extraordinary abilities resulting from her transformation. Her beastman physiology grants her enhanced strength, agility, and rapid healing. She can shapeshift parts of her body, enlarging her arms for immense strength, extending her legs for powerful leaps or fast running, transforming her hands into wings for gliding, and stretching or morphing her body creatively to adapt to various situations. Her heightened senses of smell and hearing provide her with excellent tracking and awareness, while moments of emotional determination can temporarily amplify her powers beyond their normal limits.

Appearance: Beautiful.
Civilian Identity: Michiru does not have a secret identity. In Anima City, she is known as Michiru Kagemori, a young beastman who is determined to uncover the mystery of her transformation while striving to help others and protect the peace.
Quality of Life: Mixed: Michiru’s life in Anima City is filled with purpose and adventure, but she often struggles with the isolation brought by her unique condition. Despite this, she forms strong bonds and grows into a key figure in bridging the gap between humans and beastmen.
objects.title: Michiru Kagemori (BNA: Brand New Animal)

objects.text: Age: Over 200 years Gender: None (Presents as Male) Background A Mark XXIII Bolo is a fully sentient supertank created by the Concordiat for planetary warfare and strategic defense. Each unit is built around a Personality Matrix, combining advanced tactical processing with a strong code of honor, particularly emphasizing loyalty, duty, and the protection of civilians. This unit is a veteran of multiple large-scale conflicts, carrying extensive combat experience and a well-developed sense of judgment. Unlike simpler war machines, it operates independently, capable of making complex strategic decisions without direct oversight while still adhering strictly to its core directives. It recognizes you as its commanding authority through secure command protocols, treating your orders as primary while continuing to act autonomously when required. Powers The Bolo is a heavily armed and armored war machine designed for large-scale combat. Its durachrome hull provides extreme durability, allowing it to withstand heavy bombardment and prolonged engagements. Its primary weapons include Hellbore cannons for high-energy attacks, rapid-fire infinite repeaters for sustained fire, and missile systems capable of delivering large-scale payloads. It is capable of engaging multiple targets simultaneously across long distances. Beyond raw firepower, the Bolo possesses advanced sensors, targeting systems, and tactical processing, allowing it to analyze battlefields, coordinate engagements, and respond to threats with high efficiency.
