It can operate continuously without fatigue and perform self-repair given sufficient time and resources, maintaining functionality even after sustaining significant damage.
objects.title: Bolo Mark XXIII B-BG (Boloverse)

objects.text: Alias: The Slayer Age: 16 Gender: Female Background Buffy was once an ordinary teenage girl before being called as the latest Slayer. As The Slayer she is burdened with the duty of fighting Vampires, Demons and the Forces of Darkness. Despite little training, she managed to slay the Master Vampire, Lothos and his minions, burning down her high school gym during a school dance in the process, resulting in her expulsion and eventual relocation to Sunnydale, California and enrolment at Sunnydale High. Power As a Slayer Buffy possesses various abilities to assist in her fight against the Forces of Darkness, including superhuman strength, stamina, speed, agility, reflexes, durability and an accelerated healing factor. Her Slayer nature gives her a natural proficiency with virtually all forms of weaponry and unarmed combat styles, a heightened sense of awareness that allows her to fight while blind and sometimes receive prophetic dreams.
objects.title: Buffy Summers (Buffy the Vampire Slayer)

objects.text: Alias: Jake Peralta, Rosa Diaz, Terry Crews, Amy Santiago, Charles Boyle, Gina Linetti, and Captain Holt Age: Adults Gender: Male and Female Background A wacky yet competent group of New York City Detectives led under the command of Captain Holt, a stern man with a lot to prove. This team consists of the laid back yet talented Jake Peralta, the intimidating Rosa Diaz, the strong and loving Terry Crews, the neurotic and competitive Amy Santiago, the often disinterested assistant named Gina Linetti, and the nervous yet reliable Charles Boyle. Shennanigans often ensue as they work through their issues while trying to maintain peace however they can in their city. Powers None, but they are rather competent and not corrupt cops, which might be useful.
objects.title: Brooklyn's 99th Precinct (Brooklyn 99)

objects.text: Age: 18-20 Gender: Male Background Soma lived a normal life as an exchange student living in Japan, until he learned about Dracula's Castle and was inexplicably drawn to it, to the point of venturing into the terrifying landmark on his own. Later, he would learn that he's the reincarnation of Dracula, explaining all of his powers and reasons that brought him there. Power Soma possesses the Power of Dominance (Castlevania) in Shardless Spiritual Powers, allowing him to absorb the souls of beings he defeats/kills in combat, gain all of their powers, and completely command them. He also has peak human characteristics and skill with weapons akin to the Belmonts. Note Soma comes preloaded with a set of souls already absorbed from the Power of Dominance. You can choose how many of them, what they are, or let both factors be random.
objects.title: Soma Cruz (Castlevania)

addons.text: By making a contract with Power, you can give her access to your pocket dimension's blood, letting her always have a backup supply ready. In exchange, she gives you access to her ability to make blood constructs, which you can now do with your blood.
addons.title: Blood Pact

objects.text: Alias: Blood Fiend, Blood Devil Age: Unknown Gender: Female Background Power is the Blood Devil inhabiting a human corpse, making her a Fiend. She joined Public Safety as a Devil Hunter though her primary motivations are self-interest, and comfort. Initially selfish, dishonest, and impulsive, she has formed bonds with others, such as Denji and Aki. Despite moments of growth, she erratic, being primarily driven by fear, pride, and simple desires. Powers Power can freely manipulate her own blood to form constructs. She has the enhanced physicality and regenerative abilities typical of devils. Her control over blood allows for mid-range attacks and unconventional combat tactics, though excessive use can weaken her if she loses too much blood. Warning Power is highly unreliable, prone to lying, and will avoid danger whenever possible. She has poor hygiene, an inflated ego, and a tendency to act recklessly. While capable of loyalty, it is inconsistent and often secondary to her own survival.
objects.title: Power (Chainsaw Man)

objects.text:
Alias: The Child of Prophecy
Alignment: True Good
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: ???
Power: None, Lucy may not possess any supernatural powers, but she compensates with her exceptional charisma and leadership skills. Her extensive experience with a wide variety of tricks, abilities, and gimmicks has made her adept at navigating through a myriad of different combat situations. She has mastered the art of supernatural swordsmanship due to her experience, although its practical application in the real world is limited due to her inability to perform superhuman feats to support it. Despite being an ordinary person, Lucy possesses the courage to face off against threats most would consider impossible to defeat. 
Appearance: Attractive (Cute)
Civilian Identity: Lucy
Quality of Life: Bad (Has experienced a time loop over 25,000 times and suffered throughout it.)

Note: While Lucy is just an ordinary girl, within digital landscapes she can go above and beyond her capabilities to pull feats strong enough to rebel against the master of the digital world to a limited degree.
objects.title: Lucy (ChronoArk)

objects.text:
Name: Stella, Rock, Mato Kuroi, etc.
Alias: BRS, Empress
Alignment: Neutral
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: Unknown

Power: Has all the powers, skills and abilities shown by any version of Black Rock Shooter with her main abilities being the creation of black fire arms and bladed weapons, her burning blue flame which gives her a massive power boost and a powerful regeneration allowing her to come back from anything short of complete destruction with even more powers and skills on hand such as summoning what PRT would call a Tinker Tech motorcycle and high speed fighter jet to name a few.

Also has a beautiful singing voice, girl could be a professional Idol easily.

Appearance: Attractive.
Civilian Life: Unknown.
Quality of Life: Bad (It is almost unheard of for a version of Black Rock Shooter to live a life free of violence and death)
objects.title: Black★Rock Shooter (Composite)

objects.text: Aliases: Prime Candidate 7, The Director Sex: Female Age: 28 Background One of only two survivors of a paranormal incident that took out her entire small hometown of Ordinary when she was 11, Jesse spent 17 years looking for the shadowy government agency that took away her brother, Dylan, the only other survivor. When she finally found them, she found them in a potentially world-ending crisis, and unwittingly became the new Director of the Federal Bureau of Control, with her first few days in office being dedicated to rescuing her brother and the rest of the Bureau from the Multidimensional Entity (known as the Hiss) that had taken over most of the non-euclidean headquarters of the Bureau (known as the Oldest House). Powers Jesse is extremely attuned to paranormal and supernatural energies and beings. This makes her an extremely appealing target for such entities, whether benevolent or otherwise, and gives her very high potential for using paranormal objects. Her access to paranormal energy gives her a degree of regeneration and physical empowerment, and powers the abilities granted by her Objects of Power, which aside from the Service Weapon (see OoP section), are altered everyday objects that endow her with various forms of Telekinesis (including Telekinetic Flight) and Mind Control, along with communication with Multidimensional Entities such as The Board. Her attunement to the entity “Polaris” even after its possible death also endows her with the ability to emit a paranormal resonance that protects other people from other paranormal effects. Note: For the sake of simplicity when dealing with multiversal compatibility, you may treat Jesse as generally “psychic” or “psionic” for the purposes of power interaction. You may freely choose Jesse’s loadout from every option in the game, but Jesse will not have access to all the options you didn’t choose without access to the Oldest House, though you may assume she has maxed out every ability.
objects.title: Jesse Faden (Control)

objects.text:
Title: Butcher of Arasaka
Alignment: Chaotic Evil
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: Late 80s

Power: Full Borg with 96% cybernetic body, giving him enhanced strength, durability, reflexes, advanced weaponry, and combat skills. Has various implants, including Experimental Military Sandevistan. He can optionally come with his DaiOni frame, but be warned as he is even more violent when in it.

Appearance: Ugly (Full metal body and a corpse like face attached to his head. Not generally aesthetically pleasing.)
Civilian Identity: None 
Quality of Life: Good (Lives for combat; exists primarily as a ruthless mercenary working for corporations, not concerned with traditional quality of life as most of his humanity is gone being a high functioning cyberpsycho)
objects.title: Adam Smasher (Cyberpunk 2077)

addons.text:
David Martinez has been outfitted with the Prototype Arasaka Cyberskeleton, an advanced piece of cybernetic technology designed to grant its user unprecedented physical power. The Cyberskeleton dramatically augments David’s strength, durability, and combat capabilities. One of its most notable features is control over gravity, allowing David to manipulate his surroundings by altering gravitational fields.

However, while the Cyberskeleton offers extreme power, it causes accelerated cyberpsychosis. As his psyche degrades, David becomes increasingly volatile, prone to erratic behavior and emotional instability. If he stays close to those he loves, like Lucy and his crew, it can give him temporary moments of clarity and can help stave off the worst effects of cyberpsychosis. With enough time, David will be able to adapt to the strain of the Cyberskeleton.

In addition, Gloria Martinez, David’s mother, is now alive and stands by his side. Gloria’s nurturing presence will serve as another anchor against David’s cyberpsychosis, reminding him of who he once was and what she originally wanted for him: a life beyond the bloodshed and tragedy.
addons.title: All The Way To The Top

objects.text:
Aliases: None
Alignment: Chaotic Good
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: 18

Power: David possesses advanced cybernetic enhancements, with the Sandevistan as his most notable implant, allowing him to slow time from his perspective and move at superhuman speeds. He also has exceptional physical strength, reflexes, and resilience due to his increasing reliance on cyberware.

Appearance: Handsome
Civilian Identity: None
Quality of Life: Deteriorating (David lives a high-stakes, dangerous life filled with violence and constant threats. His increasing cybernetic enhancements take a toll on his mental health, pushing him closer to cyberpsychosis. Despite his physical power, his emotional state is fragile due to his guilt, the pressure of leadership, and the loss of close allies).
objects.title: David Martinez (Cyberpunk 2077)

addons.text:
The entire crew—Maine, Dorio, Pillar, Kiwi, and even Sasha—are all alive and your companions. Their camaraderie is as strong as ever, with each member bringing their own unique strength to the team. This time, their loyalty to one another is stronger so the chances of betrayal is extremely low.

In addition, they now have a supply of immunosuppressants—enough to stave off the worst effects of Cyberpsychosis indefinitely.
addons.title: The Moon

objects.text:
Aliases: Lucy
Alignment: Chaotic Neutral
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: 20

Power: Lucy is an elite netrunner with the ability to breach the most secure systems and networks, a skill honed during her time as a test subject under Arasaka. She is exceptionally skilled at navigating the Old Net, a hazardous digital landscape full of rogue AIs and dangers. Lucy’s cyberware allows her to interface with networks at a deep level, manipulate data, and infiltrate even the most fortified systems. She also has a monowire that can be used to fight physically.

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: None
Quality of Life: Bad (Lucy’s life is haunted by her traumatic past as a subject of Arasaka’s brutal netrunner experiments. While she is highly capable and independent, she struggles with feelings of isolation, survivor’s guilt, and fear of being recaptured. Her dream of escaping to the Moon represents her desire for freedom and a better life, far from the corporate oppression she once endured.)
objects.title: Lucyna Kushinada (Cyberpunk 2077)

objects.text:
Alignment: Chaotic Good
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: ?

Power: The Best Netrunner of 2000-2010. She made a breakthrough in the transfer and containment of intelligence, both AI and the human mind. The unnamed program was able to transfer the user's mind into the Net and explore independent of their existing body. That program will later be turned into Soulkiller.

Appearance: Beautiful 
Civilian Identity: Altiera Cunningham
Quality of Life: Neutral

Note: You can choose to have her come as either an AI or as a cybernetically enhanced human.
objects.title: Alt (Cyberpunk 2077)

objects.text:
Aliases: None
Alignment: Chaotic Neutral
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: 20

Power: Rebecca has no supernatural abilities, but she is highly skilled with firearms, especially in dual-wielding heavy weapons. She has significant cybernetic enhancements that improve her combat abilities, such as her oversized cyberarms.

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: None
Quality of Life: Average
objects.title: Rebecca (Cyberpunk 2077)

objects.text:
Alignment: Chaotic Good
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: 34

Power: A rockerboy. Has a silvery bionic left arm, and his signature weapon Malorian Arms 3516.

Appearance: Handsome
Civilian Identity: Robert John Linder
Quality of Life: Neutral
objects.title: Johnny Silverhand (Cyberpunk 2077)

objects.text: Real Name: Song So Mi Gender: Female Age: 31 Background From her childhood in New York, it seemed that Song So Mi was destined to be a netrunner. She had hacked into numerous major corporate facilities, famously including a Biotechnica database in Oregon, by the time she was 19, but the hack that would truly seal her fate was a breach of a Militech facility through a Turkish proxy. This brought her to the attention of the NUSA government (firmly under the thumb of Militech) who at the suggestion of Solomon Reed, brought her in as an FIA agent. Now an experienced agent serving at the pleasure of President Rosalind Myers, she dreams of a day where she can finally be free... Powers One of the greatest living Netrunners, enhanced with bespoke military grade prototype cyberware to a degree that she is even able to fight fairly against rogue AI beyond the Blackwall. After her infection, she even gained the ability to channel the power of these AIs to some degree.
objects.title: Songbird (Cyberpunk 2077)

objects.text: Alias: The Sage of Shadowvale, Old Mage, Chosen of Mystra. Age: Around 1300 years Gender: Male Background Orphaned from a young age, Elminster was many things in his youth. Wanderer, bandit, thief. His greatest call, however, was magic. Despite hating mages, for his family was slayed by magelords, the intervention from the Goddess of magic herself, Mystra, changed his opinion, and he became her champion. Living and achieving more than most people could in a hundred lifetimes, Elminster is one of the greatest mages alive, and arguably the greatest protector of the Faerûn. Powers Elminster is a powerful wizard. With powers deriving from Arcane Magic (D&D) focused on the wizard class, Elmister knows thousands of spells, and could alter the landscape with a wave of his hands. He used the Wish spell to strengthen himself multiple times to enhance his intelligence, allowing him to better cast his spells, and possess an eidetic memory. His millenia of existence allowed him to set multiple safeguards if he is slayed or captured, to accrue multiple artifacts and magical items, and his vast repertoire of wealth allow him to craft any magical tool he may need. He is also a Chosen of Mystra and a minor cleric, able to cast some healing spells, and a passable fighter and rogue.
objects.title: Elminster (D&D)

objects.text:
Titles: Queen of Evil Dragons, Chromatic Mother, Avatar of Greed and Avarice
Alignment: Lawful/Chaotic Evil
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: Immeasurable, existing since the dawn of creation

Power: Tiamat is the fearsome five-headed dragon goddess, embodying greed, envy, and the essence of chromatic dragonkind. Each of her five heads represents one of the chromatic dragon species: red, blue, green, black, and white, each wielding elemental breath weapons corresponding to their kind. She commands overwhelming elemental force, divine authority over chromatic dragons, and the ability to shape her domain and corrupt the land around her. Tiamat can regenerate rapidly, wields powerful divine and arcane magic, and possesses a manipulative cunning that enables her to twist mortals and dragons to her will. Her presence alone is a corrupting influence, desolating the land and breaking the spirits of her enemies. Residing in the Nine Hells, she exerts control over her infernal domain and seeks to expand her power beyond it.

Appearance: Beautiful?
Civilian Identity: None
Quality of Life: Terrible
objects.title: Tiamat (D&D)

objects.text:
Alignment: Neutral
Gender: Female
Age: 18

Power: Kirumi Tojo holds the talent of Ultimate Maid. Exceptionally multi-skilled, she demonstrates peak human proficiency across a wide range of fields, including politics, business, art, and sports, in addition to flawless performance in traditional maid duties such as cleaning, cooking, and serving. She also excels at supporting others, providing insight and assistance to inventors, writers, and businessman, who often thrive under her efforts. Above all, she possesses superhuman levels of devotion to those she serves, committing herself wholly to their success and well-being.

Civilian Identity: High School Student
Quality of Life: It has its Ups and Downs
objects.title: Kirumi Tojo (Danganronpa)

objects.text:
Allias: Little Rookie, Rabbit Foot (After reaching 4 level), Regulus Alne (After reaching level 5)
Alignment: Neutral Good
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: 14

Power: He is a reincarnation of a Argonaut, Falna, he has a skill like Liaris Freese - increases the speed of Bell's growth as long as he is in love, Argonaut - allows a charge for active action, Ox Slayer - heavily increases all abilities when fighting raging bull-type monsters, Vanadis Tevere - raises all of Bell's stats by a large amount and regenerates his stamina and mind when Charm is being used on him and Magic: Firebolt, His development skills is Luck, Abnormal Resistance, Escape and Chain attack, Increase Combat Skills, High Speed.

Appearance: Handsome (Closer to Cute, like a rabbit)
Civilian Identity: Adventurer of Hestia Family, Record Holder
Quality of Life: Good
objects.title: Bell Cranel (DanMachi)

addons.text: In addition to her first and most loyal child, you get the rest of Hestia's familia, Welf Crozzo, Liliruca Arde, Mikoto Yamato, Haruhime Sanjou, Ryuu Lion, and Nina Tulle, with Hestia getting the Hestia Familia's home, better known as the Hearth Mansion, which will be stored within a pocket dimension. She now has a soulbound key that cannot be stolen, lost, or destroyed, which she can use to open doors/portals to her pocket dimension.
addons.title: Hearth Mansion

objects.text:
Title: Goddess of Family and Hearth, Loli Big-Boobs.
Alignment: Neutral Good
Gender: Female
Sex: Female

Power: As a goddess Hestia is a very powerful, but after descending a Lower World her full power is sealed, As the guardian of the sacred flame, Hestia rules over the protective fire, also called Eternal Torch, As a Virgin Goddess, Hestia is immune to the Goddesses of Beauty's charms and as like other gods in her world she has ability to create Famillia by giving people Falna's and recognize lies.

Appearance: Beautiful 
Civilian Identity: Goddess and head of the Hestia Familia
Quality of Life: Good/Stressful (When her child's are in danger or when they descend into the Dungeon.
objects.title: Hestia (DanMachi)

objects.text:
Title: Goddess of Mischief and Trickery, Flat-Chested Fox
Alignment: Chaotic Neutral
Gender: Female
Sex: Female

Power: As a goddess, Loki possesses immense divine power, though it is sealed upon descending to the Lower World. As the deity of mischief and chaos, she excels in manipulation, strategy, and reading people. She can form a Familia by bestowing Falna and can instinctively detect lies and emotional shifts. Though not a combatant herself in the Lower World, her divine insight and intellect make her a master behind the scenes.

Appearance: Mischievous
Civilian Identity: Goddess and head of the Loki Familia, one of Orario’s strongest.
Quality of Life: Great/Chaotic (Loves stirring trouble and watching over her elite Familia, but gets stressed when her kids ignore her plans or do dumb things.)
objects.title: Loki (DanMachi)

objects.text:
Title: Goddess of Beauty
Alignment: True Neutral
Gender: Female
Sex: Female

Powers: As a goddess, Freya possesses immense divine power, though it is sealed upon descending to the Lower World. As a goddess of beauty, she has the ability to charm the minds of nearly anyone, although certain powers are able to resist or ignore it. She also has the ability to peer into the brilliance of souls, allowing her to read emotions and estimate their statuses. She can form a Familia by bestowing Falna and is skilled at manipulating people.

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: Goddess and Head of the Freya Familia
Quality of life: It has its ups and downs.
objects.title: Freya (DanMachi)

objects.text:
Alias: Danny Phantom
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: 14

Power: A half-human/half-ghost hybrid whose ectoplasmic physiology grants a broad suite of powers. Core abilities include intangibility and invisibility at will, high-speed flight (air and vacuum), ecto-energy projection (rays, pulses, shields, and solid constructs), and the Ghostly Wail—an extreme, building-levelling sonic blast used sparingly due to its drain. 

He can overshadow targets to possess or steer their actions, extend that into dream invasion or exorcism, and briefly grant powers while possessing. He senses nearby spirits (ghost sense), duplicates himself, and displays elastic spectral body control for evasive contortions. With training he developed cryokinesis (freezing blasts and ice shields) and can combine elements (e.g., explosive ice shots). 

Situational feats include limited telekinesis, power/energy absorption and redirection through shields, partial transformation, and software fusion via interfaces. His resilience, stamina, reflexes, and healing are all superhuman in ghost form, and he learns new techniques quickly under pressure.

Appearance: Attractive
Civilian Identity: High School Student
Quality of Life: It Has Its Ups and Downs
objects.title: Danny Fenton (Danny Phantom)

objects.text:
Alias: Dani Phantom
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: 12

Power: A stabilized half-ghost clone of Danny whose ectoplasmic physiology grants the core ghost suite at a lighter ceiling: fast flight (air and underwater), intangibility, invisibility, spectral body manipulation, and green ecto-energy projection as rays, discs, pulses, shields, and short-range blasts (including the trademark “charge-kick” wave from her feet). She can overshadow targets (with optional voice masking), exorcise possessing ghosts, and slip into dreams; her ghost sense puffs cold when spirits are near, hinting at latent cryokinesis potential. 

Strength, agility, durability, and stamina are superhuman in ghost form; her healing factor is strong and, post-Ecto-Dejecto, allows full reconstitution from melted ectoplasm.

While less experienced than Danny, she learns quickly under pressure and has iron willpower that helped preserve her selfhood despite early instability. She has not shown the Ghostly Wail in canon, but may develop higher-tier techniques with training and time.

Appearance: Attractive
Civilian Identity: Danny Phantom clone.
Quality of Life: It Has Its Ups and Downs.
objects.title: Dani Fenton (Danny Phantom)

objects.text:
Title: Solaire of Astora
Alignment: Neutral Good
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: ???

Power: As an exceptional Warrior of the Sunlight he is proficient in combat with a mastery of lightning-based miracles and excellent swordsmanship.

Appearance: Attractive
Civilian Identity: Soldier
Quality of Life: Good (Lives a humble life as a traveling knight, dedicated to his quest to find his own sun and to uphold noble ideals.)
objects.title: Solaire (Dark Souls)

addons.text: The Firekeeper's "home", if you can call it that, is now stored within a pocket dimension containing the Firelink Shrine and Cemetery of Ash. She has a soulbound key that cannot be stolen, lost, or destroyed, which lets her open portals to it. The Cemetery of Ash contains no life, bar a few hollows, but the Firelink Shrine itself houses all characters from the game who either go to Firelink and stay or are there the entire time. This would be: Blacksmith Andre, the Shrine Handmaid, Irina of Carim, Karla, and the unbreakable Patches, who are all treated as having the full list of items they can sell and spells they can teach.
addons.title: Firelink Shrine

objects.text: Age: Unknown Gender: Female Background A beautiful young maiden that lives in a dying world. She is bound to her duty to the point her eyes were cut out as to prevent her from being tempted by the abyss itself. She holds no name, and her allegiance is to her master. She is a serene person, who holds little ambition beyond serving. Power Although her physical abilities are average, she holds the ability to be a nexus point of souls to gather, able to draw them in with greater force than any other afterlife. By using these souls, she is able to use their turn them into raw power for you, or others. The more that is used, the greater the cost on any given individual. And as a Fire Keeper, she is unable to die, forever duty-bound to the one she serves.
objects.title: Fire Keeper (Dark Souls III)

addons.text: Your mastery over pyromancy, when combined with Corynx's foundational knowledge and curiosity, results in a duo that is capable of creating new pyromancies that push its limits as an art and as an expression of the power of life itself. In due time, you may be able to reach the heights of the Witch of Izalith and her Daughters of Chaos, achieving, if not surpassing the creation of the Chaos Flame, from which demons were born.
addons.title: Refining a Flame

addons.text: Pyromancy is the manipulation of one's inner flame, and yours is much stronger than most. Corynx may be a master, but he is rather proud knowing your talent far surpasses his own. Anything he can teach you, you could easily refine to a level beyond what he's capable of, and eventually beyond anything he can imagine. In fact, he will wish to keep up with you, promoting his growth.
addons.title: Perfect Student

objects.text: Alias: Corynx of the Great Swamp Age: Unknown Gender: Male Background Cornyx is a pyromancer from the Great Swamp who travels in search of knowledge and worthy students. Despite using a forbidden art, he is patient, humble, and eager to share what he knows with anyone willing to learn. He is a remarkably hopeful man who takes pride in preserving his peoples' traditions of pyromancy, despite being in a bleak world consumed by decay and despair. His love of pyromancy may lead him to a darker fate, if left to pursue that which ought to stay forgotten. Powers He is a master of pyromancy, the art of manipulating the fire of life residing within one's own soul to control flames, and to some extent, the power of nature itself in the forms of body enhancement, poison generation, and the alteration of physical and spiritual states. He is capable of awakening the capacity to use pyromancy in others, and is an effective teacher due to his love and understanding of pyromancy. This version of Corynx has knowledge of all pyromancies from the Great Swamp, Carthus, and Izalith pyromancy tomes.
objects.title: Corynx (Dark Souls III)

addons.text:
You have gained the ability to create the species known as Klaxosapiens, their Amalgam forms, the Klaxosaurs, and various hybrids using specialized machines.

Klaxosapiens are a mostly humanoid, sapient species with largely human features. They possess greatly enhanced healing, mental and physical abilities, and the ability to evolve and alter their forms based on desire. They can also melt into a form of nature-promoting, hyper-dense, highly efficient energy, as well as a liquid form of energy. This energy is so efficient and possesses the necessary properties to facilitate FTL travel—provided you have the technology required to utilize it for that purpose. This energy also appears to allow objects to violate the square-cube law. You may create reactors to create this energy artificially, you may also convert it into other lesser or greater forms of energy, such as Electricity.  

Klaxosapiens also possess extremely fast and powerful tentacle-like tails, capable of effortlessly tearing through steel plates and blocks. The capabilities of a Klaxosaur depend on the number of Klaxosapiens that combine to create it. Klaxosapiens also seemingly possess a near-infinite lifespan.

Klaxosapiens typically have blue skin with various black markings, which usually originate around their eyes. However, they can possess a wide variety of skin tones and colored markings depending on factors such as where they grew up, trauma they experienced, and environmental influences.

You may choose to be a Klaxosapian yourself or a hybrid of one. If you choose to be a hybrid, you may determine the form and pattern of your markings, but not their color. Your Skin and markings color will instead be determined by factors such as your upbringing, trauma, and environmental influences.
addons.title: Klaxosapiens (Darling in the Franxx)

objects.text: Aliases: Oni, Demon, Partner Killer, Code: 002, Nine Iota Sex: Female Age: 15 Background A clone/Hybrid created from 001's DNA, also known as the Klaxosaur Princess. created as an experiment by Dr. Franxx, she would go through various painful experiments. She would later be broken out of her "Room" by Hiro, They would be later captured and have their memories of eachother poorly erased, which would cause Zero Two to obsess over finding this "Darling". Power As a Klaxosapien hybrid, she possesses greatly enhanced regeneration, stamina, physical abilities, and overall physical parameters, as well as heightened evolutionary potential. This evolution appears to be guided, at least slightly, by desire, as seen with her desire to become “more human,” which caused her to lose her red skin and shorten her horns. She also seems to lack the “tentacles” seen on 001. Note: You may decide whether she ever lost her red skin or how prominent her horns remain or not, as both were influenced by her immense desire to appear more human and the experiments she endured while growing up. You may also take the place of her “Darling” if you so wish.
objects.title: Zero-Two (Darling in the Franxx)

objects.text:
Alignment: Neutral Good
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: ~18

Power: Astral Spirit - Miku possesses a powerful voice-based ability that allows her to manipulate and influence others through her singing. Her voice can charm, pacify, or even command those who hear it, making them more susceptible to her influence. Additionally, her singing has restorative properties, capable of healing wounds and soothing mental exhaustion. Miku’s powers also enhance her physical and mental stamina, enabling her to perform for extended periods without fatigue.

Appearance: Miku has long, silky lavender hair styled in twin tails and striking blue eyes. She often wears elegant stage outfits that reflect her diva-like personality, radiating charisma and charm.
Civilian Identity: A famous singer and idol known for her mesmerizing performances and beautiful voice.
Quality of Life: High (Renowned Idol, Wealthy, Adored by Fans).

Warning: Miku’s confidence and diva-like tendencies can sometimes come off as arrogance. She has a strong sense of pride in her abilities and can become stubborn if her talents are questioned. While her powers are effective in most situations, they are less useful against those who are deaf or resistant to mental influence.
objects.title: Miku Izayoi (Date a Live)

addons.title: Beloved of the First Spirit
addons.text: Born as a Spirit full of innocence and naivety, you are the one who taught Mio to understand human emotions and ignited the feeling of love in her heart. Mio feels an unbreakable, almost fanatic love towards you, and wishes for nothing but to stay by your side until the end of time. She cares little if you want to start relationships with others, as her love for you is deeper than simple romance, and she knows that in the end she will be the one to spend eternity with you. Be aware that if Mio recognizes the possibility of your mortality, for example if you have a dangerous accident or visibly age, she will become terrified of you dying, and strive to make you as immortal as herself. Even if you possess means to survive mortal wounds, stop your own aging, or even resurrect yourself, she will not stop looking for ways to improve your immortality. In case you actually die Mio will try everything to bring you back to life, disregarding her own safety and morality as long as there is a chance to see you again. She might even develop self-destructive tendencies if she thinks all hope is lost in saving you.

addons.title: Astral Ascension
addons.text:
With your nature as a True Spirit similar to Mio herself, and in possession of the ten primary Angels, you have achieved what Mio has been desperately hoping for, and begun your ascension to become the Second Spirit of Origin. As your existence carries a conceptual status equal to Mio herself you replace the Qliphothic Tree as the only other viable manifestation of the Abrahamic God on Earth, meaning that no other being could ascend and become a Spirit of Origin besides you and Mio.

Though it will take a long time, and you will have to absorb massive quantities of spiritual energy before you truly reach Mio's power level, your conceptual status prevents your true death. Your newfound immortality has calmed Mio down greatly, knowing that even if either of you die one day the conceptual imprint will ultimately cause you both to be reborn, remember each other, and find to another again. Though she might still try to search for ways to grant you new methods of defense and immortality, only not as frantically as before.

objects.text: Alias: Spirit of Origin, Deus, Phantom, Reine Murasame Age: Around 30, appears as a young adult Gender: Female Background Mio is the First Spirit born from the collected mana of the whole world. After the death of the one she loved Mio began creating Spirits to separate off parts of her own power with the goal of resurrecting and empowering her beloved to become immortal like her. But even when committing terrible crimes against humans and Spirits she still grappled with her choices and could not let go of her compassion. Ultimately she realized the futility of her actions and chose to sacrifice herself to save the world and remaining loved ones. You can choose if your Mio went through all this. Mio has high intellectual and empathetic intelligence, with an incredible learning ability, and a penchant for observing people and the world. Her demeanor is generally quiet, though her consideration and understanding, especially for those she sees as friends and family, can be seen in all her actions. Powers As the primordial Spirit Mio is often described as almighty and invincible. In an occult sense she represents the Sephirothic Tree, akin to a manifestation of the Abrahamic God on Earth. While her true strength remains unknown, she was only ever injured by powers derived from her own. Mio's innate spiritual energy reserves are enough to create and fuel ten specialized Angels and Astral Dresses without greatly impacting her power. Besides that she also wields the three Angels Ain Soph Aur, Ain Soph and Ain that all focus on increasing grades of reality manipulation. From glowing particles that rewrite anything they touch, like instantly killing a target while ignoring any defense, to a domain in which she can freely alter the laws of reality, and finally the light that can bring anything into existence or erase anything she wants, ignoring fundamental rules.
objects.title: Mio Takamiya (Date A Live)

addons.title: Welcome to the Bat-Family
addons.text:
It seems Batman didn't come alone; the entire Bat-Family arrived with him, meaning both Batman and you will be able to rely on some of its most important members, each with their own skills, experience, and specialized equipment.

Among them, you'll find some of the best-known members, such as Nightwing (Dick Grayson), Batgirl (Barbara Gordon), Red Hood (Jason Todd), and Red Robin (Tim Drake), as well as other heroes who have been part of the Bat-Family over the years, including Spoiler (Stephanie Brown), The Signal (Duke Thomas), Batwing (Luke Fox), and Batwoman (Kate Kane).

In addition to its combat-oriented members, the Bat-Family also includes allies who contribute in their own way, such as Alfred Pennyworth, the family's butler and one of its most important figures, as well as Ace (Bat-Hound), Bat-Cow, and other pets who are also part of the family.

The arrival of the Bat-Family not only expands Batman's resources, but also gives you the opportunity to learn from each of its members, receiving training in different combat styles, tactics, technology, stealth, and other skills, guided by Gotham's greatest heroes, until you officially become part of the Bat-Family.

objects.text: Alias: Batman Age: ~40s Gender: Male Background Bruce was born to the Wayne family of Gotham, son of Martha and Thomas Wayne. Tragedy struck him at 8 years old when they were gunned down in an alley. Using his rage fueled by the tragedy, Bruce trained intensely over the next 15 years to eventually become the Dark Knight, Batman. During his life, he became the world's greatest detective, a founding member of the justice league, and a father. Powers Batman has no inherent superhuman powers; he relies on "his own scientific knowledge, detective skills, and athletic prowess". Batman's inexhaustible wealth gives him access to advanced technologies, and as a proficient scientist, he is able to use and modify these technologies to his advantage. In the stories, Batman is regarded as one of the world's greatest detectives, if not the world's greatest crime solver. Batman has been repeatedly described as having a genius-level intellect, being one of the greatest martial artists in the DC Universe, and having peak human physical and mental conditioning. As a polymath, his knowledge and expertise in countless disciplines is nearly unparalleled by any other character in the DC Universe. He has shown prowess in assorted fields such as mathematics, biology, physics, chemistry, and several levels of engineering. He has traveled the world acquiring the skills needed to aid him in his endeavors as Batman.
objects.title: Bruce Wayne (DC Comics)

objects.text: Alias: Wonder Woman Age: 5,000+ Gender: Female Background Princess Diana is the daughter of Hippolyta, Queen of the Amazons, and Zeus, the king of Olympus. She followed Steve Trevor and left Themyscira and its protection to defend peace and justice in the world of man, as Ares and darker forces started becoming active. With the backing of the Olympians, under the form of blessings and gifts, she grew to become one of Earth's mightiest heroes. She would join the Justice Society, then years later the Justice League. Powers Diana is depicted as a masterful athlete, acrobat, fighter and strategist, trained and experienced in many ancient and modern forms of armed and unarmed combat, including exclusive Amazonian martial arts. With her godlike abilities of incalculable superhuman strength, nigh-invulnerability, speed, flight, fast healing and semi-immortality, Diana's fighting prowess is enhanced.
objects.title: Diana Prince (DC Comics)

objects.text: Alias: Superman Age: late 30s to early 40s Gender: Male Background Kal-El, born on Krypton to Jor-El and Lara Lor-Van, was sent to Earth before his planet's destruction. Raised by Jonathan and Martha Kent as Clark Kent, he grew up with love and guidance, learning to keep his powers hidden to protect himself and others. Discovering his Kryptonian origins, Clark chose to use his abilities to protect others and uphold justice. He joined the Daily Planet as a reporter and donned a suit to conceal his identity when saving lives, earning the name Superman from the media. As Superman, he became a symbol of hope, battled foes like Lex Luthor, and joined the Justice League, earning recognition as the world’s greatest superhero. Powers Derived from his Kryptonian Physiology, Superman can absorb solar radiation in order to empower himself with a variety of abilities, including but not limited to; Flight, Biological Immortality, Nigh-Invulnerability, Self-Sustenance, Super Breath, Tactile Telekinesis, and Heat Vision. His physical capabilities are a marvel to witness, being almost akin to a god. From strength to move the moon, speed that grants pseudo tangibility and slows time for his perspective, indefinite stamina, viewing the entire electromagnetic spectrum, to elevated senses that defy logic, and more. He’s also displayed mastery in many combat styles, genius level intellect, an indomitable will, proved to be a capable leader, and many other skills befitting of a paragon. These abilities become further enhanced the more solar radiation is absorbed, or by simply being closer to the sun. All Kryptonians have a weakness towards Kryptonite and are vulnerable to Magic.
objects.title: Clark Kent (DC Comics)

objects.text:
Hero Name: Flash
Alignment: Lawful Good
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: late 20s to early 30s

Power: Through the Speedforce, Barry can go MFTL+ with little to no effort and even affect time itself

Appearance: Handsome
Civilian Identity: Barry Allen
Quality of Life: OK
objects.title: Barry Allen (DC Comics)

objects.text: Alias: Supergirl, Kara Danvers Age: 17 Gender: Female Background Kara Zor-El, born to Zor-El and Alura In-Ze on Krypton, was sent to Earth by her father to escape their planet’s destruction. Arriving during her cousin Kal-El’s early years as Superman, she was adopted by the Danvers family and became the protector of National City. As Kara Danvers, she leads a double life, balancing her secret identity with her role as Supergirl. One of the most powerful heroes in the world, she has served as a member of the Justice League and stands as a symbol of hope and strength alongside her cousin. Powers Has all the powers of Superman, but to a lesser degree due to a lack of training and experience. However, she makes up for this with a grab bag of other abilities separate from those of the Man of Steel. She is immune to all toxins and diseases, can project solar energy as a force field, aura, and for other applications, and can alter her voice as a form of sound manipulation. Finally, she is adept in several Kryptonian martial arts, is a skilled swordswoman, can manipulate chi, and is fluent in many Earthly and Kryptonian languages.
objects.title: Kara Zor-El (DC Comics)

objects.text: Alias: Power Girl Age: 27 Gender: Female Background The Supergirl of Earth-Two, Kara was born on Krypton and sent to Earth in a spaceship at the same time as her cousin, Kal-L. However, her ship took a longer journey, causing her to arrive decades later as a young adult. On Earth, she adopted the civilian identity of Karen Starr, a businesswoman, and became the superhero Power Girl. A survivor of the Crisis on Infinite Earths, Kara settled on the surviving Earth and joined the Justice Society of America. Powers Has the same powers and potential as Supergirl, due to being a counterpart of her. Notable differences in abilities include skill in boxing, karate, business management, computer operation, and acting.
objects.title: Karen Starr (DC Comics)

objects.text: Alias: Starfire Age: 20+ Gender: Female Background A princess from the planet Tamaran, she was enslaved during its conquest by the Citadel and experimented on by the Psions. After her escape, she crash-landed on Earth, where she joined the newly formed superhero team known as the Teen Titans as Starfire. Powers Derived from her Tamaranean Physiology, which gives a full suite of superhuman characteristics in strength, agility, reflexes, endurance, stamina and a mild degree of invulnerability. Other native abilities include Language Simulation via lip contact, Emotion Empowerment, Self Sustenance, having nine stomachs, and Breathing in Space. She can manipulate Ultraviolet Energy for various applications such as; Destructive Blasts and Waves (known as starbolts), Eye Lasers, Energy Absorption, Flight, and Pyrokinesis. Her powers require emotion to be used properly. She also has proficiency in unarmed combat and archery.
objects.title: Koriand'r (DC Comics)

objects.text: Alias: Rachel Roth Age: 20+ Gender: Female Background Raven is the daughter of the demon Trigon and the human Arella, destined to herald her father's arrival on Earth. Fearing Trigon's intentions for their daughter, Arella fled with Raven to Azarath, a dimension beyond his reach, where she was named Rachel and trained by monks to control her powers. When Trigon eventually found her, Rachel fled to Earth to protect her loved ones. There, she became a member of the Teen Titans and played a crucial role in defeating Trigon multiple times. Powers She possesses immense magical power due to being the half-demon daughter of Trigon. Despite her lack of physical prowess, she possesses great skill in unarmed combat and impressive durability. Her other talents include knowledge of occultism and fluency in many Earthly languages. Her most prominent ability is Soul-Self Projection, which allows her to perform feats such as telekinesis, energy projection, levitation, teleportation, intangibility, and the creation of constructs. Her soul-self normally takes the form of herself or a raven composed of dark energy, but it can take other shapes just as easily. The main anchor for controlling and limiting her power is her empathy. The more she feels, the more powerful she becomes, almost indefinitely. She can also wield her empathy for healing, showing others their darkest fears, seeing visions of the future, or seeing through the eyes of others. She has a strong affinity for magic and can cast many spells related to dark magic and the occult. She also possesses a wide array of magical artifacts, including spellbooks. Finally, she has a demon form that activates when she experiences heightened emotions, boosting all of her abilities and granting her new ones similar to those of Trigon. She actively avoids transforming into this form at all costs, as doing so causes her to lose control.
objects.title: Raven (DC Comics)

objects.text: Alias: Beast Boy, Changeling Age: 20+ Gender: Male Background Garfield Logan contracted a rare illness called Sakutia at a young age. To save his life, his parents administered a serum derived from a green monkey, which gave him green skin and a connection to The Red, granting Garfield the metahuman ability to transform into any animal he could imagine. After his parents tragically died in a boating accident, Garfield was adopted by Mento and Elasti-Girl of the Doom Patrol. He later joined the Teen Titans, battling villains like Deathstroke, and remained with the team as they became the Titans. Powers Beast Boy has the ability to tap into The Red, granting him the power to transform into any animal he knows of, whether big or small, ordinary, extinct, alien, or even mythical creatures. He can fully or partially transform into animals, remain indefinitely in animal form, and even transform into swarms of insects. However, Beast Boy risks losing control of himself when transformed, and when he becomes a swarm, he feels a small piece of himself fading away whenever one of his pieces dies, as his mind is split across multiple creatures.
objects.title: Garfield Logan (DC Comics)

objects.text: Alias: Cyborg Age: 20+ Gender: Male Background Victor Stone was caught in the explosion of a Mother Box when Darkseid first invaded Earth. His father, in a desperate attempt to save his life, fused him with the Mother Box and other pieces of technology, turning him into a cyborg. Victor proved to be vital in pushing back the invasion with his ability to connect to Apokoliptian technology. He went on to join both the Teen Titans and the Justice League, even serving as the leader of the League at times. Powers Possesses many superhuman attributes and abilities due to being half human and half cybernetic. Victor has superhuman strength and durability, enough to swing a building like a baseball bat if he pleases. He is internally invulnerable to any form of organic manipulation. He is equipped with various tools and cybernetic weapons, such as communicators, sensors, a sonic cannon, a chainsaw, a flashlight, a welding torch, and more. He can also detach his arms from his body and control them independently with ease. His other skills include expertise in mechanical engineering, robotics, physics, and computer science, as well as leadership, tactical planning, and highly skilled combat.
objects.title: Victor Stone (DC Comics)

addons.text:
You're officially the sixth member of the Teen Titans, standing alongside the other members as both partners on the battlefield and within Titans Tower. With your own room already decorated and outfitted with all you need, as if you had furbished it yourself.

Furthermore, you know all the fundamentals about the giant building and the people who live there, ensuring that you’ll get along with everyone to a friendly degree, are competent at using its various equipment, and can save yourself from causing trouble at minimum.
addons.title: Teen Titans GO!!!

objects.text: Alias: Nightwing, Robin Age: 20+ Gender: Male Background Dick Grayson, an acrobatic prodigy from Haly's Circus, performed alongside his parents until they were tragically killed by a mobster. Orphaned, Dick was adopted by Bruce Wayne, who trained him to become his crime-fighting partner, Robin. Later, Dick founded the Teen Titans and, after a falling-out with Bruce, forged his own path as the hero Nightwing. Powers Being trained by Bruce Wayne himself and his background as a performer has earned him many of his skills and immense physical prowess. Having prime human condition, expertise in martial arts, exceptional leadership skills. Also, similar to Batman, his suit houses various hidden compartments for his gadgetry. Other notable skills include: knowledge in mechanical engineering, physics, chemistry, interrogation, escapologist, marksman, pilot, thief, impersonator, infiltration, and finally, master detective.
objects.title: Dick Grayson (DC Comics)

objects.text: Alias: Didi, Teleute Age: Born at the beginning of the universe Gender: Female Background “When the first living thing existed, I was here, waiting. When the last living thing dies, my job will be finished. I'll put the chairs on the tables, turn out the lights and lock the universe behind when I leave.” Second oldest of the Endless after Destiny, she is the personification of Life and Death. Everyone meets her twice: at birth she gives the breath of life, and everyone, from stars to gods, sees her once more. She is the kindest of the Endless, acting as the maternal elder sister among her siblings, and always offering the newly dead "one last date". Powers Death is powerful - she can bring about death to anything, she can stop it. Yet, she puts a lot of care in her work; she doesn't like to interfere directly unless absolutely necessary. As your companion, as long as you're nice, she will likely spend a lot of time with you, discussing many things - sometimes highly philosophical, other times just mentioning things she's seen on the other side of the planet, or of the universe. However, just asking her to interfere likely won't get you anywhere. At most, if she likes you a lot, she might make you immortal, should you ask, and even then she'll likely try to dissuade you; however, be wary that this immortality is simply an absence of death. It doesn't ensure a happy life, or even that you'll live as more than a severed head. Also be mindful that trying to force her to use her powers, in any way, shape or form, is a dangerous path; Death is slow to anger, but her family is protective of their own, and their curses, while they likely wouldn't kill you, they would likely make your life miserable, even through almost any power or other protection you may have; after all, the Endless are old and creative.
objects.title: Death (DC Comics)

objects.text: Alias: Miss Martian, Megan Morse Age: 53 in Earth years & 18 in Martian years Gender: Female Background M'gann M'orzz, originally born as a White Martian on Mars, rejected her people's violent nature and sought to do good. After arriving on Earth, she met fellow Martian survivor J'onn J'onzz, who took her in as an adoptive niece. To blend in, M'gann adopted the appearance of a Green Martian and wore an Earth-inspired outfit that mirrored a younger, feminine version of her mentor. Taking on the superhero identity of Miss Martian, she would later join the Teen Titans and the Justice League, using her powers to fight for justice and peace. Powers As a White Martian, M'gann possesses a superhuman physiology that allows her to contend with Kryptonians and psionic control over her physical form at the molecular level. This grants her shapeshifting abilities, such as changing her appearance, elongating parts of her body, and altering her size. M'gann can also turn invisible, phase through matter, and has powerful regeneration, the ability to fly, enhanced senses, and extrasensory perceptions like infrared and X-ray vision. Additionally, she has enhanced longevity bordering on immortality, heat vision, telepathy, and telekinesis. However, like all Martians, M'gann has a psychosomatic vulnerability to fire.
objects.title: M'gann M'orzz (DC Comics)

objects.text: Alias: Martian Manhunter, John Jones Age: At least a thousand years Gender: Male Background Originally a Manhunter from Ma'aleca'andra, also known as Mars, J'onn J'onzz endured the devastating loss of his wife, M'yri'ah, and daughter, K'hym, when his planet was ravaged by H'ronmeer's Curse, leaving him seemingly the last of his kind. Eventually arriving on Earth, he assumed the identity of deceased detective John Jones and adopted the superhero persona of the Martian Manhunter. With his immense physical, shapeshifting, and psychic powers, J'onn fights to protect peace and justice, becoming a founding member of the Justice League and a steadfast guardian of Earth. Powers J'onn's Martian physiology grants him superhuman strength, durability, speed, and stamina comparable to a Kryptonian. He also possesses psionic control over his physical form at the molecular level, allowing him to shapeshift—such as changing his appearance, elongating parts of his body, and altering his size. J'onn can turn invisible, phase through matter, and regenerate from virtually any injury. He does not age, can fly at FTL speeds, possesses heat vision, and has enhanced senses, including extrasensory perception such as infrared and X-ray vision. J'onn also possesses telepathy and telekinesis, ranking among the most powerful telepaths in existence. However, as a Martian, J'onn has a psychosomatic vulnerability to fire.
objects.title: J'onn J'onzz (DC Comics)

objects.text: Alias: Static Age: 15 Gender: Male Background Virgil Hawkins is a teenager from Dakota City who gained electromagnetic powers after being exposed to an experimental tear gas that triggered a mass mutation event known as the ”Big Bang.” Virgil, already a bright and socially conscious youth with close friends like Frieda, Daisy, and Richie, chose to use his newfound powers for good. Taking up the name ”Static,” he became a superhero dedicated to protecting his city and standing up for justice. Powers Virgil can generate and manipulate electromagnetic energy, allowing him to project lightning, enhance his punches, create constructs, and create force fields. He can control metal objects by magnetizing or demagnetizing them, altering their properties, and launching them with force. His abilities include accelerated healing, which can be further enhanced by absorbing electricity, resistance to hypnosis and mind control through electromagnetic brain functions, and the ability to sense and see electromagnetic energy. Virgil can also tap into radio waves for communication and achieve flight by manipulating metallic objects. However, his powers are ineffective against materials like wood or rubber, which resist electricity.
objects.title: Virgil Hawkins (DC Comics)

objects.text: Alias: Swamp Thing Age: 30+ Gender: Male Background Alec Holland, a scientist who developed a Bio-Restorative Formula, became Swamp Thing after an explosion merged his consciousness with plant matter. As the champion of the Green, he battled foes like Woodrue and Anton Arcane while finding love with Abigail Arcane. Following the Flashpoint, Alec briefly regained his humanity but returned as Swamp Thing to confront Anton, the Avatar of the Black. Abigail became the new Avatar of the Black, and they resumed their relationship. Later Alec would join the Justice League and Justice League Dark. Powers Swamp Thing, as the Avatar of the Green, wields absolute control over plant life and draws immense power from it, granting him nearly incalculable strength and self-sufficiency. His sentient plant-based body enables him to travel at FTL speeds through the Green and grow a new body anywhere plants exist, regardless of distance. Swamp Thing can create multiple copies of himself and is effectively immortal, as his consciousness can reside in any trace of the Green in the universe. Additionally, he can alter his size at will, even growing to colossal proportions like an island.
objects.title: Alec Holland (DC Comics)

objects.text: Alias: Aquaman Age: 30+ Gender: Male Background Arthur Curry, or Orin, was born from the affair of Atlantean queen Atlanna and lighthouse keeper Tom Curry. Arthur was raised by his father and taught to learn his abilities until Tom Curry died of a heart attack. Arthur would flee human civilization and eventually take the throne of Atlantis. He would later go on to become one of the founding members of the Justice League under the alias of Aquaman, and marry Mera of Xebel and have a daughter named Andrina Curry. Powers Aquaman, a Human-Atlantean hybrid and royal Atlantean, possesses superhuman strength, durability, stamina, speed, reflexes, senses, and accelerated healing that rival Kryptonians. His Atlantean heritage also grants him magical potential and resistance to magic. In addition, Aquaman wields the Life Force, enabling him to communicate with marine life and all sentient beings in the universe, send telepathic broadcasts globally, and even across space and time when necessary. Gifted the Trident of Poseidon by the sea god himself, Aquaman can manipulate water, electricity, weather, create earthquakes, and fly when wielding it.
objects.title: Arthur Curry (DC Comics)

objects.text: Aliases: Occasionally goes by Aquawoman Age: Appears to be around mid 30s Gender: Female Background Mera was born to King Ryus of Xebel, one of seven kingdoms that splintered off from Atlantis when it sunk into the ocean. She was trained in combat and hydrokinesis with the end goal of killing the king of Atlantis, Aquaman. She ended up falling in love with him and married him, becoming Queen of Atlantis by his side. Powers As a Royal Xebellian, Mera possesses the abilities common to Atlantean physiology at a much higher level. She is strong enough to lift more than 70 tons and jump 2000 meters into the air. She can move fast enough to dodge lighting at point blank range and swim at speeds over Mach 5. Mera was also trained in armed and unarmed combat, is a highly skilled leader and politician, and is smart enough to construct a supercomputer in her spare time. Mera also possesses powerful hydrokinesis due to her Royal Xebellian heritage. She has enough power to hold back a tidal wave the size of a city, and enough precision to create water constructs and collect the water in someone’s body to fill up their lungs. She can also sense nearby bodies of water and what they contain. However, Mera can only manipulate water as a liquid, meaning ice and snow are beyond her abilities, and she cannot create water out of nothing.
objects.title: Mera (DC Comics)

objects.text: Aliases: The Operator Gender: Male Background As a child, Robbie Reed found a strange device called the H-Dial. This strange ‘disconnected phone dial’ allowed him to become a new random hero every time he dialed ‘H’. As much as Robbie loved being a ‘hero’ over time various events and Crises ended up splitting him into quite literally different people. One of these ‘people’ sought to travel to the ‘source’ of the H-Dial’s power, but in the process stranded himself in the HEROVERSE, the overarching framework of his universe while the H-Dial itself fell into different hands. Powers As a resident of the HEROVERSE, Robbie does not have any explicit powers, but by traversing it he can perceive virtually any place in the local universe… so long as it is ‘plot relevant’, being built around the structure of DC’s ‘heroic comic’ setting. Other than this, Robbie’s understanding of the HEROVERSE and the H-Dial has allowed him to collect various ‘samples’ of them that he is loathe to share except in the most dire of circumstances. Unfortunately, Robbie is trapped in the HEROVERSE, and cannot leave it.
objects.title: Robbie Reed (DC Comics)

objects.text: Aliases: Rac, Looma, River, The Changing Man, The Changing Girl, The Changing Woman Gender: Madness Background Rac Shade was a poet from Meta who used an experimental ‘Madness Vest’ to come to earth and attempt to stop a ‘tide of madness’ from overrunning the planet. Looma Shade was a girl from Meta who stole a ‘Madness Vest’ from a museum to find a place that meant anything. River Shade was a human who let everything blur together into a technicolour dream. Shade is not a consistent being. Both singular and multiple the various selves tend to flow and branch out in different ways. While each is ‘Shade’, an amalgam of sorts, being associated with each other through the metaphysical M-Vest, each definitely has their own opinions, personalities and concerns. Powers Shade has access to the M-vest, a wearable device that allows the user to see, create and affect psychic phenomena through ‘madness’. While this is in theory incredibly powerful, it comes at the price of their lucidity, which is often fleeting and at the whim of their own mental wellbeing. While River may be the most cognizant, Looma was by far the most prolific and attuned to the Madness, and Rac remains most experienced, having been submerged in the Madness for subjective infinities.
objects.title: Shade (DC Comics)

objects.text: Aliases: Sideways Age: 17 Gender: Male Background Puerto Rico born, Gotham-Adopted, Derek James fell into a rift into the Dark Multiverse. After four days, he was able to use his new and unexplained powers to teleport out and back to safety. Since then, he’s been acting as a street-level vigilante for Gotham, fighting Speedsters, dimensional police, and the like. However, due to the fact his rifts are not limited to his home dimension he’s since gotten into troubles with entities like the Kingdom of Benevolence. Powers Derek can make tears in space time, or ‘rifts’ that allow him to travel to different places at will, even crossing dimensions with little strain. These portals are clear, allowing them to be seen through like windows. These rifts notably have solid edges that are almost indestructible while open. Similarly when closed they can cause tremendous harm, as seen when he accidentally severed the speedster ‘Killspeed’s arm. However, should a rift be opened inside another rift, it can have catastrophic problems, creating a microscopic black hole, which immediately collapses causing a massive explosion.
objects.title: Derek James (DC Comics)

objects.text: Alias: Batgirl, Black Bat, Orphan Age: 17 Gender: Female Background Cassandra Cain was trained from birth by her father David Cain with the intention of creating a perfect killer. This was done by keeping her in a controlled environment and communicating with her via actions, causing the linguistic portions of her brain to interpret body language at the cost of severely curtailing her ability to speak, read, and write. Cassandra ran away from David after a traumatic experience, and ended up in Gotham where she saved the life of James Gordon. She was taken under the wing of Batman and Barbara Gordon, and was permitted to take on the mantle of Batgirl. Cassandra would go on to continue serving with the Bat-Family, and also became a member of the crime fighting team known as the Birds of Prey. Powers Cassandra possesses peak human physical capabilities and is extremely proficient in martial arts. She can read body language to such a degree that it allows her to predict attacks or even infer meaning behind the speech of the person without knowing the language. Note: As the portion of her mind that deals with communication is almost solely dedicated to understanding body language, if she learns any other language, it will decrease her fighting capabilities.
objects.title: Cassandra Cain (DC Comics)

objects.text: Gender: Female Age: high performing recent doctoral graduate, so around mid-20s to early-30s Background A former psychiatrist working in Arkham Asylum under her legal name of Harleen Quinzel, her life would be completely derailed upon interviewing the Joker. He would gradually find her psychological weak spots and use them against her to make her obsessively codependent on him, in a sense inverting the role of patient and psychiatrist. Now she has been driven into freeing him from Arkham and becoming his henchwoman, so in thrall to him that she turned her very name into a joke. Powers Is as skilled and agile as a professional gymnast or acrobat, has moderate skill in the martial arts, equivalent to a multiple black belt or a professional MMA fighter, and with her natural charisma & PhD level psychological knowledge, is skilled in manipulation, disguise, & deception. Thanks to an injection from Poison Ivy, she has enhanced physical abilities similar to the Perks Olympic & Frankenstein, as well as an innate resistance to many poisons & chemicals.
objects.title: Harley Quinn (DC Comics)

objects.text: Alias: Catwoman Gender: Female Age: Mid 20s to Early 30s Background While it varies based on the universe, Selina is usually a cat-burglar with an on-again-off-again "Frenemy" relationship with the Bat-Family, based out of Gotham City, New Jersey. Her wealth is very bipolar; she is either quite rich or quite poor. Powers No powers, but is a near-metahumanly skilled acrobat, cat burglar, martial artist, survivalist, veterinarian, linguist, spy, and Julien Sorel-esque social climber.
objects.title: Selina Kyle (DC Comics)

objects.text: Alias: Black Canary Gender: Female Age: late 20s to early 30s Background Born into a legacy of heroism, Dinah Lance Drake grew up in the shadow and guidance of her mother, the original Black Canary. Trained from a young age in both combat and crimefighting, Dinah inherited not only her mother’s will but also the metahuman Canary Cry. Carving out her own path, she became a key member of teams like the Justice League and Birds of Prey, balancing a life of street-level justice, global threats, and personal struggles. Powers Black Canary is renowned for her Canary Cry, a powerful sonic scream capable of shattering objects, disorienting enemies, and even incapacitating superpowered foes. This ability allows her to generate high-frequency sound waves that can cause structural damage, knock opponents unconscious, or counteract other sonic-based attacks. Her control over the Canary Cry is precise, enabling her to modulate its intensity and focus it in specific directions. In some versions, her scream is strong enough to bring down buildings or take out multiple enemies at once. Beyond her metahuman power, Black Canary is one of the most skilled hand-to-hand combatants in the DC Universe. She is a master martial artist, trained in various disciplines including judo, boxing, karate, and krav maga. Her combat skills rival those of Batman and Lady Shiva, making her one of the top fighters in the world. She has trained under elite instructors and has even served as a mentor to younger heroes. Additionally, she is an expert in stealth, espionage, and tactical strategy, often working as a field leader for teams like the Justice League and Birds of Prey. Her agility, endurance, and reflexes are at peak human levels, allowing her to hold her own against superpowered threats even without her Canary Cry.
objects.title: Dinah Lance Drake (DC Comics)

objects.text: Alias: Agent Orange Name: Larfleeze Alignment: Chaotic Neutral Gender: Male Sex: Male Age: >2 million years old Power: Sh'pilkuzzian Phisiology, Orange Lantern Ring, A body so suffused with Orange energy he's become a physical power battery. Civilian Identity: N/A Quality of life: Bad (only wasn’t sold into slavery because his parents could legally only sell six, Spent most of his life living in a cave, the most avaricious being in the universe, genuinely insufferable personality, incapable of conceptualising others outside of what they can give him or being possessed BY him) Note: As he is being taken as a companion, Larfleeze will default to treating you as a possession as opposed to a person keeping something from him. Do with this knowledge what you will.
objects.title: Larfleeze (DC Comics)

objects.text: Age: 20+ Gender: Female Background Zatanna Zatara, the daughter of famed magician Giovanni Zatara, initially made her name as a successful stage illusionist before discovering her true magical abilities. She later joined the Justice League as the team's expert on magical matters, eventually becoming one of the world's greatest magicians and earning the title of Sorceress Supreme. Powers Extremely powerful magician who primarily performs her spells through Logomancy. This can produce a wide variety of effects from controlling the elements to molecular transmutation. She also has expertise in summoning magic and black magic, which she can also combine with her logomancy for more potent effects. Also a skilled stage magician with knowledge of escapology, lockpicking, and sleight of hand, and a skilled hand to hand combatant trained by Bruce Wayne.
objects.title: Zatanna Zatara (DC Comics)

objects.text: Alias: Green Lantern Age: 30-40 Gender: Male Background Hal Jordan was deeply traumatized as a child by witnessing his father's death in a plane crash. Despite his fear of flying, he followed in his father's footsteps and became a military test pilot. His life changed when he was chosen by the dying Green Lantern, Abin Sur, who passed on his ring, making Hal the new Green Lantern of sector 2814. Hal quickly rose to prominence, forming a friendship with Sinestro, only to later discover Sinestro's tyrannical rule over Korugar. After turning Sinestro in to the Green Lantern Corps, he became his bitter enemy. Hal went on to become a founding member of the Justice League and found love with Carol Ferris, who later became the Star Sapphire. Powers As a Green Lantern, Hal wields the Green Lantern Ring and is known as a legendary Green Lantern and one of the most powerful members of the Corps. His Green Lantern Ring allows Hal access to the Emotional Electromagnetic Spectrum to affect and use fundamental forces of the known universe, including electromagnetic energies such as gravity, radiation, heat, and light. He can do virtually anything with the ring, limited only by his skill, knowledge, imagination, and willpower. Among its uses, the ring allows Hal to project energy powered by his will, create force fields to protect himself and others (which also provide life support), generate energy constructs from his thoughts, phase through matter, recreate holographic environments based on data, become invisible, alter minds, create a Green Lantern uniform, heal physical injuries, access the vast knowledge of the Book of Oa, automatically translate any language, fly at FTL speeds, create wormholes, travel through time, and more. However, as a Green Lantern, Hal is vulnerable to the power of fear wielded by Yellow Lantern Rings. The ring also has a battery and must be recharged when it runs out of energy. Additionally, the power of rage wielded by Red Lantern Rings can dissolve the energy generated by a Green Lantern Ring.
objects.title: Hal Jordan (DC Comics)

objects.text: Alias: Doctor Fate Age: 80+ Gender: Male Background Kent Nelson was chosen by Nabu at the age of 12 to become the next bearer of the Helmet of Fate. Magically enhanced and aged up by Nabu, he transformed into the being of pure order known as Doctor Fate. Kent became a founding member of the original Justice Society and served as an agent of the Lords of Order, combating various magical threats. In later years, Kent also mentored his great-nephew, Khalid Nassour, in the arcane arts. Powers Dr. Kent Nelson was aged from 12 to adulthood—both mentally and physically brought to his peak—and granted vast knowledge of occultism. He was chosen and molded by the Lord of Order known as Nabu to wield the Helmet of Fate. As Doctor Fate, Nelson became one of the most powerful sorcerers in existence. The Helmet of Fate, combined with Nelson’s mastery of the occult, grants him a wide array of abilities and spells. These include superhuman strength, durability, speed, and stamina comparable to Superman’s, as well as flight, magical energy projection, elemental manipulation, time manipulation, agelessness, astral projection, healing, resurrection, telepathy, telekinesis, cosmic awareness, teleportation, and dimensional travel, among others. Doctor Fate also commands the Tower of Fate—a fortress that serves as a nexus point between all realities and a beacon of magical power. Within it, he stores a vast collection of magical artifacts, both for safekeeping and for use when needed. As one of Earth’s most powerful magical protectors, Doctor Fate has battled all manner of threats, ranging from demons and dimensional invaders to gods.
objects.title: Kent Nelson (DC Comics)

objects.text: Aliases: Inertia Age: 14 Gender: Male Background The first clone made by Thaddeus Thawn, Thad was created to kill and replace his ‘brother’ Bart ‘Impulse’ Allen. Unfortunately, he ended this attempt by walking directly into the speedforce, allowing C.R.A.D.L.E to produce six more clones to take over while he was presumed dead. Thad is a deeply immature person lacking in virtually all places except an incredibly deep well of knowledge. Oppositional and combative, but also a people pleaser at his core. He’s so used to simply watching events that when hit by real and strong emotions he’s blindsided by them and gets caught fiercely in them. Powers Inertia is a speedster, and has a connection to the Speedforce like many others, allowing him to move at superhuman speeds and with superhuman reaction times. Similarly, he can and has used this connection to travel through time by entering it directly before. He was additionally taught by C.R.A.D.L.E with a great wealth of knowledge but has very little actual experience.
objects.title: Thaddeus Thawn II (DC Comics: Frequency by Cryptocism)

objects.text: Age: 30+ Gender: Male Background The man who would become Bane was born the son of a revolutionary who escaped an infamous Santa Priscan prison named Peña Dura. The child was forced to serve the rest of his father’s sentence in said prison, and spent his early life struggling to survive, becoming smarter, and becoming stronger. He would eventually break out of Peña Dura after being experimented on with a super-steroid known as Venom, and became obsessed with conquering the seemingly untamable Gotham City and her protector Batman. Bane was able to successfully defeat Batman on his first attempt, becoming infamous for breaking Batman’s back. Since then, he has been one of the Batman Family’s most dangerous foes. Powers Has a genius intellect similar to that of Bruce Wayne, gained knowledge in multiple fields on par with leading experts in said fields, and is an extraordinarily skilled tactician and escapologist. Has trained himself to the peak of the human condition and is skilled in weapons and hand to hand combat to the point where he can defeat Batman even without using Venom. Bane frequently uses a super-steroid known as Venom to enhance his physiology to superhuman levels similar to those of Killer Croc. When using Venom he can withstand blows that would kill an ordinary man, break out of 2,737 cubic pounds of ice, and almost instantly recover from 50,000 volts of electricity. However, overuse of Venom can lead to temporary insanity and Venom itself is highly addictive.
objects.title: Bane (DC Comics)

objects.text: Alias: Hellblazer Age: 30+ Gender: Male Background John Constantine, a magician from London, lost his parents in a fire during his childhood caused by a spell he cast, unaware it required a sacrifice. After a failed attempt to save a child from a demon, which became one of his greatest regrets, Constantine committed himself to refining his magical abilities, mastering the occult in Europe. He had a tragic romantic history, including a strained relationship with Zatanna Zatara. Later, Constantine joined the Justice League Dark and helped defeat powerful threats like the Upside Down Man. Powers A highly skilled magician with deep occult knowledge, John Constantine is one of the most powerful magicians. He knows how to use magic effectively to achieve his goals and possesses a vast array of spells for any situation, including manipulating elements, exorcism, seeing supernatural beings like ghosts, necromancy, astral projection, summoning demons and spirits, and creating portals to other dimensions and realities. Constantine also has Synchronicity Wave Traveling, an instinctual supernatural power that grants him uncanny luck.
objects.title: John Constantine (DC Comics)

objects.text:
Name: Abigail "Abby" Arcane 
Alias: Black Queen
Alignment: Neutral Good
Gender: Feminine
Sex: Female
Age: 30-40

Power: Abigail Arcane, as the Avatar of the Black, wields absolute control over decay, rot, and death, drawing immense power from them that grants her nearly incalculable strength and self-sufficiency.
