Her undead body allows her to travel at lightspeed through the Black and regenerate a new form anywhere decay exists, regardless of distance. She can create multiple copies of herself and is effectively immortal, as her consciousness can inhabit any trace of the Black in the universe. Additionally, she can alter her size at will, ranging from microscopic to colossal proportions.

Appearance: Beautiful 
Civilian Identity: Avatar of the Black
Quality of Life: It Has its Ups and Downs
objects.title: Abigail Arcane (DC Comics)

objects.text:
Name: N/A
Alignment: Chaotic Good
Gender: Is referred to with male pronouns
Sex: N/A

Power: Has superhuman strength and durability, able to easily lift a bathtub with a humanoid with no problems and can take bullets with no issues. Is capable of flight and can turn his arms into
machine guns with a massive amount of ammunition. Is powerful and skilled enough to kill hundreds of Nazis during WWII.

Appearance:  Robot
Civilian Identity: N/A
Quality of Life: Terrible (Was programmed to kill Nazis and not much else, outlived most of his friends from the army, is very much a relic of a past time that is unable to change. Despite this, is still generally optimistic and willing to make friends on the basis of killing Nazis together)

Note: He will consider you his commanding officer and will generally adhere to your position on who is and isn’t a Nazi. This does not make him incapable of making his own judgements, and if he’s sufficiently convinced someone is a Nazi his programming will be prioritized above your orders.
objects.title: GI Robot (DCU)

objects.text: Alias: 'Shocking Suzi' Gender: Male (?) Age: early 30s Background After finding the H-Dial, Joe Hamil was transformed into ‘Shocking Suzi’... And promptly lost the H-Dial, trapping him in that body. Despite having superpowers now, the next weeks would take worse and worse turns for ‘Jo’ until they were barely making ends meet without any ID or proof of their real identity. Powers Since the H-Dial randomly selected ‘shocking suzi’, Joe has medium speed flight, but strong electrokinetic powers, being able to generate massive amounts of electricity with seemingly no negative effect (beyond collateral damage) However, these powers are tied to their mental state, and given the shockingly terrible downward spiral ‘Joe’ has been on, they’ve been unable to use them for little more than quick sparkles recently.
objects.title: Joe Hamil (DC Comics)

objects.text: Alias: Fire Age: 20+ Gender: Female Background Beatriz Bonilla da Costa began her career as a model and performer in Rio de Janeiro before becoming an undercover agent for the Brazilian government. During a mission, she was caught in a pyroplasmic explosion that granted her fire-based powers. Taking on the name Green Fury, she joined the Global Guardians and later rebranded as Green Flame. When the team lost UN funding, Beatriz and her close friend Icemaiden joined the Justice League International. There, they both shortened their names, with Beatriz adopting the codename "Fire" to complement Icemaiden’s new moniker, "Ice." Powers Beatriz is a Pyrokinetic, able to unleash green flames from any part of her body. She can shift into a pyroplasmic form, turning her body fully green, massively amplifying her fire-based abilities and letting her fly.
objects.title: Beatriz da Costa (DC Comics)

objects.text:
Hero Name: Ice
Alignment: Neutral Good
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: 20s

Power: Tora is a cryokinetic. She can conjure massive amounts of ice and snow at will, shaping them into any form required.


Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: Model
Quality of Life: Good
objects.title: Tora Olafsdotter (DC Comics)

objects.text: Aliases: Salem the Witch Girl Age: 14/80s (Stolen from time in the 1940s) Gender: Female Background Salem Nadir was born in Limbo Town, a magical colony of subterranean puritans. Suffering a curse that ensured anyone who cared for her would suffer various misfortunes, ranging from the minor to the fatal. In 1940 after leaving Limbo Town she met Kent Nelson, Doctor Fate, and became his ‘protege’ while he attempted to find a way to remove, or at least mitigate, her curse. She disappeared from the world on March 13, 1944, stolen away from the timeline by a ‘time scavenger’ called the Childminder, aiming to sell a large number of forgotten sidekicks in return for returning her youth. After foiling this scheme, Salem was returned to the world decades after she’d left, where Kent Nelson had died, Nabu had passed from the world, and nobody could even remember her existence. As a person, Salem is a somewhat vindictive, arrogant, and standoffish little sneak. Her time as an outcast from Limbo Town, only to be stolen away from the only parental figure she’d ever really known has rendered her rather brittle and defensive. In addition, her tendency towards arrogance and unpleasantness serves to keep others from getting close to her, and thus keep them at less risk from her curse. She’s proud of her power, sure in her strength, and in desperate need of any form of release valve. Powers Salem is a powerful witch, both due to her extradimensional heritage, and in receiving training from Doctor Fate. Among these trainings are the signature Ankh-shaped mnemonics taught to her by Kent Nelson, teleportations and other standard useful magical abilities. Additionally she‘s adept at seeing through non-magical illusions, finding them ‘flatter’ than real people. However, while powerful, she’s still prone to overextending, and allowing her power to become unstable. For example, once while attempting to turn Solomon Grundy human again, temporarily, she accidentally ended up burning him to ash. She also has a seemingly sentient flying broom named Sweep.
objects.title: Salem Nadir (DC Comics)

objects.text: Aliases: Secret Age: 14 Gender: Female Background Greta Hayes was murdered by her brother, Billy ‘Harm’ Hayes. Wandering the earth she was eventually captured by the DEO before being involuntarily freed by the nascent Young Justice. After joining the team, she’d continue to flee from the DEO in between ‘missions’ (which usually took the form of Young Justice being roped into whatever mess one of the members had gotten themselves into). Playing baseball for the fate of the planet, fighting Tim’s ex-girlfriend, attempting to force Superboy to actually pick a name, and of course, Invading Apokalypse. It was after that last mission she’d choose to retire, having seen a friend die and die herself while there, for a while. Greta is flighty by nature, but loyal almost to a fault. A born follower, she takes orders quickly and efficiently. That said, she's not the sharpest tool in the shed, and is rather naive once managing to mistake the New God ‘Darkseid’ for a regular, if strange, alien. Powers Greta is a Warder, a kind of spiritual entity designed to guide the dead to the other side. As such, she’s incorporeal and ghostly, able to fly, become intangible, possess others and perform most actions assumed of a ghost. Additionally, to facilitate her role she can jump into a private dimension named the ‘Abyss’ temporarily.
objects.title: Greta Hayes (DC Comics)

objects.text: Aliases: Big Barda Age: Was born in 1748 in human years Gender: Female Background Barda was born on Apokalips and trained by Granny Goodness to lead the Female Furies, Darkseid’s elite warriors. She then met Highfather’s son Scott Free, fell in love with him, and eventually they were both able to escape Apokalips and go to Earth, where they would marry and become valuable members of the Justice League. Powers New God physiology grants her immortality superhuman physical characteristics akin to those of Wonder Woman. Even while severely wounded can still lift 55 tons. Can withstand attacks from beings as strong as Superwoman without major damage. Can also grow into a giant at will, but rarely uses this ability. Is highly trained in hand to hand combat and weapons. Fought Wonder Woman to a draw and forced her to cheat in order to win another fight. Possesses various technologies from Apokalips, including a Mother Box that can create Boom Tubes, Aero Discs for flight, and her signature Mega Rod. Aside from being used as a weapon, the Mega Rod can fire energy blasts that can tear through heavily armored spacecraft and can also be used to fly.
objects.title: Big Barda (DC Comics)

objects.text: Aliases: Batgirl, Oracle Gender: Female Age: 15-20+ (Depending on the version) Background Barbara Gordon is the daughter of the police commissioner who was most famous for working alongside Batman, and as a result grew up being quite a fan of his. She eventually managed to become the Dark Knight's side kick and became Batgirl, a part of the overarching Bat Family. Depending on the version of her you get, you can also get the Barbara that had been attacked by the Joker, who shot her in the spine and paralyzed her from the waist down. She wouldn't have let this keep her down however and would have become the Girl in the Chair known as Oracle, helping Batman behind the scenes with her phenomenal tech skills. Powers Barbara has no inherent powers, but is trained to peak human capability, and is incredibly well trained when it comes to combat, acrobatics, forensic science, and chemistry. Her true talent and capabilities lie in her computer science skill, she is incredibly skilled at hacking, making her a top tier information broker for other heroes.
objects.title: Barbara Gordon (DC Comics)

Alignment: Chaotic Neutral
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: 16–19 

Power: She has probability manipulation, more specifically she can wield the power of bad luck, which manifests as pink, lightning-like energy blasts/waves fired from her hands. 

Appearance: Beautiful 
Civilian Identity: None
Quality of Life: Has its Ups and Downs
objects.title: Jinx (DC Comics: Teen Titans)

objects.text: Aliases: Gold, Lead, Platinum (Tina), Mercury, Tin, Iron, Gender: Machine, Female (Platinum) Background Created by doctor Will Magnus by implanting a ‘Responsometer’ capable of bestowing sapience and bonding material with microcircuitry into various vats of pure metals, creating the metamorphic miracles of artificial intelligence the Metal Men! While Magnus received acclaim for his invention of fully sapient life, his six Metal Men went on to fight extra-terrestrial invaders, strange robotic duplicates, and run-of-the-mill supervillains. The Six Metal Men are composed of Platinum, The eldest and most passionate of her siblings, and often infatuated with her creator (much to his continued chagrin). Most independent of the Metal Men, she’s the only one to meaningfully change her name away from her composite metal (for a certain value of change). Gold is often considered their leader. Intelligent and charismatic, his time is most spent resolving conflicts within the Metal Men themselves, though his analytical mind has brought them strategic success in the past. This has not stopped him from growing quite a sense of ego (constantly challenged by his siblings), as one would expect of someone made of pure gold. Mercury is… hot headed at the best of times. Sour, confrontational, and easily prone to resentment, he has a tendency to start arguments within the team and without. Often these will involve Platinum due to their passionate natures. While the Metal Men technically share their powers, Mercury has demonstrated a preference for more elastic and non-human shapes in casual settings compared to his siblings. Iron is the stable emotional core to the group. He actively avoids involvement in the arguments of the day in favour of making himself a strong foundation on which to rely. While this is important, he is also rather unexciting as far as personalities go compared with his siblings. Tin is a kind but timid personality, tending towards regular massive drops in self-esteem. Usually on the outside of any group conflicts, Tin is also the one that tends to operate best weith the public, being genuinely enchanted by the human experience. Finally, Lead is a workhorse first and foremost. While relatively relaxed (and quite a bit less intelligent than his siblings, he’s often the first to act when something needs to be done. He and Iron often form a duo, forming into independent halves of constructs to increase their speed (as the two are relatively slow otherwise). Powers Each of the six Metal Men are polymorphs of a kind. Able to morph their bodies into any shape they can imagine. Unfortunately these objects will still be made of the pure metal that makes up their form, making them largely incapable of concealing who they are or mimicking any properties involved unless it would also be made of their metal. Additionally, each of them is powered by a device called a Responsometer, acting as their brain and animating force. Though it is protected from EMPs, if it were damaged or destroyed it would need to be repaired before any of them could return to action.
objects.title: The Metal Men (DC Comics)

objects.text: Aliases: The Lash Gender: The Lash Background Jacob Lash is an Asshole. Powers Jacob Lash is a wrestling heel and brawler specialising in using ropes and high flies to do massive damage, to such an extent he can lay the pain on people made of metal. He however has no supernatural abilities.
objects.title: Jacob Lash (Deadlock)

objects.text: Aliases: Death’s Advocate, The Reaper’s Handmaiden Age: 17-18 Gender: Female Background The daughter of high-power defense attorneys, Darcy Graves grew up in a home where every conversation was a debate, argument, or negotiation. It was exhausting. But while her parents were often too busy meeting with clients or working on cases to bond with her, the dead were always there to listen. Slowly though, she made contact with a Lich who was so interested in having a student it could pass its knowledge on to. Now, while balancing attendance of Blackmore Academy, she acts as a fledgeling necromancer, putting the dead to rest. Powers Darcy is a novice necromancer, capable of summoning the dead to fight for her, both as zombies and severed parts. Additionally, she’s assisted by the severed hand of a Lich she considers her mentors, capable of sucking the life force from her enemies.
objects.title: Darcy Graves (Deadlock)

objects.text: Age: 18 Gender: Male Background The son of Ixia’s General-King, Apollo was sent to study at Blackmore Academy in New York largely for his own safety. However, since starting Blackmore, he’s made an effort to stand above the well of mediocrity that is his peers. Instead, he’s put all of his energy into his schoolwork, his extracurricular fencing, and rigorous training. Ixia is a blood stained land, and when he’s called to succeed his father as warlord, he intends to show he’s worthy to pick up his blade. The fact he will be fighting American troops as they attempt to annex ‘Northern’ Ixia like they did the south is neither here nor there. Powers Apollo is an incredibly gifted fencer and trains rigorously. In addition, he’s a moderately good magician, capable of blending Ixian magic and sigils with his bladework.
objects.title: Apollo (Deadlock)

objects.text: Aliases: The GOAT, That Fucker, Gender: Male Background Billy is a white hot ball of rage, furious at the very notion of...something. Maybe it’s the cops. Maybe it’s magic regulations. Maybe it’s the service at the gyro place downtown. (Not the good one. The other one.) He’s an intensely angry person who lacks a target for this anger and so lashes out at everyone and everything, which only means when he actually tries to reach out to others they rebuff him because of his sandpaper-esc attitude. Don't ask him how he got the goat head. Powers Billy is a brawler, mostly with a nail-spiked bat and under the influence of alcohol. However he has some connection to Eldritch Power, and a seeming awareness of the fourth wall (complaining about 'aimbots' and specific item-builds) implying whatever gave him his physical might and seething anger also made him semi-aware of his metaphysical situation.
objects.title: Billy (Deadlock)

objects.text: Aliases: The Saviour of Spanish Harlem Age: 20s Gender: Female Background Ivy Arroyo is a gargoyle that came to life during a magical surge, and was quickly adopted by the Arroyo family after saving two of them from a mugger. Since then, Ivy has been delivering a kind of vigilante justice on the Mendoza Syndicate and has become an impromptu saviour of Spanish Harlem, successfully driving them out of the area while Carlos Arroyo runs for mayor of New York. Powers Ivy is a gargoyle, and naturally can fly and turn herself to stone again in order to drop violently on enemies. Additionally, she carries a submachine gun, should fists not work out.
objects.title: Ivy (Deadlock)

objects.text: Age: 70s Gender: Male Background Professor Dynamo always had an inquisitive mind. So when an Astral Gate oopened up in Central Park he was first on the scene to investigate. Unfortunately, his body was then obliterated utterly, reduced to a tiny dying star. Now housed inside a robotic body fifty years on, Dynamo acts as a tenured professor at Columbia College, and has been married for 30 years. While most of his condition remains a magical mystery, he has to maintain his class first and foremost. Powers Dynamo’s body has been replaced with a microscopic black hole, allowing him to release energy pulses, reposition small distances, or even opening a singularity pulling enemies in and rendering them useless while stuck in its gravity.
objects.title: Dynamo (Deadlock)

objects.text: Gender: female Background Haze is a Sandman, an operative for the Occult Security and Investigation Commission that is tasked with infiltrating the dreams of persons of interest, to assess their threat level, and if needed... to put them to sleep. Not much is known about her life before being a sandman, or her activities off duty. However, while she seems not to agree with everything the OSIC does, she is willing to work towards its ends. She also plays the Cello. Powers Haze is a dream infiltrator, capable of infiltrating dreams and affecting people through them. This seems to extend to the real world too as she is able to disappear from sight for a limited time. Additionally the OSIC has equipped her with potent sedatives, with which she coats various knives, two submachine guns and more than a few additional utilities to help complete her duties.
objects.title: Haze (Deadlock)

objects.text:
Title: The Knight
Alignment: Chaotic Evil
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: Unknown (appears early 40s)

Power: Tarhos Kovács, known as The Knight, is a brutal warlord empowered by the Entity. He wields a colossal zweihander and commands spectral warriors — the spirits of his betrayed companions. These summoned guards allow him to strike from multiple angles, trap opponents, or control the battlefield. His strength and durability are superhuman, forged through relentless violence and the Entity’s dark gift.

Appearance: Scarred
Civilian Identity: None
Quality of Life: Dreadful (sustains himself through violence and the Entity’s will)
objects.title: Tarhos Kovács (Dead by Daylight)

objects.text:
Hero Name: L
Alignment: Neutral Good
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: early 20s

Power: L’s greatest asset is his unparalleled deductive reasoning and investigative skills. He is a world-renowned detective, known for solving complex and seemingly unsolvable cases. L’s intelligence allows him to analyze intricate patterns, predict behaviors, and set traps for his adversaries. His brilliance is complemented by his ability to think several steps ahead, often employing unorthodox and risky methods to uncover the truth. L is also highly skilled in strategy and planning, making him a formidable opponent even against supernatural forces.

Appearance: Below Average
Civilian Identity: Reclusive Detective
Quality of Life: Moderate (Has significant wealth and resources at his disposal, lives a minimalistic lifestyle, focusing entirely on his work. His dedication to justice often isolates him socially and emotionally.)
objects.title: L Lawliet (Death Note)

objects.text:
Villain Name: Kira
Alignment: Lawful Evil
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: Late teens

Power: Light’s primary power comes from the Death Note, a supernatural notebook that allows him to kill anyone whose name he writes in it, as long as he knows their face. This ability grants him near-absolute control over life and death, enabling him to manipulate events and people to suit his goals. Light combines this with his extraordinary intelligence, strategic thinking, and manipulative skills to orchestrate elaborate schemes.

Appearance: Above Average
Civilian Identity: High School Student
Quality of Life: Good
objects.title: Light Yagami (Death Note)

objects.text:
Hero Name: None
Alignment: Lawful Good
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: 16

Power: Tanjiro uses two breathing styles, Water Breathing, and Hinokami Kagura which he uses to great effect 

Appearance: Above Average 
Civilian Identity: Slayer
Quality of Life: Neutral
objects.title: Tanjiro Kamado (Demon Slayer)

objects.text:
Hero Name: Insect Hashira
Alignment: Neutral Good
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: 18

Power: Insect Breathing, she made this style because she is weak.

She makes up for this with her keen intellect and indomitable will. These both have allowed her to have a poisonous wisteria physique and be a medical expert. She was a part of the team that made the anti-Kibutsuji drug.

Her equipment is a stinger Nichirin katana.

Appearance: Beautiful
Quality of Life: Ups and Downs (She lost her sister and wants revenge from Doma.)
objects.title: Shinobu Kochō (Demon Slayer)

objects.text:
Hero Name: Love Hashira
Alignment: Neutral Good
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: 19

Power: Love Breathing. She made it from learning Flame Breathing from Rengoku and then adapting it.

She has a Nichirin whip katana as equipment.

She also has an abnormal muscular structure granting superhuman flexibility, speed, reflexes, strength, stamina, and endurance. This is because her muscles are 8 times denser than a normal human's. Her regular diet is worth 3 sumo wrestler portioned meals.

Also unlocked her Demon Slayer mark.

Appearance: Beautiful
Quality of Life: Ups and downs (Wants to find her true love and get married; Hunts demons and has lost friends.)
objects.title: Mitsuri Kanroji (Demon Slayer)

objects.text:
Hero Name: None
Alignment: Lawful Good
Gender: Male
Sex: Male 
Age: 20

Power: Flame Breathing, a Breathing Style taught to Kyojuro by the previous Flame Hashira, Shinjuro Rengoku, and later mastered by reading the instruction books left behind by previous Flame Hashira in the Rengoku Family. As the Flame Hashira, Kyojuro is his generation's most skilled Flame Breathing user. He became evidently proficient in fighting with this Breathing Style, being able to singlehandedly defeat former Lower Rank Two, Hairo, and later hold his own against Upper-Rank Three, Akaza.

Appearance: Above Average 
Civilian Identity: None
Quality of Life: Neutral
objects.title: Kyojuro Rengoku (Demon Slayer)

objects.text: Alias: God of Flash Age: 24 Gender: Male Background Born into a family clan of Shinobi, Tengen went through relentless training from a young age, to the point that almost everyone around him, except his younger brother, died before reaching ten years old. Later on, he would leave the clan alongside his three wives for freedom and a better life, which led to him joining the Demon Slayer Corps. Power Tengen is a master Shinobi and is the Sound Hashira, which he utilizes to great effect. Combining his mastery of stealth, infiltration, espionage, and shinobi weaponry alongside Sound Breathing for a variety of abilities. He can also manually manipulate the muscles in his body, has resistance to poisons, and an enhanced sense of hearing. As the Sound Hashira, he wields a pair of nunchunk-like cleavers as his Nichirin Weapon, which he combines with Sound Breathing to create a variety of fast paced mid and long range attacks. His expertise allows him to use a form of Echolocation to gain greater spatial awareness and read his opponent's like an open book. Note You can choose to receive Tengen by himself, or alongside his three wives; Makio, Suma, and Hinatsuru. Who are all highly skilled kunoichi.
objects.title: Tengen Uzui (Demon Slayer)

objects.text:
Hero Name: "King of the Mountain", "Inoko" (undercover as a courtesan).
Alignment: Chaotic Neutral 
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: 15

Power: Self Made Beast Breathing Style, Total Concentration Breathing, Enchanced Sense of Touch: Incredible spatial awareness and is able to know when someone is looking at him and the direction they are looking, Incredible Flexibility, High Poison Resistance, Capable of moving his organs to some extent.

Apperance: Beautiful - Head, Handsome - Body
Civillian Identity: Slayer
Quality of Life: It has up's and down's
objects.title: Hashibira Inosuke (Demon Slayer)

objects.text:
Occupation: Flower Hashira 
Alignment: Chaotic Good
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age:21

Power: She is a master swordswoman and the strongest user of the flower breathing. She is powerful enough to stalemate the second-strongest upper moon until sunrise on her own.

Appearance: Beautiful
Quality of Life: Has its ups and downs.
objects.title: Kanae Kocho (Demon Slayer)

objects.text: Gender: Male Age: 20+ Background Born in the Sengoku era, Yoriichi was gifted with unnatural and unrivaled skill in swordship, to the point of being considered blessed by the heavens. By the time he was an adult, he was revered as the greatest swordsman in history, with an equal amount of jealously from his twin brother. After failing at what he believed was his purpose to end Muzan Kibutsuji, he would dedicate the rest of his days to hunting him down again, only to instead die of old age after finding his brother as a demon. Power The creator and unrivaled user of Sun Breathing, alongside the powers of a Demon Slayer Mark, the Selfless State, and the Transparent World. He wields all of this power as naturally as breathing, allowing him to utilize his abilities with divine-like grace and perfection. Note: As in the Golden Age of Demon Slayers, he is willing to teach Breathing Styles to others, including you. Even if you didn't take Total Concentration Breathing (Demon Slayer), you'd still be forged into a formidable Hashira under his guidance
objects.title: Yoriichi Tsugikuni (Demon Slayer)

objects.text:
Villain Name: The Witch Queen
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: Billions of years

Power: Lightbearer, Throne World, Mastery of Hive Magic

Appearance: Horrifying
Civilian Identity: None
Quality of Life: Very Good
objects.title: Savathun (Destiny)

objects.text:
Name: Rasputin
Alias: AI-COM/RSPN, The Tyrant, The Last Warmind
Alignment: Lawful Neutral
Gender: Male
Sex: None
Age: Over 400 years

Power: Rasputin is the most powerful Warmind ever created by humanity during the Golden Age. An AI of such scope and complexity that Rasputin was entrusted with the defense of Earth, its colonies, and its people against any threat, terrestrial or otherwise. His capabilities span simultaneous global military coordination, orbital defense management, solar system wide autonomous weapon system deployment, and strategic interstellar naval warfare. 

Rasputin is not merely an AI but an electronic war god, with authority and knowledge over the most devastating technologies humanity ever produced during the Golden Age. His databanks include golden age forbidden technologies, knowledge of the Darkness, and weapons that even the Guardians of the Last City can barely comprehend. His Foresight is so great that with no data to support it, he was able to sense an Paracausal threat and evacuate a large portion of the Solar System in time to prepare for it. 

Appearance: N/A - Rasputin is a near eldritch artificial intelligence stored inside a extradimensional data chip
Civilian Identity: None
Quality of Life: Terrible (In Constant state of war and vigilance against threats both native and foreign to the solar system)
objects.title: Rasputin (Destiny)

objects.text:
Name: Elisabeth "Elsie" Bray
Alias: Exo Stranger Alignment: True Good Gender: Female Sex: Female Age: Centuries (chronologically); appears early 30s

Power: Elsie Bray is an Exo whose uploaded human consciousness grants her superhuman strength, speed, and resilience—and, uniquely, temporal foresight, allowing her to tap alternate timelines for strategic insight. She wields Stasis without the Light, focusing crystalline freezing and shattering effects through sheer willpower and study. As a Clovis Bray heir, she commands lost Braytech secrets and advanced temporal technology, operating solo to minimize her impact on the timestream.

Appearance: Attractive for a Robot, Deformed for a Human
Civilian Identity: Brilliant Scientist, Researcher, and Time Traveler
Quality of Life: Terrible (Constantly watching timelines being consumed by the darkness)
objects.title: Elisabeth Bray (Destiny)

objects.text:
Name: Unknown 
Aliases: Young Wolf, Slayer of Oryx, Bane of Ghaul, Savior of the City
Alignment: Chaotic Good
Gender: Unknown
Sex: Unknown
Age: Unknown (resurrected sometime after the Collapse)

Power: The Young Wolf is a legendary Guardian resurrected by the Traveler’s Light, now wielding its full might to command Arc, Solar, and Void energies with surgical precision. They have mastered all subclass abilities including shattering foes with flaming hammer strikes, electrifying swarms of enemies, or collapsing reality in void explosions. Their control over battlefield physics allows them to bend time and space, turning the tide of conflict through feats unattainable by ordinary combatants. 

Having transcended pure Light, the Young Wolf also wields Darkness subclasses like Stasis, freezing enemies in crystalline bondage, and Strand, weaving metaphysical threads to manipulate fate and consciousness. Uncorrupted by either side, they have single-handedly defeated gods, ascended beings, and the worst agents of the Darkness. Backed by a loyal Ghost they can resurrect indefinitely to press any advantage. The Young Wolf is a myth incarnate, using their willpower and tactical genius place them at the fulcrum of cosmic events.

Appearance: Unknown
Civilian Identity: Guardian of the Last City
Quality of Life: Terrible (Constantly fighting to prevent the end of mankind)
objects.title: The Young Wolf (Destiny)

objects.text:
Name: The Traveler
Alias: The Great Machine, The Gardener, Moon X
Alignment: True Good
Gender: None
Sex: None
Age: Unknown (billions of years old)

Power: The Traveler is an ancient paracausal entity whose mere presence warps reality—terraforming planets, uplifting species, and seeding golden ages across the cosmos. It emanates the Light, a generative force granted to its champions (Guardians) through Ghosts, which bestows resurrection, mastery over elemental Arc, Solar, and Void energies, and the ability to reshape matter and energy by will alone. Guardians can cleanse corruption, repel the Darkness, and catalyze metaphysical evolution—abilities that scale from individual skirmishes to planetary defense. 
Though the Traveler seldom intervenes directly, its power manifests on a global scale: healing devastated cities, annihilating armadas, and empowering entire civilizations to stand against cosmic threats. Yet it is not omnipotent—its decisions can appear inscrutable or indifferent, and it has retreated from battles it could not—or chose not to—win. Its influence lies as much in potential as in action: wherever it goes, the laws of nature bend, allowing miracles and fostering immortality among those it deems worthy.

Appearance: N/A - The Traveler is an enormous eldritch being that appears as a spherical white orb to normal lifeforms
Civilian Identity: None
Quality of Life: Terrible (On the losing side of a billion year old war for the fate of the universe)
objects.title: The Traveler (Destiny)

objects.text:
Name: Nero
Alignment: Chaotic Good
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: 20+

Power: Nero, thanks to his demonic heritage, possesses immense power, combat skill, and resilience, allowing him to defeat powerful demons and contend with Dante. He can endure significant damage, move at incredible speeds, heal rapidly with his Devil Trigger, and even regrow his arm. Nero wields the Red Queen sword and Blue Rose gun, excelling in both melee and ranged combat. After losing his Devil Bringer arm, he uses Devil Breakers, versatile prosthetics granting unique abilities. His Devil Trigger unlocks his true demon form, enhancing his strength, granting spectral arms that double as wings, and enabling him to summon a spectral Yamato blade made of demonic energy.

Appearance: Handsome
Civilian Identity: Devil Hunter
Quality of Life: It Has its Ups and Downs
objects.title: Nero (Devil May Cry)

objects.text: Age: 24 Gender: Female Background Regina is a weapons specialist for the US Army espionage and intelligence group, Secret Operation Raid Team (S.O.R.T.). She would go on to prove instrumental in the success of the investigation of the 3rd Energy research facility and the closing of its time-warp, be the lone survivor of the rescue and investigation of Edward City’s 3rd Energy anomaly, managing to retrieve research data on 3rd Energy that would go on to reshape the history of multiple timelines. Powers Regina has no powers, but is highly skilled and trained in her work and carries a wide arsenal of weapons. She is proficient in and able to modify all manner of firearms and explosives, able to pilot various military vehicles, decently skilled at investigation and detective work, especially good at taking down dinosaurs, and quick to adapt to strange situations like how to fight in a bulky diving suit against marine reptiles.
objects.title: Regina (Dino Crisis)

objects.text: Aliases: Miss Pleinair, Mascot Girl Age: Unknown Gender: Female Background Pleinair is a quiet demon who usually finds work running either the various Netherworld's Dark Assembly's or as a TV news anchor, all while gather a surprisingly large fan club. You will usually find her rabbit doll Usagi by her side, serving as her mouthpiece or weapon. Don't worry if you notice any chunks missing from Usagi, Pleinair will summon a new one soon enough Powers Pleinair is proficient with guns, elemental magic, and summoning more Usagi dolls. The Usagi dolls themselves are capable of independent movement, exploding, and sticking together to create a sturdy bludgeon. Besides that, Pleinair also has the increased durability expected of a demon and is capable of flight.
objects.title: Pleinair (Disgaea)

objects.text:
"A fairy's work is much more than at first it might appear. Suppose your broken clock ticks, though it hasn't in a year. Perchance you'd find a toy you lost or jingling bells you hear. It all means that one very special fairy might be near."

Name: Tinker Bell
Alias: Tink, Miss Bell, Little-Miss-Spare-Parts
Alignment: Chaotic Good
Species: Never Fairy
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: Appears to be in her early teens (fairy age equivalent)

Powers: Tinker Bell is an exceptionally talented fairy, specializing in building, repairing, and inventing using natural materials. Her magical talent allows her to fix anything in Pixie Hollow with ease and craft useful pots-and-pans, creative machines, and utensils for nature-talent fairies and sparrowmen. She uses Pixie Dust to fly and occasionally allows others to fly as well.

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: Tinker Fairy of Pixie Hollow
Quality of Life: Good
objects.title: Tinker Bell (Disney)

objects.text:
Name: Rapunzel
Alias: Sundrop
Alignment: Good
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: 18

Powers: Rapunzel is the living embodiment of the Sundrop Flower, granting her the ability to heal even fatal injuries with her magical song. This power can even extend a person’s lifespan. 

Furthermore, she is highly skilled in using her extraordinarily long hair in versatile and creative ways. During her many years of isolation, she developed a wide range of talents and  indoor practical skills. In addition to her resourcefulness, she is also a clever and capable strategist.

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: Princess of Corona (Unbeknownst to her)
Quality of Life: Bad (Kidnapped as an infant, has never left her tower in 18 years)
objects.title: Rapunzel (Disney)

objects.text: Alies: Mecha Man Gender: Male Age: 33 Background Robert's grandfather was the original Mecha Man (Mecha Man Prime) and the person who made the original mech suit. Then, after him, it was Robert's father, more widely known as 'Astral'. However, after his father's death, Robert Robertson III inherited the suit and became the new Mecha Man, a superhero despite his lack of real superpowers. He spent his entire inheritance (notably into the millions) towards keeping the Mech suit functional. Powers Robert doesn’t possess innate superpowers and is an above-average human. Robert possesses a self-designed powered suit (the Mecha Man suit) that grants super-strength, enhanced durability, speed, and flight via jetpacks, disc-projectiles, a plasma “Pulse Blade”, and force-field/ shield capabilities. Aside from the suit, he’s a skilled engineer (able to repair his own suit), a capable hand-to-hand combatant, a master hacker, and a tactician. He can pilot the Mecha Man suit flawlessly and use all of its features to their full potential. Note: You may decide if he has Mecha Man suit or not, also you can pick if he has the old or the newer version of the Mecha Man suit; An he will also come with the astral pulse to power the Mecha Man suit. an he can come with his dog, Beef.
objects.title: Robert Robertson (Dispatch)

addons.text:
Shroud, ever the meticulous inventor and strategist, has brought together the Red Ring Collective, a criminal organization unlike any other. Comprised of rogue engineers, cybernetic surgeons, data thieves, and enhanced mercenaries, the Collective operates under Shroud’s direct supervision. Each member has undergone some degree of augmentation, ranging from simple neural interfaces to full-body mechanization. Under Shroud’s guidance, the organization focuses on the development of cutting-edge weapons, advanced armor, and experimental tech capable of reshaping the battlefield.

Scale and Strength of the Red Ring Collective

Small Organization: 5–10 civilians, 5 specialists or augmented agents.

Medium Organization: 40–50 civilians, 10–20 specialists/augmented agents.

A Big Organization: 100–150 civilians, 30–50 specialists/augmented agents.

Supervillain Base: 150 workers with 10 CP each, 50 specialists with 30 CP each

The You Foundation: Full global reach, thousands of operatives, hundreds of augmented agents, and all secret workshops accessible, giving near-limitless production capabilities.

Whatever your resources, the Red Ring Collective scales alongside your ambitions. From small clandestine operations to full-scale global domination, Shroud’s organization is ready to meet any challenge with ingenuity, precision, and an intimidating array of technological power.

Note 1: If you have anything above Medium Organization, then the Red Ring Collective can optionally come with Villains such as Toxic, Armstrong, Blob Goon, Khopesh, White Lightning, Lóng, Spiderlegs, Gravity Bitch, and Lightningstruck from the game dispatch. Also, you may optionally choose to have either Coupé or Sonar as well. Though you can only choose one of them.

Note 2. If you have Medium Organization, then Shroud can optionally have access to the giant mech suit he showed off in episode 8.
addons.title: Red Ring Collective

objects.text: Alias: Shroud Gender: Male Age: Unknown (Definitely an Adult) Background Shroud was a superhero and former Brave Brigade member who worked alongside the second Mecha Man, Astral. Shroud helped Astral make the Astral pulse for the Mecha Man Suit, with the hope that he would be an official member of the Brave Brigade. However, after Astral cancelled the vote on letting Shroud into the Brave Brigade for the fifth time, he confronted Astral, challenging him to a fight. After losing the fight with Astral (who fought back without the Mecha Man suit), he stole Astral's gun from his locker and shot him in the chest, killing Astral. Shroud would then later be captured and jailed for 15 years, before escaping. Powers Shroud is an exceptionally intelligent inventor and engineer. He can create advanced mechanical implants capable of augmenting human abilities, and he designed the Astral Pulse, the energy source that powered the Mecha Man armor.
objects.title: Shroud (Dispatch)

objects.text:
Hero Name: Invisigal

Gender: Female
Age: 27
Appearance: Attractive

Power: While holding her breath, Invisigal can turn herself and her clothes invisible.

Civilian Identity: Hero in the Phoenix Program.

Note: Suffers from asthma, which limits the use of her powers.
objects.title: Courtney (Dispatch)

objects.text: Alias: Blonde Blazer Age: N/A Gender: Female Background Mandy, also known as Blonde Blazer, was an active superhero who earned a reputation for herself while being dispatched on the streets. Later, she decided to broaden her career by moving into a management role and was assigned to take over SDN Torrance. Under her leadership, the struggling branch became a model for the company, particularly through its efforts to rehabilitate former supervillains and retrain them as heroes via the Phoenix Program. Powers Blonde Blazer's powers originate from an apparently magical necklace adorned with a large red gem. While wearing it, her appearance transforms, making her taller, more muscular, and blonde. In this form, she possesses superhuman strength capable of breaking through concrete, durability that renders her invulnerable to gunfire and capable of withstanding Phenomaman's supersonic flight, the ability to project yellow energy beams from her hands, as well as the ability to fly.
objects.title: Mandy (Dispatch)

objects.text: Age: Somewhere around thousands of years, likely much older Gender: Varies Background Originally from the planet Gallifrey, the Doctor is a Time Lord who became the greatest of them all. As the War Doctor, he brought an end to the Time War and saved the universe. The Doctor has traveled to countless places across space and time, met innumerable people, lived many lives through various incarnations, and saved reality countless times from all kinds of foes, from monsters to gods. Powers The Doctor, as a Time Lord, can perceive all of time, including past, present, future, and events that must not happen, with an instinct to avoid destined events. The Doctor can evade death through regeneration, transforming physically and psychologically, with each incarnation living up to 10,000 years. However, the Doctor's greatest strength lies in their vast intelligence, mastery of countless technologies, especially Gallifreyan, and fluency in billions of languages, making them one of the most intelligent beings in the universe.
objects.title: The Doctor (Doctor Who)

objects.text:
Name: Noximilien Coxen
Alias: Nox
Alignment: True Neutral
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: Over 200

Power: Nox is a powerful Xelor, a time-manipulating race whose abilities stem from Wakfu, a form of life force energy. In combination with his possession of the Eliacube, a powerful Eliatrope artifact, he massively boosted the power of his racially granted time manipulation: accelerating, slowing, freezing, and even rewinding short periods of it if given massive amounts of energy.

He can teleport with near-limitless range, create devastating time-based explosions, and summon constructs of pure temporal energy. When using the Eliacube, Nox also possesses incredible durability, regenerative capacity, and endurance, sustained by the life force energy he obsessively hoards. He is an unstoppable force in single combat and a genius inventor and tactician. His only weakness is his limited reserves of Wakfu, driving him to constantly acquire more, often by draining the life out of everything in his path.

Appearance: Average
Civilian Identity: Former clockmaker and family man
Quality of Life: Terrible (Lost his family and consumed by the need to bring them back by any means necessary)
objects.title: Nox (Dofus)

addons.text:
What a pleasant surprise, it seems Monika didn't come alone as along with her are Sayori, Yuri and Natsuki with all of them being just as aware of Monika herself. Along with getting her friends back, with or without angst, the other girls bring their own skills and can multi-task by working together.

Should you upload Monika and the others to have them replace an AI they all gain the same copy of the skills of the AI and able to use them without needing additional resources, effectively having four for the price of one.​
addons.title: Literature Club Reunion

objects.text:
Alias: monika.chr, President of the Literature Club, Monitor Kernel Access
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: 18

Power: Is an AI, can manipulate data to a degree, is bad at coding

Civilian Identity: President of the Literature Club
Quality of Life: Bad (All her friends are simulations, her reality was a simulation, lives in a void of her creation)
Note: Monika will appear within a pendrive, however if you have an item/OoP that can host her then you can choose to have her appear there. Similiarly, if you have an item/OoP that has an AI you can have Monika take their place. Should you do the latter, Monika will gain all the skills that the original AI had.
objects.title: Monika (Doki Doki Literature Club)

objects.text: Aliases: Doomslayer, Doomguy, Hellwalker, Unchained Predator, Scourge of Hell Age: N/A Gender: Male Background A former Space Marine stationed at the UAC Mars base, the Doom Slayer witnessed an experiment malfunction that opened a portal to Hell, allowing demons to invade the facility. He single-handedly fought back the demonic hordes across Phobos, Deimos, and Hell itself, only to return home and find Earth overrun, with both his family and his pet rabbit, Daisy, killed by demons. After this, the Doom Slayer dedicated his entire existence to becoming the scourge of all demons. Eventually, he encountered the people of Argent D’Nur, became a Night Sentinel, and was empowered by the Divinity Machine, turning him into a truly unstoppable force of nature. Powers Once a mortal capable of singlehandedly fending off the hordes of Hell, the Doomslayer was empowered by the Divinity Machine and transformed into a transcendental being akin to a god. His power matches his unfathomable willpower and rage, making him unstoppable. The Doomslayer possesses immense strength, durability, speed, and agility. He can lift and throw massive objects, overpower the strongest demons, and even kill a titan with his bare hands. His durability allows him to remain unscathed by ranged weaponry, falls from great heights, the strongest demonic attacks, and even exposure to Argent Energy—an energy source that generates temperatures beyond theoretical limits. The Doomslayer is immortal: he does not age, require sustenance such as food or water, or need rest. He possesses unlimited stamina, enabling him to fight in Hell for eons without pause. Even death cannot stop him, as he simply returns to life to continue his war against the demonic hordes. The Slayer is a highly trained and experienced combatant, skilled in both armed and unarmed combat. He received training as a Space Marine and a Night Sentinel, and his time among technologically advanced civilizations has granted him exceptional intellect and technical knowledge. This allows him to wield alien technology with ease and create powerful weaponry. The Doomslayer also grows stronger with every demon he slays, absorbing their souls to increase his power and tenacity. He wears the Praetor Suit, which is so durable that even the strongest demons and the fires of Hell cannot damage it. The suit also supports survival in extreme environments, including underwater and the vacuum of space. Additionally, it can absorb and metabolize Argent Energy, enabling the Slayer to recover health, armor, and ammunition by killing demons. He wields a wide array of powerful weapons, including a shotgun, rocket launcher, minigun, plasma gun, Gauss cannon, chainsaw, the Unmaker, the BFG 9000, and the Crucible.
objects.title: Doomslayer (DOOM)

objects.text:
Hero Name: None
Alignment: Chaotic Good
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: early to mid 40s

Power: Goku can manipulate his Ki, the fighting power and life force of a martial artist, a tangible energy derived from the user's vigor, courage, and mind. It can be used in several ways, such as to surpass the limits of one's body to greatly increase in strength, and it can be fired as blasts of energy or used to create defensive barriers. Along with his Saiyan blood, Ki acts as the source of Goku's incredible power and abilities. Goku's prodigal skill in combat and the use of ki allows him to replicate the ki techniques of others after seeing them only once. After becoming a Super Saiyan God, Goku gained divine ki, which can only be sensed by other gods.

Appearance: Average 
Civilian Identity: Farmer
Quality of Life: Good
objects.title: Son Goku (Dragon Ball)

objects.text:
Hero Name: None
Alignment: Chaotic Neutral
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: Early 40s

Power: As a Saiyan prince, Vegeta possesses immense physical strength, speed, and durability, alongside the ability to manipulate Ki for combat purposes. His combat skills are honed through years of intense training and battle experience. He is capable of achieving powerful transformations, such as Super Saiyan forms, Super Saiyan Blue, and Ultra Ego, which drastically increase his power levels.

Appearance: Handsome
Civilian Identity: Prince of the Saiyan Race
Quality of Life: Good
objects.title: Vegeta (Dragon Ball)

addons.text:
Bulma and Chi-Chi have, if you so desire, permanently fused into a singular being: Bulchi.
Bulchi inherits Bulma's coloring, figure and intelligence, along with Chi-Chi's hairstyle, temper and abilities as a Martial Artist. The combination of this talent and brainpower has become greater than the sum of its parts, and Bulchi has significantly more potential as a Ki user than both women combined (or even multiplied).
Optionally, Bulchi has always been Bulchi, and has no specific memories of either woman who combined to originate her- hailing from the Briefs of Fire Mountain and taking the place of both Bulma AND Chi-Chi in the original Dragon Ball, somehow. Should this be the case, Bulchi is not in love with Goku OR Yamcha OR Vegeta- though that could certainly change if she's in their company in the future.
addons.title: Bulchi

objects.text:
Hero Name: None
Alignment: True Good
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: Late teens to early 20s

Power: Martial Artist from the early days of Dragon Ball and Dragon Ball Z- in other words as good a martial artist as normal humans in most worlds can be, and peak human or slightly beyond physicality (could throw around entire dinosaurs as a child, is referred to as one of the strongest humans alive, competes in world tournaments, can press young Gohan in training in his base form, is stated in some sources to have a power level anywhere between 130-300).

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: Princess of Fire Mountain/ Martial Artist
Quality of Life: OK (from a loving family, literal princess of a tiny kingdom, that admittedly has a history of being set on fire, and in love with someone who is... Absent-minded, to be kind.)
objects.title: Chi-Chi (Dragon Ball)

objects.text:
Hero Name: None
Alignment: True Good
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: 20s

Power: None, but makes up for it by being a super genius. From being the creator of several items that impacted the world and assisted the Z-Fighters. Such as; the dragon radar, gravity chamber and time machine, to reverse engineering alien technology to make spaceships, battle armor, scouters, and much more.

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: CEO of Capsule Corp/Scientist
Quality of Life: Good
objects.title: Bulma Briefs (Dragon Ball)

objects.text: Age: Late 40s Gender: Male Background Son of the high-class Saiyan Paragus, after being discovered to possess an incredible but fluctuating base power level up to 10,000, jealously offended of the infant’s power to dare to exceed his son’s, King Vegeta decide to exile him leave him for dead to an hostile planet called Vampa, yet survived by fending off by himself and his father’s unforgiving training after Paragus went to look for his son. After some time, him and father were rescued by a contingent of the Frieza Force, Frieza particularly taking an interest on him. Being used as an instrument of vengeance by his Father and a no more than a weapon, lately he’s welcomed by the friends who rescued him, Cheelai and Lemo, as well as catching the eye of Goku. Powers Born as a Mutant of the Saiyan Race, his potential and growth rate are off-the-charts, offset by his power’s inherent instability and fluctuating power level tied to his emotions, namely rage, tapping into the savagery of the Great Ape while in base form. He’s prodigy in combat, both learning to adap against an opponent the long he fights, while his power level increases to meet the opposition, enough to face against the likes of Gogeta.
objects.title: Broly (Dragon Ball)

objects.text:
Alignment: Varies, depending on her mental state.
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: Less than 10 chronologically, but was created with an adult body and mind.

Power: She is a New Type Bio-Android, a hybrid of Earth-type humans, Frieza race, Saiyan, Namekian, and Majin.

With Majin Buu's and Cell's powers, she can absorb lifeforms and get stronger; she heals/regenerates like a Namekian, possesses the zenkai boost of Saiyans, can survive in the vacuum of space due to Frieza's DNA, and much more.

Last, but not least, she possesses an array of magical abilities inherited from Majin Buu, such as transmuting living beings into candy, for example.

Appearance: Beautiful 
Quality of Life: Has its ups and downs (Her hunger is so severe that she must constantly fight it to keep herself from turning everyone around her into treats. As a result of this, her psyche is damaged to the point where she developed a split personality, concerned only with consuming others. If you do not help her deal with this problem, sooner or later she will undergo fission, with both personalities gaining a body of their own).
objects.title: Android 21 (Dragon Ball)

addons.text:
Caulifla and Kale have fused into a singular being: Kefla. 

This fused Saiyan woman inherits Caulifla's fighting spirit and prodigious nature, plus Kale's monstrous power as the Legendary Super Saiyan, which was capable of giving Ultra Instinct Sign Goku a run for his money. This brings out the best of both while removing their individual weaknesses, meaning that she can access the power of Legendary Super Saiyan without losing herself, and despite still having Caulifla's cockiness and attitude, is not above humbling herself or being under a teacher. 

Optionally, Kefla has always been Kefla, with no memories of being the sum of her parts. If she were to meet Cabba or Goku, she would experience the same friendship and mentorship from them respectively. You can easily fill those roles if capable of them.

Alternatively, you can have a hypothetical result of if they did the Fusion Dance instead.
addons.title: Kefla

objects.text: Gender: Female Age: 20+ Background Caulifla is a Saiyan from Planet Sadala of Universe 6. She is a tomboy who loves the thrill of combat, and can be quite arrogant and aggressive, but also not above being humbled or showing compassion. After meeting Cabba, she joins the Tournament of Power to test her fighting prowess. Power Caulifa is a full blooded Saiyan and thus has great talent in combat, Ki manipulation, and can adapt mid fight. She is also a prodigy among her kind, having achieved the Super Saiyan 2 form after the Tournament of Power.
objects.title: Caulifla (Dragon Ball)

objects.text: Alias: Legendary Super Saiyan Gender: Female Age: 20+ Background Kale is a Saiyan from Planet Sadala of Universe 6, unlike what's expected of one though, she is quite timid and soft spoken. After meeting Cauilfa and Cabba, she gained more confidence and was able to control her power as the Legendary Super Saiyan. Power Kale is a full blooded Saiyan with a similar mutation to Broly, thus possessing the same ability in both combat and Ki manipulation, as well as monstrous power that can make her go on a rampage. After the Tournament of Power, she learned to control this form and achieved Super Saiyan 2 on top of that.
objects.title: Kale (Dragon Ball)

objects.text: Gender: Male Age: 20+ Background Cabba is a Saiyan from Planet Sadala of Universe 6, and a member of the Sadala Defense Force. Unlike of what's expected of a Saiyan, he has an honorable and polite personality, and mainly fights in the name of justice. Power Cabba is a full blooded Saiyan, thus possessing great talent in combat and Ki manipulation. After meeting Vegeta, he achieved Super Saiyan, and after the Tournament of Power, achieved Super Saiyan 2.
objects.title: Cabba (Dragon Ball)

objects.text:
Alignment: True Neutral 
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: 1000+ 

Power: An assassin from Universe 6, with over a millennia of experience in his profession, Ki manipulation, and alongside his signature technique: Time Skip. To skip time for a tenth of a second, then using his immense speed to land multiple blows on an opponent at once, and many variations on for it. 

As well as Pure Progress to rapidly increase his fighting ability, attributes like strength and speed, and even adapt to his opponents. 

Appearance: Average
Civilian Identity: Assassin
Quality of Life: Good
objects.title: Hit (Dragon Ball)

objects.text: Alias: Lapis (OG Name), 17 Gender: Male Age: Unknown, likely early-thirties Background Born alongside his older twin, Lazuli, the boy named Lapis was kidnapped by a man named Doctor Gero during their delinquent phase, and turned into Android 17, alongside his sister Android 18. After being reawakened from an incident involving the doctor's enemies, 17 joined his sister and their new friend, Android 16, on a trip around the world as they sought to kill Son Goku. After a series of events involving his DEATH, they ceased this goal, as 17 continued to spend the next decade and some change being a ranger at a park, married and having kids. Powers Android 17 is a VERY powerful individual, one of the top fighters in Universe 7. He has an infinite energy generator implanted inside him, allowing him to be unable to run out of Ki or Stamina in a fight. He can make barriers with impressive durability out of his Ki, fly, reinforce his body, and more. He can also, as a last resort, remotely detonate the powerful bomb inside him, which will leave him VERY open to attacks and wounded.
objects.title: Android 17 (Dragon Ball)

objects.text: Alias: Lazuli (OG Name) 18 Gender: Female Age: Unknown, likely early-thirties Background Born alongside her younger twin, Lapis, the girl named Lazuli was kidnapped by a man named Doctor Gero during their delinquent phase, and turned into Android 18, alongside her brother Android 17. Being reawakened after an incident involving the doctor's enemies, 18 joined her brother and their new friend, Android 16, on a trip across the world as they looked to kill Son Goku. After a series of events involving his death, they ceased this goal, as with 18 deciding to get married to a man named Krillin, having a little girl named Marron, while always training at least a little. Powers Android 18 is a VERY powerful individual, one of the top fighters in Universe 7. She has an infinite energy generator implanted inside her, allowing her to be unable to run out of Ki or Stamina in a fight. She can use her husbands techniques with her Ki, fly, reinforce her body, and more. She also has quite an adaptability to situations.
objects.title: Android 18 (Dragon Ball)

objects.text:
Title: Kami, Earth's Guardian

Alignment: Neutral Good

Gender: Asexual

Sex: Asexual

Age: Young

Power: As a Dragon Clan Namekian, Dende possesses exceptional magical prowess, including the ability to create his own Dragon Balls. After Guru unlocked his hidden potential, he gained powerful healing abilities.

Appearance: Average

Quality of Life: Good
objects.title: Dende (Dragon Ball)

objects.text: Gender: Male Age: 30s Background Piccolo is the reincarnation of Demon King Piccolo, a villain who once terrorized the Earth until defeated by Son Goku. As his reincarnation, his ultimate goal was to finish what his father began, but after needing to team up with Goku to defeat an enemy and training his son, Gohan, he began to convert to good. Power Piccolo is a Warrior Clan Namekian, and is capable of all the feats of one. Such as stretching his limbs, becoming a giant, enhanced hearing, regeneration, etc. He is a master at unarmed combat, and can use his Ki for a variety of techniques like flight, energy blasts, enhancing his physical abilities, and sealing. As well as Namekian Magic like Magic Materialization. After obtaining his Orange Form through Shenron, his power has risen exponentially.
objects.title: Piccolo (Dragon Ball)

objects.text: Aliases: The Great Saiyaman Age: Late 20s Gender: Male Background Born from a human mother and a Saiyan father, Gohan has been fighting against enemies since a young age. Although he is a great warrior, much of his potential is unreached due to his kind nature that led him to avoid conflict and fighting, choosing instead to focus on his studies - and later, his family. Powers Gohan uses Ki to fight, boosting his physical stats to near divine levels and allowing him to fly, blast energy attacks, and much more. Gohan's strongest move however is both his Super Saiyan state - which multiplies his already incredible strength; and his Ultimate form, which allows him to use his potential to the max. The latter can be further enhanced in his Beast form, elevating him to an even greater strength, though it needs a powerful emotion to do so. Gohan is a skillful martial artist, which he uses with his powers, and is a scholar, with a degree in biology.
objects.title: Son Gohan (Dragon Ball)

objects.text: Gender: Male Age: 20+ Background A Half Saiyan born as the son of Vegeta and Bulma, but lost his father to the threat of the Androids when he was only an infant. Growing up, he would dedicate himself alongside Gohan to train in order to one day defeat the Androids. He eventually does after many years of hardship, a time travel adventure to the past, and training with his father from the past. Now he lives in peace within his timeline as the sole defender of Earth. Power As a Half Saiyan, Trunks possesses an immense amount of potential and power, and the natural ability to manipulate his Ki for a wide range of abilities like energy projection, flight, and ascending his already incredible physical abilities. He can transform into a Super Saiyan to further elevate these abilities, with his highest level being Super Saiyan 2. He's also a master swordsman and can imbue Ki into his sword for a variety of attacks.
objects.title: Trunks (Dragon Ball)

objects.text:
Alignment: Good
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: 200+

Power: As a nimbat and guardian to the Blade of Ahrah, she possess various abilities fit to assist you in the trials ahead. Her most prominent ones being the manipulation of energy, fire and lightning as projectiles and a "sixth sense" for finding useful items from long distances. Mainly things such as keys, treasure chests or hints.

Her projectiles become much more effective and versatile in combination to the Blade of Ahrah.

Appearance: Adorable
Civilian Identity: None
Quality of Life: It has it ups and downs.
objects.title: Fidget (Dust: An Elysian Tail)

objects.text: Alignment: Chaotic Neutral Age: Unknown Gender: Male Sex: Male Power: An ambitious Tarnished, the Drake Warrior Igon harbors a will stronger than most of his kind, unwilling to give in even after being grievously wounded. Igon is equipped with a greatbow made of a dragon’s bones and imbued to enhance the power of the harpoons he launches using it. Not only this, but he also has partaken in Dragon Communion, able to use some of the powers of his sworn enemies. Appearance: Scarred Civilian Identity: N/A Quality of Life: CURRRRRSE YOUUUU, BAYYYLLLLLEE!!!
objects.title: Drake Warrior Igon (Elden Ring)

objects.text:
Alias: Godrick the Golden, Godrick the Grafted, Runt of the Demigods
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: ?
Power: Has grafted various tarnished onto his body. 
Civilian Identity: Ruler of Stormveil Castle
Quality of Life: Varied (A Tyrant Lord, hated by his people, known as the “Runt of the Demigods”)
objects.title: Godrick (Elden Ring)

objects.text:
Alias: Malenia, Blade of Miquella/Malenia the Severed
Alignment: Chaotic Neutral
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: Unknown (Said to be among the youngest of her family, who are described as ‘Ancient’)
Power: She is an excellent swordswoman, whose speed and dexterity were second to none among the demigods. She is host to the Scarlet Rot, a dangerous disease caused by the Outer God of Rot that eats away at her body and mind. She can utilize this to her advantage, at the cost of further giving into the disease. She can use this to steal away the vitality of others, and spread the Scarlet Rot to everything around her. Should she give into the rot entirely, she will ascend and become the Goddess of Rot.
Appearance: Beautiful, but Deformed due to the Scarlet Rot
Civilian Identity: Demigod, and child of Queen Marika the Eternal
Quality of Life: Bad/Terrible (Was born with the Scarlet Rot, endured many years of pain and loss, has lost her sight and some of her body to the Scarlet Rot, and the one person she trusted and could forestall it is nowhere to be found, showing no signs of returning.)
objects.title: Malenia (Elden Ring)

addons.text:
You have taken Radahn’s place, becoming Miquella’s Promised Consort, with Miquella assuming the mantle of your Divine Patron. No longer a mere follower, your role is sacred and central to his vision. Your body has been elevated beyond your natural limits, operating at its absolute peak at all times.

Miquella, through your connection, can summon radiant avatars of himself into the world. These manifestations wield Incantations with divine precision—blessing allies, healing the faithful, and obliterating opposition.

With his gift of Charm working in tandem with your influence, followers are drawn to the faith in droves. Miquella’s message of love, gentleness, and transformation spreads like wildfire. With each new convert, his divine strength swells, and his will begins to touch the edges of the world itself.

Together, you stand as the heralds of the “Age of Kindness.”
addons.title: Promised Consort

objects.text:
Alias: Miquella the Kind/Kindly Miquella
Alignment: Neutral Evil
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: Unknown (Said to be among the youngest of his family, who are described as ‘Ancient’)
Power: As a demigod, he is physically more powerful than the average person, but in comparison to the other Demigods, he is one of, if not the weakest. However, he makes up for this ‘weakness’ by having the ability to compel love in others towards himself, thus gaining their loyalty and affection. Because of this, he is unofficially titled the most powerful and/or terrifying of the Demigods.
Appearance: Androgynous
Civilian Identity: Demigod, and child of Queen Marika the Eternal
Quality of Life: ??? (Cursed to forever be a child. Currently seeks to ascend to Godhood and bring an ‘Age of Compassion’, even if it means discarding every part of himself to do so. Desires to have his half-brother Radahn as his chosen consort)
objects.title: Miquella (Elden Ring)

objects.text:
Alias: Messmer the Impaler, Base Serpent Messmer
Alignment: Lawful Evil
Gender: Male

Sex: Male

Age: Unknown (one of the older members of his family, who are all described as ancient)

Powers: Extremely skilled spearman, strategist and general. Wields a spear that returns to his hand when thrown, and can summon a field of spears from the ground. Controls Messmerfire, and can bestow this flame onto others. Hosts the Abyssal Serpent within his right eye socket

Appearance: Deformed (Has snakes growing out of his body, skin resembles snake skin at times)

Quality of life: Terrible (Forced into a genocidal campaign by Marika, abandoned to the Land of Shadow and removed from history, loathed by remaining population of the Land of Shadow, hates himself due to dual curses of Messmerfire and the Abyssal Serpent)
objects.title: Messmer (Elden Ring)

addons.text: Melina can grant you access to the Roundtable Hold, now contained within a pocket dimension tied to her. She has a soulbound key that cannot be stolen, lost, or destroyed, which lets her open portals to it. In addition to the location itself, it also contains those who do not leave the Hold at any point in the story, namely the Smithing Master Hewg, Spirit Tuner Roderika, Twin Maiden Husks, and Finger Reader Eina. Hewg is treated as having all whetblades, letting him give all infusions from the game, meanwhile the Twin Maiden Husks and Eina are treated as having the full list of items, equipment, and spells that they sell. In place of runes, the apparent lifeforce of those in the Lands Between, you can buy items and services using any lifeforce from those you've slain.
addons.title: Roundtable Hold

objects.text:
Alias: Kindling Maiden, Bearer of the Flame, Maiden Without Guidance
Alignment: Neutral Good
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: ?
Powers: Melina is a spirit of divine origin, likely the daughter of Queen Marika, without a corporeal form. Though not a true Finger Maiden, she can take on the role. She is able to channel runes into others that make them grow stronger. She also has the Spectral Steed Whistle, summoning Torrent, the faithful mount.
Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: None
Quality of Life: Devout (Melina lives for a single purpose, not a personal one. She walks beside the living, not among them. She does not laugh or love, but watches with solemn hope. Her duty gives her peace, but not fulfillment. Her only joy lies in the hope that her sacrifice might grant someone else a better world.)
objects.title: Melina (Elden Ring)

addons.text:
You have become the promised consort of Ranni the Witch, bound to her by fate and sealed beneath the pale glow of the eternal moon. Together, you have kindled the Age of Stars, an age free from the designs of gods and untouched by the chains of the Greater Will. Together, the first step of your thousand-year voyage has been taken. From this sacred union, your Moonlight Greatsword has awakened to a power befitting your place at her side.

Through your blade, you may now channel the Full Moon Incantations. This includes all Full Moon spells available to players, as well as those once wielded by Bosses. Each spell remains bound to your strength and reserves of power, their potency and frequency tethered to your own growth.

Beyond this, Ranni may weave her will directly into your blade. She can infuse your Greatsword with a fragment of her own lunar essence, elevating its destructive might far beyond its natural limits. The depth and duration of this empowerment grow in proportion to the strength of your bond with her.
addons.title: Promised Consort Eternal

objects.text:
Alias: Ranni the Witch, Lunar Princess, Daughter of Rennala, Defier of the Greater Will
Alignment: True Neutral
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: ?
Powers: Ranni is a demigod who cast aside her mortal flesh in rebellion against the Greater Will, severing her destiny and taking on a doll’s form to walk the world unseen. She commands the power of the cold moon and ancient sorceries born of the cosmos. Her magic manipulates death, soul, and space itself—drawing on star-forged forces to erase fates and shatter divine order.
Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: None
Quality of Life: Detached (Ranni lives at the edge of reality, untouched by time, mortality, or feeling. Though she once knew affection, she has since exiled herself from warmth in pursuit of an eternal cause. She watches the world like a ghost behind glass—never fully present, never fully gone. There is no joy in her path, only the cold silence of chosen exile.)
objects.title: Ranni (Elden Ring)

objects.text:
Alias: The Spirit-Bound Lady, The Doll of Grief, The Mourning Bride, La Creatura, She Who Calls the Lost, Pale Daughter of the Veil
Alignment: Neutral Good
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: ?
Powers: Revenant is a spectral summoner and necromancer, bound in the fragile body of a mourning doll. Her form is delicate—lightweight, with low physical durability—but her command of the dead makes her one of the most dangerous entities in the field. She passively reanimates slain foes into temporary allies if she lands the killing blow, and plays a spectral lyre to summon ghostly “family” members (Helen, Frederick, and Sebastian), each with unique combat roles. Her Ultimate, Immortal March, grants temporary immortality to allies, revives the fallen, and empowers her summoned spirits. Though she’s easily broken in direct combat, her strength lies in overwhelming the battlefield with a relentless tide of the dead.
Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: None
Quality of Life: Haunted (Revenant does not live—she lingers. Her existence is animated by grief and tethered to the dead she raises. She finds fleeting comfort in the spirits she calls “family,” but her eyes are always distant, locked on things long lost. Though beautiful and composed, there is no peace in her, only purpose.)
objects.title: Revenant (Elden Ring)

objects.text:
Alias: Guardian
Alignment: Lawful Good
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: ?
Powers: Guardian is a tank-style warrior clad in silver avian armor, forged for defense and unshakable resolve. His body, resilient and broad, is designed to endure immense punishment while shielding those around him. Armed with a greatshield and halberd, Guardian’s passive endurance allows him to brace for impacts with superior guard boost and stamina efficiency while holding position. With a sweep of his wings, he can summon a cyclone that staggers enemies around him, controlling the field through force and momentum. His ultimate, Wings of Salvation, sends him leaping skyward before crashing down in a radiant impact that revives nearby allies and leaves behind a protective dome. Though slow and deliberate in movement, Guardian thrives at the heart of chaos—where others fall, he remains standing.
Appearance: Handsome
Civilian Identity: None
Quality of Life: Restrained (Guardian’s life is bound to duty. Though admired for his strength and courage, he lives without indulgence or reprieve. He is not tormented—but he is never free. He sees the world through the lens of what must be protected, never what he personally desires. Moments of peace are fleeting, stolen between battles. While not unhappy, he lives entirely for others—and without them, he would be aimless.)
objects.title: Guardian (Elden Ring)

objects.text:
Alias: Executor
Alignment: Lawful Good
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: ?
Powers: Executor is a parry-focused melee specialist clad in golden Crucible-forged armor, wielding a cursed katana permanently fused to his arm. He excels in close-quarters combat through precise timing and deflection, redirecting enemy strikes to charge his blade with divine Crucible energy. Each successful parry empowers him further, allowing him to cut through even heavily armored enemies. His passive, Tenacity, boosts his attack and stamina recovery after surviving ailments like poison or bleed. His ultimate, Aspects of the Crucible: Beast, lets him transform into a monstrous, horned beast—enhancing his reach, granting regeneration, and unleashing devastating area attacks that can revive allies. Executor is relentless and disciplined, thriving when measured judgment meets practiced aggression.
Appearance: Handsome
Civilian Identity: None
Quality of Life: Burdened (Executor lives under the immense weight of duty and spiritual obligation. Though noble in bearing and unwavering in action, his existence is one of self-denial. He does not seek companionship or rest, only atonement for a forgotten sin hinted at in the etched runes along his cursed blade. Even among allies, he is distant, as if already walking toward an end he has accepted.)
objects.title: Executor (Elden Ring)

objects.text:
Alias: Recluse
Alignment: Neutral Good
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: ?
Powers: Recluse is a high-prowess elemental sorceress who channels volatile affinity energy through forbidden rites. She absorbs ambient elemental remnants from the world around her—magic, fire, lightning, or holy—and refines them into devastating arcane spells. By drawing in these energies from the damage dealt to nearby enemies and allies, she sustains her casting power without relying on flasks. When three elemental types are absorbed, she can trigger a “Magic Cocktail,” unleashing a potent spell whose effects vary depending on the elemental combination—ranging from massive AoE firestorms to temporary shields or unlimited FP zones. Her Ultimate, Soulblood Song, brands all nearby foes with cursed sigils that refund FP and HP to any ally who strikes them, while temporarily making her invulnerable. Fragile in body but devastating in magic, Recluse is a glass cannon who thrives on precision, positioning, and momentum.
Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: None
Quality of Life: Isolated (Recluse lives in profound solitude, by choice and by necessity. Her mastery over chaotic, forbidden elements sets her apart, and few can understand her arcane craft—fewer still can stand to be near her. While not unhappy, she is distant, often locked in meditative silence or cryptic muttering, her thoughts fixed on equations of power and entropy. She finds joy in mastery, but rarely in company. Peace eludes her, replaced by purpose and detachment.)
objects.title: Recluse (Elden Ring)

objects.text:
Alias: Raider
Alignment: Neutral Good
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: ?
Powers: Raider is a weathered marauder and seaborne bruiser who thrives in the heart of the fight. Built like a ship’s prow and just as relentless, he fights with brute strength and stamina, shrugging off blows and answering with crushing counters. His passive, Fighter’s Resolve, grants stacking attack and poise bonuses as he takes damage, letting him tank hits that would stagger lesser warriors. He wields colossal weapons with a brutal overhead swing and a punishing uppercut that can break shields and knock enemies off balance. His ultimate, Totem Stela, plants a massive stone idol into the battlefield, blasting surrounding enemies, reviving nearby allies, and creating temporary cover for ranged fighters. He doesn’t dodge—he endures, absorbs, and strikes back harder.
Appearance: Attractive
Civilian Identity: None
Quality of Life: Comfortable (Raider lives well by the standards of war. He doesn’t dwell on loss or meaning—he lives for the rhythm of battle, the brotherhood of the crew, and the salty wind of freedom. There’s hardship, but it doesn’t trouble him.
