He eats well, fights well, and sleeps without nightmares. In a world haunted by guilt and purpose, Raider simply survives—and in that simplicity, he finds peace.)
objects.title: Raider (Elden Ring)

objects.text:
Alias: Duchess
Alignment: Lawful Good
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: ?
Powers: Duchess is a swift and graceful rogue specializing in evasive combat and magic mimicry. She wields a slim ceremonial dagger and dances across the battlefield with almost unnatural fluidity. Her passive, Magnificent Pose, lets her chain dodges without stamina cost for a short window, allowing her to remain untouchable if she keeps moving. Her skill, Restage, echoes the last burst of damage dealt to her and reflects it back in delayed phantom slashes—turning her pain into precision vengeance. Her Ultimate, Finale, cloaks herself and nearby allies in invisibility, letting them revive, reposition, or assassinate while unseen. Though she lacks raw durability, Duchess thrives in duels and chaos alike, always one step ahead and just out of reach.
Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: None
Quality of Life: Lavish (Despite the horrors of the world, Duchess lives well. Her quarters are plush, her clothing fine, and her meals refined—she surrounds herself with elegance, even on the brink of war. Whether this opulence is inherited or stolen is unclear, but she maintains it with confidence. She enjoys her role, relishes the attention her style commands, and while she is deadly, she lives like someone who believes she was born to win. Among Nightfarers, hers is a rare life touched by pleasure and polish.)
objects.title: Duchess (Elden Ring)

objects.text:
Alias: Ironeye
Alignment: Neutral Good
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: ?
Powers: Ironeye is a silent sharpshooter who thrives in long-range engagement and tactical control. His passive, Eagle Eye, reveals rare items and hidden weaknesses in enemies struck by his arrows, benefiting the whole party. He uses an enchanted longbow and a curved dagger for close-quarters marking strikes that debilitate foes. His primary skill allows him to dash in and mark targets with a precision strike, creating weak points that amplify incoming damage and stagger. His Ultimate, Single Shot, fires a devastating, line-piercing arrow that damages all enemies in its path, revives allies it touches, and grants Ironeye brief invincibility during the draw and release. Though lightly armored, his positioning and awareness make him a consistent and invaluable asset in both skirmish and siege.
Appearance: Handsome
Civilian Identity: None
Quality of Life: Satisfying (Ironeye leads a quiet but deeply fulfilling life. He doesn’t seek comfort or praise—only clarity. Each arrow he nocks is a choice made with purpose, and each life he saves or fells adds meaning to his path. Though solitary by nature, he finds joy in being part of a greater mission, supporting others from the shadows. His needs are few, his focus sharp, and in the stillness between battles, he finds peace.)
objects.title: Ironeye (Elden Ring)

objects.text:
Alias: Wylder
Alignment: Neutral Good
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: ?
Powers: Wylder is a balanced, all‑round melee specialist skilled with greatswords, a small shield, and a wrist-mounted grappling hook that doubles as a stake launcher. His passive, Sixth Sense, allows him to cheat death once per run, granting a second chance through revival or a Site of Grace reset. With Claw Shot, he can zip toward foes or pull them into range for a follow‑up. His Ultimate, Onslaught Stake, delivers a powerful explosive strike—when charged, it deals massive damage, staggers large enemies, and can even revive nearby allies. Designed for versatility, Wylder delivers strength, mobility, and survivability in equal measure.
Appearance: Handsome
Civilian Identity: None
Quality of Life: Rewarding (Wylder’s life on Limveld offers a grounded sense of purpose and resilience. He walks into chaos with confidence, knowing he can survive mistakes and protect allies. His existence is steady rather than extraordinary—no grand drives or heartbreak shadow him—just the reliable satisfaction of mastering his tools and living to fight another night. Victories and comradeship give his path meaning, and he carries that quiet contentment forward.)
objects.title: Wylder (Elden Ring)

objects.text: Alias: Queen Marika the Eternal, Vessel of the Elden Ring, Goddess of the Lands Between Gender: Female Age: ??? (Unknown) Background At the heart of Elden Ring’s mythic tapestry stands Marika, a divine ruler chosen as the living vessel of the Elden Ring, the source of order itself. She rose from mysterious origins to godhood, shaping the Lands Between under the influence of the Greater Will. As queen, she forged an empire through both grace and iron decree, binding champions, demigods, and entire peoples to her vision of order. Yet beneath the polished gold of her reign, fractures spread. In a moment that reshaped reality, Marika shattered the Elden Ring, an act equal parts rebellion and catastrophe, plunging the world into chaos and war among her own kin. Powers Marika wields divine authority as the vessel of the Elden Ring, granting her near-absolute control over the fundamental laws governing reality in the Lands Between. She possesses immense holy power, capable of shaping life, death, and fate itself through runes. Her connection to the Greater Will allows her to bestow blessings, create demigods, and enforce cosmic order. Even in ruin, her presence lingers like a cracked crown still humming with power, influencing the world long after her fall.
objects.title: Queen Marika (Elden Ring)

objects.text: Alias: Spirit Tuner Age: Unknown Gender: Female Background Roderika is a Tarnished who journeyed to the Lands Between with a group of companions, only to lose them to Stormveil Castle. Initially lacking confidence and self-worth, she searched for a purpose. Through guidance and self-discovery, she awakened her talent as a Spirit Tuner and learned to support others. While not good in a fight, she's compassionate, helpful, and more humble than she should be. Powers Roderika possesses an innate gift for Spirit Tuning, allowing her to strengthen and nurture Spirit Ashes. While she is not known for direct combat, her connection to spirits is exceptional, enabling her to enhance the abilities of spectral allies beyond what most could achieve. Her spiritual sensitivity lets her easily understand people on a deep level. Note While she does have the spirit ashes for Spirit Jellyfish, Aurelia, she does not have a spirit caller bell.
objects.title: Roderika (Elden Ring)

objects.text: Designations: Boc the Seamster Age: Unknown Gender: Male Background Boc is a scrawny, rat-like demihuman, deemed too weak for his tribe and kicked out to fend for himself. He is a gentle soul, showing immense loyalty in return for kindness. Boc harbors a deep sense of self-loathing for his demihuman body, desiring to become a human. Powers Boc possesses no real powers of his own, but with the right tools, he is a capable seamster, capable of learning how to modify and potentially even craft clothing and armor fit for demigods.
objects.title: Boc (Elden Ring)

objects.text: Designations: Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon Age: Unknown, likely to be hundreds of years old Gender: Female Background When she gazed at the night sky and chased the stars, Rennala's path to excellence was set, becoming the master of the Academy of Raya Lucaria and establishing the the House of Caria. After two wars, the woman would marry Radagon of the Golden Order after he cleansed himself with the Celestial Dew, their union uniting the Erdtree and the Moon. Their marriage would prove to be fruitful, with Rennala giving birth to three children: Radahn, Rykard, and most importantly, Ranni. Until Radagon broke her heart by leaving her to become Queen Marika's Consort. Clutching onto the amber egg Radagon gifted her, the only solace her broken self found was the art of reincarnation, creating her 'Sweetings' from Juvenile Scholars, attempting to fill the void of not only her lost marriage, but of her lost children, with Radahn losing his mind to Scarlet Rot, Rykard falling into his Blasphemy, and Ranni killing Godwyn and destroying her empyrean body in the process. It is up to you, dear traveler, to show her hope again despite a world that has done everything to take it away. Powers Master of Glinstone Sorceries, Rennala shows why you should never let up to give her time to cast as single spell if you happen to cross her past. With her ability to tap into the primeval current, she can also cast Comet Azure, one of the most powerful sorceries in Elden Ring, along with Rennala's Full Moon. She is also capable of utilizing Spirit Summons without the use of a Spirit Bell. Thanks to her Great Rune of the Unborn, Rennala can also give use Rebirth, allowing Tarnished to become new and whole again without the usual side effects of rebirth, such as short lived memories and fragile bodies.
objects.title: Rennala (Elden Ring)

objects.text:
Alignment: Lawful Neutral
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: 1000+ (Ancient Nasod)
Power: Eve is the last surviving Nasod (a race of advanced robotic beings) from an ancient civilization. As the Nasod Queen, she commands an array of Nasod technology, including her loyal drones, Moby and Remy, which are capable of attacking, defending, and scouting. She possesses the ability to summon and control Nasod weaponry, utilizing energy-based attacks and deploying mechanical guardians to aid her. Her combat style combines high intelligence, precision, and adaptability.

Appearance: Eve has a petite and elegant appearance, with long silver hair and piercing yellow eyes. She typically wears attire that reflects her Nasod heritage, often incorporating futuristic and mechanical elements into her clothing.

Civilian Identity: Nasod Queen

Quality of Life: Moderate (Focused on Mission, Detached from Modern Society, Seeks Restoration of Nasod Civilization).
objects.title: Eve (Elsword)

objects.text:
Gender: Female
Age: Unknown (Appears around 10-11 years old)
Appearance: (Beautiful) A silver-haired girl with silver-blue eyes, dressed in a long, flowing silver-blue one-piece dress. Despite her innocent and deceptively cute appearance, this façade quickly fades when her true nature is revealed.

Power
The Silver Devil, known as Arcadia, is a sentient magical construct created from a combination of rare metals and potent enchantments. One of the metals used in her creation is mithteil, a unique alloy formed by compressing mithril under the intense pressure of a meteorite impact. Mithril, the least valuable of the metals used, contributes to the alloy that forms her body. Her construction is further enhanced by powerful enchantments, making her abilities far beyond the ordinary.

Arcadia is an ego weapon, a miraculous creation granted a soul by a divine entity to showcase the extraordinary nature of her forging. The process was so intricate and imbued with magic that it resulted in a sentient weapon. She is both a living entity and a weapon, designed with intelligence and purpose.

Arcadia is a being of both curses and blessings, with 108 curses and 256 blessings intertwined within her. These enchantments work in tandem, creating a paradoxical effect. The curses are the most prominent aspect of her abilities, enabling her to inflict excruciating, magical agony. The torment she inflicts goes beyond mere physical pain, targeting the body’s senses and psyche in a way that feels eternal, as though the victim is enduring an unrelenting metaphysical suffering. The pain is constant and all-consuming, yet the target’s body remains alive, allowing them to endure the suffering.

What makes Arcadia's curses unique is their ability to bypass all magical and physical defenses. Regardless of how resilient the target is or what protective measures are in place, her curses will still penetrate and inflict their torment. With each touch, the agony intensifies, and no shield or resistance can prevent the curse from affecting the body. As such, anyone encountering Arcadia is subjected to the full extent of her power, without reprieve.

Alongside the curses, Arcadia also possesses blessings—256 of them—which counterbalance her malicious nature. These blessings primarily serve as healing magic, restoring physical injuries and alleviating some of the damage caused by her curses. However, the blessings are intricately tied to the curses, and their healing effects paradoxically make the body more receptive to the pain. The healing repairs the body’s wounds, but leaves it vulnerable to further agony, heightening its susceptibility to the torment that follows. This creates an endless cycle where the body is perpetually recovering, but each recovery only makes it more sensitive to the next wave of suffering.

As a result, those who endure her torment never develop a tolerance to the pain. Instead of desensitizing them, the blessings make them more vulnerable to the next instance of agony. The cycle of healing and torment continues indefinitely, ensuring that the victim is forever trapped in a state of heightened vulnerability and suffering.

Arcadia also has the ability to shapeshift into various forms, such as a suit of armor, two separate bats, or even a human-like construct. This versatility makes her unpredictable and difficult to confront. She can also move instantaneously, creating the illusion of teleportation by sending parts of herself ahead and shifting to those locations. This ability allows her to pursue fleeing targets relentlessly, leaving little opportunity for escape.

Additionally, Arcadia can consume both mana stones and human food, which sustain her magical abilities and maintain her complex structure. Although she is a magical construct, her ability to eat human food adds a strange, paradoxical layer to her nature, as she exists simultaneously as a mechanical being and one with a profound connection to magical forces.

Personality
Despite her terrifying abilities, Arcadia presents herself as innocent, often speaking with a childlike lisp and engaging in playful sounds and gestures. This innocent exterior quickly gives way to her sadistic nature when her true power is revealed. She takes pleasure in the suffering of others, particularly those who attempt to resist or oppose her.

While Arcadia delights in inflicting pain, she paradoxically shows care for those who endure her trials. Survivors often experience a strange form of revitalization—physically healed but forever changed by the agony they’ve endured. However, the healing effect does not lessen the torment they face; instead, it makes them more vulnerable to the pain that will inevitably return.

In her interactions, Arcadia balances between childlike innocence and horrifying power, embodying a complex personality that is both captivating and terrifying. Her cruel actions, though serving a greater purpose in her design, are a constant reminder of the torment she brings, hidden behind her deceptively sweet and innocent appearance.
objects.title: The Silver Devil (Evade the Hero and Flee)

objects.text:
Hero Name: None
Alignment: Chaotic Good
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: 18-19 (400+ chronologically)
Power: Natsu is adept with his Dragon Slayer Magic and makes use of it in many different ways in combat.As with all Dragon Slayers, he can consume his respective element, with the exception of that which he has created, to replenish his energy reserves. The heat of his fire can increase in temperature, which is proportional to Natsu's emotional state.
Appearance: Average
Civilian Identity: Mage
Quality of Life: Neutral
objects.title: Natsu Dragneel (Fairy Tail)

objects.text:
Hero Name: None
Alignment: Lawful Good
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: 19
Power: Erza possesses several different types of magic but her favorite is "Requip: Knight", this is a type of Spatial Magic and Erza's signature form of Magic, over which she possesses great mastery. It is a type of Magic that allows her to swap weapons, armor, and clothes at will. Her particular form of Requip is called The Knight.
Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: None
Quality of Life: Neutral
objects.title: Erza Scarlet (Fairy Tail)

objects.text:
Hero Name: None
Alignment: Neutral Good
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: 19

Power:
Lucy is a Celestial Spirit Mage, wielding Celestial Spirit Magic, a rare form of Spatial Magic that allows her to summon powerful spirits from the Celestial Spirit World using magical keys. She owns 10 Gold Keys representing the Zodiac Spirits and 5 Silver Keys, plus a unique Water Dragon God Key, giving her access to a wide range of combat, utility, and support options through her spirits.

Lucy’s mastery of Star Dress magic lets her don the powers and aspects of her Celestial Spirits directly, gaining their abilities in combat. This includes elemental powers like Water, Earth, Sand, and Light, enhanced speed, strength, marksmanship, and magic attacks. She can combine two Star Dress forms at once through Star Dress Mix, greatly amplifying her power for brief periods.

She can cast Urano Metria, the “Ultimate Magic of the Stars,” and Gottfried, a legendary and forgotten celestial spell capable of devastating large-scale targets. She also wields her Fleuve d’étoiles, a water-based whip from the Celestial Spirit World, as a powerful and versatile weapon.

Despite often seeming less physically aggressive than her guildmates, Lucy is highly intelligent, quick-thinking in battle, and capable of impressive magical feats when backed into a corner. Her resilience, courage, and tactical ingenuity make her far more dangerous than she appears at first glance.

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: Author, Mage, Celestial Spirit Keybearer
Quality of Life: Good
objects.title: Lucy Heartfilia (Fairy Tail)

objects.text:
Hero Name: None
Alignment: Lawful Good
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: 12–13 (chronologically over 400)

Power:
Wendy is a Sky Dragon Slayer, a rare and powerful mage who manipulates air for offense, healing, and support. Her Sky Dragon Slayer Magic allows her to unleash powerful wind-based spells, enhance physical attributes with enchantments, and perform advanced healing—capable of saving allies from lethal injuries or purging curses and poisons.

She possesses an advanced form of Enchant Magic, letting her empower herself or others with boosts to speed, strength, and defense. Her enchantments can alter physical and magical traits, cancel spells, and even affect abstract properties like magical affinities or resistances. Her skill level rivals that of High Enchanters.

She can enter Dragon Force, the final and most powerful state a Dragon Slayer can achieve. In this form, Wendy gains tremendous power, heightened speed and strength, durable white scales, and partial Dragon features.

Appearance: Cute
Civilian Identity: Mage, Sky Dragon Slayer
Quality of Life: Good
objects.title: Wendy Marvell (Fairy Tail)

objects.text:
Alias: The Demon
Alignment: Lawful Good
Age: 19
Gender: Female
Sex: Female

Power: Mirajane is skilled in numerous magics, such as Water Magic, Darkness Magic and Transformation Magic, but her primary Magic is the Satan Soul Take Over Magic. Satan Soul is a category of Take Over Magic, which allows the user to take the appearance and abilities of other beings, such as animals or monsters. In Mira’s case, she can use the souls of demons to use their power and take on different forms.

She also is an expert hand-to-hand combatant, having spent many years completing missions. She possesses a rather keen intelligence, holding a deep well of knowledge in regards to Magic and related subjects.

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: Fairy Tail Guild Member, S-Class Wizard
Quality of Life: Good

Note: In regard to Satan Soul, Mirajane has access to all of her known forms, such as Sitri, Alegria, Seilah, Halphas, and Hell's Core.
objects.title: Mirajane Strauss (Fairy Tail)

objects.text:
Name: Irene Belserion
Alignment: Neutral Evil
Gender: Female
Sex: Female

Power:  Extremely skilled at Enchant magic to the point where she can terraform the surrounding area by enchanting it. Can assume the form of a Sage Dragon, which allows her to breathe out energy blasts and further empower her Enchantments. Skilled in melee with a staff.

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: N/A
Quality of Life: Terrible (Betrayed by her husband, spent a long time having to deal with sensory deprivation in a dragon’s body)

Note: She now has the ability to physiologically transform into her human form, ensuring that she won’t end up going insane through sensory loss. She can transform to and from her Sage Dragon form at will.
objects.title: Irene Belserion (Fairy Tail)

objects.text:
Hero Name: Sidestep
Villain Name: Unknown (Varies)
Name: Unknown (Varies)
Alignment: True Neutral - Chaotic Evil (depends)
Gender: Unknown (Varies)
Sex: Unknown (Varies)
Age: Estimated to be 30

Powers: Sidestep is a Telepathic Re-Gene Cuckoo, an artificially made "human" meant to be used for infiltration  before they escaped their handlers. Thus, they are able to use their abilities to affect people's minds; from standard mind reading, visual and auditory hallucinations, brainwashing, scrambling brains, and even potentially causing permanent nerve damage. They are also incredibly skilled at possession, able to restrict a person's mind for them to puppet their body. Finally, they have some resistance to other people's telepathic powers, though they are not immune.

This ability does have weaknesses though. They need to consume carbohydrates to keep their telepathy fueled. They also could not use their telepathy on people with Epilepsy, since their brains feel like unreadable static to them. As for possession, they need to be close in proximity to the target, with their own body going slump and thus is vulnerable to attacks. They also lose access to their telepathic powers besides the body snatching while in somebody else's body.

Otherwise, they are a skilled combatant, able to fight alongside Heroes of more combat oriented powers than them through martial arts. After their fall, they have gained a powered up suit that possesses nanomachines that can eat nonorganic material that they control through their powers. Their Cuckoo training also gave them skills to blend in and infiltrate in high societies.

Appearance: Average 
Civilian Identity: Just a retired hero who is totally disinterested in getting back in the field.
Quality of Life: Terrible, suffers from PTSD and Depression, but it is starting to look up since debutting as a Villain.
objects.title: Sidestep (Fallen Hero Series)

objects.text:
Name: Frank Horrigan
Alignment: Lawful Evil
Gender: Male
Sex: None
Age: 31 years old

Power: Super Mutant Biology, allowing for superhuman strength, speed, and durability, combined with one of the best Power Armors ever designed. Is capable of fighting a whole small community of steel rending monsters nearly by himself. Armed with a Plasma gun only he can use due to his physiology. Has Cyborg components that help with his functions.

Quality of Life: It has its ups and downs (Has to wear a suit or else suffer death, gets to kill mutants on the daily, lives a "privileged" life with his fellow humans.), Is a rather intense "Genetic-racist" where he sees anyone exposed to radiation as "muties" besides himself.
objects.title: Frank Horrigan (Fallout)

objects.text: Alias: Courier Six Gender: Unknown Age: Around 35 years old Background Not much is known about the man... or even woman, who became Courier Six. They originally lived in a place soon to be known as the Divide, before an unknown nuclear package delivery turned it into a living hell hole. Time passed, before a fateful package delivery of a platinum chip to the wasteland city of New Vegas brought him to the verge of death. But despite 2 bullets in his skull and a close death, the Courier recovered above all odds, and made his way through a wasteland of hell, change... and unknown futures. Powers The courier is a rather ambiguous powerset. But the common accepted "Version", is a person that has the power known as "You're S.P.E.C.I.A.L (Fallout) from Shardless. On top of this, he has a rather insane will to live, able to survive 2 pistol shots to his head. Finally, he also has access to an orbital laser platform called the Archimedes II, able to decimate battlefields with a single shot, originating from a ray gun he possesses.
objects.title: The Courier (Fallout)

addons.text: You gain control of the First Encounter Assault Recon, a former U.S. unit dedicated to combating paranormal threats. It is now a wholly independent organization, retaining all its resources and manpower, all of which are now under your control. Along with all the operatives, there is one figure of note: The Point Man, Alma Wade's firstborn son, who was denied even a name as he was turned into a human weapon. Needless to say, having him here greatly improves Alma's mood, as she has one of her sons back.
addons.title: First Encounter Assault Recon

addons.text:
Perhaps you uncovered a forgotten Armacham Technology Corporation base, or perhaps they fell off a truck—the details don’t matter, as what’s important is that you now have an army of cloned Super Soldiers created by ATC, along with all the technology and infrastructure needed to mass-produce them and alter them to your liking, all of them ultimately loyal to you. To help lead these cloned soldiers, you have a psychic commander: Paxton Fettel, Alma Wade's second son, who was groomed by ATC to be the one to control their clone army, and who worked with Alma to set the events of F.E.A.R. into motion.

Needless to say, having him here greatly improves Alma's mood, as she has one of her sons back. As a result, Paxton himself looks very favorably upon you.
addons.title: Replica Forces

addons.text:
Alma Wade has her sons by her side as the nightmares that once clung to her have faded, granting her and her sons the strength to move past the torment inflicted upon them, knowing that you are at the core of their salvation from their Hell.

With the reunited Wade family at your side, you have taken full control of Armacham Technology Corporation after 'handling' everyone even remotely connected to the company. You now have access to all the bases and resources the company ever had access to, including—but not limited to—their weapon development division, and the city of Fairport itself under your full control, being able to transplant the city into any world of your choice.

But you are able to push their technological edge even further, as along with the complete understanding and knowledge of the technology of F.E.A.R., you also gain the same knowledge from a different version of ATC from the Shogo: Mobile Armor Division universe, augmenting your technology and putting it decades, if not centuries, ahead of what it would have been otherwise.
addons.title: Retribution Complete

objects.text:
Name: Alma Wade
Alignment: Neutral (Mentally unwell due to a mixture of her power and life-and-death experiences)
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: 47 (Time of Death: 26)

Power: Alma is a profoundly powerful psychic who can influence the minds of people for miles around. She is attuned to negative emotions, and possesses telekinesis, pyrokinesis, and numerous other psychic abilities found in the world of F.E.A.R. These include persisting after death as a psychic entity, reality warping, and the creation of worlds through psychic energy, with the potential to develop even more powers over time. On top of this, she has a remarkable ability to multitask through her use of the clone soldiers of Armacham Technology Corporation, though the extent of this ability is unclear. However, while seemingly omnipotent, she does not have total control over her powers, as nightmarish figments of her trauma can manifest unexpectedly.

objects.text: Aliases: Sarah, Renelle Talbert, Ella, The Agony, possibly RWQFSFASXC, possibly Mr. Renner, likely others. Age: Unknown, at least thirty Gender: Female Background Eleanor is an extremely sadistic and cruel being who deeply enjoys causing suffering in others, often taking her time to mock her victims and enemies and rub it in when she is winning. She also seems to be extremely egotistical and petty, responding violently to insults and considering cruel jokes to be funny. That said, she is capable of pretending to be a kind-hearted, wise, supportive figure for extended periods of time if it suits her. Her origins are unclear but implied to be connected to Fazbear Entertainment and William Afton. For at least three decades she has been responsible for orchestrating bizarre incidents leading to deaths and disappearances, usually targeting children. She aims to gain power and eternal life by consuming Remnant, which will allow her to bring about worldwide chaos. Powers Eleanor is a powerful being who feeds on pain and suffering and harnesses it to warp reality in small-scale but potent ways. Typically she uses it to animate objects, particularly animatronics and dolls, grant them powers, and make them attack others. When she acts personally she usually relies on her shapeshifting and illusions to manipulate others into doing her bidding, but if she’s forced into a physical confrontation she has enough physical strength to easily pin an animatronic that could send grown men flying with a single blow and can grow hundreds of tentacles to attack with. The souls of her victims are trapped in a ball pit where they are tormented in pocket dimensions formed from Agony.

objects.text: Alias: The Fullmetal Alchemist Gender: Male Age: 15 and 14 respectively Background When their mother died while they were still young, the brothers Elric devised a scheme to bring her back. The young prodigy Edward had learned enough of Alchemy to perform a human transmutation; unfortunately for the brothers, he succeeded. The dead do not return to life, and the horror writhing on their floor was not their mother. As the price for spitting in God's face, one brother lost several limbs, and the other lost everything but his soul, now bound to a suit of armor. The brothers, now fully grown State Alchemists in the employ of the Amestrian Military, search for the means to return their bodies to normal. Powers Masters of the power "Alchemy (Fullmetal Alchemist)" with the "Gate Of Truth (Fullmetal Alchemist)" upgrade from their contact with Truth, and the "Armstrong (Fullmetal Alchemist)" addon from their training with Izumi Curtis. They are also all-around skilled scholars, scientists, & military officers. You may choose whether or not they have had their bodies restored, as they were at the end of the series; if you do, Edward's Gate remains perfectly intact and he can still use Alchemy.

objects.text: Age: 16 Gender: Female Background Hajime was a high school girl living in Tachikawa City who was chosen by J.J. Robinson to become a new member of the G-Crew. She is a carefree, energetic, and eccentric girl with an artistic spirit. Although her impulsive actions initially led many of her teammates to see her as "troublesome" and stupid, she ultimately proved to be incredibly insightful. This allowed her to completely transform the purpose of the G-Crew for the better and her actions proved to be inspirational for her teammates, such as when she understood the MESS and their true intentions, and even defeated the vile Berg Katze, who had brought about the destruction of several planets. Powers Hajime possesses a NOTE, a seemingly high-tech notebook that is the physical manifestation of a person’s spiritual powers, making her a Gatchaman. The NOTE grants Hajime abilities based on her lifestyle, personality, and skills. Because she is skilled in arts and crafts such as origami, as well as in using hardware tools like a power drill, Hajime’s Gatchaman form allows her to manifest scissor-like weapons, including twin blades holstered in the boots of her armor that can combine into a giant pair of scissors. Hajime also has a pair of retractable wings shaped like swan heads that allow her to fly and can detach from her armor to form a secondary pair of scissors.
objects.title: Hajime Ichinose (Gatchaman Crowds)

objects.text: Age: Teenager Gender: Male Background Born to scientists Rafael and Violeta Salazar, Rex was injected with nanites to save his life after a catastrophic accident. Following the Nanite Event, he lost his memory and was later recruited by Six to join Providence. Powers As an EVO due to his active nanites, Rex possesses a wide range of abilities. His powers include technopathy, the ability to cure other EVOs, and the capability to construct various machines from his body, such as the Smack Hands, Boogie Pack, Slam Cannon, Rex Ride, Punk Busters, and the Big Fat Sword. The Omega-1 Nanite also granted him blueprints for even more advanced machines, such as the blast caster, funchucks, bad axes, block party and sky slyder. The nanites further enhance Rex’s physical capabilities, granting him superhuman durability as well as a regenerative healing factor. Thanks to the Omega-1 Nanite’s self-replication program, he never has to worry about depleting his nanite supply. Rex is also highly intelligent, capable of calculating the trajectories of his weapons in the middle of combat. Combined with his training under Providence, he has become a skilled hand-to-hand fighter even without relying on his powers. Note Rex does not come with any of the Meta-Nanites.

addons.text:
Through you, Scaramouche has regained his lost divine power, once more attaining the might of an archon. This form fuses advanced technology with his elemental mastery, allowing him to unleash devastating attacks such as electro-charged rocket barrages, fiery Pyro-infused kicks, freezing Cryo strikes, and much more.

However, this transformation draining to use, rapidly depleting his energy. Using Shouki no Kami drains him to his limits, leaving him vulnerable and exhausted after its effects fade. Due to this, it is best used as a final trump card unless you can somehow fix his energy problem, one way being giving him a gnosis or something equal in power.

objects.text: Alias: Fischl von Luftschloss Narfidort, Prinzessin der Verurteilung Real Name: Amy Age: Late teens, likely 16-18 Gender: Female Background Fischl is a young Vision wielder from Mondstadt, obsessed with fantasy stories due to her upbringing, and roleplays as the benevolent princess 'Fischl' from her favorite fairy tale. She generally acts in a chuunibyou manner, speaking in an aristocratic and formal tone, with words and phrases that often confuse those who interact with her. Unlike what most people think, Fischl does not actually believe her own act, knowing in her heart that she is just playing the role of the princess of Immernachtreich. Despite this she enjoys living out her fantasy by truly embodying the role as if she actually were, only breaking character in the rarest of moments. Outside of playing her role Fischl is a studious, friendly and well-behaved girl. She lives with her parents, is good at making friends to go adventuring with, and serves as an investigator for the Adventurers' Guild. Due to her eccentric personality, unique abilities, and great quest performance she is seen as a rising star by the guild and people of Mondstadt. Powers Fischl's power comes from her Electro Vision. She is a ranged fighter, using Mitternachts Waltz, a bow that shoots bolts of her elemental energy instead of arrows. She is accompanied by her raven familiar Ozvaldo Hrafnavins, who is in truth a sentient construct of Electro energy subconsciously manifested by Fischl's power. As Oz is essentially a representation of Fischl's elemental power he can independently attack with Electro energy or act together with her seamlessly. Like many advanced Electro users Fischl can also transform her body into pure elemental energy. Because she subconsciously equates her Electro powers with Oz, she will inhabit his construct body to take flight in the form of a raven.
objects.title: Fischl (Genshin Impact)

addons.text:
Good news; you're getting two more Ghostface Killers to help out Billy and Stu. Bad news; these two are arguably bigger dumbasses due to being from a parody movie. Along with Billy Loomis and Stu Macher, their parody counterparts Bobby Prinze and Ray Wilkins will be joining them as Ghostface Killers, receiving the same buff but lacking the pop culture literacy (mainly due to Bobby and Ray being copycats).

But it doesn't end there, as along with Bobby and Ray, Cindy Campbell, Brenda Meeks, Shorty Meeks, and Buffy Gilmore will be joining you as companions. Normally, having them around could give Billy and Stu a wider social circle, but due to being from a parody movie, every one of them brings their own form of trouble, with each having low-level toon force similar to It's a Haunted Scary Addon!

Billy and Stu will more often than not end up trying to wrangle this lot from causing too much trouble, and will have an easier time doing so as they now have a similar form of parody movie / low-level toon force. That being said, relationship drama with the group is a very real possibility.
addons.title: There's 4 of them now!

objects.text: Alias: The Killer, Father Death Age: 18 (Eternally) Gender: Bill & Stu (Male) Background Billy Loomis and Stu Macher were once a pair of normal teens who would go on a killing spree, Billy being the mastermind who wanted revenge and who pressured Stu into helping, creating the mantle of the Ghostface Killer. Normally they would have died in 1996, but this version of Billy and Stu got roped into the Mortal Kombat Tournament and were drawn into a multiverse where they are… outclassed constantly, to put it simply. Suffering repeated death and humiliation through STUpidity, only to be revived and settled with a lot of hospital debt. Powers Billy and Stu are above average in fitness for their age, and their psychotic mental state makes them adept killers with a high pain tolerance. While their inclusion into the Mortal Kombat Tournament and multiversal misadventures have made them strong enough to knock a person's head off with one good swing of their knife, and seemingly possessing all the skills and knowledge of those who have worn the Ghostface mask, they are still well within the limits of a normal human. Billy himself being reasonably skilled enough to talk certain people into joining in his killings, as seen with Stu and two members of the Black Dragons (said members left, but still). Both Billy and Stu have the luck of surviving most incidents that would have killed them, and even if they do die, they revive the next day with the trauma of their deaths mostly erased, kept fresh so they won't abuse their revivals, making them think each death could be their last. On the plus side, between the two of them, Billy and Stu have an encyclopedic knowledge regarding all of pop culture, with them up to date on the latest trends and niches; however, that knowledge tends to slip Stu's mind when he goes looking for targets to kill, leading to them both getting their butts caved in.
objects.title: The Ghostface Killers (Ghostface VS)

objects.text:
Hero Name: The Heterodyne

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: None

objects.title: Agatha Heterodyne (Girl Genius)

addons.text:
Elite T-Dolls of the AR Team receive all the additional benefits and improvements that come from upgrades and add-ons of the T-Dolls branch.

You are free to determine the type and form of these upgrades, if necessary, but in any case, AR Team dolls will retain their uniqueness and the characteristics of character and appearance inherent to them.
addons.title: Joint Modernization

addons.text:
The squad is joined by W, an elite T-Doll with similar stats to the M4 SOPMOD II. She wields an M4A1 CQBR Mk18, has light hair with red streaks, and wears black clothing.
Presumably a sadist.

Note:
The character was featured in concept art and was featured in an image created by the concept artist for a fan. Presumably used as a concept for the character W, from the game Arknights.
addons.title: W

objects.text: Aliases: M4A1, AR-15, M4 SOPMOD II, M16A1, and RO635. Age: Unknown (16 – 25) Gender: Female Background An elite T-Doll squad created by Persica using the neural imprint of a human, Lunasia von Oberstein. The team consists of M4A1, who leads the squad, AR-15, M4 SOPMOD II, M16A1, and RO635. Overall, the squad is less effective than other elite T-Dolls, but has a high degree of autonomy in decision-making and independent action. A distinctive feature is that the squad members are more emotional and have more pronounced characters. The squad has extensive experience in countering EW attacks, as well as in operations with an incomplete composition. AR-15 leads the squad and is distinguished by having a "special" neural cloud and being "too smart". AR-15 is the most serious, strict and straightforward in the squad. M4 SOPMOD II is distinguished by her hot temper and energy, often turning into a frenzy in battle. In addition, it is distinguished by the greatest durability and modularity, as well as a love of collecting trophies from enemies and integrating them into its body. M16A1 is the most experienced and balanced in the squad, is an instructor and mentor for other dolls of the squad, additionally armed with the "Inherited Case", a powerful fire support system in the form of an oblong case and created on the basis of SF technologies. RO635 is a rational professional who is ready to support or replace the AR-15 if necessary. Powers Elite T-Dolls are specialized combat models and have no connection to the civilian market. These T-Dolls are extremely expensive due to the limited production run of each series. They possess outstanding combat capabilities thanks to their strength, durability, speed, and specialized military modules, programs, and equipment. Their capabilities far exceed those of ordinary T-Dolls, let alone humans.
objects.title: AR Team (Girls Frontline)

addons.text:
Elite T-Dolls of the Squad 404 receive all the additional benefits and improvements that come from upgrades and add-ons of the T-Dolls branch.

You are free to determine the type and form of these upgrades, if necessary, but in any case, Squad 404 dolls will retain their uniqueness and the characteristics of character and appearance inherent to them.
addons.title: Joint Modernization

addons.text: Additional dolls-operatives are joining the 404 squad, consisting of G28, G36K, Vector, TMP, PP-90 and Welrod MkII.
addons.title: H.I.D.E. 404

objects.text: Aliases: UMP45, UMP9, HK416 and G11. Age: Unknown (16 – 18) Gender: Female Background A squad of elite T-Dolls capable of operating independently without human orders. The squad is led by UMP45, who also includes UMP9, HK416 and G11. The squad is known for using any tactics necessary to complete a contract or achieve a given objective, with little regard for collateral damage. The squad is also highly effective in EW and signal spoofing and interception, and is prone to erasing records of themselves from T-Dolls they come into contact with during a mission. UMP45, the squad leader, is cunning, determined, and always willing to make some extra money and get something for free. At the same time, he has unrivaled EW capabilities among other T-Dolls, although he has relatively low combat stats. UMP9, the lieutenant in the squad, has a sincere, good-natured character and is highly knowledgeable about world history. She is mainly responsible for erasing the memory of the 404th squad from other T-Dolls. HK416, serious and rough, is the main striking force of the squad. G11, often paired with HK416, acts as a shooter and likes to pretend to be sleepy and lazy. Powers Elite T-Dolls are specialized combat models and have no connection to the civilian market. These T-Dolls are extremely expensive due to the limited production run of each series. They possess outstanding combat capabilities thanks to their strength, durability, speed, and specialized military modules, programs, and equipment. Their capabilities far exceed those of ordinary T-Dolls, let alone humans.
objects.title: Squad 404 (Girls Frontline)

addons.text:
Ringleaders of the Sangvis Ferri receive all the additional benefits and improvements that come from upgrades and add-ons of the T-Dolls branch.

Due to the "complex, unpredictable, and often poorly controlled" nature of reangleaders SF, it is highly recommended that you purchase this add-on. Without it, there are no guarantees of personal safety.
addons.title: Joint Modernization

addons.text:
Each ringleader receives a retinue of 20 Sangvis Ferri-level T-Dolls, which will be adapted to the style and methods of their ringleader.

You are free to choose adaptations and upgrades within the paradigm of their ringleader's warfare style.

They receive all the benefits of the T-Doll branch.

This add-on is similar to “Boss's Retinue” and is its analogue, but does not require the “technical” Sangvis Ferri level.
addons.title: Personal Guards Of The Leaders

addons.text:
Now, each ringleader's personal entourage and guard has grown to the size of a small army, consisting of 500 Sangvis Ferri T-Dolls.

You can also freely choose the adaptation, modernization, and type of these T-Dolls. However, it is advisable to adapt them to a specific ringleader and their style and tactics of warfare.

They receive all the benefits of the T-Doll branch.
addons.title: Personal Army Ringleader

objects.text: Aliases: Agent, Gager, Intruder, Dreamer, Judge, Executioner, Hunter, Destroyer, Architect, Beak, Ouroboros, Alchemist, Scarecrow Age: Unknown (16 – 25) Gender: Female Background The high-tech Sangvis Ferri T-Dolls surpass human Elite T-Dolls. They are completely autonomous. Agent — deputy commander between Elisa and the personnel. She knows how to fight and command. She is calm, polite, and respects only Elisa. Gager obeys the Agent and has command priority. She protects other ringleaders. She follows a code of honor, but not to the detriment of her tasks. Intruder is a high-ranking doll with command priority. She is polite but cold and ruthless. She loves drama and uses quotes. Dreamer — under Elisa's command, possesses long-range combat capabilities, is arrogant and selfish, can be unstable, and disregards the safety of allies. Judge — responsible for the security of Sangvis Ferri headquarters, Elisa's bodyguard, harsh, old-fashioned, soldierly character. Executioner — commands the outpost, straightforward, rude, loves close combat, does not mock weak enemies. Hunter — distinguished by mobility and intelligence, engaged in pursuit, commands fewer units, arrogant, disregards behind-the-scenes methods. Destroyer — chief explosives expert, tsundere, haughty, sharp-tongued, loves children's songs and toys, dislikes when people talk about her height. Architect — ringleader of fire, artillery, and engineering support. Cheerful and silly, she feels no hostility or loyalty, dislikes giving orders, and is prone to desertion. She is fascinated by destruction. Beak — ringleader of speed and destruction operations. Arrogant, flamboyant, and stylish, she considers boredom unnecessary. Ouroboros — combat ringleader. A perfectionist and ruthless, unpredictable, and dangerous due to experimental AI. Alchemist — ringleader of special operations. A specialist in tactics and interrogation, she is selfish, haughty, and sadistic, mentally mature, and ready to help her allies. Scarecrow is the ringleader of intelligence and analysis. Intelligent, rational, quiet, and sharp-tongued, she is focused on her duties and despises sentimentality. Powers Sangvis Ferri Ringleaders are specialized dolls equipped with advanced artificial intelligence and well-developed personalities, who hold command positions within SF and lead through the OGAS system. Each leader belongs to a specific subtype: command, defense, combat, special operations, or reconnaissance. Their place in the hierarchy and their tasks depend on this. Regardless of subtype, all leaders can effectively command large SF units, employing a variety of tactics and strategies. Each Ringleader possesses significant combat power, allowing them to single-handedly take on a platoon of elite T-Dolls. They have access to high-tech equipment, including energy cannons, shields, levitation systems, and more.
objects.title: Sangvis Ferri Ringleaders (Girls Frontline)

addons.text:
Elite T-Dolls of the DEFY squad receive all the additional benefits and improvements that come from upgrades and add-ons of the T-Dolls branch.

You are free to determine the type and form of these upgrades, if necessary, but in any case, DEFY dolls will retain their uniqueness and the characteristics of character and appearance inherent to them.
addons.title: Joint Modernization

addons.text:
You can now deploy 1,000 T-Dolls as G&K forces directly under your command.

Most of these T-Dolls are armed and mobilized civilian dolls, but they are more than capable of combat and pose a serious threat, especially in urban combat conditions.

Excluding the DEFY, AR Team, and Squad 404 units under your command, there are no more than 20-30 Elite T-Dolls in your own units and as individuals.

If you have add-ons and upgrades from the T-Dolls branch, all of these dolls will receive benefits and privileges from them. At the same time, they will be considered a separate army.
addons.title: The Griffin & Kryuger Elite

objects.text: Aliases: AK-12, AN-94, AK-15, RPK-16 Age: Unknown (18 – 20) Gender: Female Background A squad of elite T-Dolls capable of operating independently and autonomously in the field is led by AK-12 and includes AK-15, AN-94, and RPK-16. This is the most effective squad, also known as the “Wolf Pack,” created for the Statesec project of the same name. The squad is extremely effective both individually and as a group. The squad’s T-Dolls are capable of independently carrying out missions involving sabotage, counter-sabotage, and counter-terrorism. However, when operating in pairs or as a squad, their effectiveness is significantly higher. While the AK-15 and RPK-16 are designed more for solving problems through forceful means, the AK-12 and AN-94 are intended for a more flexible and strategic approach. Powers Elite T-Dolls are specialized combat models and have no connection to the civilian market. These T-Dolls are extremely expensive due to the limited production run of each series. They possess outstanding combat capabilities thanks to their strength, durability, speed, and specialized military modules, programs, and equipment. Their capabilities far exceed those of ordinary T-Dolls, let alone humans.
objects.title: Task Force DEFY / Wolf Pack (Girls Frontline)

addons.text: Elisa receive all the additional benefits and improvements that come from upgrades and add-ons of the T-Dolls branch.
addons.title: Joint Modernization

addons.text: Eliza will take command of the Sangvis Ferri Ringleaders, significantly improving their coordination and greatly increasing their danger thanks to her outstanding abilities.
addons.title: The Sangvis Ferri Elite

addons.text:
Sangvis Ferri is experiencing its second heyday. Led by their Supreme Commander and the Ringleaders he directs, Sangvis Ferri forces are ready to challenge even the greatest powers and mighty threats, let alone some Griffin & Kryuger mercenaries and their T-Dolls. 

Each additional addon or upgrade from the T-Doll branch will provide a significant boost to all of Sangvis Ferri's forces, turning them into an increasingly terrifying foe.

To reflect this, you can consider that each quantitative improvement will be added twice (x2). This applies to the number of T-Dolls, the number of Dummy Dolls, the number of military vehicles, and the number of supplies and ammo you get.

If you have the OATH Systems addon, it will be able to bring back lost T-Dolls 2x faster.

If you have the Digitizing the Mind addon, Elisa will be fully capable of replacing you and maintaining all addons and upgrades on her own.

If you have the Dolls never die addon, the number of replicator cubes can also be doubled. Elisa will also get the same number of replicator cubes that you have.

This will result in the new Sangvis Ferri army being considered indestructible unless you both are destroyed quickly and permanently.
addons.title: Renaissance Sangvis Ferri

addons.text:
Elisa can adopt the characteristics of “Shogun” — Raiden Ei's puppet. At the same time, she will retain her strengths, which will significantly strengthen her and bring her closer to divine status.

Elisa will also gain a second form, similar to Magatsu Mitake Narukami no Makoto, capable of absorbing any energy, with a shield that blocks damage and powerful attacks. Her strongest attack, “Eye of Stormy Judgement,” paralyzes and instantly kills the target.

You can change her appearance and the type of attacks she uses, as well as choose whether her powers are based on spiritual and magical forms or on high technology indistinguishable from magic.

T-Dolls associated with Elise will receive a boost without Magatsu Mitake Narukami no Makoto, but will be able to use an analogue of Musou no Hitotachi, which is sufficient to defeat opponents of the Harbingers of Fatui level and above.
addons.title: Shogun Eliza

objects.text: Aliases: Elisa or Mastermind. Age: Unknown (16) Gender: Female Background She is an artificial intelligence and commander-in-chief of all Sangvis Ferri forces, giving broader orders and leaving situational control to subordinate ringleaders. But her commands and control are even more effective than theirs, although she has not yet reached full effectiveness at the tactical level. She continuously develops and evolves “on her own,” but rarely enters combat personally. She possesses great combat power, and even if she simply resists, it will force entire units of the best Elite T-Dolls to strain all their strength. She is quick-tempered, irritable, and cruel, as well as extremely demanding. She does not care about the means and methods used to achieve her goals. She generally hates humans and the T-Dolls who obey them. Her main goals are to avenge the death of her “father” Lyco and to achieve his dream of “perfect artificial intelligence” capable of self-awareness and feelings. But in the process of achieving her goals, she has become even more “inhuman” in moral terms. Powers Elisa is a cutting-edge artificial intelligence system developed using Relic Technology. She is capable of finding the most optimal and effective solutions for any task. Elisa possesses powerful capabilities in the field of electronic warfare. She can disable or take control of modern digital devices, bypass military-grade electronic warfare programs and countermeasures, and carry out large-scale cyberattacks capable of paralyzing or taking down entire armies. She is equipped with a kinetic barrier capable of withstanding an explosion equivalent to several kilotons of TNT. Elisa’s arsenal includes both conventional weapons and several powerful energy cannons comparable in power to tank guns. In addition, she possesses gravity control technologies that allow her to move through the air or deliver powerful gravitational strikes against multiple targets simultaneously. Elisa is also capable of teleportation, but only between objects created using Relic Technology.
objects.title: Elisa (Girls Frontline)

objects.text:
Hero Name: Queen of the Monsters, Mothra
Alignment: Neutral
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: Unkown

Powers:
Mosura is a colossal divine Kaiju closely tied to life, light, and the natural balance of the world. She possesses powerful flight and extreme aerial agility, allowing her to maneuver gracefully despite her immense size. Her wings generate radiant energy and hurricane-force winds capable of knocking back enemies or deflecting attacks, while the glowing scales she sheds can disrupt energy attacks, weaken opponents, or empower allies. Though less physically durable than many Kaiju, she compensates with remarkable resilience and the ability to reincarnate, being reborn through her eggs after death. As a guardian Kaiju, Mosura also possesses a supernatural connection to the natural world and is often able to sense disturbances in the planet’s balance.

Appearance: Monstrous (She’s a giant divine esc moth)
Civilian Identity: None
Quality of Life: Has its ups and downs
objects.title: Mosura (Godzilla Franchise)

objects.text:
Hero Name: Godzilla, King of the Monsters, God of Destruction, Nature’s Wrath
Alignment: Neutral
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: Unkown

Powers:
Gojira is a colossal, radiation-powered Kaiju whose body functions like a living nuclear reactor, allowing him to absorb and feed on radiation, with nuclear weapons often strengthening him rather than harming him. His signature Atomic Breath is a devastating beam of radioactive energy capable of destroying cities, blasting through mountains, and even shattering incoming meteors. Gojira possesses immense physical strength, able to wrestle and overpower other giant monsters, along with extreme durability that lets him withstand planet-destroying impacts. 

Appearance: Monstrous (He’s a giant nuclear radiation monster)
Civilian Identity: None
Quality of Life: Has its ups and downs
objects.title: Gojira (Godzilla Franchise)

objects.text: Alias: Ed Age: ??? Gender: Takes on a male form Ed is one of the Elder Gods, banished to this universe by the Eldest Elder God Shaquille O’Neal until he can perfect the Good Burger. In the meantime he entertains himself by using his powers to toy with the mortal inhabitants of this reality. Powers Ed is an Elder God who predates the universe and may have created it. He controls everything in the universe and can create life, move objects with his mind, absorb souls, reset time, speak the Elder Tongue and be answered by anything, absorb knowledge from anything he interacts with to instantly comprehend its entirety, create entire worlds wholesale with fabricated histories, and generally do just about anything. He is also able to guide mortals to see beyond the ephemeral limitations of their reality and achieve similar feats to him, with time.
objects.title: Ed (Good Burger - Horror of the Old Gods)

objects.text: Aliases: Old Man McGucket Age: 50s-60s Gender: Male Background McGucket is an eccentric genius. While researching the mysteries of Gravity Falls with his friend Stanford, McGucket made a memory-erasing gun to reprieve himself of the frightening nightmares of the place. Soon he was using it daily, even making a secret organization known as the Blind Eye Society. Unfortunately, the continuous use of the gun also carved apart his sanity, leading him to become the town kook known as Old Man McGucket. Powers McGucket is a genius inventor. He assisted in the creation of a multiversal portal with Stanford and developed numerous advanced machines, including the memory-erasing gun and several large mechs such as the GideonBot, Gobblewonker, and Shackatron. Due to prolonged exposure to the memory-erasing gun, he has developed resistance to memory alteration.
objects.title: Fiddleford McGucket (Gravity Falls)

objects.text:
Alias: The Gravity Queen
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: 16-18

Power: Kat has the unique ability to manipulate gravity, allowing her to defy the laws of physics and move freely through the air. She can shift the direction of her personal gravity at will, enabling her to walk on walls, glide through the sky, and accelerate toward her target with incredible speed. Her gravity powers also enhance her agility and strength, letting her deliver devastating gravity-enhanced kicks that can shatter objects and overpower enemies much larger than herself.

In combat, Kat can create localized gravity fields, allowing her to lift and throw objects with ease, hurl enemies into the air, and generate powerful shockwaves that clear out multiple foes at once. Her abilities extend beyond simple offense, as she can manipulate gravity to protect herself, avoid attacks, and traverse any environment with unparalleled mobility.

Her connection to the cosmic entity Dusty, a mysterious black cat, is the source of her powers. As long as Dusty is by her side, she retains her gravity-shifting abilities, but if separated, she loses access to them. Over time, she has learned to refine her powers, unlocking new techniques such as the ability to shift between different gravity styles, which can boost her speed, increase her strength, or allow for more precise aerial maneuvers.

Kat’s gravity powers make her an unpredictable and highly versatile fighter, able to take on enemies from any angle and adapt to any battlefield.

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: None
Quality of Life: Moderate to Good
objects.title: Kat (Gravity Rush)

objects.text: Aliases: Goddess of Wisdom, War, Intelligence, Craft Age: Thousands of years Gender: Female Background The favorite child of Zeus, the goddess Athena is one of the Twelve Olympians. Born by bursting out of Zeus’s head, she quickly became one of the most prominent deities, and even the city of Athens was named after her. Powers Athena is the Goddess of Wisdom and War from Greek mythology. As a goddess, she is completely immortal, in the sense that she neither ages nor can be killed. She possesses many abilities befitting her domains, including a divine physique, the power to command anything derived from wisdom or war, and even the capacity to act beyond her own domains simply by virtue of being a goddess. Athena also wields the Aegis, a shield forged by Hephaestus.
objects.title: Athena (Greek Mythology)

objects.text: Alias: Soran Ibrahim Age: 21 Gender: Male Background Setsuna was born in a country torn by war. Radicalized from a young age by a mercenary, he fought alongside other brainwashed kids. When he was the only one left and ready to die, a Gundam killed the enemy's soldiers and left him alive. This set a profound change in him, seeing the Gundam as salvation personified, and believing that only by achieving that strength, “becoming” a Gundam, he could end all conflict. Eventually Setsuna grew as a person. Despite still believing that strength is necessary to end conflicts, he now believes that through words, through mutual understanding, that true peace can be achieved. Setsuna is a deeply wounded individual, carrying his childhood traumas to this day, but he eventually learned to open his heart to his friends, using his determination and strong resolve to keep going. Powers Setsuna is an Innovator. This allows him to sense and control quantum waves, making him able to read people's surface intentions and talk as if he had telepathy and react as if he had a danger sense. This also grants him an extended life span and enhanced reflexes. Aside from that, he also has informal soldier training. His main suit is Gundam Exia, a war machine made to handle other mechas at close distances. Armed with a solar reactor, it has, in theory, an infinite operational time, aside from whatever wear and tear the suit may suffer. The GN field the reactor creates can scramble signals close to it and enhance the suit's durability, allowing it to receive a tank shot without scratching.
objects.title: Setsuna F. Seiei (Gundam 00)

objects.text: Nickname: Zag Alignment: Chaotic Good Age: Unknown Gender: Male Sex: Male Power: As a Chthonic God and son of Hades, God of the Dead, Zagreus is already powerful on his own. However, he was trained in the art of combat by the Greek hero Achilles, able to wield different weapons with ease. He has access to the Infernal Arms, powerful weapons once wielded by the Gods to defeat the Titans, and uses them efficiently. Usually, Zagreus wields the Stygian Blade. As a resident of the Underworld, he cannot traditionally stay dead, as he will find himself in the Underworld shortly after dying. It is unknown what Zagreus is the God of exactly, but it is speculated to be associated with Blood and Life. Appearance: Handsome Civilian Identity: Chthonic God, and Prince of the Underworld Quality of Life: Good
objects.title: Zagreus (Hades)

objects.text:
Nickname: Meg
Alignment: Lawful Good
Age: Unknown
Gender: Female
Sex: Female

Power: As one of the Three Furies, Megaera is an expert combatant, able to put down demigods and monsters alike as it is her job to torture adulterers, thieves, and oathbreakers. She holds mastery over the leather whip she uses in her job and combat. She can create projectiles using her whip and magical attacks that cover an area.

Appearance: Beautiful 
Civilian Identity: One of the Three Furies
Quality of Life: Good
objects.title: Megaera (Hades)

objects.text:
Nickname: Than
Alignment: Lawful Good
Age: Unknown
Gender: Male
Sex: Male

Power: Thanatos is Death Incarnate, a child of the Primordial Nyx. As such, he stands on roughly equal footing to the Gods, as do his siblings. He wields a scythe with mastery over its usage. He can also cast spells that inflict foes with instant death, such as marking others with a brand that will kill them in seconds or leaving a magical circle that will do the same for all within it.

Appearance: Handsome
Civilian Identity: Death Incarnate, and Child of Nyx
Quality of Life: Good
objects.title: Thanatos (Hades)

objects.text:
Alignment: Lawful Good
Age: Unknown, at least centuries old
Gender: Male
Sex: Male

Power: Hades holds nigh-absolute authority over the Underworld, ruling over all that resides in his domain. He wields Gigaros, a replica of the Infernal Arm he once had in his battle against the Titans, Varatha, along with his Helm of Darkness, which allows Hades to go invisible for a time.

Not only this, but he can also use his Authority to summon the Dead to aid him in battle, coming in many forms and shapes. He has some experience in wielding magic, or at least using his domain in ways that makes it hard to distinguish between his Authority or magic.

Appearance: Handsome
Civilian Identity: God of the Dead, Lord of the Underworld
Quality of Life: Good
objects.title: Hades (Hades)

objects.text:
Alias: Mother Night, Night Incarnate
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: One of the first being born of primordial Chaos
Power: Primordial Goddess of the Night, she controls darkness. She can teleport through shadows, obscure divine sight, resurrect the deads, oppose the Fates, create artifacts that empower Chthonic Gods and give birth to potent Gods.
Civilian Identity: Manager of the Underworld
Quality of Life: Very High (Primordial Goddess that scares Zeus, second-in-command of Hades)
objects.title: Nyx (Hades)

objects.text:
Nickname: Mel

Alignment: Neutral Good

Age: Unknown

Gender: Female

Sex: Female

Power: Princess of the Underworld trained by Hecate in witchcraft and combat. Wields the Nocturnal Arms (successors to the Infernal Arms) with practiced ease and channels Magick to briefly empower attacks (Ω moves). Selects one Hex from Selene that can be unleashed after spending Magick during an encounter. Uses Arcana Cards for straightforward passive boosts (e.g., Magick regen, resilience, speed). As a denizen of the Underworld, defeat sends her back to the Crossroads rather than a final death. Commonly fights with a mix of melee weaponry and spells, with her spectral left arm serving as a precise, durable magical limb.

Suspected domains include ghosts, witchcraft, and the night. Naturally draws shades and small familiars to her side and can calm or guide them.

Appearance: Beautiful

Civilian Identity: Princess of the Underworld; Witch of the Crossroads

Quality of Life: Good
objects.title: Melinoë (Hades II)

addons.text: Cortana is now Metastable, a theoretical fourth state of Rampancy that happens when an AI becomes a “Real Person.” As a result of this Metastability she has an unlimited lifespan and will never be endangered by Rampancy again.
addons.title: Metastable

objects.text:
Full Name: CTN 0452-9
Alignment: True Good
Gender: Female
Sex: None
Age: 3 years by End of War (2552)
Power: Cortana is an 3rd Generation UNSC Smart Artificial Intelligence specializing in infiltration and research. She is considered a genius and a miracle worker even compared to 4th Generation AI. She can analyze advanced unknown systems and even improve upon them in just a handful of days, as done with a Covenant warship. She comes preprogramed with the entirety of human history along with a massive amount of UNSC research including nearly every UNSC hacking program ever made. During the Human-Covenant War, she also gained access to limited Covenant and Forerunner technology which she reverse-engineered to a signifiant degree.
Appearance: Case 53-like, data chips, servers, and robotic bodies
Identity: No Civilian
Quality of Life: Okay/Bad (Extremely limited lifespan of 7 years, constantly fighting for the survival of the human race, given the best resources and technology money can buy)
objects.title: Cortana (Halo)

objects.text:
Name: John-117
Alias: Master Chief, The Demon, The Reclaimer
Alignment: Lawful Good
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: 41 (as of 2552)

Power: Master Chief is a Spartan-II supersoldier, enhanced through brutal training and advanced augmentations that grant him superhuman strength, speed, reflexes, and endurance. His MJOLNIR powered assault armor further amplifies these abilities, allowing him to run at highway speeds for hours, react fast enough to deflect missiles midair, and exert enough force to bench press a car. The Gen 3 MJOLNIR armor, further enhanced with shapeable energy shields, a thruster pack, and AI support is durable enough to survive a fall from orbit without a drop pod or parachute. As a master tactician and marksman Master Chief is highly proficient with a vast array of weapons, vehicles, and combat scenarios. His adaptability, unyielding determination, and uncanny luck has make him a nearly unstoppable force and humanity’s greatest warrior.

Appearance: Unknown 
Civilian Identity: None
Quality of Life: Terrible (Drafted as a child soldier, Fought a life long war, Watched near genocide of humanity)
objects.title: Master Chief (Halo)

objects.text:
Name: Thel 'Vadam(ee)
Alias: Arbiter, Supreme Commander, Kaidon Alignment: Lawful Neutral  Gender: Male Sex: Male Age: 66 (as of 2552)

Power: The Arbiter is a warrior of unparalleled skill, strength, and discipline, possessing superhuman strength, agility, and resilience granted by his Sangheili physiology. Armed with advanced Covenant weaponry and armor, he excels in both close-quarters combat and ranged engagements, wielding energy swords, energy shields, and plasma firearms with precision. As a leader and strategist, the Arbiter commands overwhelming respect capable of inspiring loyalty even against overwhelming odds. His tactical brilliance, unyielding honor, and unbreakable commitment to his people had made him one of the galaxy’s most formidable and revered warriors.

Appearance: Scarred (Large burn scars across chest) Civilian Identity: Warrior, General, and Admiral  of New Sangheili Government (Swords of Sanghelios)
Quality of Life: Life has its Ups and Downs (Become Admiral of large fleet before being named Arbiter, branded as failure in front of entire species, watched the collapse of entire species government)
objects.title: Arbiter (Halo)

addons.text:
Through possessing the technological knowledge of the UNSC, you managed to upgrade both Cal’s augments and equipment.

On top of her Spartan-II augments, Cal now also has the Spartan-IV augments, which have increased her survivability. Her body is now far more efficient, ages slower, heals faster, is immune to almost all known toxins, can filter out airborne toxins, is able to breathe in low-oxygen environments, can breathe methane for up to an hour, and finally gains far more nutrients from food, with tree bark equating to a full meal.

Instead of the original MJNOLIR armor she had before, now Cal has the Gen 3 MJOLNIR armor, equipped with shapable energy shields, thruster packs, an AI port, and even a grappling hook.
addons.title: Further Augments

addons.text:
Somehow you managed to achieve the impossible and grant the Primaris Space Marine augments in a synergistic manner with Cal’s Spartan-II augments, despite the gender restriction.

Cal is now a monstrous force upon the battlefield, able to lift and throw tens of tons with causal ease, shrug off gunfire without her armor, move at blurring speeds, possess near-AI-levels of connection and control over her MJNOLIR armor, and fully take in and analyze a battlefield in nearly an instant with stim-enhanced spartan time.
addons.title: An Impossibility of Augments

objects.text: Aliases: Cal-141, S-141 Age: 33 Gender: Female Background Abducted by ONI at six years old, Cal was conscripted to take part in the SPARTAN-II Program. Through which she would be trained and taught in nearly all aspects of war, and later successfully augmented into a super soldier. With said training and augmentation, she would go on to later fight for humanity’s survival in the Human-Covenant War. Powers As a Spartan-II Cal has been biochemically and biomechanically augmented, granting her a superhuman physiology. Said physique granted her nigh unbreakable bones, the capacity to run up to 55 kilometers per hour, the strength to both lift over three times her own body weight and strike with enough force to be fatal to normal humans, and perception and reaction speeds that appear akin to slo-mo. Further, she also possesses MJOLNIR Mark IV armor, a highly advanced suit of power armor that not only renders her impervious to small arms fire, highly resistant to armor-piercing rounds, and able to survive in all manner of environments, but also doubles her strength and enhances her reaction speed by a factor of five. These factors, combined with her sheer combat prowess and knowledge, result in Cal being an incredible asset upon the battlefield.
objects.title: Cal-141 (Halo)

objects.text:
Name: [Classified] 
Alias: Lone Wolf
Alignment: Lawful Neutral 
Gender: [Classified] 
Sex: [Classified] 
Age: [Classified] 

Power: Noble Six is a nearly unmatched “Hyper-Lethal” SPARTAN-III supersoldier. Trained to excel in any battlefield condition, Noble Six possesses superhuman strength, reflexes, and endurance due to their training, advanced augmentations, and armor. Their MJOLNIR armor is equipped with energy shields, enhanced agility, and an arsenal of customizable weaponry. Noble Six is skilled in stealth, vehicular combat, and tactical planning, capable of completing high-risk missions alone against overwhelming odds. Their ability to operate both independently and within a team has cemented their legacy as one of the UNSC’s finest Spartans.

Appearance: [Classified] 
Civilian Identity: None
Quality of Life: Terrible (Volunteered as a child soldier, fought a life long war, watched near genocide of humanity)
objects.title: Noble 6 (Halo)

objects.text:
Name: Lighter Than Some
Alias: Engineer
Alignment: True Neutral
Gender: N/A (Huragok are genderless)
Age: Unknown

Power: Lighter Than Some is a Huragok, a highly intelligent and peaceful biological mobile supercomputer engineered by the Forerunners. Huragok can interface with almost any electronic system at the near molecular level to repair, enhance, and reverse-engineer technology with extraordinary efficiency and precision. Huragok also have incredible memory that can recall vast amounts of technical data and schematics, to the point that they can repair nearly all covenant technology from memory alone.

In dangerous situations, Lighter Than Some can deploy personal energy shields for protection but remains strictly non-combative, refusing to engage in violence under any circumstances. Its helium-based physiology enables it to float effortlessly, providing high levels of mobility at the cost of being highly explosive if injured. While incapable of combat, Lighter Than Some is an invaluable asset with an expertise in repairing and upgrading critical systems.

Appearance: Ugly by human standards
Civilian Identity: Covenant Maintenance Engineer
Quality of Life: N/A (Huragoks do not process emotions like humans; so long as they have stuff to fix they are happy)
objects.title: Lighter Than Some (Halo)

However, her talents extend far beyond shapeshifting. Tonks is highly trained in magical combat, stealth, and defense against the dark arts. She is especially skilled with stunning spells, disarming techniques, and protective enchantments, capable of holding her own against elite Death Eaters and often emerging victorious.

Appearance: Variable but by default takes an Attractive form
Civilian Identity: Ministry of Magic Auror

Sex: Female
