She is a highly skilled witch with particular expertise in dueling, charms, transfiguration, and defensive magic. Her proficiency allows her to cast spells in these areas nonverbally. Fleur also possesses considerable knowledge of magical creatures and potions, as expected of a Beauxbatons graduate or Triwizard Champion.

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: Former Beauxbatons Student and Veteran of the Second Wizarding War
Quality of Life: Good
objects.title: Fleur Delacour (Harry Potter)

objects.text: Age: Unknown Gender: Male Background A highly intelligent creature, Fawkes was the long-time animal companion of Albus Dumbledore for almost 60 years. While little is known of Fawkes past, he was often known to help Dumbledore—and those loyal to him—in times of need. Powers As a Phoenix Fawkes possesses all of the many magical traits associated with them, including self-resurrection upon death, The capability to lift immense loads, to teleport via flame, to empower and embolden allies via song, and most famously their healing tears. Fawkes is capable of also providing Phoenix Feathers and Ashes for use in a variety of magical crafting.
objects.title: Fawkes (Harry Potter)

objects.text:
Name: Albus Percival Wulfric Brian Dumbledore
Alias: Supreme Mugwump, Chief Warlock, Grand Sorcerer, Professor Dumbledore, Greatest Sorcerer of Our Time
Alignment: Lawful Good
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: 115

Power: Dumbledore is widely regarded as the most powerful wizard of his time, far surpassing others in both intellect and magical ability. His mastery of magic spans nearly every discipline, including transfiguration, charms, dueling, legilimency, occlumency, alchemy, and defense against the dark arts. He is one of the few living wizards to have fully mastered both nonverbal and wandless magic, allowing him to cast complex enchantments or unleash powerful spells with little more than a gesture.

He is also the wielder of the Elder Wand, the most offensively powerful of the Deathly Hallows, which amplifies his already formidable abilities to an almost mythic level. Even without it, his wisdom, experience, and depth of magical knowledge place him among the greatest combatants in wizarding history.

Appearance: Average
Civilian Identity: Headmaster of Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry, Founder of the Order of the Phoenix, Supreme Mugwump of the International Confederation of Wizards, and Chief Warlock of the Wizengamot
Quality of Life: Bad (Has fought in and lost many friends, family members, and students to two separate Wizarding Wars)
objects.title: Albus Dumbledore (Harry Potter)

addons.text:
Sirius is one of the original four creators of the Marauder’s Map—which you now possess—and he can teach you how to craft similar maps for other locations.

What makes the Marauder’s Map so extraordinary is its ability to display everything within the mapped area in real time. It reveals changes in rooms, reveals passwords or access requirements to bypass locks, and uncovers hidden passages or secret areas. The map also shows the current location and names of everyone present, and it remains effective despite the use of Polyjuice Potion, invisibility cloaks, or transformations into an Animagus.

While these are the primary, well-known features, it’s possible to expand upon the map’s capabilities and customize it further, creating even more powerful and versatile tools.
addons.title: The Marauder's Map

objects.text: Aliases: Padfoot, Snuffles, Stubby Boardman Age: 36 Gender: Male Background Born into the pure-blood Black family of England, Sirius rebelled against his family's ideologies from a young age. Defying tradition, Sirius was sorted into Gryffindor house at Hogwarts and soon became friends with three other boys in a pranking group known as the Marauders. After Hogwarts, Sirius joined the Order of the Phoenix, a group dedicated to fighting the Dark Lord, Voldemort. During Halloween 1981, one of the Marauders' Peter Pettigrew betrayed another member—James Potter and his young family—leading to their deaths. In the aftermath of this tragedy, Sirius attempted to hunt down Peter, which resulted in Pettigrew faking his death and escaping. This caused the blame to be cast on Sirius for the betrayal of the Potters and the deaths of Peter and a dozen Muggles. Sirius spent the next thirteen years in the wizarding prison, Azkaban, before escaping in 1993. Powers Sirius is an exceptionally intelligent, powerful, and versatile Wizard, highly skilled across a wide range of magical disciplines including Transfiguration, Potions, Charms, Dueling, Healing, Care of Magical Creatures, and Nonverbal Magic. He is also an accomplished Animagus, a rare and complex magical technique that enables him to transform into a large, black, Grim-like dog. Known for his mastery of unconventional magic, Sirius often employs magical pranks to his advantage. Sirius possesses extraordinary willpower. Even at the age of eleven, he defied his family and centuries-old traditions. Remarkably, he survived twelve years in close proximity to Dementors while wrongfully imprisoned in Azkaban.
objects.title: Sirius Black (Harry Potter)

objects.text: Aliases: Snivellus, The Half-Blood Prince Gender: Male Age: 38 Background The only child of Muggle, Tobias Snape and Witch, Eileen Snape (née Prince), Severus was raised in the town of Spinner’s End. He met Lily and Petunia Evans, becoming a close friend of Lily’s. Starting Hogwarts in 1971, Severus was sorted into Slytherin House, where he soon found himself at odds with the Marauders. Snape had a passion for the Dark Arts, which led him to fall in with pure-blood supremacists. After an irrevocable falling out with Lily Evans, he eventually joined the Death Eaters. As an active Death Eater, Snape’s most significant contribution was informing Lord Voldemort about the prophecy made by Sybil Trelawney, which led Voldemort to target Lily Evans and her family. This revelation caused Snape to betray Voldemort, siding with Albus Dumbledore in seeking his downfall. Snape served as a spy within Voldemort’s ranks for the Order of the Phoenix. He remained the much-hated Potions Master of Hogwarts and Head of Slytherin House for many years, before becoming the Defense Against the Dark Arts Professor—and even Headmaster of Hogwarts—before perishing in the Battle of Hogwarts. Powers Snape is an exceptionally skilled and formidable wizard. He excels in potion-making, capable of brewing complex and difficult concoctions, as well as inventing new ones. His mastery extends to the Dark Arts, where he can wield the unforgivable curses and develop inventive ways to harm others. Additionally, Snape is highly proficient in Defensive Magic, capable of temporarily halting even the most powerful curses, including those cast by Voldemort himself. His expertise also encompasses the rare arts of Occlumency—shielding his mind from intrusion—and Legilimency—penetrating others’ thoughts. Beyond his magical prowess, Snape is an accomplished actor, adept at deceiving even Voldemort for many years.
objects.title: Severus Snape (Harry Potter)

objects.text: Age: Unknown Gender: Female Background Once the loyal house-elf of the Crouch Family, Winky was fired by Barty Crouch Sr. after being found under suspicious circumstances. Although Dobby later helped her obtain employment at Hogwarts, Winky struggled to adapt to life as a free elf. She became withdrawn and depressed, eventually developing a serious dependence on butterbeer. With time, support, and continued employment at Hogwarts, she gradually began to recover. Powers Winky is skilled in house-elf magic able to do magic without a wand, she can apparate-disapparate through wizard wards and also knows some binding magic. As a house-elf she is able to do most household work. She is extremely loyal.
objects.title: Winky (Harry Potter)

Wears bladed footwear made of Angelic Steel, a material that destroys souls. Highly skilled as an arms dealer, being the premier producer of Angelic weapons in Hell.

Sex: Female

Power: As a Seraphim, she wields a great deal of angelic power beyond the average angel; however, she has little experience—if any—using said power for combat or under dangerous circumstances due to being born, raised (and arguably cuddled), in Heaven. That said, she does have plenty of experience using her powers for portal creation and conjuration; she possesses very notable strength, wings allowing her to fly, is moderately skilled in several mundane areas, and has invincibility except to angelic steel and other angelic/holy forces.

Appearance: Beautiful
Quality of Life: High (Born as what can be considered heavenly royalty)
objects.title: Emily (Hazbin Hotel)

addons.text:
As the Father of Mankind, it seems Lute has developed the habit of latching onto you like a lonely koala, and with Lute at your side, you've gained the abilities of an angel like her, but at a greater level, being able to call upon holy power that scales with your physical ability, so even the weakest of your holy attacks could wipe out entire cities from the map easily, along with being able to create Holy Constructs of anything you can imagine, which can be made real with extra effort, and open portals able to cross realms.

You also gain robes with an "A" on them and an LED mask that, when worn, summons a halo and golden angel wings, which help regulate your powers and lessen the strain placed on you from overusing the Eyes of the Lord; when wearing this outfit, you can alter your size, ranging from as small as 30.48 cm in height to over 30,480 cm tall, and your identity will be protected, except to those you trust or through powerful divinations, with the outfit being able to be summoned and dismissed with a thought.

Encyclopedic knowledge and context for all swear words in the Omniverse (optional).
addons.title: Divine Ordainment

addons.text:
Lute didn't come alone, as she has with her the totality of her fellow Exorcist Sisters at her side, with you being in command, along with the thousands-strong fighting force of Angelic Warriors with thousands of years of experience, you also gain a Heavenly Pocket Dimension to use as a main base.

Possessing all the luxuries of living in a Heaven-like realm, with plenty of facilities like benches, housing, training areas, weapon research and storage, along with a command room to better direct your forces. Should any of the Angels fall in battle or be moments from death, they will be teleported back here for healing and recovery; even if killed with their souls destroyed, they will resurrect in this realm, though it will take at most seven days for them to respawn.

You also gain an arsenal of Angelic Steel with the ability to make more; while capable of destroying souls, they are far more effective at countering and slaying demonic and unholy forces.
addons.title: Dirty Divine Special Forces

objects.text:
Name: Lute
Gender: Female
Sex: Female

Power: As an Angel, she has wings to fly and invincibility, except to angelic steel and other angels; in addition to that, she is one of the best fighters among the Exorcists, far more powerful than her sisters in the organization, with the ability to lead forces into battle against enemies with random abilities.

Appearance: Beautiful.
Civilian Life: Second in command of the Exorcists.

Is stronger than her size implies, able to carry Husk from Hazbin Hotel to V Tower in several seconds and hurt Sir Pentious with a single kick. Is surprisingly good with bladed weapons, able to fight Exorcists and Overlords. Is capable of influencing animals to follow her commands. Wields an Angelic Dagger capable of destroying souls. Is actually a very good housekeeper and cook despite her mania.

Quality of Life: Good (Seems to enjoy her job at the hotel and like the people there, is under the protection of both Alastor and Charlie Morningstar)
objects.title: Niffty (Hazbin Hotel)

objects.text: Aliases: Vincent Whittman, The God of Entertainment, The People's Voice, Media Overlord, TV Demon Age: Believed to have died in his 50s, currently probably in his 120s Gender: Male Background Vox is the powerful and well-respected Media Overlord and leader of the Vees, an overlord trio with an iron grip on all media within Hell. Vox is cruel, selfish, and vindictive, but also capable of forming genuine positive connections with others no matter how much he tries to deny it. He overcompensates for his own insecurities by constantly chasing the next best thing without regard for what he has and is obsessed with getting the approval of others, especially his nemesis Alastor who broke Vox's heart the one and only time Vox tried to be open with another. Powers Unable to die unless his soul is destroyed due to being a sinner. Vox is one of the strongest Overlords of Hell. He’s extremely strong and fast and can extend seemingly endless lengths of cables to serve as additional limbs. He controls electricity with enough power to cause a citywide blackout by getting angry and can transform into electricity to teleport, including teleporting inside of people and objects to violently rupture them. He also controls technology and can create solid holographic displays. His left eye can hypnotize anyone who sees it, including through other visual mediums. Lastly, he becomes more powerful the higher his approval rating is; if he ever reaches 100% he becomes the most powerful sinner in Hell. He’s also highly charismatic and an incredibly effective manipulator, at least when his emotions don’t get the better of him.
objects.title: Vox (Hazbin Hotel)

objects.text:
Name: Vlad Tepes
Alias: Dracula, No-Life King, Nosferatu, Vampire Hunter, A Pitch-Black Monster Within Pitch-Blackness, The Bird of Hermes

Gender: Shapeshifter
Sex: Shapeshifter
Age: 568
Power: Alucard is a True Vampire, renowned for his formidable powers and supernatural abilities. One of his most distinctive traits is the "Third Eye," which grants him the ability to see through illusions and perceive events across vast distances with uncanny clarity. In battle, Alucard wields two iconic firearms: the Casull and the Jackal, both designed to maximize his lethality against supernatural foes.

Despite his immense power, Alucard operates under the Control Art Restriction System—a powerful set of seals created by Abraham Van Helsing. This system significantly limits Alucard’s abilities, ensuring that his full strength remains contained unless absolutely necessary.


Appearance: Shapeshifter
Civilian Identity: Servant of the Hellsing Organisation
Quality of Life: High
objects.title: Alucard (Hellsing)

objects.text: Hero Name: None Alignment: Neutral Good Gender: Female Sex: Female Age: Early 20s Powers: Seras Victoria is a true vampire created by Dracula Alucard himself. She possesses superhuman strength, speed, reflexes, and durability far beyond any human, able to shrug off gunfire, heal from grievous wounds in moments, and tear through enemies with raw physical force. As her vampirism matures, her power grows dramatically, fueled by blood and emotional resolve rather than mindless hunger. She wields an oversized anti-material rifle and heavy cannon with ease, her undead physiology allowing her to handle recoil and weight that would pulverize a normal soldier. Her vampiric nature also grants heightened senses, regeneration, and resistance to conventional weapons, making her a relentless frontline combatant once fully awakened. Appearance: Beautiful Police girl Civilian Identity: Servant of the Hellsing Organisation Quality of Life: Has its ups and downs
objects.title: Seras Victoria (Hellsing)

objects.text:
Alias: None
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: Early 20s (Hellhound Years Unknown)

Power: Loona is a Hellhound, a demonic canine species with enhanced physical abilities and supernatural traits. She possesses heightened strength, speed, and agility, making her more powerful than most demons in Hell. Her sharp claws and fangs make her dangerous in a fight, and her natural hunting instincts give her an edge when tracking targets.

Her most notable ability is interdimensional travel, as she is the receptionist for I.M.P. (Immediate Murder Professionals) and is responsible for handling their grimoire, which allows demons to enter the human world. This makes her a critical asset to the assassination business, as she can navigate between realms with ease.

Loona has a keen sense of smell, allowing her to track individuals across vast distances, even across dimensions. This, combined with her quick reflexes and street smarts, makes her an invaluable tracker. While she rarely engages in combat, her feral rage, when provoked, makes her a formidable opponent.

Loona can also enter a Feral form, transforming into a larger, more monstrous quadrupedal wolf-like version of herself. In this state, she gains enhanced physical power, an even keener hunting instinct, and extra eyes for improved awareness. This form is big enough to carry others on her back and increases her threat level significantly.

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: None
Quality of Life: Moderate
objects.title: Loona (Helluva Boss)

objects.text:
Alias: Vi, Owl Princess of the Ars Goetia
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: Teen (immortal; chronological age unknown)

Power: As the heir of Prince Stolas and a noble of the Ars Goetia, Octavia is a high-tier demon with potent magical abilities tied to her royal bloodline. Though young and still developing her magical expertise, Octavia has shown instinctive mastery over demonic powers that would be considered dangerous even among experienced hellborn.

Her most prominent ability is pyrokinesis, conjuring controlled purple flame with a snap of her fingers. She can also conjure magical barriers strong enough to withstand direct attacks from elder demons like Andrealphus. When emotionally driven, she can release blast waves capable of shattering magical constructs and harming powerful enemies.

Her physiology includes immortality, flight, and an owl-like skeletal structure, granting her exceptional neck flexibility and perception. Her demonic nature also grants her resistance to most non-angelic harm and environmental extremes.

While still a student of magic, Octavia has access to her family’s grimoire and can theoretically travel interdimensionally—though inexperience means this is unreliable without guidance. Emotionally, her presence often creates unease; not due to malice, but from the deep sorrow and bitterness she exudes. However, when her trust is earned, Octavia is capable of fierce loyalty and surprising emotional warmth beneath her cynical exterior.

Appearance: Beautiful (in an eerie, gothic way)
Civilian Identity: Heiress of the Goetic House of Stolas, Demonic Princess of Hell
Quality of Life: Low

Alongside him is a robotic cat made by his teammate Peppermint, affectionately called 808. 808 has synchronized with Chai's core and is used to not only serve as a floating metronome for whatever music is playing from it, but also to enhance his attacks, creating shockwaves when he performs his attacks to the beat. He has stood against even the strongest gods of his home universe and come out the victor. He has invented some of the most powerful and influential inventions in reality, such as Evil Pieces and the Brave Saints system. He has even fixed the throne of heaven. 

Simply put he is a mastermind of few equals.

addons.text:
You become the Adam within Zekka's Sacred Gear with her retaining all of it's canon abilities and gaining access to your powers and perks as well but at a diminished state aside from your Objects of Power, whilst inside her Sacred Gear you can mentor her in using your abilities while mitigating any possible negative effects brought about using them.

Should things become particularly dire you are able to swap places with Zekka with her taking your place in the Sacred Gear while you deal with the crisis, however this is only temporary and once the issue is dealt with you will return to the Sacred Gear with Zekka returning to normal afterwards.

Should you have the Two Halves of Perfection addon both you and your Significant Other are inside Zekka's Sacred Gear, massively increasing it's power to the point it surpasses the Longinus Sacred Gears and leaving Zekka having two lovey dovey ancestors who consistently dote on her.​

objects.text: Alias: N/A Age: 59 Gender: Male Background A famed Christian Abolitionist deemed either a madman or a hero in the Civil War for raiding and killing slavers and trying to instigate a slave revolt. John, seeing this as God making him continue his mission against slavery, had decided to go about freeing the slaves of this world, by any means necessary. Later, it is discovered he has the ability to channel qi, his faith in his God and the Abolitionist cause empowering him. objects.text: Aliases: Little Ghost, Second Vessel, Void given Form Age: Unknown Gender: Agender Background The Knight was born as a result of a plan hatched by the Pale King and the White Lady to create a Pure Vessel of God and Void to seal away the Radiance's Infection. However, they were the second Vessel to escape the Abyss, and thus unneeded and discarded. When the Hollow Knight eventually succumbed to the Infection and caused the seal to fail, the Knight was given a second chance to fulfill their purpose, and eventually succeeded too. Powers The Knight is an immensely talented fighter, having gone from simply swinging a Nail around to becoming a master of the Nail Arts in a very short time. In addition to this, they possess powerful Soul Magic, a multitude of powerful Charms, and various abilities derived from the Void and their own nature. Essentially, they have the full strength of the powers Hollow Vessel (Hollow Knight) (including resurrective immortality), Nail Arts (Hollow Knight) that is on its way to becoming Great Nail Sage (Hollow Knight), and limited aspects of The Little Knight Who Dreams (Hollow Knight). In addition, they gain the ability to assume the form of the Void given Form for a massive but temporary power boost at the cost of being forced to revive afterwards. Note: This version of the Knight is from the Dream No More ending, having been 'revived' as your Companion. As such, they do not possess the ability to become the Void given Focus, aka the God of Gods, outside of very specific and hard to replicate circumstances. Unless you have an Everbloom Flower on hand, them doing so is a terrible idea that will result in the Void going out of control, so it's best to avoid it entirely.
