objects.text: Alias: Rogue/Knight of Heart/Time, "Nepeta", "Dave", "Davesprite" Age: 16 (Homestuck Canon), Adult?? (Beyond Canon) Gender: Nonbinary Background Created from the components of Davesprite, a young time traveling kid from a doomed timeline who in order to save his friends became part bird, and Nepeta, a young troll who was randomly murdered when the Troll game session went downhill. They ended up accidentally merging due to Homestuck shennanigans. And now, they are one, and seemingly fully realized, with Davesprite's issues about being a "fake Dave" as compared to the main timeline Dave being dealt with by allowing him to no longer be a time based clone of sorts, while Nepeta finally gets saved from obscurity after her death left her lost and forgotten. Now their truest self, they are more determined than ever to forge their own path and to literally spit in the face of the embodiment of entropy. Powers It could be presumed that Davepeta inherited all of the skills their components once possessed. Despite this, they mostly use Nepeta's Claws in combat. Also, due to their biology, they are able to fly as well. Not to mention that due to the shennanigans that lead to their creation, they are also a Sprite, an entity in Homestuck that serves as a Tutorial Guide to the game's players of sorts, and due to this, is gifted with the knowledge of all of their alternate selves' memories all held into one head. Adding the fact that Nepeta is a Hero of Heart, a title given to folks with a strong affinity to their sense of self, then we have a well realized fighter in our hands. Finally, they also seem to be able to manifest themself into a SOUL like form like in the game Undertale, though the full ramifications of this power isn't well known. All in all, they are not only a formidable fighter, but also a great companion, capable of dispensing wisdom due to their multiversal knowledge.
objects.title: Davepeta (Homestuck)

objects.text: Aliases: Hua, Phoenix, Herrscher of Sentience Age: 50,000+ Gender: Female Background Fu Hua is a survivor of the Previous Era, a soldier who has fought the Honkai for over fifty thousand years. Through experimentation, she became a MANTIS, gaining immense power and functional immortality at the cost of her humanity. She witnessed the fall of her civilization and carried its legacy alone into the Current Era. Over time, she took on students in an attempt to preserve her teachings, but her rigid ideals and the weight of her experiences led to their eventual betrayal, leaving her isolated once more. In the modern era, she served under Otto Apocalypse, remaining loyal until his actions during the Herrscher crisis revealed his willingness to sacrifice others for his goals. When she opposed him, he killed her. However, using Fenghuang Down, she preserved her consciousness, binding her soul to Kiana to survive. Even after betrayal and death, Fu Hua continued to fight, guiding and protecting others from the shadows. Through her bond with Kiana and her growing connection to Mei and Bronya, she has begun to reconnect with the humanity she once set aside. Powers Fu Hua possesses MANTIS physiology, granting her immense strength, speed, durability, and extreme vitality, allowing her to recover from otherwise fatal injuries and persist through prolonged combat. She is a master martial artist with unparalleled skill and precision, utilizing refined techniques such as the Taixu Sword Art to channel internal energy into powerful strikes and construct weapons from intent. Through Fenghuang Down, she wields powerful mental and illusion-based abilities, allowing her to manipulate perception, influence cognition, create mental constructs, and project or bind consciousness. She also demonstrates limited elemental manipulation, reinforcing her combat techniques with fire and other energies. Her longevity and regenerative nature grant her functional immortality, shaped by over fifty thousand years of combat experience.
objects.title: Fu Hua (Honkai Impact 3rd)

objects.text: Aliases: Herrscher of Origin, Herrscher of Human: Ego, Flame-Chaser II Age: Unknown (50,000+ Simulation) Gender: Female Background Elysia is an anomaly among Herrschers, born in the Previous Era not as a corrupted human, but as a Herrscher who naturally loved humanity. Found as a mysterious child and raised in an orphanage, she chose to live as a human despite her nature, eventually joining MOTH and becoming one of its most important figures. She founded the Thirteen Flame-Chasers and stood as their unifying force, choosing the rank of second despite her strength to maintain balance within the group. Unlike all other Herrschers of her time, Elysia never turned against humanity, instead dedicating herself to protecting it while hiding her true identity. In the final days of the Previous Era, she revealed herself and sacrificed her life in a final act that altered the nature of the Honkai itself. Her death allowed future Herrschers to retain their sense of self, giving humanity a chance to fight back instead of being consumed. In the current era, she exists as a preserved consciousness within the Elysian Realm, guiding others and ensuring her will continues forward. Powers Elysia possesses Herrscher and MANTIS physiology, granting enhanced physical capabilities, resilience, and combat adaptability. As the Herrscher of Origin and Human: Ego, her power is tied to individuality and the persistence of self, allowing her to influence the nature of Honkai energy and resist external control or mental interference. She primarily fights through crystallokinesis, creating and manipulating crystalline constructs for offense and defense, including projectiles, barriers, and delayed formations. Elysia is highly proficient with multiple weapons, especially her bow, but is capable of adapting to a wide range of combat styles. Her existence carries a unique anomaly, placing her outside conventional fate or prediction, making her actions difficult to foresee or constrain.
objects.title: Elysia (Honkai Impact 3rd)

objects.text: Aliases: K-423, Herrscher of the Void, Herrscher of Flamescion, Herrscher of Finality Age: 18 (Chronologically) Gender: Female Background Kiana Kaslana was never meant to exist. Created as clone K-423 by Otto Apocalypse using the DNA of the original Kiana and the Herrscher Sirin’s core, she was intended to serve as a vessel for a reborn god. Unlike the many failed attempts before her, she developed her own will. Rescued by Siegfried Kaslana, she was raised in isolation. Though he provided for her, grief kept him distant, and Kiana grew up longing to be acknowledged. That changed when she risked her life to protect him from a Honkai beast, earning both his recognition and the Kaslana name, along with their shared oath to fight for what is beautiful. After Siegfried disappeared, she wandered in search of him before eventually meeting Raiden Mei. Through their bond, Kiana found someone who chose her. Even when Mei became the Herrscher of Thunder, Kiana refused to abandon her. As the Herrscher of the Void awakened within her, Kiana was forced to confront her origins. In the end, she chose to define herself not by what she was made to be, but by what she fights to protect. Powers Kiana possesses Herrscher physiology, granting her greatly enhanced strength, speed, durability, and combat adaptability, alongside high proficiency in hand-to-hand combat, firearms, and swordsmanship. As the Herrscher of the Void, she controls space, allowing her to create portals, distort distance, form spatial constructs, and launch attacks that bypass conventional defenses, granting exceptional mobility and battlefield control. As the Herrscher of Flamescion, she gains authority over fire, significantly increasing her offensive power and enhancing her close-range combat. As the Herrscher of Finality, she wields the combined authority of all Herrschers, including control over time, space, and Honkai phenomena. She can manipulate or halt time, reshape reality through Honkai authority, control Imaginary Space, and generate or command vast numbers of Honkai constructs and entities.
objects.title: Kiana Kaslana (Honkai Impact 3rd)

objects.text: Aliases: Herrscher of Thunder, Herrscher of Origin Age: 19 Gender: Female Background Raiden Mei was once the daughter of a powerful corporate figure, living a life of comfort and privilege. That life collapsed when her father was falsely accused and imprisoned, stripping her of everything. Abandoned by those who once surrounded her, Mei was left isolated and struggling to survive, learning harshly that most of her former relationships had been built on status rather than sincerity. Burdened by loneliness and the unstable power sealed within her, Mei’s life changed when she met Kiana Kaslana. Despite Mei’s circumstances and the rumors surrounding her, Kiana treated her without hesitation or judgment. Through that bond, Mei found genuine connection and a reason to keep moving forward. That fragile peace shattered when the Honkai awakened within her, triggering her transformation into the Herrscher of Thunder. Overwhelmed by destructive power and a second, more violent self, Mei nearly lost everything. Even so, Kiana refused to abandon her, pulling her back from the brink. From that moment on, Mei chose to move forward not as someone defined by loss or anger, but as someone who fights to protect the people she cares about, even at great personal cost. Powers Mei possesses Herrscher physiology, granting her enhanced strength, speed, durability, and combat awareness, combined with high-level swordsmanship and disciplined martial skill. As the Herrscher of Thunder, she controls lightning and electromagnetic forces, allowing her to unleash powerful electrical attacks, move at extreme speeds, and augment her strikes with high-voltage energy capable of overwhelming opponents. As the Herrscher of Origin, her power evolves into a more conceptual authority centered on severing. She can cut through space, energy, and even abstract connections, allowing her to bypass defenses, negate durability, and disrupt or sever targets from their power sources. Her abilities extend to limited spatial disruption and high-speed combat, and she can summon the Honkai beast Kurikara to assist her in battle.
objects.title: Raiden Mei (Honkai Impact 3rd)

objects.text: Aliases: Silver Wolf of the Urals, Herrscher of Reason, Herrscher of Truth Age: 18 Gender: Female Background Bronya Zaychik was raised as a weapon. Taken in by criminal organizations at a young age, she was trained as a child soldier, specializing in assassination and marksmanship. Her life changed after a failed mission against Cocolia led to her being taken into the orphanage instead, where she formed a deep bond with Seele Vollerei. Her talent and adaptability led her to undergo the Project X-10 experiment, an attempt to interface the human mind with Honkai energy. The result left her emotionally numb and unable to walk, forcing her to rely on logic and her mechanical companion, Project Bunny, to function. Despite this, Bronya continued forward, eventually being sent to infiltrate Raiden Mei. Instead, she formed genuine connections with Mei and Kiana Kaslana, finding a place where she was accepted not as a tool, but as a person. During her journey, Bronya inherited the power of the Herrscher of Reason, restoring her body and allowing her to feel again. She later evolved into the Herrscher of Truth, overcoming her limitations and choosing her own path to protect those she cares about. Powers Bronya possesses Herrscher physiology, granting enhanced physical capabilities alongside exceptional intelligence, tactical processing, and advanced hacking ability. She is proficient in firearms, stealth, and precision combat, often fighting in coordination with her support systems. As the Herrscher of Reason, she can materialize and reconstruct objects, weapons, and technology based on her understanding, effectively turning knowledge into physical constructs. She also has access to vast inherited knowledge, allowing rapid analysis and adaptation in combat. As the Herrscher of Truth, her abilities expand beyond prior limitations, allowing her to create complex or advanced technology without requiring full personal understanding, enabling large-scale weapon systems, drones, and mechanized constructs. She is supported by Project Bunny, a highly adaptable combat unit that enhances her offensive and defensive capabilities.
objects.title: Bronya Zaychik (Honkai Impact 3rd)

objects.text:
Alignment: True Neutral
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: ??? (Appears as a young girl, actual age unknown)

Power: Herta is a mechanical genius with a deep understanding of technology and artificial intelligence. She primarily interacts with the world through autonomous puppets modeled after her younger self, each possessing enhanced strength, durability, and processing capabilities. These puppets allow her to operate remotely, acting as both her eyes and hands while she remains in a secure location. She has an exceptional ability to analyze and optimize machinery, swiftly identifying flaws and improving efficiency in technology.

Appearance: A doll-like girl with pale blue hair, striking red eyes, and a perpetually unimpressed expression.

Civilian Identity: Herta exists primarily through her puppets, rarely interacting in person. She is known in technological and scientific circles as a prodigy who contributes to major advancements but prefers to remain in the background.

Quality of Life: High (Respected Scholar, Near-Immortality via Puppets).

Instead of her standard Puppeteer build, Herta can be taken as Madam Herta, who embodies an eccentric yet powerful combat style. This version of her harnesses energy-based abilities, allowing her to launch ranged magical attacks, alter gravitational forces around herself, and manipulate matter on a small scale. She retains her calculating nature but adopts a more theatrical and whimsical approach to combat, often making dramatic poses and over-the-top declarations.
objects.title: Herta (Honkai: StarRail)

objects.text: Aliases: Raiden Bosenmori Mei, Emanator of Nihility, Self-Annihilator Age: Unknown Gender: Female Background Acheron is a wanderer shaped by Nihility, originating from the fallen world of Izumo. Once a warrior who fought to protect her home, she was driven to the brink as her world was consumed by endless conflict and the encroaching shadow of the Aeon IX. In the end, she forged a final blade by sacrificing what remained of her past, using it to sever the fate of her world entirely. In doing so, she erased both its future and its suffering, but at the cost of becoming something no longer fully human. Now a Self-Annihilator and Emanator of Nihility, Acheron exists in a state between presence and absence. Her memories fade, her senses dull, and her connection to reality weakens over time. Despite this, she continues to travel the cosmos, guided by fragments of emotion and a quiet purpose to witness, remember, and mourn what has been lost. Powers Acheron, as an Emanator of Nihility, wields power on a conceptual level, allowing her to erase targets by severing their existence rather than simply destroying them. Her attacks can cut through space, time, and causality, bypassing defenses and nullifying phenomena by returning them to nothing. She can create localized distortions where time ceases to flow or reality fractures, isolating targets within controlled domains. Her nature as a Self-Annihilator grants her extreme survivability, allowing her to persist beyond conventional life and death, reforming even after otherwise fatal damage. Acheron exists outside conventional fate and perception, making her difficult to predict, track, or influence through mental or temporal means. She is a master swordswoman, capable of defeating high-level threats with minimal effort, often striking with speed and precision that borders on instantaneous.
objects.title: Acheron (Honkai: StarRail)

objects.text: Alias: Ultimate Conductor Age: Unknown Gender: Pom-Pom Background Pom-Pom is the conductor (and mascot) of the Astral Express. Though their origin is unknown, having appeared on the train after it was repaired, it is implied they are a creation of the Aeon Akivili. As a companion to the innumerable Nameless that once called the train their home, they are a living witness to the glorious age of Trailblaze. Powers Pom-Pom is a diligent and meticulous companion, making sure the Parlor Car is always clean, cooking and organizing storage for the crew, and notifying all passengers when the Express is about to warp jump. They can be surprisingly wise and knowledgeable, able to help you break through at critical moments of growth. Besides that they do not have any special powers.
objects.title: Pom-Pom (Honkai: Star Rail)

objects.text:
Name: Aloy
Hero Name: None
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: 19

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: Nora Brave 
Quality of Life: Ok (Loving father, outcast)
Power: Peak Human, Skilled Hunter

Aloy is incredibly physically gifted, capable of physically overpowering enemies much larger than herself, utilizing a heavy draw bow power in quick succession, lift massive machine parts, and is incredibly agile and quick, capable of climbing and traversing vast landscapes in almost any direction without much effort. 

She’s incredibly intelligent, and an incredibly skilled fighter and hunter capable of overcoming hordes of humans and army fighting machines on her own without much issue. She uses a variety of equipment, from primitive bow and arrows, to elemental bombs, to futuristic armor and to the powerful focus that allows her to analyze almost anything.
objects.title: Aloy (Horizon Zero Dawn)

objects.text:
Hero Name: The Mockingjay 
Alignment: Chaotic Good
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: 18
Power: Katniss is an expert archer and experienced hunter. She has keen survival instincts, excels at tracking and foraging, and possesses impressive stealth skills. Her determination and leadership inspired others to resist oppression and fight for freedom.

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: Hunter
Quality of Life: Bad
objects.title: Katniss Everdeen (Hunger Games)

objects.text: Alias: Chain User, Rat Age: 19 Gender: Male Background Kurapika's the sole survivor of the Kurta Clan, who were massacred by the Phantom Troupe for their prized scarlet eyes, leading him to dedicate his life to retrieving the stolen eyes of his people and killing the Phantom Troupe, even if it kills him. He is both determined and disciplined, letting him succeed where most fail. Powers Kurapika is a Nen user specialized in Conjuration with his Hatsu being a chain that he can use to restrain, heal, track, and judge opponents. When his Scarlet Eyes activate, he enters Emperor Time, granting perfect efficiency with all Nen categories at the cost of his lifespan. When fighting a member of the Phantom Troupe, his capabilities are dramatically enhanced. In addition to being highly intelligent, skilled in investigation, and an experienced strategist, he is capable of unlocking and teaching people to use Nen. Warning Though normally calm and polite, he will gladly sacrifice his wellbeing for a chance to avenge his people. Note While he can unlock your Nen and teach you to use it, you cannot choose your Nen type, as it is loosely based on personality.
objects.title: Kurapika (Hunter x Hunter)

objects.text: Aliases: Rick, The Ice Cream Man Age: 13.8 Billion+ Gender: Male Background Rick is one of two survivors of a previous universe. He is the embodiment of the idea that “everything is lots of little things”: life is pointless and miserable, and no one and nothing is going to help you. He has dedicated himself to spreading suffering and nihilism since before the last universe ended, and is responsible for many of the worst things in life, ranging from massacres and torture to earworms and embarassing memories. He covers up his cruelty (barely) with the veneer of politeness and joviality, though it goes away quickly when he runs into an actual problem. He has a particular affinity for insects, especially spiders. Powers Being a “subliminal fae-influenced demigod made of raw negativistic thought”, Rick’s powers are vast, allowing him to create monsters, manipulate minds, and even manipulate reality to a degree, allowing him to create bizarre and nightmarish scenarios to torment people. Rick is immortal and will outlive the universe itself. He’s also capable of breaking the fourth wall.
objects.title: Riccardus (Ice Cream Man)

objects.text:
Alias: Fetch
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: Early 20s

Power: Fetch is a Conduit with mastery over Neon Manipulation, allowing her to harness and control energy-based light particles. She can run at immense speeds, leaving behind a glowing neon trail, scale walls, dodge attacks, and move faster than the eye can track. She can fire rapid energy blasts from her hands, capable of stunning or outright incapacitating enemies, and unleash a powerful, concentrated beam of energy that can pierce through multiple enemies or destroy obstacles.

At the peak of her abilities, she can create a devastating vortex of neon energy, pulling in and obliterating everything in its radius. Her connection to neon enhances her reaction time, allowing her to dodge bullets, leap great distances, and navigate terrain effortlessly. She can create neon constructs that allow her to swing across buildings or use them for quick mobility, and she can absorb neon from signs, streetlights, and other sources to replenish her energy reserves.

Her combat skills are sharp due to her time fighting off D.U.P. soldiers and criminals in Seattle. In addition to her powers, Fetch is an experienced street fighter, capable of handling herself in close-quarters combat.

Appearance: Attractive
Civilian Identity: Former drug addict turned vigilante. Officially, she's a fugitive Conduit, hunted by the government for her abilities. 
Quality of Life: Poor to Moderate
objects.title: Abigail Walker (inFAMOUS: First Light)

objects.text:
Hero Name: Omni-Man
Alignment: Lawful Good?
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: 2000+
Power: A master manipulator, fighter, and soldier, Nolan has served the Viltrum Empire most of his life subjugating many planets and conquering galaxies. Nolan has all the customary abilities of a Viltrumite, especially one as aged as him with superhuman strength, nigh-invulnerability, speed, flight, and enhanced regeneration, each more developed or powerful than a common Viltrumite.
Appearance: Handsome
Civilian Identity: Nolan Grayson
Quality of Life: Poor (Betrayed his home planet and earth; made enemies of all his former friends and is being hunted down by his empire for treason; family doesn’t trust him.
objects.title: Nolan (Invincible)

objects.text:
Hero Name: Rex Splode
Alignment: Chaotic Good
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: 19
Power: Able to generate energy and infuse objects with it, causing them to explode, the strength of these explosions seems to be proportional to the size and density of the object he is infusing, for example: charging his entire skeleton in a suicide attack allowed him to kill an alternate version of Invincible, who is a Viltrumite; on top of this Rex is able to operate even when under a lot of pain and extremely injured, for example: getting his hand cut off and shot in the head, only to get up and stab his assailant in the face with the points of his radius and ulna.
Appearance: Handsome
Civilian Identity: full time hero
Quality of Life: Okay (has friends and a girlfriend, but was essentially sold to the government by his parents)
objects.title: Rex Sloan (Invincible)

objects.text:
Hero Name: Atom Eve
Alignment: Neutral Good
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: 18

Power: Eve possesses Subatokinesis, the ability to manipulate matter at the molecular and sub-molecular levels, allowing her to reshape, repair, and create objects or elements from virtually anything. Her powers also include flight, energy projection, and self-healing, making her one of the most versatile and powerful hero’s of her home universe. However, her abilities are limited by her focus and emotional state, as they require intense concentration to use effectively. In times of extreme emotional stress she can also manipulate biological life making her nearly limitless in potential and influence. 

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: College Student 
Quality of Life: It has its ups and downs (occasionally has a normal life between fighting for her life and the lives of others)
objects.title: Samantha Eve Wilkins (Invincible)

objects.text: Alias: Conquest Age: Several thousand years old Gender: Male Background Conquest isn't actually the name he was born with. His original name has long since been forgotten, replaced by a title given to him by the Viltrumite Empire because conquest was all he was ever used for. Sent from world to world to crush resistance and enforce Viltrumite rule, he eventually embraced the identity completely, becoming a vicious, sadistic individual who genuinely enjoys violence and domination. Powers Conquest possesses the immense strength, durability, speed, stamina, flight, senses, and healing factor of an exceptionally powerful Viltrumite. He can survive devastating impacts, extreme environments, atmospheric reentry, and injuries that would kill ordinary beings, while continuing to fight with little concern for his own safety. His thousands of years of experience have also made him an exceptionally skilled and ruthless combatant, capable of adapting to unfamiliar powers and exploiting weaknesses with brutal efficiency.
objects.title: Conquest (Invincible)

objects.text: Age: 20 Gender Female Background At the young age of 11, Kotoko Iwanaga was abducted by yokai for two weeks and asked to become their "Goddess of Wisdom," a mediator between the spirit and human worlds. The girl quickly agreed, but at the cost of her right eye and left leg. As the Goddess of Wisdom, she often arbitrates disputes or advises yokai whenever they have issues. Over her years of service, she has successfully resolved countless disputes and mysteries throughout the supernatural world. Using her wit and deductive skills, she has solved countless problems for both humans and yokai across Japan. Powers Despite being titled a "Goddess," she is still physically just a petite twenty-year-old woman with an artificial eye and leg. Her being a "Goddess of Wisdom" naturally earns her respect and reverence from yokai and other supernatural beings. More often than not, a yokai will listen to her and agree to her requests. However, her title does not compel obedience, and yokai or other supernatural beings can refuse to listen to her. Her true and most powerful ability is her wisdom. Kotoko Iwanaga possesses incredible intelligence and deductive skills. Combined with years of dealing with the supernatural, she is a veteran detective skilled at analyzing cases and figuring out solutions. She is also a convincing speaker, and through creative thinking and carefully constructed lies, she has successfully tricked countless people into accepting her "truthful" logic.
objects.title: Kotoko Iwanaga (In/Spectre)

objects.text: Alias: Jojo Age: 20 Years Old Gender: Male Background Jonathan Joestar is a Gentleman and warrior born to the Joestar family in the 1800's. Growing up without a mother, and with a simply evil boy for an adopted brother, Jonathan turned out to have a truly pure heart despite the odds. However, tragedy and horror would strike his life many times, culminating in said adopted brother Dio Brando becoming a vampire, his father dying, and needing to kill said adopted brother... Powers Jonathan is a very powerful and intelligent human being, capable of ripping steel bars 3 times over, being able to kick men high into the air, and survive a multiple story fall in a firey building as well as an explosion sending him out of said building. He is also skilled in the use of Hamon, an art that utilizes the wavelengths of the sun to destroy Vampires and allow for major versatility, like healing, hypnotism, and manipulating the body in small ways.
objects.title: Jonathan Joestar (Jojo's Bizarre Adventure)

objects.text: Aliases: Josef Joestar, JoJo Age: 67 Gender: Male Background Joseph Joestar is the grandson of Jonathan Joestar and the second primary JoJo of the Joestar bloodline. Unlike his noble and gentlemanly grandfather, Joseph grew up as a loudmouthed, cunning delinquent with a habit of cheating, provoking, and outsmarting his opponents rather than facing them directly. Despite his immature behaviour, he inherited Jonathan’s strong sense of justice and willingness to risk his life for others. After becoming involved with the ancient beings known as the Pillar Men, Joseph was trained in the martial art known as Hamon by his mother, Lisa Lisa. Through his wit, unpredictability, and sheer luck, Joseph fought against enemies far stronger than himself and eventually became one of the greatest Hamon users of his era. Years later, after the return of DIO, Joseph awakened a Stand known as Hermit Purple and aided Jotaro Kujo and his allies in their journey to Egypt. Despite becoming older and calmer with age, Joseph retained his sarcastic personality, tendency for dramatic antics, and bizarre luck even into old age. Powers Joseph Joestar is a master of Hamon, a martial art that channels life energy through breathing techniques. Joseph can conduct Hamon through objects such as ropes, scarves, metal, and even liquids, allowing him to attack indirectly, set traps, or enhance his strikes. Joseph is also a Stand User, capable of manifesting the Stand Hermit Purple. Hermit Purple takes the form of thorn-covered vines which allow Joseph to perform spirit photography, track people and objects, create psychic maps, swing across terrain, restrain opponents, and channel Hamon through the Stand itself. Unlike most fighters, even with his Hamon enhanced physique, Joseph relies heavily on deception, psychological tricks, and improvisation during battle. He is infamous for predicting his opponent's next line before they say it, often throwing enemies off balance mentally.
objects.title: Joseph Joestar (JoJo's Bizarre Adventure)

objects.text: Aliases: Qutaro Kujo, JoJo Age: 17 Gender: Male Background Jotaro Kujo is among the noble line of Joestars; the grandson of Joseph Joestar, and the Great-Great Grandson of Jonathan Joestar. Growing up a Delinquent, he had quite a number of both hospital victims, and unrequited love interests. One day however, in a fight with multiple people, he found himself almost killing them while going untouched. A short time later, after his grandfather came to get him out, he discovered the source was not an angry ghost, as previously thought by Kujo, but a Stand known soon after as Star Platinum.. Powers Jotaro Kujo is a stand user, capable of manifesting the stand Star Platinum. Star Platinum's base stats are that of a physical powerhouse, allowing it to bend steel bars, pummel through diamond-hard rock like nothing, and move at the speed of light. Alongside that Star Platinum possesses special abilities, such as stretching its fingers out like a rapier, sucking in tremendous amounts of air and most importantly the ability to stop time for 5 seconds. He also is quite physically intimidating on his own, able to beat up multiple men in a fight, and even a full grown one as a 7 year old child.
objects.title: Jotaro Kujo (JoJo's Bizarre Adventure)

objects.text: Aliases: Higashikata Josuke, JoJo Age: 16 Gender: Male Background Josuke Higashikata is the illegitimate son of Joseph Joestar and the fourth primary JoJo of the Joestar bloodline. Growing up in the town of Morioh, Josuke became a kind-hearted but hot-blooded delinquent with a strong sense of loyalty toward his friends and community. After meeting Jotaro Kujo, Josuke discovered his connection to the Joestar family and became involved in the growing threat of enemy Stand Users within Morioh, eventually helping protect the town from criminals and supernatural threats. Powers Josuke Higashikata is a Stand User, capable of manifesting the Stand Crazy Diamond. Crazy Diamond possesses immense strength and speed, allowing it to overwhelm most opponents in close combat with rapid punches. Crazy Diamond’s primary ability is restoration. It can repair damaged objects, heal injuries, reconstruct shattered materials, and restore objects or people to a previous state, though the ability does not work on himself. Josuke frequently uses this ability creatively during battle, repairing terrain, redirecting attacks, or trapping enemies.
objects.title: Josuke Higashikata (JoJo's Bizarre Adventure)

objects.text: Aliases: GioGio Age: 15 Gender: Male Background Giorno Giovanna is the son of DIO, conceived using Jonathan Joestar’s stolen body, making him both a descendant of the Joestar bloodline and the son of one of its greatest enemies. Growing up in Italy under abusive conditions, Giorno developed a dream of becoming a “Gang-Star” capable of reforming the mafia from within. After joining the organization Passione under Bruno Bucciarati, Giorno became involved in a violent struggle against rival Stand Users and the organization’s Boss. Powers Giorno Giovanna is a Stand User, capable of manifesting the Stand Gold Experience. Gold Experience possesses impressive speed, strength, and precision, making it highly effective in close combat. Gold Experience’s primary ability is the creation and manipulation of life. Giorno can transform objects into living organisms, heal injuries by creating replacement body parts, and overload opponents’ senses through direct attacks. Giorno frequently uses these abilities creatively for healing, deception, tracking, and battlefield control.
objects.title: Giorno Giovanna (JoJo's Bizarre Adventure)

objects.text: Aliases: Jolyne Cujoh, JoJo, Chorokichi Age: 19 Gender: Female Background Jolyne Cujoh is the daughter of Jotaro Kujo and the sixth primary JoJo of the Joestar bloodline. Growing up with an absent father due to his battles against enemy Stand Users, Jolyne developed into a rebellious and short-tempered delinquent. After being falsely accused of murder and imprisoned in Green Dolphin Street Prison, Jolyne discovered her Stand abilities and became entangled in a conspiracy connected to DIO and one of his remaining followers, Enrico Pucci. Alongside her allies, Jolyne fought against numerous enemy Stand Users while attempting to stop Pucci’s plans and protect her father. Powers Jolyne Cujoh is a Stand User, capable of manifesting the Stand Stone Free. Stone Free possesses considerable strength, speed, and precision, allowing Jolyne to fight effectively in close combat through rapid punches and physical attacks. Stone Free’s primary ability allows Jolyne to unravel her body into string. She can use these strings for mobility, binding enemies, stitching wounds, setting traps, transmitting vibrations, and unravelling parts of herself to avoid damage or detect distant movements. Jolyne frequently uses her Stand creatively and strategically during battle, adapting quickly to dangerous situations. Despite her rough personality and delinquent tendencies, Jolyne is highly determined, courageous, and willing to risk her life to protect the people she cares about.
objects.title: Jolyne Kujo (JoJo's Bizarre Adventure)

objects.text: Alias: Jojo, Joe Kidd, Jonathan Joestar (Birth name) Age: 20 Years Old Gender: Male Background Johnny Joestar was a young boy who was an up and comer in the Jockey world. However, many events like the death of his brother, estrangement of his father, AND being crippled by someone simply waiting in line for a show that Johnny cut in front of, Johnny would find himself at the very bottom of the world and try to, as he'd put it, "Get back to 0." Through the events of the Steel Ball run in 1890, through joy and tragedy, he would develop into a man that could walk once more, in more ways than one. Powers Johnny is a fairly skilled marksman, able to hit a target about 10 meters away. In particular, this is due to his ability to use Spin. Spin is the manipulation of energy created by the near-perfect rotation of an object. Johnny utilizes this via his stand, Tusk. Tusk allows Johnny to shoot his nails using spin, from both his fingers, AND his toes. He can also use his nails in ways such as brushing his teeth, eating spaghetti, and grating cheese. Depending on the act he uses, he can do different things with his nails, from Act 1 being limited to a weaker shot with shorter reload time, Act 2 being given a drilling property that causes missed shots to make the holes it causes go after the intended target's vitals, to act 3 which lets Johnny shoot himself and teleport through the holes he shoots and reposition himself. Note: This version of Johnny does not have Act 4.
objects.title: Johnny Joestar (JoJo's Bizarre Adventure)

objects.text:
Name: Sun Wukong
Titles: Stone Monkey, Handsome Monkey-King, Victorious Fighting Buddha, Intelligent Stone Monkey, Great Sage Heaven's Equal

Gender: Male
Sex: Shapeshifter
Age: Immortal
Power: Sun Wukong is famed for his many forms of immortality, making him virtually indestructible. He possesses immense superhuman strength and wields the magical Ruyi Jingu Bang staff, which can change size at will. Gifted with Fiery Golden Eyes, he can see through any illusion. His abilities also include the 72 Earthly Transformations, allowing shapeshifting and duplication, cloud somersaults for rapid travel, invisibility, weather control, and a wide array of powerful magical feats.

Appearance: Shapeshifter (Normally a monkey)
Quality of Life: It has it's ups and downs
objects.title: Monkey King (Journey to the West)

objects.text:
Title: The Explosive Clown
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: Early 30s

Power: Ozob is a mercenary replicant with advanced combat skills and expertise in explosives. His body is enhanced with cybernetic implants, giving him superior strength, reflexes, and durability. Ozob's most iconic feature is the live grenade embedded in place of his nose, which he can use as a last-resort weapon. He is an unpredictable and highly dangerous opponent, with an affinity for chaos and destruction.

Appearance: Scarred 
Civilian Identity: None
Quality of Life: Average (Ozob lives a life of constant danger and violence as a mercenary in a dystopian, cyberpunk world. His personality and actions often alienate others, leaving him isolated. However, his resourcefulness and cunning keep him alive and thriving in chaos.)

Note: Ozob is known for his dark humor and sharp wit, often using his sarcasm and banter to mask deeper personal scars. His violent nature and lack of hesitation to use deadly force make him both a valuable ally and a perilous adversary.
objects.title: Ozob (Jovem Nerd Cyberpunk RPG)

addons.text: "Sukuna... Let's try it one more time. Living not by cursing someone, but by existing alongside them." In a twist of fate almost too good to be true, Yuji Itadori and Ryomen Sukuna, two sides of the same coin with opposing ideologies, have reached a consensus. After the King of Curses was defeated, he grew curious over the turn of events, setting all his rage and wounded pride to side to properly analyze what Yuji tried to show and tell him, and acknowledged the faults in his own worldview with newfound clarity. This time, Sukuna chose to be caged with Yuji again, and their bond has grown into something akin to how he treated Ururame. This bond will only grow overtime until Sukuna becomes comfortable with assisting Yuji in his endeavors and comes to have an appreciation for life, instead of only seeking to destroy it and revel in its pleasures. By the events of Modulo, or even sooner, the pair would develop a true Nephew and Uncle bond, and their combined strength easily places them into a class of their own beyond "The Strongest".
addons.title: You are Me

objects.text: Age: 16-80+ Gender: Male Background A once normal highschool student who have his life radically changed the day his grandfather died and consuming Sukuna's finger, becoming a vessel for him. He would then dedicate his life to consuming all twenty of Sukuna's fingers before execution, alongside being plunged into the world of Jujutsu and Curses. After many trails and events, he would defeat Sukuna and begin changing the world of Jujutsu for the better. Power Yuji is a Special Grade Sorcerer of immense talent, even before he knew about Cursed Energy by already shattering world records with natural born physicality and mastery of unarmed combat. After learning how to control his Cursed Energy, he's gained several abilities. Divergent Fist to create a second impact after an initial strike by delaying his Cursed Energy; Blood Manipulation for a variety of long range attacks; Shrine to cut objects he touches into several pieces; Dismantle to fire an invisible high-speed slash capable of levelling buildings; Reversed Cursed Technique to heal himself from injuries; Simple Domain and Domain Expansion. He is also incredibly proficent at landing Black Flashes, to the point of doing it at will in his later years. Which amplify the power of his strikes by the power of 2.5.
objects.title: Yuji Itadori (Jujutsu Kaisen)

objects.text: Age: 16 Gender: Male Background A once orphaned young man who was adopted by Satoru Gojo, becoming his first student. He would train in Jujutsu for several years for the sake of his sister, Tsumiki. Later, he would meet Yuji Itadori on a mission to recover Sukuna's finger, sparking a long chain of events for the pair. Power Megumi is a Grade 2 Sorcerer who uses his intellect and skill in unarmed combat in fights. His Cursed Technique, The Ten Shadows, allows him to summon multiple shikigami to fight alongside him and can store objects within shadows as an inventory or for stealth. With several options like Divine Dogs, Max Elephant, Rabbit Escape, Nue, and Mahorago to name a few. All with their own unique abilities he can utilize. His Domain Expansion, Black Chimera Shadow Garden, floods the area with fluid shadows that allows him to summon any and all tamed Shikigami as well as produce clones of himself made of shadow. Although his domain is still incomplete and may develop additional features with time.
objects.title: Megumi Fushiguro (Jujutsu Kaisen)

objects.text:
Hero Name: N/A
Gender: Feminine  
Sex: Female  
Age: 16
Appearance: Attractive 
Civilian Identity: High School Student 
Quality of Life: Good 

Power: (Cursed Energy Manipulation, Cursed Technique, Enhanced Physical Ability )
objects.title: Nobara Kugisaki (Jujutsu Kaisen)

objects.text:
Hero Name: The Strongest Sorcerer  
Gender: Masculine  
Sex: Male  
Age: 28
Appearance: Handsome Masculine 
Civilian Identity: High School Teacher 
Quality of Life: Good (enjoys life with a playful and confident demeanor, though often burdened by the responsibilities of his power)

Power: (Cursed Energy Manipulation, Reversed Cursed Energy Manipulation, Limitless, Six Eyes, Domain Expansion, Powerful Physical Ability) 

Is the most powerful sorcerer in modern history, possessing his family’s famed Six Eyes and Limitless Cursed Technique, with no equal among his contemporaries or any sorcerers in history except for Ryomen Sukuna.
objects.title: Satoru Gojo (Jujutsu Kaisen)

objects.text: Gender: Male Age: 17-27 Background Once a top student of Jujutsu Tech, Geto would dedicate his life to exorcising Cursed Spirits for the sake of protecting non-sorcerers alongside his friend, Satoru Gojo. Things took a turn after the events of one mission, making him spiral into a breakdown of hating non-sorcerers, separating from his friends, and creating a world with only Jujutsu Sorcerers. Power A Special Grade Sorcerer equal in power to Satoru Gojo, with mastery of unarmed combat, a strategic intellect, and powerful physical abilities. His Cursed Technique, Cursed Spirit Manipulation, allows him to summon and manipulate the powers of Cursed Spirits, giving him an ocean of various abilities to draw on, and is extremely effective at using them. Once he defeats a Cursed Spirit (or something similar), he can devour it as an orb that adds them to his already vast repertoire.
objects.title: Suguru Geto (Jujutsu Kaisen)

objects.text: Alias: The King of Curses, The Disgraced One, Strongest Sorcerer in History, and many others Gender: Male Age: 1000+ Background Born in the Heian Era, Sukuna made a name for himself by becoming the Strongest Jujutsu Sorcerer in history, fueled by his childhood of being treated poorly for his deformed appearance. During his reign, he remained undefeated in the Golden Era of Jujutsu. Before his death, he made a deal with Kenjaku to be reborn in the modern era, leading to Yuji Itadori consuming one of his fingers. Power Sukuna is an unparalleled master at manipulating Cursed Energy, to the point of understanding it at such a deep level that he's able to perform the impossible and adapt to new obstacles within mere moments. He has several Cursed Techniques; Cleave as a multicutting slash that can chip away at nearly anything, while adjusting itself based on the target’s constitution; Spiderweb as a variant of Cleave that covers a wide area; Dismantle as an invisible high-speed slash that's nigh impossible to dodge; World Cutting Slash to cut space itself at impossible speeds; Divine Flame as an arrow of fire that can casually blow up city blocks. His Domain Expansion, Malevolent Shrine, is an extension of Dismantle, implanting its effects onto the world around him several times over. He is also a master at using Binding Vows to his advantage. Note You can choose to receive Sukuna in his true form from the Heian Era, in an incarnated body, or to receive all twenty of his fingers.
objects.title: Ryomen Sukuna (Jujutsu Kaisen)

objects.text:
Alignment: Chaotic Neutral
Gender: Male 
Sex: Male 
Age: 18

Power: Todo is a Grade 1 Sorcerer with immense physical prowess and unarmed combat mastery. He can further reinforce his already great strength and speed with cursed energy. 

His Cursed Technique, Boogie Woogie, allows him to swap places of two objects (including living beings) that contain a sufficient amount of cursed energy.

Appearance: Scarred
Civilian Identity: Kyoto Jujutsu High Student
Quality of Life: Good.
objects.title: Aoi Todo (Jujutsu Kaisen)

objects.text:
Alias: 7:3 Sorcerer
Alignment: Neutral Good
Gender: Male 
Sex: Male 
Age: 28

Power: Nanami is a  Grade 1 Sorcerer with immense physical prowess, armed and unarmed combat mastery, durability, and tactical precision. He can further reinforce his body with Cursed Energy with cursed energy. When he's on the battlefield for long enough, he enters Overtime, a self-imposed Binding Vow that amplifies his already potent abilities even higher. 

His cursed technique, "Ratio", allows him to create weak points on his target by mentally dividing any part of the target's body in a 7:3 ratio and then striking the spot at exactly the correct spot.

Appearance: Average
Civilian Identity: Tokyo Jujutsu High Teacher
Quality of Life: It has Its Ups and Downs
objects.title: Kento Nanami (Jujutsu Kaisen)

addons.text:
Through some miracle, you’ve removed the binding vow placed on the “disgraced” Zenin sisters and replaced it with new powers instead. They can be powers you possess or entirely new ones tailored to them. Whether it's the equivalent of both gaining Maki’s or Toji’s Heavenly Restriction, a new Cursed Technique, a Domain Expansion, or a power from a different universe the result is the same. 

Both now have their own separate abilities that can grow and improve on their own, without the interference of the binding vow they were once born with. The Zenin clan taking them back, or them forsaking it to be in your debt is a different story.
addons.title: Honor to the Zenin Clan

objects.text:
Alignment: Neutral Good
Gender: Female 
Sex: Female
Age: 16

Power: Heavenly Restriction that grants her tremendous physical prowess, mastery in armed and unarmed combat, and high tactical intellect in exchange for no cursed energy and ability to see cursed spirits. Despite this, she’s worthy of being a Grade 2 Sorcerer. 

She also has a variety of cursed tools to aid her, from weapons like Playful Cloud, Dragon Bone and Split Soul Katana, to glasses that let her see cursed spirits.

Note: You may decide if this is her Pre or Post Shibuya version. 

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: Tokyo Jujutsu High Student
Quality of Life: Bad. (Considered a disappointment to her family.)
objects.title: Maki Zenin (Jujutsu Kaisen)

addons.text: Just like her sister, you can get Mai in the state she'd be in if she was the sister who survived, giving her access to her full potential. In this state, Mai can now push Creation to its absolute limit, creating powerful cursed tools and constructs. As she is now, she could eventually rival Yorozu, a woman who could stand as an equal to the greatest sorcerers of jujutsu's golden age. Getting Mai this way does not stop you from getting Maki with her full potential unlocked either.
addons.title: Completed Sorcerer

objects.text:
Alignment: Neutral
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: 16

Power: Mai is a Grade 3 Jujutsu Sorcerer and expert marksman, but with less than average cursed energy. Her Cursed Technique, Construction, allows her to produce matter and even create Cursed Tools using nothing but her own Cursed Energy. The only limitation is that it takes an immense amount of Cursed Energy to create even something as small as a bullet.

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: Kyoto Jujutsu High Student
Quality of Life: Bad (Considered a disappointment to her family due to low level of cursed energy.)
objects.title: Mai Zenin (Jujutsu Kaisen)

objects.text:
Alignment: Neutral Good
Gender: Male 
Sex: Male 
Age: 17

Power: Toge is a Semi Grade 1 Sorcerer. His Cursed Technique, "Cursed Speech", infuses his words with Cursed Energy to will commands into existence, although it damages his throat the stronger the intended effect. For example, if he commands a target to “Explode” or “Blast Away” they literally will. 

Although it is less effective if the target has much more cursed energy than Toge. As every word is treated as a command, he cannot use normal language in conversation, and instead uses food ingredients in place of regular words to avoid blowback from the technique.

Appearance: Average
Civilian Identity: Tokyo Jujutsu High Student
Quality of Life: It Has Its Ups and Downs
objects.title: Toge Inumaki (Jujutsu Kaisen)

objects.text: Age: 17 Gender: Male Background A once normal young boy who would spend time with his best friend, Rika. After her untimely death, he would unknowingly curse her, causing Rika to become a vengeful cursed spirit tied to him and would cause harm to others in the name of "protection". After meeting Satoru Gojo, he would learn to control his Cursed Energy and free Rika. Power Yuta is a Special Grade Sorcerer with an immense well of Cursed Energy Reserves, skill in armed and unarmed combat, and proficiency in using Cursed Tools. His Cursed Technique, Copy, allows him to use a duplicate of the Innate Techniques of other Sorcerers by having Rika consume their body parts. He can also use Reversed Cursed Technique to heal himself and others. He wears a ring that can summon Rika to fight alongside him and refuel his Cursed Energy Reserves for five minutes.
objects.title: Yuta Okkotsu (Jujutsu Kaisen)

objects.text: Ryu Ishigori (Jujutsu Kaisen) Cost: 15 CP Gender: Male Age: Unknown (Incarnated sorcerer, at least 400+) Background Ryu is a jujutsu sorceror from 400 years ago who was incarnated in the modern day by Kenjaku as a player of the Culling Game. During this time, he eliminated a fair number of players in the Sendai Colony with zero regards given to any non-combatants caught up in the battles. He would later clash with both Takako Uro and Yuta Okkotsu, ending with his loss to the latter and his relenquishing of the points he amassed. He would later face Sukuna after he possessed Megumi Fushiguro, but this ended with his death at Sukuna's hands. Powers The jujutsu sorcerer with the highest recorded output of Cursed Energy, capable of releasing it as a powerful beam attack. In his canon incarnated form, this beam was fired from his cannon-shaped pompadour that becomes undone upon 'burning out'. Skilled in hand-to-hand combat and able to enhance body with cursed energy. Experienced and ruthless in battle, with a straightforward fighting style built on overwhelming firepower. Note You can alternatively get Ryu as a cursed object without a host, letting whoever eats or otherwise merges with that cursed object become his new host, being able to negotiate terms to not have him fully take over.
objects.title: Ryu Ishigori (Jujutsu Kaisen)

objects.text: Gender: Female Age: 30s Background While not much is known about her, she was once a Star Plasma vessel for Tengen and the one who trained Aoi Todo. Her ultimate goal is to create a world where Curses no longer exists. She has a very expressive and energetic personality, even in the midst of conflict. Power Yuki is a Special Grade Sorcerer and thus, a master at manipulating Cursed Energy and unarmed combat. She can reinforce her already amazing physical abilities, use Reversed Cursed Technique to heal herself, use Simple Domain and Domain Expansion. Her Cursed Technique, Star Rage, can add imaginary mass to herself or other objects like her shikigami, Garuda. This allows her to add more destructive power or force into her attacks or objects in question. The mass itself doesn't impede her or objects she touches.
objects.title: Yuki Tsukumo (Jujutsu Kaisen)

objects.text: Age: 16 Gender: Female Background A talented young sorcerer and granddaughter of Yuta Okkotsu and Maki Zenin, and younger sister to Tsurugi. Haunted by a rapidly progressing terminal illness (brain cancer), she enters dangerous territory by utilizing a death-defying binding vow to accelerate her cursed energy output, determined to make her time count while striving to match her legendary grandfather's legacy. She was later cured of brain cancer by Maru. Powers Yuka is a First Grade Sorcerer possessing high agility, expert martial arts mastery, and powerful cursed energy reinforcement. Rather than inheriting the Copy technique, she inherited the prized Ten Shadows Technique of the Zenin Clan, though she is restricted to using specific shikigami abilities or traits directly in combat rather than full traditional summons. Her combat style utilizes close-quarters martial arts mixed with special physical cursed traits like the Savage Jaw Strike and Biting Twist. She is able to summon Mahoraga.
objects.title: Yuka Okkotsu (Jujutsu Kaisen Modulo)

objects.text: Age: 39 Gender: Male Background Shiba is a veteran from the Seitei Wars. After the murder of his best friend Kunishige Rokuhira and the theft of the Enchanted Blades, he took his son, Chihiro, under his wing. Now three years later, they are after the murderers to take them down and recover the blades. While he is a good, and even forgiven man, Shiba struggles with his duty as a friend and as a mentor, where his desire to keep Chihiro safe is often in conflict with his desire for retrieving the blades and taking down Kunishige murders, and Chihiro's own desire for revenge. Powers Shiba can use Yōjutsu (Kagurabachi), and his sorcery is Itazura, or Wicked Tricks. It allows him to afflict themself or others he touches with 'errors', allowing the user to freely edit their positional information and physical properties. He uses it mostly in two ways: to teleport, able to cross shorts or vast distances; or increasing someone's weight, either for forcing someone in place or to deliver a stronger blow. The changes on the target aside from dislocation appear to be temporary, and he can't use it to cross dimensional barriers or heavily magically warded areas. He is an expert fighter, making full use of this power both offensively and as support, and is said to have reached the pinnacle of sorcery.
objects.title: Togo Shiba (Kagurabachi)

objects.text: Age: 7 Gender: Female Background Char came from a lineage of potent regenerators. While her mother tried to hide from people interested in this trait, they were eventually kidnapped and used as test subjects. While her mother passed away to give her a chance to escape, she was found and eventually rescued by Chihiro. While still carrying her trauma, she can now start to live a normal life her mother desired for her. Powers Char has the potential to use Yōjutsu (Kagurabachi). She has a hereditary power that allows her to heal herself of any injury flawlessly, being able to regenerate a leg in a minute. With some effort, she can use this ability on others, though much slower and draining, taking a couple of weeks to grow back another person's arm.
objects.title: Char (Kagurabachi)

objects.text: Age: 18 Gender: Male Background Chihiro is the son of Kunishige Rokuhira, the creator of the six Enchanted Blades used in the Seitei War. After his father murder and theft of the blades, he took the seventh enchanted blade made by his father and swore to recover the blades and take down his murderers. Despite hiding behind a mask of indifference and vengeance, Chihiro is a sensible and empathetic individual, who cares for anyone in need. He also struggle with his father role in the war, whose blades led to the death of hundreds of thousands of civilians, and with his own role of fighting their thieves being something his father wouldn't aprove. Powers Chihiro can use Yōjutsu (Kagurabachi). His true strength however lies in his Enchanted Blade, Enten. Enten can amplify his spiritual energy and manifest in three different powers, visualized as three different colored goldfish: Kuro (Black), the ability to project cuts; Aka (Red), the ability to absorb non-physical attacks to an extent based on how much energy was spent blocking them, and use them as his own temporarily; and Nishiki (Tricolor), which covers him in high-density energy, enhancing all his previously enhanced aspects even further, but at a high-energy expenditure. Enten can respond to Chihiro's wishes and needs to an extent. It can't create new, unrelated expressions. Still, it can, for example, create multiple smaller slashes with Kuro rather than a singular big one or adjust Nishiki to support his weakened body rather than enhance it. This sword is bound to him for life. If this bond were to be severed somehow, he might discover his own innate sorcery technique. On the mundane side, he is an expert swordsman and swordsmith, as well as a good homekeeper.
objects.title: Chihiro Rokuhira (Kagurabachi)

objects.text: Age: 17 Gender: Male Background Hakuri was born into the Sazanami clan. Suffering abuse and neglect due to his apparent ineptitude to sorcery, he left the clan when one of the clan “merchandise” killed herself in front of him. Joining Chihiro, he eventually managed to discover his true talent as a sorcerer, and they managed to dismantle the Sazanami clan as it was. Still facing issues with his self-worth, he now assist Chihiro with his quest to recover the Enchanted Blades. Powers Hakuri can use the power of Yōjutsu (Kagurabachi). He is also a rare case, possessing two sorceries: Storehouse and Isou. Storehouse allows him to send things to a subspace connected to him. When registering an object by covering it with his own energy, he can then transport it to and back from his subspace. It doesn't differentiate from people or inanimate objects, though the registration process can be countered by someone's own energy. Aside from that, they can communicate with people registered, and manifest their own image or of anything inside the Storehouse in the real world, and vice-versa. Isou is the ability to create and manipulate shockwaves. In its basic form, it can be used to hit people with devastating force and send them away, and with practice he could use it to move with its force or tear down buildings.
objects.title: Hakuri Sazanami (Kagurabachi)

objects.text: Age: 20~ Gender: Female Background Born into a famous clan of Sorcerers, Hiyuky joined the government to use her powers to fight those who abuse their powers as sorcerers. A very upright individual, she doesn't hesitate to question her superiors when she thinks their orders are wrong, or to disobey orders so she can save people. That said, behind her serious facade hides a battle junkie personality, enjoying fighting strong enemies. Power Hiyuky can use the power of Yōjutsu (Kagurabachi). Her sorcery is the Flame Bone of the Starving, a powerful sorcery that allows her to summon a giant flaming skeleton called Rikuo. She can either summon the body parts on herself to enhance her attacks and protect herself, or around her to hit her enemies or protect her allies.
objects.title: Hiyuky Kagari (Kagurabachi)

objects.text: Age: 20~ Gender: Male Background Tafuku is a calm person. Acting as the voice of reason more often than not, he tries to judge people from what he sees of them rather than their position or word of mouth. Despite that, he is a caring person when it comes to his allies, and he doesn't hesitate to fight when the need arises. Powers Tafuku can use the power of Yōjutsu (Kagurabachi). His sorcery is to create a dimension identical to ours, where he takes anyone he wants inside a range. The dimension is empty of people, and the only way for anyone to leave is if at least one person is “defeated”, either being knocked out or dying. His method of fighting is by going with a partner and defeating their enemy.
objects.title: Tafuku Mihara (Kagurabachi)

objects.text: Age: 40 Gender: Male Background Samura is a veteran from the Seitei wars. When he took his first life, the sight of it traumatized him, to the point he blinded himself. While eventually marrying and having a child, Iori, he soon left them, due to his regrets consuming him. After his wife passed, he returned to raise his daughter, and while they bonded, eventually his past caught up to him, and he left her once again to avoid hurting her. Years later, he has come to the conclusion that the current generation should not carry the weight of the sins of their fathers, and decide to carry this burden himself - no matter the cost. Powers Samura can use the power of Yōjutsu (Kagurabachi). He also has a unique sorcery that is currently unavailable due to Tobimune eternal contract. Tobimune is an enchanted blade that amplifies his spiritual energy. Made for a supporter role (but by no means harmless), it manifests its energy as black feathers, and has three expressions of power. Crow allow Samura to fill a round radius around him with crow feathers, and to swap locations with any of them. This is fast enough that he can use this to move over from Kyoto to Tokyo in a matter of minutes. Owl allows him to cover an area and darken it as if it were night and sense any spiritual energy in it, allowing him to sense individuals. This technique is inversely proportional, the larger the covered area the lesser is his sensory capability - he could track a specific sorcerer in a city, but could only track extremely powerful sources when covering the whole of Japan. And finally, Suzaku (Crimson Bird) conjures flaming feathers that burn those who touch but heal the user. He can imbue this in his attack for extra, explosive damage. It also has an extension technique called Eternal Suzaku, where instead of burning others, it can heal them, restore objects, and even resurrect someone affected by Suzaku if they die from it. Tobimune is bound to Samura for as long as he lives. If this bound were to be broken, someone else could use the blade, and he could use his unique Sorcery. While he is blind, Samura is able to use echolocation from the draw of his sword to pin-point accuracy, and is a fantastic swordsman with few equals.
objects.title: Seiichi Samura (Kagurabachi)

addons.text: Sento, the genius that he is, has managed to create a transformation system anyone can use to transform using your Gochizous. The form of the transformation system can be changed if needed, and you can also make Gochizous for the system itself that are comparable to even your strongest transformations.
addons.title: Secondary Riders

objects.text: Alias: Kamen Rider Build Age: 28 Gender: Male Background Born Takumi Katsuragi in the World of Build, he was the infamous "Devil's Scientist" researcher at the Touto Institute of Advanced Matter Physics, who alongside his father Shinobu was involved in the creation of Project Build, which was completed after Takumi had joined Faust, in order to kill the omnicidal Blood Tribe alien Evolt. This plan failed, resulting in Katsuragi being turned into the amnesiac Sento Kiryu by Evolt, with Katsuragi's new face being derived from Taro Sato. After many trials and tribulations, Sento would eventually succeed in killing Evolt between dimensions. Powers Genius physicist, inventor of Kamen Rider Build & Cross-Z's gear, adaptable combatant, and the Build Driver, allowing him to transform into Kamen Rider Build with various Fullbottles, which are themed after organic and inorganic objects and have form-specific powers. Certain Fullbottles can even grant their holder a temporary power boost once shaken.
objects.title: Sento Kiryu (Kamen Rider Build)

addons.text:
Your wish to gamble and gain power in doing so has been recognized and manifested for you in the form of a Desire Driver, ID Core, and a Fever Buckle. The Fever Buckle, when has slots that when activated, can land on any of the Larger Raise Buckles not made with the power of Creation or any Armed Raise Buckle. This doubles as a strength and weakness as you may get a form you are not used to or is weak. You can compensate for this by pulling the lever a second time, but no more than that.

As for the raise buckles themselves, any of them will equip you with armor on your top or lower half, depending on which side you put the buckle, as well as granting an enhanced physiology. Larger Raise Buckles will give you full armor on either half of your body and a higher physicality boost than Armed Raise Buckles, but either will give you a corresponding weapon when equipped on your top half.
addons.title: Fever Buckle

objects.text:
Titles: Kamen Rider Geats, Star of Stars of the Stars, God of Creation

Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: Over 2000 years (chronologically), appears mid-20s

Power: Genius-level strategy, peak physical condition, as well as mastery of the Desire Driver and multiple forms with enhanced abilities accessed through it. Later attains the status of a Creation God, capable of rewriting reality and creating worlds using the power of humanity's wishes. Immortal through reincarnation across iterations of the Desire Grand Prix. Additionally, he can use his power to create a Desire Driver, ID Core, and Raise Buckles for someone else, allowing them to transform.

Appearance: Handsome, confident
Civilian Identity: Former contestant of the Desire Grand Prix
Quality of Life: Detached
objects.title: Ukiyo Ace (Kamen Rider Geats)

addons.text: Your organization is now a company that you are now in charge of. What you plan to do with this company is up to you, but being able to keep transforming into Kamen Rider Zero-One will depend on you maintaining your presidency to be able to transform, so better be good at what you want the company to do, Shachou!
addons.title: Take Off Toward a Dream

objects.text: Alias: Kamen Rider Zero-Two II Age: Unknown Gender: Female Background Izu is a Secretary-type HumaGear from the World of Zero-One, a kind of self-aware robot that was made to be the secretary of the next president of Hiden Intelligence, Aruto, after the passing of his grandfather Korenosuke. She was there through thick and thin in Aruto's life as a president and a Kamen Rider. Due to her intimate ties with the Zero-One System, however, she was unable to have her data backed up for security reasons, which resulted in Izu being seemingly lost forever with her death at Horobi's hands, being rebuilt from scratch. The Zero-Two Driver, however, turned out to have a backup of her memories, allowing her to fully return. Powers Bureaucratic knowledge, secretary training, and the Zero-Two Driver. While transformed into Zero-Two, she possesses true quantum computing, allowing her to move fast enough that she can briefly be in two places at once and to potentially out-precog a precog. She's also armed with the folding sword Attache Calibur and the Progrise Hopper Blade, a sword that allows her to purify hacked/corrupted machinery, especially fellow HumaGears.
objects.title: Izu (Kamen Rider Zero-One)

objects.text:
Alignment: Chaotic Neutral
Sex: Female
Age: 27
Appearance: Beautiful
Quality of Life: Bad

Background: Nanami was born with a weak constitution and was sickly from birth. Growing up, she was unkindly looked upon by her father, who called her monster due to her unnatural talent and abilities, fearing her enough such that he would even attempt to kill her.

Personality: Nanami appears to be soft-spoken and gentle, however underneath this exterior lies a cruel disregard for even basic human values, critically lacking both human understanding and empathy.

Abilities: She can copy and master any abilities she sees, even those that are normally unlearnable, or intrinsic. She has already learned Kyotōryū, also known as the flow of the empty sword, a sword style that requires no sword. She has also learned myriad different ninja techniques, as well as supernatural strength, allowing her to be extremely lethal in hand-to-hand combat.
objects.title: Nanami Yasuri (Katanagatari)

addons.text:
Karura, having witnessed your mastery of the Niko Style, has chosen to devote herself to you with fierce loyalty beyond what she would have showed Tokita Ohma. Ever dutiful and unshakably committed, she went further—persuading her entire clan to follow her lead and pledge themselves to you as well. The scale of the Kure presence she brings varies depending on your selection:

Small Organization: 5–10 civilians and 5 specialists.

Medium Organization: 40–50 civilians and 10–20 specialists.

Big Organization: 100–150 civilians and 30–50 specialists.

Supervillain Base: The entirety of the Kure Clan—every civilian and every specialist without exception.

The You Foundation: Full global reach. This option includes not only the full Kure Clan but also the entire Wu Clan, along with every property, business, etc ever owned by either lineage anywhere in the world, granting you an unparalleled international network.

Keep in mind that even the so-called “civilians” are far beyond peak human capability in every way, and are each masters of various superpower level martial arts, including their clans Kure Assassin Arts; every one of them has been, or still is, a trained assassin raised in the brutal traditions of their bloodline.
addons.title: The Kure Clan

objects.text: Aliases: The Succubus Age: 16 Gender: Female Background Kure Karura , also known as The Succubus, is the great-granddaughter of Kure Erioh, and a member of the main branch of the Kure Clan. Powers Karura is a member of the Kure Clan, a lineage of “Supermen” created through centuries of extremely selective breeding. Their blood contains over twenty varieties of endorphins, which, combined with their abnormal physical resilience, grant every member muscle density and strength comparable to the lower levels of Superman Syndrome. The clan also possesses a technique known as Removal, which allows them to consciously suppress their brain’s natural limiters to unleash their full physical power. Karura’s Removal rate is 85%, second only to Raian Kure’s 100%.
objects.title: Kure Karura (Kengan Ashura)

objects.text:
Alignment: Chaotic Good

Age: 17

Gender: Female

Sex: Female

Power: Life-Fiber hybrid physiology that dramatically elevates raw strength, speed, and durability beyond human limits even without external gear. Her body self-repairs from grievous trauma with near-instant regeneration and sustains peak output under extreme stress. Heightened reflexes, balance, and spatial awareness enable agile rushdowns, aerial recoveries, and split-second reads in close combat. Inherent resistance to Life-Fiber domination and other coercive control lets her tear free of invasive influence through sheer will. As her acceptance of her hybrid nature grows, her performance spikes further—delivering building-cleaving strikes, tanking impacts that would pulp a normal fighter, and maintaining relentless pressure through pain tolerance and rapid recovery.

Appearance: Attractive

Civilian Identity: Transfer student at Honnōji Academy

Quality of Life: Moderate
objects.title: Ryūko Matoi (Kill La Kill)

objects.text: Gender: Female Age: 18 Background Simultaneously principal, student council president, & absolute dictator of Honnōji Academy and the surrounding Honnō City. This coup d'etat was a plan she put together to oppose her mother Ragyo's plans, by creating an army of Life Fiber using super-soldiers & establishing her perfect society. Her sister Ryūko does not yet realize that they're on the same side... Powers Before even considering her Life Fibers, Satsuki Kiryuin is a formidable foe, capable of enacting brilliant plans that take years to see fruition (like the plan to overthrow Ragyo), accounting for every contingency, down to minutiae like having her toenails modified with the same material as her sword in case she needs to escape from captivity, or carefully developing a stable meritocratic caste system. Her combat skills (again, sans Life Fibers) are enough to fight through 500 men and defeat an armed Ira Gamagori, and that was when she was in middle school. She is also so strong willed she effectively has the Perk "Invictus", able to subdue a 100% Life Fiber Kamui despite not being a Life Fiber Hybrid, with nothing but her will. The core of her powers however is the Life Fibers, including her use of her Kamui Junketsu & her Life-Fiber destroying sword Bakuzan (sharper than even a Scissor Blade). With Junketsu on, she can manipulate its form to her advantage (like creating grappling hooks or sharp blades), fly (due to modifications from Senketsu), and she gains super strength, super speed, super agility, & super durability.
objects.title: Satsuki Kiryuin (Kill La Kill)

objects.text: Aliases: Grand Couturier Age: 17 Gender: Female Background She was artificially created by Ragyō Kiryūin, who created an artificial Life Fiber womb within which Nui was grown, making her a Human Life Fiber Hybrid. She was raised as a servant to the parasitic Life Fibers, becoming the Grand Couturier of the Kiryūin Conglomerate. Powers Thanks to her unique biology, she has superhuman physical abilities and has an especially powerful healing factor, allowing her to release Life Fibers from her body to reform near instantly, pulling off feats like reattaching her head and reforming limbs. She can even form replicas of herself, albeit with weakened abilities. But her most noteworthy capability is her skill as a Tailor, allowing her to create Goku Uniforms which can grant their wearers superhuman abilities and, at higher tiers, even unique powers. She has also shown skill at modifying the ever-evolving Kamui, which is the pinnacle of this technology. As she herself acts as a source of Life Fibers, she can make use of her skills in any world.
objects.title: Nui Harime (Kill La Kill)

objects.text: Gender: Female Age: 40s Background As an elder of the Kiriyun Family, Ragyo was tasked with overseeing the safety and awakening of the Primordial Life Fiber, and was infused with its Life Fibers to gain tremendous power. To further her goals, she married Sōichirō Kiryūin to have access to his laboratory and skills as a scientist, which she used to attempt infusing her daughters with Life Fibers. Realizing the twisted nature of Ragyo, her husband would disappear and be killed for attempting to betray her, alongside her second daughter, or so she thought... Powers Ragyo is a Life Fiber Hybrid, thus having superhuman physical abilities, regeneration, immortality, and flight, to the point of overpowering both Ryuko and Satsuki's Kamui Forms simultaneously. She can wield dual swords modeled after sewing needles and change their shape to her will. As well as use Mind Stitching to mind control others, by manipulating Life Fibers into sewing themselves into a victim's brain. She can also wear her Kamui, Shinra-Kōketsu, to further elevate her abilities and gains the power of Absoulte Domination. Allowing her to neutralize the powers and transformations of others, as well as completely paralyze them. This version can affect beings beyond just Life Fiber Clothing as long as she is stronger than them.

Power: Tigress is one of the most powerful kung fu warriors in China, possessing unparalleled martial arts mastery and immense physical strength. As a member of the Furious Five and the most disciplined student of Master Shifu, she has honed her skills to perfection, making her a nearly unstoppable force in combat.

Her fighting style is based on Tiger Kung Fu, emphasizing overwhelming power, speed, and precision. She can take on multiple opponents at once, delivering devastating strikes with her claws and powerful kicks. Her combat instincts are razor-sharp, allowing her to anticipate enemy movements and counter them with ease.

Tigress possesses immense physical strength, capable of punching through solid stone, lifting massive objects, and overpowering even the largest adversaries. Her agility and reflexes allow her to dodge attacks effortlessly, while her endurance enables her to fight for extended periods without tiring.

Despite her preference for raw power, she is also a skilled strategist and can adapt to different fighting styles. Her dedication to discipline and perfection makes her one of the most dangerous martial artists in existence.

Power: Viper is a master of Snake Kung Fu, specializing in fluid, unpredictable movements that make her a formidable and graceful fighter. Unlike most martial artists, she lacks arms, but compensates with extreme flexibility, agility, and speed, allowing her to coil around opponents, dodge attacks effortlessly, and strike with incredible precision.

She is one of the fastest members of the Furious Five, capable of slithering through battlefields undetected and striking with lightning speed. Her fighting style revolves around grappling, acrobatics, and rapid counterattacks, making her nearly impossible to pin down. Her fangs, while not venomous, can still be used for close-quarters combat, delivering powerful blows that can knock out even large opponents.

Her ribbon-like body allows her to constrict enemies, wrapping around them to immobilize them completely. She can also use her tail as a whip-like weapon, striking from unexpected angles. Despite her lack of brute strength compared to Tigress or Monkey, Viper’s combat technique is evasive, tactical, and incredibly effective against larger opponents.

Her unique skillset makes her a master of deception and unpredictability, using feints and misdirection to outmaneuver foes. She is also one of the most graceful and acrobatic fighters in the Furious Five, often performing elegant spins, twirls, and coiling techniques mid-battle.
