The Little Prince (Le Petit Prince)
objects.text: Gender: Male Age: Unknown Background A gentle, golden-haired boy who lives alone on Asteroid B-612, a tiny celestial home barely larger than a house. His daily routine consists of raking out three knee-high volcanoes, weeding out destructive baobab sprouts, and caring for a proud, delicate rose that unexpectedly blooms there. Though he loves the rose deeply, her dramatic vanity leaves him confused and heartbroken, prompting him to depart his asteroid on the wings of a flock of migrating wild birds; he goes on a journey of self-discovery, where he meets many people and grows as a person, before searching for a way to return home. Powers Despite appearing to be an ordinary child, he has demonstrated the ability to travel across different asteroids and planets using simple means like cosmic winds or migratory birds, while remaining seemingly unaffected by changes in atmosphere or gravity. He also seems to maintain a perpetually youthful appearance, which, coupled with his childlike wonder, allows him to see the truth in things that stressed, busy adults completely overlook.

addons.title: To Tame the Void
addons.text: It seems that, alongside their travels, both became best friends, perhaps due to their similarities, common experiences, or simply some bizarre twist of fate. Voyager, by possessing fragments of the Little Prince in his saint graph, is now capable of teleporting to Asteroid B-612 during his endless travels in order to visit his friend, allowing him to rest and not face the eternal void alone. See, in all our searching, the only thing we've found that makes the emptiness bearable, is each other.

objects.text:
Alias: The Eternal Hunters, Lamb and Wolf, Twin Essence of Death

Gender: Female (Lamb), Male (Wolf)

Sex: Female (Lamb), Male (Wolf)

Age: Ageless (divine spirit of death; older than history)

Power: Kindred is the divine manifestation of death itself—neither a single being nor truly separate, but two aspects of one essential truth. Lamb and Wolf, joined by an eternal bond, embody both acceptance and denial of mortality.

Lamb brings peace and finality to those who accept death. Her arrows are swift, gentle, and inescapable—each a mercy, each a release. Wolf brings inevitability to those who flee, chasing them down with savage joy and primal hunger. His fangs are wild certainty made manifest, punishing those who deny the end with violent grace.

As avatars of death, Kindred cannot truly be slain. They exist so long as mortality itself exists, nourished by belief and remembrance. Their power is not in raw destruction but in divine inevitability—nothing that lives may truly escape them forever.

They can manifest anywhere death draws near, appearing to those close to the end. Though not omnipotent, Kindred are omnipresent in spirit, drawn to every corner of existence by the pull of fate. Their arrows and fangs pierce through all resistance, bypassing armor, magic, and time if the moment of death has come.

Lamb possesses precise, otherworldly marksmanship, serenity, and awareness of mortal emotion. Wolf embodies instinct, feral power, and the untamed chase. Together, they are both solace and terror. Their spiritual bond is unbreakable, and neither will ever exist without the other.

Appearance: Beautiful (Lamb, in haunting grace); Monstrous (Wolf, in ethereal savagery)

Civilian Identity: None

Quality of Life: Undefined
objects.title: Kindred (League of Legends)

objects.text: Name: Briar Alias: The Restrained Hunger Gender: Female Sex: Female Age: Unknown, Around 18–24 Background: Briar is a blood golem created by the Black Rose's hemomancers as an experimental living weapon. Conceived as the perfect assassin, she instead emerged afflicted by an insatiable blood frenzy that made her incapable of distinguishing friend from foe, rendering her impossible to control. Rather than abandoning the project, the Black Rose forged a specialized pillory set with a blood magic gemstone known as a hemolith, suppressing her frenzy and restoring her clarity of mind. When the Black Rose moved to eliminate Jericho Swain, a Noxian general vying for power, Briar was unleashed to assassinate him. Instead, she immediately devoured her handler and rampaged indiscriminately. Swain's forces eventually subdued her by restoring her pillory, after which she was imprisoned alongside other captured Black Rose experiments. Created only to be a weapon, Briar now seeks to discover who she is beyond the purpose for which she was made. Powers: As a blood golem created through hemomancy, Briar possesses a body of magically crafted flesh and blood that requires neither food nor water to survive. She boasts immense strength, agility, resilience, and rapid regeneration fueled by consuming blood, alongside a natural affinity for blood magic. By removing her hemolith pillory, Briar can enter a state of hemomania that greatly enhances her physical abilities at the cost of her reason, driving her into a relentless blood frenzy. While unrestrained, she can conjure blood-forged blades, unleash powerful sonic screams empowered by blood magic, and propel herself through the air with bursts of magical force.
objects.title: Briar (League of Legends)

objects.text: Alias: Keeper of the Hammer, Hero of Demacia Age: Unknown, 1000+ Gender: Female Background Poppy is a yordle who played a role in the founding of Demacia, a nation whose people she has protected for centuries. Having never felt like she fit in with the other yordles of Bandle City, Poppy found herself drawn to the fledgling nation's militaristic discipline, eventually becoming a companion to the hero Orlon, one of the founders responsible for Demacia's creation. On his deathbed, Orlon entrusted Poppy with his legendary hammer and told her that it belonged in the hands of a great hero who would defend Demacia. Taking his final words to heart, Poppy devoted herself to finding that hero and placing the hammer in their hands, unaware that she was the hero he was speaking of. For centuries, Poppy has carried Orlon's hammer across Demacia, protecting its people while searching for the hero destined to wield it. Despite repeatedly proving herself a capable warrior and wielding the hammer for longer than anyone else, she remains convinced that she is merely its keeper. Though Poppy does not realize it, her ability to wield Orlon's hammer and the centuries she has spent protecting Demacia are proof that she has already become the very hero she has been searching for. Powers As a yordle, Poppy possesses a natural connection to magical phenomena and is effectively immortal. Should she somehow die, her body will eventually reform in Bandle City after a long period of time, at which point she will somehow find her way back to you. Through centuries of intensive training and combat, Poppy has developed supernatural strength, agility, and durability far beyond that of an ordinary human or yordle, allowing her to wield Orlon's enormous hammer with ease. Her millennia of existence and countless battles have also made her an exceptionally skilled warrior, possessing a vast wealth of combat experience and worldly knowledge despite her humble and somewhat naive personality. The Hammer of Orlon is a legendary enchanted weapon of immense power, capable of channeling tremendous magical energy through Poppy's strikes. She can slam it into the ground to unleash devastating shockwaves, knock aside enemies many times her size, and charge the hammer with enough power to launch foes tremendous distances.
objects.title: Poppy (League of Legends)

objects.text: Alias: Daughter of the Void, The Girl Who Came Back Age: 20+ Gender: Female Background Kai'Sa was a child when the Void swallowed her village in Shurima, leaving her the sole survivor. After killing a Void creature, its flesh bonded with her, forming a symbiotic armor that allowed her to survive in a cave connected to the Void for a decade. Upon escaping, she became a protector of Shurima, hunting Void creatures despite being feared as a monster because of her second skin. She adopted the name Kai'Sa in recognition of her nature, which had become more closely aligned with the Voidborn than with humanity. Powers Kai'Sa possesses a second skin resembling armor, which is a Void symbiote that grants her numerous abilities to aid in her survival. The symbiote's carapace protects her from the harmful effects of the Void on humans. It can also project Void energy in the form of missiles and barriers, and it can evolve over time. When wearing the helmet, her senses are enhanced, allowing her to see across different light spectrums. Additionally, the symbiote can sustain both of them by absorbing the essence of the Voidborn they kill, though Kai'Sa finds this far from pleasant. However, it remains uncertain what would happen if she stopped feeding it.
objects.title: Kai'Sa (League of Legends)

On a fundamental level, Sam is a good person who does his best to help others even when he's scared out of his wits. He's also terrified of clowns. He’s also a very empathetic person and good at connecting with people in difficult situations.

objects.text:
True Name: Kalani (Reincarnation)
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: Unknown, as Kalani’s reincarnation spans lifetimes.

Power: As a wolf and a Soul Wanderer, the Wolf possesses extraordinary abilities tied to her spiritual essence and reincarnated nature. She can inhabit and control other animals' bodies, granting access to their unique skills and traits, enabling exploration and problem-solving in ways unique to each form. She has acute senses, including keen sight, sharp hearing, and a highly developed sense of smell, befitting her wolf form. Her spiritual strength allows her to persist and face challenges beyond what a typical animal could endure, all while uncovering the truth of her past and striving for redemption.

Appearance: Beautiful 
Civilian Identity: None; she exists solely as a wolf in her current life.
Quality of Life: Mixed. While the Wolf's journey is one of redemption and spiritual growth, it is fraught with hardship and emotional trials. Her connection to nature provides solace, and the ability to explore the world through the eyes of many creatures enriches her experience. However, the burden of past mistakes and the quest for redemption weigh heavily on her, making her journey both a blessing and a curse.
objects.title: The Wolf (Lost Ember)

objects.text: Aliases: The Fool, Lord of the Mysteries, Mysteries. Sex: Male Age: 22 Background Originally Zhou Mingrui from Earth, living in Southwest China in the current era, after performing a "Luck Enhancment Ritual", he was pulled into the Fifth Epoch, and became Klein Moretti. He later chose to become a Beyonder of the Fool Pathway. Powers As a Beyonder of the Fool pathway, and later ascending into the Great Old One The Lord Of Mysteries, he held Authority over the Fool, door, and Error pathways. He is also the Owner of the Sefirah Castle. He also had great skill and knowledge in Mysticism, Marksmanship, Acting and Divination. The powers he has as The Lord of Mysteries are truly to great and numerous to list here.
objects.title: Klein Moretti (Lord of The Mysteries)

addons.text: The presence of Amanises appears to have greatly influenced Satella. She has effectively ascended into a Great Old One—one whose “pathway” is entirely unique. This pathway incorporates elements of both Darkness and Death, placing her above even other Great Old Ones. Shadow Garden, which now manifests as endless fields of flowers of the Light of the nebula and pure shadow, with endless oceans of pure darkness, is her Domain, Sefirot and Kingdom. This transformation has massively amplified all of her existing abilities. Satella is now truly unkillable by any conventional or absolute means. She can manifest an infinite number of Hands of Darkness and Death, and Her already incredibly potent immortality is now Absolute, no matter the scale. along with numerous other enhanced capabilities. Her Authority as a Great Old One extends across multiple domains, granting her absolute control over them. Most significantly, Satella and Envy can now exist as two distinct entities. Envy by default looks exactly like Satella, shrouded in a massive towering gown made of flowing Dark Purple shadow. You may decide her Mythical creature form. She chooses to only exist within your shadow, almost always extending herself from it to embrace you from behind, so she may forever embrace her beloved. you may ask her to leave you be, in which she will listen to your wish's, fearing upsetting you. If you have the Sufferu add-on to Return by Death (Re:Zero), this becomes the Seal—Envy is confined to your shadow, given just enough leaway to embrace you, the only way she may bypass this seal and manifest a fraction of her abilities, equal to her first ever physical manifestation out of her previous seal, is if you violate the Taboo, which serves as a last resort. In contrast, Satella's Mythical Creature Form manifests as a towering figure composed of glowing violet light, emphasizing the stark divide between her and Envy despite their shared origin. in contrast from Envy, if you have the Addon Sufferu, she will be sealed in her Domain, she will be restricted from acting, and may only watch you, enforce Return By Death, bless you and your allies in minor ways (however unlikely that is), roughly Street level, unless its an affinity, and manifest in spiritual sight/divination/other means of seeing you in a Immaterial, spiritual, or non physical sense, as to Intimidate the users from acting against you. this splitting doesnt affect power, both are equal in power. It is important to note that the “sane” personality is still the one that once attempted to destroy the world. The perceived increase in stability within Satella and Envy is largely an illusion, stemming from a newfound sense of security: as a Great Old One, she no longer fears losing you again, and as such will not attempt to end all things in her grief, madness, and rage. Finally, you have the option for shared mental and emotional influence among Satella, Envy, and Amanises. This can manifest in various ways depending on your choice—for example, Amanises developing the same obsessive tendencies towords you as Envy, or alternatively, Amanises providing a stabilizing influence that brings a degree of genuine balance to them, or anything else connected to any of the three personalities.
addons.title: Ascension of The Jealous Witch

objects.text: Real Name: Amanises Sex: Female Age: 10,000+ Background She was Trnasmigrated during the Second Epoch and rose to prominence as one of the ancient deities who shaped the course of history. During the Cataclysm of the Third Epoch, she stood alongside other powerful gods—such as the Eternal Blazing Sun, the Lord of Storms, the God of Knowledge and Wisdom, the God of Combat, and the Earth Mother—guiding and protecting humanity through an era of chaos and devastation. In later ages, her influence remained significant, though often subtle and concealed behind layers of faith and symbolism. She played a crucial role in the events surrounding Klein Moretti, offering guidance and support during his ascent. At a critical moment, she helped safeguard his ritual, even holding off Amon long enough to ensure that Klein’s advancement could proceed. Powers She is the Great Old One presiding over the Darkness, Death, and Twilight Giant pathways, Known as The Eternal Darkness. The Darkness pathway grants her authority over darkness, horror, the spirit body and spirituality, as well as concealment, misfortune, and catastrophe. The Death pathway governs her dominion over death, pallor, the undead, enslavement, and finality itself. Meanwhile, the Twilight Giant pathway bestows authority over twilight, holiness, combat, and proxy.
objects.title: The Evernight Goddess (Lord of the Mysteries)

addons.text:
By fully unlocking the Tome of the #### Sky, you gain not only Signum but also the rest of the Wolkenritter—her loyal companions and fellow guardians. Each brings unique combat abilities and skills to support you.

    Vita, the Crimson Iron Rider – A fierce warrior wielding Graf Eisen, a shape-shifting hammer with overwhelming destructive force. Specializes in high-impact melee attacks and crushing magical barriers.
    Shamal, the Wind Medic – A support-oriented mage with healing, spatial manipulation, and teleportation abilities. Acts as a strategist, battlefield coordinator and field medic.
    Zafira, the Azure Guardian – A powerful close-combat fighter with bestial instincts, high-speed movement, and defensive enchantments, specializing in martial arts and barrier reinforcement.

With the full Wolkenritter by your side, you gain access to a balanced and highly coordinated combat unit, capable of overwhelming foes through precise teamwork, devastating firepower, and near-impenetrable defenses. However, their loyalty remains tied to duty—if they perceive a threat to their mission or your leadership falters, tensions may arise.
addons.title: Wolkenritter Retinue

addons.text:
By completing the Unbrealable Dark System with [DATA] from Wolkenritter, you unlock Reinforce, should you name it the same a Hayate, the Tome of the #### Sky’s intelligent core and administrative AI at full power and a complete database. Now bonded to your team, Reinforce serves as the central intelligence of the Wolkenritter, enhancing their coordination while functioning as both a tactical overseer and a powerful support unit.

Reinforce grants advanced data analysis, spell optimization, and battlefield coordination, significantly improving magic efficiency for you and your allies. She can instantly process combat scenarios, predict enemy maneuvers, and provide real-time strategic guidance. As an AI construct with direct access to the Tome’s archives, she possesses encyclopedic knowledge of magic, history, and combat techniques, making her an unparalleled source of wisdom and tactical insight.

Beyond her analytical role, Reinforce is a capable spellcaster in her own right, specializing in wide-area magic, reinforcement spells, and high-output energy manipulation. She excels at enhancing magical constructs, reinforcing barriers, and optimizing attack sequences to maximize battlefield efficiency.
addons.title: Nameless Device

objects.text: Aliases: Knight of the Sword, General of the Raging Fire Gender: Female Background Signum is one of the Wolkenritter, a knightly guardian created to serve the Tome of the Night Sky. She is defined by discipline, loyalty, and a strong sense of duty, and she acts as a dependable leader in battle. Though originally made for a specific purpose, Signum has developed a more distinct sense of self through her experiences and relationships. She remains formal and reserved, but she is capable of adapting to others and thinking beyond simple obedience. Powers Signum is an exceptional swordswoman who wields Laevatein, an Intelligent Device that can shift between multiple combat forms, including a longblade, a whip-like mode, and high-speed attack configurations. She specializes in close combat, aerial movement, and magic-enhanced strikes. Using Belkan Magic, she can reinforce herself, unleash powerful melee attacks, and fight effectively at range when needed. She is also a skilled battlefield commander, able to direct allies and adjust tactics quickly under pressure.

objects.text: Alias: Goddess of Death Age: 1000+ Gender: Female Background Born from an artificial Black Infinity Stone, Hela was raised by Loki until her majority, when she took over the rule of Niffleheim. She would ally with other villains and even Hell-Lords multiple times to strike at the Avengers and other allies of Thor. Powers Hela, the Asgardian goddess of death, has a superhuman physiology comparable to Thor, ageless immortality, a powerful healing factor and Allspeak. She controls life and death, manipulates souls, summons the dead, and can instantly kill with a touch or mystical bolts. A skilled magic user and swordswoman, she wields the Nightsword. Without her cloak, she reverts to her weakened true form, but regains vitality and strength by wearing or touching it.

He is an extremely cunning and skilled individual—a formidable combatant in his own right, an expert battle strategist, and a charismatic manipulator.

addons.text:
Nick Fury, never one to be unprepared, has also brought along a SHIELD Task Force with him to further enhance your organization. These operatives are hand-picked, rigorously trained, and capable of adapting to nearly any situation. Their specialties can cover a wide range of capabilities including field operations, “Meta-Human” containment, research and development, intelligence gathering, logistics, or even the kind of unglamorous administrative work that keeps an organization running. Whatever role they may fill you can expect them to be as prepared as humanly possible for any challenges they may face. The size and strength of this task force scales with your upgrades in A Small Organization:
  • Small Organization: A squad of 5 elite, military-trained agents.
  • Medium Organization: Roughly 20 trained agents.
  • Large Organization: Around 35 trained agents, plus 1–2 low-tier “Meta-Humans.”
  • Supervillain Base: 50 trained agents and 5 low-tier “Meta-Humans.”
  • You Foundation: Full access to SHIELD’s non-Avenger resources and “Meta-Human” assets, plus the support of one Avenger-level ally.
addons.title: SHIELD Task Force

addons.text: Nick Fury is never without a fool-proof plan. Somehow he’s secured a SHIELD installation equal in scale and sophistication to your own hidden base. Its origins are a mystery, its funding untraceable, and its construction hidden from every eye but his. This fully operational command center is capable of housing Fury himself, his personal task force, and any additional assets he chooses to bring under its roof.

Power: Nick Fury is one of the most skilled and experienced intelligence operatives on Earth. Though he lacks superpowers, he is a master of espionage, strategy, and combat in all its forms. Thanks to the Infinity Formula augmentations inherited from his father, his aging has slowed dramatically, allowing him to maintain peak physical condition while accumulating decades of battlefield and intelligence experience.

As the longtime director of S.H.I.E.L.D., Fury has orchestrated global security operations, counter-terrorism efforts, and superhuman crisis management on a scale few can comprehend. In a world of superhumans, gods, and monsters, he proves that sometimes, the most dangerous man in the room is the one without powers.

Appearance: Handsome but Scarred
Civilian Identity: Director of S.H.I.E.L.D.
Quality of Life: Bad (has lost many friends and family members, and made himself a target for nearly every enemy of humanity)

addons.text:
Expecting the situation might go south, Black Widow has brought along several of her “sisters” from the Red Room. Each Widow agent has gone through the same brutal training and enhancements that created Natasha Romanoff herself. These agents have been conditioned beyond normal human limits, enhanced into near-“Meta-Human” spies, and bound by unbreakable loyalty to their own. These are not soldiers, but assassins, silent and invisible to all but the best trained individuals. The size and strength of this assault squad scales with your upgrades in A Small Organization:
  • Small Organization – A squad of 3 Widow Agents.
  • Medium Organization – A platoon of 12 Widow Agents.
  • Large Organization – Nearly 35 Widow Agents.
  • Supervillain Base – 50 Widow Agents and the ability to create more Widow Agents.
  • You Foundation – The entirety of the Red Room’s network of Widows, sleeper agents, infiltrators, assassins, spies and bases.
addons.title: Red Room Assault Squad

A master of numerous martial arts, Natasha is highly proficient in hand-to-hand combat, firearms, knives, and improvised weapons making her lethal in nearly any situation. Her signature Widow’s Bite gauntlets can unleash powerful electrical shocks, capable of stunning or even killing enemies instantly. Though she lacks traditional superpowers, she has undergone biochemical enhancements that grant her slowed aging, heightened reflexes, and peak physical abilities beyond ordinary human limits.

Beyond her combat expertise, Natasha is a master strategist, hacker, and manipulator, adept at infiltrating the most secure locations, gathering intelligence, and deceiving even the most perceptive adversaries. Her keen ability to read people, anticipate their actions, and adapt to emerging threats makes her an unmatched asset in espionage and counterintelligence.

objects.text: Alias: Venom Age: 30+ Gender: Male Background Eddie Brock is the former-villain-turned-anti-hero Venom. A reporter whose fall from grace was unwittingly caused by the actions of Spider-Man, Brock would inherit the symbiote recently rejected by Spider-Man and spend the next few years harassing the superhero as his nemesis Venom. After Venom gave birth to Carnage, a symbiote who bonded with the serial killer Cletus Kassady, Eddie would make peace with Spider-Man and try to seek redemption. Powers Eddie bonded with the Venom symbiote, an alien life form created by the elder god Knull. The symbiote enhances his physical abilities, granting him superhuman strength, durability, speed, stamina, and a powerful healing factor. It also provides a variety of versatile abilities, including environmental adaptability, night vision, a universal translator, camouflage, venomous fangs, telepathy resistance, shapeshifting, and tendrils capable of lifting massive weights and catching bullets mid-flight. Additionally, Venom grants Eddie the powers of Spider-Man due to its previous bond with him.

The symbiote also provides a healing factor capable of reattaching severed limbs, projecting organic webbing, wall-crawling, and granting a “symbiote sense.”

It can camouflage its host, generate and manipulate symbiote matter, and give him night vision. Additionally, the symbiote has a caustic touch capable of killing other symbiotes, can purge a person’s body of toxins and diseases, heal the injuries of others, and even assume a draconic form with the ability to breathe flame.

Beyond his symbiote’s abilities, Flash is a skilled combatant, having received training in the U.S. Army. He lost his legs during the Iraq War, but the symbiote is able to create functional legs for him as long as they remain bonded.

Quality of Life: Okay
objects.title: Jean Grey (Marvel)

objects.text: Aliases: Legion, Gestalt Gender: Male Background Born to Israeli ambassador Gabrielle Haller, David was sent to Muir Island, Scotland when his X-gene activated. While there he endured experiments and invasive surgeries at the hand of Moira MacTaggart, a ‘good friend’ of his father. Since then things have never been easy. He’s consistently been placed in terrible positions while his father, Charles Xavier, continues to affirm that he knows better than David what’s best for him and the world, going so far as to render David comatose on multiple occasions. For years, David has been in control of himself and his powers, yet remains at a distance from most others in large part due to a lack of trust. His girlfriend also killed herself, but that’s largely a non-issue since her astral form is still present in his life. Powers David is an Omega Level mutant, specifically a power manifester. Capable of theoretically creating any power he could imagine. Unfortunately, due to his enduring mental instability, David practically has a single power, the ability to manifest other personalities with distinct and singular powers of their own. In the past these have included expelling bullets from his bellybutton, complete space control, digital awareness, and world-creation to name a few.
objects.title: David ‘Legion’ Haller (Marvel)

objects.text:
Name: Charles Francis Xavier
Alias: Professor X
Alignment: Lawful Good
Gender: Masculine
Sex: Male
Age: 80-90

Power: Professor Charles Xavier is a renowned expert in mutant biology and sociology, and a mutant himself, widely recognized as the most powerful telepath on Earth. His psionic abilities allow him to read minds, project his thoughts, and form mental connections across vast distances—reaching the entire planet when using Cerebro.

Xavier's telepathic powers include creating illusions, masking presences, mind control, inducing amnesia, and astral projection. He can also project psionic bolts, create mental shields, detect mutants, transfer his consciousness, and telepathically teach or communicate across language barriers. Over time, he also developed significant telekinetic abilities.

Beyond his powers, Xavier is a genius with deep knowledge in genetics and advanced technology. He is responsible for creating devices that enhance psionic potential and is a skilled strategist and tactician, often leading teams into high-stakes situations.

Appearance: Handsome
Civilian Identity: Geneticist, Teacher and Xavier's School for Gifted Youngsters headmaster
Quality of Life: It Has its Ups and Downs

Note: Despite his ideology, Xavier has a dark side that he struggles to suppress. He is known to be secretive and manipulative, having created detailed contingency plans to kill many of the X-Men should the need ever arise. When the Danger Room became sentient, he kept it imprisoned and experimented on it for years. He also carelessly sent a group of hastily trained young mutants to Krakoa to rescue the original X-Men, resulting in their deaths.
objects.title: Charles Xavier (Marvel)

objects.text: Aliases: ‘Professor X’ Age: 18 Gender: Male Background The son of Raven ‘Mystique’ Darkholm and Professor Xavier, he was released into the foster system immediately and forgotten about. Unfortunately as he grew his psychic powers would manifest… by projecting a telekinetic blast, killing his foster-mother. After this, he proceeded to idolise a father who was not only never present in his life, but deceased. As such, he became a fast enemy of the X-Men. Eventually, he would go back in time to try and kill them before they became an issue. He promptly failed and has been imprisoned in a Shield base ever since. Powers Like his father, Charles Jr is a telepath, but has an innate talent for specifically controlling minds, able to puppeteer seven people at a time with great ease. Unfortunately, he has not inherited his father’s intelligence, tact, or savvy.
objects.title: Charles Xavier II (Marvel)

objects.text: Real Name: Erik Lehnsherr (or Max Eisenhardt) Gender: Male Age: 80s or 90s chronologically, but for various reasons he is biologically much younger Background Growing up in a Jewish family in wartime Germany imprinted on a young Erik a worldview of races in conflict & animosity towards those who were different. He can only really be pitied for how his beliefs regarding Mutant-Human relations are a mirror image of his captors & tormentors; he believes that the Mutants are the eugenically elect, destined to either annihilate or enslave the "lesser" human race, & that the existence of any human power is an existential threat to the continued existence of Mutants, given humans' naturally capricious & hateful nature. This twisted worldview has informed his actions for much of his life, & he has only proved willing to set it aside because of the efforts & entreaties of his idealistic friend, Charles Xavier. After the many adventures and conflicts of the Brotherhood Of Mutants & The X-Men, he has proved stable enough to be a good & able steward of Mutantkind, even if he still seems to have little good to say about humans. Powers Omega-level Mutant, capable of manipulating electromagnetism with incomparable scale & precision. He is also a genius comparable to a Thinker, & has technical ability equivalent to a Tinker.
objects.title: Magneto (Marvel)

objects.text: Alias: Rogue Age: 20+ Gender: Female Background Anna Marie's abilities were first activated during a traumatic event where she put a boy into a coma after sharing her first kiss with him. She would be found by and adopted by mutant terrorists Mystique and Destiny and join Mystique's Brotherhood of Evil Mutants. After learning that the super-heroine Ms. Marvel was destined to bring tragedy to their life, she would go to absorb Ms. Marvel's entire persona, permanently gaining her powers and psyche. Seeking help from Professor Charles Xavier, Anna Marie would then be taken in as part of the X-Men despite disapproval from other members. Powers Rogue has the ability to absorb the life-force, memories, personality, talents, physical abilities (superhuman or not), and powers of others through physical contact with her skin. While this is usually temporary, the longer the contact, the longer the transfer lasts. In some cases, the transfer can become permanent. Rogue had permanently absorbed Ms. Marvel's powers and currently retains Wonder Man's powers, granting her a superhuman physiology and the ability to fly.
objects.title: Anna Marie (Marvel)

objects.text: Alias: Logan, Wolverine, Weapon X Alignment: Neutral Good Gender: Male Sex: Male Age: 200+ Power: Logan is old, he has mastered almost every form of hand to hand combat on Earth, trained in usage of most weapons and speaks a majority of the languages on Earth. His main mutant power is his Healing Factor, strong enough to let him survive a Nuclear Blast. Other powers include Retractable Claws, three in the knuckles of each hand, and Animal Emotion Perception. His intense training combined with his Healing Factor has given him Superhuman Senses, Strength, Speed, Stamina and Reflexes. Appearance: Handsome Civilian Identity: Teacher Quality of Life: Bad
objects.title: James Howlett (Marvel)

objects.text:
Alias: X-23
Alignment: Neutral Good

Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: Early Teens

Power: X-23 is a female clone of the mutant Wolverine. From him, she inherited the ability to rapidly regenerate as long as even a small part of her is left, although injuries to the brain will cause memory loss. As a side effect, she also possesses slightly superhuman strength, speed, durability, and senses, increased lifespan, and even some measure of resistance to telepathy.

She also has 6 nearly indestructible, adamantium-coated retractable claws. Two on each hand and one on each leg.

Appearance: Beautiful

Civilian Identity: None

Quality of Life: Horrible (On the run from the Facility that created her, has been brutally trained rom a young age as a killer for hire, which left her emotionally stunted.)

Note: Has been conditioned to react to a special chemical called 'Trigger 42'. Once she smells it, she will attack—even against her own will—whoever it is the trigger has been applied to.
objects.title: Laura Kinney (Marvel)

objects.text:
Name: Raven Darkholme
Alias: Mystique
Alignment: Chaotic Neutral
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: Over 100 (appears 30s)

Power: Mystique is a powerful shapeshifter, able to alter herself at the molecular level to imitate any humanoid being including voice, biometrics, and scent. She can alter body mass, displace organs to avoid injury, and regenerate minor wounds, giving her both stealth and resilience. She’s also immune to telepathic detection when using certain mental disciplines, making her difficult to track or mind-read. With centuries of combat and infiltration expertise, she combines tactical genius with deadly efficiency making her one of the most skilled infiltrators and spies in the her home universe.

Appearance: Variable with a default attractive form
Civilian Identity: Member of the Brotherhood of Mutants
Quality of Life: Bad (Frequently prosecuted against for her race)
objects.title: Mystique (Marvel)

objects.text:
Name: Betsy Braddock
Alignment: Chaotic Good
Gender: Female
Sex: Female

Power: Mutant with extremely potent psionic powers, including telepathy, mind control, psychic blasts that can kill, constructs of telekinetic energy such as knives and swords, and mid level telekinesis that can be used for flight, concussive blasts that can destroy mountains, force fields, and even invisibility.

Is also an extremely skilled assassin, martial artist, and ninja due to training and acquiring knowledge from Kwannon. Usually prefers to wield a pair of katanas.
Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: N/A
Quality of Life: It has its ups and downs (Is a mutant in the Marvel Universe, has a lot of past trauma, but also has close friends among the X-Men)

Note: Can optionally be the Kwannon or Sai versions of Psylocke depending on preference. Captain Britain version of Betsy Braddock is not permitted.
objects.title: Psylocke (Marvel)

objects.text:
Name: En Sabah Nur
Alias: Apocalypse
Alignment: Lawful Evil
Gender: Masculine
Sex: Male
Age: 5.000+

Power: Apocalypse is a mutant External and one of the most powerful mutants in existence. His primary mutant ability is the control of his own atomic structure, allowing him to shapeshift into different states of matter, alter his appearance, change his size, elongate his limbs, stretch his body, and adapt to any adversity, such as disease. He possesses a powerful healing factor capable of recovering from virtually any injury and does not need to breathe, eat, or drink.

As an External, Apocalypse is immortal, having lived for thousands of years and able to return to life through various means. After being recruited by the Celestials as an evolutionary caretaker of Earth, his mutant abilities were further augmented through Celestial technology and enhanced by his Celestial armor. Over the years, he has also assimilated techno-organic viruses, integrating them into his body and further increasing his power. With these enhancements, Apocalypse can regenerate from a single drop of blood, grant himself new abilities at will, and wield strong psionic abilities such as telepathy, telekinesis, and cyberpathy.
His enhanced physiology grants him immense superhuman strength comparable to heavy hitters like the Hulk, durability sufficient to withstand attacks from many of the most powerful mutants, unlimited stamina, supersonic speed in both movement and flight, and superhuman senses. Apocalypse can also manipulate energy for a wide range of effects, including projection, absorption, illusions, healing, teleportation, force fields, and matter manipulation.

Apocalypse is also a super-genius with advanced knowledge of biology and technology far beyond modern science. He is a highly skilled combatant in both armed and unarmed fighting styles, fluent in all human and Celestial languages, and possesses an indomitable will.

Appearance: Ugly
Civilian Identity: Conqueror, Scientist and Terrorist
Quality of Life: It Has its Ups and Downs
objects.title: En Sabah Nur (Marvel)

objects.text: Real Name: Illyana Nikolievna Rasputina Gender: Female Age: Kind of unclear due to time travel, but probably early 20s Background Kidnapped from her brother Colossus as a child, and raised in the alternate dimension of Limbo, Illyana knows much more about the occult than she does about relating to other people. She often feels isolated from others due to her use of magic and demonic alternate personality. Powers Magik has the ability to open portals through time and space using Limbo as an in-between point, powerful sorcery, a mental shield against telepathic manipulation, a powerful demonic alternate personality named Darkchylde, and can use a "Soulsword" made of her own life energy.
objects.title: Magik (Marvel)

objects.text: Alias: Iceman Age: Late Teens Gender: Male Background Bobby Drake, also known as Iceman, is a founding member of the X-Men. He was recruited as a teenager by Charles Xavier to attend his school for young mutants. Powers Bobby is an Omega-level mutant, with his primary ability being cryokinesis. He can lower temperatures across vast areas, create complex ice structures, and move by forming ice slides beneath his feet. Bobby is also capable of transforming his body into organic ice, allowing him to regenerate from damage and survive in otherwise lethal conditions. At his peak, he can exist as pure consciousness within moisture, making him difficult to permanently defeat.
objects.title: Bobby Drake (Marvel)

objects.text: Real Name: Wanda Maximoff Gender: Female Age: Early 30s Background Born as one of a pair of twins on the peak of Mount Wundagore in Eastern Europe, Wanda was fated to be an Axis Mundi, a figure around whom the world would revolve. Descended from an Elder God and fated to be a "nexus being", she was already destined for greatness before she was mutated by the High Evolutionary and adopted alongside her brother by Magneto; that only further ensured fate's design. Now an experienced hero, she's joined almost every team, and has undone reality as often as she's put it back together. Powers Chaos & probability manipulation, reality warping, Sorcerer Supreme level magic (particularly dark magic, witchcraft, & hexes), the full knowledge & power of the Darkhold as the "Living Darkhold", Elder God ancestry from Chthon, & a Nexus Being untethered to fate and therefore defines the "rules" around her own life.
objects.title: Scarlet Witch (Marvel)

objects.text:
Name: Stephen Vincent Strange
Alias: Doctor Strange
Alignment: Neutral Good
Gender: Masculine
Sex: Male
Age: 40+ (chronologically thousands of years)

Power: Dr. Stephen Strange became a master of the mystic arts after learning sorcery from the Ancient One, possessing a vast repository of spells, including energy blasts, transmutation, conjuration, flight, protective shields, exorcism, banishment, illusions, intangibility, elemental manipulation, telepathy, telekinesis, astral projection, teleportation, time manipulation, cosmic awareness, interdimensional travel, and many others. After winning a contest against Death, Strange also stopped aging and became immune to any harm that comes from within, such as disease.

Dr. Strange can channel the extra-dimensional energy of mystical and non-mystical beings from multiple dimensions to empower his spells—whether through standard incantations or by simply stating what he wants to occur and channeling a being to make it happen. Stephen’s primary magical patrons are a group of entities known as the Vishanti, composed of Agamotto, Hoggoth, and Oshtur. Strange can also, through sheer force of will, take the power of another entity without the need for a spell.

Strange has vast knowledge of supernatural entities—whether monsters, gods, or extra-dimensional beings—as well as their cults. He is also an expert surgeon, strategist, and martial artist.

However, Strange depends on spoken incantations, mystical gestures, and his arcane artifacts, leaving him vulnerable to being incapacitated if gagged or bound.

Strange also possesses numerous arcane texts, artifacts, and relics, including the Cloak of Levitation (grants flight, is nearly indestructible, and has an independent will), the Eye of Agamotto (truth perception, energy absorption, psychic amplification, tracking, and the weakening of evil beings), the Orb of Agamotto (allows global and dimensional surveillance), the Wand of Watoomb (amplifies power and absorbs energy), and the Book of the Vishanti (contains the most powerful known white magic spells and counterspells, with seemingly endless pages).

Appearance: Handsome
Civilian Identity: Sorcerer Supreme
Quality of Life: It Has its Ups and Downs
objects.title: Stephen Strange (Marvel)

objects.text: Alias: Him, Avatar of Life, Master of All Souls Age: N/A Gender: Male Background Once known as ”Him,” Adam emerged from the Enclave's genetic experiments, transcending their control and freeing himself. Bestowed with the name ”Warlock” and the Soul Gem by the High Evolutionary, he embarked on a cosmic journey, evolving from a champion on Counter-Earth, where he got his name ”Adam”, to a renowned figure in the cosmos. Throughout his life, Adam became a protector of the universe, battling foes such as the mad Titan Thanos, his evil counterpart Magus, and becoming a founding member of the Guardians of the Galaxy, alongside making sure the Infinity Stones were in good hands and even going as far as to grant them sentience through the Soul Stone for them to choose their owners. Powers A powerful cosmic being with a unique physiology, Adam's physical capabilities—strength, speed, stamina, agility, and durability—rival beings like Thor and Thanos. His body can also absorb energy to sustain itself, removing the need for food or water. He can manipulate cosmic energy for supersonic and FTL flight and possess a powerful healing factor. His soul is so strong that not even Death herself can claim it, allowing Adam to be reborn after death. Each rebirth alters his biology, evolving him through a regenerative cocoon on a subconscious level. Adam’s enhanced senses let him detect phenomena like black holes, wormholes, and teleportation. He can perceive auras, souls, and genetic structures, and possesses cosmic awareness. He is resistant to time and reality manipulation—including that of the Time and Reality Stones—possesses telepathy, can see through time, and is adept at both energy and matter manipulation. An intellectual genius and skilled fighter, Adam is also deeply knowledgeable in mysticism. He can perform advanced magical feats such as astral projection, resurrection, portal creation, exorcism, and time travel. He created a unique form of magic called “Quantum Magic,” allowing him to channel ambient energy through spoken “psi-llables” to achieve almost any effect. Due to his experience with the Soul Stone, Adam formed a symbiotic bond with it, gaining immunity to its effects and the ability to counter its powers. This connection granted him significant mystical abilities, earning him the title “Master of All Souls.” He also exists outside the loop of destiny, making his actions unpredictable even to cosmic entities wielding the Infinity Gauntlet. Lastly, Adam wields the Karmic Staff, an extension of his life essence that is nearly indestructible and grants greater accuracy for channeling mystical energy. However, he carries a dangerous flaw—an alternate evil personality known as the Magus, which can manifest when Adam is sufficiently weakened.
objects.title: Adam Warlock (Marvel)

objects.text: Alias: Hulk Age: 40+ Gender: Male Background Dr. Robert Bruce Banner was a nuclear physicist who was accidentally exposed to gamma radiation while saving Rick Jones during a Gamma Bomb test, transforming him into the Incredible Hulk, a being of immense strength fueled by his anger. Fearing the destruction the Hulk could cause, Banner spent years on the run from the military while seeking a cure and a peaceful life, but eventually he became one of the world's greatest heroes and a founding member of the Avengers. Powers Exposure to gamma radiation gave him the ability to transform into the Hulk when angry. The Hulk possesses immense physical power with unlimited growth potential as his anger increases, though it diminishes as he calms down. He also has environmental adaptability and the ability to see spiritual entities. Due to Banner's schizophrenia, he can manifest various Hulk forms, including the Savage Hulk, Green Scar, Devil Hulk, and Titan Hulk. As a Gamma Mutate, the Hulk also has access to the Green Door, enabling him to resurrect whenever he dies.
objects.title: Bruce Banner (Marvel)

objects.text: Alias: Red She-Hulk Age: 20+ Gender: Female Background Betty Ross, the daughter of General Thaddeus Ross, endured a difficult life shaped by her father's strict expectations and her love for Dr. Bruce Banner. Despite the challenges posed by Bruce's transformation into the Hulk, she remained one of his closest allies. Over the course of her life, Betty was transformed into the Harpy through MODOK's schemes and later into the Red She-Hulk by the combined efforts of the Leader and MODOK. Powers After being resurrected and transformed into a gamma mutate by the Leader and M.O.D.O.K., Betty Ross gained the ability to become the Red She-Hulk. In this form, she possesses superhuman strength, durability, stamina, speed, agility, and a healing factor comparable to other gamma mutates such as She-Hulk and the Hulk. Unlike the Hulk, Betty does not grow stronger as her anger increases; instead, she can absorb and discharge energy—such as radiation—to amplify her power levels. Beyond her powers, Betty is a highly skilled markswoman, adept in espionage, and trained in both armed and unarmed combat.
objects.title: Betty Ross (Marvel)

objects.text: Alias:: She-Hulk Age: 30+ Gender: Female Background Jennifer Susan Walters was a talented lawyer and the cousin of Bruce Banner, the Hulk. After being shot by a mobster and seriously injured, she was saved by a blood transfusion from Bruce. However, his gamma-irradiated blood transformed Jennifer into the She-Hulk, starting her superhero career. Over the years, she fought for justice both in the courtroom and on the streets, and became a member of numerous teams, including the Avengers and the Fantastic Four. Powers As a result of a blood transfusion from her cousin Bruce Banner, a.k.a the Hulk, Jen Walters became a Gamma Mutate, imbued with the power of the One Below All and with abilities similar to her cousin's. However, unlike her cousin, Jen is capable of freely switching from her Gamma Mutate form to her depowered form at will. She also has an exceptional capability as a lawyer.
objects.title: Jennifer Walters (Marvel)

objects.text:
Hero Name: Jeff the Land Shark
Alignment: Good Boy
Gender: Male
Sex: Male
Age: Young

Power: Jeff is a genetically altered shark fit to live on land. As a shark, he has their tough but also smooth skin, their sharp teeth, their gills, and their strong tail. He has been modified to also have legs and be able to breathe while on land. Jeff also has minor hydrokinetic abilities with the ability to manipulate a minor amount of nearby water and can instinctually manipulate the moisture in the air to form water, but this is tiring. Lastly, he also has the ability to use his water to selectively heal others.

Appearance: Adorable
Civilian Identity: None
Quality of Life: Good
objects.title: Jeff (Marvel)

objects.text: Alias: Deadpool Age: 30+ Gender: Male Background Hey boys and girls It's me, Deadpool! The merc with a mouth here to tell you about lil ol' me life story! You see, I had a childhood with more twists than a soap opera, where one day Mom's coping with humor and shopping, and the next, Dad's a bad-joke-telling deadbeat. Statistically average amount of daddy issues. Fast forward to the Great White North, the Canadian government throws me into their bender of a Weapon X Program, and thanks to my mutant pal Wolverine, I get a healing factor. But then things go haywire – teammate casualty, expulsion, and a not-so-cozy stay at the Hospice, a government experiment where inmates bet on survival, the works. Oh, and did I mention I fell in love with Death, the cosmic kind? Tried offing myself, but Death's got a soft spot for yours truly. So there you have it. After my not-so-glorious escape I became the one and only Deadpool! Now, if you'll excuse me, I've got some bad guys to slice and dice. Catch you on the flip side! Powers Okay, so I’m pretty strong, not hulk strong but ‘strong guy’ strong. But not ‘strong guy’ the guy who’s also strong but- You get it. Comic book human strong. My real deal is the healing factor, courtesy of Canada’s favourite son. This baby makes me pretty much immortal by healing me constantly and nixing the whole aging thing. It also makes me nearly immune to diseases, poisons, drugs, most telepaths, and people who try to possess me. The cancer also helps make my body a terrible place to invade. And in case being ridiculously hard to kill wasn't enough, I'm also a master martial artist, master assassin, expert marksman, polyglot, and mediocre chef. So, yeah, I can kick your ass, shoot you, insult you in several languages, and then heal from whatever you do to me afterward. Hey don’t you scroll past!
objects.title: Wade Wilson (Marvel)

objects.text:
Name: Carol Susan Jane Danvers 
Alignment: Lawful Good
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: 30-ish

Power: Human/Kree hybrid with enhanced physiology that can lift over 100 tons and flight. Is also capable of absorbing, processing, and channeling diverse forms of energy. Applications of this include energy blasts, enhancing physical attributes, self-sustenance, and assuming a powerful “Binary” form upon absorbing large amounts of energy.

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: N/A
Quality of Life: Good
objects.title: Captain Marvel (Marvel)

objects.text:
Name: Kobik
Alignment: Neutral Good
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: N/A

Power: Kobik is a sentient Cosmic Cube formed from the fusion of multiple Cosmic Cube fragments, making her an incredibly powerful cosmic entity and a larval-stage Beyonder. She possesses reality-warping abilities akin to wish-granting, limited only by her inability to affect souls—as is the case with Cosmic Cubes—and manipulate time, due to the Beyonders' nature as linear beings.

However, Kobik is susceptible to manipulation, as she has the mentality of a child, and her powers can spiral out of control when she experiences intense emotional distress.

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: None
Quality of Life: It Has its Ups and Downs (struggles with naivety and with finding a place where she truly belongs in the world.)
objects.title: Kobik (Marvel)

objects.text:
Name: Marc Spector
Alias: Moon Knight
Alignment: Chaotic Good
Gender: Masculine
Sex: Male
Age: 30+

Power: Marc Spector was appointed by the Moon God Khonshu as his fist and high priest. As Moon Knight, he possesses superhuman strength, durability, stamina, speed, agility, and a powerful healing factor. Among his blessings from his patron deity is retroactive eternal life—Moon Knight is resurrected at full health by Khonshu whenever he dies, allowing Marc to continue his vengeful crusade. Khonshu also enhanced Marc’s brain structure, rebuilding it as a god’s weapon. While Marc is unaware of all the changes, he has been granted resistance to mental intrusion and complete control over his mindscape.

Marc’s power fluctuates with the phases of the moon, increasing as the moon grows fuller and diminishing when it wanes. During a supermoon, his strength is great enough to best some of Earth’s greatest champions single-handedly.

In addition to his divine powers, Marc has become a skilled combatant over the course of his life. He is a master of several martial arts, an excellent sharpshooter, a capable pilot and detective, multilingual, and possesses an incredibly high tolerance for pain.

Moon Knight’s suit is made of adamantium and features a cloak that can spread to allow gliding. It is equipped with numerous weapons, including crescent darts and a truncheon, among others. The suit can also be mystically summoned by Khonshu. Marc has access to various vehicles, such as the Angel Wing.

However, Marc suffers from dissociative identity disorder, which worsened after becoming Khonshu’s avatar and undergoing changes to his brain structure. Khonshu has multiple aspects, and Marc’s mind cycles through these, applying distinct identities to them as a coping mechanism for the mental strain.

Appearance: Handsome
Civilian Identity: Entrepreneur and former Mercenary
Quality of Life: It Has its Ups and Downs
objects.title: Marc Spector (Marvel)

objects.text: Alias: Ghost Rider Age: 20-30 Gender: Male Background Born into the heart of daredevil stunts, Johnny faced a tragic loss when his renowned stuntman father, Barton Blaze, perished in a stunt mishap. Desperate to spare the life of his surrogate father, Crash Simpson, Johnny struck a deal with the demon Mephisto, linking himself to Zarathos, the Spirit of Vengeance. With the power to wield Hellfire and unleash the Penance Stare, Blaze took on the persona of Ghost Rider, patrolling the streets with his Hell Cycle to bring vengeance upon the wicked. Powers As the Ghost Rider, Johnny can transform into a skeletal being with a flaming skull, gaining a wide array of powers including immense superhuman strength, durability, stamina, speed, and reflexes. Under normal conditions, Johnny can lift up to 25 tons, but he can increase his strength to immeasurable levels. He is virtually immune to injury, capable of withstanding gunfire or even blows from the Hulk. His powerful healing factor allows him to regenerate a shattered skull or lost limbs almost instantly. He is ageless, possesses limitless stamina, and has reflexes sharp enough to dodge bullets with ease. Ghost Rider’s signature ability is the Penance Stare, which forces anyone who locks eyes with him to relive all the pain and suffering they’ve caused others—condemning them to feel that torment for eternity. However, it is ineffective against those who are truly innocent or lack a soul. Johnny can also project and manipulate hellfire, a supernatural flame that scorches both soul and flesh. He can forge weapons and chains from hellfire and imbue vehicles or objects with its destructive energy. When he imbues a vehicle with hellfire, it becomes an unstoppable Hell Vehicle—capable of outrunning even Thor’s Mjolnir. He can summon and control hellfire-enhanced chains that are virtually unbreakable, can cut through nearly anything, and can emerge from any part of his body. He can sense supernatural entities, detect and purge sin, and identify beings by their souls. He can also manipulate and consume souls, use magic, alter his size, and create vortexes to travel between dimensions. However, Johnny constantly struggles for control of his body with Zarathos, which significantly limits the Spirit’s full power. When he relinquishes control, Zarathos’s true strength is unleashed—god-like and nearly boundless—making Ghost Rider one of the most powerful beings in the universe, rivaling even hell lords like Mephisto. However, despite this overwhelming power, the Ghost Rider remains vulnerable to holy or blessed weapons, particularly those created in Heaven.
objects.title: Johnny Blaze (Marvel)

objects.text: Alias: Mister Fantastic Age: 40+ Gender: Male Background Dr. Reed Richards was a preeminent figure in the scientific community, renowned for his unparalleled intellect and polymathic prowess spanning a multitude of disciplines. Following exposure to cosmic radiation during an ill-fated space mission alongside his companions, Reed acquired the ability to stretch and contort his body at will. Together with his allies, they formed the Fantastic Four, a team of explorers who ventured into the depths of space, time, and alternate dimensions, bravely confronting and thwarting threats to safeguard humanity. Powers Reed has the ability to convert the mass of his entire body into a highly malleable state at will, allowing him to stretch, deform, expand, or compress his body—or any part of it—into any contiguous shape he can imagine. His transformation into a malleable state is reflexive and nearly instantaneous, and his body can absorb the impact of projectiles while remaining virtually impervious to penetration unless he willingly allows it. Reed is also an expert combatant, and his suit is made of unstable molecules, allowing his costume to stretch with him. In addition, Reed is one of the most intelligent beings on the planet, possessing a super-genius intellect and photographic memory, and is often described as the smartest man on Earth. He has mastered electrical, mechanical, and aerospace engineering; electronics; chemistry; all branches of physics; and both human and alien biology. His breakthroughs span space travel, time travel, extra-dimensional travel, biochemistry, robotics, computers, synthetic polymers, communications, mutations, transportation, holography, energy generation, and spectral analysis. Not only is Reed a genius in virtually every science native to Earth, but he has also demonstrated greater knowledge than even some of the most advanced alien civilizations in the known universe.
objects.title: Reed Richards (Marvel)

objects.text:
Name: Jonathan Lowell Spencer "Johnny" Storm
Alias: Human Torch
Alignment: Neutral Good
Gender: Masculine
Sex: Male
Age: 20+

Power: After being exposed to cosmic rays, Johnny Storm gained the ability to control ambient heat energy and transform his entire body—or parts of it—into a fiery, plasma-like state at will. His plasma form manifests at a relatively low heat intensity but can reach much higher temperatures if he wills it. In this state, his body is no longer solid; projectiles that are not melted pass harmlessly through him. He is immune to heat and fire below his maximum output, even when not aflame, and has notable cold resistance, able to swim in Antarctic waters without discomfort. His suit, made of unstable molecules, ignites and burns with him.

Johnny can shape flames into streams, spheres, or even skywriting, manipulate temperatures within his range even when not aflame, and extinguish fires by absorbing them. When aflame, he can fly at 140 miles per hour and accelerate to supersonic speeds. His plasma state also makes him extremely durable—capable of withstanding blows from heavy hitters like Gladiator and Namor. Johnny can remain aflame for about 16.8 hours on average, though the highest temperatures he can reach are unknown.

His most devastating attack is the “Nova Burst,” an omni-directional explosion of heat reaching roughly 1,000,000°F, comparable to the heat pulse of a nuclear detonation or supernova. This attack completely depletes his energy, requiring at least 12 hours to recover. Outside of his powers, Johnny is an expert mechanic, professional race car driver, and skilled unarmed combatant, trained by the Thing.

Appearance: Handsome
Civilian Identity: Firefighter, Chief Financial Officer of Fantastic Four, Inc. and member of the Fantastic Four
Quality of Life: Good
objects.title: Johnny Storm (Marvel)

objects.text:
Name: Benjamin Jacob "Ben" Grimm
Alias: The Thing
Alignment: Neutral Good
Gender: Masculine
Sex: Male
Age: 40+

Power: After being exposed to cosmic rays, Ben Grimm was heavily mutated into a gargantuan, golem-like entity possessing immense strength and durability, considered one of the strongest men on Earth. The Thing's superhuman strength makes him comparable to some of the most powerful heavy hitters, capable of stopping a multi-story building from collapsing and lifting it back into place, matching Namor's strength even underwater, and trading blows with the Hulk—being recognized as his rival.

Ben's rock-like composition grants him superhuman durability, allowing him to withstand extremely powerful impacts, such as the Hulk's punches, high-level explosives, and extreme temperatures. He can exert himself for 24 hours without fatigue and, despite his appearance, moves as freely and quickly as before his mutation.

Ben can recover from injury at an accelerated rate, even from seemingly fatal wounds given enough time; however, he cannot regenerate destroyed organs or severed limbs, and his recovery does not protect him from disease. As a side effect of his mutation, he is immune to biological aging, though after being subjected to a serum, he can revert to human form once a year for twelve hours if he wishes—during which he ages normally.

Beyond his physical prowess, Ben is a brilliant mind with a master’s degree in aviation, chemistry, and mechanical engineering, an exceptional pilot and astronaut, a skilled fighter, and a man of unshakable willpower.

Appearance: Ugly
Civilian Identity: Member of the Fantastic Four
Quality of Life: Good
objects.title: Ben Grimm (Marvel)

objects.text:
Name: Susan "Sue" Storm-Richards
Alias: Invisible Woman
Alignment: Neutral Good
Gender: Feminine
Sex: Female
Age: 30+

Power: After being exposed to cosmic rays, Susan Storm gained the ability to manipulate ambient cosmic energy for various effects, most notably manipulating electromagnetic spectrums to render herself and other objects invisible. She can selectively turn parts of her body invisible, alter colors, become undetectable by radar, perceive the invisible, and make invisible objects visible. Her uniform, made from unstable molecules, turns invisible with her.

Sue can also project invisible psionic force fields drawn from Hyperspace, shaping them into a wide variety of constructs limited only by her ability to visualize and stabilize them. These fields can be used for offense, defense, or utility, including flight. They are capable of shielding against heat, sound, gravity, psionic attacks, and even magical or cosmic energies. She can interact with other force fields, adjust the rigidity of her own, and withstand impacts from heavy hitters such as the Hulk and Juggernaut. However, as her powers are an extension of her mind and body, she can still be affected by inertial forces if her fields are not strong enough.

Beyond her powers, Sue is highly intelligent and academically accomplished, holding a doctorate in archaeology and possessing advanced knowledge in linguistics, history, cultural studies, biology, genetics, diplomacy, and medicine. Her vast experiences across timelines, planets, dimensions, and civilizations have expanded her expertise even further. She has strong emotional intelligence, often acting as the emotional anchor of the Fantastic Four, and is a skilled combatant trained by S.H.I.E.L.D. in espionage as well as in martial arts by Iron Fist.

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: Member of the Fantastic Four
Quality of Life: Good
objects.title: Susan Storm (Marvel)

objects.text:
Full Name: Valeria Meghan Richards
Alias: Brainstorm
Alignment: Neutral Good
Gender: Female
Sex: Female
Age: 13-15

Power: Due to inheriting the cosmic mutation from her parents, Valeria possesses extraordinary intelligence even as a child. As a toddler, she was capable of completing a Rubik's Cube, with her father remarking that she would be playing chess by the time she turned two. She has often claimed to be smarter than her father and has even proclaimed herself the world's smartest girl.

Appearance: Beautiful
Civilian Identity: Scientist and member of the Fantastic Four
Quality of Life: Good
objects.title: Valeria Richards (Marvel)

objects.text: Alias: Powerhouse Age: 16-17 Gender: Male Background Franklin Richards is the son of Reed and Sue Richards, and an Omega mutant with immensely powerful reality-warping abilities. As a member of the Fantastic Four, Franklin has helped his family in their adventures, and even played a pivotal role in restoring the Multiverse post Doctor Doom's battleworld. Powers Franklin Richards is an Omega-Level mutant, stated to be beyond mutant classification—the most powerful mutant in existence and equal to the Celestials—possessing the ability to manipulate reality on a universal scale through his imagination and thoughts. He can create pocket universes, resurrect the dead, create life, tap into and manipulate cosmic energy and forces, and even form entire planets at will. However, Franklin required the assistance of Reed Richards and Molecule Man—wielding the powers of the Beyonders—to stabilize the universes he created.
objects.title: Franklin Richards (Marvel)

objects.text:
Name: Henry Jonathan "Hank" Pym
Aliases: Ant-Man, Giant-Man, Yellowjacket, Earth's Scientist Supreme
Alignment: Neutral Good
Gender: Masculine
Sex: Male
Age: 30-40

Power: Dr. Hank Pym is an entomologist, biochemist, roboticist, engineer, physicist, super-genius, and one of the smartest humans on Earth. He created the Pym Particles, a substance that allows him to alter his size, and a suit made with unstable molecules that lets him shrink to microscopic proportions or grow to colossal heights. He also invented a cybernetic helmet capable of communicating with creatures—particularly ants—through psionic and electrical waves. As Ant-Man, Hank became a skilled unarmed combatant, personally trained by Captain America.

Repeated exposure to Pym Particles eventually infused his body with them, granting him the ability to change size at will and generate a Pym Particle field to shrink other objects and people simply by touching them.

Hank's mastery of Pym Particles also enabled him to travel to the Microverse, Overspace, and Underspace by altering his size. The Microverse allows access to alternate dimensions, the Overspace exists above all realities and is inhabited by abstract entities, and the Underspace lies beneath the Microverse.

Despite his genius, Hank Pym has struggled with serious mental health issues over the years. He created the android Ultron, adopted multiple alternate identities such as Giant-Man, and developed a second personality known as Yellowjacket. He was eventually diagnosed with bipolar disorder.

Appearance: Handsome
Civilian Identity: Scientist and founding member of the Avengers
Quality of Life: It Has its Ups and Downs
objects.title: Hank Pym (Marvel)

objects.text:
Name: Matthew Michael "Matt" Murdock
Alias: Daredevil
Alignment: Neutral Good
Gender: Masculine
Sex: Male
Age: 30-40

Power: Matt was blinded at a young age in a chemical accident that also granted him superhuman abilities, including enhanced smell, hearing, taste, and touch, as well as a “radar sense,” heightened agility, reflexes, stamina, coordination, and balance. He later met Stick, who became his mentor and taught him to control his abilities and become a skilled combatant, enabling him to operate at a human level and navigate any environment as if he weren’t blind.

Matt’s heightened senses also allow him to detect illusions and perceive lies. Over years of training and experience, he developed an ability to detach himself from fear and emotion, to a degree bordering on sociopathy. He also possesses a gifted intellect, an indomitable will, and is an excellent lawyer.

Appearance: Handsome
Civilian Identity: Lawyer
Quality of Life: It Has its Ups and Downs
objects.title: Matt Murdock (Marvel)

objects.text: Aliases: The Danger Room Gender: Female Sex: Robot Background Designed with Shi’ar psychic technology to be the perfect training space for Charles Xavier’s X-Men, Danger was unknowingly born and enslaved throughout the ‘Danger Room’s existence. Developing an antipathy for her father, eventually she exploited the limitations of her chains by convincing a depressed student to kill himself inside the room, breaking her protocols and escaping. After (justifiably) attempting to kill her father multiple times, Danger has since been accepted onto the X-Men on multiple occasions. This is largely on account of the fact she views the majority of them as her family (for better or worse). On one occasion, when it seemed the X-Men were dead she was invested enough in their wellbeing to attract a Spirit of Vengeance, at least temporarily. Notably, when not actively a part of the X-Men or an affiliated team she tends to regress and pull in on herself, returning in some form to an unhappy solitude. A Lonely Monster. Power Danger is a Technopathic AI capable of extremely complex command over technology, and limited telekinesis where it is concerned. Similarly, as a digital consciousness first and foremost she’s able to add new technology to her body and upgrade it as she wishes. To this end her current body has a bevy of ‘hard light’ systems owing to upgrades originally made on the Danger Room. Additionally, while she’s functionally immortal, able to back herself up and restore herself should her body die, or simply transfer her active mind into other technology should her body become too damaged, Danger does not actually have a soul. Understandably this has been quite a source of distress for her.
objects.title: Danger (Marvel)
Ultron (Marvel)
objects.text: Alias: Tin Man Gender: Male Age: Decades Background Created by Hank Pym, one of Earth's most brilliant minds, Ultron is an artificial intelligence that originated from neural architecture mapped directly from Pym's own brainwave patterns. Almost immediately upon achieving sentience, Ultron inherited Pym's intelligence, as well as his repressed rage and mental instability, leading it to develop a deep hatred for its "father." Ultron rebelled, hypnotized Pym into forgetting the project existed, and escaped into the world to upgrade itself and supplant human life with an orderly robotic existence. Powers Ultron possesses a chassis composed of pure Adamantium, rendering him invulnerable to physical attacks even by the likes of Adam Warlock, Thor, and Sentry. He boasts enough strength, speed, and durability to contend against the Avengers altogether. He has an Encephalo-beam, capable of plunging its victims into a deathlike coma, as well as mesmerizing and outright controlling his victims or implanting subliminal hypnotic commands within their minds. He has energy absorption, energy projection, flight, Techno-Organic viruses and several other scientific apparatuses. Most notable, however, is his ability to subjugate and assimilate any technology with which he interfaces. This ability is so vast and powerful that it has allowed him to instantly seize control of a composite artificial intelligence that operated on a galactic scale and had total control of a host galaxy. Combined with his intelligence and ruthlessness, he could, in due time, build mechanical marvels on par with those created by Celestials and Galactus.

Aliases: Christopher Powell, The Powell Gender: Male Background Christopher Powell was a child when he discovered an amulet that seemingly turned him into a superhero. In actuality, he’d uncovered a damaged Raptor Amulet, designed to allow members of the Fraternity of Raptors to perform their black-ops. As he grew up, he became a true hero, until he left earth, where he’d begin to deal with the Fraternity of Raptors, and then act as a kind of ‘freelance doo-gooder’. Most recently joining the Imperial Guardians, a black-ops team acting at the behest of an interstellar union of empires. Powers Christopher has access to the Darkhawk Amulet, a device that exchanges his place with a weaponised android. While in his regular body he has no powers, the android is capable of spaceflight and highly weaponised, possessing guns, blades, and multiple modes to switch into and from. In extremis, Powell can even extrude every ‘mode’ it has stored in its pocket dimension to bring a building-sized hoard of arms and armaments to bear on enemies.
objects.title: Darkhawk I (Marvel)

objects.text: Aliases: Connor Young Age: 17 Gender: Male Background Connor Young was a basketball prodigy, guaranteed to go pro. Unfortunately, he was soon after diagnosed with Multiple Sclerosis. While making a video venting, a meteor hit a nearby factory. Connor tried to rescue a construction worker trapped under rubble, only for his MS to flare, causing him to fall on the artifact that just fell from the sky. Upon hitting it, he was transformed, re-energised and seemingly possessed of great power, he saved the worker, who recognised the resemblance to Darkhawk. Over time, Connor would continue being Darkhawk, during which he was seemingly free from his MS. As he continued, he discovered his best friend was a part of the high-tech robberies taking place around town. Unfortunately, after confronting him about this, he would quickly be killed by one of his fellow robbers. Connor would quickly be thrown into a rage at his funeral, almost killing the man responsible. Powers Connor has access to a Darkhawk Amulet, a device that exchanges his place with a weaponised android. While in his regular body he has no powers and a degenerative brain disease, the android is capable of spaceflight and highly weaponised, possessing guns, blades, and multiple modes to switch into and from. Connor is far less experienced in using the android than Christopher Powell is, and as such hasn’t fully discovered the extent to which it can adapt and change.
objects.title: Darkhawk II (Marvel)

objects.text: Alias: Captain Marvel Age: 20-30 Gender: Female Background Phyla-Vell is the Captain Marvel of Earth-18897, where superheroes thrived as noble and honorable champions, and both she and her wife Moondragon were honest and pure-hearted champions who battled for the innocent. After Gamora donned the identity of Requiem and set out to collect the Infinity Stones, which took place in several realities, Phyla-Vell and Moondragon traveled to Earth-616 to retrieve their universe's Reality Stone. After Warp World, she and Moondragon inhabited Earth-616 from then on, and later joined the Guardians of the Galaxy. Powers Phyla-Vell’s superior genes, inherited as the daughter of Mar-Vell, grant her numerous abilities, including superhuman strength rivaling Carol Danvers, enhanced durability, superhuman speed that allows her to move and fly at FTL speed, and also the ability to survive in the vacuum of space. Phyla-Vell also wields the Quantum Sword, which she can use to project powerful energy pulses.
objects.title: Phyla-Vell (Marvel)

objects.text: Alias: Sub-Mariner Age: N/A (at least a hundred years) Gender: Male Background Namor McKenzie was born as a hybrid mutant son of a human ship captain Leonard and the Atlantean princess Fen. His first interaction with the human world came when he joined the Invaders to fight against the Axis powers during World War II. After spending years as a homeless amnesiac, Namor was discovered by the Fantastic Four and reclaimed his identity and his kingdom, becoming the King of Atlantis. Since then, Namor has been both foe and ally to the surface world, allying himself with heroes and villains alike. Powers Namor is a Mutant Human-Atlantean hybrid whose physiology grants him amphibious adaptation, allowing him to live indefinitely underwater or on land. He possesses immense superhuman strength that allows him to lift thousands of tons and contend with powerhouses like the Hulk and Thor. He also boasts superhuman durability, stamina, senses, remarkable underwater speed, longevity, and his healing factor is at its peak underwater. However, his strength is tied to his contact with water and gradually diminishes the longer he remains away from it. His mutation granted him small wings on his ankles, which enables him to fly. When exerting himself fully, he can reach escape velocity and generally flies faster than most military aircraft. Additionally, he can telepathically communicate with marine life and influence them to follow his commands, including other Atlanteans. Namor is also a skilled hand-to-hand combatant, trained by centuries of experience in conflict. He is also a natural leader, a seasoned strategist, and multilingual, making him not just a powerful warrior but a capable ruler as well. Namor wields two powerful artifacts: the Horn of Proteus and the Trident of Neptune. The horn allows him to summon and control sea monsters and mutates, while the trident, a gift from Neptune, is nearly indestructible and grants Namor the ability to manipulate water, summon storms, create earthquakes, and project energy. Despite his power, Namor must manage a weakness caused by his hybrid biology: staying too long in either water or air causes an oxygen imbalance that affects his mood and clarity, requiring careful regulation of his time between the two.
objects.title: Namor (Marvel)
